en.description: When a user opens a Benshi SDK nudge notification, this screen records the open and sends the tap to the app’s configured action or returns to the app.
en.disableEffect: Tapping a Benshi nudge will no longer be handled by this screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 Benshi SDK 的提醒通知时，此页面会记录打开事件，并将点击交给应用配置的操作，或返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，点击 Benshi 提醒时将无法通过此页面处理。

en.description: When a user dismisses a Benshi SDK nudge notification, this receiver records the dismissal.
en.disableEffect: Benshi will no longer receive the dismissal event through this receiver.

zh-CN.description: 用户关闭 Benshi SDK 的提醒通知时，此接收器会记录这次关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，Benshi 将无法通过此接收器收到关闭提醒的事件。

en.description: When a user taps a Benshi SDK nudge notification, this receiver processes the tap and tries to open the app if handling fails.
en.disableEffect: Taps on Benshi nudge notifications will no longer be processed by the SDK.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击 Benshi SDK 的提醒通知时，此接收器会处理点击；处理失败时会尝试打开应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，SDK 将无法处理 Benshi 提醒通知上的点击。

en.description: When Android reports a network connection change, the Benshi SDK checks connectivity and schedules a fetch for new nudges.
en.disableEffect: Benshi will no longer schedule nudge fetches through this connectivity receiver.

zh-CN.description: Android 检测到网络连接变化时，Benshi SDK 会检查网络状态并安排获取新提醒。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，Benshi 将无法通过此网络接收器安排提醒获取任务。

en.description: When the user removes the app from recent tasks, the Benshi SDK service records an app-close event and stops.
en.disableEffect: Benshi will no longer record app-close events through this service.

zh-CN.description: 用户从最近任务中移除应用时，Benshi SDK 会通过此服务记录应用关闭事件，然后停止服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，Benshi 将无法通过此服务记录应用关闭事件。

en.description: The CardScan.ai insurance scanning screen is launched by the app with scan settings; it loads the bundled scanner interface and returns card data, an error, or a cancellation.
en.disableEffect: The app’s insurance card scanning flow will not open, so users cannot capture or return card details.

zh-CN.description: 应用提供扫描设置并打开 CardScan.ai 保险卡扫描界面；该页面载入内置扫描流程，并向应用返回卡片信息、错误或取消结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，应用的保险卡扫描流程将无法打开，用户也无法扫描并返回卡片信息。

en.description: When a user opens a Causal Foundry SDK nudge notification, this screen records the open and sends the tap to the app’s configured action or returns to the app.
en.disableEffect: Tapping a Causal Foundry nudge will no longer be handled by this screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 Causal Foundry SDK 的提醒通知时，此页面会记录打开事件，并将点击交给应用配置的操作，或返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，点击 Causal Foundry 提醒时将无法通过此页面处理。

en.description: When a user dismisses a Causal Foundry SDK nudge notification, this receiver records the dismissal.
en.disableEffect: Causal Foundry will no longer receive the dismissal event through this receiver.

zh-CN.description: 用户关闭 Causal Foundry SDK 的提醒通知时，此接收器会记录这次关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，Causal Foundry 将无法通过此接收器收到关闭提醒的事件。

en.description: When a user taps a Causal Foundry SDK nudge notification, this receiver processes the tap and tries to open the app if handling fails.
en.disableEffect: Taps on Causal Foundry nudge notifications will no longer be processed by the SDK.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击 Causal Foundry SDK 的提醒通知时，此接收器会处理点击；处理失败时会尝试打开应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，SDK 将无法处理 Causal Foundry 提醒通知上的点击。

en.description: When Android reports a network connection change, the Causal Foundry SDK checks connectivity and schedules a fetch for new nudges.
en.disableEffect: Causal Foundry will no longer schedule nudge fetches through this connectivity receiver.

zh-CN.description: Android 检测到网络连接变化时，Causal Foundry SDK 会检查网络状态并安排获取新提醒。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，Causal Foundry 将无法通过此网络接收器安排提醒获取任务。

en.description: When the user removes the app from recent tasks, the Causal Foundry SDK service records an app-close event and stops.
en.disableEffect: Causal Foundry will no longer record app-close events through this service.

zh-CN.description: 用户从最近任务中移除应用时，Causal Foundry SDK 会通过此服务记录应用关闭事件，然后停止服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，Causal Foundry 将无法通过此服务记录应用关闭事件。

en.description: When the app opens its DevRev support screen, this Activity displays the support conversation and lets users attach a file.
en.disableEffect: The app’s in-app DevRev support chat and file attachments will be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开 DevRev 支持界面时，此页面会显示支持对话，并允许用户附加文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，应用内的 DevRev 支持聊天和文件附件将无法使用。

en.description: When the app opens the Engagely OpenBot chat window, it shows messages, FAQ suggestions, and a message box, with controls for ending the conversation and attaching media.
en.disableEffect: The app’s OpenBot chat, bot answers, feedback, and support actions will be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开 Engagely OpenBot 聊天窗口时，此界面会显示消息、常见问题建议和输入框，并提供结束对话及附加媒体的操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，应用中的 OpenBot 聊天、机器人答复、反馈和支持操作将无法使用。

en.description: When OpenBot opens a video link, this Activity shows a video player with playback controls and picture-in-picture support.
en.disableEffect: Videos opened through this OpenBot player will not play, and users cannot resume them from this screen.

zh-CN.description: OpenBot 打开视频链接时，此页面会显示带播放控制的播放器，并支持画中画。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，通过此 OpenBot 播放器打开的视频将无法播放，用户也无法从此页面继续播放。

en.description: When OpenBot opens a YouTube video, this Activity embeds the player and shows the supplied video title and subtitle.
en.disableEffect: YouTube videos opened from OpenBot will no longer play in this screen.

zh-CN.description: OpenBot 打开 YouTube 视频时，此页面会嵌入播放器并显示视频标题和副标题。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，OpenBot 中打开的 YouTube 视频将无法在此页面播放。

en.description: When the app starts a FedML Edge task, this foreground service runs the background AI worker and reports training status and progress to the app.
en.disableEffect: The app’s FedML background training and edge AI tasks will not run through this service.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动 FedML Edge 任务时，此前台服务会运行后台 AI 处理，并向应用报告训练状态和进度。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，应用将无法通过此服务运行 FedML 后台训练和边缘 AI 任务。

en.description: When FedML Edge starts background AI work, it briefly starts this helper service to support foreground operation, then the helper exits.
en.disableEffect: The FedML background AI service startup flow may be disrupted without this helper.

zh-CN.description: FedML Edge 启动后台 AI 任务时，会短暂启动此辅助服务以支持前台运行，然后该服务退出。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用此辅助服务后，FedML 后台 AI 服务的启动流程可能受到影响。

en.description: The FedML Edge background process uses this provider to read and update saved settings needed by its AI work.
en.disableEffect: FedML Edge tasks will lose access to the saved settings handled by this provider.

zh-CN.description: FedML Edge 后台进程会通过此提供程序读取和更新 AI 任务所需的已保存设置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，FedML Edge 任务将无法访问由此提供程序处理的已保存设置。

en.description: Leqi ShareCenter opens a web-based sharing page whose options can save images to the photo album, share them to WeChat friends or Moments, and request WeChat authorization.
en.disableEffect: The sharing page and its WeChat sharing and authorization flows cannot be used.

zh-CN.description: Leqi ShareCenter 会打开网页分享页面，用户可将图片保存到相册、分享给微信好友或朋友圈，也可请求微信授权。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 分享页面以及微信分享和授权流程将无法使用。

en.description: Leqi ShareCenter uses this Activity to receive results from WeChat after sharing or authorization. It returns authorization codes to the sharing page and displays other operation results.
en.disableEffect: WeChat authorization and sharing cannot return their results to ShareCenter.

zh-CN.description: Leqi ShareCenter 使用此 Activity 接收微信分享或授权后的返回结果，并将授权码交回分享页面或显示其他操作结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 微信授权和分享操作将无法把结果返回给 ShareCenter。

en.description: When Meson displays a full-screen ad or in-ad page, this Activity attaches the ad view and handles its close and navigation controls.
en.disableEffect: Full-screen Meson ads and their in-ad pages will not display.

zh-CN.description: Meson 显示全屏广告或广告内页面时，此界面会载入广告内容并处理关闭和页面导航操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，Meson 全屏广告及其广告内页面将无法显示。

en.description: When a user opens a Meson ad landing page, this Activity attaches the requested ad view and reports when it is displayed.
en.disableEffect: Meson ad landing pages will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 Meson 广告落地页时，此界面会载入对应广告内容，并在显示后发送展示事件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，Meson 广告落地页将无法打开。

en.description: The Meson test suite opens this screen with SDK test data to check the integration and fetch the test results.
en.disableEffect: The Meson SDK setup-check screen will no longer be available.

zh-CN.description: Meson 测试套件会带入 SDK 测试数据打开此页面，检查集成情况并获取测试结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，Meson SDK 集成检查页面将无法使用。

en.description: Android battery-level broadcasts trigger the NextBillion Asset Tracking SDK receiver. It forwards the percentage so the tracking service can include it with location records and show low-battery warnings.
en.disableEffect: Disabling the manifest entry does not stop location tracking or battery updates during an active tracking session; the SDK also listens for battery changes while tracking.

zh-CN.description: Android 电量变化广播会触发 NextBillion Asset Tracking SDK 的接收器。它会转发电量百分比，供跟踪服务随位置记录上报并显示低电量提醒。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用清单中的此项不会停止位置跟踪或活动跟踪期间的电量更新；SDK 在跟踪时也会接收电量变化。

en.description: Android runs this scheduled job for the NextBillion Asset Tracking SDK when its tracking job is due. It restores the saved tracking settings and starts asset-location tracking if tracking is not already running.
en.disableEffect: Background asset tracking may fail to restart or resume after Android stops its tracking service.

zh-CN.description: NextBillion Asset Tracking SDK 的跟踪任务到期时，Android 会运行此计划任务。它会恢复已保存的跟踪设置，并在跟踪尚未运行时启动资产位置跟踪。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Android 停止跟踪服务后，后台资产跟踪可能无法重新启动或恢复。

en.description: The NextBillion Asset Tracking SDK starts this foreground service when asset tracking is enabled. It requests device location updates, records and batches positions with battery information, and uploads the batches to the tracking service.
en.disableEffect: The app can no longer collect and send ongoing asset locations in the background.

zh-CN.description: 启用资产跟踪后，NextBillion Asset Tracking SDK 会启动此前台服务。它会请求设备位置更新，将位置与电量信息记录并分批上传到跟踪服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法在后台持续收集并发送资产位置。

en.description: The NextBillion Asset Tracking SDK starts this foreground service in a separate app process while tracking is active. It helps sustain background location tracking and maintains the SDK's tracking notification.
en.disableEffect: The app's background asset tracking may stop or fail to resume.

zh-CN.description: 跟踪期间，NextBillion Asset Tracking SDK 会在单独的应用进程中启动此前台服务。它用于维持后台位置跟踪和 SDK 的跟踪通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用的后台资产跟踪可能停止或无法恢复。

en.description: The NextBillion Navigation SDK starts this foreground service when guided navigation begins. It continues receiving location updates and maintains navigation status and notifications while the route is active.
en.disableEffect: The app may not keep guided navigation active or show its navigation notification in the background.

zh-CN.description: 开始路线导航时，NextBillion Navigation SDK 会启动此前台服务。路线进行期间，它会持续接收位置更新，并维护导航状态和通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用可能无法在后台继续导航或显示导航通知。

en.description: When the app opens this screen with a route, the NextBillion Navigation SDK displays a map preview and lets users step through its turns.
en.disableEffect: Users lose the app's visual route-preview screen before navigation.

zh-CN.description: 应用让用户预览路线时，NextBillion Navigation SDK 会打开此地图页面。页面会绘制路线，并允许用户在导航开始前逐步查看转弯位置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在导航前查看应用中的路线预览地图。

en.description: The NextBillion Navigation SDK launches this screen when the app begins turn-by-turn guidance. It loads the selected route, displays the map, and updates guidance as the device location changes.
en.disableEffect: The app's NextBillion turn-by-turn navigation screen cannot open.

zh-CN.description: 应用开始逐向导航时，NextBillion Navigation SDK 会打开此页面。它会加载选定路线、显示地图，并根据设备位置更新导航指引。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法打开 NextBillion 的逐向导航页面。

en.description: Passio Nutrition AI schedules this background service when required recognition files are missing. It downloads the requested model files into the SDK's data folder so food recognition can run.
en.disableEffect: Food recognition may not initialize when required model files are absent.

zh-CN.description: 缺少识别所需文件时，Passio Nutrition AI 会安排此后台服务运行。它会将所需模型文件下载到 SDK 的数据目录，以便进行食物识别。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 缺少必要模型文件时，食物识别可能无法初始化。

en.description: The Proba Android SDK opens this developer screen when the app launches its experiment controls. It lets a tester inspect available experiments and save or clear local test overrides.
en.disableEffect: Blocking it only removes the SDK's experiment-testing screen; regular app screens and features remain available.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开实验控制功能时，Proba Android SDK 会显示此开发者页面。测试人员可以查看可用实验，并保存或清除本地测试设置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后仅会移除 SDK 的实验测试页面，应用的常规页面和功能仍可使用。

en.description: The Promoted.AI Android Metrics SDK opens this dialog for a reported initialization or logging anomaly. It shows a problem description and Promoted support contacts, and identifies the warning as intended for development builds.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it hides the SDK's diagnostic dialog without affecting the app's normal screens.

zh-CN.description: Promoted.AI Android Metrics SDK 在收到初始化或日志异常报告时会打开此对话框。它会显示问题说明和 Promoted 支持联系方式，并注明此警告面向开发版本。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后将不再显示 SDK 的诊断对话框，但应用的常规页面不受影响。

en.description: The Redpen Capture Widget SDK starts this service after a user begins a screen recording for a report. It shows a floating timer with controls and opens the report form when recording ends.
en.disableEffect: Redpen screen-recording reports lose the floating timer and the automatic transition from recording to the report form.

zh-CN.description: 用户开始为报告录屏后，Redpen Capture Widget SDK 会启动此服务。它会显示带控制按钮的悬浮计时器，并在录屏结束后打开报告表单。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Redpen 录屏报告将失去悬浮计时器及其停止录制后转到提交表单的流程。

en.description: The Redpen Capture Widget SDK starts this foreground service after the user grants screen-capture permission. It records the device display into a video file for attaching to a feedback report.
en.disableEffect: The SDK cannot attach a screen recording to a report.

zh-CN.description: 用户授予屏幕捕获权限后，Redpen Capture Widget SDK 会启动此前台服务。它会将设备屏幕录制为视频文件，供反馈报告附加。
zh-CN.disableEffect: SDK 将无法在报告中附加屏幕录制视频。

en.description: The Redpen Capture Widget SDK starts this foreground service after the user grants screen-capture permission. It saves screen images and passes the captured files to the report flow.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to attach screenshots to Redpen reports.

zh-CN.description: 用户授予屏幕捕获权限后，Redpen Capture Widget SDK 会启动此前台服务。它会保存屏幕图像，并将捕获的文件传给报告流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在 Redpen 报告中附加屏幕截图。

en.description: The Redpen Capture Widget SDK opens this form when a user submits a screenshot or screen-recording report. It collects a title and details, attaches the selected evidence, and sends the issue to the configured project board.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot send issue reports through Redpen.

zh-CN.description: 用户开始报告截图或录屏问题时，Redpen Capture Widget SDK 会打开此表单。表单会收集标题和说明、附加所选证据，并将问题发送到已配置的项目看板。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 Redpen 发送问题报告。

en.description: When the host app opens it, the Redpen Capture Widget SDK shows a brief onboarding overlay. It closes itself after about five seconds.
en.disableEffect: The brief Redpen onboarding overlay will not be shown.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开此页面时，Redpen Capture Widget SDK 会显示简短的引导浮层。约五秒后页面会自动关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后将不再显示 Redpen 的简短引导浮层。

en.description: The app or SDK opens this screen when a user chooses Redpen feedback. It lets them start a screenshot or screen recording and attach it to a report.
en.disableEffect: Users lose Redpen's in-app screenshot and screen-recording report flow.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择 Redpen 反馈功能时，应用或 SDK 会打开此页面。用户可以开始截图或录屏，并将内容附加到报告中。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法使用 Redpen 的应用内截图和录屏报告流程。

en.description: The Tabby Android SDK opens this in-app web page when a shopper taps Learn More on Tabby's installment widget. It loads the financing information page using the purchase amount and currency, then closes from its close control or Back.
en.disableEffect: Shoppers cannot open the Tabby installment information page from that widget.

zh-CN.description: 购物者点击 Tabby 分期组件上的“了解更多”时，Tabby Android SDK 会打开此应用内网页。页面会根据购买金额和币种加载分期说明，并可通过关闭按钮或返回键退出。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 购物者将无法从该组件打开 Tabby 分期说明页面。

en.description: The Tabby Android SDK opens this screen with the checkout address for the selected purchase. It hosts Tabby's checkout page and returns the checkout result to the app when the flow ends.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot complete the app's Tabby checkout flow or return its result to the app.

zh-CN.description: Tabby Android SDK 会使用所选商品的结账地址打开此页面。页面承载 Tabby 结账流程，并在流程结束时将结果返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法完成应用中的 Tabby 结账流程，也无法将结账结果返回给应用。

en.description: The ZerekAI SDK uses this Provider when a user shares a story image, creating the file link that the sharing sheet sends to another app.
en.disableEffect: Sharing a ZerekAI story image may fail because other apps can no longer open the file.

zh-CN.description: 用户通过 ZerekAI 分享故事图片时，SDK 会通过此 Provider 生成图片文件链接，并交给其他应用打开。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，其他应用可能无法打开图片，ZerekAI 故事图片分享会失败。

en.description: The ZerekAI SDK can start this Receiver with a direct cleanup message naming a video file; it deletes that file from the app cache.
en.disableEffect: Video files it was asked to delete may remain in the app cache and use storage.

zh-CN.description: ZerekAI SDK 可通过指定视频文件名的清理广播直接启动此 Receiver；它会从应用缓存中删除该文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，待清理的视频文件可能会继续留在应用缓存中并占用存储空间。

en.description: Mediastream Platform uses this Cast entry to bring the app's existing screen to the foreground, then closes. It runs when that entry is opened.
en.disableEffect: The Cast entry will no longer bring the app to the foreground; media already playing can continue.

zh-CN.description: Mediastream Platform SDK 会通过此 Cast 入口将应用已有页面带到前台，然后关闭此页面；用户打开该入口时会触发此操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Cast 入口将无法再把应用带到前台，但正在播放的媒体可以继续播放。

en.description: Mediastream Platform provides Google's expanded Cast controller as a full-screen control page during Cast playback.
en.disableEffect: Users will lose the expanded Cast controls page provided by Mediastream Platform.

zh-CN.description: Mediastream Platform SDK 在 Cast 播放期间提供 Google 的全屏扩展控制页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法使用 Mediastream Platform SDK 提供的 Cast 扩展控制页面。

en.description: Mediastream Platform listens for Next and Previous actions from its media playback notification and tells the player to change tracks.
en.disableEffect: The Next and Previous buttons in the playback notification will no longer change tracks.

zh-CN.description: Mediastream Platform SDK 会监听媒体播放通知中的“下一首”和“上一首”操作，并让播放器切换曲目。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 播放通知中的“下一首”和“上一首”按钮将无法切换曲目。

en.description: Ando File Operator (Javakam) uses this provider when the app opens or shares local files through the library. It gives another app temporary access to a selected file.
en.disableEffect: File opening or sharing through Ando File Operator can fail if this provider is disabled.

zh-CN.description: 应用通过 Ando File Operator（Javakam）打开或分享本地文件时，会用此内容提供器让其他应用临时读取所选文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，通过 Ando File Operator 打开或分享文件的功能可能失效。

en.description: Ando Gallery (Javakam) opens this screen when its picker is configured to use the built-in camera. It lets the user take a photo or record a video and returns the capture to the picker.
en.disableEffect: The app can no longer capture photos or videos with Ando Gallery's built-in camera.

zh-CN.description: Ando Gallery（Javakam）的媒体选择器启用内置相机时，会打开此页面。用户可拍照或录制视频，完成后媒体会返回到选择器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法再使用 Ando Gallery 的内置相机拍照或录像。

en.description: Ando Gallery opens this viewer when the app asks to preview supplied photos or videos outside the picker. It lets the user browse the items and, when enabled, delete or save them.
en.disableEffect: External media preview and its enabled save or delete actions will stop working.

zh-CN.description: 应用要求在选择器之外预览指定照片或视频时，Ando Gallery 会打开此查看页面。用户可浏览媒体，并在相关选项启用时删除或保存文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 外部媒体预览以及已启用的保存或删除操作将无法使用。

en.description: Ando Gallery uses this provider when it creates a camera output file or shares selected media. It gives the camera or receiving app access to the file through a temporary link.
en.disableEffect: Camera capture and file sharing through Ando Gallery can fail when it cannot provide access to the media file.

zh-CN.description: Ando Gallery 创建相机输出文件或分享所选媒体时，会用此内容提供器让相机或接收应用通过临时链接读取文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 无法提供媒体文件访问权限时，Ando Gallery 的拍摄或分享功能可能失效。

en.description: Ando Gallery opens this full-screen viewer from its media picker so the user can browse selected items, change the selection, and crop photos when cropping is enabled.
en.disableEffect: Users can no longer preview or crop selected media inside Ando Gallery.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Ando Gallery 媒体选择器中查看所选内容时，会打开此全屏页面，可浏览媒体、更改选择，并在启用裁剪时编辑照片。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法再通过 Ando Gallery 预览或裁剪所选媒体。

en.description: Ando Gallery opens this screen when the app starts its media picker. It lets the user browse device albums and choose photos, videos, or audio files for the app.
en.disableEffect: The app loses Ando Gallery's media-selection flow.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动 Ando Gallery 媒体选择器时，会打开此页面。用户可浏览设备相册，并为应用选择照片、视频或音频文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法再使用 Ando Gallery 的媒体选择流程。

en.description: Ando Gallery uses this screen when its picker routes photo, video, or audio capture through the device camera or recorder. It requests the needed permission, processes the returned file, and adds it to the selection result.
en.disableEffect: The picker's standard camera or audio-capture flow can no longer return media to the app.

zh-CN.description: Ando Gallery 通过设备相机或录音工具拍摄照片、视频或音频时，会使用此页面。它会请求所需权限、处理返回的文件，并将媒体加入选择结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 选择器将无法再把通过普通相机或录音流程获得的媒体返回给应用。

en.description: Ando Gallery opens this WeChat-style preview while the user reviews selected photos or videos. It shows the current item and selected-item strip before the user confirms the choice.
en.disableEffect: Reviewing and confirming selected media in Ando Gallery's WeChat-style preview will stop working.

zh-CN.description: 用户以微信风格查看已选照片或视频时，Ando Gallery 会打开此预览页面。页面显示当前媒体和已选项目缩略栏，供用户确认选择。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Ando Gallery 的微信风格媒体预览和确认功能将无法使用。

en.description: Ando Gallery uses this alternate picker screen to show device media in a WeChat-style layout. The user can select items and return them to the app.
en.disableEffect: The app can no longer use Ando Gallery's WeChat-style media picker.

zh-CN.description: Ando Gallery 使用此备用选择页面，以微信风格展示设备中的媒体。用户可选择项目并将其返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法再使用 Ando Gallery 的微信风格媒体选择器。

en.description: Ando Gallery opens this player when a user previews a video from the picker or media viewer. It plays the video and can return it as the selected item.
en.disableEffect: Video playback inside Ando Gallery stops, so apps that require this preview cannot complete that step.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Ando Gallery 选择器或媒体查看器中预览视频时，会打开此播放器。它播放视频，并可将视频作为所选项目返回。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Ando Gallery 内的视频播放将停止；依赖此预览步骤的应用流程也无法完成。

en.description: Ando WebView (Javakam) opens this screen when an embedded page requests the device's location. It checks whether Android should explain the permission and then asks for location access.
en.disableEffect: Web pages in the app can no longer request location permission through Ando WebView.

zh-CN.description: Ando WebView（Javakam）中的网页请求设备位置时，会打开此页面。它检查 Android 是否应先说明权限用途，然后请求位置权限。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用中的网页将无法再通过 Ando WebView 请求位置权限。

en.description: Just shows an error message about the account restrictions for the limited user.

An activity is a single, focused thing that the user can do. Almost all activities interact with the user, so the Activity class takes care of creating a window for you in which you can place your UI with #setContentView. While activities are often presented to the user as full-screen windows, they can also be used in other ways: as floating windows (via a theme with android.R.attr#windowIsFloating set).
Google Android Architecture Components initializes this Provider as an app process starts; it registers app lifecycle callbacks and sets up foreground and background tracking.
en.disableEffect: App features that rely on automatic lifecycle events may stop detecting foreground and background changes correctly.

zh-CN.description: 应用进程启动时，Google Android Architecture Components 会初始化此 Provider，注册应用生命周期回调，并建立前台和后台状态跟踪。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖自动生命周期事件的应用功能可能无法正确识别前台和后台状态变化。

en.description: Google Android Architecture Components initializes this Provider as an app process starts; it registers app lifecycle callbacks and sets up foreground and background tracking.
en.disableEffect: App features that rely on automatic lifecycle events may stop detecting foreground and background changes correctly.

zh-CN.description: 应用进程启动时，Google Android Architecture Components 会初始化此 Provider，注册应用生命周期回调，并建立前台和后台状态跟踪。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖自动生命周期事件的应用功能可能无法正确识别前台和后台状态变化。

en.description: Presents multiple options for handling the case where a sync was aborted because there were too many pending deletes. One option is to force the delete, another is to rollback the deletes, the third is to do nothing.
The implementation service for DisplayHashingService
Notification assistant that provides guidance on notification channel blocking
A Logistic Regression based android.service.resolver.ResolverRankerService, to be used in ResolverComparator.
CacheQuotaServiceImpl implements the CacheQuotaService with a strategy for populating the quota of CacheQuotaHint.
Routes explicit health check requests to the appropriate ExplicitHealthChecker.
Service that handles hardware geofencing.
When the app’s picture-cropping flow finishes, this Loren Wang common-frame Activity returns the cropped photo to the app.
en.disableEffect: Picture cropping through this library cannot return the edited photo to the app.

zh-CN.description: 应用的图片裁剪流程完成时，Loren Wang 通用基础框架中的此 Activity 会将裁剪后的照片返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法通过此库完成图片裁剪并取回编辑后的照片。

en.description: Trampoline activity that enables the GameSession#startActivityFromGameSessionForResult(Intent, Bundle, Executor, GameSessionActivityCallback) API by reusing existing activity result infrastructure in the Activity class. This activity forwards activity results back to the calling GameSession via AndroidFuture.
The default implementation of SelectionToolbarRenderService. <b>NOTE:<b/> The requests are handled on the service main thread.
Android Support Library creates a shareable link to an app file when another app or SDK needs to open or share it. It runs when the host app requests that file link.
en.disableEffect: File sharing, opening, or installation flows that use this provider can fail; an SDK that requests a file link from it can also fail.

zh-CN.description: Android Support Library 会在其他应用或 SDK 需要打开、分享应用文件时，为文件生成可分享的链接。应用请求此链接时它会运行。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此 Provider 的文件分享、打开或安装流程可能失败；请求文件链接的 SDK 也可能无法继续。

en.description: The Android Support Library media receiver forwards button presses from headsets and other media controls to the active playback service. Disabling it prevents those buttons from controlling playback.
en.disableEffect: Headset and other media-control buttons will no longer control the app's audio playback.

zh-CN.description: Android Support Library 媒体接收器会把耳机和其他媒体控制按键的操作转交给当前播放服务。禁用后，这些按键将无法控制播放。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 耳机和其他媒体控制按键将无法控制应用的音频播放。

en.description: Service to execute MMS requests using deprecated legacy APIs on older platform (prior to L)

AndroidX Activity provides a basic app screen for showing content and remembering its state as the app pauses or restarts. It also handles the system Back button and requests that open other screens; the analyzed manifests give it no launch entry, so an app or test must start it directly.
en.disableEffect: Tests or app actions that directly open this basic screen will no longer be able to use it.

zh-CN.description: AndroidX Activity 提供可显示内容的基础应用界面，并在应用暂停或重新启动时保存和恢复界面状态。它还处理系统返回操作以及打开其他界面后返回的结果；分析到的清单没有为它配置启动入口，因此只有应用或测试直接启动时才会打开。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 直接打开此基础界面的测试或应用操作将无法再使用它。

en.description: AndroidX Ads Identifier Provider starts when an app binds to request the advertising ID and returns the registered provider through the service connection.
en.disableEffect: Advertising requests that use this provider will no longer receive its identifier.

zh-CN.description: 应用绑定并请求广告标识符时，AndroidX Ads Identifier Provider 会启动，并通过 Service 连接返回已注册的标识符提供方。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此 Provider 的广告请求将无法再获取广告标识符。

en.description: AndroidX AppCompat helps apps keep their screens and controls working consistently across Android versions. This standalone Activity has no page content of its own.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it stops this empty screen from opening; other app screens that use AppCompat are separate and can remain available.

zh-CN.description: AndroidX AppCompat 帮助应用在不同 Android 版本上保持界面和控件的一致行为。此处单独声明的 Activity 本身没有页面内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，此空白页面无法打开；应用中使用 AppCompat 的其他页面是独立组件，仍可使用。

en.description: AndroidX AppCompat reads this service entry metadata when deciding whether to save and restore the language selected in the app.
en.disableEffect: AppCompat reads this component metadata even while it is disabled and can enable it during Android locale synchronization, so disabling the entry does not remove in-app language support.

zh-CN.description: AndroidX AppCompat 会在判断是否保存并恢复应用所选语言时读取此 Service 条目的元数据。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 即使此组件被停用，AppCompat 仍会读取其元数据，并可在与 Android 同步语言时重新启用它，因此停用此条目不会移除应用内语言支持。

en.description: AndroidX AppFunctions targets this private Receiver with a one-time caller-check message; the Receiver returns a success result to the access check.
en.disableEffect: App functions that require this caller check may be denied before they run.

zh-CN.description: AndroidX AppFunctions 会通过一次性调用方检查消息直接启动此私有 Receiver；Receiver 会向访问检查返回成功结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要此调用方检查的应用功能可能会在运行前被拒绝。

en.description: AndroidX AppFunctions starts this service when the system requests a function published by the app; it runs the requested function and returns its result or an error.
en.disableEffect: The system and other authorized callers will no longer be able to run functions the app exposes through Android AppFunctions.

zh-CN.description: 系统请求运行应用发布的功能时，AndroidX AppFunctions 会启动此 Service，执行请求并返回结果或错误。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 系统和其他获授权的调用方将无法再运行应用通过 AndroidX AppFunctions 提供的功能。

en.description: On supported Android versions, AndroidX AppFunctions starts this service when the platform requests a function published by the app; it runs the function and returns its result or an error.
en.disableEffect: The platform will no longer be able to run functions the app exposes through Android AppFunctions.

zh-CN.description: 在受支持的 Android 版本上，平台请求运行应用发布的功能时，AndroidX AppFunctions 会启动此 Service，执行功能并返回结果或错误。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 平台将无法再运行应用通过 AndroidX AppFunctions 提供的功能。

en.description: The AndroidX Benchmark test runner opens this full-screen Activity during performance measurements and keeps it visible until the run is done. It appears only in instrumented benchmark runs.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it interrupts benchmark runs that use this screen.

zh-CN.description: AndroidX Benchmark 测试工具会在性能测量时打开此全屏 Activity，并在测量结束前保持显示。它供基准测试使用，不属于应用的日常界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此隔离界面的基准测试可能失败，应用的常规功能不会使用它。

en.description: AndroidX Biometric opens this Activity when an authentication prompt uses the phone lock-screen credential; it starts the credential check and returns its result to the app.
en.disableEffect: Apps that use AndroidX Biometric for a device PIN, pattern, or password check may fail to complete authentication.

zh-CN.description: 认证提示需要使用手机锁屏凭据时，AndroidX Biometric 会打开此 Activity，启动凭据验证并将结果返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用 AndroidX Biometric 验证设备 PIN 码、图案或密码的应用可能无法完成认证。

en.description: AndroidX Biometric opens this Activity for its fingerprint authentication flow on supported devices; it displays the prompt and returns success, cancellation, or an error to the app.
en.disableEffect: Apps relying on this AndroidX fingerprint prompt may be unable to authenticate users.

zh-CN.description: 在受支持的设备上使用 AndroidX Biometric 进行指纹认证时，会打开此 Activity 显示提示，并向应用返回成功、取消或错误结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此 AndroidX 指纹提示的应用可能无法完成用户认证。

en.description: When a compatible Custom Tabs browser binds this AndroidX Browser service, it forwards browser-ready and browser message callbacks to the app.
en.disableEffect: Custom Tabs message channels stop working, which can interrupt app flows that rely on browser-to-app messages.

zh-CN.description: 兼容的 Custom Tabs 浏览器绑定此 AndroidX Browser 服务后，它会将浏览器就绪和浏览器消息回调传递给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Custom Tabs 消息通道将停止工作，依赖浏览器向应用传递消息的流程可能中断。

en.description: AndroidX CameraX reads this disabled-by-default Service's package information while initializing the camera to find the default Camera2 setup and compatibility settings; the Service itself is never started.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it does not hide its package metadata from CameraX, so camera setup and camera features continue to work.

zh-CN.description: AndroidX CameraX 在初始化相机时会读取这个默认关闭的 Service 的包信息，以查找 Camera2 默认配置和兼容性设置；该 Service 本身不会启动。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用它不会阻止 CameraX 读取包元数据，因此相机初始化和相机功能仍可使用。

en.description: When an app asks AndroidX CameraX which camera feature combinations a device supports, this Service advertises the Google Play services provider that answers the query. CameraX reads this entry while setting up the query.
en.disableEffect: Without this entry, devices that lack a native replacement may no longer report supported camera combinations, which can make camera modes that depend on those checks unavailable.

zh-CN.description: 应用向 AndroidX CameraX 查询设备支持哪些相机功能组合时，这个 Service 会公布负责回答查询的 Google Play 服务实现；CameraX 会在准备查询时读取这项信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 如果设备没有原生替代实现，禁用后可能无法查询支持的相机组合，依赖这些检查的相机模式也可能无法使用。

en.description: AndroidX Android for Cars App reads this disabled-by-default Service's package information when setting up car hardware access and result handling; its metadata selects the Automotive or projected Android Auto implementation.
en.disableEffect: Blocking it leaves its package metadata readable, so the car hardware and result implementations remain available.

zh-CN.description: AndroidX Android for Cars App 在设置车载硬件访问和结果处理时会读取这个默认关闭的 Service 的包信息；其中的元数据用于选择 Android Automotive 或投射式 Android Auto 实现。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用它后包元数据仍可读取，因此车载硬件和结果处理实现仍可使用。

en.description: AndroidX Android for Cars App opens this Activity when the car host requests app permissions, shows Android's permission prompt, and returns which permissions were granted or rejected.
en.disableEffect: Car permission requests will not open or return their result, so car features that need those permissions may stop working.

zh-CN.description: 车载主机通过 AndroidX Android for Cars App 请求应用权限时会打开这个 Activity；它显示 Android 权限提示，并把用户允许或拒绝的结果返回给车载主机。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 车载权限请求将无法打开或返回结果，因此依赖这些权限的车载功能可能无法使用。

en.description: AndroidX Android for Cars App uses this Receiver when a user taps an app notification action; it asks the connected car host to open the app.
en.disableEffect: Tapping those notification actions will no longer open the car app.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击应用通知中的操作时，AndroidX Android for Cars App 会通过这个 Receiver 请求已连接的车载主机打开应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 点击这些通知操作将无法再打开车载应用。

en.description: A development tool can send a start or stop broadcast to the AndroidX Compose tracing Receiver to record how Compose screens are recomputed during a diagnostic session.
en.disableEffect: Compose recomposition tracing cannot be started or stopped through this Receiver, while normal app screens remain unaffected.

zh-CN.description: 开发诊断工具可以向 AndroidX Compose 追踪 Receiver 发送开始或停止广播，以记录诊断期间 Compose 界面的重新计算情况。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后无法通过这个 Receiver 开始或停止 Compose 重新计算追踪，但应用界面不受影响。

en.description: AndroidX Compose tracing changes this disabled-by-default Receiver's state while recomposition capture starts or ends; it only indicates whether tracing is active and does not handle app screens.
en.disableEffect: Blocking it can affect tracing status checks, but Compose screens and other app features keep working.

zh-CN.description: AndroidX Compose 追踪会在重新计算记录开始或结束时切换这个默认关闭的 Receiver 状态；它只表示追踪是否正在运行，不处理应用界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用它可能影响追踪状态检查，但 Compose 界面和其他应用功能仍可使用。

en.description: AndroidX Compose Tooling opens this Activity in a debuggable app to render a requested Compose preview, including previews with sample parameters.
en.disableEffect: Compose previews in the development tools can no longer use this preview screen; installed app screens are unaffected.

zh-CN.description: AndroidX Compose Tooling 会在可调试的应用中打开这个 Activity，以显示指定的 Compose 预览，包括带示例参数的预览。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 开发工具将无法通过此预览界面显示 Compose 预览，但已安装应用的界面不受影响。

en.description: AndroidX Core provides a private file-sharing component that turns files from configured folders into temporary links other apps can access. Android starts it with the app; it is used when the app shares a file or hands a photo or video to another app, and it has no screen of its own.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it can make file sharing, exports, photo or video handoffs, and camera capture fail when an app relies on it to give another app access to a file.

zh-CN.description: AndroidX Core 提供私有文件共享组件，可将指定文件夹中的文件转换为临时链接，供其他应用访问。Android 会随应用启动此组件；分享文件或把照片、视频交给其他应用处理时会用到它，而且它没有独立界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，依赖此组件的文件分享、导出、照片或视频交接以及相机拍摄流程可能失败，因为其他应用无法取得所需文件。

en.description: AndroidX Core Google Shortcuts uses this no-display Activity to open a published shortcut: it verifies the signed shortcut link and then opens its destination screen.
en.disableEffect: Shortcuts published through the Google integration will no longer open their destination, while normal in-app navigation remains available.

zh-CN.description: AndroidX Core Google Shortcuts 使用这个不显示界面的 Activity 打开已发布的快捷方式：它会验证快捷方式链接，然后打开目标界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过 Google 集成发布的快捷方式将无法打开目标界面，但应用内的普通导航仍可使用。

en.description: AndroidX Core PiP starts this hidden Activity when an app requests its content picture-in-picture fallback; it attaches the supplied content, enters picture-in-picture, and reports when that view closes.
en.disableEffect: Apps using this fallback can no longer show or close their content in picture-in-picture.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求 AndroidX Core PiP 的内容画中画备用流程时会启动这个隐藏 Activity；它接入指定内容、进入画中画，并在该内容关闭时返回结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此备用流程的应用将无法再以画中画方式显示或关闭该内容。

en.description: AndroidX Core Telecom exposes this Service to Android Telecom, which binds it for incoming or outgoing app calls so it can create the call connection.
en.disableEffect: Android Telecom cannot create or manage the app's calls through this Service, so call handling and system call controls may fail.

zh-CN.description: AndroidX Core Telecom 向 Android Telecom 提供这个 Service；系统会在应用接听或拨出电话时绑定它，以创建通话连接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Android Telecom 将无法通过此 Service 创建或管理应用通话，通话处理和系统通话控制可能失效。

en.description: AndroidX Core Telecom declares this Receiver for system microphone-mute changes. The copy started from the manifest has no call listener; active calls register their own listener directly.
en.disableEffect: Blocking the manifest entry does not stop active calls from tracking microphone mute changes, because they use a separate listener.

zh-CN.description: AndroidX Core Telecom 为系统麦克风静音变化声明了这个 Receiver。由清单启动的实例没有通话监听器；活动通话会单独注册自己的监听器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用清单中的这一项不会阻止活动通话跟踪麦克风静音变化，因为通话使用另一个监听器。

en.description: AndroidX RemoteViews binds this Service when a home-screen widget needs a collection such as a list or grid; it supplies the saved rows for the requested widget.
en.disableEffect: Widgets that use these collection views lose their list or grid content and may appear empty.

zh-CN.description: 主屏幕小组件需要列表或网格等集合内容时，AndroidX RemoteViews 会绑定这个 Service；它为相应小组件提供已保存的条目。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此集合视图的小组件将失去列表或网格内容，显示可能变为空白。

en.description: AndroidX Credentials Play Services Auth advertises its Google sign-in and credential-saving provider through this Service; Credential Manager reads the entry when choosing available providers.
en.disableEffect: Play services sign-in, password-saving, and passkey flows may no longer find this provider.

zh-CN.description: AndroidX Credentials Play Services Auth 通过这个 Service 公布 Google 登录和凭据保存实现；Credential Manager 选择可用实现时会读取这项信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Play 服务登录、密码保存和通行密钥流程可能无法再找到此实现。

en.description: AndroidX Credentials Play Services Auth opens this hidden Activity while Google Play services handles sign-in, password saving, or passkey creation; it presents Google's pending screen and returns the result to Credential Manager.
en.disableEffect: These Play services credential flows may fail because their sign-in or confirmation screen cannot open.

zh-CN.description: Google Play 服务处理登录、密码保存或通行密钥创建时，AndroidX Credentials Play Services Auth 会打开这个隐藏 Activity；它显示 Google 的待处理界面，并将结果返回给 Credential Manager。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 登录或确认界面无法打开，这些 Play 服务凭据流程可能失败。

en.description: The older AndroidX Credentials Play Services Auth adapter opens this hidden Activity for digital-credential requests; it presents Google's pending identity screen and returns the user's result to Credential Manager.
en.disableEffect: Digital-credential retrieval through this older Play services adapter may fail.

zh-CN.description: 较旧的 AndroidX Credentials Play Services Auth 实现会在处理数字凭据请求时打开这个隐藏 Activity；它显示 Google 的待处理身份验证界面，并将用户结果返回给 Credential Manager。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过较旧 Play 服务实现获取数字凭据的流程可能失败。

en.description: AndroidX Credentials Play Services Auth opens this Activity for a pending Google sign-in, password, or passkey screen; after the user responds, it returns the result to Credential Manager.
en.disableEffect: Play services authentication, password-saving, and passkey operations may fail before their result can return.

zh-CN.description: AndroidX Credentials Play Services Auth 会为待处理的 Google 登录、密码或通行密钥界面打开这个 Activity；用户操作后，它会把结果返回给 Credential Manager。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Play 服务身份验证、密码保存和通行密钥操作可能无法完成结果返回。

en.description: AndroidX Credentials Play Services Auth opens this hidden Activity when Google returns a pending screen for creating or retrieving a digital credential; it sends the user's result back to Credential Manager.
en.disableEffect: Google digital-credential creation or sign-in through this adapter may fail.

zh-CN.description: Google 返回用于创建或获取数字凭据的待处理界面时，AndroidX Credentials Play Services Auth 会打开这个隐藏 Activity；它会将用户结果返回给 Credential Manager。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过此实现创建数字凭据或使用数字凭据登录的流程可能失败。

en.description: AndroidX Credentials Provider Events with Play services opens this Activity to show Google's pending screen for a credential import or transfer and returns the outcome to the app.
en.disableEffect: Credential import and transfer operations through Play services cannot complete their screen handoff.

zh-CN.description: AndroidX Credentials Provider Events 的 Play 服务实现会打开这个 Activity，显示 Google 凭据导入或传输的待处理界面，并将结果返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过 Play 服务进行的凭据导入和传输将无法完成界面交接。

en.description: AndroidX Credentials Provider Events with Play services uses this file provider to give Google Play services access to temporary credential-transfer files.
en.disableEffect: Google Play services can no longer open those transfer files, so credential import or export may fail.

zh-CN.description: AndroidX Credentials Provider Events 的 Play 服务实现使用这个文件提供器，让 Google Play 服务访问临时凭据传输文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Google Play 服务将无法打开这些传输文件，因此凭据导入或导出可能失败。

en.description: AndroidX Credentials Provider Events with Play services advertises the Google-backed provider-events implementation through this Service; the provider-events library reads the entry when selecting an implementation.
en.disableEffect: Play services provider-event updates and credential-transfer operations may no longer find this implementation.

zh-CN.description: AndroidX Credentials Provider Events 的 Play 服务实现通过这个 Service 公布 Google 提供的事件处理实现；事件库选择实现时会读取这项信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Play 服务事件更新和凭据传输流程可能无法再找到此实现。

en.description: The AndroidX Credentials Registry Play Services integration uses this Service to advertise the Play Services-backed credential registry to Credential Manager. That registry handles an app registering or clearing digital credentials and their sign-in options.
en.disableEffect: Apps that rely on this integration may lose digital credential registration and cleanup.

zh-CN.description: AndroidX 凭据注册表的 Play 服务集成通过此 Service 向凭据管理器提供 Play 服务凭据注册表。该注册表负责应用注册或清除数字凭据及其登录选项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此集成的应用可能无法注册或清除数字凭据。

en.description: AndroidX Fragment Testing launches this blank Activity when a test needs to host a fragment. It creates the fragment container and applies the requested test theme.
en.disableEffect: Fragment tests that use this host cannot launch, while normal app screens are unaffected.

zh-CN.description: 测试需要承载 Fragment 时，AndroidX Fragment Testing 会启动此空白 Activity。它会创建 Fragment 容器并应用测试所需的主题。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此容器的 Fragment 测试将无法启动，但应用的正常界面不受影响。

en.description: When the launcher requests a scrolling collection in an AndroidX Glance AppWidget, this Service supplies the collection rows for that widget. It starts or resumes the widget content needed to fill the list.
en.disableEffect: List sections in affected Glance widgets may appear blank or unavailable.

zh-CN.description: 桌面启动器请求显示 AndroidX Glance 小组件中的滚动列表时，此 Service 会提供列表项，并启动或恢复填充列表所需的小组件内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 受影响的 Glance 小组件中的列表部分可能为空或无法使用。

en.description: After the app is replaced by an update, AndroidX Glance checks which widget providers are still installed and removes saved entries for providers that are gone.
en.disableEffect: Glance may retain stale records for widget providers removed in an app update.

zh-CN.description: 应用更新后，AndroidX Glance 会检查仍已安装的小组件提供方，并清除已移除提供方的保存记录。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用更新移除小组件提供方后，Glance 可能仍保留这些提供方的过期记录。

en.description: When an AndroidX Glance widget sends a tap for an action tied to an active widget session, this Receiver finds that session and runs the action. This applies to widgets that use session-based actions.
en.disableEffect: Glance widget controls that depend on an active session may stop responding.

zh-CN.description: AndroidX Glance 小组件通过当前会话发送操作请求时，此 Receiver 会找到该会话并执行操作。这适用于使用会话操作的小组件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖当前会话的 Glance 小组件控件可能会失去响应。

en.description: When a user taps a Glance widget control configured to run an app action, this Receiver reads the action details and starts that action.
en.disableEffect: Glance widget controls that use these app actions will stop running their assigned behavior.

zh-CN.description: 用户点按配置为执行应用操作的 Glance 小组件控件时，此 Receiver 会读取操作内容并启动该操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用这些应用操作的 Glance 小组件控件将无法执行指定行为。

en.description: When a user taps a Glance widget control that opens an app screen, this no-display Activity launches that screen.
en.disableEffect: Those widget controls will no longer open their target app screens.

zh-CN.description: 用户点按用于打开应用界面的 Glance 小组件控件时，此不显示界面的 Activity 会启动目标界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 这些小组件控件将无法再打开目标应用界面。

en.description: When a user taps a Glance widget control that triggers a broadcast, service, or callback, this invisible Activity runs the assigned action without displaying a screen.
en.disableEffect: Those widget controls will no longer trigger their assigned app actions.

zh-CN.description: 用户点按用于触发广播、服务或回调的 Glance 小组件控件时，此不可见 Activity 会在不显示界面的情况下执行指定操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 这些小组件控件将无法再触发指定的应用操作。

en.description: AndroidX Health Connect Client exposes this Service to the Health Connect system app for permission-state requests. It lets that app update or retrieve the current permission token and check whether the calling app is in the foreground.
en.disableEffect: Health Connect permission checks and health data access for the app may fail.

zh-CN.description: AndroidX Health Connect Client 通过此 Service 响应 Health Connect 系统应用的权限状态请求。系统应用可借此更新或读取当前权限令牌，并检查发起请求的应用是否位于前台。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 此应用的 Health Connect 权限检查和健康数据访问可能失败。

en.description: AndroidX Health Services Client exposes this version service when the Wear OS Health Services app sends its protected binding request. It returns the Health Services API and client SDK version numbers for compatibility checks.
en.disableEffect: Wear OS Health Services may be unable to verify compatibility and provide health features through the app.

zh-CN.description: Wear OS Health Services 应用发送受权限保护的绑定请求时，AndroidX Health Services Client 会提供此版本服务。它会返回 Health Services API 和客户端 SDK 的版本号，以供兼容性检查。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Wear OS Health Services 可能无法验证兼容性，也可能无法通过此应用提供健康功能。

en.description: Class that provides lifecycle for the whole application process. It is useful for use cases where you would like to react on your app coming to the foreground or going to the background and you don't need a milliseconds accuracy in receiving lifecycle events.

zh-CN.description: 此类为整个应用程序进程提供生命周期事件支持。它适用于希望在应用程序切换到前台或后台时做出响应，但不需要毫秒级准确性来接收生命周期事件的用例。

en.description: A media button receiver receives and helps translate hardware media playback buttons, such as those found on wired and wireless headsets, into the appropriate callbacks in your app.

zh-CN.description: 媒体按钮事件接收器。将硬件媒体播放按钮事件（例如有线和无线耳机上的按钮）转换为应用程序中的回调。

en.description: The AndroidX Media3 playback library uses this service for scheduled media work, including downloads. Android runs it when requirements such as network access, charging, idle state, or available storage are met, and it starts the requested media service.
en.disableEffect: Scheduled Media3 downloads will not restart through this job when their requirements are met.

zh-CN.description: AndroidX Media3 播放库会用此服务调度媒体任务，包括下载。网络、充电、设备空闲或存储空间等条件满足时，Android 会运行它并启动相应的媒体服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Media3 下载将无法通过此任务在条件满足时自动重新启动。

en.description: When Android checks which apps can open audio content for Bluetooth media controls, this AndroidX Media3 Session Activity matches the check and immediately closes if launched.
en.disableEffect: Bluetooth may not recognize the app as an audio player when matching apps to audio content.

zh-CN.description: Android 检查哪些应用可以为蓝牙媒体控件打开音频内容时，此 AndroidX Media3 Session Activity 会匹配该检查，并在启动后立即关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 蓝牙在为音频内容匹配应用时可能无法识别此应用是音频播放器。

en.description: AndroidX Media3 receives media-button commands from headsets, car controls, and system media controls, then forwards them to the app’s media service.
en.disableEffect: System or headset media-button commands will no longer reach the app’s media service.

zh-CN.description: AndroidX Media3 接收耳机、车载设备和系统媒体控件发出的媒体按键命令，并将命令转交给应用的媒体服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 系统或耳机发出的媒体按键命令将无法再传到应用的媒体服务。

en.description: AndroidX MediaRouter includes this receiver so Android’s system interface can offer media-transfer controls for apps that route playback to other devices.
en.disableEffect: Android’s media-transfer interface will no longer offer this app’s routed playback for moving between devices.

zh-CN.description: AndroidX MediaRouter 通过声明此接收器，让 Android 系统界面为支持媒体路由的应用提供媒体传输控件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Android 系统将无法通过媒体传输界面把此应用正在播放的内容切换到其他设备。

en.description: AndroidX PDF uses this isolated service when the PDF viewer binds to process a document. It provides PDF document processing and page rendering for apps using the AndroidX PDF library.
en.disableEffect: Apps using AndroidX PDF may fail to open, inspect, or render PDF documents.

zh-CN.description: AndroidX PDF 阅读器绑定并处理文档时会使用此隔离 Service。它为使用 AndroidX PDF 库的应用提供 PDF 文档处理和页面渲染。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用 AndroidX PDF 的应用可能无法打开、读取或渲染 PDF 文档。

en.description: When a Privacy Sandbox SDK used by the app asks to show a screen, AndroidX Privacy Sandbox SDK Runtime opens this Activity to display the SDK-provided screen.
en.disableEffect: Screens supplied by the app's Privacy Sandbox SDKs may fail to open.

zh-CN.description: 应用使用的 Privacy Sandbox SDK 请求显示界面时，AndroidX Privacy Sandbox SDK Runtime 会打开此 Activity 来展示 SDK 提供的界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用中的 Privacy Sandbox SDK 所提供的界面可能无法打开。

en.description: This AndroidX Profile Installer receiver runs when a developer or benchmark tool requests profile maintenance. It installs or saves the app’s startup profile and adjusts profile-related settings for benchmark runs.
en.disableEffect: The app can still open and use its normal features, but developer tools cannot use this receiver for profile or benchmark operations.

zh-CN.description: 这个 AndroidX Profile Installer 接收器会在开发者工具或基准测试工具请求维护应用配置文件时运行。它会安装或保存应用的启动配置文件，并为基准测试调整相关设置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用仍可正常打开和使用，但开发者工具无法再通过此接收器执行配置文件或基准测试操作。

en.description: When another part of the app sends a remote callback through a content provider, this AndroidX Remote Callback receiver forwards the request to that provider.
en.disableEffect: Any app feature that depends on this callback path will no longer receive its callback.

zh-CN.description: 当应用的其他部分通过内容提供程序发送远程回调时，这个 AndroidX Remote Callback 接收器会将请求转发给相应的内容提供程序。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此回调路径的应用功能将无法再收到回调。

en.description: This AndroidX Room service keeps data up to date when different parts of the app use the same database. When one part changes a table, it notifies the others so they can refresh.
en.disableEffect: A change made in one part of the app may not appear in another until it reloads, leaving information out of date.

zh-CN.description: 当应用的不同部分使用同一个数据库时，这个 AndroidX Room 服务会帮助它们保持数据同步。一处修改数据后，它会通知其他部分刷新。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用一处所做的修改可能不会及时显示在其他部分，信息可能暂时过期。

en.description: This AndroidX Room 3 service keeps data up to date when different parts of the app use the same database. When one part changes a table, it notifies the others so they can refresh.
en.disableEffect: A change made in one part of the app may not appear in another until it reloads, leaving information out of date.

zh-CN.description: 当应用的不同部分使用同一个数据库时，这个 AndroidX Room 3 服务会帮助它们保持数据同步。一处修改数据后，它会通知其他部分刷新。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用一处所做的修改可能不会及时显示在其他部分，信息可能暂时过期。

en.description: This AndroidX Share Target service runs when Android asks for suggestions in the share menu. It matches the content being shared to saved app shortcuts and offers matching destinations.
en.disableEffect: The app’s shortcut-based destinations will no longer appear as suggestions in Android’s share menu.

zh-CN.description: Android 请求分享菜单建议时，这个 AndroidX Share Target 服务会根据正在分享的内容匹配应用中保存的快捷方式，并提供相应的分享去向。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用基于快捷方式的分享去向将不再显示在 Android 分享菜单的建议中。

en.description: This AndroidX Slice activity opens a confirmation when another app asks to display a small shared panel from this app. If allowed, the requesting app receives access to that panel.
en.disableEffect: Other apps cannot complete the permission request for the app’s shared panels, so a connected view that needs approval may not appear.

zh-CN.description: 其他应用请求显示此应用共享的小面板时，这个 AndroidX Slice 界面会打开确认对话框。用户允许后，请求方即可访问该面板。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 其他应用将无法完成访问共享面板的授权请求，因此需要授权的关联视图可能无法显示。

en.description: AndroidX Startup reads the library initializers registered in the app manifest and runs them automatically when the app process starts.
en.disableEffect: Libraries that rely on automatic startup can remain uninitialized, so their dependent features may not work.

zh-CN.description: AndroidX Startup 会读取应用清单中注册的库初始化任务，并在应用进程启动时自动运行。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖自动启动的库可能无法完成初始化，其相关功能也可能无法使用。

en.description: AndroidX Test Core starts this temporary Activity when an instrumentation test launches another screen for a result. It starts that screen and passes its result back to the test.
en.disableEffect: AndroidX Test Core tests that launch screens for results may fail; normal app launches are unaffected.

zh-CN.description: AndroidX Test Core 会在测试需要启动另一个界面并接收返回结果时启动这个临时 Activity。它负责打开目标界面，并将结果传回测试。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要启动界面并接收返回结果的 AndroidX Test Core 测试可能失败；应用的正常启动不受影响。

en.description: AndroidX Test Core starts this blank Activity during instrumentation tests to move the app into a stopped screen state while testing another Activity.
en.disableEffect: Tests that rely on these screen lifecycle transitions may fail or time out; normal app navigation is unaffected.

zh-CN.description: AndroidX Test Core 会在测试期间启动这个空白 Activity，使正在测试的另一个界面进入停止状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖这些界面生命周期变化的测试可能失败或超时；应用的正常导航不受影响。

en.description: AndroidX Test Core starts this blank floating Activity during instrumentation tests to pause another screen and check its paused state.
en.disableEffect: Tests that rely on this screen lifecycle transition may fail or time out; normal app navigation is unaffected.

zh-CN.description: AndroidX Test Core 会在测试期间启动这个空白浮动 Activity，使另一个界面暂停，以便检查其暂停状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此界面生命周期变化的测试可能失败或超时；应用的正常导航不受影响。

en.description: AndroidX Tracing Perfetto keeps this receiver disabled by default and checks its enabled state when deciding whether to restore saved startup-tracing settings. Tracing tools enable it while startup tracing is configured.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents saved startup-tracing settings from being restored; normal app use is unaffected.

zh-CN.description: AndroidX Tracing Perfetto 默认关闭此接收器，并通过它的启用状态判断是否恢复已保存的启动跟踪设置。配置启动跟踪时，跟踪工具会将其启用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 关闭此组件会阻止恢复已保存的启动跟踪设置，但不影响应用的正常使用。

en.description: This AndroidX Tracing Perfetto receiver runs when a developer tool asks to record performance data now, start tracing on a later app launch, or clear that setup. These requests require Android’s DUMP permission.
en.disableEffect: Developers can no longer control Perfetto tracing through these requests, but the app’s own features continue to work.

zh-CN.description: 开发者工具请求立即记录性能数据、在下次启动时开始跟踪或清除相关设置时，这个 AndroidX Tracing Perfetto 接收器会运行。这些请求需要 Android 的 DUMP 权限。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 开发者将无法再通过这些请求控制 Perfetto 跟踪，但应用自身的功能仍可正常使用。

en.description: This AndroidX Tracing Wire receiver is disabled in the SDK manifest and has no intent actions. Its receive handler does nothing, so it has no task during ordinary app use.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it causes no visible change to the app; the receiver is already disabled and performs no work.

zh-CN.description: AndroidX Tracing Wire 的清单默认关闭此接收器，也没有为它配置意图操作。它的接收处理代码不执行任何操作，因此不会参与应用的日常运行。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 关闭它不会给应用带来可见变化；此接收器本来就是关闭状态，也不执行任何操作。

en.description: This AndroidX Tracing Wire receiver runs when a developer tool with the required permission asks to start, stop, or retrieve an in-app trace. It can copy completed trace files to device storage for inspection.
en.disableEffect: Connected-profiler tools can no longer start, stop, or retrieve traces, but app features continue to work.

zh-CN.description: 具备所需权限的开发者工具请求开始、停止或取回应用内跟踪记录时，这个 AndroidX Tracing Wire 接收器会运行。它还可以将已完成的记录复制到设备存储中供检查。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 连接的性能分析工具将无法再开始、停止或取回跟踪记录，但应用功能仍可正常使用。

en.description: AndroidX Compose Tooling opens this screen for an IDE preview in a debuggable app, rendering the selected composable and, when supplied, sample values.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents IDE previews from opening; the app's normal screens continue to work.

zh-CN.description: AndroidX Compose Tooling 会在可调试的应用中打开此界面，供开发工具预览指定的 Compose 界面，并可显示示例数据。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后开发工具无法打开 Compose 预览，应用的正常界面不受影响。

en.description: AndroidX Wear Watchface opens this screen when a user configures a watch-face complication; it requests data permission and starts the system chooser for a data source.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot complete the permission or data-source selection flow for watch-face complications.

zh-CN.description: AndroidX Wear Watchface 会在用户配置表盘小组件时打开此界面，申请数据权限并启动系统数据源选择器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后用户无法完成表盘小组件的授权或数据源选择流程。

en.description: AndroidX Wear Watchface responds when Wear OS requests a watch-face control connection, providing the host app's watch-face instance for system management.
en.disableEffect: Wear OS can no longer connect to this service to manage the app's watch-face instances.

zh-CN.description: AndroidX Wear Watchface 会在 Wear OS 请求表盘控制连接时响应，为系统管理应用提供的表盘实例。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后 Wear OS 无法连接此服务来管理应用的表盘实例。

en.description: AndroidX WorkManager runs this initializer as the app process starts so scheduled background jobs can be set up.
en.disableEffect: Background jobs that rely on WorkManager may stop running, and apps without another initialization path may fail when scheduling them.

zh-CN.description: 应用进程启动时，AndroidX WorkManager 会运行此初始化器，以便设置已安排的后台任务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖 WorkManager 的后台任务可能无法运行；没有其他初始化方式的应用在安排任务时也可能失败。

en.description: Android WorkManager Firebase integration starts this Receiver from an alarm for deferred work, looks up the saved task, and submits it to Firebase JobDispatcher when it is due.
en.disableEffect: Tasks scheduled through this Firebase backend may not be submitted when due, delaying or stopping related background work.

zh-CN.description: Android WorkManager 的 Firebase 集成会通过延迟任务的闹钟启动此 Receiver，查找已保存的任务，并在到期时将其提交给 Firebase JobDispatcher。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过此 Firebase 后端安排的任务可能无法按时提交，相关后台工作会延迟或停止。

en.description: When Firebase JobDispatcher delivers a scheduled task, this Android WorkManager service starts or stops the task as requested and reports when it finishes.
en.disableEffect: Jobs sent through Firebase JobDispatcher will not run through this service, which can stop app background tasks that depend on it.

zh-CN.description: Firebase JobDispatcher 送达已安排的任务时，此 Android WorkManager Service 会按要求启动或停止任务，并在任务结束时报告结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过 Firebase JobDispatcher 发送的任务将无法由此 Service 执行，依赖它的应用后台任务可能停止。

en.description: The AndroidX WorkManager Receiver reacts when the phone starts or stops charging and asks WorkManager to recheck background tasks that require charging.
en.disableEffect: Tasks that require charging may not resume promptly when the charging state changes.

zh-CN.description: 手机开始充电或停止充电时，AndroidX WorkManager 的此 Receiver 会通知 WorkManager 重新检查需要充电条件的后台任务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 充电状态变化后，需要充电的任务可能无法及时恢复。

en.description: The AndroidX WorkManager Receiver reacts when Android reports a low battery or a recovered battery and rechecks background tasks that require enough charge.
en.disableEffect: Tasks waiting for a safe battery level may not resume promptly after the battery state changes.

zh-CN.description: Android 报告电量过低或电量恢复时，AndroidX WorkManager 的此 Receiver 会重新检查需要足够电量的后台任务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 电量状态变化后，等待电量充足的任务可能无法及时恢复。

en.description: The AndroidX WorkManager Receiver reacts to network connection changes and asks WorkManager to recheck background tasks that require a network.
en.disableEffect: Network-dependent background tasks may remain pending after connectivity changes.

zh-CN.description: 网络连接状态变化时，AndroidX WorkManager 的此 Receiver 会通知 WorkManager 重新检查需要网络的后台任务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 网络状态变化后，依赖网络的后台任务可能仍会处于等待状态。

en.description: The AndroidX WorkManager Receiver reacts when device storage becomes low or available again and rechecks tasks that require free storage.
en.disableEffect: Tasks waiting for free storage may not resume after space becomes available.

zh-CN.description: 设备存储空间不足或恢复可用时，AndroidX WorkManager 的此 Receiver 会重新检查需要可用空间的任务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 存储空间恢复后，等待空间的任务可能无法继续运行。

en.description: AndroidX WorkManager sends this Receiver an internal update when its queued tasks change; it updates monitoring for the battery, network, and storage conditions those tasks require.
en.disableEffect: WorkManager may not update condition monitoring, so tasks waiting on battery, network, or storage conditions can be delayed or run at the wrong time.

zh-CN.description: AndroidX WorkManager 的待处理任务发生变化时，会发送内部更新并由此 Receiver 调整电量、网络和存储条件监测。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，WorkManager 可能无法更新条件监测，等待电量、网络或存储条件的任务可能延迟或在不合适的时间运行。

en.description: When Android reports that the device has restarted, AndroidX WorkManager uses this Receiver to schedule its saved background tasks again.
en.disableEffect: Saved WorkManager tasks may not resume after a reboot.

zh-CN.description: Android 报告设备重新启动后，AndroidX WorkManager 会通过此 Receiver 重新安排已保存的后台任务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 设备重启后，已保存的 WorkManager 任务可能无法恢复。

en.description: AndroidX WorkManager starts this Service to process alarm-based background task commands and run or reschedule queued tasks.
en.disableEffect: Tasks assigned to WorkManager alarm scheduling may stop running.

zh-CN.description: AndroidX WorkManager 会启动此 Service 来处理基于闹钟的后台任务指令，并运行或重新安排待处理任务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 交由 WorkManager 闹钟调度的任务可能停止运行。

en.description: Android JobScheduler binds to this WorkManager service when a background job is ready; the service runs or stops the task as Android directs.
en.disableEffect: Background jobs assigned to Android JobScheduler will not run through WorkManager.

zh-CN.description: Android JobScheduler 的后台任务就绪时，会绑定到此 WorkManager Service，由它按 Android 的要求运行或停止任务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 交由 Android JobScheduler 的后台任务将无法通过 WorkManager 运行。

en.description: AndroidX WorkManager responds when a privileged support tool requests a report on recent and active background tasks.
en.disableEffect: WorkManager support tools cannot request this report; the app's scheduled background tasks continue to run.

zh-CN.description: AndroidX WorkManager 会在诊断工具请求时生成近期及正在运行的后台任务报告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 诊断工具无法请求此报告，但应用已安排的后台任务仍会照常运行。

en.description: AndroidX WorkManager uses this Service for long-running work that must run in the foreground with an ongoing notification. It starts when a worker requests foreground execution.
en.disableEffect: Long-running tasks that depend on it may stop or fail, and their progress notifications may disappear.

zh-CN.description: 当长时间任务需要以前台方式运行并显示持续通知时，AndroidX WorkManager 会使用此服务。工作线程请求前台执行后，此服务便会启动。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此服务的长时间任务可能停止或失败，任务进度通知也可能消失。

en.description: AndroidX WorkManager targets this private Receiver with an internal alarm broadcast; when it fires, the Receiver resets the long-lived alarm used to track app force-stops.
en.disableEffect: WorkManager force-stop recovery can be disrupted, which may affect saved background tasks after the app is force-stopped.

zh-CN.description: AndroidX WorkManager 会通过内部闹钟广播直接启动此私有 Receiver；闹钟触发后，它会重设用于跟踪应用强行停止状态的长期闹钟。
zh-CN.disableEffect: WorkManager 的强行停止恢复流程可能受影响，进而影响应用被强行停止后的已保存后台任务。

en.description: AndroidX WorkManager uses this internal service to coordinate background tasks that the app runs from another process.
en.disableEffect: Background tasks that rely on this service cannot be started or managed by the app's other processes.

zh-CN.description: AndroidX WorkManager 会用此内部服务协调应用在其他进程中运行的后台任务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，依赖此服务的后台任务无法从应用的其他进程启动或管理。

en.description: AndroidX XR Projected opens this short-lived screen when an XR app requests permissions for a projected device; it forwards the request to Android's permission prompt in that device's context and returns the results.
en.disableEffect: Projected-device permission requests cannot complete through this flow, preventing features that need those permissions from working.

zh-CN.description: AndroidX XR Projected 会在 XR 应用为投影设备请求权限时打开此临时界面，在该设备的 Android 权限提示中转交请求并返回结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后投影设备的权限请求无法通过此流程完成，依赖这些权限的功能也无法使用。

en.description: AndroidX XR Projected opens this bridge when a projected-device app needs permissions; it forwards the request to a screen on the host device and returns the user's decision.
en.disableEffect: Projected-device apps cannot use this flow to request permissions from the host device.

zh-CN.description: AndroidX XR Projected 会在投影设备上的应用需要权限时打开此中转界面，将请求转交给宿主设备上的界面，并返回用户的选择。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后投影设备上的应用无法通过此流程向宿主设备请求权限。

en.description: AndroidX XR Projected opens this screen on the host device for a projected app's permission request; it presents and requests the permissions, then sends the grant results back.
en.disableEffect: Projected apps cannot request or receive host-device permission results through this flow.

zh-CN.description: AndroidX XR Projected 会在宿主设备上为投影应用显示权限请求，申请相应权限后将授权结果返回给投影设备。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后投影应用无法通过此流程请求宿主设备权限或接收授权结果。

en.description: When an app uses Suckgamony's Andrxid library to open another screen and wait for a result, this transparent Activity receives that result and returns it to the app.
en.disableEffect: App actions that depend on results from screens opened through Andrxid may not complete.

zh-CN.description: 应用通过 Suckgamony 的 Andrxid 打开另一个界面并等待返回结果时，此透明 Activity 会接收结果并交还给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖 Andrxid 获取其他界面返回结果的操作可能无法完成。

en.description: The AkeXorcist BluetoothSPP library opens a picker of paired and newly discovered Bluetooth devices and returns the selected device address to the calling app.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot use this BluetoothSPP picker to select a serial Bluetooth device.

zh-CN.description: AkeXorcist BluetoothSPP 会显示已配对和新发现的蓝牙设备，并将用户选择的设备地址返回给调用它的应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 本应用将无法通过此 BluetoothSPP 选择器选择串口蓝牙设备。

en.description: Cybrid's Android financial UI opens this screen to show a customer's accounts and total balance, plus account-linked trades and transfers; it refreshes account and price data while open.
en.disableEffect: Users lose this Cybrid account overview and its related trade and transfer details.

zh-CN.description: Cybrid Android 金融界面会在应用打开账户页时显示客户账户、总余额及关联的交易和转账记录，并在界面打开时刷新账户和价格数据。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后用户无法使用 Cybrid 账户总览及相关交易和转账明细。

en.description: Cybrid's Android UI opens this screen to list linked bank accounts and start Plaid's bank-link flow when a customer connects or updates an account.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot link, update, view, or disconnect bank accounts through Cybrid's bank-account screen.

zh-CN.description: Cybrid Android 界面会在应用打开银行账户页时列出已关联账户，并在用户连接或更新账户时启动 Plaid 银行关联流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后用户无法通过 Cybrid 银行账户界面关联、更新、查看或断开银行账户。

en.description: Cybrid's Android UI opens this screen to transfer cryptocurrency between a customer's Cybrid account and an external wallet; it loads accounts, wallets, prices, and a transfer quote before submission.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot create this crypto transfer or use its quote flow.

zh-CN.description: Cybrid Android 界面会打开此界面，在客户的 Cybrid 账户和外部钱包之间转移加密货币，并在提交前加载账户、钱包、价格和转账报价。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后用户无法创建此类加密货币转账或使用报价流程。

en.description: Cybrid's Android UI opens this screen for customer identity verification and launches Persona's Inquiry flow when verification is required.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot complete Cybrid identity-verification steps, leaving features that require verification unavailable.

zh-CN.description: Cybrid Android 界面会打开此界面进行客户身份验证，并在需要验证时启动 Persona Inquiry 流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后用户无法完成 Cybrid 身份验证，需要验证的功能将无法使用。

en.description: Cybrid's Android UI opens this screen to display tradable asset prices and prepare, quote, and submit customer trades.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot place trades through this Cybrid trading screen.

zh-CN.description: Cybrid Android 界面会打开此界面显示可交易资产价格，并供客户准备、获取报价和提交交易。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后用户无法通过 Cybrid 交易界面下单。

en.description: Cybrid's Android UI opens this screen to move funds between a customer's Cybrid account and linked bank accounts; it loads a quote and submits the transfer.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot quote or submit these bank transfers through the app.

zh-CN.description: Cybrid Android 界面会打开此界面，在客户的 Cybrid 账户和已关联银行账户之间转移资金，并加载报价后提交转账。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后用户无法在应用中获取此类银行转账报价或提交转账。

en.description: Cybrid's Android UI opens this screen to view and manage external cryptocurrency wallets, add or remove a wallet, and view its transfers.
en.disableEffect: Users lose the Cybrid flow for managing external wallets and their transfers.

zh-CN.description: Cybrid Android 界面会打开此界面查看和管理外部加密货币钱包、添加或移除钱包，并查看相关转账。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后用户无法通过 Cybrid 流程管理外部钱包及其转账。

en.description: King App's file picker opens this Activity for image-cropping requests. It loads the selected image and returns the crop result to the app.
en.disableEffect: The app's photo-cropping step will be unavailable when it uses this picker.

zh-CN.description: King App 文件选择器收到图片裁剪请求时会打开此界面，载入所选图片并将裁剪结果返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用使用此选择器时将无法完成图片裁剪。

en.description: Kula's OnLaunch client displays a supplied message and its actions; messages marked as blocking do not close with the back button, and a store action opens the configured app-store link.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot see OnLaunch messages, including blocking notices, or use their app-store actions.

zh-CN.description: Kula 的 OnLaunch 客户端会显示收到的消息及其操作；标记为阻止关闭的消息不会响应返回键，应用商店操作会打开配置的商店链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后用户看不到 OnLaunch 消息（包括阻止关闭的提醒），也无法使用其中的应用商店入口。

en.description: At app startup, the Pivo Pod Basic SDK and Pivo Device SDK use this Provider to initialize the app's Pivo Pod and accessory controls, including the Pod, microphone, and light controllers.
en.disableEffect: Pivo Pod movement and supported accessory controls may fail to start.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，Pivo Pod Basic SDK 和 Pivo Device SDK 会通过此 Provider 初始化 Pivo Pod 及配件控制，包括云台、麦克风和灯光控制。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Pivo Pod 的转动和受支持的配件控制可能无法启动。

en.description: When a Screeb survey asks the user to attach a file, the Screeb Android survey SDK opens this Activity to run the file picker and return the selected file to the survey.
en.disableEffect: File attachments in Screeb surveys will not work.

zh-CN.description: Screeb 问卷需要用户添加文件时，Screeb Android 问卷 SDK 会启动此 Activity 打开文件选择器，并将选中的文件交回问卷。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Screeb 问卷中的文件附件将无法使用。

en.description: The Screeb Android survey SDK runs this Provider at app startup to initialize itself with the app context so survey features can be used.
en.disableEffect: Screeb surveys will not initialize automatically when the app starts.

zh-CN.description: Screeb Android 问卷 SDK 会在应用启动时通过此 Provider 获取应用上下文并完成初始化，以便使用问卷功能。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用启动时，Screeb 问卷将不再自动初始化。

en.description: When a Screeb survey needs an Android permission, the Screeb Android survey SDK opens this Activity to request it and return the result.
en.disableEffect: Screeb survey features that need those permissions will not be able to request them.

zh-CN.description: Screeb 问卷需要 Android 权限时，Screeb Android 问卷 SDK 会启动此 Activity 发起权限请求并接收结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要这些权限的 Screeb 问卷功能将无法发起权限请求。

en.description: The SuprSend Android SDK opens this Activity when someone taps one of its push notifications. It records the tap and opens the notification's link, or opens the app if the notification has no link.
en.disableEffect: Tapping a SuprSend notification will no longer open its destination or bring the app to the foreground, and SuprSend will not receive the tap event.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击 SuprSend Android SDK 发出的推送通知时，此 Activity 会记录点击并打开通知链接；如果通知没有链接，则打开应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，点击 SuprSend 通知将无法打开目标页面或唤起应用，SuprSend 也不会收到点击记录。

en.description: The SuprSend Android SDK invokes this Receiver when one of its push notifications is dismissed. It reports the dismissal to SuprSend for notification activity tracking.
en.disableEffect: SuprSend will stop recording when its notifications are dismissed; other app screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: SuprSend Android SDK 发出的推送通知被划掉时，此 Receiver 会向 SuprSend 上报这次关闭事件，用于记录通知互动情况。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，SuprSend 将无法记录其通知被关闭的情况；应用的其他页面仍可使用。

en.description: Chat SDK's XMPP sign-in flow opens this screen from the advanced server option when server setup is enabled. It lets the user enter or save the XMPP server connection details.
en.disableEffect: Without it, users cannot configure a custom XMPP server and may be unable to sign in when the app depends on that server.

zh-CN.description: Chat SDK 的 XMPP 登录流程会在启用高级服务器设置时，从登录页的高级选项打开此界面。用户可在这里填写并保存 XMPP 服务器连接信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法配置自定义 XMPP 服务器；如果应用依赖该服务器，用户可能无法登录。

en.description: The Chat SDK XMPP adapter uses this sign-in screen when a user logs in through an XMPP server. It checks the account details and saves the chosen server details when they are valid.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot sign in to an XMPP-based chat service through the Chat SDK.

zh-CN.description: 用户通过 XMPP 服务器登录时，Chat SDK 的 XMPP 适配器会打开此登录界面。它会检查账户信息，并在信息有效时保存所选服务器设置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 Chat SDK 登录基于 XMPP 的聊天服务。

en.description: The Appaloosa Android Tools library provides this short-lived Activity, which closes itself as soon as Android opens it. The analyzed artifact does not show what launches it.
en.disableEffect: A flow that relies on this immediate close step will no longer close at this point.

zh-CN.description: Appaloosa Android Tools 库提供此短暂显示的 Activity；Android 打开它后，它会立即关闭。已分析的构件中没有显示它由什么流程启动。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此即时关闭步骤的流程将无法在此处关闭。

en.description: Apptentive's customer feedback SDK opens this screen when an in-app enjoyment prompt is triggered. It presents the prompt for the user to respond to.
en.disableEffect: The optional Apptentive enjoyment prompt will no longer appear.

zh-CN.description: Apptentive 客户反馈 SDK 在应用内触发满意度提示时打开此页面，供用户查看并作出回应。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Apptentive 的可选满意度提示将不再显示。

en.description: Apptentive's customer feedback SDK opens this screen when a message or survey contains a link. It displays the linked page inside the app.
en.disableEffect: Links opened from Apptentive messages and surveys will no longer load in the in-app browser.

zh-CN.description: Apptentive 客户反馈 SDK 在消息或问卷包含链接时打开此页面，并在应用内显示链接内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Apptentive 消息和问卷中的链接将无法再通过应用内浏览器打开。

en.description: Apptentive's customer feedback SDK opens this screen when a user selects an image attachment in the message center. It displays the image for preview.
en.disableEffect: Users will no longer be able to preview image attachments in Apptentive conversations.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Apptentive 消息中心选择图片附件时，客户反馈 SDK 会打开此页面供用户预览图片。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法预览 Apptentive 对话中的图片附件。

en.description: Apptentive's customer feedback SDK opens this screen when the app launches its message center. It shows conversations and lets users send messages and attachments or open their profile settings.
en.disableEffect: The Apptentive message center, including support conversations and message attachments, will be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开 Apptentive 消息中心时，客户反馈 SDK 会显示对话，并允许用户发送消息和附件或进入个人资料设置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Apptentive 消息中心将无法使用，包括支持对话和消息附件。

en.description: Apptentive's customer feedback SDK opens this screen from the message center's profile settings. It lets users edit the contact details associated with their conversations.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to view or update their Apptentive message center contact details.

zh-CN.description: 用户从 Apptentive 消息中心进入个人资料设置时，客户反馈 SDK 会打开此页面，供用户修改对话关联的联系信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法查看或修改 Apptentive 消息中心关联的联系信息。

en.description: When a user taps an Apptentive notification, this screen routes them to the related message center. It is part of Apptentive's customer feedback SDK.
en.disableEffect: Tapping Apptentive notifications will no longer open the related message center; other app features remain available.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击 Apptentive 通知时，此页面会将其带到相关消息中心；它属于 Apptentive 客户反馈 SDK。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 点击 Apptentive 通知将无法再打开相关消息中心，但应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: Apptentive's customer feedback SDK opens this screen when an in-app survey is presented. It displays the questions and submits the user's answers.
en.disableEffect: Apptentive surveys will no longer appear or accept responses.

zh-CN.description: Apptentive 客户反馈 SDK 展示应用内问卷时会打开此页面，显示问题并提交用户的回答。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Apptentive 问卷将不再显示，也无法提交回答。

en.description: Apptentive's customer feedback SDK opens this screen when an in-app note is triggered. It displays the configured message in a dialog.
en.disableEffect: Apptentive in-app notes will no longer be shown.

zh-CN.description: Apptentive 客户反馈 SDK 触发应用内说明时会打开此页面，并在对话框中显示相应内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Apptentive 应用内说明将不再显示。

en.description: At app startup, the A-SIT Plus Signum Supreme SDK uses this Provider to track the current screen so it can show biometric unlock for protected Android Keystore signing keys.
