en.disableEffect: Biometric signing that relies on the active screen may fail if this Provider is disabled.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，A-SIT Plus Signum Supreme SDK 会通过此 Provider 跟踪当前界面，以便为受保护的 Android Keystore 签名密钥显示生物识别解锁提示。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 如果停用此 Provider，依赖当前界面的生物识别签名可能会失败。

en.description: When Google Firebase delivers a push message or refreshes its token, ChoiceSDK Messaging forwards the message or token update to the app.
en.disableEffect: The app will stop receiving messages and token updates through Google Firebase via ChoiceSDK.

zh-CN.description: Google Firebase 投递推送消息或更新令牌时，ChoiceSDK Messaging 会将消息或令牌更新转交给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法再通过 ChoiceSDK 接收 Google Firebase 消息和令牌更新。

en.description: When Huawei Push Kit delivers a push message or refreshes its token, ChoiceSDK Messaging forwards the message or token update to the app.
en.disableEffect: The app will stop receiving messages and token updates through Huawei Push Kit via ChoiceSDK.

zh-CN.description: Huawei Push Kit 投递推送消息或更新令牌时，ChoiceSDK Messaging 会将消息或令牌更新转交给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法再通过 ChoiceSDK 接收 Huawei Push Kit 消息和令牌更新。

en.description: The Gridstone DebugDrawer Timber module uses this Provider when its debug drawer shares a saved file of app logs.
en.disableEffect: Sharing diagnostic logs from the debug drawer will fail when it tries to open the log file.

zh-CN.description: Gridstone DebugDrawer Timber 模块会在调试抽屉分享已保存的应用日志文件时使用此 Provider。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 调试抽屉尝试打开日志文件时，诊断日志分享将失败。

en.description: At app startup, the Gridstone DebugDrawer Timber module uses this Provider to begin collecting app logs for the debug drawer.
en.disableEffect: The debug log panel may fail to open, and the module will not collect app logs.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，Gridstone DebugDrawer Timber 模块会通过此 Provider 开始收集应用日志，供调试抽屉显示。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 调试日志面板可能无法打开，该模块也不会收集应用日志。

en.description: The Auryc Android SDK receives Android connectivity and Wi-Fi change broadcasts and starts its replay-video upload service. This lets queued screen-session videos be retried when network conditions change.
en.disableEffect: Auryc may not retry queued session-video uploads when connectivity changes.

zh-CN.description: Auryc Android SDK 会在网络连接或 Wi-Fi 状态变化时收到系统广播，并启动回放视频上传服务，以便在网络变化后重试排队的视频。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 网络状态变化时，Auryc 可能不会重试排队中的会话视频上传。

en.description: The Auryc Android SDK schedules this background job to make videos from screen captures recorded during app sessions. It checks saved session captures and creates a replay video after recording is complete.
en.disableEffect: Auryc will not create session replay videos from captured screens.

zh-CN.description: Auryc Android SDK 会安排此后台任务，将应用会话期间保存的屏幕截图制作为视频；录制完成后，它会检查截图并生成会话回放视频。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Auryc 将无法把已捕获的屏幕内容制作为会话回放视频。

en.description: The Auryc Android SDK schedules this job to remove local records and files for sessions whose event data and replay videos have already been uploaded. It runs in the background as part of Auryc’s data cleanup.
en.disableEffect: Auryc will retain uploaded session records and files longer, which may use more device storage.

zh-CN.description: Auryc Android SDK 会安排此任务清理事件数据和回放视频均已上传的会话记录及本地文件，这是 Auryc 的后台数据清理工作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Auryc 会更久地保留已上传的会话记录和文件，可能占用更多设备存储空间。

en.description: The Auryc Android SDK schedules this job to send stored usage and interaction records for app sessions when event uploading is enabled and a network is available.
en.disableEffect: Auryc usage and interaction records will no longer be uploaded from this background job.

zh-CN.description: 启用事件上传且网络可用时，Auryc Android SDK 会安排此任务发送应用会话中保存的使用和交互记录。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Auryc 将不再通过此后台任务上传使用和交互记录。

en.description: The Auryc Android SDK schedules this job to upload saved session-replay videos when the configured network preference allows it.
en.disableEffect: Auryc session-replay videos will not be uploaded by this background job.

zh-CN.description: 网络条件符合设置时，Auryc Android SDK 会安排此任务上传已保存的会话回放视频。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Auryc 将无法通过此后台任务上传会话回放视频。

en.description: The Auryc Android SDK starts this background service while it is initialized. It processes queued app-session interaction records and sends them to Auryc when uploading is enabled and the network is available.
en.disableEffect: Auryc interaction records will not be uploaded by this service.

zh-CN.description: Auryc Android SDK 初始化时会启动此后台服务；启用上传且网络可用时，它会处理排队的应用会话交互记录并发送给 Auryc。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 此服务将不再上传 Auryc 交互记录。

en.description: The Auryc Android SDK starts this service during initialization. It periodically removes local session records and files after their event data and replay videos have been uploaded.
en.disableEffect: Auryc will retain uploaded session records and files longer, which may use more device storage.

zh-CN.description: Auryc Android SDK 初始化时会启动此服务；事件数据和回放视频上传后，它会定期清理对应的本地会话记录及文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Auryc 会更久地保留已上传的会话记录和文件，可能占用更多设备存储空间。

en.description: The Auryc Android SDK starts this service for tracked app sessions. It periodically captures screen images and records view timing so Auryc can assemble an app-session replay.
en.disableEffect: Auryc will no longer capture the screens needed to build app-session replays.

zh-CN.description: Auryc Android SDK 会在跟踪应用会话时启动此服务，定期截取屏幕并记录页面时间信息，以便制作应用会话回放。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Auryc 将无法继续捕获制作应用会话回放所需的屏幕内容。

en.description: The Auryc Android SDK starts this background service to turn saved screen captures into videos for app-session replay. It also removes incomplete video work left by an interrupted run.
en.disableEffect: Auryc will not assemble captured screens into app-session replay videos.

zh-CN.description: Auryc Android SDK 会启动此后台服务，将保存的屏幕截图制作为应用会话回放视频；它也会清理中断处理后留下的未完成视频文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Auryc 将无法把捕获的屏幕内容合成为应用会话回放视频。

en.description: The Auryc Android SDK starts this service to upload completed app-session videos to its replay storage, following the configured network preference. It retries queued files while active.
en.disableEffect: Auryc will not upload completed session-replay videos through this service.

zh-CN.description: Auryc Android SDK 会启动此服务，根据网络设置将已完成的应用会话视频上传到回放存储，并在运行期间重试排队的文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Auryc 将无法通过此服务上传已完成的会话回放视频。

en.description: Auryc opens this screen when its in-app feedback form or preview is requested. It fetches the selected form from Auryc and displays it so the user can provide feedback.
en.disableEffect: Auryc feedback forms will no longer open, while the host app’s other screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: 请求打开 Auryc 应用内反馈表单或预览时，会显示此页面；它从 Auryc 获取所选表单并供用户填写反馈。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Auryc 反馈表单将无法打开，但宿主应用的其他页面仍可使用。

en.description: When an iPay checkout starts, this Activity opens the iPay app; when the payment app returns through a VIEW link, it reads the checkout result and sends it back to the app.
en.disableEffect: Users may not be able to finish iPay payments or return their checkout result to the app.

zh-CN.description: iPay 结账开始时，此 Activity 会打开 iPay 应用；支付应用通过 VIEW 链接返回后，它会读取结账结果并将结果交回本应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户可能无法完成 iPay 支付，或无法将结账结果返回本应用。

en.description: When the iPay app is unavailable and checkout falls back to the web, this Activity loads the payment page and returns its success, failure, or cancellation result to the app.
en.disableEffect: Web-based fallback payments and their completion results will stop working.

zh-CN.description: 无法使用 iPay 应用而结账改用网页时，此 Activity 会加载支付页面，并将成功、失败或取消结果返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 网页备用支付流程及其完成结果将无法使用。

en.description: At app startup, the iPay Checkout SDK uses this Provider to initialize itself and read its app settings; checkout code also initializes the SDK on demand before a transaction.
en.disableEffect: The iPay SDK will initialize when checkout is first requested instead of at app startup.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，iPay Checkout SDK 会通过此 Provider 完成初始化并读取应用设置；结账代码也会在交易开始前按需初始化 SDK。
zh-CN.disableEffect: iPay SDK 将在首次请求结账时初始化，而不是在应用启动时初始化。

en.description: This is part of MrSweeter's HypCo app logger. This is HypCo's app-logging screen; when opened, it loads the saved records and lets users export a selected item as a JSON file.
en.disableEffect: HypCo's saved-record browser and JSON export screen will be unavailable; the host app's features are unaffected.

zh-CN.description: 这是 MrSweeter 的 HypCo 应用日志工具的一部分。这是 HypCo 的应用日志页面；打开后会加载已保存的记录，并可将选中的条目导出为 JSON 文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，HypCo 已保存记录的浏览和 JSON 导出页面不可用；宿主应用功能不受影响。

en.description: The BumptechLab Shell SDK opens this screen when the app starts a game session; it runs the game and handles returning from it.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot play the game provided through this SDK if disabled.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动游戏时，BumptechLab Shell SDK 会打开此界面运行游戏并处理返回流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法游玩此 SDK 提供的游戏。

en.description: The BumptechLab Shell SDK opens this screen when a game feature requests a web page; it displays that page inside the app and supports back navigation.
en.disableEffect: Web pages opened by this SDK will no longer be available if disabled.

zh-CN.description: 游戏功能请求打开网页时，BumptechLab Shell SDK 会在应用内显示该网页，并支持返回浏览。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，此 SDK 打开的网页将无法使用。

en.description: When a user selects a recorded UI stall from BlockCanaryX history, this screen displays the captured report for that stall.
en.disableEffect: Developers can no longer open detailed reports for recorded UI stalls.

zh-CN.description: 用户从 BlockCanaryX 的历史记录中选择界面卡顿后，此界面会显示该卡顿的记录报告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 开发者将无法查看已记录界面卡顿的详细报告。

en.description: BlockCanaryX adds a Blocking History icon to the app launcher; tapping it opens the list of recorded UI stalls.
en.disableEffect: The app launcher no longer provides a shortcut to BlockCanaryX stall history.

zh-CN.description: BlockCanaryX 会在应用启动器中添加“卡顿历史”图标，点击后打开已记录的界面卡顿列表。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用启动器将不再提供进入 BlockCanaryX 卡顿历史的快捷入口。

en.description: BlockCanaryX lists recorded UI stalls with their duration and time and lets the user open a report for a selected record.
en.disableEffect: BlockCanaryX stall history is no longer available in the app.

zh-CN.description: BlockCanaryX 会列出已记录的界面卡顿及其持续时间和发生时间，并可打开所选记录的报告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用中将无法查看 BlockCanaryX 的卡顿历史。

en.description: The Vest SDK opens this screen when its app requests online content; it loads the requested page in an in-app browser and supports game-style launches.
en.disableEffect: Content and game pages opened through the Vest SDK will not open if this screen is disabled.

zh-CN.description: 应用通过 Vest SDK 请求在线内容时会打开此界面；它在应用内载入网页，也支持游戏内容页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Vest SDK 打开的内容页和游戏页面将无法打开。

en.description: FlatOCRExtractor's lib-ocr library opens this Activity when an app starts a scan. It shows scan instructions, then hosts the camera capture and text-recognition flow and returns the scan result to the app.
en.disableEffect: The app's camera-based text scanning and OCR results will no longer be available.

zh-CN.description: 应用开始扫描时，FlatOCRExtractor 的 lib-ocr 文字识别库会打开此 Activity。它先显示扫描说明，再承载相机拍摄和文字识别流程，并将扫描结果返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法再使用相机扫描文字或获取 OCR 识别结果。

en.description: FlatOCRExtractor's lib-ocr library opens this Activity when an app starts a scan. It shows scan instructions, then hosts the camera capture and text-recognition flow and returns the scan result to the app.
en.disableEffect: The app's camera-based text scanning and OCR results will no longer be available.

zh-CN.description: 应用开始扫描时，FlatOCRExtractor 的 lib-ocr 文字识别库会打开此 Activity。它先显示扫描说明，再承载相机拍摄和文字识别流程，并将扫描结果返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法再使用相机扫描文字或获取 OCR 识别结果。

en.description: The Bemobi Medescope download library receives Android Download Manager completion and notification-click broadcasts. It forwards completed downloads to the app and opens the download queue when a download notification is tapped.
en.disableEffect: Medescope downloads may not report completion, and their notification taps may not open the download queue.

zh-CN.description: Bemobi Medescope 下载库会接收 Android 下载管理器的完成和通知点击广播，将完成结果传回应用，并在用户点击下载通知时打开下载队列。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Medescope 下载可能无法向应用报告完成状态，点击下载通知也可能无法打开下载队列。

en.description: The Bemobi Medescope download library starts this service after a download finishes or its notification is tapped. It matches the Android download to the app request and sends the completion result or opens the queue.
en.disableEffect: The app may not receive Medescope download results, and download notification taps may stop opening the queue.

zh-CN.description: Bemobi Medescope 下载库会在下载完成或用户点击下载通知后启动此服务，将系统下载与应用请求对应起来，再传回完成结果或打开下载队列。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用可能收不到 Medescope 下载结果，点击下载通知也可能无法打开队列。

en.description: The Bemobi Medescope download library starts this service when the app queues or cancels a file, requests progress, or handles a finished download. It submits downloads to Android Download Manager and reports progress and results to the app.
en.disableEffect: Files downloaded through Medescope may not start, cancel, or report progress and results correctly, breaking app features that use those downloads.

zh-CN.description: 应用通过 Bemobi Medescope 下载库添加或取消文件、请求进度或处理已完成的下载时，此服务会执行相应操作，并把进度和结果传回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，通过 Medescope 下载的文件可能无法正常开始、取消或报告进度和结果，依赖这些下载的应用功能也会受影响。

en.description: Getmo SmartPromo opens this screen from the campaign home to show a consumer’s statement of awards and related campaign entries.
en.disableEffect: The consumer will no longer be able to view the SmartPromo awards statement.

zh-CN.description: Getmo SmartPromo 会从活动首页打开此页面，显示用户的奖励明细及相关活动记录。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法再查看 SmartPromo 的奖励明细。

en.description: Getmo SmartPromo opens this screen from the campaign home to list the consumer’s available coupons.
en.disableEffect: The consumer will no longer be able to view coupons in SmartPromo.

zh-CN.description: Getmo SmartPromo 会从活动首页打开此页面，列出用户可用的优惠券。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法再查看 SmartPromo 中的优惠券。

en.description: Getmo SmartPromo opens this campaign screen as its main entry point, where users can reach campaign participation, receipts, coupons, prizes, and other sections.
en.disableEffect: The SmartPromo campaign entry screen and its linked campaign features will not open.

zh-CN.description: Getmo SmartPromo 会将此活动页面作为主要入口，用户可从中进入活动参与、收据、优惠券、奖励等页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: SmartPromo 的活动入口及其关联功能将无法打开。

en.description: Getmo SmartPromo uses this screen as a manual receipt option, where the consumer enters a receipt access key, date, and amount for submission.
en.disableEffect: The consumer will lose the manual receipt submission option in SmartPromo.

zh-CN.description: Getmo SmartPromo 使用此页面提供手动提交收据的方式，用户可输入收据验证码、日期和金额。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法再通过 SmartPromo 手动提交收据。

en.description: Getmo SmartPromo opens this screen to browse available campaigns and manage campaign favorites.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to browse or favorite campaigns through this SmartPromo screen.

zh-CN.description: Getmo SmartPromo 使用此页面浏览可参与的活动并管理收藏。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此 SmartPromo 页面浏览或收藏活动。

en.description: Getmo SmartPromo opens this screen so consumers can review or edit personal information saved for campaign use.
en.disableEffect: Consumers will no longer be able to review or edit their saved SmartPromo information here.

zh-CN.description: Getmo SmartPromo 会打开此页面，供用户查看或编辑为活动保存的个人信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在此查看或编辑已保存的 SmartPromo 信息。

en.description: Getmo SmartPromo opens this screen to verify a consumer with a confirmation code before campaign participation.
en.disableEffect: SmartPromo consumer verification by confirmation code will not work.

zh-CN.description: Getmo SmartPromo 会打开此页面，用户参与活动前可通过验证码完成身份验证。
zh-CN.disableEffect: SmartPromo 将无法通过验证码验证用户身份。

en.description: Getmo SmartPromo opens this screen to collect the consumer information and consent configured for campaign registration.
en.disableEffect: Consumers will not be able to complete the SmartPromo registration form.

zh-CN.description: Getmo SmartPromo 会打开此页面，收集活动报名所需的用户信息和授权。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法填写并提交 SmartPromo 报名表。

en.description: Getmo SmartPromo opens this screen to ask for a consumer identifier and route the user to registration or verification.
en.disableEffect: The SmartPromo consumer identification and registration or verification flow will not work.

zh-CN.description: Getmo SmartPromo 会打开此页面收集用户标识，并引导用户注册或验证。
zh-CN.disableEffect: SmartPromo 的用户识别、注册或验证流程将无法使用。

en.description: Getmo SmartPromo opens this web page from a prize flow to display the supplied payment page and return when payment navigation finishes.
en.disableEffect: The payment page opened by SmartPromo prizes will not be available.

zh-CN.description: Getmo SmartPromo 会在奖励流程中打开此网页，显示指定的支付页面，并在支付页面流程结束后返回。
zh-CN.disableEffect: SmartPromo 奖励流程将无法打开该支付页面。

en.description: Getmo SmartPromo opens this screen to show campaign prizes, including instant prizes, gifts, or awards.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to view or continue the SmartPromo prize flow.

zh-CN.description: Getmo SmartPromo 会打开此页面，显示活动奖品，包括即时奖励、礼品或奖项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法查看或继续 SmartPromo 的奖励流程。

en.description: Getmo SmartPromo opens this screen so consumers can photograph or choose a receipt image and submit it for a campaign.
en.disableEffect: Consumers will not be able to capture and submit campaign receipts through SmartPromo.

zh-CN.description: Getmo SmartPromo 会打开此页面，用户可拍摄或选择收据图片并提交到活动中。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 SmartPromo 拍摄并提交活动收据。

en.description: Getmo SmartPromo opens this screen from the campaign home to show previously submitted receipts and their status.
en.disableEffect: Consumers will no longer be able to review their submitted SmartPromo receipts.

zh-CN.description: Getmo SmartPromo 会从活动首页打开此页面，显示已提交的收据及其状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法再查看已提交的 SmartPromo 收据。

en.description: Getmo SmartPromo opens this screen to display a campaign banner or receipt image at an enlarged size.
en.disableEffect: Campaign and receipt images opened from SmartPromo will no longer be viewable in the enlarged screen.

zh-CN.description: Getmo SmartPromo 会打开此页面，以放大尺寸显示活动横幅或收据图片。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在 SmartPromo 的放大页面中查看活动图片和收据图片。

en.description: Getmo SmartPromo opens this screen to list the winners associated with a campaign.
en.disableEffect: Consumers will no longer be able to view campaign winners in SmartPromo.

zh-CN.description: Getmo SmartPromo 会打开此页面，列出活动相关的获奖者。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法再通过 SmartPromo 查看活动获奖者。

en.description: Hand Talk Android SDK opens this Activity in its separate process to show Hugo signing translated text for the user.
en.disableEffect: The app will no longer show Hugo signing translated text.

zh-CN.description: Hand Talk Android SDK 会在独立进程中打开此 Activity，让 Hugo 以手语展示翻译后的文字。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法再显示 Hugo 的手语翻译。

en.description: Hand Talk Android SDK opens this screen to show illustrated instructions for using the translation feature.
en.disableEffect: Users will no longer be able to open the Hand Talk feature tutorial.

zh-CN.description: Hand Talk Android SDK 会打开此页面，以插图说明如何使用翻译功能。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法再打开 Hand Talk 功能教程。

en.description: Moip Android SDK opens this checkout screen to collect payer details and card number, expiry date, and security code.
en.disableEffect: The Moip card checkout form will not open, preventing users from entering payment details through this flow.

zh-CN.description: Moip Android SDK 会打开此结账页面，收集付款人信息、银行卡号、有效期和安全码。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Moip 银行卡结账表单将无法打开，用户无法通过此流程输入支付信息。

en.description: Moip Android SDK opens this screen to collect account credentials and request an OAuth access token for the connected Moip account.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to authorize the Moip account through this login flow.

zh-CN.description: Moip Android SDK 会打开此页面收集账户凭据，并为关联的 Moip 账户申请 OAuth 访问令牌。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此登录流程授权 Moip 账户。

en.description: Moip Android SDK opens this screen after login so the user can allow or cancel the requested account access.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to approve or cancel the Moip account-access request in the SDK flow.

zh-CN.description: Moip Android SDK 会在登录后打开此页面，让用户允许或取消所请求的账户访问。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在 SDK 流程中批准或取消 Moip 账户访问请求。

en.description: This is part of Mrocigno's BigBrother diagnostic toolkit. BigBrother registers this task when the app starts; when its diagnostic tools are enabled, it prepares a local database for saved sessions and crash reports. It does not open the app's own databases.
en.disableEffect: BigBrother's local diagnostic records will not be initialized, so saved crash and session details may be unavailable; the app's own data is unaffected.

zh-CN.description: 这是 Mrocigno 的 BigBrother 诊断工具的一部分。应用启动时，BigBrother 会注册此任务；启用诊断工具后，它会准备保存会话和崩溃报告的本地数据库。它不会打开应用自己的数据库。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，BigBrother 的本地诊断记录无法初始化，已保存的崩溃和会话详情可能不可用；应用自身数据不受影响。

en.description: This is part of Mrocigno's BigBrother diagnostic toolkit. When BigBrother monitoring is enabled, it places a floating shortcut on app screens so users can open the diagnostic panel.
en.disableEffect: The BigBrother floating shortcut and its diagnostic panel will disappear; normal app screens will continue to work.

zh-CN.description: 这是 Mrocigno 的 BigBrother 诊断工具的一部分。启用 BigBrother 监控后，它会在应用页面上显示悬浮入口，供用户打开诊断面板。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，BigBrother 悬浮入口和诊断面板将不再出现；应用的普通页面仍可使用。

en.description: This is part of Mrocigno's BigBrother diagnostic toolkit. When BigBrother handles an uncaught app crash, it opens this screen with the page where the crash occurred, the error details, and a session timeline.
en.disableEffect: The BigBrother crash report screen will not open, so its saved error details cannot be reviewed; the app's normal operation is unaffected.

zh-CN.description: 这是 Mrocigno 的 BigBrother 诊断工具的一部分。BigBrother 处理应用未捕获的崩溃时会打开此页面，显示出错时所在的页面、错误详情和会话时间线。

en.description: This is part of Mrocigno's BigBrother diagnostic toolkit. As app screens resume, this BigBrother task registers a handler for uncaught crashes; when one occurs, the handler saves a report and opens the crash screen.
en.disableEffect: BigBrother will stop saving and showing crash reports; the app's existing crash handler remains in place.

zh-CN.description: 这是 Mrocigno 的 BigBrother 诊断工具的一部分。应用页面恢复显示时，此 BigBrother 任务会注册未捕获崩溃的处理程序；发生崩溃时，该程序会保存报告并打开崩溃页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，BigBrother 不再保存或显示崩溃报告；应用原有的崩溃处理程序仍会工作。

en.description: This is part of Mrocigno's BigBrother diagnostic toolkit. When the BigBrother diagnostic panel starts, this task scans accessible app storage for SQLite databases and preference files that can be browsed.
en.disableEffect: The app's databases and preference files will no longer appear in BigBrother's diagnostic browser; the app will keep using them normally.

zh-CN.description: 这是 Mrocigno 的 BigBrother 诊断工具的一部分。BigBrother 诊断面板启动时，此任务会扫描应用存储中可访问的 SQLite 数据库和偏好设置文件，供用户浏览。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用的数据库和偏好设置文件不会显示在 BigBrother 诊断浏览器中；应用仍可正常使用这些数据。

en.description: This is part of Mrocigno's BigBrother diagnostic toolkit. This BigBrother screen opens after a preference file is selected in the diagnostic browser and displays that file's stored values.
en.disableEffect: You will not be able to inspect preference-file contents in BigBrother; the app's preferences continue to work.

zh-CN.description: 这是 Mrocigno 的 BigBrother 诊断工具的一部分。在 BigBrother 诊断浏览器中选择偏好设置文件后会打开此页面，显示该文件保存的内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法在 BigBrother 中查看偏好设置文件；应用的偏好设置仍可正常使用。

en.description: This is part of Mrocigno's BigBrother diagnostic toolkit. After a table is selected in BigBrother's database browser, this screen shows its columns and rows and lets users inspect expanded values.
en.disableEffect: BigBrother's table-inspection screen will be unavailable; the app's databases remain unchanged and usable.

zh-CN.description: 这是 Mrocigno 的 BigBrother 诊断工具的一部分。在 BigBrother 数据库浏览器中选择数据表后，此页面会显示表的列和记录，并可展开查看字段内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，BigBrother 无法打开数据表检查页面；应用数据库不受影响，仍可正常使用。

en.description: This is part of Mrocigno's BigBrother diagnostic toolkit. BigBrother opens this older log screen for a selected session to show that session's recorded log entries.
en.disableEffect: The older BigBrother session-log screen will be unavailable; the app's own logging and features are unaffected.

zh-CN.description: 这是 Mrocigno 的 BigBrother 诊断工具的一部分。BigBrother 为选定会话打开此旧版日志页面，显示该会话记录的日志条目。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，旧版 BigBrother 会话日志页面不可用；应用自身的日志和功能不受影响。

en.description: This is part of Mrocigno's BigBrother diagnostic toolkit. Android creates this BigBrother provider during app startup; it initializes the local log store used by the diagnostic log screen.
en.disableEffect: BigBrother's local log store will not be initialized, so its diagnostic log history may be missing; normal app features continue to work.

zh-CN.description: 这是 Mrocigno 的 BigBrother 诊断工具的一部分。Android 会在应用启动时创建此 BigBrother Provider；它会初始化诊断日志页面使用的本地日志存储。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，BigBrother 的本地日志存储不会初始化，诊断日志记录可能缺失；应用的普通功能仍可使用。

en.description: This is part of Mrocigno's BigBrother diagnostic toolkit. BigBrother opens this log screen for a selected session to show its recorded log entries.
en.disableEffect: BigBrother's session-log screen will be unavailable; the app's own logging and features are unaffected.

zh-CN.description: 这是 Mrocigno 的 BigBrother 诊断工具的一部分。BigBrother 为选定会话打开此日志页面，显示该会话记录的日志条目。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，BigBrother 会话日志页面不可用；应用自身的日志和功能不受影响。

en.description: This is part of Mrocigno's BigBrother diagnostic toolkit. When a user selects a captured request in BigBrother's network history, this screen shows the request and response details.
en.disableEffect: You will not be able to inspect individual network requests in BigBrother; the app's network connections continue to work.

zh-CN.description: 这是 Mrocigno 的 BigBrother 诊断工具的一部分。在 BigBrother 网络记录中选择一条请求后，此页面会显示请求和响应详情。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法在 BigBrother 中检查单条网络请求；应用的网络连接仍可正常工作。

en.description: This is part of Mrocigno's BigBrother diagnostic toolkit. Android creates this BigBrother provider during app startup; it initializes the local store used by the diagnostic network history.
en.disableEffect: BigBrother's network history will not initialize, so diagnostic request records may be unavailable; the app's network traffic is unaffected.

zh-CN.description: 这是 Mrocigno 的 BigBrother 诊断工具的一部分。Android 会在应用启动时创建此 BigBrother Provider；它会初始化诊断网络记录使用的本地存储。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，BigBrother 网络记录无法初始化，诊断请求记录可能不可用；应用的网络通信不受影响。

en.description: This is part of Mrocigno's BigBrother diagnostic toolkit. BigBrother opens this screen when a user selects a JSON request or response body, then formats the JSON for reading.
en.disableEffect: The formatted JSON view will be unavailable; captured requests and the app's network connections remain unaffected.

zh-CN.description: 这是 Mrocigno 的 BigBrother 诊断工具的一部分。用户在 BigBrother 中选择 JSON 请求或响应内容时会打开此页面，页面会整理格式以便阅读。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，格式化的 JSON 查看页面不可用；已捕获的请求和应用网络连接不受影响。

en.description: This is part of Mrocigno's BigBrother diagnostic toolkit. When a user selects a captured request in BigBrother's network history, this screen shows its URL, request data, and response.
en.disableEffect: You will not be able to open individual request details in BigBrother; the app's network connections continue to work.

zh-CN.description: 这是 Mrocigno 的 BigBrother 诊断工具的一部分。在 BigBrother 网络记录中选择一条请求后，此页面会显示网址、请求内容和响应。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法在 BigBrother 中打开单条请求详情；应用的网络连接仍可正常工作。

en.description: This is part of Mrocigno's BigBrother diagnostic toolkit. BigBrother opens this screen for a network session to list its captured requests.
en.disableEffect: The BigBrother network-session request list will be unavailable; normal app network activity is unaffected.

zh-CN.description: 这是 Mrocigno 的 BigBrother 诊断工具的一部分。BigBrother 为网络会话打开此页面，列出该会话捕获的请求。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，BigBrother 网络会话的请求列表不可用；应用的正常网络活动不受影响。

en.description: This is part of Mrocigno's BigBrother diagnostic toolkit. When BigBrother session diagnostics start, this task records which app screens open and adds interaction markers to the session timeline.
en.disableEffect: BigBrother will stop collecting the screen and interaction history used in session reports; app screens continue to work normally.

zh-CN.description: 这是 Mrocigno 的 BigBrother 诊断工具的一部分。BigBrother 会话诊断启动后，此任务会记录打开过的应用页面，并将交互标记加入会话时间线。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，BigBrother 不再收集会话报告使用的页面和交互记录；应用页面仍可正常运行。

en.description: This is part of Mrocigno's BigBrother diagnostic toolkit. When the older BigBrother report handler catches an uncaught crash, it opens this screen with the failing page, error stack, and recent session activity.
en.disableEffect: The older BigBrother crash report screen will be unavailable; the app's normal features are unaffected.

zh-CN.description: 这是 Mrocigno 的 BigBrother 诊断工具的一部分。旧版 BigBrother 报告处理程序捕获未处理崩溃时会打开此页面，显示出错页面、错误堆栈和近期会话活动。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，旧版 BigBrother 崩溃报告页面不可用；应用的普通功能不受影响。

en.description: This is part of Mrocigno's BigBrother diagnostic toolkit. As app screens resume, this older BigBrother task registers a handler for uncaught crashes; a crash opens the report screen.
en.disableEffect: The older BigBrother crash handler and report screen will no longer run; the app's existing crash handler remains in place.

zh-CN.description: 这是 Mrocigno 的 BigBrother 诊断工具的一部分。应用页面恢复显示时，此旧版 BigBrother 任务会注册未捕获崩溃的处理程序；发生崩溃时会打开报告页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，旧版 BigBrother 崩溃处理程序和报告页面不再运行；应用原有的崩溃处理程序仍会工作。

en.description: This is part of Mrocigno's BigBrother diagnostic toolkit. After a user selects a saved session in BigBrother, this screen shows its recorded activity and links to the session's network and log details.
en.disableEffect: Saved session details and their diagnostic links will not be viewable in BigBrother; the app's normal screens are unaffected.

zh-CN.description: 这是 Mrocigno 的 BigBrother 诊断工具的一部分。用户在 BigBrother 中选择已保存的会话后，此页面会显示记录的活动，并提供该会话的网络和日志详情入口。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，BigBrother 中无法查看已保存的会话详情及诊断链接；应用的普通页面不受影响。

en.description: This is part of Mrocigno's Sandman diagnostic toolkit. When Sandman's crash handler catches an uncaught app error, it opens this screen with the page name and exception details.
en.disableEffect: Sandman's crash report screen will not open; the app's normal features are unaffected.

zh-CN.description: 这是 Mrocigno 的 Sandman 诊断工具的一部分。Sandman 的崩溃处理程序捕获应用未处理的错误后会打开此页面，显示页面名称和异常详情。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Sandman 崩溃报告页面不会打开；应用的普通功能不受影响。

en.description: This is part of Mrocigno's Sandman diagnostic toolkit. As app screens resume, this Sandman task registers an uncaught-crash handler that opens Sandman's crash report when an error occurs.
en.disableEffect: Sandman will stop opening its crash report; the app's existing crash handler remains in place.

zh-CN.description: 这是 Mrocigno 的 Sandman 诊断工具的一部分。应用页面恢复显示时，此 Sandman 任务会注册未捕获崩溃的处理程序，发生错误时打开 Sandman 崩溃报告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Sandman 不再打开崩溃报告；应用原有的崩溃处理程序仍会工作。
