en.disableEffect: The Sandman floating shortcut and its diagnostic panel will disappear; normal app screens will continue to work.

zh-CN.description: 这是 Mrocigno 的 Sandman 诊断工具的一部分。启用 Sandman 监控后，此任务会在应用页面上显示悬浮入口，供用户打开 Sandman 诊断面板。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Sandman 悬浮入口和诊断面板将不再出现；应用的普通页面仍可使用。

en.description: This is part of Mrocigno's Sandman diagnostic toolkit. When a user selects a captured request in Sandman's network history, this screen shows its request and response details.
en.disableEffect: Sandman's individual network-request details will be unavailable; the app's network connections continue to work.

zh-CN.description: 这是 Mrocigno 的 Sandman 诊断工具的一部分。用户在 Sandman 网络记录中选择一条请求后，此页面会显示请求和响应详情。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Sandman 无法查看单条网络请求详情；应用的网络连接仍可正常工作。

en.description: This is part of Mrocigno's Sandman diagnostic toolkit. Sandman opens this screen when a user selects JSON from a captured network request or response, and formats it for reading.
en.disableEffect: The formatted JSON view will be unavailable; Sandman's request capture and the app's network connections are unaffected.

zh-CN.description: 这是 Mrocigno 的 Sandman 诊断工具的一部分。用户在 Sandman 捕获的网络请求或响应中选择 JSON 内容时会打开此页面，页面会整理格式以便阅读。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，格式化的 JSON 查看页面不可用；Sandman 请求记录和应用网络连接不受影响。

en.description: This is part of Mrocigno's Sandman diagnostic toolkit. When Sandman monitoring is active, this task records the app screens and fragments users visit and adds interaction markers to its session report.
en.disableEffect: Sandman will stop collecting the screen and interaction history used in its reports; the app's normal screens remain usable.

zh-CN.description: 这是 Mrocigno 的 Sandman 诊断工具的一部分。Sandman 监控启用后，此任务会记录用户访问的应用页面和片段，并在会话报告中加入交互标记。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Sandman 不再收集报告使用的页面和交互记录；应用的普通页面仍可使用。

en.description: Neomode HTTP Loader receives Android connectivity and Wi-Fi state changes and updates whether network requests can proceed.
en.disableEffect: The loader may not detect restored connectivity and may fail to resume queued requests.

zh-CN.description: Neomode HTTP Loader 会接收 Android 网络连接和 Wi-Fi 状态变化，并更新请求是否可以继续。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Loader 可能无法检测网络恢复，导致排队的请求无法继续。

en.description: After the device finishes starting, Off2's audio identification and advertising SDK clears old timers and starts its advertising schedule.
en.disableEffect: Off2's scheduled audio advertising will not restart automatically after the device boots.

zh-CN.description: 设备启动完成后，Off2 音频识别与广告 SDK 会清理旧的定时任务并启动广告安排。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 关闭后，Off2 的定时音频广告不会在设备启动后自动恢复。

en.description: When Off2 requests an advertising refresh, this receiver starts a background request using the saved customer ID and advertising-server address.
en.disableEffect: Off2's advertising refresh through this request will stop.

zh-CN.description: Off2 请求刷新广告时，此接收器会使用已保存的客户编号和广告服务器地址启动后台请求。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 关闭后，Off2 无法通过此请求刷新广告。

en.description: After Off2 installs a new sound-recognition data bundle, this receiver sends the bundle version, device token, customer ID, and update time to Off2's server.
en.disableEffect: Off2 will stop reporting completed sound-catalog updates through this receiver.

zh-CN.description: Off2 安装新的声音识别数据包后，此接收器会把数据包版本、设备令牌、客户编号和更新时间发送给 Off2 服务器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 关闭后，Off2 不会通过此接收器报告声音数据包更新完成。

en.description: When Off2 requests a sound-recognition data update, this receiver starts a download using the saved file address, name, and checksum.
en.disableEffect: Off2's sound-recognition catalog will no longer update through this download flow.

zh-CN.description: Off2 请求更新声音识别数据时，此接收器会使用已保存的文件地址、文件名和校验值启动下载。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 关闭后，Off2 无法通过此下载流程更新声音识别数据。

en.description: When Firebase gives Off2 a new push token, this service saves it and sends the token and device registration details to Firebase.
en.disableEffect: Off2 will not register refreshed push tokens, so its push-driven updates may stop.

zh-CN.description: Firebase 为 Off2 分配新的推送令牌时，此服务会保存令牌并将令牌和设备注册信息写入 Firebase。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 关闭后，Off2 不会登记更新后的推送令牌，其推送更新可能停止。

en.description: When Firebase sends Off2 a data message requesting a sound-catalog update, this service saves the download details and starts the update flow.
en.disableEffect: Off2 will no longer receive push-triggered sound-catalog updates through this service.

zh-CN.description: Firebase 向 Off2 发送声音数据更新消息时，此服务会保存下载信息并启动更新流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 关闭后，Off2 无法通过此服务接收推送触发的声音数据更新。

en.description: When a user dismisses an Off2 advertising notification, this receiver cancels it and records the ad ID, time, and location in Firebase.
en.disableEffect: Off2 will stop recording dismissals of these advertising notifications.

zh-CN.description: 用户关闭 Off2 广告通知时，此接收器会取消通知，并将广告编号、时间和位置记录到 Firebase。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 关闭后，Off2 不会再记录此类广告通知的关闭情况。

en.description: When a user taps an Off2 advertising notification, this receiver records the ad ID, time, and location, dismisses the notification, and opens its link.
en.disableEffect: Off2 advertising notifications will no longer open their links or record taps through this receiver.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击 Off2 广告通知时，此接收器会记录广告编号、时间和位置，取消通知并打开广告链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 关闭后，Off2 广告通知无法通过此接收器打开链接或记录点击。

en.description: When Off2's audio-service restart signal arrives, this receiver starts or stops its background audio-listening service according to the saved setting.
en.disableEffect: Off2's background audio-listening service will no longer follow its saved restart setting.

zh-CN.description: 收到 Off2 的音频服务重启信号时，此接收器会根据已保存的设置启动或停止后台听音服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 关闭后，Off2 的后台听音服务不再按已保存的设置启停。

en.description: When Off2 updates its sound-recognition catalog, this service downloads the archive, checks it, and unpacks it before reporting the update.
en.disableEffect: Off2's local sound-recognition catalog will not update through this service.

zh-CN.description: Off2 更新声音识别数据时，此服务会下载数据包、校验文件并解压，然后报告更新结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 关闭后，Off2 无法通过此服务更新本地声音识别数据。

en.description: When Off2 performs an audio check, this service records a short sound clip, matches it against its local ACRCloud catalog, and can show a notification for a match.
en.disableEffect: Off2 will stop identifying nearby audio and showing match-based notifications through this service.

zh-CN.description: Off2 进行音频识别时，此服务会录制一小段声音，与本地 ACRCloud 数据进行匹配，并可在匹配成功时显示通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 关闭后，Off2 不会再通过此服务识别周围声音或显示匹配通知。

en.description: Off2's advertising manager checks the server's schedule and starts or stops its background audio-advertising service during the configured hours.
en.disableEffect: Off2's scheduled audio advertising will stop being managed.

zh-CN.description: Off2 广告管理服务会读取服务器上的时间安排，并在设定时段启停后台音频广告服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 关闭后，Off2 将无法按时间安排管理音频广告。

en.description: During first registration, this Off2 service sends the device's push token to the server and saves the returned sound-catalog download details.
en.disableEffect: Off2's initial device registration and sound-catalog setup will not run through this service.

zh-CN.description: 首次注册 Off2 时，此服务会向服务器发送设备推送令牌，并保存返回的声音数据下载信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 关闭后，Off2 无法通过此服务完成设备首次注册和声音数据配置。

en.description: After an Off2 sound-catalog update, this service reports the bundle version, device, customer, and update time to the server, retrying when offline.
en.disableEffect: Off2 will stop reporting sound-catalog update receipts through this service.

zh-CN.description: Off2 更新声音数据后，此服务会向服务器报告数据版本、设备、客户和更新时间，并在离线时重试。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 关闭后，Off2 不会通过此服务报告声音数据更新回执。

en.description: When Off2 refreshes advertising, this service sends the customer ID to its ad server and reads any returned links, titles, and messages.
en.disableEffect: Off2's advertising refresh through this service will stop.

zh-CN.description: Off2 刷新广告时，此服务会向广告服务器发送客户编号，并读取返回的链接、标题和消息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 关闭后，Off2 无法通过此服务刷新广告。

en.description: During scheduled Off2 monitoring, this service records ambient sound, matches it against the local catalog, and displays a notification for an eligible ad.
en.disableEffect: Off2 will stop matching ambient sound and displaying related advertising notifications.

zh-CN.description: 在 Off2 设定的监测时段内，此服务会录制周围声音，与本地数据匹配，并为符合条件的广告显示通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 关闭后，Off2 不会再匹配周围声音或显示相关广告通知。

en.description: When Off2's advertising timer fires, this receiver starts the service that checks the advertising schedule.
en.disableEffect: Off2's advertising schedule will no longer restart from this timer.

zh-CN.description: Off2 的广告定时器触发时，此接收器会启动检查广告时间安排的服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 关闭后，Off2 无法通过此定时器重新检查广告安排。

en.description: When Off2's audio-service watchdog fires, this receiver checks its saved service state and restarts the audio listener when the saved instance matches.
en.disableEffect: Off2's scheduled recovery check for background audio recognition will stop.

zh-CN.description: Off2 的音频服务监控定时器触发时，此接收器会检查已保存的服务状态，并在实例匹配时重启听音服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 关闭后，Off2 将停止定时恢复后台音频识别服务。

en.description: When Off2's stop timer fires, this receiver stops background audio recognition, cancels its restart timer, and schedules the advertising manager.
en.disableEffect: Off2's scheduled stop and follow-up advertising check will not run through this receiver.

zh-CN.description: Off2 的停止定时器触发时，此接收器会停止后台音频识别、取消重启定时器，并安排广告管理服务运行。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 关闭后，Off2 无法通过此接收器定时停止识别并继续检查广告。

en.description: When an Off2 sound-catalog update is pending, this receiver manages download retries and schedules another attempt; otherwise it clears the retry state.
en.disableEffect: Off2's scheduled retry and cleanup for sound-catalog downloads will stop.

zh-CN.description: Off2 有待处理的声音数据更新时，此接收器会安排下载重试；没有待更新内容时则清理重试状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 关闭后，Off2 将停止定时重试或清理声音数据下载任务。

en.description: After the device starts, Off2's newer advertising scheduler resumes its routine and sets a watchdog timer, with a separate path on recent Android versions.
en.disableEffect: Off2's advertising and configuration routine will not restart automatically after boot.

zh-CN.description: 设备启动后，Off2 的新版广告调度器会恢复定时流程；较新 Android 版本会通过另一条路径启动。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 关闭后，Off2 的广告和配置流程不会在开机后自动恢复。

en.description: When Off2 signals that scheduled audio monitoring should start or stop, this receiver starts or stops its sound-recognition service.
en.disableEffect: Off2's audio recognition and match-based advertising will not follow the configured schedule.

zh-CN.description: Off2 发出开始或停止定时音频监测的信号时，此接收器会启动或停止声音识别服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 关闭后，Off2 的音频识别和匹配广告不会按设定时间启停。

en.description: On Off2's routine timer, this receiver reschedules itself and starts device registration or refreshes advertising configuration, depending on registration status.
en.disableEffect: Off2's recurring registration and advertising-configuration checks will stop.

zh-CN.description: Off2 的定时流程触发时，此接收器会重新安排下一次运行，并根据注册状态启动设备注册或刷新广告配置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 关闭后，Off2 将停止定期检查注册状态和广告配置。

en.description: When a user dismisses an Off2 advertising notification, this receiver saves the dismissal details locally and cancels the notification.
en.disableEffect: Off2 will stop saving dismissal events for its advertising notifications.

zh-CN.description: 用户关闭 Off2 广告通知时，此接收器会在本地保存关闭记录并取消通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 关闭后，Off2 不会再保存广告通知的关闭记录。

en.description: When a user taps an Off2 advertising notification, this receiver saves the click details locally, cancels the notification, and opens the ad link.
en.disableEffect: Off2 advertising notifications will no longer open links or save click details through this receiver.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击 Off2 广告通知时，此接收器会在本地保存点击信息、取消通知并打开广告链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 关闭后，Off2 广告通知无法通过此接收器打开链接或保存点击信息。

en.description: Every minute, this Off2 receiver schedules its next check and starts the routine manager if it is no longer running.
en.disableEffect: Off2 will stop automatically restarting its advertising and registration routine.

zh-CN.description: 此 Off2 接收器每分钟安排下一次检查；如果定时管理流程已停止，就会重新启动它。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 关闭后，Off2 不会再自动恢复广告和注册流程。

en.description: During Off2 device registration, this service sends the device identifier, customer number, and SDK version to Off2 when phone-state permission is available.
en.disableEffect: Off2's device registration and the configuration fetched after it will not run through this service.

zh-CN.description: 注册 Off2 设备时，如果已授予电话状态权限，此服务会向 Off2 发送设备标识、客户编号和 SDK 版本。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 关闭后，Off2 无法通过此服务注册设备或获取后续配置。

en.description: When Off2 refreshes its settings, this service reports advertising events and optional location, then stores schedules, ad details, and sound-catalog download settings.
en.disableEffect: Off2's advertising schedule and sound catalog will stop refreshing, and its ad-event reports will not be sent.

zh-CN.description: Off2 刷新设置时，此服务会报告广告事件和可选的位置数据，并保存时间安排、广告信息及声音数据下载配置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 关闭后，Off2 不会刷新广告安排和声音数据，也不会发送广告事件报告。

en.description: At each Off2 schedule check, this service compares the current time with saved advertising hours and starts or stops background audio recognition.
en.disableEffect: Off2's background audio advertising will no longer start or stop according to its schedule.

zh-CN.description: Off2 检查广告安排时，此服务会将当前时间与已保存的广告时段比较，并启停后台音频识别。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 关闭后，Off2 的后台音频广告不会再按时间安排启停。

en.description: After Off2 updates its sound catalog, this service reports the bundle version, device, customer, and update time to the server, retrying if offline.
en.disableEffect: Off2 will stop sending sound-catalog update receipts through this service.

zh-CN.description: Off2 更新声音数据后，此服务会向服务器报告数据版本、设备、客户和更新时间，并在离线时重试。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 关闭后，Off2 不会通过此服务发送声音数据更新回执。

en.description: During configured Off2 hours, this service listens for sounds in its local catalog and shows an advertising notification when a match passes the time and location filters.
en.disableEffect: Off2 will stop matching ambient sound and displaying its related advertising notifications.

zh-CN.description: 在 Off2 设定的时段内，此服务会监听本地数据中的声音；匹配结果符合时间和位置条件时显示广告通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 关闭后，Off2 不会再匹配周围声音或显示相关广告通知。

en.description: Off2's background routine periodically checks device registration and starts registration or advertising-configuration services; it also schedules a restart after the app task is removed.
en.disableEffect: Off2's periodic registration, advertising updates, and routine restart will stop.

zh-CN.description: Off2 的后台流程会定期检查设备注册状态，并启动注册或广告配置服务；应用任务移除后也会安排重新启动。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 关闭后，Off2 将停止定期注册检查、广告更新和流程重启。

en.description: Moip mPOS SDK opens this screen for payment-terminal authentication or transaction data entry when the corresponding action is requested.
en.disableEffect: The Moip mPOS authentication or transaction data-entry flow may not complete.

zh-CN.description: Moip mPOS SDK 会在收到相应请求时打开此页面，用于支付终端认证或交易信息输入。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Moip mPOS 的支付终端认证或交易信息输入流程可能无法完成。

en.description: Moip mPOS SDK provides this transparent Activity variant for its authentication and transaction data-entry interface.
en.disableEffect: An mPOS flow routed through the transparent Activity may not complete.

zh-CN.description: Moip mPOS SDK 提供此透明 Activity 版本，用于显示认证和交易信息输入界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 经由此透明 Activity 运行的 mPOS 流程可能无法完成。

en.description: Moip mPOS SDK opens this screen to display a QR code for a payment, refund, or technical activation.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to complete an mPOS QR-code payment, refund, or activation flow.

zh-CN.description: Moip mPOS SDK 会打开此页面，显示用于支付、退款或技术激活的二维码。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法完成 mPOS 二维码支付、退款或激活流程。

en.description: When a user opens the Venture Labs BluePay device-activation flow, this screen asks for the account PIN and submits it to activate the device.
en.disableEffect: Without it, users cannot complete device activation through BluePay.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Venture Labs 的 BluePay 设备激活流程中打开此界面时，需要输入账户 PIN 并提交以完成激活。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过 BluePay 完成设备激活。

en.description: BluePay opens this authentication screen when an account PIN is needed, so the user can enter the PIN and continue the requested action.
en.disableEffect: PIN-protected BluePay actions cannot continue if this screen is disabled.

zh-CN.description: BluePay 在某项操作需要账户 PIN 时会打开此验证界面，供用户输入 PIN 后继续操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，需要账户 PIN 的 BluePay 操作无法继续。

en.description: When a user creates a Pix payment request in BluePay, this screen prepares the request and displays a QR code, with an optional amount and description.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot create Pix payment requests through BluePay if this screen is disabled.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 BluePay 中创建 Pix 收款请求时会打开此界面；它生成收款二维码，并可附带金额和说明。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过 BluePay 创建 Pix 收款请求。

en.description: This BluePay screen lists saved Pix payment favorites and lets users add, rename, or remove a favorite.
en.disableEffect: Users lose access to the saved payment favorites managed here.

zh-CN.description: 此 BluePay 界面会列出已保存的 Pix 常用收款对象，供用户添加、重命名或删除。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法使用此处管理的常用收款对象。

en.description: The BluePay home screen loads customer and account information, recent transactions, and entry points to other payment features.
en.disableEffect: The BluePay home screen and its account and transaction overview are unavailable if disabled.

zh-CN.description: BluePay 主界面会载入客户和账户资料、近期交易记录，并提供进入其他付款功能的入口。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，BluePay 主界面及其中的账户和交易概览将无法使用。

en.description: Users open this BluePay screen to manage Pix keys, including viewing, adding, removing, or moving a key between providers.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot manage Pix keys through BluePay if this screen is disabled.

zh-CN.description: 用户通过 BluePay 管理 Pix 密钥时会打开此界面，可查看、新增、删除密钥或办理密钥迁移。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过 BluePay 管理 Pix 密钥。

en.description: This BluePay screen shows and changes daily, per-transaction, and night-time payment limits.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot review or adjust these payment limits in BluePay if the screen is disabled.

zh-CN.description: 此 BluePay 界面显示并允许调整每日交易额度、单笔额度和夜间额度。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法在 BluePay 中查看或调整这些交易额度。

en.description: This BluePay flow handles Pix Saque cash withdrawals; it shows nearby service locations, collects the withdrawal amount, and proceeds to payment confirmation.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot find a service location or complete Pix Saque withdrawals through BluePay if disabled.

zh-CN.description: 此 BluePay 流程用于 Pix Saque 现金提取；它显示附近服务点、收集提取金额并继续付款确认。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过 BluePay 查找服务点或完成 Pix Saque 提现。

en.description: This BluePay flow handles Pix Troco cash withdrawal with a purchase; it collects the purchase and change amounts before payment confirmation.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot complete Pix Troco payments through BluePay if this screen is disabled.

zh-CN.description: 此 BluePay 界面用于 Pix Troco 购物取现流程，用户输入购买金额和取现金额后确认付款。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过 BluePay 完成 Pix Troco 购物取现。

en.description: The BluePay profile screen shows account information and provides actions such as password recovery, logout, account deletion, and transaction history.
en.disableEffect: Users lose access to these BluePay profile and account-management actions if disabled.

zh-CN.description: BluePay 个人账户界面显示账户信息，并提供找回密码、退出登录、删除账户和查看交易记录等功能。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法访问这些 BluePay 个人资料和账户管理功能。

en.description: When a user scans a payment QR code in BluePay, this screen reads it and loads the payment details needed to continue the transaction.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot scan and use payment QR codes through this BluePay flow if disabled.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 BluePay 中扫描付款二维码时会打开此界面；它读取二维码内容并加载付款信息以继续交易。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过此 BluePay 流程扫描并使用付款二维码。

en.description: This BluePay screen lists past and scheduled transactions, opens transaction details or receipts, and supports scheduled cancellation and transaction return flows.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot review or manage transaction history through this BluePay screen if disabled.

zh-CN.description: 此 BluePay 界面列出历史和待处理交易，可查看详情或凭证，并支持取消待执行交易和办理退款。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过此 BluePay 界面查看或管理交易记录。

en.description: When a user starts a BluePay transfer, this screen lets them choose a Pix key or bank account, enter an amount and description, and continue the transfer.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot make these BluePay transfers if this screen is disabled.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 BluePay 中发起转账时会打开此界面，可选择 Pix 密钥或银行账户作为收款方，填写金额和说明后继续转账。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过 BluePay 发起此类转账。

en.description: Beagle (Zup IT)'s optional live preview screen connects to the preview service and displays incoming screen updates.
en.disableEffect: Beagle's live developer preview will no longer connect or display screen updates.

zh-CN.description: Zup IT 的 Beagle 可选实时预览页面会连接预览服务，并显示收到的页面更新。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 关闭后，Beagle 的实时开发预览无法连接或显示页面更新。

en.description: When the app opens a Beagle (Zup IT) server-driven page, this Activity hosts the page and shows loading or retry feedback while it loads.
en.disableEffect: App screens delivered through Beagle will not open, which can make their app features unavailable.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开 Zup IT 的 Beagle 服务端驱动页面时，此 Activity 会承载页面，并在加载期间显示进度或重试提示。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过 Beagle 提供的应用页面将无法打开，依赖这些页面的功能也会不可用。

en.description: The BugBattle Android SDK opens its hosted bug report form when a user starts a report from the app. The form can attach a screenshot and send the user's feedback to BugBattle.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to submit bug reports or feedback through BugBattle.

zh-CN.description: BugBattle Android SDK 会在用户从应用发起问题报告时打开在线反馈表单。表单可以附上屏幕截图，并把反馈发送给 BugBattle。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 BugBattle 提交问题报告或反馈。

en.description: When Firebase delivers a CleverTap push, RenderMax helps the SDK finish displaying the notification.
en.disableEffect: Some CleverTap push notifications may not appear or may take longer to display.

zh-CN.description: Firebase 送达 CleverTap 推送时，RenderMax 会协助 SDK 完成通知显示。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 部分 CleverTap 推送可能无法显示，或显示延迟。

en.description: Chat SDK's bundled audio recorder opens when the host app starts an audio recording request. It lets users record audio, listen back, and save the clip to the requested file.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot record and save audio clips through this recorder, so any chat feature that uses it for audio messages stops working.

zh-CN.description: 宿主应用发起录音请求时，Chat SDK 内置的录音界面会打开。用户可录音、回放，并将音频保存到指定文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法通过此录音界面录制和保存音频，因此依赖它发送语音消息的功能会停止工作。

en.description: When an app starts the Lyra PayCards Recognizer card-scan flow, this screen checks camera access and recognition availability, then displays the scanner; a successful scan returns card details to the app.
en.disableEffect: The card-scanning flow will be unavailable, so users cannot capture card details with the camera through this SDK.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动 Lyra PayCards Recognizer 的银行卡扫描流程时，此页面会检查相机权限和识别功能，并显示扫描界面；扫描成功后会把卡片信息返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此 SDK 用相机扫描银行卡信息。

en.description: After Custom Activity on Crash handles an uncaught app failure, this screen can show error details and offer restart or close options, depending on the app's settings.
en.disableEffect: After a crash, users will not see this SDK's custom error and restart screen.

zh-CN.description: Custom Activity on Crash SDK 处理未捕获的应用故障后，此界面可按应用设置显示错误详情，并提供重启或关闭选项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 发生崩溃后，用户将看不到此 SDK 提供的自定义错误和重启界面。

en.description: Android runs this provider with the app, and the Custom Activity on Crash SDK uses it so a crash can show the SDK’s recovery screen.
en.disableEffect: The SDK's custom crash screen will no longer be installed; ordinary app screens do not depend on this provider.

zh-CN.description: Android 启动应用时会运行此内容提供程序，Custom Activity on Crash SDK 通过它启用自己的崩溃恢复界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用日常功能仍可使用，但崩溃后不会显示 SDK 的自定义恢复界面。

en.description: Rokubun Core's Spear Location Engine uses this foreground service for GNSS location work. It provides a local connection to the location manager and shows an ongoing location notification while running.
en.disableEffect: Location tracking that relies on Rokubun Core will lose its GNSS service connection.

zh-CN.description: Rokubun Core 的 Spear Location Engine 使用此前台服务处理 GNSS 定位。服务为应用提供本地定位管理器连接，并在运行时显示持续通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖 Rokubun Core 的定位功能将失去 GNSS 服务连接。

en.description: Meringue's Firebase push service delivers incoming messages to the app's registered listeners and saves refreshed push tokens. It runs when Firebase delivers a message or token update.
en.disableEffect: Meringue message callbacks and token updates stop, so app behavior driven by Meringue push messages may no longer work.

zh-CN.description: Meringue 的 Firebase 推送服务会把收到的消息交给应用注册的监听器，并保存更新后的推送令牌；Firebase 送达消息或更新令牌时会运行。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Meringue 的消息回调和令牌更新会停止，依赖其推送消息的应用行为可能无法运行。

en.description: PostFinance Checkout opens this screen to display its payment checkout. It loads the checkout interface and its payment methods, including TWINT.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open or complete payments through PostFinance Checkout.

zh-CN.description: PostFinance Checkout 使用此界面显示支付结账流程，并加载结账界面及包括 TWINT 在内的支付方式。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 PostFinance Checkout 打开或完成付款。

en.description: PostFinance Checkout shows this branded loading screen while a checkout starts, then closes it when the payment screen is ready.
en.disableEffect: The checkout launcher cannot show its loading screen, so opening a PostFinance payment flow fails.

zh-CN.description: PostFinance Checkout 启动结账时会显示此品牌加载界面，并在支付界面就绪后将其关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 结账启动器无法显示加载界面，PostFinance 支付流程将无法打开。

en.description: Luqinx's AMI Android debug tools use this Activity to open optional in-app diagnostic screens.
en.disableEffect: AMI's diagnostic screens that use this container will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: Luqinx 的 AMI Android 调试工具通过此 Activity 打开可选的应用内诊断页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，使用此容器的 AMI 诊断页面将无法打开。

en.description: Luqinx's AMI Android debug tools use this Activity to open optional in-app diagnostic screens.
en.disableEffect: AMI's diagnostic screens that use this container will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: Luqinx 的 AMI Android 调试工具通过此 Activity 打开可选的应用内诊断页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，使用此容器的 AMI 诊断页面将无法打开。

en.description: Luqinx's AMI Android debug tools start this Service to handle background diagnostic commands for their monitor screens, including dump and memory-cleanup requests.
en.disableEffect: AMI's diagnostic monitor commands will stop, while ordinary app features remain available.

zh-CN.description: Luqinx 的 AMI Android 调试工具通过此 Service 处理监控页面的后台诊断命令，包括转储和内存清理请求。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，AMI 的诊断监控命令将停止，但应用的常规功能仍可使用。

en.description: Luqinx's AMI Android debug tools open this Activity to request Android permissions needed by an optional diagnostic tool. It returns the permission result to AMI.
en.disableEffect: AMI's permission-dependent diagnostic tools cannot request or report permissions; unrelated host-app features remain available.

zh-CN.description: Luqinx 的 AMI Android 调试工具通过此 Activity 为可选诊断功能申请 Android 权限，并将权限结果返回给 AMI。
zh-CN.disableEffect: AMI 中依赖权限的诊断功能将无法申请或获知权限结果；宿主应用的其他功能不受影响。

en.description: AnswerzDigital CrosswalkLib opens a web page in its embedded browser when users tap its launcher entry or the app asks the library to open it. Some releases register it as the app launcher.
en.disableEffect: The page will no longer open, and a release that relies on it as the launcher may leave the app without its normal entry screen.

zh-CN.description: AnswerzDigital CrosswalkLib 会在用户点开它的启动入口，或应用要求该库打开页面时，在内置浏览器中显示网页。部分版本会把它注册为应用的启动页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 网页将无法打开；如果某个版本把它作为应用启动页面，应用可能会失去正常入口。

en.description: The AnswerzDigital CrosswalkLib opens a web page in its embedded browser from its launcher icon.
en.disableEffect: If this is the app's only launcher screen, disabling it may prevent users from opening the app normally.

zh-CN.description: AnswerzDigital CrosswalkLib 会在用户点击启动图标时，通过内置浏览器打开网页。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 如果这是应用唯一的启动页面，停用后用户可能无法正常打开应用。

en.description: The Yoharaja Library and Malathi8190 MyLib samples use this Activity for the same demo screen: a button displays a greeting when tapped.
en.disableEffect: Blocking it removes this optional sample greeting screen.

zh-CN.description: Yoharaja Library 和 Malathi8190 MyLib 样例库都使用此 Activity 显示同一个演示页面，点按按钮会显示问候信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，这个可选的样例问候页面将无法打开。

en.description: AnswerzDigital MyLIBApplication opens the CheharaTime room page selected by the app, shows loading or error feedback, and lets the room page share an invitation.
en.disableEffect: Users can no longer join a room through this screen or share its invitation.

zh-CN.description: AnswerzDigital MyLIBApplication 会打开应用指定的 CheharaTime 房间页面，显示加载或错误提示，并允许房间页面分享邀请信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此页面进入房间或分享邀请信息。

en.description: MagnetRestClient uses this screen when the host app requires an update; its button opens the app's store listing or, if no store app is available, the web listing.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, the app cannot show its required-update prompt or send users to the update page.

zh-CN.description: 宿主应用需要升级时，MagnetRestClient 会显示此页面；点击按钮会打开应用的商店页面，如果没有可用的商店应用则打开网页商店页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，应用无法显示必需的升级提示，也无法引导用户前往更新页面。

en.description: The Gojek Clickstream event visualizer opens this screen when the user taps its floating viewer control. It lists captured event names for inspection while debugging.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it removes the in-app Clickstream event viewer; event collection and the app's regular screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: Gojek Clickstream 事件查看器会在用户点按悬浮查看按钮时打开此页面。页面列出已捕获的事件名称，供调试时检查。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后将无法打开应用内的 Clickstream 事件查看器，但事件采集和应用的常规页面仍可使用。

en.description: When Firebase Cloud Messaging delivers a push or refreshes the device token, the EZPush Android SDK uses this service to handle its messages and commands and register the new token.
en.disableEffect: EZPush notifications, commands, and token updates will no longer be handled, while the rest of the host app remains available.

zh-CN.description: Firebase Cloud Messaging 投递推送或刷新设备令牌时，EZPush Android SDK 会通过此服务处理消息和命令，并登记新令牌。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，EZPush 通知、命令和令牌更新将无法处理，但宿主应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: When a user dismisses an EZPush notification, the EZPush Android SDK records that dismissal through this receiver.
en.disableEffect: EZPush will stop recording dismissed notifications, but notifications can still be received and shown.

zh-CN.description: 用户清除 EZPush 通知时，EZPush Android SDK 会通过此接收器记录该事件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，EZPush 将无法记录通知被清除的事件，但通知仍可接收和显示。

en.description: Opening an EZPush test-device pairing link starts this screen; the SDK registers the phone as a test device and shows whether pairing succeeded.
en.disableEffect: The EZPush test-device pairing link will no longer register the phone, while other app features remain available.

zh-CN.description: 打开 EZPush 测试设备配对链接时会显示此页面；SDK 会将手机登记为测试设备，并显示配对是否成功。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，EZPush 测试设备配对链接将无法登记手机，但应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: After a user taps an EZPush notification, the SDK briefly opens this screen and passes the notification link and extra information to the host app.
en.disableEffect: Tapping an EZPush notification will no longer open the host app with its link or extra information; users can still open the app normally.

zh-CN.description: 用户点按 EZPush 通知后，SDK 会短暂显示此页面，并将通知链接及附带信息传给宿主应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，点按 EZPush 通知将无法携带链接或附加信息打开宿主应用，但用户仍可正常启动应用。

en.description: Mindbox opens this screen during its in-app push setup to request notification permission; it handles the user's choice and can direct them to notification settings after repeated denials.
en.disableEffect: Mindbox cannot request notification permission or guide users to notification settings through this flow, so Mindbox push activation stops working.

zh-CN.description: Mindbox 的应用内推送启用流程需要请求通知权限时，会打开此页面；它处理用户的选择，并可在多次拒绝后引导用户前往通知设置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，Mindbox 无法通过此流程请求通知权限或引导用户前往通知设置，推送启用流程将无法使用。

en.description: When the host app opens a PACE connected-fueling page, the PACE Cloud SDK displays it in the app and handles page actions such as Google Pay requests.
en.disableEffect: PACE in-app pages and their payment actions will not open, so connected-fueling tasks that use them can fail.

zh-CN.description: 宿主应用打开 PACE 互联加油服务页面时，PACE Cloud SDK 会在应用内显示该页面，并处理包括 Google Pay 在内的支付操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，PACE 应用内页面及其支付操作将无法打开，依赖这些页面的互联加油服务可能无法使用。

en.description: When a PACE page asks to open a link, the PACE Cloud SDK opens it in an in-app web page or a Chrome custom tab and passes the return result back to the original page.
en.disableEffect: PACE page links that leave the app and need to return to the original page will not complete.

zh-CN.description: PACE 页面要求打开链接时，PACE Cloud SDK 会在应用内网页或 Chrome 自定义标签页中打开，并将返回结果交还原页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，从 PACE 页面跳出并需要返回原页面的链接流程将无法完成。

en.description: When Android opens a return link registered by the PACE Cloud SDK, this screen passes it back into the app so the active PACE web flow can finish.
en.disableEffect: PACE web flows that rely on this return link, such as sign-in or payment, will not return to the app.

zh-CN.description: Android 打开 PACE Cloud SDK 注册的回跳链接时，此页面会将链接转回应用，让正在进行的 PACE 网页流程完成。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，依赖此回跳链接的 PACE 网页流程（例如登录或支付）将无法返回应用。

en.description: The PACE Cloud SDK uses this screen for in-app payment pages; it loads the requested page and routes PACE return links back into the app.
en.disableEffect: The in-app PACE payment page and its return flow will not work.

zh-CN.description: PACE Cloud SDK 使用此页面显示应用内支付网页、加载相应内容，并将 PACE 回跳链接转回应用处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，PACE 应用内支付网页及其回跳流程将无法使用。

en.description: When a user shares a receipt PDF from the PACE Cloud SDK, this provider lets Android's share menu read the generated file.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to share PACE receipt PDFs from the app.

zh-CN.description: 用户分享 PACE Cloud SDK 生成的收据 PDF 时，此提供程序会让 Android 分享菜单读取该文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，用户将无法从应用中分享 PACE 收据 PDF。

en.description: When PACE account sign-in or sign-out is requested, the PACE Cloud SDK displays the authorization page and returns its result to the app.
en.disableEffect: PACE account authorization and sign-out flows that use this screen will fail.

zh-CN.description: 发起 PACE 账户登录或退出登录时，PACE Cloud SDK 会显示授权页面，并将处理结果返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，依赖此页面的 PACE 账户授权和退出登录流程将无法完成。

en.description: When Android finishes starting the device, this receiver initializes the Proxi.cloud proximity SDK in the main process of the app.
en.disableEffect: Proxi.cloud background location features may not initialize until the app is opened.

zh-CN.description: 设备启动完成后，这个接收器会在应用主进程中初始化 Proxi.cloud 邻近服务 SDK。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 如果禁用它，Proxi.cloud 的后台定位功能可能要等到用户打开应用后才会启动。

en.description: Android starts this Proxi.cloud service when one of its scheduled background tasks is due. Older SDK releases use it to run the saved task; in SDK 3.0.14, starting it has no visible effect.
en.disableEffect: Blocking it can stop scheduled Proxi.cloud updates and uploads in older releases; the app's ordinary screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: Proxi.cloud 的后台任务到期时，Android 会启动这个服务。旧版 SDK 会用它执行已安排的任务；在 SDK 3.0.14 中，启动它没有可见效果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 在旧版 SDK 中禁用它可能会停止 Proxi.cloud 的定期更新和上传，但应用的普通页面仍可使用。

en.description: After a normal or quick reboot, this receiver restarts Proxi.cloud when enabled and clears its saved last location.
en.disableEffect: Proxi.cloud background proximity monitoring may not restart until the app is opened.

zh-CN.description: 设备正常重启或快速重启后，如果 Proxi.cloud 已启用，这个接收器会重新启动 SDK 并清除保存的最近位置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，Proxi.cloud 的后台邻近监测可能要等到用户打开应用后才会恢复。

en.description: When queued as background work, this Proxi.cloud job refreshes the layout and settings used for location-based content.
en.disableEffect: Proxi.cloud may keep outdated location-based content and settings; other app features remain available.

zh-CN.description: 被安排为后台任务后，这项 Proxi.cloud 任务会更新定位内容所用的布局和设置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Proxi.cloud 可能继续使用过期的定位内容和设置，但应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: When its scheduled alarm fires, this receiver checks whether Proxi.cloud is enabled and queues a refresh of its location-based content and settings.
en.disableEffect: Proxi.cloud content may stop refreshing in the background and become outdated.

zh-CN.description: 定时提醒触发时，这个接收器会检查 Proxi.cloud 是否已启用，并安排更新定位内容和设置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，Proxi.cloud 的内容可能无法在后台更新并逐渐过期。

en.description: When Proxi.cloud queues a background sync, this job uploads its stored location and usage events.
en.disableEffect: Proxi.cloud stops sending these event records; the app's other features remain available.

zh-CN.description: Proxi.cloud 安排后台同步时，这项任务会上传已保存的位置和使用事件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，Proxi.cloud 将停止发送这些事件记录，但应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: When its scheduled alarm fires, this receiver checks whether Proxi.cloud is enabled and queues an upload of stored events.
en.disableEffect: Proxi.cloud event records will no longer be uploaded on schedule.

zh-CN.description: 定时提醒触发时，这个接收器会检查 Proxi.cloud 是否已启用，并安排上传已保存的事件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，Proxi.cloud 将无法按计划上传事件记录。

en.description: When Firebase delivers a Proxi.cloud message, this background job processes it, can display its notification, and records the event.
en.disableEffect: Proxi.cloud push notifications and their event reports stop being processed.

zh-CN.description: Firebase 收到 Proxi.cloud 消息时，这项后台任务会处理消息、显示相应通知并记录事件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，Proxi.cloud 推送通知及其事件报告将无法处理。

en.description: When Firebase sends a Proxi.cloud message, this background job processes it, displays the corresponding notification, and records the event.
en.disableEffect: Proxi.cloud Firebase notifications and related event reporting stop.

zh-CN.description: Firebase 发送 Proxi.cloud 消息时，这项后台任务会处理消息、显示相应通知并记录事件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，Proxi.cloud 的 Firebase 通知和相关事件报告将停止。

en.description: When Google location services reports that the device entered or left a Proxi.cloud area, this receiver passes the visit for content matching and notification handling. Older SDK releases also use it for location updates and changes to location settings.
en.disableEffect: Proxi.cloud location-triggered messages and visit reports stop, while the rest of the app remains available.

zh-CN.description: Google 定位服务报告设备进入或离开 Proxi.cloud 区域时，这个接收器会交由 SDK 匹配内容并处理通知。旧版 SDK 还会用它处理位置更新和定位设置变化。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，Proxi.cloud 的位置触发消息和到访报告将停止，但应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: When Huawei location services reports a Proxi.cloud area entry, exit, location update, or provider change, this receiver forwards it for proximity processing.
en.disableEffect: Huawei-based Proxi.cloud location messages and event reports stop; other app features remain available.

zh-CN.description: 华为定位服务报告进入或离开 Proxi.cloud 区域、位置更新或定位服务变化时，这个接收器会转交事件进行邻近处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，基于华为定位服务的 Proxi.cloud 位置消息和事件报告将停止，但应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: When Google location services delivers a new location, this receiver uses it to refresh Proxi.cloud area monitoring.
en.disableEffect: Proxi.cloud background area monitoring will no longer refresh from new locations.

zh-CN.description: Google 定位服务提供新位置时，这个接收器会据此更新 Proxi.cloud 的区域监测。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，Proxi.cloud 的后台区域监测将无法根据新位置更新。

en.description: When Google location services reports a Proxi.cloud area transition, this receiver processes it and can display matching content. Earlier SDK releases queue a separate background task to do this work.
en.disableEffect: Proxi.cloud area-triggered messages and visit reports stop.

zh-CN.description: Google 定位服务报告 Proxi.cloud 区域状态变化时，这个接收器会处理该事件并可显示匹配内容。较早版本的 SDK 会另行安排后台任务处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，Proxi.cloud 的区域触发消息和到访报告将停止。

en.description: When Google location services reports a new location, this receiver refreshes Proxi.cloud area monitoring; earlier releases pass the update to a background task.
en.disableEffect: Proxi.cloud location matching and related notifications may stop updating.

zh-CN.description: Google 定位服务报告新位置时，这个接收器会更新 Proxi.cloud 的区域监测；较早版本会把更新交给后台任务处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，Proxi.cloud 的位置匹配和相关通知可能无法继续更新。

en.description: When an area entry or exit is queued, this Proxi.cloud job checks for matching content, records the visit, and can display a notification.
en.disableEffect: Proxi.cloud area-triggered notifications and visit reporting stop.

zh-CN.description: 区域进入或离开事件进入任务队列后，这项 Proxi.cloud 任务会查找匹配内容、记录到访情况，并可显示通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，Proxi.cloud 的区域触发通知和到访报告将停止。

en.description: When a location result is queued, this Proxi.cloud background job uses the latest position to refresh area monitoring.
en.disableEffect: Proxi.cloud area monitoring will no longer refresh from location updates.

zh-CN.description: 位置结果进入任务队列后，这项 Proxi.cloud 后台任务会使用最新位置更新区域监测。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，Proxi.cloud 的区域监测将无法根据位置更新。

en.description: When the app sends Proxi.cloud a custom event, this service adds available location and app-state details before reporting it.
en.disableEffect: Custom app events and their location context will no longer reach Proxi.cloud; normal app features remain available.

zh-CN.description: 应用向 Proxi.cloud 发送自定义事件时，这个服务会先附加可用的位置和应用状态信息，再上报事件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 自定义应用事件及其位置上下文将无法到达 Proxi.cloud，但应用的普通功能仍可使用。

en.description: When Android reports that the app was updated, this receiver cancels Proxi.cloud's old scheduled tasks so they do not run alongside the new ones.
en.disableEffect: Old Proxi.cloud background tasks may not be canceled after an app update.

zh-CN.description: Android 报告应用更新后，这个接收器会取消 Proxi.cloud 的旧后台任务，避免它们与新任务同时运行。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，应用更新时 Proxi.cloud 的旧后台任务可能无法取消。

en.description: When a special Proxi.cloud dial code is entered, this receiver turns SDK diagnostic logging on or off.
en.disableEffect: The dial code can no longer change Proxi.cloud logging; ordinary app use is unaffected.

zh-CN.description: 输入 Proxi.cloud 专用拨号代码时，这个接收器会开启或关闭 SDK 诊断日志。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，拨号代码将无法更改 Proxi.cloud 日志设置，但不影响应用的日常使用。

en.description: When the app moves to the background, older Proxi.cloud releases use this service to upload saved event history; a later inspected release has no visible action.
en.disableEffect: Proxi.cloud event history may upload less often in older releases; the app remains usable.

zh-CN.description: 应用转入后台时，旧版 Proxi.cloud 会用此服务上传已保存的事件记录；较新的已检查版本没有可见操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 在旧版 SDK 中禁用它可能降低 Proxi.cloud 事件记录的上传频率，但应用仍可使用。

en.description: When the app returns to the foreground, older Proxi.cloud releases use this service to upload event history and refresh area monitoring; a later inspected release has no visible action.
en.disableEffect: In older releases, Proxi.cloud location messages may not refresh when the app opens; the app remains usable.

zh-CN.description: 应用回到前台时，旧版 Proxi.cloud 会用此服务上传事件记录并更新区域监测；较新的已检查版本没有可见操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 在旧版 SDK 中禁用它后，Proxi.cloud 的位置消息可能不会在应用打开时更新，但应用仍可使用。

en.description: After the app reports a location permission decision, older Proxi.cloud releases use this service to start area monitoring when permission is granted; a later inspected release has no visible action.
en.disableEffect: Location-triggered Proxi.cloud content may not start after permission is granted in older releases; other app functions remain available.

zh-CN.description: 应用报告定位权限结果后，旧版 Proxi.cloud 会在用户授予权限时通过此服务启动区域监测；较新的已检查版本没有可见操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 在旧版 SDK 中禁用它后，授予定位权限后 Proxi.cloud 的位置触发内容可能无法启动，但应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: When Proxi.cloud queues a beacon event, older releases add the current area and event details to its event processing; a later inspected release has no visible action.
en.disableEffect: Proxi.cloud beacon events may no longer be matched or reported in older releases; other app functions remain available.

zh-CN.description: Proxi.cloud 收到信标事件后，旧版 SDK 会用此服务附加当前位置区域和事件详情并继续处理；较新的已检查版本没有可见操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 在旧版 SDK 中禁用它后，Proxi.cloud 的信标事件可能无法匹配或上报，但应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: After the app records advertising consent, older Proxi.cloud releases use this service to save an advertising identifier only when consent allows it; later inspected code has no visible action.
en.disableEffect: Proxi.cloud events may lose advertising attribution data in older releases; normal app use is unchanged.

zh-CN.description: 应用记录广告标识符授权结果后，旧版 Proxi.cloud 会在获得许可时通过此服务保存广告标识符；较新的已检查代码没有可见操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 在旧版 SDK 中禁用它后，Proxi.cloud 事件可能不再包含广告归因信息，但不影响应用日常使用。

en.description: When an internal Proxi.cloud logging setting changes, older releases use this service to apply it; a later inspected release has no visible action.
en.disableEffect: The SDK diagnostic logging setting may not change in older releases; ordinary app features remain available.

zh-CN.description: Proxi.cloud 的内部日志设置变化时，旧版 SDK 会用此服务应用新设置；较新的已检查版本没有可见操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 在旧版 SDK 中禁用它后，SDK 诊断日志设置可能无法更改，但应用的普通功能仍可使用。

en.description: When Proxi.cloud requests a settings refresh, older releases use this service to fetch updated SDK settings; later inspected code has no visible action.
en.disableEffect: Proxi.cloud may keep older settings in earlier releases; the rest of the app remains usable.

zh-CN.description: Proxi.cloud 请求刷新设置时，旧版 SDK 会用此服务获取更新后的设置；较新的已检查代码没有可见操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 在旧版 SDK 中禁用它后，Proxi.cloud 可能继续使用旧设置，但应用其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: When Proxi.cloud queues an analytics upload, older releases use this service to send saved event history; later inspected code has no visible action.
en.disableEffect: Proxi.cloud event history may not be uploaded in older releases; other app features continue to work.

zh-CN.description: Proxi.cloud 安排上传分析数据时，旧版 SDK 会用此服务发送已保存的事件记录；较新的已检查代码没有可见操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 在旧版 SDK 中禁用它后，Proxi.cloud 事件记录可能无法上传，但应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: When Proxi.cloud receives a sufficiently recent and accurate location, this receiver queues a nearby Wi-Fi scan for location matching.
en.disableEffect: Wi-Fi-assisted Proxi.cloud location matching and related content stop updating.

zh-CN.description: Proxi.cloud 收到足够新且准确的位置后，这个接收器会安排扫描附近的 Wi-Fi 网络，用于位置匹配。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，基于 Wi-Fi 的 Proxi.cloud 位置匹配和相关内容将无法继续更新。

en.description: When the SDK schedules a scan, this background job collects nearby Wi-Fi network details and passes them to Proxi.cloud proximity processing.
en.disableEffect: Proxi.cloud can no longer use nearby Wi-Fi observations for location matching; other app features remain available.

zh-CN.description: SDK 安排扫描时，这项后台任务会收集附近 Wi-Fi 网络信息，并交给 Proxi.cloud 进行邻近匹配。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，Proxi.cloud 无法再用附近 Wi-Fi 信息进行位置匹配，但应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: When a scheduled Proxi.cloud background alarm fires, this receiver checks whether the SDK is enabled and queues a Wi-Fi scan.
en.disableEffect: Background Wi-Fi scans for Proxi.cloud location matching stop.

zh-CN.description: Proxi.cloud 的后台定时提醒触发时，这个接收器会检查 SDK 是否已启用，并安排 Wi-Fi 扫描。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，Proxi.cloud 将停止在后台扫描 Wi-Fi 以进行位置匹配。

en.description: When a host app opens a ShopLive live show or video, this Activity plays the stream and provides playback controls, chat, and sharing.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents the ShopLive player screen from opening, so users lose in-app playback and its chat controls.

zh-CN.description: 宿主应用打开 ShopLive 直播或视频时，此 Activity 播放内容并提供播放控制、聊天和分享功能。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后 ShopLive 播放页面无法打开，用户将无法在应用内观看内容或使用聊天功能。

en.description: Android starts this Provider with the app process. It initializes ShopLive's saved guest and client identifiers, then retrieves the device advertising ID for the ShopLive live-commerce SDK.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it leaves ShopLive without startup identifiers used by its live and video features, which can prevent those features from initializing or making requests.

zh-CN.description: 应用进程启动时，Android 会创建此 Provider。它初始化 ShopLive 保存的访客和客户端标识，并读取设备广告标识，供 ShopLive 直播商务 SDK 使用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，ShopLive 直播和视频功能缺少启动时设置的标识，相关功能可能无法初始化或发送请求。

en.description: After the app's last open screen closes, this Provider removes cached files used by ShopLive in the background.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it leaves ShopLive cache files behind after the app closes.

zh-CN.description: 应用最后一个页面关闭后，此 Provider 会在后台删除 ShopLive 使用的缓存文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用关闭时 ShopLive 的缓存文件不会被清理。

en.description: Android starts this Provider during app startup, and it writes the ShopLive module name and version to the log.
en.disableEffect: Users lose no app feature; only the startup SDK version log is omitted.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，Android 会创建此 Provider，并将 ShopLive 模块名称和版本写入日志。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户不会失去应用功能，只会少一条启动时记录的 SDK 版本日志。

en.description: The ShopLive short-video creation flow opens this Activity when a creator chooses a cover. It shows frames from a clip for cropping and submits the selected cover through the ShopLive upload service.
en.disableEffect: Creators cannot choose and submit a custom cover in that ShopLive video-creation flow.

zh-CN.description: 创作者为 ShopLive 短视频选择封面时，流程会打开此 Activity。它显示视频画面供裁剪，并通过 ShopLive 上传服务提交选定的封面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，创作者无法在 ShopLive 视频制作流程中选择并提交自定义封面。

en.description: During the older ShopLive video-creation flow, this Activity opens a selected local clip or camera recording for editing before upload. It loads video information and thumbnails for the editing screen.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from completing the older ShopLive video-editing and upload flow.

zh-CN.description: 在旧版 ShopLive 视频制作流程中，此 Activity 会打开用户选取的本地视频或相机录制内容，以便上传前编辑，并加载视频信息和缩略图。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法完成旧版 ShopLive 视频编辑和上传流程。

en.description: The ShopLive short-video flow opens this Activity to trim and crop a clip, adjust playback speed or volume, and apply filters before submission.
en.disableEffect: Creators lose these editing controls and cannot complete video creation through this ShopLive editor.

zh-CN.description: ShopLive 短视频流程会打开此 Activity，让创作者在提交前裁剪视频片段、调整播放速度或音量，并应用滤镜。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，创作者将无法使用这些编辑功能，也无法通过此 ShopLive 编辑器完成视频制作。

en.description: When a ShopLive creator chooses local media, this Activity lists photos and videos so they can select a clip or image for editing or upload.
en.disableEffect: The ShopLive editor cannot pick local media through its built-in gallery.

zh-CN.description: ShopLive 创作者选择本地媒体时，此 Activity 会列出照片和视频，供其选择要编辑或上传的内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，ShopLive 编辑器将无法通过内置图库选择本地媒体。

en.description: ShopLive opens this Activity to review or change details for an existing short video. It displays the clip with fields for its title, description, and tags.
en.disableEffect: Creators cannot use this ShopLive screen to review or change short-video details.

zh-CN.description: ShopLive 会打开此 Activity，以查看或修改已有短视频的信息。页面显示视频，并提供标题、描述和标签字段。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，创作者无法通过此 ShopLive 页面查看或修改短视频信息。

en.description: When ShopLive opens short-video submission, this Activity loads the upload page and connects its controls to the SDK's upload state and errors.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot submit short videos through ShopLive's uploader.

zh-CN.description: ShopLive 打开短视频提交流程时，此 Activity 会加载上传页面，并连接页面控件与 SDK 的上传状态和错误信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过 ShopLive 上传器提交短视频。

en.description: After an edited ShopLive video is ready, this Activity sends it to ShopLive and shows upload progress and the result.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from completing the older ShopLive video-upload flow.

zh-CN.description: ShopLive 视频编辑完成后，此 Activity 会将视频上传到 ShopLive，并显示上传进度和结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法完成旧版 ShopLive 视频上传流程。

en.description: The ShopLive video-playback module starts this Provider with the app. Its setup currently does no visible work and it does not show a screen or provide user content.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it does not remove a ShopLive playback or host-app feature in the analyzed SDK release.

zh-CN.description: ShopLive 视频播放模块会随应用启动此 Provider。它当前的初始化没有可见效果，也不显示页面或提供用户内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 在分析的 SDK 版本中，停用它不会影响 ShopLive 播放或宿主应用功能。

en.description: The ShopLive networking module starts this Provider with the app. Its setup currently does no visible work and it does not provide user content.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it does not change ShopLive network or host-app features in the analyzed SDK release.

zh-CN.description: ShopLive 网络模块会随应用启动此 Provider。它当前的初始化没有可见效果，也不提供用户内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 在分析的 SDK 版本中，停用它不会影响 ShopLive 网络或宿主应用功能。

en.description: When ShopLive requests permissions for a live-streaming feature, this Activity presents the Android permission flow and returns the user's decision to the SDK.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it breaks ShopLive permission requests, so features that need camera or microphone access cannot continue.

zh-CN.description: ShopLive 的直播功能请求权限时，此 Activity 会显示 Android 权限流程，并将用户的选择返回给 SDK。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，ShopLive 权限请求会中断，需要摄像头或麦克风的功能将无法继续。

en.description: When a host app opens a ShopLive short-video feed from a supplied list of IDs, this Activity displays the clips in a swipeable feed and requests more clips when needed.
en.disableEffect: The ID-based ShopLive short-video feed will not open or load additional clips.

zh-CN.description: 宿主应用按给定的视频 ID 打开 ShopLive 短视频列表时，此 Activity 会以滑动信息流展示视频，并在需要时请求更多内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，按 ID 打开的 ShopLive 短视频信息流无法显示或加载更多视频。

en.description: When a user opens a ShopLive short video, the SDK shows a full-screen swipeable feed starting at that clip, with related-video and shuffle options.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open the ShopLive short-video detail and feed screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 ShopLive 短视频时，SDK 会显示全屏滑动信息流，从所选视频开始，并提供相关视频和随机播放选项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法打开 ShopLive 短视频详情和信息流页面。

en.description: When the host app starts a direct ShopLive broadcast, this Activity opens the camera and streaming controls and sends the live video.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot start or control this direct ShopLive broadcast.

zh-CN.description: 宿主应用启动 ShopLive 直接直播时，此 Activity 会打开摄像头和直播控件并发送实时视频。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法开始或控制此 ShopLive 直接直播。

en.description: When the host app opens a ShopLive real-time video stream, this Activity initializes the WebRTC player and displays the incoming stream and its status.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot watch ShopLive real-time video through this player.

zh-CN.description: 宿主应用打开 ShopLive 实时视频时，此 Activity 会初始化 WebRTC 播放器并显示接收的视频和连接状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过此播放器观看 ShopLive 实时视频。

en.description: When the host app starts a ShopLive broadcast with streamer settings, this Activity sets up camera, audio, and connection controls, then starts or stops the stream.
en.disableEffect: Users lose the ShopLive camera-broadcast flow.

zh-CN.description: 宿主应用按主播设置启动 ShopLive 直播时，此 Activity 会配置摄像头、音频和连接控件，并控制直播的开始与停止。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法使用 ShopLive 摄像头直播流程。

en.description: The ShopLive WebRTC module starts this Provider with the app. Its setup currently does no visible work and it does not provide user content.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it does not remove a ShopLive streaming or host-app feature in the analyzed SDK release.

zh-CN.description: ShopLive WebRTC 模块会随应用启动此 Provider。它当前的初始化没有可见效果，也不提供用户内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 在分析的 SDK 版本中，停用它不会影响 ShopLive 直播或宿主应用功能。

en.description: JPush (Jiguang) opens this brief screen when a push notification is tapped, passes the notification to the app, and then closes.
en.disableEffect: Tapping JPush notifications will no longer reach the app through this screen.

zh-CN.description: 点击 JPush（极光）推送通知时，SDK 会打开这个短暂界面，把通知交给应用处理后关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，点击 JPush 通知将无法通过此界面交给应用处理。

en.description: Authing Guard shows a confirmation page when a user signs in to an app by scanning a login code. It identifies the signed-in account and target app, then sends the user’s confirm or cancel choice.
en.disableEffect: The scanned-app login confirmation cannot open, so this sign-in route cannot finish.

zh-CN.description: 用户通过扫码登录某个应用时，Authing Guard 会显示确认页，标明当前账号和目标应用，并把确认或取消选择发送给登录流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 扫码登录确认页无法打开，因此此登录方式无法完成。

en.description: Authing Guard lists the applications connected to the signed-in account, showing each app’s name and identifier from the account profile.
en.disableEffect: The connected-app list cannot open from the Authing account profile.

zh-CN.description: Authing Guard 会列出当前账号关联的应用，并显示每个应用的名称和编号。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 无法从 Authing 账号页面打开已关联应用列表。

en.description: Authing Guard opens the sign-in screen selected by the app’s authentication flow and handles results from supported social and passkey sign-in methods.
en.disableEffect: Configured Authing sign-in flows that use this screen cannot open or return a completed login.

zh-CN.description: Authing Guard 会打开应用所选认证流程对应的登录界面，并处理已接入的社交账号和通行密钥登录结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此界面的 Authing 登录流程无法打开或返回完成的登录结果。

en.description: Authing Guard displays the resources granted to the signed-in account, including each resource’s code and type.
en.disableEffect: The account’s authorized-resource list cannot open from the Authing profile.

zh-CN.description: Authing Guard 会显示当前账号获授权的资源，包括每项资源的代码和类型。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 无法从 Authing 账号页面打开已授权资源列表。

en.description: Authing Guard routes its sign-in link entry through this page and uses it to prepare the shared appearance of account screens.
en.disableEffect: Authing Guard’s link-based sign-in entry may not open correctly.

zh-CN.description: Authing Guard 会将登录链接入口交给此页面，并由它设置账号页面共用的界面样式。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Authing Guard 通过链接进入的登录流程可能无法正常打开。

en.description: Authing Guard opens an email-binding form when the account flow asks a user to add or verify an email. If an email is already stored, the page fills it in and locks the field.
en.disableEffect: Email binding or verification cannot open from the Authing account flow.

zh-CN.description: Authing Guard 在账号流程要求添加或验证邮箱时打开绑定表单；如果账号已有邮箱，页面会预填并锁定该字段。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Authing 账号流程中的邮箱绑定或验证界面无法打开。

en.description: Authing Guard opens a phone-binding form when the account flow asks a user to add or verify a phone number. If a number is already stored, the page fills it in and locks the field.
en.disableEffect: Phone binding or verification cannot open from the Authing account flow.

zh-CN.description: Authing Guard 在账号流程要求添加或验证手机号时打开绑定表单；如果账号已有手机号，页面会预填并锁定该字段。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Authing 账号流程中的手机号绑定或验证界面无法打开。

en.description: Authing Guard opens the password-change form from the account profile. The user enters the old and new passwords, and the page submits the change.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open the Authing password-change screen from their account profile.

zh-CN.description: Authing Guard 会从账号页面打开修改密码表单，用户填写旧密码和新密码后提交修改。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法从 Authing 账号页面打开修改密码界面。

en.description: Authing Guard displays the account-deletion verification page. It shows an SMS-code section when the account has a phone number, or a password field when the account has a password.
en.disableEffect: The Authing account-deletion verification page cannot open.

zh-CN.description: Authing Guard 会显示账号注销验证页；账号有手机号时显示短信验证码区域，有密码时显示密码输入框。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Authing 账号注销验证页无法打开。

en.description: Authing Guard’s developer page displays access, ID, and refresh-token details. It can show decoded token data, copy values, and request a refreshed access token.
en.disableEffect: The token-inspection and refresh page will not open from the Authing profile.

zh-CN.description: Authing Guard 的开发者页面展示访问令牌、身份令牌和刷新令牌，可查看解码内容、复制信息并请求更新访问令牌。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 无法从 Authing 账号页面打开令牌查看和更新界面。

en.description: Authing Guard opens its feedback form from the feedback link and lets the user choose an image attachment.
en.disableEffect: The in-app Authing feedback form cannot open from its feedback link.

zh-CN.description: Authing Guard 会从反馈入口打开反馈表单，并允许用户选择图片作为附件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 无法从反馈入口打开 Authing 应用内反馈表单。

en.description: Authing Guard opens this sign-in entry from login or password-reset actions and displays the authentication flow configured by the app.
en.disableEffect: Authing sign-in or password-reset routes that use this entry cannot open.

zh-CN.description: Authing Guard 会从登录或密码重置入口打开此页面，并显示应用配置的认证流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此入口的 Authing 登录或密码重置流程无法打开。

en.description: Authing Guard lists the organizations associated with the signed-in account in the account profile.
en.disableEffect: The account’s organization list cannot open from the Authing profile.

zh-CN.description: Authing Guard 会在账号页面列出当前账号关联的组织。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 无法从 Authing 账号页面打开组织列表。

en.description: Authing Guard lists the roles assigned to the signed-in account, including each role’s code, namespace, and description.
en.disableEffect: The account’s role list cannot open from the Authing profile.

zh-CN.description: Authing Guard 会列出当前账号的角色，包括角色代码、所属命名空间和说明。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 无法从 Authing 账号页面打开角色列表。

en.description: Authing Guard lets a signed-in user edit a standard or custom profile field and save it to the account.
en.disableEffect: Profile fields that use this editor cannot be changed from the Authing account flow.

zh-CN.description: Authing Guard 允许已登录用户编辑标准或自定义资料字段，并将修改保存到账户。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此编辑界面的资料字段无法在 Authing 账号流程中修改。

en.description: Authing Guard displays the signed-in user’s profile and account controls. It also returns a chosen picture to the profile page for avatar upload.
en.disableEffect: The Authing profile page, avatar update, and its account controls cannot open through this screen.

zh-CN.description: Authing Guard 会显示已登录用户的资料和账号操作，并把选中的图片交给资料页面上传为头像。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过此界面无法打开 Authing 个人资料页、更新头像或使用其中的账号操作。

en.description: When an Authing Guard flow opens a policy or notice link, this page shows its supplied title and loads the page inside the app.
en.disableEffect: Policy or notice pages launched through this Authing screen will not load in the app.

zh-CN.description: Authing Guard 打开政策或说明链接时，此页面会显示传入的标题并在应用内加载网页。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过此 Authing 页面打开的政策或说明网页无法在应用内加载。

en.description: Authing Guard uses this callback page when DingTalk returns a social-sign-in result. It passes the result back to the sign-in flow and then closes.
en.disableEffect: DingTalk sign-in cannot return its authorization result to Authing Guard.

zh-CN.description: 钉钉返回社交登录结果时，Authing Guard 会通过此回调页面把结果交回登录流程，然后关闭页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 钉钉登录结果无法返回给 Authing Guard。

en.description: Authing Guard provides this background push-service entry in a separate app process for its push-based authentication features.
en.disableEffect: Authing Guard’s background push-service entry will not run, so push-based authentication messages cannot use it.

zh-CN.description: Authing Guard 在独立进程中提供此后台推送服务入口，用于其推送认证功能。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Authing Guard 的后台推送服务入口不会运行，推送认证消息也无法通过它处理。

en.description: When Getui delivers an authentication request for the currently signed-in user, Authing Guard checks the target account and opens the configured sign-in flow.
en.disableEffect: Push-based Authing sign-in requests cannot be processed or opened.

zh-CN.description: Getui 收到针对当前账号的认证请求时，Authing Guard 会核对目标用户并打开应用配置的登录流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Authing 推送登录请求无法处理或打开。

en.description: Authing Guard opens a web authorization page for its LinkedIn social sign-in flow, follows the provider redirect, and returns the authorization result and profile.
en.disableEffect: The Authing web-based LinkedIn sign-in flow cannot finish.

zh-CN.description: Authing Guard 会为 LinkedIn 社交登录打开网页授权界面，跟踪服务方的跳转，并返回授权结果和用户资料。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Authing 基于网页的 LinkedIn 登录流程无法完成。

en.description: The Authok Android authentication SDK opens a browser tab for sign-in and returns the result to the app when the user finishes or cancels.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it can prevent users from completing browser-based sign-in.

zh-CN.description: Authok Android 身份验证 SDK 会在登录时打开浏览器页面，并在用户完成或取消登录后将结果交还给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户可能无法完成基于浏览器的登录。

en.description: When the browser returns from Authok sign-in through the app link, this Activity forwards the response into the SDK authentication flow.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents the app from receiving browser sign-in results.

zh-CN.description: 用户从 Authok 登录页面通过应用链接返回时，此 Activity 会将结果交给 SDK 完成身份验证。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用无法接收浏览器返回的登录结果。

en.description: The BGA PhotoPicker library opens the device photo collection, lets users choose images, and can offer a camera option when capture is enabled.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it stops screens that use this picker from selecting or capturing photos.

zh-CN.description: BGA PhotoPicker 会打开设备中的照片列表供用户选择；启用拍照时，也可从此界面调用相机。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，使用此选择器的界面将无法选择或拍摄照片。

en.description: During photo selection, the BGA PhotoPicker library shows chosen images one at a time so users can review and adjust the selection before confirming.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from reviewing and adjusting selected photos before confirmation.

zh-CN.description: 选择照片时，BGA PhotoPicker 会逐张显示已选图片，供用户检查并调整后再确认。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法在确认前查看并调整所选照片。

en.description: The BGA PhotoPicker library displays one or more images full screen, lets users move between them, and can save the current image when a save folder is provided.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents screens that use this Activity from viewing images full screen or saving them.

zh-CN.description: BGA PhotoPicker 会全屏显示一张或多张图片供用户切换查看；配置保存目录后，还可将当前图片保存到设备。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，依赖此界面的功能将无法全屏查看图片或保存图片。

en.description: The BlueMobi Pay library includes a WeChat Pay screen that requests order details and attempts to start payment in WeChat.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents flows that use this screen from starting WeChat Pay.

zh-CN.description: BlueMobi Pay 界面会请求订单信息，并尝试启动微信支付。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，依赖此界面的支付流程无法启动微信支付。

en.description: BlueMobi PhotoView displays images full screen with page navigation and can save the current image when the save option is enabled.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it makes image browsing and saving through this screen unavailable.

zh-CN.description: BlueMobi PhotoView 会以全屏分页方式查看图片；启用保存选项后，用户也可保存当前图片。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，通过此界面浏览和保存图片的功能将不可用。

en.description: After an unhandled app exception, the AndroidFastDevFrame crash screen offers restart or close options and can show, copy, or send error details when configured.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it can leave users without the configured crash screen and restart option after a crash.

zh-CN.description: 应用发生未处理异常后，AndroidFastDevFrame 崩溃处理界面提供重启或关闭选项，并可按配置查看、复制或提交错误信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，崩溃发生时用户可能看不到配置的错误界面和重启选项。

en.description: XPicker opens the device gallery to choose photos or videos, with options to preview, crop or open the camera when enabled.
en.disableEffect: Apps using XPicker cannot open its media-selection screen or continue those photo and video selection flows.

zh-CN.description: XPicker 会打开设备图库供用户选择照片或视频，并可按设置预览、裁剪或打开相机。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用 XPicker 的应用将无法打开媒体选择页面，也无法继续相关照片和视频选择流程。

en.description: XPicker displays the selected photos or videos for review, lets the user play video previews and confirm the selection.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot review or confirm media selections through XPicker’s preview screen.

zh-CN.description: XPicker 会展示选中的照片或视频供用户检查，并可播放视频预览和确认选择。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 XPicker 预览页面检查或确认媒体选择。

en.description: This XPicker camera screen takes photos or records videos and returns the captured file to the app.
en.disableEffect: The camera option in XPicker will not be able to capture photos or videos.

zh-CN.description: 此 XPicker 相机页面可拍摄照片或录制视频，并将生成的文件返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: XPicker 中的相机选项将无法拍摄照片或录制视频。

en.description: XPicker uses this file-sharing provider to give selected media files links that can be opened by the calling screen or another app.
en.disableEffect: Passing selected media files between XPicker and the app may fail.

zh-CN.description: XPicker 使用此文件共享服务为所选媒体生成链接，供发起选择的页面或其他应用打开。
zh-CN.disableEffect: XPicker 与应用之间传递所选媒体文件时可能会失败。
