zh-CN.description: 电银伙伴的盛掌柜（DY_SZG）业务 SDK 在用户打开机具采购订单时显示订单状态和付款信息，并在可操作时提供确认收货。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法查看采购订单详情或确认收货。

en.description: The Dianyinhuoban SHENGZHANGUI (DY_SZG) business SDK opens the purchase-order list with tabs for all orders, awaiting shipment, review, receipt confirmation, and completed orders.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it hides the user's purchase orders.

zh-CN.description: 电银伙伴的盛掌柜（DY_SZG）业务 SDK 打开采购订单列表，并按全部、待发货、待审核、待确认和已完成分类。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法查看采购订单列表。

en.description: The Dianyinhuoban SHENGZHANGUI (DY_SZG) business SDK displays a successful machine-purchase result, a summary, and controls to finish or return home.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it removes the purchase completion screen.

zh-CN.description: 电银伙伴的盛掌柜（DY_SZG）业务 SDK 显示机具采购成功结果和订单摘要，并提供完成或返回首页的入口。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法看到采购完成页。

en.description: The Dianyinhuoban SHENGZHANGUI (DY_SZG) business SDK opens a machine-purchase selection form. It loads purchase products, lets the user adjust quantity, and proceeds to order confirmation.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it removes this product-selection and purchase path.

zh-CN.description: 电银伙伴的盛掌柜（DY_SZG）业务 SDK 打开机具采购选择表单，加载采购商品、调整数量并进入订单确认。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过此采购页面选择商品并继续下单。

en.description: The Dianyinhuoban SHENGZHANGUI (DY_SZG) business SDK opens the shipping-address list during order entry or address management. Users can select an address or add and edit one.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from selecting or managing shipping addresses.

zh-CN.description: 电银伙伴的盛掌柜（DY_SZG）业务 SDK 在下单或管理地址时打开收货地址列表，供用户选择地址或新增、修改地址。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法选择或管理收货地址。

en.description: The Dianyinhuoban SHENGZHANGUI (DY_SZG) business SDK opens offline-payment instructions after an order selects that payment route. It shows payment details and lets the user upload a payment voucher.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it breaks the offline-payment and voucher-submission flow.

zh-CN.description: 电银伙伴的盛掌柜（DY_SZG）业务 SDK 在订单选择线下付款后显示付款信息，并支持上传付款凭证。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法完成线下付款凭证提交。

en.description: The Dianyinhuoban SHENGZHANGUI (DY_SZG) business SDK opens a selected machine product's detail page. Users review the item and quantity before continuing to order confirmation.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it removes product details and the direct purchase entry.

zh-CN.description: 电银伙伴的盛掌柜（DY_SZG）业务 SDK 在用户选择机具商品后显示商品详情，供用户核对商品和数量并继续确认订单。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法查看商品详情或从此页下单。

en.description: The Dianyinhuoban SHENGZHANGUI (DY_SZG) business SDK opens the machine-purchase catalog and loads machine types for browsing.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it removes the machine-purchase catalog.

zh-CN.description: 电银伙伴的盛掌柜（DY_SZG）业务 SDK 打开机具采购目录，并加载机具类型供用户浏览。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法进入机具采购目录。

en.description: The Dianyinhuoban SHENGZHANGUI (DY_SZG) business SDK opens the user's PK competition records from the PK page.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it hides PK history.

zh-CN.description: 电银伙伴的盛掌柜（DY_SZG）业务 SDK 在用户查看 PK 记录时打开此页，显示比赛历史。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法查看 PK 历史记录。

en.description: The Dianyinhuoban SHENGZHANGUI (DY_SZG) business SDK opens the PK area, where users switch between team and personal challenges and open their PK records.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it removes the app's PK entry and challenge pages.

zh-CN.description: 电银伙伴的盛掌柜（DY_SZG）业务 SDK 打开 PK 页面，供用户切换战队 PK 和个人 PK，并进入 PK 记录。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法进入战队或个人 PK 功能。

en.description: The Dianyinhuoban SHENGZHANGUI (DY_SZG) business SDK opens this picker when the user chooses an opponent for a team or personal PK. It returns the selected member or team.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from choosing a PK opponent.

zh-CN.description: 电银伙伴的盛掌柜（DY_SZG）业务 SDK 在用户为战队或个人 PK 选择对手时打开此列表，并返回所选成员或战队。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法选择 PK 对手。

en.description: The Dianyinhuoban SHENGZHANGUI (DY_SZG) business SDK displays a PK result, including the outcome, score summary, cycle, and options to start another round or return.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it removes the PK result screen.

zh-CN.description: 电银伙伴的盛掌柜（DY_SZG）业务 SDK 显示 PK 结果、成绩摘要和周期，并提供再来一局或返回的入口。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法查看 PK 结果页。

en.description: The Dianyinhuoban SHENGZHANGUI (DY_SZG) business SDK opens a search page to find the team or member selected as a PK opponent.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it removes PK opponent search.

zh-CN.description: 电银伙伴的盛掌柜（DY_SZG）业务 SDK 打开 PK 对手搜索页，供用户查找要选择的团队或成员。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法搜索 PK 对手。

en.description: The Dianyinhuoban SHENGZHANGUI (DY_SZG) business SDK opens the PK setup form. Users choose a challenge period, enter a reward amount, and submit a challenge request.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from configuring or starting a PK challenge.

zh-CN.description: 电银伙伴的盛掌柜（DY_SZG）业务 SDK 打开 PK 设置表单，供用户选择周期、填写奖励金额并提交挑战申请。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法配置或发起 PK 挑战。

en.description: The Dianyinhuoban SHENGZHANGUI (DY_SZG) business SDK shows the waiting state after a team PK request is submitted. It tells the user that the opposing team must confirm.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it removes the pending-confirmation result screen.

zh-CN.description: 电银伙伴的盛掌柜（DY_SZG）业务 SDK 在战队 PK 申请提交后显示等待状态，提示用户等待对方战队确认。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法看到 PK 申请的等待确认页。

en.description: The Dianyinhuoban SHENGZHANGUI (DY_SZG) business SDK opens the poster and training area. It loads poster categories into tabs and includes the training content page.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it removes the poster and training entry.

zh-CN.description: 电银伙伴的盛掌柜（DY_SZG）业务 SDK 打开海报与培训内容页面，加载海报分类标签，并包含讲武堂内容页。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法进入海报分类或此处的培训内容。

en.description: The Dianyinhuoban SHENGZHANGUI (DY_SZG) business SDK opens the editor for a selected promotional poster. It adds the user's name, referral code, and QR code, then lets the user save or share the image.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from customizing and sharing referral posters.

zh-CN.description: 电银伙伴的盛掌柜（DY_SZG）业务 SDK 在用户选择宣传海报后打开编辑页，加入姓名、推荐码和二维码，并支持保存或分享图片。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法制作或分享带个人推荐信息的海报。

en.description: The Dianyinhuoban SHENGZHANGUI (DY_SZG) business SDK opens this form to add or edit a shipping address. It validates recipient and address details and can delete an existing address.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from adding or updating shipping addresses.

zh-CN.description: 电银伙伴的盛掌柜（DY_SZG）业务 SDK 打开收货地址新增或编辑表单，校验收件人和地址信息，也可删除已有地址。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法新增、修改或删除收货地址。

en.description: The Dianyinhuoban SHENGZHANGUI (DY_SZG) business SDK opens the authorization-letter page. It loads authorization status and submits an application, directing users to real-name verification when required.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it removes the authorization application and status flow.

zh-CN.description: 电银伙伴的盛掌柜（DY_SZG）业务 SDK 打开授权书页面，加载授权状态并提交申请；需要实名认证时会引导用户先认证。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法查看或申请授权书。

en.description: The Dianyinhuoban SHENGZHANGUI (DY_SZG) business SDK opens bank-card management. Users can add or edit a card, choose a default card, or remove one.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents bank-card management for payments and withdrawals.

zh-CN.description: 电银伙伴的盛掌柜（DY_SZG）业务 SDK 打开银行卡管理页，供用户新增或修改银行卡、设为默认卡或删除银行卡。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法管理用于付款或提现的银行卡。

en.description: The Dianyinhuoban SHENGZHANGUI (DY_SZG) business SDK opens the form for changing the account login password.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from changing their login password.

zh-CN.description: 电银伙伴的盛掌柜（DY_SZG）业务 SDK 打开登录密码修改表单。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法在应用内修改登录密码。

en.description: The Dianyinhuoban SHENGZHANGUI (DY_SZG) business SDK opens the form for changing the payment password used to authorize payments.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from changing their payment password.

zh-CN.description: 电银伙伴的盛掌柜（DY_SZG）业务 SDK 打开支付密码修改表单，用于修改付款验证密码。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法在应用内修改支付密码。

en.description: The Dianyinhuoban SHENGZHANGUI (DY_SZG) business SDK opens an edit form for the user's nickname or team name, depending on the selected field.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from changing these profile names.

zh-CN.description: 电银伙伴的盛掌柜（DY_SZG）业务 SDK 根据所选资料项打开编辑表单，用于修改用户昵称或团队名称。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法修改昵称或团队名称。

en.description: The Dianyinhuoban SHENGZHANGUI (DY_SZG) business SDK opens the Jiang Wu Tang training and learning content page.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it removes this training content page.

zh-CN.description: 电银伙伴的盛掌柜（DY_SZG）业务 SDK 打开讲武堂培训内容页。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法在此页面查看培训内容。

en.description: The Dianyinhuoban SHENGZHANGUI (DY_SZG) business SDK opens message notifications with tabs for all messages, pending items, other notices, and announcements. Selecting a message loads its details.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it hides message notifications and their details.

zh-CN.description: 电银伙伴的盛掌柜（DY_SZG）业务 SDK 打开消息通知页，提供全部、待处理、其他通知和公告标签，选择消息后加载详情。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法查看消息通知或消息详情。

en.description: The Dianyinhuoban SHENGZHANGUI (DY_SZG) business SDK opens the forgotten-payment-password recovery form. It verifies the phone with an image code and SMS code before resetting the password.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from recovering a forgotten payment password.

zh-CN.description: 电银伙伴的盛掌柜（DY_SZG）业务 SDK 打开支付密码找回表单，通过图形验证码和短信验证码验证手机号后重置密码。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法找回支付密码。

en.description: The Dianyinhuoban SHENGZHANGUI (DY_SZG) business SDK opens the account settings page. It links to profile, bank-card, authentication, password, and other account options and handles logout.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it removes the app's settings and account-management entry.

zh-CN.description: 电银伙伴的盛掌柜（DY_SZG）业务 SDK 打开账户设置页，提供个人资料、银行卡、认证、密码等管理入口，并处理退出登录。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法进入设置或管理账户。

en.description: The Dianyinhuoban SHENGZHANGUI (DY_SZG) business SDK opens the profile editor. Users can update their avatar and personal details such as gender, birthday, and address.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from editing personal profile information.

zh-CN.description: 电银伙伴的盛掌柜（DY_SZG）业务 SDK 打开个人资料编辑页，供用户更新头像、性别、生日和地址等信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法编辑个人资料。

en.description: The Dianyinhuoban SHENGZHANGUI (DY_SZG) business SDK opens an embedded payment page for the Alipay content returned by order checkout. Its web view handles payment-page navigation and results.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it breaks the Alipay payment route for purchases.

zh-CN.description: 电银伙伴的盛掌柜（DY_SZG）业务 SDK 打开内嵌支付宝付款页，展示订单流程返回的支付宝内容并处理页面跳转和付款结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过支付宝完成采购付款。

en.description: The EllaBook reading SDK opens this full-screen landscape screen to display a book while it is being read. The screen stays awake until the reader closes.
en.disableEffect: Books opened through EllaBook cannot be displayed in this reader screen.

zh-CN.description: EllaBook 阅读 SDK 在阅读书籍时打开这个横屏全屏页面，用来显示书籍内容；阅读期间屏幕会保持常亮。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用无法通过 EllaBook 阅读器显示书籍内容。

en.description: When the host app opens EnterTech's Bio BLE device screen, it shows the selected sensor's connection state, battery, and firmware details and provides controls to reconnect or manage it.
en.disableEffect: Users lose this sensor-management screen and cannot view or reconnect the selected BLE device through it.

zh-CN.description: 宿主应用打开 EnterTech Bio 蓝牙设备页面时，此页面会显示所选传感器的连接状态、电量和固件信息，并提供重新连接和设备管理入口。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法使用此页面查看或重新连接所选蓝牙设备。

en.description: When a user opens connection help from EnterTech's Bio BLE device screen, this Activity displays the SDK's troubleshooting page.
en.disableEffect: The connection-help page will not open after a problem, and the device screen launches it directly from its help control.

zh-CN.description: 用户从 EnterTech Bio 蓝牙设备页面打开连接帮助时，此页面会显示该 SDK 的故障排查内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 连接出现问题后将无法打开此帮助页面，设备页面的帮助入口也会失效。

en.description: When the host app starts EnterTech's Bio BLE device flow, this screen checks Bluetooth and location readiness, then opens the required system settings or the single-device or multi-device screen.
en.disableEffect: Users lose the entry screen for the SDK's Bluetooth device flow, including its permission and Bluetooth setup guidance.

zh-CN.description: 宿主应用启动 EnterTech Bio 蓝牙设备流程时，此页面会检查蓝牙和定位状态，并打开所需的系统设置、单设备页面或多设备列表。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将失去进入该 SDK 蓝牙设备流程的页面，也无法通过此处查看权限和蓝牙设置指引。

en.description: During first-time EnterTech BLE setup, this screen asks the user to turn on the sensor; continuing opens the device connection screen.
en.disableEffect: The first-connection guidance will be unavailable, so users may not reach the sensor connection screen through this setup flow.

zh-CN.description: 首次设置 EnterTech 蓝牙设备时，此页面会提示用户打开传感器；继续后会进入设备连接页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 首次连接指引将不可用，用户可能无法通过此设置流程进入传感器连接页面。

en.description: When the host app opens an available or required EnterTech sensor firmware update, this screen shows its status and starts transferring the selected firmware package when the user taps Update.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot start or follow firmware updates for the EnterTech BLE sensor from the app.

zh-CN.description: 宿主应用打开 EnterTech 传感器的可用或强制固件更新时，此页面会显示更新状态，并在用户点击更新后传输所选固件包。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在应用中启动或查看 EnterTech 蓝牙传感器的固件更新。

en.description: When a user taps an EnterTech BLE firmware-update notification, this Activity forwards the update details to the firmware update screen and then closes.
en.disableEffect: Tapping the firmware-update notification can no longer return users to the update screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击 EnterTech 蓝牙固件更新通知时，此页面会把更新信息交给固件更新页面，然后关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 点击固件更新通知后将无法返回更新页面。

en.description: When the host app is configured for multiple EnterTech BLE sensors, this screen lists the configured devices for the user.
en.disableEffect: Users lose the SDK's multi-device list and cannot choose a sensor from this screen.

zh-CN.description: 宿主应用配置了多个 EnterTech 蓝牙传感器时，此页面会列出已配置的设备供用户查看和选择。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法使用该 SDK 的多设备列表，也无法从此页面选择传感器。

en.description: When the host app opens an EnterTech BLE SDK web page with a title and address, this screen loads it in an embedded browser and shows an offline message when there is no network.
en.disableEffect: Web pages opened through the EnterTech BLE SDK will no longer be available in the app.

zh-CN.description: 宿主应用打开带有标题和网址的 EnterTech 蓝牙 SDK 网页时，此页面会在内置浏览器中加载；没有网络时会显示离线提示。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法显示通过 EnterTech 蓝牙 SDK 打开的网页。

en.description: When the Nordic DFU upload request is sent for an EnterTech sensor update, this service transfers firmware to the BLE device and provides the update notification.
en.disableEffect: Firmware uploads to the EnterTech BLE sensor will not run.

zh-CN.description: EnterTech 传感器更新发出 Nordic DFU 上传请求时，此服务会通过蓝牙向设备传输固件并提供更新通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 将无法向 EnterTech 蓝牙传感器上传固件。

en.description: When a user opens a saved log from EnterTech Log's viewer, this provider grants a text viewer access to the selected file.
en.disableEffect: Saved log files can no longer be opened in another app from the EnterTech Log viewer.

zh-CN.description: 用户从 EnterTech Log 日志查看器打开已保存的日志时，此 Provider 会授权文本查看应用读取所选文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法从 EnterTech Log 查看器中把已保存的日志交给其他应用打开。

en.description: When the host app opens EnterTech Log's local viewer, this screen lists saved log files and lets the user open a selected file in a text viewer.
en.disableEffect: The app's local log-browsing screen will be unavailable; its other screens and features are unaffected.

zh-CN.description: 宿主应用打开 EnterTech Log 本地查看器时，此页面会列出已保存的日志，并允许用户用文本查看应用打开所选文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用的本地日志浏览页面将不可用，其他页面和功能不受影响。

en.description: Android initializes this declared provider from EnterTech's serial communication SDK when the app process starts, but it exposes no data and performs no serial-port initialization.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it has no visible effect in the analyzed SDK code.

zh-CN.description: 应用进程启动时，Android 会初始化 EnterTech 串口通信 SDK 声明的此 Provider，但它不提供数据，也不初始化串口。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 根据分析到的 SDK 代码，停用它不会产生可见影响。

en.description: When the app begins a serial connection to an external device, EnterTech's serial communication SDK runs this background service in a separate process to initialize the port and signal when it is ready.
en.disableEffect: Serial-connected external devices may fail to initialize or communicate with the app.

zh-CN.description: 应用开始连接串口外设时，EnterTech 串口通信 SDK 会在独立进程中运行此后台服务，初始化串口并发出就绪通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过串口连接的外设可能无法初始化或与应用通信。

en.description: When the host app opens an expanded biofeedback report, EnterTech's UI Components SDK plots the session's attention and relaxation readings over time.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot view the detailed attention and relaxation chart for a session.

zh-CN.description: 宿主应用打开扩展生物反馈报告时，EnterTech UI Components SDK 会绘制本次训练中专注度和放松度随时间变化的曲线。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法查看本次训练的专注度和放松度详细图表。

en.description: When the host app opens a detailed report chart, EnterTech's UI Components SDK displays the supplied values as bars, with optional period and average details.
en.disableEffect: Users lose this detailed bar-chart view of the report data.

zh-CN.description: 宿主应用打开详细报告图表时，EnterTech UI Components SDK 会将提供的数据绘制为柱状图，并可显示周期和平均值信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法查看报告数据的详细柱状图。

en.description: When the host app opens a selected-band brainwave chart, EnterTech's UI Components SDK plots gamma, beta, alpha, theta, and delta readings with a selectable legend.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open this detailed comparison of the brainwave frequency bands.

zh-CN.description: 宿主应用打开可选频段脑波图时，EnterTech UI Components SDK 会绘制伽马、贝塔、阿尔法、西塔和德尔塔读数，并显示可选择的图例。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开脑波各频段的详细对比图。

en.description: When the host app requests a brainwave spectrum chart, EnterTech's UI Components SDK plots the supplied gamma, beta, alpha, theta, and delta readings.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot show this detailed chart of brainwave frequency-band readings.

zh-CN.description: 宿主应用请求脑波频谱图时，EnterTech UI Components SDK 会绘制提供的伽马、贝塔、阿尔法、西塔和德尔塔读数。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法显示脑波各频段读数的详细图表。

en.description: When the host app opens a detailed brainwave report, EnterTech's UI Components SDK displays the supplied brainwave trends across reporting periods.
en.disableEffect: Users lose the detailed brainwave trend view in the report.

zh-CN.description: 宿主应用打开详细脑波报告时，EnterTech UI Components SDK 会按报告周期显示提供的脑波趋势。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法查看报告中的脑波详细趋势图。

en.description: When the host app opens a detailed report chart, EnterTech's UI Components SDK displays the supplied metric data in a candlestick chart across reporting periods.
en.disableEffect: Users lose this detailed candlestick view of the report data.

zh-CN.description: 宿主应用打开详细报告图表时，EnterTech UI Components SDK 会按报告周期以蜡烛图展示提供的指标数据。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法查看报告数据的详细蜡烛图。

en.description: When the host app opens an expanded heart-rate-variability report, EnterTech's UI Components SDK plots the supplied HRV readings over time, including a comparison series when provided.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot view the detailed heart-rate-variability chart in the report.

zh-CN.description: 宿主应用打开扩展心率变异性报告时，EnterTech UI Components SDK 会绘制提供的 HRV 读数；如果提供了对照数据，也会一并显示。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法查看报告中的心率变异性详细图表。

en.description: When the host app opens a detailed metric view, EnterTech's UI Components SDK plots the supplied time-series values as a line chart.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open this detailed line-chart view of the selected metric.

zh-CN.description: 宿主应用打开指标详情时，EnterTech UI Components SDK 会将提供的时间序列数据绘制为折线图。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开所选指标的详细折线图。

en.description: When the host app opens a pressure report, EnterTech's UI Components SDK displays the supplied pressure readings as a trend chart across reporting periods.
en.disableEffect: Users lose the detailed pressure-trend view in the report.

zh-CN.description: 宿主应用打开压力报告时，EnterTech UI Components SDK 会按报告周期显示提供的压力读数趋势。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法查看报告中的压力详细趋势图。

en.description: When the host app opens a session brainwave chart, EnterTech's UI Components SDK plots the supplied brainwave-band readings over the session.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot view the detailed brainwave-band traces for the session.

zh-CN.description: 宿主应用打开训练脑波图时，EnterTech UI Components SDK 会绘制本次训练期间提供的各脑波频段读数。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法查看本次训练各脑波频段的详细曲线。

en.description: When the host app opens a session brainwave summary, EnterTech's UI Components SDK displays the supplied brainwave bands together in a stacked chart.
en.disableEffect: Users lose the stacked view of the session's brainwave readings.

zh-CN.description: 宿主应用打开训练脑波汇总时，EnterTech UI Components SDK 会用堆叠图一起展示本次训练提供的各脑波频段数据。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法查看本次训练脑波读数的堆叠图。

en.description: When the host app opens a session metric report, EnterTech's UI Components SDK plots the supplied primary, comparison, and quality values over the session.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot display these detailed session metric and quality trends.

zh-CN.description: 宿主应用打开训练指标报告时，EnterTech UI Components SDK 会绘制本次训练提供的主要数据、对照数据和质量数据。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法显示这些训练指标和质量数据的详细趋势。

en.description: When the host app opens a session pressure report, EnterTech's UI Components SDK plots the supplied pressure readings over the session.
en.disableEffect: Users lose the detailed pressure chart for the session.

zh-CN.description: 宿主应用打开训练压力报告时，EnterTech UI Components SDK 会绘制本次训练期间提供的压力读数。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法查看本次训练的详细压力图表。

en.description: When the host app supplies a network address and port for a bio report, EnterTech's Bio Report SDK starts an HTTP server and makes a course and session report page available at a generated link.
en.disableEffect: The host app cannot serve or open report pages through this EnterTech web-report feature.

zh-CN.description: 宿主应用为生物报告提供网络地址和端口时，EnterTech Bio Report SDK 会启动 HTTP 服务，并通过生成的链接提供课程和训练报告页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 宿主应用将无法通过 EnterTech 网页报告功能提供或打开报告页面。

en.description: When Feige's IM SDK initializes the user's messaging client, this service connects to the chat server and handles sign-in, messages, group invitations, and online status.
en.disableEffect: Feige-based chat cannot connect or keep messages and online status in sync.

zh-CN.description: Feige 即时通信 SDK 初始化用户的聊天功能时，此服务会连接聊天服务器并处理登录、消息、群组邀请和在线状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 基于 Feige 的聊天功能将无法连接，也无法同步消息和在线状态。

en.description: When GalleryFinal photo editing is enabled, this Activity lets the user crop or rotate selected photos before returning them to the app.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot use GalleryFinal to return cropped or rotated photos.

zh-CN.description: 启用 GalleryFinal 图片编辑时，此 Activity 可让用户裁剪或旋转已选照片，然后将照片返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法通过 GalleryFinal 取回裁剪或旋转后的照片。

en.description: When GalleryFinal previews selected photos, this Activity opens them in a swipeable gallery with a position indicator.
en.disableEffect: The app’s GalleryFinal photo-preview screen cannot open.

zh-CN.description: GalleryFinal 预览已选照片时，此 Activity 会在可滑动的画廊中显示照片和当前位置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法打开 GalleryFinal 图片预览页面。

en.description: When the app requests GalleryFinal’s picker, this Activity lists photo albums and images, can open the camera, and returns selected images to the app.
en.disableEffect: The app’s GalleryFinal photo picker and any camera capture started from it stop working.

zh-CN.description: 应用调用 GalleryFinal 选择器时，此 Activity 会列出相册和图片、打开相机，并将所选图片返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用的 GalleryFinal 图片选择器及从中启动的拍照功能将无法使用。

en.description: When the UC Game SDK opens an in-app screen, this Activity displays it and accepts the user’s input while it is open.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it can prevent UC Game SDK screens used by the app from opening.

zh-CN.description: UC 游戏 SDK 打开应用内页面时，这个 Activity 会显示页面并接收用户操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，应用使用的 UC 游戏 SDK 页面可能无法打开。

en.description: When the UC Game SDK opens an in-app screen with a requested appearance, this Activity displays it using that screen’s theme.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it can prevent UC Game SDK screens that the app relies on from opening.

zh-CN.description: UC 游戏 SDK 打开带有指定外观的应用内页面时，这个 Activity 会使用相应主题显示页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，应用依赖的 UC 游戏 SDK 页面可能无法打开。

en.description: The UC Game SDK creates a shareable link to a file when one of its flows needs another app to open that file. The provider runs when the SDK requests access to a configured file.
en.disableEffect: UC SDK flows that hand off or open downloaded files can fail when this provider cannot create the file link.

zh-CN.description: UC 游戏 SDK 需要其他应用打开文件时，会通过此 Provider 为文件创建可分享的链接。SDK 请求访问已配置文件时它会运行。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 此 Provider 无法创建文件链接时，UC SDK 中交接或打开下载文件的流程可能失败。

en.description: The UC Game SDK starts this background Service for its account resource work and uses it while carrying out account-related tasks.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it can interrupt UC Game SDK account operations used by the app.

zh-CN.description: UC 游戏 SDK 会启动这个后台 Service 来处理账号资源相关任务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，应用使用的 UC 游戏 SDK 账号操作可能中断。

en.description: The Hacktons Dexing library starts this screen during startup on older Android versions that need extra app code prepared. It installs that code and then closes.
en.disableEffect: On affected older Android versions, the app may remain stuck during startup or fail to open because its additional code is not installed.

zh-CN.description: Hacktons Dexing 库会在需要预先准备额外应用代码的旧版 Android 启动过程中打开此页面，完成安装后再关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 在受影响的旧版 Android 上，额外代码无法安装，应用可能卡在启动过程中或无法打开。

en.description: The Adsail (Haorui) ad SDK opens this screen when an ad asks the user to confirm or cancel an action. It closes after handling the selected response.
en.disableEffect: Adsail ad confirmation prompts will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: Adsail（Haorui）广告 SDK 会在广告需要用户确认或取消操作时打开此页面。处理所选操作后，页面会关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Adsail 的广告确认提示将无法打开。

en.description: Adsail (Haorui) opens this screen from an ad's media view to show the promoted offer or app while its video plays. Tapping the offer can start the ad download flow.
en.disableEffect: Adsail video-ad offer details and their download links will not open.

zh-CN.description: Adsail（Haorui）会从广告媒体视图打开此页面，在视频播放时展示推广内容或应用。点击推广内容可进入广告下载流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Adsail 视频广告的推广详情和下载链接将无法打开。

en.description: The Adsail (Haorui) ad SDK opens this screen from an app-download ad to show the promoted app description, features, permissions, and privacy information. Privacy and other links can open a web page or another app.
en.disableEffect: Adsail app-download details and their privacy links will not open.

zh-CN.description: Adsail（Haorui）广告 SDK 会在应用下载广告中打开此页面，展示推广应用的介绍、功能、权限和隐私信息。隐私等链接可打开网页或其他应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Adsail 应用下载详情和隐私链接将无法打开。

en.description: The Adsail (Haorui) ad SDK opens this screen to display a full-screen native ad and its related offer details.
en.disableEffect: Adsail full-screen native ads will not appear.

zh-CN.description: Adsail（Haorui）广告 SDK 会打开此页面，展示全屏原生广告及相关推广详情。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Adsail 的全屏原生广告将不再显示。

en.description: The Adsail (Haorui) ad SDK opens this screen from an ad link to try to open the linked app or page and return the result.
en.disableEffect: Adsail ad links will no longer open their linked app or page through this flow.

zh-CN.description: Adsail（Haorui）广告 SDK 会从广告链接打开此页面，尝试启动链接指向的应用或页面并返回结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Adsail 广告链接将无法通过此流程打开目标应用或页面。

en.description: The Adsail (Haorui) ad SDK displays a web-based rewarded ad on this screen and tracks how long it is viewed before completion.
en.disableEffect: Adsail web-based rewarded ads will not open, and watching ads will no longer earn rewards.

zh-CN.description: Adsail（Haorui）广告 SDK 会在此页面展示网页形式的激励广告，并记录观看时长以判断是否完成。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Adsail 网页激励广告将无法打开，观看广告也将不再获得奖励。

en.description: The Adsail (Haorui) ad SDK plays a full-screen rewarded video on this screen and tracks whether viewing is completed.
en.disableEffect: Adsail rewarded videos will not open, and watching ads will no longer earn rewards.

zh-CN.description: Adsail（Haorui）广告 SDK 会在此页面播放全屏激励视频，并记录是否完成观看。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Adsail 激励视频将无法打开，观看广告也将不再获得奖励。

en.description: The Adsail (Haorui) ad SDK opens this screen for ad destination, privacy, and download links. It loads the supplied web page and can offer sharing or download actions.
en.disableEffect: Adsail ad destination and privacy pages will not open in its built-in browser.

zh-CN.description: Adsail（Haorui）广告 SDK 会用此页面打开广告目标页、隐私页和下载链接。页面加载指定网页，并可提供分享或下载操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Adsail 内置浏览器将无法打开广告目标页和隐私页。

en.description: The Adsail (Haorui) ad SDK opens this screen to confirm an advertised app download and show app and privacy details before starting it.
en.disableEffect: Adsail app-download confirmation and its details will not open.

zh-CN.description: Adsail（Haorui）广告 SDK 会打开此页面，确认是否下载广告推广的应用，并在开始下载前展示应用和隐私信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Adsail 应用下载确认页面及其详情将无法打开。

en.description: Android creates this Adsail (Haorui) provider during app startup. It tracks when the app moves between foreground and background so the advertising SDK can follow app activity.
en.disableEffect: Adsail will lose app lifecycle tracking; the host app screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: Android 会在应用启动时创建 Adsail（Haorui）内容提供器。它跟踪应用进入前台或后台的状态，供广告 SDK 使用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Adsail 将无法跟踪应用的前后台状态，但应用自身页面仍可使用。

en.description: The Adsail (Haorui) ad SDK opens a task-center web page inside the app. The page can respond when the app resumes or the user presses Back.
en.disableEffect: Adsail task-center pages will not open.

zh-CN.description: Adsail（Haorui）广告 SDK 会在应用内打开任务中心网页。应用恢复或用户按下返回键时，页面会收到相应通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Adsail 任务中心页面将无法打开。

en.description: Receives Android God Eye's private leak-analysis start, progress, retry, and completion messages, then records the diagnostic status and leak details.
en.disableEffect: God Eye's leak diagnostics will no longer receive analysis updates and results.

zh-CN.description: 接收 Android God Eye 私有的内存泄漏分析开始、进度、重试和完成消息，并记录诊断状态与结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: God Eye 的内存泄漏诊断将无法收到分析进度和结果。

en.description: When Android God Eye requests a heap-dump check, this background service examines the dump for objects that remain in memory and reports the analysis result.
en.disableEffect: God Eye cannot run this background memory-leak analysis.

zh-CN.description: Android God Eye 请求检查堆转储时，此后台服务会分析仍留在内存中的对象并返回分析结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: God Eye 将无法运行此后台内存泄漏分析。

en.description: After a heap dump is analyzed, this background service saves the leak result and sends private updates to Android God Eye's diagnostic receiver.
en.disableEffect: God Eye cannot save and deliver leak-analysis results through this service.

zh-CN.description: 堆转储分析完成后，此后台服务会保存泄漏结果，并向 Android God Eye 的诊断接收器发送内部更新。
zh-CN.disableEffect: God Eye 将无法通过此服务保存并传递泄漏分析结果。

en.description: Android starts this Huolala Battery Finder provider with the app. It begins recording battery and screen activity and marks app-lifecycle times for battery diagnostics.
en.disableEffect: Battery Finder stops collecting these battery, screen, and lifecycle measurements.

zh-CN.description: Android 会在应用启动时运行这个货拉拉 Battery Finder 提供程序，开始记录电量和屏幕活动，并标记应用生命周期时间用于电量诊断。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Battery Finder 将停止收集这些电量、屏幕和生命周期数据。

en.description: When Huolala Battery Finder's main process connects, this private service receives location-use records over a local message channel and adds them to its diagnostics.
en.disableEffect: Battery Finder can no longer receive these location-use measurements for its analysis.

zh-CN.description: 货拉拉 Battery Finder 的主进程连接时，此私有服务会通过本地消息通道接收位置使用记录并加入诊断数据。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Battery Finder 将无法接收这些位置使用数据进行分析。

en.description: The Graffiti editor library opens a supplied picture so the user can draw on it and save a new annotated image.
en.disableEffect: Apps that use this editor may lose their picture-markup flow.

zh-CN.description: Graffiti 图片编辑库会打开传入的照片，供用户绘制标记并保存一张新的编辑图片。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此编辑器的应用可能无法继续使用图片标注流程。

en.description: This Teemo debug screen lists phone and app diagnostics, including screen size, memory and storage, device model and Android version, and app identity and signature details.
en.disableEffect: This diagnostic screen will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: Teemo 调试界面会列出手机和应用诊断信息，包括屏幕尺寸、内存和存储空间、设备型号与 Android 版本，以及应用身份和签名信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 此诊断界面将无法打开。

en.description: Magic-Box (HiJesse developer toolkit) opens a diagnostics dashboard when the app requests it. The dashboard controls CPU, memory, and frame-rate monitoring, request logging, and tests that simulate blocked, slow, or timed-out network access.
en.disableEffect: The developer dashboard and its monitoring and network simulation controls will be unavailable; regular app screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: Magic-Box（HiJesse 开发工具包）会在应用请求时打开诊断面板。面板可控制 CPU、内存和帧率监测、请求日志，以及模拟断网、低速或超时网络。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 开发诊断面板及其监测和网络模拟功能将无法使用，应用的常规界面仍可使用。

en.description: Magic-Box (HiJesse developer toolkit) shows the app icon, name, version, package name, and any extra diagnostic details supplied by the app when a developer opens its app information screen.
en.disableEffect: The app information diagnostic screen will be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: Magic-Box（HiJesse 开发工具包）会在开发者打开应用信息页面时显示应用图标、名称、版本、包名和应用提供的其他诊断信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用信息诊断页面将无法使用。

en.description: Magic-Box (HiJesse developer toolkit) shows device details such as brand, model, Android version, processor type, root status, screen size, network, and Wi-Fi signal when a developer opens device information.
en.disableEffect: The device information diagnostic screen will be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: Magic-Box（HiJesse 开发工具包）会在开发者打开设备信息页面时显示品牌、型号、Android 版本、处理器类型、Root 状态、屏幕尺寸、网络和 Wi-Fi 信号等信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 设备信息诊断页面将无法使用。

en.description: Magic-Box (HiJesse developer toolkit) previews a selected text or image file from its diagnostic file browser.
en.disableEffect: Text and image file previews in the diagnostic browser will be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: Magic-Box（HiJesse 开发工具包）会在诊断文件浏览器中预览选中的文本或图片文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 诊断浏览器将无法预览文本和图片文件。

en.description: Magic-Box (HiJesse developer toolkit) browses the app sandbox or a diagnostic folder when a developer opens its file tool. It lets the developer move through folders and select a file to preview.
en.disableEffect: The sandbox and diagnostic file browser will be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: Magic-Box（HiJesse 开发工具包）会在开发者打开文件工具时浏览应用沙盒或指定的诊断目录。开发者可以进入文件夹并选择文件进行预览。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用沙盒和诊断文件浏览器将无法使用。

en.description: Jiguang JAD opens this screen to display an ad and handle the ad screen's open, pause, resume, Back, and close events.
en.disableEffect: JAD ads will not be able to open or complete their display flow.

zh-CN.description: Jiguang JAD 会打开此界面展示广告，并处理广告页面的打开、暂停、恢复、返回和关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，JAD 广告将无法正常打开或完成展示。

en.description: Jiguang JAD uses this provider to let other apps read files in its ad download folder, such as APKs opened from an ad.
en.disableEffect: Ad downloads that need to pass a file to the installer will no longer open; regular app features are unaffected.

zh-CN.description: Jiguang JAD 通过此 Provider 向其他应用提供广告下载目录中的文件，例如从广告打开的 APK。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，需要交给安装器处理的广告下载文件将无法打开；应用的其他功能不受影响。

en.description: When the app starts, Jiguang JAD uses this provider to follow whether the app is in the foreground or background for ad handling.
en.disableEffect: JAD may miss app state changes and handle ads incorrectly when the app moves between foreground and background.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，Jiguang JAD 会通过此 Provider 监听应用进入前台或后台，以配合广告处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，JAD 将无法及时感知前后台切换，广告行为可能异常。

en.description: Jiguang JAD uses this receiver to pass its background ad messages to the ad service.
en.disableEffect: JAD ad operations that rely on these messages will stop, while non-ad app features continue.

zh-CN.description: Jiguang JAD 用此 Receiver 接收广告 SDK 的后台消息，并转交给广告服务处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖这些消息的 JAD 广告操作会停止，应用的非广告功能不受影响。

en.description: Jiguang JAD briefly opens this transparent screen to pass an ad action to its service, then closes it.
en.disableEffect: Ad operations that use this handoff will not complete.

zh-CN.description: Jiguang JAD 会短暂打开此透明界面传递广告操作，然后立即关闭它。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，依赖此界面的广告操作将无法完成。

en.description: During a QR-code visual tracking session, JAnalytics opens this screen and loads its page for selecting app views to track.
en.disableEffect: Visual event tracking setup will stop; normal app screens will continue to work.

zh-CN.description: 通过二维码启动可视化埋点时，JAnalytics 会打开此界面并加载可选择应用页面的跟踪页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，可视化事件跟踪的配置将无法使用；应用的正常页面仍可使用。

en.description: The Tencent GDT ad SDK opens this full-screen page to display an interstitial ad.
en.disableEffect: Tencent GDT interstitial ads will not display.

zh-CN.description: Tencent GDT 广告 SDK 会打开此全屏界面来展示插屏广告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Tencent GDT 插屏广告将无法显示。

en.description: Tencent GDT opens this confirmation screen when an ad offers an APK download and waits for the user's choice.
en.disableEffect: Ad APK downloads that require confirmation will not continue; other app features are unaffected.

zh-CN.description: Tencent GDT 在广告需要下载 APK 时会打开此确认窗口，等待用户选择是否继续。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，需要用户确认的广告 APK 下载将无法继续；应用的其他功能不受影响。

en.description: Jiguang Ads uses this background service to handle its own requests in a separate app process.
en.disableEffect: Jiguang Ads operations that rely on this background service will stop.

zh-CN.description: Jiguang Ads 会在后台通过此 Service 处理 SDK 请求，这些工作运行在应用的独立进程中。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，依赖该后台服务的 Jiguang Ads 操作将无法运行。

en.description: Kuaishou Ads opens this full-screen page to display an interstitial ad and handle its close flow.
en.disableEffect: Kuaishou interstitial ads will not display.

zh-CN.description: Kuaishou Ads 会打开此全屏界面来展示插屏广告，并处理广告关闭流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Kuaishou 插屏广告将无法显示。

en.description: Kuaishou Ads opens this screen for interstitial ads with a timed close control; it closes when the ad ends or the timer finishes.
en.disableEffect: These Kuaishou interstitial ads and their timed close flow will not work.

zh-CN.description: Kuaishou Ads 会打开此界面展示带倒计时关闭控件的插屏广告，并在广告结束或计时完成后关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，这类 Kuaishou 插屏广告及其倒计时关闭流程将无法使用。

en.description: Jiguang Share opens this screen for social-service authorization or sharing and passes the result back to the app.
en.disableEffect: Jiguang Share authorization, sign-in, and sharing flows will not complete.

zh-CN.description: Jiguang Share 发起社交平台授权或分享时会打开此界面，并把操作结果交还给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，依赖 Jiguang Share 的授权、登录或分享流程将无法完成。

en.description: When the app shares a photo or other attachment to Facebook through Jiguang Share, this provider makes the local file available to Facebook.
en.disableEffect: Sharing local files to Facebook through Jiguang Share will not work.

zh-CN.description: 应用通过 Jiguang Share 向 Facebook 分享图片或其他附件时，此 Provider 会把本地文件提供给 Facebook。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，通过 Jiguang Share 向 Facebook 分享本地文件将无法完成。

en.description: JPush uses this provider to create links that let its in-app messages and ad flows open downloaded files.
en.disableEffect: JPush in-app messages and ad downloads that need these files may fail to open.

zh-CN.description: JPush 会用此 Provider 为站内消息或广告下载中的文件生成可供打开的链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，依赖这些文件的 JPush 站内消息或广告下载可能无法打开。

en.description: Jiguang Verification opens this screen for one-tap carrier phone authentication, showing the configured authorization page and returning the sign-in result.
en.disableEffect: An app sign-in flow that uses Jiguang one-tap phone authentication will not complete.

zh-CN.description: Jiguang Verification 进行运营商手机号一键验证时会打开此 Activity，显示授权页面并返回登录结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，依赖 Jiguang Verification 一键手机号登录的流程将无法完成。

en.description: Jiguang Verification opens this screen for SMS-code sign-in, where the user enters a phone number, requests a code, and submits it.
en.disableEffect: SMS-code sign-in through Jiguang Verification will stop working.

zh-CN.description: Jiguang Verification 进行短信验证码登录时会打开此 Activity，供用户填写手机号、获取验证码并提交登录。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Jiguang Verification 的短信验证码登录将无法使用。

en.description: ASUS Push reports device registration and push results to this receiver. JPush (Jiguang) uses those reports to keep its ASUS push service in sync.
en.disableEffect: ASUS-delivered JPush messages and registration updates will stop reaching the app.

zh-CN.description: ASUS Push 会把设备注册和推送结果发送给此接收器。JPush（极光）根据这些信息更新 ASUS 推送状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过 ASUS 通道送达的 JPush 消息和注册更新将无法到达应用。

en.description: JPush's optional floating-message feature opens this Activity when it needs to show an in-app floating message. It displays the message and handles taps or dismissal.
en.disableEffect: JPush floating messages will no longer appear inside the app.

zh-CN.description: JPush（极光）的浮窗消息功能需要展示应用内消息时会打开此 Activity；它负责显示消息并处理点击或关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用内将不再显示 JPush 浮窗消息。

en.description: Huawei Location sends this service area-change events for places set up in JPush. JPush uses the location changes to run location-triggered message scenarios.
en.disableEffect: JPush location-triggered messages will no longer be processed.

zh-CN.description: 华为位置服务会把 JPush 设置的区域变化事件发送给此服务。JPush 根据设备位置变化触发相应的场景消息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: JPush 将不再处理由位置变化触发的消息。

en.description: When a JPush background wake-up alarm fires, Android sends it here. It checks that JPush has been started and may wake automatically, then continues JPush background push work.
en.disableEffect: JPush heartbeat and background wake-up tasks will stop, which can delay or prevent push delivery.

zh-CN.description: JPush 设置的后台唤醒闹钟触发时，Android 会启动此接收器。它会检查 JPush 是否已启动且允许自动唤醒，然后继续执行后台推送任务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: JPush 的心跳和后台唤醒任务将停止，推送可能延迟或无法送达。

en.description: A legacy JPush wake-up request can open this short-lived Activity. It passes the request to JPush and closes immediately.
en.disableEffect: Legacy JPush wake-up requests through this Activity will no longer be handled.

zh-CN.description: 旧版 JPush 的唤醒请求会打开这个短暂显示的 Activity。它把请求交给 JPush 处理后立即关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 旧版 JPush 通过此 Activity 发起的唤醒请求将无法处理。

en.description: JPush uses this background service to handle wake-up requests and keep its push work running.
en.disableEffect: JPush background wake-up and keep-alive work will stop.

zh-CN.description: JPush 使用此后台服务处理唤醒请求并维持推送后台任务运行。
zh-CN.disableEffect: JPush 的后台唤醒和保活任务将停止。

en.description: JPush uses this provider behind the scenes to pass information between its background push service and the app. Android opens it when JPush starts or handles a push request.
en.disableEffect: JPush's background service will lose this internal handoff, so push delivery and message handling may stop.

zh-CN.description: JPush 使用此 provider 在后台推送服务与应用之间传递信息。JPush 启动推送服务或处理推送请求时会用到它。
zh-CN.disableEffect: JPush 的后台服务将无法通过此 provider 交接请求，推送送达和消息处理可能停止。

en.description: In older JPush versions, another app can use this provider to send a wake-up request. JPush uses that request to resume background push work.
en.disableEffect: Older JPush cross-app wake-up and provider requests will no longer work.

zh-CN.description: 旧版 JPush 中，其他应用可以通过此 provider 发送唤醒请求，让 JPush 继续执行后台推送任务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 旧版 JPush 的应用间唤醒和 provider 请求将无法使用。

en.description: When a legacy JPush message asks for a file download, this background service retrieves the file and updates a progress or completion notification.
en.disableEffect: Files requested through JPush messages will no longer download, and their progress and completion notices will be missing.

zh-CN.description: 旧版 JPush 消息要求下载文件时，此后台服务会获取文件，并更新下载进度或完成通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: JPush 消息请求的文件将无法下载，进度和完成通知也不会显示。

en.description: Android runs this provider when the app starts so JPush can prepare its push service. It gives JPush the app information needed for startup.
en.disableEffect: JPush's automatic startup initialization will not run, so its push features may stay unavailable unless the app initializes JPush elsewhere.

zh-CN.description: Android 会在应用启动时运行此 provider，让 JPush 准备推送服务并取得启动所需的应用信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: JPush 的自动启动初始化将不再运行，除非应用通过其他方式初始化 JPush，否则推送功能可能不可用。

en.description: Honor Push sends this service new messages and device registration updates. It passes them to JPush, including messages used for incoming calls.
en.disableEffect: Honor-delivered JPush notifications and incoming calls using JPush's Honor route will stop reaching the app.

zh-CN.description: Honor Push 收到新消息或设备注册更新时会调用此服务。它将消息交给 JPush，也会转交用于来电的消息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过 Honor 通道送达的 JPush 通知和来电消息将无法到达应用。

en.description: When a user taps a local JPush notification, this Activity passes the selected action into the app and then closes.
en.disableEffect: Tapping a local JPush notification may no longer open its destination in the app.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击本地 JPush 通知时，此 Activity 会把相应操作交给应用，然后关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 点击本地 JPush 通知后，应用可能无法再打开对应页面。

en.description: This Activity handles taps on JPush notifications and opens the linked content or app screen.
en.disableEffect: Tapping a JPush notification may no longer open the app or its linked content.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击 JPush 通知时，此 Activity 会打开通知关联的内容或应用页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 点击 JPush 通知后，应用或通知关联内容可能无法打开。

en.description: When a user chooses a feedback option on a JPush notification, this service records the choice and updates or dismisses the notification.
en.disableEffect: JPush notification feedback options will stop responding, and their feedback reports will not be sent.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择 JPush 通知中的反馈选项时，此服务会记录选择，并更新或关闭该通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: JPush 通知中的反馈选项将无法响应，反馈结果也不会提交。

en.description: HeyTap enhanced-data messages start this service for OPPO Callkit. It passes incoming-call messages to JPush.
en.disableEffect: Incoming-call messages delivered through OPPO Callkit will not reach the app, so keep it enabled if the app relies on that route for calls.

zh-CN.description: HeyTap 增强数据服务收到 OPPO Callkit 消息时会启动此服务。它会把来电消息交给 JPush。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过 OPPO Callkit 送达的来电消息将无法到达应用；如果应用依赖此通道接听来电，请保持启用。

en.description: Firebase Cloud Messaging starts this service for new messages and registration tokens. It passes push messages to JPush and can show Firebase notifications in the Android notification shade.
en.disableEffect: Firebase-delivered messages and token updates will no longer reach JPush through this route.

zh-CN.description: Firebase Cloud Messaging 收到新消息或注册令牌时会启动此服务。它把推送消息交给 JPush，也可在 Android 通知栏显示 Firebase 通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过 Firebase 到达的消息和令牌更新将无法再经此通道交给 JPush。

en.description: Huawei Push starts this service when it receives a message or new token. The service forwards the data and token to JPush's Huawei channel.
en.disableEffect: JPush messages and token updates delivered through Huawei Push will stop.

zh-CN.description: Huawei Push 收到新消息或注册令牌时会启动此服务；它将消息数据和令牌交给 JPush 的华为推送通道。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过 Huawei Push 送达的 JPush 消息和令牌更新将停止。

en.description: Meizu Push sends broadcasts for messages, registration results, and notification events. This receiver reports push arrivals and registration data to JPush.
en.disableEffect: Meizu-delivered JPush messages, registration updates, and notification-arrival reports will stop.

zh-CN.description: Meizu Push 会通过广播发送消息、注册结果和通知事件。此接收器会把推送到达和注册信息报告给 JPush。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过 Meizu Push 送达的 JPush 消息、注册更新和通知到达报告将停止。

en.description: ColorOS sends standard OPPO data messages to this background service. It initializes the OPPO push handler and receives the message.
en.disableEffect: The standard OPPO data-message push route will stop receiving messages.

zh-CN.description: ColorOS 会把标准 OPPO 数据消息发送给此后台服务；服务初始化 OPPO 推送处理程序并接收消息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: OPPO 标准数据消息推送通道将无法再接收消息。

en.description: Vivo Push sends this receiver registration IDs, push messages, and call-related messages. It forwards them to JPush, including a separate route for incoming calls.
en.disableEffect: Vivo-delivered JPush messages and incoming calls using JPush's Vivo route will stop reaching the app.

zh-CN.description: Vivo Push 会向此接收器发送注册 ID、推送消息和通话相关消息。它把这些信息交给 JPush，也会转发来电消息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过 Vivo 通道送达的 JPush 消息和来电消息将无法到达应用。

en.description: Xiaomi Mi Push sends messages, notification events, and registration results to this receiver. It forwards them to JPush, including incoming-call messages.
en.disableEffect: Xiaomi-delivered JPush messages and incoming calls using JPush's Xiaomi route will stop reaching the app.

zh-CN.description: Xiaomi Mi Push 会向此接收器发送消息、通知事件和注册结果。它把这些信息交给 JPush，也会转发来电消息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过 Xiaomi 通道送达的 JPush 消息和来电消息将无法到达应用。

en.description: When JPush receives a notification, this receiver passes it into JPush notification handling so it can be shown or opened.
en.disableEffect: JPush notifications delivered through this broadcast will no longer be handled.

zh-CN.description: JPush 收到通知后，此接收器会把通知交给 JPush 处理，以便显示或打开。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过此广播送达的 JPush 通知将无法继续处理。

en.description: Android starts this service for JPush registration, delivery reports, and scheduled push tasks.
en.disableEffect: JPush background registration, reporting, and scheduled message tasks will stop.

zh-CN.description: Android 会启动此服务处理 JPush 注册、送达报告和定时推送任务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: JPush 后台注册、状态上报和定时消息任务将停止。

en.description: When a JPush notification is scheduled for later, Android sends an alarm here at the chosen time. The receiver asks JPush to display the delayed notification.
en.disableEffect: JPush notifications scheduled for later will no longer appear at their scheduled time.

zh-CN.description: JPush 通知被安排稍后显示时，Android 会在指定时间发送闹钟广播。此接收器会让 JPush 显示该通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 延迟显示的 JPush 通知将无法在预定时间出现。

en.description: JPush opens this Activity when it needs a rich notification pop-up. A link from the pop-up can open the push-content screen.
en.disableEffect: JPush pop-up messages and their links will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: JPush 需要显示富媒体通知弹窗时会打开此 Activity；用户也可以从弹窗链接进入推送内容页。
zh-CN.disableEffect: JPush 富媒体通知弹窗及其中的链接将无法打开。

en.description: When a user opens a JPush notification with a rich content page, this Activity displays the linked message content.
en.disableEffect: Tapping a JPush notification that leads to a rich push page may no longer open its content.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开带有富媒体内容页的 JPush 通知时，此 Activity 会显示关联的消息内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 点击要打开富媒体内容页的 JPush 通知后，相关内容可能无法显示。

en.description: Kuwo music player uses this provider to read and update its music library, playback lists, downloads, radio records, and car audio settings.
en.disableEffect: Kuwo music library, playback list, and download features that use these records may stop working.

zh-CN.description: Kuwo 音乐播放器使用此 Provider 读取和更新音乐库、播放列表、下载记录、电台记录及车载音效设置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖这些记录的 Kuwo 音乐库、播放列表和下载功能可能无法工作。

en.description: Kuwo music player registers this receiver for network changes and updates whether Wi-Fi or mobile data is available to playback features.
en.disableEffect: Online music playback may not respond correctly when the network connection changes.

zh-CN.description: Kuwo 音乐播放器注册此 Receiver 监听网络变化，并向播放功能更新 Wi-Fi 或移动数据是否可用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 网络连接变化时，在线音乐播放可能无法正确响应。

en.description: Kuwo music player starts this service to manage music playback and downloads, including playback that continues while the app is in the background.
en.disableEffect: Music playback and downloads may stop or fail to continue in the background.

zh-CN.description: Kuwo 音乐播放器通过此 Service 管理音乐播放和下载，也包括应用转入后台后继续播放的任务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 音乐播放和下载可能停止，或无法在后台继续。

en.description: Kuwo music player uses this service in its separate player process to handle playback and download requests.
en.disableEffect: Kuwo playback and downloads that rely on the separate player process may fail.

zh-CN.description: Kuwo 音乐播放器在独立的播放器进程中使用此 Service 处理播放和下载请求。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖独立播放器进程的 Kuwo 播放和下载功能可能失败。

en.description: Kuwo music player opens this screen for VIP web pages, including purchase and payment flows.
en.disableEffect: Kuwo VIP purchase, payment, and related web pages may not open.

zh-CN.description: Kuwo 音乐播放器使用此页面打开 VIP 网页，包括购买和支付流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Kuwo VIP 购买、支付及相关网页可能无法打开。

en.description: When the app starts an in-app purchase through Google Play Billing, WenjieGithub's Android Auth Library opens this Activity to bring up the store purchase flow; the user confirms the purchase through Google Play.
en.disableEffect: Google Play in-app purchases through this library can no longer be completed.

zh-CN.description: 应用通过 Google Play Billing 发起应用内购买时，WenjieGithub 的 Android Auth Library 会打开此界面启动商店付款流程，用户在 Google Play 确认购买。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此库完成 Google Play 应用内购买。

en.description: During Huawei account sign-in or a Huawei in-app purchase, WenjieGithub's Android Auth Library opens this screen to complete the provider flow.
en.disableEffect: Huawei account sign-in and in-app purchases through this library will stop working.

zh-CN.description: 应用发起华为账号登录或华为应用内购买时，WenjieGithub 的 Android Auth Library 会打开此界面完成相应流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此库完成华为账号登录或应用内购买。

en.description: When a user signs in with QQ or shares content through QQ, WenjieGithub's Android Auth Library opens this screen to finish the provider flow.
en.disableEffect: QQ sign-in and sharing through this library will stop working.

zh-CN.description: 用户通过 QQ 登录或分享内容时，WenjieGithub 的 Android Auth Library 会打开此界面完成相应流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此库使用 QQ 登录或分享内容。

en.description: When the app starts an RY account sign-in or Honor in-app purchase, WenjieGithub's Android Auth Library opens this screen to complete the provider flow.
en.disableEffect: RY account sign-in and Honor in-app purchases through this library will stop working.

zh-CN.description: 应用发起 RY 账号登录或荣耀应用内购买时，WenjieGithub 的 Android Auth Library 会打开此界面完成相应流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此库完成 RY 账号登录或荣耀应用内购买。

en.description: When a user signs in with Sina Weibo or shares content there, WenjieGithub's Android Auth Library opens this screen to finish the provider flow.
en.disableEffect: Sina Weibo sign-in and sharing through this library will stop working.

zh-CN.description: 用户通过新浪微博登录或分享内容时，WenjieGithub 的 Android Auth Library 会打开此界面完成相应流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此库使用新浪微博登录或分享内容。

en.description: When the app starts WeChat sign-in, sharing, or payment, WenjieGithub's Android Auth Library opens this screen to complete the WeChat flow.
en.disableEffect: WeChat sign-in, sharing, and payments through this library will stop working.

zh-CN.description: 应用发起微信登录、分享或付款时，WenjieGithub 的 Android Auth Library 会打开此界面完成相应流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此库完成微信登录、分享或付款。

en.description: When the app starts Xiaomi account sign-in or a Xiaomi in-app purchase, WenjieGithub's Android Auth Library opens this screen to complete the provider flow.
en.disableEffect: Xiaomi account sign-in and in-app purchases through this library will stop working.

zh-CN.description: 应用发起小米账号登录或小米应用内购买时，WenjieGithub 的 Android Auth Library 会打开此界面完成相应流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此库完成小米账号登录或应用内购买。

en.description: When the app starts a UnionPay purchase, WenjieGithub's Android Auth Library opens this screen to complete the payment and return the result.
en.disableEffect: UnionPay payments through this library can no longer be completed.

zh-CN.description: 应用发起银联付款时，WenjieGithub 的 Android Auth Library 会打开此界面完成付款并返回结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此库完成银联付款。

en.description: When the app starts an Alipay payment, WenjieGithub's Android Auth Library opens this screen and receives Alipay's return to the app.
en.disableEffect: Alipay payments through this library can no longer be completed.

zh-CN.description: 应用发起支付宝付款时，WenjieGithub 的 Android Auth Library 会打开此界面，并接收支付宝返回应用的结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此库完成支付宝付款。

en.description: The Zhongruan Gaoke (CshtZrgk) passport OCR SDK opens this camera screen when the app starts a document scan through its older camera path. It shows a live preview and passes a captured image to the document recognition flow.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot complete document scans through this camera path.

zh-CN.description: 应用通过旧式相机流程启动证件扫描时，中软高科（CshtZrgk）护照 OCR SDK 会打开此相机页面。页面显示实时预览，并将采集的画面交给证件识别流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法通过此相机流程完成证件扫描。

en.description: The Zhongruan Gaoke (CshtZrgk) passport OCR SDK opens this camera screen when the app starts a scan. It analyzes camera frames for document text and returns the recognized text to the app.

en.description: When the user pays through UC Pay, this Activity displays the payment screen and returns the outcome to the payment SDK.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it can interrupt payment or checkout flows and prevent a purchase from completing.

zh-CN.description: 用户通过 UC Pay 付款时，这个 Activity 会显示支付页面，并将支付结果返回给支付 SDK。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，支付或结账流程可能中断，导致购买无法完成。

en.description: UC Pay starts this background Service to begin its service work and signals the SDK when that work ends.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it can stop UC Pay tasks that the app needs for payment flows.

zh-CN.description: UC Pay 会启动这个后台 Service 来开始支付 SDK 的服务任务，并在任务结束时通知 SDK。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，应用支付流程依赖的 UC Pay 任务可能无法运行。

en.description: When the app opens Udesk customer support, this screen connects to an agent and displays live messages, conversation history, and support actions such as attachments or leaving a message.
en.disableEffect: Udesk live support chat and its message, attachment, and follow-up actions will be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开 Udesk 客服后，此页面会连接客服人员并显示实时消息、聊天记录，以及发送附件或留言等客服操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Udesk 在线客服聊天及其消息、附件和后续联系功能将无法使用。

en.description: When the user chooses to send feedback or leave a message, Udesk opens its feedback form inside the app.
en.disableEffect: Users will no longer be able to submit the Udesk feedback or leave-message form in the app.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择提交反馈或留言时，Udesk 会在应用内打开反馈表单。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在应用内提交 Udesk 反馈或留言表单。

en.description: When a user opens Udesk's help center, this screen lists help articles and lets the user search for answers.
en.disableEffect: The Udesk help article list and search will not open.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 Udesk 帮助中心时，此页面会列出帮助文章并允许搜索问题答案。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Udesk 帮助文章列表和搜索功能将无法打开。

en.description: The Udesk help center opens this screen after an article is selected; it fetches and displays that article's content.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to read Udesk help articles in the app.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Udesk 帮助中心选择文章后，此页面会获取并显示文章内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在应用内阅读 Udesk 帮助文章。

en.description: When Udesk support asks the user to choose a team, this screen lists agent groups and opens a chat for the selected group.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to choose a support team or start the matching Udesk chat.

zh-CN.description: Udesk 客服要求用户选择服务团队时，此页面会列出客服组，并为选中的客服组开启聊天。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法选择客服团队或通过 Udesk 开启对应的聊天。

en.description: Udesk opens this screen when a support link should load inside the app; it displays the supplied page in an in-app browser.
en.disableEffect: Support links assigned to Udesk's in-app browser will not open there.

zh-CN.description: Udesk 需要在应用内打开客服链接时会显示此页面，并在内置浏览器中加载指定网页。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 交由 Udesk 应用内浏览器打开的客服链接将无法在此处显示。

en.description: Udesk opens this screen from an image in a support conversation so the user can enlarge it and save it to the device.
en.disableEffect: Images in Udesk conversations can no longer be enlarged or saved from this screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Udesk 客服对话中打开图片时，此页面可放大图片并将其保存到设备。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此页面放大或保存 Udesk 对话中的图片。

en.description: Udesk opens a work-order page from the support conversation and loads it with the user's support details.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to open or submit work-order pages through Udesk.

zh-CN.description: Udesk 会从客服对话中打开工单页面，并附上用户的客服请求信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 Udesk 打开或提交工单页面。

en.description: When the user chooses to attach new media in Udesk chat, this screen opens the camera and returns a captured photo or video to the conversation.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to capture and attach photos or videos from Udesk chat.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择在 Udesk 聊天中添加新媒体时，此页面会打开相机，并将拍摄的照片或视频返回到对话中。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在 Udesk 聊天中拍摄并添加照片或视频。

en.description: This Udesk screen opens from chat to browse the phone's photos and videos and select items to send as attachments.
en.disableEffect: Users will lose the Udesk gallery picker for message attachments.

zh-CN.description: Udesk 聊天会打开此页面浏览手机中的照片和视频，并选择要作为附件发送的内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法使用 Udesk 相册选择器为消息添加附件。

en.description: Udesk opens this screen to play a video while the user previews media for a support-message attachment.
en.disableEffect: Videos can no longer be previewed or played from the Udesk attachment flow.

zh-CN.description: 用户预览要附加到客服消息中的媒体时，Udesk 会通过此页面播放视频。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在 Udesk 附件流程中预览或播放视频。

en.description: This Udesk screen previews selected photos and videos and lets the user choose which items to send with a support message.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to review and confirm media selected for a Udesk support message.

zh-CN.description: 此 Udesk 页面会预览已选的照片和视频，并允许用户选择要随客服消息发送的内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法检查并确认要发送给 Udesk 客服的媒体。

en.description: The Udesk customer-support UI uses this provider to give chat photos and documents a shareable content link for opening or sending.
en.disableEffect: Udesk photo or file attachments may fail to open or upload.

zh-CN.description: Udesk 客服界面通过此 Provider 为聊天中的照片和文档创建可分享的内容链接，以便打开或发送。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Udesk 中的照片或文件附件可能无法打开或上传。

en.description: The CNLIVE VLion ad SDK uses this receiver after Android reports that an advertised app has downloaded or been installed. It checks the downloaded package, opens the system installer, and reports the download or install result back to VLion.
en.disableEffect: VLion app-download ads will stop opening their installer and reporting install completion, while the host app's own screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: Android 报告广告应用已下载或安装后，CNLIVE 的 VLion 广告 SDK 会使用此接收器。它检查下载的安装包、打开系统安装界面，并把下载或安装结果交回 VLion。
zh-CN.disableEffect: VLion 的应用下载广告将不再打开安装界面或报告安装完成，但宿主应用自身的界面仍可使用。

en.description: Vlion VL46 ad SDK opens this screen to display a full-screen interstitial ad when the app requests one.
en.disableEffect: Vlion interstitial ads will not be displayed.

zh-CN.description: Vlion VL46 广告 SDK 在应用请求插屏广告时打开此页面，显示全屏广告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Vlion 插屏广告将无法显示。

en.description: Vlion VL46 ad SDK opens this screen to display a rewarded video ad when the app requests one.
en.disableEffect: Rewarded ads will not open, and users will no longer receive rewards for watching them.

zh-CN.description: Vlion VL46 广告 SDK 在应用请求激励视频时打开此页面，显示视频广告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 激励广告将无法打开，用户观看广告后也不会再获得奖励。

en.description: Vlion VL46 ad SDK uses this provider to give Android's installer access to downloaded APK files.
en.disableEffect: Installing an app downloaded through a Vlion ad may fail.

zh-CN.description: Vlion VL46 广告 SDK 使用此 Provider 将下载的 APK 文件交给 Android 安装程序。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过 Vlion 广告下载的应用可能无法安装。

en.description: VLion starts this screen when it has a video ad to display. It plays the ad, reports playback and click events, and opens the ad's landing page or end card when clicked or finished.
en.disableEffect: VLion video ads and their click-through pages will not display; the host app's ordinary features remain available.

zh-CN.description: VLion 有视频广告需要展示时会打开此界面。它播放广告、报告播放和点击事件，并在用户点击或视频结束时打开广告落地页或结束页。
zh-CN.disableEffect: VLion 视频广告及其点击后的页面将不再显示，但宿主应用的日常功能仍可使用。

en.description: VLion uses this alternate video screen to play an ad, with close and mute controls. When the viewer clicks the ad or playback ends, it can open the ad's landing page or end card.
en.disableEffect: VLion video ads and their landing pages will not display; the host app's ordinary features remain available.

zh-CN.description: VLion 使用此备用视频界面播放广告，并提供关闭和静音控制。用户点击广告或视频播放结束时，界面可以打开广告落地页或结束页。
zh-CN.disableEffect: VLion 视频广告及其落地页将不再显示，但宿主应用的日常功能仍可使用。

en.description: After a VLion ad is clicked or its video ends, this screen displays the ad's HTML end page or landing page and handles links the viewer taps.
en.disableEffect: VLion ad end cards and landing pages will not open, though the host app's regular screens can continue to work.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击 VLion 广告或视频播放结束后，此界面会显示广告的 HTML 结束页或落地页，并处理用户点击的链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: VLion 广告结束页和落地页将无法打开，但宿主应用的常规界面仍可继续使用。

en.description: WanderSnail Commons uses this provider to share files and pass APK files to Android's installer through file URIs.
en.disableEffect: File sharing and APK installation through WanderSnail utilities may fail.

zh-CN.description: WanderSnail Commons 使用此 Provider 通过文件 URI 分享文件，并将 APK 文件交给 Android 安装程序。
zh-CN.disableEffect: WanderSnail 工具中的文件分享和 APK 安装可能失败。

en.description: WanderSnail File Selector opens this screen to browse folders and return selected file paths when the app requests a file.
en.disableEffect: The app's file selection screen will no longer open or return selected files.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求选择文件时，WanderSnail File Selector 会打开此页面供用户浏览文件夹并返回所选文件路径。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法打开文件选择页面或取得所选文件。

en.description: YanjingTP Utils relies on this provider to initialize the shared app context used by its app, device, file, and media helpers.
en.disableEffect: Utilities that depend on the shared app context may fail or break app features that use them.

zh-CN.description: YanjingTP Utils 依赖此 Provider 初始化共享应用上下文，供应用、设备、文件和媒体工具使用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖共享应用上下文的工具可能失败，并影响使用这些工具的应用功能。

en.description: YuanFengShan AppUpdate uses this file-sharing component to give Android’s package installer access to a downloaded APK when the user installs an update.
en.disableEffect: Android’s installer will not be able to read the downloaded APK through this provider, so installing an in-app update will fail.

zh-CN.description: 用户安装更新时，YuanFengShan AppUpdate 会通过此文件共享组件向 Android 安装程序提供已下载 APK 的访问权限。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Android 安装程序将无法通过此 Provider 读取 APK，因此应用内更新无法完成安装。

en.description: When YuanFengShan AppUpdate starts an update, this service downloads the new APK, reports progress in a notification, and hands the finished file to Android’s installer.
en.disableEffect: The app will not be able to download and install updates through YuanFengShan AppUpdate.

zh-CN.description: YuanFengShan AppUpdate 启动更新时，此 Service 会下载新版 APK，通过通知显示进度，并将完成的文件交给 Android 安装程序。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法通过 YuanFengShan AppUpdate 下载并安装更新。

en.description: The Sensors Analytics Android SDK, distributed in the Yunxi package, initializes local analytics storage through this provider and stores, reads, or removes event data.
en.disableEffect: Sensors Analytics event data and settings will no longer be stored or retrieved through this provider.

zh-CN.description: 随 Yunxi 软件包分发的 Sensors Analytics Android SDK 会通过此内容提供器初始化本地分析数据存储，并保存、读取或删除事件数据。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Sensors Analytics 将无法通过此提供器保存或读取事件数据和设置。

en.description: The Yunxi Analytics Android SDK initializes its local event database through this provider and uses it to store, query, or delete analytics records.
en.disableEffect: Yunxi Analytics event records will no longer be available through this provider.

zh-CN.description: Yunxi Analytics Android SDK 会通过此内容提供器初始化本地事件数据库，并用它保存、查询或删除分析记录。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Yunxi Analytics 将无法通过此提供器访问事件记录。

en.description: The YYXXGame YYXX Comm SDK opens this Activity for HNQJ account sign-in or account switching; it displays phone and account login or registration screens.
en.disableEffect: Players cannot complete HNQJ sign-in or account switching through the YYXX Comm SDK.

zh-CN.description: YYXXGame 的 YYXX 通信 SDK 在玩家使用 HNQJ 账号登录或切换账号时打开此 Activity；它显示手机号、账号登录或注册界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，玩家无法通过 YYXX 通信 SDK 完成 HNQJ 登录或切换账号。

en.description: The YYXXGame YYXX Comm SDK opens this Activity for HNYY account sign-in or account switching; it displays phone and account login or registration screens.
en.disableEffect: Players cannot complete HNYY sign-in or account switching through the YYXX Comm SDK.

zh-CN.description: YYXXGame 的 YYXX 通信 SDK 在玩家使用 HNYY 账号登录或切换账号时打开此 Activity；它显示手机号、账号登录或注册界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，玩家无法通过 YYXX 通信 SDK 完成 HNYY 登录或切换账号。

en.description: The YYXXGame YYXX Comm SDK opens this Activity for SHXY account sign-in or account switching; it displays phone and account login or registration screens.
en.disableEffect: Players cannot complete SHXY sign-in or account switching through the YYXX Comm SDK.

zh-CN.description: YYXXGame 的 YYXX 通信 SDK 在玩家使用 SHXY 账号登录或切换账号时打开此 Activity；它显示手机号、账号登录或注册界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，玩家无法通过 YYXX 通信 SDK 完成 SHXY 登录或切换账号。

en.description: The YYXXGame YYXX Comm SDK opens this Activity for XinRui account sign-in or account switching; it displays phone and account login or registration screens.
en.disableEffect: Players cannot complete XinRui sign-in or account switching through the YYXX Comm SDK.

zh-CN.description: YYXXGame 的 YYXX 通信 SDK 在玩家使用 XinRui 账号登录或切换账号时打开此 Activity；它显示手机号、账号登录或注册界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，玩家无法通过 YYXX 通信 SDK 完成 XinRui 登录或切换账号。

en.description: The YYXXGame YYXX Comm SDK opens this shared sign-in screen when a player logs in or switches accounts; it presents phone or account login, registration, password recovery, and account switching.
en.disableEffect: The YYXX Comm account sign-in and account-switching screen cannot open.

zh-CN.description: YYXXGame 的 YYXX 通信 SDK 在玩家登录或切换账号时打开此登录界面；界面提供手机号或账号登录、注册、找回密码和切换账号选项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，YYXX 通信 SDK 的账号登录和切换账号界面无法打开。

en.description: The Eyuan (YYXXGame) game communication SDK binds this Service to display a floating menu on the game screen; its configured entries open the member center, game-service links, recharge and invitation pages, or account switching.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it removes those floating entries, including the member and recharge links, from the game screen.

zh-CN.description: 易元（YYXXGame）游戏通信 SDK 绑定此 Service，在游戏画面上显示悬浮菜单；菜单中的配置入口可打开会员中心、游戏服务链接、充值和邀请页面，或切换账号。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，游戏画面上的悬浮菜单及其会员、充值等入口会消失。

en.description: The Eyuan (YYXXGame) game communication SDK opens this Activity when it requests player sign-in; it displays the SDK login screens and returns the sign-in result to the calling game.
en.disableEffect: The Eyuan communication SDK sign-in screen cannot open, so players cannot finish login through this flow.

zh-CN.description: 易元（YYXXGame）游戏通信 SDK 请求玩家登录时会打开此 Activity；它显示 SDK 登录界面，并把登录结果返回给调用它的游戏。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，易元通信 SDK 的登录界面无法打开，玩家不能通过这条流程完成登录。

en.description: The Eyuan (YYXXGame) game SDK opens this Activity with a page address when a game feature needs an in-game web page; it displays the page, handles links and file selection, and passes page actions back to the game.
en.disableEffect: Game features that use these web pages, including their links or file selection, will not work.

zh-CN.description: 易元（YYXXGame）游戏 SDK 在游戏功能需要打开网页时，会把页面地址交给此 Activity；它显示游戏内网页、处理链接和文件选择，并把页面操作传回游戏。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖这些网页的游戏功能将无法使用，其中包括网页链接和文件选择。

en.description: The Eyuan (YYXXGame) game SDK opens this Activity when a player opens the member center; it hosts the member screens and their in-app navigation.
en.disableEffect: Players cannot open or navigate the Eyuan game SDK member center.

zh-CN.description: 玩家打开易元（YYXXGame）游戏 SDK 的会员中心时会进入此 Activity；它承载会员界面及界面内的页面切换。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 玩家无法打开或浏览易元游戏 SDK 的会员中心。

en.description: The Eyuan (YYXXGame) game SDK binds this Service to show its draggable floating menu; configured entries open the member center, support, gift, recharge, and invitation pages.
en.disableEffect: The floating menu and its member, support, gift, and recharge entry points disappear.

zh-CN.description: 易元（YYXXGame）游戏 SDK 绑定此 Service 来显示可拖动的悬浮菜单；菜单入口可打开会员中心、客服、礼包、充值和邀请页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，悬浮菜单以及会员、客服、礼包和充值入口会消失。

en.description: The Eyuan (YYXXGame) game SDK opens this Activity when a player signs in or switches accounts; it displays the game SDK login screen and handles the login result.
en.disableEffect: Players cannot complete sign-in or account switching through the Eyuan game SDK flow.

zh-CN.description: 易元（YYXXGame）游戏 SDK 在玩家登录或切换账号时打开此 Activity；它显示游戏 SDK 登录界面并处理登录结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 玩家无法通过易元游戏 SDK 流程完成登录或切换账号。

en.description: The YYXXGame shared support SDK starts this Activity when it requests app permissions; it checks the requested permissions, opens Android's permission prompt or Settings, and returns the results.
en.disableEffect: SDK permission requests cannot complete, so game features that need those permissions may be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: YYXXGame 通用支持 SDK 在请求应用权限时启动此 Activity；它检查所需权限、打开 Android 权限提示或系统设置，并返回检查结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: SDK 的权限申请流程无法完成，因此需要这些权限的游戏功能可能无法使用。

en.description: Android creates this Provider when the app starts; the YYXXGame YLink instant-messaging SDK initializes its conversation and attachment functions here.
en.disableEffect: YLink messaging will not initialize, so conversations and message attachments will not work.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时 Android 会创建此 Provider；YYXXGame 的 YLink 即时通信 SDK 在此初始化聊天和附件发送功能。
zh-CN.disableEffect: YLink 消息功能无法初始化，聊天和消息附件将无法使用。

en.description: The YYXXGame YLink instant-messaging SDK opens this Activity when a player attaches a photo or video to a conversation; it launches Android's media picker and returns the selected item to the chat.
en.disableEffect: Players cannot select photos or videos to attach to YLink conversations.

zh-CN.description: 玩家在 YYXXGame 的 YLink 即时通信 SDK 聊天中添加照片或视频时，SDK 会打开此 Activity；它启动 Android 媒体选择器，并把选中的内容返回给聊天界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 玩家无法选择照片或视频作为 YLink 聊天附件。

en.description: Android creates this older Provider at app startup to configure the YYXXGame YLink SDK's compressed diagnostic log files; without it, YLink logs fall back to Android's system log.
en.disableEffect: The YLink SDK will no longer save its rolling diagnostic files, though it can still write messages to Android's system log.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时 Android 会创建旧版 Provider，用于配置 YYXXGame YLink SDK 的压缩诊断日志文件；没有它时，YLink 日志会改为写入 Android 系统日志。
zh-CN.disableEffect: YLink SDK 不再保存滚动诊断日志文件，但仍可向 Android 系统日志写入信息。

en.description: The YYXXGame YLink instant-messaging SDK opens this Activity when a player attaches a photo or video to a conversation; it launches Android's media picker and returns the selected item to the chat.
en.disableEffect: Players cannot select photos or videos to attach to YLink conversations.

zh-CN.description: 玩家在 YYXXGame 的 YLink 即时通信 SDK 聊天中添加照片或视频时，SDK 会打开此 Activity；它启动 Android 媒体选择器，并把选中的内容返回给聊天界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 玩家无法选择照片或视频作为 YLink 聊天附件。

en.description: The Acoustic Mobile Push SDK sends queued user-profile and delivery-channel attribute changes to Acoustic after registration.
en.disableEffect: The SDK's attribute updates may stop reaching Acoustic, while the app's own screens and data remain available.

zh-CN.description: Acoustic Mobile Push SDK 会在应用完成注册后，将排队等待的用户资料和推送渠道属性变更发送到 Acoustic。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，SDK 的属性更新可能无法送达 Acoustic，但应用自身的页面和数据仍可使用。

en.description: The Acoustic Mobile Push SDK checks tracked beacon settings every minute and starts Bluetooth scanning when saved beacon regions need monitoring.
en.disableEffect: Acoustic beacon-based location features may stop detecting nearby beacons, while the app's other features remain available.

zh-CN.description: Acoustic Mobile Push SDK 每分钟检查一次已跟踪的信标设置，并在需要监测已保存区域时启动蓝牙扫描。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Acoustic 基于信标的位置功能可能无法检测附近信标，但应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: When Acoustic location tracking is enabled, the SDK scans nearby Bluetooth signals on a schedule to detect tracked beacons.

zh-CN.disableEffect: 此演示加法页面将无法打开。

en.description: When the user removes the app from the recent-apps list, Lemnisk's engagement SDK runs this service and clears posted notifications.
en.disableEffect: Notifications may remain in the notification shade after the app is dismissed.

zh-CN.description: 用户从最近使用的应用列表中移除应用时，Lemnisk 用户互动 SDK 会运行此服务并清除已发布的通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用被移除后，通知可能仍留在通知栏中。

en.description: At app startup, Lemnisk's engagement SDK uses this provider to start analytics and automatic setup when enabled. If required setup details are missing, the SDK waits for the app to initialize it explicitly.
en.disableEffect: Lemnisk tracking, campaigns, and push setup will not start automatically unless the app initializes Lemnisk another way.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，Lemnisk 用户互动 SDK 会通过此提供程序启动分析和自动配置；如果缺少必要配置，SDK 会等待应用显式初始化。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 除非应用通过其他方式初始化 Lemnisk，否则其跟踪、营销活动和推送功能不会自动启动。

en.description: When Lemnisk shows an in-app campaign, this screen builds a popup or carousel from the campaign content and records whether it was viewed or dismissed.
en.disableEffect: Lemnisk in-app campaign popups and their links will no longer appear.

zh-CN.description: Lemnisk 展示应用内营销活动时，会打开此页面，根据活动内容生成弹窗或轮播，并记录查看或关闭情况。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Lemnisk 应用内营销弹窗及其中的链接将不再显示。

en.description: When a user taps a Lemnisk push notification or one of its buttons, this screen opens the supplied app link and reports the interaction to Lemnisk.
en.disableEffect: Lemnisk notification taps and button actions will no longer be handled.

zh-CN.description: 用户点按 Lemnisk 推送通知或其中的按钮时，此页面会打开指定的应用链接，并向 Lemnisk 报告这次操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Lemnisk 推送通知的点按和按钮操作将不再处理。

en.description: When a Lemnisk push notification is tapped, acknowledged, closed, or dismissed, this background service opens its app link when appropriate, updates the notification, and sends the event to Lemnisk.
en.disableEffect: Lemnisk push action links and acknowledgement or dismissal updates will stop working.

zh-CN.description: Lemnisk 推送通知被点按、确认、关闭或清除时，此后台服务会在适当情况下打开应用链接、更新通知并将操作上报给 Lemnisk。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Lemnisk 推送通知的链接、确认或清除操作将无法正常处理。

en.description: When an app opens an image by URL or bitmap, the Twitterized PhotoView SDK shows it full-screen with zoom and optional bottom actions; tapping the image toggles the screen controls.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot use this SDK’s full-screen image viewer or any image actions placed in it.

zh-CN.description: 应用通过网址或位图打开图片时，Twitterized PhotoView SDK 会以全屏方式显示图片，支持缩放和可选的底部操作；点按图片可切换屏幕控件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法使用此 SDK 的全屏图片查看器，其中的图片操作也无法使用。

en.description: TPShareLogin opens this screen during QQ sign-in or sharing. It calls QQ's account or sharing flow and returns the result to the host app.
en.disableEffect: QQ sign-in and sharing through TPShareLogin will not complete.

zh-CN.description: 通过 QQ 登录或分享时，TPShareLogin 会打开此页面，调用 QQ 的账号或分享流程，并将结果返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: TPShareLogin 的 QQ 登录和分享将无法完成。

en.description: TPShareLogin opens this screen to authorize with Sina Weibo or post a share, then returns the result to the host app.
en.disableEffect: Sina Weibo sign-in and sharing through TPShareLogin will not complete.

zh-CN.description: 通过 TPShareLogin 使用新浪微博授权或发布分享时，会打开此页面，并将结果返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: TPShareLogin 的新浪微博登录和分享将无法完成。

en.description: TPShareLogin receives WeChat authorization results here, exchanges the returned code for an access token, and retrieves the user's profile.
en.disableEffect: WeChat authorization through TPShareLogin will not return its result to the app.

zh-CN.description: TPShareLogin 在此接收微信授权结果，用返回的代码换取访问令牌，并获取用户资料。
zh-CN.disableEffect: TPShareLogin 的微信授权结果将无法返回给应用。

en.description: When the app process starts, this Provider registers lifecycle tracking so the Meta RTC engine knows when the app moves to the foreground or background.
en.disableEffect: The RTC engine will miss app visibility updates, which can disrupt ongoing voice or video sessions.

zh-CN.description: 应用进程启动时，此 Provider 会注册生命周期跟踪，让 Meta RTC 引擎知道应用何时进入前台或后台。
zh-CN.disableEffect: RTC 引擎将收不到应用可见状态更新，可能影响正在进行的语音或视频会话。
