en.description: When an app starts an identity check through the Ahfz eKYC SDK, this Activity guides the user through mobile entry, ID-card capture, a face liveness check, validation, and signing.
en.disableEffect: The app will not be able to complete identity verification through this SDK.

zh-CN.description: 应用通过 Ahfz eKYC SDK 启动身份核验时，此 Activity 会引导用户填写手机号、拍摄并确认证件、完成活体检测、核验和签署。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法通过此 SDK 完成身份核验。

en.description: When Notix shows an ad as the app opens, this screen displays it and handles the close or click outcome.
en.disableEffect: Notix app-open ads will no longer be shown.

zh-CN.description: Notix 展示应用启动广告时，此全屏页面会显示广告并处理关闭或点按结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Notix 的应用启动广告将不再显示。

en.description: When Notix shows a full-screen ad between app screens, it uses this screen to display the ad and handle the result.
en.disableEffect: Notix interstitial ads will no longer be shown.

zh-CN.description: Notix 展示全屏插页广告时会打开此页面，并加载 SDK 提供的广告位信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Notix 的插页广告将不再显示。

en.description: For a web-based Notix interstitial ad, this screen loads the supplied page or ad content in a WebView.
en.disableEffect: Web-based Notix interstitial ads will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: 展示网页形式的 Notix 插页广告时，此页面会在应用内加载指定网页或广告内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Notix 网页插页广告将无法打开。

en.description: When Notix shows a lock-screen interstitial ad, it uses this screen to display it and report the result.
en.disableEffect: Notix lock-screen interstitial ads will no longer be shown.

zh-CN.description: Notix 展示锁屏插页广告时会打开此页面，显示全屏广告并将结果上报给 Notix。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Notix 的锁屏插页广告将不再显示。

en.description: When a Notix push notification is tapped, this screen passes its click data and event to the app's configured Notix handler, then closes.
en.disableEffect: Notix notification taps will no longer reach the configured handler, so linked actions may not open.

zh-CN.description: 用户点按 Notix 推送通知时，此页面会将点按数据和事件传给应用配置的 Notix 处理程序，然后关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Notix 通知的点按事件将无法传给应用配置的处理程序，相关链接可能无法打开。

en.description: This Notix service receives Firebase push messages and refreshed device tokens and passes them to Notix's push processing.
en.disableEffect: Notix push messages and device-token updates will no longer reach Notix.

zh-CN.description: 此 Notix 服务接收 Firebase 推送消息和更新后的设备令牌，并交由 Notix 处理推送。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Notix 将无法收到推送消息或设备令牌更新。

en.description: On Android 13 and later, Notix opens this screen to request permission to post notifications and receives the user's choice.
en.disableEffect: Notix cannot show its built-in notification permission prompt, so its push messages may stay disabled.

zh-CN.description: 在 Android 13 及更高版本上，Notix 会打开此页面请求发布通知的权限，并接收用户的选择。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Notix 无法显示内置通知权限提示，其推送消息可能会保持关闭。

en.description: The OpenApp smart-lock SDK opens this screen for a selected lock. It connects over Bluetooth and lets the user lock or unlock the device, then returns the operation result.
en.disableEffect: Users will lose the OpenApp screen for operating supported smart locks.

zh-CN.description: OpenApp 智能门锁 SDK 会为选定的门锁打开此页面，通过蓝牙连接并让用户锁定或解锁设备，然后返回操作结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 OpenApp 页面操作受支持的智能门锁。

en.description: The OpenApp smart-lock SDK binds this background service to create and expose its Bluetooth lock controller and send lock-state updates.
en.disableEffect: The app's OpenApp smart-lock connection and lock-control features will stop working.

zh-CN.description: OpenApp 智能门锁 SDK 通过此后台服务创建并提供蓝牙门锁控制器，同时发送门锁状态更新。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用中的 OpenApp 门锁连接和控制功能将无法使用。

en.description: Payload’s Android payments SDK opens this screen when checkout asks for Google Pay; it presents the payment request and returns the result to the app.
en.disableEffect: Google Pay cannot return payment details, so this payment option will not complete.

zh-CN.description: Payload Android 支付 SDK 会在结账选择 Google Pay 时打开此界面，发起付款请求并将结果交回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Google Pay 将无法返回付款信息，因此无法完成此支付方式。

en.description: Paystack’s Android payment SDK opens this form when a card transaction requests address verification; it collects the billing street, city, postal code, and state for the selected country.
en.disableEffect: Card transactions that require address verification cannot submit the billing details and may fail.

zh-CN.description: Paystack Android 支付 SDK 会在银行卡付款需要地址验证时打开此表单，收集所选国家对应的账单街道、城市、邮编和州或省信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要地址验证的银行卡付款将无法提交账单信息，可能无法完成。

en.description: Paystack’s Android payment SDK opens a card authorization page when a charge requires 3-D Secure, then returns the authorization result to the payment flow.
en.disableEffect: Card charges that require this authorization cannot be completed.

zh-CN.description: Paystack Android 支付 SDK 会在银行卡付款需要 3-D Secure 验证时打开授权页面，并将验证结果交回付款流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要此项授权的银行卡付款将无法完成。

en.description: Paystack’s Android payment SDK shows a card form when checkout starts a card payment; it checks the card number, security code, and expiry date before returning the details to the charge flow.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot enter card details through this Paystack flow, so card payments cannot start.

zh-CN.description: Paystack Android 支付 SDK 会在结账进入银行卡付款时显示卡片表单，检查卡号、安全码和有效期，再把资料交回付款流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法通过此 Paystack 流程输入银行卡资料，因此无法开始银行卡付款。

en.description: Paystack’s Android payment SDK asks for a one-time code when a card charge requires OTP verification and returns the code to the charge flow.
en.disableEffect: Card charges that require an OTP cannot pass verification or complete.

zh-CN.description: 银行卡付款需要一次性验证码时，Paystack Android 支付 SDK 会要求用户输入验证码，并将其交回付款流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要一次性验证码的银行卡付款将无法通过验证或完成。

en.description: Paystack’s Android payment SDK asks for the card PIN when a charge needs PIN verification, then returns the entered PIN to the payment flow.
en.disableEffect: Card charges that request a PIN cannot continue through this payment flow.

zh-CN.description: 银行卡付款需要 PIN 验证时，Paystack Android 支付 SDK 会要求用户输入银行卡密码，并将其交回付款流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要 PIN 验证的银行卡付款将无法继续。

en.description: Pisano Feedback opens a native questionnaire when the app starts a feedback flow. Users can move through form pages, choose a language, and submit their answers.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to open or submit this feedback questionnaire.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动反馈流程时，Pisano Feedback 会显示原生问卷。用户可以逐页填写、切换语言并提交回答。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开或提交此反馈问卷。

en.description: When the app opens a configured Pisano feedback flow, this Activity displays its questions and handles language selection.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to open or complete this feedback form.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开 Pisano 配置的反馈流程时，此 Activity 会显示问题表单并处理语言选择。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开或完成此反馈表单。

en.description: Pisano Feedback displays a triggered survey or feedback form inside the app, either full-screen or as a dialog; users can attach an image when the form offers that option.
en.disableEffect: The survey or feedback form will not open or submit, and users cannot add its image attachments.

zh-CN.description: Pisano Feedback 会在应用内显示触发的调查或反馈表单，可全屏或以对话框呈现；表单提供相关选项时，用户还可以附加图片。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 调查或反馈表单将无法打开或提交，用户也无法添加图片附件。

en.description: PushAlert’s Android SDK receives Firebase push messages, processes notification and channel updates, and refreshes the registration token when it changes.
en.disableEffect: PushAlert notifications and their channel or token updates will stop reaching the SDK.

zh-CN.description: PushAlert Android SDK 会接收 Firebase 推送消息、处理通知和渠道更新，并在注册令牌变化时刷新令牌。
zh-CN.disableEffect: PushAlert 通知及其渠道或令牌更新将无法送达 SDK。

en.description: When a PushAlert notification or its action is opened, this Activity records the click and opens its link or delivers the event to the app’s configured notification handler.
en.disableEffect: Tapping a PushAlert notification will no longer open its link or reach the app’s notification handler.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 PushAlert 通知或点击其中的操作时，此 Activity 会记录点击、打开链接，或将事件交给应用配置的通知处理程序。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 点击 PushAlert 通知后将无法打开链接，也无法将事件交给应用的通知处理程序。

en.description: PushAlert opens this screen when requesting push access; it can show an opt-in prompt, request Android notification permission, or take users to the app’s notification settings.
en.disableEffect: PushAlert’s in-app permission prompt and permission handoff will stop working.

zh-CN.description: PushAlert 请求推送权限时会打开此界面，可显示应用内提示、请求 Android 通知权限，或带用户前往应用的通知设置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: PushAlert 的应用内权限提示和权限跳转将无法使用。

en.description: Pushe Datalytics listens for location-setting changes and refreshes the last known location for geofence tracking when GPS is enabled.
en.disableEffect: Pushe location-based geofence events and campaigns may stop updating.

zh-CN.description: Pushe Datalytics 会监听位置设置变化，并在 GPS 开启时刷新地理围栏跟踪所需的最近位置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Pushe 基于位置的地理围栏事件和活动可能不再更新。

en.description: After Android reports an app installation or removal, Pushe Datalytics sends that change to its analytics service.
en.disableEffect: Pushe will no longer receive app installation and removal events.

zh-CN.description: Android 报告应用安装或卸载后，Pushe Datalytics 会将该变化发送给其分析服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Pushe 将不再收到应用安装和卸载事件。

en.description: Pushe’s Firebase push service receives messages addressed to Pushe and handles new registration tokens and incoming push messages.
en.disableEffect: Pushe notifications delivered through Firebase and their token updates will stop working.

zh-CN.description: Pushe 的 Firebase 推送服务会接收发给 Pushe 的消息，并处理新的注册令牌和收到的推送。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过 Firebase 送达的 Pushe 通知及其令牌更新将无法使用。

en.description: When a geofence event arrives through Firebase, Pushe processes it to update location-triggered notifications or campaigns.
en.disableEffect: Pushe location-triggered notifications and campaigns may stop responding to geofence events.

zh-CN.description: 通过 Firebase 收到地理围栏事件时，Pushe 会处理该事件以更新基于位置的通知或活动。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Pushe 的位置触发通知和活动可能不再响应地理围栏事件。

en.description: On devices using Huawei Push, Pushe receives push messages and registration-token changes for its notification service.
en.disableEffect: Pushe notifications delivered through Huawei Push and their token updates will stop working.

zh-CN.description: 在使用华为推送的设备上，Pushe 会为其通知服务接收推送消息和注册令牌变更。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过华为推送送达的 Pushe 通知及其令牌更新将无法使用。

en.description: On devices using Huawei location services, Pushe processes geofence events that can trigger location-based messages.
en.disableEffect: Pushe location-triggered messages may stop responding to Huawei geofence events.

zh-CN.description: 在使用华为定位服务的设备上，Pushe 会处理可触发位置消息的地理围栏事件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Pushe 的位置触发消息可能不再响应华为地理围栏事件。

en.description: At app startup, this Pushe provider automatically initializes Pushe Plus and its registered messaging, notification, analytics, and location modules.
en.disableEffect: Pushe’s automatic initialization will stop, so its push, notification, analytics, and geofence services will not start.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，此 Pushe 内容提供程序会自动初始化 Pushe Plus 及已注册的消息推送、通知、分析和定位模块。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Pushe 将无法自动初始化，其推送、通知、分析和地理围栏服务也不会启动。

en.description: After the app is updated, Pushe LogCollection resumes its log collection and upload work.
en.disableEffect: Pushe’s log collection will not resume automatically after an app update.

zh-CN.description: 应用更新后，Pushe LogCollection 会恢复日志收集和上传任务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用更新后，Pushe 的日志收集将无法自动恢复。

en.description: After the app is updated, Pushe LogCollection resumes its log collection and upload work.
en.disableEffect: Pushe’s log collection will not resume automatically after an app update.

zh-CN.description: 应用更新后，Pushe LogCollection 会恢复日志收集和上传任务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用更新后，Pushe 的日志收集将无法自动恢复。

en.description: When users tap a button or action on a Pushe notification, this service processes the choice and reports the interaction to Pushe.
en.disableEffect: Pushe notification buttons and their click tracking will stop working.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击 Pushe 通知中的按钮或操作时，此服务会处理选择并向 Pushe 上报互动记录。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Pushe 通知按钮及其点击记录将无法使用。

en.description: When a user taps a Pushe download-complete notification, this receiver continues the pending app-install flow using the downloaded file.
en.disableEffect: Tapping a Pushe download-complete notice will no longer continue that app’s installation.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击 Pushe 下载完成通知时，此接收器会使用已下载的文件继续应用安装流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 点击 Pushe 下载完成通知后，将无法继续安装该应用。

en.description: When an app downloaded through Pushe’s notification installer finishes, this receiver posts a completion notice and prepares the pending install check.
en.disableEffect: Pushe will not show or process the download-complete notice for that app.

zh-CN.description: 通过 Pushe 通知安装器下载的应用完成后，此接收器会显示完成通知并准备后续安装检查。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Pushe 将无法显示或处理该应用的下载完成通知。

en.description: When a scheduled Pushe notification is due, this receiver reads the saved message and displays it.
en.disableEffect: Scheduled Pushe notifications will not be displayed.

zh-CN.description: 到达设定时间时，此接收器会读取已保存的 Pushe 通知并将其显示。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 设定时间到达时，Pushe 通知将无法显示。

en.description: When a Pushe message requests an in-app dialog, this Activity displays its text and buttons and processes the user’s selection.
en.disableEffect: Pushe in-app dialog messages and their actions will not appear.

zh-CN.description: Pushe 消息要求显示应用内弹窗时，此 Activity 会展示文本和按钮，并处理用户的选择。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Pushe 的应用内弹窗消息及其操作将无法显示。

en.description: When a Pushe notification opens a web page or form, this Activity displays it inside the app and sends any form response back to Pushe.
en.disableEffect: Pushe web pages and forms will not open or return responses.

zh-CN.description: Pushe 通知打开网页或表单时，此 Activity 会在应用内显示页面，并将表单答复发送给 Pushe。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Pushe 网页和表单将无法打开或返回答复。

en.description: After Android reports that the device has restarted, Pushe receives the boot signal used to resume its scheduled background work.
en.disableEffect: Scheduled Pushe notifications and background tasks may not resume after a device restart.

zh-CN.description: 设备重启后，Pushe 会收到系统启动信号，以恢复已安排的后台任务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 设备重启后，Pushe 的定时通知和后台任务可能无法恢复。

en.description: ReachFive Identity opens an authorization page in a browser tab or embedded page for sign-in, sign-out, and web-based passkey flows, then returns the result to the app.
en.disableEffect: ReachFive web sign-in, sign-out, and supported passkey flows cannot finish.

zh-CN.description: ReachFive Identity 会在浏览器标签页或应用内页面打开授权页面，用于登录、退出登录和网页通行密钥流程，再将结果返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: ReachFive 的网页登录、退出登录和受支持的通行密钥流程将无法完成。

en.description: When users choose WeChat sign-in, ReachFive Identity opens WeChat and requests an authorization code to return the login result to the app.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to sign in through WeChat with ReachFive.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择微信登录时，ReachFive Identity 会打开微信并请求授权码，再将登录结果返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 ReachFive 使用微信登录。

en.description: When WeChat returns from a ReachFive sign-in, this Activity receives the response and sends the authorization code, cancellation, or error back to the app.
en.disableEffect: WeChat sign-in cannot return its authorization result, so that login option will fail.

zh-CN.description: 微信返回 ReachFive 登录流程后，此 Activity 会接收响应，并将授权码、取消或错误状态交回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 微信登录无法返回授权结果，因此该登录方式将失败。

en.description: When the Rover SDK needs location access for nearby beacon experiences, this Activity asks Android for fine-location permission and starts or stops Rover monitoring based on the user choice.
en.disableEffect: Rover cannot request location permission here, so nearby and location-triggered Rover content will not start; the rest of the app remains available.

zh-CN.description: Rover SDK 需要定位权限来提供附近的信标体验时，此 Activity 会向 Android 请求精确位置权限，并根据用户的选择启动或停止 Rover 监测。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Rover 无法在此请求定位权限，因此附近及位置触发的内容无法启动；应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: Started with the Rover experience configuration, this Service monitors visits and locations, fetches nearby geofences, and delivers the SDK location-triggered cards and notifications.
en.disableEffect: Rover stops detecting visits and delivering nearby cards or notifications; the host app's other screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: Rover SDK 使用应用的体验配置启动此 Service 后，它会监测到访和位置、获取附近的地理围栏，并投递位置触发的卡片和通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Rover 将停止检测到访并投递附近卡片或通知；应用的其他界面仍可使用。

en.description: When Rover queues an event such as a card view or click, this background Service sends the event to Rover's server.
en.disableEffect: Rover will stop recording these interactions, while its cards and the host app's other functions remain available.

zh-CN.description: Rover 记录卡片查看或点击等事件时，会启动此后台 Service 将事件发送到 Rover 服务器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Rover 将不再记录这些互动，但卡片及应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: When the Rover SDK needs location access for nearby beacon experiences, this Activity asks Android for fine-location permission and starts or stops Rover monitoring based on the user choice.
en.disableEffect: Rover cannot request location permission here, so nearby and location-triggered Rover content will not start; the rest of the app remains available.

zh-CN.description: Rover SDK 需要定位权限来提供附近的信标体验时，此 Activity 会向 Android 请求精确位置权限，并根据用户的选择启动或停止 Rover 监测。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Rover 无法在此请求定位权限，因此附近及位置触发的内容无法启动；应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: When a Rover notification is canceled, this Receiver clears notifications of the matching Rover type from the notification tray.
en.disableEffect: A canceled Rover notification may remain in the notification tray because the SDK cannot clear it through this Receiver.

zh-CN.description: Rover 通知被取消时，此 Receiver 会从通知栏清除相同类别的 Rover 通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，被取消的 Rover 通知可能仍留在通知栏中。

en.description: Opened when a user selects a Rover card, this Activity renders its text, images, barcode, buttons, and web content; tapping a card link opens that destination.
en.disableEffect: Rover card details and their links will not open, while unrelated app screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择 Rover 卡片时，此 Activity 会显示卡片的文字、图片、条码、按钮和网页内容；点击卡片链接会打开对应页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Rover 卡片详情及其链接无法打开，但应用的其他界面仍可使用。

en.description: Opened from the Rover card feed or a card notification, this Activity lists cards stored for the selected deck and lets the user open a card.
en.disableEffect: The Rover card feed will not be available, while unrelated app screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: 用户从 Rover 卡片动态或卡片通知进入时，此 Activity 会列出所选卡组中保存的卡片，并允许用户打开卡片。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Rover 卡片动态将无法打开，但应用的其他界面仍可使用。

en.description: When Google location services report that a monitored geofence was entered or left, this Service forwards the transition to the Rover Estimote SDK.
en.disableEffect: Rover will not react to monitored geofence entry or exit, so nearby location messages may stop.

zh-CN.description: Google 定位服务报告进入或离开已监测地理围栏时，此 Service 会将变化转交给 Rover Estimote SDK。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Rover 将无法响应已监测地理围栏的进出事件，附近的位置消息可能停止。

en.description: When the older Rover Estimote integration receives a fused-location update, this Service forwards the latest location to Rover's location manager.
en.disableEffect: Rover cannot update visits from these location callbacks, so location-triggered messages may not appear.

zh-CN.description: 较早版本的 Rover Estimote 集成收到融合定位更新时，此 Service 会将最新位置转交给 Rover 的位置管理器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Rover 无法根据这些定位回调更新到访记录，因此位置触发的消息可能不会出现。

en.description: When Rover Estimote receives a fused-location update, this Service forwards the latest location to Rover's location manager.
en.disableEffect: Rover cannot update visits from these location callbacks, so location-triggered messages may not appear.

zh-CN.description: Rover Estimote 收到融合定位更新时，此 Service 会将最新位置转交给 Rover 的位置管理器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Rover 无法根据这些定位回调更新到访记录，因此位置触发的消息可能不会出现。

en.description: Started by the Rover Estimote SDK, this Service combines location updates with beacon visits, fetches nearby geofences, and monitors them for location-triggered cards.
en.disableEffect: Rover Estimote will stop monitoring location visits and nearby geofences, so its location-triggered cards will not arrive.

zh-CN.description: Rover Estimote SDK 启动此 Service 后，它会结合定位更新和信标到访、获取附近的地理围栏，并监测位置触发的卡片。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Rover Estimote 将停止监测位置到访和附近地理围栏，因此不会再收到它的位置触发卡片。

en.description: When Bluetooth changes state, this Receiver starts Rover monitoring when Bluetooth turns on and stops it when Bluetooth turns off.
en.disableEffect: Bluetooth changes will no longer start or stop Rover beacon monitoring, so nearby Rover content may remain inactive.

zh-CN.description: 蓝牙状态变化时，此 Receiver 会在蓝牙开启后启动 Rover 监测，并在蓝牙关闭后停止监测。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，蓝牙状态变化将不再启停 Rover 信标监测，因此附近 Rover 内容可能无法启用。

en.description: When Rover starts, this Service monitors Estimote beacon regions, records visits and touchpoints, and loads associated Rover cards and notifications.
en.disableEffect: Rover will stop detecting beacon visits and delivering their cards or notifications; the host app's other screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: Rover 启动时，此 Service 会监测 Estimote 信标区域、记录到访和触点，并加载关联的 Rover 卡片及通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Rover 将停止检测信标到访并投递相关卡片或通知；应用的其他界面仍可使用。

en.description: When Rover queues an event such as a card view or click, this background Service sends the event to Rover's server.
en.disableEffect: Rover will stop recording these interactions, while its cards and the host app's other functions remain available.

zh-CN.description: Rover 记录卡片查看或点击等事件时，会启动此后台 Service 将事件发送到 Rover 服务器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Rover 将不再记录这些互动，但卡片及应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: When the app opens a Rover visit card, this Activity shows the first card's title and ID with an OK button.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open this Rover card screen, while the host app's other screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开 Rover 到访卡片时，此 Activity 会显示第一张卡片的标题和编号，并提供确认按钮。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法打开此 Rover 卡片界面，但应用的其他界面仍可使用。

en.description: When the app opens the Rover card list, this Activity displays cards for the latest visit's current touchpoint.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open the Rover current-touchpoint card list, while the host app's other screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开 Rover 卡片列表时，此 Activity 会显示最近一次到访当前触点中的卡片。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法打开 Rover 当前触点的卡片列表，但应用的其他界面仍可使用。

en.description: Opened when a user selects a Rover card, this Activity renders its text, images, barcode, and buttons; tapping a linked card block opens that destination.
en.disableEffect: Rover card details and their links will not open, while unrelated app screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择 Rover 卡片时，此 Activity 会显示卡片的文字、图片、条码和按钮；点击带链接的卡片内容会打开对应页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Rover 卡片详情及其链接无法打开，但应用的其他界面仍可使用。

en.description: Opened for a Rover touchpoint, this Activity lists its stored cards and lets the user open a card.
en.disableEffect: The Rover card feed will not be available, while unrelated app screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: 用户进入 Rover 触点时，此 Activity 会列出该触点保存的卡片，并允许用户打开卡片。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Rover 卡片动态将无法打开，但应用的其他界面仍可使用。

en.description: When the SaltPay/Teya ePOS integration shares a cached file with another app, this Provider exposes the file through a temporary content link.
en.disableEffect: File handoff through the Teya integration becomes unavailable and a payment flow that needs it can fail.

zh-CN.description: SaltPay/Teya ePOS 集成需要向其他应用分享缓存文件时，此 Provider 会通过临时内容链接提供该文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Teya 集成将无法交接文件，依赖该交接的支付流程可能失败。

en.description: When the app starts, this Provider sets up Teya's app-visibility tracking for the ePOS integration.
en.disableEffect: The integration loses foreground and background state updates, which can interrupt ePOS requests as the app changes state.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，此 Provider 会为 Teya ePOS 集成设置应用前后台状态跟踪。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 集成将无法收到应用前后台状态更新，应用状态变化时 ePOS 请求可能中断。

en.description: When the Teya terminal sends a response, this Receiver passes the ePOS result back to the requesting app.
en.disableEffect: The requesting app will not receive the terminal result, so its payment may remain incomplete or unresolved.

zh-CN.description: Teya 终端发送响应时，此 Receiver 会将 ePOS 结果传回发起请求的应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 发起请求的应用将收不到终端结果，支付可能无法完成或确认。

en.description: When another app sends an ePOS request, this Receiver validates it, opens the payment app for foreground requests, and dispatches valid background requests.
en.disableEffect: The app will not accept terminal requests, so Teya payment handoffs stop working.

zh-CN.description: 其他应用发送 ePOS 请求时，此 Receiver 会验证请求、为前台请求打开支付应用，并分发有效的后台请求。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法接收终端请求，因此 Teya 支付交接将无法使用。

en.description: When the host app starts a Tamara checkout for an order or checkout link, this Activity opens the payment flow and returns its outcome to the app.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot complete or return from Tamara checkout in the host app.

zh-CN.description: 应用为订单或结账链接启动 Tamara 结账时，此 Activity 会打开支付流程并将结果返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在应用中完成 Tamara 结账或返回支付结果。

en.description: Opened with Thepeer checkout details, this Activity hosts the SDK checkout dialog and its transaction page, then returns the result to the app.
en.disableEffect: The Thepeer checkout cannot open, so the app cannot complete that transaction flow.

zh-CN.description: 使用 Thepeer 结账信息打开时，此 Activity 会承载 SDK 结账对话框和交易页面，并将结果返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Thepeer 结账无法打开，应用也就无法完成该交易流程。

en.description: Opened with Thepeer checkout details, this Activity hosts the SDK checkout screen and returns the transaction outcome to the app.
en.disableEffect: The Thepeer checkout cannot open, so the app cannot complete that transaction flow.

zh-CN.description: 使用 Thepeer 结账信息打开时，此 Activity 会显示 SDK 结账界面，并将交易结果返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Thepeer 结账无法打开，应用也就无法完成该交易流程。

en.description: Opened with Thepeer transaction details, this Activity loads the transaction page and returns success or cancellation to the app.
en.disableEffect: The Thepeer transaction page cannot open or return its result to the app.

zh-CN.description: 使用 Thepeer 交易信息打开时，此 Activity 会加载交易页面，并将成功或取消结果返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Thepeer 交易页面无法打开或向应用返回结果。

en.description: When the phone reads an enabled FreeStyle Libre sensor over NFC, this Activity returns the glucose sensor details to the Terra SDK.
en.disableEffect: Terra cannot read FreeStyle Libre glucose data through this NFC flow.

zh-CN.description: 手机通过 NFC 读取已启用的 FreeStyle Libre 传感器时，此 Activity 会将血糖传感器数据返回 Terra SDK。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Terra 将无法通过此 NFC 流程读取 FreeStyle Libre 血糖数据。

en.description: When opened by the Vacom calling library, this Activity displays a non-cancelable prompt to install Vacom Addon and restart the app before making a video call.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot show the add-on installation prompt, leaving the Vacom video-call flow unavailable.

zh-CN.description: Vacom 通话库打开此 Activity 时，它会显示不可取消的提示，要求安装 Vacom Addon 并重启应用后再进行视频通话。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用无法显示插件安装提示，Vacom 视频通话流程将无法使用。

en.description: The Youverify identity-verification SDK opens this screen for document capture and requests camera access when needed.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot capture identity documents for this Youverify verification flow.

zh-CN.description: Youverify 身份核验 SDK 会在证件采集流程中打开此界面，并在需要时请求相机权限。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在此 Youverify 核验流程中采集身份证件。

en.description: During Youverify identity verification, this Activity lets the user select a country and document type before continuing to capture guidance.
en.disableEffect: The user cannot select a verification document, so this identity-verification flow cannot continue.

zh-CN.description: Youverify 身份验证过程中，此 Activity 让用户选择国家和证件类型，然后继续查看拍摄指引。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法选择验证证件，因此身份验证流程无法继续。

en.description: During Youverify identity verification, this Activity scans a document, checks captured text and images, uploads them, and returns a result or failure.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot capture or submit identity documents through the Youverify verification flow.

zh-CN.description: Youverify 身份验证过程中，此 Activity 会扫描证件、检查拍摄文字和图像、上传资料，并返回结果或失败状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法通过 Youverify 验证流程拍摄或提交身份证件。

en.description: After document selection, this Activity shows capture instructions and opens the document scanner when the user continues.
en.disableEffect: The Youverify flow cannot show its capture instructions or continue through this screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择证件后，此 Activity 会显示拍摄说明，并在用户继续时打开证件扫描界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Youverify 流程无法显示拍摄说明或通过此界面继续。

en.description: When Youverify document verification starts, this Activity shows the configured introduction and opens document selection when the user continues.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot begin the Youverify document-verification flow in the app.

zh-CN.description: Youverify 证件验证启动时，此 Activity 会显示配置的介绍，并在用户继续后打开证件选择界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法在应用中开始 Youverify 证件验证流程。

en.description: After a document scan or upload fails, this Activity shows the failure screen and lets the user choose documents again.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot see the verification failure screen or restart document selection from it.

zh-CN.description: 证件扫描或上传失败后，此 Activity 会显示失败界面，并允许用户重新选择证件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法查看验证失败界面，也无法从此处重新选择证件。

en.description: After document and face capture, this Activity presents the verification result screen and continues to the success screen when the user proceeds.
en.disableEffect: The Youverify flow cannot show this result screen or continue to its success screen.

zh-CN.description: 证件和人脸拍摄完成后，此 Activity 会显示验证结果，并在用户继续时打开成功界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Youverify 流程无法显示此结果界面或继续进入成功界面。

en.description: When Youverify reaches the completion screen, this Activity shows success and returns to the introduction flow when the user closes it.
en.disableEffect: Users will not see the verification completion screen or its close action.

zh-CN.description: Youverify 验证完成时，此 Activity 会显示成功界面，并在用户关闭后返回介绍流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将看不到验证完成界面，也无法使用其关闭操作。

en.description: The Youverify identity-verification SDK opens this screen for a face-liveness check, using the camera during the verification flow.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot complete the camera-based liveness check required by this verification flow.

zh-CN.description: Youverify 身份核验 SDK 会在活体检测流程中打开此界面，并在检测时使用相机。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法完成此核验流程所需的相机活体检测。

en.description: The Youverify verification SDK opens this screen to collect form information and can accept camera or file input requested by the form.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot complete the Youverify form flow that collects this information.

zh-CN.description: Youverify 核验 SDK 会打开此界面收集表单信息，并可按表单要求接收相机或文件输入。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法完成此 Youverify 信息采集表单流程。

en.description: When Youverify opens its configured workflow, this Activity displays the form in a web view, requests camera access when needed, handles file selection, and reports completion or failure to the app.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot complete the configured Youverify form or return its result to the app.

zh-CN.description: Youverify 打开配置的工作流程时，此 Activity 会在网页视图中显示表单、按需请求相机权限、处理文件选择，并向应用返回完成或失败结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法完成配置的 Youverify 表单，也无法将结果返回应用。

en.description: At app startup, the YGAlbum Core (MediaSelector) Provider saves the application instance that the media picker needs later to read albums and files.
en.disableEffect: Without it, the media picker can fail when it tries to load albums or media.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，YGAlbum Core（MediaSelector）的 Provider 会保存媒体选择器之后读取相册和文件所需的应用实例。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，媒体选择器可能因缺少应用实例而无法加载相册或媒体。

en.description: When a user opens an image preview from Zuper Forms (Zupersoft Solutions), this Activity loads the supplied image and displays it full-screen.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to preview images from Zuper Forms.

zh-CN.description: 用户从 Zuper Forms（Zupersoft Solutions）打开图片预览时，此 Activity 会载入指定图片并以全屏方式显示。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法预览 Zuper Forms 中的图片。

en.description: When the host app opens Zuper Forms, this Activity runs the form workflow, including sign-in, form lists, form details, and submission results.
en.disableEffect: Users may be unable to sign in, open, fill out, or submit Zuper forms.

zh-CN.description: 宿主应用打开 Zuper Forms 时，此 Activity 会运行表单流程，包括登录、表单列表、表单详情和提交结果页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户可能无法登录、打开、填写或提交 Zuper 表单。

en.description: Zuper Forms uses this Provider to create Android file links when an attachment must be opened or shared with another app.
en.disableEffect: Files that use this sharing route may no longer open or be shared correctly.

zh-CN.description: Zuper Forms 在需要打开附件或将附件分享给其他应用时，会使用此 Provider 创建 Android 文件链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，通过此方式访问或分享的文件可能无法正常打开或共享。

en.description: The Vest SDK opens this screen when its app requests online content; it loads the requested page in an in-app browser and supports game-style launches.
en.disableEffect: Content and game pages opened through the Vest SDK will not open if this screen is disabled.

zh-CN.description: 应用通过 Vest SDK 请求在线内容时会打开此界面；它在应用内载入网页，也支持游戏内容页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Vest SDK 打开的内容页和游戏页面将无法打开。

en.description: AnyLife's face verification SDK uses this background service during face search to exchange a submitted face image and matching results with the app.
en.disableEffect: The app's face search or matching flow may stop working.

zh-CN.description: AnyLife 人脸验证 SDK 在人脸搜索期间使用此后台服务，与应用交换提交的人脸图像和匹配结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用的人脸搜索或匹配流程可能无法使用。

en.description: AnyLife's face verification SDK uses this Android file provider to make files in the app's configured folders available through temporary file links. The SDK can request these links when a verification step needs a file.
en.disableEffect: Face-verification steps that need to read or share one of these files may fail.

zh-CN.description: AnyLife 人脸验证 SDK 使用此 Android 文件提供程序，通过临时文件链接提供应用已配置目录中的文件；验证步骤需要文件时会使用这些链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，需要读取或共享这些文件的人脸验证步骤可能失败。

en.description: UnitySdk by Gokul Sukumar starts this screen when the app is launched from the phone or Android TV launcher. It displays the app's embedded Unity content and accepts touch and key input.
en.disableEffect: The app's Unity game or interactive content will not launch.

zh-CN.description: Gokul Sukumar 发布的 UnitySdk 会在用户从手机或 Android TV 启动器打开应用时启动此界面。它显示应用内的 Unity 内容，并接收玩家的触控和按键操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 屏蔽后，应用中的 Unity 游戏或交互内容将无法启动。

en.description: When Noober 2.0's debugging dashboard is opened, this Activity displays captured API calls, logs, shared preferences, and app properties. Noober can also open it from its browsable link.
en.disableEffect: Users lose the Noober debugging dashboard and its link-based debugging account switch.

zh-CN.description: 打开 Noober 2.0 的调试面板时，这个 Activity 会显示记录的 API 请求、日志、共享偏好设置和应用属性。用户也可以通过 Noober 的可浏览链接打开它。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开 Noober 调试面板，也无法通过其链接切换调试账号。

en.description: ImageProvider uses this provider for camera capture: it creates a temporary photo location that the camera can write to and return to the app.
en.disableEffect: Taking a photo through ImageProvider may fail or leave the app without the captured image.

zh-CN.description: ImageProvider 在拍照时通过此提供程序创建临时照片位置，让相机可以写入照片并将结果交回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，通过 ImageProvider 拍照可能失败，应用也可能拿不到拍摄的照片。

en.description: SendToPush (DigioAndroid) handles incoming Firebase push messages and displays them as app notifications, updating the app icon badge when a count is included. It runs when Firebase delivers a message for the app.
en.disableEffect: Notifications delivered through SendToPush and their badge updates will stop.

zh-CN.description: SendToPush（DigioAndroid）接收 Firebase 推送消息并将其显示为应用通知；消息包含角标数量时也会更新应用图标角标。Firebase 向应用送达消息时会运行。
zh-CN.disableEffect: SendToPush 的通知将不再显示，相关角标也不会更新。

en.description: SendToPush (DigioAndroid) refreshes the app’s Firebase push token here and passes the new token to the library so the device can stay registered. Firebase starts it when the token changes.
en.disableEffect: SendToPush will not receive refreshed push tokens, so the device cannot keep its push registration current.

zh-CN.description: SendToPush（DigioAndroid）在此刷新应用的 Firebase 推送令牌，并把新令牌交给库以维持设备注册。令牌变化时 Firebase 会启动此服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: SendToPush 无法收到更新后的推送令牌，设备的推送注册将无法保持最新。

en.description: The older SendToPush (DigioAndroid) service registers or unregisters this device with the push server when the app requests that change. It sends app and device details and returns the server result to the app.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot use this older SendToPush flow to register or unregister the device for push.

zh-CN.description: 较早版本的 SendToPush（DigioAndroid）会按应用请求向推送服务器注册或注销此设备，并把服务器结果返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法通过这条较早的 SendToPush 流程注册或注销推送设备。

en.description: When the Adapty in-app purchase SDK presents a visual paywall, this screen displays its configured offer and products and sends purchase or close events back to the SDK.
en.disableEffect: The app’s Adapty paywall and subscription purchase screen cannot be shown.

zh-CN.description: Adapty 应用内购买 SDK 展示可视化付费墙时，此页面会显示已配置的优惠和商品，并将购买或关闭事件交回 SDK。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法显示 Adapty 付费墙和订阅购买页面。

en.description: When the Adapty in-app purchase SDK opens a configured visual onboarding flow, this screen displays its steps and sends user actions back to the SDK.
en.disableEffect: The app’s Adapty onboarding flow cannot be opened or completed.

zh-CN.description: Adapty 应用内购买 SDK 打开已配置的可视化引导流程时，此页面会显示引导步骤，并将用户操作交回 SDK。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法打开或完成 Adapty 引导流程。

en.description: AdColony opens this Activity to host an AdColony display ad inside the app. It attaches the ad view while the ad is active and closes it when the viewer backs out.
en.disableEffect: AdColony display ads hosted by this Activity will no longer appear.

zh-CN.description: AdColony 展示应用内广告时会打开此界面。广告显示期间它承载广告视图，用户返回时会将其关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 屏蔽后，由此界面承载的 AdColony 展示广告将不会出现。

en.description: AdColony opens this Activity for a full-screen interstitial or rewarded ad. It presents the ad and returns to the app when the viewer closes it.
en.disableEffect: AdColony full-screen ads will not show, and rewards for watching AdColony rewarded ads will no longer be granted.

zh-CN.description: AdColony 展示全屏插屏或奖励广告时会打开此界面。它播放广告，并在用户关闭后返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 屏蔽后，AdColony 全屏广告将无法显示；观看 AdColony 奖励广告也不会获得奖励。

en.description: When Addhen's KAnalytics Viewer is opened, this screen displays the event viewer for inspecting collected analytics events.
en.disableEffect: Users can no longer open the KAnalytics event browser; the host app's regular screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: 打开 Addhen 的 KAnalytics 查看器时，此页面会显示已收集分析事件的浏览界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法打开 KAnalytics 事件查看器，应用的常规页面仍可使用。

en.description: When opened from Adevinta's Tagging Viewer overlay, this screen lists recorded app tags with details and offers controls to filter or clear the list.
en.disableEffect: The detailed tag list and its filter and clear controls become unavailable; normal app screens remain usable.

zh-CN.description: 从 Adevinta Tagging Viewer 浮层打开详情时，此页面会列出应用记录的标签及其详情，并提供筛选和清除选项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后无法查看详细标签列表，也无法使用筛选和清除功能；应用的正常页面仍可使用。

en.description: When the app starts, Adevinta's Tagging Viewer initializes its on-screen tag overlay so developers can inspect tags from app screens.
en.disableEffect: The Tagging Viewer overlay will not initialize, while the app's own screens continue working.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，Adevinta Tagging Viewer 会初始化屏幕标签浮层，供开发者检查各页面记录的标签。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Tagging Viewer 浮层不会初始化，但应用自身页面仍可正常使用。

en.description: The AdFly Android SDK opens this Activity when an ad link should stay inside the app. It shows the linked page in an in-app browser with back, close, and network-error controls.
en.disableEffect: Ad landing pages that use AdFly's in-app browser will not open.

zh-CN.description: AdFly Android SDK 需要在应用内打开广告链接时，会使用此 Activity 显示链接页面，并提供返回、关闭和网络错误提示。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，使用 AdFly 内置浏览器的广告落地页将无法打开。

en.description: AdFly opens this full-screen Activity when an interactive popup banner is shown, displaying its linked page in an in-app browser.
en.disableEffect: AdFly popup banners will not be displayed.

zh-CN.description: AdFly 展示互动弹窗横幅时，会使用此全屏 Activity 在应用内显示横幅链接页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，AdFly 互动弹窗横幅将无法显示。

en.description: The AdFly Android SDK opens this Activity to play a full-screen video interstitial, showing the ad video, its cover, playback controls, and click area.
en.disableEffect: AdFly video interstitial ads will not play.

zh-CN.description: AdFly Android SDK 会用此 Activity 播放全屏视频插屏广告，并显示广告封面、播放控件和可点击区域。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，AdFly 视频插屏广告将无法播放。

en.description: The AdFly Android SDK starts this Activity for a rewarded-video ad and uses its result to tell whether the video was shown and completed.
en.disableEffect: Rewarded videos cannot finish through this flow, and rewards for watching ads will no longer be granted.

zh-CN.description: AdFly Android SDK 展示激励视频时会启动此 Activity，并根据播放结果判断视频是否已展示和看完。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，激励视频无法按此流程完成，观看广告也不会再获得奖励。

en.description: The AdFly Android SDK uses this Activity to play a rewarded video, show its playback controls and click-through options, and report whether viewing completed.
en.disableEffect: Rewarded ads will not play, and rewards for watching ads will no longer be granted.

zh-CN.description: AdFly Android SDK 会用此 Activity 播放激励视频、显示播放控件和广告跳转选项，并报告视频是否看完。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，激励广告将无法播放，观看广告也不会再获得奖励。

en.description: When the Taptime (AdFly) SDK opens a page, this Activity loads its supplied address in an in-app browser and lets the user go back or choose a file requested by the page.
en.disableEffect: Taptime pages will no longer open inside the app.

zh-CN.description: Taptime（AdFly）SDK 打开网页时，此 Activity 会在应用内浏览器中加载指定网址，并允许用户返回或为网页选择文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 关闭后，Taptime 页面将无法在应用内打开。

en.description: When Taptime (AdFly) opens an offer page, this Activity displays it in an embedded browser, handles links to websites or app stores, and returns file selections to the page.
en.disableEffect: Taptime's embedded offer pages and their links will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: Taptime（AdFly）SDK 打开推广页面时，此 Activity 会在应用内浏览器中显示页面、处理网站或应用商店链接，并把用户选择的文件交还给网页。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 关闭后，Taptime 的内嵌推广页面及其中的链接将无法打开。

en.description: At app startup, AdGem prepares the application context needed to initialize its advertising and offerwall services.
en.disableEffect: AdGem ads and offerwall content will not initialize, while the host app's other screens remain usable.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，AdGem 会准备初始化广告和任务墙服务所需的应用上下文。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，AdGem 广告和任务墙内容无法初始化，应用的其他页面仍可使用。

en.description: After an AdGem video ad finishes, this screen shows its ending card and reports the completed viewing to AdGem.
en.disableEffect: The ad's ending screen cannot open, and rewards for watching ads will no longer be granted.

zh-CN.description: AdGem 视频广告播放完毕后，此页面会显示广告结束画面并向 AdGem 报告观看完成。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后无法打开广告结束画面，观看广告获得的奖励也不会发放。

en.description: When AdGem starts a cached video ad, this full-screen activity plays it, shows the remaining time, and opens the ad's ending card when playback completes.
en.disableEffect: AdGem video ads will not play, and rewards for watching ads will no longer be granted.

zh-CN.description: AdGem 开始展示已缓存的视频广告时，此全屏页面会播放视频、显示剩余时间，并在播放完毕后打开广告结束画面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，AdGem 视频广告无法播放，观看广告获得的奖励也不会发放。

en.description: When AdGem opens a web-based ad, this screen displays the saved ad page and handles its close and advertiser-link actions.
en.disableEffect: AdGem web ads and their advertiser links will no longer open; rewards for watching ads will no longer be granted.

zh-CN.description: AdGem 打开网页广告时，此页面会显示广告内容，并处理关闭和打开广告链接的操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，AdGem 网页广告及其广告链接无法打开，应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: When a ready AdGem offer wall is opened, this screen displays available offers and handles their browser and app-store links; completing offers can earn account credits.
en.disableEffect: The offer wall cannot open, so users cannot complete its offers or receive credits from them.

zh-CN.description: AdGem 任务墙就绪并被打开时，此页面会展示可用任务并处理浏览器和应用商店链接；完成任务可获得账号积分。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后任务墙无法打开，用户不能完成其中的任务或领取相应积分。

en.description: When a user opens AdGem's offer wall, this screen displays its offer page and handles links to browser and app-store pages.
en.disableEffect: The offer wall cannot open, so users cannot complete its offers or receive credits from them.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 AdGem 任务墙时，此页面会展示任务内容，并处理跳转到浏览器或应用商店的链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后任务墙无法打开，用户不能完成其中的任务或领取相应积分。

en.description: When the app opens BrowseMyFiles to browse storage, this screen lists folders and files and lets users open a selected file with another app.
en.disableEffect: The host app's storage browsing and file-opening screen will no longer work.

zh-CN.description: 应用使用 BrowseMyFiles 浏览存储空间时，此页面会列出文件和文件夹，并允许用户用其他应用打开所选文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用内的存储浏览和文件打开页面将无法使用。

en.description: When the app opens BrowseMyFiles to choose a file, this screen browses storage and returns the selected file to the app.
en.disableEffect: The host app cannot finish tasks that depend on choosing a file through this screen.

zh-CN.description: 应用通过 BrowseMyFiles 选择文件时，此页面会浏览存储空间并将选中的文件交还应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，依赖此页面选择文件的应用操作无法完成。

en.description: When the app requests a file, this BrowseMyFiles screen lets users browse local storage and return the selected file to the app.
en.disableEffect: The app's file-selection flow will stop working.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求选择文件时，此 BrowseMyFiles 页面允许用户浏览本地存储，并将选中的文件交还应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用的文件选择流程将无法使用。

en.description: When the app asks users to choose a folder, this BrowseMyFiles screen lets them browse storage and return the selected folder.
en.disableEffect: The app's folder-selection flow will stop working.

zh-CN.description: 应用要求用户选择文件夹时，此 BrowseMyFiles 页面允许用户浏览存储空间并返回所选文件夹。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用的文件夹选择流程将无法使用。

en.description: Before BrowseMyFiles displays local files or folders, this screen requests the storage access its picker needs and reports whether access was granted.
en.disableEffect: Without it, BrowseMyFiles cannot request required storage access, so its file and folder pickers may fail to open.

zh-CN.description: BrowseMyFiles 显示本地文件或文件夹前，此页面会申请选择器所需的存储权限，并返回授权结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，BrowseMyFiles 无法申请所需存储权限，其文件和文件夹选择器可能无法打开。

en.description: Adivery ad SDK runs this background job when Android starts it and the app has location permission. It reads the last known GPS or network location, or a saved location, then sends the coordinates, accuracy, altitude, and advertising ID to Adivery’s audience service.
en.disableEffect: Adivery will no longer receive location audience data through this component; the app’s own features continue to work.

zh-CN.description: Adivery 广告 SDK 会在 Android 调度此后台任务且应用拥有位置权限时运行。它读取 GPS 或网络提供的最近位置，或已保存的位置，再将经纬度、精度、海拔和广告标识符发送到 Adivery 受众服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Adivery 将无法通过此组件接收位置受众数据，应用自身功能仍可正常使用。

en.description: Adivery SDK receiver runs after Android reports that an app store package has been fully removed. It clears Adivery’s saved installation cache when the removed package matches a supported store and the removal is not an app replacement.
en.disableEffect: Adivery will no longer clear its installation cache when a supported store is removed; normal app features continue to work.

zh-CN.description: Android 报告应用商店程序包已完全卸载时，Adivery 广告 SDK 的接收器会运行。如果卸载的是受支持的应用商店且不是应用替换，它会清除 Adivery 保存的安装缓存。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，受支持的应用商店被卸载时，Adivery 不会再清除安装缓存；应用的常规功能不受影响。

en.description: Adivery ad SDK opens this private Activity to show full-screen ad content, including video. It pauses and resumes the ad with the screen and closes when the user exits.
en.disableEffect: Adivery full-screen ads will no longer open, while the host app’s own screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: Adivery 广告 SDK 会打开此私有 Activity，以全屏方式展示广告内容，包括视频广告。它会随屏幕暂停和恢复广告，并在用户退出时关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Adivery 全屏广告将无法打开，但宿主应用自身的页面仍可使用。

en.description: When a user opens an Adivery ad link, this exported Activity reads the destination URL carried by that link, opens it with Android, and closes.
en.disableEffect: Adivery ad links will no longer open their destination through this handler; other app features remain available.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 Adivery 广告链接时，此导出的 Activity 会读取链接中的目标网址，通过 Android 打开该网址，然后关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Adivery 广告链接将无法通过此组件打开目标页面，应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: Adjust runs this Receiver when Android sends the Play Store install-referrer broadcast. It passes campaign information to Adjust so the app can measure what led to an install.
en.disableEffect: Adjust will lose Play Store install attribution for this app; other app features continue to work.

zh-CN.description: Android 发出 Play 商店安装来源广播时，Adjust 会运行此接收器。它把推广来源信息交给 Adjust，用于统计用户通过什么活动安装了应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Adjust 将无法统计此应用的 Play 商店安装来源；应用的其他功能不受影响。

en.description: Adjust Android SDK initializes this provider when the app process starts. It observes app foreground and background changes so Adjust can measure session timing.
en.disableEffect: Adjust will lose automatic app lifecycle updates for session measurement, while the app itself continues to work.

zh-CN.description: 应用进程启动时，Adjust Android SDK 会初始化此 Provider。它监听应用进入前台和后台的变化，供 Adjust 统计会话时长。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Adjust 将失去用于会话统计的自动应用生命周期更新，但应用本身仍可正常运行。

en.description: AdMarvel’s ad SDK opens this page to show a full-screen ad or an expanded banner, including web content opened from an ad.
en.disableEffect: AdMarvel ads that use this page will not open, and rewards tied to completing a rewarded video shown here will not be granted.

zh-CN.description: AdMarvel 广告 SDK 会在展示全屏广告或展开横幅广告时打开此页面，也会在这里加载广告中打开的网页内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，使用此页面的 AdMarvel 广告无法打开，通过此页面观看奖励视频也不会获得奖励。

en.description: AdMarvel’s ad SDK opens this page to show a full-screen ad supplied by a partner advertising service; it also handles expanded ad content.
en.disableEffect: Partner ads that use this page will not appear, and rewards for watching those ads will not be granted.

zh-CN.description: AdMarvel 广告 SDK 会打开此页面来展示合作广告服务提供的全屏广告，也会在这里处理展开后的广告内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此页面的合作广告将无法显示，观看这些奖励广告也不会获得奖励。

en.description: AdMarvel’s ad SDK opens this full-screen player when an ad contains a video, then plays the clip.
en.disableEffect: AdMarvel video ads that use this player will not play, so users cannot earn a reward tied to watching one.

zh-CN.description: AdMarvel 广告 SDK 会在广告包含视频时打开此全屏播放器并播放视频片段。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此播放器的 AdMarvel 视频广告将无法播放，用户也无法获得观看视频对应的奖励。

en.description: The Yandex Mobile Ads AdMob mediation adapter starts this provider with the app. In debuggable builds it logs that the adapter is integrated and initialized.
en.disableEffect: Only the adapter startup messages in debuggable builds are lost; this provider does not change normal app features.

zh-CN.description: Yandex Mobile Ads 的 AdMob 中介适配器会在应用启动时运行此提供器。可调试版本中，它会记录适配器已集成和初始化的日志。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 只会失去可调试版本中的适配器启动日志；此提供器不会改变应用的正常功能。

en.description: Adobe Creative SDK Image (Aviary) binds this service when the editor opens its content manager. It checks Adobe account status and handles purchases and restores for downloadable editing packs.
en.disableEffect: Adobe sign-in, pack purchases, and restoring previously owned editing packs may fail.

zh-CN.description: Adobe Creative SDK Image（Aviary）编辑器打开素材管理功能时会绑定此服务。它检查 Adobe 账户状态，并处理可下载编辑素材包的购买和恢复。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Adobe 登录、素材包购买以及恢复已购素材包可能会失败。

en.description: When the app opens a photo for editing, Adobe Creative SDK Image (Aviary) displays its editing workspace and photo tools.
en.disableEffect: The in-app Aviary photo editor will not open.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开照片进行编辑时，Adobe Creative SDK Image（Aviary）会显示编辑工作区和照片工具。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用内的 Aviary 照片编辑器将无法打开。

en.description: When the editor requests Adobe account or pack-billing data, Adobe Creative SDK Image binds this service in the editor process. It handles Adobe sign-in, account status, and lookup of owned packs.
en.disableEffect: Adobe sign-in and access to paid or previously owned editing packs may fail.

zh-CN.description: 编辑器请求 Adobe 账户或素材包计费信息时，Adobe Creative SDK Image 会在编辑进程中绑定此服务。它处理 Adobe 登录、账户状态以及已购素材包查询。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Adobe 登录以及访问已购或已拥有的编辑素材包可能会失败。

en.description: After Adobe Creative SDK Image refreshes its catalog, this background service fetches extra pack previews, detail images, icons, and message assets when download conditions allow.
en.disableEffect: Extra catalog images and previews may be missing, but installed editing tools remain available.

zh-CN.description: Adobe Creative SDK Image 刷新素材目录后，此后台服务会在网络条件允许时下载素材包预览图、详情图、图标和消息资源。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，目录中的部分图片和预览可能缺失，但已安装的编辑工具仍可使用。

en.description: When Adobe Creative SDK Image loads its catalog or handles pack downloads and restores, this provider stores and serves the related pack, purchase, and download records.
en.disableEffect: The editor may fail to load its pack catalog or complete pack downloads and restores.

zh-CN.description: Adobe Creative SDK Image 加载素材目录或处理素材包下载和恢复时，此内容提供程序会保存并提供相关素材包、购买和下载记录。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，编辑器可能无法加载素材目录，也可能无法完成素材包下载或恢复。

en.description: Adobe Creative SDK Image handles Android download-complete, Wi-Fi, power, app-update, and notification broadcasts here. It finishes downloaded pack installs and schedules or retries catalog downloads.
en.disableEffect: Pack downloads may remain unfinished, and automatic refresh or retry actions will stop.

zh-CN.description: Adobe Creative SDK Image 在此处理 Android 下载完成、Wi-Fi、电源、应用更新和通知广播，以完成素材包安装并安排或重试目录下载。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，素材包下载可能无法完成，自动刷新和重试也会停止。

en.description: When Adobe Creative SDK Image refreshes its catalog or restores user and owned packs, this service downloads catalog data and retrieves the requested editing packs.
en.disableEffect: Catalog refreshes and restoration of user or purchased editing packs may fail.

zh-CN.description: Adobe Creative SDK Image 刷新素材目录或恢复用户素材和已购素材时，此服务会下载目录数据并获取请求的编辑素材包。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，素材目录刷新以及用户素材或已购编辑素材的恢复可能会失败。

en.description: When an app opens Adobe Creative SDK Color, this screen presents color pickers, saved themes, and library browsing. It asks the user to sign in to Adobe before loading the collections.
en.disableEffect: The Color picker, theme, and library screens will not open.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开 Adobe Creative SDK Color 时，此界面会显示颜色选择器、已保存的主题和素材库；加载这些内容前会要求用户登录 Adobe。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，颜色选择、主题和素材库界面将无法打开。

en.description: When a user edits a color theme, Adobe Creative SDK Color opens this screen with its color-picking tools.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to open the theme editor or save changes through it.

zh-CN.description: 用户编辑配色主题时，Adobe Creative SDK Color 会打开此界面并显示颜色选择工具。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法通过此界面打开主题编辑器或保存更改。

en.description: When a user removes a saved color item, Adobe Creative SDK Color shows a confirmation screen with remove and cancel choices.
en.disableEffect: The color item cannot be deleted through this flow.

zh-CN.description: 用户删除已保存的颜色项目时，Adobe Creative SDK Color 会显示确认界面，供用户确认删除或取消。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法通过此流程删除颜色项目。

en.description: When the app requests a name change in Adobe Creative SDK Color, this screen accepts a new name and returns it to the calling screen.
en.disableEffect: Name changes started through Adobe Creative SDK Color may fail.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求在 Adobe Creative SDK Color 中修改名称时，此界面会接收新名称并返回给发起界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，通过 Adobe Creative SDK Color 发起的名称修改可能会失败。

en.description: When Adobe Creative SDK Color needs the user to select a library, this screen lists the available libraries and returns the choice.
en.disableEffect: Color libraries cannot be selected through this flow.

zh-CN.description: Adobe Creative SDK Color 需要用户选择素材库时，此界面会列出可用素材库并返回所选项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法通过此流程选择颜色素材库。

en.description: When a user opens a color library, Adobe Creative SDK Color displays the color items saved in that library.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to browse the saved color items through this screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开颜色素材库时，Adobe Creative SDK Color 会显示该库中保存的颜色项目。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法通过此界面浏览已保存的颜色项目。

en.description: When Adobe Creative SDK is asked to choose a workflow for an asset, this screen lists available actions such as editing, capture, or embedding, then opens the selected action.
en.disableEffect: The Adobe action chooser will not open, so users cannot choose those workflows from the app.

zh-CN.description: Adobe Creative SDK 需要为资源选择处理流程时，此界面会列出编辑、捕捉或嵌入等可用操作，并打开用户选中的操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，Adobe 操作选择界面无法打开，用户无法从应用中选择这些处理流程。

en.description: When the app opens Adobe Creative SDK's app library, this screen loads the app catalog and lets users browse by category or search.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to browse or open apps listed in this catalog.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开 Adobe Creative SDK 应用库时，此界面会加载应用目录，并支持按类别浏览和搜索。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，用户无法浏览或打开 Adobe 应用库中的应用条目。

en.description: When an Adobe account sign-in requires an extra step, Adobe Creative SDK opens this screen to display the requested Adobe page and return whether the step finished or was cancelled.
en.disableEffect: Required Adobe account checks may not finish, so sign-in and cloud features that need them can fail.

zh-CN.description: Adobe 账户登录需要额外步骤时，Adobe Creative SDK 会打开此界面显示相应的 Adobe 页面，并返回该步骤已完成或已取消的结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，Adobe 账户要求的验证可能无法完成，依赖这些验证的登录和云端功能可能会失败。

en.description: When an Adobe account sign-in requires an extra step, Adobe Creative SDK opens this screen to display the requested Adobe page and retry account authentication.
en.disableEffect: Required Adobe account checks may not finish, so sign-in and cloud features that need them can fail.

zh-CN.description: Adobe 账户登录需要额外步骤时，Adobe Creative SDK 会打开此界面显示相应的 Adobe 页面，并重新验证账户。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，Adobe 账户要求的验证可能无法完成，依赖这些验证的登录和云端功能可能会失败。

en.description: When the app needs an Adobe account sign-in or account link, Adobe Creative SDK opens this screen to show its sign-in form and return the result to the app.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot sign in to or link an Adobe account through Adobe Creative SDK.

zh-CN.description: 应用需要登录或关联 Adobe 账户时，Adobe Creative SDK 会打开此界面显示登录表单，并将结果返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，应用无法通过 Adobe Creative SDK 登录或关联 Adobe 账户。

en.description: Android binds the Adobe Creative SDK Foundation Auth service when an Adobe ID account-authentication request arrives. It supplies the authenticator used to connect or sign in to an Adobe account.
en.disableEffect: Adobe ID sign-in and account authentication for Adobe Creative SDK features may fail.

zh-CN.description: 收到 Adobe ID 账户验证请求时，Android 会绑定 Adobe Creative SDK Foundation Auth 服务。它提供用于连接或登录 Adobe 账户的验证器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Adobe Creative SDK 功能的 Adobe ID 登录和账户验证可能会失败。

en.description: When Adobe requires age or email verification, or acceptance of updated terms, this Adobe Creative SDK activity opens the matching account page.
en.disableEffect: Required Adobe account verification or terms steps may not continue, affecting cloud and editing flows that need them.

zh-CN.description: Adobe 要求进行年龄或邮箱验证，或要求接受更新后的条款时，此 Adobe Creative SDK 活动会打开相应的账户页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，Adobe 账户要求的验证或条款确认可能无法继续，依赖这些步骤的云端和编辑流程会受影响。

en.description: When users change the cloud storage location in Adobe Creative SDK, this screen lists available cloud services and lets them set the default location.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot change the default cloud storage location from this screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Adobe Creative SDK 中更改云端存储位置时，此界面会列出可用的云服务，并允许设置默认位置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，用户无法通过此界面更改默认云端存储位置。

en.description: While Adobe Creative SDK uploads files or has upload history to show, this screen lists active and completed uploads and lets users cancel cancellable tasks.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot view upload progress or history, or cancel uploads from this screen.

zh-CN.description: Adobe Creative SDK 正在上传文件或有历史记录时，此界面会显示进行中和已完成的上传，并允许用户取消可取消的任务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，用户无法查看上传进度或历史记录，也无法通过此界面取消上传。

en.description: When users open a file from Adobe Creative SDK's file browser, this screen shows a full-screen preview with paging and the available file actions.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open the selected file in Adobe Creative SDK's full-screen preview.

zh-CN.description: 用户从 Adobe Creative SDK 文件浏览器打开文件时，此界面会显示全屏预览，支持翻页和可用的文件操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，用户无法在 Adobe Creative SDK 的全屏预览中打开所选文件。

en.description: When users open a video in Adobe Creative SDK's asset viewer, this screen plays the selected file with video playback controls.
en.disableEffect: Videos opened through Adobe Creative SDK's asset viewer cannot play in this screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Adobe Creative SDK 资源查看器中打开视频时，此界面会播放所选文件并显示播放控制。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，通过 Adobe Creative SDK 资源查看器打开的视频无法在此播放。

en.description: When users open a composition page from an Adobe Creative SDK mobile creation package, this screen previews the page and lets them browse package items.
en.disableEffect: Composition pages in these packages cannot open in Adobe Creative SDK's full-screen viewer.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 Adobe Creative SDK 移动创作包中的合成页面时，此界面会预览该页面，并支持浏览包内其他项目。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，用户无法在 Adobe Creative SDK 的全屏查看器中打开这些创作包里的合成页面。

en.description: When users open an item collection from an Adobe Creative SDK design library, this screen shows its assets in a paged full-screen view with the available sharing and information actions.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open or browse assets in that design library collection.

zh-CN.description: 用户从 Adobe Creative SDK 设计库打开项目集合时，此界面会以可翻页的全屏视图展示其中的资源，并提供可用的分享和信息操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，用户无法打开或浏览该设计库集合中的资源。

en.description: When users choose a page from an Adobe Creative SDK mobile creation package, this screen previews package assets and lets them move between pages.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot preview or select package pages through this full-screen viewer.

zh-CN.description: 用户从 Adobe Creative SDK 移动创作包中选择页面时，此界面会预览包内资源，并支持在页面间切换。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，用户无法通过此全屏查看器预览或选择创作包中的页面。

en.description: When users open a photo from Adobe Creative SDK's photo list, this screen shows a large preview and lets them browse other photos.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open photo previews from this list.

zh-CN.description: 用户从 Adobe Creative SDK 照片列表打开照片时，此界面会显示大图预览，并支持浏览其他照片。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，用户无法从此列表打开照片预览。

en.description: When the app opens Adobe Creative SDK's cloud asset browser, this screen handles the account state and shows files, photos, design libraries, and mobile creations to browse or select.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot open or select these cloud assets through Adobe Creative SDK.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开 Adobe Creative SDK 云端资源浏览器时，此界面会处理账户状态，并显示文件、照片、设计库和移动创作内容供用户浏览或选择。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，应用无法通过 Adobe Creative SDK 打开或选择这些云端资源。

en.description: When the app starts an Adobe Creative SDK asset edit flow, this screen shows multi-select editing or opens a browser for moving or copying files, according to the requested operation.
en.disableEffect: File editing, renaming, moving, or copying operations that use this screen cannot be completed.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动 Adobe Creative SDK 资源编辑流程时，此界面会根据请求显示多选编辑，或打开用于移动、复制文件的浏览器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此界面的文件编辑、重命名、移动或复制操作将无法完成。

en.description: When users move or copy items in an Adobe Creative SDK design library, this screen lets them browse destination libraries and choose where to place the selected item.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot move or copy design library items through this screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Adobe Creative SDK 设计库中移动或复制项目时，此界面允许浏览目标设计库，并选择放置所选项目的位置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，用户无法通过此界面移动或复制设计库项目。

en.description: When users move or copy items in an Adobe Creative SDK design library, this screen lets them browse destination libraries and choose where to place the selected item.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot move or copy design library items through this screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Adobe Creative SDK 设计库中移动或复制项目时，此界面允许浏览目标设计库，并选择放置所选项目的位置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，用户无法通过此界面移动或复制设计库项目。

en.description: When an app opens Adobe Creative SDK Typekit, this screen lets users browse and search font families, view synced fonts, and choose a font.
en.disableEffect: Typekit font browsing and selection will not open.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开 Adobe Creative SDK Typekit 时，此界面允许用户浏览和搜索字体系列、查看已同步字体并选择字体。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Typekit 字体浏览和选择界面将无法打开。

en.description: When the Typekit font list is filtered, Adobe Creative SDK Typekit opens this screen to show the available font-filter controls.
en.disableEffect: The Typekit filter screen will not open, so users may be unable to narrow the font list.

zh-CN.description: 筛选 Typekit 字体列表时，Adobe Creative SDK Typekit 会打开此界面显示可用的字体筛选选项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Typekit 筛选界面将无法打开，用户可能无法缩小字体列表范围。

en.description: When a user opens a font family in Adobe Creative SDK Typekit, this screen shows its fonts and supports selecting or syncing them.
en.disableEffect: Users may be unable to inspect, sync, or select fonts from the font-family screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Adobe Creative SDK Typekit 中打开字体系列时，此界面会显示其中的字体，并支持选择或同步字体。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户可能无法在字体系列界面查看、同步或选择字体。

en.description: When the Typekit preview asks for sample text, Adobe Creative SDK Typekit shows preset alphabets and pangrams and returns the selected text.
en.disableEffect: The preset sample-text chooser in Typekit previews will not open.

zh-CN.description: Typekit 预览需要示例文本时，Adobe Creative SDK Typekit 会显示预设字母表和完整句示例，并返回所选文本。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Typekit 预览中的预设示例文本选择器将无法打开。

en.description: Adobe Campaign Classic invokes this Receiver for push-notification actions such as carousel buttons, reminders, and scheduled notifications; it updates or schedules the notification.
en.disableEffect: Those Campaign Classic notification buttons and reminder actions will no longer update or schedule notifications.

zh-CN.description: Adobe Campaign Classic 会在用户操作推送通知轮播按钮、提醒选项或定时通知时调用此 Receiver，以更新或安排通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Campaign Classic 通知按钮和提醒操作将无法更新或安排通知。

en.description: Adobe Assurance opens this screen when it needs to report a session error; it shows the error and details with a dismiss button.
en.disableEffect: Assurance session errors will no longer have this explanation screen.

zh-CN.description: Adobe Assurance 需要报告会话错误时会打开此界面，显示错误及详细信息，并提供关闭按钮。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Assurance 会话错误将不再显示此说明界面。

en.description: During an Adobe Assurance debugging session, this Activity hosts a full-screen inspection overlay above the current app screen.
en.disableEffect: Assurance will no longer be able to show its full-screen debugging overlay.

zh-CN.description: 在 Adobe Assurance 调试会话中，此 Activity 会在当前应用界面上承载全屏检查浮层。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Assurance 将无法显示全屏调试浮层。

en.description: Adobe Campaign Classic opens this Activity when a user opens a push notification or taps its button; it records the interaction, then opens the app or the notification's link.
en.disableEffect: Campaign Classic push taps will no longer be tracked or routed to the app or link through this Activity.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 Adobe Campaign Classic 推送通知或点击其中的按钮时，此 Activity 会记录交互，然后打开应用或通知中的链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Campaign Classic 推送点击将无法通过此 Activity 记录或跳转到应用及链接。

en.description: When the Adobe Experience Platform Mobile SDK registers its extensions, it reads this service's manifest entries to find modules such as Analytics, Campaign, and Messaging. The service itself has no user interface.
en.disableEffect: Disabling this shared discovery entry can prevent Adobe extensions bundled with the app from being registered, stopping their related SDK features.

zh-CN.description: Adobe Experience Platform Mobile SDK 注册扩展时，会读取此 service 的清单声明，以发现 Analytics、Campaign 和 Messaging 等模块。此 service 本身没有用户界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用此共享发现入口可能导致应用内的 Adobe 扩展无法注册，其相关 SDK 功能也会停止。

en.description: During an Adobe Griffon mobile-debugging session, this Activity hosts a full-screen inspection overlay above the current app screen.
en.disableEffect: Griffon will no longer be able to show its full-screen debugging overlay.

zh-CN.description: 在 Adobe Griffon 移动端调试会话中，此 Activity 会在当前应用界面上承载全屏检查浮层。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Griffon 将无法显示全屏调试浮层。

en.description: When Adobe Places Monitor requests location access, it opens this Activity to show Android's location-permission prompt and return the user's choice to Places.
en.disableEffect: Places Monitor will no longer be able to request location access through this screen, so location-based updates stop.

zh-CN.description: Adobe Places Monitor 请求定位权限时，会打开此 Activity 显示 Android 定位权限提示，并将用户的选择返回给 Places。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Places Monitor 无法通过此界面请求定位权限，基于位置的更新将停止。

en.description: When Android reports a geofence transition, this Adobe Places Monitor Receiver sends the affected region IDs and transition to Places for app experiences to respond.
en.disableEffect: Places will stop receiving geofence events, so location-triggered updates will not run.

zh-CN.description: Android 报告地理围栏状态变化时，此 Adobe Places Monitor Receiver 会将相关区域 ID 和变化信息发送给 Places，以便应用体验作出响应。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Places 将无法接收地理围栏事件，位置触发的更新也不会运行。

en.description: When Android sends a location update, this Adobe Places Monitor Receiver forwards the latest coordinates to Places.
en.disableEffect: Places will stop receiving location-update events, so location-based updates will not run.

zh-CN.description: Android 发送位置更新时，此 Adobe Places Monitor Receiver 会将最新坐标转交给 Places。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Places 将无法接收位置更新事件，基于位置的更新也不会运行。

en.description: After Android reports that the device has restarted, this Adobe Places Monitor Receiver refreshes location monitoring.
en.disableEffect: Places Monitor will no longer refresh location monitoring at device startup.

zh-CN.description: Android 报告设备重新启动后，此 Adobe Places Monitor Receiver 会刷新位置监测。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Places Monitor 将不会在设备启动时刷新位置监测。

en.description: Adobe Assurance opens this screen when a session error needs an explanation; it displays the error details and lets the user dismiss them.
en.disableEffect: Assurance session errors will no longer have this explanation screen.

zh-CN.description: Adobe Assurance 会在需要说明会话错误时打开此界面，显示错误详情并允许用户关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Assurance 会话错误将不再显示此说明界面。

en.description: During an Adobe Assurance debugging session, this Activity hosts a full-screen inspection overlay above the current app screen.
en.disableEffect: Assurance will no longer be able to show its full-screen debugging overlay.

zh-CN.description: 在 Adobe Assurance 调试会话中，此 Activity 会在当前应用界面上承载全屏检查浮层。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Assurance 将无法显示全屏调试浮层。

en.description: In an Adobe Assurance debug build, this screen lets the user connect or retry a QuickConnect session and shows connection errors.
en.disableEffect: The Assurance QuickConnect screen cannot start or retry a debugging session.

zh-CN.description: 在 Adobe Assurance 调试版本中，用户可通过此界面连接或重试 QuickConnect 会话，并查看连接错误。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Assurance QuickConnect 界面无法启动或重试调试会话。

en.description: Adobe Assurance opens this screen for a debugging session and displays its current connection state and session interface.
en.disableEffect: The built-in Assurance session screen will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: Adobe Assurance 会在调试会话中打开此界面，显示当前连接状态和会话界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Assurance 内置会话界面将无法打开。

en.description: When a Campaign Classic push action fires, this Receiver rebuilds the notification for actions such as carousel selection, reminders, replies, or timers.
en.disableEffect: Those Campaign Classic notification actions will no longer rebuild, update, or reschedule their notifications.

zh-CN.description: Campaign Classic 推送操作触发时，此 Receiver 会为轮播选择、提醒、回复或计时器等操作重新构建通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Campaign Classic 的这些通知操作将无法重新构建、更新或重新安排通知。

en.description: Adobe Campaign Classic opens this Activity when a user clicks, dismisses, or replies to a push notification; it records the interaction and can open the app or the notification's link.
en.disableEffect: Campaign Classic push clicks, dismissals, and replies will no longer be tracked or routed through this Activity.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击、关闭或回复 Adobe Campaign Classic 推送通知时，此 Activity 会记录交互，并可打开应用或通知中的链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Campaign Classic 推送的点击、关闭和回复将无法通过此 Activity 记录或跳转。

en.description: Adobe Experience Platform Messaging uses this Provider to give Android access to cached rich-media images for push notifications.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it can prevent rich-media push images from being shown or cause those notifications to fail while they are built.

zh-CN.description: Adobe Experience Platform Messaging 使用此 Provider 向 Android 提供推送通知中缓存的富媒体图片。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，富媒体推送图片可能无法显示，或通知在构建时失败。

en.description: Adobe Experience Platform Messaging opens this Activity when a user opens a push notification or taps one of its buttons; it records the response and opens the app or the notification's link.
en.disableEffect: Messaging push taps will no longer be tracked or routed to the app or link through this Activity.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 Adobe Experience Platform Messaging 推送通知或点击其中的按钮时，此 Activity 会记录响应，并打开应用或通知中的链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Messaging 推送点击将无法通过此 Activity 记录或跳转到应用及链接。

en.description: Adobe Experience Platform Messaging uses this Receiver to process notification-dismissal and background-interaction broadcasts.
en.disableEffect: Messaging will no longer process these notification dismissal or background-interaction events.

zh-CN.description: Adobe Experience Platform Messaging 使用此 Receiver 处理通知关闭和后台交互广播。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Messaging 将无法处理这些通知关闭或后台交互事件。

en.description: When Adobe Target Mobile VEC starts a remote editing session, this foreground service connects to the Target authoring server and exchanges page-selection and offer updates.
en.disableEffect: Target Mobile VEC can no longer connect to the authoring server for remote editing sessions.

zh-CN.description: Adobe Target Mobile VEC 启动远程编辑会话时，此前台服务会连接 Target 创作服务器并交换页面选择和体验内容更新。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Target Mobile VEC 无法连接创作服务器进行远程编辑。

en.description: When Adobe Target Mobile VEC runs in simulation mode, this service connects to the local preview simulator and returns selection and offer updates to the editor.
en.disableEffect: Local VEC simulation and preview editing will stop working.

zh-CN.description: Adobe Target Mobile VEC 运行在模拟模式时，此服务会连接本地预览模拟器，并将选择和体验内容更新返回给编辑器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，本地 VEC 模拟和预览编辑将无法使用。

en.description: Adobe Target Mobile VEC opens this Activity to display a full-screen in-app message over the current app screen and closes it when the user backs out.
en.disableEffect: Target full-screen messages will not appear, so users may miss content the app delivers through those messages.

zh-CN.description: Adobe Target Mobile VEC 会打开此 Activity，在当前应用界面上显示全屏应用内消息，并在用户返回时关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Target 全屏消息将无法显示，用户可能会错过应用通过这些消息提供的内容。

en.description: When Adobe Target Mobile VEC starts a remote editing session, this foreground service connects to the Target authoring server and exchanges page-selection and offer updates.
en.disableEffect: Target Mobile VEC can no longer connect to the authoring server for remote editing sessions.

zh-CN.description: Adobe Target Mobile VEC 启动远程编辑会话时，此前台服务会连接 Target 创作服务器并交换页面选择和体验内容更新。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Target Mobile VEC 无法连接创作服务器进行远程编辑。

en.description: When the older Adobe Target Mobile VEC editor runs in simulation mode, this service connects to the local preview simulator and returns selection and offer updates to the editor.
en.disableEffect: Local VEC simulation and preview editing will stop working.

zh-CN.description: 旧版 Adobe Target Mobile VEC 编辑器运行在模拟模式时，此服务会连接本地预览模拟器，并将选择和体验内容更新返回给编辑器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，本地 VEC 模拟和预览编辑将无法使用。

en.description: When Android starts the device or Chabok requests a restart, this Chabok push Receiver restarts the background push service if persistent delivery is enabled.
en.disableEffect: Chabok push will no longer restart automatically after device startup or a service restart request.

zh-CN.description: Android 启动设备或 Chabok 请求重启时，如果启用了持续送达，此 Chabok 推送 Receiver 会重启后台推送服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Chabok 推送服务将无法在设备启动或收到重启请求后自动恢复。

en.description: Android creates the Chabok Provider during app startup so it can store the application context before Chabok is initialized.
en.disableEffect: Without another way to supply that context, Chabok initialization throws an error and push notifications do not start.

zh-CN.description: Android 会在应用启动期间创建 Chabok Provider，以便在 Chabok 初始化前保存应用上下文。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 如果没有其他方式提供该上下文，停用后 Chabok 初始化会报错，推送通知也无法启动。

en.description: When Firebase delivers a Chabok push message or refreshes its push token, this Chabok service handles the message, builds its notification, or sends the updated token.
en.disableEffect: Chabok push messages and token updates will no longer be handled through Firebase.

zh-CN.description: Firebase 收到 Chabok 推送消息或刷新推送令牌时，此 Chabok service 会处理消息、构建通知或发送更新后的令牌。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Chabok 将无法通过 Firebase 处理推送消息或令牌更新。

en.description: When Google Play sends the install-referrer broadcast, this Chabok Receiver forwards the referral information to Chabok.
en.disableEffect: Chabok will no longer receive install-referrer information for attribution.

zh-CN.description: Google Play 发送安装来源广播时，此 Chabok Receiver 会将来源信息转交给 Chabok。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Chabok 将无法接收用于归因的安装来源信息。

en.description: The Chabok push SDK starts this background service to connect to its push system, send keep-alives, and reconnect or disconnect as app state changes.
en.disableEffect: Chabok may stop receiving push messages when this background connection cannot be maintained.

zh-CN.description: Chabok 推送 SDK 会启动此后台服务连接推送系统、发送保活消息，并根据应用状态重新连接或断开。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，后台连接无法维持，Chabok 可能无法继续接收推送消息。

en.description: When a user taps or uses an action on a Chabok push notification, this Receiver opens the configured app screen or link and dismisses action notifications.
en.disableEffect: Chabok notification taps will no longer open their configured destination through this Receiver.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击 Chabok 推送通知或使用其中的操作时，此 Receiver 会打开配置的应用界面或链接，并关闭操作通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Chabok 通知点击将无法通过此 Receiver 打开配置的目标页面。

en.description: When the Ad-Pole advertising SDK shows a full-screen placement, this screen plays its video or banner ad, provides close or skip controls, and opens the advertiser's link when tapped.
en.disableEffect: Ad-Pole ads and their advertiser links will stop appearing; the app's other features remain available.

zh-CN.description: Ad-Pole 广告 SDK 展示全屏广告时，此页面会播放视频或横幅广告，提供关闭或跳过按钮，并在用户点击时打开广告链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Ad-Pole 广告及其广告链接不会再显示，应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: The AdPushup ad-mediation SDK opens this full-screen Activity to display an interstitial ad, its close controls, and any display timer.
en.disableEffect: Interstitial ads will no longer appear.

zh-CN.description: AdPushup 广告聚合 SDK 会打开此全屏 Activity 展示插页广告、关闭控件和显示计时器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，插页广告将不再显示。

en.description: The AdPushup ad-mediation SDK opens this full-screen Activity to show a native ad with its headline, icon, and call-to-action.
en.disableEffect: Native ads shown through this Activity will no longer appear.

zh-CN.description: AdPushup 广告聚合 SDK 会打开此全屏 Activity，展示包含标题、图标和操作按钮的原生广告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，通过此 Activity 展示的原生广告将不再显示。

en.description: The AdPushup ad-mediation SDK opens this full-screen Activity to play a rewarded video ad and lets the user close or skip it.
en.disableEffect: Rewards for watching ads will no longer be granted.
