zh-CN.description: AdPushup 广告聚合 SDK 会打开此全屏 Activity 播放激励视频广告，并允许用户关闭或跳过。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，观看广告可获得的奖励将不再发放。

en.description: Ox SDK by Kevin ZXD uses this transparent Activity while managing a full-screen ad; it stays open until the ad flow signals that it is finished.
en.disableEffect: Full-screen Ox SDK ads that rely on this helper may fail to open or close properly.

zh-CN.description: Kevin ZXD 的 Ox SDK 会在管理全屏广告时使用此透明 Activity，并在广告流程结束时将其关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，依赖此辅助页面的 Ox SDK 全屏广告可能无法正常打开或关闭。

en.description: Ox SDK’s ad library runs this Provider at app startup to initialize its ad manager and privacy-related setup.
en.disableEffect: Ox SDK ads and their privacy setup may not initialize.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，Ox SDK 广告库会通过此 Provider 初始化广告管理和隐私相关设置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Ox SDK 广告及其隐私设置可能无法初始化。

en.description: Ox SDK opens this full-screen Activity to display a native interstitial ad. The ad fills the screen, and a countdown reveals a skip control.
en.disableEffect: Ox SDK native interstitial ads will no longer display.

zh-CN.description: Ox SDK 会打开此全屏 Activity 展示原生插屏广告；广告铺满屏幕，并在倒计时结束后显示跳过控件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Ox SDK 原生插屏广告将无法显示。

en.description: Ox SDK’s MAX adapter uses this full-screen Activity to show a native interstitial ad with a five-second countdown before the skip control appears.
en.disableEffect: Ox SDK native interstitial ads shown through MAX will no longer display.

zh-CN.description: Ox SDK 的 MAX 适配器会通过此全屏 Activity 展示原生插屏广告，并在五秒倒计时后显示跳过控件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Ox SDK 通过 MAX 展示的原生插屏广告将无法显示。

en.description: Ox AdSdk opens this screen when the app asks users to review ad privacy information or set consent. It records whether the user accepts or rejects.
en.disableEffect: The app will no longer be able to show or update Ox AdSdk’s consent screen.

zh-CN.description: 应用要求用户查看广告隐私信息或设置同意选项时，Ox AdSdk 会打开此页面，并保存用户接受或拒绝的选择。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用将无法显示或更新 Ox AdSdk 的同意设置页面。

en.description: MobFox's ad SDK opens the web page linked from a tapped ad in an in-app browser. Links to an app store or another external destination are handed to the phone.
en.disableEffect: MobFox ad landing pages will not open; the app's other screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: MobFox 广告 SDK 会在用户点按广告时于应用内打开广告网页；跳转到应用商店或其他外部目标的链接会交由手机打开。
zh-CN.disableEffect: MobFox 广告落地页将无法打开，应用的其他界面仍可使用。

en.description: MobFox's interactive ad flow opens an in-app browser for the ad page, with back, forward, refresh, and close controls.
en.disableEffect: Interactive MobFox ad pages will not open through this browser; the app's other screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: MobFox 互动广告会在应用内浏览器中打开广告页面，并提供前进、后退、刷新和关闭控件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: MobFox 互动广告页面将无法通过此浏览器打开，应用的其他界面仍可使用。

en.description: MobFox's ad SDK uses this screen to play video and interactive ads and show their click-through content.
en.disableEffect: MobFox video and interactive ads will not play or open; the app's other screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: MobFox 广告 SDK 使用此界面播放视频和互动广告，并展示广告的跳转内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: MobFox 视频和互动广告将无法播放或打开，应用的其他界面仍可使用。

en.description: Adyen Checkout queues this service when it has a payment analytics event to send, and the service sends that event to Adyen.
en.disableEffect: The checkout and payment screens remain available, but Adyen will no longer receive these analytics events.

zh-CN.description: Adyen Checkout 有付款分析事件需要发送时会排队启动此服务，由它把事件发送给 Adyen。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 结账和付款界面仍可使用，但 Adyen 将收不到这些分析事件。

en.description: Adyen Drop-in starts this service for a session checkout; it submits payments and additional verification details, checks balances, manages orders, and returns session updates.
en.disableEffect: Adyen Drop-in session payments and the order actions that depend on this service will not complete.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开 Adyen Drop-in 会话结账时会启动此服务；它提交付款和补充验证资料、查询余额、管理订单并返回会话更新。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此服务的 Adyen Drop-in 会话付款和订单操作将无法完成。

en.description: When an app opens Adyen Drop-in checkout, this screen presents payment methods and guides the selected method through payment and verification. Older integrations also route Adyen checkout return links through this screen.
en.disableEffect: The app's Adyen Drop-in payment flow cannot open or finish.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开 Adyen Drop-in 结账时，此界面会展示付款方式，并引导用户完成所选方式的付款和验证。旧版集成也会通过此界面处理 Adyen 付款返回链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用的 Adyen Drop-in 付款流程将无法打开或完成。

en.description: When a payment link returns to the app, this screen forwards the result to the older Adyen Drop-in checkout.
en.disableEffect: Older Adyen Drop-in payments that leave the app for an external page may not return and finish.

zh-CN.description: 付款链接跳回应用时，此界面会把结果转交给旧版 Adyen Drop-in 结账继续处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 旧版 Adyen Drop-in 跳转到外部页面的付款可能无法返回应用并完成。

en.description: The older Adyen Drop-in session flow binds this service to submit payments and verification details, check balances, manage orders, and refresh available payment methods.
en.disableEffect: Older Adyen Drop-in session payments and related order actions will not complete.

zh-CN.description: 旧版 Adyen Drop-in 会话结账会绑定此服务，以提交付款和验证资料、查询余额、管理订单并更新可用付款方式。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 旧版 Adyen Drop-in 会话付款及相关订单操作将无法完成。

en.description: When an older Adyen Drop-in session opens, this screen presents payment methods and handles payment submission, additional verification, and returned payment actions.
en.disableEffect: Older Adyen Drop-in checkout cannot collect payment details or finish the payment.

zh-CN.description: 旧版 Adyen Drop-in 会话打开时，此界面会展示付款方式，并处理付款提交、补充验证和返回的付款操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 旧版 Adyen Drop-in 将无法收集付款资料或完成付款。

en.description: When card payment is selected, this screen collects the card number, expiry date, security code, and other required card details before submitting payment.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot enter card details and complete card payments through Adyen Checkout.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择银行卡付款时，此界面会收集卡号、有效期、安全码和其他所需资料，然后提交付款。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 Adyen Checkout 输入银行卡资料并完成付款。

en.description: After a UnionPay SecurePlus payment requests SMS verification, this screen accepts the code and returns it to the payment flow.
en.disableEffect: UnionPay payments that require this SMS verification cannot finish.

zh-CN.description: 银联 SecurePlus 付款要求短信验证时，此界面会收集验证码并交回付款流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要此短信验证的银联付款将无法完成。

en.description: When a saved UnionPay SecurePlus card is used, this screen asks for the card security code and phone number, then opens SMS verification if the issuer requests it.
en.disableEffect: Saved UnionPay SecurePlus card payments cannot complete their security checks.

zh-CN.description: 用户使用已保存的银联 SecurePlus 卡付款时，此界面会要求输入安全码和手机号；发卡方要求时还会继续短信验证。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 已保存的银联 SecurePlus 卡将无法完成安全验证和付款。

en.description: When the app opens Adyen's checkout, this screen lists available and saved payment methods and lets the user choose or remove a saved method.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot choose or manage payment methods in this Adyen checkout flow.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开 Adyen 结账时，此界面会列出可用和已保存的付款方式，并允许用户选择或移除已保存的方式。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在此 Adyen 结账流程中选择或管理付款方式。

en.description: When a payment requires an external bank or wallet page, this screen opens it and handles the return link and payment result.
en.disableEffect: Payments that redirect to an external bank or wallet may not return to the app and complete.

zh-CN.description: 付款需要跳转到银行或钱包页面时，此界面会打开外部页面，并处理返回链接和付款结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 跳转到外部银行或钱包的付款可能无法返回应用并完成。

en.description: Selecting DOKU opens this screen to collect the shopper's email and name before submitting the payment.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot provide the details needed to complete DOKU payments through Adyen Checkout.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择 DOKU 付款时，此界面会收集邮箱和姓名，然后提交付款。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法填写 Adyen Checkout 中 DOKU 付款所需的资料。

en.description: Selecting giropay opens this screen to search participating banks, choose one, and submit that bank selection for payment.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot choose a bank and complete giropay payments through Adyen Checkout.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择 giropay 付款时，此界面会查找可用银行、提交银行选择并继续付款。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在 Adyen Checkout 中选择银行并完成 giropay 付款。

en.description: Some Adyen bank payment methods require an issuer choice; this screen lists the available institutions and submits the user's selection.
en.disableEffect: Payment methods that require choosing an issuer cannot be completed.

zh-CN.description: 部分 Adyen 银行付款方式需要选择发卡机构；此界面会列出可选机构并提交用户的选择。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要选择发卡机构的付款方式将无法完成。

en.description: Selecting an invoice or pay-later method opens this screen to collect required personal details, billing or delivery addresses, and consent; some methods also request an identity-number lookup before payment.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot provide the information required to complete the selected invoice or pay-later payment.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择账单或先买后付方式时，此界面会收集所需个人资料、账单或配送地址及同意信息；部分方式还会在付款前查询身份号码。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法提交所选账单或先买后付方式要求的资料并完成付款。

en.description: Selecting the QIWI wallet opens this screen to collect a country calling code and phone number before starting the payment.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot provide the phone details needed to continue QIWI wallet payments through Adyen Checkout.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择 QIWI 钱包时，此界面会收集国家区号和手机号，然后继续付款。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法填写 Adyen Checkout 中 QIWI 钱包付款所需的手机号资料。

en.description: Selecting SEPA Direct Debit opens this screen to validate the IBAN and account holder name and obtain consent before submitting the debit payment.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot enter the bank details and consent needed to complete SEPA Direct Debit payments.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择 SEPA 直接扣款时，此界面会验证 IBAN 和账户姓名、收集同意信息，然后提交扣款付款。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法输入完成 SEPA 直接扣款所需的银行资料并表示同意。

en.description: When the app provisions an issued payment card, this screen passes the card and billing details to Google Wallet; it can also create the wallet when needed.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot add the issued card to Google Wallet or complete the related wallet setup.

zh-CN.description: 应用为发卡方的支付卡办理数字化添加时，此界面会把卡片和账单资料交给 Google Wallet；需要时也会创建钱包。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法把发卡方的卡添加到 Google Wallet，也无法完成相关钱包设置。

en.description: When a card issuer requests 3D Secure verification, this screen presents the challenge, such as entering a code, choosing an option, approving out of band, or completing a web challenge, and returns the response to payment authentication.
en.disableEffect: Card payments that require a 3D Secure challenge may fail authentication and cannot complete.

zh-CN.description: 发卡方要求 3D Secure 验证时，此界面会显示验证步骤，例如输入验证码、选择选项、在其他渠道确认或完成网页验证，并把结果交回付款认证流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要 3D Secure 挑战的银行卡付款可能无法通过认证或完成。

en.description: When the app starts a bank-link session, this screen opens Aerosync's bank connection page and returns link-flow events to the app.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot connect or finish linking a bank account through Aerosync.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动银行连接流程时，此界面会打开 Aerosync 的银行连接页面，并把连接进度和结果交回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 Aerosync 连接银行账户或完成绑定。

en.description: When the app requests an Aevi X.Pay direct transaction, this screen launches the selected supported payment terminal app and returns the transaction result.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot complete X.Pay transactions that use this direct payment flow.

zh-CN.description: 应用发起 Aevi X.Pay 直接交易时，此界面会启动所选的受支持支付终端应用，并返回交易结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法完成依赖此直接付款流程的 X.Pay 交易。

en.description: When the app connects to a paired Bluetooth X.Pay payment terminal, this service maintains the connection and exchanges transaction messages with the terminal.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot connect to the Bluetooth terminal or exchange its payment transaction messages.

zh-CN.description: 应用连接已配对的蓝牙 X.Pay 支付终端时，此服务会维护连接并与终端交换交易消息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法连接蓝牙终端或与其交换付款交易消息。

en.description: When the app uses an X.Pay terminal on its local network, this service discovers the saved terminal and maintains the transaction connection.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot discover or communicate with the X.Pay terminal over the local network.

zh-CN.description: 应用通过局域网使用 X.Pay 终端时，此服务会发现已保存的终端并维护交易连接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法通过局域网发现 X.Pay 终端或与其通信。

en.description: When the app starts an Affirm checkout, this screen presents Affirm's financing flow and returns the purchase token, cancellation, or error to the app.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot finish the Affirm checkout offered by the app.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动 Affirm 结账时，此界面会展示 Affirm 融资流程，并把购买令牌、取消或错误结果返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法完成应用提供的 Affirm 结账。

en.description: Within Affirm's virtual-card checkout, this screen lets the buyer adjust the purchase amount before continuing to card checkout.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot set the amount and continue through this Affirm virtual-card payment flow.

zh-CN.description: 在 Affirm 虚拟卡结账流程中，此界面允许用户调整购买金额，然后继续办理虚拟卡付款。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在此 Affirm 虚拟卡付款流程中设置金额并继续。

en.description: When the app requests an Affirm financing prequalification modal for a purchase amount, this screen displays the prompt and returns its outcome.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot show or complete this Affirm prequalification prompt.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求显示指定金额的 Affirm 融资预审弹窗时，此界面会展示预审内容并返回结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法显示或完成此 Affirm 融资预审流程。

en.description: When the app requests an Affirm prequalification check for a purchase amount, this screen presents the check and returns its result or error.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot complete the Affirm prequalification flow offered by the app.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求针对指定金额进行 Affirm 预审时，此界面会展示预审流程并返回结果或错误。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法完成应用提供的 Affirm 融资预审流程。

en.description: When the buyer chooses Affirm virtual-card checkout, this screen guides card creation and returns the card details, cancellation, or error to the app.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot complete the Affirm virtual-card checkout offered by the app.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择 Affirm 虚拟卡结账时，此界面会引导创建卡片，并把卡片资料、取消或错误结果返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法完成应用提供的 Affirm 虚拟卡结账。

en.description: After Affirm creates a virtual card, this screen displays the card and purchase amount, lets the user copy or cancel the card, and returns the chosen result.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot view or use the Affirm virtual card created for this purchase.

zh-CN.description: Affirm 创建虚拟卡后，此界面会显示卡片和购买金额，允许用户复制或取消卡片，并返回相应结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法查看或使用为此次购买创建的 Affirm 虚拟卡。

en.description: When a shopper opens an Afterpay information link, this screen displays the supplied explanation page. If the screen is unavailable, the SDK opens the link with the system handler instead.
en.disableEffect: The in-app Afterpay information page will not open, and its link will fall back to the system handler or browser while checkout remains available.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 Afterpay 说明链接时，此界面会显示相应说明页面。若此界面不可用，SDK 会改用系统程序打开链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Afterpay 应用内说明页将无法打开，链接会改由系统程序或浏览器处理，结账流程仍可使用。

en.description: When a buyer starts Afterpay checkout, this screen loads the approved checkout page and returns the order token after success or a cancellation result if the buyer leaves.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot complete the Afterpay checkout flow opened by the app.

zh-CN.description: 用户启动 Afterpay 结账时，此界面会打开经验证的结账页面，并在成功后返回订单令牌，或在用户离开时返回取消结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法完成应用打开的 Afterpay 结账流程。

en.description: When the app starts Afterpay Express checkout, this screen obtains the checkout token, opens the checkout page, and returns the order token or cancellation to the app.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot complete the Afterpay Express checkout flow offered by the app.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动 Afterpay Express 结账时，此界面会获取结账令牌、打开结账页面，并把订单令牌或取消结果返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法完成应用提供的 Afterpay Express 结账流程。

en.description: When the app starts Afterpay Checkout V3, this screen requests and displays the checkout, then returns a success or cancellation result to the app.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot complete the Afterpay Checkout V3 payment offered by the app.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动 Afterpay Checkout V3 时，此界面会请求并展示结账流程，然后把成功或取消结果返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法完成应用提供的 Afterpay Checkout V3 付款。

en.description: The File Log Provider library stores app messages in rotating files and can record crashes. Apps with its pre-unlock support can also log before the device is unlocked.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it stops the app from recording logs and crashes; an app that depends on this library to start logging may also fail during that setup.

zh-CN.description: File Log Provider 库会把应用消息和崩溃信息写入轮换日志文件。启用了相关支持的应用还能在设备解锁前记录日志。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后应用将无法通过此库保存日志和崩溃记录；依赖它启动日志功能的应用在初始化时也可能失败。

en.description: Port2's Whiteboard meeting SDK starts this service when the app opens its floating meeting whiteboard. It displays the shared board and a control for hiding or showing it.
en.disableEffect: The floating meeting whiteboard will not open.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开悬浮会议白板时，Port2 的 Whiteboard 会议 SDK 会启动此服务，显示共享白板及其显示控制。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 悬浮会议白板将无法打开。

en.description: AhmerUtils (Ahmer Afzal) opens this activity after an uncaught app error to prepare a crash report with the error, app and device details, and available logs or screenshot. It then opens the system chooser to send the report by email.
en.disableEffect: The app’s built-in crash-report email flow will not be available.

zh-CN.description: AhmerUtils（Ahmer Afzal）会在应用发生未捕获错误后打开此 Activity，整理错误、应用和设备信息以及可用的日志或截图，再打开系统选择器通过邮件发送报告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用内置的崩溃报告邮件流程将无法使用。

en.description: AhmerUtils (Ahmer Afzal) provides screenshot and log files to the crash-report email flow so another app can attach them. It runs when the report shares those files.
en.disableEffect: Crash reports will be unable to attach the saved screenshot and logs.

zh-CN.description: AhmerUtils（Ahmer Afzal）会向崩溃报告邮件流程提供截图和日志文件，供其他应用作为附件读取；报告分享这些文件时会调用它。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 崩溃报告将无法附加保存的截图和日志。

en.description: AhmerUtils (Ahmer Afzal) uses this Activity to identify the visible screen for a crash-report screenshot. It records itself when shown and clears that reference when it leaves the foreground.
en.disableEffect: Crash reports will not include a screenshot of the active screen; the app’s other features continue to work.

zh-CN.description: AhmerUtils（Ahmer Afzal）使用此 Activity 识别崩溃截图对应的当前页面；页面显示时会记录自身，离开前台时会清除记录。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 崩溃报告将不包含当前页面的截图，应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: AhmerUtils (Ahmer Afzal) opens this Activity to explain a denied permission and launch Android’s app settings when the app needs the user to restore that permission. It returns the result to the screen that requested the dialog.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot show this permission-recovery dialog or open settings through this flow.

zh-CN.description: AhmerUtils（Ahmer Afzal）会打开此 Activity 说明被拒绝的权限，并在应用需要恢复该权限时跳转到 Android 应用设置；结果会返回给发起对话框的页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法通过此流程显示权限恢复对话框或打开设置。

en.description: When the Ahmer Utils library starts with the app, this provider initializes the library and supplies file links for files the app opens or shares.
en.disableEffect: Ahmer Utils initialization and file-sharing actions that depend on this provider may fail.

zh-CN.description: Ahmer Utils 库随应用启动时，此 Provider 会初始化库，并为应用打开或分享的文件提供访问链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Ahmer Utils 初始化以及依赖此 Provider 的文件分享操作可能失效。

en.description: When Ahmer Utils needs a short-lived screen for a permission request or activity result, this transparent Activity carries out the request and returns the result to the app.
en.disableEffect: Permission prompts and other utility actions that rely on this screen may fail.

zh-CN.description: Ahmer Utils 需要请求权限或接收其他界面结果时，会短暂打开此透明 Activity 处理请求并把结果交还应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此界面的权限请求和其他工具操作可能失效。

en.description: When an Ahmer Utils task needs a screen in the app main process, this transparent Activity hosts the brief task and returns its result to the app.
en.disableEffect: Main-process utility prompts and result-returning actions that rely on this screen may fail.

zh-CN.description: Ahmer Utils 的任务需要在应用主进程中使用界面时，此透明 Activity 会短暂承载该任务并把结果交还应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此界面的主进程工具提示和结果返回操作可能失效。

en.description: AnyLife's face verification SDK uses this Android file provider to make files in the app's configured folders available through temporary file links. The SDK can request these links when a verification step needs a file.
en.disableEffect: Face-verification steps that need to read or share one of these files may fail.

zh-CN.description: AnyLife 人脸验证 SDK 使用此 Android 文件提供程序，通过临时文件链接提供应用已配置目录中的文件；验证步骤需要文件时会使用这些链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，需要读取或共享这些文件的人脸验证步骤可能失败。

en.description: AnyLife's FaceAI, FaceAISDK, FaceRecognition, and FaceSearchSDK use this Android file provider to make app files available through temporary file links when a face-analysis flow needs them.
en.disableEffect: Face-recognition and face-analysis flows that need these files may fail.

zh-CN.description: AnyLife 的 FaceAI、FaceAISDK、FaceRecognition 和 FaceSearchSDK 使用此 Android 文件提供程序，在人脸分析流程需要文件时通过临时链接提供应用文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，需要这些文件的人脸识别和分析流程可能失败。

en.description: AnyLife's face-search SDK uses this Android file provider to make files in the app's configured folders available through temporary file links during face searches.
en.disableEffect: Face-search steps that need to read or share one of these files may fail.

zh-CN.description: AnyLife 人脸搜索 SDK 使用此 Android 文件提供程序，在人脸搜索期间通过临时文件链接提供应用已配置目录中的文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，需要读取或共享这些文件的人脸搜索步骤可能失败。

en.description: The Aigens SDK starts this Activity from the host app with a page address and opens the page in an in-app web view. It also handles app redirects and loads the SDK's native payment and utility integrations.
en.disableEffect: The Aigens web flow cannot open or return from its page, so checkout and other web features that use it may stop working.

zh-CN.description: Aigens SDK 会由本应用传入页面地址并启动此 Activity，在应用内打开该页面。它还会处理应用跳转，并加载 SDK 的原生支付和工具功能。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Aigens 网页流程将无法打开页面或从页面返回，依赖它的结账及其他网页功能可能无法使用。

en.description: When an app opens an Aigens OrderPlace page, this Activity displays the supplied online ordering page with the SDK navigation and options.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to open or complete online orders through this Aigens screen.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开 Aigens OrderPlace 页面时，此 Activity 会显示指定的在线订购页面以及 SDK 提供的导航和选项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此 Aigens 界面打开或完成在线订购。

en.description: When the Aigens OrderPlace SDK receives a code-scan request, this Activity opens the camera reader and returns decoded text or opens a scanned web link as an order page.
en.disableEffect: Code scanning and scan-to-order links through this Aigens SDK will no longer work.

zh-CN.description: Aigens OrderPlace SDK 收到扫码请求时，此 Activity 会打开相机扫码界面，并返回识别文本，或将扫到的网址作为订购页面打开。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 此 Aigens SDK 的扫码和扫码进入订购页面功能将无法使用。

en.description: During an Aigens checkout using Adyen Drop-in, this payment service forwards submitted payment details and follow-up authentication details to the app, then returns the next payment action or final result.
en.disableEffect: Adyen payment submission and follow-up authentication cannot complete through the Aigens flow.

zh-CN.description: 在使用 Adyen Drop-in 的 Aigens 结账流程中，此支付服务会将已提交的支付信息和后续验证信息交给本应用，再返回下一步支付操作或最终结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Aigens 流程中的 Adyen 支付提交和后续验证将无法完成。

en.description: HackServer (nbox1989) declares this private file provider to serve app-owned files through content links when the debugging tools request them.
en.disableEffect: File links served through HackServer may not open.

zh-CN.description: HackServer（nbox1989）会用此私有文件提供程序在调试工具请求时通过内容链接提供应用文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过 HackServer 提供的文件链接可能无法打开。

en.description: HackServer (nbox1989) starts this VPN service when its debugging tools request traffic capture and the user allows the VPN. It routes IPv4 traffic through a local capture interface.
en.disableEffect: HackServer's VPN-based network capture will not start.

zh-CN.description: HackServer（nbox1989）会在调试工具请求流量捕获且用户授权 VPN 后启动此服务，并通过本地捕获接口路由 IPv4 流量。
zh-CN.disableEffect: HackServer 将无法启动基于 VPN 的网络流量捕获。

en.description: Airbnb Showkase opens a developer browser for the app's registered Compose components, colors, and typography. The app launches it with a module identifier so it can display that module's catalog.
en.disableEffect: Developers can no longer open the app's Compose component catalog through Showkase.

zh-CN.description: Airbnb Showkase 会打开开发者浏览器，用于查看应用注册的 Compose 组件、颜色和字体样式。本应用会传入模块标识，让它显示对应目录。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 开发者将无法再通过 Showkase 打开应用的 Compose 组件目录。

en.description: The Airbnb Mavericks debug launcher opens the app's list of registered mock screens for preview. The library manifest marks it for command-line launch in debug builds.
en.disableEffect: The Mavericks developer launcher and its mock-screen list cannot be opened.

zh-CN.description: Airbnb Mavericks 调试启动器会打开应用中已注册的模拟界面列表，供开发者预览。库清单注明它用于调试版本的命令行启动。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Mavericks 开发者启动器及其模拟界面列表将无法打开。

en.description: The Airbnb Mavericks debug flow opens this screen after a developer selects a mock, displaying the selected app view for inspection.
en.disableEffect: Developers cannot preview a selected mock screen through the Mavericks launcher.

zh-CN.description: 开发者在 Airbnb Mavericks 调试流程中选择模拟界面后，此界面会显示所选应用界面以供检查。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 开发者将无法通过 Mavericks 启动器预览选定的模拟界面。

en.description: The Airbnb Mavericks test launcher opens queued mock screens one by one and reports when they all finish without a crash.
en.disableEffect: The Mavericks developer tools can no longer run their batch mock-screen crash check.

zh-CN.description: Airbnb Mavericks 测试启动器会逐个打开排队的模拟界面，并在它们均未崩溃地完成后显示结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Mavericks 开发者工具将无法再批量运行模拟界面崩溃检查。

en.description: The Airbnb MvRx debug launcher opens the app's list of registered mock screens for preview. The library manifest marks it for command-line launch in debug builds.
en.disableEffect: The MvRx developer launcher and its mock-screen list cannot be opened.

zh-CN.description: Airbnb MvRx 调试启动器会打开应用中已注册的模拟界面列表，供开发者预览。库清单注明它用于调试版本的命令行启动。
zh-CN.disableEffect: MvRx 开发者启动器及其模拟界面列表将无法打开。

en.description: The Airbnb MvRx debug flow opens this screen after a developer selects a mock, displaying the selected app view for inspection.
en.disableEffect: Developers cannot preview a selected mock screen through the MvRx launcher.

zh-CN.description: 开发者在 Airbnb MvRx 调试流程中选择模拟界面后，此界面会显示所选应用界面以供检查。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 开发者将无法通过 MvRx 启动器预览选定的模拟界面。

en.description: The Airbnb MvRx test launcher opens queued mock screens one by one and reports when they all finish without a crash.
en.disableEffect: The MvRx developer tools can no longer run their batch mock-screen crash check.

zh-CN.description: Airbnb MvRx 测试启动器会逐个打开排队的模拟界面，并在它们均未崩溃地完成后显示结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: MvRx 开发者工具将无法再批量运行模拟界面崩溃检查。

en.description: When Airnow Media Network starts a full-screen interstitial or rewarded ad, this Activity displays the ad and passes user actions back to the ad flow.
en.disableEffect: Airnow full-screen ads will not appear; rewarded ads cannot be completed, so rewards for watching ads will not be granted.

zh-CN.description: Airnow Media Network 启动全屏插屏或激励广告时，此 Activity 会显示广告并将用户操作交回广告流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Airnow 全屏广告将不会显示；激励广告无法完成，观看广告的奖励也不会发放。

en.description: Airsaid Sample Core opens a Fragment selected by the app's sample browser and shows its title and description in a dedicated sample screen.
en.disableEffect: The sample browser cannot show Fragment-based sample details through this screen.

zh-CN.description: Airsaid Sample Core 会打开应用示例浏览器选中的 Fragment，并在专用示例界面中显示标题和说明。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 示例浏览器将无法通过此界面显示基于 Fragment 的示例详情。

en.description: When an Airwallex card checkout needs the card security code, the payment flow opens this screen. It shows the selected card and total, collects the code, and submits the payment.
en.disableEffect: A card payment that requires this confirmation cannot be completed.

zh-CN.description: 当 Airwallex 银行卡付款需要安全码时，结账流程会打开此页面。页面显示所选卡片和金额，收集安全码并提交付款。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要此项确认的银行卡付款将无法完成。

en.description: Airwallex opens this screen when card checkout offers dynamic currency conversion. It shows the transaction and converted amounts with the exchange rate, then continues with the selected currency.
en.disableEffect: A payment that requires this currency choice cannot continue.

zh-CN.description: 银行卡结账提供动态货币转换时，Airwallex 会打开此页面。页面显示交易金额、换算后的金额和汇率，并按用户选定的货币继续付款。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要此项货币选择的付款将无法继续。

en.description: When a customer chooses Google Pay in Airwallex checkout, this screen starts wallet authorization and returns the wallet result to the payment flow.
en.disableEffect: Google Pay payments that use this screen cannot be completed.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Airwallex 结账时选择 Google Pay 后，此页面会启动钱包授权，并将授权结果交回付款流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此页面的 Google Pay 付款将无法完成。

en.description: When a card issuer requires 3-D Secure verification during Airwallex checkout, this screen loads the issuer verification page and sends the result back to payment processing.
en.disableEffect: A card payment that requires this verification cannot be completed.

zh-CN.description: 银行卡付款需要 3-D Secure 验证时，此页面会加载发卡机构的验证页面，并将结果交回 Airwallex 付款流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要此项验证的银行卡付款将无法完成。

en.description: When a customer adds a card in Airwallex checkout, this screen collects the payment and billing details and returns the new method or checkout result.
en.disableEffect: Customers cannot add a card or complete a checkout path that opens this form.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Airwallex 结账时添加银行卡，此页面会收集付款和账单信息，并将新支付方式或结账结果交回流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法添加银行卡，也无法完成需要此表单的结账流程。

en.description: Airwallex opens this screen when a payment offers dynamic currency conversion. It shows the transaction and converted amounts, lets the customer choose which currency to pay in, and continues the payment.
en.disableEffect: A payment that requires this currency choice cannot continue.

zh-CN.description: 付款提供动态货币转换时，Airwallex 会打开此页面。页面显示交易金额和换算金额，让用户选择付款货币，然后继续付款。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要此项货币选择的付款将无法继续。

en.description: Airwallex opens this screen to confirm a selected payment method during checkout. It shows the method, collects any required card security code, and submits the payment.
en.disableEffect: Customers cannot complete checkout flows that use this payment confirmation screen.

zh-CN.description: Airwallex 会在结账确认所选支付方式时打开此页面。页面显示支付方式、收集所需的银行卡安全码，并提交付款。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法完成需要此付款确认页面的结账流程。

en.description: When Airwallex checkout asks for a payment method, this screen lists saved methods and lets the customer choose one or add a card. Flows configured to include checkout can continue payment from this screen.
en.disableEffect: Customers cannot choose or manage saved payment methods through this screen, and checkout flows that use it cannot continue.

zh-CN.description: Airwallex 结账需要选择支付方式时，此页面会列出已保存的方式，并允许用户选择一种或添加银行卡。包含结账步骤的流程也可从此页面继续付款。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此页面选择或管理已保存的支付方式，依赖此页面的结账流程也无法继续。

en.description: When an Airwallex checkout requests shipping information, this screen collects the recipient contact details and delivery address, then returns them to checkout.
en.disableEffect: Checkout flows that require a shipping address cannot continue.

zh-CN.description: Airwallex 结账需要配送信息时，此页面会收集收件人的联系方式和配送地址，并将信息交回结账流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要配送地址的结账流程将无法继续。

en.description: When an Airwallex card payment requires 3-D Secure issuer authentication, this screen opens the issuer challenge in a web page and returns its result to checkout.
en.disableEffect: A card payment that requires this authentication cannot be completed.

zh-CN.description: Airwallex 银行卡付款需要 3-D Secure 发卡机构验证时，此页面会在网页中打开验证挑战，并将结果交回结账流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要此项验证的银行卡付款将无法完成。

en.description: After a customer authorizes a payment with WeChat Pay, this screen processes WeChat return data and hands the result back to Airwallex checkout.
en.disableEffect: WeChat Pay authorization cannot return to the app correctly, so the payment may not complete.

zh-CN.description: 用户通过微信支付授权后，此页面会处理微信返回的数据，并将结果交回 Airwallex 结账流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 微信支付授权将无法正常返回应用，付款可能无法完成。

en.description: The AISpeech DUI/DDS notification monitor receives notification events after the user enables its accessibility service. It forwards each notification and the source app name to the SDK's notification listener.
en.disableEffect: The SDK cannot monitor notifications or deliver notification updates to the app's listener.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Android 无障碍设置中启用 AISpeech DUI/DDS 通知监控后，此服务会接收通知事件，并将通知及来源应用名称交给 SDK 的通知监听器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: SDK 将无法监控通知，也无法向本应用的监听器传递通知更新。

en.description: The AISpeech DUI/DDS debug receiver responds to diagnostic broadcasts for remote settings, bus topic and RPC calls, local configuration changes, and event injection.
en.disableEffect: Broadcast-based DDS debugging and event-injection controls will no longer reach the SDK.

zh-CN.description: AISpeech DUI/DDS 调试接收器会处理诊断广播，用于远程设置、总线主题和 RPC 调用、本地配置更改及事件注入。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 基于广播的 DDS 调试和事件注入控制将无法再传递到 SDK。

en.description: The AkeXorcist KnoxActivator wrapper receives Android device-admin enable and disable callbacks. When administrator access is removed, it notifies the app's Knox event listener and can show the system warning before removal.
en.disableEffect: The app may miss Knox administrator removal and lose its device-admin activation flow.

zh-CN.description: AkeXorcist KnoxActivator 封装会接收 Android 设备管理员启用和停用回调。管理员权限被移除时，它会通知应用的 Knox 事件监听器，并可在移除前显示系统警告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 本应用可能无法获知 Knox 管理员权限已被移除，设备管理员激活流程也可能受影响。

en.description: The AkeXorcist KnoxActivator wrapper registers this Android device-administrator receiver for Knox activation. Its subclass adds no extra callback behavior of its own.
en.disableEffect: Android cannot deliver the Knox device-admin activation event to the app, so Knox administrator setup may fail.

zh-CN.description: AkeXorcist KnoxActivator 封装会将此接收器注册为 Android 设备管理员，以支持 Knox 激活。该子类本身没有额外的回调处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Android 将无法向本应用传递 Knox 设备管理员激活事件，Knox 管理员设置可能失败。

en.description: The AkeXorcist KnoxActivator wrapper listens for Knox license-status broadcasts and tells the app whether activation succeeded or failed.
en.disableEffect: The app no longer receives the Knox license result, so licensed enterprise features may not initialize.

zh-CN.description: AkeXorcist KnoxActivator 封装会监听 Knox 许可证状态广播，并告知应用激活成功或失败。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 本应用将无法收到 Knox 许可证结果，依赖许可证的企业功能可能无法初始化。

en.description: AkeXorcist LocalizationActivity launches this brief blank screen during a language change, then closes it with the library's transition. It is a handoff while the host screen is recreated in the new locale.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it can interrupt the locale-change handoff, so the app's language-change flow may fail.

zh-CN.description: 更改语言时，AkeXorcist LocalizationActivity 会启动此短暂的空白界面，播放库内过渡效果后将其关闭。主界面会在此交接过程中按新语言重新创建。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，语言切换交接流程可能中断，导致本应用无法正常切换语言。

en.description: AkeXorcist LocalizationActivity launches this brief blank screen during a language change, then closes it with the library's transition. It is a handoff while the host screen is recreated in the new locale.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it can interrupt the locale-change handoff, so the app's language-change flow may fail.

zh-CN.description: 更改语言时，AkeXorcist LocalizationActivity 会启动此短暂的空白界面，播放库内过渡效果后将其关闭。主界面会在此交接过程中按新语言重新创建。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，语言切换交接流程可能中断，导致本应用无法正常切换语言。

en.description: Alan's voice-assistant SDK runs this foreground service while the app is listening, showing an ongoing notification that says the app is using the microphone.
en.disableEffect: Alan's listening service cannot stay active in the foreground, so voice-assistant listening stops.

zh-CN.description: Alan 语音助手 SDK 会在应用处于聆听状态时运行此前台服务，并持续显示应用正在使用麦克风的通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后 Alan 的聆听服务无法在前台保持运行，语音助手聆听会停止。

en.description: Alan's voice-assistant SDK opens this screen when it needs microphone access; it requests audio-recording permission and reports the user's choice back to the SDK.
en.disableEffect: The SDK cannot request or receive microphone permission through this flow, so voice input cannot be enabled here.

zh-CN.description: Alan 语音助手 SDK 需要麦克风时会打开此界面，请求录音权限并将用户的选择返回给 SDK。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后 SDK 无法通过此流程请求或接收麦克风权限，因此无法在此启用语音输入。

en.description: Alan's SDK opens this screen for its camera-based code-scanning flow; it requests camera permission, scans a code, and returns the decoded text to the app.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot scan and receive codes through Alan's scanning screen.

zh-CN.description: Alan SDK 会为相机扫码流程打开此界面，请求相机权限、扫描代码并将识别出的文字返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后应用无法通过 Alan 的扫码界面扫描并接收代码。

en.description: The ALE Rainbow SDK registers with Android Telecom for its VoIP calls. When Android asks about an incoming or outgoing Rainbow call, this service creates a system call connection and links it with the SDK's call state.
en.disableEffect: Rainbow calls lose Android Telecom integration, so native call presentation and controls may fail.

zh-CN.description: ALE Rainbow SDK 会为其网络电话向 Android Telecom 注册。Android 收到或拨出 Rainbow 通话时，此服务会创建系统通话连接，并与 SDK 的通话状态关联。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Rainbow 通话将失去 Android Telecom 集成，系统通话界面和控制功能可能无法正常工作。

en.description: Alex Styl Warden opens Android's system prompt for a requested set of runtime permissions and returns the user's grant decisions to the app.
en.disableEffect: Warden cannot request or report runtime permissions, so app features that depend on them cannot complete their permission request.

zh-CN.description: Alex Styl Warden 会打开 Android 系统权限提示，请求一组运行时权限，并将用户的授权结果返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Warden 将无法请求运行时权限或返回授权结果，依赖这些权限的应用功能也无法完成权限申请。

en.description: Alibaba Member Account SDK opens this screen when the app starts account sign-in, single sign-on, or QR login, then returns the authentication result to the requesting flow.
en.disableEffect: Account sign-in flows that use Alibaba Member Account SDK may not open or complete.

zh-CN.description: 阿里巴巴会员账号 SDK 会在应用发起账号登录、单点登录令牌登录或二维码登录时打开此页面，并将认证结果交回登录流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用通过阿里巴巴会员账号 SDK 使用的登录流程可能无法打开或完成。

en.description: Alibaba Member Account SDK opens this embedded browser during web sign-in; it refreshes the account session and returns login or cancellation results to the app.
en.disableEffect: Alibaba account sign-in flows that use this browser may fail to open or finish.

zh-CN.description: 阿里巴巴会员账号 SDK 会在网页账号登录时打开此内置浏览器，刷新账号会话，并把登录或取消结果返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，使用此浏览器的阿里巴巴账号登录流程可能无法打开或完成。

en.description: Alibaba Member Account SDK opens this page to display the supplied QR sign-in page in a web view and complete account authorization.
en.disableEffect: QR account sign-in flows that use this page may not open or finish.

zh-CN.description: 阿里巴巴会员账号 SDK 会在此页面的网页视图中显示二维码登录页面，并完成账号授权。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，使用此页面的二维码账号登录流程可能无法打开或完成。

en.description: Alibaba Member Account SDK uses this embedded page for the account-confirmation step in a QR sign-in flow.
en.disableEffect: QR sign-in flows that require this confirmation page may not complete.

zh-CN.description: 阿里巴巴会员账号 SDK 会在二维码登录流程中使用此内置页面完成账号确认。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，需要此确认页面的二维码登录流程可能无法完成。

en.description: Alibaba Member Account SDK registers this shared in-app browser for account pages; it loads the URL supplied by an authentication flow and returns a cancellation result when the user backs out.
en.disableEffect: An account flow that launches this shared page directly may not open or finish.

zh-CN.description: 阿里巴巴会员账号 SDK 将此页面用作账号网页的内置浏览器；它会加载认证流程传入的网址，并在用户返回时交回取消结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，直接打开此共享页面的账号流程可能无法显示或完成。

en.description: Tanx advertising, Quick A+ analytics, and Alibaba trade integrations use Alibaba Analytics to process event data. It runs separately when one of these SDKs connects to it.
en.disableEffect: These integrations may stop collecting or reporting analytics events, while the app's own screens and flows remain available.

zh-CN.description: Tanx 广告、Quick A+ 统计和阿里巴巴交易组件会使用阿里巴巴统计服务；相关 SDK 连接时，它会在独立进程中处理事件数据。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，这些组件可能停止收集或上报统计事件，但应用自身的页面和流程仍可使用。

en.description: Alibaba SecurityGuard's middle-tier verification opens this web page for a session-specific security challenge and sends the result back to the SDK. It can also handle security-package download or update links.
en.disableEffect: Security checks or update actions that rely on this page may not complete, blocking an app feature that depends on them.

zh-CN.description: 阿里巴巴安全组件会在此网页中显示与当前会话相关的安全验证，并将结果返回给 SDK。此页面也可处理安全组件的下载或更新链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，依赖此页面的安全验证或更新操作可能无法完成，相关应用功能也可能受影响。

en.description: Alibaba Cloud RUM's test link starts a built-in test operation and passes its inputs to the RUM SDK.
en.disableEffect: Alibaba Cloud RUM's built-in test link will no longer run its test operation.

zh-CN.description: 阿里云 RUM 的测试链接会启动内置测试操作，并将输入参数交给 RUM SDK。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，阿里云 RUM 的内置测试链接将无法运行测试操作。

en.description: Alibaba Cloud RUM opens this screen after a test to show whether it succeeded and any error message.
en.disableEffect: The result of an Alibaba Cloud RUM test will no longer appear on this screen.

zh-CN.description: 阿里云 RUM 会在测试后打开此页面，显示测试是否成功以及错误信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，阿里云 RUM 测试结果将不会显示在此页面。

en.description: Alike Audience's audience-measurement SDK receives network-change broadcasts and resumes background device-data tracking when its saved SDK key is available.
en.disableEffect: Audience-data tracking will no longer restart automatically after network changes.

zh-CN.description: Alike Audience 受众测量 SDK 收到网络状态变化广播后，会在已保存 SDK 密钥时恢复后台设备数据跟踪。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，网络状态变化时不会自动恢复受众数据跟踪。

en.description: Alike Audience's audience-measurement SDK saves the Google Play install source when the store sends the installation referral.
en.disableEffect: The SDK will no longer record Google Play install-source information for attribution.

zh-CN.description: Alike Audience 受众测量 SDK 收到 Google Play 安装来源广播时，会保存安装来源信息用于归因。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，SDK 将无法记录 Google Play 安装来源信息。

en.description: When enabled, Alike Audience's audience-measurement SDK uses the device-start broadcast to resume tracking if the app has saved an SDK key.
en.disableEffect: The SDK will not automatically resume audience-data tracking after device startup.

zh-CN.description: 启用后，Alike Audience 受众测量 SDK 会在设备启动广播到达时检查已保存的 SDK 密钥并恢复跟踪。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，设备启动后不会自动恢复受众数据跟踪。

en.description: Alike Audience's background service gathers available device, motion, location, and Wi-Fi signals while tracking is active, then periodically sends audience data when the device is online.
en.disableEffect: Alike Audience's background audience measurement and data uploads will stop.

zh-CN.description: Alike Audience 的后台服务会在跟踪开启时收集可用的设备、运动、位置和 Wi-Fi 信息，并在设备联网时定期发送受众数据。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Alike Audience 的后台受众测量和数据上传将停止。

en.description: Alike Audience uses this receiver for scheduled audience-data collection. It gathers available location, nearby Wi-Fi, and installed-app category information, saves a record, and refreshes the SDK's app-category list.
en.disableEffect: Scheduled audience-data collection and app-category updates will stop.

zh-CN.description: Alike Audience 通过此接收器定时收集受众数据，包括可用的位置、附近 Wi-Fi 和已安装应用类别信息，并保存记录、更新 SDK 的应用类别列表。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，定时受众数据收集和应用类别更新将停止。

en.description: After device startup, Alike Audience schedules recurring data collection and upload when its SDK tracking has already been initialized.
en.disableEffect: Background audience collection and upload will not be rescheduled automatically after a reboot.

zh-CN.description: 设备启动后，如果 Alike Audience SDK 已初始化跟踪，此接收器会重新安排定期数据收集和上传。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，设备重启后不会自动重新安排后台受众数据收集和上传。

en.description: When network status changes after Alike Audience tracking has been initialized, this receiver schedules recurring data collection and upload.
en.disableEffect: The SDK will no longer schedule audience-data collection and uploads automatically after network changes.

zh-CN.description: Alike Audience 跟踪初始化后，网络状态变化时此接收器会安排定期数据收集和上传。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，网络状态变化时 SDK 将不会自动安排受众数据收集和上传。

en.description: When its scheduled upload broadcast arrives and the device is online, Alike Audience sends queued audience records with available advertising and device identifiers to its collection service.
en.disableEffect: Collected audience and device data will no longer be uploaded by this SDK.

zh-CN.description: 收到定时上传广播且设备联网时，Alike Audience 会将排队的受众记录及可用的广告和设备标识发送到其数据服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，此 SDK 将不再上传已收集的受众和设备数据。

en.description: Tanx Core SDK opens this portrait rewarded-ad screen to display ad content and a reward countdown. When the required viewing period ends, it reports the reward to the app.
en.disableEffect: The Tanx rewarded-ad screen will not open, so rewards for watching ads will no longer be granted.

zh-CN.description: Tanx Core SDK 会打开此竖屏激励广告界面，展示广告内容和奖励倒计时。达到观看时长后，它会向应用报告奖励结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Tanx 激励广告界面将无法打开，因此用户观看广告后将不再获得奖励。

en.description: Tanx Core SDK opens this portrait Activity to play a rewarded video and its ad content. When playback reaches the completion point, it reports the reward to the app.
en.disableEffect: The Tanx rewarded-video screen will not open, so rewards for watching ads will no longer be granted.

zh-CN.description: Tanx Core SDK 会打开此竖屏界面播放激励视频及其广告内容。视频达到完成条件后，它会向应用报告奖励结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Tanx 激励视频界面将无法打开，因此用户观看广告后将不再获得奖励。

en.description: Tanx Core SDK opens this portrait Activity for a Table Screen ad, displays the ad content, and forwards a shake gesture to the ad interaction.
en.disableEffect: Tanx Table Screen ads and their shake-triggered interactions will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: Tanx Core SDK 会打开此竖屏界面展示 Table Screen 广告，并将摇动设备的手势传递给广告互动。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Tanx Table Screen 广告及其摇动触发的互动将无法打开。

en.description: When the Tanx ad SDK opens a destination URL, this Activity loads the page in its in-app browser and handles browser navigation.
en.disableEffect: Users will no longer be able to open Tanx ad destinations in this in-app browser.

zh-CN.description: Tanx 广告 SDK 打开目标网址时，此界面会在应用内浏览器中加载页面并处理浏览导航。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法再通过此应用内浏览器打开 Tanx 广告的目标页面。

en.description: Alipay's payment bridge opens the Alipay app's order screen for a payment request and returns the wallet result to the app that started it.
en.disableEffect: Alipay payments that use this bridge may fail to open or return their result.

zh-CN.description: 支付宝支付桥接页面会为支付请求打开支付宝的订单页面，并将钱包返回结果交给发起支付的应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，通过此页面发起的支付宝支付可能无法打开或返回结果。

en.description: Alipay's return screen receives the result after an app-based payment or authorization and passes it to the waiting flow in the app.
en.disableEffect: Alipay payment or authorization results may not reach the app, leaving those flows incomplete.

zh-CN.description: 支付宝回跳页面会接收应用支付或授权后的结果，并将结果交回应用中等待的流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，支付宝支付或授权结果可能无法返回应用，相关流程将无法完成。

en.description: Alipay's Android SDK opens its in-app web authorization flow when an app requests Alipay authorization, then returns the result to the caller.
en.disableEffect: Alipay authorization and login flows that use this page will fail.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求支付宝授权时，支付宝 Android SDK 会打开内置网页授权流程，并将结果返回给调用方。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此页面的支付宝授权和登录流程将无法完成。

en.description: Alipay's web authorization screen displays the requested authorization page and hands off to the Alipay app when the flow opens it.
en.disableEffect: Alipay web-authorization flows that use this screen will not complete.

zh-CN.description: 支付宝网页授权页面会展示应用请求的授权内容，并在流程跳转到支付宝应用时完成交接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，使用此页面的支付宝网页授权流程无法完成。

en.description: Alipay's Android SDK opens a payment web page when a checkout request supplies a payment URL, then reports the payment result.
en.disableEffect: Payments routed through Alipay's in-app web checkout will fail.

zh-CN.description: 结算请求提供支付链接时，支付宝 Android SDK 会打开内置支付网页，并返回支付结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过支付宝内置网页收银台完成的支付将无法进行。

en.description: Alipay's payment-return screen receives wallet results and wakes the app's pending payment request; it can also open the Hong Kong wallet for a payment handoff.
en.disableEffect: Alipay wallet payments may not return their result to the app that started them.

zh-CN.description: 支付宝支付回跳页面会接收钱包结果并唤醒应用中等待的支付请求；需要时也会为支付交接打开香港版钱包。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，支付宝钱包支付可能无法将结果返回给发起支付的应用。

en.description: The Alipay Mobile SDK opens this Activity during an authorization request and displays the Alipay authorization page inside the app. It returns the approval or cancellation result to the requesting flow.
en.disableEffect: Alipay authorization flows that use this page cannot display it or return a result.

zh-CN.description: 支付宝移动 SDK 会在发起授权时打开此 Activity，并在应用内显示支付宝授权页面。用户同意或取消后，它会把结果返回给发起授权的流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此页面的支付宝授权将无法显示页面或返回结果。

en.description: During a Zoloz face-verification step that enables playback capture, this foreground Service keeps the audio-capture session running for that verification flow.
en.disableEffect: The playback-capture step may fail, preventing that configured face check from completing.

zh-CN.description: Zoloz 人脸核验启用播放采集步骤时，此前台 Service 会保持音频采集会话运行，供该核验流程使用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 播放采集步骤可能失败，导致相应的人脸核验无法完成。

en.description: During a configured Zoloz face check, this Activity guides the user through a sequence of liveness actions and returns the captured face results to the verification flow.
en.disableEffect: The multi-step face and liveness check that uses this screen cannot be completed.

zh-CN.description: Zoloz 执行已配置的人脸核验时，此 Activity 会引导用户完成一系列活体检测动作，并将采集结果交回核验流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此页面的多步骤人脸和活体检测将无法完成。

en.description: Zoloz opens this Activity for a camera-based face check; it guides the user to show their face, evaluates camera frames, and submits the result.
en.disableEffect: A face-verification flow that uses this screen may not complete.

zh-CN.description: Zoloz 进行基于摄像头的人脸核验时会打开此 Activity，引导用户面对摄像头、分析画面并提交核验结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此页面的人脸核验流程可能无法完成。

en.description: During a Zoloz biometric check, this Activity opens a camera preview, checks face frames, and submits a suitable capture for verification.
en.disableEffect: Face-based identity checks that use this screen cannot finish.

zh-CN.description: Zoloz 执行生物特征核验时，此 Activity 会打开摄像头预览、分析人脸画面，并提交合适的采集结果用于核验。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此页面的人脸身份核验将无法完成。

en.description: When the app opens its AlitaJS interface, this screen loads the configured web app and connects it to Android features such as camera, files, location, sharing, and notifications.
en.disableEffect: The AlitaJS interface and app actions that depend on it cannot be used.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开 AlitaJS 界面时，此页面会加载配置的网页应用，并连接相机、文件、位置、分享和通知等 Android 功能。
zh-CN.disableEffect: AlitaJS 界面及依赖它的应用操作将无法使用。

en.description: Aliyun Log Service uses this ContentProvider at app startup to make the app context available to its Android logging library before app code runs.
en.disableEffect: The logging library loses this early setup and must obtain the app context the first time it is used.

zh-CN.description: 阿里云日志服务会在应用启动时通过此内容提供器，将应用上下文交给 Android 日志库。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，日志库需要在首次使用时再获取应用上下文，无法提前完成这项设置。

en.description: Chrome Custom Tabs Utilities by Xuanyi Huang opens the Android share sheet with the current page link when its browser share option is used.
en.disableEffect: The page link cannot be shared from this browser option, so keep it enabled if the app uses that sharing flow.

zh-CN.description: 使用浏览器的分享功能时，Xuanyi Huang 的 Chrome Custom Tabs Utilities 会将当前页面链接交给 Android 并打开系统分享面板。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后无法通过此浏览器选项分享页面链接；如果应用依赖该分享流程，请保持启用。

en.description: Chrome Custom Tabs Utilities by Xuanyi Huang opens a URL supplied by the app in an in-app browser with JavaScript and a back button.
en.disableEffect: Pages the app routes through this browser will not open, which can interrupt any in-app flow that uses them.

zh-CN.description: Xuanyi Huang 的 Chrome Custom Tabs Utilities 会在应用请求时，通过内置浏览器打开网页，并启用 JavaScript 和返回按钮。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用通过此浏览器打开的页面将无法显示，使用这些页面的应用流程也会中断。

en.description: When the user chooses to share a page opened through ShowPowerfulWeb by Xuanyi Huang, this receiver sends the page link to the Android share sheet.
en.disableEffect: Link sharing from pages opened through ShowPowerfulWeb will stop working.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择分享通过 Xuanyi Huang 的 ShowPowerfulWeb 打开的网页时，此接收器会将页面链接交给 Android 系统分享面板。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后将无法分享通过 ShowPowerfulWeb 打开的网页链接。

en.description: Allihoopa's sign-in page loads the service's account login when the app requests authentication. After sign-in, it stores the returned access token and reports the result to the app.
en.disableEffect: Allihoopa account sign-in and features that require this account authorization will not complete.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求登录时，Allihoopa 登录页面会加载服务的账号登录页。登录成功后，它会保存访问令牌并将结果返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Allihoopa 账号登录及依赖此账号授权的功能无法完成。

en.description: When an AliPay+ return opens this AllPayX screen, it marks the payment result for server confirmation and closes.
en.disableEffect: The app may not receive or confirm the result of an AliPay+ payment.

zh-CN.description: AliPay+ 返回此 AllPayX 页面时，它会标记支付结果待服务器确认，然后关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用可能无法收到或确认 AliPay+ 支付结果。

en.description: The AllPayX payment SDK fetches an order's payment details, opens the configured payment method, and returns the transaction result to the app.
en.disableEffect: Payments started through AllPayX may fail or may not return a result to the app.

zh-CN.description: AllPayX 支付 SDK 会获取订单支付信息、打开配置的支付方式，并将交易结果返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，通过 AllPayX 发起的支付可能失败，或无法向应用返回结果。

en.description: The AllPayX payment SDK uses this screen to receive WeChat Pay's response and pass its status into the payment flow.
en.disableEffect: WeChat Pay may not be able to return its payment result to the app.

zh-CN.description: AllPayX 支付 SDK 使用此页面接收微信支付的响应，并将支付状态传回支付流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，微信支付可能无法向应用返回支付结果。

en.description: The GitHub Contributors Library by Alorma shows the contributor list for a repository selected by the app, loading names and avatar images from GitHub with refresh and more results as the list scrolls.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot open or refresh this repository contributor list.

zh-CN.description: Alorma 的 GitHub Contributors Library 会显示应用指定仓库的贡献者名单，从 GitHub 加载姓名和头像，并支持刷新及滚动加载更多结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用将无法打开或刷新此仓库的贡献者名单。

en.description: When Algorix (Alx) opens an ad landing page inside the app, this screen displays the supplied web page or ad HTML with back and close controls.
en.disableEffect: Ad landing pages that use this screen cannot be displayed.

zh-CN.description: Algorix（Alx）在应用内打开广告落地页时，此页面会显示指定网页或广告 HTML，并提供返回和关闭控件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此页面的广告落地页将无法显示。

en.description: The Algorix Ads SDK opens this full-screen page to show an interstitial ad and its web content. Closing the page reports that the ad was dismissed.
en.disableEffect: Algorix interstitial web ads will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: Algorix Ads SDK 会打开此全屏页面展示插屏广告及其网页内容。关闭页面时，它会记录广告已关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Algorix 插屏网页广告将无法打开。

en.description: When Algorix displays a landscape full-screen interstitial ad, this screen hosts the web creative and its close control.
en.disableEffect: Landscape full-screen interstitial ads that use this screen cannot be shown.

zh-CN.description: Algorix 展示横屏全屏插屏广告时，此页面会承载广告网页内容和关闭控件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此页面的横屏全屏插屏广告将无法展示。

en.description: When Algorix displays a portrait full-screen interstitial ad, this screen hosts the web creative and its close control.
en.disableEffect: Portrait full-screen interstitial ads that use this screen cannot be shown.

zh-CN.description: Algorix 展示竖屏全屏插屏广告时，此页面会承载广告网页内容和关闭控件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此页面的竖屏全屏插屏广告将无法展示。

en.description: The Algorix Ads SDK opens this Activity to play a full-screen video ad. Some launches identify the video as a rewarded ad.
en.disableEffect: Algorix video ads will not play, and rewards for watching these ads will no longer be granted.

zh-CN.description: Algorix Ads SDK 会打开此 Activity 播放全屏视频广告，其中部分视频属于激励广告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Algorix 视频广告将无法播放，观看此类广告也不再发放奖励。

en.description: When Algorix plays a landscape video ad, this screen hosts the full-screen player, including the SDK rewarded-ad mode.
en.disableEffect: Landscape video ads cannot play; users who were offered a rewarded ad will not receive its reward.

zh-CN.description: Algorix 播放横屏视频广告时，此页面会承载全屏播放器，也支持 SDK 的激励广告模式。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 横屏视频广告将无法播放；用户观看激励广告后也不会获得奖励。

en.description: When Algorix plays a portrait video ad, this screen hosts the full-screen player, including the SDK rewarded-ad mode.
en.disableEffect: Portrait video ads cannot play; users who were offered a rewarded ad will not receive its reward.

zh-CN.description: Algorix 播放竖屏视频广告时，此页面会承载全屏播放器，也支持 SDK 的激励广告模式。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 竖屏视频广告将无法播放；用户观看激励广告后也不会获得奖励。

en.description: When an app uses Alex Mofer Super Clipboard to copy or paste rich content, Android routes the data through this provider. It stores temporary items in app storage and supplies them in the requested format.
en.disableEffect: Copy-and-paste features that rely on this library stop working, especially for images or other rich content.

zh-CN.description: 应用使用 Alex Mofer Super Clipboard 复制或粘贴富媒体内容时，Android 会通过此内容提供程序传递数据。它会在应用存储中暂存内容，并按请求的格式提供数据。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此库的复制和粘贴功能将无法使用，图片等富媒体内容尤其会受影响。

en.description: AMap Location SDK starts this service while the app is obtaining or maintaining a location fix. It runs the positioning engine and handles the foreground notification needed during location work.
en.disableEffect: AMap-based location selection and sharing may stop working if this service is disabled.

zh-CN.description: 高德地图定位 SDK 会在应用获取或持续更新位置时启动此服务。它运行定位引擎，并处理定位期间所需的前台通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用中的高德地图选点和位置分享可能无法使用。

en.description: When the app opens AMap navigation, this built-in AMap Navigation SDK Activity displays route options or turn-by-turn guidance for the supplied trip.
en.disableEffect: The app will lose AMap route selection and guided navigation.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动高德导航时，这个 AMap 导航 SDK 内置 Activity 会根据传入的行程显示路线方案或逐向导航。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用将无法显示 AMap 路线选择页或逐向导航。

en.description: The Alexa Auto SDK text-to-speech service is called by Android's speech engine for spoken-text requests and asks the Alexa Auto Client Service for voice capabilities and synthesized speech.
en.disableEffect: Apps that use Alexa Auto will lose its speech synthesis and voice options.

zh-CN.description: Android 语音引擎需要朗读文本时会调用 Amazon Alexa Auto SDK 的语音合成服务；该服务会向 Alexa Auto Client Service 查询语音能力并请求合成语音。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖 Alexa Auto 的应用将无法使用它提供的语音合成和语音选项。

en.description: The Alexa Auto SDK receiver handles broadcasts for client connection changes, voice capabilities, speech preparation results, and service stop requests, then forwards the messages to its text-to-speech service.
en.disableEffect: Alexa Auto speech handling will miss these client and speech-result messages, so voice playback or service state updates can fail.

zh-CN.description: Amazon Alexa Auto SDK 的接收器处理客户端连接状态、语音能力、语音准备结果和停止服务等广播，并将消息转交给语音合成服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Alexa Auto 语音服务将收不到这些客户端和语音处理消息，语音播放或服务状态更新可能失效。

en.description: The Amazon GameCircle SDK opens this Activity to show an in-game service alert as an overlay. It displays the alert content supplied by GameCircle and closes when the alert is dismissed.
en.disableEffect: Amazon GameCircle alerts will no longer appear in the game.

zh-CN.description: Amazon GameCircle SDK 用这个界面以游戏内浮层显示服务提醒，并在用户关闭提醒后退出。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，游戏中将不再显示 Amazon GameCircle 提醒。

en.description: Amazon GameCircle opens this Activity when the game requests a GameCircle panel. It builds the in-game panel from the supplied session details and closes when the player dismisses it.
en.disableEffect: The game's Amazon GameCircle panel and the feature shown in it will not open.

zh-CN.description: 游戏请求打开 GameCircle 面板时，Amazon GameCircle 会启动这个界面。它根据会话信息显示游戏内面板，并在玩家关闭后退出。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，游戏内的 Amazon GameCircle 面板及其中的功能将无法打开。

en.description: The Amazon Pay Android browsing library opens this Activity when a payment or sign-in flow needs a browser; it uses Chrome Custom Tabs when available, otherwise an external browser, and returns the redirect result to the calling flow.
en.disableEffect: Amazon Pay sign-in or payment flows that require browser authorization will not complete.

zh-CN.description: Amazon Pay Android 浏览库在付款或登录流程需要打开网页时启动此界面；有 Chrome 自定义标签页时会优先使用，否则打开外部浏览器，并将返回结果交还给发起流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要浏览器授权的 Amazon Pay 登录或付款流程将无法完成。

en.description: When Android opens an Amazon Pay return link for the app, this Activity forwards the link to the Amazon Pay browsing Activity for payment or sign-in completion.
en.disableEffect: The app will not receive the browser's Amazon Pay authorization or payment result, so that flow will fail.

zh-CN.description: Android 打开返回应用的 Amazon Pay 链接时，此界面会把链接转交给 Amazon Pay 浏览界面，以完成付款或登录流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将收不到浏览器返回的 Amazon Pay 授权或付款结果，因此该流程会失败。

en.description: The Amazon Pay Android browsing library opens this Activity when a payment or sign-in flow needs a browser; it uses Chrome Custom Tabs when available, otherwise an external browser, and returns the redirect result to the calling flow.
en.disableEffect: Amazon Pay sign-in or payment flows that require browser authorization will not complete.

zh-CN.description: Amazon Pay Android 浏览库在付款或登录流程需要打开网页时启动此界面；有 Chrome 自定义标签页时会优先使用，否则打开外部浏览器，并将返回结果交还给发起流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要浏览器授权的 Amazon Pay 登录或付款流程将无法完成。

en.description: When Android opens an Amazon Pay return link for the app, this Activity forwards the link to the Amazon Pay browsing Activity for payment or sign-in completion.
en.disableEffect: The app will not receive the browser's Amazon Pay authorization or payment result, so that flow will fail.

zh-CN.description: Android 打开返回应用的 Amazon Pay 链接时，此界面会把链接转交给 Amazon Pay 浏览界面，以完成付款或登录流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将收不到浏览器返回的 Amazon Pay 授权或付款结果，因此该流程会失败。

en.description: Amazon Pay Android CommonLibrary opens this Activity for the browser step of a payment or sign-in flow; it launches the requested web page and returns the redirect result to the calling flow.
en.disableEffect: Amazon Pay flows that rely on this browser step will not complete.

zh-CN.description: Amazon Pay Android CommonLibrary 会在付款或登录流程需要浏览器时打开此界面，载入请求的网页，并将返回结果交还给发起流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此浏览步骤的 Amazon Pay 流程将无法完成。

en.description: When Android opens an Amazon Pay return link for the app, this CommonLibrary Activity forwards its URI to the matching Amazon Pay browsing Activity.
en.disableEffect: The Amazon Pay browser flow will not return its authorization or payment result to the app.

zh-CN.description: Android 打开返回应用的 Amazon Pay 链接时，CommonLibrary 的此界面会把链接地址转交给对应的 Amazon Pay 浏览界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Amazon Pay 浏览流程将无法把授权或付款结果返回给应用。

en.description: Amazon Pay Hardened Android SDK opens this Activity during authorization or charge operations; it completes the Login with Amazon authorization step and returns the result to the payment flow.
en.disableEffect: Amazon Pay authorization and payment flows that use the hardened browser will fail.

zh-CN.description: Amazon Pay Hardened Android SDK 会在授权或付款操作期间打开此界面，完成 Login with Amazon 授权并将结果返回付款流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此安全浏览流程的 Amazon Pay 授权和付款操作将失败。

en.description: When Android opens an Amazon Pay authorization return link for the app, this Activity forwards its URI to the Amazon Pay Hardened browser Activity.
en.disableEffect: Amazon Pay Hardened SDK will not receive the browser return needed to finish authorization or payment.

zh-CN.description: Android 打开返回应用的 Amazon Pay 授权链接时，此界面会把链接地址转交给 Amazon Pay Hardened 浏览界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Amazon Pay Hardened SDK 将收不到完成授权或付款所需的浏览器返回结果。

en.description: Amazon Publisher Services' mobile advertising SDK opens this Activity to show a full-screen interstitial ad with its ad content and close control.
en.disableEffect: Amazon Publisher Services interstitial ads will not appear; the app's other features remain available.

zh-CN.description: Amazon Publisher Services（Amazon）的移动广告 SDK 会在展示插屏广告时打开此界面，铺开广告内容并显示关闭控件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Amazon Publisher Services 的插屏广告将不再显示；应用其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: Amazon Ads displays a full-screen ad on this page and manages it while it is visible.
en.disableEffect: Amazon ads can no longer open, but the app’s other features continue to work.

zh-CN.description: 显示 Amazon 广告时，Amazon Ads 会打开此全屏页面，并在页面显示期间管理广告内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Amazon 广告将无法打开，但应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: Amazon Publisher Services (APS) opens this Activity when an expandable ad grows into a full-screen view. It loads the expanded creative and handles closing it.
en.disableEffect: Expanded APS ads will not open; the app's other features remain available.

zh-CN.description: Amazon Publisher Services（APS）在可展开广告扩展为全屏内容时会打开此 Activity。它加载扩展后的广告并处理关闭操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: APS 展开式广告将无法打开，应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: Amazon Publisher Services (APS) opens this Activity to display a full-screen interstitial ad and provide its close and back controls.
en.disableEffect: APS interstitial ads will not display; the app's other features remain available.

zh-CN.description: Amazon Publisher Services（APS）会打开此 Activity 显示全屏插屏广告，并提供关闭和返回操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: APS 插屏广告将无法显示，应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: Amazon Appstore In-App Purchasing uses this Receiver when the store sends a purchase or purchase-history update; it forwards the result to the app purchase flow.
en.disableEffect: Amazon Appstore purchase results will stop reaching the app, so buying or restoring in-app content may fail.

zh-CN.description: Amazon Appstore 应用内购买功能会在商店发送购买或购买记录更新时调用此接收器，并将结果交给应用处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用将收不到 Amazon Appstore 的购买结果，应用内购买或恢复购买可能失败。

en.description: Login with Amazon's Identity Mobile SDK opens this Activity for account authorization; it starts the browser sign-in and returns an authorization result to the app.
en.disableEffect: Login with Amazon sign-in and authorization will not complete in apps using this flow.

zh-CN.description: Login with Amazon Identity Mobile SDK 会在账号授权时打开此界面，启动浏览器登录并将授权结果返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此流程的应用将无法完成 Login with Amazon 登录和授权。

en.description: Login with Amazon's identity SDK uses this Activity during its single-sign-on handoff and closes it after the authorization result arrives.
en.disableEffect: Login with Amazon single sign-on may not return successfully to the app.

zh-CN.description: Login with Amazon 身份 SDK 在单点登录交接过程中使用此界面，并在收到授权结果后关闭它。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用可能无法通过 Login with Amazon 单点登录顺利返回。

en.description: The Login with Amazon SDK uses this Activity when a user returns from its sign-in page. It processes the authorization response and returns the token, cancellation, or error result to the app.
en.disableEffect: Login with Amazon sign-in and authorization flows that rely on this SDK will not finish.

zh-CN.description: 用户从登录授权页面返回后，Login with Amazon SDK 会用这个界面处理授权结果，并把令牌、取消或错误结果交还应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，依赖 Login with Amazon 的登录和授权流程将无法完成。

en.description: When Android reports a package installation, the Login with Amazon SDK uses this Receiver to clear cached service information used for sign-in.
en.disableEffect: Without this cleanup, Login with Amazon may keep stale service information after an install event and disrupt a later sign-in.

zh-CN.description: Android 报告软件包安装事件时，Login with Amazon SDK 会用这个接收器清理登录服务缓存。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，安装事件不会触发这次缓存清理，后续登录可能继续使用过期的服务信息。

en.description: Login with Amazon's identity SDK receives the authorization return link in this Activity and passes the response back to the sign-in flow.
en.disableEffect: The app's Login with Amazon redirect and sign-in result will not be delivered.

zh-CN.description: Login with Amazon 身份 SDK 在此界面接收授权返回链接，并将响应交回登录流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将收不到 Login with Amazon 的跳转结果和登录响应。

en.description: Amazon IVS Broadcast registers this provider at app startup to watch screen lifecycle changes and notify the broadcast engine when the app moves to the background or returns, when lifecycle reporting is enabled.
en.disableEffect: IVS Broadcast may not respond correctly when the user leaves or returns to the app.

zh-CN.description: Amazon IVS Broadcast 会在应用启动时注册此组件；启用生命周期报告后，它会监测界面变化，并在应用进入后台或返回时通知直播引擎。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户离开应用或返回时，IVS Broadcast 可能无法正确响应。

en.description: AWS Authentication UI opens this Activity when the app requests sign-in; it displays the configured identity-provider choices and returns the provider's success, cancellation, or error result.
en.disableEffect: Apps using AWS Authentication UI will not be able to sign in through its screen.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求登录时，AWS Authentication UI 会打开此界面，显示已配置的身份提供方选项，并返回登录成功、取消或错误结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用 AWS Authentication UI 的应用将无法通过其登录界面登录。

en.description: AWS Cognito User Pools sign-in opens this screen when an account must replace its temporary password; it returns the new password to the sign-in flow.
en.disableEffect: A user required to change a temporary password will be unable to finish signing in.

zh-CN.description: AWS Cognito User Pools 登录要求更换临时密码时会打开此界面，并将新密码交回登录流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 被要求更换临时密码的用户将无法完成登录。

en.description: AWS Cognito User Pools opens this screen during password recovery so a user can enter a replacement password and the verification code, then returns both to the reset flow.
en.disableEffect: Users will be unable to complete password recovery through the AWS Cognito screen.

zh-CN.description: AWS Cognito User Pools 会在找回密码时打开此界面，让用户输入新密码和验证码，再将两项内容交回重置流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 AWS Cognito 界面完成密码找回。

en.description: AWS Cognito User Pools opens this screen when sign-in requires multi-factor verification; it collects the verification code and returns it to authentication.
en.disableEffect: Users will be unable to complete sign-in challenges that require a verification code.

zh-CN.description: AWS Cognito User Pools 登录需要多重验证时会打开此界面，收集验证码并将其交回身份验证流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法完成需要验证码的登录验证。

en.description: AWS Cognito User Pools opens this screen when the app starts account registration; it collects account details and submits them to Cognito, then returns the confirmation status and delivery destination.
en.disableEffect: Users will be unable to create a Cognito User Pool account through the app.

zh-CN.description: 应用开始注册账号时，AWS Cognito User Pools 会打开此界面，收集账号资料并提交给 Cognito，然后返回确认状态和验证码发送位置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过应用注册 AWS Cognito User Pools 账号。

en.description: AWS Cognito User Pools opens this screen when a new account needs verification; it shows where the code was sent and returns the user's confirmation code to registration.
en.disableEffect: Users will be unable to verify new accounts through the AWS Cognito sign-up flow.

zh-CN.description: AWS Cognito User Pools 新账号需要验证时会打开此界面，显示验证码发送位置，并将用户输入的确认码交回注册流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 AWS Cognito 注册流程验证新账号。

en.description: AWS Cognito Auth uses this Activity to launch the browser sign-in page and return its callback link to the app, or report that the user canceled.
en.disableEffect: Browser-based AWS Cognito sign-in and its return to the app will fail.

zh-CN.description: AWS Cognito Auth 使用此界面打开浏览器登录页，并将回调链接交回应用；用户取消时也会返回取消结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 基于浏览器的 AWS Cognito 登录及返回应用的流程将失败。

en.description: AWS Location starts this foreground service when the app enables location tracking; it requests periodic fused-location updates and delivers each location to the tracking listener.
en.disableEffect: The app's AWS Location tracking feature will stop receiving periodic location updates.

zh-CN.description: 应用启用位置跟踪时，AWS Location 会启动此前台服务，定期请求融合定位结果并将位置交给跟踪监听器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用的 AWS Location 跟踪功能将无法继续接收定期位置更新。

en.description: AWS Pinpoint opens this Activity when a user taps a Pinpoint notification; it reports the notification open to the registered handler and otherwise launches the app with the notification data.
en.disableEffect: Tapping AWS Pinpoint notifications will no longer reach their normal handler; the rest of the app remains usable.

zh-CN.description: 用户点按 AWS Pinpoint 通知时会打开此界面；它会把通知打开事件交给已注册的处理器，若没有处理器则携带通知内容启动应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 点按 AWS Pinpoint 通知将无法交给原有处理器；应用其他功能仍可使用。

A provider of downloaded cover art images. Cover art images are downloaded from remote devices and are promised to be "good" for the life of a connection. Android applications are provided a Uri with their MediaMetadata and MediaItem objects that points back to this provider. Uris are in the following format: content://com.android.bluetooth.avrcpcontroller.AvrcpCoverArtProvider/<device>/<image-handle> It's expected by the Media framework that artwork at URIs will be available using the ContentResolver#openInputStream and BitmapFactory#decodeStream functions. Our provider must enable that usage pattern.

Implements the MediaBrowserService interface to AVRCP and A2DP This service provides a means for external applications to access A2DP and AVRCP. The applications are expected to use MediaBrowser (see API) and all the music browsing/playback/metadata can be controlled via MediaBrowser and MediaController. The current behavior of MediaSessionCompat exposed by this service is as follows: 1. MediaSessionCompat is active (i.e. SystemUI and other overview UIs can see updates) when device is connected and first starts playing. Before it starts playing we do not activate the session. 1.1 The session is active throughout the duration of connection. 2. The session is de-activated when the device disconnects. It will be connected again when (1) happens.

Provides Bluetooth Headset and Handsfree profile, as a service in the Bluetooth application. Three modes for SCO audio: Mode 1: Telecom call through #phoneStateChanged(int, int, int, String, int, String, boolean) Mode 2: Virtual call through #startScoUsingVirtualVoiceCall() Mode 3: Voice recognition through #startVoiceRecognition(BluetoothDevice) When one mode is active, other mode cannot be started. API user has to terminate existing modes using the correct API or just #disconnectAudio() if user is a system service, before starting a new mode. #connectAudio() will start SCO audio at one of the above modes, but won't change mode #disconnectAudio() can happen in any mode to disconnect SCO When audio is disconnected, only Mode 1 Telecom call will be persisted, both Mode 2 virtual call and Mode 3 voice call will be terminated upon SCO termination and client has to restart the mode. NOTE: SCO termination can either be initiated on the AG side or the HF side TODO(b/79660380): As a workaround, voice recognition will be terminated if virtual call or Telecom call is initiated while voice recognition is ongoing, in case calling app did not call #stopVoiceRecognition(BluetoothDevice) AG - Audio Gateway, device running this HeadsetService, e.g. Android Phone HF - Handsfree device, device running headset client, e.g. Wireless headphones or car kits

en.description: Provides network overrides for carrier configuration. The configuration available through CarrierConfigManager is a combination of default values, default network overrides, and carrier overrides. The default network overrides are provided by this service. For a given network, we look for a matching XML file in our assets folder, and return the PersistableBundle from that file. Assets are preferred over Resources because resource overlays only support using MCC+MNC and that doesn't work with MVNOs. The only resource file used is vendor.xml, to provide vendor-specific overrides.

Activity that launches when the user clicks on the performance boost notification. This will open a WebView for the carrier website to allow the user to complete the premium capability purchase. The carrier website can get the requested premium capability using the JavaScript interface method @code SlicePurchaseWebInterface.getRequestedCapability(). If the purchase is successful, the carrier website shall notify the slice purchase application using the JavaScript interface method @code SlicePurchaseWebInterface.notifyPurchaseSuccessful(duration), where @code duration is the optional duration of the performance boost. If the purchase was not successful, the carrier website shall notify the slice purchase application using the JavaScript interface method @code SlicePurchaseWebInterface.notifyPurchaseFailed(code, reason), where @code code is the SlicePurchaseController.FailureCode indicating the reason for failure and @code reason is the human-readable reason for failure if the failure code is SlicePurchaseController#FAILURE_CODE_UNKNOWN. If either of these notification methods are not called, the purchase cannot be completed successfully and the purchase request will eventually time out.

The SlicePurchaseBroadcastReceiver listens for SlicePurchaseController#ACTION_START_SLICE_PURCHASE_APP from the SlicePurchaseController in the phone process to start the slice purchase application. It displays the performance boost notification to the user and will start the SlicePurchaseActivity to display the WebView to purchase performance boosts from the user's carrier.

This class provides the ability to query the enhanced address book databases(A.K.A. EAB) based on both SIP options and UCE presence server data. There are 4 tables in EAB DB: Contact: It stores the name and phone number of the contact. Common: It's a general table for storing the query results and the mechanisms of querying UCE capabilities. It should be 1:1 mapped to the contact table and has a foreign key(eab_contact_id) that refers to the id of contact table. If the value of mechanism is 1 ( android.telephony.ims.RcsContactUceCapability#CAPABILITY_MECHANISM_PRESENCE), the capability information should be stored in presence table, if the value of mechanism is 2( android.telephony.ims.RcsContactUceCapability#CAPABILITY_MECHANISM_OPTIONS), it should be stored in options table. Presence: It stores the information ( android.telephony.ims.RcsContactUceCapability) that queried through presence server. It should be *:1 mapped to the common table and has a foreign key(eab_common_id) that refers to the id of common table. Options: It stores the information ( android.telephony.ims.RcsContactUceCapability) that queried through SIP OPTIONS. It should be *:1 mapped to the common table and it has a foreign key(eab_common_id) that refers to the id of common table.
