This class is a content provider that publishes the system settings. It can be accessed via the content provider APIs or via custom call commands. The latter is a bit faster and is the preferred way to access the platform settings. There are three settings types, global (with signature level protection and shared across users), secure (with signature permission level protection and per user), and system (with dangerous permission level protection and per user). Global settings are stored under the device owner. Each of these settings is represented by a com.android.providers.settings.SettingsState object mapped to an integer key derived from the setting type in the most significant bits and user id in the least significant bits. Settings are synchronously loaded on instantiation of a SettingsState and asynchronously persisted on mutation. Settings are stored in the user specific system directory. Apps targeting APIs Lollipop MR1 and lower can add custom settings entries and get a warning. Targeting higher API version prohibits this as the system settings are not a place for apps to save their state. When a package is removed the settings it added are deleted. Apps cannot delete system settings added by the platform. System settings values are validated to ensure the clients do not put bad values. Global and secure settings are changed only by trusted parties, therefore no validation is performed. Also there is a limit on the amount of app specific settings that can be added to prevent unlimited growth of the system process memory footprint.

This class provides the ability to query the Carrier Identification databases (A.K.A. cid) which is stored in a SQLite database. Each row in carrier identification db consists of matching rule (e.g., MCCMNC, GID1, GID2, PLMN) and its matched carrier id & carrier name. Each carrier either MNO or MVNO could be identified by multiple matching rules but is assigned with a unique ID (cid). This class provides the ability to retrieve the cid of the current subscription. This is done atomically through a query. This class also provides a way to update carrier identifying attributes of an existing entry. Insert entries for new carriers or an existing carrier.

This class provides the ability to query the MMS and SMS databases at the same time, mixing messages from both in a single thread (A.K.A. conversation). A virtual column, MmsSms.TYPE_DISCRIMINATOR_COLUMN, may be requested in the projection for a query. Its value is either "mms" or "sms", depending on whether the message represented by the row is an MMS message or an SMS message, respectively. This class also provides the ability to find out what addresses participated in a particular thread. It doesn't support updates for either of these. This class provides a way to allocate and retrieve thread IDs. This is done atomically through a query. There is no insert URI for this. Finally, this class provides a way to delete or update all messages in a thread.

A SliceProvider for Settings to enabled inline results in system apps. SettingsSliceProvider accepts a Uri with #SLICE_AUTHORITY and a @code String key based on the setting intended to be changed. This provider builds a Slice and responds to Slice actions through the database defined by SlicesDatabaseHelper, whose data is written by SlicesIndexer. When a Slice is requested, we start loading SliceData in the background and return an stub Slice with the correct Uri immediately. In the background, the data corresponding to the key in the Uri is read by SlicesDatabaseAccessor, and the entire row is converted into a SliceData. Once complete, it is stored in #mSliceWeakDataCache, and then an update sent via the Slice framework to the Slice. The Slice displayed by the Slice-presenter will re-query this Slice-provider and find the SliceData cached to build the full Slice. When an action is taken on that Slice, we receive the action in SliceBroadcastReceiver, and use the com.android.settings.core.BasePreferenceController indexed as SlicesDatabaseHelper.IndexColumns#CONTROLLER to manipulate the setting.

The WapPushManager service is implemented to process incoming WAP Push messages and to maintain the Receiver Application/Application ID mapping. The WapPushManager runs as a system service, and only the WapPushManager can update the WAP Push message and Receiver Application mapping (Application ID Table). When the device receives an SMS WAP Push message, the WapPushManager looks up the Receiver Application name in Application ID Table. If an application is found, the application is launched using its full component name instead of broadcasting an implicit Intent. If a Receiver Application is not found in the Application ID Table or the WapPushManager returns a process-further value, the telephony stack will process the message using existing message processing flow, and broadcast an implicit Intent.

Service for dumping extremely verbose content during a bug report Our primary service, SystemUIService, is dumped during the CRITICAL section of a bug report. This has some advantages (we get to go first!), but also imposes strict limitations on how much we can dump. This service exists to handle any content that is too large to be safely dumped within those constraints, namely log buffers. It's dumped during the NORMAL section, along with all other services.
Confirmation dialog shown when Set Menu Language CEC message was received.
Wrap Keyguard going away animation.
Simple Slice provider that shows the current date. Injection is handled by SystemUIAppComponentFactory + com.android.systemui.dagger.GlobalRootComponent#inject(KeyguardSliceProvider).

Bouncer between work activities and the activity used to confirm credentials before unlocking a managed profile. Shows a solid color when started, based on the organization color of the user it is supposed to be blocking. Once focused, it switches to a screen to confirm credentials and auto-dismisses if credentials are accepted.
Dialog responsible for obtaining user consent per-use log access
Indicates if user must review already-granted consent that the MediaProjection app is
BroadcastReceiver for handling media output intent
Notify user that a NetworkTemplate is over its NetworkPolicy#limitBytes, giving them the choice of acknowledging or "snoozing" the limit.

An internal proxy activity that starts the notes role setting. This activity is introduced mainly for the error handling of the notes app lock screen shortcut picker, which only supports package + action but not extras. See [KeyguardQuickAffordanceConfig.PickerScreenState.Disabled.actionComponentName].

A fire & forget service for updating note task shortcuts. The main use is to update shortcuts in different user by launching it using `startServiceAsUser`. The service will open with access to a context from that user, trigger [NoteTaskController.updateNoteTaskAsUser] and [stopSelf] immediately. The fire and forget approach was created due to its simplicity but may use unnecessary resources by recreating the services. We will investigate its impacts and consider to move to a bounded services - the implementation is more complex as a bounded service is asynchronous by default. TODO(b/278729185): Replace fire and forget service with a bounded service.

Activity responsible for creating a shortcut for notes action. If the shortcut is enabled, a new shortcut will appear in the widget picker. If the shortcut is selected, the Activity here will be launched, creating a new shortcut for [CreateNoteTaskShortcutActivity], and will finish. @see Creating a custom shortcut activity
Activity responsible for launching the note experience, and finish.

An internal proxy activity that starts notes app in the work profile. If there is no work profile, this activity finishes gracefully. This activity MUST NOT be exported because that would expose the INTERACT_ACROSS_USER privilege to any apps.

Follow-up job that runs after a Conversations widgets restore operation. Check if shortcuts that were not available before are now available. If any shortcut doesn't become available after 1 day, we clean up its storage.
API that returns a People Tile preview.
People Tile Widget configuration activity that shows the user their conversation tiles.
Proxy activity to launch ShortcutInfo's conversation.
Called when a People Tile widget is added via AppWidgetManager.requestPinAppWidget().
People Space Widget Provider class.

Invoked when the GlobalActions menu is shown. @param callbacks Callbacks instance that can be used by the Panel to interact with the Global Actions menu. @param deviceLocked Indicates whether or not the device is currently locked. @return A PanelViewController instance used to receive Global Actions events.
A service which records the device screen and optionally microphone input.
Dialog to select screen recording options
Receiver to proxy the share or edit intent, used to clean up the notification and send appropriate signals to the system (ie. to dismiss the keyguard if necessary).
Removes the file at a provided URI.
LongScreenshotActivity acquires bitmap data for a long screenshot and lets the user trim the top and bottom before saving/sharing/editing.

If a screenshot is saved to the work profile, any intents that grant access to the screenshot must come from a service running as the work profile user. This service is meant to be started as the desired user and just startActivity for the given intent.
Provides state from the main SystemUI process on behalf of the Screenshot process.
Performs a number of miscellaneous, non-system-critical actions after the system has finished booting.
Executes the smart action tapped by the user in the notification.
Informs about coarse grained state of the Controller.

An Activity to take a screenshot for the App Clips flow and presenting a screenshot editing tool. An App Clips flow includes: Checking if calling activity meets the prerequisites. This is done by AppClipsTrampolineActivity. Performing the screenshot. Showing a screenshot editing tool. Returning the screenshot to the AppClipsTrampolineActivity so that it can return the screenshot to the calling activity after explicit user consent. This Activity runs in its own separate process to isolate memory intensive image editing from SysUI process. TODO(b/267309532): Polish UI and animations.
A helper service that runs in SysUI process and helps AppClipsActivity which runs in its own separate process take a screenshot.
A service that communicates with StatusBarManager to support the StatusBarManager#canLaunchCaptureContentActivityForNote(Activity) API.

A trampoline activity that is responsible for: Performing precondition checks before starting the actual screenshot activity. Communicating with the screenshot activity and the calling activity. As this activity is started in a bubble app, the windowing for this activity is restricted to the parent bubble app. The screenshot editing activity, see AppClipsActivity, is started in a regular activity window using Intent#FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK. However, Activity#startActivityForResult(Intent, int) is not compatible with Intent#FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK. So, this activity acts as a trampoline activity to abstract the complexity of communication with the screenshot editing activity for a simpler developer experience. TODO(b/267309532): Polish UI and animations.

Dialog to be shown on top of apps that are attempting to use a sensor (e.g. microphone) which is currently in "sensor privacy mode", aka. muted. The dialog is started for the user the app is running for which might be a secondary users.
Bottom sheet that is shown when the camera/mic sensors privacy state changed by the global software toggle or physical privacy switch.
Bottom sheet that is shown when the camera/mic sensors are blocked by the global software toggle or physical privacy switch.
A dialog that provides controls for adjusting the screen brightness.
Receiver for the Keyboard Shortcuts Helper.
This Activity shows a notification panel for tv. It is used if no other app (e.g. a launcher) can be found to show the notifications.
Dialog shown to the user to switch to managed profile for making a call using work SIM.
Copy all the preferences over to this screen so they go into the attached state.

If the attached USB accessory has a URL associated with it, and that URL is valid, show this dialog to the user to allow them to optionally visit that URL for more information or software downloads. Otherwise (no valid URL) this activity does nothing at all, finishing immediately.
Dialog shown to confirm the package to start when a USB device or accessory is attached and there is only one package that claims to handle this USB device or accessory.
Activity that alerts the user when contaminant is detected on USB port.
Emulator does not support reseating the usb cable to reshow the dialog.
Dialog shown when a package requests access to a USB device or accessory.
Resolve info that switches user profiles
Dialog shown to confirm the package to start when a USB device or accessory is attached and there is only one package that claims to handle this USB device or accessory.
Dialog shown when a package requests access to a USB device or accessory on TVs.
This screen shows a Dialog for choosing nickname and photo for a new user, and then delegates the user creation to a UserCreator.
BroadcastReceiver for handling volume panel dialog intent

Serves as an intermediary between QuickAccessWalletService and ContextualCardManager (in PCC). When QuickAccessWalletService has a list of store locations, WalletContextualLocationsService will send them to ContextualCardManager. When the user enters a store location, this Service class will be notified, and WalletContextualSuggestionsController will be updated.
Displays Wallet carousel screen inside an activity.
Default built-in wallpaper that simply shows a static image.
Alerts the user of an untrusted network when enabling wireless debugging. The user can either deny, allow, or allow with the "always allow on this network" checked.
Alerts the user that wireless debugging cannot be enabled by a secondary user.
An implementation of a TextClassifierService.
Service to expose IModelDownloaderService.
Handles the copy code action.

LeakCanary's Android Studio integration runs this Provider at app startup to connect heap-dump and control events to Android Studio. Disabling it stops that profiler bridge without affecting the app's normal screens.
en.disableEffect: Android Studio can no longer use this integration to control LeakCanary or receive its heap-dump events.

zh-CN.description: LeakCanary 的 Android Studio 集成会在应用启动时运行此 Provider，把堆转储和控制事件接入 Android Studio。禁用后，分析器桥接功能停止，应用的常规界面不受影响。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Android Studio 将无法再通过此集成控制 LeakCanary 或接收堆转储事件。

en.description: If stack sampling is active, the "Record trace" tile cannot be interacted with.
Enables/disables the System Traces storage component. enableProvider should be true iff
System Tracing shouldn't be searchable if developer options are not enabled or if the
If we stop a trace using this entrypoint, we must also reset the preference and the Quick Settings UI, since this may be the only indication that the user wants to stop the trace.
Adds an entry for traces in the file picker.
Silently stops a trace without saving it. This is intended to be called when tracing is no
Dialog that warns about contents of a trace. Adapted from fw/base/packages/Shell's BugreportWarningActivity.
Receives Intent#ACTION_BOOT_COMPLETED and Intent#ACTION_SHUTDOWN
Receives android.provider.Telephony.SECRET_CODE
JobService triggered when the setup wizard is completed, and rerun all ActivationTask scheduled during the setup.

A job to perform StatusCheckTask once per day, performing book keeping to ensure the credentials and status for a activated voicemail account is still correct. A task will be scheduled for each active voicemail account. The status is expected to be always in sync, the check is a failsafe to mimic the previous status check on signal return behavior.
Activity launched by simulator->voicemail, provides debug features.

BroadcastReceiver to queue and run Task with the android.app.job.JobScheduler. A task is queued using a explicit broadcast to this receiver. The intent should contain enough information in Intent#getExtras() to construct the task (see Tasks#createIntent(Context, Class)). The task will be queued directly in TaskExecutor if it is already running, or in TaskSchedulerJobService if not.
A JobService that will trigger the background execution of TaskExecutor.
Receives changes to the voicemail provider so they can be sent to the voicemail server.

JobScheduler service for transcribing old voicemails. This service does a database scan for un-transcribed voicemails and schedules transcription tasks for them, once we have an un-metered network connection.
JobScheduler service for uploading transcription feedback. This service requires a network connection.

Job scheduler callback for launching voicemail transcription tasks. The transcription tasks will run in the background and will typically last for approximately the length of the voicemail audio (since thats how long the backend transcription service takes to do the transcription).
Usually the label represents the app name, 150 code points might be enough to display the app
PlatformVpnConfirmDialog is a minimal subclass for requesting user consent for platform VPN profiles.

Generates hash codes for currently set static image wallpapers on N+ devices where they are missing because older versions of the app did not generate and set them. Static image wallpaper hash codes are necessary on N+ devices for the purposes of backup & restore because N+ WallpaperManager integer IDs are local to physical devices and not backed up and restored on the framework side.
android.app.job.JobScheduler job for generating missing hash codes for static wallpapers on N+ devices.
Get the information about this component. Implemented this way
Performs daily logging operations when alarm is received.
Receiver to run when the app was updated or on first boot to switch from live rotating wallpaper to static rotating wallpaper.
Main Activity allowing containing view sections for the user to switch between the different Fragments providing customization options.
An intermediate activity to redirect to a brand new target activity when the user clicks the url link to deep link.
Activity that displays a full preview of a specific wallpaper and provides the ability to set the wallpaper as the user's current wallpaper.
Activity to retain correct base intent in non multi-pane case.
Activity that displays a preview of a specific wallpaper and provides the ability to set the wallpaper as the user's current wallpaper.

Activity that displays a preview of a specific wallpaper and provides the ability to set the wallpaper as the user's current wallpaper. It's "standalone" meaning it doesn't reside in the app navigation hierarchy and can be launched directly via an explicit intent.
Activity to relinquish task identity for multi-pane and prevent launching incorrect base intent in non multi-pane.
Activity that displays a view-only preview of a specific wallpaper.
Copied from Launcher3
Main Activity of the WifiDialog application. All dialogs should be created and managed from here.
The Beseting Nes Emulator cheat screen lists cheats for the current game and lets users add, edit, remove, or enable them.
en.disableEffect: Users will lose access to cheat codes while playing games in the emulator.

zh-CN.description: Beseting Nes Emulator 的作弊码页面会列出当前游戏的作弊码，并允许用户添加、编辑、删除或启用它们。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在模拟器游戏中查看或管理作弊码。

en.description: The Beseting Nes Emulator opens this screen when a user chooses a Bluetooth game controller; it searches for nearby devices and lists controllers that can be connected.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to find and connect a Bluetooth controller through the emulator.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择蓝牙游戏手柄时，Beseting Nes Emulator 会打开此页面搜索附近设备并列出可连接的手柄。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过模拟器查找并连接蓝牙手柄。

en.description: The Beseting Nes Emulator opens this Activity when a user selects or opens a supported NES game file; it loads the game and displays the playable game screen.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to play NES games through the emulator.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择游戏文件或从系统打开受支持的 NES 游戏文件时，Beseting Nes Emulator 会加载游戏并显示游玩画面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过该模拟器游玩 NES 游戏。

en.description: While a game is running, the Beseting Nes Emulator service shows an ongoing notification that can return the user to the game; the game screen starts it for foreground play.
en.disableEffect: The emulator will lose its foreground service and the ongoing notification that provides a way back to the running game.

zh-CN.description: 游戏运行期间，Beseting Nes Emulator 服务会显示可返回游戏的常驻通知；游戏页面会在前台游玩时启动此服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 模拟器将失去游戏期间的前台服务和返回正在运行游戏的常驻通知。

en.description: The Beseting Nes Emulator settings screen opens from the game list and provides emulator preferences and an entry for searching for game files.
en.disableEffect: Users will lose access to the emulator preferences and game-file search entry.

zh-CN.description: Beseting Nes Emulator 的设置页面从游戏列表打开，提供模拟器选项和搜索游戏文件的入口。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开模拟器选项和游戏文件搜索入口。

en.description: The Beseting Nes Emulator uses this screen to browse device folders and choose a game file that matches the app filters.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to browse for and select game files through the emulator.

zh-CN.description: Beseting Nes Emulator 使用此页面浏览设备文件夹，并选择符合筛选条件的游戏文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过模拟器浏览并选择游戏文件。

en.description: The Beseting Nes Emulator opens this help page when a user chooses Help from the game list.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to open the emulator help page.

zh-CN.description: 用户从游戏列表选择帮助时，Beseting Nes Emulator 会打开此帮助页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开模拟器帮助页面。

en.description: The Beseting Nes Emulator lets users create and edit controller-key profiles here, then save the selected button assignments for games.
en.disableEffect: Users will lose the ability to create or change controller-key profiles.

zh-CN.description: Beseting Nes Emulator 在此允许用户创建和编辑手柄按键配置，并保存游戏按键分配。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法创建或修改手柄按键配置。

en.description: The Beseting Nes Emulator opens this main screen to browse for NES game files; choosing a file starts the game, and the screen also links to settings and help.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to browse for and start games from the emulator main screen.

zh-CN.description: Beseting Nes Emulator 会打开此主页面浏览 NES 游戏文件；选择文件后会启动游戏，页面还提供设置和帮助入口。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法从模拟器主页面浏览并启动游戏。

en.description: The Beseting Nes Emulator opens this screen to choose a save or load slot for the current game, with saved slots shown for selection.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to save or restore game progress through the emulator slots screen.

zh-CN.description: Beseting Nes Emulator 会打开此页面，为当前游戏选择存档或读档位置，并显示已有存档供选择。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过模拟器的存档页面保存或恢复游戏进度。

en.description: The older ASNE social-network library opens this in-app browser for provider sign-in, including its Twitter and LinkedIn flows, and returns when the provider redirects back.
en.disableEffect: Social sign-in flows that use this ASNE authorization screen can no longer finish.

zh-CN.description: 旧版 ASNE 社交网络库会通过此应用内浏览器打开服务商登录页面，包括 Twitter 和 LinkedIn 流程，并在服务商重定向回来时返回结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此 ASNE 授权页面的社交登录流程将无法完成。

en.description: The Angel Sensor Bluetooth connector bundled with SSJ (HCM Lab) runs when an app connects to an Angel sensor, initializes Bluetooth, and provides the connection needed to receive sensor readings. It works in the background when the app requests that connection.
en.disableEffect: Angel Sensor pairing and sensor readings will stop.

zh-CN.description: 随 SSJ（HCM Lab）打包的 Angel Sensor 蓝牙连接组件会在应用连接 Angel 传感器时初始化蓝牙，并提供读取传感器数据所需的连接。应用请求连接时，它会在后台运行。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Angel Sensor 设备将无法配对，应用也无法读取其传感器数据。

en.description: The Aniways Android SDK starts this Service in the background to queue, batch, and upload usage and error events. Disabling it stops Aniways analytics and error reporting while its conversation features remain available.
en.disableEffect: Aniways usage and error events will no longer be uploaded.

zh-CN.description: Aniways Android SDK 会在后台启动此 Service，将使用和错误事件排队、打包并上传。禁用后，Aniways 的统计和错误报告停止发送，聊天功能仍可使用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Aniways 的使用事件和错误事件将不再上传。

en.description: When users open the Aniways Android SDK credit store, including from an icon-unlock request, this Activity shows credit packs, handles purchases, and adds purchased credits to the balance. Disabling it removes that payment flow.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot buy Aniways credits or complete the related icon-unlock purchase flow.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 Aniways Android SDK 的积分商店时（包括从图标解锁入口进入），此 Activity 会展示积分套餐、处理购买并将购得积分计入余额。禁用后，这条付款流程会失效。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法购买 Aniways 积分，也无法完成相关的图标解锁付款流程。

en.description: After Android reports that the device has booted, the Aniways Android SDK receiver schedules server-update checks and a daily installed-app heartbeat. Disabling it stops those background checks and reports.
en.disableEffect: Aniways scheduled configuration updates and installed-app heartbeat reports will stop.

zh-CN.description: Android 发出设备启动完成广播后，Aniways Android SDK 的此 Receiver 会安排服务器更新检查和每日安装状态心跳。禁用后，这些后台检查和上报会停止。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Aniways 的定时配置更新和安装状态心跳上报将停止。

en.description: The Aniways Android SDK starts this Service for scheduled or requested server syncs; it downloads updated configuration and keyword data used by its conversation suggestions. Disabling it prevents those updates from being fetched.
en.disableEffect: Aniways will stop downloading refreshed configuration and suggestion data.

zh-CN.description: Aniways Android SDK 会在定时任务或应用请求同步时启动此 Service，从服务器下载更新后的配置和关键词数据，供对话建议功能使用。禁用后，SDK 无法获取这些更新。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Aniways 将停止下载更新后的配置和建议数据。

en.description: The Aniways Android SDK opens this screen from its conversation controls so users can change automatic and contextual suggestions and the inline icon size. Disabling it removes these user-facing settings.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open Aniways settings to change suggestion behavior or icon size, and an attempt to open the screen can fail.

zh-CN.description: 用户从 Aniways 对话控件打开此设置页后，可以调整自动建议、上下文建议和消息内图标大小。禁用后，这些面向用户的设置将无法使用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法打开 Aniways 设置来调整建议行为或图标大小，尝试进入此页也可能失败。

en.description: The Antsomi Android SDK targets this Receiver when one of its push notifications is dismissed; it reads the notification's push ID. Disabling it stops this dismissal hook while leaving notification clearing available.
en.disableEffect: Antsomi's notification-dismissal hook will not run when a user clears one of its messages.

zh-CN.description: 用户清除 Antsomi Android SDK 的推送通知时，通知会触发此 Receiver；它会读取通知的推送 ID。禁用后，清除通知仍可进行，但此清除回调不会运行。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户清除 Antsomi 通知时，对应的清除回调将不会运行。

en.description: Antsomi's gamification pages use this file provider when users share generated files or screen recordings with other apps. Disabling it breaks those file-sharing flows.
en.disableEffect: Sharing a gamification file or recording may fail when the experience tries to create a shareable file link.

zh-CN.description: 用户从 Antsomi 游戏化页面向其他应用分享生成的文件或屏幕录像时，SDK 会通过此文件 Provider 提供文件访问。禁用后，这些文件分享流程会失败。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 游戏化页面尝试创建可分享文件链接时，文件或录像分享可能失败。

en.description: The Antsomi Android SDK uses this Receiver for push-notification button, rating, and carousel actions. When a user taps one, it forwards the action to the SDK's notification handler.
en.disableEffect: Antsomi push button, rating, and carousel actions will no longer be handled.

zh-CN.description: Antsomi Android SDK 使用此 Receiver 处理推送通知中的按钮、评分和轮播卡片操作。用户点击后，它会把操作交给 SDK 的通知处理流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Antsomi 推送通知中的按钮、评分和轮播操作将不再生效。

en.description: The Antsomi Android SDK queues push payloads for background delivery through this Service, which turns them into notifications. Disabling it can stop queued Antsomi notifications from appearing.
en.disableEffect: Antsomi push messages queued through this background service may not be displayed.

zh-CN.description: Antsomi Android SDK 会通过此 Service 在后台排队处理推送内容，并将其生成通知。禁用后，经此后台服务排队的 Antsomi 通知可能无法显示。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过此后台 Service 排队的 Antsomi 推送消息可能不会显示。

en.description: When a user taps an Antsomi push notification or one of its buttons, this Receiver opens the configured destination and sends the click through the SDK's notification handler. Disabling it breaks those push interactions.
en.disableEffect: Tapping Antsomi notifications or their buttons will no longer open the configured content.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击 Antsomi 推送通知或其中的按钮时，此 Receiver 会打开配置的目标页面，并将点击交给 SDK 的通知处理流程。禁用后，这些推送交互将失效。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 点击 Antsomi 通知或其中的按钮将无法打开配置的内容。

en.description: Firebase Cloud Messaging starts this Antsomi Android SDK Service for incoming push messages; it processes the payload and builds notifications for the user. Disabling it stops this SDK's push delivery.
en.disableEffect: Antsomi push messages will no longer be processed or shown by this service.

zh-CN.description: Firebase Cloud Messaging 会在收到推送时启动 Antsomi Android SDK 的此 Service；它处理消息内容并为用户生成通知。禁用后，此 SDK 的推送投递会停止。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 此 Service 将不再处理或显示 Antsomi 推送消息。

en.description: When an Antsomi gamification experience is opened, this Activity loads its web-based game or campaign and handles in-page media access, file sharing, and screen recording. Disabling it stops those user-facing experiences.
en.disableEffect: Antsomi gamification pages and their sharing or recording features will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: 打开 Antsomi 游戏化体验时，此 Activity 会加载网页游戏或活动，并处理页面内的媒体访问、文件分享和屏幕录像。禁用后，这些面向用户的体验将无法使用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Antsomi 游戏化页面及其分享或录像功能将无法打开。

en.description: When a user taps an Antsomi push notification, this short-lived Activity routes the tap to the app's configured destination or a web link and records the click. Disabling it stops that notification navigation.
en.disableEffect: Tapping Antsomi notifications will no longer open their configured destination or web link.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击 Antsomi 推送通知时，此短暂显示的 Activity 会把点击转到应用配置的页面或网页链接，并记录点击。禁用后，通知导航将停止。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 点击 Antsomi 通知将无法打开配置的页面或网页链接。

en.description: Antsomi gamification starts this foreground Service while a user records a game session; it displays an ongoing notification and keeps the recording session active. Disabling it interrupts the in-game recording feature.
en.disableEffect: Gamification screen recording cannot stay active, so recording and sharing game sessions may fail.

zh-CN.description: 用户录制游戏过程时，Antsomi 游戏化功能会启动此前台 Service；它显示持续通知并保持录像会话运行。禁用后，游戏内录像功能会中断。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 游戏化屏幕录像无法持续运行，录制和分享游戏过程可能失败。

en.description: AnyLife DownloadInstaller uses this provider when passing a downloaded app file to Android's installer. It lets the installer read the APK from the app's private storage.
en.disableEffect: Downloaded apps can no longer be passed to Android for installation through this flow.

en.description: The AppCoins Billing SDK uses this Activity to return a wallet or billing response to the waiting SDK request, then closes it.
en.disableEffect: AppCoins wallet and billing results will no longer return to the app's purchase flow.

zh-CN.description: AppCoins Billing SDK 会在钱包或支付流程返回结果时通过此 Activity 将结果交还给正在等待的 SDK 请求，然后关闭界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: AppCoins 钱包或支付流程的结果将无法返回应用的购买流程。

en.description: The AppCoins Billing SDK opens this Activity when a wallet returns a payment link or result. It reads the result and notifies the active payment flow.
en.disableEffect: Wallet and web payment results will no longer reach the app, so AppCoins purchases may remain incomplete.

zh-CN.description: 钱包通过支付链接返回结果时，AppCoins Billing SDK 会打开此 Activity。它读取结果并通知正在进行的支付流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 钱包或网页支付结果将无法传回应用，AppCoins 购买流程可能无法完成。

en.description: Older AppCoins Billing SDK versions open this Activity to display a payment page inside the app. It returns the transaction result when the page reports completion.
en.disableEffect: In-app web payments in those AppCoins Billing SDK versions will not complete.

zh-CN.description: 较早版本的 AppCoins Billing SDK 会在应用内打开此 Activity 显示支付网页，并在网页返回结果后交还交易结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 这些版本中的应用内网页支付将无法完成。

en.description: The AppCoins Billing SDK launches the supplied purchase activity through this Activity, then returns its payment result to the app.
en.disableEffect: Apps that rely on AppCoins Billing will not be able to complete wallet purchases.

zh-CN.description: AppCoins Billing SDK 会在收到购买请求后通过此 Activity 启动相应的支付界面，并将支付结果返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖 AppCoins Billing 的应用将无法完成 AppCoins 钱包购买。

en.description: The AppCoins Billing SDK shows this dialog when its wallet needs to be installed. The install button opens an available app store or browser for AppCoins Wallet.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot install the required AppCoins Wallet from the billing flow, so purchases that need it cannot continue.

zh-CN.description: 需要安装钱包时，AppCoins Billing SDK 会显示此界面，并提供打开应用商店或浏览器安装 AppCoins Wallet 的入口。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法从支付流程安装所需的 AppCoins Wallet，依赖该钱包的购买将无法继续。

en.description: The AppCoins Billing SDK shows this Activity when billing is unavailable, with an error message and a close button.
en.disableEffect: The billing flow will fail when it tries to show this unavailable-service message.

zh-CN.description: 支付服务不可用时，AppCoins Billing SDK 会通过此 Activity 显示错误说明和关闭按钮。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 支付服务不可用时，相关流程将无法显示说明界面并会中断。

en.description: The AppCoins Billing SDK shows this Activity when its wallet needs an update. The user can open the update page or close the prompt.
en.disableEffect: AppCoins purchases that require a wallet update will have no update prompt or entry point.

zh-CN.description: 钱包需要更新时，AppCoins Billing SDK 会显示此界面；用户可以跳转至更新页面或关闭提示。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要更新钱包的 AppCoins 购买将无法向用户提供更新入口。

en.description: Older AppCoins Billing SDK versions show this dialog when the wallet needs to be installed. Its install button opens an available app store or browser for AppCoins Wallet.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot install the required AppCoins Wallet from these older billing flows, so purchases that need it cannot continue.

zh-CN.description: 较早版本的 AppCoins Billing SDK 会在需要安装钱包时显示此界面，并提供打开应用商店或浏览器安装 AppCoins Wallet 的入口。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法从这些旧版支付流程安装所需的 AppCoins Wallet，依赖该钱包的购买将无法继续。

en.description: Older AppCoins Billing SDK versions show this Activity when the wallet needs an update. The user can open the update page or close the prompt.
en.disableEffect: AppCoins purchases that require a wallet update will have no update prompt or entry point in these versions.

zh-CN.description: 较早版本的 AppCoins Billing SDK 会在钱包需要更新时显示此界面；用户可以跳转至更新页面或关闭提示。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 这些版本中需要更新钱包的 AppCoins 购买将无法向用户提供更新入口。

en.description: Older AppCoins Billing SDK versions use this Activity for guest purchases. It shows payment choices such as card or PayPal and handles web payment, wallet installation, and purchase results.
en.disableEffect: The older AppCoins guest purchase options and their payment results will not work.

zh-CN.description: 较早版本的 AppCoins Billing SDK 使用此 Activity 处理访客购买。它展示银行卡或 PayPal 等支付选项，并处理网页支付、钱包安装及购买结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 旧版 AppCoins 访客购买选项及其支付结果回传将无法使用。

en.description: Older AppCoins Billing SDK versions start this Service for web payments. It runs the WebSocket server that exchanges payment status between the payment page and the app.
en.disableEffect: The older AppCoins web payment flow will not be able to exchange payment status through its WebSocket server.

zh-CN.description: 较早版本的 AppCoins Billing SDK 会在网页支付时启动此服务，为支付网页和应用之间的状态通信运行 WebSocket 服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 旧版 AppCoins 网页支付将无法通过 WebSocket 交换支付状态。

en.description: The AppCoins Billing SDK opens this Activity when a web purchase switches to an external payment page. It opens that page in a browser tab and waits for the payment result to return.
en.disableEffect: External payment pages will not open or return their result to the AppCoins payment flow.

zh-CN.description: 网页购买转到外部支付页面时，AppCoins Billing SDK 会打开此 Activity。它在浏览器标签页中打开支付页面，并等待支付结果返回。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 外部支付页面将无法打开，支付结果也无法返回 AppCoins 流程。

en.description: The AppCoins Billing SDK opens this Activity for web purchases. It displays the payment page in an in-app browser and handles wallet return links and purchase results.
en.disableEffect: In-app AppCoins web purchases will not complete.

zh-CN.description: AppCoins Billing SDK 会在网页支付时打开此 Activity，在应用内网页中显示支付页面并处理钱包返回链接和购买结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用内 AppCoins 网页支付将无法完成。

en.description: When an Appcues in-app experience requests a Play Store review, this Activity requests and launches Google's review prompt. Disabling it removes the Appcues review prompt.
en.disableEffect: Appcues experiences can no longer open the in-app Play Store review prompt.

zh-CN.description: Appcues 站内体验请求 Play 商店评价时，此 Activity 会申请并打开 Google 的评价提示。禁用后，Appcues 的评价提示将无法显示。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Appcues 站内体验将无法再打开 Play 商店的应用内评价提示。

en.description: When an Appcues in-app experience asks the user to enable notifications, this Activity requests Android's notification permission and returns the user's choice. Disabling it stops that Appcues permission prompt.
en.disableEffect: Appcues experiences can no longer show their notification-permission prompt through this Activity.

zh-CN.description: Appcues 站内体验请求用户启用通知时，此 Activity 会申请 Android 通知权限并返回用户的选择。禁用后，Appcues 的权限提示将停止。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Appcues 站内体验将无法通过此 Activity 显示通知权限提示。

en.description: The Appier Ads SDK opens this full-screen page when an interstitial ad is ready, displays the ad, and closes when the viewer dismisses it.
en.disableEffect: Appier interstitial ads will no longer appear, while the app’s other screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: Appier Ads SDK 会在插屏广告准备好时打开此全屏页面展示广告，并在用户关闭广告后退出。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将不再显示 Appier 插屏广告，其他页面仍可使用。

en.description: The Appier Ads SDK opens this full-screen page to play a video ad and may show an end card with a link to the advertiser.
en.disableEffect: Appier video ads and their advertiser links will no longer open, while the app’s other features remain available.

zh-CN.description: Appier Ads SDK 会打开此全屏页面播放视频广告，并可在结束时展示广告主链接页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将不再打开 Appier 视频广告及其广告主链接，其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: When someone taps an Appier ad link, this screen loads web pages inside the app and sends app or store links to a suitable external app.
en.disableEffect: Appier ad links will no longer open through this screen; other app features remain available.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击 Appier 广告链接时，此页面会在应用内打开网页，并将应用或商店链接交给合适的外部应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Appier 广告链接将无法通过此页面打开，应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: The Appier AiDeal SDK uses this troubleshooting screen to show its stored session details and let the integrator reset them.
en.disableEffect: The AiDeal session troubleshooting screen will no longer open, while the app’s normal screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: Appier AiDeal SDK 使用此故障排查页面显示已保存的会话信息，并允许重置这些信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: AiDeal 会话故障排查页面将无法打开，应用的正常页面仍可使用。

en.description: Appier AIQUA declares this receiver for when Android finishes restarting, but its handler runs no task.
en.disableEffect: This component currently has no visible behavior to lose; AIQUA’s other features remain available.

zh-CN.description: Appier AIQUA 声明此接收器用于 Android 完成重启时，但它的处理代码不会执行任何任务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 此组件目前没有可见行为，停用后 AIQUA 的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: Appier AIQUA runs this scheduled background job to fetch campaigns and refresh notification data.
en.disableEffect: AIQUA may stop refreshing campaigns and notification data in the background, while the app’s own screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: Appier AIQUA 会通过此计划任务在后台获取营销活动并更新通知数据。
zh-CN.disableEffect: AIQUA 可能无法再于后台更新营销活动和通知数据，应用自身的页面仍可使用。

en.description: Appier AIQUA briefly opens this screen for notification actions or links, passes their details to its notification handler, and then closes.
en.disableEffect: AIQUA notification actions and links may no longer be handled through this screen; the app’s other features remain available.

zh-CN.description: Appier AIQUA 会在处理通知操作或链接时短暂打开此页面，将相关信息交给通知处理程序后立即关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: AIQUA 通知操作和链接将无法再通过此页面处理，应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: Android invokes this Appier AIQUA receiver when the screen is unlocked; it passes the event and notification actions to AIQUA’s background notification handler.
en.disableEffect: AIQUA will no longer receive this screen-unlock trigger or process notification actions through this receiver; the app’s other features remain available.

zh-CN.description: 屏幕解锁时，Android 会调用 Appier AIQUA 的此接收器；它会将该事件和通知操作交给 AIQUA 的后台通知处理程序。
zh-CN.disableEffect: AIQUA 将无法再通过此接收器接收屏幕解锁事件或处理通知操作，应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: Appier AIQUA runs this background service to handle push messages, display rich notifications, and process notification taps, dismissals, and links.
en.disableEffect: AIQUA push notifications and their actions may stop working, while the app’s other features remain available.

zh-CN.description: Appier AIQUA 会通过此后台服务处理推送消息、显示富媒体通知，并处理通知点击、关闭和链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: AIQUA 推送通知及其操作可能无法继续使用，应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: Appier AIQUA uses this file provider to let Android read files that the SDK stores for notification features.
en.disableEffect: AIQUA notifications that rely on those files may lose their attached media; the app’s other features remain available.

zh-CN.description: Appier AIQUA 使用此文件提供程序，让 Android 读取 SDK 为通知功能保存的文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖这些文件的 AIQUA 通知可能无法显示附带媒体，应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: When an Appier AIQUA campaign asks for an email address or phone number, this screen collects the answer and sends it to the SDK.
en.disableEffect: Those AIQUA prompts will no longer collect an email address or phone number through this screen; the app’s other features remain available.

zh-CN.description: Appier AIQUA 营销活动要求填写电子邮箱或电话号码时，此页面会收集信息并发送给 SDK。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 这些 AIQUA 提示将无法再通过此页面收集电子邮箱或电话号码，应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: Appier AIQUA invokes this receiver when a session-reporting timer expires so it can send accumulated session activity for analytics.
en.disableEffect: AIQUA session activity will no longer be reported by this timer; the app’s other features remain available.

zh-CN.description: Appier AIQUA 的会话上报计时器到期时会调用此接收器，以便发送累计的会话活动数据用于分析。
zh-CN.disableEffect: AIQUA 将无法再通过此计时器上报会话活动，应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: Appier AIQUA uses this background job to apply silent-push requests to refresh in-app campaigns or location boundaries without showing a notification.
en.disableEffect: Silent AIQUA updates to in-app campaigns and location boundaries will stop; the app’s other features remain available.

zh-CN.description: Appier AIQUA 会通过此后台任务处理静默推送请求，在不显示通知的情况下更新应用内营销活动或地理围栏。
zh-CN.disableEffect: AIQUA 将停止通过静默推送更新应用内营销活动和地理围栏，应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: The Appier Ads SDK opens this full-screen page to display an interstitial ad and closes it when the viewer dismisses the ad.
en.disableEffect: Appier interstitial ads will no longer appear, while the app’s other screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: Appier Ads SDK 会打开此全屏页面展示插屏广告，并在用户关闭广告后退出。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将不再显示 Appier 插屏广告，其他页面仍可使用。

en.description: The Appier Ads SDK opens this full-screen page to play a video ad and may show an end card with a link to the advertiser.
en.disableEffect: Appier video ads and their advertiser links will no longer open, while the app’s other features remain available.

zh-CN.description: Appier Ads SDK 会打开此全屏页面播放视频广告，并可在结束时展示广告主链接页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将不再打开 Appier 视频广告及其广告主链接，其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: When someone taps an Appier ad link, this screen loads web pages inside the app and sends app or store links to a suitable external app.
en.disableEffect: Appier ad links will no longer open through this screen; other app features remain available.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击 Appier 广告链接时，此页面会在应用内打开网页，并将应用或商店链接交给合适的外部应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Appier 广告链接将无法通过此页面打开，应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: At startup, the Appier Ads SDK uses this provider to initialize background data signals and error reporting.
en.disableEffect: Appier’s startup data and error signals will not initialize through this provider, while the host app can still start.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，Appier Ads SDK 会通过此提供程序初始化后台数据采集和错误报告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Appier 将无法通过此提供程序初始化启动时的数据采集和错误报告，宿主应用仍可启动。

en.description: Appier AIQUA uses this receiver to process push messages and updated delivery tokens from its push service.
en.disableEffect: AIQUA push messages and delivery-token updates will no longer be processed through this receiver; the app’s other features remain available.

zh-CN.description: Appier AIQUA 使用此接收器处理推送服务发来的消息和更新后的送达令牌。
zh-CN.disableEffect: AIQUA 将无法再通过此接收器处理推送消息和送达令牌更新，应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: When the app starts, Appier AIQUA uses this provider to initialize Firebase push handling, its message inbox, and location support.
en.disableEffect: AIQUA push, inbox, and location features will not initialize through this provider, while the host app can still start.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，Appier AIQUA 会通过此提供程序初始化 Firebase 推送处理、消息收件箱和位置支持。
zh-CN.disableEffect: AIQUA 将无法通过此提供程序初始化推送、收件箱和位置功能，宿主应用仍可启动。

en.description: The Appier Geofence SDK receives Android location-boundary events here and handles the matching location-based campaign activity.
en.disableEffect: Location-based AIQUA campaign triggers will stop; the app’s other features remain available.

zh-CN.description: Appier Geofence SDK 会在此接收 Android 地理围栏事件，并处理相应的位置营销活动。
zh-CN.disableEffect: AIQUA 的位置营销活动触发将停止，应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: Appier AIQUA binds to this service to set up and manage Android location boundaries used by geofence campaigns.
en.disableEffect: AIQUA will no longer set up or manage location boundaries for campaigns; the app’s other features remain available.

zh-CN.description: Appier AIQUA 会绑定到此服务，设置并管理地理围栏营销活动所用的 Android 位置边界。
zh-CN.disableEffect: AIQUA 将无法再为营销活动设置或管理位置边界，应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: When the app starts, this older Appier AIQUA provider initializes Firebase push handling and the SDK’s message inbox.
en.disableEffect: AIQUA Firebase notifications and inbox features will not initialize through this provider, while the host app can still start.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，这个较旧版本的 Appier AIQUA 提供程序会初始化 Firebase 推送处理和 SDK 消息收件箱。
zh-CN.disableEffect: AIQUA 将无法通过此提供程序初始化 Firebase 通知和收件箱功能，宿主应用仍可启动。

en.description: Firebase delivers AIQUA push messages and refreshed device tokens to this Appier service, which forwards them to the SDK.
en.disableEffect: AIQUA will no longer process Firebase push messages or refreshed tokens through this service; the app’s other features remain available.

zh-CN.description: Firebase 会将 AIQUA 推送消息和更新后的设备令牌发送给此 Appier 服务，再由它转交给 SDK。
zh-CN.disableEffect: AIQUA 将无法再通过此服务处理 Firebase 推送消息或更新后的令牌，应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: The Applause Android SDK opens this editor when a user attaches an image or video to a report, so they can review, adjust, save, or discard the attachment.
en.disableEffect: Users will no longer be able to edit report screenshots or videos in Applause; other app features remain available.

zh-CN.description: 用户在报告中附加图片或视频时，Applause Android SDK 会打开此编辑器，让用户查看、调整、保存或放弃附件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法再通过 Applause 编辑报告中的截图或视频，应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: The Applause Android SDK opens this screen to display an in-app survey, collect answers, and show a thank-you message.
en.disableEffect: Applause surveys can no longer be shown or completed; the app’s other features remain available.

zh-CN.description: Applause Android SDK 会打开此页面展示应用内问卷、收集回答并显示感谢信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Applause 问卷将无法显示或完成，应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: The Applause Android SDK opens this screen so users can rate the app and send written feedback, optionally with a screenshot.
en.disableEffect: Users can no longer send ratings or feedback through Applause; the app’s other features remain available.

zh-CN.description: Applause Android SDK 会打开此页面，让用户为应用评分并提交文字反馈，也可附上截图。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法再通过 Applause 提交评分或反馈，应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: The Applause Android SDK opens this screen so users can describe an issue and submit a problem report.
en.disableEffect: Users can no longer submit problem reports through Applause; the app’s other features remain available.

zh-CN.description: Applause Android SDK 会打开此页面，让用户描述问题并提交故障报告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法再通过 Applause 提交故障报告，应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: Applied Recognition's Ver-ID identity-checking SDK uses this Provider to expose captured images and other permitted files through app-scoped links. It runs when the SDK needs to provide an image file to the host app.
en.disableEffect: Ver-ID may be unable to return or share captured images, which can disrupt a verification flow that needs them.

zh-CN.description: Applied Recognition 的 Ver-ID 身份核验 SDK 会通过此 Provider 为采集的图像及其他获准访问的文件生成应用内链接。SDK 需要向宿主应用提供图像文件时会使用它。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Ver-ID 可能无法返回或共享采集到的图像，依赖这些图像的核验流程会受影响。

en.description: Applied Recognition's Ver-ID 2 identity-checking SDK registers this Provider to expose selected SDK files through app-scoped links. The SDK can use it when a face-session flow needs to pass a file to the host app.
en.disableEffect: Ver-ID 2 flows that need to provide SDK files may fail to return them.

zh-CN.description: Applied Recognition 的 Ver-ID 2 身份核验 SDK 注册此 Provider，用于通过应用内链接提供选定的 SDK 文件。面部核验流程需要向宿主应用传递文件时会用到它。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要提供 SDK 文件的 Ver-ID 2 流程可能无法返回这些文件。

en.description: Applied Recognition's Ver-ID face-check SDK opens this Activity from its session guidance controls to show three camera tips: use even lighting, avoid busy backgrounds, and remove glasses if possible. It can read the tips aloud when that option is enabled.
en.disableEffect: The face-capture tips page will be unavailable, but face sessions can still run.

zh-CN.description: Applied Recognition 的 Ver-ID 人脸核验 SDK 会从会话指引入口打开此 Activity，展示三条摄像头使用建议：光线均匀、避开杂乱背景，并尽量摘下眼镜。启用语音提示时，它也会朗读这些建议。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 人脸采集提示页将无法打开，但人脸核验会话仍可运行。

en.description: Applied Recognition's Ver-ID SDK opens this Activity for a face-verification session. It starts camera capture, guides the session, and returns the session result to the app.
en.disableEffect: Apps using Ver-ID for face verification will be unable to start or complete that session.

zh-CN.description: Applied Recognition 的 Ver-ID SDK 会打开此 Activity 执行人脸核验会话。它启动摄像头采集、引导核验过程，并将会话结果返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用 Ver-ID 进行人脸核验的应用将无法启动或完成该会话。

en.description: Applied Recognition's Ver-ID 2 UI registers this Activity for swipeable guidance pages such as face-capture tips. It has no separate content and is not opened directly by the SDK.
en.disableEffect: The SDK's face-session and visible tips screens are separate Activities, so this entry can be disabled without removing those screens.

zh-CN.description: Applied Recognition 的 Ver-ID 2 界面会注册此 Activity 来承载可滑动的指引页面，例如人脸采集提示。它没有独立内容，SDK 不会直接打开它。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 人脸核验和实际显示的提示页由其他 Activity 提供，停用此项不会移除那些页面。

en.description: Applied Recognition's Ver-ID 2 SDK uses this Activity to run a face-verification session with the camera and return its result to the app.
en.disableEffect: Apps using the standard Ver-ID 2 session flow will be unable to run face verification.

zh-CN.description: Applied Recognition 的 Ver-ID 2 SDK 使用此 Activity 调用摄像头执行人脸核验，并将结果返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用 Ver-ID 2 标准会话流程的应用将无法进行人脸核验。

en.description: After a Ver-ID 2 face session fails or times out, this Activity displays the failure status and offers a link to the camera tips.
en.disableEffect: The default flow loses its failure screen, so users will not see why a face check ended or reopen its tips.

zh-CN.description: Ver-ID 2 人脸会话失败或超时时，此 Activity 会显示失败状态，并提供打开摄像头使用提示的入口。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 默认流程将失去失败结果页面，用户无法查看核验为何结束或重新打开相关提示。

en.description: This registered Ver-ID 2 Activity is not a standalone user screen; the SDK opens its separate success or failure result pages instead.
en.disableEffect: Disabling this entry does not remove the separate success and failure pages used by the session flow.

zh-CN.description: 此 Ver-ID 2 Activity 不是独立的用户界面；SDK 会打开单独的成功或失败结果页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用此项不会移除会话流程使用的成功和失败结果页面。

en.description: After a Ver-ID 2 face session succeeds, this Activity confirms success and shows a face image from the captured result.
en.disableEffect: Users will lose the SDK's success confirmation and captured-face result screen.

zh-CN.description: Ver-ID 2 人脸会话成功后，此 Activity 会显示成功提示，并展示本次采集结果中的人脸图像。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将看不到 SDK 的成功确认和采集结果页面。

en.description: Applied Recognition's Ver-ID 2 UI opens this Activity to show three face-capture tips about lighting, background, and glasses. It can also speak the tips when voice prompts are enabled.
en.disableEffect: Users will lose the optional camera guidance, while the face-session Activity remains available.

zh-CN.description: Applied Recognition 的 Ver-ID 2 界面会打开此 Activity，展示关于光线、背景和眼镜的三条人脸采集建议。启用语音提示时，它也会朗读这些建议。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将失去可选的摄像头指引，但人脸核验会话仍可使用。

en.description: Applied Recognition's Ver-ID 2 SDK opens this Activity for a live face session, starts camera capture, and returns the session result to the app.
en.disableEffect: Apps using this Ver-ID 2 face-session flow will be unable to complete biometric checks.

zh-CN.description: Applied Recognition 的 Ver-ID 2 SDK 会打开此 Activity 执行实时人脸会话、启动摄像头采集，并将结果返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此 Ver-ID 2 人脸会话流程的应用将无法完成生物识别核验。

en.description: AppliKey SocialManager opens this screen when Facebook is selected for sign-in. It completes Facebook authorization, retrieves profile details, and returns the result to the app.
en.disableEffect: Facebook sign-in through this library can no longer complete, so an account flow that depends on it will fail.

zh-CN.description: AppliKey SocialManager 在用户选择 Facebook 登录时打开此页面，完成 Facebook 授权、读取个人资料并将结果返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 该库将无法完成 Facebook 登录，依赖此方式的账号流程也会失败。

en.description: AppliKey SocialManager opens this screen when Google is selected for sign-in. It runs Google Sign-In and returns the selected account result to the app.
en.disableEffect: Google sign-in through this library can no longer complete, so an account flow that depends on it will fail.

zh-CN.description: AppliKey SocialManager 在用户选择 Google 登录时打开此页面，执行 Google 登录并将所选账号结果返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 该库将无法完成 Google 登录，依赖此方式的账号流程也会失败。

en.description: AppliKey SocialManager opens Instagram authorization in an in-app browser when Instagram sign-in is selected, then exchanges the returned code for an access token.
en.disableEffect: Instagram sign-in through this library can no longer complete, so an account flow that depends on it will fail.

zh-CN.description: AppliKey SocialManager 在用户选择 Instagram 登录时，通过应用内浏览器打开授权页面，再用返回的代码换取访问令牌。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 该库将无法完成 Instagram 登录，依赖此方式的账号流程也会失败。

en.description: AppliKey SocialManager opens this screen when Twitter sign-in is selected. It starts Twitter authorization and returns the sign-in result to the app.
en.disableEffect: Twitter sign-in through this library can no longer complete, so an account flow that depends on it will fail.

zh-CN.description: AppliKey SocialManager 在用户选择 Twitter 登录时打开此页面，启动 Twitter 授权并将登录结果返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 该库将无法完成 Twitter 登录，依赖此方式的账号流程也会失败。

en.description: Applivery's app-distribution SDK uses this Provider to create file links for downloaded builds and feedback screenshots. Android uses the links when installing an update or attaching an image to a report.
en.disableEffect: Downloaded builds may fail to install, and feedback screenshots may not be attachable.

zh-CN.description: Applivery 应用分发 SDK 使用此 Provider 为下载的版本包和反馈截图生成文件链接。安装更新或将图像附加到反馈时，Android 会读取这些链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 下载的版本包可能无法安装，反馈也可能无法附加截图。

en.description: Applivery's feedback Activity opens the report form, loads its current state, and lets users send feedback from inside the app.
en.disableEffect: Users will be unable to submit feedback through Applivery's in-app form.

zh-CN.description: Applivery 反馈 Activity 会打开并加载反馈表单，让用户直接在应用内提交意见或问题。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 Applivery 的应用内表单提交反馈。

en.description: Applivery opens this Activity to let users choose a screenshot report or a screen-recording report. Each choice starts the corresponding feedback flow.
en.disableEffect: The feedback choices will be unavailable, so users cannot start either report type from this screen.

zh-CN.description: Applivery 会打开此 Activity，让用户选择截图反馈或录屏反馈。选择后会启动相应的反馈流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 反馈选项将无法使用，用户不能从此页面发起这两类反馈。

en.description: During Applivery video feedback, this Activity asks Android for permission to capture the screen and returns the user's choice to the recording flow.
en.disableEffect: The screen-recording consent flow cannot run, so users cannot submit video feedback through Applivery.

zh-CN.description: 提交 Applivery 视频反馈时，此 Activity 会向 Android 请求屏幕录制授权，并将用户的选择返回给录制流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 屏幕录制授权流程无法运行，用户不能通过 Applivery 提交录屏反馈。

en.description: After screen-capture permission is granted, this Applivery foreground Service records the screen into a video for a feedback report and shows a recording notification.
en.disableEffect: Applivery cannot record screen videos for feedback.

zh-CN.description: 获得屏幕录制授权后，此 Applivery 前台 Service 会录制屏幕视频用于反馈，并显示录制通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Applivery 将无法录制用于反馈的屏幕视频。

en.description: This Applivery Receiver handles the stop button in the screen-recording notification and stops the recording Service.
en.disableEffect: The notification's stop button will not stop an active Applivery recording.

zh-CN.description: 此 Applivery Receiver 处理屏幕录制通知中的停止按钮，并停止录制 Service。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通知中的停止按钮将无法停止正在进行的 Applivery 录制。

en.description: Applivery opens this Activity to start account authorization and process the authentication result returned from the sign-in flow.
en.disableEffect: Applivery sign-in and SDK actions that require an authenticated account will not complete.

zh-CN.description: Applivery 会打开此 Activity 启动账户授权，并处理登录流程返回的认证结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Applivery 登录及需要已认证账户的 SDK 操作将无法完成。

en.description: This Applivery Activity receives the sign-in redirect link from the browser and forwards its URL to the authentication flow.
en.disableEffect: Applivery may not process the returned sign-in link, leaving the account login unfinished.

zh-CN.description: 此 Applivery Activity 接收浏览器返回的登录跳转链接，并将链接地址转交给认证流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Applivery 将无法处理返回的登录链接，账户登录会无法完成。

en.description: When an Applivery update is accepted or required, this foreground Service downloads the build, reports progress, and hands it to the installer.
en.disableEffect: Applivery builds cannot be downloaded and installed through this update flow.

zh-CN.description: 接受或必须执行 Applivery 更新时，此前台 Service 会下载应用版本、报告进度，并将安装交给系统安装器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 此更新流程将无法下载并安装 Applivery 应用版本。

en.description: Applivery opens this Activity when an update is required, displays the update progress, and starts the build download. Back presses are ignored while this screen is active.
en.disableEffect: Users will lose the required-update screen and its install flow.

zh-CN.description: Applivery 要求更新时会打开此 Activity，显示更新进度并启动版本下载。此页面打开期间，返回操作不会退出更新流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法看到强制更新页面或通过它安装新版本。

en.description: Applivery opens this Activity for an optional update prompt. Users can start the download or postpone the update.
en.disableEffect: Users will not see or accept Applivery's optional update prompt here.

zh-CN.description: Applivery 会打开此 Activity 显示可选更新提示，用户可以开始下载或推迟更新。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将看不到此处的 Applivery 可选更新提示，也无法从此页面接受更新。

en.description: The legacy Applivery distribution SDK uses this Provider to give Android's package installer access to a downloaded APK file.
en.disableEffect: The legacy Applivery update flow cannot pass a downloaded build to Android for installation.

zh-CN.description: 旧版 Applivery 应用分发 SDK 使用此 Provider 向 Android 系统安装器提供已下载 APK 的访问链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 旧版 Applivery 更新流程无法将下载的应用版本交给 Android 安装。

en.description: At app startup, this Applivery Provider stores the application context used by the SDK to read saved settings and current app information.
en.disableEffect: Applivery components that need app settings or package details can fail because the SDK context is not initialized.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，此 Applivery Provider 会保存 SDK 读取设置和当前应用信息所需的应用上下文。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 由于 SDK 上下文没有初始化，需要读取应用设置或包信息的 Applivery 组件可能无法运行。

en.description: The legacy Applivery updates module runs this Service to download an APK, show download progress, and launch Android's install prompt when the download finishes.
en.disableEffect: The legacy in-app build download and installation flow will stop working.

zh-CN.description: 旧版 Applivery 更新模块通过此 Service 下载 APK、显示下载进度，并在完成后打开 Android 安装提示。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 旧版应用内版本下载和安装流程将无法使用。

en.description: The legacy Applivery updates module uses this Provider to create a file link that Android's package installer can open for a downloaded APK.
en.disableEffect: Android's installer cannot open the downloaded APK through the legacy Applivery update flow.

zh-CN.description: 旧版 Applivery 更新模块使用此 Provider 为下载的 APK 生成 Android 系统安装器可读取的文件链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Android 系统安装器无法通过旧版 Applivery 更新流程打开下载的 APK。

en.description: After an AppLovin incentivized ad reports an accepted, rejected, or over-limit reward outcome, this Activity shows the matching confirmation dialog. If the Activity is unavailable, AppLovin falls back to a brief message.
en.disableEffect: The full reward confirmation dialog will not appear; AppLovin will show a brief message instead.

zh-CN.description: AppLovin 激励广告返回奖励已接受、被拒绝或超出限额等结果后，此 Activity 会显示相应的确认对话框。若此 Activity 不可用，AppLovin 会改为显示简短提示。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 完整的奖励确认对话框不会显示，AppLovin 会改为显示简短提示。

en.description: When AppLovin starts a fullscreen ad, this Activity displays it and handles playback, clicks, and closing. It is used for fullscreen video and rewarded ads.
en.disableEffect: AppLovin fullscreen ads will no longer open, and rewards for watching rewarded ads will no longer be granted.

zh-CN.description: AppLovin 启动全屏广告时，此 Activity 会显示广告并处理播放、点击和关闭操作。它用于全屏视频广告和激励广告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: AppLovin 全屏广告将无法打开，观看激励广告也将不再获得奖励。

en.description: When AppLovin uses immersive mode for a fullscreen ad, this Activity displays the ad without the usual system bars. It handles the same ad playback and closing as the standard fullscreen screen.
en.disableEffect: Immersive fullscreen ads from AppLovin will no longer open, and rewards for watching rewarded ads will no longer be granted.

zh-CN.description: AppLovin 以沉浸模式显示全屏广告时，此 Activity 会隐藏系统栏并展示广告。它负责处理广告播放和关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: AppLovin 的沉浸式全屏广告将无法打开，观看激励广告也将不再获得奖励。

en.description: When an older AppLovin integration requests an interstitial ad, this Activity displays the ad and tracks its playback, impressions, and clicks.
en.disableEffect: AppLovin interstitial ads will no longer appear.

zh-CN.description: 较早版本的 AppLovin 集成请求插屏广告时，此 Activity 会显示广告并记录播放、展示和点击情况。
zh-CN.disableEffect: AppLovin 插屏广告将不再显示。

en.description: When the AppLovin MAX Creative Debugger is opened, this Activity lists recently recorded ad creatives. Selecting an entry opens its details.
en.disableEffect: Recent ad creatives will no longer be available in the MAX Creative Debugger.

zh-CN.description: 打开 AppLovin MAX 创意调试器时，此 Activity 会列出最近记录的广告创意。选择条目可查看详情。
zh-CN.disableEffect: MAX 创意调试器中将无法查看最近记录的广告创意。

en.description: When someone selects a displayed ad in the AppLovin MAX Creative Debugger, this Activity shows its creative and bidding details. It also offers options to report or share the ad information.
en.disableEffect: Ad creative details and their report or share options will no longer open in the MAX Creative Debugger.

zh-CN.description: 在 AppLovin MAX 创意调试器中选择已展示的广告后，此 Activity 会显示创意和竞价详情，并提供举报或分享广告信息的选项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: MAX 创意调试器将无法打开广告创意详情，也无法使用其中的举报或分享选项。

en.description: While an AppLovin fullscreen ad is open, this Service tracks whether the app task is removed. The SDK uses that signal to decide how to handle the ad when the app is opened again.
en.disableEffect: AppLovin may not detect that a fullscreen ad was interrupted when the app task was removed, so the ad may be restored incorrectly after reopening the app.

zh-CN.description: AppLovin 全屏广告打开期间，此 Service 会记录应用任务是否被移除。SDK 会根据这一信号决定应用再次打开时如何处理广告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用任务被移除时，AppLovin 可能无法检测到全屏广告已中断，因此重新打开应用后广告可能无法正确恢复。

en.description: AppLovin uses this Service during fullscreen ads to pass ad status and video completion events back to its SDK.
en.disableEffect: AppLovin fullscreen ads may stop working correctly, and rewards for watching rewarded ads will no longer be granted.

zh-CN.description: AppLovin 在展示全屏广告期间使用此 Service 将广告状态和视频完成事件传回 SDK。
zh-CN.disableEffect: AppLovin 全屏广告可能无法正常工作，观看激励广告也将不再获得奖励。

en.description: When the AppLovin MAX mediation debugger is opened, this Activity shows the main troubleshooting screen with ad network status and debugging sections.
en.disableEffect: The main MAX mediation troubleshooting screen will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: 打开 AppLovin MAX 中介调试器时，此 Activity 会显示主排查页面，其中包含广告网络状态和调试功能分区。
zh-CN.disableEffect: MAX 中介调试器的主排查页面将无法打开。

en.description: From an ad unit or waterfall in the AppLovin MAX mediation debugger, this Activity shows load and display status and provides controls for testing an ad.
en.disableEffect: Ad unit status and ad testing controls will no longer be available in the MAX debugger.

zh-CN.description: 在 AppLovin MAX 中介调试器中选择广告单元或瀑布流后，此 Activity 会显示加载和展示状态，并提供广告测试控件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: MAX 调试器将无法查看广告单元状态或使用广告测试控件。

en.description: When an ad unit is selected in the AppLovin MAX debugger, this Activity lists its targeted and other ad waterfalls. It also shows the targeting information used for each waterfall.
en.disableEffect: The MAX debugger will no longer show an ad unit's waterfall list or targeting details.

zh-CN.description: 在 AppLovin MAX 调试器中选择广告单元后，此 Activity 会列出该单元的定向瀑布流和其他瀑布流，并显示各瀑布流使用的定向信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: MAX 调试器将无法显示广告单元的瀑布流列表和定向详情。

en.description: When the AppLovin MAX mediation debugger opens its ad units section, this Activity lists ad unit IDs and formats, including units used for selective initialization.
en.disableEffect: Ad unit IDs and formats will no longer be available in the MAX debugger.

zh-CN.description: 打开 AppLovin MAX 中介调试器的广告单元分区时，此 Activity 会列出广告单元 ID 和格式，包括用于选择性初始化的单元。
zh-CN.disableEffect: MAX 调试器将无法查看广告单元 ID 和格式。

en.description: When the MAX debugger opens its Axon events section, this Activity lists events recorded by the AppLovin SDK.
en.disableEffect: Recorded AppLovin SDK events will no longer be viewable in the MAX debugger.

zh-CN.description: 打开 MAX 调试器的 Axon 事件分区时，此 Activity 会列出 AppLovin SDK 记录的事件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: MAX 调试器将无法查看 AppLovin SDK 记录的事件。

en.description: From the privacy section of the MAX debugger, this Activity lists configured consent management networks and other consent networks AppLovin recognizes.
en.disableEffect: The MAX debugger will no longer show the configured consent network list.

zh-CN.description: 在 MAX 调试器的隐私分区中，此 Activity 会列出已配置的同意管理网络及 AppLovin 识别的其他同意网络。
zh-CN.disableEffect: MAX 调试器将无法显示已配置的同意网络列表。

en.description: When a network entry is selected in the AppLovin MAX debugger, this Activity shows the ad network adapter details and its initialization status.
en.disableEffect: Ad network adapter details and initialization status will no longer open in the MAX debugger.

zh-CN.description: 在 AppLovin MAX 调试器中选择广告网络条目后，此 Activity 会显示网络适配器详情及其初始化状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: MAX 调试器将无法打开广告网络适配器详情和初始化状态。

en.description: From a ready network's test ads section in the AppLovin MAX debugger, this Activity lets a tester run test ads across supported ad formats.
en.disableEffect: Test ads across ad formats will no longer be available from the MAX debugger.

zh-CN.description: 在 AppLovin MAX 调试器中打开已就绪网络的测试广告分区后，此 Activity 可让用户测试该网络支持的多种广告格式。
zh-CN.disableEffect: MAX 调试器将无法测试该网络的多种广告格式。

en.description: When the MAX debugger opens network consent statuses, this Activity lists privacy consent states for TCF vendors, ad networks, and AppLovin settings.
en.disableEffect: Privacy consent statuses will no longer be viewable in the MAX debugger.

zh-CN.description: 打开 MAX 调试器的网络同意状态页面时，此 Activity 会列出 TCF 供应商、广告网络和 AppLovin 设置的隐私同意状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: MAX 调试器将无法查看隐私同意状态。

en.description: From the privacy section of the AppLovin MAX debugger, this Activity shows consent management platform details, TCF settings, and configured consent networks.
en.disableEffect: Consent platform details and TCF settings will no longer be available in the MAX debugger.

zh-CN.description: 在 AppLovin MAX 调试器的隐私分区中，此 Activity 会显示同意管理平台详情、TCF 设置和已配置的同意网络。
zh-CN.disableEffect: MAX 调试器将无法查看同意管理平台详情和 TCF 设置。

en.description: When a consent string is selected in the AppLovin MAX debugger, this Activity displays the string and lets the user share it.
en.disableEffect: Consent strings will no longer be viewable or shareable from the MAX debugger.

zh-CN.description: 在 AppLovin MAX 调试器中选择同意字符串后，此 Activity 会显示该字符串并提供分享功能。
zh-CN.disableEffect: MAX 调试器将无法查看或分享同意字符串。

en.description: When the AppLovin MAX debugger opens its live network test selector, this Activity lists available ad networks for testing.
en.disableEffect: The MAX debugger will no longer let users choose networks for live ad tests.

zh-CN.description: 打开 AppLovin MAX 调试器的实时网络测试选择页面时，此 Activity 会列出可供测试的广告网络。
zh-CN.disableEffect: MAX 调试器将无法选择用于实时广告测试的网络。

en.description: When the AppLovin MAX debugger opens its test mode network selector, this Activity lists the ad networks available for test mode.
en.disableEffect: The MAX debugger will no longer let users choose networks for test mode.

zh-CN.description: 打开 AppLovin MAX 调试器的测试模式网络选择页面时，此 Activity 会列出可用于测试模式的广告网络。
zh-CN.disableEffect: MAX 调试器将无法选择测试模式使用的广告网络。

en.description: From the AppLovin MAX debugger's privacy section, this Activity shows consent flow geography, privacy policy and terms links, and related settings.
en.disableEffect: The MAX debugger will no longer show the consent flow settings or open the privacy and terms links from this screen.

zh-CN.description: 在 AppLovin MAX 调试器的隐私分区中，此 Activity 会显示同意流程适用地区、隐私政策和服务条款链接及相关设置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: MAX 调试器将无法显示同意流程设置，也无法从此页面打开隐私政策和服务条款链接。

en.description: When a waterfall's keyword section is opened in the AppLovin MAX debugger, this Activity lists the keywords and marks which ones include or exclude the device.
en.disableEffect: Waterfall keyword targeting details will no longer be available in the MAX debugger.

zh-CN.description: 在 AppLovin MAX 调试器中打开瀑布流的关键词分区时，此 Activity 会列出关键词，并标明哪些关键词包含或排除当前设备。
zh-CN.disableEffect: MAX 调试器将无法查看瀑布流关键词定向详情。

en.description: When a waterfall is inspected in the AppLovin MAX debugger, this Activity shows the audience segments used to target it.
en.disableEffect: Waterfall audience targeting details will no longer be available in the MAX debugger.

zh-CN.description: 在 AppLovin MAX 调试器中查看瀑布流时，此 Activity 会显示用于定向该瀑布流的用户群体分组。
zh-CN.disableEffect: MAX 调试器将无法查看瀑布流的用户群体定向详情。

en.description: When the AppLovin adapter displays a native interstitial ad, this Activity presents the ad and handles its close button.
en.disableEffect: Native interstitial ads from this AppLovin adapter will no longer appear.

zh-CN.description: AppLovin 适配器展示原生插屏广告时，此 Activity 会呈现广告并处理关闭按钮。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 此 AppLovin 适配器的原生插屏广告将不再显示。

en.description: When AppLovin MAX displays a hybrid medium rectangle ad, this Activity places the supplied ad view on screen.
en.disableEffect: Hybrid medium rectangle ads from MAX will no longer appear.

zh-CN.description: AppLovin MAX 展示混合中矩形广告时，此 Activity 会将广告视图显示在屏幕上。
zh-CN.disableEffect: MAX 的混合中矩形广告将不再显示。

en.description: When AppLovin MAX displays a hybrid native ad, this Activity renders the ad and prepares its clickable parts.
en.disableEffect: Hybrid native ads from MAX will no longer appear.

zh-CN.description: AppLovin MAX 展示混合原生广告时，此 Activity 会呈现广告并设置可点击区域。
zh-CN.disableEffect: MAX 的混合原生广告将不再显示。

en.description: Android starts this Provider with the app so AppLovin can run its startup setup and retain the application context before the SDK is requested.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it skips AppLovin's startup setup and can leave AppLovin SDK features uninitialized when the app uses them.

zh-CN.description: Android 会随应用启动此 Provider，让 AppLovin 在 SDK 被请求前执行启动设置并保存应用上下文。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，AppLovin 的启动设置会被跳过，应用使用 AppLovin SDK 功能时可能无法完成初始化。

en.description: When an AppLovin ad opens a destination inside the app, this Activity loads the page and receives events such as a back button dismissal.
en.disableEffect: In-app destination pages opened by AppLovin ads will no longer load.

zh-CN.description: AppLovin 广告在应用内打开目标页面时，此 Activity 会加载页面并接收返回键关闭等事件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: AppLovin 广告在应用内打开的目标页面将无法加载。

en.description: When the AppLovin Axon debugger is opened, this Activity shows its diagnostics home screen and an entry to the recorded event list.
en.disableEffect: The AppLovin Axon diagnostics screen will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: 打开 AppLovin Axon 调试器时，此 Activity 会显示诊断主页，并提供进入已记录事件列表的入口。
zh-CN.disableEffect: AppLovin Axon 诊断页面将无法打开。

en.description: When the Axon debugger's events section is opened, this Activity displays recorded AppLovin SDK events and their details.
en.disableEffect: The Axon debugger will no longer show its recorded event list.

zh-CN.description: 打开 Axon 调试器的事件分区时，此 Activity 会显示 AppLovin SDK 记录的事件及其详情。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Axon 调试器将无法显示已记录的事件列表。

en.description: The Kommunicate (Applozic) chat SDK runs this background service after a network or device-clock change. It synchronizes queued and deleted messages and user status, or refreshes the time offset used for chat timestamps.
en.disableEffect: Queued messages, deletions, or user status may remain out of sync after reconnecting, and chat times may be wrong after a clock change.

zh-CN.description: Kommunicate（Applozic）聊天 SDK 在网络或设备时间变化后运行此后台服务。它会同步待发送和已删除的消息及用户状态，或更新聊天时间使用的时差。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 重新联网后，待发送消息、删除状态或用户状态可能无法同步；设备时间变化后，聊天时间也可能不准确。

en.description: The Kommunicate (Applozic) chat SDK uses this service to manage live conversation and typing updates, including subscriptions for contacts, groups, and support teams.
en.disableEffect: Live chat updates and typing indicators may stop arriving for the app's conversations.

zh-CN.description: Kommunicate（Applozic）聊天 SDK 使用此服务管理实时会话和输入状态更新，包括联系人、群组和客服团队的消息订阅。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用会话中的实时消息更新和输入状态提示可能停止接收。

en.description: The Kommunicate (Applozic) chat SDK uses this background service to process incoming messages and synchronize conversation history, message details, and muted-user lists.
en.disableEffect: Incoming messages or conversation updates may not be processed or synchronized.

zh-CN.description: Kommunicate（Applozic）聊天 SDK 使用此后台服务处理收到的消息，并同步会话记录、消息详情和已静音用户列表。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 收到的消息或会话更新可能无法处理或同步。

en.description: The Kommunicate (Applozic) chat SDK sends queued chat messages through this background service.
en.disableEffect: Messages waiting to send may remain unsent.

zh-CN.description: Kommunicate（Applozic）聊天 SDK 通过此后台服务发送排队等待发送的聊天消息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 排队等待发送的消息可能无法发出。

en.description: The Kommunicate (Applozic) chat SDK uses this service to update contact or group read status, unread counts, and user presence or last-seen information.
en.disableEffect: Read receipts, unread counts, and user-status information may become stale.

zh-CN.description: Kommunicate（Applozic）聊天 SDK 使用此服务更新联系人或群组的已读状态、未读数量，以及用户在线或最后活跃信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 已读回执、未读数量和用户状态信息可能不再更新。

en.description: For a signed-in Kommunicate (Applozic) chat user, this receiver requests a background sync after device startup or when connectivity returns.
en.disableEffect: Chat messages and user status may not resynchronize automatically after startup or a network reconnect.

zh-CN.description: Kommunicate（Applozic）聊天用户登录后，设备启动或网络恢复时，此接收器会请求后台同步。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 设备启动或网络恢复后，聊天消息和用户状态可能不会自动重新同步。

en.description: When the device time or time zone changes, the Kommunicate (Applozic) chat SDK recalculates the time offset used for chat timestamps.
en.disableEffect: Chat timestamps may be inaccurate after a device time or time-zone change.

zh-CN.description: 设备时间或时区变化时，Kommunicate（Applozic）聊天 SDK 会重新计算聊天时间使用的时差。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 设备时间或时区变化后，聊天时间可能不准确。

en.description: The AppNexus (Xandr) mobile ads SDK opens this Activity for full-screen ad content, expanded ads, or its in-app browser when a user follows an ad link.
en.disableEffect: AppNexus full-screen and expanded ads, and its in-app ad browser, will not open; other app features remain available.

zh-CN.description: AppNexus（Xandr）移动广告 SDK 会打开此 Activity 显示全屏或展开式广告，也会在用户点击广告链接时打开应用内浏览器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: AppNexus 全屏广告、展开式广告和应用内广告浏览器将无法打开，应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: When the app process starts, Appodeal prepares its ad SDK in the background and initializes the network state it uses to deliver ads.
en.disableEffect: Blocking this provider stops Appodeal’s automatic startup preparation and network-status setup; ads may not load, while the app’s own features remain available.

zh-CN.description: 应用进程启动时，Appodeal 会在后台准备广告 SDK，并初始化投放广告所需的网络状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用此提供器会停止 Appodeal 的自动启动准备和网络状态设置，广告可能无法加载，但应用自身功能仍可使用。

en.description: When Android reports that an app was installed, the Appodeal Ads SDK checks whether it matches an advertised app and records an install attribution event.
en.disableEffect: Appodeal install attribution stops; the app’s other features continue to work.

zh-CN.description: Android 通知有应用安装时，Appodeal Ads SDK 会检查它是否与推广应用匹配，并记录安装归因事件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Appodeal 的安装归因将停止，应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: The Appodeal Ads SDK opens this screen to display a full-screen interstitial ad and closes it when the ad finishes.
en.disableEffect: Appodeal interstitial ads will not appear, but the app’s other features continue to work.

zh-CN.description: Appodeal Ads SDK 会打开此页面显示全屏插页广告，并在广告结束时关闭页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Appodeal 插页广告将不再显示，但应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: The Appodeal ad SDK opens this Activity as a brief loading screen while an ad request settles. It dims the screen, shows a spinner, and then closes.
en.disableEffect: Appodeal ads lose this brief loading overlay; the host app's non-ad features remain available.

zh-CN.description: Appodeal 广告 SDK 会在广告请求处理期间短暂打开此 Activity，遮暗屏幕并显示加载指示，随后自动关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Appodeal 广告将不再显示这段短暂的加载遮罩；应用的非广告功能仍可使用。

en.description: The Appodeal Ads SDK uses this screen to preview test ads and check ad-format callbacks during development.
en.disableEffect: The Appodeal test-ad screen will not open; normal app features continue to work.

zh-CN.description: Appodeal Ads SDK 使用此页面预览测试广告，并在开发期间检查广告格式的回调。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Appodeal 测试广告页面将无法打开，应用的正常功能仍可使用。

en.description: The Appodeal Ads SDK opens this screen to play a full-screen video ad, either rewarded or non-rewarded.
en.disableEffect: Appodeal video ads will not play, and rewards for watching them will no longer be granted; other app features continue to work.

zh-CN.description: Appodeal Ads SDK 会打开此页面播放全屏视频广告，广告可以是奖励型或非奖励型。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Appodeal 视频广告将无法播放，观看广告也不再获得奖励；应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: The Appodeal Ads SDK uses this screen to play a cached ad video and report playback completion or interruption.
en.disableEffect: Cached Appodeal videos will not play, and rewards tied to watching them will no longer be granted; other app features continue to work.
