zh-CN.description: Appodeal Ads SDK 使用此页面播放缓存的视频广告，并报告播放完成或中断。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 缓存的 Appodeal 视频将无法播放，观看视频相关的奖励也不再发放；应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: When the app starts, Appodeal registers its BidMachine ad adapter so BidMachine can supply ads through Appodeal.
en.disableEffect: BidMachine ads stop being available through Appodeal; the host app's other features remain available.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，Appodeal 会注册 BidMachine 广告适配器，让 BidMachine 通过 Appodeal 提供广告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Appodeal 将无法提供 BidMachine 广告，但应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: The Appodeal ad SDK uses this full-screen Activity to play SpotX video ads, including rewarded and non-rewarded ads.
en.disableEffect: SpotX video ads will stop playing, and rewards for watching ads will no longer be granted.

zh-CN.description: Appodeal 广告 SDK 使用此全屏 Activity 播放 SpotX 视频广告，包括激励广告和普通广告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: SpotX 视频广告将无法播放，观看广告的奖励也将不再发放。

en.description: Appodeal Ads opens this screen for interactive video ads, including rewarded and non-rewarded placements.
en.disableEffect: These interactive video ads will not open, and rewards for watching them will no longer be granted; other app features continue to work.

zh-CN.description: Appodeal 的 VPAID 广告集成会打开此页面播放互动视频广告，包括奖励型和非奖励型广告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 此类互动视频广告将无法打开，观看广告也不再获得奖励；应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: Appodeal’s consent SDK opens this web page when the app asks users to review or choose data-use options.
en.disableEffect: The consent page cannot open, so an app that requires this consent step may be unable to finish that flow.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求用户查看或选择数据使用选项时，Appodeal 同意管理 SDK 会打开此网页。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 同意页面将无法打开，因此要求完成此步骤的应用可能无法完成相应流程。

en.description: Appodeal Ads opens this screen to play a full-screen video ad and track its clicks and completion.
en.disableEffect: Appodeal VAST video ads will not open; the app’s other features continue to work.

zh-CN.description: Appodeal Ads SDK 会打开此页面播放 VAST 视频广告，并记录广告点击和播放完成情况。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Appodeal VAST 视频广告将无法打开，应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: Appodeal Ads opens this page to display a full-screen ad, which may be rewarded.
en.disableEffect: These full-screen ads will not open, and rewards for watching rewarded ads will no longer be granted; other app features continue to work.

zh-CN.description: Appodeal 的互动广告集成会打开此全屏页面展示广告，其中可能包括奖励型广告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 此类全屏广告将无法打开，观看奖励型广告也不再获得奖励；应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: Mapp Engage uses this receiver for Mapp Intelligence broadcasts that exchange the user's alias and page information, connecting analytics with Engage messages.
en.disableEffect: Mapp Intelligence and Mapp Engage will stop exchanging alias and page information, so alias-based targeting and page-triggered messages will not work.

zh-CN.description: Mapp Engage 使用此接收器处理 Mapp Intelligence 广播中的用户别名和页面信息，以便将分析数据与 Engage 消息关联起来。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Mapp Intelligence 与 Mapp Engage 将无法再交换别名和页面信息，因此基于别名的定向和页面触发消息将不可用。

en.description: When a scheduled Mapp Engage geofence alarm fires, this receiver reads the region crossing and sends it to Mapp; it also posts a location status notification.
en.disableEffect: Mapp geofence entry and exit reports and their local status notification will stop.

zh-CN.description: Mapp Engage 的地理围栏定时提醒触发时，此接收器会读取区域进出事件并发送给 Mapp，同时显示位置状态通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Mapp 地理围栏的区域进出报告及本地状态通知将停止。

en.description: After Android reports that startup is complete, this Mapp Engage receiver restarts geofencing if it was active before the phone restarted.
en.disableEffect: Mapp geofencing will not resume automatically after the phone restarts.

zh-CN.description: Android 通知系统启动完成后，如果手机重启前已启用地理围栏，此 Mapp Engage 接收器会重新启动它。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 手机重启后，Mapp 地理围栏将不会自动恢复。

en.description: Mapp Engage starts this job service to fetch configured regions and register or remove Android geofences; it also handles a restart request after boot.
en.disableEffect: Mapp region targeting and geofence entry or exit reporting will stop working.

zh-CN.description: Mapp Engage 会启动此任务服务来获取已配置的区域并注册或移除 Android 地理围栏，也会处理开机后的恢复请求。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Mapp 区域定向以及地理围栏进出报告将无法工作。

en.description: When the phone enters or exits a Mapp Engage region, this service processes the transition and sends the region event and location to Mapp.
en.disableEffect: Mapp will no longer receive geofence entry and exit reports from the phone.

zh-CN.description: 手机进入或离开 Mapp Engage 区域时，此服务会处理该事件并将区域变化和位置发送给 Mapp。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Mapp 将不再收到手机的地理围栏进出报告。

en.description: This Mapp Engage receiver handles Android geofence events for monitored regions and schedules an entry or exit report for delivery to Mapp.
en.disableEffect: Mapp geofence entry and exit events will no longer be reported.

zh-CN.description: 此 Mapp Engage 接收器会处理受监控区域的 Android 地理围栏事件，并安排向 Mapp 发送进出报告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Mapp 将不再收到地理围栏区域的进出事件。

en.description: When Android reports a geofence transition, this Mapp Engage receiver checks whether geofencing is active and schedules the region event for processing.
en.disableEffect: Mapp Engage will stop processing geofence entry and exit events.

zh-CN.description: Android 报告地理围栏变化时，此 Mapp Engage 接收器会检查地理围栏是否启用，并安排处理该区域事件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Mapp Engage 将停止处理地理围栏区域的进出事件。

en.description: Mapp Engage's location receiver runs when Android supplies a location result; in the analyzed version it only records the update in the SDK log.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it has no visible effect in the analyzed version; the location log entry will be absent.

zh-CN.description: Android 提供位置结果时，Mapp Engage 的位置接收器会运行；在分析的版本中，它只会将更新写入 SDK 日志。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 在分析的版本中，禁用它没有可见影响，只会缺少这条位置日志。

en.description: When Mapp Engage needs a runtime permission, this activity asks Android to show the permission request and returns the user's decision to the SDK.
en.disableEffect: Mapp Engage will not be able to request permissions needed for its location and notification features.

zh-CN.description: Mapp Engage 需要运行时权限时，此界面会请求 Android 显示权限提示，并将用户的选择返回给 SDK。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Mapp Engage 将无法请求其位置和通知功能所需的权限。

en.description: Mapp Engage uses this receiver for internal push events such as receipt, opening, dismissal, and button clicks; it calls app callbacks, updates badges, and reports engagement.
en.disableEffect: Mapp push callbacks, badge updates, and engagement reports will stop.

zh-CN.description: Mapp Engage 使用此接收器处理推送收到、打开、关闭和按钮点击等内部事件，并调用应用回调、更新角标及报告互动情况。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Mapp 推送回调、角标更新和互动报告将停止。

en.description: When a user opens a Mapp Engage push, this service clears the notification, reports the open, and launches its configured inbox, rich message, web page, deep link, store page, or app screen.
en.disableEffect: Tapping Mapp notifications will no longer open their destination or report the open.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 Mapp Engage 推送时，此服务会清除通知、报告打开事件，并启动配置的收件箱、富媒体消息、网页、深层链接、应用商店页面或应用界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 点击 Mapp 通知将无法打开目标页面，也不会报告打开事件。

en.description: Mapp Engage's audio push service responds to play, pause, seek, and dismiss requests from audio notification controls and plays the attached audio.
en.disableEffect: Audio playback and its notification controls for Mapp push messages will stop working.

zh-CN.description: Mapp Engage 的音频推送服务会响应通知控件的播放、暂停、快进、快退和关闭请求，并播放随消息附带的音频。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Mapp 推送消息中的音频播放及其通知控件将无法工作。

en.description: When an audio push control is used, this Mapp Engage receiver updates the notification and forwards the playback request to the audio service.
en.disableEffect: Audio notification buttons will no longer control playback or refresh the notification.

zh-CN.description: 用户操作音频推送控件时，此 Mapp Engage 接收器会更新通知，并将播放请求转交给音频服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 音频通知按钮将无法控制播放或刷新通知。

en.description: Mapp Engage binds this service to initialize device setup, push, geofencing, analytics, and in-app messaging; it also restarts geofencing after a delayed update.
en.disableEffect: Mapp Engage background messaging, analytics, and geofencing may stop, while the app's regular screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: Mapp Engage 会绑定此服务以初始化设备设置、推送、地理围栏、分析和应用内消息；更新延迟时，它也会恢复地理围栏。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Mapp Engage 的后台消息、分析和地理围栏可能停止，但应用的常规界面仍可使用。

en.description: When Mapp Engage displays a full-screen in-app message, this activity shows its web content and handles message links and dismissal.
en.disableEffect: Full-screen Mapp in-app messages and the links inside them will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: Mapp Engage 显示全屏应用内消息时，此界面会呈现网页内容并处理消息链接和关闭操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Mapp 全屏应用内消息及其中的链接将无法打开。

en.description: When a Mapp Engage push opens a web landing page, this activity loads the page and lets the user return to the app.
en.disableEffect: Web landing pages opened from Mapp push messages will no longer be shown.

zh-CN.description: Mapp Engage 推送打开网页落地页时，此界面会加载页面，并允许用户返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Mapp 推送打开的网页落地页将不再显示。

en.description: Mapp Engage starts this transparent activity to route a push tap to its destination, then closes it.
en.disableEffect: Tapping Mapp Engage notifications will no longer be forwarded to their destination.

zh-CN.description: Mapp Engage 会启动此透明界面，将推送点击转到目标页面，然后自动关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 点击 Mapp Engage 通知将无法跳转到目标页面。

en.description: When a Mapp Engage video message opens, this activity plays its video and provides playback controls.
en.disableEffect: Videos attached to Mapp Engage messages will no longer play in the app.

zh-CN.description: Mapp Engage 视频消息打开时，此界面会播放视频并提供播放控件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Mapp Engage 消息中的视频将无法在应用内播放。

en.description: Mapp Engage sends this receiver push events such as receipt, opening, dismissal, silent messages, and button clicks so the app can handle them.
en.disableEffect: The app will stop receiving Mapp push event callbacks.

zh-CN.description: Mapp Engage 会向此接收器发送推送收到、打开、关闭、静默消息和按钮点击等事件，供应用处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将不再收到 Mapp 推送事件回调。

en.description: When Firebase Cloud Messaging delivers a Mapp Engage message, this service passes it to Mapp's push renderer; it also receives new messaging tokens.
en.disableEffect: Mapp Engage push messages delivered through Firebase will no longer be rendered by the SDK.

zh-CN.description: Firebase Cloud Messaging 收到 Mapp Engage 消息时，此服务会将其交给 Mapp 的推送处理程序；它也会接收新的消息令牌。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过 Firebase 送达的 Mapp Engage 推送将无法再由 SDK 显示。

en.description: When AppsPrize (App Samurai) sends an internal request containing apps to block, this receiver saves that list for the AppsPrize (App Samurai) offer system.
en.disableEffect: AppsPrize’s app-block list will no longer update; the host app’s other features remain available.

zh-CN.description: AppsPrize（App Samurai）发出需要屏蔽应用的内部请求时，此接收器会将名单保存到 AppsPrize（App Samurai）优惠系统。
zh-CN.disableEffect: AppsPrize 的应用屏蔽名单将不再更新，但应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: When AppsPrize (App Samurai) sends an internal request containing apps to block, this receiver saves that list for the AppsPrize (App Samurai) offer system.
en.disableEffect: AppsPrize’s app-block list will no longer update; the host app’s other features remain available.

zh-CN.description: AppsPrize（App Samurai）发出需要屏蔽应用的内部请求时，此接收器会将名单保存到 AppsPrize（App Samurai）优惠系统。
zh-CN.disableEffect: AppsPrize 的应用屏蔽名单将不再更新，但应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: When AppsPrize (App Samurai) opens its Playtime offers, it starts this foreground service to sync offer data in the background and shows an ongoing low-priority notification while it runs.
en.disableEffect: AppsPrize Playtime offers will stop refreshing in the background; the host app’s other features remain available.

zh-CN.description: AppsPrize（App Samurai）打开 Playtime 优惠时，会启动此前台服务在后台同步优惠数据，并在运行期间显示低优先级常驻通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: AppsPrize Playtime 优惠将不再于后台刷新，但应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: When a user opens the AppsPrize (App Samurai) playtime offer page, this screen displays the available offers and records that the page was opened.
en.disableEffect: AppsPrize offers will no longer be available through this screen; the host app’s other features remain available.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 AppsPrize（App Samurai）Playtime 优惠页时，此页面会展示可用优惠并记录页面已打开。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 此页面将无法显示 AppsPrize 优惠，但应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: When a user opens AppsPrize (App Samurai)’s Playtime screen, this page loads the offer experience, tracks that it was opened, and resumes offer tasks when brought to the foreground.
en.disableEffect: AppsPrize Playtime offers and their related rewards will be unavailable; the host app’s other features remain available.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 AppsPrize（App Samurai）Playtime 页面时，此页面会加载优惠内容、记录页面已打开，并在回到前台时继续相关任务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: AppsPrize Playtime 优惠及其相关奖励将无法使用，但应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: When editing a Storyly Moments story, this App Samurai screen opens the text editor for an overlay; users can type text, adjust its style, and apply it to the story.
en.disableEffect: Users will lose text editing while creating Storyly Moments, breaking part of that story-authoring feature.

zh-CN.description: 编辑 Storyly Moments 故事时，App Samurai 的此页面会打开文字编辑器；用户可以输入文字、调整样式并将其应用到故事中。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在创建 Storyly Moments 时编辑文字，故事创作功能的一部分会因此失效。

en.description: When Storyly (App Samurai) sends a countdown reminder with a title and message, this receiver posts an Android notification; tapping it opens the app with the reminder destination attached.
en.disableEffect: Storyly countdown reminder notifications will not appear; the host app’s other features remain available.

zh-CN.description: Storyly（App Samurai）发送带有标题和内容的倒计时提醒时，此接收器会发布 Android 通知；点击通知会将提醒目标传给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Storyly 倒计时提醒通知将不再显示，但应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: Appinfra’s AppsFerry Core starts automatically with the app and initializes modules registered for app-start and foreground/background callbacks.
en.disableEffect: AppsFerry modules that need startup or app-lifecycle callbacks will not initialize, so features they provide may stop working.

zh-CN.description: Appinfra 的 AppsFerry Core 会随应用启动，并初始化已注册的启动及前后台生命周期模块。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，需要启动或应用生命周期回调的 AppsFerry 模块无法初始化，其提供的功能可能停止工作。

en.description: AppsFlyer reads Google Play install-referrer messages to record campaign attribution, then forwards them to other registered receivers.
en.disableEffect: AppsFlyer install attribution and the install-referrer messages it forwards will stop.

zh-CN.description: AppsFlyer 会读取 Google Play 安装来源以记录推广归因，并将相关消息转给其他已登记的接收器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，AppsFlyer 安装归因及其转发的安装来源消息将停止。

en.description: After Google Play reports a new installation, AppsFlyer receives the install referral and records which source brought the user to the app.
en.disableEffect: AppsFlyer will no longer attribute installs from the store referral; the app itself continues to work.

zh-CN.description: Google Play 报告新安装后，AppsFlyer 会接收安装来源信息并记录用户从哪里进入了应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: AppsFlyer 将无法根据商店的来源信息统计安装归因，但应用本身仍可使用。

en.description: When AppSpector’s diagnostic tools request a runtime permission or location setting, this screen shows the prompt, opens settings when needed, and returns the result.
en.disableEffect: AppSpector permission and location-setting prompts will stop working; the host app’s normal features remain available.

zh-CN.description: AppSpector 诊断工具请求运行时权限或位置设置时，此页面会显示提示、按需打开系统设置并返回处理结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: AppSpector 的权限和位置设置提示将无法使用，但应用的常规功能仍可使用。

en.description: KashProxy (Appspiriment Labs) opens this screen when the app launches its API-response mapping tool. It shows saved mappings and lets users inspect or edit them.
en.disableEffect: The app can no longer open or manage KashProxy's API-response mappings through this SDK.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动 API 响应映射工具时，Appspiriment Labs 的 KashProxy 会打开此页面，显示已保存的映射并供用户查看或编辑。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用将无法通过此 SDK 打开或管理 KashProxy 的 API 响应映射。

en.description: AlphaPush (AppsPress) receives Firebase push messages and routes them to the app’s push handlers unless notifications are muted. It also saves updated push-delivery tokens.
en.disableEffect: The app will stop receiving or handling AlphaPush notifications and may not register refreshed push-delivery tokens.

zh-CN.description: AlphaPush（AppsPress）会接收 Firebase 推送消息；通知未静音时，它会把消息交给应用的推送处理程序。它也会保存更新后的推送令牌。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法接收或处理 AlphaPush 通知，也可能无法登记更新后的推送令牌。

en.description: When a user taps or dismisses an AlphaPush notification, this component opens its linked app page or records the dismissal.
en.disableEffect: Tapping a notification will no longer open its linked page through AlphaPush; notification click and dismissal handling will stop.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击或移除 AlphaPush 通知时，此组件会打开通知关联的应用页面，或记录通知已被移除。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 点击通知将无法通过 AlphaPush 打开关联页面，通知点击和移除操作也不会被处理。

en.description: When Updraft (Apps with Love) opens a feedback form, this screen displays the form and can include a screenshot captured for the report.
en.disableEffect: Updraft’s in-app feedback screen cannot be opened, so its feedback flow may fail; unrelated app features remain available.

zh-CN.description: Updraft（Apps with Love）打开反馈表单时，此页面会显示表单，并可附上为反馈报告截取的屏幕截图。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Updraft 的应用内反馈页面将无法打开，反馈流程可能失败；其他无关功能仍可使用。

en.description: When Updraft (Apps with Love) raises an update or feedback notice, this translucent screen shows an update prompt, feedback hint, or feedback-disabled notice.
en.disableEffect: Updraft update and feedback notices will not open, so those flows may fail; unrelated app features remain available.

zh-CN.description: Updraft（Apps with Love）发出更新或反馈提示时，此半透明页面会显示更新提醒、反馈提示或反馈已停用的通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Updraft 更新和反馈提示将无法打开，相关流程可能失败；其他无关功能仍可使用。

en.description: When Updraft (Apps with Love) opens a bug report, this screen lets the user annotate a screenshot and then continue to the feedback form.
en.disableEffect: Updraft screenshot reports and feedback submissions will be unavailable, and opening this flow may fail.

zh-CN.description: Updraft（Apps with Love）打开错误反馈时，此页面允许用户标注屏幕截图，然后继续填写反馈表单。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Updraft 截图报告和反馈提交将无法使用，打开此流程也可能失败。

en.description: Apptentive's customer feedback SDK opens this screen to display an in-app interaction, such as a message or feedback page. It provides the interaction view and navigation back to the app.
en.disableEffect: Apptentive in-app interactions that use this screen will not open.

zh-CN.description: Apptentive 客户反馈 SDK 使用此页面展示应用内互动内容，例如消息或反馈页面，并提供返回应用的导航。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此页面的 Apptentive 应用内互动将无法打开。

en.description: Apptentive's SDK uses this provider to attach diagnostic log files when the user chooses to share them by email. It serves files only for that optional support and debugging flow.
en.disableEffect: Sharing Apptentive diagnostic logs by email will stop working.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择通过电子邮件分享诊断日志时，Apptentive SDK 会通过此内容提供器附加日志文件；它仅用于可选的支持和调试流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过电子邮件分享 Apptentive 诊断日志。

en.description: When a user chooses a diagnostic log action from an Apptentive notification, this receiver sends the logs to an email app or stops log monitoring. It is part of the SDK's optional debugging tools.
en.disableEffect: Apptentive diagnostic log sharing and its notification controls will stop working.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Apptentive 通知中选择诊断日志操作时，此接收器会将日志交给邮件应用，或停止日志监控；它属于 SDK 的可选调试工具。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Apptentive 诊断日志分享及其通知控制将无法使用。

en.description: When a user acts on an Apptentive SDK notification, this receiver passes the action to the SDK to open the related message or interaction.
en.disableEffect: Actions on Apptentive notifications will no longer open their related content.

zh-CN.description: 用户操作 Apptentive SDK 通知时，此接收器会将操作交给 SDK，以打开相关消息或互动内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Apptentive 通知的操作将无法再打开相关内容。

en.description: AppVirality's referral SDK opens this screen from a referral offer. It lets users manage sharing details and view their referrals, earnings, and available coupons.
en.disableEffect: Users will lose access to AppVirality referral settings, referral history, earnings, and coupons.

zh-CN.description: AppVirality 推荐 SDK 会从推荐活动打开此页面，供用户管理分享信息并查看推荐记录、收益和可用优惠券。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法使用 AppVirality 推荐设置，也无法查看推荐记录、收益和优惠券。

en.description: AppVirality opens this screen when a referral campaign is triggered. It presents the offer and lets users share it, view its terms, or manage referral settings.
en.disableEffect: AppVirality referral offers and their sharing options will not be available.

zh-CN.description: AppVirality 在推荐活动触发时打开此页面，展示活动内容，并允许用户分享、查看条款或管理推荐设置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: AppVirality 推荐活动及其分享选项将无法使用。

en.description: AppVirality opens this screen from a referral campaign so users can read the campaign's terms.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to open the terms for AppVirality referral campaigns.

zh-CN.description: AppVirality 会从推荐活动打开此页面，供用户阅读活动条款。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法查看 AppVirality 推荐活动的条款。

en.description: AppVirality opens this screen during a referred user's offer flow. It collects referral details and submits a request for the advertised reward.
en.disableEffect: The AppVirality referral reward flow will not be available.

zh-CN.description: 推荐用户进入活动流程时，AppVirality 会打开此页面收集推荐信息并提交奖励申请。
zh-CN.disableEffect: AppVirality 推荐奖励流程将无法使用。

en.description: Appylar's ad SDK opens this screen when a full-screen ad is ready to display. It shows the ad and lets the user close it.
en.disableEffect: Appylar interstitial ads will no longer be displayed.

zh-CN.description: Appylar 广告 SDK 准备展示全屏广告时会打开此页面，显示广告并允许用户关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Appylar 插屏广告将不再显示。

en.description: Apto Payments opens this screen when a user starts adding an eligible payment card to Google Pay. It guides card provisioning and requests the required device authentication.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to add eligible cards to Google Pay through this Apto Payments flow.

zh-CN.description: 用户开始将符合条件的支付卡添加到 Google Pay 时，Apto Payments 会打开此页面，引导卡片配置并请求所需的设备验证。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此 Apto Payments 流程将符合条件的卡添加到 Google Pay。

en.description: Apto Payments opens this screen for card controls and cardholder authentication. It supports actions such as verifying identity or entering a card PIN.
en.disableEffect: Apto Payments card controls and authentication screens will not open.

zh-CN.description: Apto Payments 会打开此页面提供银行卡控制和持卡人验证，支持身份确认或输入银行卡 PIN 等操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Apto Payments 的银行卡控制和验证页面将无法打开。

en.description: The Aranea Apps async runners library starts this service to run queued background tasks. Libraries that use it, including REST clients, may depend on those tasks to complete network work.
en.disableEffect: Queued background work handled by the Aranea Apps runner, including dependent network requests, may not complete.

zh-CN.description: Aranea Apps 异步任务库会启动此服务来运行排队的后台任务。使用该库的 REST 客户端等组件可能依赖这些任务完成网络操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Aranea Apps 任务运行器负责的后台工作（包括依赖它的网络请求）可能无法完成。

en.description: Esri’s ArcGIS Maps SDK for Kotlin Feature Forms toolkit uses this Provider to create temporary files and share content links for form attachments, including captured photos and videos.
en.disableEffect: Feature forms may fail to create, open, or share attachments, including photos and videos.

zh-CN.description: Esri 的 ArcGIS Maps SDK for Kotlin Feature Forms 工具包通过此 Provider 为表单附件创建临时文件并提供内容链接，包括拍摄的照片和视频。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 屏蔽后，表单可能无法创建、打开或分享附件，照片和视频附件也会受影响。

en.description: Argyle Link opens this screen while a user links a financial account. It displays the account-linking interface and guides the connection process.
en.disableEffect: The Argyle account-linking flow that uses this screen will not open.

zh-CN.description: 用户关联金融账户时，Argyle Link 会打开此页面显示账户关联界面并引导连接流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此页面的 Argyle 账户关联流程将无法打开。

en.description: Argyle Link opens this screen for its main financial account-linking flow. It displays the interface users need to connect an account.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to connect a financial account through the Argyle Link flow.

zh-CN.description: Argyle Link 会在主要金融账户关联流程中打开此页面，显示用户连接账户所需的界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 Argyle Link 流程连接金融账户。

en.description: AromaJoin's Aroma Shooter SDK opens this screen when a user connects an Aroma Shooter device. It lists nearby devices and lets the user connect or disconnect over Bluetooth.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to find or connect Aroma Shooter devices through this screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户连接 Aroma Shooter 设备时，AromaJoin SDK 会打开此页面，列出附近设备并允许用户通过蓝牙连接或断开连接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此页面查找或连接 Aroma Shooter 设备。

en.description: Ascend Corp's WeOmni LiveKit opens this screen with room and user details, checks whether the stream is live or a replay, and loads the stream page in the app.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot watch WeOmni live streams or replays from the app.

zh-CN.description: Ascend Corp 的 WeOmni LiveKit 会根据房间和用户信息检查直播状态，并在应用内加载直播或回放页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在应用中观看 WeOmni 直播或回放。

en.description: Ascend Corp's Credit Wallet SDK opens this screen during wallet setup; it hosts the phone-connection step using the wallet data supplied by the app.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot connect a phone or continue this wallet-application flow.

zh-CN.description: 设置钱包时，Ascend Corp 的 Credit Wallet SDK 会打开此页面，并根据应用提供的钱包信息连接手机号。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法连接手机号或继续此钱包申请流程。

en.description: Ascend Corp's Credit Wallet SDK opens this screen to show the wallet's money-transfer history using the wallet data supplied by the app.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot review transfer history in the SDK's wallet.

zh-CN.description: Ascend Corp 的 Credit Wallet SDK 会根据应用提供的钱包信息，在此页面显示转账记录。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法查看此 SDK 钱包中的转账记录。

en.description: Ascend Corp's Credit Wallet SDK opens this screen for topping up with a TrueMoney Wallet, using the current wallet and balance details.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot use the SDK's TrueMoney top-up flow.

zh-CN.description: Ascend Corp 的 Credit Wallet SDK 会使用当前钱包和余额信息，在此页面提供 TrueMoney 钱包充值流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法使用此 SDK 的 TrueMoney 充值流程。

en.description: Ascend Corp’s Credit Wallet SDK opens this screen for its wallet service; it shows the SDK screen title and a back control.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open the Credit Wallet SDK screen through this entry point.

zh-CN.description: Ascend Corp 的 Credit Wallet SDK 会通过此页面打开钱包服务入口；页面显示 SDK 标题和返回按钮。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此入口打开 Credit Wallet SDK 页面。

en.description: Ascend Corp's Credit Wallet SDK uses this screen to load the wallet's online balance page in an embedded browser, using wallet details supplied by the app.
en.disableEffect: The wallet's online balance page cannot open.

zh-CN.description: Ascend Corp 的 Credit Wallet SDK 会使用应用提供的钱包信息，在此页面的内置浏览器中打开在线余额页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 钱包的在线余额页面将无法打开。

en.description: Ascend Corp's Credit Wallet SDK opens this screen to withdraw money from the credit wallet, using the current wallet and balance details.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot start the SDK's withdrawal flow.

zh-CN.description: Ascend Corp 的 Credit Wallet SDK 会使用当前钱包和余额信息，在此页面提供信用钱包提现流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法启动此 SDK 的提现流程。

en.description: The AppCoins Ads SDK uses this Service in its AppCoins Wallet campaign verification flow. The SDK registers campaigns and sends time-stamped confirmations while the app is in the foreground through this connection.
en.disableEffect: AppCoins ad campaigns that rely on the Wallet connection will no longer exchange their attention confirmations through this service.

zh-CN.description: AppCoins Ads SDK 会在与 AppCoins Wallet 的广告活动核验流程中使用此服务。SDK 会注册广告活动，并在应用处于前台时通过该连接发送带时间戳的使用确认。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖 AppCoins Wallet 连接的广告活动将无法通过此服务交换使用确认。

en.description: At app startup, MAshhal's Android Debug Database initializes SQLite access so developers can inspect the app's stored data during debugging.
en.disableEffect: The database inspection tool will not initialize; the app's normal features can still use their data.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，MAshhal 的 Android Debug Database 会初始化对 SQLite 数据的调试查看功能，供开发者检查应用保存的数据。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，该数据库检查工具不会启动；应用的正常功能仍可使用数据。

en.description: When a user taps Clear in a notification from Ashok Varma's Gander HTTP inspector, the service removes saved request records and dismisses the notification.
en.disableEffect: The notification's Clear action will no longer remove Gander's saved request history; the app's own network features remain available.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击 Ashok Varma 的 Gander HTTP 检查器通知中的清除操作时，该服务会删除已保存的请求记录并关闭通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通知中的清除操作将无法删除 Gander 保存的请求记录；应用自身的网络功能仍可使用。

en.description: When a user taps Dismiss in a notification from Ashok Varma's Gander HTTP inspector, the service removes that notification from the status bar.
en.disableEffect: The notification's Dismiss action will stop working; the app's network requests continue normally.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击 Ashok Varma 的 Gander HTTP 检查器通知中的关闭操作后，该服务会从状态栏移除通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通知中的关闭操作将失效；应用的网络请求仍会正常进行。

en.description: When a user selects a saved request in Ashok Varma's Gander HTTP inspector, this screen shows its overview, request and response details, and sharing options.
en.disableEffect: The app keeps working, but users cannot open or share detailed request records in Gander.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Ashok Varma 的 Gander HTTP 检查器中选择一条已保存的请求后，此页面会显示概览、请求和响应详情以及分享选项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用仍可正常使用，但用户无法在 Gander 中查看或分享请求详情。

en.description: When a user opens Ashok Varma's Gander HTTP inspector, it displays and searches the app's saved network requests and responses.
en.disableEffect: The app keeps working, but Gander's saved request list and search screen cannot be opened.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 Ashok Varma 的 Gander HTTP 检查器时，可以查看并搜索应用保存的网络请求和响应。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用仍可正常使用，但 Gander 的请求列表和搜索页面无法打开。

en.description: When an app opens Ashok Varma's SharedPref Manager, this screen lists selected app preferences and lets developers add, edit, or remove entries.
en.disableEffect: Developers lose this preference-inspection screen; the app's normal features are unaffected.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开 Ashok Varma 的 SharedPref Manager 时，此页面会列出指定的应用偏好数据，并让开发者添加、修改或删除条目。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 开发者将无法使用此偏好数据检查页面；应用的正常功能不受影响。

en.description: When an app opens Ashok Varma's SQLite Manager with a database reader, this screen browses tables and rows, runs custom queries, and supports editing or sharing exported data.
en.disableEffect: Only the in-app database inspection and editing tool is lost; the app's normal database use is unaffected.

zh-CN.description: 应用通过数据库读取器打开 Ashok Varma 的 SQLite Manager 时，开发者可以浏览表和记录、运行自定义查询、编辑数据或分享导出内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用内的数据库检查和编辑工具不可用；应用正常读写数据库不受影响。

en.description: The yst1011 Base Android library provides a reusable in-app web page. When the host app opens it with a URL, it displays that page under an optional configured title bar.
en.disableEffect: If the host app routes web content through this screen, those pages will no longer open; other screens are unaffected.

zh-CN.description: yst1011 Base Android 基础库提供可复用的应用内网页页面。宿主应用传入网址后，此页面会显示对应网页，并可使用配置好的标题栏。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 如果宿主应用通过此页面打开网页，这些网页将无法显示；其他页面不受影响。

en.description: The YST1011 QRCode scanner, also shipped in Han Hankj qrcode 1.0.6, opens a CameraX camera preview when the app requests code scanning and supports scan settings such as zoom and focus.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot open this scanner, so code-scanning actions that use it stop working.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求扫码时，YST1011 的 QRCode 扫描库会打开 CameraX 相机预览，并支持缩放、对焦等扫描设置；Han Hankj 的 qrcode 1.0.6 也包含此页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用无法打开此扫描器，依赖它的扫码操作将无法使用。

en.description: When an app launches AstraPay's QRIS scanner, this screen requests camera access and scans payment QR codes for the app.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot open this scanner, so QR payment or scanning flows that use it will stop working.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动 AstraPay 的 QRIS 扫码功能时，此页面会申请相机权限并为应用扫描付款二维码。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用无法打开此扫码页面，因此依赖它的二维码付款或扫码流程将无法使用。

en.description: When an AstraPay QRIS tap payment has generated a code and a compatible NFC reader requests it, this service sends the code to that reader and marks it used once fully read.
en.disableEffect: AstraPay's NFC handoff for QR payments will stop working.

zh-CN.description: AstraPay QRIS 生成轻触付款码后，兼容的 NFC 读卡器请求该码时，此服务会发送二维码内容，并在读取完成后将其标记为已使用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: AstraPay 的二维码 NFC 轻触交接功能将无法使用。

en.description: When a host app starts the AstraPay QRIS SDK, this screen manages its payment session and shows loading, authorization, and connection messages as the flow runs.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot open the AstraPay QRIS payment flow provided by this SDK.

zh-CN.description: 宿主应用启动 AstraPay QRIS SDK 时，此页面会管理付款流程，并在流程中显示加载、授权或连接提示。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用无法打开此 SDK 提供的 AstraPay QRIS 付款流程。

en.description: When an integrated app launches AstraPay's QRIS scanner, this screen requests camera access, scans payment QR codes, and returns scan events to the app.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot open this scanner, so QR scanning flows that use it will stop working.

zh-CN.description: 集成应用启动 AstraPay QRIS 扫码功能时，此页面会申请相机权限、扫描付款二维码并将扫码结果返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用无法打开此扫码页面，因此依赖它的二维码扫描流程将无法使用。

en.description: After notification access is granted, the AstraPay QRIS SDK checks new WhatsApp and WhatsApp Business notifications for a six-digit verification code and sends a match to the code-entry screen.
en.disableEffect: WhatsApp codes will no longer fill in automatically; the verification screen can still receive SMS codes or accept manual entry.

zh-CN.description: 获得通知访问权限后，AstraPay QRIS SDK 会检查 WhatsApp 和 WhatsApp Business 的新通知，提取六位验证码并发送到输入页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: WhatsApp 验证码将不再自动填入；验证页面仍可接收短信验证码或手动输入。

en.description: When a host app opens QRIS payment through the AstraPay Android SDK, this screen hosts the flow from QR scanning through amount entry, payment confirmation, and results.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot open the QRIS payment flow provided by this SDK.

zh-CN.description: 宿主应用通过 AstraPay Android SDK 打开 QRIS 付款时，此页面承载从扫码、输入金额到确认付款和查看结果的流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用无法打开此 SDK 提供的 QRIS 付款流程。

en.description: When a host app starts the AstraPay QRIS Android SDK, this screen hosts its payment flow, beginning with QR scanning and continuing to amount entry and confirmation.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot open the QR payment flow provided by this SDK.

zh-CN.description: 宿主应用启动 AstraPay QRIS Android SDK 时，此页面承载付款流程，先扫描二维码，再输入金额并确认付款。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用无法打开此 SDK 提供的二维码付款流程。

en.description: When Android routes an NFC card-emulation request to the AstraPay Android SDK, this service displays “NFC is not enabled” and returns a fixed sample response.
en.disableEffect: The SDK's NFC tap payment option will not receive a response from this service.

zh-CN.description: Android 将 NFC 卡模拟请求交给 AstraPay Android SDK 时，此服务会显示“NFC 未启用”并返回固定的示例内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，SDK 的 NFC 轻触付款选项将无法从此服务获得响应。

en.description: When a host app opens AstraPay's user SDK, this screen hosts the user-account flow, including entry into one-time-code verification.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot open the user-account and verification flow provided by this SDK.

zh-CN.description: 宿主应用打开 AstraPay 用户 SDK 时，此页面承载用户账户流程，包括进入一次性验证码验证。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用无法打开此 SDK 提供的用户账户和验证流程。

en.description: After notification access is granted, the AstraPay Android SDK checks new WhatsApp and WhatsApp Business notifications for a six-digit verification code and sends a match to the code-entry screen.
en.disableEffect: WhatsApp codes will no longer fill in automatically; the verification screen can still receive SMS codes or accept manual entry.

zh-CN.description: 获得通知访问权限后，AstraPay Android SDK 会检查 WhatsApp 和 WhatsApp Business 的新通知，提取六位验证码并发送到输入页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: WhatsApp 验证码将不再自动填入；验证页面仍可接收短信验证码或手动输入。

en.description: When a host app opens AstraPay's top-up flow, this screen loads AstraPay's top-up methods in a web page using the current session authorization.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot open or complete top-ups through this SDK screen.

zh-CN.description: 宿主应用打开 AstraPay 充值流程时，此页面会在内置网页中加载 AstraPay 的充值方式，并使用当前会话授权访问。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用无法通过此 SDK 页面打开或完成充值。

en.description: The Yongzheng7 logger uses this Provider to share log files with another app when a user chooses to export a log. Disabling it affects log sharing, not normal app features.
en.disableEffect: Users may be unable to share or export diagnostic log files.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择导出日志时，Yongzheng7 日志模块会通过此 Provider 将日志文件共享给其他应用。停用后会影响日志分享，但不影响应用的日常功能。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户可能无法分享或导出诊断日志文件。

en.description: When a user opens a saved log, this Yongzheng7 logger screen displays its contents and offers options to delete, share, or upload it. Disabling it only removes diagnostic-log tools.
en.disableEffect: Users may be unable to read, share, upload, or delete an individual diagnostic log from the logger screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开已保存的日志时，此 Yongzheng7 日志界面会显示内容，并提供删除、分享或上传操作。停用后只会失去诊断日志工具。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户可能无法在日志界面查看、分享、上传或删除单条诊断日志。

en.description: When a user opens the Yongzheng7 log viewer, this Activity lists log folders in pages and lets the user delete or bundle log files. Disabling it only affects diagnostic tools.
en.disableEffect: Users may be unable to browse, bundle, or delete diagnostic log files through the logger screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 Yongzheng7 日志查看器时，此 Activity 会分页显示日志目录，并允许删除或打包日志文件。停用后只会影响诊断工具。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户可能无法通过日志界面浏览、打包或删除诊断日志。

en.description: When the app starts an NFC scan or Android opens a discovered tag, this Activity reads the tag data and returns it to the app. It also enables foreground NFC tag handling while the scan screen is open.
en.disableEffect: The app may no longer read NFC tags or receive their data through this module.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动 NFC 扫描或 Android 打开已发现的标签时，此 Activity 会读取标签数据并返回给应用；扫描期间也会启用前台 NFC 标签处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用可能无法通过此模块读取 NFC 标签或接收标签数据。

en.description: When the Yongzheng7 file picker shares a local file, this Provider creates a controlled file link that other apps can open. Disabling it can break file-sharing flows that use the picker.
en.disableEffect: The app may fail when it tries to share a local file with another app.

zh-CN.description: Yongzheng7 文件选择器共享本地文件时，此 Provider 会创建受控文件链接供其他应用读取。停用后，使用该选择器的文件分享流程可能中断。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用尝试把本地文件分享给其他应用时可能失败。

en.description: The Yongzheng7 crash reporter uses this Provider to share crash-log files with other apps. Disabling it affects diagnostic reports rather than the app's normal features.
en.disableEffect: Users may be unable to share a crash log from the reporter.

zh-CN.description: Yongzheng7 崩溃报告模块通过此 Provider 将崩溃日志分享给其他应用。停用后会影响诊断报告，不影响应用的日常功能。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户可能无法从报告界面分享崩溃日志。

en.description: When a user opens the Yongzheng7 crash reporter, this Activity lists crash and exception logs and can clear them or restart the app. Disabling it only removes diagnostic-log management.
en.disableEffect: Users may be unable to review or clear saved crash and exception reports from this screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 Yongzheng7 崩溃报告界面时，此 Activity 会列出崩溃和异常日志，并可清理日志或重启应用。停用后只会失去诊断日志管理功能。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户可能无法在此界面查看或清除已保存的崩溃和异常报告。

en.description: When the Yongzheng7 crash reporter opens a saved error log, this Activity displays it and offers report, share, delete, and restart options. Disabling it affects crash diagnostics.
en.disableEffect: Users may be unable to review or send a diagnostic error report through this screen.

zh-CN.description: Yongzheng7 崩溃报告模块打开已保存的错误日志时，此 Activity 会显示日志并提供报告、分享、删除和重启操作。停用后会影响崩溃诊断。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户可能无法通过此界面查看或提交诊断错误报告。

en.description: When a user taps the crash reporter's share-link notification, this Receiver sends the saved report through the configured reporting service and opens the resulting link for sharing. Disabling it only affects diagnostics.
en.disableEffect: Users may be unable to upload and share a report from that notification.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击崩溃报告的分享链接通知时，此 Receiver 会通过已配置的报告服务上传日志，并打开生成的链接供分享。停用后只会影响诊断功能。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户可能无法通过该通知上传并分享报告。

en.description: The Atome Merchant SDK uses this provider to give its in-app web flow a safe link to a temporary camera photo when the page asks the user to take a picture.
en.disableEffect: Atome flows that need to pass a newly captured photo to a web page will fail.

zh-CN.description: Atome 商户 SDK 的应用内网页请求用户拍照时，会通过此 Provider 将临时照片安全地提供给网页。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Atome 中需要把新拍摄照片交给网页处理的流程将无法完成。

en.description: Atommerce's Maca Android SDK receives Firebase push messages and registers refreshed push tokens; it posts community, counseling, chat, and call alerts and routes relevant taps to the app's screens.
en.disableEffect: The app may miss community, counseling, chat, and call alerts from this SDK, and related notifications may not open their intended screen.

zh-CN.description: Atommerce 的 Maca Android SDK 接收 Firebase 推送并登记更新后的推送令牌；它显示社区、咨询、聊天和通话提醒，并将相关通知点击带到应用对应界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用可能收不到此 SDK 的社区、咨询、聊天和通话提醒，相关通知也可能无法打开对应界面。

en.description: The Mindcafe (Atommerce) SDK starts during a Mindcafe counseling call to handle ringing alerts, answer or decline actions, and the ongoing voice or video connection.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it means users may miss call alerts or lose an active call when its screen is not open.

zh-CN.description: Mindcafe（Atommerce）SDK：在 Mindcafe 咨询来电或通话时启动，处理来电提醒、接听或拒绝以及语音或视频通话。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户可能收不到来电提醒，或在通话界面未显示时无法保持通话。

en.description: The Mindcafe (Atommerce) SDK shows a personal-information form before a user begins an interpretation questionnaire about counseling.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it means users cannot submit the basic details needed to continue the interpretation questionnaire.

zh-CN.description: Mindcafe（Atommerce）SDK：在用户开始咨询解读问卷前，显示个人基础信息填写表。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法提交继续解读问卷所需的基础信息。

en.description: The Mindcafe (Atommerce) SDK shows the details and follow-up links for a counseling or coaching session when the user opens information from its chat.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it means users cannot open session details, questionnaires, or reports from the chat.

zh-CN.description: Mindcafe（Atommerce）SDK：用户从聊天页面打开会话信息时，显示咨询或辅导会话详情及后续问卷、报告入口。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法从聊天页面查看会话详情、问卷或报告。

en.description: The Mindcafe (Atommerce) SDK opens the counseling tab when the user enters the Mindcafe module.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it means the counseling tab cannot open and the host flow may fail when it requests that page.

zh-CN.description: Mindcafe（Atommerce）SDK：用户进入 Mindcafe 模块并打开咨询标签页时显示咨询主页。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，咨询标签页将无法打开，调用该页面的流程也可能中断。

en.description: The Mindcafe (Atommerce) SDK loads the report for a completed counseling or coaching session when the user opens its result.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it means users cannot view the report for a completed counseling or coaching session.

zh-CN.description: Mindcafe（Atommerce）SDK：用户查看已完成的咨询或辅导结果时，加载对应的会话报告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法查看已完成的咨询或辅导报告。

en.description: The Mindcafe (Atommerce) SDK loads the interpretation questionnaire when a user starts that assessment from a counseling flow.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it means users cannot complete the interpretation assessment.

zh-CN.description: Mindcafe（Atommerce）SDK：用户从咨询流程开始解读评估时，加载对应的问卷。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法完成解读评估。

en.description: The Mindcafe (Atommerce) SDK opens the list of completed interpretation results for the counseling session selected by the user.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it means users cannot review their completed interpretation results.

zh-CN.description: Mindcafe（Atommerce）SDK：用户打开某次咨询的解读结果时，显示已完成的结果列表。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法查看已完成的解读结果。

en.description: The Mindcafe (Atommerce) SDK opens the interpretation-result sharing page when the user chooses to share a result with a counselor.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it means users cannot share interpretation results with their counselor.

zh-CN.description: Mindcafe（Atommerce）SDK：用户选择与咨询师分享解读结果时，打开结果分享页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法与咨询师分享解读结果。

en.description: The Mindcafe (Atommerce) SDK shows the voice-call screen when a Mindcafe counselor or coach calls or the user starts a voice session.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it means users cannot answer or control Mindcafe voice counseling calls.

zh-CN.description: Mindcafe（Atommerce）SDK：Mindcafe 咨询师或辅导师来电，或用户发起语音会话时，显示语音通话界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法接听或控制 Mindcafe 语音咨询。

en.description: The Mindcafe (Atommerce) SDK shows the details and follow-up links for a counseling or coaching session when the user opens information from its chat.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it means users cannot open session details, questionnaires, or reports from the chat.

zh-CN.description: Mindcafe（Atommerce）SDK：用户从聊天页面打开会话信息时，显示咨询或辅导会话详情及后续问卷、报告入口。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法从聊天页面查看会话详情、问卷或报告。

zh-CN.description: Mindcafe（Atommerce）SDK：用户进入已预约的咨询、辅导或团体会话时，打开聊天并显示消息、剩余时间及会话状态。

zh-CN.description: Mindcafe（Atommerce）SDK：用户打开咨询前后提供的冥想内容时，播放 Mindcafe 冥想。

zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法开始或继续即时咨询或辅导聊天。

en.description: The Mindcafe (Atommerce) SDK shows the video-call screen when a Mindcafe counselor or coach starts a video session with the user.

zh-CN.description: Mindcafe（Atommerce）SDK：Mindcafe 咨询师或辅导师与用户开始视频会话时，显示视频通话界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法接听或控制 Mindcafe 视频咨询。

en.description: The Mindcafe (Atommerce) SDK plays Mindcafe meditation content when the user opens a meditation offered before or after a counseling session.

zh-CN.description: Mindcafe（Atommerce）SDK：用户打开咨询前后提供的冥想内容时，播放 Mindcafe 冥想。

zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法使用会话聊天，也无法查看消息和会话状态。

en.description: The Mindcafe (Atommerce) SDK loads the counseling self-check questions when the user opens a purchased or assigned assessment.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it means users cannot complete the counseling self-check.

zh-CN.description: Mindcafe（Atommerce）SDK：用户打开已购买或分配的咨询自测时，加载自测问题。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法完成咨询自测。

en.description: The Mindcafe (Atommerce) SDK loads completed counseling self-check results when the user opens the result for a session.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it means users cannot view the counseling self-check results.

zh-CN.description: Mindcafe（Atommerce）SDK：用户查看某次会话的咨询自测结果时，加载已完成的结果页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法查看咨询自测结果。

zh-CN.description: Mindcafe（Atommerce）SDK：Mindcafe 咨询师或辅导师来电，或用户发起语音会话时，显示语音通话界面。

en.disableEffect: Disabling it means users cannot apply an eligible saved coupon to a purchase.

zh-CN.description: Mindcafe（Atommerce）SDK：用户结算时选择优惠时，列出可用的已保存优惠券。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法在购买时使用符合条件的优惠券。

en.description: The Mindcafe (Atommerce) SDK shows the Mindcafe opening screen briefly before the host app enters the main Mindcafe pages.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it means users may be unable to enter the Mindcafe pages through the normal launch flow.

zh-CN.description: Mindcafe（Atommerce）SDK：在宿主应用进入 Mindcafe 主页面前，短暂显示启动画面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户可能无法通过正常启动流程进入 Mindcafe 页面。

en.description: The Mindcafe (Atommerce) SDK shows Mindcafe terms of service, privacy, and refund policies when the user opens the legal-information page.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it means users cannot review Mindcafe terms, privacy, or refund policies.

zh-CN.description: Mindcafe（Atommerce）SDK：用户打开法律信息页面时，显示 Mindcafe 服务条款、隐私和退款政策。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法查看 Mindcafe 服务条款、隐私或退款政策。

en.description: The Mindcafe (Atommerce) SDK shows purchased counseling vouchers, remaining sessions, and reservation actions when the user opens their voucher.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it means users cannot review voucher sessions or manage their reservations and cancellations.

zh-CN.description: Mindcafe（Atommerce）SDK：用户打开服务券时，显示已购买的咨询服务券、剩余次数和预约操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法查看服务券会话，也无法管理预约或取消操作。

en.description: The Mindcafe Android SDK from Atommerce uses this as its main screen for the home page, counselor search, counseling, and My Space. It also opens counseling sessions and related pages when the SDK routes the user there.
en.disableEffect: Without it, users cannot enter these main Mindcafe areas or follow the SDK counseling routes.

zh-CN.description: Atommerce 的 Mindcafe Android SDK 以此作为主界面，提供首页、咨询师搜索、咨询服务和「我的空间」入口。SDK 也会通过此界面打开咨询会话及相关页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法进入这些 Mindcafe 主页面，也无法沿 SDK 的咨询服务入口继续操作。

en.description: When the user opens My Coupons in the Mindcafe Android SDK from Atommerce, it loads saved coupons and lets the user register a coupon code. Selecting a coupon can continue to the counselors who accept it.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot view or register coupons here, or continue from a coupon to an eligible counselor.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 Atommerce 的 Mindcafe Android SDK 中的「我的优惠券」时，此页面会加载已保存的优惠券并提供登记优惠券代码的入口。选择优惠券后，用户还可以查看可使用该券的咨询师。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在此查看或登记优惠券，也无法从优惠券继续选择适用的咨询师。

en.description: After a user selects a coupon in the Mindcafe Android SDK from Atommerce, this screen lists counselors who accept that coupon. Selecting a counselor opens that counselor page.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot see or choose a counselor eligible for the selected coupon, interrupting that coupon use flow.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Atommerce 的 Mindcafe Android SDK 中选择优惠券后，此页面会列出接受该优惠券的咨询师。选择咨询师会打开其介绍页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法查看或选择适用该优惠券的咨询师，相关优惠券使用流程会中断。

en.description: When the user opens counseling history in the Mindcafe Android SDK from Atommerce, this screen shows past chat, voice, video, and group sessions that are available for the account.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot access these past counseling session records from the SDK.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 Atommerce 的 Mindcafe Android SDK 中的咨询记录时，此页面会显示账户中可用的文字、语音、视频和团体咨询记录。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此 SDK 查看这些过往咨询记录。

en.description: The Mindcafe Android SDK from Atommerce opens this screen from its My Products area to show purchased counseling services in in-progress and completed lists. The lists also provide service and refund information.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot view purchased counseling services or their related refund information here.

zh-CN.description: Atommerce 的 Mindcafe Android SDK 会从「我的商品」入口打开此页面，按进行中和已完成分类展示已购买的咨询服务，并提供服务及退款信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在此查看已购买的咨询服务及相关退款信息。

en.description: When a user opens reservations in the Mindcafe Android SDK from Atommerce, this screen lists current, previous, and canceled counseling reservations. Users can review reservation details and available cancellation actions.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot check or manage counseling reservations, including available cancellation actions.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 Atommerce 的 Mindcafe Android SDK 中的预约页面时，此界面会列出当前、过往和已取消的咨询预约，并提供预约详情及可用的取消操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法查看或管理咨询预约，也无法使用此页面提供的取消操作。

en.description: The Mindcafe Android SDK from Atommerce opens this screen from its reviews area to show sessions eligible for the user to review. Choosing an item continues to the review form.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot see the sessions awaiting a review or submit a review from this screen.

zh-CN.description: Atommerce 的 Mindcafe Android SDK 会从评价入口打开此页面，列出用户可以评价的咨询记录。选择一条记录后可继续填写评价。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法查看待评价的咨询记录，也无法通过此页面提交评价。

en.description: This is the dedicated My Page screen in the Mindcafe Android SDK from Atommerce. It opens the SDK account and service page when the user enters My Space.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open the Mindcafe My Page from this dedicated SDK screen.

zh-CN.description: 这是 Atommerce 的 Mindcafe Android SDK 中专用的「我的页面」。用户进入「我的空间」时，此界面会打开 SDK 的账户和服务页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此 SDK 专用界面打开 Mindcafe 我的页面。

en.description: When the user follows a profile update link in the Mindcafe Android SDK from Atommerce, this screen lets them review and update profile details such as their nickname and phone number.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot update their profile details or the related service-use consent from this screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击 Atommerce 的 Mindcafe Android SDK 中的个人资料更新入口时，此页面可供查看和修改昵称、电话号码等资料。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此页面更新个人资料或相关服务使用同意信息。

en.description: During a coaching flow in the Mindcafe Android SDK from Atommerce, this screen loads coaching intake questions and collects the user’s answers and profile details. The user can submit the completed answers to the service.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot complete or submit the coaching intake questions through this screen.

zh-CN.description: 在 Atommerce 的 Mindcafe Android SDK 的教练服务流程中，此页面会加载初始问卷并收集用户答案和个人资料。用户可以将填写完成的答案提交给服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此页面填写或提交教练服务初始问卷。

en.description: During a counseling flow in the Mindcafe Android SDK from Atommerce, this screen loads counseling intake questions and consent information. It collects the answers and required privacy choices for submission to the service.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot complete the counseling intake questions or record the related consent choices here.

zh-CN.description: 在 Atommerce 的 Mindcafe Android SDK 的咨询流程中，此页面会加载咨询初始问卷和同意信息，并收集答案及所需的隐私选项以提交给服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在此填写咨询初始问卷或记录相关同意选项。

en.description: When a user opens the questionnaire chooser in the Mindcafe Android SDK from Atommerce, it shows the available counseling and coaching questionnaires. Choosing one opens its intake form.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot choose or open the counseling and coaching questionnaires from this screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 Atommerce 的 Mindcafe Android SDK 中的问卷选择页面时，此页面会显示可用的咨询和教练服务问卷。选择一种后会打开相应的初始问卷。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此页面选择或打开咨询和教练服务问卷。

en.description: When a review link in the Mindcafe Android SDK from Atommerce is opened, this screen displays the available service reviews. Selecting a review opens its full details.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot browse the service reviews through this SDK screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 Atommerce 的 Mindcafe Android SDK 中的评价链接时，此页面会显示可查看的服务评价。选择一条评价会打开完整详情。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此 SDK 页面浏览服务评价。

en.description: When the user selects a review, the Mindcafe Android SDK from Atommerce opens this screen with the full review for that item.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open the full details of a selected review.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择一条评价后，Atommerce 的 Mindcafe Android SDK 会在此页面显示该评价的完整内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开所选评价的完整详情。

en.description: The Mindcafe Android SDK from Atommerce can show this brief opening screen before entering its service pages. It closes after the display time chosen by the app.
en.disableEffect: If the app uses this opening screen, it will no longer open and that SDK entry flow may fail.

zh-CN.description: Atommerce 的 Mindcafe Android SDK 可在进入服务页面前显示此短暂的启动画面。显示时长由接入应用设定，到时后页面会自动关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 如果应用使用此启动画面，它将无法打开，相关 SDK 入口流程可能因此失败。

en.description: When the user opens a legal document from the Mindcafe Android SDK from Atommerce, this screen presents the service terms, privacy policy, and refund policy in separate sections.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot read the service terms, privacy policy, or refund policy from this screen, which may interrupt related consent or purchase flows.

zh-CN.description: 用户从 Atommerce 的 Mindcafe Android SDK 打开法律文件时，此页面会分栏展示服务条款、隐私政策和退款政策。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在此阅读服务条款、隐私政策或退款政策，相关同意或购买流程可能会中断。

en.description: The Mindcafe Android SDK from Atommerce opens this screen to display counseling voucher offers, optionally for a selected counselor. The user can continue from an offer into the related service flow.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot view counseling voucher offers or continue from them through this screen.

zh-CN.description: Atommerce 的 Mindcafe Android SDK 会通过此页面展示咨询服务券，也可以显示指定咨询师的服务券。用户可从优惠项目继续进入相关服务流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此页面查看咨询服务券或继续相关服务流程。

en.description: When another Mindcafe feature opens a web page, this screen displays the configured page inside the app. The SDK uses it for counselor pages, legal documents, and other counseling service pages.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open the counselor, legal, or other service pages that the Mindcafe SDK displays inside the app.

zh-CN.description: 当 Mindcafe 的其他功能打开网页时，此页面会在应用内显示指定页面。SDK 会用它展示咨询师页面、法律文件及其他咨询服务页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开 Mindcafe SDK 在应用内展示的咨询师页面、法律文件或其他服务页面。

en.description: In newer Mindcafe Android SDK releases from Atommerce, this screen displays the web page configured by the service flow inside the app. The user can return from it using the page’s navigation controls.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open configured Mindcafe service pages that use this in-app web screen.

zh-CN.description: 在 Atommerce 较新的 Mindcafe Android SDK 版本中，此页面会在应用内显示服务流程指定的网页。用户可通过页面的导航控件返回。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开使用此应用内网页界面的 Mindcafe 服务页面。

en.description: Attestr FlowX, Attestr’s identity-check SDK, opens this screen when an identity verification session begins. It presents the requested checks, such as identity details and one-time codes, and sends the answers to Attestr.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, the app cannot complete this Attestr identity-check session.

zh-CN.description: Attestr FlowX（Attestr 的身份核验 SDK）会在身份核验开始时打开此页面，展示所需的身份信息和验证码步骤，并将结果提交给 Attestr。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用将无法完成这次 Attestr 身份核验。

en.description: Attestr FlowX opens its camera when a verification step needs a photo or short video. It captures images or videos used for face, document, or in-person checks and returns them to the verification flow.
en.disableEffect: Camera-based identity and document checks cannot capture the photo or video they need.

zh-CN.description: Attestr FlowX 会在核验步骤需要照片或短视频时打开相机，拍摄人脸、证件或现场核验所需的内容，并将结果交回核验流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖相机的人脸和证件核验将无法拍摄所需的照片或视频。

en.description: Attestr FlowX opens this screen during DigiLocker-based identity or document verification. It loads the authorization page and returns the result to the ongoing check.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot authorize or finish a DigiLocker document check in Attestr FlowX.

zh-CN.description: Attestr FlowX 会在使用 DigiLocker 进行身份或证件核验时打开此页面，加载授权页面，并将结果交回当前核验流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在 Attestr FlowX 中授权或完成 DigiLocker 证件核验。

en.description: Attestr FlowX opens this form during employment verification. Users enter employer, position and dates, references, and supporting documents, then return those details to the ongoing check.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot collect or submit the employment details required by this Attestr verification step.

zh-CN.description: Attestr FlowX 会在工作经历核验时打开此表单。用户填写雇主、职位和任职日期、推荐人及证明文件后，信息会返回当前核验流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法收集或提交 Attestr 此核验步骤所需的工作经历信息。

en.description: Attestr FlowX opens this screen after the app starts a verification session. It displays the requested identity checks, handles their steps, and shows the result.
en.disableEffect: The Attestr identity-check flow cannot open, so users cannot complete the checks requested by the app.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动核验会话后，Attestr FlowX 会打开此页面，展示所需的身份核验项目、处理各个步骤并显示结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Attestr 身份核验流程将无法打开，用户也就无法完成应用要求的核验。

en.description: Attestr FlowX opens a language picker when the app starts a check without a language choice. Selecting a language starts the verification session in that language.
en.disableEffect: A FlowX check that needs the user to choose a language cannot start.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动核验但未指定语言时，Attestr FlowX 会打开语言选择页面；选定语言后，核验会话才会开始。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要用户选择语言的 FlowX 核验将无法启动。

en.description: The Audioburst Player SDK opens this screen when the app requests its player. It shows the listening interface, including the mini-player, for Audioburst audio.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open the Audioburst listening screen from the app.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求打开播放器时，Audioburst Player SDK 会显示此页面，其中包含 Audioburst 音频的收听界面和迷你播放器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法从应用打开 Audioburst 收听页面。

en.description: The Audioburst Player SDK opens this screen with the feed or playlist selected by the app. It presents Audioburst audio items and a mini-player; choosing an item loads it for playback.
en.disableEffect: The Audioburst feed and its in-app playback controls will not open.

zh-CN.description: Audioburst Player SDK 会按应用选择的内容流或播放列表打开此页面，展示 Audioburst 音频和迷你播放器；选择内容后即可加载播放。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Audioburst 内容流及其应用内播放控件将无法打开。

en.description: The Audioburst Player SDK uses this provider to serve cached album artwork to player and media surfaces. It opens files only from the app’s cache.
en.disableEffect: Audio can still play, but album artwork supplied by Audioburst will not load.

zh-CN.description: Audioburst Player SDK 通过此内容提供器向播放器和媒体界面提供缓存的专辑封面文件；它只会打开应用缓存目录中的文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 音频仍可播放，但 Audioburst 提供的专辑封面将无法加载。

en.description: Audioburst Player runs this background service for listening and Android media controls. It manages the playback session used for media browsing and play-from-search requests.
en.disableEffect: Audioburst audio may not start or continue playing, and its system playback controls may disappear.

zh-CN.description: Audioburst Player 通过此后台服务播放音频并提供 Android 媒体控件；媒体浏览或搜索播放请求也会由它处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Audioburst 音频可能无法开始或继续播放，系统播放控件也可能消失。

en.description: Audioburst Player runs this download service to save audio for offline listening and resume interrupted downloads. It reports progress while media is being saved.
en.disableEffect: Audioburst audio downloads may stop, and saved items may not be available for offline listening.

zh-CN.description: Audioburst Player 通过此下载服务保存音频以供离线收听，并恢复中断的下载；下载期间它还会报告进度。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Audioburst 音频下载可能会停止，已保存的内容也可能无法离线收听。

en.description: Audioburst Player Core starts this background service when playback is needed, including media-browsing or play-from-search requests. It manages the audio player, system controls, and now-playing notification.
en.disableEffect: Audioburst playback and its system media controls will stop working.

zh-CN.description: 需要播放时，Audioburst Player Core 会启动此后台服务，包括响应媒体浏览或搜索播放请求；它负责音频播放、系统控件和正在播放通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Audioburst 播放及其系统媒体控件将无法使用。

en.description: The AuroPay Payments SDK opens this activity with a payment request and displays the checkout screens used to process it.
en.disableEffect: Payments that use the AuroPay flow cannot be started or completed.

zh-CN.description: AuroPay 支付 SDK 会携带支付请求打开此界面，并显示处理该请求所需的结账页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法启动或完成通过 AuroPay 流程进行的支付。

en.description: Auth0 Lock for Android opens this picker from its passwordless phone sign-in screen. It lets users search for a country and returns that country’s calling code.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot choose a country calling code during Auth0 passwordless phone sign-in.

zh-CN.description: Auth0 Lock for Android 会在无密码手机号登录时打开此选择页面，用户可以搜索国家或地区并选择电话区号。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在 Auth0 无密码手机号登录中选择国家或地区区号。

en.description: Auth0 Lock for Android opens this screen for interactive sign-in and account creation. It loads the configured login choices, authenticates with Auth0, and returns the result to the app.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot open the Auth0 Lock login or sign-up flow.

zh-CN.description: Auth0 Lock for Android 会在交互式登录或创建账户时打开此页面，加载已配置的登录方式、通过 Auth0 验证身份，并将结果返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法打开 Auth0 Lock 登录或注册流程。

en.description: Auth0 Lock for Android opens this screen for email or phone sign-in using a one-time code. It handles code entry and verification and returns the authentication result to the app.
en.disableEffect: Auth0 passwordless email or phone sign-in will not be available.

zh-CN.description: Auth0 Lock for Android 会在使用一次性验证码登录邮箱或手机号时打开此页面，处理验证码输入和验证，并将登录结果返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Auth0 无密码邮箱或手机号登录将无法使用。

en.description: Auth0.Android uses this temporary screen for browser-based authentication. It opens the Auth0 authorization page in a browser tab and returns success, cancellation, or an error to the login flow.
en.disableEffect: Browser-based Auth0 sign-in cannot complete or return its result to the app.

zh-CN.description: Auth0.Android 会在浏览器认证时使用此临时页面，在浏览器标签页打开 Auth0 授权页面，并将成功、取消或错误结果交回登录流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 基于浏览器的 Auth0 登录将无法完成，也无法把结果返回应用。

en.description: Auth0.Android opens this screen when the browser returns to the app’s Auth0 redirect link. It passes that link back to the authentication flow so sign-in can finish.
en.disableEffect: Auth0 browser sign-in cannot return to the app or finish authentication.

zh-CN.description: 浏览器跳回应用的 Auth0 重定向链接时，Auth0.Android 会打开此页面并将链接交回认证流程，以便完成登录。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Auth0 浏览器登录将无法返回应用或完成身份验证。

en.description: AuthMe eKYC opens this Activity when an app starts face verification. It captures and analyzes a live face, then returns the check result.
en.disableEffect: Apps that require AuthMe face verification cannot complete that check.

zh-CN.description: 应用开始人脸核验时，AuthMe 电子身份核验（eKYC）会打开此界面。它采集并分析实时人脸，然后返回核验结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要 AuthMe 人脸核验的应用将无法完成这项检查。

en.description: AuthMe NFC opens this screen after reading an electronic passport chip. It displays extracted passport details and the portrait, then returns when the user finishes reviewing them.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot review the extracted passport data in the AuthMe NFC flow.

zh-CN.description: 读取电子护照芯片后，AuthMe NFC 会打开此界面。它显示提取的护照信息和照片，并在用户完成查看后返回。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在 AuthMe NFC 流程中查看提取的护照信息。

en.description: AuthMe NFC and OCR NFC flows open this Activity to read supported identity-document chips. It accepts document details, activates NFC reading, and returns scanned data and a photo.
en.disableEffect: Apps using AuthMe NFC document reading cannot complete the scan.

zh-CN.description: AuthMe NFC 和 OCR NFC 流程会打开此界面读取受支持的身份证件芯片。它接收证件信息、启动 NFC 读取，并返回扫描数据和照片。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用 AuthMe NFC 证件读取的应用将无法完成扫描。

en.description: AuthMe OCR opens this Activity to scan an identity document such as a card or passport. It captures the document with the camera, reads printed or machine-readable fields, and returns results or opens a review screen.
en.disableEffect: Apps using AuthMe document recognition cannot scan documents or receive their details.

zh-CN.description: AuthMe OCR 会打开此界面扫描身份证件，例如证件卡或护照。它通过摄像头采集证件、读取印刷或机读字段，并返回结果或打开确认界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用 AuthMe 证件识别的应用将无法扫描证件或获取证件信息。

en.description: AuthMe OCR opens this screen when users choose the country or region on an identity document. It returns that choice so the scan flow can offer matching document types.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot choose a document country in AuthMe OCR flows that require this screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 AuthMe OCR 中选择证件所属国家或地区时，会打开此界面。它返回所选地区，以便扫描流程提供对应的证件类型。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要此界面的 AuthMe OCR 流程将无法选择证件所属国家或地区。

en.description: AuthMe's Japan-specific OCR flow opens this guide during a driver's-license thickness check. It explains the check and returns the user to the document flow.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot read the guide for the Japanese license thickness check.

zh-CN.description: AuthMe 面向日本证件的 OCR 流程会在驾驶证厚度检查步骤打开此指南。它展示检查说明，并将用户带回证件识别流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法查看日本驾驶证厚度检查的指南。

en.description: Before an AuthMe OCR scan, this screen shows document-scanning guidance and a button to begin. Starting opens the camera-based document scanner and returns its result.
en.disableEffect: Users relying on this guided entry cannot start AuthMe document scanning from the guide.

zh-CN.description: AuthMe OCR 扫描开始前，此界面会显示证件扫描说明和开始按钮。用户开始后，它会打开摄像头扫描界面并返回结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此引导页进入 AuthMe 证件扫描的用户将无法从此处开始扫描。

en.description: AuthMe OCR opens this screen before scanning so users can choose a country and document type. Continuing starts the matching scan.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot choose the document type or continue through AuthMe document scanning.

zh-CN.description: AuthMe OCR 会在扫描前打开此界面，让用户选择国家或地区及证件类型。继续后，它会启动对应的证件扫描。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法选择证件类型或继续 AuthMe 证件扫描。

en.description: AuthMe OCR uses this screen to show fields read from a scanned document for review and confirmation. It returns the reviewed result to the app.
en.disableEffect: Flows that open this screen lose the AuthMe document-result review step.

zh-CN.description: AuthMe OCR 会用此界面展示从证件中读取的信息，供用户查看和确认，然后将结果返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 打开此界面的流程将失去 AuthMe 证件结果确认步骤。

en.description: After AuthMe reads an identity document, this screen presents the extracted fields for review and confirmation. It returns confirmed or edited details to the app.
en.disableEffect: Scans using this screen cannot return reviewed document details.

zh-CN.description: AuthMe 读取身份证件后，会通过此界面展示识别出的字段，供用户查看和确认，并将确认或修改后的信息返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此界面的扫描将无法返回经用户查看的证件信息。

en.description: When an app requests AuthMe consent, this screen loads the supplied agreement page and lets the user accept or reject it. It returns the user's choice.
en.disableEffect: AuthMe consent flows that require this screen cannot be completed.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求 AuthMe 用户同意时，此界面会加载提供的协议页面，并允许用户接受或拒绝，然后返回用户的选择。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要此界面的 AuthMe 同意流程将无法完成。

en.description: AuthMe opens this screen after a photo is captured so the user can review it, keep it, or choose to retake it.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot review or approve a captured photo in AuthMe flows that use this screen.

zh-CN.description: AuthMe 会在照片采集后打开此界面，让用户查看照片、确认保留或重新拍摄。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此界面的 AuthMe 流程将无法让用户查看或确认已拍摄的照片。

en.description: AuthMe NFC opens this screen to guide users through reading an identity-document chip. It starts NFC reading, handles detected chip data, and returns the scan result.
en.disableEffect: Apps using AuthMe NFC document reading cannot complete the scan or receive its data.

zh-CN.description: AuthMe NFC 会打开此界面，引导用户读取身份证件芯片。它启动 NFC 读取、处理检测到的芯片数据，并返回扫描结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用 AuthMe NFC 证件读取的应用将无法完成扫描或获取数据。

en.description: AuthMe NFC uses this screen to display decoded information from a document chip. It reads the scan result and shows its details to the user.
en.disableEffect: The AuthMe NFC flow cannot show this decoded-result screen.

zh-CN.description: AuthMe NFC 会用此界面展示从证件芯片读取的信息。它读取扫描结果并向用户显示详细内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: AuthMe NFC 流程将无法显示此芯片读取结果界面。

en.description: Automatic Android SDK responds to a companion-service ping when the user is signed in and the app uses service binding. It reconnects the service or repeats its authentication handshake.
en.disableEffect: The SDK will not restore or re-authenticate its service connection in response to the companion ping, so service-backed features lose this recovery path.

zh-CN.description: 用户已登录且应用使用服务绑定时，Automatic Android SDK 会响应配套服务的 ping，重新连接服务或再次执行身份验证握手。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 配套服务发送 ping 时，SDK 将无法重新连接或重新验证服务，因此依赖该服务的功能会失去这条恢复路径。

en.description: When an app opens the legacy photo editor, Adobe's Aviary SDK displays its editing workspace and tools.
en.disableEffect: The legacy Aviary photo editor will not open.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开旧版照片编辑器时，Adobe 的 Aviary SDK 会显示编辑工作区和工具。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，旧版 Aviary 照片编辑器将无法打开。

en.description: The legacy Adobe Aviary SDK starts this background service after a catalog refresh to download extra pack previews, detail images, and other catalog assets when conditions allow.
en.disableEffect: Some catalog images and previews may be missing, but installed Aviary editing tools remain available.

zh-CN.description: 旧版 Adobe Aviary SDK 刷新素材目录后，会启动此后台服务，在条件允许时下载额外的素材包预览图、详情图和其他目录资源。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，部分目录图片和预览可能缺失，但已安装的 Aviary 编辑工具仍可使用。

en.description: The legacy Adobe Aviary SDK receives Android download-complete, Wi-Fi, power, app-update, and notification broadcasts here. It completes downloaded pack installs and schedules retries.
en.disableEffect: Aviary pack downloads may remain unfinished, and automatic retry or refresh actions will stop.

zh-CN.description: 旧版 Adobe Aviary SDK 在此接收 Android 下载完成、Wi-Fi、电源、应用更新和通知广播，以完成素材包安装并安排重试。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Aviary 素材包下载可能无法完成，自动重试或刷新也会停止。

en.description: When the legacy Adobe Aviary SDK refreshes its catalog or restores user and owned packs, this service downloads catalog data and retrieves the requested editing packs.
en.disableEffect: Catalog refreshes and restoration of user or purchased Aviary packs may fail.

zh-CN.description: 旧版 Adobe Aviary SDK 刷新素材目录或恢复用户素材和已购素材时，此服务会下载目录数据并获取请求的编辑素材包。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，素材目录刷新以及用户素材或已购 Aviary 素材的恢复可能会失败。

en.description: Lema (AwesomeGlobal) opens this screen when the app requests account authorization; it loads the authorization web page and returns the user's result to the app.
en.disableEffect: The app will not be able to complete Lema's web-based sign-in or authorization flow.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求账户授权时，Lema（AwesomeGlobal）会打开此页面加载授权网页，并将用户的处理结果返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用无法完成 Lema 的网页登录或授权流程。

en.description: Lema (AwesomeGlobal) opens this screen to handle a payment or related credit and automatic-payment operation in a web page, then returns the result to the app.
en.disableEffect: Payments and related operations handled through Lema's web flow will not complete.

zh-CN.description: Lema（AwesomeGlobal）会在此页面通过网页处理支付、相关额度操作或自动扣款签约，并将结果返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，通过 Lema 网页流程处理的支付及相关操作将无法完成。

en.description: Iggy is a general-purpose Android image-gallery library. This Activity opens a swipeable full-screen gallery for host-app images, with optional save and share controls.
en.disableEffect: The app loses this full-screen image-browsing, saving, and sharing screen.

zh-CN.description: Iggy 是通用 Android 图片画廊库。应用提供图片后，此界面会以可滑动的全屏画廊显示，并可提供保存和分享操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将失去此全屏图片浏览、保存和分享界面。

en.description: AYVYTR's KTX AndroidX library creates this provider at app startup and saves application context for its display-size and clipboard helpers.
en.disableEffect: KTX helpers that need the saved app context may fail when used.

zh-CN.description: AYVYTR 的 KTX AndroidX 库会在应用启动时创建此 Provider，并保存应用上下文供屏幕尺寸和剪贴板工具使用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，需要已保存应用上下文的 KTX 工具在使用时可能失败。

en.description: AYVYTR Network Cache and Cookie creates this provider at app startup and saves application context for network-connectivity checks and cookie storage.
en.disableEffect: The library's connectivity and cookie helpers may fail when the host app uses them.

zh-CN.description: AYVYTR Network Cache and Cookie 会在应用启动时创建此 Provider，并保存应用上下文供网络连接检查和 Cookie 存储使用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 宿主应用使用该库的网络连接或 Cookie 工具时，停用此 Provider 可能导致这些功能失败。

en.description: When an app opens the Azerion BlueStack ad SDK's debug screen, this Activity displays its diagnostic menu and related panels.
en.disableEffect: The SDK's diagnostic screen will no longer be available.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开 Azerion BlueStack 广告 SDK 的调试界面时，此 Activity 会显示诊断菜单及相关面板。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后将无法打开该 SDK 的诊断界面。

en.description: The Azerion BlueStack ad SDK opens this Activity when it has a full-screen ad ready. It displays the ad and handles clicks and closing.
en.disableEffect: Full-screen ads served through Azerion BlueStack will not display.

zh-CN.description: Azerion BlueStack 广告 SDK 准备好全屏广告时会打开此 Activity。它负责显示广告并处理点击和关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后将无法显示 Azerion BlueStack 提供的全屏广告。

en.description: When an app requests an interstitial from the Azerion BlueStack ad SDK, this Activity displays the full-screen ad and handles its clicks, completion, and close controls.
en.disableEffect: Interstitial ads from Azerion BlueStack will not display.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求 Azerion BlueStack 广告 SDK 的插屏广告时，此 Activity 会显示全屏广告并处理点击、播放完成和关闭操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后将无法显示 Azerion BlueStack 的插屏广告。

en.description: When Azerion BlueStack presents a native ad with an app icon and screenshots, this Activity shows the ad card and handles taps and closing.
en.disableEffect: Native ads served through Azerion BlueStack will not display.

zh-CN.description: Azerion BlueStack 展示带有应用图标和截图的原生广告时，此 Activity 会显示广告卡片并处理点击和关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后将无法显示 Azerion BlueStack 提供的原生广告。

en.description: When Azerion BlueStack needs to play a video ad, this Activity opens a full-screen player with playback controls and closes when playback ends or fails.
en.disableEffect: Video ads that use this Azerion BlueStack player will not play.

zh-CN.description: Azerion BlueStack 需要播放视频广告时，此 Activity 会打开带播放控件的全屏播放器，并在播放结束或失败时关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后将无法通过 Azerion BlueStack 的此播放器播放视频广告。

en.description: After a user taps a BlueStack ad, this Activity shows its destination in an in-app browser. Store and download links can open outside the app.
en.disableEffect: BlueStack ad landing pages will not open in this in-app browser.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击 BlueStack 广告后，此 Activity 会在应用内浏览器中显示广告目标页面；应用商店和下载链接可转到应用外打开。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后将无法在此应用内浏览器中打开 BlueStack 广告落地页。

en.description: Azerion BlueStack starts this Service in the background to send queued ad request and event reports on a schedule.
en.disableEffect: Queued BlueStack ad request and event reports will no longer be sent by this Service.

zh-CN.description: Azerion BlueStack 会在后台启动此 Service，按计划发送排队中的广告请求和事件报告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，此 Service 将不再发送排队中的 BlueStack 广告请求和事件报告。

en.description: The Azerion Improve Digital ad SDK opens this Activity to show a full-screen image, HTML, or video ad and handle its close timer and clicks.
en.disableEffect: Full-screen Improve Digital ads will not display.

zh-CN.description: Azerion Improve Digital 广告 SDK 会打开此 Activity，显示全屏图片、HTML 或视频广告，并处理关闭倒计时和点击。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后将无法显示 Improve Digital 的全屏广告。

en.description: The Azerion Ads SDK opens this Activity for full-screen interstitial or rewarded video ads. It displays image, HTML, or video creatives and grants the configured reward when a rewarded video is completed.
en.disableEffect: Interstitial and rewarded ads served here will not display, and watching a rewarded ad will no longer grant its reward.

zh-CN.description: Azerion Ads SDK 会为全屏插屏广告或激励视频广告打开此 Activity。它显示图片、HTML 或视频广告素材，并在激励视频播放完成后发放相应奖励。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后将无法显示此处承载的插屏和激励广告，观看激励广告也不再获得奖励。

en.description: The Azerion Ads SDK opens this Activity to display a full-screen ad, a close countdown, and an Improve Digital privacy link. Ad clicks open their destination outside the app.
en.disableEffect: Full-screen ads handled by the Azerion Ads SDK will not display.

zh-CN.description: Azerion Ads SDK 会打开此 Activity，显示全屏广告、关闭倒计时和 Improve Digital 隐私政策链接。点击广告会在应用外打开目标页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后将无法显示 Azerion Ads SDK 承载的全屏广告。

en.description: On Android 7 and newer, the AppUpdate (Azhon) SDK uses this Provider to give Android’s installer access to a downloaded APK when an update is ready to install.
en.disableEffect: On Android 7 and newer, if disabled, users cannot install an update downloaded through this library.

zh-CN.description: 在 Android 7 及更高版本上，AppUpdate（Azhon）更新库会在准备安装更新时，通过此 Provider 让 Android 安装程序读取已下载的 APK。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 在 Android 7 及更高版本上，停用后，用户无法通过此库安装已下载的应用更新。

en.description: When a user starts an update in the AppUpdate (Azhon) SDK, this Service downloads the APK, can show progress in a notification, and can open the installer when the download finishes.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, this library cannot download app updates.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 AppUpdate（Azhon）更新库中启动更新后，此 Service 会下载 APK，可在通知中显示进度，并可在下载完成后打开安装程序。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过此库下载应用更新。

en.description: The AppUpdate (Azhon) SDK opens this Activity to present an available update with its version and notes; users can start the download or dismiss the prompt unless the app requires the update.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, users cannot open this library's update prompt or continue a required update through it.

zh-CN.description: AppUpdate（Azhon）更新库会用此 Activity 展示可用更新的版本和说明；用户可以开始下载或关闭提示，除非应用要求必须更新。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法打开此库的更新提示，也无法通过它继续必需的更新流程。

en.description: When Azupay account setup starts, the Azupay Android SDK opens this screen and shows its account-registration flow, then returns the outcome to the app.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to complete Azupay account registration through the SDK.

zh-CN.description: Azupay 账户设置开始时，Azupay Android SDK 会打开此界面并显示账户注册流程，随后将结果返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此 SDK 完成 Azupay 账户注册。
