en.description: Android's call system starts this Azure Communication Services component when it needs a connection for an incoming or outgoing app call. It creates the call connection used by the Calling SDK.
en.disableEffect: The app's calls may lose Android Telecom integration or fail to connect.

zh-CN.description: Android 通话系统需要为应用的来电或去电建立连接时，会启动此 Azure Communication Services 组件。它负责创建 Calling SDK 使用的通话连接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用通话可能失去 Android Telecom 集成或无法接通。

en.description: The Azure Communication Services Calling UI opens this Activity to present the call screen, request camera and microphone access, and keep call controls and notifications in sync.
en.disableEffect: The app's Azure calling screen will not open.

zh-CN.description: Azure Communication Services Calling UI 会打开此 Activity 显示通话界面、请求相机和麦克风权限，并同步通话控件与通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用的 Azure 通话界面将无法打开。

en.description: During an Azure Communication Services call with multitasking enabled, this Activity presents the call screen while the user moves between app tasks or returns from the lock screen.
en.disableEffect: The app's call multitasking screen will not open.

zh-CN.description: 启用多任务通话时，此 Activity 会在用户切换应用任务或从锁屏返回期间显示 Azure Communication Services 通话界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用的通话多任务界面将无法打开。

en.description: When picture-in-picture is enabled for an Azure Communication Services call, Android opens this Activity to keep the call visible in a small floating window.
en.disableEffect: The app's call will not continue in its picture-in-picture window.

zh-CN.description: 为 Azure Communication Services 通话启用画中画时，Android 会打开此 Activity，让通话继续显示在小型悬浮窗口中。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用通话将无法继续显示在画中画窗口中。

en.description: The Azure Communication Services Calling UI binds this foreground Service during an active call to show an ongoing-call notification that can reopen the call screen.
en.disableEffect: The app's ongoing-call notification and its shortcut back to the call will be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: Azure Communication Services Calling UI 会在通话期间绑定此前台 Service，显示可重新打开通话界面的持续通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用的持续通话通知及其返回通话的入口将不可用。

en.description: Azure Communication Services Chat UI opens this Activity to fill the screen with the configured conversation interface.
en.disableEffect: The app will not be able to open its Azure chat interface through this screen.

zh-CN.description: Azure Communication Services Chat UI 会打开此 Activity，以全屏显示已配置的会话界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用将无法通过此界面打开 Azure 聊天功能。

en.description: The earlier Azure Communication Services Calling UI opens this Activity to host the full call screen, set up call controls, and start the ongoing-call notification service.
en.disableEffect: The app's call screen from this Azure Communication Services UI will not open.

zh-CN.description: 较早版本的 Azure Communication Services Calling UI 会打开此 Activity 承载完整通话界面、设置通话控件并启动持续通话通知服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用将无法打开此 Azure Communication Services UI 的通话界面。

en.description: The earlier Azure Communication Services Calling UI uses this as its main call screen. It moves between call setup and the active call and starts the ongoing-call service.
en.disableEffect: The app will not be able to enter the call setup or active-call screens through this UI.

zh-CN.description: 较早版本的 Azure Communication Services Calling UI 使用此 Activity 作为主通话界面，可切换呼叫设置和通话中界面，并启动持续通话服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用将无法通过此 UI 进入呼叫设置或通话中界面。

en.description: The earlier Azure Communication Services Calling UI starts this foreground Service during a call to show an ongoing-call notification with a shortcut back to the call screen.
en.disableEffect: The app's ongoing-call notification and its shortcut back to the call will be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: 较早版本的 Azure Communication Services Calling UI 会在通话期间启动此 Service，显示带有通话界面入口的持续通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用的持续通话通知及其返回通话的入口将不可用。

en.description: The Dekkho (Baadl) Full SDK opens this page from a channel link or channel selection and loads the channel’s videos, recommendations, and subscribe controls.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, users cannot open channel details or subscribe from this page.

zh-CN.description: Dekkho（Baadl）完整 SDK 会在用户打开频道链接或选择频道时显示此页面，并加载频道视频、推荐内容和订阅选项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法打开频道详情页，也无法在此订阅频道。

en.description: The Dekkho (Baadl) Full SDK opens an image picker from profile editing so users can choose a new profile picture.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, users cannot choose or change a profile picture through this picker.

zh-CN.description: Dekkho（Baadl）完整 SDK 会从个人资料编辑页打开图片选择器，让用户挑选新的头像。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过此选择器挑选或更换头像。

en.description: The Dekkho (Baadl) Full SDK opens a cover-image picker while editing a profile or creating a reel.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, users cannot choose a new profile or reel cover through this screen.

zh-CN.description: Dekkho（Baadl）完整 SDK 会在编辑个人资料或创建短视频时打开封面图片选择器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过此页面为个人资料或短视频挑选新封面。

en.description: The Dekkho (Baadl) Full SDK asks to read contacts, matches phone numbers with Dekkho users, and lets users select people to invite.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, users lose contact matching and the phone-contact invitation flow.

zh-CN.description: Dekkho（Baadl）完整 SDK 会请求读取通讯录，将电话号码与 Dekkho 用户匹配，并允许用户选择联系人发送邀请。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法匹配通讯录联系人或通过此流程邀请他们。

en.description: The Dekkho (Baadl) Full SDK opens a reviewer’s profile with their follower counts and movie, television, and reel reviews.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, users cannot view or follow a reviewer from this profile page.

zh-CN.description: Dekkho（Baadl）完整 SDK 会打开影评用户的个人资料，显示其关注人数以及电影、电视节目和短视频评论。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法查看此评论者资料或从该页关注对方。

en.description: The Dekkho (Baadl) Full SDK shows this sign-in screen to signed-out users, with phone-number and Facebook login options.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, users cannot sign in through this login screen.

zh-CN.description: Dekkho（Baadl）完整 SDK 会向未登录用户显示此登录页，提供手机号和 Facebook 登录选项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过此登录页登录。

en.description: The Dekkho (Baadl) Full SDK opens a movie, television, video, or music detail page and shows its description, cast or genre, ratings, recommendations, and playback or download options.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, users lose these media details and the page’s rating, recommendation, and offline-download controls.

zh-CN.description: Dekkho（Baadl）完整 SDK 会打开电影、电视节目、视频或音乐详情页，显示简介、演员或类型、评分、推荐内容以及播放或下载选项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法查看这些媒体详情，也无法使用页面中的评分、推荐和离线下载选项。

en.description: The Dekkho (Baadl) Full SDK opens the profile editor for personal details, profile and cover images, language, privacy, and linked social accounts.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, users cannot update their Dekkho profile or account preferences here.

zh-CN.description: Dekkho（Baadl）完整 SDK 会打开个人资料编辑页，供用户修改个人信息、头像和封面、语言、隐私设置及关联的社交账号。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法在此更新 Dekkho 个人资料或账号偏好。

en.description: During phone sign-in, the Dekkho (Baadl) Full SDK lets users choose a country code, enter a phone number, and request a verification code.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, users cannot start phone-number sign-in or verification.

zh-CN.description: 手机号登录时，Dekkho（Baadl）完整 SDK 会让用户选择国家区号、输入手机号并请求验证码。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过手机号发起登录或验证。

en.description: The Dekkho (Baadl) Full SDK opens a list of frequently asked questions; selecting a row opens its answer page.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, users cannot open the FAQ list.

zh-CN.description: Dekkho（Baadl）完整 SDK 会显示常见问题列表；用户点选条目后会打开对应答案页。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法打开常见问题列表。

en.description: The Dekkho (Baadl) Full SDK shows the FAQ answer text after a user selects a question.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, users cannot read the FAQ answer page.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择问题后，Dekkho（Baadl）完整 SDK 会显示对应的常见问题答案。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法阅读常见问题答案页。

en.description: The Dekkho (Baadl) Full SDK displays channels for the user to select as filters for a content list.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, users cannot choose channel filters from this page.

zh-CN.description: Dekkho（Baadl）完整 SDK 会显示频道列表，供用户选择并筛选内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法在此选择频道筛选条件。

en.description: The Dekkho (Baadl) Full SDK opens sorting and channel filters for a content list, with apply and reset controls.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, users cannot adjust or apply these content filters.

zh-CN.description: Dekkho（Baadl）完整 SDK 会为内容列表提供排序和频道筛选，并显示应用与重置选项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法调整或应用这些内容筛选条件。

en.description: The Dekkho (Baadl) Full SDK shows pending requests from people who want to follow the user and provides controls to manage them.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, users cannot review or manage incoming follow requests.

zh-CN.description: Dekkho（Baadl）完整 SDK 会显示希望关注该用户的待处理请求，并提供管理选项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法查看或管理收到的关注请求。

en.description: The Dekkho (Baadl) Full SDK opens a help page with a text field and a send button, but the button has no action in the analyzed code.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, users cannot open this help form.

zh-CN.description: Dekkho（Baadl）完整 SDK 会显示帮助页面，包含文本输入框和发送按钮；分析到的代码中该按钮没有执行操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法打开此帮助表单。

en.description: After startup or sign-in, the Dekkho (Baadl) Full SDK shows the main browse screen and navigation drawer for home, music, television, channels, and live content.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, users lose the main browsing and navigation screen.

zh-CN.description: 启动或登录后，Dekkho（Baadl）完整 SDK 会显示主浏览页和导航抽屉，可进入首页、音乐、电视、频道及直播内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法使用主浏览页和导航菜单。

en.description: The Dekkho (Baadl) Full SDK lists reels created by the signed-in user and offers the entry point for creating another reel.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, users cannot browse or manage their own reels from this page.

zh-CN.description: Dekkho（Baadl）完整 SDK 会列出当前用户创建的短视频，并提供创建新短视频的入口。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法在此浏览或管理自己创建的短视频。

en.description: The Dekkho (Baadl) Full SDK lets users create or edit a short reel by setting its title, tags, cover, music, and privacy, then saving it.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, users cannot create or edit reels.

zh-CN.description: Dekkho（Baadl）完整 SDK 允许用户创建或编辑短视频，设置标题、标签、封面、音乐和隐私后保存。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法创建或编辑短视频。

en.description: The Dekkho (Baadl) Full SDK opens the notifications feed, where users can read updates and follow links to related profiles or content.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, users cannot read or act on notifications from this screen.

zh-CN.description: Dekkho（Baadl）完整 SDK 会打开通知列表，用户可查看动态并前往相关个人资料或内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法在此查看通知或处理通知中的动态。

en.description: The Dekkho (Baadl) Full SDK plays a video saved for offline viewing and provides playback controls.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, users cannot watch downloaded videos through this player.

zh-CN.description: Dekkho（Baadl）完整 SDK 会播放已下载供离线观看的视频，并提供播放控制。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过此播放器观看已下载的视频。

en.description: The Dekkho (Baadl) Full SDK lists offline videos, checks their expiry, and lets users open or manage saved downloads.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, users cannot browse the offline-video library or open its downloads from this page.

zh-CN.description: Dekkho（Baadl）完整 SDK 会列出离线视频、检查有效期，并允许用户打开或管理已保存的下载。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法浏览离线视频库或从此页面打开已下载内容。

en.description: The Dekkho (Baadl) Full SDK shows a searchable list of people so users can choose recipients for a video recommendation or watchlist.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, users cannot search for or select these recommendation recipients.

zh-CN.description: Dekkho（Baadl）完整 SDK 会显示可搜索的用户列表，供用户选择视频推荐或片单的接收者。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法搜索或选择这些推荐接收者。

en.description: The Dekkho (Baadl) Full SDK asks new users to choose favorite content categories to shape their recommendations.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, users cannot complete this favorite-category setup step.

zh-CN.description: Dekkho（Baadl）完整 SDK 会让新用户选择喜欢的内容类别，以便定制推荐。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法完成这一步偏好类别设置。

en.description: During phone sign-in, the Dekkho (Baadl) Full SDK displays a searchable list for choosing a country calling code.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, users cannot select a country code through this screen.

zh-CN.description: 手机号登录时，Dekkho（Baadl）完整 SDK 会显示可搜索的国家区号列表供用户选择。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过此页面选择国家区号。

en.description: The Dekkho (Baadl) Full SDK lets users choose preferred content languages during setup or profile editing.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, users cannot set or change their preferred content languages here.

zh-CN.description: Dekkho（Baadl）完整 SDK 允许用户在初始设置或编辑资料时选择偏好的内容语言。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法在此设置或更改偏好的内容语言。

en.description: The Dekkho (Baadl) Full SDK shows the signed-in user’s profile, follower counts, reviews, reels, and subscribed content, with links to edit the profile.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, users cannot open their profile or reach its follower, reel, and editing pages.

zh-CN.description: Dekkho（Baadl）完整 SDK 会显示当前用户的个人资料、关注人数、评论、短视频和已订阅内容，并提供资料编辑入口。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法打开个人资料或进入其中的关注者、短视频和编辑页面。

en.description: The Dekkho (Baadl) Full SDK lists people who follow the profile and provides search controls.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, users cannot view or search the profile’s followers.

zh-CN.description: Dekkho（Baadl）完整 SDK 会列出关注该个人资料的用户，并提供搜索功能。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法查看或搜索该个人资料的关注者。

en.description: The Dekkho (Baadl) Full SDK lists people the profile follows and provides search controls.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, users cannot view or search the profile’s following list.

zh-CN.description: Dekkho（Baadl）完整 SDK 会列出该个人资料关注的用户，并提供搜索功能。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法查看或搜索该个人资料的关注列表。

en.description: The Dekkho (Baadl) Full SDK lets users rate a movie or show and recommend it to selected groups such as family, friends, or kids.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, users cannot send content recommendations from this screen.

zh-CN.description: Dekkho（Baadl）完整 SDK 允许用户为电影或节目评分，并推荐给家人、朋友或儿童等选定群组。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过此页面发送内容推荐。

en.description: The Dekkho (Baadl) Full SDK opens a short-reel detail page from a reel selection or link, with playback, subscription, and sharing controls.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, users cannot open reel details or use the page’s playback and subscription controls.

zh-CN.description: Dekkho（Baadl）完整 SDK 会在用户选择短视频或打开短视频链接时显示详情页，并提供播放、订阅和分享选项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法打开短视频详情或使用页面中的播放和订阅选项。

en.description: The Dekkho (Baadl) Full SDK displays a selected review with its rating, comment, and related movie or show details.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, users cannot read the full review from this page.

zh-CN.description: Dekkho（Baadl）完整 SDK 会显示选中的评论及其评分、文字内容和相关电影或节目详情。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法在此阅读完整评论。

en.description: The Dekkho (Baadl) Full SDK opens catalog search for movies and other content, with quick mood-based search choices.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, users cannot search the Dekkho catalog from this screen.

zh-CN.description: Dekkho（Baadl）完整 SDK 会打开电影和其他内容的目录搜索，并提供按心情快速搜索的选项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过此页面搜索 Dekkho 内容目录。

en.description: The Dekkho (Baadl) Full SDK searches short reels so users can select one while creating or editing a reel.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, users cannot search for a reel to add through this screen.

zh-CN.description: Dekkho（Baadl）完整 SDK 会搜索短视频，供用户在创建或编辑短视频时选择添加。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过此页面搜索并添加短视频。

en.description: The Dekkho (Baadl) Full SDK shows selectors for city, video quality, content language, and subtitle language.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, users cannot open this page to view or change these settings.

zh-CN.description: Dekkho（Baadl）完整 SDK 会显示城市、视频画质、内容语言和字幕语言的选项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法打开此页面查看或调整这些设置。

en.description: The Dekkho (Baadl) Full SDK opens a sharing page with a message field and controls for Facebook, Twitter, Instagram, or copying a link.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, users cannot share content through this page.

zh-CN.description: Dekkho（Baadl）完整 SDK 会打开分享页面，提供消息输入框，以及分享到 Facebook、Twitter、Instagram 或复制链接的选项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过此页面分享内容。

en.description: The Dekkho (Baadl) Full SDK offers a share control for inviting friends to join Dekkho.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, users cannot share the Dekkho invitation from this page.

zh-CN.description: Dekkho（Baadl）完整 SDK 会提供分享入口，供用户邀请朋友加入 Dekkho。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过此页面分享 Dekkho 邀请。

en.description: The Dekkho (Baadl) Full SDK uses this startup screen to validate a saved session and route channel, reel, media, and listing links to their pages.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, startup and incoming Dekkho content links cannot follow this routing flow.

zh-CN.description: Dekkho（Baadl）完整 SDK 会在启动页验证已保存的登录状态，并将频道、短视频、媒体和列表链接转到对应页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用启动和 Dekkho 内容链接将无法使用此跳转流程。

en.description: The Dekkho (Baadl) Full SDK shows a featured performer’s profile and browsable movie, television, and music sections.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, users cannot view these featured-performer profiles or their content lists.

zh-CN.description: Dekkho（Baadl）完整 SDK 会显示特邀演员或艺人的资料，并列出可浏览的电影、电视节目和音乐。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法查看这些艺人资料或其内容列表。

en.description: The Dekkho (Baadl) Full SDK displays static information pages such as About, privacy, or terms in a web view.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, users cannot open these information pages from the app.

zh-CN.description: Dekkho（Baadl）完整 SDK 会在网页视图中显示关于、隐私或条款等信息页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法从应用中打开这些信息页面。

en.description: The Dekkho (Baadl) Full SDK lists channels the user has subscribed to.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, users cannot browse their subscribed channels from this page.

zh-CN.description: Dekkho（Baadl）完整 SDK 会列出用户已订阅的频道。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过此页面浏览已订阅的频道。

en.description: The Dekkho (Baadl) Full SDK lists recommendation content the user follows and lets the user open or subscribe to its channels.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, users cannot browse their subscribed recommendations from this page.

zh-CN.description: Dekkho（Baadl）完整 SDK 会列出用户关注的推荐内容，并允许用户打开或订阅其中的频道。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过此页面浏览已关注的推荐内容。

en.description: The Dekkho (Baadl) Full SDK lists reels the user has subscribed to.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, users cannot browse their subscribed reels from this page.

zh-CN.description: Dekkho（Baadl）完整 SDK 会列出用户已订阅的短视频。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过此页面浏览已订阅的短视频。

en.description: The Dekkho (Baadl) Full SDK displays details for an upcoming channel, including its release date, promotion, and available playback option.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, users cannot view upcoming-channel details or open its available preview.

zh-CN.description: Dekkho（Baadl）完整 SDK 会显示即将上线频道的详情，包括上线日期、宣传内容和可用的播放选项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法查看即将上线频道的详情或打开可用预览。

en.description: After a phone sign-in request, the Dekkho (Baadl) Full SDK lets users enter and verify the code sent to their phone.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, users cannot complete phone-number verification through this flow.

zh-CN.description: 手机号登录请求发出后，Dekkho（Baadl）完整 SDK 会让用户输入并验证发送到手机的验证码。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过此流程完成手机号验证。

en.description: The Dekkho (Baadl) Full SDK plays selected video, episode, or live content and provides playback and playlist controls.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, users cannot watch streamed content through this player.

zh-CN.description: Dekkho（Baadl）完整 SDK 会播放选中的视频、剧集或直播内容，并提供播放和播放列表控制。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过此播放器观看流媒体内容。

en.description: The Dekkho (Baadl) Full SDK opens the full list behind a home or profile content section, with title, filtering, and subscription controls.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, users cannot browse or filter the full content list from that section.

zh-CN.description: Dekkho（Baadl）完整 SDK 会打开首页或个人资料内容区对应的完整列表，并提供标题、筛选和订阅选项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法浏览或筛选该内容区的完整列表。

en.description: The Dekkho (Baadl) Full SDK searches people already receiving a selected watchlist recommendation.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, users cannot search the watchlist’s recipient list.

zh-CN.description: Dekkho（Baadl）完整 SDK 会搜索已接收所选片单推荐的用户。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法搜索该片单的接收者列表。

en.description: The Dekkho (Baadl) Full SDK lists people receiving a selected watchlist recommendation and lets the user add, search, or remove recipients.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, users cannot manage recipients for that watchlist.

zh-CN.description: Dekkho（Baadl）完整 SDK 会列出接收所选片单推荐的用户，并允许用户添加、搜索或移除接收者。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法管理该片单的接收者。

en.description: When Android sends a headphone or device media-button event, the Dekkho (Baadl) Full SDK forwards it to its playback broadcast.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, media-button presses are no longer forwarded through this Dekkho playback hook.

zh-CN.description: Android 收到耳机或设备的媒体按键事件时，Dekkho（Baadl）完整 SDK 会将事件转发给播放控制广播。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，媒体按键事件将无法通过此 Dekkho 播放入口转发。

en.description: When Dekkho has queued offline videos, the Dekkho (Baadl) Full SDK downloads and encrypts them in the background while reporting progress.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, queued offline downloads cannot finish and those videos will not be available for offline viewing.

zh-CN.description: Dekkho 存在排队的离线视频时，Dekkho（Baadl）完整 SDK 会在后台下载并加密视频，同时报告进度。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，排队中的离线下载无法完成，这些视频也无法用于离线观看。

en.description: When Android delivers an incoming SMS broadcast, the Dekkho (Baadl) Full SDK logs the sender and the message’s last four characters; it does not pass the code into the sign-in screen.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, this SMS log is no longer recorded; phone verification remains available for manual entry.

zh-CN.description: Android 收到短信广播时，Dekkho（Baadl）完整 SDK 会记录发送方和短信末尾四个字符；它不会将验证码传入登录页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后不再记录这条短信日志；用户仍可手动输入验证码完成手机号验证。

en.description: The Dekkho (Baadl) Full SDK starts this background service as users load more home, profile, channel, notification, or favorites content; it fetches the next list entries for that screen.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, scrolling to additional list sections or results may stop working.

zh-CN.description: 用户继续加载首页、个人资料、频道、通知或收藏内容时，Dekkho（Baadl）完整 SDK 会启动此后台服务，为相应页面获取下一批列表内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，列表滚动加载更多分区或结果可能无法继续。

en.description: The BAGTAG EBT Framework uses this screen to guide passengers through signing in, connecting an electronic bag tag and sending baggage check-in details to it.
en.disableEffect: The app loses this BAGTAG sign-in, tag-connection and baggage check-in flow.

zh-CN.description: BAGTAG EBT Framework 使用此页面引导乘客登录、连接电子行李牌，并向行李牌发送值机信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用将无法使用此 BAGTAG 登录、连接行李牌和办理行李值机流程。

en.description: The BAGTAG EBT Framework opens this screen when a passenger removes an electronic bag tag from an account; it finds the tag and confirms when it has been removed.
en.disableEffect: Passengers cannot remove a registered electronic bag tag through this BAGTAG flow.

zh-CN.description: 乘客通过 BAGTAG EBT Framework 打开此页面，从账户中移除电子行李牌；页面会查找行李牌并确认移除结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，乘客无法通过此 BAGTAG 流程移除已注册的电子行李牌。

en.description: The BAGTAG EBT Framework opens this screen to update an electronic bag tag firmware; it guides the passenger through finding and connecting to the tag.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot update electronic bag tag firmware through this BAGTAG flow.

zh-CN.description: BAGTAG EBT Framework 会在更新电子行李牌固件时打开此页面，并引导乘客查找和连接行李牌。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用无法通过此 BAGTAG 流程更新电子行李牌固件。

en.description: The BAGTAG EBT Framework opens this screen to send a selected image to an electronic bag tag and shows the image transfer progress.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot update an electronic bag tag image through this BAGTAG flow.

zh-CN.description: BAGTAG EBT Framework 会在向电子行李牌发送所选图片时打开此页面，并显示图片传输进度。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用无法通过此 BAGTAG 流程更新电子行李牌上的图片。

en.description: The BAGTAG EBT Framework opens this screen to connect an electronic bag tag to a passenger account and confirms when the tag is added.
en.disableEffect: Passengers cannot register an electronic bag tag to their account through this BAGTAG flow.

zh-CN.description: 乘客通过 BAGTAG EBT Framework 打开此页面，将电子行李牌连接到自己的账户，并查看注册结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，乘客无法通过此 BAGTAG 流程将电子行李牌注册到账户。

en.description: The BAGTAG EBT Framework opens this screen to send baggage check-in details to an electronic bag tag or clear its display.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot complete BAGTAG baggage check-in updates or clear the tag display through this flow.

zh-CN.description: BAGTAG EBT Framework 会在向电子行李牌发送行李值机信息或清除牌面时打开此页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用无法通过此流程更新 BAGTAG 值机信息或清除行李牌显示内容。

en.description: Baidu Push SDK handles background commands for incoming or tapped push notifications. The push SDK starts it when dispatching a command.
en.disableEffect: Baidu push commands and notification actions will stop working; the game itself remains available.

zh-CN.description: 百度推送 SDK 会在处理收到或点击的推送通知时，通过此后台 Service 执行推送命令。推送 SDK 派发命令时会启动它。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 百度推送命令和通知操作将停止工作，游戏本身仍可使用。

en.description: Baidu Push SDK stores and exposes push registration, message, and app-status information when its push services query the provider.
en.disableEffect: Baidu push registration and message delivery can stop working; the host app's own features remain available.

zh-CN.description: 百度推送服务查询此 Provider 时，它会保存并提供推送注册、消息和应用状态信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 百度推送注册和消息投递可能停止，宿主应用自身功能仍可使用。

en.description: Baidu Push SDK starts this background Service for a request to start push service to maintain the push connection and process push work.
en.disableEffect: Baidu push messages may no longer arrive; the game itself remains available.

zh-CN.description: 百度推送 SDK 收到 PUSH_SERVICE 操作时会启动此后台 Service，以维护推送连接并处理推送任务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 百度推送消息可能无法送达，游戏本身仍可使用。

en.description: Baidu Push SDK listens for power, boot, media, user-presence, network, and notification actions, then restarts or dispatches push work.
en.disableEffect: Baidu push reconnection and notification actions can stop working; the game itself remains available.

zh-CN.description: 百度推送 SDK 会监听电源、开机、存储介质、用户活动、网络和通知操作，并据此恢复或派发推送任务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 百度推送重连和通知操作可能停止，游戏本身仍可使用。

en.description: Baidu Push SDK receives registration-sync and internal method callbacks, along with package-removal events, to update push registration state.
en.disableEffect: Baidu push registration maintenance can stop working; the game itself remains available.

zh-CN.description: 百度推送 SDK 会接收注册同步、内部方法回调和应用移除事件，以更新推送注册状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 百度推送注册维护可能停止，游戏本身仍可使用。

en.description: The SHYS-packaged Baidu Face SDK sample shows the captured face after successful collection and offers return-home or repeat-capture actions.
en.disableEffect: Only the sample's face-capture result and retry screen becomes unavailable.

zh-CN.description: SHYS 打包的百度人脸 SDK 示例会在采集成功后显示人脸图像，并提供返回首页或重新采集的操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 只有示例中的人脸采集结果和重试页面会无法使用。

en.description: The SHYS-packaged Baidu Face SDK sample runs a camera-based face-detection capture, selects a captured image, and handles success or timeout.
en.disableEffect: Only the SDK's bundled face-detection example can no longer capture and show a result.

zh-CN.description: SHYS 打包的百度人脸 SDK 示例会通过相机进行人脸检测采集，选择采集图像，并处理成功或超时情况。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 只有 SDK 附带的人脸检测示例将无法采集并显示结果。

en.description: The SHYS-packaged Baidu Face SDK sample displays its face-verification agreement and provides a way to return from that information screen.
en.disableEffect: Only the sample's face-verification agreement page becomes unavailable.

zh-CN.description: SHYS 打包的百度人脸 SDK 示例会显示人脸验证协议，并提供从该说明页面返回的操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 只有示例中的人脸验证协议页面会无法打开。

en.description: The SHYS-packaged Baidu Face SDK sample runs a camera-based liveness check, selects a captured image, and offers retry or return after failure or timeout.
en.disableEffect: Only the SDK's bundled liveness demonstration becomes unavailable.

zh-CN.description: SHYS 打包的百度人脸 SDK 示例会通过相机进行活体检测，选择采集图像，并在失败或超时时提供重试或返回操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 只有 SDK 附带的活体检测示例会无法使用。

en.description: The SHYS-packaged Baidu Face SDK sample home screen initializes the face engine and lets users enter face detection, liveness, agreement, and settings screens.
en.disableEffect: The bundled face-verification sample home screen becomes unavailable.

zh-CN.description: SHYS 打包的百度人脸 SDK 示例首页会初始化人脸引擎，并提供人脸检测、活体检测、协议和设置页面入口。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 附带的人脸验证示例首页将无法打开。

en.description: The SHYS-packaged Baidu Face SDK sample lets users choose low, normal, high, or custom face-image quality settings, then open parameter editing.
en.disableEffect: Only the sample's face-quality preset controls become unavailable.

zh-CN.description: SHYS 打包的百度人脸 SDK 示例允许用户选择低、普通、高或自定义的人脸图像质量设置，并进入参数编辑页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 只有示例中的人脸质量预设控制会无法使用。

en.description: The SHYS-packaged Baidu Face SDK sample lets users edit and save face-image thresholds for lighting, blur, facial occlusion, and head pose.
en.disableEffect: Only the sample's detailed face-quality tuning screen becomes unavailable.

zh-CN.description: SHYS 打包的百度人脸 SDK 示例允许用户编辑并保存人脸图像的光照、模糊、面部遮挡和头部姿态阈值。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 只有示例中的详细人脸质量调节页面会无法使用。

en.description: The SHYS-packaged Baidu Face SDK sample settings screen adjusts face quality and liveness actions and links to detailed quality controls.
en.disableEffect: Only the sample's face-capture settings screen becomes unavailable.

zh-CN.description: SHYS 打包的百度人脸 SDK 示例设置页面可调整人脸质量和活体动作，并链接到详细质量控制。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 只有示例中的人脸采集设置页面会无法使用。

en.description: When an app requests location, the Baidu Location SDK runs its location service in a separate process and can display an ongoing notification when running in the foreground.
en.disableEffect: Apps using Baidu Location will not receive location fixes.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求位置信息时，Baidu Location SDK 会在独立进程中运行位置服务；以前台方式运行时也可显示持续通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖 Baidu Location 的应用将无法获取位置。

en.description: The Baidu MobAds SDK opens this screen to show an in-app ad landing page after a user taps an ad.
en.disableEffect: Baidu ads will no longer be able to open their in-app landing pages.

zh-CN.description: 用户点按广告后，百度 MobAds SDK 会通过此页面显示应用内广告落地页。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，百度广告将无法打开应用内落地页。

en.description: The Baidu MobAds SDK uses this file provider to hand a downloaded advertised app package to Android when a user chooses to install it.
en.disableEffect: Ad app download and install links that need this file handoff will fail, while the host app's own screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择安装广告中的应用时，百度 MobAds SDK 会通过此文件提供器将下载的安装包交给 Android。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要此文件传递的广告应用下载和安装链接将会失败，但宿主应用本身的页面仍可使用。

en.description: When a Baidu MobAds rewarded video is shown, this screen plays the full-screen ad and handles its viewing lifecycle.
en.disableEffect: Rewarded videos will not open, and rewards for watching ads will no longer be granted.

zh-CN.description: 播放百度 MobAds 激励视频时，此页面会显示全屏广告并处理播放过程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 激励视频将无法打开，观看广告的奖励也不会再发放。

en.description: Baidu Mobads opens this screen to display ad content and handle the user's taps and Back action.
en.disableEffect: Baidu Mobads ads that use this screen will not open.

zh-CN.description: Baidu Mobads 会通过此界面展示广告内容，并处理用户对广告的点击和返回操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，依赖此界面的 Baidu Mobads 广告将无法打开。

en.description: Baidu Mobile Ads uses this file provider to expose files from its configured SDK paths as content links, including files used in ad download and install flows.
en.disableEffect: Baidu ad downloads or installs that need these file links may fail.

zh-CN.description: 百度移动广告 SDK 通过此文件提供器将配置目录中的文件以内容链接形式开放，供广告下载和安装流程使用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖这些文件链接的百度广告下载或安装可能失败。

en.description: Baidu Mobile Ads uses this Activity to host ad pages that its SDK loads while the app is running.
en.disableEffect: Baidu ads that use these dynamically loaded pages will not open.

zh-CN.description: 百度移动广告 SDK 使用此 Activity 承载运行期间动态加载的广告页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖这些动态加载页面的百度广告将无法打开。

en.description: Baidu Mobile Ads opens this screen to play a rewarded video ad and manage its playback.
en.disableEffect: Rewarded videos will not play, and users will not receive rewards for watching them.

zh-CN.description: 百度移动广告 SDK 通过此页面播放激励视频广告并管理播放过程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 激励视频将无法播放，用户也不会因观看这些广告获得奖励。

en.description: Baidu Navigation uses this file provider when it shares SDK files through Android file links that another app can open.
en.disableEffect: Baidu Navigation file handoffs that depend on these links can fail, so sharing or opening SDK files may stop working.

zh-CN.description: 百度导航 SDK 需要分享供其他应用打开的文件时，会通过此文件提供器生成 Android 文件链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，依赖这些链接的百度导航文件传递可能失败，相关分享或打开操作可能无法使用。

en.description: Baidu Navigation starts this background service when it saves, updates, deletes or syncs favorite places and route data in its local database.
en.disableEffect: Saving, deleting or syncing saved places and routes in Baidu Navigation may fail.

zh-CN.description: 百度导航会在保存、更新、删除或同步收藏地点和路线信息时启动此后台服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，百度导航中的地点和路线收藏可能无法保存、删除或同步。

en.description: Baidu Navigation opens this screen to play a supplied video, with controls for seeking, pausing and optionally skipping it.
en.disableEffect: Videos launched by Baidu Navigation will not open, which can break any in-app flow that relies on them.

zh-CN.description: 百度导航会打开此页面播放指定视频，并提供进度、暂停及可选的跳过控件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，百度导航启动的视频将无法打开，依赖这些视频的应用流程也会受影响。

en.description: The Baidu MobAds bundle uses this screen for its web-based OAuth sign-in and authorization flow. It reads the request details and returns the result to the app that started it.
en.disableEffect: Baidu OAuth sign-in and authorization may fail; keep this enabled if the app uses that login flow.

zh-CN.description: 百度 MobAds 套件会用此页面完成网页 OAuth 登录和授权。页面读取请求信息，并将结果返回给发起登录的应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 百度 OAuth 登录和授权可能失败；如果应用使用此登录流程，请保持启用。

en.description: This Baidu OCR camera screen opens when an app starts a document scan. It lets the user capture an image or choose one from the gallery, crop or rotate it, and return it to the OCR flow.
en.disableEffect: Apps that use Baidu OCR may lose the document-capture step, so their scan flow can no longer receive an image.

zh-CN.description: 当应用开始文档识别扫描时，Baidu OCR 会打开此相机界面。用户可以拍摄图片或从图库选择图片，裁剪或旋转后将其交给 OCR 流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖 Baidu OCR 的应用会失去文档采集步骤，扫描流程可能无法取得图片。

en.description: Baidu Game SDK opens this brief Activity when a platform login or authorization operation needs a screen, then returns the result to the game.
en.disableEffect: Baidu platform login or authorization flows that use this handoff can fail.

zh-CN.description: 百度游戏 SDK 的平台登录或授权需要打开页面时，会启动此短暂 Activity，并将结果返回给游戏。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此页面交接的百度平台登录或授权流程可能失败。

en.description: Baidu Game SDK presents an account-authentication screen when its login flow requires an additional check, then returns success or cancellation to the game.
en.disableEffect: Baidu account authentication required during login will fail.

zh-CN.description: 百度游戏 SDK 登录流程需要额外验证时，会显示账号验证页面，并向游戏返回成功或取消结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 百度账号登录所需的验证流程将无法完成。

en.description: Baidu Game SDK starts this short background Service during a platform-session keep-alive check while the app is active. It stops itself after the check returns.
en.disableEffect: The SDK may stop refreshing its background session; the game's own features remain available.

zh-CN.description: 百度游戏 SDK 会在应用运行期间通过此短暂后台 Service 检查并维持平台会话。检查返回后 Service 会自行停止。
zh-CN.disableEffect: SDK 可能不再刷新后台平台会话，游戏自身功能仍可使用。

en.description: Baidu Game SDK opens this account screen when a player binds a phone number to a Baidu game account, then returns the result to the login flow.
en.disableEffect: Phone binding for Baidu game accounts will not complete.

zh-CN.description: 玩家为百度游戏账号绑定手机号时，百度游戏 SDK 会打开此页面，并将结果返回登录流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 百度游戏账号的手机号绑定将无法完成。

en.description: Baidu Game SDK starts this Activity for platform login or account-change requests and sends the result back to the game.
en.disableEffect: Baidu platform sign-in and account switching that use this Activity will fail.

zh-CN.description: 百度游戏 SDK 处理平台登录或切换账号请求时会启动此 Activity，并将结果返回给游戏。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此 Activity 的百度平台登录和切换账号流程将失败。

en.description: Baidu Game SDK presents its account sign-in screen when the game requests login, including an automatic sign-in attempt when available.
en.disableEffect: Players will be unable to sign in through the Baidu Game SDK.

zh-CN.description: 游戏请求登录时，百度游戏 SDK 会显示账号登录页面，并在可用时尝试自动登录。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 玩家将无法通过百度游戏 SDK 登录。

en.description: Baidu Game SDK opens this screen when a player changes the password for a Baidu game account.
en.disableEffect: Players will be unable to change their Baidu game-account password through the SDK.

zh-CN.description: 玩家修改百度游戏账号密码时，百度游戏 SDK 会打开此页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 玩家将无法通过此 SDK 修改百度游戏账号密码。

en.description: Baidu Game SDK opens Baidu account sign-in in an embedded web page when the login flow requests it, then returns the login result.
en.disableEffect: Baidu SAPI sign-in through the game SDK will fail.

zh-CN.description: 百度游戏 SDK 登录流程需要百度账号认证时，会打开内置网页登录页面，并返回登录结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 游戏 SDK 中的百度账号网页登录将无法完成。

en.description: Baidu Game SDK opens account pages for password recovery or changes and phone binding when a player requests those account tasks.
en.disableEffect: The corresponding Baidu password and phone-account flows will fail.

zh-CN.description: 玩家找回或修改密码、绑定手机号时，百度游戏 SDK 会打开相应的账号页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 相应的百度密码和手机号账号流程将无法完成。

en.description: Baidu Game SDK opens its account web page for password recovery and other account checks when requested by the login flow.
en.disableEffect: Account-recovery pages that use the newer Baidu web flow will not open.

zh-CN.description: 百度游戏 SDK 登录流程请求密码找回或其他账号验证时，会打开新版账号网页。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖新版百度网页流程的账号找回页面将无法打开。

en.description: Baidu Game SDK opens a web sign-in page when a player chooses a linked third-party account, then returns the authorization result.
en.disableEffect: Third-party sign-in through the Baidu Game SDK will fail.

zh-CN.description: 玩家选择已关联的第三方账号登录时，百度游戏 SDK 会打开网页登录页面，并返回授权结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过百度游戏 SDK 进行的第三方登录将失败。

en.description: Baidu Game SDK prompts a visitor-account player to bind or upgrade the account when the game requests account protection or a verified account.
en.disableEffect: Visitor-account binding required by the game platform will not complete.

zh-CN.description: 游戏平台要求保护访客账号或升级为正式账号时，百度游戏 SDK 会提示玩家绑定或升级账号。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 游戏平台要求的访客账号绑定流程将无法完成。

en.description: Baidu Game SDK opens a titled web page when the game requests a platform link such as account help or a service page.
en.disableEffect: Baidu platform links that rely on this page will not open.

zh-CN.description: 游戏请求打开账号帮助或平台服务链接时，百度游戏 SDK 会显示带标题的网页。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此页面的百度平台链接将无法打开。

en.description: Bambora Online Checkout opens this screen for a payment session and returns to it when the checkout link sends the user back.
en.disableEffect: The app checkout and payment-completion flow may fail.

zh-CN.description: Bambora 在线支付 SDK 会在付款过程中打开此页面，并在支付链接返回时继续处理结账流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用的结账和完成付款流程可能失败。

en.description: The Spotii SDK test app uses this screen as its main interface when the app is opened from its icon.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents the older Spotii test app from opening its main screen.

zh-CN.description: Spotii SDK 测试应用从桌面图标启动时，会通过此页面显示应用主界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，较早版本的 Spotii 测试应用无法打开主界面。

en.description: The ChatAI library opens this screen with a web address from the calling screen and displays that page inside the app.
en.disableEffect: Any in-app page opened through this web screen will be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: ChatAI 库会根据调用界面提供的网址打开此界面，并在应用内显示对应网页。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法通过此网页界面打开相应的应用内页面。

en.description: The ChatAI library opens this screen when the app starts its AI chat feature; it shows the conversation, sends text prompts, and displays replies.
en.disableEffect: The app's AI chat screen cannot open, so users cannot send prompts or receive replies there.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动 AI 聊天功能时，ChatAI 库会打开此界面；用户可以发送文字问题并查看回复。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用的 AI 聊天界面将无法打开，用户也无法在其中提问或查看回复。

en.description: The ChatAI library opens this chat screen with suggested prompts; users can send a chosen question and read the reply.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open this chat screen or use its suggested questions to get replies.

zh-CN.description: ChatAI 库会打开带有推荐问题的聊天界面，用户可以选择问题并查看回复。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开此聊天界面，也无法使用其中的推荐问题获取回复。

en.description: Batch opens this screen when a user taps a push message containing a link and directs that link to a screen in the app.
en.disableEffect: Links and actions launched from Batch push messages will no longer open through this route.

zh-CN.description: 用户点按包含链接的 Batch 推送消息时，Batch 会打开此页面并将链接转到应用中的相应页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Batch 推送消息中的链接和操作将无法通过此入口打开。

en.description: Batch runs actions selected from a push notification in the background and can dismiss that notification.
en.disableEffect: Buttons and actions in Batch push messages will stop working.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择推送通知中的操作后，Batch 会在后台执行该操作，也可以关闭对应通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Batch 推送消息中的按钮和操作将无法使用。

en.description: Batch retains this old background job entry for notification display receipts; the analyzed version exits immediately when Android starts it.
en.disableEffect: This version cancels pending jobs for this legacy service, so disabling it does not change current push delivery.

zh-CN.description: Batch 保留此旧后台任务入口用于通知展示回执；在分析的版本中，Android 启动它后会立即结束。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 此版本会取消该旧服务的待处理任务，因此停用它不会改变当前推送的送达流程。

en.description: Batch opens this screen when it requests a runtime permission, including permission to send notifications, and returns the result to its SDK.
en.disableEffect: Batch cannot request notification permission through its own prompt, so users may not be able to enable Batch push alerts from the app.

zh-CN.description: Batch 请求运行时权限（包括通知权限）时会打开此页面，并将用户的选择返回给 SDK。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Batch 无法通过自己的提示页面请求通知权限，用户可能无法在应用中启用 Batch 推送提醒。

en.description: When Android schedules a Batch push job, this service processes the queued message and displays its notification.
en.disableEffect: Normal-priority Batch push notifications may not be shown.

zh-CN.description: Android 安排 Batch 推送任务时，此服务会处理排队的消息并显示通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，普通优先级的 Batch 推送通知可能无法显示。

en.description: After a user dismisses a Batch push message, this Receiver records the dismissal for Batch analytics.
en.disableEffect: Batch will stop recording push notification dismissals; app screens continue to work.

zh-CN.description: 用户关闭 Batch 推送消息后，此接收器会为 Batch 记录这次关闭事件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Batch 将不再记录推送通知的关闭事件，应用页面仍可正常使用。

en.description: When Google push delivery brings a Batch message to the app, this Receiver checks it and forwards it for display.
en.disableEffect: Batch messages delivered through Google push will not reach the app for display.

zh-CN.description: Google 推送服务向应用送达 Batch 消息时，此接收器会检查消息并将其转交显示。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，通过 Google 推送服务送达的 Batch 消息将无法交给应用显示。

en.description: Batch starts this service to process an incoming push message and show its notification.
en.disableEffect: Batch push notifications may no longer be processed or shown.

zh-CN.description: Batch 会启动此服务来处理收到的推送消息并显示通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Batch 推送通知可能无法处理或显示。

en.description: Batch opens this screen to display an in-app message or campaign to the user.
en.disableEffect: Batch in-app messages and their actions will no longer be shown.

zh-CN.description: Batch 会打开此页面，向用户显示应用内消息或活动内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Batch 应用内消息及其操作将无法显示。

en.description: This optional Batch screen shows SDK debugging tools and diagnostic views.
en.disableEffect: Batch debugging tools will be unavailable; regular app features continue to work.

zh-CN.description: 此可选页面显示 Batch SDK 调试工具和诊断信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Batch 调试工具将无法使用，但应用的常规功能仍可使用。

en.description: Batch uses this service entry when it sets up event reporting so activity and campaign events can be sent to configured analytics providers.
en.disableEffect: Batch events will no longer be forwarded to configured analytics providers; push delivery and app screens can still work.

zh-CN.description: Batch 设置事件统计时会使用此服务入口，将应用活动和营销活动事件发送给已配置的分析服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Batch 事件将不再转发到已配置的分析服务，但推送送达和应用页面仍可正常工作。

en.description: When Huawei Push sends a message or a new app token, this Batch service passes it to Batch push handling.
en.disableEffect: Huawei-delivered Batch notifications and token updates will stop; other app features continue to work.

zh-CN.description: 华为推送送达消息或应用收到新的推送令牌时，此 Batch 服务会将信息交给 Batch 处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，通过华为推送送达的 Batch 通知和令牌更新将停止，但其他应用功能仍可使用。

en.description: Batch uses this service entry when choosing a push provider and registering the app for Batch notifications.
en.disableEffect: Batch may not find its configured registration provider, so Batch push notifications may stop arriving.

zh-CN.description: Batch 选择推送服务并为应用注册 Batch 通知时会使用此服务入口。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Batch 可能无法找到已配置的注册服务，因此推送通知可能无法送达。

en.description: The Bazaarvoice Notifications SDK uses this Receiver when a user taps a notification button and forwards the selected action for handling.
en.disableEffect: Buttons in Bazaarvoice notifications will stop responding.

zh-CN.description: 用户点按通知按钮时，Bazaarvoice Notifications SDK 会通过此接收器转交所选操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Bazaarvoice 通知中的按钮将无法响应。

en.description: The Bazaarvoice Notifications SDK starts this service to display its notifications and handle their button actions.
en.disableEffect: Bazaarvoice notifications and their button actions will stop working.

zh-CN.description: Bazaarvoice Notifications SDK 会启动此服务来显示通知并处理通知按钮操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Bazaarvoice 通知及其按钮操作将无法使用。

en.description: Bazaarvoice PIN Notifications uses this Receiver when a user taps a product notification button and forwards that action for handling.
en.disableEffect: Actions on Bazaarvoice PIN product notifications will no longer be handled.

zh-CN.description: 用户点按产品通知按钮时，Bazaarvoice PIN Notifications 会通过此接收器转交所选操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Bazaarvoice PIN 产品通知中的操作将无法处理。

en.description: Bazaarvoice PIN Notifications processes a tapped product notification and can schedule that product reminder again after a selected response.
en.disableEffect: PIN notification buttons will stop working, including the option to schedule a product reminder again.

zh-CN.description: Bazaarvoice PIN Notifications 会处理用户点按的产品通知，并可在用户选择相应选项后重新安排该产品提醒。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，PIN 通知按钮将无法使用，包括重新安排产品提醒的选项。

en.description: Bazaarvoice Store Notifications forwards nearby-store events and notification button taps for processing.
en.disableEffect: Nearby-store notifications and their buttons will stop working.

zh-CN.description: Bazaarvoice Store Notifications 会转交附近门店事件和通知按钮操作进行处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，附近门店通知及其按钮将无法使用。

en.description: Bazaarvoice Store Notifications schedules a notice after a store-area visit and handles buttons on that notice.
en.disableEffect: Nearby-store notifications will no longer be scheduled, and their buttons will not work.

zh-CN.description: 用户到达门店附近后，Bazaarvoice Store Notifications 会安排门店通知，并处理通知中的按钮。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，附近门店通知将不再安排，其按钮也无法使用。

en.description: Pankaj Adhav's ReferAndEarn SDK opens this screen to load the referral campaign and the user's referral code. Users can copy the code or share the campaign with friends.
en.disableEffect: The app's referral campaign, referral code, and share-with-friends flow will be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: Pankaj Adhav 的 ReferAndEarn SDK 会打开此页面加载推荐活动和用户的推荐码。用户可复制推荐码，或将活动分享给朋友。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用中的推荐活动、推荐码及分享给好友的流程将无法使用。

en.description: The ReferAndEarn SDK opens this screen when users view the referral program's terms. It loads the URL supplied by the app in an in-app browser.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to read the referral program terms inside the app.

zh-CN.description: 用户查看推荐活动条款时，ReferAndEarn SDK 会打开此页面，并在应用内浏览器中载入应用提供的网址。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在应用内阅读推荐活动条款。

en.description: When an app using BBGGO HookProject opens another screen, this Activity supports the library navigation handling.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, screens opened through HookProject may fail to open, disrupting app navigation.

zh-CN.description: 使用 BBGGO HookProject 的应用打开其他页面时，此 Activity 为应用导航提供支持。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，经 HookProject 打开的页面可能无法出现，应用导航会受影响。

en.description: When an app using BBGGO HookProject opens another screen, this Activity supports the library navigation handling.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, screens opened through HookProject may fail to open, disrupting app navigation.

zh-CN.description: 使用 BBGGO HookProject 的应用打开其他页面时，此 Activity 为应用导航提供支持。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，经 HookProject 打开的页面可能无法出现，应用导航会受影响。

en.description: The BBGGO WanAndroid content module displays a web article when a user opens a content item in the app.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to open those article pages in the app.

zh-CN.description: BBGGO WanAndroid 内容模块会在用户打开内容条目时显示对应的网页文章。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在应用中打开这些文章页面。

en.description: The BBGGO WanAndroid login module shows the account sign-in form and sends submitted credentials for login; a successful sign-in opens the app home screen.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to sign in through the app login flow.

zh-CN.description: BBGGO WanAndroid 登录模块显示账号登录表单，并在用户提交后验证账号；登录成功后会进入应用主页。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过应用的登录流程登录账号。

en.description: The BBGGO WanAndroid login module shows the account registration form and submits the entered details when a user chooses to register.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to create an account through the app registration flow.

zh-CN.description: BBGGO WanAndroid 登录模块显示账号注册表单，并在用户提交时发送填写的注册信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过应用的注册流程创建账号。

en.description: The Be-Bound messaging SDK receives Android broadcasts when apps are installed, updated, or removed and checks whether the changed package is Be-Bound Services. If that service package changes, it signals the host app and unregisters the messaging setup when the service is removed.
en.disableEffect: The SDK will not detect Be-Bound Services changes, so its automatic messaging registration and cleanup may be left out of date.

zh-CN.description: Be-Bound 消息 SDK 会接收 Android 在应用安装、更新或卸载时发出的广播，并检查发生变化的包名是否属于 Be-Bound Services。该服务安装、更新或移除时，它会通知宿主应用；移除时还会注销消息注册。
zh-CN.disableEffect: SDK 将无法发现 Be-Bound Services 的变化，因此自动消息注册或清理可能无法及时进行。

en.description: The Be-Bound messaging SDK sends this receiver registration, request, session, and user-link events; it forwards incoming Be-Bound push messages to the host app.
en.disableEffect: Be-Bound push messages and any login, user-mapping, or subscription handling that depends on these callbacks will stop working.

zh-CN.description: Be-Bound 消息 SDK 会向此接收器发送注册、请求、会话和用户关联事件；它会把收到的 Be-Bound 推送消息转发给宿主应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Be-Bound 推送消息将无法送达，依赖这些回调的登录、用户关联或订阅处理也会停止。

en.description: The Be-Bound messaging SDK sends this receiver its internal connectivity-change event, which it forwards to the SDK's network listeners.
en.disableEffect: The Be-Bound SDK will no longer receive these network-change notifications.

zh-CN.description: Be-Bound 消息 SDK 会通过内部连接变化事件通知此接收器，接收器再把网络变化转给 SDK 的监听方。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Be-Bound SDK 将无法再收到这些网络变化通知。

en.description: Adobe Creative SDK Behance runs this background service when a user publishes a project. It uploads the project and its media, reports progress, and can share the result through connected social accounts.
en.disableEffect: Behance project uploads may fail or stop before completion.

zh-CN.description: 用户发布项目时，Adobe Creative SDK Behance 会运行此后台服务。它上传项目及媒体、报告进度，并可通过已连接的社交账户分享结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Behance 项目上传可能失败或无法完成。

en.description: Adobe Creative SDK Behance runs this background service when a user publishes a work-in-progress revision. It uploads the revision and reports the result.
en.disableEffect: Behance work-in-progress uploads may fail or stop before completion.

zh-CN.description: 用户发布进行中作品的修订版本时，Adobe Creative SDK Behance 会运行此后台服务。它上传修订内容并报告结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Behance 进行中作品的上传可能失败或无法完成。

en.description: When Adobe Creative SDK Behance needs Adobe Creative Cloud files, this screen loads the user's available cloud spaces and returns the selected one.
en.disableEffect: Users may be unable to choose an Adobe cloud for a Behance workflow.

zh-CN.description: Adobe Creative SDK Behance 流程需要 Adobe Creative Cloud 文件时，此界面会加载用户可用的云端空间并返回所选项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户可能无法为 Behance 流程选择 Adobe 云端空间。

en.description: During an Adobe Creative SDK Behance project workflow, this screen opens the Adobe Creative Cloud asset browser and returns downloaded files or errors.
en.disableEffect: Selecting or downloading Creative Cloud assets for Behance projects may fail.

zh-CN.description: 在 Adobe Creative SDK Behance 项目流程中，此界面会打开 Adobe Creative Cloud 素材浏览器，并返回下载文件或错误信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户可能无法为 Behance 项目选择或下载 Creative Cloud 素材。

en.description: When a user starts a new project with Adobe Creative SDK Behance, this workflow lets them choose images and continue to project details and publishing.
en.disableEffect: The Behance new-project publishing flow will not open.

zh-CN.description: 用户通过 Adobe Creative SDK Behance 开始新项目时，此流程允许其选择图片并继续填写项目详情和发布。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Behance 新项目发布流程将无法打开。

en.description: When a user starts a work-in-progress post with Adobe Creative SDK Behance, this workflow lets them choose an image and enter revision details.
en.disableEffect: The Behance work-in-progress creation flow will not open.

zh-CN.description: 用户通过 Adobe Creative SDK Behance 开始发布进行中作品时，此流程允许其选择图片并填写修订内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Behance 进行中作品创建流程将无法打开。

en.description: When a user edits a profile through Adobe Creative SDK Behance, this screen loads profile details and lets them change text, location, and profile image.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to edit their Behance profile through the app.

zh-CN.description: 用户通过 Adobe Creative SDK Behance 编辑个人资料时，此界面会加载资料信息，并允许其修改文字、位置和头像。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法通过应用编辑 Behance 个人资料。

en.description: When a user connects Twitter through Adobe Creative SDK Behance, this screen completes Twitter sign-in and returns the authorization result.
en.disableEffect: Connecting a Twitter account to Behance may fail.

zh-CN.description: 用户通过 Adobe Creative SDK Behance 将 Twitter 连接到账户时，此界面会完成 Twitter 登录并返回授权结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，将 Twitter 账户连接到 Behance 可能会失败。

en.description: When a user opens a project through Adobe Creative SDK Behance, this screen loads and displays its details along with information about its creator.
en.disableEffect: Behance project details will not open in the app.

zh-CN.description: 用户通过 Adobe Creative SDK Behance 打开项目时，此界面会加载并显示项目详情及创作者信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Behance 项目详情将无法在应用中打开。

en.description: When a user publishes a project through Adobe Creative SDK Behance, this screen collects selected images and project details before the upload starts.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to prepare and publish Behance projects through this flow.

zh-CN.description: 用户通过 Adobe Creative SDK Behance 发布项目时，此界面会在上传前收集所选图片和项目详情。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法通过此流程准备并发布 Behance 项目。

en.description: When an Adobe Creative SDK Behance project upload finishes, this screen shows the result and can open the published project's web page.
en.disableEffect: The Behance upload result screen will not open, and its link to the published project will be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: Adobe Creative SDK Behance 项目上传完成后，此界面会显示结果，并可打开已发布项目的网页。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Behance 上传结果界面将无法打开，也无法通过其中的链接查看已发布项目。

en.description: When a user publishes a work-in-progress revision through Adobe Creative SDK Behance, this screen gathers the revision image, title, description, and tags.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to prepare or publish Behance work-in-progress revisions through this flow.

zh-CN.description: 用户通过 Adobe Creative SDK Behance 发布进行中作品的修订版本时，此界面会收集修订图片、标题、描述和标签。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法通过此流程准备或发布 Behance 进行中作品的修订版本。

en.description: When a user disconnects a linked social account through Adobe Creative SDK Behance, this screen asks for confirmation and submits the unlink request.
en.disableEffect: Users may be unable to disconnect a linked social account from Behance.

zh-CN.description: 用户通过 Adobe Creative SDK Behance 断开已连接的社交账户时，此界面会请求确认并提交解除连接操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户可能无法断开与 Behance 关联的社交账户。

en.description: The Beizi Ads SDK opens this Activity to show an ad or its in-app browser page.
en.disableEffect: Beizi ad screens and browser landing pages will not open.

zh-CN.description: Beizi Ads SDK 会打开此 Activity 展示广告或应用内浏览页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Beizi 广告界面和浏览器落地页将无法打开。

en.description: The Beizi Ads SDK starts this Service to download an advertised app and handle its completed-download install flow.
en.disableEffect: Beizi ad downloads and their install handoff will stop working.

zh-CN.description: Beizi Ads SDK 会启动此 Service 下载广告推广的应用，并处理下载完成后的安装流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Beizi 广告下载及其安装跳转将无法使用。

en.description: The BeiZi Ads SDK opens this screen to confirm downloading an app promoted by an ad. Confirming starts the download and may open the Android package installer.
en.disableEffect: The download confirmation for apps promoted by BeiZi ads will not open.

zh-CN.description: BeiZi Ads SDK 会打开此页面，确认是否下载广告推广的应用。确认后会开始下载，并可能打开 Android 安装程序。
zh-CN.disableEffect: BeiZi 广告推广应用的下载确认页面将无法打开。

en.description: The BeiZi Ads SDK displays a full-screen interstitial advertisement on this screen.
en.disableEffect: BeiZi full-screen interstitial ads will not appear.

zh-CN.description: BeiZi Ads SDK 会在此页面展示全屏插屏广告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: BeiZi 全屏插屏广告将不再显示。

en.description: The BeiZi Ads SDK plays a rewarded video on this screen and tracks viewing completion.
en.disableEffect: BeiZi Ads rewarded videos will not open, and watching ads will no longer earn rewards.

zh-CN.description: BeiZi Ads SDK 会在此页面播放激励视频，并记录观看是否完成。
zh-CN.disableEffect: BeiZi Ads 激励视频将无法打开，观看广告也将不再获得奖励。

en.description: The BeiZi Ads SDK opens this screen to show details about an app promoted by an advertisement before download.
en.disableEffect: Details for apps promoted by BeiZi Ads will not open.

zh-CN.description: BeiZi Ads SDK 会打开此页面，在下载前展示广告推广应用的相关信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: BeiZi Ads 推广应用的详情页将无法打开。

en.description: The BeiZi Fusion ad SDK opens this full-screen page for an advertisement, with web navigation and links to download the promoted app.
en.disableEffect: BeiZi Fusion ad landing pages and their download links will not open.

zh-CN.description: BeiZi Fusion 广告 SDK 会为广告打开此全屏页面，提供网页浏览和推广应用下载链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: BeiZi Fusion 广告落地页及其下载链接将无法打开。

en.description: The BeiZi Fusion ad SDK opens this page to show an advertised app or offer and provide its download or other ad links.
en.disableEffect: BeiZi Fusion ad landing pages and their offer links will not open.

zh-CN.description: BeiZi Fusion 广告 SDK 会打开此页面，展示广告推广的应用或优惠，并提供下载及其他广告链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: BeiZi Fusion 广告落地页及推广链接将无法打开。

en.description: The BeiZi Fusion ad SDK displays an advertisement destination as an in-app web page.
en.disableEffect: BeiZi Fusion web-based ad destination pages will not open.

zh-CN.description: BeiZi Fusion 广告 SDK 会在应用内网页中展示广告目标页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: BeiZi Fusion 网页广告目标页将无法打开。

en.description: The BeiZi Fusion ad SDK displays a full-screen interstitial or video advertisement on this screen.
en.disableEffect: BeiZi Fusion full-screen ads will not appear.

zh-CN.description: BeiZi Fusion 广告 SDK 会在此页面展示全屏插屏或视频广告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: BeiZi Fusion 全屏广告将不再显示。

en.description: The BeiZi Fusion ad SDK opens this page to show an advertised app or offer and provide its download or other ad links.
en.disableEffect: BeiZi Fusion ad landing pages and their offer links will not open.

zh-CN.description: BeiZi Fusion 广告 SDK 会打开此页面，展示广告推广的应用或优惠，并提供下载及其他广告链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: BeiZi Fusion 广告落地页及推广链接将无法打开。

en.description: The BeiZi Fusion ad SDK plays a rewarded video on this screen and tracks viewing completion.
en.disableEffect: BeiZi Fusion rewarded videos will not open, and watching ads will no longer earn rewards.

zh-CN.description: BeiZi Fusion 广告 SDK 会在此页面播放激励视频，并记录观看是否完成。
zh-CN.disableEffect: BeiZi Fusion 激励视频将无法打开，观看广告也将不再获得奖励。

en.description: The BeiZi Fusion AdsScope plugin runs this background service to download an app promoted by an ad and hand the package to Android for installation.
en.disableEffect: App downloads started by BeiZi Fusion ads will stop working.

zh-CN.description: BeiZi Fusion 的 AdsScope 插件会通过此后台服务下载广告推广的应用，并将安装包交给 Android 安装。

zh-CN.description: Banfengcanyue 基础 Android 库的示例主页可打开网络测试和 Wi-Fi 扫描页面，也可显示弹出菜单。
