en.disableEffect: The app’s QR-code sharing screen will no longer work.

zh-CN.description: Android APP Factory 的分享页面会将应用提供的网址、标题和说明生成二维码，并允许用户分享或保存图片、发送链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用的二维码分享页面将无法使用。

en.description: The Android APP Factory TBS feedback screen opens the app-supplied feedback page in its TBS-based web view and includes app and device details.
en.disableEffect: The TBS-based feedback page will no longer open through this Activity.

zh-CN.description: Android APP Factory 的 TBS 反馈页面会在基于 TBS 的网页视图中打开应用提供的反馈地址，并附带应用和设备信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法通过此 Activity 打开基于 TBS 的反馈页面。

en.description: The Android APP Factory test log screen lists framework, router, and WebView logs that the user can open or send.
en.disableEffect: The optional test and debug log screen will no longer be available.

zh-CN.description: Android APP Factory 的测试日志页面可列出框架、路由和 WebView 日志，供用户查看或发送。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 可选的测试和调试日志页面将无法使用。

en.description: The Android APP Factory TBS WebView helper starts this Service in a separate web process when engine preloading is enabled; TBS pages use that process.
en.disableEffect: TBS-based pages may fail to initialize or display correctly.

zh-CN.description: 启用引擎预加载时，Android APP Factory 的 TBS WebView 辅助组件会在独立网页进程中启动此 Service，TBS 页面会使用该进程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 基于 TBS 的页面可能无法初始化或正常显示。

en.description: The Android APP Factory framework uses this Activity as a standard host screen that displays the page requested by the app.
en.disableEffect: Pages that rely on this shared screen may no longer open.

zh-CN.description: Android APP Factory 框架将此 Activity 用作通用页面容器，显示应用指定的页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此通用页面容器的页面可能无法打开。

en.description: The Android APP Factory internal file provider creates permission-protected content links for files in app storage and cache.
en.disableEffect: File sharing or opening flows that use these links may fail.

zh-CN.description: Android APP Factory 的内部文件提供程序会为应用存储和缓存中的文件创建受权限保护的内容链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用这些链接的文件分享或打开流程可能失败。

en.description: The Android APP Factory file provider creates permission-granted links to local files and resolves links received by the app.
en.disableEffect: File sharing, opening, or installation flows that use these links may fail.

zh-CN.description: Android APP Factory 的文件提供程序会创建带访问授权的本地文件链接，并解析应用收到的链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用这些链接的文件分享、打开或安装流程可能失败。

en.description: The Android APP Factory file picker browses the folder supplied by the app, or device storage by default, and returns the selected file or folder.
en.disableEffect: The app’s in-app file picker will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: Android APP Factory 的文件选择器会浏览应用指定的文件夹，未指定时浏览设备存储，并将选中的文件或文件夹返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用内的文件选择器将无法打开。

en.description: The Android APP Factory foreground service runs app-registered background tasks and keeps an ongoing notification while those tasks are active.
en.disableEffect: Background tasks managed by AAF may stop or fail to stay active.

zh-CN.description: Android APP Factory 的前台服务会执行应用登记的后台任务，并在任务运行期间显示持续通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: AAF 管理的后台任务可能停止或无法持续运行。

en.description: The Android APP Factory receiver handles Android installer status for split APK installation, opens user confirmation when required, and reports success or failure to the app.
en.disableEffect: Split APK installation may stop before confirmation or completion.

zh-CN.description: Android APP Factory 的接收器会处理分包 APK 安装状态，在需要时打开用户确认页面，并向应用报告成功或失败。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 分包 APK 安装可能无法继续到确认或完成阶段。

en.description: The Android APP Factory lock-screen service starts this Service to briefly show and then remove its temporary foreground notification during lock-screen startup.
en.disableEffect: Lock-screen startup may fail or leave its temporary notification visible.

zh-CN.description: Android APP Factory 的锁屏服务会在启动时调用此 Service，短暂显示再移除临时前台通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 锁屏功能启动可能失败，或临时通知无法清除。

en.description: The Android APP Factory permission screen requests the runtime permissions supplied by the app and can guide the user to system settings after denial.
en.disableEffect: The app’s runtime permission request flow may fail.

zh-CN.description: Android APP Factory 的权限页面会申请应用指定的运行时权限；用户拒绝后，还可引导其前往系统设置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用的运行时权限申请流程可能失败。

en.description: The Android APP Factory updated permission screen explains why the app needs access, requests the supplied runtime permissions, and may guide the user to system settings after denial.
en.disableEffect: The app’s explained permission request flow may fail.

zh-CN.description: Android APP Factory 的新版权限页面会说明应用申请权限的用途、请求指定的运行时权限，并可在用户拒绝后引导其前往系统设置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用带用途说明的权限申请流程可能失败。

en.description: Android app links handled by the Android APP Factory framework open this browsable Activity, which routes the link to its matching destination.
en.disableEffect: App links handled by the AAF router may stop opening.

zh-CN.description: 由 Android APP Factory 框架处理的应用链接会通过此可浏览 Activity 打开，并被路由到匹配的目标页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 由 AAF 路由处理的应用链接可能无法打开。

en.description: The Android APP Factory WebView helper starts this Service in a separate web process when engine preloading is enabled; WebView pages use that process.
en.disableEffect: WebView pages may fail to initialize or display correctly.

zh-CN.description: 启用引擎预加载时，Android APP Factory 的 WebView 辅助组件会在独立网页进程中启动此 Service，网页会使用该进程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: WebView 页面可能无法初始化或正常显示。

en.description: Bilibili Boxing uses this page as its standard photo and video picker. It displays the media-selection interface and returns the items chosen by the user.
en.disableEffect: Apps using this picker cannot open it to choose photos or videos if it is disabled.

zh-CN.description: Bilibili Boxing 使用此页面作为标准照片和视频选择器。页面显示媒体选择界面，并把用户选中的项目交还给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，使用此选择器的应用无法打开它来选择照片或视频。

en.description: Bilibili Boxing presents this picker as a collapsible bottom sheet with a selected-media preview. The user can choose photos or videos and return the selection to the app.
en.disableEffect: Apps using the bottom-sheet picker cannot choose and preview media through it if it is disabled.

zh-CN.description: Bilibili Boxing 会以可收起的底部面板显示此选择器，并预览已选媒体。用户可以选择照片或视频，再把结果交还给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，使用此底部面板的应用无法通过它选择和预览媒体。

en.description: Bilibili Boxing opens this full-screen gallery to review photos or videos, move through an album, and adjust the selected items before confirming.
en.disableEffect: Apps using this gallery cannot review and confirm their photo or video selection if it is disabled.

zh-CN.description: Bilibili Boxing 会打开此全屏图库，供用户预览照片或视频、浏览相册，并在确认前调整所选项目。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，使用此图库的应用无法预览并确认照片或视频选择。

en.description: The Bill24 Payment SDK displays transaction details after checkout succeeds and offers receipt copying, sharing, and downloading. Its Done action closes the screen or opens the supplied return link.
en.disableEffect: The SDK cannot show the payment receipt or run the success screen action that closes the screen or follows its return link.

zh-CN.description: Bill24 Payment SDK 会在结账成功后显示交易详情，并提供复制、分享和下载凭证的功能；点击完成后会关闭页面或打开指定的返回链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: SDK 无法显示支付凭证，也无法执行成功页面中的关闭或打开返回链接操作。

en.description: When the Bill24 Payment SDK opens this screen with a completed transaction, it shows the invoice's transaction number, bank reference, merchant, date, and total, with options to save or share the invoice.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it removes the payment-completion receipt and its save/share actions, so the payment flow can no longer show its success page.

zh-CN.description: Bill24 支付 SDK 在支付完成后打开此页面，展示交易号、银行参考号、商户、日期和金额，并提供保存或分享账单的选项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，支付流程无法显示完成凭证，也不能通过此页面保存或分享账单。

en.description: Billy CC's component communication library briefly opens this transparent Activity when the app hands work to a component running separately, then closes it immediately.
en.disableEffect: App features that rely on this cross-process connection may fail.

zh-CN.description: 应用通过 Billy CC 组件通信库将工作交给单独运行的组件时，会短暂打开此透明 Activity，随后立即关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖这种跨进程连接的应用功能可能无法使用。

en.description: When the app connects features that run separately, Billy CC uses this provider to exchange connection information. It responds to the app's own requests and to enabled remote connections.
en.disableEffect: Features that use Billy CC to connect app processes may stop working.

zh-CN.description: 应用连接单独运行的功能时，Billy CC 会使用此提供程序交换连接信息。它会响应应用自身的请求以及已启用的远程连接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖 Billy CC 跨进程连接的功能可能无法使用。

en.description: BingoGame's Android SDK opens this screen when a user needs to change accounts; it presents the SDK's account sign-in options.
en.disableEffect: Users can no longer switch or reauthenticate their BingoGame account.

zh-CN.description: 用户需要更换账号时，BingoGame 安卓 SDK 会打开此界面，显示该 SDK 提供的账号登录方式。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法切换或重新验证 BingoGame 账号。

en.description: BingoGame's Android SDK opens this full-screen viewer when a user selects an image in its web pages or side panel; the screen also offers saving the image.
en.disableEffect: BingoGame image previews and the save action will not open.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 BingoGame 网页或侧边栏中选择图片时，BingoGame 安卓 SDK 会打开此全屏查看界面，并提供保存图片的操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: BingoGame 图片预览和保存界面将无法打开。

en.description: BingoGame's Android SDK opens this full-screen player when a user selects a video in its content; it provides playback controls.
en.disableEffect: Videos opened from BingoGame content can no longer be played in this viewer.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 BingoGame 内容中选择视频时，BingoGame 安卓 SDK 会打开此全屏播放器并提供播放控制。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此播放器播放 BingoGame 内容中的视频。

en.description: BingoGame opens this event page for a configured popup associated with the signed-in game account. The page can offer sharing or links to other SDK pages.
en.disableEffect: Configured game-event pages and their sharing or navigation actions will no longer work.

zh-CN.description: BingoGame 为已登录游戏账号配置弹窗活动时会打开此活动页面；页面可提供分享功能或跳转到其他 SDK 页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 配置的游戏活动页面及其分享和跳转操作将无法使用。

en.description: When a BingoGame installation request is opened, this screen checks whether Android allows package installs and sends the downloaded file to the system installer.
en.disableEffect: APK installation requests from BingoGame cannot complete.

zh-CN.description: 打开 BingoGame 的安装请求时，此界面会检查 Android 是否允许安装应用，并将下载的文件交给系统安装器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: BingoGame 发起的 APK 安装请求将无法完成。

en.description: BingoGame's Android SDK opens this screen when the user starts game-account sign-in; it shows the available login options, including one-tap phone sign-in when configured.
en.disableEffect: Users can no longer sign in to the BingoGame account needed by the SDK's account features.

zh-CN.description: 用户开始登录游戏账号时，BingoGame 安卓 SDK 会打开此界面，显示可用的登录方式，并在已配置时提供手机号一键登录。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法登录 BingoGame 账号，也无法使用依赖该账号的 SDK 功能。

en.description: During BingoGame SDK initialization, the server's configured notice address opens in this screen as an in-app announcement with controls to return to the game.
en.disableEffect: Configured announcements will not open, and SDK initialization can fail when it tries to launch the notice screen.

zh-CN.description: BingoGame SDK 初始化时，如果服务器配置了公告地址，就会在此界面打开应用内公告，并提供返回游戏的控件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 配置的公告将无法打开，SDK 启动时尝试打开公告界面也可能失败。

en.description: BingoGame opens this account-specific web screen for a configured mini-game or retained game page after checking the signed-in account.
en.disableEffect: BingoGame's account-specific mini-game and retained web pages will not open.

zh-CN.description: BingoGame 在确认当前登录账号后，会为配置的小游戏或游戏续接页面打开此账号专属网页界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: BingoGame 的账号专属小游戏和续接网页将无法打开。

en.description: BingoGame's Android SDK opens this in-game side panel to show configured game links and content actions such as web pages, sharing, and media previews.
en.disableEffect: The BingoGame side panel and its configured links and content actions will no longer be available.

zh-CN.description: BingoGame 安卓 SDK 会打开此游戏侧边栏，显示配置的游戏链接以及网页、分享和媒体预览等操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: BingoGame 侧边栏及其中配置的链接和内容操作将无法使用。

en.description: The BingoGame SDK declares this as the app's launcher screen; when opened, it shows a brief splash and then starts the app's configured main destination.
en.disableEffect: The app's launcher handoff through BingoGame will no longer reach its main screen.

zh-CN.description: BingoGame SDK 将此界面声明为应用启动页；打开后会短暂显示启动画面，再进入应用配置的主界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过 BingoGame 启动入口打开应用时，将无法进入主界面。

en.description: When BingoGame's update check returns a new version, this screen displays the update details and download progress, including required updates.
en.disableEffect: The SDK cannot show or apply updates, and a configured forced update can prevent users from continuing.

zh-CN.description: BingoGame 检查到新版本时会打开此界面，显示更新信息和下载进度，包括必须安装的更新。
zh-CN.disableEffect: SDK 将无法显示或安装更新，配置了强制更新时用户可能无法继续使用。

en.description: BingoGame opens this screen when the user views available game vouchers; it shows their details and expiration status.
en.disableEffect: Users can no longer view their BingoGame vouchers or expiration status.

zh-CN.description: 用户查看可用游戏代金券时，BingoGame 会打开此界面显示券的详情和有效期。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法查看 BingoGame 代金券及其有效期。

en.description: BingoGame opens this web screen for configured community pages, mini-games, and other SDK web content, with in-page navigation controls when enabled.
en.disableEffect: BingoGame community, mini-game, and other web pages will not open.

zh-CN.description: BingoGame 会用此网页界面打开配置的社区页面、小游戏和其他 SDK 网页内容，并可显示页面导航控件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: BingoGame 的社区、小游戏及其他网页将无法打开。

en.description: BingoGame opens this checkout screen with an order and payment address; it handles WeChat or Alipay handoffs and reports reward-ad results from the page.
en.disableEffect: Web purchases through BingoGame cannot complete, and rewards for watching ads in this payment flow will no longer be granted.

zh-CN.description: BingoGame 会根据订单和付款地址打开此结账界面，处理微信或支付宝跳转，并接收页面中的广告奖励结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 BingoGame 网页完成购买，此付款流程中的广告观看奖励也将不再发放。

en.description: BingoGame opens this media-selection screen when a web page requests a file; the user can choose media for the page.
en.disableEffect: BingoGame media selection and web upload controls will no longer work.

zh-CN.description: BingoGame 网页请求选择文件时会打开此媒体选择界面，供用户为网页选取媒体。
zh-CN.disableEffect: BingoGame 的媒体选择和网页上传功能将无法使用。

en.description: BingoGame's installer uses this file provider to give Android access to a downloaded APK with the app's configured file paths.
en.disableEffect: BingoGame cannot give the system installer access to downloaded APKs, so its package-install flow fails.

zh-CN.description: BingoGame 安装器通过此文件提供器和应用配置的文件路径，让 Android 读取下载的 APK。
zh-CN.disableEffect: BingoGame 无法让系统安装器读取下载的 APK，因此应用安装流程会失败。

en.description: When BingoGame receives an internal request to install a downloaded package, this receiver opens its installer screen with the file details.
en.disableEffect: BingoGame installation requests will no longer open the installer screen.

zh-CN.description: BingoGame 收到内部下载包安装请求时，此接收器会携带文件信息打开安装界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: BingoGame 的安装请求将无法打开安装界面。

en.description: The Bingzer Driven storage library opens Dropbox authorization, lets the user approve access, and returns the sign-in result to the app.
en.disableEffect: The app will not be able to connect a Dropbox account through Driven.

zh-CN.description: Bingzer Driven 存储库会打开 Dropbox 授权页面，让用户批准访问，并将登录结果返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法通过 Driven 连接 Dropbox 账户。

en.description: The Bingzer Driven storage library lets the user choose a Google account and authorize access to Google Drive, then returns the result to the app.
en.disableEffect: The app will not be able to connect Google Drive through Driven.

zh-CN.description: Bingzer Driven 存储库会让用户选择 Google 账户并授权访问 Google Drive，然后将结果返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法通过 Driven 连接 Google Drive。

en.description: The Bingzer Driven storage library validates a local external-storage folder supplied by the app and returns whether the connection succeeded.
en.disableEffect: The app will not be able to connect this local folder through Driven.

zh-CN.description: Bingzer Driven 存储库会验证应用提供的本地外部存储文件夹，并返回连接是否成功。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法通过 Driven 连接此本地文件夹。

en.description: Locus, Birju Vachhani's Android location library, receives updates from Android's location service and delivers the latest position to the app. It runs when the app has requested ongoing location updates.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it stops those location updates from reaching the app, which can break features that rely on current location or location tracking.

zh-CN.description: Birju Vachhani 的 Locus Android 定位库会接收 Android 定位服务发来的更新，并把最新位置传给应用。应用请求持续定位更新后会触发它。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，定位更新无法传递给应用，依赖当前位置或位置跟踪的功能可能无法工作。

en.description: Locus, Birju Vachhani's Android location library, opens this Activity when the app requests location access. It asks for the required permissions and, if needed, guides the user to turn on location or open the app's permission settings.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents Locus from completing its permission and location setup, so location features that use the library may not work.

zh-CN.description: 当应用通过 Birju Vachhani 的 Locus 定位库请求位置时，会打开此界面。它会请求必要的权限；必要时引导用户开启设备定位或前往应用权限设置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，Locus 无法完成权限和定位设置流程，使用此库的定位功能可能无法工作。

en.description: MoliHuan’s general utility library starts this background service when app code sends messages between processes. It relays those messages to connected parts of the app.
en.disableEffect: App features that rely on messages between processes may stop receiving updates or callbacks.

zh-CN.description: 应用代码需要在不同进程间传递消息时，MoliHuan 通用工具库会启动此后台服务。它负责把消息转发给应用中已连接的部分。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖跨进程消息的应用功能可能无法收到更新或回调。

en.description: MoliHuan’s general utility library uses this provider to initialize its helpers when the app starts and to grant controlled access to files through content links.
en.disableEffect: Utility initialization and app features that share or open files through these links may fail.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，MoliHuan 通用工具库会通过此 Provider 初始化工具功能；需要传递文件时，它也会提供受控的内容链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，工具库初始化以及通过这些链接分享或打开文件的功能可能失效。

en.description: MoliHuan’s general utility library opens this transparent helper activity when a task needs an activity context, including permission prompts. It returns task updates to the calling feature.
en.disableEffect: Permission requests and other helper tasks that need this activity may fail, blocking the features that depend on them.

zh-CN.description: MoliHuan 通用工具库需要 Activity 环境执行任务（包括请求权限）时，会打开此透明辅助页面，并把处理结果交回发起功能。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，需要此页面的权限请求和其他辅助任务可能失败，依赖它们的功能也可能无法使用。

en.description: MoliHuan’s general utility library uses this transparent helper activity for tasks that must run through the app’s main process. It returns the task updates to the calling feature.
en.disableEffect: Features that rely on these main-process helper tasks may not complete.

zh-CN.description: MoliHuan 通用工具库会通过此透明辅助页面处理必须经由应用主进程执行的任务，并把处理结果交回发起功能。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖这些主进程辅助任务的功能可能无法完成。

en.description: The Blankj AndroidUtilCode messaging service starts when the app sends a message between processes or another process connects through the app-specific messaging action. It forwards messages to registered parts of the app.
en.disableEffect: App features that use this service will stop receiving messages from other processes.

zh-CN.description: Blankj AndroidUtilCode 的消息服务会在应用发送跨进程消息，或其他进程通过应用专属消息入口连接时启动，并把消息转给应用中已登记的接收方。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此服务的应用功能将无法再接收来自其他进程的消息。

en.description: The Blankj AndroidUtilCode file provider initializes the utility library when the app starts and makes app files available through shareable content links.
en.disableEffect: Sharing or opening files through the utility library may fail, and the library may not initialize as expected.

zh-CN.description: Blankj AndroidUtilCode 的文件提供器会在应用启动时初始化工具库，并通过可分享的内容链接提供应用文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过此工具库分享或打开文件可能失败，工具库也可能无法正常初始化。

en.description: This transparent Blankj AndroidUtilCode Activity runs short tasks that need an Activity, such as showing a permission prompt, and returns the result to the app.
en.disableEffect: Permission requests and other utility operations that rely on this Activity may fail or lose their results.

zh-CN.description: Blankj AndroidUtilCode 会用这个透明 Activity 执行需要界面的短时操作，例如显示权限请求，并把结果交回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此 Activity 的权限请求和其他工具操作可能失败，或无法取得操作结果。

en.description: This is the Blankj AndroidUtilCode main-process variant of its transparent helper Activity; app code can use it for short tasks that need an Activity and return permission or activity results.
en.disableEffect: Utility operations that rely on this main-process Activity may fail or lose their returned results.

zh-CN.description: 这是 Blankj AndroidUtilCode 透明辅助 Activity 的主进程版本；应用可用它执行需要界面的短时操作，并取得权限或其他 Activity 的返回结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此主进程 Activity 的工具操作可能失败，或无法取得返回结果。

en.description: When the TTC Android BLE SDK connects to a nearby supported device, this background Service manages the Bluetooth LE connection, exchanges device data, and reports connection changes to the app.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot connect to or exchange data with supported Bluetooth devices through this SDK.

zh-CN.description: TTC Android BLE SDK 连接附近的兼容设备时，此后台服务会管理蓝牙低功耗连接、收发设备数据，并向应用报告连接变化。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用无法通过此 SDK 连接兼容蓝牙设备或与设备交换数据。

en.description: When a Blitzllama survey has a call-to-action link, this Activity opens the link in an in-app browser and lets the user navigate back.
en.disableEffect: Links in Blitzllama surveys will no longer open inside the app.

zh-CN.description: Blitzllama 调查问卷中的操作链接打开时，此 Activity 会在应用内浏览器中加载链接，并支持返回。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Blitzllama 调查问卷中的链接将无法再在应用内打开。

en.description: The Blue Billywig Native Player SDK opens this screen when a video player or shelf is expanded; it displays the selected player in a full-screen modal and responds to orientation changes.
en.disableEffect: The app’s expanded video player and shelf playback screen will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: Blue Billywig Native Player SDK 在展开视频播放器或内容栏时打开此界面，在全屏弹层中显示所选播放器，并响应屏幕方向变化。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法再打开展开的视频播放器和内容栏播放界面。

en.description: The BlueCats Android SDK starts this service while its beacon engine is active. It initializes Bluetooth scanning, handles beacon-site updates and network changes, and keeps the beacon engine running.
en.disableEffect: Bluetooth beacon discovery and any app actions driven by nearby BlueCats beacons will stop.

zh-CN.description: BlueCats Android SDK 的信标引擎运行时会启动此服务。它负责初始化蓝牙扫描、处理信标站点更新和网络变化，并维持信标引擎运行。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 蓝牙信标发现以及应用中由附近 BlueCats 信标触发的操作将停止。

en.description: The Blueshift SDK opens this Activity when it requests Android notification permission; it handles the system prompt and can direct users to app notification settings after repeated denial.
en.disableEffect: Blueshift cannot request notification permission or guide users to notification settings, so its push notifications may remain unavailable.

zh-CN.description: Blueshift SDK 请求 Android 通知权限时会打开此 Activity；它负责显示系统权限请求，并可在多次拒绝后引导用户前往应用通知设置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Blueshift 将无法请求通知权限或引导用户前往通知设置，因此其推送通知可能无法使用。

en.description: When the Blueshift SDK’s scheduled event-batching alarm fires, this Receiver queues collected events for delivery.
en.disableEffect: Blueshift events will not be queued for delivery when this alarm fires, delaying event reporting.

zh-CN.description: Blueshift SDK 的事件批量处理闹钟触发时，此接收器会将收集到的事件加入发送队列。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 闹钟触发时，Blueshift 事件将无法加入发送队列，事件上报会延迟。

en.description: When Android runs a scheduled Blueshift event job, this Service queues collected events for network delivery.
en.disableEffect: Blueshift’s scheduled event batches will not be queued for delivery.

zh-CN.description: Android 执行 Blueshift 的定时事件任务时，此服务会将收集到的事件加入网络发送队列。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Blueshift 定时收集的事件将无法加入发送队列。

en.description: When Android runs this Blueshift connectivity job, it builds an event batch and synchronizes queued requests if the device is online.
en.disableEffect: Queued Blueshift events and requests will not be flushed by this connectivity job.

zh-CN.description: Android 执行此 Blueshift 网络任务时，服务会整理事件批次，并在设备联网时同步排队的请求。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 此网络任务将无法发送排队中的 Blueshift 事件和请求。

en.description: When Android runs this Blueshift network job, the Service sends requests waiting in the SDK’s delivery queue.
en.disableEffect: Blueshift requests waiting for network delivery may remain queued.

zh-CN.description: Android 执行此 Blueshift 网络任务时，服务会发送 SDK 队列中等待处理的请求。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 等待网络发送的 Blueshift 请求可能会一直留在队列中。

en.description: When the app opens the Blueshift message inbox, this Activity displays the SDK’s inbox screen and its list of messages.
en.disableEffect: The Blueshift in-app message inbox will not open.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开 Blueshift 消息收件箱时，此 Activity 会显示 SDK 的收件箱界面和消息列表。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Blueshift 应用内消息收件箱将无法打开。

en.description: When a user opens a Blueshift push notification or taps one of its actions, this Activity processes the selected action and then closes.
en.disableEffect: Blueshift notification taps will no longer open their linked app content or be recorded by the SDK.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 Blueshift 推送通知或点击其中的操作时，此 Activity 会处理所选操作，然后关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Blueshift 通知点击将无法再打开关联的应用内容，也不会被 SDK 记录。

en.description: On Android versions where it is registered, this Blueshift Receiver runs after a connectivity-change broadcast and retries queued network requests.
en.disableEffect: Blueshift queued requests will not be retried when network connectivity changes.

zh-CN.description: 在注册此接收器的 Android 版本上，Blueshift 会在收到网络变化广播后运行它，并重试队列中的网络请求。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 网络连接变化时，Blueshift 队列中的请求将不会被重试。

en.description: When an older Blueshift rich push uses an alert dialog, this Activity shows the message and lets the user open the app or dismiss the alert.
en.disableEffect: Blueshift alert-style push messages will no longer show their open and dismiss dialog.

zh-CN.description: 旧版 Blueshift 富媒体推送使用提醒对话框时，此 Activity 会显示消息，并允许用户打开应用或关闭提醒。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Blueshift 提醒式推送将不再显示打开或关闭消息的对话框。

en.description: When the Blueshift SDK receives a carousel-image change or notification-delete task, this Service updates the push carousel or removes its cached images.
en.disableEffect: Blueshift carousel notifications will not update their image, and deleted notifications may leave cached media behind.

zh-CN.description: Blueshift SDK 收到轮播图片切换或通知删除任务时，此服务会更新推送轮播内容或清除缓存图片。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Blueshift 轮播通知将无法切换图片，已删除通知的缓存媒体也可能残留。

en.description: When the app-specific Blueshift scheduled-push broadcast arrives, this Receiver reads the scheduled message and asks the SDK to display it.
en.disableEffect: Locally scheduled Blueshift notifications will not be displayed.

zh-CN.description: 应用专属的 Blueshift 定时推送广播到达时，此接收器会读取预定消息并交由 SDK 显示。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 本地定时的 Blueshift 通知将不会显示。

en.description: After a supported boot or reboot broadcast, this blukii Receiver restores saved discovery settings and restarts nearby-device discovery when those settings exist.
en.disableEffect: blukii background device discovery will not resume automatically after a reboot.

zh-CN.description: 收到受支持的开机或重启广播后，如果保存了发现设置，blukii 接收器会恢复设置并重新开始附近设备发现。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 重启后，blukii 将无法自动恢复后台设备发现。

en.description: When Android runs a scheduled blukii discovery job, this Service starts a worker that scans for nearby devices using the saved scan settings.
en.disableEffect: Scheduled blukii nearby-device scans will stop running.

zh-CN.description: Android 执行 blukii 定时发现任务时，此服务会按已保存的扫描设置启动附近设备扫描。
zh-CN.disableEffect: blukii 定时附近设备扫描将停止运行。

en.description: When the blukii SDK starts nearby-device discovery, this foreground location Service hosts the scan worker and keeps the discovery session active.
en.disableEffect: blukii foreground nearby-device scanning and its discovery results will stop.

zh-CN.description: blukii SDK 开始发现附近设备时，此前台定位服务会运行扫描任务并维持发现会话。
zh-CN.disableEffect: blukii 前台附近设备扫描及其发现结果将停止。

en.description: When Google Nearby delivers a subscribed-device trigger, this blukii Receiver checks location access and starts the discovery listener for a valid nearby trigger.
en.disableEffect: Nearby-device triggers will no longer start a blukii discovery session.

zh-CN.description: Google Nearby 发送已订阅设备的触发消息时，此 blukii 接收器会检查定位权限，并在触发有效时开始设备发现。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 附近设备触发消息将无法再启动 blukii 发现会话。

en.description: When the older blukii client starts a scan, this Service performs Bluetooth LE scans, collects nearby-device data and reports the results to the app.
en.disableEffect: The older blukii Bluetooth scan and the app’s nearby-device results will stop.

zh-CN.description: 旧版 blukii 客户端开始扫描时，此服务会执行蓝牙低功耗扫描、收集附近设备信息并将结果交给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 旧版 blukii 蓝牙扫描及应用的附近设备结果将停止。

en.description: When its scheduled network job runs, this blukii Service uploads saved beacon battery and activity statistics to the blukii cloud.
en.disableEffect: blukii will stop uploading beacon battery and activity statistics.

zh-CN.description: blukii 定时网络任务运行时，此服务会将保存的信标电量和活动统计信息上传到 blukii 云端。
zh-CN.disableEffect: blukii 将停止上传信标电量和活动统计信息。

en.description: When a BNC GIMAC call moves out of its main screen, this Activity keeps the call view connected to the floating meeting window. It lets the user return to the video call after switching to another app.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it can prevent the call from switching cleanly to or back from the floating view.

zh-CN.description: 当 BNC GIMAC 通话切换到浮动会议窗口时，此 Activity 会维持通话画面的连接，方便用户切换应用后回到视频通话。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，通话可能无法正常切换到浮动窗口，或无法从浮窗返回通话界面。

en.description: When a BNC GIMAC call is sent to the background, this Activity keeps the call page linked to its floating video window and restores the call when the user returns. It also updates the window as the call changes.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it can stop the call from staying available in a floating window when the user leaves the call screen.

zh-CN.description: 当 BNC GIMAC 通话进入后台时，此 Activity 会把通话页面与浮动视频窗口保持连接，并在用户返回时恢复通话画面；通话状态变化时也会更新浮窗。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户离开通话页面时，通话可能无法继续显示在浮动窗口中。

en.description: When the app opens an embedded Flutter screen from BNC GIMAC, this Activity provides the page frame and applies the app's status bar and back-button behavior. Disabling it can prevent screens built on this base from opening.
en.disableEffect: BNC GIMAC pages that use this screen base may fail to open or return correctly.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开 BNC GIMAC 的嵌入式 Flutter 页面时，此 Activity 提供页面基础，并处理状态栏样式和返回操作。停用后，依赖此基础的页面可能无法打开。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此页面基础的 BNC GIMAC 界面可能无法打开或正常返回。

en.description: When BNC GIMAC opens a transparent Flutter screen over the existing app view, this Activity supplies the screen base and transparent status-bar styling. Disabling it can prevent those screens from appearing.
en.disableEffect: Transparent BNC GIMAC pages, including call-related pages, may no longer open.

zh-CN.description: BNC GIMAC 在现有应用界面上打开透明 Flutter 页面时，此 Activity 提供页面基础和透明状态栏样式。停用后，这些页面可能无法显示。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 包括通话界面在内的透明 BNC GIMAC 页面可能无法打开。

en.description: When a native screen opens a BNC GIMAC Flutter page and expects a result, this Activity displays the page and returns the result when it closes. Disabling it can break that handoff.
en.disableEffect: The app may be unable to open the requested Flutter page or receive its result.

zh-CN.description: 原生界面打开 BNC GIMAC 的 Flutter 页面并需要返回结果时，此 Activity 会显示页面，并在关闭时把结果交还给原界面。停用后，这种页面跳转和结果返回可能中断。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用可能无法打开所需的 Flutter 页面，或无法收到页面返回的结果。

en.description: When a native screen opens a transparent BNC GIMAC Flutter page, this Activity shows it over the existing screen and closes back to the caller. Disabling it can interrupt that navigation flow.
en.disableEffect: The app may be unable to display or close the transparent Flutter page correctly.

zh-CN.description: 原生界面打开透明的 BNC GIMAC Flutter 页面时，此 Activity 会在现有界面上显示页面，并在结束后返回原界面。停用后，这种页面跳转可能中断。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用可能无法正常显示或关闭透明 Flutter 页面。

en.description: When a BNC GIMAC meeting is moved to a floating view, this Service draws the call window and renders the meeting's video streams over other apps. Disabling it stops the floating meeting view.
en.disableEffect: The user may lose the floating video-call view while switching to another app.

zh-CN.description: BNC GIMAC 会议切换到浮动窗口时，此 Service 会显示通话窗口，并在其他应用上方渲染会议视频。停用后，浮动会议画面将无法使用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户切换到其他应用时，可能无法继续查看浮动视频通话。

en.description: When a BNC GIMAC call continues after the user leaves its screen, this Service shows a movable call window with video and a way to return to the call. Disabling it stops calls from remaining visible in a floating window.
en.disableEffect: The user may lose the floating call window and have trouble returning to a call in progress.

zh-CN.description: 用户离开 BNC GIMAC 通话界面后，此 Service 会显示可移动的通话浮窗和视频画面，并允许用户回到通话。停用后，通话无法继续以浮窗形式显示。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户可能看不到通话浮窗，也可能不便返回正在进行的通话。

en.description: BNC GIMAC screens and call features use this Provider to read and save shared settings. Disabling it can prevent those features from loading or storing settings they rely on.
en.disableEffect: BNC GIMAC screens may lose saved preferences or fail when they try to read or update them.

zh-CN.description: BNC GIMAC 的界面和通话功能通过此 Provider 读取和保存共享设置。停用后，相关功能可能无法读取或保存所需设置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: BNC GIMAC 界面可能无法读取已保存的偏好设置，或在更新设置时失败。

en.description: The RevOS Bolt Core SDK opens this screen from the active-bookings area and loads the user's current charger bookings. Selecting a booking opens its charging controls.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot review or open active bookings from this list.

zh-CN.description: RevOS Bolt Core SDK 会在用户打开进行中的预订时加载当前充电预订；点选某项可进入充电控制页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法查看或打开这份进行中的预订列表。

en.description: The RevOS Bolt Core SDK opens this form when a user adds a bank account for charger payments. It collects the account, bank, and account-holder details and submits them to Bolt.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot add a bank account for Bolt payments or payouts.

zh-CN.description: RevOS Bolt Core SDK 会在用户添加充电业务收款银行账户时打开此表单，收集账户、银行和持有人信息并提交给 Bolt。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法为 Bolt 充电业务添加银行账户。

en.description: The RevOS Bolt Core SDK opens the coupon list from a charger-booking checkout. It loads available coupons and returns the selected coupon to the booking screen.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot choose a coupon during charger checkout.

zh-CN.description: RevOS Bolt Core SDK 会在充电预订结账时显示可用优惠券，并将用户选中的优惠券返回预订页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在充电结账时选择优惠券。

en.description: The RevOS Bolt Core SDK briefly shows its “Powered by RevOS” startup screen when the logged-in user launches Bolt. It then opens the main Bolt screen.
en.disableEffect: The SDK launch flow may stop before the main Bolt screen opens.

zh-CN.description: RevOS Bolt Core SDK 会在已登录用户启动 Bolt 时短暂显示“Powered by RevOS”启动画面，随后打开 Bolt 主界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: SDK 的启动流程可能会停在主界面打开之前。

en.description: The RevOS Bolt Core SDK opens this checkout after a user selects a charger to book. The user chooses a charging duration, applies a coupon, and confirms payment; a successful booking leads to charger controls.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot book a charging session or continue from checkout to its controls.

zh-CN.description: RevOS Bolt Core SDK 会在用户选定充电桩后打开预订结账页。用户可选择充电时长、使用优惠券并付款；预订成功后可进入充电控制页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法预订充电时段，也无法从结账页继续进入充电控制。

en.description: The RevOS Bolt Core SDK loads a user's past charger bookings and shows booking counts and expense charts for a selected period. Users can open booking details from the list.
en.disableEffect: Users lose access to their Bolt booking history and its expense summary.

zh-CN.description: RevOS Bolt Core SDK 会加载用户过去的充电预订，并按所选时间段显示预订数量和支出图表；用户还可从列表打开预订详情。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法查看 Bolt 预订历史及其支出汇总。

en.description: The RevOS Bolt Core SDK opens this store page for ordering a charger. It loads charger models, lets users set a quantity and shipping location, and submits the order and payment details.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot place charger orders through the Bolt store.

zh-CN.description: RevOS Bolt Core SDK 会打开充电桩购买页面，加载型号，让用户选择数量和配送地点，并提交订单及付款信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 Bolt 商店购买充电桩。

en.description: The RevOS Bolt Core SDK shows links for buying a charger from Amazon or Flipkart. Tapping either retailer button opens its shopping page.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open the linked charger listings from Bolt.

zh-CN.description: RevOS Bolt Core SDK 会显示在 Amazon 或 Flipkart 购买充电桩的入口；点按后会打开对应的购物页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法从 Bolt 打开这些充电桩商品页面。

en.description: The RevOS Bolt Core SDK opens this screen for an active charger booking. It connects to the charger over Bluetooth, shows charging progress and energy use, and lets the user end the booking or call the owner.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot connect to or monitor the booked charger, or end the session through Bolt.

zh-CN.description: RevOS Bolt Core SDK 会为进行中的充电预订打开此页面，通过蓝牙连接充电桩，显示充电进度和用电量，并允许用户结束预订或联系桩主。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 Bolt 连接或监控已预订的充电桩，也无法结束充电。

en.description: The RevOS Bolt Core SDK opens this screen after a user scans a charger to sync its meter readings. It compares the current and previous readings with the booking record and updates the session data.
en.disableEffect: Charger readings may not be synchronized with Bolt booking records.

zh-CN.description: RevOS Bolt Core SDK 会在用户扫描充电桩并同步电量读数时打开此页面，将当前和上次读数与预订记录对照并更新会话数据。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 充电桩读数可能无法同步到 Bolt 预订记录。

en.description: The RevOS Bolt Core SDK opens this screen when a user scans a charger to update its software. It downloads the update file and shows progress while sending the update to the charger over Bluetooth.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot install firmware updates on the charger through Bolt.

zh-CN.description: RevOS Bolt Core SDK 会在用户扫描充电桩以更新软件时打开此页面，下载更新文件并显示通过蓝牙向充电桩传送更新的进度。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 Bolt 为充电桩安装固件更新。

en.description: The RevOS Bolt Core SDK shows Bolt support phone and email details. Tapping them opens the phone dialer or an email app.
en.disableEffect: Users lose the in-app support contact page and its call and email shortcuts.

zh-CN.description: RevOS Bolt Core SDK 会显示 Bolt 客服电话和邮箱；点按后可打开拨号器或邮件应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过应用内的客服页面查看联系方式或快速拨打电话、发送邮件。

en.description: The RevOS Bolt Core SDK loads charger earnings for the chosen time period and displays income, expenses, energy use, booking counts, and charts. Users open it from the profile area.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot view their Bolt earnings and charging summary.

zh-CN.description: RevOS Bolt Core SDK 会加载所选时间段的充电收益，并显示收入、支出、用电量、预订数和图表；用户可从个人资料页面打开此功能。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法查看 Bolt 收益和充电汇总。

en.description: The RevOS Bolt Core SDK opens this form when a charger owner edits a listing. It lets the owner change the charger location, use and pricing terms, payment account, and contact details, then submit the changes.
en.disableEffect: Owners cannot update the charger listing and its payment or contact details through Bolt.

zh-CN.description: RevOS Bolt Core SDK 会在桩主编辑充电桩信息时打开此表单，可修改位置、使用方式、价格、收款账户和联系人信息，并提交更改。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 桩主将无法通过 Bolt 更新充电桩信息、收款设置或联系人资料。

en.description: The RevOS Bolt Core SDK asks for a phone number or email during checkout if the user's profile is missing either one. After submission, it saves the contact details for that payment and returns checkout details to the booking flow.
en.disableEffect: Users may be unable to provide the contact details required to continue charger payment.

zh-CN.description: 如果用户资料中缺少电话号码或邮箱，RevOS Bolt Core SDK 会在结账时要求补充。提交后，它会为本次付款保存联系方式，并将结账信息返回预订流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户可能无法提供继续充电付款所需的联系方式。

en.description: The RevOS Bolt Core SDK opens this main screen after Bolt starts. It provides the search, scan, and profile sections, loads the user's chargers and bookings, and shows active-booking access.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open the main Bolt charging screens or reach its search, scan, and profile sections.

zh-CN.description: RevOS Bolt Core SDK 会在 Bolt 启动后打开主界面，提供搜索、扫描和个人资料页面，加载用户的充电桩与预订，并显示进行中的预订入口。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法进入 Bolt 主界面及其搜索、扫描和个人资料功能。

en.description: The RevOS Bolt Core SDK loads the user's registered chargers into a management list. From this screen, users can add a charger by scanning its QR code or open its details.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot view or register chargers from the Bolt charger list.

zh-CN.description: RevOS Bolt Core SDK 会将用户登记的充电桩加载到管理列表。用户可在此扫描二维码添加充电桩，或打开已有充电桩的详情。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 Bolt 充电桩列表查看或登记充电桩。

en.description: The RevOS Bolt Core SDK shows earnings and charging statistics for a selected charger, including income, expenses, energy use, and bookings over a chosen period.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot view the selected charger's earnings and usage summary.

zh-CN.description: RevOS Bolt Core SDK 会显示所选充电桩在指定时间段内的收益和充电统计，包括收入、支出、用电量和预订数。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法查看该充电桩的收益和使用情况汇总。

en.description: The RevOS Bolt Core SDK loads the user's previous charger purchases and displays them in an order list. A support button can open the phone dialer.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot review their Bolt charger purchase orders from this screen.

zh-CN.description: RevOS Bolt Core SDK 会加载用户过去购买充电桩的订单并显示列表；客服按钮可打开拨号器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在此查看 Bolt 充电桩购买订单。

en.description: The RevOS Bolt Core SDK shows the saved bank-account details used for charger payments. Users can review the information or remove the account.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot review or remove a saved charger-payment account in Bolt.

zh-CN.description: RevOS Bolt Core SDK 会显示用于充电业务收款的已保存银行账户信息，用户可查看或删除账户。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在 Bolt 中查看或删除已保存的收款账户。

en.description: The RevOS Bolt Core SDK loads the user's saved bank accounts and displays them in a list. Users can add an account or select one for a charger listing.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot view, add, or select a bank account for Bolt charger payments.

zh-CN.description: RevOS Bolt Core SDK 会加载并显示用户已保存的银行账户；用户可添加账户，或为充电桩选择收款账户。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法查看、添加或为 Bolt 充电桩选择银行账户。

en.description: The RevOS Bolt Core SDK creates and displays a QR code for a selected charger's ID. Users open it from the charger list.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot display the charger ID QR code from the Bolt charger list.

zh-CN.description: RevOS Bolt Core SDK 会为所选充电桩编号生成并显示二维码，用户可从充电桩列表打开。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法从 Bolt 充电桩列表显示该充电桩的编号二维码。

en.description: The RevOS Bolt Core SDK guides an owner through setting up a new charger. It collects charger and location details, connects to the device, and submits its registration.
en.disableEffect: Owners cannot register a new charger through Bolt.

zh-CN.description: RevOS Bolt Core SDK 会引导桩主登记新充电桩，收集设备和位置信息、连接设备并提交登记。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 桩主将无法通过 Bolt 登记新充电桩。

en.description: The RevOS Bolt Core SDK opens the camera scanner when an owner starts adding a charger. It reads the QR code on the charger box and looks up that device for registration.
en.disableEffect: Owners cannot scan a new charger's QR code to register it.

zh-CN.description: RevOS Bolt Core SDK 会在桩主添加充电桩时打开相机扫描器，读取包装盒上的二维码并查找待登记设备。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 桩主将无法扫描新充电桩的二维码并登记设备。

en.description: The RevOS Bolt Core SDK scans a charger QR code when the user starts syncing its meter readings from a booking or earnings list. It then opens the charger-data sync screen.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot start a charger-reading sync by scanning its QR code.

zh-CN.description: 用户从预订或收益列表启动电量同步时，RevOS Bolt Core SDK 会扫描充电桩二维码，然后打开设备数据同步页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过扫描二维码启动充电桩读数同步。

en.description: The RevOS Bolt Core SDK scans a charger QR code when the owner starts a software update. It identifies the charger and opens its update screen.
en.disableEffect: Owners cannot start a charger software update by scanning its QR code.

zh-CN.description: 桩主启动软件更新时，RevOS Bolt Core SDK 会扫描充电桩二维码、识别设备并打开更新页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 桩主将无法通过扫描二维码启动充电桩软件更新。

en.description: The RevOS Bolt Core SDK shows the service-provider details assigned to a charger. Owners can change the provider name and submit the update.
en.disableEffect: Owners cannot view or update a charger's service-provider details in Bolt.

zh-CN.description: RevOS Bolt Core SDK 会显示充电桩关联的服务商信息，桩主可修改服务商名称并提交更新。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 桩主将无法在 Bolt 中查看或更新充电桩的服务商信息。

en.description: The RevOS Bolt Core SDK displays a map while an owner chooses a charger's location. Confirming returns the chosen map coordinates to the charger form.
en.disableEffect: Owners cannot set or correct the charger's map location through this flow.

zh-CN.description: RevOS Bolt Core SDK 会在桩主选择充电桩位置时显示地图；确认后将所选坐标返回充电桩表单。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 桩主将无法通过此流程设置或修正充电桩地图位置。

en.description: The RevOS Bolt Core SDK loads and lists the user's active charger-subscription plans. Users open it from the profile area.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot review their Bolt subscription plans from this screen.

zh-CN.description: RevOS Bolt Core SDK 会加载并列出用户当前有效的充电订阅计划，用户可从个人资料页面打开。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在此查看 Bolt 订阅计划。

en.description: The RevOS Bolt Core SDK loads a selected charger's details, including its location, usage type, prices, payment account, and contact information. Owners can open the edit form from this screen.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot view or edit the selected charger's listing details through Bolt.

zh-CN.description: RevOS Bolt Core SDK 会加载所选充电桩的详情，包括位置、使用方式、价格、收款账户和联系人信息；桩主可从此页面进入编辑表单。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 Bolt 查看或编辑所选充电桩的资料。

en.description: The RevOS Bolt Core SDK shows instructions for connecting to a charger's Wi-Fi hotspot and can open Android Wi-Fi settings. The charger name is shown when supplied by the setup flow.
en.disableEffect: Users lose the guided hotspot-connection steps and may not be able to finish charger setup.

zh-CN.description: RevOS Bolt Core SDK 会说明如何连接充电桩的 Wi-Fi 热点，并可打开 Android Wi-Fi 设置；如果设置流程提供了热点名称，页面也会显示该名称。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将失去热点连接指引，可能无法完成充电桩设置。

en.description: The RevOS Bolt Core SDK uses this screen to show success, warning, error, or information messages after Bolt actions. It displays the supplied text and may show a button or close automatically.
en.disableEffect: Users may not see whether a booking, account change, or charger action succeeded or failed.

zh-CN.description: RevOS Bolt Core SDK 会在 Bolt 操作后用此页面显示成功、警告、错误或提示信息，并可显示按钮或定时关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户可能无法得知预订、账户更改或充电桩操作是否成功。

en.description: After the RevOS Bolt Core SDK confirms a charger booking, it briefly shows this screen and then opens the active charger controls with the booking details. The handoff is used by host apps that need to enter the charging screen.
en.disableEffect: The booking flow may finish without opening charger controls, leaving users unable to manage the session there.

zh-CN.description: RevOS Bolt Core SDK 确认充电预订后会短暂显示此页面，再携带预订信息打开充电控制；需要跳转到充电页面的宿主应用会使用此交接流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 预订流程可能无法继续打开充电控制页面，用户将无法在该页面管理会话。

en.description: The RevOS Bolt Core SDK opens Cashfree's checkout with the payment token and parameters supplied by the booking or wallet flow. It returns the transaction result to Bolt.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot complete or return the result of a Cashfree payment in this flow.

zh-CN.description: RevOS Bolt Core SDK 会使用预订或钱包流程提供的付款令牌和参数打开 Cashfree 收银台，并将交易结果返回 Bolt。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在此流程中完成 Cashfree 付款或将结果返回 Bolt。

en.description: The RevOS Bolt Core SDK opens this screen for a booked charger session. It connects to the charger over Bluetooth, shows live charging and energy information, and lets the user manage or end the booking.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot connect to or control the booked charger session from Bolt.

zh-CN.description: RevOS Bolt Core SDK 会为已预订的充电会话打开此页面，通过蓝牙连接充电桩、显示实时充电和电量信息，并允许用户管理或结束预订。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 Bolt 连接或控制已预订的充电桩。

en.description: The RevOS Bolt Core SDK opens this payment screen for booking or wallet flows. It routes prepaid bookings to payment choices and postpaid bookings to their final charge summary.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot choose or continue through the Bolt booking-payment flow.

zh-CN.description: RevOS Bolt Core SDK 会在预订或钱包付款流程中打开此页面；预付预订会进入付款方式选择，后付预订会进入最终费用页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法选择付款方式或继续 Bolt 预订付款流程。

en.description: When RevOS Bolt BLE discovery needs access to find nearby chargers, it opens a permission prompt for location and Bluetooth scanning. Granting access lets the discovery flow continue.
en.disableEffect: The required prompt cannot be shown, so nearby charger discovery may fail when access has not already been granted.

zh-CN.description: RevOS Bolt BLE 在查找附近充电桩需要权限时会打开此提示，请求位置和蓝牙扫描权限；获准后即可继续搜索。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 如果用户尚未授予相关权限，搜索附近充电桩可能无法继续。

en.description: The RevOS Bolt Core SDK opens this prompt when a charger firmware update needs storage access to download its update file. It requests permission and reports whether it was granted.
en.disableEffect: Users may be unable to download a charger firmware file and install the update.

zh-CN.description: 充电桩固件更新需要存储权限下载更新文件时，RevOS Bolt Core SDK 会打开此提示并报告用户是否授权。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户可能无法下载充电桩固件文件并安装更新。

en.description: Booking PerfSuite starts this Provider early in the app process and records a timestamp used to measure app startup time.
en.disableEffect: Booking PerfSuite may miss its early app-start timestamp, leaving startup-time measurements incomplete.

zh-CN.description: Booking PerfSuite 会在应用进程启动早期运行此提供器，并记录用于测量应用启动时间的时间戳。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Booking PerfSuite 可能无法取得应用启动早期的时间戳，导致启动耗时测量不完整。

en.description: The Tianjiu Cloud live SDK uses this shared page foundation for common navigation, layout, status-bar, permission, and network-change behavior. It has no standalone screen of its own.
en.disableEffect: There is no separate screen to lose; the concrete pages continue to use the shared behavior.

zh-CN.description: 天九云直播 SDK 的各个页面会共用这套基础界面行为，包括导航、布局、状态栏、权限和网络变化处理；它本身没有独立页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 没有单独的页面会消失，具体页面仍会使用这套共享行为。

en.description: The Tianjiu Cloud live SDK opens web pages inside the app when a page needs to be shown, using the supplied page title.
en.disableEffect: Pages opened through this in-app web screen will no longer load.

zh-CN.description: 天九云直播 SDK 会在应用需要展示网页时，在应用内打开相应页面并显示指定标题。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过此应用内网页页面打开的内容将无法加载。

en.description: The Tianjiu Cloud live SDK shows a prompt before a live stream moves to a floating window. When overlay permission is available, it starts the floating playback service for that stream.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot complete this prompt and permission flow to move a live stream into a floating window.

zh-CN.description: 天九云直播 SDK 会在直播切换到悬浮窗前显示提示；获得悬浮窗权限后，它会启动该直播的悬浮播放服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法完成此提示和权限流程，直播也无法切换到悬浮窗。

en.description: The Tianjiu Cloud live SDK plays a live stream in a movable video window over other apps. Users can close the window or return to the full live page.
en.disableEffect: A live stream cannot continue in this floating window while the user uses another app.

zh-CN.description: 天九云直播 SDK 会在其他应用上方的可移动视频窗口中播放直播，用户可以关闭窗口或返回完整直播页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户切换到其他应用后，直播无法继续显示在此悬浮窗中。

en.description: The Watch Connection Library receives a message sent from a paired Wear OS watch and passes it to the phone app.
en.disableEffect: The app will no longer receive messages from the watch if this service is disabled.

zh-CN.description: Watch Connection Library 会接收配对的 Wear OS 手表发来的消息，并转交给手机应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用将无法接收手表发来的消息。

en.description: The Watch Connection Library receives messages sent from a paired Wear OS watch and passes them to the phone app.
en.disableEffect: The app will no longer receive messages from the watch if this service is disabled.

zh-CN.description: Watch Connection Library 会接收配对的 Wear OS 手表发来的消息，并转交给手机应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用将无法接收手表发来的消息。

en.description: The Watch Connection Library receives messages sent from a paired Wear OS watch and passes them to the phone app.
en.disableEffect: The app will no longer receive messages from the watch if this service is disabled.

zh-CN.description: Watch Connection Library 会接收配对的 Wear OS 手表发来的消息，并转交给手机应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用将无法接收手表发来的消息。

en.description: When the Botnerd UI library opens a web link, this Activity loads the supplied page in an in-app browser and lets the user go back or close it.
en.disableEffect: App pages that rely on this screen will no longer load their web content.

zh-CN.description: Botnerd UI 库打开网页链接时，此 Activity 会在应用内浏览器中加载页面，并允许用户返回或关闭页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此界面的应用页面将无法再加载网页内容。

en.description: The wxlibowen job library opens a QR scanner; users can scan with the camera or choose an image, and the decoded text is returned to the app.
en.disableEffect: The app's QR-code scanning and result flow will stop working.

zh-CN.description: wxlibowen job library 会打开二维码扫描页面，用户可用相机扫描或选择图片识别二维码，再把文本结果交给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用的二维码扫描和结果返回功能将无法使用。

en.description: Box (Box Android Browse SDK) opens this screen to browse and search Box files, then returns the selected file to the app.
en.disableEffect: Apps that use Box file selection will no longer be able to open this screen or receive a selected file.

zh-CN.description: Box（Box Android Browse SDK）在用户浏览或搜索 Box 文件时打开此界面，并在用户选择文件后将文件返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖 Box 文件选择的应用将无法打开此界面或取得用户选中的文件。

en.description: Box (Box Android Browse SDK) lets users browse or create Box folders and return the chosen folder to the app.
en.disableEffect: Apps will not be able to browse, create, or select folders through the Box interface.

zh-CN.description: Box（Box Android Browse SDK）让用户浏览或创建 Box 文件夹，并将选中的文件夹返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法通过 Box 界面浏览、创建或选择文件夹。

en.description: Box (Box Android Browse SDK) opens a filter screen for file search results so users can adjust which results are shown.
en.disableEffect: Box search will no longer be able to open the result-filter screen.

zh-CN.description: Box（Box Android Browse SDK）在文件搜索时显示结果筛选界面，让用户调整显示哪些结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Box 搜索将无法打开结果筛选界面。

en.description: Box Android SDK shows this error screen when access is blocked by an IP restriction; the user can dismiss it with the OK button.
en.disableEffect: When a Box request reaches this error state, the SDK may not be able to show or handle its dedicated explanation screen.

zh-CN.description: Box Android SDK 在访问因 IP 限制而被拦截时显示此错误界面，用户可点“确定”关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Box 请求遇到此错误时，SDK 可能无法显示或处理专用说明界面。

en.description: Box Android SDK opens Box sign-in or consent in a web page or the Box app, then returns the authorization result to the host app.

en.description: Box (Box Android Preview SDK) opens files for preview and loads the file or folder information needed to show documents, images, audio, and video.
