zh-CN.description: Box（Box Android Preview SDK）打开 Box 文件供用户预览，并读取显示文档、图片、音频或视频所需的信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法通过此界面预览 Box 文件。

en.description: Box (Box Android Preview SDK) uses this service to keep audio or video playback connected while a file preview is open.
en.disableEffect: Audio or video playback in Box file previews may stop or lose its playback service.

zh-CN.description: Box（Box Android Preview SDK）在文件预览播放音频或视频时使用此服务维持播放会话。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Box 文件预览中的音频或视频播放可能中断，或失去播放服务。

en.description: Box (Box Android Share SDK) shows the people who collaborate on a Box file or folder so users can review their access.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to manage collaborators through the Box screen.

zh-CN.description: Box（Box Android Share SDK）显示 Box 文件或文件夹的协作者，供用户查看其访问权限。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 Box 界面管理协作者。

en.description: Box (Box Android Share SDK) opens the invitation screen where users can add collaborators to a Box file or folder.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to invite collaborators through Box.

zh-CN.description: Box（Box Android Share SDK）打开邀请界面，让用户为 Box 文件或文件夹添加协作者。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 Box 邀请协作者。

en.description: Box (Box Android Share SDK) lets users review and change who can access a file through its shared link.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to change shared-link access through Box.

zh-CN.description: Box（Box Android Share SDK）让用户查看并调整哪些人可以通过共享链接访问文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 Box 修改共享链接的访问范围。

en.description: Box (Box Android Share SDK) opens the shared-link screen for a file and provides access to its sharing settings.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to view or edit Box shared links through this screen.

zh-CN.description: Box（Box Android Share SDK）打开文件的共享链接界面，并提供相应的分享设置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此界面查看或修改 Box 共享链接。

en.description: Braintree's payment SDK uses this screen when a checkout returns from a web browser. It passes the return result back to the app so the payment can continue.
en.disableEffect: Payments that hand off to a browser may not be able to return to or finish in the app.

zh-CN.description: Braintree 支付 SDK 会在结账流程从浏览器返回时打开此页面，并把返回结果交还应用以继续支付。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要跳转浏览器的支付流程可能无法返回应用或完成支付。

en.description: Braintree Drop-in opens its ready-made checkout screen, handles the payment-method selection, and returns the checkout result to the app.
en.disableEffect: Apps that start checkout with Braintree Drop-in will not be able to complete that payment flow.

zh-CN.description: Braintree Drop-in 打开现成的付款界面，处理用户选择付款方式的流程，并将结果返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过 Braintree Drop-in 发起的付款将无法完成。

en.description: Braintree's Google Pay module opens Google Pay for the payment request supplied by the app and returns the wallet result.
en.disableEffect: Google Pay payments in this Braintree flow will not be able to complete.

zh-CN.description: Braintree Google Pay 模块根据应用提供的付款请求打开 Google Pay，并将钱包付款结果返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 此 Braintree 流程中的 Google Pay 付款将无法完成。

en.description: Braintree's Google Pay module opens Google Pay for the payment request supplied by the app and returns the wallet result.
en.disableEffect: Google Pay payments in this Braintree flow will not be able to complete.

zh-CN.description: Braintree Google Pay 模块根据应用提供的付款请求打开 Google Pay，并将钱包付款结果返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 此 Braintree 流程中的 Google Pay 付款将无法完成。

en.description: Braintree's older 3D Secure flow starts the card issuer's verification challenge and returns its validation result to checkout.
en.disableEffect: Payments that require 3D Secure verification may not complete.

zh-CN.description: Braintree 的旧版 3D Secure 流程会启动发卡行的验证挑战，并将验证结果返回付款流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要 3D Secure 验证的付款可能无法完成。

en.description: Braintree's Google Pay module opens Google Pay to handle a payment request and returns the user's wallet choice to the app.
en.disableEffect: Google Pay payments in this Braintree flow will not be able to complete.

zh-CN.description: Braintree Google Pay 模块打开 Google Pay 处理付款请求，并将用户的钱包选择结果返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 此 Braintree 流程中的 Google Pay 付款将无法完成。

en.description: Braintree Android SDK sends queued SDK analytics to Braintree's analytics endpoint in the background.
en.disableEffect: Braintree analytics events will no longer be sent; the payment flow itself does not use this service.

zh-CN.description: Braintree Android SDK 在后台向 Braintree 分析服务发送排队的 SDK 分析事件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Braintree 分析事件将不再发送；付款流程本身不使用此服务。

en.description: Braintree's 3D Secure module presents the card issuer's verification challenge and returns the validated result to checkout.
en.disableEffect: Payments that require the issuer's 3D Secure challenge may not complete.

zh-CN.description: Braintree 3D Secure 模块显示发卡行的验证挑战，并将验证结果返回付款流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要发卡行 3D Secure 验证的付款可能无法完成。

en.description: Braintree v.zero Android SDK opens the card issuer's 3D Secure verification page and returns its response to the payment flow.
en.disableEffect: Payments that require web-based 3D Secure verification may not complete.

zh-CN.description: Braintree v.zero Android SDK 打开发卡行的网页 3D Secure 验证页面，并将验证结果返回付款流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要网页式 3D Secure 验证的付款可能无法完成。

en.description: Khoros Brand Messenger uses this provider to share camera output and message attachments through file links with approved apps. It supports the messenger’s attachment and image flows.
en.disableEffect: Capturing, opening, or sharing image attachments in Brand Messenger may fail.

zh-CN.description: Khoros Brand Messenger 通过此组件向获准的应用提供相机拍摄内容和消息附件的文件链接，以支持附件及图片操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Brand Messenger 中拍摄、打开或分享图片附件的操作可能失败。

en.description: When the device starts or network connectivity returns, Brand Messenger schedules a background message update for signed-in users. It also forwards network changes to the messaging service.
en.disableEffect: Brand Messenger may reconnect or refresh messages more slowly after a reboot or network change.

zh-CN.description: 设备启动或网络恢复时，Brand Messenger 会为已登录用户安排后台消息更新，并把网络变化通知消息服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 设备重启或网络变化后，Brand Messenger 可能无法及时重新连接或刷新消息。

en.description: When the device clock or time zone is changed manually, Brand Messenger adjusts the time information it uses and schedules a background update.
en.disableEffect: Message timestamps or background updates may remain out of sync after a manual clock or time-zone change.

zh-CN.description: 手动修改设备时间或时区时，Brand Messenger 会调整消息时间并安排后台更新。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 手动修改时间或时区后，消息时间或后台更新可能无法及时同步。

en.description: Khoros Brand Messenger opens this screen when a user attaches a photo or video to a conversation. It lets the user choose media and returns the files to the chat for sending.
en.disableEffect: Users may not be able to select or send photo and video attachments in a conversation.

zh-CN.description: 用户要在对话中添加照片或视频时，Khoros Brand Messenger 会打开此界面。用户可在此选择媒体文件，再交回聊天界面发送。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户可能无法在对话中选择或发送照片和视频附件。

en.description: Khoros Brand Messenger opens its location picker as a map around the current position with a movable marker. Pressing the send button returns the chosen coordinates to the chat.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to choose and share a location through this messenger screen.

zh-CN.description: Khoros Brand Messenger 的位置选择界面会显示当前位置附近的地图和可移动标记。按下发送按钮后，所选坐标会交回聊天界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此消息界面选择并分享位置。

en.description: When a user starts a new group conversation, Khoros Brand Messenger opens this screen to collect a group name and optional picture. Continuing opens contact selection for the group members.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to create a new Brand Messenger group conversation.

zh-CN.description: 用户新建群组对话时，Khoros Brand Messenger 会打开此界面，让用户填写群组名称并可选择图片。继续后会进入联系人选择界面添加成员。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法创建新的 Brand Messenger 群组对话。

en.description: From a group conversation, this Khoros Brand Messenger screen shows group details and members. It also offers actions to add members, edit group information, leave, or delete the group.
en.disableEffect: Users may lose access to group details and the controls for managing group membership and information.

zh-CN.description: 从群组对话打开此 Khoros Brand Messenger 界面后，用户可查看群组信息和成员，也可添加成员、编辑群组资料、退出或删除群组。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户可能无法查看群组信息，也无法管理群组成员和资料。

en.description: From group details, this Khoros Brand Messenger screen lets a user change the group name and picture, then returns the update to the messenger.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to change a group’s name or picture.

zh-CN.description: 用户可从群组信息界面进入此 Khoros Brand Messenger 页面，修改群组名称和图片，再把更改交回消息服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法修改群组名称或图片。

en.description: Khoros Brand Messenger shows this searchable contact list when users create a group or add members to one. The selected people are returned to the group conversation flow.
en.disableEffect: Users may not be able to choose participants when creating a group or adding members.

zh-CN.description: 创建群组或为群组添加成员时，Khoros Brand Messenger 会显示可搜索的联系人列表。选中的联系人会交回群组对话流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户可能无法在创建群组或添加成员时选择参与者。

en.description: Khoros Brand Messenger opens this screen for a one-to-one or group conversation. It displays the message thread and provides actions for starting conversations, creating groups, and attaching media.
en.disableEffect: The app’s Brand Messenger conversations and their message controls will not be available.

zh-CN.description: Khoros Brand Messenger 会为一对一或群组对话打开此界面。界面显示消息记录，并提供发起对话、创建群组和添加媒体等操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用中的 Brand Messenger 对话及其消息操作将无法使用。

en.description: When a user edits group details, this Khoros Brand Messenger screen lets them change the group description and returns the update to the messenger.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to change a group’s description.

zh-CN.description: 用户编辑群组信息时，此 Khoros Brand Messenger 界面允许修改群组描述，并将更改交回消息服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法修改群组描述。

en.description: When a user opens an image in a Brand Messenger message or rich card, this screen displays it full screen with zoom and any available caption.
en.disableEffect: Images in Brand Messenger messages may no longer open in the full-screen viewer.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 Brand Messenger 消息或富卡片中的图片时，此界面会全屏显示图片，支持缩放并显示可用说明。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Brand Messenger 消息中的图片可能无法在全屏查看器中打开。

en.description: When a user shares new media from a Brand Messenger conversation, this screen opens the camera and media-selection flow for photos or videos. The selected files are returned to the chat to send as a message.
en.disableEffect: Users may not be able to capture or select photos and videos to send in a conversation.

zh-CN.description: 用户要在 Brand Messenger 对话中分享新媒体时，此界面会打开相机和媒体选择流程，供用户拍摄或选择照片、视频，再交回聊天界面发送。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户可能无法拍摄或选择照片和视频并在对话中发送。

en.description: When a user opens a link or interactive form in a Brand Messenger rich message, this screen displays the page inside the app. It can also submit form data supplied by the message.
en.disableEffect: Links and interactive actions in Brand Messenger messages may not open or finish.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 Brand Messenger 富消息中的链接或交互表单时，此界面会在应用内显示相应页面，也可提交消息提供的表单数据。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Brand Messenger 消息中的链接和交互操作可能无法打开或完成。

en.description: Khoros Brand Messenger opens this screen to search people and groups or choose a recipient for shared content. It handles Android SEARCH and SEND requests and can pass shared text or media into a conversation.
en.disableEffect: Searching for people or choosing a conversation for content shared to Brand Messenger may stop working.

zh-CN.description: Khoros Brand Messenger 会打开此界面搜索联系人和群组，或为分享内容选择接收者。它处理 Android 的 SEARCH 和 SEND 请求，并可把分享的文字或媒体交给对话发送。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户可能无法搜索联系人，也无法为分享给 Brand Messenger 的内容选择对话。

en.description: When a user opens a video attachment in a Brand Messenger message, this screen plays it full screen with playback controls.
en.disableEffect: Videos attached to Brand Messenger messages may no longer play in the full-screen player.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 Brand Messenger 消息中的视频附件时，此界面会全屏播放视频并提供播放控制。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Brand Messenger 消息中的视频可能无法在全屏播放器中播放。

en.description: When a user opens a Vimeo link preview in Brand Messenger, this screen plays the linked video full screen.
en.disableEffect: Vimeo videos opened from Brand Messenger previews may not play in the app.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Brand Messenger 中打开 Vimeo 链接预览时，此界面会全屏播放对应视频。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 从 Brand Messenger 预览打开的 Vimeo 视频可能无法在应用内播放。

en.description: When a user opens a YouTube link preview in Brand Messenger, this screen plays the linked video full screen.
en.disableEffect: YouTube videos opened from Brand Messenger previews may not play in the app.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Brand Messenger 中打开 YouTube 链接预览时，此界面会全屏播放对应视频。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 从 Brand Messenger 预览打开的 YouTube 视频可能无法在应用内播放。

en.description: Braze Android SDK reports push-delivery activity to Braze in the background when its delivery-flush request is received.
en.disableEffect: Braze push-delivery records may remain unsent; unrelated app features can continue working.

zh-CN.description: Braze Android SDK 收到送达记录刷新请求时，在后台向 Braze 报告推送送达活动。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Braze 推送送达记录可能无法发送，其他应用功能仍可继续使用。

en.description: Braze Android Location SDK processes geofence transitions and single-location updates for Braze’s location-based messaging.
en.disableEffect: Braze location updates and geofence messages will stop updating; unrelated app features can continue working.

zh-CN.description: Braze Android Location SDK 处理地理围栏变化和单次定位更新，供 Braze 的位置消息使用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Braze 定位更新和地理围栏消息将停止更新，其他应用功能仍可继续使用。

en.description: Braze Android SDK receives Braze push messages and processes their notification payloads.
en.disableEffect: The app will no longer receive or handle Braze push notifications; unrelated app features can continue working.

zh-CN.description: Braze Android SDK 接收 Braze 推送消息并处理其中的通知内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法接收或处理 Braze 推送，其他应用功能仍可继续使用。

en.description: Braze Android SDK handles a tap on its push notification so the intended message content can open in the app.
en.disableEffect: Tapping a Braze notification may no longer open its intended content or record the open.

zh-CN.description: Braze Android SDK 处理用户对推送的点击，以便在应用中打开对应消息内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户点开 Braze 推送后，应用可能无法打开对应内容或记录此次打开。

en.description: Braze Android SDK displays a message page inside the app and loads the page supplied by the message.
en.disableEffect: Web pages opened from Braze messages will not load inside the app; unrelated app features can continue working.

zh-CN.description: Braze Android SDK 在应用内显示消息网页，并加载消息提供的页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Braze 消息中的网页将无法在应用内打开，其他应用功能仍可继续使用。

en.description: Braze Android SDK displays its in-app feed of messages for the user.
en.disableEffect: The app's Braze message feed will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: Braze Android SDK 显示供用户查看的应用内消息动态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用内的 Braze 消息动态将无法打开。

en.description: Braze Android SDK displays its in-app Content Cards screen.
en.disableEffect: The app's Braze Content Cards screen will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: Braze Android SDK 显示应用内的 Content Cards 内容卡片界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用内的 Braze 内容卡片界面将无法打开。

en.description: Breinify Android SDK handles taps and other actions on its notifications, records opened-push activity, and can open a supplied link or the app.
en.disableEffect: Breinify notification actions will no longer open or be recorded; unrelated app features can continue working.

zh-CN.description: Breinify Android SDK 处理用户对其通知的点击等操作，记录推送打开活动，并可打开通知链接或应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Breinify 通知操作将无法打开或记录，其他应用功能仍可继续使用。

en.description: Brightwell's ReadyRemit SDK opens this screen when an app starts a money-transfer session; it loads sender details and either enters transfer details or follows the full setup and transfer flow.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot complete ReadyRemit setup or send money through this screen if disabled.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动汇款流程时，Brightwell ReadyRemit SDK 会打开此界面并载入汇款人资料；它可直接进入转账详情，也可继续完整的设置和汇款流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过此界面完成 ReadyRemit 设置或汇款。

en.description: JsonBroadcaster by GuilhE receives the app's UI-state broadcasts and stores the included value as the current screen state for the app to observe.
en.disableEffect: Screens that depend on these broadcasts will no longer receive their state updates.

zh-CN.description: GuilhE 的 JsonBroadcaster 会接收应用发送的界面状态广播，并将其中的内容保存为当前界面状态，供应用读取。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖这些广播的界面将无法再收到状态更新。

en.description: Woody230's Ktx Ktor Client Connectivity library starts this provider with the app to check whether the device has network access and whether a configured internet address responds. The app can use these checks before starting online work.
en.disableEffect: Apps that rely on this check may treat a working connection as unavailable, so online features can fail.

zh-CN.description: Woody230 的 Ktx Ktor Client Connectivity 库会在应用启动时初始化此提供程序，用于检查设备是否联网，以及配置的网络地址是否可访问。应用可用这些检查判断联网操作能否继续。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 如果应用依赖此检查，联网功能可能会把正常网络误判为不可用而失败。

en.description: Woody230's Ktx Intent library starts this provider with the app and uses it when the app opens a web link. It passes the link to whichever browser or app can handle it.
en.disableEffect: Links that use this library will no longer open from the app.

zh-CN.description: Woody230 的 Ktx Intent 库会随应用启动此提供程序，并在应用打开网页链接时调用它。它会把链接交给系统中能够处理该链接的浏览器或应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用内通过此库打开的网页链接将无法正常跳转。

en.description: Woody230's Ktx Intent library starts this provider with the app and uses it when the app asks to compose an email. It opens the system email app with recipients, subject and message filled in.
en.disableEffect: Email drafts that use this library cannot be opened.

zh-CN.description: Woody230 的 Ktx Intent 库会随应用启动此提供程序，并在应用请求撰写邮件时调用它。它会打开系统邮件应用并预填收件人、主题和正文。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过此库发起的邮件将无法打开撰写界面。

en.description: Woody230's Ktx Ktor Client library starts this provider with the app to check whether the device has network access and whether a configured internet address responds. The app can use these checks before starting online work.
en.disableEffect: Apps that rely on this check may treat a working connection as unavailable, so online features can fail.

zh-CN.description: Woody230 的 Ktx Ktor Client 库会在应用启动时初始化此提供程序，用于检查设备是否联网，以及配置的网络地址是否可访问。应用可用这些检查判断联网操作能否继续。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 如果应用依赖此检查，联网功能可能会把正常网络误判为不可用而失败。

en.description: Woody230's Ktx Resource library uses this provider when the app reads text files included with it; it gives the library access to those files.
en.disableEffect: Pages or features that need these packaged text assets may fail to display or initialize.

zh-CN.description: 应用读取随应用打包的文本文件时，Woody230 的 Ktx Resource 库会使用此提供程序访问这些文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖这些文本资源的页面或功能可能无法正常显示或初始化。

en.description: The Bugfender remote logging and feedback SDK opens this Activity when an app presents its user feedback form. It collects a subject and message and sends them to Bugfender.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to send feedback through Bugfender's form, while the app's other features remain available.

zh-CN.description: Bugfender 远程日志与反馈 SDK 会在应用打开用户反馈表单时显示此页面，收集反馈主题和内容并发送给 Bugfender。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过 Bugfender 表单提交反馈，但应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: Crashlife, Buglife's native crash reporting add-on, receives a captured native crash and saves device and environment details alongside the crash report.
en.disableEffect: Crashlife's native crash reports will no longer include these device and environment details.

zh-CN.description: Crashlife（Buglife 的原生崩溃报告扩展）会在收到原生崩溃记录后，把设备和运行环境信息保存到崩溃报告旁边。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Crashlife 的原生崩溃报告将不再包含这些设备和运行环境信息。

en.description: Crashlife's diagnostic menu shows its report endpoint and cached crash count, with options to clear the cache, trigger a sample crash, or record a test error. It appears when Crashlife's debug menu is opened.
en.disableEffect: Crashlife's diagnostic menu and its crash-testing options will be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: Crashlife 的诊断菜单会显示报告服务地址和缓存的崩溃数量，并提供清除缓存、触发示例崩溃和记录测试错误的选项。应用打开 Crashlife 诊断菜单时会显示此页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Crashlife 的诊断菜单和崩溃测试选项将无法使用。

en.description: The Buglife Android bug reporting SDK shows this settings page when its report-trigger settings are opened. It lets users turn shake-to-report on or off and adjust how much shaking triggers a report.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to change Buglife's shake-to-report settings from this page.

zh-CN.description: Buglife Android 问题报告 SDK 会在打开报告触发设置时显示此页面，用户可启用或关闭摇动反馈，并调整触发报告所需的摇动幅度。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过此页面更改 Buglife 的摇动反馈设置。

en.description: When the Buglife Android SDK opens its issue reporting flow, this Activity displays the report fields and attached files so users can review and submit a report.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to submit issue reports through Buglife's reporting screen.

zh-CN.description: Buglife Android SDK 打开问题反馈流程时，此页面会显示报告内容和附件，供用户检查并提交问题报告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过 Buglife 的报告页面提交问题。

en.description: When a user opens an image attached to a Buglife report, this Activity lets them mark the screenshot with arrows, a magnifier, or blur before returning to the report.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to mark up screenshots attached to Buglife reports.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 Buglife 报告中的图片附件时，此页面可在截图上添加箭头、放大镜或模糊标记，然后返回报告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法标注 Buglife 报告中的截图。

en.description: When a user opens a video attached to a Buglife report, this Activity plays the recording for review.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to preview video attachments in Buglife reports.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 Buglife 报告中的视频附件时，此页面会播放录制内容供其查看。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法预览 Buglife 报告中的视频附件。

en.description: The Buglife Android SDK starts this background service when it sends or retries issue reports. It uploads the queued reports and keeps reports that fail because the network is unavailable for a later attempt.
en.disableEffect: Buglife reports may remain queued instead of being delivered in the background.

zh-CN.description: Buglife Android SDK 在发送或重试问题报告时会启动此后台服务。服务会上传排队中的报告，并在网络不可用时保留报告以便稍后重试。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Buglife 报告可能会一直留在队列中，无法在后台送达。

en.description: Android starts this Buglife job service to upload a queued issue report in the background. It removes the local report file after a successful upload.
en.disableEffect: Scheduled Buglife report uploads will not run, so queued reports may not be delivered.

zh-CN.description: Android 在后台启动此 Buglife 作业服务来上传排队的问题报告；报告成功上传后，服务会删除本地报告文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，计划执行的 Buglife 报告上传任务将无法运行，排队中的报告可能无法送达。

en.description: The Bugsee Android bug reporting SDK runs this Provider at app startup to register app lifecycle tracking and start Bugsee automatically when its app settings include a token.
en.disableEffect: Bugsee's automatic startup and diagnostic collection will stop, while the host app can still open.

zh-CN.description: Bugsee Android 问题报告 SDK 会在应用启动时运行此 Provider，以登记应用生命周期追踪，并在应用设置中提供令牌时自动启动 Bugsee。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Bugsee 将不再自动启动或收集诊断信息，但宿主应用仍可打开。

en.description: In Bugsee 5, this Activity lets a user draw on a screenshot attached to a report before returning the marked image to the report form.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to annotate screenshots in Bugsee reports.

zh-CN.description: 在 Bugsee 5 中，用户可通过此页面标注报告中的截图，再将标注后的图片返回报告表单。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法标注 Bugsee 报告中的截图。

en.description: In Bugsee 5, this Activity shows Bugsee's in-app feedback conversation, where users can send messages, read replies, and optionally provide an email address.
en.disableEffect: Bugsee's in-app feedback conversation will be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: 在 Bugsee 5 中，此页面显示 Bugsee 应用内反馈对话，用户可发送消息、查看回复，也可提供电子邮件地址。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Bugsee 应用内反馈对话将无法使用。

en.description: When Bugsee starts a screen recording for a report, this service manages the user-approved recording and its foreground notification.
en.disableEffect: Bugsee will not be able to record the screen to attach to an issue report.

zh-CN.description: Bugsee 为问题报告启动屏幕录制时，此服务负责管理用户授权的录制过程和前台通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Bugsee 将无法录制屏幕并把录像附加到问题报告中。

en.description: When Bugsee requests a screen recording for a report, this Activity opens Android's screen capture approval prompt and passes the user's choice back to Bugsee.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to grant Bugsee permission to record the screen for reports.

zh-CN.description: Bugsee 为问题报告请求屏幕录制时，此页面会打开 Android 的屏幕捕获授权提示，并把用户的选择传回 Bugsee。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法授权 Bugsee 为问题报告录制屏幕。

en.description: In Bugsee 5, this service manages a user-approved screen recording when a recording is attached to a report.
en.disableEffect: Bugsee will not be able to record the screen to attach to an issue report.

zh-CN.description: 在 Bugsee 5 中，此服务会在报告需要屏幕录像时管理用户授权的录制过程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Bugsee 将无法录制屏幕并把录像附加到问题报告中。

en.description: In Bugsee 5, this Activity opens Android's screen capture approval prompt when the SDK requests a recording for a report, then returns the user's choice to Bugsee.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to grant Bugsee permission to record the screen for reports.

zh-CN.description: 在 Bugsee 5 中，SDK 为报告请求屏幕录像时，此页面会打开 Android 的屏幕捕获授权提示，再把用户的选择传回 Bugsee。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法授权 Bugsee 为问题报告录制屏幕。

en.description: In Bugsee 5, this Activity collects a report's summary, description, severity, and contact details, and can include an annotated screenshot before returning the report to Bugsee for sending.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to submit Bugsee issue reports through this form or include a marked screenshot.

zh-CN.description: 在 Bugsee 5 中，此页面收集问题摘要、描述、严重程度和联系信息，也可附上标注过的截图，再将报告交给 Bugsee 发送。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过此表单提交 Bugsee 问题报告或附上标注后的截图。

en.description: Android starts this Bugsee service for scheduled background tasks, including preparing and uploading issue reports. It runs the task requested by Bugsee and reports whether it should be retried.
en.disableEffect: Bugsee's scheduled report preparation and uploads may not finish in the background.

zh-CN.description: Android 会为 Bugsee 的计划后台任务启动此服务，包括准备和上传问题报告。服务会执行 Bugsee 请求的任务，并返回是否需要重试。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Bugsee 计划执行的问题报告准备和上传任务可能无法在后台完成。

en.description: The Bugsee Android SDK opens this report form when a user starts a report. It collects a summary, description, severity, and optional contact details, then submits the report.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to file Bugsee issue reports through the app.

zh-CN.description: 用户开始提交问题时，Bugsee Android SDK 会打开此报告表单，收集摘要、描述、严重程度和可选联系信息，然后提交报告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过应用提交 Bugsee 问题报告。

en.description: When a user edits a screenshot in a Bugsee report, this Activity lets them mark up the image and return the changes to the report.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to annotate screenshots in Bugsee reports.

zh-CN.description: 用户编辑 Bugsee 报告中的截图时，此页面可在图片上添加标记，并将修改后的图片返回报告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法标注 Bugsee 报告中的截图。

en.description: When a user opens a Bugsee report notification, this Activity forwards the tap to Bugsee's reporting flow and then closes.
en.disableEffect: Tapping Bugsee report notifications will no longer open the reporting flow.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 Bugsee 问题报告通知时，此页面会将点击操作转交给 Bugsee 报告流程，然后关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，点击 Bugsee 问题报告通知将无法打开报告流程。

en.description: The Bugsnag Android error reporting SDK runs this Provider at app startup to register foreground and background detection for its monitoring reports.
en.disableEffect: Bugsnag will miss the automatic app foreground and background updates provided at startup.

zh-CN.description: Bugsnag Android 错误报告 SDK 会在应用启动时运行此 Provider，为监控报告登记应用前台和后台状态检测。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Bugsnag 将无法通过启动流程自动获取应用的前后台状态变化。

en.description: The Bugsnag Performance SDK runs this Provider at app startup to begin app-start timing and register foreground and background tracking.
en.disableEffect: Automatic app-start timing and lifecycle measurements from Bugsnag Performance will stop.

zh-CN.description: Bugsnag Performance SDK 会在应用启动时运行此 Provider，开始记录启动耗时并登记前后台状态追踪。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Bugsnag Performance 将不再自动记录应用启动耗时和生命周期数据。

en.description: The Bugtags Android issue reporting SDK opens this Activity for its in-app report and related issue screens. It also handles a Bugtags screen opened for a report link.
en.disableEffect: Bugtags report and issue screens will not open, while the host app's other features remain available.

zh-CN.description: Bugtags Android 问题报告 SDK 会通过此页面打开应用内报告和相关问题页面，也会处理通过报告链接打开的 Bugtags 页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Bugtags 报告和问题页面将无法打开，但宿主应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: The Bugtags Android issue reporting SDK opens this Activity for its in-app report and feedback screens, including screens that request location access for a report.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to open Bugtags report or feedback screens from the app.

zh-CN.description: Bugtags Android 问题报告 SDK 会通过此页面打开应用内报告和反馈页面，包括为报告请求位置信息的页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法从应用打开 Bugtags 报告或反馈页面。

en.description: When Android reports a network connectivity change, this Bugtags receiver retries saved issue reports and resumes the SDK's network-dependent tracking.
en.disableEffect: Bugtags may not retry queued reports or resume network-dependent tracking after connectivity changes.

zh-CN.description: Android 通知网络连接状态发生变化时，此 Bugtags 接收器会重试已保存的问题报告，并恢复依赖网络的 SDK 追踪。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，网络状态变化时 Bugtags 可能无法重试排队中的报告或恢复网络相关追踪。

en.description: The Bugtags Android SDK starts this service to manage its floating report control and shake-to-report trigger. It also handles commands to show, hide, reset, or lock the control.
en.disableEffect: Bugtags' floating report control and shake-to-report trigger will stop working.

zh-CN.description: Bugtags Android SDK 会启动此服务来管理悬浮报告按钮和摇动反馈触发方式，也会处理显示、隐藏、重置或锁定按钮的指令。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Bugtags 的悬浮报告按钮和摇动反馈触发方式将无法使用。

en.description: The Appyx UI testing library from Bumble launches this Activity as a host for a supplied Compose screen during navigation UI tests.
en.disableEffect: Appyx UI tests that rely on this test host will not run; ordinary app screens are unaffected.

zh-CN.description: Bumble 的 Appyx 界面测试库会在导航界面测试中启动此 Activity，用作承载指定 Compose 界面的测试宿主。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，依赖此测试宿主的 Appyx 界面测试将无法运行，应用的普通页面不受影响。

en.description: The Appyx 2 navigation testing library from Bumble launches this Activity as a host for a supplied Compose screen during UI tests.
en.disableEffect: Appyx UI tests that rely on this test host will not run; ordinary app screens are unaffected.

zh-CN.description: Bumble 的 Appyx 2 导航测试库会在界面测试中启动此 Activity，用作承载指定 Compose 界面的测试宿主。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，依赖此测试宿主的 Appyx 界面测试将无法运行，应用的普通页面不受影响。

en.description: The BumptechLab-published Adjust Android SDK receives Google Play's install-referrer broadcast after installation and sends the referral information for attribution.
en.disableEffect: Install-source attribution through this SDK will stop being recorded if the receiver is disabled.

zh-CN.description: 安装后，BumptechLab 发布的 Adjust Android SDK 会接收 Google Play 的安装来源广播，并发送来源信息用于归因统计。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，此 SDK 将无法记录应用安装来源归因。

en.description: Android Tools DevPanel opens this developer panel after a shake gesture or when requested by the app; it shows registered app information and controls for changing registered settings.
en.disableEffect: The developer information and tuning panel becomes unavailable; ordinary app screens remain usable.

zh-CN.description: Android Tools 的 DevPanel 会在用户摇动设备或应用请求时打开开发者面板，其中列出已登记的应用信息和可调整的设置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，开发者信息和调试设置面板将无法使用，但应用的日常页面仍可使用。

en.description: When Buyhatke Onramp requests NFC verification, this screen reads an identity document using its document number, birth date, and expiry date, then returns the read data.
en.disableEffect: Onramp verification flows that require NFC document reading will not complete.

zh-CN.description: Buyhatke Onramp 请求 NFC 核验时，此页面会根据证件号码、出生日期和到期日期读取身份文件，并返回读取结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要 NFC 身份核验的 Onramp 流程将无法完成。

en.description: Buyhatke Onramp opens its payment gateway’s web flow inside the app and returns the completion or failure result.
en.disableEffect: The Onramp checkout or verification page will not open, so transactions relying on it cannot finish.

zh-CN.description: Buyhatke Onramp 会在应用内打开支付网关的网页流程，并返回成功或失败结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Onramp 结账或核验页面将无法打开，依赖它的交易无法完成。

en.description: When a Pangle ad offers an app that must be installed from outside the app store, this Activity prompts for installation permission and continues or cancels the install flow.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it stops Pangle from prompting for permission to install an advertised app; the host app remains usable.

zh-CN.description: Pangle 广告推广的应用需要从应用商店以外安装时，这个 Activity 会提示安装权限，并继续或取消安装流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，Pangle 将无法提示安装推广应用所需的权限；宿主应用仍可使用。

en.description: The Pangle (ByteDance) ad SDK opens this screen when an advertised app needs permission to be installed from this source.
en.disableEffect: The install-permission prompt for apps promoted by Pangle ads will not open.

zh-CN.description: Pangle（字节跳动）广告 SDK 会在广告推广应用需要获准从当前来源安装时打开此页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Pangle 广告推广应用的安装授权提示将无法打开。

en.description: The Pangle (ByteDance) ad SDK opens this screen for ad-related confirmations, permission prompts, privacy or app information, and web pages.
en.disableEffect: Pangle ad confirmations, information pages, and related prompts will not open.

zh-CN.description: Pangle（字节跳动）广告 SDK 会用此页面展示广告确认、权限提示、隐私或应用信息以及网页。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Pangle 广告确认页、信息页及相关提示将无法打开。

en.description: The Pangle (ByteDance) ad SDK displays an advertisement and its destination details on this native landing page.
en.disableEffect: Pangle native ad landing pages will not open.

zh-CN.description: Pangle（字节跳动）广告 SDK 会在此原生落地页展示广告及其目标内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Pangle 原生广告落地页将无法打开。

en.description: The Pangle (ByteDance) ad SDK displays a long, multi-screen advertisement page in its web view.
en.disableEffect: Pangle multi-screen ad web pages will not open.

zh-CN.description: Pangle（字节跳动）广告 SDK 会在网页视图中展示可跨多个屏幕滚动的广告页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Pangle 多屏广告网页将无法打开。

en.description: The Pangle (ByteDance) ad SDK displays a scrollable video advertisement page.
en.disableEffect: Pangle scrollable video ad pages will not open.

zh-CN.description: Pangle（字节跳动）广告 SDK 会展示可滚动的视频广告页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Pangle 可滚动视频广告页将无法打开。

en.description: The Pangle (ByteDance) ad SDK combines video playback with an advertisement web page on this screen.
en.disableEffect: Pangle video and web ad pages will not open.

zh-CN.description: Pangle（字节跳动）广告 SDK 会在此页面结合播放视频和展示广告网页。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Pangle 视频及网页广告页将无法打开。

en.description: The Pangle (ByteDance) ad SDK opens an advertisement destination in its in-app web page.
en.disableEffect: Pangle in-app ad destination pages will not open.

zh-CN.description: Pangle（字节跳动）广告 SDK 会在应用内网页中打开广告目标页。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Pangle 应用内广告目标页将无法打开。

en.description: The Pangle (ByteDance) ad SDK runs this background service to start and manage downloads of apps promoted by ads.
en.disableEffect: App downloads started by Pangle ads will stop working.

zh-CN.description: Pangle（字节跳动）广告 SDK 会通过此后台服务启动并管理广告推广应用的下载。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Pangle 广告发起的应用下载将无法使用。

en.description: While Pangle is downloading an app promoted by an ad, this Service updates the progress notice and reacts to download or network changes.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it stops Pangle download progress and recovery notifications; the host app remains usable.

zh-CN.description: Pangle 下载广告推广的应用时，这个 Service 会更新进度通知，并响应下载状态或网络变化。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，Pangle 下载进度和恢复通知会停止显示；宿主应用仍可使用。

en.description: When Pangle is downloading an app promoted by an ad, this Service responds to requests to resume the task or refresh its status.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents Pangle downloads from resuming or updating through this path; the host app remains usable.

zh-CN.description: Pangle 下载广告推广的应用时，这个 Service 会响应恢复下载或刷新状态的请求。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，Pangle 下载将无法通过此路径恢复或更新；宿主应用仍可使用。

en.description: When someone taps an ad download notification or storage becomes available again, the Yodo1 MAS 4399 TT ad plugin handles opening, pausing, resuming, or deleting the Pangle ad download.
en.disableEffect: Pangle ad downloads may not resume, install, or respond to their notification controls; the app's own screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击广告下载通知或存储空间重新可用时，Yodo1 MAS 的 4399 TT 广告插件会处理穿山甲广告的打开、暂停、继续或删除操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 穿山甲广告下载可能无法继续、安装或响应通知操作；应用自身的界面仍可使用。

en.description: Android starts this Yodo1 MAS 4399 TT ad plugin service when a scheduled Pangle download retry meets its network conditions, and it signals the downloader to check the pending task again.
en.disableEffect: Failed Pangle ad downloads may not retry automatically.

zh-CN.description: 当已安排的穿山甲下载重试满足网络条件时，Android 会启动 Yodo1 MAS 的 4399 TT 广告插件服务，让下载器再次检查待处理任务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 穿山甲广告下载失败后可能无法自动重试。

en.description: When a user taps an install-style Pangle ad, this Activity handles the ad click and routes to the promoted app or its download flow.
en.disableEffect: Pangle ad links that use this screen will not open, but the host app’s own features continue to work.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击带有应用安装入口的 Pangle 广告时，这个 Activity 会处理点击并打开推广应用或相关下载流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此页面的 Pangle 广告链接将无法打开，宿主应用自身功能仍可使用。

en.description: This Provider helps Pangle display ad content and supporting pages in the host app.
en.disableEffect: Pangle ads that need this Provider will not load; the host app’s own features remain available.

zh-CN.description: 这个 Provider 帮助 Pangle 在宿主应用中显示广告内容和相关页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要此 Provider 的 Pangle 广告将无法加载；宿主应用自身功能仍可使用。

en.description: The Pangle (ByteDance) ad SDK runs this background service to start and manage downloads of apps promoted by ads.
en.disableEffect: App downloads started by Pangle ads will stop working.

zh-CN.description: Pangle（字节跳动）广告 SDK 会通过此后台服务启动并管理广告推广应用的下载。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Pangle 广告发起的应用下载将无法使用。

en.description: The Pangle (ByteDance) ad SDK uses this background service to process app-download tasks, including download actions from ad pages.

zh-CN.description: Pangle（字节跳动）广告 SDK 会通过此后台服务处理应用下载任务，包括广告页面发起的下载操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Pangle 广告下载任务将无法使用。

en.description: The Pangle (ByteDance) ad SDK opens this screen when an advertised app needs permission to be installed from this source.
en.disableEffect: The install-permission prompt for apps promoted by Pangle ads will not open.

zh-CN.description: Pangle（字节跳动）广告 SDK 会在广告推广应用需要获准从当前来源安装时打开此页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Pangle 广告推广应用的安装授权提示将无法打开。

en.description: Android runs this Pangle (ByteDance) job service to retry scheduled downloads of apps promoted by ads.
en.disableEffect: Pangle scheduled download retries will stop.

zh-CN.description: Android 会运行 Pangle（字节跳动）的此任务服务，重试已排期的广告推广应用下载。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Pangle 已排期的下载重试将停止。

en.description: The Pangle (ByteDance) ad SDK uses this background service to connect its own processes and ad-download services.
en.disableEffect: Pangle components that rely on this service connection may stop working.

zh-CN.description: Pangle（字节跳动）广告 SDK 会通过此后台服务连接其进程和广告下载服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此服务连接的 Pangle 组件可能无法工作。

en.disableEffect: Pangle app-download notification actions will not open.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击应用下载通知时，Pangle（字节跳动）广告 SDK 会打开此页面，并将操作交给下载服务处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Pangle 应用下载通知的操作将无法打开。

en.description: After someone taps a Pangle ad, the SDK opens this brief Activity to show download, permission, or installation prompts.
en.disableEffect: Pangle ad prompts and the downloads they confirm may not work.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击 Pangle 广告后，SDK 会打开此短暂显示的 Activity，展示下载、权限或安装确认提示。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Pangle 广告提示及其确认的下载操作可能无法使用。

en.description: When Pangle displays an express-format video ad in portrait mode, this Activity plays it full-screen and provides playback controls.
en.disableEffect: Pangle express-format full-screen video ads will not open in this orientation.

zh-CN.description: Pangle 展示竖屏模板视频广告时，会通过此 Activity 全屏播放视频并提供播放控制。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Pangle 的竖屏模板全屏视频广告将无法打开。

en.description: When Pangle displays a full-screen video ad in portrait mode, this Activity plays the video and provides playback controls.
en.disableEffect: Pangle portrait full-screen video ads will not open.

zh-CN.description: Pangle 展示竖屏全屏视频广告时，会通过此 Activity 播放视频并提供播放控制。

en.description: When an express-format Pangle video ad requests landscape mode, this Activity plays it full-screen.
en.disableEffect: Pangle landscape express-format full-screen video ads will not open.

zh-CN.description: Pangle 的模板视频广告需要横屏显示时，此 Activity 会全屏播放广告。

en.description: When a Pangle full-screen video ad requests landscape mode, this Activity plays it full-screen.
en.disableEffect: Pangle landscape full-screen video ads will not open.

zh-CN.description: Pangle 的全屏视频广告需要横屏显示时，此 Activity 会全屏播放广告。

en.description: After someone taps a Pangle ad, this Activity opens the advertiser landing page and handles links or app downloads from it.
en.disableEffect: Pangle ad landing pages and their download links will not open.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击 Pangle 广告后，此 Activity 会打开广告主落地页，并处理页面上的链接或应用下载。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Pangle 广告落地页及其中的下载链接将无法打开。

en.description: For some Pangle native ads, the SDK opens this Activity to render an intermediate ad page before continuing the click-through.
en.disableEffect: Those Pangle ad pages and their click-throughs may not appear.

zh-CN.description: 部分 Pangle 原生广告会通过此 Activity 显示中间广告页，随后继续打开广告链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，这些 Pangle 广告页面及后续链接可能无法显示。

en.description: When a Pangle ad includes an interactive playable experience, this Activity displays the playable page and handles its links.
en.disableEffect: Interactive Pangle ad pages will not launch.

zh-CN.description: Pangle 广告包含可试玩的互动内容时，此 Activity 会显示互动页面并处理后续广告链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Pangle 的互动广告页面将无法打开。

en.description: When an express-format Pangle rewarded video is selected, this Activity plays it full-screen in portrait mode and reports the viewing result.

zh-CN.description: Pangle 选中模板激励视频广告时，此 Activity 会在竖屏中全屏播放，并返回观看结果。

en.description: When a Pangle rewarded video ad is selected, this Activity plays it full-screen and returns the viewing result to the app.

zh-CN.description: Pangle 选中激励视频广告时，此 Activity 会全屏播放视频并将观看结果返回应用。

en.description: After a Pangle video ad is clicked, this Activity opens the advertiser landing page with video content and download links.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击 Pangle 视频广告后，此 Activity 会打开包含视频内容和下载链接的广告主落地页。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Pangle 视频广告落地页及其中的下载链接将无法打开。

en.disableEffect: The Pangle ad explanation page will not open.

en.description: The Pangle SDK binds to this background Service when ad work in another process needs to exchange data with the app.
en.disableEffect: Pangle ad or download functions that use this connection may stop working.

zh-CN.description: Pangle 广告任务需要跨进程交换数据时，SDK 会绑定此后台 Service。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，依赖此连接的 Pangle 广告或下载任务可能无法运行。

en.disableEffect: Pangle ads that rely on shared process data or ad conversion may fail.

zh-CN.description: Pangle 广告在多个进程中运行时，此 Provider 可让这些进程交换广告相关数据。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，依赖跨进程数据或广告转化的 Pangle 广告可能无法正常运行。

en.description: Pangle (ByteDance) contacts this background connection when its ad downloader handles an app promoted by an ad.
en.disableEffect: Pangle ad downloads may fail, while the app’s other features remain available.

zh-CN.description: Pangle（字节跳动）广告 SDK 在下载广告推广的应用时，会通过此后台连接调用下载服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Pangle 广告中的应用下载可能失败，但应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: Pangle uses this provider to connect its separate push-related process with internal SDK services for background ad and notification work.
en.disableEffect: Pangle background push or notification work may stop.

zh-CN.description: Pangle 会通过此 Provider 连接独立的推送进程和 SDK 服务，以支持广告与通知相关的后台工作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Pangle 的后台推送或通知相关工作可能会停止。

en.description: ByteDance's ad conversion SDK opens this Activity after an ad click to save click attribution and forward the requested link into the app, or launch the app if that link cannot be opened.
en.disableEffect: Ad links that use this handoff may no longer open the app, and click attribution will be lost.

zh-CN.description: 广告点击后，字节跳动的广告转化 SDK 会打开此 Activity 记录点击归因，并将链接转到应用内目标；如果链接无法打开，它会尝试启动应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此流程的广告链接可能无法打开应用，点击归因也会丢失。

en.description: Pangle initializes its live-content feature through this provider before opening live pages. It starts automatically when the live-content process begins.
en.disableEffect: Pangle live pages may not initialize, and their related authorization flow may fail.

zh-CN.description: Pangle 会通过此 Provider 在打开直播页面前初始化直播内容功能。直播内容进程启动时会自动运行此 Provider。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Pangle 的直播页面可能无法初始化，相关授权流程也可能无法运行。

en.description: When a Pangle live-content flow requests Douyin authorization, this Activity returns the sign-in result to that flow. If authorization setup fails, the user sees a failure message.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot complete the Douyin authorization required by that live feature.

zh-CN.description: 当 Pangle 直播内容流程请求抖音授权时，此 Activity 会把登录结果交回该流程。授权界面启动失败时，用户会看到失败提示。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法完成该直播功能所需的抖音授权。

en.description: When the ByteDance Douyin OpenLive plug-in returns from an authorization screen, this Activity passes the result to the plug-in's live authorization flow.
en.disableEffect: Douyin authorization and any live features that require it may fail.

zh-CN.description: 字节跳动抖音 OpenLive 插件从授权界面返回时，此 Activity 会将结果交给插件的直播授权流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 抖音授权以及依赖该授权的直播功能可能失败。

en.description: When the ByteDance Douyin OpenLive plug-in loads a live page, it uses this hidden Activity to display the page in a regular screen.
en.disableEffect: Any Douyin OpenLive page that uses this screen may fail to open.

zh-CN.description: 字节跳动抖音 OpenLive 插件加载直播页面时，会使用此隐藏 Activity 在普通界面中显示该页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此界面的抖音 OpenLive 页面可能无法打开。

en.description: When the ByteDance Douyin OpenLive plug-in loads a live page, it uses this hidden Activity to display it with the orientation of the screen beneath it.
en.disableEffect: Any Douyin OpenLive page that uses this screen may fail to open.

zh-CN.description: 字节跳动抖音 OpenLive 插件加载直播页面时，会使用此隐藏 Activity 显示该页面，并沿用下层界面的屏幕方向。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此界面的抖音 OpenLive 页面可能无法打开。

en.description: When the ByteDance Douyin OpenLive plug-in loads a live page, it uses this hidden Activity to display it in portrait orientation.
en.disableEffect: Any portrait Douyin OpenLive page that uses this screen may fail to open.

zh-CN.description: 字节跳动抖音 OpenLive 插件加载直播页面时，会使用此隐藏 Activity 以竖屏方式显示该页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此界面的抖音 OpenLive 竖屏页面可能无法打开。

en.description: ByteDance OpenLive uses this portrait screen for live pages that its plug-in loads into the app at runtime.
en.disableEffect: OpenLive live pages that need this portrait screen will not open.

zh-CN.description: 字节跳动 OpenLive 插件会通过此竖屏页面显示运行时载入应用的直播内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要此竖屏页面的 OpenLive 直播内容将无法打开。

en.description: ByteDance OpenLive uses this portrait screen for live pages that its plug-in loads into the app at runtime.
en.disableEffect: OpenLive live pages that need this portrait screen will not open.

zh-CN.description: 字节跳动 OpenLive 插件会通过此竖屏页面显示运行时载入应用的直播内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要此竖屏页面的 OpenLive 直播内容将无法打开。

en.description: ByteDance OpenLive uses this portrait screen for live pages that its plug-in loads into the app at runtime.
en.disableEffect: OpenLive live pages that need this portrait screen will not open.

zh-CN.description: 字节跳动 OpenLive 插件会通过此竖屏页面显示运行时载入应用的直播内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要此竖屏页面的 OpenLive 直播内容将无法打开。

en.description: ByteDance OpenLive uses this portrait screen for live pages that its plug-in loads into the app at runtime.
en.disableEffect: OpenLive live pages that need this portrait screen will not open.

zh-CN.description: 字节跳动 OpenLive 插件会通过此竖屏页面显示运行时载入应用的直播内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要此竖屏页面的 OpenLive 直播内容将无法打开。

en.description: When the ByteDance Douyin OpenLive plug-in loads a live page, it uses this hidden translucent Activity to display it over the current screen.
en.disableEffect: Any Douyin OpenLive page that uses this screen may fail to open.

zh-CN.description: 字节跳动抖音 OpenLive 插件加载直播页面时，会使用此半透明隐藏 Activity 在当前界面上显示该页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此界面的抖音 OpenLive 页面可能无法打开。

en.description: When the ByteDance Douyin OpenLive plug-in loads a live page for a single-task screen, it uses this hidden translucent Activity to display it.
en.disableEffect: Any Douyin OpenLive page that uses this screen may fail to open.

zh-CN.description: 字节跳动抖音 OpenLive 插件加载单任务直播页面时，会使用此半透明隐藏 Activity 显示该页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此界面的抖音 OpenLive 页面可能无法打开。

en.description: When the ByteDance Douyin OpenLive plug-in loads a live page, it uses this hidden Activity to display the page.
en.disableEffect: Any Douyin OpenLive page that uses this screen may fail to open.

zh-CN.description: 字节跳动抖音 OpenLive 插件加载直播页面时，会使用此隐藏 Activity 显示该页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此界面的抖音 OpenLive 页面可能无法打开。

en.description: When the ByteDance Douyin OpenLive plug-in loads a live page, it uses this hidden Activity to display it in portrait orientation.
en.disableEffect: Any portrait Douyin OpenLive page that uses this screen may fail to open.

zh-CN.description: 字节跳动抖音 OpenLive 插件加载直播页面时，会使用此隐藏 Activity 以竖屏方式显示该页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此界面的抖音 OpenLive 竖屏页面可能无法打开。

en.description: When the ByteDance Douyin OpenLive plug-in loads a single-task portrait live page, it uses this hidden Activity to display it.
en.disableEffect: Any portrait Douyin OpenLive page that uses this screen may fail to open.

zh-CN.description: 字节跳动抖音 OpenLive 插件加载竖屏单任务直播页面时，会使用此隐藏 Activity 显示该页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此界面的抖音 OpenLive 竖屏页面可能无法打开。

en.description: When the ByteDance Douyin OpenLive plug-in loads a live page, it uses this hidden translucent Activity to display it over the current screen.
en.disableEffect: Any Douyin OpenLive page that uses this screen may fail to open.

zh-CN.description: 字节跳动抖音 OpenLive 插件加载直播页面时，会使用此半透明隐藏 Activity 在当前界面上显示该页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此界面的抖音 OpenLive 页面可能无法打开。

en.description: When the ByteDance Douyin OpenLive plug-in loads a live page, it uses this translucent Activity without opening another copy if the page is already on top.
en.disableEffect: Any Douyin OpenLive page that uses this screen may fail to open.

zh-CN.description: 字节跳动抖音 OpenLive 插件加载直播页面时，如果页面已位于顶部，就不会再打开一个副本。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此界面的抖音 OpenLive 页面可能无法打开。

en.description: When the ByteDance Douyin OpenLive plug-in loads its full-screen web authorization page, it uses this hidden portrait Activity to display it.
en.disableEffect: Users may be unable to finish web authorization for Douyin OpenLive features.

zh-CN.description: 字节跳动抖音 OpenLive 插件加载全屏网页授权页面时，会使用此隐藏竖屏 Activity 显示该页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户可能无法完成抖音 OpenLive 功能所需的网页授权。

en.description: This ByteDance AppLog Receiver accepts analytics events sent within the app and forwards them to the tracking SDK. It runs when the SDK sends an event for collection.
en.disableEffect: AppLog may stop recording events delivered through this receiver, while the app’s normal screens and features remain available.

zh-CN.description: 这个字节跳动 AppLog 接收器会接收应用内部发送的分析事件，并交给追踪 SDK 处理。SDK 发送待收集事件时会触发它。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，AppLog 可能无法记录通过此接收器传递的事件，但应用的日常页面和功能仍可使用。

en.description: This provider starts with the app and lets ByteDance AppLog DevTools observe tracking setup, event activity, and screen changes for diagnostics.
en.disableEffect: The optional AppLog debugging tools will lose these diagnostics; regular app screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，这个提供程序会让字节跳动 AppLog DevTools 观察埋点初始化、事件活动和页面变化，供调试时查看。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，AppLog 调试工具将无法查看这些诊断信息，但应用的日常页面仍可使用。

en.description: This provider lets ByteDance AppLog DevTools attach its saved debugging files to a share action.
en.disableEffect: Files from the AppLog debugging tools can no longer be shared, while the app’s normal features remain available.

zh-CN.description: 这个提供程序让字节跳动 AppLog DevTools 可以通过系统分享功能发送其保存的调试文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，AppLog 调试工具保存的文件将无法分享，但应用的日常功能仍可使用。

en.description: This ByteDance AppLog testing screen opens from a browser link or a development shortcut to check event tracking. It reads test settings and can open the host app when no screen is already running.
en.disableEffect: AppLog event-tracking test links will no longer open this screen; normal app launches still work.

zh-CN.description: 这个字节跳动 AppLog 测试页面可通过浏览器链接或开发调试入口打开，用于检查事件埋点。它会读取测试参数；若应用尚未运行，也会尝试启动应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，AppLog 埋点测试链接将无法打开此页面，但应用仍可正常启动。

en.description: When a developer opens a Rangers AppLog debug link from its QR workflow, ByteDance's Rangers AppLog SDK checks the app's logging session and starts an event-simulation session in the app.
en.disableEffect: Blocking it only prevents this AppLog QR-based debug session; normal app startup and features remain available.

zh-CN.description: 开发者通过 Rangers AppLog 的二维码流程打开调试链接时，字节跳动的 Rangers AppLog SDK 会校验应用的日志会话，并在应用中启动事件模拟会话。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后将无法通过 AppLog 二维码启动此调试会话，应用的正常启动和功能不受影响。

en.description: ByteDance Embed AppLog sends internal batches of app events to this receiver, which forwards them to the analytics SDK. It handles tracking data rather than an app screen.
en.disableEffect: Blocking it stops this component from forwarding those analytics events, while the app’s own screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: 字节跳动 Embed AppLog 会把应用事件批次通过内部广播交给此接收器，再由它转交给统计 SDK；它处理的是统计数据，不会显示应用页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，此组件不会再转交这些统计事件，但应用自身页面仍可使用。

en.description: Splash screen advertisement shown when the app starts.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时展示的开屏广告。

en.description: GroMore bundles ByteDance MapLog, which processes analytics data when the SDK sends a broadcast.
en.disableEffect: MapLog analytics broadcasts sent to this receiver will no longer be processed.

zh-CN.description: GroMore 集成的字节跳动 MapLog 会在 SDK 发出广播时处理统计数据。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 发给此接收器的 MapLog 统计广播将不再被处理。

en.description: GroMore (ByteDance’s ad SDK) uses this hidden screen when an ad network requests location, device-information, or storage access. It displays Android’s permission request for that ad service.
en.disableEffect: Ads from partner networks that request these permissions may lose targeting or download features; the app’s own screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: GroMore（字节跳动广告聚合 SDK）在广告网络请求位置、电话状态或存储权限时会使用此隐藏页面，并显示 Android 的权限请求。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要这些权限的聚合广告可能失去定向或下载功能，但应用自身页面仍可使用。

en.description: GroMore uses this invisible screen during some transitions between the app and a full-screen ad, without showing an extra page.
en.disableEffect: Some mediated ads may fail to open or return correctly.

zh-CN.description: GroMore 会在部分全屏广告切换过程中打开此透明页面，让切换过程不显示额外页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 部分聚合广告可能无法正常打开或返回。

en.description: GroMore displays an optional prompt after a rewarded-ad view, offering the user another chance to watch an ad or to stop.
en.disableEffect: The extra watch-again offer will disappear, and rewards for ads watched through that offer will no longer be granted.

zh-CN.description: 用户看完激励广告后，GroMore 可以显示此提示，让用户选择再看一次广告或结束。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 额外的再看一次提示将不再显示，通过该提示观看广告也不会再获得奖励。

en.description: When Pangle's plug-in runtime needs to install or share a file, this provider creates a private content link and serves the file or its basic details to the requesting component.
en.disableEffect: Pangle plug-in installation and file sharing may fail when they need this provider, and related ad pages may not open.

zh-CN.description: 穿山甲插件运行环境需要安装或分享文件时，此 Provider 会生成私有内容链接，并向请求组件提供文件或其基本信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要此 Provider 的穿山甲插件安装和文件分享可能失败，相关广告页面也可能无法打开。

en.description: Pangle (ByteDance) uses this provider in the app's main process to handle requests from its ad modules.
en.disableEffect: Pangle ads that need this provider will not work.

zh-CN.description: Pangle（字节跳动）使用此内容提供器，在应用主进程中处理广告模块的请求。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要此提供器的 Pangle 广告将无法正常运行。

en.description: Pangle (ByteDance) uses this provider to connect its ad process to the main ad service and obtain service connections when the app process starts. It has no screen.
en.disableEffect: Pangle ads and their plug-in services will stop working, while the app’s non-ad features remain available.

zh-CN.description: Pangle（字节跳动）会通过此提供程序连接广告进程与主广告服务，并取得广告服务连接；它在应用进程启动时由系统创建，不显示界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Pangle 广告及其插件服务将无法使用，应用的非广告功能仍可运行。

en.description: This ByteDance RheaTrace receiver listens for commands to start or stop a performance trace. It runs only when one of those tracing commands is sent.
en.disableEffect: Those commands can no longer start or stop RheaTrace; the app’s normal features remain available.

zh-CN.description: 这个字节跳动 RheaTrace 接收器会响应开始或停止性能跟踪的命令。只有发送这类跟踪命令时它才会运行。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，这些命令将无法启动或停止 RheaTrace，但应用的日常功能仍可使用。

en.description: ByteDance's one-tap phone-login module clears its cached SIM details when Android reports a SIM-state change.
en.disableEffect: The phone-login module will not refresh this cache after a SIM change, which can prevent one-tap login from using the current SIM.

zh-CN.description: Android 检测到 SIM 卡状态变化时，ByteDance 的一键手机号登录模块会清除缓存的 SIM 卡信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 屏蔽后，SIM 卡更换时登录模块不会刷新缓存，可能无法使用当前 SIM 卡完成一键登录。

en.description: When a game requests a Douyin account sign-in, ByteDance's Douyin Open Platform SDK shows its web authorization page and returns the user's approval result to the game.
en.disableEffect: The game cannot complete its Douyin account sign-in or authorization flow.

zh-CN.description: 游戏请求抖音账号登录时，ByteDance 抖音开放平台 SDK 会显示网页授权页面，并把用户的授权结果返回游戏。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 屏蔽后，游戏无法完成抖音账号登录或授权流程。

en.description: When a game requests a TikTok account sign-in, ByteDance's TikTok Open Platform SDK shows its web authorization page and returns the user's approval result to the game.
en.disableEffect: The game cannot complete its TikTok account sign-in or authorization flow.

zh-CN.description: 游戏请求 TikTok 账号登录时，ByteDance TikTok 开放平台 SDK 会显示网页授权页面，并把用户的授权结果返回游戏。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 屏蔽后，游戏无法完成 TikTok 账号登录或授权流程。

en.description: This TikTok Open SDK activity displays a web page where the user authorizes the app with TikTok, then returns the result to the app.
en.disableEffect: TikTok authorization and sign-in flows that use this page cannot complete.

zh-CN.description: 这个 TikTok Open SDK 页面会显示网页授权流程，让用户允许应用访问 TikTok，然后把授权结果返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，依赖此页面的 TikTok 授权和登录流程将无法完成。

en.description: The Pangle (ByteDance) ad SDK uses this Provider to pass downloaded ad files to Android or another app when an ad download needs to open or install a file.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it can stop Pangle ad downloads from opening or installing their files.

zh-CN.description: Pangle（字节跳动）广告 SDK 使用此 Provider 在广告下载需要打开或安装文件时，将已下载的广告文件交给 Android 或其他应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Pangle 广告下载可能无法打开或安装相应文件。

en.description: During an ad or ad-download flow, the Pangle (ByteDance) ad SDK opens this Activity to show a permission, consent, or app-download confirmation prompt.
en.disableEffect: Pangle permission, consent, and ad-download prompts that use this screen will not appear.

zh-CN.description: 广告或广告下载过程中，Pangle（字节跳动）广告 SDK 会打开此 Activity 显示权限、同意或应用下载确认提示。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此页面的 Pangle 权限、同意及广告下载提示将无法显示。

en.description: When the app requests a Pangle full-screen video ad, this Activity shows the video and its controls.
en.disableEffect: Pangle full-screen video ads that use this screen will not appear.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求 Pangle 全屏视频广告时，此 Activity 会显示视频和操作控件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此页面的 Pangle 全屏视频广告将无法显示。

en.description: When the app requests a Pangle full-screen video ad, this Activity shows the video and its controls.
en.disableEffect: Pangle full-screen video ads that use this screen will not appear.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求 Pangle 全屏视频广告时，此 Activity 会显示视频和操作控件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此页面的 Pangle 全屏视频广告将无法显示。

en.description: When Pangle shows full-screen web ad content, this Activity displays the ad page inside the app, including reward-style web ads that use this screen.
en.disableEffect: Pangle web ads using this screen will not open, and rewards for watching rewarded ads will no longer be granted.

zh-CN.description: Pangle 展示全屏网页广告时，此 Activity 会在应用内显示广告页面，包括使用此页面的网页激励广告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此页面的 Pangle 网页广告将无法打开，观看激励广告的奖励也将不再发放。

en.description: After a user taps a Pangle ad, this Activity opens the advertiser’s destination page inside the app and shows its links.
en.disableEffect: The advertiser’s page for that Pangle ad will not open inside the app.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击 Pangle 广告后，此 Activity 会在应用内打开广告主的目标页面并显示页面链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 该 Pangle 广告的广告主页面将无法在应用内打开。

en.description: When a Pangle ad opens an interactive playable or linked page, this Activity displays the page and lets the viewer use its controls.
en.disableEffect: Interactive Pangle ad pages that use this screen will not open.

zh-CN.description: 当 Pangle 广告打开互动试玩或链接页面时，此 Activity 会显示该页面并提供操作控件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此页面的 Pangle 互动广告将无法打开。

en.description: When the app requests a Pangle rewarded video ad, this Activity shows the video and its controls.
en.disableEffect: The Pangle rewarded video will not open, and rewards for watching ads will no longer be granted.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求 Pangle 激励视频广告时，此 Activity 会显示视频和操作控件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Pangle 激励视频将无法打开，观看广告的奖励也将不再发放。

en.description: When the app requests a Pangle rewarded video ad, this Activity shows the video and its controls.
en.disableEffect: The Pangle rewarded video will not open, and rewards for watching ads will no longer be granted.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求 Pangle 激励视频广告时，此 Activity 会显示视频和操作控件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Pangle 激励视频将无法打开，观看广告的奖励也将不再发放。

en.description: When the app requests a web-based Pangle rewarded ad, this Activity shows the ad page inside the app.

zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此页面的 Pangle 广告反馈功能将无法使用。

en.description: When Pangle loads an ad through its background service, the Pangle (ByteDance) ad SDK uses this Service to pass the ad request and result so the ad can open.
en.disableEffect: Pangle ad formats that rely on this Service may fail to load.

zh-CN.description: 当 Pangle 通过后台服务加载广告时，Pangle（字节跳动）广告 SDK 使用此 Service 传递广告请求和结果，以便打开广告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此 Service 的 Pangle 广告可能无法加载。

en.description: When a user gives feedback about a Pangle ad, this Activity opens the ad feedback page so the user can submit a response.
en.disableEffect: The Pangle ad feedback page that uses this screen will not open.

zh-CN.description: 用户反馈 Pangle 广告时，此 Activity 会打开广告反馈页面供用户提交意见。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此页面的 Pangle 广告反馈功能将无法使用。

en.description: When an ad download needs notification permission or a download action, the Pangle (ByteDance) ad SDK opens this Activity to show the prompt or handle that action.
en.disableEffect: Pangle ad download prompts and related download actions will not work.

zh-CN.description: 广告下载需要通知权限或处理下载操作时，Pangle（字节跳动）广告 SDK 会打开此 Activity 显示提示或处理该操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Pangle 广告下载提示及相关下载操作将无法使用。

en.description: When a user starts an ad download, the Pangle (ByteDance) ad SDK uses this Service to handle the download request and its follow-up actions.
en.disableEffect: Pangle ad downloads that rely on this Service will not start or complete.

zh-CN.description: 用户开始下载广告内容时，Pangle（字节跳动）广告 SDK 使用此 Service 处理下载请求及后续操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此 Service 的 Pangle 广告下载将无法开始或完成。

en.description: When Pangle handles an ad through its background service, the Pangle (ByteDance) ad SDK uses this ContentProvider to pass the information needed to show the ad.
en.disableEffect: Blocking it can stop Pangle ads that rely on this background service from loading.

zh-CN.description: 当 Pangle 通过后台服务处理广告时，Pangle（字节跳动）广告 SDK 使用此 ContentProvider 传递显示广告所需的信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，依赖此后台服务的 Pangle 广告可能无法加载。

en.description: During ad display, the Pangle (ByteDance) ad SDK uses this Activity to show ad content and its on-screen controls.

zh-CN.description: 展示广告时，Pangle（字节跳动）广告 SDK 使用此 Activity 显示广告内容和屏幕操作控件。

zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此显示方式的 Pangle 广告页面将无法打开。

en.disableEffect: Pangle ad screens that use this display will not open.

zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此显示方式的 Pangle 广告页面将无法打开。

zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此显示方式的 Pangle 广告页面将无法打开。

en.description: During ad display, the Pangle (ByteDance) ad SDK uses this Activity to show ad content and its on-screen controls in landscape orientation.
en.disableEffect: Pangle ad screens that use this display will not open.

zh-CN.description: 展示广告时，Pangle（字节跳动）广告 SDK 使用此 Activity 显示广告内容和屏幕操作控件，以横屏显示。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此显示方式的 Pangle 广告页面将无法打开。

en.description: During ad display, the Pangle (ByteDance) ad SDK uses this Activity to show ad content and its on-screen controls in portrait orientation.
en.disableEffect: Pangle ad screens that use this display will not open.

zh-CN.description: 展示广告时，Pangle（字节跳动）广告 SDK 使用此 Activity 显示广告内容和屏幕操作控件，以竖屏显示。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此显示方式的 Pangle 广告页面将无法打开。

en.description: When Pangle starts an ad download, the Pangle (ByteDance) ad SDK uses this Provider to prepare the background service that handles the download.
en.disableEffect: Blocking it can prevent Pangle’s background ad downloader from starting.

zh-CN.description: 当 Pangle 开始下载广告时，Pangle（字节跳动）广告 SDK 使用此 Provider 准备处理下载的后台服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Pangle 的后台广告下载服务可能无法启动。

en.description: When the app opens, the Pangle (ByteDance) ad SDK uses this Provider to set up its ad features and respond to app screen changes.
en.disableEffect: Blocking it can prevent Pangle ads from being set up when the app opens.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开时，Pangle（字节跳动）广告 SDK 使用此 Provider 设置广告功能，并响应应用页面的变化。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Pangle 广告可能无法在应用打开时完成设置。

en.description: ByteDance VGame opens this screen when it needs Android to request runtime permissions, then receives the user’s choices.
en.disableEffect: The SDK’s permission requests cannot be shown, which can limit its ad or tracking services; the host app’s own screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: 字节跳动 VGame SDK 需要向 Android 申请运行时权限时会打开此页面，并接收用户的选择结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，SDK 无法显示这些权限请求，其广告或统计服务可能受限，但应用自身页面仍可使用。

en.description: This Pangle (ByteDance) ad SDK service uploads crash details in a separate process and removes saved report files after a successful upload.
en.disableEffect: Pangle crash reports will not be uploaded, while the app’s normal features remain available.

zh-CN.description: 这是穿山甲（字节跳动）广告 SDK 的崩溃报告服务，会在独立进程中上传崩溃信息，并在上传成功后清理已保存的报告文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，穿山甲 SDK 的崩溃报告不会上传，但应用的日常功能仍可使用。

en.description: This ByteDance CodeLocator provider starts the UI inspection tool with the app process and reports its status when the tool requests it.
en.disableEffect: The CodeLocator inspection tool will not start or report status; ordinary app features remain available.

zh-CN.description: 应用进程启动时，这个字节跳动 CodeLocator 提供程序会启动界面检查工具，并在工具查询时返回状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，CodeLocator 检查工具将无法启动或获取状态，但应用的日常功能仍可使用。

en.description: When ByteTrack shares an image or attachment, this Provider exposes an allowed app file through an Android content link. It supports the SDK's media and message-sharing flows.
en.disableEffect: Message attachments or media-sharing flows that need these file links may fail.

zh-CN.description: ByteTrack 需要分享图片或附件时，此 Provider 会通过 Android 内容链接提供获准访问的应用文件，支持 SDK 的媒体和消息分享。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖这些文件链接的消息附件或媒体分享可能失败。

en.description: At app startup, this Provider registers screen-lifecycle callbacks so ByteTrack's floating message controls can track the screen in front. This supports the SDK's floating contact and message view.
en.disableEffect: ByteTrack's floating contact or message view may not follow app screens or open correctly.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，此 Provider 会注册页面生命周期监听，让 ByteTrack 的悬浮消息控件跟踪当前显示的页面，支持 SDK 的悬浮联系和消息窗口。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，ByteTrack 的悬浮联系或消息窗口可能无法跟随应用页面正常显示或打开。

en.description: At app startup, this Provider initializes the activity-lifecycle handling used by ByteTrack's floating-window feature.
en.disableEffect: ByteTrack's floating contact or message window may not follow app screens or open correctly.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，此 Provider 会初始化 ByteTrack 悬浮窗口功能所需的页面生命周期处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，ByteTrack 的悬浮联系或消息窗口可能无法跟随应用页面正常显示或打开。

en.description: Opened when a user taps a ByteTrack link, this Activity loads the page inside the app and offers back, copy, and open-in-browser controls.
en.disableEffect: ByteTrack article, message, and shared links may no longer open inside the app.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击 ByteTrack 链接时会打开此 Activity，在应用内浏览网页，并可返回、复制或用外部浏览器打开。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，ByteTrack 文章、消息和分享链接可能无法在应用内打开。

en.description: Opened when ByteTrack requests a photo, video, or audio selection, this Activity displays the SDK's media picker and returns the selected items.
en.disableEffect: Picking media for ByteTrack messages or other SDK screens may fail.

zh-CN.description: ByteTrack 请求选择图片、视频或音频时，会打开此 Activity 显示 SDK 媒体选择器并返回选中的内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，ByteTrack 消息或其他 SDK 页面可能无法选择媒体。

en.description: Opened for ByteTrack system-picker and camera flows, this transparent Activity runs the selection or capture screen and returns the chosen media.
en.disableEffect: Media selection or camera capture in ByteTrack may stop returning results.

zh-CN.description: ByteTrack 启动系统相册或相机流程时，会打开此透明 Activity 承载选择或拍摄页面，并返回选中的媒体。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，ByteTrack 的媒体选择或拍摄可能无法返回结果。

en.description: When a ByteTrack media-picker session uses camera or audio capture that must continue in the foreground, this Service displays a notification and keeps the capture session running.
en.disableEffect: Camera or audio capture may stop or be interrupted while the app is in the background.

zh-CN.description: ByteTrack 媒体选择器使用相机或音频采集并需要在前台持续运行时，此 Service 会显示通知并保持采集任务运行。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用在后台时的相机或音频采集可能停止或中断。

en.description: ByteTrack starts this Service after app screens become active to maintain the SDK's live messaging connection and handle incoming chat updates and floating notices.
en.disableEffect: New ByteTrack messages and floating alerts may not arrive in real time; existing screens and message history remain available.

zh-CN.description: 应用页面启动后，ByteTrack 会运行此 Service 维持 SDK 实时消息连接，并处理收到的聊天更新和悬浮提醒。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，新的 ByteTrack 消息和悬浮提醒可能无法实时送达；现有页面和消息记录仍可查看。

en.description: Opened when a user taps a ByteTrack article, this Activity loads the full article in an in-app browser and provides language and sharing controls.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open full ByteTrack article content from messages or recommendations.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击 ByteTrack 文章时会打开此 Activity，在应用内浏览完整内容，并提供语言和分享选项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法从消息或推荐内容中打开 ByteTrack 文章全文。

en.description: Opened from ByteTrack's inbox or article recommendations, this Activity lists recommended articles and opens the search screen.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot browse ByteTrack recommendations or enter article search from this list.

zh-CN.description: 从 ByteTrack 收件箱或文章推荐入口进入后，此 Activity 会列出推荐文章并可打开搜索页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法浏览 ByteTrack 推荐文章，也无法从此列表进入搜索。

en.description: Opened from the recommended-article list, this Activity searches ByteTrack articles and displays matching results.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot search ByteTrack's recommended-article catalog.

zh-CN.description: 从推荐文章列表进入后，此 Activity 可搜索 ByteTrack 文章并显示匹配结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法搜索 ByteTrack 的推荐文章。

en.description: Opened from a ByteTrack inbox or dedicated-chat entry, this Activity displays a conversation and supports sending replies and media.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open or continue ByteTrack conversations.

zh-CN.description: 从 ByteTrack 收件箱或专属聊天入口进入后，此 Activity 会显示对话，并支持发送回复和媒体。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法打开或继续 ByteTrack 对话。

en.description: Opened from a ByteTrack group conversation, this Activity shows the group name, member details, and whether members are online.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot inspect ByteTrack group members or their online status.

zh-CN.description: 从 ByteTrack 群聊进入后，此 Activity 会显示群名称、成员详情及成员在线状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法查看 ByteTrack 群成员及其在线状态。

en.description: Opened when a user selects a ByteTrack Explore item, this Activity displays its linked content and offers sharing or external-browser controls.
en.disableEffect: ByteTrack Explore detail pages may no longer open.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择 ByteTrack 探索内容时会打开此 Activity，显示相关网页并提供分享或外部浏览器选项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，ByteTrack 探索详情页可能无法打开。

en.description: Opened from ByteTrack's main entry, this Activity combines recent conversations with recommended articles and Explore items, and lets users start a chat.
en.disableEffect: The ByteTrack inbox and its conversation, article, and Explore entry points are unavailable.

zh-CN.description: 从 ByteTrack 主入口进入后，此 Activity 会汇总近期对话、推荐文章和探索内容，并可开始聊天。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，ByteTrack 收件箱及其对话、文章和探索入口都无法使用。

en.description: Opened from the ByteTrack inbox, this Activity lists all conversations and opens a selected chat.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot browse all ByteTrack conversations or resume a chat from this list.

zh-CN.description: 从 ByteTrack 收件箱进入后，此 Activity 会列出所有对话，并可打开选中的聊天。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法浏览 ByteTrack 的全部对话，也无法从此列表继续聊天。

en.description: Opened from ByteTrack's inbox notification control, this Activity fetches and groups notices into tabs and lets users clear the unread indicator.
en.disableEffect: Users lose the ByteTrack notification list and cannot clear its unread indicator from the notice center.

zh-CN.description: 从 ByteTrack 收件箱的通知入口进入后，此 Activity 会获取并分类展示通知，也可清除未读提示。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法查看 ByteTrack 通知列表，也无法在通知中心清除未读提示。

en.description: Opened when a user selects a ByteTrack notice, this Activity displays its title, time, text, and image.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open the full content of ByteTrack notices.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择一条 ByteTrack 通知后，会打开此 Activity 查看标题、时间、文字和图片。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法打开 ByteTrack 通知的完整内容。

en.description: Opened when a user taps an image attachment, this Activity displays a large preview and can save the original image.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot view ByteTrack images full-size or save the original from this screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击图片附件时会打开此 Activity 查看大图，也可保存原始图片。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法在此页面查看 ByteTrack 图片大图或保存原图。

en.description: Opened when a user taps a video attachment, this Activity plays the selected video with playback controls.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot preview ByteTrack videos from messages.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击视频附件时会打开此 Activity 播放视频并提供播放控制。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法预览 ByteTrack 消息中的视频。

en.description: This CA Mobile App Services service processes sign-in and protected-request work, including obtaining credentials and returning authentication results to the app.
en.disableEffect: Apps that rely on MAS for sign-in or protected API requests may fail to authenticate or renew a session.

zh-CN.description: 这个 CA Mobile App Services 服务会处理登录和受保护请求，包括获取凭据并向应用返回认证结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖 MAS 登录或访问受保护接口的应用可能无法完成认证或续期会话。

en.description: When a browser returns from sign-in, this CA MAS activity reads the authorization result and completes the user login or reports an error.
en.disableEffect: Browser-based MAS sign-in cannot finish when its return link is opened.

zh-CN.description: 浏览器登录返回应用时，这个 CA MAS 页面会读取授权结果并完成登录，或显示认证错误。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，浏览器返回的登录链接无法完成 MAS 登录流程。

en.description: This CA MAS activity provides an in-app web screen for an enterprise sign-in address and shows its loading progress.
en.disableEffect: Enterprise web sign-in pages that use MAS will not open inside the app.

zh-CN.description: 这个 CA MAS 页面会在应用内显示企业登录网页，并显示页面加载进度。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，使用 MAS 的企业网页登录流程将无法在应用内打开。

en.description: This CA MAS activity handles a cancelled authentication request by showing a cancellation notice and cancelling outstanding MAS requests.
en.disableEffect: MAS may not clean up a cancelled sign-in request, leaving the authentication flow unresolved.

zh-CN.description: 认证请求被取消时，这个 CA MAS 页面会显示取消提示，并取消尚未完成的 MAS 请求。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，MAS 可能无法清理已取消的登录请求，导致认证流程无法正常结束。

en.description: This CA MAS activity presents the sign-in methods configured by the app, including username and password and available enterprise or social options.
en.disableEffect: Users may be unable to sign in through the app’s MAS login flow.

zh-CN.description: 这个 CA MAS 页面会显示应用配置的登录方式，包括用户名密码，以及可用的企业或社交账号选项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，用户可能无法通过应用的 MAS 登录流程登录。

en.description: This CA MAS activity receives the return from browser-based OAuth sign-in, submits the authorization result to MAS, and shows any login error.
en.disableEffect: MAS browser-based OAuth sign-in cannot complete through this return path.

zh-CN.description: 浏览器 OAuth 登录返回应用时，这个 CA MAS 页面会把授权结果交给 MAS 处理，并显示登录错误。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，MAS 无法通过此返回路径完成浏览器 OAuth 登录。

en.description: When MAS needs the current user to unlock a protected session, this activity asks for the device credential and then retries the unlock.
en.disableEffect: The user’s MAS session may remain locked, preventing access to protected app features.

zh-CN.description: MAS 要求当前用户解锁受保护的会话时，这个页面会请求设备凭据，然后重试解锁。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，用户的 MAS 会话可能仍处于锁定状态，无法访问受保护的应用功能。

en.description: This CA MAS activity displays a one-time-code prompt when the authentication service requests another verification step.
en.disableEffect: Sign-ins that require a one-time code cannot be completed.

zh-CN.description: 认证服务要求进一步验证时，这个 CA MAS 页面会显示一次性验证码输入提示。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，需要一次性验证码的登录流程将无法完成。

en.description: Enowr Android Auth Library opens this screen while the app signs in through a supported identity provider, then returns the sign-in result to the app.
en.disableEffect: Sign-in through providers handled by this library will fail or return without an authentication result.

zh-CN.description: Enowr Android Auth 登录库会在应用通过受支持的身份服务登录时打开此界面，并将登录结果返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过该库接入的登录方式将无法正常打开或返回认证结果。

en.description: At app startup, this Provider registers the coroutine HTTP library's response converter and GET/POST request handlers. Screens using this library rely on those registrations to load network data.
en.disableEffect: Requests made through this HTTP library may lack their converter or handlers and fail, leaving the affected app data unavailable.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，此 Provider 会注册协程 HTTP 库的响应转换器以及 GET/POST 请求处理器。使用该库的页面依靠这些注册来加载网络数据。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，通过该 HTTP 库发起的请求可能缺少转换器或处理器而失败，相关应用数据将无法加载。

en.description: At app startup, this Provider enables Caldremch's diagnostic logger and network-log monitoring, and registers for app lifecycle changes.
en.disableEffect: Automatic diagnostic and network logging stops; normal app screens and requests can continue without this logging setup.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，此 Provider 会开启 Caldremch 诊断日志和网络日志监测，并注册应用生命周期监听。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，自动诊断和网络日志会停止；应用页面和请求仍可在没有这套日志配置的情况下运行。

en.description: At app startup, this Provider registers Caldremch's Retrofit and RxJava HTTP module for the app's network requests.
en.disableEffect: Features that make requests through this library may not initialize or load their server data.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，此 Provider 会为应用网络请求注册 Caldremch 的 Retrofit 和 RxJava HTTP 模块。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，依赖该库发起请求的功能可能无法初始化或加载服务器数据。

en.description: Started by the Caldremch utility library when it needs to open another screen and return that screen's result, this transparent Activity completes the request and reports the result to its caller.
en.disableEffect: Utility flows that wait for another screen's result may not complete correctly.
