zh-CN.description: Caldremch 工具库需要打开另一个页面并取得结果时，会启动此透明 Activity 来完成请求并把结果返回给调用页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，依赖其他页面返回结果的工具流程可能无法正常完成。

en.description: Started when an app feature requests runtime permissions through Caldremch's utility library, this Activity opens Android's system permission prompt and returns the grant result.
en.disableEffect: Features that request camera, storage, or media access through this helper may not receive the required permission.

zh-CN.description: 应用功能通过 Caldremch 工具库请求运行时权限时，此 Activity 会打开 Android 系统权限提示并返回授权结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此工具申请相机、存储或媒体权限的功能可能无法获得所需授权。

en.description: At app startup, this Caldremch utilities Provider initializes shared Android utilities and provides shareable links to allowed app files.
en.disableEffect: File-sharing flows and utility calls that need the app context may stop working.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，此 Caldremch 工具 Provider 会初始化共享 Android 工具，并为获准访问的应用文件提供可分享链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，文件分享和依赖应用上下文的工具调用可能无法正常工作。

en.description: The CanHub Android Image Cropper uses this provider to pass camera-captured photos to the cropping flow through a private content link. Its manifest also configures the image files the cropper can share.
en.disableEffect: The cropper may fail to open the camera or pass its captured image to the cropping screen.

zh-CN.description: CanHub Android Image Cropper 使用此文件提供程序，通过私有内容链接将相机拍摄的照片传给裁剪流程。清单还配置了裁剪器可共享的图像文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 裁剪器可能无法打开相机，也无法将拍摄的照片交给裁剪页面。

en.description: The CanHub Android Image Cropper opens this screen when an app starts an image-cropping flow. Users can choose or take a photo, crop or rotate it, and return the result to the app.
en.disableEffect: Apps using this library will not be able to complete photo-cropping flows such as choosing a profile or upload image.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动图片裁剪流程时，CanHub Android Image Cropper 会打开此页面。用户可以选择或拍摄照片、裁剪或旋转照片，然后将结果返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此库的应用将无法完成图片裁剪，例如选择头像或上传图片。

en.description: The Capacitor Browser plugin coordinates opening a web link in an Android Custom Tab and returns control when the tab closes. If disabled, sign-in, checkout, or help pages that the app opens through this browser may fail.
en.disableEffect: The app may be unable to open or complete web flows that use the Capacitor Browser plugin.

zh-CN.description: Capacitor Browser 插件通过 Android 自定义标签页打开网页，并在页面关闭时把控制权交还给应用。禁用后，应用通过此浏览器打开的登录、结账或帮助页面可能无法正常使用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用可能无法打开或完成通过 Capacitor Browser 插件进行的网页流程。

en.description: When Android reports that the device has booted and the user profile is unlocked, Capacitor Local Notifications reloads saved reminders and schedules them again. This keeps app reminders available after a restart.
en.disableEffect: Scheduled local reminders may be lost after the device restarts.

zh-CN.description: 设备启动且用户配置已解锁后，Capacitor Local Notifications 会读取已保存的提醒并重新安排，以便重启后继续显示应用提醒。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 设备重启后，已安排的本地提醒可能不再出现。

en.description: Capacitor Local Notifications uses this Android file provider to make local sound files available to notifications. If disabled, notifications that use custom sounds stored in the app may lose that sound or fail to schedule correctly.
en.disableEffect: Custom sounds stored in the app may not play in local notifications.

zh-CN.description: Capacitor Local Notifications 通过 Android 文件提供程序向通知提供应用中的本地声音文件。禁用后，使用应用内自定义声音的通知可能无法播放该声音，或无法正常安排。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 本地通知可能无法播放存放在应用中的自定义声音。

en.description: When a user dismisses a Capacitor local notification, this receiver removes its saved record when the reminder can safely be forgotten. This keeps dismissed one-time reminders from being restored later.
en.disableEffect: Dismissed reminders may remain saved and can reappear after the app restores its notifications.

zh-CN.description: 用户清除 Capacitor 本地通知后，此接收器会在可以安全删除时移除已保存的提醒记录，避免一次性提醒之后再次恢复。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 已清除的提醒可能仍保存在记录中，并在应用恢复通知时再次出现。

en.description: When a scheduled Capacitor local notification alarm fires, this receiver displays the notification and schedules the next occurrence for repeating reminders. It also forwards the received reminder to the plugin.
en.disableEffect: Scheduled local notifications will not appear at their set times.

zh-CN.description: Capacitor 本地通知的定时提醒到期时，此接收器会显示通知；对于重复提醒，还会安排下一次触发，并把提醒转交给插件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 已安排的本地通知将无法在设定时间显示。

en.description: When Firebase delivers a push message or refreshes the device's registration token, the Capacitor Push Notifications plugin forwards it to the app's push handler. Disabling it stops this plugin from receiving pushes and token updates.
en.disableEffect: Push messages and refreshed registration tokens will no longer reach the app through Capacitor Push Notifications.

zh-CN.description: Firebase 投递推送消息或更新设备注册令牌时，Capacitor Push Notifications 插件会将消息或新令牌交给应用处理。禁用后，该插件将不再接收推送或令牌更新。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法再通过 Capacitor Push Notifications 接收推送消息或新的注册令牌。

en.description: When a card payment requires a Cardinal 3-D Secure challenge, this screen displays the issuer challenge as a web page and returns the customer response.
en.disableEffect: A payment that requires this security challenge cannot be authenticated.

zh-CN.description: 银行卡付款需要 Cardinal 3-D Secure 安全挑战时，此页面会以网页形式显示发卡机构的验证内容，并提交用户的响应。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要此项安全挑战的付款将无法完成验证。

en.description: When a card payment requires a Cardinal 3-D Secure challenge, this screen displays the issuer challenge using native controls and returns the customer response.
en.disableEffect: A payment that requires this security challenge cannot be authenticated.

zh-CN.description: 银行卡付款需要 Cardinal 3-D Secure 安全挑战时，此页面会使用原生控件显示发卡机构的验证内容，并提交用户的响应。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要此项安全挑战的付款将无法完成验证。

en.description: When CardInfoLink Smart POS logging uploads are enabled and a network connection is available, this service sends stored diagnostic log files. It is for log delivery rather than the POS screen or payment flow.
en.disableEffect: CardInfoLink diagnostic logs will no longer upload through this service.

zh-CN.description: 启用 CardInfoLink Smart POS 日志上传且网络可用时，此服务会发送已保存的诊断日志。它负责传送日志，不负责 POS 界面或支付流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: CardInfoLink 诊断日志将不再通过此服务上传。

en.description: CardInfoLink Smart POS schedules this service to upload diagnostic logs periodically when the device is idle and online. Disabling it stops background log uploads.
en.disableEffect: Background CardInfoLink diagnostic log uploads will stop.

zh-CN.description: CardInfoLink Smart POS 会在设备空闲且联网时定期运行此服务，上传诊断日志。禁用后，后台日志上传会停止。
zh-CN.disableEffect: CardInfoLink 诊断日志的后台上传会停止。

en.description: CardInfoLink Smart POS listens for screen on, screen off, and user-present events, then asks its log service to upload logs when allowed. It does not handle the POS payment interaction.
en.disableEffect: Screen-state changes will no longer trigger CardInfoLink log uploads.

zh-CN.description: CardInfoLink Smart POS 监听屏幕亮起、熄灭和用户解锁事件，并在允许时请求日志服务上传记录。它不处理 POS 支付操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 屏幕状态变化将不再触发 CardInfoLink 日志上传。

en.description: The Bullhorn audio SDK runs this background service for episode downloads and shows download progress in a notification. It can resume scheduled downloads when the system restarts them.
en.disableEffect: Episodes will no longer download or resume in the background.

zh-CN.description: Bullhorn 音频 SDK 通过此后台服务下载节目，并在通知中显示进度；系统重新启动已安排的下载时，它也会继续处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 节目将无法在后台下载或续传。

en.description: The Bullhorn audio SDK receives Firebase push messages, passes them to its notification system, and updates the delivery token when Firebase issues a new one.
en.disableEffect: Bullhorn push messages will stop arriving, and their delivery token will no longer refresh.

zh-CN.description: Bullhorn 音频 SDK 接收 Firebase 推送消息并交给其通知系统处理；Firebase 生成新令牌时，此服务也会更新推送令牌。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Bullhorn 推送消息将无法送达，推送令牌也不会再更新。

en.description: The Bullhorn audio SDK starts this service for audio playback, creates the player and media session, and supplies a playback notification for system controls.
en.disableEffect: Bullhorn audio playback, including background playback and system media controls, will stop working.

zh-CN.description: Bullhorn 音频 SDK 通过此服务播放音频、建立媒体会话，并提供供系统控件使用的播放通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Bullhorn 音频播放、后台播放和系统媒体控件都将无法使用。

en.description: The Bullhorn audio SDK starts this service while a media session or live audio stream is active and keeps playback controls available in a notification.
en.disableEffect: Background audio playback and its notification controls will stop working.

zh-CN.description: Bullhorn 音频 SDK 在媒体会话或实时音频流播放时启动此服务，并通过通知提供播放控件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 后台音频播放和通知中的播放控件将无法使用。

en.description: The Bullhorn audio SDK uses this compatibility service during playback to keep a media session and its notification controls available on older integrations.
en.disableEffect: Playback notifications and background audio controls for those integrations will stop working.

zh-CN.description: Bullhorn 音频 SDK 在旧版集成中通过此兼容服务维持媒体会话和通知播放控件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 这些集成的播放通知和后台音频控件将无法使用。

en.description: The Bullhorn audio SDK uses this receiver for playback buttons and the stop action attached to its media notification, forwarding the selected action to the active media session.
en.disableEffect: Playback controls and the stop action in the older media notification will no longer control audio.

zh-CN.description: Bullhorn 音频 SDK 通过此接收器处理媒体通知中的播放按钮和停止操作，并将所选操作传给当前媒体会话。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 旧版媒体通知中的播放控件和停止操作将无法控制音频。

en.description: The Bullhorn audio SDK uses this receiver for playback buttons and the stop action attached to its media notification, forwarding the selected action to the active media session.
en.disableEffect: Playback controls and the stop action in the media notification will no longer control audio.

zh-CN.description: Bullhorn 音频 SDK 通过此接收器处理媒体通知中的播放按钮和停止操作，并将所选操作传给当前媒体会话。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 媒体通知中的播放控件和停止操作将无法控制音频。

en.description: The Bullhorn audio SDK uses this receiver when a user dismisses one of its notifications, so the alert is also removed from the in-app notification list.
en.disableEffect: A dismissed Bullhorn alert may remain marked as active in the in-app notification list.

zh-CN.description: 用户关闭 Bullhorn 通知时，音频 SDK 会通过此接收器同步移除应用内列表中的对应提醒。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户关闭 Bullhorn 提醒后，它在应用内通知列表中可能仍显示为未处理。

en.description: The Bullhorn audio SDK opens this screen when the listener views downloaded episodes; it also provides a way to remove all downloads.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to review or clear downloaded episodes from this screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户查看已下载节目时，Bullhorn 音频 SDK 会打开此页面；页面还提供清除全部下载内容的选项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在此页面查看或清除已下载的节目。

en.description: The Bullhorn audio SDK opens this details page for a selected post or episode so the listener can view its content and related actions.
en.disableEffect: The details page for a selected post or episode will not open.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择帖子或节目后，Bullhorn 音频 SDK 会打开此详情页，展示内容和相关操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 选中的帖子或节目详情页将无法打开。

en.description: The Bullhorn audio SDK opens the listener’s saved favorites list.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to view their saved favorites in the SDK.

zh-CN.description: Bullhorn 音频 SDK 会打开用户收藏内容的列表。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在 SDK 页面查看已收藏的内容。

en.description: The Bullhorn audio SDK opens a list of the podcasts and creators the listener follows.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to view their followed podcasts and creators in the SDK.

zh-CN.description: Bullhorn 音频 SDK 会打开用户关注的播客和创作者列表。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在 SDK 页面查看已关注的播客和创作者。

en.description: The Bullhorn audio SDK opens its in-app notifications list.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to open the Bullhorn notifications list.

zh-CN.description: Bullhorn 音频 SDK 会打开应用内通知列表。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开 Bullhorn 通知列表。

en.description: The Bullhorn audio SDK opens its full-screen audio player.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to open the Bullhorn audio player screen.

zh-CN.description: Bullhorn 音频 SDK 会打开全屏音频播放器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开 Bullhorn 音频播放器页面。

en.description: The Bullhorn audio SDK opens the live chat screen for a playing stream so listeners can follow the conversation.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to open the stream’s chat screen.

zh-CN.description: Bullhorn 音频 SDK 会在直播播放时打开聊天页面，供听众查看交流内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开直播聊天页面。

en.description: The Bullhorn audio SDK opens the questions screen for a live audio session.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to open the session’s questions screen.

zh-CN.description: Bullhorn 音频 SDK 会打开实时音频会话的提问页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开该会话的提问页面。

en.description: The Bullhorn audio SDK opens recent search history for a selected content network.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to view recent searches in the SDK.

zh-CN.description: Bullhorn 音频 SDK 会打开所选内容网络的近期搜索记录。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在 SDK 页面查看近期搜索记录。

en.description: The Bullhorn audio SDK opens a supplied web page inside the app, such as a page linked from its content.
en.disableEffect: Links that use the in-app browser will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: Bullhorn 音频 SDK 会在应用内打开指定网页，例如内容中链接的页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用应用内浏览器打开的链接将无法打开。

en.description: The Bullhorn audio SDK opens a profile page for a selected listener or creator.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to open listener or creator profiles in the SDK.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择听众或创作者后，Bullhorn 音频 SDK 会打开其个人资料页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在 SDK 页面打开听众或创作者的个人资料。

en.description: The Bullhorn audio SDK opens its main screen for browsing content and navigating to playback, downloads, and other sections.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to open the Bullhorn SDK’s main screen.

zh-CN.description: Bullhorn 音频 SDK 会打开主页面，供用户浏览内容并进入播放、下载等版块。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开 Bullhorn SDK 的主页面。

en.description: The Bullhorn audio SDK opens its player screen and supports continuing playback in a small floating picture-in-picture window.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to open the Bullhorn player or continue it in the floating window.

zh-CN.description: Bullhorn 音频 SDK 会打开播放器页面，并支持在小型悬浮画中画窗口中继续播放。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开 Bullhorn 播放器，也无法在悬浮窗口中继续播放。

en.description: When an app using CarterChen247 Alarm Scheduler starts, this provider makes the app's context available so the scheduler can use Android alarm services. Disabling it can prevent the app's scheduled alarms from being set up.
en.disableEffect: The app's alarm scheduler may fail to create or restore reminders and background tasks.

zh-CN.description: 使用 CarterChen247 Alarm Scheduler 的应用启动时，此提供程序会为调度器准备应用上下文，使其能够使用 Android 闹钟服务。禁用后，应用可能无法设置定时任务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用的调度器可能无法创建或恢复提醒及后台任务。

en.description: When a CarterChen247 scheduled alarm fires, this receiver runs the app task configured for that alarm with its saved data. This is how scheduled reminders and background tasks are delivered.
en.disableEffect: The app's scheduled reminders and background tasks may not run.

zh-CN.description: CarterChen247 安排的闹钟触发时，此接收器会携带已保存的数据运行应用为该闹钟配置的任务。应用的定时提醒和后台任务由此触发。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用安排的提醒和后台任务可能无法运行。

en.description: After Android reports a device reboot, app update, or supported quick-boot event, CarterChen247 Alarm Scheduler starts its alarm-restoration work. This restores alarms Android cleared during restart.
en.disableEffect: Saved alarms may not be restored after a reboot or app update.

zh-CN.description: Android 报告设备重启、应用更新或支持的快速启动事件后，CarterChen247 Alarm Scheduler 会启动闹钟恢复工作，以恢复重启期间清除的提醒。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 设备重启或应用更新后，已保存的闹钟可能无法恢复。

en.description: When the user grants Android permission for exact alarms, CarterChen247 Alarm Scheduler restores saved alarms and informs the app that the permission is available.
en.disableEffect: Alarms that depend on exact timing may not be restored after permission is granted.

zh-CN.description: 用户授予 Android 精确闹钟权限后，CarterChen247 Alarm Scheduler 会恢复已保存的闹钟，并通知应用权限已可用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 授予权限后，依赖精确时间的闹钟可能无法恢复。

en.description: When requested after a reboot or exact-alarm permission change, CarterChen247 Alarm Scheduler reloads and reschedules saved alarms. It restores the app's pending reminders and scheduled tasks.
en.disableEffect: Pending app alarms may not be restored after reboot or after exact-alarm access changes.

zh-CN.description: 设备重启或精确闹钟权限变化后，CarterChen247 Alarm Scheduler 会读取并重新安排已保存的闹钟，恢复应用尚未触发的提醒和定时任务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 设备重启或精确闹钟权限变化后，应用尚未触发的闹钟可能无法恢复。

en.description: When the host app starts, Cashfree Payments' PG SDK initializes its payment core unless the app has disabled automatic initialization. This also starts payment-event reporting used by the SDK.
en.disableEffect: Cashfree payment setup may not initialize, so the app's Cashfree checkout flows can fail.

zh-CN.description: 宿主应用启动时，Cashfree Payments PG SDK 会初始化支付核心，除非应用关闭了自动初始化；同时也会启动 SDK 的支付事件上报。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Cashfree 支付初始化可能无法完成，应用中的 Cashfree 结账流程可能失败。

en.description: During a Cashfree payment, this screen presents payment-verification or one-time-code prompts, including UPI collection and card or pay-later verification. Disabling it can leave a payment waiting for confirmation.
en.disableEffect: Cashfree payment verification or one-time-code steps may not complete.

zh-CN.description: Cashfree 支付过程中，此界面会显示支付验证或一次性验证码提示，包括 UPI 收款以及银行卡或先买后付验证。禁用后，支付可能停留在等待确认的步骤。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Cashfree 支付验证或一次性验证码步骤可能无法完成。

en.description: When a user selects UPI for a Cashfree payment, this screen opens the chosen UPI app and checks the payment result when the user returns. Disabling it breaks this UPI payment route.
en.disableEffect: Cashfree UPI payments may not launch or finish verification.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择 UPI 支付时，此界面会打开所选 UPI 应用，并在用户返回后核验支付结果。禁用后，这条 UPI 支付流程会中断。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Cashfree UPI 支付可能无法启动或完成核验。

en.description: During a Cashfree subscription payment, this screen presents the UPI payment-verification prompt. Disabling it can prevent a subscription payment from being confirmed.
en.disableEffect: Cashfree subscription UPI verification may not complete.

zh-CN.description: Cashfree 订阅支付过程中，此界面会显示 UPI 支付验证提示。禁用后，订阅支付可能无法确认。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Cashfree 订阅的 UPI 验证可能无法完成。

en.description: When a user chooses UPI for a Cashfree subscription, this screen opens the UPI app and verifies the subscription transaction after the user returns.
en.disableEffect: Cashfree subscription payments through UPI may not launch or finish verification.

zh-CN.description: 用户为 Cashfree 订阅选择 UPI 时，此界面会打开 UPI 应用，并在用户返回后核验订阅交易。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Cashfree 订阅的 UPI 支付可能无法启动或完成核验。

en.description: Cashfree uses this screen to authenticate a payment in its embedded checkout, including one-time codes, UPI handoff, and supported NFC card verification. Disabling it can interrupt payment confirmation.
en.disableEffect: Cashfree payment authentication and verification may fail.

zh-CN.description: Cashfree 使用此界面在内嵌结账页中验证支付，包括一次性验证码、跳转到 UPI 应用以及支持的 NFC 银行卡验证。禁用后，支付确认流程可能中断。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Cashfree 支付身份验证和核验可能失败。

en.description: When a Cashfree subscription checkout begins, this screen loads the subscription payment page and handles UPI app handoff and the resulting subscription response.
en.disableEffect: Users may be unable to create or confirm a Cashfree subscription.

zh-CN.description: Cashfree 订阅结账开始时，此界面会加载订阅支付页面，并处理跳转到 UPI 应用及返回的订阅结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户可能无法创建或确认 Cashfree 订阅。

en.description: Cashfree uses this screen to authenticate and verify a subscription payment in an embedded page. Disabling it can stop the subscription from being confirmed.
en.disableEffect: Cashfree subscription payment verification may fail.

zh-CN.description: Cashfree 使用此界面在内嵌页面中验证订阅支付。禁用后，订阅可能无法确认。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Cashfree 订阅支付验证可能失败。

en.description: When the app starts a Cashfree web checkout, this screen loads the payment page using the current payment session. Disabling it prevents that checkout route from completing.
en.disableEffect: Cashfree web checkout may fail to open or complete.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动 Cashfree 网页结账时，此界面会使用当前支付会话加载支付页面。禁用后，这条结账流程可能无法完成。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Cashfree 网页结账可能无法打开或完成。

en.description: When the app starts a Cashfree payment workflow, this screen loads that workflow in Cashfree's embedded checkout. Disabling it can interrupt the payment.
en.disableEffect: Cashfree workflow-based payments may fail.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动 Cashfree 支付工作流时，此界面会在 Cashfree 内嵌结账页中加载工作流。禁用后，支付可能中断。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Cashfree 工作流支付可能失败。

en.description: When the app opens Cashfree native checkout, this screen loads the available payment methods, such as UPI, cards, wallets, pay-later, EMI, and net banking. Disabling it removes the app's Cashfree payment screen.
en.disableEffect: Users may be unable to pay through Cashfree native checkout.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开 Cashfree 原生结账时，此界面会加载可用支付方式，例如 UPI、银行卡、钱包、先买后付、分期和网上银行。禁用后，应用的 Cashfree 支付页面将无法使用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户可能无法通过 Cashfree 原生结账完成支付。

en.description: When the app starts Cashfree seamless checkout, this screen fetches checkout settings and presents the available UPI payment choices, then returns the payment result to the app.
en.disableEffect: Cashfree seamless UPI checkout may not open or return a payment result.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动 Cashfree 无缝结账时，此界面会获取结账配置并展示可用的 UPI 支付选项，之后把支付结果返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Cashfree 无缝 UPI 结账可能无法打开或返回支付结果。

en.description: When Cassbana eKYC needs an identity-document image, this screen opens the camera, captures the photo, and returns the saved image to the verification flow. Disabling it prevents document capture.
en.disableEffect: Users may be unable to photograph an identity document and complete eKYC.

zh-CN.description: Cassbana eKYC 需要身份证件照片时，此界面会打开相机、拍摄照片并将图片交回验证流程。禁用后，证件照片将无法采集。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户可能无法拍摄身份证件并完成电子身份验证。

en.description: Cassbana eKYC uses this screen to capture both sides of an identity document, read the details from the images, and let the user retry or enter details manually if reading fails.
en.disableEffect: The document-reading and manual-correction steps of Cassbana eKYC may not complete.

zh-CN.description: Cassbana eKYC 使用此界面拍摄证件正反面、识别图片中的信息，并在识别失败时让用户重拍或手动填写。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Cassbana eKYC 的证件识别和手动更正步骤可能无法完成。

en.description: At the start of Cassbana eKYC, this screen explains the identity-check steps and shows the name read from the user's ID before opening document-photo capture.
en.disableEffect: Users may be unable to start the guided Cassbana eKYC flow.

zh-CN.description: Cassbana eKYC 开始时，此界面会说明身份验证步骤，并显示从证件读取的姓名，然后打开证件拍照流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户可能无法启动 Cassbana eKYC 引导流程。

en.description: Cassbana eKYC uses this screen to review the front and back identity-document photos, retake either side, and continue to the ID-details review.
en.disableEffect: Users may be unable to review or submit their document photos for eKYC.

zh-CN.description: Cassbana eKYC 使用此界面查看证件正反面照片、重拍任一面，并继续审核证件信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户可能无法检查证件照片或提交照片进行电子身份验证。

en.description: When Cassbana eKYC needs the user to enter identity details manually, this form checks the name, ID number, address, and birth date before continuing.
en.disableEffect: When Cassbana eKYC needs the user to enter identity details manually, this form collects their name, ID number, address, and birth date, then validates required entries before continuing.

zh-CN.description: Cassbana eKYC 要求手动填写身份信息时，此表单会检查姓名、证件号码、地址和出生日期，再继续流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 当 Cassbana eKYC 要求手动填写身份信息时，此表单会收集姓名、证件号码、地址和出生日期，并在继续前检查必填信息。

en.description: After Cassbana eKYC reads an ID, this screen shows the recognized name and address so the user can correct them and confirm whether the details are right before continuing.
en.disableEffect: Users may be unable to correct or confirm ID details during eKYC.

zh-CN.description: Cassbana eKYC 识别证件后，此界面会显示识别出的姓名和地址，让用户修改信息并确认内容是否正确。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户可能无法在电子身份验证中更正或确认证件信息。

en.description: Cassbana eKYC uses this screen to take a selfie and check the captured photo before returning it to the verification flow.
en.disableEffect: Users may be unable to complete the selfie check required by Cassbana eKYC.

zh-CN.description: Cassbana eKYC 使用此界面拍摄自拍照、检查照片，并将结果交回验证流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户可能无法完成 Cassbana eKYC 所需的自拍核验。

en.description: In Cassbana's earliest eKYC release, this entry screen displays the four identity-check steps: photograph both sides of an ID, review the details, and take a selfie.
en.disableEffect: The app may lose the entry screen used to begin that Cassbana eKYC flow.

zh-CN.description: 在 Cassbana 最早的 eKYC 版本中，此入口界面展示四个身份验证步骤：拍摄证件正反面、检查信息并拍摄自拍照。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用可能无法显示用于开始 Cassbana eKYC 流程的入口界面。

en.description: Cassbana Risk's setup screen guides the user through app permissions and Android Notification Access and Usage Access settings needed by its data-collection features.
en.disableEffect: The app may be unable to complete Cassbana Risk's guided permission setup, leaving related risk-data collection unavailable.

zh-CN.description: Cassbana Risk 的设置界面会引导用户授予应用权限，并打开 Android 通知访问和使用情况访问设置，以启用相应的数据采集功能。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用可能无法完成 Cassbana Risk 的权限引导，相关风险数据采集也无法使用。

en.description: When Android Notification Access is enabled, Cassbana Risk records new and currently visible notifications, including their titles, text, times, and source apps, for its risk-data store.
en.disableEffect: Cassbana Risk loses notification history as a risk-data signal, which can affect app flows that depend on that signal.

zh-CN.description: 启用 Android 通知访问后，Cassbana Risk 会记录新通知和当前显示的通知，包括标题、正文、时间及来源应用，并保存到风险数据中。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Cassbana Risk 将失去通知历史这一风险数据来源，依赖该信号的应用流程可能受到影响。

en.description: At app startup, the Castles card-processing module used by the Global Payments Device Library saves the app context required by its payment routines. The module uses that context to access app resources and prepare card-reader payment configuration.
en.disableEffect: The card module loses the app context it needs, so card-present payment setup and transactions can fail.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，Global Payments 设备库使用的 Castles 刷卡模块会保存支付流程所需的应用上下文。该模块依靠此上下文访问应用资源并准备读卡器支付配置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 刷卡模块将失去所需的应用上下文，实体卡支付的初始化和交易可能失败。

en.description: The ZXingScanner library opens a camera screen when the app starts a barcode or QR scan. It reads the code and returns its text to the app, with a beep or vibration when a scan succeeds.
en.disableEffect: The app's built-in scan screen will not open, so scans that use this library cannot be completed.

zh-CN.description: ZXingScanner 扫码库会在应用发起条码或二维码扫描时打开相机页面，读取码内容并返回给应用；识别成功时还会播放提示音或振动。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用内使用此库的扫码页面将无法打开，条码和二维码扫描也无法完成。

en.description: When an external payment app returns to 2C2P PGW SDK Helper, this Activity reads the returned payment token and passes the transaction result back to checkout.
en.disableEffect: Payments that leave the app for a partner wallet may not return a result to checkout.

zh-CN.description: 外部支付应用返回 2C2P PGW SDK Helper 时，此 Activity 会读取返回的支付令牌，并将交易结果交还结账流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，跳转到合作钱包的支付可能无法将结果返回结账流程。

en.description: When checkout selects Google Pay through 2C2P PGW SDK Helper, this Activity checks wallet availability, opens the Google Pay payment sheet, and returns the result.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to complete the Google Pay option in the app.

zh-CN.description: 结账流程通过 2C2P PGW SDK Helper 选择 Google Pay 时，此 Activity 会检查钱包是否可用、打开 Google Pay 支付界面并返回结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法在应用中完成 Google Pay 支付。

en.description: When checkout hands a transaction to ZaloPay, this 2C2P PGW SDK Helper Activity initializes the wallet and receives its success, cancellation, or failure result.
en.disableEffect: ZaloPay payments may fail or may not return a result to checkout.

zh-CN.description: 结账流程将交易交给 ZaloPay 时，2C2P PGW SDK Helper 的此 Activity 会初始化钱包并接收成功、取消或失败结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，ZaloPay 支付可能失败，或无法将结果返回结账流程。

en.description: When a merchant starts an in-person 2C2P SoftPOS transaction, this Activity requests payment options and coordinates the MineSec card-payment session.
en.disableEffect: In-person SoftPOS transactions may not start or complete.

zh-CN.description: 商户发起 2C2P SoftPOS 现场交易时，此 Activity 会请求支付选项并协调 MineSec 刷卡或感应支付流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，现场 SoftPOS 交易可能无法启动或完成。

en.description: When 2C2P SoftPOS hands a transaction to MineSec, this Activity supplies MineSec's payment interface for the card-payment session.
en.disableEffect: The MineSec payment screen may not open, preventing a SoftPOS transaction from completing.

zh-CN.description: 2C2P SoftPOS 将交易交给 MineSec 时，此 Activity 会提供银行卡支付流程所需的 MineSec 支付界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，MineSec 支付界面可能无法打开，SoftPOS 交易也就无法完成。

en.description: When an app starts a Cedexis Android Radar session, this service measures network performance and reports the results to Cedexis. Disabling it stops those network measurements and reports.
en.disableEffect: The app will stop sending network-performance measurements and impact reports through Cedexis Radar.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动 Cedexis Android Radar 会话时，此服务会测量网络性能并将结果报告给 Cedexis。禁用后，这些网络测量和报告会停止。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将不再通过 Cedexis Radar 发送网络性能测量结果和影响报告。

en.description: Prasham Trivedi’s SharedPreferencesInspector opens this screen when the app explicitly starts its inspector; it lists the app’s stored settings files and lets the user browse a selected file.
en.disableEffect: The in-app settings inspector becomes unavailable, while the app’s saved settings continue to work.

zh-CN.description: Prasham Trivedi 的 SharedPreferencesInspector 在应用主动打开检查器时显示此界面；它列出应用保存的设置文件，并可打开其中一个查看。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用内的设置检查器将无法使用，但已保存的应用设置仍可正常工作。

en.description: Chalk Digital's CD Ads SDK opens a full-screen player for video ads. It can also show interactive rich-media video ads.
en.disableEffect: These ad videos will not play; if the app uses a rewarded video placement, the user will not receive its reward.

zh-CN.description: Chalk Digital 的 CD Ads 广告 SDK 会打开这个全屏页面播放视频广告，也可播放带互动内容的视频广告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，这些视频广告将无法播放；如果应用使用激励视频广告，用户将无法获得观看奖励。

en.description: Chalk Digital's CD Ads SDK handles the device startup broadcast and, after the SDK has logged in, restarts background tracking and its network monitor. It also asks the SDK to send queued tracking data.
en.disableEffect: CD Ads will not restart its background tracking through this receiver after the device reboots.

zh-CN.description: 设备启动完成时，Chalk Digital 的 CD Ads 广告 SDK 会处理启动广播；SDK 已登录后，它会恢复后台追踪和网络监测，并尝试发送排队的追踪数据。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，设备重启时 CD Ads 将无法通过此接收器恢复后台追踪。

en.description: When Android reports a network change, Chalk Digital's CD Ads SDK checks whether the connection is usable and starts its reverse-geocoding work.
en.disableEffect: CD Ads will no longer respond to network changes to refresh location data.

zh-CN.description: Android 报告网络状态变化时，Chalk Digital 的 CD Ads 广告 SDK 会检查网络是否可用，并启动地址反查工作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，CD Ads 将无法根据网络变化刷新位置信息。

en.description: Once CD Ads starts this background service, it watches for an available network connection and triggers SDK work when the device comes online.
en.disableEffect: CD Ads will stop receiving network-availability updates from this service.

zh-CN.description: CD Ads 启动此后台服务后，它会监测网络连接，并在设备联网时触发 SDK 的相关任务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，CD Ads 将无法通过此服务接收网络可用状态更新。

en.description: When CD Ads requests a location update, this background service asks Chalk Digital for an estimate based on the device's public IP address. It saves the result and requests a more detailed location lookup when needed.
en.disableEffect: CD Ads will lose this IP-based location lookup for its ad features.

zh-CN.description: CD Ads 请求更新位置时，此后台服务会根据设备的公网 IP 地址向 Chalk Digital 查询大致位置，并在需要时继续获取更详细的位置信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，CD Ads 的广告功能将无法通过此服务获取基于 IP 的位置估算。

en.description: Chalk Digital's CD Ads SDK starts this service for one-time or ongoing device location updates and address lookups. It sends location changes to the SDK's tracking service.
en.disableEffect: CD Ads will stop receiving location updates for its location-based ad features and tracking.

zh-CN.description: Chalk Digital 的 CD Ads 广告 SDK 会启动此服务，获取一次性或持续的设备位置更新及地址信息，并将位置变化发送给 SDK 的追踪服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，CD Ads 的位置相关广告和追踪将无法收到位置更新。

en.description: This screen appears when CD Ads requests location access or tracking consent. It returns the user's choice to the ad SDK.
en.disableEffect: CD Ads will not be able to request location access or tracking consent through this screen.

zh-CN.description: CD Ads 请求位置权限或追踪授权时会打开此页面，并将用户的选择返回给广告 SDK。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，CD Ads 将无法通过此页面请求位置权限或追踪授权。

en.description: Chalk Digital's CD Ads SDK starts this background service to register the device with its ad service and upload queued location-tracking events. After a successful response, it saves SDK settings and schedules the next daily upload.
en.disableEffect: Chalk Digital will not receive registration requests or queued tracking data from this service.

zh-CN.description: Chalk Digital 的 CD Ads 广告 SDK 会启动此后台服务，将设备注册到广告服务并上传排队的位置追踪事件；收到成功响应后，它会保存 SDK 设置并安排下一次每日上传。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Chalk Digital 将无法通过此服务收到设备注册请求或排队的追踪数据。

en.description: When this receiver gets a device startup event, Chalk Digital's CD Ads SDK starts its background tracking service again.
en.disableEffect: CD Ads background tracking will not restart through this receiver after a device startup event.

zh-CN.description: 此接收器收到设备启动事件时，Chalk Digital 的 CD Ads 广告 SDK 会重新启动后台追踪服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，设备启动时 CD Ads 将无法通过此接收器恢复后台追踪。

en.description: Chalk Digital's CD Ads SDK opens the destination of an ad link in this in-app web browser. Users can go back, move forward, refresh, or close the page.
en.disableEffect: Ad destinations will not open in this in-app browser.

zh-CN.description: Chalk Digital 的 CD Ads 广告 SDK 会在此应用内浏览器中打开广告链接的目标页面，用户可返回、前进、刷新或关闭页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，广告目标页面将无法在此应用内浏览器中打开。

en.description: When Android reports a network change, Chalk Digital's CD Ads SDK updates its IP-location lookup and tells other ad tasks whether the device is online. It also resumes tasks that were waiting for a connection.
en.disableEffect: CD Ads will not receive these network updates to resume waiting ad and location tasks.

zh-CN.description: Android 报告网络状态变化时，Chalk Digital 的 CD Ads 广告 SDK 会更新 IP 定位，并通知其他广告任务设备是否联网；它还会恢复等待网络的任务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，CD Ads 将无法收到这些网络更新来恢复等待中的广告和定位任务。

en.description: When started by CD Ads, this service watches for network availability and notifies the SDK when the device comes online or loses its connection.
en.disableEffect: CD Ads will no longer receive network-availability changes from this service.

zh-CN.description: CD Ads 启动此服务后，它会监测网络可用状态，并在设备联网或断网时通知 SDK。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，CD Ads 将无法通过此服务收到网络状态变化。

en.description: Android runs this scheduled job when Chalk Digital's CD Ads SDK needs an IP-based location estimate. The result supports the SDK's location-aware ad features.
en.disableEffect: CD Ads will not get IP-based location updates through this scheduled job.

zh-CN.description: Chalk Digital 的 CD Ads 广告 SDK 需要通过 IP 估算位置时，Android 会运行此定时任务；结果用于支持 SDK 的位置相关广告功能。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，CD Ads 将无法通过此定时任务获取基于 IP 的位置更新。

en.description: When CD Ads requests a location refresh, this background service asks the SDK to estimate the device's location from its public IP address.
en.disableEffect: CD Ads will not get IP-based location updates through this service.

zh-CN.description: CD Ads 请求刷新位置时，此后台服务会让 SDK 根据设备的公网 IP 地址估算位置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，CD Ads 将无法通过此服务获取基于 IP 的位置更新。

en.description: Android runs this scheduled job to request a device location or look up an address from a saved location for Chalk Digital's CD Ads SDK.
en.disableEffect: CD Ads will not receive these scheduled location updates or address lookups.

zh-CN.description: Android 会运行此定时任务，为 Chalk Digital 的 CD Ads 广告 SDK 请求设备位置，或根据已保存的位置查询地址。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，CD Ads 将无法通过此定时任务获取位置更新或地址信息。

en.description: Chalk Digital's CD Ads SDK starts this foreground service for one-time or ongoing location updates and address lookups. Android shows a location notification while it runs.
en.disableEffect: CD Ads will stop receiving location updates for its location-based ad features.

zh-CN.description: Chalk Digital 的 CD Ads 广告 SDK 会启动此定位前台服务，获取一次性或持续的位置更新及地址信息；服务运行时 Android 会显示位置通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，CD Ads 的位置相关广告将无法收到位置更新。

en.description: When CD Ads requests location or tracking permission, this screen asks the user and reports whether access was granted or denied.
en.disableEffect: The ad SDK cannot request location access or tracking consent through this permission screen.

zh-CN.description: CD Ads 请求位置或追踪权限时会打开此页面，并向广告 SDK 返回用户是否允许。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，广告 SDK 将无法通过此权限页面请求位置访问。

en.description: Android runs this scheduled job to upload queued Chalk Digital ad-tracking data when an internet connection is available.
en.disableEffect: Queued ad-tracking data will not be uploaded by this scheduled job.

zh-CN.description: 设备联网时，Android 会运行此定时任务，将排队的 Chalk Digital 广告追踪数据上传。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，此定时任务将不会上传排队的广告追踪数据。

en.description: When Chalk Digital's CD Ads SDK requests a tracking upload, this background service sends queued tracking data if the device has an internet connection.
en.disableEffect: Chalk Digital's queued tracking data will not be uploaded through this service.

zh-CN.description: Chalk Digital 的 CD Ads 广告 SDK 请求上传追踪数据时，此后台服务会在设备联网后发送排队的数据。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Chalk Digital 排队的追踪数据将无法通过此服务上传。

en.description: Chalk Digital's CD Ads SDK opens this screen to display a full-screen interstitial ad and handle its links and close action.
en.disableEffect: Chalk Digital interstitial ads will not display.

zh-CN.description: Chalk Digital 的 CD Ads 广告 SDK 会打开此页面显示全屏插屏广告，并处理广告链接和关闭操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Chalk Digital 的插屏广告将无法显示。

en.description: Chalk Digital's CD Ads SDK opens this screen for full-screen interactive rich-media ads and handles their controls and links while they are shown.
en.disableEffect: Chalk Digital rich-media interstitial ads will not display.

zh-CN.description: Chalk Digital 的 CD Ads 广告 SDK 会打开此页面显示全屏互动富媒体广告，并在广告展示时处理其控件和链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Chalk Digital 的互动富媒体插屏广告将无法显示。

en.description: Chalk Digital's CD Ads SDK opens this screen to play a full-screen video interstitial. It reports when the ad opens, closes, or fails to load.
en.disableEffect: Chalk Digital video interstitial ads will not display.

zh-CN.description: Chalk Digital 的 CD Ads 广告 SDK 会打开此页面播放全屏视频插屏广告，并记录广告打开、关闭或加载失败的状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Chalk Digital 的视频插屏广告将无法显示。

en.description: Chartboost opens this screen to display a full-screen ad impression and forwards screen lifecycle changes to the ad.
en.disableEffect: Chartboost ads will not appear, but the app’s other features continue to work.

zh-CN.description: Chartboost 会打开此页面展示全屏广告，并将页面生命周期变化传递给广告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Chartboost 广告将不再显示，但应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: Chartboost's Android ads SDK opens a full-screen ad view and passes display events to its ad service. It is used for ads started by Chartboost.
en.disableEffect: Chartboost ads will not open here; users will not receive a reward for watching a rewarded placement.

zh-CN.description: Chartboost Android 广告 SDK 会打开此全屏页面展示广告，并将展示状态传给广告服务；此页面供 Chartboost 启动的广告使用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Chartboost 广告将无法在此显示；用户观看激励广告后也无法获得奖励。

en.description: Chartboost's Android ads SDK uses this full-screen ad view to present ads and keep display state in sync while a user watches or closes them.
en.disableEffect: Chartboost ads will not display here; users will not receive a reward for watching a rewarded placement.

zh-CN.description: Chartboost Android 广告 SDK 会打开此全屏页面展示广告，并在用户观看或关闭广告时同步展示状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Chartboost 广告将无法在此显示；用户观看激励广告后也无法获得奖励。

en.description: Chartboost's Helium adapter opens a full-screen ad view to present Chartboost ads and report their display events.
en.disableEffect: Mediated Chartboost ads will not display; users will not receive a reward for watching a rewarded placement.

zh-CN.description: Chartboost 的 Helium 适配器会打开此全屏页面展示 Chartboost 广告，并将展示状态传给广告服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，经 Helium 接入的 Chartboost 广告将无法显示；用户观看激励广告后也无法获得奖励。

en.description: The AndroidSandHook internal testing library starts its support tools in the background when the app opens.
en.disableEffect: Features that rely on this library to change app behavior may stop working.

zh-CN.description: AndroidSandHook 内部测试库会在应用启动时于后台开启相关支持功能。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖该库改变应用行为的功能可能无法正常工作。

en.description: chdown's JPush extension for Jiguang JPush handles incoming custom messages, notification taps and push-registration updates when JPush calls the app.
en.disableEffect: The app will stop receiving JPush messages and handling notification taps through this receiver.

zh-CN.description: chdown 为极光 JPush 提供的扩展会在 JPush 调用应用时处理自定义消息、通知点击和推送注册更新。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用将无法通过此 Receiver 接收 JPush 消息或处理通知点击。

en.description: chdown's JPush extension registers this background Service with Jiguang JPush so the SDK can run its push-service work.
en.disableEffect: JPush will no longer be able to run its background service work through this component.

zh-CN.description: chdown 的 JPush 扩展会向极光 JPush 注册此后台 Service，以便 SDK 执行推送服务工作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，JPush 将无法通过此 Service 执行后台推送服务任务。

en.description: When chdown's Keep library starts its keep-alive mode, this Service shows an ongoing app notification and runs as a foreground service.
en.disableEffect: The keep-alive Service and its ongoing notification will stop, so the app may be less able to stay active in the background.

zh-CN.description: chdown 的 Keep 库启动保活模式时，此 Service 会显示持续通知并以前台服务方式运行。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，保活服务及其持续通知将停止，应用在后台持续运行的能力会降低。

en.description: CheckinPass DS Plus opens this panel to show service status and QR-code, GPS, or Wi-Fi diagnostics. When it resumes, it also sends device and service details to CheckinPass for a status check.
en.disableEffect: The CheckinPass service-status and QR-code panel will not open.

zh-CN.description: CheckinPass DS Plus 会打开此面板显示服务状态、二维码、GPS 或 Wi-Fi 诊断信息；面板恢复时还会向 CheckinPass 发送设备和服务信息以检查状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，CheckinPass 的服务状态和二维码面板将无法打开。

en.description: Checkout.com Address Components opens a form where users can enter or edit an address during checkout. It returns the completed contact details to the payment flow.
en.disableEffect: Users may be unable to enter or update an address required to complete checkout.

zh-CN.description: Checkout.com 地址组件会在结账时打开表单，供用户填写或修改地址，并将完成的联系信息返回给支付流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户可能无法填写或更新完成结账所需的地址。

en.description: Checkout.com's 3-D Secure SDK runs this provider during app startup to perform its payment-authentication setup. It has no user-facing screen.
en.disableEffect: The 3-D Secure SDK may not initialize correctly, which can prevent required card authentication during checkout.

zh-CN.description: Checkout.com 的 3-D Secure SDK 会在应用启动时通过此提供程序执行支付验证初始化；它不会显示用户界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，3-D Secure SDK 可能无法正确初始化，导致结账时需要的银行卡验证无法完成。

en.description: Checkout.com's 3-D Secure SDK receiver runs after the app is updated and clears its saved SDK identifier so payment authentication can start with fresh state.
en.disableEffect: After an app update, the SDK may keep an outdated identifier, which can disrupt later 3-D Secure authentication.

zh-CN.description: 应用更新后，Checkout.com 的 3-D Secure SDK 接收器会清除保存的 SDK 标识，让支付验证从新的状态开始。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用更新后 SDK 可能保留过期标识，影响后续的 3-D Secure 验证。

en.description: Checkout.com's 3-D Secure SDK opens this screen during a bank-card verification challenge. It collects the challenge result and returns it to the payment flow.
en.disableEffect: Card payments that require bank verification will not complete if this screen is blocked.

zh-CN.description: Checkout.com 的 3-D Secure SDK 会在银行卡验证挑战期间打开此页面，收集验证结果并返回给支付流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，需要银行验证的银行卡支付将无法完成。

en.description: The MyChehara video-interview library opens this screen on Android 5.0 and newer when the app starts a recording. It records a video and offers preview and upload.
en.disableEffect: The app can no longer record or submit video interviews through this screen on these Android versions.

zh-CN.description: MyChehara 视频面试库会在 Android 5.0 及更新版本上响应应用的录制请求，打开此页面录制视频，并提供预览和上传功能。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 在这些 Android 版本上，应用将无法通过此页面录制或提交面试视频。

en.description: The MyChehara video-interview library opens this screen on Android versions older than 5.0 when the app starts a recording. It records a video and offers preview and upload.
en.disableEffect: The app can no longer record or submit video interviews through this screen on these Android versions.

zh-CN.description: MyChehara 视频面试库会在 Android 5.0 以下版本响应应用的录制请求，打开此页面录制视频，并提供预览和上传功能。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 在这些 Android 版本上，应用将无法通过此页面录制或提交面试视频。

en.description: The Chehara upload library asks the user to choose an MP4 video résumé, checks that it is under 25 MB, and uploads it.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to choose and upload a video résumé.

zh-CN.description: Chehara 上传库会让用户选择 MP4 格式的视频简历，检查文件是否小于 25 MB，然后上传。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法选择和上传视频简历。

en.description: The Chehara upload library asks the user to choose a PDF résumé, checks that it is under 1 MB, and uploads it.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to choose and upload a PDF résumé.

zh-CN.description: Chehara 上传库会让用户选择 PDF 简历，检查文件是否小于 1 MB，然后上传。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法选择和上传 PDF 简历。

en.description: The XPicker camera screen captures a photo or video and returns the result to the requesting app.
en.disableEffect: The calling app cannot capture photos or videos through this camera screen.

zh-CN.description: 此 XPicker 相机页面会拍摄照片或录制视频，并将结果返回给发起请求的应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 发起请求的应用将无法通过此相机页面拍照或录制视频。

en.description: Kotpref initializes the app's preference storage through this provider as the app starts, so preference settings are ready before use.
en.disableEffect: App features that rely on Kotpref settings may fail when they try to read or save preferences.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，Kotpref 会通过此提供程序初始化偏好设置存储，让相关设置在使用前准备就绪。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖 Kotpref 设置的应用功能在读取或保存偏好数据时可能失败。

en.description: Kotpref's initializer prepares the app's preference storage through this provider as the app starts, before the app uses those settings.
en.disableEffect: App features that rely on Kotpref settings may fail when they try to read or save preferences.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，Kotpref 初始化模块会通过此提供程序准备偏好设置存储，以便应用使用相关设置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖 Kotpref 设置的应用功能在读取或保存偏好数据时可能失败。

en.description: The Chiclaim Android Downloader uses this Provider to give Android a private link to a downloaded APK so the package installer can read it.
en.disableEffect: Downloaded APK files can no longer be passed to the Android installer through this provider.

zh-CN.description: Chiclaim Android Downloader 使用此 Provider 为已下载的 APK 提供应用专用链接，供 Android 安装程序读取。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，下载的 APK 将无法通过此 Provider 交给 Android 安装程序。

en.description: When the app starts a download through Chiclaim Android Downloader, this Service fetches the supplied file and keeps the download running in the background.
en.disableEffect: Downloads started through this library will not start or resume.

zh-CN.description: 应用通过 Chiclaim Android Downloader 开始下载时，此 Service 会获取指定文件并在后台继续下载。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过此库发起的下载将无法开始或继续。

en.description: Chiclaim Android Downloader listens for Android's download-complete event; after a completed download, it opens the downloaded APK with the system installer.
en.disableEffect: A completed APK download will no longer open the installer automatically.

zh-CN.description: Chiclaim Android Downloader 会监听 Android 的下载完成事件，并在下载完成后用系统安装程序打开 APK。
zh-CN.disableEffect: APK 下载完成后将不再自动打开安装程序。

en.description: When the app opens its download or update prompt, this Activity shows the supplied title and details, lets the user confirm or cancel, and begins the download on confirmation.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot start this library's download or update flow from its prompt.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开下载或更新提示时，此 Activity 会显示相应标题和说明，供用户确认或取消；确认后便开始下载。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此提示启动该库提供的下载或更新流程。

en.description: When an update needs permission to install from this source, the Chiclaim Android Downloader shows a prompt to open Android's install settings and continues with the installer after permission is granted.
en.disableEffect: The downloaded package cannot continue through this install-permission screen.

zh-CN.description: 更新需要获得此来源的安装权限时，Chiclaim Android Downloader 会提示用户打开 Android 安装设置，并在授权后继续安装。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 下载的安装包将无法通过此权限页面继续安装。

en.description: Chillibits Simple Settings opens the app's settings page, showing configured preference sections and any available reset options.
en.disableEffect: The app's Simple Settings page and its available reset option will be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: Chillibits Simple Settings 会打开应用设置页面，显示已配置的偏好设置分区和可用的重置选项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用的 Simple Settings 页面及其重置选项将无法使用。

en.description: Niddler, Chimerapps' network inspection tool, runs this service while an inspection session is active. It keeps the inspection connection available and shows a notification with its port and a stop option.
en.disableEffect: The Niddler inspection session will not run, while the app's regular features continue.

zh-CN.description: Chimerapps 的 Niddler 网络检查工具会在检查会话开启时运行此服务，保持检查连接可用，并显示带端口号和停止选项的通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后将无法使用 Niddler 网络检查会话，但应用的常规功能仍可使用。

en.description: Apex advertising opens the web page attached to an ad so the user can view its landing page.
en.disableEffect: Apex ad landing pages will not open.

zh-CN.description: Apex 广告 SDK 会打开广告附带的网页，供用户查看广告落地页。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Apex 广告的落地页将无法打开。

en.description: When the user enables it and opens DingTalk, Szhittech's accessibility SDK reads attendance screens and can follow configured steps, enter a configured password, and tap clock-in or clock-out during scheduled times.
en.disableEffect: Automatic DingTalk attendance actions will stop.

zh-CN.description: 用户启用此无障碍服务并打开钉钉后，Szhittech 无障碍 SDK 会读取考勤页面，可按配置步骤输入密码，并在设定时间点击上班或下班打卡。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 钉钉自动考勤操作将停止。

en.description: ChooonggKtx lets the app share files with other apps through temporary file links, such as when the user shares an attachment or opens it in another app. It exposes only the app's configured sharing locations.
en.disableEffect: The app may no longer be able to share or open files through this provider.

zh-CN.description: ChooonggKtx 可通过临时文件链接把文件交给其他应用，例如分享附件或用其他应用打开附件；它只开放应用配置的分享目录。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用可能无法通过此组件分享文件或将文件交给其他应用打开。

en.description: CHS Framework Kotlin opens this quiet Activity when its permission helper requests Android permissions or returns from app settings, then handles the result.
en.disableEffect: Permission requests from this CHS Framework Kotlin version may not complete, which can break app features that need those permissions.

zh-CN.description: CHS Framework Kotlin 的权限功能会在请求 Android 权限或从应用设置返回时打开此隐藏 Activity，并处理返回结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，此版本 CHS Framework Kotlin 的权限请求可能无法完成，依赖这些权限的应用功能也可能受影响。

en.description: CHS Framework Kotlin opens this quiet Activity when its permission helper requests Android permissions or returns from app settings, then handles the result.
en.disableEffect: Permission requests from this CHS Framework Kotlin version may not complete, which can break app features that need those permissions.

zh-CN.description: CHS Framework Kotlin 的权限功能会在请求 Android 权限或从应用设置返回时打开此隐藏 Activity，并处理返回结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，此版本 CHS Framework Kotlin 的权限请求可能无法完成，依赖这些权限的应用功能也可能受影响。

en.description: CHS Library Video opens this Activity for full-screen video playback and returns the playback position when the user leaves the player.
en.disableEffect: The app's full-screen video playback and return-to-video position flow will stop working.

zh-CN.description: CHS Library Video 会通过此 Activity 全屏播放视频，并在用户退出播放器时返回播放位置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用的全屏视频播放及退出后恢复播放位置的流程将无法使用。

en.description: CHS Library Video opens this Activity to show its TV-style video player in full-screen mode.
en.disableEffect: The app's TV-style full-screen video playback will stop working.

zh-CN.description: CHS Library Video 会通过此 Activity 全屏显示电视样式的视频播放器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用的电视样式全屏视频播放将无法使用。

en.description: CHS Library Video opens this Activity for full-screen video playback and returns the playback position when the user leaves the player.
en.disableEffect: The app's full-screen video playback and return-to-video position flow will stop working.

zh-CN.description: CHS Library Video 会通过此 Activity 全屏播放视频，并在用户退出播放器时返回播放位置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用的全屏视频播放及退出后恢复播放位置的流程将无法使用。

en.description: CHS Library Video opens this Activity to show its TV-style video player in full-screen mode.
en.disableEffect: The app's TV-style full-screen video playback will stop working.

zh-CN.description: CHS Library Video 会通过此 Activity 全屏显示电视样式的视频播放器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用的电视样式全屏视频播放将无法使用。

en.description: The ShanYan one-tap carrier-login SDK opens this screen when a user views China Telecom’s privacy terms during phone-number login. It displays the carrier’s protocol.
en.disableEffect: China Telecom one-tap login may fail to show its required privacy terms.

zh-CN.description: 用户通过手机号使用闪验一键登录并查看中国电信隐私条款时，闪验 SDK 会打开此页面展示运营商协议。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 中国电信一键登录可能无法显示所需的隐私条款。

en.description: The ShanYan one-tap carrier-login SDK opens this screen for China Mobile phone-number authentication. It presents the carrier’s login page and returns the authentication result.
en.disableEffect: China Mobile one-tap phone-number login may stop working.

zh-CN.description: 用户通过手机号使用闪验一键登录时，SDK 会打开此页面进行中国移动号码认证，并返回认证结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 中国移动手机号一键登录可能无法使用。

en.description: The ShanYan one-tap carrier-login SDK opens this screen to let a user confirm a China Unicom phone-number login and review the carrier terms.
en.disableEffect: China Unicom one-tap phone-number login may stop working.

zh-CN.description: 用户通过手机号使用闪验一键登录时，SDK 会打开此页面供用户确认中国联通号码登录并查看运营商条款。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 中国联通手机号一键登录可能无法使用。

en.description: The Chucker HTTP inspector runs this service when a user clears captured request history. It removes saved requests or errors and dismisses their notifications.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to clear Chucker's saved request or error history from its controls; normal app networking still works.

zh-CN.description: 用户清除已记录的请求历史时，Chucker 网络检查工具会运行此服务。它会删除保存的请求或错误记录，并关闭相应通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 Chucker 控件清除已保存的请求或错误记录；应用的正常网络功能仍可使用。

en.description: The Chucker HTTP inspector opens this screen to show captured network requests and errors. Users can browse the lists and open an individual record.
en.disableEffect: Chucker's network-history screen will not open, but the app's own network requests continue to work.

zh-CN.description: Chucker 网络检查工具会打开此页面，显示已记录的网络请求和错误。用户可以浏览列表并打开单条记录。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Chucker 网络历史页面将无法打开，但应用自身的网络请求仍可正常工作。

en.description: The Chucker HTTP inspector opens this screen to show details for a captured error. It displays the saved error information selected from the history list.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to inspect captured error details in Chucker; normal app features remain available.

zh-CN.description: 用户查看已记录的错误详情时，Chucker 网络检查工具会打开此页面。页面显示用户从历史列表中选中的错误信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在 Chucker 中查看已记录的错误详情；应用的正常功能仍可使用。

en.description: The Chucker HTTP inspector opens this screen when a user selects a captured network request. It displays that request's details.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to inspect individual captured requests in Chucker; normal app networking continues.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择一条已记录的网络请求时，Chucker 网络检查工具会打开此页面，显示该请求的详细信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在 Chucker 中查看单条请求详情；应用的正常网络功能仍可使用。

en.description: The Chucker HTTP inspector provides access to saved request and response files when a developer exports captured traffic.
en.disableEffect: Chucker may not be able to share exported traffic files, while the app's network requests and other features remain available.

zh-CN.description: Chucker HTTP 检查器会在开发者导出网络记录时提供已保存的请求和响应文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Chucker 可能无法分享导出的网络记录文件，但应用的网络请求和其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: The Chucker HTTP inspector receives the Clear action from its captured-traffic notification and queues work that removes saved transactions.
en.disableEffect: The Clear action in Chucker's captured-traffic notification will not remove saved transactions, while network capture and the rest of the app remain available.

zh-CN.description: Chucker HTTP 检查器会接收捕获流量通知中的清除操作，并安排任务删除已保存的网络记录。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Chucker 捕获流量通知中的清除操作将无法删除已保存的网络记录，但网络捕获和应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: The Chucker HTTP inspector runs this service when a user clears saved traffic history. It removes captured requests and errors; the Chucker Extended fork also clears its WebSocket history.
en.disableEffect: Chucker's saved inspection history cannot be cleared through this service, while the app's own network features keep working.

zh-CN.description: 用户清除已保存的流量历史时，Chucker 网络检查工具会运行此服务。它会删除已记录的请求和错误；Chucker Extended 分支还会清除 WebSocket 历史。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此服务清除 Chucker 检查历史，但应用自身的网络功能仍可使用。

en.description: The Chucker HTTP inspector lists captured network requests and lets a developer search, select, clear, or export them.
en.disableEffect: The Chucker traffic-inspection screen will be unavailable, while the app's network requests and other features remain available.

zh-CN.description: Chucker HTTP 检查器会列出捕获的网络请求，供开发者搜索、选择、清除或导出。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Chucker 网络检查页面将无法打开，但应用的网络请求和其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: The Chucker HTTP inspector opens this screen to show details for a captured error. It displays the saved error information selected from the history list.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to inspect captured error details in Chucker; normal app features remain available.

zh-CN.description: 用户查看已记录的错误详情时，Chucker 网络检查工具会打开此页面。页面显示用户从历史列表中选中的错误信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在 Chucker 中查看已记录的错误详情；应用的正常功能仍可使用。

en.description: The Chucker HTTP inspector opens this screen to show details for a captured exception. It displays the saved exception information selected from the history list.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to inspect captured exception details in Chucker; normal app features remain available.

zh-CN.description: 用户查看已记录的异常详情时，Chucker 网络检查工具会打开此页面。页面显示用户从历史列表中选中的异常信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在 Chucker 中查看已记录的异常详情；应用的正常功能仍可使用。

en.description: The Chucker HTTP inspector shows the details of a captured request and response, with options to copy or share them.
en.disableEffect: The app will lose Chucker's per-request detail screen, while its network requests and other features remain available.

zh-CN.description: Chucker HTTP 检查器会显示捕获请求和响应的详情，并提供复制或分享选项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用将无法打开 Chucker 的单条请求详情页面，但网络请求和其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: Chucker Extended opens a captured WebSocket transaction from its debugging interface, shows its details, and can share the record as text or a file.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it removes Chucker’s in-app detail and export screen for captured WebSocket traffic.

zh-CN.description: Chucker Extended 会从调试界面打开已捕获的 WebSocket 记录，显示其详情，并可将记录以文本或文件形式分享。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Chucker 应用内的 WebSocket 记录详情和导出页面将无法使用。

en.description: When PhotoPicker+ asks the user to connect a photo service, Chute SDK v2 opens that service's sign-in page and completes the login when the user returns. A successful login lets the picker access that service's media.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot sign in to a connected photo service through PhotoPicker+.

zh-CN.description: PhotoPicker+ 请求连接照片服务时，Chute SDK v2 会打开该服务的登录页面，并在用户返回后完成登录。登录成功后，选择器才能读取该服务中的媒体。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法通过 PhotoPicker+ 登录并连接照片服务。

en.description: When an app binds ACTV8’s audio-search Service and starts a search, it samples microphone audio and compares it with ACTV8’s local fingerprint library and online service to identify matching audio triggers.
en.disableEffect: Audio-based ACTV8 triggers will stop being recognized, so any app feature that uses them will no longer activate.

zh-CN.description: 应用绑定并启动 ACTV8 音频搜索服务后，它会采集麦克风音频片段，并与 ACTV8 本地指纹库及在线服务比对，以识别匹配的音频触发内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: ACTV8 的音频触发将无法再被识别，依赖这些触发的应用功能也会停止。

en.description: When an app binds ACTV8’s combined audio-search Service and starts a search, it repeatedly checks microphone samples against local and online audio fingerprints and also looks for ACTV8 sound codes.
en.disableEffect: ACTV8 audio and sound-code triggers will no longer be recognized, so features that depend on them will stop.

zh-CN.description: 应用绑定并启动 ACTV8 的组合音频搜索服务后，它会反复检查麦克风音频，与本地及在线音频指纹比对，并查找 ACTV8 声码。
zh-CN.disableEffect: ACTV8 音频和声码触发将无法再被识别，依赖这些触发的功能也会停止。

en.description: When an app starts or binds ACTV8’s legacy sound-code feature, this Service reads microphone audio and reports detected sound-code IDs to the SDK listener.
en.disableEffect: The legacy ACTV8 sound-code feature will no longer detect audio codes or deliver content triggered by them.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动或绑定 ACTV8 的旧版声码功能时，该服务会读取麦克风音频，并将检测到的声码编号报告给 SDK 监听端。
zh-CN.disableEffect: ACTV8 旧版声码功能将无法检测音频声码，也无法提供由声码触发的内容。

en.description: Cisco DNA Spaces OpenRoaming SDK uses this Activity when it passes a Wi-Fi profile and callback; the Activity submits the profile to Android's Add networks screen and reports the user's response.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot complete installation or confirmation of its OpenRoaming Wi-Fi profile.

zh-CN.description: Cisco DNA Spaces OpenRoaming SDK 会在传入 Wi-Fi 配置文件和回调时使用此 Activity；它会将配置文件提交到 Android 的“添加网络”界面，并返回用户的选择。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用无法完成 OpenRoaming Wi-Fi 配置文件的安装或确认。

en.description: CITCON's payment SDK opens this screen when the user adds a bank card. It collects the card details and returns the payment provider's result to the app.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to add a bank card through this CITCON checkout.

zh-CN.description: 用户添加银行卡时，CITCON 支付 SDK 会打开此页面收集卡片信息，并把支付服务返回的结果交给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此 CITCON 结账流程添加银行卡。

en.description: CITCON's drop-in checkout lets users choose a saved or new payment method, including the card and wallet options supported by the app. It returns the selected payment result to the app.
en.disableEffect: The CITCON payment choices will not open, so users may be unable to pay through this checkout.

zh-CN.description: CITCON 的快捷结账页面让用户选择已保存或新添加的支付方式，包括应用支持的银行卡和电子钱包，并将支付结果交还应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: CITCON 支付选项将无法打开，用户可能无法通过此结账流程付款。

en.description: CITCON's payment SDK opens this screen to review and remove saved payment methods. It returns the updated list to the checkout.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to manage saved payment methods in this CITCON checkout.

zh-CN.description: CITCON 支付 SDK 会打开此页面供用户查看和删除已保存的支付方式，并把更新后的列表交回结账流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在此 CITCON 结账流程中管理已保存的支付方式。

en.description: The CITCON payment SDK opens this screen to start checkout and present the available payment choices. It returns the checkout result to the app, including when a supported payment service sends the user back.
en.disableEffect: CITCON checkout and payment-return flows may not finish.

zh-CN.description: CITCON 支付 SDK 会打开此页面开始结账并展示可用的支付方式；结账结果会交还应用，也会处理受支持支付服务返回应用的流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: CITCON 结账和支付返回流程可能无法完成。

en.description: CITCON's payment SDK uses this screen to receive the result after the user switches to WeChat Pay. It reports success or failure to the active CITCON or UPI payment.
en.disableEffect: WeChat Pay results will not return to the app, so those payments may remain unfinished.

zh-CN.description: 用户跳转到微信支付后，CITCON 支付 SDK 会通过此页面接收结果，并把成功或失败状态交给当前的 CITCON 或 UPI 支付流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 微信支付结果将无法返回应用，因此这类支付可能无法完成。

en.description: CITCON's mobile payment SDK uses this older entry point to receive the result after the user returns from WeChat Pay. It reports whether the order succeeded or failed.
en.disableEffect: WeChat Pay results will not return to the app, so those payments may remain unfinished.

zh-CN.description: 用户从微信支付返回后，CITCON 移动支付 SDK 会通过此旧入口接收结果，并报告订单成功或失败。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 微信支付结果将无法返回应用，因此这类支付可能无法完成。

en.description: City Coder's AndroidToolKit FileManager uses this Provider to create a permission-granted file link when a user shares a file from its file browser.
en.disableEffect: File sharing from the FileManager may fail because Android can no longer provide access to the selected file.

zh-CN.description: City Coder 的 AndroidToolKit 文件管理库会通过此 Provider 为用户分享的文件创建带访问权限的链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，文件管理器中的分享功能可能无法让其他应用读取所选文件。

en.description: City Coder's AndroidToolKit FileManager opens an in-app file browser where users can browse files, choose items and share them.
en.disableEffect: The app's file browser and its file selection and sharing flow will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: City Coder 的 AndroidToolKit 文件管理库会显示设备文件，供用户浏览、选择和分享。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用内的文件浏览、选择和分享流程将无法打开。

en.description: City Coder's AndroidToolKit MediaSelector uses this Provider to create file links for photos produced by its image-capture flow.
en.disableEffect: Camera-based photo capture in the media picker may fail to save or return the captured image.

zh-CN.description: City Coder 的 AndroidToolKit 媒体选择器会通过此 Provider 为拍摄流程生成照片文件链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，媒体选择器中的拍照功能可能无法保存或返回拍摄的照片。

en.description: City Coder's AndroidToolKit MediaSelector opens this screen when a user changes albums in the image or video picker; it lists device albums and returns the chosen album.
en.disableEffect: Users will no longer be able to choose an album while selecting photos or videos.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 City Coder 的 AndroidToolKit 媒体选择器中切换相册时，此页面会列出设备相册并返回所选相册。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户在选择照片或视频时将无法切换相册。

en.description: City Coder's AndroidToolKit MediaSelector opens this screen to crop a photo selected by the user, then returns the saved cropped image.
en.disableEffect: Photo-cropping flows in the app will no longer complete.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 City Coder 的 AndroidToolKit 媒体选择器中裁剪照片时，此页面会显示裁剪工具并返回保存后的图片。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用中的照片裁剪流程将无法完成。

en.description: City Coder's AndroidToolKit MediaSelector opens this screen to preview selected photos and return the user's preview or selection result.
en.disableEffect: The app's photo-preview and confirmation flow may fail when a user selects images.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 City Coder 的 AndroidToolKit 媒体选择器中预览照片时，此页面显示所选图片并返回预览或选择结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户选择图片时的预览和确认流程可能无法完成。

en.description: City Coder's AndroidToolKit MediaSelector opens this screen when the app requests photo selection; it lists device images and returns the chosen photos.
en.disableEffect: The app will no longer be able to open this photo picker or receive its selected images.

zh-CN.description: 应用通过 City Coder 的 AndroidToolKit 媒体选择器请求选图时，此页面会列出设备照片、供用户选择并返回所选图片。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用将无法打开此选图页面或接收用户选中的照片。

en.description: City Coder's AndroidToolKit MediaSelector opens this screen to play and preview a video clip before returning the user's selection.
en.disableEffect: Video preview and confirmation in the app's media picker will stop working.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 City Coder 的 AndroidToolKit 媒体选择器中预览视频时，此页面会播放视频并返回用户的选择。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，媒体选择器中的视频预览和确认功能将无法使用。

en.description: City Coder's AndroidToolKit MediaSelector opens this screen when the app requests video selection; it lists device videos, lets users preview clips and returns their selection.
en.disableEffect: The app will no longer be able to open this video picker or receive its selected clips.

zh-CN.description: 应用通过 City Coder 的 AndroidToolKit 媒体选择器请求选视频时，此页面会列出设备视频，供用户预览、选择并返回片段。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用将无法打开此选视频页面或接收用户选中的视频。

en.description: City Coder's AndroidToolKit ScanCode opens a camera scanner for QR codes and barcodes and can also scan an image chosen from the device gallery.
en.disableEffect: The app's camera and gallery barcode-scanning flow will no longer be available.

zh-CN.description: City Coder 的 AndroidToolKit 扫码库会打开相机扫描二维码和条形码，也可扫描用户从设备图库中选择的图片。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用将无法通过相机或图库扫描二维码和条形码。

en.description: City Coder's AndroidToolKit opens this short-lived screen for tasks that need an Activity, such as requesting permissions or receiving a result from another screen.
en.disableEffect: AndroidToolKit operations that request permissions or wait for another screen's result may not complete.

zh-CN.description: City Coder 的 AndroidToolKit 在需要 Activity 的短暂操作中打开此页面，例如请求权限或接收其他页面返回的结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，AndroidToolKit 中请求权限或等待其他页面返回结果的操作可能无法完成。

en.description: CKEnergy JaCoCoX writes collected test coverage to a local file when the app sends this receiver a broadcast.
en.disableEffect: Test coverage data will not be saved when this receiver is called.

zh-CN.description: 应用向此 Receiver 发送广播时，CKEnergy JaCoCoX 会将收集到的测试覆盖率写入本地文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 调用此 Receiver 时将不会保存测试覆盖率数据。

en.description: CAS.AI's Exchange ad adapter opens an advertiser's web page and video in this in-app browser when an ad needs a landing page. Users can navigate the page or open a link in another app.
en.disableEffect: CAS Exchange ads will not be able to open their in-app landing pages or videos; other app screens continue to work.

zh-CN.description: CAS.AI 的 Exchange 广告适配器会在广告需要落地页时，用此应用内浏览器打开广告主网页和视频；用户可浏览页面或在其他应用中打开链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: CAS Exchange 广告将无法打开应用内落地页或视频，应用的其他页面仍可使用。

en.description: CAS.AI's cross-promotion entry opens this activity, but this SDK version closes it immediately without showing content. It is an ad-related entry point rather than a normal app page.
en.disableEffect: The cross-promotion entry will not open; this version already shows no page, and the app's other features continue.

zh-CN.description: CAS.AI 的交叉推广入口会打开此页面，但此版本会立即关闭页面且不显示内容；它属于广告入口，不是应用的普通页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 交叉推广入口将无法打开；此版本本来就不显示页面，应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: CAS.AI's promo adapter uses this full-screen page to show image or video promotions with close and tap controls. It handles playback and the advertiser's call to action.
en.disableEffect: CAS.AI promotional ads will no longer appear through this screen, while the app's own features continue.

zh-CN.description: CAS.AI 推广广告适配器会用此全屏页面展示图片或视频广告，并提供关闭和点击控件；此页面负责播放广告并处理广告主的行动按钮。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 此页面中的 CAS.AI 推广广告将不再显示，但应用自身功能仍可使用。

en.description: CAS.AI opens this full-screen page for a sample ad used to check an ad integration in the app. It displays the test creative and integration information rather than a regular app screen.
en.disableEffect: CAS.AI's test ad and integration page will not open; regular app features continue.

zh-CN.description: CAS.AI 会为应用中的广告集成检查打开此全屏页面，展示测试广告素材和集成信息，而不是应用的常规页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: CAS.AI 的测试广告和集成页面将无法打开，但应用的常规功能仍可使用。

en.description: CAS.AI uses this full-screen ad end card to show an ad headline and description, a close timer, and an advertiser button. Tapping the button opens the advertiser's page.
en.disableEffect: This CAS.AI ad end card and its advertiser link will not appear; the app's own features continue.

zh-CN.description: CAS.AI 会用此全屏广告结束页展示广告标题、介绍、关闭倒计时和广告主按钮；点击按钮会打开广告主页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 此 CAS.AI 广告结束页及其广告主链接将不再显示，但应用自身功能仍可使用。

en.description: CAS.AI's ads SDK starts this provider with the app and uses it to register for app and screen lifecycle changes. That lets the SDK manage its ad sessions as the user opens and leaves the app.
en.disableEffect: CAS.AI's automatic lifecycle tracking for ads will stop, while the app's own screens continue to work.

zh-CN.description: CAS.AI 广告 SDK 会在应用启动时运行此提供程序，并注册应用和页面的生命周期变化，以便在用户打开或离开应用时管理广告会话。
zh-CN.disableEffect: CAS.AI 的广告自动生命周期跟踪将停止，但应用自身页面仍可正常使用。

en.description: Cleverpine's authentication library opens the sign-in page supplied by the app and watches for the returned sign-in code. It sends that code into the login flow and closes after sign-in completes.
en.disableEffect: Users may not be able to sign in through the app's web-based authentication flow.

zh-CN.description: Cleverpine 身份验证库会打开应用提供的登录页面，并等待返回登录代码；它会把代码交给登录流程，并在登录完成后关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户可能无法通过应用的网页身份验证流程登录。

en.description: Cleverpine's authentication library receives the sign-in link returned by a browser and sends its code into the login flow.
en.disableEffect: Browser-based sign-in may not return to the app, so users may be unable to complete login.

zh-CN.description: Cleverpine 身份验证库会接收浏览器返回的登录链接，并把其中的代码交给登录流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 浏览器登录可能无法返回应用，用户可能无法完成登录。

en.description: When a configured CleverPush geofence is entered or exited, this Receiver waits for its configured delay and reports the transition to CleverPush.
en.disableEffect: CleverPush will not receive these location transitions, so location-triggered messages will not be updated.

zh-CN.description: 进入或离开 CleverPush 配置的地理围栏后，这个 Receiver 会等待设定的延迟，再将状态变化发送给 CleverPush。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 这些位置变化将不会发送给 CleverPush，因此基于位置的消息将无法更新。

en.description: When a user opens a CleverPush notification, this Activity processes the click, records it, and follows the app-opening or link behavior configured for that notification.
en.disableEffect: CleverPush notification taps will not be processed, so click tracking and configured app or link opening will fail.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 CleverPush 通知时，这个 Activity 会处理点击、记录点击，并按通知设置打开应用或跳转链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: CleverPush 通知点击将无法处理，点击记录以及按设置打开应用或链接的操作都会失效。

en.description: When CleverPush requests location or notification access, this Activity shows the Android permission prompt and returns the result to the SDK.
en.disableEffect: CleverPush cannot request location or notification access through its permission flow, so features that need those grants may remain unavailable.

zh-CN.description: CleverPush 请求定位或通知权限时，这个 Activity 会显示 Android 权限提示，并将结果返回给 SDK。
zh-CN.disableEffect: CleverPush 将无法通过自己的权限流程请求定位或通知权限，因此依赖这些授权的功能可能无法使用。

en.description: When a CleverPush in-app banner action opens a link inside the app, this Activity displays the web page with a close control.
en.disableEffect: Links configured to open inside a CleverPush banner will not open in the app.

zh-CN.description: CleverPush 应用内横幅操作选择在应用内打开链接时，这个 Activity 会显示网页并提供关闭按钮。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 设置为在应用内打开的 CleverPush 横幅链接将无法打开。

en.description: The CleverPush inbox opens a selected message banner in this Activity and handles actions provided inside that message.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to open CleverPush inbox message details or use the actions inside them.

zh-CN.description: CleverPush 收件箱会在这个 Activity 中展示所选消息的横幅内容，并处理消息内提供的操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开 CleverPush 收件箱消息详情，也无法使用消息内的操作。

en.description: When a user changes images or dismisses a CleverPush carousel notification, this Service refreshes the carousel or removes its cached images.
en.disableEffect: Image controls on CleverPush carousel notifications will stop working, and dismissed carousel images may remain cached.

zh-CN.description: 用户切换 CleverPush 轮播通知的图片或清除通知时，这个 Service 会更新轮播内容或删除缓存图片。
zh-CN.disableEffect: CleverPush 轮播通知的图片切换操作将失效，清除通知后其缓存图片也可能残留。

en.description: When the app task is removed, this Service lets CleverPush clear its session state after checking that no notification click is still being handled.
en.disableEffect: CleverPush session cleanup after the app is swiped away will not run, so its in-memory notification state can remain until the process stops.

zh-CN.description: 应用任务从最近任务中移除时，这个 Service 会确认没有正在处理的通知点击，然后清理 CleverPush 会话状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用从最近任务中划掉后，CleverPush 将不会执行会话清理，通知相关的内存状态可能保留到进程结束。

en.description: This Firebase Cloud Messaging Service receives CleverPush messages and refreshed device tokens, then passes them to the SDK for display and subscription updates.
en.disableEffect: CleverPush messages delivered through Firebase will not be handled, and refreshed device tokens will not reach the subscription.

zh-CN.description: 这个 Firebase Cloud Messaging Service 会接收 CleverPush 消息和更新后的设备令牌，再交由 SDK 展示消息并更新订阅。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过 Firebase 送达的 CleverPush 消息将无法处理，更新后的设备令牌也不会同步到订阅。

en.description: When Google Play services reports a CleverPush geofence transition, this Service sends the region and enter or exit state to CleverPush.
en.disableEffect: Geofence transitions routed to this Service will not reach CleverPush, so location-based messaging may miss those events.

zh-CN.description: Google Play 服务报告 CleverPush 地理围栏变化时，这个 Service 会将围栏和进入或离开状态发送给 CleverPush。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 发送到这个 Service 的地理围栏变化将无法到达 CleverPush，基于位置的消息可能会漏掉这些事件。

en.description: This Huawei Push Service receives CleverPush messages and refreshed device tokens, then passes them to the SDK for processing and subscription updates.
en.disableEffect: CleverPush messages delivered through Huawei Push will not be handled, and refreshed device tokens will not reach the subscription.

zh-CN.description: 这个 Huawei Push Service 会接收 CleverPush 消息和更新后的设备令牌，再交由 SDK 处理并更新订阅。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过 Huawei Push 送达的 CleverPush 消息将无法处理，更新后的设备令牌也不会同步到订阅。

en.description: When a user dismisses a CleverPush notification, this Service updates the app icon badge according to the message settings.
en.disableEffect: The app icon badge will not be updated when a CleverPush notification is dismissed.

zh-CN.description: 用户清除 CleverPush 通知时，这个 Service 会根据消息设置更新应用图标角标。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 清除 CleverPush 通知时，应用图标角标将不会更新。

en.description: When a user opens a CleverPush Story, this Activity displays the story content and records its viewed state.
en.disableEffect: CleverPush Stories will not open, and their viewed state will not be updated.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 CleverPush Stories 中的故事时，这个 Activity 会展示故事内容并记录已读状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: CleverPush Stories 中的故事将无法打开，已读状态也不会更新。

en.description: CAS.AI's VAST ad player uses this full-screen page to play a video ad with its ad controls. It closes when playback finishes or an ad error occurs.
en.disableEffect: VAST video ads will not play through CAS.AI, while the app's own features continue.

zh-CN.description: CAS.AI 的 VAST 广告播放器会用此全屏页面播放视频广告及其控件；播放结束或发生广告错误时页面会关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: CAS.AI 将无法通过此页面播放 VAST 视频广告，但应用自身功能仍可使用。

en.description: CleverTap DirectCall starts this service for incoming-call and cancellation messages delivered through Firebase; it shows the incoming-call notification or ends the call alert.
en.disableEffect: Incoming DirectCall alerts may not ring or appear, and cancellation updates may not be handled.

zh-CN.description: CleverTap DirectCall 在 Firebase 送达来电或取消消息时启动此服务；它会显示来电通知，或结束来电提示。
zh-CN.disableEffect: DirectCall 来电可能无法响铃或显示，取消状态也可能无法处理。

en.description: When someone taps Answer, Decline, Hang up, or a missed-call action on a CleverTap DirectCall notification, this receiver sends that choice to the call screen or call handler.
en.disableEffect: Users may not be able to answer or decline an incoming DirectCall from its notification, hang up, or use a missed-call action.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击 CleverTap DirectCall 通知中的接听、拒绝、挂断或未接来电操作时，此接收器会把选择交给通话界面或通话处理流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户可能无法从通知接听或拒绝 DirectCall 来电、挂断通话，或使用未接来电操作。

en.description: When a regular phone call starts during DirectCall, CleverTap DirectCall can pause the internet call and restore it after the phone call ends.
en.disableEffect: A regular call may interrupt DirectCall audio, or the internet call may stay paused after the regular call ends.

zh-CN.description: DirectCall 通话期间，CleverTap DirectCall 会监听普通电话的状态；普通电话开始或结束时，它会暂停或恢复网络通话。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 普通电话可能无法让正在进行的 DirectCall 暂停或在结束后恢复，两通电话可能相互干扰。

en.description: CleverTap DirectCall starts this foreground service when an incoming call needs a notification; it displays the call alert and starts ringing audio.
