en.disableEffect: Incoming DirectCall notifications and their ringing audio may stop working.

zh-CN.description: 来电需要通知时，CleverTap DirectCall 会启动此前台服务，显示来电提示并播放铃声。
zh-CN.disableEffect: DirectCall 来电通知和铃声可能无法正常工作。

en.description: CleverTap DirectCall uses this background service to keep the connection for call alerts available while the app is closed.
en.disableEffect: Background call alerts may be delayed or missed when the app is closed.

zh-CN.description: 应用关闭时，CleverTap DirectCall 会通过此后台服务维持接收来电提示所需的连接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用关闭时，来电提示可能延迟或无法收到。

en.description: CleverTap DirectCall opens this screen for an incoming or outgoing call, shows the matching call controls, and configures call audio.
en.disableEffect: The app may lose the DirectCall screen for placing or answering calls and managing an active call.

zh-CN.description: CleverTap DirectCall 会在来电或拨出电话时打开此界面，显示相应的通话控制并设置通话音频。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用可能无法显示 DirectCall 拨号或接听界面，也无法管理进行中的通话。

en.description: After the device restarts, CleverTap Geofence restores registered geofences and location updates when the required location permissions are available.
en.disableEffect: Location-based CleverTap triggers may not resume after a restart until geofences and location updates are registered again.

zh-CN.description: 设备重启后，只要具备所需定位权限，CleverTap Geofence 就会恢复已登记的地理围栏和位置更新。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 重启后，基于位置的 CleverTap 触发可能无法恢复，直到地理围栏和位置更新重新登记。

en.description: When a saved location area reports a transition, CleverTap Geofence sends the event for processing.
en.disableEffect: CleverTap may miss location-area events and the campaigns or messages they trigger.

zh-CN.description: 已保存的位置区域报告状态变化时，CleverTap Geofence 会发送该事件进行处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: CleverTap 可能错过位置区域事件及其触发的活动或消息。

en.description: When a location update arrives, CleverTap Geofence forwards it for processing.
en.disableEffect: CleverTap may miss location updates and any location-triggered messages.

zh-CN.description: 收到位置更新时，CleverTap Geofence 会转交该更新进行处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: CleverTap 可能错过位置更新和由此触发的消息。

en.description: When Huawei Push Kit delivers a message or a refreshed device token, this CleverTap service passes it to the Huawei push handler.
en.disableEffect: Huawei-delivered CleverTap pushes may not display, and refreshed push tokens may not reach CleverTap.

zh-CN.description: Huawei Push Kit 送达消息或更新设备令牌时，CleverTap 此服务会将其交给华为推送处理流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过华为送达的 CleverTap 推送可能无法显示，更新后的推送令牌也可能无法传给 CleverTap。

en.description: When Firebase delivers a CleverTap push, RenderMax helps the SDK finish displaying the notification.
en.disableEffect: Some CleverTap push notifications may not appear or may take longer to display.

zh-CN.description: Firebase 送达 CleverTap 推送时，RenderMax 会协助 SDK 完成通知显示。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 部分 CleverTap 推送可能无法显示，或显示延迟。

en.description: When Firebase delivers a CleverTap push, RenderMax helps the SDK finish displaying the notification.
en.disableEffect: Some CleverTap push notifications may not appear or may take longer to display.

zh-CN.description: Firebase 送达 CleverTap 推送时，RenderMax 会协助 SDK 完成通知显示。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 部分 CleverTap 推送可能无法显示，或显示延迟。

en.description: When someone opens a CleverTap template push, this receiver handles the tap and clears temporary images used by the notification.
en.disableEffect: Tapping a template push may stop opening the app or its link, and temporary images may remain stored.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 CleverTap 模板推送时，此接收器会处理点击并清理通知使用的临时图片。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 点击模板推送后，应用或目标链接可能无法打开，临时图片也可能留在设备上。

en.description: When CleverTap handles a template notification or one of its actions, this receiver renders or updates rating, carousel, product, and reply notifications.
en.disableEffect: CleverTap template notifications and their rating, carousel, product, or reply controls may stop working.

zh-CN.description: CleverTap 处理模板通知或其操作时，此接收器会显示或更新评分、轮播、商品和回复类通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: CleverTap 模板通知及其中的评分、轮播、商品或回复控件可能无法工作。

en.description: CleverTap uses this component to let push notifications display GIFs downloaded to the app.
en.disableEffect: GIFs in some CleverTap push notifications may not display.

zh-CN.description: CleverTap 使用此组件显示已下载到应用中的推送通知 GIF 图片。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 部分 CleverTap 推送通知中的 GIF 图片可能无法显示。

en.description: CleverTap opens this activity to show in-app campaign messages and also uses it for notification-permission prompts.
en.disableEffect: CleverTap in-app messages and its notification-permission prompt may not appear.

zh-CN.description: CleverTap 会打开此界面显示应用内活动消息，也会用它展示通知权限提示。
zh-CN.disableEffect: CleverTap 应用内消息和通知权限提示可能无法显示。

en.description: CleverTap App Inbox opens this activity to display a user’s saved notification messages, with optional tabs.
en.disableEffect: Users may not be able to open the CleverTap App Inbox.

zh-CN.description: CleverTap App Inbox 会打开此界面展示用户保存的通知消息，并可按标签分页。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户可能无法打开 CleverTap App Inbox。

en.description: When a user closes a CleverTap Live Update notification, this receiver tells CleverTap to update the notification state.
en.disableEffect: CleverTap may not receive the dismissal, leaving its notification state out of sync.

zh-CN.description: 用户关闭 CleverTap Live Update 通知时，此接收器会通知 CleverTap 更新通知状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: CleverTap 可能收不到关闭事件，通知状态可能不同步。

en.description: When a user taps a CleverTap push notification, this receiver records the click and opens the app or the notification’s target link.
en.disableEffect: Push taps may no longer open the app or target link through this CleverTap handler, and click tracking may be lost.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击 CleverTap 推送通知时，此接收器会记录点击并打开应用或通知指向的链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 点击推送后，CleverTap 可能无法通过此处理流程打开应用或目标链接，点击记录也可能丢失。

en.description: When CleverTap needs a backup display path for a Firebase push, this receiver helps finish handling it and records that it was shown.
en.disableEffect: CleverTap may fail to record that some backup-displayed pushes were shown.

zh-CN.description: CleverTap 需要备用方式显示 Firebase 推送时，此接收器会协助完成处理并记录通知已显示。
zh-CN.disableEffect: CleverTap 可能无法记录部分通过备用方式显示的推送。

en.description: CleverTap SignedCall starts this service after a call push arrives and passes the incoming call details to the call handler.
en.disableEffect: Incoming SignedCall alerts may not start or appear.

zh-CN.description: 收到通话推送后，CleverTap SignedCall 会启动此服务，并把来电信息交给通话处理流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: SignedCall 来电提示可能无法启动或显示。

en.description: When a user taps or cancels the temporary CleverTap SignedCall notification used while a Firebase call alert is processed, this receiver opens the app or handles the cancel action.
en.disableEffect: The temporary call-processing notification’s open and cancel buttons may stop responding.

zh-CN.description: Firebase 通话提示处理期间，用户点击或取消 CleverTap SignedCall 的临时通知时，此接收器会打开应用或处理取消操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通话处理临时通知中的打开和取消按钮可能失去响应。

en.description: When a user opens or cancels a CleverTap SignedCall M2P notification, this receiver opens the app, calls the configured notification listener, or processes the cancel action.
en.disableEffect: M2P notification taps, configured click callbacks, and cancel handling may stop working.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开或取消 CleverTap SignedCall 的 M2P 通知时，此接收器会打开应用、调用已设置的通知回调，或处理取消操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: M2P 通知点击、已设置的点击回调和取消处理可能无法工作。

en.description: When someone taps Answer, Decline, Hang up, or a missed-call action on a CleverTap SignedCall notification, this receiver routes the choice to the calling flow.
en.disableEffect: Users may not be able to answer or decline SignedCalls from notifications, hang up, or use missed-call actions.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击 CleverTap SignedCall 通知中的接听、拒绝、挂断或未接来电操作时，此接收器会将选择交给通话流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户可能无法从通知接听或拒绝 SignedCall、挂断通话，或使用未接来电操作。

en.description: When a regular phone call starts during SignedCall, this receiver pauses the internet call and restores it after the regular call ends.
en.disableEffect: A regular call may interrupt SignedCall audio, or the internet call may stay paused after the regular call ends.

zh-CN.description: CleverTap SignedCall 通话期间，此接收器会监听普通电话状态，并在需要时暂停或恢复网络通话。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 普通电话可能无法暂停或恢复正在进行的 SignedCall，两通电话的声音可能相互干扰。

en.description: CleverTap SignedCall starts this foreground service for an incoming call; it displays the call notification and starts ringing audio.
en.disableEffect: Incoming SignedCall notifications and their ringing audio may stop working.

zh-CN.description: CleverTap SignedCall 会为来电启动此服务，显示来电通知并播放铃声。
zh-CN.disableEffect: SignedCall 来电通知和铃声可能无法正常工作。

en.description: CleverTap SignedCall uses this background service to keep the connection for call alerts available while the app is closed.
en.disableEffect: Background call alerts may be delayed or missed when the app is closed.

zh-CN.description: 应用关闭时，CleverTap SignedCall 会通过此后台服务维持接收来电提示所需的连接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用关闭时，来电提示可能延迟或无法收到。

en.description: During an active CleverTap SignedCall, this foreground service displays the ongoing-call notification and keeps the call’s microphone service running.
en.disableEffect: An active SignedCall may lose its foreground call service or be ended if service startup fails.

zh-CN.description: CleverTap SignedCall 通话进行中，此前台服务会显示通话通知并维持通话所需的麦克风服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 正在进行的 SignedCall 可能失去前台通话服务；服务启动失败时，通话也可能结束。

en.description: If the app is swiped away during a call, CleverTap SignedCall either keeps the call running as configured or closes the call and removes its notification.
en.disableEffect: Swiping the app away may leave a call or its notification in the wrong state.

zh-CN.description: 通话期间应用被划掉时，CleverTap SignedCall 会按设置保持通话，或结束通话并移除通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 划掉应用后，通话或其通知可能无法正确保持或清理。

en.description: When a user opens or cancels a CleverTap SignedCall notification, or chooses a missed-call action, this activity routes that action and then closes.
en.disableEffect: Opening SignedCall notifications and using their cancel or missed-call actions may fail.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开或取消 CleverTap SignedCall 通知，或选择未接来电操作时，此界面会处理相应操作后关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 打开 SignedCall 通知以及使用取消或未接来电操作可能失败。

en.description: CleverTap SignedCall opens this screen for incoming, outgoing, and ongoing calls, showing the matching call controls and configuring call audio.
en.disableEffect: The app may lose the SignedCall screen for placing or answering calls and managing an active call.

zh-CN.description: CleverTap SignedCall 会在来电、拨出或通话进行中打开此界面，显示相应控制并设置通话音频。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用可能无法显示 SignedCall 拨号或接听界面，也无法管理进行中的通话。

en.description: CleverTap uses this receiver for Xiaomi push messages; it displays pass-through messages and forwards push registration results.
en.disableEffect: CleverTap may not receive Xiaomi push messages or registration updates.

zh-CN.description: CleverTap 使用此接收器处理小米推送消息；它会显示透传消息并转交推送注册结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: CleverTap 可能无法收到小米推送消息或注册更新。

en.description: When Clicktale starts a background upload, this service sends recorded session events or video and reports when the upload is done.
en.disableEffect: Recorded Clicktale session data or video may remain unsent.

zh-CN.description: Clicktale 开始后台上传时，此服务会发送记录的会话事件或视频，并报告上传完成状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Clicktale 记录的会话数据或视频可能无法发送。

en.description: Clicktale starts this service when session events or recordings are ready to upload; it can defer video uploads until Wi-Fi is available.
en.disableEffect: Clicktale session events or recordings may stop uploading, including uploads waiting for Wi-Fi.

zh-CN.description: 会话事件或录制内容准备上传时，Clicktale 会启动此服务；视频上传可等到 Wi-Fi 可用时再进行。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Clicktale 会话事件或录制内容可能停止上传，包括正在等待 Wi-Fi 的上传。

en.description: When a Clicktale video upload is waiting for Wi-Fi, this receiver watches for Wi-Fi to connect and starts the upload.
en.disableEffect: Wi-Fi-only Clicktale video uploads may remain queued after Wi-Fi connects.

zh-CN.description: Clicktale 视频上传等待 Wi-Fi 时，此接收器会等待 Wi-Fi 连接并启动上传。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Wi-Fi 已连接后，仅限 Wi-Fi 的 Clicktale 视频上传也可能继续留在队列中。

en.description: When the app starts, Clicktale begins watching when screens open, appear, pause, or close so it can record a session.
en.disableEffect: Clicktale may stop observing app screens and miss normal session activity.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，Clicktale 会开始观察界面打开、显示、暂停和关闭的时机，以记录会话。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Clicktale 可能停止观察应用界面，漏记正常的会话活动。

en.description: NewNode (Clostra's decentralized content delivery SDK) listens for low-battery and battery-restored broadcasts. It pauses nearby-device discovery while the battery is low and resumes it when the battery recovers.
en.disableEffect: NewNode will not pause its nearby-device activity when the battery is low, so it may use more battery.

zh-CN.description: NewNode（Clostra 的去中心化内容分发 SDK）会监听电量过低和电量恢复广播。电量过低时，它会暂停附近设备发现；电量恢复后再继续。
zh-CN.disableEffect: NewNode 不会在电量过低时暂停附近设备活动，因此可能会消耗更多电量。

en.description: NewNode (Clostra's decentralized content delivery SDK) opens this Activity when it needs Android's nearby-device permissions. It explains location access where required and requests nearby Wi-Fi, location, or Bluetooth permission before starting nearby connections.
en.disableEffect: Without this Activity, NewNode cannot request the permissions needed for nearby content delivery, so app content that depends on this network may not load.

zh-CN.description: NewNode（Clostra 的去中心化内容分发 SDK）需要附近设备权限时会打开此 Activity。它会在需要时说明位置权限用途，并在启动附近连接前请求附近 Wi-Fi、位置或蓝牙权限。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 没有此 Activity，NewNode 无法请求附近内容分发所需的权限，因此依赖该网络的应用内容可能无法加载。

en.description: JioPay AutoRead OTP starts this background service for SDK event logs and session records. It saves log entries and creates or updates session data.
en.disableEffect: JioPay's SDK event and session records will not be processed.

zh-CN.description: JioPay AutoRead OTP 会在后台处理 SDK 的事件日志和会话记录，包括保存日志以及创建或更新会话信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: JioPay SDK 的事件和会话记录将无法处理。

en.description: Cloud273 Localization receives system language-change broadcasts and reloads the app’s saved language preference so the app can use the updated setting.
en.disableEffect: The app will not automatically reload its language preference after the device language changes.

zh-CN.description: Cloud273 Localization 会接收系统语言变更广播，并重新载入应用保存的语言偏好，使应用能够使用更新后的设置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 设备语言更改后，应用将无法自动重新载入语言偏好。

en.description: CloudFive Push receives Firebase messages for the app and forwards their data to its push handler. It also forwards refreshed Firebase messaging tokens so the app can remain registered for push delivery.
en.disableEffect: The app will stop receiving CloudFive push messages and Firebase token updates through this service.

zh-CN.description: CloudFive Push 会接收发送给应用的 Firebase 消息，并将消息数据转交给推送处理程序。它也会转交更新后的 Firebase 消息令牌，以维持推送注册。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法再通过此服务接收 CloudFive 推送消息或 Firebase 令牌更新。

en.description: CloudRail SI opens an authorization page when an app connects to a service that requires sign-in. It loads the service’s sign-in page and returns the authorization details when the page redirects back to the app.
en.disableEffect: Users will be unable to finish sign-in for CloudRail-connected accounts, so app features that rely on those accounts may stop working.

zh-CN.description: 应用连接到需要登录的服务时，CloudRail SI 会打开授权页面。它会载入服务的登录页面，并在页面跳回应用时返回授权信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法完成 CloudRail 所连接账户的登录，因此依赖这些账户的应用功能可能无法使用。

en.description: Clover Go uses this Service to transfer firmware updates to supported payment readers over Bluetooth. It runs the Nordic firmware-update service used by the reader update flow.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents firmware updates for supported readers and may eventually affect their compatibility with payment features.

zh-CN.description: Clover Go 会通过此 Service 使用蓝牙为受支持的支付读卡器传输固件更新。它运行读卡器更新流程所用的 Nordic 固件更新服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后将无法为受支持的读卡器更新固件，之后可能影响读卡器与支付功能的兼容性。

en.description: Clover Connector listens for supported payment readers being connected or removed over USB. It requests USB access and starts the connection service to set up, connect to, or disconnect from the reader.
en.disableEffect: The app will not automatically detect and connect to a Clover reader over USB, so payments that use that reader may fail.

zh-CN.description: Clover Connector 会监听受支持的支付读卡器通过 USB 接入或移除的事件。它会请求 USB 访问权限，并启动连接服务来设置、连接或断开读卡器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法通过 USB 自动检测并连接 Clover 读卡器，因此使用该读卡器的支付可能失败。

en.description: Clover Connector starts this Service when a supported USB payment reader is set up, connected, or disconnected. It opens the reader connection and carries payment messages between the app and the reader.
en.disableEffect: The app will not be able to communicate with a Clover reader over USB, so transactions that rely on it may fail.

zh-CN.description: 设置、连接或断开受支持的 USB 支付读卡器时，Clover Connector 会启动此 Service。它会打开读卡器连接，并在应用与读卡器之间传递支付消息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法通过 USB 与 Clover 读卡器通信，因此依赖该读卡器的交易可能失败。

en.description: Android opens this brief Clover Connector Activity when a supported payment reader is attached over USB. It requests USB access, starts the reader connection, and then closes.
en.disableEffect: The app may not be able to request access or start setup for a newly attached Clover reader, preventing USB payments.

zh-CN.description: 受支持的支付读卡器通过 USB 接入时，Android 会打开 Clover Connector 的短暂 Activity。它会请求 USB 访问权限、启动读卡器连接，然后关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用可能无法请求访问新接入的 Clover 读卡器或启动其设置，从而无法进行 USB 支付。

en.description: Clover Go opens this Activity while a merchant authorizes the app. It displays the sign-in page and returns to the app when the page reaches the app’s callback address.
en.disableEffect: Users will be unable to finish Clover account authorization, so the app may not connect to the merchant account.

zh-CN.description: 商家授权应用时，Clover Go 会打开此 Activity。它会显示登录页面，并在页面到达应用的回调地址时返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法完成 Clover 账户授权，因此应用可能无法连接到商家账户。

en.description: When an app requests screen sharing during a UPRTC session, this CMCIM real-time communications Service captures the screen and sends it as video to other participants.
en.disableEffect: The app’s screen-sharing feature will not work in UPRTC calls.

zh-CN.description: 应用在 UPRTC 通话中请求共享屏幕时，CMCIM 实时通信 SDK 的此 Service 会捕获屏幕，并将其作为视频发送给其他参与者。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法在 UPRTC 通话中使用屏幕共享功能。

en.description: When a UPush link or notification tap opens it, CMCIM UPush brings the app to the foreground and passes along the notification details so the app can open the right screen.
en.disableEffect: UPush links and notification taps will no longer be routed to their destination in the app.

zh-CN.description: 通过 UPush 链接或点击通知打开时，CMCIM UPush 会将应用带到前台，并传递通知详情，让应用打开相应页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: UPush 链接和通知点击将无法再跳转到应用中的目标页面。

en.description: CMCIM UPush opens this Activity when Android routes a notification click to it. The app is brought to the foreground and receives the message details for navigation.
en.disableEffect: Tapping a UPush notification may no longer open the app at the intended destination.

zh-CN.description: Android 将通知点击路由到此 Activity 时，CMCIM UPush 会打开它。应用会转到前台并收到用于页面跳转的消息详情。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 点击 UPush 通知后，应用可能无法打开预期的目标页面。

en.description: When Firebase refreshes its messaging token, this CMCIM UPush service registers the new token with UPush for the app.
en.disableEffect: UPush cannot refresh this app’s Firebase push registration, so delivery through Firebase may stop.

zh-CN.description: Firebase 更新消息令牌时，CMCIM UPush 的此 Service 会将新令牌注册到 UPush。
zh-CN.disableEffect: UPush 无法更新应用的 Firebase 推送注册，因此通过 Firebase 发送的推送可能停止。

en.description: When Honor Push provides a new device token, this CMCIM UPush service registers it with UPush and enables Honor’s notification center.
en.disableEffect: UPush cannot register refreshed Honor tokens, so push delivery through Honor may stop.

zh-CN.description: Honor Push 提供新的设备令牌时，CMCIM UPush 的此 Service 会将令牌注册到 UPush，并启用 Honor 通知中心。
zh-CN.disableEffect: UPush 无法注册更新后的 Honor 令牌，因此通过 Honor 发送的推送可能停止。

en.description: When Huawei Push refreshes the device token, this CMCIM UPush service registers the new token with UPush.
en.disableEffect: UPush cannot refresh this app’s Huawei push registration, so Huawei push delivery may stop.

zh-CN.description: Huawei Push 更新设备令牌时，CMCIM UPush 的此 Service 会将新令牌注册到 UPush。
zh-CN.disableEffect: UPush 无法更新应用的 Huawei 推送注册，因此 Huawei 推送可能停止。

en.description: When Meizu Push reports a registration result, this CMCIM UPush receiver passes the device’s Meizu push ID to UPush.
en.disableEffect: UPush cannot register this device with Meizu Push, so delivery through Meizu may stop.

zh-CN.description: Meizu Push 返回注册结果时，CMCIM UPush 的此 Receiver 会将设备的 Meizu 推送 ID 传给 UPush。
zh-CN.disableEffect: UPush 无法向 Meizu Push 注册此设备，因此通过 Meizu 发送的推送可能停止。

en.description: CMCIM UPush uses this compatibility service to receive OPPO ColorOS data-message callbacks.
en.disableEffect: UPush will no longer receive data-message callbacks through the compatible OPPO push service.

zh-CN.description: CMCIM UPush 使用此兼容 Service 接收 OPPO ColorOS 数据消息回调。
zh-CN.disableEffect: UPush 将无法再通过兼容的 OPPO 推送服务接收数据消息回调。

en.description: CMCIM UPush uses this service to receive data-message callbacks from OPPO and HeyTap Push.
en.disableEffect: UPush will no longer receive data-message callbacks through OPPO or HeyTap Push.

zh-CN.description: CMCIM UPush 使用此 Service 接收 OPPO 和 HeyTap Push 的数据消息回调。
zh-CN.disableEffect: UPush 将无法再通过 OPPO 或 HeyTap Push 接收数据消息回调。

en.description: When CMCIM UPush’s heartbeat broadcast arrives, this Receiver asks the SDK to check and reconnect its push connection.
en.disableEffect: UPush will lose this background connection check, which may make push delivery less reliable.

zh-CN.description: 收到 CMCIM UPush 的心跳广播时，此 Receiver 会让 SDK 检查并重新连接推送服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: UPush 将无法通过此方式在后台检查连接，推送送达可能变得不稳定。

en.description: CMCIM UPush listens for Wi-Fi and network-connectivity changes and requests a reconnect when network access returns.
en.disableEffect: UPush will not automatically reconnect when the network returns, so notifications may be delayed or missed.

zh-CN.description: CMCIM UPush 会监听 Wi-Fi 和网络连接变化，并在网络恢复时请求重新连接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 网络恢复后，UPush 将无法自动重新连接，因此通知可能延迟或无法送达。

en.description: After the device boots or app data is cleared, CMCIM UPush asks its service to restore the push connection.
en.disableEffect: UPush will not automatically restore its background connection after device startup or app-data clearing.

zh-CN.description: 设备启动或应用数据被清除后，CMCIM UPush 会让其服务恢复推送连接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 设备启动或应用数据被清除后，UPush 将无法自动恢复后台连接。

en.description: CMCIM UPush uses this background Service to keep a connection to its main push service and reconnect if that service stops.
en.disableEffect: UPush loses one of its background recovery paths, so push notifications may be less reliable.

zh-CN.description: CMCIM UPush 使用此后台 Service 维持与主要推送服务的连接，并在主要服务停止时重新连接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: UPush 将失去一条后台恢复路径，因此推送通知可能变得不稳定。

en.description: Android runs this CMCIM UPush job when the SDK’s background process needs recovery. The job asks UPush to restart its push connection if it is not already running.
en.disableEffect: UPush will lose this scheduled recovery path, so push delivery may be less reliable after background process stops.

zh-CN.description: SDK 后台进程需要恢复时，Android 会运行 CMCIM UPush 的此任务。如果推送服务尚未运行，该任务会请求 UPush 重新启动连接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 后台进程停止后，UPush 将失去此定时恢复方式，推送送达可能变得不稳定。

en.description: CMCIM UPush starts this main background Service to register the device and user, maintain push delivery, and handle reconnect requests.
en.disableEffect: The app will stop receiving CMCIM UPush notifications and cannot maintain its UPush device registration.

zh-CN.description: CMCIM UPush 会启动此主要后台 Service 来注册设备和用户、维持推送送达并处理重新连接请求。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法再接收 CMCIM UPush 通知，也无法维持 UPush 设备注册。

en.description: This is CMCIM UPush’s Vivo push callback receiver. Vivo Push sends delivery events here for the SDK to handle.
en.disableEffect: UPush will no longer receive push callbacks from Vivo Push.

zh-CN.description: 这是 CMCIM UPush 的 Vivo 推送回调 Receiver。Vivo Push 会将推送事件发送到这里供 SDK 处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: UPush 将无法再接收来自 Vivo Push 的推送回调。

en.description: When Xiaomi Push reports successful device registration, this CMCIM UPush receiver sends the Xiaomi token to UPush.
en.disableEffect: UPush cannot register or refresh this device’s Xiaomi push token, so delivery through Xiaomi may stop.

zh-CN.description: Xiaomi Push 成功注册设备时，CMCIM UPush 的此 Receiver 会将 Xiaomi 令牌发送给 UPush。
zh-CN.disableEffect: UPush 无法注册或更新此设备的 Xiaomi 推送令牌，因此通过 Xiaomi 发送的推送可能停止。

en.description: China Mobile's unified carrier-authentication SDK displays a phone-number sign-in and operator-terms page when an app requests one-tap phone login. It returns the authentication result to the calling SDK.
en.disableEffect: One-tap carrier phone login through CMCC, Umeng, Jiguang, or the game-channel integration will fail.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求一键手机号登录时，中国移动统一认证 SDK 会显示手机号登录和运营商协议页面，并将认证结果返回调用 SDK。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过 CMCC、友盟、极光或游戏渠道集成的一键运营商手机号登录将无法完成。

en.description: The Cnmen Photo Selector library opens this Activity when an app requests image selection. It shows a photo grid, enforces the requested selection limit, supports optional cropping, and returns the chosen images.
en.disableEffect: App flows that rely on this picker to choose or crop photos may fail to accept those images.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求选图时，Cnmen Photo Selector 会打开此界面。它显示照片网格，按应用要求限制选择数量，支持可选裁剪，并把选中的照片交回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此选择器来选择或裁剪照片的应用流程可能无法接收这些图片。

en.description: Cnmen Photo Selector opens this screen when an app asks to review selected images. Users can swipe through, remove or restore images, and save remote images to the gallery before returning the remaining selection.
en.disableEffect: The app's image-review step cannot open, so users may be unable to confirm or edit selected photos.

zh-CN.description: 应用需要检查已选图片时，Cnmen Photo Selector 会打开此预览界面。用户可以滑动查看、移除或恢复图片，也可以把远程图片保存到图库，然后返回剩余选择。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用的图片预览步骤无法打开，用户可能无法确认或编辑已选照片。

en.description: CMS3102 Lotto Picker shows the zodiac sign for the date a user selects. Its result button opens the Lotto Picker result screen.
en.disableEffect: The zodiac-based lottery selection screen is unavailable when this Activity is disabled.

zh-CN.description: CMS3102 Lotto Picker 会根据用户选择的日期显示星座；结果按钮会打开 Lotto Picker 的号码结果页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，用户无法使用按星座选择号码的页面。

en.description: CMS3102 Lotto Picker opens this Activity as a static layout page. The Activity displays its layout without running a lottery selection flow.
en.disableEffect: This static layout page becomes unavailable.

zh-CN.description: CMS3102 Lotto Picker 会打开此静态布局页面；此 Activity 只显示布局，不执行彩票号码选择流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，此静态布局页面无法打开。

en.description: CMS3102 Lotto Picker's launcher screen offers random, zodiac-based, and name-based lottery number choices. The library manifest marks it as a launcher Activity.
en.disableEffect: If the app relies on this entry screen, disabling it removes the Lotto Picker menu and its launcher entry.

zh-CN.description: CMS3102 Lotto Picker 的启动页面提供随机、按星座和按姓名生成彩票号码的入口；库的清单将它标记为启动 Activity。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 如果应用依赖此入口，禁用后 Lotto Picker 菜单和对应的启动入口会消失。

en.description: CMS3102 Lotto Picker lets the user enter a name and creates lottery numbers from that text, then opens the result screen.
en.disableEffect: The name-based number generator cannot be opened when this Activity is disabled.

zh-CN.description: CMS3102 Lotto Picker 允许用户输入姓名，根据输入内容生成彩票号码并打开结果页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，用户无法打开按姓名生成号码的页面。

en.description: CMS3102 Lotto Picker's result screen displays six lottery numbers as numbered balls and labels them with the supplied name, zodiac sign, or a general caption.
en.disableEffect: Generated lottery numbers cannot be shown on this result screen when it is disabled.

zh-CN.description: CMS3102 Lotto Picker 的结果页面会以号码球显示六个彩票号码，并使用传入的姓名、星座或通用说明作为标题。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，生成的彩票号码无法通过此结果页面显示。

en.description: CMS3102 Lotto Picker's test screen offers buttons to open its sample picker pages and a website. It is a test menu rather than the number generator itself.
en.disableEffect: This test menu becomes unavailable; the picker pages are separate Activities.

zh-CN.description: CMS3102 Lotto Picker 的测试页面提供按钮，用于打开示例选择页面和一个网站；它是测试菜单，不负责生成号码。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后只有此测试菜单无法打开，号码选择页面是独立的 Activity。

en.description: The RippleView sample app opens a screen that demonstrates a ripple spreading outward when touched.
en.disableEffect: The sample app’s launcher screen and ripple demonstration will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: RippleView 示例应用启动时会显示触摸后向外扩散的水波纹演示页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，该示例应用的启动页和水波纹演示将无法打开。

en.description: chenqunming's mpay payment library opens this Activity when the user returns from WeChat after a payment so the app can receive WeChat's payment response.
en.disableEffect: WeChat payment results may not return to the app, leaving the payment flow incomplete.

zh-CN.description: 用户通过微信完成支付并返回应用时，chenqunming 的 mpay 支付库会打开此 Activity，将微信支付结果交回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，微信支付结果可能无法返回应用，导致支付流程无法完成。

en.description: chenqunming's mpay payment library opens this Activity when the user returns from WeChat after a payment so the app can receive WeChat's payment response.
en.disableEffect: WeChat payment results may not return to the app, leaving the payment flow incomplete.

zh-CN.description: 用户通过微信完成支付并返回应用时，chenqunming 的 mpay 支付库会打开此 Activity，将微信支付结果交回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，微信支付结果可能无法返回应用，导致支付流程无法完成。

en.description: When an app opens EasyZxing’s scanner, this Activity previews the camera, scans QR codes or barcodes, and returns the decoded text; it can also scan an image selected from the gallery.
en.disableEffect: The app’s QR-code and barcode scanning flow will not open.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开 EasyZxing 扫码界面时，此 Activity 会显示相机预览、识别二维码或条形码并返回结果，也可识别从相册选择的图片。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用中的二维码和条形码扫描功能将无法打开。

en.description: When an app uses Chuck’s network inspector, Android creates this Provider at app startup to store the captured request and response history shown in Chuck’s screens.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it can make the app’s internet requests fail while Chuck’s inspector is recording them.

zh-CN.description: 应用启用 Chuck 网络检查工具时，系统会在启动时创建此 Provider，用来保存检查界面展示的请求和响应记录。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 如果 Chuck 检查工具正在记录网络请求，停用此 Provider 可能导致应用的联网请求失败。

en.description: Chuck starts this background service when its clear-history action is used; it deletes saved HTTP transactions and dismisses the inspector notification.
en.disableEffect: Chuck’s history-clearing action will stop working, but the app’s normal screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: 用户使用 Chuck 的清除记录操作时，会启动此后台 Service；它会删除保存的网络记录并关闭检查工具通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Chuck 的清除记录操作将无法使用，但应用的普通页面仍可打开。

en.description: When the app opens Chuck’s in-app HTTP inspector, this Activity lists captured requests and responses and lets the user open an entry.
en.disableEffect: The request-history screen will be unavailable; ordinary app screens and networking remain available.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开 Chuck 的网络检查界面时，此 Activity 会列出已记录的请求和响应，并可打开其中一条记录。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 网络记录列表将无法打开；应用的普通页面和联网功能仍可使用。

en.description: When the user selects a captured request in Chuck’s history, this Activity shows its overview, request and response details, and sharing options.
en.disableEffect: The detail and sharing screen for recorded requests will be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Chuck 的网络记录中选择一条请求后，此 Activity 会显示概要、请求与响应内容，并提供分享选项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 已记录请求的详情和分享页面将无法使用。

en.description: CoilAds opens this screen when it needs a response to its personalized-ad privacy notice. It displays the supplied explanation and lets users allow or refuse data collection for personalized advertising.
en.disableEffect: The CoilAds consent choice cannot be opened or changed through this screen; a request to show it may fail, and users cannot set the personalized-ad preference here.

zh-CN.description: CoilAds 需要用户回应个性化广告隐私提示时，会打开此界面。界面显示相关说明，并允许用户同意或拒绝为个性化广告收集数据。
zh-CN.disableEffect: CoilAds 的同意选项将无法通过此界面打开或更改；请求显示该界面时可能失败，用户也无法在此设置个性化广告偏好。

en.description: LikeMinds Chat-v1 uses its FileUtil library to make chat files and selected media available to the parts of the app that send or open them. This provider grants access to files in the app's cache, files, and external-storage folders.
en.disableEffect: Chat attachments that rely on these shared files may fail to open, send, or share.

zh-CN.description: LikeMinds Chat-v1 通过 FileUtil 库为聊天文件和选中的媒体提供访问权限，供应用发送或打开这些内容。此 Provider 可授权访问应用缓存、文件目录和外部存储中的文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖这些共享文件的聊天附件可能无法打开、发送或分享。

en.description: The OPPO/Heytap push SDK starts this Service to handle platform push messages and registration results, then forwards them to the app's configured push handlers.
en.disableEffect: OPPO-channel push registration and message handling will stop, so notifications through that channel will not reach the app.

zh-CN.description: OPPO/Heytap 推送 SDK 会启动此 Service 处理平台推送消息和注册结果，再转交给应用配置的推送处理器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，OPPO 通道的推送注册和消息处理会停止，应用将收不到该通道的通知。

en.description: When Firebase issues a new push token, this service notifies Comapi's internal listeners to refresh push registration.
en.disableEffect: Comapi may keep a stale push token and fail to refresh its registration.

zh-CN.description: Firebase 下发新的推送令牌时，此 Service 会通知 Comapi 内部监听器刷新推送注册。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Comapi 可能继续使用旧令牌，无法刷新推送注册。

en.description: Firebase delivers Comapi messages to this service, which forwards messages and token updates to Comapi's internal listeners.
en.disableEffect: Comapi remote messages and push-token updates will no longer be relayed.

zh-CN.description: Firebase 将 Comapi 消息交给此 Service，再由它转发消息和令牌更新。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Comapi 远程消息和推送令牌更新将无法转发。

en.description: Android sends this receiver the boot-complete broadcast, but the analyzed Comapi Foundation 1.8 handler does no work in response.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it has no code-visible effect in Comapi Foundation 1.8.

zh-CN.description: Android 开机完成时会向此 Receiver 发送广播，但 Comapi Foundation 1.8 中的处理代码没有执行任何操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 在 Comapi Foundation 1.8 中禁用它没有可见的代码行为影响。

en.description: When a Comapi push click includes a deep link, this receiver broadcasts the link and push data to Comapi listeners.
en.disableEffect: Comapi push clicks will not be relayed to the app's notification handlers.

zh-CN.description: Comapi 推送点击包含深层链接时，此 Receiver 会将链接和推送数据广播给 Comapi 监听器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Comapi 推送点击将无法转交给应用的通知处理流程。

en.description: CometChat opens this screen for a live audio or video call, with participant, mute, audio-mode, and end-call controls.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to open or control the CometChat call screen.

zh-CN.description: CometChat 在语音或视频通话期间打开此界面，提供参会者、静音、音频模式和结束通话等控制。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开或操作 CometChat 通话界面。

en.description: After Android finishes booting, Dataroid AppConnect checks for analytics events saved before a restart and tries to send them.
en.disableEffect: The app remains usable, but AppConnect may not automatically send analytics events saved before a restart.

zh-CN.description: Android 开机完成后，Dataroid AppConnect 会检查重启前保存的分析事件，并尝试发送这些事件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用仍可使用，但 AppConnect 可能不会在开机后自动发送重启前保存的分析事件。

en.description: When Firebase Cloud Messaging delivers an AppConnect push, this Dataroid extension processes the message and keeps the Firebase push token current for AppConnect.
en.disableEffect: The app remains usable, but AppConnect push messages will no longer be handled and refreshed Firebase push tokens will not reach AppConnect.

zh-CN.description: Firebase Cloud Messaging 收到发给 Dataroid AppConnect 的推送时，此扩展会处理消息，并为 AppConnect 更新 Firebase 推送令牌。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用仍可使用，但 AppConnect 推送消息将不再处理，更新后的 Firebase 推送令牌也不会同步给 AppConnect。

en.description: When Huawei Push Kit delivers an AppConnect push, this Dataroid extension processes the message and keeps the Huawei push token current for AppConnect.
en.disableEffect: The app remains usable, but AppConnect push messages will no longer be handled and refreshed Huawei push tokens will not reach AppConnect.

zh-CN.description: Huawei Push Kit 收到发给 Dataroid AppConnect 的推送时，此扩展会处理消息，并为 AppConnect 更新华为推送令牌。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用仍可使用，但 AppConnect 推送消息将不再处理，更新后的华为推送令牌也不会同步给 AppConnect。

en.description: When Dataroid AppConnect triggers a standard in-app campaign, this screen displays its text and buttons and carries out choices such as opening a link, copying text, or calling the app's configured button action.
en.disableEffect: If AppConnect tries to show a standard campaign after this screen is disabled, its direct launch may crash the app and the message cannot appear.

zh-CN.description: Dataroid AppConnect 触发普通应用内活动消息时，会通过此界面显示文字和按钮，并执行打开链接、复制文字或调用应用所配置按钮操作等选择。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用此界面后，如果 AppConnect 尝试显示普通活动消息，直接启动该界面的过程可能导致应用崩溃，消息也无法显示。

en.description: When Dataroid AppConnect triggers a full-screen custom in-app campaign, this screen displays its localized content in a web page and records that the message was viewed.
en.disableEffect: If AppConnect tries to show a full-screen custom campaign after this screen is disabled, its direct launch may crash the app and the message cannot appear.

zh-CN.description: Dataroid AppConnect 触发全屏自定义应用内活动消息时，会通过此界面在网页中显示本地化内容，并记录消息已查看。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用此界面后，如果 AppConnect 尝试显示全屏自定义活动消息，直接启动该界面的过程可能导致应用崩溃，消息也无法显示。

en.description: When Android delivers an AppConnect geofence transition, this Dataroid receiver schedules background processing for that location event.
en.disableEffect: The app remains usable, but AppConnect will stop processing geofence transitions and any location-based campaigns or tracking that depend on them.

zh-CN.description: Android 传递 AppConnect 地理围栏变化时，Dataroid 的此接收器会为该位置事件安排后台处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用仍可使用，但 AppConnect 将停止处理地理围栏变化，依赖这些变化的位置活动消息或跟踪也会停止。

en.description: When Dataroid AppConnect receives a location change, this receiver passes it to the geofencing system for location-based event and message processing.
en.disableEffect: The app remains usable, but AppConnect will not receive location updates for its geofence monitoring or location-based campaigns.

zh-CN.description: Dataroid AppConnect 收到位置变化时，此接收器会将更新交给地理围栏系统，以处理基于位置的事件和消息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用仍可使用，但 AppConnect 将无法收到用于地理围栏监测或位置活动消息的位置更新。

en.description: When a Dataroid AppConnect notification is opened, dismissed, or one of its buttons is tapped, this receiver records the interaction and carries out the linked or custom action.
en.disableEffect: The app remains usable, but AppConnect notification taps, buttons, and dismissals will no longer be handled, so notification links or custom actions may not open.

zh-CN.description: 打开或关闭 Dataroid AppConnect 通知，或点击其中的按钮时，此接收器会记录互动并执行相应的链接或自定义操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用仍可使用，但 AppConnect 通知的点击、按钮和关闭操作将不再处理，通知链接或自定义操作可能无法打开。

en.description: On Android 12 and later, Dataroid AppConnect uses this brief transparent screen when a push notification is tapped to record the tap, open its intended app action, and close.
en.disableEffect: The app remains usable, but on Android 12 and later AppConnect notification taps may no longer open the app or linked page or be recorded.

zh-CN.description: 在 Android 12 及更高版本上，点击推送通知时，Dataroid AppConnect 会短暂打开此透明界面，记录点击、执行通知指定的应用操作，然后关闭界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用仍可使用，但在 Android 12 及更高版本上，AppConnect 通知可能无法打开应用或链接页面，点击也不会被记录。

en.description: FansLib's Acp permission helper uses this screen during Android permission requests and passes the user's permission results back to the app.
en.disableEffect: Features that need these permissions may not be able to request them through Acp.

zh-CN.description: FansLib 中的 Acp 权限助手会在请求 Android 权限时使用此界面，并将用户的授权结果返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要这些权限的功能可能无法通过 Acp 发起请求。

en.description: This provider initializes ComPDFKit when Android starts the app process.
en.disableEffect: ComPDFKit will not initialize, so PDF viewing and editing may fail.

zh-CN.description: Android 启动应用进程时，此 Provider 会初始化 ComPDFKit。
zh-CN.disableEffect: ComPDFKit 将无法初始化，PDF 查看和编辑功能可能会失败。

en.description: ComPDFKit opens this screen when a user adds a PDF signature; users can draw, type, or import an image for the signature.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to add a signature through this ComPDFKit screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户为 PDF 添加签名时，ComPDFKit 会打开此界面，支持手绘、输入文字或导入图片。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此 ComPDFKit 界面添加签名。

en.description: ComPDFKit opens this screen to create a custom PDF stamp from text, date, time, color, and shape choices.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to create custom stamps through this ComPDFKit screen.

zh-CN.description: ComPDFKit 使用此界面创建自定义 PDF 印章，可设置文字、日期、时间、颜色和形状。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此 ComPDFKit 界面创建自定义印章。

en.description: ComPDFKit opens this activity with a file path or URI to display a PDF using the requested or default viewer settings.
en.disableEffect: PDFs will not open through the ComPDFKit document viewer.

zh-CN.description: ComPDFKit 会通过此 Activity 接收文件路径或 URI，并按指定或默认设置显示 PDF。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 ComPDFKit 文档查看器打开 PDF。

en.description: ComPDFKit tools use this provider to create shareable file links for exported PDFs and screenshots.
en.disableEffect: PDF and screenshot sharing or other file handoffs that use this provider will fail.

zh-CN.description: ComPDFKit 工具使用此 Provider 为导出的 PDF 和截图创建可分享的文件链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此 Provider 的 PDF、截图分享及其他文件交接流程将会失败。

en.description: The ComplyCube identity verification SDK runs this Provider when the app starts and saves the app context for its verification screens and services.
en.disableEffect: ComplyCube identity checks may fail to start or continue because the SDK cannot access the app context it needs.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，ComplyCube 身份核验 SDK 会运行此 Provider，保存供验证页面和服务使用的应用上下文。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 由于无法取得所需的应用上下文，ComplyCube 身份核验可能无法启动或继续运行。

en.description: When an app starts a ComplyCube identity check, this Activity opens the verification flow, loads its session settings, and presents the checks requested for that user.
en.disableEffect: Users will be unable to complete the ComplyCube verification flow started by the app.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动 ComplyCube 身份核验后，此 Activity 会加载本次核验的设置，并展示该用户需要完成的验证步骤。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法完成应用发起的 ComplyCube 身份核验。

en.description: During a ComplyCube electronic identity check, this Activity handles the identity provider sign-in and returns its success or cancellation result to the verification flow.
en.disableEffect: Electronic identity checks that use this sign-in flow will not be able to finish.

zh-CN.description: 进行 ComplyCube 电子身份核验时，此 Activity 处理身份提供方的登录，并将成功或取消结果交回核验流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此登录流程的电子身份核验将无法完成。

en.description: When an identity provider returns to the app through a ComplyCube eID link, this Activity passes the return link to the verification screen and closes.
en.disableEffect: The return link will not reach ComplyCube, so the electronic identity check cannot complete.

zh-CN.description: 身份提供方通过 ComplyCube eID 链接返回应用时，此 Activity 会把返回链接交给核验页面，然后关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 返回链接无法交回 ComplyCube，因此电子身份核验无法完成。

en.description: ConnectAd, the Connected Interactive ad SDK, opens this Activity to show a full-screen ad in a WebView and handle ad clicks or closing.
en.disableEffect: ConnectAd full-screen web ads will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: Connected Interactive 的 ConnectAd 广告 SDK 会打开此 Activity，在 WebView 中展示全屏广告并处理点击或关闭操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: ConnectAd 的全屏网页广告将无法打开。

en.description: The ConsoliAds ad mediation SDK opens this Activity to display a full-screen image campaign and handle its close and landing-page actions.
en.disableEffect: ConsoliAds interstitial ads and their landing pages will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: ConsoliAds 广告聚合 SDK 会打开此 Activity 展示全屏图片广告，并处理关闭和跳转到广告落地页的操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: ConsoliAds 插屏广告及其落地页将无法打开。

en.description: The ConsoliAds ad mediation SDK opens this Activity to play a full-screen video ad and handle completion, including rewarded-video completion.
en.disableEffect: ConsoliAds video ads will not play, and users will no longer receive rewards for watching rewarded ads.

zh-CN.description: ConsoliAds 广告聚合 SDK 会打开此 Activity 播放全屏视频广告，并处理播放完成事件，包括激励视频完成事件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: ConsoliAds 视频广告将无法播放，用户观看激励广告后也不会再获得奖励。

en.description: The Contacto customer-support SDK opens this Activity to load its in-app chat and calls widget and handle its file, camera, and microphone requests.
en.disableEffect: The app's Contacto chat and calls support screen will not open.

zh-CN.description: Contacto 客服 SDK 会打开此 Activity 加载应用内聊天和通话组件，并处理组件发起的文件、相机和麦克风请求。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用中的 Contacto 聊天和通话客服页面将无法打开。

en.description: This legacy Contentsquare provider watches the app process lifecycle and starts the SDK when the app enters the foreground.
en.disableEffect: Contentsquare will not automatically start tracking app sessions through this provider.

zh-CN.description: 此旧版 Contentsquare Provider 会监听应用进程生命周期，并在应用进入前台时启动 SDK。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Contentsquare 将无法通过此 Provider 自动开始应用会话跟踪。

en.description: Contentsquare Analytics opens this Activity to show its in-app Client Mode deactivation screen.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to turn off Contentsquare Client Mode through this screen.

zh-CN.description: Contentsquare 分析 SDK 会打开此 Activity，显示应用内 Client Mode 的停用页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此页面关闭 Contentsquare Client Mode。

en.description: Contentsquare Analytics uses this Activity to let a tester enter the activation details for its in-app Client Mode tools.
en.disableEffect: Testers will not be able to activate Contentsquare Client Mode through this screen.

zh-CN.description: Contentsquare 分析 SDK 通过此 Activity 让测试人员填写应用内 Client Mode 工具的启用信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 测试人员将无法通过此页面启用 Contentsquare Client Mode。

en.description: When Contentsquare Client Mode is active, this service adds its floating overlay to the app window if Android allows overlays.
en.disableEffect: The Contentsquare Client Mode overlay will not appear.

zh-CN.description: Contentsquare Client Mode 启用时，如果 Android 允许显示悬浮内容，此 Service 会在应用窗口中添加悬浮层。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Contentsquare Client Mode 的悬浮层将不会显示。

en.description: Contentsquare Client Mode uses this private file provider to share the SDK's debug log file from its settings when requested.
en.disableEffect: The Contentsquare debug log file cannot be shared from Client Mode settings.

zh-CN.description: Contentsquare Client Mode 会通过此私有文件 Provider，在设置页面需要时分享 SDK 调试日志。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法从 Client Mode 设置页面分享 Contentsquare 调试日志。

en.description: Contentsquare Client Mode opens this Activity to show its in-app settings and diagnostic options.
en.disableEffect: Contentsquare Client Mode settings will not open.

zh-CN.description: Contentsquare Client Mode 会打开此 Activity，显示应用内设置和诊断选项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Contentsquare Client Mode 的设置页面将无法打开。

en.description: Contentsquare Client Mode opens this Activity to explain how to use its in-app testing tools.
en.disableEffect: The Contentsquare Client Mode tutorial will not open.

zh-CN.description: Contentsquare Client Mode 会打开此 Activity，说明如何使用应用内测试工具。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Contentsquare Client Mode 教程将无法打开。

en.description: When another app opens a Contentsquare Client Mode link, this Activity routes its setup or tutorial request to Contentsquare and then closes.
en.disableEffect: Contentsquare Client Mode links will not open the SDK's in-app tools.

zh-CN.description: 其他应用打开 Contentsquare Client Mode 链接时，此 Activity 会将设置或教程请求交给 Contentsquare 处理，然后关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Contentsquare Client Mode 链接将无法打开 SDK 的应用内工具。

en.description: The legacy Contentsquare Client Mode opens this Activity to show its activation prompt and setup choices.
en.disableEffect: Testers will not be able to open the legacy Contentsquare Client Mode activation prompt.

zh-CN.description: 旧版 Contentsquare Client Mode 会打开此 Activity，显示启用提示和设置选项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 测试人员将无法打开旧版 Contentsquare Client Mode 启用页面。

en.description: The legacy Contentsquare Client Mode opens this Activity to show its deactivation prompt.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to open the legacy Contentsquare Client Mode deactivation prompt.

zh-CN.description: 旧版 Contentsquare Client Mode 会打开此 Activity，显示停用提示。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开旧版 Contentsquare Client Mode 停用页面。

en.description: The legacy Contentsquare Client Mode opens this Activity to request overlay permission when needed and launch its floating controls.
en.disableEffect: The legacy Contentsquare Client Mode floating controls will not launch.

zh-CN.description: 旧版 Contentsquare Client Mode 会打开此 Activity，在需要时请求悬浮窗权限并启动悬浮控制按钮。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 旧版 Contentsquare Client Mode 的悬浮控制按钮将无法启动。

en.description: This legacy Contentsquare service creates and updates the floating Client Mode controls over the app.
en.disableEffect: The legacy Contentsquare Client Mode floating controls will not appear.

zh-CN.description: 此旧版 Contentsquare Service 会在应用上方创建并更新 Client Mode 悬浮控制按钮。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 旧版 Contentsquare Client Mode 的悬浮控制按钮将不会显示。

en.description: The legacy Contentsquare Client Mode opens this Activity to show its in-app testing tutorial.
en.disableEffect: The legacy Contentsquare Client Mode tutorial will not open.

zh-CN.description: 旧版 Contentsquare Client Mode 会打开此 Activity，显示应用内测试教程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 旧版 Contentsquare Client Mode 教程将无法打开。

en.description: At app startup, this Contentsquare Analytics provider starts the SDK and connects it to the app's lifecycle.
en.disableEffect: Contentsquare Analytics will not start automatically when the app opens.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，此 Contentsquare 分析 Provider 会启动 SDK，并将其接入应用生命周期。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用打开时，Contentsquare 分析将不会自动启动。

en.description: When Contentstack sends its cache-cleanup broadcast, this Receiver removes cached responses older than a day while keeping session and installation records.
en.disableEffect: Old Contentstack response files will no longer be cleaned up by this Receiver.

zh-CN.description: Contentstack 发出缓存清理广播时，此 Receiver 会删除超过一天的缓存响应，同时保留会话和安装记录。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 此 Receiver 将不再清理较旧的 Contentstack 响应文件。

en.description: When network connectivity changes, this Contentstack Receiver checks for a connection and resends the SDK's saved offline content requests.
en.disableEffect: Contentstack requests saved while offline will not be resent when the app reconnects, which can interrupt app features that use that content.

zh-CN.description: 网络连接状态变化时，此 Contentstack Receiver 会检查网络，并重新发送 SDK 保存的离线内容请求。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 重新联网后，离线期间保存的 Contentstack 请求将不会重发，依赖这些内容的应用功能可能因此中断。

en.description: When the host app sends the Contus FlyChat app-state broadcast, this receiver checks whether the app is online and active, then reconnects the chat service.
en.disableEffect: FlyChat may not reconnect as the user returns to the app, delaying message updates.

zh-CN.description: 宿主应用发送 Contus FlyChat 应用状态广播时，此 Receiver 会检查应用是否联网且处于活动状态，然后重新连接聊天服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，用户返回应用时 FlyChat 可能无法重新连接，消息更新会延迟。

en.description: When Android creates the app process, the Contus FlyChat SDK's initialization provider sets up the chat manager before chat features are used.
en.disableEffect: The chat SDK may not initialize, so its chat screens, messaging, and file transfers can fail.

zh-CN.description: Android 创建应用进程时，Contus FlyChat SDK 的初始化 Provider 会先设置聊天管理器，再供聊天功能使用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，聊天 SDK 可能无法初始化，其聊天界面、消息和文件传输功能可能失效。

en.description: When FlyChat marks a conversation as read, this Service updates message receipts and shows a temporary progress notification while the status is processed.
en.disableEffect: Read receipts and conversation read status may stop updating in FlyChat.

zh-CN.description: FlyChat 将会话标记为已读时，此 Service 会更新消息回执，并在处理状态时显示临时进度通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，FlyChat 中的已读回执和会话阅读状态可能无法更新。

en.description: When a FlyChat user opens an attachment or retries a failed download, this Service downloads the chat media and reports progress.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot download images, videos, or other attachments from FlyChat conversations.

zh-CN.description: FlyChat 用户打开附件或重试失败的下载时，此 Service 会下载聊天媒体文件并报告进度。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，用户无法从 FlyChat 会话下载图片、视频或其他附件。

en.description: When a FlyChat user sends an attachment, this Service encrypts and uploads the file, tracks progress, and offers a retry after network failure.
en.disableEffect: Sending media attachments through FlyChat will fail.

zh-CN.description: FlyChat 用户发送附件时，此 Service 会加密并上传文件、跟踪进度，并在网络故障后提供重试。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，用户将无法通过 FlyChat 发送媒体附件。

en.description: When the Contus FlyChat SDK starts contact synchronization, this Service prepares phone-contact data and sends it to the chat service to find or update chat contacts.
en.disableEffect: FlyChat contact matching and contact-list updates will stop working.

zh-CN.description: Contus FlyChat SDK 开始同步联系人时，此 Service 会整理手机联系人数据并发送给聊天服务，以查找或更新聊天联系人。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，FlyChat 的联系人匹配和联系人列表更新将停止。

en.description: The Contus FlyChat SDK uses this FileProvider to create shareable file links for chat attachments and grant temporary access to those files.
en.disableEffect: Opening or sharing files in FlyChat chats may fail, and attachment flows that require the provider can crash.

zh-CN.description: Contus FlyChat SDK 使用此 FileProvider 为聊天附件创建可分享的文件链接，并临时授予文件访问权限。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，FlyChat 聊天中的文件打开或分享可能失败，依赖此 Provider 的附件流程也可能崩溃。

en.description: The Conviva App Sensor SDK uses this Provider at process startup to record launch timing and observe app activity and process lifecycle.
en.disableEffect: Conviva will not automatically receive these app launch and lifecycle measurements.

zh-CN.description: Conviva App Sensor SDK 会在进程启动时通过此 Provider 记录启动时间，并监听应用活动和进程生命周期。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Conviva 将无法自动收到这些应用启动和生命周期数据。

en.description: At process startup, the Conviva SDK registers this Provider to observe when the app process starts and stops.
en.disableEffect: Conviva will not receive automatic app process start and stop updates through this provider.

zh-CN.description: 进程启动时，Conviva SDK 会通过此 Provider 注册监听，以观察应用进程的启动和停止。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Conviva 将无法通过此 Provider 自动收到应用进程启动和停止的状态更新。

en.description: The Cookie Information Mobile Consents SDK opens this screen when the app presents its consent settings. It shows the available consent choices and lets the user save them.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from reviewing or changing their consent choices through the Cookie Information screen.

zh-CN.description: 当应用打开 Cookie Information Mobile Consents 的同意设置时，此界面会显示可选的同意项目，并允许用户保存选择。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过 Cookie Information 界面查看或更改同意选择。

en.description: The Cookie Information Mobile Consents SDK opens this screen to display the app's privacy and consent choices. Users can review the listed items and save their selections.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it removes this privacy and consent settings screen.

zh-CN.description: Cookie Information Mobile Consents SDK 会在应用打开隐私和同意设置时显示此界面，供用户查看项目并保存选择。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法通过此 SDK 使用隐私和同意设置界面。

en.description: Interstitial advertisement.

zh-CN.description: 插屏广告。

en.description: Splash screen advertisement shown when the app starts.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时展示的开屏广告。

en.description: Splash screen advertisement shown when the app starts.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时展示的开屏广告。

en.description: Coolerfall's Android HTTP Download Manager starts this provider with the app and saves the application context needed to create its download manager.
en.disableEffect: If it is disabled, the download manager can fail to initialize because it has no application context, so downloads may not start.

zh-CN.description: Coolerfall 的 Android HTTP Download Manager 会在应用启动时运行此 Provider，并保存创建下载管理器所需的应用上下文。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，下载管理器可能因缺少应用上下文而无法初始化，导致下载无法开始。

en.description: When Cordial's Mobile Android SDK opens an in-app message, this activity displays the message and handles its links and actions.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it hides Cordial in-app messages and prevents users from opening their links or actions.

zh-CN.description: Cordial Mobile Android SDK 打开应用内消息时，此界面会显示消息内容并处理其中的链接和操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将看不到 Cordial 应用内消息，也无法打开其中的链接或使用相关操作。

en.description: Cordial's Mobile Android SDK opens this activity when the app launches its message inbox. It displays the Cordial message feed using the app's inbox settings.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from opening the Cordial message inbox.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开消息收件箱时，Cordial Mobile Android SDK 会启动此界面，并按照应用的设置显示 Cordial 消息列表。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法打开 Cordial 消息收件箱。

en.description: Cordial's Mobile Android SDK receives push notifications and refreshed push tokens through this service. It passes them to Cordial notification handling when SDK-managed pushes are enabled.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it stops Cordial push messages and push-token updates in the app.

zh-CN.description: Cordial Mobile Android SDK 通过此 Service 接收推送通知和更新后的推送令牌；启用 SDK 推送时，它会将这些内容交给 Cordial 处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用将无法通过 Cordial 接收推送消息或更新推送令牌。

en.description: When a user taps an unread-message badge, Cordial's Mobile Android SDK receives the badge click here and notifies the app's registered listener.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents unread-message badge taps from reaching the app's Cordial listener.

zh-CN.description: 用户点按未读消息标记时，Cordial Mobile Android SDK 会在此接收点击并通知应用注册的监听器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，未读消息标记的点击将无法传递给应用的 Cordial 监听器。

en.description: When a user opens a Cordial unread-message badge, this activity forwards the click to the SDK's badge handler and then closes.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents Cordial unread-message badge taps from reaching the app.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 Cordial 未读消息标记时，此界面会将点击转交给 SDK 处理，然后关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Cordial 未读消息标记的点击将无法传递给应用。

en.description: When a user opens an item in a Cordial carousel notification, this activity forwards the selected action for handling and then closes.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents carousel notification items from carrying out their actions.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 Cordial 轮播通知中的项目时，此界面会转交所选操作进行处理，然后关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，轮播通知中的项目将无法执行相应操作。

en.description: Cordial's Mobile Android SDK uses this activity during its notification-permission flow. It can show an education screen first or open Android's notification-permission prompt, depending on the app's settings and the user's prior choices.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents Cordial from guiding users through its notification-permission request.

zh-CN.description: Cordial Mobile Android SDK 会在申请通知权限时使用此界面。根据应用设置和用户之前的选择，它可能先显示说明页面，也可能直接打开 Android 通知权限提示。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Cordial 将无法通过此流程引导用户申请通知权限。

en.description: When Cordial is configured to explain notifications before requesting permission, this activity displays that education screen, including configured categories and continue or skip controls.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it removes Cordial's notification education screen and category choices.

zh-CN.description: 如果 Cordial 设置为先说明通知用途再申请权限，此界面会显示说明内容、配置的通知类别以及继续或跳过选项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Cordial 的通知说明页面和类别选择将无法显示。

en.description: Cordial's Mobile Android SDK uses this receiver when a user selects an action in a carousel notification. It forwards the selected item action to the SDK's notification handler.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents carousel notification buttons from carrying out their actions.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择轮播通知中的操作时，Cordial Mobile Android SDK 会通过此 Receiver 将所选操作交给通知处理程序。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，轮播通知中的按钮将无法执行相应操作。

en.description: When a user taps a Cordial push notification, the Mobile Android SDK processes the message, notifies the app, or follows a link supplied with the message.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents Cordial push taps from reaching the app or opening their linked destination.

zh-CN.description: 用户点按 Cordial 推送通知时，Mobile Android SDK 会处理消息、通知应用，或打开消息提供的链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Cordial 推送通知的点击将无法传递给应用，也无法打开其链接。

en.description: When a user dismisses a Cordial push notification, this receiver reports the dismissal and notifies the app's Cordial listener.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it stops Cordial from handling notification dismissals and their follow-up events.

zh-CN.description: 用户清除 Cordial 推送通知时，此 Receiver 会报告清除操作并通知应用的 Cordial 监听器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Cordial 将无法处理通知清除操作及其后续事件。

en.description: When a user opens a Cordial push notification, this activity passes the notification to the SDK's click handler and then closes.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents Cordial notification taps from starting the SDK's click handling.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 Cordial 推送通知时，此界面会将通知交给 SDK 的点击处理程序，然后关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Cordial 推送通知的点击将无法启动 SDK 的后续处理。

en.description: Cordial's Mobile Android SDK binds this service while the app is active when event batching is configured. It periodically sends queued Cordial events.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it can stop queued Cordial events from being sent.

zh-CN.description: 配置了事件批量发送时，Cordial Mobile Android SDK 会在应用运行期间绑定此 Service，并定期发送排队的 Cordial 事件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，排队的 Cordial 事件可能无法发送。

en.description: The Corsano Android SDK runs this service while installing firmware on a Corsano wearable over Bluetooth. It performs the update transfer and provides update status.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents the app from updating firmware on supported Corsano wearables.

zh-CN.description: 通过蓝牙为 Corsano 穿戴设备安装固件时，Corsano Android SDK 会运行此 Service。它负责传输更新并提供更新状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用将无法为受支持的 Corsano 穿戴设备更新固件。

en.description: Momo’s Cosmos Photon (MoPush) push SDK starts this Activity when a user taps a notification, then opens the app page or web link named in it.
en.disableEffect: Tapping a MoPush notification will no longer open its target page or link.

zh-CN.description: Momo 的 Cosmos Photon（MoPush）推送 SDK 会在用户点按通知时启动此 Activity，并打开通知指定的应用页面或网页链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 点按 MoPush 通知后将无法再打开它指定的页面或链接。

en.description: Momo’s Cosmos Photon (MoPush) push SDK uses this Provider to pass incoming notifications and background messages to the app for handling.
en.disableEffect: The app will no longer receive MoPush messages through this route, although the SDK can still show fallback notifications in some cases.

zh-CN.description: Momo 的 Cosmos Photon（MoPush）推送 SDK 使用此 Provider 将收到的通知和后台消息交给应用处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法再通过此入口接收 MoPush 消息，但某些情况下 SDK 仍可显示备用通知。

en.description: Momo’s Cosmos Photon (MoPush) push SDK starts this Receiver when a user taps a notification; it opens the app page, intent, or web link specified by that notification.
en.disableEffect: Tapping a MoPush notification will no longer open its target page or link.

zh-CN.description: Momo 的 Cosmos Photon（MoPush）推送 SDK 会在用户点按通知时启动此 Receiver，并打开通知指定的应用页面、操作或网页链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 点按 MoPush 通知后将无法再打开它指定的页面或链接。

en.description: When MoPush cannot pass an incoming notification to the app through its Provider, it starts this Activity to offer the notification to the app or display it itself.
en.disableEffect: Notifications that need this handoff may no longer reach the app or appear on the device.

zh-CN.description: MoPush 无法通过 Provider 将收到的通知交给应用时，会启动此 Activity，让应用处理通知，或由 SDK 直接显示。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要此处理流程的通知可能无法交给应用，也可能不会显示在设备上。

en.description: After MoPush starts, it runs this background Service to connect to its push server and receive the app’s notifications and messages.
en.disableEffect: MoPush notifications and messages will stop arriving.

zh-CN.description: MoPush 启动后会运行此后台 Service，连接推送服务器并接收应用的通知和消息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: MoPush 通知和消息将无法送达。

en.description: MoPush starts this Service with scheduled notification data; it checks the display and expiry times, then passes the notification to the app or displays it.
en.disableEffect: Scheduled MoPush notifications will no longer be passed to the app or displayed.

zh-CN.description: MoPush 会在处理定时通知时启动此 Service；它会检查通知的展示和过期时间，再将通知交给应用处理或直接显示。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 定时 MoPush 通知将无法交给应用处理，也不会显示。

en.description: Momo’s Cosmos Photon push SDK receives Firebase push tokens and incoming messages here, then forwards notification and background-message data to the app.
en.disableEffect: Firebase messages sent through the MoPush adapter will no longer reach the app.

zh-CN.description: Momo 的 Cosmos Photon 推送 SDK 会在此接收 Firebase 推送令牌和消息，并将通知及后台消息交给应用处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过 MoPush 的 Firebase 通道发送的消息将无法再送达应用。

en.description: Momo’s Cosmos Photon push SDK handles registration, message, status, and notification-tap events from Huawei’s legacy push channel here, forwarding tokens and background messages to the app.
en.disableEffect: Huawei legacy push registration, messages, and notification taps will no longer pass through MoPush.

zh-CN.description: Momo 的 Cosmos Photon 推送 SDK 会在此处理华为旧版推送通道的注册、消息、状态和通知点击事件，并将令牌和后台消息交给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 华为旧版推送的注册、消息和通知点击将无法再通过 MoPush 处理。

en.description: Momo’s Cosmos Photon push SDK receives Huawei Push Kit data messages and new registration tokens through this Service, then forwards them to the app.
en.disableEffect: Huawei Push Kit messages and token updates will no longer reach the MoPush adapter.

zh-CN.description: Momo 的 Cosmos Photon 推送 SDK 会通过此 Service 接收华为推送服务的数据消息和新注册令牌，再交给应用处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 华为推送服务的消息和令牌更新将无法再送达 MoPush。

en.description: Momo’s Cosmos Photon push SDK receives Meizu registration results and data messages here, forwarding successful tokens and background messages to the app.
en.disableEffect: Meizu push registration and background messages will no longer reach the app through MoPush.

zh-CN.description: Momo 的 Cosmos Photon 推送 SDK 会在此接收魅族推送注册结果和数据消息，并将成功注册的令牌及后台消息交给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 魅族推送注册结果和后台消息将无法再通过 MoPush 送达应用。

en.description: Momo’s Cosmos Photon push SDK receives Xiaomi push callbacks here and forwards registration results and messages marked for app delivery.
en.disableEffect: Xiaomi push registration results and app-directed messages will no longer reach MoPush.

zh-CN.description: Momo 的 Cosmos Photon 推送 SDK 会在此接收小米推送回调，并将注册结果和发送给应用的消息继续传递。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 小米推送的注册结果和应用消息将无法再送达 MoPush。

en.description: Momo’s Cosmos Photon push SDK uses this Service for HeyTap push app notifications, data messages, and command responses.
en.disableEffect: HeyTap push messages and command responses will no longer reach the app through MoPush.

zh-CN.description: Momo 的 Cosmos Photon 推送 SDK 使用此 Service 接收欢太推送的应用通知、数据消息和命令响应。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 欢太推送消息和命令响应将无法再通过 MoPush 送达应用。

en.description: Momo’s Cosmos Photon push SDK uses this Service to receive OPPO push notifications, data messages, and command responses from the ColorOS push channel.
en.disableEffect: Messages from the OPPO push channel will no longer reach the app through MoPush.

zh-CN.description: Momo 的 Cosmos Photon 推送 SDK 使用此 Service 接收 ColorOS 通道发送的 OPPO 推送通知、数据消息和命令响应。
zh-CN.disableEffect: OPPO 推送通道的消息将无法再通过 MoPush 送达应用。

en.description: Momo’s Cosmos Photon push SDK receives Vivo registration updates here and opens the destination supplied when a user taps a Vivo notification.
en.disableEffect: Vivo push registration updates and notification links will no longer be handled by MoPush.

zh-CN.description: Momo 的 Cosmos Photon 推送 SDK 会在此接收 vivo 推送注册更新，并在用户点按通知时打开指定目标。
zh-CN.disableEffect: MoPush 将无法再处理 vivo 推送注册更新和通知链接。

en.description: Cosmos Radar binds to this background Service to analyze saved heap dumps for memory leaks, optionally showing a progress notification.
en.disableEffect: Cosmos Radar will no longer be able to generate memory-leak analysis reports.

zh-CN.description: Cosmos Radar 会绑定此后台 Service，分析已保存的堆转储以查找内存泄漏，并可选择显示进度通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Cosmos Radar 将无法再生成内存泄漏分析报告。

en.description: When leak analysis is enabled, Cosmos Radar opens this screen from a saved report to show the affected page and leak trace.
en.disableEffect: Users will no longer be able to view the details and trace of a Cosmos Radar leak report.

zh-CN.description: 启用泄漏分析后，Cosmos Radar 会从已保存的报告打开此页面，显示受影响的页面和泄漏引用链。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法再查看 Cosmos Radar 泄漏报告的详情和引用链。

en.description: When leak analysis is enabled, Cosmos Radar opens this screen to list saved leak reports and lets users open a report or clear the list.
en.disableEffect: Users will no longer be able to review or clear saved Cosmos Radar leak reports in the app.

zh-CN.description: 启用泄漏分析后，Cosmos Radar 会打开此页面列出已保存的泄漏报告，并允许用户查看报告或清空列表。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法再在应用中查看或清空 Cosmos Radar 保存的泄漏报告。

en.description: Cosmos Radar uses this Receiver when a user taps a leak-count notification to send the tap to its leak-review flow.
en.disableEffect: Tapping a Cosmos Radar leak-count notification will no longer open the configured review flow.

zh-CN.description: 用户点按内存泄漏数量通知时，Cosmos Radar 会通过此 Receiver 将点击操作交给泄漏查看流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 点按 Cosmos Radar 的泄漏数量通知后，将无法再打开已配置的查看流程。

en.description: The Fabric Crashlytics SDK uses this provider during app startup to initialize crash reporting. It also enables native crash reporting when the app opts in.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it stops automatic Crashlytics initialization, so app crashes may no longer be reported.

zh-CN.description: Fabric Crashlytics SDK 会在应用启动时通过此 Provider 初始化崩溃报告；如果应用启用了原生崩溃报告，它也会一并初始化。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Crashlytics 将不会自动初始化，应用崩溃可能无法上报。

en.description: The Flutter Open File plugin uses this provider to give another app temporary access to a local file when the user asks to open it.
en.disableEffect: Opening downloaded or local files in another app can fail.

zh-CN.description: 用户要求用其他应用打开本地文件时，Flutter Open File 插件会通过此内容提供器临时授予对方访问该文件的权限。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户可能无法在其他应用中打开下载文件或本地文件。

en.description: During a Criteo Publisher SDK interstitial ad, this activity presents the full-screen ad and handles the user's close or ad selection.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents Criteo full-screen interstitial ads from opening.

zh-CN.description: 展示 Criteo Publisher SDK 插屏广告时，此界面会显示全屏广告，并处理用户关闭广告或选择广告的操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Criteo 全屏插屏广告将无法打开。

en.description: When a Criteo Publisher banner ad is expanded, this activity displays the enlarged ad and handles close and orientation requests.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from expanding Criteo banner ads.

zh-CN.description: Criteo Publisher 横幅广告展开时，此界面会显示放大的广告，并处理关闭和屏幕方向请求。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法展开 Criteo 横幅广告。

en.description: The Zhongruan Gaoke ID-card reader SDK opens this page when the app asks the user to choose a Bluetooth reader. It scans for nearby low-energy Bluetooth card readers and lets the user connect to one.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot find or connect to a Bluetooth card reader through this page, so Bluetooth-based card reading may stop working.

zh-CN.description: 应用需要用户选择蓝牙读卡器时，中软高科身份证阅读 SDK 会打开此页面。它搜索附近的低功耗蓝牙读卡器，并允许用户连接其中一台。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此页面查找或连接蓝牙读卡器，依赖蓝牙的读卡功能可能无法使用。

en.description: When messaging is enabled, the Zhongruan Gaoke ID-card reader SDK connects this service to its server. It sends device heartbeats and handles remote reader upgrades and diagnostic-log upload requests.
en.disableEffect: Remote reader upgrades, heartbeats, and requested diagnostic uploads stop; card reading itself does not run through this service.

zh-CN.description: 启用消息服务后，中软高科身份证阅读 SDK 会通过此 Service 连接服务器。它发送设备心跳，并处理远程读卡器升级和诊断日志上传请求。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 远程读卡器升级、心跳和诊断日志上传请求将停止；读卡流程本身不通过此 Service 执行。

en.description: At app startup, the Zhongruan Gaoke card-reading SDK checks for its bundled ID-card and passport decoder data and initializes the native reader when both files are present.
en.disableEffect: The native decoder may not initialize, so ID-card and passport scans that rely on it can fail.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，中软高科读卡 SDK 会检查随库提供的身份证和护照解码数据；两份数据都存在时，它会初始化本地解码器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 本地解码器可能无法初始化，依赖它的身份证和护照扫描也可能失败。

en.description: The CSHT (中软高科) ID-card reader SDK uses this receiver to notice when its compatible USB reader is attached, detached, or granted access, then open the reader and update its connection state.
en.disableEffect: The app will lose automatic detection and reconnection for this USB ID-card reader, so card reading through it will not work.

zh-CN.description: 中软高科身份证读卡 SDK 使用此接收器处理兼容 USB 读卡器的接入、拔出和授权事件，并打开读卡器、更新连接状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用无法通过此接收器发现或重新打开 USB 读卡器，相关身份证读取功能将无法使用。

en.description: The CSHT (中软高科) ID-card reader SDK opens this screen when an app starts an NFC card-reading request. It checks that NFC is available, initializes the reader, and returns card data or the read result to the app.
en.disableEffect: NFC ID-card reading through the CSHT SDK will not be available.

zh-CN.description: 中软高科身份证读卡 SDK 在应用发起 NFC 读卡请求时打开此界面。它会检查 NFC 是否可用、初始化读卡器，并将卡片数据或读取结果返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用将无法使用中软高科 SDK 进行 NFC 身份证读取。

en.description: When network checks are enabled, the Zhongruan Gaoke reader SDK starts this service after initialization. It periodically pings configured servers and logs whether they respond.
en.disableEffect: Only these background connectivity checks stop; the card-reading flow remains available.

zh-CN.description: 启用网络检查后，中软高科读卡 SDK 会在初始化完成时启动此 Service。它定期 ping 已配置的服务器，并记录服务器是否响应。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后只会停止后台连通性检查，读卡流程仍可使用。

en.description: The Zhongruan Gaoke UniApp reading plugin opens this screen when an NFC card or passport tag is presented. It passes the tag to the configured reader and returns the card data to the app.
en.disableEffect: The plugin cannot read NFC cards or passports or return their data.

zh-CN.description: 出现 NFC 身份证或护照标签时，中软高科 UniApp 读卡插件会打开此页面。它将标签交给已配置的读卡器，并把证件数据返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 插件将无法读取 NFC 身份证或护照，也无法向应用返回证件数据。

en.description: The Zhongruan Gaoke UniApp reading plugin starts this foreground service during NFC reading. It keeps NFC tag dispatch active and starts the configured reader flow while the app may be in the background.
en.disableEffect: The plugin loses its background NFC dispatch and reader flow, so NFC reading sessions may not complete.

zh-CN.description: 进行 NFC 读卡时，中软高科 UniApp 读卡插件会启动此前台 Service。它保持 NFC 标签分发有效，并在应用可能处于后台时启动已配置的读卡流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 插件将失去后台 NFC 标签分发和读卡流程，NFC 读卡可能无法完成。

en.description: The Zhongruan Gaoke ID-card reader SDK declares this provider for Android to create at app startup, but it exposes no content and performs no setup.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it has no functional effect in the inspected SDK version because it exposes no data or performs no setup.

zh-CN.description: 中软高科身份证阅读 SDK 声明 Android 在应用启动时创建此 Provider，但它不提供内容，也不执行初始化。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 在检查的 SDK 版本中，停用它不会影响功能，因为它不提供数据，也不执行初始化。

en.description: chensj1992's mvvmlib opens this image viewer when the app asks to show a picture or QR image; users can zoom it and save it to the device.
en.disableEffect: The app's image and QR-image preview and save screen will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: 应用通过 chensj1992 的 mvvmlib 查看图片或二维码图片时，此页面支持缩放并可将图片保存到设备。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用的图片和二维码预览及保存页面将无法打开。

en.description: chensj1992's mvvmlib includes this theme demonstration screen, where users can preview and switch between default, day and night themes.
en.disableEffect: The library's theme demonstration screen and its theme-switching controls will no longer be available.

zh-CN.description: chensj1992 的 mvvmlib 提供此主题演示页面，用户可预览并切换默认、日间和夜间主题。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，库中的主题演示页面及主题切换控件将无法使用。

en.description: When chensj1992's mvvmlib download manager needs to install an app on Android 8 or later, this Activity requests install permission or opens the related system settings.
en.disableEffect: The app may be unable to request permission to install downloaded apps through mvvmlib.

zh-CN.description: chensj1992 的 mvvmlib 下载管理器在 Android 8 及更高版本安装应用时，会通过此 Activity 请求安装权限或打开相关系统设置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用可能无法通过 mvvmlib 请求安装已下载应用所需的权限。

en.description: The RevOS Vehicle Controller SDK starts and binds this service when it initializes a Bluetooth link. The service connects to the paired device, discovers its Bluetooth services, and exchanges device data.
en.disableEffect: The SDK cannot establish or maintain this Bluetooth device connection.

zh-CN.description: RevOS Vehicle Controller SDK 初始化蓝牙连接时会启动并绑定此服务。服务负责连接已配对设备、发现蓝牙服务并交换设备数据。
zh-CN.disableEffect: SDK 将无法建立或维持此蓝牙设备连接。

en.description: SimpleGCM runs this receiver after Android reports that the app was updated. If push registration is needed, it starts the service that requests a fresh Google Cloud Messaging token.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents SimpleGCM from refreshing push registration after an app update.

zh-CN.description: Android 通知应用已更新后，SimpleGCM 会运行此 Receiver；如果需要重新注册推送，它会启动服务申请新的 Google Cloud Messaging 令牌。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，SimpleGCM 将无法在应用更新后刷新推送注册信息。

en.description: SimpleGCM runs this service when push registration is requested. It asks Google Cloud Messaging for a token and retries if registration fails.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents the app from registering for SimpleGCM push messages.

zh-CN.description: 收到推送注册请求时，SimpleGCM 会运行此 Service，向 Google Cloud Messaging 申请令牌，并在注册失败时重试。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用将无法注册接收 SimpleGCM 推送消息。

en.description: When network connectivity changes, SimpleGCM checks whether push registration is needed and requests a new token if necessary.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents SimpleGCM from retrying registration when network access returns.

zh-CN.description: 网络连接状态变化时，SimpleGCM 会检查是否需要推送注册，并在需要时申请新令牌。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，网络恢复时 SimpleGCM 将无法重试推送注册。

en.description: When Google Cloud Messaging delivers a push message, SimpleGCM passes it to the app's message listener through this service.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents SimpleGCM push messages from reaching the app.

zh-CN.description: Google Cloud Messaging 投递推送消息时，SimpleGCM 会通过此 Service 将消息交给应用的消息监听器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，SimpleGCM 推送消息将无法传递给应用。

en.description: When Google Cloud Messaging reports a refreshed instance token, SimpleGCM clears the saved token and starts registration again.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it can leave the app using an outdated push token and stop new messages from arriving.

zh-CN.description: Google Cloud Messaging 通知令牌已更新时，SimpleGCM 会清除已保存的令牌并重新开始注册。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用可能继续使用过期的推送令牌，导致无法收到新消息。

en.description: Cuneyt Ayyildiz's UsefulThings library opens this screen with the app's release notes. It displays the supplied list of changes and provides close and back navigation.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents the app from showing its release notes through this library.

zh-CN.description: Cuneyt Ayyildiz 的 UsefulThings 库会通过此界面显示应用的版本更新说明，包括提供的变更列表以及关闭和返回操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用将无法通过此库显示版本更新说明。

en.description: Cursor Insight's Trap sensor-collection library uses this activity to request Bluetooth, location, or Wi-Fi permissions from Android and report the result to the library.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents Trap from requesting permissions needed for its Bluetooth, location, and Wi-Fi data collection.

zh-CN.description: Cursor Insight 的 Trap 传感器采集库会通过此界面向 Android 申请蓝牙、位置或 Wi-Fi 权限，并将结果返回给该库。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Trap 将无法申请蓝牙、位置和 Wi-Fi 数据采集所需的权限。

en.description: SliderImage opens this full-screen viewer with an image set and starting position. Users can swipe between the images and see which one is selected.
en.disableEffect: The app's full-screen image browsing through SliderImage will not open.

zh-CN.description: SliderImage 会按给定的图片列表和起始位置打开全屏查看页面。用户可以左右滑动浏览图片，并看到当前所在位置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用将无法通过 SliderImage 打开全屏图片浏览页面。

en.description: CustomerGlu opens this screen for SDK setup checks, including account registration, event delivery, campaigns, links, and in-app promotions.
