en.disableEffect: CustomerGlu setup checks will no longer open; if the app still requests this screen, that launch may fail.

zh-CN.description: CustomerGlu 运行 SDK 配置检查时会打开此页面，检查账户注册、事件传递、活动、链接和应用内推广。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后无法打开 CustomerGlu 的配置检查页面；如果应用仍请求启动它，该请求可能失败。

en.description: CustomerGlu opens this full-screen view when a user expands a floating campaign video; it plays the clip and provides sound, back, collapse, and campaign-action controls.
en.disableEffect: If a user expands a CustomerGlu video after this component is disabled, the uncaught screen launch may fail and crash the app.

zh-CN.description: 用户展开 CustomerGlu 的悬浮活动视频时会进入此全屏界面，可播放视频并控制声音、返回、收起或打开活动操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后若用户展开 CustomerGlu 视频，未捕获的界面启动错误可能导致应用崩溃。

en.description: CustomerGlu opens this pop-up for an in-app campaign; it can show an image, animation, or video with buttons to open campaign content.
en.disableEffect: CustomerGlu pop-up campaigns will not appear, while the app's other screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: CustomerGlu 的应用内活动会通过此弹窗展示，可显示图片、动画或视频，并提供打开活动内容的按钮。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，CustomerGlu 的弹窗活动不会显示，但应用的其他页面仍可使用。

en.description: CustomerGlu uses this bottom pop-up for campaign pages and opened push messages; it loads the page inside the app and handles its links.
en.disableEffect: Bottom pop-up campaigns and reward content that use this layout will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: CustomerGlu 用此底部弹窗展示活动页面和打开的推送消息；页面在应用内加载，并处理其中的链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，使用此布局的底部活动弹窗和奖励内容将无法打开。

en.description: CustomerGlu uses this bottom-sheet panel for campaign pages and opened push messages; it loads the content inside the app and handles its links.
en.disableEffect: Campaign or reward pages that use this bottom-sheet layout will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: CustomerGlu 用此底部滑出面板展示活动页面和打开的推送消息；内容在应用内加载，并处理其中的链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，使用此底部面板布局的活动或奖励页面将无法打开。

en.description: CustomerGlu uses this centered pop-up for campaign pages and opened push messages; it loads the page inside the app and handles its links.
en.disableEffect: Campaign or reward pages that use this centered layout will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: CustomerGlu 用此居中弹窗展示活动页面和打开的推送消息；页面在应用内加载，并处理其中的链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，使用此居中布局的活动或奖励页面将无法打开。

en.description: CustomerGlu opens this full-screen page when a campaign or notification links to web content; it loads that content inside the app and handles its links.
en.disableEffect: Full-screen campaign, notification, or reward-wallet pages provided through CustomerGlu will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: CustomerGlu 的活动或通知链接到网页内容时会打开此全屏页面；页面在应用内加载，并处理其中的链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，通过 CustomerGlu 展示的全屏活动、通知或奖励钱包页面将无法打开。

en.description: CustomerGlu opens this screen for a contextual tip, dimming the page and highlighting a selected area while showing a short tip.
en.disableEffect: If CustomerGlu tries to show this tip after it is disabled, the uncaught launch error may crash the app.

zh-CN.description: CustomerGlu 显示上下文提示时会打开此界面，把当前页面变暗并突出显示指定区域，同时展示简短提示。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后如果 CustomerGlu 仍尝试显示此提示，未捕获的启动错误可能导致应用崩溃。

en.description: When an app uses indoo.rs indoor navigation, this Service runs the SDK's background localization work, using Wi-Fi and Bluetooth signals and loading packaged map files.
en.disableEffect: Indoor positioning or navigation provided through indoo.rs may stop working.

zh-CN.description: 应用使用 indoo.rs 室内导航时，此服务会在后台运行定位任务，利用 Wi-Fi 和蓝牙信号并加载 SDK 自带的地图文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，indoo.rs 提供的室内定位或导航可能无法使用。

en.description: This startup provider supports CWSky's Multiple Image Picker, which lets users choose photos and makes configured app, cache and media files available through private content links.
en.disableEffect: Without it, the photo-picker view cannot calculate its layout from the app's screen settings and can fail to open.

zh-CN.description: 这个启动 Provider 为 CWSky Multiple Image Picker 提供支持，供用户选择照片，并通过私有内容链接提供已配置的应用、缓存和媒体文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，照片选择页面无法从应用的屏幕设置计算布局，可能无法打开。

en.description: Dadino BarcodeScanner's ADB test adapter receives app-specific barcode test broadcasts and forwards scan text while the scanner is active.
en.disableEffect: Barcode scans started in the app continue to work; this component adds no separate user-facing feature while the scanner is idle.

zh-CN.description: Dadino BarcodeScanner 的 ADB 测试适配器接收应用专属的条码测试广播，并在扫描器运行时把条码文本传给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用中已启动的条码扫描仍可使用；扫描器未运行时，此组件没有独立的用户功能。

en.description: Dadino BarcodeScanner's Newland adapter receives broadcasts from Newland handheld scanners and forwards successful barcode text or scan failures while the scanner is active.
en.disableEffect: Newland scans started in the app continue to work; this component adds no separate user-facing feature while the scanner is idle.

zh-CN.description: Dadino BarcodeScanner 的 Newland 适配器接收新大陆手持扫描器发出的广播，并在扫描器运行时把成功的条码文本或扫描错误传给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用中已启动的 Newland 扫描仍可使用；扫描器未运行时，此组件没有独立的用户功能。

en.description: Android starts this Dailymotion Player SDK provider with the app; it saves the app context and begins a background lookup for the Google advertising ID.
en.disableEffect: Dailymotion's startup setup and advertising-ID lookup will not run, which may affect apps that rely on its embedded player or ad information.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时 Android 会自动创建 Dailymotion Player SDK 的此内容提供器；它保存应用上下文，并在后台查询 Google 广告 ID。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Dailymotion 的启动初始化和广告 ID 查询不会运行，依赖其内嵌播放器或广告信息的应用可能受到影响。

en.description: Dangbei's Euthenia ad SDK uses this full-screen web page to load an ad destination; links can also open an installed app.
en.disableEffect: Dangbei ad landing pages will not open, while the app's other screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: Dangbei Euthenia 广告 SDK 用此全屏网页加载广告目标页面；其中的链接也可以打开已安装的应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Dangbei 广告落地页将无法打开，但应用的其他页面仍可使用。

en.description: The Dangbei downloader starts this background Service for queued download actions; it restores saved tasks and reports download progress and completion.
en.disableEffect: Downloads handled through this service will not start or resume, which may break app flows that rely on it.

zh-CN.description: Dangbei 下载器收到排队的下载任务时会启动此后台服务；它会恢复已保存的任务并报告下载进度和完成状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，通过此服务处理的下载将无法启动或恢复，依赖它的应用流程可能受影响。

en.description: The DangoDX TapTap core SDK starts this provider automatically with the app and asks the SDK to initialize. In version 0.1.13, that startup step only writes a diagnostic log.
en.disableEffect: This version loses only that startup log; the provider performs no app-facing work.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，DangoDX TapTap 核心 SDK 会自动运行此 Provider 并请求初始化；在 0.1.13 版中，该初始化流程只写入诊断日志。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 此版本只会少写一条启动日志；该 Provider 不执行面向应用的功能。

en.description: Daoyixun's AMap navigation library opens this screen after a bus route is selected; it shows the route map, travel time, fare estimate, and route segments.
en.disableEffect: The app will not be able to show this bus route map and its segment details.

zh-CN.description: 选择公交路线后，Daoyixun 的 AMap 导航库会打开此页面，显示路线地图、所需时间、打车费用估算和各段行程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用将无法显示这条公交路线的地图和分段详情。

en.description: Daoyixun's AMap navigation library opens this screen to plan bus, driving, or walking routes; it can also start guided navigation for a selected trip.
en.disableEffect: The app will lose route choices and navigation started from this screen.

zh-CN.description: Daoyixun 的 AMap 导航库会打开此页面规划公交、驾车或步行路线，也可为选定行程启动逐向导航。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用将无法使用此页面选择路线或启动导航。

en.description: During indoor positioning, the Daoyixun IPSMap SDK starts this foreground Service to help keep Bluetooth scans from being throttled and shows an indoor-positioning notification.
en.disableEffect: Indoor positioning may stop or become less reliable when Bluetooth scans are throttled.

zh-CN.description: 进行室内定位时，Daoyixun IPSMap SDK 会启动此前台 Service，帮助避免蓝牙扫描被系统限流，并显示室内定位通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 蓝牙扫描受到系统限流时，室内定位可能停止或变得不稳定。

en.description: When a user opens location history from the Daoyixun IPSMap screen, this Activity loads saved background-location records for the selected map and supports refresh and paging.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to open or browse IPSMap location-history records.

zh-CN.description: 用户从 Daoyixun IPSMap 页面打开足迹记录时，此 Activity 会加载所选地图的后台位置记录，并支持刷新和分页浏览。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开或浏览 IPSMap 的位置历史记录。

en.description: The Daoyixun IPSMap SDK opens this indoor map to locate the user, search for places, share a location, and guide the user along a selected route.
en.disableEffect: IPSMap indoor maps, location, place search, and guided routes will stop working.

zh-CN.description: Daoyixun IPSMap SDK 会打开此室内地图，用于定位用户、搜索地点、分享位置，并引导用户沿选定路线前进。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，IPSMap 的室内地图、定位、地点搜索和路线引导将无法使用。

en.description: When IPSMap asks the user to choose a starting point or destination, this screen searches indoor places by text or voice and returns the selected place to the map.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to search for or select indoor route endpoints.

zh-CN.description: IPSMap 让用户选择起点或目的地时，此页面可通过文字或语音搜索室内地点，并将选定地点返回地图。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法搜索或选择室内路线的起点和目的地。

en.description: CrazyCodeBoy MultipleImageSelect is a photo-picker SDK, also published as a WDEO3601-maintained fork. This screen opens when an app asks the user to choose photos, lists albums from the device photo library, and opens the selected album.
en.disableEffect: Apps that use this picker can no longer browse photo albums or continue to selecting photos through this screen.

zh-CN.description: CrazyCodeBoy 的 MultipleImageSelect 图片选择 SDK（也有 WDEO3601 维护的分支）会在应用打开图片选择器时显示此页面。它读取设备照片库并列出相册，用户选择相册后即可继续选图。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此选择器的应用将无法通过此页面浏览相册或继续选择照片。

en.description: CrazyCodeBoy MultipleImageSelect is a photo-picker SDK, also published as a WDEO3601-maintained fork. This screen shows photos from the album selected in the picker, lets the user select several images, and returns the selection to the app.
en.disableEffect: Apps that use this picker can no longer select photos and return them through this screen.

zh-CN.description: CrazyCodeBoy 的 MultipleImageSelect 图片选择 SDK（也有 WDEO3601 维护的分支）会在用户选定相册后显示其中的照片。用户可以选择多张图片并将结果返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此选择器的应用将无法通过此页面选取照片并返回结果。

en.description: DashingQi Common Utils uses this startup Provider to save the app's Application context for its shared helpers.
en.disableEffect: Common Utils helpers that need the app context may fail when the app uses them.

zh-CN.description: DashingQi Common Utils 会通过此启动 Provider 保存应用的 Application 上下文，供通用工具使用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用使用依赖该上下文的 Common Utils 工具时可能会失败。

en.description: When WeChat returns from a DashingQi WeChat Pay request, this Activity receives the payment response and reports success, cancellation, or failure to the app.
en.disableEffect: The app may be unable to complete or confirm WeChat Pay transactions.

zh-CN.description: 微信从 DashingQi 微信支付请求返回时，此 Activity 会接收支付结果，并向应用报告成功、取消或失败。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用可能无法完成或确认微信支付交易。

en.description: When Firebase delivers a DashX push, this service processes the message and reports updated push registrations to DashX.
en.disableEffect: DashX push messages and token updates will no longer be processed; other app screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: Firebase 送达 DashX 推送时，此服务会处理消息，并向 DashX 更新推送注册信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，DashX 将不再处理推送消息和令牌更新，但应用的其他页面仍可使用。

en.description: When a user dismisses a DashX notification, this Receiver records the dismissal with the SDK and sends its dismissal event.
en.disableEffect: DashX will stop recording notification dismissals; the rest of the app remains available.

zh-CN.description: 用户划掉 DashX 通知时，此接收器会向 SDK 记录该操作并发送通知关闭事件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，DashX 将不再记录通知关闭情况，但应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: When a user taps a DashX notification or its action button, this Activity passes the message to DashX to open the configured destination and then closes.
en.disableEffect: Tapping DashX notifications will no longer open their configured destinations or actions.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击 DashX 通知或其操作按钮时，此界面会把消息交给 DashX 打开设定的目标页面，然后关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，点击 DashX 通知将无法打开设定的页面或执行对应操作。

en.description: When a user dismisses an older DashX notification, this Receiver records the dismissal with the SDK.
en.disableEffect: DashX will stop recording dismissals for these notifications; the rest of the app remains available.

zh-CN.description: 用户划掉旧版 DashX 通知时，此接收器会向 SDK 记录该操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，DashX 将不再记录这些通知的关闭情况，但应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: When Firebase delivers a push carrying app data, this service forwards the message to the app; it also passes updated push tokens to the app.
en.disableEffect: The app will no longer receive push messages or token updates through Dastan Library.

zh-CN.description: Firebase 送达包含应用数据的推送时，此服务会把消息转交给应用；推送令牌更新时也会通知应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用将无法通过 Dastan Library 接收推送消息或令牌更新。

en.description: When the app opens this page with a web address, Dastan Library loads it in an embedded browser with a loading indicator and back navigation.
en.disableEffect: Pages that the app opens through this embedded browser will no longer load.

zh-CN.description: 应用通过网页地址打开此页面时，Dastan Library 会在内嵌浏览器中加载网页，并显示加载状态和返回操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用通过此内嵌浏览器打开的网页将无法加载。

en.description: When opened, this Dastan Library screen lists text log files saved in the app's cache.
en.disableEffect: The built-in log list will be unavailable, but regular app functions remain available.

zh-CN.description: 打开时，此 Dastan Library 界面会列出保存在应用缓存中的文本日志文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，内置日志列表将无法使用，但应用的常规功能不受影响。

en.description: Datadog's Android Real User Monitoring (RUM) SDK starts this provider with the app and records whether the current process is in the foreground, which the SDK uses when reporting app starts and RUM events.
en.disableEffect: The app remains usable, but Datadog may miss app-start data and the process foreground state in its RUM reports.

zh-CN.description: Datadog Android Real User Monitoring（RUM）SDK 会在应用启动时运行此内容提供程序，并记录当前进程是否处于前台，供 SDK 判断应用启动和 RUM 事件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用仍可使用，但 Datadog 的 RUM 报告可能缺少应用启动数据和进程前后台状态。

en.description: When Dataseat's Android SDK has a full-screen interstitial ad ready, this screen displays it and tracks whether it appeared, failed, or was closed; it also supports rewarded ads.
en.disableEffect: The app remains usable, but full-screen ads will not appear and rewards for watching them will no longer be granted.

zh-CN.description: Dataseat Android SDK 准备展示全屏插屏广告时，会通过此界面显示广告并记录展示、失败或关闭结果；此界面也支持激励广告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用仍可使用，但全屏广告不会显示，观看广告对应的奖励也不会发放。

en.description: When DataSnap starts Gimbal-based location tracking, this service initializes Gimbal and listens for nearby beacons, visits, geofence changes, and related communications to send events to DataSnap.
en.disableEffect: DataSnap location-based events and location-triggered communications will stop being tracked.

zh-CN.description: DataSnap 启动基于 Gimbal 的位置跟踪时，这个 Service 会初始化 Gimbal，监听附近信标、到访、地理围栏变化及相关沟通活动，并向 DataSnap 发送事件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: DataSnap 的位置事件和基于位置触发的沟通将停止跟踪。

en.description: When David Luoye's permission library requests Android permissions, this Activity displays the system prompt and returns the permissions the user granted.
en.disableEffect: Features that use this permission library may not receive permission results and can stop working.

zh-CN.description: David Luoye 权限库请求 Android 权限时，此 Activity 会显示系统权限提示，并返回用户已授予的权限。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此权限库的功能可能收不到权限结果，因而无法正常工作。

en.description: When David Luoye CommonSupport requests Android permissions, this Activity displays the system prompt and returns the permissions the user granted.
en.disableEffect: Features that use CommonSupport's permission flow may not receive permission results.

zh-CN.description: David Luoye CommonSupport 请求 Android 权限时，此 Activity 会显示系统权限提示，并返回用户已授予的权限。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用 CommonSupport 权限流程的功能可能收不到权限结果。

en.description: View DB (Jiang Junmin) initializes the app database viewer when the app starts and starts the viewer's local access service. The library can then list the app's database files and inspect their tables and rows.
en.disableEffect: The database viewer's local access service will not initialize automatically, so its inspection screens may not be reachable.

zh-CN.description: View DB（Jiang Junmin）会在应用启动时初始化数据库查看工具，并启动其本地访问服务。此工具之后可列出应用的数据库文件，查看其中的表和数据。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 数据库查看工具的本地访问服务将不会自动初始化，其查看界面可能无法使用。

en.description: View DB (Jiang Junmin) displays rows from a selected database table and lets the user copy cell text or change a cell value. It opens after a table is selected in the database viewer.
en.disableEffect: The database inspection tool will no longer open or edit table rows through this screen.

zh-CN.description: View DB（Jiang Junmin）会显示所选数据库表中的数据，并允许用户复制单元格文字或修改单元格内容。用户在数据库查看工具中选择数据表后即可打开此界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 数据库查看工具将无法通过此界面打开或修改表中数据。

en.description: View DB (Jiang Junmin) lists database files found for the app and opens the table list for a selected database. It refreshes the database list when the screen is opened or resumed.
en.disableEffect: The database viewer's database-file list will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: View DB（Jiang Junmin）会列出应用中的数据库文件，并打开所选数据库的表清单。界面打开或返回前台时会刷新数据库清单。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 数据库查看工具将无法打开数据库文件清单。

en.description: View DB (Jiang Junmin) lists the tables in a selected database and opens the rows for a chosen table. It is reached from the database-file list.
en.disableEffect: The database inspection tool will no longer show or open database tables through this screen.

zh-CN.description: View DB（Jiang Junmin）会列出所选数据库中的表，并打开所选表中的数据。用户可从数据库文件清单进入此界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 数据库查看工具将无法通过此界面查看或打开数据表。

en.description: Machbird (APUS Group) opens this screen when an app-install promotion is triggered. It presents the promoted app and offers actions to visit its page or download it.
en.disableEffect: Machbird app-install promotions and their download options will no longer appear.

zh-CN.description: Machbird（APUS Group）在触发应用安装推广时打开此页面，展示被推广的应用，并提供查看页面或下载的选项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Machbird 应用安装推广及其下载选项将不再显示。

en.description: Machbird (APUS Group) opens this screen when a promoted app needs installation guidance. It shows instructions for completing that app's installation.
en.disableEffect: Installation guidance for apps promoted by Machbird will not appear.

zh-CN.description: Machbird（APUS Group）在推广应用需要安装指引时打开此页面，显示完成安装的说明。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Machbird 推广应用的安装指引将不再显示。

en.description: Machbird (APUS Group) uses this receiver for app-promotion notifications and links. When a user taps a promotion, it can open the app's store page or campaign link, or remove the notification.
en.disableEffect: Machbird promotion notifications and their store or campaign links will no longer be handled.

zh-CN.description: Machbird（APUS Group）通过此接收器处理应用推广通知和链接。用户点击推广内容时，它可打开应用商店页面或活动链接，也可移除通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Machbird 推广通知及其商店或活动链接将无法处理。

en.description: When the Android Realm Browser opens a selected database model, this Activity shows its records in a table and lets the user choose columns or inspect linked objects.
en.disableEffect: The optional Realm record inspection screen and linked-object navigation will not open; normal app features remain available.

zh-CN.description: Android Realm Browser 打开所选数据库模型时，此 Activity 会以表格显示记录，并允许用户选择列或查看关联对象。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 可选的 Realm 记录查看界面和关联对象导航将无法打开，应用的常规功能仍可使用。

en.description: When an app opens the Android Realm Browser file screen, this Activity lists stored Realm database files and opens a selected database for inspection.
en.disableEffect: Users can no longer open the optional list of stored Realm files; normal app features remain available.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开 Android Realm Browser 的文件界面时，此 Activity 会列出已存储的 Realm 数据库文件，并打开用户选中的数据库供查看。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法再打开可选的 Realm 文件列表，应用的常规功能仍可使用。

en.description: After a database file is selected in Android Realm Browser, this Activity lists the registered Realm model types and opens records for the chosen type.
en.disableEffect: Users can no longer choose a Realm model type to inspect through the optional browser; normal app features remain available.

zh-CN.description: 在 Android Realm Browser 中选定数据库文件后，此 Activity 会列出已注册的 Realm 模型类型，并打开所选类型的记录。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法再通过可选浏览器选择并查看 Realm 模型类型，应用的常规功能仍可使用。

en.description: When an app opens settings from Android Realm Browser, this Activity lets the user turn text wrapping on or off in the database table.
en.disableEffect: The optional database browser loses its text-wrapping setting; regular app features remain available.

zh-CN.description: 应用从 Android Realm Browser 打开设置时，此 Activity 可让用户开启或关闭数据库表格中的文字换行。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 可选数据库浏览器将无法使用文字换行设置，应用的常规功能仍可使用。

en.description: Roamcharge (DeepFleet) opens this map when the host app launches its charging-station screen. It fetches electric-vehicle charging station names and locations and marks them on the map.
en.disableEffect: The charging-station map cannot open, so users cannot find stations through this screen.

zh-CN.description: Roamcharge（DeepFleet）会在宿主应用打开充电站页面时显示这张地图。它会获取电动车充电站的名称和位置，并在地图上标出站点。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，充电站地图无法打开，用户不能通过此页面查找站点。

en.description: Kai Boluo (开菠萝) Open SDK opens an anchor's home page for the requested creator.
en.disableEffect: The SDK's anchor profile page will not open.

zh-CN.description: 开菠萝开放 SDK 会打开指定主播的主页。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，SDK 提供的主播主页将无法打开。

en.description: Kai Boluo (开菠萝) Open SDK opens its calendar view when the app routes the user to the SDK calendar page.
en.disableEffect: The calendar page supplied by this SDK will not open.

zh-CN.description: 应用跳转到开菠萝开放 SDK 的日历页面时，此页面会展示 SDK 提供的日历视图。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，SDK 提供的日历页面将无法打开。

en.description: Kai Boluo (开菠萝) Open SDK opens details for the selected product, including its price and live-sale status, with purchase, coupon, and sale-reminder actions.
en.disableEffect: The product details and purchase or reminder actions provided by this SDK will not open.

zh-CN.description: 开菠萝开放 SDK 会展示所选商品的详情、价格和直播销售状态，并提供购买、领券及开售提醒操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，此 SDK 提供的商品详情、购买和提醒操作将无法打开。

en.description: Kai Boluo (开菠萝) Open SDK opens a list of live-shopping sessions associated with the selected live event or product.
en.disableEffect: The related live-shopping list will not open.

zh-CN.description: 开菠萝开放 SDK 会展示与所选直播活动或商品相关的直播列表。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，相关直播列表将无法打开。

en.description: Kai Boluo (开菠萝) Open SDK opens the requested live room so the user can watch its stream and related shopping content.
en.disableEffect: Live rooms opened through this SDK will not be available.

zh-CN.description: 开菠萝开放 SDK 会打开指定的直播间，供用户观看直播及相关购物内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，无法打开此 SDK 提供的直播间。

en.description: Kai Boluo (开菠萝) Open SDK opens its recommendation home page and can use an incoming notification message to route the user to a specific page.
en.disableEffect: The SDK's recommendation page and its notification-driven page links will not open.

zh-CN.description: 开菠萝开放 SDK 会打开推荐首页，也可根据收到的通知内容将用户带到指定页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，SDK 推荐首页及通知内的页面跳转将无法打开。

en.description: Kai Boluo (开菠萝) Open SDK opens a supplied web page inside its in-app browser.
en.disableEffect: Web pages opened through this SDK screen will not load.

zh-CN.description: 开菠萝开放 SDK 会在应用内浏览器中打开传入的网页。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，通过此 SDK 页面打开的网页将无法加载。

en.description: The Deepleaper MVVM library initializes shared app context and registers connectivity, activity, and foreground-lifecycle monitoring when the app starts.
en.disableEffect: Apps using the Deepleaper MVVM setup may lose its shared app context and network or lifecycle monitoring.

zh-CN.description: Deepleaper 的 MVVM 库会在应用启动时初始化共享应用上下文，并注册网络、Activity 和应用前后台生命周期监听。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用 Deepleaper MVVM 的应用可能失去共享应用上下文以及网络或生命周期监听。

en.description: Deeply Listen Cloud SDK initializes its sound-event detection client automatically when the app starts, before the app can use the library.
en.disableEffect: Apps that use Listen Cloud will not initialize their sound-event detection feature.

zh-CN.description: Deeply Listen Cloud SDK 会在应用启动时自动初始化声音事件检测客户端，供应用后续调用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，使用 Listen Cloud 的应用将无法初始化声音事件检测功能。

en.description: When Konotor's scheduled alarm fires, this Receiver starts the support SDK's background service to process queued events.
en.disableEffect: Queued Konotor support events will not be processed by this scheduled alarm flow.

zh-CN.description: Konotor 的定时闹钟触发时，此 Receiver 会启动支持 SDK 的后台服务来处理排队事件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 排队中的 Konotor 支持事件将无法通过此定时任务处理。

en.description: When a user opens the Konotor support conversation, this Activity shows message history and controls for sending text, voice, or picture messages.
en.disableEffect: The app's Konotor support conversation will not open, so users cannot send feedback through that screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 Konotor 支持对话时，此 Activity 会显示消息记录，并提供发送文字、语音或图片消息的控件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用的 Konotor 支持对话将无法打开，用户不能通过该页面发送反馈。

en.description: When a user taps a Konotor notification action, this Activity records the action and opens its supplied app link, or the app's launch screen when no link is supplied.
en.disableEffect: Konotor notification actions will no longer record the tap or open their linked app screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击 Konotor 通知操作时，此 Activity 会记录点击，并打开通知提供的应用链接；若没有链接，则打开应用启动页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Konotor 通知操作将不再记录点击或打开关联的应用页面。

en.description: When a user opens a photo in a Konotor support conversation, this Activity loads the message's image and displays it in a photo view.
en.disableEffect: Photos in Konotor support messages will no longer open in the image viewer.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 Konotor 支持对话中的照片时，此 Activity 会加载该消息的图片并在图片视图中显示。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Konotor 支持消息中的照片将无法在图片查看器中打开。

en.description: When Android reports a connectivity change and the network becomes connected, Konotor refreshes its connection state and runs its update work.
en.disableEffect: Konotor will not run this connection-triggered refresh when network access returns.

zh-CN.description: Android 报告网络连接变化且网络已连接时，Konotor 会刷新连接状态并执行更新操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 网络恢复时，Konotor 将无法通过此接收器执行连接刷新。

en.description: When Konotor starts this background Service, it processes events queued by the support SDK and sends them through the matching event handlers.
en.disableEffect: Queued Konotor support events may remain unsent or unprocessed.

zh-CN.description: Konotor 启动此后台 Service 时，它会处理支持 SDK 排队的事件，并通过对应的事件处理程序发送这些事件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 排队中的 Konotor 支持事件可能无法发送或处理。

en.description: When the Konotor Android SDK starts this Service, it schedules a backlog check shortly afterward and then once each hour.
en.disableEffect: The hourly scheduled retry for queued Konotor support events will stop.

zh-CN.description: Konotor Android SDK 启动此 Service 时，它会安排稍后检查一次待处理事件，之后每小时检查一次。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 排队中的 Konotor 支持事件将不再按小时定时重试。

en.description: Dementhius's Battle.net OAuth2 library uses this Activity during sign-in; it shows Blizzard's authorization page, handles the HTTPS localhost callback, saves the returned access token, and opens the app's next screen.
en.disableEffect: Battle.net sign-in cannot finish because the app will not receive and save the authorization result.

zh-CN.description: Dementhius 的 Battle.net OAuth2 登录库会在登录时使用此 Activity；它会显示暴雪授权页面、处理 HTTPS localhost 回调、保存返回的访问令牌，并打开应用的后续页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用无法接收和保存授权结果，因此 Battle.net 登录无法完成。

en.description: GetCropImage uses this screen to take or choose a photo, crop it if requested, and return it to the app. In an older package copy, the screen closes immediately without opening the camera or photo picker.
en.disableEffect: Apps that use this photo feature will no longer be able to capture, select, or crop images through the library.

zh-CN.description: GetCropImage 的一个打包版本会打开相机或本地图片选择器，可裁剪图片后返回应用；另一个较早的版本不会打开选择器，而是立即关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，使用有效版本进行图片附件或上传的功能将无法拍摄、选择或裁剪图片。

en.description: DeployGate Android SDK initializes its test-build and diagnostics service automatically at app startup, including crash reporting where enabled.
en.disableEffect: DeployGate testing and diagnostic reporting may stop, while the app's own features remain available.

zh-CN.description: DeployGate Android SDK 会在应用启动时自动初始化测试版本和诊断服务，并在启用时提供崩溃报告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，DeployGate 测试及诊断报告可能停止，但应用自身功能仍可使用。

en.description: Descope Android SDK opens a supplied sign-in or account-link URL in a Chrome custom tab and detects when the user returns or closes it.
en.disableEffect: Browser-based sign-in flows using Descope may fail to open or report the user's return to the app.

zh-CN.description: Descope Android SDK 会在 Chrome 自定义标签页中打开传入的登录或账号关联网址，并检测用户返回或关闭页面的情况。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，使用 Descope 的浏览器登录流程可能无法打开，或无法将用户返回应用的情况告知登录流程。

en.description: DEUNA’s payment SDK opens this Activity when the app starts its hosted checkout. It retrieves the order’s payment link and displays the checkout page so the customer can pay.
en.disableEffect: The app’s DEUNA checkout cannot open, so customers cannot complete purchases through this flow.

zh-CN.description: DEUNA 支付 SDK 会在应用启动托管结账流程时打开此 Activity。它会获取订单的支付链接并显示结账页面，供用户完成付款。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用的 DEUNA 结账页面无法打开，用户不能通过此流程完成购买。

en.description: DEUNA’s payment SDK opens this Activity to load a hosted Elements page during checkout. It displays the page inside the app and returns its events to the app.
en.disableEffect: The app’s DEUNA Elements page will not open, so checkout steps that use it may fail.

zh-CN.description: DEUNA 支付 SDK 会在结账过程中打开此 Activity 来加载托管的 Elements 页面。页面显示在应用内，其操作事件会返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用的 DEUNA Elements 页面无法打开，依赖它的结账步骤可能无法完成。

en.description: DEUNA’s payment SDK opens this Activity to load an order’s hosted checkout page. It requests the order’s payment link and shows the page inside the app.
en.disableEffect: The app’s DEUNA checkout page will not open, preventing customers from paying through this flow.

zh-CN.description: DEUNA 支付 SDK 会打开此 Activity 来加载订单的托管结账页面。它会请求订单的支付链接，并在应用内显示该页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用的 DEUNA 结账页面无法打开，用户不能通过此流程付款。

en.description: DEUNA’s payment SDK opens this Activity to show a hosted Elements page inside the app. The app supplies the page address, and the Activity reports page events back to the app.
en.disableEffect: The app’s DEUNA Elements screen will not load, which can break checkout steps that depend on it.

zh-CN.description: DEUNA 支付 SDK 会打开此 Activity，在应用内显示托管的 Elements 页面。应用会提供页面地址，此 Activity 会将页面事件返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用的 DEUNA Elements 页面无法加载，依赖它的结账步骤可能无法完成。

en.description: DEUNA’s payment SDK opens this Activity to load its payment widget from a web page. It sends widget events back to the app while the customer completes a payment step.
en.disableEffect: The DEUNA payment widget will not open, so payment options that use it will be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: DEUNA 支付 SDK 会打开此 Activity，从网页加载支付组件。用户完成支付步骤时，组件会将操作事件返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，DEUNA 支付组件无法打开，使用该组件的支付选项将不可用。

en.description: The PlaylistCore media library receives media-button commands from Android, such as headset or lock-screen controls. It forwards play, pause, next, and previous commands to the app’s playback service.
en.disableEffect: Headset and lock-screen playback controls will stop working, although the app may still play media on screen.

zh-CN.description: PlaylistCore 媒体库会接收 Android 发来的媒体按键命令，例如耳机或锁屏上的控制操作，并将播放、暂停、上一首和下一首命令转给应用的播放服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，耳机和锁屏上的播放控制将无法使用，但应用仍可能可以在屏幕内播放媒体。

en.description: Develouz Library Core opens Android’s speech-recognition screen when the app requests voice input. It returns the recognized words to the app.
en.disableEffect: Voice input through Develouz Library Core will stop working.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求语音输入时，Develouz Library Core 会打开 Android 语音识别界面，并将识别出的文字返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用将无法通过 Develouz Library Core 使用语音输入。

en.description: Develouz SDK Core opens Android’s speech-recognition screen when the app requests voice input. It returns the recognized words to the app.
en.disableEffect: Voice input through Develouz SDK Core will stop working.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求语音输入时，Develouz SDK Core 会打开 Android 语音识别界面，并将识别出的文字返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用将无法通过 Develouz SDK Core 使用语音输入。

en.description: When an app opens the DeveloperPaul123 Simple Bluetooth Library chooser, this Activity lists paired devices and discovers nearby devices, then returns the selected Bluetooth device to the app.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot use this library screen to pick a Bluetooth device, so any pairing or connection flow that depends on it will fail.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开 DeveloperPaul123 Simple Bluetooth Library 的设备选择界面时，此 Activity 会列出已配对设备并搜索附近设备，然后将用户选中的蓝牙设备返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用无法通过此库的界面选择蓝牙设备，因此依赖它进行配对或连接的流程会失败。

en.description: When an app opens the DeveloperPaul123 FilePicker library, this Activity lists storage folders and files so the user can browse, create a folder, and choose a file or folder; it returns the selected path to the app.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot open this library file or folder picker or receive a selection through it.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开 DeveloperPaul123 FilePicker 文件选择库时，此 Activity 会列出存储中的文件和文件夹，供用户浏览、创建文件夹并选择文件或文件夹，然后将所选路径返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用无法再通过此文件选择库打开文件或文件夹选择界面并获取所选路径。

en.description: Devsu Push Client starts this Service when Google refreshes the app’s GCM push token. It requests a fresh registration so Devsu notifications can continue to arrive.
en.disableEffect: The app will not refresh its Devsu GCM registration when Google changes the push token.

zh-CN.description: Google 更新应用的 GCM 推送令牌时，Devsu Push Client 会启动此 Service，并重新注册令牌以继续接收 Devsu 通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Google 更换推送令牌时，应用将无法更新 Devsu GCM 注册信息。

en.description: When Google Cloud Messaging delivers a push message, this Devsu Push Client Service passes the message to the app’s notification handler.
en.disableEffect: Devsu push messages handled by this service will no longer be processed.

zh-CN.description: Google Cloud Messaging 投递推送消息时，Devsu Push Client 的此 Service 会将消息交给应用的通知处理程序。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，此 Service 负责处理的 Devsu 推送消息将无法处理。

en.description: When a Google Cloud Messaging message arrives from the configured sender, this Devsu Push Client Service passes it to the app’s notification handler.
en.disableEffect: The app will stop handling Devsu notifications delivered through this GCM service.

zh-CN.description: 配置的发送方通过 Google Cloud Messaging 投递消息时，Devsu Push Client 的此 Service 会将消息交给应用的通知处理程序。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用将无法处理通过此 GCM Service 投递的 Devsu 通知。

en.description: When the app requests Devsu GCM push registration, this Service obtains a messaging token and returns the registration result to the app.
en.disableEffect: The app will not be able to register this device for Devsu GCM push messages.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求注册 Devsu GCM 推送时，此 Service 会获取消息令牌，并将注册结果返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用将无法为此设备注册 Devsu GCM 推送。

en.description: When the app requests Devsu GCM push unregistration, this Service deletes the device’s GCM token and reports the result.
en.disableEffect: The app will not be able to complete GCM push unregistration through this Service.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求取消 Devsu GCM 推送注册时，此 Service 会删除设备的 GCM 令牌并返回处理结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用将无法通过此 Service 完成 GCM 推送注销。

en.description: Devsu Push Client starts this Service when Firebase refreshes the app’s push token. It requests a new registration so Firebase-delivered Devsu notifications can continue.
en.disableEffect: The app will not refresh its Devsu Firebase registration when Firebase changes the push token.

zh-CN.description: Firebase 更新应用的推送令牌时，Devsu Push Client 会启动此 Service，并重新注册令牌以继续接收 Firebase 投递的 Devsu 通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Firebase 更换推送令牌时，应用将无法更新 Devsu Firebase 注册信息。

en.description: This Devsu Push Client Service receives Firebase push messages and passes messages for the configured sender to the app’s notification handler.
en.disableEffect: The app will stop handling Devsu notifications delivered through Firebase.

zh-CN.description: Devsu Push Client 的此 Service 会接收 Firebase 推送，并将配置的发送方发来的消息交给应用的通知处理程序。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用将无法处理通过 Firebase 投递的 Devsu 通知。

en.description: When the app requests Firebase push registration, this Devsu Push Client Service obtains the Firebase messaging token and returns the result.
en.disableEffect: The app will not be able to register this device for Devsu Firebase push messages.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求注册 Firebase 推送时，Devsu Push Client 的此 Service 会获取 Firebase 消息令牌并返回结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用将无法为此设备注册 Devsu Firebase 推送。

en.description: When the app requests Firebase push unregistration, this Devsu Push Client Service deletes the Firebase device token and reports the result.
en.disableEffect: The app will not be able to complete Firebase push unregistration through this Service.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求取消 Firebase 推送注册时，Devsu Push Client 的此 Service 会删除 Firebase 设备令牌并返回处理结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用将无法通过此 Service 完成 Firebase 推送注销。

en.description: Devsu Push Client starts this Service when Google refreshes the app’s GCM token. It requests a new registration so GCM notifications can continue to arrive.
en.disableEffect: The app will not refresh its Devsu GCM registration when Google changes the push token.

zh-CN.description: Google 更新应用的 GCM 令牌时，Devsu Push Client 会启动此 Service，并重新注册令牌以继续接收 GCM 通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Google 更换推送令牌时，应用将无法更新 Devsu GCM 注册信息。

en.description: This Devsu Push Client Service receives GCM messages and passes messages from the configured sender to the app’s notification handler.
en.disableEffect: The app will stop handling Devsu notifications delivered through GCM.

zh-CN.description: Devsu Push Client 的此 Service 会接收 GCM 消息，并将配置的发送方发来的消息交给应用的通知处理程序。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用将无法处理通过 GCM 投递的 Devsu 通知。

en.description: When the app requests Devsu GCM push registration, this Service obtains a GCM token and returns the registration result.
en.disableEffect: The app will not be able to register this device for Devsu GCM push messages.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求注册 Devsu GCM 推送时，此 Service 会获取 GCM 令牌并返回注册结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用将无法为此设备注册 Devsu GCM 推送。

en.description: When the app requests Devsu GCM push unregistration, this Service deletes the GCM device token and reports the result.
en.disableEffect: The app will not be able to complete GCM push unregistration through this Service.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求取消 Devsu GCM 推送注册时，此 Service 会删除 GCM 设备令牌并返回处理结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用将无法通过此 Service 完成 GCM 推送注销。

en.description: The devtodev Analytics SDK starts this background Service as part of its session lifecycle. It has no user-facing screen.
en.disableEffect: The devtodev session service will not run; the code shown does not provide a visible app feature.

zh-CN.description: devtodev Analytics SDK 会在会话生命周期中启动此后台 Service。它不会显示用户界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，devtodev 会话 Service 将无法运行；当前代码没有提供可见的应用功能。

en.description: When a user opens a devtodev push notification, this Activity forwards the tap to the SDK’s notification handler and then closes.
en.disableEffect: Tapping a devtodev notification will no longer open its configured destination or action.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 devtodev 推送通知时，此 Activity 会将点击操作交给 SDK 的通知处理程序，然后关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，点击 devtodev 通知将无法打开其指定页面或执行相应操作。

en.description: When a user opens a devtodev push notification, this Activity forwards the tap to the SDK’s notification handler and then closes.
en.disableEffect: Tapping a devtodev notification will no longer open its configured destination or action.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 devtodev 推送通知时，此 Activity 会将点击操作交给 SDK 的通知处理程序，然后关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，点击 devtodev 通知将无法打开其指定页面或执行相应操作。

en.description: The devtodev Messaging SDK receives Firebase push messages here and displays messages sent by the SDK as notifications.
en.disableEffect: devtodev push notifications delivered through Firebase will no longer be handled by the app.

zh-CN.description: devtodev Messaging SDK 会在此接收 Firebase 推送，并将 SDK 的消息显示为通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用将无法处理通过 Firebase 投递的 devtodev 推送通知。

en.description: When Android reports a tap on a devtodev notification, this Receiver passes the notification action to the SDK’s click handler.
en.disableEffect: Tapping a devtodev notification or its action buttons will no longer trigger the configured action.

zh-CN.description: Android 报告用户点击 devtodev 通知时，此 Receiver 会将通知操作交给 SDK 的点击处理程序。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，点击 devtodev 通知或其操作按钮将无法触发指定操作。

en.description: The devtodev Android SDK receives Firebase push messages here and passes them to its notification handler. It also receives refreshed push tokens.
en.disableEffect: The app will no longer handle devtodev push messages delivered through Firebase.

zh-CN.description: devtodev Android SDK 会在此接收 Firebase 推送并交给其通知处理程序，也会接收更新后的推送令牌。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用将无法处理通过 Firebase 投递的 devtodev 推送消息。

en.description: When Android reports a tap on a devtodev notification, this Receiver passes the notification and selected action to the SDK’s handler.
en.disableEffect: Tapping a devtodev notification or its action buttons will no longer trigger the configured action.

zh-CN.description: Android 报告用户点击 devtodev 通知时，此 Receiver 会将通知和所选操作交给 SDK 处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，点击 devtodev 通知或其操作按钮将无法触发指定操作。

en.description: When Android reports a completed download, the Dahanis Foundation library checks whether its tracked download succeeded and notifies the app download manager.
en.disableEffect: Foundation-managed downloads may finish without the app receiving their completion notification.

zh-CN.description: Android 报告下载完成时，Dahanis Foundation 会检查其跟踪的下载是否成功，并通知应用的下载管理功能。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Foundation 管理的下载可能已经完成，但应用收不到完成通知。

en.description: DHCC’s crash handler opens this Activity after an app crash; it shows an error screen, sends crash details and lets the user restart or close the app.
en.disableEffect: The SDK’s crash-report and restart screen will be unavailable, which can leave the app closed after a crash.

zh-CN.description: DHCC 崩溃处理器会在应用崩溃后打开此 Activity；它显示错误页面、发送崩溃信息，并允许用户重启或关闭应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: SDK 的崩溃上报和重启页面将无法使用，应用崩溃后可能只能关闭。

en.description: DHCC Phone SDK opens this Activity as its main embedded web screen and connects page requests to native actions such as photo/gallery access and downloads.
en.disableEffect: The SDK’s main web interface and its native page actions will not open.

zh-CN.description: DHCC Phone SDK 会将此 Activity 作为主要内嵌网页界面，并把网页请求连接到拍照、相册和下载等原生操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: SDK 的主要网页界面及其原生页面操作将无法打开。

en.description: DHCC Phone SDK opens this Activity for embedded web pages; it hosts the page and supports downloads, media display and native page actions.
en.disableEffect: SDK flows routed to this embedded web screen will be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: DHCC Phone SDK 会用此 Activity 打开内嵌网页，并支持下载、媒体显示和网页调用的原生操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 经此内嵌网页打开的 SDK 流程将无法使用。

en.description: When DHCC’s QR scanner opens, this Activity shows a camera preview, decodes a code and returns the result to the calling screen.
en.disableEffect: QR-scanning flows that use the DHCC library will fail.

zh-CN.description: DHCC 扫码功能打开时，此 Activity 会显示相机预览、识别二维码并将结果返回调用页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用 DHCC 扫码库的二维码扫描流程将无法使用。

en.description: The DHSZ ad SDK uses this Activity to show an ad landing page; the page can open linked destinations and start downloads.
en.disableEffect: Ad landing pages and downloads that use this screen will not work.

zh-CN.description: DHSZ 广告 SDK 会用此 Activity 展示广告落地页；页面可以打开链接目标并启动下载。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此页面的广告落地页和下载功能将无法使用。

en.description: The DHSZ ad SDK uses this provider to give Android temporary access to a downloaded APK when opening it in the installer.
en.disableEffect: The installer may be unable to read a downloaded APK, so app downloads offered by ads can fail to install.

zh-CN.description: DHSZ 广告 SDK 将下载的 APK 交给安装程序时，会通过此提供程序临时开放文件读取权限。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 安装程序可能无法读取下载的 APK，广告提供的应用将无法安装。

en.description: The DHSZ ad SDK uses this background service to download APK files, report progress, and pass completed downloads to Android’s installer.
en.disableEffect: Ad downloads handled by this service will not complete or open for installation.

zh-CN.description: DHSZ 广告 SDK 通过此后台服务下载 APK、报告进度，并在完成后交由 Android 安装程序打开。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 此服务处理的广告下载将无法完成或交给安装程序打开。

en.description: The DHSZ ad SDK’s transparent helper Activity handles short utility tasks that need permission results, results from another screen, or screen-state callbacks.
en.disableEffect: Utility tasks that depend on this Activity cannot receive permission or screen results and may be interrupted.

zh-CN.description: DHSZ 广告 SDK 的透明辅助 Activity 处理需要权限结果、其他页面结果或页面状态回调的短暂工具操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此 Activity 的工具操作将无法收到权限或页面结果，相关流程可能中断。

en.description: Diagnal Engage receives the Play Store install-referrer broadcast through this Receiver. It decodes the referral information so Engage can attribute the app install.
en.disableEffect: Diagnal Engage will not receive Play Store install-referrer information for install attribution.

zh-CN.description: Google Play 商店发送安装来源信息时，Diagnal Engage 会通过此 Receiver 接收并解码该信息，以归因应用安装来源。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Diagnal Engage 将无法接收 Google Play 商店的安装来源信息来进行安装归因。

en.description: Diagnal Engage opens this Activity when a campaign preview returns to the app. It brings the app to the foreground and passes the preview’s campaign details to Engage.
en.disableEffect: Engage campaign previews will not return their campaign details to the app.

zh-CN.description: Diagnal Engage 的广告活动预览返回应用时会打开此 Activity。它会将应用带到前台，并把预览的活动信息交给 Engage。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Engage 广告活动预览将无法把活动信息返回给应用。

en.description: When Firebase issues a new push token, Diagnal Engage passes the token to its messaging client so push delivery can stay registered.
en.disableEffect: Diagnal Engage will not receive updated Firebase push tokens through this Service.

zh-CN.description: Firebase 发放新的推送令牌时，Diagnal Engage 会将令牌交给其消息客户端，以维持推送注册。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Diagnal Engage 将无法通过此 Service 接收更新后的 Firebase 推送令牌。

en.description: Diagnal Engage receives Firebase push messages through this Service and passes them to its messaging client for handling.
en.disableEffect: Diagnal Engage messages delivered through Firebase will no longer be handled by this app.

zh-CN.description: Diagnal Engage 会通过此 Service 接收 Firebase 推送，并将消息交给其消息客户端处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用将无法处理通过 Firebase 投递的 Diagnal Engage 消息。

en.description: Diagnal Engage opens this Activity to play a video campaign from an Engage message. It shows the campaign’s title, text, and available action buttons with the video.
en.disableEffect: Video campaigns opened from Diagnal Engage messages will not play.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 Diagnal Engage 消息中的视频活动时，Engage 会启动此 Activity 播放视频，并显示活动标题、正文和操作按钮。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，从 Diagnal Engage 消息打开的视频活动将无法播放。

en.description: Diagnal Engage receives Huawei push-token updates and push messages through this Service. It passes incoming messages to Engage for notification handling.
en.disableEffect: Huawei-delivered Diagnal Engage messages will no longer be handled by the app.

zh-CN.description: Diagnal Engage 会通过此 Service 接收华为推送令牌更新和推送消息，并将收到的消息交给 Engage 处理通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用将无法处理通过华为推送投递的 Diagnal Engage 消息。

en.description: Didi DreamBox’s sample catalog opens this screen to list example actions, including logging, dialogs, network requests, and page navigation.
en.disableEffect: Users will lose access to the DreamBox action examples.

zh-CN.description: Didi DreamBox 示例目录通过此页面展示操作示例，包括日志、弹窗、网络请求和页面跳转。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法查看 DreamBox 的操作示例。

en.description: Didi DreamBox’s sample catalog launches into this screen, which lists examples for views, actions, demo pages, and extensions.
en.disableEffect: The DreamBox catalog launcher and its example entry points will no longer be available.

zh-CN.description: Didi DreamBox 示例目录会从此页面启动，并列出视图、操作、演示页面和扩展示例。
zh-CN.disableEffect: DreamBox 示例目录的启动页面和示例入口将不可用。

en.description: When a user selects an item in Didi DreamBox’s sample catalog, this screen renders the packaged example and lets the user switch to view its XML layout.
en.disableEffect: The selected DreamBox layout example and its XML view will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Didi DreamBox 示例目录中选择项目后，此页面会渲染随 SDK 提供的示例，并可切换查看对应的 XML 布局。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开所选的 DreamBox 布局示例或查看其 XML。

en.description: Didi DreamBox’s sample catalog opens this screen from its extension section. The current catalog lists that no extension pages are available.
en.disableEffect: The extension section of the DreamBox sample catalog will be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: Didi DreamBox 示例目录会从扩展部分打开此页面；当前目录显示没有可用的扩展页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: DreamBox 示例目录中的扩展部分将无法打开。

en.description: Didi DreamBox’s sample catalog opens this screen to list view examples such as text, images, loading indicators, progress bars, and lists.
en.disableEffect: Users will lose access to the DreamBox view examples.

zh-CN.description: Didi DreamBox 示例目录通过此页面列出视图示例，例如文字、图片、加载提示、进度条和列表。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法查看 DreamBox 的视图示例。

en.description: Didi DreamBox’s debug tool opens this screen so developers can select a loaded design template, connect to a preview address, scan a QR code, or refresh the preview.
en.disableEffect: The DreamBox developer console and remote template preview will no longer be available.

zh-CN.description: Didi DreamBox 调试工具通过此页面供开发者选择已加载的模板、连接预览地址、扫描二维码或刷新预览。
zh-CN.disableEffect: DreamBox 开发者控制台和远程模板预览将不可用。

en.description: Didi Chameleon’s image tools open this screen after a user chooses or takes a photo that needs cropping. The user adjusts the crop area and saves the finished picture for the app.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot finish Chameleon image flows that require photo cropping.

zh-CN.description: Didi Chameleon 图像工具会在用户选择或拍摄需要裁剪的照片后打开此页面，用户可调整裁剪范围并保存图片供应用使用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法完成需要裁剪照片的 Chameleon 图像流程。

en.description: Didi Chameleon’s image tools use this provider to pass camera and crop images to the app as temporary links. It lets the app read a saved picture without exposing its file path.
en.disableEffect: Photo capture or cropping through Chameleon may fail when the app cannot access the image file.

zh-CN.description: Didi Chameleon 图像工具通过此 Provider 将相机拍摄或裁剪后的图片以临时链接交给应用读取，而无需暴露文件路径。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用无法读取图片文件时，通过 Chameleon 拍照或裁剪可能会失败。

en.description: When the app requests a picture through Didi Chameleon, this screen lets the user choose the camera or photo library and can crop the image before returning it to the app.
en.disableEffect: The app will lose the Chameleon photo selection and capture flow.

zh-CN.description: 应用通过 Didi Chameleon 请求图片时，此页面让用户选择相机或相册，并可在将图片交回应用前进行裁剪。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法再使用 Chameleon 选择或拍摄照片。

en.description: Didi Chameleon’s image SDK opens this screen after a user chooses or takes a photo that needs cropping. The user adjusts the crop area and saves the finished picture for the app.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot finish Chameleon image flows that require photo cropping.

zh-CN.description: Didi Chameleon 图像 SDK 会在用户选择或拍摄需要裁剪的照片后打开此页面，用户可调整裁剪范围并保存图片供应用使用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法完成需要裁剪照片的 Chameleon 图像流程。

en.description: When the app requests a picture through Didi Chameleon’s image SDK, this screen lets the user choose the camera or photo library and can crop the image before returning it to the app.
en.disableEffect: The app will lose the Chameleon photo selection and capture flow.

zh-CN.description: 应用通过 Didi Chameleon 图像 SDK 请求图片时，此页面让用户选择相机或相册，并可在将图片交回应用前进行裁剪。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法再使用 Chameleon 选择或拍摄照片。

en.description: When the app opens a page rendered with Didi Chameleon’s web engine, this screen loads the supplied page and displays it inside the app with a back button.
en.disableEffect: App screens that rely on Chameleon’s web renderer will fail to open.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开由 Didi Chameleon 网页引擎渲染的页面时，此页面会在应用内加载指定网页，并提供返回按钮。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖 Chameleon 网页引擎的应用页面将无法打开。

en.description: When the app opens a page rendered with Didi Chameleon’s Weex engine, this screen loads the supplied page and displays its content in the app.
en.disableEffect: App screens that rely on Chameleon’s Weex renderer will fail to open.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开由 Didi Chameleon Weex 引擎渲染的页面时，此页面会加载指定页面并在应用内显示内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖 Chameleon Weex 引擎的应用页面将无法打开。

en.description: At app startup, DiDi DRouter uses this Provider to save the Application context needed by its routing framework.
en.disableEffect: Pages or modules opened through DRouter may fail to initialize.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，DiDi DRouter 会通过此 Provider 保存路由框架所需的 Application 上下文。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过 DRouter 打开的页面或模块可能无法初始化。

en.description: The Didi Hummer framework opens this Activity when an app asks it to display a Hummer page, then renders that page from a web address, local file, or app asset.
en.disableEffect: Hummer-based screens will not open.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求 Didi Hummer 展示页面时会打开此 Activity，并从网址、本地文件或应用资源中加载页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖 Hummer 的界面将无法打开。

en.description: The Didi Hummer framework opens this Activity for a delegated page, creates its view, and returns the page result when the user closes it.
en.disableEffect: Delegated Hummer screens and their return results will stop working.

zh-CN.description: Didi Hummer 展示委托页面时会打开此 Activity，创建页面视图，并在用户关闭页面时返回结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 委托的 Hummer 页面及其返回结果将无法使用。

en.description: The Didi Hummer developer-tools provider runs during app startup and registers tools used to inspect and debug Hummer pages.
en.disableEffect: Hummer page inspection and debugging will be unavailable, while normal app screens continue to work.

zh-CN.description: Didi Hummer 开发工具 Provider 会在应用启动时注册用于检查和调试 Hummer 页面的工具。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Hummer 页面检查和调试功能将不可用，应用的普通界面仍可使用。

en.description: AndroidUtilCode's helper Activity starts when utility code needs a temporary screen to request a permission or receive a system result, then passes that result back to the caller.
en.disableEffect: Permission and system-result flows that rely on this helper can fail.

zh-CN.description: AndroidUtilCode 的辅助 Activity 会在工具代码需要临时界面申请权限或接收系统操作结果时启动，并将结果交还给发起操作的功能。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此辅助界面的权限申请或系统结果处理可能失效。

en.description: When DiDi DoKit shares a saved diagnostic file, this Provider supplies the app-scoped content link used by the share flow.
en.disableEffect: DoKit may not be able to share its saved diagnostic files.

zh-CN.description: DiDi DoKit 分享已保存的诊断文件时，此 Provider 会为分享流程提供应用内的文件链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: DoKit 可能无法分享已保存的诊断文件。

en.description: When a developer opens DiDi DoKit's automated-test tool, this Activity shows controls for connecting, recording interactions, running tests, and viewing cases.
en.disableEffect: DoKit's app-testing and interaction-recording screens will not open.

zh-CN.description: 开发者打开 DiDi DoKit 自动化测试工具时，此 Activity 会显示连接、录制操作、运行测试和查看用例的控件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: DoKit 的应用测试和操作录制页面将无法打开。

en.description: After the user grants screen-capture access, DiDi DoKit starts this foreground Service so its color picker can inspect screen pixels.
en.disableEffect: DoKit's color picker will not be able to read colors from the screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户授予屏幕捕获权限后，DiDi DoKit 会启动此前台 Service，让取色器读取屏幕像素。
zh-CN.disableEffect: DoKit 取色器将无法读取屏幕颜色。

en.description: When a developer opens DiDi DoKit's connection scanner, this Activity requests camera access, scans a QR code, and returns its contents to the tool.
en.disableEffect: DoKit's QR-based connection flow will not be available.

zh-CN.description: 开发者打开 DiDi DoKit 连接扫描器时，此 Activity 会请求相机权限、扫描二维码，并将内容返回给工具。
zh-CN.disableEffect: DoKit 的二维码连接流程将无法使用。

en.description: DiDi DoKit uses this translucent Activity to host selected diagnostic panels, such as color-picker settings or the screen-stall monitor.
en.disableEffect: Those DoKit diagnostic panels will not open through this Activity.

zh-CN.description: DiDi DoKit 会用此半透明 Activity 承载选定的诊断面板，例如取色设置或界面卡顿监测。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 这些 DoKit 诊断面板将无法通过此 Activity 打开。

en.description: When DiDi DoKit opens a built-in or custom diagnostic panel, this Activity displays the selected screen, including color-picker settings and the screen-stall monitor.
en.disableEffect: DoKit's built-in and custom diagnostic panels will not open through this Activity.

zh-CN.description: DiDi DoKit 打开内置或自定义诊断面板时，此 Activity 会显示选定页面，包括取色设置和界面卡顿监测。
zh-CN.disableEffect: DoKit 的内置和自定义诊断面板将无法通过此 Activity 打开。

en.description: In older DiDi DoKit releases, this Activity opens the multi-device control tool and shows its host, client, recording, and test-case pages.
en.disableEffect: DoKit's older multi-device testing screens will not open.

zh-CN.description: 在较早版本的 DiDi DoKit 中，此 Activity 会打开多设备控制工具，并显示主机、客户端、录制和测试用例页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: DoKit 旧版多设备测试页面将无法打开。

en.description: In older DiDi DoKit releases, this Activity scans a QR code for the multi-device control tool and returns the code to the tool.
en.disableEffect: QR-based pairing for DoKit's older multi-device controls will not work.

zh-CN.description: 在较早版本的 DiDi DoKit 中，此 Activity 会为多设备控制工具扫描二维码，并将二维码内容返回给工具。
zh-CN.disableEffect: DoKit 旧版多设备控制将无法通过二维码配对。

en.description: In current DiDi DoKit releases, this Activity opens the multi-device control tool and routes to connection history, host, client, or test-case pages.
en.disableEffect: DoKit's multi-device testing screens will not open.

zh-CN.description: 在当前版本的 DiDi DoKit 中，此 Activity 会打开多设备控制工具，并进入连接历史、主机、客户端或测试用例页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: DoKit 的多设备测试页面将无法打开。

en.description: In current DiDi DoKit releases, this Activity scans a QR code for the multi-device control tool and returns the code to the tool.
en.disableEffect: QR-based pairing for DoKit's multi-device controls will not work.

zh-CN.description: 在当前版本的 DiDi DoKit 中，此 Activity 会为多设备控制工具扫描二维码，并将二维码内容返回给工具。
zh-CN.disableEffect: DoKit 的多设备控制将无法通过二维码配对。

en.description: DiDi DoKit's Weex tools start this Activity to display a selected troubleshooting screen.
en.disableEffect: DoKit's Weex troubleshooting screens may not open.

zh-CN.description: DiDi DoKit 的 Weex 工具会启动此 Activity，以显示选定的故障排查页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: DoKit 的 Weex 故障排查页面可能无法打开。

en.description: In a debug build, DiDi DoKit uses this Activity to scan a Weex debugging QR code and connect Weex pages to the server named in the code.
en.disableEffect: Weex pages will not be able to connect to the remote debugging server through DoKit's QR flow.

zh-CN.description: 在调试版本中，DiDi DoKit 会用此 Activity 扫描 Weex 调试二维码，并让 Weex 页面连接到二维码中指定的服务器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Weex 页面将无法通过 DoKit 的二维码流程连接远程调试服务器。

en.description: When Weex remote debugging needs a connection code, this DiDi DoKit Activity scans the QR code and returns its text to the debugging screen.
en.disableEffect: Weex remote debugging will not be able to connect by scanning a QR code.

zh-CN.description: Weex 远程调试需要连接码时，此 DiDi DoKit Activity 会扫描二维码，并将内容返回给调试页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Weex 远程调试将无法通过扫描二维码连接。

en.description: When a DiDi DoKit scanning tool opens, this Activity starts the camera, reads a QR code, and returns its text to the caller.
en.disableEffect: DoKit's QR-based setup and connection tools will not be able to scan codes.

zh-CN.description: DiDi DoKit 扫描工具打开时，此 Activity 会启动相机、读取二维码，并将内容返回给调用方。
zh-CN.disableEffect: DoKit 的二维码设置和连接工具将无法扫描二维码。

en.description: Digitify ScanX opens an identity-card scan when the app starts verification, requests camera access, and guides the user through front and back scans, review, and completion.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot complete the ScanX identity-card scanning and review flow.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动身份核验时，Digitify ScanX 会打开证件扫描页面并请求相机权限，引导用户扫描证件正反面、核对信息并完成流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法完成 ScanX 证件扫描和信息核对流程。

en.description: After Bling-Base catches an app error, this screen shows the error details and saved log, with options to restart or close the app and copy the details.
en.disableEffect: The custom error-details and restart screen will not appear after a crash.

zh-CN.description: Bling-Base 捕获应用错误后，此界面会显示错误详情和日志，并提供重启、关闭应用或复制详情的选项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用崩溃后将不再显示自定义错误详情和重启界面。

en.description: Android starts this private Bling-Base provider with the app; it installs the library's handler for uncaught app errors and its optional crash-details screen.
en.disableEffect: Bling-Base will not record uncaught errors or open its custom crash screen.

zh-CN.description: Android 会在应用启动时运行这个 Bling-Base 私有提供程序，以安装未处理应用错误的处理器和可选崩溃详情界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Bling-Base 将不再记录未处理的错误或打开自定义崩溃界面。

en.description: Ditchoom MQTT Client maintains the app’s configured connections to MQTT message brokers and keeps messaging sessions available to the app.
en.disableEffect: Apps that rely on these MQTT connections may stop sending and receiving broker messages.

zh-CN.description: Ditchoom MQTT Client 负责维护应用配置的 MQTT 消息代理连接，并为应用提供消息会话。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖这些 MQTT 连接的应用可能无法继续收发代理消息。

en.description: Ditchoom MQTT Client runs this service in a separate process so other parts of the app can connect to and manage MQTT brokers through it.
en.disableEffect: The app’s cross-process MQTT connections and messages will stop working.

zh-CN.description: Ditchoom MQTT Client 会在独立进程中运行此服务，供应用的其他部分连接并管理 MQTT 消息代理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用跨进程使用的 MQTT 连接和消息将无法工作。

en.description: Dixa Messenger uses this provider to expose downloaded chat attachments as temporary links so they can be opened or shared by the app.
en.disableEffect: The app may no longer open or share attachments downloaded in Dixa conversations.

zh-CN.description: Dixa Messenger 通过此 Provider 为下载的聊天附件生成临时链接，供应用打开或分享附件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用可能无法打开或分享 Dixa 对话中下载的附件。

en.description: Dixa Messenger opens its in-app customer-support conversation area here, including a specific conversation when the app asks to open one.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to open Dixa’s in-app support conversation screen.

zh-CN.description: Dixa Messenger 会在此页面打开应用内的客户支持对话区，也可按应用请求直接打开指定对话。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开 Dixa 应用内的客户支持对话页面。

en.description: Diyalotech’s BusSewa SDK opens its bus-travel service screen when a host app launches the SDK with its client details.
en.disableEffect: Users will lose the BusSewa flow embedded in the app.

zh-CN.description: 宿主应用使用客户端信息启动 SDK 时，Diyalotech 的 BusSewa SDK 会打开巴士出行服务页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法使用应用内嵌的 BusSewa 流程。

en.description: dLocal Web Drop-In opens a web-based payment step inside the app and returns a payment-tokenization result to the checkout flow.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot finish checkouts that rely on dLocal Web Drop-In.

zh-CN.description: dLocal Web Drop-In 会在应用内打开网页支付步骤，并将支付令牌化结果返回给结账流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法完成依赖 dLocal Web Drop-In 的结账流程。

en.description: DCloud Uni-App’s gallery opens when an app asks to select photos or videos; it lists device media, lets the user choose or crop items, and returns the selection to the calling feature.
en.disableEffect: Photo and video selection through the DCloud gallery will fail, and the calling feature may receive no result.

zh-CN.description: DCloud Uni-App 的相册选择页会在应用请求选择照片或视频时打开；它列出设备中的媒体，允许用户选择或裁剪内容，并把选择结果交回发起功能。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，DCloud 相册功能将无法选择照片或视频，调用功能也可能收不到结果。

en.description: In DCloud Uni-App’s media-selection flow, this screen opens after photos or videos are selected so the user can preview them, adjust the selection, and optionally edit an image before returning the result.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to preview or adjust selected media in the DCloud gallery.

zh-CN.description: 在 DCloud Uni-App 的媒体选择流程中，用户选中照片或视频后会打开此预览页；用户可浏览并调整选择，也可在返回结果前编辑图片。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法在 DCloud 相册中预览或调整所选媒体。

en.description: When an app routes an action or link through it, Dmitriy Morozov's sample library opens this Activity and forwards that action and link to the matching app screen.
en.disableEffect: Actions or links using this handoff will not reach their destination.

zh-CN.description: 应用通过此界面转交某个操作或链接时，Dmitriy Morozov 的示例库会打开此 Activity，并将操作和链接转发给匹配的应用页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过此界面转交的操作或链接将无法到达目标页面。

en.description: Android binds this notification-listener Service after the user grants notification access; the Dmitriy Morozov sample library logs notification arrivals and ranking changes.
en.disableEffect: The sample listener stops observing notification changes, but the app can still post and display notifications.

zh-CN.description: 用户授予通知访问权限后，Android 会绑定此通知监听 Service；Dmitriy Morozov 的示例库会记录新通知和通知排序变化。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 示例监听器将停止观察通知变化，但应用仍可发布和显示通知。

en.description: The DoNews feedback module opens a form where users can describe a problem, attach photos, and submit feedback; it also links to customer service.
en.disableEffect: The feedback form and customer-service route provided by this module will be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: DoNews 反馈模块会打开意见表单，供用户描述问题、附加图片并提交反馈，也提供客服入口。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 该模块提供的意见反馈表单和客服入口将无法使用。

en.description: DoingLab FoodLens starts this Provider with the app and saves the shared app information its image tools use. This prepares FoodLens to load scan images and food photos.
en.disableEffect: FoodLens may fail to load images used by food scans and meal screens.

zh-CN.description: DoingLab FoodLens 会在应用启动时运行此 Provider，并保存图片工具所需的应用信息，为加载扫描图像和食物照片做准备。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，FoodLens 可能无法加载食物扫描和餐食页面所需的图片。

en.description: When a user adds a meal photo through DoingLab FoodLens, this Activity lets them take a new photo or choose one from the gallery and sends the image into the food logging flow.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot start this FoodLens photo flow, so photo recognition and the related meal entry can break.

zh-CN.description: 用户通过 DoingLab FoodLens 添加餐食照片时，此 Activity 可拍摄新照片或从相册选择照片，并将图片交给食物识别和记录流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过 FoodLens 拍照或选图记录餐食，相关识别流程也会中断。

en.description: FoodLens opens this Activity for the daily report; it gathers the day's meal list and shows the score and nutrition feedback.
en.disableEffect: Users lose the FoodLens daily report and its meal feedback screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开每日报告时，FoodLens 会通过此 Activity 汇总当天的餐食列表，并显示评分和营养反馈。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法查看 FoodLens 每日报告和餐食反馈。

en.description: FoodLens opens this Activity when a user edits a meal; it displays the meal's food items and lets them adjust the selected foods and amounts.
en.disableEffect: Editing food items and amounts in this FoodLens meal flow will stop working.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 FoodLens 中编辑餐食时，此 Activity 会显示餐食中的食物条目，并允许调整食物和份量。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法在此 FoodLens 流程中编辑食物条目和份量。

en.description: FoodLens opens this Activity when a user views nutrition coaching feedback; it presents the selected feedback and related nutrition details.
en.disableEffect: Users can no longer open the FoodLens nutrition coaching details.

zh-CN.description: 用户查看营养指导反馈时，FoodLens 会通过此 Activity 展示所选反馈及相关营养信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法查看 FoodLens 的营养指导详情。

en.description: FoodLens opens this Activity for a logged meal; it displays the meal's food entries and photo, and lets the user review notes and nutrition feedback.
en.disableEffect: Users can no longer review meal details and feedback in this FoodLens flow.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开已记录的餐食时，FoodLens 会通过此 Activity 显示食物条目和照片，并提供备注与营养反馈。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法在此 FoodLens 流程中查看餐食详情和反馈。

en.description: After a FoodLens scan finds no food, this Activity offers another camera or gallery attempt, food search, and nutrition label scanning when that option is enabled.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot continue the FoodLens retry flow after a scan finds no food.

zh-CN.description: FoodLens 扫描未识别出食物后，此 Activity 会提供重新拍摄、从相册选图、搜索食物，以及在启用时扫描营养标签的选项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，扫描未识别出食物时，用户将无法继续使用 FoodLens 的重试流程。

en.description: When a user changes a meal's date, time, or meal category, this Activity displays the current values and lets them confirm the edits.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot correct the date, time, or category of a FoodLens meal through this screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户修改餐食的日期、时间或餐别时，此 Activity 会显示当前信息并让用户确认更改。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法通过此页面更正 FoodLens 餐食的日期、时间或餐别。

en.description: When a user edits ingredients for a FoodLens food item, this Activity loads the ingredient list and updates the nutrition summary as amounts change.
en.disableEffect: Editing ingredient amounts and reviewing their updated nutrition summary will stop working.

zh-CN.description: 用户编辑 FoodLens 食物的配料时，此 Activity 会加载配料列表，并在份量变化时更新营养摘要。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法编辑配料份量或查看更新后的营养摘要。

en.description: When a user adds an ingredient, this Activity shows recent ingredients and searches the FoodLens ingredient list as they type.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot search for and select ingredients in this FoodLens flow.

zh-CN.description: 用户添加配料时，此 Activity 会显示最近使用的配料，并根据输入内容搜索 FoodLens 配料列表。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法在此 FoodLens 流程中搜索和选择配料。

en.description: FoodLens opens this Activity when a user creates or edits a saved custom food; it collects nutrition details and can start a label scan.
en.disableEffect: Creating or updating saved custom foods through FoodLens will stop working.

zh-CN.description: 用户创建或编辑已保存的自定义食物时，FoodLens 会通过此 Activity 收集营养信息，也可启动营养标签扫描。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法通过 FoodLens 创建或更新已保存的自定义食物。

en.description: After a nutrition label scan, this Activity shows the scanned image and extracted nutrition values so the user can check and complete them.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot review or complete nutrition information returned from a FoodLens label scan.

zh-CN.description: 扫描营养标签后，此 Activity 会显示扫描图像和提取出的营养数据，供用户检查和补充。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法检查或补充 FoodLens 营养标签扫描得到的数据。

en.description: FoodLens opens this Activity to show the full nutrient list for a selected food item.
en.disableEffect: Users lose the full nutrition details for foods shown by FoodLens.

zh-CN.description: FoodLens 会通过此 Activity 显示所选食物的完整营养成分列表。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法查看 FoodLens 食物的完整营养信息。

en.description: When a user chooses nutrition label scanning, this Activity checks camera access, opens the camera, and returns the scan image and nutrition result to FoodLens.
en.disableEffect: Nutrition label scanning and its return to the FoodLens food entry flow will stop working.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择扫描营养标签时，此 Activity 会检查相机权限、打开相机，并将扫描图像和营养结果返回给 FoodLens。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，营养标签扫描及其返回 FoodLens 食物记录流程的功能将无法使用。

en.description: When a user needs to select foods, this Activity presents FoodLens search, recommendations, and saved custom foods; it can return one or several selected foods.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot search for and select foods through this FoodLens screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户需要选择食物时，此 Activity 会提供 FoodLens 搜索、推荐内容和已保存的自定义食物，并可返回一个或多个所选食物。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法通过此 FoodLens 页面搜索和选择食物。

en.description: The legacy DoingLab FoodLens camera Activity opens the food capture screen. It supports taking a photo, choosing a gallery image, entering food manually, and opening food search.
en.disableEffect: Users lose the legacy FoodLens photo and manual food entry flow.

zh-CN.description: DoingLab FoodLens 旧版相机 Activity 会打开食物拍摄页面，支持拍照、从相册选图、手动录入食物和打开食物搜索。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法使用旧版 FoodLens 拍照或手动录入食物。

en.description: The legacy FoodLens food editor saves a new custom food or updates an existing one with the nutrition details entered by the user.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot create or update custom foods in the legacy FoodLens flow.

zh-CN.description: FoodLens 旧版食物编辑器会将用户填写的营养信息保存为新自定义食物，或用于更新已有食物。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法在旧版 FoodLens 流程中创建或更新自定义食物。

en.description: After legacy FoodLens recognizes a meal photo, this Activity shows candidate foods for the user to confirm or replace, then returns the completed meal as a food log.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot complete the legacy FoodLens photo-based meal logging flow.

zh-CN.description: 旧版 FoodLens 识别餐食照片后，此 Activity 会显示候选食物供用户确认或替换，并将完成的餐食作为记录返回。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法完成旧版 FoodLens 的拍照记录餐食流程。

en.description: FoodLens opens this Activity when a user asks for help; it pages through help images or links supplied by the app, or the SDK's default help list.
en.disableEffect: The FoodLens help pages will no longer be available.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开帮助时，FoodLens 会通过此 Activity 分页展示应用提供的帮助图片或链接；未提供时则使用 SDK 默认内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，FoodLens 帮助页面将无法打开。

en.description: This legacy FoodLens Activity displays nutrition information in summary and detailed views, with tabs to switch between them.
en.disableEffect: Users lose the legacy FoodLens nutrition summary and detailed views.

zh-CN.description: 此 FoodLens 旧版 Activity 以摘要和详细视图展示营养信息，并提供标签页供用户切换。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法查看 FoodLens 旧版营养摘要和详细信息。

en.description: This legacy FoodLens Activity handles food search and saved custom foods, including finding, adding, updating, or deleting a custom food.
en.disableEffect: Food search and custom food management in the legacy FoodLens flow will stop working.

zh-CN.description: 此 FoodLens 旧版 Activity 负责食物搜索和已保存的自定义食物，并可查找、添加、更新或删除自定义食物。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，旧版 FoodLens 流程中的食物搜索和自定义食物管理将无法使用。

en.description: At app startup, DoingLab FoodLens saves shared app information used by its screens and clears leftover scan images from earlier sessions. This prepares image and resource access for the SDK's UI.
en.disableEffect: FoodLens screens may fail when they need this saved information, and old scan images will not be cleaned up.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，DoingLab FoodLens 会保存界面所需的应用信息，并清理之前会话遗留的扫描图像，为 SDK 界面准备图片和资源访问。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，FoodLens 页面可能无法取得所需信息，旧扫描图像也不会被清理。

en.description: When its API monitor is started with a monitoring address, Don Chakkappan's client runs this foreground Service and forwards captured API-call records to the monitoring server.
en.disableEffect: API monitoring and captured-call uploads stop; ordinary app features remain available.

zh-CN.description: Don Chakkappan 的 API 监控客户端收到监控地址并启动监控后，会运行此前台 Service，将捕获的 API 调用记录转发到监控服务器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: API 监控和调用记录上传会停止，应用的普通功能仍可使用。

en.description: The Donking Liang image selector opens this screen when a chosen photo needs cropping. It crops the photo to the requested shape, saves the result, and returns it to the app.
en.disableEffect: Apps that need a cropped photo cannot finish that image-selection step if this screen is disabled.

zh-CN.description: Donking Liang 图片选择库会在用户需要裁剪所选照片时打开此页面。它按请求的比例裁剪并保存照片，再把结果交还给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，依赖裁剪结果的图片选择流程无法完成。

en.description: The Donking Liang image selector uses this alternate page to preview supplied photos in a swipeable gallery. The Yinhe build displays the photos; several other bundled versions declare the page but leave its gallery empty.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it removes this alternate preview page; the main photo picker remains available.

zh-CN.description: Donking Liang 图片选择库会用此备用页面滑动预览已选照片。Yinhe 版本会显示照片；其他几个打包版本虽然声明了此页面，但没有初始化图片列表。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，这个备用预览页面无法打开，主图片选择器仍可使用。

en.description: The Donking Liang image selector shows photo folders on the device, lets people choose one or more photos, and can open the camera. It returns the chosen photo paths to the app.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot open this picker to choose or capture photos if it is disabled.

zh-CN.description: Donking Liang 图片选择库会显示设备上的照片文件夹，让用户选择一张或多张照片，也可以打开相机。它会把所选照片的路径交还给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用无法通过此选择器挑选或拍摄照片。

en.description: The Donking Liang image selector displays supplied photo paths in a swipeable full-screen gallery. VHall chat also opens it when a viewer taps an image message.
en.disableEffect: People cannot open these full-screen image previews from the image selector or VHall chat if it is disabled.

zh-CN.description: Donking Liang 图片选择库会用可滑动的全屏图库显示传入的照片路径。用户点击聊天图片消息时，VHall 聊天也会打开此页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法从图片选择库或 VHall 聊天中打开这些全屏图片预览。

en.description: After photos are selected, the Donking Liang image selector opens this page to preview them. People can swipe between photos, change which ones are selected, and confirm the list returned to the app.
en.disableEffect: The photo-selection flow cannot preview and confirm its chosen images if this page is disabled.

zh-CN.description: 选好照片后，Donking Liang 图片选择库会打开此页面供用户预览。用户可以滑动查看、调整所选照片，并确认要交给应用的照片列表。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，图片选择流程无法在此预览并确认所选照片。

en.description: The Donking Liang image selector uses this provider to give the camera and other parts of the app temporary access to selected or captured image files.
en.disableEffect: Camera capture and image handoffs that use this provider may fail if it is disabled.

zh-CN.description: Donking Liang 图片选择库通过此 Provider，让相机和应用的其他部分临时读取已选或拍摄的图片文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，使用此 Provider 的拍照和图片传递流程可能失败。

en.description: Android starts this Doordeck Headless SDK Provider with the app; it saves shared app information for later use by the SDK.
en.disableEffect: Doordeck operations may fail because the SDK will not receive the app information initialized here.

zh-CN.description: Android 会在应用启动时运行此 Doordeck Headless SDK Provider，并保存 SDK 后续使用的应用信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Doordeck SDK 无法取得在此初始化的应用信息，其功能可能无法正常运行。

en.description: When a Dosh cash-back notification is opened, this activity displays the notification's title, details, and Dosh logo.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to view cash-back details from Dosh notifications.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 Dosh 返现通知时，此界面会显示通知标题、详情和 Dosh 标志。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法查看 Dosh 通知中的返现详情。

en.description: When users open the Dosh PoweredBy setup checklist, this activity loads and displays the available setup checks.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to open the Dosh rewards setup checklist.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 Dosh PoweredBy 设置清单时，此界面会加载并显示可用的设置检查项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开 Dosh 奖励功能的设置清单。

en.description: When the app opens the Dosh PoweredBy area, this activity hosts Dosh offers and account pages and routes supplied Dosh links to their destination.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to open Dosh offers and rewards account pages through the app.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开 Dosh PoweredBy 区域时，此界面会承载 Dosh 优惠和账户页面，并将传入的 Dosh 链接导航到对应页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过应用打开 Dosh 优惠和奖励账户页面。

en.description: When opened, this Dosh PoweredBy screen previews the SDK's theme fonts with labeled examples.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to open the Dosh theme details and font preview screen.

zh-CN.description: 打开后，此 Dosh PoweredBy 界面会通过带标签的示例预览 SDK 主题字体。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开 Dosh 主题详情和字体预览界面。

en.description: During an exam recording, the Alemira Proctor (Examus) foreground service coordinates front-camera, screen, and audio capture and uploads the recording.
en.disableEffect: Exam camera and screen recording and their upload cannot run through Alemira Proctor.

zh-CN.description: 考试录制期间，Alemira Proctor（Examus）前台服务会协调前置摄像头、屏幕和音频采集，并上传录制内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Alemira Proctor 将无法进行考试摄像头和屏幕录制，也无法上传录制内容。

en.description: When the app requests an exam-readiness check, the Alemira Proctor (Examus) foreground service runs the selected camera, microphone, screen-capture, or network check and returns its result.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot run the selected proctoring readiness check, which may prevent an exam session from being validated.

zh-CN.description: 本应用请求考试准备检查时，Alemira Proctor（Examus）前台服务会运行所选的摄像头、麦克风、屏幕采集或网络检查，并返回结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 本应用将无法运行所选的监考准备检查，考试场次可能无法完成验证。

en.description: Dounine TMSDK starts this Service during SDK initialization and schedules a regular heartbeat. While the app is open, it sends status updates to the TMSDK server.
en.disableEffect: TMSDK stops sending regular status updates to its server.
