zh-CN.description: Dounine TMSDK 会在初始化时启动此 Service 并定期发送心跳；应用打开时，它会向 TMSDK 服务器发送状态更新。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，TMSDK 将停止向服务器发送定期状态更新。

en.description: Android starts this AutoPrefs Provider with the app; it saves the app information that AutoPrefs uses to open and save the app's preferences.
en.disableEffect: App features that use AutoPrefs may no longer be able to read or save their settings.

zh-CN.description: Android 会在应用启动时运行 AutoPrefs Provider，并保存 AutoPrefs 读取和保存应用偏好设置所需的信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，使用 AutoPrefs 的应用功能可能无法读取或保存设置。

en.description: Drant's Doctor SDK opens a photo viewer when a user taps an image in a medical-record or attachment list. It shows the selected images one at a time and lets the user move between them.
en.disableEffect: Images in Drant's medical-record and attachment flows can no longer be previewed.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击病历或附件列表中的图片时，Drant Doctor SDK 会打开图片查看页面。它逐张显示所选图片，并允许用户切换图片。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Drant 病历和附件流程中的图片将无法预览。

en.description: Drant's Doctor SDK opens this page for selected photos and other attachments. It shows upload progress and completion, and tapping an image opens its preview.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot follow these uploads or preview the selected images from this list.

zh-CN.description: Drant Doctor SDK 会为选中的照片和其他附件打开此页面。它显示上传进度和完成状态，点击图片还可打开预览。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在此列表中查看上传进度或预览所选图片。

en.description: When a regular phone call connects during a Drant consultation, this receiver reports the change so the SDK can end its video call and cancel the current transfer.
en.disableEffect: A cellular call may no longer automatically end an active Drant call or cancel its file transfer.

zh-CN.description: Drant 问诊期间接通普通电话时，此 Receiver 会上报状态变化，使 SDK 结束视频通话并取消当前传输。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 接通手机电话时，Drant 通话可能不再自动结束，文件传输也可能不会取消。

en.description: When Drant's call flow supplies a video stream, this screen plays it full-screen, repeats it, and offers an end control.
en.disableEffect: The supplied video stream cannot be played through Drant.

zh-CN.description: Drant 通话流程提供视频流时，此页面会全屏循环播放，并提供结束操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 Drant 播放该视频流。

en.description: The Drant Doctor SDK uses this file-sharing provider to create permission-limited links for photos captured or shared through the app.
en.disableEffect: Capturing, opening, or sharing files in Drant's attachment flows may fail.

zh-CN.description: Drant Doctor SDK 使用此文件 Provider 为应用拍摄或分享的照片创建受权限限制的链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Drant 附件流程中的文件拍摄、打开或分享可能失败。

en.description: When users place or accept a Drant one-to-one video call, this screen starts the live audio and video connection and shows the call controls.
en.disableEffect: Drant's one-to-one video-call screen will not open, so that call feature will be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: 用户发起或接听 Drant 一对一视频通话时，此页面会建立实时音视频连接并显示通话操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Drant 一对一视频通话页面将无法打开，该通话功能也将无法使用。

en.description: When Drant starts a group consultation, this screen presents the multi-person video room and call controls, with access to shared attachments.
en.disableEffect: Drant group video consultations cannot be started.

zh-CN.description: Drant 启动群组问诊时，此页面会显示多人视频房间和通话操作，并提供共享附件入口。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Drant 群组视频问诊将无法启动。

en.description: Dream11's authentication SDK opens this screen for web-based sign-in; it loads the login page and returns the result to the app.
en.disableEffect: Apps relying on this Dream11 web sign-in route may no longer let users log in.

zh-CN.description: Dream11 身份验证 SDK 会通过这个界面进行网页登录；它加载登录页面并将结果返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖 Dream11 网页登录流程的应用可能无法再让用户登录。

en.description: When an app requests Dream11 sign-in, this screen prepares the authorization request, opens the Dream11 app or web login, and passes the result back to the app.
en.disableEffect: Apps relying on Dream11 authentication may not be able to complete sign-in.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求 Dream11 登录时，这个界面会准备授权请求、打开 Dream11 应用或网页登录，并将结果返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖 Dream11 身份验证的应用可能无法完成登录。

en.description: While DriveBuddy's automatic driving detection is enabled, activity recognition updates arrive here. The service forwards likely vehicle activity to the trip monitor so it can detect a drive.
en.disableEffect: DriveBuddy can miss the movement signals it uses to detect trips.

zh-CN.description: 启用 DriveBuddy 自动驾驶检测后，活动识别更新会交给此 Service 处理。它会将可能的乘车活动转给行程监测流程，用于识别驾驶行程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，DriveBuddy 可能会漏掉用于识别行程的活动信号。

en.description: In older DriveBuddy releases, activity recognition results are delivered to this service and forwarded to the trip tracker.
en.disableEffect: Automatic trip detection in those DriveBuddy releases loses its activity recognition results.

zh-CN.description: 在较旧的 DriveBuddy 版本中，活动识别结果会交给此 Service，再转发给行程追踪流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，这些 DriveBuddy 版本将无法获得自动识别行程所需的活动结果。

en.description: DriveBuddy schedules this Receiver with an hourly alarm; each alarm refreshes the SDK's network setup and requests an access token.
en.disableEffect: DriveBuddy may not refresh the token it needs to send driving data to its service.

zh-CN.description: DriveBuddy 会每小时通过闹钟触发此 Receiver；每次触发都会刷新 SDK 网络设置并申请访问令牌。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，DriveBuddy 可能无法刷新向其服务发送驾驶数据所需的令牌。

en.description: An hourly alarm in an older DriveBuddy release runs this Receiver; it uploads stored sensor and log files and briefly shows a timestamp on screen.
en.disableEffect: The older DriveBuddy upload flow will stop sending those stored files.

zh-CN.description: 旧版 DriveBuddy 会通过每小时闹钟运行此 Receiver；它会上传保存的传感器和日志文件，并短暂显示时间。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，旧版 DriveBuddy 上传流程将停止发送这些已保存的文件。

en.description: DriveBuddy starts this foreground service to track a drive. While active, it requests activity and location updates, records motion and location events, and shows an in-drive notification.
en.disableEffect: DriveBuddy will stop detecting and recording drives in the background, which can break trip history or driving assessments that the app provides.

zh-CN.description: DriveBuddy 会启动此前台 Service 来追踪驾驶行程。运行期间，它会请求活动和位置更新、记录运动与位置数据，并显示行程中的通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，DriveBuddy 将无法在后台识别和记录驾驶行程，应用提供的行程历史或驾驶评估也可能受影响。

en.description: When a monitored geofence is exited, DriveBuddy queues this service to process the event and start its trip monitor.
en.disableEffect: DriveBuddy can miss the geofence signal that starts automatic trip tracking.

zh-CN.description: 离开受监测的地理围栏时，DriveBuddy 会将事件交给此 Service 处理并启动行程监测。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，DriveBuddy 可能会漏掉用于启动自动行程追踪的地理围栏信号。

en.description: DriveBuddy starts this short-lived service while setting up trip detection; it registers an exit boundary around the last known location and then stops.
en.disableEffect: DriveBuddy cannot set this location boundary, so geofence-based trip startup may not work.

zh-CN.description: DriveBuddy 设置行程检测时会短暂启动此 Service；它会围绕最近已知位置注册离开边界，然后停止运行。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，DriveBuddy 无法设置此位置边界，基于地理围栏启动行程的功能可能失效。

en.description: Google Play services sends geofence alerts to this Receiver, which passes each event to DriveBuddy's background trip processing.
en.disableEffect: DriveBuddy will not process geofence events used to begin trip tracking.

zh-CN.description: Google Play 服务会将地理围栏提醒发送给此 Receiver，由它转交 DriveBuddy 后台处理行程事件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，DriveBuddy 将无法处理用于开始行程追踪的地理围栏事件。

en.description: Google Play services delivers requested location results to this service; it passes the latest location into DriveBuddy's active trip recorder.
en.disableEffect: Recorded drives may be missing location updates used to build trip routes.

zh-CN.description: Google Play 服务会将请求的位置结果交给此 Service；它会把最新位置传给 DriveBuddy 正在运行的行程记录流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，驾驶记录可能缺少用于生成行程路线的位置更新。

en.description: During older DriveBuddy setup, this foreground service registers vehicle activity transitions. When the phone detects entering or leaving a vehicle, it starts or stops drive tracking.
en.disableEffect: DriveBuddy's automatic trip start and stop detection may not work.

zh-CN.description: 旧版 DriveBuddy 设置期间，此前台 Service 会注册车辆活动转换；手机检测到进入或离开车辆时，它会启动或停止驾驶追踪。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，DriveBuddy 的自动行程开始和结束检测可能无法工作。

en.description: When Google Activity Recognition reports a recent vehicle transition, this Receiver forwards it to DriveBuddy's trip tracker so it can start or stop a drive.
en.disableEffect: DriveBuddy can miss vehicle transitions and record trip boundaries incorrectly.

zh-CN.description: Google 活动识别报告近期车辆活动转换时，此 Receiver 会将其转交 DriveBuddy 行程追踪流程，用于开始或结束驾驶记录。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，DriveBuddy 可能漏掉车辆活动转换，导致行程边界记录不准确。

en.description: When DriveBuddy has queued trip, crash, or log files, it starts this foreground service to send sensor files and related records to its server when the network and an access token are available.
en.disableEffect: Trip and crash records may remain on the device instead of reaching DriveBuddy's service.

zh-CN.description: DriveBuddy 有待上传的行程、碰撞或日志文件时，会启动此前台 Service；网络和访问令牌可用后，它会将传感器文件及相关记录发送到服务器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，行程和碰撞记录可能留在设备上，无法发送到 DriveBuddy 服务。

en.description: When Android reports a Wi-Fi state change and a connection becomes available, this Receiver checks DriveBuddy setup and queues stored files for upload.
en.disableEffect: DriveBuddy will miss this automatic setup and upload step after Wi-Fi reconnects.

zh-CN.description: Android 报告 Wi-Fi 状态变化并恢复连接时，此 Receiver 会检查 DriveBuddy 设置并安排上传已保存的文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Wi-Fi 重新连接时 DriveBuddy 将无法自动执行此设置和文件上传流程。

en.description: When DriveMetaData or app code queries the install-referrer path, this provider checks Facebook, Instagram, and Facebook Lite referrer sources, saves campaign details it can read, and returns an available referrer record.
en.disableEffect: DriveMetaData can no longer provide these social install-attribution details to its tracking code.

zh-CN.description: DriveMetaData 或应用代码查询安装来源路径时，此 Provider 会检查 Facebook、Instagram 和 Facebook Lite 的来源信息，保存可读取的推广数据，并返回可用的安装来源记录。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，DriveMetaData 将无法向其追踪代码提供这些社交平台的安装来源信息。

en.description: When Drivemode TimberLorry's log-collection SDK receives log records for later collection, this private Provider stores them in the app's local database.
en.disableEffect: Blocking it prevents TimberLorry from saving or reading pending logs, while the host app's own features continue to work.

zh-CN.description: Drivemode TimberLorry 日志收集 SDK 收到待收集的日志记录时，会通过这个私有 Provider 将它们保存在应用本地数据库中。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，TimberLorry 无法保存或读取待收集日志，但宿主应用本身的功能不受影响。

en.description: Android starts this Drivemode TimberLorry log-collection service in a background sync process when the scheduled job runs; it collects the app's pending logs.
en.disableEffect: Blocking it stops TimberLorry's scheduled log collection, while the host app's features continue to work.

zh-CN.description: Android 定期执行 Drivemode TimberLorry 日志收集任务时，会在后台同步进程中启动此 Service，由它收集应用中待处理的日志。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，TimberLorry 的计划日志收集不会运行，但宿主应用的功能仍可使用。

en.description: Android connects to this Drivemode TimberLorry service while setting up scheduled log syncing, making the SDK's log-collection job available to the system.
en.disableEffect: Blocking it prevents TimberLorry's sync account from being set up for log collection, but does not affect the host app's own features.

zh-CN.description: Android 配置 Drivemode TimberLorry 定期日志同步时会连接此 Service，使日志收集任务能够交由系统调度。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，TimberLorry 无法设置日志同步账户，但宿主应用本身的功能不受影响。

en.description: DroidKit Pickers opens this Activity when the host app requests file selection; it browses folders and returns the files the user selects.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot use this picker to choose files for importing or attaching.

zh-CN.description: 宿主应用请求选择文件时，DroidKit Pickers 会打开此 Activity 浏览文件夹，并将用户选中的文件交回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，应用无法通过此选择器挑选要导入或附加的文件。

en.description: DroidKit Pickers opens this Activity when the host app requests a location; it shows a searchable map and nearby places and returns the selected place and coordinates.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot use this screen to select a map location.

zh-CN.description: 宿主应用请求选择位置时，DroidKit Pickers 会打开此 Activity 显示可搜索的地图和附近地点，并返回所选地点及坐标。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，应用无法通过此界面选择地图位置。

en.description: The Dropbox Android SDK opens this screen when an app starts Dropbox account authorization, handing the user to the Dropbox app or web sign-in and receiving the return. The GroundUpWorks Wings Dropbox integration uses it to connect an account for photo sharing.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot link or reauthorize a Dropbox account, so Wings photo sharing to Dropbox may fail.

zh-CN.description: 应用发起 Dropbox 账户授权时，Dropbox Android SDK 会打开此页面，将用户带到 Dropbox 应用或网页完成登录，并接收授权返回结果。GroundUpWorks Wings 的 Dropbox 集成通过它连接用于分享照片的账户。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法连接或重新授权 Dropbox 账户，因此通过 Wings 分享照片到 Dropbox 可能失败。

en.description: When the Livery log-report library is asked to upload diagnostics, this service checks for crash reports, packages them with logs, and sends the archive through the configured uploader.
en.disableEffect: Crash reports and accompanying logs collected by Livery will remain on the device instead of being uploaded.

zh-CN.description: Livery 日志报告库收到上传诊断信息的请求后，此服务会查找崩溃报告，将其与日志打包，并通过已配置的上传程序发送。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Livery 收集的崩溃报告和相关日志会留在设备上，不再上传。

en.description: DSly Android WebLib declares this support-library FileProvider to expose app files as content links for external file handoffs.
en.disableEffect: Any file handoff that relies on this provider will fail.

zh-CN.description: DSly Android WebLib 声明了此 Support Library FileProvider，用于通过内容链接向外部应用传递应用文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此 Provider 的文件传递功能将失效。

en.description: When an app opens an HTTPS link with the VIEW action, DSly Android WebLib displays it in an X5 web screen with page navigation, progress, and video support.
en.disableEffect: Links routed to this screen will no longer open inside the app.

zh-CN.description: 应用通过 VIEW 操作打开 HTTPS 链接时，DSly Android WebLib 会在 X5 网页界面中显示内容，并提供页面导航、加载进度和视频支持。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 转交给此页面的链接将无法在应用内打开。

en.description: The Ant Digital identity-verification SDK opens this form when passport verification uses manual entry; users enter the passport number, birth date, and expiry date before the NFC step. Disabling it blocks that verification route.
en.disableEffect: Passport verification in manual-entry mode cannot proceed to the NFC read.

zh-CN.description: 护照核验采用手动录入时，Ant Digital 身份核验 SDK 会打开此表单，让用户填写护照号码、出生日期和有效期，然后进入 NFC 读取。禁用后，这条核验流程无法继续。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 手动录入模式下的护照核验无法进入 NFC 读取步骤。

en.description: The Ant Digital identity-verification SDK opens this screen for NFC document checks; it guides users through positioning a passport or ID card and reading its chip. Disabling it prevents the SDK from completing that document check.
en.disableEffect: Passport and ID-card verification that requires NFC cannot read the document or return its result.

zh-CN.description: Ant Digital 身份核验 SDK 会在需要 NFC 证件核验时打开此界面，引导用户放置护照或身份证并读取芯片。禁用后，SDK 无法完成这项证件核验。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要 NFC 的护照或身份证核验将无法读取证件并返回结果。

en.description: The Ant Digital OCR SDK opens this landscape screen when an identity-document scan requires the wide layout; it captures and reads the document image. Disabling it prevents that scan from completing.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot complete document OCR in the landscape verification flow.

zh-CN.description: Ant Digital OCR SDK 会在证件扫描需要横屏布局时打开此界面，用于拍摄并识读证件图像。禁用后，该横屏核验流程无法完成。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法完成横屏核验流程中的证件识读。

en.description: The Ant Digital OCR SDK opens this portrait screen for identity-document scans on the standard layout; it captures and reads the document image. Disabling it prevents that scan from completing.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot complete document OCR in the portrait verification flow.

zh-CN.description: Ant Digital OCR SDK 会在标准竖屏布局下打开此界面，用于拍摄并识读证件图像。禁用后，该竖屏核验流程无法完成。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法完成竖屏核验流程中的证件识读。

en.description: In the older Ant Digital OCR flow, this screen explains how to photograph the back of an identity document and opens the camera when the user continues. After the photo is accepted, the flow proceeds to face verification.
en.disableEffect: The back side of a document cannot be captured in this OCR flow, so verification may not finish.

zh-CN.description: 在较早版本的 Ant Digital OCR 流程中，此界面说明如何拍摄证件背面，用户继续后会打开相机。照片确认后，流程进入人脸核验。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 此 OCR 流程无法拍摄证件背面，核验可能无法完成。

en.description: In the older Ant Digital OCR SDK, this general screen presents document-capture guidance and handles camera permission and photo review; the normal flow opens separate front- and back-side guides. Disabling this entry prevents the general screen from opening directly.
en.disableEffect: Only direct launches of this general guide are blocked; the SDK's separate front- and back-side guide screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: 在较早版本的 Ant Digital OCR SDK 中，此通用界面展示证件拍摄说明，并处理相机权限和照片确认；常规流程会打开独立的正面和背面指引页。禁用后，无法直接打开此通用界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用只会阻止直接打开此通用指引页，SDK 独立的正面和背面指引页仍可使用。

en.description: After document photos are accepted, the older Ant Digital OCR flow shows this transition screen and then opens the configured face-verification step. Disabling it interrupts the document-to-face verification handoff.
en.disableEffect: The OCR flow cannot continue from document capture to its required face-verification step.

zh-CN.description: 证件照片确认后，较早版本的 Ant Digital OCR 流程会显示此过渡界面，随后打开配置好的人脸核验步骤。禁用后，证件采集到人脸核验的衔接会中断。
zh-CN.disableEffect: OCR 流程无法从证件拍摄继续进入所需的人脸核验步骤。

en.description: The older Ant Digital OCR flow opens this screen before capturing the front of an identity document; continuing opens the camera, and the accepted photo advances the document flow. Disabling it blocks that capture step.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot begin the front-side document capture in this OCR flow.

zh-CN.description: 较早版本的 Ant Digital OCR 流程会在拍摄证件正面前打开此界面；用户继续后进入相机，确认照片后流程继续。禁用后，正面拍摄步骤无法开始。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法在此 OCR 流程中开始拍摄证件正面。

en.description: The Ant Digital OCR SDK opens this camera screen from its document guides to capture the front or back of an ID or passport and return the selected image. Disabling it stops document-photo capture.
en.disableEffect: The required identity-document photo cannot be captured or returned to the verification flow.

zh-CN.description: Ant Digital OCR SDK 会从证件指引页打开此相机界面，拍摄身份证或护照正面、背面，并把选定图像返回流程。禁用后，证件照片无法采集。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 核验流程无法拍摄证件照片或接收照片结果。

en.description: When Ant Digital face verification enters its fallback authorization route, this browsable screen lets the user exit or continue with Alipay-based verification and returns the outcome. Disabling it removes that authentication path.
en.disableEffect: Users may be unable to complete the Alipay fallback verification route.

zh-CN.description: Ant Digital 人脸核验进入备用授权流程时，此可浏览界面允许用户退出或继续使用支付宝核验，并返回处理结果。禁用后，这条身份验证路径会失效。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户可能无法完成支付宝备用核验流程。

en.description: The Ant Digital face-verification SDK uses this landscape loading screen while preparing a face check, requesting camera access, loading verification models, and showing any required authorization page. Disabling it can stop the landscape verification flow before capture.
en.disableEffect: Landscape face verification may fail before the face check begins.

zh-CN.description: Ant Digital 人脸核验 SDK 会在横屏流程中使用此加载界面，准备核验、申请相机权限、加载核验模型并显示所需授权页面。禁用后，横屏核验可能在拍摄前中断。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 横屏人脸核验可能无法在采集前完成启动。

en.description: This is the Ant Digital face-verification SDK's opaque landscape loading screen; the manifest marks it as a compatibility variant for Android 8.0. It prepares the face check, camera permission, verification models, and authorization page.
en.disableEffect: The landscape compatibility route may not be able to start face verification.

zh-CN.description: 这是 Ant Digital 人脸核验 SDK 的横屏不透明加载界面；清单将其标记为 Android 8.0 兼容版本。它会准备人脸核验、相机权限、核验模型和授权页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 横屏兼容流程可能无法启动人脸核验。

en.description: The Ant Digital face-verification SDK uses this portrait loading screen while preparing a face check, requesting camera access, loading verification models, and showing any required authorization page. Disabling it can stop the portrait verification flow before capture.
en.disableEffect: Portrait face verification may fail before the face check begins.

zh-CN.description: Ant Digital 人脸核验 SDK 会在竖屏流程中使用此加载界面，准备核验、申请相机权限、加载核验模型并显示所需授权页面。禁用后，竖屏核验可能在拍摄前中断。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 竖屏人脸核验可能无法在采集前完成启动。

en.description: This is the Ant Digital face-verification SDK's opaque portrait loading screen; the manifest marks it as a compatibility variant for Android 8.0. It prepares the face check, camera permission, verification models, and authorization page.
en.disableEffect: The portrait compatibility route may not be able to start face verification.

zh-CN.description: 这是 Ant Digital 人脸核验 SDK 的竖屏不透明加载界面；清单将其标记为 Android 8.0 兼容版本。它会准备人脸核验、相机权限、核验模型和授权页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 竖屏兼容流程可能无法启动人脸核验。

en.description: The Ant Digital face-verification SDK opens this landscape camera Activity when the verification settings or device layout call for landscape mode; it runs the live-face check and returns the result. Disabling it blocks that face-verification route.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot complete landscape face verification.

zh-CN.description: Ant Digital 人脸核验 SDK 会在核验设置或设备布局要求横屏时打开此相机 Activity，执行活体人脸检查并返回结果。禁用后，这条人脸核验路径会被阻断。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法完成横屏人脸核验。

en.description: The Ant Digital face-verification SDK opens this portrait camera Activity for its standard live-face check and returns the result to the calling flow. Disabling it blocks portrait face verification.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot complete portrait face verification.

zh-CN.description: Ant Digital 人脸核验 SDK 会在标准竖屏流程中打开此相机 Activity，执行活体人脸检查并把结果返回调用流程。禁用后，竖屏人脸核验会被阻断。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法完成竖屏人脸核验。

en.description: During an Aliyun WishVerify real-person check, this background service starts or stops screen and voice evidence recording and returns the recordings to the verification flow.
en.disableEffect: The verification flow cannot collect and return required screen and voice evidence, so checks that rely on it will fail.

zh-CN.description: 进行阿里云 WishVerify 实人认证时，此后台服务会按流程启动或停止屏幕和语音证据录制，并将录制结果交回认证流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 认证流程无法收集并返回所需的屏幕和语音证据，依赖这些证据的认证将无法完成。

en.description: Dudu Ads Library opens a web link supplied by the app inside an in-app page with a title bar and a close control.
en.disableEffect: Links that use this Dudu Ads page will no longer open inside the app.

zh-CN.description: Dudu Ads 广告库会在应用内页面中打开应用提供的网页链接，并显示标题栏和关闭按钮。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此 Dudu Ads 页面打开的链接将无法在应用内显示。

en.description: The Duitku Android payment SDK opens this Activity during checkout, requests a transaction, displays Duitku's payment page in the app, and handles the payment response.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot complete Duitku checkout or receive its transaction result.

zh-CN.description: Duitku Android 支付 SDK 在结账时打开此 Activity，请求交易并在应用内显示 Duitku 支付页面，随后处理支付结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，用户无法完成 Duitku 结账或获取交易结果。

en.description: The Duitku Android payment SDK opens this Activity when checkout begins; it loads available payment methods and opens the payment page after the user chooses one.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot choose a Duitku payment method to start checkout.

zh-CN.description: Duitku Android 支付 SDK 在结账开始时打开此 Activity，获取并显示可用付款方式；用户选定后会进入支付页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，用户无法选择 Duitku 付款方式并开始结账。

en.description: Duoku Single SDK opens this account page when the game's Duoku login flow requests account interaction.
en.disableEffect: Duoku account sign-in and account-management flows that use this page will fail.

zh-CN.description: 游戏的多酷登录流程需要账号操作时，多酷 Single SDK 会打开此账号页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此页面的多酷账号登录和管理流程将失败。

en.description: Duoku GamePlus binds this background Service when a game requests queued game downloads. It tracks progress and responds to network changes so downloads can pause or resume.
en.disableEffect: Game packages and updates managed by Duoku GamePlus will no longer download; the host game's own play features remain available.

zh-CN.description: 游戏请求排队下载时，多酷 GamePlus 会绑定此后台 Service。它跟踪下载进度，并根据网络变化暂停或恢复下载。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 多酷 GamePlus 管理的游戏包和更新将无法下载，宿主游戏本身仍可运行。

en.description: Duoku GamePlus opens this screen when its account or download flow requests phone or file access, then returns the permission result to the SDK.
en.disableEffect: Duoku account or download steps that require these permissions can fail.

zh-CN.description: 多酷 GamePlus 的账号或下载流程请求读取手机信息或文件时，会打开此权限页面并将结果返回 SDK。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要这些权限的多酷账号或下载步骤可能失败。

en.description: Duoku's Baidu-backed push SDK receives message, delivery, and notification-click callbacks, then forwards them to the game or opens the requested page.
en.disableEffect: Duoku push messages and notification actions will stop working; the host game remains available.

zh-CN.description: 多酷使用的百度推送 SDK 会接收消息、送达和通知点击回调，再转交给游戏或打开指定页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 多酷推送消息和通知操作将停止，宿主游戏仍可使用。

en.description: Duoku Single SDK opens the requested GamePlus platform screen in its shared page window when a game invokes that screen.
en.disableEffect: Duoku platform screens that use this Activity, including account or service pages, will not open.

zh-CN.description: 游戏调用多酷平台页面时，多酷 Single SDK 会在此页面窗口中展示所请求的 GamePlus 内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此 Activity 的多酷平台页面（包括账号或服务页面）将无法打开。

en.description: Duoku Single SDK opens a turntable draw and draw-history screen when the game requests a lottery event. It loads draw counts, entries, and results from the Duoku service.
en.disableEffect: Players will lose access to the Duoku draw event and any game rewards delivered through it.

zh-CN.description: 游戏请求抽奖活动时，多酷 Single SDK 会打开转盘和抽奖记录页面，并从多酷服务加载抽奖次数、记录和结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 玩家将无法使用多酷抽奖活动，也无法领取通过该活动发放的游戏奖励。

en.description: Duoku GamePlus opens its recommended-games page or its download and installed-game update manager when requested.
en.disableEffect: Duoku game recommendations and its separate game-download/update pages will not open; the host game remains playable.

zh-CN.description: 收到请求时，多酷 GamePlus 会打开游戏推荐页面，或打开下载与已安装游戏更新管理页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 多酷游戏推荐及独立的游戏下载、更新页面将无法打开，宿主游戏仍可游玩。

en.description: Duoku GamePlus displays a download prompt when a player starts downloading a recommended game or package.
en.disableEffect: The Duoku download prompt and the game-package download it starts will not work.

zh-CN.description: 玩家开始下载推荐游戏或安装包时，多酷 GamePlus 会显示下载提示。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 多酷下载提示以及由此启动的游戏包下载将无法使用。

en.description: Duoku Single SDK loads a real-name verification page when its game-account or cashier flow requires an identity check.
en.disableEffect: Real-name checks required by the Duoku game platform or cashier will fail, which can prevent account access or purchases.

zh-CN.description: 多酷游戏账号或收银流程要求身份核验时，多酷 Single SDK 会加载实名认证页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 多酷游戏平台或收银流程要求的实名认证将无法完成，账号访问或购买可能受阻。

en.description: Duoku's anti-addiction service opens this screen when age or play-time rules block game entry. It handles real-name results and lets the SDK resume or close the game.
en.disableEffect: Required age and anti-addiction checks can be bypassed or left incomplete, and the game may not be allowed to continue through the Duoku platform.

zh-CN.description: 年龄或游戏时长规则阻止进入游戏时，多酷防沉迷服务会打开此页面。它处理实名结果，并让 SDK 恢复或关闭游戏。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 必要的年龄与防沉迷核验可能无法完成，游戏也可能无法通过多酷平台继续运行。

en.description: Duoku GamePlus shows this error page when a game download cannot continue because of a network problem.
en.disableEffect: The Duoku download error and retry screen will not appear; the host game's own features remain available.

zh-CN.description: 游戏下载因网络问题无法继续时，多酷 GamePlus 会显示此错误页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 多酷下载错误和重试页面将不再显示，宿主游戏自身功能仍可使用。

en.description: Duoku's download SDK receives download-state broadcasts and updates the status of queued packages.
en.disableEffect: Download progress and completion updates for Duoku-managed packages may stop.

zh-CN.description: 多酷下载 SDK 会接收下载状态广播，并更新排队安装包的状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 多酷管理的安装包可能无法更新下载进度和完成状态。

en.description: Duoku GamePlus listens for Android package-added and package-removed events to update the installed status of downloaded games.
en.disableEffect: Duoku's game-download manager may show stale installed-game status.

zh-CN.description: 多酷 GamePlus 会监听 Android 应用安装和移除事件，以更新已下载游戏的安装状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 多酷游戏下载管理器中的游戏安装状态可能无法及时更新。

en.description: Duoku's download manager listens for network-connectivity changes to pause or resume package downloads.
en.disableEffect: Duoku downloads may not respond correctly when the network disconnects or returns.

zh-CN.description: 多酷下载管理器会监听网络连接变化，以暂停或恢复安装包下载。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 网络断开或恢复时，多酷下载可能无法正确暂停或继续。

en.description: Duoku GamePlus opens a screen where users can view and manage downloaded games, active downloads, and available upgrades.
en.disableEffect: The Duoku download manager and its separate game-install/update controls will not open.

zh-CN.description: 多酷 GamePlus 会打开游戏下载管理页面，供用户查看和管理已下载游戏、正在进行的下载及可用更新。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 多酷下载管理器及其独立的游戏安装、更新操作将无法打开。

en.description: The DejaPay (iPOS Systems/Dejavoo) payment SDK opens this Activity for terminal transactions, sends payment details to the selected Dejavoo terminal app, and returns the result; Dejavoo can also open it for terminal registration.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot start or complete Dejavoo terminal payments or handle registration through this integration.

zh-CN.description: DejaPay（iPOS Systems/Dejavoo）支付 SDK 通过此 Activity 处理终端交易，将付款信息交给所选的 Dejavoo 终端应用并回传结果；终端注册也会打开它。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，应用无法通过此集成发起或完成 Dejavoo 终端付款，也无法处理终端注册。

en.description: Dylan Cai’s ActivityResultLauncher includes this private provider for camera output files. Its photo and video capture helpers use it when the app configures the library to use this provider.
en.disableEffect: If the app uses this provider for camera output, disabling it prevents the camera from opening the photo or video file.

zh-CN.description: Dylan Cai 的 ActivityResultLauncher 内置此私有文件提供器以供相机输出照片和视频文件；应用配置该库使用此提供器后，拍摄流程会调用它。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 如果应用使用此提供器传递相机输出文件，停用后相机将无法打开照片或视频文件。

en.description: The Dynatrace Session Replay SDK declares this service disabled by default. If enabled, it coordinates when replay data is ready and when a recording should stop.
en.disableEffect: If the SDK enables this service, blocking it prevents replay coordination; the host app's own features are unaffected.

zh-CN.description: Dynatrace Session Replay SDK 默认不启用此 Service。若 SDK 启用它，它会协调回放数据处理完成及停止录制的时机。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 如果 SDK 启用此 Service，禁用它会阻断回放协调，但宿主应用本身的功能不受影响。

en.description: Dynatrace Session Replay starts this background service to process session replay data separately from the app's main work.
en.disableEffect: Blocking it stops background Session Replay tasks from running in the separate process, but leaves host-app features working.

zh-CN.description: Dynatrace Session Replay 会启动此后台 Service，在应用主要工作之外处理会话回放数据。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，Session Replay 的后台任务无法在独立进程中运行，但宿主应用功能仍可使用。

en.description: When Dynatrace Session Replay schedules background work, Android starts this service to process session replay data.
en.disableEffect: Blocking it stops Dynatrace Session Replay tasks from being processed, while the host app continues to work.

zh-CN.description: Dynatrace Session Replay 安排后台工作时，Android 会启动此 Service 处理会话回放数据。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，Dynatrace Session Replay 任务不会得到处理，但宿主应用仍可正常使用。

en.description: Eartho One opens a browser for authentication when the app starts a sign-in or sign-out flow, then returns the result to the app.
en.disableEffect: Browser-based Eartho One sign-in and sign-out flows will not complete.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动登录或退出登录流程时，Eartho One 会打开浏览器进行身份验证，并将结果返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Eartho One 的浏览器登录和退出登录流程将无法完成。

en.description: Eartho One receives the app-specific browser return link after authentication and forwards it to the authentication screen to finish the flow.
en.disableEffect: The browser will not be able to return Eartho One authentication results to the app.

zh-CN.description: 身份验证完成后，Eartho One 会接收应用专用的浏览器回跳链接，并将其转交给验证页面以完成流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，浏览器无法将 Eartho One 的验证结果返回应用。

en.description: Swapnil Huddar's AlertDemo Android library opens this screen to show an app-supplied title and message in a dialog, then closes when the user responds. An app may use it for a checkout notice.
en.disableEffect: A checkout or status notice that uses this dialog may no longer appear.

zh-CN.description: Swapnil Huddar 的 AlertDemo Android 库会打开此页面，以对话框显示应用提供的标题和消息，并在用户作出响应后关闭；应用可能用它显示结账提示。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此对话框的结账或状态提示可能不再显示。

en.description: Easebuzz's payment gateway opens this Activity for bank-page payment confirmation. It displays the bank page, supports the OTP step, and returns the transaction result to the app.
en.disableEffect: Payments that use this bank confirmation flow may fail or remain incomplete.

zh-CN.description: Easebuzz 支付网关会在银行付款需要确认时打开此 Activity。它显示银行页面、支持一次性验证码步骤，并将交易结果返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，使用此银行确认流程的付款可能失败或无法完成。

en.description: Easebuzz's payment gateway opens this Activity to show its checkout payment page. It processes the user's payment choice and returns the transaction result to the host app.
en.disableEffect: Payments that rely on this checkout screen cannot be completed.

zh-CN.description: Easebuzz 支付网关会打开此 Activity 显示结账付款页面。它处理用户选择的付款方式，并将交易结果返回宿主应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，依赖此结账页面的付款将无法完成。

en.description: Easebuzz's payment gateway opens this Activity during checkout to show payment methods, cashback offers, and discount codes. It applies the selected offer and submits the payment.
en.disableEffect: Users may be unable to choose a payment method or complete checkout through this Easebuzz flow.

zh-CN.description: Easebuzz 支付网关会在结账时打开此 Activity，显示付款方式、返现优惠和折扣码。它应用所选优惠并提交付款。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户可能无法在此 Easebuzz 流程中选择付款方式或完成结账。

en.description: While an Easebuzz payment is pending, this Service counts down the transaction session and sends updates so the checkout can show remaining time and handle expiry.
en.disableEffect: The checkout can lose its countdown and may not end an expired payment cleanly.

zh-CN.description: Easebuzz 付款等待处理期间，此 Service 会倒计时并发送更新，让结账页面显示剩余时间并处理超时。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，结账页面可能无法正确显示倒计时或结束已超时的付款。

en.description: Eason's AndroidUtils permission library opens Android's permission prompt when the app requests access, then returns which permissions were granted or denied.
en.disableEffect: The permission request cannot complete through this screen, so app features that need those permissions may stop working.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求权限时，Eason AndroidUtils 权限库会显示 Android 权限提示，并将用户允许或拒绝的结果返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用无法通过此页面完成权限请求，因此依赖这些权限的功能可能无法使用。

en.description: The EGLS (EasyGames) Android Game Platform SDK opens this screen from sign-in and account-linking pages to display the configured service agreement. Players can scroll through it and close the page to return to the account flow.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, players cannot read the service agreement from the SDK's sign-in or account-linking flow.

zh-CN.description: EGLS（EasyGames）Android 游戏平台 SDK 会在登录或账号关联页面打开此界面，显示已配置的服务协议。玩家可以滚动阅读并关闭页面，返回账号流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，玩家无法在 SDK 的登录或账号关联流程中查看服务协议。

en.description: The EGLS (EasyGames) Android Game Platform SDK opens this screen when a player links a game account to a sign-in channel or verifies a phone number or email address. It handles the selected account provider and confirmation code.
en.disableEffect: Players cannot link sign-in accounts or add and update verified contact details through the SDK.

zh-CN.description: 玩家关联登录渠道，或验证手机号、电子邮箱时，EGLS（EasyGames）Android 游戏平台 SDK 会打开此界面。界面会处理所选账号渠道和验证码。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，玩家无法通过 SDK 关联登录账号，也无法添加或更新已验证的联系方式。

en.description: Before a new player signs in, the EGLS (EasyGames) Android Game Platform SDK shows the service agreement and, for some regional settings, the privacy policy. It waits for the player to accept before continuing.
en.disableEffect: New players cannot complete the SDK's consent step, so sign-in cannot continue.

zh-CN.description: 新玩家登录前，EGLS（EasyGames）Android 游戏平台 SDK 会显示服务协议；在部分地区还会显示隐私政策，并要求玩家同意后才能继续。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，新玩家无法完成 SDK 的同意步骤，因此不能继续登录。

en.description: The EGLS (EasyGames) Android Game Platform SDK opens this screen when a player chooses the privacy-policy link in an account flow. It displays the configured policy text for reading.
en.disableEffect: Players cannot review the privacy policy from the SDK's account screens.

zh-CN.description: 玩家在账号流程中打开隐私政策链接时，EGLS（EasyGames）Android 游戏平台 SDK 会显示已配置的政策内容，供玩家阅读。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，玩家无法通过 SDK 的账号界面查看隐私政策。

en.description: From the forgotten-password option on the sign-in screen, the EGLS (EasyGames) Android Game Platform SDK lets a player request a password reset after confirming their registered email or phone number with a one-time code.
en.disableEffect: Players lose the SDK's email and phone account-recovery path.

zh-CN.description: 玩家在登录界面选择找回密码后，EGLS（EasyGames）Android 游戏平台 SDK 会通过已登记的电子邮箱或手机号发送验证码，并据此提交密码重置请求。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，玩家无法通过 SDK 使用电子邮箱或手机号找回账号密码。

en.description: The EGLS (EasyGames) Android Game Platform SDK opens this screen when the game asks a player to sign in or switch accounts. It presents the available account and social sign-in choices, registration, and saved-player options.
en.disableEffect: Players cannot sign in, register, or switch accounts through this SDK.

zh-CN.description: 游戏要求玩家登录或切换账号时，EGLS（EasyGames）Android 游戏平台 SDK 会打开此界面。界面提供可用的账号或社交登录方式、注册入口和已保存账号。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，玩家无法通过此 SDK 登录、注册或切换账号。

en.description: The EGLS (EasyGames) Android Game Platform SDK opens this screen for optional app-rating, Facebook promotion or sharing, and LINE promotion activities requested by the game. It presents configured images or links and returns whether the player completed or cancelled the activity.
en.disableEffect: The SDK's rating and social-promotion screens stop working, while the game's other screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: 游戏请求评价、Facebook 推广或分享、LINE 推广等可选活动时，EGLS（EasyGames）Android 游戏平台 SDK 会打开此界面。界面显示已配置的图片或链接，并将玩家完成或取消活动的结果返回给游戏。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，SDK 的评价和社交推广界面无法使用，但游戏的其他界面仍可打开。

en.description: When the game requests a purchase, the EGLS (EasyGames) Android Game Platform SDK displays the product and order details and starts the configured payment route, including supported in-app, carrier, and web payments.
en.disableEffect: Players cannot complete purchases started through this SDK.

zh-CN.description: 游戏发起购买时，EGLS（EasyGames）Android 游戏平台 SDK 会显示商品和订单信息，并启动已配置的支付方式，包括应用内支付、运营商支付和网页支付。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，玩家无法完成通过此 SDK 发起的购买。

en.description: The EGLS (EasyGames) Android Game Platform SDK opens this screen when real-name verification is requested during sign-in or account management. It asks for the player's legal name and identity number, submits them for verification, and returns the result.
en.disableEffect: Players cannot complete real-name verification through the SDK.

zh-CN.description: 登录或管理账号时需要实名认证，EGLS（EasyGames）Android 游戏平台 SDK 就会打开此界面。玩家在此填写姓名和身份证号码，提交验证并接收结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，玩家无法通过 SDK 完成实名认证。

en.description: From account security settings, the EGLS (EasyGames) Android Game Platform SDK opens this screen to bind or change a phone number or email address after code verification.
en.disableEffect: Players cannot add or change verified phone and email contacts for the account.

zh-CN.description: 在账号安全设置中，EGLS（EasyGames）Android 游戏平台 SDK 会打开此界面，让玩家通过验证码绑定或更换手机号、电子邮箱。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，玩家无法为账号添加或更换已验证的手机号和电子邮箱。

en.description: The EGLS (EasyGames) Android Game Platform SDK opens this screen from its account-center option. It shows the player's profile, security contacts, recharge records, and controls such as password change and sign-out.
en.disableEffect: Players cannot view or manage their account details through the SDK.

zh-CN.description: 玩家选择账号中心时，EGLS（EasyGames）Android 游戏平台 SDK 会打开此界面。界面显示个人资料、安全联系方式、充值记录，以及修改密码和退出登录等选项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，玩家无法通过 SDK 查看或管理账号信息。

en.description: The EGLS (EasyGames) support library opens this embedded browser for SDK web pages, external return links, and web-payment or promotion flows. It also accepts browsable links such as the configured Twitter return link.
en.disableEffect: Players cannot complete web-based payments or return through links handled by the SDK browser.

zh-CN.description: EGLS（EasyGames）支持库会在打开 SDK 网页、处理外部返回链接以及网页支付或推广流程时显示此内置浏览器。它也会接收可浏览的链接，例如已配置的 Twitter 返回链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，玩家无法完成网页支付，也无法通过 SDK 浏览器处理的链接返回应用。

en.description: When the host app opens the EGLS (EasyGames) permission-information screen, it shows the app name, version, icon, and configured explanation on the first run. It also forwards any permission results delivered to this screen.
en.disableEffect: Players cannot see the SDK's first-run permission guidance or return permission results through this screen.

zh-CN.description: 宿主应用打开 EGLS（EasyGames）的权限说明界面时，此界面会在首次运行时显示应用名称、版本、图标和已配置的说明，并转交收到的权限结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，玩家无法查看 SDK 的首次运行权限说明，也无法通过此界面返回权限结果。

en.description: The EGLS (EasyGames) support library receives the return link for Facebook account association, forwards its token to the game's account flow, and then closes.
en.disableEffect: Facebook account association cannot return its result to the game.

zh-CN.description: EGLS（EasyGames）支持库会接收 Facebook 账号关联后的返回链接，将其中的令牌交回游戏账号流程，然后关闭界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Facebook 账号关联结果无法返回游戏。

en.description: When the game asks to invite friends, the EGLS (EasyGames) support library opens Facebook's game-request dialog. It returns the selected invitees' profile details or a cancellation or error result.
en.disableEffect: Players cannot invite Facebook friends through the game's SDK integration.

zh-CN.description: 游戏请求邀请好友时，EGLS（EasyGames）支持库会打开 Facebook 游戏邀请对话框，并返回所选好友的资料，或取消、错误结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，玩家无法通过游戏的 SDK 集成邀请 Facebook 好友。

en.description: When the game asks to share an image or link, the EGLS (EasyGames) support library opens Facebook's sharing dialog. It returns whether sharing succeeded, was cancelled, or failed.
en.disableEffect: Players cannot share game images or links through Facebook using the SDK.

zh-CN.description: 游戏请求分享图片或链接时，EGLS（EasyGames）支持库会打开 Facebook 分享对话框，并返回分享成功、取消或失败的结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，玩家无法通过 SDK 在 Facebook 分享游戏图片或链接。

en.description: When the game requests Facebook sign-in, the EGLS (EasyGames) support library obtains the player's Facebook account details after the requested permissions are granted and returns them to the game.
en.disableEffect: Players cannot sign in to the game with Facebook.

zh-CN.description: 游戏请求 Facebook 登录时，EGLS（EasyGames）支持库会在玩家授予所需权限后获取其 Facebook 账号资料，并将资料返回给游戏。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，玩家无法使用 Facebook 登录游戏。

en.description: When the game starts Google sign-in through the EGLS (EasyGames) support library, this screen checks for an existing session or opens Google sign-in. It returns the player's account details and an authentication token or code.
en.disableEffect: Players cannot use this Google sign-in flow to access the game.

zh-CN.description: 游戏通过 EGLS（EasyGames）支持库启动 Google 登录时，此界面会检查已有会话或打开 Google 登录，并返回玩家账号资料及身份验证令牌或授权码。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，玩家无法通过此 Google 登录流程进入游戏。

en.description: When launched for Google sign-in, the EGLS (EasyGames) support library checks for an existing Google account or asks the player to choose one. It returns the account details and an authentication token or code.
en.disableEffect: Players cannot use this Google sign-in flow to access the game.

zh-CN.description: 启动 Google 登录时，EGLS（EasyGames）支持库会检查已有的 Google 账号，或请玩家选择账号，并返回账号资料及身份验证令牌或授权码。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，玩家无法通过此 Google 登录流程进入游戏。

en.description: The eBay OAuth Android Client opens this Activity to start browser-based account authorization, then handles the returned authorization code or error.
en.disableEffect: Apps using eBay OAuth cannot complete authorization or receive its result.

zh-CN.description: eBay OAuth Android Client 会打开此 Activity，通过浏览器启动账户授权，并处理返回的授权码或错误。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，依赖 eBay OAuth 的应用无法完成授权或获取授权结果。

en.description: When the browser redirects an eBay authorization response back to the app, this Activity forwards the returned link to the OAuth flow for processing.
en.disableEffect: The eBay authorization response cannot be delivered to the app's OAuth flow.

zh-CN.description: 浏览器将 eBay 授权结果重定向回应用时，此 Activity 会把返回链接交给 OAuth 流程继续处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，eBay 授权结果无法传回应用的 OAuth 流程。

en.description: The ech0s7r androidlog library binds this service when file logging receives messages; it queues them and appends them to the current daily log file.
en.disableEffect: Blocking it stops androidlog from writing file logs, while the host app's features continue to work.

zh-CN.description: ech0s7r androidlog 日志库收到需要写入文件的日志时会绑定此 Service，将日志排队并追加到当天的日志文件中。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，androidlog 不会写入文件日志，但宿主应用的功能仍可使用。

en.description: When a user taps a photo in EChatSoft's EChat media picker, this Activity previews images from the selected album before the user chooses one.
en.disableEffect: The user cannot preview album photos before attaching them to an EChat conversation.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 EChatSoft 的 EChat 媒体选择器中点开照片时，这个 Activity 会预览所选相册中的图片，供用户确认后再选择。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法在将照片附加到 EChat 对话前预览相册图片。

en.description: When the user reviews media already selected in EChatSoft's EChat picker, this Activity shows the selected items in a preview and returns them to the picker.
en.disableEffect: The user cannot review selected media before attaching it to an EChat message.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 EChatSoft 的 EChat 媒体选择器中查看已选内容时，这个 Activity 会预览所选项目并将结果返回给选择器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法在将媒体附加到 EChat 消息前检查已选内容。

en.description: When an EChat attachment flow opens the EChatSoft media picker, this Activity lists media albums, lets the user choose photos or videos, and returns the selection.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot choose photos or videos to attach to an EChat message.

zh-CN.description: EChat 附件流程打开 EChatSoft 的媒体选择器时，这个 Activity 会列出媒体相册，让用户选择照片或视频并返回所选内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法选择照片或视频并将其附加到 EChat 消息。

en.description: When an EChatSoft embedded web page requests a permission or asks to attach a file, photo, or video, this Activity opens the matching Android prompt or chooser and returns the result.
en.disableEffect: Embedded EChat pages may be unable to request permissions or select files and media for upload.

zh-CN.description: EChatSoft 的内嵌网页请求权限或需要选择文件、照片、视频时，这个 Activity 会打开相应的 Android 提示或选择器，并返回操作结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，EChat 内嵌网页可能无法申请权限，也无法选择要上传的文件或媒体。

en.description: After an EChat attachment finishes downloading, this Receiver records its saved location in the chat's local file record.
en.disableEffect: A downloaded attachment may not be linked to its chat message or available to open.

zh-CN.description: EChat 附件下载完成后，这个 Receiver 会将文件保存位置写入聊天的本地文件记录。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，已下载的附件可能无法关联到对应消息或打开。

en.description: At app startup and when EChatSoft needs to share a local file with Android or another app, this Provider initializes SDK utilities and supplies a safe file link.
en.disableEffect: EChat startup or sharing and opening chat files may fail.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，以及 EChatSoft 需要向 Android 或其他应用提供本地文件时，这个 Provider 会初始化 SDK 工具并生成安全的文件访问链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，EChat 可能无法正常启动，聊天文件的分享或打开也可能失败。

en.description: When EChatSoft needs an Android runtime permission, it opens this short-lived Activity to show the system prompt and return the user's choice to the requesting feature.
en.disableEffect: EChat features that need a system permission may be unable to request or receive it.

zh-CN.description: EChatSoft 需要申请 Android 运行时权限时，会打开这个临时 Activity 显示系统提示，并将用户的选择返回给相关功能。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，需要系统权限的 EChat 功能可能无法申请权限或收到授权结果。

en.description: EChatSoft's EChat SDK uses this Provider to share saved settings and user information between the app and its chat process.
en.disableEffect: EChat settings or account information may not be available across processes, disrupting chat features.

zh-CN.description: EChatSoft 的 EChat SDK 通过这个 Provider 在应用进程和聊天进程之间共享设置及用户信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，EChat 设置或账户信息可能无法在不同进程间读取，影响聊天功能。

en.description: EChatSoft diagnostic tools use this exported Provider to read SDK version and log information and to change diagnostic switches.
en.disableEffect: External EChat version and diagnostic controls will no longer be available through this Provider.

zh-CN.description: EChatSoft 的诊断工具通过这个已导出的 Provider 查询 SDK 版本和日志信息，并调整诊断开关。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，外部工具将无法通过此 Provider 查询 EChat 版本或调整诊断设置。

en.description: When an EChat download is opened, Android uses this Provider to give the file viewer safe access to the downloaded file.
en.disableEffect: Opening downloaded EChat attachments in a file viewer or another app may fail.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 EChat 下载的文件时，Android 会通过这个 Provider 安全地将文件交给文件查看器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，可能无法在文件查看器或其他应用中打开 EChat 下载的附件。

en.description: When EChatSoft's image browser is opened for a set of images, this Activity displays them full screen so the user can swipe, zoom, and save an image.
en.disableEffect: Full-screen image preview and saving from EChat's image browser will not work.

zh-CN.description: EChatSoft 的图片浏览器打开一组图片时，这个 Activity 会全屏显示图片，供用户滑动、缩放或保存。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，EChat 图片浏览器的全屏预览和保存功能将无法使用。

en.description: On Android 4.4 through 7.0, EChatSoft briefly starts this Service to remove its temporary chat-service notification after startup.
en.disableEffect: On Android 4.4 through 7.0, EChat's temporary service notification may remain visible.

zh-CN.description: 在 Android 4.4 至 7.0 上，EChatSoft 会短暂启动这个 Service，在启动后移除临时的聊天服务通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，在 Android 4.4 至 7.0 上，EChat 的临时服务通知可能会继续显示。

en.description: Android runs this scheduled EChatSoft Service to restore the chat connection and respond to network changes while the app is in the background.
en.disableEffect: Background chat reconnection may stop, so new messages or updates can be missed until EChat is opened again.

zh-CN.description: 应用在后台时，Android 会按计划运行这个 EChatSoft Service，以恢复聊天连接并响应网络变化。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，后台聊天可能无法重新连接，用户可能要重新打开 EChat 才能收到新消息或更新。

en.description: When the EChat SDK queues an incoming chat attachment, this Service downloads it and reports progress to the conversation.
en.disableEffect: Incoming chat attachments may not download or become available to open.

zh-CN.description: EChat SDK 将收到的聊天附件加入下载队列后，这个 Service 会下载文件并向对话更新进度。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，收到的聊天附件可能无法下载或打开。

en.description: When EChatSoft starts its background chat session, this Service maintains the connection and tries to restore it after network changes.
en.disableEffect: EChat may miss new messages and chat updates while the app is in the background.

zh-CN.description: EChatSoft 启动后台聊天会话时，这个 Service 会维持连接，并在网络变化后尝试恢复连接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用处于后台时 EChat 可能无法及时收到新消息和聊天更新。

en.description: EChatSoft starts this Service in the app's main process alongside its chat services to coordinate their startup and shutdown.
en.disableEffect: Background chat coordination may fail, making message delivery and other chat updates less reliable.

zh-CN.description: EChatSoft 会在应用主进程中启动这个 Service，与聊天服务配合协调启动和关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，后台聊天服务的协调可能失效，消息送达和其他聊天更新也会变得不可靠。

en.description: EChatSoft briefly starts this Service to warm the separate web-page process before an EChat page is opened, then stops it.
en.disableEffect: The first EChat web page may take longer to open.

zh-CN.description: 打开 EChat 网页前，EChatSoft 会短暂启动这个 Service 预热独立的网页进程，随后将其停止。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，首次打开 EChat 网页可能会更慢。

en.description: When a user sends a file or media attachment in an EChat conversation, this Service uploads it and reports progress or failure.
en.disableEffect: Users may be unable to send file and media attachments in EChat conversations.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 EChat 对话中发送文件或媒体附件时，这个 Service 会上传内容并报告进度或失败状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户可能无法在 EChat 对话中发送文件或媒体附件。

en.description: When a user opens EChatSoft's message box, this Activity displays the EChat messages and conversation entry points.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open EChat's message box to review or enter conversations.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 EChatSoft 的消息盒子时，这个 Activity 会显示 EChat 消息及进入对话的入口。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法打开 EChat 消息盒子查看消息或进入对话。

en.description: When EChat opens a link in its compact browser, this Activity displays the page in a bottom-sheet view.
en.disableEffect: Links opened in EChat's compact browser will not display.

zh-CN.description: EChat 在紧凑浏览器中打开链接时，这个 Activity 会以底部弹出页面的形式显示网页。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，EChat 紧凑浏览器中的链接将无法显示。

en.description: When EChatSoft is asked to show a page in its full-screen browser, this Activity displays the page inside the app.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open conversation links in EChat's in-app browser.

zh-CN.description: EChatSoft 需要在全屏浏览器中显示网页时，会由这个 Activity 在应用内打开页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法在 EChat 应用内浏览器中打开对话链接。

en.description: When a user chooses camera capture from the EChat conversation composer, this Activity opens the camera to take a photo or record a video for the message.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot capture photos or videos from the EChat conversation composer.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 EChat 对话编辑区选择拍摄时，这个 Activity 会打开相机，为消息拍照或录制视频。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法在 EChat 对话编辑区拍摄照片或视频。

en.description: When the host app opens an EChatSoft customer-service conversation, this Activity displays the chat thread and loads its conversation details.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot open its EChat conversation screen, so its customer-service chat feature will not work.

zh-CN.description: 宿主应用打开 EChatSoft 客服对话时，这个 Activity 会显示聊天内容并加载该对话的信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用无法打开 EChat 对话页面，客服聊天功能将无法使用。

en.description: When a user chooses to share a location in EChat, this Activity displays the map and returns the selected location to the conversation.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot choose and share a location through EChat's map screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 EChat 中选择分享位置时，这个 Activity 会显示地图，并将选定的位置返回给对话。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过 EChat 地图选择并分享位置。

en.description: When a user taps an EChat notification, this Activity clears the notification and opens the matching customer-service conversation.
en.disableEffect: Tapping an EChat notification will no longer take the user to its conversation.

zh-CN.description: 用户点按 EChat 通知时，这个 Activity 会清除通知并打开对应的客服对话。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，点按 EChat 通知将无法跳转到对应对话。

en.description: When a user taps a video attachment in an EChat conversation, this Activity plays it full screen.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot play EChat video attachments in the full-screen player.

zh-CN.description: 用户点开 EChat 对话中的视频附件时，这个 Activity 会全屏播放视频。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法在全屏播放器中播放 EChat 视频附件。

en.description: The host app and EChatSoft chat process use this Provider for shared chat operations such as login, conversation routing, and unread counts.
en.disableEffect: EChat login, unread counts, or conversation routing may fail and disrupt chat use.

zh-CN.description: 宿主应用和 EChatSoft 聊天进程通过这个 Provider 执行共享聊天操作，例如登录、对话跳转和未读数查询。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，EChat 登录、未读数查询或对话跳转可能失败，影响聊天使用。

en.description: Echo Utils starts this transparent Activity when the app uses its fragment-based image picker or sharing functions; it hosts the operation and forwards activity and permission results.
en.disableEffect: The app's image-picking or fragment-based sharing flow will not run correctly or return its result.

zh-CN.description: 应用使用 Echo Utils 的图片选择或分享功能时，工具会启动这个透明界面来承载操作，并转交页面返回值和权限请求结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用的图片选择或基于 Fragment 的分享流程将无法正常运行或返回结果。

en.description: Echo Utils receives Twitter composer upload success, failure, or cancellation broadcasts and passes the outcome to the app's share callback.
en.disableEffect: The app will no longer receive a success, failure, or cancellation result for Twitter shares.

zh-CN.description: Twitter 分享界面广播上传成功、失败或取消时，Echo Utils 会接收结果并通知应用的分享回调。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用将无法收到 Twitter 分享成功、失败或取消的结果。

en.description: Android creates this Echo Utils provider at app startup; it initializes the library's application context, logging tag, and default interface sizing.
en.disableEffect: Echo Utils helpers will lose the application context and default sizing setup that this provider initializes.

zh-CN.description: Android 会在应用启动时创建 Echo Utils 的此初始化提供器；它设置工具库的应用上下文、日志标签和默认界面尺寸。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Echo Utils 工具将失去此提供器初始化的应用上下文和默认尺寸配置。

en.description: When the host app starts an Ecommpay Payment Page checkout, this Activity displays payment methods, collects payment details, and returns the result to the app.
en.disableEffect: The app's Ecommpay checkout cannot complete through the Payment Page.

zh-CN.description: 宿主应用启动 Ecommpay Payment Page 结账流程时，这个 Activity 会显示支付方式、收集支付信息并将结果返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用无法通过 Ecommpay Payment Page 完成结账。

en.description: When Ecommpay checkout opens a payment or privacy-policy URL, this Activity displays the page in an in-app web view.
en.disableEffect: Payment and privacy pages opened from Ecommpay checkout will not display.

zh-CN.description: Ecommpay 结账流程打开支付页面或隐私政策链接时，这个 Activity 会在应用内网页视图中显示页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Ecommpay 结账中打开的支付页面或隐私政策将无法显示。

en.description: When a card payment requires issuer verification, this Ecommpay Activity opens the bank's 3-D Secure authorization page and returns the result.
en.disableEffect: Card payments that require 3-D Secure verification may not complete.

zh-CN.description: 银行卡支付需要发卡行验证时，这个 Ecommpay Activity 会打开银行的 3-D Secure 验证页面并返回结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，需要 3-D Secure 验证的银行卡支付可能无法完成。

en.description: The EdCast MyGuide SDK starts this service when an app launches its floating shortcut; it places a draggable guide icon over the screen, and tapping it opens the guide list when the user is signed in and online.
en.disableEffect: The floating MyGuide icon and its shortcut to the guide list disappear.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动 EdCast MyGuide SDK 的悬浮入口时会启动此 Service；它在屏幕上显示可拖动的指南图标，用户已登录且联网时点击图标即可打开指南列表。
zh-CN.disableEffect: MyGuide 悬浮图标及其打开指南列表的入口将消失。

en.description: EdCast MyGuide starts this service after the user grants screen-capture permission and chooses an inline guide; it captures the screen and places highlights and prompts over matching guide steps.
en.disableEffect: MyGuide’s on-screen inline walkthroughs cannot run.

zh-CN.description: 用户授予屏幕捕获权限并选择内嵌指南后，EdCast MyGuide 会启动此 Service；它捕获屏幕，并在匹配的指南步骤上显示高亮和提示。
zh-CN.disableEffect: MyGuide 的屏幕内嵌式操作指南将无法运行。

en.description: When a user chooses the “Show me” mode for a guide, the EdCast MyGuide SDK opens this Activity with that guide’s ID and title and displays its instructional details.
en.disableEffect: The selected guide’s detail walkthrough cannot open in “Show me” mode.

zh-CN.description: 用户为指南选择“Show me”模式时，EdCast MyGuide SDK 会带着该指南的 ID 和标题打开此 Activity，并显示操作说明详情。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 所选指南将无法以“Show me”模式打开详情说明。

en.description: Tapping the floating EdCast MyGuide icon opens this full-screen dialog, which displays the available guide list.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open the MyGuide guide catalog from the floating shortcut.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击 EdCast MyGuide 悬浮图标时会打开此全屏对话框，其中显示可用的指南列表。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过悬浮入口打开 MyGuide 指南目录。

en.description: The visibledebugtool library by snaps-eddy uses this Service for its floating log viewer. When the viewer is opened, it displays the app's live log messages and offers tag filtering and clearing.
en.disableEffect: The visibledebugtool floating log panel and its log controls will be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: snaps-eddy 的 visibledebugtool 库用此 Service 显示悬浮日志面板。用户打开面板时，它会展示应用的实时日志，并提供按标签筛选和清除日志的操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，visibledebugtool 的悬浮日志面板及其日志操作将无法使用。

en.description: The visibledebugtool library by snaps-eddy uses this Service for its floating log viewer. It displays app log messages and applies a keyword sent from the viewer's search screen.
en.disableEffect: The visibledebugtool floating log panel and its keyword filtering will be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: snaps-eddy 的 visibledebugtool 库用此 Service 显示悬浮日志面板，并按搜索页面传入的关键词筛选应用日志。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，visibledebugtool 的悬浮日志面板和关键词筛选将无法使用。

en.description: The visibledebugtool library by snaps-eddy opens this Activity when its floating log viewer needs permission to appear over other apps. Its prompt can take the user to Android's overlay permission settings.
en.disableEffect: The tool cannot guide the user to grant overlay access, so its log viewer may remain unavailable until that permission is enabled in system settings.

zh-CN.description: snaps-eddy 的 visibledebugtool 库在悬浮日志面板需要显示在其他应用上层的权限时打开此 Activity，并可引导用户前往 Android 悬浮窗权限设置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，该工具无法引导用户开启悬浮窗权限；如果尚未授予权限，日志面板可能无法使用。

en.description: The visibledebugtool library by snaps-eddy opens this Activity from its floating log viewer to ask for a search keyword, then applies that keyword to the displayed logs.
en.disableEffect: The user cannot enter a keyword to search the visibledebugtool log panel.

zh-CN.description: snaps-eddy 的 visibledebugtool 库从悬浮日志面板打开此 Activity，让用户输入关键词并据此筛选显示的日志。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在 visibledebugtool 日志面板中输入关键词进行搜索。

en.description: The visibledebugtool library by snaps-eddy uses this Activity to configure its log viewer, including log text size, background display behavior, and saved filter keywords.
en.disableEffect: The viewer's settings screen and its controls for log display and filters will be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: snaps-eddy 的 visibledebugtool 库用此 Activity 配置日志查看器，包括日志文字大小、后台显示行为和已保存的筛选关键词。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，日志查看器的设置页面以及显示和筛选选项将无法使用。

en.description: When a user taps an edna Push Lite notification, this Activity processes its action, clears or updates the notification, and opens an app link when requested.
en.disableEffect: Push notification actions such as opening a link or dismissing a message will stop working.

zh-CN.description: 用户点按 edna Push Lite 通知时，这个 Activity 会处理通知操作、清除或更新通知，并在需要时打开应用链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，打开链接或清除消息等推送通知操作将无法使用。

en.description: Firebase starts this edna Push Lite Service for incoming push messages or a refreshed registration token; it forwards messages for handling and registers new tokens.
en.disableEffect: edna push messages and refreshed registration tokens will no longer be delivered to the app.

zh-CN.description: 收到推送消息或注册令牌更新时，Firebase 会启动 edna Push Lite 的这个 Service；它会转交消息并注册新令牌。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，edna 推送消息和更新后的注册令牌将无法送达应用。

en.description: When edna Push X receives push-message updates, this Receiver handles arrivals, dismissals, and read status, and updates device registration or reports errors.
en.disableEffect: edna Push X message handling and device-registration updates will stop.

zh-CN.description: edna Push X 收到推送消息更新时，这个 Receiver 会处理新消息、消息隐藏和已读状态，并更新设备注册信息或报告错误。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，edna Push X 的消息处理和设备注册更新将停止。

en.description: When edna Voice Push starts a voice message or call, this Service plays the audio and sends playback state back to the call interface.
en.disableEffect: Voice Push call audio and voice-message playback may not start or may be silent.

zh-CN.description: edna Voice Push 开始播放语音消息或通话时，这个 Service 会播放音频并将播放状态反馈给通话界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Voice Push 通话音频和语音消息可能无法播放或没有声音。

en.description: edna Voice Push starts this Service for incoming or outgoing calls; it manages call actions, connection state, ringtone, and call notifications.
en.disableEffect: Incoming and outgoing edna Voice Push calls may not connect or respond to answer and reject actions.

zh-CN.description: edna Voice Push 收到来电或发起呼叫时会启动这个 Service；它管理通话操作、连接状态、铃声和通话通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，edna Voice Push 来电或去电可能无法接通，也无法响应接听或拒接操作。

en.description: Android call handling starts this edna Voice Push Service when it creates an incoming or outgoing call connection, then passes the call details to the SDK.
en.disableEffect: Voice Push calls may not integrate with Android's call system or connect correctly.

zh-CN.description: Android 通话系统为 edna Voice Push 建立来电或去电连接时，会启动这个 Service 并将通话信息传给 SDK。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Voice Push 通话可能无法接入 Android 通话系统或正常连接。

en.description: When an edna Voice Push call arrives, this Activity displays the incoming-call screen and lets the user answer or reject it.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot answer or reject edna Voice Push calls from the incoming-call screen.

zh-CN.description: edna Voice Push 收到来电时，这个 Activity 会显示来电界面，让用户接听或拒接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法在来电界面接听或拒绝 edna Voice Push 来电。

en.description: After an edna Voice Push call is accepted, this Activity displays the active-call controls, audio-device selection, and keypad.
en.disableEffect: Users lose the usual controls for managing an active edna Voice Push call.

zh-CN.description: edna Voice Push 通话接通后，这个 Activity 会显示通话控制、音频设备选择和拨号键盘。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法使用 edna Voice Push 通话的常用控制功能。

en.description: When MultiPicker captures a photo or video, this provider exposes the temporary file through a content link so the camera can write it and the app can read it.
en.disableEffect: The camera may not be able to access the output file, so photo or video capture from MultiPicker can fail.

zh-CN.description: MultiPicker 拍摄照片或视频时，此 Provider 会通过内容链接开放临时文件，让相机写入、应用读取。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 相机可能无法访问输出文件，导致 MultiPicker 中的拍照或录像失败。

en.description: When an app opens MultiPicker, this screen lets the user browse folders, select and preview photos or videos, and, when enabled, capture new media.
en.disableEffect: The app loses the MultiPicker selection flow, including any capture action configured there.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开 MultiPicker 时，此界面让用户浏览文件夹、选择并预览照片或视频；启用相应设置时，也可在此拍摄新媒体。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法使用 MultiPicker 的媒体选择流程，包括其中配置的拍摄功能。

en.description: When a Senspark EE-X flow needs to open another screen and receive its result, this hidden Activity briefly runs and returns the result to the app.
en.disableEffect: Any app flow that uses this EE-X result path may fail to open or finish its next screen.

zh-CN.description: 当 Senspark EE-X 流程需要打开其他页面并取得返回结果时，这个隐藏界面会短暂运行，并将结果交回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖这条 EE-X 流程的页面可能无法打开或完成。

en.description: Senspark EE-X uses this receiver when a scheduled local reminder is due. It shows the saved title and message as a notification, which opens the app's selected screen when tapped.
en.disableEffect: Reminders scheduled through Senspark EE-X will not appear, so app features that rely on them will stop notifying users.

zh-CN.description: Senspark EE-X 会在预定的本地提醒到期时运行此接收器，显示保存的标题和消息；点击通知后会进入应用指定页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过 Senspark EE-X 设置的提醒不会再显示，依赖这些提醒的应用功能会停止通知用户。

en.description: When Umeng APM has a saved heap snapshot to inspect, this background Service analyzes it and prepares a memory-leak report in a separate process.
en.disableEffect: Umeng APM will no longer analyze heap snapshots or produce memory-leak reports; the app's regular features continue to work.

zh-CN.description: Umeng APM 有需要检查的堆快照时，会在独立进程中启动此后台服务进行分析并生成内存泄漏报告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Umeng APM 将无法分析堆快照或生成内存泄漏报告；应用的日常功能仍可使用。

en.description: The EGLS Android Game Manager Library opens this screen when a game requests legacy video playback. It plays the supplied video at the requested size on the game screen and closes when playback ends or fails.
en.disableEffect: Game videos routed through this player will not play.

zh-CN.description: 游戏请求旧版视频播放时，EGLS Android 游戏管理库会打开此界面。它会按游戏指定的大小播放视频，并在播放结束或失败时关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过此播放器播放的游戏视频将无法播放。

en.description: This is a test screen bundled with the EGLS Android Game Manager Library. It starts the game manager for an integration check but has no game content of its own.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents this test screen from opening, but does not remove the game's normal screens.

zh-CN.description: 这是 EGLS Android 游戏管理库附带的测试界面。它会启动游戏管理库以检查集成情况，但本身不包含游戏内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，此测试界面无法打开，但游戏的常规界面不受影响。

en.description: E-goi opens this hidden screen when a user taps a push notification or one of its action buttons. It records opens and handles web links or app deep links.
en.disableEffect: Users may be unable to open E-goi notification actions or follow their links.

zh-CN.description: 用户点按 E-goi 推送通知或其中的操作按钮时，E-goi 会打开此隐藏界面。它会记录打开事件，并处理网页链接或应用内深层链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户可能无法打开 E-goi 通知操作或跟随其中的链接。

en.description: This E-goi Activity coordinates location tracking with the screen lifecycle: it stops location updates while the screen is visible, restarts them when it leaves, and forwards location permission results.
en.disableEffect: E-goi can no longer manage its location updates or receive location permission results through this Activity, so location-triggered messaging may stop.

zh-CN.description: 此 E-goi Activity 会根据界面生命周期协调位置跟踪：界面显示时停止位置更新，离开时重新启动，并转交位置权限结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: E-goi 无法再通过此 Activity 管理位置更新或接收位置权限结果，因此基于位置的消息可能停止。

en.description: When Android reports entry into an E-goi geofence, this receiver asks E-goi to send a notification for that area.
en.disableEffect: E-goi notifications tied to entering a geofenced area will no longer be sent.

zh-CN.description: Android 报告进入 E-goi 地理围栏时，此接收器会让 E-goi 为对应区域发送通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 进入地理围栏后触发的 E-goi 通知将不再发送。

en.description: E-goi uses this receiver for background location updates and stop requests. A stop request removes the active location updates.
en.disableEffect: E-goi can no longer handle these location events, so location-based messaging may behave incorrectly.

zh-CN.description: E-goi 使用此接收器处理后台位置更新和停止请求；收到停止请求时会移除正在进行的位置更新。
zh-CN.disableEffect: E-goi 无法再处理这些位置事件，基于位置的消息可能无法正常工作。

en.description: This receiver handles E-goi notification opens, action buttons, and dismissals. It records the event and opens the app, an action screen, or a link as needed.
en.disableEffect: E-goi notification taps, action links, and dismissal tracking may stop working.

zh-CN.description: 此接收器处理 E-goi 通知的打开、操作按钮和关闭事件。它会记录相应事件，并按需打开应用、操作界面或链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: E-goi 通知点击、操作链接和关闭记录可能停止工作。

en.description: When an E-goi geofence entry arrives, this service passes the entered area’s identifier to E-goi so it can send the matching location notification.
en.disableEffect: E-goi location notifications will not be sent when this service receives a geofence entry.

zh-CN.description: E-goi 服务收到地理围栏进入事件时，会把进入区域的标识交给 E-goi，以发送对应的位置通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 此服务收到地理围栏进入事件时，E-goi 将无法发送对应的位置通知。

en.description: While E-goi tracks location in the background, this foreground service keeps a notification visible with the tracking status and a control to stop updates.
en.disableEffect: E-goi loses this foreground location service and its stop control, which may prevent location-based messaging from working.

zh-CN.description: E-goi 在后台跟踪位置时，此前台服务会持续显示跟踪状态通知，并提供停止位置更新的操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: E-goi 将失去此前台位置服务及其停止操作，基于位置的消息可能无法正常工作。

en.description: The Picasso image-loading library starts this Provider with the app and uses it to load images.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents the library from loading images, including bank logos used by screens that rely on Picasso.

zh-CN.description: Picasso 图片加载库会随应用启动此 Provider，供应用通过该库加载图片。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，依赖 Picasso 的页面无法加载图片，包括银行卡标志。

en.description: When a user adds or verifies a bank card in PayEase Webox, this Activity collects the card number and mobile number, submits them, and continues to bank verification or SMS confirmation.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from adding or verifying cards and blocks the card check used during PayEase payment-password recovery.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 PayEase Webox 添加或验证银行卡时，此 Activity 会收集卡号和手机号并提交申请，然后进入银行验证或短信确认。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法添加或验证银行卡，也无法完成 PayEase 支付密码找回中的银行卡校验。

en.description: When PayEase Webox requests identity verification or digital-certificate enrollment, this Activity collects the user’s ID number and SMS code, submits the verification, and continues the security or face-check flow.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it blocks identity checks and certificate enrollment needed by the related payment and security flows.

zh-CN.description: PayEase Webox 需要进行身份验证或申请数字证书时，此 Activity 会收集用户的身份证号和短信验证码并提交验证，然后继续安全验证或人脸核验流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，相关支付和安全流程所需的身份核验及数字证书申请将无法完成。

en.description: During PayEase Webox card binding, this Activity sends and checks an SMS code and submits the card and phone details; during password recovery, it verifies the linked phone before allowing a reset.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it blocks the phone-verification steps used to bind cards or recover a payment password.

zh-CN.description: PayEase Webox 绑定银行卡时，此 Activity 会发送并校验短信验证码，再提交银行卡和手机号信息；找回密码时，它会先验证已绑定手机号。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，绑定银行卡或找回支付密码所需的手机号验证将无法完成。

en.description: When a user opens PayEase Webox’s bank-card page, this Activity loads and displays linked cards and requires the payment password before adding or removing one.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from viewing or managing linked cards and may block checkout flows that need the card list.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 PayEase Webox 的银行卡页面时，此 Activity 会加载并显示已绑定的银行卡；添加或解绑银行卡前需要验证支付密码。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法查看或管理已绑定的银行卡，需要银行卡列表的结账流程也可能无法继续。

en.description: When a bank requires an online redirect during PayEase Webox card binding, this Activity displays the bank’s verification page and returns the user to the binding flow.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents card binding from completing when the bank requires this redirect step.

zh-CN.description: 银行要求在 PayEase Webox 绑卡过程中跳转验证时，此 Activity 会显示银行验证页面，并让用户返回绑卡流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，要求通过此跳转步骤验证的银行卡将无法完成绑定。

en.description: During PayEase Webox identity or card verification, this Activity captures and crops an ID-card or bank-card image, sends it for text recognition, and returns the recognized details to the form.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents the SDK’s camera-scanning flow and can interrupt identity or card verification that depends on a scan.

zh-CN.description: 进行 PayEase Webox 身份或银行卡验证时，此 Activity 会拍摄并裁剪证件或银行卡照片，发送识别，并把识别出的信息交回表单。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，SDK 的摄像头扫描流程无法使用，依赖扫描的身份或银行卡验证也会中断。

en.description: When a user installs or updates a PayEase Webox digital certificate, this Activity requests SMS authentication and then opens the identity-verification and certificate flow.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents certificate enrollment or renewal and may block payments that require certificate authentication.

zh-CN.description: 用户安装或更新 PayEase Webox 数字证书时，此 Activity 会先请求短信验证，再打开身份核验和证书办理流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，数字证书无法申请或更新，需要证书验证的支付也可能无法进行。

en.description: Before PayEase Webox adds or removes a bank card or changes a payment password, this Activity verifies the user’s existing payment password and continues the selected action.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it blocks the password checks required for card management and payment-password changes.

zh-CN.description: PayEase Webox 添加或解绑银行卡、修改支付密码前，此 Activity 会核验用户现有的支付密码，然后继续相应操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，银行卡管理和修改支付密码所需的密码校验将无法完成。

en.description: When PayEase Webox requires face verification, this Activity presents the start and result screens, launches the face-check step, and returns its result to the payment flow.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents the related face-verification flow from starting or returning a result.

zh-CN.description: PayEase Webox 需要人脸核验时，此 Activity 会显示核验开始和结果页面、启动人脸检测，并将结果交回支付流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，相关人脸核验流程无法启动或返回结果。

en.description: After PayEase Webox’s camera-based liveness check fails, this Activity shows the failure reason and offers retry or return options.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it interrupts the liveness-verification failure flow and its retry or return actions.

zh-CN.description: PayEase Webox 的摄像头活体检测未通过时，此 Activity 会显示失败原因，并提供重试或返回选项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，活体核验失败后的结果页面以及重试、返回操作会中断。

en.description: When a user recovers a PayEase Webox payment password, this Activity collects an ID number and verifies it online before continuing to the linked-card check.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it blocks the identity and bank-card checks used to recover the payment password.

zh-CN.description: 用户找回 PayEase Webox 支付密码时，此 Activity 会收集身份证号并在线核验，通过后继续已绑定银行卡校验。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，找回支付密码所需的身份和银行卡校验将无法完成。

en.description: When a user opens a PayEase Webox service agreement or privacy notice, this Activity loads the supplied page in an in-app web view.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents those agreement pages from opening and may interrupt the card-binding or payment flow that links to them.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 PayEase Webox 用户协议或隐私说明时，此 Activity 会在应用内网页中加载对应页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，相关协议页面无法打开，引用这些页面的绑卡或支付流程可能中断。

en.description: When PayEase Webox requires active face-liveness verification, this Activity shows the start page, opens the camera check with prompted face movements, and submits the result.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents this face-verification route and can block the payment or identity flow that requires it.

zh-CN.description: PayEase Webox 需要主动式人脸活体核验时，此 Activity 会显示开始页面、打开摄像头并提示用户完成面部动作，然后提交检测结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，此人脸核验流程无法进行，需要该验证的支付或身份流程也会受阻。

en.description: After a PayEase Webox card-binding, password-change, or identity flow, this Activity displays the result and refreshes the related card or payment state when the user returns.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it interrupts result handling and the follow-up refresh for payment and card-management flows.

zh-CN.description: PayEase Webox 完成绑卡、修改密码或身份验证后，此 Activity 会显示处理结果，并在用户返回时刷新相关银行卡或支付状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，支付和银行卡管理流程的结果处理及后续刷新会中断。

en.description: When a user sets, recovers, or changes a PayEase Webox payment password, this Activity asks them to enter and confirm it, submits the new password, and displays the result.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from setting, recovering, or changing their PayEase payment password.

zh-CN.description: 用户设置、找回或修改 PayEase Webox 支付密码时，此 Activity 会要求输入并确认密码，提交新密码并显示处理结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法设置、找回或修改 PayEase 支付密码。

en.description: When a user opens PayEase Webox security settings, this Activity provides access to digital-certificate and password management and controls for face verification.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it removes access to these payment-security settings and their related setup flows.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 PayEase Webox 安全设置时，此 Activity 会提供数字证书和密码管理入口，以及人脸核验设置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法进入这些支付安全设置及其相关办理流程。

en.description: After PayEase Webox’s liveness check succeeds, this Activity displays the result and captured face image and offers retry or return options.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it interrupts the success-result flow after face verification.

zh-CN.description: PayEase Webox 活体检测通过后，此 Activity 会显示检测结果和采集到的人脸图像，并提供重试或返回选项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，人脸核验成功后的结果流程会中断。

en.description: When the app starts, this EllaBook provider supplies the application context needed by the book-reading SDK.
en.disableEffect: Without this startup initialization, opening an EllaBook book can fail if the SDK cannot recover the app context itself.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，EllaBook 内容提供程序会向阅读 SDK 提供所需的应用上下文。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，如果 SDK 无法自行获取应用上下文，通过 EllaBook 打开书籍可能会失败。

en.description: When the app opens a book with EllaBook, this landscape screen displays the book and handles reader controls as the session starts, pauses, and ends.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot open the EllaBook reading screen or use its reading controls.

zh-CN.description: 应用通过 EllaBook 打开书籍时，这个横屏页面会显示书籍，并在阅读开始、暂停和结束时处理阅读操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用无法打开 EllaBook 阅读页面或使用其中的阅读操作。
