en.description: The EllaBook SDK uses this temporary screen to request Android permissions for reader options, including microphone access for one reading mode.
en.disableEffect: Reader options that need permission cannot complete their access requests.

zh-CN.description: EllaBook SDK 使用这个临时页面申请阅读功能所需的 Android 权限，其中一种阅读模式会申请麦克风权限。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要权限的阅读功能将无法完成权限申请。

en.description: Tapping an Emarsys push notification opens this temporary screen, which processes the notification action or link and then closes.
en.disableEffect: Emarsys notification taps and their app or web links may no longer be handled.

zh-CN.description: 用户点按 Emarsys 推送通知后会打开此临时界面；它处理通知操作或链接，然后关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Emarsys 通知点击及其应用内或网页链接可能无法再处理。

en.description: When Android reports that startup is complete, this Emarsys receiver writes a startup message to the system log. Its code does not display a screen or register geofences.
en.disableEffect: No user-facing behavior in this receiver changes; only its startup log entry is lost.

zh-CN.description: Android 发出启动完成事件时，Emarsys 接收器会在系统日志中写入一条启动信息。该接收器代码不会显示界面或注册地理围栏。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 此接收器没有可见的用户操作；禁用后只会少一条启动日志。

en.description: When Android reports an Emarsys geofence transition, this receiver forwards the area, transition type, and event time to Emarsys Mobile Engage for campaign processing.
en.disableEffect: Emarsys location-based campaigns will no longer respond to geofence entry, exit, or dwell events.

zh-CN.description: Android 报告 Emarsys 地理围栏转换事件时，此接收器会把区域、转换类型和事件时间交给 Emarsys Mobile Engage 处理营销活动。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Emarsys 基于位置的营销活动将不再响应进入、离开或停留事件。

en.description: Emerge Tools opens this full-screen cover while running performance benchmarks and can display a short status message.
en.disableEffect: Emerge Tools cannot cover the app during performance tests, so benchmark isolation may fail; regular app use remains available.

zh-CN.description: Emerge Tools 运行性能基准测试时会打开此全屏遮罩，并可显示简短状态信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Emerge Tools 无法在性能测试期间遮挡应用内容，测试隔离可能失败；应用日常使用仍可进行。

en.description: The Empatica Link Bluetooth component bundled with SSJ connects to Empatica E3 and E4 wristbands. When the app searches for a band, it discovers nearby devices, subscribes to their readings, and forwards sensor data to the app.
en.disableEffect: Empatica wristband discovery, connection, and sensor data will stop.

zh-CN.description: 随 SSJ 打包的 Empatica Link 蓝牙组件用于连接 Empatica E3 和 E4 腕带。应用搜索腕带时，它会发现附近设备、订阅设备数据并将传感器读数传给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法发现或连接 Empatica 腕带，也无法接收其传感器数据。

en.description: EngageLab opens this translucent screen to handle push-platform messages and notification actions. It decodes incoming platform messages, forwards push events to EngageLab, and closes.
en.disableEffect: EngageLab push messages and notification taps may stop reaching the app; unrelated app screens continue to work.

zh-CN.description: EngageLab 会打开此半透明界面处理推送平台消息和通知操作。它解码平台消息、将推送事件转交给 EngageLab，然后关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: EngageLab 推送消息和通知点击可能无法再传到应用；应用的其他界面仍可使用。

en.description: At app startup, this provider initializes EngageLab lifecycle and network observers and prepares the SDK logging system.
en.disableEffect: EngageLab may miss app and network state changes, and its push features may not initialize; the app’s own screens are not provided by this component.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，此 Provider 会初始化 EngageLab 的生命周期和网络观察功能，并准备 SDK 日志系统。
zh-CN.disableEffect: EngageLab 可能无法获知应用和网络状态变化，其推送功能也可能无法初始化；应用自身界面并非由此组件提供。

en.description: When an event matches an EngageLab in-app campaign, this receiver forwards the event data to the in-app message manager. It also relays clicks from in-app message notifications.
en.disableEffect: EngageLab event-triggered in-app messages and their click reporting may stop.

zh-CN.description: EngageLab 应用内营销活动匹配事件到达时，此接收器会将事件数据交给应用内消息管理器，也会转发应用内通知的点击事件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: EngageLab 由事件触发的应用内消息及其点击记录可能停止。

en.description: When an event matches an EngageLab push campaign, this receiver forwards it to the push manager and relays notification clicks for campaign tracking.
en.disableEffect: EngageLab push event matching and notification click reporting may stop.

zh-CN.description: EngageLab 推送营销活动匹配事件到达时，此接收器会交给推送管理器处理，并转发通知点击以记录活动结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: EngageLab 推送事件匹配和通知点击记录可能停止。

en.description: Firebase Cloud Messaging sends push-token updates and incoming messages here, and this service passes them to EngageLab.
en.disableEffect: EngageLab can no longer register or receive Firebase-delivered push messages through this service.

zh-CN.description: Firebase Cloud Messaging 发送推送令牌更新或新消息时，此服务会接收并转交给 EngageLab。
zh-CN.disableEffect: EngageLab 将无法再通过此服务注册 Firebase 推送令牌或接收 Firebase 推送消息。

en.description: Honor Push sends token updates and incoming push messages to this service, which passes them to EngageLab.
en.disableEffect: EngageLab can no longer register or receive Honor-delivered push messages through this service.

zh-CN.description: Honor Push 发送令牌更新或新推送消息时，此服务会接收并转交给 EngageLab。
zh-CN.disableEffect: EngageLab 将无法再通过此服务注册 Honor 推送令牌或接收 Honor 推送消息。

en.description: Huawei Push sends token updates and incoming messages to this service, which passes them to EngageLab.
en.disableEffect: EngageLab can no longer register or receive Huawei-delivered push messages through this service.

zh-CN.description: Huawei Push 发送令牌更新或新推送消息时，此服务会接收并转交给 EngageLab。
zh-CN.disableEffect: EngageLab 将无法再通过此服务注册 Huawei 推送令牌或接收 Huawei 推送消息。

en.description: Meizu Push sends registration results and notification arrival, click, or deletion events to this receiver; it forwards them to EngageLab.
en.disableEffect: EngageLab’s Meizu push registration and notification handling may stop.

zh-CN.description: Meizu Push 会将注册结果以及通知到达、点击或删除事件发给此接收器；它再把这些事件交给 EngageLab。
zh-CN.disableEffect: EngageLab 的 Meizu 推送注册和通知处理可能停止。

en.description: Xiaomi Mi Push sends registration results, notification arrivals or clicks, and call messages to this EngageLab receiver. It forwards those events to EngageLab’s push or call handling.
en.disableEffect: Xiaomi-delivered EngageLab notifications stop, and apps that rely on its call messages may miss incoming calls.

zh-CN.description: Xiaomi Mi Push 会将注册结果、通知到达或点击以及通话消息发送给此 EngageLab 接收器；接收器会转交给 EngageLab 的推送或通话处理流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Xiaomi 渠道的 EngageLab 通知将停止；依赖此通话消息的应用可能无法收到来电。

en.description: Xiaomi Global Mi Push sends registration results, notification arrivals, and clicks to this receiver, which forwards them to EngageLab.
en.disableEffect: EngageLab’s Xiaomi global push registration and notification handling may stop.

zh-CN.description: Xiaomi Global Mi Push 会将注册结果、通知到达和点击事件发送给此接收器，再由它转交给 EngageLab。
zh-CN.disableEffect: EngageLab 的 Xiaomi Global 推送注册和通知处理可能停止。

en.description: OPPO HeyTap sends enhanced CallKit data messages here; the service forwards their call details to the app through EngageLab.
en.disableEffect: If the app uses this channel for incoming calls, blocking it can prevent those calls from reaching the app.

zh-CN.description: OPPO HeyTap 会将增强型 CallKit 数据消息发送到此服务；服务通过 EngageLab 把通话信息转交给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 如果应用通过此渠道接收来电，禁用后这些来电可能无法送达应用。

en.description: Vivo Push sends registration updates, foreground messages, and call messages here. This receiver passes them to EngageLab’s push and call handling.
en.disableEffect: Vivo-delivered EngageLab notifications stop, and apps that rely on its call messages may miss incoming calls.

zh-CN.description: Vivo Push 会将注册更新、前台消息和通话消息发送给此接收器；它再转交给 EngageLab 的推送和通话处理流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Vivo 渠道的 EngageLab 通知将停止；依赖此通话消息的应用可能无法收到来电。

en.description: Enioka Scan (Enioka) opens this Activity when the app starts its built-in barcode-scanning screen. It shows scanner status and recent results, supports manual barcode entry, and offers a camera option when the optional camera scanner is included.
en.disableEffect: Users lose the built-in scanning screen, including its scanner controls and manual-entry option.

zh-CN.description: Enioka Scan（Enioka）会在应用打开内置条码扫描界面时显示此 Activity。它展示扫描器状态和最近的扫描结果，支持手动输入条码；如果应用还集成了可选的相机扫描功能，也可以切换到相机扫描。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开内置扫描界面，也无法使用其中的扫描控制和手动输入功能。

en.description: When Enioka Scan searches for Bluetooth barcode readers, this service finds paired or newly connecting devices and connects supported readers so their scans can reach the app.
en.disableEffect: The app may no longer discover or use supported Bluetooth barcode readers, breaking scanning with those accessories.

zh-CN.description: Enioka Scan 搜索蓝牙条码扫描器时，此服务会查找已配对或新连接的设备，并连接受支持的扫描器，让应用能够接收扫描结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用可能无法再发现或使用受支持的蓝牙条码扫描器，导致这些设备无法扫描。

en.description: When Enioka Scan searches for a built-in scanner on an Athesi RD50TE/E5L handheld, this service makes that device's barcode reader available to the app.
en.disableEffect: Barcode scanning through the built-in reader on an Athesi RD50TE/E5L device stops working.

zh-CN.description: Enioka Scan 在 Athesi RD50TE/E5L 手持设备上搜索内置扫描器时，此服务会向应用提供该设备的条码读取器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Athesi RD50TE/E5L 设备的内置扫描器将无法再用于条码扫描。

en.description: When Enioka Scan searches an Athesi RD50TE handheld for its built-in reader, this service connects the RD50TE barcode scanner for app use.
en.disableEffect: The app can no longer scan barcodes with the built-in reader on an Athesi RD50TE device.

zh-CN.description: Enioka Scan 搜索 Athesi RD50TE 手持设备的内置扫描器时，此服务会连接该条码扫描器供应用使用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法再使用 Athesi RD50TE 设备的内置扫描器读取条码。

en.description: When Enioka Scan searches an Athesi SPA43LTE handheld for its built-in scanner, this service provides the device's barcode reader to the app.
en.disableEffect: Barcode scanning through the built-in reader on an Athesi SPA43LTE device stops working.

zh-CN.description: Enioka Scan 搜索 Athesi SPA43LTE 手持设备的内置扫描器时，此服务会向应用提供该设备的条码读取器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Athesi SPA43LTE 设备的内置扫描器将无法再用于条码扫描。

en.description: When Enioka Scan searches an Athesi SPA43LTE device for its built-in reader, this service connects the SPA43LTE barcode scanner for app use.
en.disableEffect: The app can no longer scan barcodes with the built-in reader on an Athesi SPA43LTE device.

zh-CN.description: Enioka Scan 搜索 Athesi SPA43LTE 设备的内置扫描器时，此服务会连接该设备的条码扫描器供应用使用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法再使用 Athesi SPA43LTE 设备的内置扫描器读取条码。

en.description: During Enioka Scan's scanner search, this service checks for Bluebird's barcode service and connects the integrated reader when it is available.
en.disableEffect: Bluebird devices can no longer provide barcode scans to the app through this integration.

zh-CN.description: Enioka Scan 搜索扫描器时，此服务会检查 Bluebird 条码服务；如果该服务可用，就连接设备的内置扫描器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法再通过此集成接收 Bluebird 设备扫描的条码。

en.description: When Enioka Scan discovers a GeneralScan Bluetooth barcode reader, this service checks the device and opens a scanner connection so its barcode data can be read by the app.
en.disableEffect: The app can no longer use supported GeneralScan Bluetooth barcode readers for scanning.

zh-CN.description: Enioka Scan 发现 GeneralScan 蓝牙条码扫描器时，此服务会检查设备并建立扫描连接，让应用能够读取条码数据。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法再使用受支持的 GeneralScan 蓝牙扫描器。

en.description: When Enioka Scan searches for Honeywell barcode readers, this service checks for Honeywell's scanning driver and lists available or connected readers for the app.
en.disableEffect: The app can no longer discover or scan with Honeywell readers supported by this driver.

zh-CN.description: Enioka Scan 搜索 Honeywell 条码扫描器时，此服务会检查 Honeywell 扫描驱动，并向应用列出可用或已连接的扫描器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法再发现或使用此驱动支持的 Honeywell 扫描器。

en.description: During scanner discovery on a Honeywell handheld, this service checks for Honeywell's built-in decode service and connects the integrated barcode reader.
en.disableEffect: The app can no longer scan barcodes with the integrated reader on supported Honeywell devices.

zh-CN.description: Honeywell 手持设备搜索扫描器时，此服务会检查 Honeywell 内置解码服务，并连接设备自带的条码读取器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法再使用受支持 Honeywell 设备的内置扫描器读取条码。

en.description: When Enioka Scan discovers a Honeywell Bluetooth barcode reader, this service checks its firmware response and connects compatible readers so the app can receive scans.
en.disableEffect: The app can no longer use supported Honeywell Bluetooth barcode readers for scanning.

zh-CN.description: Enioka Scan 发现 Honeywell 蓝牙条码扫描器时，此服务会检查其固件响应并连接兼容设备，让应用能够接收扫描结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法再使用受支持的 Honeywell 蓝牙扫描器。

en.description: When Enioka Scan searches for barcode readers, this service asks the Koamtac device software for available KDC scanners and connects any it finds.
en.disableEffect: The app can no longer discover or scan with Koamtac KDC readers through this integration.

zh-CN.description: Enioka Scan 搜索条码扫描器时，此服务会通过 Koamtac 设备软件查找可用的 KDC 扫描器，并连接发现的设备。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法再通过此集成发现或使用 Koamtac KDC 扫描器。

en.description: When Enioka Scan searches for a scanner, this service checks whether the M3 Ring Scanner app is available and enabled, then connects its ring scanner.
en.disableEffect: The app can no longer receive barcode scans from a supported M3 ring scanner.

zh-CN.description: Enioka Scan 搜索扫描器时，此服务会检查 M3 Ring Scanner 应用是否已安装并启用，然后连接其环形扫描器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法再接收受支持 M3 环形扫描器读取的条码。

en.description: During Enioka Scan's scanner search, this service checks for ProGlove's companion app and connects supported ProGlove Bluetooth barcode readers.
en.disableEffect: The app can no longer use supported ProGlove barcode readers for scanning.

zh-CN.description: Enioka Scan 搜索扫描器时，此服务会检查 ProGlove 配套应用，并连接受支持的 ProGlove 蓝牙条码扫描器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法再使用受支持的 ProGlove 条码扫描器。

en.description: When Enioka Scan searches for Zebra Bluetooth readers, this service checks for Zebra's scanner software and starts a search for compatible barcode devices.
en.disableEffect: The app can no longer discover or use Zebra Bluetooth barcode readers through this integration.

zh-CN.description: Enioka Scan 搜索 Zebra 蓝牙扫描器时，此服务会检查 Zebra 扫描软件，并开始查找兼容的条码设备。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法再通过此集成发现或使用 Zebra 蓝牙条码扫描器。

en.description: When Enioka Scan searches a Zebra handheld for its built-in barcode reader, this service checks for Zebra's device scanning software and connects the reader.
en.disableEffect: Barcode scanning through a supported Zebra handheld's built-in reader stops working.

zh-CN.description: Enioka Scan 搜索 Zebra 手持设备的内置条码扫描器时，此服务会检查 Zebra 设备扫描软件并连接扫描器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 受支持的 Zebra 手持设备将无法再使用内置扫描器读取条码。

en.description: During scanner discovery on a Zebra device, this service checks for Zebra's DataWedge scanning app and connects the barcode reader through it.
en.disableEffect: The app can no longer scan barcodes through DataWedge on supported Zebra devices.

zh-CN.description: Zebra 设备搜索扫描器时，此服务会检查 Zebra 的 DataWedge 扫描应用，并通过它连接条码扫描器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法再通过 DataWedge 使用受支持 Zebra 设备的条码扫描器。

en.description: When Enioka Scan checks nearby Zebra Bluetooth readers, this service identifies compatible low-energy Bluetooth scanners and connects them for barcode reading.
en.disableEffect: The app can no longer scan with supported Zebra low-energy Bluetooth barcode readers.

zh-CN.description: Enioka Scan 检查附近的 Zebra 蓝牙扫描器时，此服务会识别兼容的低功耗蓝牙扫描器并连接读取条码。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法再使用受支持的 Zebra 低功耗蓝牙扫描器。

en.description: When Enioka Scan checks connected Zebra Bluetooth readers, this service identifies compatible standard Bluetooth scanners and connects them for barcode reading.
en.disableEffect: The app can no longer scan with supported standard Bluetooth Zebra barcode readers.

zh-CN.description: Enioka Scan 检查已连接的 Zebra 蓝牙扫描器时，此服务会识别兼容的普通蓝牙扫描器并连接读取条码。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法再使用受支持的普通蓝牙 Zebra 扫描器。

en.description: When the app connects to Enioka Scan's scanning feature, this service finds available scanner integrations, initializes connected readers, and sends barcode results and scanner status back to the app.
en.disableEffect: The app can no longer start or receive results from the barcode scanners managed by Enioka Scan.

zh-CN.description: 应用连接 Enioka Scan 扫描功能时，此服务会查找可用的扫描器集成、初始化已连接的设备，并将条码结果和扫描器状态传回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法启动或接收 Enioka Scan 管理的条码扫描器结果。

en.description: The Enited Union account SDK uses this form to link a bank card to an account. It collects card details and a text-message verification code.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot link a bank card or complete account actions that require one.

zh-CN.description: 亿联体账户 SDK 使用此表单为账户绑定银行卡，并收集银行卡信息和短信验证码。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法绑定银行卡，也无法完成需要已绑定银行卡的账户操作。

en.description: When users choose to take a new account photo, the Enited Union account SDK opens the device camera and returns the captured image to the form.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot take a new photo from the SDK image picker.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择拍摄账户资料照片时，亿联体账户 SDK 会打开设备相机，并将拍摄的照片交回表单。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法从 SDK 图片选择页面拍摄新照片。

en.description: The Enited Union account SDK shows the user's identity details and ID-card images before opening a funds account. It also shows whether the account is already open.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open or check the status of their funds account through this screen.

zh-CN.description: 亿联体账户 SDK 会显示用户的身份信息和身份证照片，并提供开通资金账户的操作及账户状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过此页面开通资金账户或查看其状态。

en.description: The Enited Union account SDK uses this screen to replace the phone number linked to an account after the user enters a text-message verification code.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot change the phone number linked to their account through Enited Union.

zh-CN.description: 亿联体账户 SDK 使用此页面更换账户绑定的手机号，用户需要输入短信验证码。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过亿联体账户 SDK 更换绑定的手机号。

en.description: Users open this Enited Union screen to recover a forgotten password or change an existing password using a phone number and text-message code.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot reset or change their Enited Union account password here.

zh-CN.description: 用户可在亿联体此页面找回忘记的密码，或使用手机号和短信验证码修改现有密码。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法在此页面重置或修改亿联体账户密码。

en.description: When users tap a photo in the Enited Union image picker, this screen shows it full size and lets them swipe through the selected photos.
en.disableEffect: Users lose full-size photo review, and tapping a photo in the picker can fail to open its preview.

zh-CN.description: 用户在亿联体图片选择页面点选照片时，此页面会全屏显示照片，并可左右浏览已选照片。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法全屏查看照片；从选择页面点开照片预览也可能失败。

en.description: This Enited Union screen lets users choose one or more photos from device storage, or take a new photo, for an account form such as identity verification.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot select identity-card photos for Enited Union verification.

zh-CN.description: 亿联体此页面允许用户从设备存储中选择一张或多张照片，也可现场拍摄，用于身份认证等账户表单。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法为亿联体身份认证选择身份证照片。

en.description: This Enited Union screen shows a linked bank card and lets users add a card or remove the current one.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot view, add, or unlink a bank card through Enited Union.

zh-CN.description: 亿联体此页面会显示已绑定的银行卡，并允许用户添加银行卡或解绑当前银行卡。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过亿联体查看、添加或解绑银行卡。

en.description: This Enited Union screen collects a user's name, identity details, and images of both sides of an ID card. It checks the images and opens an online e-sign verification page to finish real-name verification.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot complete identity verification through this SDK.

zh-CN.description: 亿联体此页面会收集用户姓名、身份信息和身份证正反面照片，核验照片后打开线上电子签约页面完成实名认证。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过此 SDK 完成身份认证。

en.description: Enliple iBot opens the configured chatbot page inside the app when the chat is launched. The page can open web links, show the phone dialer, or open an email app.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open the Enliple iBot chat screen.

zh-CN.description: 启动聊天时，Enliple iBot 会在应用内打开已配置的聊天机器人页面；该页面可打开网页链接、电话拨号界面或邮件应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法打开 Enliple iBot 聊天页面。

en.description: The Enliple PayTalk SDK opens this screen when a user enters its friend and notification-message area; it displays the SDK's friend-message view. A PayTalk message notification can also open it.
en.disableEffect: Users can no longer open PayTalk friend conversations or notification messages from this screen.

zh-CN.description: Enliple PayTalk SDK 会在用户打开好友和通知消息区域时显示此界面；它展示 SDK 的好友消息页。用户也可以从 PayTalk 消息通知进入此界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，用户将无法通过此界面打开 PayTalk 好友会话或通知消息。

en.description: Enliple PayTalk opens an in-app web page when a user follows a link from a chat, news item, or product page. The SDK can synchronize advertising cookies before loading the page.
en.disableEffect: PayTalk links and product or news pages that use this screen will not open inside the app.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Enliple PayTalk 聊天、新闻或商品页面中点击链接时，SDK 会在应用内打开网页。SDK 也可能在加载页面前同步广告 Cookie。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，依赖此界面的 PayTalk 链接、商品页或新闻页将无法在应用内打开。

en.description: The Enliple PayTalk SDK opens this Activity for its channel browser, showing channel sections as tabs that users can switch between.
en.disableEffect: The PayTalk channel browser and its section tabs will not open.

zh-CN.description: Enliple PayTalk SDK 使用此 Activity 展示频道浏览页，并将频道内容分成可切换的标签页。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，PayTalk 频道浏览页及其内容标签将无法打开。

en.description: Enliple PayTalk displays this screen when a user opens liked posts; it shows the list of liked content and a back control.
en.disableEffect: Users lose access to their liked PayTalk posts through this screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Enliple PayTalk 中打开已点赞内容时，此界面会显示点赞列表和返回按钮。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，用户将无法通过此界面查看自己点赞的 PayTalk 内容。

en.description: Enliple PayTalk displays this screen when a user opens saved posts; it arranges the saved content in tabs.
en.disableEffect: Users lose access to saved PayTalk posts through this screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Enliple PayTalk 中打开收藏内容时，此界面会以标签页展示已收藏的帖子。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，用户将无法通过此界面查看已收藏的 PayTalk 帖子。

en.description: After a user taps a news image in Enliple PayTalk, this screen displays the images in a swipeable viewer and offers a reply action.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot view PayTalk news images in this viewer or open its reply screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Enliple PayTalk 中点击新闻图片后，此界面会打开可滑动浏览的图片查看器，并提供查看回复的入口。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，用户无法通过此查看器浏览 PayTalk 新闻图片或打开回复界面。

en.description: Enliple PayTalk's standalone video player opens this screen, which starts a sample video and provides playback, seeking, volume, and full-screen controls.
en.disableEffect: The PayTalk video player will not open, so videos routed through it cannot be watched there.

zh-CN.description: Enliple PayTalk 的独立视频播放器会打开此界面，播放示例视频并提供播放、拖动进度、音量和全屏控制。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，PayTalk 视频播放器将无法打开，通过它播放的视频也无法观看。

en.description: The Enliple PayTalk SDK uses this screen for one of its news-detail layouts; tapping the post's media area opens an image viewer.
en.disableEffect: This PayTalk news layout and the image viewer opened from it will be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: Enliple PayTalk SDK 使用此界面展示一种新闻详情版式；点击帖子的媒体区域会打开图片查看器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，这种 PayTalk 新闻详情页及其打开的图片查看器将无法使用。

en.description: Enliple PayTalk opens this screen for a standard news post, displaying the article details and opening a full image viewer when its image is tapped.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open this PayTalk article detail or view its images through the full-screen viewer.

zh-CN.description: Enliple PayTalk 会在用户打开普通新闻帖子时显示此界面，呈现文章详情，并在点击图片时打开全屏查看器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，用户无法打开此 PayTalk 文章详情页，也无法通过全屏查看器浏览其中的图片。

en.description: Enliple PayTalk opens this screen for a video-news post; it shows a video preview, starts playback, and opens the full player when tapped.
en.disableEffect: PayTalk video-news details and the player opened from them will be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: Enliple PayTalk 会在用户打开视频新闻时显示此界面，呈现视频预览并开始播放，点击后可进入完整播放器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，PayTalk 视频新闻详情页及其打开的播放器将无法使用。

en.description: Enliple PayTalk opens this screen when a user selects a post's replies; it shows the reply list and controls for writing or managing a reply.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot read or manage replies through PayTalk's dedicated reply screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Enliple PayTalk 中选择查看帖子回复时，此界面会显示回复列表，并提供撰写或管理回复的控件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，用户将无法通过 PayTalk 专用回复界面查看或管理回复。

en.description: Enliple PayTalk opens its chat and channel home when a user selects a friend, chat room, or channel route. It shows the section selected by the app.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to enter PayTalk chat and channel pages through these routes.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择好友、聊天室或频道入口时，Enliple PayTalk 会打开聊天和频道主页，并显示应用指定的内容版块。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过这些入口进入 PayTalk 聊天和频道页面。

en.description: When a user enters a PayTalk channel, this screen shows the channel page at the requested section, which can include chat or product content. Pressing Back returns a result to the screen that opened it.
en.disableEffect: The PayTalk channel page, including its chat and product sections, will not open.

zh-CN.description: 用户进入 PayTalk 频道时，此界面会打开指定的频道栏目，其中可包含聊天或商品内容。按返回键后，它会向打开此界面的页面返回结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，PayTalk 频道页面及其中的聊天、商品栏目将无法打开。

en.description: Enliple PayTalk opens this screen when a user enters a chat conversation; it displays the conversation view for reading and sending messages.
en.disableEffect: PayTalk chat conversations will not open, so users cannot read or send messages through this screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户进入聊天会话时，Enliple PayTalk 会打开此界面，供用户查看和发送消息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，PayTalk 聊天会话将无法打开，用户不能通过此界面查看或发送消息。

en.description: When Enliple PayTalk receives a chat message, this Service reports its receipt to PayTalk, updates open chat screens, and plays the message alert sound.
en.disableEffect: Incoming PayTalk messages may not be acknowledged or reflected in the chat screen, and the alert sound will stop.

zh-CN.description: Enliple PayTalk 收到聊天消息时，此 Service 会向 PayTalk 回报消息接收情况、更新已打开的聊天界面并播放提示音。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，收到的 PayTalk 消息可能无法回报或显示在聊天界面中，提示音也会停止。

en.description: When a user manages blocked notification sources in Enliple PayTalk, this screen displays the friend and channel blocking controls.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot manage blocked PayTalk notification sources through this screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Enliple PayTalk 中管理通知屏蔽对象时，此界面会显示好友和频道屏蔽控件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，用户无法通过此界面管理被屏蔽的 PayTalk 通知来源。

en.description: This screen displays Enliple PayTalk's notification-message preferences when the user opens its settings.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot change PayTalk notification-message preferences through this screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开设置时，此界面会显示 Enliple PayTalk 的通知消息偏好设置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，用户无法通过此界面更改 PayTalk 通知消息偏好设置。

en.description: Multiple Media Picker (Erika Gutiérrez) opens this screen when an app asks the user to choose media. It shows photos and videos in separate tabs and returns the selected items when the user confirms.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot open this gallery picker or receive the selected photos and videos.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求用户选择媒体文件时，Multiple Media Picker（Erika Gutiérrez）会打开此界面。它将照片和视频分栏显示，并在用户确认后把所选文件返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法打开此图库选择界面，也无法收到用户选择的照片和视频。

en.description: When a user opens a photo or video list in Multiple Media Picker, this screen displays the available files in a grid and lets them select or deselect multiple items.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot browse and select media in the picker, so app flows that need those files stop working.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Multiple Media Picker 中打开照片或视频列表时，此界面会以网格展示可用文件，并允许选择或取消选择多个项目。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在选择器中浏览和选择媒体文件，依赖这些文件的应用流程会受影响。

en.description: When a DLNA controller sends audio or video to the app, the Eryanet DLNA Service forwards the media address and title into the app’s playback flow.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot receive DLNA playback requests through this service.

zh-CN.description: DLNA 控制设备向应用发送音频或视频时，Eryanet DLNA 服务会将媒体地址和标题交给应用的播放流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法通过此服务接收 DLNA 播放请求。

en.description: EyLink starts this foreground Service when a remote-device session begins; it keeps the device connection and screen-mirroring session available.
en.disableEffect: EyLink remote-device control and screen mirroring stop working.

zh-CN.description: 远程设备会话开始时，EyLink 会启动此前台服务，以维持设备连接和屏幕镜像会话。
zh-CN.disableEffect: EyLink 的远程设备控制和屏幕镜像将无法使用。

en.description: When a supported USB accessory is attached, EyLink briefly runs this Activity to initialize the accessory connection.
en.disableEffect: EyLink cannot start its USB accessory connection after attachment.

zh-CN.description: 连接受支持的 USB 配件时，EyLink 会短暂运行此 Activity 来初始化配件连接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: USB 配件连接后，EyLink 将无法启动相应连接。

en.description: After the user enables EyLink’s accessibility access, this Service watches screen changes and performs gestures used by EyLink’s automated device-control features.
en.disableEffect: EyLink’s accessibility-based automation and remote control stop working.

zh-CN.description: 用户开启 EyLink 的无障碍权限后，此服务会观察屏幕变化并执行 EyLink 自动设备控制功能所需的手势。
zh-CN.disableEffect: EyLink 的无障碍自动操作和远程控制将无法使用。

en.description: When the user enables EyLink’s accessibility features, this transparent Activity opens Android Accessibility settings and returns after the user closes them.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot use this flow to guide the user to enable EyLink’s accessibility service.

zh-CN.description: 用户开启 EyLink 的无障碍功能时，此透明 Activity 会打开 Android 无障碍设置，并在用户关闭设置后返回。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法通过此流程引导用户开启 EyLink 无障碍服务。

en.description: When the app starts EyLink screen mirroring, this Activity briefly handles the screen-capture step and returns its result to the app.
en.disableEffect: EyLink screen-mirroring setup cannot complete.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动 EyLink 屏幕镜像时，此 Activity 会短暂处理屏幕捕获步骤，并将结果返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: EyLink 屏幕镜像无法完成启动流程。

en.description: The EyTV SDK starts this foreground Service to maintain a DLNA TV connection and send media selected from a TV device back to the app.
en.disableEffect: The app’s EyTV connection and media handoff from TV devices stop working.

zh-CN.description: EyTV SDK 会启动此前台服务来维持 DLNA 电视连接，并将电视设备选择的媒体信息发送回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用的 EyTV 连接以及电视设备向应用传递媒体的功能将无法使用。

en.description: When Android finishes booting, the EyTV SDK receiver runs its startup routine so the TV service can initialize without opening the app.
en.disableEffect: EyTV’s automatic startup after a device reboot is disabled.

zh-CN.description: Android 启动完成时，EyTV SDK 接收器会运行启动流程，使电视服务无需打开应用即可初始化。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 设备重启后，EyTV 将无法自动运行启动流程。

en.description: The NetAlo Chat SDK receives Google Play's install-referrer broadcast, saves the referral for attribution, and forwards it to other matching receivers in the same app.
en.disableEffect: Install-source attribution may stop being recorded; chat and calling can continue to work.

zh-CN.description: NetAlo 聊天 SDK 会接收 Google Play 的安装来源广播，保存来源信息用于归因，并将广播转发给同一应用中的其他匹配接收器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 安装来源归因可能不再记录；聊天和通话仍可继续使用。

en.description: The eSellTech YXF advertising SDK schedules this receiver for the next ad start time and refreshes active ad playlists so scheduled content can appear.
en.disableEffect: YXF ad playlists may not refresh when their scheduled start time arrives.

zh-CN.description: eSellTech YXF 广告 SDK 会在下一条广告的计划开始时间触发此接收器，并刷新当前广告列表以显示新内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: YXF 广告列表可能无法在计划开始时间刷新。

en.description: Espreccino’s PepperTalk chat library starts this Service when the app connects its chat client; it maintains the chat connection and sends or retries messages as connection state changes.
en.disableEffect: PepperTalk cannot connect or deliver messages, so the app’s chat feature will stop working.

zh-CN.description: 应用连接聊天客户端时，Espreccino 的 PepperTalk 聊天库会启动此 Service；它维持聊天连接，并在连接状态变化时发送或重试消息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 屏蔽后，PepperTalk 无法建立连接或传递消息，应用的聊天功能会停止工作。

en.description: When the host app opens a direct conversation, Espreccino’s PepperTalk chat library shows the selected person’s or topic’s messages in this Activity.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to open PepperTalk conversations, so the app’s chat feature will be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开与某位用户或某个主题的对话时，Espreccino 的 PepperTalk 聊天库会在此 Activity 展示聊天内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 屏蔽后，用户无法打开 PepperTalk 对话，应用的聊天功能将无法使用。

en.description: When the host app requests its conversation list, Espreccino’s PepperTalk chat library opens this Activity; choosing an entry opens that conversation.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to browse PepperTalk conversations or open a chat from the list.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求显示会话列表时，Espreccino 的 PepperTalk 聊天库会打开此 Activity；用户选择一项后即可进入对应对话。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 屏蔽后，用户无法浏览 PepperTalk 会话，也无法从列表进入聊天。

en.description: Espreccino’s PepperTalk chat library receives Android connectivity and Wi-Fi state changes here and uses them to update its chat connection when the device goes offline or changes networks.
en.disableEffect: The chat service will miss network-change notices and may not reconnect automatically after connectivity changes.

zh-CN.description: 设备断网或切换网络时，Espreccino 的 PepperTalk 聊天库会通过此 Receiver 接收 Android 的网络和 Wi-Fi 状态变化，并据此更新聊天连接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 屏蔽后，聊天服务收不到网络变化通知，网络切换后可能无法自动重新连接。

en.description: When the Estimote SDK finds Bluetooth or location requirements missing, this Activity asks the user to enable Bluetooth, grant location permission, or open location settings.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot be guided to meet missing Bluetooth or location requirements, which can prevent beacon features from working.

zh-CN.description: Estimote SDK 发现蓝牙或定位条件未满足时，会打开此 Activity，引导用户开启蓝牙、授予定位权限或进入定位设置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 屏蔽后，用户无法通过 SDK 的提示补齐蓝牙或定位条件，信标功能可能无法运行。

en.description: When an alarm scheduled for background scanning fires, the Estimote SDK uses this Receiver to wake its beacon-scanning Service again.
en.disableEffect: Background beacon scans will not be restarted by their scheduled alarms.

zh-CN.description: Estimote SDK 为后台扫描设定的闹钟到期时，会通过此 Receiver 再次唤起信标扫描 Service。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 屏蔽后，后台信标扫描不会再由预定闹钟重新启动。

en.description: When an app binds to Estimote scanning, this Service runs Bluetooth scans for beacon and nearable discovery, ranging, and region monitoring, then provides results to the app.
en.disableEffect: Estimote beacon and nearable discovery, ranging, and region monitoring will stop.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动 Estimote 扫描时会绑定此 Service；它通过蓝牙发现信标和近距离设备、测距并监控区域，再把结果提供给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 屏蔽后，Estimote 信标和近距离设备的发现、测距及区域监控都会停止。

en.description: When an app requests a connection to a configurable Estimote device, this bound Service provides the connection used to read or change device settings.
en.disableEffect: The app will not be able to connect to configurable Estimote devices to read or change their settings.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求连接可配置的 Estimote 设备时，会绑定此 Service；它提供读取或修改设备设置所需的连接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 屏蔽后，应用无法连接可配置的 Estimote 设备，也无法读取或修改其设置。

en.description: The Estimote SDK starts this background Service to send firmware updates over Bluetooth to an Estimote device and report update progress.
en.disableEffect: Firmware updates for Estimote devices will not complete.

zh-CN.description: Estimote SDK 会在升级设备固件时启动此后台 Service，通过蓝牙向 Estimote 设备发送固件并报告更新进度。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 屏蔽后，Estimote 设备无法通过此 SDK 完成固件升级。

en.description: The Estimote Proximity SDK uses this receiver for notification triggers tied to nearby beacons. It displays the configured notification when the device enters an Estimote beacon's range.
en.disableEffect: Notifications configured to appear near Estimote beacons will no longer appear, disabling any app feature that relies on those proximity alerts.

zh-CN.description: Estimote Proximity SDK 使用此 Receiver 处理与附近信标相关的通知触发器。设备进入 Estimote 信标范围时，它会显示已配置的通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 进入 Estimote 信标附近时将不再显示相应通知，依赖这类邻近提醒的应用功能也会失效。

en.description: When the legacy Estimote SDK finds Bluetooth or location requirements missing, this Activity asks the user to enable Bluetooth, grant location permission, or open location settings.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot be guided to meet missing Bluetooth or location requirements, which can prevent legacy beacon features from working.

zh-CN.description: 旧版 Estimote SDK 发现蓝牙或定位条件未满足时，会打开此 Activity，引导用户开启蓝牙、授予定位权限或进入定位设置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 屏蔽后，用户无法通过 SDK 的提示补齐蓝牙或定位条件，旧版信标功能可能无法运行。

en.description: When an app requests a connection to a configurable Estimote device, this legacy Estimote SDK Service provides the connection used to read or change device settings.
en.disableEffect: The app will not be able to connect to configurable Estimote devices to read or change their settings.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求连接可配置的 Estimote 设备时，旧版 Estimote SDK 会绑定此 Service，提供读取或修改设备设置所需的连接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 屏蔽后，应用无法连接可配置的 Estimote 设备，也无法读取或修改其设置。

en.description: The legacy Estimote SDK starts this background Service to send firmware updates over Bluetooth to an Estimote device and report update progress.
en.disableEffect: Firmware updates for Estimote devices will not complete.

zh-CN.description: 旧版 Estimote SDK 会在升级设备固件时启动此后台 Service，通过蓝牙向 Estimote 设备发送固件并报告更新进度。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 屏蔽后，Estimote 设备无法通过此 SDK 完成固件升级。

en.description: When the Estimote SDK binds for scanning, this Service manages Bluetooth beacon ranging and monitoring and reports detected beacons and locations to SDK clients.
en.disableEffect: Estimote and Rover beacon detection and region notifications will stop; unrelated app screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: Estimote SDK 绑定以进行扫描时，此 Service 会管理蓝牙信标测距和监测，并向 SDK 使用方报告检测到的信标及位置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Estimote 和 Rover 的信标检测及区域通知将停止；应用的其他界面仍可使用。

en.description: When an alarm for an Estimote SDK background scan fires, this Receiver restarts beacon scanning so the app can continue monitoring nearby devices.
en.disableEffect: Background beacon scans will not be restarted by their scheduled alarms.

zh-CN.description: Estimote SDK 的后台扫描闹钟到期时，此 Receiver 会重新启动信标扫描，让应用继续监测附近设备。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 屏蔽后，后台信标扫描不会再由预定闹钟重新启动。

en.description: The Send Anywhere Android SDK opens this Activity to list file-transfer tasks and show their progress and available actions.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to view or manage Send Anywhere transfer tasks in the SDK’s activity screen.

zh-CN.description: Send Anywhere Android SDK 会通过此 Activity 列出文件传输任务、显示进度并提供可用操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 屏蔽后，用户无法在 SDK 的传输页面查看或管理 Send Anywhere 任务。

en.description: When a Send Anywhere transfer notification is tapped in dialog mode, the SDK opens this temporary Activity, which immediately closes without showing a screen.
en.disableEffect: Tapping a transfer notification in dialog mode may fail because this temporary target cannot open.

zh-CN.description: 用户在对话框模式下点击 Send Anywhere 传输通知时，SDK 会打开此临时 Activity，并立即关闭，不显示页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 屏蔽后，对话框模式下点击传输通知可能无法完成跳转。

en.description: The Send Anywhere Android SDK opens this Activity when a user enters a transfer key; it checks the key and starts receiving files from another device.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to enter a transfer key here or receive files through this screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户输入传输码时，Send Anywhere Android SDK 会打开此 Activity 校验传输码，并开始从另一台设备接收文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 屏蔽后，用户无法通过此界面输入传输码或接收文件。

en.description: The Send Anywhere Android SDK’s QR scanner opens the camera, reads a code, and returns the decoded text to the app that launched it.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to scan transfer codes through this screen.

zh-CN.description: Send Anywhere Android SDK 的扫码页面会打开相机读取二维码，并把识别出的文字返回给启动它的应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 屏蔽后，用户无法通过此页面扫描传输二维码。

en.description: When the host app passes files or file links to Send Anywhere, this Activity displays the sending screen and starts a file transfer.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to send files through the Send Anywhere SDK.

zh-CN.description: 应用把文件或文件链接交给 Send Anywhere 时，此 Activity 会显示发送界面并开始文件传输。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 屏蔽后，用户无法通过 Send Anywhere SDK 发送文件。

en.description: When a user taps or dismisses a Send Anywhere transfer notification, this Service opens the transfer screen or clears the related notification.
en.disableEffect: Send Anywhere transfer notifications will no longer open their screen or be cleared through these actions.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击或清除 Send Anywhere 传输通知时，此 Service 会打开传输页面或清除相应通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 屏蔽后，Send Anywhere 传输通知无法通过这些操作打开页面或清除。

en.description: When a user taps a Send Anywhere transfer notification, this Service opens the send screen, receive screen, or task list that matches the transfer.
en.disableEffect: Tapping a transfer notification will no longer return users to the related transfer screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击 Send Anywhere 传输通知时，此 Service 会根据传输任务打开发送页、接收页或任务列表。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 屏蔽后，用户点击传输通知无法返回对应的传输页面。

en.description: When Google Cloud Messaging delivers a Send Anywhere transfer push, this Receiver checks for incoming send or receive requests, transfer keys, and peer-device changes.
en.disableEffect: Incoming transfer requests and key updates delivered through Send Anywhere push will not be picked up.

zh-CN.description: Google Cloud Messaging 收到 Send Anywhere 的传输推送时，此 Receiver 会检查新的发送或接收请求、传输码及对端设备状态变化。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 屏蔽后，Send Anywhere 推送中的传输请求和传输码更新不会被处理。

en.description: While Send Anywhere sends or receives files, its transfer manager binds this Service to run the transfer tasks and maintain their progress notification.
en.disableEffect: File transfers through the Send Anywhere SDK will not run.

zh-CN.description: Send Anywhere 发送或接收文件时，传输管理器会绑定此 Service 来运行传输任务并维护进度通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 屏蔽后，Send Anywhere SDK 无法运行文件传输。

en.description: Etienne Lawlor’s ImageGallery opens a supplied set of images full screen at the selected starting position. The user can move through the images in the gallery.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot open this library’s full-screen image gallery.

zh-CN.description: Etienne Lawlor 的 ImageGallery 会从指定起始位置全屏打开应用提供的一组图片。用户可以在图库中切换浏览这些图片。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用无法打开此库提供的全屏图片浏览页面。

en.description: When Firebase refreshes the device’s messaging token, the Eventflit Android WebSocket library passes the new token to its registered push-token handler.
en.disableEffect: Eventflit push registration will stop receiving refreshed tokens, so its notifications may stop reaching the app.

zh-CN.description: Firebase 刷新设备的消息令牌时，Eventflit Android WebSocket 库会把新令牌交给已注册的推送令牌处理器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 屏蔽后，Eventflit 推送注册收不到更新的令牌，通知可能无法送达应用。

en.description: When Firebase refreshes the device’s messaging token, the Eventflit Push Notifications SDK passes it to the app’s configured token-refresh handler.
en.disableEffect: Eventflit may stop registering updated tokens, so future push notifications may not reach the app.

zh-CN.description: Firebase 刷新设备的消息令牌时，Eventflit Push Notifications SDK 会把新令牌交给应用配置的令牌更新处理器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 屏蔽后，Eventflit 可能无法注册更新后的令牌，之后的推送通知可能无法送达应用。

en.description: When Firebase delivers an Eventflit push message, this Service passes it to the app’s configured notification handler.
en.disableEffect: Eventflit push messages will no longer be delivered to the app’s configured handler.

zh-CN.description: Firebase 送达 Eventflit 推送消息时，此 Service 会把消息交给应用配置的通知处理器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 屏蔽后，Eventflit 推送消息不会再交给应用的处理器。

en.description: At app startup, the Eventflit Push Notifications SDK refreshes saved subscription and device-version details and registers app lifecycle tracking used for notification reports.
en.disableEffect: Eventflit’s startup registration and notification-reporting setup will not run, while the app’s regular screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，Eventflit Push Notifications SDK 会更新已保存的订阅和设备版本信息，并注册用于通知报告的应用生命周期跟踪。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 屏蔽后，Eventflit 的启动注册和通知报告设置不会运行，应用的普通页面仍可使用。

en.description: When Google Cloud Messaging delivers an Eventflit message with tracking data, this Receiver queues a delivery report for the Eventflit push service.
en.disableEffect: Eventflit will stop recording delivery reports for received pushes; message handling through the other service is unaffected.

zh-CN.description: Google Cloud Messaging 收到带有跟踪信息的 Eventflit 消息时，此 Receiver 会为 Eventflit 推送服务排队提交送达报告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 屏蔽后，Eventflit 不再记录已收到推送的送达报告；其他服务处理消息的流程不受影响。

en.description: When a tracked Eventflit notification is opened, this Activity records the open and launches the app screen selected by the notification.
en.disableEffect: Tapping a tracked Eventflit notification will no longer open its selected app screen through the SDK.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开带跟踪信息的 Eventflit 通知时，此 Activity 会记录打开情况，并启动通知指定的应用页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 屏蔽后，点击带跟踪信息的 Eventflit 通知无法通过 SDK 打开指定页面。

en.description: When the Eventflit push SDK schedules a delivery or open report, this Service submits that report to Eventflit in the background.
en.disableEffect: Eventflit delivery and open reports will no longer be submitted; push delivery itself is handled separately.

zh-CN.description: Eventflit 推送 SDK 安排送达或打开报告后，此 Service 会在后台把报告提交给 Eventflit。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 屏蔽后，Eventflit 不再收到送达和打开报告；推送送达由其他流程处理。

en.description: When Android opens a link using the configured Evergage URL scheme, the Evergage Android SDK handles the link in this hidden Activity and then closes it; the SDK manifest disables it by default.
en.disableEffect: Evergage campaign or test links using that URL scheme will not be processed, while regular app screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: Android 打开使用已配置 Evergage URL scheme 的链接时，Evergage Android SDK 会在此隐藏 Activity 中处理链接并随即关闭；SDK 清单默认将它禁用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 屏蔽后，使用该 URL scheme 的 Evergage 活动或测试链接不会被处理，应用普通页面仍可使用。

en.description: When the device boots, quick-boots, or replaces the app, this Evernote Android-Job receiver initializes the job library so saved background jobs can be restored.
en.disableEffect: Scheduled jobs may be lost after a device restart or app update.

zh-CN.description: 设备启动、快速启动或应用更新后，此 Evernote Android-Job Receiver 会初始化任务库，以恢复已保存的后台任务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，设备重启或应用更新后可能无法恢复定时任务。

en.description: When the Evernote Android-Job library repairs its schedule, this service checks saved requests and resubmits jobs missing from Android's scheduler.
en.disableEffect: Jobs removed from Android's scheduler will not be restored by the library.

zh-CN.description: Evernote Android-Job 库修复任务计划时，此 Service 会检查已保存的请求，并重新提交 Android 调度器中缺失的任务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Android 调度器中丢失的任务将无法由此库恢复。

en.description: When Google Play services runs a tagged network task for Evernote Android-Job, this service executes the matching scheduled background job.
en.disableEffect: Background jobs scheduled through Google Play services will not run.

zh-CN.description: Google Play 服务执行 Evernote Android-Job 的网络任务时，此 Service 会运行对应的定时后台任务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，通过 Google Play 服务调度的后台任务将无法运行。

en.description: The patched Evernote Android Job library bundled with Yandex MapKit restores saved background tasks after device boot, quick boot, or an app update; MapKit uses these jobs for offline-map downloads.
en.disableEffect: After a reboot or update, Yandex MapKit's scheduled offline-map downloads may not resume.

zh-CN.description: 随 Yandex MapKit 打包的修订版 Evernote Android Job 库会在设备启动、快速启动或应用更新后恢复已保存的后台任务；MapKit 使用这些任务进行离线地图下载。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 重启设备或更新应用后，Yandex MapKit 已安排的离线地图下载可能无法继续。

en.description: When the patched Evernote Android Job library bundled with Yandex MapKit repairs its schedule, this Service checks saved jobs and restores those missing from the system; MapKit uses the jobs for offline-map downloads.
en.disableEffect: Offline-map download jobs with a lost schedule may remain stopped instead of being restored.

zh-CN.description: Yandex MapKit 附带的 Evernote Android Job 库修复任务计划时，会通过此 Service 检查已保存的任务并恢复系统中缺失的任务；MapKit 使用这些任务进行离线地图下载。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 离线地图下载任务的计划丢失后，可能会一直停止，无法自动恢复。

en.description: When a scheduled alarm fires, the patched Evernote Android Job library bundled with Yandex MapKit routes it to the matching background task; MapKit uses this scheduler for offline-map downloads.
en.disableEffect: Offline-map download jobs using the library's alarm fallback may not start when due.

zh-CN.description: 定时闹钟触发时，随 Yandex MapKit 打包的修订版 Evernote Android Job 库会将其转交给对应的后台任务；MapKit 使用此调度器下载离线地图。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用该库闹钟备用调度的离线地图下载任务可能无法按时启动。

en.description: The patched Evernote Android Job library bundled with Yandex MapKit starts this Service when an ordinary scheduled alarm fires and runs the due task; MapKit uses the library for offline-map downloads.
en.disableEffect: Offline-map download jobs scheduled through this alarm service will not run.

zh-CN.description: 普通定时闹钟触发后，随 Yandex MapKit 打包的修订版 Evernote Android Job 库会启动此 Service 并执行到期任务；MapKit 使用此库下载离线地图。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过此闹钟服务安排的离线地图下载任务将无法运行。

en.description: The patched Evernote Android Job library bundled with Yandex MapKit starts this Service when an exact-time alarm fires and runs the scheduled task; MapKit uses the same job library for offline-map downloads.
en.disableEffect: Exact-time background tasks scheduled through this service will not run, so app features that rely on them may stop.

zh-CN.description: 精确时间闹钟触发时，随 Yandex MapKit 打包的修订版 Evernote Android Job 库会启动此 Service 并执行对应任务；MapKit 使用同一任务库下载离线地图。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过此服务安排的精确时间后台任务将无法运行，依赖它们的应用功能可能停止。

en.description: When Android's job scheduler reports a task is due, the patched Evernote Android Job library bundled with Yandex MapKit runs it through this Service; MapKit uses these jobs for offline-map downloads.
en.disableEffect: Yandex MapKit offline-map downloads scheduled through Android's job scheduler will not run.

zh-CN.description: Android 系统任务调度器报告任务到期时，随 Yandex MapKit 打包的修订版 Evernote Android Job 库会通过此 Service 执行任务；MapKit 使用这些任务下载离线地图。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 交由 Android 系统任务调度器运行的 Yandex MapKit 离线地图下载将无法执行。

en.description: When an Evernote Android-Job alarm fires, this receiver forwards the scheduled work to the service for ordinary or exact alarm jobs.
en.disableEffect: Jobs started by the library's alarm receiver will not be delivered.

zh-CN.description: Evernote Android-Job 的闹钟触发时，此 Receiver 会把普通或精确定时任务交给相应的 Service。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，由此闹钟 Receiver 启动的任务将无法执行。

en.description: After the Evernote Android-Job alarm receiver delivers a regular alarm, this service runs the saved background job.
en.disableEffect: Background jobs scheduled through regular alarms will not run.

zh-CN.description: Evernote Android-Job 的闹钟 Receiver 送达普通闹钟后，此 Service 会运行已保存的后台任务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，通过普通闹钟安排的后台任务将无法运行。

en.description: When an exact Evernote Android-Job alarm is due, this service runs its saved job and releases the wake lock when the work finishes.
en.disableEffect: Jobs that depend on exact alarms will not run.

zh-CN.description: Evernote Android-Job 的精确闹钟到期时，此 Service 会运行已保存的任务，并在结束后释放唤醒锁。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，依赖精确闹钟的任务将无法运行。

en.description: When Android's JobScheduler starts an Evernote Android-Job task, this service runs the saved work and reports completion to Android.
en.disableEffect: Jobs scheduled through Android's JobScheduler will not run.

zh-CN.description: Android 的 JobScheduler 启动 Evernote Android-Job 任务时，此 Service 会运行已保存的任务并向 Android 报告完成状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，通过 Android JobScheduler 安排的任务将无法运行。

en.description: The Evernote SDK opens this screen during account authorization. It displays the sign-in page and returns the authorization result to the app.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot complete Evernote account authorization, so connected Evernote features will not work.

zh-CN.description: Evernote SDK 在账号授权时打开此界面，显示登录页面，并将授权结果返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法完成 Evernote 账号授权，依赖 Evernote 账号的功能将无法使用。

en.description: The Evernote SDK uses this screen to start account login, show progress, and return whether sign-in succeeded.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot sign in to Evernote, so app features that need an Evernote account cannot connect.

zh-CN.description: Evernote SDK 使用此界面发起账号登录、显示进度，并返回登录是否成功。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法登录 Evernote，依赖 Evernote 账号的应用功能也无法连接。

en.description: Evokly’s beacon and geofence marketing SDK opens this full-screen Activity when a user follows one of its campaign links, showing the campaign content and acting on taps.
en.disableEffect: Evokly campaign cards and their in-app links will not open.

zh-CN.description: Evokly 的信标与地理围栏营销 SDK 会在用户打开推广链接时显示全屏推广内容，并处理用户点击后的操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Evokly 的推广页面及其应用内跳转将无法打开。

en.description: When an Evokly trigger asks for an in-app notification, this Activity shows the message and lets the user follow its action.
en.disableEffect: Evokly’s in-app campaign prompts and their action links will not appear.

zh-CN.description: 当 Evokly 的营销触发条件要求显示应用内通知时，此页面会展示消息，并允许用户打开相关操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Evokly 的应用内推广提示及其跳转不会显示。

en.description: When Evokly’s scheduled upload alarm fires, this Receiver starts the background job that sends queued activity and proximity records.
en.disableEffect: Queued Evokly activity, beacon, and geofence records will stop uploading on schedule.

zh-CN.description: Evokly 计划的上传闹钟触发时，此接收器会启动后台任务，发送排队等待的活动、信标和地理围栏记录。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，排队等待上传的 Evokly 活动、信标和地理围栏记录将不再按计划发送。

en.description: When the SDK starts an upload, this Service sends queued app events and beacon or geofence activity to Evokly’s server.
en.disableEffect: Evokly will stop receiving these analytics and proximity records.

zh-CN.description: Evokly 的上传任务启动时，此后台服务会把应用事件以及信标和地理围栏活动记录发送到服务器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Evokly 将收不到这些分析和附近活动记录。

en.description: When Evokly’s scheduled configuration-refresh alarm fires, this Receiver starts a sync if one is not already running.
en.disableEffect: Evokly configuration will no longer refresh automatically, so new campaign and trigger settings may not arrive.

zh-CN.description: 当 Evokly 安排的配置刷新闹钟触发时，如果当前没有同步任务，此接收器会启动配置同步。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Evokly 配置将不再自动刷新，新的推广活动和触发设置可能无法及时更新。

en.description: When a refresh is requested, this Service downloads the current Evokly configuration and imports it into the SDK’s local data.
en.disableEffect: Evokly campaign and trigger settings will no longer update from the server.

zh-CN.description: Evokly 请求刷新设置时，此服务会从服务器获取当前配置并更新 SDK 本地保存的内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Evokly 的推广活动和触发设置将无法从服务器更新。

en.description: When Evokly’s diagnostics screen is opened, this Activity shows current beacon, action, and trigger data and offers a manual refresh.
en.disableEffect: Only Evokly’s diagnostics screen will be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: 打开 Evokly 的调试页面时，此页面展示当前信标、操作和触发规则，并可手动刷新设置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Evokly 的调试页面将无法打开。

en.description: When a configured Evokly geofence is entered or exited, this Receiver passes the location change to the SDK’s campaign triggers.
en.disableEffect: Evokly campaigns tied to entering or leaving places will not trigger.

zh-CN.description: 当设备进入或离开已配置的 Evokly 地理围栏时，此接收器会把位置变化交给 SDK 的营销触发系统处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，与进入或离开地点相关的 Evokly 推广将不会触发。

en.description: After Android reports that the device has restarted, this Receiver resumes Evokly’s background service when saved settings allow it.
en.disableEffect: Evokly beacon and geofence campaigns will not resume automatically after a reboot.

zh-CN.description: Android 通知设备启动完成后，如果 Evokly 保存的设置允许后台运行，此接收器会重新启动 SDK 后台服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Evokly 的信标和地理围栏活动在设备重启后不会自动恢复。

en.description: When Evokly background operation starts, this Service connects beacon and geofence monitoring, runs matching campaign triggers, and schedules configuration refresh and reporting around network availability.
en.disableEffect: Evokly proximity campaigns, automatic refresh, and related reporting may stop.

zh-CN.description: Evokly 后台服务启动时，此服务连接信标和地理围栏监测、执行匹配的营销触发条件，并按网络情况安排配置刷新和数据上报。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Evokly 的附近推广、自动刷新和相关数据上报可能停止。

en.description: When Evokly requests beacon monitoring, this Service loads saved beacon regions and supplies nearby beacon updates to the campaign trigger system.
en.disableEffect: Beacon-based Evokly messages and actions will stop working.

zh-CN.description: Evokly 请求监测信标时，此服务读取已保存的信标区域，并向营销触发系统提供附近信标变化。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，基于 Evokly 信标的推广消息和操作将无法触发。

en.description: When Android delivers an enter or exit event for a configured location, this Service forwards the change to Evokly’s campaign triggers.
en.disableEffect: Evokly messages and actions tied to entering or leaving monitored places will not trigger.

zh-CN.description: Android 送达已配置地点的进入或离开事件时，此服务会将变化通知 Evokly 的营销触发系统。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，与进入或离开监测地点有关的 Evokly 消息和操作将不会触发。

en.description: When Evokly sets up a location campaign, this Service registers and manages its monitored areas and supplies their state changes to the SDK.
en.disableEffect: Evokly location-based campaigns will not trigger.

zh-CN.description: Evokly 设置位置营销活动时，此服务登记并管理监测区域，并向 SDK 提供区域状态变化。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Evokly 基于位置的推广活动将不会触发。

en.description: WonderAndroid’s Amazon ads integration opens this screen to display a full-screen native ad with its media, app details, and action button.
en.disableEffect: Full-screen native ads from this integration will no longer appear.

zh-CN.description: WonderAndroid 的 Amazon 广告适配会打开此页面，展示包含媒体内容、应用信息和操作按钮的全屏原生广告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 此适配提供的全屏原生广告将不再显示。

en.description: WonderAndroid’s Amazon ads integration opens this screen to show a custom ad, including its media or video and destination when tapped.
en.disableEffect: Custom ads from this integration will no longer open or play.

zh-CN.description: WonderAndroid 的 Amazon 广告适配会打开此页面展示自定义广告，包括图片或视频以及点击后的目标页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 此适配提供的自定义广告将无法打开或播放。

en.description: WonderAndroid’s Google and Google MAX ad integrations use this Firebase service when an SDK push message or device-token update arrives. It handles the message, can show its notification, and forwards the token to the ad SDK.
en.disableEffect: The ad integrations will stop receiving their Firebase messages and showing related notifications.

zh-CN.description: WonderAndroid 的 Google 和 Google MAX 广告适配会在收到 SDK 推送消息或设备令牌更新时使用此 Firebase 服务。它处理消息、显示相关通知，并把令牌传给广告 SDK。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 这些广告适配将无法接收 Firebase 消息或显示相关通知。

en.description: The 3akat Android TV Paused Ads library opens a video player for ad content supplied by the host app and returns the ad-skip action to the host.
en.disableEffect: Video ads routed through this library screen will no longer appear.

zh-CN.description: 3akat Android TV Paused Ads 库会打开视频播放器展示应用提供的广告内容，并将跳过广告的操作返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过此库页面播放的视频广告将不再显示。

en.description: The qstorage (CompatScopeStorage) demo by lckjcnWq opens this screen at launch and requests storage access. Its controls demonstrate creating a file, deleting it, and looking up its saved path through Android scoped storage.
en.disableEffect: The app's scoped-storage demo screen and its file operations will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: lckjcnWq 的 qstorage（CompatScopeStorage）示例应用启动后会打开此界面并请求存储权限。界面按钮演示通过 Android 分区存储创建文件、删除文件以及查询文件路径。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用的分区存储示例界面及其文件操作将无法打开。

en.description: Captain Miao's Grantap Android permission library opens this Activity when the app asks for sensitive access, such as the camera; it explains the request, shows Android's permission prompt, and returns the user's choice.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot use Grantap's permission flow, so features that need those permissions may not start.

zh-CN.description: Captain Miao 的 Grantap Android 权限库会在应用请求相机等敏感权限时打开此 Activity；它会说明请求原因、显示 Android 权限提示，并返回用户的选择。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用无法使用 Grantap 的权限申请流程，因此依赖这些权限的功能可能无法启动。

en.description: Tengjijing contactspicker reads contacts after access is granted, shows a searchable list, and returns the contacts the user selects.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot open this contact picker or receive the selected contacts.

zh-CN.description: Tengjijing contactspicker 会在获得联系人访问权限后显示可搜索的联系人列表，用户可多选并将结果返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用无法打开此联系人选择器或接收用户选择的联系人。

en.description: When the sampleDalCapture sample app is launched, this Activity loads the app's main screen. It is registered as the app's launcher entry point.
en.disableEffect: The sample app loses its launcher screen and may no longer open from its app icon.

zh-CN.description: 启动 sampleDalCapture 示例应用时，这个 Activity 会加载应用主界面。它被注册为应用的启动入口。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 示例应用会失去启动界面，用户可能无法通过应用图标打开它。

en.description: The DemoLibMavenCentral test library by Aman Satija registers this launcher screen, which displays a basic sample page when opened.
en.disableEffect: The demo launcher screen will not open; if it is the sole launcher, the app will no longer start from its icon.

zh-CN.description: Aman Satija 的 DemoLibMavenCentral 是测试库；应用通过此启动页面打开时，会显示带有示例文字的简单演示页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后演示启动页面将无法打开；如果它是应用唯一的启动入口，应用将无法从图标启动。

en.description: When the host app opens Sebastian Schipor's DemoLibrary payment SDK screen, this Activity shows a mostly empty sample page and sends a card-data request with empty values. Its button only displays a placeholder message.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot open this SDK's payment sample page or run its card-data request.

zh-CN.description: 宿主应用打开 Sebastian Schipor 的 DemoLibrary 支付 SDK 页面时，此 Activity 会显示基本为空的示例页，并发送字段为空的银行卡数据请求。页面按钮只会显示占位提示。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法打开此 SDK 的支付示例页，也不会执行其中的银行卡数据请求。

en.description: The Dummy Library sample app opens its greeting screen when launched from the app icon. The page contains only a "Hello World!" message.
en.disableEffect: The sample app will have no launcher screen, so users cannot open it from the app icon.

zh-CN.description: 从应用图标启动 Dummy Library 示例应用时，会显示问候页面；页面只有一句“Hello World!”。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，示例应用将没有可从应用图标打开的启动页面。

en.description: Hassan Mirza's Intergrate_arr Flutter integration sample opens this Activity for its native demo controls and starts a Flutter engine. Its buttons send sample game-report and API-key status messages to the app.
en.disableEffect: The sample's native demo screen and its event-report controls will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: Hassan Mirza 的 Intergrate_arr Flutter 集成示例会打开此 Activity 显示原生演示控件，并启动 Flutter 引擎。页面按钮会向应用发送示例游戏报告和 API 密钥状态消息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 示例的原生演示页面及其事件报告控件将无法打开。

en.description: Hassan Mirza's Intergrate_arr Flutter integration sample registers this Activity as the app's launcher and starts the main Flutter screen. It passes API-key and email-selection results between the Flutter page and the app.
en.disableEffect: The sample app will lose its launcher screen, so its main Flutter experience cannot start.

zh-CN.description: Hassan Mirza 的 Intergrate_arr Flutter 集成示例将此 Activity 注册为应用入口，并启动 Flutter 主页面。它会在 Flutter 页面与应用之间传递 API 密钥和邮箱选择结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 示例应用将失去启动入口，因此无法启动其 Flutter 主界面。

en.description: Starts when an app uses the Interswitch Smart Till SDK to open a Bluetooth till connection. It keeps the connection available for payment commands and terminal replies.
en.disableEffect: Bluetooth till payments and terminal communication stop working.

zh-CN.description: 应用通过 Interswitch Smart Till SDK 连接蓝牙收银终端时，此服务会启动并保持连接，以传送支付指令和终端回复。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法通过蓝牙收银终端进行支付或收发交易数据。

en.description: Runs when the Interswitch Smart Till SDK reports a Bluetooth connection change or receives a terminal message. It passes connection status, errors and transaction replies to the app.
en.disableEffect: The app may not receive Bluetooth till status or transaction replies, so payments through that terminal can fail.

zh-CN.description: Interswitch Smart Till SDK 报告蓝牙连接状态变化或收到终端消息时，此接收器会把连接状态、错误和交易回复传给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用可能无法收到蓝牙终端状态或交易回复，导致通过该终端进行的支付失败。

en.description: Starts when an app selects a USB-connected till through the Interswitch Smart Till SDK. It connects to the till and carries payment and status messages between the terminal and app.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot communicate with a USB-connected till or complete payments through it.

zh-CN.description: 应用通过 Interswitch Smart Till SDK 选择 USB 收银终端时，此服务会启动并连接终端，在应用与终端之间传送支付和状态消息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法与 USB 收银终端通信，也无法通过它完成支付。

en.description: JCPlayer (Jean Carlos) uses this Receiver for taps on the audio playback notification. It handles play, pause, next-track and previous-track requests.
en.disableEffect: Audio may keep playing, but the playback notification buttons will stop controlling it.

zh-CN.description: JCPlayer（Jean Carlos）通过此 Receiver 处理音频播放通知上的点击。它响应播放、暂停、下一首和上一首操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 音频可能仍会播放，但通知上的播放控制按钮将无法使用。

en.description: JCPlayer (Jean Carlos) binds this Service for playlist audio playback. It plays the selected track from its supplied web address and reports playback progress and completion to the app and its notification.
en.disableEffect: The app may lose playlist audio playback that relies on this Service.

zh-CN.description: JCPlayer（Jean Carlos）通过此 Service 播放播放列表中的音频。它从应用提供的网址播放曲目，并向应用和播放通知报告进度与完成状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此 Service 的播放列表音频功能可能无法使用。

en.description: JCPlayer (Jean Carlos) uses this Receiver for taps on the audio playback notification. It handles play, pause, next-track and previous-track requests.
en.disableEffect: Audio may keep playing, but the playback notification buttons will stop controlling it.

zh-CN.description: JCPlayer（Jean Carlos）通过此 Receiver 处理音频播放通知上的点击。它响应播放、暂停、下一首和上一首操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 音频可能仍会播放，但通知上的播放控制按钮将无法使用。

en.description: JCPlayer (Jean Carlos) binds this Service for playlist audio playback. It plays tracks from a web address, device file or app resource and reports playback progress and completion to the app and its notification.
en.disableEffect: The app may lose playlist audio playback that relies on this Service.

zh-CN.description: JCPlayer（Jean Carlos）通过此 Service 播放播放列表中的音频。曲目可来自网址、本地文件或应用资源，播放进度与完成状态会反馈给应用和播放通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此 Service 的播放列表音频功能可能无法使用。

en.description: JcPlayer (Jean C. Sanchez) binds this service when the app starts audio playback. It manages the audio player and reports playback state and progress to the app's controls.
en.disableEffect: Audio playback through JcPlayer will stop working.

zh-CN.description: 应用开始播放音频时，JcPlayer（Jean C. Sanchez）会绑定此服务。它管理音频播放，并向应用的控制界面报告播放状态和进度。
zh-CN.disableEffect: JcPlayer 的音频播放将无法使用。

en.description: JcPlayer sends this receiver play, pause, next, or previous commands when the user taps a playback notification control. It passes those commands to the audio player.
en.disableEffect: The playback notification's controls will stop responding.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击播放通知中的控制按钮时，JcPlayer 会通过此接收器传递播放、暂停、上一首或下一首指令。它将指令交给音频播放器处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 播放通知中的控制按钮将无法响应。

en.description: When the KeepAlive library starts this service, it shows an ongoing notification to keep the service in the foreground and removes the notification when it stops.
en.disableEffect: The library will lose this foreground keep-alive, so its background service may stop running.

zh-CN.description: KeepAlive 库启动此服务时会显示持续通知，使服务保持在前台；服务停止后会移除通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，该库将无法通过此服务保持前台运行，后台服务可能停止。

en.description: When the SAWebView SDK opens its browser screen, it loads the supplied web page inside the app and provides back and close controls.
en.disableEffect: Web pages that the app opens through this SAWebView screen will not load.

zh-CN.description: SAWebView SDK 打开浏览器页面时，会在应用内加载传入的网页，并提供返回和关闭控件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，应用通过 SAWebView 页面打开的网页将无法加载。

en.description: When the SAWebView SDK opens this browser screen, it loads the supplied web address in an in-app page beneath a toolbar.
en.disableEffect: Web pages that the app opens through this SAWebView screen will not load.

zh-CN.description: SAWebView SDK 打开此浏览器页面时，会在工具栏下方的应用内页面中加载传入的网址。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，应用通过此 SAWebView 页面打开的网页将无法加载。

en.description: The BinduMCX Maven Central Demo SDK exposes this as a launcher entry, but it only calculates a number's factorial and has no usable screen. Opening the library's entry therefore does not show a working demo page.
en.disableEffect: Removing it hides only this demo entry; the host app's own screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: BinduMCX Maven Central Demo SDK 将此项作为启动入口，但它只计算数字的阶乘，没有可用界面。打开该示例入口无法显示正常的演示页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后只会移除此示例入口，不影响宿主应用自己的页面。

en.description: The Bolttech MY MavenLibClient2 sample Activity opens a simple demo page labeled “Activity maven lib.”
en.disableEffect: Disabling it hides this sample screen.

zh-CN.description: Bolttech MY 的 MavenLibClient2 示例界面会打开一个仅显示“Activity maven lib”的简单演示页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，此示例页面将无法打开。

en.description: The MavenTest card-view library includes an Activity that opens a basic screen with a text area and a scrolling list; this Activity does not fill them with content.
en.disableEffect: The app loses this screen, and any app flow that opens it will stop there.

zh-CN.description: MavenTest 卡片视图库包含一个简单页面，显示文本区域和滚动列表；此页面本身不会填入内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将失去此页面，任何打开该页面的流程都会中断。

en.description: Sivaganesh Kantamani's Maven Publish Library sample opens a simple profile placeholder with an account icon and a “Sample” label.
en.disableEffect: Only this sample placeholder screen becomes unavailable.

zh-CN.description: Sivaganesh Kantamani 的 Maven Publish Library 示例会打开一个简单的个人资料占位页，显示账户图标和“Sample”字样。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 只有这个示例占位页面会无法打开。

en.description: ScreenCap's demo client looks for a screen-sharing host on the local network, shows its live screen, and sends the user's touch input back to that host.
en.disableEffect: The demo can no longer view or send touch input to a shared screen.

zh-CN.description: ScreenCap 示例的客户端会在本地网络中查找屏幕共享端，显示对方的实时画面，并把用户的触摸操作传回共享端。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，示例无法查看共享屏幕，也无法向共享端发送触摸操作。

en.description: ScreenCap's demo server lets the user approve screen capture and start streaming this phone's display; a separate control opens accessibility settings for remote touch control.
en.disableEffect: The demo cannot start screen sharing or its remote touch-control service.

zh-CN.description: ScreenCap 示例的服务端页面可请求录屏授权并开始共享本机画面；另一个控件会打开辅助功能设置以启用远程触控。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，示例无法启动屏幕共享或远程触控服务。

en.description: When enabled for ScreenCap's demo, this accessibility service runs with a foreground notification and applies touch gestures sent by the remote controller to this phone.
en.disableEffect: Remote touch gestures will no longer be applied on this phone.

zh-CN.description: 为 ScreenCap 示例启用后，此辅助功能服务会显示前台通知，并在本机执行远程控制端发送的触摸操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，本机将不再执行远程控制端发送的触摸操作。

en.description: After the user approves screen capture, ScreenCap's service captures the phone display and streams it to a connected viewer; it also forwards remote touch commands to the accessibility helper.
en.disableEffect: The demo cannot stream this phone's screen or relay remote touch commands.

zh-CN.description: 用户同意录屏后，ScreenCap 服务会捕获本机画面并传送给已连接的查看端，也会把远程触控命令转交给辅助功能服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，示例无法传送本机屏幕画面或转发远程触控命令。

en.description: The Newsapp demo opens its main news feed from the app icon and loads headlines by category. Selecting a headline opens its story.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open the demo’s home screen or browse its headline categories.

zh-CN.description: Newsapp 示例应用从图标启动后会打开新闻主页，并按类别加载标题；选择标题即可查看新闻。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，用户无法打开示例应用主页或浏览各类新闻标题。

en.description: The Newsapp demo opens the selected story in a reading screen. It displays the article and provides controls to share it, save it, or hear the text aloud.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot read selected stories or use this screen to share, save, or listen to them.

zh-CN.description: Newsapp 示例应用会在用户选择新闻后打开阅读页面，显示文章，并提供分享、收藏和朗读功能。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，用户无法阅读所选新闻，也无法通过此页面分享、收藏或收听文章。

en.description: The Newsapp demo opens its saved-stories screen from the main menu. It lists bookmarked stories and lets users reopen or delete them.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot view, reopen, or remove their bookmarked stories.

zh-CN.description: Newsapp 示例应用从主菜单打开收藏页面，列出已收藏的新闻，并允许用户重新打开或删除文章。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，用户无法查看、重新打开或删除已收藏的新闻。

en.description: Pham Quang Sang’s CameraFilter (ImageFilter) library uses this Activity for its camera and media editor; release 0.0.1 registers it as the launcher, and it asks for camera, microphone and storage access before showing camera, gallery, photo/video preview and editing screens.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents these camera and media screens from opening and blocks app launch in release 0.0.1.

zh-CN.description: Pham Quang Sang 的 CameraFilter（ImageFilter）库用此 Activity 提供相机和媒体编辑界面；0.0.1 版将其设为启动页，它会请求相机、麦克风和存储权限，然后显示拍摄、图库、照片/视频预览和编辑界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，相机和媒体界面无法打开；在 0.0.1 版中，应用也无法从此启动页进入。

en.description: Aemon Sythe's OnRampWebviewSDK opens the app-provided page in a full-screen web view when an OnRamp widget flow starts, and reports when the page closes.
en.disableEffect: The app's OnRamp widget page will not open.

zh-CN.description: Aemon Sythe 的 OnRampWebviewSDK 会在 OnRamp 小组件流程启动时，以全屏网页显示应用提供的页面，并在页面关闭时通知应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用中的 OnRamp 小组件页面将无法打开。

en.description: Aemon Sythe's OnRampWebviewSDK opens the app-provided page in its widget screen, shows a loading indicator, and asks before closing the widget.
en.disableEffect: The OnRamp widget page and its close-confirmation flow will be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: Aemon Sythe 的 OnRampWebviewSDK 会在小组件页面中打开应用提供的网页，显示加载指示，并在关闭前询问用户。
zh-CN.disableEffect: OnRamp 小组件页面及其关闭确认流程将无法使用。

en.description: Starts when an app uses the Interswitch Smart Till SDK to open a Bluetooth till connection. It keeps the connection available for payment commands and terminal replies.
en.disableEffect: Bluetooth till payments and terminal communication stop working.

zh-CN.description: 应用通过 Interswitch Smart Till SDK 连接蓝牙收银终端时，此服务会启动并保持连接，以传送支付指令和终端回复。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法通过蓝牙收银终端进行支付或收发交易数据。

en.description: Runs when the Interswitch Smart Till SDK reports a Bluetooth connection change or receives a terminal message. It passes connection status, errors and transaction replies to the app.
en.disableEffect: The app may not receive Bluetooth till status or transaction replies, so payments through that terminal can fail.

zh-CN.description: Interswitch Smart Till SDK 报告蓝牙连接状态变化或收到终端消息时，此接收器会把连接状态、错误和交易回复传给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用可能无法收到蓝牙终端状态或交易回复，导致通过该终端进行的支付失败。

en.description: Starts when an app selects a USB-connected till through the Interswitch Smart Till SDK. It connects to the till and carries payment and status messages between the terminal and app.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot communicate with a USB-connected till or complete payments through it.

zh-CN.description: 应用通过 Interswitch Smart Till SDK 选择 USB 收银终端时，此服务会启动并连接终端，在应用与终端之间传送支付和状态消息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法与 USB 收银终端通信，也无法通过它完成支付。

en.description: SmH Blood Analysis opens this camera Activity when an app starts scanning a blood-test report. It reads text from the live camera view and returns the extracted analysis to the calling screen.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot scan blood-test reports with this screen or receive its extracted readings.

zh-CN.description: 应用开始扫描血液检测报告时，SmH Blood Analysis 会打开此相机 Activity。它读取实时画面中的文字，并将提取出的分析结果返回调用页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法通过此页面扫描血液检测报告或接收提取出的检测结果。

en.description: ModuleNotificationRating (Huliganul) prepares optional app rating reminders when the app configures them. It stores the chosen reminder text and icon, and the screen to open when a reminder is tapped.
en.disableEffect: The effect of disabling this manifest entry on rating reminders is uncertain because the code uses it as a helper, not as an Android screen.

zh-CN.description: ModuleNotificationRating（Huliganul）会在应用启用时准备可选的评分提醒。它保存提醒文字、图标以及用户点击提醒后要打开的页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 由于代码将它用作评分提醒辅助类，而不是 Android 页面，禁用此清单项对评分提醒的影响尚无法确认。

en.description: ModuleNotificationRating (Huliganul) posts an optional app rating reminder after its configured delay and repeats it up to the selected count. Tapping the notification opens the destination chosen by the app.
en.disableEffect: Scheduled app rating reminders will not appear.

zh-CN.description: ModuleNotificationRating（Huliganul）会在设定的延迟后发出可选评分提醒，并按设定次数重复。点击通知会打开应用指定的页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 已安排的应用评分提醒将不会显示。

en.description: ModuleNotificationRating (Huliganul) checks saved reminder settings after the device starts and restores the alarm for a pending app rating notification.
en.disableEffect: Pending rating reminders will not be restored after the device restarts.

zh-CN.description: ModuleNotificationRating（Huliganul）会在设备启动后检查已保存的提醒设置，并为待发送的评分通知恢复闹钟。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 设备重启后，待发送的评分提醒将不会恢复。

en.description: ModuleNotificationRating (Huliganul) checks for a waiting app rating reminder when network connectivity returns and reschedules it if needed.
en.disableEffect: A waiting rating reminder will not resume when network connectivity returns.

zh-CN.description: ModuleNotificationRating（Huliganul）会在网络恢复时检查是否有待发送的评分提醒，并在需要时重新安排。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 网络恢复时，待发送的评分提醒将不会继续安排。

en.description: ModuleNotificationRating (Huliganul) reads the saved reminder flags for diagnostic logs when Android reports shutdown or quick reboot; it does not send or reschedule a reminder.
en.disableEffect: Only the reminder scheduler's shutdown diagnostic log will be lost.

zh-CN.description: Android 通知关机或快速重启时，ModuleNotificationRating（Huliganul）会读取已保存的提醒状态并写入诊断日志；它本身不会发送或重新安排提醒。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 评分提醒调度器的关机诊断日志将不再记录。

en.description: When a user chooses registration in Shilo Gavra’s Top-Card app, this screen collects a username, phone number, and email address and returns them to the card screen.
en.disableEffect: Users could not complete the registration step from the Top-Card screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Shilo Gavra 开发的 Top-Card 应用中选择注册时，此页面会收集用户名、电话号码和电子邮箱，并将这些信息返回卡片页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在 Top-Card 页面中完成注册步骤。

en.description: Shilo Gavra’s Top-Card app opens this screen from its launcher or when an NFC tag is presented. It displays the card page and handles reading data from or writing a contract to an NFC card.
en.disableEffect: Users could not launch the Top-Card screen or use its NFC card reading and writing features.

zh-CN.description: Shilo Gavra 开发的 Top-Card 应用会从启动器或在检测到 NFC 标签时打开此页面。页面显示卡片界面，并负责读取 NFC 卡片数据或向卡片写入合约。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开 Top-Card 页面，也无法使用其中的 NFC 卡片读写功能。

en.description: The Trovan scanner connector (TooLazyy) scans for nearby Bluetooth devices and connects to a saved scanner when the app starts the service. It reports discovered devices, connection state, and scanner version; this code does not turn incoming scan data into a user-visible result.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot discover or connect to its Trovan scanner, so features that rely on the scanner will stop working.

zh-CN.description: Trovan 扫描器连接库（TooLazyy）会在应用启动服务时搜索附近的蓝牙设备，并连接已保存的扫描器。它会向应用报告发现的设备、连接状态和扫描器版本；此代码不会把收到的扫描数据转换为用户可见的结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法发现或连接 Trovan 扫描器，依赖该扫描器的功能会停止工作。

en.description: When the host app opens a page with Alif Garindra WebView, this screen loads the address supplied by the app and keeps navigation inside the app. It supports back navigation and closes when the designated close link is reached.
en.disableEffect: Pages that use this embedded browser cannot be opened.

zh-CN.description: 宿主应用使用 Alif Garindra WebView 打开网页时，此页面会加载应用提供的地址，并在应用内显示网页。页面支持返回，并会在访问指定关闭链接时关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此内置浏览器的网页将无法打开。

en.description: When an ExploreStack consent form is ready to show, this Activity displays it in a full-screen window.
en.disableEffect: If the app requests this consent form, it cannot open and the consent flow may fail.

zh-CN.description: ExploreStack 的同意表单准备好展示时，此页面会以全屏方式显示表单。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 如果应用请求用户填写此表单，停用后表单将无法打开，同意流程可能失败。

en.description: ExploreStack’s ad library uses this full-screen Activity to show static, video, or rewarded in-app ads.
en.disableEffect: Ads that use this screen will not display, and rewards for watching them will no longer be granted.

zh-CN.description: ExploreStack 的广告库会使用此全屏页面展示应用内静态广告、视频广告或激励广告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，通过此页面展示的广告将无法显示，观看广告的奖励也将无法发放。
