en.description: ExploreStack’s ad library uses this full-screen, dialog-style Activity for interactive in-app ads, including rewarded ads.
en.disableEffect: These ads will not display, and rewards for watching them will no longer be granted.

zh-CN.description: ExploreStack 的广告库会通过此全屏对话框样式页面展示互动广告，也可用于激励广告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，这些广告将无法显示，观看广告的奖励也将无法发放。

en.description: When an app presents a video ad, ExploreStack’s ad library opens this full-screen Activity to play it and let users tap through.
en.disableEffect: Video ads that use this player will not play.

zh-CN.description: 应用展示视频广告时，ExploreStack 的广告库会打开此全屏页面播放广告，并支持用户点击广告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，通过此播放器展示的视频广告将无法播放。

en.description: ExpoFP's CrowdConnected location integration opens this Activity when its location service needs permission. It asks Android for fine location and Bluetooth access, then closes after the user's response.
en.disableEffect: Without this screen, the CrowdConnected provider cannot request permissions it needs, so visitor positioning in the floor plan may not work.

zh-CN.description: ExpoFP 的 CrowdConnected 定位集成在定位服务需要权限时会打开此 Activity。它向 Android 请求精确位置和蓝牙权限，并在用户作出选择后关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 没有此页面，CrowdConnected 定位提供程序无法申请所需权限，平面图中的访客定位可能无法使用。

en.description: ExpoFP's floor-plan viewer opens this Activity when its map asks for device location and the app still needs permission. It requests fine or approximate location and closes after the user's response.
en.disableEffect: If this screen is disabled, users may be unable to grant location access for the floor plan's current-position and location-based navigation features.

zh-CN.description: ExpoFP 的平面图查看器在地图请求设备位置且应用尚未获得权限时会打开此 Activity。它请求精确或大致位置权限，并在用户作出选择后关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用此页面后，用户可能无法为平面图的当前位置和基于位置的导航功能授予权限。

en.description: ExpoFP's GPS provider opens this Activity when it needs location permission before receiving device GPS updates. It requests fine or approximate location, then closes after the user's response.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it can prevent the GPS provider from receiving location updates, so map current-position features may stop working.

zh-CN.description: ExpoFP 的 GPS 定位提供程序在接收设备 GPS 更新前需要位置权限时会打开此 Activity。它请求精确或大致位置权限，并在用户作出选择后关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用此页面可能导致 GPS 定位提供程序无法获取位置更新，地图当前位置功能可能停止工作。

en.description: ExpoFP's IndoorAtlas integration opens this Activity before starting indoor-position updates when location or Bluetooth permission is missing. It requests the needed permissions and closes after the user's response.
en.disableEffect: If this screen is disabled, IndoorAtlas may not start, leaving indoor position and location-based floor-plan features unavailable.

zh-CN.description: 缺少位置或蓝牙权限时，ExpoFP 的 IndoorAtlas 集成会在启动室内定位更新前打开此 Activity。它会请求所需权限，并在用户作出选择后关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用此页面后，IndoorAtlas 可能无法启动，室内定位和平面图的位置相关功能可能无法使用。

en.description: Exponea's customer-engagement SDK runs this Receiver after an app update to move a saved push-notification token into its current storage. It only handles the package-replaced event.
en.disableEffect: An older Exponea push token will not be migrated, which can interrupt delivery of notifications that use it.

zh-CN.description: Exponea 客户互动 SDK 在应用更新后使用此接收器，将已保存的旧版推送令牌迁移到当前存储中。它只处理应用包替换事件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 旧版 Exponea 推送令牌将不会迁移，可能导致使用该令牌的通知无法继续送达。

en.description: Exponea's SDK uses this Provider during startup to save the app context and track when app screens move between foreground and background. That state helps time sessions and in-app messages.
en.disableEffect: Exponea's foreground-aware sessions and in-app-message timing will no longer work as intended.

zh-CN.description: Exponea SDK 在启动时通过此 Provider 保存应用上下文，并跟踪应用界面进入前台或退到后台的状态。这些状态用于会话统计和站内消息的展示时机。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Exponea 将无法按预期跟踪前后台状态、会话以及站内消息的展示时机。

en.description: When a user taps an Exponea push notification, this Activity passes the click to the SDK, dismisses the notification, and closes the notification shade. It handles push, deep-link, and URL click launches.
en.disableEffect: Taps on Exponea push notifications will no longer be processed by the SDK.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击 Exponea 推送通知时，此 Activity 会把点击交给 SDK 处理、关闭该通知并收起通知栏。它处理推送、深层链接和网址类型的点击。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Exponea SDK 将不再处理用户对推送通知的点击。

en.description: For older Android integrations, this Exponea Activity handles a push-notification tap, then opens the app or the linked page. It dismisses the notification before routing.
en.disableEffect: Tapping an Exponea push notification will no longer open the app or its linked destination.

zh-CN.description: 在较旧的 Android 集成中，用户点击 Exponea 推送通知后，此 Activity 会打开应用或通知中的链接，并先关闭该通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户点击 Exponea 推送通知后，将无法再打开应用或其中的链接。

en.description: Exponea's in-app message inbox opens this Activity when a message is selected. It fetches the selected item and shows its content on a detail screen.
en.disableEffect: Messages selected from the Exponea inbox will not open.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Exponea 站内消息收件箱中选择一条消息时，会打开此 Activity。它获取所选消息并显示详情。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开 Exponea 收件箱中的消息详情。

en.description: This Activity displays Exponea's in-app message inbox and loads the message list. It closes if the Exponea integration is not active.
en.disableEffect: The Exponea message inbox will not be available.

zh-CN.description: 此 Activity 显示 Exponea 站内消息收件箱并加载消息列表。如果 Exponea 集成已停止，它会关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Exponea 站内消息收件箱将无法打开。

en.description: Exponea opens this Activity to present a prepared in-app message over the app. It shows the message while available and dismisses it when the screen closes.
en.disableEffect: Exponea in-app message overlays will no longer appear.

zh-CN.description: Exponea 使用此 Activity 在应用界面上展示已准备好的站内消息，并在界面关闭时收起消息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Exponea 站内消息浮层将不再显示。

en.description: When Exponea requests notification access on Android 13 or later, this Activity displays the system permission prompt and sends the decision back to the SDK. On earlier versions, it reports that the permission is unnecessary.
en.disableEffect: Exponea cannot use this screen to request notification permission, so its push messages may remain disabled.

zh-CN.description: 在 Android 13 及更高版本上，Exponea 请求通知权限时会由此 Activity 显示系统授权提示，并将用户选择告知 SDK。较早版本则会报告无需此权限。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Exponea 将无法通过此界面申请通知权限，因此它的推送通知可能无法启用。

en.description: Extole's Android SDK opens a full-screen web page for an Extole zone selected by the app and passes along the page data. The page can navigate backward before it closes.
en.disableEffect: Any app experience routed through an Extole zone will have no page to display.

zh-CN.description: Extole Android SDK 会为应用选择的 Extole 区域打开全屏网页，并传入页面所需的数据。用户可以在关闭前返回上一页。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过 Extole 区域展示的应用界面将无法打开。

en.description: Debug Bottle opens this developer toolbox for app status, screen and intent inspection, saved preferences, network records, crashes, and performance reports. Its launcher and debug shortcut both open the toolbox.
en.disableEffect: Debug Bottle's main diagnostic menu and views will be unavailable; the app's normal screens still open.

zh-CN.description: Debug Bottle 使用此开发者工具箱查看应用状态、界面和 Intent、已保存的偏好设置、网络记录、崩溃及性能报告。它可通过启动入口或调试快捷方式打开。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Debug Bottle 的主诊断菜单和相关界面将无法使用；应用的普通界面仍可打开。

en.description: This Debug Bottle screen lets developers adjust network logging, strict checks, the floating debug view, leak and block monitors, and the long-block threshold.
en.disableEffect: Developers will not be able to open or change these Debug Bottle settings.

zh-CN.description: 此 Debug Bottle 界面可调整网络记录、严格检查、悬浮调试视图、内存泄漏和卡顿监测，以及卡顿时长阈值。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 开发者将无法打开或修改这些 Debug Bottle 设置。

en.description: This Debug Bottle QA screen has shortcuts to inspect app activities, open leak and long-block reports, and start a floating debug view. The source marks the screen as unused.
en.disableEffect: Only this Debug Bottle test shortcut screen will be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: 此 Debug Bottle 测试界面提供快捷入口，可查看应用 Activity、内存泄漏和卡顿报告，并启动悬浮调试视图。源码注明该界面未使用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 只有此 Debug Bottle 测试快捷界面会无法打开。

en.description: When a Debug Bottle notification is tapped, this Receiver opens the toolbox drawer or quick controls on the current app screen. If no screen is open, it opens the toolbox.
en.disableEffect: Debug Bottle notification shortcuts will no longer open their controls.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击 Debug Bottle 通知时，此接收器会打开工具箱抽屉，或在当前应用界面显示快捷控制。若当前没有打开的界面，它会打开工具箱。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Debug Bottle 通知中的快捷入口将无法打开控制界面。

en.description: Debug Bottle binds this Service to place, move, and remove its floating on-screen bubbles. It also provides the area used to dismiss a bubble.
en.disableEffect: Debug Bottle's floating bubble controls will not be available.

zh-CN.description: Debug Bottle 通过绑定此 Service 放置、移动和移除屏幕上的悬浮气泡；它也提供用于关闭气泡的区域。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Debug Bottle 的悬浮气泡控制将无法使用。

en.description: When Debug Bottle starts its bubble manager, this Service initializes the floating controls and their dismissal area, then cleans them up when it stops.
en.disableEffect: Debug Bottle's floating bubble controls will not work.

zh-CN.description: Debug Bottle 启动气泡管理器时，此 Service 会初始化悬浮控制及其关闭区域，并在停止时清理这些界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Debug Bottle 的悬浮气泡控制将无法工作。

en.description: In older Debug Bottle releases, this Service hosts the floating 3D debug window. Newer releases replace it with the bubble manager.
en.disableEffect: The older floating debug window will not be available.

zh-CN.description: 在较旧版本的 Debug Bottle 中，此 Service 用于承载 3D 悬浮调试窗口；较新版本已改用气泡管理器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 旧版悬浮调试窗口将无法使用。

en.description: In older Debug Bottle releases, this Service hosts the floating stress-test runner window. Newer releases replace it with a test bubble.
en.disableEffect: The floating stress-test controls will not be available.

zh-CN.description: 在较旧版本的 Debug Bottle 中，此 Service 用于承载悬浮压力测试窗口；较新版本已改用测试气泡。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 悬浮压力测试控制将无法使用。

en.description: Debug Bottle shows this introduction screen when its setup guide is opened; it explains the developer tools and offers a floating-window permission check.
en.disableEffect: Developers lose the setup guide and its permission shortcut; the app's normal screens continue to work.

zh-CN.description: 打开 Debug Bottle 设置指南时会显示此介绍界面，说明开发工具并提供悬浮窗权限检查入口。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 开发者将无法使用此设置指南和权限快捷入口；应用的普通界面仍可使用。

en.description: This Debug Bottle tool lists app screens, intents, or runnable test actions that a developer can invoke, with a text box for the selected test type.
en.disableEffect: Developers cannot use this screen to launch those Debug Bottle test actions.

zh-CN.description: 此 Debug Bottle 工具可列出应用界面、Intent 或可运行的测试操作，供开发者调用，并提供相应的输入框。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 开发者将无法通过此界面启动这些 Debug Bottle 测试操作。

en.description: Debug Bottle shows captured HTTP traffic here, including request and response details for each address. Developers can open a record and remove saved logs.
en.disableEffect: Saved HTTP traffic records will not be available through this Debug Bottle screen.

zh-CN.description: Debug Bottle 在此显示捕获的 HTTP 流量，包括各网址的请求和响应详情。开发者可以打开记录并删除已保存的日志。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 开发者将无法通过此 Debug Bottle 界面查看已保存的 HTTP 流量记录。

en.description: This Debug Bottle screen lists the app's saved preference files and values. Tapping a value opens an editor.
en.disableEffect: Developers cannot inspect or edit saved preferences through Debug Bottle.

zh-CN.description: 此 Debug Bottle 界面列出应用保存的偏好设置文件及其数值，点击数值可打开编辑器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 开发者将无法通过 Debug Bottle 查看或编辑已保存的偏好设置。

en.description: BlockCanary's Debug Bottle screen lists recorded main-thread stalls and opens their detailed traces. Developers can share a report or heap dump.
en.disableEffect: Recorded stall reports will not be available through this screen.

zh-CN.description: BlockCanary 的 Debug Bottle 界面列出已记录的主线程卡顿并打开详细记录，开发者还可以分享报告或堆转储。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 此界面将无法查看已记录的卡顿报告。

en.description: Eyeofcloud's experimentation SDK receives boot and app-update broadcasts here, then schedules background refreshes for its experiment datafiles. These files can contain remote settings used by feature experiments and rollouts.
en.disableEffect: An app that depends on Eyeofcloud-managed experiments may keep stale settings after startup or an update.

zh-CN.description: Eyeofcloud 实验 SDK 在设备启动或应用更新时通过此接收器重新安排实验数据文件的后台刷新。这些文件可能包含功能实验和发布控制所用的远程设置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖 Eyeofcloud 远程实验配置的应用，在启动或更新后可能继续使用旧设置。

en.description: Eyeofcloud's SDK receives boot, app-update, and network-available events here and asks its background worker to send queued experiment events.
en.disableEffect: Queued Eyeofcloud analytics and experiment events may not be sent after those events.

zh-CN.description: Eyeofcloud SDK 在设备启动、应用更新或网络恢复时通过此接收器请求后台任务发送排队的实验事件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 这些事件发生后，排队的 Eyeofcloud 分析和实验事件可能无法发送。

en.description: Facebook Core declares this receiver for authentication-token changes. In the analyzed SDK release, its receive handler has no additional action.
en.disableEffect: Blocking it has no user-visible effect in the analyzed SDK release.

zh-CN.description: Facebook Core 为身份验证令牌变化声明了此接收器。在所分析的 SDK 版本中，它收到通知后没有执行其他操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 在所分析的 SDK 版本中，停用它不会产生可见的用户影响。

en.description: Facebook Core uses this receiver when the current sign-in token changes and passes the update to Facebook's token manager.
en.disableEffect: Apps that use Facebook sign-in may not process access-token changes correctly if this receiver is disabled.

zh-CN.description: 当前登录令牌变化时，Facebook Core 会通过此接收器把更新交给 Facebook 令牌管理器处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用此接收器后，使用 Facebook 登录的应用可能无法正确处理访问令牌变化。

en.description: Meta’s Facebook SDK opens a browser tab during sign-in or an app-link handoff, then returns the result to the app.
en.disableEffect: Facebook sign-in and browser-based return flows may fail.

zh-CN.description: Meta 的 Facebook SDK 会在登录或应用链接跳转时打开浏览器标签页，随后把结果返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Facebook 登录和通过浏览器返回应用的流程可能失败。

en.description: Facebook's login SDK opens this Activity while sign-in is happening in a browser tab, then returns the result to the app.
en.disableEffect: Facebook login flows that use a browser tab cannot complete.

zh-CN.description: Facebook 登录 SDK 会在浏览器标签页中进行登录时打开此 Activity，然后把登录结果返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用浏览器标签页的 Facebook 登录流程将无法完成。

en.description: Meta’s Facebook SDK uses this screen for Facebook sign-in and dialog-based features such as sharing.
en.disableEffect: Facebook sign-in and dialog-based sharing features may stop working.

zh-CN.description: Meta 的 Facebook SDK 使用此页面进行 Facebook 登录，以及分享等对话框功能。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Facebook 登录和对话框分享等功能可能无法使用。

en.description: Meta’s Facebook SDK uses this provider to make attachment files available to Facebook sharing flows.
en.disableEffect: Sharing photos or other files through Facebook may fail, and flows that require the provider may crash.

zh-CN.description: Meta 的 Facebook SDK 使用此内容提供器，为 Facebook 分享流程提供图片等附件文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过 Facebook 分享图片或其他文件可能失败，依赖此提供器的流程也可能崩溃。

en.description: The Facebook Android SDK opens this screen during Facebook account sign-in for Adobe Creative SDK Behance, ASNE, OneAll, or Wings integrations. It completes authorization and returns the result to the requesting app.
en.disableEffect: Facebook sign-in and authorization flows that use this screen will fail.

zh-CN.description: Adobe Creative SDK Behance、ASNE、OneAll 或 Wings 集成进行 Facebook 账户登录时，Facebook Android SDK 会打开此界面。它完成授权并将结果返回给发起请求的应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，使用此界面的 Facebook 登录和授权流程将会失败。

en.description: Facebook Account Kit initializes through this Provider when the app starts.
en.disableEffect: Apps that use Account Kit may fail to initialize phone or email login.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，Facebook Account Kit 会通过此 Provider 完成初始化。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用 Account Kit 的应用可能无法初始化手机号或电子邮件登录。

en.description: Facebook Account Kit presents its phone or email sign-in and verification screens in this Activity, then returns the login result to the app.
en.disableEffect: Account Kit sign-in and verification cannot complete.

zh-CN.description: Facebook Account Kit 通过此 Activity 显示手机号或电子邮件登录和验证界面，并将登录结果返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Account Kit 的登录和验证流程将无法完成。

en.description: When a user opens an Account Kit email-verification link, this Activity forwards the link back into Account Kit's login flow.
en.disableEffect: Account Kit email-verification links will not return to the app's login flow.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 Account Kit 电子邮件验证链接时，此 Activity 会把链接转回 Account Kit 登录流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Account Kit 电子邮件验证链接将无法返回应用的登录流程。

en.description: Meta Audience Network opens this Activity to display its full-screen ad experience inside the app.
en.disableEffect: Meta Audience Network ads that use a full-screen presentation will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: Meta Audience Network 会通过此 Activity 在应用内展示全屏广告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Meta Audience Network 需要全屏展示的广告将无法打开。

en.description: Meta Audience Network uses this provider to initialize its ad SDK when the app starts.
en.disableEffect: Meta Audience Network ad initialization and ads may stop; the app’s other features continue to work.

zh-CN.description: Meta Audience Network 会在应用启动时通过此 Provider 初始化广告 SDK。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Meta Audience Network 的广告初始化和广告可能停止，应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: Facebook Audience Network opens this full-screen page for interstitial and video ads, including videos offered in exchange for an in-app reward.
en.disableEffect: Facebook full-screen ads that use this page will not open, and rewards for watching rewarded videos will not be granted.

zh-CN.description: Facebook Audience Network 会打开此全屏页面展示插页广告和视频广告，也包括观看后可获得应用内奖励的视频广告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此页面的 Facebook 全屏广告将无法打开，观看奖励视频也不会获得奖励。

en.description: Meta Audience Network uses this service to exchange messages between its ad components.
en.disableEffect: Meta Audience Network ad messaging may stop; the app’s other features continue to work.

zh-CN.description: Meta Audience Network 使用此服务在广告组件之间传递消息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Meta Audience Network 的广告消息传递可能停止，应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: Meta Audience Network uses this service to coordinate process priority for ad work.
en.disableEffect: Meta Audience Network process coordination may stop and ads may be affected; the app’s other features continue to work.

zh-CN.description: Meta Audience Network 使用此服务协调广告任务的进程优先级。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Meta Audience Network 的进程协调可能停止并影响广告，应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: Meta Audience Network opens this activity to display an ad.
en.disableEffect: Meta Audience Network ads that use the separate process will not open; the app’s other features continue to work.

zh-CN.description: Meta Audience Network 会在独立广告进程中打开此页面来显示广告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖独立进程的 Meta Audience Network 广告将无法打开，应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: The Facebook SDK runs this provider at app startup to initialize its core services automatically.
en.disableEffect: Facebook login, sharing, and other features that depend on the SDK may not initialize.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，Facebook SDK 会通过此 Provider 自动初始化核心服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖 Facebook SDK 的登录、分享等功能可能无法初始化。

en.description: Facebook Marketing initializes automatic event tracking and retrieves its tracking configuration when the app starts.
en.disableEffect: Facebook Marketing's automatic tracking and configuration loading will stop.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，Facebook Marketing 会初始化自动事件跟踪并获取跟踪配置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Facebook Marketing 的自动跟踪和配置加载将停止。

en.description: Facebook's in-app notifications framework displays a campaign card here, records the open and button action, and opens the selected link.
en.disableEffect: Facebook in-app notification cards will not appear or open their links.

zh-CN.description: Facebook 站内通知框架通过此 Activity 显示活动卡片、记录打开和按钮操作，并打开用户选择的链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Facebook 站内通知卡片将无法显示，也无法打开其中的链接。

en.description: React Native uses this screen to show developer preferences when development support is enabled.
en.disableEffect: Developers lose access to React Native's settings screen; normal app screens and payment checkout do not use it.

zh-CN.description: 启用开发支持时，React Native 会通过此界面显示开发者设置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 开发者将无法打开 React Native 设置界面；应用常规界面和支付结账不使用它。

en.description: FaceTec's face-verification SDK starts this full-screen session when an integrated app begins a selfie and liveness check. Yoti and Onfido SDK bundles also include this session screen.
en.disableEffect: Any app flow that relies on FaceTec for face or liveness verification will fail to finish.

zh-CN.description: 集成 FaceTec 的应用开始自拍和活体检测时，FaceTec 人脸核验 SDK 会启动此全屏会话页面；Yoti 和 Onfido 的 SDK 包中也包含此页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖 FaceTec 进行人脸或活体核验的应用流程将无法完成。

en.description: Lightning Launcher’s script library opens this screen when a script needs the user to approve or cancel an action. It shows the prompt and returns the selected button to the script.
en.disableEffect: Scripts that require confirmation cannot finish that step if this prompt is disabled.

zh-CN.description: Lightning Launcher 的脚本库会在脚本需要用户确认或取消操作时显示此对话框，并将用户的选择返回给脚本。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，依赖用户确认的脚本步骤无法完成。

en.description: When a Lightning Launcher script requests an Android permission that has not been granted, the script library opens this screen and passes the result back to the script.
en.disableEffect: Scripts that need the requested permission can no longer perform the protected action.

zh-CN.description: 当 Lightning Launcher 的脚本请求尚未授予的 Android 权限时，脚本库会打开此页面，并将授权结果传回脚本。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要该权限的脚本将无法执行受保护的操作。

en.description: Fairmatic’s driving SDK sends this receiver trip-start, trip-resume, trip-end, drive-analysis, accident and settings updates. It forwards those updates to the app’s configured driving callback.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it stops the app from receiving Fairmatic trip and accident updates, which can break its driving and safety features.

zh-CN.description: Fairmatic 驾驶 SDK 会在行程开始、恢复、结束、分析完成或发生事故及设置变更时发送更新；此接收器会将更新转交给应用配置的驾驶事件处理程序。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用将收不到 Fairmatic 的行程和事故更新，驾驶监测及安全功能可能因此失效。

en.description: Android starts this provider as the app opens. Fairmatic uses the app context it supplies while loading driving preferences and trip-monitoring features.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, Fairmatic cannot obtain the app context it needs, so its driving preferences and trip-monitoring setup can fail.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时 Android 会创建此提供程序。Fairmatic 会借助它取得应用环境，以便加载驾驶偏好设置和行程监测功能。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Fairmatic 无法取得所需的应用环境，驾驶偏好设置和行程监测初始化可能失败。

en.description: Fairmatic’s driving SDK calls this receiver when a trip starts, resumes or ends, when a drive is analyzed, and after accident or settings events. This release records those updates in SDK logs.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it stops these Fairmatic event entries from being written to the SDK log.

zh-CN.description: Fairmatic 驾驶 SDK 会在行程开始、恢复、结束、分析完成或发生事故及设置变更时调用此接收器；此版本会将这些更新写入 SDK 日志。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，这些 Fairmatic 事件将不再写入 SDK 日志。

en.description: Fanap POD Chat handles Firebase pushes for chat messages and calls, showing or updating the matching notification when a push arrives.
en.disableEffect: Chat and call push notifications from POD Chat will stop appearing in the background.

zh-CN.description: Fanap POD Chat 会处理 Firebase 推送的聊天消息和通话内容，并在收到推送时显示或更新对应通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: POD Chat 的聊天和通话推送通知将不再于后台显示。

en.description: Fanap POD Chat handles taps on message notifications, opens the configured chat screen, and clears the related alerts.
en.disableEffect: Tapping a POD Chat notification may no longer open the chat screen or clear its alert.

zh-CN.description: Fanap POD Chat 会处理聊天通知的点击，打开指定的聊天页面并清除相关提醒。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 点击 POD Chat 通知后，可能无法打开聊天页面或清除提醒。

en.description: Fanap POD Chat updates or clears message alerts when the user dismisses them, including marking a thread or all messages as read.
en.disableEffect: Dismissed chat alerts may remain uncleared or their unread state may not update.

zh-CN.description: 用户清除聊天通知时，Fanap POD Chat 会更新或清除相关提醒，并可将会话或全部消息标记为已读。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 清除聊天通知后，提醒可能仍会保留，未读状态也可能无法更新。

en.description: Fanap POD Chat uses this Android file provider to create app-accessible links when files are opened or shared.
en.disableEffect: Opening or sharing files through POD Chat may fail.

zh-CN.description: Fanap POD Chat 使用此 Android 文件提供程序，在打开或分享文件时生成应用可访问的链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过 POD Chat 打开或分享文件可能会失败。

en.description: This Machbird provider initializes and serves the SDK's app-specific data store and preference values to other SDK parts.
en.disableEffect: Machbird functions that read or update local data and preferences through this provider will fail.

zh-CN.description: 此 Machbird Provider 会初始化并提供 SDK 的应用专属数据和偏好设置，供其他 SDK 部分使用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过此 Provider 读取或更新本地数据和偏好设置的 Machbird 功能将无法正常工作。

en.description: Farimarwat Grizzly shows an error title and message after an uncaught app crash; closing the report exits the app.
en.disableEffect: The Grizzly crash message will not appear after an uncaught crash; normal app use is unaffected.

zh-CN.description: Farimarwat Grizzly 会在应用发生未捕获崩溃后显示错误标题和信息；关闭报告会退出应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 未捕获崩溃后将不再显示 Grizzly 崩溃信息；正常使用应用不受影响。

en.description: Farimarwat PushPilot receives Firebase push messages and displays a system notification when a message includes a title and body.
en.disableEffect: PushPilot notifications will no longer appear.

zh-CN.description: Farimarwat PushPilot 会接收 Firebase 推送；消息包含标题和正文时，它会显示系统通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: PushPilot 通知将不再显示。

en.description: Farimarwat ZeroCrash shows the crash title and details supplied by its crash handler, then exits when the user closes the report.
en.disableEffect: The ZeroCrash message screen will not appear after a crash; normal app use is unaffected.

zh-CN.description: Farimarwat ZeroCrash 会显示崩溃处理程序提供的标题和详情；用户关闭报告后，应用会退出。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 崩溃后将不再显示 ZeroCrash 信息界面；正常使用应用不受影响。

en.description: When Firebase delivers a Feedify notification, this Feedify push service processes it if notifications are enabled; when Firebase refreshes the device token, it saves the token and registers the device with Feedify.
en.disableEffect: Feedify push notifications and token updates will stop; the app’s other screens can continue working.

zh-CN.description: Firebase 投递 Feedify 通知时，如果通知已启用，此 Feedify 推送服务会处理通知；Firebase 更新设备令牌时，它会保存令牌并向 Feedify 注册设备。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Feedify 推送通知和令牌更新将停止；应用的其他界面仍可使用。

en.description: When a user taps a button in a Feedify notification, this receiver opens the button’s link in a browser, records the click with Feedify, and dismisses the notification.
en.disableEffect: Feedify notification buttons will no longer open their links or record clicks; other app functions can continue.

zh-CN.description: 用户点按 Feedify 通知中的按钮时，此接收器会在浏览器中打开按钮链接、向 Feedify 记录点击并关闭通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Feedify 通知按钮将无法打开链接或记录点击；应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: Android starts the FeedAd provider when the app opens; it initializes FeedAd so the app can request and show advertisements. It has no screen.
en.disableEffect: FeedAd will not receive this automatic startup setup, so its ad placements may fail to load.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时 Android 会创建 FeedAd 提供程序，为应用请求和展示广告初始化 FeedAd；它不显示界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: FeedAd 将无法通过此提供程序自动初始化，其广告位可能无法加载。

en.description: The FeedAd SDK binds to this background service for standalone ad requests and ad playback. It prepares a standalone placement and can request another ad when the placement is configured to reload.
en.disableEffect: Standalone FeedAd requests and placements that depend on this service will stop working.

zh-CN.description: FeedAd SDK 会绑定此后台服务来处理独立广告请求和播放；它准备独立广告位，并可按设置在广告结束后请求下一条广告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 独立 FeedAd 请求以及依赖此服务的广告位将无法使用。

en.description: FeedAd opens this screen after an interstitial ad is requested. It displays the full-screen ad and returns whether playback completed, was skipped, canceled or failed.
en.disableEffect: FeedAd interstitial advertisements will not appear.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求插屏广告后，FeedAd 会打开此页面展示全屏广告，并回报广告是已完成、已跳过、已取消还是播放失败。
zh-CN.disableEffect: FeedAd 插屏广告将不再显示。

en.description: ChannelSurfer exposes this Service to Android media clients that request a media browser. It creates an empty media session and returns no media items; its play, pause, and seek controls have no behavior.
en.disableEffect: Android media clients will no longer discover this empty media service; the component currently exposes no playable items or working playback controls.

zh-CN.description: Android 媒体客户端请求媒体浏览服务时，ChannelSurfer 会提供此 Service。它会创建一个空媒体会话且不返回媒体项目，播放、暂停和拖动控制也没有实际操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Android 媒体客户端将无法再发现此空媒体服务；该组件目前没有可播放项目或可用的播放控制。

en.description: ChannelSurfer's Live Channels library shows this setup Activity when Android TV configures its input. It displays the setup page and starts an initial channel sync.
en.disableEffect: ChannelSurfer's TV input cannot complete setup, so its channels may not appear in Android TV.

zh-CN.description: Android TV 配置 ChannelSurfer 输入源时，ChannelSurfer 的 Live Channels 库会显示此设置 Activity。它会显示设置页面并启动首次频道同步。
zh-CN.disableEffect: ChannelSurfer 的 TV 输入源将无法完成设置，其频道可能不会显示在 Android TV 中。

en.description: ChannelSurfer's account setup opens this Activity when its authenticator blocks adding another sync account. It displays a brief refusal and closes; it can also show the same kind of message for a removal request.
en.disableEffect: Android's account flow may not complete ChannelSurfer's add-account refusal screen, and account setup or channel sync can be disrupted.

zh-CN.description: ChannelSurfer 的账户设置在阻止添加另一个同步账户时会打开此 Activity。它会显示简短的拒绝提示后关闭；收到移除请求时也会显示类似提示。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Android 的账户流程可能无法完成 ChannelSurfer 的拒绝提示界面，账户设置或频道同步可能受到影响。

en.description: Android binds to this ChannelSurfer account authenticator when managing the library's sync account. It blocks creating a duplicate account and prevents the existing account from being removed.
en.disableEffect: Android's sync account may no longer be available to ChannelSurfer, interrupting background channel updates.

zh-CN.description: Android 管理 ChannelSurfer 的同步账户时，会连接到此账户验证 Service。它会阻止重复创建账户，并禁止移除现有账户。
zh-CN.disableEffect: ChannelSurfer 可能无法再使用 Android 同步账户，后台频道更新会受到影响。

en.description: When Android requests a ChannelSurfer account sync, this Service provides the sync adapter that refreshes TV input channels and program listings.
en.disableEffect: ChannelSurfer's TV channels and program listings will no longer refresh through Android's background sync.

zh-CN.description: Android 请求同步 ChannelSurfer 账户时，此 Service 会提供同步适配器，用于更新 TV 输入源的频道和节目列表。
zh-CN.disableEffect: ChannelSurfer 的 TV 频道和节目列表将无法再通过 Android 后台同步更新。

en.description: Hourglass's watch-face settings library opens this Activity when the user changes its options. It displays date, time, ambient-display, and developer settings, then sends supported changes to the paired watch.
en.disableEffect: The Hourglass settings screen will be unavailable, and its options cannot be changed from the phone.

zh-CN.description: 用户更改表盘选项时，Hourglass 的表盘设置库会打开此 Activity。它显示日期、时间、环境显示和开发者设置，并将支持的更改发送到配对手表。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Hourglass 设置界面将无法使用，用户也无法从手机修改相关选项。

en.description: Hourglass Wear listens for settings data sent from its paired phone. When new data arrives, it applies those preferences on the watch.
en.disableEffect: Settings changed on the phone will no longer be applied to the Hourglass watch face.

zh-CN.description: Hourglass Wear 会接收配对手机发送的设置数据。新数据到达时，它会在手表上应用这些偏好设置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 手机上更改的设置将无法再应用到 Hourglass 手表表盘。

en.description: Ferhat Ozcelik’s Firebase messaging integration handles the app’s push messages. When a message includes a title and body, it creates a notification that can open the app or its store page when tapped.
en.disableEffect: The app will stop receiving and displaying push notifications through this Firebase integration.

zh-CN.description: Ferhat Ozcelik 的 Firebase 消息集成负责处理应用推送；消息包含标题和正文时，它会创建通知，点按后可打开应用或其商店页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法通过此 Firebase 集成接收和显示推送通知。

en.description: FFSky’s Cordova app framework uses this Activity as the base for configured in-app web pages and handles their pause and resume behavior.
en.disableEffect: App pages built on this screen will not open or resume correctly.

zh-CN.description: FFSky Cordova 应用框架以此 Activity 为内嵌网页的基础，并处理页面进入后台或返回前台时的状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 基于此页面的应用内容将无法正常打开或恢复。

en.description: When an app opens an embedded Cordova page, FFSky’s Web Activity loads the supplied address or the page configured for the app.
en.disableEffect: Web pages launched through this Activity will not open.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开 Cordova 内嵌网页时，FFSky 的此页面会加载应用传入的网址或已配置的起始页。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过此 Activity 启动的网页将无法打开。

en.description: FFSky’s Cordova X5 integration uses this Activity as the base for in-app pages rendered by Tencent’s X5 browser and handles their pause and resume behavior.
en.disableEffect: App pages that rely on Tencent X5 through this screen will not open or resume correctly.

zh-CN.description: FFSky Cordova X5 集成以此 Activity 为基础，使用腾讯 X5 浏览器显示应用内网页，并处理页面进入后台或返回前台时的状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖腾讯 X5 的应用页面将无法正常打开或恢复。

en.description: When an app opens an X5 Cordova page, FFSky’s Activity loads the supplied or configured address in Tencent’s embedded browser.
en.disableEffect: Web pages launched through this Tencent X5 screen will not open.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开 X5 Cordova 网页时，FFSky 的此 Activity 会用腾讯内置浏览器加载传入或已配置的网址。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过此腾讯 X5 页面启动的网页将无法打开。

en.description: When the app opens Fidzup Android CMP's consent prompt, this screen lets the user accept all purposes, reject them, or continue to detailed settings.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from setting or updating their choices through Fidzup's consent flow.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开 Fidzup Android CMP 的同意提示时，用户可在此接受所有用途、拒绝所有用途，或进入详细设置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过 Fidzup 的同意流程设置或更新选择。

en.description: Opened from Fidzup Android CMP's consent prompt, this screen lists consent purposes with switches and provides access to the active vendor list. Users can save their detailed choices here.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from adjusting or saving detailed consent choices in Fidzup's interface.

zh-CN.description: 此页面从 Fidzup Android CMP 的同意提示打开，列出各项同意用途及开关，并提供进入有效供应商列表的入口。用户可在此保存详细选择。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法在 Fidzup 界面中调整或保存详细的同意选择。

en.description: When a user opens a vendor's policy link from Fidzup Android CMP's vendor details, this screen loads the policy in an in-app browser view.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from reading that vendor's linked privacy policy inside Fidzup's consent flow.

zh-CN.description: 用户从 Fidzup Android CMP 的供应商详情打开政策链接时，此页面会在应用内网页视图中加载该政策。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法在 Fidzup 的同意流程中查看该供应商的隐私政策。

en.description: When opened with a purpose and its current consent choice, Fidzup Android CMP shows the purpose name and description with a switch. It returns the user's updated choice when they leave.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from viewing or changing an individual purpose from its detail screen.

zh-CN.description: 收到某项用途及其当前同意选择后，Fidzup Android CMP 会显示用途名称、说明和开关，并在用户离开时返回更新后的选择。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法在详情页面查看或更改单项用途的选择。

en.description: When a user opens a vendor from Fidzup Android CMP's vendor list, this screen shows the vendor's purposes and features. It also opens the vendor's policy when a policy link is available.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from inspecting a vendor's stated purposes and features or reaching its linked policy from Fidzup's interface.

zh-CN.description: 用户从 Fidzup Android CMP 的供应商列表打开某个供应商时，此页面会显示该供应商涉及的用途和功能；若有政策链接，也可从此处打开。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法在 Fidzup 界面中查看供应商所列的用途和功能，也无法打开其政策链接。

en.description: Opened from Fidzup Android CMP's detailed consent settings, this screen lists active vendors, lets the user change each vendor's consent, and opens vendor details.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from reviewing or changing consent for individual vendors in Fidzup's interface.

zh-CN.description: 此页面从 Fidzup Android CMP 的详细同意设置打开，列出当前有效的供应商，允许用户分别更改同意选择并查看供应商详情。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法在 Fidzup 界面中查看或更改对单个供应商的同意选择。

en.description: When a user starts Fillr autofill from an embedded browser, this screen handles the form review and PIN steps before Fillr fills saved details. It also lets users create or change their Fillr PIN.
en.disableEffect: Without it, users cannot complete the embedded Fillr autofill or PIN flow.

zh-CN.description: 用户在嵌入式浏览器中启动 Fillr 自动填充时，此页面会先处理表单确认和 PIN 步骤，再填入已保存的信息；用户也可在此创建或更改 Fillr PIN。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法完成嵌入式 Fillr 自动填充或 PIN 流程。

en.description: Fillr's embedded autofill SDK opens this profile and settings screen so users can view and edit the saved details used to fill forms.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from opening or managing their Fillr profile through this screen.

zh-CN.description: Fillr 嵌入式自动填充 SDK 会打开此资料和设置页面，供用户查看和编辑用于表单填充的已保存信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过此页面打开或管理 Fillr 资料。

en.description: Android invokes Fillr's native autofill service when a user focuses a supported form field or saves a form. Fillr matches form fields to its saved profile and offers suggestions, then handles details the user chooses to save.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents Android from offering Fillr profile data or saving new details through the system autofill feature.

zh-CN.description: 用户在其他应用中聚焦受支持的表单字段或保存表单时，Android 会调用 Fillr 的系统自动填充服务。Fillr 会将表单字段与已保存的资料匹配并提供建议，也会处理用户选择保存的信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Android 无法通过系统自动填充功能提供 Fillr 资料或保存新信息。

en.description: When Fillr imports addresses into the user's profile, this service turns each free-form address into structured fields and saves them for later use.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents imported addresses from being added to the profile, reducing the address details available for autofill.

zh-CN.description: Fillr 将地址导入用户资料时，此服务会把每条自由格式的地址转换为结构化字段并保存，供之后使用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，导入的地址无法写入资料，可用于自动填充的地址信息会减少。

en.description: When Fillr needs to interpret an address during profile or form mapping, it sends the address and field context for parsing, then saves the structured result to the profile.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it can prevent address values from being mapped into the profile fields used for autofill.

zh-CN.description: Fillr 在资料或表单映射过程中需要解析地址时，会连同目标字段信息一起处理，并将结构化结果保存到资料中。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，地址内容可能无法映射到自动填充所用的资料字段。

en.description: When affiliate links are enabled in a Fillr embedded browser, this service looks up a country-specific affiliate destination and returns the resulting link to the browser.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it can stop Fillr from creating affiliate redirects, while ordinary browsing and form filling can continue.

zh-CN.description: Fillr 嵌入式浏览器启用联盟链接时，此服务会查询适用于当前国家或地区的联盟目标地址，并将结果链接返回给浏览器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Fillr 可能无法生成联盟跳转链接，但普通浏览和表单填充仍可继续。

en.description: When a Fillr embedded browser sends form data for capture, this service maps the submitted fields and stores approved values in the user's profile for later autofill. It can ask before saving sensitive values.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents Fillr from capturing new form details for reuse in the user's profile.

zh-CN.description: Fillr 嵌入式浏览器提交表单数据以供保存时，此服务会映射表单字段，并将获准保存的信息写入用户资料，供之后自动填充；保存敏感信息前也可能征求用户同意。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Fillr 无法采集并保存新的表单信息以供用户资料复用。

en.description: During Fillr's profile and form-filling flows, this service checks for an updated profile-field schema and loads the local schema when needed.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it can prevent schema updates, so some profile details may not map correctly to form fields.

zh-CN.description: Fillr 处理资料和表单填充流程时，此服务会检查资料字段定义是否有更新，并在需要时加载本地定义。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，字段定义可能无法更新，部分资料信息可能无法正确映射到表单字段。

en.description: When Fillr's browser SDK requests a refresh, this service updates Fillr's remote feature settings in the background.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it can leave Fillr using older settings, so options controlled by those settings may not update.

zh-CN.description: Fillr 浏览器 SDK 请求刷新时，此服务会在后台更新 Fillr 的远程功能设置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Fillr 可能继续使用旧设置，由这些设置控制的选项也可能无法更新。

en.description: When an embedded browser requests Fillr's headless form mapping, this service matches form fields without opening a screen and returns the matched and empty fields to the caller.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents the browser integration from receiving Fillr's headless field mapping.

zh-CN.description: 嵌入式浏览器请求 Fillr 的无界面表单映射时，此服务会在不打开页面的情况下匹配表单字段，并将已匹配和空缺的字段返回给调用方。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，浏览器集成无法收到 Fillr 的无界面字段映射结果。

en.description: When Fillr's browser integration reports a page event, this service forwards the event to Fillr's service.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it stops this page-event reporting; embedded browsing and autofill can continue.

zh-CN.description: Fillr 浏览器集成报告页面事件时，此服务会将事件发送给 Fillr 的服务端。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，页面事件将不再上报，但嵌入式浏览和自动填充仍可继续。

en.description: After a Fillr form-fill attempt, this service reports the result and mapping time. If Fillr's demographic reporting option is enabled, the report can also include details derived from the saved profile.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it stops these performance and optional demographic reports while form filling can continue.

zh-CN.description: Fillr 尝试填充表单后，此服务会上报填充结果和字段映射耗时。若启用了 Fillr 的人口统计信息上报选项，报告还可能包含从已保存资料中提取的信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，这些性能和可选的人口统计信息报告将停止上报，表单填充仍可继续。

en.description: When the user completes Fillr's sign-up flow, this service reads the saved email and name and prepares registration details with browser information. It clears the saved sign-up data when it receives a response.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it can leave the saved Fillr sign-up details unprocessed and prevent the profile registration flow from completing.

zh-CN.description: 用户完成 Fillr 注册流程时，此服务会读取已保存的邮箱和姓名，并准备包含浏览器信息的注册资料；收到响应后会清除已保存的注册信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，已保存的 Fillr 注册资料可能无法处理，资料注册流程也可能无法完成。

en.description: When the app opens FirebaseUI Auth’s configured sign-in flow, this Activity displays its email, identity-provider, or phone authentication screens and returns the sign-in outcome to the app.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot display or complete this FirebaseUI Auth sign-in flow.

zh-CN.description: 当应用打开 FirebaseUI Auth 配置的登录流程时，此 Activity 会显示邮箱、身份提供方或手机号验证界面，并将登录结果返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法显示或完成此 FirebaseUI Auth 登录流程。

en.description: When FirebaseUI Auth begins a configured sign-in, this background Activity checks any required Google Play services and starts the authentication request.
en.disableEffect: FirebaseUI Auth may be unable to start or finish sign-in, leaving users unable to log in.

zh-CN.description: FirebaseUI Auth 开始配置的登录流程时，此后台 Activity 会检查所需的 Google Play 服务并启动身份验证请求。
zh-CN.disableEffect: FirebaseUI Auth 可能无法启动或完成登录，用户因此无法登录。

en.description: Android creates this provider during app startup; it gives FirebaseUI Auth the application context used to prepare its sign-in features.
en.disableEffect: Without it, FirebaseUI Auth may lack its required startup context and its sign-in flow can fail.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，Android 会创建此 Provider；它为 FirebaseUI Auth 提供准备登录功能所需的应用上下文。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，FirebaseUI Auth 可能无法取得启动所需的应用上下文，导致登录流程失败。

en.description: When FirebaseUI Auth starts its sign-in flow, this Activity checks for saved Google sign-in credentials and either uses them or opens the configured email or provider choices.
en.disableEffect: Users may not reach the configured sign-in choices, so FirebaseUI authentication can fail.

zh-CN.description: FirebaseUI Auth 开始登录时，此 Activity 会检查已保存的 Google 登录凭据；如果不能直接使用，就显示已配置的邮箱或身份提供方选项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户可能无法进入已配置的登录选项，导致 FirebaseUI 身份验证失败。

en.description: After an older FirebaseUI Auth sign-in succeeds, this Activity offers to save the account in Google Smart Lock, including its email, password, and supported provider details.
en.disableEffect: Blocking it can interrupt sign-in flows that invoke credential saving, and saved login details will not be offered.

zh-CN.description: 较早版本的 FirebaseUI Auth 登录成功后，此 Activity 会通过 Google Smart Lock 提供保存账号的选项，包括邮箱、密码和受支持的身份提供方信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，调用凭据保存步骤的登录流程可能中断，也不会再提供保存登录信息的选项。

en.description: When FirebaseUI Auth finds that an email address belongs to a different sign-in provider, this screen asks the user to sign in with the existing provider so the accounts can be linked.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot confirm the existing provider account, so this account-linking sign-in flow cannot finish.

zh-CN.description: FirebaseUI Auth 发现邮箱已关联其他登录方式时，此界面会要求用户使用原有方式登录，以便关联账号。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法确认原有身份提供方账号，因此此账号关联登录流程无法完成。

en.description: When FirebaseUI Auth finds that an email address belongs to a different sign-in provider, this screen asks the user to sign in with the existing provider so the accounts can be linked.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot confirm the existing provider account, so this account-linking sign-in flow cannot finish.

zh-CN.description: FirebaseUI Auth 发现邮箱已关联其他登录方式时，此界面会要求用户使用原有方式登录，以便关联账号。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法确认原有身份提供方账号，因此此账号关联登录流程无法完成。

en.description: When FirebaseUI Auth finds that an email address already has an email-and-password account, this screen asks for that account’s password to continue sign-in or linking.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot enter the existing account password, so this sign-in or account-linking flow cannot finish.

zh-CN.description: FirebaseUI Auth 发现邮箱已有密码账号时，此界面会要求用户输入该账号的密码，以继续登录或关联账号。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法输入原账号密码，因此此登录或账号关联流程无法完成。

en.description: When FirebaseUI Auth finds that an email address belongs to a different sign-in provider, this screen asks the user to sign in with the existing provider so the accounts can be linked.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot confirm the existing provider account, so this account-linking sign-in flow cannot finish.

zh-CN.description: FirebaseUI Auth 发现邮箱已关联其他登录方式时，此界面会要求用户使用原有方式登录，以便关联账号。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法确认原有身份提供方账号，因此此账号关联登录流程无法完成。

en.description: When FirebaseUI Auth finds that an email address already has an email-and-password account, this screen asks for that account’s password to continue sign-in or linking.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot enter the existing account password, so this sign-in or account-linking flow cannot finish.

zh-CN.description: FirebaseUI Auth 发现邮箱已有密码账号时，此界面会要求用户输入该账号的密码，以继续登录或关联账号。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法输入原账号密码，因此此登录或账号关联流程无法完成。

en.description: After FirebaseUI Auth signs a user in, this background Activity asks Android’s credential manager to save the account details and returns the sign-in result.
en.disableEffect: Blocking it can interrupt FirebaseUI flows that start credential saving after authentication.

zh-CN.description: FirebaseUI Auth 完成登录后，此后台 Activity 会请求 Android 凭据管理器保存账号信息，并返回登录结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，身份验证完成后启动凭据保存的 FirebaseUI 流程可能中断。

en.description: After FirebaseUI Auth sends a password-reset email, this screen shows the address it was sent to and lets the user close the confirmation.
en.disableEffect: The password-reset confirmation cannot open, and the recovery flow may fail to return to the app.

zh-CN.description: FirebaseUI Auth 发送密码重置邮件后，此界面会显示收件地址，并让用户关闭确认提示。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 密码重置确认界面无法打开，恢复流程也可能无法正常返回应用。

en.description: When the user chooses email authentication in FirebaseUI Auth, this screen supports account registration, password sign-in, and email-link sign-in, including existing-account linking.
en.disableEffect: FirebaseUI email sign-in, registration, and account linking will not work.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 FirebaseUI Auth 中选择邮箱验证时，此界面支持注册账号、使用密码登录和通过邮件链接登录，也处理已有账号的关联。
zh-CN.disableEffect: FirebaseUI 的邮箱登录、注册和账号关联将无法使用。

en.description: When FirebaseUI Auth requests an email account hint, this Activity opens Google’s saved-account picker and checks the selected address before continuing sign-in.
en.disableEffect: Email sign-in flows that use the saved-account picker cannot continue.

zh-CN.description: FirebaseUI Auth 请求邮箱账号提示时，此 Activity 会打开 Google 已保存账号选择器，并检查所选地址后继续登录。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用已保存账号选择器的邮箱登录流程将无法继续。

en.description: When FirebaseUI Auth starts an email-link sign-in, this background Activity processes the configured link and either completes authentication or opens recovery if the link cannot be used.
en.disableEffect: FirebaseUI email-link sign-in cannot complete.

zh-CN.description: FirebaseUI Auth 启动邮件链接登录时，此后台 Activity 会处理已配置的链接；如果链接不可用，则打开恢复流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: FirebaseUI 的邮件链接登录将无法完成。

en.description: When an email-link sign-in needs recovery, this screen lets the user request another link or continue the cross-device linking step.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot recover a failed email-link sign-in through FirebaseUI.

zh-CN.description: 邮件链接登录需要恢复时，此界面允许用户重新请求链接，或继续跨设备关联步骤。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法通过 FirebaseUI 恢复失败的邮件链接登录。

en.description: When a user chooses forgot password in FirebaseUI Auth, this screen collects the email address and sends a Firebase password-reset email.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot request a password-reset email through FirebaseUI Auth.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 FirebaseUI Auth 中选择忘记密码时，此界面会收集邮箱地址并发送 Firebase 密码重置邮件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法通过 FirebaseUI Auth 请求密码重置邮件。

en.description: In the FirebaseUI Auth email flow, this screen creates an email-and-password account; if the address already exists, it routes the user to the matching sign-in method.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot create an email account through this FirebaseUI Auth flow.

zh-CN.description: 在 FirebaseUI Auth 的邮箱流程中，此界面会创建邮箱和密码账号；如果地址已存在，则引导用户使用对应方式登录。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法通过此 FirebaseUI Auth 流程创建邮箱账号。

en.description: In the FirebaseUI Auth email flow, this screen signs an existing user in with an email address and password and provides a password-recovery option.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot sign in to an email-and-password account through this FirebaseUI Auth flow.

zh-CN.description: 在 FirebaseUI Auth 的邮箱流程中，此界面会使用邮箱地址和密码登录已有账号，并提供密码恢复选项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法通过此 FirebaseUI Auth 流程登录邮箱和密码账号。

en.description: When FirebaseUI Auth has no saved email hint, this screen collects an address and checks whether it belongs to an existing account before opening registration or sign-in.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot enter an email address to continue this FirebaseUI Auth sign-in route.

zh-CN.description: FirebaseUI Auth 没有已保存的邮箱提示时，此界面会收集邮箱地址，并检查它是否属于已有账号，再打开注册或登录流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法通过此 FirebaseUI Auth 登录入口输入邮箱并继续。

en.description: When a sign-in method is being linked to an existing account that uses email links, this screen lets the user continue with that email-link sign-in.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot continue the existing email-link sign-in needed to link the account.

zh-CN.description: 当用户要关联的已有账号使用邮件链接登录时，此界面会让用户继续通过邮件链接登录。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法继续关联账号所需的已有邮件链接登录流程。

en.description: When FirebaseUI Auth finds an existing email-and-password account during sign-in, this screen asks for its password and offers password recovery.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot confirm the existing account password, so this FirebaseUI Auth sign-in or linking flow cannot finish.

zh-CN.description: FirebaseUI Auth 在登录时发现已有邮箱和密码账号，此界面会要求输入密码，并提供密码恢复选项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法确认已有账号密码，因此此 FirebaseUI Auth 登录或关联流程无法完成。

en.description: When FirebaseUI Auth offers multiple configured sign-in methods, this screen shows the available choices and starts authentication with the selected provider or saved credential.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot choose a configured sign-in method, so those FirebaseUI Auth login flows will fail.

zh-CN.description: FirebaseUI Auth 提供多种已配置的登录方式时，此界面会显示可选项，并使用选定的身份提供方或已保存凭据启动验证。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法选择已配置的登录方式，因此相关 FirebaseUI Auth 登录流程将失败。

en.description: When FirebaseUI Auth uses an identity provider for sign-in, this Activity starts that provider’s login and returns the response to the authentication flow.
en.disableEffect: Sign-in through the configured identity provider cannot complete.

zh-CN.description: FirebaseUI Auth 使用身份提供方登录时，此 Activity 会启动该提供方的登录流程，并将结果交回身份验证流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过已配置身份提供方的登录将无法完成。

en.description: When FirebaseUI Auth uses an identity provider for sign-in, this Activity starts that provider’s login and returns the response to the authentication flow.
en.disableEffect: Sign-in through the configured identity provider cannot complete.

zh-CN.description: FirebaseUI Auth 使用身份提供方登录时，此 Activity 会启动该提供方的登录流程，并将结果交回身份验证流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过已配置身份提供方的登录将无法完成。

en.description: When FirebaseUI Auth signs in with an existing account’s identity provider, this background Activity starts that provider’s login and returns the response.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot complete sign-in with the existing identity provider through this FirebaseUI Auth route.

zh-CN.description: FirebaseUI Auth 使用已有账号的身份提供方登录时，此后台 Activity 会启动该提供方的登录流程并返回结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法通过此 FirebaseUI Auth 流程使用原有身份提供方完成登录。

en.description: When an email address already belongs to another identity provider, this FirebaseUI Auth screen asks the user to sign in with that provider and link the accounts.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot confirm the existing provider account, so this sign-in or account-linking flow cannot finish.

zh-CN.description: 邮箱已关联其他身份提供方时，此 FirebaseUI Auth 界面会要求用户使用原提供方登录并关联账号。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法确认原有身份提供方账号，因此此登录或账号关联流程无法完成。

en.description: When a user chooses phone sign-in in FirebaseUI Auth, this screen collects the phone number, sends a verification code, and completes phone authentication.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot sign in or register with a phone number through FirebaseUI Auth.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 FirebaseUI Auth 中选择手机号登录时，此界面会收集号码、发送验证码并完成手机身份验证。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法通过 FirebaseUI Auth 使用手机号登录或注册。

en.description: In the older FirebaseUI Auth phone flow, this Activity sends an SMS code to the supplied number, checks the entered code, and completes sign-in.
en.disableEffect: Phone-number sign-in cannot finish because users cannot complete SMS verification.

zh-CN.description: 在较早版本的 FirebaseUI Auth 手机号流程中，此 Activity 会向提供的号码发送短信验证码、核对输入的验证码并完成登录。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法完成短信验证，因此手机号登录无法完成。

en.description: When the app opens a Firework feed video, story, or video link, this Activity sets up and displays the full-screen video or live-stream player.
en.disableEffect: Videos and live streams opened through the Firework player will not play.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开 Firework 信息流视频、故事或视频链接时，此 Activity 会初始化并显示全屏视频或直播播放器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过 Firework 播放器打开的视频和直播将无法播放。

en.description: When the app opens a Firework video or live stream in a separate task, this Activity displays the full-screen player in its own app task.
en.disableEffect: Videos or live streams that use this separate Firework player entry will not open.

zh-CN.description: 应用在独立任务中打开 Firework 视频或直播时，此 Activity 会在单独的应用任务中显示全屏播放器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此独立 Firework 播放入口的视频或直播将无法打开。

en.description: When the app opens a Firework video or live stream in a single-instance window, this Activity displays the full-screen player in its own task.
en.disableEffect: Videos or live streams that use this Firework player entry will not open.

zh-CN.description: 应用以独立实例窗口打开 Firework 视频或直播时，此 Activity 会在自己的任务中显示全屏播放器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此 Firework 播放入口的视频或直播将无法打开。

en.description: LINE Ads Network's FiveAd SDK opens this Activity to display a full-screen ad and handle the user's back action.
en.disableEffect: FiveAd full-screen ads cannot be displayed.

zh-CN.description: LINE Ads Network 的 FiveAd SDK 会打开此 Activity 展示全屏广告并处理用户的返回操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，FiveAd 无法展示全屏广告。

en.description: When a user reports an ad through FiveAd, this Activity displays the ad-reporting screen and handles that reporting flow.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open FiveAd's ad-reporting screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户通过 FiveAd 举报广告时，此 Activity 会显示广告举报界面并承载举报流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法打开 FiveAd 的广告举报界面。

en.description: When Android reports a connectivity change, this FlagSense receiver checks internet access and tells the SDK when the connection changes; the SDK starts or stops feature-flag polling and experiment-event uploads.
en.disableEffect: FlagSense will not pause or restart its polling and event services when internet connectivity changes, so remote flag data or experiment events may become stale or delayed.

zh-CN.description: Android 报告网络连接变化时，此 FlagSense 接收器会检查互联网连接，并通知 SDK；SDK 据此启动或停止功能开关轮询和实验事件上传。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 网络连接变化时，FlagSense 将无法暂停或重启轮询与事件服务，因此远程功能开关数据可能过时，实验事件也可能延迟上传。

en.description: When a user follows a FlatAds ad link that opens inside the app, this Activity loads the destination in an in-app web page and passes along the ad details.
en.disableEffect: FlatAds ad destinations that use this in-app page will not open.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击由 FlatAds 在应用内打开的广告链接时，此 Activity 会在内置网页中加载目标页面并传递广告信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此内置页面的 FlatAds 广告目标将无法打开。

en.description: When opened from a FlatAds interactive ad page, this Activity shows the SDK's download manager for ad offers and downloaded items.
en.disableEffect: The FlatAds ad download manager will not open, while the host app's other screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: 从 FlatAds 互动广告页面打开时，此 Activity 会显示广告下载管理器及已下载的项目。
zh-CN.disableEffect: FlatAds 广告下载管理器将无法打开，但应用的其他页面仍可使用。

en.description: When a user taps a FlatAds ad with an interactive landing page, this Activity displays the ad's web content and its close and download controls.
en.disableEffect: FlatAds interactive ad landing pages and their in-page downloads will no longer be available.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击带有互动落地页的 FlatAds 广告时，此 Activity 会显示广告网页内容以及关闭和下载控件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: FlatAds 互动广告落地页及其中的下载功能将无法使用。

en.description: When FlatAds shows a portrait interstitial ad, this Activity presents it full screen and reports ad display, click, and close events.
en.disableEffect: Portrait FlatAds interstitial ads will not appear; the host app's other features remain available.

zh-CN.description: FlatAds 展示竖屏插页广告时，此 Activity 会全屏显示广告并记录展示、点击和关闭事件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 竖屏 FlatAds 插页广告将不再显示，应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: When FlatAds shows a landscape interstitial ad, this Activity presents it full screen and reports ad display, click, and close events.
en.disableEffect: Landscape FlatAds interstitial ads will not appear; the host app's other features remain available.

zh-CN.description: FlatAds 展示横屏插页广告时，此 Activity 会全屏显示广告并记录展示、点击和关闭事件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 横屏 FlatAds 插页广告将不再显示，应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: When the app requests a FlatAds open-screen ad, this Activity displays the prepared splash ad and closes when the ad finishes.
en.disableEffect: FlatAds open-screen ads will not appear; the host app can continue to open normally.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求 FlatAds 开屏广告时，此 Activity 会显示已准备好的开屏广告，并在广告结束时关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: FlatAds 开屏广告将不再显示，应用仍可正常启动。

en.description: When the app shows a portrait FlatAds rewarded ad, this Activity presents it full screen and reports ad interactions.
en.disableEffect: The ad will not display, so the host app can still run but rewards for watching it will no longer be granted.

zh-CN.description: 应用展示 FlatAds 竖屏激励广告时，此 Activity 会全屏播放广告并记录广告交互。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 广告将不会显示，应用仍可运行，但用户将无法获得观看该广告的奖励。

en.description: When the app shows a landscape FlatAds rewarded ad, this Activity presents it full screen and reports ad interactions.
en.disableEffect: The ad will not display, so the host app can still run but rewards for watching it will no longer be granted.

zh-CN.description: 应用展示 FlatAds 横屏激励广告时，此 Activity 会全屏播放广告并记录广告交互。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 广告将不会显示，应用仍可运行，但用户将无法获得观看该广告的奖励。

en.description: When a user installs an app downloaded from a FlatAds ad, this provider gives Android a temporary file link to the downloaded package.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it can prevent Android from opening the downloaded package for installation.

zh-CN.description: 用户安装通过 FlatAds 广告下载的应用时，此 Provider 会向 Android 提供该安装包的临时文件链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Android 可能无法打开下载的安装包进行安装。

en.description: When the app or Android media controls connect to Flowplayer playback, this media service creates and maintains the playback session used to play and control audio or video.
en.disableEffect: Flowplayer playback and the system media controls for that content may stop working.

zh-CN.description: 应用或 Android 媒体控件连接到 Flowplayer 播放时，此媒体服务会创建并维护用于播放和控制音视频的会话。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 该内容的 Flowplayer 播放及系统媒体控件可能无法使用。

en.description: When the FlowSense Android SDK daily alarm fires on older Android versions, this background service sends a keep-alive update for the registered device. It requests the SDK device connection again if registration is missing.
en.disableEffect: FlowSense will miss this periodic device-presence update; the host app screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: 在较旧的 Android 版本上，FlowSense Android SDK 的每日闹钟触发后，此后台服务会为已注册设备发送保活更新；若设备未注册，则会重新请求建立 SDK 连接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，FlowSense 将错过定期设备在线更新；宿主应用页面仍可使用。

en.description: When the FlowSense Android SDK scheduled job queues this background work, it sends a keep-alive update and syncs whether FlowSense push notifications are enabled.
en.disableEffect: FlowSense device-presence and push-setting updates stop; ordinary host app use is unaffected.

zh-CN.description: FlowSense Android SDK 的定时任务会将此后台工作加入队列，用于发送设备保活更新并同步 FlowSense 推送通知的启用状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，FlowSense 将停止更新设备在线状态和推送设置；宿主应用的普通功能不受影响。

en.description: When the daily FlowSense Android SDK network job is due, this service queues its device keep-alive and push-setting update work.
en.disableEffect: FlowSense will stop running this scheduled background update; host app screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: FlowSense Android SDK 的每日联网任务到期时，此服务会将设备保活和推送设置更新加入后台队列。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，FlowSense 将不再运行这项定时后台更新；宿主应用页面仍可使用。

en.description: After a geofence entry on older Android versions, a scheduled FlowSense alarm runs this service. It reads the matching region data and sends a location check-in to FlowSense.
en.disableEffect: FlowSense will stop receiving these geofence check-ins; app features unrelated to FlowSense location campaigns remain available.

zh-CN.description: 在较旧的 Android 版本上，设备进入地理围栏后会由 FlowSense 定时闹钟启动此服务。它读取对应区域数据并向 FlowSense 发送位置签到。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，FlowSense 将收不到这些地理围栏签到；与 FlowSense 位置活动无关的应用功能仍可使用。

en.description: When FlowSense queues a geofence check-in job, this background service reads the matching region data and sends the check-in time and location to FlowSense.
en.disableEffect: FlowSense will stop receiving these geofence check-ins; unrelated host app features remain available.

zh-CN.description: FlowSense 将地理围栏签到任务加入队列时，此后台服务会读取对应区域数据，并向 FlowSense 发送签到时间和位置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，FlowSense 将收不到这些地理围栏签到；宿主应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: When Android runs a FlowSense geofence check-in job, this service queues the background work that sends the check-in to FlowSense.
en.disableEffect: FlowSense geofence check-ins will not be queued; ordinary host app features remain available.

zh-CN.description: Android 执行 FlowSense 地理围栏签到任务时，此服务会将发送签到所需的后台工作加入队列。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，FlowSense 地理围栏签到不会进入处理队列；宿主应用的普通功能仍可使用。

en.description: When Android reports that the device entered or left a FlowSense location region, this receiver records the region and schedules an entry check-in or sends departure data.
en.disableEffect: FlowSense location-region entry and exit activity will no longer be tracked; unrelated app features remain available.

zh-CN.description: Android 报告设备进入或离开 FlowSense 位置区域时，此接收器会记录区域状态；进入时安排签到，离开时发送离开信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，FlowSense 将不再跟踪位置区域的进入和离开；应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: When FlowSense sends a region transition to this background service, it reads whether the device entered or left a region and records the transition for the SDK.
en.disableEffect: This FlowSense geofence-transition processing will stop; ordinary host app features remain available.

zh-CN.description: FlowSense 将区域变化交给此后台服务时，它会识别设备进入或离开区域，并为 SDK 记录该变化。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，FlowSense 将停止处理这项区域变化记录；宿主应用的普通功能仍可使用。

en.description: When the FlowSense location job requests a region refresh, this background service updates or removes the SDK geofences on Wi-Fi according to its daily refresh schedule.
en.disableEffect: FlowSense region data may become stale, affecting its location-based messages and tracking; unrelated app features remain available.

zh-CN.description: FlowSense 位置任务请求刷新区域时，此后台服务会按每日计划在 Wi-Fi 下更新或移除 SDK 地理围栏。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，FlowSense 的区域数据可能过期，影响其基于位置的消息和跟踪；应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: When FlowSense requests a one-time location during app-use monitoring or a push flow, this service asks Android for the current location, stores its coordinates, and reports the request when it came from a push.
en.disableEffect: FlowSense one-time location requests and related location tracking stop; unrelated host app features remain available.

zh-CN.description: FlowSense 在应用使用监测或推送流程中请求一次性位置时，此服务会向 Android 获取当前位置并保存坐标；若请求来自推送，还会报告该请求。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，FlowSense 的一次性位置请求和相关位置跟踪将停止；宿主应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: When the FlowSense location scheduler queues a location refresh, this service reads and processes the device location for FlowSense tracking.
en.disableEffect: FlowSense scheduled location updates stop; unrelated host app features remain available.

zh-CN.description: FlowSense 位置调度器将位置刷新加入队列时，此服务会读取并处理设备位置，供 FlowSense 跟踪使用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，FlowSense 的定时位置更新将停止；宿主应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: When Android runs the scheduled FlowSense location job, this service checks device registration, queues geofence and location updates, and restarts location monitoring.
en.disableEffect: FlowSense background location and geofence updates stop; unrelated host app features remain available.

zh-CN.description: Android 执行 FlowSense 定时位置任务时，此服务会检查设备注册状态、安排地理围栏和位置更新，并重新启动位置监测。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，FlowSense 的后台位置和地理围栏更新将停止；宿主应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: When the FlowSense periodic location alarm fires, this service processes a location update for a registered device or starts device registration when needed.
en.disableEffect: FlowSense periodic location tracking or registration stops; unrelated host app features remain available.

zh-CN.description: FlowSense 定时位置闹钟触发时，此服务会为已注册设备处理位置更新，或在需要时启动设备注册。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，FlowSense 的定时位置跟踪或设备注册将停止；宿主应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: When a user taps next or previous on a FlowSense carousel notification, this receiver changes the visible card and refreshes the notification.
en.disableEffect: Carousel controls on FlowSense push notifications stop working; other host app features remain available.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击 FlowSense 轮播通知中的上一张或下一张时，此接收器会切换卡片并刷新通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，FlowSense 推送通知中的轮播按钮将无法使用；宿主应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: When Firebase Cloud Messaging delivers a message or refreshes its token, the FlowSense Android SDK processes the push or updates the token used for push delivery.
en.disableEffect: FlowSense push messages may no longer arrive or be processed; unrelated host app features remain available.

zh-CN.description: Firebase Cloud Messaging 收到消息或刷新令牌时，FlowSense Android SDK 会处理推送，或更新推送投递所用的令牌。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，FlowSense 推送可能无法送达或处理；宿主应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: When a user taps a FlowSense push notification or one of its action buttons, this screen opens the configured app page, link, or store listing and records the click.
en.disableEffect: Tapping FlowSense notifications may no longer open their configured destination or report the response; other app features remain available.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击 FlowSense 推送通知或其中的操作按钮时，此页面会打开配置的应用页面、链接或商店页面，并记录点击。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，点击 FlowSense 通知可能无法打开指定目标或报告点击；应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: When Android finishes updating the host app, this receiver refreshes FlowSense app details and restarts location monitoring for registered devices.
en.disableEffect: FlowSense monitoring may not restart or refresh after an app update; unrelated host app features remain available.

zh-CN.description: Android 完成宿主应用更新后，此接收器会刷新 FlowSense 应用信息，并为已注册设备重新启动位置监测。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用更新后 FlowSense 监测可能无法重新启动或刷新；宿主应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: After Android finishes booting, this receiver restarts FlowSense location monitoring for a registered device.
en.disableEffect: FlowSense background location monitoring will not resume at boot; unrelated host app features remain available.

zh-CN.description: Android 启动完成后，此接收器会为已注册设备重新启动 FlowSense 位置监测。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，FlowSense 后台位置监测不会在开机后恢复；宿主应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: When Android reports a network change and the registered device is connected to Wi-Fi, this receiver refreshes FlowSense geofence data and SDK status.
en.disableEffect: FlowSense region and location data may become stale; unrelated host app features remain available.

zh-CN.description: Android 报告网络变化且已注册设备连接到 Wi-Fi 时，此接收器会刷新 FlowSense 地理围栏数据和 SDK 状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，FlowSense 的区域和位置数据可能过期；宿主应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: When a user dismisses a FlowSense push notification, this receiver reports the dismissal time and notification ID to FlowSense.
en.disableEffect: FlowSense stops receiving push-dismissal reports; other host app features remain available.

zh-CN.description: 用户清除 FlowSense 推送通知时，此接收器会向 FlowSense 报告清除时间和通知编号。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，FlowSense 将收不到推送清除记录；宿主应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: When a user opens an ad destination, the Flurry Ads SDK displays its URL in an in-app browser and reports ad and page events.
en.disableEffect: Flurry ad landing pages will not open in the app.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开广告目标页面时，Flurry Ads SDK 会在应用内浏览器中显示该网址并记录广告和页面事件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Flurry 广告落地页将无法在应用内打开。

en.description: Flurry Ads opens this screen to show a full-screen web or video ad and report when it opens or closes.
en.disableEffect: Flurry full-screen ads will not appear; the app’s other features continue to work.

zh-CN.description: Flurry Ads 会打开此页面展示全屏网页或视频广告，并报告广告的打开和关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Flurry 全屏广告将不再显示，应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: When Flurry Ads requests a tile ad, this Activity renders its HTML creative, loading the renderer content from cache or the network.
en.disableEffect: Flurry tile ads will not be displayed.

zh-CN.description: Flurry Ads 请求展示平铺广告时，此 Activity 会渲染广告网页内容，并从缓存或网络加载渲染素材。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Flurry 平铺广告将不会显示。

en.description: At app startup, this provider initializes Flurry Analytics and supplies process start and memory-use data for performance reporting.
en.disableEffect: Flurry startup analytics and performance collection may stop, while the app's other features remain available.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，此 Provider 会初始化 Flurry Analytics，并提供进程启动时间和内存使用数据用于性能报告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Flurry 启动分析和性能数据采集可能停止，但应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: When Firebase refreshes the registration token used by Flurry Marketing, this service passes the new token to Flurry so campaign messages can keep reaching the app.
en.disableEffect: Flurry push campaigns may stop reaching the app after its Firebase token changes.

zh-CN.description: Firebase 刷新 Flurry Marketing 使用的注册令牌时，此 Service 会将新令牌传给 Flurry，使营销推送继续送达应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Firebase 令牌变更后，Flurry 营销推送可能无法再送达应用。

en.description: When Firebase delivers a push message for Flurry Marketing, this service passes it to Flurry for notification handling and forwards refreshed push tokens.
en.disableEffect: Flurry Marketing push messages will no longer be processed by this SDK.

zh-CN.description: Firebase 收到 Flurry Marketing 的推送消息时，此 Service 会将消息交给 Flurry 处理通知，并转发更新后的推送令牌。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 此 SDK 将不再处理 Flurry Marketing 推送消息。

en.description: After a user dismisses a Flurry Marketing notification, this receiver reports the dismissal to Flurry and the app's messaging listener.
en.disableEffect: Dismissal reports and callbacks for Flurry Marketing notifications will stop.

zh-CN.description: 用户划掉 Flurry Marketing 通知后，此 Receiver 会向 Flurry 和应用的消息监听器报告该操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Flurry Marketing 通知的划除记录和回调将停止。

en.description: After a user taps a Flurry Marketing notification, this Activity handles the click and routes the notification back into the app, then closes.
en.disableEffect: Flurry notification taps may no longer be tracked or routed into the app.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击 Flurry Marketing 通知后，此 Activity 会处理点击并将通知操作转回应用，随后关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Flurry 通知点击可能不再被记录或转入应用。

en.description: After a user taps a Flurry Marketing notification, this receiver notifies Flurry's messaging handler and opens the app when its listener does not handle the click.
en.disableEffect: Tapping Flurry campaign notifications may no longer open the app or trigger click callbacks.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击 Flurry Marketing 通知后，此 Receiver 会通知 Flurry 消息处理器；如果应用监听器未处理点击，它会打开应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 点击 Flurry 营销通知可能无法打开应用，也不会触发点击回调。

en.description: FlyJingFish AndroidAop runs this provider when the app starts and stores app-wide context used by the library's diagnostics. It does not show a screen or serve user content.
en.disableEffect: AndroidAop checks that need this startup context can fail if the provider is disabled.

zh-CN.description: FlyJingFish AndroidAop 会在应用启动时通过此 Provider 保存应用级上下文，供库内诊断使用。它不显示页面，也不提供用户内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，依赖该启动上下文的 AndroidAop 检查可能无法正常工作。

en.description: FlyJingFish OpenImage runs this provider at app startup to configure image loading and media saving for its image viewer. It selects the viewer's large-image and download support based on the image library available in the app.
en.disableEffect: Large images or media downloads in the OpenImage viewer may fail.

zh-CN.description: FlyJingFish OpenImage 会在应用启动时通过此 Provider 配置图片查看器的加载和媒体保存功能，并根据应用中可用的图片库选择相应支持。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，OpenImage 查看器中的大图加载或媒体下载可能无法使用。

en.description: FlyJingFish OpenImage runs this provider at app startup to prepare video playback and media saving in its full viewer.
en.disableEffect: Video viewing and saving media through the OpenImage viewer may stop working.

zh-CN.description: FlyJingFish OpenImage 会在应用启动时通过此 Provider 为完整查看器准备视频播放和媒体保存功能。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，OpenImage 查看器的视频播放和媒体保存可能无法使用。

en.description: At app startup, this component prepares OpenImage’s default support for displaying large pictures and saving media from the image viewer.
en.disableEffect: Large pictures may not load and saving media may stop unless the app supplies another image support.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，此组件会为 OpenImage 图片查看器准备默认的大图显示和媒体保存支持。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 除非应用另行提供图片支持，否则大图可能无法显示，媒体也可能无法保存。

en.description: When an image viewer closes on Android 12 or later, OpenImage briefly opens this screen to finish the return animation.
en.disableEffect: The image viewer’s return transition may fail on Android 12 or later because this helper screen cannot open.

zh-CN.description: Android 12 及以上版本关闭图片查看器时，OpenImage 会短暂打开此页面以完成返回动画。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 此辅助页面无法打开时，Android 12 及以上版本的图片返回动画可能失败。

en.description: When an app opens an image with OpenImage, this screen displays a swipeable image or video viewer with touch-to-close behavior.
en.disableEffect: Image and video previews opened through OpenImage will not appear.

zh-CN.description: 应用通过 OpenImage 打开图片时，此页面会显示可滑动的图片或视频预览，并支持触摸关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过 OpenImage 打开的图片和视频将无法预览。

en.description: When a reader opens the FolioReader highlights list, this Activity shows saved passages, dates, and notes; users can return to a passage, edit its note, or delete it.
en.disableEffect: The reader's saved-highlight list, note editing, and return-to-highlight navigation will no longer work.

zh-CN.description: 读者打开 FolioReader 高亮列表时，此 Activity 会显示已保存的段落、日期和备注；用户可以返回段落、编辑备注或删除记录。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 阅读器的已保存高亮列表、备注编辑和返回高亮位置功能将无法使用。

en.description: When the app starts checkout through Foloosi, this Activity displays the payment form, loads saved cards, and handles payment requests and responses.
en.disableEffect: The app's Foloosi payment flow may fail or become unavailable.

zh-CN.description: 应用通过 Foloosi 发起结账时，此 Activity 会显示付款表单、加载已保存的银行卡并处理付款请求和响应。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用的 Foloosi 付款流程可能失败或无法使用。

en.description: When the experimental AnalyticsTools app starts, this launcher opens its online tools content and shows a loading screen while it retrieves the content; if offline, it offers an exit option.
en.disableEffect: The app may not be able to open its main online tools experience.

zh-CN.description: 实验性 AnalyticsTools 应用启动时，此入口会打开在线工具内容，并在获取内容时显示加载界面；离线时会提供退出选项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用可能无法打开主要的在线工具界面。

en.description: When the ForYouAndMe research app is launched or a health-permission explanation is requested, this screen opens the assigned study using its study details.
en.disableEffect: The app may not be able to launch a study or show its health-permission explanation.

zh-CN.description: ForYouAndMe 研究应用启动或需要说明健康权限时，此界面会根据研究信息打开分配的研究项目。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用可能无法启动研究项目或显示健康权限说明。

en.description: When Firebase delivers a ForYouAndMe message, this service updates the notification token or displays a notification that can open a linked study screen.
en.disableEffect: ForYouAndMe push notifications and their linked screens will no longer be handled.

zh-CN.description: Firebase 收到 ForYouAndMe 消息时，此服务会更新通知令牌或显示可打开相关研究页面的通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: ForYouAndMe 推送通知及其关联页面将不再处理。

en.description: While a ForYouAndMe study is running, this service manages scheduled research recorders, activity timers and spoken prompts.
en.disableEffect: The app may stop collecting study data or completing scheduled research tasks.

zh-CN.description: ForYouAndMe 研究项目运行期间，此服务会管理定时研究记录器、活动计时器和语音提示。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用可能会停止收集研究数据或完成定时研究任务。

en.description: When a user opens the saved chat for a completed service task, the Foton Server UI SDK loads and displays that conversation's messages.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot review the saved conversation for a completed task.

zh-CN.description: 用户查看已完成服务任务的聊天记录时，福田 Foton Server UI SDK 会加载并显示该会话的消息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法查看已完成任务的聊天记录。

en.description: During meeting creation, the Foton Server UI SDK opens this picker to load people and let the user choose whom to invite.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot choose invitees when creating a meeting.

zh-CN.description: 创建会议时，福田 Foton Server UI SDK 会打开此选择页面，加载人员列表并供用户选择受邀人。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在创建会议时选择受邀人。

en.description: When a service task is ready to be rated, the Foton Server UI SDK opens a form where the user scores service attitude and technical work.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot submit a rating for a service task.

zh-CN.description: 服务任务进入评价环节时，福田 Foton Server UI SDK 会打开评价表，供用户为服务态度和技术水平打分。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法提交服务任务评价。

en.description: When a user opens an expert's details, the Foton Server UI SDK loads the profile and provides options to contact the expert, start a chat or meeting, and view a related task.
en.disableEffect: Users lose access to expert details and the contact, chat, meeting, and task lookup actions on this screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开专家信息时，福田 Foton Server UI SDK 会加载其资料，并提供联系专家、发起聊天或会议以及查看关联任务的入口。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法查看专家资料，也无法使用此页面上的联系、聊天、会议和任务查询功能。

en.description: While a user is filing a service task, the Foton Server UI SDK opens this searchable list of vehicle faults and returns the selected fault to the task form.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot choose the vehicle fault when filing a service task.

zh-CN.description: 用户提交服务任务时，福田 Foton Server UI SDK 会打开可搜索的车辆故障列表，并将所选故障带回任务表单。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在提交服务任务时选择车辆故障。

en.description: When a user starts a new after-sales service request, the Foton Server UI SDK opens the task form and lets the user enter the vehicle fault and submit the request.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot create a new after-sales service task through this form.
