zh-CN.description: 用户发起新的售后服务请求时，福田 Foton Server UI SDK 会打开任务表单，供用户填写车辆故障并提交请求。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此表单创建新的售后服务任务。

en.description: When a user adds or replaces experts on a service task, the Foton Server UI SDK loads experts and roles and lets the user submit the selections.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot add or replace experts on a service task.

zh-CN.description: 用户为服务任务添加或更换专家时，福田 Foton Server UI SDK 会加载专家和角色列表，并提交用户的选择。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法为服务任务添加或更换专家。

en.description: When the user opens messages from the task screen, the Foton Server UI SDK displays the conversation list.
en.disableEffect: The message inbox and its conversation list are unavailable.

zh-CN.description: 用户从任务页面打开消息时，福田 Foton Server UI SDK 会显示会话列表。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 消息收件箱及其中的会话列表将无法使用。

en.description: When the task flow asks for a symptom, the Foton Server UI SDK displays the symptom choices supplied by the task screen for the user to select.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot choose a symptom in this service-task flow.

zh-CN.description: 任务流程要求选择故障现象时，福田 Foton Server UI SDK 会显示任务页面提供的选项，供用户选择。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在此服务任务流程中选择故障现象。

en.description: When a user opens a task from a task list or expert page, the Foton Server UI SDK loads its details and provides task actions such as chat, meetings, expert invitations, and ratings.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot view service-task details or use the task's chat, meeting, invitation, and rating actions.

zh-CN.description: 用户从任务列表或专家页面打开任务时，福田 Foton Server UI SDK 会加载任务详情，并提供聊天、会议、邀请专家和评价等操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法查看服务任务详情，也无法使用任务中的聊天、会议、邀请和评价功能。

en.description: The Foton Server UI SDK opens this main work screen to show searchable service tasks in status tabs, with entry points for training, new requests, messages, and to-do items.
en.disableEffect: Users lose the service-task dashboard and its task, message, training, and to-do entry points.

zh-CN.description: 福田 Foton Server UI SDK 会打开此工作主页，按状态分页显示可搜索的服务任务，并提供培训、新建请求、消息和待办事项入口。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法使用服务任务主页及其中的任务、消息、培训和待办入口。

en.description: When another Foton screen opens a video URL, the Foton Server UI SDK plays it in a full-screen landscape player.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot play videos opened through this player.

zh-CN.description: 其他福田 Foton 页面打开视频链接时，Foton Server UI SDK 会在横屏播放器中播放视频。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此播放器观看打开的视频。

en.description: From a service task or its rating flow, the Foton Server UI SDK loads videos for that task and opens a selected video in the player.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot view or play videos attached to service tasks.

zh-CN.description: 用户从服务任务或评价流程打开视频时，福田 Foton Server UI SDK 会加载该任务的视频，并在播放器中打开所选视频。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法查看或播放服务任务关联的视频。

en.description: Android creates this Foton Server UI SDK provider during app startup; it saves the app context used by the SDK's shared service screens and utilities.
en.disableEffect: Foton screens that need the saved app setup can fail when they open or run.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，Android 会创建福田 Foton Server UI SDK 的此 Provider；它保存 SDK 的服务页面和工具共用的应用上下文。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖这项应用初始化信息的 Foton 页面可能无法打开或正常运行。

en.description: After a knowledge record is saved, the Foton Server UI SDK opens this confirmation screen to show that submission succeeded.
en.disableEffect: The knowledge-submission flow can fail when it tries to show the success confirmation.

zh-CN.description: 知识条目保存后，福田 Foton Server UI SDK 会打开此确认页面，告知用户提交成功。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 知识提交流程尝试显示成功确认页面时可能失败。

en.description: When a feedback or knowledge form needs a longer text entry, the Foton Server UI SDK opens this editor with a character limit and returns the edited text.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot edit the longer text used by feedback and knowledge forms.

zh-CN.description: 反馈或知识表单需要填写较长内容时，福田 Foton Server UI SDK 会打开此编辑页面，限制字数并返回修改后的文字。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法编辑反馈和知识表单中的长文本内容。

en.description: When the app opens feedback submission, the Foton Server UI SDK shows a form for the issue type and description, with controls for attaching supporting files.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot submit feedback or attach supporting files through this form.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开反馈提交功能时，福田 Foton Server UI SDK 会显示问题类型和描述表单，并提供添加附件的控件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此表单提交反馈或添加附件。

en.description: When the app opens feedback history, the Foton Server UI SDK loads submitted reports, filters them by status, and opens a selected report's details.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot review or filter their submitted feedback.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开反馈记录时，福田 Foton Server UI SDK 会加载已提交的问题、按状态筛选，并打开所选记录的详情。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法查看或筛选已提交的反馈。

en.description: When a user opens a feedback report, the Foton Server UI SDK shows its details and lets the user play or download attached files.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot inspect feedback details or open the report's attachments.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开一条反馈记录时，福田 Foton Server UI SDK 会显示详情，并允许播放或下载附件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法查看反馈详情或打开记录中的附件。

en.description: When users browse the knowledge base, the Foton Server UI SDK loads searchable, categorized records and opens a selected record's details.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot browse or filter the Foton knowledge base.

zh-CN.description: 用户浏览知识库时，福田 Foton Server UI SDK 会加载可搜索、可分类的知识条目，并打开所选条目的详情。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法浏览或筛选 Foton 知识库。

en.description: When a user creates a knowledge record, the Foton Server UI SDK collects its type, vehicle and related-task details, reviewer, and supporting files before submission.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot create knowledge records or add their vehicle details and supporting files.

zh-CN.description: 用户创建知识条目时，福田 Foton Server UI SDK 会收集条目类型、车辆和关联任务信息、审核人及附件，然后提交。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法创建知识条目或添加车辆信息和附件。

en.description: When a user selects a knowledge record, the Foton Server UI SDK shows its details, related information, activity history, and attached files.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot read knowledge records or open their attachments and related information.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择知识条目时，福田 Foton Server UI SDK 会显示条目详情、关联信息、操作记录和附件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法阅读知识条目或打开其附件和关联信息。

en.description: When users open announcements, the Foton Server UI SDK loads the notice list and lets them filter by type or search before opening a notice.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot browse or filter announcements in this screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开公告时，福田 Foton Server UI SDK 会加载公告列表，并允许按类型筛选或搜索后查看公告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在此页面浏览或筛选公告。

en.description: When a user selects an announcement, the Foton Server UI SDK loads its full text and any attached files.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot read announcement details or open their attachments.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择公告时，福田 Foton Server UI SDK 会加载公告全文及其附件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法阅读公告详情或打开其中的附件。

en.description: From the study area, the Foton Server UI SDK shows a directory of Foton technical-service materials and opens the selected online resource.
en.disableEffect: Users lose the technical-service resource directory and its online links.

zh-CN.description: 用户从学习专区进入时，福田 Foton Server UI SDK 会显示技术服务资料目录，并打开所选在线资料。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法使用技术服务资料目录及其在线链接。

en.description: While a user creates a knowledge record, the Foton Server UI SDK opens this picker to load and return a selected vehicle brand.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot choose a vehicle brand for a knowledge record.

zh-CN.description: 用户创建知识条目时，福田 Foton Server UI SDK 会打开此选择页面，加载车辆品牌并返回所选品牌。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法为知识条目选择车辆品牌。

en.description: While a user creates a knowledge record, the Foton Server UI SDK opens this searchable fault list and returns the selected vehicle fault.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot choose a vehicle fault for a knowledge record.

zh-CN.description: 用户创建知识条目时，福田 Foton Server UI SDK 会打开可搜索的故障列表，并返回所选车辆故障。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法为知识条目选择车辆故障。

en.description: While a user creates a knowledge record, the Foton Server UI SDK loads related vehicle brands and returns the selected brand links.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot link related vehicle brands to a knowledge record.

zh-CN.description: 用户创建知识条目时，福田 Foton Server UI SDK 会加载关联车辆品牌，并返回用户选择的品牌关系。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法为知识条目关联其他车辆品牌。

en.description: While a user creates a knowledge record, the Foton Server UI SDK loads service tasks matching the supplied vehicle details and returns the selected related task.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot link a related service task to a knowledge record.

zh-CN.description: 用户创建知识条目时，福田 Foton Server UI SDK 会根据给定车辆信息加载服务任务，并返回所选的关联任务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法为知识条目关联服务任务。

en.description: While a user prepares a knowledge record, the Foton Server UI SDK loads eligible reviewers for the selected vehicle brand and returns the chosen reviewer.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot assign a reviewer to a knowledge record.

zh-CN.description: 用户准备知识条目时，福田 Foton Server UI SDK 会根据所选车辆品牌加载可选审核人，并返回用户选定的审核人。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法为知识条目指定审核人。

en.description: While a user creates a knowledge record, the Foton Server UI SDK loads the available record types and returns the selected type.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot choose the type of knowledge record they are creating.

zh-CN.description: 用户创建知识条目时，福田 Foton Server UI SDK 会加载可用的条目类型，并返回用户选定的类型。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法选择正在创建的知识条目类型。

en.description: When opened from the task screen, the Foton Server UI SDK presents the study hub with knowledge, notices, and technical-service resources that lead to their details or web pages.
en.disableEffect: Users lose the study hub and its knowledge, notice, and technical-service pages.

zh-CN.description: 用户从任务页面进入时，福田 Foton Server UI SDK 会显示学习专区，提供知识、公告和技术服务资料，并可打开详情或网页。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法使用学习专区及其中的知识、公告和技术服务页面。

en.description: When the user opens the to-do area, the Foton Server UI SDK groups pending notices, knowledge items, and task ratings into tabs.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot view notices, knowledge items, and task ratings grouped in the to-do screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开待办专区时，福田 Foton Server UI SDK 会将待处理公告、知识条目和任务评价分栏显示。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在待办页面查看汇总的公告、知识条目和任务评价。

en.description: When users open video viewing from the study area, the Foton Server UI SDK loads a searchable video list and plays a selected item.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot search or view videos provided in the study area.

zh-CN.description: 用户从学习专区打开视频时，福田 Foton Server UI SDK 会加载可搜索的视频列表，并播放所选视频。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法搜索或观看学习专区提供的视频。

en.description: When a user opens a selected video or video attachment, the Foton Server UI SDK plays its supplied link in an in-app video screen.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot play selected videos in the in-app player.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开所选视频或视频附件时，福田 Foton Server UI SDK 会在应用内播放对应的视频链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过应用内播放器播放所选视频。

en.description: When a study or technical-service item opens an online page, the Foton Server UI SDK displays the supplied page inside the app.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open the online pages used by the study and technical-service sections.

zh-CN.description: 学习或技术服务条目打开在线页面时，福田 Foton Server UI SDK 会在应用内显示该网页。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开学习和技术服务专区使用的在线页面。

en.description: When a user previews a supported knowledge or notice attachment, the Foton Server UI SDK uses Tencent TBS's file reader to display the file and offer download controls.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot preview supported attachments in the TBS-powered file viewer.

zh-CN.description: 用户预览支持的知识或公告附件时，福田 Foton Server UI SDK 会使用腾讯 TBS 文件阅读器显示文件并提供下载操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在 TBS 文件阅读器中预览支持的附件。

en.description: When Foton's floating-window utility needs overlay access, the Foton Server UI SDK opens Android's overlay-permission settings and returns whether access was granted.
en.disableEffect: The floating window cannot complete its overlay-permission request and may fail to open when that access is needed.

zh-CN.description: 福田 Foton 的悬浮窗工具需要悬浮权限时，Foton Server UI SDK 会打开 Android 悬浮权限设置，并返回授权结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 悬浮窗将无法完成权限申请，在需要此权限时可能无法打开。

en.description: Foursquare's OAuth SDK opens this browser-based sign-in screen when the Foursquare app cannot handle authorization. It loads Foursquare's sign-in page so you can connect your account.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it can prevent Foursquare account linking from completing when browser sign-in is needed.

zh-CN.description: Foursquare OAuth SDK 会在 Foursquare 应用无法处理授权时打开此浏览器登录页面。页面会加载 Foursquare 登录服务，供你连接账号。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，当 Foursquare 应用无法处理授权而需要通过浏览器登录时，账号连接可能无法完成。

en.description: Foursquare's OAuth SDK exchanges the authorization code for account access tokens after you approve sign-in. It runs as the final step of the OAuth connection flow.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it can stop the OAuth exchange, so the app may not finish connecting the Foursquare account.

zh-CN.description: Foursquare OAuth SDK 会在你批准登录后，将授权码兑换为账号访问令牌。它负责完成 OAuth 账号连接流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，Foursquare 登录流程可能无法完成，应用也无法取得账号访问令牌。

en.description: Foursquare Place Picker displays nearby places and search suggestions so you can choose a venue in the app. The app opens it when a user needs to select a Foursquare place.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents the app from opening this Foursquare place search and selection screen.

zh-CN.description: Foursquare Place Picker 会显示附近地点和搜索建议，供你在应用中选择地点。需要选择 Foursquare 地点时，应用会打开此页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，应用中依赖 Foursquare 地点选择器的地点搜索和选择功能将无法使用。

en.description: Foursquare Snap-To-Place displays nearby venues and search results so you can attach a place to something in the app. Selecting a venue returns it to the app.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents the app from searching for and selecting a place through Snap-To-Place.

zh-CN.description: Foursquare Snap-To-Place 会显示附近场所和搜索结果，供你为应用中的内容关联地点。选择场所后，结果会返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，应用中依赖 Snap-To-Place 的地点查找和选择功能将无法使用。

en.description: ConnectPush keeps a separate connection to its push server and schedules tick alarms to maintain it. It posts an Android notification when a received message is marked for notification.
en.disableEffect: ConnectPush server messages and their notifications will stop.

zh-CN.description: ConnectPush 会在独立进程中维持与推送服务器的连接，并安排定时检查来保持连接；收到需要通知的消息时会发布 Android 通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: ConnectPush 的服务器消息和相关通知将停止。

en.description: When a scheduled push tick fires and a network connection is available, this receiver starts ConnectPush’s service to maintain its server connection.
en.disableEffect: ConnectPush may not restart its scheduled connection checks or maintain its push connection.

zh-CN.description: 定时推送检查触发且网络可用时，此接收器会启动 ConnectPush 服务以维持与服务器的连接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: ConnectPush 可能无法重新启动定时连接检查或维持推送连接。

en.description: When Huawei Mobile Services sends a new push token or message, this ConnectPush service forwards the token to its server and passes message events to the app.
en.disableEffect: Huawei push token and message callbacks will no longer reach ConnectPush.

zh-CN.description: 华为移动服务发送新的推送令牌或消息时，ConnectPush 会通过此服务将令牌转发至服务器，并把消息事件传给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: ConnectPush 将无法收到华为推送令牌和消息回调。

en.description: This ConnectPush receiver handles Vivo Push registration and transmitted-message callbacks; its code records the received values in the app log.
en.disableEffect: ConnectPush will no longer receive Vivo Push registration and message callbacks.

zh-CN.description: 此 ConnectPush 接收器处理 Vivo 推送注册和透传消息回调，并将收到的信息写入应用日志。
zh-CN.disableEffect: ConnectPush 将无法收到 Vivo 推送注册和消息回调。

en.description: When Xiaomi Push reports a notification arrival or tap, this ConnectPush receiver captures the message text and its topic or account details.
en.disableEffect: Xiaomi push notification callbacks will no longer reach ConnectPush.

zh-CN.description: 小米推送通知到达或被点击时，此 ConnectPush 接收器会获取消息内容及其话题或账号信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: ConnectPush 将无法收到小米推送通知回调。

en.description: Freeletics RxSmartLock uses this helper to show sign-in choices saved with Google Smart Lock and return your selection to the app. It runs when the app requests saved sign-in hints.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it can prevent the app from retrieving saved Google Smart Lock sign-in choices.

zh-CN.description: Freeletics RxSmartLock 会通过此辅助页面显示 Google Smart Lock 保存的登录选项，并将你的选择返回给应用。应用请求已保存的登录提示时会运行此页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，应用可能无法显示或接收 Google Smart Lock 保存的登录账号。

en.description: Freshworks Freshchat opens this screen when a user selects a help article, then loads and displays the article content.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to open Freshchat help articles.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择帮助文章时，Freshworks Freshchat 会打开此页面并加载、显示文章内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开 Freshchat 帮助文章。

en.description: Freshworks Freshchat shows the available help articles on this screen and opens an article when the user selects it.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to browse or open Freshchat help articles from this list.

zh-CN.description: Freshworks Freshchat 在此页面列出可用的帮助文章，用户选择文章后会打开文章内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此列表浏览或打开 Freshchat 帮助文章。

en.description: Freshworks Freshchat uses this screen to show the full answer for a frequently asked question surfaced in a support conversation.
en.disableEffect: Users may see a support conversation without being able to open its linked answer.

zh-CN.description: Freshworks Freshchat 使用此页面显示支持对话中呈现的常见问题完整答案。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户可能仍能看到支持对话，但无法打开其中关联的问题答案。

en.description: Freshworks Freshchat lists help-content categories here; selecting one opens the articles in that category.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to browse Freshchat help articles by category.

zh-CN.description: Freshworks Freshchat 在此列出帮助内容分类；用户选择分类后可查看其中的文章。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法按分类浏览 Freshchat 帮助文章。

en.description: Freshworks Freshchat lists the available support channels here; selecting a channel opens a conversation with that support team.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to choose a Freshchat support channel.

zh-CN.description: Freshworks Freshchat 在此列出可用的客服渠道；用户选择渠道后会打开与该客服团队的对话。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法选择 Freshchat 客服渠道。

en.description: Freshworks Freshchat opens a support conversation here, showing message history and controls for sending replies and attachments.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to read or send messages in Freshchat conversations.

zh-CN.description: Freshworks Freshchat 在此打开客服对话，显示消息记录以及发送回复和附件的操作界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法查看或发送 Freshchat 对话消息。

en.description: When a user taps a Freshchat marketing notification, this screen routes the linked destination or reopens the app if the notification requests it.
en.disableEffect: Freshchat marketing-notification taps and their linked destinations will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击 Freshchat 营销通知时，此页面会打开通知关联的目标；如果通知要求，则重新打开应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Freshchat 营销通知及其关联目标将无法通过点击打开。

en.description: Freshworks Freshchat shows its FAQ categories here; choosing a category opens its questions.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to browse Freshchat FAQs by category.

zh-CN.description: Freshworks Freshchat 在此显示常见问题分类；用户选择分类后可查看其中的问题。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法按分类浏览 Freshchat 常见问题。

en.description: When a user selects a Freshchat FAQ, this screen loads and displays its answer and handles links in the answer.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to open Freshchat FAQ answers.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择 Freshchat 常见问题后，此页面会加载并显示答案，也会处理答案中的链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开 Freshchat 常见问题的答案。

en.description: Freshworks Freshchat lists questions from a selected FAQ category here and opens the answer when a user selects a question.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to browse or open questions from this Freshchat FAQ list.

zh-CN.description: Freshworks Freshchat 在此列出所选常见问题分类中的问题，用户选择问题后会打开答案。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法浏览或打开此 Freshchat 常见问题列表中的问题。

en.description: Freshworks Freshchat provides an in-app search screen for FAQs and displays matching questions as the user searches.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to search Freshchat FAQs.

zh-CN.description: Freshworks Freshchat 提供应用内常见问题搜索页面，并在用户搜索时显示匹配的问题。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法搜索 Freshchat 常见问题。

en.description: When the app asks Freshchat to show help or start a conversation, this brief loading screen fetches the needed categories, articles, or support channels and opens the right screen.
en.disableEffect: Freshchat help and conversation entry points will not load their destination screens.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求 Freshchat 显示帮助内容或开始对话时，此加载页面会获取所需的分类、文章或客服渠道，并打开相应页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Freshchat 帮助和对话入口将无法加载目标页面。

en.description: When a user taps a picture attached to a Freshchat message, this screen opens the picture for viewing.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to open picture attachments in Freshchat conversations.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击 Freshchat 消息中的图片附件时，此页面会打开图片供查看。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开 Freshchat 对话中的图片附件。

en.description: Freshworks Freshchat runs this startup entry to initialize its app state before the app uses Freshchat help, conversations, or messages.
en.disableEffect: Freshchat will miss this automatic startup initialization, so its help and messaging features may not initialize correctly.

zh-CN.description: Freshworks Freshchat 通过此启动入口初始化应用状态，以便应用随后使用 Freshchat 帮助内容、对话和消息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Freshchat 将无法执行此自动启动初始化，其帮助和消息功能可能无法正常初始化。

en.description: When Android reports a network connection change, Freshworks Freshchat checks its connection state and resumes its network work.
en.disableEffect: Freshchat may not resume its network work when connectivity changes, interrupting support conversations and updates.

zh-CN.description: Android 通知网络连接发生变化时，Freshworks Freshchat 会检查连接状态并恢复网络任务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 网络状态变化时 Freshchat 可能无法恢复网络任务，导致客服对话和更新中断。

en.description: Freshworks Freshchat handles Android boot, language-change, and app-update broadcasts here, and routes Freshchat notification taps to their linked content.
en.disableEffect: Freshchat background refresh and notification-click flows will stop working.

zh-CN.description: Freshworks Freshchat 在此处理 Android 启动、语言变化和应用更新广播，并将 Freshchat 通知点击转到关联内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Freshchat 后台刷新和通知点击流程将无法工作。

en.description: Freshworks Freshchat runs queued background tasks here to process message and conversation work requested by the SDK.
en.disableEffect: Freshchat will not process its queued background message and conversation tasks.

zh-CN.description: Freshworks Freshchat 在此执行排队的后台任务，处理 SDK 请求的消息和对话工作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Freshchat 将无法处理排队的后台消息和对话任务。

en.description: Freshworks Mobile Authentication receives the return from browser sign-in, exchanges the authorization response for a session, and gives the result back to the app. It runs after the user completes Freshworks login.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it can prevent Freshworks browser sign-in from returning a usable login session to the app.

zh-CN.description: Freshworks Mobile Authentication 会接收浏览器登录后的返回结果，将授权响应兑换为会话，并把结果交还应用。用户完成 Freshworks 登录后会运行此页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，应用可能无法完成 Freshworks 登录或取得登录会话。

en.description: Freshservice Support asks for Android storage permission through this screen when an older Android version requires it to download a support attachment. It returns the permission result to the support page.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it can prevent support attachment downloads on older Android versions that require this permission step.

zh-CN.description: Freshservice Support 会在旧版 Android 需要存储权限下载支持附件时，通过此页面请求权限，并把结果返回支持页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，在需要该权限的旧版 Android 设备上，Freshservice 支持附件可能无法下载。

en.description: Freshservice Support receives the result of its sign-in flow here. On success, it saves the Freshworks session and opens the support area.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it can prevent the app from finishing Freshservice sign-in and opening the support area.

zh-CN.description: Freshservice Support 会在此接收登录流程的结果。登录成功后，它会保存 Freshworks 会话并打开支持页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，Freshservice 支持登录结果可能无法处理，用户也可能无法进入支持页面。

en.description: Freshservice Support displays support pages such as tickets, incidents, service requests, and approvals, and handles their attachment uploads and downloads. It opens after support sign-in or when the app selects a support page.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents the app from displaying Freshservice support pages and handling their attachments.

zh-CN.description: Freshservice Support 会显示工单、事件、服务请求和审批等支持页面，并处理附件上传和下载。用户登录支持服务或应用选择支持页面时会打开此页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，应用中的 Freshservice 支持页面及其附件功能将无法使用。

en.description: Freshservice Support listens for Android's completed-download broadcast and opens a support attachment after Download Manager finishes downloading it. It runs when an attachment download completes.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it can stop a completed support attachment from opening automatically.

zh-CN.description: Freshservice Support 会监听 Android 下载完成广播，并在下载管理器完成附件下载后打开支持附件。附件下载完成时会运行此接收器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，已下载的支持附件可能不会自动打开。

en.description: Freshservice Support opens the support screen selected by the app, such as the dashboard, ticket list, issue report, service request, or approval requests. It runs when the app invokes one of those support options.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents the app from opening Freshservice support screens through the SDK.

zh-CN.description: Freshservice Support 会打开应用所选的支持页面，例如控制台、工单列表、问题反馈、服务请求或审批请求。应用调用这些支持功能时会运行此页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，应用将无法通过 Freshservice Support 打开这些支持页面。

en.description: Freshworks SDK displays a support conversation in its web view and handles attached files, photos, or videos selected for the conversation. The SDK opens it when the app starts a support conversation.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it can prevent Freshworks support conversations from opening or accepting file attachments.

zh-CN.description: Freshworks SDK 会在内置网页视图中显示支持对话，并处理为对话选择的文件、照片或视频附件。应用启动支持对话时会打开此页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，应用可能无法打开 Freshworks 支持对话或添加对话附件。

en.description: Frodoking's App-Architecture library uses this LeakCanary Service after a heap dump has been analyzed. If a memory leak is found, it sends the dump and leak details to the app's configured diagnostic uploader.
en.disableEffect: Memory-leak reports will no longer be uploaded for diagnosis; normal app features are unaffected.

zh-CN.description: 堆转储分析完成后，Frodoking 的 App-Architecture 库会使用此 LeakCanary Service。如果发现内存泄漏，它会将堆转储和泄漏详情发送到应用配置的诊断上传器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 内存泄漏报告将无法再上传供诊断使用；应用的正常功能不受影响。

en.description: Frodoking's App-Architecture library opens this Activity for browsable links using the app's configured redirect scheme. It routes a matching link to the corresponding in-app screen.
en.disableEffect: Links that use the app's redirect scheme will no longer open their intended screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开使用应用所配置跳转协议的可浏览链接时，Frodoking 的 App-Architecture 库会打开此 Activity。它会将匹配的链接转到应用内对应页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用该跳转协议的链接将无法再打开预期页面。

en.description: AndroidDevMetrics opens a developer diagnostics screen with activity and dependency-injection metrics. It is launched from the SDK's metrics notification.
en.disableEffect: Developers will lose this AndroidDevMetrics diagnostics screen; normal app features continue.

zh-CN.description: AndroidDevMetrics 会打开开发者诊断页面，显示 Activity 和依赖注入指标。此页面由 SDK 的指标通知启动。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，开发者将无法通过该通知查看 AndroidDevMetrics 诊断信息；应用的普通功能不受影响。

en.description: Dagger2Metrics displays an informational page about the dependency-injection metrics tool. It runs only when that page is opened.
en.disableEffect: Developers will lose the Dagger2Metrics information page; normal app features continue.

zh-CN.description: Dagger2Metrics 会显示依赖注入指标工具的说明页面。只有打开该页面时才会运行。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，开发者将无法打开 Dagger2Metrics 的说明页面；应用的普通功能不受影响。

en.description: Dagger2Metrics opens a developer diagnostics screen showing dependency-injection metrics. It is launched from the SDK's metrics notification.
en.disableEffect: Developers will lose this Dagger2Metrics diagnostics screen; normal app features continue.

zh-CN.description: Dagger2Metrics 会打开开发者诊断页面，显示依赖注入指标。此页面由 SDK 的指标通知启动。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，开发者将无法通过该通知查看 Dagger2Metrics 指标；应用的普通功能不受影响。

en.description: Frontegg Android SDK displays the account's admin portal inside the app. It runs when the app opens the Frontegg administration page.
en.disableEffect: The app will no longer be able to open its Frontegg administration portal.

zh-CN.description: Frontegg Android SDK 会在应用内显示账号管理门户。应用打开 Frontegg 管理页面时会运行此页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，应用内的 Frontegg 管理门户将无法打开。

en.description: Frontegg Android SDK handles browser-based sign-in and redirects from the identity provider. It runs during OAuth or social-login flows started by the app.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it can prevent the app from completing Frontegg browser or social sign-in.

zh-CN.description: Frontegg Android SDK 会处理浏览器登录以及身份提供方的跳转。应用启动 OAuth 或社交登录时会运行此页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，依赖 Frontegg 的登录或身份验证流程可能无法完成。

en.description: Frontegg Android SDK displays its sign-in page inside the app and returns the authentication result. It runs for embedded sign-in, including extra verification when requested.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it can prevent the app from completing embedded Frontegg sign-in or verification.

zh-CN.description: Frontegg Android SDK 会在应用内显示登录页面并返回身份验证结果。应用使用内嵌登录时会运行此页面，也可用于要求额外验证的流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，应用内 Frontegg 登录和相关身份验证可能无法完成。

en.description: Frontegg Android SDK opens its hosted sign-in page in a trusted browser experience and handles the return to the app. The activity is disabled by default in the SDK manifest, but apps can enable this login route.
en.disableEffect: Apps that enable this route will no longer be able to use Frontegg hosted sign-in.

zh-CN.description: Frontegg Android SDK 会在可信浏览器页面中打开托管登录，并处理返回应用的跳转。SDK 清单默认禁用此页面，但应用可以启用此登录方式。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，已启用此路由的应用将无法使用 Frontegg 托管式登录。

en.description: Frontegg Android SDK requests an extra identity check for sensitive actions through this sign-in page. It runs when the app's authentication flow requires step-up verification.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it can prevent sensitive actions that require extra Frontegg identity verification.

zh-CN.description: Frontegg Android SDK 会通过此登录页面为敏感操作请求额外身份验证。应用的登录流程要求加强验证时会运行此页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，需要额外身份验证的敏感操作可能无法完成。

en.description: Frontegg Android SDK initializes automatically when the app starts and monitors validated network changes to reconnect the authentication session. It runs during application startup.
en.disableEffect: Frontegg will no longer automatically reconnect the authentication session when network access returns.

zh-CN.description: Frontegg Android SDK 会在应用启动时自动初始化，并监测已验证的网络变化以重新连接身份验证会话。此提供程序在应用启动期间运行。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，Frontegg 将无法自动监测网络恢复并重新连接身份验证会话。

en.description: Frontegg Android SDK uses this scheduled receiver to refresh an authentication token in the background. It runs when the SDK's refresh alarm fires.
en.disableEffect: Frontegg may stop refreshing the login token in the background, so the user may need to sign in again sooner.

zh-CN.description: Frontegg Android SDK 会通过此定时接收器在后台刷新身份验证令牌。SDK 的刷新闹钟触发时会运行它。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，Frontegg 登录令牌可能无法在后台自动续期，用户可能需要重新登录。

en.description: Frontegg Android SDK refreshes an authentication token in a background job scheduled by Android. It runs when Android's job scheduler starts the refresh task.
en.disableEffect: Frontegg may stop refreshing the login token in the background, so the user may need to sign in again sooner.

zh-CN.description: Frontegg Android SDK 会在 Android 调度的后台任务中刷新身份验证令牌。系统任务调度器启动刷新任务时会运行此服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，Frontegg 登录令牌可能无法在后台自动续期，用户可能需要重新登录。

en.description: When the app's SzhitTech GW MQTT client starts this service with connection details, it connects to the configured MQTT server and subscribes to a topic. It forwards incoming messages to the app.
en.disableEffect: App features that rely on this MQTT topic will stop receiving server messages.

zh-CN.description: 应用的 SzhitTech GW MQTT 客户端提供连接信息并启动此服务时，服务会连接配置的 MQTT 服务器并订阅主题，再把收到的消息转交给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此 MQTT 主题的应用功能将无法继续接收服务器消息。

en.description: fsryan.tools' Android New Relic logging adapter starts New Relic reporting automatically when the app declares this provider and supplies its configuration. It runs at app startup to enable log and event reporting.
en.disableEffect: New Relic startup and event reporting through this adapter will stop; ordinary app features continue.

zh-CN.description: fsryan.tools 的 Android New Relic 日志适配器会在应用声明此提供程序并提供配置后自动启动 New Relic 上报。它在应用启动时运行，以启用日志和事件上报。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，New Relic 的自动初始化及该日志适配器的事件上报将停止；应用的普通功能不受影响。

en.description: Attributr opens this screen to list third-party libraries used by the app and links to their projects.
en.disableEffect: The app's open-source license and attribution screen will be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: Attributr 使用此页面列出应用中的第三方库，并提供这些项目的链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用的开源许可证和致谢页面将无法打开。

en.description: In 52inc Attributr, this screen opens after a library is selected from the acknowledgements list and shows its author, license text, and project link.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it removes the per-library license details page; the app's other features continue working.

zh-CN.description: 在 52inc Attributr 的开源库致谢列表中选中一个库后，此页面会显示作者、许可证文本和项目链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后无法查看单个库的许可证详情，但应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: 52inc Attributr opens this screen to show the app's configured list of bundled libraries and their licenses; selecting a row opens that library's details page.
en.disableEffect: The app's open-source library and license list becomes unavailable, while its other features continue working.

zh-CN.description: 52inc Attributr 使用此页面展示应用配置的开源库及其许可证；点选条目会打开该库的详情页。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后无法打开应用的开源库和许可证列表，但其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: In 52inc 52Kit's Attributr screen, this page opens after a library is selected from the acknowledgements list and shows its author, license text, and project link.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it removes the per-library license details page; the app's other features continue working.

zh-CN.description: 在 52inc 52Kit 的 Attributr 致谢列表中选中一个库后，此页面会显示作者、许可证文本和项目链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后无法查看单个库的许可证详情，但应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: 52inc 52Kit's Attributr screen lists the libraries supplied in the app's configuration and their licenses; selecting a row opens that library's details page.
en.disableEffect: The app's open-source library and license list becomes unavailable, while its other features continue working.

zh-CN.description: 52inc 52Kit 的 Attributr 页面会列出应用配置的开源库及其许可证；点选条目会打开该库的详情页。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后无法打开应用的开源库和许可证列表，但其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: When the app opens the 52inc 52Kit Winds changelog, this screen displays release notes from the supplied changelog resource.
en.disableEffect: The app's changelog page will no longer open; its other features continue working.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开 52inc 52Kit Winds 的更新记录时，此页面会显示随应用提供的版本说明。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后无法查看应用内的更新记录，但其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: When the app opens 52inc Winds' changelog, this screen displays release notes from the supplied changelog resource.
en.disableEffect: The app's changelog page will no longer open; its other features continue working.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开 52inc Winds 的更新记录时，此页面会显示随应用提供的版本说明。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后无法查看应用内的更新记录，但其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: When opened from the app's appearance settings, this 52inc Scoops screen lists the available themes. Selecting one applies it and reloads the settings screen.
en.disableEffect: Users can no longer switch among the app's configured Scoops themes, so its theme-selection feature stops working.

zh-CN.description: 从应用的外观设置打开 52inc Scoops 页面时，它会列出可用主题；选中主题后会立即应用并重新打开设置页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法切换应用中配置的 Scoops 主题，主题选择功能会失效。

en.description: Fyber OfferWall Edge and FairBid display an in-app offer wall with advertiser offers. It opens when the app launches the offer wall; disabling it also makes rewards tied to those offers unavailable.
en.disableEffect: The in-app Fyber offer wall and rewards tied to its offers will be unavailable; ordinary app features continue.

zh-CN.description: Fyber OfferWall Edge 和 FairBid 会在应用内显示广告主提供的任务和优惠。应用打开 Offer Wall 时会运行此页面；禁用后，与这些优惠关联的奖励也无法领取。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，Fyber 应用内 Offer Wall 和其中关联的奖励将无法使用；应用的普通功能不受影响。

en.description: Fyber FairBid installs its crash-reporting handler automatically when the app starts. It reports uncaught errors to FairBid and then lets the previous handler continue.
en.disableEffect: FairBid will stop automatically sending uncaught-error reports; ordinary app features continue.

zh-CN.description: Fyber FairBid 会在应用启动时自动安装崩溃报告处理器。它会向 FairBid 报告未捕获的错误，然后继续调用原有处理器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，FairBid 将不再自动接收应用崩溃报告；应用的普通功能不受影响。

en.description: Fyber FairBid opens a test screen for checking ad integrations and SDK behavior. It runs only when a developer opens the FairBid test suite.
en.disableEffect: Developers will lose the FairBid test screen; normal app features and ad display continue.

zh-CN.description: Fyber FairBid 会打开广告集成和 SDK 功能测试页面。只有开发者打开 FairBid 测试套件时才会运行。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，开发者将无法打开 FairBid 测试页面；应用的普通功能和广告展示不受影响。

en.description: Fyber's Inneractive ad SDK opens an advertiser page where a user can report an ad. It runs when the ad-report option is selected.
en.disableEffect: Users will no longer be able to report an ad through this page; other app features continue.

zh-CN.description: Fyber 的 Inneractive 广告 SDK 会打开广告举报页面。用户选择举报广告时会运行此页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，用户将无法通过该页面举报广告；应用的其他功能不受影响。

en.description: When Fyber Marketplace shows a full-screen ad, this screen displays the ad and its close controls.
en.disableEffect: Fyber full-screen ad placements will not open correctly; the app's other features remain available.

zh-CN.description: Fyber Marketplace 展示全屏广告时，此页面会显示广告及其关闭控件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Fyber 的全屏广告无法正常打开；应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: When a user opens an ad destination inside the app, Fyber Marketplace displays the webpage here with back, forward, refresh, and close controls.
en.disableEffect: Ad destinations routed to Fyber's in-app browser will not be viewable there.

zh-CN.description: 用户在应用内打开广告目标网页时，Fyber Marketplace 会在此页面显示网页，并提供前进、后退、刷新和关闭控件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Fyber 应用内浏览器无法显示广告跳转页面。

en.description: When a Fyber Marketplace rich-media ad opens a video, this screen plays it full-screen and provides a close control.
en.disableEffect: Videos opened from Fyber rich-media ads will not play in full-screen.

zh-CN.description: Fyber Marketplace 富媒体广告打开视频时，此页面会全屏播放视频并提供关闭控件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Fyber 富媒体广告打开的视频无法全屏播放。

en.description: Fyber's Inneractive ad SDK opens an advertiser's store or landing page after an ad is clicked. It runs from the ad-click flow.
en.disableEffect: Ad clicks will no longer open the associated advertiser store or promotion page; other app features continue.

zh-CN.description: Fyber 的 Inneractive 广告 SDK 会在用户点击广告后打开广告主的商店或推广页面。它由广告点击流程启动。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，广告点击将无法打开相应的商店或推广页面；应用的其他功能不受影响。

en.description: When the Fyber VAMP ad SDK prepares an ad, this receiver enables its mobile interstitial format.
en.disableEffect: Fyber VAMP interstitial ads will stop working; the app's non-ad features remain available.

zh-CN.description: Fyber VAMP 广告 SDK 准备移动插屏广告时，会调用此接收器来启用该广告格式。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Fyber VAMP 插屏广告将无法使用；应用的非广告功能仍可使用。

en.description: When the Fyber VAMP ad SDK prepares an interactive ad, this receiver makes that ad format available.
en.disableEffect: Fyber VAMP interactive ads may not load or respond.

zh-CN.description: Fyber VAMP 广告 SDK 准备互动广告时，会调用此接收器来启用该广告格式。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Fyber VAMP 互动广告可能无法加载或响应。

en.description: When the Fyber VAMP ad SDK prepares a video ad, this receiver enables video playback and starts its video cache.
en.disableEffect: Fyber VAMP video ads will no longer load or play; the app's non-ad features remain available.

zh-CN.description: Fyber VAMP 广告 SDK 准备视频广告时，会调用此接收器来启用视频播放和视频缓存。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Fyber VAMP 视频广告将无法加载或播放；应用的非广告功能仍可使用。

en.description: Asmain6's FZM wallet library shows the recovery words for the user to arrange and confirm; confirmation completes wallet creation or an existing wallet backup.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot finish confirming recovery words when creating a wallet or backing one up.

zh-CN.description: Asmain6 的 FZM 钱包库在此显示恢复助记词，供用户排列并确认；确认后可完成钱包创建或现有钱包的备份。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法在创建钱包或备份钱包时完成助记词确认。

en.description: Asmain6's FZM wallet library opens this scanner from wallet, transfer, or import flows; it reads a QR code with the camera or from a chosen photo and returns the decoded text.
en.disableEffect: Wallet tasks that rely on scanning a QR code or reading one from a photo will not work.

zh-CN.description: Asmain6 的 FZM 钱包库会在钱包、转账或导入流程中打开此扫描页面；它可用相机扫描二维码，也可读取用户选取照片中的二维码并返回内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，依赖扫描二维码或从照片读取二维码的钱包操作将无法使用。

en.description: Asmain6's FZM wallet library opens this screen from wallet settings so the user can enter the current password and save a replacement.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to change the password protecting that wallet.

zh-CN.description: 用户在钱包设置中选择修改密码时，Asmain6 的 FZM 钱包库会打开此页面，让用户输入当前密码并设置新密码。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法修改该钱包的保护密码。

en.description: Asmain6's FZM wallet library asks the user to enter recovery words and checks them against the selected wallet before continuing to password setup.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot verify the wallet's recovery words or continue the related recovery and password flow.

zh-CN.description: Asmain6 的 FZM 钱包库会要求用户输入恢复助记词，并与所选钱包核对；核对成功后才会继续设置密码。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法核验钱包助记词，也无法继续相关恢复和密码设置流程。

en.description: During FZM wallet setup, this screen generates and displays a Chinese or English recovery phrase, then opens the confirmation step.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to create a wallet through the recovery phrase setup flow.

zh-CN.description: 创建 FZM 钱包时，此页面会生成并显示中文或英文恢复助记词，然后进入确认步骤。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过助记词设置流程创建钱包。

en.description: Asmain6's FZM wallet library opens this form when a user creates a wallet; it collects a wallet name and password, then begins recovery phrase setup.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to start creating a wallet through the FZM wallet library.

zh-CN.description: 用户创建钱包时，Asmain6 的 FZM 钱包库会打开此表单收集钱包名称和密码，然后开始设置恢复助记词。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过 FZM 钱包库开始创建钱包。

en.description: Asmain6's FZM wallet library opens this screen to import a wallet from its recovery phrase; it validates the phrase and saves the wallet with the name and password entered by the user.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to import a wallet through this recovery phrase flow.

zh-CN.description: Asmain6 的 FZM 钱包库会在此页面通过恢复助记词导入钱包，核验助记词后保存用户填写名称和密码的钱包。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过此助记词流程导入钱包。

en.description: When the user chooses to receive an asset, the FZM wallet library shows the wallet address and its QR code, along with the current balance.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to view the receive address and QR code through the wallet library.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择收取资产时，Asmain6 的 FZM 钱包库会显示钱包地址、对应二维码和当前余额。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过钱包库查看收款地址和二维码。

en.description: After recovery words are verified, the FZM wallet library opens this screen to set a new wallet password and protect the saved phrase.
en.disableEffect: The recovery flow cannot finish setting a new password for the wallet.

zh-CN.description: 恢复助记词核验成功后，Asmain6 的 FZM 钱包库会打开此页面设置新的钱包密码，并用它保护保存的助记词。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，恢复流程无法为钱包完成新密码设置。

en.description: Asmain6's FZM wallet library opens this screen to show and select saved wallets, with options to create or import another wallet.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to choose among saved wallets or start wallet creation and import from this screen.

zh-CN.description: Asmain6 的 FZM 钱包库会在此显示并供用户选择已保存的钱包，也提供创建或导入其他钱包的入口。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法在此选择已保存的钱包，也无法从此处开始创建或导入钱包。

en.description: When the user sends an asset, the FZM wallet library collects the destination address, amount, and transfer fee, then checks the wallet password before submitting the transfer.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to send assets through the wallet library.

zh-CN.description: 用户发送资产时，Asmain6 的 FZM 钱包库会收集收款地址、金额和手续费，并在提交转账前核验钱包密码。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过钱包库发送资产。

en.description: Asmain6's FZM wallet library opens this screen when a wallet needs its first password, then saves the password entered by the user.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot set the password needed to protect a wallet that does not yet have one.

zh-CN.description: 钱包尚未设置密码时，Asmain6 的 FZM 钱包库会打开此页面，让用户设置并保存首个钱包密码。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法为尚无密码的钱包设置保护密码。

en.description: When a user opens a transaction from the wallet history, the FZM wallet library shows its details and status for the selected asset.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to open transaction details from wallet history.

zh-CN.description: 用户从钱包交易记录中打开某笔交易时，Asmain6 的 FZM 钱包库会显示该资产交易的详情和状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法从钱包交易记录中打开交易详情。

en.description: Asmain6's FZM wallet library opens this screen from a wallet to show transaction history and provide the asset send and receive actions.
en.disableEffect: Users will lose access to the wallet's transaction history and its send and receive actions from this screen.

zh-CN.description: Asmain6 的 FZM 钱包库会从钱包页面打开此界面，显示交易记录，并提供资产发送和收取入口。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过此页面查看钱包交易记录或使用发送和收取入口。

en.description: Asmain6's FZM wallet library opens this screen for a selected wallet, where users can rename or delete it, change its password, and back up or export recovery information.
en.disableEffect: Users will lose access to these wallet settings and recovery or export actions.

zh-CN.description: Asmain6 的 FZM 钱包库会为用户选中的钱包打开此页面，提供重命名、删除、修改密码以及备份或导出恢复信息等操作。

en.description: In wallet library versions that contain this screen, the host app supplies a title and web address and the screen displays that page inside the wallet.
en.disableEffect: Any wallet feature that opens its web page through this screen will be unavailable.

zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，通过此页面打开网页的钱包功能将无法使用。

en.description: When 2C2P GAC requests an identity photo, this Activity opens the camera, captures the picture, and returns it for account verification.

zh-CN.description: 2C2P GAC 请求身份照片时，此 Activity 会打开相机、拍摄照片并将照片交回账户验证流程。

en.description: During 2C2P GAC registration, this Activity collects the applicant's personal and address details and validates them before submission.

en.description: During 2C2P GAC registration, this Activity presents address details in guided tabs and lets the applicant move between address sections.

zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户可能无法完成 GAC 注册中的地址信息部分。

zh-CN.description: 2C2P GAC 开始身份验证时，此 Activity 会说明证件核验流程、检查相机权限，并启动证件扫描或人脸验证。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户可能无法继续身份验证并完成注册。

en.description: Near the end of 2C2P GAC registration, this Activity collects the new account passcode and sends it to the registration flow.

en.description: When a user starts 2C2P GAC registration, this Activity collects sign-up details and requests a one-time verification code.

zh-CN.description: 用户开始 2C2P GAC 注册时，此 Activity 会收集注册资料并请求一次性验证码。

en.description: Before 2C2P GAC's face check, this Activity shows identity-verification instructions and starts the face-capture flow after the user continues.

en.disableEffect: Baidu-based location features will not receive location updates.

zh-CN.description: 应用通过 GeneXus 百度位置服务请求定位时，此服务会启动百度位置更新并把结果交给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 基于百度定位的功能将无法收到位置更新。

en.description: When Android reports that a saved location boundary has been entered or exited, the GeneXus location library queues that event for processing.
en.disableEffect: The app will not respond to location-boundary entry or exit.

zh-CN.description: Android 报告进入或离开已保存的位置边界时，GeneXus 位置库会将该事件排队处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法响应进入或离开位置边界的事件。

en.description: When a location-boundary event is processed, the GeneXus service detects entry or exit and runs the configured app action or shows a notification.
en.disableEffect: Location-based reminders and actions will not run.

zh-CN.description: GeneXus 服务处理位置边界事件时会判断进入或离开，并执行设定的应用操作或显示通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 基于位置的提醒和操作将无法运行。

en.description: When an app requests location through GeneXus's Google provider, this service gets updates from Google Play services and passes them to the app.
en.disableEffect: The app will not receive location updates through the Google provider.

zh-CN.description: 应用通过 GeneXus Google 定位服务请求位置时，此服务会从 Google Play 服务获取更新并交给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法通过 Google 定位服务获取位置更新。

en.description: When an app requests location through GeneXus's Android system provider, this service starts and stops system location updates and passes fixes to the app.
en.disableEffect: The app will not receive location updates through the Android system provider.

zh-CN.description: 应用通过 GeneXus Android 系统定位服务请求位置时，此服务会启停系统位置更新并把结果交给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法通过 Android 系统定位服务获取位置更新。

en.description: GeneXus Super Apps uses this screen to start a native mini app and hand control to its startup flow.
en.disableEffect: Native mini apps will not start.

zh-CN.description: GeneXus Super Apps 会通过此界面启动原生小程序并进入其启动流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 原生小程序将无法启动。

en.description: GeneXus Super Apps displays a web mini app inside the host app, with back and close controls and access to supported host-app features.
en.disableEffect: Web mini apps will not open or return to their host app correctly.

zh-CN.description: GeneXus Super Apps 会在宿主应用中显示网页小程序，提供返回和关闭控件，并允许其使用宿主应用支持的功能。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 网页小程序将无法正常打开或返回宿主应用。

en.description: GeneXus Super Apps starts a web mini app, loads its initial screen, and opens the configured entry page.
en.disableEffect: Web mini apps will not start.

zh-CN.description: GeneXus Super Apps 会启动网页小程序、加载其初始界面并打开配置的入口页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 网页小程序将无法启动。

en.description: GeneXus's Firebase Cloud Messaging integration registers the phone's push token and handles incoming messages that can show notifications or open app actions.
en.disableEffect: Firebase push messages will no longer reach the app; its other screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: GeneXus Firebase Cloud Messaging 集成会登记手机的推送令牌，并处理可显示通知或打开应用操作的消息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法收到 Firebase 推送消息，其他界面仍可使用。

en.description: GeneXus's Huawei push integration forwards new Huawei push tokens and messages to OneSignal.
en.disableEffect: Huawei push messages handled by OneSignal will stop; the app's other screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: GeneXus 华为推送集成会把新的华为推送令牌和消息转交给 OneSignal。
zh-CN.disableEffect: OneSignal 处理的华为推送将停止，应用的其他界面仍可使用。

en.description: GeneXus's JPush integration receives push messages, updates the app's notification badge, and opens the app action attached to a tapped notification.
en.disableEffect: JPush messages and their notification actions will stop; the app's other screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: GeneXus JPush 集成会接收推送消息、更新应用通知角标，并在用户点按通知时打开关联的应用操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: JPush 消息及其通知操作将停止，应用的其他界面仍可使用。

en.description: Jiguang JPush runs this service in its push process to support its user and push-service functions.
en.disableEffect: The JPush user service will stop; the app's other screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: 极光 JPush 会在推送进程中运行此服务，以支持其用户和推送服务功能。
zh-CN.disableEffect: JPush 用户服务将停止，应用的其他界面仍可使用。

en.description: When a scheduled local reminder is due, GeneXus retrieves its saved text and action, displays a notification, and removes the saved reminder.
en.disableEffect: Scheduled local reminders will not appear.

zh-CN.description: 本地提醒到期时，GeneXus 会读取保存的文字和操作、显示通知，然后删除已触发的提醒。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 已安排的本地提醒将不会显示。

en.description: After Android restarts, GeneXus restores the app's scheduled local reminders.
en.disableEffect: Scheduled local reminders may not be restored after a phone restart.

zh-CN.description: Android 重新启动后，GeneXus 会恢复应用中已安排的本地提醒。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 手机重启后，已安排的本地提醒可能无法恢复。

en.description: GeneXus's QR scanner opens the camera to read a QR code or supported barcode and returns the scanned text to the app.
en.disableEffect: App screens that rely on scanning codes will not work.

zh-CN.description: GeneXus 二维码扫描器会打开相机读取二维码或支持的条码，并把扫描内容返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖扫码的应用界面将无法使用。

en.description: GeneXus Super Apps asks the user to grant a mini app's requested phone permissions and returns the choices to the host app.
en.disableEffect: Mini apps will not be able to complete this permission request flow.

zh-CN.description: GeneXus Super Apps 会请求用户授予小程序所需的手机权限，并把选择结果返回宿主应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 小程序将无法完成此权限申请流程。

en.description: GeneXus's Android testing utilities open this screen during an app test run.
en.disableEffect: The app's test screen will not open; regular app screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: GeneXus Android 测试工具会在运行应用测试时打开此界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用测试界面将无法打开，常规应用界面仍可使用。

en.description: GeneXus's Twitter sign-in flow opens the authorization page in a web view and returns the verification result to the app.
en.disableEffect: Twitter sign-in flows using this screen will not complete.

zh-CN.description: GeneXus Twitter 登录流程会在网页界面中打开授权页面，并把验证结果返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此界面的 Twitter 登录流程将无法完成。

en.description: GeneXus's media player keeps audio playback available in the background and exposes the playback queue to phone controls and supported cast devices.
en.disableEffect: Background playback, phone media controls, and casting through this player will not work.

zh-CN.description: GeneXus 媒体播放器会在后台持续播放音频，并向手机媒体控件和支持的投放设备提供播放队列。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 此播放器的后台播放、手机媒体控件和投放功能将无法使用。

en.description: GeneXus's media player opens a full-screen interface for play, pause, seeking, track details, and playback options.
en.disableEffect: The app's full-screen media controls will not be available.

zh-CN.description: GeneXus 媒体播放器会打开全屏界面，提供播放、暂停、进度调整、曲目信息和播放选项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用的全屏媒体控件将无法使用。

en.description: The Genius Sports SportsGenius integration library opens a small message test page from the app launcher. Its two buttons send messages to the app and show the app's response on the page.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it removes the launcher entry for this test page, so the page can no longer be opened from the app icon.

zh-CN.description: Genius Sports 的 SportsGenius 集成库会从应用启动图标打开一个消息测试页面。页面上的两个按钮会向应用发送消息，并显示应用返回的结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，启动图标无法再打开这个测试页面。

en.description: GeoTourist opens this screen for a selected tour, hosts the tour pages, and can open the QR scanner after the user grants camera access.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open GeoTourist tour screens or continue a tour from this entry point.

zh-CN.description: GeoTourist 会为选定的旅程打开此界面并显示旅程页面；用户授予相机权限后，还可从这里打开二维码扫描器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法从此入口打开 GeoTourist 旅程界面或继续旅程。

en.description: GeoTourist starts this service from tour audio controls to play, pause, skip, or stop location-based narration.
en.disableEffect: GeoTourist tour narration and its playback controls will stop working.

zh-CN.description: 用户通过旅程音频控件操作时，GeoTourist 会启动此服务来播放、暂停、切换或停止位置讲解音频。
zh-CN.disableEffect: GeoTourist 旅程讲解音频及其播放控件将无法使用。

en.description: The GeoTourist tour screen opens this activity when the user chooses QR scanning; it uses the camera to read a code and returns the result to the tour.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot scan QR codes to open the associated GeoTourist tour or page.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择扫描二维码时，GeoTourist 旅程界面会打开此界面；它使用相机读取二维码并将结果返回旅程页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法扫描二维码来打开对应的 GeoTourist 旅程或页面。

en.description: Bouncer’s card-scanning SDK opens this Activity when an app requests card scanning. It uses the camera to read payment-card details and returns a result or a cancellation or failure.
en.disableEffect: The card-scanning option stops working; a checkout that depends on scanned details cannot continue.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求扫描银行卡时，Bouncer 的卡片扫描 SDK 会打开这个 Activity 使用相机读取卡片信息，并返回扫描结果、取消或失败状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，银行卡扫描功能无法使用，依赖扫描结果的结账步骤无法继续。

en.description: When an app requests a Bouncer CardVerify card check, this Activity opens the card-capture flow and can allow manual entry. It returns the captured card details and validation result to the app.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot open this card-verification step, so checkout or other card entry that relies on it may fail.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求 Bouncer CardVerify 验卡时，此 Activity 会打开银行卡拍摄流程，也可让用户手动输入，并将识别到的卡片信息和验证结果返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用无法打开这一步验卡流程，依赖它的结账或卡片录入功能可能无法完成。

en.description: When an app requests Bouncer CardVerify's network card check, this Activity guides the user through scanning a payment card and returns the verification result to the app.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot open this card-verification step, so checkout or another flow that relies on it may fail.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求 Bouncer CardVerify 网络验卡时，此 Activity 会引导用户扫描银行卡，并将验证结果返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用无法打开这一步验卡流程，依赖它的结账或其他功能可能无法完成。

en.description: When an app requests Bouncer CardVerify to check a user's payment card, this Activity guides the user through a card scan and returns the check result.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot complete the ZeroFraud card check, which may block a payment or another flow that requires it.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求 Bouncer CardVerify 检查用户的银行卡时，此 Activity 会引导用户扫描卡片，并将检查结果返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用无法完成 ZeroFraud 验卡，依赖它的付款或其他流程可能会受阻。

en.description: When an app starts Bouncer CardVerify's hosted card check, this Activity opens the verification page. It receives the page's return link and sends the result back to the app.
en.disableEffect: The app's hosted card-verification flow may not finish or return its result.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动 Bouncer CardVerify 托管验卡流程时，此 Activity 会打开验证页面，并接收页面返回的链接和结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用的托管验卡流程可能无法完成，也无法收到验证结果。

en.description: When the app starts Catch direct checkout, this Activity opens the merchant payment page and returns whether the shopper confirmed, canceled, or encountered an error.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot complete Catch direct checkout, so payment through that option may fail.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动 Catch 直接结账时，此 Activity 会打开商户付款页面，并返回用户确认、取消或遇到错误的结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用无法完成 Catch 直接结账，因此通过该方式付款可能会失败。

en.description: When the app starts a Catch virtual-card checkout, this Activity opens the payment page and returns the virtual-card details after confirmation.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot finish Catch virtual-card checkout or receive the resulting card details.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动 Catch 虚拟卡结账时，此 Activity 会打开付款页面，并在用户确认后返回虚拟卡信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用无法完成 Catch 虚拟卡结账，也无法收到生成的卡片信息。

en.description: When the Catch Android SDK opens a merchant rewards page, this Activity displays the purchase and reward details supplied by the app and returns the user's choices.
en.disableEffect: The Catch rewards page will not open, so related purchase or rewards steps may not complete.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开 Catch 商户奖励页面时，此 Activity 会展示应用提供的购买和奖励信息，并将用户在页面上的选择返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Catch 商户奖励页面将无法打开，相关购买或领取奖励流程可能无法完成。

en.description: When PhotoPicker+ asks the user to connect a photo service, this Activity opens that service's sign-in page and completes the login when the user returns. A successful login lets the picker access that service's media.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot sign in to a connected photo service through PhotoPicker+.

zh-CN.description: PhotoPicker+ 请求连接照片服务时，此 Activity 会打开该服务的登录页面，并在用户返回后完成登录。登录成功后，选择器才能读取该服务中的媒体。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法通过 PhotoPicker+ 登录并连接照片服务。

en.description: After PhotoPicker+ opens a device or account media source, this Activity shows its folders, photos, and videos. It returns the items the user selects to the app.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot show this media browser or receive the photos and videos selected through it.

zh-CN.description: PhotoPicker+ 打开设备或账户媒体来源后，此 Activity 会显示其中的文件夹、照片和视频，并将用户选中的内容返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用无法显示这个媒体浏览页面，也无法收到用户在其中选择的照片或视频。

en.description: When PhotoPicker+ starts a media selection, this Activity offers sources such as the camera roll, connected photo services, and camera capture. It opens the chosen source and returns the selected media.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot choose a media source or return photos and videos through PhotoPicker+.

zh-CN.description: PhotoPicker+ 开始选择媒体时，此 Activity 会提供相机胶卷、已连接的照片服务和拍摄照片等来源，并将选中的媒体返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法通过 PhotoPicker+ 选择媒体来源，也无法将照片或视频返回应用。

en.description: When an app opens a Front Finance broker connection using a supplied link, this Activity displays the account-linking page and returns the connected accounts to the app.
en.disableEffect: The app may not be able to finish the broker account sign-in or linking flow.

zh-CN.description: 应用通过提供的链接打开 Front Finance 券商连接流程时，此 Activity 会显示账户连接页面，并将已连接的账户返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用可能无法完成券商账户的登录或连接流程。

en.description: When the app starts the Front Finance catalog, this Activity opens its catalog page and returns the items selected by the user to the app.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot open the Front Finance catalog or receive selections made there.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动 Front Finance 目录时，此 Activity 会打开目录页面，并将用户选中的项目返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用无法打开 Front Finance 目录，也无法收到用户在其中的选择。

en.description: KeepSafe Cashier's Google Play test purchase flow opens a sample checkout showing the product and price. Pressing Buy returns a simulated Google Play purchase result.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it removes the fake purchase screen used to test Google Play billing flows.

zh-CN.description: KeepSafe Cashier 的 Google Play 调试模块会打开一个显示商品和价格的测试结账页面。点击购买后，它会返回模拟的 Google Play 购买结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，用于测试 Google Play 结账流程的模拟购买页面将无法打开。

en.description: KeepSafe Cashier's in-app purchase test flow opens a sample checkout for a product. Pressing Buy returns a simulated in-app purchase result.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it removes the fake purchase screen used to test in-app billing flows.

zh-CN.description: KeepSafe Cashier 的应用内结账调试模块会打开商品测试页面。点击购买后，它会返回模拟的应用内购买结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，用于测试应用内结账流程的模拟购买页面将无法打开。

en.description: When a Mati identity-check flow starts, this Activity loads the verification details and shows progress or an error with a retry option. Once the details are ready, it opens the identity-check screens.
en.disableEffect: Users may not reach the identity-check steps, so the app's Mati verification flow cannot continue.

zh-CN.description: Mati 身份核验流程开始时，此 Activity 会加载核验信息并显示进度；发生错误时会提供重试入口。信息准备好后，它会打开身份核验页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户可能无法进入身份核验步骤，应用中的 Mati 核验流程也就无法继续。

en.description: Mati identity verification opens this Activity to guide the user through the requested identity-check steps, which can include submitting identity documents and completing camera checks.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot complete the Mati identity-verification steps required by the app.

zh-CN.description: Mati 身份核验流程会打开此 Activity，引导用户完成所需步骤，包括提交身份证明材料和进行摄像头核验。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法完成应用要求的 Mati 身份核验步骤。

en.description: When a Mati identity check opens its signing-document PDF, this Provider lets a PDF viewer read the document from the app. It is used during that document handoff.
en.disableEffect: The signing document may fail to open, preventing the related verification step from completing.

zh-CN.description: Mati 身份核验需要打开签署文件 PDF 时，此 Provider 会让 PDF 阅读器读取应用中的文档，并完成文件交接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 签署文件可能无法打开，相关核验步骤也可能无法完成。

en.description: The Mati identity-verification flow opens this Activity to guide the user through required checks, including document and camera capture, then returns the verification outcome to the app.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot complete the Mati verification flow required by the app.

zh-CN.description: Mati 身份核验流程会打开此 Activity，引导用户完成所需检查，包括提交文件和摄像头拍摄，并将核验结果返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法完成应用要求的 Mati 身份核验流程。

en.description: When the Moneytree LINK SDK receives a VIEW link back from a sign-in or account-link flow, this Activity returns the URL to the SDK and closes.
en.disableEffect: Moneytree LINK sign-in and account-link flows may not finish after returning from the browser.

zh-CN.description: Moneytree LINK SDK 在登录或账户关联流程中收到 VIEW 返回链接时，此 Activity 会将链接交回 SDK，然后关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 从浏览器返回后，Moneytree LINK 登录或账户关联流程可能无法完成。

en.description: When a Moneytree LINK sign-in flow returns to the app through a VIEW link, this Activity sends the URL back to the SDK and closes.
en.disableEffect: Moneytree LINK sign-in callbacks may stop completing, leaving account sign-in or linking unfinished.

zh-CN.description: Moneytree LINK 登录流程通过 VIEW 链接返回应用时，此 Activity 会将链接交回 SDK，然后关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Moneytree LINK 登录回调可能无法完成，导致账户登录或关联流程中断。

en.description: The Moneytree LINK Core SDK starts this private Activity during an account-connection or sign-in web flow. It restores the flow, handles return links, and resumes or closes the flow.
en.disableEffect: Moneytree LINK account connection and sign-in flows may fail to complete.

zh-CN.description: Moneytree LINK Core SDK 会在账户关联或网页登录流程中启动此内部 Activity。它会恢复流程、处理返回链接，并继续或结束流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Moneytree LINK 账户关联和登录流程可能无法完成。

en.description: Moneytree LINK Issho Tsucho starts this Activity for its account-balance and points service. It refreshes LINK authorization when needed and displays the service in an in-app web page.
en.disableEffect: The Issho Tsucho balance and points service may not open or complete sign-in.

zh-CN.description: Moneytree LINK Issho Tsucho 会为账户余额和积分服务启动此 Activity。需要时它会更新 LINK 授权，并在应用内网页中显示服务页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Issho Tsucho 的余额和积分服务可能无法打开或完成登录。

en.description: Moneytree LINK Kit starts this private Activity to open a LINK Kit page in a browser tab and watch for sign-out or session completion.
en.disableEffect: Moneytree LINK Kit pages may not open or close correctly after a user finishes or signs out.

zh-CN.description: Moneytree LINK Kit 会启动此内部 Activity，在浏览器标签页中打开 LINK Kit 页面，并监测退出登录或会话结束。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Moneytree LINK Kit 页面可能无法打开，或在用户完成操作、退出登录后无法正确关闭。

en.description: When power is connected, the battery reaches its okay state, or network connectivity changes, Brigand, Steven Karas's background communication library, wakes its transfer service to check queued requests.
en.disableEffect: Queued background requests may be delayed because these system events can no longer wake the transfer service.

zh-CN.description: 接通电源、电池状态恢复正常或网络连接发生变化时，Steven Karas 的 Brigand 后台通信库会唤醒传输服务，检查排队中的请求。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 这些系统事件无法再唤醒传输服务，排队的后台请求可能会延迟。

en.description: When the app queues a request with Brigand, Steven Karas's background communication library, this Service stores it and sends queued requests when its network and battery policy allows. Failed requests stay queued for another attempt.
en.disableEffect: The app's background requests may remain unsent, interrupting any feature that relies on them.

zh-CN.description: 应用通过 Steven Karas 的 Brigand 后台通信库排入请求后，此 Service 会保存请求，并在网络和电池条件允许时发送；失败的请求会留待下次重试。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用的后台请求可能一直无法送达，依赖这些请求的功能也可能中断。

en.description: During Phyllo Connect account linking, this Activity opens the platform sign-in page in a browser tab and returns the authorization result to the connection flow.
en.disableEffect: Account linking or refresh through Phyllo Connect cannot complete through this sign-in route.

zh-CN.description: 连接 Phyllo Connect 账号时，此 Activity 会在浏览器标签页中打开平台登录页面，并把授权结果交回连接流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过此登录入口无法完成 Phyllo Connect 账号的连接或刷新。

en.description: In older Phyllo Connect versions, this Activity opens a browser tab for platform sign-in and handles the link that returns from the platform.
en.disableEffect: Platform sign-in and its return to Phyllo Connect will fail, preventing account linking or refresh through this route.

zh-CN.description: 在较早版本的 Phyllo Connect 中，此 Activity 会打开浏览器标签页供用户登录平台，并处理平台返回的链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 平台登录及返回 Phyllo Connect 的流程将无法完成，相关账号无法通过此入口连接或刷新。

en.description: Phyllo Connect opens this Activity to show its account-connection screen, handle returning platform links, and display the selected platform’s connection page.
en.disableEffect: The Phyllo Connect account-connection screen and its platform return flow will not open.

zh-CN.description: Phyllo Connect 会在此显示账号连接页面、处理平台返回链接，并展示所选平台的连接页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Phyllo Connect 的账号连接页面及平台返回流程将无法打开。

en.description: Phyllo Connect opens its account-linking website in this Activity, where users authorize a platform and follow links needed to complete the connection.
en.disableEffect: The web-based platform authorization and account-linking flow will not open.

zh-CN.description: Phyllo Connect 会在此打开账号连接网页，用户可在网页中授权平台并完成账号连接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 基于网页的平台授权和账号连接流程将无法打开。

en.description: Phyllo Connect uses this Activity to show its privacy-policy page or a connection error page inside the account-linking flow.
en.disableEffect: The privacy-policy and connection error pages used by Phyllo Connect will not open.

zh-CN.description: Phyllo Connect 会用此 Activity 在账号连接流程中显示隐私政策页面或连接错误页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Phyllo Connect 流程中的隐私政策和连接错误页面将无法打开。

en.description: When Airship reports that it is ready, Gimbal processes queued place-entry or place-exit events and sends the enabled event types to Airship analytics.
en.disableEffect: Gimbal place-visit events queued while Airship was unavailable will not be forwarded when it becomes ready.

zh-CN.description: Airship 准备就绪时，Gimbal 会处理排队中的地点进入或离开事件，并将已启用的事件类型发送到 Airship 分析服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Airship 暂不可用期间排队的 Gimbal 地点访问事件，在 Airship 就绪后将无法转发。

en.description: Gimbal’s background job service initializes Gimbal and runs its scheduled location and proximity work when Android starts a job.
en.disableEffect: Gimbal will not be able to run its scheduled background location and proximity tasks.

zh-CN.description: Android 启动已安排的后台任务时，Gimbal 的后台服务会初始化 Gimbal，并执行位置与邻近检测工作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Gimbal 将无法执行这些后台位置和邻近检测任务。

en.description: When a Gimbal communication notification is opened, this Activity records the click, opens its web content when provided, and then closes.
en.disableEffect: Tapping a Gimbal communication notification will not open linked web content through this route.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 Gimbal 通信通知时，此 Activity 会记录点击；若通知包含网页内容，就打开该网页，然后关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过此入口点按 Gimbal 通信通知后，将无法打开其中链接的网页内容。

en.description: When enabled, this Gimbal service receives Firebase messages and forwards new device tokens to Gimbal’s push service. The SDK manifest disables it by default.
en.disableEffect: Gimbal will not receive Firebase push messages or device-token updates through this service.

zh-CN.description: 启用后，此 Gimbal 服务会接收 Firebase 消息，并把新的设备令牌交给 Gimbal 推送服务；SDK 清单默认将其禁用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Gimbal 将无法通过此服务接收 Firebase 推送消息或设备令牌更新。

en.description: Gimbal uses this background service to obtain push tokens, process received messages, and migrate older push registrations.
en.disableEffect: Gimbal’s background push registration and message handling will stop.

zh-CN.description: Gimbal 通过此后台服务获取推送令牌、处理收到的消息，并迁移旧版推送注册数据。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Gimbal 的后台推送注册和消息处理将停止。

en.description: When Google Cloud Messaging delivers a Gimbal push broadcast, Gimbal reads the message and passes it to its communication handler.
en.disableEffect: Gimbal messages delivered through this older Google push route will not be processed.

zh-CN.description: Google Cloud Messaging 收到 Gimbal 推送时，Gimbal 会读取消息并交给自己的通信处理流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过这条旧版 Google 推送通道送达的 Gimbal 消息将无法处理。

en.description: Gimbal location tracking starts this background service to initialize nearby-place and beacon monitoring for location events.
en.disableEffect: Nearby-place and beacon events stop being processed, which can break location-triggered features that rely on Gimbal.

zh-CN.description: Gimbal 定位功能会启动此后台服务，初始化附近地点和信标监测，以处理位置事件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，附近地点和信标事件将无法处理，依赖 Gimbal 的位置触发功能可能受影响。

en.description: Gimbal uses this Receiver at device startup or shutdown to restart or stop its background location service.
en.disableEffect: Gimbal background location monitoring may not restart after the device boots, so location-triggered app features can stop updating.

zh-CN.description: 设备启动或关闭时，Gimbal 会通过此接收器重启或停止后台定位服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，设备启动后 Gimbal 后台定位监测可能无法恢复，位置触发的应用功能可能不再更新。

en.description: When Android reports a Bluetooth scan result, Gimbal sends the nearby-device information to its proximity service.
en.disableEffect: Gimbal will stop receiving Bluetooth scan results used to detect nearby beacons.

zh-CN.description: Android 返回蓝牙扫描结果时，Gimbal 会将附近设备信息交给邻近检测服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Gimbal 将收不到用于发现附近信标的蓝牙扫描结果。

en.description: FFSky App Devkit opens this page when an app shows its About screen; the page displays the title supplied by the app and an About heading.
en.disableEffect: The app’s About page provided by FFSky App Devkit will not open.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开关于页面时，FFSky App Devkit 会在此显示应用提供的页面标题和“关于”内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: FFSky App Devkit 提供的关于页面将无法打开。

en.description: When selected as the app’s launcher, FFSky App Devkit shows the configured list of tools and links; selecting an item opens its page or runs its action.
en.disableEffect: The app’s FFSky tools and links home screen will be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: 作为应用启动页打开时，FFSky App Devkit 会列出已配置的工具和链接；点选后可进入相应页面或执行对应操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用中的 FFSky 工具与链接主页将无法使用。

en.description: FFSky App Devkit opens this page for a support entry and displays the content configured for that entry.
en.disableEffect: Help or support entries that use this page will not open.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 FFSky App Devkit 中的帮助或支持入口时，此页面会显示该入口配置的内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此页面的帮助或支持入口将无法打开。

en.description: The Badoualy Android UI Library opens an FAQ screen from questions supplied by the app, with a colored toolbar and a back button.
en.disableEffect: Users can no longer open this FAQ page or read the questions and answers supplied to it.

zh-CN.description: Badoualy Android UI Library 会根据应用提供的问题列表打开常见问题页面，并显示彩色工具栏和返回按钮。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开此常见问题页面或阅读其中的问题与答案。

en.description: Boybeak EasyPermission opens this hidden screen when the app requests runtime permissions. It shows the Android permission prompt and returns each permission choice to the feature that requested it.
en.disableEffect: Permission requests made through EasyPermission can no longer be completed, which may stop features that need those permissions.

zh-CN.description: 应用通过 Boybeak EasyPermission 请求运行时权限时，会打开此隐藏页面显示 Android 权限提示，并将用户的选择返回给请求功能。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过 EasyPermission 发起的权限请求将无法完成，依赖这些权限的功能可能无法使用。

en.description: Boybeak Permission opens this hidden screen when the app requests runtime permissions. It shows the Android permission prompt and returns each permission choice to the feature that requested it.
en.disableEffect: Permission requests made through this library can no longer be completed, which may stop features that need those permissions.

zh-CN.description: 应用通过 Boybeak Permission 请求运行时权限时，会打开此隐藏页面显示 Android 权限提示，并将用户的选择返回给请求功能。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过此库发起的权限请求将无法完成，依赖这些权限的功能可能无法使用。

en.description: Boybeak Picker opens this screen when the app asks users to choose images or videos from storage or capture new ones. It returns the selected media to the app.
en.disableEffect: The app can no longer use this library to choose or capture images and videos.

zh-CN.description: 应用通过 Boybeak Picker 让用户从存储中选择图片或视频，或拍摄新的媒体时，会打开此页面并将所选内容返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法再通过此库选择或拍摄图片和视频。

en.description: Boybeak SAFR opens this helper when the app asks it to launch another app or system screen for a result. It forwards the requested action and returns the result to the app.
en.disableEffect: Any app flow using SAFR to open another screen and receive its result can no longer complete.

zh-CN.description: 应用通过 Boybeak SAFR 启动其他应用或系统页面并等待结果时，会打开此辅助页面转发操作，再将结果返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 任何依赖 SAFR 打开其他页面并接收返回结果的流程都将无法完成。

en.description: The BumptechLab embedded browser opens when the app requests a web page; it loads the requested address and asks before closing.
en.disableEffect: Pages the app opens through this browser will no longer be available if disabled.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求打开网页时，BumptechLab 内置浏览器会载入该网页，并在关闭前询问用户。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用通过此浏览器打开的网页将无法使用。

en.description: Enrico Cid’s ColorBox library opens this Activity when the app launches its color picker; users browse palettes and selectors, and the chosen color is saved for the requested setting.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot open ColorBox to choose a color, so screens that rely on this picker lose that option.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动 Enrico Cid 的 ColorBox 颜色选择器时会打开此 Activity；用户可浏览调色板和颜色选择项，选定的颜色会保存到指定设置中。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法打开 ColorBox 选择颜色，依赖此选择器的页面也会失去该选项。

en.description: CrazyOrr's ZoomCropImage library opens this Activity with an image and crop settings; the user can adjust the crop and return the saved image.
en.disableEffect: The app's image-cropping flow cannot return a cropped image.

zh-CN.description: CrazyOrr 的 ZoomCropImage 图片裁剪库会在应用传入图片和裁剪设置时打开此 Activity；用户可以调整裁剪范围并返回保存后的图片。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用的图片裁剪流程将无法返回裁剪后的图片。

en.description: Ddnosh's ARabbit Android development SDK opens this Activity when the app displays one of its pages; it places the selected ARabbit screen in a full-page view.
en.disableEffect: App pages that use ARabbit's page container will not open.

zh-CN.description: Ddnosh 的 ARabbit Android 开发库会在应用显示其提供的页面时启动此 Activity，并将所选页面完整显示出来。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖 ARabbit 页面容器的应用页面将无法打开。

en.description: Ddnosh's ARabbit Android development SDK opens this Activity when the app requests a web page; it displays the supplied address, or ARabbit's default page, in an in-app browser with loading progress and back navigation.
en.disableEffect: Web pages opened through ARabbit's in-app browser will no longer be available.

zh-CN.description: Ddnosh 的 ARabbit Android 开发库会在应用请求打开网页时启动此 Activity；它会在应用内浏览器中显示指定地址或 ARabbit 默认页面，并提供加载进度和返回导航。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过 ARabbit 应用内浏览器打开的网页将无法使用。

en.description: When an app requests runtime permissions through Grantor (dfqin Android permission library), this Activity checks and requests those permissions, then reports the result to the app. If access is denied, it can show a help dialog with a link to app settings.
en.disableEffect: Grantor permission requests can no longer finish through this Activity or return their result, which can prevent features that require those permissions from working.

zh-CN.description: 应用通过 Grantor（dfqin Android 权限申请库）请求运行时权限时，此 Activity 会检查并申请这些权限，然后将结果通知应用。用户拒绝后，它还可以显示帮助对话框并提供前往应用设置的入口。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Grantor 无法再通过此 Activity 完成权限申请或返回结果，因此依赖这些权限的功能可能无法使用。

en.description: When an app opens Dhaval2404 ImagePicker for a gallery or camera photo, this Activity handles the selected image and can crop or compress it before returning the result.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot use this library to pick or capture a photo and return it to the calling feature.

zh-CN.description: 应用通过 Dhaval2404 ImagePicker 选择相册照片或拍摄照片时，此 Activity 会处理所选图片，并可在返回结果前进行裁剪或压缩。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用无法通过此库选择或拍摄照片并将结果返回给调用该功能的界面。

en.description: Dhaval2404 ImagePicker uses this AndroidX file-sharing Provider in its camera flow to give camera apps access to image files through content URIs.
en.disableEffect: Camera capture on Android versions that require content URIs can fail because the camera app cannot write the requested image file.

zh-CN.description: Dhaval2404 ImagePicker 会在拍摄流程中使用此 AndroidX 文件共享 Provider，以内容 URI 的形式向相机应用提供图片文件访问权限。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 在要求使用内容 URI 的 Android 版本上，相机应用无法写入待拍摄的图片文件，因此拍摄流程可能失败。
