en.description: When Blaze Share receives a remote-file download request, this Service saves the supplied file in the requested location or the app cache and reports download progress and completion to the app.
en.disableEffect: Remote files requested through Blaze Share will not download, so a share operation that needs them cannot complete.

zh-CN.description: Blaze Share 收到远程文件下载请求时，此 Service 会将文件保存到指定位置或应用缓存，并向应用报告下载进度和完成状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过 Blaze Share 请求的远程文件将无法下载，因此依赖这些文件的分享操作无法完成。

en.description: When an app starts an outgoing share through Blaze Share, this Activity lists apps that can handle the requested content and launches the destination selected by the user.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot complete shares started through Blaze Share because its destination chooser will not open.

zh-CN.description: 应用通过 Blaze Share 发起内容分享时，此 Activity 会列出能够接收这些内容的应用，并启动用户选定的目标应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Blaze Share 的目标应用选择界面无法打开，用户将无法完成通过它发起的分享。

en.description: Drjacky ImagePicker opens the camera or photo gallery when the app requests an image, then returns the selected photo after optional cropping or resizing. It also supports selecting more than one photo when configured.
en.disableEffect: The app’s image-selection and camera-capture flow will not open.

zh-CN.description: Drjacky ImagePicker 会在应用请求图片时打开相机或照片库，并可按设置裁剪或调整照片大小后返回；配置允许时也支持选择多张照片。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法打开此图片选择和相机拍摄流程。

en.description: Drjacky ImagePicker uses this private file provider to create links for temporary photos used by the camera and cropping flow. It runs when the picker needs to pass an image file to another app.
en.disableEffect: The picker cannot pass its temporary photo files to the camera or cropping screen.

zh-CN.description: Drjacky ImagePicker 使用此私有文件提供器为相机和裁剪流程中的临时照片创建访问链接；选择器需要把图片文件交给其他应用时会调用它。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 选择器将无法把临时照片文件交给相机或裁剪页面。

en.description: The droidpl Android JSON Viewer opens when an app asks to display a JSON object or list; it shows values in scrollable rows and lets users open nested objects and lists.
en.disableEffect: The JSON inspection screen is unavailable; normal app screens continue to work.

zh-CN.description: droidpl Android JSON Viewer 会在应用要求展示 JSON 对象或列表时打开，以可滚动的行显示各项内容，并允许用户继续查看其中嵌套的对象和列表。
zh-CN.disableEffect: JSON 查看界面将无法打开，应用的常规页面仍可使用。

en.description: Euzee's permissionUtil library opens this Activity when an app requests contacts, calendar, storage, location, camera, microphone, phone, sensor, or SMS access. If the app supplied an explanation for a permission Android previously denied, the screen shows it before asking Android for access.
en.disableEffect: Features that use this library to request runtime access may no longer reach the data or device functions they need.

zh-CN.description: Euzee 的 permissionUtil 权限工具会在应用申请联系人、日历、存储、位置、相机、麦克风、电话、传感器或短信权限时打开此 Activity。如果应用为 Android 曾拒绝的权限提供了说明，屏幕会先显示说明，再向 Android 请求权限。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此工具申请运行时权限的功能可能无法再访问所需数据或设备功能。

en.description: ASNE Core opens an in-app browser for the sign-in page supplied by a social-network integration and watches for its return address.
en.disableEffect: Social sign-in flows that use the ASNE web authorization screen can no longer finish.

zh-CN.description: ASNE Core 会在应用内浏览器中打开社交网络集成提供的登录页面，并等待授权后的返回地址。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用 ASNE 网页授权页面的社交登录流程将无法完成。

en.description: ScanLibrary by Haggholm opens this screen when the app starts a document scan. Users can take a picture with the camera or choose an existing image, then continue through the scan review flow.
en.disableEffect: The app's document-scanning flow will be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: 应用开始扫描文档时，Haggholm 的 ScanLibrary 会打开此界面。用户可用相机拍摄或选择已有图片，再继续查看和处理扫描结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 屏蔽后，应用的文档扫描流程将无法使用。

en.description: Android Common Utils by Hanlyjiang runs this Provider automatically at app startup. It initializes helpers that report app foreground and background changes and network connectivity changes.
en.disableEffect: The SDK's app-visibility and network-change helpers will not initialize, so app behavior relying on those updates may stop working correctly.

zh-CN.description: Hanlyjiang 的 Android Common Utils 会在应用启动时自动运行此 Provider，初始化用于报告应用前后台变化和网络连接变化的辅助功能。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 屏蔽后，SDK 的应用状态和网络变化辅助功能不会初始化，依赖这些更新的应用行为可能无法正常工作。

en.description: iCloudThink’s AMap location service requests a high-accuracy location fix and sends the province, city, and district to the app. If Wi-Fi was off, it temporarily enables it while locating and restores its previous state when done.
en.disableEffect: Apps using this service lose its location result and any location-based features that depend on it.

zh-CN.description: iCloudThink 的高德定位服务会请求高精度定位，并将省、市、区信息发送给应用。如果 Wi-Fi 原本关闭，定位期间会暂时开启，并在结束后恢复原状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此服务的应用将无法取得该定位结果，依赖定位的功能也会受到影响。

en.description: Kaygenzo BugReporter opens this form when the app starts a bug report, showing the captured screenshot and configured device details. The user can add a description and open an email draft with the report text.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open this SDK’s bug-report form or send a report through it.

zh-CN.description: 应用开始提交问题报告时，Kaygenzo BugReporter 会打开此表单，显示捕获的屏幕截图和已配置的设备信息。用户可以填写说明并打开包含报告文字的邮件草稿。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法打开此 SDK 的问题报告表单，也无法通过它发送报告。

en.description: When Kaygenzo BugReporter has floating-button or shake reporting enabled, this service can show a movable report button over the app and listen for a shake. Tapping the button or shaking the device starts a report.
en.disableEffect: The configured floating-button and shake shortcuts for bug reporting stop working.

zh-CN.description: Kaygenzo BugReporter 启用悬浮按钮或摇一摇反馈时，此服务可以在应用上方显示可移动的反馈按钮并监听设备摇动。点击按钮或摇动设备会开始提交问题报告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 已配置的问题反馈悬浮按钮和摇一摇快捷入口将无法使用。

en.description: Kaygenzo BugReporter opens this screen when the user chooses to mark up a report screenshot. The user can draw on the image, undo or clear marks, and save the annotated screenshot.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot mark up a screenshot before sending a bug report.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择标注问题报告截图时，Kaygenzo BugReporter 会打开此页面。用户可以在图片上绘画、撤销或清除标记，并保存标注后的截图。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法在发送问题报告前标注截图。

en.description: Kaygenzo BugReporter uses this file provider to attach a captured screenshot to a report email or share message. It grants the receiving app access to that image file.
en.disableEffect: The report cannot share its screenshot, and submitting it may fail when the provider is missing.

zh-CN.description: Kaygenzo BugReporter 通过此文件提供方将捕获的截图附加到报告邮件或分享消息中，并授权接收应用读取图片文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 报告无法分享截图，而且缺少此提供方时提交报告可能失败。

en.description: Kaygenzo BugReporter opens this form after capturing a screenshot for a bug report. It shows the image and configured device details, collects the user’s description, and prepares a report message with the screenshot attached.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot complete the app’s bug-report submission through this form.

zh-CN.description: Kaygenzo BugReporter 会在捕获问题报告截图后打开此表单，显示图片和已配置的设备信息，收集用户说明，并准备附有截图的报告消息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法通过此表单完成应用的问题报告提交。

en.description: Kaygenzo BugReporter opens this screen from the report form when the user taps the screenshot. It lets the user draw on the image and save the marked-up screenshot for the report.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot annotate the screenshot from this version of the bug-report form.

zh-CN.description: 用户在报告表单中点击截图时，Kaygenzo BugReporter 会打开此页面。用户可以在图片上绘画，并保存标注后的截图用于报告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法在此版本的问题报告表单中标注截图。

en.description: When Kaygenzo BugReporter has floating-button or shake reporting enabled, this service can show a movable report button over the app and listen for a shake. Tapping the button or shaking the device starts a report.
en.disableEffect: The configured floating-button and shake shortcuts for bug reporting stop working.

zh-CN.description: Kaygenzo BugReporter 启用悬浮按钮或摇一摇反馈时，此服务可以在应用上方显示可移动的反馈按钮并监听设备摇动。点击按钮或摇动设备会开始提交问题报告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 已配置的问题反馈悬浮按钮和摇一摇快捷入口将无法使用。

en.description: Kaygenzo BugReporter uses this file provider to attach a captured screenshot to a report email or share message. It grants the receiving app access to that image file.
en.disableEffect: The report cannot share its screenshot, and submitting it may fail when the provider is missing.

zh-CN.description: Kaygenzo BugReporter 通过此文件提供方将捕获的截图附加到报告邮件或分享消息中，并授权接收应用读取图片文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 报告无法分享截图，而且缺少此提供方时提交报告可能失败。

en.description: Kaygenzo BugReporter opens this report screen after capturing a screenshot. It shows device details, lets the user describe the issue and mark up the image, then opens a message composer with the report and screenshot.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot complete the app’s built-in bug-report flow through this screen.

zh-CN.description: Kaygenzo BugReporter 会在捕获截图后打开此报告页面，显示设备信息，供用户描述问题并标注图片，随后打开附有报告和截图的消息编辑器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法通过此页面完成应用内置的问题反馈流程。

en.description: Kaygenzo BugReporter opens this report form after capturing a screenshot. It collects a description and device details, shows the image, and prepares a report message with the screenshot attached.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot submit a bug report through this version of the form.

zh-CN.description: Kaygenzo BugReporter 会在捕获截图后打开此报告表单，收集问题说明和设备信息、显示图片，并准备附有截图的报告消息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法通过此版本的表单提交问题报告。

en.description: Kaygenzo BugReporter opens this screen from a report when the user taps its screenshot. It lets the user draw on the image and save the marked-up version.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot annotate screenshots in this version of the bug-report flow.

zh-CN.description: 用户在问题报告中点击截图时，Kaygenzo BugReporter 会打开此页面。用户可以在图片上绘画并保存标注后的版本。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法在此版本的问题反馈流程中标注截图。

en.description: When Kaygenzo BugReporter has floating-button or shake reporting enabled, this service can show a movable report button over the app and listen for a shake. Tapping the button or shaking the device starts a report.
en.disableEffect: The configured floating-button and shake shortcuts for bug reporting stop working.

zh-CN.description: Kaygenzo BugReporter 启用悬浮按钮或摇一摇反馈时，此服务可以在应用上方显示可移动的反馈按钮并监听设备摇动。点击按钮或摇动设备会开始提交问题报告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 已配置的问题反馈悬浮按钮和摇一摇快捷入口将无法使用。

en.description: Android starts zawn's Root Activity library Activity from the app launcher; it routes the launch to the app's normal start screen or to another screen requested by the app.
en.disableEffect: The launcher entry or screen routing can no longer reach the app, so users may be unable to open it normally.

zh-CN.description: Android 从应用启动器启动 zawn 的 Root Activity 库 Activity；它会把启动请求转到应用主界面，或转到应用指定的其他界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 启动器入口或界面跳转无法到达应用，用户可能无法正常打开应用。

en.description: When the app starts an in-app purchase, Reactive Billing opens the supplied purchase confirmation and returns the result to the app.
en.disableEffect: In-app purchases that use Reactive Billing cannot complete.

zh-CN.description: 应用发起应用内购买时，Reactive Billing 会打开相应的购买确认界面，并将结果返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用 Reactive Billing 的应用内购买将无法完成。

en.description: During LinkedIn sign-in, Mark Zhai’s Authorize library displays the authorization webpage and returns the result after the page redirects to the app.
en.disableEffect: The app’s LinkedIn sign-in flow cannot complete.

zh-CN.description: LinkedIn 登录期间，Mark Zhai 的 Authorize 库会显示授权网页，并在网页跳转回应用后返回登录结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用的 LinkedIn 登录流程将无法完成。

en.description: Mark Zhai’s Share library demo shows a sample message and sharing options; choosing one shares a sample link and image.
en.disableEffect: Blocking this Activity removes the Share library’s sample sharing screen.

zh-CN.description: Mark Zhai 的 Share 库演示页面会显示示例消息和分享选项；选择一项后会分享示例链接和图片。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用此 Activity 后，Share 库的示例分享页面将无法打开。

en.description: BlockCanary opens this diagnostics screen to list recorded UI freezes and show details that can be deleted or shared.
en.disableEffect: The app’s saved BlockCanary freeze reports cannot be reviewed in this screen.

zh-CN.description: BlockCanary 会在此诊断页面列出已记录的界面卡顿，并显示可删除或分享的详情。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法在此页面查看已保存的 BlockCanary 卡顿报告。

en.description: BlockCanary opens a screen listing recorded app freezes, with options to view, share, or delete their reports.
en.disableEffect: Users will no longer be able to view or share recorded freeze reports from this screen.

zh-CN.description: BlockCanary 会打开页面列出应用记录到的卡顿信息，并提供查看、分享或删除记录的选项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过此页面查看或分享应用的卡顿记录。

en.description: The Omottec AndroidLog library uses this Activity as a small logging control screen. It lets a developer turn the library's log output on or off and write a test entry.
en.disableEffect: The screen for changing this library's logging setting and writing a test entry will be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: Omottec AndroidLog 使用此 Activity 提供简单的日志控制页面，开发者可在这里开启或关闭库的日志输出，也可写入一条测试记录。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 将无法打开此页面来调整库的日志设置或写入测试记录。

en.description: When Android reports startup, power, screen, battery, storage, media, download, network, or Bluetooth changes, the OnciZL Daemon SDK starts its background services. Those services restart background tasks that the app registered with the SDK.
en.disableEffect: The SDK will no longer respond to these system events to start its background keep-alive work.

zh-CN.description: 当 Android 发出开机、电源、屏幕、电量、存储、媒体、下载、网络或蓝牙状态变化广播时，OnciZL Daemon SDK 会启动后台服务。这些服务会重新启动应用登记的后台任务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: SDK 将不再响应这些系统事件来启动后台保活任务。

en.description: The OnciZL Daemon SDK starts this Service in a separate background process. It periodically restarts the service tasks registered by the app.
en.disableEffect: The SDK will stop restarting the app's registered background services.

zh-CN.description: OnciZL Daemon SDK 会在独立的后台进程中启动此 Service，并定期重启应用登记的服务任务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: SDK 将不再重新启动应用登记的后台服务。

en.description: The OnciZL Daemon SDK runs this short-lived helper from its foreground keep-alive path on newer Android versions. It briefly starts foreground work and clears the temporary notification.
en.disableEffect: The daemon SDK's foreground keep-alive path will not complete as designed.

zh-CN.description: 在较新的 Android 版本上，OnciZL Daemon SDK 会在前台保活流程中短暂运行此辅助 Service。它会短暂进入前台并移除临时通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Daemon SDK 的前台保活流程将无法按预期完成。

en.description: The OnciZL Daemon SDK starts this foreground Service to keep background work active. While it runs, it repeatedly starts the companion worker that restarts the app's registered background tasks.
en.disableEffect: The SDK's background keep-alive and automatic service restarts will stop.

zh-CN.description: OnciZL Daemon SDK 会启动此前台 Service 来维持后台工作。运行期间，它会反复启动配套服务，以重新启动应用登记的后台任务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: SDK 的后台保活和自动服务重启将停止。

en.description: Android starts this Panpf Activity Monitor provider with the app process, and it registers listeners that track when app Activities are created, started, resumed, paused, stopped, or destroyed.
en.disableEffect: Activity Monitor counts and lifecycle callbacks stop updating, but the app's screens can still launch.

zh-CN.description: Android 随应用进程启动 Panpf Activity Monitor Provider；它会注册监听器，跟踪应用页面的创建、启动、恢复、暂停、停止和销毁状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Activity Monitor 的页面计数和生命周期回调将停止更新，但应用页面仍可启动。

en.description: Lynx is a developer log viewer; when the app launches this screen, it shows log messages in an on-screen panel.
en.disableEffect: The Lynx debugging screen becomes unavailable; regular app features continue to work.

zh-CN.description: Lynx 是开发者日志查看工具；应用打开此页面时，它会在屏幕面板中显示日志信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Lynx 调试页面将无法打开，但应用的常规功能仍可使用。

en.description: Autsoft’s Krate Kotlin SharedPreferences wrapper includes this sample Activity; when opened, it performs basic Activity startup but adds no content or library behavior.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it does not affect Krate’s SharedPreferences functions; it only removes this empty sample screen.

zh-CN.description: Autsoft 的 Krate Kotlin SharedPreferences 封装库中包含此示例 Activity；打开时它只执行基础启动流程，不添加界面内容，也不执行库功能。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后不会影响 Krate 的 SharedPreferences 功能，只会移除此空白示例界面。

en.description: The PrivacyStreams framework’s accessibility Service runs after the user enables it in Android Accessibility settings; it forwards screen events and the current window’s content to PrivacyStreams handlers.
en.disableEffect: PrivacyStreams will stop receiving accessibility event data, while the app’s other screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Android 辅助功能设置中启用后，PrivacyStreams 框架的辅助功能 Service 会把界面事件和当前窗口内容交给 PrivacyStreams 处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: PrivacyStreams 将无法再接收辅助功能事件数据，但应用的其他界面仍可使用。

en.description: The PrivacyStreams framework’s accessibility Service runs after the user enables it in Android settings; it forwards accessibility changes and the current window’s content to PrivacyStreams handlers.
en.disableEffect: PrivacyStreams will stop receiving accessibility event data, while the app’s other screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Android 设置中启用后，PrivacyStreams 框架的辅助功能 Service 会把界面变化和当前窗口内容交给 PrivacyStreams 处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: PrivacyStreams 将无法再接收辅助功能事件数据，但应用的其他界面仍可使用。

en.description: When Android reports a phone state change, the PrivacyStreams Receiver registers a listener that logs whether a call is idle, ringing or active, along with any number Android provides.
en.disableEffect: PrivacyStreams will stop observing and logging call-state changes; phone calls and the dialer continue to work.

zh-CN.description: Android 报告电话状态变化时，PrivacyStreams 的 Receiver 会注册监听器，记录电话处于空闲、响铃或通话状态，以及 Android 提供的号码。
zh-CN.disableEffect: PrivacyStreams 将停止监测和记录电话状态变化；拨打和接听电话仍可正常进行。

en.description: PrivacyStreams’ Gmail integration opens this Activity when a Gmail data request needs Google account access; it lets the user choose an account or approve access, then returns the Gmail connection to the app.
en.disableEffect: Apps using this integration cannot complete Gmail authorization or access Gmail data through PrivacyStreams.

zh-CN.description: PrivacyStreams 的 Gmail 集成在读取 Gmail 数据需要 Google 账号授权时打开此 Activity；用户可选择账号或批准访问，之后连接会返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此集成的应用将无法完成 Gmail 授权，也无法通过 PrivacyStreams 读取 Gmail 数据。

en.description: PrivacyStreams’ image tools open this Activity when the app requests a photo; it opens Android’s camera with an output file and reports the capture result to the app.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents photo capture through PrivacyStreams and can break app flows that depend on that capture screen.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求拍照时，PrivacyStreams 图像工具会打开此 Activity；它调用 Android 相机并提供照片保存文件，再把拍摄结果返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用无法通过 PrivacyStreams 拍照，依赖此拍摄界面的流程也可能失效。

en.description: After the user enables notification access in Android settings, the PrivacyStreams Service receives posted and removed notifications and sends their details to PrivacyStreams handlers.
en.disableEffect: PrivacyStreams will stop receiving notification content and change events; the app’s other features remain available.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Android 设置中启用通知访问后，PrivacyStreams 的 Service 会接收新发布和已移除的通知，并把通知信息交给 PrivacyStreams 处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: PrivacyStreams 将无法再接收通知内容和变化信息，但应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: After the user enables notification access in Android settings, the PrivacyStreams Service receives notifications as they appear or disappear and forwards them to PrivacyStreams handlers.
en.disableEffect: PrivacyStreams will stop receiving notification events; the app’s other features remain available.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Android 设置中启用通知访问后，PrivacyStreams 的 Service 会接收通知出现或消失的事件，并交给 PrivacyStreams 处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: PrivacyStreams 将无法再接收通知事件，但应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: PrivacyStreams’ camera flow uses this file provider to let Android’s camera app write a photo to the output file requested by the app.
en.disableEffect: Photo capture may fail because the camera cannot access the requested output file.

zh-CN.description: PrivacyStreams 的拍照流程使用此文件提供器，让 Android 相机能够写入应用指定的照片文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 相机无法访问指定的照片文件，拍摄流程可能失败。

en.description: PrivacyStreams starts this Activity when a data query needs Android permissions; it can open Accessibility or notification access settings, request other permissions, and continue the waiting query.
en.disableEffect: Permission-gated PrivacyStreams queries may fail to get access or return results.

zh-CN.description: PrivacyStreams 的数据查询需要 Android 权限时会启动此 Activity；它可打开辅助功能或通知访问设置、申请其他权限，并继续等待中的查询。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要权限的 PrivacyStreams 查询可能无法取得访问权限或返回结果。

en.description: Older PrivacyStreams queries start this Activity to request required Android permissions; after the user responds, it resumes the waiting query.
en.disableEffect: Older PrivacyStreams queries that need Android permissions may not complete.

zh-CN.description: 旧版 PrivacyStreams 查询需要 Android 权限时会启动此 Activity；用户作出选择后，它会继续等待中的查询。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要 Android 权限的旧版 PrivacyStreams 查询可能无法完成。

en.description: If automatic restart is enabled, Shadowsocks starts the saved proxy after the phone finishes booting or the app is replaced.
en.disableEffect: The saved proxy will no longer start automatically after a reboot or app update, but it can still be started manually.

zh-CN.description: 启用重启后自动恢复时，Shadowsocks 会在手机开机完成或应用更新后启动已保存的代理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 重启或更新后代理将不再自动启动，但仍可手动连接。

en.description: When a user opens a Shadowsocks server link, this screen reads the link and asks for confirmation before adding its server profiles.
en.disableEffect: Users will lose the option to add server profiles by opening a link.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 Shadowsocks 服务器链接时，此页面会读取链接内容，并在添加服务器配置前请求确认。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过打开链接来添加服务器配置。

en.description: When Shadowsocks starts in VPN mode, this screen asks Android to approve the VPN connection; if the phone is locked, it waits until the user unlocks it.
en.disableEffect: Without the approval screen, Android may not grant the access needed to connect in VPN mode.

zh-CN.description: Shadowsocks 以 VPN 模式启动时，此页面会向 Android 请求 VPN 连接授权；如果手机处于锁定状态，它会等到用户解锁后再请求。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 缺少授权页面时，Android 可能不会授予 VPN 模式所需的连接权限。

en.description: While a Shadowsocks proxy profile is active, this background service keeps its local proxy connection running and shows a connection notification.
en.disableEffect: The proxy connection handled by this service will stop.

zh-CN.description: Shadowsocks 代理配置启用时，此后台服务会维持本地代理连接，并显示连接通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 此服务负责的代理连接将停止。

en.description: In transparent-proxy mode, this service redirects device traffic through the selected Shadowsocks proxy.
en.disableEffect: Transparent-proxy connections will stop working.

zh-CN.description: 在透明代理模式下，此服务会将设备流量转发到所选的 Shadowsocks 代理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 透明代理连接将无法继续工作。

en.description: This Shadowsocks VPN service creates an Android VPN connection and routes configured device traffic through the selected proxy.
en.disableEffect: Shadowsocks VPN connections cannot start or remain active.

zh-CN.description: 此 Shadowsocks VPN 服务会建立 Android VPN 连接，并将配置的设备流量转发到所选代理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Shadowsocks VPN 连接将无法启动或保持运行。

en.description: When a user refreshes server subscriptions, this service downloads the configured lists and adds the server profiles they contain.
en.disableEffect: Subscription-linked server lists will no longer refresh, so their saved profiles may become outdated.

zh-CN.description: 用户刷新服务器订阅时，此服务会下载已配置的列表，并添加其中的服务器配置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 订阅服务器列表将无法刷新，已保存的配置可能因此过期。

en.description: The ZXing Simplify library opens a camera scanner for QR codes and barcodes, with a flashlight and an option to scan an image from the gallery; it returns the decoded text to the caller.
en.disableEffect: QR-code or barcode scanning that uses this library will stop working.

zh-CN.description: ZXing Simplify 会打开二维码和条形码相机扫描页面，提供手电筒及从相册扫描图片的选项，并将识别文本返回给调用方。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此库的二维码或条形码扫描功能将停止工作。

en.description: StartActivityX briefly opens this transparent screen for activity or permission requests that need to return a result to the app.
en.disableEffect: Result-based launches or permission requests that rely on StartActivityX may fail.

zh-CN.description: StartActivityX 会在需要将结果返回应用的页面启动或权限请求中短暂打开此透明页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖 StartActivityX 的结果返回式启动或权限请求可能失败。

en.description: The Roborazzi Android screenshot-testing library opens this themed activity as a surface for capturing app screens during screenshot tests.
en.disableEffect: Roborazzi screenshot tests that use this capture screen will not run correctly.

zh-CN.description: Roborazzi Android 截图测试库会在截图测试期间打开此主题页面，用作捕获应用画面的载体。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此捕获页面的 Roborazzi 截图测试将无法正常运行。

en.description: The Roborazzi Android screenshot-testing library provides this transparent activity for screenshot-test capture flows that need a transparent screen.
en.disableEffect: Roborazzi screenshot tests that require this transparent capture screen will not work correctly.

zh-CN.description: Roborazzi Android 截图测试库提供此透明页面，供需要透明屏幕的截图捕获流程使用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要此透明捕获页面的 Roborazzi 截图测试将无法正常运行。

en.description: Venom (YarikSOffice) is a developer tool for testing process-death behavior. This Activity waits about a second after opening, then ends the app process; one test mode moves the app to the background first.
en.disableEffect: Blocking it disables the Venom process-death test, while normal app features continue to work.

zh-CN.description: Venom（YarikSOffice）是用于测试进程退出行为的开发工具。此 Activity 打开约一秒后会结束应用进程；一种测试模式会先将应用移至后台。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用它会使 Venom 进程退出测试无法运行，但应用的正常功能仍可使用。

en.description: Venom (YarikSOffice) is a developer process-death testing tool. Its older service keeps a test notification running and can use it to start the process-death test or cancel it.
en.disableEffect: The test notification and its process-death controls will no longer be available; normal app use is unaffected.

zh-CN.description: Venom（YarikSOffice）是进程退出测试工具。此旧版服务会持续显示测试通知，并可通过通知启动或取消进程退出测试。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 测试通知及其进程退出控制将不可用，应用的正常使用不受影响。

en.description: Venom (YarikSOffice) is a developer process-death testing tool. This service keeps its test notification running and stops when the test is canceled.
en.disableEffect: The test notification cannot run or be canceled through this service; normal app use is unaffected.

zh-CN.description: Venom（YarikSOffice）是进程退出测试工具。此服务会持续显示测试通知，并在测试取消时停止。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 此服务无法显示或取消测试通知，应用的正常使用不受影响。

en.description: FlankLocation uses this background service to connect to Google Play location services and process queued location requests. It disconnects after the work is finished.
en.disableEffect: Apps that rely on FlankLocation may stop receiving background location results if this service is disabled.

zh-CN.description: FlankLocation 使用此后台 Service 连接 Google Play 位置服务并处理排队的位置请求。任务完成后，它会断开连接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，依赖 FlankLocation 的应用可能无法继续收到后台位置结果。

en.description: RoundSoftInput opens a custom keyboard for round Android Wear screens. It accepts a configurable set of characters and returns the text entered by the user.
en.disableEffect: Wear apps that rely on RoundSoftInput cannot complete text entry with this keyboard if it is disabled.

zh-CN.description: RoundSoftInput 会为圆形 Android Wear 屏幕打开自定义键盘。键盘支持配置字符集，并把用户输入的文字交还给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，依赖 RoundSoftInput 的 Wear 应用无法使用此键盘完成文字输入。

en.description: The AndroidLifeCycle library initializes activity tracking when the app starts, recording when screens are created, started, resumed, and destroyed for lifecycle-aware work.
en.disableEffect: Features using AndroidLifeCycle may no longer start or stop their work at the right screen-lifecycle stages.

zh-CN.description: AndroidLifeCycle 库会在应用启动时初始化界面生命周期跟踪，记录界面的创建、启动、恢复和销毁状态，供生命周期相关任务使用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用 AndroidLifeCycle 的功能可能无法在正确的界面生命周期阶段启动或停止任务。

en.description: The xintro introduction library uses this screen to show a configured sequence of introduction slides with next, back, and progress controls.
en.disableEffect: The app's introduction or onboarding slides will not open.

zh-CN.description: xintro 引导库通过此界面展示已配置的介绍页面，并提供前进、返回和进度控制。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用的介绍或初始引导页面将无法打开。

en.description: StallBuster opens this screen for a selected performance report and displays its recorded activity events and timings.
en.disableEffect: Users will no longer be able to inspect individual StallBuster reports.

zh-CN.description: StallBuster 为选中的性能报告打开此界面，并显示记录的界面事件和耗时。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法查看单条 StallBuster 性能报告。

en.description: StallBuster loads saved app-performance reports into this screen, where users can open or delete a report.
en.disableEffect: Saved performance reports will no longer be viewable from the StallBuster report list.

zh-CN.description: StallBuster 会在此界面加载已保存的应用性能报告，用户可以打开或删除报告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 StallBuster 报告列表查看已保存的性能报告。

en.description: Gkash Android Payment SDK opens this Activity to display its hosted payment form and handle the return to the app after payment.
en.disableEffect: The app will not be able to open the Gkash checkout form or handle its payment return, so Gkash payments will not work.

zh-CN.description: Gkash Android 支付 SDK 会打开此界面显示托管的支付表单，并处理支付后返回应用的流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用将无法打开 Gkash 支付表单或处理支付返回结果，Gkash 支付将无法使用。

en.description: When the Glance Game Center opens, this screen displays its game area and lets the user choose a game to play.
en.disableEffect: The Glance Game Center game area will not open.

zh-CN.description: Glance Game Center 打开时，此界面会显示游戏区域，供用户选择要玩的游戏。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Glance Game Center 的游戏区域将无法打开。

en.description: When a player chooses a game in Glance Game Center, this screen loads the game and its interactive controls.
en.disableEffect: Glance games will not open or continue playing.

zh-CN.description: 玩家在 Glance Game Center 选择游戏后，此界面会加载游戏及其交互控件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Glance 游戏将无法打开或继续游玩。

en.description: When Glance Game Center opens a web page from its game area, this screen loads the page and handles its focus while the user navigates.
en.disableEffect: Web pages opened from the Glance Game Center may not display.

zh-CN.description: Glance Game Center 从游戏区域打开网页时，此界面会加载页面，并在用户浏览时管理页面焦点。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，从 Glance Game Center 打开的网页可能无法显示。

en.description: The Glance database debugging library opens this screen to show rows from a selected database table and let the user inspect or change values.
en.disableEffect: Glance's table-data viewer and editing controls will be unavailable; other app screens remain usable.

zh-CN.description: Glance 数据库调试库会打开此页面，显示所选数据库表中的数据行，并供用户查看或修改数值。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Glance 的表数据查看和编辑功能将不可用，但应用的其他页面仍可使用。

en.description: The Glance database debugging library uses this screen to list the host app's local database files for inspection.
en.disableEffect: Users will no longer be able to browse the app's database files through Glance.

zh-CN.description: Glance 数据库调试库使用此页面列出宿主应用的本地数据库文件，供用户检查。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法再通过 Glance 浏览应用的数据库文件。

en.description: The Glance library adds this app-drawer entry to open its database browser when selected.
en.disableEffect: Users will no longer be able to launch Glance's database browser from this app-drawer entry.

zh-CN.description: Glance 库会在应用抽屉中添加此入口，供用户打开数据库浏览器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法再通过此应用抽屉入口启动 Glance 数据库浏览器。

en.description: After a user selects a database in Glance, this screen lists its tables so one can be opened for inspection.
en.disableEffect: Users will no longer be able to browse a database's table list through Glance.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Glance 中选择数据库后，此页面会列出其中的表，供用户打开检查。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法再通过 Glance 浏览数据库中的表列表。

en.description: The Glia Android SDK runs this provider when the app starts to set its application context and initialize the SDK.
en.disableEffect: Glia SDK features may fail because the core SDK is not initialized at app startup.

zh-CN.description: Glia Android SDK 会在应用启动时运行此提供程序，以设置应用上下文并初始化 SDK。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 由于核心 SDK 未在应用启动时初始化，Glia 功能可能无法使用。

en.description: The Glia Android Widgets SDK runs this provider at app startup to initialize widget dependencies and configure the SDK's error handling.
en.disableEffect: Glia chat, calls, and other widget flows may fail to initialize.

zh-CN.description: Glia Android Widgets SDK 会在应用启动时运行此提供程序，以初始化组件依赖并配置 SDK 的错误处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Glia 聊天、通话和其他组件流程可能无法初始化。

en.description: The Glia customer-care SDK opens this screen for an audio or video support call and connects the call controls to the active engagement.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to start or use Glia in-app support calls.

zh-CN.description: Glia 客服 SDK 会通过此界面进行音频或视频客服通话，并将通话控制连接到当前客服会话。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法发起或使用 Glia 应用内客服通话。

en.description: The Glia customer-care SDK shows this screen as a screen-sharing session ends and connects it to the session-ending flow.
en.disableEffect: The Glia screen-sharing end flow may fail to open or complete normally.

zh-CN.description: Glia 客服 SDK 会在屏幕共享会话结束时显示此界面，并将其连接到结束流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Glia 屏幕共享的结束流程可能无法正常打开或完成。

en.description: The Glia customer-care SDK opens this screen for live support messaging and starts or restores the conversation.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to start or resume Glia support chats.

zh-CN.description: Glia 客服 SDK 会通过此界面提供实时客服消息，并开始或恢复对话。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法开始或继续 Glia 客服聊天。

en.description: When Glia minimizes a support engagement, this service creates a floating chat bubble that can reopen the engagement when tapped.
en.disableEffect: The floating support bubble will be unavailable; users can still open support through other app entry points.

zh-CN.description: Glia 将客服会话最小化时，此服务会创建一个悬浮聊天气泡，点击后可重新打开会话。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 悬浮客服气泡将不可用；用户仍可通过应用中的其他入口打开客服。

en.description: The Glia customer-care SDK uses this file provider to share image and attachment files from support conversations with other apps.
en.disableEffect: Sharing or saving support attachments that use these file links may fail.

zh-CN.description: Glia 客服 SDK 使用此文件提供程序，将客服对话中的图片和附件分享给其他应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用这些文件链接分享或保存客服附件时可能会失败。

en.description: The Glia customer-care SDK receives the stop-sharing action from its screen-sharing notification and ends the active screen-sharing session.
en.disableEffect: The notification's action for stopping a screen share will no longer work.

zh-CN.description: Glia 客服 SDK 会接收屏幕共享通知中的停止操作，并结束当前屏幕共享会话。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通知中的停止屏幕共享操作将无法使用。

en.description: Android invokes this Glia cleanup service when the app task is removed; it clears the SDK's ongoing call notification.
en.disableEffect: The Glia call notification may remain after the app is dismissed from the recent-apps screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户从最近任务中移除应用时，Android 会调用此 Glia 清理服务；它会清除 SDK 的通话通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 从最近任务中关闭应用后，Glia 通话通知可能仍会保留。

en.description: The Glia customer-care SDK runs this foreground service while a user shares their screen during support; it reports when sharing is ready and stops after the engagement ends.
en.disableEffect: Screen sharing in a Glia support session may not start or remain active.

zh-CN.description: 用户在客服过程中共享屏幕时，Glia 客服 SDK 会运行此前台服务；服务会报告共享就绪，并在会话结束后停止。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Glia 客服会话中的屏幕共享可能无法启动或保持运行。

en.description: The Glia customer-care SDK opens this screen to show its support-entry panel, where users can choose an available support option.
en.disableEffect: The in-app Glia support-entry panel will not open.

zh-CN.description: Glia 客服 SDK 会通过此界面显示客服入口面板，供用户选择可用的客服方式。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用内的 Glia 客服入口面板将无法打开。

en.description: The Glia customer-care SDK opens this screen to preview an image attachment from a support conversation and offers save and share actions.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to preview, save, or share image attachments through this screen.

zh-CN.description: Glia 客服 SDK 会通过此界面预览客服对话中的图片附件，并提供保存和分享操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此界面预览、保存或分享图片附件。

en.description: The Glia customer-care SDK opens this screen to preview an image attachment from a support conversation and offers save and share actions.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to preview, save, or share image attachments through this screen.

zh-CN.description: Glia 客服 SDK 会通过此界面预览客服对话中的图片附件，并提供保存和分享操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此界面预览、保存或分享图片附件。

en.description: The earlier Glia Widgets SDK runs this service to show a floating support chat head; tapping it returns to the active engagement.
en.disableEffect: The floating support shortcut will disappear, though other Glia chat entry points may remain available.

zh-CN.description: 较早版本的 Glia Widgets SDK 会运行此服务以显示悬浮客服气泡；点击气泡可返回当前会话。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 悬浮客服快捷入口将消失，但 Glia 的其他聊天入口仍可能可用。

en.description: The Glia customer-care SDK opens this temporary screen to host permission prompts during support flows such as calls or screen sharing.
en.disableEffect: Glia may be unable to show permission prompts needed to start calls or screen sharing.

zh-CN.description: Glia 客服 SDK 会在通话或屏幕共享等流程中打开此临时界面，用于承载权限请求。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Glia 可能无法显示发起通话或屏幕共享所需的权限请求。

en.description: During a Glia audio or video call, this service creates the ongoing call notification and keeps the call active as a foreground task with microphone or camera access.
en.disableEffect: Calls may lose required foreground handling or stop when the app moves to the background.

zh-CN.description: Glia 音频或视频通话期间，此服务会创建持续显示的通话通知，并以可使用麦克风或摄像头的前台任务保持通话。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用切到后台后，通话可能失去所需的前台服务支持或停止。

en.description: The Glia customer-care SDK opens this screen for the support message center, where users can read and send messages and attach photos or files.
en.disableEffect: Users will lose access to Glia's message center and its attachment flow.

zh-CN.description: Glia 客服 SDK 会通过此界面提供客服消息中心，用户可在此收发消息并附加图片或文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法使用 Glia 消息中心及其附件功能。

en.description: The earlier Glia Widgets SDK receives the stop-sharing action from its screen-sharing notification and tells the SDK to end the active screen share.
en.disableEffect: The notification's action for stopping a screen share will no longer work.

zh-CN.description: 较早版本的 Glia Widgets SDK 会接收屏幕共享通知中的停止操作，并通知 SDK 结束当前屏幕共享。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通知中的停止屏幕共享操作将无法使用。

en.description: When a user taps a Glia support push notification, this screen passes its conversation details to the SDK, opens the app, and then closes.
en.disableEffect: Tapping Glia support notifications will no longer route into the app's support flow.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击 Glia 客服推送通知时，此界面会将对话信息交给 SDK，打开应用后关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 点击 Glia 客服推送通知将无法进入应用内的客服流程。

en.description: The earlier Glia Widgets SDK runs this foreground service and its persistent notification while a support screen-sharing session is active.
en.disableEffect: Glia screen sharing may not start or stay active without its foreground service.

zh-CN.description: 较早版本的 Glia Widgets SDK 会在客服屏幕共享会话期间运行此前台服务并显示持续通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 缺少此前台服务时，Glia 屏幕共享可能无法启动或保持运行。

en.description: The Glia customer-care SDK opens this screen to show a support survey and let the user submit responses after an engagement.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to complete Glia support surveys.

zh-CN.description: Glia 客服 SDK 会通过此界面展示客服问卷，供用户在客服会话后提交回答。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法填写并提交 Glia 客服问卷。

en.description: The Glia customer-care SDK opens a page supplied by a support flow in its in-app browser; links tapped on that page open through Android.
en.disableEffect: Pages opened from Glia support flows will not appear in the in-app browser.

zh-CN.description: Glia 客服 SDK 会在应用内浏览器中打开客服流程提供的页面；用户点击页面链接时会交由 Android 打开。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Glia 客服流程打开的页面将无法在应用内浏览器中显示。

en.description: When the host app opens the Global Payments Device Library's card-entry screen, it displays a card form and passes the entry to the SDK's tokenization flow. The screen shows the resulting token or an error.
en.disableEffect: Any app payment flow that opens this card-entry and tokenization screen will be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: 宿主应用打开 Global Payments 设备库的银行卡输入界面时，此界面会显示卡片表单并将输入内容交给 SDK 进行令牌化。界面会显示生成的令牌或错误信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此银行卡输入和令牌化界面的支付流程将无法使用。

en.description: GmTheme by Goutham106 opens this screen when the app offers its preset theme picker. It lists available themes and applies the selected theme to the app.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to open the preset theme picker or switch themes.

zh-CN.description: Goutham106 的 GmTheme 主题库会在应用打开预设主题选择页时显示可用主题；用户选择后会将该主题应用到应用界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 屏蔽后，用户无法打开预设主题选择页或切换主题。

en.description: GmTheme by Goutham106 opens this screen for appearance settings. It lets users choose a preset theme and adjust the app's primary, accent, background, and navigation bar colors.
en.disableEffect: The app's theme settings page will not open, so users cannot use these controls to change its appearance.

zh-CN.description: Goutham106 的 GmTheme 主题库会在应用打开外观设置时显示主题选项，用户可选择预设主题，也可调整主色、强调色、背景色和导航栏颜色。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 屏蔽后，主题设置页无法打开，用户不能通过这些选项更改应用外观。

en.description: Gojek Courier Chuck MQTT starts this Service when the user taps Clear in its MQTT notification. It deletes saved MQTT transaction history, clears the notification buffer, and dismisses the notification.
en.disableEffect: The notification can no longer clear saved MQTT history, while the app's regular MQTT messaging continues.

zh-CN.description: 用户点按 Gojek Courier Chuck MQTT 的通知中的清除按钮时，此服务会删除已保存的 MQTT 事务记录、清空通知缓存并关闭该通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，通知无法清除已保存的 MQTT 记录，但应用的常规 MQTT 通信仍会继续。

en.description: Gojek Courier Chuck MQTT opens this screen when a user selects a recorded MQTT transaction from its history list. It displays that transaction's details for inspection.
en.disableEffect: Recorded MQTT transaction details can no longer be opened, but the app's MQTT messages continue to flow.

zh-CN.description: 用户从 MQTT 历史列表中选择一条记录时，Gojek Courier Chuck MQTT 会打开此页面，显示该事务的详细信息以供查看。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后将无法打开单条 MQTT 事务的详情，但应用的 MQTT 消息仍会正常传输。

en.description: Gojek Courier Chuck MQTT opens this screen when the user opens its MQTT activity notification. It shows recorded MQTT transactions and lets the user open an individual entry.
en.disableEffect: Captured MQTT history can no longer be opened in the viewer, but normal app messaging continues.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 MQTT 活动通知时，Gojek Courier Chuck MQTT 会显示此页面。页面列出已记录的 MQTT 事务，用户可继续打开单条记录查看详情。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后将无法在查看器中打开已记录的 MQTT 历史，但应用的常规消息通信仍会继续。

en.description: The Gokulakrishnan CameraX screen requests camera access, shows a live preview, and saves a photo when the user takes one.
en.disableEffect: The app's CameraX capture flow will not open or save photos.

zh-CN.description: Gokulakrishnan CameraX 页面会请求相机权限、显示实时预览，并在用户拍照时保存照片。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用的 CameraX 拍摄流程将无法打开相机或保存照片。

en.description: GoKwik's checkout SDK opens this screen when a merchant starts web checkout. It displays the payment page and returns success or failure to the merchant app.
en.disableEffect: Customers may be unable to complete or return from GoKwik web checkout.

zh-CN.description: 商家启动网页结账时，GoKwik 结账 SDK 会打开此页面。它显示付款页面，并将成功或失败结果返回给商家应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户可能无法完成 GoKwik 网页结账或返回付款结果。

en.description: GoKwik's checkout SDK opens this screen for an order. It verifies the order, offers payment options such as UPI, and returns the payment result to the merchant app.
en.disableEffect: Customers will not be able to complete GoKwik checkout payments.

zh-CN.description: GoKwik 结账 SDK 会为订单打开此页面，核验订单并提供 UPI 等付款方式，然后将付款结果返回给商家应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 GoKwik 结账完成付款。

en.description: GoKwik's checkout SDK opens this screen when its customer support chat is requested. It loads the merchant's chat settings and displays the conversation, with notification permission and file selection handled when needed.
en.disableEffect: Customers will lose the GoKwik in-app support chat and its attachment flow.

zh-CN.description: 需要使用 GoKwik 客服聊天时，结账 SDK 会打开此页面，读取商家的聊天设置并显示对话；必要时还会处理通知权限和文件选择。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法使用 GoKwik 应用内客服聊天及其附件功能。

en.description: GoKwik's checkout SDK opens this screen when a merchant starts web checkout. It displays the payment page and returns success or failure to the merchant app.
en.disableEffect: Customers may be unable to complete or return from GoKwik web checkout.

zh-CN.description: 商家启动网页结账时，GoKwik 结账 SDK 会打开此页面。它显示付款页面，并将成功或失败结果返回给商家应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户可能无法完成 GoKwik 网页结账或返回付款结果。

en.description: The legacy Google AdMob SDK opens this full-screen activity when an app needs to show an ad page. It displays web or video ads and handles ad closing or opening its destination.
en.disableEffect: Full-screen ads and ad destination pages provided through this SDK will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: 旧版 Google AdMob 广告 SDK 会打开此全屏页面来展示网页或视频广告，并处理关闭广告或打开广告目标页面的操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，该 SDK 提供的全屏广告和广告目标页面将无法打开。

en.description: Google Mobile Ads Mediation Test Suite opens this screen after a developer selects an ad unit. It lists that unit's mediation network configurations and can load test ads from selected networks.
en.disableEffect: Developers can no longer inspect or batch-test an ad unit's mediation sources here; regular ad delivery is unaffected.

zh-CN.description: 开发者在 Google Mobile Ads 中介测试套件里选择广告单元后，会打开此页面。页面列出该单元的中介网络配置，并可从选定网络加载测试广告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 开发者将无法在此查看广告单元的中介来源或批量测试广告；常规广告投放不受影响。

en.description: Google Mobile Ads Mediation Test Suite opens this screen when a developer searches its configured ad units. It filters the list as the query changes and opens the selected unit's detail page.
en.disableEffect: Developers lose search access to the test suite's configured ad units; regular ad delivery is unaffected.

zh-CN.description: 开发者搜索 Google Mobile Ads 中介测试套件中的已配置广告单元时，会打开此页面。页面会随搜索内容筛选列表，并可打开所选单元的详情。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 开发者将无法搜索测试套件中已配置的广告单元；常规广告投放不受影响。

en.description: Google Mobile Ads Mediation Test Suite opens this screen for a selected configured item. It lists that item's mediation sources and can load test ads from sources selected by the developer.
en.disableEffect: Developers can no longer review that item's mediation sources or run batch test-ad requests; regular ad delivery is unaffected.

zh-CN.description: 开发者在 Google Mobile Ads 中介测试套件中选择一项配置后，会打开此页面。页面列出该项的中介来源，并可从开发者选中的来源加载测试广告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 开发者将无法在此查看该配置项的中介来源或批量请求测试广告；常规广告投放不受影响。

en.description: Google Mobile Ads Mediation Test Suite opens this screen from its configuration list. It filters configured mediation items as the developer types and opens the selected item's detail page.
en.disableEffect: Developers can no longer search the test suite's configured mediation items; regular ad delivery is unaffected.

zh-CN.description: 开发者从 Google Mobile Ads 中介测试套件的配置列表进入此页面。页面会随输入内容筛选已配置的中介项目，并可打开所选项目的详情。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 开发者将无法搜索测试套件中已配置的中介项目；常规广告投放不受影响。

en.description: Google Mobile Ads Mediation Test Suite opens this as its main screen when a developer launches the suite for an app. It loads the app's configured mediation items and links to their details and test tools.
en.disableEffect: The app's mediation test suite cannot be opened, but its regular ad placements continue to work.

zh-CN.description: 开发者为应用启动 Google Mobile Ads 中介测试套件时，会进入此主页面。页面加载应用已配置的中介项目，并提供查看详情和测试工具的入口。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用的中介测试套件将无法打开，但常规广告位仍可正常投放广告。

en.description: Google Mobile Ads Mediation Test Suite opens this page for a selected network configuration. It displays that configuration's details for checking the app's mediation setup.
en.disableEffect: Network configuration details in the test suite become unavailable; regular ad serving remains unaffected.

zh-CN.description: 开发者在 Google Mobile Ads 中介测试套件中选择一个网络配置时，会打开此页面。页面显示该配置的详细信息，供检查应用的中介设置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 测试套件中的网络配置详情将无法查看；常规广告投放不受影响。

en.description: Widget that shows a preview of the user's bookmarks.

zh-CN.description: 显示用户书签预览的小部件。

en.description: Google Play Games Memory Advice starts this Service in a separate helper process while monitoring game memory. It keeps a small amount of memory there so the library can detect severe memory pressure if Android stops the helper.
en.disableEffect: The library loses this early memory-pressure warning, which can leave a game less able to respond before memory runs out.

zh-CN.description: Google Play Games Memory Advice 会在监测游戏内存时于独立辅助进程中启动此服务。服务在该进程中占用少量内存，以便 Android 停止辅助进程时，库能检测到严重的内存压力。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 库将失去这项早期内存压力预警，使用该服务的游戏在内存耗尽前可能更难及时应对。

en.description: Google Play Games Memory Advice starts this Service only when an app requests its optional on-device memory stress test. It reports baseline memory readings and gradually allocates test memory to measure the limit.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents the optional memory stress test from returning its memory limit; regular game operation and routine memory reporting remain available.

zh-CN.description: 只有应用请求可选的设备端内存压力测试时，Google Play Games Memory Advice 才会启动此服务。服务会报告基准内存数据，并逐步分配测试内存以测量上限。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，可选的内存压力测试将无法返回内存上限；游戏的常规运行和日常内存报告仍可使用。

en.description: Google Android Data Transport keeps this Service in the manifest to register Google's event-upload backend. When an SDK queues telemetry or diagnostic events, the transport runtime reads this registration to route them for upload.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it can stop telemetry or diagnostic events that use this backend from uploading, while ordinary app screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: Google Android Data Transport 通过清单中的此服务登记 Google 的事件上传后端。SDK 有遥测或诊断事件等待上传时，数据传输运行时会读取这项登记并进行路由。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，使用此后端的遥测或诊断事件可能无法上传，但应用的常规页面仍可使用。

en.description: When a scheduled alarm fires, Google Data Transport sends queued event data to the service configured by the app.
en.disableEffect: Scheduled uploads through Google Data Transport may be delayed or missed.

zh-CN.description: 预定闹钟触发时，Google Data Transport 会将排队的事件数据发送到应用配置的服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过 Google Data Transport 进行的定时上传可能延迟或丢失。

en.description: Google Android Data Transport starts this service when Android runs a scheduled data-upload job. It sends queued events to their configured destination in the background.
en.disableEffect: Background delivery of queued events through Android Data Transport may stop or be delayed.

zh-CN.description: Android 执行定时数据上传任务时，Google Android Data Transport 会启动此服务，在后台将排队的事件发送到指定目标。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，通过 Android Data Transport 排队的事件可能无法在后台送达或会延迟送达。

en.description: The Google ExoPlayer library runs this service when Android is ready to resume a scheduled background media task. It checks the device and network requirements, then starts the requested media service when they are met.
en.disableEffect: Scheduled ExoPlayer media tasks may fail to restart when their network, charging, idle, or storage requirements are met.

zh-CN.description: Google ExoPlayer 库会在 Android 准备恢复计划中的后台媒体任务时运行此服务。它检查设备和网络条件，并在条件满足后启动指定媒体服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 当网络、充电、空闲或存储条件满足时，已计划的 ExoPlayer 媒体任务可能无法重新启动。

en.description: Google Mobile Ads opens this screen to display a full-screen ad and manage its screen lifecycle.
en.disableEffect: Google ads will not open, and rewards for watching rewarded ads will no longer be granted; other app features continue to work.

zh-CN.description: Google Mobile Ads 会打开此页面显示全屏广告并管理页面生命周期。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Google 广告将无法打开，观看奖励型广告也不再获得奖励；应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: Google Mobile Ads uses this background Service to process ad notification work when the SDK sends it. It runs without showing a screen.
en.disableEffect: Ad notification work handled by Google Mobile Ads will stop.

zh-CN.description: Google 移动广告会在 SDK 发来广告通知任务时，通过此后台服务进行处理。它运行时不会显示界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Google 移动广告通过此服务处理的广告通知任务将停止。

en.description: Google Mobile Ads checks the app's AdMob app ID or integration details during startup. This provider performs an early setup check and does not display an app screen.
en.disableEffect: Google's early app ID check will not run, so a missing or invalid ad setup may go unnoticed until ads are used.

zh-CN.description: Google Mobile Ads 会在应用启动时检查 AdMob 应用 ID 或集成信息；此提供程序只进行早期配置检查，不显示应用页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Google 的早期应用 ID 检查将不再运行，因此缺失或无效的广告配置可能要到使用广告时才会发现。

en.description: Google Mobile Ads opens this screen to process a tap on an ad-related notification, then closes it.
en.disableEffect: Tapping an ad-related notification will no longer open its Google Mobile Ads destination.

zh-CN.description: 用户点按广告相关通知时，Google 移动广告会打开此界面处理该操作，随后关闭界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 点按广告相关通知后，将无法再打开 Google 移动广告对应的页面。

en.description: Google Mobile Ads uses this screen to display an ad-unit test or preview outside the app's normal screens.
en.disableEffect: The Google Mobile Ads ad-unit test or preview screen will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: Google 移动广告会用此界面在应用的常规页面之外显示广告单元测试或预览。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Google 移动广告的广告单元测试或预览界面将无法打开。

en.description: Google Analytics for Android runs scheduled background work through this service to process measurement data.
en.disableEffect: Scheduled Google Analytics work for the app will stop running.

zh-CN.description: Google Analytics for Android 会通过此服务运行定时后台任务，处理统计数据。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用的 Google Analytics 定时后台任务将停止运行。

en.description: The Google Play services Analytics SDK receives scheduled analytics-dispatch broadcasts and starts background delivery of queued usage measurements.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, scheduled analytics may not be sent to Google; the app’s user-facing features continue to work.

zh-CN.description: Google Play 服务 Analytics SDK 会接收定时分析分发广播，并在后台发送排队的使用情况数据。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，定时分析数据可能无法发送到 Google；应用面向用户的功能仍可使用。

en.description: The Google Play services Analytics SDK runs this background service for scheduled dispatches and processes queued analytics measurements.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, queued analytics measurements cannot be dispatched through this service; app screens and playback remain available.

zh-CN.description: Google Play 服务 Analytics SDK 会在定时分发时运行此后台服务，处理排队的分析数据。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，排队的分析数据无法通过此服务发送；应用页面和播放功能仍可使用。

en.description: The Google Play services Analytics SDK receives the app store’s install-referrer broadcast and records the campaign source for attribution.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, install-campaign attribution is lost, while the host app’s features remain available.

zh-CN.description: Google Play 服务 Analytics SDK 会接收应用商店的安装来源广播，并记录活动来源以进行归因。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后将无法记录安装活动归因，但宿主应用的功能仍可使用。

en.description: Older Google Play services Analytics releases start this background service to process install-referrer campaign details; the newer analyzed release retains it as an empty legacy service.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, older releases lose install-campaign attribution; the host app’s screens and regular use remain available.

zh-CN.description: 较旧的 Google Play 服务 Analytics 版本会启动此后台服务处理安装来源活动信息；较新的分析版本保留了该旧服务条目，但不执行处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，旧版将无法记录安装活动归因；宿主应用页面及常规使用仍可继续。

en.description: Google App Invites opens this preview when Google Play services follows an invitation link. The screen renders the invitation's tabs, text, and web content.
en.disableEffect: Invitation previews provided by Google App Invites will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: Google Play 服务打开邀请链接时，Google App Invites 会显示此预览界面，其中可以呈现邀请标签、文字和网页内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Google App Invites 提供的邀请预览将无法打开。

en.description: Google Sign-In's fallback flow opens an account authorization page in a browser, handles the return from Google, and sends the sign-in result to the app.
en.disableEffect: Apps using this Google Sign-In fallback will not complete their browser sign-in flow.

zh-CN.description: Google Sign-In 的备用流程会在浏览器中打开账号授权页面，处理 Google 返回的信息，并将登录结果交给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此 Google Sign-In 备用流程的应用将无法完成浏览器登录。

en.description: Google Sign-In binds to this service to handle requests to disconnect an account or clear the app's sign-in state.
en.disableEffect: Google Sign-In account disconnect and client-state clearing requests may not complete.

zh-CN.description: Google Sign-In 会绑定此服务，以处理断开账号连接或清除应用登录状态的请求。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Google Sign-In 断开账号连接或清除客户端状态的请求可能无法完成。

en.description: Google Sign-In opens this screen to start a Google or fallback sign-in request and return the account result to the app.
en.disableEffect: Google Sign-In flows that use this screen will not return an account result to the app.

zh-CN.description: Google Sign-In 会打开此界面启动 Google 登录或备用登录流程，并将账号结果返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此界面的 Google 登录流程将无法向应用返回账号结果。

en.description: Google Cast starts this background service to coordinate recovery of a Cast session through the session manager.
en.disableEffect: Cast sessions may not reconnect or recover correctly after a connection is interrupted.

zh-CN.description: Google Cast 会通过此后台服务和会话管理器协调 Cast 会话恢复。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Cast 连接中断后，会话可能无法重新连接或正确恢复。

en.description: Google Cast uses this receiver for playback commands such as play or pause, skipping, seeking, stopping casting, and disconnecting.
en.disableEffect: Playback controls for Cast media, including stop and disconnect, will no longer work through this receiver.

zh-CN.description: Google Cast 会通过此接收器处理播放控制，例如播放或暂停、切换内容、快进或倒退、停止投放和断开连接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过此接收器控制 Cast 播放的功能（包括停止投放和断开连接）将无法使用。

en.description: Google Cast runs this foreground service during remote playback to maintain a media notification with the cast device, current item, and playback controls.
en.disableEffect: The Cast media notification and its playback controls will no longer appear.

zh-CN.description: Google Cast 会在远程播放期间运行此前台服务，显示投放设备、当前媒体和播放控制通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Cast 媒体通知及其播放控制将不再显示。

en.description: The microG GmsCore Cast service makes nearby Cast receivers available to media-routing apps and sends playback controls to a selected receiver. Android binds it when an app opens a Cast or remote-playback route.
en.disableEffect: Cast receivers may disappear from the app, and controlling playback on them will stop working.

zh-CN.description: microG GmsCore 的 Cast 服务会让媒体路由应用发现附近的 Cast 接收设备，并把播放控制发送给选中的设备。应用打开 Cast 或远程播放线路时，Android 会连接此服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用可能无法再发现 Cast 接收设备，也无法控制这些设备上的播放。

en.description: Google Cast TV lets the system MediaShell app bind to this service to launch the app's Cast receiver, send messages, and report connected senders.
en.disableEffect: The app's Cast TV receiver will no longer be available to the system Cast host.

zh-CN.description: Google Cast TV 允许系统 MediaShell 应用绑定此服务，以启动应用的 Cast 接收端、发送消息并报告已连接的发送端。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 系统 Cast 主机将无法再使用应用的 Cast TV 接收端。

en.description: Google Play services opens this activity when an API needs a user-facing resolution, such as an availability dialog or a pending action, and returns the result to the requesting flow.
en.disableEffect: Google Play services features that need this user-approved resolution step may stop working.

zh-CN.description: Google Play services 在某个 API 需要用户处理问题时打开此页面，例如显示服务可用性提示或执行待处理操作，并将结果返回请求流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要此用户确认处理步骤的 Google Play services 功能可能无法使用。

en.description: Google Play Games opens this screen for a game shortcut, resolves the requested shortcut, then launches the game's launcher screen.
en.disableEffect: Game shortcuts opened through Google Play Games will no longer launch the requested game screen.

zh-CN.description: Google Play Games 会在打开游戏快捷方式时解析对应操作，然后启动游戏的入口界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过 Google Play Games 打开的游戏快捷方式将无法再启动对应游戏界面。

en.description: Google Play Games uses this screen to open a requested confirmation or other action and send its result back to the game.
en.disableEffect: Google Play Games actions that need this confirmation screen may fail or return no result.

zh-CN.description: Google Play Games 会用此界面打开请求的确认或其他操作，并将结果返回给游戏。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要此确认界面的 Google Play Games 操作可能失败或无法返回结果。

en.description: Google Play Games starts this provider with the app process to initialize its SDK automatically.
en.disableEffect: Google Play Games may not initialize, so game sign-in and related Play Games features can stop working.

zh-CN.description: 应用进程启动时，Google Play Games 会通过此提供程序自动初始化 SDK。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Google Play Games 可能无法初始化，游戏登录及相关 Play Games 功能可能停止工作。

en.description: Google Play services' legacy GCM receiver accepts push and registration broadcasts, prepares the message, and forwards it to a service in the app that handles it.
en.disableEffect: Apps using this legacy GCM path will no longer receive or route SDK push messages through this receiver.

zh-CN.description: Google Play 服务的旧版 GCM 接收器会接收推送和注册广播，整理消息后转交给应用中的处理服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此旧版 GCM 通道的应用将无法通过该接收器接收或转发 SDK 推送消息。

en.description: When Google Play reports an app install, this Firebase Analytics receiver reads the install referrer to record which campaign led to the install.
en.disableEffect: Firebase Analytics stops recording which campaign led to installs; normal app features continue.

zh-CN.description: Google Play 报告应用安装后，此 Firebase Analytics 接收器会读取安装来源信息，记录用户通过哪个广告系列安装了应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Firebase Analytics 将停止记录安装来源的广告系列，应用的常规功能仍可使用。

en.description: Google's measurement SDK, also used by Firebase Analytics, runs scheduled analytics work through this job service.
en.disableEffect: Scheduled measurement and analytics work for the app will stop running.

zh-CN.description: Google 统计 SDK（Firebase Analytics 也会使用）会通过此任务服务运行定时统计工作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用的定时统计和分析任务将停止运行。

en.description: Google's measurement SDK, also used by Firebase Analytics, receives analytics broadcasts here and starts background measurement work.
en.disableEffect: Broadcast-triggered measurement and analytics work will no longer run.

zh-CN.description: Google 统计 SDK（Firebase Analytics 也会使用）会在此接收统计广播，并启动后台统计任务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 由广播触发的统计和分析任务将无法运行。

en.description: Google's measurement SDK, also used by Firebase Analytics, uses this service to process background measurement requests.
en.disableEffect: Background measurement and analytics requests handled by this service will stop.

zh-CN.description: Google 统计 SDK（Firebase Analytics 也会使用）会通过此服务处理后台统计请求。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 此服务处理的后台统计和分析请求将停止。

en.description: Google Play services reads this disabled manifest entry to determine that the app requires its Photo Picker module. It is module-delivery information, not a service that runs while the app is in use.
en.disableEffect: Photo selection that depends on the Google Play services Photo Picker may stop working on devices that need this module.

zh-CN.description: Google Play 服务会读取这条已禁用的清单声明，以判断应用需要其照片选择器模块。这是模块交付信息，不会作为普通服务在应用使用期间运行。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 在需要此模块的设备上，依赖 Google Play 服务照片选择器的选图功能可能无法使用。

en.description: Google Nearby Exposure Notifications binds to this service for background exposure-notification callbacks while an app uses exposure alerts.
en.disableEffect: Apps using exposure alerts may stop receiving the background callbacks needed to update them.

zh-CN.description: 应用使用接触暴露提醒时，Google Nearby Exposure Notifications 会绑定此服务以接收后台提醒回调。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用接触暴露提醒的应用可能无法再收到更新提醒所需的后台回调。

en.description: Google Open Source Licenses opens this page to show the license text for a selected third-party library, using the app's bundled license data or the license service.
en.disableEffect: Individual open-source license details in the app will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: Google 开源许可证会打开此页面，显示所选第三方库的许可证文本；内容来自应用内置数据或许可证服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用中的单项开源许可证详情将无法打开。

en.description: Google Open Source Licenses uses this screen to list the third-party licenses included with the app.
en.disableEffect: The app's open-source license list will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: Google 开源许可证会通过此界面列出应用包含的第三方库许可证。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用的开源许可证列表将无法打开。

en.description: Google Open Source Licenses uses this screen to show the app's bundled third-party license list in its newer interface.
en.disableEffect: The newer open-source license list will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: 新版 Google 开源许可证界面会通过此页面显示应用内置的第三方库许可证列表。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 新版开源许可证列表将无法打开。

en.description: When Firebase ML Natural Language needs to generate Smart Reply suggestions on the device, this service loads the local model and uses recent messages to produce replies.
en.disableEffect: Apps using Smart Reply can no longer obtain suggested replies from this on-device model.

zh-CN.description: Firebase ML 自然语言功能需要在设备上生成智能回复建议时，此服务会加载本地模型，并根据最近的消息生成回复。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用智能回复的应用将无法再从此设备端模型获取建议回复。

en.description: Google Tag Manager opens this screen for a preview link and passes the link to Tag Manager to preview the selected container.
en.disableEffect: Google Tag Manager preview links will no longer open in the app.

zh-CN.description: Google Tag Manager 会在打开预览链接时显示此界面，并将链接交给 Tag Manager 预览相应容器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法打开 Google Tag Manager 预览链接。

en.description: Google Tag Manager binds to this background service to handle tag and container work for the app.
en.disableEffect: Tags, analytics, and other behavior configured through Google Tag Manager will stop running.

zh-CN.description: Google Tag Manager 会绑定此后台服务，处理应用的标签和容器任务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过 Google Tag Manager 配置的标签、统计及其他行为将停止运行。

en.description: Google Horologist handles app-launch requests received over the Wear OS data layer. It can open the phone app or a requested screen, or launch the connected watch companion.
en.disableEffect: The phone and watch may no longer open each other's app screens through the Horologist data layer.

zh-CN.description: Google Horologist 会处理通过 Wear OS 数据层收到的应用启动请求，可打开手机应用或指定页面，也可启动已连接的手表配套应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 手机和手表可能无法再通过 Horologist 数据层打开对方的应用页面。

en.description: Google Horologist uses this phone screen to show an app-install prompt with app-provided text and an image. Continuing opens that app's Google Play listing.
en.disableEffect: The app's install prompt and its link to Google Play will no longer work.

zh-CN.description: Google Horologist 会在手机上通过此界面显示应用提供的安装提示文字和图片。继续操作会打开该应用在 Google Play 中的页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用的安装提示及其 Google Play 跳转将无法使用。

en.description: Google Horologist uses this screen to show a prompt to add a Wear OS tile. Continuing opens Google's tile-management page in the Wear companion flow.
en.disableEffect: The prompt and shortcut for adding the app's watch tile will no longer work.

zh-CN.description: Google Horologist 会通过此界面提示用户添加 Wear OS 磁贴。继续操作会打开 Google 的手表磁贴管理页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 添加应用手表磁贴的提示和跳转将无法使用。

en.description: Google Horologist shows this prompt to invite the user to return to the app on a connected watch. Choosing its positive action launches the app on that watch.
en.disableEffect: Users will lose this prompt for reopening the app on their watch.

zh-CN.description: Google Horologist 会通过此提示邀请用户返回已连接手表上的应用。选择继续后，会在手表上启动该应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法再通过此提示重新打开手表上的应用。

en.description: Google Horologist shows a sign-in prompt for a connected watch. Continuing opens the app on that watch so the user can sign in there.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot complete this watch sign-in handoff through the prompt.

zh-CN.description: Google Horologist 会显示与已连接手表有关的登录提示。继续操作会在手表上打开应用，供用户在那里登录。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此提示完成手表端的登录交接。

en.description: Google Horologist handles app-launch requests received over the Wear OS data layer on the watch. It can wake the watch to open the requested app screen or companion.
en.disableEffect: The watch may no longer respond to phone requests to open app screens through this data-layer service.

zh-CN.description: Google Horologist 会在手表上处理通过 Wear OS 数据层收到的应用启动请求，并可唤醒手表以打开指定页面或配套应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 手表可能无法再通过此数据层服务响应手机发来的应用启动请求。

en.description: When Android starts an app that includes Google Jacquard, this provider prepares the SDK so the app can connect to supported Jacquard wearables over Bluetooth.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot initialize its Jacquard wearable connection; device setup and controls may fail.

zh-CN.description: Android 启动包含 Google Jacquard 的应用时，此 Provider 会准备 SDK，使应用能够通过蓝牙连接兼容的 Jacquard 可穿戴设备。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用无法初始化 Jacquard 可穿戴设备连接，设备设置和控制功能可能失败。

en.description: Google Mobile Ads opens this full-screen activity to present an ad experience inside the app.
en.disableEffect: Full-screen ads provided by this Google Mobile Ads SDK will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: Google 移动广告会打开此全屏界面，在应用中展示广告内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 此 Google 移动广告 SDK 提供的全屏广告将无法打开。

en.description: Google Cloud Telco Subgraph uses this background service to post SDK notifications with their text and icons. Tapping a notification opens the app's matching destination when available.
en.disableEffect: Notifications from the Google Cloud Telco Subgraph SDK will no longer appear through this service.

zh-CN.description: Google Cloud Telco Subgraph 会通过此后台服务发布带有文字和图标的 SDK 通知。若应用中存在对应页面，点按通知会打开该页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Google Cloud Telco Subgraph SDK 的通知将无法通过此服务显示。

en.description: Google Cloud Telco Subgraph uses this background service to process an internal notification update and save an identifier for later notification handling.
en.disableEffect: Notification updates from this SDK will no longer be saved for later handling.

zh-CN.description: Google Cloud Telco Subgraph 会通过此后台服务处理内部通知更新，并保存供后续通知处理使用的标识。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 此 SDK 收到的通知更新将无法保存以供后续处理。

en.description: Google Navigation SDK runs this location service during navigation to keep turn-by-turn directions and the ongoing navigation notification active.
en.disableEffect: Turn-by-turn navigation may fail to continue in the background or end unexpectedly.

zh-CN.description: 导航期间，Google Navigation SDK 会运行此定位服务，以保持逐向指引和导航通知正常显示。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，逐向导航可能无法在后台继续，或会意外结束。

en.description: Google Health Data API opens this screen to request provider permissions and returns the permissions granted by the user to the app.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot complete health-data permission requests through this API, so features that need those permissions will stop working.

zh-CN.description: Google Health Data API 会打开此界面请求数据提供方权限，并将用户授予的权限返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法通过此 API 完成健康数据权限请求，因此需要这些权限的功能将停止工作。

en.description: The Google Maps Platform Transportation Consumer SDK uses this service when an app begins tracking a trip; it supports the live trip updates shown in the app.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it can prevent the consumer trip-tracking client from initializing and receiving live trip updates.

zh-CN.description: 应用开始跟踪行程时，Google 地图平台 Transportation Consumer SDK 会使用此服务支持行程信息更新，让用户在应用中查看实时进度。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，行程跟踪客户端可能无法初始化，也无法接收实时行程更新。

en.description: Google Maps Platform Driver SDK includes this deprecated service, but the analyzed 7.1.0 version leaves it inactive and performs no location logging.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it has no user-visible effect in this SDK version.

zh-CN.description: Google 地图平台 Driver SDK 仍包含这个已弃用服务，但所分析的 7.1.0 版本不会运行它，也不会记录导航位置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 在此 SDK 版本中停用它不会造成用户可见的变化。

en.description: During driver navigation, Google Maps Platform Driver SDK uses this background service to keep the route and navigation status updated in the app.
en.disableEffect: Driver navigation status and route updates may stop reaching the app.

zh-CN.description: 驾驶导航期间，Google 地图平台 Driver SDK 会使用此后台服务，让应用中的路线和导航状态保持更新。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用可能无法收到驾驶导航状态和路线更新。

en.description: When an app asks for a place search, Google Places SDK for Android opens this older search screen; users can enter a place and send the result back to the app.
en.disableEffect: Apps that use this place-search screen will lose place suggestions and selection.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求地点搜索时，Google Places SDK for Android 会打开此旧版搜索页面；用户输入地点后，可将结果返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此地点搜索页面的应用将无法显示地点建议或返回所选地点。

en.description: Google Places SDK for Android opens this screen when the app asks the user to choose a place; it returns the selected place to the app.
en.disableEffect: The app will no longer be able to use this place-selection screen.

zh-CN.description: 应用需要用户选择地点时，Google Places SDK for Android 会打开此页面，并将选中的地点返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法再使用此地点选择页面。

en.description: Google Places SDK for Android opens this search screen to show place suggestions; the user can choose a suggestion and return it to the app.
en.disableEffect: The app will no longer be able to search and select places through this screen.

zh-CN.description: Google Places SDK for Android 会打开此搜索页面并显示地点建议；用户可以选择一项并将结果返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法再通过此页面搜索并选择地点。

en.description: When a user taps a photo in Google Places place details, the Places SDK opens a full-screen gallery with more photos and contributor information.
en.disableEffect: The place-details screen will no longer be able to open its photo gallery.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Google Places 地点详情中点开照片时，Places SDK 会打开全屏相册，显示更多照片和贡献者信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 地点详情页面将无法再打开照片浏览器。

en.description: When a user taps a photo in the newer Google Places details screen, the Places SDK opens a full-screen gallery with more photos and contributor information.
en.disableEffect: The place-details screen will no longer be able to open its photo gallery.

zh-CN.description: 用户在新版 Google Places 地点详情中点开照片时，Places SDK 会打开全屏相册，显示更多照片和贡献者信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 地点详情页面将无法再打开照片浏览器。

en.description: When an app requests age information that needs confirmation, Google Play Age Signals opens the confirmation screen and returns the user choice to the app.
en.disableEffect: Age-sharing or age-verification requests that need consent will not complete.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求的年龄信息需要用户确认时，Google Play 年龄信号 SDK 会打开确认页面，并将用户选择返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要用户同意的年龄信息共享或验证请求将无法完成。

en.description: When an app needs to download and unpack extra content from Google Play, Google Play Asset Delivery uses this service to prepare that content for the app.
en.disableEffect: On-demand app content that depends on Play asset packs may fail to install or load.

zh-CN.description: 应用需要从 Google Play 下载并解包额外内容时，Google Play Asset Delivery 会使用此服务为应用准备内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖 Play 资源包的按需内容可能无法安装或加载。

en.description: For longer Google Play Asset Delivery downloads, this service keeps extra app content available while it is being prepared.
en.disableEffect: Long-running asset-pack extraction may stop, leaving requested app content unavailable.

zh-CN.description: Google Play Asset Delivery 下载和准备额外内容需要较长时间时，此服务会帮助任务持续运行。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 长时间运行的资源包提取可能中断，导致应用请求的内容不可用。

en.description: When Google Play changes the status of extra content being downloaded for an app, this receiver passes the update to background processing so the app can show progress and finish the download.
en.disableEffect: Asset-pack progress and background completion handling may stop working.

zh-CN.description: Google Play 更新应用额外内容的下载状态时，此接收器会把更新交给后台处理，让应用显示进度并完成下载。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 资源包进度和后台完成处理可能停止工作。

en.description: When the app requests an in-app update or review, Google Play Core opens this confirmation screen and returns the user choice.
en.disableEffect: In-app update confirmation and Play review prompts may not open or finish.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求应用内更新或评价时，Google Play Core 会打开此确认页面并返回用户的选择。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用内更新确认或 Play 评价提示可能无法打开或完成。

en.description: Google Play Inline Install uses this screen to send an app-install request to Google Play, which shows an install panel and progress indicator without leaving the current app.
en.disableEffect: The host app remains usable, but its Google Play inline install sheet and install-status affordance will not appear.

zh-CN.description: Google Play Inline Install 会通过此页面向 Google Play 发送应用安装请求，随后在当前应用内显示安装页面和进度。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 宿主应用仍可使用，但 Google Play 应用内安装页面和安装状态提示不会显示。

en.description: If required parts of an app are missing after installation, Google Play Core opens this screen to explain that the app must be reinstalled and, when possible, offers a button to reinstall from Play.
en.disableEffect: Without the recovery screen, an app missing required components may remain unusable.

zh-CN.description: 安装后若应用缺少必需部分，Google Play Core 会打开此页面说明需要重新安装，并在可用时提供从 Play 重新安装的按钮。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 没有此恢复页面时，缺少必需组件的应用可能无法使用。

en.description: When a game starts on Android 13 or later, Google Play Sidekick starts its in-game overlay support, which can show Play Games content and offers over the game.
en.disableEffect: The game continues to run, but the Sidekick overlay and its in-game content and offers will not appear.

zh-CN.description: Android 13 及以上版本的游戏启动时，Google Play Sidekick 会准备游戏内浮层，以便在游戏画面上显示 Play Games 内容和优惠。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 游戏仍可运行，但 Sidekick 游戏内浮层、内容和优惠不会显示。

en.description: Hardcoded values below
When a viewer selects an ad icon that cannot open its linked content, Google TV Ads opens this screen to show an alternate image and description or an error message.
en.disableEffect: Ad-icon fallback images and their click-through panel will not be shown; app content remains available.

zh-CN.description: 观众点选的广告图标无法打开关联内容时，Google TV Ads 会打开此页面显示备用图片和说明，或显示错误提示。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 广告图标的备用图片和点击后面板将不再显示，应用内容仍可使用。

en.description: Google TV Panel Framework opens this screen when the TV asks to show input settings; it lists connected inputs and lets users switch or lock them.
en.disableEffect: TV input selection and the controls in this panel will be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: 电视请求显示输入设置时，Google TV Panel Framework 会打开此页面；它列出已连接的输入源，并允许用户切换或锁定输入源。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 电视输入源选择以及此面板中的控制将不可用。

en.description: Google TV Panel Framework uses this screen to display the app settings in a TV side panel.
en.disableEffect: Settings screens implemented through this TV panel will not open.

zh-CN.description: Google TV Panel Framework 使用此页面在电视侧边面板中显示应用设置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过此电视面板实现的设置页面将无法打开。

en.description: When a page opened in the app requests location, Android Browser Helper asks the user to grant location permission and returns the choice to that page.
en.disableEffect: Trusted web pages in the app will no longer be able to request device location through this flow.

zh-CN.description: 应用中打开的网页请求定位时，Android Browser Helper 会询问用户是否允许定位，并将选择返回网页。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用中的可信网页将无法再通过此流程请求设备定位权限。

en.description: When a user taps a shortcut to a saved web page while the app is closed, Android Browser Helper opens that page in the app web experience.
en.disableEffect: A static shortcut may fail to open the trusted web page when the app is not already running.

zh-CN.description: 应用关闭时，用户点选已保存网页的快捷方式，Android Browser Helper 会在应用的网页界面中打开该页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用尚未运行时，静态快捷方式可能无法打开对应的可信网页。

en.description: When the app opens a web link through it, Google's Android Browser Helper launches the configured website in an app-style browser window and falls back to a regular browser tab when needed.
en.disableEffect: Apps that route sign-in through this browser page will no longer be able to open that login route.

zh-CN.description: 应用通过此入口打开网页链接时，Google Android Browser Helper 会在类似应用的浏览器窗口中启动配置的网站，并在需要时回退到普通浏览器标签页。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 如果应用通过此浏览器页面登录，停用后将无法打开这条登录流程。

en.description: When a user opens a shortcut to a trusted web page, Android Browser Helper checks the address and opens the page in the app or an available browser.
en.disableEffect: Static shortcuts to trusted web pages will not open correctly.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开可信网页的快捷方式时，Android Browser Helper 会检查网址，并在应用或可用的浏览器中打开页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 指向可信网页的静态快捷方式将无法正常打开。

en.description: When an app needs ARCore for augmented reality, ARCore opens this screen if the required Google Play service must be installed or updated; it explains the request and starts setup after the user agrees.
en.disableEffect: AR features that require ARCore may be unavailable if its installation or update cannot be completed.

zh-CN.description: 应用的增强现实功能需要 ARCore 时，如果必需的 Google Play 服务尚未安装或需要更新，ARCore 会打开此页面说明原因，并在用户同意后开始设置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 如果无法完成 ARCore 安装或更新，依赖 ARCore 的增强现实功能可能不可用。
