en.description: After Google Assistant completes a request to add a widget from the app, this receiver applies the supplied setup options to that widget. It belongs to the Google Assistant App Actions widgets library.
en.disableEffect: The widget may miss its initial settings when users add it through Google Assistant.

zh-CN.description: Google 助理完成将应用中的小组件添加到桌面的请求后，此接收器会为该小组件应用请求中提供的设置选项。它属于 Google 助理 App Actions 小组件库。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户通过 Google 助理添加小组件时，它可能无法收到初始设置。

en.description: Google Assistant calls this service to handle a request to add a widget from the app to the home screen. It belongs to the Google Assistant App Actions widgets library.
en.disableEffect: Users can no longer add the app's widgets from Google Assistant.

zh-CN.description: Google 助理会调用此服务，将应用中的小组件添加到主屏幕。它属于 Google 助理 App Actions 小组件库。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法再通过 Google 助理添加应用的小组件。

en.description: During a Firebase App Distribution test release, this screen lets a tester describe an issue, choose a screenshot, and submit feedback for the release.
en.disableEffect: Testers can no longer send in-app feedback or attach a screenshot through Firebase App Distribution.

zh-CN.description: 在 Firebase App Distribution 测试版本中，测试者可通过此页面描述问题、选择截图并提交该版本的反馈。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 测试者无法再通过 Firebase App Distribution 在应用内提交反馈或附上截图。

en.description: Firebase App Distribution uses this provider to give the Android package installer a temporary content link to a downloaded test APK.
en.disableEffect: Without it, Firebase App Distribution cannot provide the APK link required by its test-build installation flow.

zh-CN.description: Firebase App Distribution 会通过此 Provider 为 Android 安装程序提供指向已下载测试 APK 的临时内容链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 没有它，Firebase App Distribution 就无法提供测试版本安装流程所需的 APK 链接。

en.description: When a Firebase App Distribution update is ready, this screen checks the unknown-app install setting and opens Android's package installer with the downloaded APK.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it stops the test-build install flow, and the SDK direct launch of this screen may fail.

zh-CN.description: Firebase App Distribution 更新准备就绪后，此页面会检查是否允许安装未知来源应用，并使用已下载的 APK 打开 Android 安装程序。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，测试版本安装流程会中断，SDK 直接启动此页面也可能失败。

en.description: When a tester follows a Firebase App Distribution sign-in return link, this screen opens and immediately closes to hand control back to the app.
en.disableEffect: Firebase App Distribution tester sign-in cannot return through this screen.

zh-CN.description: 测试者打开 Firebase App Distribution 登录返回链接时，此页面会短暂打开并立即关闭，将操作交还给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Firebase App Distribution 测试者登录流程无法通过此页面返回应用。

en.description: When a tester taps a Firebase App Distribution feedback notification, this screen captures a screenshot and opens the release feedback form.
en.disableEffect: Testers lose the notification shortcut for submitting screenshot-based feedback.

zh-CN.description: 测试者点击 Firebase App Distribution 反馈通知时，此页面会截取屏幕并打开版本反馈表单。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 测试者将无法再通过通知快捷入口提交带截图的反馈。

en.description: Firebase App Distribution uses this provider to give the Android package installer a temporary content link to a downloaded test APK.
en.disableEffect: Without it, Firebase App Distribution cannot provide the APK link required by its test-build installation flow.

zh-CN.description: Firebase App Distribution 会通过此 Provider 为 Android 安装程序提供指向已下载测试 APK 的临时内容链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 没有它，Firebase App Distribution 就无法提供测试版本安装流程所需的 APK 链接。

en.description: In the earlier Firebase App Distribution integration, this screen checks the unknown-app install setting and launches Android's package installer for a downloaded APK.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it stops the test-build install flow, and the SDK direct launch of this screen may fail.

zh-CN.description: 在较早版本的 Firebase App Distribution 集成中，此页面会检查是否允许安装未知来源应用，并为已下载的 APK 启动 Android 安装程序。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，测试版本安装流程会中断，SDK 直接启动此页面也可能失败。

en.description: When a tester follows a Firebase App Distribution sign-in return link, this screen opens and immediately closes to hand control back to the app.
en.disableEffect: Firebase App Distribution tester sign-in cannot return through this screen.

zh-CN.description: 测试者打开 Firebase App Distribution 登录返回链接时，此页面会短暂打开并立即关闭，将操作交还给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Firebase App Distribution 测试者登录流程无法通过此页面返回应用。

en.description: When Firebase Authentication handles a request through its backup path, this background service establishes the connection used for sign-in and account operations.
en.disableEffect: Authentication requests that need this backup path may fail, including sign-in and account operations.

zh-CN.description: Firebase Authentication 通过备用路径处理请求时，此后台服务会建立用于登录和账户操作的连接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要此备用路径的身份验证请求可能失败，包括登录和账户操作。

en.description: When a user signs in with an external account through Firebase Authentication, this temporary screen opens the provider website and returns the result to the app. It also supports account linking and checking identity again.
en.disableEffect: External-account sign-in, account linking, or identity checks that use this flow cannot finish.

zh-CN.description: 用户通过 Firebase Authentication 使用外部账户登录时，此临时页面会打开服务提供方的网站，并将结果返回给应用。它也支持关联账户和再次验证身份。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此流程的外部账户登录、账户关联或身份验证将无法完成。

en.description: When Firebase Authentication requests app verification, this screen opens the web-based reCAPTCHA check and returns its result to Authentication.
en.disableEffect: Authentication flows that require reCAPTCHA cannot finish.

zh-CN.description: Firebase Authentication 请求验证应用时，此页面会打开网页形式的 reCAPTCHA 检查，并将结果返回给 Authentication。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要 reCAPTCHA 的身份验证流程将无法完成。

en.description: When Firebase starts, this background service helps it find and set up the Firebase tools included in the app. It does not show a screen or handle a user action.
en.disableEffect: Firebase tools that rely on this setup may not start, which can make their app features unavailable.

zh-CN.description: Firebase 启动时，此后台服务会帮助它查找并准备应用中包含的 Firebase 功能。它不会显示页面，也不处理用户操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此初始化流程的 Firebase 功能可能无法启动，导致应用中的相关功能无法使用。

en.description: When Firebase Cloud Messaging receives a push or a user opens or dismisses its notification, this receiver passes the event to Firebase messaging in the app.
en.disableEffect: Firebase push messages and notification actions no longer reach the app through this receiver.

zh-CN.description: Firebase Cloud Messaging 收到推送消息，或用户打开、清除相关通知时，此接收器会将事件转交给应用中的 Firebase 消息处理流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Firebase 推送消息和通知操作将无法再通过此接收器到达应用。

en.description: Firebase Cloud Messaging starts this Service when push messages or push registration updates arrive. It displays notification messages, delivers data messages to the app, and processes other message delivery events.
en.disableEffect: The app stops receiving Firebase push messages and token updates; other features remain available.

zh-CN.description: Firebase Cloud Messaging 会在收到推送消息或推送注册更新时启动此服务。它会显示通知类推送、把数据类推送交给应用，并处理其他消息送达事件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法接收 Firebase 推送消息，也无法处理推送令牌更新；其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: When a push message arrives before the device is unlocked after a restart, Firebase Cloud Messaging uses this Receiver to forward it for normal handling in the app.
en.disableEffect: Push messages that arrive before the device is unlocked after a restart will not be handled through this receiver; other app features remain available.

zh-CN.description: 设备重启后、尚未解锁时收到推送消息，Firebase Cloud Messaging 会使用此接收器将消息转交给应用的常规处理流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 设备重启后首次解锁前到达的推送将无法通过此接收器处理；应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: At app startup, this Provider initializes Firebase so the app can use its Firebase services.
en.disableEffect: Firebase-dependent features may fail to initialize or become unavailable.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，此 Provider 会初始化 Firebase，供应用使用相关服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖 Firebase 的功能可能无法初始化或无法使用。

en.description: Firebase Sessions includes this background service but disables it by default in the analyzed release. It has no screen or user action in that release.
en.disableEffect: Blocking it has no additional effect in this release because the service is already disabled.

zh-CN.description: Firebase Sessions 在分析的版本中包含此后台服务，但默认将其停用。该版本中它没有页面，也不处理用户操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 此版本已默认停用该服务，因此再次屏蔽不会产生额外影响。

en.description: When Google ML Kit checks how well an on-device recognition model performs, this service runs background checks that measure its accuracy and speed.
en.disableEffect: ML Kit cannot complete these checks, so it cannot use the measured results to choose an acceleration option.

zh-CN.description: Google ML Kit 检查设备端识别模型的表现时，此服务会在后台测量模型的准确度和速度。
zh-CN.disableEffect: ML Kit 无法完成这些检查，因此不能使用测量结果选择加速方案。

en.description: When Google ML Kit starts, this background service helps it find and set up the ML Kit features included in the app. It does not show a screen.
en.disableEffect: ML Kit features that rely on this setup may not start and can become unavailable.

zh-CN.description: Google ML Kit 启动时，此后台服务会帮助它查找并准备应用中包含的 ML Kit 功能。它不会显示页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此初始化流程的 ML Kit 功能可能无法启动或使用。

en.description: Android creates this provider early when the app starts, preparing Google ML Kit so the app can use its image, barcode, or object recognition features.
en.disableEffect: ML Kit features may not work unless the app initializes ML Kit another way.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动早期，Android 会创建此 Provider 并准备 Google ML Kit，使应用能够使用图像、条码或物体识别功能。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 除非应用通过其他方式初始化 ML Kit，否则相关功能可能无法使用。

en.description: ML Kit Barcode Scanning opens Google's scanner screen when the app requests a barcode scan, then returns the scanned code or an error.
en.disableEffect: Barcode scanning through ML Kit will fail or return no result.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求扫描条码时，ML Kit 条码扫描会打开 Google 扫描界面，并返回扫描结果或错误。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过 ML Kit 进行的条码扫描将失败或无法返回结果。

en.description: ML Kit Document Scanner opens Google's document-scanning screen with the app's scan options, then returns scanned pages or a PDF.
en.disableEffect: The app's document capture and PDF scanning flow will stop working.

zh-CN.description: ML Kit 文档扫描会根据应用提供的选项打开 Google 文档扫描界面，然后返回扫描页面或 PDF 文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用的文档采集和 PDF 扫描流程将停止工作。

en.description: The ZXing barcode-scanning library, as packaged by ZHScanQRCode, opens this Activity when an app asks to scan a QR code or barcode. It uses the camera to read the code and returns its contents to the app.
en.disableEffect: Apps that use this screen will lose their QR-code and barcode-scanning flow.

zh-CN.description: ZHScanQRCode 集成的 ZXing 条码扫描库会在应用发起扫码时打开此 Activity，使用相机读取二维码或条形码，并把识别结果交还给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此界面的应用将无法继续通过它扫描二维码或条形码。

en.description: An HTML-based help screen.
ZHScanQRCode’s ZXing scanner opens this settings screen when an app offers scan preferences. Users can choose barcode formats and adjust options such as sound, vibration, and camera focus.
en.disableEffect: Users will no longer be able to change scanner options here; scanning continues with the saved or default choices.

zh-CN.description: 当应用提供扫码设置时，ZHScanQRCode 的 ZXing 扫描库会打开此设置界面。用户可以选择要识别的码制，并调整提示音、振动和相机对焦等选项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在此界面更改扫描选项；扫描仍会使用已保存或默认的设置。

en.description: Uses Google Book Search to find a word or phrase in the requested book.
This class encodes data from an Intent into a QR code, and then displays it full screen so that another person can scan it with their device.
The activity for interacting with the scan history.
Barcode Scanner can share data like contacts and bookmarks by displaying a QR Code on screen, such that another user can scan the barcode with their phone.
When someone taps a goPUSH (iWinBack) push notification, this Activity records the open and sends the user to the notification’s web link, app action, or the app’s main screen.
en.disableEffect: Tapping a goPUSH notification will no longer open its link or app destination.

zh-CN.description: 用户点按 goPUSH（iWinBack）推送通知时，此 Activity 会记录打开事件，并根据通知内容打开网页链接、应用操作或应用主界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，点按 goPUSH 通知将无法打开其中的链接或应用页面。

en.description: When goPUSH (iWinBack) requests notification permission on Android 13 or later, this Activity shows the system prompt and returns the user’s choice to the SDK.
en.disableEffect: Users who have not granted notification permission will not be able to grant it through goPUSH, so its notifications may remain off.

zh-CN.description: goPUSH（iWinBack）在 Android 13 及更高版本请求通知权限时，此 Activity 会显示系统提示，并将用户的选择交还给 SDK。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 尚未授权的用户无法通过 goPUSH 完成通知授权，因此可能收不到 goPUSH 通知。

en.description: When goPUSH (iWinBack) displays an in-app message, this Activity opens the message screen and reports when the user closes it.
en.disableEffect: goPUSH in-app messages will no longer appear.

zh-CN.description: goPUSH（iWinBack）显示应用内消息时，此 Activity 会打开消息页面，并在用户关闭页面后通知 SDK。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，goPUSH 应用内消息将无法显示。

en.description: When an app starts an online identity check, the Governikus AusweisApp service runs its verification engine in the background and communicates with the app. It supports checks using an electronic residence permit or eID card over NFC.
en.disableEffect: Identity checks that rely on AusweisApp cannot run, so the related verification or sign-in flow fails.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动在线身份核验时，Governikus AusweisApp 服务会在后台运行核验引擎并与应用通信，支持通过 NFC 读取电子居留许可或电子身份证。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖 AusweisApp 的身份核验将无法运行，相关验证或登录流程会失败。

en.description: Calculator Input View by GPerez88 opens this calculator screen when the app requests calculator-assisted number entry. Users can enter numbers and arithmetic, then return the result to the app.
en.disableEffect: The app's calculator input flow will be unavailable and cannot return a value entered on this screen.

zh-CN.description: GPerez88 的 Calculator Input View 会在应用需要通过计算器输入数值时打开此界面。用户可输入数字并进行四则运算，再将结果返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 屏蔽后，应用无法打开此计算器输入流程，也无法从此界面返回计算结果。

en.description: GPSHopper FireSearch registers this Activity for launcher and Android search; it finds matching saved dictionary words and adds a submitted word if it is new.
en.disableEffect: FireSearch's dictionary search and add-word screen will no longer be available.

zh-CN.description: GPSHopper 的 FireSearch 会将此 Activity 注册为启动页和 Android 搜索页面；它会查找匹配的已保存词条，并在提交的新词尚不存在时将其加入词典。
zh-CN.disableEffect: FireSearch 的词典搜索和添加词条界面将无法使用。

en.description: The gaoqianZ ModularEventBus Annotations artifact includes an unexported activity that opens an empty screen; its code defines no visible action.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it only prevents this empty screen from opening.

zh-CN.description: gaoqianZ 的 ModularEventBus Annotations 组件包含一个未导出的页面，打开后为空白界面，代码中没有可见操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后仅无法打开这个空白页面。

en.description: When a host app starts Grab account sign-in, the Grab ID Partner SDK opens the authorization page in a Chrome custom tab and returns the login result or cancellation to the app.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot complete Grab sign-in through the SDK; apps that rely on this login flow lose that feature.

zh-CN.description: 宿主应用启动 Grab 账户登录时，Grab ID Partner SDK 会在 Chrome 自定义标签页中打开授权页面，并将登录结果或取消状态返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此 SDK 完成 Grab 登录；依赖该登录流程的应用功能也会失效。

en.description: When Android starts a GreedyGame crash-reporting job with network access, this service sends the queued crash report. If sending fails, it saves the report for a later attempt.
en.disableEffect: GreedyGame may stop sending crash reports from this job; ordinary app features continue to work.

zh-CN.description: Android 启动 GreedyGame 的联网崩溃报告任务时，此服务会发送排队中的崩溃报告；发送失败时会保存报告以便之后重试。
zh-CN.disableEffect: GreedyGame 可能无法通过此任务发送崩溃报告，但应用的常规功能仍可使用。

en.description: When GreedyGame queues a crash report as background work, this service uploads it and saves it locally if the upload fails.
en.disableEffect: This GreedyGame crash-reporting path may stop working, without disabling the host app's normal features.

zh-CN.description: GreedyGame 将崩溃报告加入后台任务队列时，此服务会尝试上传；上传失败时会将报告保存在本地。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 此 GreedyGame 崩溃报告流程可能停止工作，但不会影响宿主应用的常规功能。

en.description: When GreedyGame opens an ad, this Activity displays the selected ad or branded creative using the matching ad provider and format.
en.disableEffect: Ads that need this GreedyGame screen will not display or open; the host app's other features remain available.

zh-CN.description: GreedyGame 打开广告时，此页面会根据对应的广告平台和形式展示广告或品牌创意。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要此 GreedyGame 页面展示的广告将无法显示或打开，宿主应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: GroundUpWorks Wings uses this receiver when its scheduled alarm fires to start background processing of queued photo shares.
en.disableEffect: Queued shares may not be sent or retried.

zh-CN.description: GroundUpWorks Wings 在预定闹钟触发时通过此接收器启动后台任务，处理排队等待的照片分享。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 排队的分享可能无法发送或重试。

en.description: After Android reports that the device has booted, this Wings receiver schedules the background sharing service to resume several minutes later.
en.disableEffect: Queued shares may not resume automatically after a device restart.

zh-CN.description: Android 通知设备启动完成后，Wings 会通过此接收器安排后台分享服务在几分钟后恢复运行。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 设备重启后，排队的分享可能无法自动继续。

en.description: GroundUpWorks Wings runs this service to process pending shares for linked destinations, show result notifications, and retry work after errors.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it stops Wings background delivery and retries for queued shares.

zh-CN.description: GroundUpWorks Wings 使用此服务处理发往已连接目的地的待分享内容、显示结果通知，并在出错后重试。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Wings 将无法在后台发送或重试排队的分享。

en.description: The GroundUpWorks Wings Facebook integration uses this screen for Facebook sign-in when a user links Facebook as a photo-sharing destination.
en.disableEffect: Users may be unable to connect or reauthorize Facebook, so sharing to Facebook can fail.

zh-CN.description: 用户将 Facebook 添加为照片分享目的地时，GroundUpWorks Wings 的 Facebook 集成会通过此页面完成 Facebook 登录。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户可能无法连接或重新授权 Facebook，因此分享内容到 Facebook 可能失败。

en.description: This Wings Facebook screen lets the user choose a Facebook album and photo privacy settings before saving the sharing destination.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot finish or change the Facebook album settings used for sharing.

zh-CN.description: 此 Wings Facebook 页面供用户选择 Facebook 相册和照片隐私设置，然后保存分享目的地。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法完成或修改 Facebook 分享所用的相册设置。

en.description: The GroundUpWorks Wings Google Cloud Print screen lets the user choose a Google account and printer, then set copies and paper size before linking it.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot link or configure a Google Cloud Print printer for Wings.

zh-CN.description: GroundUpWorks Wings 的 Google Cloud Print 页面供用户选择 Google 账户和打印机，并在连接前设置份数和纸张大小。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法为 Wings 连接或配置 Google Cloud Print 打印机。

en.description: YooMoney's YooKassa payments SDK includes Group-IB's mobile security service. It runs during payment checks to gather device and browser signals for transaction risk assessment.
en.disableEffect: YooKassa loses these device signals for its payment security checks, so a payment that depends on them may not complete.

zh-CN.description: YooMoney 的 YooKassa 支付 SDK 集成了 Group-IB 移动安全服务。该服务会在付款校验时收集设备和浏览器信息，用于评估交易风险。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 关闭后，YooKassa 的支付安全检查将缺少这些设备信息，依赖这些信息的付款可能无法完成。

en.description: At app startup, the GrowingIO Android analytics database provider opens the event store and records an SDK app-start measurement; GrowingIO uses it to read and write queued tracking events.
en.disableEffect: GrowingIO event storage and reporting may stop, while unrelated app screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，GrowingIO Android 分析 SDK 的数据库提供程序会打开事件存储并记录 SDK 启动数据；GrowingIO 通过它读写排队等待上报的跟踪事件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: GrowingIO 的事件存储和上报可能停止，但应用的其他页面仍可使用。

en.description: At app startup, the GrowingIO Android analytics SDK starts this provider to load saved settings and prepare its tracking, session, message, and deep-link features.
en.disableEffect: GrowingIO tracking setup and SDK-managed deep-link preparation may stop, while the app's other screens continue to open.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，GrowingIO Android 分析 SDK 会启动此提供程序，读取已保存的设置，并准备跟踪、会话、消息和深度链接功能。
zh-CN.disableEffect: GrowingIO 的跟踪初始化和 SDK 深度链接准备可能停止，但应用的其他页面仍可打开。

en.description: When a user taps a Huawei push notification, GrowingIO GPush opens this screen with the message and routes the tap into the app.
en.disableEffect: Tapping Huawei notifications will no longer open their intended app content.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击华为推送通知时，GrowingIO GPush 会携带消息打开此页面，并将点击操作转到应用内处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 点击华为推送通知将无法再打开对应的应用内容。

en.description: Huawei Push Kit calls this GrowingIO GPush service when its registration token changes, so GrowingIO can update push registration.
en.disableEffect: Huawei push registration and delivery may stop working.

zh-CN.description: 华为 Push Kit 的注册令牌变化时会调用 GrowingIO GPush 的此服务，以便更新推送注册信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 华为推送的注册和送达可能停止。

en.description: Meizu Flyme push broadcasts reach this GrowingIO GPush receiver for registration updates and notification taps; it forwards tapped GrowingIO messages into the app.
en.disableEffect: Meizu push registration and notification taps will stop working.

zh-CN.description: 魅族 Flyme 推送广播会触发 GrowingIO GPush 的此接收器，用于更新注册信息和处理通知点击；它会将 GrowingIO 消息转入应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 魅族推送注册和通知点击将无法使用。

en.description: When an Oppo push notification is tapped, GrowingIO GPush opens this screen with the message and routes it to its destination in the app.
en.disableEffect: Tapping Oppo notifications will no longer open their intended app content.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击 OPPO 推送通知时，GrowingIO GPush 会携带消息打开此页面，并将消息转到应用内对应内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 点击 OPPO 推送通知将无法再打开对应的应用内容。

en.description: GrowingIO GPush uses this receiver to process Vivo push registration updates and notification taps delivered through the app's internal broadcasts.
en.disableEffect: Vivo push registration updates or notification opens may stop working.

zh-CN.description: GrowingIO GPush 通过应用内部广播使用此接收器处理 Vivo 推送注册更新和通知点击。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Vivo 推送注册更新或通知打开操作可能无法使用。

en.description: GrowingIO starts this background service to turn Vivo push registration on or off in the app's separate push process.
en.disableEffect: Vivo push setup and delivery may stop working.

zh-CN.description: GrowingIO 会在应用单独的推送进程中启动此后台服务，以开启或关闭 Vivo 推送注册。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Vivo 推送的配置和送达可能停止。

en.description: Vivo Push callbacks reach this GrowingIO receiver, which reports registration tokens and routes tapped GrowingIO messages into the app.
en.disableEffect: Vivo push registration and notification taps may stop working.

zh-CN.description: Vivo Push 回调会发送到 GrowingIO 的此接收器；它上报注册令牌，并将点击的 GrowingIO 消息转入应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Vivo 推送注册和通知点击可能无法使用。

en.description: Xiaomi push callbacks reach this GrowingIO receiver to report registration status and open tapped GrowingIO messages in the app; it also passes other Xiaomi messages on to other receivers.
en.disableEffect: Xiaomi push registration and notification taps may stop working.

zh-CN.description: 小米推送回调会发送到 GrowingIO 的此接收器，用于上报注册状态并在应用中打开点击的 GrowingIO 消息；它也会转发其他小米消息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 小米推送注册和通知点击可能无法使用。

en.description: When a user follows an HTTP or HTTPS link opened by GrowingIO GTouch, this screen displays the page inside the app.
en.disableEffect: GTouch links that use this screen will not open, which may interrupt an app flow that sends users through those links.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 GrowingIO GTouch 提供的 HTTP 或 HTTPS 链接时，此页面会在应用内显示网页。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此页面的 GTouch 链接将无法打开，应用中通过这些链接引导的流程可能中断。

en.description: At app startup, the GrowingIO GTouch Banner SDK stores the app context used by its image loader when it needs a default context for banner images.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it can prevent GTouch Banner image requests from loading when no other screen has initialized the image loader.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，GrowingIO GTouch Banner SDK 会保存应用上下文，供图片加载器在没有其他默认上下文时加载横幅图片。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 如果图片加载器尚未由其他页面初始化，停用此项可能导致 GTouch Banner 图片无法加载。

en.description: GrowingIO GioKit starts this service when a user opens its floating inspection menu, which displays in-app SDK debugging tools.
en.disableEffect: The GioKit floating inspection menu will no longer appear; regular app screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 GrowingIO GioKit 悬浮检查菜单时会启动此服务，用于显示应用内的 SDK 调试工具。
zh-CN.disableEffect: GioKit 悬浮检查菜单将无法显示，但应用的常规页面仍可使用。

en.description: GrowingIO GioKit opens this screen when a user selects one of its inspection pages from the floating menu.
en.disableEffect: GioKit inspection pages that use this screen will not open.

zh-CN.description: 用户从悬浮菜单选择检查页面时，GrowingIO GioKit 会打开此页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此页面的 GioKit 检查工具将无法打开。

en.description: GrowingIO GioKit opens this screen from its floating menu to show SDK settings and diagnostics.
en.disableEffect: GioKit settings and diagnostics will not open from the floating menu.

zh-CN.description: GrowingIO GioKit 会从悬浮菜单打开此页面，显示 SDK 设置和诊断信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法从悬浮菜单打开 GioKit 设置和诊断页面。

en.description: When a Daily Alarm Service alarm flow sends a stop-playback signal, this receiver stops media associated with that alarm job.
en.disableEffect: Alarm-related media may continue playing after its stop request.

zh-CN.description: Daily Alarm Service 的闹钟流程发送停止播放信号时，此接收器会停止与该闹钟任务关联的媒体播放。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停止请求发出后，与闹钟相关的媒体仍可能继续播放。

en.description: When a Daily Alarm Service wake-up alarm fires, this receiver starts the background job that checks whether an alert is due and can show its notification, sound, and vibration.
en.disableEffect: Scheduled daily alarm notifications and sounds may no longer run.

zh-CN.description: Daily Alarm Service 的唤醒闹钟触发时，此接收器会启动后台任务，检查是否应提醒，并按设置显示通知、播放声音和振动。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 预定的每日闹钟通知和声音可能无法触发。

en.description: When a user enables GuarDanis AppLock, this screen guides them through creating the credential used to protect app access.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to set up the AppLock credential or enable that lock flow.

zh-CN.description: 用户启用 GuarDanis AppLock 时，此页面会引导其创建用于保护应用访问的凭据。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法设置 AppLock 凭据或启用该锁定流程。

en.description: When an app protected by GuarDanis AppLock requests access, this screen asks the user to unlock it and returns success only after verification.
en.disableEffect: Users may be unable to open content guarded by AppLock.

zh-CN.description: GuarDanis AppLock 保护的应用请求访问时，此页面会要求用户解锁，并在验证通过后才返回成功。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户可能无法打开由 AppLock 保护的内容。

en.description: When GuardianConnect starts its DNS protection, Android runs this VPN service to create a local VPN interface and route configured DNS and blocked-host destinations through it.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents GuardianConnect from establishing its VPN, so its DNS protection will stop.

zh-CN.description: GuardianConnect 启动 DNS 保护时，Android 会运行此 VPN 服务，建立本地 VPN 接口，并通过它路由已配置的 DNS 和拦截主机目标。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后 GuardianConnect 将无法建立 VPN，DNS 保护也会停止。

en.description: Park SangGwon's TedOnActivityResult opens the external screen requested by the app, such as the camera or a picker, and returns its result to the app.
en.disableEffect: Features that rely on TedOnActivityResult to open another screen, such as taking a photo, may not receive a result.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求打开相机或文件选择器等外部页面时，Park SangGwon 的 TedOnActivityResult 会启动该页面并将结果交回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖 TedOnActivityResult 打开外部页面的功能（例如拍照）可能无法收到返回结果。

en.description: Park SangGwon's TedPermission opens this Activity when an app requests runtime or screen-overlay access. It explains the request, opens Android's permission prompt or settings, and reports whether access was granted.
en.disableEffect: Features that need permissions cannot request or receive the result through TedPermission.

zh-CN.description: 应用通过 Park SangGwon 的 TedPermission 请求运行时权限或屏幕悬浮权限时，会打开此 Activity。它说明权限请求、打开 Android 权限提示或设置页面，并返回授权结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要权限的功能无法通过 TedPermission 请求权限或收到授权结果。

en.description: Park SangGwon's TedPermission starts this provider with the app and prepares the shared state its permission-request flow uses later.
en.disableEffect: TedPermission permission requests may fail because their startup setup is missing.

zh-CN.description: Park SangGwon 的 TedPermission 会在应用启动时运行此 Provider，为后续权限请求流程准备所需状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，TedPermission 权限请求可能因启动准备未完成而失败。

en.description: The Mock Interceptor SDK by Gustafah uses this Provider to give Android's share menu access to saved mock-response database files during export.
en.disableEffect: The SDK will not be able to attach an exported mock-response database to Android's share menu, so sharing that file will fail.

zh-CN.description: Gustafah 的 Mock Interceptor SDK 会在导出模拟响应数据库时通过此 Provider 将文件提供给 Android 分享菜单。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 屏蔽后，SDK 无法将导出的模拟响应数据库附加到 Android 分享菜单，分享该文件会失败。

en.description: The Mock Interceptor SDK opens this Receiver when the user taps the automatic-mocking switch in its notification. It changes whether saved mock responses are used automatically and refreshes the notification.
en.disableEffect: The notification will no longer be able to switch automatic mock responses on or off.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击 Mock Interceptor SDK 通知中的自动模拟开关时，此 Receiver 会切换是否自动使用已保存的模拟响应，并刷新通知内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 屏蔽后，用户无法通过该通知开启或关闭自动使用模拟响应。

en.description: The Mock Interceptor SDK opens this screen when its database export option is chosen. It saves the mock-response database and starts Android's share flow for the file.
en.disableEffect: The optional mock-database export flow will be unavailable, while the app's normal screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择 Mock Interceptor SDK 的数据库导出功能时，此界面会保存模拟响应数据库，并启动 Android 分享流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 屏蔽后，模拟数据库导出功能将无法使用，应用的其他常规界面仍可使用。

en.description: The Mock Interceptor SDK opens this screen when its database import option is chosen. It opens Android's file picker and loads the selected mock database.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to restore saved mock responses through this optional import screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择 Mock Interceptor SDK 的数据库导入功能时，此界面会打开 Android 文件选择器，并载入选中的模拟数据库。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 屏蔽后，用户无法通过此导入界面恢复已保存的模拟响应。

en.description: The Mock Interceptor SDK opens this screen from its request-mocking controls to display choices for the selected mock request.
en.disableEffect: The mock-request choices will not open, but the app's normal use remains available.

zh-CN.description: Mock Interceptor SDK 会从请求模拟控制界面打开此页，为选中的模拟请求显示可用选项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 屏蔽后，模拟请求的选项无法打开，但应用的常规功能仍可使用。

en.description: The Mock Interceptor SDK opens this screen from its request-mocking reference control to display reference information for a selected request.
en.disableEffect: The mock-request reference information will not open, but the app's normal use remains available.

zh-CN.description: Mock Interceptor SDK 会从请求模拟参考入口打开此页，显示所选请求的参考信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 屏蔽后，模拟请求的参考信息无法打开，但应用的常规功能仍可使用。

en.description: Android invokes this scheduled Service as part of the Cactus by Kuloud keep-alive routine. It checks whether Cactus is running and registers its background work again when it has stopped.
en.disableEffect: Cactus's scheduled recovery checks will stop, so its background work may not restart after Android stops it.

zh-CN.description: 作为 Kuloud Cactus 保活流程的一部分，Android 会按计划调用此服务。它会检查 Cactus 是否仍在运行，并在服务停止后重新登记后台任务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Cactus 的定时恢复检查将停止；后台任务被 Android 停止后可能无法重新运行。

en.description: Cactus by Kuloud briefly starts this Service with a configured foreground notification, then removes that notification after about two seconds. This is part of its background keep-alive routine.
en.disableEffect: Cactus's background keep-alive and notification handoff may stop working as intended.

zh-CN.description: Kuloud Cactus 会用此服务短暂显示配置好的前台通知，并在约两秒后移除通知。这是其后台保活流程的一部分。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Cactus 的后台保活和通知切换流程可能无法正常工作。

en.description: When started by Cactus by Kuloud, this local background Service launches its companion service and runs the app's configured keep-alive callbacks. It also reports when the app enters or leaves the background.
en.disableEffect: Cactus's background keep-alive callbacks and recovery behavior will stop.

zh-CN.description: Kuloud Cactus 启动此本地后台服务后，会启动配套服务并执行应用配置的保活回调。它也会报告应用进入或离开后台的状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Cactus 的后台保活回调和恢复行为将停止。

en.description: Cactus by Kuloud starts this companion background Service alongside its other service and watches their connection so it can restore background work if one stops.
en.disableEffect: Cactus will lose this recovery path for its background work.

zh-CN.description: Kuloud Cactus 会同时启动此配套后台服务，并监测它与另一项服务的连接，以便在服务停止时恢复后台任务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Cactus 将失去这条恢复后台任务的途径。

en.description: Haier Biomedical’s PriceTag screen lets staff scan an electronic price tag and vaccine code, look up vaccine details, and bind or unbind the vaccine to the tag.
en.disableEffect: Staff cannot use this screen to bind or unbind a vaccine price tag.

zh-CN.description: Haier Biomedical PriceTag 页面让工作人员扫描电子价签和疫苗码、查询疫苗信息，并将疫苗与价签绑定或解绑。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 工作人员无法在此页面完成电子价签与疫苗的绑定或解绑。

en.description: Hailiang's ad SDK registers this Provider for files on external storage so an ad flow can share a file with Android or another app using temporary access.
en.disableEffect: Hailiang ad flows that need to hand off an external-storage file will no longer be able to open it.

zh-CN.description: Hailiang 广告 SDK 为外部存储中的文件注册了这个 Provider，使广告流程可以临时授权 Android 或其他应用读取文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要传递外部存储文件的 Hailiang 广告流程将无法再打开该文件。

en.description: When a Hailiang ad click opens a page inside the app, this Activity hosts the ad's browser page and handles navigation and permission results.
en.disableEffect: Hailiang ad landing pages that use the in-app browser will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击 Hailiang 广告并在应用内打开目标页面时，这个 Activity 会显示广告浏览页面并处理页面导航和权限结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖应用内浏览器的 Hailiang 广告落地页将无法打开。

en.description: When Hailiang starts an incentive video ad, this Activity hosts the ad and handles its playback lifecycle and user input.
en.disableEffect: Incentive video ads stop, and users will no longer receive rewards for watching them.

zh-CN.description: Hailiang 启动激励视频广告时，这个 Activity 会承载广告播放并处理播放过程和用户操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 激励视频广告将停止，用户也不会再获得观看广告的奖励。

en.description: Halley HTTP's mock screen opens this Activity to show an editable HTTP response-status field. It is a mock/testing screen and does not handle the app's regular network requests.
en.disableEffect: The HTTP mock-status screen will be unavailable; regular app screens and network requests are unaffected.

zh-CN.description: Halley HTTP 的模拟界面会打开此 Activity，显示可编辑的 HTTP 响应状态码字段。这是模拟或测试界面，不处理应用的常规网络请求。
zh-CN.disableEffect: HTTP 模拟状态码界面将无法使用；应用的常规界面和网络请求不受影响。

en.description: When the app's debug tools bind to Hannes Dorfmann's DebugOverlay library, this service displays their log messages in an on-screen panel. The panel appears when a message arrives and can be closed by the user.
en.disableEffect: The debug message panel will not appear; the app's other screens continue to work.

zh-CN.description: 应用的调试工具连接到 Hannes Dorfmann 的 DebugOverlay 调试库时，此服务会在屏幕面板中显示日志消息。收到消息后面板会出现，用户可以将其关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 调试日志面板将不会显示；应用的其他页面仍可使用。

en.description: At app process startup, the Haochezhu UBM trip-tracking SDK sets up its shared app context and logging. Its location collection and trip-recording features use that setup.
en.disableEffect: UBM tracking and trip-recording setup may fail, so the app may not collect or display new driving records correctly.

zh-CN.description: 应用进程启动时，好车主 UBM 行程追踪 SDK 会保存应用上下文并初始化日志。SDK 的定位采集和行程记录功能会使用这些初始化信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，UBM 的追踪和行程记录可能无法正常初始化，应用可能无法采集或显示新的行程记录。

en.description: The UBM SDK receives this Receiver after the phone boots, the app is replaced, or certain manufacturers send a quick-boot broadcast. In this version it only checks which broadcast arrived and takes no further action.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it has no visible effect in the analyzed version because it does not restart tracking or perform another task.

zh-CN.description: 手机启动、应用更新或部分厂商发送快速启动广播时，UBM 会收到此 Receiver。当前版本只检查收到的广播类型，没有继续执行其他操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 在分析的版本中，停用它不会产生可见影响，因为它不会重启追踪或执行其他任务。

en.description: When Google's activity recognition reports a change in detected movement, the UBM SDK passes that event into its automatic trip-detection flow. Disabling it can stop the SDK from recognizing trips reliably.
en.disableEffect: Automatic trip detection may miss or fail to record trips.

zh-CN.description: Google 活动识别服务报告检测到的活动变化时，UBM 会把事件交给自动行程识别流程。停用后，SDK 可能无法可靠识别行程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 自动行程识别可能漏掉行程或无法记录行程。

en.description: When Google reports that the phone crossed a monitored location boundary, the UBM SDK passes the geofence event into its tracking flow. Disabling it can stop location-based trip or place-change tracking.
en.disableEffect: UBM may stop responding to monitored location boundaries and may miss related trip events.

zh-CN.description: Google 报告手机进入或离开受监测区域时，UBM 会把地理围栏事件交给追踪流程。停用后，基于位置的行程或地点变化追踪可能停止。
zh-CN.disableEffect: UBM 可能不再响应受监测区域的进出事件，并漏掉相关行程事件。

en.description: When UBM starts or resumes automatic trip detection, this foreground Service collects location and motion readings for trip records. It can keep recording while the app is in the background.
en.disableEffect: Automatic trip detection and new trip records stop, so UBM trip-history screens may stay empty or out of date.

zh-CN.description: 当 UBM 开始或恢复自动行程检测时，此前台 Service 会采集定位和动作数据，用于生成行程记录。应用在后台时，它也可以继续记录。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，自动行程检测和新行程记录会停止，UBM 行程历史可能为空或不再更新。

en.description: When a scheduled UBM alarm fires, this Receiver checks the saved tracking state and restarts or schedules the trip detector. It helps the SDK resume background trip monitoring.
en.disableEffect: UBM may not resume background detection, leaving later driving trips unrecorded.

zh-CN.description: 收到 UBM 预定的提醒后，此 Receiver 会检查已保存的追踪状态，并重新启动或安排行程检测，帮助 SDK 恢复后台行程监测。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，UBM 可能无法恢复后台检测，之后的驾驶行程可能不会被记录。

en.description: Opened when UBM guides a user through location and battery-use settings, this Activity explains the system access needed for automatic trip tracking.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot complete UBM's guided setup for location and background tracking, so automatic trip recording may not start.

zh-CN.description: 当 UBM 引导用户设置定位和后台耗电权限时，会打开此 Activity。页面分步说明启用自动行程追踪所需的系统设置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法完成 UBM 的定位和后台追踪引导，自动行程记录可能无法启动。

en.description: When UBM sets up location tracking, this Activity requests location and background-location access and guides the user through location and battery settings. Disabling it can prevent the setup from completing.
en.disableEffect: Users may be unable to grant the background access UBM needs, so automatic trip recording may not start.

zh-CN.description: UBM 设置位置追踪时，此 Activity 会申请定位和后台定位权限，并引导用户调整定位与电池设置。停用后，设置流程可能无法完成。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户可能无法授予 UBM 所需的后台权限，导致自动行程记录无法启动。

en.description: Opened when a user selects a saved UBM trip, this Activity displays the trip route, map, and driving details.
en.disableEffect: The selected trip's route and detailed driving report are no longer available.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择一条已保存的 UBM 行程后，会打开此 Activity，查看路线、地图和驾驶详情。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法查看所选行程的路线和详细驾驶报告。

en.description: Opened from UBM trip history, this Activity shows dated trip records and summary statistics, and lets a user upload an unfinished trip.
en.disableEffect: Users lose the UBM trip-history list and summary view, and cannot review or upload unfinished trips from this screen.

zh-CN.description: 从 UBM 行程历史进入后，此 Activity 会按日期显示行程记录和统计信息，并可上传尚未完成的行程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法查看 UBM 行程列表和统计信息，也无法从此页面检查或上传未完成的行程。

en.description: Opened for UBM's background-use whitelist guidance, this Activity displays the SDK's settings page and lets users check or change automatic detection settings. It can take users to relevant Android settings.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open UBM's tracking setup page or change automatic detection there, which can make background trip collection harder to enable.

zh-CN.description: 打开 UBM 后台运行白名单引导时，此 Activity 会显示 SDK 设置页面，允许用户查看或更改自动检测状态，并可跳转到相关 Android 设置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法打开 UBM 追踪设置页或在其中更改自动检测，后台行程采集会更难启用。

en.description: The Haodanku BianXian monetization SDK starts this provider with the app and uses it to save or retrieve its own user and Android device identifiers. Its shopping pages read these values from app-local storage when needed.
en.disableEffect: BianXian can no longer retrieve its saved user and device identifiers for attribution; other app screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: 好单库 BianXian 变现 SDK 会在应用启动时启用此数据提供程序，用来保存或读取 SDK 自己的用户标识和 Android 设备标识。SDK 的购物页面需要这些值时，会从应用本地存储中读取。
zh-CN.disableEffect: BianXian 将无法读取已保存的用户和设备标识，相关归因会停止；应用的其他页面仍可使用。

en.description: When the app opens a Haodanku BianXian shopping page, this screen builds its tabs from page data supplied by the SDK and loads each tab inside an embedded browser. BianXian uses it as its in-app shopping and service hub.
en.disableEffect: BianXian's shopping and service pages will not open, while the host app's other screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开好单库 BianXian 购物页面时，此界面会根据 SDK 提供的页面数据生成标签，并在内置浏览器中加载各个页面。BianXian 用它展示应用内的购物和服务入口。
zh-CN.disableEffect: BianXian 的购物和服务页面将无法打开，宿主应用的其他页面仍可使用。

en.description: When Haodanku's BianXian SDK opens a single shopping or service page, this screen loads the supplied web address inside the app. The page type controls whether an in-app back button is shown.
en.disableEffect: BianXian's selected shopping or service page will not open; the rest of the host app remains available.

zh-CN.description: 好单库 BianXian SDK 打开单个购物或服务页面时，此界面会在应用内加载提供的网址。页面类型会决定是否显示返回按钮。
zh-CN.disableEffect: BianXian 选中的购物或服务页面将无法打开；宿主应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: When the app opens a Haodanku BianXian shopping page, this screen builds its tabs from page data supplied by the SDK and loads each tab inside an embedded browser. BianXian uses it as its in-app shopping and service hub.
en.disableEffect: BianXian's shopping and service pages will not open, while the host app's other screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开好单库 BianXian 购物页面时，此界面会根据 SDK 提供的页面数据生成标签，并在内置浏览器中加载各个页面。BianXian 用它展示应用内的购物和服务入口。
zh-CN.disableEffect: BianXian 的购物和服务页面将无法打开，宿主应用的其他页面仍可使用。

en.description: When Haodanku's BianXian SDK opens a single shopping or service page, this screen loads the supplied web address inside the app. The page type controls whether an in-app back button is shown.
en.disableEffect: BianXian's selected shopping or service page will not open; the rest of the host app remains available.

zh-CN.description: 好单库 BianXian SDK 打开单个购物或服务页面时，此界面会在应用内加载提供的网址。页面类型会决定是否显示返回按钮。
zh-CN.disableEffect: BianXian 选中的购物或服务页面将无法打开；宿主应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: When a selected photo is sent for cropping, Haolin Image Picker shows a crop frame and saves the edited image back into the selection.
en.disableEffect: Photo cropping in Haolin Image Picker will no longer work.

zh-CN.description: 在 Haolin 图片选择器中裁剪照片时，此界面会显示裁剪框，并将编辑后的图片保存回所选照片列表。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Haolin 图片选择器将无法裁剪照片。

en.description: When the app opens Haolin Image Picker, this screen lists photo folders and images on the device for selection, then opens the preview or cropping steps.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot select device photos through Haolin Image Picker.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开 Haolin 图片选择器时，此界面会列出设备上的照片文件夹和图片供用户选择，并可继续预览或裁剪。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 Haolin 图片选择器选择设备中的照片。

en.description: In Haolin Image Picker, this screen previews selected photos one at a time, lets users adjust the selection and original-size option, and returns the final list to the app.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot preview or adjust selected photos in this picker screen.

zh-CN.description: 在 Haolin 图片选择器中，此界面会逐张预览已选照片，允许用户调整选择和原图选项，并将最终列表交回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在此界面预览或调整已选照片。

en.description: When the app requests full-screen viewing of images, Haolin Image Picker shows a swipeable photo viewer with a counter for the current image.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot open this full-screen photo viewer.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求全屏查看图片时，Haolin 图片选择器会打开可左右滑动的照片查看界面，并显示当前图片序号。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法打开此全屏照片查看界面。

en.description: When Android reports a connectivity change, Haolin Network Monitoring checks whether the device is on Wi-Fi, mobile data, or offline and notifies the app’s registered listeners.
en.disableEffect: Apps that rely on these updates may not react correctly when the network changes or disconnects.

zh-CN.description: Android 通知网络状态变化时，Haolin 网络监测库会判断设备当前使用 Wi-Fi、移动数据还是处于离线状态，并通知应用中已注册的监听方。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖这些通知的应用功能可能无法正确响应网络切换或断开。

en.description: Haolin SwiftDownloader uses this service to hold its download queue, task records, HTTP client, and progress callbacks while file transfers run.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot start or manage downloads through Haolin SwiftDownloader.

zh-CN.description: Haolin SwiftDownloader 使用此服务保存下载队列、任务记录和网络请求状态，并在文件传输时更新进度。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法通过 Haolin SwiftDownloader 启动或管理下载任务。

en.description: When the app requests cancel-all in Haolin SwiftDownloader, this receiver cancels all active and queued download tasks.
en.disableEffect: The app’s cancel-all control cannot cancel Haolin SwiftDownloader tasks.

zh-CN.description: 应用在 Haolin SwiftDownloader 中请求取消全部任务时，此接收器会取消正在进行和排队中的下载。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用的全部取消操作将无法取消 Haolin SwiftDownloader 的任务。

en.description: When the app requests cancellation in Haolin SwiftDownloader, this receiver cancels the current download task.
en.disableEffect: The app’s cancel control cannot cancel the current download.

zh-CN.description: 应用在 Haolin SwiftDownloader 中请求取消任务时，此接收器会取消当前下载。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用的取消操作将无法终止当前下载。

en.description: When the user chooses to open a downloaded file, this receiver checks that the file exists and asks Android to open it with a suitable app.
en.disableEffect: Downloaded files cannot be opened from Haolin SwiftDownloader’s open-file action.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择打开已下载文件时，此接收器会检查文件是否存在，并请求 Android 使用合适的应用打开它。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 Haolin SwiftDownloader 的打开操作查看已下载文件。

en.description: When the app requests resume in Haolin SwiftDownloader, this receiver resumes paused downloads.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot resume paused Haolin SwiftDownloader downloads.

zh-CN.description: 应用在 Haolin SwiftDownloader 中请求继续下载时，此接收器会恢复已暂停的任务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法恢复已暂停的 Haolin SwiftDownloader 下载任务。

en.description: When the app requests stop in Haolin SwiftDownloader, this receiver stops all active downloads.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot stop all active Haolin SwiftDownloader downloads with its stop control.

zh-CN.description: 应用在 Haolin SwiftDownloader 中请求停止任务时，此接收器会停止所有正在进行的下载。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法通过停止操作结束所有正在进行的 Haolin SwiftDownloader 下载。

en.description: IShare (Jiang Junmin) uses this Android file provider to create shareable links for files. It can grant another app temporary access to a file while the user shares it.
en.disableEffect: File sharing that relies on IShare's file access may fail, including handoffs to supported social apps.

zh-CN.description: IShare（Jiang Junmin）通过此 Android 文件 Provider 为文件创建可分享的链接。用户分享文件时，它可以向接收应用临时授权访问。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖 IShare 文件访问能力的分享可能失败，包括向支持的社交应用发送文件。

en.description: IShare for WeChat (Jiang Junmin) handles the return from WeChat after an app-to-app sharing request. It passes the returned request or response to WeChat's library and then closes.
en.disableEffect: WeChat handoffs that return to this app may not complete correctly.

zh-CN.description: IShare 微信分享模块（Jiang Junmin）处理应用间分享流程从微信返回时带回的信息。它将请求或响应交给微信库处理后关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要返回此应用的微信分享流程可能无法正确完成。

en.description: IShare (Jiang Junmin) handles the return from WeChat after an app-to-app sharing request. It passes the returned request or response to WeChat's library and then closes.
en.disableEffect: WeChat handoffs that return to this app may not complete correctly.

zh-CN.description: IShare（Jiang Junmin）处理应用间分享流程从微信返回时带回的信息。它将请求或响应交给微信库处理后关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要返回此应用的微信分享流程可能无法正确完成。

en.description: The HappyFox chat widget (Android port by SureshCS-50) opens an in-app help page when the app requests support. It loads the bundled support interface inside the app.
en.disableEffect: The app’s HappyFox help and support screen will not open.

zh-CN.description: HappyFox 聊天客服组件（SureshCS-50 的 Android 移植版）会在应用请求帮助时打开应用内客服页面，并加载随库提供的客服界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法打开 HappyFox 帮助和客服页面。

en.description: YuzurihaInori's HappyGame SDK uses this screen in its account panel to add a linked game account by name.
en.disableEffect: Players will be unable to add another linked game account from the SDK.

zh-CN.description: YuzurihaInori 的 HappyGame 游戏 SDK 在账号面板中通过此页面按名称添加关联游戏账号。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 玩家将无法通过该 SDK 添加其他关联游戏账号。

en.description: YuzurihaInori's HappyGame SDK shows this prompt when its savings-card link cannot open the companion app; the prompt can open a configured web page.
en.disableEffect: If the companion app is unavailable, the savings-card fallback prompt and its web link will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: 当省钱卡链接无法打开配套应用时，YuzurihaInori 的 HappyGame 游戏 SDK 会显示此提示，并可打开配置的网页。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 配套应用不可用时，省钱卡备用提示及其网页链接将无法打开。

en.description: When the app requests a new sign-in, YuzurihaInori's HappyGame SDK offers phone verification, account-and-password login, or one-tap sign-in through its companion app, with service and privacy terms.
en.disableEffect: Users will be unable to sign in through this SDK, so app services that require its account will be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求新登录时，YuzurihaInori 的 HappyGame 游戏 SDK 提供手机号验证、账号密码登录或通过配套应用一键登录，并展示服务协议和隐私条款。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过该 SDK 登录，依赖其账号的应用服务也将无法使用。

en.description: For a returning YuzurihaInori HappyGame account, this screen checks the saved session and continues to linked-account selection or real-name verification.
en.disableEffect: Returning users may be unable to finish sign-in or reach the required account and identity steps.

zh-CN.description: YuzurihaInori 的 HappyGame 游戏 SDK 处理老用户登录时，会检查已保存的登录状态，并继续进入关联账号选择或实名认证流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 老用户可能无法完成登录，也无法继续进行必要的账号选择或实名认证。

en.description: The YuzurihaInori HappyGame account panel uses this screen to change and save the display name of a linked game account.
en.disableEffect: Players will be unable to rename linked game accounts through the SDK.

zh-CN.description: YuzurihaInori 的 HappyGame 游戏 SDK 账号面板通过此页面修改并保存关联游戏账号的显示名称。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 玩家将无法通过该 SDK 修改关联游戏账号的名称。

en.description: After sign-in, tapping the YuzurihaInori HappyGame SDK's floating account button opens this panel with account, coupon, game-event, gift, and rebate sections.
en.disableEffect: These account and game-service sections will no longer open from the floating button.

zh-CN.description: 登录后点按 YuzurihaInori 的 HappyGame 游戏 SDK 悬浮账号按钮会打开此面板，其中包含账号、优惠券、游戏活动、礼包和返利栏目。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法再通过悬浮按钮打开这些账号和游戏服务栏目。

en.description: YuzurihaInori's HappyGame SDK shows this form when an account needs real-name verification; it submits the player's legal name and identity-card number for verification.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot complete required real-name verification through the SDK, which can block sign-in.

zh-CN.description: 账号需要实名认证时，YuzurihaInori 的 HappyGame 游戏 SDK 会显示此表单，提交玩家的真实姓名和身份证号码进行验证。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法通过该 SDK 完成必要的实名认证，登录可能因此受阻。

en.description: When a player opens an event from the YuzurihaInori HappyGame SDK's event list, this screen loads that event's web page.
en.disableEffect: Players will be unable to open event details from the SDK's event list.

zh-CN.description: 玩家从 YuzurihaInori 的 HappyGame 游戏 SDK 活动列表打开活动时，此页面会加载对应的活动网页。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 玩家将无法从该 SDK 的活动列表打开活动详情。

en.description: After the app starts a game purchase, YuzurihaInori's HappyGame SDK shows the order, coupons, virtual currency, and payment choices, then opens the selected payment route.
en.disableEffect: In-app game orders cannot be completed through this SDK.

zh-CN.description: 应用发起游戏购买后，YuzurihaInori 的 HappyGame 游戏 SDK 会显示订单、优惠券、平台币和支付方式，并打开所选支付渠道。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过该 SDK 完成游戏内订单支付。

en.description: After YuzurihaInori HappyGame sign-in, this screen displays the web page supplied for the post-login pop-up.
en.disableEffect: The post-login page will not open and may interrupt sign-in when the service supplies one.

zh-CN.description: YuzurihaInori 的 HappyGame 游戏 SDK 登录后，如果服务提供弹窗网页，此页面会显示该网页。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 服务提供弹窗网页时，该页面将无法打开，登录流程可能因此中断。

en.description: From the YuzurihaInori HappyGame account panel, this screen asks the player to confirm switching to a linked game account and applies the selected account.
en.disableEffect: Players will be unable to switch linked game accounts through the SDK panel.

zh-CN.description: YuzurihaInori 的 HappyGame 游戏 SDK 账号面板通过此页面确认并切换到选定的关联游戏账号。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 玩家将无法通过该 SDK 面板切换关联游戏账号。

en.description: After primary sign-in, YuzurihaInori's HappyGame SDK lists linked game accounts so the player can choose one, add another, or remove one before continuing.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot choose or manage linked accounts at this step, so sign-in may not continue when an account selection is needed.

zh-CN.description: 主账号登录后，YuzurihaInori 的 HappyGame 游戏 SDK 会列出关联游戏账号，供玩家选择、添加或移除账号后继续。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法在此步骤选择或管理关联账号；需要选择账号时，登录流程可能无法继续。

en.description: Hardik Goswami's oauthLibGithub library opens this screen to sign the user into GitHub. It loads GitHub's authorization page, obtains and saves an access token, then returns to the configured app screen.
en.disableEffect: GitHub sign-in cannot complete, so app features that require that account or token may stop working.

zh-CN.description: Hardik Goswami 的 oauthLibGithub 库会打开此页面，让用户登录 GitHub。它加载 GitHub 授权页面、获取并保存访问令牌，然后返回应用指定页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: GitHub 登录流程将无法完成，依赖该账户或令牌的应用功能可能停止工作。

en.description: HCS Android Call (NetWolf712) starts this service to run Linphone's SIP calling engine. It initializes calling in the background and accepts call-related push starts.
en.disableEffect: Incoming and outgoing VoIP calls and call-related alerts can stop working.

zh-CN.description: HCS Android Call（NetWolf712）会启动此服务运行 Linphone 的 SIP 通话引擎，并在后台初始化通话及处理来电推送。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 来电、拨出网络电话和相关提醒可能无法正常工作。

en.description: HCS Android Common (NetWolf712) listens for storage and USB status events. It logs storage changes and asks the update service to start on a USB accessory attach signal.
en.disableEffect: Update handling that depends on this receiver's storage or USB events may stop working.

zh-CN.description: HCS Android Common（NetWolf712）会监听存储设备和 USB 状态事件，记录存储变化，并在收到 USB 配件连接信号时请求启动更新服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此接收器处理存储或 USB 事件的更新流程可能停止工作。

en.description: When the app opens Healthcare Locator's provider-finder screen, this activity shows the configured main search page or nearby-provider map. It is the entry point for searching for care through the Healthcare Locator client-stack SDK.
en.disableEffect: The app's integrated provider search and nearby-care screen will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开 Healthcare Locator 的服务机构查找界面时，此界面会根据配置显示主搜索页或附近机构地图。它是通过 Healthcare Locator 客户端 SDK 查找医疗服务的入口。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用集成的服务机构搜索和附近医疗服务页面将无法打开。

en.description: Healthcare Locator opens this activity when it needs a location-permission result for nearby search. It requests GPS access and reports whether access was granted to the SDK.
en.disableEffect: Nearby-provider search can no longer receive the location-permission result from this flow.

zh-CN.description: Healthcare Locator 在附近搜索需要位置权限结果时会打开此界面。它会请求 GPS 访问权限，并将用户是否授予权限告知 SDK。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 附近服务机构搜索将无法通过此流程获得位置权限结果。

en.description: At app startup, Heap Analytics' Android client registers for screen and app lifecycle changes and tracks activity, fragment, and foreground or background transitions. This provider prepares the SDK's automatic usage analytics.
en.disableEffect: Heap's automatic screen and app lifecycle tracking will stop, while the app's own screens continue to work.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，Heap Analytics Android 客户端会注册界面和应用生命周期变化，并跟踪页面、片段以及前台或后台状态切换。此提供程序负责启用 SDK 的自动使用情况分析。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Heap 的自动页面和应用生命周期跟踪将停止，应用自身页面仍可正常使用。

en.description: When the host app opens the Heartland Android SDK's card-entry screen, it displays a card form and passes the entry to the SDK's tokenization flow. The screen shows the resulting token or an error.
en.disableEffect: Any app payment flow that opens this card-entry and tokenization screen will be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: 宿主应用打开 Heartland Android SDK 的银行卡输入界面时，此界面会显示卡片表单并将输入内容交给 SDK 进行令牌化。界面会显示生成的令牌或错误信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此银行卡输入和令牌化界面的支付流程将无法使用。

en.description: HeePay's payment SDK opens this cashier page for a payment request, then checks the payment result and returns it to the calling game.
en.disableEffect: HeePay payments requested through the Qihoo 360 game channel will fail or lose their result callback.

zh-CN.description: 收到支付请求时，汇付宝支付 SDK 会打开收银页面，随后查询支付结果并返回给调用游戏。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过奇虎 360 游戏渠道发起的汇付宝支付将失败，或无法返回结果。

en.description: The HelpCrunch chat SDK receives Firebase notifications through this service. When Firebase delivers a HelpCrunch message or refreshes the registration token, the service passes the message to HelpCrunch and updates notification registration.
en.disableEffect: HelpCrunch push messages will no longer be handled or have their registration refreshed; the app's other screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: HelpCrunch 客服聊天 SDK 通过此服务接收 Firebase 通知。Firebase 送达 HelpCrunch 消息或更新注册令牌时，此服务会将消息交给 HelpCrunch 处理并更新通知注册信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: HelpCrunch 推送消息将不再由此服务处理或刷新注册；应用的其他页面仍可使用。

en.description: When a user replies from a HelpCrunch message notification, this receiver reads the reply and sends it to the selected conversation.
en.disableEffect: Quick replies from HelpCrunch notifications will stop; users can still open the in-app chat.

zh-CN.description: 用户从 HelpCrunch 消息通知中回复时，此接收器会读取回复内容并发送到对应会话。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法直接从 HelpCrunch 通知中快速回复，但仍可打开应用内聊天。

en.description: When HelpCrunch starts this service for a notification reply, it reads the inline reply text and sends it to the conversation.
en.disableEffect: Replies entered from HelpCrunch notifications will stop sending; users can still open the in-app chat.

zh-CN.description: HelpCrunch 为通知回复启动此服务时，它会读取通知中的回复文字并发送到对应会话。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 从 HelpCrunch 通知输入的回复将无法发送；用户仍可打开应用内聊天。

en.description: HelpCrunch's provider runs automatically at app startup and initializes the chat SDK with the host app context. This prepares the support chat and related HelpCrunch features for use.
en.disableEffect: The app will lose HelpCrunch's automatic startup initialization, so its support chat and related features may not start.

zh-CN.description: HelpCrunch 提供程序会在应用启动时自动运行，并使用宿主应用上下文初始化聊天 SDK，为使用客服聊天和相关功能做准备。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将失去 HelpCrunch 的自动启动初始化，客服聊天及相关功能可能无法启动。

en.description: When Firebase refreshes its registration token, HelpCrunch's service sends the new token to the SDK's notification registration flow.
en.disableEffect: HelpCrunch push registration will no longer refresh, so support notifications may stop arriving.

zh-CN.description: Firebase 更新注册令牌时，HelpCrunch 服务会将新令牌发送到 SDK 的通知注册流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: HelpCrunch 推送注册将无法刷新，客服通知可能不再送达。

en.description: When Firebase delivers a HelpCrunch message, this service recognizes the message payload and hands it to HelpCrunch's notification handler. It also forwards refreshed registration tokens.
en.disableEffect: HelpCrunch push messages will no longer be processed by this service, while the app's other features remain available.

zh-CN.description: Firebase 送达 HelpCrunch 消息时，此服务会识别消息内容并交给 HelpCrunch 通知处理程序。它也会转交更新后的注册令牌。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 此服务将不再处理 HelpCrunch 推送消息，应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: When the HelpCrunch chat opens its attachment picker, this screen lets users choose documents, photos, or other media and returns the selection to the conversation.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to select files or media to attach to HelpCrunch messages.

zh-CN.description: HelpCrunch 聊天打开附件选择器时，此界面允许用户选择文档、照片或其他媒体，并将所选内容交回会话。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法选择文件或媒体并附加到 HelpCrunch 消息中。

en.description: When a user opens a media folder in HelpCrunch's picker, this screen reads photos and videos from the device and displays items to select for an attachment.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to browse and select photos or videos from this HelpCrunch screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 HelpCrunch 选择器中打开媒体文件夹时，此界面会读取设备中的照片和视频，并显示可作为附件选择的项目。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此 HelpCrunch 界面浏览和选择照片或视频。

en.description: HelpCrunch's file-sharing provider creates shareable links to local files selected for chat attachments. Android uses it when the SDK opens or shares those files.
en.disableEffect: HelpCrunch cannot share selected attachment files through this provider, so file-sharing and attachment flows may fail.

zh-CN.description: HelpCrunch 文件共享提供程序会为聊天附件中选取的本地文件创建可共享链接。SDK 打开或分享这些文件时，Android 会使用此提供程序。
zh-CN.disableEffect: HelpCrunch 将无法通过此提供程序共享选中的附件文件，文件共享和附件流程可能失败。

en.description: When a user opens an image attachment in HelpCrunch chat, this screen loads its address into an image viewer and offers a share option.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to view or share image attachments in this HelpCrunch screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 HelpCrunch 聊天中打开图片附件时，此界面会在图片查看器中加载图片，并提供分享选项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此 HelpCrunch 界面查看或分享图片附件。

en.description: When the app opens its HelpCrunch support chat, this activity creates the conversation screen and loads the chat content supplied by the SDK.
en.disableEffect: The app's HelpCrunch support conversation screen will not open.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开 HelpCrunch 客服聊天时，此界面会创建会话页面并加载 SDK 提供的聊天内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用的 HelpCrunch 客服会话页面将无法打开。

en.description: When a user opens an image attached to an older HelpCrunch conversation, this screen loads the message's attachment or preview image into an image viewer.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to view image attachments through this HelpCrunch screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开旧版 HelpCrunch 会话中的图片附件时，此界面会在图片查看器中加载消息附件或预览图片。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此 HelpCrunch 界面查看图片附件。

en.description: When a user opens a text message attachment in the older HelpCrunch SDK, this screen displays its text and linked images. Users can open web links from the text.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to read or open links from text attachments in this HelpCrunch screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户在旧版 HelpCrunch SDK 中打开文本消息附件时，此界面会显示文本和其中的图片，并允许用户打开网页链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此 HelpCrunch 界面阅读文本附件或打开其中的链接。

en.description: When the app opens a HelpCrunch conversation in the older SDK, this activity displays the chat screen and loads the conversation data provided by the app.
en.disableEffect: The app's older HelpCrunch conversation screen will not open.

zh-CN.description: 应用通过旧版 SDK 打开 HelpCrunch 会话时，此界面会显示聊天页面并加载应用提供的会话数据。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用的旧版 HelpCrunch 会话页面将无法打开。

en.description: When a user opens a web attachment in the older HelpCrunch SDK, this screen loads its address in an in-app browser with zoom controls.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to open HelpCrunch web attachments in the in-app browser.

zh-CN.description: 用户在旧版 HelpCrunch SDK 中打开网页附件时，此界面会在应用内浏览器中加载网址并提供缩放控制。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在应用内浏览器中打开 HelpCrunch 网页附件。

en.description: When a user opens HelpCrunch's knowledge base, this screen displays the selected category, section, or article. The SDK can open an article directly from its identifier.
en.disableEffect: The app's HelpCrunch knowledge-base categories and articles will not open.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 HelpCrunch 知识库时，此界面会显示选定的分类、栏目或文章。SDK 可根据文章编号直接打开对应内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用中的 HelpCrunch 知识库分类和文章将无法打开。

en.description: When the app opens HelpCrunch, this activity displays the main support-chat interface and can switch between conversations and knowledge-base content.
en.disableEffect: The app's main HelpCrunch chat and knowledge-base screen will not open.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开 HelpCrunch 时，此界面会显示客服聊天主页面，并可在会话和知识库内容之间切换。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用的 HelpCrunch 聊天和知识库主界面将无法打开。

en.description: When a user opens an image attachment in HelpCrunch chat, this screen loads its address into an image viewer and offers a share option.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to view or share image attachments in this HelpCrunch screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 HelpCrunch 聊天中打开图片附件时，此界面会在图片查看器中加载图片，并提供分享选项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此 HelpCrunch 界面查看或分享图片附件。

en.description: When a user opens a video attachment in HelpCrunch chat, this screen plays it in the app and offers controls to save or share the video.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to play or share video attachments through this HelpCrunch screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 HelpCrunch 聊天中打开视频附件时，此界面会在应用内播放视频，并提供保存或分享控制。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此 HelpCrunch 界面播放或分享视频附件。

en.description: When a user opens web content or a supported video link from HelpCrunch, this screen checks the content type and displays it in an embedded browser.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to preview this web content or supported video links inside HelpCrunch.

zh-CN.description: 用户从 HelpCrunch 打开网页内容或受支持的视频链接时，此界面会识别内容类型并在内置浏览器中显示。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在 HelpCrunch 内预览此类网页内容或受支持的视频链接。

en.description: When HelpCrunch audio playback is requested, this service creates a media player and session so audio messages can play with Android's media controls.
en.disableEffect: HelpCrunch audio messages will no longer play through the app's media session.

zh-CN.description: HelpCrunch 请求播放音频时，此服务会创建播放器和媒体会话，使音频消息能够通过 Android 媒体控制播放。
zh-CN.disableEffect: HelpCrunch 音频消息将无法通过应用的媒体会话播放。

en.description: When the older HelpCrunch SDK queues a file download, this service fetches the supplied address, saves the file in app storage, and reports when the download finishes.
en.disableEffect: HelpCrunch will not be able to download files through this service, so attachment downloads may fail.

zh-CN.description: 旧版 HelpCrunch SDK 将文件加入下载队列时，此服务会获取指定网址、将文件保存到应用存储中，并报告下载完成状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: HelpCrunch 将无法通过此服务下载文件，附件下载可能失败。

en.description: When HelpCrunch schedules an attachment download, this worker fetches the file address, saves the file in app storage, and reports completion to the chat SDK.
en.disableEffect: HelpCrunch attachment downloads handled by this worker will stop working.

zh-CN.description: HelpCrunch 安排下载附件时，此工作程序会获取文件地址、将文件保存到应用存储中，并向聊天 SDK 报告完成状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 由此工作程序处理的 HelpCrunch 附件下载将无法使用。

en.description: HelpCrunch's file-sharing provider creates shareable links to local files selected for chat attachments. Android uses it when the SDK opens or shares those files.
en.disableEffect: HelpCrunch cannot share selected attachment files through this provider, so file-sharing and attachment flows may fail.

zh-CN.description: HelpCrunch 文件共享提供程序会为聊天附件中选取的本地文件创建可共享链接。SDK 打开或分享这些文件时，Android 会使用此提供程序。
zh-CN.disableEffect: HelpCrunch 将无法通过此提供程序共享选中的附件文件，文件共享和附件流程可能失败。

en.description: When the older HelpCrunch SDK queues a file attachment, this service passes its local path to the upload worker and reports the upload result.
en.disableEffect: HelpCrunch will not be able to upload file attachments through this service.

zh-CN.description: 旧版 HelpCrunch SDK 将文件附件加入上传队列时，此服务会把本地文件路径交给上传工作程序并报告上传结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: HelpCrunch 将无法通过此服务上传文件附件。

en.description: When UtilsX starts its message service, it relays messages between the app’s processes and sends them to registered parts of the app.
en.disableEffect: App features that depend on messages between its processes may stop updating or responding.

zh-CN.description: UtilsX 启动消息服务后，此服务会在应用的不同进程之间转发消息，并发送给应用中已登记接收消息的部分。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖应用进程间消息的功能可能无法继续更新或响应。

en.description: When UtilsX requests a runtime permission or special access such as overlay or file access, this transparent Activity opens the Android prompt or settings page and returns the result.
en.disableEffect: Permission requests through UtilsX cannot complete, which can stop features that need those permissions.

zh-CN.description: UtilsX 请求运行时权限或悬浮窗、文件访问等特殊权限时，此透明 Activity 会打开 Android 权限提示或设置页面，并将结果返回。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过 UtilsX 发起的权限请求将无法完成，依赖这些权限的功能也可能停止。

en.description: UtilsX uses this FileProvider to make app files available through shareable content links; creating it also initializes the UtilsX library.
en.disableEffect: File sharing through this provider and UtilsX startup initialization can fail.

zh-CN.description: UtilsX 使用此文件提供程序通过可分享的内容链接提供应用文件；创建它时也会初始化 UtilsX 库。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过此提供程序分享文件以及 UtilsX 的启动初始化都可能失败。

en.description: When the app opens a Helppier onboarding tour with a list of image steps, this screen displays the steps with previous, next, skip, and end controls.
en.disableEffect: The app's Helppier onboarding tour will not open.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开带有图片步骤的 Helppier 新手引导时，此界面会展示各个步骤，并提供上一步、下一步、跳过和结束控制。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用中的 Helppier 新手引导将无法打开。

en.description: Help Scout Beacon opens this screen when a user selects a help article. It loads and displays the selected article.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open Beacon help articles from the in-app support experience.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Help Scout Beacon 中选择帮助文章时会打开此界面。它会加载并显示所选文章。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在应用内的 Beacon 客服界面中打开帮助文章。

en.description: Help Scout Beacon uses this Activity as the entry to its in-app help and contact experience. It opens the help, search, chat, or other support screen requested by the host app.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open Help Scout Beacon’s in-app help or contact-support experience from the host app.

zh-CN.description: Help Scout Beacon 使用此 Activity 作为应用内帮助和联系客服功能的入口，并打开宿主应用请求的帮助、搜索、聊天或其他客服页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法从宿主应用打开 Help Scout Beacon 的应用内帮助或联系客服界面。

en.description: Help Scout Beacon opens this screen when its support interface asks the user to attach a file. It launches Android’s document picker and returns the selected files to Beacon.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot select files to attach to Beacon support messages or requests.

zh-CN.description: Help Scout Beacon 的客服界面请求添加附件时会打开此界面。它会启动 Android 文档选择器，并把所选文件交回 Beacon。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法为 Beacon 客服消息或请求选择附件。

en.description: Help Scout Beacon uses this provider to create temporary Android links for attachment files, so Beacon can hand a file to another app for viewing.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it can break opening Beacon attachments in another app.

zh-CN.description: Help Scout Beacon 使用此 Provider 为附件创建临时 Android 链接，以便将附件交给其他应用打开。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Beacon 附件可能无法交由其他应用打开。

en.description: Firebase delivers Help Scout Beacon messages to this service. It processes Beacon notifications and forwards refreshed Firebase messaging tokens to Beacon.
en.disableEffect: Beacon support push notifications and token updates stop; the host app’s other features continue.

zh-CN.description: Firebase 会将 Help Scout Beacon 消息交给此 Service。它处理 Beacon 通知，并将更新后的 Firebase 消息令牌传给 Beacon。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后 Beacon 推送通知和令牌更新会停止，宿主应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: Help Scout Beacon’s initialization provider runs when Android starts the host app and prepares Beacon using the app’s configuration. Beacon’s support screens depend on this setup unless the app initializes Beacon separately.
en.disableEffect: Without it, Beacon may remain uninitialized, and opening the in-app help experience can fail.

zh-CN.description: Help Scout Beacon 的初始化 Provider 会在 Android 启动宿主应用时按应用配置准备 Beacon。除非应用另行初始化 Beacon，其客服界面依赖这一步。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后 Beacon 可能无法完成初始化，打开应用内的帮助或客服界面时可能失败。

en.description: Help Scout Beacon opens this screen for a live support chat, where users read and send messages and can attach files.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot use live support chat in Beacon.

zh-CN.description: Help Scout Beacon 会在用户开始实时客服聊天时打开此界面，用户可在其中阅读和发送消息，也可添加附件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法使用 Beacon 实时客服聊天。

en.description: When a user replies from a Help Scout Beacon chat notification, this receiver forwards the reply to the chat.
en.disableEffect: Replies sent from Beacon chat notifications will no longer be delivered; users can still reply after opening Beacon.

zh-CN.description: 用户从 Help Scout Beacon 聊天通知中回复时，此 Receiver 会把回复发送到聊天中。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法再从 Beacon 聊天通知直接回复，但仍可打开 Beacon 后发送消息。

en.description: Help Scout Beacon opens this screen when a user replies to an existing support conversation. It accepts a reply and optional attachments.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot send replies to existing support conversations through Beacon.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Help Scout Beacon 中回复已有客服会话时会打开此界面，可填写回复并添加附件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 Beacon 回复已有客服会话。

en.description: Help Scout Beacon opens this screen to show a selected support conversation and its message history.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot view or continue that support conversation in Beacon.

zh-CN.description: Help Scout Beacon 会打开此界面，显示用户选中的客服会话及其消息记录。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在 Beacon 中查看或继续该客服会话。

en.description: When a user replies from a Help Scout Beacon conversation notification, this receiver sends the reply to that support conversation.
en.disableEffect: Replies sent from Beacon conversation notifications will no longer be delivered; users can still reply after opening Beacon.

zh-CN.description: 用户从 Help Scout Beacon 会话通知中回复时，此 Receiver 会把回复发送到对应客服会话。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法再从 Beacon 会话通知直接回复，但仍可打开 Beacon 后发送消息。

en.description: Help Scout Beacon opens this screen to list a user’s earlier support conversations; selecting one opens its message thread.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot browse their previous Beacon support conversations.

zh-CN.description: Help Scout Beacon 会在此界面列出用户之前的客服会话，点选会话后可查看消息记录。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法浏览之前的 Beacon 客服会话。

en.description: Help Scout Beacon opens this screen when the host app requests a specific support destination, such as an article or chat, and routes the request to the matching Beacon screen.
en.disableEffect: Direct links from the host app to selected Beacon support screens will stop working.

zh-CN.description: 宿主应用请求打开特定客服内容（例如文章或聊天）时，Help Scout Beacon 会打开此界面并转到对应页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 宿主应用指向特定 Beacon 客服页面的直接入口将无法使用。

en.description: Help Scout Beacon opens this screen when a user taps an image attachment in a chat. It displays the image and offers a download option.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from viewing or downloading chat images in Beacon’s full-screen viewer.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Help Scout Beacon 聊天中点按图片附件时会打开此界面。它会显示图片，并提供下载选项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法在 Beacon 的全屏查看器中查看或下载聊天图片。

en.description: Help Scout Beacon opens this screen as its main help center, where users can search help articles and reach support options.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open Beacon’s main help screen to search for help or contact support.

zh-CN.description: Help Scout Beacon 会在此界面显示主帮助中心，用户可搜索帮助文章并进入客服入口。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开 Beacon 主帮助界面来搜索帮助或联系客服。

en.description: When a user selects the read action on a Help Scout Beacon notification, this receiver removes that notification from the notification shade.
en.disableEffect: The Beacon notification action will no longer clear the alert; users can dismiss it manually.

zh-CN.description: 用户点按 Help Scout Beacon 通知中的已读操作时，此 Receiver 会从通知栏移除该通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Beacon 通知中的该操作将不再清除提醒，用户仍可手动关闭通知。

en.description: Help Scout Beacon opens this form when a user starts a new support request. It collects the message and any allowed attachments before submission.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot send a new support request through Beacon.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Help Scout Beacon 中创建新的客服请求时会打开此表单，用于填写消息并添加允许的附件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 Beacon 发送新的客服请求。

en.description: Helpshift’s Android customer-support SDK opens this Activity when the app starts a support conversation. It shows a new request or an existing message thread so users can contact support and read replies.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open the in-app Helpshift conversation, so they cannot send a support request or read replies through it.

zh-CN.description: 当应用打开 Helpshift 客户支持对话时，Helpshift Android 客户支持 SDK 会启动此 Activity。它显示新的支持请求或已有的消息对话，供用户联系支持团队并查看回复。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法打开应用内的 Helpshift 对话，也无法通过该入口发送支持请求或查看回复。

en.description: Helpshift’s Android customer-support SDK opens this Activity when the app presents its Help Center. Users can browse FAQs here and move into the app’s support pages.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open the Helpshift Help Center, browse its FAQs, or enter support through this screen.

zh-CN.description: 当应用展示 Helpshift 帮助中心时，Helpshift Android 客户支持 SDK 会打开此 Activity。用户可在其中浏览常见问题并进入应用的支持页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过此页面打开 Helpshift 帮助中心、浏览常见问题或进入支持流程。

en.description: When a user selects a Helpshift help article from a section, FAQ list, or search result, this Activity displays the answer and related support options.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open Helpshift help articles or use the support options shown with them.

zh-CN.description: 当用户从 Helpshift 分类、常见问题列表或搜索结果中选择文章时，此 Activity 会显示答案和相关支持选项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法打开 Helpshift 帮助文章或使用文章中的支持选项。

en.description: When users browse a Helpshift Help Center category, this Activity presents its FAQ groups in swipeable tabs and loads the articles in each group.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot browse Helpshift FAQ groups or open their articles through this screen.

zh-CN.description: 当用户浏览 Helpshift 帮助中心的某个分类时，此 Activity 会用可滑动的标签页展示其中的问题分组和文章。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过此页面浏览 Helpshift 常见问题分组或打开其中的文章。

en.description: The Helpshift Android customer-support SDK starts this Service to resend support messages and related requests that failed earlier, then stops it after the retry attempt.
en.disableEffect: Failed Helpshift messages and requests are no longer retried automatically, so a user’s support request may not reach the support team.

zh-CN.description: Helpshift Android 客户支持 SDK 会启动此 Service，重新发送先前发送失败的支持消息和相关请求；重试后 Service 会停止。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，发送失败的 Helpshift 消息和请求不会自动重试，用户的支持请求可能无法送达支持团队。

en.description: The Helpshift Android customer-support SDK opens this dialog when its optional app-rating prompt is due or the app requests one. Users can rate the app, dismiss the prompt, or choose feedback to enter support.
en.disableEffect: Users lose the in-app Helpshift rating and feedback prompt, and the prompt may fail to open when the SDK tries to show it.

zh-CN.description: 当应用请求评分提示或 Helpshift 的可选评分提示到期时，SDK 会显示此对话框。用户可以为应用评分、关闭提示，或选择反馈并进入支持流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法使用 Helpshift 的评分和反馈提示，而且 SDK 尝试显示提示时可能无法打开该页面。

en.description: When users open a section in the Helpshift Help Center, this Activity shows the section’s article list and opens selected answers.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot browse Helpshift FAQ sections or open their articles through this screen.

zh-CN.description: 当用户打开 Helpshift 帮助中心的某个分类时，此 Activity 会显示该分类的文章列表，并打开用户选中的答案。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过此页面浏览 Helpshift 常见问题分类或打开其中的文章。

en.description: When started by the Helpshift Android customer-support SDK, this Service checks for conversation notification updates while the app is in the foreground and refreshes the SDK’s in-app notification state.
en.disableEffect: New Helpshift message notifications and unread counts stop refreshing while the app is open; the app’s other screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: Helpshift Android 客户支持 SDK 启动此 Service 后，它会在应用处于前台时检查对话通知更新，并刷新 SDK 的应用内通知状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用打开时新的 Helpshift 消息通知和未读数将不再刷新；应用的其他页面仍可使用。
