en.description: When Android broadcasts a network connectivity change, this receiver checks whether a network is available and starts Helpshift’s retry Service for pending support messages and requests.
en.disableEffect: Pending Helpshift messages and requests may remain unsent after the connection returns, delaying the user’s support conversation.

zh-CN.description: Android 广播网络连接状态变化时，此接收器会检查网络是否可用，并启动 Helpshift 重试服务来处理尚未送达的支持消息和请求。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，网络恢复时待发送的 Helpshift 消息和请求可能仍无法送达，用户的支持对话会受到影响。

en.description: When users add or change a screenshot in a Helpshift support request or conversation, this Activity previews the image and lets them choose another picture before sending.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot choose or preview screenshots for Helpshift support messages.

zh-CN.description: 当用户在 Helpshift 支持请求或对话中添加或更换截图时，此 Activity 会预览图片，并允许用户在发送前重新选择。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法为 Helpshift 支持消息选择或预览截图。

en.description: While a user writes a new Helpshift support request, the SDK searches its saved FAQs and opens this Activity with matching articles. The user can read a suggestion or continue sending the request.
en.disableEffect: Users lose the article suggestions, and the Helpshift request flow can fail when it tries to open this screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户填写新的 Helpshift 支持请求时，SDK 会搜索已保存的常见问题，并通过此 Activity 显示匹配文章。用户可以先查看建议文章，也可以继续发送请求。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法看到文章建议，而且 Helpshift 尝试打开此页面时，支持请求流程可能失败。

en.description: When a user taps the Helpshift debug notification, this Helpshift SDK X Activity reads local diagnostic logs and opens an email composer addressed to Helpshift support.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot export Helpshift diagnostic logs from the SDK notification; regular app features remain available.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击 Helpshift 调试通知时，此 Helpshift SDK X Activity 会读取本地诊断日志，并打开收件人为 Helpshift 支持团队的邮件编辑器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过 SDK 通知导出 Helpshift 诊断日志；应用的常规功能仍可使用。

en.description: Helpshift SDK X opens this Activity when the app asks it to show web chat or the Help Center. It hosts that support screen and handles navigation between help articles and conversations.
en.disableEffect: Helpshift chat, FAQs, individual help articles, and support conversations opened through SDK X are unavailable.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求显示网页聊天或帮助中心时，Helpshift SDK X 会打开此 Activity。它承载相应的支持页面，并处理帮助文章与对话之间的导航。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，通过 Helpshift SDK X 打开的聊天、常见问题、单篇帮助文章和支持对话都无法使用。

en.description: When a user taps a Helpshift campaign notification, this Activity clears the alert and opens the campaign inbox or performs the action attached to the message.
en.disableEffect: Tapping a Helpshift campaign notification no longer opens its inbox or linked content; the app’s other screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击 Helpshift 活动通知时，此 Activity 会清除通知，并打开活动收件箱或执行通知关联的操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，点击 Helpshift 活动通知将无法打开收件箱或关联内容；应用的其他页面仍可使用。

en.description: When the app opens the Helpshift campaign inbox, this Activity displays campaign messages and handles navigation through that inbox.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open the Helpshift campaign inbox; the app’s regular support and other screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开 Helpshift 活动收件箱时，此 Activity 会显示活动消息并处理收件箱中的页面导航。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法打开 Helpshift 活动收件箱；应用的常规支持页面和其他页面仍可使用。

en.description: When a Helpshift campaign notification is handled while the app is in the background, this Service clears the notification and records the interaction for the campaign system.
en.disableEffect: Background campaign notifications may not be cleared or recorded correctly; the app’s other features remain available.

zh-CN.description: 应用在后台处理 Helpshift 活动通知时，此 Service 会清除通知，并将用户操作记录到活动系统中。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，后台活动通知可能无法正确清除或记录；应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: When the app opens web chat from the early Helpshift SDK X, this Activity checks the network, shows chat when connected, and offers a retry screen when offline.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open this Helpshift support chat or use its connection retry screen.

zh-CN.description: 应用通过早期 Helpshift SDK X 打开网页聊天时，此 Activity 会检查网络；联网时显示聊天，离线时提供重试页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法打开此 Helpshift 支持聊天，也无法使用其网络重试页面。

en.description: When a user taps a proactive Helpshift notification, this Helpshift SDK X Activity clears the alert, records the interaction, and follows the notification’s configured action, such as opening support or the app.
en.disableEffect: Tapping a proactive Helpshift notification no longer opens its configured destination; the app’s other screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击 Helpshift 主动通知时，此 Helpshift SDK X Activity 会清除通知、记录操作，并执行通知设置的动作，例如打开支持页面或应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，点击 Helpshift 主动通知将无法打开其指定页面；应用的其他页面仍可使用。

en.description: When the app starts, Helpshift SDK X uses this provider to track whether the app is open or in the background, which guides the SDK’s notification handling.
en.disableEffect: Helpshift no longer receives automatic app foreground and background updates through this provider, affecting SDK behavior that responds to those changes.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，Helpshift SDK X 会通过此 Provider 跟踪应用处于前台还是后台，以指导 SDK 通知处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Helpshift 无法再通过此 Provider 自动获取应用前台和后台状态变化，依赖这些状态的 SDK 行为会受到影响。

en.description: Helpshift’s Android customer-support SDK opens this Activity when the app starts a support conversation. It shows a new request or an existing message thread so users can contact support and read replies.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open the in-app Helpshift conversation, so they cannot send a support request or read replies through it.

zh-CN.description: 当应用打开 Helpshift 客户支持对话时，Helpshift Android 客户支持 SDK 会启动此 Activity。它显示新的支持请求或已有的消息对话，供用户联系支持团队并查看回复。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法打开应用内的 Helpshift 对话，也无法通过该入口发送支持请求或查看回复。

en.description: Helpshift’s Android customer-support SDK opens this Activity when the app presents its Help Center. Users can browse FAQs here and move into the app’s support pages.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open the Helpshift Help Center, browse its FAQs, or enter support through this screen.

zh-CN.description: 当应用展示 Helpshift 帮助中心时，Helpshift Android 客户支持 SDK 会打开此 Activity。用户可在其中浏览常见问题并进入应用的支持页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过此页面打开 Helpshift 帮助中心、浏览常见问题或进入支持流程。

en.description: When a user selects a Helpshift help article from a section, FAQ list, or search result, this Activity displays the answer and related support options.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open Helpshift help articles or use the support options shown with them.

zh-CN.description: 当用户从 Helpshift 分类、常见问题列表或搜索结果中选择文章时，此 Activity 会显示答案和相关支持选项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法打开 Helpshift 帮助文章或使用文章中的支持选项。

en.description: When users browse a Helpshift Help Center category, this Activity presents its FAQ groups in swipeable tabs and loads the articles in each group.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot browse Helpshift FAQ groups or open their articles through this screen.

zh-CN.description: 当用户浏览 Helpshift 帮助中心的某个分类时，此 Activity 会用可滑动的标签页展示其中的问题分组和文章。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过此页面浏览 Helpshift 常见问题分组或打开其中的文章。

en.description: The Helpshift Android customer-support SDK starts this Service to resend support messages and related requests that failed earlier, then stops it after the retry attempt.
en.disableEffect: Failed Helpshift messages and requests are no longer retried automatically, so a user’s support request may not reach the support team.

zh-CN.description: Helpshift Android 客户支持 SDK 会启动此 Service，重新发送先前发送失败的支持消息和相关请求；重试后 Service 会停止。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，发送失败的 Helpshift 消息和请求不会自动重试，用户的支持请求可能无法送达支持团队。

en.description: The Helpshift Android customer-support SDK opens this dialog when its optional app-rating prompt is due or the app requests one. Users can rate the app, dismiss the prompt, or choose feedback to enter support.
en.disableEffect: Users lose the in-app Helpshift rating and feedback prompt, and the prompt may fail to open when the SDK tries to show it.

zh-CN.description: 当应用请求评分提示或 Helpshift 的可选评分提示到期时，SDK 会显示此对话框。用户可以为应用评分、关闭提示，或选择反馈并进入支持流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法使用 Helpshift 的评分和反馈提示，而且 SDK 尝试显示提示时可能无法打开该页面。

en.description: When users open a section in the Helpshift Help Center, this Activity shows the section’s article list and opens selected answers.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot browse Helpshift FAQ sections or open their articles through this screen.

zh-CN.description: 当用户打开 Helpshift 帮助中心的某个分类时，此 Activity 会显示该分类的文章列表，并打开用户选中的答案。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过此页面浏览 Helpshift 常见问题分类或打开其中的文章。

en.description: When started by the Helpshift Android customer-support SDK, this Service checks for conversation notification updates while the app is in the foreground and refreshes the SDK’s in-app notification state.
en.disableEffect: New Helpshift message notifications and unread counts stop refreshing while the app is open; the app’s other screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: Helpshift Android 客户支持 SDK 启动此 Service 后，它会在应用处于前台时检查对话通知更新，并刷新 SDK 的应用内通知状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用打开时新的 Helpshift 消息通知和未读数将不再刷新；应用的其他页面仍可使用。

en.description: When users add or change a screenshot in a Helpshift support request or conversation, this Activity previews the image and lets them choose another picture before sending.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot choose or preview screenshots for Helpshift support messages.

zh-CN.description: 当用户在 Helpshift 支持请求或对话中添加或更换截图时，此 Activity 会预览图片，并允许用户在发送前重新选择。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法为 Helpshift 支持消息选择或预览截图。

en.description: While a user writes a new Helpshift support request, the SDK searches its saved FAQs and opens this Activity with matching articles. The user can read a suggestion or continue sending the request.
en.disableEffect: Users lose the article suggestions, and the Helpshift request flow can fail when it tries to open this screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户填写新的 Helpshift 支持请求时，SDK 会搜索已保存的常见问题，并通过此 Activity 显示匹配文章。用户可以先查看建议文章，也可以继续发送请求。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法看到文章建议，而且 Helpshift 尝试打开此页面时，支持请求流程可能失败。

en.description: Helpshift’s Android customer-support SDK opens this Activity for its Help Center and support conversations. It hosts the selected screen and handles navigation between help articles and conversations.
en.disableEffect: Helpshift’s in-app Help Center, article, and conversation screens cannot open through this Activity.

zh-CN.description: Helpshift Android 客户支持 SDK 会通过此 Activity 打开帮助中心和支持对话。它承载所选页面，并处理帮助文章与对话之间的导航。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Helpshift 应用内帮助中心、文章和对话页面都无法通过此 Activity 打开。

en.description: When a user opens an attachment from a Helpshift support conversation, the SDK uses this provider to pass the file to the viewing app.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open file attachments from Helpshift conversations, so the attachment viewing flow stops working.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 Helpshift 支持对话中的附件时，SDK 会通过此 Provider 将文件交给查看应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法打开 Helpshift 对话中的文件附件，附件查看流程会停止工作。

en.description: When a user taps an older Helpshift campaign notification, this Activity clears the alert and routes to its destination, which can be an FAQ, support conversation, campaign inbox, or app link.
en.disableEffect: Tapping these Helpshift campaign notifications no longer opens their linked content or inbox; the app’s other screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击旧版 Helpshift 活动通知时，此 Activity 会清除通知并打开其目标页面，例如常见问题、支持对话、活动收件箱或应用链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，点击这些 Helpshift 活动通知将无法打开关联内容或收件箱；应用的其他页面仍可使用。

en.description: When an older Helpshift campaign notification is handled while the app is in the background, this Service clears the alert and records the interaction.
en.disableEffect: Background campaign notifications may not be cleared or recorded correctly; the app’s other features remain available.

zh-CN.description: 应用在后台处理旧版 Helpshift 活动通知时，此 Service 会清除通知并记录用户操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，后台活动通知可能无法正确清除或记录；应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: UpdateX, shiweibsw's Android update library, declares this private Receiver for Android's package-replaced broadcast. In version 1.0.1 its handler is empty, so it performs no work when that event arrives.
en.disableEffect: There is no behavior to lose in this version; the app's update features are unaffected.

zh-CN.description: shiweibsw 的 UpdateX Android 更新库为 Android 的应用包替换广播声明了这个私有接收器。1.0.1 版本的处理逻辑为空，因此收到该事件时不会执行操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 此版本没有可失去的功能，应用的更新功能不受影响。

en.description: Crashczyk, Henorek’s Android crash-handler library, launches this Activity after it catches an uncaught app error. It shows an error screen with restart and optional error-detail and copy actions.
en.disableEffect: After an app crash, users lose Crashczyk’s restart and error-details screen, and the crash handler may fail when it tries to open the disabled screen.

zh-CN.description: Henorek 的 Crashczyk Android 崩溃处理库捕获未处理的应用错误后，会启动此 Activity。它显示错误页面，并提供重启以及查看、复制错误详情的选项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用崩溃后，用户将无法使用 Crashczyk 的重启和错误详情页面；崩溃处理器尝试打开已停用页面时也可能失败。

en.description: The HERE SDK bundled with The Ahoy App’s AHOY Maps and Navigation products opens this screen when positioning consent is needed. It lets the user allow or deny that consent.
en.disableEffect: The user will not be able to complete the HERE positioning-consent flow, which can prevent location-based map or navigation features from working.

zh-CN.description: The Ahoy App 的 AHOY Maps 和 Navigation 产品所包含的 HERE SDK 在需要定位授权时会打开此界面，供用户同意或拒绝授权。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法完成 HERE 定位授权流程，依赖位置的地图或导航功能可能无法使用。

en.description: The HERE SDK bundled by The Ahoy App uses this provider to start its map engine automatically when Android launches the app. It prepares the SDK’s network and location features.
en.disableEffect: AHOY Maps or Navigation features that rely on HERE may fail to initialize.

zh-CN.description: The Ahoy App 所包含的 HERE SDK 会通过此 Provider 在 Android 启动应用时自动启动地图引擎，并准备 SDK 的网络和定位功能。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖 HERE 的 AHOY Maps 或 Navigation 功能可能无法初始化。

en.description: The HERE SDK bundled by The Ahoy App binds to this background service when an app uses positioning. It prepares the location engine and supplies the connection used for location updates.
en.disableEffect: The app may lose HERE location updates used to position maps or guide navigation.

zh-CN.description: 应用使用定位功能时，The Ahoy App 所包含的 HERE SDK 会绑定此后台服务。它准备定位引擎，并提供接收位置更新所需的连接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用可能无法收到 HERE 位置更新，影响地图定位或导航指引。

en.description: HeretoBase provides shared behavior for in-app web pages and loads the address an app sends to that page.
en.disableEffect: Disabling this entry does not remove other web pages in the app; they can continue using the shared HeretoBase browser behavior.

zh-CN.description: HeretoBase 为应用内网页提供通用功能，并加载应用传入的网页地址。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用此项不会移除应用中的其他网页，它们仍可使用 HeretoBase 的共享网页功能。

en.description: When SzhitTech's HET device-binding SDK starts Bluetooth Low Energy discovery while Bluetooth is off, this screen asks Android to enable Bluetooth. After approval, it continues nearby-device scanning and setup.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot show this Bluetooth prompt, so Bluetooth-based device discovery and binding may fail.

zh-CN.description: SzhitTech 的 HET 设备绑定 SDK 在蓝牙关闭时开始低功耗蓝牙发现，会通过此界面请求 Android 打开蓝牙。用户同意后，SDK 会继续扫描附近设备并进行配置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用无法显示此蓝牙提示，因此基于蓝牙的设备发现和绑定可能失败。

en.description: The HET CLife Open SDK starts this background service to capture Android log output and save it in the app's local storage.
en.disableEffect: The SDK will no longer collect these local diagnostic logs.

zh-CN.description: HET CLife Open SDK 会启动此后台服务，收集 Android 日志输出并保存到应用本地存储。
zh-CN.disableEffect: SDK 将不再收集这些本地诊断日志。

en.description: OPPO’s instant-app upgrade service runs in the background when the instant platform needs to be downloaded or resumed. It manages the download and shows a foreground notification while it runs.
en.disableEffect: If the instant platform needs an update, its download and installation flow cannot finish.

zh-CN.description: OPPO 即时应用升级服务会在即时应用平台需要下载或继续下载时于后台运行，并在下载期间显示通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 即时应用平台需要更新时，其下载和安装流程将无法完成。

en.description: The Analysys EasyTouch Oppo push integration starts this service for incoming Oppo push messages, parses them, and handles command callbacks.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents this service from processing Oppo push messages and commands.

zh-CN.description: Analysys EasyTouch 的 Oppo 推送集成会通过此 Service 接收 Oppo 推送消息、解析消息并处理命令回调。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Oppo 推送消息和命令将无法由此服务处理。

en.description: The Analysys EasyTouch ColorOS push integration uses this service to receive push messages and process command callbacks.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents this service from processing ColorOS push messages and commands.

zh-CN.description: Analysys EasyTouch 的 ColorOS 推送集成会通过此 Service 接收推送消息并处理命令回调。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，ColorOS 推送消息和命令将无法由此服务处理。

en.description: The OPPO HeyTap Mobad SDK opens this screen for an advertiser’s in-app page. It displays the ad content and handles page links and ad actions.
en.disableEffect: OPPO Mobad ad pages will not open; the app’s non-ad screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: OPPO HeyTap Mobad SDK 会在需要展示广告落地页时打开此页面，显示广告内容并处理页面链接和广告操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: OPPO Mobad 的广告页面将无法打开，应用的非广告页面仍可使用。

en.description: The Tencent GDT ad SDK bundled with OPPO MobAd uses this provider to share downloaded ad files with Android when an ad opens or installs an app.
en.disableEffect: App downloads started by GDT ads may not open or install.

zh-CN.description: OPPO MobAd 中的腾讯 GDT 广告 SDK 使用此 Provider，在广告打开或安装应用时向 Android 提供下载文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，GDT 广告发起的应用下载可能无法打开或安装。

en.description: OPPO HeyTap Mobad uses this provider to share downloaded ad files with Android, including files passed to the app installer.
en.disableEffect: Blocking it makes Mobad initialization fail and prevents ad-file or app-install links from opening.

zh-CN.description: OPPO HeyTap Mobad 会通过此提供程序将已下载的广告文件交给 Android 使用，包括传给应用安装程序的文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后 Mobad 初始化会失败，广告文件或应用安装链接也无法打开。

en.description: The Oppo (HeyTap) Push SDK starts this compatibility service for data messages delivered through its older ColorOS route; it initializes push handling, parses the message, and records its title and content.
en.disableEffect: The app will no longer handle Oppo data messages delivered through the older ColorOS route.

zh-CN.description: Oppo（欢太）推送 SDK 会在 ColorOS 旧版数据消息通道送达消息时启动此兼容服务；它会初始化推送处理、解析消息并记录标题和内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用将无法处理通过 ColorOS 旧版通道送达的 Oppo 数据消息。

en.description: The Oppo (HeyTap) Push SDK starts this service for its current data-message deliveries; it initializes the push client, parses each message, and records its title and content.
en.disableEffect: The app will no longer handle Oppo data messages delivered through the current HeyTap route.

zh-CN.description: Oppo（欢太）推送 SDK 会在当前 HeyTap 数据消息通道送达消息时启动此服务；它会初始化推送客户端、解析消息并记录标题和内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用将无法处理通过当前 HeyTap 通道送达的 Oppo 数据消息。

en.description: HeyTap Mobile Services uses this file provider to make approved app files available through temporary links for workflows that need to read or hand off a file.
en.disableEffect: File handoffs that rely on HeyTap's temporary links may fail.

zh-CN.description: HeyTap 移动服务会通过此文件组件生成临时链接，以读取或传递应用文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 屏蔽后，依赖 HeyTap 临时文件链接的文件传递可能失败。

en.description: The HeyTap User Center account SDK runs this Provider when the app starts to initialize account services and register for login, logout, and profile-change notices.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it can leave HeyTap sign-in and account-state updates unavailable in the app.

zh-CN.description: HeyTap（OPPO）用户中心账号 SDK 会在应用启动时运行此 Provider，以初始化账号服务并注册接收登录、退出和资料变更通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用内的 HeyTap 登录和账号状态同步可能无法使用。

en.description: The HeyTap User Center account SDK uses this Receiver for account login, logout, and profile-change broadcasts; it updates saved account data and returns login results to the app.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it can leave sign-in results, saved login state, or account-name updates out of sync.

zh-CN.description: HeyTap 用户中心账号 SDK 使用此 Receiver 接收账号登录、退出和资料变更广播；它会更新已保存的账号信息并将登录结果返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，登录结果、账号状态或昵称更新可能无法及时同步。

en.description: OPPO HeyTap WebView uses this file provider when a web page asks to take a photo for upload. It gives the camera access to a temporary image and lets the page receive the captured photo.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it can stop photo capture and upload in pages opened through the HeyTap WebView extension.

zh-CN.description: OPPO HeyTap WebView 扩展在网页请求拍照上传时，通过此文件入口把临时图片交给相机，并将拍到的照片返回给网页。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，通过 HeyTap WebView 打开的网页可能无法拍照并上传图片。

en.description: Hfitp Support opens this feedback screen when a user submits a report; it sends the message and contact text with app-version and device information to the support service.
en.disableEffect: In-app feedback submission becomes unavailable, while other app screens continue to work.

zh-CN.description: 用户提交反馈时，Hfitp Support 会打开此页面，并将反馈与联系信息、应用版本和设备信息发送给支持服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用内反馈无法提交，但其他页面仍可正常使用。

en.description: Hfitp Support opens this list of recommended apps, fetched for the current app and device; tapping an item opens its store listing.
en.disableEffect: The recommended-app list and its store links become unavailable; other app features continue to work.

zh-CN.description: Hfitp Support 会打开为当前应用和设备获取的推荐应用列表；点击列表项目可前往对应的商店页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，推荐应用列表及其商店链接无法使用，但其他应用功能仍可正常使用。

en.description: Hfitp Support opens this in-app web page when requested by the app and loads either a supplied web address or HTML content.
en.disableEffect: Pages routed through this screen cannot be shown, so app flows that rely on them may stop working.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求打开内嵌网页时，Hfitp Support 会显示此页面，并加载应用提供的网址或 HTML 内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，通过此页面打开的内容无法显示，依赖它的应用流程可能无法继续。

en.description: Han Hankj Base uses this screen when the app opens a video; it prepares and plays the video supplied by the app.
en.disableEffect: Video playback through Han Hankj Base cannot open this player screen.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开视频时，Han Hankj Base 会显示此页面，准备并播放应用传入的视频。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Han Hankj Base 无法打开此播放器页面播放视频。

en.description: Han Hankj Base opens this screen when the app asks to show an available update; it displays update notes and offers download and installation controls.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot use Han Hankj Base's in-app download and installation screen for updates.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求显示可用更新时，Han Hankj Base 会打开此页面，展示更新说明并提供下载和安装选项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过 Han Hankj Base 的页面下载并安装应用更新。

en.description: Han Hankj Base uses this screen for in-app web pages, displaying the page and title or navigation settings supplied by the app.
en.disableEffect: Web pages routed through this screen cannot open, so app features that use them may stop working.

zh-CN.description: Han Hankj Base 使用此页面展示应用打开的内嵌网页，以及应用提供的标题和导航设置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，通过此页面打开的网页无法显示，依赖这些页面的应用功能可能无法使用。

en.description: Han Hankj qrcode opens this CameraX scanner screen when the app requests a code scan and displays the live camera view with app-supplied scan settings.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot open this scanner, so code-scanning actions that use it stop working.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求扫码时，Han Hankj 的 qrcode 会打开此 CameraX 扫描页面，显示实时相机画面并使用应用提供的扫描设置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用无法打开此扫描器，依赖它的扫码操作将无法使用。

en.description: HH Medics’ doctor SDK uses this file provider to pass camera photos and other app files to its consultation and upload screens. It creates shareable links for files in the app’s storage and cache.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it can prevent camera photos or attached files from opening in HH Medics consultation and upload flows.

zh-CN.description: HH Medics 医生 SDK 使用此文件入口，将相机拍摄的照片和应用文件交给问诊及上传页面；它为应用存储和缓存中的文件提供可共享的访问链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，HH Medics 问诊和上传流程可能无法使用相机照片或打开附件。

en.description: HH Medics’ HHVideo SDK shows this screen when a user enters a six-digit service activation code. It checks the code online and refreshes the account after activation succeeds.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to activate HH Medics services that require this code.

zh-CN.description: HH Medics 的 HHVideo SDK 在用户输入六位服务激活码时显示此页面，并在线核验激活码；激活成功后会刷新账户信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法激活需要此激活码的 HH Medics 服务。

en.description: HH Medics’ doctor SDK opens this screen for its in-app web pages. Pages can request a photo, camera capture or PDF, and the HHVideo release also routes consultation, payment and health-report actions.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it can interrupt the SDK’s web pages, attachment selection and web-based consultation or payment flows.

zh-CN.description: HH Medics 医生 SDK 使用此页面显示应用内网页。网页可以请求照片、调用相机或选择 PDF；HHVideo 版本还会处理问诊、支付和健康报告相关入口。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，SDK 网页、附件选择以及基于网页的问诊或支付流程可能无法使用。

en.description: HH Medics’ HHVideo SDK shows this screen to increase the medicine quantity on an order. It submits the change and opens the related purchase page after the update succeeds.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to change the medicine quantity or continue to its purchase flow through this screen.

zh-CN.description: HH Medics 的 HHVideo SDK 使用此页面增加订单中的药品数量。页面提交变更，并在更新成功后打开相关购买页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过此页面修改药品数量或继续相关购买流程。

en.description: HH Medics’ HHVideo SDK uses this screen as its in-app service home. It loads the doctor service page and provides consultation, call and participant actions.
en.disableEffect: Users will lose the HH Medics service home and its consultation and call entry points.

zh-CN.description: HH Medics 的 HHVideo SDK 使用此页面作为应用内服务首页。它加载医生服务页面，并提供问诊、呼叫和成员管理入口。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法打开 HH Medics 服务首页及其中的问诊和呼叫入口。

en.description: HH Medics’ HHVideo SDK opens a photo viewer for images attached to a medical record or upload list. It starts at the image the user selected and lets them browse the set.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to view these medical-record and upload-list photos in the SDK viewer.

zh-CN.description: HH Medics 的 HHVideo SDK 使用此页面查看病历或上传列表中的照片，并从用户选中的图片开始浏览。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过 SDK 查看病历和上传列表中的这些照片。

en.description: HH Medics’ HHVideo SDK shows the files being uploaded during a consultation, including their progress and errors. Selecting an item opens its video, PDF or photo viewer.
en.disableEffect: Users will lose the consultation upload list and the ability to open its uploaded files from this screen.

zh-CN.description: HH Medics 的 HHVideo SDK 使用此页面显示问诊期间上传的文件及其进度或错误。选择文件后会打开相应的视频、PDF 或照片查看页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法查看问诊上传列表，也无法从此页面打开已上传的文件。

en.description: HH Medics’ doctor SDK shows this settings menu for account options such as membership, medical records, activation, orders and addresses when those options are enabled.
en.disableEffect: Users will lose these HH Medics account and service settings, including any options offered by their account.

zh-CN.description: HH Medics 医生 SDK 使用此页面显示账户设置，例如会员、医疗档案、激活、订单和地址；具体选项取决于账户配置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法使用此页面提供的 HH Medics 账户和服务设置。

en.description: HH Medics’ HHVideo SDK opens an in-app player for a supplied video, such as a video selected from an upload list. The player can loop the video and hide its hang-up control.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to play videos through the HH Medics SDK player.

zh-CN.description: HH Medics 的 HHVideo SDK 使用此页面播放指定视频，例如从上传列表中选择的视频。播放器可以循环播放，也可以隐藏挂断按钮。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过 HH Medics SDK 播放视频。

en.description: HH Medics’ HHVideo SDK shows PDFs stored on the device when a web upload asks the user to choose a document. Selecting a PDF returns it to the requesting page.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to choose a stored PDF for upload through this HH Medics flow.

zh-CN.description: HH Medics 的 HHVideo SDK 在网页上传请求选择文档时，列出设备中保存的 PDF。用户选中文件后，页面会收到该文档。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过此 HH Medics 流程选择设备中的 PDF 并上传。

en.description: HH Medics’ doctor and PingAn SDKs use this screen for live clinician-patient video consultations. It sets up the call’s real-time audio and video connection and keeps consultation messages in sync.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it can prevent HH Medics video consultations from opening or connecting.

zh-CN.description: HH Medics 医生及平安 SDK 使用此页面进行医生与患者的视频问诊。页面会建立实时音视频连接，并同步问诊消息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，HH Medics 视频问诊可能无法打开或建立连接。

en.description: HH Medics’ doctor SDK starts this service during a video call to show the caller’s or remote participant’s video in a small movable window over the current screen.
en.disableEffect: Users will lose the floating video window during a call and may be unable to keep viewing the participant while switching screens.

zh-CN.description: HH Medics 医生 SDK 在视频通话期间使用此服务，在当前页面上方显示可移动的小窗，继续播放本机或远端参与者的视频。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，通话期间将无法显示悬浮视频窗，切换页面时也可能无法继续查看通话画面。

en.description: HH Medics’ doctor SDK opens this screen for group video consultations. It shows the participants, handles call controls and lets users send medical photos during the call.
en.disableEffect: Group consultation participants will lose the video-call screen, call controls and photo-sharing flow.

zh-CN.description: HH Medics 医生 SDK 使用此页面进行多人视频问诊，显示参与者画面、提供通话控制，并允许用户在通话中发送医疗照片。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，多人问诊将无法使用视频通话页面、通话控制和照片发送功能。

en.description: Matisse opens this screen after the user taps a photo in an album. It previews that item and lets the user browse nearby images before returning to the album.
en.disableEffect: Users will lose the album photo preview step in the Matisse picker.

zh-CN.description: 用户在相册中点选照片后，Matisse 会打开此页面预览该图片，并可浏览相邻图片后返回相册。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法在 Matisse 选择器中预览相册照片。

en.description: Matisse opens this screen from its preview control to review the media already selected before the user confirms the selection.
en.disableEffect: Users will lose the review step for selected media, and flows that open this screen may not complete as expected.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击预览已选内容时，Matisse 会打开此页面，供用户在确认前检查已选媒体。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法检查已选媒体，依赖此页面的选择流程也可能无法正常完成。

en.description: Matisse opens this photo and video picker when a feature asks the user to choose media. It lists device albums, supports media selection or capture, and returns the chosen items.
en.disableEffect: Photo and video selection or capture through the Matisse picker will stop working.

zh-CN.description: 需要选择媒体时，Matisse 会打开此照片和视频选择器。它列出设备相册，支持选择或拍摄媒体，并返回选中的内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，将无法通过 Matisse 选择器选择或拍摄照片和视频。

en.description: Hianzuo Android Logger starts this service when an app requests file logging. It initializes the logger and handles requests to write, flush or delete log files.
en.disableEffect: File logging through Hianzuo Android Logger will stop; the host app’s regular screens and features remain available.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求写入文件日志时，Hianzuo Android Logger 会启动此服务。它初始化日志功能，并处理写入、刷新或删除日志文件的请求。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Hianzuo Android Logger 的文件日志将停止，但宿主应用的常规页面和功能仍可使用。

en.description: HiLeia.PS bundles this HiAR WebCore file provider to expose configured local files through Android content links.
en.disableEffect: A web feature that requests a local-file link may fail to open or share that file.

zh-CN.description: HiLeia.PS 随附的 HiAR WebCore 文件 Provider 可通过 Android 内容链接公开已配置的本地文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要本地文件链接的网页功能可能无法打开或分享相应文件。

en.description: HIGH MOBILITY HMKit opens this screen when an app needs the user to authorize access to a vehicle service. It displays the authorization page and any status or error before returning to the app.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it can prevent users from authorizing or connecting an account to a vehicle service.

zh-CN.description: 应用需要用户授权访问车辆服务时，HIGH MOBILITY HMKit 会打开此页面。页面显示授权内容及状态或错误信息，之后返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户可能无法授权账户或连接车辆服务。

en.description: Honor Ads SDK shows this prompt when a user follows an ad link to download an advertised app; it displays the file size and lets the user continue or stop.
en.disableEffect: Users will not see the download-size confirmation, so this ad-download flow cannot continue through the prompt.

zh-CN.description: Honor 广告 SDK 在用户通过广告链接下载推广应用时显示此提示，告知文件大小，并让用户选择继续或停止。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 屏蔽后，用户无法查看下载文件大小或通过此提示继续广告下载流程。

en.description: After a user taps an Honor ad, Honor Ads SDK opens the ad landing page in an in-app browser. The page can open the promoted app or start and check its download.
en.disableEffect: The ad landing page and its app download or open controls will no longer be available, while the host app's regular screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击 Honor 广告后，Honor 广告 SDK 会在应用内打开广告落地页。用户可在页面中打开推广应用，或发起并查看其下载进度。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 屏蔽后，广告落地页及其中的应用打开和下载控件将无法使用，但应用的常规功能仍可使用。

en.description: When an Honor ad flow supplies an information URL, Honor Ads SDK opens that page in its in-app browser.
en.disableEffect: That ad information page will not open, while the host app's other features remain available.

zh-CN.description: 当广告流程提供信息链接时，Honor 广告 SDK 会在应用内打开该网页。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 屏蔽后，广告信息网页无法打开，但应用的其他功能不受影响。

en.description: Honor Ads SDK opens an ad's landing page when the ad is set to play video there, then displays the video with ad playback controls.
en.disableEffect: Video ads that use this page and their landing-page controls will no longer work, while the host app's other features remain available.

zh-CN.description: 当 Honor 广告设置为在落地页播放视频时，SDK 会打开该页面并显示视频及广告播放控件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 屏蔽后，依赖此页面的视频广告及落地页控件将无法使用，应用的其他功能仍可运行。

en.description: Honor Ads SDK displays a full-screen interstitial ad when an ad is ready to show and reports whether the display was closed or failed.
en.disableEffect: Honor full-screen ads will no longer appear, while the host app's other features remain available.

zh-CN.description: 广告准备展示时，Honor 广告 SDK 会打开此全屏插屏广告，并记录广告关闭或展示失败的结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 屏蔽后，Honor 全屏广告将无法显示，应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: Honor Ads SDK plays a rewarded video ad and checks that its required viewing time is completed before returning the reward result.
en.disableEffect: Rewarded ads will not play through this screen, and users will no longer receive rewards for watching them.

zh-CN.description: Honor 广告 SDK 在此播放激励视频，并确认用户看完要求的时长后才返回奖励结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 屏蔽后，激励视频无法在此播放，用户也不会再因观看广告获得奖励。

en.description: Honor Game Center Joint SDK uses this full-screen page to show screens that its game services load while a game is running.
en.disableEffect: Game Center screens that depend on this page, including account actions, will not open.

zh-CN.description: Honor 游戏中心联合 SDK 使用此全屏页面显示游戏运行时动态加载的游戏中心页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 屏蔽后，依赖此页面的游戏中心界面和账号操作将无法打开。

en.description: Honor Game Center Joint SDK uses this translucent page to host screens loaded by its game services.
en.disableEffect: Game Center screens that depend on this page will not open, which can interrupt account or other game-service flows.

zh-CN.description: Honor 游戏中心联合 SDK 使用此半透明页面承载其游戏服务动态加载的页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 屏蔽后，依赖此页面的游戏中心界面将无法打开，账号或其他游戏服务流程可能中断。

en.description: Honor Game Center Joint SDK uses this provider to connect its dynamically loaded game services to the SDK's download helper.
en.disableEffect: Honor Game Center downloads or updates that rely on this helper may fail to initialize.

zh-CN.description: Honor 游戏中心联合 SDK 通过此组件连接动态加载的游戏服务和下载辅助功能。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 屏蔽后，依赖此辅助功能的 Honor 游戏中心下载或更新流程可能无法初始化。

en.description: Honor Game Center Joint SDK sends game-service events through this receiver, which passes each event to the matching loaded handler.
en.disableEffect: Game Center flows that depend on these events may stop working.

zh-CN.description: Honor 游戏中心联合 SDK 通过此接收器将游戏服务事件转交给相应的动态加载处理程序。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 屏蔽后，依赖这些事件的游戏中心流程可能无法正常运行。

en.description: Honor Game Center Joint SDK starts or binds this background service when a dynamically loaded game feature needs background work.
en.disableEffect: Game Center features that rely on this background work may stop functioning.

zh-CN.description: 动态加载的游戏功能需要后台任务时，Honor 游戏中心联合 SDK 会启动或连接此服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 屏蔽后，依赖此后台任务的游戏中心功能可能无法正常运行。

en.description: Honor Game Center Joint SDK lets its game services share app files through temporary links that the intended recipient can open.
en.disableEffect: File transfers that use Honor Game Center's links will fail.

zh-CN.description: Honor 游戏中心联合 SDK 通过临时链接，让游戏服务读取或传递应用中的文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 屏蔽后，Honor 游戏中心依赖这些链接传递的文件将无法打开或共享。

en.description: Android creates this provider as the app starts so Honor Game Center Joint SDK can prepare its connection to the app before game-center features run.
en.disableEffect: Honor Game Center may not initialize correctly, so its login and game services can fail.

zh-CN.description: Android 会在应用启动时创建此组件，为 Honor 游戏中心联合 SDK 准备与应用的连接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 屏蔽后，Honor 游戏中心可能无法正常初始化，登录和游戏服务也可能中断。

en.description: When a player signs out of an Honor ID game account, Honor Game Center opens Honor account settings and returns the result to the game.
en.disableEffect: The game cannot complete this Honor ID sign-out flow.

zh-CN.description: 玩家在游戏中退出 Honor ID 账号时，Honor 游戏中心会打开 Honor 账号设置，并将退出结果返回游戏。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 屏蔽后，游戏无法完成此 Honor ID 账号退出流程。

en.description: When a game requests an Honor ID sign-in, Honor Game Center starts the account login flow and returns success or an error to the game.
en.disableEffect: The game cannot complete Honor ID sign-in.

zh-CN.description: 游戏请求使用 Honor ID 登录时，Honor 游戏中心会启动账号登录流程，并将成功或错误结果返回游戏。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 屏蔽后，游戏无法完成 Honor ID 登录。

en.description: When a game asks the player to authorize access to an Honor ID, Honor Game Center opens the approval flow and returns the account identifier and authorization result.
en.disableEffect: The game cannot complete this Honor ID authorization flow.

zh-CN.description: 游戏请求授权访问 Honor ID 账号时，Honor 游戏中心会显示授权流程，并把账号标识和授权结果返回游戏。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 屏蔽后，游戏无法完成此 Honor ID 授权流程。

en.description: When Honor Game Center asks players to read a privacy notice or service agreement, this page opens the supplied link inside the game.
en.disableEffect: Players cannot open these agreement pages, which can stop them from completing Honor Game Center's consent flow.

zh-CN.description: Honor 游戏中心要求玩家查看隐私声明或服务协议时，此页面会在游戏内打开相应链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 屏蔽后，玩家无法打开这些协议页面，可能无法完成 Honor 游戏中心的隐私同意流程。

en.description: This provider prepares the download helper used by Honor Game Center when the app starts.
en.disableEffect: Honor Game Center download or update tasks may fail to start.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，Honor 游戏中心的下载辅助功能会通过此组件准备应用环境。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 屏蔽后，Honor 游戏中心的下载或更新任务可能无法启动。

en.description: Honor Push Kit sends this receiver registration and incoming-message broadcasts; it parses token or message data in the background and passes it into Honor's push callback flow.
en.disableEffect: Honor push registration updates and incoming messages will no longer reach the app.

zh-CN.description: Honor 推送套件会通过此接收器发送注册和新消息广播；它在后台解析令牌或消息数据，并交给 Honor 推送回调流程处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用将无法收到 Honor 推送注册更新和新消息。

en.description: Honor Push Kit runs this provider when the app starts to initialize push automatically.
en.disableEffect: Honor push will no longer initialize automatically, so its registration and message delivery will stop.

zh-CN.description: Honor 推送套件会在应用启动时运行此提供程序，以自动初始化推送服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Honor 推送将无法自动初始化，注册和消息接收也会停止。

en.description: Hina Data Track initializes this app-local data store for analytics events and the SDK’s key-value data. It serves those records when the tracking SDK saves or reads them.
en.disableEffect: Hina analytics events and SDK data will no longer be stored or retrieved; other host app features remain available.

zh-CN.description: Hina Data Track 使用此应用内数据存储保存分析事件和 SDK 的键值数据，并在跟踪功能写入或读取时提供这些记录。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Hina 分析事件和 SDK 数据将无法保存或读取；宿主应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: Hina Data Track uses this app-local data store for analytics events and the SDK’s key-value data. It serves those records when the tracking SDK saves or reads them.
en.disableEffect: Hina analytics events and SDK data will no longer be stored or retrieved; other host app features remain available.

zh-CN.description: Hina Data Track 使用此应用内数据存储保存分析事件和 SDK 的键值数据，并在跟踪功能写入或读取时提供这些记录。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Hina 分析事件和 SDK 数据将无法保存或读取；宿主应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: HiPay Fullservice opens this in-app web page when checkout redirects to a hosted payment or authentication page. It follows payment redirects and returns the transaction result to checkout.
en.disableEffect: Blocking it can interrupt payment redirects, authentication and the return from checkout.

zh-CN.description: HiPay Fullservice 在结账跳转到托管支付或身份验证页面时打开此应用内网页。它跟进支付跳转，并将交易结果返回结账流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，支付跳转、身份验证或结账结果返回可能中断。

en.description: HiPay Fullservice opens this screen when an order offers saved payment cards. It displays the available cards, processes the user’s choice and returns the order result.
en.disableEffect: Users may be unable to choose a saved card or complete checkout for orders that use this screen.

zh-CN.description: 订单支持已保存的支付卡时，HiPay Fullservice 会打开此页面列出可用卡片，处理用户选择并返回订单结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户可能无法选择已保存的卡片，也无法完成依赖此页面的结账。

en.description: HiPay Fullservice opens this screen after the user chooses a payment method. It collects the required payment details, submits the order and can offer card scanning when enabled.
en.disableEffect: Users may be unable to enter payment details or complete the order.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择支付方式后，HiPay Fullservice 会打开此页面收集支付所需信息并提交订单；启用相关选项时，也可在此扫描银行卡。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户可能无法填写支付信息或完成订单。

en.description: HiPay Fullservice opens this screen to load and show the payment methods available for an order. Choosing a method starts the corresponding payment form.
en.disableEffect: Users may be unable to choose a payment method or continue checkout.

zh-CN.description: HiPay Fullservice 使用此页面加载并显示订单可用的支付方式。用户选择一种方式后，会进入相应的支付表单。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户可能无法选择支付方式或继续结账。

en.description: Hippo (Jungle Works) opens this screen to show its campaign and announcement feed when a campaign is selected.
en.disableEffect: Campaign announcements will no longer open here, while ordinary support chats remain available.

zh-CN.description: Hippo（Jungle Works）会在用户选择活动或公告时打开此页面，显示 SDK 的活动和公告内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 此页面将无法打开活动公告，但普通客服聊天仍可使用。

en.description: When a user opens Hippo support, this activity shows the chat list and, when configured, a campaign-notification tab; it also starts the live chat connection.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from opening Hippo's support inbox and its notification list.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 Hippo 客服时，此页面显示聊天列表，并在配置后提供活动通知标签页；它也会启动实时聊天连接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，用户无法打开 Hippo 客服收件箱和通知列表。

en.description: When a business configures a pre-chat form, this screen collects the requested customer details and sends them before opening the conversation.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot complete the configured customer form or continue through this chat-onboarding step.

zh-CN.description: 商家配置聊天前表单时，此页面会收集要求的客户资料并提交，然后打开会话。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法填写已配置的客户表单，也无法完成这一步聊天引导。

en.description: This is Hippo's customer support conversation screen; it displays messages, sends replies and attachments, and receives live conversation updates.
en.disableEffect: Users lose the in-app support conversation, including its message and attachment flow.

zh-CN.description: 这是 Hippo 的客户支持聊天页面，可显示消息、发送回复和附件，并接收实时会话更新。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法使用应用内客服会话，包括消息和附件功能。

en.description: When Hippo creates a payment request, this screen collects its title, currency, item descriptions, and prices, then returns the request to the chat flow.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it can prevent the host app's Hippo payment-request flow from being completed.

zh-CN.description: Hippo 创建付款请求时，此页面会收集标题、币种、项目说明和价格，再将请求交回聊天流程。

en.description: When an agent opens a web link or shared file, this screen displays the page inside Hippo Agent and can download linked files.
en.disableEffect: Agents cannot use this in-app page and file-download flow.

zh-CN.description: 客服人员打开网页链接或共享文件时，此页面会在 Hippo Agent 中显示网页，并可下载链接文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 客服人员无法使用此应用内网页和文件下载流程。

en.description: After a Hippo Agent call, this screen asks the user for a rating and optional written feedback and submits it to Hippo.
en.disableEffect: Only post-call feedback collection stops; calling remains available.

zh-CN.description: Hippo Agent 通话结束后，此页面会收集评分和可选文字意见并提交给 Hippo。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 只有通话后的意见收集会停止，通话功能仍可使用。

en.description: When an agent call is ended or rejected, this receiver processes the call-end data and coordinates cleanup with the ongoing-call service.
en.disableEffect: Call rejection or hang-up may not be synchronized and the background call service may remain active.

zh-CN.description: 客服人员结束或拒绝通话时，此接收器会处理通话结束信息，并协调通话服务清理状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 拒接或挂断状态可能无法同步，后台通话服务也可能继续运行。

en.description: While an agent call is active, this foreground service keeps call state and call notifications available when the call screen is not visible.
en.disableEffect: An active call may lose its background state, notification, or call controls.

zh-CN.description: 客服人员通话期间，此前台服务会在通话页面不可见时维持通话状态和通话通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通话在后台时可能失去状态、通知或通话控制。

en.description: When Hippo Agent receives an incoming call, this service plays the ringing sound and vibration until the alert is stopped.
en.disableEffect: Incoming calls may no longer ring or vibrate for the agent.

zh-CN.description: Hippo Agent 收到来电时，此服务会播放铃声并振动，直到来电提示停止。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 客服人员可能无法听到来电铃声或感受到振动。

en.description: When an agent dismisses a chat notification action, this service clears the notification for that channel.
en.disableEffect: The chat notification may remain until Android or the user clears it; the inbox still works.

zh-CN.description: 客服人员执行聊天通知的清除操作时，此服务会清除此频道的通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 聊天通知可能会保留到 Android 或用户将其清除；收件箱仍可使用。

en.description: When an agent dismisses a Hippo notification, this receiver is notified; the analyzed release reads its channel number and takes no further action.
en.disableEffect: No additional dismissal handling is lost in the analyzed release.

zh-CN.description: 客服人员清除 Hippo 通知时，此接收器会收到通知；分析的版本只读取频道编号，没有其他处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 分析的版本中没有其他通知清除处理会受到影响。

en.description: When an agent replies directly from a notification, this service clears that notification and sends the reply to the conversation.
en.disableEffect: Replies from notifications stop working; agents can still reply from the Hippo Agent inbox.

zh-CN.description: 客服人员直接从通知回复时，此服务会清除通知并将回复发送到会话。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通知内回复将无法使用；客服人员仍可从 Hippo Agent 收件箱回复。

en.description: This is the Hippo Agent call screen for incoming and outgoing voice or video calls, with call controls and connection status.
en.disableEffect: Agents cannot answer, place, or control calls through this screen.

zh-CN.description: 这是 Hippo Agent 来电和去电的语音或视频通话页面，提供通话控制和连接状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 客服人员无法通过此页面接听、发起或控制通话。

en.description: When an agent starts a Jitsi-based conference, this screen prepares the meeting and joins the call.
en.disableEffect: Agents cannot start or join these Hippo Agent conferences.

zh-CN.description: 客服人员发起 Jitsi 会议时，此页面会准备会议并加入通话。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 客服人员无法发起或加入这些 Hippo Agent 会议。

en.description: During an agent voice or video call, this service maintains the WebRTC connection, call signaling, and call notifications in the background.
en.disableEffect: Active calls may disconnect or lose their call controls and notifications.

zh-CN.description: 客服人员语音或视频通话期间，此服务会在后台维持 WebRTC 连接、通话信令和通话通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 正在进行的通话可能断开，或失去通话控制和通知。

en.description: When network connectivity changes, this receiver reconnects Hippo Agent's live conversation feed and retries queued messages or uploads.
en.disableEffect: Live chat may not reconnect, and queued messages or files may remain unsent after a network change.

zh-CN.description: 网络连接状态变化时，此接收器会重新连接 Hippo Agent 实时会话，并重试队列中的消息或上传。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 网络变化后实时聊天可能无法重连，队列中的消息或文件也可能无法发送。

en.description: Hippo Agent sends this service message-delivery, message-open, campaign-click, and conversation-session events for reporting.
en.disableEffect: Those delivery and engagement events stop reaching Hippo; the agent conversation screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: Hippo Agent 通过此服务上报消息送达、打开、活动点击和会话时长等统计事件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 这些送达和互动事件将不再上报 Hippo，但客服会话页面仍可使用。

en.description: When the Hippo Agent inbox starts its background service, this service initializes the SDK session and closes it when the service stops.
en.disableEffect: The SDK session may not initialize or close correctly, disrupting the agent inbox and live updates.

zh-CN.description: Hippo Agent 收件箱启动后台服务时，此服务会初始化 SDK 会话，并在服务停止时关闭会话。
zh-CN.disableEffect: SDK 会话可能无法正确初始化或关闭，影响客服收件箱和实时更新。

en.description: When an agent creates a support ticket, this screen collects account details and ticket information, accepts attachments, and submits the ticket.
en.disableEffect: Agents cannot create tickets or attach supporting files through this flow.

zh-CN.description: 客服人员创建客服工单时，此页面会收集账户和工单信息、接收附件并提交工单。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 客服人员无法通过此流程创建工单或附加相关文件。

en.description: When an agent taps a Hippo notification, this screen routes to its conversation or campaign, including when the app needs to be opened first.
en.disableEffect: Notification taps no longer open the related Hippo Agent conversation or campaign.

zh-CN.description: 客服人员点击 Hippo 通知时，此页面会转到对应会话或活动；必要时也会先打开应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 点击通知将无法打开对应的 Hippo Agent 会话或活动。

en.description: When a Hippo Agent push arrives, this service opens the related conversation or campaign and sends replies entered directly from the notification.
en.disableEffect: Push taps and notification replies stop routing to Hippo Agent; the inbox remains available when opened normally.

zh-CN.description: Hippo Agent 收到推送时，此服务会打开对应会话或活动，并发送直接从通知输入的回复。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 推送点击和通知内回复将无法转到 Hippo Agent；正常打开收件箱仍可使用。

en.description: When a customer sends an attachment in Hippo Agent chat, this service uploads it and updates the conversation with the uploaded file.
en.disableEffect: Customer attachments may fail to upload or appear in the conversation.

zh-CN.description: 客户在 Hippo Agent 聊天中发送附件时，此服务会上传文件并更新会话中的附件信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 客户附件可能无法上传或显示在会话中。

en.description: When an agent sends a file in a conversation, this service uploads it, tracks progress, and updates the message.
en.disableEffect: Agent file attachments may not upload or finish updating in the conversation.

zh-CN.description: 客服人员在会话中发送文件时，此服务会上传文件、跟踪进度并更新消息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 客服人员的文件附件可能无法上传或完成会话更新。

en.description: When an agent attaches audio to a conversation, this screen browses audio files, previews a selection, and returns it for upload.
en.disableEffect: Agents cannot select audio files for conversation attachments.

zh-CN.description: 客服人员在会话中添加音频时，此页面会浏览音频文件、预览所选音频并交给上传流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 客服人员无法为会话附件选择音频文件。

en.description: When a user chooses the gallery option in Hippo (Jungle Works) support chat, this Activity lists photo folders and lets them select an image to attach to the conversation.
en.disableEffect: Users can no longer attach a saved image from the gallery to a Hippo conversation; opening that option may fail.

zh-CN.description: 在 Hippo（Jungle Works）客服聊天中选择图库附件时，此 Activity 会列出照片文件夹，供用户选择图片并添加到对话中。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法从图库向 Hippo 对话添加已保存的图片，打开图库附件选项也可能失败。

en.description: When a user chooses a file attachment in Hippo (Jungle Works) support chat or ticket creation, this Activity lists supported files or opens the Android file picker and returns the chosen file for attachment.
en.disableEffect: Hippo chats and tickets can no longer attach supported documents or files; opening the file option may fail.

zh-CN.description: 在 Hippo（Jungle Works）客服聊天或创建工单时选择文件附件，此 Activity 会列出支持的文件或打开 Android 文件选择器，并返回所选文件以供添加。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Hippo 聊天和工单无法添加支持的文档或文件，打开文件附件选项也可能失败。

en.description: When a user chooses the video attachment option in Hippo (Jungle Works) support chat, this Activity lists videos saved on the device and returns the selected clip to the conversation.
en.disableEffect: Users can no longer attach saved videos to Hippo chats; opening the video option may fail.

zh-CN.description: 在 Hippo（Jungle Works）客服聊天中选择视频附件时，此 Activity 会列出设备上保存的视频，并将所选视频返回给对话以供发送。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法在 Hippo 聊天中添加设备上保存的视频，打开视频附件选项也可能失败。

en.description: When Hippo Calling (Jungle Works) starts or rejoins a voice or video call, this Activity opens the Jitsi conference screen and handles connected, ended, and connection-timeout states. It also supports picture-in-picture while a call continues.
en.disableEffect: Hippo voice and video calls cannot open or rejoin their in-app conference screen.

zh-CN.description: 当 Hippo Calling（Jungle Works）发起或重新加入语音或视频通话时，此 Activity 会打开 Jitsi 会议界面并处理接通、结束和连接超时状态。通话继续时也支持画中画。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Hippo 语音和视频通话无法打开或重新加入会议界面。

en.description: During a Hippo Calling (Jungle Works) call, this silent listener watches for Jitsi conference-ended or participant-left events and notifies Hippo's ongoing-call service. It does not display a call screen.
en.disableEffect: No user-visible effect is expected; Hippo still registers its call-end listener during call setup.

zh-CN.description: Hippo Calling（Jungle Works）通话期间，这个静默监听器会关注 Jitsi 会议结束或参与者离开的事件，并通知 Hippo 的通话服务。它不显示通话界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后预计不会产生用户可见的影响；Hippo 仍会在通话设置期间注册通话结束监听。

en.description: The HiLeia.PS SDK opens this screen when a user chooses photos or takes a new one. It requests the needed media and camera access, shows photo albums, and can launch the camera.
en.disableEffect: The SDK's photo selection and capture screens will not open, preventing photo-based features such as adding call media.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择照片或拍摄新照片时，HiLeia.PS 会打开此界面。该界面会请求所需的媒体和相机权限、显示相册，并可启动相机。
zh-CN.disableEffect: HiLeia.PS 的照片选择和拍摄界面将无法打开，依赖照片的功能（例如在通话中添加媒体）将无法使用。

en.description: HiLeia.PS opens this screen when a user reviews selected photos and changes the selection before returning to the previous screen.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to preview selected photos or adjust the selection before returning.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择照片后，HiLeia.PS 会打开此界面供用户预览并调整选择，然后返回上一界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法预览已选照片或在返回前调整选择。

en.description: HiLeia.PS opens this screen to arrange selected photos into a collage. Users can change the layout, rotate or mirror images, add stickers, and save the result.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to edit or save photo collages.

zh-CN.description: HiLeia.PS 会打开此界面，将所选照片排成拼图。用户可以更改布局、旋转或翻转图片、添加贴纸并保存结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法编辑或保存照片拼图。

en.description: HiLeia.PS opens this screen so a user can choose up to nine photos for a collage.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to choose photos for a collage.

zh-CN.description: HiLeia.PS 会打开此界面，供用户为拼图选择最多九张照片。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法为照片拼图选择图片。

en.description: Android starts this HiLeia.PS provider when the app process initializes. It sets up the SDK database, engine, and app lifecycle hooks used by the SDK.
en.disableEffect: HiLeia.PS startup initialization will not complete, so features that depend on the SDK may not work.

zh-CN.description: 应用进程初始化时，Android 会启动 HiLeia.PS 的此 Provider。它会设置 SDK 数据库和引擎，并注册 SDK 使用的应用生命周期回调。
zh-CN.disableEffect: HiLeia.PS 的启动初始化将无法完成，依赖该 SDK 的功能可能无法正常工作。

en.description: HiLeia.PS starts this receiver for its scheduled or explicit alarms. It starts the SDK service that checks account and call-session state.
en.disableEffect: Service checks started through these alarms will stop, which may prevent call or meeting state from being updated.

zh-CN.description: HiLeia.PS 会在收到定时或显式闹钟时启动此接收器。它会启动检查账户和通话会话状态的 SDK 服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过此接收器启动的服务检查将停止，通话或会议状态可能无法及时更新。

en.description: HiLeia.PS starts this service to receive call and meeting messages, including session, participant, drawing, and call-control updates.
en.disableEffect: Call and meeting messages or state updates may stop, disrupting those features.

zh-CN.description: HiLeia.PS 会启动此服务来接收通话和会议消息，包括会话、参与者、绘图和通话控制更新。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通话和会议中的消息及状态更新可能停止，相关功能将无法正常使用。

en.description: HiLeia.PS runs this service to check account and conference activity, incoming calls, and call answers; it may also show a foreground notification.
en.disableEffect: Checks for incoming calls and active calls or meetings may stop, affecting those features.

zh-CN.description: HiLeia.PS 会通过此服务检查账户和会议活动、来电及接听状态；服务也可能显示前台通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: SDK 对来电和正在进行的通话或会议的检查可能停止，影响这些功能的持续运行。

en.description: HiLeia.PS declares this receiver for a notification keep-alive broadcast, but its broadcast handler performs no action.
en.disableEffect: The inspected code shows no visible feature change when this receiver is disabled.

zh-CN.description: HiLeia.PS 声明此接收器用于接收通知保活广播，但收到广播后不会执行操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 检查到的代码中，停用它不会造成可见的功能变化。

en.description: HiLeia.PS starts this service to resume queued recording uploads and send saved recordings to the configured server.
en.disableEffect: Queued recording uploads will stop.

zh-CN.description: HiLeia.PS 会启动此服务以继续排队中的录制文件上传，并将已保存的录制文件发送到配置的服务器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 录制文件的上传和排队任务将停止。

en.description: HiLeia.PS opens this nearly invisible, one-pixel screen as a background keep-alive helper and closes it when the display is on.
en.disableEffect: The app’s own features remain available, but this HiLeia.PS background keep-alive helper will stop.

zh-CN.description: HiLeia.PS 会打开几乎不可见的单像素界面作为后台保活辅助；屏幕亮起时，该界面会关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用自身功能不受影响，但 HiLeia.PS 的此后台保活辅助功能将停止。

en.description: HiLeia.PS uses this receiver when a user taps its keep-alive notification; it forwards the tap to the configured notification action.
en.disableEffect: The action configured for tapping that notification will not run.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击 HiLeia.PS 的保活通知时，此接收器会将点击交给已配置的通知操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 点击该通知时配置的操作将无法触发。

en.description: HiLeia.PS briefly starts this foreground service with a notification, then stops it after about two seconds as a background keep-alive helper.
en.disableEffect: The app’s own features remain available, but this short-lived background keep-alive helper will stop.

zh-CN.description: HiLeia.PS 会短暂启动此前台服务并显示通知，约两秒后停止服务，以辅助后台保活。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用自身功能不受影响，但这项短暂的后台保活辅助功能将停止。

en.description: HiLeia.PS uses this job service to schedule background work when network and charging conditions are met and to keep its background service running.
en.disableEffect: The app’s own features remain available, but this HiLeia.PS background keep-alive task will stop.

zh-CN.description: 网络和充电条件满足时，HiLeia.PS 会通过此任务服务安排后台工作，并维持其后台服务运行。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用自身功能不受影响，但 HiLeia.PS 的这项后台保活任务将停止。

en.description: HiLeia.PS uses this service with a companion service to restart and bind its background keep-alive process; it can also use silent audio and a notification.
en.disableEffect: The app’s own features remain available, but HiLeia.PS background restart and keep-alive behavior will stop.

zh-CN.description: HiLeia.PS 会通过此服务与配套服务相互启动和绑定，以恢复后台保活进程；它也可能使用静音音频和通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用自身功能不受影响，但 HiLeia.PS 的后台自动恢复和保活将停止。

en.description: HiLeia.PS runs this service in a separate process and binds it to its companion service to restart the SDK background process if it disconnects.
en.disableEffect: The app’s own features remain available, but HiLeia.PS background restart and keep-alive behavior will stop.

zh-CN.description: HiLeia.PS 会在单独进程中运行此服务，并让它绑定配套服务；连接断开时，它会尝试重启 SDK 后台进程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用自身功能不受影响，但 HiLeia.PS 的后台自动恢复和保活将停止。

en.description: HiLeia.PS starts this foreground service for screen sharing after Android grants screen-capture access. Its manifest declares the screen-share action and media-projection foreground type.
en.disableEffect: Screen sharing will not start or continue.

zh-CN.description: Android 授予屏幕捕获权限后，HiLeia.PS 会启动此屏幕共享前台服务。清单将其标记为屏幕共享操作和媒体投影类型。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 屏幕共享功能将无法启动或继续。

en.description: Android starts this HiLeia.PS provider with the app. It initializes the permission support used by camera and media screens.
en.disableEffect: Permission support used by camera and media screens will not initialize, so those features may not work.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，Android 会启动 HiLeia.PS 的此 Provider。它会初始化相机和媒体界面使用的权限支持。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 相机和媒体页面使用的权限支持将无法初始化，相关功能可能无法正常工作。

en.description: Android starts this HiLeia.PS provider with the app. It initializes the SDK engine and sets up its navigation and floating-window permissions.
en.disableEffect: HiLeia.PS core initialization will not complete, so SDK pages or floating-window features may fail.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，Android 会启动 HiLeia.PS 的此 Provider。它会初始化 SDK 引擎，并设置导航和悬浮窗权限。
zh-CN.disableEffect: HiLeia.PS 的核心初始化将无法完成，依赖该 SDK 的页面或悬浮窗功能可能失效。

en.description: HiLeia.PS opens this screen when a user browses the device for a file. It shows common and other files and returns the selected file.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to browse for and select files in HiLeia.PS.

zh-CN.description: 用户在设备上浏览文件时，HiLeia.PS 会打开此界面。界面会显示常用文件和其他文件，并返回所选文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在 HiLeia.PS 中浏览并选择文件。

en.description: HiLeia.PS opens this screen to show documents received in a channel. A user can select a listed document and open it.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to view or open files received in a channel.

zh-CN.description: HiLeia.PS 会打开此界面显示频道中收到的文档。用户可以选择并打开列表中的文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法查看或打开频道中收到的文件。

en.description: During a HiLeia.PS call, the app registers this receiver for connectivity, Wi-Fi, and low-battery changes. It reports whether a network is available and its connection type to the call manager.
en.disableEffect: Network changes during a call will not reach the SDK and may prevent call connection status from updating.

zh-CN.description: HiLeia.PS 通话期间，应用会注册此接收器以接收网络连接、Wi-Fi 和低电量变化。它会向通话管理器报告网络是否可用及连接类型。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通话期间的网络变化将无法传递给 SDK，可能影响通话连接状态的更新。

en.description: HiLeia.PS opens this screen to scan QR codes with the camera or decode a QR code from a selected photo.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to scan QR codes with the camera or from a photo.

zh-CN.description: HiLeia.PS 会打开此界面，使用相机扫描二维码，也可以识别用户选取照片中的二维码。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法使用相机或照片扫描二维码。

en.description: HiLeia.PS starts this service when a call needs a floating video window. It displays and manages the configured floating call view.
en.disableEffect: The floating video window during a call will not appear or update.

zh-CN.description: 通话需要显示悬浮视频窗口时，HiLeia.PS 会启动此服务来显示和管理配置的通话悬浮界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通话中的悬浮视频窗口将无法显示或更新。

en.description: HiLeia.PS opens this screen for an active audio or video call. It shows call participants, video, and meeting controls.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to enter or use the SDK call screen.

zh-CN.description: HiLeia.PS 会为正在进行的音频或视频通话打开此界面，显示通话参与者、视频和会议控制项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法进入或使用 SDK 的通话界面。

en.description: HiLeia.PS opens this screen for an incoming call. The user can accept or decline the call here.
en.disableEffect: The incoming-call screen will not appear, and users will not be able to answer or decline calls here.

zh-CN.description: 收到来电时，HiLeia.PS 会打开此界面，供用户接听或拒绝。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 来电界面将无法显示，用户也无法通过它接听或拒绝来电。

en.description: HiLeia.PS opens this screen to load contacts and let a user choose someone to call.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to start a call from the contact list.

zh-CN.description: HiLeia.PS 会打开此界面加载联系人，并让用户选择联系人发起通话。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法从联系人列表中发起通话。

en.description: HiLeia.PS opens this screen to view images received as files, with navigation between the available images.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to view received images.

zh-CN.description: HiLeia.PS 会打开此界面查看以文件形式收到的图片，并可在图片间切换。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法查看收到的图片。

en.description: HiLeia.PS opens this screen while a user waits to join a meeting, shows the caller or contact, and then starts the call.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to wait for and join a meeting through this screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户等待加入会议时，HiLeia.PS 会打开此界面显示呼叫方或联系人，然后开始通话。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此界面等待并加入会议。

en.description: HiLeia.PS opens this nearly invisible, one-pixel screen as a background keep-alive helper.
en.disableEffect: The app’s own features remain available, but this HiLeia.PS background keep-alive helper will stop.

zh-CN.description: HiLeia.PS 会打开几乎不可见的单像素界面作为后台保活辅助。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用自身功能不受影响，但 HiLeia.PS 的此后台保活辅助功能将停止。

en.description: HiLeia.PS opens this screen while setting up an outgoing call. It shows the participants being called and lets the user cancel.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to view or cancel the outgoing call through this screen.

zh-CN.description: 设置呼出通话时，HiLeia.PS 会打开此界面显示正在呼叫的参与者，并允许用户取消。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此界面查看或取消呼出通话。

en.description: HiLeia.PS opens this screen during a call so the user can choose additional contacts to invite.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to choose and invite more contacts during a call.

zh-CN.description: 通话期间，HiLeia.PS 会打开此界面供用户选择其他联系人并邀请加入。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在通话中选择并邀请其他联系人。

en.description: HiLeia.PS opens this screen to show recording uploads in progress and upload history. Users can manage the listed recordings.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to view or manage recordings and their upload status.

zh-CN.description: HiLeia.PS 会打开此界面显示正在上传的录制文件和上传记录，并允许用户管理列表中的文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法查看或管理录制文件及其上传状态。

en.description: Android can open this HiLeia.PS Activity for a VIEW request. It uses the camera to record video and can save the recording.
en.disableEffect: The recording screen will not open, so users will not be able to record video through HiLeia.PS.

zh-CN.description: Android 可通过 VIEW 请求打开 HiLeia.PS 的此界面。它会使用相机录制视频，并可保存录制内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 录制界面将无法打开，用户将无法通过 HiLeia.PS 录制视频。

en.description: HiLeia.PS opens this screen to search the contact list; the displayed results update as the user types.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to search contacts.

zh-CN.description: HiLeia.PS 会打开此界面搜索联系人，并在用户输入时更新结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法搜索联系人。

en.description: HiLeia.PS opens this screen to play a saved or remote video recording. It also provides recording actions such as marking, deleting, or retrying an upload.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to play or manage video recordings.

zh-CN.description: HiLeia.PS 会打开此界面播放本地或远程视频录制文件，并提供标记、删除或重试上传等操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法播放或管理视频录制文件。

en.description: HiLeia.PS declares this receiver for a background keep-alive broadcast, but its broadcast handler performs no action.
en.disableEffect: The inspected code shows no visible feature change when this receiver is disabled.

zh-CN.description: HiLeia.PS 声明此接收器用于接收后台保活广播，但收到广播后不会执行操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 检查到的代码中，停用它不会造成可见的功能变化。

en.description: HiLeia.PS uses this Android file provider to create file links for photo capture, opening files, and sharing call files.
en.disableEffect: Photo capture, file-opening, or sharing flows that use these file links may fail.

zh-CN.description: HiLeia.PS 会通过此 Android 文件 Provider 为拍照、打开文件和分享通话文件创建文件链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖这些文件链接的拍摄、打开或分享流程可能失败。

en.description: HitPay Terminal SDK uses this as the sign-in start screen. After the user enters an email, it checks the available login path and opens email-and-password or Stripe sign-in.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to start HitPay account sign-in from this screen.

zh-CN.description: HitPay Terminal SDK 使用此页面作为登录入口。用户输入邮箱后，页面会确认可用的登录方式，并打开邮箱密码登录或 Stripe 登录。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法从此页面开始登录 HitPay 账户。

en.description: HitPay Terminal SDK asks for the account password after email sign-in. Successful login continues to two-factor verification when required, while missing business credentials can lead to account setup.
en.disableEffect: Users may be unable to complete password sign-in or continue to the next account step.

zh-CN.description: 邮箱登录后，HitPay Terminal SDK 使用此页面收集账户密码。登录成功后，如需验证会继续到双重验证；若缺少商户资料，则进入账户设置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户可能无法完成密码登录或继续后续账户步骤。

en.description: HitPay Terminal SDK uses this screen to collect the two-factor code after password sign-in. It submits the code to finish login, or directs users to business setup if their account needs it.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to complete two-factor sign-in through HitPay.

zh-CN.description: 密码登录后，HitPay Terminal SDK 使用此页面收集双重验证代码，并提交代码完成登录；账户需要商户资料时会引导用户进行设置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过 HitPay 完成双重验证登录。

en.description: HitPay Terminal SDK opens this embedded page to create or link a Stripe account with HitPay. It follows Stripe’s return to HitPay and refreshes the account profile.
en.disableEffect: Users may be unable to create or connect the Stripe account needed for HitPay services.

zh-CN.description: HitPay Terminal SDK 使用此内嵌页面创建或关联 Stripe 账户，并在 Stripe 返回后更新 HitPay 账户资料。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户可能无法创建或关联 HitPay 服务所需的 Stripe 账户。

en.description: HitPay Terminal SDK opens the supplied Stripe sign-in page for an existing account. It follows the return to HitPay and refreshes the account profile.
en.disableEffect: Users may be unable to sign in to Stripe and reconnect the existing account through HitPay.

zh-CN.description: HitPay Terminal SDK 使用此页面打开现有账户的 Stripe 登录页，并在返回 HitPay 后更新账户资料。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户可能无法通过 HitPay 登录 Stripe 并重新连接现有账户。

en.description: HitPay Terminal SDK collects business name, email, address, contact number and country on this sign-up screen. Submitting the form creates the business profile.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to submit the business details needed to create a HitPay account.

zh-CN.description: HitPay Terminal SDK 使用此注册页面收集商户名称、邮箱、地址、联系电话和国家，并在提交后创建商户资料。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法提交创建 HitPay 账户所需的商户信息。

en.description: HitPay Terminal SDK shows this account-setup step after business details are submitted. Continuing opens the Stripe connection page for the new account.
en.disableEffect: Users may be unable to continue from HitPay business setup to connect Stripe.

zh-CN.description: 提交商户信息后，HitPay Terminal SDK 使用此页面继续账户设置；用户继续后会打开新账户的 Stripe 关联页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户可能无法从 HitPay 商户设置继续关联 Stripe。

en.description: HitPay Terminal SDK asks how to find a card reader: Bluetooth, internet or a local mobile terminal. It returns the chosen connection method to the reader workflow.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to choose how HitPay discovers the card reader.

zh-CN.description: HitPay Terminal SDK 使用此页面选择读卡器的发现方式：蓝牙、互联网或本地移动终端，并将选择结果交给后续连接流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法选择 HitPay 查找读卡器的方式。

en.description: HitPay Terminal SDK opens the Stripe Terminal workflow to find and connect a card reader and accept payments. The screen also handles reader setup and payment choices.
en.disableEffect: Users may be unable to connect a reader or accept in-person payments through the HitPay terminal flow.

zh-CN.description: HitPay Terminal SDK 使用 Stripe Terminal 流程查找并连接读卡器、接收付款，也在此页面处理读卡器设置和支付方式。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户可能无法连接读卡器或通过 HitPay 终端流程接受现场付款。

en.description: HitPay Terminal SDK shows the progress, time estimate and result while a terminal update is in progress.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to view or complete the terminal update through this screen.

zh-CN.description: HitPay Terminal SDK 在终端更新过程中使用此页面显示进度、预计时间和更新结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过此页面查看或完成终端更新。

en.description: After HIVE setup, this provider registers Facebook sign-in and social support; the Cloud Game variant also connects Facebook App-to-User notifications.
en.disableEffect: HIVE Facebook sign-in and social features will stop working, along with the App-to-User notifications provided by the Cloud Game variant.

zh-CN.description: HIVE 完成设置后，此 Provider 会注册 Facebook 登录和社交功能；Cloud Game 版本还会接入 Facebook App-to-User 通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: HIVE 的 Facebook 登录和社交功能将无法使用；Cloud Game 版本提供的 App-to-User 通知也会停止。

en.description: After HIVE setup, this provider registers Google sign-in, social, game, and store support, plus Firebase push when available; the Google v2 version also initializes Play Games.
en.disableEffect: HIVE Google sign-in, social, game, store, and push integrations may stop working.

zh-CN.description: HIVE 完成设置后，此 Provider 会注册 Google 登录、社交、游戏和商店支持，并在 Firebase 消息服务可用时接入推送；Google v2 版本还会初始化 Play Games。
zh-CN.disableEffect: HIVE 的 Google 登录、社交、游戏、商店及推送集成功能可能无法使用。

en.description: After HIVE setup, this provider registers Huawei social support for HIVE.
en.disableEffect: HIVE features that use Huawei social services will stop working.

zh-CN.description: HIVE 完成设置后，此 Provider 会为 HIVE 注册华为社交功能。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖华为社交服务的 HIVE 功能将无法使用。

en.description: HIVE opens this screen for user-agreement or permission checks; it displays the agreement page or requests the needed permission.
en.disableEffect: Users may be unable to complete HIVE agreement or permission steps required by sign-in or other features.

zh-CN.description: HIVE 在用户协议或权限检查流程中打开此界面，用于展示协议或请求所需权限。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户可能无法完成登录或其他功能所需的 HIVE 协议与权限步骤。

en.description: When the app returns from WeChat sign-in to Hive, this brief screen passes the result to Hive's login flow and closes. It is used only by apps that integrate WeChat sign-in.
en.disableEffect: WeChat sign-in through Hive will not complete, so users may be unable to sign in with that account.

zh-CN.description: 应用从微信登录流程返回 Hive 时，此短暂界面会把结果交给 Hive 登录流程并关闭。只有集成微信登录的应用会使用它。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过 Hive 使用微信登录将无法完成，用户可能无法使用该账号登录。

en.description: When a user signs in to HIVE with WeChat, WeChat returns to this activity so HIVE can receive the sign-in result.
en.disableEffect: WeChat sign-in cannot return its result to HIVE.

zh-CN.description: 用户通过微信登录 HIVE 时，微信会返回到此界面，由 HIVE 接收登录结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 微信登录结果无法返回 HIVE，相关登录流程将无法完成。

en.description: HIVE uses this screen for its X sign-in link and authorization flow.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to complete HIVE sign-in through X.

zh-CN.description: HIVE 使用此界面处理 X 登录链接和授权流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 X 完成 HIVE 登录。

en.description: HIVE uses this provider to create temporary file links for image flows such as taking or choosing a profile picture.
en.disableEffect: HIVE camera, photo-selection, and other file handoff flows may fail.

zh-CN.description: HIVE 使用此 Provider 为拍摄或选择头像等图片流程创建临时文件链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: HIVE 的拍照、选图及其他文件交接流程可能会失败。

en.description: Android starts this Hive SDK provider during app launch. It initializes Hive, registers its app lifecycle handling, and checks for install-referral information when none is stored.
en.disableEffect: Hive features that need startup setup, including sign-in, may fail to initialize or become unavailable.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，Android 会自动运行此 Hive SDK Provider。它初始化 Hive、注册应用生命周期处理，并在尚无记录时检查安装来源信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要启动设置的 Hive 功能（包括登录）可能无法初始化或无法使用。

en.description: When HIVE is configured to use Hercules, this provider starts that game service after HIVE setup and supplies player and device identity after sign-in.
en.disableEffect: The configured HIVE Hercules game integration will not start.

zh-CN.description: 当 HIVE 配置启用 Hercules 时，此 Provider 会在 HIVE 设置后启动该游戏服务，并在登录后提供玩家和设备身份信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 已启用的 HIVE Hercules 游戏集成功能将不会启动。

en.description: This provider registers HIVE's IAP v2 purchase module when HIVE initializes.
en.disableEffect: Purchase flows that use HIVE IAP v2 will stop working.

zh-CN.description: HIVE 初始化时，此 Provider 会注册 HIVE 的 IAP v2 购买模块。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用 HIVE IAP v2 的购买流程将无法工作。

en.description: Amazon store age-data test requests query this provider with a test option and receive preset age and supervision responses.
en.disableEffect: HIVE's preset Amazon age-data test responses will no longer be available.

zh-CN.description: Amazon 商店的年龄信息测试请求会带测试选项查询此 Provider，并获得预设的年龄和监护状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: HIVE 预设的 Amazon 年龄信息测试响应将不可用。

en.description: When WeChat returns from an HIVE LEBI purchase, this activity passes the payment result back to HIVE and closes.
en.disableEffect: WeChat payment results cannot return to HIVE, so the corresponding purchase flow may fail.

zh-CN.description: 微信从 HIVE LEBI 购买流程返回时，此界面会将支付结果交还给 HIVE 并关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 微信支付结果无法返回 HIVE，相应的购买流程可能会失败。

en.description: Samsung store age-data test requests query this provider with a test option and receive preset age and supervision responses.
en.disableEffect: HIVE's preset Samsung age-data test responses will no longer be available.

zh-CN.description: Samsung 商店的年龄信息测试请求会带测试选项查询此 Provider，并获得预设的年龄和监护状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: HIVE 预设的 Samsung 年龄信息测试响应将不可用。

en.description: Hive Promotion opens this screen when a promotion requests a video. It plays the requested clip and returns whether playback finished, was cancelled, or could not start.
en.disableEffect: Hive promotional videos will not play; this removes that promotional content but does not disable the game's other Hive features.

zh-CN.description: Hive Promotion 请求播放视频时会打开此界面。它播放相应的视频，并向应用返回播放已结束、已取消或无法启动的结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Hive 推广视频将无法播放；这只会移除该推广内容，不会关闭游戏的其他 Hive 功能。

en.description: HIVE opens this screen to play a promotional YouTube video, with options for autoplay, looping, and a timed close button.
en.disableEffect: HIVE promotional videos cannot play or return a completion result.

zh-CN.description: HIVE 使用此界面播放宣传用 YouTube 视频，并可设置自动播放、循环播放和关闭按钮的显示时间。
zh-CN.disableEffect: HIVE 宣传视频将无法播放，也无法返回播放完成结果。

en.description: HIVE opens this screen for in-game news and promotions; it displays banner, notice, offerwall, or web pages and can present forced notices.
en.disableEffect: HIVE announcements, promotion pages, offerwalls, and forced notices cannot open.

zh-CN.description: HIVE 使用此界面展示游戏内新闻和活动，包括横幅、公告、任务墙或网页，也可展示强制通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: HIVE 公告、活动页面、任务墙和强制通知将无法打开。

en.description: When a user opens a HIVE push notification, this activity records the open, clears the badge, and launches the configured game screen or web link.
en.disableEffect: HIVE push notifications will not be able to open their target screen or link.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 HIVE 推送通知时，此界面会记录打开情况、清除角标，并跳转到指定的游戏页面或网页。
zh-CN.disableEffect: HIVE 推送通知将无法跳转到指定页面或链接。

en.description: When a user presses a HIVE notification action, this receiver dismisses the notification and can queue its URL to open when a network connection is available.
en.disableEffect: HIVE notification buttons will not dismiss notifications or open their linked pages.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击 HIVE 通知操作按钮时，此 Receiver 会关闭通知，并可在网络可用时安排打开其中的链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: HIVE 通知按钮将无法关闭通知或打开相关链接。

en.description: Amazon Device Messaging sends push and registration callbacks to this service, which passes message data into HIVE push handling.
en.disableEffect: HIVE remote push delivery and Amazon device registration will stop working.

zh-CN.description: Amazon 设备消息服务会将推送和注册回调发送到此 Service，由它把消息交给 HIVE 推送处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: HIVE 远程推送和 Amazon 设备注册将停止工作。

en.description: When Amazon's job-based messaging service delivers a push, this service passes it into HIVE push handling and saves token updates.
en.disableEffect: HIVE remote push delivery through Amazon's job-based service will stop working.

zh-CN.description: Amazon 以 Job 方式送达推送时，此 Service 会将消息交给 HIVE 处理并保存令牌更新。
zh-CN.disableEffect: HIVE 将无法通过 Amazon 的 Job 消息服务接收远程推送。

en.description: Amazon Device Messaging sends registration and receive broadcasts to this receiver, which routes them to HIVE's message handlers.
en.disableEffect: HIVE Amazon push registration and message delivery will stop working.

zh-CN.description: Amazon 设备消息服务会将注册和收信广播发送到此 Receiver，再由它转交给 HIVE 消息处理器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: HIVE 的 Amazon 推送注册和消息接收将停止工作。

en.description: Firebase sends HIVE push messages to this service, which passes their data into HIVE notification handling.
