en.disableEffect: HIVE push messages delivered through this Firebase service will no longer be received.

zh-CN.description: Firebase 会将 HIVE 推送消息发送到此 Service，由它把消息交给 HIVE 通知处理流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过此 Firebase Service 送达的 HIVE 推送消息将无法接收。

en.description: Firebase sends HIVE push messages to this service, which passes their data into HIVE notification handling.
en.disableEffect: HIVE push messages delivered through this Firebase service will no longer be received.

zh-CN.description: Firebase 会将 HIVE 推送消息发送到此 Service，由它把消息交给 HIVE 通知处理流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过此 Firebase Service 送达的 HIVE 推送消息将无法接收。

en.description: Android sends this receiver boot and clock-change events; it restores or adjusts alarms for scheduled HIVE local notifications.
en.disableEffect: Scheduled HIVE local notifications may not be restored after a restart or time change.

zh-CN.description: Android 在开机或系统时间变化时通知此 Receiver；它会恢复或调整 HIVE 本地通知的闹钟。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 设备重启或系统时间变化后，HIVE 计划中的本地通知可能无法恢复或按时触发。

en.description: When a scheduled HIVE local-notification alarm fires, this receiver marks it as a local push and broadcasts its configured action to HIVE listeners.
en.disableEffect: Scheduled HIVE local-push actions will no longer be delivered.

zh-CN.description: HIVE 计划的本地通知闹钟触发时，此 Receiver 会将其标记为本地推送，并把预设操作广播给 HIVE 监听器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: HIVE 计划的本地推送操作将无法送达。

en.description: HIVE uses this screen for interactive flows such as sign-in, age checks, social pages, photo selection, and its in-app browser.
en.disableEffect: HIVE sign-in, age-check, social, photo-selection, or browser flows that use this screen may fail.

zh-CN.description: HIVE 使用此界面处理登录、年龄验证、社交页面、选图和内置浏览器等交互流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此界面的 HIVE 登录、年龄验证、社交、选图或浏览器流程可能会失败。

en.description: HIVE uses this screen for sign-in flows that keep the previous app screen visible; the X sign-in activity uses it.
en.disableEffect: HIVE sign-in flows that use this screen, including X sign-in, will not complete.

zh-CN.description: HIVE 使用此界面处理需要保留原应用画面的登录流程；X 登录界面也使用它。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此界面的 HIVE 登录流程（包括 X 登录）将无法完成。

en.description: Hive opens this screen when a user taps a campaign link from a browser or another app. It saves the link for Hive user-engagement features, then opens the installed app.
en.disableEffect: Tapping those links may no longer reopen the app or pass along the saved campaign destination.

zh-CN.description: 用户从浏览器或其他应用点击活动链接时，Hive 会打开此界面。它会为 Hive 用户互动功能保存链接，然后打开已安装的应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 点击这些链接时，应用可能无法重新打开，也无法取得已保存的活动目标页面。

en.description: After a player shares through WeChat from the YYXXGame YYXX Comm sharing SDK, WeChat returns here with the result; this Activity reports whether the share succeeded, was cancelled, or failed.
en.disableEffect: The WeChat share result is not returned to the YYXX Comm SDK, so the in-app sharing flow may not complete.

zh-CN.description: 玩家通过 YYXXGame 的 YYXX 通信分享 SDK 分享到微信后，微信会把结果返回此 Activity；它会通知 SDK 分享成功、已取消或失败。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 微信分享结果无法返回 YYXX 通信 SDK，应用内的分享流程可能无法完成。

en.description: CloneAgain's AndroLib sample app registers this Activity as its launcher; starting the app displays its main screen.
en.disableEffect: The app loses this launcher screen, so its normal entry point may no longer open.

zh-CN.description: CloneAgain 的 AndroLib 示例应用将此 Activity 设为启动页；打开应用时会显示主界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用会失去这个启动界面，常规入口可能无法打开。

en.description: HPUHSP QRScanner opens this camera screen when the app requests a scan, reads a code, and returns the scanned text to the calling screen.
en.disableEffect: Scanning and returning a code through HPUHSP QRScanner no longer works.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求扫码时，HPUHSP 的 QRScanner 会打开相机页面、读取码内容，并将扫描结果返回给发起页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，HPUHSP QRScanner 无法完成扫码并返回结果。

en.description: When a Hongxin incoming call arrives while the phone is locked, this activity appears over the lock screen and presents the call dialog.
en.disableEffect: Incoming calls will not show their call controls over the lock screen.

zh-CN.description: 手机锁屏时收到 Hongxin 来电，此页面会显示在锁屏上方并呈现来电对话框。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，来电时锁屏上方将不会显示通话控件。

en.description: In older releases of the Hongxin video SDK, this service posts an ongoing notification when started so the service can remain in the foreground while the app is away.
en.disableEffect: The SDK may lose this background keep-alive and become less reliable while the app is closed.

zh-CN.description: 在较早版本的 Hongxin 视频 SDK 中，此服务启动后会显示持续通知，使应用离开前台时服务仍可保持运行。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，SDK 可能无法维持此后台常驻服务，应用关闭时的后台运行会不稳定。

en.description: During a Hongxin call, this service posts an ongoing call notification using the configured title and text; tapping it opens the SDK's call entry screen.
en.disableEffect: The ongoing-call notification and its shortcut back to the call screen will stop working.

zh-CN.description: Hongxin 通话期间，此服务会按配置显示持续来电通知；点击通知可返回 SDK 的通话页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，持续通话通知及其返回通话页面的入口将无法使用。

en.description: When the user taps a Hongxin call notification, this activity checks the current call or meeting state and brings the appropriate call, meeting, or app screen forward.
en.disableEffect: Tapping Hongxin call notifications will no longer open the right call or meeting screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击 Hongxin 通话通知时，此页面会检查当前通话或会议状态，并将相应的通话、会议或应用页面带到前台。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，点击 Hongxin 通话通知将无法打开对应的通话或会议页面。

en.description: When started, Hongxin's background connection service shows an ongoing notification and keeps its communication connection active for wake-up events.
en.disableEffect: The SDK may not keep its background connection alive, so wake-up events can be missed while the app is closed.

zh-CN.description: 启动后，Hongxin 后台连接服务会显示持续通知，并维持通信连接以接收唤醒事件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，SDK 可能无法维持后台连接，应用关闭时可能错过唤醒事件。

en.description: When Hongxin receives a wake-up push, this receiver passes it to the background connection helper so the connection can be restored.
en.disableEffect: Hongxin wake-up pushes will no longer restore the SDK's background connection.

zh-CN.description: Hongxin 收到唤醒推送时，此接收器会将消息交给后台连接组件以恢复连接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，Hongxin 唤醒推送将无法恢复 SDK 的后台连接。

en.description: In older Hongxin video SDK releases, an incoming call while the screen is locked opens this activity to show the call dialog over the lock screen.
en.disableEffect: Incoming calls will not show their call controls over the lock screen.

zh-CN.description: 在较早版本的 Hongxin 视频 SDK 中，锁屏时收到来电会打开此页面，并在锁屏上方显示通话对话框。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，来电时锁屏上方将不会显示通话控件。

en.description: When a Hongxin wake-up push arrives, this receiver asks the SDK's background connection to resume after a short delay.
en.disableEffect: Wake-up pushes will no longer restart the Hongxin background connection.

zh-CN.description: Hongxin 收到唤醒推送后，此接收器会短暂延迟，再请求 SDK 恢复后台连接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，唤醒推送将无法重启 Hongxin 后台连接。

en.description: When a user starts a Hongxin call, this dial pad accepts a phone number and can place the call or invite that number by text message.
en.disableEffect: The Hongxin dial pad will not be available for placing calls or sending text invitations.

zh-CN.description: 用户发起 Hongxin 通话时，此拨号页面可输入电话号码、拨打电话或通过短信邀请该号码。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，Hongxin 拨号页面无法拨打电话或发送短信邀请。

en.description: During a Hongxin video meeting, this activity shows the meeting room, participants, and controls for managing the live session.
en.disableEffect: The Hongxin meeting screen and its in-meeting controls will not be available.

zh-CN.description: Hongxin 视频会议期间，此页面会显示会议室、参会者以及管理实时会议的控件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，Hongxin 会议页面及会议中的操作控件将无法使用。

en.description: During a one-to-one Hongxin video call, this screen shows the other participant and provides camera, microphone, and speaker controls.
en.disableEffect: The Hongxin one-to-one video-call screen and its controls will not be available.

zh-CN.description: Hongxin 一对一视频通话期间，此页面会显示对方，并提供摄像头、麦克风和扬声器控件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，Hongxin 一对一视频通话页面及其控件将无法使用。

en.description: During a one-to-one Hongxin voice call, this screen shows the other participant and provides microphone and speaker controls.
en.disableEffect: The Hongxin one-to-one voice-call screen and its controls will not be available.

zh-CN.description: Hongxin 一对一语音通话期间，此页面会显示对方，并提供麦克风和扬声器控件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，Hongxin 一对一语音通话页面及其控件将无法使用。

en.description: When the Hongxin meeting invitation screen opens, it loads the organization's contact list and lets the user select meeting participants.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to choose contacts from this Hongxin invitation screen.

zh-CN.description: Hongxin 会议邀请页面打开时，会加载组织通讯录并让用户选择参会者。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，用户无法通过此 Hongxin 邀请页面选择联系人。

en.description: When Hongxin call setup opens this picker, it loads user contact information and lets the user choose recipients.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to select contacts through this Hongxin picker.

zh-CN.description: Hongxin 通话设置打开此选择页面时，会加载用户联系人信息并让用户选择接收对象。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，用户无法通过此 Hongxin 页面选择联系人。

en.description: When a user starts a Hongxin call, this dial pad accepts a phone number and can place the call or invite that number by text message.
en.disableEffect: The Hongxin dial pad will not be available for placing calls or sending text invitations.

zh-CN.description: 用户发起 Hongxin 通话时，此拨号页面可输入电话号码、拨打电话或通过短信邀请该号码。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，Hongxin 拨号页面无法拨打电话或发送短信邀请。

en.description: When a Hongxin meeting opens, this activity displays the active meeting and controls for participants, audio and video, chat, and invitations.
en.disableEffect: The Hongxin meeting screen and its in-meeting controls will not be available.

zh-CN.description: Hongxin 会议打开时，此页面会显示正在进行的会议，以及参会者、音视频、聊天和邀请控件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，Hongxin 会议页面及会议中的操作控件将无法使用。

en.description: Horntell Cards opens Google's account picker when a card flow requests an email address, then returns the selected email to that card flow.
en.disableEffect: Horntell cards cannot collect a Google email through this screen, while the host app's other features remain available.

zh-CN.description: Horntell Cards 在卡片流程需要邮箱时会打开 Google 账号选择器，并将选中的邮箱交回该卡片流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Horntell 卡片无法通过此界面收集 Google 邮箱，但应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: Horntell Cards opens Google sign-in when a card requests authentication, then returns the selected account's email and sign-in token to that card.
en.disableEffect: Google sign-in for Horntell cards stops working, while the host app's separate sign-in remains available.

zh-CN.description: 当 Horntell 卡片请求身份验证时，该界面会打开 Google 登录，并把所选账号的邮箱和登录令牌交回卡片流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Horntell 卡片的 Google 登录将无法使用，但应用自身的登录功能仍可使用。

en.description: Horntell Cards opens Android's permission prompt for a card flow, including the SDK's request to read contacts.
en.disableEffect: Horntell card flows that need the requested permission stop working, but the host app's other features remain available.

zh-CN.description: Horntell Cards 会为卡片流程打开 Android 权限提示，包括 SDK 请求读取联系人的权限。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要该权限的 Horntell 卡片流程将无法使用，但应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: When Horntell sends a card update, this receiver routes new cards to Horntell Cards and prevents the same update from being handled more than once.
en.disableEffect: Horntell cards will no longer be delivered to or shown by the SDK, while the host app's other features remain available.

zh-CN.description: Horntell 发来卡片更新时，此接收器会将新卡片交给 Horntell Cards，并避免同一更新被重复处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Horntell SDK 将不再接收或显示卡片，但应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: Horntell Cards schedules this receiver to check its live connection; when the network is available, it checks that the connection responds and restarts the service if needed.
en.disableEffect: Horntell card updates may not recover after the live connection is interrupted.

zh-CN.description: Horntell Cards 会定期触发此接收器检查实时连接；网络可用时，它会检查连接是否正常，并在需要时重启连接服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 实时连接中断后，Horntell 卡片更新可能无法自动恢复。

en.description: When a card needs backup handling, this receiver passes the pending request to Horntell's card service.
en.disableEffect: Cards that need fallback handling may not reach Horntell Cards, while the host app's other features remain available.

zh-CN.description: 卡片需要备用处理时，此接收器会把待处理请求转交给 Horntell 卡片服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要备用处理的卡片可能无法交给 Horntell Cards，但应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: When Android reports a connectivity change, Horntell Cards receives the current network state so it can react to disconnection and reconnection.
en.disableEffect: Horntell's network and reconnection behavior may not respond promptly to connectivity changes.

zh-CN.description: Android 报告网络状态变化时，Horntell Cards 会收到当前连接状态，以便处理断网和重新连接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Horntell 可能无法及时响应网络变化或恢复连接。

en.description: When another Horntell component asks to open the panel, Horntell Cards opens its floating card panel.
en.disableEffect: The Horntell floating card panel cannot be opened through this action, while the host app's other features remain available.

zh-CN.description: Horntell 的其他组件请求打开面板时，Horntell Cards 会显示悬浮卡片面板。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 无法通过此操作打开 Horntell 悬浮卡片面板，但应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: After Android reports that the device has booted, Horntell Cards reads its saved credentials and sets up its connection checks again.
en.disableEffect: Horntell's scheduled connection checks will not be restored after a reboot, so cards may not resume until the app starts.

zh-CN.description: Android 发出设备启动完成通知后，Horntell Cards 会读取已保存的凭据并重新设置连接检查。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 设备重启后 Horntell 不会恢复定时连接检查，卡片可能要等应用再次启动才会恢复。

en.description: When a Horntell card is marked as seen or read, this receiver syncs that status through Horntell's live connection and handles requests for more cards.
en.disableEffect: Horntell may not sync card read and seen statuses or respond to requests for cards.

zh-CN.description: Horntell 卡片被标记为已看或已读时，此接收器会通过 Horntell 实时连接同步状态，并处理获取更多卡片的请求。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Horntell 可能无法同步卡片的已读和已看状态，也无法响应卡片请求。

en.description: When Horntell Cards' scheduled diagnostic alarm fires, this receiver uploads a saved error report if the device is online or marks it for retry.
en.disableEffect: Horntell diagnostic reports will no longer upload automatically.

zh-CN.description: Horntell Cards 的定时诊断提醒触发时，设备联网则此接收器会上传已保存的错误报告，否则会标记为待重试。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Horntell 诊断报告将不再自动上传。

en.description: Horntell Cards starts this background service to maintain a live connection, receive new and older cards, and sync delivery, read, and other card events.
en.disableEffect: Live Horntell cards and their status updates will stop arriving or syncing, while the host app's other features remain available.

zh-CN.description: Horntell Cards 会启动此后台服务维持实时连接、接收新旧卡片，并同步送达、已读等卡片事件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Horntell 实时卡片及其状态将停止接收或同步，但应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: When Horntell Cards' scheduled alarm fires, this receiver uploads a saved error report if the device is online or marks it for retry.
en.disableEffect: Horntell diagnostic reports will no longer upload automatically.

zh-CN.description: Horntell Cards 的定时提醒触发时，设备联网则此接收器会上传已保存的错误报告，否则会标记为待重试。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Horntell 诊断报告将不再自动上传。

en.description: Horntell Cards schedules this receiver to check its live connection; when the network is available, it checks that the connection responds and restarts the service if needed.
en.disableEffect: Horntell card updates may not recover after the live connection is interrupted.

zh-CN.description: Horntell Cards 会定期触发此接收器检查实时连接；网络可用时，它会检查连接是否正常，并在需要时重启连接服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 实时连接中断后，Horntell 卡片更新可能无法自动恢复。

en.description: Horntell Cards starts this foreground service to initialize card handling, fetch the user's Horntell profile, and show an ongoing unread-card notification; it also receives new card broadcasts.
en.disableEffect: Horntell's card panel and unread-card notification will stop working, while the host app's other features remain available.

zh-CN.description: Horntell Cards 会启动此前台服务来初始化卡片处理、获取用户的 Horntell 资料并显示未读卡片通知；新卡片广播也由它处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Horntell 卡片面板和未读卡片通知将无法使用，但应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: Horntell Zed starts this background service when it needs to run its live connection task.
en.disableEffect: Horntell Zed's background connection task will not run, while the host app's unrelated features remain available.

zh-CN.description: Horntell Zed 需要运行实时连接任务时，会启动此后台服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Horntell Zed 的后台连接任务将无法运行，但应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: When Horntell Cards' scheduled diagnostic alarm fires, this receiver uploads a saved error report if the device is online or marks it for retry.
en.disableEffect: Horntell diagnostic reports will no longer upload automatically.

zh-CN.description: Horntell Cards 的定时诊断提醒触发时，设备联网则此接收器会上传已保存的错误报告，否则会标记为待重试。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Horntell 诊断报告将不再自动上传。

en.description: When Horntell Zed's download alarm fires, this receiver fetches an update needed by the Zed agent and schedules another attempt if the download fails.
en.disableEffect: Horntell Zed may not get needed updates, while the host app's unrelated features remain available.

zh-CN.description: Horntell Zed 的下载提醒触发时，此接收器会获取 Zed 运行所需的更新；下载失败后会安排再次尝试。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Horntell Zed 可能无法获取所需更新，但应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: The Hovans support library opens a custom sharing screen from the app's share link, lists apps that accept text, and sends the entered message and optional link to the selected app.
en.disableEffect: The app's custom share flow cannot open or send its message and link.

zh-CN.description: Hovans 支持库会通过应用的分享链接打开自定义分享界面，列出可接收文本的应用，并将输入的消息和可选链接发送到所选应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用的自定义分享流程将无法打开，也无法发送消息和链接。

en.description: Tengjijing VideoPlayerLib opens a playback screen for a video address and title supplied by the app, with full-screen and orientation controls.
en.disableEffect: Videos assigned to this screen will not play in the app.

zh-CN.description: Tengjijing VideoPlayerLib 会根据应用传入的视频地址和标题打开播放页面，并支持全屏和方向切换。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 分配给此页面播放的视频将无法在应用中播放。

en.description: When an app schedules a timed task with Htjy Base Library, this receiver notifies the app when the scheduled time arrives.
en.disableEffect: Scheduled actions that rely on this receiver may not run at the chosen time.

zh-CN.description: 应用通过 Htjy 基础库安排的定时操作到点后，此接收器会通知应用处理相应事件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此接收器的定时操作可能无法按时触发。

en.description: HTTP Monitor (Jiang Junmin) adds a launcher shortcut for its saved HTTP-traffic screen. Tapping the shortcut opens the monitor's request list.
en.disableEffect: The HTTP-monitor shortcut will no longer appear in the launcher.

zh-CN.description: HTTP Monitor（Jiang Junmin）会在启动器中添加已保存网络流量界面的快捷方式。点击快捷方式会打开请求清单。
zh-CN.disableEffect: HTTP Monitor 的快捷方式将不再显示在启动器中。

en.description: EasyPhotos (Joker-Fu’s photo picker) opens this camera screen when a user chooses to take a photo or video; it uses either the phone’s camera app or EasyPhotos’ built-in camera and returns the captured media to the picker.
en.disableEffect: Users can no longer take a new photo or video from EasyPhotos, although choosing existing media remains available.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 EasyPhotos（Joker-Fu 的照片选择 SDK）中选择拍照或录像时会打开此相机界面；它会调用手机相机或使用 SDK 自带相机，并将拍摄结果返回给选择界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法再通过 EasyPhotos 拍摄照片或视频，但仍可选择已有媒体。

en.description: EasyPhotos opens this album picker when the app asks users to choose media. It lists local photo albums, may offer a camera shortcut, and returns selected photos or, when configured for video selection, videos.
en.disableEffect: The app will lose this media-picker screen and its in-picker camera shortcut.

zh-CN.description: 应用要求用户选择媒体时，EasyPhotos 会打开此相册选择界面。它会列出本地照片相册、按配置提供相机入口，并将选中的照片或视频交还给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法使用此媒体选择界面及其中的相机入口。

en.description: EasyPhotos opens this full-screen preview from the picker so users can browse images, adjust their selection, and confirm which items to return.
en.disableEffect: The app’s image picker will no longer provide this preview and review step.

zh-CN.description: 用户从选择界面查看照片时，EasyPhotos 会打开此全屏预览，让用户浏览图片、调整选择并确认要交给应用的内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用的图片选择流程将失去此预览和确认步骤。

en.description: EasyPhotos opens this collage editor after users choose photos for a collage. They can select a layout, adjust and rotate photos, add stickers or text, and save the finished image.
en.disableEffect: The app will lose EasyPhotos’ collage editing and export flow.

zh-CN.description: 用户选好拼图照片后，EasyPhotos 会打开此拼图编辑界面。用户可以选择布局、调整和旋转照片、添加贴纸或文字，并保存完成的图片。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法使用 EasyPhotos 的拼图编辑和导出流程。

en.description: When users choose collage creation in EasyPhotos, this screen shows albums and photos so they can choose which images to combine before entering the editor.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to select source photos for EasyPhotos collages through this screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 EasyPhotos 中选择制作拼图时，此界面会显示相册和照片，供用户选择要组合的图片，然后进入编辑界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此界面选择 EasyPhotos 拼图所需的照片。

en.description: At app startup, this EasyPhotos (Joker-Fu’s photo picker) file component initializes the picker; it also provides file links used to return photos and videos captured with EasyPhotos.
en.disableEffect: The photo picker may not start correctly, and captured photos or videos may not return to it.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，此 EasyPhotos（Joker-Fu 的照片选择 SDK）文件组件会初始化照片选择功能，也会为 EasyPhotos 拍摄的照片和视频提供返回应用所需的文件地址。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，照片选择功能可能无法正常启动，拍摄的照片或视频也可能无法返回选择界面。

en.description: Android creates this provider during app startup, and it starts Huawei AppGallery Connect Performance Management (APMS) monitoring.
en.disableEffect: APMS performance monitoring and measurement collection will stop, while the host app's regular features remain available.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时 Android 会创建此 Provider，并由它启动华为 AppGallery Connect 性能管理服务（APMS）的监控。
zh-CN.disableEffect: APMS 性能监控和数据采集将停止，但应用的常规功能仍可使用。

en.description: Huawei AGConnect Core uses this service to discover and register the Huawei modules included in the app, such as authentication, API access, A/B testing, and crash reporting.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it can prevent AGConnect modules from initializing and may break app sign-in or other features that rely on those services.

zh-CN.description: 华为 AGConnect Core 会通过此服务发现并注册应用中集成的华为模块，例如身份验证、API、A/B 测试和崩溃报告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后 AGConnect 模块可能无法初始化，进而影响应用登录或其他依赖这些服务的功能。

en.description: Huawei AGConnect initializes this provider at app startup to prepare AGConnect services for the app.
en.disableEffect: Features that rely on Huawei AGConnect may fail to initialize or become unavailable.

zh-CN.description: Huawei AGConnect 会在应用启动时通过此 Provider 初始化服务，供应用后续使用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖 Huawei AGConnect 的功能可能无法初始化或无法使用。

en.description: Huawei’s HMS Agent opens this Activity when an HMS connection error needs user attention, shows Huawei’s repair flow, and returns the result to the agent.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot complete Huawei’s connection-repair flow, so Huawei services that need the repair, including push, may remain unavailable.

zh-CN.description: 华为 HMS Agent 会在 HMS 连接错误需要用户处理时打开此 Activity，显示华为的修复流程并接收处理结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法完成华为连接修复流程，因此需要该修复的华为服务（包括推送）可能无法使用。

en.description: When Huawei Push Kit refreshes a token or delivers a message, this Tencent TPNS service passes the token or message into the app's TPNS push handling.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it stops TPNS from registering or receiving messages through Huawei Push Kit.

zh-CN.description: 华为推送令牌更新或消息到达时，这个腾讯 TPNS 服务会把令牌或消息交给应用中的 TPNS 推送处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，TPNS 将无法通过华为推送渠道登记令牌或接收消息。

en.description: At app startup, Huawei Open Device checks whether Push Kit auto-initialization is enabled and, if so, starts push registration for the app.
en.disableEffect: Huawei Push Kit may no longer register the app for notifications automatically.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，Huawei Open Device 会检查是否启用 Push Kit 自动初始化；如果已启用，就开始为应用注册推送。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Huawei Push Kit 可能无法再自动为应用注册通知推送。

en.description: This Huawei Account Kit Activity is opened when an app requests Huawei account sign-in through HMS. It checks the request, opens Huawei's sign-in screen, and returns the sign-in result.
en.disableEffect: Apps that use Huawei account sign-in can no longer complete that login flow.

zh-CN.description: 这是华为 Account Kit 的登录 Activity，在应用通过 HMS 请求华为帐号登录时打开。它会检查登录请求、打开华为帐号登录界面，并把结果返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖华为帐号登录的应用将无法完成该登录流程。

en.description: Huawei Mobile Services (HMS) opens this Activity when a service flow needs a temporary screen and a result returned to the app.
en.disableEffect: HMS flows that use this screen cannot complete or return their result when it is disabled.

zh-CN.description: 华为移动服务（HMS）的某项服务需要打开临时页面并将操作结果返回应用时，会启动此 Activity。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，依赖此页面的 HMS 服务流程无法完成或返回结果。

en.description: When an app needs a Huawei service enabled, Huawei Mobile Services uses this screen to show service setup.
en.disableEffect: HMS flows that need this service setup screen may not be able to complete setup.

zh-CN.description: 应用需要启用 Huawei 服务时，Huawei Mobile Services 会使用此页面显示服务设置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要此服务设置页面的 HMS 流程可能无法完成设置。

en.description: At app startup, Huawei HiAnalytics checks the app's saved analytics settings and starts event reporting when analytics is enabled.
en.disableEffect: Huawei analytics will not initialize automatically, so event reporting can stop; the app's other features continue to work.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，华为 HiAnalytics 会检查已保存的分析设置，并在分析功能启用时启动事件上报。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，华为分析功能不会自动初始化，事件上报可能停止；应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: When it receives Huawei Ads event broadcasts, Huawei HiAnalytics records ad requests, displays, clicks, and reward events for analytics.
en.disableEffect: These Huawei Ads events will no longer be sent to analytics; ad display and other app features can continue.

zh-CN.description: 收到华为广告发送的事件广播时，华为 HiAnalytics 会记录广告请求、展示、点击和奖励事件，供统计分析使用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，这些华为广告事件不会再发送给分析服务；广告展示和应用的其他功能仍可继续。

en.description: When the app starts a scan, Huawei Scan Kit opens a camera view, reads a barcode or QR code, and returns the scan result.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot complete code-scanning flows that depend on Huawei Scan Kit.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动扫码时，华为 Scan Kit 会打开相机扫描界面，读取条码或二维码并将结果返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，依赖华为 Scan Kit 的扫码功能无法完成。

en.description: This Huawei ID Activity is opened for an HMS Huawei ID sign-in request. It checks HMS Core availability, opens Huawei ID sign-in, and returns the account result to the app.
en.disableEffect: Apps that rely on Huawei ID sign-in can no longer complete that authentication flow.

zh-CN.description: 这是华为 ID 的登录 Activity，在 HMS 收到华为 ID 登录请求时打开。它会检查 HMS Core 是否可用、启动华为 ID 登录界面，并将帐号结果返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖华为 ID 登录的应用将无法完成该认证流程。

en.description: When the app requests Huawei ML Kit speech recognition, this screen listens for speech and returns recognized text or an error.
en.disableEffect: Voice dictation and other speech-recognition flows that use this screen will not complete.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求华为 ML Kit 语音识别时，此界面会收听语音，并将识别出的文字或错误返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，使用此界面的语音输入和语音识别流程无法完成。

en.description: At app startup, this provider prepares Huawei ML Kit for the app screens that use its machine-learning features.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it can prevent Huawei ML Kit screens and tasks from starting or completing correctly.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，此 Provider 会为使用机器学习功能的华为 ML Kit 页面做启动准备。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，华为 ML Kit 的页面或任务可能无法正常启动或完成。

en.description: When the app starts a face-liveness check, Huawei ML Kit opens a camera screen and guides the user through face capture, then returns a result or error.
en.disableEffect: The app's Huawei face-liveness verification flow cannot complete.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动人脸活体检测时，华为 ML Kit 会打开相机界面并引导用户采集人脸，随后返回检测结果或错误。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用中的华为人脸活体验证流程无法完成。

en.description: When the app opens place search, Huawei Site Kit shows suggestions as the user types, looks up the selected place, and returns its information.
en.disableEffect: Place-search flows that rely on this screen will no longer return a selected place.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开地点搜索时，华为 Site Kit 会随用户输入显示建议，查询选中的地点并返回地点信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，依赖此界面的地点搜索流程无法返回所选地点。

en.description: Huawei’s legacy HMS Push SDK sends self-displayed push notifications here so the SDK can process and show them.
en.disableEffect: Legacy Huawei push notifications will no longer be processed or shown.

zh-CN.description: 华为旧版 HMS 推送 SDK 会将需要自行显示的推送通知发送到此 Receiver，由 SDK 处理并显示。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 华为旧版推送通知将无法再处理或显示。

en.description: Huawei Push Kit uses this Receiver to display or handle incoming notifications, including messages delivered later by the system.
en.disableEffect: Huawei push notifications may stop appearing or responding to notification actions.

zh-CN.description: Huawei Push Kit 会通过此 Receiver 显示或处理收到的通知，包括由系统延后送达的消息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Huawei 推送通知可能不再显示，也可能无法响应通知操作。

en.description: Huawei Push Kit uses this Provider to check the app notification-display preference.
en.disableEffect: Huawei Push Kit may no longer be able to read the app's notification-display setting.

zh-CN.description: Huawei Push Kit 会通过此 Provider 查询应用是否允许显示通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Huawei Push Kit 可能无法再读取应用的通知显示设置。

en.description: Huawei Push Kit receives registration and message broadcasts, then forwards device tokens and incoming messages to the app's push service.
en.disableEffect: Huawei push registration and incoming message delivery will stop working.

zh-CN.description: Huawei Push Kit 通过此 Receiver 接收注册和消息广播，再将设备令牌和收到的消息转交应用的推送服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Huawei 推送注册和消息接收将无法继续工作。

en.description: When a user opens a Huawei push notification, this brief screen passes the notification action to Huawei Push Kit and closes immediately.
en.disableEffect: Huawei notification actions that use this routing step may not open the intended app screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 Huawei 推送通知时，此页面会将通知操作交给 Huawei Push Kit 处理，然后立即关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此转交步骤的 Huawei 通知操作可能无法打开目标应用页面。

en.description: Huawei Push Kit receives messages from HMS Core here; it displays notifications or delivers messages directly to the app.
en.disableEffect: The app will stop receiving Huawei Push Kit notification and pass-through messages through this service.

zh-CN.description: Huawei Push Kit 在此接收 HMS Core 发来的消息；它会显示通知，或将消息直接交付给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法再通过此服务接收 Huawei Push Kit 通知和透传消息。

en.description: When Huawei HMS Core Installer retrieves an update, this provider lets the installer open downloaded update files for installation.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents the installer from reading update files through this provider, so update flows that use it fail.

zh-CN.description: 华为 HMS Core Installer 获取更新后，会通过此 Provider 打开已下载的更新文件以便安装。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，安装程序无法通过此 Provider 读取更新文件，依赖它的更新流程会失败。

en.description: During a Huawei Ads app-install flow, this Activity forwards an AppGallery confirmation request and returns the user’s decision to the ad service.
en.disableEffect: Huawei Ads download flows that need this AppGallery handoff cannot finish; normal app use is unaffected.

zh-CN.description: 华为 Ads 的应用安装流程需要确认时，此 Activity 会转交 AppGallery 的确认请求，并把用户的选择返回广告服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，需要此 AppGallery 交接步骤的华为广告下载流程无法完成；应用的正常功能不受影响。

en.description: When a user opens the information view for a Huawei ad, this Activity displays advertiser details and “why this ad” information.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open this Huawei ad information view; other app features continue.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开华为广告信息页时，此 Activity 会显示广告主资料和“为什么看到此广告”的说明。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法打开华为广告信息页；应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: When a user chooses to give feedback on a Huawei native ad, this Activity opens the ad feedback panel and returns the selected feedback to Huawei Ads.
en.disableEffect: The Huawei ad feedback panel is unavailable; ad display and other app features are unaffected.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择反馈华为原生广告时，此 Activity 会打开广告反馈面板，并将所选反馈返回华为 Ads。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，华为广告反馈面板无法打开；广告展示和应用的其他功能不受影响。

en.description: During Huawei Ads navigation, this short-lived Activity opens and immediately closes as part of an ad handoff.
en.disableEffect: Blocking it interrupts that ad-navigation handoff; other app features remain available.

zh-CN.description: 华为 Ads 进行页面跳转时，会短暂打开此 Activity 并立即关闭，以完成广告流程的交接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，该广告跳转交接会中断；应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: When a Huawei Ads link is opened, this Activity brings the app to the foreground or launches it, then reports the ad-open event.
en.disableEffect: Huawei Ads links will not open or foreground the app through this route; normal app features continue.

zh-CN.description: 打开华为广告链接时，此 Activity 会将应用切到前台或启动应用，然后记录广告打开事件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，华为广告链接无法通过此入口打开或唤起应用；应用的正常功能仍可使用。

en.description: When a user taps a Huawei Ads notification, this Activity passes the notification to Huawei Ads for handling and then closes.
en.disableEffect: Tapping those ad notifications will no longer open their intended ad content.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击华为广告通知时，此 Activity 会把通知交给华为 Ads 处理，然后关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，点击这些广告通知将无法打开对应的广告内容。

en.description: When a user chooses to share a Huawei ad, this Activity displays a share panel with the ad’s title, image, and link.
en.disableEffect: Huawei ad sharing will no longer open; other app features continue.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择分享华为广告时，此 Activity 会显示包含广告标题、图片和链接的分享面板。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，华为广告的分享界面无法打开；应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: When Huawei Ads needs to show an ad page built at runtime, this Activity displays the supplied ad content.
en.disableEffect: Those template-based ad screens will not appear; the rest of the app remains available.

zh-CN.description: 华为 Ads 需要显示运行时生成的广告页面时，此 Activity 会展示广告内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，这类模板广告页面不会显示；应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: When Huawei Ads needs to show an ad screen loaded as part of an ad, this Activity displays that screen.
en.disableEffect: Those dynamically supplied ad screens will not appear; the rest of the app remains available.

zh-CN.description: 华为 Ads 需要显示随广告加载的页面时，此 Activity 会展示该广告界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，这类动态加载的广告界面不会显示；应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: Huawei Ads uses this provider to supply an access token to approved ad-service requests.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents those Huawei Ads requests from receiving the token; unrelated app features continue.

zh-CN.description: 华为 Ads 会通过此 Provider 向获准的广告服务请求提供访问令牌。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，这些华为广告请求无法取得令牌；应用的其他功能不受影响。

en.description: When Huawei Update SDK installs an update package, this provider gives the installer read access to the downloaded APK.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents the installer from opening that package, so Huawei updates that use it fail.

zh-CN.description: 华为 Update SDK 安装更新包时，此 Provider 会向安装程序提供已下载 APK 的读取权限。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，安装程序无法打开该安装包，依赖它的华为更新流程会失败。

en.description: Huawei HMS Update SDK opens this Activity when an app update is requested; it presents the Huawei AppGallery update prompt and can start the download or hand off to the store.
en.disableEffect: The app will not be able to use this Huawei update prompt and download flow.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求更新时，华为 HMS Update SDK 会打开此 Activity，显示华为应用市场的更新提示，并启动下载或转交给应用市场处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用无法使用此华为更新提示和下载流程。

en.description: Huawei HMS Update SDK opens this Activity after downloading an update package; it checks the package file and launches Android's package-install screen.
en.disableEffect: Packages downloaded through Huawei HMS Update SDK will not be installable through this flow.

zh-CN.description: 华为 HMS Update SDK 下载更新包后会打开此 Activity，检查安装文件并启动 Android 的应用安装界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，通过华为 HMS Update SDK 下载的应用包无法通过此流程安装。

en.description: When a user opens HubSpot customer chat or follows a chat notification, this Activity shows the conversation in HubSpot’s in-app web screen and supports attachment selection.
en.disableEffect: The in-app HubSpot conversation and its attachment flow are unavailable.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 HubSpot 客服聊天或点击聊天通知时，此 Activity 会在应用内页面显示对话，并支持选择附件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用内的 HubSpot 对话和附件流程无法使用。

en.description: When Firebase delivers a HubSpot chat message or refreshes its push token, this service registers the token or posts a notification that opens the conversation.
en.disableEffect: HubSpot chat push notifications and notification-based chat opening stop working.

zh-CN.description: Firebase 收到 HubSpot 聊天消息或刷新推送令牌时，此 Service 会注册令牌，或发布可打开对话的通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，HubSpot 聊天推送通知以及通过通知打开对话的功能会停止。

en.description: When the app starts a Hubtel checkout, this Activity displays the configured checkout screen and returns the checkout status to the app.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot complete or return from the Hubtel checkout flow.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动 Hubtel 结账流程时，此 Activity 会显示配置好的结账界面，并将结账状态返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法完成 Hubtel 结账或将结果返回应用。

en.description: When the app opens Huilan AiKF customer service, this screen displays the support conversation.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open or reply in this Huilan support chat.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开 Huilan AiKF 客服时，此界面会显示客服对话。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法打开或回复 Huilan 客服聊天。

en.description: Huilan AiKF starts this service to keep its customer-service chat connected, receive new messages, and show notifications when the app is in the background.
en.disableEffect: Incoming Huilan chat messages and alerts stop, and the live-support connection can be lost.

zh-CN.description: Huilan AiKF 会启动此 Service 以维持客服聊天连接、接收新消息，并在应用处于后台时显示通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Huilan 聊天消息和提醒会停止，实时客服连接也会中断。

en.description: When the app asks Hummingwave ImageCrop for a photo, this screen lets the user take a picture or choose one from the gallery, then begins cropping and returns the image.
en.disableEffect: Photo selection through this SDK will not return a usable cropped image.

zh-CN.description: 应用通过 Hummingwave ImageCrop 获取照片时，此界面允许用户拍照或从图库选择照片，随后开始裁剪并返回图片。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，通过此 SDK 选择照片的流程无法返回可用的裁剪图片。

en.description: When the app passes it a picture, Hummingwave ImageCrop shows a crop editor; saving writes the selected crop and returns its file location.
en.disableEffect: Features that use this editor cannot finish cropping and saving their image.

zh-CN.description: 应用传入图片后，Hummingwave ImageCrop 会显示裁剪编辑界面；保存时写入选定区域并返回文件位置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，使用此编辑器的功能无法完成图片裁剪和保存。

en.description: When the app starts WaveORM database setup, this service reads bundled SQL scripts and asks WaveORM to apply them to the local database.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it stops these setup scripts from being applied, which can break features that depend on their database tables.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动 WaveORM 数据库初始化时，此 Service 会读取随应用提供的 SQL 脚本，并交由 WaveORM 应用到本地数据库。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，这些初始化脚本不会执行，依赖相关数据库表的功能可能无法使用。

en.description: UInspector (Yves Cheung) uses this foreground Service to keep a notification with a control for starting or stopping inspection of the app's screens.
en.disableEffect: The UInspector control notification will not appear, so users cannot toggle screen inspection from it.

zh-CN.description: UInspector（Yves Cheung）通过此前台服务持续显示控制通知，供用户启动或停止检查应用界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: UInspector 控制通知将不再显示，用户无法通过它切换界面检查状态。

en.description: The optional UInspector (Yves Cheung) provider initializes the view-inspection tool in the app's main process when the app starts.
en.disableEffect: The inspector will no longer initialize automatically in the app's main process.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，UInspector（Yves Cheung）的可选 Provider 会在主进程中初始化界面检查工具。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 界面检查工具将不再由该 Provider 在应用主进程中自动初始化。

en.description: Splash screen advertisement shown when the app starts.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时展示的开屏广告。

en.description: When HyperBid displays an ad in landscape orientation, this activity hosts the full-screen ad.
en.disableEffect: HyperBid landscape full-screen ads will not appear.

zh-CN.description: HyperBid 以横屏展示广告时，此界面承载全屏广告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: HyperBid 的横屏全屏广告将无法显示。

en.description: When HyperBid displays a half-screen ad in landscape orientation, this translucent activity hosts the ad window.
en.disableEffect: HyperBid landscape half-screen ads will not appear.

zh-CN.description: HyperBid 以横屏展示半屏广告时，此透明界面承载广告窗口。
zh-CN.disableEffect: HyperBid 的横屏半屏广告将无法显示。

en.description: When HyperBid displays an ad in portrait orientation, this activity hosts the full-screen ad.
en.disableEffect: HyperBid portrait full-screen ads will not appear.

zh-CN.description: HyperBid 以竖屏展示广告时，此界面承载全屏广告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: HyperBid 的竖屏全屏广告将无法显示。

en.description: When HyperBid displays a half-screen ad in portrait orientation, this translucent activity hosts the ad window.
en.disableEffect: HyperBid portrait half-screen ads will not appear.

zh-CN.description: HyperBid 以竖屏展示半屏广告时，此透明界面承载广告窗口。
zh-CN.disableEffect: HyperBid 的竖屏半屏广告将无法显示。

en.description: If a user tries to leave a HyperBid rewarded ad early, this screen asks whether to keep watching or give up.
en.disableEffect: The rewarded-ad exit prompt will be unavailable, and rewards for watching ads will no longer be granted.

zh-CN.description: 用户尝试提前退出 HyperBid 激励广告时，此界面会询问用户是继续观看还是放弃。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 激励广告的退出提示将无法显示，观看广告也将不再获得奖励。

en.description: When HyperBid requests a privacy choice for its ads, this activity loads the privacy policy and returns the selected option to the SDK.
en.disableEffect: HyperBid cannot show its privacy authorization page, so ads that require this choice may not load.

zh-CN.description: HyperBid 为广告请求隐私选项时，此界面会加载隐私政策，并将用户的选择返回给 SDK。
zh-CN.disableEffect: HyperBid 将无法显示隐私授权页面，因此依赖该选择的广告可能无法加载。

en.description: When a user taps a HyperBid ad, this activity opens the advertiser’s page in a built-in browser with navigation and refresh controls.
en.disableEffect: Tapping a HyperBid ad will no longer open its landing page.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击 HyperBid 广告时，此界面会在内置浏览器中打开广告主页面，并提供前进、后退和刷新操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 点击 HyperBid 广告后将无法打开其落地页。

en.description: When HyperBid shows a rewarded video ad, this activity plays the video and reports viewing results to the ad SDK.
en.disableEffect: Rewarded videos will not play, and rewards for watching ads will no longer be granted.

zh-CN.description: HyperBid 展示激励视频广告时，此界面负责播放视频并将观看结果返回给广告 SDK。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 激励视频将无法播放，观看广告也将不再获得奖励。

en.description: When Hypers Consent Manager runs, this provider sets up the consent database and saved settings, including consent version, display time, and user ID.
en.disableEffect: The consent manager cannot read or update its saved choices and history, so its consent flow can fail.

zh-CN.description: Hypers Consent Manager 运行时，此 Provider 会建立同意记录数据库并读取已保存的设置，包括同意版本、展示时间和用户 ID。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，同意管理器无法读取或更新已保存的选择和记录，其同意流程可能失败。

en.description: The Hyperwallet Android Receipt UI opens the receipt list for a selected prepaid card when the app requests that card's history. Choosing a receipt opens its details.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to browse or inspect receipts for that prepaid card.

zh-CN.description: Hyperwallet Android Receipt UI 会在应用打开某张预付卡的记录时显示该卡的收据列表。选择一条收据后可查看详情。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法浏览或查看该预付卡的收据。

en.description: The Hyperwallet Android Receipt UI opens the user's receipt list when the app shows account history. Selecting an entry opens the receipt details.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to browse their account receipt list or open a receipt from it.

zh-CN.description: Hyperwallet Android Receipt UI 会在应用显示账户记录时打开用户的收据列表。选择一条记录后可查看收据详情。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法浏览账户收据列表，也无法从列表打开收据。

en.description: The Hyperwallet Android Receipt UI opens the details of a receipt selected from a receipt list. The screen shows the transaction information supplied with that receipt.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to open transaction receipt details from the Hyperwallet history screens.

zh-CN.description: Hyperwallet Android Receipt UI 会在用户从收据列表中选择记录后显示收据详情。页面展示该收据包含的交易信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法从 Hyperwallet 记录页面打开交易收据详情。

en.description: The Hyperwallet Android Receipt UI opens a combined receipt browser when the app shows transaction history. It provides pages for the account and its prepaid cards when those cards are available.
en.disableEffect: Users will lose the combined receipt history screen and its account and card receipt pages.

zh-CN.description: Hyperwallet Android Receipt UI 会在应用显示交易记录时打开综合收据页面。页面可按账户和可用的预付卡切换记录。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开综合收据页面，也无法查看其中的账户和卡片收据。

en.description: The Hyperwallet Android Transfer UI opens the money-transfer form when the app starts a transfer. It gathers the source, destination, and amount, then moves the user to a review step.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to create and review Hyperwallet transfers in the app.

zh-CN.description: Hyperwallet Android Transfer UI 会在应用发起转账时打开转账表单。页面收集转出来源、收款方式和金额，然后进入确认步骤。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在应用中创建或确认 Hyperwallet 转账。

en.description: During a Hyperwallet transfer, this screen lists available receiving methods for the selected source. Choosing one returns it to the transfer flow, and the screen can also open the method-selection screen to add a new destination.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to choose or add a receiving method while creating a Hyperwallet transfer.

zh-CN.description: 进行 Hyperwallet 转账时，此页面会列出所选转出来源可用的收款方式。用户选择后会返回转账流程，也可以打开方式选择页面添加新的收款方式。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户在创建 Hyperwallet 转账时将无法选择或添加收款方式。

en.description: During a Hyperwallet transfer, this screen lists the available accounts or balances that can fund the transfer. Choosing one returns it to the transfer form.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to select a source for a Hyperwallet transfer.

zh-CN.description: 进行 Hyperwallet 转账时，此页面会列出可用于转账的账户或余额。选择一项后会将其返回转账表单。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法为 Hyperwallet 转账选择转出来源。

en.description: The Hyperwallet Android Transfer UI opens the final review screen for a prepared transfer. Confirming it submits the transfer request and shows the resulting confirmation.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to review, submit, or confirm a Hyperwallet transfer.

zh-CN.description: Hyperwallet Android Transfer UI 会为已准备好的转账打开最终确认页面。用户确认后会提交转账请求并看到处理结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法审核、提交或确认 Hyperwallet 转账。

en.description: When a user adds a Hyperwallet payout method, this screen opens the required country, currency, and method-specific fields and submits the entry.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot add a payout method through the Hyperwallet flow.

zh-CN.description: 用户添加 Hyperwallet 收款方式时，此界面会显示所需的国家、币种和方式相关字段，并提交信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过 Hyperwallet 流程添加收款方式。

en.description: When users manage saved Hyperwallet payout methods, this screen lists them and allows adding or deactivating a method.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot manage or deactivate saved Hyperwallet payout methods.

zh-CN.description: 用户管理已保存的 Hyperwallet 收款方式时，此界面会列出这些方式，并允许添加或停用某项方式。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法管理或停用已保存的 Hyperwallet 收款方式。

en.description: When a user adds a Hyperwallet payout method, this screen lets them choose a country, currency, and method type before opening the details form.
en.disableEffect: New payout-method setup cannot proceed through this Hyperwallet flow.

zh-CN.description: 用户添加 Hyperwallet 收款方式时，可先在此界面选择国家、币种和方式类型，再进入资料填写界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，无法通过此 Hyperwallet 流程继续设置新的收款方式。

en.description: The Hyperwallet Android Transfer Method UI opens a form for adding a payout method when the user chooses to add one. It collects the method's country, currency, type, and required account details.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to add a bank, card, or other payout method through this screen.

zh-CN.description: Hyperwallet Android Transfer Method UI 会在用户选择添加收款方式时打开表单。页面收集国家、币种、方式类型及所需账户资料。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此页面添加银行账户、卡片或其他收款方式。

en.description: The Hyperwallet Android Transfer Method UI lists saved payout methods when the app manages or selects them. From this screen, users can add a method, edit one, or deactivate one.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to manage, edit, deactivate, or select saved payout methods in this flow.

zh-CN.description: Hyperwallet Android Transfer Method UI 会在应用管理或选择收款方式时列出已保存的方式。用户可从此页面添加、修改或停用收款方式。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在此流程中管理、修改、停用或选择已保存的收款方式。

en.description: The Hyperwallet Android Transfer Method UI opens a chooser during transfer setup so the user can select the country, currency, and payout method to add. It returns the chosen method to the transfer flow.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to choose a new payout method when setting up a transfer destination.

zh-CN.description: Hyperwallet Android Transfer Method UI 会在转账设置过程中打开选择页面，让用户选择国家、币种和要添加的收款方式。选定后会将方式返回转账流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户在设置转账收款目标时将无法选择新的收款方式。

en.description: The Hyperwallet Android Transfer Method UI opens an editing form when the user changes a saved payout method. It loads the existing method and saves updated details.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to update saved payout-method details in the app.

zh-CN.description: Hyperwallet Android Transfer Method UI 会在用户修改已保存的收款方式时打开编辑表单。页面读取现有方式并保存更新后的资料。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在应用中更新已保存收款方式的资料。

en.description: The Easemob (Hyphenate) customer-service chat SDK starts or binds this service to maintain background message delivery; boot, unlock, and scheduled jobs can restart it.
en.disableEffect: Support-chat messages may be delayed or missed in the background or after the device restarts.

zh-CN.description: Easemob（Hyphenate）客服聊天 SDK 启动或绑定此 Service 以维持后台消息送达；设备启动、解锁或系统计划任务也会重新启动它。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，应用进入后台或设备重启后，客服聊天消息可能延迟或无法收到。

en.description: Android starts this Easemob Job Service when a scheduled chat job runs; it restarts the SDK's background message service.
en.disableEffect: The scheduled job can no longer restore background chat delivery, so new support messages may be delayed or missed.

zh-CN.description: Android 执行 Easemob 安排的后台聊天任务时会启动此 Job Service，由它重新启动 SDK 的后台消息服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，计划任务无法恢复后台聊天消息送达，新客服消息可能延迟或漏收。

en.description: Android triggers this Easemob receiver when the device boots or the user unlocks it; it restarts the background chat service so support messages can keep arriving.
en.disableEffect: Easemob cannot restore its background message service at boot or unlock, so support messages may be delayed or missed.

zh-CN.description: 设备启动或用户解锁时，Android 会触发此 Easemob Receiver；它会重新启动后台聊天服务，让客服消息继续送达。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，设备启动或解锁时 Easemob 无法通过此 Receiver 恢复后台消息服务，客服消息可能延迟或漏收。

en.description: When the Easemob chatroom UI opens a room’s user-management screen, this Activity shows its members and muted users and lets moderators mute, unmute, or remove participants.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, room member management and moderation controls in this screen will be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: Easemob 聊天室 UI 打开某个聊天室的用户管理页面时，此 Activity 会显示成员和已禁言用户，并允许管理员禁言、解除禁言或移除成员。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，此页面中的聊天室成员管理和审核控制将无法使用。

en.description: When a user opens a combined message in an Easemob conversation, this screen displays the messages bundled inside it and downloads their contents when needed.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, users cannot view the conversation history bundled in a combined message.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Easemob 会话中打开合并消息时，此页面会显示其中打包的聊天记录，并在需要时下载内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法查看合并消息中包含的聊天记录。

en.description: After a user selects a message from Easemob chat search, this screen opens the conversation around that matching message.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, users cannot open a selected search result in its conversation.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Easemob 聊天搜索中选择一条消息后，此页面会打开对应会话并定位到该消息附近。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法在会话中打开选中的搜索结果。

en.description: When a user opens an image in an Easemob chat, this screen shows it at full size and downloads the attachment when it is not on the device.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, users cannot view full-size chat images through this screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Easemob 聊天中打开图片时，此页面会显示大图，并在图片尚未保存在设备上时下载附件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法通过此页面查看聊天图片的大图。

en.description: When a user previews a local video from an Easemob chat, this screen plays the selected video file.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, local chat videos cannot be previewed through this screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户预览 Easemob 聊天中的本地视频时，此页面会播放所选视频文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法通过此页面预览聊天中的本地视频。

en.description: When a user opens a file attachment in an Easemob chat, this screen shows the file and downloads it if the local copy is missing.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, users cannot open or download chat files through this screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Easemob 聊天中打开文件附件时，此页面会显示文件，并在本地没有文件时进行下载。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法通过此页面打开或下载聊天文件。

en.description: When a user opens a video message in an Easemob chat, this screen downloads the video if needed and plays it.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, users cannot watch chat video messages through this screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Easemob 聊天中打开视频消息时，此页面会在需要时下载视频并进行播放。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法通过此页面观看聊天视频消息。

en.description: The Easemob Ease Chat UI kit opens this screen for a one-to-one or group conversation; it displays messages and supports composing text, voice, photo, video, and file messages.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, the kit’s conversation screen and message-composing controls will not open.

zh-CN.description: Easemob Ease Chat UI Kit 会为单聊或群聊打开此页面；页面显示聊天消息，并提供文字、语音、图片、视频和文件消息的编辑功能。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，此 UI Kit 的会话页面和消息编辑控件将无法打开。

en.description: When a user manages blocked contacts in the Easemob chat UI, this screen loads and displays the block list from local data or the server.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, users cannot view or change the chat block list through this screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Easemob 聊天界面管理屏蔽联系人时，此页面会从本地或服务器加载并显示屏蔽列表。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法通过此页面查看或修改聊天屏蔽列表。

en.description: When the Easemob chat UI opens a person’s contact page, this screen checks the local contact list and lets the user start an add-contact request or open more details.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, users cannot start this contact request flow or inspect the person through this screen.

zh-CN.description: Easemob 聊天界面打开某人的联系人页面时，此页面会检查本地联系人列表，并允许用户发起添加联系人请求或查看更多资料。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法通过此页面发起联系人请求或查看该用户资料。

en.description: When a user opens a contact’s details in the Easemob chat UI, this screen shows profile information and offers actions such as muting notifications, blocking the contact, clearing the conversation, or searching messages.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, these contact-management and per-contact conversation actions will be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Easemob 聊天界面打开联系人资料时，此页面会显示个人信息，并提供消息免打扰、屏蔽联系人、清空会话或搜索消息等操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，这些联系人管理和单个会话操作将无法使用。

en.description: When a user starts a group chat in Easemob, this screen lets them search for and select contacts, then creates the group.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, users cannot create a group through the Easemob chat UI.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Easemob 中创建群聊时，此页面允许搜索并选择联系人，然后创建群组。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法通过 Easemob 聊天界面创建群组。

en.description: When a user opens a group’s details in the Easemob chat UI, this screen loads the group information and presents its available group and conversation controls.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, users cannot open group details or use the controls on this screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Easemob 聊天界面打开群组详情时，此页面会加载群组信息并显示可用的群组和会话操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法打开群组详情或使用此页面中的控件。

en.description: When a user chooses to edit group or thread details in the Easemob chat UI, this screen opens the relevant form, including name changes.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, users cannot change group or thread details through this screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Easemob 聊天界面选择编辑群组或话题详情时，此页面会打开相应表单，包括名称修改。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法通过此页面修改群组或话题详情。

en.description: When a user opens the group section of Easemob chat, this screen displays the user’s group conversations.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, users cannot open the group conversation list through this screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 Easemob 聊天的群组页面时，此页面会显示其群组会话列表。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法通过此页面打开群组会话列表。

en.description: When a user opens a group’s member-management screen in Easemob, this Activity lists participants and supports adding, removing, or changing the group owner.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, users cannot manage group members through this screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Easemob 中打开群组成员管理页面时，此 Activity 会列出成员，并支持添加、移除成员或更换群主。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法通过此页面管理群组成员。

en.description: When a user opens Easemob’s new-requests inbox, this screen loads and displays incoming contact requests and related notices.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, users cannot review or respond to new contact requests through this screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 Easemob 的新请求收件箱时，此页面会加载并显示收到的联系人请求及相关通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法通过此页面查看或回应新的联系人请求。

en.description: When a user opens an Easemob contact invitation, this screen shows the requester’s details and lets the user add that contact.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, users cannot view or respond to an invitation through its details screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 Easemob 联系人邀请时，此页面会显示邀请者资料，并允许用户添加该联系人。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法通过邀请详情页面查看或回应邀请。

en.description: When Easemob chat search is opened, this screen searches users, conversations, or messages according to the requested search type; selecting a message opens its result in the conversation.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, the kit’s user, conversation, and message search screens will not open.

zh-CN.description: Easemob 聊天搜索打开时，此页面会按搜索类型查找用户、会话或消息；选择消息后会在会话中打开搜索结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，此 UI Kit 的用户、会话和消息搜索页面将无法打开。

en.description: When a user creates a thread from a conversation message in Easemob, this screen opens a composer linked to that conversation and topic message.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, users cannot start a new thread from a chat message through this screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Easemob 中基于会话消息创建话题时，此页面会打开与该会话和主题消息关联的编辑界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法通过此页面从聊天消息发起新话题。

en.description: When a user opens a thread in Easemob, this screen displays its replies and lets the user continue the discussion.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, users cannot open or reply in chat threads through this screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Easemob 中打开话题时，此页面会显示话题回复，并允许用户继续讨论。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法通过此页面打开话题或参与回复。

en.description: When a user opens the thread list for an Easemob conversation, this screen displays the conversation’s threads.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, users cannot view or enter conversation threads through this screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 Easemob 会话的话题列表时，此页面会显示该会话中的话题。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法通过此页面查看或进入会话话题。

en.description: When a user opens an Easemob thread’s member list, this screen displays its participants and lets an authorized user remove a member or open that person’s details.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, users cannot inspect or manage thread members through this screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 Easemob 话题成员列表时，此页面会显示参与者，并允许有权限的用户移除成员或查看其资料。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法通过此页面查看或管理话题成员。

en.description: When the host app opens a customer-service conversation, the Easemob helpdesk SDK starts this Activity to display the chat for the selected support contact.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot open this customer-service chat screen.

zh-CN.description: 宿主应用打开客户服务对话时，Easemob 客服 SDK 会启动此 Activity，显示与指定客服的聊天界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，应用无法打开此客服聊天界面。

en.description: When a user adds media to an Easemob support chat, this Activity lists device photos and videos and returns the selected attachment to the conversation.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot choose photos or videos from this screen as chat attachments.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Easemob 客服聊天中添加媒体时，此 Activity 会列出设备中的照片和视频，并将选中的附件交回聊天界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，用户无法通过此界面选择照片或视频作为聊天附件。

en.description: When a user opens a locally stored video attachment in Easemob chat, this Activity plays the video.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot play local video attachments in support chats.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Easemob 客服聊天中打开本地视频附件时，此 Activity 会播放该视频。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，用户无法播放客服聊天中的本地视频附件。

en.description: When a user chooses to record video in Easemob chat, this Activity records a clip and returns it to the conversation for sending.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot record and send video clips in support chats.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Easemob 客服聊天中选择录制视频时，此 Activity 会录制片段并交回聊天界面发送。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，用户无法录制并发送客服聊天视频。

en.description: When a user opens an image message, this Easemob helpdesk Activity displays the attached image at full size.
en.disableEffect: Images in support chats can no longer be opened in the large preview.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击聊天中的图片消息时，此 Easemob 客服 Activity 会以大图形式显示图片附件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，客服聊天中的图片无法打开大图预览。

en.description: When a user opens a normal file message, this Easemob helpdesk Activity downloads the attachment and opens it with an app that supports that file type.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot download and open chat files through this screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开普通文件消息时，此 Easemob 客服 Activity 会下载附件，并尝试用支持该文件类型的应用打开。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，用户无法通过此界面下载并打开聊天文件。

en.description: When a user opens a video message, this Easemob helpdesk Activity downloads the video attachment and opens the player.
en.disableEffect: Video attachments in support chats can no longer be downloaded and played.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击视频消息时，此 Easemob 客服 Activity 会下载视频附件并打开播放器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，客服聊天中的视频附件无法下载和播放。

en.description: The Easemob helpdesk SDK uses this Provider to share chat attachments with other apps through file links that grant access to the shared file.
en.disableEffect: Sharing or opening chat attachments that use this provider may fail.

zh-CN.description: Easemob 客服 SDK 通过此 Provider 向其他应用分享聊天附件，并为共享文件提供授权访问链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，依赖此 Provider 的聊天附件分享或打开可能失败。

en.description: When an Easemob customer-service voice or video call starts, this Activity shows the call screen and handles answering, camera controls, and hanging up.
en.disableEffect: Easemob customer-service voice and video calls cannot open or be answered.

zh-CN.description: Easemob 客服语音或视频通话开始时，此 Activity 会显示通话界面并处理接听、摄像头控制和挂断操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，Easemob 客服语音和视频通话无法打开或接听。

en.description: The HyprMX ad SDK shows this page when an ad placement has no offer to display. It provides the offer screen's close and return behavior.
en.disableEffect: The no-offers ad page will not open; the host app's other features remain available.

zh-CN.description: HyprMX 广告 SDK 会在广告位没有可展示的优惠时显示此页面。页面提供关闭和返回操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 没有可用优惠时将不再打开该广告提示页；应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: The HyprMX ad SDK opens this full-screen viewer when an ad or offer is presented. It displays the ad's web creative or offer content and handles its viewing lifecycle.
en.disableEffect: HyprMX full-screen ads and offers will not open; the host app's other features remain available.

zh-CN.description: HyprMX 广告 SDK 会在展示广告或优惠时打开此全屏页面。页面显示广告网页内容或优惠内容，并处理展示过程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: HyprMX 全屏广告和优惠将无法打开；应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: The HyprMX ad SDK opens this form when an offer requires additional answers before it can continue. The form collects the requested information and returns it to the offer flow.
en.disableEffect: Offers that require this information cannot continue through HyprMX; the host app's other features remain available.

zh-CN.description: HyprMX 广告 SDK 会在优惠需要补充资料才能继续时打开此表单。页面收集所需信息并将其返回优惠流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要这些资料的 HyprMX 优惠将无法继续；应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: The HyprMX ad SDK opens this in-app browser for an advertiser's landing page or web-based ad experience. Users can navigate the page and close it from the HyprMX screen.
en.disableEffect: HyprMX ad landing pages will not open in the in-app browser; the host app's other features remain available.

zh-CN.description: HyprMX 广告 SDK 会使用此应用内浏览器打开广告主落地页或网页广告内容。用户可在页面中导航并关闭浏览器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: HyprMX 广告落地页将无法在应用内打开；应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: The HyprMX ad SDK uses this file provider when an ad form opens the system camera or photo picker to choose an image. It gives that app temporary access to the image file.
en.disableEffect: Camera or photo selection in that HyprMX form can fail, and opening its camera option may crash the ad flow.

zh-CN.description: HyprMX 广告 SDK 会在广告表单打开系统相机或照片选择器时使用此文件提供器，让相关应用临时读取图像文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 该 HyprMX 表单中的拍照或选图可能失败，打开相机选项还可能导致广告流程崩溃。

en.description: The HyprMX ad SDK opens this full-screen player when an ad placement supplies a video creative. It plays the video for the ad placement.
en.disableEffect: HyprMX video ads will not play, and rewards for watching ads will no longer be granted.

zh-CN.description: HyprMX 广告 SDK 会在广告位提供视频广告时打开此全屏播放器。页面播放该视频广告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: HyprMX 视频广告将无法播放，观看广告也不会再获得奖励。

en.description: The HyXen AdLocus ad SDK opens this page for in-app ads and ad-notification taps; it shows the ad page or opens the advertised link, and also handles the SDK's ad-setting prompt.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents AdLocus ads, their landing pages, and related notification controls from opening; the host app's other screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: HyXen AdLocus 广告 SDK 在展示应用内广告或用户点击广告通知时打开此页面，显示广告内容或跳转至广告链接，也处理 SDK 的广告设置页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，AdLocus 广告、落地页和相关通知设置无法打开，但宿主应用的其他页面仍可使用。

en.description: The HyXen AdLocus ad SDK opens this screen for a full-screen video ad; it plays the video and closes when playback ends or fails.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents AdLocus video ads from appearing; the app's own screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: HyXen AdLocus 广告 SDK 在播放全屏视频广告时打开此页面；视频结束或加载失败后页面会关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，AdLocus 视频广告无法显示，应用自身页面仍可使用。

en.description: The HyXen AdLocus ad SDK uses this background service for adding and removing monitored regions and checking location changes in earlier releases; the latest analyzed release has no active work here.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it stops location-triggered AdLocus events in releases with geofence handling; it makes no visible difference in the latest analyzed release.

zh-CN.description: HyXen AdLocus 广告 SDK 在较早版本中通过此后台服务添加或移除监控区域并检查位置变化；本次分析的最新版本没有实际处理逻辑。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，包含围栏处理逻辑的版本将停止发送 AdLocus 位置触发事件；本次分析的最新版本不会因此产生可见变化。

en.description: Android starts this HyXen AdLocus push job when its scheduled background task runs; the analyzed implementations only log the start and immediately finish without processing the task.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it has no visible effect in the analyzed releases because this service performs no job work.

zh-CN.description: Android 在 AdLocus 推送任务运行时启动此服务；分析的版本只记录启动信息并立即结束，没有处理后台任务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 本次分析的版本中，此服务没有实际任务逻辑，停用后不会产生可见影响。

en.description: HyXen AdLocus registers this Receiver for device startup and its own push broadcast; after a reboot it restores the SDK's push alarm, while the other broadcast is only logged by the analyzed code.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it stops the AdLocus push alarm from being restored after reboot, so push notifications may not resume.

zh-CN.description: HyXen AdLocus 为此接收器注册了设备启动和 SDK 推送广播；设备重启后它会恢复推送闹钟，分析的代码对另一种广播只作记录。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，设备重启时 AdLocus 不会恢复推送闹钟，推送通知可能无法继续。

en.description: HyXen AdLocus starts this background service for push checks and event messages; it fetches ad content and can post eligible ad notifications.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it stops AdLocus push-ad notifications and their delivery tracking.

zh-CN.description: HyXen AdLocus 在检查推送或收到事件消息时启动此后台服务，获取广告内容并发布符合条件的广告通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，AdLocus 广告推送及其送达记录会停止。

en.description: When a HyXen AdLocus push alarm fires, this Receiver loads SDK settings and initializes the ad repository; its analyzed handler does not itself fetch or display an ad.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it removes this alarm-time AdLocus initialization; no host-app screen is lost.

zh-CN.description: HyXen AdLocus 的推送闹钟触发时，此接收器会读取 SDK 设置并初始化广告数据仓库；分析的处理逻辑本身不会获取或显示广告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，AdLocus 的这一步闹钟初始化不会执行，但不会移除宿主应用页面。

en.description: HyXen AdLocus uses this ContentProvider when its background push service saves or reads the shared push key between the app and the separate push service.
en.disableEffect: Without it, AdLocus cannot retrieve the shared push key and its push checks may stop; the app's regular screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: HyXen AdLocus 的后台推送服务通过此 ContentProvider 与应用主进程共享推送密钥，并读取或保存该密钥。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，AdLocus 无法读取共享推送密钥，推送检查可能停止；应用的普通页面仍可使用。

en.description: When HyXen AdLocus requests a location check, this Receiver retrieves the SDK's location-targeting task and uses available network or GPS location when the required permissions are granted.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it stops AdLocus location-based ad updates; the host app's own screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: HyXen AdLocus 请求检查位置时，此接收器会获取 SDK 的位置定向任务，并在权限允许时使用网络或 GPS 位置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，AdLocus 的位置定向广告更新会停止，但宿主应用自身页面仍可使用。

en.description: HyXen AdLocus declares this Activity, but the analyzed SDK does not launch it directly and it displays no user-facing content on its own.
en.disableEffect: Disabling this unused screen has no visible effect on app features or on AdLocus's separately launched ad page.

zh-CN.description: HyXen AdLocus 声明了此 Activity，但分析的 SDK 不会直接启动它，而且它本身不显示用户可见内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用此未直接使用的页面不会影响应用功能，也不会影响 AdLocus 单独打开的广告页面。

en.description: HyXen AdLocus opens this screen after an ad tap or when users open an SDK push-ad setting or sharing action; it displays the landing page or selected push-ad control.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it blocks AdLocus ad landing pages and push-ad controls, while the host app's other screens remain available.

en.description: When someone opens a recorded network request, NetWatcher shows that request in a tabbed detail screen.
en.disableEffect: The app’s screen for inspecting captured network requests is unavailable.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开一条已记录的网络请求时，NetWatcher 会在带有多个标签页的详情页面中显示该请求。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法使用此页面查看已记录的网络请求。

en.description: The iAdvize conversation SDK opens this chat screen when the app presents an active or targeted support conversation. Users can read and send messages, attach files, and start a video escalation from the chat.
en.disableEffect: Users will lose iAdvize in-app support chat, including its message, attachment, and video-escalation entry points.

zh-CN.description: iAdvize 会话 SDK 会在应用展示正在进行或符合触发条件的客服会话时打开此聊天页面。用户可收发消息、添加附件，并从聊天发起视频求助。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法使用 iAdvize 应用内客服聊天，包括消息、附件和视频求助入口。

en.description: The iAdvize Copilot conversation screen opens when the iAdvize controller presents a support conversation. It shows replies and suggested actions, and supports product links and attachments.
en.disableEffect: Users will lose the iAdvize Copilot conversation and its replies, suggestions, product links, and attachment interactions.

zh-CN.description: iAdvize Copilot 会在 iAdvize 控制器展示客服会话时打开。页面显示回复和建议操作，并支持商品链接和附件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法使用 iAdvize Copilot 会话、回复、建议、商品链接和附件交互。

en.description: The iAdvize conversation SDK uses this provider to share temporary chat-attachment files with the camera or an app that opens an attachment. It runs when a user captures, attaches, or opens a file in a conversation.
en.disableEffect: Camera attachments and opening shared conversation files may fail, and the attachment flow can crash when it requests a file URI.

zh-CN.description: iAdvize 会话 SDK 会用此提供器把聊天附件临时分享给相机或打开附件的应用。用户拍照、添加或打开会话文件时会用到它。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 相机附件和打开共享会话文件可能失败，附件流程请求文件地址时也可能崩溃。

en.description: The iAdvize conversation SDK opens this viewer when a user taps an image attached to a chat message. It displays the selected image on its own screen.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to open chat images in the dedicated image viewer.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击聊天消息中的图片时，iAdvize 会话 SDK 会打开此查看页面。页面单独显示所选图片。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在专用查看页面中打开聊天图片。

en.description: The iAdvize conversation SDK receives Android connectivity and Wi-Fi state changes here, then signals its messaging connection to refresh its network state.
en.disableEffect: An iAdvize conversation may not recover its messaging connection reliably after Wi-Fi or network changes.

zh-CN.description: iAdvize 会话 SDK 会在此接收 Android 网络连接和 Wi-Fi 状态变化，并通知消息连接更新网络状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Wi-Fi 或网络切换后，iAdvize 会话的消息连接可能无法可靠恢复。

en.description: During an iAdvize video support session, this service displays a small movable preview of the call over the app. Tapping it returns the user to the full call screen.
en.disableEffect: The movable video preview and quick return to an active support call will be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: iAdvize 视频客服通话期间，此服务会在应用上显示可移动的小型通话预览。点击预览可返回完整通话页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 可移动的视频预览和快速返回正在进行的客服通话功能将不可用。

en.description: The iAdvize conversation SDK opens this screen for a live video support call. It displays the call video and controls while the user speaks with an agent.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to join or continue iAdvize video support calls in the call screen.

zh-CN.description: iAdvize 会话 SDK 会在进行视频客服通话时打开此页面。页面显示通话视频和控制项，供用户与客服沟通。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在通话页面中加入或继续 iAdvize 视频客服通话。

en.description: When an iAdvize chat escalates to video, this screen previews the camera and microphone before the call. The user can accept or decline the video conversation.
en.disableEffect: Users will lose the pre-call preview and cannot accept an iAdvize video escalation through this screen.

zh-CN.description: iAdvize 聊天升级为视频时，此页面会在通话前预览摄像头和麦克风。用户可接受或拒绝视频会话。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此页面预览通话或接受 iAdvize 视频求助。

en.description: The iAdvize conversation SDK starts this service with call credentials to keep the video connection and call events active while the call screen changes. It releases the video session when the call ends.
en.disableEffect: An active iAdvize video call may disconnect or fail to continue when the user leaves the call screen.

zh-CN.description: iAdvize 会话 SDK 会在此服务中接收通话凭据，在通话页面切换时维持视频连接和通话事件。通话结束后会释放视频会话。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户离开通话页面后，正在进行的 iAdvize 视频通话可能断开或无法继续。

en.description: The iAdvize Copilot SDK opens this screen when a user taps a picture in the conversation. It displays the picture from its image address in a full-screen viewer.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to open Copilot conversation pictures in the full-screen viewer.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击会话中的图片时，iAdvize Copilot SDK 会打开此页面。页面会从图片地址加载并全屏显示图片。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在全屏查看器中打开 Copilot 会话图片。

en.description: The IAMPASS authentication SDK opens this screen for an incoming sign-in or identity request, often delivered through the app's notification handling. It performs the checks requested for that challenge, such as device authentication, face capture, or proximity verification, and returns the result to IAMPASS.
en.disableEffect: IAMPASS sign-in and identity challenges cannot complete, so apps that rely on them may deny the requested access.

zh-CN.description: IAMPASS 身份验证 SDK 会在收到登录或身份验证请求时打开此页面，通常由应用的通知处理流程触发。页面执行请求要求的设备验证、人脸采集或近距离验证，并将结果返回 IAMPASS。
zh-CN.disableEffect: IAMPASS 登录和身份验证请求将无法完成，依赖该流程的应用可能会拒绝访问。

en.description: The IAMPASS authentication SDK opens the Android system authentication prompt when a challenge requires device biometrics or the device credential. It returns success, failure, cancellation, or unsupported status to the sign-in flow.
en.disableEffect: IAMPASS challenges that require the system biometric or device-authentication prompt will fail or be cancelled.

zh-CN.description: IAMPASS 身份验证 SDK 会在验证请求需要设备生物识别或设备凭据时打开 Android 系统验证提示。页面会将成功、失败、取消或不支持的结果返回登录流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要系统生物识别或设备验证提示的 IAMPASS 请求将失败或被取消。

en.description: The IAMPASS SDK opens the camera when an authentication or enrollment request needs face samples. It captures the requested number of face images and returns them to the requesting flow.
en.disableEffect: Face-based IAMPASS verification and enrollment will not be able to collect the required images.

zh-CN.description: IAMPASS SDK 会在人脸验证或注册请求需要样本时打开相机。页面采集所需数量的人脸图像并返回给请求流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 基于人脸的 IAMPASS 验证和注册将无法采集所需图像。

en.description: The IAMPASS SDK opens this enrollment screen when a registered user needs face training, including after registration or initialization. It captures face images and uploads them to the IAMPASS training service.
en.disableEffect: Users who require face training cannot finish IAMPASS enrollment, and facial authentication may remain unavailable.

zh-CN.description: 注册用户需要人脸训练时，IAMPASS SDK 会打开此注册页面，包括注册或初始化后的训练流程。页面采集人脸图像并上传到 IAMPASS 训练服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要人脸训练的用户将无法完成 IAMPASS 注册，面部验证也可能无法使用。

en.description: The IAMPASS SDK launches this screen during app initialization after obtaining a push-notification token. It updates saved user registrations with the token and starts any required face training.
en.disableEffect: IAMPASS cannot refresh registered devices or complete the initialization updates and training started from the app.

zh-CN.description: 应用取得推送通知令牌后，IAMPASS SDK 会在初始化期间打开此页面。页面更新已保存用户注册信息中的令牌，并启动所需的人脸训练。
zh-CN.disableEffect: IAMPASS 将无法刷新已注册设备，也无法完成应用发起的初始化更新和训练。

en.description: The IAMPASS SDK opens this screen when a sign-in challenge requires nearby-device verification. It uses Bluetooth Low Energy to advertise and wait for the expected nearby device or service, then returns the proximity result.
en.disableEffect: IAMPASS sign-in requests that require nearby-device verification will not complete.

zh-CN.description: 登录请求需要附近设备验证时，IAMPASS SDK 会打开此页面。页面使用低功耗蓝牙广播并等待指定设备或服务响应，然后返回近距离验证结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要附近设备验证的 IAMPASS 登录请求将无法完成。

en.description: The IAMPASS SDK opens this screen when the app registers a user for authentication on the device. It obtains a notification token, registers the user and device with IAMPASS, and starts face training if required.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot be enrolled for IAMPASS authentication on this device.

zh-CN.description: 应用为用户注册设备身份验证时，IAMPASS SDK 会打开此页面。页面获取通知令牌，将用户和设备注册到 IAMPASS，并在需要时启动人脸训练。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在此设备上注册 IAMPASS 身份验证。

en.description: The IAMPASS SDK opens this screen when the app removes one registered user from the device. It requests remote unregistration and returns the result to the app.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot remove that user's IAMPASS registration through the SDK flow.

zh-CN.description: 应用从设备移除一名已注册用户时，IAMPASS SDK 会打开此页面。页面请求远程注销并将结果返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法通过 SDK 流程移除此用户的 IAMPASS 注册。

en.description: The IAMPASS SDK opens this screen when the app removes one or more registered users in a single operation. It deletes those registrations from the service and the saved device list.
en.disableEffect: Bulk removal of IAMPASS registrations will fail, leaving the selected user entries registered.

zh-CN.description: 应用一次移除一名或多名已注册用户时，IAMPASS SDK 会打开此页面。页面从服务端和设备保存列表中删除这些注册信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 批量移除 IAMPASS 注册将失败，所选用户仍会保持注册状态。

en.description: After an IAMPASS challenge collects its requested checks, this screen uploads the verification result to the service and returns whether the user was identified. It is part of the sign-in flow, not a separate user action.
en.disableEffect: The verification result will not reach IAMPASS, so the authentication request cannot complete.

zh-CN.description: IAMPASS 挑战收集完所需验证信息后，此页面会将结果上传到服务并返回用户是否通过识别。它属于登录流程的一部分，无需用户单独操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 验证结果将无法送达 IAMPASS，因此身份验证请求无法完成。

en.description: The Alipay+ Cashier component in the AllPayX bundle lists available wallet methods and opens the selected wallet app or payment page.
en.disableEffect: Users may be unable to choose a wallet and continue this payment flow.

zh-CN.description: AllPayX 套件中的 Alipay+ Cashier 会列出可用的钱包支付方式，并打开用户选定的钱包应用或支付页面。
