zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户可能无法选择钱包并继续此支付流程。

en.description: The Xiaomi GetApps IAP SDK uses this Activity to display a billing-related web page in a floating screen, loading the address supplied by the payment flow. Users can navigate back within the page or close it.
en.disableEffect: A GetApps IAP flow that needs this web page will not display it.

zh-CN.description: 小米 GetApps IAP SDK 用这个界面在浮动窗口中显示付款流程提供的网页，用户可以在页面内返回或关闭它。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，需要此网页的 GetApps IAP 流程将无法显示页面。

en.description: The Xiaomi GetApps IAP SDK uses this Activity for extra web pages in a purchase flow. It loads the supplied page and can ask whether the user wants to continue or cancel when leaving a payment that is still in progress.
en.disableEffect: The related billing page and its continue or cancel handling may not work.

zh-CN.description: 小米 GetApps IAP SDK 在购买流程中用这个界面显示附加网页。离开仍在进行的付款页面时，它还可以询问用户继续还是取消。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，相关付款页面及其继续或取消操作可能无法正常工作。

en.description: The Xiaomi GetApps IAP SDK uses this Activity to show its online payment page, start the selected billing flow, and return payment or account-binding results to the app.
en.disableEffect: In-app purchases and payment methods that use this page will not complete.

zh-CN.description: 小米 GetApps IAP SDK 用这个界面展示在线付款页面、启动所选支付流程，并把付款或账户绑定结果返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，使用此页面的应用内购买和支付方式将无法完成。

en.description: The Xiaomi GetApps IAP SDK opens this Activity to hand a purchase request to the Xiaomi payment app and return the purchase or cancellation result to the host app.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot start Xiaomi GetApps purchases or receive their results.

zh-CN.description: 小米 GetApps IAP SDK 用这个界面将购买请求交给小米付款应用，并把购买或取消结果返回宿主应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用无法通过小米 GetApps 启动购买或接收购买结果。

en.description: The QIndicators sample activity opens a simple greeting screen using the library’s Jetpack Compose theme.
en.disableEffect: This sample greeting screen will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: QIndicators 的示例界面会使用该库的 Jetpack Compose 主题显示简单问候语。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 此示例问候界面将无法打开。

en.description: The IBM Presence Insights beacon service starts when the app enables beacon sensing, scans for nearby Bluetooth beacons, and reports sightings to the configured Presence Insights service. It also sends region-entry and region-exit updates to the app.
en.disableEffect: Nearby-beacon reporting and any app behavior tied to beacon regions will stop.

zh-CN.description: 应用启用信标感知时，IBM Presence Insights 后台服务会扫描附近的蓝牙信标，并将发现结果发送到已配置的 Presence Insights 服务；它也会把进入或离开信标区域的事件通知应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 附近信标的采集与上报会停止，依赖信标区域变化的应用功能也会失效。

en.description: After Android reports a normal or quick boot, this IBM Presence Insights receiver restarts the beacon sensor so background scanning and region updates can resume.
en.disableEffect: Beacon scanning will not restart automatically after a device reboot, so location-aware app updates may stop until the app starts sensing again.

zh-CN.description: Android 正常开机或快速重启后，IBM Presence Insights 接收器会重新启动信标感知功能，让后台扫描和区域更新继续运行。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 设备重启后信标扫描不会自动恢复，依赖附近信标的应用更新可能会停止，直到应用重新启动感知功能。

en.description: The IBM Presence Insights beacon service starts when the app enables beacon sensing, scans for nearby Bluetooth beacons, and reports sightings to the configured Presence Insights service. It also sends region-entry and region-exit updates to the app.
en.disableEffect: Nearby-beacon reporting and any app behavior tied to beacon regions will stop.

zh-CN.description: 应用启用信标感知时，IBM Presence Insights 后台服务会扫描附近的蓝牙信标，并将发现结果发送到已配置的 Presence Insights 服务；它也会把进入或离开信标区域的事件通知应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 附近信标的采集与上报会停止，依赖信标区域变化的应用功能也会失效。

en.description: After Android reports a normal or quick boot, this IBM Presence Insights receiver restarts the beacon sensor so background scanning and region updates can resume.
en.disableEffect: Beacon scanning will not restart automatically after a device reboot, so location-aware app updates may stop until the app starts sensing again.

zh-CN.description: Android 正常开机或快速重启后，IBM Presence Insights 接收器会重新启动信标感知功能，让后台扫描和区域更新继续运行。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 设备重启后信标扫描不会自动恢复，依赖附近信标的应用更新可能会停止，直到应用重新启动感知功能。

en.description: If the iBuildApp PayPal utility cannot immediately send a payment confirmation, it starts this background service to queue the result and retry delivery to the merchant when a network is available.
en.disableEffect: A payment result may not reach the merchant, so the purchase may remain unrecorded or unfulfilled.

zh-CN.description: iBuildApp 的 PayPal 工具无法立即发送付款确认时，会启动此后台服务暂存结果，并在网络可用时重试向商家发送。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 付款结果可能无法送达商家，订单可能无法登记或履约。

en.description: When iBuildApp's PayPal utility builds an empty multi-item checkout, this Activity immediately returns a blank successful confirmation and closes without opening PayPal.
en.disableEffect: Checkout flows that rely on this empty-cart result may not complete.

zh-CN.description: 当 iBuildApp 的 PayPal 工具生成空的多商品结账单时，此页面会立即返回空白的成功确认并关闭，不会打开 PayPal。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此空购物车结果的结账流程可能无法完成。

en.description: Niddler, Chimerapps' network inspection tool, runs this service while an inspection session is active. It keeps the inspection connection available and shows a notification with its port and a stop option.
en.disableEffect: The Niddler inspection session will not run, while the app's regular features continue.

zh-CN.description: Chimerapps 的 Niddler 网络检查工具会在检查会话开启时运行此服务，保持检查连接可用，并显示带端口号和停止选项的通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后将无法使用 Niddler 网络检查会话，但应用的常规功能仍可使用。

en.description: Android starts this private provider with the app. It gives Fly2Think SmartPanorama access to the app so its panorama-camera screens can use app files and settings.
en.disableEffect: The camera SDK may fail to connect to a camera or open its panorama features.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，Android 会启动这个私有提供程序，让 Fly2Think SmartPanorama 能访问应用及其文件和设置，供全景相机界面使用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 相机 SDK 可能无法连接相机或打开全景功能。

en.description: Android starts this private provider with newer Fly2Think SmartPanorama releases. It gives the panorama-camera SDK access to the app and its files and settings.
en.disableEffect: The camera SDK may fail to connect to a camera or open its panorama features.

zh-CN.description: 较新版本的 Fly2Think SmartPanorama 会在应用启动时使用这个私有提供程序，以便访问应用及其文件和设置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 相机 SDK 可能无法连接相机或打开全景功能。

en.description: When a user shares a panorama photo from SmartPanorama, this private provider gives the receiving app temporary access to the image file.
en.disableEffect: The panorama viewer can no longer pass the selected image to another app for sharing.

zh-CN.description: 用户从 SmartPanorama 分享全景照片时，这个私有提供程序会临时授权接收应用读取图片文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 全景查看器将无法把所选图片交给其他应用分享。

en.description: Opens the Fly2Think SmartPanorama album with separate tabs for completed panoramas and camera images still waiting to be stitched.
en.disableEffect: Users lose the album screen for browsing completed and pending panoramas.

zh-CN.description: 打开 Fly2Think SmartPanorama 相册，其中分别列出已合成的全景照片和等待合成的相机图片。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开相册浏览已完成或待合成的全景照片。

en.description: Shows SmartPanorama's local photo picker, lets the user select up to the requested number of files, and returns the selected file paths to the caller.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot open this photo-selection step for the panorama workflow.

zh-CN.description: 显示 SmartPanorama 的本地照片选择界面，允许用户按调用方设定的数量选择文件，并把所选文件位置返回给调用方。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 全景操作将无法打开这一步照片选择界面。

en.description: During V35 panorama creation, this screen downloads the camera's photos and stitches them into a panorama, then opens the result for review or saving.
en.disableEffect: The V35 camera's photo-to-panorama creation flow will not complete.

zh-CN.description: 创建 V35 全景照片时，这个界面会从相机下载照片并合成为全景图，随后打开结果供用户查看或保存。
zh-CN.disableEffect: V35 相机将无法完成照片合成全景图的流程。

en.description: During V50 panorama creation, this screen downloads the camera's photos and stitches them into a panorama, then opens the result for review or saving.
en.disableEffect: The V50 camera's photo-to-panorama creation flow will not complete.

zh-CN.description: 创建 V50 全景照片时，这个界面会从相机下载照片并合成为全景图，随后打开结果供用户查看或保存。
zh-CN.disableEffect: V50 相机将无法完成照片合成全景图的流程。

en.description: When the user taps Connect, SmartPanorama connects to the selected Wi-Fi panorama camera and opens the live-preview screen for that camera model.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot start the SDK's camera connection and preview flow.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击连接后，SmartPanorama 会连接所选 Wi-Fi 全景相机，并打开对应机型的实时预览界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法启动 SDK 的相机连接和预览流程。

en.description: Opens a panorama photo stored on the phone in an interactive viewer, with controls to move through photos, change the panorama view, share, or delete.
en.disableEffect: Users lose the in-app viewer and management controls for saved panorama photos.

zh-CN.description: 在交互式查看器中打开手机里保存的全景照片，并提供切换照片、调整全景视角、分享和删除操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在应用中查看或管理已保存的全景照片。

en.description: Plays a video selected from the phone's local panorama-media list, with playback, seeking, and panorama-view controls.
en.disableEffect: Users lose the in-app player for locally stored panorama videos.

zh-CN.description: 播放从手机本地全景媒体列表中选取的视频，并提供播放、定位和全景视角控制。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在应用中播放本地保存的全景视频。

en.description: Opens the SmartPanorama list of completed panorama photos, where users can browse and open a saved image.
en.disableEffect: Users lose this screen for browsing completed panorama photos.

zh-CN.description: 打开 SmartPanorama 已完成的全景照片列表，用户可浏览并打开已保存的图片。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此界面浏览已完成的全景照片。

en.description: After a V35 camera connects, this screen shows its live view and photo, video, and time-lapse controls; captured photos can be stitched now or later.
en.disableEffect: The V35 camera's live view and capture controls become unavailable.

zh-CN.description: V35 相机连接后，这个界面显示实时画面以及拍照、录像和延时拍摄控制；拍摄的照片可立即或稍后合成。
zh-CN.disableEffect: V35 相机的实时画面和拍摄控制将无法使用。

en.description: After a V50 camera connects, this screen shows its live view and photo, video, and time-lapse controls; captured photos can be stitched now or later.
en.disableEffect: The V50 camera's live view and capture controls become unavailable.

zh-CN.description: V50 相机连接后，这个界面显示实时画面以及拍照、录像和延时拍摄控制；拍摄的照片可立即或稍后合成。
zh-CN.disableEffect: V50 相机的实时画面和拍摄控制将无法使用。

en.description: After a V51 camera connects, this screen shows its live view and photo, video, and time-lapse controls; captured photos can be stitched now or later.
en.disableEffect: The V51 camera's live view and capture controls become unavailable.

zh-CN.description: V51 相机连接后，这个界面显示实时画面以及拍照、录像和延时拍摄控制；拍摄的照片可立即或稍后合成。
zh-CN.disableEffect: V51 相机的实时画面和拍摄控制将无法使用。

en.description: Plays a panoramic video from the connected camera and provides playback, seeking, download, and delete controls.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot play or manage panoramic videos stored on the connected camera.

zh-CN.description: 播放已连接相机中的全景视频，并提供播放、定位、下载和删除控制。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法播放或管理相机中的全景视频。

en.description: In older SmartPanorama releases, this screen displays a panoramic photo from the connected camera and lets users browse, download, or delete it.
en.disableEffect: Older camera integrations lose their in-app panoramic-photo playback and download screen.

zh-CN.description: 在较旧的 SmartPanorama 版本中，这个界面显示已连接相机中的全景照片，并允许用户浏览、下载或删除照片。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 较旧的相机集成将无法在应用中查看或下载全景照片。

en.description: After a panorama is stitched, this screen displays it in an interactive viewer and lets the user save it to the phone or return it to the calling app.
en.disableEffect: Users lose the review-and-save step for a newly stitched panorama.

zh-CN.description: 全景图合成后，这个界面会在交互式查看器中显示图片，并允许用户保存到手机或返回给调用应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法查看并保存刚合成的全景图。

en.description: Previews a temporary panorama made from camera images; from the pending list, the user can stitch its saved source images into a full result and open the save screen.
en.disableEffect: Users lose the preview and finish-stitching step for a saved panorama set.

zh-CN.description: 预览由相机图片生成的临时全景图；从待合成列表进入时，用户可将保存的原始图片合成为完整结果并打开保存界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法预览或完成已保存图片组的全景合成。

en.description: When panorama capture begins, this screen downloads a set of images from the connected camera, builds a thumbnail panorama, and opens it for review.
en.disableEffect: The camera's thumbnail-panorama capture and review flow will not complete.

zh-CN.description: 开始全景拍摄时，这个界面会从已连接相机下载一组图片，生成全景缩略预览并打开供用户查看。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 相机的全景缩略预览流程将无法完成。

en.description: Opens the list of saved camera-image sets that are waiting to be stitched into panoramas.
en.disableEffect: Users lose this screen for finding and reopening pending panorama sets.

zh-CN.description: 打开等待合成为全景图的已保存相机图片组列表。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此界面查找或重新打开待合成的图片组。

en.description: Shows a completed panorama image and lets the user delete it or return it to the calling app as a capture result.
en.disableEffect: Users lose the result screen for viewing or returning a finished panorama.

zh-CN.description: 显示已完成的全景图片，并允许用户删除图片或将其作为拍摄结果返回给调用应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法查看或返回已完成的全景图片。

en.description: Provides controls to turn on or off a Wi-Fi hotspot and set its network name, password, and security type.
en.disableEffect: The app loses this hotspot setup and control screen.

zh-CN.description: 提供 Wi-Fi 热点开关，并可设置网络名称、密码和安全类型。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法打开此热点设置和控制界面。

en.description: When a user opens an IceMobile Campaign SDK offer, this Activity loads its campaign page in the app with the supplied title and back navigation.
en.disableEffect: Campaign links and their promotional details will no longer open in the app.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 IceMobile Campaign SDK 的活动内容时，此页面会在应用内加载对应网页，并显示活动标题和返回操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用内的活动链接及其推广内容将无法打开。

en.description: When a user shares an image from an IceMobile campaign page, the SDK uses this provider to make the temporary image available to another app through Android's share menu.
en.disableEffect: Sharing images from campaign pages may fail or be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: 用户分享 IceMobile 活动页面中的图片时，SDK 会通过此 Provider 将临时图片提供给 Android 分享菜单中的其他应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 活动页面中的图片可能无法分享。

en.description: The SiliCompressor library uses this provider to give apps and other apps temporary access to compressed images and videos through shareable file links.
en.disableEffect: Apps may be unable to open or share compressed images and videos.

zh-CN.description: SiliCompressor 库会通过此提供器生成可分享的文件链接，让应用或其他应用临时访问压缩后的图片和视频。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用可能无法打开或分享压缩后的图片和视频。

en.description: ICONDRM (ICON Networks) provides the TV streaming app's entry Activity. The TV launcher can open it, and its startup flow passes account, device, channel, and DRM details to the streaming screen.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it can prevent the ICONDRM TV flow from reaching its streaming startup screen.

zh-CN.description: ICONDRM（ICON Networks）提供电视串流应用的入口 Activity。电视启动器可以打开它，启动流程会把账户、设备、频道和 DRM 信息传给串流页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，ICONDRM 电视流程可能无法进入串流启动页面。

en.description: ICONDRM (ICON Networks) opens this screen when account verification requires a one-time code. It checks the entered code and submits the verification request before the session continues.
en.disableEffect: Users may not be able to verify their account and enter the streaming service.

zh-CN.description: ICONDRM（ICON Networks）会在账户需要验证码时打开此页面。它检查用户输入的验证码并提交验证请求，然后才能继续会话。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户可能无法验证账户并进入串流服务。

en.description: ICONDRM (ICON Networks) opens this screen to play the selected live TV channel and show channel and program controls. It fetches stream data and plays it through the device's video player.
en.disableEffect: Live channel playback will not be available.

zh-CN.description: ICONDRM（ICON Networks）会打开此页面播放所选的直播频道，并显示频道和节目控制。它获取串流数据并通过设备的视频播放器播放。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法观看直播频道。

en.description: ICONDRM (ICON Networks) runs this startup screen when a streaming session begins. It reads account and device details and contacts the service to validate and prepare the session before playback.
en.disableEffect: The service may not complete its startup checks, preventing users from reaching the channel screen.

zh-CN.description: ICONDRM（ICON Networks）会在串流会话开始时运行此启动页面。它读取账户和设备信息，并联系服务验证和准备会话，然后才能播放。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，服务可能无法完成启动检查，用户也可能无法进入频道页面。

en.description: ICONDRM (ICON Networks) receives Android network-change notifications and checks whether a connection is active. The receiver does not use the result to update the screen or trigger another action.
en.disableEffect: This removes the connectivity check; the code shows no change to the streaming or login screens.

zh-CN.description: ICONDRM（ICON Networks）会接收 Android 网络变化通知并检查当前是否有网络连接。此接收器不会使用检查结果更新画面或触发其他操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后只会移除此网络检查；代码没有显示串流或登录页面会因此改变。

en.description: When an app starts idemeum sign-in, this identity SDK Activity can open browser-based login or handle the sign-in return link; it saves a successful login token and reports the result to the app.
en.disableEffect: Users may be unable to complete idemeum sign-in or return a successful login result to the app.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动 idemeum 登录时，此身份 SDK 页面可以打开浏览器登录或处理登录返回链接；登录成功后会保存令牌并把结果交还应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户可能无法完成 idemeum 登录，应用也可能收不到成功登录结果。

en.description: When the app routes an idemeum sign-in return link to this Activity, it forwards the link to the SDK's login handler and then closes.
en.disableEffect: The app may not receive the result of idemeum sign-in, leaving login incomplete.

zh-CN.description: 应用将 idemeum 登录返回链接交给此页面时，它会把链接转交给 SDK 的登录处理流程，然后关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用可能收不到 idemeum 登录结果，导致登录无法完成。

en.description: IDfy's Right First Time capture SDK opens the camera for the requested identity document or face, guides the user to frame it, and captures the image for verification.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot capture the document or face image required by this verification flow.

zh-CN.description: IDfy 的 Right First Time 证件采集 SDK 会为当前核验步骤打开相机，指导用户对准证件或人脸并拍摄图像。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法拍摄此核验流程所需的证件或人脸图像。

en.description: Before IDfy's Right First Time SDK captures a KYC document, this screen presents the consent text for Jio and Baldor Technologies to collect and use the selected document type; agreeing stores that type, while declining closes the screen.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot provide the SDK's document consent, so this verification flow cannot proceed through this screen.

zh-CN.description: IDfy 的 Right First Time SDK 在采集 KYC 证件前会显示授权说明，告知 Jio 和 Baldor Technologies 将收集并使用所选证件类型；同意后会保存证件类型，拒绝则关闭页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法提供 SDK 所需的证件授权，因此无法通过此页面继续核验。

en.description: IDfy's Right First Time capture SDK shows this screen after an identity photo is captured so the user can approve it or take a new image. When transaction recording is enabled, approval sends the capture for review and returns the result to the app.
en.disableEffect: The user cannot confirm or retake the identity image, so the verification flow may not complete.

zh-CN.description: IDfy 的 Right First Time 证件采集 SDK 会在拍摄身份照片后显示此页面，供用户确认或重新拍摄；启用交易记录时，确认操作会提交照片并把结果返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法确认或重拍身份照片，证件核验流程可能无法完成。

en.description: The Instnt Android identity SDK opens this Activity when its document-scanning flow requests a license or passport image. It uses a live camera to capture, crop, and review the selected document side, then returns the image and detected barcode or passport text to the app.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, identity verification cannot collect or return the requested document image and scan data.

zh-CN.description: Instnt Android 身份验证 SDK 请求采集驾照或护照时，会打开此 Activity。它使用实时相机拍摄、裁剪并检查证件的一面，然后把图像以及识别到的条码或护照文字返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，身份验证流程无法采集或返回所需的证件图像和识别数据。

en.description: When IDWise needs an Android runtime permission such as camera access, this short-lived screen asks the user and returns the granted or denied result to the identity SDK.
en.disableEffect: IDWise may not complete camera or other permission requests, which can stop identity verification.

zh-CN.description: IDWise 需要相机等 Android 运行时权限时，会短暂打开此页面询问用户，并将授权或拒绝结果交还身份 SDK。
zh-CN.disableEffect: IDWise 可能无法完成相机或其他权限请求，导致身份核验中断。

en.description: When IDWise blocks a verification attempt, this screen explains the reason and offers a retry or close option according to the block result.
en.disableEffect: A blocked verification may not show its reason or retry option, leaving the identity-check flow incomplete.

zh-CN.description: IDWise 阻止一次身份核验时，此页面会说明原因，并根据阻止结果提供重试或关闭选项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 核验被阻止时，用户可能看不到原因或重试选项，身份核验流程也可能无法正常结束。

en.description: When IDWise opens its introductory step, this screen shows the configured verification instructions and privacy-policy link; the user can start the identity check from here.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot review the introduction or start the IDWise identity-check journey from this screen.

zh-CN.description: IDWise 显示核验介绍时，此页面会展示配置好的核验说明和隐私政策链接，用户可从这里开始身份核验。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法查看介绍内容，也无法从此页面启动 IDWise 身份核验流程。

en.description: This IDWise identity-verification screen runs the configured check steps, including document or selfie capture or upload when those steps are requested, and returns completion or failure to the app.
en.disableEffect: The identity check cannot run its configured steps or return a result to the app.

zh-CN.description: 此 IDWise 身份核验页面会运行配置好的核验步骤，包括按流程拍摄或上传证件、人脸照片，并把完成或失败结果返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 身份核验无法运行配置步骤，也无法向应用返回结果。

en.description: The Phoenix News (iFeng) SDK opens this screen when a user changes their local news region; it loads the province list and saves the selected region as the local news channel.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to change the local news region through this SDK.

zh-CN.description: 凤凰新闻（iFeng）SDK 会在用户切换本地新闻地区时打开此页面，加载省份列表，并将所选地区保存为本地新闻频道。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此 SDK 更改本地新闻地区。

en.description: The Phoenix News (iFeng) SDK opens the channel picker when a user edits subscriptions; it shows available news channels and returns the chosen channel to the calling screen.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open this picker to choose a news channel.

zh-CN.description: 凤凰新闻（iFeng）SDK 会在用户编辑订阅时打开频道选择页面，展示可用新闻频道，并将所选频道返回到调用页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开此页面选择新闻频道。

en.description: The Phoenix News (iFeng) SDK opens this screen for a selected story and loads its article page; the screen also provides comment and share controls.
en.disableEffect: The in-app article page and its comment and share controls will be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: 凤凰新闻（iFeng）SDK 会为用户选中的新闻打开此页面并加载文章，同时提供评论和分享入口。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用内的文章页面以及评论和分享入口将无法使用。

en.description: The KuGou integration in Xfyun AIUI Player opens this screen to sign in with a phone number and SMS verification code.
en.disableEffect: Signing in to KuGou from this player will no longer work.

zh-CN.description: Xfyun AIUI Player 中的 KuGou 集成会打开此页面，供用户使用手机号和短信验证码登录。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法从此播放器登录 KuGou。

en.description: The IFTTT Connect SDK opens this connection-information screen when the user asks about a connected service; it links to service details, connection management, and terms and privacy information.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to view or manage the IFTTT connection through this screen.

zh-CN.description: IFTTT Connect SDK 会在用户查看已连接服务的信息时打开此页面，并提供服务详情、连接管理以及条款和隐私信息入口。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此页面查看或管理 IFTTT 连接。

en.description: The IFTTT Connect Location SDK receives Google Awareness events for entering a monitored place and sends the matching event to the connected IFTTT automation.
en.disableEffect: IFTTT automations triggered by entering a monitored place will stop working.

zh-CN.description: IFTTT Connect Location SDK 会接收 Google Awareness 发出的进入监控地点事件，并将对应事件发送给已连接的 IFTTT 自动化。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 由进入监控地点触发的 IFTTT 自动化将无法运行。

en.description: The IFTTT Connect Location SDK receives Google Awareness events for leaving a monitored place and sends the matching event to the connected IFTTT automation.
en.disableEffect: IFTTT automations triggered by leaving a monitored place will stop working.

zh-CN.description: IFTTT Connect Location SDK 会接收 Google Awareness 发出的离开监控地点事件，并将对应事件发送给已连接的 IFTTT 自动化。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 由离开监控地点触发的 IFTTT 自动化将无法运行。

en.description: After the phone restarts, the IFTTT Connect Location SDK refreshes an existing location connection so its monitoring can resume.
en.disableEffect: Saved location automations may not resume after the phone restarts.

zh-CN.description: 手机重启后，IFTTT Connect Location SDK 会刷新已有的位置连接，以便恢复位置监控。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 手机重启后，已保存的位置自动化可能无法恢复。

en.description: The EGLS (EasyGames) Android Game Platform SDK opens this screen from sign-in and account-linking pages to display the configured service agreement. Players can scroll through it and close the page to return to the account flow.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, players cannot read the service agreement from the SDK's sign-in or account-linking flow.

zh-CN.description: EGLS（EasyGames）Android 游戏平台 SDK 会在登录或账号关联页面打开此界面，显示已配置的服务协议。玩家可以滚动阅读并关闭页面，返回账号流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，玩家无法在 SDK 的登录或账号关联流程中查看服务协议。

en.description: The EGLS (EasyGames) Android Game Platform SDK opens this screen when a player links a game account to a sign-in channel or verifies a phone number or email address. It handles the selected account provider and confirmation code.
en.disableEffect: Players cannot link sign-in accounts or add and update verified contact details through the SDK.

zh-CN.description: 玩家关联登录渠道，或验证手机号、电子邮箱时，EGLS（EasyGames）Android 游戏平台 SDK 会打开此界面。界面会处理所选账号渠道和验证码。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，玩家无法通过 SDK 关联登录账号，也无法添加或更新已验证的联系方式。

en.description: Before a new player signs in, the EGLS (EasyGames) Android Game Platform SDK shows the service agreement and, for some regional settings, the privacy policy. It waits for the player to accept before continuing.
en.disableEffect: New players cannot complete the SDK's consent step, so sign-in cannot continue.

zh-CN.description: 新玩家登录前，EGLS（EasyGames）Android 游戏平台 SDK 会显示服务协议；在部分地区还会显示隐私政策，并要求玩家同意后才能继续。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，新玩家无法完成 SDK 的同意步骤，因此不能继续登录。

en.description: The EGLS (EasyGames) Android Game Platform SDK opens this screen when a player chooses the privacy-policy link in an account flow. It displays the configured policy text for reading.
en.disableEffect: Players cannot review the privacy policy from the SDK's account screens.

zh-CN.description: 玩家在账号流程中打开隐私政策链接时，EGLS（EasyGames）Android 游戏平台 SDK 会显示已配置的政策内容，供玩家阅读。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，玩家无法通过 SDK 的账号界面查看隐私政策。

en.description: From the forgotten-password option on the sign-in screen, the EGLS (EasyGames) Android Game Platform SDK lets a player request a password reset after confirming their registered email or phone number with a one-time code.
en.disableEffect: Players lose the SDK's email and phone account-recovery path.

zh-CN.description: 玩家在登录界面选择找回密码后，EGLS（EasyGames）Android 游戏平台 SDK 会通过已登记的电子邮箱或手机号发送验证码，并据此提交密码重置请求。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，玩家无法通过 SDK 使用电子邮箱或手机号找回账号密码。

en.description: The EGLS (EasyGames) Android Game Platform SDK opens this screen when the game asks a player to sign in or switch accounts. It presents the available account and social sign-in choices, registration, and saved-player options.
en.disableEffect: Players cannot sign in, register, or switch accounts through this SDK.

zh-CN.description: 游戏要求玩家登录或切换账号时，EGLS（EasyGames）Android 游戏平台 SDK 会打开此界面。界面提供可用的账号或社交登录方式、注册入口和已保存账号。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，玩家无法通过此 SDK 登录、注册或切换账号。

en.description: The EGLS (EasyGames) Android Game Platform SDK opens this screen for optional app-rating, Facebook promotion or sharing, and LINE promotion activities requested by the game. It presents configured images or links and returns whether the player completed or cancelled the activity.
en.disableEffect: The SDK's rating and social-promotion screens stop working, while the game's other screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: 游戏请求评价、Facebook 推广或分享、LINE 推广等可选活动时，EGLS（EasyGames）Android 游戏平台 SDK 会打开此界面。界面显示已配置的图片或链接，并将玩家完成或取消活动的结果返回给游戏。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，SDK 的评价和社交推广界面无法使用，但游戏的其他界面仍可打开。

en.description: When the game requests a purchase, the EGLS (EasyGames) Android Game Platform SDK displays the product and order details and starts the configured payment route, including supported in-app, carrier, and web payments.
en.disableEffect: Players cannot complete purchases started through this SDK.

zh-CN.description: 游戏发起购买时，EGLS（EasyGames）Android 游戏平台 SDK 会显示商品和订单信息，并启动已配置的支付方式，包括应用内支付、运营商支付和网页支付。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，玩家无法完成通过此 SDK 发起的购买。

en.description: The EGLS (EasyGames) Android Game Platform SDK opens this screen when real-name verification is requested during sign-in or account management. It asks for the player's legal name and identity number, submits them for verification, and returns the result.
en.disableEffect: Players cannot complete real-name verification through the SDK.

zh-CN.description: 登录或管理账号时需要实名认证，EGLS（EasyGames）Android 游戏平台 SDK 就会打开此界面。玩家在此填写姓名和身份证号码，提交验证并接收结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，玩家无法通过 SDK 完成实名认证。

en.description: From account security settings, the EGLS (EasyGames) Android Game Platform SDK opens this screen to bind or change a phone number or email address after code verification.
en.disableEffect: Players cannot add or change verified phone and email contacts for the account.

zh-CN.description: 在账号安全设置中，EGLS（EasyGames）Android 游戏平台 SDK 会打开此界面，让玩家通过验证码绑定或更换手机号、电子邮箱。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，玩家无法为账号添加或更换已验证的手机号和电子邮箱。

en.description: The EGLS (EasyGames) Android Game Platform SDK opens this screen from its account-center option. It shows the player's profile, security contacts, recharge records, and controls such as password change and sign-out.
en.disableEffect: Players cannot view or manage their account details through the SDK.

zh-CN.description: 玩家选择账号中心时，EGLS（EasyGames）Android 游戏平台 SDK 会打开此界面。界面显示个人资料、安全联系方式、充值记录，以及修改密码和退出登录等选项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，玩家无法通过 SDK 查看或管理账号信息。

en.description: The EGLS (EasyGames) support library opens this embedded browser for SDK web pages, external return links, and web-payment or promotion flows. It also accepts browsable links such as the configured Twitter return link.
en.disableEffect: Players cannot complete web-based payments or return through links handled by the SDK browser.

zh-CN.description: EGLS（EasyGames）支持库会在打开 SDK 网页、处理外部返回链接以及网页支付或推广流程时显示此内置浏览器。它也会接收可浏览的链接，例如已配置的 Twitter 返回链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，玩家无法完成网页支付，也无法通过 SDK 浏览器处理的链接返回应用。

en.description: When the host app opens the EGLS (EasyGames) permission-information screen, it shows the app name, version, icon, and configured explanation on the first run. It also forwards any permission results delivered to this screen.
en.disableEffect: Players cannot see the SDK's first-run permission guidance or return permission results through this screen.

zh-CN.description: 宿主应用打开 EGLS（EasyGames）的权限说明界面时，此界面会在首次运行时显示应用名称、版本、图标和已配置的说明，并转交收到的权限结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，玩家无法查看 SDK 的首次运行权限说明，也无法通过此界面返回权限结果。

en.description: When the game asks to invite friends, the EGLS (EasyGames) support library opens Facebook's game-request dialog. It returns the selected invitees' profile details or a cancellation or error result.
en.disableEffect: Players cannot invite Facebook friends through the game's SDK integration.

zh-CN.description: 游戏请求邀请好友时，EGLS（EasyGames）支持库会打开 Facebook 游戏邀请对话框，并返回所选好友的资料，或取消、错误结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，玩家无法通过游戏的 SDK 集成邀请 Facebook 好友。

en.description: When the game asks to share an image or link, the EGLS (EasyGames) support library opens Facebook's sharing dialog. It returns whether sharing succeeded, was cancelled, or failed.
en.disableEffect: Players cannot share game images or links through Facebook using the SDK.

zh-CN.description: 游戏请求分享图片或链接时，EGLS（EasyGames）支持库会打开 Facebook 分享对话框，并返回分享成功、取消或失败的结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，玩家无法通过 SDK 在 Facebook 分享游戏图片或链接。

en.description: When the game requests Facebook sign-in, the EGLS (EasyGames) support library obtains the player's Facebook account details after the requested permissions are granted and returns them to the game.
en.disableEffect: Players cannot sign in to the game with Facebook.

zh-CN.description: 游戏请求 Facebook 登录时，EGLS（EasyGames）支持库会在玩家授予所需权限后获取其 Facebook 账号资料，并将资料返回给游戏。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，玩家无法使用 Facebook 登录游戏。

en.description: When the game starts Google sign-in through the EGLS (EasyGames) support library, this screen checks for an existing session or opens Google sign-in. It returns the player's account details and an authentication token or code.
en.disableEffect: Players cannot use this Google sign-in flow to access the game.

zh-CN.description: 游戏通过 EGLS（EasyGames）支持库启动 Google 登录时，此界面会检查已有会话或打开 Google 登录，并返回玩家账号资料及身份验证令牌或授权码。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，玩家无法通过此 Google 登录流程进入游戏。

en.description: When launched for Google sign-in, the EGLS (EasyGames) support library checks for an existing Google account or asks the player to choose one. It returns the account details and an authentication token or code.
en.disableEffect: Players cannot use this Google sign-in flow to access the game.

zh-CN.description: 启动 Google 登录时，EGLS（EasyGames）支持库会检查已有的 Google 账号，或请玩家选择账号，并返回账号资料及身份验证令牌或授权码。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，玩家无法通过此 Google 登录流程进入游戏。

en.description: The IGAWorks AdPopcorn Offerwall SDK opens this full-screen player for a rewarded-video campaign; it plays the ad and handles campaign completion.
en.disableEffect: Reward videos will not play, and users will not receive the reward for watching them.

zh-CN.description: IGAWorks AdPopcorn Offerwall SDK 会为奖励视频活动打开此全屏播放器，播放广告并处理活动完成结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 奖励视频将无法播放，用户也无法获得观看奖励。

en.description: The IGAWorks AdPopcorn Offerwall SDK opens this page for a selected benefit placement; it displays campaign content and can launch reward videos and other reward campaigns.
en.disableEffect: Benefit campaigns will not open, and users will miss rewards for completing them, including rewards for watching video ads.

zh-CN.description: IGAWorks AdPopcorn Offerwall SDK 会为选中的福利广告位打开此页面，展示活动内容，并可启动奖励视频及其他奖励活动。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 福利活动将无法打开，用户也无法获得完成活动的奖励，包括观看视频广告的奖励。

en.description: When the app opens the IGAWorks AdPopcorn offer wall, this screen presents the available reward campaigns and offers.
en.disableEffect: The offer wall will not open, so users cannot complete its offers or earn their rewards.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开 IGAWorks AdPopcorn 积分墙时，此页面会展示可参加的奖励活动和优惠。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 积分墙将无法打开，用户不能完成其中的优惠活动或获得奖励。

en.description: When the app opens an IGAWorks AdPopcorn web offer wall, this screen loads the requested offer or campaign page inside the app.
en.disableEffect: The offer page will not open, so users cannot complete its offers or earn their rewards.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开 IGAWorks AdPopcorn 网页积分墙时，此页面会在应用内加载所请求的优惠或活动页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 优惠页面将无法打开，用户不能完成其中的活动或获得奖励。

en.description: The IGAWorks AdPopcorn SSP SDK opens this optional diagnostics screen to inspect its ad placements and loaded ad data.
en.disableEffect: The ad-inspection screen will be unavailable; ordinary app screens can still work.

zh-CN.description: IGAWorks AdPopcorn SSP SDK 会打开此可选诊断页面，用于查看广告位及已加载的广告数据。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 广告检查页面将无法使用，应用的普通页面仍可运行。

en.description: When requested by AdPopcorn SSP, this screen opens the SDK build-information page in an in-app browser.
en.disableEffect: The SDK information page will not open; ordinary app features can still work.

zh-CN.description: AdPopcorn SSP 请求查看 SDK 构建信息时，此页面会在应用内浏览器中打开相应页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: SDK 信息页面将无法打开，应用的普通功能仍可运行。

en.description: The IGAWorks AdPopcorn SSP SDK opens an interactive ad page for a configured placement; the page can report completed campaigns and rewards to the app.
en.disableEffect: These interactive ads will not open, and rewards linked to completing them will not be credited.

zh-CN.description: IGAWorks AdPopcorn SSP SDK 会为配置的广告位打开互动广告页面，并可将活动完成情况和奖励结果返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 这些互动广告将无法打开，完成广告所关联的奖励也不会到账。

en.description: When the app requests a full-screen AdPopcorn SSP interstitial, this screen shows the ad and can open its advertiser link or app-store listing.
en.disableEffect: Interstitial ads and their advertiser landing pages will not open.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求 AdPopcorn SSP 全屏插页广告时，此页面会展示广告，并可打开广告主链接或应用商店页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 插页广告及其广告主落地页将无法打开。

en.description: The IGAWorks AdPopcorn SSP SDK opens an in-app page for a configured pop-up content ad and loads its promotion and related service information.
en.disableEffect: Pop-up content ads and their promotional pages will not open.

zh-CN.description: IGAWorks AdPopcorn SSP SDK 会为配置的弹出内容广告打开应用内页面，并加载推广内容及相关服务信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 弹出内容广告及其推广页面将无法打开。

en.description: The IGAWorks AdPopcorn SSP SDK opens a Reward Plus settings page; it shows the current payment, notification, and daily point-limit options.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to view or adjust those Reward Plus settings.

zh-CN.description: IGAWorks AdPopcorn SSP SDK 会打开 Reward Plus 设置页面，展示当前的支付、通知和每日积分上限选项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法查看或调整这些 Reward Plus 设置。

en.description: The IGAWorks AdPopcorn SSP SDK opens this screen to play a video ad and, for rewarded placements, reports when the required viewing is complete.
en.disableEffect: Rewarded videos will not play, and users will not receive the reward for watching them.

zh-CN.description: IGAWorks AdPopcorn SSP SDK 会打开此页面播放视频广告；对于奖励广告位，它还会在用户完成观看后提交结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 奖励视频将无法播放，用户也无法获得观看奖励。

en.description: The IGAWorks AdPopcorn SSP SDK opens the app-provided Reward Plus page and displays its reward offers and video-ad content.
en.disableEffect: Reward Plus content will not open, and users will not receive rewards for its rewarded-video ads.

zh-CN.description: IGAWorks AdPopcorn SSP SDK 会打开应用提供的 Reward Plus 页面，并展示奖励优惠和视频广告内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Reward Plus 内容将无法打开，用户也无法获得其中奖励视频的观看奖励。

en.description: Ignidata Surveys by Andre Teixeira opens this sign-up page as part of its survey flow, collects age, gender, and country from the participant, sends the details to Ignidata, and then opens the survey.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot complete participant registration or continue into a survey that requires it.

zh-CN.description: Andre Teixeira 的 Ignidata Surveys 会在调查流程中打开此注册页面，收集参与者的年龄、性别和国家并发送给 Ignidata，随后打开调查。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法完成参与者注册，也无法继续需要该注册的调查。

en.description: Ignidata Surveys by Andre Teixeira opens a survey requested by the app, loads its questions from Ignidata, records answers, and submits them. It returns completion or cancellation status to apps and Unity games that use the integration.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot complete Ignidata surveys, and app flows waiting for the survey result cannot finish.

zh-CN.description: Andre Teixeira 的 Ignidata Surveys 会按应用请求打开调查，从 Ignidata 加载问题、记录答案并提交结果；使用该集成的应用和 Unity 游戏还会收到完成或取消状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法完成 Ignidata 调查，等待调查结果的应用流程也无法结束。

en.description: Ignidata Surveys by Andre Teixeira uses this bridge for Unity games to start a survey and return its result to the game. If opened on its own, it only displays a short startup notice.
en.disableEffect: Unity games using Ignidata cannot start surveys through this integration or receive their results.

zh-CN.description: Andre Teixeira 的 Ignidata Surveys 通过此桥接页面为 Unity 游戏启动调查并将结果返回游戏；如果单独打开，它只会显示简短的启动提示。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用 Ignidata 的 Unity 游戏将无法通过此集成启动调查或接收结果。

en.description: The iKangtai (孕橙) Bluetooth SDK receives nearby Bluetooth scan results and passes them to the device-discovery feature in the app.
en.disableEffect: The app will not receive results from these Bluetooth scans, so nearby compatible devices may not be found.

zh-CN.description: iKangtai（孕橙）蓝牙 SDK 会接收附近蓝牙设备的扫描结果，并将结果交给应用的设备查找功能。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法收到这些蓝牙扫描结果，附近兼容的设备可能无法被发现。

en.description: LiveHelp (Highras customer support SDK) shows the selected help article, its update time, and a helpfulness question. Readers can send feedback or open the support bot from the article.
en.disableEffect: The article details, feedback, and contact route will be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: LiveHelp（Highras 客户支持 SDK）会显示选中的帮助文章、更新时间和有用性反馈问题。用户可以提交反馈，也可以从文章页面打开客服机器人。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 文章详情、反馈和联系客服入口将无法使用。

en.description: LiveHelp (Highras customer support SDK) opens a searchable list of help topics when a user requests FAQs, then opens the selected article.
en.disableEffect: Users will lose the FAQ list, search, and article navigation.

zh-CN.description: LiveHelp（Highras 客户支持 SDK）会在用户打开常见问题时显示可搜索的帮助主题列表，并打开选中的文章。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法查看或搜索常见问题，也无法打开文章。

en.description: LiveHelp (Highras customer support SDK) opens the human support conversation when the app directs a user to an agent. The conversation page can open attachments from the phone.
en.disableEffect: Human support chat and sending attachments from this screen will be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: LiveHelp（Highras 客户支持 SDK）会在应用将用户转接给客服人员时打开人工会话页面。会话页面也可以从手机中选择附件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 人工客服聊天和从此页面发送附件将无法使用。

en.description: LiveHelp (Highras customer support SDK) opens its automated help conversation when the app starts a bot session. Its contact option can open the human support conversation.
en.disableEffect: The automated help conversation and its handoff to a human agent will be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: LiveHelp（Highras 客户支持 SDK）会在应用启动机器人客服会话时打开自动答疑页面。页面中的联系选项可以转到人工客服会话。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 自动答疑会话及转接人工客服的入口将无法使用。

en.description: The BuzzMsg IM SDK uses this file provider to create shareable links for local message attachments when the app or another viewer opens them.
en.disableEffect: Opening or sharing message attachments may fail because the SDK cannot provide access to their files.

zh-CN.description: BuzzMsg 即时通信 SDK 会通过此文件提供器为本地消息附件创建可分享的链接，供应用或其他查看器打开文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，SDK 无法提供附件文件的访问方式，打开或分享消息附件可能失败。

en.description: The BuzzMsg and BBIM instant messaging SDK variants open this Activity when a user previews a PDF attachment. It displays the PDF pages from the selected file.
en.disableEffect: Users may lose the ability to preview PDF files shared in messages, and PDF-open actions in the messaging SDK may fail.

zh-CN.description: BuzzMsg 和 BBIM 即时通信 SDK 会在用户预览 PDF 附件时打开此页面，并显示所选文件的各页内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户可能无法预览消息中分享的 PDF 文件，即时通信 SDK 的 PDF 打开流程也可能失败。

en.description: When a user taps an action in a Webex Connect push notification, this Activity sends the selected action to its destination in the app and then closes.
en.disableEffect: Actions on Webex Connect push notifications will no longer open their destination; the app's in-app screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击 Webex Connect 推送通知中的操作时，此 Activity 会将所选操作送到应用中的目标页面，然后关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Webex Connect 推送通知中的操作将无法打开目标页面，但应用内页面仍可使用。

en.description: Webex Connect opens this Activity for a quick reply to a push notification. It shows a text field and a send control for the response.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to reply directly from Webex Connect notifications, but can still use the app's conversation screen.

zh-CN.description: Webex Connect 会为推送通知中的快速回复打开此 Activity。页面提供文本框和发送按钮。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法直接回复 Webex Connect 通知，但仍可使用应用内的会话页面。

en.description: When a Webex Connect notification action opens a web destination, this Activity displays the page in an embedded browser. It loads the destination URL from the incoming request.
en.disableEffect: Webex Connect notification links that open in this browser will stop working; other app pages remain available.

zh-CN.description: Webex Connect 通知操作打开网页目标时，此 Activity 会在内置浏览器中显示页面，并从请求中读取目标网址。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过此浏览器打开的 Webex Connect 通知链接将无法使用，但应用的其他页面仍可打开。

en.description: When a Webex Connect file download is scheduled, Android runs this Service in the background to continue the transfer and report when it finishes.
en.disableEffect: File attachments or other files shared through Webex Connect conversations may not finish downloading.

zh-CN.description: 安排 Webex Connect 文件下载后，Android 会在后台运行此 Service 以继续传输，并在完成时报告结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过 Webex Connect 会话分享的文件或附件可能无法下载完成。

en.description: When Webex Connect starts a file transfer, this Service downloads the file in the background for use in a conversation.
en.disableEffect: Users may be unable to download files shared through Webex Connect conversations.

zh-CN.description: Webex Connect 启动文件传输时，此 Service 会在后台下载文件，供会话使用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户可能无法下载 Webex Connect 会话中分享的文件。

en.description: When Android detects that the device entered or left a geofence, this Receiver passes the location event to Webex Connect for background processing.
en.disableEffect: Webex Connect will no longer receive geofence events through this component; other app functions remain available.

zh-CN.description: Android 检测到设备进入或离开地理围栏时，此 Receiver 会将位置事件交给 Webex Connect 在后台处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Webex Connect 将无法再通过此组件收到地理围栏事件，但应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: This background service processes Webex Connect geofence entry and exit events and updates the SDK with the triggering regions. It runs after Android reports a location transition.
en.disableEffect: Webex Connect location-based messages and updates will stop responding to geofence transitions; other app functions remain available.

zh-CN.description: Android 报告位置变化后，此后台服务会处理 Webex Connect 地理围栏的进入和离开事件，并更新触发的区域信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Webex Connect 的位置定向消息和更新将不再响应地理围栏变化，但应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: When Android delivers a location update, this Receiver extracts the new position and notifies Webex Connect's registered location listeners.
en.disableEffect: Webex Connect will stop receiving background location updates for location-based messaging; other app functions remain available.

zh-CN.description: Android 发送位置更新时，此 Receiver 会提取新位置并通知 Webex Connect 已注册的位置监听器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Webex Connect 将无法收到用于位置定向消息的后台位置更新，但应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: When Webex Connect needs a runtime permission, this Activity requests it from the user and returns the result to the SDK. It can also explain why a permission is needed.
en.disableEffect: Permission-dependent Webex Connect features may stop working because the SDK cannot complete their permission requests.

zh-CN.description: Webex Connect 需要运行时权限时，会通过此 Activity 向用户请求权限，并将结果返回 SDK；页面也可说明请求原因。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 由于 SDK 无法完成权限请求，需要这些权限的 Webex Connect 功能可能无法使用。

en.description: After Android finishes starting the device, this Receiver schedules Webex Connect's one-time network task to resume background synchronization, including event and geofence work.
en.disableEffect: Webex Connect background synchronization and location state may not resume after a device restart; the app still opens normally.

zh-CN.description: Android 完成设备启动后，此 Receiver 会安排 Webex Connect 的一次性联网任务，以恢复后台同步，包括事件和地理围栏数据。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 设备重启后，Webex Connect 的后台同步和位置状态可能无法恢复，但应用仍可正常打开。

en.description: When Webex Connect needs images for its content, Android runs this background job to load and prepare them for display.
en.disableEffect: Webex Connect content that relies on downloaded images may appear without those images.

zh-CN.description: Webex Connect 内容需要图片时，Android 会在后台运行此任务来加载图片并为显示做好准备。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖下载图片的 Webex Connect 内容可能无法显示这些图片。

en.description: When Google Firebase delivers a Webex Connect push message or token update, this Service passes the data to the SDK's push handler.
en.disableEffect: Webex Connect push notifications and token updates will stop, while in-app conversation screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: Google Firebase 送达 Webex Connect 推送消息或令牌更新时，此 Service 会将数据交给 SDK 的推送处理器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Webex Connect 推送通知和令牌更新将停止，但应用内会话页面仍可使用。

en.description: When Huawei Push Kit delivers a Webex Connect push message or token update, this Service passes the data to the SDK's push handler.
en.disableEffect: Webex Connect push notifications and token updates will stop on Huawei devices, while in-app conversation screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: Huawei Push Kit 送达 Webex Connect 推送消息或令牌更新时，此 Service 会将数据交给 SDK 的推送处理器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 华为设备上的 Webex Connect 推送通知和令牌更新将停止，但应用内会话页面仍可使用。

en.description: Webex Connect opens this Activity to show conversation lists, categories, or a selected message thread. It also creates and manages conversation threads.
en.disableEffect: The app's Webex Connect conversation screen and thread creation will no longer be available.

zh-CN.description: Webex Connect 通过此 Activity 展示会话列表、分类或选中的消息线程，也负责创建和管理会话线程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法再使用 Webex Connect 会话页面或创建会话线程。

en.description: When a user opens an image in Webex Connect, this Activity loads a local file or remote image and shows it in a zoomable preview.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to open and inspect image attachments in the Webex Connect interface.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Webex Connect 中打开图片时，此 Activity 会加载本地文件或远程图片，并提供可缩放的预览。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在 Webex Connect 界面中打开和查看图片附件。

en.description: When a user records an audio message in Webex Connect, this Activity records a clip to a temporary file and returns it to the message composer.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to record and send audio messages through Webex Connect.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Webex Connect 中录制语音消息时，此 Activity 会将录音保存到临时文件并交给消息编辑器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 Webex Connect 录制和发送语音消息。

en.description: When Webex Connect's user interface needs a runtime permission, this Activity asks for the requested permissions and returns the grant result to the caller.
en.disableEffect: The Webex Connect interface may be unable to request permissions needed to view or attach shared media.

zh-CN.description: Webex Connect 界面需要运行时权限时，此 Activity 会请求相应权限，并将授权结果返回调用方。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Webex Connect 界面可能无法请求查看或附加共享媒体所需的权限。

en.description: The Momo Live SDK opens this screen when a flow such as changing a phone number requires the wallet password. It shows the supplied prompt and lets the user enter the password for verification.
en.disableEffect: Changing a phone number through a flow that requires wallet verification cannot continue.

zh-CN.description: 陌陌直播 SDK 在更换手机号等需要验证钱包密码的流程中打开此界面。界面显示相应提示，并让用户输入密码完成验证。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要钱包密码验证的手机号更换流程将无法继续。

en.description: The Momo Live SDK uses this screen for a fast purchase after receiving the product, price, coupon, and payment-channel details. It starts the purchase through Alipay or WeChat Pay and closes when the result returns.
en.disableEffect: The fast-purchase flow cannot complete product purchases.

zh-CN.description: 陌陌直播 SDK 在快速购买流程中接收商品、价格、优惠券和支付渠道信息，并通过支付宝或微信支付发起购买。支付结果返回后，界面会关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 快速购买流程将无法完成商品购买。

en.description: When a user opens membership details, the Momo Live SDK loads the supplied benefits page in a browser view. A button on the page can take the user to open or renew membership.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot view membership details or continue to the membership page through this screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户查看会员详情时，陌陌直播 SDK 会在浏览页面中加载相应的权益介绍。页面按钮可带用户前往开通或续费会员。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此界面查看会员详情或进入会员页面。

en.description: The Momo Live SDK opens this membership center to show membership benefits and account-specific renewal options. Users can renew or gift membership to a friend, and can open a web page for a listed benefit.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot use this screen to view membership benefits, renew, or gift membership.

zh-CN.description: 陌陌直播 SDK 使用此会员中心展示会员权益和相应的续费选项。用户可在此续费或向好友赠送会员，也可打开权益详情页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此界面查看会员权益、续费或赠送会员。

en.description: During an in-app purchase, this Momo Live SDK screen displays available payment methods and lets the user choose one. It sends the payment result back to the page that started the purchase.
en.disableEffect: The in-app payment flow cannot be completed.

zh-CN.description: 应用内购买时，陌陌直播 SDK 会显示可用的支付方式并让用户选择。支付结果会返回到发起购买的页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用内支付流程将无法完成。

en.description: When users open a VIP or SVIP offer, the Momo Live SDK displays the matching membership purchase choices and account details. The screen also supports switching between the two membership types when the request allows it.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open the VIP or SVIP purchase and renewal screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 VIP 或 SVIP 会员优惠时，陌陌直播 SDK 会显示相应的会员购买选项和账户信息。请求允许时，用户还可在两种会员类型之间切换。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开 VIP 或 SVIP 的购买及续费界面。

en.description: The Momo Live SDK uses this screen to buy Momo coins. Users choose a coin amount, review a payment method, and return from the payment flow.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot recharge Momo coins through this flow.

zh-CN.description: 陌陌直播 SDK 使用此界面购买陌陌币。用户选择币数、确认支付方式，并在支付后返回。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此流程充值陌陌币。

en.description: When users manage recurring membership payments, the Momo Live SDK shows their renewal status and lets them turn VIP or SVIP auto-renewal on or off.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot manage membership auto-renewal through this screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户管理会员自动续费时，陌陌直播 SDK 会显示续费状态，并允许开启或关闭 VIP、SVIP 自动续费。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此界面管理会员自动续费。

en.description: When a wallet payment needs confirmation, the Momo Live SDK shows the transaction details and asks the user to enter the wallet password before continuing.
en.disableEffect: Wallet transactions that require this check cannot proceed.

zh-CN.description: 钱包支付需要确认时，陌陌直播 SDK 会显示交易信息，并要求用户输入钱包密码后才能继续。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要此项验证的钱包交易将无法继续。

en.description: When a purchase needs more Momo coins, this Momo Live SDK panel shows recharge packages and starts payment for the amount needed. It returns the payment result to the original purchase.
en.disableEffect: A purchase that depends on this fast-recharge panel cannot get the required coins or complete payment.

zh-CN.description: 购买所需陌陌币不足时，陌陌直播 SDK 会显示充值套餐，并为所需金额发起支付。支付结果会返回到原购买流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖快速充值面板的购买流程将无法获得所需陌陌币或完成支付。

en.description: During a Momo account sign-in or authorization request, this screen opens the authorization page and returns its result to the requesting flow. It may ask for phone permission used by the authentication check.
en.disableEffect: Momo account sign-in or authorization flows that use this screen will fail.

zh-CN.description: 陌陌账号登录或授权时，此界面会打开授权页面，并将结果返回发起流程。身份验证过程中可能会请求电话状态权限。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此界面的陌陌账号登录或授权流程将无法完成。

en.description: Immomo’s LiteBuild library runs this Provider as the app starts to load available code patches and resource updates.
en.disableEffect: LiteBuild code and resource patches will not load, so fixes or resources supplied through those patches may be missing.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，Immomo 的 LiteBuild 库会通过此 Provider 加载可用的代码补丁和资源更新。
zh-CN.disableEffect: LiteBuild 的代码补丁和资源更新将无法加载，补丁提供的修复或资源可能缺失。

en.description: The MoMo Cosmos certification SDK opens this screen for a live face check; it requests camera access, guides the user through the check, and submits the captured verification images.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot complete this identity-verification step or receive its result.

zh-CN.description: MoMo Cosmos 认证 SDK 会在此页面进行人脸活体检测，申请相机权限、引导用户完成检测，并提交采集到的认证图像。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法完成此身份认证步骤或取得认证结果。

en.description: After a user chooses an image for a Momo Live SDK flow, this screen lets them crop it to the requested size and save or discard the result.
en.disableEffect: Flows that require this image-cropping step cannot prepare the selected picture.

zh-CN.description: 用户为陌陌直播 SDK 的流程选好图片后，可在此界面按要求裁切图片并保存或放弃。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要此裁切步骤的流程将无法准备所选图片。

en.description: When a Momo Live SDK flow needs pictures, this screen lists recent albums and lets the user select multiple images. Depending on the flow, it can also open the camera or the image-cropping screen.
en.disableEffect: Flows that use this picker cannot choose or attach pictures.

zh-CN.description: 陌陌直播 SDK 的流程需要图片时，此界面会列出最近的相册并允许用户多选。根据具体流程，用户还可打开相机或图片裁切界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此选择器的流程将无法选择或附加图片。

en.description: The Momo Live SDK opens this screen for live-room routes. It loads the matching video room, audio room, or broadcast screen and manages that live session until the user leaves.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot view or host live rooms through this SDK.

zh-CN.description: 陌陌直播 SDK 通过此界面打开直播间，并加载相应的视频房间、语音房间或开播界面，直到用户离开。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此 SDK 观看直播间或进行开播。

en.description: This Momo Live SDK screen hosts full-screen pages supplied at runtime. It can use landscape orientation when the requested page needs it.
en.disableEffect: Dynamically supplied full-screen pages that use this screen will not open.

zh-CN.description: 陌陌直播 SDK 使用此界面承载运行时提供的全屏页面。页面需要横屏时，界面会切换为横屏。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此界面的动态全屏页面将无法打开。

en.description: This Momo Live SDK screen lets users enter a room number to open a live room or grant camera and microphone access to start a broadcast.
en.disableEffect: Users lose this SDK screen for opening a room or starting a broadcast.

zh-CN.description: 陌陌直播 SDK 使用此界面让用户输入房间号并打开直播间，或在获得相机和麦克风权限后开始直播。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此 SDK 界面打开房间或开始直播。

en.description: When the app opens the Momo Live SDK’s new live home, this screen shows the live-home feed supplied by the SDK.
en.disableEffect: The new live-home screen cannot be opened.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开陌陌直播 SDK 的新版直播首页时，此界面会显示 SDK 提供的直播内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 新版直播首页将无法打开。

en.description: This Momo Live SDK screen shows a tabbed home with a live feed and a tools tab. It passes activity results to the selected tab.
en.disableEffect: Users lose the SDK’s live and tools tabs.

zh-CN.description: 陌陌直播 SDK 使用此界面展示带标签页的首页，其中包括直播内容和工具页。界面会将活动结果传回当前标签页。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法使用 SDK 的直播页和工具页。

en.description: The Momo Live SDK entry screen shows its app identifier and offers account sign-in, guest access, profile editing, and shortcuts to live rooms.
en.disableEffect: This entry screen and the login, profile, and live shortcuts on it will not open.

zh-CN.description: 陌陌直播 SDK 的入口界面会显示应用标识，并提供账号登录、游客访问、资料编辑和直播入口。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 此入口界面及其中的登录、资料和直播入口将无法打开。

en.description: When the app launcher opens this Momo Live SDK activity, it immediately forwards the user to the SDK entry screen.
en.disableEffect: Disabling this activity prevents the launcher route from reaching the SDK entry screen.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动器打开陌陌直播 SDK 的此界面后，它会立即将用户带到 SDK 入口页。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用此界面后，启动器将无法通过这一路径进入 SDK 入口页。

en.description: This Momo Live SDK screen hosts pages supplied at runtime for the live area. The page shown depends on what the user opens.
en.disableEffect: Live-area pages that use this screen will not open.

zh-CN.description: 陌陌直播 SDK 使用此界面承载直播区域中运行时提供的页面。具体显示内容取决于用户打开的页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此界面的直播页面将无法打开。

en.description: When users search in the live area, the Momo Live SDK shows matching live-related results and lets them refine or clear the search.
en.disableEffect: Live-area search results cannot be viewed through the SDK.

zh-CN.description: 用户在直播区域搜索时，陌陌直播 SDK 会显示相关结果，并允许用户修改或清除搜索内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此 SDK 查看直播区域的搜索结果。

en.description: This Momo Live SDK screen shows live results for a selected tag or a recent-host list, using the title supplied by the page that opened it.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open the tag or recent-host results page.

zh-CN.description: 陌陌直播 SDK 使用此界面展示所选标签的直播结果或最近浏览的主播列表，并采用打开页面提供的标题。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开标签结果页或最近浏览主播列表。

en.description: This Momo Live SDK screen displays a web page opened from an SDK link and handles the page’s in-app interactions. It also supports page actions such as choosing a file to upload.
en.disableEffect: Web pages that use this screen will not open or complete their in-page flows.

zh-CN.description: 陌陌直播 SDK 使用此界面显示从 SDK 链接打开的网页，并处理网页内的交互操作。它也支持选择文件上传等页面操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此界面的网页将无法打开或完成页面内的流程。

en.description: This Momo Live SDK browser opens pages supplied by SDK links or by the `momochat://immomo.com` web link. It displays the page and handles its navigation.
en.disableEffect: Web pages and deep links routed to this screen cannot be opened.

zh-CN.description: 陌陌直播 SDK 的此浏览器会打开 SDK 链接或 `momochat://immomo.com` 网页链接提供的页面，并处理页面导航。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 路由到此界面的网页和深层链接将无法打开。

en.description: Users open this Momo Live SDK screen to view and edit profile details such as their display name, birthday, and avatar. It loads profile information and saves changes to the account.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot edit these profile details through this flow.

zh-CN.description: 用户可通过陌陌直播 SDK 的此界面查看和编辑昵称、生日、头像等资料。界面会加载个人资料，并将修改保存到账户。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此流程编辑这些资料。

en.description: This Momo Live SDK test screen displays a simple sample greeting. It has no account or live controls.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it only removes the sample greeting screen.

zh-CN.description: 陌陌直播 SDK 的此测试界面只显示简单的示例问候语，不包含账号或直播操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后只会移除此示例问候界面。

en.description: When Android grants screen capture for a Momo Live SDK session, this foreground service holds the capture grant and shows a recording notification.
en.disableEffect: Live sessions that share the screen cannot keep screen capture running through this service.

zh-CN.description: Android 为陌陌直播 SDK 会话授予屏幕录制权限后，此前台服务会持有该授权并显示录制通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要共享屏幕的直播会话将无法通过此服务继续录制屏幕。

en.description: This Momo Live SDK screen plays a supplied video full-screen, repeats it when it ends, and provides a close button.
en.disableEffect: The video screen used by that flow will not open.

zh-CN.description: 陌陌直播 SDK 使用此界面全屏播放指定视频；视频结束后会重新播放，并提供关闭按钮。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 该流程使用的视频界面将无法打开。

en.description: This Momo Live SDK screen hosts pages supplied at runtime; the content changes according to the page requested by the app.
en.disableEffect: Dynamically supplied SDK pages that use this screen cannot be shown.

zh-CN.description: 陌陌直播 SDK 使用此界面承载运行时提供的页面，具体内容由应用请求的页面决定。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此界面的动态 SDK 页面将无法显示。

en.description: This Momo Live SDK screen hosts the dynamically supplied nearby-live page and closes when nearby-live browsing is dismissed.
en.disableEffect: Nearby-live pages that use this screen will not open.

zh-CN.description: 陌陌直播 SDK 使用此界面承载动态提供的附近直播页面；用户关闭附近直播浏览时，界面也会关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此界面的附近直播页面将无法打开。

en.description: When the Momo Live SDK needs phone-state access for an account security check, this screen explains the request and asks the user to grant permission. Without it, the account flow may be limited to guest access.
en.disableEffect: Non-guest account access may be unavailable when the SDK requires this permission.

zh-CN.description: 陌陌直播 SDK 需要读取电话状态以进行账号安全检查时，此界面会说明原因并请求用户授权。缺少该权限时，账号流程可能只能使用游客访问。
zh-CN.disableEffect: SDK 需要此权限时，非游客账号访问可能无法使用。

en.description: When a dynamically loaded MOMO plugin page reads or updates its content, the MOMO plugin SDK uses this ContentProvider to make that plugin data available.
en.disableEffect: Plugin pages that need this data source may fail to load, and app features supplied by those plugins may stop working.

zh-CN.description: 当动态加载的 MOMO 插件页面读取或更新内容时，MOMO 插件 SDK 会通过此 ContentProvider 提供相应的数据访问。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此数据源的插件页面可能无法加载，应用中由这些插件提供的功能也可能无法使用。

en.description: When the host app starts the MOMO plugin runtime, this service runs the separate process used by dynamically loaded plugin features.
en.disableEffect: Dynamically loaded MOMO plugin pages or tasks may fail to start, so app features that rely on them may be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: 宿主应用启动 MOMO 插件运行环境时，此 Service 会运行动态加载插件功能所需的独立进程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: MOMO 动态插件页面或任务可能无法启动，依赖这些插件的应用功能也可能无法使用。

en.description: When the MOMO plugin SDK opens a page loaded at runtime, this Activity provides the screen for displaying that page.
en.disableEffect: Plugin pages assigned to this screen may not open, which can make app features supplied through those pages unavailable.

zh-CN.description: MOMO 插件 SDK 打开动态加载的页面时，此 Activity 用于显示该页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此页面入口的插件可能无法打开，应用中由这些插件提供的功能也可能无法使用。

en.description: When the MOMO plugin SDK opens a page loaded at runtime, this Activity provides a screen slot for that plugin page.
en.disableEffect: Plugin pages assigned to this screen may not open, which can make app features supplied through those pages unavailable.

zh-CN.description: MOMO 插件 SDK 打开动态加载的页面时，此 Activity 为该插件页面提供显示入口。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此页面入口的插件可能无法打开，应用中由这些插件提供的功能也可能无法使用。

en.description: When the MOMO plugin SDK opens a page loaded at runtime, this Activity provides a screen slot for that plugin page.
en.disableEffect: Plugin pages assigned to this screen may not open, which can make app features supplied through those pages unavailable.

zh-CN.description: MOMO 插件 SDK 打开动态加载的页面时，此 Activity 为该插件页面提供显示入口。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此页面入口的插件可能无法打开，应用中由这些插件提供的功能也可能无法使用。

en.description: When the MOMO plugin SDK opens a page loaded at runtime, this Activity provides a screen slot for that plugin page.
en.disableEffect: Plugin pages assigned to this screen may not open, which can make app features supplied through those pages unavailable.

zh-CN.description: MOMO 插件 SDK 打开动态加载的页面时，此 Activity 为该插件页面提供显示入口。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此页面入口的插件可能无法打开，应用中由这些插件提供的功能也可能无法使用。

en.description: Momo’s Cosmos Photon push SDK receives Honor push tokens and data messages through this Service, then forwards them to the app.
en.disableEffect: Honor push registration updates and data messages will no longer reach the app through MoPush.

zh-CN.description: Momo 的 Cosmos Photon 推送 SDK 会通过此 Service 接收荣耀推送令牌和数据消息，再交给应用处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 荣耀推送注册更新和数据消息将无法再通过 MoPush 送达应用。

en.description: At app startup, the MOMO Wink LiteBuild SDK checks for available app fixes and applies code or resource updates it finds.
en.disableEffect: Available Wink fixes may not load, so the app may miss a correction or resource update that it depends on.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，MOMO Wink LiteBuild SDK 会检查可用的修复，并应用找到的代码或资源更新。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 可用的 Wink 修复可能无法加载，应用可能缺少其依赖的错误修正或资源更新。

en.description: After a user submits an image in the Imoji sticker editor, this background service sends it to Imoji to create a sticker and returns the result to the app.
en.disableEffect: The app's Imoji sticker creation flow will not be able to submit images or return newly created stickers.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Imoji 贴纸编辑器中提交图片后，此后台 Service 会将图片发送给 Imoji 生成贴纸，并把结果返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用的 Imoji 贴纸创建流程将无法提交图片或返回新生成的贴纸。

en.description: When the app starts Imoji's sticker creation flow for a selected image, this Activity opens the image editor used to prepare an Imoji sticker.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to open the Imoji editor to prepare or create stickers from images.

zh-CN.description: 应用为选中的图片启动 Imoji 贴纸创建流程时，此 Activity 会打开图片编辑界面，用于制作 Imoji 贴纸。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开 Imoji 编辑器，也无法从图片制作贴纸。

en.description: The SAN incentive SDK uses this brief background Activity during an app-install incentive task. It opens a nearly invisible window and closes it after about two seconds.
en.disableEffect: This brief app-install incentive step will not run.

zh-CN.description: SAN 激励广告 SDK 在应用安装激励任务中会使用这个短暂的后台 Activity；它打开一个几乎不可见的窗口，并在约两秒后关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 这个短暂的应用安装激励步骤将无法运行。

en.description: When the SAN incentive SDK performs an app-install auto-open task, this Activity briefly creates a nearly invisible window and closes itself after about two seconds.
en.disableEffect: SAN may not be able to auto-open an advertised app after the corresponding incentive task.

zh-CN.description: SAN 激励广告 SDK 执行应用安装自动打开任务时，此 Activity 会短暂显示一个几乎不可见的窗口，并在约两秒后关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: SAN 可能无法在相应激励任务后自动打开推广应用。

en.description: When Android reports an app install or removal, the SAN incentive SDK checks whether that app came from an offer and records the install or upgrade for attribution.
en.disableEffect: SAN may stop recognizing and crediting advertised-app installs and upgrades.

zh-CN.description: Android 通知应用安装或卸载时，SAN 激励广告 SDK 会检查该应用是否来自推广，并记录安装或升级归因。
zh-CN.disableEffect: SAN 可能无法再识别或记录推广应用的安装与升级。

en.description: The SAN incentive SDK starts this Service to download promoted apps and to pause or resume those downloads.
en.disableEffect: Promoted-app downloads through the SAN incentive SDK will not start or resume.

zh-CN.description: SAN 激励广告 SDK 通过这个服务下载推广应用，并暂停或继续这些下载。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过 SAN 激励广告 SDK 下载的推广应用将无法开始或继续下载。

en.description: When a user taps a SAN app-promotion notification, this Activity checks the advertised app and continues its open or install action.
en.disableEffect: Tapping these SAN promotion notifications will no longer take the user to the advertised app or its install step.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击 SAN 应用推广通知时，这个 Activity 会检查推广应用，并继续打开或安装该应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 点击这些 SAN 推广通知后，将无法再打开推广应用或进入安装步骤。

en.description: When a verification flow needs to open or share a saved result file, the MetaMap identity verification SDK uses this provider to pass a protected file link to the viewer.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it can prevent result files from opening or being shared from the verification flow.

zh-CN.description: 核验流程需要打开或分享已保存的结果文件时，MetaMap 身份核验 SDK 会通过此提供程序向查看器传递受保护的文件链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，核验流程可能无法打开或分享结果文件。

en.description: When the app starts, Android runs this background provider to initialize the MetaMap (Incode) identity verification SDK before a verification flow opens.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it skips SDK initialization, so identity verification may fail before its first screen opens.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，Android 会运行此后台提供程序，在身份核验流程打开前初始化 MetaMap（Incode）身份核验 SDK。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，SDK 会跳过初始化，身份核验可能在首个页面打开前就失败。

en.description: Android starts this background service for scheduled video-upload work in older MetaMap flows; it sends recorded verification videos to MetaMap.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents required video evidence from uploading, so a video-based verification cannot finish.

zh-CN.description: 旧版 MetaMap 核验流程安排视频上传后，Android 会在后台启动此服务，将录制的核验视频发送给 MetaMap。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，所需的视频材料无法上传，依赖视频的身份核验无法完成。

en.description: Android starts this background service when MetaMap schedules video upload or cleanup; it sends recorded verification videos to MetaMap.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents required video evidence from uploading, so a video-based verification cannot finish.

zh-CN.description: MetaMap 安排视频上传或清理任务后，Android 会在后台启动此服务，将录制的核验视频发送给 MetaMap。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，所需的视频材料无法上传，依赖视频的身份核验无法完成。

en.description: The MetaMap identity verification SDK shows this brief transition screen while moving between verification steps.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it can stop a configured verification flow while it is moving to the next screen.

zh-CN.description: MetaMap 身份核验 SDK 在不同核验步骤之间切换时会显示此过渡页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，包含此页面的核验流程可能会在切换步骤时中断。

en.description: The MetaMap identity verification SDK shows this brief transition screen while moving between verification steps.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it can stop a configured verification flow while it is moving to the next screen.

zh-CN.description: MetaMap 身份核验 SDK 在不同核验步骤之间切换时会显示此过渡页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，包含此页面的核验流程可能会在切换步骤时中断。

en.description: When a configured verification flow requires a video selfie, this screen explains the recording step and asks the user to accept it before recording begins. The MetaMap identity verification SDK opens this screen when the configured flow reaches this step.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from accepting the video-selfie step when the flow requires one.

zh-CN.description: 核验流程要求录制视频自拍时，此页面会说明录制步骤，并在开始前征求用户同意。配置的核验流程到达此步骤时，MetaMap 身份核验 SDK 会打开此页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法在流程要求时同意视频自拍步骤。

en.description: When a flow includes electronic document signing, this screen lets the user review or add a PDF and accept the signing terms before continuing. The MetaMap identity verification SDK opens this screen when the configured flow reaches this step.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from completing document-signing flows that require it.

zh-CN.description: 核验流程包含电子文件签署时，此页面允许用户查看或添加 PDF，并在继续前接受签名条款。配置的核验流程到达此步骤时，MetaMap 身份核验 SDK 会打开此页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法完成要求电子签名的核验步骤。

en.description: The MetaMap SDK opens this screen for an anti-fraud check selected by the verification flow and presents the check's progress or outcome.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it can prevent a verification that requires the anti-fraud check from continuing.

zh-CN.description: 核验流程要求反欺诈检查时，MetaMap SDK 会打开此页面并展示检查进度或结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，要求反欺诈检查的身份核验可能无法继续。

en.description: This screen confirms the selfie or face-approval step when a MetaMap verification flow requests it, and displays the resulting approval state.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents the user from completing a flow that requires this approval step.

zh-CN.description: MetaMap 核验流程要求确认自拍或人脸审核时，此页面会处理该步骤并展示审核状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法完成要求此审核步骤的核验流程。

en.description: Before a verification flow captures a face or other biometric information, this screen asks the user to review and provide biometric consent. The MetaMap identity verification SDK opens this screen when the configured flow reaches this step.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from giving the required biometric consent, so that verification flow cannot proceed.

zh-CN.description: 核验流程采集人脸或其他生物识别信息前，此页面会请用户阅读并提供生物识别同意。配置的核验流程到达此步骤时，MetaMap 身份核验 SDK 会打开此页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法提供所需的生物识别同意，该核验流程也无法继续。

en.description: When the flow asks for an identity document, this screen opens the camera to capture the document image and check the scan. The MetaMap identity verification SDK opens this screen when the configured flow reaches this step.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from completing document capture when this screen is selected.

zh-CN.description: 核验流程要求提供身份证件时，此页面会打开相机拍摄证件并检查扫描结果。配置的核验流程到达此步骤时，MetaMap 身份核验 SDK 会打开此页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法在流程选用此页面时完成证件拍摄。

en.description: After an identity document is captured, this screen processes the selected document type and advances the user through the document-review step. The MetaMap identity verification SDK opens this screen when the configured flow reaches this step.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents the configured document-verification flow from processing the captured ID.

zh-CN.description: 身份证件拍摄完成后，此页面会处理所选证件类型，并带用户进入证件复核步骤。配置的核验流程到达此步骤时，MetaMap 身份核验 SDK 会打开此页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，配置了此步骤的证件核验流程无法处理已拍摄的证件。

en.description: This screen shows the identity-document scan summary, including whether the front or back image passed or failed, and offers the next step. The MetaMap identity verification SDK opens this screen when the configured flow reaches this step.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from reviewing and continuing from the document-scan outcome when this step is required.

zh-CN.description: 此页面会显示证件扫描摘要，包括正面或背面图像是否通过，并提供后续操作。配置的核验流程到达此步骤时，MetaMap 身份核验 SDK 会打开此页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，流程要求此步骤时，用户无法查看扫描结果并继续。

en.description: When selected by the verification flow, this screen opens a full-screen camera for an identity-document or age-assurance scan and checks the captured image. The MetaMap identity verification SDK opens this screen when the configured flow reaches this step.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents the configured camera-based identity check from completing.

zh-CN.description: 核验流程选用此页面时，它会打开全屏相机进行证件或年龄核验扫描，并检查拍摄的图像。配置的核验流程到达此步骤时，MetaMap 身份核验 SDK 会打开此页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，配置了此相机检查的身份核验流程无法完成。

en.description: When a verification step requires a QR code, this screen uses the camera to scan it and return the result to the flow. The MetaMap identity verification SDK opens this screen when the configured flow reaches this step.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from completing verification steps that require a QR-code scan.

zh-CN.description: 核验步骤要求扫描二维码时，此页面会打开相机读取二维码并将结果交回流程。配置的核验流程到达此步骤时，MetaMap 身份核验 SDK 会打开此页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法完成要求扫描二维码的核验步骤。

en.description: Before the QR-code camera opens, this screen explains how to position and scan the code. The MetaMap identity verification SDK opens this screen when the configured flow reaches this step.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents the QR-scan path from showing its required instructions and may interrupt that path.

zh-CN.description: 二维码相机打开前，此页面会说明如何摆放并扫描二维码。配置的核验流程到达此步骤时，MetaMap 身份核验 SDK 会打开此页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，二维码扫描流程无法显示所需说明，并可能中断该流程。

en.description: After a document photo is taken, this screen lets the user inspect it and choose to scan again or continue. The MetaMap identity verification SDK opens this screen when the configured flow reaches this step.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it removes the photo-review choice, preventing the user from confirming or retaking a required document image.

zh-CN.description: 证件照片拍摄后，此页面让用户检查图像，并选择重新扫描或继续。配置的核验流程到达此步骤时，MetaMap 身份核验 SDK 会打开此页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法确认或重新拍摄所需证件图像，照片复核步骤也无法完成。

en.description: When the flow requests a selfie, this screen uses the front camera to capture the user's face and gives guidance when the face image needs another try. The MetaMap identity verification SDK opens this screen when the configured flow reaches this step.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents selfie-based identity checks from collecting the required face image.

zh-CN.description: 核验流程要求自拍时，此页面会用前置相机拍摄用户人脸，并在图像需要重拍时给出提示。配置的核验流程到达此步骤时，MetaMap 身份核验 SDK 会打开此页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，依赖自拍的人脸核验无法采集所需图像。

en.description: When a flow requests a video selfie, this screen records the user on camera and uploads the recording for verification. The MetaMap identity verification SDK opens this screen when the configured flow reaches this step.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents video-selfie verification from recording and submitting the required video.

zh-CN.description: 核验流程要求视频自拍时，此页面会录制用户视频并上传以供核验。配置的核验流程到达此步骤时，MetaMap 身份核验 SDK 会打开此页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，视频自拍核验无法录制并提交所需视频。

en.description: Before video recording, this screen lists the checks the user must complete, such as showing an ID, looking at the camera, and speaking a prompt. The MetaMap identity verification SDK opens this screen when the configured flow reaches this step.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from seeing and completing the required video-selfie instructions.

zh-CN.description: 开始录制视频前，此页面会列出用户必须完成的检查，例如展示证件、看向相机和朗读提示内容。配置的核验流程到达此步骤时，MetaMap 身份核验 SDK 会打开此页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法查看并完成视频自拍所需的说明。

en.description: When the verification service requests a code challenge, this screen shows the code and accepts the user's answer, with an option to try again if it is incorrect. The MetaMap identity verification SDK opens this screen when the configured flow reaches this step.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from completing verification flows that require this challenge.

zh-CN.description: 核验服务要求完成验证码挑战时，此页面会显示验证码并接收用户输入；答案错误时可重新尝试。配置的核验流程到达此步骤时，MetaMap 身份核验 SDK 会打开此页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法完成要求此验证码挑战的核验流程。

en.description: When a flow requests combined consent, this screen displays the supplied consent text and records the user's choice. The MetaMap identity verification SDK opens this screen when the configured flow reaches this step.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents the user from giving or declining the consent required by that verification flow.

zh-CN.description: 核验流程要求合并同意时，此页面会显示流程提供的同意内容并记录用户选择。配置的核验流程到达此步骤时，MetaMap 身份核验 SDK 会打开此页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法对该核验流程要求的事项表示同意或拒绝。

en.description: This screen collects or generates the user's CURP identifier and submits it for validation during identity verification. The MetaMap identity verification SDK opens this screen when the configured flow reaches this step.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from completing a verification flow that requires CURP validation.

zh-CN.description: 此页面会收集或生成用户的 CURP 身份识别码，并在身份核验中提交验证。配置的核验流程到达此步骤时，MetaMap 身份核验 SDK 会打开此页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法完成要求验证 CURP 的核验流程。
