en.description: When the flow includes a custom-watchlist check, this screen submits the user's information and shows the check's progress and result. The MetaMap identity verification SDK opens this screen when the configured flow reaches this step.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents identity checks that rely on the configured custom watchlist from completing.

zh-CN.description: 核验流程包含自定义名单检查时，此页面会提交用户信息并展示检查进度和结果。配置的核验流程到达此步骤时，MetaMap 身份核验 SDK 会打开此页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，依赖已配置自定义名单的身份核验无法完成。

en.description: When the MetaMap flow defers onboarding, this screen introduces the later verification step to the user.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from reaching the deferred-onboarding introduction when the flow uses it.

zh-CN.description: MetaMap 流程延后开始身份核验时，此页面会向用户介绍稍后进行的核验步骤。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，使用延后流程的用户无法进入该流程的介绍页面。

en.description: When identity documents are needed, this screen lets the user choose how to provide the requested document and whether to show the scan tutorial. The MetaMap identity verification SDK opens this screen when the configured flow reaches this step.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from selecting a document path required by the verification flow.

zh-CN.description: 需要身份证件时，此页面让用户选择如何提供所需证件，以及是否查看扫描说明。配置的核验流程到达此步骤时，MetaMap 身份核验 SDK 会打开此页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法选择核验流程所需的证件提交方式。

en.description: When the verification flow supplies a dynamic form, this screen displays its requested fields and collects the user's answers. The MetaMap identity verification SDK opens this screen when the configured flow reaches this step.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from submitting information required by a flow that uses dynamic forms.

zh-CN.description: 核验流程提供动态表单时，此页面会显示所需字段并收集用户填写的内容。配置的核验流程到达此步骤时，MetaMap 身份核验 SDK 会打开此页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法提交使用动态表单的核验流程所需信息。

en.description: When a flow verifies a business, this screen collects business details such as its name, country, address, and tax number, then submits them for checking. The MetaMap identity verification SDK opens this screen when the configured flow reaches this step.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents business-verification flows from collecting and submitting the required details.

zh-CN.description: 核验流程验证企业时，此页面会收集企业名称、国家、地址和税号等信息并提交检查。配置的核验流程到达此步骤时，MetaMap 身份核验 SDK 会打开此页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，企业核验流程无法收集并提交所需信息。

en.description: When a flow verifies an individual, this screen collects personal details such as name, date of birth, contact information, and tax ID, then submits them for checking. The MetaMap identity verification SDK opens this screen when the configured flow reaches this step.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents individual-verification flows from collecting and submitting the required details.

zh-CN.description: 核验流程验证个人身份时，此页面会收集姓名、出生日期、联系方式和税号等信息并提交检查。配置的核验流程到达此步骤时，MetaMap 身份核验 SDK 会打开此页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，个人身份核验流程无法收集并提交所需信息。

en.description: When email verification is part of the flow, this screen collects the user's email address and can verify it with a code sent by email. The MetaMap identity verification SDK opens this screen when the configured flow reaches this step.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from completing required email collection or email-code verification.

zh-CN.description: 核验流程要求验证邮箱时，此页面会收集用户邮箱，并可通过邮件发送的验证码进行验证。配置的核验流程到达此步骤时，MetaMap 身份核验 SDK 会打开此页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法完成所需的邮箱收集或邮件验证码验证。

en.description: When location is required for verification, this screen requests location access and guides the user through providing it. The MetaMap identity verification SDK opens this screen when the configured flow reaches this step.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents verification flows that require the user's location from completing.

zh-CN.description: 核验要求提供位置时，此页面会请求位置权限并引导用户提交位置。配置的核验流程到达此步骤时，MetaMap 身份核验 SDK 会打开此页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，要求用户位置的核验流程无法完成。

en.description: When the flow includes a global-watchlist check, this screen collects identifying details such as name, birth date, and country, then shows the screening result. The MetaMap identity verification SDK opens this screen when the configured flow reaches this step.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from completing verification flows that require global-watchlist screening.

zh-CN.description: 核验流程包含全球名单检查时，此页面会收集姓名、出生日期和国家等身份信息，并展示筛查结果。配置的核验流程到达此步骤时，MetaMap 身份核验 SDK 会打开此页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法完成要求全球名单筛查的核验流程。

en.description: When the flow checks a user's identity against government data, this screen presents the check and whether the submitted face matches the government record. The MetaMap identity verification SDK opens this screen when the configured flow reaches this step.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from seeing or completing a required government identity check.

zh-CN.description: 核验流程将用户身份与政府数据核对时，此页面会展示检查过程以及提交的人脸是否与政府记录匹配。配置的核验流程到达此步骤时，MetaMap 身份核验 SDK 会打开此页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法查看或完成所需的政府身份核验。

en.description: When a configured identity scan begins, this screen requests camera permission and guides the user into document capture. The MetaMap identity verification SDK opens this screen when the configured flow reaches this step.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from starting the required identity-document capture.

zh-CN.description: 配置的身份扫描开始时，此页面会请求相机权限并引导用户拍摄证件。配置的核验流程到达此步骤时，MetaMap 身份核验 SDK 会打开此页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法开始所需的身份证件拍摄。

en.description: After text is read from an identity document, this screen lets the user review and, when allowed, correct details such as name, birth date, document number, and address. The MetaMap identity verification SDK opens this screen when the configured flow reaches this step.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from reviewing or correcting document details required for verification.

zh-CN.description: 身份证件文字识别完成后，此页面让用户检查并在允许时修改姓名、出生日期、证件号码和地址等信息。配置的核验流程到达此步骤时，MetaMap 身份核验 SDK 会打开此页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法检查或更正身份核验所需的证件信息。

en.description: At the start of a MetaMap verification flow, this screen introduces the process and lets the user begin.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from starting flows that require this introduction screen.

zh-CN.description: MetaMap 身份核验流程开始时，此页面会介绍核验过程并让用户开始操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法开始要求显示此介绍页面的核验流程。

en.description: When the verification flow requests machine-learning consent, this screen explains the requested use and records the user's choice. The MetaMap identity verification SDK opens this screen when the configured flow reaches this step.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from responding to the machine-learning consent required by that flow.

zh-CN.description: 核验流程要求机器学习相关同意时，此页面会说明用途并记录用户的选择。配置的核验流程到达此步骤时，MetaMap 身份核验 SDK 会打开此页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法回应该流程要求的机器学习相关同意。

en.description: When a flow needs the user's name, this screen collects it for identity verification. The MetaMap identity verification SDK opens this screen when the configured flow reaches this step.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from submitting a required name in flows that use this step.

zh-CN.description: 核验流程需要用户姓名时，此页面会收集姓名以供身份核验。配置的核验流程到达此步骤时，MetaMap 身份核验 SDK 会打开此页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法在使用此步骤的流程中提交所需姓名。

en.description: When phone verification is part of the flow, this screen collects the user's phone number and can verify it with an SMS code. The MetaMap identity verification SDK opens this screen when the configured flow reaches this step.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from completing required phone collection or SMS-code verification.

zh-CN.description: 核验流程要求验证电话时，此页面会收集用户手机号，并可通过短信验证码进行验证。配置的核验流程到达此步骤时，MetaMap 身份核验 SDK 会打开此页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法完成所需的手机号收集或短信验证码验证。

en.description: After document capture, this newer processing screen handles the selected identity-document type and advances verification to the next document step. The MetaMap identity verification SDK opens this screen when the configured flow reaches this step.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents document-verification flows that use this processing path from continuing.

zh-CN.description: 证件拍摄完成后，此新版处理页面会处理所选证件类型，并将核验流程推进到下一证件步骤。配置的核验流程到达此步骤时，MetaMap 身份核验 SDK 会打开此页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，使用此处理流程的证件核验无法继续。

en.description: When a flow requires a qualified electronic signature, this screen lets the user review documents, provide the signature consent, and see the signing result. The MetaMap identity verification SDK opens this screen when the configured flow reaches this step.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from completing the qualified-signature step in flows that require it.

zh-CN.description: 核验流程要求合格电子签名时，此页面让用户查看文件、提供签名同意并查看签署结果。配置的核验流程到达此步骤时，MetaMap 身份核验 SDK 会打开此页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法完成要求合格电子签名的核验步骤。

en.description: At the end of a verification flow, this screen shows the result and can open a generated result document when one is available. The MetaMap identity verification SDK opens this screen when the configured flow reaches this step.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from seeing the final verification result or opening its result document.

zh-CN.description: 身份核验流程结束时，此页面会显示结果，并可在有结果文件时打开该文件。配置的核验流程到达此步骤时，MetaMap 身份核验 SDK 会打开此页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法查看最终核验结果或打开相关结果文件。

en.description: When a flow checks a selfie against the face on an identity document, this screen presents the face-match step and its outcome. The MetaMap identity verification SDK opens this screen when the configured flow reaches this step.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from completing flows that require this face comparison.

zh-CN.description: 核验流程将自拍与身份证件上的人脸进行比对时，此页面会展示人脸比对步骤和结果。配置的核验流程到达此步骤时，MetaMap 身份核验 SDK 会打开此页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法完成要求此人脸比对的核验流程。

en.description: When a flow requests a selfie scan, this screen guides and captures the user's face according to the supplied scan instructions. The MetaMap identity verification SDK opens this screen when the configured flow reaches this step.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from submitting a selfie scan required by the verification flow.

zh-CN.description: 核验流程要求自拍扫描时，此页面会按照扫描说明引导用户并拍摄人脸。配置的核验流程到达此步骤时，MetaMap 身份核验 SDK 会打开此页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法提交核验流程所需的自拍扫描。

en.description: When a document needs a digital signature, this screen lets the user sign it on the screen and submit the signature. The MetaMap identity verification SDK opens this screen when the configured flow reaches this step.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from completing document-signing flows that require this signature.

zh-CN.description: 文件需要数字签名时，此页面让用户在屏幕上签名并提交签名。配置的核验流程到达此步骤时，MetaMap 身份核验 SDK 会打开此页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法完成要求此签名的文件签署流程。

en.description: When a flow needs a tax identifier, this screen collects the user's tax ID and submits it for validation. The MetaMap identity verification SDK opens this screen when the configured flow reaches this step.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from completing flows that require tax-ID validation.

zh-CN.description: 核验流程需要税务识别号时，此页面会收集用户税号并提交验证。配置的核验流程到达此步骤时，MetaMap 身份核验 SDK 会打开此页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法完成要求验证税号的核验流程。

en.description: Before document capture, this screen lets the user choose the type of identity document to provide. The MetaMap identity verification SDK opens this screen when the configured flow reaches this step.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from selecting a document type when the configured flow uses this choice.

zh-CN.description: 证件拍摄前，此页面让用户选择要提供的身份证件类型。配置的核验流程到达此步骤时，MetaMap 身份核验 SDK 会打开此页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，使用此选项的核验流程中，用户无法选择证件类型。

en.description: Before the back of an identity card is scanned, this screen shows the user how to position and capture it. The MetaMap identity verification SDK opens this screen when the configured flow reaches this step.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from reaching the back-side capture step when this tutorial is required.

zh-CN.description: 扫描身份证背面前，此页面会说明如何摆放和拍摄证件。配置的核验流程到达此步骤时，MetaMap 身份核验 SDK 会打开此页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，教程为必需步骤时，用户无法进入身份证背面拍摄。

en.description: Before an identity document is scanned, this screen explains the document-capture process and how to prepare the document. The MetaMap identity verification SDK opens this screen when the configured flow reaches this step.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from reaching document capture when this tutorial is required.

zh-CN.description: 扫描身份证件前，此页面会说明拍摄流程以及如何准备证件。配置的核验流程到达此步骤时，MetaMap 身份核验 SDK 会打开此页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，教程为必需步骤时，用户无法进入证件拍摄。

en.description: Before the front of an identity card is scanned, this screen shows the user how to position and capture it. The MetaMap identity verification SDK opens this screen when the configured flow reaches this step.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from reaching the front-side capture step when this tutorial is required.

zh-CN.description: 扫描身份证正面前，此页面会说明如何摆放和拍摄证件。配置的核验流程到达此步骤时，MetaMap 身份核验 SDK 会打开此页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，教程为必需步骤时，用户无法进入身份证正面拍摄。

en.description: Before a passport is scanned, this screen explains how to capture it and applies the document-specific scan settings supplied by the flow. The MetaMap identity verification SDK opens this screen when the configured flow reaches this step.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from reaching passport capture when this tutorial is required.

zh-CN.description: 扫描护照前，此页面会说明拍摄方式，并应用流程提供的护照扫描设置。配置的核验流程到达此步骤时，MetaMap 身份核验 SDK 会打开此页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，教程为必需步骤时，用户无法进入护照拍摄。

en.description: Before a selfie is captured, this screen shows the user how to position their face for a clear image. The MetaMap identity verification SDK opens this screen when the configured flow reaches this step.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from reaching selfie capture when this tutorial is required.

zh-CN.description: 拍摄自拍前，此页面会说明如何摆放人脸以获得清晰图像。配置的核验流程到达此步骤时，MetaMap 身份核验 SDK 会打开此页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，教程为必需步骤时，用户无法进入自拍拍摄。

en.description: Before the newer selfie-capture flow starts, this screen shows instructions tailored to the selfie mode selected for verification. The MetaMap identity verification SDK opens this screen when the configured flow reaches this step.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from reaching selfie capture when this version of the tutorial is required.

zh-CN.description: 新版自拍流程开始前，此页面会根据核验所选的自拍模式展示相应说明。配置的核验流程到达此步骤时，MetaMap 身份核验 SDK 会打开此页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，该版本教程为必需步骤时，用户无法进入自拍拍摄。

en.description: Before processing the user's information, this screen presents the consent required by the MetaMap verification flow and records the user's choice.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from giving or declining consent required to continue verification.

zh-CN.description: 处理用户信息前，此页面会展示 MetaMap 核验流程要求的同意事项并记录用户选择。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法对继续核验所需事项表示同意或拒绝。

en.description: When the verification flow requires a live review, this screen connects the user to a video conference with a reviewer. The MetaMap identity verification SDK opens this screen when the configured flow reaches this step.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from completing verification flows that require a live video review.

zh-CN.description: 核验流程要求实时审核时，此页面会将用户接入与审核人员的视频通话。配置的核验流程到达此步骤时，MetaMap 身份核验 SDK 会打开此页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法完成要求实时视频审核的核验流程。

en.description: When a compatible car connection is detected over Bluetooth or USB, indigitall's SmartDeviceLink integration starts its car service so app notifications can be handled in the vehicle.
en.disableEffect: indigitall notifications will no longer connect to a compatible car system automatically; the app remains usable on the phone.

zh-CN.description: 通过蓝牙或 USB 检测到兼容的车载连接时，indigitall 的 SmartDeviceLink 集成会启动车载服务，以便在车内处理应用通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: indigitall 通知将无法自动连接到兼容的车载系统；应用在手机上仍可使用。

en.description: When SmartDeviceLink requests a router, indigitall's Android Auto integration runs the service that routes communication between the phone app and a compatible in-car system.
en.disableEffect: The app's SmartDeviceLink connection and in-car notifications may stop working; normal phone use remains available.

zh-CN.description: SmartDeviceLink 请求路由服务时，indigitall 的 Android Auto 集成会运行此 Service，在手机应用与兼容的车载系统之间传递通信。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用的 SmartDeviceLink 连接和车载通知可能无法使用；手机上的正常功能仍可使用。

en.description: When an indigitall SmartDeviceLink connection starts, this service registers the app with the car system and can show indigitall push notifications there.
en.disableEffect: indigitall push notifications will not be shown through the connected car system; the phone app remains usable.

zh-CN.description: indigitall 的 SmartDeviceLink 连接启动时，此 Service 会向车载系统注册应用，并可在车内显示 indigitall 推送通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: indigitall 推送通知将无法通过已连接的车载系统显示；手机应用仍可使用。

en.description: When a user opens a contact card in an indigitall chat, this Activity shows the contact's details and lets the user add the contact to the phone's address book.
en.disableEffect: Contact cards in indigitall chat will not open, and users will lose the add-to-contacts action.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 indigitall 聊天中打开联系人卡片时，此 Activity 会显示联系人资料，并可将联系人添加到手机通讯录。
zh-CN.disableEffect: indigitall 聊天中的联系人卡片将无法打开，用户也无法通过此界面添加联系人。

en.description: When an indigitall chat message contains an interactive list, this Activity shows its choices and lets the user send a reply.
en.disableEffect: Interactive lists in indigitall chat will not open, so users cannot choose or submit those replies.

zh-CN.description: indigitall 聊天消息包含交互列表时，此 Activity 会显示选项，并允许用户发送回复。
zh-CN.disableEffect: indigitall 聊天中的交互列表将无法打开，用户也无法选择或提交其中的回复。

en.description: When a user opens an indigitall in-app message with a destination, this Activity opens that screen or returns to the app if the destination is unavailable.
en.disableEffect: Tapping an indigitall in-app message may no longer open its destination; normal app navigation remains available.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开带有跳转目标的 indigitall 应用内消息时，此 Activity 会打开对应页面；若目标不可用，则返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 点击 indigitall 应用内消息后可能无法跳转到目标页面；应用的正常导航仍可使用。

en.description: After a boot broadcast, this receiver restores indigitall location updates when in-app location targeting is enabled and location permission is available.
en.disableEffect: Location-based indigitall in-app targeting may stop receiving location updates after a restart; other app features remain available.

zh-CN.description: 收到设备启动广播后，若启用了 indigitall 应用内定位定向且已获得定位权限，此 Receiver 会重新注册定位更新。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 设备重启后，基于位置的 indigitall 应用内定向可能无法继续获取位置更新；应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: When a user clicks an indigitall in-app message, this service sends the message interaction to indigitall for campaign reporting.
en.disableEffect: indigitall will stop recording in-app message clicks; the app's other features continue to work.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击 indigitall 应用内消息时，此 Service 会将消息交互发送给 indigitall 用于活动统计。
zh-CN.disableEffect: indigitall 将无法记录应用内消息点击；应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: When a user opens an indigitall push notification, this Activity records the open and follows its destination, returning to the app if that destination cannot be opened.
en.disableEffect: Opening indigitall push notifications may no longer navigate to their destination; normal app screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 indigitall 推送通知时，此 Activity 会记录打开操作并跳转到通知目标；若目标无法打开，则返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 打开 indigitall 推送通知后可能无法跳转到目标页面；应用的普通页面仍可使用。

en.description: After the phone restarts, this receiver retrieves indigitall app settings and restores the services used for push notifications.
en.disableEffect: indigitall push services may not be restored after a restart; the app's normal phone features remain available.

zh-CN.description: 手机重启后，此 Receiver 会获取 indigitall 应用设置，并恢复推送通知所需的服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 设备重启后，indigitall 推送服务可能无法恢复；应用的普通手机功能仍可使用。

en.description: When a user taps or responds to an indigitall push notification, this service reports the action and any topic choice, then clears the opened notification.
en.disableEffect: Push actions and topic choices will no longer be reported to indigitall, and opened notifications may remain in the notification shade.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击或回复 indigitall 推送通知时，此 Service 会上报操作和主题选择，并清除已打开的通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 推送操作和主题选择将无法上报给 indigitall，已打开的通知也可能留在通知栏中。

en.description: When an Infinario analytics alarm fires, this receiver sends queued event data if automatic flushing is enabled, or cancels the alarm otherwise.
en.disableEffect: Scheduled Infinario event delivery will stop, so queued analytics may not be sent on time.

zh-CN.description: Infinario 分析数据的定时提醒触发时，若已启用自动发送，此 Receiver 会发送排队的事件数据；否则会取消提醒。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Infinario 定时事件发送将停止，排队的分析数据可能无法按时上报。

en.description: After Android finishes booting, this receiver restores Infinario's periodic analytics alarm when automatic flushing is enabled.
en.disableEffect: Automatic analytics delivery will not be rescheduled after a restart; normal app use remains available.

zh-CN.description: Android 完成启动后，若启用了自动发送，此 Receiver 会恢复 Infinario 的定时分析数据上报。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 设备重启后将不会重新安排自动分析数据上报；应用仍可正常使用。

en.description: If enabled, this receiver reacts to network changes and prompts Infinario to send queued analytics when a connection is available.
en.disableEffect: The network-return prompt for queued analytics is lost; the app's normal features remain available.

zh-CN.description: 若启用此 Receiver，它会响应网络变化，并在网络可用时提示 Infinario 发送排队的分析数据。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 网络恢复时触发的分析数据发送提示将失效；应用的正常功能仍可使用。

en.description: When Google Cloud Messaging delivers an Infinario message, this receiver passes it to the SDK service that handles the message.
en.disableEffect: Infinario's Google push messages will not reach the app's message handler; other app features remain available.

zh-CN.description: Google Cloud Messaging 收到 Infinario 消息时，此 Receiver 会将消息交给 SDK 服务处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Infinario 的 Google 推送消息将无法交给应用处理；应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: When the Infinario push receiver passes it a Google message, this service checks and displays eligible Infinario push notifications.
en.disableEffect: Infinario push notifications will no longer be processed or shown; the app's other features remain available.

zh-CN.description: Infinario 推送接收器交来 Google 消息时，此 Service 会检查并显示符合条件的 Infinario 推送通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Infinario 推送通知将无法继续处理或显示；应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: When Google Play reports an app install referrer, this receiver saves its campaign ID so Infinario can attribute the installation.
en.disableEffect: Infinario will lose this install-campaign attribution data; normal app use is unaffected.

zh-CN.description: Google Play 报告应用安装来源时，此 Receiver 会保存活动 ID，供 Infinario 进行安装归因。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Infinario 将无法获取这项安装活动归因数据；应用正常使用不受影响。

en.description: When the host app opens the Infinum Collar viewer, this Activity shows recorded app screens, events, and properties in a searchable list with filters and settings.
en.disableEffect: The built-in Collar event-inspection screen will not open; normal app screens and analytics collection remain available.

zh-CN.description: 宿主应用打开 Infinum Collar 查看界面时，此 Activity 会以可搜索列表显示记录的应用页面、事件和属性，并提供筛选和设置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 内置的 Collar 事件查看页面将无法打开；应用页面和分析数据收集仍可使用。

en.description: When a user opens Infinum DBInspector, this launcher entry opens the list of local databases available for inspection.
en.disableEffect: The DBInspector entry screen will not open; the app's normal screens and database operations remain available.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 Infinum DBInspector 时，此启动入口会打开可供检查的本地数据库列表。
zh-CN.disableEffect: DBInspector 入口页面将无法打开；应用的正常页面和数据库操作仍可使用。

en.description: When a user shares a database from Infinum DBInspector, this provider supplies the file link used by the share action.
en.disableEffect: Sharing a database from DBInspector may fail because the tool can no longer provide the database file; normal app features remain available.

zh-CN.description: 用户通过 Infinum DBInspector 分享数据库时，此 Provider 会提供分享操作所需的文件链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: DBInspector 将无法提供数据库文件，因此分享操作可能失败；应用的正常功能仍可使用。

en.description: When a developer selects a table in Infinum DBInspector, this Activity displays that table's rows and columns.
en.disableEffect: The DBInspector tool will not be able to open table contents; the app's normal data handling remains available.

zh-CN.description: 开发者在 Infinum DBInspector 中选择数据表时，此 Activity 会显示该表的行和列。
zh-CN.disableEffect: DBInspector 将无法打开数据表内容；应用的正常数据处理仍可使用。

en.description: When a developer selects a database trigger in Infinum DBInspector, this Activity shows the trigger information for inspection.
en.disableEffect: The DBInspector tool will not be able to open trigger details; SQLite triggers continue to run normally in the app.

zh-CN.description: 开发者在 Infinum DBInspector 中选择数据库触发器时，此 Activity 会显示触发器信息供检查。
zh-CN.disableEffect: DBInspector 将无法打开触发器详情；应用中的 SQLite 触发器仍会正常运行。

en.description: When a developer selects a database view in Infinum DBInspector, this Activity opens that view's contents for inspection.
en.disableEffect: The DBInspector tool will not be able to inspect database views; the app's normal database access remains available.

zh-CN.description: 开发者在 Infinum DBInspector 中选择数据库视图时，此 Activity 会打开视图内容供检查。
zh-CN.disableEffect: DBInspector 将无法检查数据库视图；应用的正常数据库访问仍可使用。

en.description: When Infinum DBInspector opens, this Activity lists the app's local databases so a developer can choose one to inspect; the no-op release variant closes immediately.
en.disableEffect: The database list in DBInspector will not open; normal app screens continue to work.

zh-CN.description: Infinum DBInspector 打开时，此 Activity 会列出应用的本地数据库供开发者选择检查；无操作版本会立即关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: DBInspector 中的数据库列表将无法打开；应用的正常页面仍可使用。

en.description: When a developer edits a database entry in Infinum DBInspector, this Activity lets them change the name shown for that database.
en.disableEffect: The database display name cannot be changed from DBInspector; normal app database use is unaffected.

zh-CN.description: 开发者在 Infinum DBInspector 中编辑数据库条目时，此 Activity 可修改数据库列表中显示的名称。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 DBInspector 修改数据库显示名称；应用的正常数据库使用不受影响。

en.description: When a developer opens the Infinum DBInspector query editor, this Activity lets them enter and run SQL statements and review query history.
en.disableEffect: The DBInspector query editor and its history will be unavailable; normal app database operations continue.

zh-CN.description: 开发者打开 Infinum DBInspector 查询编辑器时，此 Activity 可输入并运行 SQL 语句，也可查看查询历史。
zh-CN.disableEffect: DBInspector 查询编辑器及其历史记录将无法使用；应用的正常数据库操作仍可继续。

en.description: When a developer opens the PRAGMA section in Infinum DBInspector, this Activity displays SQLite database settings and values for inspection.
en.disableEffect: The DBInspector PRAGMA screen will not open; the app's database behavior remains unchanged.

zh-CN.description: 开发者在 Infinum DBInspector 中打开 PRAGMA 区域时，此 Activity 会显示 SQLite 数据库设置和值供检查。
zh-CN.disableEffect: DBInspector 的 PRAGMA 页面将无法打开；应用的数据库行为不受影响。

en.description: When a developer opens a database's schema in Infinum DBInspector, this Activity lists schema objects and supports searching by name.
en.disableEffect: The DBInspector schema browser will be unavailable; the app's database continues to work normally.

zh-CN.description: 开发者在 Infinum DBInspector 中打开数据库结构时，此 Activity 会列出结构对象并支持按名称搜索。
zh-CN.disableEffect: DBInspector 的数据库结构浏览器将无法使用；应用数据库仍可正常运行。

en.description: When a developer opens Infinum DBInspector settings, this Activity displays preferences for the database inspection tool.
en.disableEffect: DBInspector preferences will not be accessible; normal app screens and database operations remain available.

zh-CN.description: 开发者打开 Infinum DBInspector 设置时，此 Activity 会显示数据库检查工具的偏好设置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: DBInspector 偏好设置将无法访问；应用的正常页面和数据库操作仍可使用。

en.description: When a user shares a saved log from Infinum Sentinel's Timber logging tool, this Provider supplies the file link that the sharing screen needs to open it.
en.disableEffect: Sentinel log sharing fails and can crash the app when attempted; the app's other features remain available.

zh-CN.description: 当用户通过 Infinum Sentinel 的 Timber 日志工具分享已保存的日志时，此 Provider 会提供分享界面读取文件所需的链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后无法分享 Sentinel 日志，尝试分享时还可能导致应用崩溃；应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: When a user opens Bundle Monitor in Infinum Sentinel's diagnostics panel, this Activity lists Android bundles Sentinel has collected for inspection.
en.disableEffect: Sentinel's bundle list cannot be opened, but the app's regular features continue to work.

zh-CN.description: 当用户在 Infinum Sentinel 诊断面板中打开 Bundle Monitor 时，此 Activity 会列出 Sentinel 收集的 Android Bundle，供用户检查。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Sentinel 的 Bundle 列表将无法打开，但应用的日常功能仍可正常使用。

en.description: When a user selects a collected bundle in Infinum Sentinel's Bundle Monitor, this Activity shows that bundle's contents.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot inspect individual bundles in Sentinel, while the app's regular features continue to work.

zh-CN.description: 当用户在 Infinum Sentinel 的 Bundle Monitor 中选择一条记录时，此 Activity 会显示该 Bundle 的内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在 Sentinel 中查看单条 Bundle 记录，但应用的日常功能仍可正常使用。

en.description: When a user opens certificate monitoring in Infinum Sentinel, this Activity lists checked system and user certificates, including invalid or soon-to-expire certificates.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot view Sentinel's certificate results here, but the app's regular features continue to work.

zh-CN.description: 当用户在 Infinum Sentinel 中打开证书监控时，此 Activity 会列出已检查的系统证书和用户证书，包括无效或即将过期的证书。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在 Sentinel 中查看证书结果，但应用的日常功能仍可正常使用。

en.description: When a user selects a certificate in Infinum Sentinel's certificate list, this Activity shows details about that certificate.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open certificate details in Sentinel, while the app's regular features continue to work.

zh-CN.description: 当用户在 Infinum Sentinel 的证书列表中选择一张证书时，此 Activity 会显示该证书的详细信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在 Sentinel 中查看证书详情，但应用的日常功能仍可正常使用。

en.description: When a user opens Infinum Sentinel's crash monitor, this Activity lists recorded app crashes and lets the user search the list.
en.disableEffect: Sentinel's crash list cannot be opened, but the app's regular features continue to work.

zh-CN.description: 当用户打开 Infinum Sentinel 的崩溃监控时，此 Activity 会列出记录到的应用崩溃，并支持搜索列表。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Sentinel 的崩溃列表将无法打开，但应用的日常功能仍可正常使用。

en.description: When a user selects a recorded crash in Infinum Sentinel, this Activity shows details about that crash.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot inspect individual crash records in Sentinel, while the app's regular features continue to work.

zh-CN.description: 当用户在 Infinum Sentinel 中选择一条崩溃记录时，此 Activity 会显示该记录的详细信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在 Sentinel 中查看单条崩溃记录的详情，但应用的日常功能仍可正常使用。

en.description: When a user opens Infinum Sentinel's logging tool, this Activity displays app log messages and offers search and sharing.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot view or share app logs through Sentinel, but the app's regular features continue to work.

zh-CN.description: 当用户打开 Infinum Sentinel 的日志工具时，此 Activity 会显示应用日志，并提供搜索和分享功能。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 Sentinel 查看或分享应用日志，但应用的日常功能仍可正常使用。

en.description: When a user opens saved logs from Infinum Sentinel's logging tool, this Activity lists saved log files that can be shared or deleted.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot browse, share, or delete saved logs through Sentinel, while the app's regular features continue to work.

zh-CN.description: 当用户从 Infinum Sentinel 的日志工具打开已保存日志时，此 Activity 会列出日志文件，用户可以分享或删除这些文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 Sentinel 浏览、分享或删除已保存的日志，但应用的日常功能仍可正常使用。

en.description: When Infinum Sentinel's diagnostics panel is opened, this Activity shows device and app information, permissions, preferences, and monitoring tools.
en.disableEffect: The Sentinel diagnostics panel and its tools cannot be opened, but the app's regular screens and features continue to work.

zh-CN.description: 当用户打开 Infinum Sentinel 诊断面板时，此 Activity 会显示设备和应用信息、权限、偏好设置及监控工具。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Sentinel 诊断面板及其工具将无法打开，但应用的日常页面和功能仍可正常使用。

en.description: When a user chooses to see all preferences in Infinum Sentinel, this Activity lists the app's saved preference values for inspection.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot browse all saved preferences through Sentinel, while the app's regular settings remain available.

zh-CN.description: 当用户选择在 Infinum Sentinel 中查看全部偏好设置时，此 Activity 会列出应用保存的偏好设置值，供用户检查。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 Sentinel 浏览全部已保存的偏好设置，但应用自身的设置功能仍可使用。

en.description: When a user chooses a preference in Infinum Sentinel's preference tools, this Activity opens an editor for that saved value.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot edit saved values through Sentinel, while the app's regular settings continue to work.

zh-CN.description: 当用户在 Infinum Sentinel 的偏好设置工具中选择一项时，此 Activity 会打开编辑界面供用户修改该值。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 Sentinel 修改已保存的值，但应用的日常设置功能仍可正常使用。

en.description: When a user opens Infinum Sentinel's settings, this Activity shows controls for crash, bundle, and certificate monitoring and their notifications.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot change Sentinel's monitoring and notification settings here, but the app's regular features continue to work.

zh-CN.description: 当用户打开 Infinum Sentinel 的设置时，此 Activity 会显示崩溃、Bundle 和证书监控及其通知的控制选项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在此处更改 Sentinel 的监控和通知设置，但应用的日常功能仍可正常使用。

en.description: When Android's document picker lists available file sources, this Infinum Thimble Provider exposes saved screenshots and screen recordings for browsing.
en.disableEffect: The Thimble files disappear from Android's document picker, so saved screenshots and recordings cannot be browsed there; the app's regular features continue to work.

zh-CN.description: 当 Android 文档选择器列出可用文件来源时，此 Infinum Thimble Provider 会提供已保存的屏幕截图和录屏，供用户浏览。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Thimble 文件将不再显示在 Android 文档选择器中，用户无法在那里浏览已保存的截图和录屏；应用的日常功能仍可正常使用。

en.description: When Infinum Thimble is opened, this Activity provides controls for layout grids, mockup overlays, a pixel magnifier, screenshots, and screen recording, and requests permission to draw over other apps.
en.disableEffect: Thimble's design and screen-capture controls cannot be opened, while the host app's regular features continue to work.

zh-CN.description: 当用户打开 Infinum Thimble 时，此 Activity 会提供布局网格、设计稿覆盖层、像素放大镜、屏幕截图和录屏控制，并请求在其他应用上层显示的权限。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Thimble 的设计检查和屏幕捕获控制界面将无法打开，但宿主应用的日常功能仍可正常使用。

en.description: When a user starts or changes a Thimble overlay, this foreground Service runs the layout grid, mockup, magnifier, and screen recorder.
en.disableEffect: Thimble's overlays and screenshot or video recording stop working, while the host app's regular features continue to work.

zh-CN.description: 当用户启动或调整 Thimble 覆盖层时，此前台 Service 会运行布局网格、设计稿覆盖层、放大镜和屏幕录制功能。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Thimble 的覆盖层、屏幕截图和录屏功能将无法使用，但宿主应用的日常功能仍可正常运行。

en.description: PerScope opens the supplied webpage in this in-app screen for its privacy-policy flow, follows the page to the flow's completion page and supports choosing an image when a web form requests one.
en.disableEffect: Blocking it prevents the in-app policy step and any image selection requested by that page from completing.

zh-CN.description: PerScope 会在此应用内页面打开隐私政策流程提供的网页，跟随页面直至流程完成，并支持网页表单要求时选择图片。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用内的政策步骤以及该页面要求的图片选择都无法完成。

en.description: When Firebase issues a new push token, Infobip RTC uses this service to refresh the device registration for incoming calls.
en.disableEffect: Incoming RTC calls may stop reaching the device after its Firebase token changes.

zh-CN.description: Firebase 更新推送令牌时，Infobip RTC 会用此服务刷新设备的来电登记信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Firebase 令牌更新后设备可能无法再收到 RTC 来电。

en.description: When Infobip Mobile Messaging updates the live-chat registration, Infobip RTC UI stores it and refreshes call registration for apps using in-app chat.
en.disableEffect: Incoming RTC calls linked to in-app chat may no longer register correctly.

zh-CN.description: Infobip Mobile Messaging 更新实时聊天登记信息时，Infobip RTC UI 会保存该信息，并为使用应用内聊天的应用刷新来电登记。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，与应用内聊天关联的 RTC 来电可能无法正确登记。

en.description: When the phone reports a cellular call, Infobip RTC UI checks whether it was answered and can end an active internet call if the app has enabled that setting.
en.disableEffect: A cellular call may no longer automatically end an overlapping RTC call.

zh-CN.description: 手机报告蜂窝通话状态时，Infobip RTC UI 会检查通话是否接通；如果应用启用了相应设置，它会结束正在进行的网络通话。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，蜂窝电话接通时重叠的 RTC 通话可能不会自动结束。

en.description: When Infobip Mobile Messaging creates a push token, Infobip RTC UI uses it to refresh the device registration for incoming calls.
en.disableEffect: The device may stop receiving RTC calls when its push registration changes.

zh-CN.description: Infobip Mobile Messaging 创建推送令牌后，Infobip RTC UI 会用它刷新设备的来电登记。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，设备的推送登记变化时可能无法再收到 RTC 来电。

en.description: During an Infobip RTC call, this service shows incoming or ongoing call notifications, rings for incoming calls, and stays active while the call is in progress.
en.disableEffect: Incoming-call alerts and the ongoing-call notification may fail, disrupting calls.

zh-CN.description: Infobip RTC 通话期间，此服务会显示来电或通话通知、为来电响铃，并在通话进行时保持运行。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，来电提醒或通话通知可能失效，影响通话。

en.description: When Firebase delivers an Infobip RTC call message or refreshes a push token, this service handles the call or updates the device registration; other messages can be passed to Infobip Mobile Messaging.
en.disableEffect: Incoming RTC calls may not appear, and refreshed push tokens may not be registered.

zh-CN.description: Firebase 收到 Infobip RTC 来电消息或更新推送令牌时，此服务会处理来电或更新设备登记；其他消息可转交给 Infobip Mobile Messaging。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，RTC 来电可能不会显示，更新后的推送令牌也可能无法登记。

en.description: When a user starts screen sharing during an Infobip RTC call, this service keeps the share running and displays its notification until sharing stops.
en.disableEffect: Screen sharing during RTC calls will not work.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Infobip RTC 通话中开始共享屏幕时，此服务会维持共享并显示通知，直到共享结束。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，RTC 通话中的屏幕共享无法使用。

en.description: When an Infobip RTC call starts or is answered, this screen shows the incoming-call and in-call controls and requests needed microphone or camera access.
en.disableEffect: The app may be unable to show or manage its RTC call screen.

zh-CN.description: Infobip RTC 来电或接听通话时，此界面会显示来电和通话控制，并请求所需的麦克风或相机权限。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用可能无法显示或管理 RTC 通话界面。

en.description: The Ingenico PCL terminal service used by Cashlez and Finix connects a POS app to a payment terminal over Bluetooth, USB, or a supported network link. Disabling it can stop the terminal from communicating with the app.
en.disableEffect: Card-terminal connection and in-person payments may fail.

zh-CN.description: Cashlez 和 Finix 使用的 Ingenico PCL 终端服务可通过蓝牙、USB 或支持的网络连接 POS 应用与支付终端。禁用后，终端可能无法与应用通信。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 刷卡终端连接和线下支付可能失败。

en.description: The Ingenico PCL terminal service used by Cashlez and Finix handles card-terminal operations for a POS app, including transactions, receipt printing, and signature capture. Disabling it can stop in-person card payments.
en.disableEffect: Terminal transactions and related receipt or signature functions may fail.

zh-CN.description: Cashlez 和 Finix 使用的 Ingenico PCL 终端服务负责 POS 应用的终端操作，包括交易、打印收据和采集签名。禁用后，线下银行卡支付可能无法进行。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 终端交易以及相关收据或签名功能可能失败。

en.description: The Global Payments and Heartland RUA device service is bound by apps when they need to discover or connect to an Ingenico card reader. It manages reader search, pairing, and connections over USB, Bluetooth, or an audio jack.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot discover or connect to supported Ingenico readers, so card-present payments through them stop working.

zh-CN.description: 应用需要查找或连接 Ingenico 读卡器时，会绑定 Global Payments 或 Heartland 的 RUA 设备服务。此服务负责通过 USB、蓝牙或耳机接口搜索读卡器、配对并建立连接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法发现或连接受支持的 Ingenico 读卡器，因此无法再通过这些设备进行实体卡支付。

en.description: When InLocoMedia needs to request an Android permission, this screen hosts its permission prompt and returns the user's choice to the SDK.
en.disableEffect: The InLocoMedia SDK may be unable to request permissions needed for its own location or ad functions.

zh-CN.description: InLocoMedia 需要申请 Android 权限时，此界面会显示权限请求并将用户的选择交还给 SDK。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，InLocoMedia SDK 可能无法申请其位置或广告功能所需的权限。

en.description: When an InLocoMedia alarm, device restart, or ad-notification click occurs, this receiver updates the SDK's geofence schedules or opens the ad destination.
en.disableEffect: InLocoMedia location targeting and ad-notification clicks may stop working.

zh-CN.description: InLocoMedia 定时事件、设备重启或广告通知点击发生时，此接收器会更新 SDK 的地理围栏计划或打开广告目标页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，InLocoMedia 的位置定向和广告通知点击可能失效。

en.description: When InLocoMedia requests a location update or changes its tracking mode, this service starts, stops, or adjusts the SDK's location monitoring.
en.disableEffect: InLocoMedia location-based targeting and related SDK updates may stop working.

zh-CN.description: InLocoMedia 请求位置更新或改变跟踪模式时，此服务会启动、停止或调整 SDK 的位置监测。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，InLocoMedia 的位置定向及相关 SDK 更新可能失效。

en.description: When InLocoMedia displays an ad, opens its linked page, handles an ad click, or saves an ad image, this screen runs that ad experience.
en.disableEffect: InLocoMedia ads, their linked pages, and ad-image saving may stop working.

zh-CN.description: InLocoMedia 显示广告、打开广告链接、处理广告点击或保存广告图片时，此界面会运行相应广告内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，InLocoMedia 广告、广告链接页面和图片保存可能失效。

en.description: InMobi Ads starts this background service to download an app package promoted by an ad.
en.disableEffect: InMobi-promoted app downloads will stop; the host app’s other features remain available.

zh-CN.description: InMobi Ads 会在后台启动此服务，下载广告推广的应用安装包。
zh-CN.disableEffect: InMobi 广告推广的应用将无法下载；宿主应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: The InMobi Mobile Ads SDK opens this screen when an ad needs its own page; it displays the ad and handles taps and closing.
en.disableEffect: Ads that need this screen will not open, and rewards tied to rewarded ads shown there will not be granted.

zh-CN.description: InMobi Mobile Ads SDK 会在广告需要独立页面时打开此界面，用于展示广告并响应点击和关闭操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要此页面的广告将无法打开，通过此页面观看奖励广告也不会获得奖励。

en.description: The InMobi Mobile Ads SDK uses this in app browser screen when an ad opens a web destination; it displays that page without leaving the app.
en.disableEffect: Ad destinations that use this browser will no longer open inside the app.

zh-CN.description: 广告打开网页时，InMobi Mobile Ads SDK 会使用此应用内浏览器页面，在不离开应用的情况下显示目标网页。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此浏览器的广告目标网页将无法在应用内打开。

en.description: Android runs this InMobi Swish Folder analytics job when a scheduled retry is due; it retries analytics records that previously failed to send.
en.disableEffect: Failed analytics records will not be retried in the background; other app screens can still work.

zh-CN.description: 计划的重试时间到达时，Android 会运行 InMobi Swish Folder 分析任务，重新发送此前未能发出的分析记录。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 此前发送失败的分析记录将不会在后台重试，应用的其他页面仍可使用。

en.description: InMobi advertising uses this full-screen page to show an ad, an expanded interactive ad, or the destination opened from an ad.
en.disableEffect: InMobi ads and their landing pages will not open.

zh-CN.description: InMobi 广告 SDK 会用此全屏页面展示广告、展开式互动广告或广告落地页。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，InMobi 广告及其落地页将无法打开。

en.description: The InMobi Swish Folder SDK opens this screen when a user edits the folder's app list; it shows installed apps and saves selection changes.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to view or change the folder's app list from this screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户编辑文件夹应用列表时，InMobi Swish Folder SDK 会打开此页面，显示已安装的应用并保存选择更改。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此页面查看或更改文件夹中的应用列表。

en.description: When Android opens a Swish Folder link, this screen routes home, settings, app recommendation, and widget setup links to their matching pages.
en.disableEffect: Swish Folder links will no longer reach the requested home, settings, recommendation, or widget setup page.

zh-CN.description: Android 打开 Swish Folder 链接时，此页面会将主页、设置、应用推荐和小组件设置链接转到对应页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Swish Folder 链接将无法再打开对应的主页、设置、推荐或小组件设置页面。

en.description: The InMobi Swish Folder SDK opens this Activity for the main folder screen; it loads the folder pages and handles home, app recommendation, and widget launches.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to open the main Swish Folder screen or navigate its contents.

zh-CN.description: InMobi Swish Folder SDK 会通过此页面打开文件夹主页、加载文件夹内容，并处理主页、应用推荐和小组件启动请求。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开 Swish Folder 主页或浏览其中的内容。

en.description: The InMobi Swish Folder SDK opens this welcome screen during first use; it shows introductory pages and links to the terms and privacy policy.
en.disableEffect: The folder's welcome and first use guidance will not appear, leaving users without these setup instructions.

zh-CN.description: 首次使用时，InMobi Swish Folder SDK 会打开此欢迎页面，展示介绍内容以及使用条款和隐私政策链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 文件夹欢迎页和首次使用指引将不会显示，用户会失去这些设置说明。

en.description: When an app opens InMobi's consent-management flow, this screen presents the privacy choices for the applicable rules and lets the user review or change them.
en.disableEffect: The app may be unable to show its InMobi consent screen or let users review their privacy choices.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开 InMobi 同意管理流程时，此界面会展示适用规则下的隐私选项，供用户查看或更改。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用可能无法显示 InMobi 同意界面，也无法让用户查看隐私选项。

en.description: The InMobi Swish Folder SDK opens this screen for a selected collection; it fetches and displays that collection's shopping deals and handles item selection.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to view or open deals in the selected collection.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择合集后，InMobi Swish Folder SDK 会打开此页面，获取并显示该合集中的购物优惠并处理商品选择。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法查看或打开所选合集中的优惠。

en.description: The InMobi Hello You SDK opens this screen when a user chooses Settings; it lists links to the SDK's terms of use and privacy policy.
en.disableEffect: Users can no longer open Hello You's terms or privacy pages from this screen.

zh-CN.description: InMobi Hello You SDK 会在用户选择“设置”时打开此页面，其中列出 SDK 的使用条款和隐私政策链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此页面打开 Hello You 的使用条款或隐私政策。

en.description: After InMobi Game Center finishes initializing, it opens this screen to show its game center page.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to open the InMobi Game Center page or reach its games.

zh-CN.description: InMobi Game Center 初始化完成后会打开此页面，显示游戏中心内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开 InMobi Game Center 页面或进入其中的游戏。

en.description: InMobi Game Center opens this screen for a selected hosted game; it loads the game page and provides the play area and ad space.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to play hosted games that use this screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择托管游戏后，InMobi Game Center 会打开此页面，加载游戏并显示游玩区域和广告区域。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法游玩使用此页面的托管游戏。

en.description: When InMobi Game Center opens a game related web page, this screen loads its address in an in app browser while that page is active.
en.disableEffect: Game Center pages that use this screen will not load, so those linked game experiences will be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: InMobi Game Center 打开游戏相关网页时，此页面会在应用内浏览器中加载该网页。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此页面的 Game Center 网页将无法加载，相关游戏体验也将无法使用。

en.description: The InMobi Hello You Games SDK opens this page when a user enters its games section or follows a game notification; it loads the game catalog and opens a selected game.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to open the Hello You game catalog or start games from it.

zh-CN.description: InMobi Hello You Games SDK 会在用户进入游戏区或打开游戏通知时显示此页面；它加载游戏目录，并打开用户选择的游戏。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开 Hello You 游戏目录或从中启动游戏。

en.description: The InMobi Hello You Games SDK opens this screen for a selected game; it loads the game, records play progress and achievements, and can show interstitial and rewarded ads.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to play games that use this screen or receive rewards for watching their rewarded ads.

zh-CN.description: InMobi Hello You Games SDK 会在用户选择游戏后打开此页面；它加载游戏、记录游玩进度和成就，也可显示插屏广告和奖励广告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此页面的游戏将无法游玩，用户也无法获得观看其中奖励广告后发放的奖励。

en.description: The InMobi Hello You Games SDK opens this full screen viewer for a selected game story; it displays the supplied story pages in a swipeable sequence and tracks page views.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to open or browse game stories in this viewer.

zh-CN.description: InMobi Hello You Games SDK 会为用户选择的游戏故事打开此全屏页面；它以可滑动的方式展示故事页面并记录浏览情况。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在此页面打开或浏览游戏故事。

en.description: InMobi Hello You News opens this page when the news section is entered; it selects a news region, loads the feed, and opens a chosen article in an in app reader.
en.disableEffect: The Hello You news feed and its article reading flow will not open.

zh-CN.description: 用户进入新闻区时，InMobi Hello You News 会打开此页面；它确定新闻地区、加载新闻列表，并在应用内阅读器中打开选中的文章。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Hello You 新闻列表及其文章阅读流程将无法打开。

en.description: InMobi Hello You News opens this screen when a user selects a story; it displays the article in the SDK's reader and handles returning to the news feed.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to read Hello You articles in this in app reader.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择新闻后，InMobi Hello You News 会打开此页面，在 SDK 的阅读器中显示文章并处理返回新闻列表的操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在此应用内阅读器中阅读 Hello You 文章。

en.description: The InMobi Hello You News SDK uses this receiver to refresh its home screen news widget and respond to next, previous, refresh, settings, and widget add or removal events.
en.disableEffect: The Hello You news widget will not update or respond to its controls.

zh-CN.description: InMobi Hello You News SDK 使用此接收器刷新桌面新闻小组件，并响应上一条、下一条、刷新、设置以及小组件添加或移除事件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Hello You 新闻小组件将无法更新，也无法响应其控件。

en.description: The InMobi Swish Folder SDK opens this screen for onboarding; it shows a swipeable introduction and lets users continue, skip, or close it.
en.disableEffect: New users will lose the introductory guidance shown before folder setup.

zh-CN.description: InMobi Swish Folder SDK 会在引导流程中打开此页面，展示可滑动的介绍内容，并允许用户继续、跳过或关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 新用户将无法看到文件夹设置前的介绍指引。

en.description: The InMobi Swish Folder SDK starts this screen for folder setup; it routes users through the introduction or the steps for adding the folder to the home screen.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to complete the Swish Folder introduction or add to home setup through this flow.

zh-CN.description: 开始设置文件夹时，InMobi Swish Folder SDK 会打开此页面，引导用户查看介绍或将文件夹添加到桌面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此流程完成 Swish Folder 介绍或桌面添加设置。

en.description: The InMobi Swish Folder SDK opens this screen from widget setup links; it shows an add widget prompt or asks Android to pin the folder widget to the home screen.
en.disableEffect: The widget setup prompt and home screen add request will not run.

zh-CN.description: 通过小组件设置链接进入时，InMobi Swish Folder SDK 会打开此页面，显示添加小组件提示或请求 Android 将文件夹小组件固定到桌面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 小组件设置提示和桌面添加请求将无法执行。

en.description: InMobi Ads opens this screen for a full-screen ad or in-app browser and loads the ad destination in a web view.
en.disableEffect: InMobi ads and their in-app landing pages will not open; the app’s other features continue to work.

zh-CN.description: InMobi Ads 会打开此页面展示全屏广告或应用内浏览器，并在网页视图中加载广告目标页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: InMobi 广告及其应用内落地页将无法打开，应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: Android creates this InMobi Mobile Ads provider as the app starts, and it performs the SDK's automatic initialization before ads are requested.
en.disableEffect: Apps relying on this automatic startup initialization may not load InMobi ads unless they initialize the SDK another way.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时 Android 会创建 InMobi Mobile Ads 提供程序，它会在请求广告前自动初始化 SDK。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此自动启动初始化的应用可能无法加载 InMobi 广告，除非通过其他方式初始化 SDK。

en.description: The InMobi Swish Folder SDK opens this page for its settings flow; it displays the available settings pages and their navigation.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to open or navigate Swish Folder settings.

zh-CN.description: InMobi Swish Folder SDK 会在设置流程中打开此页面，显示可用的设置页面及其导航。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开或浏览 Swish Folder 设置。

en.description: The InMobi Swish Folder Settings module opens this screen for its terms or privacy page; it displays the selected page in an in app browser.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to read those policy pages inside Swish Folder.

zh-CN.description: InMobi Swish Folder 设置模块会通过此页面打开使用条款或隐私政策，并在应用内浏览器中显示所选页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在 Swish Folder 中阅读这些政策页面。

en.description: Android creates this InMobi Swish Folder provider as the app starts; queries report whether its home screen widget is added and its current status.
en.disableEffect: Swish Folder screens and integrations will not be able to read whether the widget is added or active.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时 Android 会创建 InMobi Swish Folder 提供程序；查询结果会说明桌面小组件是否已添加及其当前状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Swish Folder 页面和集成将无法读取小组件是否已添加或处于启用状态。

en.description: This InMobi Swish Folder receiver restores the widget's scheduled refresh after boot, app updates, locale or clock changes, and sends refresh requests on its schedule.
en.disableEffect: The widget may stop refreshing on schedule and show stale information after those system changes.

zh-CN.description: InMobi Swish Folder 接收器会在设备启动、应用更新、语言或时钟变化后恢复小组件的定时刷新，并按计划发送刷新请求。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 发生这些系统变化后，小组件可能不再按计划刷新并显示过时内容。

en.description: The InMobi Swish Folder SDK uses this receiver to add, update, and remove its home screen widget and respond to widget refresh or open requests.
en.disableEffect: The Swish Folder widget will not be added or refreshed, and its actions will not work.

zh-CN.description: InMobi Swish Folder SDK 使用此接收器添加、更新和移除桌面小组件，并响应小组件刷新或打开请求。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Swish Folder 小组件将无法添加或刷新，其中的操作也将失效。

en.description: The InMoment Android SDK starts this screen when the app opens a survey; it displays the web survey, accepts responses, and handles completion or cancellation.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to open or complete InMoment surveys.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开问卷时，InMoment Android SDK 会显示此页面，用于展示网页问卷、接收回答并处理完成或取消操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开或完成 InMoment 问卷。

en.description: The Innov8tif Face Detector SDK starts its camera based face check when the app requests detection, then returns the result to the app.
en.disableEffect: Apps that call this SDK will be unable to start face detection or receive its result.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求人脸检测时，Innov8tif Face Detector SDK 会启动基于摄像头的人脸检查，并将结果返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 调用此 SDK 的应用将无法启动人脸检测或接收检测结果。

en.description: When the Innov8tif Face Detector SDK starts a face check, this screen opens the camera preview and analyzes image frames for a face before returning a capture result.
en.disableEffect: The camera based face check will not complete or return a result to the app.

zh-CN.description: Innov8tif Face Detector SDK 启动人脸检查时，此页面会打开摄像头预览并分析图像帧中的人脸，然后返回采集结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 基于摄像头的人脸检查将无法完成，也无法向应用返回结果。

en.description: OkayCam (Innov8tif) uses this shared camera Activity beneath its document and selfie screens. It handles camera permission, preview, focus and still-photo capture for those screens.
en.disableEffect: It has no separate camera screen, so disabling this entry does not remove those functions from the actual OkayCam capture screens.

zh-CN.description: OkayCam（Innov8tif）在证件和自拍界面中继承这个共享相机 Activity。它负责相机权限、预览、对焦和拍照。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 它没有独立的相机界面，停用此组件入口不会移除实际 OkayCam 拍摄界面的这些功能。

en.description: OkayCam (Innov8tif) opens this screen when an app requests automatic document capture. It guides the user to position the document, captures its front and back, and sends the photos to the app for review.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot complete automatic document capture through OkayCam if this screen is disabled.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求自动采集证件时，OkayCam（Innov8tif）会打开此界面，引导用户摆正证件并自动拍摄正反面照片，再交由应用检查。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用无法通过 OkayCam 完成自动证件采集。

en.description: OkayCam (Innov8tif) opens the front camera and guides the user through a face-movement check before taking a selfie. The user can review or retake the resulting image before it is returned.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot complete OkayCam automatic selfie and face-check flows if this screen is disabled.

zh-CN.description: OkayCam（Innov8tif）会打开前置相机，引导用户完成面部动作检查后拍摄自拍照。照片会先供用户确认或重拍，再交回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用无法通过 OkayCam 完成自动自拍和面部检查流程。

en.description: OkayCam (Innov8tif) opens this screen when an app requests guided document capture. The user takes document photos in the camera frame, then reviews them and confirms or retakes them.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot capture and receive document photos through this OkayCam flow if this screen is disabled.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求引导式证件采集时，OkayCam（Innov8tif）会打开此界面，让用户按取景框拍摄证件照片，再确认或重拍。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用无法通过此 OkayCam 流程拍摄并接收证件照片。

en.description: OkayCam (Innov8tif) opens this help page from its document-capture and photo-review screens. It shows tips for keeping text clear, avoiding glare and holding the phone steady.
en.disableEffect: The document-photo help action fails if this page is disabled.

zh-CN.description: OkayCam（Innov8tif）会从证件拍摄和照片预览界面打开此帮助页，介绍如何保持文字清晰、避开反光并稳住手机。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，证件拍摄界面的帮助功能将无法打开提示页。

en.description: OkayCam (Innov8tif) opens this help page from its automatic selfie screen. It explains how to center one face in the frame and use suitable lighting.
en.disableEffect: The selfie-help action fails if this page is disabled.

zh-CN.description: OkayCam（Innov8tif）会从自动自拍界面打开此帮助页，说明如何将一张脸置于取景框中央并选择合适的光线。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，自拍界面的帮助功能将无法打开提示页。

en.description: After OkayCam takes regular document or selfie photos, this screen displays them and lets the user confirm or retake them before returning the accepted images to the app.
en.disableEffect: The OkayCam flows that use this screen cannot finish photo review or return accepted images if it is disabled.

zh-CN.description: OkayCam 拍摄普通证件照或自拍照后会显示在此界面，用户可确认或重拍，确认的照片随后交回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，使用此界面的 OkayCam 流程无法完成照片确认或返回已确认的照片。

en.description: After automatic document capture, OkayCam (Innov8tif) displays the document photos here and lets the user confirm or retake them. The screen also links to document-photo tips.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot complete review of automatically captured document photos through OkayCam if this screen is disabled.

zh-CN.description: OkayCam（Innov8tif）自动拍摄证件后会在此显示照片，供用户确认或重拍；界面还提供证件拍摄提示。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用无法通过 OkayCam 完成自动采集证件照片的确认。

en.description: After automatic selfie capture, OkayCam (Innov8tif) shows the selfie here and lets the user retake or confirm it before returning the image to the app.
en.disableEffect: The automatic selfie flow cannot finish or return a confirmed image if this screen is disabled.

zh-CN.description: OkayCam（Innov8tif）自动拍摄自拍照后会在此显示照片，供用户重拍或确认，确认的照片随后交回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，自动自拍流程无法完成，也无法向应用返回确认后的照片。

en.description: When an app requests regular selfie capture, OkayCam (Innov8tif) opens the front camera so the user can take a photo. It then shows the image for confirmation or retaking.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot complete this OkayCam selfie flow or receive its photo if this screen is disabled.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求普通自拍采集时，OkayCam（Innov8tif）会打开前置相机供用户拍照，随后显示照片以便确认或重拍。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用无法完成此 OkayCam 自拍流程或接收拍摄的照片。

en.description: OkayCam (Innov8tif) opens this screen during its licensed face-verification selfie flow. It launches IAD face capture and returns a selfie image and verification data to the app.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot complete the OkayCam face-verification selfie flow or receive its result if this screen is disabled.

zh-CN.description: OkayCam（Innov8tif）在授权的人脸验证自拍流程中打开此界面，启动 IAD 人脸采集，并向应用返回自拍照和验证数据。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用无法完成 OkayCam 人脸验证自拍流程或接收其结果。

en.description: OkayDoc (Innov8tif document-authenticity SDK) opens a camera preview and checks live images for a face as part of its face-detection flow. The older release sends preview images to its face-check service.
en.disableEffect: An OkayDoc flow that needs this face check cannot finish if this screen is disabled.

zh-CN.description: OkayDoc（Innov8tif 证件真伪检测 SDK）会打开相机预览，并在面部检测流程中检查实时画面。此旧版会将预览图像发送到面部检测服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，需要此面部检查的 OkayDoc 流程无法完成。

en.description: OkayDoc (Innov8tif document-authenticity SDK) opens the camera for a still-image or video check of a Malaysian MyKad. It guides card framing and checks the captured card before returning a result.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot run OkayDoc Malaysian identity-card authenticity checks if this screen is disabled.

zh-CN.description: OkayDoc（Innov8tif 证件真伪检测 SDK）会打开相机，对马来西亚 MyKad 身份证进行照片或视频检测，引导用户摆正卡片并检查采集结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用无法通过 OkayDoc 检测马来西亚 MyKad 身份证真伪。

en.description: OkayID Mobile (Innov8tif identity-document SDK) uses this shared camera Activity beneath its document-capture screen. It handles camera permission, preview, focus and still-photo capture for that screen.
en.disableEffect: It has no separate camera screen, so disabling this entry does not remove those functions from the actual OkayID Mobile capture screen.

zh-CN.description: OkayID Mobile（Innov8tif 身份证件 SDK）在证件拍摄界面中继承这个共享相机 Activity。它负责相机权限、预览、对焦和拍照。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 它没有独立的相机界面，停用此组件入口不会移除 OkayID Mobile 实际拍摄界面的这些功能。

en.description: OkayID Mobile (Innov8tif identity-document SDK) opens this screen with an identity-document image for card segmentation, feature checks and text recognition. It can also let the user choose or take an image and returns recognized details to the app.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot extract or receive identity-document details through OkayID Mobile if this screen is disabled.

zh-CN.description: OkayID Mobile（Innov8tif 身份证件 SDK）会在此处理证件图像，定位证件、检查图像并识别文字；用户也可在界面中选择或拍摄图像，识别结果会交回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用无法通过 OkayID Mobile 提取或接收证件信息。

en.description: OkayID Mobile (Innov8tif identity-document SDK) opens this camera screen for the document type requested by the app. It guides the user to photograph the configured document sides and sends the images for review.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot capture and receive the requested document images through OkayID Mobile if this screen is disabled.

zh-CN.description: OkayID Mobile（Innov8tif 身份证件 SDK）会根据应用请求的证件类型打开此相机界面，引导用户拍摄所需的证件面，并将照片交由后续界面确认。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用无法通过 OkayID Mobile 拍摄并接收所需的证件图像。

en.description: OkayID Mobile (Innov8tif identity-document SDK) checks camera frames for a steady, clear document image. When it finds one, it passes the photo to its text-recognition screen; the user can also skip directly to that screen.
en.disableEffect: The app loses OkayID Mobile assisted scanning and cannot use this automatic image check if this screen is disabled.

zh-CN.description: OkayID Mobile（Innov8tif 身份证件 SDK）会检查相机画面，寻找稳定清晰的证件图像；找到后将照片交给文字识别界面，用户也可直接跳过扫描进入识别。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用无法使用 OkayID Mobile 的辅助扫描和自动图像检查。

en.description: After OkayID Mobile captures document photos, this screen displays them and lets the user confirm or retake them before returning accepted images to the app.
en.disableEffect: The OkayID Mobile capture flow cannot finish photo review or return accepted images if this screen is disabled.

zh-CN.description: OkayID Mobile 拍摄证件照片后会在此显示照片，供用户确认或重拍，确认后的照片随后交回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，OkayID Mobile 拍摄流程无法完成照片确认或返回已确认的照片。

en.description: Innov8tif Okay ID NFC opens this screen during passport verification; it waits for an NFC passport chip, reads it using the entered document details, and returns a result to the app.
en.disableEffect: Passport chip reading and the app's passport verification result will not be available.

zh-CN.description: 护照验证期间，Innov8tif Okay ID NFC 会打开此页面，等待读取护照 NFC 芯片，根据输入的证件信息读取芯片并将结果返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 护照芯片读取和应用的护照验证结果将无法使用。

en.description: OkayID Lite (Innov8tif OCR SDK) validates its license and requests camera or image permissions before opening MyKad scanning. It reports license or permission failures to the app.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot start OkayID Lite MyKad scanning or receive its result if this screen is disabled.

zh-CN.description: OkayID Lite（Innov8tif OCR SDK）会先验证授权并请求相机或图像权限，再打开 MyKad 扫描界面；授权或权限失败时会向应用报告错误。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用无法启动 OkayID Lite MyKad 扫描或接收扫描结果。

en.description: OkayID Lite (Innov8tif OCR SDK) opens the camera to read a Malaysian MyKad. It returns the recognized name, identity number, address and other card details, along with the card image.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot read or return Malaysian identity-card details through OkayID Lite if this screen is disabled.

zh-CN.description: OkayID Lite（Innov8tif OCR SDK）会打开相机读取马来西亚 MyKad 身份证，并向应用返回识别到的姓名、身份证号码、地址等信息以及证件图像。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用无法通过 OkayID Lite 读取或返回马来西亚身份证信息。

en.description: Inspetor (antifraud event SDK) prepares app context at process startup so the app can later send account, sign-in, sale, password recovery, and page activity for risk monitoring. This provider does not perform those app actions itself.
en.disableEffect: Inspetor event reporting will not be prepared automatically; the app's own sign-in and purchase screens are separate.

zh-CN.description: Inspetor（反欺诈事件 SDK）会在进程启动时准备应用上下文，以便应用之后发送账户、登录、交易、密码找回和页面活动信息进行风险监测。此 Provider 本身不执行这些应用操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Inspetor 事件上报将无法自动初始化；应用自身的登录和购买界面不由它处理。

en.description: Instabug APM uses this provider at app startup to initialize performance monitoring and record startup and screen-lifecycle timing.
en.disableEffect: Instabug will stop automatically collecting startup and screen performance data, while the host app remains usable.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，Instabug APM 会通过此 Provider 初始化性能监测，并记录启动和页面生命周期数据。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Instabug 将不再自动收集启动和页面性能数据，应用本身仍可使用。

en.description: Instabug bug reporting starts this service after the user grants screen-capture permission. It records the app screen as a video attachment for an issue report.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to record and attach screen videos to Instabug issue reports.

zh-CN.description: 用户授予屏幕捕获权限后，Instabug 缺陷反馈会启动此 Service，录制应用画面并将视频附加到问题报告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法录制屏幕视频并将其附加到 Instabug 问题报告。

en.description: When a user opens Instabug's in-app feedback prompt, this Activity displays the available feedback actions and opens the selected flow.
en.disableEffect: Users will no longer be able to open Instabug's feedback options from this prompt.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 Instabug 应用内反馈入口时，此 Activity 会显示可选的反馈操作并打开所选流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法再通过此入口打开 Instabug 的反馈选项。

en.description: Instabug uses this Activity to show its feedback-tool introduction as a set of pages with a Done button.
en.disableEffect: The Instabug introduction will not appear, but the host app's other screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: Instabug 使用此 Activity 展示反馈工具的介绍页面，并提供完成按钮。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Instabug 的引导页面将不再显示，应用的其他页面仍可使用。

en.description: When Instabug presents a prompt about a frustrating app experience, this Activity asks whether the user wants to continue and can open a feedback flow.
en.disableEffect: Instabug's proactive feedback prompt will no longer appear.

zh-CN.description: Instabug 针对令人困扰的应用体验发起反馈提示时，此 Activity 会询问用户是否继续，并可打开反馈流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Instabug 的主动反馈提示将不再显示。

en.description: After an Instabug issue report is sent, this Activity shows a confirmation and closes automatically after a short delay.
en.disableEffect: Users will not see Instabug's report-sent confirmation screen.

zh-CN.description: Instabug 问题报告发送后，此 Activity 会显示确认提示，并在短暂等待后自动关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将看不到 Instabug 的报告发送成功提示。

en.description: Instabug opens this Activity while a user prepares an issue report or feedback. It hosts the form, screenshot-markup, and attachment steps before submission.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to compose or submit issue reports through Instabug.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Instabug 中撰写问题报告或反馈时，此 Activity 承载表单、截图标注和添加附件等步骤。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 Instabug 编写或提交问题报告。

en.description: Instabug Chat opens this Activity to display an in-app support conversation or message thread.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to open or continue Instabug in-app support conversations.

zh-CN.description: Instabug Chat 使用此 Activity 显示应用内客服会话或消息线程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开或继续 Instabug 应用内客服会话。

en.description: When an Instabug report needs an image or video attachment, this Activity opens Android's media picker and returns the selected item to the report flow.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to choose media for Instabug reports through this picker.

zh-CN.description: Instabug 报告需要添加图片或视频时，此 Activity 会打开 Android 媒体选择器，并将选中的内容交回报告流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此选择器为 Instabug 报告选择媒体。

en.description: Instabug Crash Reporting uses this startup provider to install its uncaught-exception handler when crash reporting is enabled.
en.disableEffect: Instabug will no longer capture and report app crashes through its crash-reporting feature.

zh-CN.description: 启用崩溃报告时，Instabug Crash Reporting 会通过此启动 Provider 安装未捕获异常处理器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Instabug 将不再通过崩溃报告功能捕获并上报应用崩溃。

en.description: Instabug Feature Requests uses this Activity to show the feature-request board, where users can browse suggestions and add one of their own.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to browse or submit suggestions through Instabug Feature Requests.

zh-CN.description: Instabug Feature Requests 使用此 Activity 展示功能建议列表，用户可浏览已有建议或提交自己的建议。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 Instabug Feature Requests 浏览或提交功能建议。

en.description: After a user submits a feature suggestion, Instabug Feature Requests shows this Activity as a thank-you message and closes it after a short delay.
en.disableEffect: Users will not see the thank-you message after submitting a feature suggestion.

zh-CN.description: 用户提交功能建议后，Instabug Feature Requests 会通过此 Activity 显示感谢提示，并在短暂等待后自动关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户提交功能建议后将看不到感谢提示。

en.description: In the older Instabug feedback flow, this Activity shows a screenshot-markup and feedback form where users can annotate the screen, add a comment or email, and send feedback.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to annotate a screenshot or submit feedback through this older Instabug screen.

zh-CN.description: 在旧版 Instabug 反馈流程中，此 Activity 会显示截图标注和反馈表单，用户可标记屏幕、填写意见或邮箱并发送反馈。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此旧版 Instabug 页面标注截图或提交反馈。

en.description: In Instabug's older feedback flow, this Activity lets users mark up a screenshot, add a comment, and send feedback.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to use this older Instabug screenshot-annotation and feedback screen.

zh-CN.description: 在旧版 Instabug 反馈流程中，用户可通过此 Activity 标注截图、填写意见并发送反馈。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法使用此旧版 Instabug 截图标注和反馈页面。

en.description: Instabug Core uses this provider at app startup to read the app's Instabug token, initialize the SDK, and start in-app tracking.
en.disableEffect: Instabug's automatic startup initialization and in-app feedback or diagnostics may not be available.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，Instabug Core 会通过此 Provider 读取应用的 Instabug 令牌、初始化 SDK 并启动应用内跟踪。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Instabug 将无法自动完成启动初始化，应用内反馈或诊断功能可能无法使用。

en.description: Instabug opens this Activity when it needs system permission to capture the app screen for a screenshot or recording. It can also request microphone access when recording audio is enabled.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to grant Instabug screen-capture or optional recording-audio permission through this flow.

zh-CN.description: Instabug 需要截取屏幕或录制画面时，会打开此 Activity 请求系统授权；启用录音后也可能申请麦克风权限。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此流程授予 Instabug 屏幕捕获或可选的录音权限。

en.description: Older Instabug Core versions register this Receiver for Android's connectivity-change broadcast and start cached-report uploads when a network is available.
en.disableEffect: Cached Instabug reports will not be automatically queued for upload when network connectivity returns.

zh-CN.description: 旧版 Instabug Core 会通过此 Receiver 接收 Android 网络连接变化广播，并在网络可用时启动缓存报告上传。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 网络恢复时，缓存的 Instabug 报告将不会自动开始上传。

en.description: Older Instabug Core versions use this service to check network availability and upload feedback reports saved on the device. The connectivity Receiver starts it when network connectivity returns.
en.disableEffect: Saved Instabug reports will not be uploaded by this background service.

zh-CN.description: 旧版 Instabug Core 会通过此 Service 检查网络，并上传保存在设备上的反馈报告；网络恢复后由连接状态 Receiver 启动它。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 设备上保存的 Instabug 报告将无法通过此后台服务上传。

en.description: Instabug Core starts this foreground service after screen-capture permission is granted to capture the current app screen for an Instabug report.
en.disableEffect: Instabug users will not be able to capture a new screenshot through this service.

zh-CN.description: 用户授予屏幕捕获权限后，Instabug Core 会启动此前台 Service，截取当前应用画面并用于 Instabug 报告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Instabug 用户将无法通过此服务截取新的屏幕画面。

en.description: Instabug Surveys uses this Activity to show an in-app announcement and handle the user's response or dismissal.
en.disableEffect: Instabug announcements will no longer appear in the app.

zh-CN.description: Instabug Surveys 使用此 Activity 展示应用内公告，并处理用户的响应或关闭操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用内将不再显示 Instabug 公告。

en.description: Instabug Surveys uses this Activity to present an in-app survey or app-rating prompt, with a layout chosen for the survey type.
en.disableEffect: Users will not receive or answer Instabug in-app surveys or rating prompts.

zh-CN.description: Instabug Surveys 使用此 Activity 展示应用内问卷或评分提示，并根据问卷类型显示相应界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法收到或填写 Instabug 应用内问卷和评分提示。

en.description: Instamojo Payments opens this Activity to display the checkout page for an order and handle payment completion or cancellation.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to complete payments through Instamojo's checkout page.

zh-CN.description: Instamojo Payments 使用此 Activity 显示订单结账页面，并处理付款完成或取消操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 Instamojo 结账页面完成付款。

en.description: Instamojo Payments opens this Activity with an order ID, loads available payment methods, and lets the user choose one before checkout.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to view payment methods or start checkout through Instamojo.

zh-CN.description: Instamojo Payments 使用此 Activity 根据订单编号加载可用付款方式，供用户在结账前选择。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法查看付款方式或通过 Instamojo 开始结账。

en.description: Instana's Android Agent uses this provider during startup to measure launch time when the app opens in the foreground and mark launches that start in the background.
en.disableEffect: Instana will stop automatically measuring app startup time.

zh-CN.description: Instana Android Agent 会在启动时通过此 Provider 测量应用在前台打开时的启动时间，并标记从后台启动的情况。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Instana 将不再自动测量应用启动时间。

en.description: Instana's Android Agent runs this service when Android removes the app task and records the final network-usage measurement.
en.disableEffect: Instana may miss the final network-usage measurement when the app is removed from Recents.

zh-CN.description: Android 从最近任务中移除应用时，Instana Android Agent 会通过此 Service 记录最后一次网络用量。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用从最近任务中移除时，Instana 可能无法记录最后一次网络用量。

en.description: Android Permissions (Nishkarsh) opens this Activity when the library needs to request runtime permissions. It sends the granted or denied results back to the library.
en.disableEffect: Permission prompts cannot complete, so app features that need those permissions may fail.

zh-CN.description: Android Permissions（Nishkarsh）会在库需要申请运行时权限时打开此 Activity，并将授权或拒绝结果返回给库。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 权限申请流程将无法完成，依赖这些权限的应用功能可能失效。

en.description: Intercom's message composer opens this Activity when a user expands the gallery to choose a photo for a message. It returns the selected image to the conversation.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to browse the full-screen gallery and attach a photo to an Intercom message.

zh-CN.description: 用户展开 Intercom 消息编辑器中的图库并选择图片时，图库会打开此 Activity，并将所选图片返回给会话。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法浏览全屏图库并为 Intercom 消息添加图片。

en.description: Intercom's message gallery opens this Activity to show a selected image in a full-screen preview.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to open the full-screen preview for gallery images in Intercom.

zh-CN.description: Intercom 消息图库会通过此 Activity 全屏预览用户选中的图片。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在 Intercom 中打开图库图片的全屏预览。

en.description: Playwire Mobile opens this Activity to display a prepared advertisement in a full-screen player and lets the user close it when allowed.
en.disableEffect: Playwire full-screen advertisements will not be displayed.

zh-CN.description: Playwire Mobile 使用此 Activity 通过全屏播放器展示已准备好的广告，并在允许时让用户关闭广告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Playwire 全屏广告将无法显示。

en.description: Playwire Mobile's VAST ad module uses this Activity to play a full-screen video advertisement and pause or resume it with the app lifecycle.
en.disableEffect: Playwire VAST video advertisements will not be displayed.

zh-CN.description: Playwire Mobile 的 VAST 广告模块使用此 Activity 播放全屏视频广告，并随应用生命周期暂停或继续播放。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Playwire VAST 视频广告将无法显示。

en.description: Runs when the Interswitch Smart Till SDK reports a Bluetooth connection change or receives a terminal message. It passes connection status, errors and transaction replies to the app.
en.disableEffect: The app may not receive Bluetooth till status or transaction replies, so payments through that terminal can fail.

zh-CN.description: Interswitch Smart Till SDK 报告蓝牙连接状态变化或收到终端消息时，此接收器会把连接状态、错误和交易回复传给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用可能无法收到蓝牙终端状态或交易回复，导致通过该终端进行的支付失败。

en.description: Starts when an app uses the Interswitch Smart Till SDK to open a Bluetooth till connection. It keeps the connection available for payment commands and terminal replies.
en.disableEffect: Bluetooth till payments and terminal communication stop working.

zh-CN.description: 应用通过 Interswitch Smart Till SDK 连接蓝牙收银终端时，此服务会启动并保持连接，以传送支付指令和终端回复。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法通过蓝牙收银终端进行支付或收发交易数据。

en.description: Starts when an app uses the Interswitch Smart Till SDK's network-connected till mode. It waits for the till on the local network and carries payment commands and replies.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot communicate with a network-connected till or complete payments through it.

zh-CN.description: 应用使用 Interswitch Smart Till SDK 的网络收银终端模式时，此服务会启动，在本地网络等待终端连接并传送支付指令和回复。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法与网络收银终端通信，也无法通过它完成支付。

en.description: Starts when an app selects a USB-connected till through the Interswitch Smart Till SDK. It connects to the till and carries payment and status messages between the terminal and app.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot communicate with a USB-connected till or complete payments through it.

zh-CN.description: 应用通过 Interswitch Smart Till SDK 选择 USB 收银终端时，此服务会启动并连接终端，在应用与终端之间传送支付和状态消息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法与 USB 收银终端通信，也无法通过它完成支付。

en.description: Opened when an app requests checkout through the Interswitch Mobile Payment SDK, it displays the payment flow and returns the transaction result to the app.
en.disableEffect: The app's Interswitch mobile-payment checkout cannot open, so those payments cannot be completed.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求使用 Interswitch Mobile Payment SDK 收款时，此页面会展示支付流程，并把交易结果返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法打开 Interswitch 移动支付页面，也无法完成这类支付。

en.description: After a bill service is selected in the Interswitch SmartPOS SDK, this screen loads the available bill options. Choosing an option continues to the payment summary.
