en.disableEffect: Users cannot view or select payment options for the chosen bill service.

zh-CN.description: 在 Interswitch SmartPOS SDK 中选定账单服务后，此页面会加载可用的账单选项；选定一项后继续到支付摘要。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法查看或选择该账单服务的支付选项。

en.description: After a user chooses a bill category in the Interswitch SmartPOS SDK, this screen loads and lists the available bill providers and services. Selecting one opens its bill options.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot choose a provider or service for bill payment.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Interswitch SmartPOS SDK 中选择账单类别后，此页面会加载并列出可用的账单服务商和服务；选中一项后进入账单选项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法选择账单支付服务商或服务。

en.description: Shown when a merchant starts bill payment through the Interswitch SmartPOS SDK, this screen loads bill categories and opens the service-selection step.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot start bill payments from the SmartPOS screen.

zh-CN.description: 商户通过 Interswitch SmartPOS SDK 开始账单支付时，此页面会加载账单类别并进入服务选择步骤。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法从 SmartPOS 页面开始账单支付。

en.description: Shows the selected bill service and amount before opening the Interswitch SmartPOS payment confirmation step. It returns the completed payment result to the SDK flow.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot review and confirm bill payments through this screen.

zh-CN.description: 此页面会显示选定的账单服务和金额，然后打开 Interswitch SmartPOS 的支付确认步骤，并将完成结果交回支付流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此页面核对并确认账单支付。

en.description: Opened from Interswitch SmartPOS transaction history, this screen lets users switch between locally stored transactions and recent transfers.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open the SmartPOS transaction history or recent-transfer list.

zh-CN.description: 此页面从 Interswitch SmartPOS 交易记录入口打开，用户可在本地交易记录和最近转账之间切换。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法查看 SmartPOS 交易记录或最近转账列表。

en.description: Opened from the Interswitch SmartPOS reports menu, this screen filters transaction reports by transaction type, currency and date range.
en.disableEffect: Merchants cannot view or filter SmartPOS transaction reports.

zh-CN.description: 此页面从 Interswitch SmartPOS 报表菜单打开，可按交易类型、币种和日期范围筛选交易报表。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 商户将无法查看或筛选 SmartPOS 交易报表。

en.description: Shows Interswitch SmartPOS setup choices and opens the selected configuration screen. Protected choices check the administrator PIN.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open the SmartPOS settings menu or its configuration screens.

zh-CN.description: 此页面列出 Interswitch SmartPOS 设置选项，并打开用户选中的配置页面；受保护的选项会检查管理员 PIN。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开 SmartPOS 设置菜单或其中的配置页面。

en.description: Lets a merchant edit SmartPOS purchase limits, merchant email, currency, contactless and multi-currency options, audio feedback and receipt QR settings, then save them.
en.disableEffect: Merchants cannot change these SmartPOS settings or configure receipt QR codes.

zh-CN.description: 商户可在此修改 SmartPOS 购买限额、商户邮箱、币种、非接触支付和多币种选项、声音提示及收据二维码设置，并保存更改。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 商户将无法修改这些 SmartPOS 设置或配置收据二维码。

en.description: Opened from merchant settings, this screen previews the transaction QR receipt and lets merchants choose, reorder or hide the information it contains.
en.disableEffect: Merchants cannot configure which transaction details appear in the QR receipt.

zh-CN.description: 此页面从商户设置中打开，可预览交易二维码收据，并让商户选择、排序或隐藏其中显示的信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 商户将无法配置二维码收据中显示哪些交易信息。

en.description: Used to change the SmartPOS supervisor PIN or enroll a supervisor card for protected terminal actions.
en.disableEffect: Supervisors cannot change their PIN or enroll a card through SmartPOS.

zh-CN.description: 此页面用于修改 SmartPOS 主管 PIN，或为受保护的终端操作登记主管卡。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 主管将无法通过 SmartPOS 修改 PIN 或登记卡片。

en.description: Used to configure SmartPOS terminal and connection settings, download terminal keys or merchant details, and save till and network options.
en.disableEffect: Merchants cannot configure the terminal, download its keys or change its till connection settings.

zh-CN.description: 此页面用于配置 SmartPOS 终端和连接设置、下载终端密钥或商户资料，并保存收银终端及网络选项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 商户将无法配置终端、下载密钥或修改收银终端连接设置。

en.description: Opened for an Interswitch SmartPOS payment, bill purchase or cash transfer, this screen handles the transaction step and returns its result, with cancellation and receipt actions.
en.disableEffect: The app's SmartPOS payment flow may not open or return a transaction result.

zh-CN.description: 进行 Interswitch SmartPOS 支付、账单购买或现金转账时，此页面负责交易步骤并返回结果，也提供取消和收据操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用的 SmartPOS 支付流程可能无法打开或返回交易结果。

en.description: Runs in the Interswitch SmartPOS payment flow to save completed transaction details, show payment notifications and handle receipt printing.
en.disableEffect: Payment notifications, transaction logging and receipt printing handled by this service stop working.

zh-CN.description: 此服务在 Interswitch SmartPOS 支付流程中保存已完成的交易信息、显示支付通知并处理收据打印。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 此服务负责的支付通知、交易记录和收据打印将停止工作。

en.description: Opens the ThankYouCash rewards flow in Interswitch SmartPOS to check a user's balance and start a points redemption.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot check or use their ThankYouCash balance in the POS app.

zh-CN.description: 此页面打开 Interswitch SmartPOS 的 ThankYouCash 奖励流程，用于查询余额并开始积分兑换。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在 POS 应用中查询或使用 ThankYouCash 余额。

en.description: Opened to confirm a ThankYouCash redemption in Interswitch SmartPOS, this screen submits the redemption, records its result and offers a receipt.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot confirm or print a receipt for a ThankYouCash redemption through this screen.

zh-CN.description: 此页面用于确认 Interswitch SmartPOS 中的 ThankYouCash 兑换，会提交兑换、记录结果并提供收据。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此页面确认 ThankYouCash 兑换或打印收据。

en.description: Opened for a selected Interswitch SmartPOS transaction, this screen shows its amount, status, payment details and receipt, with an option to reprint.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot view the selected transaction's details or reprint its receipt.

zh-CN.description: 此页面用于查看选定的 Interswitch SmartPOS 交易，可显示金额、状态、支付详情和收据，并提供重新打印选项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法查看该交易详情或重新打印收据。

en.description: Started or bound when an app uses the Inuker Android Bluetooth Library or Android-BluetoothKit to connect to nearby Bluetooth devices. It provides the library's shared Bluetooth connection service.
en.disableEffect: Bluetooth-device discovery and communication through the library stop working.

zh-CN.description: 应用使用 Inuker Android Bluetooth Library 或 Android-BluetoothKit 连接附近的蓝牙设备时，会启动或绑定此服务；它提供库共用的蓝牙连接服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过该库进行的蓝牙设备发现和通信将停止。

en.description: When the app launches Inventiv's GastroPay SDK, this screen shows the SDK's merchant, payment, and wallet sections.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot open GastroPay's merchant, payment, or wallet interface.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动 Inventiv GastroPay SDK 时，此界面会显示商户、付款和钱包入口。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法打开 GastroPay 的商户、付款或钱包界面。

en.description: Blankj Android UtilCode uses this translucent helper Activity when a utility needs an Activity to request Android permissions or receive a result from another screen.
en.disableEffect: Permission requests and results from other screens that rely on this Blankj helper may stop working.

zh-CN.description: Blankj Android UtilCode 的工具需要 Activity 来请求 Android 权限或接收其他界面返回结果时，会短暂打开此半透明界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此 Blankj 辅助界面的权限请求和其他界面结果处理可能无法完成。

en.description: Blankj Android UtilCode uses this main-process version of its translucent helper Activity for operations that need an Activity to request permissions or receive a result from another screen.
en.disableEffect: Permission requests and results handled through this Blankj main-process helper may stop working.

zh-CN.description: Blankj Android UtilCode 在主进程执行需要 Activity 的操作时会使用此半透明辅助界面，例如请求 Android 权限或接收其他界面返回结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过此 Blankj 主进程辅助界面处理的权限请求和其他界面结果可能无法完成。

en.description: When the app opens Inventiv MultiPay's add-wallet flow, this screen lets the user add a wallet or payment method.
en.disableEffect: The user cannot add a wallet or payment method through MultiPay.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开 Inventiv MultiPay 的添加钱包流程时，此界面会让用户添加钱包或付款方式。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 MultiPay 添加钱包或付款方式。

en.description: When Inventiv MultiPay starts its sign-in flow, this screen displays the login form and supports the follow-up verification or registration steps.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot sign in through the MultiPay flow, so payment features that require that account may be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: Inventiv MultiPay 启动登录流程时，此界面会显示登录表单，并支持后续验证或注册步骤。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 MultiPay 登录，因此需要该账户的付款功能可能无法使用。

en.description: When a MultiPay flow needs to show an agreement or contract page, this screen displays the supplied page title and web content, with an optional action button.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot read or complete agreement steps that rely on this MultiPay screen.

zh-CN.description: MultiPay 流程需要显示协议或合同页面时，此界面会显示传入的标题和网页内容，并可提供操作按钮。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法阅读或完成依赖此 MultiPay 界面的协议步骤。

en.description: When the app opens the Inventiv MultiPay entry flow, this screen shows the SDK's start screen and begins the next step in that flow.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot start or continue the MultiPay flow through this screen.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开 Inventiv MultiPay 流程时，此界面会显示 SDK 的入口页面并启动流程的下一步。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法通过此界面启动或继续 MultiPay 流程。

en.description: When the app opens Inventiv MultiPay's wallet section, this screen shows the wallet and can open the add-card step when requested.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot view or manage the wallet through MultiPay.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开 Inventiv MultiPay 钱包时，此界面会显示钱包，并可按请求进入添加银行卡步骤。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 MultiPay 查看或管理钱包。

en.description: Runs after the app is updated and records the new version for InviteReferrals campaign and referral tracking.
en.disableEffect: InviteReferrals may not detect an app update for its referral tracking.

zh-CN.description: 应用更新后，此接收器会记录新版本，供 InviteReferrals 活动和推荐跟踪使用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: InviteReferrals 可能无法为推荐跟踪识别应用更新。

en.description: Opened when a user joins an InviteReferrals campaign, this screen loads the campaign and presents its requested sign-up details, such as name, email or phone.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot register for or continue through the referral campaign sign-up flow.

zh-CN.description: 用户加入 InviteReferrals 活动时，此页面会加载活动信息并显示所需的注册资料，例如姓名、邮箱或手机号。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法注册或继续参与推荐活动。

en.description: Opens an InviteReferrals campaign page and loads campaign and user information, then shows the matching invitation, sharing or enrollment screen.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open or continue through the app's referral campaign pages.

zh-CN.description: 此页面打开 InviteReferrals 活动并加载活动和用户信息，然后显示相应的邀请、分享或注册内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开或继续使用应用中的推荐活动页面。

en.description: Shown when an InviteReferrals campaign is inactive, this screen loads and displays the campaign's inactive notice.
en.disableEffect: An inactive campaign link may fail to open its status page.

zh-CN.description: InviteReferrals 活动已停用时，此页面会加载并显示活动停用提示。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 已停用的活动链接可能无法打开状态说明页面。

en.description: Opens an InviteReferrals campaign's sharing page, retrieves the user's referral link and statistics, and lets them copy or share an invitation.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot view their referral link or share campaign invitations through InviteReferrals.

zh-CN.description: 此页面打开 InviteReferrals 活动的分享界面，获取用户的推荐链接和统计信息，并允许用户复制或分享邀请。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法查看推荐链接或通过 InviteReferrals 分享活动邀请。

en.description: Opened from the Invms AWProtocol web app menu, this screen lets users change the configured page address and the app features available to that page.
en.disableEffect: The web app's settings shortcut fails, and users cannot change its page or app-access settings.

zh-CN.description: 从 Invms AWProtocol 网页应用菜单打开后，此页面允许用户修改页面地址以及网页可使用的应用功能。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 网页应用的设置入口将无法使用，用户也无法修改页面地址或应用访问设置。

en.description: When the app opens, the Invms AWProtocol SDK displays its configured web-based home screen and connects the page to the app's available actions.
en.disableEffect: The app's main web screen cannot load, so its web-based features stop working.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开时，Invms AWProtocol SDK 会显示配置的网页主界面，并让网页调用应用提供的功能。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用的网页主界面将无法加载，相关网页功能也会停止。

en.description: Primer's iPay88 integration uses this Activity to finish a payment-status check and pass the returned outcome back to the SDK.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it can prevent iPay88 from returning a payment-status result to the app, leaving that checkout incomplete.

zh-CN.description: Primer 的 iPay88 集成会用此 Activity 完成支付状态查询，并把返回结果交回 SDK。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，iPay88 可能无法把支付状态返回应用，导致该笔支付流程无法完成。

en.description: Primer's iPay88 integration opens this Activity to show the hosted payment page in an embedded browser and report the transaction result to the app.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it removes the iPay88 payment page, so payments through that method cannot finish.

zh-CN.description: Primer 的 iPay88 集成会用此 Activity 在应用内显示托管支付页面，并把交易结果交回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，iPay88 支付页面无法打开，用户无法通过此方式完成付款。

en.description: Opened for checkout through IppoPay SDK, this screen lets the customer choose card, bank or UPI payment and completes the hosted payment flow.
en.disableEffect: IppoPay checkout cannot open, so payments through this SDK cannot be completed.

zh-CN.description: 通过 IppoPay SDK 结账时，此页面让用户选择银行卡、银行转账或 UPI 支付，并完成在线支付流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: IppoPay 结账页面将无法打开，用户也无法完成通过此 SDK 进行的支付。

en.description: Opened for checkout through IppoPay SDK, this screen displays the hosted payment page and returns success, pending or failure results to the app.
en.disableEffect: IppoPay checkout cannot open, so payments through this SDK cannot be completed.

zh-CN.description: 通过 IppoPay SDK 结账时，此页面会显示在线支付页面，并将成功、处理中或失败的结果返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: IppoPay 结账页面将无法打开，用户也无法完成通过此 SDK 进行的支付。

en.description: The Open Campaign Link Biometrics Capture SDK opens the camera screen to enroll or verify a face. It guides the capture and returns the saved image and result to the app.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents face enrollment or verification from returning a captured image and result.

zh-CN.description: Open Campaign Link Biometrics Capture SDK 会打开相机页面，用于录入或验证人脸。它会引导用户完成拍摄，并将保存的图片和结果返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，人脸录入或验证流程将无法返回拍摄图片和结果。

en.description: The Open Campaign Link Biometrics Capture SDK shows this introductory screen before face capture. The user can continue to the camera, skip, or go back.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it interrupts the SDK face enrollment and verification flow before capture.

zh-CN.description: Open Campaign Link Biometrics Capture SDK 会在人脸拍摄前显示此说明页面，用户可以继续打开相机、跳过或返回。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，SDK 的人脸录入和验证流程会在拍摄前中断。

en.description: The Open Campaign Link Biometrics Capture SDK shows this introductory screen before face capture. The user can continue to the camera, skip, or go back.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it interrupts the SDK face enrollment and verification flow before capture.

zh-CN.description: Open Campaign Link Biometrics Capture SDK 会在人脸拍摄前显示此说明页面，用户可以继续打开相机、跳过或返回。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，SDK 的人脸录入和验证流程会在拍摄前中断。

en.description: The Open Campaign Link (OCL) health campaign SDK opens this screen to scan a campaign QR code with the camera. When it recognizes a code, it returns its text to the app and closes the scanner.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents the app from scanning QR codes for OCL campaign links.

zh-CN.description: Open Campaign Link（OCL）健康活动 SDK 会打开此页面，通过相机扫描活动二维码。识别成功后，二维码内容会返回给应用，扫描页面随即关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用将无法扫描 OCL 活动链接二维码。

en.description: On app startup, the iRiS Guest Library opens a private local store for property content, organized by property, language, version, and content type. The provider lets guest features read, save, update, or remove these cached values.
en.disableEffect: Guest pages that depend on this local content store may fail to load or show outdated property information.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，iRiS Guest Library 会打开一个私有本地内容库，按酒店、语言、版本和内容类型保存数据。客人端功能可通过此内容提供程序读取、保存、更新或删除缓存内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此本地内容库的酒店页面可能无法加载，或无法显示最新的酒店信息。

en.description: When the iRiS Guest Library's repeating content alarm fires, this receiver requests a property-session refresh while the guest experience is active. This keeps hotel pages and outlet information current.
en.disableEffect: Property content will stop refreshing on this schedule and may become outdated.

zh-CN.description: iRiS Guest Library 的定时内容闹钟触发时，如果客人端处于活动状态，此接收器会请求刷新酒店会话，从而保持酒店页面和门店信息更新。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，酒店内容不再按此计划刷新，显示内容可能过期。

en.description: When the app's scheduled guest alarm is due, the iRiS Guest Library receiver notifies the app to trigger that alarm event.
en.disableEffect: The app will not receive its scheduled guest-alarm event.

zh-CN.description: 应用设置的客人闹钟到时后，iRiS Guest Library 的此接收器会通知应用触发闹钟事件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用将收不到预定的客人闹钟事件。

en.description: The iRiS Guest Library schedules this receiver once a minute to notify the app that its guest clock should be refreshed.
en.disableEffect: The guest clock will no longer receive its scheduled minute-by-minute updates.

zh-CN.description: iRiS Guest Library 每分钟触发一次此接收器，通知应用更新客人时钟。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，客人时钟将不再按计划每分钟更新。

en.description: When its conversation-polling alarm fires, the iRiS Guest Library checks for new conversations for a signed-in guest while the guest experience is active.
en.disableEffect: New guest messages may no longer appear automatically in the app.

zh-CN.description: 对话轮询闹钟触发时，只要客人已登录且客人端处于活动状态，iRiS Guest Library 就会检查是否有新的客人对话。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，新的客人消息可能不会自动显示在应用中。

en.description: At the scheduled welcome-message time, the iRiS Guest Library notifies the app that a welcome message is due.
en.disableEffect: The scheduled welcome-message event will not reach the app.

zh-CN.description: 到达预定的欢迎消息时间时，iRiS Guest Library 会通过此接收器通知应用处理欢迎消息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，预定的欢迎消息事件不会传递到应用。

en.description: When its repeating room check-in alarm fires, the iRiS Guest Library reads the saved device-and-room registration and starts a refresh of the related property session.
en.disableEffect: The room-linked session may stop refreshing automatically, affecting automatic room check-in.

zh-CN.description: 客房签到的重复闹钟触发时，iRiS Guest Library 会读取已保存的设备和客房登记信息，并启动相关酒店会话的刷新。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，客房关联会话可能无法自动刷新，影响自动客房签到。

en.description: When a scheduled weather alarm fires for an active guest experience, the iRiS Guest Library asks its service to fetch the property's latest forecast.
en.disableEffect: The property's weather forecast will no longer refresh automatically.

zh-CN.description: 客人端处于活动状态时，天气闹钟触发后，iRiS Guest Library 会要求服务获取酒店的最新天气预报。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，酒店天气预报将不再自动更新。

en.description: The iRiS Guest Library uses this service for room- or device-linked guest requests, including pairing a device with a room, loading guest details or conversations, and submitting orders or service requests.
en.disableEffect: Room-linked guest operations that use this service may fail or remain incomplete.

zh-CN.description: iRiS Guest Library 使用此服务处理与客房或设备关联的客人请求，包括将设备与客房配对、获取客人资料或对话，以及提交订单或服务请求。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此服务的客房关联操作可能失败或无法完成。

en.description: When the app initializes guest content, changes language, or requests outlet information, the iRiS Guest Library uses this service to download property pages, settings, language content, and outlet details.
en.disableEffect: Guest pages, menus, or language changes that need fresh property content may stop working.

zh-CN.description: 应用初始化客人内容、切换语言或请求门店信息时，iRiS Guest Library 会通过此服务下载酒店页面、设置、语言内容和门店详情。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要最新酒店内容的客人页面、菜单或语言切换可能无法使用。

en.description: When the app requests weather data or a scheduled refresh runs, the iRiS Guest Library uses this service to retrieve the property's forecast and pass it to the app.
en.disableEffect: The app's property weather forecast will no longer update through the library.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求天气信息或执行定时刷新时，iRiS Guest Library 会通过此服务获取酒店天气预报并将结果交给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用中的酒店天气预报将无法通过该库更新。

en.description: When a guest signs in, checks in or out, or uses account services, the iRiS Guest Library uses this service for guest profiles, conversations, messages, orders, service requests, and order history.
en.disableEffect: Guest sign-in, check-in, and related account services may stop working.

zh-CN.description: 客人登录、签到或退房，以及使用账户服务时，iRiS Guest Library 会通过此服务处理客人资料、对话、消息、订单、服务请求和订单记录。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，客人登录、签到及相关账户服务可能无法正常使用。

en.description: For order and service-request flows without a signed-in guest account, the iRiS Guest Library uses this service to submit basket items, orders, and requests through the property's general session.
en.disableEffect: Ordering or requesting property services through this flow will stop working.

zh-CN.description: 在没有已登录客人账户的订单或服务请求流程中，iRiS Guest Library 会通过此服务使用酒店通用会话提交购物篮项目、订单和请求。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，此流程中的点餐和酒店服务请求将无法提交。

en.description: The iRiS Guest VoIP integration starts this service to register its internet-phone account and listen for incoming calls, then forwards caller details to the app.
en.disableEffect: Incoming calls may not reach the app, so its guest-calling feature may stop working.

zh-CN.description: iRiS Guest VoIP 集成会启动此服务以注册网络电话账户并监听来电，然后把来电者信息转发给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，来电可能无法传到应用，客人语音通话功能可能无法使用。

en.description: The Yandex Mobile Ads IronSource mediation adapter starts this provider with the app. In debuggable builds it logs that this adapter version is unsupported and reports its integration status.
en.disableEffect: Only the adapter warning and startup messages in debuggable builds are lost; this provider does not change normal app features.

zh-CN.description: Yandex Mobile Ads 的 IronSource 中介适配器会在应用启动时运行此提供器。可调试版本中，它会记录该适配器版本已不受支持的警告和集成状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 只会失去可调试版本中的适配器警告和启动日志；此提供器不会改变应用的正常功能。

en.description: Unity LevelPlay (ironSource) runs this provider at app startup to register callbacks for when app screens open, pause, or stop. The ad SDK uses these changes to follow app foreground state.
en.disableEffect: LevelPlay may not track app foreground changes, so mediated ads may not pause or resume correctly.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，Unity LevelPlay（ironSource）会运行此提供程序，注册应用界面打开、暂停或停止时的回调。广告 SDK 会据此跟踪应用的前后台状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 屏蔽后，LevelPlay 可能无法跟踪应用前后台变化，中介广告的暂停或恢复可能异常。

en.description: Loaded with the Unity LevelPlay (ironSource) SDK, this provider tracks the app's active screen so the ad SDK can display and resume ads in the right place.
en.disableEffect: LevelPlay ads may not display or resume correctly when the app changes screens.

zh-CN.description: Unity LevelPlay（ironSource）SDK 加载此提供程序以跟踪应用当前页面，让广告 SDK 能在合适的页面显示或恢复广告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用切换页面时，LevelPlay 广告可能无法正常显示或恢复。

en.description: An app developer can open this Unity LevelPlay (ironSource) screen to check the ad mediation setup in its test suite.
en.disableEffect: The LevelPlay test screen will not open; ordinary app screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: 应用开发者可打开 Unity LevelPlay（ironSource）的测试界面，检查广告中介配置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 屏蔽后，LevelPlay 测试界面将无法打开，应用的普通界面仍可使用。

en.description: ironSource LevelPlay opens this screen to host interactive ad content and its controls.
en.disableEffect: LevelPlay ads that need this screen will not display or respond to interaction.

zh-CN.description: ironSource LevelPlay 会打开此页面承载互动广告内容及其操作界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要此页面的 LevelPlay 广告将无法显示或响应操作。

en.description: ironSource LevelPlay opens this screen to show a full-screen interstitial ad.
en.disableEffect: LevelPlay interstitial ads will no longer appear.

zh-CN.description: ironSource LevelPlay 会打开此页面展示全屏插页广告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: LevelPlay 全屏插页广告将不再显示。

en.description: When a LevelPlay ad opens a destination link, this screen displays the URL inside the ad SDK.
en.disableEffect: LevelPlay ad destination pages will no longer open in this screen.

zh-CN.description: LevelPlay 广告打开目标链接时，会使用此页面在广告 SDK 内显示网址内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: LevelPlay 广告的目标页面将无法通过此页面打开。

en.description: When iShow AndroidCommon shares a local file with another app, Android uses this Provider to give the receiving app temporary access to that file.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it can break file sharing or opening exported files in another app.

zh-CN.description: iShow AndroidCommon 与其他应用分享本地文件时，Android 会通过此 Provider 临时授权接收方访问该文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，文件分享或在其他应用中打开导出文件的功能可能无法工作。

en.description: Android creates this iShow AndroidCommon Provider during app startup. It registers app-state tracking and initializes the library's image-loading support and logs.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it leaves AndroidCommon image-loading and app-state support uninitialized, which can break features that use them.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，Android 会创建 iShow AndroidCommon 的此 Provider。它注册应用状态跟踪，并初始化库的图片加载支持和日志记录。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，AndroidCommon 的图片加载和应用状态支持无法初始化，使用这些功能的页面可能会受影响。

en.description: When a selected photo needs cropping, iShow AndroidCommon opens this Activity with the image and crop ratio. It returns a compressed cropped image to the selection flow.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it breaks the crop step and may prevent an image-selection flow from returning its result.

zh-CN.description: 需要裁剪所选照片时，iShow AndroidCommon 会将图片和裁剪比例传给此 Activity。它返回压缩后的裁剪图片供选择流程使用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，图片裁剪步骤会中断，选择流程可能无法返回结果。

en.description: When an app feature asks the user to choose photos or videos, iShow AndroidCommon opens this Activity with a selection mode and limit. The user browses local media and returns the chosen items.
en.disableEffect: The app's built-in photo and video selection flow will not open or return selections.

zh-CN.description: 应用功能请求用户选择照片或视频时，iShow AndroidCommon 会按指定模式和数量限制打开此 Activity。用户浏览本地媒体后，所选内容会返回给调用流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用内置的照片和视频选择流程无法打开或返回选择结果。

en.description: When an iShow AndroidCommon feature requests Android permissions, this Activity displays the permission prompt and returns which permissions were granted or denied.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it breaks those permission requests, so features that need the requested access cannot continue.

zh-CN.description: iShow AndroidCommon 功能请求 Android 权限时，此 Activity 会显示权限提示，并返回用户允许或拒绝的权限。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，相关权限请求会中断，需要这些权限的功能无法继续。

en.description: This Itachi1706 AppUpdater screen opens from updater settings and shows Android version, device model, and other details for troubleshooting.
en.disableEffect: You will no longer be able to view these device details from AppUpdater.

zh-CN.description: Itachi1706 的 AppUpdater 设置可打开此页面，查看 Android 版本、设备型号等排查信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，无法再从 AppUpdater 查看这些设备信息。

en.description: When AppUpdater finds an update and opens its update prompt, this screen shows the release notes and provides the download and install flow.
en.disableEffect: The update screen cannot open, so an update check that launches it can fail and users cannot use AppUpdater's in-app download and install flow.

zh-CN.description: AppUpdater 检测到新版本并显示更新提示时，此页面展示更新说明并提供下载和安装流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，更新页面无法打开，触发该页面的检查可能失败，用户也无法使用 AppUpdater 的应用内下载和安装流程。

en.description: Opened from AppUpdater settings, this screen shows the log output currently available to the app and lets users share it for troubleshooting.
en.disableEffect: You will no longer be able to view or share these logs from AppUpdater.

zh-CN.description: 从 AppUpdater 设置打开时，此页面显示应用当前可读取的日志，并可分享这些日志以便排查问题。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，无法再通过 AppUpdater 查看或分享这些日志。

en.description: Itachi1706 AppUpdater uses this file provider to hand downloaded update APKs to Android for installation and to share large log files.
en.disableEffect: Update installation and large-log sharing can fail because AppUpdater cannot provide Android with the required file link.

zh-CN.description: Itachi1706 的 AppUpdater 通过此文件提供器将下载的更新安装包交给 Android 安装，也用它分享较大的日志文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，AppUpdater 无法生成所需的文件链接，更新安装和大型日志分享可能失败。

en.description: When Android opens it after detecting an NFC tag, this Itachi1706 FareBot CEPAS screen forwards the tag to the card reader and then closes.
en.disableEffect: Tapping a CEPAS card will no longer open the reader through this NFC handoff.

zh-CN.description: Android 检测到 NFC 标签并打开此页面时，Itachi1706 的 FareBot CEPAS 卡库会把标签交给读卡页面处理，然后关闭此页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，通过 NFC 感应 CEPAS 卡将无法再以这种方式打开读卡页面。

en.description: This Itachi1706 FareBot CEPAS screen is opened by the host app or an NFC handoff; it sets up the card-reading screen and NFC scanning.
en.disableEffect: The app will not be able to open this card screen or scan cards through the CEPAS library.

zh-CN.description: Itachi1706 的 FareBot CEPAS 卡页面由宿主应用或 NFC 感应流程打开，负责显示卡片界面并启动 NFC 读卡。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用无法打开此卡片页面，也无法通过 CEPAS 卡库读取卡片。

en.description: The Itachi1706 FareBot CEPAS library opens this settings screen to change background NFC launch and light or dark appearance.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to change the library's background NFC launch or appearance settings.

zh-CN.description: Itachi1706 的 FareBot CEPAS 卡库通过此设置页面调整后台 NFC 启动方式和明暗外观。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法更改此卡库的后台 NFC 启动方式和外观设置。

en.description: When Firebase delivers a push or refreshes its token, the Iterable messaging SDK handles Iterable notifications and silent updates to in-app and inbox messages.
en.disableEffect: Iterable push notifications and silent message updates will no longer be handled by the app.

zh-CN.description: Firebase 收到推送或更新推送令牌时，Iterable 消息 SDK 会处理 Iterable 通知，并同步应用内消息和收件箱消息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用将不再处理 Iterable 推送通知和静默消息更新。

en.description: When an Iterable notification action is tapped, this receiver clears the notification and carries out the selected action, such as opening a page.
en.disableEffect: Tapping an Iterable notification action will no longer complete its selected action.

zh-CN.description: 用户点按 Iterable 通知中的操作时，此接收器会清除通知并执行所选操作，例如打开页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，点按 Iterable 通知操作将无法完成对应操作。

en.description: Iterable uses this brief screen for notification taps that need an action handled; it clears the notification, runs the action, and closes.
en.disableEffect: Iterable notification taps that use this route will no longer finish their action or open its destination.

zh-CN.description: Iterable 通知点按需要先处理操作时，会短暂打开此页面；页面清除通知、执行操作后便会关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，使用此流程的 Iterable 通知点按将无法完成操作或打开目标页面。

en.description: When the host app opens its Iterable message inbox, this screen displays the available messages for users to browse.
en.disableEffect: The app's Iterable message inbox will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: 宿主应用打开 Iterable 消息收件箱时，此页面会显示可供浏览的消息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用将无法打开 Iterable 消息收件箱。

en.description: After a user selects an item in the Iterable inbox, this screen displays that message.
en.disableEffect: Users will no longer be able to open messages from the Iterable inbox.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Iterable 收件箱中选择一条消息后，此页面会显示该消息内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法打开 Iterable 收件箱中的消息。

en.description: The itlgl AndroidDebugLib starts its developer debugging server when the app process initializes.
en.disableEffect: The library's developer debugging server will no longer start automatically with the app.

zh-CN.description: 应用进程初始化时，itlgl 的 AndroidDebugLib 会启动开发调试服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，该库的开发调试服务不会再随应用自动启动。

en.description: Older itlgl AndroidDebugLib versions expose this launcher screen to show app details and start or stop the developer debugging server.
en.disableEffect: The AndroidDebugLib control screen for starting or stopping its debugging server will be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: 较早版本的 itlgl AndroidDebugLib 通过此启动器页面显示应用信息，并提供开发调试服务的启动和停止控制。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，将无法打开 AndroidDebugLib 的调试服务控制页面。

en.description: When an app starts UcomDigital SSO sign-in, account setup, switching, or migration, this screen runs that authorization flow and returns its result.
en.disableEffect: Apps using UcomDigital SSO cannot complete sign-in or account-management flows.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动 UcomDigital SSO 登录、账号设置、切换或迁移时，此页面会执行相应授权流程并返回结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，使用 UcomDigital SSO 的应用将无法完成登录或账号管理流程。

en.description: When a UcomDigital SSO account provider connects, this background Service exchanges saved account information with other compatible sign-in services.
en.disableEffect: UcomDigital SSO cannot collect or share account data between cooperating services.

zh-CN.description: UcomDigital SSO 账号提供程序连接时，此后台服务会与其他兼容的登录服务交换已保存的账号信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，UcomDigital SSO 将无法在协作服务之间收集或共享账号数据。

en.description: When Android requests the UcomDigital SSO account authenticator, this Service provides the account-sign-in support used to add or manage an account.
en.disableEffect: Android account addition and sign-in through the UcomDigital SSO authenticator will stop working.

zh-CN.description: Android 请求 UcomDigital SSO 账号验证器时，此服务会提供添加或管理账号所需的登录支持。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，将无法通过 UcomDigital SSO 验证器添加 Android 账号或登录。

en.description: The Xiaomi MiMo ads SDK uses this file provider to hand a downloaded advertised app package to Android's installer.
en.disableEffect: Ad app downloads that rely on this file handoff will not be installable; the host app's own features remain available.

zh-CN.description: 小米 MiMo 广告 SDK 通过此文件提供器将下载的广告应用安装包交给 Android 安装程序。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此文件传递的广告应用将无法安装；宿主应用本身的功能仍可使用。

en.description: When a Mobius ad link is opened, this IUSMob AdKlein screen displays the destination in an in-app browser with back and download handling.
en.disableEffect: Mobius ad landing pages and their in-app download links will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: 打开 Mobius 广告链接时，IUSMob AdKlein 会通过此页面在应用内浏览目标网页，并处理返回和下载。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Mobius 广告落地页及其应用内下载链接将无法打开。

en.description: When the host app requests a Mobius rewarded ad, this IUSMob AdKlein screen plays the video and reports a reward after the required viewing is complete.
en.disableEffect: Rewarded videos will not open, and rewards for watching ads will no longer be granted.

zh-CN.description: 宿主应用请求 Mobius 激励广告时，IUSMob AdKlein 会通过此页面播放视频，并在达到观看要求后发放奖励。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 激励视频将无法打开，观看广告的奖励也不会再发放。

en.description: When Android connects the ivianuu Essentials accessibility service, it connects the app's configured accessibility features and forwards accessibility events to them.
en.disableEffect: Accessibility features that depend on Essentials will stop receiving screen-change events.

zh-CN.description: Android 连接 ivianuu Essentials 的无障碍服务时，该服务会连接应用配置的无障碍功能，并向其转发无障碍事件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖 Essentials 的无障碍功能将不再收到界面变化事件。

en.description: ivianuu Essentials provides this launcher activity to display the app's main interface and handle its screen navigation.
en.disableEffect: The app's main screen will no longer be reachable through this launcher entry.

zh-CN.description: ivianuu Essentials 通过此启动页面显示应用主界面并处理页面导航。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，无法再通过此启动入口进入应用主界面。

en.description: The ivianuu Essentials backup feature uses this file provider to share exported backup files with other apps.
en.disableEffect: Sharing exported backup files with another app will fail.

zh-CN.description: ivianuu Essentials 的备份功能通过此文件提供器将导出的备份文件分享给其他应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，无法将导出的备份文件分享给其他应用。

en.description: After Android reports that the device has finished booting, ivianuu Essentials runs the app's registered startup tasks.
en.disableEffect: App tasks that are meant to resume after a reboot will not run through this startup hook.

zh-CN.description: Android 通知设备启动完成后，ivianuu Essentials 会运行应用注册的启动任务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 设备重启后需要恢复的应用任务将无法通过此启动接收器运行。

en.description: When the app requests ongoing foreground work, ivianuu Essentials tracks those requests and shows or updates the notification that keeps the work visible.
en.disableEffect: Long-running app work that depends on this service may stop or lose its ongoing notification.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求持续的前台任务时，ivianuu Essentials 会跟踪这些请求，并显示或更新相应的持续通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此服务的长时间运行任务可能会停止，或失去持续显示的通知。

en.description: After the user grants notification access, Android connects this ivianuu Essentials service to report current, posted, removed, and changed notifications to the app.
en.disableEffect: App features using notification access will no longer see or react to notifications.

zh-CN.description: 用户授予通知访问权限后，Android 会连接 ivianuu Essentials 的此服务，将现有、新发出、已移除或变化的通知提供给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用通知访问功能的应用将无法再查看通知或对通知变化作出响应。

en.description: When ivianuu Essentials requests a clean app restart, this activity runs in a separate process, reopens the requested screen, and exits the old process.
en.disableEffect: The app's clean-restart flow will fail if it tries to open this disabled activity.

zh-CN.description: ivianuu Essentials 请求完整重启应用时，此页面会在独立进程中重新打开指定页面，然后退出旧进程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用尝试打开此页面时，完整重启流程将会失败。

en.description: When Essentials requests that the display wake, this activity turns the screen on and reports whether the device became interactive.
en.disableEffect: Screen-wake requests will no longer complete through Essentials, which may interrupt app flows that depend on waking the display.

zh-CN.description: Essentials 请求唤醒屏幕时，此页面会点亮屏幕，并回报设备是否已进入可交互状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Essentials 无法完成唤醒屏幕的请求，依赖亮屏的应用流程可能会中断。

en.description: When the app requests a screen unlock, this ivianuu Essentials activity appears over the lock screen, asks Android to dismiss it, and reports the result.
en.disableEffect: Essentials cannot complete screen-unlock requests, so app flows that depend on unlocking the device may stop.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求解除屏幕锁定时，ivianuu Essentials 会显示此页面，请求 Android 关闭锁屏并回报处理结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Essentials 无法完成解除屏幕锁定的请求，依赖设备解锁的应用流程可能会停止。

en.description: When the app opens iZooto’s News Hub, this Activity loads and displays its news feed with the configured title.
en.disableEffect: The iZooto News Hub feed will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开 iZooto News Hub 时，此 Activity 会加载并展示资讯列表及已配置的标题。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，iZooto News Hub 资讯页将无法打开。

en.description: When a user taps an iZooto notification button or link, this receiver handles the action, records the click, and opens the selected app page, web page, or phone screen.
en.disableEffect: iZooto notification buttons and their destinations will stop working.

zh-CN.description: 用户点按 iZooto 通知中的按钮或链接时，此接收器会处理操作、记录点击，并打开相应的应用页面、网页或拨号界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，iZooto 通知按钮及其目标页面将无法正常使用。

en.description: When a user dismisses an iZooto notification, this receiver clears the notification entry and sends iZooto a dismissal report.
en.disableEffect: iZooto will no longer record when one of its notifications is dismissed.

zh-CN.description: 用户清除 iZooto 通知时，此接收器会清理该通知，并向 iZooto 上报清除事件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，iZooto 将无法记录用户清除了哪些通知。

en.description: When iZooto requests notification permission on Android 13 or later, this Activity shows the system prompt and resumes iZooto push setup if permission is granted.
en.disableEffect: Users who have not granted notification permission will not be able to grant it through iZooto, so iZooto notifications may remain off.

zh-CN.description: iZooto 在 Android 13 及更高版本请求通知权限时，此 Activity 会显示系统提示；用户允许后，它会继续完成 iZooto 推送设置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 尚未授权的用户无法通过 iZooto 完成通知授权，因此 iZooto 通知可能无法显示。

en.description: When a user taps an iZooto push notification, this Activity reads its destination, records the click, and routes the user to the app, a web link, an in-app page, or the phone dialer.
en.disableEffect: Tapping iZooto notifications will no longer open their intended destinations.

zh-CN.description: 用户点按 iZooto 推送通知时，此 Activity 会读取通知目标、记录点击，并跳转到应用、网页、应用内页面或拨号界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，点按 iZooto 通知将无法打开预定的目标页面。

en.description: When Xiaomi’s push service delivers a message, this iZooto receiver checks it and passes valid messages into iZooto’s notification flow.
en.disableEffect: iZooto messages delivered through Xiaomi’s push channel will no longer be handled or shown.

zh-CN.description: 小米推送服务送达消息时，此 iZooto 接收器会检查消息内容，并将有效消息交给 iZooto 通知流程处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，通过小米推送送达的 iZooto 消息将无法处理或显示。

en.description: When Firebase Cloud Messaging delivers an iZooto push broadcast, this receiver checks the message and passes valid payloads to iZooto for processing.
en.disableEffect: iZooto notifications delivered through Firebase Cloud Messaging will no longer be processed.

zh-CN.description: Firebase Cloud Messaging 送达 iZooto 推送广播时，此接收器会检查消息，并将有效内容交给 iZooto 处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，通过 Firebase Cloud Messaging 送达的 iZooto 通知将无法处理。

en.description: When Huawei Mobile Services delivers an iZooto message or a new device token, this service passes the message to iZooto or saves the updated token.
en.disableEffect: iZooto messages and token updates from Huawei Mobile Services will no longer be handled.

zh-CN.description: 华为移动服务送达 iZooto 消息或新的设备令牌时，此服务会将消息交给 iZooto 处理，或保存更新后的令牌。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，来自华为移动服务的 iZooto 消息和令牌更新将无法处理。

en.description: When Firebase Cloud Messaging delivers iZooto push data, this service passes the message into iZooto’s notification flow.
en.disableEffect: iZooto push messages delivered through this Firebase service will no longer be shown.

zh-CN.description: Firebase Cloud Messaging 送达 iZooto 推送数据时，此服务会将消息交给 iZooto 通知流程处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，通过此 Firebase 服务送达的 iZooto 推送将无法显示。

en.description: When iZooto opens a notification link or in-app web page, this Activity loads the destination inside the app.
en.disableEffect: iZooto web destinations will no longer open inside the app.

zh-CN.description: iZooto 打开通知链接或应用内网页时，此 Activity 会在应用内加载目标网页。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，iZooto 的网页目标将无法在应用内打开。

en.description: When the app requests a full restart through Process Phoenix by Jake Wharton, this Activity ends the current process and reopens the saved app screens.
en.disableEffect: App flows that rely on Process Phoenix for a full restart will not complete correctly.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求通过 Process Phoenix 完整重启时，此 Activity 会结束当前进程，并重新打开保存的应用页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖 Process Phoenix 完整重启的应用流程将无法正常完成。

en.description: When the app requests a service restart through Process Phoenix by Jake Wharton, this background service ends the old process and starts the requested service again.
en.disableEffect: App flows that rely on Process Phoenix to restart a service will fail.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求通过 Process Phoenix 重启服务时，此后台服务会结束旧进程，并重新启动指定服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖 Process Phoenix 重启服务的应用流程将无法完成。

en.description: When the app requests a clean restart through Process Phoenix by Jake Wharton, this Activity stops the old process and relaunches the requested app screens.
en.disableEffect: Apps that use Process Phoenix to restart may fail to reopen after the restart request.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求通过 Process Phoenix 完整重启时，此 Activity 会终止旧进程，并按保存的页面顺序重新启动应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖 Process Phoenix 重启的应用可能无法在请求后重新打开。

en.description: The James F. Chen IBC API registers this screen for browsable b://native/page, b://h5/page, b://react/page, and b://flutter/page links, so matching links can open the app.
en.disableEffect: Matching b:// links will no longer enter the app through this route and may not open their intended screen.

zh-CN.description: James F. Chen 的 IBC API 将此页面注册为可浏览的 b://native/page、b://h5/page、b://react/page 和 b://flutter/page 链接入口，使匹配的链接可以打开应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，匹配的 b:// 链接无法通过此入口进入应用，目标页面可能无法打开。

en.description: SettingPie (JamGu) opens a sample settings page with grouped profile, notification and chat options. Its checkboxes and row taps demonstrate how settings can be presented.
en.disableEffect: The sample settings demonstration will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: SettingPie（JamGu）会打开一个示例设置页，按组展示资料、通知和聊天选项。复选框和选项点击用于演示设置页的呈现方式。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 示例设置页将无法再打开。

en.description: When Janrain Engage opens a provider list, sign-in page, account landing page, or publishing form, this Activity hosts that Janrain screen and returns external-activity results to it.
en.disableEffect: Janrain-based sign-in, account connection, or publishing screens cannot open or return their result.

zh-CN.description: Janrain Engage 打开服务商列表、登录页、账户主页或发布表单时，该活动会承载相应界面，并接收外部活动返回的结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Janrain 登录、账户关联或发布界面将无法打开或返回操作结果。

en.description: When Janrain Engage requests a full-screen identity flow, this Activity hosts the same provider, sign-in, account, or publishing screens without the dialog-sized presentation.
en.disableEffect: Janrain identity or publishing flows that require the full-screen host cannot open.

zh-CN.description: Janrain Engage 请求全屏身份流程时，该活动会以全屏方式承载服务商、登录、账户或发布界面，而不是使用对话框尺寸。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要全屏承载界面的 Janrain 身份或发布流程将无法打开。

en.description: When the app opens Cyanea (Jared Rummler) theme settings, this Activity displays the theme configuration screen.
en.disableEffect: The app’s Cyanea theme settings screen will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开 Jared Rummler 的 Cyanea 主题设置时，此 Activity 会显示主题配置页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用的 Cyanea 主题设置页面将无法打开。

en.description: When a user opens Cyanea (Jared Rummler) theme picker, this Activity displays the screen for choosing the app’s dynamic theme.
en.disableEffect: Users will no longer be able to choose a theme through Cyanea’s picker.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 Jared Rummler 的 Cyanea 主题选择器时，此 Activity 会显示应用动态主题的选择页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法通过 Cyanea 选择主题。

en.description: JBangTech’s Unimini embedded applets use this component to save and retrieve shared session data in the app’s local storage.
en.disableEffect: Unimini applets may fail to load or share their session data.

zh-CN.description: JBangTech 的 Unimini 嵌入式小程序读取或保存共享会话数据时，会通过此数据组件使用应用本地存储。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Unimini 小程序可能无法加载或共享会话数据。

en.description: Jubongoh’s Lib Test SDK shows this simple placeholder test page when opened.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it removes only the library’s placeholder test screen.

zh-CN.description: Jubongoh 的 Lib Test SDK 在打开时会显示这个简单的占位测试页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，只会移除该库的占位测试界面。

en.description: The JD Ads SDK opens this screen for ad landing pages and download links.
en.disableEffect: JD ad landing pages and their download links will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: 京东广告 SDK 会打开此页面展示广告落地页和下载链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 京东广告落地页及其下载链接将无法打开。

en.description: Jingdong (JD Ads) opens this screen when an ad landing link should appear in an in-app browser. It loads the advertiser’s page and sends supported links to Android or another app.
en.disableEffect: JD Ads’ in-app landing pages will not open; other app screens continue to work.

zh-CN.description: 京东广告会在需要于应用内打开广告落地链接时显示此页面，加载广告主页面，并将可外部打开的链接交给 Android 或其他应用处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 京东广告的应用内落地页将无法打开，应用的其他页面仍可使用。

en.description: Jingdong (JD Ads) uses this provider to share ad templates, preloaded-ad data and event records between its processes. It works in the background and has no screen.
en.disableEffect: JD ads may lose their cached or preloaded data and fail to load.

zh-CN.description: 京东广告会通过此提供程序在多个进程间共享广告模板、预加载数据和事件记录；它在后台工作，不显示界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 京东广告可能无法读取缓存或预加载数据，导致广告加载失败。

en.description: When opened manually for JD Cloud Aquila diagnostics, this Activity provides controls for triggering test crashes and app-unresponsive checks.
en.disableEffect: Aquila’s manual crash diagnostics will no longer be available.

zh-CN.description: 用户手动打开 JD Cloud Aquila 诊断页面时，此 Activity 会提供触发测试崩溃和应用无响应检查的控件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Aquila 的手动崩溃诊断功能将无法使用。

en.description: When Aquila’s diagnostic screen starts a background test, this service runs the requested Java or native crash test in a separate process.
en.disableEffect: Aquila’s background crash-test option will no longer run.

zh-CN.description: Aquila 诊断页面启动后台测试时，此 Service 会在独立进程中执行指定的 Java 或原生崩溃测试。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Aquila 的后台崩溃测试将无法运行。

en.description: When Google Cloud Messaging delivers a message or send-status event, this Jdroid Framework service forwards it to the app’s configured message listener.
en.disableEffect: The app will stop receiving these GCM messages and send-status callbacks through Jdroid.

zh-CN.description: Google Cloud Messaging 送达消息或发送状态事件时，Jdroid Framework 的此服务会将事件交给应用配置的消息处理器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用将无法通过 Jdroid 接收这些 GCM 消息和发送状态回调。

en.description: When a legacy Google Cloud Messaging message broadcast arrives, this receiver hands it to Jdroid Framework’s push-processing service.
en.disableEffect: Jdroid will no longer process incoming GCM messages through this broadcast path.

zh-CN.description: 旧版 Google Cloud Messaging 消息广播送达时，此接收器会将消息交给 Jdroid Framework 推送处理服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Jdroid 将无法通过此广播入口处理 GCM 消息。

en.description: Jdroid Framework schedules this service during GCM setup to obtain a device registration token, register it with the app’s server, and subscribe to configured topics.
en.disableEffect: The app may not register or refresh its GCM subscription, so those push notifications may stop arriving.

zh-CN.description: Jdroid Framework 配置 GCM 推送时会安排此服务：它获取设备注册令牌、向应用服务器注册令牌，并订阅已配置的主题。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用可能无法注册或更新 GCM 订阅，从而收不到相关推送。

en.description: When Jdroid Framework receives a GCM push, it starts this service to identify the message type and pass valid messages to the app’s configured handler.
en.disableEffect: Jdroid GCM messages will no longer reach the app’s handler.

zh-CN.description: Jdroid Framework 收到 GCM 推送时会启动此服务；服务会识别消息类型，并将有效消息交给应用配置的处理器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Jdroid GCM 消息将无法交给应用处理。

en.description: When Android’s locale changes, this receiver asks Jdroid Framework to refresh GCM registration.
en.disableEffect: The app’s GCM registration will not be refreshed after a locale change.

zh-CN.description: Android 系统语言发生变化时，此接收器会让 Jdroid Framework 更新 GCM 注册。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，系统语言变化时应用的 GCM 注册将不会更新。

en.description: When the app starts a Jedlix connection session, this Activity opens the web-based connection flow and returns the session result to the app.
en.disableEffect: Users will no longer be able to complete a Jedlix connection session from the app.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动 Jedlix 连接会话时，此 Activity 会打开网页连接流程，并将会话结果返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法在应用中完成 Jedlix 连接会话。

en.description: When the app starts a Jenga payment or redirect, this Finserve payment SDK screen loads the supplied payment page and displays its title.
en.disableEffect: The app's Jenga payment flow will not open.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动 Jenga 支付或跳转时，Finserve 支付 SDK 会加载指定的支付页面并显示页面标题。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用的 Jenga 支付流程将无法打开。

en.description: GloballyDynamic (Jeppeman) uses this component when a user cancels a module installation from its download notification. It sends the cancellation back to the installation flow.
en.disableEffect: The cancel action on a module download notification may no longer stop that installation.

zh-CN.description: GloballyDynamic（Jeppeman）的自托管模块交付 SDK 会在用户从下载通知中取消模块安装时处理取消请求，并将取消结果交回安装流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 下载通知中的取消操作可能无法停止模块安装。

en.description: When GloballyDynamic starts an on-demand module installation, this service tracks its progress and shows a notification with the current status and a cancel option.
en.disableEffect: On-demand modules may not install through this SDK, and their download progress notification will be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: GloballyDynamic 开始安装按需模块后，此服务会跟踪进度，并显示状态和取消选项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法通过此 SDK 安装按需模块，也不会显示安装进度通知。

en.description: After Android reports the result of a GloballyDynamic module installation, this receiver passes success or failure back to the app and can reopen the app when the installation requires a restart.
en.disableEffect: Module installations may not finish correctly, and the app may not reopen when an installation requires a restart.

zh-CN.description: Android 报告 GloballyDynamic 的模块安装结果后，此接收器会将成功或失败状态交回应用；如果安装需要重启，还会重新打开应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 模块安装可能无法正常完成；安装后需要重启时，应用也可能不会重新打开。

en.description: When a GloballyDynamic module install needs permission to install packages, this screen asks the user to confirm and opens Android settings to allow installs from the app.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot grant the required install permission through GloballyDynamic, so affected modules cannot be installed.

zh-CN.description: GloballyDynamic 安装模块需要安装权限时，此页面会请用户确认，并打开 Android 设置以允许此应用安装内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法通过 GloballyDynamic 授予所需安装权限，因此相关模块无法安装。

en.description: LocallyDynamic (Jeppeman) receives Android's result after installing a local module package, passes it back to the installation flow, and can reopen the app when needed.
en.disableEffect: Local module installations may not finish or activate correctly.

zh-CN.description: LocallyDynamic（Jeppeman）安装本地模块包后，此接收器会接收 Android 返回的结果并交回安装流程；需要时还会重新打开应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 本地模块安装可能无法完成或正确启用。

en.description: JetBeep's iBeacon SDK processes Bluetooth scan results, recognizes nearby beacons, and reports beacon and telemetry information to the app for proximity features.
en.disableEffect: The app loses JetBeep beacon detections and any nearby-device features that depend on them.

zh-CN.description: JetBeep iBeacon SDK 会处理蓝牙扫描结果、识别附近的信标，并把信标和相关数据交给应用，支持基于距离的功能。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法收到 JetBeep 的信标发现结果，依赖附近设备的功能可能无法使用。

en.description: JetBeep starts this service with its background manager. When the user removes the app from the recent-apps screen, JetBeep uses it to stop foreground beacon scanning.
en.disableEffect: JetBeep's foreground beacon scan may continue after the user swipes the app away.

zh-CN.description: JetBeep 会随后台管理器启动此服务；用户从最近任务中划掉应用时，SDK 会通过它停止前台信标扫描。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户划掉应用后，JetBeep 的前台信标扫描可能仍会继续。

en.description: JetBeep's iBeacon SDK invokes this receiver for a scheduled alarm and at device startup; in version 1.11.23 it only records a debug message.
en.disableEffect: No user-visible change is apparent from disabling this component in the analyzed version.

zh-CN.description: JetBeep 的 iBeacon SDK 会在定时提醒或设备启动时调用此接收器；在 1.11.23 版本中，它只记录一条调试信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 在分析的版本中，停用它看不出会造成用户可见的变化。

en.description: Before Android 8, JetBeep starts this service to scan for nearby Bluetooth beacons in the background and report detections to the app. It pauses or resumes scanning when Bluetooth is turned off or on.
en.disableEffect: Background beacon detection will stop on these Android versions, so app features that depend on nearby devices will not update.

zh-CN.description: 在 Android 8 之前，JetBeep 会启动此服务，在后台扫描附近的蓝牙信标并把发现结果交给应用；蓝牙关闭或重新打开时，它会暂停或恢复扫描。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 这些 Android 版本上的后台信标检测将停止，依赖附近设备的功能也无法更新。

en.description: When Android reports that Bluetooth has been turned off or back on, JetBeep asks its background scanner to stop or resume. This keeps nearby-beacon features in step with Bluetooth availability.
en.disableEffect: Beacon scanning may not resume after Bluetooth is turned back on, so nearby-device features can stop working.

zh-CN.description: Android 报告蓝牙关闭或重新打开时，JetBeep 会通知后台扫描器停止或恢复扫描，让附近信标功能随蓝牙状态变化。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 蓝牙重新打开后，信标扫描可能无法自动恢复，依赖附近设备的功能可能停止。

en.description: The Harshit Jee Jio PG test package includes a sample screen that can open from the app icon; it shows a basic toolbar and a button with a placeholder message.
en.disableEffect: Disabling this entry removes the sample launch screen; if the app has no other home-screen entry, users cannot open it from the app icon.

zh-CN.description: Harshit Jee 的 Jio PG 测试包包含一个可从应用图标打开的示例页面，其中有基础工具栏和显示占位消息的按钮。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，此示例启动页面会被移除；如果应用没有其他桌面入口，用户将无法通过应用图标打开它。

en.description: The JioPay Payment Gateway SDK opens this checkout screen when the app begins a payment. It loads JioPay's payment page in an embedded browser, handles returns from UPI apps, and sends the result or error back to the app.
en.disableEffect: JioPay checkout will not open, so payments using this flow cannot be completed or returned to the app.

zh-CN.description: JioPay 支付网关 SDK 在应用发起付款时打开此结算界面。它会在内嵌浏览器中加载 JioPay 支付页面、处理 UPI 应用返回结果，并将付款结果或错误交回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，JioPay 结算界面无法打开，使用此流程的付款将无法完成或将结果返回应用。

en.description: The JioPay Payment Gateway SDK opens this checkout screen for an app payment. It loads the hosted payment page in an embedded browser, may request location access for the older flow, and reports payment results to the app.
en.disableEffect: JioPay checkout will not open, so payments using this flow cannot be completed or returned to the app.

zh-CN.description: JioPay 支付网关 SDK 在应用付款时打开此结算界面。它会在内嵌浏览器中加载托管支付页面；旧版流程还可能请求位置信息，并将付款结果返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，JioPay 结算界面无法打开，使用此流程的付款将无法完成或将结果返回应用。

en.description: Jackson Liao’s ImageSelect library opens this Activity to preview selected media one item at a time and let the user change selections before returning.
en.disableEffect: The app’s full-screen media preview and selection confirmation through ImageSelect will not work.

zh-CN.description: Jackson Liao 的 ImageSelect 库会在此逐项预览已选媒体，用户可调整选择后返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用通过 ImageSelect 使用的全屏媒体预览和确认选择流程将无法使用。

en.description: ImageSelect uses this Activity to browse a supplied set of full-size images one by one and show the current image number.
en.disableEffect: Full-screen browsing of images through ImageSelect will be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: ImageSelect 用此 Activity 逐张浏览一组大图，并显示当前图片序号。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过 ImageSelect 全屏浏览图片的功能将无法使用。

en.description: When an app requests image or video selection, ImageSelect shows a media picker where users can choose from storage or capture media, then returns the results to the app.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot use ImageSelect to choose or capture photos and videos.

zh-CN.description: 应用发起图片或视频选择时，ImageSelect 会显示媒体选择器；用户可从存储中选择或拍摄媒体，完成后结果会返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法通过 ImageSelect 选择或拍摄照片和视频。

en.description: Jiangyy AppUpdate uses this file-sharing provider to give Android's installer access to a downloaded update package.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot hand the downloaded package to Android for installation, so in-app updates fail.

zh-CN.description: Jiangyy AppUpdate 使用此文件共享组件，让 Android 安装程序能够读取已下载的更新包。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用无法将下载的更新包交给 Android 安装，因此应用内更新会失败。

en.description: Jiangyy AppUpdate starts this service to download an app update, report progress, and optionally open the installation screen when the download finishes.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot download updates through Jiangyy AppUpdate.

zh-CN.description: Jiangyy AppUpdate 会启动此服务下载应用更新包、报告进度，并可在下载完成后打开安装页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用无法通过 Jiangyy AppUpdate 下载更新。

en.description: Jiangyy's ZXing scanner opens a camera preview to scan a barcode or QR code and return the result to the app.
en.disableEffect: Barcode and QR-code scanning through this library will not be available.

zh-CN.description: Jiangyy 的 ZXing 扫码库会打开相机画面，扫描条形码或二维码，并把结果返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法使用此库提供的条形码和二维码扫描页面。

en.description: Jibo App Toolkit opens the sign-in web page supplied by the app and handles the return from Jibo robot-account authentication.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot complete Jibo account sign-in through the app.

zh-CN.description: Jibo App Toolkit 会打开应用提供的网页来登录 Jibo 账户，并处理认证返回结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法通过此应用完成 Jibo 账户登录。

en.description: This Jieli permission helper hosts Android's runtime permission prompt and returns the grant result to the requesting app.
en.disableEffect: Callers that use this helper cannot complete Android runtime permission requests through it if the component is disabled.

zh-CN.description: 这是 Jieli 权限组件提供的辅助页面，用于承载 Android 运行时权限提示，并将授权结果返回给调用方。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，使用此权限组件的调用方无法通过它完成 Android 运行时权限申请。

en.description: When the Easy Http Android inspection tool opens its cookie screen, this Activity lists saved cookies by host and lets users clear them.
en.disableEffect: Users lose the cookie inspection and clear screen.

zh-CN.description: 打开 Easy Http Android 检查工具的 Cookie 页面时，这个 Activity 会按主机列出已保存的 Cookie，并允许用户清除它们。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法查看或清除 Cookie。

en.description: When Easy Http Android opens its request history, this Activity lists captured HTTP calls, supports searching and clearing the list, and opens the cookie screen.
en.disableEffect: Users lose the request-history screen and its search and clear controls.

zh-CN.description: Easy Http Android 打开请求记录时，这个 Activity 会列出捕获的 HTTP 请求，支持搜索和清空记录，也能打开 Cookie 页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法查看请求记录，也无法使用搜索和清空功能。

en.description: When a user selects a captured request, Easy Http Android opens this Activity to show its summary, request data, and response data.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot inspect the selected request's details.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择一条已捕获的请求时，Easy Http Android 会打开这个 Activity，显示请求摘要、请求数据和响应数据。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法查看所选请求的详细信息。

en.description: JioPay's AutoRead OTP helper starts this background service for a payment transaction. It checks transaction status every 20 seconds for up to five minutes and sends a success or failure update to the app.
en.disableEffect: The app will not receive status updates from this automatic check or use them to finish its payment confirmation flow.

zh-CN.description: JioPay AutoRead OTP 辅助库会为付款交易启动此后台服务。它最长运行五分钟、每隔约二十秒查询一次交易状态，并向应用发送成功或失败结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用无法收到此自动查询的交易状态更新，也无法用它完成付款确认流程。

en.description: Jivo Chat uses this private Provider to share chat logs and camera photos, and to prepare file-based notification sounds. It gives Android or another app access to those files.
en.disableEffect: Sharing Jivo chat logs or photos and loading file-based notification sounds can fail.

zh-CN.description: Jivo 客服聊天 SDK 会通过此私有 Provider 分享聊天日志和拍摄的照片，也会用它准备基于文件的通知提示音。它让 Android 或其他应用能够读取这些文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 分享 Jivo 聊天日志或照片，以及加载基于文件的通知提示音，都可能失败。

en.description: At app startup, this Jivo Chat Provider registers callbacks for screen start and stop events so the SDK can track when the app moves between the foreground and background.
en.disableEffect: Jivo will no longer receive these app foreground and background changes for its chat lifecycle handling.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，Jivo 客服聊天 SDK 的此 Provider 会注册页面启动和停止回调，以跟踪应用何时进入前台或后台。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Jivo 将无法再通过这些回调感知应用的前后台切换，聊天相关的生命周期处理会受到影响。

en.description: Jivo Chat starts this Service to load chat settings and open, reconnect, or stop the connection that carries live support messages.
en.disableEffect: The Jivo support chat will not be able to connect to agents or send and receive live messages.

zh-CN.description: Jivo 客服聊天 SDK 会启动此 Service 来加载聊天设置，并建立、重连或停止传送实时客服消息的连接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Jivo 客服聊天将无法连接客服人员，也无法收发实时消息。

en.description: When a user opens a Jivo support conversation, including from a Jivo message notification, this Activity displays the chat screen.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to open the Jivo support conversation screen, including from its message notifications.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 Jivo 客服会话时（包括点击 Jivo 消息通知），此 Activity 会显示聊天界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开 Jivo 客服会话界面，也无法通过 Jivo 消息通知进入会话。

en.description: When a user opens an image from Jivo chat, this Activity displays it full-screen and offers download and copy actions.
en.disableEffect: Users will lose Jivo chat full-screen image viewing and its image download and copy options.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 Jivo 聊天中的图片时，此 Activity 会全屏显示图片，并提供下载和复制选项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在 Jivo 聊天中全屏查看图片，也无法使用图片下载和复制选项。

en.description: Jixie Player Android SDK opens its video player for videos supplied by the app and can display a configured advertising placement in that player.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot use this screen to play its videos or display its configured ads.

zh-CN.description: Jixie Player Android SDK 会为应用提供的视频打开播放页面，并可在播放器中显示已配置的广告位。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法通过此页面播放视频或显示配置的广告。

en.description: The JJL DXZ Open Platform meeting SDK opens this transparent Activity when screen sharing starts. It asks Android for screen-capture permission and returns the user's choice to the SDK.
en.disableEffect: The SDK cannot obtain screen-capture permission, so meeting screen sharing cannot start.

zh-CN.description: JJL DXZ Open Platform 会议 SDK 在开始屏幕共享时打开此透明界面，请求 Android 的屏幕录制权限，并将用户的选择交回 SDK。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，SDK 无法取得屏幕录制权限，会议屏幕共享无法启动。

en.description: The JJL DXZ Open Platform meeting SDK runs this foreground service in a separate process while a meeting shares the screen. It captures display frames, sends them into the meeting, and responds to sharing start and stop controls.
en.disableEffect: Screen sharing during a meeting will not start or continue.

zh-CN.description: 会议进行屏幕共享时，JJL DXZ Open Platform SDK 会在独立进程中运行此前台服务。它采集屏幕画面并发送到会议中，同时处理共享的开始和停止操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，会议中的屏幕共享将无法开始或继续。

en.description: Android creates this provider at app startup to save the application context for the JJL DXZ Open Platform meeting SDK. The SDK uses that context to create its meeting engine and screen-sharing views.
en.disableEffect: The SDK loses the application context it uses to create meetings and screen-sharing views.

zh-CN.description: Android 会在应用启动时创建此内容提供器，为 JJL DXZ Open Platform 会议 SDK 保存应用上下文。SDK 会用该上下文创建会议引擎和屏幕共享画面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，SDK 将无法取得创建会议和屏幕共享画面所需的应用上下文。

en.description: The JJL DXZ Open Platform SDK opens this transparent Activity when screen sharing starts. It asks Android for screen-capture permission and returns the user's choice to the SDK.
en.disableEffect: The SDK cannot obtain screen-capture permission, so meeting screen sharing cannot start.

zh-CN.description: JJL DXZ Open Platform SDK 在开始屏幕共享时打开此透明界面，请求 Android 的屏幕录制权限，并将用户的选择交回 SDK。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，SDK 无法取得屏幕录制权限，会议屏幕共享无法启动。

en.description: The JJL DXZ Open Platform SDK runs this foreground service in a separate process while a meeting shares the screen. It captures display frames, sends them into the meeting, and responds to sharing start and stop controls.
en.disableEffect: Screen sharing during a meeting will not start or continue.

zh-CN.description: 会议进行屏幕共享时，JJL DXZ Open Platform SDK 会在独立进程中运行此前台服务。它采集屏幕画面并发送到会议中，同时处理共享的开始和停止操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，会议中的屏幕共享将无法开始或继续。

en.description: Android creates this provider at app startup to save the application context for the JJL DXZ Open Platform SDK. The SDK uses that context to create its meeting engine and screen-sharing views.
en.disableEffect: The SDK loses the application context it uses to create meetings and screen-sharing views.

zh-CN.description: Android 会在应用启动时创建此内容提供器，为 JJL DXZ Open Platform SDK 保存应用上下文。SDK 会用该上下文创建会议引擎和屏幕共享画面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，SDK 将无法取得创建会议和屏幕共享画面所需的应用上下文。

en.description: JKhanTechnoPhile's MyFirstExternalLibrary opens a sample page containing a welcome message from the library.
en.disableEffect: The sample welcome page will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: JKhanTechnoPhile 的 MyFirstExternalLibrary 会打开一个示例页面，显示来自该库的欢迎文字。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，这个示例欢迎页面将无法打开。

en.description: Jmolsmobile’s Landscape Video Capture library opens this landscape camera screen when the app requests a recording. It records a video and returns the saved file when the user accepts it.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot use this screen to record and return landscape videos.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求录制视频时，Jmolsmobile 的 Landscape Video Capture 库会打开此横屏相机页面。它负责录制视频，并在用户确认后返回保存的文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用无法通过此页面录制并返回横屏视频。

en.description: When Tasker triggers an action provided by the app, this Tasker Plugin Library Receiver forwards it for processing.
en.disableEffect: Tasker actions that rely on this app integration will no longer run.
