en.description: AgentWeb uses this helper when a web page requests a file chooser, camera or video capture, or a permission prompt.
en.disableEffect: Web pages using AgentWeb may lose file selection, camera or video capture, and permission prompts.

zh-CN.description: AgentWeb 在网页请求文件选择、拍照或录像，或申请权限时使用此辅助页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用 AgentWeb 的网页可能无法选择文件、拍照录像或显示权限请求。

en.description: Justson AgentWeb uses this file component when its WebView passes local files to other Android apps to open or share.
en.disableEffect: File operations that rely on AgentWeb file links, such as opening or sharing a downloaded file, may fail.

zh-CN.description: Justson AgentWeb 的 WebView 将本地文件交给其他 Android 应用打开或分享时，会使用此文件组件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，依赖 AgentWeb 文件地址的操作（例如打开或分享已下载文件）可能失败。

en.description: When a page in Fly2Think's AgentWeb browser requests an image upload, the photo picker returns selected files through this provider as temporary links the page can read.
en.disableEffect: Web pages in the app cannot receive selected photos for upload.

zh-CN.description: Fly2Think AgentWeb 浏览器中的网页请求上传图片时，照片选择器会通过此提供程序生成临时文件链接供网页读取。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用中的网页将无法获取用户选中的图片进行上传。

en.description: AgentWeb X5 uses this helper in its browser screen when a web page requests a file, photo, video, or related permission.
en.disableEffect: The SDK adds the helper inside the existing browser screen; its separate manifest Activity entry is unused, so disabling that entry leaves page file and camera requests available.

zh-CN.description: 网页请求选择文件、拍照、录像或相关权限时，AgentWeb X5 会在浏览器界面中使用此辅助功能。
zh-CN.disableEffect: SDK 会在现有浏览器界面中加入此辅助功能；单独的清单 Activity 注册项并未使用，因此停用该注册项后，网页文件和相机请求仍可用。

en.description: AgentWeb X5 uses this Provider to create shareable file links for photos and videos captured from a web page’s upload form.
en.disableEffect: Web uploads and camera or video capture can fail because the browser cannot provide Android with a shareable URI for the captured file.

zh-CN.description: AgentWeb X5 通过此 Provider 为网页上传表单拍摄的照片和视频创建可共享的文件链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 浏览器无法为拍摄的文件提供 Android 可共享的 URI，网页上传、拍照或录像流程可能失败。

en.description: Juphoon RTC, integrated by Rokid, opens Android's screen-capture permission prompt when screen sharing starts. After approval, the call can send the device screen to other participants.
en.disableEffect: Screen sharing cannot request capture permission, so participants cannot view the device screen in a call.

zh-CN.description: Rokid 集成的 Juphoon RTC 会在开始屏幕共享时打开 Android 的屏幕录制授权页。授权后，通话中的其他参与者才能看到设备屏幕。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后无法请求屏幕录制授权，因此通话中的其他参与者无法看到设备屏幕。

en.description: The JW Player Android SDK uses this foreground Service to process offline media downloads. Android can restart it with the SDK’s download restart request so queued downloads continue.
en.disableEffect: JW Player offline media downloads will not start or resume through this Service.

zh-CN.description: JW Player Android SDK 使用此前台服务处理媒体离线下载。Android 收到 SDK 的下载重启请求时可以重新启动该服务，让队列中的下载继续。
zh-CN.disableEffect: JW Player 媒体离线下载将无法通过此服务启动或继续。

en.description: Kakao AdFit creates this provider during app startup and passes the app context into its automatic SDK initialization. It runs in the background and has no screen of its own.
en.disableEffect: Kakao AdFit automatic startup initialization will not run, so ads that depend on it will not load.

zh-CN.description: Kakao AdFit 会在应用启动时创建此 Provider，并把应用上下文交给 SDK 自动初始化流程。它在后台运行，不会显示界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Kakao AdFit 的自动启动初始化将不会运行，依赖该初始化的广告也不会加载。

en.description: Kakao AdFit opens this Activity for an ad destination. It displays the destination page in the SDK’s in-app browser and lets the user navigate within it.
en.disableEffect: Tapping Kakao AdFit links will no longer open their in-app destination pages.

zh-CN.description: Kakao AdFit 会在用户打开广告落地页时启动此 Activity。它通过 SDK 内置浏览器显示页面，并允许用户在页面中浏览。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 点击 Kakao AdFit 广告链接后，将无法再通过应用内浏览器打开落地页。

en.description: The Kakao Android SDK uses this callback Activity to receive a login return link and forward it into the SDK authentication flow.
en.disableEffect: Kakao login will not return its result to the app through this callback.

zh-CN.description: Kakao Android SDK 使用此回调 Activity 接收登录返回链接，并将其交回 SDK 的认证流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Kakao 登录无法通过此回调把结果返回应用。

en.description: The Kakao Android SDK uses this callback Activity to receive an authorization-code return link and forward it into the SDK authentication flow.
en.disableEffect: Kakao authorization-code login will not return its result to the app through this callback.

zh-CN.description: Kakao Android SDK 使用此回调 Activity 接收授权码返回链接，并将其交回 SDK 的认证流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Kakao 授权码登录无法通过此回调把结果返回应用。

en.description: The Kakao Android SDK opens this Activity to show an account authorization page in a Chrome Custom Tab. When the browser returns to the app, it passes the result back to the login flow.
en.disableEffect: Kakao account sign-in through the browser will not complete.

zh-CN.description: Kakao Android SDK 会打开此 Activity，在 Chrome 自定义标签页中显示账号授权页面。浏览器返回应用后，此页面会把结果交回登录流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过浏览器进行的 Kakao 账号登录将无法完成。

en.description: The Kakao Android SDK starts this Activity to launch a KakaoTalk sign-in request and return its result to the app.
en.disableEffect: Sign-in through KakaoTalk will not complete.

zh-CN.description: Kakao Android SDK 会启动此 Activity，以发起 KakaoTalk 登录请求并把登录结果返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过 KakaoTalk 进行的登录将无法完成。

en.description: The Kakao Android SDK opens this full-screen Activity when an app requests the full-screen friend picker. It displays the screen used to choose Kakao friends.
en.disableEffect: Apps using Kakao friend selection will lose the full-screen picker.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求全屏好友选择器时，Kakao Android SDK 会打开此 Activity。它显示用于选择 Kakao 好友的全屏界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用 Kakao 好友选择功能的应用将无法打开全屏选择器。

en.description: The Kakao Android SDK opens this popup Activity when an app requests the popup friend picker. It displays the screen used to choose Kakao friends.
en.disableEffect: Apps using Kakao friend selection will lose the popup picker.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求弹出式好友选择器时，Kakao Android SDK 会打开此 Activity。它显示用于选择 Kakao 好友的弹出界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用 Kakao 好友选择功能的应用将无法打开弹出式选择器。

en.description: The Kakao Partner User SDK uses this callback Activity for returns from age verification. It forwards the returned link to the SDK browser callback flow.
en.disableEffect: The Kakao age-verification flow will not return to the app.

zh-CN.description: Kakao Partner User SDK 使用此回调 Activity 处理年龄验证后的返回链接，并将链接交给 SDK 的浏览器回调流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Kakao 年龄验证流程将无法把结果返回应用。

en.description: The Kakao Talk SDK uses this callback Activity when a channel-follow request returns to the app. It forwards the returned link to the SDK callback flow.
en.disableEffect: Following a Kakao channel through the SDK will not finish.

zh-CN.description: Kakao Talk SDK 会在频道关注请求返回应用时使用此回调 Activity，并将返回链接交给 SDK 的回调流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过 SDK 关注 Kakao 频道的操作将无法完成。

en.description: The Kakao Android SDK opens this Activity for its login choice screen. Users can continue with KakaoTalk or a Kakao account, and the selected login result returns to the app.
en.disableEffect: Kakao SDK login cannot open or return a result through this screen.

zh-CN.description: Kakao Android SDK 会打开此 Activity 显示登录方式选择界面。用户可以选择 KakaoTalk 或 Kakao 账号登录，登录结果会返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Kakao SDK 无法通过此界面打开登录流程或返回登录结果。

en.description: Kaltura MediaKexoplayer uses this service to restart a media service after Android’s scheduled network, charging, idle, or storage requirements are met.
en.disableEffect: Kaltura background downloads will not automatically resume when their scheduled requirements are met.

zh-CN.description: Kaltura MediaKexoplayer 使用此服务在 Android 设定的网络、充电、设备空闲或存储条件满足后重新启动媒体服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 达到调度条件时，Kaltura 后台下载将无法自动继续。

en.description: The Kaltura DTG library binds this Service to process media downloads requested by the app. It downloads regular or quality-adjusting streams, tracks progress, and supports pause and resume.
en.disableEffect: Kaltura offline downloads, including pausing and resuming them, will stop working.

zh-CN.description: Kaltura DTG 库会在应用请求媒体下载时绑定此服务。它下载普通或自适应码率媒体、跟踪进度，并支持暂停和继续。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Kaltura 媒体离线下载以及暂停和继续下载的功能将无法使用。

en.description: The Kaltura Player Android SDK uses this foreground Service for offline media downloads. It manages the download queue, shows progress notifications, and handles Android’s download restart request.
en.disableEffect: Kaltura offline media downloads will stop or fail to resume.

zh-CN.description: Kaltura Player Android SDK 使用此前台服务处理媒体离线下载。它管理下载队列、显示进度通知，并处理 Android 发来的下载重启请求。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Kaltura 媒体离线下载将停止或无法继续。

en.description: Karacca Beetle opens this Activity from its feedback form when a user chooses to edit a screenshot. Users can draw on the image and return the edited screenshot to the form.
en.disableEffect: The feedback form will no longer offer screenshot annotation.

zh-CN.description: 用户在反馈表单中选择编辑截图时，Karacca Beetle 会打开此 Activity。用户可以在图片上绘制标记，并把编辑后的截图交回表单。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 反馈表单将无法再提供截图标注功能。

en.description: Karacca Beetle opens this Activity as its in-app feedback form. It collects a title and description, can attach a screenshot and device details, and sends the report to the configured issue tracker.
en.disableEffect: The app’s Beetle feedback and issue-reporting screen will be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: Karacca Beetle 会打开此 Activity 作为应用内反馈表单。它收集标题和描述，可附加截图及设备信息，并将报告提交到配置的反馈项目。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用中的 Beetle 反馈和问题报告界面将无法使用。

en.description: The DialogLibs dialog library creates this Provider when the app starts and uses it to initialize its dialog manager.
en.disableEffect: DialogLibs dialogs may fail to initialize in apps that use this library.

zh-CN.description: DialogLibs 对话框库会在应用启动时创建此 Provider，并借此初始化对话框管理器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用该库的应用可能无法正常初始化 DialogLibs 对话框。

en.description: Karumi Dexter opens this screen when an app asks for runtime permissions through the library. It receives Android’s permission result so the app can continue with the requested feature.
en.disableEffect: Permission requests that use Dexter may fail, so features needing camera, storage, location, or other protected access may stop working.

zh-CN.description: 应用通过 Karumi Dexter 请求运行时权限时，会打开此界面。它接收 Android 返回的授权结果，供应用继续处理所请求的功能。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过 Dexter 发起的权限请求可能无法完成，依赖相机、存储、位置或其他受保护权限的功能也可能无法使用。

en.description: Dynckathline FilePicker uses this provider to create a shareable file link when its browser opens a document in another app, especially on Android 7 and later.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents the file picker from opening selected documents in other apps on Android 7 and later.

zh-CN.description: Dynckathline FilePicker 会在文件浏览器将文档交给其他应用打开时，通过此 Provider 创建可共享的文件链接，尤其用于 Android 7 及更高版本。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 在 Android 7 及更高版本中，禁用后文件选择器将无法把选中的文档交给其他应用打开。

en.description: Dynckathline FilePicker opens this Activity for its file-browser screen, where users browse folders, choose files, sort the list, and manage items.
en.disableEffect: The library’s file-browsing, selection, and file-management screen is unavailable.

zh-CN.description: Dynckathline FilePicker 会打开此 Activity 显示文件浏览界面，用户可浏览文件夹、选择文件、排序并管理文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 该库的文件浏览、选择和管理界面将无法使用。

en.description: When a user opens an image from Dynckathline FilePicker, this Activity displays the selected picture full-screen.
en.disableEffect: Users can no longer preview images inside this file picker.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Dynckathline FilePicker 中打开图片时，此 Activity 会全屏显示所选图片。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在此文件选择器中预览图片。

en.description: Dynckathline FilePicker opens this screen for QQ or WeChat files; its tabs browse pictures, videos, text files, and other documents and allow multi-file selection.
en.disableEffect: The QQ and WeChat file browser and its multi-file selection screen are unavailable.

zh-CN.description: Dynckathline FilePicker 会为 QQ 或微信文件打开此界面；其中的分页可浏览图片、视频、文本文件和其他文档，并支持多选。
zh-CN.disableEffect: QQ 和微信文件浏览及多文件选择界面将无法使用。

en.description: When a user opens a video from Dynckathline FilePicker, this Activity shows its preview and plays the file when the user presses play.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot preview or play videos inside this file picker.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Dynckathline FilePicker 中打开视频时，此 Activity 会显示预览，并在用户点击播放后播放文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在此文件选择器中预览或播放视频。

en.description: Android Multipicker uses this provider to make captured or selected photos and videos available to the app and other approved viewers. The picker creates these file links when it returns media to the calling app.
en.disableEffect: The picker may fail to return captured or selected photos and videos to the app.

zh-CN.description: Android Multipicker 通过此组件提供拍摄或选中的照片和视频，供应用及获准访问的查看程序使用。媒体选择器在把文件交回调用应用时会创建相应链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 媒体选择器可能无法把拍摄或选中的照片和视频交回应用。

en.description: When EasyPicker (4eRT) opens selected photos for review, this Activity displays them in a swipeable preview starting at the chosen image.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot preview selected photos before continuing in the picker.

zh-CN.description: EasyPicker（4eRT）打开已选照片供用户查看时，此 Activity 会以可滑动方式显示照片，并从当前选择的图片开始。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法在继续操作前预览已选照片。

en.description: The lgsg andcommon library receives new and removed system notifications after the user grants notification access, then passes them to the app’s registered listener.
en.disableEffect: App features that rely on these notification updates will stop receiving them.

zh-CN.description: 用户授予通知读取权限后，lgsg andcommon 会接收系统通知的新增和移除事件，并交给应用注册的接收器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖这些通知更新的应用功能将无法再收到通知变化。

en.description: LGSG andcommon starts this notification-listening service when the app requests it and Android grants notification access; it forwards new and removed notification events to the app.
en.disableEffect: The app will stop receiving notification events through this listener.

zh-CN.description: LGSG andcommon 会在应用请求监听通知且获得系统授权后启动此服务，并把新收到和移除的通知事件交给应用处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法通过此监听服务接收通知变化。

en.description: The AlbumManager image and video picker opens this screen when an app requests local media. It lists albums, can launch the camera, and returns the selected items.
en.disableEffect: The app loses the AlbumManager media picker, so selecting local photos or videos through it no longer works.

zh-CN.description: 应用通过 AlbumManager 图片和视频选择库请求本地媒体时，会打开此页面。页面列出相册、可启动相机，并返回选中的项目。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，AlbumManager 媒体选择器不可用，应用无法通过它选择本地照片或视频。

en.description: AlbumManager opens this screen from its media picker to preview selected photos or videos, adjust the selection, and return the chosen items.
en.disableEffect: The AlbumManager selection flow can no longer review or confirm selected media.

zh-CN.description: AlbumManager 会从媒体选择器打开此页面，供用户预览已选照片或视频、调整选择并返回所选项目。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，AlbumManager 选择流程无法预览或确认已选媒体。

en.description: This AlbumManager activity displays the current media selection in a swipeable photo and video preview and lets the user update selected items.
en.disableEffect: The media preview and selection path provided by this activity becomes unavailable.

zh-CN.description: AlbumManager 使用此页面以可滑动的方式预览当前照片和视频，并更新已选项目。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，此页面提供的媒体预览和选择流程不可用。

en.description: Keyri QR login opens this screen to request camera access and scan a sign-in code. It sends the scanned link to Keyri to complete authentication.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to complete sign-in through Keyri QR authentication.

zh-CN.description: Keyri 二维码登录会打开此界面并请求相机权限，以扫描登录码。扫描到的链接会交给 Keyri 完成身份验证。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 Keyri 二维码验证完成登录。

en.description: The Khalti payment SDK opens this screen when the app starts its payment flow. It displays the payment page and returns control to the app when the flow closes.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to complete payments through this Khalti payment flow.

zh-CN.description: 应用开始 Khalti 支付流程时，Khalti 支付 SDK 会打开此界面并显示支付页面。流程关闭后，界面会把控制权交还应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此 Khalti 支付流程完成付款。

en.description: Khalti opens this checkout screen to show the available payment options and collect a payment. It loads the selected option and handles the checkout flow.
en.disableEffect: The app’s Khalti checkout and payment flow will not be available.

zh-CN.description: Khalti 会打开此结账界面，展示可用的付款方式并收取款项。界面会加载用户选中的方式并处理结账流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法使用 Khalti 结账和支付流程。

en.description: The newer Khalti Checkout SDK opens this screen to display and handle its payment flow. It closes the payment screen when checkout finishes or is cancelled.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to complete payments through the newer Khalti Checkout flow.

zh-CN.description: 较新的 Khalti Checkout SDK 会打开此界面显示并处理支付流程。结账完成或取消时，界面会关闭支付页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过较新的 Khalti Checkout 流程完成付款。

en.description: After an e-banking handoff, this exported Khalti screen receives supported VIEW links and reads the returned banking data. It then closes when the payment handoff is handled.
en.disableEffect: A return from an e-banking app may not reach Khalti, leaving that payment handoff unfinished.

zh-CN.description: 通过电子银行跳转付款后，此 Khalti 界面会接收受支持的 VIEW 链接并读取银行返回的数据。处理完付款跳转后，界面会关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 电子银行应用可能无法把结果返回 Khalti，导致该支付跳转无法完成。

en.description: The Kidoz Android ad SDK opens this full-screen activity to show an interstitial or rewarded video ad, starting or resuming playback when it appears.
en.disableEffect: Kidoz full-screen ads will not open; if the app uses rewarded ads, watching one will no longer grant its reward.

zh-CN.description: Kidoz Android 广告 SDK 会打开此全屏界面展示插屏广告或激励视频广告，并在界面显示时开始或恢复播放。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Kidoz 全屏广告无法打开；如果应用使用激励广告，观看广告后将不再发放奖励。

en.description: UnitySdk by Gokul Sukumar opens this screen when the app sends the user to its embedded Unity content. It displays the game full screen and accepts touch and key input.
en.disableEffect: The game or interactive screen that uses this activity will not open.

zh-CN.description: 当应用内部打开此界面时，Gokul Sukumar 发布的 UnitySdk 会显示全屏 Unity 内容，并接收玩家的触控和按键操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 屏蔽后，使用此界面的游戏或交互内容将无法打开。

en.description: KimIpc (Wengliuhu) uses this bound service for messages exchanged between app processes. When an IPC client connects, the service passes incoming messages to the app's registered listeners.
en.disableEffect: App features that exchange messages through KimIpc will no longer be able to receive them through this service.

zh-CN.description: KimIpc（Wengliuhu）使用此绑定 Service 传递应用进程之间的消息。客户端连接后，Service 会把收到的消息交给应用中已注册的监听方。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖 KimIpc 进行消息通信的应用功能将无法再通过此 Service 收到消息。

en.description: KimIpc (Wengliuhu) installs this provider at app startup to prepare its process messaging and event subscriptions. It also connects marked event handlers when lifecycle-aware screens are created.
en.disableEffect: KimIpc messaging and automatic screen-event subscriptions will not be initialized, which can break app features that depend on them.

zh-CN.description: KimIpc（Wengliuhu）会在应用启动时安装此 Provider，以准备进程间消息通信和事件订阅。创建支持生命周期的页面时，它还会连接已标记的事件处理方法。
zh-CN.disableEffect: KimIpc 消息通信和页面事件订阅将不会自动初始化，依赖它们的应用功能可能无法正常工作。

en.description: Kindred’s Browser SDK opens this Activity for onboarding and offer pages. It loads the pages inside the app and can send users to sign-in, accessibility settings, or an external offer link.
en.disableEffect: Kindred onboarding, account sign-in, and offer pages will no longer open in the app.

zh-CN.description: Kindred 的 Browser SDK 会通过此 Activity 打开引导和优惠页面，并可将用户带到登录页面、无障碍设置或外部优惠链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用内的 Kindred 引导、账户登录和优惠页面将无法打开。

en.description: Kinexcs MOVE opens this screen for a guided exercise session selected in the host app. It uses the camera to track movements and count repetitions, then saves and syncs the session results.
en.disableEffect: The guided exercise session and its recorded results will not work.

zh-CN.description: 用户在应用中选择 Kinexcs MOVE 训练后，此界面会开启指导式运动流程。它使用相机追踪动作并计数，随后保存并同步训练结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 指导式运动流程及其训练结果记录将无法使用。

en.description: Jenly AppUpdater uses this provider after an update APK has been downloaded so Android's installer can read the file. It shares the update file through a temporary content link.
en.disableEffect: The updater cannot hand its downloaded APK to Android's installer, so the update installation flow can fail.

zh-CN.description: Jenly AppUpdater 会在下载更新 APK 后通过此文件提供方让 Android 安装程序读取文件，并为安装提供临时内容链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 更新程序无法将下载的 APK 交给 Android 安装程序，因此更新安装流程可能失败。

en.description: Jenly AppUpdater starts this service when the app requests or retries an update download. It downloads the APK, reports progress, and can open Android’s installer when the download finishes.
en.disableEffect: The app’s in-app update flow cannot download or install updates while this service is disabled.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求或重试下载更新时，Jenly AppUpdater 会启动此服务。它负责下载 APK、报告进度，并可在下载完成后打开 Android 安装程序。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用此服务后，应用内的更新流程无法下载或安装更新。

en.description: Jenly BaseUrlManager initializes during app startup and loads the saved server address and available address choices. Other app code uses this state for server switching and requests configured with the selected address.
en.disableEffect: The saved server address will not be initialized, so apps using BaseUrlManager can lose server switching or requests to the selected endpoint.

zh-CN.description: Jenly BaseUrlManager 会在应用启动时初始化，并加载已保存的服务器地址和可选地址。应用的其他代码可用这些数据切换服务器，或使用所选地址发送请求。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 已保存的服务器地址将无法初始化；使用 BaseUrlManager 的应用可能无法切换服务器或访问所选服务端。

en.description: Jenly ImageViewer opens this screen when the app requests a full-screen image gallery. It shows the supplied images in a swipeable viewer with an optional position counter.
en.disableEffect: The app's full-screen image-viewing feature will be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求全屏查看图片时，Jenly ImageViewer 会打开此页面。页面以可滑动的方式展示传入图片，并可显示当前页数。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法使用 Jenly ImageViewer 的全屏图片查看功能。

en.description: Jenly AppPay's WeChat Pay integration receives this activity when the user returns from WeChat after a payment attempt. It passes the payment result back to the app.
en.disableEffect: The app will not receive the WeChat payment result, which can leave its payment flow incomplete.

zh-CN.description: 用户完成或取消支付并从微信返回后，Jenly AppPay 的微信支付集成会通过此页面接收结果，并将支付状态交还应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法收到微信支付结果，支付流程可能无法完成。

en.description: Sher-gil Media Picker shows photo and video albums so users can select and preview media before returning it to the app. When enabled, the picker can also open the camera.
en.disableEffect: The app’s Sher-gil media-selection and camera-capture flow will not be available.

zh-CN.description: Sher-gil 媒体选择器会显示照片和视频相册，供用户选择和预览媒体，再交回应用。如果启用了拍摄功能，选择器也可以打开相机。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用中的 Sher-gil 媒体选择和相机拍摄流程将无法使用。

en.description: The bin0801 launch library uses this transparent screen when an app opens another screen and needs to return its result to the original caller.
en.disableEffect: App flows that depend on a result from another screen may fail to complete.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开其他页面并需要接收其返回结果时，bin0801 launch 库会使用此透明页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖其他页面返回结果的应用流程可能无法完成。

en.description: When a customer opens Klarna On-demand purchase preferences, this screen loads the saved settings for their Klarna account.
en.disableEffect: Customers will not be able to view or manage their Klarna On-demand purchase preferences in the app.

zh-CN.description: 顾客打开 Klarna 按需购买偏好设置时，此界面会加载其账户中已保存的购买设置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 顾客将无法在应用中查看或管理 Klarna 按需购买偏好设置。

en.description: During Klarna On-demand registration, this screen displays the sign-up page and returns the customer to the app when registration completes.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to register for or start using Klarna On-demand purchases in the app.

zh-CN.description: 进行 Klarna 按需购买注册时，此界面会显示注册页面，并在注册完成后把结果交回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在应用中注册或开始使用 Klarna 按需购买服务。

en.description: The Klinker Android SMS/MMS library uses this Provider to open cached files when building MMS messages or handling downloaded MMS media. It reads or writes the requested file in the app cache.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents MMS media files from being read or written through the provider, so sending or opening MMS attachments can fail.

zh-CN.description: Klinker Android SMS/MMS 库会通过此 Provider 打开缓存文件，用于创建彩信或处理下载的彩信媒体。它会读取或写入应用缓存中的指定文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用无法通过此 Provider 读写彩信媒体文件，发送或打开彩信附件可能会失败。

en.description: Pinned ChangeHost opens this settings screen from its floating shortcut so a user can choose or enter the app's service address and port. Applying a new address clears the app's local data.
en.disableEffect: The service address cannot be changed through this screen, and the floating shortcut will no longer open its settings page.

zh-CN.description: Pinned 的 ChangeHost 会从悬浮快捷入口打开此设置界面，让用户选择或输入应用的服务地址和端口；应用新地址时会清除本地数据。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此界面更改应用的服务地址或端口，悬浮快捷入口也无法再打开设置页。

en.description: When the app starts this Pinned ChangeHost service, it displays a floating shortcut that opens the service-address settings.
en.disableEffect: The floating shortcut disappears, while the app's other screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动 Pinned 的 ChangeHost 服务时，会显示一个可打开服务地址设置的悬浮快捷入口。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 悬浮快捷入口会消失，但应用的其他界面仍可使用。

en.description: BlockCanaryX FlameGraph displays a saved performance profile as a flame graph with its sampling interval.
en.disableEffect: The saved performance profile can no longer be viewed as a flame graph.

zh-CN.description: BlockCanaryX FlameGraph 会将保存的性能分析记录及其采样间隔显示为火焰图。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 保存的性能分析记录将无法以火焰图形式查看。

en.description: When Google Play sends an install-referrer broadcast, the Kochava Tracker SDK records the referral information once for campaign attribution.
en.disableEffect: Kochava will not receive this install-referrer broadcast, so attribution for installs from those campaigns may be missing.

zh-CN.description: Google Play 发送安装来源广播时，Kochava Tracker SDK 会记录安装来源信息，用于广告活动归因。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Kochava 将收不到此安装来源广播，因此可能无法记录这些活动带来的安装归因。

en.description: When Kochava's optional Location SDK receives a location-update or geofence broadcast, this Receiver passes it to the location tracker for processing.
en.disableEffect: Kochava location updates and geofence events will no longer be processed by this SDK component.

zh-CN.description: Kochava 可选 Location SDK 收到位置更新或地理围栏广播时，此 Receiver 会将事件交给位置追踪器处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 此 SDK 组件将不再处理 Kochava 的位置更新和地理围栏事件。

en.description: When Google Play sends the older install-referrer broadcast, Kochava's Legacy Referrer add-on reads the referral string and registers it with the tracker for attribution.
en.disableEffect: Kochava will no longer capture install attribution delivered through the legacy Play broadcast.

zh-CN.description: Google Play 发送旧版安装来源广播时，Kochava Legacy Referrer 插件会读取来源字符串并将其登记到追踪器中用于归因。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Kochava 将无法再捕获通过旧版 Play 广播传递的安装归因信息。

en.description: The Kontakt.io SDK receives Bluetooth scan results in the background and forwards discovered devices to the app when a scan callback arrives.
en.disableEffect: App features that rely on Kontakt.io background device or beacon discovery will stop receiving scan results.

zh-CN.description: Kontakt.io SDK 收到后台蓝牙扫描回调时，会将发现的设备结果转交给应用处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖 Kontakt.io 在后台发现设备或信标的应用功能将无法继续接收扫描结果。

en.description: When an app opens Kovac Ivan's SplashScreenHelper with its display settings, this Activity shows the configured text, images, progress indicator, or video and then calls the completion callback before closing.
en.disableEffect: The configured splash screen and its completion callback will not run; an app flow waiting for that callback may stall.

zh-CN.description: 应用携带显示设置打开 Kovac Ivan 的 SplashScreenHelper 时，此 Activity 会展示配置的文字、图片、进度指示器或视频，然后调用完成回调并关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 配置的启动画面及其完成回调将无法运行；等待此回调的应用流程可能停滞。

en.description: Kaustubh Patange’s App Updater library runs this Provider when the app starts and checks whether it was signed by an approved publisher. If the signature is not on the library’s built-in list, the app is closed.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it stops that signature check, so an app with an unlisted signing certificate will no longer be closed by the library.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，Kaustubh Patange 的 App Updater 库会通过此 Provider 检查应用是否由许可发布者签名；如果签名不在库内置的名单中，应用就会被关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后将不再进行此签名检查，签名未列入名单的应用也不会因此被库关闭。

en.description: Kaustubh Patange’s Custom WebView Tabs library opens an app-supplied URL in an in-app browser with refresh, navigation, and page-loading controls.
en.disableEffect: Pages that the app opens through this browser will no longer load.

zh-CN.description: Kaustubh Patange 的 Custom WebView Tabs 库会在应用内浏览器中打开应用传入的网址，并提供刷新、导航和加载进度控件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用通过此浏览器打开的网页将无法加载。

en.description: Kaustubh Patange’s PayPal IAP library opens a PayPal purchase page inside the app when checkout begins. It watches for the purchase result and returns the payment details to the app.
en.disableEffect: Purchases using this checkout screen cannot be completed or returned to the app.

zh-CN.description: 开始结账时，Kaustubh Patange 的 PayPal IAP 库会在应用内打开 PayPal 购买页面，等待购买结果并将付款信息交回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法通过此结账页面完成购买并将结果返回应用。

en.description: When a developer opens DiDi DoKit's thread diagnostic screen, this Activity captures and lists threads that have not exited, with their counts and Java or native stack details.
en.disableEffect: DoKit's diagnostic view of threads that remain running will be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: 开发者打开 DiDi DoKit 线程诊断页面时，此 Activity 会收集并列出尚未退出的线程、数量以及 Java 或原生堆栈详情。
zh-CN.disableEffect: DoKit 将无法显示仍在运行线程的诊断信息。

en.description: When launched through its MAIN/LAUNCHER entry, the Kingsoft Cloud (KSC) One Login Activity shows its screen and initializes the One Login SDK.
en.disableEffect: This launcher screen and its KSC One Login initialization will not run; if it is the app's only launcher Activity, the app may no longer open from the home screen.

zh-CN.description: 通过 MAIN/LAUNCHER 入口启动时，金山云（KSC）One Login Activity 会显示页面并初始化 One Login SDK。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 此启动页面及 KSC One Login 初始化将无法运行；如果它是应用唯一的启动 Activity，应用可能无法从主屏幕打开。

en.description: Room Inspector by Vipin KT opens this screen when an app requests inspection of a Room database. It lists tables and lets the user view, add, edit, delete, or export records.
en.disableEffect: The in-app Room database inspection and table tools will be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求检查 Room 数据库时，Vipin KT 的 Room Inspector 会打开此界面。它列出数据库表，并可查看、添加、编辑、删除或导出记录。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用内的 Room 数据库检查界面和表格工具将无法使用。

en.description: Room Inspector by Vipin KT opens this screen from its database inspector for custom queries. It displays the returned database rows in a table.
en.disableEffect: The inspector's custom database query screen will be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: Vipin KT 的 Room Inspector 会从数据库检查界面打开此页面，用于执行自定义查询并以表格显示结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 数据库检查工具中的自定义查询界面将无法使用。

en.description: Advertisement page shown in Kuaishou's novel reader.

zh-CN.description: 快手小说阅读中的广告页面。

en.description: Kuaishou’s Weapon security component, bundled with its ad SDK, handles an internal refresh broadcast and updates local risk-check state.
en.disableEffect: Its background security-state updates stop, while the app’s normal screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: 快手广告 SDK 捆绑的 Weapon 安全组件会处理内部状态刷新广播，并更新本地风险检查状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，这些后台安全状态更新会停止，但应用正常页面仍可使用。

en.description: When HiveLocation by Kuloud receives a location-update broadcast, it saves each reported coordinate, timestamp, and whether the app was open to local location history.
en.disableEffect: HiveLocation will stop saving new location points, so app features that rely on location tracking or history may miss updates.

zh-CN.description: Kuloud HiveLocation 收到位置更新广播时，会把坐标、时间以及应用当时是否打开保存到本地位置记录中。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，HiveLocation 将不再保存新的位置点，依赖定位跟踪或历史记录的应用功能可能缺少更新。

en.description: When the Kumulos Android SDK starts with the app, this Provider registers an observer for active screens and app foreground/background changes and makes those events available to Kumulos listeners.
en.disableEffect: Kumulos features that rely on the active screen or app foreground state will stop receiving those updates.

zh-CN.description: Kumulos Android SDK 随应用启动时，此 Provider 会注册页面和应用前后台状态观察器，并将这些事件提供给 Kumulos 监听器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖当前页面或应用前后台状态的 Kumulos 功能将无法再收到这些状态更新。

en.description: When a user opens a Kumulos push notification or action, this brief Activity sends the app a push-open or button-click event and can launch an included app intent.
en.disableEffect: Kumulos push taps and button actions will no longer reach the app or open their attached destination.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 Kumulos 推送通知或操作时，此短暂显示的 Activity 会向应用发送推送打开或按钮点击事件，并可启动随通知附带的应用 Intent。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Kumulos 推送点击和按钮操作将无法传递给应用，也无法打开附带的目标页面。

en.description: When Kumulos requests notification permission on Android 13 or newer, this Activity asks the user for permission and closes after the response.
en.disableEffect: Kumulos will not be able to ask for notification permission through this Activity, so its push notifications may remain disabled.

zh-CN.description: Kumulos 在 Android 13 或更高版本请求通知权限时，此 Activity 会向用户请求授权，并在收到结果后关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Kumulos 将无法通过此 Activity 请求通知权限，因此其推送通知可能无法启用。

en.description: Kushki’s Android payments SDK exposes an exported 3-D Secure screen. A host app can open it with merchant, card, amount, and currency details; it displays those details and a code field.
en.disableEffect: The Kushki card-check screen will not open when the payment flow requests it.

zh-CN.description: Kushki Android 支付 SDK 提供一个已导出的 3-D Secure 验证页面。宿主应用可传入商户、卡号、金额和币种信息打开页面；页面会显示这些信息和验证码输入框。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 支付流程请求打开此 Kushki 卡验证页面时，该页面将无法显示。

en.description: Kustomer’s Android chat SDK opens this screen for the app’s in-app support experience. It loads the configured conversation view or help-center pages.
en.disableEffect: The app’s in-app support chat and help-center pages will not open.

zh-CN.description: Kustomer Android 聊天 SDK 会在应用打开内置客服入口时显示此页面，并加载已配置的会话界面或帮助中心页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用内的客服聊天和帮助中心页面将无法打开。

en.description: Kustomer’s Android SDK receives support messages through Firebase and displays Kustomer notifications. It also keeps the app set up to receive support messages by push notification.
en.disableEffect: The user will no longer receive Kustomer support messages as push notifications.

zh-CN.description: Kustomer Android SDK 会通过 Firebase 接收客服消息并显示 Kustomer 通知，也会为应用配置客服消息推送。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过推送通知收到 Kustomer 客服消息。

en.description: Kustomer’s support chat uses this file-sharing component to pass local attachments to other Android apps. It supplies files when a user shares an attachment from a conversation.
en.disableEffect: Sharing or opening file attachments in the Kustomer support chat will fail.

zh-CN.description: Kustomer 客服聊天通过此文件共享组件，将本地附件交给其他 Android 应用处理。用户在会话中共享附件时会用到它。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Kustomer 客服聊天中的附件共享或打开操作将失败。

en.description: Kvalifika document verification opens the camera to photograph an ID card or passport and uploads the captured image for processing. An ID card can be captured one side at a time.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot capture or submit an identity document for Kvalifika verification.

zh-CN.description: Kvalifika 证件验证会打开相机拍摄身份证或护照，并上传照片进行处理；身份证正反面需要分别拍摄。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，用户无法拍摄或提交证件以完成 Kvalifika 验证。

en.description: After a Kvalifika document check, this screen shows success or an error and offers the next step, such as retrying capture or selecting a document again.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot see the Kvalifika verification outcome or retry from this screen.

zh-CN.description: Kvalifika 证件检查完成后，此页面会显示成功或错误结果，并提供重拍或重新选择证件等后续操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，用户无法查看 Kvalifika 验证结果或从此页面重试。

en.description: At the start of Kvalifika document verification, this screen lets users choose an ID card or passport and opens the camera-capture step.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot start ID-card or passport verification through Kvalifika.

zh-CN.description: 开始 Kvalifika 证件验证时，此页面让用户选择身份证或护照，并进入相机拍摄步骤。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，用户无法通过 Kvalifika 启动身份证或护照验证。

en.description: The Kuaishou ad SDK declares this exported Activity as part of its account sign-in route. It runs when a sign-in handoff is returned to the app.
en.disableEffect: Blocking it can prevent the SDK sign-in flow from returning to the app.

zh-CN.description: 快手广告 SDK 将此导出 Activity 用作账号登录路由的一部分。登录流程返回应用时会启动它。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，SDK 登录流程可能无法正常返回应用。

en.description: Android starts this Service when a user previews or sets a Kuaishou SDK video wallpaper. It displays the selected video as a live wallpaper.
en.disableEffect: The Kuaishou SDK video live wallpaper will no longer be available.

zh-CN.description: 系统预览或设置快手 SDK 的视频动态壁纸时会启动此 Service。它会将所选视频显示为动态壁纸。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 快手 SDK 的视频动态壁纸将无法使用。

en.description: Android starts this Provider for the Kuaishou ad SDK at app startup; it shares downloaded APK files with Android's package installer and initializes SDK activity tracking.
en.disableEffect: Ad app installation may fail, and the SDK may not initialize its activity tracking.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，Android 会为快手广告 SDK 创建此 Provider；它向 Android 安装程序提供已下载 APK 的文件访问权限，并初始化 SDK 的 Activity 跟踪。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 广告应用可能无法安装，SDK 的 Activity 跟踪也可能无法初始化。

en.description: When a user taps an ad link or landing-page control, the Kuaishou ad SDK opens this Activity to show the ad's web page.
en.disableEffect: Ad landing pages and web-based ad actions may not open.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击广告链接或落地页控件时，快手广告 SDK 会打开此 Activity 显示广告网页。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 广告落地页和网页广告操作可能无法打开。

en.description: The Kuaishou SDK opens this Activity to show details for a channel inside its media pages.
en.disableEffect: Channel detail pages provided by the Kuaishou SDK may not open.

zh-CN.description: 快手 SDK 会打开此 Activity，在其内容页面中显示频道详情。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 快手 SDK 提供的频道详情页可能无法打开。

en.description: The Kuaishou ad SDK opens this Activity to show its developer configuration page when that page is requested.
en.disableEffect: The SDK developer configuration page will not be available.

zh-CN.description: 快手广告 SDK 在需要显示开发者配置页面时会打开此 Activity。
zh-CN.disableEffect: SDK 开发者配置页面将无法使用。

en.description: The Kuaishou SDK opens this Activity to show episode details from its in-app media pages.
en.disableEffect: Episode detail pages provided by the Kuaishou SDK may not open.

zh-CN.description: 快手 SDK 会打开此 Activity，在其内容页面中显示剧集详情。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 快手 SDK 提供的剧集详情页可能无法打开。

en.description: When the Kuaishou (Kwai) ad SDK opens an ad page, this Activity displays page content the SDK loads at runtime.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents ad pages that need this screen from opening; unrelated app features remain available.

zh-CN.description: 快手广告 SDK 打开广告页面时，会通过此界面显示其运行时加载的页面内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要此界面的快手广告将无法打开，应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: The Kuaishou SDK uses this Activity to show a web page during its payment flow.
en.disableEffect: Web-based payments through the Kuaishou SDK may not complete.

en.disableEffect: Kwai responses cannot return through this handler, so dependent authorization or sharing flows may fail.

zh-CN.description: 快手应用将 OpenSDK 响应返回宿主应用时，KwaiSocial 的 Kwai OpenSDK 会通过此页面处理响应并关闭。它支持应用的授权及其他快手回调流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 快手响应无法通过此处理页面返回，依赖它的授权或分享流程可能失败。

en.description: When KwaiSocial’s Kwai OpenSDK invokes this redirect, it opens the host app’s launch screen if the SDK has not been initialized, then closes. This provides a fallback for returning to the app.
en.disableEffect: This fallback cannot reopen the app for that Kwai handoff, and the associated return flow may not resume.

zh-CN.description: KwaiSocial 的 Kwai OpenSDK 调用此重定向页面时，如果 SDK 尚未初始化，它会先打开宿主应用的启动页面，然后关闭，为返回应用提供备用路径。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 快手交接流程无法通过此备用路径重新打开应用，相关返回流程可能无法继续。

en.description: Leatherback's Android checkout SDK opens this screen with the order details supplied by the merchant and displays the checkout page.
en.disableEffect: Customers will not be able to use the app's Leatherback checkout flow to complete payment.

zh-CN.description: Leatherback Android 结账 SDK 会使用商家提供的订单信息打开此页面，并显示结账页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过应用中的 Leatherback 结账流程完成付款。

en.description: When Android reports a network change, Leatherback's checkout SDK checks whether Wi-Fi or mobile data is connected and whether the connection is slow, then updates its checkout flow.
en.disableEffect: The checkout flow may not respond correctly when its network connection changes.

zh-CN.description: Android 通知网络状态变化时，Leatherback 结账 SDK 会检查 Wi-Fi 或移动数据是否可用、连接是否缓慢，并更新结账流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 网络连接变化后，结账流程可能无法正确更新状态。

en.description: When Android requests the Machbird account authenticator, this service provides the account sign-in connection used by the SDK.
en.disableEffect: Machbird account setup and sign-in through Android's account system will fail.

zh-CN.description: Android 请求 Machbird 账户验证器时，此 Service 会提供 SDK 所需的账户登录连接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Machbird 账户无法通过 Android 账户系统完成设置或登录。

en.description: When Android's account sync system requests a sync, this Machbird service sends an in-app sync event and starts the SDK's registered background services.
en.disableEffect: Machbird account synchronization and the background work tied to it will stop.

zh-CN.description: Android 账户同步系统发起同步时，此 Machbird Service 会发送应用内同步事件，并启动 SDK 已注册的后台 Service。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Machbird 账户同步及其关联的后台工作将停止。

en.description: When Google Play services runs Machbird's scheduled network task, this service restarts the SDK's registered background services.
en.disableEffect: Machbird's scheduled background service restarts and keep-alive work will stop.

zh-CN.description: Google Play 服务运行 Machbird 的定时网络任务时，此 Service 会重新启动 SDK 已注册的后台 Service。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Machbird 定时重启后台 Service 和保活的工作将停止。

en.description: Machbird starts this short-lived helper when its background service needs a foreground start; it retries the start after a delay if needed, then stops itself.
en.disableEffect: Machbird's background keep-alive helper will no longer run.

zh-CN.description: Machbird 的后台 Service 需要以前台方式启动时会调用此短时辅助 Service；必要时它会延迟重试，然后自行停止。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Machbird 的后台保活辅助流程将无法运行。

en.description: Machbird uses this background service to maintain its paired service, restart registered SDK services, and handle internal keep-alive requests.
en.disableEffect: Machbird's background keep-alive and service restart work will stop.

zh-CN.description: Machbird 使用此后台 Service 维持配对 Service、重启已注册的 SDK Service，并处理内部保活请求。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Machbird 的后台保活和 Service 重启工作将停止。

en.description: When Android's JobScheduler runs this Machbird job, it restarts services registered by the SDK and continues its background maintenance work.
en.disableEffect: Machbird's scheduled background service restarts and maintenance will stop.

zh-CN.description: Android 的 JobScheduler 运行 Machbird 任务时，此 Service 会重启 SDK 注册的 Service 并继续后台维护工作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Machbird 定时重启后台 Service 和维护工作将停止。

en.description: Laevatein's photo-selection flow opens this screen when a user previews an image; it displays device photos one at a time and preserves the current selection.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot preview or review selected photos in apps that use Laevatein.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Laevatein 照片选择流程中预览图片时，此界面会逐张显示设备中的照片并保留当前选择。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用 Laevatein 的应用将无法预览或检查已选照片。

en.description: When the host app asks Laevatein to choose photos, this activity displays device albums and image grids, tracks selections, and handles photos captured with the camera.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot select and return photos through Laevatein.

zh-CN.description: 宿主应用调用 Laevatein 选择照片时，此界面会显示设备相册和图片网格、记录选择，并处理通过相机拍摄的照片。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 Laevatein 选择并返回照片。

en.description: The Chat SDK media picker, powered by MindInventory's Lassi library, opens when chat or profile screens request media. It lets users select or capture an image or video, crop images when requested, and returns the chosen files.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot select or capture the images and videos used for chat attachments or profile pictures through this picker.

zh-CN.description: 聊天或个人资料界面请求选择媒体时，Chat SDK 会打开由 MindInventory 的 Lassi 库提供的媒体选择器。用户可选择或拍摄图片、视频，并按需裁剪图片；选中的文件会返回给原界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法通过此选择器挑选或拍摄聊天附件及个人资料照片、视频。

en.description: LaunchDarkly’s Android feature-flag SDK checks for internet changes and informs its clients when connectivity returns or is lost. This helps the app refresh feature settings after a network change.
en.disableEffect: Feature flags may remain out of date after the network changes, which can affect app features controlled by LaunchDarkly.

zh-CN.description: LaunchDarkly Android 功能开关 SDK 会检测网络连接变化，并通知客户端网络恢复或断开，以便应用在网络变化后更新功能设置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 网络变化后功能开关可能无法及时更新，受 LaunchDarkly 控制的应用功能可能因此受到影响。

en.description: LaunchDarkly’s Android SDK periodically checks for updated feature settings while the app is in the background. Android runs this receiver when its scheduled poll is due.
en.disableEffect: Background feature-setting updates will stop, so the app may keep using stale LaunchDarkly settings.

zh-CN.description: LaunchDarkly Android SDK 会定期在应用处于后台时检查是否有新的功能设置。到达轮询时间后，Android 会运行此接收器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 后台功能设置更新会停止，应用可能继续使用过期的 LaunchDarkly 设置。

en.description: The FIB Payments SDK initializes its payment services when Android starts the app process and connects them to the app's context.
en.disableEffect: FIB payment flows may fail to initialize if this provider is disabled.

zh-CN.description: FIB 支付 SDK 会在 Android 启动应用进程时初始化支付服务，并将其连接到应用环境。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用中的 FIB 支付流程可能无法完成初始化。

en.description: The TINet image-picker library opens this Activity when an app asks the user to choose media; it scans and displays photos and videos, and can open the camera for a new photo.
en.disableEffect: The app will not be able to choose or capture media through this picker.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求通过 TINet 图片选择库选取媒体时会打开此 Activity；它扫描并显示手机中的图片和视频，也可从此界面拍摄照片。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用无法通过此选择器选取或拍摄媒体。

en.description: The TINet image-picker library opens this preview Activity after a user taps media in the gallery, so they can review and confirm selected photos or videos.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to preview or confirm media in this picker flow.

zh-CN.description: 用户点按图库中的媒体项目后，TINet 图片选择库会打开此预览 Activity，供用户查看并确认所选图片或视频。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法在此选择流程中预览或确认媒体。

en.description: The TINet image-picker library requests this FileProvider to create shareable file links for camera photos and for videos opened in another player.
en.disableEffect: Camera photo capture or opening a picked video in another player may fail.

zh-CN.description: TINet 图片选择库需要把相机照片保存为文件，或将所选视频交给其他播放器打开时，会通过此 FileProvider 创建可授权访问的文件链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，相机照片保存或在其他播放器中打开所选视频可能失败。

en.description: During an Eyuan (YYXXGame) Leidian channel update, the SDK uses this Provider to give Android a shareable file address for the downloaded APK and open the package installer.
en.disableEffect: The downloaded APK cannot be passed to Android's installer, so the Leidian in-game update flow fails.

zh-CN.description: 易元（YYXXGame）雷电渠道更新时，SDK 通过此 Provider 向 Android 提供已下载 APK 的共享文件地址，并打开系统安装程序。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 已下载的 APK 无法交给 Android 安装程序，因此雷电渠道的游戏内更新流程会失败。

en.description: The Eyuan (YYXXGame) Leidian channel SDK opens this Activity for account sign-in; it shows the channel login screen and handles account, Google, LINE, and Facebook sign-in results.
en.disableEffect: Players cannot complete account sign-in through the Leidian channel SDK.

zh-CN.description: 易元（YYXXGame）雷电渠道 SDK 在玩家登录账号时打开此 Activity；它显示渠道登录界面，并处理账号、Google、LINE 和 Facebook 登录结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 玩家无法通过雷电渠道 SDK 完成账号登录。

en.description: The Eyuan (YYXXGame) Leidian account SDK binds this Service to show or hide its floating ball during gameplay; the ball can display account notices and coupon tips.
en.disableEffect: The floating account shortcut and its notice or coupon tips disappear; the separate Leidian sign-in screen remains available.

zh-CN.description: 易元（YYXXGame）雷电账号 SDK 在游戏过程中绑定此 Service，以显示或隐藏悬浮球；悬浮球可显示账号提示和优惠券提醒。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 悬浮账号入口及提示、优惠券提醒会消失；独立的雷电登录界面仍可使用。

en.description: When Huawei delivers a Leanplum push message, this service passes it to Leanplum for handling and keeps the app connected to Huawei push delivery.
en.disableEffect: Leanplum push notifications through Huawei Push Kit will stop working.

zh-CN.description: 华为推送 Leanplum 消息时，此服务会将消息交给 Leanplum 处理，并维持应用通过华为接收推送的配置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过华为 Push Kit 发送的 Leanplum 推送通知将停止工作。

en.description: Leanplum’s messaging SDK uses this receiver to process its queued push-notification work in the background. It starts the requested Leanplum background task when Android delivers the internal broadcast.
en.disableEffect: Queued Leanplum push-notification work may not be processed.

zh-CN.description: Leanplum 消息 SDK 使用此接收器在后台处理排队的推送通知任务。Android 发出内部广播时，它会启动相应的 Leanplum 后台任务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 排队等待处理的 Leanplum 推送通知任务可能无法执行。

en.description: Leanplum’s messaging SDK runs this background service to handle queued notification messages. It passes a Leanplum message to the SDK’s notification handler when one is present.
en.disableEffect: Queued Leanplum notification messages may not be delivered.

zh-CN.description: Leanplum 消息 SDK 通过此后台服务处理排队的通知消息。收到 Leanplum 消息时，它会交给 SDK 的通知处理程序。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 排队的 Leanplum 通知消息可能无法送达。

en.description: For apps configured with Xiaomi Mi Push, this Leanplum receiver handles incoming messages, notification taps, and push-registration callbacks.
en.disableEffect: Leanplum messages and notification taps delivered through Xiaomi Mi Push will stop working.

zh-CN.description: 对于配置了小米 Mi Push 的应用，此 Leanplum 接收器会处理收到的消息、通知点击和推送注册回调。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过小米 Mi Push 接收的 Leanplum 消息和通知点击将停止工作。

en.description: When Firebase delivers a Leanplum push message, this service passes it to Leanplum for handling and keeps the app connected to Firebase push delivery.
en.disableEffect: Leanplum push notifications through Firebase will stop working.

zh-CN.description: Firebase 推送 Leanplum 消息时，此服务会将消息交给 Leanplum 处理，并维持应用通过 Firebase 接收推送的配置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过 Firebase 发送的 Leanplum 推送通知将停止工作。

en.description: When a Leanplum push notification is opened, this receiver opens the notification or forwards it to the app’s configured notification handler.
en.disableEffect: Tapping Leanplum push notifications may no longer open the intended screen or action.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 Leanplum 推送通知时，此接收器会打开通知内容，或将其转交给应用配置的通知处理程序。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 点击 Leanplum 推送通知后，可能无法打开预期页面或执行相应操作。

en.description: Leanplum’s location-engagement SDK processes geofence entry and exit events here. It uses those events to run location-based Leanplum engagement.
en.disableEffect: Leanplum location-based messages and engagement actions will stop running.

zh-CN.description: Leanplum 位置互动 SDK 在此处理设备进入或离开地理围栏的事件，并据此运行基于位置的互动内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Leanplum 基于位置的消息和互动操作将停止运行。

en.description: FileSelector (shichuanenhui) opens this screen when the app starts its file picker. It lists files from the folders chosen by the app and returns the files you select.
en.disableEffect: The app file picker cannot open, so you cannot choose files through it.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动 FileSelector（shichuanenhui）的文件选择器时会打开此页面。它会列出应用指定文件夹中的文件，并将你选中的文件返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用的文件选择器将无法打开，因此你不能通过它选择文件。

en.description: Utils (shichuanenhui) starts this service when the app sends an internal message. It carries the message to the other parts of the app that are waiting for it.
en.disableEffect: Messages sent through this utility will not reach the parts of the app waiting for them, so features that rely on those messages may stop working.

zh-CN.description: Utils（shichuanenhui）会在应用发送内部消息时启动此服务，并将消息传递给应用中等待接收的部分。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过此工具发送的消息将无法送达应用中等待接收的部分，因此依赖这些消息的功能可能无法使用。

en.description: Utils (shichuanenhui) uses this provider to create file links when the app shares files or opens an installation package. Android also creates it during app startup, when it initializes the Utils library.
en.disableEffect: Utils may not initialize correctly, and file sharing or opening an installation package may fail.

zh-CN.description: Utils（shichuanenhui）会通过此内容提供器在分享文件或打开安装包时创建文件链接。Android 还会在应用启动时创建它，并借此初始化 Utils 库。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Utils 可能无法正确初始化，文件分享或打开安装包的操作也可能失败。

en.description: Utils (shichuanenhui) opens this brief, transparent screen when it requests Android permissions or access to system settings. It returns the permission or settings result to the app.
en.disableEffect: The app may not be able to complete permission requests through Utils, leaving actions that need those permissions unavailable.

zh-CN.description: Utils（shichuanenhui）在申请 Android 权限或系统设置访问权限时会打开此透明页面，并将处理结果返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用可能无法通过 Utils 完成权限申请，依赖这些权限的操作也可能无法使用。

en.description: Utils (shichuanenhui) opens this hidden, transparent screen for utility tasks that need to run from the app main process, such as requesting a permission or receiving a result from another Android screen.
en.disableEffect: The app may not be able to finish utility actions that depend on permission requests or results handled through this screen.

zh-CN.description: Utils（shichuanenhui）会为需要在应用主进程中运行的辅助操作打开此透明页面，例如申请权限或接收其他 Android 页面返回的结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此页面处理权限申请或接收页面结果的辅助功能可能无法完成。

en.description: Legiti’s Android anti-fraud library starts this provider when the app launches and saves the application context for its client. The client uses that context when the app invokes Legiti fraud checks.
en.disableEffect: Legiti will not receive its app context at startup, so app flows that depend on its anti-fraud checks may fail.

zh-CN.description: Legiti Android 反欺诈库会在应用启动时运行此 Provider，并为客户端保存应用上下文。应用调用 Legiti 风险检查时会用到该上下文。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 启动时 Legiti 将无法取得应用上下文，依赖其反欺诈检查的应用流程可能失败。

en.description: Lenovo Game SDK displays a promotional ad when the game SDK launches an ad placement. Players can view or close the promotion.
en.disableEffect: Lenovo Game SDK ads and their landing pages will stop appearing; the game's own features remain available.

zh-CN.description: 游戏 SDK 打开广告位时，联想游戏 SDK 会展示推广内容，玩家可以查看或关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 联想游戏 SDK 的广告和落地页将不再显示，游戏自身功能仍可使用。

en.description: Lenovo Game SDK displays a configurable promotion in this flexible ad screen and handles the player's close or offer action.
en.disableEffect: Lenovo ads and optional offer actions will stop appearing; VCoin or activation-code rewards tied to those offers will no longer be delivered.

zh-CN.description: 联想游戏 SDK 会在此广告页面展示配置的推广内容，并处理玩家关闭或查看优惠的操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 联想广告和可选推广操作将不再显示；相关活动提供的游戏币或激活码奖励也无法领取。

en.description: Lenovo Game SDK shows the current signed-in account and lets a player switch accounts when a login flow finds an existing session.
en.disableEffect: Lenovo account switching during sign-in will not complete.

zh-CN.description: 联想游戏 SDK 登录流程发现已有会话时，会显示当前账号并允许玩家切换账号。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 联想账号登录过程中的切换账号操作将无法完成。

en.description: Lenovo Game SDK opens a web page for a game-center campaign or external link when requested. It also routes payment links to the corresponding payment app.
en.disableEffect: Lenovo game-center campaign pages and any purchase flow that uses this link screen will fail to open.

zh-CN.description: 收到请求时，联想游戏 SDK 会打开游戏中心活动或外部链接网页，并将支付链接转交给相应支付应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此链接页面的联想游戏中心活动和购买流程将无法打开。

en.description: Lenovo Game SDK shows an exit-time promotion with recommended games when a player opens its quit screen.
en.disableEffect: The optional Lenovo exit promotion and game recommendations will not appear; VCoin or activation-code rewards tied to its offers will no longer be delivered.

zh-CN.description: 玩家打开退出页面时，联想游戏 SDK 会展示退出推广和推荐游戏。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 可选的联想退出推广和游戏推荐将不再显示；相关活动提供的游戏币或激活码奖励也无法领取。

en.description: This Lenovo Intermodal Activity opens when the app starts a Lenovo payment. It shows the available payment options, submits the selected transaction, and returns its result to the app.
en.disableEffect: The app's Lenovo Intermodal payment flow will not open or complete.

zh-CN.description: 这是 Lenovo Intermodal 的支付 Activity，在应用发起联想支付时打开。它显示可用支付方式、提交所选交易，并将支付结果返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法打开或完成 Lenovo Intermodal 支付流程。

en.description: Lenovo User Center opens this page when a player requests password recovery for a Lenovo account.
en.disableEffect: Players will not be able to recover a Lenovo account password through the game SDK.

zh-CN.description: 玩家请求找回联想账号密码时，联想用户中心会打开此页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 玩家将无法通过游戏 SDK 找回联想账号密码。

en.description: Lenovo User Center opens this page to confirm a password-recovery request with the account's verification code.
en.disableEffect: Lenovo password recovery will stop before the verification step can finish.

zh-CN.description: 联想用户中心会打开此页面，要求使用账号验证码确认密码找回请求。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 联想密码找回流程将无法完成验证码确认。

en.description: Lenovo User Center presents password sign-in and account registration when the game requests Lenovo login.
en.disableEffect: Lenovo account sign-in and registration through this screen will fail.

zh-CN.description: 游戏请求联想登录时，联想用户中心会显示密码登录和账号注册页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过此页面进行的联想账号登录和注册将失败。

en.description: Lenovo User Center opens phone registration when a player creates a Lenovo account, then requests SMS and image verification codes.
en.disableEffect: Players will be unable to register a Lenovo account by phone through the game SDK.

zh-CN.description: 玩家创建联想账号时，联想用户中心会打开手机号注册页面并请求短信和图形验证码。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 玩家将无法通过游戏 SDK 使用手机号注册联想账号。

en.description: Lenovo User Center confirms a phone registration with the SMS code and completes the new account sign-up.
en.disableEffect: Phone-based Lenovo account registration will not complete.

zh-CN.description: 联想用户中心会通过短信验证码确认手机号注册，并完成新账号注册。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 联想手机号注册将无法完成。

en.description: Lenovo User Center shows an error and retry or return choices when starting a Lenovo game session fails.
en.disableEffect: The Lenovo sign-in failure recovery screen will not open, so the game's Lenovo login flow cannot recover here.

zh-CN.description: 联想用户中心启动游戏会话失败时，会显示错误信息以及重试或返回选项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 联想登录失败后的恢复页面将无法打开，游戏也无法在此继续联想登录流程。

en.description: Lenovo User Center starts or resumes the player's game login session and returns the account ticket to the game.
en.disableEffect: The game will not be able to complete Lenovo account sign-in or resume its Lenovo session.

zh-CN.description: 联想用户中心会启动或恢复玩家的游戏登录会话，并将账号凭据返回给游戏。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 游戏将无法完成联想账号登录或恢复联想会话。

en.description: Lenovo User Center opens account pages in a web view for tasks such as password or account changes requested during sign-in.
en.disableEffect: Lenovo account pages that use this screen will not open or return their account-change result.

zh-CN.description: 联想用户中心会在登录流程请求时，通过网页页面处理密码或账号修改等任务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此页面的联想账号操作将无法打开或返回修改结果。

en.description: Lenovo Game SDK opens the Lenovo account sign-in page when a player chooses Lenovo login, then returns the login result.
en.disableEffect: Lenovo account login through the game SDK will fail.

zh-CN.description: 玩家选择联想登录时，联想游戏 SDK 会打开联想账号登录页面，并返回登录结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过游戏 SDK 进行的联想账号登录将失败。

en.description: This Lenovo ID account entry opens when an app requests the user's account page. It sends signed-in users to account information and sends users without a signed-in account to Lenovo ID login.
en.disableEffect: The Lenovo ID account-page entry cannot open the account or sign-in screen.

zh-CN.description: 这是 Lenovo ID 的帐号入口，在应用请求打开用户帐号页面时启动。已登录用户会进入帐号信息页，未登录用户会进入 Lenovo ID 登录页。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Lenovo ID 的帐号入口将无法打开帐号信息或登录界面。

en.description: This Lenovo ID Activity opens the camera when the user chooses QR-code sign-in. It scans the code and passes the result into the account sign-in flow.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot scan a QR code to sign in to Lenovo ID.

zh-CN.description: 这是 Lenovo ID 的二维码登录 Activity，在用户选择扫码登录时打开相机。它会扫描二维码，并把结果交给帐号登录流程处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过扫描二维码登录 Lenovo ID。

en.description: This Lenovo ID Activity appears after a web sign-in request is scanned. It asks the user to confirm or cancel linking the browser sign-in to the Lenovo ID account.
en.disableEffect: The user cannot approve a Lenovo ID sign-in started in a browser by QR code.

zh-CN.description: 这是 Lenovo ID 的网页扫码登录确认 Activity，在扫描网页登录二维码后显示。用户可确认或取消将浏览器登录请求关联到自己的 Lenovo ID 帐号。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法确认通过二维码发起的 Lenovo ID 网页登录。

en.description: This Lenovo ID screen opens when a user chooses to link an existing Lenovo account to another sign-in account. It asks for the Lenovo account name and password and submits the binding request.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot link an existing Lenovo ID account through this flow.

zh-CN.description: 这是 Lenovo ID 的帐号绑定界面，在用户选择关联已有 Lenovo 帐号时打开。它要求输入 Lenovo 帐号和密码，并提交绑定请求。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此流程关联已有 Lenovo ID 帐号。

en.description: This Lenovo ID registration screen is opened when the user chooses to create an account while linking another sign-in account. It collects a phone number or email and verifies it before continuing.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot register a new Lenovo ID as part of account binding.

zh-CN.description: 这是 Lenovo ID 的绑定注册界面，在用户选择创建新帐号并进行关联时打开。它会收集手机号或邮箱，并在继续前验证该信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在帐号绑定流程中注册新的 Lenovo ID。

en.description: This Lenovo ID screen completes registration of a new account being linked to another sign-in account. It asks the user to set and confirm a password after the contact code is verified.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot finish creating and linking a new Lenovo ID account through this flow.

zh-CN.description: 这是 Lenovo ID 绑定注册的最后一步，在联系方式验证码通过后要求用户设置并确认密码，以完成新帐号注册和关联。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此流程完成新 Lenovo ID 帐号的注册和关联。

en.description: This Lenovo ID Activity opens the web-based account-information page from the account center. It lets the user view or update account details through Lenovo's account website.
en.disableEffect: The Lenovo ID account-information page cannot open from the account center.

zh-CN.description: 这是 Lenovo ID 的网页帐号信息 Activity，由帐号中心打开。用户可在联想帐号网页中查看或更新帐号资料。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法从帐号中心打开 Lenovo ID 网页资料页。

en.description: This Lenovo ID account-center Activity opens from the account-page action or after sign-in. It shows account details and links to profile, password, verification, and account-security screens.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open the Lenovo ID account center or reach its account-management options.

zh-CN.description: 这是 Lenovo ID 的帐号中心 Activity，可由帐号页面操作或登录后打开。它显示帐号资料，并提供个人信息、密码、认证和帐号安全页面入口。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开 Lenovo ID 帐号中心及其帐号管理功能。

en.description: This Lenovo ID Activity opens when an email-based account needs activation. It guides the user through activating the account with the registered email address.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot complete Lenovo ID email-account activation in this screen.

zh-CN.description: 这是 Lenovo ID 的邮箱激活 Activity，在邮箱帐号需要激活时打开。它引导用户使用注册邮箱完成帐号激活。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在此界面完成 Lenovo ID 邮箱帐号激活。

en.description: This Lenovo ID Activity opens when a phone-based account needs activation. It guides the user through activating the account with a verification code sent to the registered phone.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot complete Lenovo ID phone-account activation in this screen.

zh-CN.description: 这是 Lenovo ID 的手机号激活 Activity，在手机号帐号需要激活时打开。它引导用户通过发送到注册手机号的验证码完成激活。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在此界面完成 Lenovo ID 手机号帐号激活。

en.description: This Lenovo ID Activity shows the completion screen after a password change. It is opened by the password-change flow when the update succeeds.
en.disableEffect: Users may not see the completion state, and the SDK password-change flow may fail when opening it.

zh-CN.description: 这是 Lenovo ID 的密码修改完成页，在密码更新成功后由修改流程打开。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户可能看不到完成提示，SDK 修改密码流程也可能在打开此页面时失败。

en.description: This Lenovo ID screen opens when the user chooses to change the account password. It collects the current password, offers password recovery, and continues to the completion screen after an update.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot use the Lenovo ID password-change flow from the account center.

zh-CN.description: 这是 Lenovo ID 的密码修改界面，在用户选择修改帐号密码时打开。它收集当前密码、提供找回密码入口，并在更新后进入完成页。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法从帐号中心使用 Lenovo ID 密码修改流程。

en.description: This Lenovo ID web page opens when phone sign-in or registration needs a country or region dialing code. It displays the code selection and returns the choice to the phone form.
en.disableEffect: Users may be unable to choose a country code for phone-based Lenovo ID sign-in or registration.

zh-CN.description: 这是 Lenovo ID 的国家和地区区号网页，在手机号登录或注册需要选择区号时打开。它显示区号选项，并将选择结果返回手机号表单。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户可能无法为 Lenovo ID 手机号登录或注册选择国家和地区区号。

en.description: This Lenovo ID Activity shows the completion page for email registration and provides a route back to sign-in.
en.disableEffect: The email-registration completion page cannot open, so users may not receive its confirmation or return-to-sign-in option.

zh-CN.description: 这是 Lenovo ID 的邮箱注册完成页，并提供返回登录的入口。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 邮箱注册完成页将无法打开，用户可能看不到确认信息或返回登录的入口。

en.description: This Lenovo ID screen starts password recovery when the user selects “forgot password.” It collects the account phone number or email and continues to contact verification.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot start Lenovo ID password recovery from login, account binding, or password-change screens.

zh-CN.description: 这是 Lenovo ID 的密码找回入口，在用户选择“忘记密码”时打开。它收集帐号手机号或邮箱，并继续进行联系方式验证。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法从登录、帐号绑定或密码修改界面启动 Lenovo ID 密码找回。

en.description: This Lenovo ID screen asks for the verification code sent to the account's phone or email during password recovery. It checks the code before allowing a new password.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot verify ownership of the account during Lenovo ID password recovery.

zh-CN.description: 这是 Lenovo ID 密码找回流程中的验证码界面，要求输入发送到帐号手机号或邮箱的验证码。验证通过后才能设置新密码。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在 Lenovo ID 密码找回过程中验证帐号所有权。

en.description: This Lenovo ID screen lets the user choose a new password after the recovery code is accepted. It finishes the password-reset flow.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot set a replacement password to finish Lenovo ID account recovery.

zh-CN.description: 这是 Lenovo ID 密码找回的最后一步，在验证码通过后让用户设置新密码并完成重置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法设置新密码来完成 Lenovo ID 帐号找回。

en.description: This Lenovo ID account-security screen opens when the user needs to set a security question. It asks the user to choose a verified security phone or email before continuing.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot verify their account through a security phone or email before setting a security question.

zh-CN.description: 这是 Lenovo ID 的帐号安全验证界面，在用户需要设置安全问题时打开。它要求先选择已绑定的安全手机或邮箱进行验证。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在设置安全问题前通过安全手机或邮箱验证帐号。

en.description: This Lenovo ID screen verifies the selected security phone or email with a one-time code. After successful verification, it opens the security-question page.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot complete contact verification or continue to set a Lenovo ID security question.

zh-CN.description: 这是 Lenovo ID 的联系方式验证界面，通过一次性验证码验证所选安全手机或邮箱。验证成功后会打开安全问题页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法完成联系方式验证或继续设置 Lenovo ID 安全问题。

en.description: This Lenovo ID screen lists country and region dialing codes for phone-based sign-in, registration, and recovery. It returns the selected code to the calling form.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot select a dialing code where Lenovo ID phone sign-in, registration, or recovery requires one.

zh-CN.description: 这是 Lenovo ID 的国家和地区区号列表，用于手机号登录、注册和找回帐号。它会将所选区号返回给发起页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要区号的 Lenovo ID 手机登录、注册或找回流程将无法选择区号。

en.description: This Lenovo ID Activity displays personal profile details such as the avatar, alias, birthday, gender, and address. It opens when the app requests the user's personal-information page.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open the Lenovo ID personal-information page.

zh-CN.description: 这是 Lenovo ID 的个人资料 Activity，显示头像、昵称、生日、性别和地址等信息。应用请求打开个人信息页时会启动它。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开 Lenovo ID 个人信息页面。

en.description: This Lenovo ID screen opens during third-party account linking and lets the user choose whether to bind an existing Lenovo ID or register a new one.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot choose or continue the Lenovo ID account-binding path offered by this screen.

zh-CN.description: 这是 Lenovo ID 的第三方帐号绑定选择界面，让用户选择关联已有 Lenovo ID，或注册新的帐号。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法选择或继续此界面提供的 Lenovo ID 帐号绑定流程。

en.description: This Lenovo ID screen is the main sign-in entry. It offers account login and links to phone/email login, registration, password recovery, and supported third-party sign-in options.
en.disableEffect: Apps that use Lenovo ID cannot open the main sign-in screen or its login and registration options.

zh-CN.description: 这是 Lenovo ID 的主登录入口，提供帐号登录，并可进入手机号或邮箱登录、注册、密码找回及支持的第三方登录方式。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用 Lenovo ID 的应用将无法打开主登录界面及其中的登录和注册入口。

en.description: This Lenovo ID screen handles email-and-password or phone-and-password sign-in. The SDK opens it from the main login page or through the email/phone login actions; it also links to recovery and code-based login.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot sign in to Lenovo ID with an email or phone number and password.

zh-CN.description: 这是 Lenovo ID 的邮箱加密码或手机号加密码登录界面。SDK 可从主登录页打开它，也可通过邮箱或手机号登录操作启动；界面还提供找回密码和验证码登录入口。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法使用邮箱或手机号加密码登录 Lenovo ID。

en.description: This Lenovo ID screen signs in with a phone number and a one-time verification code instead of a password.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot complete Lenovo ID sign-in with a phone verification code.

zh-CN.description: 这是 Lenovo ID 的手机号验证码登录界面，用户可通过一次性验证码登录，而无需输入密码。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过手机号验证码完成 Lenovo ID 登录。

en.description: This Lenovo ID account-security guide appears when the user is asked to set a security question. Its continue button opens the contact-verification choices.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot start the guided setup of a Lenovo ID security question.

zh-CN.description: 这是 Lenovo ID 的帐号安全引导页，在系统提示用户设置安全问题时显示。点击继续后会进入联系方式验证选择。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法启动 Lenovo ID 安全问题设置引导。

en.description: This Lenovo ID screen starts real-name verification by asking the user to enter a mobile number and request a verification code. It is opened from account management or the SDK real-name verification request.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot start Lenovo ID real-name verification through this screen.

zh-CN.description: 这是 Lenovo ID 的实名认证入口，要求用户输入手机号并申请验证码。帐号管理页面或 SDK 的实名认证请求会打开它。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此界面启动 Lenovo ID 实名认证。

en.description: This Lenovo ID screen completes the phone-code step of real-name verification. It sends or resends a code and checks the code entered for the account.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot complete the phone verification required by this Lenovo ID real-name flow.

zh-CN.description: 这是 Lenovo ID 实名认证的手机验证码步骤。它发送或重发验证码，并验证用户为帐号输入的验证码。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法完成 Lenovo ID 实名认证所需的手机验证。

en.description: This Lenovo ID screen starts account registration with an email address. It collects the account details and, after submission, opens email verification; it also links to the service terms.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot register a Lenovo ID with an email address.

zh-CN.description: 这是 Lenovo ID 的邮箱注册入口，收集帐号资料并在提交后进入邮箱验证，同时提供服务协议入口。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法使用邮箱注册 Lenovo ID。

en.description: This Lenovo ID screen verifies the email address entered during registration with a one-time code. It continues to password setup after verification.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot verify an email address to continue Lenovo ID registration.

zh-CN.description: 这是 Lenovo ID 邮箱注册的验证码界面，通过一次性验证码验证注册邮箱。验证后会进入密码设置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法验证邮箱并继续 Lenovo ID 注册。

en.description: This Lenovo ID screen lets the user set and confirm a password after email verification to finish registration.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot finish email-based Lenovo ID registration by setting an account password.

zh-CN.description: 这是 Lenovo ID 邮箱注册的密码设置界面，用户在邮箱验证后设置并确认密码以完成注册。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过设置帐号密码完成 Lenovo ID 邮箱注册。

en.description: This Lenovo ID screen starts account registration with a phone number. It lets the user choose a dialing code, enter a number, and request the verification code.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot begin phone-based Lenovo ID registration.

zh-CN.description: 这是 Lenovo ID 的手机号注册入口，用户可选择区号、输入手机号并申请验证码。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法启动 Lenovo ID 手机号注册。

en.description: This Lenovo ID screen verifies the phone number entered during registration with an SMS code. It proceeds to password setup after the code is accepted.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot verify a phone number to continue Lenovo ID registration.

zh-CN.description: 这是 Lenovo ID 手机号注册的验证码界面，通过短信验证码验证注册手机号。验证码通过后会进入密码设置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法验证手机号并继续 Lenovo ID 注册。

en.description: This Lenovo ID screen lets the user set and confirm a password after phone verification to finish registration.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot finish phone-based Lenovo ID registration by setting an account password.

zh-CN.description: 这是 Lenovo ID 手机号注册的密码设置界面，用户在手机验证后设置并确认密码以完成注册。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过设置帐号密码完成 Lenovo ID 手机号注册。

en.description: This Lenovo ID Activity opens the web-based security-question page after account verification or from account management. It lets the user set or manage the account's security questions.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot set or manage Lenovo ID security questions through the SDK.

zh-CN.description: 这是 Lenovo ID 的网页安全问题 Activity，在帐号验证后或从帐号管理中打开。用户可在此设置或管理帐号安全问题。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 SDK 设置或管理 Lenovo ID 安全问题。

en.description: This Lenovo ID Activity displays the service agreement and privacy terms when the user opens them from registration or sign-in.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open the Lenovo ID service agreement or privacy terms from the account flow.

zh-CN.description: 这是 Lenovo ID 的服务协议和隐私条款页面，在用户从注册或登录界面打开相关条款时显示。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法从帐号流程打开 Lenovo ID 服务协议或隐私条款。

en.description: This Lenovo ID screen lets the user add or replace a security email address or phone number. It requests verification before saving the contact.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot add or replace the security phone or email used for Lenovo ID verification and recovery.

zh-CN.description: 这是 Lenovo ID 的安全联系方式设置界面，用户可添加或更换安全邮箱或手机号。保存前需要进行验证。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法添加或更换 Lenovo ID 验证和找回帐号使用的安全手机或邮箱。

en.description: This Lenovo ID screen verifies a newly added or changed security phone number or email with a one-time code before saving it.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot verify and finish adding or replacing a Lenovo ID security contact.

zh-CN.description: 这是 Lenovo ID 安全联系方式的验证码界面，在保存新增或更换的手机号或邮箱前验证一次性验证码。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法验证并完成 Lenovo ID 安全联系方式的添加或更换。

en.description: This is the final Lenovo ID step for changing the account's login phone number or email. It asks for the current password and submits the verified replacement contact.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot finish changing the Lenovo ID account's phone number or email.

zh-CN.description: 这是 Lenovo ID 更换登录手机号或邮箱的最后一步，要求输入当前密码，并提交已验证的新联系方式。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法完成 Lenovo ID 帐号手机号或邮箱的更换。

en.description: This Lenovo ID screen starts changing the account's login phone number or email. It collects the replacement contact and continues to verification.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot start changing the Lenovo ID account's phone number or email.

zh-CN.description: 这是 Lenovo ID 更换登录手机号或邮箱的入口，收集新的联系方式并进入验证步骤。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法启动 Lenovo ID 帐号手机号或邮箱更换流程。

en.description: This Lenovo ID screen verifies the replacement phone number or email with a one-time code before the account contact can be changed.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot verify the replacement contact or continue the Lenovo ID account-name change.

zh-CN.description: 这是 Lenovo ID 更换联系方式的验证码界面，在修改帐号联系方式前验证新的手机号或邮箱。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法验证新联系方式或继续更换 Lenovo ID 帐号信息。

en.description: Lenovo PayPlus opens its cashier for a game purchase and returns the payment result to the game.
en.disableEffect: Purchases routed through Lenovo PayPlus will fail.

zh-CN.description: 游戏发起购买时，联想 PayPlus 会打开收银页面，并将支付结果返回给游戏。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过联想 PayPlus 完成的购买将失败。

en.description: Lenovo PayPlus displays supported phone-card payment options when the player chooses carrier-card payment.
en.disableEffect: Phone-card purchases through Lenovo PayPlus will not complete.

zh-CN.description: 玩家选择手机充值卡支付时，联想 PayPlus 会显示可用的充值卡选项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过联想 PayPlus 使用手机充值卡购买将无法完成。

en.description: Lenovo PayPlus opens its web cashier for a purchase and routes WeChat Pay or Alipay links to the matching payment app, then returns the order result.
en.disableEffect: Lenovo PayPlus web checkout and the payment handoff will fail.

zh-CN.description: 联想 PayPlus 会为购买打开网页收银台，将微信或支付宝链接转交给相应支付应用，并返回订单结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 联想 PayPlus 网页收银台和支付交接将无法完成。

en.description: The Hangzhou Citizen Card ID Photo SDK opens this camera screen for an ID-photo order so the user can take or choose a portrait; the SDK then processes the image for the order.
en.disableEffect: The ID photo cannot be captured or processed in the app.

zh-CN.description: 杭州城市民卡证件照 SDK 会在证件照订单中打开此相机页面，供用户拍摄或选择照片；随后 SDK 会处理订单所需的图像。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法拍摄或处理证件照。

en.description: After a photo is submitted, the Hangzhou Citizen Card ID Photo SDK shows the qualification result and downloads the generated ID photo for the user to review.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot review the processed ID photo or its qualification result.

zh-CN.description: 照片提交后，杭州城市民卡证件照 SDK 会显示审核结果，并下载生成的证件照供用户查看。

en.description: The Loop Loyalty SDK opens this screen when a user selects a wheel to unlock or play. It loads the selected wheel, handles unlocking and spinning, and displays points and remaining attempts.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot unlock or play this wheel, so its rewards cannot be earned.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择解锁或游玩转盘时，Loop Loyalty SDK 会打开此页面。页面加载所选转盘，处理解锁和抽奖，并显示积分及剩余次数。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法解锁或游玩此转盘，也无法获得相应奖励。

en.description: The Loop Loyalty SDK opens this screen when a user selects the wheel-of-fortune game from the loyalty home. It lists available and unlocked wheels and lets the user choose one to unlock or play.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot browse or start Loop Loyalty wheel-of-fortune games.

zh-CN.description: 用户从忠诚度主页选择幸运转盘游戏时，Loop Loyalty SDK 会打开此页面。页面列出可用和已解锁的转盘，供用户选择解锁或游玩。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法浏览或开始 Loop Loyalty 幸运转盘游戏。

en.description: The Loop Loyalty SDK opens this screen for a selected dynamic quiz. It loads the quiz questions, records answers, and submits them to the loyalty service.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot answer or submit quizzes that use this question screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户开始动态答题时，Loop Loyalty SDK 会打开此页面。页面加载题目、记录答案，并将答案提交给忠诚度服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法回答或提交使用此答题页面的测验。

en.description: The Loop Loyalty SDK opens this screen when a user enters the Quizzlet section from the loyalty home. It loads the quiz and survey list and lets the user choose an item to open.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot browse or start Loop Loyalty quizzes and surveys from this list.

zh-CN.description: 用户从忠诚度主页进入 Quizzlet 答题区时，Loop Loyalty SDK 会打开此页面。页面加载测验和问卷列表，供用户选择并打开项目。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法从此列表浏览或开始 Loop Loyalty 测验和问卷。

en.description: The Loop Loyalty SDK opens this screen when a user starts a selected survey. It loads the questions, collects the answers, and submits the completed survey.
