en.disableEffect: Users cannot answer or submit surveys that use this screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户开始某份问卷时，Loop Loyalty SDK 会打开此页面。页面加载题目、收集答案，并提交已完成的问卷。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法回答或提交使用此页面的问卷。

en.description: The Loop Loyalty SDK opens this screen when a user selects a quiz or survey. It loads the selected item details and starts the matching question flow when the user chooses to begin.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot view quiz or survey details or start those activities from the Loop Loyalty list.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择测验或问卷时，Loop Loyalty SDK 会打开此详情页面。页面加载所选项目的信息，并在用户选择开始后进入对应答题流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法查看测验或问卷详情，也无法从 Loop Loyalty 列表启动相应活动。

en.description: The Loop Loyalty SDK opens this screen for a trivia quiz. It loads the questions, collects the user answers, and submits the quiz.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot answer or submit trivia quizzes that use this screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户开始知识问答时，Loop Loyalty SDK 会打开此页面。页面加载题目、收集用户答案，并提交测验结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法回答或提交使用此页面的知识问答。

en.description: The Loop Loyalty SDK opens this screen when a user views their points wallet or membership tier. It shows the selected points or tier tab and the related loyalty account information.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot view their Loop Loyalty points wallet or tier details from the app.

zh-CN.description: 用户查看积分账户或会员等级时，Loop Loyalty SDK 会打开此页面。页面显示所选积分或等级标签及相关忠诚度账户信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法在应用中查看 Loop Loyalty 积分账户或等级详情。

en.description: When the app connects to a NEXT robot's error feed, this service receives fault levels and messages from the robot for the app to show.
en.disableEffect: The app will no longer receive the robot's fault messages through this feed if disabled.

zh-CN.description: 应用连接 NEXT 机器人的错误信息通道时，此服务会接收机器人发来的故障等级和说明，供应用显示。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用将无法通过此通道接收机器人的故障信息。

en.description: When the app connects to a NEXT robot's laser feed, this service receives sensor scans and prepares them for display on the robot map.
en.disableEffect: The robot's live laser view will stop updating if this service is disabled.

zh-CN.description: 应用连接 NEXT 机器人的激光扫描通道时，此服务会接收传感器数据并整理后显示在机器人地图上。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，机器人地图上的实时激光扫描将停止更新。

en.description: When connected to a NEXT robot's navigation feed, this service receives navigation state and status messages for the app to display.
en.disableEffect: The app will no longer show live navigation progress and status from the robot if disabled.

zh-CN.description: 应用连接 NEXT 机器人后，此服务会接收导航状态信息，供应用显示。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用将无法显示机器人的实时导航进度和状态。

en.description: When connected to a NEXT robot, this service receives live battery, position, speed, task, and general status updates.
en.disableEffect: The app will no longer receive live status updates from the robot if disabled.

zh-CN.description: 应用连接 NEXT 机器人后，此服务会接收电量、位置、速度、任务和整体状态等实时信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用将无法接收机器人的实时状态更新。

en.description: The Malathi8190 LibraryCheckPro launcher opens the Zoho Mail inbox in its built-in browser when the app starts.
en.disableEffect: The app loses this launcher screen and its embedded inbox.

zh-CN.description: Malathi8190 LibraryCheckPro 的启动页面会在应用打开时通过内置浏览器显示 Zoho Mail 收件箱。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将失去此启动页面及其中的收件箱。

en.description: LicheeDev’s SomeLibrary context utility starts with the app and makes its application context available to the library. Other utility functions can use this context without an Activity being open.
en.disableEffect: SomeLibrary functions that need the app context may stop working.

zh-CN.description: LicheeDev 的 SomeLibrary 上下文工具会随应用启动，并将应用上下文提供给该库使用。即使没有页面打开，其他工具功能也能取得此上下文。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖应用上下文的 SomeLibrary 工具功能可能无法工作。

en.description: After Android updates or replaces the app, this LicheeDev Root Silent Install component records the new version and runs the app’s optional follow-up action.
en.disableEffect: The library’s configured post-update action will not run after the app is replaced.

zh-CN.description: Android 更新或替换应用后，LicheeDev Root Silent Install 组件会记录新版本，并运行应用配置的可选后续操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用被替换后，库中配置的更新后操作将不会执行。

en.description: LiePy ComposeAnimationKit includes this sample screen, which opens with the greeting “Hello, Android Animation Kit!”.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it only makes this sample greeting screen unavailable; other app screens can still use ComposeAnimationKit's animations.

zh-CN.description: LiePy ComposeAnimationKit 附带此示例页面，打开后会显示“Hello, Android Animation Kit!”问候语。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后只有此示例问候页面无法打开，应用的其他页面仍可使用 ComposeAnimationKit 动画。

en.description: Liferay Mobile SDK declares this Activity to receive OAuth sign-in return links. When Android opens the link here, it passes it to the AppAuth sign-in flow and closes this screen.
en.disableEffect: OAuth sign-ins that use this Liferay redirect will not return to the app and may fail.

zh-CN.description: Liferay Mobile SDK 使用此 Activity 接收 OAuth 登录返回链接。Android 打开链接后，它会将链接交给 AppAuth 登录流程，然后关闭此页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此 Liferay 回调的 OAuth 登录无法返回应用，可能会失败。

en.description: Liferay Mobile OAuth opens this Activity to start sign-in, show the authorization page in a browser, and handle the return link to retrieve access credentials.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot complete sign-ins that use this Liferay OAuth flow.

zh-CN.description: Liferay Mobile OAuth 会打开此 Activity 启动登录、在浏览器中显示授权页面，并处理返回链接以获取访问凭据。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法完成使用此 Liferay OAuth 流程的登录。

en.description: Liferay Screens sets up its app components automatically when the app starts.
en.disableEffect: Liferay Screens features may not initialize correctly.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，Liferay Screens 会自动初始化其应用组件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Liferay Screens 功能可能无法正常初始化。

en.description: Liferay Screens opens this screen when a feature asks the user to choose a photo or video, or capture one with the camera. It returns the selected media to the requesting feature.
en.disableEffect: Photo/video selection and camera capture in Liferay Screens will fail.

zh-CN.description: Liferay Screens 的功能需要用户选择照片或视频、或使用相机拍摄时，会打开此页面。它会将选中的媒体返回给发起请求的功能。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Liferay Screens 中的照片或视频选择、相机拍摄功能将无法使用。

en.description: Liferay Screens uses this file provider to give the camera app access to a file when the user takes a photo or records a video.
en.disableEffect: Liferay Screens cannot provide the output file to the camera app, so photo and video capture will fail.

zh-CN.description: 用户拍照或录像时，Liferay Screens 会通过此文件 Provider 向相机应用提供输出文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Liferay Screens 无法向相机应用提供输出文件，因此拍照和录像将失败。

en.description: Liferay Screens receives this broadcast after a successful login to start syncing changes saved for later. The library uses it to resume pending form, comment, and other cached updates.
en.disableEffect: Pending offline changes may not sync after login, so updates made while offline can remain unsent.

zh-CN.description: 成功登录后，Liferay Screens 会收到此广播并开始同步暂存的更改，用于恢复待提交的表单、评论等缓存更新。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 登录后暂存的离线更改可能无法同步，导致离线时的更新一直未发送。

en.description: After login and when the network is available, Liferay Screens runs this service to send cached form, comment, rating, portrait, and document changes to the Liferay site.
en.disableEffect: Cached changes made while offline may remain unsent and out of date on the Liferay site.

zh-CN.description: 登录且网络可用后，Liferay Screens 会运行此服务，将缓存的表单、评论、评分、头像和文档更改发送到 Liferay 网站。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 离线期间缓存的更改可能一直未发送到 Liferay 网站，造成数据未更新。

en.description: Liferay Screens runs this service when a user submits a form containing a document. It uploads the selected file to the Liferay site and returns the result to the form.
en.disableEffect: Document uploads from Liferay forms will fail.

zh-CN.description: 用户提交包含文档的表单时，Liferay Screens 会运行此服务，将所选文件上传到 Liferay 网站并把结果返回表单。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Liferay 表单中的文档将无法上传。

en.description: After a Liferay form is submitted, this screen displays the success headline and message provided for that form.
en.disableEffect: The success page for Liferay form submissions will not open.

zh-CN.description: Liferay 表单提交后，此页面会显示该表单提供的成功标题和说明。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Liferay 表单提交后的成功页面将无法打开。

en.description: When a user downloads a file from a Liferay site, this service saves it to the requested local path and reports progress. It includes the app’s Liferay authentication headers in the request.
en.disableEffect: Downloading files from Liferay Screens will fail.

zh-CN.description: 用户从 Liferay 网站下载文件时，此服务会将文件保存到指定位置并报告进度，且请求会携带应用的 Liferay 身份验证信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Liferay Screens 将无法下载文件。

en.description: When a user uploads an image to a Liferay image gallery, this service sends the selected picture and its details to the Liferay site.
en.disableEffect: Image uploads from Liferay galleries will fail.

zh-CN.description: 用户向 Liferay 图片库上传图片时，此服务会将所选图片及其信息发送到 Liferay 网站。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Liferay 图片库中的图片将无法上传。

en.description: When a user changes their profile picture, this service prepares the image and uploads it as the Liferay account portrait.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to update their profile picture through Liferay Screens.

zh-CN.description: 用户更换个人头像时，此服务会处理图片并将其上传为 Liferay 账户头像。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 Liferay Screens 更新个人头像。

en.description: When a user opens a Liferay gallery image, this screen displays it and lets them browse adjacent images with swipes.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to open the full-screen image viewer in Liferay galleries.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 Liferay 图片库中的图片时，此页面会显示大图，并允许用户滑动浏览相邻图片。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在 Liferay 图片库中打开全屏图片查看器。

en.description: LikeMinds Custom Gallery (LikeMinds) opens this Activity after the user selects media to preview or edit. It shows image, video, document or audio editing screens according to the selected item.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot open this media preview or editing screen, so gallery-based media attachments may not finish.

zh-CN.description: LikeMinds Custom Gallery（LikeMinds）会在用户选中媒体后打开此 Activity 以预览或编辑内容。它会根据所选项目显示图片、视频、文档或音频编辑界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用无法打开该媒体预览或编辑界面，因此通过图库添加媒体的流程无法完成。

en.description: LikeMinds Custom Gallery (LikeMinds) opens this Activity when the app requests photo, video, document or audio attachments. It lets the user browse local media or Android's document picker, then returns the selection to the app.
en.disableEffect: The app loses this media picker, so screens that attach files through it cannot complete.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求添加照片、视频、文档或音频时，LikeMinds Custom Gallery（LikeMinds）会打开此 Activity。用户可以浏览本地媒体或 Android 文档选择器，然后将所选内容返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用将无法使用此媒体选择器，通过它添加文件的流程无法完成。

en.description: LikeMinds Master Feed SDK (LikeMinds) opens this Activity when the app launches its community activity feed. It displays the activity feed provided by the community.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open the community activity feed through this screen.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开社区动态时，LikeMinds Master Feed SDK（LikeMinds）会启动此 Activity。它显示社区提供的动态内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过此界面查看社区动态。

en.description: LikeMinds Master Feed SDK (LikeMinds) opens this Activity from a community post when the user views its likes. It lists the members who liked that post.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open the list of members who liked a post.

zh-CN.description: 用户查看社区帖子的点赞情况时，LikeMinds Master Feed SDK（LikeMinds）会打开此 Activity。它列出为该帖子点赞的成员。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法查看为帖子点赞的成员列表。

en.description: LikeMinds Master Feed SDK (LikeMinds) opens this Activity when the user creates a poll for a community post; it can also receive an existing poll for editing. The screen contains the poll composer.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot create or edit polls through the LikeMinds feed.

zh-CN.description: 用户为社区帖子创建投票时，LikeMinds Master Feed SDK（LikeMinds）会打开此 Activity；它也可以载入已有投票供用户编辑。此界面用于编辑投票内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过 LikeMinds 动态创建或编辑投票。

en.description: LikeMinds Master Feed SDK (LikeMinds) opens this Activity when a user views a community poll's results. It shows the selected poll and its result screen.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open poll results through the LikeMinds feed.

zh-CN.description: 用户查看社区投票结果时，LikeMinds Master Feed SDK（LikeMinds）会打开此 Activity。它显示所选投票及其结果界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过 LikeMinds 动态查看投票结果。

en.description: LikeMinds Master Feed SDK (LikeMinds) opens this Activity when the user starts writing a community post. It displays the post composer and returns to the feed flow.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot create community posts through the LikeMinds feed.

zh-CN.description: 用户开始撰写社区帖子时，LikeMinds Master Feed SDK（LikeMinds）会打开此 Activity。它显示发帖编辑界面，并接入动态发布流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过 LikeMinds 动态发布社区帖子。

en.description: LikeMinds Master Feed SDK (LikeMinds) opens this Activity when the user selects a community post to read in detail. It displays the post and its discussion screen.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open the detailed post and discussion screen through the LikeMinds feed.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择查看社区帖子的详情时，LikeMinds Master Feed SDK（LikeMinds）会打开此 Activity。它显示帖子及其讨论界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过 LikeMinds 动态打开帖子详情和讨论界面。

en.description: LikeMinds Master Feed SDK (LikeMinds) opens this Activity when the user edits an existing community post. It loads the selected post into the editing screen.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot edit community posts through the LikeMinds feed.

zh-CN.description: 用户编辑已有社区帖子时，LikeMinds Master Feed SDK（LikeMinds）会打开此 Activity。它会将所选帖子载入编辑界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过 LikeMinds 动态编辑社区帖子。

en.description: LikeMinds Master Feed SDK (LikeMinds) opens this Activity when the user reports content in the community feed. It displays the report form for the selected item.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot submit reports about feed content through the LikeMinds SDK.

zh-CN.description: 用户举报社区动态中的内容时，LikeMinds Master Feed SDK（LikeMinds）会打开此 Activity。它显示针对所选内容的举报表单。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过 LikeMinds SDK 举报动态内容。

en.description: LikeMinds Master Feed SDK (LikeMinds) opens this Activity when the app starts a search in the community feed. It displays the feed search screen for the supplied search options.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot search the LikeMinds community feed through this screen.

zh-CN.description: 应用在社区动态中启动搜索时，LikeMinds Master Feed SDK（LikeMinds）会打开此 Activity。它根据传入的搜索选项显示动态搜索界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过此界面搜索 LikeMinds 社区动态。

en.description: LikeMinds Master Feed SDK (LikeMinds) opens this Activity when the user chooses community topics. It displays the topic-selection screen used to update the feed's topic choices.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open the LikeMinds topic-selection screen to change their feed topics.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择社区主题时，LikeMinds Master Feed SDK（LikeMinds）会打开此 Activity。它显示主题选择界面，用于更新动态中的主题偏好。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法打开 LikeMinds 主题选择界面来更改动态主题。

en.description: LikeMinds Feed SX opens this Activity when the user views who liked a post. It displays the post's member list of likes.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open the list of members who liked a Feed SX post.

zh-CN.description: 用户查看帖子有哪些人点赞时，LikeMinds Feed SX 会打开此 Activity。它显示该帖子的点赞成员列表。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法查看 Feed SX 帖子的点赞成员列表。

en.description: LikeMinds Feed SX opens this Activity when the user attaches media to a feed post. It lets the user browse folders, select images or videos, and choose documents from Android's file picker.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot attach media or documents through the Feed SX picker.

zh-CN.description: 用户为动态帖子添加媒体时，LikeMinds Feed SX 会打开此 Activity。用户可以浏览文件夹、选择图片或视频，也可以使用 Android 文件选择器挑选文档。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过 Feed SX 选择器为帖子添加媒体或文档。

en.description: LikeMinds Feed SX opens this Activity when the user opens the community notification feed. It displays the notifications and activity items supplied by Feed SX.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open the Feed SX notification feed from the app.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开社区通知动态时，LikeMinds Feed SX 会启动此 Activity。它显示 Feed SX 提供的通知和动态条目。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法从应用打开 Feed SX 通知动态。

en.description: LikeMinds Feed SX opens this Activity when the user starts composing a feed post. It displays the post editor and can carry the post's source information.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot create feed posts through LikeMinds Feed SX.

zh-CN.description: 用户开始撰写动态帖子时，LikeMinds Feed SX 会打开此 Activity。它显示帖子编辑界面，并可接收帖子来源信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过 LikeMinds Feed SX 创建动态帖子。

en.description: LikeMinds Feed SX opens this Activity when the user selects a feed post to read. It displays the post details and discussion screen.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open Feed SX post details and discussion from the feed.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择阅读动态帖子时，LikeMinds Feed SX 会打开此 Activity。它显示帖子详情和讨论界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法从 Feed SX 动态打开帖子详情和讨论界面。

en.description: LikeMinds Feed SX opens this Activity when the user edits an existing feed post. It loads the selected post into the editing flow.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot edit feed posts through LikeMinds Feed SX.

zh-CN.description: 用户编辑已有动态帖子时，LikeMinds Feed SX 会打开此 Activity。它会将所选帖子载入编辑流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过 LikeMinds Feed SX 编辑动态帖子。

en.description: LikeMinds Feed SX opens this Activity when the user reports content in the feed. It displays a report form for the selected item.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot report Feed SX content through this screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户举报动态内容时，LikeMinds Feed SX 会打开此 Activity。它显示针对所选条目的举报表单。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过此界面举报 Feed SX 内容。

en.description: LikeMinds Feed SX opens this Activity when the user chooses or changes community topics. It displays the topic-selection screen for the feed.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open Feed SX topic selection to change their community topics.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择或更改社区主题时，LikeMinds Feed SX 会打开此 Activity。它显示动态主题选择界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法打开 Feed SX 主题选择界面来更改社区主题。

en.description: LikeMinds Chat-v1 opens this Activity when a user enters a chatroom or discussion card. It hosts the room's discussion screen, including its active threads.
en.disableEffect: Users can no longer open chatroom details or read and respond in a room through this screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户进入聊天室或讨论卡片时，LikeMinds Chat-v1 会打开此 Activity。它显示聊天室讨论内容及其进行中的话题。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过此页面打开聊天室详情、阅读讨论或参与回复。

en.description: LikeMinds Chat-v1 opens this Activity from a chat poll's results action. It shows the poll results and the related response tabs.
en.disableEffect: Users lose the poll results screen and cannot view responses there.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 LikeMinds Chat-v1 中查看投票结果时会打开此 Activity。它显示投票结果和相关的回复列表。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法打开此投票结果页面查看回复。

en.description: LikeMinds Chat-v1 opens this Activity when a user views a chatroom's participants. The screen lists the room's members and can open their profiles.
en.disableEffect: Users can no longer view a room's participant list or open member profiles from it.

zh-CN.description: 用户查看聊天室参与者时，LikeMinds Chat-v1 会打开此 Activity。页面列出聊天室成员，并可继续打开成员资料。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法查看聊天室成员列表，也无法从列表打开成员资料。

en.description: LikeMinds Chat-v1 opens this Activity when a user chooses to explore chatrooms. It presents rooms the user can browse and join.
en.disableEffect: Users lose the chatroom discovery and join flow.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择探索聊天室时，LikeMinds Chat-v1 会打开此 Activity。页面展示可浏览和加入的聊天室。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法使用聊天室发现和加入流程。

en.description: LikeMinds Chat-v1 opens this Activity during community onboarding or member-profile editing. It shows the profile fields requested by that community and returns the result to the chat flow.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot complete or update a LikeMinds member profile through this flow.

zh-CN.description: LikeMinds Chat-v1 会在社区引导或成员资料编辑期间打开此 Activity。页面显示该社区要求填写的资料项，并将结果交回聊天流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过此流程完成或更新 LikeMinds 成员资料。

en.description: LikeMinds Chat-v1 opens this searchable choice screen from the member-profile editor when a user needs to select profile options. The selection is returned to the editor.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot choose the options required by the related profile step.

zh-CN.description: 成员编辑资料时需要选择资料选项，LikeMinds Chat-v1 会打开此搜索选择页面，并将选择结果交回编辑页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法选择相关资料步骤要求的选项。

en.description: LikeMinds Chat-v1 starts this foreground service when an audio or voice attachment is played. It plays the selected recording, keeps playback active with a notification, and reports progress to the chat screen.
en.disableEffect: Voice messages and audio attachments can no longer play through LikeMinds Chat-v1.

zh-CN.description: 播放音频或语音附件时，LikeMinds Chat-v1 会启动此前台服务。它播放选中的录音、通过通知保持播放，并向聊天页面报告进度。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，LikeMinds Chat-v1 将无法播放语音消息和音频附件。

en.description: LikeMinds Chat-v1 opens this Activity when a user views media shared in a conversation or chatroom. It provides photo and video browsing, along with related media-send and editing screens.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot browse shared media or use the chat SDK's media-editing screens.

zh-CN.description: 用户查看会话或聊天室中分享的媒体时，LikeMinds Chat-v1 会打开此 Activity。页面支持浏览照片和视频，也承载相关的媒体发送和编辑页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法浏览已分享的媒体或使用聊天 SDK 的媒体编辑页面。

en.description: LikeMinds Chat-v1 opens this Activity when a user attaches files to a conversation or chatroom. It lets them choose photos or videos, audio, and documents after checking the required media access.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot select media or documents for chat messages through this picker.

zh-CN.description: 用户为会话或聊天室添加附件时，LikeMinds Chat-v1 会打开此 Activity。它会先检查所需的媒体访问权限，再让用户选择照片、视频、音频或文档。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过此选择页面为聊天消息添加媒体或文档。

en.description: LikeMinds Chat-v1 opens this Activity for moderators changing a community member's permissions or title. It displays that member's moderation controls and saves the changes.
en.disableEffect: Moderators cannot change member permissions or titles through LikeMinds Chat-v1.

zh-CN.description: 管理员或版主修改社区成员权限或头衔时，LikeMinds Chat-v1 会打开此 Activity。页面显示该成员的管理选项并保存更改。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，管理员或版主无法通过 LikeMinds Chat-v1 修改成员权限或头衔。

en.description: LikeMinds Chat-v1 opens this Activity when a user enters its reporting flow. It presents report reasons and submits the report for review.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot submit reports through LikeMinds Chat-v1.

zh-CN.description: 用户进入 LikeMinds Chat-v1 的举报流程时会打开此 Activity。页面提供举报原因，并将举报提交审核。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过 LikeMinds Chat-v1 提交举报。

en.description: LikeMinds Chat-v1 opens this Activity when a member enters an onboarding flow. It hosts the onboarding steps and collects the information requested by that flow.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot complete the LikeMinds onboarding flow.

zh-CN.description: 成员进入引导流程时，LikeMinds Chat-v1 会打开此 Activity。页面承载引导步骤并收集该流程要求的信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法完成 LikeMinds 引导流程。

en.description: LikeMinds Chat-v1 opens this Activity when a user views a community member's profile. It displays that member's profile and related community information.
en.disableEffect: Users can no longer open member profiles from LikeMinds Chat-v1.

zh-CN.description: 用户查看社区成员资料时，LikeMinds Chat-v1 会打开此 Activity。页面显示成员资料及相关社区信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法从 LikeMinds Chat-v1 打开成员资料。

en.description: LikeMinds Chat-v1 opens this Activity when a user starts a search. It shows matching chatrooms and messages and can open a result in its chatroom.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot search chatrooms or messages through LikeMinds Chat-v1.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 LikeMinds Chat-v1 中开始搜索时会打开此 Activity。页面显示匹配的聊天室和消息，并可打开结果所在的聊天室。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过 LikeMinds Chat-v1 搜索聊天室或消息。

en.description: LikeMinds Chat-v1 runs this receiver when a user taps follow, reply, or mark-as-read actions in a chat notification. It also handles other notification buttons, such as voting or event actions, by submitting the requested action or opening its related screen.
en.disableEffect: Chat and event notification buttons stop updating or opening their related content.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击聊天通知中的关注、回复或标为已读操作时，LikeMinds Chat-v1 会运行此 Receiver。它也处理投票或活动等通知按钮，提交相应操作或打开相关页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，聊天和活动通知按钮无法更新状态或打开相关内容。

en.description: LikeMinds Sample Library declares this Activity as an app-launcher entry, but the class adds no screen content or action of its own.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it removes this app-launcher entry; if no other launcher screen exists, users cannot open the sample app from its icon.

zh-CN.description: LikeMinds Sample Library 将此活动声明为应用启动器入口，但该类本身没有添加界面内容或操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后会移除此启动器入口；如果没有其他启动界面，用户将无法通过应用图标打开示例应用。

en.description: When Firebase Cloud Messaging delivers a message, LINE ABC's remote notification SDK passes it to the app's registered notification handlers; it also forwards new registration tokens and deleted-message notices.
en.disableEffect: LINE ABC's notification handlers will stop receiving messages through this Service and will not receive its token updates.

zh-CN.description: Firebase Cloud Messaging 收到消息时，LINE ABC 远程通知 SDK 会将消息转交给应用注册的通知处理器；此 Service 也会转交新的注册令牌和消息删除通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，LINE ABC 的通知处理器将无法通过此 Service 收到推送消息或令牌更新。

en.description: When an app starts LINE sign-in, the LINE Android SDK opens this Activity to carry out authorization and return the login result to the app.
en.disableEffect: App features that rely on LINE sign-in cannot complete authorization.

zh-CN.description: 应用发起 LINE 登录时，LINE Android SDK 会打开此 Activity 完成授权，并将登录结果返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖 LINE 登录的应用功能将无法完成授权。

en.description: When LINE sign-in returns to the app, this exported Activity receives the redirect link and passes it back to the sign-in flow so authorization can finish.
en.disableEffect: LINE sign-in redirects cannot return their result to the app.

zh-CN.description: LINE 登录返回应用时，系统会将回调链接交给此 Activity，再转回登录流程以完成授权。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，LINE 登录回调无法将授权结果返回应用。

en.description: When an app starts the LINE OpenChat creation flow, this Activity guides the user through room details and profile steps, then returns the creation result to the app.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot create an OpenChat room through the LINE SDK.

zh-CN.description: 应用发起创建 LINE OpenChat 房间流程时，此 Activity 会引导用户填写聊天室资料和个人资料，并将创建结果返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用无法通过 LINE SDK 创建 OpenChat 房间。

en.description: LinkedIn's Shaky feedback SDK opens this Activity for bug, feature, or general feedback. Users can enter a message and optionally mark up a screenshot.
en.disableEffect: The in-app Shaky feedback and bug-report form will not open.

zh-CN.description: LinkedIn 的 Shaky 反馈 SDK 会打开此 Activity 收集问题、功能建议或一般反馈；用户可填写说明，也可在截图上标注。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用内的 Shaky 反馈和问题报告表单无法打开。

en.description: During Shaky's screenshot-for-feedback flow, this foreground Service shows a persistent 'Capturing Screenshot' notification while the screenshot is processed, then stops when capture ends.
en.disableEffect: Shaky cannot use this foreground Service to complete its feedback screenshot flow.

zh-CN.description: Shaky 为反馈截取屏幕时，此前台 Service 会在处理截图期间显示持续通知，并在截取结束后停止。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Shaky 无法使用此 Service 完成反馈截图流程。

en.description: During automated tests, LinkedIn Test Butler uses this Accessibility Service to signal when it connects or shuts down so test setup can wait for the change; it does not handle the app's normal screens.
en.disableEffect: Test Butler cannot wait for this Accessibility Service to start or stop; normal app use is unaffected.

zh-CN.description: 自动化测试期间，LinkedIn Test Butler 会通过此无障碍服务通知测试流程服务何时连接或关闭；它不处理应用的日常页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Test Butler 无法等待此无障碍服务启动或关闭；应用日常使用不受影响。

en.description: When an app using linshuaishuai’s ErJia Android library launches its place finder, this Activity displays the search screen using the place-service setup supplied by the app.
en.disableEffect: Apps using ErJia could not open this place-search screen.

zh-CN.description: 使用 linshuaishuai 的 ErJia Android 库的应用打开地点查找器时，此 Activity 会使用应用提供的地点服务配置显示搜索页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用 ErJia 的应用将无法打开此地点搜索页面。

en.description: When an app using linshuaishuai’s ErJia Android library opens a set of photos, this Activity displays them in a swipeable gallery starting at the selected image. Tapping a photo shows or hides the toolbar.
en.disableEffect: Apps using ErJia could no longer open these photo galleries.

zh-CN.description: 使用 linshuaishuai 的 ErJia Android 库的应用打开一组照片时，此 Activity 会从选定图片开始显示可滑动的图库。点击照片可以显示或隐藏工具栏。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用 ErJia 的应用将无法打开此类照片图库。

en.description: XTool (WeiShuaiDev) is a crash and network-reporting SDK. This provider runs automatically when the app starts, initializes XTool crash capture, and suppresses XTool notifications.
en.disableEffect: XTool will no longer automatically initialize crash capture or its reporting tools.

zh-CN.description: XTool（WeiShuaiDev）是崩溃和网络日志 SDK。此 Provider 会随应用启动自动运行，初始化 XTool 崩溃捕获，并关闭 XTool 通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: XTool 将不再自动初始化崩溃捕获和日志工具。

en.description: XTool (WeiShuaiDev) opens this screen when its floating diagnostic bubble is tapped. It offers shortcuts to crash reports and network logs.
en.disableEffect: The floating XTool shortcut will no longer open its report menu.

zh-CN.description: 点击 XTool（WeiShuaiDev）的悬浮诊断气泡时会打开此页面。页面提供崩溃报告和网络日志入口。
zh-CN.disableEffect: XTool 悬浮快捷入口将无法再打开报告菜单。

en.description: XTool (WeiShuaiDev) opens this screen from its diagnostic menu or a crash alert. It lists saved crashes and exceptions and lets users clear the stored reports.
en.disableEffect: Users will lose XTool's crash and exception report list and its clear-reports option.

zh-CN.description: XTool（WeiShuaiDev）会从诊断菜单或崩溃通知打开此页面。页面列出已保存的崩溃和异常报告，并可清除这些报告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法查看 XTool 的崩溃和异常报告列表，也无法在此清除报告。

en.description: XTool (WeiShuaiDev) opens this screen when a saved crash report is selected. It displays the report text and device details and offers sharing or deleting the report.
en.disableEffect: Users will lose XTool's crash-report detail, sharing, and deletion screen.

zh-CN.description: 选择已保存的崩溃报告时，XTool（WeiShuaiDev）会打开此页面。页面显示报告内容和设备信息，并可分享或删除报告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 XTool 查看崩溃报告详情、分享或删除报告。

en.description: XTool (WeiShuaiDev) opens this screen when a user taps a saved app log in its network-report list. It displays the log text and offers sharing or deleting the file.
en.disableEffect: Users will lose XTool's app-log detail, sharing, and deletion screen.

zh-CN.description: 在 XTool（WeiShuaiDev）的网络报告列表中点击应用日志时会打开此页面。页面显示日志内容，并可分享或删除日志文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 XTool 查看应用日志详情、分享或删除日志。

en.description: XTool (WeiShuaiDev) opens this screen when a user selects an HTTP record in its network-report list. It shows the address, response status, timing, headers, and request and response data, and offers sharing or deleting the record.
en.disableEffect: Users will lose XTool's HTTP request and response detail, sharing, and deletion screen.

zh-CN.description: 在 XTool（WeiShuaiDev）的网络报告列表中选择 HTTP 记录时会打开此页面。页面显示网址、响应状态、耗时、请求头以及请求和响应数据，并可分享或删除记录。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 XTool 查看 HTTP 请求和响应详情、分享或删除记录。

en.description: XTool (WeiShuaiDev) opens this screen when a user chooses network reports from its diagnostic menu. It has separate lists for HTTP requests and app logs and can clear saved logs.
en.disableEffect: Users will lose XTool's network and app-log lists and the option to clear them.

zh-CN.description: 用户从 XTool（WeiShuaiDev）的诊断菜单选择网络报告时会打开此页面。页面分别列出 HTTP 请求和应用日志，并可清除已保存的日志。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法查看 XTool 的网络和应用日志列表，也无法在此清除日志。

en.description: XTool (WeiShuaiDev) binds this service when its floating diagnostic tool is enabled. It keeps the on-screen shortcut and its drag-to-remove area available.
en.disableEffect: The floating XTool shortcut will disappear, so users cannot open diagnostics from the bubble.

zh-CN.description: 启用 XTool（WeiShuaiDev）的悬浮诊断工具时会绑定此 Service。它负责显示屏幕上的快捷气泡和拖动删除区域。
zh-CN.disableEffect: XTool 悬浮快捷气泡将消失，用户无法从气泡打开诊断工具。

en.description: IPicker opens this Activity when the app asks the user to choose photos. It lists local photos, supports single or multiple selection, can take a new photo, and can open the crop screen.
en.disableEffect: The app's IPicker photo-selection and in-picker camera flow will be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求用户选择照片时，IPicker 会打开此 Activity 显示本机照片，支持单选或多选，也可拍摄新照片并进入裁剪界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用通过 IPicker 选择照片或在选择器内拍照的流程将无法使用。

en.description: IPicker opens this Activity after the user chooses a photo to crop. It displays the crop area and returns the saved image when the user confirms.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot complete image-cropping flows that use IPicker.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择需要裁剪的照片后，IPicker 会打开此 Activity 显示裁剪区域，并在用户确认后返回保存的图片。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用无法通过 IPicker 完成图片裁剪流程。

en.description: Liulishuo's FileDownloader library uses this service when the app runs downloads in a separate background process. It carries out download requests and reports progress.
en.disableEffect: File downloads that depend on this process may fail to start or lose their progress updates.

zh-CN.description: 应用在独立后台进程中运行下载时，Liulishuo 的 FileDownloader 库会使用此服务处理下载请求并报告进度。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此进程的文件下载可能无法启动或无法更新进度。

en.description: Liulishuo's FileDownloader library uses this service when downloads run alongside the main app. It carries out download requests and reports progress.
en.disableEffect: File downloads that depend on this service may fail to start or lose their progress updates.

zh-CN.description: 应用在主程序中运行下载时，Liulishuo 的 FileDownloader 库会使用此服务处理下载请求并报告进度。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此服务的文件下载可能无法启动或无法更新进度。

en.description: Liulishuo FileDownloader uses this Service in a separate process to run queued file downloads.
en.disableEffect: App features that rely on Liulishuo FileDownloader may be unable to start or resume downloads.

zh-CN.description: Liulishuo FileDownloader 会在独立进程中使用此 Service 执行排队的文件下载。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖 Liulishuo FileDownloader 的应用功能可能无法启动或恢复下载。

en.description: Liulishuo FileDownloader uses this Service in the main process to run queued file downloads.
en.disableEffect: App features that rely on Liulishuo FileDownloader may be unable to start or resume downloads.

zh-CN.description: Liulishuo FileDownloader 会在主进程中使用此 Service 执行排队的文件下载。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖 Liulishuo FileDownloader 的应用功能可能无法启动或恢复下载。

en.description: At process startup, OkDownload uses this Provider to save the app context required by its default downloader when the app first requests a download.
en.disableEffect: Without the Provider, OkDownload's default downloader fails to initialize and downloads that use it cannot run.

zh-CN.description: 应用进程启动时，OkDownload 会通过此 Provider 保存应用上下文，供默认下载器在首次下载时使用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，OkDownload 默认下载器无法初始化，依赖它的下载任务将无法执行。

en.description: The 6xyun Mediaer library uses this private file provider to make a temporary file link when an image must be handed to an Android screen for selection or cropping.
en.disableEffect: Mediaer actions that need to pass an image through this file link, including cropping, may fail.

zh-CN.description: 6xyun Mediaer 媒体库在需要把图片交给安卓界面进行选择或裁剪时，通过此文件提供方生成临时文件链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要通过此链接传递图片的 Mediaer 操作（包括裁剪）可能无法完成。

en.description: The 6xyun Multimedia library uses this private file provider to make a temporary file link when a media file must be handed to an Android screen for selection or cropping.
en.disableEffect: Multimedia actions that need to pass a media file through this link, including cropping, may fail.

zh-CN.description: 6xyun Multimedia 媒体库在需要把媒体文件交给安卓界面进行选择或裁剪时，通过此文件提供方生成临时文件链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要通过此链接传递媒体文件的 Multimedia 操作（包括裁剪）可能无法完成。

en.description: The 6xyun Pay library opens UnionPay in-app checkout for an order and returns the success, failure, cancellation, or unavailable result to the payment flow.
en.disableEffect: Payments that use the 6xyun UnionPay checkout flow cannot be completed.

zh-CN.description: 6xyun Pay 会为订单打开银联应用内支付界面，并把成功、失败、取消或无法使用的结果返回给支付流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用 6xyun 银联支付流程的订单将无法完成支付。

en.description: The 6xyun QR scanner opens a camera preview when the app starts a scan, reads a QR code, and returns its text. It also offers a light control when the camera supports one.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot open this scanner to read and return QR code text.

zh-CN.description: 6xyun 二维码扫描器会在应用发起扫码时打开相机预览，读取二维码并返回其中的文本；相机支持时还可切换补光灯。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用无法打开此扫描界面来读取并返回二维码内容。

en.description: The 6xyun Service library receives Android’s completed-boot event and records it; its receiver does no other work.
en.disableEffect: Only this boot-event log entry is lost; the inspected receiver performs no other action.

zh-CN.description: 6xyun Service 库会在安卓启动完成时接收并记录该事件；接收器没有执行其他操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后只会少记一条启动事件；检查到的接收器没有其他行为。

en.description: When Android initializes the 6xyun Service library during app startup, this provider starts its service manager, which discovers and starts registered background services.
en.disableEffect: The 6xyun service manager will not start through this app-start path, so its registered services will not be started by it.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，安卓会初始化 6xyun Service 库的此内容提供方；它会启动服务管理器，由管理器发现并启动已登记的后台服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 6xyun 服务管理器无法通过此启动路径运行，因此不会由它启动已登记的服务。

en.description: The 6xyun Service library runs this manager in the background, announces when it is ready, and starts service modules registered by the app.
en.disableEffect: Service modules registered with the 6xyun manager will not be started or tracked through this service.

zh-CN.description: 6xyun Service 库会在后台运行此管理服务，在准备就绪后启动应用登记的服务模块。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用登记的服务模块将无法通过此服务启动或跟踪。

en.description: The 6xyun SM library receives Android’s boot and locked-boot events and records them; its receiver does no other work.
en.disableEffect: Only these boot-event log entries are lost; the inspected receiver performs no other action.

zh-CN.description: 6xyun SM 库会接收安卓启动完成和首次解锁前的启动事件并记录下来；接收器没有执行其他操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后只会少记这些启动事件；检查到的接收器没有其他行为。

en.description: When Android initializes the 6xyun SM library during app startup, this provider starts the service manager that connects to registered background modules.
en.disableEffect: The 6xyun SM manager will not be started through this app-start path, so its registered modules will not connect through it.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，安卓会初始化 6xyun SM 库的此内容提供方；它会启动服务管理器以连接已登记的后台模块。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 6xyun SM 管理器无法通过此启动路径运行，因此已登记的模块也无法通过它连接。

en.description: The 6xyun SM library receives Android’s boot and locked-boot events and records them; its receiver does no other work.
en.disableEffect: Only these boot-event log entries are lost; the inspected receiver performs no other action.

zh-CN.description: 6xyun SM 库会接收安卓启动完成和首次解锁前的启动事件并记录下来；接收器没有执行其他操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后只会少记这些启动事件；检查到的接收器没有其他行为。

en.description: When the app process starts, this 6xyun SM provider connects to the background service manager so that the library’s registered services can initialize.
en.disableEffect: The 6xyun SM manager will not receive this startup connection, so registered services may not initialize through it.

zh-CN.description: 应用进程启动时，6xyun SM 内容提供方会连接后台服务管理器，使该库登记的服务能够初始化。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 6xyun SM 管理器无法收到此启动连接，已登记的服务可能无法通过它初始化。

en.description: The 6xyun SM manager runs in the background, announces when it is ready, and binds to registered services. It also rediscovers services after apps are added or replaced.
en.disableEffect: The 6xyun SM manager will not connect to or monitor the registered service modules.

zh-CN.description: 6xyun SM 管理器在后台运行，准备就绪后连接已登记的服务；安装或更新应用后也会重新发现这些服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 6xyun SM 管理器将无法连接或监控已登记的服务模块。

en.description: The earlier 6xyun SM manager starts registered service modules when ready and checks for them again after apps are added or replaced.
en.disableEffect: Background service modules that rely on this earlier 6xyun manager will not start through it.

zh-CN.description: 早期版本的 6xyun SM 管理服务会在就绪后启动已登记的服务模块，并在安装或更新应用后重新检查这些模块。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此早期 6xyun 管理服务的后台模块将无法通过它启动。

en.description: The 6xyun utility library uses this private file provider to turn a local file into a temporary link for Android file handoffs.
en.disableEffect: Utility features that need to hand off files through this link may fail.

zh-CN.description: 6xyun 工具库通过此私有文件提供方把本地文件转换为临时链接，以便在安卓文件流程中传递。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要通过此链接传递文件的工具功能可能无法完成。

en.description: When PayEase Webox starts active face-liveness verification, this Activity opens the camera, checks prompted face movements and whether the face is live, and returns the result and image.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents the camera-based liveness check required by some identity and payment flows.

zh-CN.description: PayEase Webox 启动主动式人脸活体核验时，此 Activity 会打开摄像头，检查提示的面部动作及真人状态，并返回结果和图像。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，部分身份和支付流程所需的摄像头活体检测无法进行。

en.description: LiveHelp (Highras customer support SDK) shows the selected help article, its update time, and a helpfulness question. Readers can send feedback or open the support bot from the article.
en.disableEffect: The article details, feedback, and contact route will be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: LiveHelp（Highras 客户支持 SDK）会显示选中的帮助文章、更新时间和有用性反馈问题。用户可以提交反馈，也可以从文章页面打开客服机器人。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 文章详情、反馈和联系客服入口将无法使用。

en.description: LiveHelp (Highras customer support SDK) opens a searchable list of help topics when a user requests FAQs, then opens the selected article.
en.disableEffect: Users will lose the FAQ list, search, and article navigation.

zh-CN.description: LiveHelp（Highras 客户支持 SDK）会在用户打开常见问题时显示可搜索的帮助主题列表，并打开选中的文章。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法查看或搜索常见问题，也无法打开文章。

en.description: LiveHelp (Highras customer support SDK) opens the human support conversation when the app directs a user to an agent. The conversation page can open attachments from the phone.
en.disableEffect: Human support chat and sending attachments from this screen will be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: LiveHelp（Highras 客户支持 SDK）会在应用将用户转接给客服人员时打开人工会话页面。会话页面也可以从手机中选择附件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 人工客服聊天和从此页面发送附件将无法使用。

en.description: LiveHelp (Highras customer support SDK) opens its automated help conversation when the app starts a bot session. Its contact option can open the human support conversation.
en.disableEffect: The automated help conversation and its handoff to a human agent will be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: LiveHelp（Highras 客户支持 SDK）会在应用启动机器人客服会话时打开自动答疑页面。页面中的联系选项可以转到人工客服会话。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 自动答疑会话及转接人工客服的入口将无法使用。

en.description: The LivePerson Messaging SDK opens the app's in-app support conversation for a selected brand and loads the conversation screen. Disabling it prevents users from opening that support chat.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to open the LivePerson support conversation in the app.

zh-CN.description: LivePerson 消息 SDK 会为所选品牌打开应用内的客服会话，并显示聊天界面。禁用后，用户将无法打开这项客服聊天。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在应用中打开 LivePerson 客服会话。

en.description: The LivePerson Messaging SDK opens a co-browsing session from a support conversation and can keep it visible in a small floating window. Disabling it prevents users and support agents from opening that shared browsing session.
en.disableEffect: The app's LivePerson co-browsing session will not open.

zh-CN.description: LivePerson 消息 SDK 会从客服会话中打开协同浏览，并可将会话缩小到浮动窗口继续显示。禁用后，用户和客服人员将无法打开这项共享浏览。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用中的 LivePerson 协同浏览会话将无法打开。

en.description: When started for a LivePerson brand, this background service remembers the conversation and clears its local conversation data if the user removes the app from recent tasks. Disabling it can leave that data saved after the app is dismissed.
en.disableEffect: LivePerson conversation data may remain on the device after the app is dismissed.

zh-CN.description: 为 LivePerson 品牌启动后，这项后台服务会记住对应会话，并在用户从最近任务中划掉应用时清除本地会话数据。禁用后，应用退出时这些数据可能仍保留在设备上。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户划掉应用后，LivePerson 会话数据可能仍保留在设备上。

en.description: The LivePerson Messaging SDK uses this startup component to set up the app context it needs before messaging features are used. Disabling it can prevent those features from initializing.
en.disableEffect: LivePerson messaging features may fail to initialize.

zh-CN.description: LivePerson 消息 SDK 会在应用启动时设置消息功能所需的运行环境。禁用后，这些功能可能无法完成初始化。
zh-CN.disableEffect: LivePerson 消息功能可能无法初始化。

en.description: The LivePerson Messaging SDK uses this service to upload, download, or retry transfers of images, voice clips, and other files shared in chats, showing a progress notification while they run. Disabling it interrupts those attachment transfers.
en.disableEffect: Chat attachments and voice clips may not upload, download, or finish retrying.

zh-CN.description: LivePerson 消息 SDK 会用这项服务上传、下载或重新传输聊天中的图片、语音和其他文件，并在传输时显示进度通知。禁用后，这些附件传输会中断。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 聊天附件和语音可能无法上传、下载或完成重试。

en.description: The LivePerson Messaging SDK uses this file-sharing component to make local attachments available to chat features that open or send files. Disabling it can break those attachment flows.
en.disableEffect: LivePerson chat may not be able to open or share attached files.

zh-CN.description: LivePerson 消息 SDK 会通过此文件共享组件向聊天功能提供本地附件，以便打开或发送文件。禁用后，这些附件操作可能无法使用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: LivePerson 聊天可能无法打开或分享附件。

en.description: The LivePerson Messaging SDK uses this component to store welcome-message settings shared across its processes and notify the SDK when they change. Disabling it can prevent dynamic welcome messages from being read or updated.
en.disableEffect: Dynamic LivePerson welcome messages that use this store may not appear or update.

zh-CN.description: LivePerson 消息 SDK 会用此组件保存各进程共用的欢迎消息设置，并在设置变化时通知 SDK。禁用后，动态欢迎消息可能无法读取或更新。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此存储的 LivePerson 动态欢迎消息可能无法显示或更新。

en.description: The LiveShopper mobile insights SDK uses this startup component to set its app context and initialize Firebase. Disabling it can prevent LiveShopper features from initializing.
en.disableEffect: LiveShopper features that need startup initialization may stop working.

zh-CN.description: LiveShopper 移动应用洞察 SDK 会在应用启动时设置运行环境并初始化 Firebase。禁用后，依赖启动初始化的 LiveShopper 功能可能无法使用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖启动初始化的 LiveShopper 功能可能无法使用。

en.description: The LiveShopper mobile insights SDK processes queued background location updates and passes the location to its tracking features. Disabling it stops those background location updates from being processed.
en.disableEffect: LiveShopper background location updates will stop being processed.

zh-CN.description: LiveShopper 移动应用洞察 SDK 会处理排队的后台位置更新，并将位置交给其跟踪功能。禁用后，这些后台位置更新将不再处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: LiveShopper 将不再处理后台位置更新。

en.description: The LiveShopper mobile insights SDK receives background location and geofence events and schedules them for processing; it also handles device startup notifications. Disabling it stops those background location and place-boundary updates from reaching the SDK.
en.disableEffect: LiveShopper will no longer receive background location or geofence updates through this component.

zh-CN.description: LiveShopper 移动应用洞察 SDK 会接收后台位置和地点区域事件并安排处理，也会处理设备启动通知。禁用后，这些后台位置和地点区域更新将无法送达 SDK。
zh-CN.disableEffect: LiveShopper 将无法通过此组件接收后台位置或地点区域更新。

en.description: The Lixar LWAYVE SDK receives cloud messages and passes them to its experience handler. Disabling it stops this SDK message entry point.
en.disableEffect: LWAYVE push-triggered experiences and updates will no longer be delivered through this service.

zh-CN.description: Lixar LWAYVE SDK 会接收云消息并交给其体验处理功能。禁用后，此 SDK 消息入口将停止工作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: LWAYVE 将无法通过此服务接收由推送触发的体验和更新。

en.description: The Lixar LWAYVE SDK processes messages that have been routed to its background service. Disabling it stops this background message-handling path.
en.disableEffect: LWAYVE messages routed for background processing will no longer be handled.

zh-CN.description: Lixar LWAYVE SDK 会处理转交给其后台服务的消息。禁用后，这条后台消息处理流程将停止。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 转交给后台处理的 LWAYVE 消息将不再处理。

en.description: The Lixar LWAYVE SDK provides background audio playback for its audio experiences and exposes playback controls to the system. Disabling it prevents those audio clips from playing through the SDK.
en.disableEffect: LWAYVE audio content and its system playback controls will stop working.

zh-CN.description: Lixar LWAYVE SDK 会在后台播放其音频内容，并向系统提供播放控制。禁用后，SDK 将无法播放这些音频。
zh-CN.disableEffect: LWAYVE 音频内容及其系统播放控制将无法使用。

en.description: The Lixar LWAYVE recording module provides a screen for recording, reviewing, and sending an audio clip using the microphone. Disabling it prevents users from recording or submitting voice clips through this module.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to record or submit voice clips through LWAYVE.

zh-CN.description: Lixar LWAYVE 录音模块提供录音界面，用户可使用麦克风录制、试听并发送音频。禁用后，用户无法通过此模块录制或提交语音。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 LWAYVE 录制或提交语音。

en.description: The Lixar LWAYVE recording module shows an upload-failure prompt and lets the user retry sending the saved recording or dismiss the prompt. Disabling it removes the in-app retry path.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to retry a failed recording upload from this prompt.

zh-CN.description: Lixar LWAYVE 录音模块会在上传失败时显示提示，用户可重新发送已保存的录音或关闭提示。禁用后，应用内的重试入口将不可用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法通过此提示重试上传失败的录音。

en.description: The Lizhi Live SDK opens a live room and displays its live content and viewer conversation. Disabling it prevents users from entering live rooms through the SDK.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to open Lizhi live rooms in the app.

zh-CN.description: 荔枝直播 SDK 会打开直播间并显示直播内容和观众交流界面。禁用后，用户将无法通过该 SDK 进入直播间。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在应用中打开荔枝直播间。

en.description: The Lizhi Live SDK shows a live-room user's profile details and controls to follow, mention, or open that user's profile. Disabling it removes this user card and its controls from the live room.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to open a live-room user's card or use its profile and follow controls.

zh-CN.description: 荔枝直播 SDK 会显示直播间用户的资料，并提供关注、提及或打开个人主页的入口。禁用后，直播间将无法打开此用户卡片及其相关操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开直播间用户卡片或使用其中的主页和关注入口。

en.description: The Lizhi Live SDK lets users edit profile text such as a display name or signature, checks the allowed length, and submits the change. Disabling it prevents those edits from being completed through this screen.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to change profile text through this screen.

zh-CN.description: 荔枝直播 SDK 支持用户编辑昵称或签名等资料文字，会检查长度并提交修改。禁用后，用户无法通过此界面完成这些修改。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此界面修改个人资料文字。

en.description: The Lizhi Live SDK loads a user's following or follower list, supports refreshing and loading more entries, and opens profiles selected from the list. Disabling it removes these relationship lists.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to view or navigate following and follower lists through the SDK.

zh-CN.description: 荔枝直播 SDK 会加载用户的关注列表或粉丝列表，支持刷新和继续加载，并可从列表打开个人主页。禁用后，这些关系列表将无法使用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过该 SDK 查看或浏览关注列表和粉丝列表。

en.description: The Lizhi Live SDK displays a user's profile, follower and following counts, and follow controls; it also links to those lists. Disabling it prevents users from opening this profile screen.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to view profiles or use their follow and follower-list controls through the SDK.

zh-CN.description: 荔枝直播 SDK 会显示用户资料、关注数和粉丝数，并提供关注操作及列表入口。禁用后，用户将无法打开此个人主页。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过该 SDK 查看个人主页或使用关注和粉丝列表入口。

en.description: The Lizhi Live SDK opens its About screen with version details and links to service terms, privacy information, and other policies. Disabling this activity removes access to that screen and its links.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to open the Lizhi Live SDK About and policy pages from the app.

zh-CN.description: 荔枝直播 SDK 会打开关于页面，显示版本信息并提供服务条款、隐私说明及其他政策页面的链接。禁用后，用户将无法访问该页面及其链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在应用中打开荔枝直播 SDK 的关于页面和政策页面。

en.description: The Lizhi Live SDK settings screen provides account sign-out, cache clearing, a network-notification switch, and access to About information. Disabling it removes those account and settings controls.
en.disableEffect: Users will lose the Lizhi SDK settings screen, including its sign-out option.

zh-CN.description: 荔枝直播 SDK 设置页面提供账号退出、清理缓存、网络通知开关和关于页面入口。禁用后，这些账号和设置操作将无法使用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法使用荔枝 SDK 设置页面，包括其中的退出账号操作。

en.description: The Lizhi Live SDK runs this service in a separate background process and initializes its network and scheduled-task handling. This prepares the SDK for background work.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it may interrupt Lizhi Live features that rely on background network connections or scheduled work.

zh-CN.description: 荔枝直播 SDK 会在独立后台进程中运行此服务，并初始化网络处理和定时任务处理功能，为 SDK 的后台任务做好准备。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，依赖后台网络连接或定时任务的荔枝直播功能可能会中断。

en.description: The Lizhi Live SDK opens supplied web pages inside the app and can offer refresh or opening the page in another browser. Disabling it prevents SDK content that uses this screen from opening.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to open Lizhi SDK web content in the app.

zh-CN.description: 荔枝直播 SDK 会在应用内打开指定网页，并可提供刷新或改用其他浏览器打开的操作。禁用后，使用此界面的 SDK 内容将无法打开。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在应用中打开荔枝 SDK 网页内容。

en.description: The Lizhi Live SDK creates a live-stream player and provides it to the app when requested. Disabling it prevents features that depend on this player from playing live streams.
en.disableEffect: Live streams that use the Lizhi player will not play.

zh-CN.description: 荔枝直播 SDK 会创建直播流播放器，并在应用请求时提供给应用。禁用后，依赖此播放器的功能将无法播放直播流。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用荔枝播放器的直播流将无法播放。

en.description: The Lizhi Live SDK opens the live-room gift panel for a selected recipient. Disabling it prevents users from opening the panel and sending live gifts through the SDK.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to open the live gift panel or send gifts through the SDK.

zh-CN.description: 荔枝直播 SDK 会为选定的接收者打开直播间礼物面板。禁用后，用户无法打开面板或通过该 SDK 赠送直播礼物。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开直播礼物面板或通过该 SDK 赠送礼物。

en.description: When an app using Lodz Component (LZ9) opens its photo picker, this screen displays available photos for selection and can include camera and preview actions when configured.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot use this built-in photo selection screen to choose images.

zh-CN.description: 使用 Lodz Component（LZ9）的应用打开图片选择器时，此页面会显示可选图片；按应用配置，也可提供拍照和预览操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法通过此内置图片选择页面选择图片。

en.description: When an app using Lodz Component (LZ9) requests a photo, this screen opens the camera and lets the user confirm or cancel the captured image.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot capture and return a photo through this camera flow.

zh-CN.description: 使用 Lodz Component（LZ9）的应用请求拍照时，此页面会打开相机，并允许用户确认或取消拍摄的照片。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法通过此相机流程拍摄并返回照片。

en.description: When an app using Lodz Component (LZ9) asks to preview selected pictures, this screen displays them in a swipeable preview and tracks the current picture.
en.disableEffect: The picture preview step in the app’s photo selection flow cannot open.

zh-CN.description: 使用 Lodz Component（LZ9）的应用预览已选图片时，此页面会以可滑动的方式显示图片并跟踪当前查看位置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用图片选择流程中的图片预览页面将无法打开。

en.description: When an app starts an OCR request with Lodz Conjurer (LZ9), this landscape camera screen captures text and returns the recognized result to the app.
en.disableEffect: Camera-based text scanning cannot finish or return recognized text to the app.

zh-CN.description: 应用通过 Lodz Conjurer（LZ9）发起 OCR 请求时，此横屏相机页面会拍摄文字，并将识别结果返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 相机文字扫描将无法完成，也无法向应用返回识别结果。

en.description: When an app opens Lodz Pandora’s custom file picker, this screen shows the entries supplied by the app for selection and can provide preview or camera actions when configured.
en.disableEffect: The app’s custom file selection flow cannot open.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开 Lodz Pandora 的自定义文件选择器时，此页面会显示应用提供的可选条目，并可按配置提供预览或拍照操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用的自定义文件选择流程将无法打开。

en.description: When an app opens Lodz Pandora’s phone picker, this screen browses device images, videos, audio, or configured file types and returns the selected items.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot choose device media or files through this Lodz Pandora picker.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开 Lodz Pandora 的手机文件选择器时，此页面会浏览设备上的图片、视频、音频或已配置的文件类型，并返回所选项目。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 Lodz Pandora 选择器选择设备媒体或文件。

en.description: When an app using Lodz Pandora requests a preview of selected items, this screen displays them in a swipeable viewer and tracks the current item.
en.disableEffect: The preview step in the app’s Lodz Pandora selection flow cannot open.

zh-CN.description: 使用 Lodz Pandora 的应用请求预览已选项目时，此页面会在可滑动的查看器中显示内容并跟踪当前项目。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用 Lodz Pandora 选择流程中的预览页面将无法打开。

en.description: When an app requests a photo through Lodz Pandora, this screen opens the camera and returns the captured image for confirmation or immediately, according to the app’s settings.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot capture and return a photo through the Lodz Pandora camera flow.

zh-CN.description: 应用通过 Lodz Pandora 请求拍照时，此页面会打开相机，并根据应用设置等待确认或立即返回拍摄的图片。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法通过 Lodz Pandora 相机流程拍摄并返回照片。

en.description: When selected as the keyboard for a form field, Lodz Pandora’s custom keyboard provides layouts for ID numbers, vehicle plate numbers, or company certificate numbers and enters the chosen characters into the field.
en.disableEffect: Forms that use this service lose the custom keyboard for these values and may need another input method.

zh-CN.description: 当表单字段选择 Lodz Pandora 的自定义键盘时，该键盘会提供身份证号码、车牌号码或企业证书号码布局，并将所选字符输入字段。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此服务的表单将失去这些内容的专用键盘，可能需要改用其他输入方式。

en.description: During a LoFTechs Call SDK call session, this service starts the call library and displays an ongoing call notification while active.
en.disableEffect: Voice calls or their ongoing call notification may not work correctly.

zh-CN.description: LoFTechs Call SDK 进行通话时会启动此服务来运行通话库，并在服务活动期间显示通话通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 语音通话或通话期间的通知可能无法正常工作。

en.description: During a call in the LoFTechs JKVoice voice-call SDK, this service starts the call library and displays a foreground call notification when requested, so call activity can continue in the background.
en.disableEffect: Voice calls through this SDK may fail to start correctly or lose their background notification.

zh-CN.description: LoFTechs JKVoice 语音通话 SDK 发起通话时，此服务会运行通话库；收到通知请求后，还会显示前台通话通知，使通话可在后台继续。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过此 SDK 发起的语音通话可能无法正常启动，或失去后台通话通知。

en.description: This shared Machbird Account screen starts account sign-in or account linking and handles the results from external sign-in providers.
en.disableEffect: Machbird account sign-in and account-linking flows that use this screen will fail.

zh-CN.description: 此 Machbird Account 通用页面用于账户登录或绑定账户，并处理外部登录服务返回的结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，使用此页面的 Machbird 账户登录和绑定流程将无法完成。

en.description: This Machbird Account screen lets users connect or disconnect sign-in methods on an existing account, including email and external providers.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to link or unlink sign-in methods from their Machbird account.

zh-CN.description: 此 Machbird Account 页面可为现有账户绑定或解绑登录方式，包括邮箱和外部登录服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法为 Machbird 账户绑定或解绑登录方式。

en.description: This Machbird Account screen offers a simplified sign-in route and can open the email sign-in page.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to use this simplified Machbird account sign-in route.

zh-CN.description: 此 Machbird Account 页面提供简化的登录入口，也可打开邮箱登录页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法使用此 Machbird 账户简化登录入口。

en.description: This Machbird Account page accepts an email address and password to sign in, and can open account registration.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to sign in with email through this page.

zh-CN.description: 此 Machbird Account 页面供用户输入邮箱和密码登录，也可打开账户注册页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此页面使用邮箱登录。

en.description: This Machbird Account page displays the current account information and offers a route back to account sign-in.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to view this account page or continue to its sign-in route.

zh-CN.description: 此 Machbird Account 页面会显示当前账户信息，并提供返回账户登录的入口。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法查看此账户页面或继续进入其中的登录入口。

en.description: This is the main Machbird Account sign-in page, with Google, Facebook, and email sign-in plus routes to registration and password recovery.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to sign in, register, or recover a Machbird account through this page.

zh-CN.description: 这是 Machbird Account 的主登录页面，提供 Google、Facebook 和邮箱登录，以及注册和找回密码入口。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此页面登录、注册或找回 Machbird 账户。

en.description: This Machbird Account page requests an email verification code and then opens the password reset flow.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to start email-based password recovery from Machbird Account.

zh-CN.description: 此 Machbird Account 页面会请求邮箱验证码，然后进入密码重置流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法从 Machbird Account 发起邮箱密码找回流程。

en.description: This Machbird Account page registers an email account after checking the submitted account details and password.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to register an email-based Machbird account through this page.

zh-CN.description: 此 Machbird Account 页面会检查提交的账户信息和密码，并注册邮箱账户。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此页面注册邮箱 Machbird 账户。

en.description: This Machbird Account page accepts a verification code and new password to reset an email account's password.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to reset their Machbird account password through this page.

zh-CN.description: 此 Machbird Account 页面供用户输入验证码和新密码，以重置邮箱账户密码。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此页面重置 Machbird 账户密码。

en.description: When the app starts native Facebook sign-in through LoginRadius, this screen runs Facebook authorization and sends the returned credential to LoginRadius, then continues with any required profile details.
en.disableEffect: Facebook sign-in through LoginRadius cannot be completed.

zh-CN.description: 应用通过 LoginRadius 启动 Facebook 原生登录时，此界面会执行 Facebook 授权并将返回的凭据交给 LoginRadius；之后还会继续收集所需的个人资料。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法通过 LoginRadius 完成 Facebook 登录。

en.description: When the app starts native Google sign-in through LoginRadius, this screen requests Google credentials and sends the result to LoginRadius, then continues with any required profile details.
en.disableEffect: Google sign-in through LoginRadius cannot be completed.

zh-CN.description: 应用通过 LoginRadius 启动 Google 原生登录时，此界面会获取 Google 登录凭据并将结果交给 LoginRadius；之后还会继续收集所需的个人资料。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法通过 LoginRadius 完成 Google 登录。

en.description: After a traditional LoginRadius sign-in, the SDK opens this screen when account configuration requires profile details that are missing. It displays the required fields and returns the sign-in result after they are completed.
en.disableEffect: A sign-in that requires additional profile details cannot finish if this screen is disabled.

zh-CN.description: LoginRadius 传统登录完成后，如果账号配置要求填写尚缺少的个人资料，SDK 会打开此界面。界面显示必填信息，并在用户补齐后返回登录结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，需要补充个人资料的登录流程无法完成。

en.description: When the app starts native VKontakte sign-in through LoginRadius, this screen authenticates with VKontakte and sends the result to LoginRadius; it can also collect required profile details.
en.disableEffect: VKontakte sign-in through LoginRadius cannot be completed.

zh-CN.description: 应用通过 LoginRadius 启动 VKontakte 原生登录时，此界面会执行 VKontakte 授权并将结果交给 LoginRadius；也可继续收集必填个人资料。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法通过 LoginRadius 完成 VKontakte 登录。

en.description: When WeChat returns an authorization result, this LoginRadius screen handles it, exchanges the authorization code with LoginRadius, and returns the sign-in result; it can also continue into required profile completion.
en.disableEffect: LoginRadius sign-in through WeChat cannot be completed.

zh-CN.description: 微信返回授权结果时，LoginRadius 会通过此界面处理结果并向 LoginRadius 交换授权码，随后返回登录结果；必要时还会继续收集必填个人资料。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法通过 LoginRadius 完成微信登录。

en.description: When the app starts a LoginRadius web login for an identity provider, this screen displays the sign-in page inside the app and handles the returned token and any required profile steps.
en.disableEffect: LoginRadius web-based sign-in cannot be completed.

zh-CN.description: 应用通过 LoginRadius 启动身份提供方的网页登录时，此界面会在应用内显示登录页面，并处理返回的令牌及后续必填资料。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法完成 LoginRadius 网页登录。

en.description: Lokiy Core (Kotlin Kit) opens a screen supplied by the app and lets that screen handle Back navigation.
en.disableEffect: Apps that rely on this host to open feature screens may fail to show those screens or complete the related flow.

zh-CN.description: Lokiy Core（Kotlin Kit）用此页面承载应用提供的屏幕内容，并让该屏幕处理返回操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此页面打开功能屏幕的应用可能无法显示这些页面或完成相关操作。

en.description: When Loopeer Reader opens its navigation panel, it shows the current book's chapter list and saved bookmarks in separate tabs; choosing a chapter moves to it.
en.disableEffect: Users will lose the combined contents and bookmarks screen and cannot jump to chapters or browse saved bookmarks there.

zh-CN.description: Loopeer Reader 打开导航面板时，会在两个标签页中显示当前书籍的目录和书签；选择章节后会跳转到该处。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开目录与书签合并页面，也不能从这里跳转章节或浏览已保存的书签。

en.description: Loopeer Reader uses this screen to list available reading fonts; choosing one changes the font used for book text.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to change the reading font through the Loopeer Reader font picker.

zh-CN.description: Loopeer Reader 在此列出可用的阅读字体；用户选择后，书籍正文会改用该字体。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 Loopeer Reader 的字体选择页更改阅读字体。

en.description: When Loopeer Reader opens its reading settings, users can adjust text and page spacing, page-turn animation, screen timeout, and the recently-read option.
en.disableEffect: Users will lose the reader's custom controls for text spacing, page turning, and screen behavior.

zh-CN.description: 打开 Loopeer Reader 的阅读设置后，用户可以调整文字和页面间距、翻页动画、屏幕常亮时间以及最近阅读选项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法使用阅读器提供的文字间距、翻页动画和屏幕行为设置。

en.description: When the app opens a Loyagram campaign, the Loyagram Campaign SDK loads cached campaign content or fetches it from Loyagram and displays it in the app.
en.disableEffect: The app will no longer display Loyagram campaign and feedback content.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开 Loyagram 营销活动时，Loyagram Campaign SDK 会读取缓存内容，或从 Loyagram 获取活动内容并在应用内显示。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将不再显示 Loyagram 营销活动和反馈内容。

en.description: PictureSelector by LuckSiege opens this camera screen when the user chooses to take a photo from the picker. It returns the captured image to the app or reports that the user cancelled.
en.disableEffect: The app’s PictureSelector camera option will not open, so users may be unable to take a photo from the picker.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 PictureSelector by LuckSiege 中选择拍照时，SDK 会打开此相机页面。它会将拍摄的照片返回应用，或报告用户已取消。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用中的 PictureSelector 拍照入口将无法打开，用户可能无法通过选择器拍照。

en.description: LuckSiege PictureSelector opens this screen when you choose its audio-recording option. It records audio, lets you pause or stop, and returns the saved recording to the selector.
en.disableEffect: PictureSelector cannot record and return an audio file through this screen.

zh-CN.description: LuckSiege 的 PictureSelector 会在你选择录音时打开此页面。页面可录制、暂停或停止音频，并将录音文件返回给选择器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: PictureSelector 将无法通过此页面录制并返回音频文件。

en.description: PictureSelector (LuckSiege) opens this screen when its picker is configured to use the built-in camera. It lets the user take a photo or record a video and returns the capture to the picker.
en.disableEffect: The app can no longer capture photos or videos with PictureSelector's built-in camera.

zh-CN.description: PictureSelector（LuckSiege）的媒体选择器启用内置相机时，会打开此页面。用户可拍照或录制视频，完成后媒体会返回到选择器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法再使用 PictureSelector 的内置相机拍照或录像。

en.description: PictureSelector opens this viewer when the app asks to preview supplied photos or videos outside the picker. It lets the user browse the items and, when enabled, delete or save them.
en.disableEffect: External media preview and its enabled save or delete actions will stop working.

zh-CN.description: 应用要求在 PictureSelector 选择器之外预览指定照片或视频时，会打开此查看页面。用户可浏览媒体，并在相关选项启用时删除或保存文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 外部媒体预览以及已启用的保存或删除操作将无法使用。

en.description: The LuckSiege PictureSelector image picker uses this Provider to pass local media files between the picker and camera apps during capture or editing. GalleryManager and the PictureSelector forks in this input bundle the same component.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it can break camera capture or passing edited media between the picture picker and other apps.

zh-CN.description: LuckSiege 的 PictureSelector 图片选择器在拍摄或编辑媒体时，通过此 Provider 在选择器与相机等应用之间传递本地媒体文件。GalleryManager 和输入中的 PictureSelector 分支也包含此组件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，拍照或在图片选择器与其他应用之间传递编辑后的媒体文件可能失败。

en.description: PictureSelector opens this screen when a user previews an audio file in the media picker. It plays the selected audio and provides playback controls.
en.disableEffect: Audio preview through PictureSelector will stop working.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 PictureSelector 媒体选择器中预览音频文件时，会打开此页面。页面播放所选音频并提供播放控制。
zh-CN.disableEffect: PictureSelector 的音频预览将无法使用。

en.description: PictureSelector opens this full-screen viewer from its media picker so the user can browse selected items, change the selection, and crop photos when cropping is enabled.
en.disableEffect: Users can no longer preview or crop selected media inside PictureSelector.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 PictureSelector 媒体选择器中查看所选内容时，会打开此全屏页面，可浏览媒体、更改选择，并在启用裁剪时编辑照片。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法再通过 PictureSelector 预览或裁剪所选媒体。

en.description: PictureSelector opens this screen when the app starts its media picker. It lets the user browse device albums and choose photos, videos, or audio files for the app.
en.disableEffect: The app loses PictureSelector's media-selection flow.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动 PictureSelector 媒体选择器时，会打开此页面。用户可浏览设备相册，并为应用选择照片、视频或音频文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法再使用 PictureSelector 的媒体选择流程。

en.description: PictureSelector uses this screen when its picker routes photo, video, or audio capture through the device camera or recorder. It requests the needed permission, processes the returned file, and adds it to the selection result.
en.disableEffect: The picker's standard camera or audio-capture flow can no longer return media to the app.

zh-CN.description: PictureSelector 通过设备相机或录音工具拍摄照片、视频或音频时，会使用此页面。它会请求所需权限、处理返回的文件，并将媒体加入选择结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 选择器将无法再把通过普通相机或录音流程获得的媒体返回给应用。

en.description: PictureSelector opens this WeChat-style preview while the user reviews selected photos or videos. It shows the current item and selected-item strip before the user confirms the choice.
en.disableEffect: Reviewing and confirming selected media in PictureSelector's WeChat-style preview will stop working.

zh-CN.description: 用户以微信风格查看已选照片或视频时，PictureSelector 会打开此预览页面。页面显示当前媒体和已选项目缩略栏，供用户确认选择。
zh-CN.disableEffect: PictureSelector 的微信风格媒体预览和确认功能将无法使用。

en.description: PictureSelector uses this alternate picker screen to show device media in a WeChat-style layout. The user can select items and return them to the app.
en.disableEffect: The app can no longer use PictureSelector's WeChat-style media picker.

zh-CN.description: PictureSelector 使用此备用选择页面，以微信风格展示设备中的媒体。用户可选择项目并将其返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法再使用 PictureSelector 的微信风格媒体选择器。

en.description: PictureSelector opens this player when a user previews a video from the picker or media viewer. It plays the video and can return it as the selected item.
en.disableEffect: Video playback inside PictureSelector stops, so apps that require this preview cannot complete that step.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 PictureSelector 选择器或媒体查看器中预览视频时，会打开此播放器。它播放视频，并可将视频作为所选项目返回。
zh-CN.disableEffect: PictureSelector 内的视频播放将停止；依赖此预览步骤的应用流程也无法完成。

en.description: PictureSelector by LuckSiege uses this provider to share selected picture files through temporary content links that other parts of the app or other apps can read.
en.disableEffect: Photo selection, cropping, or sharing may fail when the app needs to pass a selected file to another screen or app.

zh-CN.description: PictureSelector by LuckSiege 通过此文件提供组件生成临时内容链接，让应用的其他页面或其他应用读取所选图片文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用需要将所选文件传给其他页面或应用时，选图、裁剪或分享可能失败。

en.description: PictureSelector by LuckSiege opens this main selection screen when an app asks the user to choose photos or videos. It displays the media picker and returns the selected items to the app.
en.disableEffect: The app’s photo and video selection screen will not open, and media selection may fail.

zh-CN.description: 应用要求用户选择照片或视频时，PictureSelector by LuckSiege 会打开此主选择页面。页面显示媒体选择器，并将选中的内容返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用的照片和视频选择页面将无法打开，媒体选择可能失败。

en.description: PictureSelector by LuckSiege uses this mostly invisible screen when opening system photo selection or media preview. It completes the requested selection flow and returns the chosen media to the app.
en.disableEffect: System photo selection and some media preview flows provided by PictureSelector may not open or return results.

zh-CN.description: PictureSelector by LuckSiege 打开系统选图或媒体预览时会使用此透明页面。它完成相应的选择流程，并将所选媒体返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: PictureSelector 提供的系统选图和部分媒体预览流程可能无法打开或返回结果。

en.description: PictureSelector by LuckSiege starts this notification-backed service when foreground camera mode is enabled. It keeps the camera session active while the app handles the camera flow.
en.disableEffect: Apps that use foreground camera mode may lose camera activity while the picker is in use or the app moves to the background.

zh-CN.description: 启用前台相机模式时，PictureSelector by LuckSiege 会启动此带通知的服务。它在应用处理相机流程时保持相机任务运行。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用前台相机模式的应用在选择器运行或切到后台时，相机任务可能会中断。

en.description: When a nearby NFC reader selects an emulated tag, LuigiVampa92's NDEF emulation library returns the saved tag data to it.
en.disableEffect: The host app will not be able to emulate its saved NDEF tag for nearby NFC readers.

zh-CN.description: 附近的 NFC 读卡器选择模拟标签时，LuigiVampa92 的 NDEF 模拟库会向读卡器返回已保存的标签数据。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 宿主应用将无法向附近的 NFC 读卡器模拟已保存的 NDEF 标签。

en.description: The i-test APM SDK opens this screen when a push message uses its default landing page. It reads the message link and displays that page in an in-app browser.
en.disableEffect: i-test push messages can no longer open this browser landing page; the analyzed SDK shows no other app flow using it.

zh-CN.description: i-test APM SDK 的推送消息使用默认落地页时会打开此页面。它读取消息链接，并在应用内浏览器中显示该网页。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，i-test 推送消息无法打开此浏览器落地页；所分析的 SDK 未显示其他应用流程会使用它。

en.description: The i-test APM SDK starts this service for location-tagged context or push-message feedback. It obtains the device location and sends it with context details or a message rating and reading statistics.
en.disableEffect: The SDK's location-based context and message-feedback records stop being sent; no app-screen behavior is shown to depend on this service.

zh-CN.description: i-test APM SDK 在需要附带位置的上下文信息或推送反馈时启动此服务。它获取设备位置，并将位置与上下文信息或消息评分、阅读统计一同发送。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，SDK 不再发送带位置的上下文信息和消息反馈记录；所分析代码未显示应用页面依赖此服务。

en.description: The i-test APM SDK starts this service to connect to its push channel, register the device, and fetch undelivered messages; received messages can appear as notifications.
en.disableEffect: i-test push delivery and its notifications stop, while the analyzed code shows no core app flow depending on this service.

zh-CN.description: i-test APM SDK 启动此服务以连接推送通道、登记设备并获取尚未送达的消息；收到的消息可以显示为通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，i-test 推送及其通知将停止；所分析代码未显示应用核心流程依赖此服务。

en.description: The i-test APM SDK handles taps and dismissals of its push notifications here. A tap opens the configured app screen or the SDK's news page, and both actions are reported to the push service.
en.disableEffect: i-test notifications can no longer open their target screen or report taps and dismissals.

zh-CN.description: i-test APM SDK 在此处理推送通知的点击和关闭操作。点击会打开指定的应用页面或 SDK 新闻页，两种操作都会上报给推送服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，i-test 通知无法打开目标页面，也不会上报点击或关闭记录。

en.description: At app startup, Android creates the BStartUp provider, which reads the app's registered startup tasks and starts them.
en.disableEffect: App initialization tasks registered with BStartUp will not run, so features that depend on them may fail.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，Android 会创建 BStartUp Provider；它会读取应用登记的启动任务并运行这些任务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过 BStartUp 登记的初始化任务将不会运行，依赖它们的功能可能无法使用。

en.description: XPopup opens this permission screen when an app requests runtime permissions, overlay access, or permission to change system settings; it forwards the request to Android and returns the result.
en.disableEffect: Features that depend on permissions requested through XPopup may not be able to request or use them.

zh-CN.description: 应用通过 XPopup 请求运行时权限、悬浮窗权限或修改系统设置的权限时，会打开此权限界面；它向 Android 发起请求并返回结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖 XPopup 请求权限的功能可能无法发起或使用相应权限。

en.description: The HTJY CameraCore screen opens the camera to take photos or record video after requesting camera and, for video, microphone access. It returns the captured file to the app for review or use.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot use this screen to capture photos or videos.

zh-CN.description: HTJY CameraCore 会请求相机权限，并在录像时请求麦克风权限，然后打开相机拍照或录制视频。拍摄结果会交回应用供预览或使用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法通过此界面拍照或录制视频。

en.description: When the app starts, AndroidMonitor uses this provider to initialize its local request-history database and browser-viewing service.
en.disableEffect: AndroidMonitor's request viewer and local service will not initialize, while the host app's own screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，AndroidMonitor 会通过此 Provider 初始化本地请求记录数据库和浏览器查看服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: AndroidMonitor 的请求查看器和本地服务将无法初始化，但宿主应用自身的页面仍可使用。

en.description: AndroidMonitor's settings page opens from its request viewer and lets the user configure request capture, mock replies, and slow-network testing. It also stores the test address and response.
en.disableEffect: AndroidMonitor's testing controls will be unavailable, but the app can still make its normal requests.

zh-CN.description: 从 AndroidMonitor 请求查看器打开后，此设置页可配置请求记录、模拟响应和弱网测试，也可设置测试地址和返回内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: AndroidMonitor 的测试设置将无法使用，但应用仍可正常发起自身请求。

en.description: When a user selects a captured request in AndroidMonitor, this page shows its address, request and response details, and a text summary that can be shared.
en.disableEffect: Users will lose AndroidMonitor's detailed request view, while the app's own networking remains available.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 AndroidMonitor 中选择一条已记录的请求后，此页面会显示请求地址、请求和响应详情，并提供可分享的文本摘要。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法查看 AndroidMonitor 的请求详情，但应用自身的网络功能仍可使用。

en.description: AndroidMonitor's launcher screen lists captured network requests and saved preference files, and shows a local browser address when the viewer service is available.
en.disableEffect: AndroidMonitor's request and preference diagnostics will not open, but the host app's normal screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: AndroidMonitor 的启动页会列出已记录的网络请求和保存的偏好设置文件；查看服务可用时，还会显示本地浏览器访问地址。
zh-CN.disableEffect: AndroidMonitor 的请求和偏好设置诊断页面将无法打开，但宿主应用的常规页面仍可使用。

en.description: Opened from AndroidMonitor's saved-preferences list, this page shows one file's stored keys and values and lets the user change a value.
en.disableEffect: Users will no longer be able to inspect or edit saved preference values through AndroidMonitor.

zh-CN.description: 从 AndroidMonitor 的偏好设置文件列表打开后，此页面会显示一个文件中保存的键和值，并允许用户修改其中的值。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法再通过 AndroidMonitor 查看或修改已保存的偏好设置值。

en.description: Dusk (LZQ's Android development framework) initializes app lifecycle tracking when Android creates this provider at process startup, and its file helpers use the provider to create private-file links.
en.disableEffect: Dusk's automatic startup setup and file-sharing helpers will stop working, which can break features that depend on them.

zh-CN.description: Dusk（LZQ 的 Android 开发框架）会在 Android 于应用进程启动时创建此 Provider 后初始化应用生命周期跟踪；框架的文件工具也通过它生成私有文件链接。
