zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Dusk 的自动初始化和文件分享工具将无法正常工作，依赖这些功能的应用能力可能受影响。

en.description: The Lzy ImagePicker library uses this Provider to make files from its configured folders available to other apps through file links.
en.disableEffect: Other apps may not be able to open images shared through this provider.

zh-CN.description: Lzy ImagePicker 库通过此 Provider 将配置目录中的文件以访问链接的形式提供给其他应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 其他应用可能无法打开通过此 Provider 分享的图片。

en.description: When ImagePicker is set to free-form cropping, this Activity lets users adjust a photo's crop area and save the result.
en.disableEffect: Users will lose free-form cropping in the picker.

zh-CN.description: ImagePicker 启用自由裁剪时，此 Activity 允许用户调整照片的裁剪范围并保存结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在选图器中使用自由裁剪。

en.description: This Lzy ImagePicker Activity handles shared status-bar styling and permission feedback for the library's photo screens; it does not show a separate photo selection or editing screen.
en.disableEffect: Users lose no separate photo-picker flow here; browsing and editing are provided by the library's other Activities.

zh-CN.description: Lzy ImagePicker 的此 Activity 为照片界面统一设置状态栏样式并提供权限提示；它本身没有独立的选图或编辑界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用此项不会移除单独的选图流程；照片浏览和编辑由库中的其他 Activity 提供。

en.description: When ImagePicker requests a standard crop, this Activity lets users frame a photo and saves the cropped image back to the picker.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to use the picker's standard crop screen.

zh-CN.description: ImagePicker 需要常规裁剪时，此 Activity 让用户调整照片范围，并将裁剪后的图片返回选图器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法使用选图器的常规裁剪界面。

en.description: ImagePicker opens this Activity when users choose photos; it lists device photo folders, supports multiple selections, and can continue to capture or crop an image.
en.disableEffect: Users will lose the picker's photo browsing and selection screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择照片时，ImagePicker 会打开此 Activity；它展示设备相册目录、支持多选，并可继续拍照或裁剪图片。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法使用选图器浏览和选择照片。

en.description: ImagePicker opens this Activity to review selected photos full-screen, move between them, change which photos are selected, and return the selection.
en.disableEffect: Users will lose the picker's full-screen photo review and selection controls.

zh-CN.description: ImagePicker 会通过此 Activity 全屏预览已选照片；用户可以切换照片、调整选择并返回结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法使用选图器的全屏预览和选取控制。

en.description: ImagePicker opens this Activity to review a selected set of photos and remove unwanted items from that set before returning.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to review or remove items from a selection in this screen.

zh-CN.description: ImagePicker 会通过此 Activity 预览已选照片，并允许用户在返回前从所选列表中移除不需要的图片。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在此界面预览所选照片或从列表中移除图片。

en.description: LizoneZhi's AndroidLzzLib provides a private screen for browsing and selecting saved log files. In this artifact, its upload button only records a log message.
en.disableEffect: The optional log-browsing screen and its upload control will no longer be available.

zh-CN.description: LizoneZhi 的 AndroidLzzLib 提供一个私有页面，用于浏览和选择已保存的日志文件。此版本的上传按钮只会记录一条日志消息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，将无法使用这个可选的日志浏览页面及其上传入口。

en.description: LizoneZhi's AndroidLzzLib listens for Android app-update broadcasts. When the updated package is the host app, it opens the app again.
en.disableEffect: The app will no longer reopen automatically after its own update.

zh-CN.description: LizoneZhi 的 AndroidLzzLib 监听 Android 的应用更新广播。若更新的是宿主应用，它会再次打开该应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用自身更新后将不再自动重新打开。

en.description: Schibsted M10S Identity opens this screen while completing browser-based sign-in. It returns the authorization success or cancellation to the app.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it can prevent browser sign-in from returning to the app correctly.

zh-CN.description: Schibsted M10S Identity 会在完成基于浏览器的登录时打开此页面，并将授权成功或取消结果交还应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，基于浏览器的登录可能无法正确返回应用。

en.description: Schibsted M10S Identity opens this screen when the browser redirects back to the app after sign-in. It forwards the sign-in response to the authorization flow.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it can break the return step of browser-based sign-in.

zh-CN.description: 浏览器登录后重定向回应用时，Schibsted M10S Identity 会打开此页面。它会将登录响应转交给授权流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，基于浏览器的登录回跳步骤可能无法完成。

en.description: Schibsted M10S Identity's login prompt reads and updates saved session records through this provider. It is used when the app presents the SDK's login prompt.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it can prevent the Schibsted M10S Identity login prompt from reading or updating the session it needs.

zh-CN.description: Schibsted M10S Identity 的登录提示会通过此 Provider 读取和更新已保存的会话记录。应用显示 SDK 登录提示时会使用它。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，Schibsted M10S Identity 登录提示可能无法读取或更新所需会话。

en.description: The 7moor Visitor IM SDK opens this screen for a support page or help link supplied by the app. It loads the page in an embedded browser and lets the user choose a file when the page requests an upload.
en.disableEffect: The app's embedded 7moor support pages will not open, including any web-based file upload flow.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开客服页面或帮助链接时，7moor 访客客服 SDK 会显示此页面。它在内置浏览器中加载网页，并在网页请求上传时允许用户选择文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法打开 7moor 内置客服网页，网页中的文件上传流程也会失效。

en.description: The 7moor Visitor IM SDK opens this screen when a user starts a live support conversation. It loads the conversation and provides controls for sending text and voice messages.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to open or use the SDK's live customer support chat.

zh-CN.description: 用户开始在线客服会话时，7moor 访客客服 SDK 会打开此页面。页面加载会话内容，并提供发送文字和语音消息的功能。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开或使用此 SDK 的在线客服聊天。

en.description: The 7moor Visitor IM SDK opens this screen after a user selects a frequently asked question category. It loads and pages through the questions in that category.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to browse the selected category's support questions.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择常见问题类别后，7moor 访客客服 SDK 会打开此页面。页面会加载该类别的问题，并支持继续浏览后续问题。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法浏览所选类别中的客服常见问题。

en.description: The 7moor Visitor IM SDK opens this screen to load and display frequently asked question categories. Users can choose a category to see its questions.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to open the SDK's frequently asked question list.

zh-CN.description: 7moor 访客客服 SDK 会打开此页面并加载常见问题类别，用户可以选择类别查看其中的问题。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开此 SDK 的常见问题列表。

en.description: When no support agent is available, the 7moor Visitor IM SDK opens this form so the user can leave a message and provide any required details. The form submits the request to customer support.
en.disableEffect: Users may be unable to leave an offline support message when no agent is available.

zh-CN.description: 没有客服人员在线时，7moor 访客客服 SDK 会打开此表单，让用户留言并填写所需信息，再将请求提交给客服。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 没有客服人员在线时，用户可能无法提交离线客服留言。

en.description: The 7moor Visitor IM SDK opens this form for a scheduled customer support follow-up. It loads the required fields and submits the user's message and contact details.
en.disableEffect: Users may be unable to request a scheduled follow-up from customer support.

zh-CN.description: 7moor 访客客服 SDK 会打开此表单，让用户预约客服跟进。页面会加载所需字段，并提交用户留言和联系信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户可能无法预约客服跟进。

en.description: The 7moor Visitor IM SDK opens this screen when a user selects a video in a support conversation. It plays a saved clip or downloads a remote clip before playing it.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to play video clips attached to 7moor support conversations.

zh-CN.description: 用户点开客服会话中的视频时，7moor 访客客服 SDK 会打开此页面。它可以播放本地视频，也可以先下载远程视频再播放。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法播放 7moor 客服会话中的视频附件。

en.description: The 7moor Visitor IM SDK receives new-message events here, forwards them to the open support chat, and shows a notification when the app is in the background.
en.disableEffect: The support chat may stop updating when messages arrive, and background notifications for new support messages will stop.

zh-CN.description: 7moor 访客客服 SDK 在此接收新消息事件，将消息转给正在打开的客服聊天，并在应用处于后台时显示通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 收到消息时，客服聊天可能不再更新；应用后台的新客服消息通知也会停止。

en.description: The 7moor video-call SDK opens this screen while an incoming or outgoing support video call is waiting. It rings, shows a camera preview, and lets the user accept or refuse the call.
en.disableEffect: Users may not be able to answer or place video calls through 7moor customer support.

zh-CN.description: 7moor 视频通话 SDK 会在客服视频来电或呼出等待时打开此页面。页面会响铃、显示摄像头预览，并允许用户接听或拒绝通话。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户可能无法通过 7moor 客服接听或发起视频通话。

en.description: The 7moor video-call SDK opens this screen while an incoming or outgoing support voice call is waiting. It rings and lets the user accept or refuse the call.
en.disableEffect: Users may not be able to answer or place voice calls through 7moor customer support.

zh-CN.description: 7moor 视频通话 SDK 会在客服语音来电或呼出等待时打开此页面。页面会响铃，并允许用户接听或拒绝通话。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户可能无法通过 7moor 客服接听或发起语音通话。

en.description: The 7moor Visitor IM SDK opens this screen to show images attached to a customer support conversation. Users can browse the images and download remote ones.
en.disableEffect: Users will lose the full-screen preview and download option for images in 7moor support chats.

zh-CN.description: 7moor 访客客服 SDK 会打开此页面，显示客服会话中的图片。用户可以浏览图片，也可以下载远程图片。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法全屏预览或下载 7moor 客服聊天中的图片。

en.description: Android creates this Machbird provider early in app startup; it initializes the SDK and sets up its push support before other components run.
en.disableEffect: Machbird's automatic startup initialization and push setup will not run.

zh-CN.description: Android 会在应用启动早期创建此 Machbird Provider，以便在其他组件运行前初始化 SDK 并设置推送功能。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Machbird 的自动启动初始化和推送设置将无法运行。

en.description: This Machbird in-app browser displays a URL supplied by the SDK and reloads the page when network access returns.
en.disableEffect: Machbird web pages that use this in-app browser will not open.

zh-CN.description: 此 Machbird 应用内浏览器会显示 SDK 提供的网址，并在网络恢复后重新加载页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此应用内浏览器的 Machbird 网页将无法打开。

en.description: When an app opens the RunningAndroid Gallery Library picture manager, it scans the device gallery and shows images by folder. Users can select photos or take a new one with the camera app, then return their choices to the app.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot open this library image picker, so users cannot choose photos through it.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开 RunningAndroid Gallery Library 的图片管理页时，该页面会扫描设备相册并按文件夹显示图片。用户可以选择照片或调用相机拍照，再把选择结果返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，应用无法打开此图片选择页，用户也无法通过该库选择照片。

en.description: When an app opens Azerion BlueStack's consent manager, this Activity presents advertising privacy choices that users can accept, refuse, or edit for vendors, purposes, and features.
en.disableEffect: Users will lose access to this consent screen and its controls for changing advertising privacy choices.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开 Azerion BlueStack 同意管理工具时，此 Activity 会展示广告隐私选项，供用户接受、拒绝或编辑广告商、用途和功能的选择。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法使用此同意界面查看或更改广告隐私选择。

en.description: The Azerion BlueStack consent flow opens this page to list standard and special advertising features covered by a user's choices.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to review these feature categories in the consent flow.

zh-CN.description: Azerion BlueStack 同意流程会打开此页面，列出用户选择所涉及的常规和特殊广告功能。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法在同意流程中查看这些功能类别。

en.description: Opened from the Azerion BlueStack consent screen, this page lets users request information about stored personal data or request its deletion.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to submit personal-data access or deletion requests through this page.

zh-CN.description: 此页面从 Azerion BlueStack 同意界面打开，供用户请求查看已存储的个人数据或请求删除这些数据。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法通过此页面提交个人数据访问或删除请求。

en.description: The Azerion BlueStack consent tool opens this page to show special purposes recorded in a user's advertising consent settings.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to review these special purposes in the consent tool.

zh-CN.description: Azerion BlueStack 同意管理工具会打开此页面，显示用户广告同意设置中记录的特殊用途。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法在同意管理工具中查看这些特殊用途。

en.description: The Azerion BlueStack consent tool lists advertising vendors here and lets users accept or reject all before opening a vendor's details.
en.disableEffect: Users will lose access to the vendor list and its consent controls.

zh-CN.description: Azerion BlueStack 同意管理工具会在此列出广告商，供用户全部接受或拒绝，并打开单个广告商的详情。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法查看广告商列表或使用其中的同意控制。

en.description: When a user selects a vendor in the Azerion BlueStack consent tool, this page shows that vendor's purposes, features, and privacy policy, with controls for consent choices.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to review or change consent choices for individual vendors here.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Azerion BlueStack 同意管理工具中选择广告商后，此页面会显示该广告商的用途、功能和隐私政策，并提供同意选项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法在此查看或更改单个广告商的同意选项。

en.description: The Azerion BlueStack consent tool opens this page from Google vendor details to list Google's advertising technology providers and their policy links.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to review or set choices for Google's advertising technology providers.

zh-CN.description: Azerion BlueStack 同意管理工具会从 Google 广告商详情打开此页面，列出 Google 的广告技术提供商及其政策链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法查看或设置 Google 广告技术提供商的选项。

en.description: When Android delivers a location update or a boot, screen, or power-state broadcast, the Azerion BlueStack Location SDK handles the coordinates and schedules their background delivery.
en.disableEffect: The SDK's background location collection and delivery will stop.

zh-CN.description: Android 提供位置更新或发送设备启动、屏幕和电源状态广播时，Azerion BlueStack Location SDK 会处理坐标并安排后台传送。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，该 SDK 将停止在后台收集和传送位置数据。

en.description: qqlizhn's Android Common Utils accessibility service runs after the user enables it in Accessibility settings; the app can use it to find onscreen text and controls, tap them, scroll, or enter text.
en.disableEffect: The app's accessibility-driven screen actions will stop working.

zh-CN.description: qqlizhn 的 Android Common Utils 无障碍服务会在用户于无障碍设置中启用后运行，供应用查找屏幕文字和控件、点击、滚动或输入文字。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用依赖无障碍服务执行的屏幕操作将无法继续。

en.description: qqlizhn's Android Common Utils account service lets Android's account framework connect to the app's account handler; the included handler has no working account-creation or token flow.
en.disableEffect: Android account requests for this app will no longer reach the handler.

zh-CN.description: qqlizhn 的 Android Common Utils 账户服务供 Android 账户框架连接应用的账户处理器；其中的处理器没有可用的账户创建或令牌流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Android 发给此应用的账户请求将无法再到达该处理器。

en.description: Android's sync framework uses qqlizhn's Android Common Utils provider as the content authority paired with the app's sync service; the provider itself returns no content.
en.disableEffect: The app's scheduled sync requests may no longer run through their required content authority.

zh-CN.description: Android 同步框架会将 qqlizhn 的 Android Common Utils 提供程序用作应用同步服务对应的内容权限入口；该提供程序本身不返回内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用的定时同步请求可能无法再通过所需的内容权限入口运行。

en.description: Android's sync framework binds to qqlizhn's Android Common Utils service to run scheduled syncs; each run sends the app-configured internal broadcast.
en.disableEffect: The app's scheduled sync tasks and the work they trigger will stop.

zh-CN.description: Android 同步框架会连接 qqlizhn 的 Android Common Utils 服务来运行定时同步；每次同步都会发送应用配置的内部广播。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用的定时同步及其触发的工作将停止。

en.description: Android sends administrator activation and removal events to qqlizhn's Android Common Utils receiver, which records those changes for the app.
en.disableEffect: The app may miss device-administrator state changes, breaking its administration flow.

zh-CN.description: Android 会将设备管理员启用和移除事件发送给 qqlizhn 的 Android Common Utils 接收器，由它记录这些状态变化。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用可能无法收到设备管理员状态变化，从而影响其管理流程。

en.description: When the app sends its internal owner-removal message, qqlizhn's Android Common Utils receiver asks Android to clear the app's device-owner status.
en.disableEffect: The app's built-in device-owner removal flow will stop working.

zh-CN.description: 应用发送内部移除所有者消息时，qqlizhn 的 Android Common Utils 接收器会请求 Android 清除该应用的设备所有者状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用内置的设备所有者移除流程将无法使用。

en.description: qqlizhn's Android Common Utils libimobiledevice service starts a USB communication server and connects USB devices when the app requests it.
en.disableEffect: The app's USB device connection and any feature that relies on it will stop working.

zh-CN.description: qqlizhn 的 Android Common Utils libimobiledevice 服务会启动 USB 通信服务器，并在应用请求时连接 USB 设备。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用的 USB 设备连接及依赖该连接的功能将无法使用。

en.description: qqlizhn's Android Common Utils remote-task service runs in a separate process; the app can create background tasks and start, pause, resume, or stop them through it.
en.disableEffect: Background tasks sent through this service will no longer run or respond to controls.

zh-CN.description: qqlizhn 的 Android Common Utils 远程任务服务运行在独立进程中，应用可通过它创建、启动、暂停、恢复或停止后台任务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过此服务提交的后台任务将无法运行或响应控制操作。

en.description: qqlizhn's Android Common Utils foreground location service checks available location sources and requests a location update while showing an ongoing notification.
en.disableEffect: App features that use UnifiedLocation will stop receiving these background location updates.

zh-CN.description: qqlizhn 的 Android Common Utils 前台定位服务会检查可用的位置来源、请求位置更新，并显示持续通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用 UnifiedLocation 的应用功能将无法再收到这些后台位置更新。

en.description: The ManuSunny PinLock library shows this entry screen when the app asks the user to confirm an existing PIN. The app checks the entered PIN and can offer a forgotten-PIN action.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot show this PIN confirmation screen, which may block access to features protected by the app PIN.

zh-CN.description: 应用要求确认已有 PIN 时，ManuSunny PinLock 库会显示此输入页面。应用会检查输入的 PIN，也可以提供忘记 PIN 的操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，应用无法显示此 PIN 确认页，依赖 PIN 保护的功能可能无法访问。

en.description: The ManuSunny PinLock library shows this screen when the app asks the user to create a PIN. It asks for the PIN twice and returns it to the app only when both entries match.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot use this screen to set or change its PIN lock.

zh-CN.description: 应用要求设置 PIN 时，ManuSunny PinLock 库会显示此页面。用户需要输入两次相同的 PIN，匹配后页面才会把结果交回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，应用无法通过此页面设置或更改 PIN 锁。

en.description: Mapbox Android Telemetry binds this service during startup to follow whether the app is in the foreground or background. It saves those app state changes for Mapbox telemetry.
en.disableEffect: Mapbox telemetry will stop receiving app foreground and background state changes.

zh-CN.description: Mapbox Android Telemetry 会在启动初始化时绑定此服务，以跟踪应用处于前台还是后台，并保存这些状态供遥测使用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，Mapbox 遥测将无法继续接收应用前后台状态变化。

en.description: Mapbox Android Telemetry queues this background job when its crash reporting flow requests delivery. It sends saved Mapbox crash reports from the device to Mapbox.
en.disableEffect: Saved Mapbox crash reports will not be uploaded by this job.

zh-CN.description: Mapbox Android Telemetry 安排崩溃报告发送时会运行此后台任务，将设备上保存的 Mapbox 崩溃报告发送给 Mapbox。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，此任务不会上传设备上保存的 Mapbox 崩溃报告。

en.description: Mapbox Android Telemetry queues this background job for SDK error reporting. It sends queued Mapbox SDK error reports to Mapbox.
en.disableEffect: Queued Mapbox SDK error reports will not be uploaded.

zh-CN.description: Mapbox Android Telemetry 会为 SDK 错误报告安排此后台任务，并将排队的 Mapbox SDK 错误报告发送给 Mapbox。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，排队的 Mapbox SDK 错误报告将无法上传。

en.description: Android runs the Mapbox Android Telemetry provider during app startup. It registers access-token change handling, installs Mapbox crash reporting, and configures periodic location collection.
en.disableEffect: Mapbox telemetry, location collection, and SDK crash reporting will not be initialized automatically.

zh-CN.description: Android 会在应用启动时运行 Mapbox Android Telemetry 提供程序。它会注册访问令牌变化处理、安装 Mapbox 崩溃报告，并设置周期性位置收集。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，Mapbox 遥测、位置收集和 SDK 崩溃报告将无法自动初始化。

en.description: The Mapbox Android Offline Plugin starts this service when the app starts or cancels an offline map download. It creates saved map regions and reports download progress and completion.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot start, cancel, or track offline map downloads through this plugin.

zh-CN.description: 应用开始或取消离线地图下载时，Mapbox Android Offline Plugin 会启动此服务。它会创建离线地图区域，并报告下载进度和完成状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，应用无法通过此插件开始、取消或跟踪离线地图下载。

en.description: The Mapbox Android Offline Plugin opens this screen when the app asks the user to choose a map area for offline use. The selected area and name are returned to the app for saving.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot choose a map area to save for offline use through this plugin.

zh-CN.description: 应用要求用户选择离线使用的地图区域时，Mapbox Android Offline Plugin 会打开此页面。用户选定的区域和名称会返回给应用以便保存。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，用户无法通过此插件选择要保存供离线使用的地图区域。

en.description: The Mapbox Places Plugin opens this screen when the app requests place search. It shows autocomplete suggestions and returns the selected place to the app.
en.disableEffect: Place search through this plugin cannot open, so users cannot choose an autocomplete result.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求搜索地点时，Mapbox Places Plugin 会打开此页面，显示自动补全建议并把用户选中的地点返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，此插件无法打开地点搜索页，用户也无法选择自动补全结果。

en.description: The Mapbox Places Plugin opens an interactive map when the app asks the user to choose a location. It can look up the place at the map center and returns the selection to the app.
en.disableEffect: Map-based location picking through this plugin is unavailable.

zh-CN.description: 应用要求用户选择地点时，Mapbox Places Plugin 会打开交互式地图。它可以查询地图中心位置的地点，并把用户的选择返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，应用无法通过此插件在地图上选择地点。

en.description: Android runs the Mapbox Navigation SDK provider during app startup. For apps billed by monthly active users, it obtains the SDK token used for account and usage reporting.
en.disableEffect: Monthly-active-user billing may miss its SDK token setup, disrupting Mapbox navigation account reporting.

zh-CN.description: Android 会在应用启动时运行 Mapbox Navigation SDK 提供程序。按月活跃用户计费的应用会通过它获取用于账户和用量报告的 SDK 令牌。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，按月活跃用户计费所需的 SDK 令牌可能无法初始化，影响 Mapbox 导航的账户用量报告。

en.description: The Mapbox Navigation SDK starts this service when a trip session begins, then displays the ongoing navigation notification and updates it with trip information.
en.disableEffect: The app may lose its persistent navigation notification and background guidance during a trip.

zh-CN.description: Mapbox Navigation SDK 会在行程会话开始时启动此服务，显示持续的导航通知，并用行程信息更新通知内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，应用可能无法在行程中显示持续的导航通知或维持后台导航指引。

en.description: The Mapbox Places Plugin opens this screen when the app requests place search. It shows autocomplete suggestions and returns the selected place to the app.
en.disableEffect: Place search through this plugin cannot open, so users cannot choose an autocomplete result.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求搜索地点时，Mapbox Places Plugin 会打开此页面，显示自动补全建议并把用户选中的地点返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，此插件无法打开地点搜索页，用户也无法选择自动补全结果。

en.description: The Mapbox Places Plugin opens an interactive map when the app asks the user to choose a location. It can look up the place at the map center and returns the selection to the app.
en.disableEffect: Map-based location picking through this plugin is unavailable.

zh-CN.description: 应用要求用户选择地点时，Mapbox Places Plugin 会打开交互式地图。它可以查询地图中心位置的地点，并把用户的选择返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，应用无法通过此插件在地图上选择地点。

en.description: Mapbox Navigation UI opens this screen when the app starts guidance for a supplied route. It hosts the turn-by-turn map view and closes when navigation is canceled or completed.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot launch this SDK-provided turn-by-turn navigation screen.

zh-CN.description: 应用为指定路线启动导航时，Mapbox Navigation UI 会打开此页面并显示逐向导航地图。用户取消或完成导航后，页面会关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，应用无法打开此 SDK 提供的逐向导航页面。

en.description: The Mapbox Navigation SDK starts this service for a navigation session to update the route and device location, process guidance, and keep the ongoing navigation notification active.
en.disableEffect: The SDK cannot start or maintain turn-by-turn route guidance through this service.

zh-CN.description: Mapbox Navigation SDK 会在导航会话期间启动此服务，以更新路线和设备位置、处理导航指引并维持正在进行的导航通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，SDK 无法通过此服务启动或维持逐向路线导航。

en.description: The Mapbox Navigation SDK starts this service for a navigation session to update the route and device location, process guidance, and keep the ongoing navigation notification active.
en.disableEffect: The SDK cannot start or maintain turn-by-turn route guidance through this service.

zh-CN.description: Mapbox Navigation SDK 会在导航会话期间启动此服务，以更新路线和设备位置、处理导航指引并维持正在进行的导航通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，SDK 无法通过此服务启动或维持逐向路线导航。

en.description: Android initializes the MapmyIndia BLE plugin as the app starts, preparing its Bluetooth Low Energy scanning support.
en.disableEffect: MapmyIndia BLE scanning features may fail to initialize.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，Android 会初始化 MapmyIndia BLE 插件，为插件的低功耗蓝牙扫描功能做好准备。
zh-CN.disableEffect: MapmyIndia BLE 插件提供的扫描功能可能无法初始化。

en.description: When the app opens the MapmyIndia Feedback UI, this Activity loads issue categories and guides the user through selecting a category and subcategory and describing the problem before submitting a report.
en.disableEffect: The app’s MapmyIndia issue-report form will not open, so users cannot submit reports through it.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开 MapmyIndia 反馈界面时，此 Activity 会加载问题类别，并引导用户选择类别和子类别、填写问题说明，然后提交报告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用的 MapmyIndia 问题反馈表单将无法打开，用户也无法通过它提交报告。

en.description: Android creates this MapmyIndia InTouch Provider during app startup to initialize InTouch and prepare its local location-tracking storage.
en.disableEffect: InTouch may not initialize its tracking storage, so location tracking can fail.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，Android 会创建此 MapmyIndia InTouch Provider，以初始化 InTouch 并准备本地位置跟踪存储。
zh-CN.disableEffect: InTouch 可能无法初始化跟踪存储，导致位置跟踪无法正常运行。

en.description: When the app opens the MapmyIndia Nearby widget, this Activity displays place categories and nearby results; selecting a result returns that place to the app.
en.disableEffect: Apps using the widget can no longer show nearby places or return a selected place.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开 MapmyIndia Nearby 小组件时，此 Activity 会显示地点类别和附近结果；用户选择结果后，该地点会返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此小组件的应用将无法显示附近地点或返回用户选中的地点。

en.description: When the app opens the MapmyIndia Places Widget search screen, this Activity shows place suggestions and returns the selected place or suggested search to the app.
en.disableEffect: Apps using the widget can no longer open its place search and suggestion flow.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开 MapmyIndia Places Widget 搜索界面时，此 Activity 会显示地点建议，并将用户选中的地点或搜索建议返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此小组件的应用将无法打开地点搜索和建议选择流程。

en.description: When the app opens the MapmyIndia Places Widget picker, this Activity displays a map where the user can choose a location and return its place details to the app.
en.disableEffect: Apps using the picker can no longer let users choose and return a location through this map screen.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开 MapmyIndia Places Widget 选点界面时，此 Activity 会显示地图，供用户选择位置并将地点信息返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此选点界面的应用将无法让用户通过地图选择位置并返回结果。

en.description: Android creates this Provider during app startup to initialize the MapmyIndia Safety plugin with the app.
en.disableEffect: The MapmyIndia Safety plugin may not initialize, so its tracking features can fail.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，Android 会创建此 Provider，为 MapmyIndia Safety 插件提供应用环境并完成初始化。
zh-CN.disableEffect: MapmyIndia Safety 插件可能无法初始化，其跟踪功能也可能无法运行。

en.description: Android creates this MapmyIndia Safety plugin Provider at startup; it initializes the location storage used by safety tracking.
en.disableEffect: Safety tracking may fail to store location data or start correctly.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，Android 会创建此 MapmyIndia Safety 插件 Provider，初始化安全跟踪使用的位置存储。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 安全跟踪可能无法保存位置数据或正常启动。

en.description: When MapmyIndia Safety tracking starts, this foreground Service keeps requesting location updates and reading movement sensors in the background.
en.disableEffect: MapmyIndia Safety location tracking and its movement updates will stop.

zh-CN.description: MapmyIndia Safety 跟踪启动后，此前台 Service 会在后台持续获取位置更新并读取运动传感器数据。
zh-CN.disableEffect: MapmyIndia Safety 的位置跟踪和运动状态更新将停止。

en.description: When MapmyIndia Safety’s activity-recognition system delivers an update, this Service identifies the detected movement and passes it to the tracker.
en.disableEffect: The Safety tracker will no longer receive activity-recognition updates.

zh-CN.description: MapmyIndia Safety 的活动识别系统送来更新时，此 Service 会识别检测到的运动状态并传给跟踪功能。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Safety 跟踪功能将不再收到活动识别更新。

en.description: When Android reports an app replacement or the MapmyIndia Safety plugin receives a broadcast, this Receiver reinitializes Safety tracking.
en.disableEffect: Safety tracking will no longer reinitialize in response to these broadcasts.

zh-CN.description: Android 报告应用被替换或 MapmyIndia Safety 插件收到广播时，此 Receiver 会重新初始化 Safety 跟踪。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Safety 跟踪将不再因这些广播而重新初始化。

en.description: When MapmyIndia Safety needs location access, this Activity requests location, background-location, and activity-recognition permissions; after approval it can start tracking or a one-time location update.
en.disableEffect: The Safety plugin cannot guide the user through these permissions, so its tracking or location lookup may fail to start.

zh-CN.description: MapmyIndia Safety 需要位置权限时，此 Activity 会请求位置、后台位置和活动识别权限；获得授权后可启动跟踪或单次位置更新。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Safety 插件将无法引导用户授予这些权限，因此跟踪或位置查询可能无法启动。

en.description: When Android reports a package replacement or MapmyIndia InTouch receives a broadcast, this Receiver reinitializes InTouch tracking.
en.disableEffect: InTouch tracking may no longer automatically reinitialize after these broadcasts.

zh-CN.description: Android 报告软件包被替换或 MapmyIndia InTouch 收到广播时，此 Receiver 会重新初始化 InTouch 跟踪。
zh-CN.disableEffect: InTouch 跟踪可能无法再因这些广播而自动重新初始化。

en.description: When MapmyIndia InTouch tracking starts, this foreground Service keeps obtaining location updates, recognizing movement, and reading device sensors in the background.
en.disableEffect: InTouch background location tracking and its movement updates will stop.

zh-CN.description: MapmyIndia InTouch 跟踪启动后，此前台 Service 会在后台持续获取位置更新、识别运动状态并读取设备传感器数据。
zh-CN.disableEffect: InTouch 的后台位置跟踪和运动状态更新将停止。

en.description: When the activity-recognition system delivers a movement update to MapmyIndia InTouch, this Service passes the detected activity to the tracker.
en.disableEffect: InTouch tracking will no longer receive activity-recognition updates.

zh-CN.description: 活动识别系统向 MapmyIndia InTouch 发送运动更新时，此 Service 会将检测到的活动传给跟踪功能。
zh-CN.disableEffect: InTouch 跟踪功能将不再收到活动识别更新。

en.description: When MapmyIndia InTouch needs location access, this Activity requests location, background-location, and activity-recognition permissions, then resumes continuous or one-time tracking after approval.
en.disableEffect: InTouch cannot guide the user through the required permissions, so location tracking may not start.

zh-CN.description: MapmyIndia InTouch 需要位置权限时，此 Activity 会请求位置、后台位置和活动识别权限，并在获得授权后恢复持续跟踪或单次位置更新。
zh-CN.disableEffect: InTouch 将无法引导用户授予所需权限，因此位置跟踪可能无法启动。

en.description: When an app opens the MapmyIndia InTouch live-video screen, this Activity shows a camera preview and lets the user start or stop a live stream, switch cameras, mute audio, and change resolution.
en.disableEffect: Apps that use InTouch live video will not be able to open this broadcast screen.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开 MapmyIndia InTouch 直播界面时，此 Activity 会显示摄像头预览，并允许用户开始或停止直播、切换摄像头、静音和调整分辨率。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用 InTouch 直播功能的应用将无法打开此直播界面。

en.description: At app startup, the Mappls BLE plugin uses this provider to initialize Bluetooth scanning so it can detect nearby Bluetooth sensors.
en.disableEffect: Mappls BLE scanning will not be initialized, so features that use nearby Bluetooth sensors may stop working.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，Mappls BLE 插件会通过此提供程序初始化蓝牙扫描，以检测附近的蓝牙传感器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Mappls BLE 扫描将无法初始化，因此依赖附近蓝牙传感器的功能可能无法工作。

en.description: When the app opens Mappls feedback, this activity shows the report form and returns whether the user submitted or cancelled it.
en.disableEffect: Users will no longer be able to open or submit the Mappls feedback form.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开 Mappls 反馈功能时，此界面会显示反馈表单，并返回用户是提交还是取消。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开或提交 Mappls 反馈表单。

en.description: At app startup, Mappls InTouch uses this provider to initialize location storage and schedule background location uploads.
en.disableEffect: Mappls InTouch location collection and background uploads will not be initialized.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，Mappls InTouch 会通过此提供程序初始化位置存储并安排后台位置上传。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Mappls InTouch 的位置收集和后台上传将无法初始化。

en.description: When the app opens Mappls Nearby, this activity displays nearby categories and places, then returns the place the user selects.
en.disableEffect: The app's Mappls nearby-place search and selection flow will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开 Mappls Nearby 时，此界面会显示附近类别和地点，并返回用户选择的地点。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用中的 Mappls 附近地点搜索和选择流程将无法打开。

en.description: When the app opens Mappls place autocomplete, this activity displays place suggestions and returns the chosen place, favorite, or suggested search.
en.disableEffect: The app's Mappls place-search suggestions and selection flow will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开 Mappls 地点自动补全功能时，此界面会显示地点建议，并返回选中的地点、收藏地点或建议搜索。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用中的 Mappls 地点搜索建议和选择流程将无法打开。

en.description: When the app opens Mappls Place Picker, this activity shows a map with search and location selection and returns the selected place.
en.disableEffect: The app's Mappls map-based place-selection flow will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开 Mappls Place Picker 时，此界面会显示地图和搜索功能，供用户选择地点并将其返回。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用中的 Mappls 地图选点流程将无法打开。

en.description: When the app or package is replaced, or a Mappls beacon event arrives, this InTouch receiver restarts beacon tracking if tracking is enabled.
en.disableEffect: Mappls beacon tracking may not resume after an app update or beacon event.

zh-CN.description: 应用或程序包更新，或收到 Mappls beacon 事件时，如果已启用跟踪，此 InTouch 接收器会重新启动 beacon 跟踪。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用更新或收到 beacon 事件后，Mappls beacon 跟踪可能无法恢复。

en.description: When Mappls InTouch beacon tracking starts, this foreground service gathers location and movement or sensor readings, sends tracking data, and shows a tracking notification.
en.disableEffect: Background location updates, beacon reports, and the tracking notification will stop.

zh-CN.description: Mappls InTouch beacon 跟踪启动时，此前台服务会收集位置及移动或传感器数据、发送跟踪信息，并显示跟踪通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 后台位置更新、beacon 报告和跟踪通知将停止。

en.description: When Android supplies a recognized activity update, this Mappls InTouch service forwards the activity type to the beacon tracker.
en.disableEffect: Movement activity updates will no longer be included in Mappls beacon tracking.

zh-CN.description: Android 提供识别到的活动更新时，此 Mappls InTouch 服务会将活动类型转发给 beacon 跟踪器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Mappls beacon 跟踪将不再包含移动活动更新。

en.description: When Mappls InTouch needs location access, this activity explains the request and asks Android for permissions for continuous or one-time location use.
en.disableEffect: Mappls InTouch will not be able to request location access for its tracking features.

zh-CN.description: Mappls InTouch 需要访问位置时，此界面会说明原因，并向 Android 请求持续或单次位置使用权限。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Mappls InTouch 将无法为跟踪功能请求位置访问权限。

en.description: Mapxus Positioning binds to this service to combine Wi-Fi, GPS, and movement readings into indoor or outdoor location updates for the app.
en.disableEffect: Mapxus positioning results will stop, so app features that rely on this location service may fail.

zh-CN.description: Mapxus Positioning 会绑定此服务，将 Wi-Fi、GPS 和移动传感器数据结合起来，为应用提供室内或室外位置更新。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Mapxus 定位结果将停止，依赖此位置服务的应用功能可能无法工作。

en.description: Mapxus Positioning binds to this service to sample requested device readings, including Wi-Fi, GPS, Bluetooth, and motion sensors, and deliver them to listeners.
en.disableEffect: Mapxus sensor readings will no longer be collected for positioning features.

zh-CN.description: Mapxus Positioning 会绑定此服务，采集所需的设备数据，包括 Wi-Fi、GPS、蓝牙和运动传感器数据，并将其提供给监听方。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Mapxus 定位功能将无法继续采集传感器数据。

en.description: When an app binds to or starts the Mapxus Sensing service, it starts or stops the sensor sampling requested by the app.
en.disableEffect: Sensor sampling requested through the Mapxus Sensing SDK will no longer run.

zh-CN.description: 应用绑定或启动 Mapxus Sensing 服务时，此服务会按应用请求启动或停止传感器采样。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过 Mapxus Sensing SDK 请求的传感器采样将无法运行。

en.description: When Mapzen LOST receives a geofence transition, this Service forwards the transition and the device’s triggering location to the app that registered it.
en.disableEffect: Location-based alerts or reminders that rely on this geofence callback may stop working.

zh-CN.description: Mapzen LOST 收到地理围栏变化时，会把变化事件和设备当时的位置发送给注册该围栏的应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此围栏回调的位置提醒或通知可能会停止。

en.description: When a geofence dwell event arrives, Mapzen LOST uses this Service to forward it to the app that registered the geofence.
en.disableEffect: Features triggered by staying in a location may stop receiving their geofence notifications.

zh-CN.description: 收到地理围栏停留事件时，Mapzen LOST 会将事件转发给注册该围栏的应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖用户在某个地点停留来触发的功能可能无法再收到围栏通知。

en.description: Mapzen LOST uses this Service to provide an app’s last known location, location availability, and requested ongoing location updates.
en.disableEffect: The app may lose the location results and updates it requests through Mapzen LOST.

zh-CN.description: Mapzen LOST 通过此服务向应用提供最后已知位置、位置服务状态和应用请求的持续位置更新。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用可能无法再通过 Mapzen LOST 获取所请求的位置结果和持续更新。

en.description: When Mapzen LOST receives a geofence transition, this Service forwards it to the app and checks whether it should trigger a dwell notification.
en.disableEffect: Geofence entry, exit, or dwell events may stop reaching the app, disrupting location-based features.

zh-CN.description: Mapzen LOST 收到地理围栏变化时，会将事件发送给应用，并检查是否需要触发停留通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用可能无法再收到进入、离开或停留事件，依赖这些事件的位置功能也会受影响。

en.description: When Mapzen LOST needs the user to enable location, this Activity enables Bluetooth when an adapter is available and opens Android’s Location settings. It closes when the user returns.
en.disableEffect: Location requests that need this resolution flow may fail or leave the user unable to enable the required setting.

zh-CN.description: Mapzen LOST 需要用户开启位置服务时，会在设备支持时尝试开启蓝牙，并打开 Android 的位置设置；用户返回后此页面会关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要此引导流程的位置请求可能失败，用户也可能无法开启所需设置。

en.description: When an app requests Mapzen Places autocomplete, this activity searches place names and returns the chosen place and its details.
en.disableEffect: The app's Mapzen place-autocomplete search and selection flow will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求 Mapzen Places 自动补全时，此界面会搜索地点名称，并返回选中的地点及其详细信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用中的 Mapzen 地点自动补全搜索和选择流程将无法打开。

en.description: When an app requests the Mapzen Places picker, this activity displays a map, lets the user select a place, and returns that place to the app.
en.disableEffect: The app's Mapzen map-based place-selection flow will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求 Mapzen Places 选点器时，此界面会显示地图，供用户选择地点并将结果返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用中的 Mapzen 地图选点流程将无法打开。

en.description: When a user opens a Markelytics survey, this Activity presents the survey inside the app and sends completion information back to the app.
en.disableEffect: Users may lose access to in-app Markelytics surveys, and the app may not receive their completion results.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 Markelytics 问卷时，会在应用内看到问卷，完成情况也会返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户可能无法使用应用内的 Markelytics 问卷，应用也可能收不到问卷完成结果。

en.description: When Market CTV presents a video ad, this Activity places the SDK’s video player on screen and reports ad completion or dismissal.
en.disableEffect: The CTV SDK will no longer be able to show its video ads in the app.

zh-CN.description: Market CTV 展示视频广告时，此页面会播放广告，并报告播放完成或关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，CTV SDK 将无法在应用中展示视频广告。

en.description: Xiaomi Market uses this Receiver after Android reports a completed download, then handles the downloaded app installation.
en.disableEffect: Xiaomi Market ad-download completion and install handoff will stop working.

zh-CN.description: Android 报告下载完成后，Xiaomi Market 会通过此 Receiver 处理已下载应用的安装。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Xiaomi Market 广告下载完成处理和安装跳转将无法使用。

en.description: Xiaomi Market uses this file provider to share update files with Android during its self-update flow.
en.disableEffect: Xiaomi Market self-updates or file sharing for updates may fail.

zh-CN.description: Xiaomi Market 在自我更新流程中使用此文件提供程序向 Android 共享更新文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Xiaomi Market 自我更新或更新文件共享可能失败。

en.description: When the app asks Peko to request Android permissions, this transparent Activity presents the system permission prompt and returns each grant or denial.
en.disableEffect: App features that rely on permissions requested through Peko may not be able to start.

zh-CN.description: 应用通过 Peko 请求 Android 权限时，这个透明页面会显示系统权限提示，并把每项权限的允许或拒绝结果返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖 Peko 请求权限的应用功能可能无法启动。

en.description: The BlackfireTeam MSIMSDK push integration receives Firebase push-token updates and incoming push messages; it passes updated tokens to the messaging SDK.
en.disableEffect: MSIMSDK push delivery and alerts may stop.

zh-CN.description: BlackfireTeam MSIMSDK 推送集成会接收 Firebase 推送标识更新和到达的推送消息，并把更新后的标识交给消息 SDK。
zh-CN.disableEffect: MSIMSDK 推送和提醒可能停止。

en.description: The BlackfireTeam MSIMSDK opens this one-to-one chat screen for a selected person, where users can read and send conversation messages.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to open one-to-one conversations through the MSIMSDK chat interface.

zh-CN.description: 选择联系人后，BlackfireTeam MSIMSDK 会打开此单聊页面，供用户查看和发送会话消息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 MSIMSDK 聊天界面打开一对一会话。

en.description: At app startup, this background component prepares the RxBluetoothKotlin library to scan for nearby Bluetooth devices, check permissions, and connect.
en.disableEffect: Bluetooth scanning or device connections used by the app may fail to initialize.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，这个后台组件为 RxBluetoothKotlin 准备蓝牙功能所需的应用访问能力，以便扫描附近设备、检查权限并连接设备。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用使用的蓝牙扫描或设备连接功能可能无法初始化。

en.description: If Mastercard Commerce checkout needs to report a connectivity problem, this Activity shows an error dialog; confirming it returns a checkout cancellation error to the app.
en.disableEffect: Checkout may not be able to show its connectivity error or return a cancellation result cleanly.

zh-CN.description: Mastercard Commerce 结账遇到网络问题时，此页面会显示错误提示；用户确认后，应用会收到取消结账的错误结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 结账遇到网络问题时，可能无法显示错误提示或正常返回取消结果。

en.description: When the app starts Mastercard Commerce web checkout, this Activity loads the supplied checkout page in an in-app web view and returns the transaction result.
en.disableEffect: Users may be unable to complete Mastercard Commerce checkout in apps that use this flow.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动 Mastercard Commerce 网页结账时，此页面会在应用内打开结账内容，并把交易结果返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此流程的应用中，用户可能无法完成 Mastercard Commerce 结账。

en.description: When the app starts Mastercard Open Banking Connect, this Activity displays the configured financial connection page and handles authorization redirects back into the app.
en.disableEffect: Users may be unable to connect a financial account or return from its authorization flow.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动 Mastercard Open Banking Connect 时，此页面会显示金融账户连接流程，并处理授权后返回应用的跳转。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户可能无法连接金融账户，或无法从授权流程返回应用。

en.description: During Mastercard Open Banking Connect authorization, this Activity opens the external browser page and tells Connect when it cannot open or when the user closes it.
en.disableEffect: The bank authorization page may fail to open or return to Connect correctly.

zh-CN.description: Mastercard Open Banking Connect 进行银行授权时，此页面会打开外部浏览器，并在页面无法打开或用户关闭时通知 Connect。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 银行授权页面可能无法打开，或无法正常返回 Connect。

en.description: When an app starts Mastercard Open Banking Connect Transfer with a transfer link, this Activity presents the transfer flow and returns completion, cancellation, or error results.
en.disableEffect: Users may be unable to complete the app’s Mastercard transfer flow or return its result.

zh-CN.description: 应用通过转账链接启动 Mastercard Open Banking Connect Transfer 时，此页面会展示转账流程，并把完成、取消或错误结果返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户可能无法完成应用中的 Mastercard 转账流程，或无法返回流程结果。

en.description: Moviper’s test utilities use this Activity as an empty screen for placing views under test.
en.disableEffect: Only tests that use this Moviper container stop running; normal app screens are unaffected.

zh-CN.description: Moviper 测试工具使用此页面作为空白容器，以便放置待测视图。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 只有使用此 Moviper 容器的测试会停止运行，应用的普通界面不受影响。

en.description: Moviper’s instrumented tests use this Activity to insert a view-holder layout and inspect it during testing.
en.disableEffect: The Moviper view-holder test cannot inspect its layout; normal app features are unaffected.

zh-CN.description: Moviper 仪器测试使用此页面插入并检查待测布局。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Moviper 的 view-holder 测试将无法检查其布局，应用的普通功能不受影响。

en.description: Maticoo Ads sets up automatic app-activity tracking when the host app starts. The SDK uses it to follow activity changes while its ads are in use.
en.disableEffect: Maticoo's automatic activity tracking will not start; the host app's normal screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: Maticoo 广告 SDK 会在宿主应用启动时初始化自动的页面活动跟踪，供其广告功能使用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Maticoo 的自动活动跟踪不会启动；宿主应用的普通页面仍可使用。

en.description: Maticoo Ads opens a full-screen page to show an interactive ad when the app presents that placement. Viewers can use the ad page's own back and close actions.
en.disableEffect: Interactive Maticoo ads will not open; the host app's other features remain available.

zh-CN.description: Maticoo 广告 SDK 在展示互动广告时会打开全屏页面，用户可以使用广告页面自己的返回和关闭操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Maticoo 的互动广告将无法打开；宿主应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: Maticoo Ads opens this full-screen page to show a web interstitial. It displays a close countdown and allows dismissal when the countdown ends.
en.disableEffect: Maticoo 插屏广告将无法显示；宿主应用不依赖广告的功能仍可使用。

zh-CN.description: Maticoo 广告 SDK 会打开此全屏页面展示网页插屏广告，并显示关闭倒计时；倒计时结束后用户可以关闭广告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Maticoo 插屏广告将无法显示；宿主应用不依赖广告的功能仍可使用。

en.description: Maticoo Ads uses this full-screen page for an interactive interstitial. It displays the ad and allows closing when the ad's close control or countdown permits it.
en.disableEffect: Maticoo interactive interstitial ads will not display; the host app's other features remain available.

zh-CN.description: Maticoo 广告 SDK 使用此全屏页面展示互动插屏广告，并在广告允许关闭时响应关闭操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Maticoo 的互动插屏广告将无法显示；宿主应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: Maticoo Ads opens this page to show a launch-screen ad. A countdown controls when it can be skipped or when the ad closes.
en.disableEffect: Maticoo 启动页广告将不会显示；宿主应用的其他功能仍可使用。

zh-CN.description: Maticoo 广告 SDK 会打开此页面展示启动页广告，并通过倒计时控制何时可以跳过或关闭广告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Maticoo 启动页广告将不会显示；宿主应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: Maticoo Ads opens this page to play a full-screen video ad, including rewarded-video placements. The SDK reports when a viewer earns a reward.
en.disableEffect: Maticoo video ads will not open, and users will no longer receive rewards for watching ads.

zh-CN.description: Maticoo 广告 SDK 会打开此页面播放全屏视频广告，也包括激励视频广告；用户完成观看并获得奖励时，SDK 会记录该结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Maticoo 视频广告将无法打开，用户也不会再因观看广告获得奖励。

en.description: When a user starts a screen capture from Matt Precious’s Telescope bug-report tool, this Activity opens Android’s screen-capture consent prompt and returns the choice to the report flow.
en.disableEffect: Telescope cannot request screen capture, so a bug report that needs a captured screen cannot be completed.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Matt Precious 的 Telescope 错误报告工具中启动屏幕捕获时，此 Activity 会显示 Android 的屏幕捕获授权提示，并将用户的选择交回报告流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Telescope 无法申请屏幕捕获，因此需要屏幕内容的错误报告无法完成。

en.description: When Telescope attaches a captured screenshot to a bug-report email, this Provider gives the email app temporary access to the image file.
en.disableEffect: The screenshot cannot be attached or shared, so that bug-report action may fail.

zh-CN.description: Telescope 将屏幕截图添加到错误报告邮件时，此 Provider 会让邮件应用临时读取该图片文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 截图无法附加或分享，因此该错误报告操作可能失败。

en.description: After the user approves screen capture, Telescope starts this foreground Service to pass the capture permission to its bug-report screen.
en.disableEffect: Telescope cannot continue the screen-capture flow or include the captured screen in a bug report.

zh-CN.description: 用户同意屏幕捕获后，Telescope 会启动此前台 Service，将捕获权限交给错误报告界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Telescope 无法继续屏幕捕获流程，也无法在错误报告中加入屏幕内容。

en.description: VersatileLog's launcher screen opens its sample logging interface; when it starts, it writes sample messages and sets up the app's navigation.
en.disableEffect: VersatileLog's sample logging screen can no longer be opened from its launcher entry.

zh-CN.description: VersatileLog 的启动界面会打开示例日志界面；启动时会写入示例日志并设置应用导航。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，无法通过 VersatileLog 的启动入口打开其示例日志界面。

en.description: When a host app starts checkout through the MaxPay Payment Android SDK, this Activity displays its payment form and any required bank verification screen.
en.disableEffect: The MaxPay checkout and any required bank verification cannot be completed.

zh-CN.description: 宿主应用通过 MaxPay Payment Android SDK 启动结账时，此 Activity 会显示付款表单以及需要的银行验证界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: MaxPay 结账及所需的银行验证将无法完成。

en.description: The conf-interface Android library opens this screen when the app requests a web page; it loads the page inside the app, handles links and downloads, supports full-screen video, and reports page events back to the app.
en.disableEffect: App screens or flows that depend on this in-app web browser can no longer open.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求显示网页时，conf-interface Android 库会打开此界面；它在应用内加载网页、处理链接和下载、支持全屏视频，并将页面事件反馈给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此应用内浏览器的页面或流程将无法打开。

en.description: Mayzs FTP Server starts an FTP server when the app requests file sharing. It keeps the server available for connections until it is stopped.
en.disableEffect: The FTP server will not start or stay available, so other devices cannot transfer files through the app.

zh-CN.description: Mayzs FTP 服务器库会在应用请求共享文件时启动 FTP 服务器，并在停止前持续接受连接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: FTP 服务器将无法启动或保持运行，其他设备也就无法通过此应用传输文件。

en.description: Mayzs FTP Server announces its running FTP server on the local network so compatible devices can find it automatically.
en.disableEffect: Automatic network discovery of the FTP server stops; compatible clients must use the server's address and port instead.

zh-CN.description: Mayzs FTP 服务器库会在本地网络公布正在运行的 FTP 服务，方便兼容设备自动发现它。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 其他设备将无法自动发现 FTP 服务器，需要改用服务器地址和端口连接。

en.description: Mayzs FTP Server opens this page when the user chooses About. It displays the library's about information.
en.disableEffect: The About page will not open; FTP file sharing remains available.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择“关于”时，Mayzs FTP 服务器库会打开此页面显示相关信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: “关于”页面将无法打开；FTP 文件共享仍可使用。

en.description: Mayzs FTP Server provides a Quick Settings tile that shows the server state and starts or stops file sharing when tapped.
en.disableEffect: The Quick Settings tile will no longer control the FTP server; users must start or stop sharing from the app.

zh-CN.description: Mayzs FTP 服务器库提供快捷设置磁贴，用于显示服务器状态，并在点击时启动或停止文件共享。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 快捷设置磁贴将无法控制 FTP 服务器，用户需要在应用中启动或停止共享。

en.description: Mayzs FTP Server updates its home-screen widget when Android refreshes it or the server starts or stops. The widget shows the server state and provides a start/stop button.
en.disableEffect: The FTP status widget can no longer be added or refreshed through the system's widget broadcasts.

zh-CN.description: Android 刷新桌面小组件或 FTP 服务器启动、停止时，Mayzs FTP 服务器库会更新状态小组件；小组件还提供启动和停止按钮。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 系统发送小组件广播后，FTP 状态小组件将无法添加或更新。

en.description: Mayzs FTP Server uses this background service to refresh its home-screen widget and set the button that starts or stops the server.
en.disableEffect: The widget's server status and its start/stop controls will no longer be refreshed.

zh-CN.description: Mayzs FTP 服务器库通过此后台服务刷新桌面状态小组件，并设置用于启动或停止服务器的按钮。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 小组件中的服务器状态和启动、停止控件将无法刷新。

en.description: Mayzs FTP Server opens this screen from its settings to display saved server logs or the system log. It refreshes the displayed entries while open.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to open the FTP log screen, but file sharing can continue.

zh-CN.description: 用户从设置中打开此页面后，Mayzs FTP 服务器库会显示保存的服务器日志或系统日志，并在页面打开时刷新内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开 FTP 日志页面，但文件共享仍可继续。

en.description: Mayzs FTP Server opens this settings page to control anonymous access, its shared folder and its connection limit.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to change anonymous FTP access, its shared folder or its connection limit.

zh-CN.description: Mayzs FTP 服务器库会打开此设置页面，用于控制匿名访问、匿名用户可访问的文件夹和连接数上限。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法更改匿名 FTP 访问权限、共享文件夹或连接数上限。

en.description: Mayzs FTP Server opens this settings page to list and manage the FTP accounts used by connecting devices.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to view or manage FTP accounts from the app.

zh-CN.description: Mayzs FTP 服务器库会打开此设置页面，列出并管理连接设备使用的 FTP 账户。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在应用中查看或管理 FTP 账户。

en.description: Mayzs FTP Server declares this screen for edit-setting requests from Locale-compatible automation apps. It applies the server theme and serves as the integration's settings screen.
en.disableEffect: Locale-compatible automation apps will no longer be able to open this FTP setting editor.

zh-CN.description: Mayzs FTP 服务器库为兼容 Locale 的自动化应用声明了此设置编辑页面，并在打开时应用服务器主题。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 兼容 Locale 的自动化应用将无法再打开此 FTP 设置编辑页面。

en.description: Mayzs AndServer starts the app's embedded web server on port 8080 when this service is started. The server serves the app's bundled web pages and reports when it starts, stops or encounters an error.
en.disableEffect: The app's local web pages and the endpoints served by this web server will be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: Mayzs AndServer 会在此服务启动时开启应用内置的网页服务器，监听 8080 端口，并提供应用打包的网页内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用提供的本地网页和此服务器上的接口将无法使用。

en.description: MBridge (Mintegral) ad SDK opens this Activity for ad click destinations it handles inside the app. It loads the ad campaign web page and can hand app or store links to Android.
en.disableEffect: MBridge ad destinations that rely on this screen will no longer open inside the app; the SDK can fall back to the external browser.

zh-CN.description: MBridge（Mintegral）广告 SDK 会在应用内处理广告点击目标时打开此 Activity。它加载广告推广页面，也可以将应用链接或商店链接交由 Android 打开。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，依赖此组件的 MBridge 广告页面将无法在应用内打开；SDK 的部分点击流程会改用外部浏览器打开目标。

en.description: When Android reports an app installation, Mintegral uses this receiver to update the download state and record whether an advertised app was installed.
en.disableEffect: Mintegral ad-install completion handling and attribution will stop.

zh-CN.description: Android 报告应用安装完成时，Mintegral 会用此 Receiver 更新广告下载状态并记录推广应用的安装结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Mintegral 的广告安装完成处理与归因记录将停止。

en.description: Mintegral opens this full-screen page to show an interactive playable ad and handle its links and click events.
en.disableEffect: Interactive Mintegral ads will not open.

zh-CN.description: Mintegral 会打开此全屏界面展示可交互广告，并处理用户点击和广告链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Mintegral 可交互广告将无法打开。

en.description: Mintegral opens this screen to display full-screen interstitial ads and record ad impressions and clicks.
en.disableEffect: Mintegral interstitial ads will not display.

zh-CN.description: Mintegral 会打开此界面展示全屏插屏广告，并记录广告展示与点击。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Mintegral 插屏广告将无法显示。

en.description: Mintegral opens this screen to play rewarded video ads and handle their completion flow.
en.disableEffect: Rewarded video ads will not play, and rewards for watching ads will no longer be granted.

zh-CN.description: Mintegral 会打开此界面播放激励视频广告，并处理广告播放完成流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，激励视频广告将无法播放，观看广告获得的奖励也将不再发放。

en.description: When a player opens the xgvlsdk XiGuSdk account center's balance page, this screen loads and displays the game's stored-point and wallet balances.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it removes access to the SDK balance and point tabs, which can disrupt account and payment-related tasks.

zh-CN.description: 玩家从 xgvlsdk 的 XiGuSdk 账号中心打开余额页时，此页面会加载并显示游戏点数和钱包余额。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后将无法查看 SDK 余额和点数页面，可能影响账号及支付相关操作。

en.description: When a player chooses to bind or unbind an email in xgvlsdk's XiGuSdk account center, this screen sends and checks a verification code before updating the account.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it breaks the SDK's email-binding and email-unbinding flow.

zh-CN.description: 玩家在 xgvlsdk 的 XiGuSdk 账号中心选择绑定或解绑邮箱时，此页面会发送并校验验证码，然后更新账号信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，SDK 的邮箱绑定和解绑流程将无法完成。

en.description: When a player chooses to bind or unbind a phone in xgvlsdk's XiGuSdk account center, this screen sends and checks SMS codes and updates the account.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it breaks phone verification and account phone-binding changes.

zh-CN.description: 玩家在 xgvlsdk 的 XiGuSdk 账号中心选择绑定或解绑手机时，此页面会发送并校验短信验证码并更新账号。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，手机验证和账号手机号变更流程将无法完成。

en.description: After xgvlsdk's XiGuSdk real-name verification succeeds, this screen confirms that the identity check is complete.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents the verification flow from opening its completion screen and may interrupt that account-verification task.

zh-CN.description: xgvlsdk 的 XiGuSdk 实名认证成功后，此页面会告知用户认证已完成。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，认证流程无法打开完成页面，可能中断账号实名认证操作。

en.description: When a player starts real-name verification from xgvlsdk's XiGuSdk account center or account web page, this screen collects and submits the identity details.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from completing the SDK's real-name verification flow.

zh-CN.description: 玩家从 xgvlsdk 的 XiGuSdk 账号中心或账号网页启动实名认证时，此页面会收集并提交身份信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法完成 SDK 的实名认证流程。

en.description: During xgvlsdk's XiGuSdk account sign-in or registration, this page loads a web verification challenge and returns its result to the account flow.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it can prevent the SDK from completing account verification and signing in.

zh-CN.description: 在 xgvlsdk 的 XiGuSdk 账号登录或注册过程中，此页面会加载网页验证，并将验证结果返回账号流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，SDK 可能无法完成账号验证和登录。

en.description: When a player changes an xgvlsdk XiGuSdk account password from the account center, this screen validates the change and asks the user to sign in again after success.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it removes the password-change flow and can prevent account security updates.

zh-CN.description: 玩家从 xgvlsdk 的 XiGuSdk 账号中心修改密码时，此页面会处理密码变更，并在成功后要求重新登录。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后将无法修改账号密码，可能影响账号安全维护。

en.description: After xgvlsdk's XiGuSdk signs in to an account with linked game subaccounts, this screen lets the player choose or add the account to use.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it can block account selection or adding a subaccount during sign-in.

zh-CN.description: xgvlsdk 的 XiGuSdk 登录到含有多个游戏子账号的账号后，此页面可让玩家选择或添加要使用的子账号。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，登录时可能无法选择或添加子账号。

en.description: When a player opens the community-contact tab in xgvlsdk's XiGuSdk help area, this screen opens the SDK's QQ customer-support chat.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it removes this QQ support shortcut; the game's other screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: 玩家在 xgvlsdk 的 XiGuSdk 帮助区打开社区联系页时，此页面会进入 SDK 的 QQ 客服会话。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后将无法从此入口联系 QQ 客服，游戏的其他页面仍可使用。

en.description: After WeChat or QQ returns an authorization result to xgvlsdk's XiGuSdk, this transparent screen passes the result back to the account flow and closes.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it can break third-party sign-in callbacks and leave WeChat or QQ login unfinished.

zh-CN.description: 微信或 QQ 将授权结果返回 xgvlsdk 的 XiGuSdk 后，此透明页面会把结果交回账号流程并关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，第三方登录回调可能失效，导致微信或 QQ 登录无法完成。

en.description: When a player opens the coupon area in xgvlsdk's XiGuSdk or switches to the full coupon list, this screen displays available coupons for the account.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it removes coupon browsing and can interrupt coupon selection during checkout.

zh-CN.description: 玩家打开 xgvlsdk 的 XiGuSdk 代金券页面或切换到全部代金券列表时，此页面会显示账号可用的代金券。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后将无法浏览代金券，也可能中断结账时的优惠券选择。

en.description: During xgvlsdk's XiGuSdk checkout, this screen lists the player's coupons and returns the chosen coupon and discount to the payment screen.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it breaks coupon selection in the SDK payment flow.

zh-CN.description: xgvlsdk 的 XiGuSdk 结账时，此页面会列出玩家的代金券，并将选中的代金券和优惠金额返回支付页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，SDK 支付流程中的代金券选择将无法使用。

en.description: When a player opens the rebate entry in xgvlsdk's XiGuSdk account center, this screen loads the account's rebate information as a web page.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it removes access to the SDK rebate page and its discount information.

zh-CN.description: 玩家从 xgvlsdk 的 XiGuSdk 账号中心打开返利入口时，此页面会以网页形式加载账号返利信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后将无法打开 SDK 返利页面或查看其中的优惠信息。

en.description: When a player chooses forgot password from xgvlsdk's XiGuSdk sign-in screen, this page handles account recovery through verification.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from recovering an account through the SDK's password-reset flow.

zh-CN.description: 玩家在 xgvlsdk 的 XiGuSdk 登录页面选择忘记密码时，此页面会通过验证处理账号找回。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法通过 SDK 的密码重置流程找回账号。

en.description: When a player opens xgvlsdk's XiGuSdk functions menu, this screen provides shortcuts to account, gift, coupon, welfare, support, and purchase-history pages.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it removes the SDK shortcut menu and can hide access to account, coupon, and payment-related pages.

zh-CN.description: 玩家打开 xgvlsdk 的 XiGuSdk 功能菜单时，此页面会提供账号、礼包、代金券、福利、客服和账单页面入口。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，SDK 快捷菜单将无法打开，账号、代金券和支付相关页面可能失去入口。

en.description: When an app using xgvlsdk's XiGuSdk opens the recharge-history page, this screen loads and lists past top-ups for the signed-in game account.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it removes access to the account's recharge history.

zh-CN.description: 使用 xgvlsdk 的 XiGuSdk 的应用打开充值记录页时，此页面会加载并列出当前游戏账号的历史充值。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后将无法查看账号的历史充值记录。

en.description: When a player selects a package in xgvlsdk's XiGuSdk gift center, this screen loads its details, validity, instructions, and claim information.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents players from viewing or claiming the selected SDK gift package.

zh-CN.description: 玩家在 xgvlsdk 的 XiGuSdk 礼包中心选择礼包后，此页面会加载礼包详情、有效期、说明和领取信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，玩家将无法查看或领取所选 SDK 礼包。

en.description: When a player opens the common-questions tab in xgvlsdk's XiGuSdk help area, this screen lists answers and support contacts.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it removes this SDK FAQ list and its support links; other game screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: 玩家打开 xgvlsdk 的 XiGuSdk 帮助区常见问题页时，此页面会列出解答和客服联系方式。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后将无法使用此 SDK 常见问题列表及其客服入口，游戏的其他页面仍可使用。

en.description: When a player opens account management in xgvlsdk's XiGuSdk account center, this screen manages the linked game accounts.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it can prevent users from managing or switching linked game accounts.

zh-CN.description: 玩家在 xgvlsdk 的 XiGuSdk 账号中心打开账号管理时，此页面会管理已关联的游戏账号。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户可能无法管理或切换已关联的游戏账号。

en.description: After a player opens transaction history from xgvlsdk's XiGuSdk platform-credit payment screen, this page lists the account's credit records.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it removes transaction-history access for the SDK credit balance.

zh-CN.description: 玩家从 xgvlsdk 的 XiGuSdk 平台币支付页面打开交易记录后，此页面会列出账号的平台币记录。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后将无法查看 SDK 平台币余额的交易记录。

en.description: When a player opens the activities and messages entry in xgvlsdk's XiGuSdk menu, this screen fetches notices; selecting one opens its details.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it hides the SDK activity and message list, while the game's other screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: 玩家打开 xgvlsdk 的 XiGuSdk 菜单中的活动与消息入口时，此页面会获取通知，选择一条可查看详情。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后将无法查看 SDK 活动和消息列表，游戏的其他页面仍可使用。

en.description: When a player selects an item from xgvlsdk's XiGuSdk notice list, this screen loads the selected notice as a web page.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from opening notice details; the game's other screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: 玩家从 xgvlsdk 的 XiGuSdk 通知列表选择一条消息时，此页面会以网页形式加载该消息详情。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法打开通知详情，游戏的其他页面仍可使用。

en.description: When xgvlsdk's XiGuSdk presents a notice, this dialog displays its title and content and lets the player move between notices.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it hides these SDK popup notices; the game's other screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: xgvlsdk 的 XiGuSdk 展示通知时，此对话框会显示标题和内容，并允许玩家切换查看通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后将不再显示这些 SDK 弹窗通知，游戏的其他页面仍可使用。

en.description: When a player opens the gift center in xgvlsdk's XiGuSdk menu, this screen fetches regular and VIP gift packages; selecting one opens its details.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it removes the SDK gift center and prevents access to its package details.

zh-CN.description: 玩家从 xgvlsdk 的 XiGuSdk 菜单打开礼包中心时，此页面会获取普通和 VIP 礼包，选择礼包可进入详情。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后将无法打开 SDK 礼包中心或查看其中的礼包详情。

en.description: When the host game starts a purchase through xgvlsdk's XiGuSdk, this screen presents payment choices and returns the payment result to the game.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it breaks the SDK checkout flow and can prevent in-game purchases.

zh-CN.description: 宿主游戏通过 xgvlsdk 的 XiGuSdk 发起购买时，此页面会显示支付方式并将支付结果返回游戏。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，SDK 结账流程将无法使用，可能导致游戏内购买失败。

en.description: When a player chooses XiGuSdk platform-credit payment, this screen handles the purchase and can open web checkout or the credit transaction history.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it can break platform-credit purchases and their payment result flow.

zh-CN.description: 玩家选择 XiGuSdk 平台币支付时，此页面会处理购买，并可打开网页结账或平台币交易记录。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，平台币购买及其支付结果流程可能无法完成。

en.description: When a player opens game bills from xgvlsdk's XiGuSdk menu, this screen loads the account's purchase records.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it removes access to in-game purchase history and billing details.

zh-CN.description: 玩家从 xgvlsdk 的 XiGuSdk 菜单打开游戏账单时，此页面会加载账号的购买记录。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后将无法查看游戏内购买历史和账单详情。

en.description: When a player opens sharing from xgvlsdk's XiGuSdk account center, this screen lets them choose to share with a WeChat friend or to Moments.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it removes the SDK share chooser and can break the app's share flow.

zh-CN.description: 玩家从 xgvlsdk 的 XiGuSdk 账号中心打开分享时，此页面可选择分享给微信好友或朋友圈。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，SDK 分享选择页将无法使用，可能中断应用的分享流程。

en.description: When an app using xgvlsdk's XiGuSdk opens its social and help area, this screen presents tabs for common questions and community messages.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it removes the SDK FAQ and community area; gameplay and account screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: 使用 xgvlsdk 的 XiGuSdk 的应用打开社交与帮助区时，此页面会显示常见问题和社区留言两个标签页。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后将无法使用 SDK 常见问题和社区区域，游戏及账号页面仍可使用。

en.description: During xgvlsdk's XiGuSdk WeChat sign-in, this screen sends the authorization request to WeChat and returns control to the account flow.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it can break WeChat account sign-in.

zh-CN.description: xgvlsdk 的 XiGuSdk 进行微信登录时，此页面会向微信发送授权请求并将流程交回账号登录。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，微信账号登录可能无法完成。

en.description: When xgvlsdk's XiGuSdk opens account sign-in over the game, this transparent screen hosts the login and registration dialog.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it can prevent the SDK login dialog from opening or closing cleanly, breaking sign-in and registration.

zh-CN.description: xgvlsdk 的 XiGuSdk 在游戏画面上打开账号登录时，此透明页面会承载登录和注册对话框。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，SDK 登录对话框可能无法打开或正常关闭，导致登录和注册受阻。

en.description: When a signed-in player opens xgvlsdk's XiGuSdk account center, this screen shows account details and links to balance, password, phone, email, and identity settings.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it removes the SDK account center and can block account-management and security tasks.

zh-CN.description: 已登录玩家打开 xgvlsdk 的 XiGuSdk 账号中心时，此页面会显示账号信息，并提供余额、密码、手机、邮箱和身份设置入口。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后将无法打开 SDK 账号中心，可能阻断账号管理和安全设置。

en.description: When a guest player upgrades an xgvlsdk XiGuSdk account, this screen collects the details needed to bind the guest profile to a permanent account.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it can prevent guest-account upgrades and account binding.

zh-CN.description: 游客玩家升级 xgvlsdk 的 XiGuSdk 账号时，此页面会收集将游客资料绑定到正式账号所需的信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，游客账号可能无法升级或绑定到正式账号。

en.description: When xgvlsdk's XiGuSdk checkout uses a web payment page or a payment-provider redirect, this screen loads the page and opens payment links.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it can break web-based checkout and external payment handoffs.

zh-CN.description: xgvlsdk 的 XiGuSdk 结账需要网页支付或跳转支付渠道时，此页面会加载支付页面并打开支付链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，网页结账和外部支付跳转可能无法完成。

en.description: After a player chooses a WeChat destination in xgvlsdk's XiGuSdk share screen, this screen sends the configured webpage to a friend or Moments.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents the SDK from completing WeChat shares.

zh-CN.description: 玩家在 xgvlsdk 的 XiGuSdk 分享页选择微信分享目标后，此页面会将设定的网页发送给好友或朋友圈。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，SDK 将无法完成微信分享。

en.description: When xgvlsdk's XiGuSdk opens an account or service web page, this screen loads it and routes phone, email, or identity links to the matching account screen.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it can break SDK web pages and account-verification or binding flows.

zh-CN.description: xgvlsdk 的 XiGuSdk 打开账号或服务网页时，此页面会加载网页，并将手机、邮箱或身份验证链接转到相应账号页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，SDK 网页以及账号验证或绑定流程可能无法使用。

en.description: When a player opens xgvlsdk's XiGuSdk welfare page, this screen displays its check-in and ad-related welfare entries.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it removes the SDK welfare page and its listed reward entries.

zh-CN.description: 玩家打开 xgvlsdk 的 XiGuSdk 福利页时，此页面会显示签到和广告相关福利入口。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后将无法打开 SDK 福利页及其中列出的奖励入口。

en.description: When a player opens xgvlsdk's XiGuSdk customer-service center, this screen shows the available chat, QQ group, phone, and email contacts.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it removes the SDK customer-service contact page; gameplay and account screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: 玩家打开 xgvlsdk 的 XiGuSdk 客服中心时，此页面会显示在线客服、QQ群、电话和邮箱联系方式。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后将无法查看 SDK 客服联系方式，游戏和账号页面仍可使用。

en.description: When a player selects a help topic in xgvlsdk's XiGuSdk support area, this screen displays the selected answer.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents access to SDK help-topic details; gameplay and account screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: 玩家在 xgvlsdk 的 XiGuSdk 帮助区选择问题时，此页面会显示对应解答。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后将无法查看 SDK 帮助内容详情，游戏和账号页面仍可使用。

en.description: When WeChat returns to an app using xgvlsdk's XiGuSdk after sign-in or sharing, this callback screen reads the result and returns authorization data to the SDK.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it can break WeChat sign-in and sharing callbacks.

zh-CN.description: 微信在 xgvlsdk 的 XiGuSdk 登录或分享后返回应用时，此回调页面会读取结果并将授权信息交回 SDK。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，微信登录和分享的回调可能失效。

en.description: When xgvlsdk's XiGuSdk diagnostic controls request it, this service displays a movable log viewer with filtering and save controls.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it removes this optional diagnostic panel and log saving; ordinary game and account screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: xgvlsdk 的 XiGuSdk 诊断控制请求此服务时，它会显示可移动的日志查看面板，并提供筛选和保存功能。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后将无法使用此可选诊断面板和日志保存功能，游戏及账号页面仍可使用。

en.description: When xgvlsdk's XiGuSdk updater finds a newer SDK version, this dialog shows its version, download size, and change notes with update choices.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it can block the SDK update prompt and leave a required update flow unavailable.

zh-CN.description: xgvlsdk 的 XiGuSdk 更新器发现 SDK 有新版本时，此对话框会显示版本、下载大小、更新说明和更新选项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后可能无法显示 SDK 更新提示，导致必需的更新流程不可用。

en.description: When an app using xgvlsdk's XiGuSdk opens its VIP-level page, this screen shows the current and next membership levels and their benefits.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it removes the SDK VIP-level and benefits page.

zh-CN.description: 使用 xgvlsdk 的 XiGuSdk 的应用打开 VIP 等级页时，此页面会显示当前和下一等级及其权益。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后将无法查看 SDK 的 VIP 等级和权益页面。

en.description: When the app requests its current location, an address lookup, or ongoing tracking, Android Coordinate Tracker runs the request and returns the result to the app.
en.disableEffect: The app loses the location lookups and tracking provided by this library.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求当前位置、地址查询或持续跟踪时，Android Coordinate Tracker 会执行请求并将结果返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将失去此库提供的位置查询和跟踪功能。

en.description: The Tracking System (Esmartwave) analytics SDK starts this private provider automatically with the app. It creates the SDK's local analytics database and registers the private address used for its stored user identifier.
en.disableEffect: The SDK's local tracking store and user-identifier persistence stop working, while the host app's main features remain available.

zh-CN.description: Tracking System（Esmartwave）分析 SDK 会在应用启动时自动启用此私有 Provider。它会创建 SDK 的本地分析数据库，并注册用于保存用户标识的私有地址。
zh-CN.disableEffect: SDK 的本地跟踪数据存储和用户标识持久化将停止工作，但宿主应用的主要功能仍可使用。

en.description: osarms AutoSize initializes the app's screen-size adaptation at startup so layouts use the app's chosen design size.
en.disableEffect: Screens that rely on AutoSize may have incorrect sizing or spacing.

zh-CN.description: osarms AutoSize 会在应用启动时初始化屏幕尺寸适配，帮助应用按设定的布局尺寸显示界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖 AutoSize 的页面可能出现尺寸或间距不正确。

en.description: When a user opens the MechDome About screen, this Activity displays MechDome information, an ad, and controls to buy or restore the ad-free option.
en.disableEffect: The MechDome About screen, its ad-free purchase, and its purchase-restore controls cannot be opened.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 MechDome 关于页面时，此 Activity 会显示 MechDome 信息、广告，以及购买或恢复免广告选项的控件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: MechDome 关于页面、免广告购买入口和购买恢复控件都无法打开。

en.description: When a user opens the MechDome donation screen, this Activity shows donation choices and the button that starts the selected donation purchase.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open the MechDome donation page or start a donation purchase.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 MechDome 捐赠页面时，此 Activity 会显示捐赠选项和用于发起所选捐赠购买的按钮。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法打开 MechDome 捐赠页面或发起捐赠购买。

en.description: When the Medallia Digital SDK opens a full-screen feedback survey, this Activity hosts the form and its back controls.
en.disableEffect: The full-screen survey cannot be shown or submitted, so the app’s Medallia feedback flow may fail.

zh-CN.description: Medallia Digital SDK 打开全屏反馈问卷时，此 Activity 会承载表单和返回控件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 全屏问卷无法显示或提交，因此应用中的 Medallia 反馈流程可能失败。

en.description: When the Medallia Digital SDK opens a survey configured as modal, this Activity hosts the form in a compact layout with a close control.
en.disableEffect: The modal survey cannot be shown or submitted, so the app’s Medallia feedback flow may fail.

zh-CN.description: Medallia Digital SDK 打开配置为模态形式的问卷时，此 Activity 会以紧凑布局承载表单和关闭控件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 模态问卷无法显示或提交，因此应用中的 Medallia 反馈流程可能失败。

en.description: photo_select_lib (Roofroot) registers a file-sharing provider for the photo-selection flow, exposing configured image files as content links when the app requests them.
en.disableEffect: Photo capture, editing, or sharing steps that need image links from this provider can fail.

zh-CN.description: photo_select_lib（Roofroot）为选图流程注册文件共享服务，在应用请求时将配置范围内的图片文件提供为内容链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要通过此服务获取图片链接的拍摄、编辑或分享步骤可能会失败。

en.description: Pardeep MG MediaPicker opens this Activity when an app requests media selection; users can browse photos and videos or use its camera-only photo and video options.
en.disableEffect: The app loses this media-selection and camera-capture flow.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求选择媒体时，Pardeep MG MediaPicker 会打开此 Activity；用户可浏览照片和视频，也可使用仅拍照或仅录像的选项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法使用此媒体选择和相机拍摄流程。

en.description: Face++ FaceEE opens this page when a user chooses the agreement link during face verification. It displays the supplied agreement page inside the app and provides refresh and back controls.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot review the FaceEE agreement from the face-verification flow.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Face++ FaceEE 人脸验证中打开协议链接时，会看到此页面。它在应用内显示对应协议，并提供刷新和返回操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，用户无法在人脸验证流程中查看 FaceEE 协议。

en.description: Face++ FaceEE shows the user's enrolled sign-in methods and available face, device-biometric, and one-time-code enrollment options. Users can change their default method here.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot manage the FaceEE sign-in methods used by the app's authentication flow.

zh-CN.description: Face++ FaceEE 会在此显示用户已启用的登录方式，以及可用的人脸、设备生物识别和一次性验证码设置选项。用户也可以在这里更改默认方式。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，用户无法管理应用登录流程所用的 FaceEE 验证方式。

en.description: Face++ FaceEE uses this screen to report when the device cannot use its quick device-authentication sign-in option. Closing it returns an unsupported result to the calling flow.
en.disableEffect: The FaceEE flow cannot show its unsupported-device message or return the expected result.

zh-CN.description: 设备无法使用 Face++ FaceEE 的快捷设备验证登录方式时，会显示此提示页。关闭页面后，流程会收到“不支持”的结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，FaceEE 流程无法显示设备不支持的提示，也无法返回预期结果。

en.description: After the user verifies their account, Face++ FaceEE offers to enroll the phone's biometric or device credential for quicker future sign-in. It reports whether setup succeeds or fails.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot enroll or activate this FaceEE quick sign-in option on the device.

zh-CN.description: 用户完成账户验证后，Face++ FaceEE 会提示将手机的生物识别或设备凭据用于快捷登录，并显示设置成功或失败的结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，用户无法在设备上启用 FaceEE 快捷登录方式。

en.description: When Face++ FaceEE receives a sign-in or registration response, this screen processes it and moves the user to available credential setup or a success or failure page.
en.disableEffect: The FaceEE sign-in or registration flow may stop before it returns to the app.

zh-CN.description: Face++ FaceEE 收到登录或注册结果后，会在此处理并把用户带到可用的凭据设置页面，或显示成功、失败结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，FaceEE 登录或注册流程可能无法完成并返回应用。

en.description: Face++ FaceEE displays a time-limited offline sign-in code generated from a key retrieved earlier, together with the linked device name and expiry time.
en.disableEffect: Users who sign in with FaceEE offline codes lose access to this code screen.

zh-CN.description: Face++ FaceEE 会在此显示使用先前取得的密钥生成的限时离线登录码，并显示关联设备名称和有效时间。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，使用 FaceEE 离线验证码登录的用户将无法打开此页面。

en.description: Face++ FaceEE requests a one-time sign-in code, shows its countdown, and lets users request an offline code for their enrolled device.
en.disableEffect: FaceEE one-time-code sign-in and access to the offline-code flow are unavailable.

zh-CN.description: Face++ FaceEE 会在此申请并显示一次性登录码及其倒计时，也允许用户为已登记的设备申请离线验证码。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，FaceEE 一次性验证码登录及离线验证码流程都无法使用。
