en.description: During Face++ FaceEE sign-in or credential activation, this screen presents the available face, device-biometric, and one-time-code checks and continues the selected verification.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot finish the FaceEE verification or credential activation that opens this screen.

zh-CN.description: 在 Face++ FaceEE 登录或凭据启用流程中，此页面会显示可用的人脸、设备生物识别和一次性验证码验证方式，并继续所选流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，应用无法完成打开此页面的 FaceEE 验证或凭据启用流程。

en.description: When Face++ FaceEE asks a user to verify or enroll sign-in credentials, this screen starts face verification or device-authentication setup and can open the related agreement page.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot complete the FaceEE verification and credential-setup choices offered here.

zh-CN.description: Face++ FaceEE 要求用户验证身份或登记登录凭据时，此页面会启动人脸验证或设备验证设置，也可打开相关协议。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，用户无法完成此处提供的 FaceEE 身份验证和凭据设置。

en.description: After Face++ FaceEE registration, this screen shows the available face and device-authentication options, the current one-time-code status, and a way to skip setup.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot continue FaceEE registration through credential setup or skip this step.

zh-CN.description: Face++ FaceEE 注册后，此页面会显示可用的人脸和设备验证选项、当前一次性验证码状态，以及跳过设置的入口。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，用户无法继续 FaceEE 凭据设置，也无法从此步骤跳过。

en.description: Face++ FaceEE shows this screen after a failed sign-in or verification. It displays the error and offers the relevant retry, return, or credential-management action.
en.disableEffect: Users lose the explanation and recovery actions for a failed FaceEE flow.

zh-CN.description: Face++ FaceEE 登录或验证失败后会显示此页面，说明错误并提供相应的重试、返回或凭据管理操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，用户无法查看 FaceEE 流程失败原因或使用相应的恢复操作。

en.description: Face++ FaceEE shows this screen after sign-in, registration, or credential setup succeeds, then sends the user to any remaining setup or back to the app.
en.disableEffect: A successful FaceEE flow cannot show its completion or continue to the next setup step.

zh-CN.description: Face++ FaceEE 登录、注册或凭据设置成功后会显示此页面，并带用户继续完成剩余设置或返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，FaceEE 流程无法显示完成结果或继续下一步设置。

en.description: Face++ FaceEE displays progress while checking a registration or credential-verification result. It then returns the result to the calling screen or opens the appropriate success or failure page.
en.disableEffect: FaceEE cannot finish or return the registration-verification result.

zh-CN.description: Face++ FaceEE 会在此显示注册或凭据验证结果的处理进度，完成后把结果返回上一页面，或打开相应的成功、失败页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，FaceEE 无法完成或返回注册验证结果。

en.description: Face++ FaceEE displays progress while checking a sign-in verification result, then returns the result or opens a success or failure page.
en.disableEffect: FaceEE cannot finish the sign-in verification that uses this screen.

zh-CN.description: Face++ FaceEE 会在此显示登录验证的处理进度，完成后返回结果或打开成功、失败页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，使用此页面的 FaceEE 登录验证无法完成。

en.description: During Face++ FaceEE QR sign-in, this Activity uses the camera or a selected image to read a code, checks it with FaceEE, and opens the next verification screen.
en.disableEffect: FaceEE QR-code sign-in cannot scan the code or continue to verification.

zh-CN.description: Face++ FaceEE 使用二维码登录时，此 Activity 会通过相机或用户选择的图片读取二维码，交由 FaceEE 核验后打开下一步验证页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，FaceEE 二维码登录无法扫描二维码或继续验证。

en.description: Megvii's v5 liveness screen opens the camera and asks the user to follow prompted face actions so the app can check that a real person is present.
en.disableEffect: Face-based identity verification may fail because this action check cannot be completed.

zh-CN.description: Megvii v5 活体检测页面会打开相机，并提示用户完成指定面部动作，以便应用确认镜头前是真人。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，依赖此动作检测的人脸身份验证可能无法完成。

en.description: Megvii's v5 liveness screen opens the camera and uses changing light or color cues while it checks the user's face.
en.disableEffect: Face-based identity verification that uses this light-assisted check cannot be completed.

zh-CN.description: Megvii v5 活体检测页面会打开相机，并在人脸检测时使用变化的光线或颜色提示。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，依赖此光线辅助检测的人脸身份验证无法完成。

en.description: Before a Megvii face-liveness check, this screen displays guidance and requires agreement to the liveness terms before opening the selected camera check.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot review the guidance or start the corresponding face-liveness check through this path.

zh-CN.description: 开始 Megvii 人脸活体检测前，此页面会展示操作说明，并要求用户同意相关条款后再打开所选相机检测。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，用户无法通过此流程查看说明或启动对应的人脸活体检测。

en.description: During Megvii face verification, this Activity opens the applicable liveness agreement in a web page; the user can read it and close the page to return.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open the liveness agreement from this verification flow.

zh-CN.description: Megvii 人脸验证流程会通过此 Activity 在网页中打开适用的活体检测协议，用户阅读后可关闭页面返回。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，用户无法从此验证流程打开活体检测协议。

en.description: When Megvii's face-verification flow selects an action challenge, this screen uses the camera to guide and check the user's face movements.
en.disableEffect: The Megvii action-based face check will fail to open, so verification using this challenge may not complete.

zh-CN.description: Megvii 人脸验证流程选择动作挑战时，此界面会使用相机引导并检查用户的人脸动作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Megvii 的动作人脸检查将无法打开，使用此挑战的验证可能无法完成。

en.description: When the user opens the agreement from Megvii's liveness guide, this screen displays the face-check terms in a web page.
en.disableEffect: Users may be unable to review the terms required by the Megvii face-verification flow.

zh-CN.description: 用户从 Megvii 活体检测说明中打开协议时，此界面会通过网页显示人脸检查条款。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户可能无法查看 Megvii 人脸验证流程所需的条款。

en.description: When Megvii selects its colorful-light liveness challenge, this screen uses the camera and changing light patterns to check that a face is live.
en.disableEffect: The colorful-light face check will not run, so verification flows that select it may fail.

zh-CN.description: Megvii 选择彩光活体挑战时，此界面会结合相机和变化的光线图案检查人脸是否为真人。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 彩光人脸检查将无法运行，选择该检查的验证流程可能失败。

en.description: When Megvii starts its FMP face-liveness check, this screen guides the user through camera-based detection and returns the check result.
en.disableEffect: The FMP face-verification step will not open, so a flow that relies on it may not complete.

zh-CN.description: Megvii 启动 FMP 人脸活体检查时，此界面会引导用户完成相机检测并返回检查结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: FMP 人脸验证步骤将无法打开，依赖该步骤的流程可能无法完成。

en.description: Before Megvii face detection, this screen presents the liveness instructions and agreement option, then starts the selected camera check when the user continues.
en.disableEffect: Users may be unable to accept the face-check terms or enter Megvii's liveness verification.

zh-CN.description: Megvii 人脸检测开始前，此界面会显示活体检查说明和协议选项，并在用户继续后启动相机检查。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户可能无法接受人脸检查条款或进入 Megvii 活体验证。

en.description: Moon permission (nov-moon) opens this internal screen when its SDK requests runtime permissions. It can explain a denial and take the user to app settings after a permanent denial.
en.disableEffect: Moon permission requests and recovery after denial will stop working; app features that need those permissions may fail.

zh-CN.description: Moon permission（nov-moon）会在 SDK 申请运行时权限时打开此内部页面，可说明拒绝原因，并在永久拒绝后引导用户前往应用设置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Moon permission 的权限申请和拒绝后的恢复流程将无法工作，依赖这些权限的应用功能可能失效。

en.description: At app startup, the Meiqia customer-service SDK tracks which app screen is currently visible so it can show Meiqia in-app notification messages there.
en.disableEffect: Meiqia may no longer know which screen is active, so its in-app notification messages may not appear.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，Meiqia 客服 SDK 会记录当前显示的应用页面，以便在该页面上展示 Meiqia 应用内通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Meiqia 可能无法获知当前页面，因此应用内通知可能不会显示。

en.description: When a Meiqia support conversation opens, the SDK starts this Service to keep a live connection with the support team and synchronize incoming messages and read status.
en.disableEffect: Live support replies may stop arriving while a chat is open, and message status may not synchronize.

zh-CN.description: Meiqia 客服会话打开时，SDK 会启动此 Service，与客服保持实时连接并同步收到的消息和已读状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 聊天打开期间，客服实时回复可能无法送达，消息状态也可能无法同步。

en.description: When Meiqia requires visitor details before starting support, this Activity shows the configured intake fields and submits them before returning the user to chat.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot complete the configured pre-chat contact form, so that support entry path may be blocked.

zh-CN.description: Meiqia 在开始客服会话前需要访客资料时，此 Activity 会显示配置好的信息表单，并在提交后带用户返回聊天。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法填写配置好的聊天前联系表单，因此这条客服入口可能无法继续。

en.description: When an app opens Meiqia customer support, this Activity loads the conversation and lets users exchange messages with a support agent. It also routes users to configured intake or offline-message forms when needed.
en.disableEffect: The Meiqia support chat cannot open, so users cannot contact support through that app flow.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开 Meiqia 客服时，此 Activity 会载入会话，让用户与客服人员交换消息；需要时也会转到已配置的信息表单或离线留言表单。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Meiqia 客服聊天无法打开，用户也就无法通过该应用流程联系支持人员。

en.description: When Meiqia has a pre-chat inquiry menu, this Activity shows the configured choices for routing a visitor to a support team or agent. A choice can lead to a contact form or directly into the conversation.
en.disableEffect: The Meiqia routing menu cannot open, so users may not reach the support team selected by the app.

zh-CN.description: Meiqia 配置了聊天前咨询菜单时，此 Activity 会显示将访客转接到客服团队或客服人员的选项；用户选择后可能进入联系表单或直接开始会话。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Meiqia 分流菜单无法打开，用户可能无法联系应用所选的客服团队。

en.description: When live support is unavailable or a user chooses to leave a message, this Meiqia Activity collects the message and requested contact details and submits a support ticket.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot submit an offline support request through Meiqia.

zh-CN.description: 实时客服不可用或用户选择留言时，此 Meiqia Activity 会收集留言和所需的联系资料，并提交客服工单。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法通过 Meiqia 提交离线客服请求。

en.description: When a user chooses to attach pictures in a Meiqia chat, this Activity browses device photos for selection and can handle camera capture when the chat enables it.
en.disableEffect: The Meiqia photo-attachment picker and any camera-capture flow provided by the chat will not open.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择在 Meiqia 聊天中添加图片时，此 Activity 会浏览设备照片供其选择；聊天启用拍照功能时也可处理新拍的照片。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Meiqia 图片选择器以及聊天提供的拍照流程都无法打开。

en.description: After a user selects pictures for a Meiqia chat, this Activity shows them for review and returns the final selection to the conversation.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot review or confirm selected pictures before sending them in Meiqia chat.

zh-CN.description: 用户为 Meiqia 聊天选好图片后，此 Activity 会显示图片供其预览，并将最终选择交回会话。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法在 Meiqia 聊天发送图片前预览或确认所选内容。

en.description: When a user taps a picture in a Meiqia conversation or form, this Activity displays it larger and can save it to the device when saving is enabled.
en.disableEffect: Pictures shared in Meiqia chat or forms cannot be opened in the full-screen viewer or saved from it.

zh-CN.description: 用户点开 Meiqia 会话或表单中的图片时，此 Activity 会放大显示；启用保存功能时也可将图片存到设备。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Meiqia 聊天或表单中的图片无法在全屏查看器中打开，也无法从中保存。

en.description: When launched with Meiqia rich-message content, this Activity displays the supplied formatted text and can collect a helpful or not-helpful rating for robot answers.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot read that content in Meiqia’s built-in web screen or send the robot-answer rating from it.

zh-CN.description: 此 Activity 收到 Meiqia 富消息内容后，会显示格式化内容，并可收集用户对机器人回答有用或无用的评价。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法在 Meiqia 内置页面阅读该内容，也无法在此提交机器人回答评价。

en.description: When Meiqia shares or captures images for a support chat, this Provider grants Android apps temporary access to those chat files.
en.disableEffect: Meiqia photo capture, sharing, or opening of attached files may fail because Android cannot obtain the required file access.

zh-CN.description: Meiqia 为客服聊天分享或拍摄图片时，此 Provider 会让 Android 应用临时访问这些聊天文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Android 无法取得所需文件权限，因此 Meiqia 拍照、分享图片或打开附件可能失败。

en.description: The Meizu Flyme push receiver used by EngageLab and Tencent TPNS is registered for system push broadcasts. In the versions reviewed, its message handler is empty.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it removes this Meizu push receiver, but the reviewed handler performs no message processing.

zh-CN.description: EngageLab 和 Tencent TPNS 使用的 Meizu Flyme 推送接收器会接收系统推送广播；在检查的版本中，它的消息处理逻辑为空。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后会移除此 Meizu 推送接收器，但检查的版本中该接收器本身不处理消息。

en.description: Meizu Flyme Push SDK uses this background service to handle message, registration, and unregistration commands, then forwards them to the app's configured push receiver.
en.disableEffect: Meizu push messages and registration callbacks will no longer be forwarded to the app.

zh-CN.description: 魅族 Flyme 推送 SDK 使用此后台服务处理消息、注册和注销指令，再将回调交给应用配置的推送接收器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，魅族推送消息和注册回调将无法转交给应用。

en.description: When Meizu Push broadcasts that its system service has started, this receiver starts the matching Meizu push service and its registration flow.
en.disableEffect: The Meizu push channel may no longer register or receive messages.

zh-CN.description: 魅族推送系统服务启动时，此接收器会启动对应的魅族推送服务并执行注册流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 魅族推送通道可能无法完成注册或接收消息。

en.description: Main screen of Meizu Themes (Customize Center). This is not an ad component.
en.disableEffect: The app icon disappears from the launcher.

zh-CN.description: 魅族主题美化（个性化中心）的主界面，不是广告组件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 桌面上的应用图标会消失。

en.description: Splash screen advertisement shown when the app starts.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时展示的开屏广告。

en.description: Linkester is a library for testing app deep links. This screen lists automatically found and manually configured links and lets a user try one.
en.disableEffect: Linkester’s test screen and its manual link checks disappear; other app screens that handle links are not launched by this component.

zh-CN.description: Linkester 是用于测试应用深层链接的库。此界面会列出自动发现和手动配置的链接，并允许用户试开链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Linkester 测试界面及手动链接测试将无法使用；此组件不会启动应用中其他处理链接的界面。

en.description: The Red Screen of Death library opens this screen after an uncaught app exception. It shows the thread, exception, and stack trace, with an option to share the crash details.
en.disableEffect: After a crash, the custom crash screen and its share option will no longer appear.

zh-CN.description: Red Screen of Death 库会在应用出现未捕获异常后打开此界面，显示线程、异常和堆栈信息，并提供分享崩溃详情的选项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用崩溃后，将不再显示自定义崩溃界面及其分享选项。

en.description: At app startup, the Memfault Bort reporting SDK gives its metrics service the app context needed to report metrics and events.
en.disableEffect: Memfault Bort metric and event reporting will not be initialized.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，Memfault Bort 报告 SDK 会向指标服务提供上报指标和事件所需的应用上下文。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Memfault Bort 的指标和事件上报将不会初始化。

en.description: Mercado Pago Android SDK opens this Activity from checkout when the buyer chooses to view bank deals. It lists available offers and opens the selected deal’s terms.
en.disableEffect: Bank offers and their terms will be unavailable; a checkout path that opens this screen cannot complete that step.

zh-CN.description: Mercado Pago Android SDK 会在结账时用户选择查看银行优惠后打开此 Activity。它会列出可用优惠，并显示所选优惠的条款。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法查看银行优惠及其条款；如果结账流程打开此界面，该步骤将无法继续。

en.description: Mercado Pago Android SDK opens this Activity when a card payment needs approval from the card issuer. It asks the buyer to contact the issuer and return after authorizing the payment.
en.disableEffect: The issuer-approval step will be unavailable, so the affected card payment cannot be completed through this recovery path.

zh-CN.description: 当银行卡付款需要发卡机构授权时，Mercado Pago Android SDK 会打开此 Activity。它会提示用户联系发卡机构，并在授权后返回。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 发卡机构授权步骤将无法使用，因此这笔银行卡付款无法通过此恢复流程完成。

en.description: Mercado Pago Android SDK uses this Activity to continue a card payment. It routes buyers to enter card details or provide a saved or recovered card’s security code, issuer, or installment choice as needed.
en.disableEffect: The card-payment flow cannot collect the required details or return its payment data, so card payments through this SDK flow may fail.

zh-CN.description: Mercado Pago Android SDK 会使用此 Activity 继续银行卡付款。它会根据需要引导用户填写卡片信息，或为已保存、恢复的卡片输入安全码并选择发卡机构或分期方案。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 银行卡付款流程将无法收集所需信息或返回付款数据，因此通过此 SDK 流程进行的银行卡付款可能无法完成。

en.description: Mercado Pago Android SDK opens this Activity to run a checkout from a payment preference supplied by the app. It retrieves or validates the preference, gathers payment information, and creates the payment.
en.disableEffect: The integrated checkout cannot run or return its payment result to the app.

zh-CN.description: 应用提供付款偏好后，Mercado Pago Android SDK 会打开此 Activity 执行结账。它会获取或校验付款偏好、收集付款信息并创建付款。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 集成的结账流程将无法运行，也无法向应用返回付款结果。

en.description: Mercado Pago Android SDK opens this Activity after a payment is approved. It shows the success summary, payment details, receipt number when available, and any configured review items.
en.disableEffect: The buyer will lose the SDK’s payment-success and receipt screen, including any review action shown there.

zh-CN.description: 付款获批后，Mercado Pago Android SDK 会打开此 Activity。它会显示付款成功摘要、付款详情、可用的收据编号以及配置的检查项目。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将看不到 SDK 的付款成功和收据页面，也无法使用该页面中的检查操作。

en.description: Mercado Pago Android SDK opens this Activity when checkout needs the buyer to choose one of their saved cards. It loads the customer’s cards and returns the selected card to the payment flow.
en.disableEffect: The buyer cannot choose a saved card in this flow, which can prevent checkout from continuing with that card.

zh-CN.description: 结账需要用户选择已保存的银行卡时，Mercado Pago Android SDK 会打开此 Activity。它会加载用户的银行卡，并将所选卡片返回给付款流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法在此流程中选择已保存的银行卡，结账可能因此无法使用该卡继续。

en.description: Mercado Pago Android SDK opens this Activity when checkout offers the buyer a discount-code option. It lets the buyer enter and validate a code and view the resulting discount.
en.disableEffect: The buyer cannot enter or apply a discount code through this checkout flow.

zh-CN.description: 结账提供优惠码选项时，Mercado Pago Android SDK 会打开此 Activity。用户可以输入并验证优惠码，查看应用后的折扣。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法通过此结账流程输入或使用优惠码。

en.description: Mercado Pago Android SDK opens this Activity when checkout needs to show an error to the buyer. It displays the error message and provides a retry option when the error is recoverable.
en.disableEffect: Checkout errors cannot be shown or retried through the SDK’s error screen, interrupting those recovery paths.

zh-CN.description: 结账需要向用户显示错误时，Mercado Pago Android SDK 会打开此 Activity。它会显示错误信息，并在错误可恢复时提供重试选项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: SDK 将无法通过错误页面显示结账错误或进行重试，这些错误恢复流程会中断。

en.description: Mercado Pago Android SDK opens this Activity for new-card checkout. It collects the card number, holder, expiration date, security code, and requested identity details, then advances with the matching payment options.
en.disableEffect: The buyer cannot enter a new card or continue that card-payment flow.

zh-CN.description: 使用新银行卡结账时，Mercado Pago Android SDK 会打开此 Activity。它会收集卡号、持卡人、有效期、安全码及所需身份信息，然后继续显示适用的付款选项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法录入新银行卡，也无法继续此银行卡付款流程。

en.description: Mercado Pago Android SDK opens this Activity when a card payment needs an installment plan. It loads the available plans and lets the buyer choose one for the purchase.
en.disableEffect: The buyer cannot choose the required installment plan, so the affected card payment may not continue.

zh-CN.description: 银行卡付款需要选择分期方案时，Mercado Pago Android SDK 会打开此 Activity。它会加载可用方案，并让用户为这笔交易选择分期方式。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法选择所需的分期方案，因此相关银行卡付款可能无法继续。

en.description: Mercado Pago Android SDK opens this Activity when a payment requires follow-up instructions. It fetches the instructions and displays payment references and any available action link.
en.disableEffect: The buyer may not receive the instructions or reference details needed to complete that payment.

zh-CN.description: 付款需要后续操作说明时，Mercado Pago Android SDK 会打开此 Activity。它会获取并显示付款说明、参考信息以及可用的操作链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户可能无法获得完成该笔付款所需的说明或参考信息。

en.description: Mercado Pago Android SDK opens this Activity when the buyer must identify which bank issued their card. It loads the available issuers and returns the selected one to checkout.
en.disableEffect: The buyer cannot select the card issuer when checkout requires that choice, which can stop the card payment.

zh-CN.description: 结账需要确认银行卡的发卡机构时，Mercado Pago Android SDK 会打开此 Activity。它会加载可选机构，并将用户的选择返回给结账流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 结账要求选择发卡机构时，用户将无法完成选择，银行卡付款可能因此中断。

en.description: Mercado Pago Android SDK opens this Activity when the buyer adds a new card. It collects and validates the card number, holder, expiration date, security code, and any required identity details.
en.disableEffect: The buyer cannot add a new card through this SDK flow.

zh-CN.description: 用户添加新银行卡时，Mercado Pago Android SDK 会打开此 Activity。它会收集并校验卡号、持卡人、有效期、安全码以及所需身份信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法通过此 SDK 流程添加新银行卡。

en.description: Mercado Pago Android SDK opens this Activity to show payment methods available for the current checkout. The buyer can choose a method and, when enabled, open the bank-deals screen.
en.disableEffect: The buyer cannot select a payment method through this checkout screen.

zh-CN.description: Mercado Pago Android SDK 会打开此 Activity，显示当前结账可用的付款方式。用户可以选择付款方式；如果启用了银行优惠，也可以打开优惠页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法通过此结账页面选择付款方式。

en.description: Mercado Pago Android SDK opens this Activity after checkout receives a payment result. It routes approved, pending, rejected, issuer-approval, and waiting-for-payment results to the appropriate next screen.
en.disableEffect: The SDK cannot route the payment result to its confirmation, pending, rejection, or instruction screen.

zh-CN.description: 结账收到付款结果后，Mercado Pago Android SDK 会打开此 Activity。它会根据结果状态进入成功、处理中、拒绝、发卡机构授权或付款说明页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: SDK 将无法根据付款结果进入确认、处理中、拒绝或付款说明页面。

en.description: Mercado Pago Android SDK opens this Activity when checkout needs the buyer to choose among payment types available for the entered card. It displays the compatible options and returns the selected type.
en.disableEffect: The buyer cannot choose a compatible payment type, so that card-payment path cannot continue.

zh-CN.description: 结账需要用户为已录入的银行卡选择付款类型时，Mercado Pago Android SDK 会打开此 Activity。它会显示兼容选项，并返回用户的选择。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法选择兼容的付款类型，因此该银行卡付款流程无法继续。

en.description: Mercado Pago Android SDK opens this Activity to let the buyer search and choose among available payment options, including saved cards. Selecting a card continues into the card-payment steps, and the chosen payment data is returned to checkout.
en.disableEffect: The buyer cannot choose a payment option through this checkout flow, so payment may not continue.

zh-CN.description: Mercado Pago Android SDK 会打开此 Activity，让用户搜索并选择可用付款方式，包括已保存的银行卡。选择银行卡后会继续进入银行卡付款步骤，所选付款信息会返回结账流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法通过此结账流程选择付款方式，付款可能无法继续。

en.description: Mercado Pago Android SDK opens this Activity when a payment is still pending or being processed. It shows the current status, configured follow-up items, and an option to choose another payment method when available.
en.disableEffect: The buyer loses the pending-payment status and any follow-up or alternate-method actions provided by this screen.

zh-CN.description: 付款仍在等待处理或处理中时，Mercado Pago Android SDK 会打开此 Activity。它会显示当前状态、配置的后续检查项目，并在可用时提供更换付款方式的选项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法看到待处理状态，也无法使用此页面提供的后续操作或更换付款方式。

en.description: Mercado Pago Android SDK opens this Activity after a payment is rejected. It explains the rejection using the payment result and may offer a suitable next step, such as trying another payment method.
en.disableEffect: The buyer loses the SDK’s rejection explanation and any retry or alternate-payment action shown there.

zh-CN.description: 付款被拒绝后，Mercado Pago Android SDK 会打开此 Activity。它会根据付款结果说明拒绝原因，并可能提供合适的后续操作，例如尝试其他付款方式。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将看不到 SDK 的拒绝说明，也无法使用页面提供的重试或更换付款方式操作。

en.description: Mercado Pago Android SDK opens this Activity before payment submission when the checkout is configured to review the order. It shows the items, amount, discount, and selected payment details, and can display the terms and conditions.
en.disableEffect: The buyer cannot review or confirm the configured order before payment, so that checkout flow cannot complete as designed.

zh-CN.description: 结账配置为付款前检查订单时，Mercado Pago Android SDK 会打开此 Activity。它会显示商品、金额、折扣和所选付款信息，并可展示条款。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法在付款前检查或确认已配置的订单，因此该结账流程无法按预期完成。

en.description: Mercado Pago Android SDK opens this Activity when a card payment requires the card’s security code. It lets the buyer enter the code and returns it to checkout.
en.disableEffect: The buyer cannot provide the required card security code, so the affected card payment cannot continue.

zh-CN.description: 银行卡付款需要安全码时，Mercado Pago Android SDK 会打开此 Activity。用户可以输入安全码，随后该信息会返回结账流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法提供所需的银行卡安全码，因此相关银行卡付款无法继续。

en.description: Mercado Pago Android SDK opens this Activity when the buyer asks to read Mercado Pago terms or the terms for a bank deal. It displays the relevant text or loads the applicable terms page.
en.disableEffect: The buyer cannot read the terms linked from checkout or a bank offer.

zh-CN.description: 用户查看 Mercado Pago 条款或银行优惠条款时，Mercado Pago Android SDK 会打开此 Activity。它会显示相关文本或加载适用的条款页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法阅读从结账页面或银行优惠中打开的条款。

en.description: Mercado Pago Android SDK opens this Activity for its payment-method and saved-card flow. It loads saved cards or payment choices, collects a security code or installment selection when needed, and returns the selected payment details.
en.disableEffect: The buyer cannot choose or use a saved or new payment method through this SDK flow.

zh-CN.description: Mercado Pago Android SDK 会打开此 Activity 执行付款方式和已保存银行卡流程。它会加载已保存的银行卡或付款选项，并在需要时收集安全码或分期选择，最后返回所选付款信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法通过此 SDK 流程选择或使用已保存或新添加的付款方式。

en.description: Mercado Pago Connect Android SDK opens this Activity when the user authorizes an app to connect with Mercado Pago. It shows Mercado Pago’s authorization page and returns the resulting credentials to the app.
en.disableEffect: The user cannot authorize or finish connecting the app to Mercado Pago.

zh-CN.description: 用户授权应用连接 Mercado Pago 时，Mercado Pago Connect Android SDK 会打开此 Activity。它会显示 Mercado Pago 的授权页面，并将生成的凭据返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法授权或完成应用与 Mercado Pago 的连接。

en.description: Mercury (Bayescom) uses this Activity to ask whether to continue an app download offered by an ad when the download flow needs confirmation.
en.disableEffect: An ad-offer app download that requires confirmation cannot continue.

zh-CN.description: Mercury（Bayescom）会在广告应用下载流程需要确认时，通过此 Activity 询问用户是否继续下载。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要确认的广告应用下载将无法继续。

en.description: Mercury (Bayescom) opens this screen for an app download offered by an ad. It shows the offer page and download progress, then provides the install action.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot follow the ad-offer download or continue to installation through Mercury’s screen.

zh-CN.description: Mercury（Bayescom）会在用户选择广告应用后打开此页面，显示广告内容和下载进度，并提供安装操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 Mercury 的页面查看广告应用下载进度或继续安装。

en.description: Mercury (Bayescom) displays a full-screen interstitial ad here when the app requests one in landscape orientation.
en.disableEffect: Mercury landscape interstitial ads will not appear.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求横屏插页广告时，Mercury（Bayescom）会通过此 Activity 显示全屏广告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Mercury 的横屏插页广告将无法显示。

en.description: Mercury (Bayescom) displays a full-screen interstitial ad here when the app requests one in portrait orientation.
en.disableEffect: Mercury portrait interstitial ads will not appear.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求竖屏插页广告时，Mercury（Bayescom）会通过此 Activity 显示全屏广告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Mercury 的竖屏插页广告将无法显示。

en.description: Mercury (Bayescom) plays a landscape rewarded video ad here when the app requests one. The screen includes the video and its completion countdown.
en.disableEffect: The rewarded video cannot play, so users will no longer receive the reward for watching the ad.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求横屏激励视频时，Mercury（Bayescom）会在此播放广告视频并显示完成倒计时。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，奖励视频无法播放，用户观看广告后将不再获得奖励。

en.description: Mercury (Bayescom) plays a portrait rewarded video ad here when the app requests one. The screen includes the video and its completion countdown.
en.disableEffect: The rewarded video cannot play, so users will no longer receive the reward for watching the ad.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求竖屏激励视频时，Mercury（Bayescom）会在此播放广告视频并显示完成倒计时。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，奖励视频无法播放，用户观看广告后将不再获得奖励。

en.description: Mercury opens this Activity from an ad download flow to show the permission details for the app being offered.
en.disableEffect: The permission-details page for the offered app will not open.

zh-CN.description: Mercury 会在广告应用下载流程中打开此 Activity，显示该应用的权限详情。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 广告所提供应用的权限详情页面将无法打开。

en.description: Mercury uses this Activity to show web pages linked to an ad or app-download flow; it can also hand a page download to the SDK. It can open links sent to the app.
en.disableEffect: Mercury ad landing pages, information pages, and their download links may not open.

zh-CN.description: Mercury 会通过此 Activity 显示广告或应用下载流程中的网页，也可把网页下载交给 SDK 处理。应用收到链接时也能打开此页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Mercury 的广告落地页、说明页面及其下载链接将无法正常打开。

en.description: Mercury uses this provider to give Android access to an APK downloaded through an ad when the user chooses to install it.
en.disableEffect: Android’s installer cannot access APKs downloaded by Mercury, so those app installations may fail.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择安装广告应用时，Mercury 会通过此 Provider 让 Android 访问已下载的 APK。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Android 安装器将无法访问 Mercury 下载的应用安装包，相关安装可能失败。

en.description: After a user starts an app download from an ad, Mercury runs this service to download the file and show progress notifications before installation.
en.disableEffect: Mercury ad-offer downloads and their progress notifications will stop.

zh-CN.description: 用户开始下载广告应用后，Mercury 会通过此 Service 下载文件，并在安装前显示进度通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Mercury 广告应用下载及其进度通知将停止。

en.description: When a user taps a Mercury download notification, this receiver opens Android’s installer for the downloaded app package.
en.disableEffect: Tapping a Mercury download notification will no longer open Android’s installer for the downloaded app.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击 Mercury 下载通知时，此 Receiver 会打开 Android 安装器来处理已下载的应用安装包。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 点击 Mercury 下载通知将无法打开 Android 安装器来安装已下载的应用。

en.description: Main entry for the Blocker application
Interact with other application for controlling components.
en.disableEffect: Not be able to control components via 3rd apps

en.description: Mesh Connect Android SDK opens this Activity with a link token to host its financial-account linking flow. It displays the embedded linking page and returns a completed connection or cancellation result to the app.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot launch Mesh’s account-linking flow or receive its connection result.

zh-CN.description: Mesh Connect Android SDK 会使用链接令牌打开此 Activity，承载金融账户连接流程。它会显示内嵌的连接页面，并向应用返回连接成功或取消的结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法启动 Mesh 的账户连接流程，也无法收到连接结果。

en.description: The Mesibo Core API receiver handles battery, power, shutdown, screen, and unlock events; when Mesibo is active, screen-on and unlock events request a messaging connection retry.
en.disableEffect: Power-event checks stop, and background connection recovery may be slower if Android has stopped the app.

zh-CN.description: Mesibo Core API 的接收器会处理电池、电源、关机、屏幕和解锁事件；Mesibo 活动时，亮屏或解锁会触发消息连接重试。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 电源事件检查会停止；如果 Android 已停止应用，后台连接恢复可能变慢。

en.description: When Mesibo moves to the background, the Core API schedules this job to check the network connection and retry the messaging connection when needed.
en.disableEffect: Background messages and presence may not reconnect automatically until the user opens the app again.

zh-CN.description: Mesibo 进入后台后，Core API 会安排此任务检查网络，并在需要时重新连接消息服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 后台消息和在线状态可能无法自动重新连接，直到用户再次打开应用。

en.description: When Mesibo opens or shares a file attachment, the Core API uses this provider to create an app-scoped file link that another app can access temporarily.
en.disableEffect: Opening or sharing Mesibo file attachments may fail, and actions that need the file link may error.

zh-CN.description: Mesibo 打开或分享文件附件时，Core API 会通过此 Provider 创建仅供应用授权访问的临时文件链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 打开或分享 Mesibo 文件附件可能失败，依赖该链接的操作也可能报错。

en.description: When the Mesibo Core API requests runtime permissions, this Activity displays Android’s permission prompt and returns the result to the calling feature.
en.disableEffect: Permission-dependent Mesibo features may be unable to show the system prompt and can fail when opened.

zh-CN.description: Mesibo Core API 请求运行时权限时，此 Activity 会显示 Android 授权提示，并把结果返回给相关功能。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖权限的 Mesibo 功能可能无法显示系统授权提示，打开时也可能因此失败。

en.description: When an app asks Mesibo to stay active in the background, this service keeps the Core API bound to a running process and schedules a restart if Android stops it.
en.disableEffect: Mesibo may lose its background connection, delaying messages while the app is closed.

zh-CN.description: 应用要求 Mesibo 在后台保持运行时，此 Service 会维持 Core API 的连接，并在 Android 停止它后安排重启。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Mesibo 可能失去后台连接，应用关闭期间收到的消息可能延迟。

en.description: When a Mesibo one-to-one voice or video call opens, this Activity checks microphone and phone access, plus camera and Bluetooth access for video calls.
en.disableEffect: Calls that rely on this Activity may fail to open or request the permissions they need.

zh-CN.description: Mesibo 一对一语音或视频通话打开时，此 Activity 会检查麦克风和电话权限；视频通话还会检查相机和蓝牙权限。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此 Activity 的通话可能无法打开通话界面或取得所需权限。

en.description: When someone taps Answer or Decline on an incoming Mesibo call notification, this Receiver connects the call or hangs it up.
en.disableEffect: Answer and Decline buttons on incoming-call notifications will no longer handle the call.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击 Mesibo 来电通知中的接听或拒绝时，此 Receiver 会接通电话或挂断来电。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 来电通知上的接听和拒绝按钮将无法处理通话。

en.description: Android Telecom starts this Mesibo Calls service for phone-style incoming or outgoing calls, exposing the call and its answer or disconnect controls to the system.
en.disableEffect: Android system call controls may no longer connect, answer, or disconnect Mesibo calls.

zh-CN.description: Android Telecom 处理电话式的 Mesibo 来电或去电时会启动此 Service，并向系统提供通话及接听、断开控制。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Android 系统的通话界面可能无法连接、接听或挂断 Mesibo 电话。

en.description: When Mesibo uses its legacy incoming-call alert, this foreground service keeps the call alert active and plays the configured ringtone.
en.disableEffect: Incoming calls may not ring or show their legacy alert, so users may miss them.

zh-CN.description: Mesibo 使用旧版来电提醒时，此前台 Service 会维持来电提示并播放所设铃声。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 来电可能不会响铃或显示旧版来电提醒，用户可能错过电话。

en.description: When someone shares their screen during a Mesibo call, this foreground service keeps screen capture running and displays the ongoing-sharing notification.
en.disableEffect: Screen sharing during Mesibo calls will not work.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Mesibo 通话中共享屏幕时，此前台 Service 会维持屏幕采集并显示共享中的通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Mesibo 通话中的屏幕共享将无法正常工作。

en.description: Mesibo Calls opens this Activity for its default one-to-one call screen, where a person can answer, place, and control a voice or video call.
en.disableEffect: One-to-one Mesibo calls that use this default screen will not open or be controllable.

zh-CN.description: Mesibo Calls 会通过此 Activity 显示默认的一对一通话界面，用户可接听、拨打和控制语音或视频通话。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此默认界面的一对一 Mesibo 通话将无法打开或控制。

en.description: When an app starts a Mesibo group call, this Activity opens the conference screen for its room and audio or video streams.
en.disableEffect: Group calls that use this screen will not open the conference view.

zh-CN.description: 应用发起 Mesibo 群组通话时，此 Activity 会打开对应房间的会议界面和音视频流控制。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此界面的 Mesibo 群组通话将无法打开会议界面。

en.description: When someone opens Mesibo conferencing, this Activity lists available rooms and lets them join with a room ID and PIN or create a room.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to join or create Mesibo conference rooms through this screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 Mesibo 会议功能时，此 Activity 会列出可用房间，并允许输入房间编号和 PIN 加入或创建房间。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此界面加入或创建 Mesibo 会议室。

en.description: When someone opens call history from the Mesibo calling UI, this Activity displays past call entries.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to open the Mesibo call history list.

zh-CN.description: 用户从 Mesibo 通话界面打开通话记录时，此 Activity 会显示之前的通话条目。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开 Mesibo 通话记录列表。

en.description: When someone opens a contact’s call history, this Activity displays that person’s call records and provides audio and video call buttons.
en.disableEffect: Users will lose per-contact call history and its quick audio and video call controls.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开某个联系人的通话记录时，此 Activity 会显示其通话历史，并提供语音和视频拨号按钮。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法查看该联系人的通话记录或使用其中的快速语音、视频拨号按钮。

en.description: When Mesibo Media Picker opens album browsing, this Activity displays photo albums and returns the selected image to the calling screen.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to browse albums and select a photo through Mesibo Media Picker.

zh-CN.description: Mesibo Media Picker 打开相册浏览时，此 Activity 会显示照片相册，并把所选图片返回给发起页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 Mesibo 媒体选择器浏览相册并选取照片。

en.description: When the media picker opens a selected image or video for editing, this Activity previews it and can crop or rotate an image and add a caption before returning it.
en.disableEffect: Users will lose the media preview and image editing step when attaching a photo or video.

zh-CN.description: 媒体选择器打开所选图片或视频进行编辑时，此 Activity 会显示预览，并可裁剪、旋转图片或添加说明后返回。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 添加媒体时，用户将无法使用图片或视频预览以及图片编辑步骤。

en.description: Mesibo Media Picker uses this provider to give camera-captured images and media files to the picker and encryption screens through temporary file links.
en.disableEffect: Camera capture and protected media sharing may fail because the app cannot create the required file links.

zh-CN.description: Mesibo Media Picker 通过此 Provider 创建临时文件链接，让选择器和加密页面读取相机拍摄的图片及媒体文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 相机拍摄和受保护的媒体文件分享可能失败，因为应用无法创建所需的文件链接。

en.description: When Mesibo opens a photo or video for viewing, this Activity shows it full-screen and lets the person swipe through selected images.
en.disableEffect: Photos and videos opened from Mesibo screens will no longer have a full-screen viewer.

zh-CN.description: Mesibo 打开照片或视频供用户查看时，此 Activity 会全屏显示媒体，并允许在所选图片间滑动。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 从 Mesibo 页面打开的照片和视频将无法使用全屏查看器。

en.description: Mesibo Messaging UI opens this Activity when someone creates a group or edits a group’s details.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to create or edit Mesibo groups through this screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户创建群组或编辑群组资料时，Mesibo Messaging UI 会打开此 Activity。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此界面创建或编辑 Mesibo 群组。

en.description: Mesibo Messaging UI opens this Activity from a conversation or profile to show end-to-end encryption status and fingerprints, and to manage passwords or certificates.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to view or change Mesibo encryption status, passwords, or certificates.

zh-CN.description: 用户从会话或个人资料进入加密设置时，Mesibo Messaging UI 会显示端到端加密状态和指纹，并提供密码或证书管理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法查看或修改 Mesibo 加密状态、密码和证书。

en.description: When someone chooses to share a location from a Mesibo conversation, this Activity shows their current position or a map place and returns the selected location.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to choose and send a map location from a Mesibo conversation.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择在 Mesibo 会话中分享位置时，此 Activity 会显示当前位置或地图地点，并返回所选位置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法从 Mesibo 会话中选择并发送地图位置。

en.description: Mesibo Messaging UI opens this Activity for a conversation; it displays messages and provides the conversation’s attachment, profile, and permission-related actions.
en.disableEffect: The conversation screen may fail to open, preventing access to messages and in-chat actions.

zh-CN.description: Mesibo Messaging UI 会为某个会话打开此 Activity；页面显示消息，并提供附件、资料及权限相关操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 会话页面可能无法打开，用户将无法查看消息或使用聊天中的相关操作。

en.description: When someone opens a Mesibo contact or group profile, this Activity displays the profile image, name, online or last-seen state, and profile details.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to open Mesibo contact or group profiles and view online status.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 Mesibo 联系人或群组资料时，此 Activity 会显示头像、名称、在线或最近上线状态以及资料详情。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开 Mesibo 个人或群组资料页面并查看在线状态。

en.description: Mesibo Messaging UI opens this Activity for contact and conversation lists, including recipient selection for message forwarding.
en.disableEffect: The Mesibo contact and conversation lists will not open, and users cannot choose a recipient when forwarding.

zh-CN.description: Mesibo Messaging UI 会通过此 Activity 显示联系人和会话列表，也用于转发消息时选择收件人。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Mesibo 联系人和会话列表将无法打开，转发时也无法选择收件人。

en.description: Mesibo UI Helper opens this Activity for its welcome, phone login, and verification screens.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to complete Mesibo phone login and verification through this Activity.

zh-CN.description: Mesibo UI Helper 会通过此 Activity 显示欢迎、手机号登录和验证页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此 Activity 完成 Mesibo 手机登录和验证。

en.description: Mesibo UI Helper opens this Activity to show the app’s configured onboarding slides and completes the tour when someone selects Skip or Done.
en.disableEffect: The onboarding tour may not open or finish, interrupting any startup flow that depends on its completion callback.

zh-CN.description: Mesibo UI Helper 会通过此 Activity 展示应用配置的引导页，并在用户选择跳过或完成时结束引导。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 引导页可能无法打开或完成；依赖引导完成回调的启动流程也会中断。

en.description: When the Messangi Messaging SDK is configured to collect location in the background, this foreground service displays an ongoing notification and fetches the device location.
en.disableEffect: Messangi background location updates and location-based targeting will stop, while the app itself remains usable.

zh-CN.description: Messangi Messaging SDK 配置为在后台收集位置时，此前台 Service 会显示持续通知并获取设备位置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Messangi 后台位置更新和基于位置的推送定位会停止，但应用本身仍可使用。

en.description: Android creates this provider during app startup; the Messangi Messaging SDK initializes there and prepares device registration data when no device record exists.
en.disableEffect: The SDK may not register the device or complete messaging setup, and dependent SDK features may fail to start.

zh-CN.description: Android 会在应用启动时创建此 Provider；Messangi Messaging SDK 在此初始化，并在设备记录不存在时准备注册信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: SDK 可能无法注册设备或完成消息初始化，依赖它的 SDK 功能也可能无法启动。

en.description: The Messangi Messaging SDK receives Firebase push messages and token changes, checks whether each message belongs to the app, and forwards displayable notifications for the app to handle.
en.disableEffect: This SDK's push messages and notifications will stop reaching the app.

zh-CN.description: Messangi Messaging SDK 会接收 Firebase 推送消息和推送令牌变更，确认消息属于当前应用后，将可显示的通知交给应用处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，此 SDK 的推送消息和通知将停止送达应用。

en.description: When a user starts screen capture in the 233 MPG game SDK, this private Service runs the capture in the foreground and shows Android's recording notification.
en.disableEffect: The 233 MPG screen-recording feature will stop.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 233 MPG 游戏 SDK 中启动屏幕捕获时，此 Service 会在前台运行捕获任务，并显示 Android 的录制通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，233 MPG 的屏幕录制功能将无法使用。

en.description: When a user requests screen capture through the 233 MPG game SDK, this Activity opens Android's screen-capture consent prompt and returns the choice to the SDK.
en.disableEffect: The SDK cannot request consent for or start its screen-capture feature.

zh-CN.description: 用户通过 233 MPG 游戏 SDK 请求屏幕捕获时，此 Activity 会打开 Android 的屏幕捕获授权提示，并将用户的选择交回 SDK。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，SDK 将无法请求屏幕捕获授权或启动屏幕捕获功能。

en.description: After an external authorization app returns a response to the 233 MPG SDK, this exported Activity checks it and passes the result back to the SDK.
en.disableEffect: 233 account-authorization callbacks will not complete, so sign-in flows that depend on them can fail.

zh-CN.description: 外部授权应用将结果返回给 233 MPG SDK 后，此导出 Activity 会检查结果并将其交回 SDK。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，233 账号授权回调将无法完成，依赖该回调的登录流程可能失败。

en.description: When the 233 MPG SDK needs user consent, this Activity shows its user agreement and reports whether the user accepts. Declining records the refusal and closes the current SDK flow.
en.disableEffect: The consent decision cannot be collected, which can prevent SDK features that require agreement from starting.

zh-CN.description: 233 MPG SDK 需要用户同意时，此 Activity 会显示用户协议并返回用户是否接受；用户拒绝后会记录拒绝结果并结束当前 SDK 流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后将无法收集用户的同意结果，需要协议确认的 SDK 功能可能无法启动。

en.description: When 233 reports that its game service is under maintenance, this Activity shows the maintenance notice and a quit-game control; it can also close after the configured maintenance interval.
en.disableEffect: The maintenance notice and its quit option will not appear, and the affected 233 game service may remain unavailable.

zh-CN.description: 233 报告游戏服务正在维护时，此 Activity 会显示维护公告和退出游戏按钮；设定的维护时长结束后，页面也会自动关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后将看不到维护公告和退出选项，受影响的 233 游戏服务仍可能无法使用。

en.description: When the 233 MPG SDK detects a newer game package, this Activity shows the version and update details, downloads it, and opens the installer. Required updates must finish before entering the game, while optional updates can be skipped.
en.disableEffect: The SDK's game-update prompt and install path will fail, and a game that requires the update may not open.

zh-CN.description: 233 MPG SDK 检测到游戏有新版本时，此 Activity 会显示版本和更新说明、下载更新并打开安装程序；强制更新必须完成后才能进入游戏，可选更新则可以跳过。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，SDK 的游戏更新提示和安装流程将无法使用，需要更新的游戏可能无法正常打开。

en.description: When 233 MPG installs a downloaded game update on Android 7 or newer, this Provider creates an app-scoped file link so Android's package installer can read the APK.
en.disableEffect: The installer cannot access the downloaded APK through this SDK, so game updates cannot be installed through this path.

zh-CN.description: 在 Android 7 及更高版本上安装 233 MPG 下载的游戏更新时，此 Provider 会创建应用专属的文件链接，让 Android 安装程序读取 APK。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 安装程序将无法通过此 SDK 读取下载的 APK，因此无法使用这条路径安装游戏更新。

en.description: When a user opens 233 MPG customer support or selects an agreement, privacy, or real-name verification link, this Activity loads the requested URL in an in-app web page.
en.disableEffect: The customer-support, agreement, privacy, and real-name information pages will not open inside the app.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 233 MPG 客服中心，或点击应用内的协议、隐私及实名认证说明链接时，此 Activity 会在应用内加载对应网页。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用内的客服、协议、隐私和实名认证说明页面将无法打开。

en.description: When a Trusted Web Activity requests location access, Meta Android Browser Helper opens this Activity to request fine or coarse Android location permission and return the result to the web page.
en.disableEffect: Web pages in the app will not receive the Android location-permission result through Trusted Web Activity integration.

zh-CN.description: Trusted Web Activity 请求位置权限时，Meta Android Browser Helper 会打开此 Activity 请求 Android 精确或大致位置权限，并把结果返回网页。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用中的网页将无法通过 Trusted Web Activity 集成取得 Android 位置权限结果。

en.description: When 233's open authorization flow needs a web sign-in page, this Activity loads the supplied page and returns the authentication result or cancellation to the SDK.
en.disableEffect: Web-based 233 authorization will fail, which can prevent login flows that rely on it.

zh-CN.description: 233 开放授权流程需要网页登录时，此 Activity 会加载指定网页，并将认证结果或取消操作返回给 SDK。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，233 的网页授权将无法完成，依赖该方式的登录流程可能失败。

en.description: When the app starts, Android runs this background component to prepare MetaMap identity verification services for the flow.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents the SDK from registering its startup handling and initializing its services, so verification may fail to open.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，Android 会运行此后台组件，为 MetaMap 身份核验流程准备所需服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，SDK 无法注册启动处理并初始化服务，身份核验可能无法打开。

en.description: When MetaMap needs to pass a captured verification image as a file link, this provider makes the file available through a protected content link.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it can prevent captured images from being opened or submitted during verification.

zh-CN.description: MetaMap 需要以文件链接传递核验图像时，此提供程序会通过受保护的内容链接提供该文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，核验过程中拍摄的图像可能无法打开或提交。

en.description: When a MetaMap identity check begins, this screen hosts the guided verification experience and its navigation.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from opening or completing MetaMap identity verification.

zh-CN.description: MetaMap 身份核验开始时，此页面会承载引导式检查和页面导航。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法打开或完成 MetaMap 身份核验。

en.description: During a Metro IPO SDK flow, this Activity lets the user draw, clear, and submit a signature; the SDK uploads the signature image with a verification code.
en.disableEffect: The user cannot submit the signature needed to finish that Metro IPO flow.

zh-CN.description: 在 Metro IPO SDK 流程中，此界面让用户手写、清除并提交签名；SDK 会将签名图片连同验证码一起上传。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法提交签名，也无法完成 Metro IPO 流程。

en.description: MFMS Push Lite starts this background Service after a push arrives or is marked read. It syncs message content and read status with MFMS and saves new messages for the app.
en.disableEffect: The app's MFMS push inbox may not sync new messages or read status.

zh-CN.description: 收到推送或消息被标记为已读后，MFMS Push Lite 会在后台启动此 Service。它会与 MFMS 同步消息内容和已读状态，并将新消息保存给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用中的 MFMS 推送收件箱可能无法同步新消息或已读状态。

en.description: When Firebase Cloud Messaging delivers a message, this older MFMS Push Lite Service checks its sender, forwards valid alerts to the app, and reports receipt to MFMS.
en.disableEffect: MFMS push alerts and delivery acknowledgments may stop in this older integration.

zh-CN.description: Firebase Cloud Messaging 收到消息时，这个较早版本的 MFMS Push Lite Service 会核对发送方、将有效提醒转给应用，并向 MFMS 报告已收到消息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 此较早集成中的 MFMS 推送提醒和送达确认可能会停止工作。

en.description: When Firebase reports that the app's Instance ID token changed, this MFMS Push Lite Service starts device registration so MFMS can send pushes to the new token.
en.disableEffect: MFMS may stop delivering push messages after the Firebase token changes.

zh-CN.description: Firebase 报告应用的 Instance ID 令牌已更改时，MFMS Push Lite 会启动设备注册，以便 MFMS 向新令牌发送推送。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Firebase 令牌更改后，MFMS 可能无法继续向设备发送推送消息。

en.description: MFMS Push Lite starts this background Service when refreshing a push token or processing a new push. It registers tokens with MFMS, forwards incoming alerts to the app, and acknowledges delivery.
en.disableEffect: MFMS push registration, incoming alerts, and delivery acknowledgments may stop working.

zh-CN.description: MFMS Push Lite 在刷新推送令牌或处理新推送时会启动此后台 Service。它向 MFMS 注册令牌、将收到的提醒转给应用，并确认消息送达。
zh-CN.disableEffect: MFMS 推送注册、提醒接收和送达确认可能无法继续工作。

en.description: Firebase Cloud Messaging starts this MFMS Push Lite Service for incoming messages and new tokens. It forwards message data to MFMS Push Lite and asks it to register changed tokens.
en.disableEffect: MFMS push messages may not be received, and refreshed Firebase tokens may not be registered.

zh-CN.description: 收到新消息或新令牌时，Firebase Cloud Messaging 会启动此 MFMS Push Lite Service。它将消息数据交给 MFMS Push Lite 处理，并让其注册已更改的令牌。
zh-CN.disableEffect: MFMS 可能无法收到推送消息，Firebase 刷新后的令牌也可能无法注册。

en.description: When a user taps an MGMI ad link, this screen opens the destination in the ad SDK's in-app browser.
en.disableEffect: MGMI ad landing pages will no longer open inside the app.

zh-CN.description: 用户点按 MGMI 广告链接时，此页面会在广告 SDK 的应用内浏览器中打开目标网页。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，MGMI 广告落地页将无法在应用内打开。

en.description: At app startup, this CheckEnv library entry prepares the app context used by its device-risk checks, which can detect emulators, root access, debugging, VPN use, and cloned-app environments.
en.disableEffect: CheckEnv checks that need the app context will fail because the library has no initialized context.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，CheckEnv 环境检测库会通过此入口准备设备风险检测所需的应用上下文；这些检测可识别模拟器、Root、调试器、VPN 和应用分身环境。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 由于库未获得初始化的应用上下文，依赖该上下文的 CheckEnv 检测将失败。

en.description: The MGMI ad SDK sends this receiver click and delete events for its download notifications, such as removing a notice or continuing a download action.
en.disableEffect: MGMI ad download notifications will no longer respond to their click or delete actions.

zh-CN.description: MGMI 广告 SDK 会将下载通知的点按和删除事件交给此接收器处理，例如移除通知或继续相应下载操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，MGMI 广告下载通知将无法响应点按或删除操作。

en.description: When a user taps an MGMI ad download notification, this screen opens its web address or app when available and reports whether the destination opened.
en.disableEffect: Tapping these MGMI download notifications will no longer open the advertised page or app.

zh-CN.description: 用户点按 MGMI 广告下载通知时，此页面会在目标可用时打开对应网页或应用，并回报打开结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，点按这些 MGMI 下载通知将无法打开广告网页或应用。

en.description: Mango TV's login SDK opens this screen to load a web-based sign-in or authorization page and handle the service's return link.
en.disableEffect: Mango TV third-party sign-in and authorization flows will not complete.

zh-CN.description: 芒果 TV 登录 SDK 会打开此页面加载网页登录或授权内容，并处理服务返回的链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 芒果 TV 的第三方登录和授权流程将无法完成。

en.description: The CacheFileProvider library serves read-only files from the app cache when another app opens a file link shared by the app.
en.disableEffect: Other apps can no longer open files shared from the app cache, including log files shared by libraries that use this provider.

zh-CN.description: CacheFileProvider 库会在其他应用打开共享文件链接时，从应用缓存中提供只读文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 其他应用将无法打开从应用缓存共享的文件，包括使用此提供程序共享的日志文件。

en.description: Scandit (formerly Microblink) Text Capture opens this screen for a barcode scan. It uses the camera to read a barcode and returns the scan result to the app.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents barcode scans that use this screen from opening or returning a result.

zh-CN.description: Scandit（原 Microblink）文字采集 SDK 会在应用发起条码扫描时打开此页面。它使用相机读取条码，并将扫描结果返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，依赖此页面的条码扫描无法启动或返回结果。

en.description: Scandit (formerly Microblink) Text Capture opens this screen to read a payment card with the camera. When card editing is enabled, a successful scan can continue to a review screen.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it interrupts payment-card capture and any card-review flow that starts after the scan.

zh-CN.description: Scandit（原 Microblink）文字采集 SDK 会打开此页面，用相机读取支付卡信息。启用卡片编辑时，扫描成功后还可以进入核对页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，支付卡采集以及扫描后衔接的卡片核对流程会中断。

en.description: Scandit (formerly Microblink) ID Capture opens this screen when an app starts an identity-document scan. It guides the camera capture and returns recognized identity details.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents the app's ID-document scanning flow from opening or returning captured details.

zh-CN.description: Scandit（原 Microblink）证件采集 SDK 会在应用启动证件扫描时打开此页面。它引导相机采集，并返回识别出的身份信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，应用的证件扫描流程无法打开或返回采集到的信息。

en.description: Scandit (formerly Microblink) Text Capture opens this screen to capture a document with the camera. It returns the captured document image and recognition result to the app.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents document-capture flows that rely on this screen from completing.

zh-CN.description: Scandit（原 Microblink）文字采集 SDK 会打开此页面，用相机采集文档，并将文档图像和识别结果返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，依赖此页面的文档采集流程无法完成。

en.description: Scandit (formerly Microblink) ID Capture opens this screen to photograph an identity document and recognize its fields. The app can receive the document image and extracted details.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents identity-document scans that use this screen from returning images or recognized details.

zh-CN.description: Scandit（原 Microblink）证件采集 SDK 会打开此页面拍摄证件并识别其中字段。应用可以接收证件图像和提取的信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，使用此页面的证件扫描无法返回图像或识别信息。

en.description: Scandit (formerly Microblink) ID Capture opens this screen when an app collects an identity document one side or field at a time. It guides each capture and returns the collected data.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it interrupts identity-document flows that require guided, step-by-step capture.

zh-CN.description: Scandit（原 Microblink）证件采集 SDK 会在应用逐面或逐项采集证件时打开此页面。它逐步引导采集并返回收集到的数据。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，需要逐步引导采集的证件流程会中断。

en.description: Scandit (formerly Microblink) ID Capture opens this screen for its legacy identity-document verification flow. It scans the document and returns the verification recognizer result to the app.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents the legacy document-verification flow from opening or returning its result.

zh-CN.description: Scandit（原 Microblink）证件采集 SDK 会为旧版证件验证流程打开此页面。它扫描证件，并将验证识别结果返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，旧版证件验证流程无法打开或返回结果。

en.description: Scandit (formerly Microblink) Text Capture opens this screen after a payment-card scan when the app requests card editing. The user can review and correct card fields before the app receives them.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it removes the card review and correction step; flows that require that step cannot finish as intended.

zh-CN.description: Scandit（原 Microblink）文字采集 SDK 会在应用要求编辑支付卡信息时，于扫描后打开此页面。用户可以核对并修改卡片字段，然后将结果交给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，卡片核对和修改步骤将不可用；依赖该步骤的流程无法按预期完成。

en.description: Scandit BlinkInput opens this screen when an app starts a barcode scan. It uses the camera to read a barcode and returns the scan result.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents barcode scans that use this screen from opening or returning a result.

zh-CN.description: Scandit BlinkInput 会在应用启动条码扫描时打开此页面。它使用相机读取条码，并返回扫描结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，依赖此页面的条码扫描无法启动或返回结果。

en.description: Scandit BlinkInput opens this screen to capture a document with the camera and recognize its contents. It returns the capture result to the app.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents document-capture flows that rely on this screen from completing.

zh-CN.description: Scandit BlinkInput 会打开此页面，用相机采集文档并识别内容，然后将采集结果返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，依赖此页面的文档采集流程无法完成。

en.description: Scandit BlinkInput opens this screen when an app collects document information one field or side at a time. It guides each capture and returns the collected data.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it interrupts document flows that require guided, step-by-step capture.

zh-CN.description: Scandit BlinkInput 会在应用逐项或逐面采集文档信息时打开此页面。它逐步引导采集并返回收集到的数据。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，需要逐步引导采集的文档流程会中断。

en.description: Microsoft ADAL opens this Activity for interactive sign-in, displays the authorization page, and returns the authentication result to the calling app or broker.
en.disableEffect: Apps using ADAL's interactive sign-in or token acquisition may fail to authenticate.

zh-CN.description: Microsoft ADAL 会在交互式登录时打开此 Activity，显示授权页面，并将认证结果返回给调用应用或身份验证代理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用 ADAL 进行交互式登录或获取令牌的应用可能无法完成认证。

en.description: Microsoft Azure Active Directory Authentication Library (ADAL) for Android opens this Activity for interactive sign-in; it displays the authorization page in a WebView and returns the result when the configured redirect is reached.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot show the ADAL sign-in screen or receive its authorization result, so sign-in through this path fails.

zh-CN.description: 微软 Android Azure Active Directory 身份验证库（ADAL）会在交互式登录时打开此 Activity；它在 WebView 中显示授权页面，并在到达配置的重定向地址后返回结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用无法显示 ADAL 登录界面或接收授权结果，因此通过此流程登录会失败。

en.description: App Center Distribute receives package-installer updates here, opens an install confirmation when required, and relaunches the app after an update replaces it.
en.disableEffect: App Center in-app release installation or its post-install restart may not complete correctly.

zh-CN.description: App Center Distribute 在此接收安装程序的更新状态，需要确认时会打开确认界面，并在新版本替换应用后重新启动应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: App Center 应用内版本安装或安装后的重新启动可能无法正常完成。

en.description: When an App Center distribution link returns to the app, this Activity stores the update details and resumes or relaunches the app.
en.disableEffect: App Center update links may not return users to the correct distribution flow.

zh-CN.description: App Center 分发链接返回应用时，此 Activity 会保存更新信息，并恢复或重新启动应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: App Center 更新链接可能无法将用户带回正确的分发流程。

en.description: When Android's Download Manager reports an App Center release download or its notification is tapped, this Receiver resumes the distribution flow and processes the update.
en.disableEffect: App Center downloads may not resume or proceed to installation.

zh-CN.description: Android 下载管理器报告 App Center 版本下载完成或用户点击其通知时，此 Receiver 会恢复分发流程并处理更新。
zh-CN.disableEffect: App Center 下载可能无法恢复，也可能无法继续安装。

en.description: After an App Center release replaces the installed app, this Receiver posts a notification that the update finished and includes the app version.
en.disableEffect: Users may not see App Center's installation-complete notification.

zh-CN.description: App Center 版本替换已安装的应用后，此 Receiver 会发布更新完成通知，并显示应用版本。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户可能看不到 App Center 的安装完成通知。

en.description: App Center Distribute starts this transparent Activity to open Android's installer for a downloaded release and return the installation result.
en.disableEffect: App Center may not be able to launch or track installation of an in-app release.

zh-CN.description: App Center Distribute 会启动此透明 Activity，打开 Android 安装程序安装下载的版本，并接收安装结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: App Center 可能无法启动应用内版本的安装，也无法跟踪安装结果。

en.description: App Center Distribute opens this transparent Activity to request runtime permissions needed by its distribution flow and collect the user's choices.
en.disableEffect: App Center may not be able to request permissions needed to deliver or install in-app releases.

zh-CN.description: App Center Distribute 会打开此透明 Activity，请求分发流程所需的运行时权限，并收集用户的选择。
zh-CN.disableEffect: App Center 可能无法请求交付或安装应用内版本所需的权限。

en.description: Microsoft Clarity schedules this background job to upload recorded app-use sessions, subject to its configured network-use limit.
en.disableEffect: Clarity session recordings may remain on the device instead of reaching the Clarity dashboard.

zh-CN.description: Microsoft Clarity 会安排此后台任务上传应用使用录屏，并遵守配置的网络用量限制。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Clarity 的会话录屏可能会留在设备上，无法传到 Clarity 控制台。

en.description: Android starts this provider with the app, and it saves the application context for later use by Microsoft Cognitive Services Speech during speech operations.
en.disableEffect: Speech SDK features that need the saved app context may fail to initialize or run.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，Android 会创建此 Provider，并保存应用上下文，供 Microsoft Cognitive Services Speech 在后续语音操作中使用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要此应用上下文的 Speech SDK 功能可能无法初始化或运行。

en.description: Microsoft Authentication Library for Android (MSAL) uses this Activity when the browser returns from interactive sign-in. It forwards the redirect response to the waiting authentication flow.
en.disableEffect: Browser-based Microsoft sign-in cannot return its response to the app.

zh-CN.description: 浏览器交互式登录返回时，Microsoft Android 身份验证库（MSAL）会使用此界面，并将重定向响应交给等待中的身份验证流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 基于浏览器的 Microsoft 登录将无法把响应返回应用。

en.description: MSAL uses this browser-return screen for sign-in flows that stay in the current task. It forwards the redirect response and closes the temporary return task when the flow finishes.
en.disableEffect: Current-task browser sign-in cannot pass its redirect response through MSAL or complete the return-task cleanup.

zh-CN.description: MSAL 会在需要留在当前任务中的登录流程里使用此浏览器返回界面。它转交重定向响应，并在流程结束时关闭临时返回任务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 保持在当前任务中的浏览器登录将无法通过 MSAL 传递重定向响应，也无法完成返回任务的清理。

en.description: MSAL can open this setup helper to show the app's package name, signing fingerprint, broker redirect address, and manifest entry needed for broker authentication.
en.disableEffect: In-app broker setup details become unavailable; this screen does not perform sign-in itself.

zh-CN.description: MSAL 可打开此设置辅助界面，显示应用包名、签名指纹、Broker 重定向地址及 Broker 身份验证所需的清单配置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用内的 Broker 设置说明将无法查看；此界面本身不执行登录。

en.description: Microsoft Authentication Library (MSAL) opens this Activity when an app sends an interactive sign-in request to a Microsoft broker app, then returns the broker result to the app.
en.disableEffect: Broker-based sign-in cannot return its result, so users may be unable to sign in through the app's Microsoft account flow.

zh-CN.description: 微软身份验证库（MSAL）会在应用通过 Microsoft broker 应用发起交互式登录时打开此 Activity，并把 broker 的结果交回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，基于 broker 的登录无法返回结果，用户可能无法通过应用的 Microsoft 账户登录流程登录。

en.description: Microsoft's shared MSAL/ADAL device-registration code opens this Activity when a broker returns an intent to install a work-device certificate; it launches the broker screen and sends the result back to the app.
en.disableEffect: The certificate used for a work account cannot be installed, so dependent work-account or device enrollment may fail.

zh-CN.description: 微软 MSAL/ADAL 共用的设备注册代码会在 broker 返回工作设备证书安装请求时打开此 Activity；它启动 broker 的安装界面，并把结果交还应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 工作账户所需的设备证书将无法安装，依赖该证书的工作账户或设备注册可能失败。

en.description: Microsoft's identity library starts this Activity for interactive authorization. It hosts the selected sign-in interface and returns the result to the app.
en.disableEffect: Apps using MSAL or the shared Microsoft identity library cannot complete interactive sign-in or authorization.

zh-CN.description: Microsoft 身份库会在应用发起交互式授权时启动此界面。它承载所选登录界面，并将结果返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用 MSAL 或 Microsoft 共享身份库的应用将无法完成交互式登录或授权。

en.description: Microsoft's identity library uses this Activity for browser authorization that remains in the current task. It receives the redirect, completes authorization, and closes the temporary sign-in screen.
en.disableEffect: Current-task browser authorization cannot complete or return its result.

zh-CN.description: Microsoft 身份库会在需要保持当前任务的浏览器授权流程中使用此界面。它接收重定向、完成授权并关闭临时登录界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 保持在当前任务中的浏览器授权将无法完成或返回结果。

en.description: Microsoft's shared MSAL/ADAL authentication library uses this transparent Activity for a timed silent WebView authorization request; it hosts the hidden authorization flow and reports its result.
en.disableEffect: The timed silent WebView authorization path cannot complete, so the app may fail to obtain a token needed for account-backed features.

zh-CN.description: 微软 MSAL/ADAL 共用的身份验证库会在定时的静默 WebView 授权请求中使用此透明 Activity；它承载隐藏的授权流程并返回结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 定时静默 WebView 授权流程将无法完成，应用可能无法获取账户功能所需的令牌。

en.description: Microsoft's shared MSAL/ADAL authentication library opens this Activity when an app opts into browser-switch sign-in; it launches the selected browser or browser tab and collects the authorization result.
en.disableEffect: Browser-switch sign-in cannot launch the browser or return its authorization result, so that sign-in method fails.

zh-CN.description: 应用启用浏览器切换登录时，微软 MSAL/ADAL 共用的身份验证库会打开此 Activity；它启动选定的浏览器或浏览器标签页，并接收授权结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 浏览器切换登录无法启动浏览器或接收授权结果，因此该登录方式会失败。

en.description: Microsoft's shared MSAL/ADAL authentication library uses this Activity to receive the browser redirect for apps that enable browser-switch sign-in, then reopens the in-app authorization flow with the returned data.
en.disableEffect: The browser-switch response cannot return to the app's authorization flow, so that sign-in request may fail or remain unfinished.

zh-CN.description: 应用启用浏览器切换登录时，微软 MSAL/ADAL 共用的身份验证库会用此 Activity 接收浏览器重定向，并用返回的数据重新打开应用内的授权流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 浏览器切换的响应无法返回应用的授权流程，因此该登录请求可能失败或无法完成。

en.description: The shared MSAL/ADAL authentication library from Microsoft attaches a return request when it sends an OpenID Verifiable Credentials request to a verified Microsoft Authenticator handler; this Activity closes the temporary task so the app can reappear.
en.disableEffect: After the credential handler finishes, the return request cannot open this Activity, so the original app may not return to the foreground automatically.

zh-CN.description: 微软 MSAL/ADAL 共用的身份验证库将 OpenID 可验证凭据请求交给已验证的 Microsoft Authenticator 处理时，会附带返回请求；此 Activity 关闭临时任务，让原应用重新显示。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 凭据处理应用结束后，返回请求无法打开此 Activity，因此原应用可能无法自动回到前台。

en.description: Azure Notification Hubs uses Firebase messaging events to register the app, save updated push tokens, and pass received notification data to the app's listener.
en.disableEffect: Push notifications from Azure Notification Hubs may not reach the app.

zh-CN.description: Azure Notification Hubs 会利用 Firebase 消息事件注册应用、保存更新后的推送令牌，并将收到的通知数据交给应用的监听器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Azure Notification Hubs 的推送通知可能无法送达应用。

en.description: Midtrans IssueTracker (Raygun) starts this background service when it sends a crash report or diagnostic message; the service posts the report or saves it until a network connection returns.
en.disableEffect: Midtrans error reports and diagnostic messages will no longer be sent; payment screens do not depend on this reporting service.

zh-CN.description: Midtrans IssueTracker（Raygun）在发送崩溃报告或诊断消息时会启动此后台服务；服务会发送报告，或暂存到网络恢复后再发送。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Midtrans 的错误报告和诊断消息将不再发送；支付页面不依赖此报告服务。

en.description: The Midtrans/GoJek GoPay Checkout SDK opens this screen with a checkout page and return address; it displays the page in the app and returns control when checkout finishes or the user backs out.
en.disableEffect: The GoPay Checkout page cannot open in the app or return its completion result.

zh-CN.description: Midtrans/GoJek GoPay Checkout SDK 会带着结账页面和返回地址打开此页面；页面在应用内显示结账内容，并在结账结束或用户返回时把控制权交还应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: GoPay Checkout 页面将无法在应用内打开或返回结账结果。

en.description: When the host app requests card scanning, Midtrans ScanCard opens the card.io camera flow to capture the card number and expiry date and collect the security code, then returns those details to the caller.
en.disableEffect: The card-scanning route will no longer return card details; a credit-card form that invokes it may fail to open the scanner.

zh-CN.description: 宿主应用请求扫描银行卡时，Midtrans ScanCard 会打开 card.io 相机流程采集卡号和有效期，并收集安全码，再把信息返回给调用方。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 银行卡扫描流程将无法再返回卡片信息；调用扫描器的信用卡表单可能无法打开扫描页面。

en.description: The Midtrans UiKit checkout opens this screen to load the enabled payment methods, show the available choices, and route the selected method to its payment step; it also returns the transaction result to the app.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it can prevent the built-in checkout from opening payment choices or returning a completed transaction.

zh-CN.description: Midtrans UiKit 结账会打开此页面加载已启用的支付方式、展示可选项，并将用户选中的方式送入对应支付步骤；页面还会把交易结果返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，内置结账可能无法打开支付选项或向应用返回交易结果。

en.description: Midtrans UiKit opens this screen when checkout needs the payer's name or address; after the required details are entered, it opens the payment-method screen.
en.disableEffect: Checkout may not reach the payment choices when the required payer details have not been supplied.

zh-CN.description: 结账需要付款人的姓名或地址时，Midtrans UiKit 会打开此页面；填写所需信息后，页面会继续打开支付方式选择页。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 如果尚未提供所需的付款人信息，结账可能无法继续到支付方式选择。

en.description: After the user chooses a bank transfer option in Midtrans UiKit, this screen shows the selected bank's account details and transfer instructions.
en.disableEffect: Users may not be able to view the bank account details needed to complete or verify a transfer.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Midtrans UiKit 中选择银行转账后，此页面会显示所选银行的账户信息和转账说明。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户可能无法查看完成或确认转账所需的银行账户信息。

en.description: When the user chooses bank transfer in Midtrans UiKit checkout, this screen lists the available banks; choosing one opens its transfer details.
en.disableEffect: Users may be unable to choose a bank or continue with a bank transfer.
