en.description: When a user selects Telkomsel Cash payments in Midtrans UiKit checkout, this screen collects the required cash-wallet token and submits the payment.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it can prevent users from completing payments with Telkomsel Cash payments.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Midtrans UiKit 结账中选择Telkomsel Cash 支付后，此页面会收集所需的钱包令牌并提交支付。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户可能无法通过Telkomsel Cash 支付完成支付。

en.description: During Midtrans UiKit checkout, this screen lists UOB EZ Pay methods choices and opens the selected payment step.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it can prevent users from choosing or continuing with UOB EZ Pay methods.

zh-CN.description: 在 Midtrans UiKit 结账过程中，此页面会列出UOB EZ Pay 方式选项，并打开用户选中的支付步骤。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户可能无法选择或继续使用UOB EZ Pay 方式。

en.description: When a user selects UOB app payments in Midtrans UiKit checkout, this screen starts the app-based payment and handles the user's return to checkout.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it can prevent users from completing payments with UOB app payments.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Midtrans UiKit 结账中选择UOB 应用支付后，此页面会发起应用内支付并处理用户返回结账的结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户可能无法通过UOB 应用支付完成支付。

en.description: When a user selects UOB web payments in Midtrans UiKit checkout, this screen starts the web-based bank payment and handles its return result.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it can prevent users from completing payments with UOB web payments.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Midtrans UiKit 结账中选择UOB 网页支付后，此页面会发起网页银行支付并处理返回结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户可能无法通过UOB 网页支付完成支付。

en.description: When a user selects online payment redirects in Midtrans UiKit checkout, this screen loads the payment provider's page and handles its return or cancellation.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it can prevent users from completing payments with online payment redirects.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Midtrans UiKit 结账中选择在线支付跳转后，此页面会加载支付服务方页面，并处理返回或取消操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户可能无法通过在线支付跳转完成支付。

en.description: During Midtrans UiKit checkout, this screen shows shows the steps for completing the XL Tunai payment before the user continues.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it can prevent users from reviewing the XL Tunai payments information needed to continue.

zh-CN.description: 在 Midtrans UiKit 结账过程中，此页面会在用户继续操作前显示显示完成 XL Tunai 付款的步骤。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户可能无法查看继续操作所需的XL Tunai 支付信息。

en.description: When a user selects XL Tunai payments in Midtrans UiKit checkout, this screen submits the payment request and continues to its status and instructions.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it can prevent users from completing payments with XL Tunai payments.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Midtrans UiKit 结账中选择XL Tunai 支付后，此页面会提交支付请求，并继续显示状态和付款说明。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户可能无法通过XL Tunai 支付完成支付。

en.description: After a user starts XL Tunai payments in Midtrans UiKit checkout, this screen shows the payment result and the payment reference, current state, and a link to the payment instructions.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it can hide the XL Tunai payments payment result or the instructions needed to complete it.

zh-CN.description: 用户通过 Midtrans UiKit 发起XL Tunai 支付后，此页面会显示支付结果以及付款参考信息、当前状态以及付款说明入口。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户可能无法查看XL Tunai 支付的支付结果或完成付款所需的说明。

en.description: Mighty-Tech MtPay opens the web sign-in page used for account authorization.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to complete MtPay sign-in or account authorization.

zh-CN.description: Mighty-Tech 的 MtPay 会在此打开网页登录和账号授权页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过 MtPay 完成登录或账号授权。

en.description: MtPay opens the web checkout for a payment order and reads the result when the checkout returns.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to complete in-app payments through MtPay.

zh-CN.description: MtPay 会在此打开支付订单的网页收银台，并读取收银台返回的支付结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过 MtPay 完成应用内支付。

en.description: AboutLibraries opens the app's list of included software libraries and their license information. When search is enabled, users can filter the list by name.
en.disableEffect: The in-app list of used libraries and license details will not be available.

zh-CN.description: AboutLibraries 会打开应用所含软件库及其许可证信息列表；启用搜索时，用户可以按名称筛选。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用内的软件库和许可证信息列表将无法查看。

en.description: Millennial Media advertising uses this screen to display ads and handle screen changes and touch input during an ad.
en.disableEffect: Millennial Media ads and their destinations will not open.

zh-CN.description: Millennial Media 广告 SDK 使用此页面展示广告，并处理广告播放时的页面切换和触摸操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Millennial Media 广告及其跳转页面将无法打开。

en.description: This Millicast (Dolby.io) provider runs automatically as the app starts and prepares the context that Millicast live audio and video features need. It does not show a screen or handle media itself.
en.disableEffect: Millicast publishing or playback may fail to initialize, so apps that use its live streams may stop streaming.

zh-CN.description: 此 Millicast（Dolby.io）Provider 会在应用启动时自动运行，为 Millicast 实时音视频功能做好初始化准备。它本身不显示界面，也不处理媒体内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Millicast 的发布或播放可能无法初始化，依赖实时音视频的功能会无法使用。

en.description: This is part of Muxiaolin's RecorderManager video-recording library. RecorderManager opens this screen for the app's video-recording flow; it checks recording permissions, captures a clip, and returns its file location and duration when confirmed.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot use RecorderManager's video-capture screen to record and return a clip.

zh-CN.description: 这是 Muxiaolin 的 RecorderManager 视频录制库的一部分。应用的视频录制流程会打开 RecorderManager 此页面；它会检查录制权限、录制视频，并在确认后返回文件位置和时长。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用无法通过 RecorderManager 的录制页面拍摄视频并返回视频文件。

en.description: When an app opens an offer wall, the Minimob AddWall SDK prepares a campaign-specific page of sponsored offers. It checks network availability and builds the page address from the campaign information.
en.disableEffect: The offer wall and its sponsored offers will be unavailable, while the app's other screens continue to work.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开广告墙时，Minimob AddWall SDK 会准备对应推广活动的赞助优惠页面。它会检查网络连接，并根据活动信息生成页面地址。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 广告墙及其中的赞助优惠将无法使用，应用的其他页面仍可正常运行。

en.description: The Minipay Android SDK opens this login screen when an app requests Minipay sign-in. It asks for an email address and password, submits the login, and returns success, failure, or cancellation to the app.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to sign in to Minipay or continue app flows that require this login.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求登录 Minipay 时，Minipay Android SDK 会打开此登录页面。用户输入邮箱和密码后，页面会提交登录，并将成功、失败或取消的结果返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法登录 Minipay，也无法继续依赖此登录流程的应用操作。

en.description: When a merchant app requests a MinkasuPay two-factor operation, the SDK opens this Activity for the authentication step and reports the result to the app. The flow can use device biometrics for payment authentication.
en.disableEffect: Payment authentication through MinkasuPay will not complete, blocking payment flows that depend on it.

zh-CN.description: 商户应用请求 MinkasuPay 双重验证操作时，SDK 会打开此 Activity 完成身份验证，并将结果返回应用。支付验证流程可以使用设备生物识别。
zh-CN.disableEffect: MinkasuPay 支付身份验证将无法完成，依赖它的支付流程也会受阻。

en.description: Mintegral Ads opens this screen for ad-related web pages or campaign shortcuts, including links to promoted apps.
en.disableEffect: Mintegral ad pages and campaign links will not open; the app’s other features continue to work.

zh-CN.description: Mintegral Ads 会打开此页面显示广告网页或推广活动快捷页面，其中包括推广应用链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Mintegral 广告页面和推广链接将无法打开，应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: When Android reports that an app was installed, Mintegral checks whether it matches an ad campaign and records an install conversion.
en.disableEffect: Mintegral install-conversion tracking stops; the app’s other features continue to work.

zh-CN.description: Android 通知有应用安装时，Mintegral 会检查它是否与广告活动匹配，并记录安装转化。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Mintegral 的安装转化跟踪将停止，应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: Mintegral's interactive ads SDK opens this full-screen screen when a playable ad is selected. It displays the interactive ad and handles its close or timeout.
en.disableEffect: Interactive Mintegral ads will not open.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开可互动广告时，Mintegral 互动广告 SDK 会显示此全屏页面，供用户体验广告并处理关闭或超时。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Mintegral 互动广告将无法打开。

en.description: Mintegral Ads opens this screen to display a full-screen interactive interstitial ad.
en.disableEffect: Mintegral interstitial ads will not appear; the app’s other features continue to work.

zh-CN.description: Mintegral Ads 会打开此页面展示全屏互动插页广告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Mintegral 插页广告将不再显示，应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: Mintegral Ads opens this screen to play a rewarded video ad and process its reward result.
en.disableEffect: Mintegral rewarded videos will not play, and rewards for watching them will no longer be granted; other app features continue to work.

zh-CN.description: Mintegral Ads 会打开此页面播放奖励型视频广告并处理奖励结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Mintegral 奖励型视频将无法播放，观看广告也不再获得奖励；应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: Mintegral uses this service to pass ad-related download tasks to its download worker.
en.disableEffect: Mintegral ad downloads may stop; the app’s other features continue to work.

zh-CN.description: Mintegral 使用此服务将广告相关下载任务交给下载工作进程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Mintegral 广告下载可能停止，应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: lauHW’s ImageEditor opens this text-entry screen when a user adds text to an image. It lets the user enter words and choose their color, then returns the text to the editor.
en.disableEffect: The editor’s text-overlay tool cannot open, so users cannot add or change text on an image.

zh-CN.description: 用户为图片添加文字时，lauHW 的 ImageEditor 会打开此文字输入页面。用户可以输入文字并选择颜色，然后将文字返回编辑器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 编辑器的文字叠加工具无法打开，用户不能为图片添加或修改文字。

en.description: lauHW’s ImageEditor opens an image supplied by the app and offers drawing, stickers, text, mosaic, and crop tools. It returns the composed edit to the app when the user saves.
en.disableEffect: The app’s image-editing screen cannot open, so its editing flow is unavailable.

zh-CN.description: lauHW 的 ImageEditor 会打开应用传入的图片，并提供绘画、贴纸、文字、马赛克和裁剪工具。用户保存后，它会将合成后的图片返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用的图片编辑页面无法打开，图片编辑流程将无法使用。

en.description: When a scheduled Mistplay LoyaltyPlay alarm is due, this receiver uploads queued SDK event records to the analytics service. It handles an analytics flush rather than a user-facing reminder.
en.disableEffect: Queued LoyaltyPlay analytics events will no longer be uploaded; its game screens and play tracking are separate.

zh-CN.description: Mistplay LoyaltyPlay 的定时闹钟触发时，此接收器会将 SDK 缓存的事件记录上传到分析服务。它处理的是分析数据上传，而不是面向用户的提醒。
zh-CN.disableEffect: LoyaltyPlay 缓存的分析事件将不再上传；游戏页面和游戏时长记录由其他组件处理。

en.description: When a scheduled Mistplay Hex alarm requests an analytics flush, this receiver uploads queued SDK event records. It does not display a notification to the user.
en.disableEffect: Queued Mistplay analytics events will remain unsent, while notification display and game screens use separate components.

zh-CN.description: Mistplay Hex 的定时闹钟请求上传分析数据时，此接收器会发送 SDK 缓存的事件记录。它不会向用户显示通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Mistplay 缓存的分析事件将无法上传；通知显示和游戏页面由其他组件处理。

en.description: When a user taps a Mistplay push notification, this receiver opens the screen attached to the notification and records that it was opened.
en.disableEffect: Mistplay push notifications will no longer open their linked screen when tapped.

zh-CN.description: 用户点按 Mistplay 推送通知时，此接收器会打开通知关联的页面，并记录通知已打开。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 点按 Mistplay 推送通知将无法再打开其关联页面。

en.description: When a user dismisses a Mistplay push notification, this receiver records the dismissal for SDK analytics.
en.disableEffect: Mistplay will no longer record when its push notifications are dismissed.

zh-CN.description: 用户清除 Mistplay 推送通知时，此接收器会为 SDK 分析记录这次清除操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Mistplay 将不再记录推送通知何时被清除。

en.description: After a daily play session is completed, this LoyaltyPlay screen shows the streak, reward, and progress for that day.
en.disableEffect: Users will not see the daily streak and reward confirmation screen.

zh-CN.description: 完成每日游戏任务后，LoyaltyPlay 会显示当天的连续签到天数、奖励和进度。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法看到每日连续记录和奖励确认页面。

en.description: When a user starts a game offer's install flow, this LoyaltyPlay screen shows installation progress and provides a way to launch the game afterward.
en.disableEffect: The in-app game installation and launch flow may fail when LoyaltyPlay opens this screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户开始安装 LoyaltyPlay 游戏推荐中的游戏时，此页面会显示安装进度，并提供安装完成后的启动入口。
zh-CN.disableEffect: LoyaltyPlay 打开此页面时，应用内的游戏安装和启动流程可能无法继续。

en.description: When a user opens a game in the LoyaltyPlay catalog, this screen shows its details and related pages, including entry points for installation and play-tracking setup.
en.disableEffect: Users may be unable to open game details or continue related install and tracking steps.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 LoyaltyPlay 游戏目录中打开某个游戏时，此页面会显示游戏详情及相关页面，包括安装和游戏记录设置入口。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户可能无法查看游戏详情或继续相关的安装和记录设置流程。

en.description: When a user opens a game's history, this LoyaltyPlay screen displays that game's accumulated play-point history.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to view the selected game's play-point history.

zh-CN.description: 用户查看某款游戏的历史记录时，LoyaltyPlay 会显示该游戏累计的游戏积分记录。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法查看所选游戏的游戏积分历史。

en.description: When a game reaches a new LoyaltyPlay level, this screen presents the new level and its progress or reward details.
en.disableEffect: Users will not see the game level-up result and its reward details.

zh-CN.description: 游戏在 LoyaltyPlay 中升到新等级时，此页面会展示新等级以及相关进度或奖励信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法看到游戏升级结果及相关奖励信息。

en.description: When the host app opens LoyaltyPlay, this screen presents its main game catalog and navigation between game and reward pages.
en.disableEffect: The host app may fail to open the LoyaltyPlay catalog and its game or reward pages.

zh-CN.description: 宿主应用打开 LoyaltyPlay 时，此页面会显示主要游戏目录，并提供游戏和奖励页面之间的导航。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 宿主应用可能无法打开 LoyaltyPlay 游戏目录及其游戏或奖励页面。

en.description: When a user opens a LoyaltyPlay web page such as its terms or privacy page, this screen loads the supplied page inside the app.
en.disableEffect: LoyaltyPlay web pages, including terms or privacy content opened through this screen, will not be available in the app.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 LoyaltyPlay 的网页（例如服务条款或隐私页面）时，此页面会在应用内加载对应网页。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过此页面打开的 LoyaltyPlay 网页（包括服务条款或隐私内容）将无法在应用内查看。

en.description: When a user opens the LoyaltyPlay reward ledger, this screen explains the reward balance and how game activity contributes to it.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to open the LoyaltyPlay reward-ledger information screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 LoyaltyPlay 奖励账本时，此页面会说明奖励余额以及游戏活动如何计入奖励。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开 LoyaltyPlay 奖励账本说明页面。

en.description: At scheduled times, this LoyaltyPlay receiver prepares reminders that encourage users to discover a game or return to their last played game.
en.disableEffect: LoyaltyPlay's scheduled game-discovery and return reminders will stop appearing.

zh-CN.description: 到达设定时间时，此 LoyaltyPlay 接收器会准备游戏推荐提醒，鼓励用户发现新游戏或返回最近玩过的游戏。
zh-CN.disableEffect: LoyaltyPlay 的定时游戏推荐和回访提醒将不再显示。

en.description: After a user installs a game from LoyaltyPlay, this service checks when it is ready and sends a game-ready reminder.
en.disableEffect: LoyaltyPlay will not send its game-ready reminder after installation.

zh-CN.description: 用户通过 LoyaltyPlay 安装游戏后，此服务会检查游戏何时可以启动，并发送游戏已就绪的提醒。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 安装完成后，LoyaltyPlay 将不再发送游戏已就绪提醒。

en.description: After a user starts installing a game through LoyaltyPlay, this service watches for installation completion and returns the user to that game's LoyaltyPlay page.
en.disableEffect: The post-install return to the LoyaltyPlay game page and its follow-up flow may not work.

zh-CN.description: 用户通过 LoyaltyPlay 开始安装游戏后，此服务会等待安装完成，并将用户带回该游戏的 LoyaltyPlay 页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 安装完成后返回 LoyaltyPlay 游戏页面及后续流程可能无法正常工作。

en.description: When LoyaltyPlay ends a play session, this bound service sends the earned-currency result to the host app and opens the session-end reward dialog.
en.disableEffect: The host app may not receive LoyaltyPlay's session reward callback or show its session-end reward dialog.

zh-CN.description: LoyaltyPlay 结束游戏会话时，此绑定服务会把获得的奖励币结果传给宿主应用，并打开会话结束奖励对话框。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 宿主应用可能无法收到 LoyaltyPlay 的会话奖励回调，也无法显示会话结束奖励对话框。

en.description: During LoyaltyPlay setup, this service shows a help notification for allowing the SDK to appear over games, and reports when that permission is accepted.
en.disableEffect: Users may lose the in-app guidance needed to enable overlays used by LoyaltyPlay's game-tracking experience.

zh-CN.description: LoyaltyPlay 设置期间，此服务会显示帮助通知，引导用户允许 SDK 在游戏上层显示，并记录用户授予该权限的情况。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户可能无法获得启用悬浮显示所需的引导，而 LoyaltyPlay 的游戏记录体验会受到影响。

en.description: During LoyaltyPlay setup, this service shows a help notification for enabling Android Usage Access so the SDK can identify which game is being played.
en.disableEffect: Users may lose the guidance needed to enable game-usage tracking for LoyaltyPlay rewards.

zh-CN.description: LoyaltyPlay 设置期间，此服务会显示帮助通知，引导用户启用 Android 使用情况访问权限，以便 SDK 识别正在玩的游戏。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户可能无法获得启用游戏使用记录的引导，LoyaltyPlay 奖励记录会受到影响。

en.description: After a user starts installing a game through LoyaltyPlay, this service watches for installation completion and returns the user to LoyaltyPlay's game and install screens.
en.disableEffect: The post-install return to LoyaltyPlay's game and install flow may not work.

zh-CN.description: 用户通过 LoyaltyPlay 开始安装游戏后，此服务会等待安装完成，并将用户带回 LoyaltyPlay 的游戏和安装页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 安装完成后返回 LoyaltyPlay 游戏和安装流程可能无法正常工作。

en.description: When LoyaltyPlay ends a play session, this bound service sends the earned-currency result to the host app and opens the session-end reward dialog.
en.disableEffect: The host app may not receive LoyaltyPlay's session reward callback or show its session-end reward dialog.

zh-CN.description: LoyaltyPlay 结束游戏会话时，此绑定服务会把获得的奖励币结果传给宿主应用，并打开会话结束奖励对话框。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 宿主应用可能无法收到 LoyaltyPlay 的会话奖励回调，也无法显示会话结束奖励对话框。

en.description: During LoyaltyPlay setup, this service shows a help notification for allowing the SDK to appear over games, and reports when that permission is accepted.
en.disableEffect: Users may lose the in-app guidance needed to enable overlays used by LoyaltyPlay's game-tracking experience.

zh-CN.description: LoyaltyPlay 设置期间，此服务会显示帮助通知，引导用户允许 SDK 在游戏上层显示，并记录用户授予该权限的情况。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户可能无法获得启用悬浮显示所需的引导，而 LoyaltyPlay 的游戏记录体验会受到影响。

en.description: During LoyaltyPlay setup, this service shows a help notification for enabling Android Usage Access so the SDK can identify which game is being played.
en.disableEffect: Users may lose the guidance needed to enable game-usage tracking for LoyaltyPlay rewards.

zh-CN.description: LoyaltyPlay 设置期间，此服务会显示帮助通知，引导用户启用 Android 使用情况访问权限，以便 SDK 识别正在玩的游戏。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户可能无法获得启用游戏使用记录的引导，LoyaltyPlay 奖励记录会受到影响。

en.description: After a daily play session is completed, this LoyaltyPlay screen shows the streak, reward, and progress for that day.
en.disableEffect: Users will not see the daily streak and reward confirmation screen.

zh-CN.description: 完成每日游戏任务后，LoyaltyPlay 会显示当天的连续签到天数、奖励和进度。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法看到每日连续记录和奖励确认页面。

en.description: When a user opens a game in the LoyaltyPlay catalog, this screen shows its details and related pages, including entry points for installation and play-tracking setup.
en.disableEffect: Users may be unable to open game details or continue related install and tracking steps.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 LoyaltyPlay 游戏目录中打开某个游戏时，此页面会显示游戏详情及相关页面，包括安装和游戏记录设置入口。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户可能无法查看游戏详情或继续相关的安装和记录设置流程。

en.description: When a game reaches a new LoyaltyPlay level, this screen presents the new level and its progress or reward details.
en.disableEffect: Users will not see the game level-up result and its reward details.

zh-CN.description: 游戏在 LoyaltyPlay 中升到新等级时，此页面会展示新等级以及相关进度或奖励信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法看到游戏升级结果及相关奖励信息。

en.description: When a user opens a game's history, this LoyaltyPlay screen displays that game's accumulated play-point history.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to view the selected game's play-point history.

zh-CN.description: 用户查看某款游戏的历史记录时，LoyaltyPlay 会显示该游戏累计的游戏积分记录。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法查看所选游戏的游戏积分历史。

en.description: When a user starts a game offer's install flow, this LoyaltyPlay screen shows installation progress and provides a way to launch the game afterward.
en.disableEffect: The in-app game installation and launch flow may fail when LoyaltyPlay opens this screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户开始安装 LoyaltyPlay 游戏推荐中的游戏时，此页面会显示安装进度，并提供安装完成后的启动入口。
zh-CN.disableEffect: LoyaltyPlay 打开此页面时，应用内的游戏安装和启动流程可能无法继续。

en.description: When a user searches the LoyaltyPlay game catalog, this screen accepts search text and displays matching games.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to search the LoyaltyPlay game catalog.

zh-CN.description: 用户搜索 LoyaltyPlay 游戏目录时，此页面会接收搜索文字并显示匹配的游戏。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法搜索 LoyaltyPlay 游戏目录。

en.description: When a user opens installation guidance for a selected game, this screen displays the game's install tips and returns when the game is installed.
en.disableEffect: Users may not be able to view the installation guidance required by this LoyaltyPlay flow.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开所选游戏的安装指南时，此页面会显示安装提示，并在游戏安装后返回。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户可能无法查看此 LoyaltyPlay 流程所需的安装指南。

en.description: When a user opens the LoyaltyPlay reward ledger, this screen explains the reward balance and how game activity contributes to it.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to open the LoyaltyPlay reward-ledger information screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 LoyaltyPlay 奖励账本时，此页面会说明奖励余额以及游戏活动如何计入奖励。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开 LoyaltyPlay 奖励账本说明页面。

en.description: When a user opens a LoyaltyPlay web page such as its terms or privacy page, this screen loads the supplied page inside the app.
en.disableEffect: LoyaltyPlay web pages, including terms or privacy content opened through this screen, will not be available in the app.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 LoyaltyPlay 的网页（例如服务条款或隐私页面）时，此页面会在应用内加载对应网页。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过此页面打开的 LoyaltyPlay 网页（包括服务条款或隐私内容）将无法在应用内查看。

en.description: When the host app opens LoyaltyPlay, this screen presents its main game catalog and navigation between game and reward pages.
en.disableEffect: The host app may fail to open the LoyaltyPlay catalog and its game or reward pages.

zh-CN.description: 宿主应用打开 LoyaltyPlay 时，此页面会显示主要游戏目录，并提供游戏和奖励页面之间的导航。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 宿主应用可能无法打开 LoyaltyPlay 游戏目录及其游戏或奖励页面。

en.description: When a user selects a game offer, this LoyaltyPlay screen opens the selected game's details and actions.
en.disableEffect: Users may be unable to open the selected game's LoyaltyPlay details and continue its offer flow.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择游戏推荐时，此 LoyaltyPlay 页面会打开所选游戏的详情和相关操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户可能无法打开所选游戏的 LoyaltyPlay 详情或继续相关推荐流程。

en.description: After Android reports that the phone has restarted, this Mistplay Hex receiver refreshes the SDK's game-install tracking state so time tracking can resume.
en.disableEffect: Game-install tracking state may be stale after a restart, which can affect LoyaltyPlay play-time records.

zh-CN.description: Android 通知设备启动完成后，此 Mistplay Hex 接收器会刷新 SDK 的游戏安装记录状态，以便恢复时长记录。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 设备重启后，游戏安装记录状态可能过期，从而影响 LoyaltyPlay 的游戏时长记录。

en.description: When Android reports a newly installed package on older Android versions, this Mistplay Hex receiver records it as installed for game tracking.
en.disableEffect: Newly installed games may not be added to Mistplay's tracking records by this receiver.

zh-CN.description: 在较旧的 Android 版本上，系统报告新应用安装时，此 Mistplay Hex 接收器会将其记入已安装应用记录，供游戏跟踪使用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 此接收器可能无法将新安装的游戏加入 Mistplay 的跟踪记录。

en.description: When Android reports that an app has been fully uninstalled, this Mistplay Hex receiver removes that package from the game-install tracking records.
en.disableEffect: Records for uninstalled games may remain in Mistplay's local tracking data.

zh-CN.description: Android 报告应用已完全卸载时，此 Mistplay Hex 接收器会从游戏安装跟踪记录中移除该应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 已卸载游戏的记录可能继续留在 Mistplay 的本地跟踪数据中。

en.description: While a game session is being tracked, this LoyaltyPlay service displays animated floating status and reward updates over the game.
en.disableEffect: The floating play-time, progress, and reward updates will no longer appear over games, but background tracking is handled separately.

zh-CN.description: 跟踪游戏会话时，此 LoyaltyPlay 服务会在游戏画面上显示动态悬浮状态和奖励更新。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 游戏上方将不再显示悬浮时长、进度和奖励更新，但后台记录由其他组件处理。

en.description: While a tracked game is open, this LoyaltyPlay service checks app-usage events, measures play time, updates game-session progress, and sends tracking updates.
en.disableEffect: LoyaltyPlay game time and related progress or rewards will no longer be recorded.

zh-CN.description: 跟踪中的游戏打开时，此 LoyaltyPlay 服务会检查应用使用事件、统计游戏时长、更新会话进度并发送跟踪数据。
zh-CN.disableEffect: LoyaltyPlay 将不再记录游戏时长以及相关进度或奖励。

en.description: While a game session is being tracked, this LoyaltyPlay service displays animated floating status and reward updates over the game.
en.disableEffect: The floating play-time, progress, and reward updates will no longer appear over games, but background tracking is handled separately.

zh-CN.description: 跟踪游戏会话时，此 LoyaltyPlay 服务会在游戏画面上显示动态悬浮状态和奖励更新。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 游戏上方将不再显示悬浮时长、进度和奖励更新，但后台记录由其他组件处理。

en.description: While a tracked game is open, this LoyaltyPlay service checks app-usage events, measures play time, updates game-session progress, and sends tracking updates.
en.disableEffect: LoyaltyPlay game time and related progress or rewards will no longer be recorded.

zh-CN.description: 跟踪中的游戏打开时，此 LoyaltyPlay 服务会检查应用使用事件、统计游戏时长、更新会话进度并发送跟踪数据。
zh-CN.disableEffect: LoyaltyPlay 将不再记录游戏时长以及相关进度或奖励。

en.description: Alviere's alCamera package includes Mitek MiSnap capture workflows. When the app starts a configured workflow, this screen guides the user through document, face, barcode, or NFC capture and returns a result or error.
en.disableEffect: The app will not be able to complete MiSnap document or face capture, or barcode and NFC steps in the same workflow.

zh-CN.description: Alviere 的 alCamera 包含 Mitek MiSnap 采集流程。应用启动已配置的流程时，此页面会引导用户采集证件、人脸、条码或 NFC 信息，并返回结果或错误。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用将无法完成 MiSnap 证件或人脸采集，以及同一流程中的条码和 NFC 步骤。

en.description: The Xiaomi MiMo ad SDK opens this screen after an ad is tapped and loads the advertiser’s landing page in a web view.
en.disableEffect: MiMo ad landing pages will not open, while the app’s own pages remain available.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击广告后，小米 MiMo 广告 SDK 会打开此页面，并在网页视图中加载广告主的落地页。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，MiMo 广告落地页无法打开，但应用自身页面仍可使用。

en.description: When the Xiaomi MiMo ads SDK is asked to show a rewarded video, this screen plays the ad and reports completion and reward callbacks.
en.disableEffect: Rewarded videos will not open, and rewards for watching ads will no longer be granted.

zh-CN.description: 小米 MiMo 广告 SDK 收到播放激励视频的请求时，此页面会播放广告并回报播放完成和奖励结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 激励视频将无法打开，观看广告的奖励也不会再发放。

en.description: Xiaomi MiMo uses this Activity to run reward ads in mini-games. Depending on the ad, it shows playable content or a video.
en.disableEffect: Reward videos will not play, and rewards for watching ads will no longer be granted.

zh-CN.description: 小米 MiMo 会通过此界面在小游戏中播放激励广告。根据广告内容，界面会显示可互动广告或视频。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 激励视频将无法播放，观看广告后也不会再发放奖励。

en.description: The Xiaomi Mimo Ads SDK opens this Activity to play a full-screen rewarded video ad.
en.disableEffect: Xiaomi Mimo rewarded videos will not play, and rewards for watching ads will no longer be granted.

zh-CN.description: Xiaomi Mimo Ads SDK 会打开此 Activity 播放全屏激励视频广告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Xiaomi Mimo 激励视频将无法播放，观看广告也不再发放奖励。

en.description: The Xiaomi MiMo ad SDK uses this full-screen Activity for rewarded video ads and carries the ad information used during playback.
en.disableEffect: Rewarded videos will not play, and rewards for watching ads will no longer be granted.

zh-CN.description: 小米 MiMo 广告 SDK 使用此全屏页面播放激励视频广告，并携带播放所需的广告信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，激励视频无法播放，观看广告的奖励也不会发放。

en.description: Xiaomi MiMo uses this Activity for web-based ad landing pages. It handles page navigation and callbacks for app download, installation, and launch.
en.disableEffect: Web ad landing pages and their download or launch actions will stop working.

zh-CN.description: 小米 MiMo 使用此界面显示网页广告落地页，并处理页面跳转以及应用下载、安装和启动回调。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 网页广告落地页及其中的下载或启动操作将无法使用。

en.description: When a user follows a Xiaomi MiMo ad or offer link, this screen loads the destination in the SDK's in-app browser and handles web navigation and downloads.
en.disableEffect: Xiaomi MiMo ad landing pages and their download links will no longer open in the app.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开小米 MiMo 广告或推广链接时，此页面会在 SDK 的应用内浏览器中加载目标网页，并处理网页跳转和下载。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，小米 MiMo 广告落地页及其下载链接将无法在应用内打开。

en.description: MixPush's Huawei push adapter opens this activity when a Huawei notification link is tapped. It reads the notification title, text, and attached data, then passes the tap to the app.
en.disableEffect: Huawei notification taps will no longer be routed into the app.

zh-CN.description: 用户点开华为推送通知链接时，MixPush 的华为推送适配器会打开此 Activity。它读取通知标题、内容和附带数据，再把点击交给应用处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，华为推送通知的点击将无法转交给应用。

en.description: Huawei Push calls this background service when a message arrives or the device push token changes. It passes the message and token status to the app.
en.disableEffect: The app will stop receiving Huawei push messages and updated Huawei push tokens.

zh-CN.description: 收到华为推送消息或设备推送令牌更新时，华为推送会调用此后台 Service。它把消息和令牌状态转交给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用将收不到华为推送消息和更新后的华为推送令牌。

en.description: MixPush’s Meizu push adapter receives Meizu message, registration, and notification callbacks. It forwards message taps and data messages to the app and supplies the icons used by Meizu notifications.
en.disableEffect: Meizu push messages, notification taps, and registration updates will no longer reach the app.

zh-CN.description: MixPush 的魅族推送适配器会接收魅族消息、注册和通知回调。它把通知点击和透传消息交给应用，并为魅族通知提供图标。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，魅族推送消息、通知点击和注册状态更新将无法到达应用。

en.description: MixPush’s Xiaomi Mi Push adapter receives data messages, notification arrivals and taps, and registration results. It forwards those updates to the app.
en.disableEffect: Xiaomi Mi Push messages, notification taps, and registration updates will no longer reach the app.

zh-CN.description: MixPush 的小米推送适配器会接收透传消息、通知到达与点击事件以及注册结果，并将这些信息转交给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，小米推送消息、通知点击和注册状态更新将无法到达应用。

en.description: MixPush’s OPPO push adapter opens this activity for an OPPO notification link. It forwards the notification details and tap to the app, or opens the app when the link has no message data.
en.disableEffect: OPPO notification links will no longer route their tap into the app.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 OPPO 推送通知链接时，MixPush 的 OPPO 推送适配器会启动此 Activity。它把通知内容和点击交给应用处理；如果链接没有消息数据，则打开应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，OPPO 通知链接将无法把点击转交给应用。

en.description: MixPush’s Vivo push adapter receives notification taps and registration IDs from Vivo Push. It forwards the tap and device token to the app.
en.disableEffect: Vivo notification taps and push registration updates will no longer reach the app.

zh-CN.description: MixPush 的 vivo 推送适配器会接收 vivo 推送通知点击和注册令牌，并把点击事件及设备令牌转交给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，vivo 通知点击和推送注册状态将无法到达应用。

en.description: The MJDY Klevin adapter for Tencent’s ad SDK shares downloaded ad APK files with Android’s installer when someone chooses to install a promoted app.
en.disableEffect: Disabling this provider can break the ad SDK’s APK installation flow.

zh-CN.description: MJDY 的腾讯 Klevin 广告适配器会通过此文件提供程序，将下载的广告应用安装包交给 Android 安装程序。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用此提供程序可能导致广告 SDK 的应用安装流程失效。

en.description: At app startup, the ma-jian Router framework tracks app screens and loads the app's registered routes and route handlers.
en.disableEffect: Screens opened through the Router framework may stop opening because its route registrations will not be loaded.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，ma-jian 的 Router 框架会跟踪应用页面，并加载应用注册的路由及处理器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Router 框架注册的路由将无法加载，通过这些路由打开的页面可能无法使用。

en.description: When Android reports that the app has been replaced or the MapmyIndia Tracking SDK receives a broadcast, this Receiver asks the SDK to resume enabled beacon tracking.
en.disableEffect: Enabled beacon tracking may no longer resume automatically after these broadcasts.

zh-CN.description: Android 报告应用被替换或 MapmyIndia Tracking SDK 收到广播时，此 Receiver 会要求 SDK 恢复已启用的信标跟踪。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 这些广播到达后，已启用的信标跟踪可能无法再自动恢复。

en.description: When MapmyIndia Tracking needs location access, this Activity requests location, background-location, and activity-recognition permissions; approval can start beacon tracking.
en.disableEffect: The Tracking SDK cannot guide the user through the required permissions, so beacon tracking may not start.

zh-CN.description: MapmyIndia Tracking 需要位置权限时，此 Activity 会请求位置、后台位置和活动识别权限；获得授权后可启动信标跟踪。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Tracking SDK 将无法引导用户授予所需权限，因此信标跟踪可能无法启动。

en.description: When MapmyIndia Tracking beacon tracking starts, this foreground Service keeps collecting location and movement-sensor data in the background.
en.disableEffect: MapmyIndia Tracking background location collection and movement updates will stop.

zh-CN.description: MapmyIndia Tracking 信标跟踪启动后，此前台 Service 会在后台持续收集位置和运动传感器数据。
zh-CN.disableEffect: MapmyIndia Tracking 的后台位置收集和运动状态更新将停止。

en.description: When MapmyIndia Tracking receives an activity-recognition update, this Service reads the detected activities and passes them to the tracker.
en.disableEffect: MapmyIndia Tracking will no longer receive activity-recognition updates.

zh-CN.description: MapmyIndia Tracking 收到活动识别更新时，此 Service 会读取检测到的活动并传给跟踪功能。
zh-CN.disableEffect: MapmyIndia Tracking 将不再收到活动识别更新。

en.description: When Firebase delivers a push message or refreshes its registration token, KMPNotifier processes the message and can display its notification to the user.
en.disableEffect: Push messages handled by KMPNotifier will no longer be processed or displayed, and refreshed push tokens will not be delivered to the app.

zh-CN.description: Firebase 收到推送消息或更新注册令牌时，KMPNotifier 会处理消息，并可向用户显示通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: KMPNotifier 将不再处理或显示推送消息，也不会把更新后的推送令牌交给应用。

en.description: When the Azerion BlueStack ad SDK's debug screen is opened, this Activity displays its diagnostic menu and related panels.
en.disableEffect: The SDK's diagnostic screen will no longer be available.

zh-CN.description: 打开 Azerion BlueStack 广告 SDK 的调试界面时，此 Activity 会显示诊断菜单及相关面板。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后将无法打开该 SDK 的诊断界面。

en.description: When Azerion BlueStack (MNGAds) presents a native ad with an app icon and screenshots, this Activity shows the ad card and handles taps and closing.
en.disableEffect: Native ads served through Azerion BlueStack will not display.

zh-CN.description: Azerion BlueStack（MNGAds）展示带有应用图标和截图的原生广告时，此 Activity 会显示广告卡片并处理点击和关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后将无法显示 Azerion BlueStack 提供的原生广告。

en.description: When an app requests an interstitial from Azerion BlueStack (MNGAds), this Activity displays the full-screen ad and handles its clicks, completion, and close controls.
en.disableEffect: Interstitial ads from Azerion BlueStack will not display.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求 Azerion BlueStack（MNGAds）的插屏广告时，此 Activity 会显示全屏广告并处理点击、播放完成和关闭操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后将无法显示 Azerion BlueStack 的插屏广告。

en.description: When Azerion BlueStack (MNGAds) needs to play a video ad, this Activity opens a full-screen player with playback controls and closes when playback ends or fails.
en.disableEffect: Video ads that use this Azerion BlueStack player will not play.

zh-CN.description: Azerion BlueStack（MNGAds）需要播放视频广告时，此 Activity 会打开带播放控件的全屏播放器，并在播放结束或失败时关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后将无法通过 Azerion BlueStack 的此播放器播放视频广告。

en.description: After a user taps a BlueStack ad, this Activity shows its destination in an in-app browser. Store and download links can open outside the app.
en.disableEffect: BlueStack ad landing pages will not open in this in-app browser.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击 BlueStack 广告后，此 Activity 会在应用内浏览器中显示广告目标页面；应用商店和下载链接可转到应用外打开。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后将无法在此应用内浏览器中打开 BlueStack 广告落地页。

en.description: Azerion BlueStack (MNGAds) starts this Service in the background to send queued ad request and event reports on a schedule.
en.disableEffect: Queued BlueStack ad request and event reports will no longer be sent by this Service.

zh-CN.description: Azerion BlueStack（MNGAds）会在后台启动此 Service，按计划发送排队中的广告请求和事件报告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，此 Service 将不再发送排队中的 BlueStack 广告请求和事件报告。

en.description: At app startup, the MobTech provider initializes the core services that MoMo Cosmos OneLogin uses for carrier phone verification.
en.disableEffect: Automatic MobTech initialization stops, so the app's carrier phone-verification flow may fail to start.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，MobTech Provider 会初始化 MoMo Cosmos OneLogin 进行运营商手机号验证所需的核心服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: MobTech 的自动初始化将停止，应用的运营商手机号验证流程可能无法启动。

en.description: When MoMo Cosmos OneLogin requests an interactive step for MobTech phone verification, this screen presents that step to the user.
en.disableEffect: The OneLogin verification screen will not open, preventing users from completing that sign-in method.

zh-CN.description: MoMo Cosmos OneLogin 请求 MobTech 手机号验证中的交互步骤时，此页面会向用户展示相应界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: OneLogin 验证页面将无法打开，用户无法完成此登录方式。

en.description: MobFox's ad SDK opens this screen when an ad's landing page should stay inside the app. It shows the advertiser's page with back, refresh, close, and external-open controls.
en.disableEffect: MobFox ad landing pages will not open in the app; the app's other screens continue to work.

zh-CN.description: MobFox 广告 SDK 会在广告落地页需要留在应用内打开时显示此页面，并提供返回、刷新、关闭和在外部打开等控件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: MobFox 广告落地页将无法在应用内打开，应用的其他页面仍可使用。

en.description: MobFox's ad data service runs a background worker that gathers device, battery, Wi-Fi, app-use, screen, and location or network signals when available, then sends ad data periodically.
en.disableEffect: MobFox's background ad data collection and updates will stop, while the app's regular features continue.

zh-CN.description: MobFox 广告数据服务会运行后台任务，在权限允许时收集设备、电池、Wi-Fi、应用使用、屏幕以及位置或网络信息，并定期发送广告数据。
zh-CN.disableEffect: MobFox 的后台广告数据收集和更新将停止，但应用的常规功能仍可使用。

en.description: When MobFox presents a video ad, this Activity displays its video player and reports ad completion or dismissal.
en.disableEffect: MobFox will no longer be able to show its video ads in the app.

zh-CN.description: MobFox 展示视频广告时，此页面会播放广告，并报告播放完成或关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，MobFox 将无法在应用中展示视频广告。

en.description: Mobgen HALO Auth provides this account-authentication service when Android requests credentials for a HALO account.
en.disableEffect: HALO account authentication can fail, disrupting sign-in or account setup in apps that use this integration.

zh-CN.description: Android 为 HALO 账户请求凭据时，Mobgen HALO Auth 会通过此服务处理账户验证。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，HALO 账户验证可能失败，影响使用该集成的应用登录或账户设置。

en.description: The HALO Auth SDK opens this screen for Facebook sign-in, runs the Facebook login flow, and returns the account result or an error.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to complete Facebook sign-in through HALO.

zh-CN.description: HALO Auth SDK 会在进行 Facebook 登录时打开此界面，运行 Facebook 登录流程，并返回账户结果或错误。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 HALO 完成 Facebook 登录。

en.description: The HALO Auth SDK opens this screen for Google sign-in, starts Google’s account flow, and returns the sign-in result or an error.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to complete Google sign-in through HALO.

zh-CN.description: HALO Auth SDK 会在进行 Google 登录时打开此界面，启动 Google 账户流程，并返回登录结果或错误。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 HALO 完成 Google 登录。

en.description: The HALO framework starts this service for a data-sync request. It queues requests for the app’s sync worker and returns their results through the service connection.
en.disableEffect: HALO-backed data synchronization may stop, leaving app data out of date.

zh-CN.description: HALO 框架收到数据同步请求时会启动此服务。它会将请求排入应用的同步工作队列，并通过服务连接返回结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，HALO 支持的数据同步可能停止，应用中的数据可能无法及时更新。

en.description: The HALO framework runs scheduled background jobs here when their triggers or deadlines arrive, and saves jobs that should survive restarts.
en.disableEffect: Scheduled app tasks may stop running or fail to resume after a restart.

zh-CN.description: HALO 框架会在后台任务的触发条件满足或截止时间到达时，通过此服务运行任务，并保存需要跨重启保留的任务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用的计划任务可能停止运行，或在重启后无法恢复。

en.description: After Android reports that the device has finished booting, this receiver starts the HALO scheduler so saved jobs can resume.
en.disableEffect: Saved HALO jobs will not be restored after a device reboot.

zh-CN.description: Android 通知设备启动完成后，此接收器会启动 HALO 调度器，以恢复已保存的任务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 设备重启后，已保存的 HALO 任务将无法恢复。

en.description: The MobId KYC SDK opens this screen when an app starts an identity check. It first shows the verification start flow, then switches to a live video conversation when the verification session starts.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot start or complete the SDK's identity verification flow from the app.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动身份核验时，MobId KYC SDK 会打开此页面。页面先显示核验开始流程，并在核验会话启动后切换到实时视频通话。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，用户无法通过应用启动或完成该 SDK 的身份核验流程。

en.description: The MobId KYC SDK opens this camera screen when identity verification needs a photo. Users can take a verification photo or choose one from the gallery, and the screen uploads it with the current verification session.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot capture and upload a verification photo through MobId.

zh-CN.description: 身份核验需要照片时，MobId KYC SDK 会打开此相机页面。用户可以拍摄核验照片或从图库中选择照片，页面会将照片上传到当前核验会话。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，应用无法通过 MobId 拍摄并上传核验照片。

en.description: The MobiGrowing Ads SDK uses this in-app browser when someone follows an ad link; it loads the landing page and provides back and close controls.
en.disableEffect: MobiGrowing ad landing pages that use this browser will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: 用户点按广告链接后，MobiGrowing Ads SDK 会通过此应用内浏览器加载落地页，并提供返回和关闭控件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此浏览器的 MobiGrowing 广告落地页将无法打开。

en.description: This MobiGrowing ad browser adds video playback and progress controls for video-ad landing pages.
en.disableEffect: Video-ad landing pages from MobiGrowing will no longer play.

zh-CN.description: 此 MobiGrowing 广告浏览器为视频广告落地页提供视频播放和进度控件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: MobiGrowing 的视频广告落地页将无法播放。

en.description: The MobiGrowing Ads SDK uses this activity to show a full-screen interstitial ad and report when it closes.
en.disableEffect: MobiGrowing full-screen interstitial ads will not appear.

zh-CN.description: MobiGrowing Ads SDK 会通过此界面展示全屏插页广告，并在广告关闭时回报结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: MobiGrowing 的全屏插页广告将无法显示。

en.description: The MobiGrowing Ads SDK uses this activity to show an interstitial ad in a modal window and report when it closes.
en.disableEffect: MobiGrowing modal interstitial ads will not appear.

zh-CN.description: MobiGrowing Ads SDK 会通过此界面在弹出窗口中展示插页广告，并在广告关闭时回报结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: MobiGrowing 的弹出式插页广告将无法显示。

en.description: This activity displays MobiGrowing rewarded ads and handles their completion.
en.disableEffect: Rewards for watching ads will no longer be granted.

zh-CN.description: 此界面会显示 MobiGrowing 激励广告并处理广告完成状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户观看广告后将不再获得奖励。

en.description: This transparent MobiGrowing activity hosts the content layer used while a rewarded ad is displayed.
en.disableEffect: Rewards for watching ads will no longer be granted.

zh-CN.description: MobiGrowing 会通过此透明界面承载激励广告的内容层。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户观看广告后将不再获得奖励。

en.description: After a MobiGrowing ad offers an app download, this activity opens Android’s install flow and checks whether the promoted app was installed when control returns.
en.disableEffect: The ad’s app-install handoff and install-result reporting will stop working.

zh-CN.description: MobiGrowing 广告提供应用下载后，此界面会打开 Android 安装流程，并在返回时检查推广应用是否已安装。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 广告的应用安装交接和安装结果回报将无法使用。

en.description: The MobiGrowing Ads SDK uses this file provider to let Android’s installer read APKs downloaded by the SDK.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it can break installation of apps downloaded from MobiGrowing ads.

zh-CN.description: MobiGrowing Ads SDK 会通过此文件提供程序，让 Android 安装程序读取 SDK 下载的应用安装包。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，通过 MobiGrowing 广告下载的应用可能无法安装。

en.description: When a user triggers the ScrollShot shake shortcut or a scroll-shot request arrives, the library captures the current scrollable screen as a JPEG and can open the image for viewing.
en.disableEffect: Blocking the manifest receiver stops action-based launches; the built-in shake shortcut calls the capture code directly and may still work.

zh-CN.description: 用户触发 ScrollShot 摇动快捷方式或收到长截图请求时，该库会将当前可滚动页面保存为 JPEG 图片，并可打开图片供查看。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用清单中的接收器会阻止通过广播启动；内置摇动快捷方式会直接调用截图逻辑，因此仍可能正常工作。

en.description: Umeng UVerify opens this screen when the app starts one-tap phone-number sign-in; it shows the masked number, service terms, and sign-in controls.
en.disableEffect: One-tap phone-number sign-in through Umeng UVerify cannot be completed.

zh-CN.description: 应用发起手机号一键登录时，Umeng UVerify 会打开此界面，显示掩码号码、服务条款和登录控件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 Umeng UVerify 完成手机号一键登录。

en.description: Umeng UVerify opens this extra consent screen when the user must review the phone provider's privacy terms during one-tap sign-in.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot accept the required privacy terms, so one-tap phone-number sign-in through Umeng UVerify cannot complete.

zh-CN.description: 手机号一键登录需要用户确认运营商隐私条款时，Umeng UVerify 会打开此补充授权界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法确认所需的隐私条款，因此不能通过 Umeng UVerify 完成手机号一键登录。

en.description: During Umeng UVerify phone-number authentication, this Activity opens a supplied web page such as a service agreement or authentication page, with a title and back button.
en.disableEffect: Phone-number sign-in and agreement pages that use UVerify may stop opening, so the login flow can fail.

zh-CN.description: 在 Umeng UVerify 手机号认证流程中，此 Activity 会打开指定网页，例如服务协议或认证页面，并显示标题栏和返回按钮。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，依赖 UVerify 的手机号登录或协议页面可能无法打开，相关登录流程会受影响。

en.description: When MobileFuse presents a full-screen ad, this activity hosts the ad content and handles its display and close events.
en.disableEffect: MobileFuse full-screen ads that use this screen will not appear.

zh-CN.description: MobileFuse 展示全屏广告时，会通过此界面承载广告内容并处理显示和关闭事件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此界面的 MobileFuse 全屏广告将无法显示。

en.description: This is MobileFuse’s transparent full-screen ad window; it reuses the SDK’s full-screen ad display over a transparent background.
en.disableEffect: MobileFuse ads that require this transparent full-screen window will not appear.

zh-CN.description: 这是 MobileFuse 的透明全屏广告窗口，会在透明背景上显示 SDK 的全屏广告内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要此透明全屏窗口的 MobileFuse 广告将无法显示。

en.description: At app startup, this MobileFuse provider registers activity-lifecycle tracking so the ads SDK can observe when the app enters or leaves the foreground.
en.disableEffect: MobileFuse loses this automatic app-context and foreground tracking, so its lifecycle-aware ad setup will not initialize; the host app can still start.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，此 MobileFuse 提供程序会注册界面生命周期跟踪，让广告 SDK 了解应用何时进入或离开前台。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，MobileFuse 将无法通过此入口获取应用上下文和前后台状态，其生命周期相关广告设置将无法初始化；宿主应用仍可启动。

en.description: When MobileFuse displays a splash ad, this activity hosts the full-screen splash creative.
en.disableEffect: MobileFuse splash ads will not appear.

zh-CN.description: MobileFuse 展示开屏广告时，会通过此界面显示全屏广告内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: MobileFuse 开屏广告将无法显示。

en.description: MobileFuse uses this activity to present an experimental native interstitial as a full-screen ad with a close control.
en.disableEffect: MobileFuse native interstitial ads will not appear.

zh-CN.description: MobileFuse 会通过此界面展示实验性的全屏原生插页广告，并提供关闭控件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: MobileFuse 原生插页广告将无法显示。

en.description: The Mobjump (MJDY) ads SDK opens this activity to show an ad landing page inside the app after an ad link is tapped.
en.disableEffect: Mobjump ad landing pages that use this screen will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: 用户点按广告链接后，Mobjump（MJDY）广告 SDK 会打开此界面，在应用内显示广告落地页。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此界面的 Mobjump 广告落地页将无法打开。

en.description: When the Mobjump ads SDK presents a full-screen ad, this activity displays the ad view and closes when the ad is dismissed.
en.disableEffect: Mobjump full-screen ads that use this screen will no longer appear.

zh-CN.description: Mobjump 广告 SDK 展示全屏广告时，会通过此界面显示广告内容，并在广告关闭后结束界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此界面的 Mobjump 全屏广告将无法显示。

en.description: After an ad downloads an app package, this activity shows the promoted app’s name and icon with an install button.
en.disableEffect: The ad’s install confirmation screen will not appear, so the promoted app cannot be installed from this screen.

zh-CN.description: 广告下载应用安装包后，此界面会显示推广应用的名称和图标，并提供安装按钮。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 广告的安装确认界面将无法显示，用户也无法通过此界面安装推广应用。

en.description: When an ad uses a direct install step, this activity checks the downloaded app package and opens Android’s installer.
en.disableEffect: The ad’s direct APK installation handoff will not open.

zh-CN.description: 广告使用直接安装步骤时，此界面会检查下载的应用安装包并打开 Android 安装程序。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 广告的应用安装包将无法通过此界面交给 Android 安装程序。

en.description: When an ad opens a web landing page, this activity displays it in an in-app browser. Links to APK files start an app download.
en.disableEffect: Mobjump ad landing pages and their APK download links will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: 广告打开网页落地页时，此界面会在应用内浏览器中显示页面；点按 APK 链接会开始下载应用安装包。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Mobjump 广告落地页及其中的 APK 下载链接将无法打开。

en.description: The Mobjump SDK declares this file provider so files in its configured app-storage locations can be shared through Android file links.
en.disableEffect: Any file-sharing action in the app that uses this provider will fail.

zh-CN.description: Mobjump SDK 声明了此文件提供程序，可通过 Android 文件链接分享其配置的应用存储位置中的文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用中依赖此提供程序的文件分享操作将无法使用。

en.description: Mobodid NotifyLib uses this receiver when a notification action is tapped; it removes the selected notification.
en.disableEffect: A NotifyLib notification action will no longer clear its notification.

zh-CN.description: 用户点按通知操作时，Mobodid NotifyLib 会通过此接收器移除对应通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，NotifyLib 通知中的操作将无法清除对应通知。

en.description: When a scheduled NotifyLib alarm fires, this receiver starts a check for server-supplied notifications and passes the configured key.
en.disableEffect: NotifyLib notification checks will no longer run when their scheduled alarms fire.

zh-CN.description: NotifyLib 的计划闹钟触发时，此接收器会启动服务器通知检查并传递已配置的密钥。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，NotifyLib 的通知检查将不会在计划闹钟触发时运行。

en.description: After Android reports that the device has finished booting, this receiver restarts NotifyLib so scheduled notification checks can resume.
en.disableEffect: NotifyLib’s scheduled notification checks will not resume after a device reboot.

zh-CN.description: Android 通知设备启动完成后，此接收器会重新启动 NotifyLib，以恢复计划通知检查。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 设备重启后，NotifyLib 的计划通知检查将无法恢复。

en.description: When Wi-Fi or mobile connectivity changes, this receiver restarts NotifyLib’s server check if a connection is available and its interval has elapsed.
en.disableEffect: NotifyLib will not restart its notification check when connectivity returns.

zh-CN.description: Wi-Fi 或移动网络状态变化时，如果网络已连接且间隔时间已到，此接收器会重新启动 NotifyLib 的服务器检查。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 网络恢复后，NotifyLib 将不会重新启动通知检查。

en.description: When an alarm, boot, or connectivity event starts NotifyLib, this service checks its configured server and displays any returned notification. The request can include the app key and available device, phone, and location details.
en.disableEffect: NotifyLib’s server-supplied notifications and follow-up checks will stop.

zh-CN.description: 闹钟、设备启动或网络变化事件启动 NotifyLib 后，此服务会查询已配置的服务器并显示返回的通知。请求可能包含应用密钥以及可获取的设备、电话和位置信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，NotifyLib 的服务器通知及后续检查将停止。

en.description: Mobon CallAdSDK opens this activity to show the detail page for a call ad. The page forwards taps on the ad’s call link to the app’s ad integration.
en.disableEffect: Call-ad details and their call links will no longer open through this activity.

zh-CN.description: Mobon CallAdSDK 会打开此 Activity 来展示通话广告的详情页。用户点按广告中的通话链接时，此页面会把操作交给应用的广告接入部分。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，通话广告详情及其中的通话链接将无法通过此页面打开。

en.description: Mobon’s advertising SDK opens this short-lived activity when an ad is ready to open a link. After a brief pause, it opens the link in the app that handles it.
en.disableEffect: Mobon ad links will no longer launch their destination from this activity.

zh-CN.description: Mobon 广告 SDK 准备打开广告链接时会启动这个短暂运行的 Activity。稍等片刻后，它会用能够处理该链接的应用打开目标页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Mobon 广告链接将无法通过此 Activity 打开目标页面。

en.description: Mobon Tune opens this activity when one of its deep links is tapped. It launches the app and passes along the link so the app can open the requested content.
en.disableEffect: Mobon links will no longer launch the app with their link details, so content reached through those links may not open.

zh-CN.description: 用户点开 Mobon Tune 的深层链接时，此 Activity 会启动应用并传入链接，让应用打开相应内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Mobon 深层链接将无法携带链接信息启动应用，通过这些链接访问的内容可能无法打开。

en.description: When the MobSpace MobScanner SDK starts a document scan, this screen opens the camera with capture, flash, gallery, and next-page controls.
en.disableEffect: The document-scanning camera cannot open, so users cannot start a scan through MobScanner.

zh-CN.description: MobSpace MobScanner SDK 开始扫描文档时，此界面会打开相机，并提供拍摄、闪光灯、相册和下一页控件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，文档扫描相机无法打开，用户不能通过 MobScanner 开始扫描。

en.description: After a page is photographed, the MobSpace MobScanner SDK shows this full-screen preview and lets the user retake or accept the image.
en.disableEffect: Users lose the review step needed to retake or accept a captured page, interrupting the scan flow.

zh-CN.description: 拍摄页面后，MobSpace MobScanner SDK 会显示此全屏预览，让用户重新拍摄或确认图片。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，用户将无法在扫描流程中检查图片并选择重拍或确认，扫描过程会中断。

en.description: After the MobScanner SDK receives photos of an ID card's front and optional back, this screen previews them and combines them into one saved page when confirmed.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to build and save a combined ID-card image through this screen.

zh-CN.description: MobScanner SDK 收到身份证正面和可选反面的照片后，此界面会预览照片，并在用户确认时将其合并保存为一页。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此界面合并并保存身份证图像。

en.description: When MobScanner opens document pages for editing, this screen lets users rotate, crop, adjust color, and apply filters before saving.
en.disableEffect: Users will lose this document image editing step and cannot save edits through it.

zh-CN.description: MobScanner 打开待编辑的文档页面时，此界面允许用户旋转、裁剪、调整颜色和应用滤镜后再保存。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法使用此界面编辑并保存文档图像。

en.description: After a scan image is captured or selected, the MobSpace MobScanner SDK opens this editor for cropping, rotating, filtering, and saving the page.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot edit or save scanned pages through the MobScanner flow.

zh-CN.description: 扫描或选择图片后，MobSpace MobScanner SDK 会打开此编辑器，让用户裁剪、旋转、滤镜处理并保存页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，用户无法通过 MobScanner 流程编辑或保存扫描页面。

en.description: Mock API Server (Jiang Junmin) connects the app to its local mock server automatically at startup. The server supplies mock responses for app requests configured to use it.
en.disableEffect: App requests or test screens that rely on this local mock server may stop receiving their mock responses.

zh-CN.description: Mock API Server（Jiang Junmin）会在应用启动时自动连接本地模拟服务器。设置为使用此服务器的应用请求会从中取得模拟响应。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此本地模拟服务器的应用请求或测试界面可能无法再取得模拟响应。

en.description: Mock API Server (Jiang Junmin) runs a local mock-response server when its service starts and stops that server when the service is destroyed. Its startup provider connects to it when the app launches.
en.disableEffect: App requests configured to use this local mock server may fail or lose their mock responses.

zh-CN.description: Mock API Server（Jiang Junmin）会在 Service 启动时运行本地模拟响应服务器，并在 Service 结束时停止。应用启动时，其 Provider 会连接此服务。
