en.description: When a user chooses to share shipments, the Mojro Partner Android SDK shows the shipment count and a QR code containing the trip information.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot share shipments through this QR-code screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择分享货件时，Mojro Partner Android SDK 会显示货件数量和包含行程信息的二维码。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此二维码页面分享货件。

en.description: The Mojro Partner Android SDK opens this home screen for a signed-in partner, refreshes trip information, and shows the partner's trips.
en.disableEffect: The partner trip home screen will not open.

zh-CN.description: Mojro Partner Android SDK 会为已登录的合作伙伴打开此主页、刷新行程信息并显示其行程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 合作伙伴的行程主页将无法打开。

en.description: When the Mojro Partner Android SDK requests a scan, this screen reads a barcode and returns the scanned text to the calling screen.
en.disableEffect: Barcode-based shipment lookup or entry will not work.

zh-CN.description: Mojro Partner Android SDK 请求扫码时，此页面会读取条码并把扫描结果返回给上一页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 基于条码的货件查询或录入将无法使用。

en.description: When a partner opens a shipment in a trip, the Mojro Partner Android SDK shows its address, shipment actions, and any required order details. Users can mark the shipment complete or record that it was not delivered.
en.disableEffect: Partners lose the shipment details and delivery-status actions needed to complete trip work.

zh-CN.description: 合作伙伴打开行程中的货件时，Mojro Partner Android SDK 会显示地址、货件操作和所需订单信息；用户可以标记已送达或记录未送达。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 合作伙伴将无法查看货件详情或更新配送状态。

en.description: For an order in a shipment, the Mojro Partner Android SDK shows invoice and package details, accepts delivery information and proof documents, and uploads captured files.
en.disableEffect: Partners cannot record order-level delivery details or upload their proof documents.

zh-CN.description: 对于货件中的订单，Mojro Partner Android SDK 会显示发票和包裹信息，接收配送记录与凭证，并上传拍摄的文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 合作伙伴将无法记录订单级配送信息或上传凭证。

en.description: When a shipment workflow requests a proof photo, the Mojro Partner Android SDK opens a camera screen, captures the image, and returns it to the calling screen.
en.disableEffect: Partners cannot take shipment proof photos through the SDK camera.

zh-CN.description: 货件流程需要拍摄凭证照片时，Mojro Partner Android SDK 会打开相机页面、拍摄图像并将其返回给上一页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 合作伙伴将无法通过 SDK 相机拍摄货件凭证照片。

en.description: When a partner opens a trip, the Mojro Partner Android SDK displays its shipments and provides shipment search, filters, map access, and trip-expense screens.
en.disableEffect: Partners cannot view or manage the shipments in a trip through this screen.

zh-CN.description: 合作伙伴打开行程时，Mojro Partner Android SDK 会显示其中的货件，并提供搜索、筛选、地图和行程费用页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 合作伙伴将无法通过此页面查看或管理行程中的货件。

en.description: When the MobGame GameSDKLite Android SDK receives an installation-referrer message, it saves the referrer value for the SDK.
en.disableEffect: The SDK will no longer retain installation-referrer information.

zh-CN.description: MobGame GameSDKLite Android SDK 收到安装来源消息时，会为 SDK 保存其中的来源值。
zh-CN.disableEffect: SDK 将不再保存安装来源信息。

en.description: MoliHuan PathSelector opens this screen when an app feature asks the user to choose folders or file paths. It displays the path picker and returns the selected paths to the app.
en.disableEffect: Features that use this picker will no longer let the user choose folders or file paths.

zh-CN.description: 应用功能需要用户选择文件夹或路径时，MoliHuan PathSelector 会打开此页面。它显示路径选择界面，并把选中的路径返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，使用此选择器的功能将无法让用户选择文件夹或路径。

en.description: MoliHuan PathSelector opens this screen when an app feature asks the user to choose folders or file paths. It displays the path picker and keeps the selection available to the app.
en.disableEffect: Features that use this picker will no longer let the user choose folders or file paths.

zh-CN.description: 应用功能需要用户选择文件夹或路径时，MoliHuan PathSelector 会打开此页面。它显示路径选择界面，并保存用户的选择供应用使用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，使用此选择器的功能将无法让用户选择文件夹或路径。

en.description: When the Moloco Android SDK displays an interactive ad, this Activity shows it full screen and handles its orientation and close controls.
en.disableEffect: Interactive ads using this renderer will not display.

zh-CN.description: Moloco Android SDK 展示互动广告时，此页面会全屏显示广告并处理屏幕方向和关闭操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此渲染器的互动广告将无法显示。

en.description: When the Moloco Android SDK presents a static ad, this Activity shows the ad full screen and handles ad taps or closing.
en.disableEffect: Static ads using this renderer will not display.

zh-CN.description: Moloco Android SDK 展示静态广告时，此页面会全屏显示广告并处理点击或关闭操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此渲染器的静态广告将无法显示。

en.description: When the Moloco Android SDK displays a web-based ad in full-screen form, this Activity shows the ad and handles its close and back controls.
en.disableEffect: Full-screen web-based ads using this renderer will not open.

zh-CN.description: Moloco Android SDK 以全屏形式展示网页广告时，此页面会显示广告并处理关闭和返回操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此渲染器的全屏网页广告将无法打开。

en.description: When the Moloco Android SDK presents a video ad, this Activity plays it full screen and closes when the ad finishes or is dismissed.
en.disableEffect: Video ads using this renderer will not display.

zh-CN.description: Moloco Android SDK 展示视频广告时，此页面会全屏播放广告，并在播放结束或关闭后退出。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此渲染器的视频广告将无法显示。

en.description: When Firebase delivers a MoMagic Android push message, this Service processes its payload and may display the notification.
en.disableEffect: MoMagic push messages delivered through this Firebase service will not be handled.

zh-CN.description: Firebase 向 MoMagic Android 推送 SDK 送达消息时，此服务会处理消息内容并可能显示通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过此 Firebase 服务送达的 MoMagic 推送消息将不再处理。

en.description: When a MoMagic notification opens a web link, this Activity displays the linked page inside the app.
en.disableEffect: Web pages linked from MoMagic notifications will not open inside the app.

zh-CN.description: MoMagic 通知打开网页链接时，此页面会在应用内显示链接页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: MoMagic 通知中的网页将无法在应用内打开。

en.description: When a user taps a MoMagic notification link or action button, this Receiver follows the requested action and records the notification click.
en.disableEffect: MoMagic notification links and action buttons will stop working.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击 MoMagic 通知中的链接或操作按钮时，此接收器会执行相应操作并记录点击。
zh-CN.disableEffect: MoMagic 通知中的链接和操作按钮将无法使用。

en.description: When a user dismisses a MoMagic notification, this Receiver clears it and sends the SDK a dismissal event.
en.disableEffect: MoMagic will stop recording when its notifications are dismissed.

zh-CN.description: 用户清除 MoMagic 通知时，此接收器会移除通知并向 SDK 发送清除事件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: MoMagic 将不再记录通知被清除的情况。

en.description: When MoMagic needs notification access, this Activity checks the Android notification permission and asks the user if it has not been granted.
en.disableEffect: The MoMagic permission prompt will not appear, so its notifications may remain unavailable without permission.

zh-CN.description: MoMagic 需要通知权限时，此页面会检查 Android 通知权限，并在尚未授权时向用户发起请求。
zh-CN.disableEffect: MoMagic 的权限请求页面将不会显示；如果尚未授权，其通知可能无法使用。

en.description: When a user opens a MoMagic notification, this Activity routes the tap to the app, a web page, or a phone action specified by the notification.
en.disableEffect: Tapping a MoMagic notification will no longer open its intended destination.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 MoMagic 通知时，此页面会根据通知内容跳转到应用、网页或拨号操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 点击 MoMagic 通知后将无法打开其指定目标。

en.description: When Xiaomi Push delivers a notification or pass-through message, this Receiver passes the message to MoMagic for notification processing.
en.disableEffect: MoMagic notifications arriving through Xiaomi Push will not be processed.

zh-CN.description: 小米推送送达通知或透传消息时，此接收器会把消息交给 MoMagic 处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过小米推送送达的 MoMagic 通知将不再处理。

en.description: When Google delivers a push-receive broadcast, this Receiver processes the MoMagic message and queues notification work.
en.disableEffect: MoMagic push messages delivered through this Google broadcast path will not be processed.

zh-CN.description: Google 送达推送接收广播时，此接收器会处理 MoMagic 消息并安排通知任务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过此 Google 广播路径送达的 MoMagic 推送消息将不再处理。

en.description: Momo XEngine’s face editor opens this full-screen editor so users can adjust a 3D character’s appearance and save or discard the changes.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open or save character-appearance changes through this editor.

zh-CN.description: 陌陌 XEngine 面部编辑功能会打开此全屏界面，让用户调整 3D 角色外观并保存或放弃修改。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此编辑器打开或保存角色外观修改。

en.description: When a Momo XEngine screen needs text entry, this screen shows a keyboard-backed text box and passes the edited text back to that screen.
en.disableEffect: Text fields in XEngine screens may stop accepting input.

zh-CN.description: 陌陌 XEngine 页面需要输入文字时，此界面会显示带键盘的文本框，并将修改后的文字传回页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: XEngine 页面中的文本框可能无法继续输入。

en.description: During a MoneyKit Connect account-linking or relinking session, this Activity opens the supplied bank-connection page and handles the authorization return link.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot complete bank-account linking through MoneyKit Connect.

zh-CN.description: MoneyKit Connect 进行账户关联或重新关联时，此页面会打开银行连接页面并处理授权后的返回链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 MoneyKit Connect 完成银行账户关联。

en.description: During app startup, the MongoDB Stitch Android SDK uses this provider to initialize Stitch and, when app resources specify it, its default app client.
en.disableEffect: App features that use MongoDB Stitch may fail because the SDK or default client was not initialized.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，MongoDB Stitch Android SDK 会通过此提供器初始化 Stitch；如果应用资源中配置了默认客户端，也会一并初始化。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用 MongoDB Stitch 的应用功能可能因 SDK 或默认客户端未初始化而失败。

en.description: At app startup, the MongoDB Stitch local-database integration registers for low-battery and memory-pressure events and forwards them to database listeners.
en.disableEffect: The local database may not respond to low battery or memory pressure, though ordinary database operations can continue.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，MongoDB Stitch 本地数据库集成会监听低电量和内存压力事件，并将其转发给数据库监听器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 本地数据库可能无法响应低电量或内存压力，但普通数据库操作仍可继续。

en.description: ZhangQinhao's MoPermission library opens this Activity when an app requests normal or special permissions; it explains the request, launches Android's permission prompt or Settings, and returns the granted-permission list.
en.disableEffect: The MoPermission request flow cannot return permission results, so features that need those permissions cannot use them through this library.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求普通或特殊权限时，ZhangQinhao 的 MoPermission 权限库会打开此 Activity；它说明权限用途、启动 Android 权限提示或系统设置，并返回已授予权限列表。
zh-CN.disableEffect: MoPermission 无法返回权限申请结果，因此依赖这些权限的应用功能无法通过此库使用。

en.description: The Monri Android SDK opens this screen to confirm a card, direct, or Google Pay transaction; it can show a bank authorization page and returns the payment result to the app.
en.disableEffect: Customers cannot confirm a Monri payment or complete a required bank-authorization step.

zh-CN.description: Monri Android SDK 会打开此页面确认银行卡、直接支付或 Google Pay 交易；页面可显示银行授权步骤，并把支付结果返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 客户将无法确认 Monri 支付或完成所需的银行授权步骤。

en.description: The 7moor Visitor IM SDK starts this service when a support conversation connects. It maintains a WebSocket connection to receive live messages and session updates.
en.disableEffect: Live support messages and session updates may stop while the conversation is open.

zh-CN.description: 客服会话连接时，7moor 访客客服 SDK 会启动此服务。它通过 WebSocket 连接接收实时消息和会话状态更新。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 会话打开期间，实时客服消息和会话状态更新可能会停止。

en.description: Android calls this provider during app startup to initialize the 7moor v7 Visitor SDK. It also supplies the SDK's private file-sharing path for support attachments.
en.disableEffect: The SDK may miss startup initialization, and file sharing for support attachments may fail.

zh-CN.description: Android 会在应用启动时调用此内容提供程序，以初始化 7moor v7 访客 SDK。它还为客服附件提供应用私有的文件共享路径。
zh-CN.disableEffect: SDK 可能无法完成启动初始化，客服附件的文件共享也可能失效。

en.description: The 7moor v7 Visitor SDK starts this service during an active visitor session. It maintains a WebSocket connection for live support messages and reconnects when network access returns.
en.disableEffect: The app may stop receiving real-time 7moor support messages and connection updates.

zh-CN.description: 7moor v7 访客 SDK 会在访客会话期间启动此服务。它通过 WebSocket 连接收取实时客服消息，并在网络恢复后重新连接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用可能无法继续接收 7moor 实时客服消息和连接状态更新。

en.description: MoPub opens this in-app browser for an ad’s destination page, with basic back, forward, and refresh controls.
en.disableEffect: MoPub ad landing pages will not open in the app; the app’s other features continue to work.

zh-CN.description: MoPub 会通过此应用内浏览器打开广告目标网页，并提供基本的前进、后退和刷新操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: MoPub 广告落地页将无法在应用内打开，应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: MoPub opens this screen when users need to review or change their advertising privacy choice.
en.disableEffect: The privacy-choice dialog cannot open or save a choice, so an app that requires this consent step may not complete it.

zh-CN.description: 用户需要查看或更改广告隐私选项时，MoPub 会打开此页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 隐私选项对话框将无法打开或保存选择，因此要求完成此同意步骤的应用可能无法完成该流程。

en.description: MoPub opens this screen to display a full-screen HTML ad or interstitial.
en.disableEffect: MoPub full-screen ads will not appear; the app’s other features continue to work.

zh-CN.description: MoPub 会打开此页面显示全屏 HTML 广告或插页广告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: MoPub 全屏广告将不再显示，应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: The MoPub (Twitter) Android ads SDK opens this Activity when it is ready to show a full-screen ad. It displays the ad and handles its playback and dismissal.
en.disableEffect: MoPub full-screen ads will not open, while the app's other screens can still work.

zh-CN.description: MoPub（Twitter）Android 广告 SDK 准备展示全屏广告时会打开此 Activity。它负责显示广告并处理播放和关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，MoPub 全屏广告无法打开，应用的其他页面仍可使用。

en.description: MoPub opens this screen to display an interactive web ad that can respond to taps and other ad actions.
en.disableEffect: MoPub interactive ads will not open; the app’s other features continue to work.

zh-CN.description: MoPub 会打开此页面展示可响应点击和其他广告操作的互动网页广告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: MoPub 互动广告将无法打开，应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: MoPub opens this screen to play video within an interactive ad and manage playback as the screen changes.
en.disableEffect: MoPub interactive-ad videos will not play; the app’s other features continue to work.

zh-CN.description: MoPub 会打开此页面播放互动广告中的视频，并在页面状态变化时管理播放。
zh-CN.disableEffect: MoPub 互动广告中的视频将无法播放，应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: MoPub opens this screen for a rewarded interactive ad and tracks the viewing time and ad interactions.
en.disableEffect: Rewarded MoPub ads will not open, and rewards for watching them will no longer be granted; other app features continue to work.

zh-CN.description: MoPub 会打开此页面展示奖励型互动广告，并记录观看时长和广告互动。
zh-CN.disableEffect: MoPub 奖励型广告将无法打开，观看广告也不再获得奖励；应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: MoPub Reference Network starts this Activity to show a full-screen reference ad. It displays the supplied ad content or plays the video for a rewarded ad.
en.disableEffect: These full-screen ads will not open, and rewards for watching rewarded ads will no longer be granted.

zh-CN.description: MoPub Reference Network 会启动此 Activity 来展示全屏参考广告。它显示提供的广告内容，或播放激励广告的视频。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，这些全屏广告无法打开，观看激励广告也将不再获得奖励。

en.description: Mori Atsushi's Katalog UI catalog library opens this Activity when its catalog screen is requested. It lets users browse UI examples registered by the app.
en.disableEffect: The Katalog UI catalog will not open, but the app's regular screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: Mori Atsushi 的 Katalog UI 目录库在应用请求打开目录页时启动此 Activity。用户可以浏览应用注册的界面示例。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，Katalog 界面目录无法打开，应用的常规页面仍可使用。

en.description: Moyasar's official Android payment SDK opens this Activity when a card payment requires 3-D Secure verification. It loads the verification page and returns the result to the payment flow.
en.disableEffect: Card payments that require 3-D Secure verification may fail or be left incomplete.

zh-CN.description: Moyasar 官方 Android 支付 SDK 在银行卡支付需要 3-D Secure 验证时打开此 Activity。它会加载验证页面，并将验证结果返回支付流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要 3-D Secure 验证的银行卡支付可能会失败或无法完成。

en.description: Moyasar's official Android payment SDK opens this Activity to collect card details and submit a payment from its payment sheet. If the payment needs 3-D Secure, it opens the card-verification screen and returns the payment result.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to complete payments through Moyasar's payment sheet.

zh-CN.description: Moyasar 官方 Android 支付 SDK 会打开此 Activity，让用户在支付页面填写银行卡信息并提交付款。如果支付需要 3-D Secure 验证，它还会打开银行卡验证页面并返回支付结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 Moyasar 支付页面完成付款。

en.description: CommonPush (Moyun365) handles Huawei push registration, messages, connection status and notification taps. It saves the Huawei registration token and sends event details to the library's registered app callbacks.
en.disableEffect: Huawei push registration, messages and notification-tap events will no longer reach CommonPush.

zh-CN.description: CommonPush（Moyun365）处理华为推送注册、消息、连接状态和通知点击事件。它会保存华为推送令牌，并将事件信息交给库中已注册的应用回调。
zh-CN.disableEffect: CommonPush 将不再收到华为推送注册、消息和通知点击事件。

en.description: CommonPush (Moyun365) receives Xiaomi push messages, notification taps and registration or command results. It records message and topic details and successful registration information for the library.
en.disableEffect: Xiaomi push messages, taps and registration callbacks will no longer be processed by CommonPush.

zh-CN.description: CommonPush（Moyun365）接收小米推送消息、通知点击以及注册或命令结果。它会记录消息和主题信息，以及成功的注册信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: CommonPush 将不再处理小米推送消息、通知点击和注册回调。

en.description: CommonPush (Moyun365) handles Vivo push registration and notification-tap callbacks. When a notice is tapped, it reads the destination information carried with that notice.
en.disableEffect: Vivo push registration and notification-tap callbacks will no longer be processed by CommonPush.

zh-CN.description: CommonPush（Moyun365）处理 vivo 推送注册和通知点击回调。用户点击通知时，它会读取通知携带的目标信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: CommonPush 将不再处理 vivo 推送注册和通知点击回调。

en.description: CommonUI (Moyun365) opens a supplied set of photos in a full-screen viewer. The user can swipe between images, see the current position and close the viewer with Back.
en.disableEffect: The app's full-screen multi-photo viewing screen will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: CommonUI（Moyun365）会以全屏方式打开一组照片。用户可以左右切换、查看当前位置，并通过返回键关闭查看器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用的全屏多图查看界面将无法打开。

en.description: CommonUI (Moyun365) shows device photos grouped into albums for selection and preview. It can also open the camera, optionally crop a new photo and return the selected images to the app.
en.disableEffect: The app's album, photo-selection and camera-pick screen will no longer be available.

zh-CN.description: CommonUI（Moyun365）按相册展示设备中的照片，供用户选择和预览。它也可以打开相机、按需裁剪新拍的照片，并将所选图片返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用的相册、选图和拍照选择界面将无法使用。

en.description: CommonUI (Moyun365) uses this shared image-picker screen to set the status-bar appearance and handle photo-picker permissions and results. It does not provide its own photo grid.
en.disableEffect: This standalone support entry will not open; the library's separately registered chooser, preview and crop screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: CommonUI（Moyun365）通过此共享图片选择界面设置状态栏样式，并处理选图权限和结果。它本身不展示照片网格。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 此独立辅助入口将无法打开；库中单独注册的选图、预览和裁剪界面仍可使用。

en.description: When the photo picker requests cropping, CommonUI (Moyun365) displays the selected photo and saves a cropped copy using the app's configured size and shape. It returns the cropped image as the selection.
en.disableEffect: Photo selections that require cropping will no longer complete through this screen.

zh-CN.description: 图片选择流程需要裁剪时，CommonUI（Moyun365）会显示所选照片，并按应用设置的尺寸和形状保存裁剪副本。裁剪后的图片会作为选图结果返回。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要裁剪的图片将无法通过此界面完成选择。

en.description: CommonUI (Moyun365) lets users review photos in a multi-image selection, change which photos are selected and optionally keep original quality. It returns the updated selection when the user confirms or goes back.
en.disableEffect: Users will lose the photo review and selection screen in the multi-image picker.

zh-CN.description: CommonUI（Moyun365）允许用户在多图选择中预览照片、调整所选图片，并可选择保留原图画质。确认或返回时，它会交回更新后的选择结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 多图选择流程中的照片预览和调整界面将无法使用。

en.description: CommonUI (Moyun365) previews the selected photos and lets the user remove a photo from the current selection. The user can swipe between images before returning the remaining choices.
en.disableEffect: Users will no longer be able to review and remove photos in this selection screen.

zh-CN.description: CommonUI（Moyun365）预览已选照片，并允许用户从当前选择中移除照片。返回前，用户可以在图片之间切换。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在此选图界面预览并移除照片。

en.description: CommonUI (Moyun365) opens a photo selected from a nine-grid image view in a full-screen viewer. The user can swipe through the supplied images and close the animated viewer with Back.
en.disableEffect: Photos opened from the app's nine-grid view will no longer have this full-screen viewer.

zh-CN.description: CommonUI（Moyun365）会将九宫格中选中的照片放入全屏查看器。用户可以切换图片，并通过返回键关闭带动画的查看界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用九宫格中的照片将无法通过此全屏查看器打开。

en.description: CommonUtil (Moyun365) shows a confirmation dialog when an app needs the user to change a permission in system settings. Confirming opens the app's Android settings page and returns a result when the user comes back.
en.disableEffect: The permission-recovery prompt and its return to Android settings will not work.

zh-CN.description: CommonUtil（Moyun365）在应用需要用户前往系统设置调整权限时显示确认对话框。确认后会打开该应用的 Android 设置页，并在用户返回时交回结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 权限处理提示及跳转到 Android 设置的流程将无法使用。

en.description: In a debug version of the app, this mParticle Inspector provider sets up the developer inspection panel at startup. Shaking the device can open a panel for viewing mParticle SDK activity.
en.disableEffect: The mParticle debugging panel will not appear, while the app's normal features continue to work.

zh-CN.description: 在应用的调试版本启动时，此 mParticle Inspector Provider 会设置开发者检查面板。摇晃设备可以打开面板查看 mParticle SDK 的活动。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，mParticle 调试面板不会显示，应用的常规功能仍可使用。

en.description: After the device restarts, Android triggers this mParticle Skyhook location receiver. If monitoring was enabled before the restart, it resumes watching campaign locations in the background.
en.disableEffect: Skyhook location monitoring will not automatically resume after a device restart.

zh-CN.description: 设备重启后，Android 会触发此 mParticle Skyhook 定位 Receiver。如果重启前已启用监测，它会在后台恢复对活动地点的关注。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，设备重启时 Skyhook 定位监测不会自动恢复。

en.description: When the device enters or leaves a location used by a Skyhook campaign, this mParticle service handles the background location alert.
en.disableEffect: Skyhook will no longer handle these background campaign-area alerts.

zh-CN.description: 设备进入或离开 Skyhook 活动使用的地点时，此 mParticle Service 会处理相应的后台位置提醒。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，Skyhook 将不再处理这些后台活动区域提醒。

en.description: When the app enables ms-square DebugOverlay, this service shows an optional diagnostics overlay and its control notification. The overlay can display performance and log information for developers.
en.disableEffect: The developer diagnostics overlay will not work, while the app's regular screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: 应用启用 ms-square DebugOverlay 时，此 Service 会显示可选的诊断浮层和控制通知。开发者可以在浮层中查看性能和日志信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，开发者诊断浮层将无法使用，应用的常规页面仍可访问。

en.description: At app startup, this provider prepares the official µSurveys survey SDK to load and save settings for in-app questionnaires. The SDK can then show surveys that the app starts in response to events.
en.disableEffect: MuSurveys questionnaires and their saved settings may fail to load or work correctly.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，此 Provider 会为 µSurveys 官方问卷 SDK 做好准备，使其能够加载并保存应用内问卷的设置。之后，SDK 可以显示应用因特定事件而启动的问卷。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，MuSurveys 问卷及其保存的配置可能无法正常加载或使用。

en.description: When the app starts a µSurveys questionnaire for an event, this Activity displays the survey form and handles the user’s answers and dismissal.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to open or complete µSurveys questionnaires in the app.

zh-CN.description: 应用为某个事件启动 µSurveys 问卷时，此 Activity 会显示问卷并处理用户的回答和关闭操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在应用中打开或完成 µSurveys 问卷。

en.description: Mutual Mobile’s Barricade2 local mock-server library opens this screen when the app launches its mock settings. It shows configured API endpoints and saved response options, with a control for the mock-response delay.
en.disableEffect: Developers lose this mock-settings screen, and an app that still tries to open it may fail at that point.

zh-CN.description: Mutual Mobile 的 Barricade2 本地模拟服务器库会在应用打开模拟设置时显示此页面。页面列出已配置的 API 接口和模拟响应选项，并可调整模拟响应的延迟。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 开发者将无法打开此模拟设置页面；如果应用仍尝试启动它，该操作可能失败。

en.description: Mutual Mobile’s Barricade mock-response library opens this panel when its optional shake shortcut detects a shake. The panel lists configured API endpoints, lets developers choose a saved response, and provides a setting for the overall response delay.
en.disableEffect: The shake shortcut can no longer open the mock-response panel, and an app that still tries to launch it may fail.

zh-CN.description: Mutual Mobile 的 Barricade 模拟响应库会在可选的摇一摇快捷操作检测到晃动时打开此面板。面板列出已配置的 API 接口，供开发者选择已保存的响应并调整整体响应延迟。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 摇一摇快捷操作将无法打开模拟响应面板；如果应用仍尝试启动该页面，该操作可能失败。

en.description: Mux Spaces’ real-time video SDK binds this foreground Service when screen sharing starts after Android’s screen-capture prompt is approved. It keeps the shared-screen capture running and displays a notification that the screen is being shared.
en.disableEffect: Screen sharing in Mux Spaces calls will not start.

zh-CN.description: Android 的屏幕采集授权通过后，Mux Spaces 实时视频 SDK 会在开始屏幕共享时绑定此 Service。它让共享屏幕的采集持续运行，并显示正在共享屏幕的通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Mux Spaces 通话中的屏幕共享将无法启动。

en.description: The About Page Library by Aman Verma shows its about screen when opened, with configured app information and links.
en.disableEffect: The About page and its information links will not be available.

zh-CN.description: Aman Verma 的 About Page Library 会在应用打开此页面时显示关于页面，其中包含已配置的应用信息和链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用的关于页面及其中的信息链接将无法使用。

en.description: myTarget opens this screen for full-screen interstitial ads, app wall content, and ad landing pages. It also shows a web page when an ad links to one.
en.disableEffect: myTarget ads and their landing pages will not open.

zh-CN.description: myTarget 使用此页面展示全屏插屏广告、应用墙内容和广告落地页。广告包含网页链接时，此页面也会显示相应网页。
zh-CN.disableEffect: myTarget 广告及其落地页将无法打开。

en.description: The myTarget Ads SDK uses this screen to display an ad and forward screen lifecycle changes to its ad engine.
en.disableEffect: myTarget ads will not appear; the app’s other features continue to work.

zh-CN.description: myTarget Ads SDK 使用此页面展示广告，并将页面生命周期变化传递给广告引擎。
zh-CN.disableEffect: myTarget 广告将不再显示，应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: The myTarget ads SDK uses this provider to initialize itself automatically when the app starts, unless the app disables that startup option. It prepares the SDK to load ads.
en.disableEffect: myTarget will not initialize automatically, so its ads will not be ready unless the app starts the SDK another way.

zh-CN.description: myTarget 广告 SDK 会在应用启动时通过此提供程序自动初始化，除非应用关闭了自动启动选项；初始化后即可加载广告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: myTarget 将不会自动初始化；除非应用通过其他方式启动 SDK，否则其广告无法加载。

en.description: When the host app opens Catwalk's virtual fashion assistant, this screen loads the styling session and presents outfit ideas with color, size, similar-item, and purchase options.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, the Catwalk styling and product-discovery screen cannot open.

zh-CN.description: 宿主应用打开 Catwalk 虚拟时尚助手时，此界面会载入搭配会话，并展示穿搭建议以及颜色、尺码、相似商品和购买选项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Catwalk 的搭配和商品发现界面将无法打开。

en.description: When an app starts OpenPass's Android TV sign-in flow, this Activity presents the authentication screen and returns the resulting tokens or an error to the app.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents OpenPass sign-in from completing, so features that require that account cannot authenticate.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动 OpenPass 的 Android TV 登录流程时，此 Activity 会显示认证界面，并把生成的令牌或错误结果返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，OpenPass 登录无法完成，依赖该账户的功能也无法通过认证。

en.description: During Mypoolin Payments PG checkout, this screen loads the hosted payment page and returns the merchant callback result after payment or cancellation.
en.disableEffect: Mypoolin PG checkout cannot display its payment page or return a transaction result.

zh-CN.description: 使用 Mypoolin Payments PG 结账时，此界面会加载托管的支付页面，并在支付或取消后返回商户回调结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Mypoolin PG 无法显示支付页面或返回交易结果。

en.description: When the app starts a Mypoolin payment order, this Activity prepares the checkout request, opens the payment page, and returns the transaction outcome.
en.disableEffect: Mypoolin payment orders cannot proceed through this checkout flow.

zh-CN.description: 应用发起 Mypoolin 支付订单时，此 Activity 会准备结账请求、打开支付页面，并返回交易结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Mypoolin 支付订单无法通过此结账流程完成。

en.description: When the Mypoolin account flow opens its account list, this Activity fetches the user's profile and displays the available payment accounts.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open the account list used by the Mypoolin payment flow.

zh-CN.description: Mypoolin 账户流程打开账户列表时，此 Activity 会获取用户资料并显示可用的支付账户。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法打开 Mypoolin 支付流程中的账户列表。

en.description: When a user links a bank account to Mypoolin for UPI payments, this Activity runs the bank registration and phone-verification flow, including the required SMS checks.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot link a bank account for Mypoolin UPI payments.

zh-CN.description: 用户为 Mypoolin UPI 支付绑定银行账户时，此 Activity 会运行银行注册和手机验证流程，包括必要的短信校验。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法为 Mypoolin UPI 支付绑定银行账户。

en.description: When a user changes a Mypoolin UPI security PIN, this Activity runs the bank verification flow and returns its result.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot change their UPI security PIN through Mypoolin.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Mypoolin 修改 UPI 安全密码时，此 Activity 会运行银行验证流程并返回结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过 Mypoolin 修改 UPI 安全密码。

en.description: When Mypoolin starts a group invitation flow, this screen lets the user select contacts and prepares invitations for the selected group.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot select contacts for this Mypoolin group-invitation flow.

zh-CN.description: Mypoolin 启动群组邀请流程时，此界面允许用户选择联系人，并为所选群组准备邀请。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法在此 Mypoolin 群组邀请流程中选择联系人。

en.description: When a Mypoolin flow needs several invitees, this screen collects the selected contacts and returns them to the calling group or invitation flow.
en.disableEffect: The calling Mypoolin flow cannot collect multiple contacts for group invitations.

zh-CN.description: Mypoolin 流程需要邀请多人时，此界面会收集用户选中的联系人，并将其返回给发起的群组或邀请流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，发起的 Mypoolin 流程无法收集群组邀请所需的多位联系人。

en.description: When the app creates a Mypoolin money pool or bill split, this screen lets the user invite contacts and assign each person's share of the total.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot create an invited Mypoolin pool or assign its participants' shares.

zh-CN.description: 应用创建 Mypoolin 资金池或账单分摊时，此界面允许用户邀请联系人并分配每个人应承担的金额。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法创建带邀请人的 Mypoolin 资金池或分配参与者应付金额。

en.description: When the app starts a Mypoolin payment or UPI order, this Activity carries out the transaction and returns its payment status to the app.
en.disableEffect: Mypoolin payment and UPI order flows cannot complete.

zh-CN.description: 应用发起 Mypoolin 支付或 UPI 订单时，此 Activity 会处理交易并把支付状态返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Mypoolin 支付和 UPI 订单流程无法完成。

en.description: When a user registers with Mypoolin UPI, this screen runs the bank registration and SMS or phone verification flow, then returns success or cancellation.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot register for Mypoolin UPI through this flow.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Mypoolin 注册 UPI 时，此界面会运行银行注册及短信或电话验证流程，并返回成功或取消结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过此流程注册 Mypoolin UPI。

en.description: When opened from the Mypoolin SDK, this screen displays a field for a virtual payment address and a Verify button.
en.disableEffect: The Mypoolin virtual-payment-address entry screen cannot open.

zh-CN.description: 从 Mypoolin SDK 打开时，此界面会显示虚拟支付地址输入框和验证按钮。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Mypoolin 的虚拟支付地址输入界面无法打开。

en.description: When Mypoolin's UPI scanner is opened, this Activity uses the camera or a selected image to scan a barcode or QR code and returns the result.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot scan a payment code through this Mypoolin flow.

zh-CN.description: 打开 Mypoolin UPI 扫码器时，此 Activity 会使用相机或用户选择的图片扫描条码或二维码，并返回扫描结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过此 Mypoolin 流程扫描支付码。

en.description: After a UPI or BharatQR code is scanned, this screen displays the recipient and payment details and lets the user continue with a payment or request.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot review scanned payment details or continue from the Mypoolin QR flow.

zh-CN.description: 扫描 UPI 或 BharatQR 码后，此界面会显示收款方和支付信息，并允许用户继续付款或发起收款请求。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法查看扫描得到的支付信息或继续 Mypoolin 二维码流程。

en.description: When a myPOS Checkout transaction is ready to finish, this Activity completes or cancels the earlier card pre-authorization and returns the transaction result.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot complete or cancel a myPOS card pre-authorization through this flow.

zh-CN.description: myPOS Checkout 交易需要结束预授权时，此 Activity 会完成或取消先前的银行卡预授权，并返回交易结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用无法通过此流程完成或取消 myPOS 银行卡预授权。

en.description: When a myPOS Checkout order reserves a card payment before capture, this Activity collects or uses the card details and submits the pre-authorization.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot pre-authorize card payments through myPOS Checkout.

zh-CN.description: myPOS Checkout 订单需要先冻结银行卡金额再扣款时，此 Activity 会收集或使用卡片信息并提交预授权。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用无法通过 myPOS Checkout 提交银行卡预授权。

en.description: When the app makes a myPOS Checkout purchase, this Activity submits the card payment using new card details or a saved card and returns the transaction result.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot complete card purchases through myPOS Checkout.

zh-CN.description: 应用通过 myPOS Checkout 购物时，此 Activity 会使用新卡信息或已保存的银行卡提交支付并返回交易结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用无法通过 myPOS Checkout 完成银行卡支付。

en.description: When a merchant app requests a myPOS Checkout refund, this Activity submits the refund and returns its status, amount, and currency.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot issue refunds through this myPOS Checkout flow.

zh-CN.description: 商户应用请求通过 myPOS Checkout 退款时，此 Activity 会提交退款，并返回状态、金额和币种。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用无法通过此 myPOS Checkout 流程办理退款。

en.description: When a card issuer requires extra authentication during a myPOS Checkout payment, this Activity opens the secure verification page and returns the challenge result to the payment flow.
en.disableEffect: Payments that require the card issuer's extra verification cannot complete.

zh-CN.description: myPOS Checkout 支付需要发卡行进行额外认证时，此 Activity 会打开安全验证页面，并把验证结果返回支付流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，需要发卡行额外验证的支付将无法完成。

en.description: When a user saves a card in myPOS Checkout, this Activity collects the card details, verifies them when needed, and returns a reusable card token.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot save a card for later myPOS Checkout payments.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 myPOS Checkout 保存银行卡时，此 Activity 会收集卡片信息，按需进行验证，并返回可重复使用的卡片令牌。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法为后续 myPOS Checkout 支付保存银行卡。

en.description: When a user updates a saved card in myPOS Checkout, this Activity collects and verifies the replacement details, then returns the updated card token.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot update a saved card through myPOS Checkout.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 myPOS Checkout 更新已保存的银行卡时，此 Activity 会收集并验证新卡信息，然后返回更新后的卡片令牌。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过 myPOS Checkout 更新已保存的银行卡。

en.description: When the myPOS Slave SDK opens a card-terminal transaction, this Activity collects an amount or pre-authorization code and submits a purchase, pre-authorization, refund, or pre-authorization completion or cancellation to the terminal.
en.disableEffect: Merchants cannot complete those card-terminal transactions through the myPOS Slave SDK.

zh-CN.description: myPOS Slave SDK 打开银行卡终端交易时，此 Activity 会收集金额或预授权代码，并向终端提交购物、预授权、退款或预授权完成、取消操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，商户无法通过 myPOS Slave SDK 完成这些银行卡终端交易。

en.description: When the host app receives a Google Cloud Messaging push, this Receiver wakes the background service that delivers the message to the app's configured push handler.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, Shove push messages will no longer be delivered, while other host-app features can continue to work.

zh-CN.description: 宿主应用收到 Google Cloud Messaging 推送时，此 Receiver 会唤醒后台服务，由其将消息交给应用配置的推送处理程序。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Shove 推送消息将无法送达，但宿主应用的其他功能仍可继续使用。

en.description: When Shove's receiver hands over a Google Cloud Messaging push, this background service forwards the message to the host app's configured push handler.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, Shove push messages will no longer be processed, while other host-app features can continue to work.

zh-CN.description: Shove 的接收器交来 Google Cloud Messaging 推送时，此后台服务会将消息转交给宿主应用配置的推送处理程序。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Shove 推送消息将无法处理，但宿主应用的其他功能仍可继续使用。

en.description: When Robobo's HRI emotion module opens its Unity-based face display, this Activity renders the robot's face and changes its expression when the app sends an emotion command.
en.disableEffect: The Robobo app cannot display or change the robot's Unity-based facial expressions.

zh-CN.description: Robobo 人机交互情绪模块打开 Unity 人脸界面时，此 Activity 会显示机器人面部，并根据应用发来的情绪指令改变表情。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Robobo 应用无法显示或切换机器人 Unity 人脸表情。

en.description: When Robobo's HRI emotion module opens its WebGL face display, this Activity loads the robot's animated face and changes its expression when the app sends an emotion command.
en.disableEffect: The Robobo app cannot display or change the robot's WebGL facial expressions.

zh-CN.description: Robobo 人机交互情绪模块打开 WebGL 人脸界面时，此 Activity 会载入机器人的动画人脸，并根据应用发来的情绪指令改变表情。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Robobo 应用无法显示或切换机器人 WebGL 人脸表情。

en.description: When a Robobo app binds this framework service, it loads the configured robot modules and starts the Robobo manager so the app can control the robot.
en.disableEffect: The Robobo framework cannot start its modules, so robot features that depend on it stop working.

zh-CN.description: Robobo 应用绑定此框架服务时，它会载入已配置的机器人模块并启动 Robobo 管理器，以便应用控制机器人。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Robobo 框架无法启动模块，依赖它的机器人功能将无法使用。

en.description: When Robobo starts its ROS support, this background service runs ROS nodes and starts the ROS master used by robot modules to communicate.
en.disableEffect: Robobo modules that rely on ROS cannot start or communicate.

zh-CN.description: Robobo 启动 ROS 支持时，此后台服务会运行 ROS 节点并启动机器人模块用于通信的 ROS 主节点。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，依赖 ROS 的 Robobo 模块无法启动或通信。

en.description: When TIKI's publishing flow needs an image, this screen requests camera access if needed, opens the device camera, and returns the captured photo to the app.
en.disableEffect: The TIKI flow cannot capture a photo with the device camera.

zh-CN.description: TIKI 发布流程需要图片时，此界面会在必要时请求相机权限、打开设备相机，并将拍摄的照片返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，TIKI 流程无法使用设备相机拍摄照片。

en.description: When an app connects an email data provider through TIKI, this Activity opens the provider's sign-in page, exchanges a successful sign-in for access tokens, and returns the result to the publishing flow.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot connect an email provider through this TIKI flow.

zh-CN.description: 应用通过 TIKI 连接电子邮件数据提供方时，此 Activity 会打开提供方的登录页面，将成功登录换取为访问令牌，并把结果返回发布流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过此 TIKI 流程连接电子邮件数据提供方。

en.description: When TIKI's publishing client asks the user for data-sharing consent, this Activity presents the opt-in screen and returns when the user accepts or exits.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot show the TIKI opt-in screen in its publishing flow.

zh-CN.description: TIKI 发布客户端征求数据共享同意时，此 Activity 会显示选择加入界面，并在用户接受或退出后返回。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用无法在发布流程中显示 TIKI 同意界面。

en.description: When TIKI requests access to device capabilities, this Activity requests the needed Android permissions, including location, notifications, or tracking access, and returns the results to the calling flow.
en.disableEffect: The TIKI flow cannot request these permissions, so features that require them remain unavailable through that flow.

zh-CN.description: TIKI 请求访问设备功能时，此 Activity 会申请所需的 Android 权限，例如位置、通知或跟踪权限，并将结果返回发起流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，TIKI 流程无法申请这些权限，依赖它们的功能也无法通过该流程使用。

en.description: When a user opens Learn more from a TIKI data offer, this Activity displays the offer's explanation.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot read the offer explanation from the TIKI screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户从 TIKI 数据权益说明中打开“了解更多”时，此 Activity 会显示该说明内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法在 TIKI 界面中阅读相关说明。

en.description: When the app asks the user to respond to a TIKI data-use offer, this Activity presents the offer, terms, permission requests, and accept or decline choices, then applies the selected result.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot review, accept, or decline the TIKI offer in the app.

zh-CN.description: 应用请用户回应 TIKI 数据使用权益时，此 Activity 会展示权益内容、条款、权限请求以及接受或拒绝选项，并应用用户的选择。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法在应用中查看、接受或拒绝 TIKI 权益。

en.description: When a user opens TIKI data settings, this screen shows the offer details and controls for opting in or out, and handles any required permissions.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot manage the TIKI data offer or opt-in choice from these settings.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 TIKI 数据设置时，此界面会显示权益详情、提供加入或退出的控制项，并处理所需权限。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法在这些设置中管理 TIKI 数据权益或加入状态。

en.description: When a user opens terms from a TIKI offer or settings flow, this Activity displays the offer's terms and conditions.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot read the TIKI offer terms from that flow.

zh-CN.description: 用户从 TIKI 权益或设置流程打开条款时，此 Activity 会显示该权益的条款与条件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过该流程阅读 TIKI 权益条款。

en.description: The Nabin Bhandari Permissions library opens this Activity when an app requests Android runtime permissions. It can explain why a permission is needed, ask Android for it, or direct the user to app settings after a denial.
en.disableEffect: Permission requests through this library will stop working, which can leave app features without permissions they need.

zh-CN.description: Nabin Bhandari 权限库会在应用请求 Android 运行时权限时打开此 Activity。它可以说明权限用途、向 Android 发起请求，或在权限被拒后引导用户前往应用设置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，该库的权限请求流程将无法使用，依赖相应权限的应用功能可能受影响。

en.description: When ANLogger's file-logging feature shares saved logs, this Provider lets the email or file app read the attachment from the app's cache. ANLogger uses it in its log-sharing flow.
en.disableEffect: Other apps cannot read the log attachment, so ANLogger's log-sharing flow will fail.

zh-CN.description: ANLogger 的文件日志功能分享已保存的日志时，这个 Provider 会让邮件或文件应用从应用缓存中读取附件。ANLogger 的日志分享流程会用到它。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，其他应用无法读取日志附件，ANLogger 的日志分享流程会失败。

en.description: When file logging is enabled and saved logs are available, ANLogger opens this Activity for choosing how to share them. It provides the screen that starts the log-sharing flow.
en.disableEffect: ANLogger cannot open its log-sharing screen, so users cannot send saved logs through this flow.

zh-CN.description: 启用文件日志且已有日志时，ANLogger 会打开这个 Activity，让用户选择如何分享日志。它提供启动日志分享流程的界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: ANLogger 无法打开日志分享界面，用户不能通过此流程发送已保存的日志。

en.description: Najva's push and advertising SDK opens this Activity when the app enables its advertising consent prompt and no choice has been saved. It asks whether ads are allowed and stores the user's choice.
en.disableEffect: Najva cannot collect this advertising consent choice through its prompt, so its advertising setup may not complete.

zh-CN.description: Najva 推送与广告 SDK 会在应用启用广告同意提示且尚无保存选择时打开此 Activity。它询问用户是否允许广告，并保存用户的选择。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Najva 无法通过此提示收集广告同意选择，广告设置流程可能无法完成。

en.description: Najva's push and advertising SDK uses this Provider at app startup to read its configuration and initialize the client; depending on settings, it can also start a notification-permission or advertising-consent screen.
en.disableEffect: Najva push messages and ads may not initialize.

zh-CN.description: Najva 推送与广告 SDK 会在应用启动时通过此 Provider 读取配置并初始化客户端；根据设置，它还可能打开通知权限或广告同意页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Najva 推送消息和广告可能无法初始化。

en.description: Najva's push SDK declares this Receiver for an explicit silent-notification broadcast. In the inspected version it checks whether the Najva client is available and does not display a notification.
en.disableEffect: Silent-notification broadcasts will no longer reach this component; ordinary Najva push messages use separate handlers.

zh-CN.description: Najva 推送 SDK 声明此 Receiver 来接收显式发送的静默通知广播。在分析的版本中，它会检查 Najva 客户端是否可用，但不会显示通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，静默通知广播将无法到达此组件；普通 Najva 推送消息由其他处理组件接收。

en.description: Najva's push SDK opens this Activity after a user taps a push notification. It records the tap and opens the destination provided with the notification, such as an app screen, web link, phone dialer, SMS app, or Telegram.
en.disableEffect: Tapping Najva notifications will no longer report the click or open their configured destination.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击推送通知后，Najva 推送 SDK 会打开此 Activity。它会记录点击，并打开通知指定的目标，例如应用页面、网页链接、拨号器、短信应用或 Telegram。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，点击 Najva 通知将不再记录点击，也无法打开通知指定的目标。

en.description: On Android 13 and later, Najva's push SDK opens this Activity to request permission to show notifications. After permission is granted, it can continue the configured advertising-consent flow.
en.disableEffect: Najva cannot request notification permission through this screen, so its push notifications may not appear.

zh-CN.description: 在 Android 13 及更高版本上，Najva 推送 SDK 会打开此 Activity 来请求显示通知的权限。获得许可后，它还可以继续已配置的广告同意流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Najva 无法通过此页面请求通知权限，因此它的推送通知可能无法显示。

en.description: Najva's push SDK uses this Service to receive Firebase Cloud Messaging data and pass it to Najva's message handler.
en.disableEffect: Najva messages received through this Service will not be delivered to the SDK's message handler.

zh-CN.description: Najva 推送 SDK 使用此 Service 接收 Firebase Cloud Messaging 数据，并将其交给 Najva 的消息处理程序。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，通过此 Service 收到的 Najva 消息将无法交给 SDK 处理。

en.description: On Android 5.0 and later, Najva's Firebase receiver schedules this JobService to process incoming push-message data.
en.disableEffect: Najva push messages handed to the job scheduler will not be processed.

zh-CN.description: 在 Android 5.0 及更高版本上，Najva 的 Firebase 接收器会安排此 JobService 来处理收到的推送消息数据。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，交由系统任务调度器处理的 Najva 推送消息将无法处理。

en.description: Najva's push SDK listens for Firebase's incoming-message broadcast here and forwards its data to a service or scheduled job based on the Android version.
en.disableEffect: Najva push messages will no longer be forwarded for processing.

zh-CN.description: Najva 推送 SDK 通过此 Receiver 接收 Firebase 的消息广播，并根据 Android 版本将消息转交给 Service 或系统任务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Najva 推送消息将无法转交处理。

en.description: In older Najva SDK versions, Firebase Cloud Messaging calls this Service for new messages and registration tokens; it forwards both to Najva's push handler.
en.disableEffect: Older Najva push delivery and registration-token updates will stop.

zh-CN.description: 在较旧版本的 Najva SDK 中，Firebase Cloud Messaging 会通过此 Service 传递新消息和注册令牌；它会将两者交给 Najva 推送处理程序。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，旧版 Najva 推送消息和注册令牌更新将停止处理。

en.description: In older Najva SDK versions, this background Service handles notification taps and opens the configured app screen or destination, such as a web link, phone dialer, SMS app, or Telegram.
en.disableEffect: Tapping older Najva notifications will no longer open their configured destinations.

zh-CN.description: 在较旧版本的 Najva SDK 中，用户点击通知后，此后台 Service 会打开通知指定的应用页面或目标，例如网页链接、拨号器、短信应用或 Telegram。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，点击旧版 Najva 通知将无法打开指定目标。

en.description: After the device finishes booting, Najva's older push SDK receives this broadcast and schedules a repeating alarm to start its messaging service.
en.disableEffect: The older Najva push service will no longer be restarted by this receiver after a reboot.

zh-CN.description: 设备启动完成后，旧版 Najva 推送 SDK 会收到此广播，并安排重复闹钟来启动其消息 Service。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，设备重启时此 Receiver 将不再重新启动旧版 Najva 推送服务。

en.description: Naresh Chocha FilePicker opens Android's document picker for one or more files with the types selected by the app, then returns the chosen documents.
en.disableEffect: Apps that use this route cannot select documents for import or upload.

zh-CN.description: Naresh Chocha FilePicker 会按应用设置的文件类型打开 Android 文档选择器，供用户选择一个或多个文档并返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此流程的应用将无法选择文档进行导入或上传。

en.description: Naresh Chocha FilePicker opens the camera to capture a still image, saves it in an app file, and returns the image to the calling screen.
en.disableEffect: The app's photo-capture flow cannot return a captured image.

zh-CN.description: Naresh Chocha FilePicker 会打开相机拍摄照片，将照片保存到应用文件中，再返回给调用页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用的拍照流程将无法返回拍摄的照片。

en.description: Naresh Chocha FilePicker opens Android's photo picker for the image or video types and number of items allowed by the app, then returns the selected media.
en.disableEffect: Screens that use this library cannot select images or videos through this picker.

zh-CN.description: Naresh Chocha FilePicker 会按应用设置打开 Android 图片或视频选择器，供用户选择媒体并返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此库的页面将无法通过此选择器选取图片或视频。

en.description: Naresh Chocha FilePicker displays the file and capture choices configured by the app in a dialog or bottom sheet, opens the selected picker, and returns its result.
en.disableEffect: The app's file-selection menu will not appear, so users cannot start its configured selection or capture flow.

zh-CN.description: Naresh Chocha FilePicker 会在对话框或底部面板中显示应用配置的文件选择和拍摄选项，打开所选工具并返回结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用的文件选择菜单将无法显示，用户也无法从中启动配置的选择或拍摄流程。

en.description: Naresh Chocha FilePicker opens the device's video camera to record a clip and returns the saved video to the app.
en.disableEffect: The app's video-capture flow cannot return a recorded clip.

zh-CN.description: Naresh Chocha FilePicker 会打开设备的摄像功能录制视频，并将保存的视频返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用的视频录制流程将无法返回录制的片段。

en.description: Naresh Chocha FilePicker uses this Provider to let the camera app save a photo or video to an app file and return it through a private content link.
en.disableEffect: Image and video capture flows cannot pass their output files back to the app.

zh-CN.description: Naresh Chocha FilePicker 使用此 Provider 让相机将照片或视频保存到应用文件中，再通过专用内容链接交还给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 拍照和录制流程将无法把生成的文件交还给应用。

en.description: AdMixer (Nasmedia) opens this full-screen page to play a video ad between parts of an app. It loads the selected ad and records playback events.
en.disableEffect: AdMixer interstitial video ads will not open or play.

zh-CN.description: AdMixer（Nasmedia）会在应用内容之间打开此全屏页面播放视频广告，并记录播放情况。
zh-CN.disableEffect: AdMixer 的插屏视频广告将无法打开或播放。

en.description: AdMixer SSP (Nasmedia) uses this provider when its ad-report page attaches a captured image. It lets the report form read that image from the app cache.
en.disableEffect: Screenshots cannot be attached to AdMixer ad reports.

zh-CN.description: AdMixer SSP（Nasmedia）会在广告举报页面添加截图时使用此内容提供程序，让举报表单读取应用缓存中的图片。
zh-CN.disableEffect: AdMixer 广告举报将无法附加截图。

en.description: AdMixer SSP (Nasmedia) opens this page when a user reports an ad. It loads the report form and accepts an image attachment.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot submit ad reports through AdMixer SSP's in-app report page.

zh-CN.description: 用户举报广告时，AdMixer SSP（Nasmedia）会打开此页面加载举报表单，并允许附加图片。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 AdMixer SSP 的应用内页面提交广告举报。

en.description: AdMixer SSP (Nasmedia) opens this full-screen page to show a static interstitial ad and handle ad taps.
en.disableEffect: AdMixer SSP static interstitial ads will not display or open.

zh-CN.description: AdMixer SSP（Nasmedia）会打开此全屏页面展示静态插屏广告并处理广告点击。
zh-CN.disableEffect: AdMixer SSP 的静态插屏广告将无法显示或打开。

en.description: AdMixer SSP (Nasmedia) opens this full-screen page to play a video interstitial and track its playback.
en.disableEffect: AdMixer SSP video interstitial ads will not open or play.

zh-CN.description: AdMixer SSP（Nasmedia）会打开此全屏页面播放视频插屏广告并记录播放情况。
zh-CN.disableEffect: AdMixer SSP 的视频插屏广告将无法打开或播放。

en.description: NAP Offerwall (Nasmedia) uses this page to show benefits the user has received, with a list and period controls. It is part of the offerwall's rewards area.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot view NAP offerwall benefits and reward history.

zh-CN.description: NAP Offerwall（Nasmedia）会用此页面展示用户已获得的权益，并提供列表和时间范围选择。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法查看 NAP Offerwall 的权益和奖励记录。

en.description: NAP Offerwall (Nasmedia) opens this customer-service form for offer questions. Users can describe an issue and attach an image.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot send NAP offerwall support requests or attach evidence.

zh-CN.description: NAP Offerwall（Nasmedia）会为广告任务问题打开客服表单，用户可以填写情况并附上图片。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法向 NAP Offerwall 提交问题或附上证明图片。

en.description: NAP Offerwall (Nasmedia) opens this page after a user selects an offer. It shows the offer image, name, and participation details before the user continues.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot review or continue to offers from their NAP detail pages.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择任务后，NAP Offerwall（Nasmedia）会打开此页面展示任务图片、名称和参与说明。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在 NAP 任务详情页查看或继续参与任务。

en.description: NAP Offerwall (Nasmedia) opens an in-app browser for a selected campaign landing page. It loads the campaign link and handles the offer visit flow.
en.disableEffect: Users may be unable to complete offers in this browser or receive the related offer rewards.

zh-CN.description: NAP Offerwall（Nasmedia）会在应用内打开所选任务的落地页，并处理任务访问流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户可能无法在此浏览器中完成任务或获得相应奖励。

en.description: Older NAP Offerwall (Nasmedia) versions open this in-app browser for a campaign landing page. It loads the selected link inside the app.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open this version's offer pages in the app, which can prevent completing an offer.

zh-CN.description: 较早版本的 NAP Offerwall（Nasmedia）会用此应用内浏览器打开任务落地页。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在应用内打开此版本的任务页面，可能无法完成任务。

en.description: NAP Offerwall (Nasmedia) opens this entry page and loads its offerwall content. Users enter the offer list from here.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot enter the NAP offerwall to browse offers.

zh-CN.description: NAP Offerwall（Nasmedia）会打开此入口页面并加载任务墙内容，用户可从这里进入任务列表。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法进入 NAP Offerwall 浏览任务。

en.description: NAP Offerwall (Nasmedia) opens this page to show available offers. Selecting an offer continues to its detail page.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot browse or start NAP offers from the offer list.

zh-CN.description: NAP Offerwall（Nasmedia）会用此页面展示可参加的任务，用户选择任务后可查看详情。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在任务列表中浏览或开始 NAP 任务。

en.description: NAP Offerwall (Nasmedia) uses this page to list the user's earned benefits and points over a selected period.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot view their NAP offerwall point and benefit history.

zh-CN.description: NAP Offerwall（Nasmedia）会用此页面按时间范围列出用户获得的权益和积分。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法查看 NAP Offerwall 的积分和权益记录。

en.description: NAP Offerwall (Nasmedia) opens this request form for participation, reward, service, or other offerwall questions. Users enter contact details and a message.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot submit requests about NAP offer participation or rewards.

zh-CN.description: NAP Offerwall（Nasmedia）会为参与、奖励、服务或其他任务问题打开申请表，用户可填写联系方式和留言。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法提交有关 NAP 任务参与或奖励的请求。

en.description: NAP Offerwall (Nasmedia) loads a linked offer or information page inside the app. The page includes a title and an in-app back control.
en.disableEffect: Linked NAP offer and information pages will not open inside the app.

zh-CN.description: NAP Offerwall（Nasmedia）会在应用内加载任务或信息页面，并显示标题和返回控件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: NAP 的任务和信息页面将无法在应用内打开。

en.description: NStation NAP Reward (Nasmedia) opens an in-app browser for a selected reward campaign. It loads the campaign page and tracks the offer visit.
en.disableEffect: Users may be unable to complete reward offers in this browser; rewards for watching ads shown through the affected flow will no longer be granted.

zh-CN.description: NStation NAP Reward（Nasmedia）会在应用内打开所选奖励任务页面，并记录任务访问情况。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户可能无法在此浏览器中完成奖励任务；受影响流程中的广告观看奖励将不再发放。

en.description: NStation NAP Reward (Nasmedia) opens this page for a selected reward campaign and displays its campaign content.
en.disableEffect: Reward campaigns in this page will stop working, and rewards for watching their ads will no longer be granted.

zh-CN.description: NStation NAP Reward（Nasmedia）会为所选奖励任务打开此页面并展示任务内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 此页面中的奖励任务将无法使用，观看其中广告的奖励也将不再发放。

en.description: NStation NAP Reward (Nasmedia) opens this in-app page for campaign-linked web content, such as an offer or information page.
en.disableEffect: Rewarded offers that require this page cannot be completed, and rewards for watching their ads will no longer be granted.

zh-CN.description: NStation NAP Reward（Nasmedia）会在应用内打开奖励任务或相关信息页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要此页面的奖励任务将无法完成，观看相关广告的奖励也将不再发放。

en.description: NStation (Nasmedia) uses this page to show benefits the user has received, with a list and period controls. It is part of the offerwall's rewards area.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot view their NStation benefits and reward history.

zh-CN.description: NStation（Nasmedia）会用此页面展示用户已获得的权益，并提供列表和时间范围选择。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法查看 NStation 的权益和奖励记录。

en.description: NStation (Nasmedia) opens this page after a user selects an offer. It shows the campaign image, name, and participation details.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot review or continue to offers from NStation detail pages.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择任务后，NStation（Nasmedia）会打开此页面展示任务图片、名称和参与说明。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在 NStation 任务详情页查看或继续参与任务。

en.description: NStation (Nasmedia) opens this in-app browser for a selected campaign landing page. It loads the link and tracks the offer visit.
en.disableEffect: Users may be unable to complete offers in this browser or receive the related offer rewards.

zh-CN.description: NStation（Nasmedia）会在应用内打开所选任务的落地页，并记录任务访问情况。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户可能无法在此浏览器中完成任务或获得相应奖励。

en.description: NStation (Nasmedia) opens this entry page to show its offerwall content and campaigns.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open NStation to browse its campaigns and related rewards.

zh-CN.description: NStation（Nasmedia）会打开此入口页面展示任务墙内容和活动。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开 NStation 浏览活动和相关奖励。

en.description: NStation (Nasmedia) opens this form for participation, reward, service, or other offerwall questions. Users enter contact details and a message.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot submit requests about NStation offer participation or rewards.

zh-CN.description: NStation（Nasmedia）会为参与、奖励、服务或其他任务问题打开申请表，用户可填写联系方式和留言。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法提交有关 NStation 任务参与或奖励的请求。

en.description: NStation (Nasmedia) loads a linked offer or information page inside the app and manages its web content.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open the linked NStation page; offers that depend on it may not complete.

zh-CN.description: NStation（Nasmedia）会在应用内加载任务或信息页面并处理网页内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开相关 NStation 页面；依赖该页面的任务可能无法完成。

en.description: Naver's common ads library uses this Provider during app startup to initialize shared ad services for its Ad Manager modules.
en.disableEffect: Naver ads that need this shared startup may fail to initialize.

zh-CN.description: Naver 通用广告库会在应用启动时通过此 Provider 初始化 Ad Manager 模块共用的广告服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此启动流程的 Naver 广告可能无法初始化。

en.description: NAVER Ad Manager's core SDK uses this Provider at app startup to start its services before ad features run.
en.disableEffect: NAVER Ad Manager features that rely on automatic startup may not initialize.

zh-CN.description: NAVER Ad Manager 核心 SDK 会在应用启动时通过此 Provider 启动服务，供后续广告功能使用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖自动启动的 NAVER Ad Manager 功能可能无法初始化。

en.description: NAVER Ad Manager debugging tools use this Provider to share diagnostic files with other apps.
en.disableEffect: The ad debugger will not be able to open or share files through this provider.

zh-CN.description: NAVER Ad Manager 调试工具会通过此 Provider 与其他应用共享诊断文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，广告调试器将无法通过此 Provider 打开或共享文件。

en.description: The NAVER Ad Manager Ad Inspector uses this Provider to share inspection files with other apps.
en.disableEffect: The Ad Inspector will not be able to open or share files through this provider.

zh-CN.description: NAVER Ad Manager 的广告检查器会通过此 Provider 与其他应用共享检查文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，广告检查器将无法通过此 Provider 打开或共享文件。

en.description: NAVER Ad Manager's debugging tools open this Activity for a selected ad event. It shows details from that ad request.
en.disableEffect: The debugger's ad-log detail screen will not open.

zh-CN.description: NAVER Ad Manager 调试工具会为选定的广告事件打开此 Activity，以显示该广告请求的详细信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，调试器中的广告日志详情页面将无法打开。

en.description: NAVER Ad Manager's debugging tools open this Activity to show details for a cached ad.
en.disableEffect: The debugger's cached-ad detail screen will not open.

zh-CN.description: NAVER Ad Manager 调试工具会打开此 Activity 来显示缓存广告的详细信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，调试器中的缓存广告详情页面将无法打开。

en.description: NAVER Ad Manager's optional debugging tools open this Activity to inspect recent ad activity and choose an event for more details.
en.disableEffect: The NAVER Ad Manager debugger screen and its diagnostics will be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: NAVER Ad Manager 的可选调试工具会打开此 Activity，以检查近期广告活动并选择事件查看详情。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，NAVER Ad Manager 调试器页面及其诊断功能将无法使用。

en.description: NAVER Ad Manager's Ad Inspector opens this Activity for a selected event to show its ad-log details.
en.disableEffect: The inspector's ad-log detail screen will not open.

zh-CN.description: NAVER Ad Manager 的广告检查器会为选定事件打开此 Activity，以显示广告日志详情。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，检查器中的广告日志详情页面将无法打开。

en.description: NAVER Ad Manager's Ad Inspector can open this Activity from an ad view or its inspection tools. It shows inspection details for recent ad activity and a selected ad event.
en.disableEffect: The Ad Inspector screen and its diagnostic details will be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: NAVER Ad Manager 的广告检查器可以从广告视图或检查工具打开此 Activity，以查看近期广告活动和选定事件的检查详情。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，广告检查器页面及其诊断详情将无法使用。

en.description: NAVER Ad Manager's mediation extension opens this Activity to display a mediated ad full screen and handle orientation, focus, and close events.
en.disableEffect: Mediated full-screen ads will not display.

zh-CN.description: NAVER Ad Manager 的广告中介扩展会打开此 Activity 来全屏显示中介广告，并处理屏幕方向、焦点和关闭事件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，中介全屏广告将无法显示。

en.description: NAVER Ad Manager opens this Activity when it needs to show an ad full screen. It presents the ad, adjusts screen orientation, and reports when the ad view opens or closes.
en.disableEffect: Full-screen NAVER ads will not be shown.

zh-CN.description: NAVER Ad Manager 需要全屏展示广告时会打开此 Activity。它负责显示广告、调整屏幕方向，并通知 SDK 广告页面的显示和关闭状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，NAVER 全屏广告将无法显示。

en.description: NAVER Ad Manager's ad extension opens this Activity when an ad expands beyond its original view. It provides a full-screen area for the expanded ad and reports its lifecycle to the ad SDK.
en.disableEffect: Expanded NAVER ads that use this format will not open in a full-screen view.

zh-CN.description: NAVER Ad Manager 广告扩展会在广告超出原显示区域时打开此 Activity。它为展开后的广告提供全屏区域，并将页面状态通知广告 SDK。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，使用此格式的 NAVER 展开式广告将无法全屏打开。

en.description: From NAVER Maps' information menu, this Activity loads the SDK's legal notice page from the web.
en.disableEffect: The NAVER Maps legal-notice page will not open; map viewing remains available.

zh-CN.description: 从 NAVER Maps 信息菜单进入时，此 Activity 会从网络加载 SDK 的法律声明页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，NAVER Maps 法律声明页面将无法打开，但地图仍可查看。

en.description: From NAVER Maps' information menu, this Activity loads a map legend page that explains map symbols.
en.disableEffect: The map legend page will not open; map viewing remains available.

zh-CN.description: 从 NAVER Maps 信息菜单进入时，此 Activity 会加载地图图例页面，说明地图符号的含义。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，地图图例页面将无法打开，但地图仍可查看。

en.description: From NAVER Maps' information menu, this Activity reads the SDK's bundled notice file and displays its open-source license notices.
en.disableEffect: The open-source notices page will not be available; ordinary map screens still work.

zh-CN.description: 从 NAVER Maps 信息菜单进入时，此 Activity 会读取 SDK 随附的声明文件，并显示开源许可证信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，开源许可证信息页面将无法查看，普通地图页面仍可使用。

en.description: The NAVER ID Login SDK opens this Activity during sign-in. It starts authentication with the NAVER app or a browser tab and returns the result to the app.
en.disableEffect: NAVER ID sign-in will fail or be unavailable if this Activity is disabled.

zh-CN.description: NAVER ID 登录 SDK 会在登录过程中打开此 Activity。它通过 NAVER 应用或浏览器标签页发起认证，并将结果返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，NAVER ID 登录将失败或无法使用。

en.description: The NAVER ID Login SDK opens this Activity during sign-in. It starts authentication with the NAVER app or a browser tab and returns the result to the app.
en.disableEffect: NAVER ID sign-in will fail or be unavailable if this Activity is disabled.

zh-CN.description: NAVER ID 登录 SDK 会在登录过程中打开此 Activity。它通过 NAVER 应用或浏览器标签页发起认证，并将结果返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，NAVER ID 登录将失败或无法使用。

en.description: During NAVER ID sign-in, this Activity opens the sign-in page in a browser tab and receives the authorization result when the browser returns.
en.disableEffect: Browser-based NAVER ID sign-in cannot start or return its authorization result.

zh-CN.description: NAVER ID 登录期间，此 Activity 会在浏览器标签页中打开登录页面，并在浏览器返回时接收认证结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，基于浏览器的 NAVER ID 登录将无法启动或返回认证结果。

en.description: The NAVER ID Login SDK declares this Activity for an older embedded-browser sign-in route. In the inspected version, the login flow reports that route as deprecated and does not open this screen.
en.disableEffect: Disabling this retired screen does not affect the NAVER app or browser-tab sign-in routes supported by this SDK version.

zh-CN.description: NAVER ID 登录 SDK 为较旧的内嵌浏览器登录方式声明了此 Activity。在分析的版本中，登录流程会将该方式标记为已弃用，不会打开此页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用此旧页面不会影响该 SDK 版本支持的 NAVER 应用或浏览器标签登录方式。

en.description: Naver App Tracking SDK creates this provider automatically at app startup; its extension watches foreground and background transitions and can send the conversion events configured by the app.
en.disableEffect: Naver extension tracking will not initialize, while the host app's regular features remain available.

zh-CN.description: NAVER 应用追踪 SDK 会在应用启动时自动创建此 Provider；其扩展会监听前后台切换，并可发送应用配置的转化事件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: NAVER 扩展追踪将不会初始化，应用的常规功能仍可使用。

en.description: Naver App Tracking SDK creates this provider automatically at app startup and registers to watch when the app enters or leaves the foreground so it can record app sessions.
en.disableEffect: Naver app-session tracking will not start, while the host app's regular features remain available.

zh-CN.description: NAVER 应用追踪 SDK 会在应用启动时自动创建此 Provider，并监听应用进入或离开前台的状态，以记录应用会话。
zh-CN.disableEffect: NAVER 的应用会话追踪将不会启动，应用的常规功能仍可使用。

en.description: NBase Android SDK handles Firebase push messages and displays them as notifications using the supplied title and text, with an image when one is provided.
en.disableEffect: Notifications delivered through NBase’s Firebase integration will no longer appear.

zh-CN.description: NBase Android SDK 会处理 Firebase 推送消息，并使用消息提供的标题和文字显示通知；如果消息附带图片，通知也会显示图片。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，通过 NBase 的 Firebase 集成发送的通知将不再显示。

en.description: NBase SDK (NBase) uses this Activity as a Unity game's entry screen and to return from sign-in or purchase screens. It also exposes sign-in and Google purchase flows to the game.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it can prevent a Unity game from launching correctly and break NBase sign-in or purchase flows.

zh-CN.description: NBase SDK（NBase）会将此 Activity 用作 Unity 游戏入口，并用它接收登录或购买页面返回的结果；它也为游戏提供登录和 Google 购买流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，使用它的 Unity 游戏可能无法正常启动，NBase 登录或购买流程也可能中断。

en.description: Older NBase SDK (NBase) versions use this Unity Activity to return results after an external sign-in or purchase screen closes.
en.disableEffect: External sign-in or purchase results may not return to the game, and games using this Activity may fail to launch correctly.

zh-CN.description: 较早版本的 NBase SDK（NBase）会用此 Unity Activity 接收外部登录或购买页面关闭后的结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 外部登录或购买结果可能无法返回游戏，使用此 Activity 的游戏也可能无法正常启动。

en.description: NBase SDK (NBase) receives Firebase messages here, stores refreshed push tokens, and creates notifications from message text and optional images.
en.disableEffect: NBase push notifications and push-token updates will stop.

zh-CN.description: NBase SDK（NBase）会在此接收 Firebase 消息、保存更新后的推送令牌，并根据消息文字和可选图片创建通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: NBase 推送通知和推送令牌更新将停止。

en.description: When an app asks the user to choose a local file, Material File Picker opens a folder browser at shared storage and returns the selected file path to the app.
en.disableEffect: File selection through this library will fail, which can break an app feature that imports or attaches a chosen file.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求用户选择本地文件时，Material File Picker 会打开共享存储中的文件夹浏览界面，并将所选文件路径返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 此库提供的文件选择功能将无法使用，依赖导入或附加文件的应用功能可能因此失效。

en.description: DanielBlue's MvvmCore uses this Activity to show a host-app webpage inside the app and display the page title in its toolbar.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents the app from opening web pages routed through this screen.

zh-CN.description: DanielBlue 的 MvvmCore 使用此 Activity 在应用内显示宿主应用提供的网页，并在工具栏显示网页标题。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用无法打开通过此页面展示的网页。

en.description: When OPPO Game SDK prepares its game-services module, this background service loads the module's code and resources and registers the providers it needs.
en.disableEffect: The OPPO game-services module may not load, so its account and game-center features may fail to start.

zh-CN.description: OPPO 游戏 SDK 准备游戏服务模块时，此后台服务会加载模块代码和资源，并注册所需的组件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 屏蔽后，OPPO 游戏服务模块可能无法加载，相关账号和游戏中心功能也可能无法启动。

en.description: OPPO Game SDK uses this receiver for a background keep-alive or update signal; it starts or stops the matching background service for the selected game.
en.disableEffect: The SDK will not start or stop its background keep-alive and update service in response to this signal, while the game's foreground features remain available.

zh-CN.description: OPPO 游戏 SDK 收到后台保活或更新信号时，此接收器会为指定游戏启动或停止相应的后台服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 屏蔽后，SDK 无法根据此信号启动或停止后台保活和更新服务，但游戏的前台功能仍可使用。

en.description: When OPPO Game SDK starts a background update or keep-alive task, this service keeps it running with a notification.
en.disableEffect: The OPPO Game SDK's background keep-alive or update service and its notification will not run, while the game's foreground features remain available.

zh-CN.description: OPPO 游戏 SDK 启动后台更新或保活任务时，此服务会通过通知让该任务保持运行。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 屏蔽后，OPPO 游戏 SDK 的后台保活或更新服务及其通知无法运行，游戏的前台功能仍可使用。

en.description: OPPO Game SDK uses this background connection to show or hide its account-login prompts and update the game player's role and account information.
en.disableEffect: OPPO account sign-in prompts and related player information may not appear or update.

zh-CN.description: OPPO 游戏 SDK 通过此后台连接显示或隐藏账号登录提示，并更新游戏角色和账号信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 屏蔽后，OPPO 游戏账号登录提示和相关玩家信息可能无法显示或更新。

en.description: OPPO Game SDK uses this background connection to show or hide its floating game-center shortcut, update its alert dot, or change its VIP appearance.
en.disableEffect: The OPPO floating game-center shortcut and its alert or VIP styling will no longer be available.

zh-CN.description: OPPO 游戏 SDK 通过此后台连接显示或隐藏游戏中心悬浮入口、更新提示红点或切换 VIP 样式。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 屏蔽后，OPPO 游戏中心悬浮入口及其提示标记和 VIP 样式将无法使用。

en.description: On a child-data export request, OPPO Game SDK packages saved child-data files and sends them back to the requesting service.
en.disableEffect: The OPPO SDK cannot return child-data export files, so child-account or protection flows that need them may fail.

zh-CN.description: 收到儿童数据导出请求时，OPPO 游戏 SDK 会将保存的儿童数据文件打包，并返回给请求方。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 屏蔽后，OPPO SDK 无法返回儿童数据导出文件，依赖这些数据的儿童账号或保护流程可能中断。

en.description: When Android opens this OPPO Game SDK screen during helper shutdown, it immediately closes and exits the SDK's separate helper process.
en.disableEffect: The SDK's helper process may not close when requested, while the host game's main screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: OPPO 游戏 SDK 关闭后台游戏服务时会打开此页面，页面随即关闭并结束 SDK 的独立辅助进程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 屏蔽后，SDK 需要关闭时可能无法正常结束辅助进程，游戏的主要页面仍可使用。

en.description: The OPPO game SDK uses this screen to open game pages supplied by its in-app game service.
en.disableEffect: Game pages provided through the OPPO game service may stop opening.

zh-CN.description: OPPO 游戏 SDK 使用此页面打开其游戏服务提供的游戏页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过 OPPO 游戏服务提供的游戏页面可能无法打开。

en.description: When OPPO Game SDK needs to show a page from its dynamically loaded game-services module, it opens this full-screen screen, including for account or game-center UI.
en.disableEffect: Account and game-center pages handled by the OPPO Game SDK will not open.

zh-CN.description: OPPO 游戏 SDK 需要显示动态加载的游戏服务页面时，会通过此全屏页面承载内容，例如账号或游戏中心界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 屏蔽后，OPPO 游戏 SDK 负责的账号和游戏中心页面将无法打开。

en.description: When OPPO Game SDK needs background work from its dynamically loaded game-services module, this service runs the matching game service.
en.disableEffect: Features that depend on the OPPO Game SDK's background tasks may stop working.

zh-CN.description: OPPO 游戏 SDK 需要运行动态加载的后台任务时，会通过此服务把请求交给对应的游戏服务处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 屏蔽后，依赖 OPPO 游戏服务后台任务的功能可能无法正常使用。

en.description: When OPPO Game SDK services need to open or hand off files, this provider resolves the temporary file link and opens the file from its loaded game-services module.
en.disableEffect: File-sharing or installation flows that rely on OPPO Game SDK links may fail.

zh-CN.description: OPPO 游戏 SDK 的游戏服务需要打开或传递文件时，会通过此组件解析临时文件链接并读取文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 屏蔽后，依赖 OPPO 游戏 SDK 文件链接的文件共享或安装流程可能失败。

en.description: When OPPO or HeyTap reports an account sign-in, sign-out, or profile change, this receiver forwards the notice to OPPO Game SDK's account handler.
en.disableEffect: The SDK may not reflect an account sign-in, sign-out, or profile change, which can interrupt related account flows.

zh-CN.description: 收到 OPPO 或 HeyTap 的账号登录、退出或资料修改通知时，此接收器会将通知转给 OPPO 游戏 SDK 的账号处理功能。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 屏蔽后，SDK 可能无法及时反映账号登录、退出或资料变更，相关账号流程可能异常。

en.description: OPPO’s instant-app router opens this screen when its runtime needs an update. It checks for an update, lets the user download it, and opens Android’s installer when the package is ready.
en.disableEffect: The instant-app runtime cannot be updated through this flow, so pages that require it may stop opening.

zh-CN.description: OPPO 即时应用路由器会在运行环境需要更新时打开此页面；页面检查更新、提供下载，并在安装包准备好后启动 Android 安装程序。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 即时应用运行环境无法通过此流程更新，依赖该环境的页面可能无法打开。

en.description: OPPO’s instant-app router uses this provider to pass a downloaded platform package to Android’s installer.
en.disableEffect: The OPPO instant-app update cannot pass its package file to Android for installation.

zh-CN.description: OPPO 即时应用路由器会通过此提供程序将下载好的平台安装包交给 Android 安装程序。
zh-CN.disableEffect: OPPO 即时应用更新将无法把安装包交给 Android 安装。

en.description: When the Nekteck app opens a page through this common SDK component, it displays the selected page in a shared container. It hosts SDK pages chosen at runtime.
en.disableEffect: Pages routed through this container will fail to open.

zh-CN.description: Nekteck 应用通过此通用 SDK 屏幕打开页面时，它会创建指定页面并显示在共享容器中，用于承载运行时选定的 SDK 页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 经由此容器打开的页面将无法显示。

en.description: The Nekteck common SDK runs this service during Bluetooth device discovery. It scans for nearby compatible devices and reports scan results and failures.
en.disableEffect: The app will no longer discover nearby Nekteck devices through this background Bluetooth scan.

zh-CN.description: Nekteck 通用 SDK 会启动此服务来发现蓝牙设备。它会扫描附近的兼容设备，并报告扫描结果和失败情况。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法通过此后台蓝牙扫描发现附近的 Nekteck 设备。

en.description: The Nekteck common SDK uses this shared component to provide common setup for its app pages. Many of the app screens rely on it.
en.disableEffect: Screens built on this shared base may fail to open or behave correctly.

zh-CN.description: Nekteck 通用 SDK 使用此基础页面为其他应用屏幕提供通用设置。许多应用屏幕都依赖它。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此基础页面的其他屏幕可能无法正常打开或运行。

en.description: This Nekteck common SDK screen opens the online AI support chat for a product or device question. It sends product and device details, the question, and diagnostic details as context.
en.disableEffect: The AI support chat inside the app will not open, and users cannot send device context with a support question.

zh-CN.description: Nekteck 通用 SDK 的此页面会打开在线 AI 客服，用于咨询产品或设备问题。它会将产品和设备信息、问题及诊断信息作为上下文发送。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用内 AI 客服将无法打开，用户也无法在咨询时附上设备信息。

en.description: The Nekteck common SDK opens this screen when users choose to add a device. It loads supported device types and lets them select a model to continue setup.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to start adding a Nekteck device from the device list.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择添加设备时，Nekteck 通用 SDK 会打开此页面。它会加载支持的设备类型，并让用户选择型号继续设置。

zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在应用中更改账号密码。

en.description: The Nekteck common SDK opens this screen to confirm and submit a request to close the signed in account.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to request account closure from the app.

zh-CN.description: Nekteck 通用 SDK 会打开此页面，供用户确认并提交关闭已登录账号的请求。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过应用申请关闭账号。

en.description: The Nekteck common SDK opens this screen when users need to recover a forgotten password. It collects the account and starts the reset verification flow.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to start password recovery from the app.

zh-CN.description: 用户忘记密码时，Nekteck 通用 SDK 会打开此页面。页面会收集账号信息并启动重置验证流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在应用中启动密码找回流程。

en.description: The Nekteck common SDK opens this screen to verify the emailed code used during password recovery and continue the reset process.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to complete the email verification step of password recovery.

zh-CN.description: Nekteck 通用 SDK 会打开此页面，验证密码找回过程中发送到邮箱的验证码，并继续重置流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法完成密码找回的邮箱验证步骤。

en.description: The Nekteck common SDK opens this screen to edit and save the signed in user's account nickname.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to change the account nickname in the app.

zh-CN.description: Nekteck 通用 SDK 会打开此页面，供已登录用户编辑并保存账号昵称。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在应用中更改账号昵称。

en.description: The Nekteck common SDK displays the signed in user's profile and lets them update profile details such as the nickname or photo.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to view or edit their account profile in the app.

zh-CN.description: Nekteck 通用 SDK 会显示已登录用户的个人资料，并允许更新昵称或头像等信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在应用中查看或编辑账号资料。

en.description: The Nekteck common SDK opens the current privacy policy in an embedded browser. It supplies language and account context to the page.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to read the privacy policy inside the app.

zh-CN.description: Nekteck 通用 SDK 会在内嵌浏览器中打开当前隐私政策，并向页面提供语言和账号信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在应用内阅读隐私政策。
