en.description: The Nekteck common SDK opens the current terms of service in an embedded browser and supplies language and account context.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to read the terms of service inside the app.

zh-CN.description: Nekteck 通用 SDK 会在内嵌浏览器中打开当前服务条款，并向页面提供语言和账号信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在应用内阅读服务条款。

en.description: The Nekteck common SDK opens a product or support web page inside the app. It passes the selected product and account details so the page can show relevant content.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to open this product or support page inside the app.

zh-CN.description: Nekteck 通用 SDK 会在应用内打开产品或客服网页，并传递所选产品和账号信息以显示相关内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开此应用内产品或客服页面。

en.description: Routee Mobile MFA opens this screen for a one-time-code check, reads the verification code from an SMS, and submits it to Routee for confirmation.
en.disableEffect: SMS one-time-code sign-in or identity checks through Routee may not complete.

zh-CN.description: Routee Mobile MFA 会在进行一次性验证码验证时打开此页面，从短信中读取验证码并提交给 Routee 确认。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过 Routee 进行的短信验证码登录或身份验证可能无法完成。

en.description: Routee Mobile MFA starts this foreground service when continuous location tracking is requested; it asks for location access, tracks location updates, and sends them to the service backend.
en.disableEffect: MFA flows that rely on continuous location updates may not be able to complete their location check.

zh-CN.description: Routee Mobile MFA 在需要持续定位时启动此前台服务，申请定位权限、收集位置更新并发送到服务端。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖持续位置更新的多重验证流程可能无法完成定位检查。

en.description: Routee Mobile MFA displays verification numbers for the user to choose from, then submits the selected number with an action token to complete the check.
en.disableEffect: The corresponding number-based identity verification step may not complete.

zh-CN.description: Routee Mobile MFA 会显示多个验证号码供用户选择，再将所选号码和操作凭证提交以完成验证。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 相应的数字验证步骤可能无法完成。

en.description: Routee Mobile MFA opens a meeting or video-verification page and requests camera or microphone access when that session needs it.
en.disableEffect: Routee video calls and video identity checks may not open or complete.

zh-CN.description: Routee Mobile MFA 会在视频通话或视频身份核验时打开会议页面，并在需要时申请摄像头或麦克风权限。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Routee 视频通话和视频身份核验可能无法打开或完成。

en.description: This NetAlo Chat SDK receiver handles Google's SMS Retriever result for one-time-code login. It can pass the text-message consent prompt to the login screen or report a retrieval timeout; the analyzed release does not activate it during normal login.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it has no user-visible effect in the analyzed release because this receiver is not activated.

zh-CN.description: 这是 NetAlo 聊天 SDK 中处理 Google 短信读取结果的接收器，可将短信授权提示交给登录界面，或报告读取超时；分析的版本不会在正常登录时启用它。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 分析的版本没有启用此接收器，因此停用它不会带来可见影响。

en.description: The NetAlo Chat SDK receives Firebase push messages for chats, secret chats, and calls, then updates message data or starts the incoming-call notification flow. It runs when Firebase delivers a message.
en.disableEffect: Messages and incoming calls may stop syncing or alerting while the app is in the background.

zh-CN.description: NetAlo 聊天 SDK 会接收聊天、私密聊天和通话的 Firebase 推送，并更新消息数据或启动来电通知流程。Firebase 投递消息时会运行此服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用在后台时，消息和来电可能无法同步或发出提醒。

en.description: The NetAlo Chat SDK opens its account sign-in and verification screens here, including password, one-time-code, and profile-update flows. It is used when the embedded chat service asks the user to sign in.
en.disableEffect: Users may be unable to sign in to the NetAlo chat service.

zh-CN.description: NetAlo 聊天 SDK 会在此打开账户登录和验证界面，包括密码、一次性验证码和资料更新流程。嵌入的聊天服务要求用户登录时会使用此界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户可能无法登录 NetAlo 聊天服务。

en.description: This NetAlo Chat SDK receiver handles Answer and Decline taps on incoming-call notifications. Answer opens the call screen; Decline sends a request to reject the call.
en.disableEffect: The notification buttons may stop handling calls, so users may have to open NetAlo to respond.

zh-CN.description: NetAlo 聊天 SDK 会在此处理来电通知上的“接听”和“拒绝”操作。“接听”会打开通话界面，“拒绝”会发送拒接请求。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通知按钮可能无法处理来电，用户可能需要打开 NetAlo 才能响应。

en.description: The NetAlo Chat SDK starts this foreground service for incoming calls; it rings or vibrates and shows a full-screen notification with Answer and Decline buttons.
en.disableEffect: Incoming calls may lose their background ringing, full-screen alert, and notification controls.

zh-CN.description: NetAlo 聊天 SDK 会在来电时启动此前台服务，使手机响铃或振动，并显示带有“接听”和“拒绝”按钮的全屏通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 来电可能不再响铃或显示全屏提醒，通知中的操作按钮也会失效。

en.description: During an active NetAlo call, this service keeps an ongoing notification with the caller, call type, and elapsed time when the call screen moves to the background. Tapping the notification returns to NetAlo.
en.disableEffect: The ongoing call notice and its return-to-call shortcut may be unavailable while the call screen is in the background.

zh-CN.description: NetAlo 通话界面转入后台后，此服务会显示持续通知，列出通话对象、通话类型和已通话时间。点击通知可返回 NetAlo。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通话界面在后台时，持续通话通知及返回通话的入口可能无法使用。

en.description: This is the NetAlo Chat SDK screen for an incoming audio or video call. The user can answer or end the call, and the screen can appear over the lock screen when a call arrives.
en.disableEffect: Users may be unable to answer incoming calls through NetAlo.

zh-CN.description: 这是 NetAlo 聊天 SDK 的音频或视频来电界面，用户可在此接听或结束通话；来电时界面也可显示在锁屏上方。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户可能无法通过 NetAlo 接听来电。

en.description: This is the NetAlo Chat SDK screen for an outgoing audio or video call. It starts the call connection and lets the user manage or end the call.
en.disableEffect: Users may be unable to place or control outgoing NetAlo calls.

zh-CN.description: 这是 NetAlo 聊天 SDK 的音频或视频去电界面，可发起通话连接并让用户管理或结束通话。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户可能无法通过 NetAlo 发起或控制去电。

en.description: The NetAlo Chat SDK uses this Activity as its main embedded messaging screen, showing conversations and related chat views. It also routes call and share notifications back into those views.
en.disableEffect: The embedded NetAlo chat interface and its call or sharing entry points may not open.

zh-CN.description: NetAlo 聊天 SDK 使用此界面作为嵌入式消息主界面，显示会话和聊天内容，并将来电或分享通知带回相应界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 嵌入的 NetAlo 聊天界面以及通话或分享入口可能无法打开。

en.description: The NetAlo Chat SDK opens this media and document picker when a user chooses an attachment. It returns the selected items to the chat flow.
en.disableEffect: Users may be unable to choose media or documents to attach in NetAlo chats.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择聊天附件时，NetAlo 聊天 SDK 会打开此媒体和文档选择界面，并将所选内容交回聊天流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户可能无法在 NetAlo 聊天中选择要附加的媒体或文档。

en.description: The NetAlo Chat SDK incoming-call notification sends its Answer and Decline taps here. Answer opens the call screen; Decline sends a rejection request and removes the notification.
en.disableEffect: The incoming-call notification buttons may stop working, preventing users from answering or rejecting calls from the notification.

zh-CN.description: NetAlo 聊天 SDK 的来电通知会在此处理“接听”和“拒绝”操作。“接听”会打开通话界面，“拒绝”会发送拒接请求并移除通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 来电通知按钮可能失效，用户将无法直接从通知接听或拒绝来电。

en.description: When a user shares live location through NetAlo Chat, this foreground service requests location updates and sends them to the shared conversation. It also shows a persistent live-location notification.
en.disableEffect: Recipients will no longer receive the sender’s changing location during a live-location share.

zh-CN.description: 用户通过 NetAlo 聊天分享实时位置时，此前台服务会持续获取位置更新并发送到共享会话，同时显示持续通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 实时位置分享期间，接收者将无法继续收到发送者更新后的位置。

en.description: The NetEase Cloud Music IoT SDK starts this Service while its processes coordinate multi-device tasks. It keeps the SDK's cross-process requests available while those tasks are active.
en.disableEffect: IoT SDK actions that rely on communication between app processes may stop working.

zh-CN.description: 网易云音乐多终端 IoT SDK 在不同进程协调多设备任务时会启动此 Service，并在任务期间提供进程间请求通道。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖应用进程间通信的 IoT SDK 操作可能无法使用。

en.description: When the app opens the IoT SDK's sound-tuning screen, this Activity provides equalizer, reverb and other audio adjustments, and can load a sample playlist for preview.
en.disableEffect: The app's audio-tuning controls and the SDK's sample-playback preview will not open.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开 IoT SDK 的声音调节界面时，此 Activity 提供均衡器、混响等音效调整，并可加载试听歌单。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用的音效调节控件和 SDK 试听歌单将无法打开。

en.description: The NetEase Cloud Music Media Controller SDK uses this Android notification-access service to find the app's active playback sessions when media control is initialized.
en.disableEffect: Remote media controls may no longer find or control active playback, so the media-controller feature can stop working.

zh-CN.description: 网易云音乐媒体控制 SDK 使用此 Android 通知访问 Service，在初始化媒体控制时查找应用当前的播放会话。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 远程媒体控制可能无法查找或控制正在播放的内容，媒体控制功能可能失效。

en.description: When a LuckyCat ad offers a downloaded app, the ad SDK uses this file provider to give Android's installer access to the APK.
en.disableEffect: Downloaded ad offers may fail to install because the SDK cannot share the APK with Android's installer.

zh-CN.description: LuckyCat 广告提供下载应用时，广告 SDK 会通过此文件 Provider 将 APK 提供给 Android 安装程序。
zh-CN.disableEffect: SDK 无法向 Android 安装程序分享 APK，广告下载应用可能无法安装。

en.description: When the LuckyCat ad SDK shows a rewarded ad in landscape orientation, this Activity plays the full-screen video and reports whether viewing finished.
en.disableEffect: Rewarded video ads will not open, so rewards for watching ads will no longer be granted.

zh-CN.description: LuckyCat 广告 SDK 以横屏展示激励广告时，此 Activity 会播放全屏视频并反馈观看是否完成。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 激励视频广告将无法打开，观看广告的奖励也将不再发放。

en.description: When the LuckyCat ad SDK shows a rewarded ad in portrait orientation, this Activity plays the full-screen video and reports whether viewing finished.
en.disableEffect: Rewarded video ads will not open, so rewards for watching ads will no longer be granted.

zh-CN.description: LuckyCat 广告 SDK 以竖屏展示激励广告时，此 Activity 会播放全屏视频并反馈观看是否完成。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 激励视频广告将无法打开，观看广告的奖励也将不再发放。

en.description: When a user opens an ad destination, LuckyCat displays the landing page in a WebView and handles ad download or app-install links.
en.disableEffect: Ad landing pages and the download or install flows they open will no longer work.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开广告目标页时，LuckyCat 会在 WebView 中显示落地页，并处理广告下载或应用安装链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 广告落地页及其触发的下载或安装流程将无法使用。

en.description: When a game purchase starts, NetEase Cloud Music Game SDK opens this Activity to show purchasable goods and prices, then continues to the selected payment flow.
en.disableEffect: The SDK's purchase screen will not open, so purchases through this game SDK cannot complete.

zh-CN.description: 游戏发起购买时，网易云音乐游戏联运 SDK 会打开此 Activity，显示可购买商品和价格，并继续进入所选支付流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: SDK 的购买页面将无法打开，通过此游戏 SDK 发起的购买无法完成。

en.description: When the game SDK needs to show a play-limit reminder, this Activity displays the supplied message and a confirmation button.
en.disableEffect: The game SDK's required play-limit notice may not appear, so its play-restriction flow can fail.

zh-CN.description: 游戏 SDK 需要提示游玩限制时，此 Activity 会显示传入的提示内容和确认按钮。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 游戏 SDK 的必要游玩限制提示可能无法显示，相关限制流程可能失效。

en.description: When the game SDK needs to show a general notice, this Activity displays the supplied message with a confirmation button.
en.disableEffect: A game SDK flow that needs this notice may fail to open or lose its confirmation step.

zh-CN.description: 游戏 SDK 需要显示一般提示时，此 Activity 会展示传入的内容和确认按钮。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此提示的游戏 SDK 流程可能无法打开，或无法完成确认步骤。

en.description: When the game SDK needs an account sign-in, this Activity lets the user submit a login and returns the result to the game.
en.disableEffect: The SDK's sign-in flow will not open, preventing access to game sessions that require an account.

zh-CN.description: 游戏 SDK 需要账号登录时，此 Activity 会让用户提交登录信息，并将结果返回给游戏。
zh-CN.disableEffect: SDK 的登录流程将无法打开，需要账号的游戏会话无法进入。

en.description: When the game requires sign-in before continuing, this Activity shows the login dialog and prevents backing out until the sign-in flow is resolved.
en.disableEffect: A required sign-in flow cannot complete, which can block access to the game.

zh-CN.description: 游戏要求先登录才能继续时，此 Activity 会显示登录对话框，并阻止用户在登录流程结束前返回。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 必要的登录流程无法完成，用户可能因此无法进入游戏。

en.description: When the game requires real-name verification, this Activity shows the verification form and prevents backing out until the check is resolved.
en.disableEffect: The game's required identity check may not complete, blocking access to play.

zh-CN.description: 游戏要求实名认证时，此 Activity 会显示验证表单，并阻止用户在验证流程结束前返回。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 游戏所需的身份验证可能无法完成，用户可能因此无法游玩。

en.description: When the game SDK requests real-name verification, this Activity collects the user's name and identity number and submits them for verification.
en.disableEffect: The game's identity-verification flow cannot finish, so accounts that require verification may not be able to play.

zh-CN.description: 游戏 SDK 请求实名认证时，此 Activity 会收集用户姓名和证件号码并提交验证。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 游戏的身份验证流程将无法完成，需要验证的账号可能无法游玩。

en.description: During NetEase account sign-in, the game SDK opens its online authorization page in a WebView and returns the result to the game.
en.disableEffect: NetEase account sign-in through the game SDK will fail.

zh-CN.description: 使用网易账号登录时，游戏 SDK 会在 WebView 中打开在线授权页面，并将结果返回给游戏。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过游戏 SDK 进行的网易账号登录将无法完成。

en.description: When a purchase needs web checkout, this Activity opens NetEase Cloud Music's online payment page and handles the payment return.
en.disableEffect: Purchases that use this web payment flow cannot complete.

zh-CN.description: 购买需要网页结算时，此 Activity 会打开网易云音乐在线支付页面并处理支付返回结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此网页支付流程的购买将无法完成。

en.description: When the NetEase iTVPN VPN SDK opens its server picker, this service checks the listed VPN servers and returns their response times for comparison.
en.disableEffect: The server picker loses its live latency results, but users can still choose a server and connect.

zh-CN.description: 网易 iTVPN VPN SDK 打开服务器选择页时，此服务会检测列表中各 VPN 服务器的响应时间，供用户比较。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 服务器选择页将不再显示实时延迟结果，但用户仍可选择服务器并连接。

en.description: When a user opens DNS settings in the NetEase iTVPN VPN SDK, this Activity lets them select a DNS server or add and edit saved DNS addresses.
en.disableEffect: Users can no longer open the DNS picker or change the DNS server used by a VPN connection.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开网易 iTVPN VPN SDK 的 DNS 设置时，此 Activity 可供其选择 DNS 服务器，或添加和编辑已保存的 DNS 地址。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开 DNS 选择页，也无法更改 VPN 连接使用的 DNS 服务器。

en.description: The NetEase iTVPN updater uses this FileProvider to share a downloaded APK with Android's package installer.
en.disableEffect: The updater cannot pass the downloaded APK to Android for installation, so an in-app update may fail to install.

zh-CN.description: 网易 iTVPN 更新程序通过此 FileProvider 将下载的 APK 文件交给 Android 安装程序。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 更新程序将无法把下载的 APK 交给 Android 安装，因此应用内更新可能无法安装。

en.description: When the NetEase iTVPN updater starts a download, this foreground Service downloads the update and reports progress until it finishes.
en.disableEffect: The SDK's in-app updater can no longer download update files through this service.

zh-CN.description: 网易 iTVPN 更新程序开始下载时，此前台 Service 会下载更新文件并报告进度，直到下载完成。
zh-CN.disableEffect: SDK 的应用内更新程序将无法通过此服务下载更新文件。

en.description: When Android reports that a system-managed download has completed, this NetEase iTVPN receiver looks up the downloaded file; it is also registered for download-notification clicks.
en.disableEffect: The SDK's updater will no longer receive this component's handling of Android download-completion broadcasts.

zh-CN.description: Android 通知系统管理的下载已完成时，网易 iTVPN 的此接收器会查询已下载文件；它也注册了下载通知点击事件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: SDK 更新程序将不再收到此组件对 Android 下载完成广播的处理。

en.description: When the NetEase iTVPN SDK presents an app update, this Activity shows the update details and lets the user start or cancel the download, including a required update.
en.disableEffect: Users lose the SDK's in-app update prompt and cannot start an update from it.

zh-CN.description: 网易 iTVPN SDK 提示应用更新时，此 Activity 会显示更新说明，并允许用户开始或取消下载，包括必须安装的更新。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将看不到 SDK 的应用内更新提示，也无法从该提示开始更新。

en.description: After an update download, this NetEase iTVPN Activity guides the user to allow app installation from this source and continues to Android's installer when permission is available.
en.disableEffect: The SDK cannot guide users through installation permission, so installing its downloaded updates may stop.

zh-CN.description: 更新文件下载后，网易 iTVPN 的此 Activity 会引导用户允许此来源安装应用，并在获得许可后继续打开 Android 安装程序。
zh-CN.disableEffect: SDK 将无法引导用户授予安装权限，因此可能无法安装其下载的更新。

en.description: The NetEase iTVPN SDK calls this provider to send VPN login state, VPN configuration, and result messages to registered app callbacks.
en.disableEffect: The SDK's global VPN callbacks cannot be delivered, which can leave host-app screens without VPN status or results.

zh-CN.description: 网易 iTVPN SDK 通过此 Provider 向已注册的应用回调发送 VPN 登录状态、VPN 配置和结果消息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: SDK 的全局 VPN 回调将无法送达，应用界面可能收不到 VPN 状态或操作结果。

en.description: During screen sharing, the NetEase Meeting Android SDK runs this foreground service with an ongoing notification so Android can keep screen capture active.
en.disableEffect: Users may lose screen sharing if Android cannot start the service that keeps capture running.

zh-CN.description: 屏幕共享期间，网易会议 Android SDK 会以前台服务和持续通知运行，以便 Android 保持屏幕采集。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Android 无法启动保持屏幕采集运行的服务，用户可能无法共享屏幕。

en.description: NetEase Yunxin Meeting opens this full-screen Activity when an initialized meeting is launched, allowing users to join or return to the meeting.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open the meeting screen to join or return to a meeting.

zh-CN.description: 网易云信会议 SDK 会在会议已初始化且收到启动请求时打开此全屏 Activity，供用户加入会议或返回会议。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开会议页面来加入或返回会议。

en.description: When the NIM hotfix library checks for an update, this background Service requests patch information, downloads a valid patch and asks the SDK to load it.
en.disableEffect: Automatic NIM hotfix downloads and updates will stop; the app will keep using its installed code until updated another way.

zh-CN.description: NIM 热修复库检查更新时，此后台 Service 会请求补丁信息、下载有效补丁并交由 SDK 加载。
zh-CN.disableEffect: NIM 热修复补丁将不再自动下载和更新；应用会继续运行已安装的代码，直到通过其他方式更新。

en.description: After the NIM hotfix library applies a patch, this Service handles the result, removes the temporary patch file and may restart the app to activate the update.
en.disableEffect: NIM hotfix completion and automatic restart handling will stop; regular app features continue on the installed version.

zh-CN.description: NIM 热修复库应用补丁后，此 Service 会处理结果、删除临时补丁文件，并可能重启应用以启用更新。
zh-CN.disableEffect: NIM 补丁完成后的处理和自动重启将停止；应用常规功能仍使用当前安装版本。

en.description: NetEase NIM coexist uses this provider to pass SDK data between the app and its separate messaging process.
en.disableEffect: The coexist messaging process may fail to initialize, breaking chat and related NIM features.

zh-CN.description: 网易云信 NIM coexist 会通过此 Provider 在应用与独立消息进程之间传递 SDK 数据。
zh-CN.disableEffect: coexist 消息进程可能无法初始化，聊天及相关 NIM 功能可能失效。

en.description: Newer NetEase NIM coexist versions use this provider as the cross-process data endpoint for the messaging engine.
en.disableEffect: The newer coexist messaging process may not initialize or communicate, breaking related NIM features.

zh-CN.description: 较新的网易云信 NIM coexist 版本会使用此 Provider 作为消息引擎的进程间数据入口。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 较新的 coexist 消息进程可能无法初始化或通信，相关 NIM 功能可能失效。

en.description: NetEase NIM coexist reads login details, tokens and SDK settings through this provider when its background process starts or reconnects.
en.disableEffect: The background NIM process may lose its sign-in state and fail to connect, so messaging can break.

zh-CN.description: 网易云信 NIM coexist 会在后台进程启动或重连时，通过此 Provider 读取登录信息、令牌和 SDK 设置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: NIM 后台进程可能丢失登录状态并无法连接，消息功能可能失效。

en.description: Android starts this service for the NIM coexist SDK's scheduled background jobs, including periodic and network-available wakeups.
en.disableEffect: Scheduled NIM background jobs will no longer wake, which may reduce background reconnect and push reliability.

zh-CN.description: Android 会为 NIM coexist SDK 的计划后台任务启动此 Service，包括定时及网络可用时的唤醒任务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: NIM 计划后台任务将不再唤醒，后台重连和推送可能变得不稳定。

en.description: When NetEase NIM coexist schedules a background heartbeat, this Service reports the check result to the SDK's connection manager.
en.disableEffect: Background NIM push may stop or become delayed while the app is closed.

zh-CN.description: 网易云信 NIM coexist 安排后台心跳时，此 Service 会将检查结果反馈给 SDK 连接管理器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用关闭时，NIM 后台推送可能停止或延迟。

en.description: When connectivity changes or a scheduled alarm fires, this NIM coexist Receiver checks the login state, restarts the messaging service when needed and schedules another check.
en.disableEffect: NIM's scheduled reconnection and background push may stop, so messages can be delayed while the app is closed.

zh-CN.description: 网络状态变化或定时闹钟触发时，NIM coexist Receiver 会检查登录状态，必要时重启消息 Service，并安排下一次检查。
zh-CN.disableEffect: NIM 定时重连和后台推送可能停止，应用关闭时消息可能延迟。

en.description: NetEase NIM coexist starts this Service in its core process to restore login settings and run the messaging engine.
en.disableEffect: NIM coexist sign-in, chat and other features that use the messaging engine may stop working.

zh-CN.description: 网易云信 NIM coexist 会在核心进程中启动此 Service，以恢复登录设置并运行消息引擎。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖 NIM coexist 消息引擎的登录、聊天及其他功能可能无法使用。

en.description: Newer NetEase NIM coexist versions use this Service to start the messaging core for background SDK requests.
en.disableEffect: The newer coexist messaging core may not start, which can break chat and related NIM features.

zh-CN.description: 较新的网易云信 NIM coexist 版本会使用此 Service，为后台 SDK 请求启动消息核心。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 较新的 coexist 消息核心可能无法启动，聊天及相关 NIM 功能可能失效。

en.description: When the NIM coexist push process needs to wake the app's visible process, this Receiver handles the internal wake-up broadcast.
en.disableEffect: Background push may no longer wake the app process, so message notifications can be missed.

zh-CN.description: NIM coexist 推送进程需要唤醒应用前台进程时，此 Receiver 会处理内部唤醒广播。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 后台推送可能无法唤醒应用进程，用户可能错过消息提醒。

en.description: When NIM coexist push needs to wake the app, this Service starts and brings the visible process online, using a foreground notification when Android requires it.
en.disableEffect: Background push may no longer wake the app process, so message notifications can be missed.

zh-CN.description: NIM coexist 推送需要唤醒应用时，此 Service 会启动并唤醒前台进程；Android 要求时会显示前台通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 后台推送可能无法唤醒应用进程，用户可能错过消息提醒。

en.description: NetEase NIM uses this provider to pass SDK data between the app and its separate messaging process when the core process needs NIM state.
en.disableEffect: NIM initialization and messaging features that rely on the core process may fail.

zh-CN.description: 网易云信 NIM 会通过此 Provider 在应用与独立消息进程之间传递 SDK 数据，供核心进程读取 NIM 状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖核心进程的 NIM 初始化和消息功能可能失效。

en.description: In newer NetEase NIM versions, this provider is the cross-process data endpoint for the messaging engine.
en.disableEffect: The newer NIM messaging process may not initialize or communicate, which can break chat and related features.

zh-CN.description: 在较新的网易云信 NIM 版本中，此 Provider 是消息引擎的进程间数据入口。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 较新的 NIM 消息进程可能无法初始化或通信，聊天及相关功能可能失效。

en.description: NetEase NIM uses this provider to keep saved login details, messaging settings and session state available to the app's background services. The SDK reads this information when signing in, reconnecting or restoring messages.
en.disableEffect: NIM login, reconnection or message state may fail in apps that use these SDK processes.

zh-CN.description: NetEase NIM 使用此提供程序，让应用的后台服务也能读取已保存的登录信息、消息设置和会话状态。SDK 会在登录、重新连接或恢复消息时读取这些信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用这些 NIM 进程的应用可能无法正常登录、重新连接或处理消息状态。

en.description: NetEase Yunxin IM declares this Service for Android's scheduled background jobs. In the inspected releases it ends immediately without doing visible work.
en.disableEffect: No direct app feature effect is evident in the analyzed code, though Android will no longer be able to start this SDK job hook.

zh-CN.description: 网易云信 IM SDK 为 Android 的定时后台任务声明了这个 Service；检查的版本中它会立即结束，没有执行可见工作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 检查到的代码没有显示它会直接影响应用功能，但停用后 Android 将无法启动这一 SDK 任务入口。

en.description: NetEase NIM's push layer, also used by the Yunxin Meeting SDK, starts this Service for scheduled heartbeat checks that keep its background connection active.
en.disableEffect: Background NIM push and incoming-message or meeting-call alerts may stop or arrive late.

zh-CN.description: 网易云信 NIM 的推送模块（云信会议 SDK 也会使用）会启动此 Service，定时执行心跳检查以维持后台连接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: NIM 后台推送以及新消息或会议来电提醒可能停止或延迟。

en.description: In builds that implement it, Android starts this Receiver on network changes and, in some older releases, after device boot; the NetEase Yunxin IM SDK then tries to resume its background connection when a saved login exists. Some bundled Flutter releases contain an empty version.
en.disableEffect: The SDK may not automatically resume background message delivery after a network change or, in older builds, a device reboot.

zh-CN.description: 在实现完整逻辑的版本中，Android 会在网络变化时启动此 Receiver，部分旧版也会在设备开机后启动；若保存了登录信息，网易云信 IM SDK 会尝试恢复后台连接。部分 Flutter 版本中的该组件为空实现。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，网络变化或旧版设备重启后，SDK 可能无法自动恢复后台消息连接。

en.description: NetEase NIM's messaging core starts this Service in a separate process when an app initializes or uses NIM; it restores the SDK's login settings and runs messaging services.
en.disableEffect: NIM sign-in, chat and other features that use its messaging core may stop working.

zh-CN.description: 应用初始化或使用网易云信 NIM 时，消息核心会在独立进程中启动此 Service，恢复 SDK 登录设置并运行消息服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖 NIM 消息核心的登录、聊天及其他功能可能无法使用。

en.description: The NetEase Yunxin IM SDK starts this auxiliary Service in its background process to help keep messaging available; Android may restart it after it stops.
en.disableEffect: The SDK loses this background keep-alive path, which may interrupt message delivery while the app is closed.

zh-CN.description: 网易云信 IM SDK 会在后台进程中启动这个辅助 Service，以维持消息服务可用；服务停止后，Android 可能会重新启动它。
zh-CN.disableEffect: SDK 的这条后台保活路径会失效，应用关闭时的消息传递可能中断。

en.description: Newer NetEase NIM versions use this Service to start the messaging core for background SDK requests.
en.disableEffect: The newer NIM messaging core may not start, which can break chat and related features.

zh-CN.description: 较新的网易云信 NIM 版本会使用此 Service，为后台 SDK 请求启动消息核心。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 较新的 NIM 消息核心可能无法启动，聊天及相关功能可能失效。

en.description: NetEase Yunxin IM uses this Receiver when background push handling needs to wake the app's main process. It resumes the SDK's pending message work after an internal broadcast.
en.disableEffect: The SDK may fail to resume background message handling after a push arrives.

zh-CN.description: 网易云信 IM SDK 在后台推送需要唤醒应用主进程时会使用此 Receiver；收到内部广播后，它会恢复 SDK 尚未处理的消息工作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 推送到达后，SDK 可能无法恢复后台消息处理。

en.description: NetEase Yunxin IM starts this Service to wake its main process during background push handling. On Android versions that require it, the Service briefly shows a foreground notification before resuming the pending work.
en.disableEffect: Background push may not wake the app, delaying incoming message handling until the app is opened.

zh-CN.description: 网易云信 IM SDK 会在处理后台推送时启动此 Service，以唤醒应用主进程；在 Android 要求时，它会短暂显示前台通知，再恢复待处理的消息工作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 后台推送可能无法唤醒应用，新消息的处理可能要等到用户打开应用。

en.description: When NetEase Yidun quick login uses China Mobile authentication, this Activity displays the carrier sign-in screen and handles the phone-number login flow. Disabling it breaks that login option.
en.disableEffect: Users may be unable to sign in with China Mobile's phone-number verification flow.

zh-CN.description: 网易易盾快捷登录使用中国移动号码认证时，此 Activity 会显示运营商登录界面并处理手机号认证流程。停用后，该登录方式会失效。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户可能无法使用中国移动手机号认证登录。

en.description: When a user opens a carrier agreement during NetEase Yidun quick login, this Activity loads the agreement in a web page and lets the user review it. Disabling it can interrupt the login consent flow.
en.disableEffect: Users may be unable to review a carrier agreement required to continue phone-number login.

zh-CN.description: 用户在网易易盾快捷登录中查看运营商协议时，此 Activity 会在网页中加载协议供用户阅读。停用后，登录授权流程可能中断。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户可能无法查看继续手机号登录所需的运营商协议。

en.description: When NetEase Yidun starts its one-tap phone-number login flow, this Activity displays the quick-login screen and handles its lifecycle and result. Disabling it can prevent that authentication flow from completing.
en.disableEffect: Users may be unable to complete Yidun's phone-number quick login.

zh-CN.description: 网易易盾启动一键手机号登录时，此 Activity 会显示快捷登录界面并处理登录流程及结果。停用后，手机号认证可能无法完成。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户可能无法完成网易易盾的一键手机号登录。

en.description: NetEase Yunxin AI Search opens this page with an optional search phrase, sends the query to its search feature, and displays matching messages.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot search for and view results through this AI Search page.

zh-CN.description: 网易云信 AI 搜索会打开此页面，可带入搜索词、执行搜索并展示匹配的消息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此 AI 搜索页面查找和查看结果。

en.description: NetEase Yunxin IM ChatKit opens the one-to-one AI conversation when the app routes a user to its AI chat screen. It displays messages for that conversation.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open the AI chat conversation, so its messages and replies are unavailable.

zh-CN.description: 网易云信 IM ChatKit 在应用打开 AI 私聊页面时显示对应的单聊内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开 AI 私聊，也无法查看或发送其中的消息。

en.description: NetEase Yunxin IM ChatKit shows the topic conversations for an AI bot when the app opens that bot's conversation list. Users can search the list, create a topic conversation, and open one.
en.disableEffect: Users lose access to the AI bot's separate topic conversations and cannot create or open them.

zh-CN.description: 网易云信 IM ChatKit 在应用打开 AI 机器人的会话列表时显示各个主题会话，用户可以搜索、创建并打开主题会话。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法查看、创建或打开 AI 机器人的主题会话。

en.description: NetEase Yunxin IM ChatKit opens a topic conversation with an AI bot when the app passes that bot and topic. It displays the messages in that conversation.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open or continue the selected AI bot topic conversation.

zh-CN.description: 网易云信 IM ChatKit 在应用打开 AI 机器人的某个主题会话时显示其中的聊天消息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开或继续该 AI 机器人的主题会话。

en.description: NetEase Yunxin IM ChatKit displays the messages inside a combined forwarded message when a user opens it. Users can inspect the included messages and their attachments.
en.disableEffect: Users may not be able to read the messages and attachments inside a combined forwarded message.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开合并转发的消息时，网易云信 IM ChatKit 会展示其中的消息和附件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法查看合并转发消息中的内容和附件。

en.description: NetEase Yunxin IM ChatKit opens a one-to-one conversation when the app routes to a contact chat. It displays the conversation's messages.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open this one-to-one conversation, so reading or sending its messages may fail.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开联系人私聊时，网易云信 IM ChatKit 会显示该单聊及其中的消息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开该单聊，消息查看和发送也会受到影响。

en.description: NetEase Yunxin IM ChatKit lists the messages pinned in a conversation when a user opens its pinned-message page. Selecting an item returns to that message in the chat.
en.disableEffect: Users lose access to pinned messages and cannot use this page to jump back to them.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开会话的置顶消息页面时，网易云信 IM ChatKit 会列出置顶内容，并可跳回对应消息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法查看置顶消息或通过此页面跳回原消息。

en.description: NetEase Yunxin IM ChatKit shows which team members have and have not read a selected group message when the app opens its read-status details.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot see the read and unread member lists for group messages.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开群消息的阅读状态详情时，网易云信 IM ChatKit 会显示已读和未读成员。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法查看群消息的已读和未读成员列表。

en.description: NetEase Yunxin IM ChatKit searches messages in a conversation when the app opens its search page. Users can enter a keyword, view matching messages, and open a result.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot search that conversation's messages or open a result from this search page.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开会话搜索页时，网易云信 IM ChatKit 可按关键词查找消息、展示匹配结果并打开所选消息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此页面搜索会话消息或打开搜索结果。

en.description: NetEase Yunxin IM ChatKit shows settings for a one-to-one conversation, including notification muting, pinning, message search, and creating a group with the contact.
en.disableEffect: Users lose the conversation settings controls, including notification and pinning options.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开私聊设置时，网易云信 IM ChatKit 会提供消息免打扰、置顶、聊天记录搜索以及与联系人创建群聊等选项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法使用该会话的设置，包括免打扰和置顶选项。

en.description: NetEase Yunxin IM ChatKit opens a team conversation when the app routes to a group chat. It displays the group's messages and handles new messages passed to the open conversation.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open this group conversation, so reading or sending its messages may fail.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开群聊时，网易云信 IM ChatKit 会显示群消息，并处理传入的会话消息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开该群聊，消息查看和发送也会受到影响。

en.description: NetEase Yunxin IM ChatKit lists messages a user has saved from conversations. Users can open, remove, or forward saved items.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot view or manage saved chat messages on this page.

zh-CN.description: 网易云信 IM ChatKit 会列出用户从聊天中收藏的消息，并支持打开、删除或转发。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在此页面查看或管理收藏的聊天消息。

en.description: NetEase Yunxin IM ChatKit lets users choose a date while searching a conversation, then finds a message from that date and opens it in the chat.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot locate conversation messages by date through this search flow.

zh-CN.description: 用户按日期查找聊天记录时，网易云信 IM ChatKit 提供日期选择，并定位到对应日期的消息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此搜索流程按日期定位聊天消息。

en.description: NetEase Yunxin IM ChatKit lists files shared in the selected conversation when a user chooses file search. Users can open or manage a file result.
en.disableEffect: Users may not be able to find or open files shared in that conversation.

zh-CN.description: 用户在会话中选择文件搜索时，网易云信 IM ChatKit 会列出分享过的文件，并可打开或管理搜索结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将难以查找或打开该会话中分享的文件。

en.description: NetEase Yunxin IM ChatKit provides message search for a conversation. Users can search by text or open focused searches for members, images, videos, dates, and files.
en.disableEffect: Users lose the conversation search page and its shortcuts to message, media, member, date, and file searches.

zh-CN.description: 网易云信 IM ChatKit 提供会话消息搜索，用户可按文字查找，也可进入成员、图片、视频、日期或文件搜索。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法使用此会话搜索页及其消息、媒体、成员、日期和文件搜索入口。

en.description: NetEase Yunxin IM ChatKit lists images or videos shared in a conversation when a user opens the matching media search. Selecting an item opens the media viewer.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot find or open images and videos through this conversation search page.

zh-CN.description: 用户搜索会话中的图片或视频时，网易云信 IM ChatKit 会列出对应媒体，选择后可打开查看。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此页面查找或打开会话中的图片和视频。

en.description: NetEase Yunxin IM ChatKit lets users choose a team member and view messages sent by that member in the group conversation.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot search group conversation messages by sender through this page.

zh-CN.description: 网易云信 IM ChatKit 可按群成员查找群聊消息，用户选择成员后会看到该成员发送的内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此页面按发送者搜索群聊消息。

en.description: NetEase Yunxin IM ChatKit opens the one-to-one AI conversation when the app routes a user to its AI chat screen. It displays messages for that conversation.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open the AI chat conversation, so its messages and replies are unavailable.

zh-CN.description: 网易云信 IM ChatKit 在应用打开 AI 私聊页面时显示对应的单聊内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开 AI 私聊，也无法查看或发送其中的消息。

en.description: NetEase Yunxin IM ChatKit shows the topic conversations for an AI bot when the app opens that bot's conversation list. Users can search the list, create a topic conversation, and open one.
en.disableEffect: Users lose access to the AI bot's separate topic conversations and cannot create or open them.

zh-CN.description: 网易云信 IM ChatKit 在应用打开 AI 机器人的会话列表时显示各个主题会话，用户可以搜索、创建并打开主题会话。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法查看、创建或打开 AI 机器人的主题会话。

en.description: NetEase Yunxin IM ChatKit opens a topic conversation with an AI bot when the app passes that bot and topic. It displays the messages in that conversation.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open or continue the selected AI bot topic conversation.

zh-CN.description: 网易云信 IM ChatKit 在应用打开 AI 机器人的某个主题会话时显示其中的聊天消息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开或继续该 AI 机器人的主题会话。

en.description: NetEase Yunxin IM ChatKit displays the messages inside a combined forwarded message when a user opens it. Users can inspect the included messages and their attachments.
en.disableEffect: Users may not be able to read the messages and attachments inside a combined forwarded message.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开合并转发的消息时，网易云信 IM ChatKit 会展示其中的消息和附件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法查看合并转发消息中的内容和附件。

en.description: NetEase Yunxin IM ChatKit opens a one-to-one conversation when the app routes to a contact chat. It displays the conversation's messages.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open this one-to-one conversation, so reading or sending its messages may fail.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开联系人私聊时，网易云信 IM ChatKit 会显示该单聊及其中的消息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开该单聊，消息查看和发送也会受到影响。

en.description: NetEase Yunxin IM ChatKit lists the messages pinned in a conversation when a user opens its pinned-message page. Selecting an item returns to that message in the chat.
en.disableEffect: Users lose access to pinned messages and cannot use this page to jump back to them.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开会话的置顶消息页面时，网易云信 IM ChatKit 会列出置顶内容，并可跳回对应消息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法查看置顶消息或通过此页面跳回原消息。

en.description: NetEase Yunxin IM ChatKit shows which team members have and have not read a selected group message when the app opens its read-status details.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot see the read and unread member lists for group messages.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开群消息的阅读状态详情时，网易云信 IM ChatKit 会显示已读和未读成员。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法查看群消息的已读和未读成员列表。

en.description: NetEase Yunxin IM ChatKit searches messages in a conversation when the app opens its search page. Users can enter a keyword, view matching messages, and open a result.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot search that conversation's messages or open a result from this search page.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开会话搜索页时，网易云信 IM ChatKit 可按关键词查找消息、展示匹配结果并打开所选消息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此页面搜索会话消息或打开搜索结果。

en.description: NetEase Yunxin IM ChatKit shows settings for a one-to-one conversation, including notification muting, pinning, message search, and creating a group with the contact.
en.disableEffect: Users lose the conversation settings controls, including notification and pinning options.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开私聊设置时，网易云信 IM ChatKit 会提供消息免打扰、置顶、聊天记录搜索以及与联系人创建群聊等选项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法使用该会话的设置，包括免打扰和置顶选项。

en.description: NetEase Yunxin IM ChatKit opens a team conversation when the app routes to a group chat. It displays the group's messages and handles new messages passed to the open conversation.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open this group conversation, so reading or sending its messages may fail.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开群聊时，网易云信 IM ChatKit 会显示群消息，并处理传入的会话消息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开该群聊，消息查看和发送也会受到影响。

en.description: NetEase Yunxin IM ChatKit lists messages a user has saved from conversations. Users can open, remove, or forward saved items.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot view or manage saved chat messages on this page.

zh-CN.description: 网易云信 IM ChatKit 会列出用户从聊天中收藏的消息，并支持打开、删除或转发。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在此页面查看或管理收藏的聊天消息。

en.description: NetEase Yunxin IM ChatKit opens a selected saved message in detail so users can read its content and open its attachments.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open a saved message's detail view or inspect its attachments from this page.

zh-CN.description: 网易云信 IM ChatKit 会打开所选收藏消息的详情，供用户阅读内容或查看附件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开收藏消息详情或查看其中的附件。

en.description: NetEase Yunxin IM ChatKit provides message search for a conversation. Users can search by text or open focused searches for members, images, videos, dates, and files.
en.disableEffect: Users lose the conversation search page and its shortcuts to message, media, member, date, and file searches.

zh-CN.description: 网易云信 IM ChatKit 提供会话消息搜索，用户可按文字查找，也可进入成员、图片、视频、日期或文件搜索。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法使用此会话搜索页及其消息、媒体、成员、日期和文件搜索入口。

en.description: NetEase Yunxin IM ChatKit lets users choose a date while searching a conversation, then finds a message from that date and opens it in the chat.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot locate conversation messages by date through this search flow.

zh-CN.description: 用户按日期查找聊天记录时，网易云信 IM ChatKit 提供日期选择，并定位到对应日期的消息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此搜索流程按日期定位聊天消息。

en.description: NetEase Yunxin IM ChatKit lists files shared in the selected conversation when a user chooses file search. Users can open or manage a file result.
en.disableEffect: Users may not be able to find or open files shared in that conversation.

zh-CN.description: 用户在会话中选择文件搜索时，网易云信 IM ChatKit 会列出分享过的文件，并可打开或管理搜索结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将难以查找或打开该会话中分享的文件。

en.description: NetEase Yunxin IM ChatKit lists images or videos shared in a conversation when a user opens the matching media search. Selecting an item opens the media viewer.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot find or open images and videos through this conversation search page.

zh-CN.description: 用户搜索会话中的图片或视频时，网易云信 IM ChatKit 会列出对应媒体，选择后可打开查看。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此页面查找或打开会话中的图片和视频。

en.description: NetEase Yunxin IM ChatKit lets users choose a team member and view messages sent by that member in the group conversation.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot search group conversation messages by sender through this page.

zh-CN.description: 网易云信 IM ChatKit 可按群成员查找群聊消息，用户选择成员后会看到该成员发送的内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此页面按发送者搜索群聊消息。

en.description: NetEase Yunxin IM ChatKit shows a map when users choose a location to send or open a location message already in a chat. It displays the selected or previously shared place.
en.disableEffect: Users may not be able to send a location or view location messages in chat.

zh-CN.description: 用户发送位置或打开聊天中的位置消息时，网易云信 IM ChatKit 会显示地图和所选地点。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户可能无法发送位置或查看聊天中的位置消息。

en.description: NetEase Yunxin IM ChatKit opens an image from a chat or search result in a full-screen viewer. Users can move through the supplied image messages and save an image.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open or save chat images through the image viewer.

zh-CN.description: 用户从聊天或搜索结果打开图片时，网易云信 IM ChatKit 会全屏显示图片，并可浏览相关图片或保存图片。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过图片查看器打开或保存聊天图片。

en.description: NetEase Yunxin IM ChatKit plays a video message when a user opens it from a chat or search result. The viewer also offers a save action.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot play or save chat videos through this viewer.

zh-CN.description: 用户从聊天或搜索结果打开视频消息时，网易云信 IM ChatKit 会播放视频并提供保存操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此查看器播放或保存聊天视频。

en.description: The NetEase Yunxin (CommsEase) common UI SDK opens this screen when the app shows a web page in its in-app browser. It provides a title bar and back navigation, and sends other kinds of links to an app that can open them.
en.disableEffect: Web pages that rely on the Yunxin in-app browser will not open.

zh-CN.description: NetEase Yunxin（CommsEase）通用 UI SDK 会在应用需要以内置浏览器打开网页时显示此界面。界面提供标题栏和返回浏览功能；其他类型的链接会交给能够处理它们的应用打开。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，依赖 Yunxin 内置浏览器打开的网页将无法打开。

en.description: The NetEase Yunxin (CommsEase) common UI SDK starts this Activity when it opens the camera or image picker, or shows an Android permission prompt. These actions are used by its photo capture, image selection, and cropping features.
en.disableEffect: Photo capture, image selection, and Yunxin permission requests that use this Activity will not complete.

zh-CN.description: NetEase Yunxin（CommsEase）通用 UI SDK 在打开相机或图片选择器、或者显示 Android 权限请求时会启动此 Activity。这些操作用于 SDK 的拍照、选图和裁剪功能。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，依赖此 Activity 的拍照、选图及 Yunxin 权限请求将无法完成。

en.description: The NetEase Yunxin (CommsEase) common UI SDK opens this portrait screen when a photo needs to be selected or cropped. The user can adjust the crop and save the resulting image for the app to use.
en.disableEffect: Photo flows that require Yunxin cropping will not return a cropped image, so uploads that depend on that result can fail.

zh-CN.description: NetEase Yunxin（CommsEase）通用 UI SDK 会在需要选择或裁剪照片时打开此竖屏界面。用户可以调整裁剪范围并保存图片，供应用后续使用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，依赖 Yunxin 裁剪的照片流程无法获得裁剪结果，依赖该结果的上传可能失败。

en.description: NetEase Yunxin's shared IM library turns a local chat file into a link that app screens can open or share. ChatKit and QChat use it for images, videos, and other message attachments.
en.disableEffect: Sending, opening, or sharing local chat attachments may fail because the app cannot create the file links it expects.

zh-CN.description: 网易云信共享 IM 工具会把本地聊天文件转换为应用页面可打开或分享的链接；ChatKit 和 QChat 会用它处理图片、视频及其他消息附件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用无法生成所需的文件链接时，聊天附件的发送、打开或分享可能失败。

en.description: When a user opens Add Friend and looks up an account, the NetEase Yunxin ContactKit UI SDK finds that person and opens their profile so the user can decide whether to add them.
en.disableEffect: Users can no longer look up an account or open its profile through ContactKit's Add Friend flow.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开“添加好友”并按账号查找时，网易云信 ContactKit UI SDK 会查找该用户并打开其资料页，供用户决定是否添加。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 ContactKit 的添加好友流程查找账号或打开对方资料。

en.description: When a user opens the AI user list, the NetEase Yunxin ContactKit UI SDK loads the app's available AI accounts and lets the user open an account's profile.
en.disableEffect: Users lose the ContactKit screen for browsing AI accounts and opening their profiles.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 AI 用户列表时，网易云信 ContactKit UI SDK 会加载应用中可用的 AI 账号，并允许用户打开账号资料。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 ContactKit 浏览 AI 账号或打开其资料。

en.description: When a user opens the blocked-people list, the NetEase Yunxin ContactKit UI SDK shows blocked contacts and lets the user remove someone from the list.
en.disableEffect: Users can no longer review or unblock contacts through ContactKit.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开黑名单时，网易云信 ContactKit UI SDK 会显示已屏蔽的联系人，并允许用户取消屏蔽。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 ContactKit 查看黑名单或取消屏蔽联系人。

en.description: When a user opens Contacts, the NetEase Yunxin ContactKit UI SDK loads the friend list, shows online status, and provides contact-related shortcuts.
en.disableEffect: Users can no longer open the ContactKit contact list or its related shortcuts.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开联系人页面时，网易云信 ContactKit UI SDK 会加载好友列表、显示在线状态，并提供联系人相关入口。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开 ContactKit 联系人列表及其中的相关入口。

en.description: When the app opens its AI-account binding screen, the NetEase Yunxin ContactKit UI SDK lists available AI accounts and binds the selected account; the screen can also lead to account creation.
en.disableEffect: Users can no longer bind an AI account through ContactKit.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开 AI 账号绑定页面时，网易云信 ContactKit UI SDK 会列出可用的 AI 账号并绑定所选账号；用户也可从此页面进入创建流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 ContactKit 绑定 AI 账号。

en.description: When a user chooses to create an AI account, the NetEase Yunxin ContactKit UI SDK accepts a name and avatar and submits the new account; a binding flow can continue afterward.
en.disableEffect: Users can no longer create an AI account from the ContactKit screens.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择创建 AI 账号时，网易云信 ContactKit UI SDK 会收集名称和头像并提交新账号；若从绑定流程进入，创建后可继续绑定。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 ContactKit 页面创建 AI 账号。

en.description: When a user edits an existing AI account, the NetEase Yunxin ContactKit UI SDK lets them change its name or avatar and save the updated profile.
en.disableEffect: Users can no longer update an AI account's name or avatar through ContactKit.

zh-CN.description: 用户编辑已有 AI 账号时，网易云信 ContactKit UI SDK 会允许用户修改名称或头像并保存资料。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 ContactKit 修改 AI 账号的名称或头像。

en.description: When a user taps an AI account's name while creating or editing it, the NetEase Yunxin ContactKit UI SDK opens a page to change that name and return it to the previous screen.
en.disableEffect: Users can no longer enter or change an AI account's name in the create and edit flows.

zh-CN.description: 用户在创建或编辑 AI 账号时点选名称，网易云信 ContactKit UI SDK 会打开名称编辑页面，并将修改结果返回上一页。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在创建或编辑流程中输入或修改 AI 账号名称。

en.description: When a user opens an AI account from the list, the NetEase Yunxin ContactKit UI SDK shows its profile and offers actions to chat, edit it, view its connection details, refresh its credential, or delete it.
en.disableEffect: Users lose the ContactKit page for viewing and managing an AI account.

zh-CN.description: 用户从列表打开 AI 账号时，网易云信 ContactKit UI SDK 会显示账号资料，并提供聊天、编辑、查看接入信息、更新凭据或删除等操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 ContactKit 查看和管理 AI 账号。

en.description: When a user opens the AI-account list, the NetEase Yunxin ContactKit UI SDK loads the accounts and lets the user open details or start creating an account.
en.disableEffect: Users can no longer browse AI accounts or open the ContactKit creation flow.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 AI 账号列表时，网易云信 ContactKit UI SDK 会加载账号，并允许用户查看详情或开始创建账号。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 ContactKit 浏览 AI 账号或进入创建流程。

en.description: When a user chooses to view an AI account's connection details, the NetEase Yunxin ContactKit UI SDK displays a copyable setup string and hides part of it on screen.
en.disableEffect: Users can no longer view or copy the AI account's setup string through ContactKit.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择查看 AI 账号接入信息时，网易云信 ContactKit UI SDK 会显示可复制的配置字符串，并在页面上隐藏其中一部分。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 ContactKit 查看或复制 AI 账号的接入配置。

en.description: When a user enters a keyword in ContactKit search, the NetEase Yunxin ContactKit UI SDK searches friends and teams or groups, then opens a selected result.
en.disableEffect: Users can no longer search for friends or teams through ContactKit's search screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 ContactKit 搜索中输入关键词时，网易云信 ContactKit UI SDK 会搜索好友、团队或群组，并打开所选结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 ContactKit 搜索好友或团队。

en.description: When an app feature asks the user to choose contacts, the NetEase Yunxin ContactKit UI SDK shows the friend list and returns the selected people to that feature.
en.disableEffect: Features that rely on this picker can no longer receive selected contacts from ContactKit.

zh-CN.description: 应用功能需要用户选择联系人时，网易云信 ContactKit UI SDK 会显示好友列表，并将所选联系人返回给调用该页面的功能。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此选择器的功能将无法从 ContactKit 获取用户选中的联系人。

en.description: When an app feature asks the user to choose people or AI accounts, the NetEase Yunxin ContactKit UI SDK shows friend and AI-account tabs and returns the selection.
en.disableEffect: Features that rely on this picker can no longer receive the selected people or AI accounts.

zh-CN.description: 应用功能需要用户选择联系人或 AI 账号时，网易云信 ContactKit UI SDK 会显示好友和 AI 账号两个列表，并返回所选对象。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此选择器的功能将无法获取用户选中的联系人或 AI 账号。

en.description: When a user chooses recipients for a forwarding action, the NetEase Yunxin ContactKit UI SDK lets them select recent conversations, friends, or teams and returns the chosen destinations.
en.disableEffect: Users can no longer choose forwarding destinations through ContactKit.

zh-CN.description: 用户为转发内容选择接收对象时，网易云信 ContactKit UI SDK 会允许用户从最近会话、好友或团队中选择目标，并返回所选会话。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 ContactKit 选择转发目标。

en.description: When a user opens the team list, the NetEase Yunxin ContactKit UI SDK loads the teams and lets the user open a team or select one for another app feature.
en.disableEffect: Users lose the ContactKit screen for browsing or selecting teams.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开团队列表时，网易云信 ContactKit UI SDK 会加载团队，并允许用户查看团队或为其他应用功能选择团队。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 ContactKit 浏览或选择团队。

en.description: When a user opens a team's profile, the NetEase Yunxin ContactKit UI SDK shows its name, introduction, ID, and owner; it offers chat for a team the user can enter or a request to join when needed.
en.disableEffect: Users can no longer view team details, open its chat, or request to join through this ContactKit page.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开团队资料时，网易云信 ContactKit UI SDK 会显示名称、简介、编号和群主；可进入的团队提供聊天入口，需要加入的团队则可提交加入申请。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此 ContactKit 页面查看团队资料、进入聊天或申请加入。

en.description: When a user searches for a team by its ID, the NetEase Yunxin ContactKit UI SDK looks it up and opens its profile when found.
en.disableEffect: Users can no longer look up a team by ID through ContactKit.

zh-CN.description: 用户按团队编号搜索时，网易云信 ContactKit UI SDK 会查询该团队，并在找到后打开其资料页。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 ContactKit 按编号查找团队。

en.description: When a user edits a contact's note from that person's profile, the NetEase Yunxin ContactKit UI SDK lets them change the name shown for that contact and returns the result.
en.disableEffect: Users can no longer change a contact's note through the ContactKit profile page.

zh-CN.description: 用户从联系人资料页编辑备注时，网易云信 ContactKit UI SDK 会允许用户修改该联系人显示的备注名称并返回结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 ContactKit 联系人资料页修改备注名称。

en.description: When a user opens a person's profile, the NetEase Yunxin ContactKit UI SDK loads contact or AI-account details and offers actions such as chatting, adding a friend, blocking, or removing a friend.
en.disableEffect: Users lose the ContactKit page for viewing a person's details and using its contact actions.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开某人的资料时，网易云信 ContactKit UI SDK 会加载联系人或 AI 账号信息，并根据关系提供聊天、添加好友、屏蔽或删除好友等操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 ContactKit 查看联系人资料或使用资料页中的联系人操作。

en.description: When a user opens contact requests, the NetEase Yunxin ContactKit UI SDK shows friend requests and team-join requests so they can review and respond to them.
en.disableEffect: Users can no longer review and respond to friend or team requests through this ContactKit page.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开联系人验证页面时，网易云信 ContactKit UI SDK 会显示好友申请和团队加入申请，供用户查看并处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此 ContactKit 页面查看或处理好友申请和团队申请。

en.description: When a user opens friend requests, the NetEase Yunxin ContactKit UI SDK lists incoming friend applications and lets the user accept or reject them.
en.disableEffect: Users can no longer review or respond to friend applications through ContactKit.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开好友申请页面时，网易云信 ContactKit UI SDK 会列出收到的好友申请，并允许用户接受或拒绝。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 ContactKit 查看或处理好友申请。

en.description: When a user opens verification messages in the older ContactKit UI, the NetEase Yunxin ContactKit UI SDK lists friend applications and team invitations or join requests, with accept, reject, and clear-all actions.
en.disableEffect: Users can no longer review, respond to, or clear ContactKit friend and team verification messages.

zh-CN.description: 用户在旧版 ContactKit UI 中打开验证消息时，网易云信 ContactKit UI SDK 会列出好友申请、团队邀请或加入申请，并提供接受、拒绝和清空操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 ContactKit 查看、处理或清空好友和团队验证消息。

en.description: When a user opens Add Friend and looks up an account, the NetEase Yunxin ContactKit UI SDK finds that person and opens their profile so the user can decide whether to add them.
en.disableEffect: Users can no longer look up an account or open its profile through ContactKit's Add Friend flow.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开“添加好友”并按账号查找时，网易云信 ContactKit UI SDK 会查找该用户并打开其资料页，供用户决定是否添加。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 ContactKit 的添加好友流程查找账号或打开对方资料。

en.description: When a user opens the AI user list, the NetEase Yunxin ContactKit UI SDK loads the app's available AI accounts and lets the user open an account's profile.
en.disableEffect: Users lose the ContactKit screen for browsing AI accounts and opening their profiles.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 AI 用户列表时，网易云信 ContactKit UI SDK 会加载应用中可用的 AI 账号，并允许用户打开账号资料。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 ContactKit 浏览 AI 账号或打开其资料。

en.description: When a user opens the blocked-people list, the NetEase Yunxin ContactKit UI SDK shows blocked contacts and lets the user remove someone from the list.
en.disableEffect: Users can no longer review or unblock contacts through ContactKit.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开黑名单时，网易云信 ContactKit UI SDK 会显示已屏蔽的联系人，并允许用户取消屏蔽。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 ContactKit 查看黑名单或取消屏蔽联系人。

en.description: When a user opens Contacts, the NetEase Yunxin ContactKit UI SDK loads the friend list, shows online status, and provides contact-related shortcuts.
en.disableEffect: Users can no longer open the ContactKit contact list or its related shortcuts.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开联系人页面时，网易云信 ContactKit UI SDK 会加载好友列表、显示在线状态，并提供联系人相关入口。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开 ContactKit 联系人列表及其中的相关入口。

en.description: When the app opens its AI-account binding screen, the NetEase Yunxin ContactKit UI SDK lists available AI accounts and binds the selected account; the screen can also lead to account creation.
en.disableEffect: Users can no longer bind an AI account through ContactKit.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开 AI 账号绑定页面时，网易云信 ContactKit UI SDK 会列出可用的 AI 账号并绑定所选账号；用户也可从此页面进入创建流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 ContactKit 绑定 AI 账号。

en.description: When a user chooses to create an AI account, the NetEase Yunxin ContactKit UI SDK accepts a name and avatar and submits the new account; a binding flow can continue afterward.
en.disableEffect: Users can no longer create an AI account from the ContactKit screens.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择创建 AI 账号时，网易云信 ContactKit UI SDK 会收集名称和头像并提交新账号；若从绑定流程进入，创建后可继续绑定。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 ContactKit 页面创建 AI 账号。

en.description: When a user edits an existing AI account, the NetEase Yunxin ContactKit UI SDK lets them change its name or avatar and save the updated profile.
en.disableEffect: Users can no longer update an AI account's name or avatar through ContactKit.

zh-CN.description: 用户编辑已有 AI 账号时，网易云信 ContactKit UI SDK 会允许用户修改名称或头像并保存资料。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 ContactKit 修改 AI 账号的名称或头像。

en.description: When a user taps an AI account's name while creating or editing it, the NetEase Yunxin ContactKit UI SDK opens a page to change that name and return it to the previous screen.
en.disableEffect: Users can no longer enter or change an AI account's name in the create and edit flows.

zh-CN.description: 用户在创建或编辑 AI 账号时点选名称，网易云信 ContactKit UI SDK 会打开名称编辑页面，并将修改结果返回上一页。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在创建或编辑流程中输入或修改 AI 账号名称。

en.description: When a user opens an AI account from the list, the NetEase Yunxin ContactKit UI SDK shows its profile and offers actions to chat, edit it, view its connection details, refresh its credential, or delete it.
en.disableEffect: Users lose the ContactKit page for viewing and managing an AI account.

zh-CN.description: 用户从列表打开 AI 账号时，网易云信 ContactKit UI SDK 会显示账号资料，并提供聊天、编辑、查看接入信息、更新凭据或删除等操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 ContactKit 查看和管理 AI 账号。

en.description: When a user opens the AI-account list, the NetEase Yunxin ContactKit UI SDK loads the accounts and lets the user open details or start creating an account.
en.disableEffect: Users can no longer browse AI accounts or open the ContactKit creation flow.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 AI 账号列表时，网易云信 ContactKit UI SDK 会加载账号，并允许用户查看详情或开始创建账号。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 ContactKit 浏览 AI 账号或进入创建流程。

en.description: When a user chooses to view an AI account's connection details, the NetEase Yunxin ContactKit UI SDK displays a copyable setup string and hides part of it on screen.
en.disableEffect: Users can no longer view or copy the AI account's setup string through ContactKit.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择查看 AI 账号接入信息时，网易云信 ContactKit UI SDK 会显示可复制的配置字符串，并在页面上隐藏其中一部分。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 ContactKit 查看或复制 AI 账号的接入配置。

en.description: When a user enters a keyword in ContactKit search, the NetEase Yunxin ContactKit UI SDK searches friends and teams or groups, then opens a selected result.
en.disableEffect: Users can no longer search for friends or teams through ContactKit's search screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 ContactKit 搜索中输入关键词时，网易云信 ContactKit UI SDK 会搜索好友、团队或群组，并打开所选结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 ContactKit 搜索好友或团队。

en.description: When an app feature asks the user to choose contacts, the NetEase Yunxin ContactKit UI SDK shows the friend list and returns the selected people to that feature.
en.disableEffect: Features that rely on this picker can no longer receive selected contacts from ContactKit.

zh-CN.description: 应用功能需要用户选择联系人时，网易云信 ContactKit UI SDK 会显示好友列表，并将所选联系人返回给调用该页面的功能。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此选择器的功能将无法从 ContactKit 获取用户选中的联系人。

en.description: When an app feature asks the user to choose people or AI accounts, the NetEase Yunxin ContactKit UI SDK shows friend and AI-account tabs and returns the selection.
en.disableEffect: Features that rely on this picker can no longer receive the selected people or AI accounts.

zh-CN.description: 应用功能需要用户选择联系人或 AI 账号时，网易云信 ContactKit UI SDK 会显示好友和 AI 账号两个列表，并返回所选对象。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此选择器的功能将无法获取用户选中的联系人或 AI 账号。

en.description: When a user chooses recipients for a forwarding action, the NetEase Yunxin ContactKit UI SDK lets them select recent conversations, friends, or teams and returns the chosen destinations.
en.disableEffect: Users can no longer choose forwarding destinations through ContactKit.

zh-CN.description: 用户为转发内容选择接收对象时，网易云信 ContactKit UI SDK 会允许用户从最近会话、好友或团队中选择目标，并返回所选会话。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 ContactKit 选择转发目标。

en.description: When a user opens the team list, the NetEase Yunxin ContactKit UI SDK loads the teams and lets the user open a team or select one for another app feature.
en.disableEffect: Users lose the ContactKit screen for browsing or selecting teams.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开团队列表时，网易云信 ContactKit UI SDK 会加载团队，并允许用户查看团队或为其他应用功能选择团队。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 ContactKit 浏览或选择团队。

en.description: When a user opens a team's profile, the NetEase Yunxin ContactKit UI SDK shows its name, introduction, ID, and owner; it offers chat for a team the user can enter or a request to join when needed.
en.disableEffect: Users can no longer view team details, open its chat, or request to join through this ContactKit page.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开团队资料时，网易云信 ContactKit UI SDK 会显示名称、简介、编号和群主；可进入的团队提供聊天入口，需要加入的团队则可提交加入申请。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此 ContactKit 页面查看团队资料、进入聊天或申请加入。

en.description: When a user searches for a team by its ID, the NetEase Yunxin ContactKit UI SDK looks it up and opens its profile when found.
en.disableEffect: Users can no longer look up a team by ID through ContactKit.

zh-CN.description: 用户按团队编号搜索时，网易云信 ContactKit UI SDK 会查询该团队，并在找到后打开其资料页。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 ContactKit 按编号查找团队。

en.description: When a user edits a contact's note from that person's profile, the NetEase Yunxin ContactKit UI SDK lets them change the name shown for that contact and returns the result.
en.disableEffect: Users can no longer change a contact's note through the ContactKit profile page.

zh-CN.description: 用户从联系人资料页编辑备注时，网易云信 ContactKit UI SDK 会允许用户修改该联系人显示的备注名称并返回结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 ContactKit 联系人资料页修改备注名称。

en.description: When a user opens a person's profile, the NetEase Yunxin ContactKit UI SDK loads contact or AI-account details and offers actions such as chatting, adding a friend, blocking, or removing a friend.
en.disableEffect: Users lose the ContactKit page for viewing a person's details and using its contact actions.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开某人的资料时，网易云信 ContactKit UI SDK 会加载联系人或 AI 账号信息，并根据关系提供聊天、添加好友、屏蔽或删除好友等操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 ContactKit 查看联系人资料或使用资料页中的联系人操作。

en.description: When a user opens contact requests, the NetEase Yunxin ContactKit UI SDK shows friend requests and team-join requests so they can review and respond to them.
en.disableEffect: Users can no longer review and respond to friend or team requests through this ContactKit page.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开联系人验证页面时，网易云信 ContactKit UI SDK 会显示好友申请和团队加入申请，供用户查看并处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此 ContactKit 页面查看或处理好友申请和团队申请。

en.description: When a user opens friend requests, the NetEase Yunxin ContactKit UI SDK lists incoming friend applications and lets the user accept or reject them.
en.disableEffect: Users can no longer review or respond to friend applications through ContactKit.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开好友申请页面时，网易云信 ContactKit UI SDK 会列出收到的好友申请，并允许用户接受或拒绝。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 ContactKit 查看或处理好友申请。

en.description: When a user opens verification messages in the older ContactKit UI, the NetEase Yunxin ContactKit UI SDK lists friend applications and team invitations or join requests, with accept, reject, and clear-all actions.
en.disableEffect: Users can no longer review, respond to, or clear ContactKit friend and team verification messages.

zh-CN.description: 用户在旧版 ContactKit UI 中打开验证消息时，网易云信 ContactKit UI SDK 会列出好友申请、团队邀请或加入申请，并提供接受、拒绝和清空操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 ContactKit 查看、处理或清空好友和团队验证消息。

en.description: The NetEase Yunxin IM Local Conversation Kit opens this alternate-styled inbox, where users scan recent chats and open a conversation.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open this version of the local conversation inbox.

zh-CN.description: 网易云信 IM 本地会话组件包会在应用进入此页面时显示另一种样式的会话列表，供用户查看最近聊天并打开会话。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法打开这种样式的本地会话列表。

en.description: When users open the local inbox, the NetEase Yunxin IM Local Conversation Kit shows recent conversations and lets them continue into a chat.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open this local conversation list or continue to chats from it.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开本地会话列表时，网易云信 IM 本地会话组件包会显示最近会话，供用户继续进入聊天。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法打开此本地会话列表或从中进入聊天。

en.description: The NetEase Yunxin IM Conversation Kit opens this alternate-styled inbox, where users scan recent chats and open a conversation.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open this version of the conversation inbox.

zh-CN.description: 网易云信 IM 会话组件包会在应用进入此页面时显示另一种样式的会话列表，供用户查看最近聊天并打开会话。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法打开这种样式的会话列表。

en.description: When users add chats to a conversation group, the NetEase Yunxin IM Conversation Kit opens this alternate-styled picker for choosing recent conversations.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot add conversations to a group through this screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户向会话分组添加聊天时，网易云信 IM 会话组件包会打开另一种样式的选择页面，供用户从最近会话中挑选聊天。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过此页面向分组添加会话。

en.description: When users organize the inbox, the NetEase Yunxin IM Conversation Kit opens this alternate-styled page for creating, showing, hiding, and reordering conversation groups.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot manage conversation groups from this version of the inbox.

zh-CN.description: 用户整理会话列表时，网易云信 IM 会话组件包会打开另一种样式的管理页面，供用户创建、显示、隐藏和调整会话分组顺序。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过此样式的页面管理会话分组。

en.description: When users edit a conversation group, the NetEase Yunxin IM Conversation Kit opens this alternate-styled settings page for renaming it, adding or removing chats, or deleting it.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot change or delete a conversation group through this screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户编辑会话分组时，网易云信 IM 会话组件包会打开另一种样式的设置页面，供用户重命名分组、添加或移除聊天，以及删除分组。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过此页面修改或删除会话分组。

en.description: When users open the inbox, the NetEase Yunxin IM Conversation Kit shows recent conversations and lets them continue into a chat.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open this conversation list or continue to chats from it.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开会话列表时，网易云信 IM 会话组件包会显示最近会话，供用户继续进入聊天。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法打开此会话列表或从中进入聊天。

en.description: When an app flow asks users to choose conversations, the NetEase Yunxin IM Conversation Kit displays a selectable list and returns their choices to that flow.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot use this screen to let users choose conversations for the current flow.

zh-CN.description: 应用流程需要用户选择会话时，网易云信 IM 会话组件包会显示可选列表，并将用户的选择返回给该流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用无法通过此页面让用户为当前操作选择会话。

en.description: When users add chats to a conversation group, the NetEase Yunxin IM Conversation Kit opens a picker for choosing recent conversations to include.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot add conversations to a group through this screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户向会话分组添加聊天时，网易云信 IM 会话组件包会打开选择页面，供用户挑选要加入的最近会话。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过此页面向分组添加会话。

en.description: When users organize the inbox, the NetEase Yunxin IM Conversation Kit opens a page for creating, showing, hiding, and reordering conversation groups.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot organize or change the visibility of conversation groups from the inbox.

zh-CN.description: 用户整理会话列表时，网易云信 IM 会话组件包会打开管理页面，供用户创建、显示、隐藏和调整会话分组顺序。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法整理会话分组或更改分组的显示状态。

en.description: When users create a conversation group, the NetEase Yunxin IM Conversation Kit opens a form for entering its name.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot create a named conversation group through this screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户创建会话分组时，网易云信 IM 会话组件包会打开名称输入页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过此页面创建命名的会话分组。

en.description: When users edit a conversation group, the NetEase Yunxin IM Conversation Kit opens settings for renaming it, adding or removing chats, or deleting it.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot change or delete a conversation group through this screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户编辑会话分组时，网易云信 IM 会话组件包会打开设置页面，供用户重命名分组、添加或移除聊天，以及删除分组。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过此页面修改或删除会话分组。

en.description: NetEase Yunxin CoreKit runs this provider when the app starts to find declared Yunxin startup entries and initialize their kits. The analyzed manifests attach ChatKit, AI Search, ContactKit, and ConversationKit services to this startup process.
en.disableEffect: The declared Yunxin kits may not initialize when the app starts, so their chat, contact, conversation, or AI search features can fail.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，网易云信 CoreKit 会通过此 Provider 查找清单中声明的启动项并初始化对应组件；所分析的清单包含 ChatKit、AI Search、ContactKit 和 ConversationKit 服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用启动时网易云信组件可能无法完成初始化，导致聊天、联系人、会话或 AI 搜索功能异常。

en.description: The NetEase Yunxin IM Location Kit opens a map where users can search for and select a place to send in chat, or view a location already shared in a message.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot select, send, or view shared locations through the chat location screen.

zh-CN.description: 网易云信 IM 位置组件包会打开地图，供用户搜索并选择要在聊天中发送的位置，或查看消息中已分享的位置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过聊天中的位置页面选择、发送或查看位置。

en.description: NetEase Yunxin Login opens this in-app browser to load the URL supplied by a login flow, with back navigation through the page history.
en.disableEffect: Login or account pages that use this embedded browser cannot open.

zh-CN.description: 网易云信登录组件会在应用内打开登录流程提供的网址，并支持按页面历史返回。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此内置浏览器的登录或账户页面将无法打开。

en.description: NetEase Yunxin Login opens the email-registration form for users creating an account with an email address.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot register by email through this login kit.

zh-CN.description: 网易云信登录组件会打开邮箱注册表单，供用户使用邮箱创建账户。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此登录组件使用邮箱注册。

en.description: NetEase Yunxin Login shows its sign-in and registration entry screen when the login-home route is opened.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot enter the login or registration flow through this screen.

zh-CN.description: 网易云信登录组件会在登录首页路由打开时显示登录和注册入口。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此页面进入登录或注册流程。

en.description: NetEase Yunxin Login opens its password-recovery form when the email password-reset route is requested.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot recover an account password through this reset screen.

zh-CN.description: 网易云信登录组件会在请求邮箱密码重置路由时打开密码找回表单。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此页面找回账户密码。

en.description: NetEase Yunxin Login opens the configured phone, email, or phone-area sign-in flow when the app requests login.
en.disableEffect: The login screen cannot open, preventing sign-in through this kit.

zh-CN.description: 网易云信登录组件会按应用配置打开手机号、邮箱或区号选择登录流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 登录页面将无法打开，用户无法通过此组件登录。

en.description: NetEase Yunxin Login shows available phone calling codes and returns the selected code to phone sign-in.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot choose a phone calling code for phone sign-in.

zh-CN.description: 网易云信登录组件会展示可用的电话区号，并将用户选择的区号返回给手机号登录流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法为手机号登录选择电话区号。

en.description: When the app opens a meeting's chat history, the NetEase Meeting Android SDK displays earlier messages from that meeting room.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open the meeting chat history screen.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开会议聊天记录时，网易会议 Android SDK 会显示该会议室之前的消息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法打开会议聊天记录页面。

en.description: When the app requests the meeting feedback page, the NetEase Meeting Android SDK displays a form for users to send feedback.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot submit meeting feedback through the SDK's feedback page.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求打开会议反馈页面时，网易会议 Android SDK 会显示供用户提交意见的表单。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过 SDK 的反馈页面提交会议意见。

en.description: When users start or return to an active meeting, the NetEase Meeting Android SDK displays the meeting and its call controls; the screen can shrink into picture-in-picture.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot enter or return to the meeting screen, so the app's meeting feature stops working.

zh-CN.description: 用户开始会议或返回正在进行的会议时，网易会议 Android SDK 会显示会议和通话控制界面；该页面也可缩小为画中画。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法进入会议或返回会议界面，应用的会议功能将无法使用。

en.description: After users start the NetEase Meeting real-time recording feature, this screen opens for that meeting's recorder session.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open the meeting's real-time recorder screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户启动网易会议实时录制功能后，此页面会打开对应会议的录制界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法打开会议的实时录制页面。

en.description: When users open a meeting web app, the NetEase Meeting Android SDK displays the selected web app within the meeting experience.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open meeting web apps through the SDK.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开会议网页应用时，网易会议 Android SDK 会在会议体验中显示所选网页应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过 SDK 打开会议网页应用。

en.description: The NetEase Yunxin QChat UI SDK opens this screen when a server owner selects an announcement manager. It lets the owner change that person's permissions to post, edit the announcement channel, delete messages, manage members, and use emoji, or remove the person.
en.disableEffect: The server owner cannot change or remove individual announcement managers through the built-in QChat screen.

zh-CN.description: 网易云信 QChat 界面库会在服务器创建者选中公告管理员时打开此页。创建者可以调整此人发消息、编辑公告频道、删除消息、管理成员和使用表情的权限，也可以将其移除。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 服务器创建者无法通过 QChat 内置界面调整或移除单个公告管理员。

en.description: The NetEase Yunxin QChat UI SDK opens this list from announcement settings. The server owner can add announcement managers, inspect a manager's permissions, or remove a manager.
en.disableEffect: The server owner cannot manage the announcement manager list through the built-in QChat screen.

zh-CN.description: 网易云信 QChat 界面库会从公告设置打开此列表。服务器创建者可以添加公告管理员、查看管理员权限或移除管理员。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 服务器创建者无法通过 QChat 内置界面管理公告管理员列表。

en.description: The NetEase Yunxin QChat UI SDK opens this screen from announcement settings to list members of the announcement server. Users with permission can invite or remove members and open a member's profile.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot view or manage announcement server members through the built-in QChat screen.

zh-CN.description: 网易云信 QChat 界面库会从公告设置打开此页，列出公告服务器的成员。有相应权限的用户可以邀请或移除成员，也可以查看成员资料。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法通过 QChat 内置界面查看或管理公告服务器成员。

en.description: The NetEase Yunxin QChat UI SDK opens this screen from an announcement conversation's settings entry. It shows announcement server settings and lets users copy its sharing information, change the icon or emoji access, edit its name or topic, manage members and managers, and leave or dismiss the server.
en.disableEffect: Users lose the built-in controls for managing announcement settings and for leaving or dismissing the announcement server.

zh-CN.description: 网易云信 QChat 界面库会在用户从公告会话进入设置时打开此页。页面显示公告服务器设置，用户可以复制分享信息、修改图标或表情权限、编辑名称或主题、管理成员和管理员，并退出或解散服务器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 QChat 内置界面管理公告设置或退出、解散公告服务器。

en.description: The NetEase Yunxin QChat UI SDK opens this editor when a permitted user selects the announcement name or topic in settings. It saves the changed server name or announcement topic.
en.disableEffect: Permitted users cannot edit the announcement server name or topic through the built-in QChat screen.

zh-CN.description: 网易云信 QChat 界面库会在有权限的用户从公告设置中选择名称或主题时打开此编辑页。页面会保存修改后的服务器名称或公告主题。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 有权限的用户无法通过 QChat 内置界面修改公告服务器名称或主题。

en.description: The NetEase Yunxin QChat UI SDK opens this screen when a user starts creating a channel in a QChat server. The user enters a name and topic, chooses whether the channel is public or private, and creates it.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot create QChat channels through the built-in channel creation flow.

zh-CN.description: 网易云信 QChat 界面库会在用户开始为 QChat 服务器创建频道时打开此页。用户填写名称和主题、选择公开或私密频道，然后创建频道。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法通过 QChat 内置流程创建频道。

en.description: The NetEase Yunxin QChat UI SDK opens this picker during channel creation. It lets the user choose a public or private channel and returns that choice to the creation screen.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot choose a channel's visibility in the built-in QChat channel creation flow.

zh-CN.description: 网易云信 QChat 界面库会在创建频道时打开此选项页。用户可以选择公开或私密频道，所选类型会返回创建页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法在 QChat 内置创建流程中选择频道的公开或私密类型。

en.description: The NetEase Yunxin QChat UI SDK opens this screen from a channel's permission settings. It lists server members who can be added to the channel; selecting a person adds them and opens their channel permission controls.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot add server members to a QChat channel through the built-in permission flow.

zh-CN.description: 网易云信 QChat 界面库会从频道权限设置打开此页。页面列出可加入频道的服务器成员；选中成员后会将其加入，并打开该成员的频道权限设置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法通过 QChat 内置权限流程将服务器成员加入频道。

en.description: The NetEase Yunxin QChat UI SDK opens this screen from a channel's permission settings. It lists server roles that can be added to the channel; selecting a role attaches it and opens its channel permission controls.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot add server roles to a QChat channel through the built-in permission flow.

zh-CN.description: 网易云信 QChat 界面库会从频道权限设置打开此页。页面列出可加入频道的服务器角色；选中角色后会将其加入，并打开该角色的频道权限设置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法通过 QChat 内置权限流程将服务器角色加入频道。

en.description: The NetEase Yunxin QChat UI SDK opens this screen when a user manages a channel's allow or block list. It shows the relevant list and lets the user add or remove members.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot change the channel's member allow or block list through the built-in QChat screen.

zh-CN.description: 网易云信 QChat 界面库会在用户管理频道的允许名单或屏蔽名单时打开此页。页面显示相应名单，并允许用户添加或移除成员。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法通过 QChat 内置界面修改频道成员允许名单或屏蔽名单。

en.description: The NetEase Yunxin QChat UI SDK opens this screen from channel settings to show the members and roles with channel access. Users can add or remove them and open their channel permission settings.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot manage member and role access to a QChat channel through the built-in permission screen.

zh-CN.description: 网易云信 QChat 界面库会从频道设置打开此页，显示拥有频道权限的成员和角色。用户可以添加或移除他们，并打开相应的频道权限设置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法通过 QChat 内置权限页面管理成员和角色对频道的访问权限。

en.description: The NetEase Yunxin QChat UI SDK opens this screen when a user edits an individual's access to a channel. It controls whether that member can send messages, manage the channel or roles, and manage the channel's member lists.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot change an individual's QChat channel permissions through the built-in screen.

zh-CN.description: 网易云信 QChat 界面库会在用户编辑某位成员的频道权限时打开此页。页面可以设置该成员能否发消息、管理频道或角色，以及管理频道成员名单。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法通过 QChat 内置界面修改单个成员的频道权限。
