en.description: The NetEase Yunxin QChat UI SDK opens this screen when a user edits a role's access to a channel. It lets the user set which channel actions members with that role may perform.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot change a role's QChat channel permissions through the built-in screen.

zh-CN.description: 网易云信 QChat 界面库会在用户编辑某个角色的频道权限时打开此页。用户可以设置拥有该角色的成员能在频道中执行哪些操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法通过 QChat 内置界面修改角色的频道权限。

en.description: The NetEase Yunxin QChat UI SDK opens this screen from a channel's settings entry. It lets users edit the channel name or topic, manage channel permissions and member allow/block lists, or delete the channel.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot use the built-in QChat screen to configure or delete the channel.

zh-CN.description: 网易云信 QChat 界面库会在用户打开频道设置时显示此页。用户可以修改频道名称或主题、管理频道权限和成员允许名单或屏蔽名单，也可以删除频道。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法通过 QChat 内置界面配置或删除该频道。

en.description: The NetEase Yunxin QChat UI SDK opens this screen when a user taps an image in a QChat message. It displays a larger preview of that image.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open this single-image preview from a QChat message.

zh-CN.description: 网易云信 QChat 界面库会在用户点按 QChat 消息中的图片时打开此页，并显示放大的图片预览。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法从 QChat 消息中打开此单图预览。

en.description: The NetEase Yunxin QChat UI SDK opens this screen after a user chooses a photo for a QChat server or announcement icon. It provides a square crop and returns the cropped image for upload.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot crop a selected photo before setting a QChat server or announcement icon.

zh-CN.description: 网易云信 QChat 界面库会在用户为 QChat 服务器或公告图标选择照片后打开此页。页面提供正方形裁剪，并将裁剪后的图片交给后续上传。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法在设置 QChat 服务器或公告图标前裁剪所选照片。

en.description: The NetEase Yunxin QChat UI SDK opens this screen from message media viewing to browse attached images in a swipeable gallery. Users can save the currently displayed image to the device.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot browse or save images through the built-in QChat message gallery.

zh-CN.description: 网易云信 QChat 界面库会从消息媒体查看入口打开此页，以可滑动的图库浏览消息图片。用户可以将当前显示的图片保存到设备。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法通过 QChat 内置消息图库浏览或保存图片。

en.description: The NetEase Yunxin QChat UI SDK opens this screen from a channel conversation's member entry. It lists channel members, lets users open member profiles, and provides a route to channel settings.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot view a QChat channel's member list through the built-in screen.

zh-CN.description: 网易云信 QChat 界面库会在用户从频道会话打开成员列表时显示此页。页面列出频道成员，允许查看成员资料，并提供进入频道设置的入口。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法通过 QChat 内置界面查看频道成员列表。

en.description: The NetEase Yunxin QChat UI SDK opens this screen when a user selects a QChat channel. It displays that channel's conversation and message history, with header entries for its members or announcement settings.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open QChat channel conversations through the built-in QChat UI.

zh-CN.description: 网易云信 QChat 界面库会在用户选择 QChat 频道时打开此页。页面显示频道会话和消息记录，标题栏还可进入成员列表或公告设置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法通过 QChat 内置界面打开频道会话。

en.description: In NetEase Yunxin QChat UI versions that declare this screen, selecting a channel opens its conversation. The page displays channel messages and provides a side panel with members and their profiles.
en.disableEffect: Apps using these QChat UI versions cannot open the built-in channel conversation screen.

zh-CN.description: 在声明此页面的网易云信 QChat 界面版本中，用户选择频道后会打开频道会话。页面显示频道消息，并提供侧栏查看成员及其资料。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用这些 QChat 界面版本的应用无法打开内置频道会话页面。

en.description: The NetEase Yunxin QChat UI SDK opens this form when a user chooses to create a QChat server or announcement server. The user enters a name and selects an icon; the SDK creates the server and its initial channel.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot create a QChat server or announcement server through the built-in flow.

zh-CN.description: 网易云信 QChat 界面库会在用户选择创建 QChat 服务器或公告服务器时打开此表单。用户填写名称并选择图标，随后创建服务器及其初始频道。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法通过 QChat 内置流程创建服务器或公告服务器。

en.description: The NetEase Yunxin QChat UI SDK opens this chooser when a user starts a server setup flow. It offers creating a server or joining an existing one, including the corresponding announcement-server choices.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot start the built-in QChat server creation or joining flow from this chooser.

zh-CN.description: 网易云信 QChat 界面库会在用户开始服务器设置流程时打开此选择页。页面提供创建服务器或加入现有服务器的选项，也包含相应的公告服务器选项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法通过此选择页启动 QChat 内置的服务器创建或加入流程。

en.description: The NetEase Yunxin QChat UI SDK opens this screen in the join-server flow. A user enters a server ID, sees the matching server, and can join it or follow the announcement-server join flow.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot look up and join an existing QChat server through the built-in flow.

zh-CN.description: 网易云信 QChat 界面库会在加入服务器流程中打开此页。用户输入服务器编号后查看匹配结果，并加入该服务器或继续公告服务器的加入流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法通过 QChat 内置流程查找并加入现有服务器。

en.description: The NetEase Yunxin QChat UI SDK opens this screen when a server or channel workflow needs users selected from the server's members. The selection is used for tasks such as assigning role members, adding channel members, or choosing announcement managers.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot select server members for these built-in QChat management flows.

zh-CN.description: 网易云信 QChat 界面库会在服务器或频道管理流程需要从成员中选人时打开此页。选中的成员可用于分配角色、加入频道或选择公告管理员等操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法为这些 QChat 内置管理流程选择服务器成员。

en.description: The NetEase Yunxin QChat UI SDK opens this screen when a user creates a server role. The user enters a role name and can select members to assign to the new role.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot create server roles through the built-in QChat role flow.

zh-CN.description: 网易云信 QChat 界面库会在用户创建服务器角色时打开此页。用户填写角色名称，也可以选择要分配给新角色的成员。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法通过 QChat 内置角色流程创建服务器角色。

en.description: The NetEase Yunxin QChat UI SDK opens this screen from server settings to list server roles. Users with permission can create a role, edit one, or change role order.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot manage server roles through the built-in QChat role list.

zh-CN.description: 网易云信 QChat 界面库会从服务器设置打开此页，列出服务器角色。有权限的用户可以创建角色、编辑角色或调整角色顺序。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法通过 QChat 内置角色列表管理服务器角色。

en.description: The NetEase Yunxin QChat UI SDK opens this screen from a server role's settings. It lists members assigned to that role and lets an authorized user add or remove members.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot view or change membership for a QChat server role through the built-in screen.

zh-CN.description: 网易云信 QChat 界面库会从服务器角色设置打开此页。页面列出分配给该角色的成员，有权限的用户可以添加或移除成员。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法通过 QChat 内置界面查看或调整服务器角色成员。

en.description: The NetEase Yunxin QChat UI SDK opens this screen when a user edits a server role. It lets the user rename the role, change its permissions, and open its member list.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot edit a QChat server role's name or permissions through the built-in screen.

zh-CN.description: 网易云信 QChat 界面库会在用户编辑服务器角色时打开此页。用户可以修改角色名称和权限，也可以打开该角色的成员列表。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法通过 QChat 内置界面修改服务器角色名称或权限。

en.description: The NetEase Yunxin QChat UI SDK opens this screen to arrange server roles by priority. A permitted user can reorder the roles or delete one.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot reorder or delete server roles through the built-in QChat screen.

zh-CN.description: 网易云信 QChat 界面库会打开此页，让用户按优先级排列服务器角色。有权限的用户可以调整顺序或删除角色。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法通过 QChat 内置界面调整或删除服务器角色。

en.description: The NetEase Yunxin QChat UI SDK opens this screen when a user selects a server member. It shows the member's profile and roles; authorized users can edit a nickname, change role membership, or remove the member from the server.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot view or manage a selected member's server details through the built-in QChat screen.

zh-CN.description: 网易云信 QChat 界面库会在用户选中服务器成员时打开此页。页面显示成员资料和角色；有权限的用户可以修改昵称、调整角色成员关系或将其移出服务器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法通过 QChat 内置界面查看或管理所选成员的服务器资料。

en.description: The NetEase Yunxin QChat UI SDK opens this screen from server settings to browse server members. The screen can invite members, load their roles, and open an individual member's details.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot browse or manage server membership through the built-in QChat member list.

zh-CN.description: 网易云信 QChat 界面库会从服务器设置打开此页，供用户浏览服务器成员。页面可以邀请成员、加载其角色并打开单个成员的详细资料。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法通过 QChat 内置成员列表浏览或管理服务器成员。

en.description: The NetEase Yunxin QChat UI SDK opens this screen for server settings. Users can change the server name, topic, or icon; open member and role management; and, when allowed, leave or delete the server.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot configure the QChat server or reach its built-in member and role management from this screen.

zh-CN.description: 网易云信 QChat 界面库会打开此服务器设置页。用户可以修改服务器名称、主题或图标，进入成员和角色管理，并在有权限时退出或删除服务器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法通过此页面配置 QChat 服务器或进入内置成员、角色管理。

en.description: The NetEase Yunxin Search UI SDK opens this screen from its global-search route. As the user types, it searches friends, groups, and teams; tapping a result opens the matching profile or conversation.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot use the built-in global search to find friends, groups, or teams.

zh-CN.description: 网易云信 Search 界面库会通过全局搜索入口打开此页。用户输入文字后，页面会搜索好友、群组和团队；点按结果可打开相应资料或会话。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法使用内置全局搜索查找好友、群组或团队。

en.description: The NetEase Yunxin SMS Login SDK opens this in-app browser for links configured on its login and registration screens, such as terms or privacy pages. It displays web pages inside the app and hands non-web links to another app when available.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open configured terms, privacy, or other login-screen links through this in-app browser.

zh-CN.description: 网易云信短信登录库会在用户点按登录或注册页面配置的链接时打开此内置浏览器，例如服务条款或隐私页面。它在应用内显示网页，并在有可用应用时将非网页链接交给其他应用打开。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法通过此内置浏览器打开登录页面配置的条款、隐私或其他链接。

en.description: The NetEase Yunxin SMS Login SDK opens this screen from the login page's password-recovery option. It requests and verifies an SMS code, collects a replacement password, and submits the recovery details through the configured callback.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot reset a forgotten password through the built-in SMS login flow.

zh-CN.description: 网易云信短信登录库会在用户从登录页选择找回密码时打开此页。页面请求并验证短信验证码、收集新密码，并通过配置的回调提交找回信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法通过内置短信登录流程重设忘记的密码。

en.description: The NetEase Yunxin SMS Login SDK opens this screen when the app starts its login flow. Users can sign in with a phone verification code or a password, and move to registration or password recovery.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot sign in through the app's built-in SMS Login screens.

zh-CN.description: 网易云信短信登录库会在应用启动登录流程时打开此页。用户可以使用手机验证码或密码登录，也可以进入注册或找回密码流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法通过应用内置的网易云信短信登录界面登录。

en.description: The NetEase Yunxin SMS Login SDK opens this screen when a user chooses registration from login. It collects a phone number, verification code, and password, verifies the code, and submits the registration details through the configured callback.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot create an account through the built-in SMS registration flow.

zh-CN.description: 网易云信短信登录库会在用户从登录页选择注册时打开此页。页面收集手机号、验证码和密码，验证验证码后通过配置的回调提交注册信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法通过内置短信注册流程创建账户。

en.description: The NetEase Yunxin SMS Login SDK opens this indexed list from the SMS-code login form. It displays available country and region dialing codes for the user to select.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open the country and region dialing-code list from SMS-code login.

zh-CN.description: 网易云信短信登录库会从短信验证码登录表单打开此索引列表，显示可选的国家和地区电话区号。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法从短信验证码登录表单打开国家和地区电话区号列表。

en.description: The NetEase Yunxin TeamKit Activity opens a team information page where users can view its name, picture, and introduction and open the editors for those details.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot view a team’s basic details in this page or open its detail editors from here.

zh-CN.description: 网易云信 TeamKit 的此 Activity 会打开群组信息页，供用户查看群名称、头像和简介，并进入相应的编辑页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法在此页面查看群组基本信息，也无法从这里进入对应的编辑页面。

en.description: The NetEase Yunxin TeamKit Activity opens team-management controls for who may invite members or edit team details, group-join approval, and member mention or pin permissions; it also opens the manager list.
en.disableEffect: Owners and managers lose this page’s controls for team permissions, joining rules, and managers.

zh-CN.description: 网易云信 TeamKit 的此 Activity 提供群管理设置，可调整邀请成员和修改群信息的权限、入群方式，以及全体提醒和置顶消息的权限，并可打开管理员列表。

zh-CN.description: 网易云信 TeamKit 的此 Activity 供群主搜索群成员，并选择要添加为管理员的人。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，群主无法通过此 TeamKit 页面选择新管理员。

en.disableEffect: Users lose this page’s team-chat settings and its shortcuts to member, manager, and team details.

zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过此编辑页面更换群头像。

en.description: The NetEase Yunxin TeamKit Activity lets an authorized team member edit and save the team’s introduction.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot change the team introduction through this editor.

zh-CN.description: 网易云信 TeamKit 的此 Activity 供有权限的群成员修改并保存群简介。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过此编辑页面修改群简介。

en.description: The NetEase Yunxin TeamKit Activity lets an authorized team member change and save the team’s name.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot change the team’s name through this editor.

zh-CN.description: 网易云信 TeamKit 的此 Activity 供有权限的群成员修改并保存群名称。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过此编辑页面修改群名称。

en.description: The NetEase Yunxin TeamKit Activity lets a member change and save their own nickname for this team.

zh-CN.description: 网易云信 TeamKit 的此 Activity 供成员修改并保存自己在此群中的昵称。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，成员无法通过此编辑页面修改自己在群中的昵称。

en.description: The NetEase Yunxin TeamKit Activity opens a team information page where users can view its name, picture, and introduction and open the editors for those details.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot view a team’s basic details in this page or open its detail editors from here.

zh-CN.description: 网易云信 TeamKit 的此 Activity 会打开群组信息页，供用户查看群名称、头像和简介，并进入相应的编辑页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法在此页面查看群组基本信息，也无法从这里进入对应的编辑页面。

en.description: NetEase Yunxin CallKit uses this Receiver when an incoming-call notification is dismissed, then rejects the invitation associated with that call.
en.disableEffect: Dismissing an incoming-call notification may leave its call invitation active.

zh-CN.description: 网易云信 CallKit 会在来电通知被关闭时使用此 Receiver，并拒绝该通知对应的通话邀请。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 关闭来电通知后，对应的通话邀请可能仍处于待接听状态。

en.description: During a NetEase Yunxin PSTN one-to-one audio call, this Activity opens the call screen and lets the user answer, reject, mute, switch speaker, or hang up.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it can prevent the app from opening or answering PSTN audio calls.

zh-CN.description: 在 NetEase 云信 CallKit 的一对一 PSTN 语音通话中，此 Activity 会打开通话界面，让用户接听、拒接、静音、切换扬声器或挂断。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，应用可能无法打开或接听 PSTN 语音通话。

en.description: When NetEase Yunxin CallKit requests camera or microphone access, or asks the user to confirm a call-type change from the floating call window, this temporary Activity runs the request and returns its result.
en.disableEffect: Permission requests or audio/video call-type changes may fail because their results cannot return to the call screen.

zh-CN.description: 当 NetEase 云信 CallKit 申请相机或麦克风权限，或需要在悬浮通话界面确认语音和视频切换时，这个临时 Activity 会执行请求并将结果交还给通话界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 权限申请或语音、视频切换可能因结果无法返回通话界面而失败。

en.description: When a user starts or joins a NetEase Yunxin CallKit group call, this Activity opens the group-call screen and provides participant, audio, and video controls.
en.disableEffect: The SDK cannot open this group-call screen, so starting or joining group calls may fail.

zh-CN.description: 用户通过 NetEase 云信 CallKit 发起或加入群组通话时，此 Activity 会打开群通话界面，并提供成员、音频和视频控制。
zh-CN.disableEffect: SDK 将无法打开此群通话界面，发起或加入群组通话可能失败。

en.description: When a user starts or answers a NetEase Yunxin CallKit one-to-one voice or video call, this Activity shows the call screen and its answer, reject, mute, camera, speaker, and hang-up controls.
en.disableEffect: One-to-one calls routed to this screen may not open, preventing users from placing or answering them.

zh-CN.description: 用户发起或接听 NetEase 云信 CallKit 一对一语音或视频通话时，此 Activity 会显示通话界面，并提供接听、拒接、静音、摄像头、扬声器和挂断操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 分配到此界面的一对一通话可能无法打开，用户将无法发起或接听这些通话。

en.description: When the app routes a NetEase Yunxin CallKit one-to-one call to this Activity, it displays the incoming, outgoing, or active voice and video call screen.
en.disableEffect: Calls routed to this screen may not open, preventing users from placing or answering them.

zh-CN.description: 应用将 NetEase 云信 CallKit 一对一通话分配到此 Activity 时，它会显示来电、拨出或通话中的语音和视频界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 分配到此界面的通话可能无法打开，用户将无法发起或接听这些通话。

en.description: When NetEase Yunxin CallKit requests runtime permissions, this Activity explains why access is needed, displays the system permission prompt, and returns the result to the calling screen.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it can prevent the app from requesting microphone or camera access needed for calls.

zh-CN.description: NetEase 云信 CallKit 申请运行时权限时，此 Activity 会说明所需权限的用途、显示系统授权提示，并将结果返回给通话界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，应用可能无法申请通话所需的麦克风或相机权限。

en.description: When NetEase Yunxin CallKit keeps an audio call running outside the visible call screen, this Service posts a foreground notification so the conversation can continue while the app is in the background.
en.disableEffect: Audio calls may be interrupted when the user leaves the call screen or locks the phone.

zh-CN.description: NetEase 云信 CallKit 需要在通话界面之外继续音频通话时，此 Service 会显示前台通知，让应用切到后台后仍可继续通话。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户离开通话界面或锁屏后，音频通话可能中断。

en.description: When NetEase Yunxin CallKit background-call support is enabled during an active call, this Service displays an ongoing notification and keeps the call running while the app is not visible.
en.disableEffect: The SDK may be unable to keep audio or video calls running after the user leaves the app.

zh-CN.description: NetEase 云信 CallKit 启用后台通话支持且正在通话时，此 Service 会显示持续通知，让应用切到后台后通话仍能继续。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户离开应用后，SDK 可能无法继续维持音频或视频通话。

en.description: When a NetEase Yunxin CallKit video call continues outside the visible call screen, this Service posts a foreground notification for the camera and microphone.
en.disableEffect: Video calls may lose camera or microphone use when the user leaves the app.

zh-CN.description: NetEase 云信 CallKit 需要在通话界面之外继续视频通话时，此 Service 会为相机和麦克风显示前台通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户离开应用后，视频通话可能无法继续使用相机或麦克风。

en.description: When a NetEase Yunxin CallKit audio session needs to continue in the background, this Service posts a notification and keeps microphone use in the foreground.
en.disableEffect: Audio sessions that rely on this service may be interrupted when the app is no longer visible.

zh-CN.description: NetEase 云信 CallKit 的音频会话需要在后台继续时，此 Service 会显示通知，并让麦克风持续处于前台使用状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此服务的音频会话可能在应用不可见时中断。

en.description: When a NetEase Yunxin CallKit video session needs to continue in the background, this Service posts a notification and keeps camera and microphone use in the foreground.
en.disableEffect: Video sessions that rely on this service may lose camera or microphone use when the app is no longer visible.

zh-CN.description: NetEase 云信 CallKit 的视频会话需要在后台继续时，此 Service 会显示通知，并让相机和麦克风持续处于前台使用状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此服务的视频会话可能在应用不可见时失去相机或麦克风。

en.description: NetEase Yunxin VCE opens this full-screen Activity for a requested call and presents its in-app calling screen.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot open the VCE calling screen to start or handle a call.

zh-CN.description: 网易云信 VCE 会在收到通话启动请求时打开此全屏 Activity，并展示应用内通话页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法打开 VCE 通话页面来发起或处理通话。

en.description: At app startup, this Netposa CommonSDK provider prepares shared SDK components by giving them access to the app information they need to run.
en.disableEffect: Without this setup, Netposa components that later need the app information may fail when they run.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，Netposa CommonSDK 的此 Provider 会为共享组件提供运行所需的应用信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 缺少这项初始化后，需要这些应用信息的 Netposa 组件运行时可能会失败。

en.description: When the app requests AMap location through Netposa's location SDK, this service collects a high-accuracy location and address and sends the result back to the app.
en.disableEffect: AMap-based location results will stop, which can break app screens or tasks that rely on that location source.

zh-CN.description: 当应用通过 Netposa 定位 SDK 请求高德定位时，此 Service 会获取高精度位置和地址，并将结果返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，高德定位结果将停止提供，依赖该定位来源的应用页面或任务可能无法正常工作。

en.description: When the app requests GPS location through Netposa's location SDK, this service watches for GPS changes and location fixes, then sends coordinates and an address back to the app.
en.disableEffect: The app will lose this GPS location source, which can break location-based screens or tasks.

zh-CN.description: 当应用通过 Netposa 定位 SDK 请求 GPS 定位时，此 Service 会监听 GPS 状态和定位结果，再将坐标及地址返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用将失去这一 GPS 定位来源，依赖定位的页面或任务可能无法正常工作。

en.description: When Netposa MQTT messaging starts, this service connects or reconnects to the configured server, listens to the app's configured topics, and passes new messages into the app.
en.disableEffect: Incoming MQTT messages and updates delivered through this Netposa service will stop.

zh-CN.description: Netposa MQTT 消息服务启动后，此 Service 会连接或重新连接到配置的服务器，监听应用设置的主题，并将新消息交给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用将不再收到通过此 Netposa 服务传递的 MQTT 消息和更新。

en.description: The Neura Android SDK runs this job for a queued push request and sends it to Neura, reporting whether it succeeded.
en.disableEffect: Queued Neura push requests will not be sent by this background job.

zh-CN.description: Neura Android SDK 会为排队的推送请求运行此任务，将请求发送给 Neura 并记录结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Neura 的排队推送请求将不会由此后台任务发送。

en.description: When a retry alarm for a Neura Android SDK push request fires, this receiver submits the request again.
en.disableEffect: Failed Neura push requests will no longer be retried.

zh-CN.description: Neura Android SDK 推送请求的重试闹钟触发时，此接收器会再次提交该请求。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Neura 推送请求失败后将不再自动重试。

en.description: When enabled, it reacts to Bluetooth adapter and device connection changes and records the connected device for the Neura Android SDK.
en.disableEffect: Neura will stop recording Bluetooth connection changes and device details.

zh-CN.description: 启用后，它会响应蓝牙适配器和设备的连接变化，并为 Neura Android SDK 记录已连接设备。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Neura 将不再记录蓝牙连接变化和设备信息。

en.description: The Neura Android SDK schedules this job to start or stop its background coordination work.
en.disableEffect: Neura's scheduled background coordination will stop.

zh-CN.description: Neura Android SDK 会安排此任务来启动或停止后台协调工作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Neura 的后台协调任务将停止运行。

en.description: When the Neura Android SDK starts this service, it starts or stops the SDK's background coordination work.
en.disableEffect: Neura's background coordination will not run through this service.

zh-CN.description: Neura Android SDK 启动此服务时，它会启动或停止 SDK 的后台协调工作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Neura 将无法通过此服务运行后台协调任务。

en.description: This Neura Android SDK provider initializes native SDK support and opens its local database at app startup; SDK code also uses it to read and write stored records.
en.disableEffect: Neura initialization or database access may fail, breaking app features that rely on the SDK.

zh-CN.description: 这个 Neura Android SDK 内容提供程序会在应用启动时初始化 SDK 原生支持并打开本地数据库；SDK 也通过它读写保存的数据。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Neura 初始化或数据库访问可能失败，依赖该 SDK 的应用功能也可能因此受影响。

en.description: When enabled, it handles startup, app updates, battery, airplane mode, location, Wi-Fi, and Bluetooth changes to refresh the Neura Android SDK's data collection and device-state records.
en.disableEffect: Neura's device-state updates and recovery after restarts may stop.

zh-CN.description: 启用后，它会处理开机、应用更新、电量、飞行模式、位置、Wi-Fi 和蓝牙变化，以更新 Neura Android SDK 的数据采集状态和设备状态记录。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Neura 的设备状态更新及重启后的恢复可能停止。

en.description: The Neura Android SDK routes account authentication, logout, data-sync, and notification-action broadcasts through this receiver; it can open the dialer or messaging app for a Neura person notification.
en.disableEffect: Neura sign-in updates, data synchronization, and actions on its notifications may stop working.

zh-CN.description: Neura Android SDK 会通过此接收器处理账户认证、退出登录、数据同步和通知操作；Neura 联系人通知还可由它打开拨号或短信界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Neura 登录状态更新、数据同步及通知操作可能停止。

en.description: When the Neura Android SDK broadcasts a running-mode change, this receiver forwards the start or stop value to a background service or scheduled job.
en.disableEffect: Neura will stop recording changes to its running mode.

zh-CN.description: Neura Android SDK 广播运行模式变化时，此接收器会把启动或停止状态转交给后台服务或计划任务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Neura 将不再记录运行模式的变化。

en.description: It responds to Neura Android SDK Bluetooth or Wi-Fi scan requests and starts the matching device scan.
en.disableEffect: Neura will stop collecting nearby Bluetooth and Wi-Fi scan data.

zh-CN.description: 它会响应 Neura Android SDK 的蓝牙或 Wi-Fi 扫描请求，并启动相应的设备扫描。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Neura 将停止收集附近蓝牙和 Wi-Fi 扫描数据。

en.description: The Neura Android SDK schedules this job to process a queued server command and pass it to the SDK command handler.
en.disableEffect: Queued Neura background commands will not run through this job.

zh-CN.description: Neura Android SDK 会安排此任务处理排队的服务器命令，并将命令交给 SDK 处理器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Neura 的后台命令将不会通过此任务运行。

en.description: When the Neura Android SDK starts this service with a command, it processes the command and dispatches the requested SDK action.
en.disableEffect: Neura background commands will not run through this service.

zh-CN.description: Neura Android SDK 通过命令启动此服务时，它会处理命令并执行相应的 SDK 操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Neura 的后台命令将不会通过此服务运行。

en.description: The Neura Android SDK schedules this job to upload queued data, using a regular or overnight sync window.
en.disableEffect: Neura data may remain unsent.

zh-CN.description: Neura Android SDK 会安排此任务上传排队的数据，并按常规或夜间时段进行同步。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Neura 数据可能会一直留在设备上，无法发送。

en.description: When started, it watches doze, power-saving, and boot changes so the Neura Android SDK can update its idle-state records.
en.disableEffect: Neura will stop recording device idle and power-saving changes.

zh-CN.description: 此服务启动后会监听设备空闲、省电和开机状态变化，让 Neura Android SDK 更新空闲状态记录。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Neura 将不再记录设备空闲和省电状态变化。

en.description: When Google Play services reports a Neura geofence exit or dwell, this service asks the Neura Android SDK to process and sync the event.
en.disableEffect: Neura will stop responding to those geofence events.

zh-CN.description: Google Play 服务报告 Neura 地理围栏离开或停留事件时，此服务会请求 Neura Android SDK 处理并同步该事件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Neura 将不再响应这些地理围栏事件。

en.description: When enabled and started, it registers for network changes so the Neura Android SDK can detect restored connectivity, resume queued work, and record Wi-Fi details.
en.disableEffect: Neura's network monitoring and background work may not resume when connectivity returns.

zh-CN.description: 启用并启动后，它会注册网络变化监听，使 Neura Android SDK 能检测网络恢复、继续排队任务并记录 Wi-Fi 信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 网络恢复时，Neura 的网络监控和后台任务可能无法继续。

en.description: After Neura Android SDK background work starts this service, it checks collection services and restarts coordination when needed.
en.disableEffect: Neura's background collection may lose its recovery path and scheduled-job cleanup.

zh-CN.description: Neura Android SDK 的后台任务启动此服务后，它会检查数据采集服务，并在需要时恢复协调工作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Neura 后台数据采集可能失去恢复机制，计划任务也可能无法正常清理。

en.description: The Neura Android SDK runs this scan only while connected to Wi-Fi and charging, then waits for the network-discovery scan to finish.
en.disableEffect: Neura will no longer perform this charging-time Wi-Fi discovery.

zh-CN.description: Neura Android SDK 仅在连接 Wi-Fi 且正在充电时运行此扫描，并等待网络发现完成。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Neura 将不再在充电时执行此 Wi-Fi 网络发现。

en.description: A scheduled Neura Android SDK job starts nearby Wi-Fi network discovery and finishes when the scan-complete broadcast arrives.
en.disableEffect: Neura will no longer run this scheduled network discovery.

zh-CN.description: Neura Android SDK 的计划任务会启动附近 Wi-Fi 网络发现，并在收到扫描完成广播后结束。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Neura 将不再运行此计划网络发现任务。

en.description: The Neura Android SDK schedules this job to record whether its running mode has started or stopped.
en.disableEffect: Neura will stop recording running-mode changes from scheduled jobs.

zh-CN.description: Neura Android SDK 会安排此任务记录运行模式已启动或停止。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Neura 将不再记录计划任务触发的运行模式变化。

en.description: When started with a Neura Android SDK running-mode change, this service records whether the mode started or stopped.
en.disableEffect: Neura will stop recording running-mode changes handled by this service.

zh-CN.description: Neura Android SDK 以运行模式变化启动此服务时，它会记录该模式已启动或停止。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Neura 将不再记录由此服务处理的运行模式变化。

en.description: The Neura Android SDK schedules this job to scan available device data and completes it after the scan finishes.
en.disableEffect: Neura's scheduled device-data scans will stop.

zh-CN.description: Neura Android SDK 会安排此任务扫描可用的设备数据，并在扫描完成后结束任务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Neura 计划执行的设备数据扫描将停止。

en.description: When the Neura Android SDK starts this service with a scan request, it runs the scan on a background worker and stops when scanning finishes.
en.disableEffect: Neura's requested background scans will stop.

zh-CN.description: Neura Android SDK 通过扫描请求启动此服务时，它会在后台执行扫描，并在扫描完成后停止。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Neura 请求的后台扫描将停止。

en.description: The Neura Android SDK schedules this job to pass a permission or sensor state alert to its alert handler.
en.disableEffect: Neura state-alert requests will not be processed, and existing alerts may not be removed when requested.

zh-CN.description: Neura Android SDK 会安排此任务，将权限或传感器状态提醒交给提醒处理器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Neura 状态提醒将不会被处理，已有提醒也可能无法按请求移除。

en.description: When the Neura Android SDK starts this service with a state alert, it passes the alert details to the SDK alert handler.
en.disableEffect: Neura state-alert requests will not be processed, and existing alerts may not be removed when requested.

zh-CN.description: Neura Android SDK 通过状态提醒启动此服务时，它会将提醒信息交给 SDK 提醒处理器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Neura 状态提醒将不会被处理，已有提醒也可能无法按请求移除。

en.description: The Neura Android SDK uses this service to read the phone's step sensor, store step totals, and switch to its custom detector when needed.
en.disableEffect: Neura step counts and activity insights will stop updating.

zh-CN.description: Neura Android SDK 会通过此服务读取手机的计步传感器、保存步数，并在需要时切换到自定义计步器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Neura 步数和活动洞察将停止更新。

en.description: After its scheduled timeout, this Neura Android SDK job asks the custom step detector to stop.
en.disableEffect: Neura's scheduled stop for its custom step detector will no longer run.

zh-CN.description: 计划超时后，此 Neura Android SDK 任务会请求自定义计步器停止。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Neura 自定义计步器的计划停止任务将不再运行。

en.description: The Neura Android SDK schedules this job to collect device-state and diagnostic data, then sync queued monitoring and command data.
en.disableEffect: Neura's scheduled background synchronization and device-state reports will stop.

zh-CN.description: Neura Android SDK 会安排此任务收集设备状态和诊断数据，并同步排队的监控与命令数据。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Neura 的计划后台同步和设备状态报告将停止。

en.description: When the Neura Android SDK starts this service for a data sync, it uploads queued SDK data.
en.disableEffect: Neura's queued data will not be synchronized by this service.

zh-CN.description: Neura Android SDK 为数据同步启动此服务时，它会上传排队的 SDK 数据。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Neura 排队的数据将不会由此服务同步。

en.description: During a scheduled Neura Android SDK sync, this service uploads diagnostic logs, device-state records, and general commands.
en.disableEffect: Those Neura records and commands may remain unsent.

zh-CN.description: Neura Android SDK 计划同步期间，此服务会上传诊断日志、设备状态记录和通用命令。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 这些 Neura 记录和命令可能无法发送。

en.description: The Neura Android SDK runs this job for a location update, records the location, and may sync it based on the update source.
en.disableEffect: Neura location updates and related insights may stop.

zh-CN.description: Neura Android SDK 会为位置更新运行此任务、记录位置，并可根据更新来源进行同步。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Neura 位置更新及相关洞察可能停止。

en.description: When the Neura Android SDK starts this service with a location update, it records the location and may request a sync based on its source.
en.disableEffect: Neura location updates and related insights may stop.

zh-CN.description: Neura Android SDK 通过位置更新启动此服务时，它会记录位置，并可根据更新来源请求同步。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Neura 位置更新及相关洞察可能停止。

en.description: When the Neura Android SDK needs custom step counting, this service reads motion-sensor updates while holding a wake lock and schedules a stop after 15 minutes.
en.disableEffect: Neura's fallback step counts may stop updating.

zh-CN.description: Neura Android SDK 需要自定义计步时，此服务会在持有唤醒锁期间读取运动传感器数据，并安排在 15 分钟后停止。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Neura 的备用计步数据可能停止更新。

en.description: The Neura Android SDK starts this service to refresh an access token and broadcast whether the refresh succeeded.
en.disableEffect: Neura authentication may expire and connected SDK features may stop working.

zh-CN.description: Neura Android SDK 会启动此服务刷新访问令牌，并广播刷新是否成功。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Neura 认证可能过期，依赖该 SDK 的功能也可能停止。

en.description: The Neura Android SDK starts this service to upgrade stored access credentials and report a failed upgrade to its account manager.
en.disableEffect: Neura authentication may fail or expire, stopping connected SDK features.

zh-CN.description: Neura Android SDK 会启动此服务升级已保存的访问凭据，并在失败时通知账户管理器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Neura 认证可能失败或过期，依赖该 SDK 的功能也可能停止。

en.description: The Neura Android SDK schedules this job to refresh an access token before it expires.
en.disableEffect: Neura authentication may expire and connected SDK features may stop working.

zh-CN.description: Neura Android SDK 会安排此任务在访问令牌过期前刷新令牌。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Neura 认证可能过期，依赖该 SDK 的功能也可能停止。

en.description: The Neura Android SDK schedules this job to upgrade stored access credentials and notify its account manager if the upgrade fails.
en.disableEffect: Neura authentication may fail or expire, stopping connected SDK features.

zh-CN.description: Neura Android SDK 会安排此任务升级已保存的访问凭据，并在失败时通知账户管理器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Neura 认证可能失败或过期，依赖该 SDK 的功能也可能停止。

en.description: When Android reports a changed next alarm, this receiver records the new alarm time for the Neura Android SDK's context data.
en.disableEffect: Neura context data will no longer include changes to the next alarm.

zh-CN.description: Android 报告下一次闹钟变化时，此接收器会为 Neura Android SDK 的情境数据记录新的闹钟时间。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Neura 情境数据将不再包含下一次闹钟的变化。

en.description: When Bluetooth devices connect or disconnect, this receiver collects available device details and queues them for Neura Android SDK processing.
en.disableEffect: Neura's Bluetooth device data will stop updating.

zh-CN.description: 蓝牙设备连接或断开时，此接收器会收集可用的设备信息并排队交由 Neura Android SDK 处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Neura 的蓝牙设备数据将停止更新。

en.description: It processes activity-recognition results from Google Play services, records the most likely activity, and can start related step or context collection for the Neura Android SDK.
en.disableEffect: Neura activity and step insights may stop updating.

zh-CN.description: 它会处理 Google Play 服务提供的活动识别结果、记录最可能的活动，并可为 Neura Android SDK 启动相关计步或情境采集。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Neura 活动和步数洞察可能停止更新。

en.description: When Google Play services sends a location update, this receiver queues its coordinates and accuracy for Neura Android SDK processing.
en.disableEffect: Neura location data and related insights may stop updating.

zh-CN.description: Google Play 服务发送位置更新时，此接收器会将坐标和精度排队交由 Neura Android SDK 处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Neura 位置数据及相关洞察可能停止更新。

en.description: This job processes a queued Google Play services location update and passes it to the Neura Android SDK location handler.
en.disableEffect: Neura location updates and related insights may stop.

zh-CN.description: 此任务会处理排队的 Google Play 服务位置更新，并将其交给 Neura Android SDK 的位置处理器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Neura 位置更新及相关洞察可能停止。

en.description: When started with a queued location update, this service passes it to the Neura Android SDK location handler.
en.disableEffect: Neura location updates and related insights may stop.

zh-CN.description: 此服务收到排队的位置更新后，会将其交给 Neura Android SDK 的位置处理器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Neura 位置更新及相关洞察可能停止。

en.description: When power is connected or disconnected, this receiver records the charging change and requests a Neura Android SDK sync when charging begins.
en.disableEffect: Neura will stop recording power changes and syncing when charging starts.

zh-CN.description: 电源接入或断开时，此接收器会记录充电状态变化，并在开始充电时请求 Neura Android SDK 同步。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Neura 将不再记录电源变化或在开始充电时同步。

en.description: It records screen-on and screen-off changes as context data for the Neura Android SDK.
en.disableEffect: Neura will stop recording screen activity changes.

zh-CN.description: 它会为 Neura Android SDK 记录屏幕亮起和熄灭的情境数据。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Neura 将不再记录屏幕活动变化。

en.description: When Google Play services reports a detected activity transition, this receiver records it and may trigger Neura Android SDK location, Bluetooth, and Wi-Fi scans.
en.disableEffect: Neura movement context and related scans will stop updating.

zh-CN.description: Google Play 服务报告检测到的活动转换时，此接收器会记录该事件，并可触发 Neura Android SDK 的位置、蓝牙和 Wi-Fi 扫描。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Neura 的移动情境数据及相关扫描将停止更新。

en.description: While Neura Android SDK data collection is enabled, this foreground service gathers location and device-state changes such as screen, Bluetooth, power, Wi-Fi, and connectivity events.
en.disableEffect: Neura's ongoing sensor and device-state collection will stop.

zh-CN.description: Neura Android SDK 数据采集启用期间，此前台服务会收集位置以及屏幕、蓝牙、电源、Wi-Fi 和网络连接等设备状态变化。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Neura 持续进行的传感器和设备状态采集将停止。

en.description: The Neura Android SDK opens this screen for app-linked sign-in, account creation, password reset, phone verification, and authentication.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to complete Neura sign-in or account linking from the app.

zh-CN.description: Neura Android SDK 会打开此界面，用于应用关联登录、创建账户、重设密码、验证手机号和完成认证。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在应用中完成 Neura 登录或账户关联。

en.description: The Neura Android SDK opens this screen to link a phone number, verify a texted code, and complete account authentication.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to complete Neura phone linking or SMS verification from the app.

zh-CN.description: Neura Android SDK 会打开此界面，用于关联手机号、验证短信验证码并完成账户认证。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在应用中关联 Neura 手机号或完成短信验证。

en.description: This Neura Android SDK dashboard screen lists defined events and lets developers send a selected test event.
en.disableEffect: Developers will lose the built-in event simulation screen.

zh-CN.description: Neura Android SDK 控制台界面会列出已定义事件，供开发者选择并发送测试事件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 开发者将无法使用内置的事件模拟界面。

en.description: The Neura Android SDK opens this screen when users choose places or services and returns their selection to the app.
en.disableEffect: App flows that configure Neura places or services may fail to open or return a selection.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择地点或服务时，Neura Android SDK 会打开此界面，并将选择结果返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 配置 Neura 地点或服务的应用流程可能无法打开界面或取得选择结果。

en.description: When a Neura Android SDK permission or sensor alert is opened, this activity requests location permission or opens the relevant device sensor settings.
en.disableEffect: Users may be unable to grant the Neura location permission or open required sensor settings from these alerts.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 Neura Android SDK 权限或传感器提醒时，此界面会请求位置权限或打开相关设备传感器设置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户可能无法通过这些提醒授予 Neura 位置权限或打开所需的传感器设置。

en.description: When Google Play services reports a Neura Android SDK geofence entry or exit, this receiver updates place state and handles leave-home or leave-work events.
en.disableEffect: Neura place-entry and departure events and related insights will stop updating.

zh-CN.description: Google Play 服务报告 Neura Android SDK 地理围栏进入或离开事件时，此接收器会更新地点状态并处理离家或离开工作地点事件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Neura 地点进入、离开事件及相关洞察将停止更新。

en.description: The Neura Android SDK runs this job when a delayed sync is due and uploads the requested queued data types.
en.disableEffect: Neura's delayed background uploads will stop.

zh-CN.description: Neura Android SDK 的延迟同步到期时会运行此任务，上传指定类型的排队数据。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Neura 的延迟后台上传将停止。

en.description: Newki ChooseFile opens this Activity when the app asks the library to pick a local file. It shows folders and files, lets you move through directories, and returns the chosen file to the app.
en.disableEffect: The app's Newki file-picking flow cannot open or return a selected file.

zh-CN.description: 应用通过 Newki ChooseFile 选择本地文件时会打开此 Activity。它会显示文件夹和文件，供用户逐级浏览并把选中的文件交还给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用的 Newki 文件选择流程将无法打开选择界面或返回所选文件。

en.description: On Android 11 and newer, Newki ChooseFile uses this Provider to read the current folder and fill its file browser with files and folders. Android can also discover it as a document source, although this version gives the system browser no starting folders or file-opening result.
en.disableEffect: Newki ChooseFile cannot list files or folders on Android 11 and newer, so users cannot choose a file there.

zh-CN.description: 在 Android 11 及更高版本上，Newki ChooseFile 会通过此 Provider 读取当前文件夹，并在文件选择界面中显示文件和文件夹。Android 也会将它识别为文档来源，但此版本不会向系统浏览器提供起始目录或打开文件的结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Android 11 及更高版本上的 Newki 文件选择界面无法列出文件或文件夹，用户因此无法选择文件。

en.description: Newki ChooseFile uses this Provider to create shareable links for selected files and let Android open those files through the links. It is used when the picker returns a file on Android 7 and newer.
en.disableEffect: The app may fail to open or hand off a selected file, breaking flows that depend on this file chooser.

zh-CN.description: Newki ChooseFile 会使用此 Provider 为所选文件生成可共享的链接，并让 Android 通过链接打开文件。Android 7 及更高版本上，选择器返回文件时会用到它。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用可能无法打开所选文件或将其交给其他应用，依赖此选择器的流程会因此失败。

en.description: The Nexmo (now Vonage) Conversation SDK service runs when Firebase delivers a conversation push and passes the event to the app.
en.disableEffect: Conversation events delivered through Firebase push will no longer reach the app, so background message updates may be missed.

zh-CN.description: Nexmo（现为 Vonage）Conversation SDK 的此 Service 会在 Firebase 收到会话推送时运行，并将事件传递给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，通过 Firebase 推送的会话事件将无法传递给应用，后台消息更新可能会遗漏。

en.description: The Nexmo Verify SDK service handles legacy Google Cloud Messaging pushes containing a verification PIN, shows a PIN notification, and passes the code to the app.
en.disableEffect: Automatic PIN handling and the associated notifications for this legacy push route will stop.

zh-CN.description: Nexmo Verify SDK 的此 Service 会处理包含验证码的旧版 Google Cloud Messaging 推送，显示验证码通知并将验证码传给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，此旧版推送方式的验证码自动处理和相关通知将停止。

en.description: The Nexmo Verify SDK service handles Firebase pushes containing a verification PIN; it shows a notification or passes the PIN to the app.
en.disableEffect: Firebase verification PIN pushes will no longer be handled, so the SDK’s automatic PIN handoff and push-notification behavior will stop.

zh-CN.description: Nexmo Verify SDK 的此 Service 会处理包含验证码的 Firebase 推送，并显示通知或将验证码传给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Firebase 验证码推送将不再处理，SDK 的验证码自动传递和推送通知功能也会停止。

en.description: After a phone number is submitted for verification, this Nexmo Verify Activity asks the user to enter the PIN and lets them cancel, retry, or request a voice call.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot enter or confirm the verification PIN through the SDK’s built-in screen.

zh-CN.description: 提交手机号进行验证后，Nexmo Verify 的此 Activity 会要求用户输入验证码，并提供取消、重试或改为语音呼叫的选项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法通过 SDK 内置页面输入或确认验证码。

en.description: This Nexmo Verify Activity starts phone-number verification: users choose a country code, enter their phone number, and begin a PIN challenge.
en.disableEffect: Apps that rely on this built-in screen cannot start their phone-number verification flow.

zh-CN.description: Nexmo Verify 的此 Activity 用于发起手机号验证：用户选择国家区号、输入手机号并开始验证码验证。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此内置页面的应用将无法发起手机号验证流程。

en.description: NextGIS Maplib (NextGIS) provides this Android account service when the system requests account authentication. It supplies the account connector used by NextGIS apps.
en.disableEffect: Adding or authenticating a NextGIS account and account sync may fail.

zh-CN.description: NextGIS Maplib（NextGIS）会在 Android 请求账户认证时提供此账户服务，为 NextGIS 应用提供账户连接功能。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 添加或认证 NextGIS 账户以及账户同步可能失败。

en.description: NextGIS Maplib (NextGIS) starts this background service when a user starts location tracking. It records GPS positions in a track and updates the tracking notification.
en.disableEffect: GPS track recording and background location tracking will stop working.

zh-CN.description: 用户开始位置跟踪时，NextGIS Maplib（NextGIS）会启动此后台服务，将 GPS 位置记录到轨迹中并更新跟踪通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: GPS 轨迹记录和后台位置跟踪将无法工作。

en.description: MrZWC SuperAdapterWrapper starts this service when its floating diagnostic log panel is requested. The panel displays diagnostic messages from the running app over the screen.
en.disableEffect: The floating diagnostic log panel is unavailable; ordinary app screens continue to work.

zh-CN.description: MrZWC SuperAdapterWrapper 在应用请求打开悬浮诊断日志面板时启动此服务。面板会覆盖在屏幕上显示应用运行时的诊断信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后无法使用悬浮诊断日志面板，应用的常规页面仍可使用。

en.description: Acorn’s Android navigation library starts automatic checks when the app opens; as users move between screens, it checks that screen state can be restored.
en.disableEffect: Acorn’s automatic checks for restoring screens will stop running.

zh-CN.description: Acorn Android 导航库会在应用启动时开始自动检查，并在用户切换页面时确认页面状态能否恢复。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Acorn 对页面恢复能力的自动检查将不再运行。

en.description: Acorn’s Android testing library contains this empty Activity as a direct entry point for navigation tests; it does not provide an app feature.
en.disableEffect: The Acorn test screen will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: Acorn Android 测试库提供了这个空白 Activity，供导航测试直接打开；它不承载应用功能。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Acorn 的这个测试页面将无法打开。

en.description: The NHN ACE Adlib Activity displays a full-screen interstitial ad when the app requests one and handles when it is shown, tapped, or closed.
en.disableEffect: Full-screen interstitial ads from Adlib will not appear.

zh-CN.description: NHN ACE Adlib 的此 Activity 会按应用请求显示全屏插屏广告，并处理广告的展示、点击和关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Adlib 的全屏插屏广告将无法显示。

en.description: The NHN ACE Adlib Activity presents a full-screen native ad using its headline, advertiser, media, and action button; tapping it opens the ad’s destination.
en.disableEffect: Native full-screen ads and their destination links will not be available.

zh-CN.description: NHN ACE Adlib 的此 Activity 会使用广告标题、广告主、素材和操作按钮展示全屏原生广告；点击广告会打开其目标链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Adlib 的全屏原生广告及其目标链接将无法使用。

en.description: The NHN ACE Adlib Activity plays a video ad, supports its tap and skip actions, and can grant the configured reward after the required viewing threshold.
en.disableEffect: Video ads from Adlib will not play, and users will not receive rewards offered for watching them.

zh-CN.description: NHN ACE Adlib 的此 Activity 会播放视频广告、处理点击和跳过操作，并可在达到要求的观看进度后发放配置的奖励。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Adlib 视频广告将无法播放，用户也无法获得观看这些广告的奖励。

en.description: NHN Cloud Core initializes its shared Android services when the app starts; Gamebase apps that include this core use the same startup provider.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it can stop NHN Cloud or Gamebase features that depend on startup initialization.

zh-CN.description: NHN Cloud Core 会在应用启动时初始化共享服务；集成该核心库的 Gamebase 应用也会使用此启动组件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，依赖启动初始化的 NHN Cloud 或 Gamebase 功能可能无法使用。

en.description: When the app starts an in-app purchase through Huawei AppGallery, NHN Cloud IAP opens the Huawei purchase flow and returns its result to the app.
en.disableEffect: Purchases through Huawei AppGallery may not complete.

zh-CN.description: 应用通过华为应用市场发起内购时，NHN Cloud IAP 会打开华为的购买流程，并将结果返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，通过华为应用市场进行的购买可能无法完成。

en.description: When the app starts a payment through MyCard, NHN Cloud IAP opens the MyCard purchase flow and returns its success, cancellation, or error result.
en.disableEffect: Purchases through MyCard may stop working.

zh-CN.description: 应用通过 MyCard 发起付款时，NHN Cloud IAP 会打开 MyCard 购买流程，并返回成功、取消或错误结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，MyCard 付款可能无法使用。

en.description: When the app requests ONE store sign-in, NHN Cloud IAP opens the store's account screen and returns the sign-in result.
en.disableEffect: The app may no longer be able to sign in to ONE store or continue purchases that require an account.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求登录 ONE store 时，NHN Cloud IAP 会打开商店账号页面，并返回登录结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，应用可能无法登录 ONE store，也无法继续需要账号的购买流程。

en.description: When the app starts a ONE store purchase, NHN Cloud IAP opens the store's checkout screen and returns the order result.
en.disableEffect: Purchases through ONE store may not complete.

zh-CN.description: 应用通过 ONE store 发起购买时，NHN Cloud IAP 会打开商店结账页面，并返回订单结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，通过 ONE store 进行的购买可能无法完成。

en.description: When the app starts an external payment through ONE store, NHN Cloud IAP displays the payment page in a web screen and returns whether the purchase completed or was canceled.
en.disableEffect: External payments through ONE store may not finish.

zh-CN.description: 应用通过 ONE store 发起外部付款时，NHN Cloud IAP 会在网页界面中显示付款页面，并返回购买是否完成或取消。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，通过 ONE store 进行的外部付款可能无法完成。

en.description: When the app starts a ONE store purchase, NHN Cloud IAP opens the store's checkout flow and returns the purchase result.
en.disableEffect: Purchases through this ONE store billing flow may not complete.

zh-CN.description: 应用通过 ONE store 发起购买时，NHN Cloud IAP 会打开商店结账流程，并返回购买结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，通过此 ONE store 计费流程进行的购买可能无法完成。

en.description: At app startup, NHN Cloud Credit Card Recognizer registers the services used to scan a payment card and read its details.
en.disableEffect: Apps that use NHN Cloud to enter card details may lose that payment feature if this component is disabled.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，NHN Cloud Credit Card Recognizer 会注册用于扫描银行卡并读取卡片信息的服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 如果应用使用 NHN Cloud 录入银行卡信息，禁用后该付款功能可能无法使用。

en.description: When the app asks NHN Cloud Credit Card Recognizer to scan a payment card, this Activity opens a camera-guided screen to capture its details.
en.disableEffect: The app's NHN Cloud card-scanning flow will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求 NHN Cloud Credit Card Recognizer 扫描银行卡时，此 Activity 会打开摄像头引导界面以拍摄卡片信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，应用将无法打开 NHN Cloud 银行卡扫描流程。

en.description: At app startup, NHN Cloud ID Card Authenticator registers the service the app can use to check whether an identity card is authentic.
en.disableEffect: The app may no longer be able to verify identity cards through NHN Cloud.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，NHN Cloud ID Card Authenticator 会注册用于验证身份证件真伪的服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，应用可能无法通过 NHN Cloud 验证身份证件。

en.description: At app startup, NHN Cloud ID Card Recognizer registers the services used to scan identity cards and read their details.
en.disableEffect: Apps that use NHN Cloud to capture identity-card details may lose that feature.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，NHN Cloud ID Card Recognizer 会注册用于扫描身份证件并读取信息的服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 如果应用使用 NHN Cloud 采集身份证件信息，禁用后该功能可能无法使用。

en.description: When the app requests an identity-card scan from NHN Cloud, this Activity opens a camera screen and guides the user through capturing the card.
en.disableEffect: The app's NHN Cloud identity-card scanning flow will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求 NHN Cloud 扫描身份证件时，此 Activity 会打开摄像头界面并引导用户拍摄证件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，应用将无法打开 NHN Cloud 身份证件扫描流程。

en.description: When Amazon Device Messaging delivers a push message or registration update, this NHN Cloud Push service processes it for the app.
en.disableEffect: NHN Cloud push messages delivered through Amazon Device Messaging will stop arriving.

zh-CN.description: Amazon Device Messaging 收到推送消息或注册状态更新时，此 NHN Cloud Push 服务会为应用处理该事件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，通过 Amazon Device Messaging 发送的 NHN Cloud 推送将无法送达。

en.description: On older Amazon Device Messaging integrations, this NHN Cloud Push service handles incoming messages and registration updates for the app.
en.disableEffect: NHN Cloud push messages delivered through the older Amazon Device Messaging path will stop arriving.

zh-CN.description: 在较早的 Amazon Device Messaging 集成中，此 NHN Cloud Push 服务会为应用处理收到的消息和注册状态更新。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，通过旧版 Amazon Device Messaging 通道发送的 NHN Cloud 推送将无法送达。

en.description: Amazon Device Messaging starts this NHN Cloud Push Receiver for registration and incoming-message events, which it routes to a background service.
en.disableEffect: NHN Cloud push messages and registration updates from Amazon Device Messaging will stop working.

zh-CN.description: Amazon Device Messaging 会在注册或收到消息时启动此 NHN Cloud Push Receiver，再由它转交给后台服务处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，来自 Amazon Device Messaging 的 NHN Cloud 推送和注册更新将无法工作。

en.description: Firebase starts this NHN Cloud Push service when a message arrives or its device token changes; the service delivers messages to the app and updates push registration.
en.disableEffect: Push messages delivered through Firebase may stop arriving, and the app's push registration may become outdated.

zh-CN.description: Firebase 收到消息或设备令牌变化时会启动此 NHN Cloud Push 服务；该服务会将消息交给应用并更新推送注册信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，通过 Firebase 发送的推送可能无法送达，应用的推送注册信息也可能无法更新。

en.description: When a user taps a button on an NHN Cloud push alert, this Receiver handles the chosen action and notifies the app.
en.disableEffect: Notification buttons such as opening a link or sending a quick reply may stop working.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击 NHN Cloud 推送通知上的按钮时，此 Receiver 会处理所选操作并通知应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，打开链接或快速回复等通知按钮可能无法使用。

en.description: When a user taps an NHN Cloud push-alert action that opens the app or a link, this Activity carries out that choice and then closes.
en.disableEffect: Those notification actions may no longer open their intended screen or link.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击会打开应用或链接的 NHN Cloud 推送操作时，此 Activity 会执行该操作并随即关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，这些通知操作可能无法打开预期页面或链接。

en.description: On Android 11 and earlier, tapping an NHN Cloud push alert runs this background Service to open the screen or link attached to the alert.
en.disableEffect: Tapping the body of a push alert may no longer open its saved screen or link on older Android versions.

zh-CN.description: 在 Android 11 及更早版本中，点击 NHN Cloud 推送通知会运行此后台 Service，以打开通知关联的页面或链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，在较旧的 Android 版本中点击推送通知正文可能无法打开关联页面或链接。

en.description: On Android 12 and later, tapping an NHN Cloud push alert opens its saved screen or link through this brief Activity, which then closes.
en.disableEffect: Tapping the body of a push alert may no longer open its saved screen or link on newer Android versions.

zh-CN.description: 在 Android 12 及更新版本中，点击 NHN Cloud 推送通知会通过此短暂显示的 Activity 打开关联页面或链接，然后关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，在较新的 Android 版本中点击推送通知正文可能无法打开关联页面或链接。

en.description: NHN TOAST IAP opens this screen for in-app purchases; it initializes purchase handling, starts the selected purchase, and returns its result to the app.
en.disableEffect: In-app purchases may fail or their results may not return to the app.

zh-CN.description: NHN TOAST IAP 会为应用内购买打开此页面，初始化购买处理、开始所选购买并将结果返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后应用内购买可能失败，购买结果也可能无法返回应用。

en.description: Hapzi Native Carousel Ads shows a carousel of promoted apps when the app opens its cross-promotion screen; tapping an item opens its Google Play listing.
en.disableEffect: The app's cross-promotion carousel and its promoted-app links will stop working.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开交叉推广页面时，Hapzi Native Carousel Ads 会展示一组推荐应用；点击其中一项会打开它在 Google Play 上的页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，应用的交叉推广轮播和推荐应用链接将无法使用。

en.description: NightlyNexus DiskCrashReporter installs crash logging when the app starts and saves details from uncaught crashes before Android's normal crash handler runs.
en.disableEffect: DiskCrashReporter will no longer save crash logs or offer its crash-report notification and shortcut.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，NightlyNexus DiskCrashReporter 会安装崩溃记录功能，并在 Android 默认崩溃处理程序运行前保存未捕获崩溃的详细信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，DiskCrashReporter 将不再保存崩溃日志，也不会提供崩溃报告通知和快捷入口。

en.description: NightlyNexus DiskCrashReporter uses this Android file-sharing provider to let external text viewers open saved crash logs.
en.disableEffect: Opening saved DiskCrashReporter logs may fail.

zh-CN.description: NightlyNexus DiskCrashReporter 通过此 Android 文件共享 Provider，让外部文本查看器能够打开已保存的崩溃日志。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，可能无法打开 DiskCrashReporter 保存的日志。

en.description: Noah's Yolink SDK opens this screen from its log-view helper when the app requests a saved log. It displays the local log file for inspection.
en.disableEffect: The SDK's in-app log preview will be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: Noah 的 Yolink SDK 会在应用请求查看已保存日志时打开此页面，并显示本地日志文件供检查。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，SDK 内查看日志的页面将无法打开。

en.description: BackgroundLibrary by zzhhz initializes its automatic view styling when the app starts and applies custom backgrounds such as rounded shapes, gradients, borders, and pressed states.
en.disableEffect: Views that rely on this library may lose their custom backgrounds and pressed appearance, while their controls remain usable.

zh-CN.description: zzhhz 的 BackgroundLibrary 会在应用启动时启用自动视图样式处理，并为按钮和页面应用圆角、渐变、边框和按压状态等自定义背景。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖该库的视图可能不再显示自定义背景和按压效果，但控件本身仍可使用。

en.description: After Android replaces the app package during an update, the NotifyVisitors Native Android SDK checks the new version and records that an update occurred for later reporting.
en.disableEffect: NotifyVisitors may miss the app-update event; the app's other features remain available.

zh-CN.description: Android 更新并替换应用包后，NotifyVisitors 原生 Android SDK 会检查新版本，并记录此次更新供后续上报。
zh-CN.disableEffect: NotifyVisitors 可能无法记录应用更新事件；应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: When started, the NotifyVisitors Native Android SDK checks whether the app was installed or updated and reports that event to NotifyVisitors.
en.disableEffect: NotifyVisitors may stop recording app install and update events.

zh-CN.description: 启动后，NotifyVisitors 原生 Android SDK 会检查应用是否刚安装或更新，并向 NotifyVisitors 上报相应事件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: NotifyVisitors 可能无法再记录应用安装和更新事件。

en.description: When the app opens a NotifyVisitors chatbot for a screen, this Activity loads that screen's configured chat and displays it inside the app.
en.disableEffect: The NotifyVisitors chatbot will not open, while the app's other features remain available.

zh-CN.description: 应用为某个界面打开 NotifyVisitors 聊天机器人时，此 Activity 会加载该界面对应的聊天内容并在应用内显示。
zh-CN.disableEffect: NotifyVisitors 聊天机器人将无法打开，应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: When a user opens NotifyVisitors' notification center, this Activity retrieves and displays the user's saved push messages.
en.disableEffect: Users will no longer be able to browse their saved NotifyVisitors notifications in the app.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 NotifyVisitors 通知中心时，此 Activity 会获取并显示用户保存的推送消息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在应用中浏览已保存的 NotifyVisitors 通知。

en.description: When Google location services report entry into or exit from a monitored area, this NotifyVisitors service checks for a matching campaign and may show its local push notification.
en.disableEffect: Location-based NotifyVisitors notifications and their related engagement reporting may stop.

zh-CN.description: Google 位置服务报告用户进入或离开监控区域时，此 NotifyVisitors 服务会查找匹配的活动，并可能显示相应的本地推送通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 基于位置的 NotifyVisitors 通知及相关互动上报可能会停止。

en.description: When a user taps a NotifyVisitors message in older SDK releases, this service records the click and carries out the message's configured destination or action.
en.disableEffect: Taps on older NotifyVisitors messages may no longer open their configured screen, link, or sharing action.

zh-CN.description: 在较早版本的 SDK 中，用户点按 NotifyVisitors 消息时，此服务会记录点击，并执行消息配置的目标页面或操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 较早版本的 NotifyVisitors 消息被点按后，可能无法再打开配置的页面、链接或分享操作。

en.description: When a user taps a NotifyVisitors push or in-app message, this Activity records the click and carries out the configured destination or action.
en.disableEffect: Taps on NotifyVisitors messages may no longer open their configured destination or action.

zh-CN.description: 用户点按 NotifyVisitors 推送或应用内消息时，此 Activity 会记录点击并执行配置的目标页面或操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户点按 NotifyVisitors 消息后，可能无法再打开配置的目标页面或执行相应操作。

en.description: When started by an interactive NotifyVisitors notification action, this service closes an animated notification or changes its playback state.
en.disableEffect: Close and playback controls on animated NotifyVisitors notifications may stop responding.

zh-CN.description: 交互式 NotifyVisitors 通知触发此服务时，它会关闭动画通知或切换其播放状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 动画 NotifyVisitors 通知的关闭和播放控制可能无法响应。

en.description: When NotifyVisitors queues a push message for background delivery, this service reads its content, retrieves any needed images, and posts the notification.
en.disableEffect: NotifyVisitors push notifications may no longer appear.

zh-CN.description: NotifyVisitors 将推送消息排入后台处理时，此服务会读取消息内容、获取所需图片并显示通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: NotifyVisitors 推送通知可能不再显示。

en.description: When started by a NotifyVisitors notification action, this service removes the SDK's persistent notification.
en.disableEffect: The persistent NotifyVisitors notification may remain after its action is used.

zh-CN.description: NotifyVisitors 通知操作启动此服务时，它会移除 SDK 显示的持续通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用通知操作后，持续显示的 NotifyVisitors 通知可能仍会保留。

en.description: When a carousel push needs to change slides, this service updates the notification using the saved campaign images and actions.
en.disableEffect: Carousel notifications may not advance between slides or respond to their navigation controls.

zh-CN.description: 轮播推送需要切换页面时，此服务会使用已保存的活动图片和操作更新通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 轮播通知可能无法切换页面，也无法响应导航控件。

en.description: When a rating-style push arrives, this service creates its interactive star-rating notification and handles the supplied rating details.
en.disableEffect: Rating-style NotifyVisitors notifications and their response controls may stop working.

zh-CN.description: 收到评分样式的推送时，此服务会创建可交互的星级评分通知，并处理其中的评分信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 评分样式的 NotifyVisitors 通知及其响应控件可能无法使用。

en.description: After Android replaces the app package during an update, the NotifyVisitors Native TWA SDK checks the new version and records that an update occurred for later reporting.
en.disableEffect: NotifyVisitors may miss the app-update event; the app's other features remain available.

zh-CN.description: Android 更新并替换应用包后，NotifyVisitors 原生 TWA SDK 会检查新版本，并记录此次更新供后续上报。
zh-CN.disableEffect: NotifyVisitors 可能无法记录应用更新事件；应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: When started, the NotifyVisitors Native TWA SDK checks whether the app was installed or updated and reports that event to NotifyVisitors.
en.disableEffect: NotifyVisitors may stop recording app install and update events.

zh-CN.description: 启动后，NotifyVisitors 原生 TWA SDK 会检查应用是否刚安装或更新，并向 NotifyVisitors 上报相应事件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: NotifyVisitors 可能无法再记录应用安装和更新事件。

en.description: The Novoda Merlin library listens for Android network-change broadcasts and forwards connection changes to its network-status service.
en.disableEffect: Apps relying on Merlin may stop receiving connection-change updates, affecting offline or reconnect behavior.

zh-CN.description: Novoda Merlin 网络状态库会监听 Android 的网络变化广播，并将连接变化转发给其网络状态服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖 Merlin 的应用可能收不到连接变化通知，离线或重连处理可能受影响。

en.description: When an app subscribes to network updates, the Novoda Merlin library checks connectivity and reports when the connection becomes available or is lost.
en.disableEffect: Apps relying on Merlin may stop receiving connection updates needed for offline or reconnect behavior.

zh-CN.description: 应用订阅网络状态更新时，Novoda Merlin 网络状态库会检查连接情况，并报告连接建立或中断。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖 Merlin 的应用可能收不到离线或重连处理所需的连接状态更新。

en.description: The PrivacyPolicyHelper library opens this screen with a policy link and title supplied by the app; it displays that page in an in-app browser and supports page navigation.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from viewing the app's privacy policy through this library.

zh-CN.description: PrivacyPolicyHelper 在应用提供隐私政策链接和标题后打开此页面，在应用内浏览页面并支持网页导航。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过此库查看应用的隐私政策。

en.description: If enabled, this Nu-Art Cyborg framework receiver runs after Android starts and tells the app framework that device startup has completed.
en.disableEffect: App behavior registered for the device-startup callback will not run at startup.

zh-CN.description: 启用后，Nu-Art Cyborg 框架会在 Android 启动完成时收到通知，并将设备已启动的事件传给应用框架。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过设备启动回调注册的应用行为将无法在开机后运行。

en.description: When an app starts or binds to it, this Nu-Art Cyborg framework service provides an app-level service endpoint and can remain available for later restarts.
en.disableEffect: App features that depend on starting or binding to this framework service may stop working.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动或绑定此服务时，Nu-Art Cyborg 框架会提供应用级服务入口，并可在之后重新启动。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖启动或绑定此框架服务的应用功能可能无法使用。

en.description: Apps built with the Nu-Art Cyborg framework use this Activity to manage screens and pass navigation, lifecycle, and permission results through the framework.
en.disableEffect: Screens that depend on this Cyborg Activity may fail to open or handle navigation and permission results.

zh-CN.description: 使用 Nu-Art Cyborg 框架构建的应用通过此 Activity 管理界面，并由框架处理导航、界面状态和权限结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此 Cyborg Activity 的界面可能无法打开，或无法处理导航和权限结果。

en.description: When Firebase refreshes the app's registration token, this Nu-Art Cyborg Firebase service saves the token and notifies app code so push registration can be updated.
en.disableEffect: The app may miss Firebase token updates, which can interrupt push delivery addressed to the updated token.

zh-CN.description: Firebase 刷新应用注册令牌时，Nu-Art Cyborg Firebase 服务会保存令牌并通知应用代码，以便更新推送注册信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用可能无法收到 Firebase 令牌更新，导致发往新令牌的推送中断。

en.description: When Firebase Cloud Messaging delivers a message, this Nu-Art Cyborg Firebase service passes it to the app's registered message handler.
en.disableEffect: Firebase messages will not reach app handlers that rely on this service.

zh-CN.description: Firebase Cloud Messaging 投递消息时，Nu-Art Cyborg Firebase 服务会将消息交给应用注册的消息处理程序。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此服务的应用消息处理程序将无法收到 Firebase 消息。

en.description: When a text, HTML, or XML file is opened with Android's VIEW action, this Nu-Art Cyborg log viewer imports it and opens its log screen.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to open text-based log files in the app's built-in Cyborg log viewer.

zh-CN.description: 通过 Android 的 VIEW 操作打开文本、HTML 或 XML 文件时，Nu-Art Cyborg 日志查看器会导入文件并打开日志界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在应用内置的 Cyborg 日志查看器中打开文本类日志文件。

en.description: When a ZIP file is opened with Android's VIEW action, this Nu-Art Cyborg log viewer imports the archive and opens its logs.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to open archived log files in the app's built-in Cyborg log viewer.

zh-CN.description: 通过 Android 的 VIEW 操作打开 ZIP 文件时，Nu-Art Cyborg 日志查看器会导入压缩包并打开其中的日志。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在应用内置的 Cyborg 日志查看器中打开压缩的日志文件。

en.description: When enabled, this Nu-Art Cyborg receiver responds to Android package install, removal, and update events and passes the changed package to the app-status module.
en.disableEffect: Apps that use Cyborg to track installed apps may miss install, removal, and update changes.

zh-CN.description: 启用后，Android 报告其他应用已安装、移除或更新时，此 Nu-Art Cyborg 接收器会将发生变化的软件包传给应用状态模块。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用 Cyborg 跟踪已安装应用的功能可能无法获知安装、移除或更新变化。

en.description: When enabled for device administration, this Nu-Art Cyborg receiver forwards Android device-admin and lock-task mode events to the app.
en.disableEffect: Device-management apps may miss administrator or lock-task events needed for their management features.

zh-CN.description: 启用设备管理后，Android 更改应用的设备管理状态或进入、退出锁定任务模式时，Nu-Art Cyborg 会将事件转交给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 设备管理应用可能无法收到管理功能所需的管理员状态或锁定任务事件。

en.description: When a user taps an action on a notification created through Nu-Art Cyborg, this receiver passes the action to the app's notification handler.
en.disableEffect: Actions on notifications created through Cyborg may stop reaching the app's handlers.

zh-CN.description: 用户点按 Nu-Art Cyborg 创建的通知操作时，此接收器会将操作交给应用的通知处理程序。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户点按 Cyborg 创建的通知操作后，应用处理程序可能无法收到相应操作。

en.description: When an alarm scheduled through Nu-Art Cyborg fires, this receiver runs the app task saved for that time.
en.disableEffect: Scheduled background tasks that use Cyborg may not run.

zh-CN.description: 通过 Nu-Art Cyborg 安排的闹钟触发时，此接收器会运行应用为该时间安排的任务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用 Cyborg 安排的后台任务可能无法运行。

en.description: When a user opens an app configured with the Nu-Art Cyborg launcher, this Activity opens the app's configured starting screen.
en.disableEffect: The app may not open its configured starting screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户通过 Nu-Art Cyborg 启动器打开应用时，此 Activity 会打开应用配置的起始界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用可能无法打开配置的起始界面。

en.description: Nyima WebSDK opens a URL selected by the app in an in-app browser; Back returns through pages already visited before closing the screen.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open app pages that rely on Nyima WebSDK.

zh-CN.description: Nyima WebSDK 会在应用内浏览器中打开应用指定的网址；按返回键时会先返回已浏览的页面，再关闭此页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法打开依赖 Nyima WebSDK 的应用页面。

en.description: The New York Times Register SDK opens this main purchase screen when requested, or goes directly to a selected purchase flow when the app supplies one. The main page can show available products and existing purchases.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to open this SDK's purchase and subscription screen.

zh-CN.description: New York Times Register SDK 在收到打开请求时显示此购买主页面；如果应用指定了购买流程，则直接进入相应页面。主页面可显示可购买产品和已有购买记录。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开此 SDK 的购买和订阅页面。

en.description: When a billing client binds through the Register SDK's in-app billing action, this New York Times service provides product, purchase, and purchase-history operations.
en.disableEffect: In-app purchase and subscription operations that use this billing service will fail.

zh-CN.description: 账单客户端通过 Register SDK 的应用内账单操作绑定时，此 New York Times 服务会提供商品、购买和购买记录相关操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此账单服务的应用内购买和订阅操作将无法使用。

en.description: The CIB SDK Huawei Branch opens this account-linking screen when an app requires the player to attach an email account. It sends a verification code and submits the link after the code is entered.
en.disableEffect: Disabling this screen prevents required account linking, so the user may be unable to continue through that sign-in flow.

zh-CN.description: CIB SDK 的 Huawei Branch 在应用要求玩家绑定邮箱账号时显示此页面。它会发送验证码，并在用户填写验证码后提交绑定。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，必须完成账号绑定的登录流程可能无法继续。

en.description: The CIB SDK Huawei Branch opens this account-linking screen when an app requires the player to attach an email account. It sends a verification code and submits the link after the code is entered.
en.disableEffect: Disabling this screen prevents required account linking, so the user may be unable to continue through that sign-in flow.

zh-CN.description: CIB SDK 的 Huawei Branch 在应用要求玩家绑定邮箱账号时显示此页面。它会发送验证码，并在用户填写验证码后提交绑定。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，必须完成账号绑定的登录流程可能无法继续。

en.description: When a user recovers an account, the CIB SDK Huawei Branch sends a verification code to the entered email and submits a new password.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot complete password recovery through the CIB SDK, which may leave them unable to sign in.

zh-CN.description: 用户找回账号时，CIB SDK 的 Huawei Branch 会向填写的邮箱发送验证码，并提交新密码。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法通过 CIB SDK 找回密码，可能因此无法登录。

en.description: The CIBMall Huawei Branch account SDK opens this page when a user requests password recovery or an account change. It requests an account verification code and submits the requested password or account update.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it blocks password recovery and account credential changes provided by Huawei Branch.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 CIBMall Huawei Branch 账号 SDK 中找回密码或更改账号信息时，会打开此页面。页面申请账号验证码，并提交密码重置或账号修改请求。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Huawei Branch 提供的密码找回和账号信息修改流程将无法使用。

en.description: When the user opens account details, the CIB SDK Huawei Branch shows the signed-in account and offers actions such as switching accounts, linking an account, changing the nickname, and signing out.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open this account page to manage or switch their CIB SDK account.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开账号资料时，CIB SDK 的 Huawei Branch 会显示已登录账号，并提供切换账号、绑定账号、修改昵称和退出等操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法打开此页面来管理或切换 CIB SDK 账号。

en.description: When a signed-in user opens account management, the CIBMall Huawei Branch SDK shows account details and offers account switching, sign-out, linked-account changes, account removal, and a profile screenshot.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it removes these Huawei Branch account-management actions from the app.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开账号管理时，CIBMall Huawei Branch SDK 会显示账号信息，并提供切换账号、退出登录、修改或绑定账号、申请注销和保存个人页面截图等操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用将无法通过 Huawei Branch 使用这些账号管理功能。

en.description: When the app requests sign-in, the CIB SDK Huawei Branch shows password login and configured Huawei, Facebook, and guest sign-in options; it also links to account creation and password recovery.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot use this CIB SDK sign-in screen, so its Huawei Branch login flow may fail.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求登录时，CIB SDK 的 Huawei Branch 会显示密码登录以及已配置的华为、Facebook 和游客登录选项，也可进入账号注册和密码找回页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用无法使用此 CIB SDK 登录页面，Huawei Branch 登录流程可能失败。

en.description: When the app requests a Huawei Branch sign-in, this CIBMall SDK page offers account login and the available Huawei or Facebook sign-in options. It returns the selected sign-in result to the app.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it blocks sign-in through the Huawei Branch SDK.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求通过 CIBMall Huawei Branch 登录时，此页面提供账号登录以及可用的华为或 Facebook 登录方式，并把所选登录结果返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过 Huawei Branch SDK 登录。

en.description: When a user chooses account-and-password login, this CIBMall Huawei Branch page accepts the credentials and links to guest sign-in, password recovery, and registration.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it blocks account-and-password sign-in and the guest, recovery, and registration options on this page.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择账号密码登录时，CIBMall Huawei Branch 页面会收集登录信息，并提供游客登录、找回密码和注册入口。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，账号密码登录以及此页面上的游客登录、找回密码和注册入口都将无法使用。

en.description: When a signed-in user chooses to change their nickname, the CIB SDK Huawei Branch opens this screen and submits the new name.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot change their nickname through the CIB SDK account page.

zh-CN.description: 已登录用户选择修改昵称时，CIB SDK 的 Huawei Branch 会打开此页面并提交新昵称。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法通过 CIB SDK 账号页面修改昵称。

en.description: The CIBMall Huawei Branch account SDK opens this page to collect a new nickname. After checking the name, it continues to the account confirmation that saves the change.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from changing their nickname through Huawei Branch.

zh-CN.description: CIBMall Huawei Branch 账号 SDK 会打开此页面收集新昵称。页面检查昵称后，会继续进入账号确认并保存修改。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过 Huawei Branch 修改昵称。

en.description: When a user creates an account, the CIB SDK Huawei Branch collects the account name and password and submits the registration.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot create an account through the CIB SDK registration flow.

zh-CN.description: 用户注册账号时，CIB SDK 的 Huawei Branch 会收集账号名和密码并提交注册。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法通过 CIB SDK 的注册流程创建账号。

en.description: The CIBMall Huawei Branch SDK uses this registration page to create an account. It checks the entered account and matching passwords, then submits the registration request.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from completing registration through this Huawei Branch page.

zh-CN.description: CIBMall Huawei Branch SDK 使用此页面创建账号。页面检查账号和两次输入的密码是否一致，然后提交注册请求。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过此 Huawei Branch 页面完成注册。

en.description: When a user chooses registration from the Huawei Branch account sign-in page, this screen collects an account and password confirmation and submits the new account.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents account registration from this Huawei Branch sign-in flow.

zh-CN.description: 用户从 Huawei Branch 账号登录页面选择注册时，会打开此页面填写账号和两次密码，并提交新账号注册。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过此 Huawei Branch 登录流程注册账号。

en.description: Before account removal, the CIBMall Huawei Branch SDK shows a confirmation page that keeps Delete disabled for 15 seconds. Confirming then sends the account-removal request.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from confirming deletion of a Huawei Branch account.

zh-CN.description: 申请注销账号前，CIBMall Huawei Branch SDK 会显示确认页面，并在 15 秒内禁用删除按钮。等待结束后确认，页面才会提交注销请求。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法确认注销 Huawei Branch 账号。

en.description: After a user chooses guest sign-in from the Huawei Branch account page, this prompt asks them to continue. Confirming submits the guest sign-in request.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it blocks guest sign-in through this Huawei Branch flow.

zh-CN.description: 用户从 Huawei Branch 账号页面选择游客登录后，会看到此确认提示。确认后，页面会提交游客登录请求。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过此 Huawei Branch 流程进行游客登录。

en.description: The CIB SDK Huawei Branch shows a follow-up prompt for guest sign-in, clearing an account, or changing a nickname. Confirming continues the selected account action, and account clearing has a short countdown.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot complete these follow-up account actions, including guest sign-in and account clearing.

zh-CN.description: CIB SDK 的 Huawei Branch 会为游客登录、清除账号或修改昵称显示后续确认提示。确认后会继续对应操作，清除账号前还会短暂倒计时。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法完成这些后续账号操作，包括游客登录和清除账号。

en.description: The CIBMall Huawei Branch account SDK uses this page for guest sign-in, account removal, or nickname changes, depending on the requested account action. Its confirmation button continues the selected request.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it blocks these Huawei Branch guest sign-in, account-removal, and nickname-change prompts.

zh-CN.description: CIBMall Huawei Branch 账号 SDK 会根据当前操作，用此页面处理游客登录、账号注销或昵称修改。点击确认后会继续执行相应请求。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Huawei Branch 的游客登录、账号注销和昵称修改提示流程将无法完成。

en.description: When saved sign-in details are available and automatic sign-in is requested, the CIBMall or PlayID OneSDK account SDK opens this page. It checks the saved account with the service and returns the sign-in result.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents saved-account sign-in from completing, so the user may remain signed out.

zh-CN.description: 存在已保存的登录信息且应用请求自动登录时，CIBMall 或 PlayID OneSDK 账号 SDK 会打开此页面。页面向账号服务验证已保存的账号，并返回登录结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，已保存账号的自动登录无法完成，用户可能仍处于未登录状态。

en.description: The CIBMall or PlayID OneSDK account SDK opens this page for password recovery or account changes. It requests a verification code and submits a password reset, password change, or account-binding request.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents OneSDK password recovery and the account-change flows that use this page.

zh-CN.description: 用户通过 CIBMall 或 PlayID OneSDK 找回密码或修改账号信息时，会打开此页面。页面申请验证码，并提交密码重置、密码修改或账号绑定请求。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，OneSDK 的密码找回和使用此页面的账号修改流程将无法完成。

en.description: When a user opens account management, the CIBMall or PlayID OneSDK account SDK shows account details and offers account switching, sign-out, linked-account changes, a profile screenshot, and account removal.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it removes these OneSDK account-management options from the app.
