zh-CN.description: 用户打开账号管理时，CIBMall 或 PlayID OneSDK 账号 SDK 会显示账号信息，并提供切换账号、退出登录、修改或绑定账号、保存个人页面截图和申请注销等功能。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用将无法通过 OneSDK 使用这些账号管理功能。

en.description: The CIBMall and PlayID OneSDK packages declare this activity as a standalone loading screen. The analyzed code displays a progress layout but does not show what launches this activity.
en.disableEffect: If the app opens this page, disabling it prevents the progress screen from appearing; no further effect is shown in the analyzed code.

zh-CN.description: CIBMall 和 PlayID OneSDK 包含此独立加载页面。代码显示它会呈现进度界面，但没有显示由什么操作启动此页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 如果应用打开此页面，停用后进度界面将无法显示；分析到的代码未显示其他影响。

en.description: PlayID’s oneSDK login SDK opens this screen when a game restores a saved account and needs to complete automatic login; some builds also continue Google or Facebook login here.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it interrupts oneSDK login, so users may be unable to enter the game with their account.

zh-CN.description: PlayID 的 oneSDK 登录 SDK 会在游戏恢复已保存账号时打开此界面并完成自动登录；部分版本也会在此继续 Google 或 Facebook 登录。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，oneSDK 登录流程会中断，用户可能无法使用账号进入游戏。

en.description: When the app requests sign-in, the CIBMall or PlayID OneSDK account SDK opens this login page. It offers account sign-in and the sign-in methods enabled for that app, then returns the result.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from signing in through OneSDK.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求登录时，CIBMall 或 PlayID OneSDK 账号 SDK 会打开此页面。页面提供账号登录和应用启用的其他登录方式，并返回登录结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过 OneSDK 登录。

en.description: PlayID’s oneSDK login SDK opens this screen when the user chooses a PlayPark account; it accepts the account details and continues the login request.
en.disableEffect: PlayPark account login will stop working in the app.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择使用 PlayPark 账号时，PlayID 的 oneSDK 登录 SDK 会打开此界面，供用户填写账号信息并继续登录。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法在应用中使用 PlayPark 账号登录。

en.description: When a user chooses account-and-password login inside OneSDK, this page accepts the credentials and offers guest sign-in, password recovery, and registration.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it blocks OneSDK account-and-password sign-in and the guest, recovery, and registration options on this page.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 OneSDK 中选择账号密码登录时，此页面会收集登录信息，并提供游客登录、找回密码和注册入口。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，OneSDK 账号密码登录以及此页面上的游客登录、找回密码和注册入口都将无法使用。

en.description: The CIBMall OneSDK account SDK opens this page to collect a new nickname. After checking the name, it continues to the account confirmation that saves the change.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from changing their nickname through this OneSDK account flow.

zh-CN.description: CIBMall OneSDK 账号 SDK 会打开此页面收集新昵称。页面检查昵称后，会继续进入账号确认并保存修改。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过此 OneSDK 账号流程修改昵称。

en.description: The CIBMall and PlayID OneSDK packages include a saved-account picker that lists previously used accounts. Selecting one attempts sign-in with that account; the analyzed SDK code does not show what opens this page.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from selecting a saved account through this screen.

zh-CN.description: CIBMall 和 PlayID OneSDK 包含已保存账号选择页，可列出以前使用过的账号。选择账号后会尝试登录；分析到的 SDK 代码没有显示由什么操作打开此页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过此页面选择已保存的账号。

en.description: When a purchase uses OneSDK web checkout, the CIBMall or PlayID OneSDK payment SDK opens this page to show the payment website and check whether the order completes.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents this web checkout from completing or returning its payment result.

zh-CN.description: 购买流程使用 OneSDK 网页收银台时，CIBMall 或 PlayID OneSDK 支付 SDK 会打开此页面显示付款网页，并检查订单是否完成。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，此网页收银台无法完成付款或返回付款结果。

en.description: When a user starts identity verification, the CIBMall or PlayID OneSDK account SDK asks for their legal name and identity number and submits them for verification.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents identity verification through OneSDK.

zh-CN.description: 用户开始身份验证时，CIBMall 或 PlayID OneSDK 账号 SDK 会要求填写真实姓名和身份证件号码，并提交验证。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过 OneSDK 完成身份验证。

en.description: The CIBMall OneSDK account SDK uses this registration page to create an account. It accepts an email address and matching new passwords, then submits the registration request.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents account registration through this OneSDK page.

zh-CN.description: CIBMall OneSDK 账号 SDK 使用此页面创建账号。页面收集邮箱和两次输入的新密码，检查一致后提交注册请求。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过此 OneSDK 页面注册账号。

en.description: When a user chooses registration from the CIBMall or PlayID OneSDK sign-in flow, this page collects an account and password confirmation. A successful registration signs the user in.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents registration through this OneSDK sign-in flow.

zh-CN.description: 用户从 CIBMall 或 PlayID OneSDK 登录流程中选择注册时，会打开此页面填写账号和两次密码。注册成功后页面会登录该账号。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过此 OneSDK 登录流程完成注册。

en.description: Before account removal, the CIBMall or PlayID OneSDK account SDK shows a confirmation page that keeps Delete disabled for 15 seconds. Confirming then submits the removal request.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from confirming deletion of a OneSDK account.

zh-CN.description: 申请注销账号前，CIBMall 或 PlayID OneSDK 账号 SDK 会显示确认页面，并在 15 秒内禁用删除按钮。等待结束后确认，页面才会提交注销请求。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法确认注销 OneSDK 账号。

en.description: After a user chooses guest sign-in in OneSDK, this prompt asks them to continue. Confirming submits the guest sign-in request.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it blocks guest sign-in through this OneSDK flow.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 OneSDK 中选择游客登录后，会看到此确认提示。确认后，页面会提交游客登录请求。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过此 OneSDK 流程进行游客登录。

en.description: The CIBMall OneSDK account SDK uses this page for guest sign-in, account removal, or nickname changes, depending on the requested account action. Its confirmation button continues the selected request.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it blocks these OneSDK guest sign-in, account-removal, and nickname-change flows.

zh-CN.description: CIBMall OneSDK 账号 SDK 会根据当前操作，用此页面处理游客登录、账号注销或昵称修改。点击确认后会继续执行相应请求。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，OneSDK 的游客登录、账号注销和昵称修改流程将无法完成。

en.description: When the CIB SDK OneSDK Branch opens its account-binding reward page, it displays the configured rewards for the user to review, copy, or dismiss.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot view or copy the account-binding reward list through this page.

zh-CN.description: CIB SDK 的 OneSDK Branch 打开账号绑定奖励页面时，会显示已配置的奖励，供用户查看、复制或关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法通过此页面查看或复制账号绑定奖励清单。

en.description: The CIB SDK OneSDK Branch opens this account-linking screen when an app requires the player to attach an email account. It sends a verification code and submits the link after the code is entered.
en.disableEffect: Disabling this screen prevents required account linking, so the user may be unable to continue through that sign-in flow.

zh-CN.description: CIB SDK 的 OneSDK Branch 在应用要求玩家绑定邮箱账号时显示此页面。它会发送验证码，并在用户填写验证码后提交绑定。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，必须完成账号绑定的登录流程可能无法继续。

en.description: When a user recovers an account, the CIB SDK OneSDK Branch sends a verification code to the entered email and submits a new password.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot complete password recovery through the CIB SDK, which may leave them unable to sign in.

zh-CN.description: 用户找回账号时，CIB SDK 的 OneSDK Branch 会向填写的邮箱发送验证码，并提交新密码。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法通过 CIB SDK 找回密码，可能因此无法登录。

en.description: When the user opens account details, the CIB SDK OneSDK Branch shows the signed-in account and offers actions such as switching accounts, linking an account, changing the nickname, and signing out.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open this account page to manage or switch their CIB SDK account.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开账号资料时，CIB SDK 的 OneSDK Branch 会显示已登录账号，并提供切换账号、绑定账号、修改昵称和退出等操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法打开此页面来管理或切换 CIB SDK 账号。

en.description: When the app requests sign-in, the CIB SDK OneSDK Branch shows password login and configured account-provider or guest sign-in options; it also links to account creation and password recovery.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot use this CIB SDK sign-in screen, so its OneSDK login flow may fail.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求登录时，CIB SDK 的 OneSDK Branch 会显示密码登录以及已配置的第三方账号或游客登录选项，也可进入账号注册和密码找回页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用无法使用此 CIB SDK 登录页面，OneSDK 登录流程可能失败。

en.description: When a signed-in user chooses to change their nickname, the CIB SDK OneSDK Branch opens this screen and submits the new name.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot change their nickname through the CIB SDK account page.

zh-CN.description: 已登录用户选择修改昵称时，CIB SDK 的 OneSDK Branch 会打开此页面并提交新昵称。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法通过 CIB SDK 账号页面修改昵称。

en.description: When a OneSDK account or payment flow needs a hosted page, the CIB SDK opens the supplied page inside the app. For APK packages, it also checks the related order status.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot open this hosted account or payment page or confirm its order status, so those flows may fail.

zh-CN.description: OneSDK 账号或支付流程需要网页时，CIB SDK 会在应用内打开传入的页面；APK 包还会查询相关订单状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用无法打开此账号或支付页面，也无法确认订单状态，相关流程可能失败。

en.description: When a user creates an account, the CIB SDK OneSDK Branch collects the account name and password and submits the registration.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot create an account through the CIB SDK registration flow.

zh-CN.description: 用户注册账号时，CIB SDK 的 OneSDK Branch 会收集账号名和密码并提交注册。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法通过 CIB SDK 的注册流程创建账号。

en.description: The CIB SDK OneSDK Branch shows a follow-up prompt for guest sign-in, clearing an account, or changing a nickname. Confirming continues the selected account action, and account clearing has a short countdown.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot complete these follow-up account actions, including guest sign-in and account clearing.

zh-CN.description: CIB SDK 的 OneSDK Branch 会为游客登录、清除账号或修改昵称显示后续确认提示。确认后会继续对应操作，清除账号前还会短暂倒计时。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法完成这些后续账号操作，包括游客登录和清除账号。

en.description: When an app starts or binds Obigo Viscuit ARO for voice interaction, this foreground service initializes wake-word detection, speech recognition, language processing, and spoken responses.
en.disableEffect: Voice wake-up, spoken commands, and speech responses that use Viscuit will stop working.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动或绑定 Obigo Viscuit ARO 语音交互功能时，此前台服务会初始化唤醒词检测、语音识别、语言处理和语音回复。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖 Viscuit 的语音唤醒、语音指令和语音回复将无法使用。

en.description: React Native Performance captures process start times during app startup for React Native launch measurements.
en.disableEffect: React Native startup timing measurements from this SDK will be incomplete; normal app startup still works.

zh-CN.description: React Native Performance 会在应用启动时记录进程起始时间，用于 React Native 启动性能测量。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 此 SDK 的 React Native 启动时间测量将不完整；应用仍可正常启动。

en.description: The Appaloosa Android SDK opens this developer panel on request to show app metadata and requested or granted permissions for inspection. Disabling it removes the diagnostic panel.
en.disableEffect: Appaloosa's app-configuration and permission diagnostic screen will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: Appaloosa Android SDK 按需打开此开发者面板，供人查看应用元数据以及请求过或已授予的权限。禁用后，诊断面板将无法打开。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Appaloosa 的应用配置和权限诊断界面将无法打开。

en.description: Octopus opens this screen to show a full-screen interstitial ad when that ad format is requested.
en.disableEffect: Octopus interstitial ads will no longer appear.

zh-CN.description: Octopus 广告 SDK 在展示插屏广告时会打开此全屏页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Octopus 插屏广告将不再显示。

en.description: Octopus runs this background service when a user chooses to download an app promoted by an ad. It downloads the package and opens Android’s installer when the download finishes.
en.disableEffect: Apps promoted by Octopus ads cannot be downloaded and installed through this service.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择下载广告推广的应用时，Octopus 会启动此后台服务下载安装包，并在完成后打开 Android 安装程序。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Octopus 广告推广的应用将无法通过此服务下载和安装。

en.description: Octopus uses this file-sharing provider to give Android’s installer access to an app package downloaded from an ad.
en.disableEffect: Android may be unable to open Octopus-downloaded app packages for installation.

zh-CN.description: Octopus 通过此文件共享提供程序，将广告下载的应用安装包交给 Android 安装程序打开。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Android 可能无法打开 Octopus 下载的应用安装包进行安装。

en.description: When a user opens a link in an Octopus ad, this in-app browser loads web pages and hands non-web links to other apps.
en.disableEffect: Octopus ad links that use its in-app browser will not open.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 Octopus 广告链接时，此应用内浏览器会加载网页，并将非网页链接交给其他应用处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用 Octopus 应用内浏览器的广告链接将无法打开。

en.description: Octopus displays this dialog while an app promoted by an ad is downloading, then opens Android’s installer when the package is ready.
en.disableEffect: The Octopus ad-download dialog and its install handoff will no longer work.

zh-CN.description: Octopus 会在广告推广的应用下载期间显示此对话框，并在安装包准备好后打开 Android 安装程序。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Octopus 广告下载对话框及其安装流程将无法使用。

en.description: Octopus shows an ad end page with the promoted app’s icon, name, description, and ad or feedback actions.
en.disableEffect: This Octopus ad end page and its actions will no longer appear.

zh-CN.description: Octopus 会显示广告结束页，其中包含推广应用的图标、名称、介绍以及广告或反馈操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Octopus 广告结束页及其操作将不再显示。

en.description: Octopus shows an intermediate ad prompt with the promoted app’s details and an option to continue to the offer.
en.disableEffect: This intermediate Octopus ad prompt will no longer appear.

zh-CN.description: Octopus 会显示广告中途提示，其中包含推广应用的信息和继续查看广告的选项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Octopus 的广告中途提示将不再显示。

en.description: When Octopus needs Android’s permission to install an app downloaded from an ad, this screen asks the user to approve it in system settings.
en.disableEffect: Octopus may be unable to install an ad-downloaded app when Android requires this permission.

zh-CN.description: Android 要求授予广告下载应用的安装权限时，Octopus 会打开此页面，引导用户前往系统设置授权。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Android 要求此权限时，Octopus 可能无法安装广告下载的应用。

en.description: When an app opens an Offerista Brochure Widget brochure, this Activity loads its pages, store details, and links to offers.
en.disableEffect: Users will no longer be able to open or browse the app's Offerista brochures or follow their offers.

zh-CN.description: 当应用打开 Offerista 宣传册时，此 Activity 会加载册页、门店信息和优惠链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法打开或浏览应用中的 Offerista 宣传册，也无法访问其中的优惠链接。

en.description: After checking whether the app has been idle, the Ogury (Presage) ad SDK briefly opens this transparent Activity as a background helper; it closes itself shortly afterward.
en.disableEffect: Blocking it stops this Ogury background check from opening its helper screen and may reduce SDK tracking or ad maintenance; the app's own screens continue to work.

zh-CN.description: 检查应用是否长时间未活动后，Ogury（Presage）广告 SDK 会短暂打开这个透明 Activity 作为后台辅助界面，随后自动关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，Ogury 无法打开此辅助界面完成后台检查，SDK 的统计或广告维护可能减少；应用自身界面仍可使用。

en.description: The Ogury (Presage) ad SDK uses this Receiver when its scheduled alarm fires. It runs a periodic SDK task and schedules the next alarm.
en.disableEffect: Ogury will miss this background signal for its ads and analytics; the app's own features remain available.

zh-CN.description: Ogury（Presage）广告 SDK 在定时任务触发时使用此接收器。它启动一次周期性 SDK 任务，并安排下一次运行。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，Ogury 将无法收到这类广告和统计后台信号；应用本身的功能仍可使用。

en.description: When Android reports a Bluetooth device connection change or USB accessory removal, this Ogury (Presage) Receiver forwards the event to the SDK's background ad and analytics work.
en.disableEffect: Ogury will miss this background signal for its ads and analytics; the app's own features remain available.

zh-CN.description: Android 报告蓝牙设备连接状态变化或 USB 配件移除时，Ogury（Presage）接收器会将此事件交给 SDK 的广告和统计后台任务处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，Ogury 将无法收到这类广告和统计后台信号；应用本身的功能仍可使用。

en.description: When the device finishes booting, this Ogury (Presage) Receiver sends a startup signal to the SDK's background ad and analytics work.
en.disableEffect: Ogury will miss this background signal for its ads and analytics; the app's own features remain available.

zh-CN.description: 设备启动完成时，Ogury（Presage）接收器会向 SDK 的广告和统计后台任务发送启动信号。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，Ogury 将无法收到这类广告和统计后台信号；应用本身的功能仍可使用。

en.description: When Android reports a mobile carrier configuration change, this Ogury (Presage) Receiver forwards the update to the SDK's background processing.
en.disableEffect: Ogury will miss this background signal for its ads and analytics; the app's own features remain available.

zh-CN.description: Android 报告移动运营商配置发生变化时，Ogury（Presage）接收器会将更新交给 SDK 后台处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，Ogury 将无法收到这类广告和统计后台信号；应用本身的功能仍可使用。

en.description: When an Android calendar reminder fires, this Ogury (Presage) Receiver forwards the event to the SDK's background processing.
en.disableEffect: Ogury will miss this background signal for its ads and analytics; the app's own features remain available.

zh-CN.description: Android 日历提醒触发时，Ogury（Presage）接收器会将此事件交给 SDK 后台处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，Ogury 将无法收到这类广告和统计后台信号；应用本身的功能仍可使用。

en.description: When the device's next scheduled alarm changes, this Ogury (Presage) Receiver forwards the update to the SDK's background processing.
en.disableEffect: Ogury will miss this background signal for its ads and analytics; the app's own features remain available.

zh-CN.description: 设备的下一次闹钟时间发生变化时，Ogury（Presage）接收器会将更新交给 SDK 后台处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，Ogury 将无法收到这类广告和统计后台信号；应用本身的功能仍可使用。

en.description: When Android reports that an installed package has been completely removed, this Ogury (Presage) Receiver forwards the event to the SDK's background processing.
en.disableEffect: Ogury will miss this background signal for its ads and analytics; the app's own features remain available.

zh-CN.description: Android 报告某个已安装软件包已彻底移除时，Ogury（Presage）接收器会将此事件交给 SDK 后台处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，Ogury 将无法收到这类广告和统计后台信号；应用本身的功能仍可使用。

en.description: When the device's system time is changed, this Ogury (Presage) Receiver forwards the update to the SDK's background processing.
en.disableEffect: Ogury will miss this background signal for its ads and analytics; the app's own features remain available.

zh-CN.description: 设备系统时间被更改时，Ogury（Presage）接收器会将更新交给 SDK 后台处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，Ogury 将无法收到这类广告和统计后台信号；应用本身的功能仍可使用。

en.description: When the user returns to or unlocks the device, this Ogury (Presage) Receiver sends a signal to the SDK's background work.
en.disableEffect: Ogury will miss this background signal for its ads and analytics; the app's own features remain available.

zh-CN.description: 用户返回设备或解锁设备时，Ogury（Presage）接收器会向 SDK 后台任务发送信号。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，Ogury 将无法收到这类广告和统计后台信号；应用本身的功能仍可使用。

en.description: Android starts this Ogury (Presage) Service for scheduled background work that may wait until the user returns to the device.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it stops or limits Ogury's background ad and analytics work; the host app's own screens and features remain available.

zh-CN.description: Android 会为 Ogury（Presage）的定时后台任务启动此服务；部分任务会等到用户重新使用设备时再继续。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，Ogury 的广告和统计后台任务会停止或受限；应用本身的界面和功能仍可使用。

en.description: Android starts this Ogury (Presage) Service for scheduled SDK work. It processes the task and tells Android when the job is finished.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it stops or limits Ogury's background ad and analytics work; the host app's own screens and features remain available.

zh-CN.description: Android 会为定时 SDK 任务启动此 Ogury（Presage）服务。它处理任务，并在完成后通知 Android。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，Ogury 的广告和统计后台任务会停止或受限；应用本身的界面和功能仍可使用。

en.description: Ogury (Presage) starts this Service for its background advertising and analytics work. It can also handle SDK work when the screen turns off.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it stops or limits Ogury's background ad and analytics work; the host app's own screens and features remain available.

zh-CN.description: Ogury（Presage）会启动此服务来处理广告和统计后台任务。屏幕熄灭时，它也可继续处理 SDK 任务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，Ogury 的广告和统计后台任务会停止或受限；应用本身的界面和功能仍可使用。

en.description: Ogury's consent manager displays its consent form here when an app asks users to review or update their data choices. The Activity places the form on screen for that consent flow.
en.disableEffect: If the app asks Ogury to show its consent form, the screen cannot open and the consent request may fail.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求用户查看或更新数据选择时，Ogury 的同意管理器会在此显示同意表单。此 Activity 为该同意流程呈现表单。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 如果应用请求显示 Ogury 同意表单，该页面无法打开，同意请求可能失败。

en.description: The earlier Ogury (Presage) consent manager opens this Activity to display its consent form after the consent flow is ready.
en.disableEffect: If the app requests the Presage consent form, it cannot open and that consent flow may fail.

zh-CN.description: 较早版本的 Ogury（Presage）同意管理器会在同意流程准备好后打开此 Activity，显示同意表单。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 如果应用请求显示 Presage 同意表单，该页面无法打开，同意流程可能失败。

en.description: When the app starts an OkDetect detection session, this service moves it to the foreground with an ongoing notification so nearby-device verification and one-time-code features can continue in the background.
en.disableEffect: OkDetect will not be able to maintain background detection or verification that depends on it.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动 OkDetect 检测会话时，此服务会显示常驻通知并转为前台运行，使附近设备验证和一次性验证码功能可在后台继续。
zh-CN.disableEffect: OkDetect 将无法维持后台检测或依赖该检测的验证功能。

en.description: When Android reports a connectivity change, the OkDetect SDK updates its detection and verification logic with whether the device has Wi-Fi, mobile data, or no connection.
en.disableEffect: OkDetect may keep an outdated connection state and fail to refresh network-dependent verification.

zh-CN.description: Android 通知网络连接变化时，OkDetect SDK 会将设备当前使用 Wi-Fi、移动数据还是无网络的信息更新到检测和验证流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: OkDetect 可能保留过期的网络状态，无法刷新依赖网络的验证。

en.description: When an app starts an Okra financial-account connection or payment flow, this screen displays the Okra widget and returns its success, error, or close result to the app.
en.disableEffect: Blocking it prevents users from completing account-connection or payment flows provided through the Okra SDK.

zh-CN.description: 应用发起 Okra 金融账户连接或支付流程时，此页面会显示 Okra 组件，并将成功、错误或关闭结果返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，用户将无法完成通过 Okra SDK 提供的账户连接或支付流程。

en.description: When an app requests biometric unlock or protected sign-in data, Okta Auth Foundation opens Android's biometric prompt and returns the unlock or decryption result.
en.disableEffect: Biometric unlock or recovery of protected sign-in data will fail for flows that rely on it.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求生物识别解锁或读取受保护的登录数据时，Okta Auth Foundation 会打开 Android 生物识别验证，并返回解锁或解密结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此流程的生物识别解锁或受保护登录数据恢复将失败。

en.description: When an Okta Devices multi-factor authenticator needs background service support, this foreground service configures the active authenticator and keeps its notification-backed service running.
en.disableEffect: Device-bound or push multi-factor authentication that needs this service may stop working.

zh-CN.description: Okta Devices 多因素验证器需要后台服务支持时，此前台服务会配置已启用的验证器，并通过常驻通知维持服务运行。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此服务的设备绑定或推送多因素验证可能无法使用。

en.description: When an app begins Okta OpenID Connect sign-in, this activity opens the authorization page in an installed secure browser tab and returns the browser result to the app.
en.disableEffect: Okta sign-in and authorization flows that use the browser will not complete.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动 Okta OpenID Connect 登录时，此界面会在已安装的安全浏览器标签页中打开授权页面，并将浏览器结果返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖浏览器的 Okta 登录和授权流程将无法完成。

en.description: When Android opens an Okta sign-in redirect link, this activity forwards the returned address to the OIDC sign-in flow and closes.
en.disableEffect: The app will not receive the browser's Okta sign-in result, so login may fail.

zh-CN.description: Android 打开 Okta 登录重定向链接时，此界面会把返回地址交给 OIDC 登录流程，然后关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法接收浏览器返回的 Okta 登录结果，登录可能失败。

en.description: When an app starts Okta web authentication, this activity opens the sign-in page in a browser tab and handles the returned authorization link or cancellation.
en.disableEffect: Okta web sign-in and its browser return step will not complete.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动 Okta 网页认证时，此界面会在浏览器标签页中打开登录页面，并处理返回的授权链接或取消结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Okta 网页登录及其浏览器返回步骤将无法完成。

en.description: When Android opens an Okta web-authentication redirect link, this activity forwards it to the sign-in screen so the app can finish the login flow.
en.disableEffect: The app will not be able to complete web sign-in using the returned link.

zh-CN.description: Android 打开 Okta 网页认证重定向链接时，此界面会将其转交给登录页面，以便应用完成登录流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法使用返回链接完成网页登录。

en.description: When a customer chooses Google Pay in Olo Pay checkout, this activity starts the wallet payment flow and returns its success, cancellation, or error result.
en.disableEffect: Google Pay checkout will fail or be unavailable in apps that use Olo Pay for this payment option.

zh-CN.description: 顾客在 Olo Pay 结账时选择 Google Pay，此界面会启动钱包付款流程，并返回成功、取消或错误结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用 Olo Pay 提供此付款方式的应用将无法完成 Google Pay 结账。

en.description: When an app uses Open Mobile Hub's sign-in flow on a device without Google Play services, this Activity opens a browser sign-in page and receives the identity provider's return. It then completes the sign-in and returns the result to the app.
en.disableEffect: Accounts using this Open Mobile Hub sign-in flow cannot complete login, so the app may not accept that sign-in method.

zh-CN.description: 在没有 Google Play 服务的设备上，应用使用 Open Mobile Hub 登录时，此 Activity 会打开浏览器登录页面并接收身份提供商的返回结果。随后它会完成登录并将结果交还给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此 Open Mobile Hub 登录流程的账户将无法完成登录，应用也可能无法接受这种登录方式。

en.description: When OnceBLE starts a Nordic Bluetooth firmware update for a connected device, this service runs the transfer and reports progress, speed, completion, or errors.
en.disableEffect: The app's Nordic Bluetooth firmware update flow cannot complete while this service is disabled.

zh-CN.description: OnceBLE 为已连接的设备启动 Nordic 蓝牙固件更新时，此服务负责传输更新文件，并报告进度、速度、完成状态或错误。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用此服务后，应用将无法完成 Nordic 蓝牙固件更新。

en.description: During OneAll social sign-in, this screen lists the configured providers and returns the one the user chooses to the sign-in flow.
en.disableEffect: OneAll sign-in cannot proceed when it requires the user to select a provider.

zh-CN.description: OneAll 社交登录过程中，此界面会列出已配置的登录服务，并将用户选择的服务交回登录流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 登录流程需要用户选择服务时，OneAll 登录将无法继续。

en.description: OneAll social sign-in opens this screen to load the login page. When the login service returns the user to the app, the Activity sends that result back to the sign-in flow.
en.disableEffect: Browser-based OneAll sign-in cannot finish or return its result to the app.

zh-CN.description: OneAll 社交登录会打开此界面加载登录页面。登录服务将用户带回应用后，此界面会把结果交还给登录流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 基于网页的 OneAll 登录将无法完成，也无法把结果返回应用。

en.description: When the 1gravity Android RTEditor adds media to a rich-text field, this Activity opens the matching picker or capture flow for pictures, video, or audio and returns the selection.
en.disableEffect: Users will no longer be able to add or capture media from the rich-text editor.

zh-CN.description: 1gravity Android RTEditor 向富文本字段添加媒体时，此 Activity 会打开对应的图片、视频或音频选择或拍摄流程，并将选择结果返回编辑器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法从富文本编辑器添加或拍摄媒体。

en.description: When a user crops or rotates a picture in the 1gravity Android RTEditor, this Activity opens the image and saves the edited result for the editor.
en.disableEffect: Image cropping and rotation from the rich-text editor will not work.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 1gravity Android RTEditor 中裁剪或旋转图片时，此 Activity 会打开图片并保存编辑结果供编辑器使用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，富文本编辑器中的图片裁剪和旋转功能将无法使用。

en.description: The OneKeyAds privacy screen opens the privacy-page link supplied by the app in an in-app browser. It displays the supplied page title and loading progress.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open the app's privacy page through this screen.

zh-CN.description: OneKeyAds 隐私页面会在应用内浏览器中打开应用提供的隐私链接，并显示页面标题和加载进度。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过此页面查看应用的隐私政策。

en.description: The OneSignal push SDK receives Android boot-completed broadcasts and schedules restoration of the app's notification reminders after a device restart.
en.disableEffect: Scheduled OneSignal notifications may not be restored after the device restarts.

zh-CN.description: OneSignal 推送 SDK 接收 Android 的开机完成广播，并在设备重启后安排恢复应用通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 设备重启后，OneSignal 安排的通知可能无法恢复。

en.description: OneSignal's push SDK receives Google Cloud Messaging broadcasts here. It filters incoming messages and forwards OneSignal notifications for background processing.
en.disableEffect: Incoming OneSignal push notifications may no longer be processed or displayed.

zh-CN.description: OneSignal 推送 SDK 会在此接收 Google Cloud Messaging 广播。它会筛选收到的消息，并将 OneSignal 通知交由后台处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 收到的 OneSignal 推送通知可能无法再处理或显示。

en.description: OneSignal's Android push SDK runs this scheduled Service when Google push work is queued. It processes each message and passes it to OneSignal's notification handling.
en.disableEffect: OneSignal push messages handled by this job may not be processed or shown.

zh-CN.description: OneSignal Android 推送 SDK 会在 Google 推送任务进入系统队列时运行此 Service，处理消息并交给 OneSignal 的通知流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 此任务负责的 OneSignal 推送消息可能无法处理或显示。

en.description: OneSignal's push SDK starts this background Service to process an incoming push message after the broadcast receiver hands it off.
en.disableEffect: OneSignal push messages that need background processing may not be handled or shown.

zh-CN.description: OneSignal 推送 SDK 会在接收器转交推送消息后启动此后台 Service 来处理消息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要后台处理的 OneSignal 推送消息可能无法处理或显示。

en.description: When a user taps a OneSignal notification delivered through Huawei Push Kit, this Activity passes the tap to OneSignal so the app can open the notification's destination.
en.disableEffect: Huawei-delivered OneSignal notification taps will no longer open their intended destination.

zh-CN.description: 用户点按通过华为推送服务送达的 OneSignal 通知时，此 Activity 会将点按事件交给 OneSignal，以便应用打开通知对应的页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过华为推送服务送达的 OneSignal 通知将无法打开其目标页面。

en.description: OneSignal starts this receiver when a user taps or dismisses one of its notifications. It records the action and, for a tap, opens the app's notification destination.
en.disableEffect: Tapping OneSignal notifications will no longer open their intended screen, and notification dismiss actions may not be recorded.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击或关闭 OneSignal 通知时，OneSignal 会启动此接收器。它会记录相应操作，并在用户点击时打开应用中对应的页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 点击 OneSignal 通知将无法再打开目标页面，关闭通知的操作也可能无法记录。

en.description: After an app update on Android versions below 8.0, OneSignal starts this background Service to restore notifications that were still active. It reloads saved notifications and posts the ones that remain valid.
en.disableEffect: OneSignal may not bring back active notifications after an app update on older Android versions.

zh-CN.description: Android 8.0 以下的设备在应用更新后，OneSignal 会启动此后台 Service 来恢复仍有效的通知。它会载入已保存的通知，并重新显示仍可恢复的项目。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 在较旧的 Android 版本上，应用更新后 OneSignal 可能无法重新显示仍有效的通知。

en.description: OneSignal's push SDK opens this Activity when location collection needs Android's location permission. It requests access and starts location collection if the user grants it.
en.disableEffect: OneSignal will no longer be able to request location access, so location-based notification features will stop working.

zh-CN.description: OneSignal 推送 SDK 需要 Android 位置权限来收集位置时，会打开此 Activity。它会请求访问权限，并在用户允许后开始收集位置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: OneSignal 将无法再申请位置访问权限，依赖位置的通知功能会停止工作。

en.description: During a OneSignal notification restore, the SDK queues this Service for each saved notification and passes its stored content back through notification handling.
en.disableEffect: Notifications being restored may not reappear in the app.

zh-CN.description: OneSignal 恢复通知时，会为每条已保存的通知排入此 Service，并将保存的内容重新交给通知流程处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 正在恢复的通知可能无法重新显示在应用中。

en.description: After an app update on Android 8.0 or later, OneSignal schedules this job to begin restoring notifications that were still active. It starts the restore process from the saved notification list.
en.disableEffect: Active OneSignal notifications may not be restored after an app update on Android 8.0 or later.

zh-CN.description: Android 8.0 及更高版本在应用更新后，OneSignal 会调度此任务来恢复仍有效的通知，并从已保存的通知列表开始处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Android 8.0 及更高版本在应用更新后，OneSignal 中仍有效的通知可能无法恢复。

en.description: OneSignal uses this Service for scheduled background synchronization in older SDK versions. Newer releases keep it as a compatibility service for old scheduled jobs and finish those jobs immediately.
en.disableEffect: OneSignal background synchronization will stop in older releases, and legacy scheduled jobs may remain uncleared in newer releases.

zh-CN.description: 旧版 OneSignal SDK 使用此 Service 执行调度的后台同步。新版仍保留它来兼容旧任务，但会立即结束这些旧任务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 旧版 OneSignal 的后台同步将停止；新版中遗留的调度任务也可能无法清理。

en.description: OneSignal's push SDK starts this background Service for scheduled synchronization of the device's push subscription and notification state with OneSignal.
en.disableEffect: OneSignal may stop syncing push-subscription changes and notification state in the background.

zh-CN.description: OneSignal 推送 SDK 会在计划同步时启动此后台 Service，将设备的推送订阅和通知状态同步到 OneSignal。
zh-CN.disableEffect: OneSignal 可能无法再于后台同步推送订阅变更和通知状态。

en.description: When Android reports that the app was updated, OneSignal schedules work to restore notifications that were active before the update. The receiver skips this work on Android 7.0.
en.disableEffect: OneSignal notifications that were still active may not reappear after an app update.

zh-CN.description: Android 报告应用更新后，OneSignal 会调度任务来恢复更新前仍有效的通知。此 Receiver 在 Android 7.0 上会跳过这项工作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用更新后，OneSignal 中仍有效的通知可能无法重新显示。

en.description: When OneSignal requests Android notification permission, this screen shows the permission request and sends the user's choice back to OneSignal.
en.disableEffect: The OneSignal permission prompt will not open, so users cannot grant notification access through this prompt.

zh-CN.description: OneSignal 请求 Android 通知权限时，此界面会显示权限请求，并将用户的选择交回 OneSignal。
zh-CN.disableEffect: OneSignal 权限提示将无法打开，用户也无法通过此提示授予通知权限。

en.description: When Android launches OneSignal's scheduled background job, this Service runs the SDK's background sync work and reports whether Android should schedule it again.
en.disableEffect: OneSignal background sync work will no longer run through this scheduled job, so notification sync can be delayed.

zh-CN.description: Android 启动 OneSignal 的定时后台任务时，此 Service 会运行 SDK 的后台同步工作，并告知 Android 是否需要再次调度。
zh-CN.disableEffect: OneSignal 将无法通过此定时任务运行后台同步，通知同步可能延迟。

en.description: When a user taps a OneSignal notification, this Activity runs OneSignal's notification-opening flow so the app can show the linked screen.
en.disableEffect: Tapping a OneSignal notification may no longer open its linked screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户点按 OneSignal 通知时，此 Activity 会运行通知打开流程，让应用显示关联页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 点按 OneSignal 通知后可能无法打开关联页面。

en.description: For older Android versions, this OneSignal compatibility Activity handles a notification tap and routes the user back into the app.
en.disableEffect: Tapping a OneSignal notification on older Android versions may no longer open its linked screen.

zh-CN.description: 对于较旧的 Android 版本，此 OneSignal 兼容界面会处理通知点按，并将用户带回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 在较旧的 Android 版本上点按 OneSignal 通知后，可能无法打开关联页面。

en.description: After Android finishes a device boot or quick reboot, this OneSignal receiver reinitializes the SDK and schedules restoration of pending notifications.
en.disableEffect: OneSignal pending notifications may not be restored after a device restart.

zh-CN.description: Android 完成设备启动或快速重启后，此 OneSignal Receiver 会重新初始化 SDK，并安排恢复待发送的通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 设备重启后，OneSignal 的待发送通知可能无法恢复。

en.description: When Google push service delivers a message, this OneSignal receiver initializes the SDK if needed and processes the notification payload.
en.disableEffect: OneSignal notifications arriving through Google push service will no longer be processed.

zh-CN.description: Google 推送服务送达消息时，此 OneSignal Receiver 会在需要时初始化 SDK，并处理通知内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过 Google 推送服务到达的 OneSignal 通知将不再处理。

en.description: When a user dismisses a OneSignal notification, this receiver sends the dismissal event to OneSignal's notification processor.
en.disableEffect: OneSignal will no longer handle notification-dismissal events.

zh-CN.description: 用户关闭 OneSignal 通知时，此 Receiver 会将关闭事件交给 OneSignal 的通知处理流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: OneSignal 将不再处理通知关闭事件。

en.description: When Android reports that the app was updated, OneSignal initializes and schedules restoration of pending notifications.
en.disableEffect: OneSignal may fail to restore pending notifications after an app update.

zh-CN.description: Android 报告应用已更新时，OneSignal 会初始化 SDK，并安排恢复待发送的通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用更新后，OneSignal 可能无法恢复待发送的通知。

en.description: Huawei Push Kit calls this OneSignal service for new messages and device-token updates; the SDK forwards both to OneSignal's push handling.
en.disableEffect: OneSignal push messages and token updates from Huawei Push Kit will stop.

zh-CN.description: 华为推送服务送达新消息或更新设备令牌时，会调用此 OneSignal Service；SDK 会将两者交给 OneSignal 推送流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 来自华为推送服务的 OneSignal 消息和令牌更新将停止。

en.description: When the app asks OneTrust to show its privacy banner or preference center, this Activity loads the consent page and handles the user's choices.
en.disableEffect: The app's OneTrust consent banner and preference center cannot open, so users cannot manage privacy choices there.

zh-CN.description: 应用要求 OneTrust 显示隐私横幅或偏好设置中心时，此 Activity 会加载同意页面并处理用户的选择。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用的 OneTrust 同意横幅和偏好设置中心将无法打开，用户也无法在其中管理隐私选项。

en.description: When an Onfido identity check needs an externally supplied biometric token, this service asks the app's configured callback and returns the token to Onfido.
en.disableEffect: A biometric check that relies on an app-supplied token cannot continue.

zh-CN.description: Onfido 身份核验需要外部提供的生物识别令牌时，此 Service 会调用应用配置的回调，并将令牌交还 Onfido。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖应用提供令牌的生物识别核验将无法继续。

en.description: When an app launches an Onfido verification flow, this Activity initializes the flow settings and displays the requested verification steps.
en.disableEffect: The Onfido flow screen will not open, so identity verification cannot proceed.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动 Onfido 核验流程时，此 Activity 会初始化流程设置并显示所请求的核验步骤。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Onfido 流程界面将无法打开，身份核验也无法继续。

en.description: When an Onfido session token is expiring, this service asks the app for a refreshed token and returns it to the verification flow.
en.disableEffect: A verification session that needs a token refresh may expire before it finishes.

zh-CN.description: Onfido 会话令牌即将过期时，此 Service 会向应用请求更新后的令牌，并将其交回核验流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要更新令牌的核验会话可能会在完成前过期。

en.description: When the Onfido SDK reports a capture error, this service queues its crash report for upload when a network connection is available.
en.disableEffect: Onfido crash reports will no longer be uploaded.

zh-CN.description: Onfido SDK 报告拍摄错误时，此 Service 会将崩溃报告加入队列，等待网络可用后上传。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Onfido 崩溃报告将不再上传。

en.description: While Onfido verification runs in a separate process, this service keeps the app's main process available beside the verification screen.
en.disableEffect: The app's main process may be restarted during a long verification session, so returning to the app can require a reload.

zh-CN.description: Onfido 在独立进程中运行核验时，此 Service 会让应用的主进程继续保持运行。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 核验时间较长时，应用主进程可能被重新启动，返回应用后可能需要重新加载。

en.description: The Onfido identity-verification SDK opens this Activity to host the applicant's verification steps, including document capture and hosted checks, then return the result to the app.
en.disableEffect: The app's Onfido document and identity checks cannot be completed.

zh-CN.description: Onfido 身份核验 SDK 会打开此 Activity 展示申请人的核验步骤，包括证件拍摄和托管核验页面，然后将结果返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用中的 Onfido 证件和身份核验将无法完成。

en.description: When an app starts a modern Onfido check, this splash screen validates the session setup, launches the verification screen, and returns its result.
en.disableEffect: The Onfido check cannot start or return its completion status.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动新版 Onfido 核验时，此启动界面会检查会话设置、打开核验页面，并将结果返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Onfido 核验将无法启动，也无法向应用返回完成状态。

en.description: During Onfido splash startup, this service saves the language selected for the verification flow so the SDK can remember it for a later session.
en.disableEffect: The selected language may not be remembered for a later Onfido session.

zh-CN.description: Onfido 启动界面初始化期间，此 Service 会保存核验流程选择的语言，供 SDK 在后续会话中记住。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Onfido 后续会话可能不会记住所选语言。

en.description: Onfido opens this camera screen during document or face capture and guides the user through taking and confirming the requested image.
en.disableEffect: The app's Onfido document or face-capture step cannot run.

zh-CN.description: Onfido 在拍摄证件或人脸时会打开此相机界面，引导用户拍摄并确认所需图像。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用中的 Onfido 证件或人脸拍摄步骤将无法运行。

en.description: Android creates this provider in Onfido's capture process to initialize Google's machine-learning services for document recognition.
en.disableEffect: Machine-learning features used during Onfido checks may fail to initialize.

zh-CN.description: Android 会在 Onfido 拍摄进程中创建此 Provider，以初始化用于证件识别的 Google 机器学习服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Onfido 核验使用的机器学习功能可能无法初始化。

en.description: When Onfido starts its verification process, this provider gives embedded verification pages a separate storage folder from the app's own web pages.
en.disableEffect: Hosted Onfido verification pages may fail to open if their separate web storage is not prepared.

zh-CN.description: Onfido 启动核验进程时，此 Provider 会为嵌入式核验页面设置独立存储目录，与应用自身的网页数据分开。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 如果未准备独立网页存储目录，Onfido 托管核验页面可能无法打开。

en.description: Onfido starts this provider with its capture process to queue downloads of the document-detection and document-type models used by its camera flow.
en.disableEffect: Automatic document detection and document-type recognition may not be available during capture.

zh-CN.description: Onfido 启动拍摄进程时，此 Provider 会安排下载相机流程使用的证件检测和证件类型识别模型。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 拍摄时可能无法使用自动证件检测和证件类型识别。

en.description: Started for an Onfido authentication session, this screen presents user consent and a face check, then returns success, cancellation, or an error to the app.
en.disableEffect: The app's Onfido authentication flow cannot be completed.

zh-CN.description: Onfido 启动身份验证会话时，此界面会展示用户同意和人脸核验步骤，并向应用返回成功、取消或错误结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用中的 Onfido 身份验证流程将无法完成。

en.description: Onfido DevTools opens this Activity to load its developer setup page in a web screen.
en.disableEffect: The Onfido developer setup page will not open.

zh-CN.description: Onfido DevTools 会打开此 Activity，在网页界面中加载开发者设置页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Onfido 开发者设置页面将无法打开。

en.description: The Onfido identity-verification SDK uses this file provider to share captured images securely with its hosted verification screen.
en.disableEffect: Captured images may not reach the verification flow, breaking photo or document submission.

zh-CN.description: Onfido 身份核验 SDK 使用此文件 Provider，将拍摄的图像安全地提供给托管核验页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 拍摄的图像可能无法传入核验流程，导致照片或证件提交失败。

en.description: While the older Onfido identity-verification screen is open, this service carries messages between that screen and the verification SDK.
en.disableEffect: The older Onfido verification session cannot exchange required messages and may fail.

zh-CN.description: 较早版本的 Onfido 身份核验界面打开期间，此 Service 会在界面与核验 SDK 之间传递消息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 较早版本的 Onfido 核验会话无法交换所需消息，可能会失败。

en.description: When the older Onfido IDV SDK launches a verification session, this Activity creates the session screen and connects it to the SDK's verification channel.
en.disableEffect: The older Onfido identity-verification flow cannot open.

zh-CN.description: 较早版本的 Onfido IDV SDK 启动核验会话时，此 Activity 会创建核验界面，并连接 SDK 的核验消息通道。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 较早版本的 Onfido 身份核验流程将无法打开。

en.description: The Onfido identity-verification SDK uses this file provider to share captured images with its camera and verification screens.
en.disableEffect: Document or selfie images may not reach the verification flow, so capture can fail.

zh-CN.description: Onfido 身份核验 SDK 使用此文件 Provider 将拍摄的图像提供给相机和核验界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 证件或自拍图像可能无法传入核验流程，导致拍摄失败。

en.description: The older Onfido identity-verification SDK uses this file provider to share captured images with its camera and verification screens.
en.disableEffect: Document or selfie images may not reach the verification flow, so capture can fail.

zh-CN.description: 较早版本的 Onfido 身份核验 SDK 使用此文件 Provider 将拍摄的图像提供给相机和核验界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 证件或自拍图像可能无法传入核验流程，导致拍摄失败。

en.description: At app startup, this Onfido provider discovers and initializes the identity-verification modules included in the app.
en.disableEffect: Onfido modules may not initialize, preventing their verification screens and checks from working.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，此 Onfido Provider 会发现并初始化应用中包含的身份核验模块。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Onfido 模块可能无法初始化，其核验界面和检查流程也无法正常工作。

en.description: The OOFTF Basic library starts this provider during app startup to initialize tracking of the app's open screens and foreground or background state. The library uses that state for features that respond to activity changes.
en.disableEffect: Features that depend on the library's app-wide activity tracking may stop working correctly if this initialization is disabled.

zh-CN.description: OOFTF Basic 会在应用启动时创建此 Provider，用于初始化页面生命周期及前台、后台状态跟踪。库中的其他功能会利用这些状态响应页面变化。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 如果关闭这项初始化，依赖应用级页面状态跟踪的功能可能无法正常工作。

en.description: OOFTF Director uses this Activity for its developer tools menu when the app opens the debug panel. The menu links to device diagnostics, saved network traces, network tools, floating controls, and an app reset action.
en.disableEffect: The app's developer menu and its optional diagnostics and testing tools will not open.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开调试面板时，OOFTF Director 会用此 Activity 显示开发者工具菜单。菜单包含设备诊断、已保存的网络跟踪、网络工具、悬浮控件和重置应用操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用的开发者菜单及其中可选的诊断和测试工具将无法打开。

en.description: OOFTF Director opens this screen from its developer menu to show app and device diagnostics such as app version, device model, Android version, root status, Wi-Fi connection, GPS state, and ROM details.
en.disableEffect: Developers will not be able to open this diagnostic screen; regular app screens are unaffected.

zh-CN.description: OOFTF Director 会从开发者菜单打开此页面，显示应用版本、设备型号、Android 版本、Root 状态、Wi-Fi 连接、GPS 状态和系统版本等诊断信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 开发者将无法打开此诊断页面，应用的常规页面不受影响。

en.description: When a developer selects a saved trace, OOFTF Director opens this Activity and displays the contents of that trace file.
en.disableEffect: Developers will not be able to inspect the contents of saved trace files.

zh-CN.description: 开发者选择一条已保存的跟踪记录后，OOFTF Director 会打开此 Activity 并显示文件内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 开发者将无法查看已保存跟踪记录的内容。

en.description: OOFTF Director opens this screen from its debug menu to list saved network trace files. Selecting an entry opens its recorded contents.
en.disableEffect: Developers will not be able to browse or open the saved trace files from the debug menu.

zh-CN.description: OOFTF Director 会从调试菜单打开此页面，列出已保存的网络跟踪文件。选择一项即可查看记录内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 开发者将无法从调试菜单浏览或打开已保存的跟踪文件。

en.description: When the app shares through QQ using OOFTF HiShare, this temporary Activity hands the share request to QQ and returns the result to the app.
en.disableEffect: QQ sharing through this library will not complete or return its result to the app.

zh-CN.description: 应用通过 OOFTF HiShare 使用 QQ 分享时，此临时 Activity 会把分享请求交给 QQ，并将结果返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过此库进行的 QQ 分享将无法完成，也无法把结果返回给应用。

en.description: When the app shares through Sina Weibo using OOFTF HiShare, this Activity sends the share request and returns Weibo's result to the app.
en.disableEffect: Sina Weibo sharing through this library will not complete or return its result to the app.

zh-CN.description: 应用通过 OOFTF HiShare 使用新浪微博分享时，此 Activity 会发送分享请求，并将微博返回的结果交给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过此库进行的新浪微博分享将无法完成，也无法把结果返回给应用。

en.description: The OOFTF OkHttp Monitor library opens this screen to manage captured request and response URL filters and view the saved URL list. Turning monitoring off clears the displayed response URLs.
en.disableEffect: The app's network-monitor settings and captured URL list will no longer be accessible from this screen.

zh-CN.description: OOFTF OkHttp Monitor 会打开此页面来管理已记录的请求和响应网址筛选项，并查看网址列表。关闭监控后，页面会清除已显示的响应网址。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 将无法从此页面打开网络监控设置或查看已记录的网址列表。

en.description: OOIMI AndroidLibraryX sets up this Provider when the app starts so its helper library can retain the app context and current screen. The library uses that context for app-specific dp and sp sizing and other screen-aware helpers.
en.disableEffect: OOIMI helpers may lose the current screen context, and layouts using app-defined dimensions may fall back to system sizing.

zh-CN.description: OOIMI AndroidLibraryX 会在应用启动时设置此 Provider，让辅助库能够获取应用上下文和当前界面。该库会用这些信息读取应用自定义的 dp、sp 尺寸，并支持其他依赖当前界面的辅助功能。
zh-CN.disableEffect: OOIMI 辅助功能可能无法获取当前界面，使用应用自定义尺寸的布局也可能退回到系统默认尺寸。

en.description: When the app asks for permissions through OOIMI AndroidLibraryX, this shared part of the permission flow displays the requested access, reports approval or denial, and can guide users to Settings after a permanent denial.
en.disableEffect: Disabling this shared component does not disable OOIMI's separate permission screen, so users can still approve or deny permission requests.

zh-CN.description: 应用通过 OOIMI AndroidLibraryX 申请权限时，此共享部分会显示所需权限、反馈获批或拒绝的结果，并可在用户不再被询问时引导其前往系统设置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用此共享组件不会停用 OOIMI 单独提供的权限申请界面，用户仍可批准或拒绝权限申请。

en.description: When an app uses OOIMI AndroidLibraryX to request runtime permissions, this Activity asks Android for the requested access and returns whether it was granted or denied. It can also guide users to Settings when a permission has been permanently denied.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot use OOIMI's permission screen to request access, so features that need those permissions may be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: 应用通过 OOIMI AndroidLibraryX 申请运行时权限时，此 Activity 会向 Android 请求所需权限，并返回获批或拒绝的结果。若权限已被永久拒绝，它还可以引导用户前往系统设置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法通过 OOIMI 的权限界面申请权限，因此依赖这些权限的功能可能无法使用。

en.description: OOIMI AndroidLibraryX starts this VPN Service when its SOCKS proxy is turned on. It creates a local VPN tunnel that sends selected app traffic and DNS requests through the configured SOCKS proxy, and keeps the connection running with a notification.
en.disableEffect: The SOCKS VPN cannot start, so app features that rely on this proxy connection will stop working.

zh-CN.description: OOIMI AndroidLibraryX 的 SOCKS 代理开启时会启动此 VPN Service。它会建立本地 VPN 隧道，将选定应用的流量和 DNS 请求转发到已配置的 SOCKS 代理，并通过通知保持连接运行。
zh-CN.disableEffect: SOCKS VPN 将无法启动，依赖此代理连接的应用功能也会停止工作。

en.description: When the app starts an OOIMI SOCKS VPN, this Activity opens Android's system approval screen and starts the VPN after the user agrees. If approval was already given, it starts the VPN directly.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot approve or start the OOIMI VPN through this flow, so the SOCKS proxy will be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动 OOIMI SOCKS VPN 时，此 Activity 会打开 Android 系统授权界面，并在用户同意后启动 VPN。如果用户此前已授权，它会直接启动 VPN。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此流程授权或启动 OOIMI VPN，因此 SOCKS 代理无法使用。

en.description: After an OPay sign-in flow returns to the app, this Activity reads the login result and sends it back to the waiting app screen. It closes after reporting whether sign-in succeeded or failed.
en.disableEffect: The app may not receive the OPay sign-in result, leaving accounts that use this login path unable to finish signing in.

zh-CN.description: OPay 登录流程返回应用后，此 Activity 会读取登录结果并交给正在等待的应用界面。它反馈登录成功或失败后随即关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用可能收不到 OPay 登录结果，使用此登录方式的账户将无法完成登录。

en.description: When an OPay payment flow returns to the app, this Activity reads its status and passes the result to the screen that started the payment. It closes after reporting whether the payment succeeded or failed.
en.disableEffect: The app may not receive the OPay payment result, so checkout flows that use this SDK may not complete correctly.

zh-CN.description: OPay 支付流程返回应用后，此 Activity 会读取支付状态并将结果交给发起支付的界面。它反馈支付成功或失败后随即关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用可能收不到 OPay 支付结果，因此使用此 SDK 的结账流程可能无法正常完成。

en.description: DQVM, DQ2020's Android MVVM library, uses this Activity for account and password sign-in; it can also open from a 2020: browser link. After the login flow reports success, it opens the library's saved-user screen.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it removes DQVM sign-in and prevents that flow from continuing to the saved-user screen.

zh-CN.description: DQVM（DQ2020 的 Android MVVM 库）使用此 Activity 提供账号和密码登录界面，也可通过 2020: 浏览器链接打开。登录流程成功后，它会进入库中的已保存用户列表。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，DQVM 登录界面无法打开，登录流程也无法进入已保存用户列表。

en.description: DQVM, DQ2020’s Android MVVM library, opens this Activity after sign-in and displays user records saved in the app’s local database.
en.disableEffect: The post-login saved-user list is unavailable.

zh-CN.description: DQVM（DQ2020 的 Android MVVM 库）会在登录成功后打开此 Activity，并显示保存在应用本地数据库中的用户记录。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 登录后将无法打开已保存的用户列表。

en.description: OPEN Payment’s Android SDK loads its hosted checkout page inside the app using payment details supplied by the app.
en.disableEffect: The payment page and its transaction completion or cancellation flow will not be available.

zh-CN.description: OPEN Payment Android SDK 会使用应用提供的支付信息，在应用内加载其托管的结账页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 支付页面以及交易完成或取消流程将无法使用。

en.description: When the app starts Dropbox sign-in through Open Mobile Hub, this Activity opens Dropbox's authorization flow and returns the account token or an error to the app.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot sign in with Dropbox through this Open Mobile Hub integration.

zh-CN.description: 应用通过 Open Mobile Hub 启动 Dropbox 登录时，此 Activity 会打开 Dropbox 授权流程，并将账户令牌或错误结果返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此 Open Mobile Hub 集成使用 Dropbox 登录。

en.description: When the app starts Facebook sign-in through Open Mobile Hub, this Activity presents Facebook's login flow and returns the authorization result to the app.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot sign in with Facebook through this Open Mobile Hub integration.

zh-CN.description: 应用通过 Open Mobile Hub 启动 Facebook 登录时，此 Activity 会显示 Facebook 登录流程，并将授权结果返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此 Open Mobile Hub 集成使用 Facebook 登录。

en.description: When the app starts Google sign-in through Open Mobile Hub on a device with Google Play services, this Activity launches Google's sign-in screen and returns the account result to the app.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot complete Google sign-in through this Open Mobile Hub integration.

zh-CN.description: 在安装了 Google Play 服务的设备上，应用通过 Open Mobile Hub 启动 Google 登录时，此 Activity 会打开 Google 登录界面并将账户结果返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此 Open Mobile Hub 集成完成 Google 登录。

en.description: When the app uses Open Mobile Hub's Google sign-in flow without Google Play services, this Activity opens a browser sign-in page and receives the identity provider's return. It then passes the sign-in result back to the app.
en.disableEffect: Users on this sign-in path cannot complete Google login, so the app may not accept their account.

zh-CN.description: 设备没有 Google Play 服务且应用使用 Open Mobile Hub 的 Google 登录流程时，此 Activity 会打开浏览器登录页面并接收身份提供商的返回结果。随后它会将登录结果交还给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此登录方式的用户将无法完成 Google 登录，应用也可能无法接受其账户。

en.description: When the app starts Microsoft sign-in through Open Mobile Hub, this Activity asks Microsoft's account library to sign in with the requested access and returns the token or an error.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot sign in with Microsoft through this Open Mobile Hub integration.

zh-CN.description: 应用通过 Open Mobile Hub 启动 Microsoft 登录时，此 Activity 会调用 Microsoft 账户服务申请所需权限，并将令牌或错误结果返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此 Open Mobile Hub 集成使用 Microsoft 登录。

en.description: When OPPO Game SDK starts, this provider enables the restricted Android API access required by its OPlus CutPayment Protect library.
en.disableEffect: OPlus game-payment protection may not initialize, so payment flows that depend on it may fail.

zh-CN.description: OPPO 游戏 SDK 启动时，会通过此组件启用 OPlus 支付保护库所需的受限 Android API 访问。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 屏蔽后，OPlus 游戏支付保护可能无法初始化，依赖它的付款流程可能失败。

en.description: When the app shares a file with Oplus system or Seedling card features, this Provider lets the approved recipient read that file. It runs when the recipient opens the shared item.
en.disableEffect: Oplus Seedling cards and other Oplus entry points may be unable to read files that the app shares with them.

zh-CN.description: 应用将文件分享给 Oplus 系统或 Seedling 卡片功能时，此 Provider 会允许获准的接收方读取该文件。接收方打开共享内容时会调用它。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Oplus Seedling 卡片及其他 Oplus 入口可能无法读取应用分享给它们的文件。

en.description: When OPPO MobAd starts a callback-based video-ad flow, this temporary Activity forwards start, resume, pause, and other lifecycle events to that flow.
en.disableEffect: Video-ad flows that rely on these callbacks may not finish, and rewards for affected rewarded ads may not be granted.

zh-CN.description: OPPO MobAd 发起依赖回调的视频广告流程时，此临时 Activity 会将启动、恢复、暂停等界面状态通知传递给该流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖这些通知的视频广告流程可能无法完成，相关激励广告的奖励也可能无法发放。

en.description: When an OPPO MobAd ad opens a web page, this Activity loads the requested page inside the app.
en.disableEffect: Ad web pages and links that open them may no longer work.

zh-CN.description: OPPO MobAd 打开广告网页时会使用此 Activity，在应用内显示广告页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，广告网页及打开这些网页的链接可能无法使用。

en.description: The OPPO MobAd SDK opens this Activity to display web-based ad content and landing pages.
en.disableEffect: OPPO web-based ads and landing pages will not open.

zh-CN.description: OPPO MobAd SDK 会打开此 Activity 展示网页广告内容和落地页。
zh-CN.disableEffect: OPPO 网页广告和落地页将无法打开。

en.description: When a user follows an OPPO MobAd ad, this Activity displays the advertiser page inside the app and handles its navigation.
en.disableEffect: OPPO MobAd advertiser pages and their links will not open.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 OPPO MobAd 广告后，此 Activity 会在应用内显示广告主页面并处理页面跳转。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，OPPO MobAd 广告主页面及其中的链接将无法打开。

en.description: OPPO HeyTap Mobad opens this screen to play a video or full-screen ad and handle actions such as downloading the advertised app.
en.disableEffect: OPPO Mobad video and full-screen ads will not appear; the app’s other features remain available.

zh-CN.description: OPPO HeyTap Mobad 会打开此页面播放视频或全屏广告，并处理下载广告所推广应用等操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: OPPO Mobad 的视频和全屏广告将不再显示，应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: OPPO HeyTap Mobad starts this provider with the app so its main and ad processes can exchange requests and results. It has no visible screen.
en.disableEffect: OPPO Mobad cannot initialize its ad-process bridge, so its ads stop loading.

zh-CN.description: OPPO HeyTap Mobad 会随应用启动此提供程序，让主进程与广告进程交换请求和结果；它不显示界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: OPPO Mobad 无法初始化广告进程间的连接，因此广告将无法加载。

en.description: The OPPO HeyTap Mobad SDK starts or binds this background service during ad work. It has no screen and handles the SDK’s service lifecycle.
en.disableEffect: Mobad’s ad work that relies on this service will stop, while non-ad app functions remain available.

zh-CN.description: OPPO HeyTap Mobad SDK 会在广告流程中启动或绑定此后台服务；它不显示界面，负责承接 SDK 的服务生命周期。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此服务的 Mobad 广告流程将停止，应用的非广告功能仍可使用。

en.description: OPPO HeyTap Mobad runs this background service when an ad needs a file or app download. It manages the download notification and can pass a downloaded app to Android’s installer.
en.disableEffect: OPPO Mobad ad downloads and their install actions will stop; the app’s non-ad features remain available.

zh-CN.description: OPPO HeyTap Mobad 会在广告需要下载文件或应用时运行此后台服务；它管理下载通知，也可将下载的应用交给 Android 安装。
zh-CN.disableEffect: OPPO Mobad 的广告下载和安装操作将停止，应用的非广告功能仍可使用。

en.description: The OPPO MobAd SDK opens this Activity for a web-based ad feedback page.
en.disableEffect: The OPPO ad feedback page and its reduce-similar-recommendations action will be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: OPPO MobAd SDK 会打开此 Activity，显示网页广告反馈页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: OPPO 广告反馈页面及减少类似推荐的操作将不可用。

en.description: Optimizely's Feature Experimentation SDK runs this Receiver after the phone restarts or the app is replaced to restore background updates to experiment settings. On Android 8 and later, the system job scheduler handles this rescheduling.
en.disableEffect: On older Android versions, Optimizely may not resume background experiment-setting updates after a restart or app update, leaving remotely controlled app behavior out of date.

zh-CN.description: 手机重启或应用更新后，Optimizely Feature Experimentation SDK 会运行此 Receiver，以恢复后台实验配置更新。Android 8 及更新版本由系统任务调度器负责恢复这些任务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 在较旧的 Android 版本上，重启或应用更新后 Optimizely 可能无法恢复后台实验配置更新，导致远程控制的应用行为未能及时更新。

en.description: Optimizely's Android SDK runs this Receiver after the phone restarts or the app is updated so queued experiment events can resume sending.
en.disableEffect: Optimizely may leave queued analytics and experiment events unsent for longer after a restart or app update.

zh-CN.description: 手机重启或应用更新后，Optimizely Android SDK 会运行此 Receiver，以恢复发送已排队的实验事件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 重启或应用更新后，Optimizely 排队的分析和实验事件可能会延迟更久才发送。

en.description: Optimove's SDK registers this Provider at app startup to watch when the app enters or leaves the foreground and which screen is active. Its engagement features use those changes for session tracking and in-app messages.
en.disableEffect: Optimove may miss app sessions and screen changes, so its engagement tracking and in-app messages may stop or become less accurate.

zh-CN.description: Optimove SDK 会在应用启动时注册此 Provider，以跟踪应用进入或离开前台以及当前显示的界面。其互动功能会利用这些变化进行会话统计并显示应用内消息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Optimove 可能无法准确记录应用会话和界面变化，因此互动统计和应用内消息可能停止或变得不准确。

en.description: When a user taps an Optimove push notification or one of its buttons, this Activity forwards that action to the app and then closes without showing a screen.
en.disableEffect: Tapping Optimove notifications or their buttons may no longer open the intended app content or action.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击 Optimove 推送通知或其中的按钮时，此 Activity 会将该操作转交给应用，然后立即关闭，不会显示界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 点击 Optimove 通知或其中的按钮后，应用可能无法打开对应内容或执行相应操作。

en.description: When Optimove asks the user to enable notifications, this Activity requests Android's notification permission on Android 13 and later. On older Android versions it closes without showing a permission prompt.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot use Optimove's prompt to request notification permission, so push notifications may remain unavailable until permission is granted another way.

zh-CN.description: Optimove 请求用户开启通知时，Android 13 及更新版本会通过此 Activity 申请系统通知权限。较旧的 Android 版本不会显示权限提示，此界面会直接关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法通过 Optimove 的提示申请通知权限，因此在通过其他方式授权前，推送通知可能无法使用。

en.description: When a user taps an Optimove push notification, this screen opens the app or notification link and asks Optimove to record the open when an identifier is present.
en.disableEffect: Tapping an Optimove push will no longer open the app or its linked page.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击 Optimove 推送通知后，此界面会打开应用或通知链接指向的页面；通知带有标识时，还会请求 Optimove 记录打开事件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，点击 Optimove 推送通知将无法打开应用或其指定页面。

en.description: When the app starts, Optimove reads the app's configuration, sets up SDK logging, and automatically initializes the SDK when tenant settings are present.
en.disableEffect: Optimove push and customer-engagement features that depend on automatic initialization may stop working, while the app itself can still open.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，Optimove 会读取应用配置、设置 SDK 日志，并在租户配置齐全时自动初始化 SDK。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖自动初始化的 Optimove 推送和客户互动功能可能无法使用，但应用本身仍可打开。

en.description: After Android reports that the app was updated, Optimove schedules a background follow-up.
en.disableEffect: The app's normal screens are unaffected; Optimove's post-update background follow-up is skipped.

zh-CN.description: Android 通知应用已更新后，Optimove 会安排一个后台后续任务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用常规页面不受影响；Optimove 更新后的后台任务会跳过。

en.description: After an app update, Optimove runs a background follow-up that writes an SDK initialization log.
en.disableEffect: The app's normal screens are unaffected; this Optimove background follow-up is skipped.

zh-CN.description: 应用更新后，Optimove 会运行一个后台后续任务，并记录一条 SDK 初始化日志。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用常规页面不受影响；此 Optimove 后台任务会跳过。

en.description: When a user opens an Optimove push notification, this background service initializes Optimove as needed and reports the notification-open event when the message includes an identifier.
en.disableEffect: The notification can still open the app, but Optimove will not receive the notification-open event.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 Optimove 推送通知时，此后台服务会按需初始化 Optimove，并在消息带有标识时上报通知打开事件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通知仍可打开应用，但 Optimove 不会收到该通知的打开事件。

en.description: When a user taps or dismisses an Optimove notification, this receiver handles the response; a tap launches the app or linked page and passes open details to Optimove when an identifier is present.
en.disableEffect: Taps on Optimove notifications will no longer open the app or their linked pages.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击或清除 Optimove 通知时，此接收器会处理相应操作；点击会打开应用或链接页面，并在通知带有标识时将打开信息交给 Optimove。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，点击 Optimove 通知将无法打开应用或其链接页面。

en.description: When Firebase delivers an Optimove push or refreshes its registration token, this service passes the message to Optimove and updates push registration.
en.disableEffect: Optimove push messages and token updates will stop being handled by this SDK.

zh-CN.description: Firebase 投递 Optimove 推送或刷新注册令牌时，此服务会把消息交给 Optimove 处理并更新推送注册信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 此 SDK 将不再处理 Optimove 推送消息或令牌更新。

en.description: When the Orange Design System accessibility statement is opened from local files, this provider gives the viewer temporary access to the statement page and its supporting files.
en.disableEffect: The local accessibility statement page and its supporting files may fail to open.

zh-CN.description: 打开 Orange Design System 的本地无障碍声明时，此文件提供器会让查看器临时读取声明页面及其相关文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 本地无障碍声明页面及其相关文件可能无法打开。

en.description: At app startup, Orange Webcom supplies its web features with the app context they need to run.
en.disableEffect: Orange Webcom web pages and authentication may fail to initialize.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，Orange Webcom 会取得其网页功能运行所需的应用上下文。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Orange Webcom 的网页和身份验证功能可能无法初始化。

en.description: When an Orange Webcom OAuth sign-in starts or its return link arrives, this screen opens the sign-in page and resumes or ends the sign-in flow.
en.disableEffect: Orange Webcom sign-in and its return from the identity provider may fail, preventing account authorization.

zh-CN.description: Orange Webcom 的 OAuth 登录启动或收到返回链接时，此界面会打开登录页面，并继续或结束登录流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Orange Webcom 登录及身份提供方的返回流程可能失败，导致账户授权无法完成。

en.description: When Orange Webcom uses its in-app browser for OAuth, this screen displays the identity provider's page and returns navigation errors to the sign-in flow.
en.disableEffect: Orange Webcom sign-in may not open or complete when it needs this in-app browser.

zh-CN.description: Orange Webcom 使用应用内浏览器进行 OAuth 登录时，此界面会显示身份提供方页面，并将导航错误交回登录流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Orange Webcom 登录需要此应用内浏览器时，登录页面可能无法打开或完成。

en.description: When Orba One starts identity-document verification, this screen lists supported countries and passes the selected country and document options to the next step.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot choose a country for Orba One document verification, so that verification flow cannot continue.

zh-CN.description: Orba One 开始身份文件验证时，此界面会列出支持的国家，并将所选国家和可用文件类型传给下一步。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法为 Orba One 身份文件验证选择国家，因此该验证流程无法继续。

en.description: After country selection in Orba One verification, this screen lists supported identity documents and opens the camera step for the selected document.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot choose an identity document or continue the Orba One document-verification flow.

zh-CN.description: 在 Orba One 验证流程中选择国家后，此界面会列出支持的身份文件，并为所选文件打开拍摄步骤。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法选择身份文件或继续 Orba One 的文件验证流程。

en.description: At the configured start of Orba One verification, this screen explains the requested ID or video steps and lets the user continue.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot proceed past the Orba One verification introduction.

zh-CN.description: Orba One 验证流程开始时，此界面会说明所需的身份文件或视频步骤，并允许用户继续。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法越过 Orba One 验证说明页面。

en.description: After a document is selected, this Orba One screen uses the camera to photograph the required identity-document pages for verification.
en.disableEffect: Orba One cannot capture the required identity-document images, so document verification may not complete.

zh-CN.description: 选择文件后，Orba One 会在此界面使用相机拍摄验证所需的身份文件页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Orba One 将无法拍摄所需的身份文件图像，文件验证可能无法完成。

en.description: At the completion step of an Orba One verification flow, this screen lets the user continue and finish the flow.
en.disableEffect: The Orba One verification flow may not reach its normal completion step.

zh-CN.description: Orba One 验证流程进入完成步骤时，此界面允许用户继续并结束流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Orba One 验证流程可能无法进入正常的完成步骤。

en.description: After the Orba One recording guide, this screen records the requested face and voice video using the camera and sends the recording to a review step.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot record the requested verification video, which can prevent the Orba One flow from completing.

zh-CN.description: 查看 Orba One 录制说明后，此界面会使用相机录制所需的人脸和语音视频，并进入检查步骤。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法录制所需的验证视频，Orba One 流程可能因此无法完成。

en.description: When the Orba One face-video step begins, this screen loads recording instructions and opens the video recorder when the user continues.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot review the recording guidance or start the Orba One face-video step.

zh-CN.description: Orba One 人脸视频步骤开始时，此界面会加载录制说明，并在用户继续后打开录像界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法查看录制说明或开始 Orba One 人脸视频步骤。

en.description: After recording, this Orba One screen plays the video for review and lets the user submit it or retry.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot review and submit the recorded video, which may prevent Orba One verification from completing.

zh-CN.description: 录制完成后，此 Orba One 界面会播放视频供用户检查，并允许用户提交或重录。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法检查并提交录制的视频，Orba One 验证可能无法完成。

en.description: When the app starts, Oriente Core prepares the screen routes used by apps and SDK pages that rely on its navigation library.
en.disableEffect: Screens opened through Oriente Core routing may fail to appear.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，Oriente Core 会准备依赖其导航库的应用页面和 SDK 页面路由。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过 Oriente Core 导航打开的页面可能无法显示。

en.description: When an Oriente Finmas SCF feature opens a web-based landing, pre-payment, or payment-readiness page, this screen displays that page inside the app.
en.disableEffect: Those Oriente SCF web pages may not open, interrupting the related account or payment flow.

zh-CN.description: Oriente Finmas SCF 功能打开网页式首页、付款前检查或支付准备页面时，此界面会在应用内显示该页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Oriente SCF 的这些网页可能无法打开，相关账户或支付流程会中断。

en.description: When Oriente Finmas SCF requests certificate capture after camera access is granted, this landscape screen hosts the capture page.
en.disableEffect: The certificate-capture page will not open, interrupting the related Oriente SCF flow.

zh-CN.description: Oriente Finmas SCF 获得相机权限并请求拍摄凭证时，此横屏界面会承载拍摄页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 凭证拍摄页面将无法打开，相关 Oriente SCF 流程会中断。

en.description: Oriente Finmas SCF uses this portrait screen for pages such as QR scanning and pre-approval status.
en.disableEffect: Those scan and approval pages may not open, interrupting the related Oriente SCF flow.

zh-CN.description: Oriente Finmas SCF 会在此竖屏界面显示二维码扫描和预审批状态等页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 这些扫描和审批页面可能无法打开，相关 Oriente SCF 流程会中断。

en.description: When an app requests a QR scan, this Oriente QR code library screen opens the camera, scans a code, and returns the decoded result.
en.disableEffect: QR scanning through this library will not work.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求扫描二维码时，此 Oriente 二维码库界面会打开相机、扫描二维码并返回识别结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过此库进行的二维码扫描将无法使用。

en.description: When Firebase delivers an Ortto push or refreshes its registration token, this service handles the message and forwards eligible token updates to Ortto.
en.disableEffect: Ortto push messages and registration-token updates will no longer be handled by this SDK.

zh-CN.description: Firebase 投递 Ortto 推送或刷新注册令牌时，此服务会处理消息，并将符合通知权限设置的令牌更新发送给 Ortto。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 此 SDK 将不再处理 Ortto 推送消息或注册令牌更新。

en.description: When an Ortto push action arrives, this receiver clears the matching notification and follows the destination carried by the notification.
en.disableEffect: Tapping or acting on an Ortto push will no longer clear it or open its destination.

zh-CN.description: 收到 Ortto 推送操作时，此接收器会清除对应通知，并打开通知携带的目标页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，点击或操作 Ortto 推送将无法清除通知或打开其目标页面。

en.description: When an app using the OST Client Android SDK asks for fingerprint confirmation, this dialog prompts the user to scan a fingerprint and closes after a match, cancellation, or error.
en.disableEffect: Fingerprint authorization through the OST Client SDK will not work, so wallet actions that require it may be interrupted.

zh-CN.description: 使用 OST Client Android SDK 的应用需要指纹确认时，这个对话框会提示用户验证指纹，并在验证成功、取消或出错后关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: OST Client SDK 的指纹授权将无法使用，依赖它的钱包操作可能因此中断。

en.description: During OST wallet device setup or management, the OST Client Android SDK checks whether a device has been registered, authorized, or revoked while the current flow waits for an update.
en.disableEffect: Turning off this entry is not expected to change wallet use; the checks run inside the active wallet flow rather than as a separate background task.

zh-CN.description: 在 OST 钱包设备的设置或管理过程中，OST Client Android SDK 会在当前流程等待更新时检查设备是否已注册、授权或撤销。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用此项预计不会改变钱包使用；这些检查在当前钱包流程中执行，不会作为独立后台任务运行。

en.description: When a user resets a wallet PIN, the OST Client Android SDK checks the recovery request status while the reset flow waits for authorization.
en.disableEffect: Turning off this entry is not expected to change wallet use; the checks run inside the active PIN recovery flow rather than as a separate background task.

zh-CN.description: 用户重置钱包 PIN 时，OST Client Android SDK 会在重置流程中检查恢复请求的授权状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用此项预计不会改变钱包使用；这些检查在当前 PIN 恢复流程中执行，不会作为独立后台任务运行。

en.description: After a wallet session is requested, the OST Client Android SDK checks whether the session has become authorized while the session flow waits for an update.
en.disableEffect: Turning off this entry is not expected to change wallet use; the checks run inside the active session flow rather than as a separate background task.

zh-CN.description: 用户请求创建钱包会话后，OST Client Android SDK 会在会话流程中检查该会话是否已获授权。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用此项预计不会改变钱包使用；这些检查在当前会话流程中执行，不会作为独立后台任务运行。

en.description: After a wallet transaction is submitted, the OST Client Android SDK checks whether it has succeeded or failed while the transaction flow waits for a result.
en.disableEffect: Turning off this entry is not expected to change wallet use; the checks run inside the active transaction flow rather than as a separate background task.

zh-CN.description: 钱包交易提交后，OST Client Android SDK 会在交易流程中检查交易是否成功或失败。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用此项预计不会改变钱包使用；这些检查在当前交易流程中执行，不会作为独立后台任务运行。

en.description: While OST wallet activation is in progress, the OST Client Android SDK checks whether the account has become active or activation has failed.
en.disableEffect: Turning off this entry is not expected to change wallet setup; the checks run inside the active activation flow rather than as a separate background task.

zh-CN.description: OST 钱包激活过程中，OST Client Android SDK 会检查账户是否已激活或激活是否失败。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用此项预计不会改变钱包设置；这些检查在当前激活流程中执行，不会作为独立后台任务运行。

en.description: When an OST Wallet SDK action requires fingerprint confirmation, this dialog asks the user to scan a fingerprint and closes after a match, cancellation, or error.
en.disableEffect: Fingerprint confirmation will not work, so wallet actions that require biometric authorization may be interrupted.

zh-CN.description: OST Wallet SDK 的操作需要指纹确认时，这个对话框会提示用户验证指纹，并在验证成功、取消或出错后关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 指纹确认将无法使用，依赖生物识别授权的钱包操作可能因此中断。

en.description: When the user chooses to stop recovery of a wallet device, the OST Wallet SDK opens the steps for cancelling that pending recovery.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot cancel a pending device recovery through the wallet app.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择停止恢复某个钱包设备时，OST Wallet SDK 会打开取消待处理恢复的操作界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过钱包应用取消待处理的设备恢复。

en.description: When the app starts OST wallet activation for a registered device, the OST Wallet SDK opens wallet setup so the user can set a PIN and activate the account.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot activate their OST wallet from the app.

zh-CN.description: 应用为已注册的设备启动 OST 钱包激活时，OST Wallet SDK 会打开钱包设置界面，让用户设置 PIN 并激活账户。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过应用激活 OST 钱包。

en.description: When the user authorizes this wallet device with recovery words, the OST Wallet SDK opens a screen for entering those words.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot authorize a wallet device with their recovery words.

zh-CN.description: 用户使用恢复助记词授权此钱包设备时，OST Wallet SDK 会打开助记词输入界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法使用恢复助记词授权钱包设备。

en.description: When the user scans a QR request to authorize a wallet device, the OST Wallet SDK checks the request and shows the device details for confirmation.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot authorize a wallet device by scanning its QR request.

zh-CN.description: 用户扫描授权钱包设备的二维码请求时，OST Wallet SDK 会检查请求并显示设备信息供用户确认。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过扫描二维码请求授权钱包设备。

en.description: When the user scans a QR request to authorize an external wallet session, the OST Wallet SDK shows the session details for review and confirmation.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot authorize an external wallet session from a QR request.

zh-CN.description: 用户扫描授权外部钱包会话的二维码请求时，OST Wallet SDK 会显示会话信息供用户查看和确认。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过二维码请求授权外部钱包会话。

en.description: When the user changes the wallet's biometric preference, the OST Wallet SDK asks for the wallet PIN and updates whether fingerprint confirmation is enabled.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot change the wallet's biometric authentication preference.

zh-CN.description: 用户更改钱包的生物识别偏好时，OST Wallet SDK 会要求输入钱包 PIN，并更新是否启用指纹确认。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法更改钱包的生物识别认证偏好。

en.description: When the app asks to create a wallet session, the OST Wallet SDK requests the user's PIN and creates the session with the selected spending limit and expiration time.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot create wallet sessions from the app.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求创建钱包会话时，OST Wallet SDK 会要求用户输入 PIN，并按所选的支出限额和有效期创建会话。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过应用创建钱包会话。

en.description: When the user scans a transaction QR request, the OST Wallet SDK checks the wallet balance and shows the transaction details for confirmation before execution.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot review and execute wallet transactions from QR requests.

zh-CN.description: 用户扫描交易二维码请求时，OST Wallet SDK 会检查钱包余额，并在执行前显示交易信息供用户确认。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法查看并执行二维码请求中的钱包交易。

en.description: When the user requests the wallet's recovery words, the OST Wallet SDK asks for the wallet PIN and then displays the device's mnemonic phrase.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot view the wallet recovery words needed to back up or restore a device.

zh-CN.description: 用户请求查看钱包恢复助记词时，OST Wallet SDK 会要求输入钱包 PIN，然后显示该设备的助记词。
