zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法查看用于备份或恢复设备的钱包助记词。

en.description: When the user starts recovery for a wallet device, the OST Wallet SDK shows the device list or the recovery steps for the selected device.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot start wallet device recovery from the app.

zh-CN.description: 用户为钱包设备启动恢复时，OST Wallet SDK 会显示设备列表，或显示所选设备的恢复步骤。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过应用启动钱包设备恢复。

en.description: When the user resets the wallet PIN, the OST Wallet SDK opens the wallet's PIN reset steps.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot reset their wallet PIN through the app.

zh-CN.description: 用户重置钱包 PIN 时，OST Wallet SDK 会打开钱包 PIN 重置流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过应用重置钱包 PIN。

en.description: When the user removes a wallet device, the OST Wallet SDK lists registered devices or begins revoking the selected device after PIN authorization.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot revoke a wallet device from the app.

zh-CN.description: 用户移除钱包设备时，OST Wallet SDK 会列出已注册的设备，或在 PIN 授权后开始撤销所选设备。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过应用撤销钱包设备。

en.description: When the user wants to add another wallet device, the OST Wallet SDK displays a QR code for the current device and checks whether the new device has been authorized.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot share the wallet's device QR code to authorize another device.

zh-CN.description: 用户要添加另一台钱包设备时，OST Wallet SDK 会显示当前设备的二维码，并检查新设备是否已获授权。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法分享钱包设备二维码来授权另一台设备。

en.description: When the app opens the OST Wallet SDK's component showcase, this screen displays a sample PIN-entry interface and no wallet operation.
en.disableEffect: Turning it off only stops the sample screen from opening; wallet activation, PIN, recovery, device, and QR actions use their own screens.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开 OST Wallet SDK 的组件展示页时，此界面会显示示例 PIN 输入画面，不会执行钱包操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后仅示例界面无法打开；钱包激活、PIN、恢复、设备和二维码操作使用各自的界面。

en.description: When WhatsApp returns a one-tap OTP, the OTPless Connect Android SDK receiver validates it and sends the code or an error to the active sign-in flow.
en.disableEffect: The automatic WhatsApp OTP step in OTPless Connect sign-in will stop working.

zh-CN.description: WhatsApp 返回一键验证码时，OTPless Connect Android SDK 接收器会验证结果，并将验证码或错误交给当前登录流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，OTPless Connect 登录中的 WhatsApp 自动读取验证码步骤将无法工作。

en.description: The OTPless Connect Android SDK starts this foreground service for a login connection; it fetches a session room, opens a live connection, and provides OTP and cellular-network helpers to the flow.
en.disableEffect: OTPless Connect sign-in and its connection or automatic OTP steps can fail when this service is disabled.

zh-CN.description: OTPless Connect Android SDK 会为登录连接启动此前台服务；它获取会话房间、建立实时连接，并为流程提供验证码和蜂窝网络辅助功能。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，OTPless Connect 登录及其连接或自动读取验证码步骤可能失败。

en.description: When WhatsApp returns an OTP to OTPless Auto Read, this receiver processes the active consumer or business login requests and returns the code or an error to the app.
en.disableEffect: Automatic WhatsApp OTP reading for OTPless Auto Read sign-in will stop working.

zh-CN.description: WhatsApp 将验证码返回给 OTPless Auto Read 时，此接收器会处理当前的个人版或商业版登录请求，并将验证码或错误交给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，OTPless Auto Read 登录中的 WhatsApp 自动读取验证码功能将停止工作。

en.description: When WhatsApp returns a one-tap OTP, the OTPless Connect Android SDK receiver validates it and sends the code or an error to the active sign-in flow.
en.disableEffect: The automatic WhatsApp OTP step in OTPless Connect sign-in will stop working.

zh-CN.description: WhatsApp 返回一键验证码时，OTPless Connect Android SDK 接收器会验证结果，并将验证码或错误交给当前登录流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，OTPless Connect 登录中的 WhatsApp 自动读取验证码步骤将无法工作。

en.description: The OTPless Connect Android SDK starts this foreground service for a login connection; it fetches a session room, opens a live connection, and provides OTP and cellular-network helpers to the flow.
en.disableEffect: OTPless Connect sign-in and its connection or automatic OTP steps can fail when this service is disabled.

zh-CN.description: OTPless Connect Android SDK 会为登录连接启动此前台服务；它获取会话房间、建立实时连接，并为流程提供验证码和蜂窝网络辅助功能。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，OTPless Connect 登录及其连接或自动读取验证码步骤可能失败。

en.description: During an OTPless Socket.IO connection, the SDK starts and binds this foreground service to open a live connection and pass sign-in messages and connection status to the active flow.
en.disableEffect: OTPless Fusion connection and authentication messages can stop working while this service is disabled.

zh-CN.description: OTPless Socket.IO 建立连接时，SDK 会启动并绑定此 Service，以建立实时连接并将登录消息和连接状态传给当前流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，OTPless Fusion 的连接和身份验证消息可能无法正常工作。

zh-CN.description: 学习者从 Oust 技能页面打开目标时，这个 Activity 会显示技能目标、按日期记录的进展和相关媒体。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 学习者将无法查看这些技能目标及其进展记录。

en.description: When a learner selects a skill in an Oust catalogue, this Activity shows its description, current score and level, target date, and related media. It also links to skill rankings, history, targets, and a practice timer.
en.disableEffect: The skill details and their related actions will not open.

zh-CN.description: 学习者在 Oust 目录中选择技能时，这个 Activity 会显示技能说明、当前分数和等级、目标日期及相关媒体。页面还可进入技能排名、历史记录、目标和练习计时器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 技能详情及相关操作将无法打开。

en.description: When opened from an Oust skill page, this Activity loads the learner’s skill results and graphs scores and levels by submission date.
en.disableEffect: The learner cannot view historical skill progress.

zh-CN.description: 从 Oust 技能页面打开后，这个 Activity 会加载学习者的技能结果，并按提交日期绘制分数和等级变化。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 学习者将无法查看技能历史进度。

en.description: When opened from an Oust skill or target page, this Activity retrieves the rankings for that skill and shows leading learners and the current learner’s rank and score.
en.disableEffect: The learner cannot view rankings for that skill.

zh-CN.description: 从 Oust 技能或目标页面打开时，这个 Activity 会获取该技能的排名，并显示领先学习者以及当前学习者的名次和分数。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 学习者将无法查看该技能的排名。

en.description: When a learner starts practice from an Oust skill page, this Activity runs timed preparation and exercise intervals with a spoken countdown and beeps.
en.disableEffect: The skill practice timer will not be available.

zh-CN.description: 学习者从 Oust 技能页面开始练习时，这个 Activity 会运行准备和练习计时，并通过语音倒数和提示音提醒。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 技能练习计时器将无法使用。

en.description: When a survey uses Oust’s newer survey screen, this Activity loads its cards, records answers, and submits completion. It then opens a screen with the completion message and any earned coins.
en.disableEffect: Surveys using this screen cannot be completed.

zh-CN.description: 调查使用 Oust 的新版界面时，这个 Activity 会加载卡片、记录回答并提交完成状态，随后显示完成提示和获得的金币。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此界面的调查将无法完成。

en.description: When a learner opens an Oust survey from a task, catalogue, calendar, or feed, this Activity loads its questions, lets the learner answer and review them, and submits the result.
en.disableEffect: These survey entry points will not open, so the learner cannot submit the survey.

zh-CN.description: 学习者从任务、目录、日历或动态中打开 Oust 调查时，这个 Activity 会加载问题，供学习者作答和检查，并提交调查结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 这些调查入口将无法打开，学习者也无法提交调查。

en.description: After an Oust survey is submitted or exited, this Activity shows the survey name, completion message, and any coins awarded, then returns the learner to the previous screen.
en.disableEffect: The survey completion and reward message will not appear, and the return result may not be handled.

zh-CN.description: Oust 调查提交或退出后，这个 Activity 会显示调查名称、完成提示和获得的金币，然后返回上一页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 调查完成和奖励提示将不会显示，返回时也可能无法处理结果。

en.description: When launched from an Oust-integrating app, this screen asks for an organization ID and user name, then opens Oust’s content-loading screen for that account.
en.disableEffect: The user cannot start the Oust experience through this entry screen.

zh-CN.description: 从集成 Oust 的应用启动时，这个界面会要求填写组织 ID 和用户名，然后为该账户打开 Oust 内容加载页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此入口启动 Oust 内容。

en.description: When an Oust course download needs a retry, this Activity displays a retry prompt; choosing Retry resumes the download.
en.disableEffect: The learner cannot retry a failed course download through this prompt.

zh-CN.description: Oust 课程下载需要重试时，这个 Activity 会显示重试提示；选择重试后会继续下载。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 学习者将无法通过此提示重试失败的课程下载。

en.description: When a learner selects FAQ or team analytics in the Oust menu, this Activity opens the supplied page inside the app and shows its loading progress.
en.disableEffect: The FAQ and team analytics pages will not open inside Oust.

zh-CN.description: 学习者在 Oust 菜单中选择常见问题或团队分析时，这个 Activity 会在应用内打开相应页面并显示加载进度。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 常见问题和团队分析页面将无法在 Oust 中打开。

en.description: When the learner is already signed in on another device, this Activity asks whether to continue and end that other session or cancel.
en.disableEffect: The learner cannot choose how to handle the other session, which can interrupt sign-in.

zh-CN.description: 学习者已在另一台设备登录时，这个 Activity 会询问是否继续并结束另一会话，或取消操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 学习者将无法选择如何处理另一会话，登录流程可能因此中断。

en.description: When a learner opens the Oust learning diary, this Activity lists entries and lets them add, edit, or delete dated activity records with photo or video attachments.
en.disableEffect: The learning diary and its entry and media tools will not open.

zh-CN.description: 学习者打开 Oust 学习日志时，这个 Activity 会列出日志，并允许添加、编辑或删除带日期的活动记录及照片或视频附件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 学习日志及其记录和媒体功能将无法打开。

en.description: When the app starts a barcode scan, the OutSystems Barcode SDK opens the camera scanner and returns the detected code or a scan error.
en.disableEffect: The app's barcode-scanning flow will not work.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动条码扫描时，OutSystems Barcode SDK 会打开相机扫描页面，并返回识别到的条码或扫描错误。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用的条码扫描流程将无法使用。

en.description: When a website in the OutSystems InAppBrowser asks to capture a photo or video, this provider makes the browser's temporary media file available to the capture flow.
en.disableEffect: Photo and video capture or upload from in-app web pages may fail.

zh-CN.description: OutSystems InAppBrowser 中的网站请求拍摄照片或视频时，此提供器会向拍摄流程提供浏览器的临时媒体文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用内网页的照片和视频拍摄或上传可能失败。

en.description: When OutSystems InAppBrowser runs its web page in a separate process, the browser binds this service to reduce the chance that Android freezes that process.
en.disableEffect: An open in-app browser session may be stopped sooner while it is in the background.

zh-CN.description: OutSystems InAppBrowser 在独立进程中运行网页时，浏览器会绑定此服务，以降低 Android 冻结该进程的可能性。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用内浏览器切到后台后，打开的会话可能更早停止。

en.description: OutSystems OSInAppBrowser uses this screen to open and track a Chrome Custom Tab for an in-app browser request, then tells the app when the tab closes. Disabling it can interrupt web pages opened through the in-app browser.
en.disableEffect: The app's OutSystems in-app browser and any web flow opened through it may fail.

zh-CN.description: OutSystems OSInAppBrowser 使用此界面打开并跟踪 Chrome 自定义标签页，并在标签页关闭时通知应用。禁用后，通过应用内浏览器打开的网页流程可能中断。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用的 OutSystems 内置浏览器及其中打开的网页流程可能无法使用。

en.description: When the app opens a link in OutSystems InAppBrowser, this screen displays the page with browser navigation and web upload and download handling.
en.disableEffect: Links that use the in-app browser will not open, and their page actions will be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: 应用通过 OutSystems InAppBrowser 打开链接时，此页面会显示网页，并提供浏览导航以及网页上传和下载处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用应用内浏览器打开的链接将无法显示，网页操作也无法使用。

en.description: When the SDK launches its separate sharing variant, this activity hosts the same OutSystems in-app browser page and inherits its navigation and file handling.
en.disableEffect: A flow routed through this browser screen will not open.

zh-CN.description: SDK 启动独立的分享版页面时，此 Activity 会承载同一 OutSystems 应用内网页，并沿用其导航和文件处理功能。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过此浏览器页面打开的流程将无法使用。

en.description: When a user follows an OwnID sign-in return link, this Activity opens briefly and closes so control returns to the host app. It is the handoff point for OwnID's redirect-based authentication flow.
en.disableEffect: OwnID sign-in flows that depend on this return link cannot complete.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 OwnID 登录返回链接时，此 Activity 会短暂启动后立即关闭，让操作返回应用。它负责 OwnID 重定向登录流程的返回交接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此返回链接的 OwnID 登录流程将无法完成。

en.description: The OwnID authentication SDK launches this Activity for a requested sign-in, social-login, or account-enrollment step and returns the result to the app.
en.disableEffect: OwnID sign-in and account-enrollment steps that use this Activity will fail, which can prevent users from logging in or setting up an account.

zh-CN.description: OwnID 身份验证 SDK 会在登录、社交账号登录或注册步骤中启动此 Activity，并将结果返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此 Activity 的 OwnID 登录或注册步骤会失败，用户可能无法登录或创建账户。

en.description: When OwnID starts a hidden sign-in or account-enrollment step, this Activity runs the step without showing a normal page and returns its result to the app.
en.disableEffect: OwnID flows that need this hidden step can fail, preventing the related sign-in or account-enrollment action.

zh-CN.description: OwnID 启动隐藏的登录或注册步骤时，此 Activity 会在不显示常规页面的情况下运行该步骤，并将结果返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要此隐藏步骤的 OwnID 流程可能失败，相关登录或注册操作将无法完成。

en.description: When an OwnID sign-in or verification flow needs a browser page, this Activity opens it in the user's browser and returns the browser result to the app. It runs while the user completes that web step.
en.disableEffect: OwnID sign-in or verification steps that require the browser handoff will not finish.

zh-CN.description: OwnID 登录或验证流程需要网页步骤时，此 Activity 会在用户的浏览器中打开页面，并将浏览器返回的结果交回应用。用户完成网页步骤时会运行它。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要浏览器跳转的 OwnID 登录或验证步骤将无法完成。

en.description: When the browser opens an OwnID return link, this Activity forwards the link to the active OwnID flow and then closes. It lets the app continue after the user finishes the web step.
en.disableEffect: The browser return link will not resume the OwnID flow, so sign-in or verification can remain unfinished.

zh-CN.description: 浏览器打开 OwnID 返回链接时，此 Activity 会把链接交回正在进行的 OwnID 流程，然后关闭。用户完成网页步骤后，应用才能继续登录或验证。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 浏览器返回链接无法继续 OwnID 流程，登录或验证可能停留在未完成状态。

en.description: When an OwnID sign-in or verification flow needs a browser page, this Activity opens it in the user's browser and returns the browser result to the app. It runs while the user completes that web step.
en.disableEffect: OwnID sign-in or verification steps that require the browser handoff will not finish.

zh-CN.description: OwnID 登录或验证流程需要网页步骤时，此 Activity 会在用户的浏览器中打开页面，并将浏览器返回的结果交回应用。用户完成网页步骤时会运行它。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要浏览器跳转的 OwnID 登录或验证步骤将无法完成。

en.description: When the browser opens an OwnID return link, this Activity forwards the link to the active OwnID flow and then closes. It lets the app continue after the user finishes the web step.
en.disableEffect: The browser return link will not resume the OwnID flow, so sign-in or verification can remain unfinished.

zh-CN.description: 浏览器打开 OwnID 返回链接时，此 Activity 会把链接交回正在进行的 OwnID 流程，然后关闭。用户完成网页步骤后，应用才能继续登录或验证。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 浏览器返回链接无法继续 OwnID 流程，登录或验证可能停留在未完成状态。

en.description: The OwnID authentication SDK uses this hidden Activity as a temporary host during account sign-in or verification steps that need Android's interface. It closes when the requested step ends.
en.disableEffect: OwnID sign-in or verification steps that need this host can fail, preventing users from completing the related account action.

zh-CN.description: OwnID 身份验证 SDK 会在需要调用 Android 界面的登录或验证步骤中使用此隐藏 Activity，并在步骤结束后关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要此 Activity 的 OwnID 登录或验证步骤可能失败，用户将无法完成相关账户操作。

en.description: OwnID opens this Activity when a sign-in or verification step needs an embedded web page; the page appears inside the app and returns its result to the same flow.
en.disableEffect: OwnID sign-in or verification steps that use the embedded page cannot finish.

zh-CN.description: OwnID 登录或验证步骤需要内嵌网页时，会启动此 Activity 在应用中显示页面，并把结果交回当前流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用内嵌网页的 OwnID 登录或验证步骤将无法完成。

en.description: Ox SDK’s MAX adapter opens this Activity to display a native interstitial ad over the app, with a countdown before users can skip it.
en.disableEffect: Ox SDK native interstitial ads shown through MAX will no longer display.

zh-CN.description: Ox SDK 的 MAX 适配器会打开此 Activity，在应用上方展示原生插屏广告，并在倒计时后允许用户跳过。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Ox SDK 通过 MAX 展示的原生插屏广告将无法显示。

en.description: PacketZoom listens for a special secret-code broadcast from the phone dialer and opens its configuration screen. The screen lets an operator change development and metrics server settings and toggle PacketZoom networking.
en.disableEffect: PacketZoom's hidden configuration screen will no longer open from the dialer; ordinary app screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: PacketZoom 会监听拨号器发出的特殊代码广播，并打开配置页面。该页面可更改开发服务器和数据服务器设置，也可切换 PacketZoom 网络功能。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 无法再从拨号器打开 PacketZoom 隐藏配置页面，应用的常规页面仍可使用。

en.description: When Android reports a Wi-Fi or mobile-network change, PacketZoom refreshes connection and carrier information and notifies its networking client of a lost or changed connection.
en.disableEffect: PacketZoom will miss connection changes and cannot refresh its accelerated connection, which can interrupt requests routed through it.

zh-CN.description: Android 通知 Wi-Fi 或移动网络发生变化时，PacketZoom 会更新连接和运营商信息，并通知其网络组件连接已断开或切换。
zh-CN.disableEffect: PacketZoom 将无法响应网络变化或刷新加速连接，经由该连接的请求可能中断。

en.description: PacketZoom opens this Activity for its configuration screen, where an operator can set development and metrics servers and choose whether PacketZoom networking is enabled.
en.disableEffect: PacketZoom's server and networking settings can no longer be changed through this screen, while the app's ordinary screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: PacketZoom 会通过此 Activity 显示配置页面，供用户设置开发服务器和数据服务器，并选择是否启用 PacketZoom 网络功能。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 无法再通过此页面更改 PacketZoom 的服务器和网络设置，应用的常规页面仍可使用。

en.description: The PallyCon Widevine SDK starts this service to run or restart protected-video downloads in the background. Android can start it again after a download restart request, and it shows download progress in a notification.
en.disableEffect: PallyCon-managed offline video downloads will not resume or complete while this service is disabled.

zh-CN.description: PallyCon Widevine SDK 会在后台通过此 Service 下载或恢复受保护的视频。Android 可在收到下载重启请求后再次启动它，并通过通知显示下载进度。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用此 Service 后，PallyCon 管理的离线观看视频将无法继续下载或恢复。

en.description: When Google delivers a Paloma push message, this service reads its message fields and forwards the notification to Paloma's notification handling.
en.disableEffect: The app will stop receiving Paloma push notifications, while its other features continue to work.

zh-CN.description: Google 投递 Paloma 推送消息时，此 Service 会读取消息内容并交给 Paloma 的通知系统处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将不再收到 Paloma 推送通知，其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: When Google refreshes the app's push token, this service clears the saved token and schedules a fresh registration with Paloma.
en.disableEffect: After Google rotates the token, Paloma will not receive the new registration and its push notifications can stop arriving.

zh-CN.description: Google 刷新应用的推送令牌时，此 Service 会清除旧令牌，并安排向 Paloma 重新注册。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Google 更换令牌后，Paloma 无法收到新的注册信息，之后可能不再向应用投递推送通知。

en.description: When Beagle shares a captured screenshot or recording, its file-sharing provider gives Android and the receiving app a readable link to that saved file.
en.disableEffect: Beagle screenshot and recording exports can fail because other apps cannot access the shared files.

zh-CN.description: Beagle 分享截屏或录屏时，它的文件分享 Provider 会为 Android 和接收应用提供可读取的文件链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，其他应用无法访问共享文件，Beagle 截屏和录屏导出可能失败。

en.description: When the user requests a Beagle screen capture and grants Android capture permission, this service saves a screenshot or video and opens a preview or gallery notification.
en.disableEffect: Beagle's debug tools can no longer capture screenshots or screen recordings.

zh-CN.description: 用户请求 Beagle 截屏并授予 Android 录屏权限后，此服务会保存截屏或视频，并显示预览或图库通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Beagle 调试工具将无法截屏或录制屏幕。

en.description: Opened from Beagle's debug menu, this screen gathers build and device details, crash and log entries, and user notes for an optional bug report.
en.disableEffect: Beagle's in-app bug-report screen is unavailable, while the host app's normal screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: 从 Beagle 调试菜单打开后，此页面会收集构建和设备信息、崩溃与日志条目以及用户备注，供提交可选的错误报告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Beagle 应用内的错误报告页面不可用，但宿主应用的正常页面仍可使用。

en.description: Beagle opens this screen to browse saved screenshots and recordings, preview them, and select, share, or delete files.
en.disableEffect: Users lose Beagle's capture gallery, including its preview, sharing, and delete actions.

zh-CN.description: Beagle 会打开此页面浏览已保存的截屏和录屏、预览内容，并选择、分享或删除文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法使用 Beagle 截屏图库的预览、分享和删除功能。

en.description: When the app opens Beagle's developer menu, this Activity displays the SDK's debugging tools and reports when the menu is shown or hidden.
en.disableEffect: Beagle's in-app developer debug menu cannot be opened.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开 Beagle 开发者菜单时，此 Activity 会显示 SDK 调试工具，并在菜单显示或隐藏时通知 SDK。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，将无法打开 Beagle 应用内的开发者调试菜单。

en.description: Pao11 ImagePicker registers this provider so the app can grant temporary access to files on external storage. It runs when another app follows a file link created through it.
en.disableEffect: Any app flow that shares a file through this provider will lose access to that file; gallery photo selection remains available.

zh-CN.description: Pao11 ImagePicker 注册此 Provider，使应用可以临时向其他应用开放外部存储中文件的访问权限。其他应用通过它创建的文件链接访问文件时，会触发此 Provider。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此 Provider 分享文件的流程将无法访问该文件；图库照片选择仍可使用。

en.description: This Pao11 ImagePicker support Activity sets the status-bar appearance and preserves selected items while its gallery, crop, and preview pages are recreated.
en.disableEffect: The built-in gallery, crop, and preview pages remain available; only direct opening of this support screen is blocked.

zh-CN.description: 这是 Pao11 ImagePicker 的辅助 Activity，负责统一状态栏外观，并在图库、裁剪和预览页面重建时保留已选内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 内置的图库、裁剪和预览页面仍可使用；停用后仅无法单独打开此辅助页面。

en.description: When the app requests cropping in Pao11 ImagePicker, this Activity lets the user adjust a selected or newly taken photo and returns the cropped result.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot complete any flow that requires this picker’s crop screen.

zh-CN.description: 应用在 Pao11 ImagePicker 中请求裁剪时，此 Activity 会让用户调整已选或刚拍摄的照片，并返回裁剪结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此裁剪页面的应用流程将无法完成。

en.description: Pao11 ImagePicker opens this Activity when the app asks users to choose photos; it lists local albums and can also launch the camera.
en.disableEffect: Users can no longer browse and select photos or start the picker’s camera flow.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求用户选择照片时，Pao11 ImagePicker 会打开此 Activity，显示本地相册，也可启动相机。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此选择器浏览、选择照片或启动相机。

en.description: Pao11 ImagePicker opens this Activity from its photo or video selection pages to show full-screen media previews and let users adjust their selections.
en.disableEffect: The picker cannot show full-screen previews or let users adjust selections from this screen.

zh-CN.description: Pao11 ImagePicker 会从照片或视频选择页面打开此 Activity，全屏预览媒体并让用户调整选择结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 选择器将无法显示全屏预览，也无法在此页面调整选择结果。

en.description: When the app opens Pao11 ImagePicker’s delete-preview screen, this Activity shows selected photos full-screen and lets the user remove items from the selection.
en.disableEffect: Apps that use this screen lose its photo-preview and removal flow.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开 Pao11 ImagePicker 的删除预览页面时，此 Activity 会全屏显示已选照片，并允许用户从选择结果中移除照片。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此页面的应用将无法进行照片预览和移除操作。

en.description: Pao11 ImagePicker opens this Activity when the app requests video selection; it lists video albums, lets users choose clips, and returns the selection.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot select videos through this picker.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求选择视频时，Pao11 ImagePicker 会打开此 Activity，显示视频相册、供用户选择片段并返回选择结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法通过此选择器选择视频。

en.description: When Parousya starts this background Service, it checks the client sign-in state, restores the Automatic Check-In session, and starts pairing with nearby beacons. It runs with a notification while this background work is active.
en.disableEffect: Parousya's background session and beacon-pairing work will stop, disabling automatic check-ins and proximity-based session updates.

zh-CN.description: Parousya 启动此后台 Service 时，会检查客户端登录状态、恢复自动签到会话，并开始与附近的蓝牙信标配对。后台任务运行期间会显示通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Parousya 的后台会话和信标配对将停止，自动签到及基于位置的会话更新会失效。

en.description: Android runs this job-backed service for queued Parousya Automatic Check-In work. It checks the client sign-in state, starts beacon pairing for an active session, and shows a foreground notification while it runs.
en.disableEffect: Queued Parousya check-in work will not run, so beacon-based check-ins and session updates will stop.

zh-CN.description: Android 会通过此 Job Service 执行排队的 Parousya 自动签到任务。它会检查客户端登录状态、为有效会话启动信标配对，并在运行时显示前台通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 排队的 Parousya 签到任务将无法运行，基于信标的签到和会话更新会停止。

en.description: When Android finishes booting, this receiver resets Parousya's alarm for its next background check-in run. The alarm starts the check-in service again after a delay.
en.disableEffect: Parousya's automatic check-ins will not be re-armed after a reboot, so background beacon monitoring will remain stopped.

zh-CN.description: Android 启动完成后，此 Receiver 会重新设置 Parousya 下一次后台签到的闹钟。延迟后，闹钟会再次启动签到 Service。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 重启后 Parousya 的自动签到不会重新安排，后台信标监测将保持停止。

en.description: When a USB remote-control accessory is attached, Parrot GroundSDK registers it with the app and launches the app. This Activity runs for the Android USB-accessory attachment event.
en.disableEffect: The app will no longer handle a Parrot remote controller when it is plugged in over USB.

zh-CN.description: USB 遥控器配件连接后，Parrot GroundSDK 会将其交给应用处理并启动应用。Android 检测到 USB 配件接入时会运行此 Activity。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过 USB 连接 Parrot 遥控器时，应用将无法再处理该配件。

en.description: Firebase Job Dispatcher runs this service to save the app's Firebase Cloud Messaging token and push type to its Parse installation. It runs when Parse schedules a push-token registration or update.
en.disableEffect: Parse will not receive updated FCM registration details, so Parse push delivery to this app will stop working reliably.

zh-CN.description: Firebase Job Dispatcher 会启动此 Service，将应用的 Firebase Cloud Messaging 令牌和推送类型保存到 Parse 安装记录中。Parse 安排推送令牌注册或更新时会运行它。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Parse 无法收到更新后的 FCM 注册信息，向此应用投递 Parse 推送将无法正常工作。

en.description: Firebase Job Dispatcher runs this service to obtain the app's Google Cloud Messaging token and save it with the app's Parse installation. It runs when Parse schedules a push-token registration or update.
en.disableEffect: Parse will not receive updated GCM registration details, so Parse push delivery to this app will stop working reliably.

zh-CN.description: Firebase Job Dispatcher 会启动此 Service，获取应用的 Google Cloud Messaging 令牌并保存到 Parse 安装记录中。Parse 安排推送令牌注册或更新时会运行它。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Parse 无法收到更新后的 GCM 注册信息，向此应用投递 Parse 推送将无法正常工作。

en.description: Particle Network AuthCore opens this screen when a user chooses account security or master-password guidance. It displays the selected account-security page or password help so the user can manage those settings.
en.disableEffect: Blocking it removes the account-security and password-guidance screens, so users cannot complete those account-management tasks.

zh-CN.description: Particle Network AuthCore 会在用户打开账户安全设置或主密码说明时显示此页面。页面展示对应的账户安全内容或密码帮助，供用户管理这些设置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后将无法打开账户安全和主密码说明页面，用户也无法完成相应的账户管理操作。

en.description: Particle Network AuthCore opens this screen when a phone sign-in flow needs a security check before sending a code. It presents the verification page and returns success or cancellation to sign-in.
en.disableEffect: Phone sign-in flows that require this check cannot finish if this screen is disabled.

zh-CN.description: Particle Network AuthCore 在手机号登录需要安全验证、准备发送验证码时显示此页面。页面完成验证后会将成功或取消结果交回登录流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，需要此项验证的手机号登录流程将无法完成。

en.description: When an app starts Particle Network AuthCore sign-in, this screen presents the account login form and handles the user's chosen sign-in method.
en.disableEffect: Blocking it prevents users from signing in through Particle AuthCore.

zh-CN.description: 应用发起 Particle Network AuthCore 登录时，此页面会显示账户登录表单，并处理用户选择的登录方式。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，用户将无法通过 Particle AuthCore 登录。

en.description: Particle Network AuthCore opens this screen to set or restore a master password, including password changes. It presents the form for the requested operation.
en.disableEffect: Blocking it prevents users from setting, restoring, or changing the master password when AuthCore requests that step.

zh-CN.description: Particle Network AuthCore 会在需要设置、恢复或更改主密码时显示此页面，并提供对应的操作表单。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，AuthCore 要求进行这些步骤时，用户将无法设置、恢复或更改主密码。

en.description: When Particle Network AuthCore requests approval to sign a message, typed data, or transaction, this screen shows the request and collects the user's decision.
en.disableEffect: Blocking it prevents the affected signing and transaction-approval flows from completing.

zh-CN.description: Particle Network AuthCore 请求签署消息、结构化数据或交易时，此页面会展示请求并收集用户的确认结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，相关签名和交易确认流程将无法完成。

en.description: When an app starts Particle Network ConnectKit's login or connection flow, this screen presents its login interface and returns the result to the caller.
en.disableEffect: Blocking it prevents users from completing ConnectKit login or connection flows.

zh-CN.description: 应用发起 Particle Network ConnectKit 登录或连接流程时，此页面会显示登录界面，并将结果返回给调用方。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，用户将无法完成 ConnectKit 登录或连接流程。

en.description: Particle Network Wallet UI declares this internal Activity as a transparent, full-width dialog window with an empty layout. The analyzed SDK code does not show what opens it or what the dialog would display.
en.disableEffect: An in-app flow that launches this window would no longer be able to show it; the analyzed code does not identify which flow depends on it.

zh-CN.description: Particle Network 钱包界面将此内部 Activity 声明为透明的全宽对话框窗口，但其布局为空。已分析的 SDK 代码没有说明由什么流程打开它，也没有显示对话框内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 如果应用内流程会启动此窗口，停用后对话框将无法显示；已分析的代码没有指出具体依赖它的流程。

en.description: Particle Network Wallet routes its wallet entry through this full-screen Activity, which provides the content area for the wallet screen. The SDK opens it through its internal wallet navigation.
en.disableEffect: Users may no longer be able to open the embedded Particle wallet screen.

zh-CN.description: Particle Network 钱包会通过此全屏 Activity 打开钱包入口，并在其中提供钱包页面的内容区域。SDK 通过内部钱包导航启动此界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户可能无法再打开内嵌的 Particle 钱包界面。

en.description: From Particle Network Wallet Service's token search, users open this screen to enter a token address and add the matching custom token to the wallet.
en.disableEffect: Blocking it removes the custom-token addition flow, so users may not be able to add assets that are missing from the wallet's token list.

zh-CN.description: 用户可从 Particle Network Wallet Service 的代币搜索页面打开此页，输入代币地址并将匹配的自定义代币添加到钱包。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后将无法通过此流程添加自定义代币，钱包列表中未显示的资产可能无法加入。

en.description: When users choose batch send from the Particle Network wallet tools, this screen lets them select tokens or NFTs for a grouped transfer before review.
en.disableEffect: Blocking it prevents users from selecting assets for batch transfers.

zh-CN.description: 用户从 Particle Network 钱包工具中选择批量发送时，此页面用于选择要一起转出的代币或 NFT，然后进入确认步骤。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，用户将无法选择资产进行批量转账。

en.description: After users select tokens or NFTs for a batch send, Particle Network Wallet Service opens this screen to review the items and recipient before submission.
en.disableEffect: Blocking it prevents the batch-send review and submission flow from completing.

zh-CN.description: 用户选好要批量发送的代币或 NFT 后，Particle Network Wallet Service 会显示此页面，让用户在提交前核对资产和收款地址。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，批量发送的核对和提交流程将无法完成。

en.description: When users open the Particle Network wallet's bridge feature, this screen lets them choose assets and networks, review bridge details, and submit a cross-network transfer.
en.disableEffect: Blocking it prevents users from initiating bridge transfers in the wallet.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 Particle Network 钱包的跨链桥功能时，此页面可供选择资产和网络、核对跨链信息并提交转账。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，用户将无法在钱包中发起跨链转账。

en.description: From the Particle Network bridge screen, users open this page to view past bridge transfers for a network and select one for more information.
en.disableEffect: Blocking it removes the bridge-history list, so users cannot review earlier bridge transfers there.

zh-CN.description: 用户可从 Particle Network 跨链桥页面打开此页，查看某个网络的历史跨链转账，并选择一笔查看详情。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后将无法查看跨链记录列表，也无法从此处检查过往转账。

en.description: When a user selects a bridge-history item, Particle Network Wallet Service displays its source and destination details, addresses, and transaction information.
en.disableEffect: Blocking it prevents users from inspecting individual bridge-transfer details.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择一条跨链记录后，Particle Network Wallet Service 会展示其来源和目标信息、地址及交易详情。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，用户将无法查看单笔跨链转账的详细信息。

en.description: During bridge setup, this Particle Network wallet screen lists supported bridge networks and returns the network chosen for the source or destination.
en.disableEffect: Blocking it prevents users from choosing a bridge network when the flow asks them to select one.

zh-CN.description: 设置跨链转账时，此 Particle Network 钱包页面会列出支持的网络，并返回用户选定的来源或目标网络。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，流程要求选择跨链网络时，用户将无法完成选择。

en.description: During bridge setup, this Particle Network wallet screen lists tokens available on the selected network and returns the token chosen for transfer.
en.disableEffect: Blocking it prevents users from selecting a token in bridge flows that open this list.

zh-CN.description: 设置跨链转账时，此 Particle Network 钱包页面会列出所选网络上的代币，并返回用户选定的转账代币。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，跨链流程打开代币列表时，用户将无法选择代币。

en.description: When an app opens a web3 site through Particle Network Wallet Service, this screen displays it in the wallet's decentralized-app browser and supports wallet interactions with the site.
en.disableEffect: Blocking it prevents users from opening sites through this wallet browser and using its connected wallet interactions.

zh-CN.description: 应用通过 Particle Network Wallet Service 打开 web3 网站时，此页面会在钱包内的去中心化应用浏览器中显示网站，并支持网站与钱包交互。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，用户将无法通过此钱包浏览器打开网站或使用其中的钱包交互功能。

en.description: From the Particle Network wallet's decentralized-app browser, users open this screen to search for or enter a site and revisit or clear saved search history.
en.disableEffect: Blocking it removes the browser's search and history screen, making it harder to find or reopen sites from there.

zh-CN.description: 用户可从 Particle Network 钱包的去中心化应用浏览器打开此页，搜索或输入网站，也可再次打开或清除搜索记录。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后将无法使用浏览器的搜索和历史记录页面，用户也更难从此处查找或重开网站。

en.description: When an account-abstraction transaction has fee quotes to choose from, Particle Network Wallet Service opens this dialog so the user can select a network-fee option.
en.disableEffect: Blocking it prevents users from choosing among the offered fee options for transactions that require this choice.

zh-CN.description: 账户抽象交易提供多种费用报价时，Particle Network Wallet Service 会显示此对话框，供用户选择网络手续费方案。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，要求用户选择费用方案的交易将无法完成该选择步骤。

en.description: When a wallet or swap operation needs a different blockchain network, Particle Network Wallet Service opens this prompt to ask the user to switch or confirm the change.
en.disableEffect: Blocking it prevents network-change requests from completing and can interrupt wallet or swap operations that need another network.

zh-CN.description: 钱包或兑换操作需要切换区块链网络时，Particle Network Wallet Service 会显示此提示，询问用户是否切换或确认更改。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，网络切换请求将无法完成，需要切换网络的钱包或兑换操作也可能中断。

en.description: When a user opens an NFT in Particle Network Wallet, this Activity loads the detail page for the active blockchain and shows the NFT preview. The wallet screen also provides actions for that NFT.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to open NFT details or use the related actions in the Particle wallet.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Particle Network 钱包中打开 NFT 时，此 Activity 会加载对应区块链的详情页面并显示 NFT 预览。钱包页面还提供该 NFT 的相关操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在 Particle 钱包中查看 NFT 详情或使用相关操作。

en.description: From the Particle Network wallet's NFT screen, users open this page to choose whether suspicious NFTs are hidden from the displayed collection.
en.disableEffect: Blocking it prevents users from changing the suspicious-NFT display setting.

zh-CN.description: 用户可从 Particle Network 钱包的 NFT 页面打开此页，设置是否隐藏列表中的可疑 NFT。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，用户将无法更改可疑 NFT 的显示设置。

en.description: From an EVM-compatible NFT's detail page, this Particle Network wallet screen opens the send form for transferring that NFT to another address.
en.disableEffect: Blocking it prevents users from sending NFTs on EVM-compatible networks through this flow.

zh-CN.description: 用户从 EVM 兼容网络的 NFT 详情页发起转出时，Particle Network 钱包会打开此发送表单，将该 NFT 转给其他地址。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，用户将无法通过此流程发送 EVM 兼容网络上的 NFT。

en.description: From a Solana NFT's detail page, this Particle Network wallet screen opens the send form for transferring that NFT to another address.
en.disableEffect: Blocking it prevents users from sending Solana NFTs through this flow.

zh-CN.description: 用户从 Solana NFT 详情页发起转出时，Particle Network 钱包会打开此发送表单，将该 NFT 转给其他地址。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，用户将无法通过此流程发送 Solana NFT。

en.description: Particle Network Wallet opens this Activity when a user scans a wallet address or connection code; it can scan with the camera or read a QR code from an image. It returns scanned addresses to the caller and can start a WalletConnect connection.
en.disableEffect: Scanning wallet addresses and connecting to wallets through QR codes will stop working.

zh-CN.description: 用户扫描钱包地址或连接码时，Particle Network 钱包会打开此 Activity；它可以使用相机扫描，也可以读取图片中的二维码。它会将扫描到的地址返回给调用方，也可以发起 WalletConnect 连接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 二维码扫描钱包地址和连接钱包的功能将无法使用。

en.description: When users choose to receive assets in the Particle Network wallet, this screen displays the selected wallet's receiving details, including its address or QR code.
en.disableEffect: Blocking it prevents users from opening the wallet's receive details through this flow.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Particle Network 钱包中选择收款时，此页面会显示所选钱包的收款信息，包括地址或二维码。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，用户将无法通过此流程查看钱包收款信息。

en.description: When a user opens the send flow in Particle Network Wallet, this Activity shows a transfer form for the active blockchain. The flow accepts a recipient and amount, supports choosing a token or scanning an address, and submits the transfer.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to send coins or tokens through the Particle wallet.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Particle Network 钱包中发起转账时，此 Activity 会显示当前区块链对应的转账表单。用户可以填写收款地址和金额、选择代币或扫描地址，并提交转账。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 Particle 钱包发送代币或加密货币。

en.description: From the Particle Network wallet, this screen opens wallet settings and links to wallet management, address book, connected sites, currency, language, appearance, and account-security options.
en.disableEffect: Blocking it removes the wallet's settings entry point and prevents users from reaching the settings pages listed there.

zh-CN.description: 用户可从 Particle Network 钱包打开此设置页，进入钱包管理、地址簿、已连接网站、货币、语言、外观和账户安全选项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后将失去钱包设置入口，用户也无法从此处进入所列设置页面。

en.description: When users open the Particle Network wallet's address book, this screen shows saved addresses and wallet accounts in separate sections for browsing or selection.
en.disableEffect: Blocking it prevents users from viewing or choosing saved addresses and wallets through the address book.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 Particle Network 钱包地址簿时，此页面会分区显示已保存的地址和钱包账户，供用户查看或选择。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，用户将无法通过地址簿查看或选择已保存的地址和钱包。

en.description: When users add or edit an address-book entry in Particle Network Wallet Service, this screen lets them enter its name and address and save or delete it.
en.disableEffect: Blocking it prevents users from adding, editing, or deleting saved address-book entries through this screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Particle Network Wallet Service 中添加或编辑地址簿条目时，此页面可供填写名称和地址，并保存或删除条目。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，用户将无法通过此页面添加、编辑或删除已保存的地址簿条目。

en.description: From wallet settings, this Particle Network screen lets users choose system, light, or dark appearance for the wallet.
en.disableEffect: Blocking it prevents users from changing the wallet's appearance preference.

zh-CN.description: 用户可从钱包设置打开此 Particle Network 页面，为钱包选择跟随系统、浅色或深色外观。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，用户将无法更改钱包的外观偏好。

en.description: From wallet settings or a connection-management entry, users open this Particle Network screen to review sites connected to the wallet and manage those connections.
en.disableEffect: Blocking it prevents users from reviewing or managing connected-site access through this screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户可从钱包设置或连接管理入口打开此 Particle Network 页面，查看已连接钱包的网站并管理这些连接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，用户将无法通过此页面查看或管理已连接网站的访问权限。

en.description: From Particle Network wallet settings, this screen lets users choose the currency used to display wallet values.
en.disableEffect: Blocking it prevents users from changing the wallet's display-currency preference.

zh-CN.description: 用户可从 Particle Network 钱包设置打开此页面，选择用于显示钱包资产价值的货币。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，用户将无法更改钱包的显示货币偏好。

en.description: From Particle Network wallet settings, this screen lets users enable account-abstraction mode and choose among the available smart-account providers.
en.disableEffect: Blocking it prevents users from changing account-abstraction settings, which can affect smart-account transactions.

zh-CN.description: 用户可从 Particle Network 钱包设置打开此页面，启用账户抽象模式并选择可用的智能账户服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，用户将无法更改账户抽象设置，智能账户交易也可能受到影响。

en.description: From wallet settings, this Particle Network screen lets users choose the language used by the wallet interface.
en.disableEffect: Blocking it prevents users from changing the wallet's language preference.

zh-CN.description: 用户可从钱包设置打开此 Particle Network 页面，选择钱包界面使用的语言。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，用户将无法更改钱包的语言偏好。

en.description: From Particle Network wallet settings or a wallet-connection flow, this screen lets users view, select, add, or manage available wallet accounts and providers.
en.disableEffect: Blocking it prevents users from managing wallet accounts and can interrupt flows that require selecting or adding a wallet.

zh-CN.description: 用户可从 Particle Network 钱包设置或钱包连接流程打开此页面，查看、选择、添加或管理可用的钱包账户和服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，用户将无法管理钱包账户，也可能无法完成需要选择或添加钱包的流程。

en.description: When users import a wallet into Particle Network Wallet Service, this screen accepts a private key or recovery phrase and imports it for the selected network.
en.disableEffect: Blocking it prevents users from importing a wallet through private-key or recovery-phrase entry.

zh-CN.description: 用户向 Particle Network Wallet Service 导入钱包时，此页面可接收私钥或助记词，并为所选网络导入钱包。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，用户将无法通过输入私钥或助记词导入钱包。

en.description: During private-key wallet import, Particle Network Wallet Service opens this screen so users can choose the EVM or Solana network family for the import.
en.disableEffect: Blocking it prevents users from choosing the network family in imports that request this selection.

zh-CN.description: 通过私钥导入钱包时，Particle Network Wallet Service 会显示此页面，供用户选择 EVM 或 Solana 网络类型。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，需要选择网络类型的导入流程将无法继续。

en.description: When users open token swap in Particle Network Wallet Service, this screen lets them choose tokens and an amount, review quotes and price impact, and submit a swap.
en.disableEffect: Blocking it prevents users from swapping tokens through the wallet's swap feature.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 Particle Network Wallet Service 的代币兑换功能时，此页面可供选择代币和数量、查看报价与价格影响并提交兑换。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，用户将无法通过钱包的兑换功能交换代币。

en.description: When a user chooses an asset for a Particle wallet transfer, this Activity lists and filters available tokens, then returns the selected token to the send screen.
en.disableEffect: The wallet's token-selection step for transfers will not work.

zh-CN.description: 用户为 Particle 钱包转账选择资产时，此 Activity 会列出并筛选可用代币，然后将所选代币返回转账页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 钱包转账时将无法完成代币选择。

en.description: When a user opens a token in Particle Network Wallet, this Activity shows its balance and transaction history and provides send and receive actions. It loads the page for the active blockchain.
en.disableEffect: Users will lose the token detail page, its transaction history, and its related send or receive actions.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Particle Network 钱包中打开代币时，此 Activity 会显示代币余额和交易记录，并提供发送和接收操作。它会加载当前区块链对应的页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开代币详情、查看交易记录或使用相关的发送和接收操作。

en.description: Particle Network Wallet opens this Activity when a user selects a transaction. It displays that transaction's details and can open the blockchain explorer page for its record.
en.disableEffect: Users will lose the transaction detail screen and its link to the blockchain explorer.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Particle Network 钱包中选择一笔交易时，此 Activity 会显示交易详情，并可打开区块链浏览器中的对应记录。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法查看交易详情或从此页面打开区块链浏览器记录。

en.description: When users select a transaction from an EVM-compatible wallet's activity list, this Particle Network screen displays its details and available transaction actions.
en.disableEffect: Blocking it prevents users from reviewing EVM transaction details or using actions offered on that detail screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户从 EVM 兼容钱包的活动记录中选择一笔交易时，此 Particle Network 页面会显示交易详情及可用操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，用户将无法查看 EVM 交易详情或使用详情页提供的操作。

en.description: When users select a transaction from a Solana wallet's activity list, this Particle Network screen displays its details and transaction reference.
en.disableEffect: Blocking it prevents users from reviewing individual Solana transaction details through the wallet.

zh-CN.description: 用户从 Solana 钱包的活动记录中选择一笔交易时，此 Particle Network 页面会显示交易详情和交易标识。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，用户将无法通过钱包查看单笔 Solana 交易详情。

en.description: Particle Network Wallet uses this screen to browse and search tokens, add a custom token, and manage hidden or suspicious tokens.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to search for or manage tokens from this wallet screen.

zh-CN.description: Particle Network 钱包使用此页面浏览和搜索代币、添加自定义代币，以及管理隐藏或可疑代币。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在此钱包页面搜索或管理代币。

en.description: From Particle Network wallet token management, users open this screen to view tokens hidden from the main list and manage their visibility.
en.disableEffect: Blocking it prevents users from reviewing or restoring hidden tokens through this screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户可从 Particle Network 钱包代币管理中打开此页面，查看主列表中隐藏的代币并管理其显示状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，用户将无法通过此页面查看或恢复隐藏的代币。

en.description: Particle Network Wallet opens this Activity for its wallet home screen and handles incoming WalletConnect links while it is open.
en.disableEffect: The embedded wallet home screen and incoming WalletConnect links will no longer open here.

zh-CN.description: Particle Network 钱包通过此 Activity 显示钱包主页，并在页面打开时处理收到的 WalletConnect 链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 内嵌钱包主页和收到的 WalletConnect 链接将无法在此打开。

en.description: When a site requests a WalletConnect session with a Particle Network wallet, this screen presents the connection request so the user can approve or reject it.
en.disableEffect: Blocking it prevents users from reviewing and responding to WalletConnect connection requests.

zh-CN.description: 网站请求与 Particle Network 钱包建立 WalletConnect 会话时，此页面会展示连接请求，供用户批准或拒绝。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，用户将无法查看或处理 WalletConnect 连接请求。

en.description: When a location check finds that device settings need attention, RxLocation opens Google Play services' resolution prompt so the user can turn on the required setting. It returns the user's choice to the waiting location request.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot show the location-settings prompt through RxLocation, so location requests that require it can fail.

zh-CN.description: 位置检查发现设备设置不符合要求时，RxLocation 会打开 Google Play 服务的解决提示，让用户启用所需设置，并把用户的选择返回给等待中的位置请求。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用无法通过 RxLocation 显示位置设置提示，需要该提示的位置请求可能失败。

en.description: When a legacy PAXSTORE client sends terminal parameters, the PAXSTORE Android SDK waits briefly, then starts the app's follow-up handler for those parameters.
en.disableEffect: Apps that rely on this SDK path may not process terminal parameters sent by older PAXSTORE clients.

zh-CN.description: 旧版 PAXSTORE 客户端发送终端参数后，PAXSTORE Android SDK 会短暂等待，再启动应用中处理这些参数的后续程序。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此 SDK 流程的应用可能无法处理旧版 PAXSTORE 客户端发送的终端参数。

en.description: This PAXSTORE Android SDK receiver handles parameter-download requests from older PAXSTORE clients and starts the delayed parameter handler when needed.
en.disableEffect: Older PAXSTORE clients will not be able to deliver parameter requests through this receiver.

zh-CN.description: 此 PAXSTORE Android SDK 接收器处理旧版 PAXSTORE 客户端发来的参数下载请求，并在需要时启动延迟处理程序。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 旧版 PAXSTORE 客户端将无法通过此接收器向应用发送参数请求。

en.description: When PAXSTORE requests terminal-parameter handling, this service checks that a terminal serial number was provided and starts the SDK's follow-up handler.
en.disableEffect: The app may miss terminal setup requests delivered through PAXSTORE.

zh-CN.description: PAXSTORE 请求处理终端参数时，此服务会检查是否提供终端序列号，然后启动 SDK 的后续处理程序。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用可能无法处理通过 PAXSTORE 发送的终端设置请求。

en.description: When PAXSTORE asks whether an app update can proceed, this service returns the app's readiness status and, when configured, a short-lived authorization token.
en.disableEffect: PAXSTORE cannot receive the app's update-readiness response, which may interrupt managed updates.

zh-CN.description: PAXSTORE 查询应用能否更新时，此服务会返回应用就绪状态，并在已配置时提供短时有效的授权令牌。
zh-CN.disableEffect: PAXSTORE 无法收到应用更新就绪状态，可能影响托管更新流程。

en.description: When the PAXSTORE client sends an accessory profile, task, or refresh request, this SDK extension forwards it to the app's accessory handler.
en.disableEffect: The app will not receive accessory updates and tasks sent through PAXSTORE.

zh-CN.description: PAXSTORE 客户端发送配件配置、任务或刷新请求时，此 SDK 扩展会将请求转交给应用中的配件处理程序。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法收到通过 PAXSTORE 发送的配件更新和任务。

en.description: During terminal activation, this PAXSTORE SDK extension sends the terminal ID to the PAXSTORE client and returns the activation result to the app.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot complete this PAXSTORE terminal-activation flow.

zh-CN.description: 终端激活期间，此 PAXSTORE SDK 扩展会将终端 ID 发送给 PAXSTORE 客户端，并把激活结果返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法完成此 PAXSTORE 终端激活流程。

en.description: When PAXSTORE requests device-log collection, this SDK extension passes the requested date range to the app's log handler.
en.disableEffect: PAXSTORE support can no longer request log collection through this SDK service.

zh-CN.description: PAXSTORE 请求收集设备日志时，此 SDK 扩展会将指定日期范围转交给应用中的日志处理程序。
zh-CN.disableEffect: PAXSTORE 支持人员将无法通过此 SDK 服务请求收集日志。

en.description: When the PAXSTORE client delivers a cloud message, PAXSTORE's cloud-messaging SDK decrypts it, shows enabled notifications, and passes notification or data content to the app.
en.disableEffect: PAXSTORE cloud notifications and messages will no longer reach the app.

zh-CN.description: PAXSTORE 客户端送达云消息时，PAXSTORE 云消息 SDK 会解密消息、按设置显示通知，并把通知或数据内容传给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将不再收到 PAXSTORE 云通知和消息。

en.description: PAX Stackly starts this background service to watch for native crashes and pass detected crashes into its crash-reporting system.
en.disableEffect: PAX Stackly may miss native crashes that this watcher would report.

zh-CN.description: PAX Stackly 会启动此后台服务来监视原生崩溃，并将检测到的崩溃交给崩溃报告系统。
zh-CN.disableEffect: PAX Stackly 可能无法发现此监测程序原本会报告的原生崩溃。

en.description: PAX Stackly uses this job to schedule or cancel timed background actions requested by its reporting and analysis routines.
en.disableEffect: Some scheduled PAX Stackly collection or reporting tasks may not run at the requested time.

zh-CN.description: PAX Stackly 的报告和分析流程需要安排定时后台任务时，此作业会为任务设置或取消定时提醒。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 部分 PAX Stackly 定时采集或报告任务可能无法按时运行。

en.description: On older Android versions, PAX Stackly uses this service to register or cancel the alarm that triggers timed background work.
en.disableEffect: Some scheduled PAX Stackly collection or reporting tasks may not run at the requested time.

zh-CN.description: 在较旧的 Android 版本上，当 PAX Stackly 安排定时后台任务时，此服务会设置或取消触发任务的提醒。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 部分 PAX Stackly 定时采集或报告任务可能无法按时运行。

en.description: When PAX Stackly's event signal arrives, this receiver queues saved app events for background processing.
en.disableEffect: PAX Stackly event records may no longer be processed and sent.

zh-CN.description: 收到 PAX Stackly 事件信号时，此接收器会将已保存的应用事件加入后台处理队列。
zh-CN.disableEffect: PAX Stackly 可能不再处理和发送已记录的事件。

en.description: PAX Stackly's event uploader uses this service to set or cancel a daily reminder that triggers app-event processing.
en.disableEffect: PAX Stackly's recurring event processing may stop.

zh-CN.description: PAX Stackly 的事件上传程序会通过此服务设置或取消每日提醒，以触发应用事件处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: PAX Stackly 的定期事件处理可能停止。

en.description: When Android runs queued PAX Stackly event work, this job passes the work to the SDK's event processor for reporting.
en.disableEffect: Recorded PAX Stackly events may remain unsent on Android versions that use this job.

zh-CN.description: Android 执行已排队的 PAX Stackly 事件任务时，此作业会将任务交给 SDK 的事件处理程序进行报告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 在使用此作业的 Android 版本上，已记录的 PAX Stackly 事件可能无法发送。

en.description: This background service passes PAX Stackly event work to its analytics processor, which handles saved app events and their alias.
en.disableEffect: PAX Stackly event records may remain unprocessed and unsent.

zh-CN.description: 此后台服务会将 PAX Stackly 事件任务交给分析处理程序，以处理已保存的应用事件及其别名。
zh-CN.disableEffect: PAX Stackly 记录的事件可能无法处理和发送。

en.description: When PAX Stackly starts native-crash monitoring, this service starts the watcher and uses a quiet notification on newer Android versions to keep it running in the background.
en.disableEffect: PAX Stackly may be unable to start its background native-crash watcher.

zh-CN.description: PAX Stackly 启动原生崩溃监测时，此服务会启动监测程序，并在较新的 Android 版本上使用低干扰通知来维持后台运行。
zh-CN.disableEffect: PAX Stackly 可能无法启动后台原生崩溃监测程序。

en.description: After PAX Stackly starts native-crash monitoring, this background service watches for native crashes and passes detected crashes into PAX Stackly's reporting system.
en.disableEffect: PAX Stackly may miss native crashes that this watcher would report.

zh-CN.description: PAX Stackly 启动原生崩溃监测后，此后台服务会监视原生崩溃，并将检测到的问题交给 PAX Stackly 的报告系统。
zh-CN.disableEffect: PAX Stackly 可能无法发现此监测程序原本会报告的原生崩溃。

en.description: When PAX Stackly schedules a saved crash report, this job passes it to the SDK's report sender for delivery.
en.disableEffect: Saved PAX Stackly crash reports may not be sent.

zh-CN.description: PAX Stackly 安排发送已保存的崩溃报告时，此作业会将报告交给 SDK 的发送程序。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 已保存的 PAX Stackly 崩溃报告可能无法发送。

en.description: When PAX Stackly processes a saved crash report in the background, this service hands it to the configured report destination.
en.disableEffect: Saved PAX Stackly crash reports may not be sent.

zh-CN.description: PAX Stackly 在后台处理已保存的崩溃报告时，此服务会将报告交给配置的接收方。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 已保存的 PAX Stackly 崩溃报告可能无法发送。

en.description: When crash-report settings request user input, this Activity lets the user review a report, add a comment or email address, and choose to send or cancel it.
en.disableEffect: Users may no longer be able to review or submit a crash report through PAX Stackly's prompt.

zh-CN.description: 崩溃报告设置需要用户输入时，此 Activity 会显示报告，让用户添加意见或邮箱，并选择发送或取消。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户可能无法通过 PAX Stackly 提示查看或提交崩溃报告。

en.description: When PAX Stackly's crash-report server advertises a newer profile, this service fetches and saves the updated exception-reporting settings.
en.disableEffect: PAX Stackly may keep using outdated crash-report settings.

zh-CN.description: PAX Stackly 的崩溃报告服务器提供了更新版本的配置时，此服务会获取并保存最新的异常报告设置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: PAX Stackly 可能继续使用过期的崩溃报告设置。

en.description: When PAX Stackly starts native-crash monitoring, this service starts the watcher and uses a quiet notification on newer Android versions to keep it running in the background.
en.disableEffect: PAX Stackly may be unable to start its background native-crash watcher.

zh-CN.description: PAX Stackly 启动原生崩溃监测时，此服务会启动监测程序，并在较新的 Android 版本上使用低干扰通知来维持后台运行。
zh-CN.disableEffect: PAX Stackly 可能无法启动后台原生崩溃监测程序。

en.description: After PAX Stackly starts native-crash monitoring, this background service watches for native crashes and passes detected crashes into PAX Stackly's reporting system.
en.disableEffect: PAX Stackly may miss native crashes that this watcher would report.

zh-CN.description: PAX Stackly 启动原生崩溃监测后，此后台服务会监视原生崩溃，并将检测到的问题交给 PAX Stackly 的报告系统。
zh-CN.disableEffect: PAX Stackly 可能无法发现此监测程序原本会报告的原生崩溃。

en.description: When the PAX Stackly user-analysis signal arrives, this receiver starts app-use reporting and schedules the next daily collection.
en.disableEffect: PAX Stackly will no longer collect app-use reports from this scheduled trigger.

zh-CN.description: 收到 PAX Stackly 用户分析信号时，此接收器会启动应用使用情况报告，并安排下一次每日采集。
zh-CN.disableEffect: PAX Stackly 将不再通过此定时触发器收集应用使用情况报告。

en.description: During PAX Stackly startup reporting, this service sends the device model, Android version, and saved app alias to the PAX Stackly service.
en.disableEffect: PAX Stackly will stop receiving these device details for quality reporting.

zh-CN.description: 在 PAX Stackly 的启动信息收集流程中，此服务会把设备型号、Android 版本和保存的应用别名发送给 PAX Stackly 服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: PAX Stackly 将无法收到用于质量报告的这些设备信息。

en.description: When PAX Stackly records an app launch, this service batches the launch details with earlier unsent records and uploads them.
en.disableEffect: PAX Stackly will no longer receive these app-start reports.

zh-CN.description: PAX Stackly 记录应用启动时，此服务会将启动信息与先前未发送的记录合并并上传。
zh-CN.disableEffect: PAX Stackly 将不再收到这些应用启动报告。

en.description: After PAX Stackly's app-use collection runs, this service sets or cancels a daily alarm that triggers the next collection.
en.disableEffect: Recurring PAX Stackly app-use collection may stop.

zh-CN.description: PAX Stackly 完成应用使用情况采集后，此服务会设置或取消每日提醒，以触发下一次采集。
zh-CN.disableEffect: PAX Stackly 的定期应用使用情况采集可能停止。

en.description: When Android runs queued PAX Stackly app-use work, this job updates saved usage totals and uploads the resulting summary.
en.disableEffect: PAX Stackly app-use summaries may remain unsent.

zh-CN.description: Android 执行排队的 PAX Stackly 应用使用情况任务时，此作业会更新已保存的使用总量并上传汇总。
zh-CN.disableEffect: PAX Stackly 的应用使用情况汇总可能无法发送。

en.description: When PAX Stackly receives its app-use signal, this service records app launches and time in use, then uploads the saved totals.
en.disableEffect: PAX Stackly will stop collecting or sending these app-use reports.

zh-CN.description: 收到 PAX Stackly 的应用使用情况信号时，此服务会记录应用启动次数和使用时长，并上传已保存的汇总。
zh-CN.disableEffect: PAX Stackly 将停止收集或发送这些应用使用情况报告。

en.description: PAX Stackly starts this background service to watch for native crashes and pass detected crashes into its crash-reporting system.
en.disableEffect: PAX Stackly may miss native crashes that this watcher would report.

zh-CN.description: PAX Stackly 会启动此后台服务来监视原生崩溃，并将检测到的崩溃交给崩溃报告系统。
zh-CN.disableEffect: PAX Stackly 可能无法发现此监测程序原本会报告的原生崩溃。

en.description: When the PAX Stackly event broadcast arrives, this receiver starts background processing for the app's saved analytics events.
en.disableEffect: Recorded PAX Stackly events may no longer be processed and sent.

zh-CN.description: 收到 PAX Stackly 事件广播时，此接收器会启动后台分析流程来处理已保存的应用事件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 已记录的 PAX Stackly 事件可能无法继续处理和发送。

en.description: This PAX Stackly service sets or cancels the daily timer that triggers the event receiver and starts analytics processing.
en.disableEffect: Daily PAX Stackly event processing may stop.

zh-CN.description: 此 PAX Stackly 服务会设置或取消每日定时任务，用于触发事件接收器并启动分析处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: PAX Stackly 的每日事件处理可能停止。

en.description: When PAX Stackly receives event work, this background service initializes event tracking or passes saved event records and the app alias to its analytics processor.
en.disableEffect: PAX Stackly event records may remain unprocessed and unsent.

zh-CN.description: PAX Stackly 收到事件任务时，此后台服务会初始化事件跟踪，或将已保存的事件记录和应用别名交给分析处理程序。
zh-CN.disableEffect: PAX Stackly 事件记录可能无法处理和发送。

en.description: The Payabbhi Android SDK opens this screen when an app starts checkout, showing the payment form and handling returns from UPI apps.
en.disableEffect: Payabbhi checkout cannot complete or return its success or cancellation result through the app.

zh-CN.description: 应用发起结账时，Payabbhi Android SDK 会打开此页面显示付款表单，并处理从 UPI 应用返回的结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用无法通过 Payabbhi 完成结账，也无法收到成功或取消结果。

en.description: The Clip (PayClip) Payment UI SDK opens this screen when a merchant needs to sign in, providing email and password fields and checking the account session.
en.disableEffect: The SDK cannot establish a merchant session for Clip account features.

zh-CN.description: 商户需要登录时，Clip（PayClip）Payment UI SDK 会打开此页面，让商户输入邮箱和密码并验证账户会话。
zh-CN.disableEffect: SDK 无法为 Clip 账户功能建立商户登录会话。

en.description: The Clip (PayClip) Payment UI SDK opens this screen when an app starts a card payment, showing the payment flow for the amount and details supplied by the merchant.
en.disableEffect: Card payments that use the Clip Payment UI cannot proceed.

zh-CN.description: 应用发起刷卡付款时，Clip（PayClip）Payment UI SDK 会打开此页面，并按商户提供的金额和交易信息显示付款流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用 Clip Payment UI 的刷卡付款无法继续。

en.description: When an app starts a Clip (PayClip) remote payment, this screen guides the merchant through preparing a request for the supplied amount and sharing it with the customer.
en.disableEffect: Clip remote payment requests cannot be created or shared.

zh-CN.description: 应用发起 Clip（PayClip）远程付款时，此页面会引导商户按指定金额创建付款请求并分享给顾客。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Clip 远程付款请求无法创建或分享。

en.description: The Clip (PayClip) Payment UI SDK uses this screen to sign in or out, connect a reader, and show the reader status and battery.
en.disableEffect: The merchant cannot connect or manage the Clip reader through the SDK settings flow.

zh-CN.description: Clip（PayClip）Payment UI SDK 使用此页面登录或退出账户、连接读卡器，并显示读卡器状态和电量。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 商户无法通过 SDK 设置流程连接或管理 Clip 读卡器。

en.description: The Clip (PayClip) in-person payment SDK opens this screen when a merchant views transaction history; it displays past transactions and can include refund controls.
en.disableEffect: The merchant cannot open Clip transaction history or use refund controls shown there.

zh-CN.description: 商户查看交易记录时，Clip（PayClip）线下支付 SDK 会打开此页面显示历史交易，并可按设置显示退款操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 商户将无法查看 Clip 交易记录或使用页面中的退款操作。

en.description: The Clip (PayClip) in-person payment SDK opens this screen for a card or remote payment started by the merchant, then keeps reader permissions and signature steps in the payment flow.
en.disableEffect: Payments that use this screen cannot run or return a result.

zh-CN.description: 商户发起刷卡或远程付款时，Clip（PayClip）线下支付 SDK 会打开此页面处理交易，并在付款流程中处理读卡器权限和签名步骤。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此页面的付款无法开始或返回交易结果。

en.description: The Clip (PayClip) in-person payment SDK opens this screen for merchant reader settings, including connecting a reader and the configured login or logout options.
en.disableEffect: The merchant cannot manage the Clip reader or its account from the SDK.

zh-CN.description: 商户管理读卡器设置时，Clip（PayClip）线下支付 SDK 会打开此页面，其中包括连接读卡器以及按配置显示登录或退出选项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 商户将无法通过此 SDK 管理 Clip 读卡器或账户。

en.description: During a Clip (PayClip) in-person payment that requests a signature, this screen shows the transaction amount and lets the customer sign, approve, or cancel.
en.disableEffect: A payment requiring a signature cannot finish through the Clip SDK.

zh-CN.description: Clip（PayClip）线下付款需要签名时，此页面会显示交易金额，并让顾客签名、确认或取消。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要签名的付款无法通过 Clip SDK 完成。

en.description: When a PayEase service page needs to attach a photo or file, Android uses this Provider to pass the file without making the app’s files public.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents PayEase service pages from attaching or handing off files when a service flow requires them.

zh-CN.description: PayEase 服务页面需要附加照片或文件时，Android 会通过此 Provider 传递文件，而不会公开应用的文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，PayEase 服务流程需要附加或传递文件时将无法完成。

en.description: When an app opens a PayEase add-on service, this Activity checks the service request, loads the service page in an in-app browser, and returns whether the user completed or cancelled it.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it makes PayEase add-on service flows unavailable and prevents their result from returning to the app.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开 PayEase 增值服务时，此 Activity 会校验服务请求，在应用内浏览器中加载服务页面，并返回用户已完成或取消的状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，PayEase 增值服务流程无法使用，处理结果也无法返回应用。

en.description: When a merchant starts a PayKun payment, the PayKun Android payment gateway SDK creates an order, displays the payment page, and handles UPI handoff and return.
en.disableEffect: PayKun orders cannot be paid or return a transaction result in the app.

zh-CN.description: 商户发起 PayKun 付款时，PayKun Android 支付网关 SDK 会创建订单、显示付款页面，并处理跳转到 UPI 应用及返回的过程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用无法支付 PayKun 订单或收到交易结果。

en.description: The Payline Android SDK opens this screen with the payment URL supplied by the app, displays the payment flow, and lets the user cancel or return when it ends.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot complete or cancel a Payline payment in the app.

zh-CN.description: Payline Android SDK 会使用应用提供的付款网址打开此页面，显示付款流程，并允许用户取消或在流程结束后返回。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法在应用中完成或取消 Payline 付款。

en.description: The Payline Android SDK opens this screen with the wallet URL supplied by the app, displaying the Payline wallet flow and a cancel control.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open or manage the Payline wallet in the app.

zh-CN.description: Payline Android SDK 会使用应用提供的钱包网址打开此页面，显示 Payline 钱包流程和取消按钮。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法在应用中打开或管理 Payline 钱包。

en.description: The PayMaya Android SDK starts checkout with the supplied payment details and client key, then shows PayMaya's checkout page and returns success, cancellation, or failure.
en.disableEffect: PayMaya checkout cannot run or return a payment result to the app.

zh-CN.description: PayMaya Android SDK 会使用指定的付款信息和客户端密钥发起结账，显示 PayMaya 付款页面，并返回成功、取消或失败结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: PayMaya 结账流程无法运行或向应用返回付款结果。

en.description: When a user chooses to scan a card in a PayTabs payment flow, PayTabs Card Recognizer opens this Activity to capture card details and return them to the payment screen.
en.disableEffect: The card-scan step cannot open, so a payment flow that requires it will not continue.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择在 PayTabs 付款流程中扫描银行卡时，PayTabs 卡片识别功能会打开这个 Activity 获取卡片信息并交回付款页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，银行卡扫描步骤无法打开，要求扫描的付款流程无法继续。

en.description: When an app starts a PayTabs payment, this Activity presents the supported payment screen and returns completion, cancellation, or error to the app.
en.disableEffect: PayTabs checkout cannot be launched or completed through this Activity.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动 PayTabs 付款时，这个 Activity 会显示受支持的付款页面，并把完成、取消或错误结果交回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，应用无法通过这个 Activity 启动或完成 PayTabs 结账。

en.description: When the app asks PayTabs to check a transaction, this Activity fetches its status and returns the result to the app.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot check PayTabs transaction status, which can prevent payment confirmation.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求 PayTabs 查询交易时，这个 Activity 会获取交易状态并把结果返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，应用无法查询 PayTabs 交易状态，可能无法确认付款结果。

en.description: When the user chooses to pay with a saved card, PayTabs opens this screen to show saved-card choices and return the selected payment result.
en.disableEffect: Saved-card payments cannot be selected or completed; another payment method is available only if the app offers one.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择使用已保存的银行卡付款时，PayTabs 会打开这个页面展示卡片选项，并返回所选付款的结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，用户无法选择或使用已保存的银行卡付款；只有应用提供其他方式时才能改用其他方式。

en.description: When checkout opens through the Ecommpay, TRX Host, or Jetpay mSDK payment UI, this Activity displays the session's payment options and checkout flow.
en.disableEffect: Checkout through the Ecommpay, TRX Host, or Jetpay mSDK payment UI cannot complete.

zh-CN.description: 宿主应用通过 Ecommpay、TRX Host 或 Jetpay 的 mSDK 支付界面打开结账会话时，这个 Activity 会显示支付选项和结账流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用无法通过 Ecommpay、TRX Host 或 Jetpay 的 mSDK 支付界面完成结账。

en.description: During checkout through the Ecommpay, TRX Host, or Jetpay mSDK payment UI, this Activity checks Google Pay availability, opens the wallet flow, and returns the payment token.
en.disableEffect: Google Pay checkout through these mSDKs will not work.

zh-CN.description: 通过 Ecommpay、TRX Host 或 Jetpay 的 mSDK 结账时，这个 Activity 会检查 Google Pay 是否可用、打开钱包流程并返回支付令牌。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，无法通过这些 mSDK 使用 Google Pay 结账。

en.description: When the host app starts an ECommPay Payment Page transaction, this Activity checks the payment details, loads available payment methods, and displays checkout.
en.disableEffect: Users may be unable to start or complete ECommPay card, bank, or wallet payments.

zh-CN.description: 宿主应用启动 ECommPay Payment Page 交易时，此 Activity 会检查支付信息、加载可用的支付方式并显示结账页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户可能无法发起或完成 ECommPay 银行卡、银行或电子钱包支付。

en.description: When a user opens a terms, privacy, or other linked page from ECommPay checkout, this Activity displays the supplied page in an in-app browser.
en.disableEffect: Those linked pages will not open, and tapping a checkout or policy link may fail.

zh-CN.description: 用户从 ECommPay 结账页面打开条款、隐私政策或其他链接时，此 Activity 会在应用内浏览器中显示该页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，这些链接页面将无法打开，点击结账或政策链接时可能失败。

en.description: During an ECommPay transaction that requires bank verification, this Activity runs the bank's 3-D Secure challenge and returns its result to checkout.
en.disableEffect: Payments that require 3-D Secure authentication cannot be completed.

zh-CN.description: ECommPay 交易需要银行验证时，此 Activity 会运行银行的 3-D Secure 验证页面并将结果返回结账流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，需要 3-D Secure 身份验证的支付将无法完成。

en.description: FasterPay opens this screen when the app starts a checkout. It loads the payment page inside the app and returns the user through the configured success link when checkout completes.
en.disableEffect: The FasterPay checkout and payment-return flow cannot run.

zh-CN.description: 应用发起结账时，FasterPay 会打开此页面，在应用内加载支付页面，并在结账完成后通过设定的成功链接返回。
zh-CN.disableEffect: FasterPay 结账和支付完成后的返回流程将无法使用。

en.description: When an app requests permission for future PayPal payments, the PayPal Android SDK opens this screen for the user to grant that access.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot obtain future-payment authorization through this PayPal flow.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求允许之后使用 PayPal 付款时，PayPal Android SDK 会打开这个页面，让用户决定是否授予该权限。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，应用无法通过这条 PayPal 流程取得未来付款授权。

en.description: During PayPal future-payment authorization, this screen shows the requested access details and lets the user go back before consenting.
en.disableEffect: The future-payment permission flow cannot show its details and may not complete.

zh-CN.description: 在 PayPal 未来付款授权流程中，这个页面会显示所请求的访问权限，并允许用户返回后再决定是否同意。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，未来付款授权流程无法显示权限详情，可能无法完成。

en.description: When a PayPal Android SDK flow requires sign-in, this Activity accepts PayPal account credentials and any required second-step verification, then returns the authorization result.
en.disableEffect: The user cannot sign in to PayPal through the app, stopping dependent payment or account-linking flows.

zh-CN.description: PayPal Android SDK 流程需要登录时，这个 Activity 会接收 PayPal 账户凭据和必要的二次验证信息，然后返回授权结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，用户无法在应用中登录 PayPal，依赖该登录的付款或账户关联流程会中断。

en.description: When an app requests authorization for future PayPal charges, this Activity starts the sign-in and consent steps and returns their authorization result.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot complete PayPal authorization for future payments.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求授权以便之后通过 PayPal 收款时，这个 Activity 会启动登录和同意步骤，并返回授权结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，应用无法完成 PayPal 未来付款授权。

en.description: When an app requests access to PayPal profile details, this Activity coordinates sign-in and consent for the requested details, then returns the authorization result.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot complete the requested PayPal profile-sharing flow.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求访问 PayPal 个人资料时，这个 Activity 会协调登录和权限确认，并返回授权结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，应用无法完成所请求的 PayPal 个人资料共享流程。

en.description: The PayPal Android SDK starts this background Service while the app initializes or runs a PayPal payment or authorization flow. It prepares the SDK session and handles requests used by those screens.
en.disableEffect: PayPal payment, sign-in, future-payment authorization, and profile-sharing flows that depend on this Service will fail.

zh-CN.description: 应用初始化 PayPal Android SDK 或执行付款、账户授权时，SDK 会启动这个后台 Service 来准备会话并处理相关请求。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，依赖此 Service 的 PayPal 付款、登录、未来付款授权和个人资料共享流程会失败。

en.description: PayPal Partner Android SDK opens the PayPal sign-in or approval step used during a PayPal payment and returns the authorization outcome.
en.disableEffect: PayPal sign-in or payment authorization will not be able to complete.

zh-CN.description: PayPal Partner Android SDK 在 PayPal 付款时打开登录或授权确认界面，并将授权结果返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: PayPal 登录或付款授权将无法完成。

en.description: When a host app starts a payment with the PayPal Android SDK, this Activity checks the payment setup and opens the payment-method screen. It returns the completed payment confirmation to the app.
en.disableEffect: Blocking it prevents the app from completing PayPal SDK payments.

zh-CN.description: 宿主应用通过 PayPal Android SDK 开始付款时，此 Activity 会检查付款设置并打开付款方式页面，随后将付款确认结果返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用将无法完成 PayPal SDK 付款。

en.description: After the user chooses a payment method, this PayPal Android SDK Activity shows the order confirmation and handles PayPal or card authorization. It returns the payment result to the checkout screen.
en.disableEffect: Blocking it prevents the user from confirming or completing a PayPal SDK payment.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择付款方式后，PayPal Android SDK 会打开此 Activity 显示订单确认并处理 PayPal 或银行卡授权，然后将付款结果返回结账页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法确认或完成 PayPal SDK 付款。

en.description: During PayPal checkout, this Activity shows the order amount and lets the user choose PayPal or a credit card; card entry can use the card scanner. It opens the confirmation step and returns the selected payment result.
en.disableEffect: Blocking it prevents the user from choosing a payment method in PayPal checkout.

zh-CN.description: PayPal 结账时，此 Activity 会显示订单金额并让用户选择 PayPal 或银行卡；输入银行卡信息时还可使用卡片扫描功能。之后它会打开确认页面并返回所选付款方式的结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法在 PayPal 结账流程中选择付款方式。

en.description: The PayPal Android SDK opens this screen when an app asks the user to share selected PayPal profile details. It records whether the user approves the requested access.
en.disableEffect: The user cannot grant the requested PayPal profile access, so that sharing flow will not finish.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求用户共享部分 PayPal 个人资料时，PayPal Android SDK 会打开这个页面，记录用户是否同意所请求的访问权限。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，用户无法授予所请求的 PayPal 个人资料访问权限，该共享流程无法完成。

en.description: When a PayPal Partner Auth checkout returns an authorization code, this screen exchanges it for a PayPal token and closes.
en.disableEffect: The authorization code cannot be exchanged for a token, so PayPal sign-in or checkout authorization fails.

zh-CN.description: PayPal Partner Auth 结账流程返回授权码时，此页面会将其兑换为 PayPal 令牌，然后关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 授权码无法兑换为令牌，因此 PayPal 登录或结账授权会失败。

en.description: During PayPal Partner Auth, this screen starts the browser sign-in flow, receives the redirect, checks its state, and sends the result or cancellation back to the app.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot finish PayPal authorization or receive its success or cancellation result.

zh-CN.description: PayPal Partner Auth 流程中，此页面会启动浏览器登录、接收重定向、检查状态，并将成功结果或取消结果返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用无法完成 PayPal 授权或收到成功、取消结果。

en.description: PayPal Native Checkout uses this exported Activity when PayPal sign-in returns through an app link. It passes the returned address to the authorization flow so checkout can resume.
en.disableEffect: PayPal sign-in cannot return to the app, so checkout or account authorization may fail.

zh-CN.description: PayPal Native Checkout 登录流程返回应用时，这个导出的 Activity 会接收返回链接，并把登录结果交回授权流程以继续结账。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，PayPal 登录结果无法返回应用，相关结账或账户授权流程可能无法完成。

en.description: The PayPal Here Retail SDK opens this Activity during card-reader setup or checkout. It shows reader scanning and connection screens, including Bluetooth and connection-error steps.
en.disableEffect: Card-reader scanning and connection through PayPal Here will not work, so in-person checkout with that reader can fail.

zh-CN.description: PayPal Here Retail SDK 会在设置读卡器或结账时打开此 Activity，显示读卡器扫描和连接页面，包括蓝牙及连接错误处理步骤。
zh-CN.disableEffect: PayPal Here 的读卡器扫描和连接将无法使用，依赖该读卡器的现场结账可能失败。

en.description: The PayPal Here Retail SDK opens this Activity to show reader and payment dialogs, including progress, choices, QR prompts, and error messages. It returns the user's selection to the SDK.
en.disableEffect: Payment confirmations, reader prompts, or error handling that use these dialogs will stop working.

zh-CN.description: PayPal Here Retail SDK 会通过此 Activity 显示读卡器和支付相关对话框，包括进度、选项、二维码提示和错误信息，并将用户选择交回 SDK。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖这些对话框的支付确认、读卡器提示或错误处理将无法正常工作。

en.description: After a PayPal Here payment, this Activity lets the user choose an email, text message, or no receipt, and can show extra receipt options supplied by the app.
en.disableEffect: The receipt choice screen will not open, so customers cannot select how to receive a receipt.

zh-CN.description: PayPal Here 支付完成后，此 Activity 可让用户选择通过电子邮件、短信接收收据，或不接收收据；页面也可显示应用提供的其他选项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 收据选项页面将无法打开，用户也无法选择收据接收方式。

en.description: When a customer chooses email or text for a PayPal Here receipt, this Activity collects and validates the address or phone number, then submits it to the SDK.
en.disableEffect: Customers will not be able to enter or submit an email address or phone number for a receipt.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择通过电子邮件或短信接收 PayPal Here 收据后，此 Activity 会收集并校验邮箱或电话号码，再提交给 SDK。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法填写并提交用于接收收据的邮箱或电话号码。

en.description: PayPal Here opens this screen when an in-person transaction requires the customer’s signature. The customer can sign, clear the signature, submit it, or cancel the transaction.
en.disableEffect: An in-person transaction that requires a signature cannot be confirmed if this screen is disabled.

zh-CN.description: PayPal Here 的线下交易要求用户签名时，这个页面会显示签名板。用户可以签名、清除签名、提交签名或取消交易。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，要求签名的线下交易无法确认。

en.description: After the app starts PayPal Native Checkout, this internal Activity shows the checkout page where the shopper reviews and completes the purchase.
en.disableEffect: The PayPal checkout screen cannot open, so purchases using this flow will fail.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动 PayPal Native Checkout 后，这个内部 Activity 会显示结账页面，供用户核对并完成付款。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，PayPal 结账页面无法打开，使用此流程的付款会失败。

en.description: PayPal Native Checkout opens this exported Activity when the app starts a checkout or returns from PayPal approval. It starts or restores checkout and returns its result to the app.
en.disableEffect: PayPal checkout cannot start or resume from its approval link.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动 PayPal Native Checkout，或用户从 PayPal 确认页面返回时，PayPal 会打开这个导出的 Activity 来开始或恢复结账，并把结果交回应用。
