zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，PayPal 结账无法启动，也无法从确认页面返回。

en.description: During PayPal Native Checkout, this Activity runs the extra 3-D Secure identity check requested for a card payment and sends the result back to checkout.
en.disableEffect: A payment that requires this bank authentication step cannot complete.

zh-CN.description: PayPal 结账中的银行卡付款需要额外身份验证时，PayPal 会打开这个 Activity 执行 3-D Secure 验证，并把结果交回结账流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，需要银行身份验证的付款无法完成。

en.description: After the app starts PayPal Native Checkout, this internal Activity shows the checkout page where the shopper reviews and completes the purchase.
en.disableEffect: The PayPal checkout screen cannot open, so purchases using this flow will fail.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动 PayPal Native Checkout 后，这个内部 Activity 会显示结账页面，供用户核对并完成付款。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，PayPal 结账页面无法打开，使用此流程的付款会失败。

en.description: PayPal Native Checkout opens this exported Activity when the app starts a checkout or returns from PayPal approval. It starts or restores checkout and returns its result to the app.
en.disableEffect: PayPal checkout cannot start or resume from its approval link.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动 PayPal Native Checkout，或用户从 PayPal 确认页面返回时，PayPal 会打开这个导出的 Activity 来开始或恢复结账，并把结果交回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，PayPal 结账无法启动，也无法从确认页面返回。

en.description: During PayPal Native Checkout, this Activity runs the extra 3-D Secure identity check requested for a card payment and sends the result back to checkout.
en.disableEffect: A payment that requires this bank authentication step cannot complete.

zh-CN.description: PayPal 结账中的银行卡付款需要额外身份验证时，PayPal 会打开这个 Activity 执行 3-D Secure 验证，并把结果交回结账流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，需要银行身份验证的付款无法完成。

en.description: When an app starts the Paystack payment sheet, this Activity presents payment choices and handles the payment until it returns a success, cancellation, or failure result.
en.disableEffect: The Paystack payment sheet cannot open, so payments using this SDK flow will not complete.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动 Paystack 付款面板时，这个 Activity 会显示付款方式并处理付款选择，再把成功、取消或失败结果返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，Paystack 付款面板无法打开，使用此 SDK 流程的付款无法完成。

en.description: The Paystack Android SDK opens this Activity to display its payment sheet and return the payment outcome to the app.
en.disableEffect: The Paystack payment sheet cannot open, so payments using this SDK flow will not complete.

zh-CN.description: Paystack Android SDK 会打开这个 Activity 显示付款面板，并把付款结果返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，Paystack 付款面板无法打开，使用此 SDK 流程的付款无法完成。

en.description: With the legacy PayTabs Android payment SDK, the app launches this Activity to validate merchant setup, collect card-payment details, and return the transaction result.
en.disableEffect: Payments using the legacy PayTabs checkout cannot be completed.

zh-CN.description: 使用旧版 PayTabs Android 付款 SDK 时，应用会启动这个 Activity 校验商户设置、收集银行卡付款信息并返回交易结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，旧版 PayTabs 结账无法完成付款。

en.description: After a legacy PayTabs payment is submitted, this Activity opens the secure bank-authentication page, verifies the transaction, and returns the result.
en.disableEffect: A legacy PayTabs payment that requires secure authentication cannot complete.

zh-CN.description: 提交旧版 PayTabs 付款后，如果需要银行安全验证，这个 Activity 会打开验证页面、核验交易并返回结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，需要安全验证的旧版 PayTabs 付款无法完成。

en.description: When a payment form invokes PayTabs Card Recognizer, this Activity opens the camera to scan a payment card and returns the recognized details or a cancellation or error.
en.disableEffect: Users lose automatic card scanning and must enter details manually if the app offers that option.

zh-CN.description: 付款页面调用 PayTabs 卡片识别功能时，这个 Activity 会打开相机扫描银行卡，并返回识别结果、取消或错误状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，用户无法自动扫描银行卡；只有应用提供手动输入时才能改为手动填写。

en.description: PayU's card scanner opens when a user chooses camera-based card entry during checkout. It uses the camera to read card text and returns the card details or a scan error to PayU.
en.disableEffect: Camera-based card entry will not work, so users cannot scan a card during checkout.

zh-CN.description: 用户在结账时选择用相机录入银行卡后，PayU 卡片扫描器会打开。它使用相机读取卡片文字，并把卡片信息或扫描错误返回 PayU。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，相机录入银行卡的功能将无法使用，用户不能在结账时扫描卡片。

en.description: PayU's Custom Browser opens when a payment needs the bank's authorization page. It shows that payment page and returns the user's result to the PayU checkout.
en.disableEffect: Payments that need this bank authorization screen cannot finish their confirmation step.

zh-CN.description: 付款需要银行授权页面时，PayU Custom Browser 会打开。它显示付款页面，并将用户的结果返回 PayU 结账流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，需要此银行授权页面的付款将无法完成确认。

en.description: PayU's Google Pay integration opens this Activity during a Google Pay transaction. It collects the payment app's result and checks the transaction status with PayU.
en.disableEffect: Google Pay payments through PayU cannot be completed or confirmed.

zh-CN.description: PayU 的 Google Pay 集成会在 Google Pay 交易期间打开此 Activity。它接收付款应用的结果，并向 PayU 核实交易状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，PayU 的 Google Pay 付款将无法完成或确认。

en.description: PayU's NFC reader opens when checkout requests a card tap. It reads supported card details from a nearby NFC card and returns them to the payment flow.
en.disableEffect: Card details cannot be read by tapping an NFC card.

zh-CN.description: 结账流程需要读取银行卡时，PayU NFC 读取器会打开。它从附近的 NFC 银行卡读取受支持的卡片信息，并将信息返回付款流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法通过轻触 NFC 银行卡读取卡片信息。

en.description: PayU's OTP-assist payment flow starts this foreground Service while a transaction is being checked. It schedules recurring status checks and shows a payment-processing notification until the check is stopped.
en.disableEffect: A pending OTP-assisted payment may not receive status updates or a final confirmation.

zh-CN.description: PayU OTP 辅助付款流程会在核实交易时启动此前台 Service。它定期检查交易状态，并显示付款处理中通知，直到检查停止。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，等待中的 OTP 辅助付款可能无法收到状态更新或最终确认。

en.description: PayU Native OTP Assist opens this Activity when a payment requires its OTP-assistance step. It displays the assistance screen and reports the outcome of payment verification.
en.disableEffect: The OTP-assisted authentication and its payment result may not complete.

zh-CN.description: 付款需要 PayU OTP 辅助验证时，PayU Native OTP Assist 会打开此 Activity。它显示辅助验证页面，并返回付款核实结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，OTP 辅助验证及其付款结果可能无法完成。

en.description: PayU opens this Activity when the user selects PhonePe for payment. It sends the transaction to the PhonePe app and verifies the returned payment status with PayU.
en.disableEffect: PhonePe payments through PayU cannot complete or return a verified result.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择 PhonePe 付款时，PayU 会打开此 Activity。它将交易交给 PhonePe 应用，并向 PayU 核实返回的付款状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，PayU 的 PhonePe 付款将无法完成或返回已核实的结果。

en.description: PayU opens this scanner when checkout requests a QR-code payment scan. It uses the camera to read the code and returns transaction details or a scanning error.
en.disableEffect: QR-code payment scanning will not work.

zh-CN.description: 结账流程需要扫描付款二维码时，PayU 会打开此扫描器。它使用相机读取二维码，并返回交易信息或扫描错误。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，二维码付款扫描将无法使用。

en.description: When a PayU card payment needs a fallback 3-D Secure challenge, this Activity displays the issuer's secure confirmation page and accepts the user's authentication response.
en.disableEffect: The issuer's fallback authentication cannot finish, so affected card payments may fail.

zh-CN.description: PayU 银行卡付款需要备用 3-D Secure 挑战时，此 Activity 会显示发卡行的安全确认页面并接收用户的验证结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，发卡行的备用验证无法完成，受影响的银行卡付款可能失败。

en.description: PayU Checkout Pro opens this Activity to display payment options for an order. It handles the checkout and reports whether the payment succeeded or was canceled.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot complete payments through PayU Checkout Pro.

zh-CN.description: PayU Checkout Pro 会打开此 Activity 为订单显示付款方式。它处理结账流程，并返回付款成功或取消的结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法通过 PayU Checkout Pro 完成付款。

en.description: PayU's UPI SDK opens this Activity while handing a payment to a UPI app or collecting the app's response. It checks the returned result and reports the transaction status.
en.disableEffect: UPI transactions through this PayU flow may not complete or be confirmed.

zh-CN.description: PayU UPI SDK 会在将付款交给 UPI 应用或接收其结果时打开此 Activity。它核实返回结果并报告交易状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，此 PayU 流程中的 UPI 交易可能无法完成或确认。

en.description: PBJ.live's Android live-streaming SDK opens this screen when the app starts an episode stream; it loads the selected episode and presents its player, with chat when enabled.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open the selected PBJ.live stream or its in-player chat.

zh-CN.description: PBJ.live 的 Android 直播 SDK 会在应用打开某个直播节目时显示此页面，加载所选节目并播放视频；启用聊天时也会显示聊天内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开所选的 PBJ.live 直播或使用播放器内的聊天功能。

en.description: When an app opens a PBJ.live episode, this Activity displays its live room and plays the supplied stream, with chat when enabled.
en.disableEffect: The PBJ.live room and its video playback cannot be opened.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开 PBJ.live 节目时，此页面会显示直播间并播放指定的视频流；启用聊天时也会提供聊天功能。
zh-CN.disableEffect: PBJ.live 直播间及其视频播放页面将无法打开。

en.description: PBJ.live's Android SDK opens this player when the app requests a show; it looks up whether that show is live and displays the available stream.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open the PBJ.live show player or watch a live stream through it.

zh-CN.description: PBJ.live 的 Android SDK 会在应用请求播放某个节目时打开此播放器，查询节目是否正在直播并显示可播放的视频流。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开 PBJ.live 节目播放器或通过它观看直播。

en.description: PBJ.live's Android SDK opens this player for a selected show and presents its live video, playback controls, and related product links.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open the PBJ.live player to watch the selected stream.

zh-CN.description: PBJ.live 的 Android SDK 会为所选节目打开此播放器，显示直播视频、播放控制和相关商品链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开 PBJ.live 播放器观看所选直播。

en.description: When the TVTechService beacon library sends a scan result or wake-up, this service passes the event to the app so it can react.
en.disableEffect: The app will stop receiving beacon scan and wake-up events from this SDK.

zh-CN.description: TVTechService 信标库收到扫描结果或唤醒事件时，此 Service 会将事件传递给应用以便处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用将不再收到此 SDK 传递的信标扫描和唤醒事件。

en.description: The TVTechService beacon service scans for nearby Bluetooth beacons in regions the app has set up and reports matches to the app.
en.disableEffect: Nearby-beacon detection and region events from this SDK will stop, which can break app features that rely on proximity.

zh-CN.description: TVTechService 信标 Service 会扫描应用设置区域内附近的蓝牙信标，并将匹配结果报告给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，此 SDK 将停止检测附近信标并报告区域事件，依赖邻近检测的应用功能可能无法正常工作。

en.description: When Android runs a scheduled TVTechService scan, this job checks for configured beacons in the background and processes the results.
en.disableEffect: Scheduled background beacon scans and their region events will no longer run.

zh-CN.description: Android 运行 TVTechService 的计划扫描时，此 Job 会在后台查找已配置的信标并处理扫描结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，计划的后台信标扫描及其区域事件将不再运行。

en.description: After boot or a power connection change, this receiver wakes the TVTechService beacon library when background monitoring is active and forwards passive scan results.
en.disableEffect: The SDK will no longer resume beacon monitoring after these broadcasts, so background proximity detection can stop after a restart or power event.

zh-CN.description: 设备启动或电源连接状态变化后，如果后台监测已启用，此 Receiver 会唤醒 TVTechService 信标库并转交被动扫描结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，SDK 不会再因这些广播恢复信标监测，设备重启或电源状态变化后后台邻近检测可能停止。

en.description: When the TVTechService library schedules a Bluetooth check, this job tests whether Bluetooth scanning and transmitting are working.
en.disableEffect: The SDK's scheduled Bluetooth self-tests will stop; its regular beacon monitoring uses separate services.

zh-CN.description: TVTechService 库安排蓝牙检查时，此 Job 会测试蓝牙扫描和发送是否正常。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，SDK 计划的蓝牙自检将停止；常规信标监测由其他 Service 负责。

en.description: When an app requests pCloud authorization, this Activity opens pCloud’s sign-in page in a browser tab or an in-app browser and returns the authorization result.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot sign in to or link a pCloud account.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求 pCloud 授权时，这个 Activity 会在浏览器标签页或应用内浏览器打开 pCloud 登录页面，并返回授权结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，应用无法登录或关联 pCloud 账户。

en.description: When the browser returns from pCloud sign-in, this exported Activity receives the return link and passes it to the waiting authorization screen.
en.disableEffect: pCloud browser sign-in cannot return its result, so login or account linking fails.

zh-CN.description: 浏览器完成 pCloud 登录并返回时，这个导出的 Activity 会接收返回链接，并交给等待中的授权页面处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，pCloud 浏览器登录结果无法返回，登录或账户关联会失败。

en.description: Apryse (PDFTron) PDF Tools initializes the PDF engine for the app at startup using the configured license; when no license is present, it attempts to request a trial key. This makes the library’s PDF viewing and editing tools ready to use.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it leaves Apryse’s PDF tools uninitialized, so documents that depend on them will not open or process correctly.

zh-CN.description: Apryse（PDFTron）PDF 工具库会在应用启动时读取已配置的授权并初始化 PDF 引擎；未配置授权时，它会尝试申请试用密钥。这样应用中的 PDF 查看和编辑工具才能使用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Apryse 的 PDF 工具无法完成初始化，依赖这些工具的文档将无法正常打开或处理。

en.description: Apryse (PDFTron) PDF SDK initializes its PDF engine when the app starts and reads the configured license key. Apps use this engine to open and process PDF files.
en.disableEffect: PDF viewing or processing features that depend on this engine will fail to initialize.

zh-CN.description: Apryse（PDFTron）PDF SDK 会在应用启动时读取已配置的授权密钥并初始化 PDF 引擎，供应用的 PDF 功能使用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，依赖此引擎的 PDF 查看或处理功能无法正常启动。

en.description: The DTEducation BookSDK opens this screen when a reader selects an exercise; it loads the selected book’s question pages and lets the user move between them.
en.disableEffect: Exercises cannot be opened in the DTEducation reader.

zh-CN.description: 读者选择练习时，DTEducation BookSDK 会打开此页面，加载所选电子书的题目页面并允许用户切换题目。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在 DTEducation 阅读器中打开练习。

en.description: The DTEducation BookSDK opens this Activity when a user enters a downloaded e-book; it shows the book’s sections and can launch its exercises and videos.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot enter the book’s main reader screen through this Activity.

zh-CN.description: 用户进入已下载的电子书时，DTEducation BookSDK 会打开此 Activity，显示书籍内容分区，并可进入练习或视频。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此 Activity 进入电子书主阅读页面。

en.description: When a user opens a downloaded HTML e-book, DTEducation BookSDK loads its local book files in a web screen and provides book navigation and playback controls.
en.disableEffect: HTML e-books that use this reader will not open.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开已下载的 HTML 电子书时，DTEducation BookSDK 会在网页界面中加载本地书籍文件，并提供书籍导航和播放控制。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此阅读器的 HTML 电子书将无法打开。

en.description: The DTEducation BookSDK’s bundled activity-tracking utility initializes at app startup, stores the application context, and tracks Activity lifecycles; its download storage reads that context.
en.disableEffect: The book-download storage that relies on this context may fail to initialize.

zh-CN.description: DTEducation BookSDK 内置的界面跟踪工具会在应用启动时保存应用上下文并记录 Activity 生命周期；其下载存储会读取该上下文。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此上下文的电子书下载存储可能无法初始化。

en.description: The RxPicker image-selection library opens this screen when an app asks the user to choose images; it requests photo access and shows the gallery picker.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot select images through RxPicker.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求用户选择图片时，RxPicker 图片选择库会打开此页面，申请图片访问权限并显示图库选择器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 RxPicker 选择图片。

en.description: RxPicker opens this screen to show selected images in a swipeable preview with a back button and image count.
en.disableEffect: The image preview screen will be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: RxPicker 会打开此页面，以可滑动的方式预览已选图片，并显示返回按钮和图片数量。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 图片预览页面将无法使用。

en.description: RxPicker’s FileProvider creates content links for image files when its picker or capture flow needs to pass them between the app and another app.
en.disableEffect: Image capture or file handoff flows that use this provider can fail.

zh-CN.description: RxPicker 的 FileProvider 会在图片选择或拍摄流程需要传递文件时，为图片生成内容链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此 Provider 的拍摄或文件传递流程可能失效。

en.description: AndroidUtilCode’s Messenger helper binds this Service when the app sends messages across its processes, and forwards those messages to registered listeners in connected processes.
en.disableEffect: Cross-process messages that rely on this helper will no longer be delivered.

zh-CN.description: 应用需要在多个进程间传递消息时，会绑定 AndroidUtilCode 的 Messenger 辅助 Service；它会将消息转发给已连接进程中的监听器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此辅助功能的跨进程消息将无法送达。

en.description: AndroidUtilCode’s FileProvider supplies content links for app files when the utility library needs to open or share them with another app.
en.disableEffect: File-opening or sharing flows that use this provider will fail.

zh-CN.description: AndroidUtilCode 的 FileProvider 会在工具库需要向其他应用打开或分享文件时，为应用文件提供内容链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此 Provider 的文件打开或分享流程将失效。

en.description: AndroidUtilCode starts this helper Activity when utility code needs a temporary Activity to request a permission or handle another system result, then returns that result to the caller.
en.disableEffect: Permission and activity-result flows that depend on this helper may fail.

zh-CN.description: AndroidUtilCode 的工具代码需要临时 Activity 申请权限或处理其他系统结果时，会启动此辅助页面并将结果交还给调用功能。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此辅助页面的权限申请或系统结果处理可能失效。

en.description: AndroidUtilCode uses this helper Activity when a utility operation needs a temporary Activity in the app’s main process to request a permission or receive a system result.
en.disableEffect: Permission or result flows that require this main-process helper may fail.

zh-CN.description: AndroidUtilCode 的工具操作需要在应用主进程中临时申请权限或接收系统结果时，会使用此辅助 Activity。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要此主进程辅助界面的权限申请或结果处理可能失效。

en.description: The DTEducation BookSDK binds this foreground Service when a user starts, resumes, or updates an e-book download; it fetches the book’s configuration and content files and reports progress.
en.disableEffect: New or updated e-books may not finish downloading, and paused downloads cannot resume through this service.

zh-CN.description: 用户开始、继续或更新电子书下载时，DTEducation BookSDK 会绑定此前台 Service；它获取书籍配置和内容文件并汇报进度。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 新书或更新内容可能无法下载完成，暂停的下载也无法通过此 Service 继续。

en.description: The DTEducation BookSDK binds this Service to download HTML e-book pages and their referenced resources when a new book is requested.
en.disableEffect: The affected HTML books and resources will not finish downloading.

zh-CN.description: 请求下载新的 HTML 电子书时，DTEducation BookSDK 会绑定此 Service，下载书页及其引用的资源文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 相关 HTML 电子书及资源将无法下载完成。

en.description: While a DTEducation book is open, the reader binds this Service to serve stored files over a local connection for the SDK’s video player.
en.disableEffect: Videos that use the local file stream may not play.

zh-CN.description: 打开 DTEducation 电子书期间，阅读器会绑定此 Service，通过本地连接向 SDK 视频播放器提供已存储的文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖本地文件传输的视频可能无法播放。

en.description: The DTEducation BookSDK opens this screen when a user selects a book video; it plays the selected clip, offers playback controls, and can list other videos from that book.
en.disableEffect: Book video clips cannot be played through this screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择书籍视频时，DTEducation BookSDK 会打开此页面播放视频，提供播放控制，并可显示本书的其他视频。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此页面播放书籍视频。

en.description: PersonaClick and REES46 use this Firebase messaging Service to receive push data and pass it to their personalization SDK for processing.
en.disableEffect: PersonaClick or REES46 push messages routed through this Service will no longer be processed.

zh-CN.description: PersonaClick 和 REES46 通过这个 Firebase 消息 Service 接收推送数据，并交给各自的个性化 SDK 处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，经由此 Service 传递的 PersonaClick 或 REES46 推送消息将不再处理。

en.description: When PersonaClick or REES46 needs to show an image-rich push notification, this Service loads the notification images and creates the notification.
en.disableEffect: Image-rich campaign notifications that use this Service will not display correctly.

zh-CN.description: PersonaClick 或 REES46 需要显示带图片的推送通知时，这个 Service 会加载通知图片并创建通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，依赖此 Service 的图片推送通知无法正常显示。

en.description: When PersonaClick or REES46 needs to show an image-rich push notification, this Service loads the notification images and creates the notification.
en.disableEffect: Image-rich campaign notifications that use this Service will not display correctly.

zh-CN.description: PersonaClick 或 REES46 需要显示带图片的推送通知时，这个 Service 会加载通知图片并创建通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，依赖此 Service 的图片推送通知无法正常显示。

en.description: When a user taps the previous or next image control in a PersonaClick or REES46 carousel notification, this Receiver schedules an update to the displayed image.
en.disableEffect: The carousel notification’s previous and next controls stop changing the displayed image.

zh-CN.description: 用户点按 PersonaClick 或 REES46 图片轮播通知中的上一张或下一张时，这个 Receiver 会安排更新通知显示的图片。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，轮播通知的上一张和下一张控件无法切换图片。

en.description: When an app requests VK sign-in, this Activity opens VK’s authorization page and returns the result to the app after the user completes or cancels the flow.
en.disableEffect: VK sign-in cannot finish, so app features that require a VK account will be affected.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求 VK 登录时，这个 Activity 会打开 VK 授权页面，并在用户完成或取消流程后把结果返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，VK 登录无法完成，依赖 VK 账户的应用功能会受影响。

en.description: FloatingX starts this provider with the app so its floating-window feature can track which app screen is currently open.
en.disableEffect: FloatingX loses the active-screen tracking used by its app-scoped floating windows.

zh-CN.description: FloatingX 会在应用启动时运行此 Provider，使其悬浮窗功能能够跟踪当前打开的应用页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: FloatingX 将无法跟踪应用内悬浮窗所需的当前页面。

en.description: When the app launches, the Pgyer app-distribution SDK reads its configured app ID and app and device details, sends a launch report, and tracks the active screen for Pgyer features.
en.disableEffect: Pgyer launch reporting and features that need to know which screen is active will stop working.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，Pgyer 应用分发 SDK 会读取配置的应用 ID 及应用和设备信息、上报启动记录，并跟踪当前页面以支持 Pgyer 功能。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Pgyer 的启动上报以及依赖当前页面状态的功能将无法工作。

en.description: When the Elite Dangerous EDDN-Android client connects to this service, Patrick Honkonen's component receives the live EDDN feed and passes incoming data to the app.
en.disableEffect: App features that use this live EDDN feed will stop receiving new messages.

zh-CN.description: Elite Dangerous 的 EDDN-Android 客户端连接此服务时，Patrick Honkonen 提供的组件会接收 EDDN 实时数据流，并将收到的数据交给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此 EDDN 实时数据流的应用功能将无法继续接收新消息。

en.description: When the app starts, the GodEye APM monitoring SDK (Phone2345) initializes its diagnostics here and, in automatic mode, begins monitoring and shows its status notice.
en.disableEffect: GodEye's automatic monitoring and issue notices will stop, while the app itself can continue to open.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，GodEye（Phone2345 的 APM 监控 SDK）会在此初始化诊断功能；未启用手动安装模式时，还会启动监控并显示状态通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 关闭后，GodEye 的自动监控和问题通知会停止，应用本身仍可继续使用。

en.description: GodEye APM monitoring starts this foreground Service when monitoring begins or an issue is reported; it shows an ongoing status notice and updates it with recent issues.
en.disableEffect: GodEye's monitoring status notice and issue alerts will no longer appear.

zh-CN.description: GodEye APM 监控启动或发现问题时，会运行这个前台 Service，显示持续的状态通知，并用最近发现的问题更新通知内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 关闭后，GodEye 的监控状态通知和问题提醒不会再显示。

en.description: When a web page captures an image or video for upload, the Flutter InAppWebView plugin uses this provider to make the captured file available to the page.
en.disableEffect: Web pages that capture files for upload may fail to receive the captured image or video.

zh-CN.description: 网页通过相机拍摄图片或视频并准备上传时，Flutter InAppWebView 插件会通过此内容提供器将拍摄的文件交给网页。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，需要拍摄文件再上传的网页可能无法收到图片或视频。

en.description: When a user taps a custom button in a Chrome browser tab, the Flutter InAppWebView plugin sends the tap and page address back to the app.
en.disableEffect: Custom browser-tab button actions may no longer reach the app.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击 Chrome 浏览器标签页中的自定义按钮时，Flutter InAppWebView 插件会将点击操作和网页地址传回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，浏览器标签页中的自定义按钮操作可能无法传回应用。

en.description: When an app opens a website in a Chrome browser tab through Flutter InAppWebView, this screen launches the tab and returns its actions to the app.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot open websites through this browser-tab option.

zh-CN.description: 应用通过 Flutter InAppWebView 在 Chrome 浏览器标签页中打开网站时，此页面负责启动标签页并将其中的操作返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用无法通过此浏览器标签页方式打开网站。

en.description: When an app opens a website in a Chrome browser tab through Flutter InAppWebView, this screen launches the tab and returns its actions to the app.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot open websites through this browser-tab option.

zh-CN.description: 应用通过 Flutter InAppWebView 在 Chrome 浏览器标签页中打开网站时，此页面负责启动标签页并将其中的操作返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用无法通过此浏览器标签页方式打开网站。

en.description: When an app opens a trusted web app through Flutter InAppWebView, this screen displays the site in the browser's full-screen trusted web mode.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot open trusted web apps through this full-screen browser option.

zh-CN.description: 应用通过 Flutter InAppWebView 打开受信任的网页应用时，此页面会以浏览器的全屏可信网页模式显示网站。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用无法通过此全屏浏览器方式打开受信任的网页应用。

en.description: When an app opens a trusted web app through Flutter InAppWebView, this screen displays the site in the browser's full-screen trusted web mode.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot open trusted web apps through this full-screen browser option.

zh-CN.description: 应用通过 Flutter InAppWebView 打开受信任的网页应用时，此页面会以浏览器的全屏可信网页模式显示网站。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用无法通过此全屏浏览器方式打开受信任的网页应用。

en.description: When an app requests an in-app browser through Flutter InAppWebView, this screen loads the website inside the app and provides navigation, page search, and sharing.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot open web pages in this in-app browser.

zh-CN.description: 应用通过 Flutter InAppWebView 请求打开内置浏览器时，此页面会在应用内加载网站，并提供页面导航、搜索和分享功能。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用无法通过此内置浏览器打开网页。

en.description: Pichs FilePicker opens this Activity when the app requests local file or media selection. It displays the requested kinds of items with the configured selection limit and returns the user's choices to the app.
en.disableEffect: The app's Pichs file picker cannot open, so flows that use it cannot receive selected files or media.

zh-CN.description: 应用通过 Pichs FilePicker 选择本地文件或媒体时会打开此 Activity。它会按请求显示相应类型的内容、遵守设置的选择数量限制，并把用户的选择返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用的 Pichs 文件选择器将无法打开，依赖它的流程也无法收到所选文件或媒体。

en.description: Pichs FilePicker opens this Activity when a caller asks to preview an image. It displays the supplied picture with its title and lets the viewer hide or restore the top bar.
en.disableEffect: Images opened through this preview route can no longer be viewed.

zh-CN.description: 调用方通过 Pichs FilePicker 预览图片时会打开此 Activity。它会显示指定图片和标题，用户也可以隐藏或重新显示顶部栏。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过此预览入口打开的图片将无法查看。

en.description: Pichs FilePicker exposes this Activity as a video preview screen. In version 8.0.0, supplying a video address makes it show an error and close immediately; with no address, there is no video for the player to open.
en.disableEffect: Blocking it removes this separate route, which already cannot play a supplied video in version 8.0.0.

zh-CN.description: Pichs FilePicker 将此 Activity 用作视频预览界面。在 8.0.0 版本中，传入视频地址会使界面提示错误并立即关闭；没有地址时，播放器也没有视频可打开。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，这个独立预览入口会消失；它在 8.0.0 版本中本来就无法播放传入的视频。

en.description: Pichs FilePicker opens this Activity when the user crops an image selected in the picker. It lets the user adjust the crop, rotate or mirror the image, and save the edited result.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open this crop screen or receive a cropped image through the editing flow.

zh-CN.description: 用户裁剪通过 Pichs FilePicker 选中的图片时会打开此 Activity。用户可以调整裁剪范围、旋转或镜像图片，并保存编辑后的结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开裁剪界面，也无法通过此编辑流程取得裁剪后的图片。

en.description: Pickey Hand Vision opens this Activity when a user requests the SDK’s configuration page; it displays camera and device-scanning settings.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open the Hand Vision settings needed to adjust the scanning setup.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 Pickey Hand Vision 的设置页面时，SDK 会启动此 Activity，显示相机和设备扫描设置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开 Hand Vision 设置，也无法调整扫描配置。

en.description: PingerX SocialGo selects this Activity for Alipay flows and uses it to return login or payment results to the app.
en.disableEffect: The app will no longer receive Alipay login or payment results through SocialGo.

zh-CN.description: PingerX SocialGo 会为支付宝流程选择此 Activity，并通过它把登录或支付结果交回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 关闭后，应用将无法通过 SocialGo 收到支付宝登录或支付结果。

en.description: PingerX SocialGo selects this Activity for QQ sign-in and sharing, then uses it to return the results to the app.
en.disableEffect: QQ sign-in and sharing results will no longer reach the app.

zh-CN.description: PingerX SocialGo 会为 QQ 登录和分享流程选择此 Activity，并通过它把结果交回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 关闭后，QQ 登录和分享结果将无法返回应用。

en.description: PingerX SocialGo's WeChat Activity receives WeChat requests and responses and passes them to the SDK for login, sharing, or payment callbacks.
en.disableEffect: The app will no longer receive WeChat login, sharing, or payment results.

zh-CN.description: PingerX SocialGo 的微信 Activity 会接收微信请求和返回结果，并交给 SDK 处理登录、分享或支付回调。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 关闭后，应用将无法收到微信登录、分享或支付结果。

en.description: At startup, the Ping Identity (formerly ForgeRock) Android authentication SDK keeps track of which app screen is open so its sign-in flows can use it.
en.disableEffect: Ping Identity sign-in flows may not be able to open or return their authentication pages correctly.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，Ping Identity（原 ForgeRock）Android 身份验证 SDK 会跟踪当前打开的页面，以供其登录流程使用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Ping Identity 登录流程可能无法正确打开身份验证页面或返回原页面。

en.description: The Ping Identity authentication browser module starts this Activity when sign-in needs a web browser; it opens an authentication tab and passes the redirect result back to the app.
en.disableEffect: Browser-based Ping Identity sign-in cannot complete its redirect back into the app.

zh-CN.description: Ping Identity 身份验证浏览器模块会在登录需要网页时启动此 Activity，打开身份验证标签页，并将返回的跳转结果交还给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖浏览器的 Ping Identity 登录无法通过返回跳转完成。

en.description: The Ping Identity browser module uses this Activity to open a Custom Tab for an authentication URL and receive the returning VIEW link with the sign-in result.
en.disableEffect: Web sign-in may not open or complete its redirect back into the app.

zh-CN.description: Ping Identity 浏览器模块会用此 Activity 打开身份验证网页的自定义标签页，并通过返回应用的 VIEW 链接接收登录结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 网页登录可能无法打开，或无法通过返回链接在应用中完成。

en.description: At startup, the Ping Identity DaVinci SDK registers the form fields and controls used in its authentication journeys, including text and password entry, submit buttons, phone fields, and device steps.
en.disableEffect: DaVinci sign-in or enrollment pages may lack required controls or fail to submit.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，Ping Identity DaVinci SDK 会注册身份验证流程使用的表单字段和控件，包括文本、密码、提交按钮、电话字段及设备相关步骤。
zh-CN.disableEffect: DaVinci 登录或注册页面可能缺少必要控件或无法提交。

en.description: At startup, the Ping Identity External IDP module registers the social sign-in option used by DaVinci authentication journeys.
en.disableEffect: Social sign-in through those DaVinci journeys will not be available and may block a login that depends on it.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，Ping Identity External IDP 模块会注册 DaVinci 身份验证流程使用的社交登录选项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: DaVinci 流程将无法使用社交登录；依赖该方式的登录可能因此无法完成。

en.description: When a user chooses Facebook sign-in through Ping Identity External IDP, this Activity opens Facebook login and returns the result to the authentication SDK.
en.disableEffect: Facebook sign-in cannot finish in the app.

zh-CN.description: 用户通过 Ping Identity External IDP 选择 Facebook 登录时，此 Activity 会打开 Facebook 登录并将结果交还给身份验证 SDK。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用中的 Facebook 登录将无法完成。

en.description: At startup, Ping Identity External IDP prepares DaVinci sign-in flows to receive and process results from external identity providers and provider selection.
en.disableEffect: External-provider sign-in may not return to or complete the app’s authentication flow.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，Ping Identity External IDP 会为 DaVinci 登录流程准备外部身份提供方的结果处理及提供方选择功能。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 外部身份提供方登录可能无法返回应用或完成身份验证流程。

en.description: When the app process starts, the PingOne MFA (Ping Identity) SDK watches for the app to enter the foreground; it refreshes MFA information and checks whether an authenticator app is configured.
en.disableEffect: PingOne MFA initialization and authenticator checks will not run, so sign-in verification that relies on this SDK may fail.

zh-CN.description: 应用进程启动时，PingOne MFA（Ping Identity）SDK 会监听应用进入前台的状态；它会刷新 MFA 信息并检查是否已配置身份验证器应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: PingOne MFA 的初始化和验证器检查将无法运行，依赖该 SDK 的登录验证可能失败。

en.description: At startup, the PingOne Signals (Ping Identity) SDK watches for the first app screen to open and marks the session active for its signal collection.
en.disableEffect: PingOne Signals receives less app-session context for its risk analysis.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，PingOne Signals（Ping Identity）SDK 会等待首个页面打开，并将会话标记为活跃，以供信号采集使用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: PingOne Signals 的风险分析将缺少部分应用会话状态信息。

en.description: At startup, the PingOne Signals (Ping Identity) SDK watches for the first app screen to open and marks the session active for its signal collection.
en.disableEffect: PingOne Signals receives less app-session context for its risk analysis.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，PingOne Signals（Ping Identity）SDK 会等待首个页面打开，并将会话标记为活跃，以供信号采集使用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: PingOne Signals 的风险分析将缺少部分应用会话状态信息。

en.description: When the host app requests a Ping++ payment, this Activity opens the selected payment channel, such as Alipay, WeChat Pay, or web checkout, and returns the outcome.
en.disableEffect: Payments using Ping++ will not open or return a result, so the checkout cannot complete.

zh-CN.description: 宿主应用发起 Ping++ 付款时，此 Activity 会打开选定的支付渠道（例如支付宝、微信支付或网页收银台），并返回支付结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Ping++ 支付无法打开或返回结果，因此结账流程无法完成。

en.description: UInspector (Yves Cheung) uses this foreground Service to keep a notification with a control for starting or stopping inspection of the app's screens.
en.disableEffect: The UInspector control notification will not appear, so users cannot toggle screen inspection from it.

zh-CN.description: UInspector（Yves Cheung）通过此前台服务持续显示控制通知，供用户启动或停止检查应用界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: UInspector 控制通知将不再显示，用户无法通过它切换界面检查状态。

en.description: The optional UInspector (Yves Cheung) provider initializes the view-inspection tool in the app's main process when the app starts.
en.disableEffect: The inspector will no longer initialize automatically in the app's main process.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，UInspector（Yves Cheung）的可选 Provider 会在主进程中初始化界面检查工具。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 界面检查工具将不再由该 Provider 在应用主进程中自动初始化。

en.description: When BillingX’s debug billing client is selected, it opens this test purchase screen with the chosen product and price, then returns a simulated purchase result rather than a store transaction.
en.disableEffect: BillingX’s simulated test purchase flow will not return a purchase result.

zh-CN.description: 选择 BillingX 调试计费客户端时，它会打开此测试购买页面，显示所选商品和价格，并返回模拟购买结果，而非应用商店交易。
zh-CN.disableEffect: BillingX 的模拟测试购买流程将无法返回购买结果。

en.description: When the host app opens the PixMatrix Shop storefront, this screen loads product listings and promotional banners. Shoppers can open a product, saved-work shelf, coupons, or cart from here.
en.disableEffect: The shop landing page and its product, coupon, cart, and saved-work entry points will not open.

zh-CN.description: 宿主应用打开 PixMatrix Shop 店铺入口时，此页面会加载商品目录和促销横幅。用户可从这里进入商品、已保存作品、优惠券或购物车。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，店铺首页以及商品、优惠券、购物车和已保存作品入口无法打开。

en.description: When a shopper opens the PixMatrix Shop saved-work shelf, this screen lists saved photo books and calendars. Selecting a work opens its preview, and shoppers can remove saved works.
en.disableEffect: Shoppers can no longer browse, preview, or remove saved photo books and calendars from the shop.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 PixMatrix Shop 的已保存作品架时，此页面会列出已保存的照片书和日历。选择作品可查看预览，也可删除已保存的作品。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，用户无法在店铺中浏览、预览或删除已保存的照片书和日历。

en.description: When a shopper opens the PixMatrix Shop cart, this screen lists saved items and totals selected goods. Shoppers can remove items or continue to order creation.
en.disableEffect: The shop cart cannot be reviewed or used to continue to checkout.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 PixMatrix Shop 购物车时，此页面会列出已加入的商品并计算所选商品金额。用户可删除商品或继续创建订单。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，用户无法查看店铺购物车或从购物车继续结账。

en.description: When the PixMatrix Shop storefront or checkout asks for available coupons, this screen lists eligible offers and returns the shopper's selection to the order flow.
en.disableEffect: Shoppers cannot choose or apply a coupon in the shop checkout.

zh-CN.description: PixMatrix Shop 店铺或结账流程需要选择优惠券时，此页面会列出可用优惠并把用户的选择返回订单流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，用户无法在店铺结账时选择或使用优惠券。

en.description: When a shopper checks out cart items or buys a product directly, this screen reviews quantities and the delivery address, creates the order, and opens payment.
en.disableEffect: The shopper cannot confirm and submit a shop order.

zh-CN.description: 用户从购物车结账或直接购买商品时，此页面会核对数量和收货地址、创建订单并进入付款。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，用户无法确认并提交店铺订单。

en.description: During PixMatrix Shop checkout, this screen lists saved delivery addresses. The shopper can select an address for the order or open it for editing.
en.disableEffect: The shopper cannot choose a saved delivery address during shop checkout.

zh-CN.description: PixMatrix Shop 结账时，此页面会列出已保存的收货地址。用户可为订单选择地址，或打开地址进行编辑。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，用户无法在店铺结账时选择已保存的收货地址。

en.description: When a shopper opens an order's shipment details, this screen displays the shipment's tracking updates.
en.disableEffect: The shopper cannot view the order's shipment tracking updates in the shop.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开订单的配送详情时，此页面会显示包裹的物流跟踪记录。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，用户无法在店铺中查看订单的物流跟踪记录。

en.description: When checkout needs a new or changed delivery address, this screen collects the address and delivery area and lets the shopper save, update, or delete it.
en.disableEffect: The shopper cannot add or change a delivery address through the shop.

zh-CN.description: 结账需要新增或修改收货地址时，此页面会收集地址和配送地区，并允许用户保存、更新或删除地址。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，用户无法通过店铺新增或修改收货地址。

en.description: When a shopper opens order management in the PixMatrix Shop, this screen shows separate tabs for current and past orders.
en.disableEffect: The shopper cannot open the shop's current and past order lists.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 PixMatrix Shop 订单管理时，此页面会用不同标签页显示当前订单和历史订单。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，用户无法打开店铺中的当前订单和历史订单列表。

en.description: When a shopper opens an order, this screen shows its details and offers the available order actions, including cancel, pay again, request a refund, or mark it complete.
en.disableEffect: The shopper cannot review or manage the selected shop order.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开订单时，此页面会显示订单详情，并提供取消、重新付款、申请退款或确认完成等操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，用户无法查看或管理所选店铺订单。

en.description: When a shopper starts payment for a PixMatrix Shop order, this screen presents payment options and handles Stripe, Alipay, WeChat Pay, and PayPal flows.
en.disableEffect: The shopper cannot pay for the shop order through this screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户开始支付 PixMatrix Shop 订单时，此页面会显示支付选项并处理 Stripe、支付宝、微信支付和 PayPal 流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，用户无法通过此页面支付店铺订单。

en.description: After a PixMatrix Shop payment attempt, this screen shows whether payment succeeded or failed. It can open the order page after success or return the shopper to payment after failure.
en.disableEffect: The shopper cannot see the shop's payment result or use its result-screen links to view the order or retry.

zh-CN.description: PixMatrix Shop 支付尝试结束后，此页面会显示成功或失败。支付成功时可打开订单页面，失败时可返回付款重试。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，用户无法查看店铺支付结果，也无法从结果页面查看订单或重试付款。

en.description: When a shopper selects a product from the PixMatrix Shop catalog or a shop link, this screen loads its description, price, and options. Custom photo-book and calendar products continue into their corresponding design previews.
en.disableEffect: The shopper cannot open shop product details or continue into the related photo-book or calendar design flow.

zh-CN.description: 用户从 PixMatrix Shop 商品目录或店铺链接选择商品时，此页面会加载商品说明、价格和选项。可定制的照片书和日历商品会继续进入相应的设计预览。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，用户无法打开商品详情，也无法继续相关照片书或日历设计流程。

en.description: When a shopper chooses to edit a photo-book preview, this screen lets them change album pages, photos, and text before returning to the preview.
en.disableEffect: The shopper cannot edit or save changes to a personalized photo book.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择编辑照片书预览时，此页面允许修改书页、照片和文字，然后返回预览。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，用户无法编辑或保存个性化照片书的修改。

en.description: When a shopper opens a new or saved photo book, this screen renders its pages for review. The shopper can edit it, save it to the work shelf, or buy it.
en.disableEffect: The shopper cannot preview, save, or order a personalized photo book.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开新建或已保存的照片书时，此页面会渲染书页供检查。用户可继续编辑、保存到作品架或购买。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，用户无法预览、保存或订购个性化照片书。

en.description: When a shopper edits a personalized calendar, this screen lets them change its pages and photos and returns the saved design to the calendar preview.
en.disableEffect: The shopper cannot edit or save changes to a personalized calendar.

zh-CN.description: 用户编辑个性化日历时，此页面允许修改日历页和照片，并把保存后的设计返回日历预览。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，用户无法编辑或保存个性化日历的修改。

en.description: When a shopper opens a new or saved calendar, this screen builds a month-by-month preview. The shopper can edit it, save it to the work shelf, add it to the cart, or buy it.
en.disableEffect: The shopper cannot preview, save, or order a personalized calendar.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开新建或已保存的日历时，此页面会生成逐月预览。用户可继续编辑、保存到作品架、加入购物车或购买。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，用户无法预览、保存或订购个性化日历。

en.description: When the host app opens a PixMatrix Shop page or order link, this screen displays it in an in-app browser. It also connects page actions to product details, album or calendar creation, checkout, and payment.
en.disableEffect: Shop pages and their embedded product, order, checkout, and payment flows cannot open in the app.

zh-CN.description: 宿主应用打开 PixMatrix Shop 页面或订单链接时，此页面会在应用内浏览器中显示内容。它也会把页面操作接到商品详情、照片书或日历创建、结账和支付流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，应用内无法打开店铺页面及其中的商品、订单、结账和支付流程。

en.description: When WeChat returns from a PixMatrix Shop payment, this exported entry screen passes the returned payment result to the shop's registered payment handler.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot receive and process the result of WeChat Pay for a shop order.

zh-CN.description: 微信从 PixMatrix Shop 支付流程返回时，此导出入口页面会把支付结果交给店铺注册的支付处理器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，应用无法接收并处理店铺订单的微信支付结果。

en.description: When a bank’s browser login returns to a plaid:// link, Plaid Link receives the VIEW callback here and forwards it so account linking can resume or finish.
en.disableEffect: Bank login redirects will not return to Plaid Link, so account linking may fail.

zh-CN.description: 银行网页登录返回 plaid:// 链接时，Plaid Link 会在此接收 VIEW 回调并继续处理，使账户关联流程能够恢复或完成。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 银行登录跳转无法返回 Plaid Link，账户关联流程可能失败。

en.description: When the app starts Plaid Link to connect an account, this Activity hosts the account-linking screen and handles its web connection and authentication steps.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot start or complete account linking through Plaid.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动 Plaid Link 关联账户时，此 Activity 会显示账户关联界面，并处理网页连接和身份验证步骤。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法通过 Plaid 启动或完成账户关联。

en.description: When a bank browser redirects to Plaid Link’s plaid:// redirect or resume link, this Activity routes the result back into the active Link screen.
en.disableEffect: Bank authentication redirects cannot resume the Plaid Link flow, so account linking may fail.

zh-CN.description: 银行浏览器跳转到 Plaid Link 的 plaid:// redirect 或 resume 链接时，此 Activity 会将结果送回正在进行的 Link 流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 银行身份验证跳转无法恢复 Plaid Link 流程，账户关联可能失败。

en.description: During a Plaid Link photo step, this private provider exposes an image saved in the SDK cache as a temporary content link so the web flow can read it.
en.disableEffect: Plaid Link photo upload or camera steps can fail because the web flow cannot access the image.

zh-CN.description: Plaid Link 的照片步骤中，此私有文件提供程序会将 SDK 缓存中的图片作为临时内容链接提供给网页流程读取。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 网页流程无法读取图片，Plaid Link 的照片上传或相机步骤可能失败。

en.description: Plaid Link starts this Activity when its web flow requests a file, a photo, or camera permission; it opens Android’s picker, camera, or permission prompt and returns the result.
en.disableEffect: Plaid Link cannot return selected documents or camera results, so those upload steps will fail.

zh-CN.description: Plaid Link 网页流程请求文件、拍照或相机权限时会启动此 Activity；它会打开 Android 文件选择器、相机或权限提示，并返回结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Plaid Link 无法返回所选文件或拍摄结果，因此相关上传步骤会失败。

en.description: During a Plaid Link photo step, this provider exposes an image saved in the SDK cache as a temporary content link so the web flow can read it.
en.disableEffect: Plaid Link photo upload or camera steps can fail because the web flow cannot access the image.

zh-CN.description: Plaid Link 的照片步骤中，此文件提供程序会将 SDK 缓存中的图片作为临时内容链接提供给网页流程读取。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 网页流程无法读取图片，Plaid Link 的照片上传或相机步骤可能失败。

en.description: The HeyTap Account OAuth Web SDK opens this Activity when account authorization needs a web page; it displays the authorization content and returns the web result to the app.
en.disableEffect: The app may be unable to complete account login or authorization that uses this web page.

zh-CN.description: HeyTap 账号 OAuth 网页 SDK 在账号授权需要网页时打开此 Activity，展示授权内容并将网页结果返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用可能无法完成需要此网页的账号登录或授权。

en.description: During an OMS OAuth request that uses a bottom-sheet display, the HeyTap OMS OAuth SDK opens this Activity to show the authorization page and return the user decision.
en.disableEffect: Account authorization using the bottom-sheet presentation will fail.

zh-CN.description: HeyTap OMS OAuth SDK 在授权请求使用底部弹窗时打开此 Activity，展示授权网页并将用户的决定返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用无法通过底部弹窗完成账号授权。

en.description: When an OMS OAuth request calls for a centered dialog, the HeyTap OMS OAuth SDK opens this Activity to show the authorization page and return approval or cancellation.
en.disableEffect: Authorization requests that use this dialog will fail.

zh-CN.description: HeyTap OMS OAuth SDK 在授权请求需要居中弹窗时打开此 Activity，展示授权网页并返回用户的同意或取消结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，使用此弹窗的账号授权请求将无法完成。

en.description: The HeyTap OMS OAuth SDK opens this Activity for full-page authorization; it loads the approval page and sends the resulting code or token back to the requesting app.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot complete OMS account authorization in full-page mode.

zh-CN.description: HeyTap OMS OAuth SDK 在整页授权流程中打开此 Activity，加载授权页面并将授权码或令牌返回请求应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用无法通过整页方式完成 OMS 账号授权。

en.description: At the start of a HeyTap OMS OAuth request, this Activity checks the request and contacts the account service, then opens the requested authorization page or dialog.
en.disableEffect: The app may fail to start or complete OMS sign-in before the approval page opens.

zh-CN.description: HeyTap OMS OAuth SDK 在授权开始时通过此 Activity 检查请求并联系账号服务，然后按请求打开授权页面或弹窗。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用的 OMS 登录或授权可能无法启动，授权页面也不会打开。

en.description: When the app starts an OMS OAuth request through a Service, this component asks the account service for an authorization result and opens the requested approval page or returns the result.
en.disableEffect: The app may be unable to start or complete an OMS sign-in or authorization request.

zh-CN.description: 应用通过 Service 发起 HeyTap OMS OAuth 请求时，此组件会向账号服务申请授权结果，并打开请求指定的授权页面或返回结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用可能无法启动或完成 OMS 登录与授权请求。

en.description: The HeyTap OMS OAuth SDK opens this Activity when an authorization flow needs another web page; it loads the requested page in the app and handles navigation and return-to-page behavior.
en.disableEffect: Links that need this in-app page may no longer complete the sign-in or authorization flow.

zh-CN.description: HeyTap OMS OAuth SDK 在授权流程需要打开后续网页时启动此 Activity，在应用内加载页面并处理网页跳转和返回上一页。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，需要此应用内网页的链接可能无法完成登录或授权流程。

en.description: The HeyTap Account OAuth SDK declares this Receiver for account support-login notices, but the analyzed version has no observable behavior for that event.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it has no observable effect in this SDK version because it does not act on the notice.

zh-CN.description: HeyTap 账号 OAuth SDK 声明此 Receiver 用于接收账号登录支持通知，但分析版本收到通知后没有可观察到的处理行为。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 此版本不会处理该通知，因此停用后没有可观察到的影响。

en.description: Yodo1 MAS’s Buyout SDK opens this reminder to promote its MoMoYu companion app; its button launches that app if installed or opens its download page.
en.disableEffect: The cross-promotion reminder will disappear, while the host app’s own features remain available.

zh-CN.description: Yodo1 MAS 的买断推广 SDK 会打开此提醒来推广“摸摸鱼”应用；点击按钮后，若已安装就启动该应用，否则打开下载页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，这个交叉推广提醒不会出现，但宿主应用自身功能仍可使用。

en.description: EzPushSDK refreshes the device’s push-notification registration when Google’s push service reports that its token has changed.
en.disableEffect: The EzPush registration will not refresh, which can stop future EzPush notifications from reaching the app.

zh-CN.description: Google 推送服务报告令牌已更改时，EzPushSDK 会刷新设备的推送通知注册信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: EzPush 注册信息将无法刷新，应用可能因此收不到后续 EzPush 通知。

en.description: EzPushSDK runs this background Service when the app registers a user or device, updates tags or location, or reports that a user opened a notification.
en.disableEffect: Those EzPush registration, profile, location, and notification updates will stop; ordinary app screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: 应用注册用户或设备、更新标签或位置，或报告用户已打开通知时，EzPushSDK 会在后台运行此 Service。
zh-CN.disableEffect: EzPush 的注册、资料、位置和通知更新将停止；应用的普通页面仍可使用。

en.description: Playtime Ads runs this receiver from an alarm while an offer based on app use time is active to resume or retry usage syncing.
en.disableEffect: Time spent on these offers may stop being counted, leaving users without progress toward the related rewards.

zh-CN.description: Playtime Ads 会在限时优惠任务进行时通过定时提醒运行此接收器，以恢复或重试使用情况同步。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户在这些优惠任务中花费的时间可能无法继续计入，任务进度可能停滞。

en.description: Playtime Ads starts this background service when it begins or stops tracking a playtime offer; the service schedules or cancels later usage checks.
en.disableEffect: The SDK may stop recording time spent on offers, so users can lose progress toward playtime rewards.

zh-CN.description: Playtime Ads 开始或停止跟踪游戏时长优惠时会启动此后台服务，由它安排或取消后续使用情况检查。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，SDK 可能无法记录用户在优惠任务中花费的时间，用户也可能失去相应奖励进度。

en.description: Playtime Ads opens this screen when users browse task and playtime offers; it loads the offer list and selected offer details inside the app.
en.disableEffect: Users will no longer be able to browse or complete Playtime offers or earn their rewards.

zh-CN.description: 用户浏览任务和游戏时长优惠时，Playtime Ads 会打开此界面，在应用内显示优惠列表和所选任务详情。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法浏览或完成 Playtime 优惠任务，也无法获得这些任务的奖励。

en.description: Playtime Ads opens this browser inside the app when an offer requires a tracked web visit; it loads the destination page and reports the visit to the offer flow.
en.disableEffect: Offers that require this web visit may no longer complete or grant rewards.

zh-CN.description: 优惠任务需要访问可跟踪的网页时，Playtime Ads 会打开此应用内浏览器加载目标页面，并将访问结果传回任务流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，需要通过此网页访问来完成的优惠任务可能无法完成或发放奖励。

en.description: Playtime Ads uses this provider to store and return its shared offer identifier when a client requests it.
en.disableEffect: Clients that rely on this provider will no longer be able to read or store the shared identifier.

zh-CN.description: Playtime Ads 使用此内容提供程序，在客户端请求时保存或返回优惠活动共用的标识符。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，依赖此服务的客户端将无法再读取或保存共享标识符。

en.description: PluggableAI Fanmeter opens this screen when the app asks to show a Fanmeter event. It displays event information, participation controls, and available rewards.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open Fanmeter event details or use its participation and reward controls.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求打开 Fanmeter 活动时，PluggableAI Fanmeter 会显示此页面，其中包含活动信息、参与控件和可用奖励。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开 Fanmeter 活动详情，也无法使用其中的参与和奖励控件。

en.description: PluggableAI Fanmeter briefly opens this screen when it needs location access or a location setting for event participation. It launches the Android permission or settings prompt and returns control to Fanmeter after the user responds.
en.disableEffect: Fanmeter cannot request these location permissions or complete location setup, so event participation that needs location access may fail.

zh-CN.description: PluggableAI Fanmeter 在活动参与需要位置权限或位置设置时会短暂打开此页面。它会启动 Android 权限或设置提示，并在用户操作后将控制权交还给 Fanmeter。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Fanmeter 将无法请求这些位置权限或完成位置设置，因此需要位置访问权限的活动参与可能会失败。

en.description: PluggableAI Fanmeter starts this foreground Service for an event when the app begins event participation. It shows an ongoing notification and keeps location and sensor tracking active for that event.
en.disableEffect: Fanmeter cannot keep event location and sensor tracking active, so participation that depends on this tracking may not count.

zh-CN.description: 应用开始参与活动时，PluggableAI Fanmeter 会为该活动启动前台 Service。它会显示持续通知，并在活动期间保持位置和传感器跟踪。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Fanmeter 将无法持续记录活动的位置和传感器数据，因此依赖这些记录的参与可能无法计入。

en.description: PluggableAI Fanmeter opens this screen when the app requests its event view. It loads and displays current event details and participation controls, refreshing their status as the event progresses.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open the Fanmeter event page or participate through that page.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求打开活动页面时，PluggableAI Fanmeter 会显示此界面。它会加载并展示当前活动详情和参与控件，并随活动进展更新控件状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开 Fanmeter 活动页面，也无法通过该页面参与活动。

en.description: PlusAuth’s OpenID Connect authentication SDK starts this screen when an app begins a web login; it opens the identity provider’s authorization page in a browser tab and returns the result.
en.disableEffect: Login flows that use PlusAuth will not be able to complete.

zh-CN.description: 应用通过网页进行账号登录时，PlusAuth 的 OpenID Connect 登录 SDK 会打开此界面，在浏览器标签页中显示身份服务商的授权页面并返回登录结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，依赖 PlusAuth 的账号登录流程将无法完成。

en.description: PlusAuth opens this activity for the app’s login callback link and forwards the returned link to its login screen.
en.disableEffect: PlusAuth will not receive the login callback, so account login will not complete.

zh-CN.description: PlusAuth 会通过此界面接收应用的登录回调链接，并将返回结果交给登录界面处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，PlusAuth 无法接收登录回调，账号登录将无法完成。

en.description: Pluto is an Android debugging toolkit that runs on the device. It uses this provider to share diagnostic files from its debugger with other apps.
en.disableEffect: Sharing diagnostic files from Pluto will fail.

zh-CN.description: Pluto 是一款 Android 设备端调试工具，它通过此内容提供程序将调试器中的诊断文件分享给其他应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法通过 Pluto 调试器分享诊断文件。

en.description: Pluto is an Android debugging toolkit that runs on the device. It uses this provider to share diagnostic files from its debugger with other apps.
en.disableEffect: Sharing diagnostic files from Pluto will fail.

zh-CN.description: Pluto 是一款 Android 设备端调试工具，它通过此内容提供程序将调试器中的诊断文件分享给其他应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法通过 Pluto 调试器分享诊断文件。

en.description: Pluto opens this screen to list its installed debugging tools and let a developer open one.
en.disableEffect: Developers will not be able to open Pluto’s screen for choosing a debugging tool.

zh-CN.description: Pluto 会打开此界面列出已安装的调试工具，供开发者选择并打开。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Pluto 的调试工具选择界面将无法打开。

en.description: Pluto’s screen ruler opens this measuring view when someone checks spacing or alignment in the app.
en.disableEffect: The Pluto ruler will no longer open to measure the app screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户检查应用界面中的间距或对齐方式时，Pluto 的屏幕标尺会打开此测量界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法打开 Pluto 标尺来测量应用界面。

en.description: Pluto opens this screen as its debugger inside the app, where developers inspect network activity, crashes, and app data.
en.disableEffect: Pluto’s debugger inside the app and its inspection tools will not open.

zh-CN.description: Pluto 会将此界面作为应用内调试面板，供开发者查看网络活动、崩溃信息和应用数据。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Pluto 调试面板及其中的检查工具将无法打开。

en.description: Pluto opens this screen to show the selected debugging tool and its controls inside the app.
en.disableEffect: The selected Pluto debugging tool will no longer appear in the app.

zh-CN.description: Pluto 会打开此界面，在应用内显示所选调试工具及其操作控件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，所选的 Pluto 调试工具将无法在应用中显示。

en.description: Pluto opens this screen to display its available debugging tools so a developer can choose one.
en.disableEffect: Developers will no longer be able to choose a Pluto debugging tool in the app.

zh-CN.description: Pluto 会打开此界面显示可用的调试工具，供开发者选择。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，开发者将无法通过 Pluto 界面选择调试工具。

en.description: At app startup, Pnuema SaveStateObserver registers callbacks that log the size of state saved by activities and fragments and warn when a saved bundle is too large.
en.disableEffect: Logs showing saved state size and warnings for large saved state will stop appearing; the app will still be able to save screen state.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，Pnuema SaveStateObserver 会注册回调，记录 Activity 和 Fragment 保存的状态大小，并在状态包过大时发出警告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，状态大小诊断日志和超大状态警告将停止出现，应用仍可正常保存界面状态。

en.description: At app startup, Pnuema SaveStateObserver registers callbacks that log the size of state saved by activities and fragments and warn when a saved bundle is too large.
en.disableEffect: Logs showing saved state size and warnings for large saved state will stop appearing; the app will still be able to save screen state.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，Pnuema SaveStateObserver 会注册回调，记录 Activity 和 Fragment 保存的状态大小，并在状态包过大时发出警告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，状态大小诊断日志和超大状态警告将停止出现，应用仍可正常保存界面状态。

en.description: Polidea Cockpit opens this screen so developers can edit named app parameters while the app is running and save the new values.
en.disableEffect: Developers will no longer be able to edit Cockpit parameters through this screen.

zh-CN.description: Polidea Cockpit 会打开此界面，供开发者在应用运行时编辑参数并保存新值。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，开发者将无法通过 Cockpit 界面修改这些运行参数。

en.description: Polidea Cockpit runs this provider at app startup to load its parameter files from app storage and bundled assets.
en.disableEffect: Cockpit parameters may not load, so app features that read them may keep using default values.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，Polidea Cockpit 会通过此内容提供程序从应用存储和内置资源中加载参数文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Cockpit 参数可能无法加载，读取这些参数的应用功能可能会继续使用默认值。

en.description: Pollfish’s survey monetization SDK launches this full screen view when a survey is ready, showing it over the app and returning its completion state.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to open Pollfish surveys in the app.

zh-CN.description: Pollfish 问卷变现 SDK 准备好问卷时会打开此全屏界面，在应用中显示问卷并返回完成状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法在应用中打开 Pollfish 问卷。

en.description: Pollfish’s Magic Receipts SDK opens a page for a receipt offer in a browser inside the app and returns the user’s submission result.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to view or submit Magic Receipts offers in the app.

zh-CN.description: Pollfish 的 Magic Receipts SDK 会在应用内浏览器中打开收据优惠任务页面，并返回用户的提交结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法在应用中查看或提交 Magic Receipts 优惠任务。

en.description: When an app starts an Aestron real-time media session, this bound service connects the SDK's media features to the app; the included module may provide audio, video or beauty effects.
en.disableEffect: The app's Aestron audio, video or beauty features may fail to start.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动 Aestron 实时媒体会话时，此绑定服务会为应用连接 SDK 媒体功能；具体模块可提供音频、视频或美颜效果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用中的 Aestron 音频、视频或美颜功能可能无法启动。

en.description: When a Google Play push message arrives, Popdeem’s social rewards SDK passes it to its notification handler.
en.disableEffect: Popdeem push messages will stop reaching the app.

zh-CN.description: Google Play 推送消息到达时，Popdeem 社交奖励 SDK 会将消息交给自己的通知处理程序。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Popdeem 推送消息将无法送达用户。

en.description: When a Popdeem push message arrives, this service displays it in the app or as a notification and handles its link when tapped.
en.disableEffect: Users will stop receiving Popdeem push messages and will not be able to open their linked content.

zh-CN.description: Popdeem 推送消息到达时，此服务会在应用内或通知栏显示消息，并处理用户点击后的链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法收到 Popdeem 推送，也无法通过推送打开相关内容。

en.description: Popdeem’s social rewards SDK opens this screen when a user claims a reward; it lets them complete the required location check or social post and submit the claim.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to complete or submit these social reward claims.

zh-CN.description: 用户领取奖励时，Popdeem 社交奖励 SDK 会打开此界面，供用户完成所需签到或社交发布并提交申请。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法完成或提交这些社交奖励申请。

en.description: Popdeem’s social rewards SDK opens this screen when a user taps an image in the activity feed, showing the image and contributor’s name.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to open images attached to feed activities.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击动态中的图片时，Popdeem 社交奖励 SDK 会打开此界面显示图片和发布者姓名。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法打开动态中附带的图片。

en.description: When a user opens Popdeem rewards, this screen displays the main rewards area and its activity feed.
en.disableEffect: The Popdeem rewards screen and its activity feed will not open.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 Popdeem 奖励功能时，此界面会显示奖励主页和活动动态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Popdeem 奖励页面及其动态内容将无法打开。

en.description: Popdeem opens this screen to show the user’s messages; selecting a message opens its contents.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to view Popdeem messages.

zh-CN.description: Popdeem 会打开此界面显示用户收到的消息；选择一条消息后可查看其内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法查看 Popdeem 消息。

en.description: Popdeem opens this screen after a user selects a reward; it shows the reward details and redemption instructions and checks when it has been redeemed.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to view these rewards’ redemption instructions or complete redemption.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择奖励后，Popdeem 会打开此界面显示奖励详情和兑换说明，并检查兑换是否完成。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法查看这些奖励的兑换说明或完成兑换。

en.description: Popdeem opens this screen to verify a social action required by a reward and submit a successful claim.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to complete social reward tasks that require this check.

zh-CN.description: Popdeem 会打开此界面，验证奖励所需的社交操作，并在验证成功后提交领取申请。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法完成需要此项验证的社交奖励任务。

en.description: When a reward requires a social action, Popdeem opens this screen so the user can choose Facebook, Twitter, or Instagram before the action is checked.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to choose a social account for these reward actions.

zh-CN.description: 奖励需要社交操作时，Popdeem 会打开此界面，供用户选择 Facebook、Twitter 或 Instagram，然后再验证操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法为这些奖励任务选择要使用的社交账号。

en.description: Popdeem opens this screen so users can manage their profile and connected Facebook, Twitter, and Instagram accounts.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to manage their Popdeem profile or connected social accounts.

zh-CN.description: Popdeem 会打开此界面，供用户管理个人资料以及已连接的 Facebook、Twitter 和 Instagram 账号。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法管理 Popdeem 个人资料或已连接的社交账号。

en.description: Portto FCL (Flow Client Library) opens the web address supplied by the app in an in-app browser during an FCL session and reports when that page opens and closes.
en.disableEffect: FCL flows that need this web page cannot continue in the app.

zh-CN.description: Portto 的 FCL（Flow Client Library）会在 FCL 流程中用应用内浏览器打开应用提供的网页，并通知 SDK 网页何时打开和关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要此网页的 FCL 流程将无法在应用中继续。

en.description: Portto’s Blocto Android SDK receives a blocto: link when Android routes a wallet or sign-in return to the app, passes the result back to Blocto, and then closes.
en.disableEffect: Wallet approvals and sign-ins that return through this link cannot finish.

zh-CN.description: Portto 的 Blocto Android SDK 会在 Android 将 blocto: 回跳链接交给应用时接收链接、把结果交回 Blocto，然后关闭页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过此链接返回的数字钱包授权和登录流程将无法完成。

en.description: Portto’s Blocto Android SDK opens the requested wallet-approval page in an in-app browser and handles the return link; leaving early reports that the request was rejected.
en.disableEffect: Wallet approval requests that use this page cannot complete.

zh-CN.description: Portto 的 Blocto Android SDK 会在应用内浏览器中打开数字钱包授权页面并处理回跳链接；用户提前离开时，应用会收到请求被拒绝的结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此页面的数字钱包授权请求将无法完成。

en.description: When a user chooses to rotate an image in the log1992 RichEditor library, this screen previews it, rotates it in 90-degree steps, saves the edited image, and returns its path to the editor.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot rotate images from the RichEditor editing screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 log1992 RichEditor 编辑器中选择旋转图片时会打开此界面。界面预览图片，可按 90 度旋转；保存后会将新图片路径返回编辑器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法在 RichEditor 编辑界面中旋转图片。

en.description: Pranav Pandey’s Dynamic Engine listens for Android phone-state broadcasts. When a call starts or ends, it sends the corresponding state event to the app’s dynamic task engine.
en.disableEffect: Call-aware tasks will no longer receive call start or end updates.

zh-CN.description: Pranav Pandey 的 Dynamic Engine 会监听 Android 电话状态广播。通话开始或结束时，它会向应用的动态任务引擎发送相应状态事件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖通话状态的任务将无法再收到通话开始或结束通知。

en.description: Pranav Pandey’s Dynamic Support library shows the app’s permission screen when its permission workflow opens, including permission information and the built-in request flow.
en.disableEffect: The app’s built-in permission screen and request flow cannot open.

zh-CN.description: Pranav Pandey 的 Dynamic Support 库会在应用打开权限管理流程时显示权限页面，包括权限信息和内置的请求流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用内置的权限页面和请求流程将无法打开。

en.description: Pranav Pandey’s Dynamic Support library shows an image or widget-theme preview supplied by the app, with controls to view its details, save it, or share it.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot view or export this preview through the app’s Dynamic Support screen.

zh-CN.description: Pranav Pandey 的 Dynamic Support 库会显示应用提供的图片或小组件主题预览，并提供查看详情、保存或分享的选项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过应用的 Dynamic Support 页面查看或导出此预览。

en.description: Pranav Pandey’s Dynamic Support library displays a supplied theme image or theme link when the app opens its theme screen, with options to share or copy theme details.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot show or share its theme preview through this screen.

zh-CN.description: Pranav Pandey 的 Dynamic Support 库会在应用打开主题页面时显示提供的主题图片或链接，并允许用户分享或复制主题信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法通过此页面显示或分享主题预览。

en.description: Pranav Pandey’s Dynamic Support library responds to Android wallpaper-change broadcasts by updating the app’s automatic theme colors.
en.disableEffect: Automatic theme colors will no longer update when the wallpaper changes.

zh-CN.description: Pranav Pandey 的 Dynamic Support 库会响应 Android 壁纸变更广播并更新应用的自动主题颜色。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 壁纸更改后，应用的自动主题颜色将不再更新。

en.description: The Android Snooper (Jainsahab) debug viewer opens this screen after a recorded network call is selected. It shows that call's request and response details, including headers and body text.
en.disableEffect: The older Snooper viewer can no longer open recorded network-call details.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Android Snooper（Jainsahab）的调试查看器中选择一条网络记录后，会打开此页面。页面显示该请求和响应的详细信息，包括标头和正文。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 旧版 Snooper 查看器将无法再打开网络请求详情。

en.description: Android Snooper opens this screen when its network log viewer is requested. It lists recorded HTTP calls and opens a selected call's details.
en.disableEffect: The older Snooper network-call list will be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 Android Snooper 的网络记录查看器时，会进入此页面。页面列出已记录的 HTTP 请求，并可打开某条记录的详情。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 旧版 Snooper 的网络请求列表将无法使用。

en.description: Android Snooper uses this provider when a user shares an exported network log with another app. It gives the receiving app access to the exported log file.
en.disableEffect: Sharing exported network logs will stop working; the app's normal network requests are unaffected.

zh-CN.description: 用户通过其他应用分享导出的网络记录时，Android Snooper 会用此内容提供器让接收应用读取记录文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 导出的网络记录将无法分享；应用自身的正常网络请求不受影响。

en.description: When a database is chosen in Android Snooper's database browser, this screen lists its tables and lets the user open one.
en.disableEffect: Snooper's database-inspection screen will no longer show a database's tables.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Android Snooper 的数据库浏览器中选择一个数据库后，会进入此页面查看其中的表，并可打开某张表。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Snooper 将无法再显示所选数据库中的表。

en.description: Android Snooper opens this screen to scan and list the app's local database files for inspection.
en.disableEffect: The app's local databases can no longer be browsed through Snooper.

zh-CN.description: Android Snooper 打开此页面来查找并列出应用的本地数据库文件，供用户检查。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法再通过 Snooper 浏览应用的本地数据库。

en.description: When a table is selected in Android Snooper's database browser, this screen displays its stored rows and columns.
en.disableEffect: Snooper can no longer display the contents of a selected database table.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Android Snooper 的数据库浏览器中选择一张表后，会进入此页面查看其中保存的行和列。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Snooper 将无法再显示所选数据库表的内容。

en.description: After a recorded call is selected from Android Snooper's network log, this screen shows its URL, headers, request and response contents, and offers log sharing.
en.disableEffect: Android Snooper's recorded-call details and log-sharing screen will be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Android Snooper 的网络记录中选择一条请求后，会进入此页面查看网址、标头、请求和响应内容，也可以分享记录。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Android Snooper 将无法再显示请求详情或分享网络记录。

en.description: When Android Snooper's network viewer is opened, this screen lists captured HTTP calls and lets the user search, open, or delete records.
en.disableEffect: Android Snooper's captured-call history can no longer be viewed or managed.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 Android Snooper 的网络查看器时，会进入此页面查看已捕获的 HTTP 请求，并可搜索、打开或删除记录。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Android Snooper 将无法再查看或管理已捕获的请求记录。

en.description: Opened from Android Snooper's network-call list, this screen filters recorded requests by a search term and lets the user open a match.
en.disableEffect: Searching the recorded network calls will no longer be available.

zh-CN.description: 用户从 Android Snooper 的网络请求列表进入此页面后，可按关键词筛选记录并打开匹配项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法再搜索已记录的网络请求。

en.description: Peekaboo's image picker uses this provider to serve saved images through app-only content links, so other app screens can read them without exposing raw file paths.
en.disableEffect: Image flows that need a file link from this provider will fail to hand the saved photo to the app.

zh-CN.description: Peekaboo 图片选择器会通过此 Provider 为已保存的图片提供应用内内容链接，供应用的其他页面读取而不暴露原始文件路径。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要通过此 Provider 传递文件链接的图片流程将无法把已保存的照片交给应用。

en.description: Presage Technologies’ Physiology SDK presents a seven-step illustrated guide that users tap through as part of the app’s measurement experience.
en.disableEffect: The Presage measurement experience loses its illustrated setup guide.

zh-CN.description: Presage Technologies 的 Physiology SDK 会在应用的测量流程中展示七步图文指南，用户点击即可逐步浏览。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Presage 测量流程将失去图文设置指南。

en.description: Presage Technologies’ Physiology SDK opens the app’s camera-based measurement screen, requests camera access when needed, and opens camera capture after permission is granted; an upload option is also available.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot run the Presage camera-measurement or upload flow from this screen.

zh-CN.description: Presage Technologies 的 Physiology SDK 会打开应用的摄像头测量页面；需要时请求摄像头权限，获得授权后打开摄像头采集页面，同时提供上传选项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法通过此页面运行 Presage 摄像头测量或上传流程。

en.description: The OOFTF Image Preview library starts this Activity when the app opens a video in its preview viewer. It plays the video path supplied by the app.
en.disableEffect: Videos opened through this library's preview viewer will not play.

zh-CN.description: 应用在 OOFTF Image Preview 的预览器中打开视频时，库会启动此 Activity 播放应用提供的视频路径。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过此库预览的视频将无法播放。

en.description: The OOFTF Image Preview library opens this Activity to show images supplied by the app in a swipeable gallery. It starts at the selected image and can show a position indicator.
en.disableEffect: The app's image preview gallery will not open.

zh-CN.description: OOFTF Image Preview 会启动此 Activity，将应用提供的图片放入可滑动的浏览页面，并从选中的图片开始显示，还可显示页码提示。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用内的图片浏览页面将无法打开。

en.description: Prisma Campaigns SDK displays a full-screen campaign banner selected by the app; users can dismiss it or choose its banner action to open the associated flow.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot show this campaign banner or start its associated flow from it.

zh-CN.description: Prisma Campaigns SDK 会显示应用选定的全屏活动横幅；用户可以关闭横幅，也可以点击横幅操作进入相关流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法显示此活动横幅，也无法从横幅进入相关流程。

en.description: Prisma Campaigns SDK displays and advances the current step of an in-app flow, such as a page, message, data-entry step, or identity check, and receives results from screens opened during that flow.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot complete the app’s Prisma campaign flow, including any identity-check step it contains.

zh-CN.description: Prisma Campaigns SDK 会显示并推进应用流程中的当前步骤，例如页面、消息、信息填写或身份核验，并接收该流程打开的其他页面返回的结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法完成应用的 Prisma 活动流程，包括其中的身份核验步骤。

en.description: ProcessOut Android SDK opens a card-scanning sheet when the payment flow requests it, asks for camera access, and returns the scanned card to the app.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot scan a card, and a checkout that relies on this step cannot continue.

zh-CN.description: ProcessOut Android SDK 会在支付流程请求扫描银行卡时打开扫描页面、申请摄像头权限，并将扫描到的银行卡交回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法扫描银行卡，依赖此步骤的结账流程也无法继续。

en.description: ProcessOut Android SDK opens the card-entry sheet when the app requests card tokenization and returns the resulting card or an error to the payment flow.
en.disableEffect: New card tokenization cannot complete, so the related card payment or save-card flow may fail.

zh-CN.description: ProcessOut Android SDK 会在应用请求银行卡令牌化时打开银行卡填写页面，并将处理后的银行卡或错误结果交回支付流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 新银行卡的令牌化无法完成，相关支付或保存银行卡流程可能失败。

en.description: ProcessOut Android SDK opens the card-entry sheet when the app requests card tokenization and returns the resulting card or an error to the payment flow.
en.disableEffect: New card tokenization cannot complete, so the related card payment or save-card flow may fail.

zh-CN.description: ProcessOut Android SDK 会在应用请求银行卡令牌化时打开银行卡填写页面，并将处理后的银行卡或错误结果交回支付流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 新银行卡的令牌化无法完成，相关支付或保存银行卡流程可能失败。

en.description: ProcessOut Android SDK opens the card-update sheet when a saved payment card needs new details, then returns the updated card or an error.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot update the selected payment card through ProcessOut, so payments that need its replacement details may fail.

zh-CN.description: ProcessOut Android SDK 会在保存的银行卡需要更新信息时打开银行卡更新页面，并交回更新后的银行卡或错误结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 ProcessOut 更新所选银行卡，需要替换信息的支付可能失败。

en.description: ProcessOut Android SDK opens the configured checkout screen and coordinates the selected payment method, card entry, saved cards, Google Pay, and available alternative methods.
en.disableEffect: The app’s ProcessOut checkout cannot complete.

zh-CN.description: ProcessOut Android SDK 会打开配置好的结账页面，并协调所选支付方式、银行卡填写、已保存银行卡、Google Pay 和可用的其他支付方式。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用的 ProcessOut 结账流程将无法完成。

en.description: ProcessOut Android SDK opens the configured checkout screen and coordinates the selected payment method, card entry, saved cards, Google Pay, and available alternative methods.
en.disableEffect: The app’s ProcessOut checkout cannot complete.

zh-CN.description: ProcessOut Android SDK 会打开配置好的结账页面，并协调所选支付方式、银行卡填写、已保存银行卡、Google Pay 和可用的其他支付方式。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用的 ProcessOut 结账流程将无法完成。

en.description: ProcessOut Android SDK opens the native payment sheet for an alternative payment option selected during checkout and returns its completion or failure.
en.disableEffect: The selected alternative payment flow cannot continue.

zh-CN.description: ProcessOut Android SDK 会在结账时为用户选择的其他支付方式打开原生支付页面，并交回完成或失败结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 所选的其他支付方式将无法继续。

en.description: ProcessOut Android SDK opens the native payment sheet for an alternative payment option selected during checkout and returns its completion or failure.
en.disableEffect: The selected alternative payment flow cannot continue.

zh-CN.description: ProcessOut Android SDK 会在结账时为用户选择的其他支付方式打开原生支付页面，并交回完成或失败结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 所选的其他支付方式将无法继续。

en.description: ProcessOut Android SDK displays the customer’s saved payment methods when checkout asks them to choose one.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot show or select a saved payment method through the ProcessOut flow.

zh-CN.description: ProcessOut Android SDK 会在结账要求用户选择已保存的支付方式时显示相应列表。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法通过 ProcessOut 流程显示或选择已保存的支付方式。

en.description: ProcessOut Android SDK opens a payment provider’s authorization page in a browser tab and listens for the return link so it can send the result to checkout.
en.disableEffect: Redirect-based payment authorization cannot return to the app, so affected payments may fail.

zh-CN.description: ProcessOut Android SDK 会在浏览器标签页中打开支付服务商的授权页面，并等待回跳链接，再将结果交回结账流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 重定向式支付授权无法返回应用，相关支付可能失败。

en.description: ProcessOut Android SDK receives the app’s return link after external payment authorization, passes it to the payment flow, and closes.
en.disableEffect: The payment provider’s return link will not be processed, so redirect-based payments may not finish.

zh-CN.description: ProcessOut Android SDK 会在外部支付授权完成后接收应用的回跳链接，将链接交给支付流程，然后关闭页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 支付服务商的回跳链接将无法处理，重定向式支付可能无法完成。

en.description: ProcessOut Android SDK opens a configured payment authorization page in an in-app browser and returns success or cancellation to the payment flow.
en.disableEffect: Payments that require in-app web authorization cannot complete.

zh-CN.description: ProcessOut Android SDK 会在应用内浏览器中打开配置好的支付授权页面，并将成功或取消结果交回支付流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要应用内网页授权的支付将无法完成。

en.description: Prodege’s monetization SDK opens full-screen placement content when the app shows an ad, rewarded ad, or survey offer.
en.disableEffect: Prodege ads and survey offers will not open, and rewards tied to completing rewarded ads will not be granted.

zh-CN.description: Prodege 的变现 SDK 会在应用展示广告、激励广告或问卷活动时打开全屏内容页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Prodege 广告和问卷活动将无法打开，通过观看激励广告获得的奖励也无法发放。

en.description: Prodege’s survey and ad SDK launches this full screen page for a selected placement and returns the outcome to the SDK.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to view Prodege ads or surveys in the app.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 Prodege 广告或问卷时，该 SDK 会针对所选展示位打开此全屏页面，并将结果返回给 SDK。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法在应用中查看 Prodege 广告或问卷。

en.description: The ProductLayer SDK for Android opens this screen when the app requests a full-screen product photo. It loads the selected image and, for a signed-in user, shows controls for voting on that image.
en.disableEffect: Users will lose the app's full-screen product image and image-voting screen.

zh-CN.description: ProductLayer Android SDK 会在应用打开商品大图时启动此页面，加载所选图片；已登录用户还可以对图片投票。
