zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法在应用中查看商品全屏图片或为图片投票。

en.description: When the app asks to scan a product barcode, the ProductLayer SDK for Android opens the camera, reads and checks the code, then returns the product number to the app.
en.disableEffect: Product lookup by barcode will no longer work.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求扫描商品条码时，ProductLayer Android SDK 会打开相机读取并校验条码，再将商品编号返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用将无法通过扫描条码查找商品。

en.description: When the Android Cloud framework receives one of its internal event broadcasts, this Receiver forwards the event details to registered app listeners.
en.disableEffect: App or SDK features that depend on these framework events may stop responding or updating.

zh-CN.description: Android Cloud 框架收到内部事件广播时，此 Receiver 会把事件内容转交给已注册的应用监听器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖这些框架事件的应用或 SDK 功能可能停止响应或更新。

en.description: When Android Cloud shares an app file, this Provider creates a content link and allows the recipient to read the approved file.
en.disableEffect: File sharing or file access flows that use Android Cloud's content links may fail.

zh-CN.description: Android Cloud 分享应用文件时，此 Provider 会创建内容链接，并允许接收方读取获准访问的文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖 Android Cloud 内容链接的文件分享或读取流程可能失败。

en.description: When Android Cloud utilities share an approved app file, this Provider exposes it through a content link and supplies its file details.
en.disableEffect: Uploads, shares, or other flows that use these file links may fail.

zh-CN.description: Android Cloud 工具分享获准的应用文件时，此 Provider 会通过内容链接提供文件，并返回文件信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖这些文件链接的上传、分享或其他流程可能失败。

en.description: During an external payment-authentication step, the Hyperswitch Android payment SDK opens this Activity to show a browser page and return to checkout when the user closes it.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, payment-authentication pages opened this way may not return to checkout.

zh-CN.description: 在外部支付验证步骤中，Hyperswitch Android 支付 SDK 会打开此 Activity 显示浏览器页面，并在用户关闭页面后返回结账流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，通过此方式打开的支付验证页面可能无法返回结账流程。

en.description: Nutrient (formerly PSPDFKit) Android PDF SDK uses this provider to load its license and initialize the SDK automatically when the app starts.
en.disableEffect: PDF features that rely on automatic SDK initialization may fail to start.

zh-CN.description: Nutrient（原 PSPDFKit）Android PDF SDK 使用此 Provider 在应用启动时加载许可并自动初始化，为 PDF 功能做好准备。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖 SDK 自动初始化的 PDF 功能可能无法启动。

en.description: Nutrient (formerly PSPDFKit) Android PDF SDK opens Android's print interface for a selected document and starts its print job.
en.disableEffect: Apps will not be able to print PDFs through the Nutrient document SDK.

zh-CN.description: Nutrient（原 PSPDFKit）Android PDF SDK 在用户请求打印文档时打开 Android 打印界面并提交打印任务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法通过 Nutrient 文档 SDK 打印 PDF。

en.description: Nutrient (formerly PSPDFKit) Android PDF SDK uses this provider to serve temporary PDF files to other apps through secure content links.
en.disableEffect: PDF sharing or export can fail because the app cannot provide the document link or temporary file.

zh-CN.description: Nutrient（原 PSPDFKit）Android PDF SDK 通过此 Provider 以内容链接向其他应用提供临时 PDF 文件，支持文档分享和导出。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用无法提供文档链接或临时文件时，PDF 分享或导出可能失败。

en.description: The PSPDFKit/Nutrient PDF SDK runs this private provider as the app process starts to prepare its PDF features before documents are opened.
en.disableEffect: Apps that rely on this automatic setup may fail to open PDF documents or use the SDK's viewing and editing tools.

zh-CN.description: PSPDFKit/Nutrient PDF SDK 会在应用进程启动时自动运行此私有组件，为打开文档准备 PDF 功能。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此自动初始化的应用可能无法打开 PDF 文档或使用 SDK 的阅读和编辑工具。

en.description: Nutrient (formerly PSPDFKit) Android PDF SDK uses this provider to open packaged asset files requested through its content links.
en.disableEffect: PDF features that depend on these app-packaged assets may fail to load them.

zh-CN.description: Nutrient（原 PSPDFKit）Android PDF SDK 根据内容链接从应用包内打开资源文件，供 PDF 功能读取。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖这些应用内资源的 PDF 功能可能无法加载所需文件。

en.description: FancyDSP’s PTG ad SDK opens this screen for interactive ad pages. It shows advertiser content in an embedded browser and responds to page links and ad actions.
en.disableEffect: Interactive PTG ad pages and their in-app actions will not open.

zh-CN.description: FancyDSP 的 PTG 广告 SDK 会为互动广告页面打开此界面，在应用内浏览器中显示广告内容并响应页面链接和广告操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: PTG 互动广告页面及其应用内操作将无法打开。

en.description: FancyDSP’s PTG ad SDK uses this provider to share downloaded ad files with Android, including files used by the installer.
en.disableEffect: Downloaded app or media files used in PTG ad flows may not open or install.

zh-CN.description: FancyDSP 的 PTG 广告 SDK 会通过此提供程序将下载的广告文件交给 Android 使用，包括安装程序需要的文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: PTG 广告流程中的应用或媒体文件可能无法打开或安装。

en.description: FancyDSP’s Tencent GDT integration opens this screen when the app requests an incentive ad. It displays the ad and reports when it is shown, clicked or closed.
en.disableEffect: Tencent GDT ads that use this page will not appear.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求激励广告时，FancyDSP 的腾讯广点通集成会打开此页面；页面展示广告，并回报广告的展示、点击和关闭事件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此页面的腾讯广点通广告将不再显示。

en.description: FancyDSP’s iFlytek Voice Ads integration opens this screen for a rewarded video. It displays the video and tracks whether playback has reached the point where the user may close it.
en.disableEffect: Users will not receive the app’s reward for watching an iFlytek video ad.

zh-CN.description: FancyDSP 的科大讯飞 Voice Ads 集成会为激励视频打开此页面；页面播放视频，并根据播放进度决定何时允许用户关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户观看讯飞广告后将无法获得应用提供的奖励。

en.description: FancyDSP’s PTG ad SDK opens this screen after an ad is tapped to show the advertiser’s web page in the app. Links can open in the browser or another app.
en.disableEffect: PTG ad landing pages will not open inside the app.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击广告后，FancyDSP 的 PTG 广告 SDK 会在应用内打开此页面，显示广告主网页；其中的链接也可以交给浏览器或其他应用打开。
zh-CN.disableEffect: PTG 广告落地页将无法在应用内打开。

en.description: FancyDSP’s PTG ad SDK opens this screen to play a rewarded video when the app requests one. It reports the playback outcome and can handle a promoted-app download.
en.disableEffect: Users will not receive the app’s reward for watching a PTG video ad.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求激励视频时，FancyDSP 的 PTG 广告 SDK 会打开此页面播放视频；页面回报播放结果，也可处理广告推广应用的下载。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户观看 PTG 视频广告后将无法获得应用提供的奖励。

en.description: FancyDSP’s PTG ad SDK starts this background service to fetch ad files and app packages and to handle download or cancel requests. It has no screen.
en.disableEffect: PTG ads that need downloaded files or app packages will not finish loading.

zh-CN.description: FancyDSP 的 PTG 广告 SDK 会启动此后台服务获取广告文件和应用安装包，并处理下载或取消请求；它不显示界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要下载文件或安装包的 PTG 广告将无法完成加载。

en.description: Pubscale SDKOne starts this job service when it schedules a crash report for upload. The service sends the report to Pubscale and saves it locally if the upload fails.
en.disableEffect: Pubscale will stop uploading crash reports through this service, reducing crash diagnostics.

zh-CN.description: Pubscale SDKOne 在安排崩溃报告上传时会启动此后台服务。服务会将报告发送给 Pubscale；上传失败时会在本地保存报告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Pubscale 将无法通过此服务上传崩溃报告，崩溃诊断信息会减少。

en.description: Pubscale SDKOne queues this background service for crash reports on its compatibility path. It uploads the report and saves it locally if the request fails.
en.disableEffect: Crash reports handled by Pubscale's compatibility service will no longer be uploaded.

zh-CN.description: Pubscale SDKOne 在兼容处理路径中会将崩溃报告任务交给此后台服务。服务会上传报告，并在请求失败时将报告保存在本地。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Pubscale 兼容服务处理的崩溃报告将无法上传。

en.description: The Pubscale SDKOne ad SDK opens this screen to show an ad placement, such as an interstitial or app-open ad. It selects the display for the ad format being shown.
en.disableEffect: Ads shown through this Pubscale SDKOne screen will no longer appear.

zh-CN.description: Pubscale SDKOne 广告 SDK 会在展示插页广告、应用打开广告等广告位时打开此页面，并按广告形式显示内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，通过此页面展示的 Pubscale SDKOne 广告将不再出现。

en.description: When a Pubscale SDKOne offerwall reminder alarm fires, this receiver handles the scheduled reminder for one offer or for all offers.
en.disableEffect: Scheduled Pubscale offerwall reminders will not be delivered.

zh-CN.description: Pubscale SDKOne 激励墙提醒的定时闹钟触发时，此接收器会处理针对某个或全部优惠的预定提醒。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Pubscale 激励墙的定时提醒将无法送达。

en.description: Pubscale SDKOne uses this receiver after device boot, app replacement, clock changes, or timezone changes to restore and reschedule offerwall reminders.
en.disableEffect: Offerwall reminders may not be restored after a reboot, app update, or clock change.

zh-CN.description: 设备启动、应用更新、时间或时区变化时，Pubscale SDKOne 会通过此接收器恢复并重新安排激励墙提醒。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，重启、应用更新或时间变化后可能无法恢复激励墙提醒。

en.description: Pubscale SDKOne opens this screen to show its native offerwall, where users browse available offers and surveys.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to open the Pubscale offerwall or use its offers and surveys.

zh-CN.description: Pubscale SDKOne 会打开此页面展示原生激励墙，供用户浏览可用优惠和调查。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法打开 Pubscale 激励墙或使用其中的优惠和调查。

en.description: When a survey returns through Pubscale SDKOne's survey-completion link, this screen checks the result code and sends the completion or reward status back to the offerwall flow.
en.disableEffect: Completed surveys may not report their outcome or reward to the Pubscale offerwall.

zh-CN.description: 调查通过 Pubscale SDKOne 的完成链接返回时，此页面会检查结果代码，并将完成状态或奖励状态交回激励墙流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，已完成的调查可能无法向 Pubscale 激励墙报告结果或奖励状态。

en.description: Pubscale SDKOne opens this screen when a user enters its offerwall. It displays the configured offerwall page and handles its offer links.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to open the Pubscale offerwall page or use offers shown there.

zh-CN.description: 用户进入 Pubscale SDKOne 激励墙时，SDK 会打开此页面展示配置好的激励墙内容并处理其中的优惠链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法打开 Pubscale 激励墙页面或使用其中的优惠。

en.description: When a user opens a Pubscale offerwall notification, this screen restores the saved offerwall setup, initializes the SDK, and then opens the offerwall.
en.disableEffect: Opening a Pubscale offerwall notification will no longer take the user to the offerwall.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 Pubscale 激励墙通知时，此页面会恢复已保存的激励墙设置、初始化 SDK，然后打开激励墙。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户点击 Pubscale 激励墙通知将无法进入激励墙。

en.description: When Android reports that the device has finished booting, the Pulsate SDK runs its startup routine so its engagement features can resume.
en.disableEffect: Pulsate's explicit startup work after a reboot will be skipped, which can delay background messaging and location engagement until the app starts again.

zh-CN.description: Android 通知设备启动完成时，Pulsate SDK 会运行启动流程，以恢复其用户互动功能。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Pulsate 在重启后的启动流程将被跳过，后台消息和位置互动功能可能要等应用再次启动才恢复。

en.description: The Pulsate SDK runs this private provider automatically when the app process starts. It creates the SDK services and performs default setup for messaging, in-app campaigns, and engagement tracking.
en.disableEffect: Disabling the automatic setup can stop Pulsate messages and campaigns from loading; app code that uses Pulsate before another setup path may fail during startup.

zh-CN.description: 应用进程启动时，Pulsate SDK 会自动运行此私有组件，创建 SDK 服务并完成消息、应用内活动和互动统计的默认初始化。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Pulsate 消息和活动可能无法加载；如果应用在其他初始化流程运行前调用 Pulsate，启动时可能失败。

en.description: The Pulsate SDK opens this screen for its internal developer diagnostics dashboard.
en.disableEffect: The Pulsate debug dashboard will be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: Pulsate SDK 会在开发者打开内部诊断面板时显示此页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Pulsate 调试面板将无法打开。

en.description: The Pulsate SDK's test-mode tools open this screen to display their testing controls.
en.disableEffect: The Pulsate test-mode screen will be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: Pulsate SDK 的测试模式工具会打开此页面显示测试控件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Pulsate 测试模式页面将无法使用。

en.description: The Pulsate SDK opens this diagnostics screen to show its in-app message testing controls.
en.disableEffect: Pulsate's in-app message diagnostics will be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: Pulsate SDK 会打开此诊断页面，显示应用内消息的测试控件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Pulsate 应用内消息诊断功能将无法使用。

en.description: The Pulsate SDK's beacon diagnostics screen shows beacon information and event logs, with map and event tabs.
en.disableEffect: Pulsate's beacon diagnostics will be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: Pulsate SDK 的信标诊断页面会通过地图和事件标签显示信标信息与事件日志。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Pulsate 信标诊断功能将无法使用。

en.description: The Pulsate SDK's geofence diagnostics screen shows a map and geofence event logs.
en.disableEffect: Pulsate's geofence diagnostics will be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: Pulsate SDK 的地理围栏诊断页面会显示地图和地理围栏事件日志。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Pulsate 地理围栏诊断功能将无法使用。

en.description: The Pulsate SDK opens this screen to display its diagnostic logs to developers.
en.disableEffect: The Pulsate diagnostic log screen will be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: Pulsate SDK 会打开此页面，向开发者显示诊断日志。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Pulsate 诊断日志页面将无法打开。

en.description: The Pulsate SDK opens this diagnostics screen to show its SDK settings controls.
en.disableEffect: Pulsate's SDK diagnostics settings will be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: Pulsate SDK 会打开此诊断页面，显示 SDK 设置控件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Pulsate SDK 诊断设置将无法使用。

en.description: The Pulsate SDK opens this diagnostics screen to show settings for the current SDK user.
en.disableEffect: Pulsate's user diagnostics settings will be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: Pulsate SDK 会打开此诊断页面，显示当前 SDK 用户的设置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Pulsate 用户诊断设置将无法使用。

en.description: When a Pulsate debug push requests an acknowledgment, this foreground service sends the receipt and message details to the SDK's acknowledgment endpoint.
en.disableEffect: Pulsate test-push acknowledgments will no longer be sent.

zh-CN.description: Pulsate 测试推送请求回执时，此前台服务会将接收回执和消息信息发送到 SDK 的回执接口。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Pulsate 测试推送的接收回执将无法发送。

en.description: When a user taps a Pulsate notification, this screen records the interaction and opens its configured destination, such as an app screen, feed, or link.
en.disableEffect: Tapping a Pulsate notification will no longer open its intended destination.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击 Pulsate 通知时，此页面会记录互动，并打开配置的目标页面、动态内容或链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，点击 Pulsate 通知将无法打开其指定目标。

en.description: When a user taps an action button on a Pulsate notification, this screen records the selected button and opens its configured destination.
en.disableEffect: Pulsate notification action buttons will no longer record the selection or open their destinations.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击 Pulsate 通知中的操作按钮时，此页面会记录所选按钮并打开其配置的目标。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Pulsate 通知操作按钮将无法记录选择或打开指定目标。

en.description: When Firebase delivers a message or refreshed registration token, the Pulsate SDK forwards it through this service for notification handling.
en.disableEffect: Pulsate push messages and refreshed delivery tokens will no longer be processed.

zh-CN.description: Firebase 收到消息或更新注册令牌时，Pulsate SDK 会通过此服务处理通知或令牌更新。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Pulsate 推送消息和更新后的令牌将无法处理。

en.description: When a user dismisses a Pulsate notification, this receiver records the dismissal and updates the SDK's notification feed.
en.disableEffect: Pulsate will stop recording notification dismissals and keeping its feed in sync after a dismissal.

zh-CN.description: 用户关闭 Pulsate 通知时，此接收器会记录关闭事件并更新 SDK 的通知动态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Pulsate 将无法记录通知关闭事件或在关闭后同步动态内容。

en.description: When a user replies from a Pulsate notification, this receiver reads the reply and sends it to the linked Pulsate conversation, then dismisses the notification.
en.disableEffect: Replies sent from Pulsate notifications will no longer reach their conversations.

zh-CN.description: 用户通过 Pulsate 通知快速回复时，此接收器会读取回复内容并发送到关联会话，然后关闭通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，通过 Pulsate 通知发送的回复将无法到达对应会话。

en.description: The Pulsate SDK Development inbox opens this screen to show SDK messages and navigate to a selected conversation or post.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to open the Pulsate message inbox.

zh-CN.description: Pulsate SDK Development 的收件箱会打开此页面展示 SDK 消息，并跳转到所选会话或文章。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法打开 Pulsate 消息收件箱。

en.description: The Pulsate SDK opens this screen for its feed landing page or a selected feed post when a message or campaign links to it.
en.disableEffect: Pulsate feed pages and linked posts will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: 消息或活动链接到 Pulsate 动态页面时，SDK 会打开此页面显示动态首页或所选文章。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Pulsate 动态页面和链接文章将无法打开。

en.description: When Pulsate displays a large in-app campaign message, this screen shows the message to the user.
en.disableEffect: Large Pulsate in-app campaign messages will no longer appear.

zh-CN.description: Pulsate 展示大型应用内活动消息时，会通过此页面向用户显示消息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Pulsate 大型应用内活动消息将不再显示。

en.description: When Android location services report a Pulsate geofence transition, this receiver passes the enter or exit event to the SDK for location-based engagement.
en.disableEffect: Pulsate will stop processing geofence entry and exit events for location-based engagement.

zh-CN.description: Android 位置服务报告 Pulsate 地理围栏状态变化时，此接收器会将进入或离开事件交给 SDK 处理位置互动。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Pulsate 将无法处理用于位置互动的地理围栏进入和离开事件。

en.description: When Android location services deliver a location update requested by Pulsate, this receiver updates the SDK's location state and most recent location.
en.disableEffect: Pulsate location-based targeting and geofence features will stop receiving location updates.

zh-CN.description: Android 位置服务提供 Pulsate 请求的位置更新时，此接收器会更新 SDK 的位置状态和最近位置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Pulsate 的位置定向和地理围栏功能将无法收到位置更新。

en.description: When a user follows a Pulsate message or notification link, this screen routes them to an app deep link, a Pulsate feed or inbox page, or a web link.
en.disableEffect: Pulsate message and notification links will no longer open their configured destinations.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 Pulsate 消息或通知链接时，此页面会将其转到应用深层链接、Pulsate 动态或收件箱页面，或网页链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Pulsate 消息和通知链接将无法打开配置的目标。

en.description: When Pulsate requests an Android permission, this screen shows the system permission prompt and returns the grant or denial result to the SDK.
en.disableEffect: Pulsate will not be able to request permissions through this flow, so permission-dependent messaging or location features may remain unavailable.

zh-CN.description: Pulsate 请求 Android 权限时，此页面会显示系统权限提示，并将允许或拒绝的结果返回给 SDK。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Pulsate 将无法通过此流程请求权限，依赖权限的消息或位置功能可能无法使用。

en.description: PulseID's Pulse SDK opens this screen to show an in-app campaign page, often after a nearby location or beacon event. It records the campaign response when an event reference is supplied.
en.disableEffect: PulseID campaign pages will not open, and their view events will not be recorded.

zh-CN.description: PulseID 的 Pulse SDK 会在附近位置或蓝牙信标触发活动时打开此页面，显示应用内活动内容；有活动编号时也会记录查看事件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: PulseID 的活动页面将无法打开，相关查看事件也不会被记录。

en.description: PulseID's Pulse SDK uses this background receiver after Android delivers an updated location. When the update includes a location fix, it schedules another check for nearby marketing zones.
en.disableEffect: PulseID may miss location-zone changes and related campaigns while the app is in the background.

zh-CN.description: Android 发送新位置后，PulseID 的 Pulse SDK 会通过此后台接收器安排附近营销区域的检查。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用在后台时，PulseID 可能无法发现位置区域变化或触发相关活动。

en.description: PulseID's Pulse SDK scans for its configured nearby Bluetooth beacons and processes the beacon identifiers it detects.
en.disableEffect: PulseID will stop detecting nearby beacons and the campaigns or events tied to them will stop.

zh-CN.description: PulseID 的 Pulse SDK 会扫描已配置的附近蓝牙信标，并处理检测到的信标编号。
zh-CN.disableEffect: PulseID 将无法继续检测附近信标，与信标关联的活动和事件也会停止。

en.description: After Android reports that the device has restarted, PulseID's Pulse SDK schedules its beacon and location-zone checks when those features are enabled.
en.disableEffect: PulseID background beacon and location-zone checks may not resume automatically after a device restart.

zh-CN.description: 设备重启后，若相关功能已启用，PulseID 的 Pulse SDK 会重新安排信标扫描和位置区域检查。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 设备重启后，PulseID 的后台信标扫描和位置区域检查可能不会自动恢复。

en.description: PulseID's Pulse SDK runs this background service to fetch campaign settings and update its beacon and location-zone schedules from the server.
en.disableEffect: PulseID campaign settings and related beacon or location-zone checks will no longer refresh.

zh-CN.description: PulseID 的 Pulse SDK 会通过此后台服务获取活动设置，并根据服务器配置更新信标和位置区域检查。
zh-CN.disableEffect: PulseID 的活动设置以及相关信标或位置区域检查将无法继续更新。

en.description: PulseID's Pulse SDK sends engagement events such as app installation, location-permission changes, and beacon or location-zone entry and exit to its service.
en.disableEffect: PulseID will stop recording these engagement and campaign-response events.

zh-CN.description: PulseID 的 Pulse SDK 会向其服务发送应用安装、位置权限变化以及进入或离开信标和位置区域等互动事件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: PulseID 将停止记录这些互动和活动响应事件。

en.description: PulseID's Pulse SDK receives location-zone transition alerts here and passes them to its background processor.
en.disableEffect: PulseID will miss location-zone entry and exit alerts, so location-triggered campaigns may stop.

zh-CN.description: PulseID 的 Pulse SDK 会在此接收位置区域变化提醒，并交给后台服务处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: PulseID 将无法收到位置区域的进入和离开提醒，基于位置的活动可能会停止。

en.description: PulseID's Pulse SDK processes entry, exit, and refresh alerts for its location zones, records the transition, and requests the matching campaign.
en.disableEffect: PulseID location-zone events and campaigns triggered by entering or leaving an area will stop.

zh-CN.description: PulseID 的 Pulse SDK 会处理位置区域的进入、离开和刷新提醒，记录变化并请求对应活动。
zh-CN.disableEffect: PulseID 的位置区域事件以及进入或离开区域后触发的活动将停止。

en.description: PulseID's Pulse SDK uses the device's location to fetch, add, refresh, or remove the location zones it monitors.
en.disableEffect: PulseID will no longer monitor or update its location-based marketing zones.

zh-CN.description: PulseID 的 Pulse SDK 会根据设备位置获取、添加、刷新或移除需要监控的位置区域。
zh-CN.disableEffect: PulseID 将无法继续监控或更新基于位置的营销区域。

en.description: When a PulseID campaign message is tapped, the Pulse SDK records the response and tries to open its phone, email, web, or app link.
en.disableEffect: Tapping a PulseID campaign will no longer open its destination or record the click.

zh-CN.description: 点击 PulseID 活动消息时，Pulse SDK 会记录响应并尝试打开电话、邮件、网页或应用链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 点击 PulseID 活动消息后将无法打开目标页面，点击事件也不会被记录。

en.description: PulseID's Pulse SDK requests a matching campaign after a beacon or location-zone event, then displays its alert or opens its campaign content according to the SDK settings.
en.disableEffect: PulseID will stop fetching and showing campaigns triggered by nearby beacons or location zones.

zh-CN.description: 蓝牙信标或位置区域触发事件后，PulseID 的 Pulse SDK 会请求对应活动，并按设置显示提醒或活动内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: PulseID 将停止获取和显示由附近信标或位置区域触发的活动。

en.description: PulseID's Pulse SDK updates the audience groups attached to a user session, including adding, clearing, or replacing group assignments.
en.disableEffect: PulseID audience groups will no longer update, which may affect campaigns targeted to those groups.

zh-CN.description: PulseID 的 Pulse SDK 会更新用户会话所属的受众分组，包括添加、清除或替换分组。
zh-CN.disableEffect: PulseID 的受众分组将无法更新，针对这些分组的活动可能受到影响。

en.description: Luoqqsh's Push SDK Google adapter receives Firebase notifications and passes their title, text, and click destination to the app's push callback. It also records new registration-token events.
en.disableEffect: Google-delivered notifications and their click actions will stop reaching the app through this SDK.

zh-CN.description: Luoqqsh 的 Push SDK Google 适配器接收 Firebase 通知，并将标题、正文和点击目标交给应用的推送回调。它也会记录新的注册令牌事件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Google 推送通知及其点击操作将无法再通过此 SDK 送达应用。

en.description: Pusher's Android client SDK handles Firebase token refreshes here and passes the new token to its notification-token registry.
en.disableEffect: Pusher notification registration may stop working after Firebase refreshes the token.

zh-CN.description: Pusher Android 客户端 SDK 会在此处理 Firebase 令牌刷新，并把新令牌交给通知令牌注册器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Firebase 刷新令牌后，Pusher 通知注册可能无法继续工作。

en.description: Pusher Push Notifications receives Firebase messages through this service and forwards them to a listener for the app's visible screen; its default message callback adds no further handling.
en.disableEffect: Pusher message delivery to the app's foreground listener will stop.

zh-CN.description: Pusher Push Notifications 会通过此服务接收 Firebase 消息，并转交给应用当前页面的监听器；默认消息回调不会继续处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用前台监听器将无法再收到 Pusher 消息。

en.description: At app startup, Pusher Push Notifications resumes saved notification instances and registers screen-lifecycle callbacks used for notification reporting.
en.disableEffect: Pusher notification instances may not resume automatically, and app-visibility reporting may stop.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，Pusher Push Notifications 会恢复已保存的通知实例，并注册用于通知报告的页面生命周期回调。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Pusher 通知实例可能无法自动恢复，应用前后台状态的报告也可能停止。

en.description: When a Pusher push arrives, this receiver checks its delivery metadata and queues a delivery report when Pusher tracking is enabled.
en.disableEffect: Pusher will stop recording delivery reports for received messages.

zh-CN.description: Pusher 推送到达时，此接收器会检查消息信息；启用追踪后会排队发送送达报告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Pusher 将停止记录已接收消息的送达报告。

en.description: When a Pusher notification is tapped, this screen records the open event and launches the app or the message's configured destination.
en.disableEffect: Tapping Pusher notifications may no longer open their configured destination or record the open event.

zh-CN.description: 点击 Pusher 通知时，此页面会记录打开事件，并启动应用或消息指定的目标页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 点击 Pusher 通知后，可能无法打开指定页面，也不会记录打开事件。

en.description: Pusher Push Notifications runs this background job to send queued message-delivery and notification-open reports when a network connection is available.
en.disableEffect: Pusher delivery and notification-open reports will no longer be uploaded.

zh-CN.description: 有网络连接时，Pusher Push Notifications 会通过此后台任务上传排队的消息送达和通知打开报告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Pusher 将不再上传消息送达和通知打开报告。

en.description: PushPole's SDK opens this screen briefly when it needs to run a queued background task, then closes the screen.
en.disableEffect: PushPole tasks routed through this temporary screen will not run.

zh-CN.description: PushPole SDK 需要运行排队的后台任务时会短暂打开此页面，然后立即关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过此临时页面运行的 PushPole 任务将无法执行。

en.description: PushPole's SDK opens this screen to show a custom message with buttons and, when requested, text fields.
en.disableEffect: PushPole pop-up messages and their response controls will no longer appear.

zh-CN.description: PushPole SDK 会通过此页面显示带按钮的自定义消息，并可按需显示文本输入框。
zh-CN.disableEffect: PushPole 的弹窗消息及其交互控件将不再显示。

en.description: When PushPole asks for device-identifier access, this screen presents its privacy prompt. If the user agrees and Android grants phone-state access, the SDK can read the device identifier and send the response to PushPole.
en.disableEffect: PushPole will not be able to show this consent prompt or submit its response and permitted device identifier.

zh-CN.description: PushPole 请求访问设备标识时，此页面会显示隐私说明；用户同意且 Android 授予电话状态权限后，SDK 可以读取设备标识并向 PushPole 提交选择结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: PushPole 将无法显示此授权提示，也无法提交用户选择及获准读取的设备标识。

en.description: PushPole's SDK opens this screen to display a web page from a push message and receive a result submitted by the page.
en.disableEffect: Web pages opened from PushPole messages and their in-page response flow will stop working.

zh-CN.description: PushPole SDK 会通过此页面显示推送消息中的网页，并接收网页提交的结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: PushPole 消息中的网页及其页面内响应流程将无法使用。

en.description: PushPole's SDK receives Firebase push messages and refreshed registration tokens here, then passes them to its notification handler.
en.disableEffect: PushPole push messages will stop arriving through this service, and refreshed tokens will not be registered.

zh-CN.description: PushPole SDK 会在此接收 Firebase 推送消息和更新后的注册令牌，再交给通知处理器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 此服务停止后，PushPole 推送消息将无法送达，更新后的令牌也不会被注册。

en.description: PushPole's SDK uses this file-sharing provider to grant access to app files and installs its crash-reporting hook when the app starts; it also starts Sentry reporting when configured.
en.disableEffect: File links provided through PushPole may fail, and its crash-reporting startup hook will not run.

zh-CN.description: PushPole SDK 会通过此文件共享提供程序授权访问应用文件，并在应用启动时安装崩溃报告处理器；配置了 Sentry 时也会启动 Sentry 报告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过 PushPole 提供的文件链接可能失效，其崩溃报告启动处理也不会运行。

en.description: When PushPole's background-job system requests a job creator, this receiver registers the scheduler that creates PushPole tasks.
en.disableEffect: PushPole background tasks may no longer be registered with its scheduler.

zh-CN.description: PushPole 的后台任务系统请求任务创建器时，此接收器会注册用于创建 PushPole 任务的调度器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: PushPole 的后台任务可能无法再通过其调度器注册。

en.description: When Android reports that an app was installed or fully removed, PushPole's SDK sends installation details or a removal record to PushPole.
en.disableEffect: PushPole will stop recording app installation and removal events.

zh-CN.description: Android 报告应用安装或完全卸载时，PushPole SDK 会向 PushPole 发送安装信息或卸载记录。
zh-CN.disableEffect: PushPole 将停止记录应用安装和卸载事件。

en.description: After a device restart, PushPole's SDK records the startup event and initializes its background work. While its screen-monitoring service is active, it also records when the screen turns on and off.
en.disableEffect: PushPole may not restart its background work after reboot or record screen-use times.

zh-CN.description: 设备重启后，PushPole SDK 会记录启动事件并初始化后台任务；屏幕监控服务运行时，它也会记录屏幕亮起和熄灭的时间。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 设备重启后 PushPole 可能无法恢复后台任务，也不会记录屏幕使用时间。

en.description: When network connectivity changes, PushPole's SDK initializes itself if needed and records network type and data-use information.
en.disableEffect: PushPole may not initialize after a connectivity change or update its network-usage records.

zh-CN.description: 网络连接状态变化时，PushPole SDK 会在需要时初始化，并记录网络类型和流量使用信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 网络状态变化后，PushPole 可能无法初始化或更新网络流量记录。

en.description: After the host app is updated, PushPole's SDK clears its old Firebase token and schedules registration of a fresh token with Firebase and PushPole.
en.disableEffect: PushPole push delivery may stop after an app update because its token will not be refreshed.

zh-CN.description: 宿主应用更新后，PushPole SDK 会清除旧的 Firebase 令牌，并安排向 Firebase 和 PushPole 注册新令牌。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用更新后，PushPole 推送可能因令牌未刷新而停止送达。

en.description: PushPole's SDK uses this background service to run queued tasks and process task requests.
en.disableEffect: PushPole tasks routed through this service will not run.

zh-CN.description: PushPole SDK 会通过此后台服务执行排队任务和处理任务请求。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过此服务运行的 PushPole 任务将无法执行。

en.description: PushPole's SDK processes movement updates from Android and records whether the device is still, walking, running, cycling, or in a vehicle.
en.disableEffect: PushPole will stop recording movement-activity updates.

zh-CN.description: PushPole SDK 会处理 Android 提供的活动识别结果，并记录设备静止、步行、跑步、骑车或乘车等状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: PushPole 将停止记录活动识别更新。

en.description: PushPole's SDK runs this service to listen for screen-on and screen-off changes and record their times.
en.disableEffect: PushPole will stop recording screen-use times.

zh-CN.description: PushPole SDK 会通过此服务监听屏幕亮起和熄灭状态并记录时间。
zh-CN.disableEffect: PushPole 将停止记录屏幕使用时间。

en.description: When Android runs PushPole's scheduled network job, this service records connection type and app/device data-use totals for PushPole.
en.disableEffect: PushPole network-usage records will stop updating.

zh-CN.description: Android 执行 PushPole 计划的网络任务时，此服务会记录连接类型以及应用和设备的流量统计。
zh-CN.disableEffect: PushPole 的网络流量记录将停止更新。

en.description: After Android finishes restarting, this Pushwoosh push SDK receiver notifies the SDK so it can run its boot-time push tasks.
en.disableEffect: Pushwoosh may miss push work that needs to resume after a device restart.

zh-CN.description: Android 完成重启后，Pushwoosh 推送 SDK 会收到此事件，以便继续执行开机后的推送任务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，Pushwoosh 可能无法恢复需要在重启后继续的推送任务。

en.description: Firebase starts this Pushwoosh service when it refreshes the app's messaging token; the service sends the new token to Pushwoosh.
en.disableEffect: Pushwoosh may stop delivering Firebase notifications after the token changes.

zh-CN.description: Firebase 刷新应用的消息令牌时会启动此 Pushwoosh 服务；服务会把新令牌发送给 Pushwoosh。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 令牌变更后，Pushwoosh 可能无法继续投递 Firebase 推送。

en.description: Google Play services starts this Pushwoosh service when it refreshes the app's GCM token, so Pushwoosh can update the notification registration.
en.disableEffect: Pushwoosh may stop delivering GCM notifications after the token changes.

zh-CN.description: Google Play 服务刷新应用的 GCM 令牌时会启动此 Pushwoosh 服务，以更新推送注册信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 令牌变更后，Pushwoosh 可能无法继续投递 GCM 推送。

en.description: When a Pushwoosh notification is opened, this receiver passes its data to Pushwoosh so it can open the intended screen or link.
en.disableEffect: Tapping a Pushwoosh notification may no longer open its intended screen or link.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 Pushwoosh 通知时，此接收器会把通知内容交给 SDK，以打开通知指定的页面或链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，点击 Pushwoosh 通知可能无法进入预期页面或链接。

en.description: Pushwoosh runs this receiver when a user dismisses a Pushwoosh notification or taps one of its custom action buttons. It updates the notification state and passes the selected action to Pushwoosh.
en.disableEffect: Pushwoosh notification dismissals and custom action buttons will no longer be processed.

zh-CN.description: 用户关闭 Pushwoosh 通知或点击其中的自定义操作按钮时，Pushwoosh 会运行此接收器来更新通知状态并处理所选操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Pushwoosh 将不再处理通知关闭事件和自定义操作按钮。

en.description: Pushwoosh's Amazon messaging service runs when Amazon Device Messaging delivers a push message or a registration result. It forwards the message and device registration changes to Pushwoosh.
en.disableEffect: Pushwoosh will stop receiving messages and registration updates through Amazon Device Messaging.

zh-CN.description: Amazon Device Messaging 送达推送消息或注册结果时，Pushwoosh 的亚马逊消息服务会运行，并把消息和设备注册变更交给 Pushwoosh 处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Pushwoosh 将无法再通过 Amazon Device Messaging 接收消息和注册状态更新。

en.description: Amazon Device Messaging starts this Pushwoosh service for registration results, errors, and incoming messages; it forwards them to Pushwoosh.
en.disableEffect: Amazon-delivered Pushwoosh notifications and registration updates will stop.

zh-CN.description: Amazon Device Messaging 会在注册成功、出错或收到消息时启动此 Pushwoosh 服务，并把事件交给 Pushwoosh 处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，Amazon 推送通知和注册状态更新将停止。

en.description: This receiver accepts Amazon Device Messaging registration and message broadcasts and directs them to Pushwoosh's message handler.
en.disableEffect: Amazon-delivered Pushwoosh notifications will not arrive.

zh-CN.description: 此接收器接收 Amazon Device Messaging 的注册和消息广播，并将其交给 Pushwoosh 处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，应用将无法收到通过 Amazon 投递的 Pushwoosh 通知。

en.description: Firebase starts this Pushwoosh service when a push message arrives, and the service passes the message to Pushwoosh.
en.disableEffect: Incoming Firebase push notifications will no longer be handled by Pushwoosh.

zh-CN.description: Firebase 收到推送消息时会启动此 Pushwoosh 服务，再由服务把消息交给 Pushwoosh 处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，Pushwoosh 将无法处理收到的 Firebase 推送。

en.description: Google Cloud Messaging starts this Pushwoosh service for incoming messages, which it passes to Pushwoosh's notification handler.
en.disableEffect: Incoming GCM notifications will no longer be handled by Pushwoosh.

zh-CN.description: Google Cloud Messaging 收到消息时会启动此 Pushwoosh 服务，并将消息交给 Pushwoosh 处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，Pushwoosh 将无法处理收到的 GCM 推送。

en.description: Android starts this provider while creating the app process, and it initializes the Pushwoosh push SDK automatically.
en.disableEffect: Pushwoosh will not initialize automatically, so its notifications and related features may stop working.

zh-CN.description: Android 创建应用进程时会自动启动此组件，并初始化 Pushwoosh 推送 SDK。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，Pushwoosh 不会自动初始化，其推送及相关功能可能停止。

en.description: When Pushwoosh schedules background work, Android starts this service to carry it out.
en.disableEffect: Scheduled Pushwoosh background tasks will not run.

zh-CN.description: Pushwoosh 安排后台任务时，Android 会启动此服务来执行这些任务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，Pushwoosh 安排的后台任务将无法运行。

en.description: When another trusted Pushwoosh app asks for the shared device ID, this provider returns the ID used by Pushwoosh in this app. Related apps can then use the same push identity.
en.disableEffect: Other trusted Pushwoosh apps will no longer be able to read this app's shared push device ID.

zh-CN.description: 受信任的其他 Pushwoosh 应用查询共享设备标识时，此数据提供器会返回本应用使用的 Pushwoosh 设备 ID，让相关应用共用同一推送身份。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 其他受信任的 Pushwoosh 应用将无法再读取本应用共享的推送设备 ID。

en.description: Android starts this provider during app startup to initialize Pushwoosh's Amazon push integration.
en.disableEffect: Amazon push notifications through Pushwoosh will not initialize.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，Android 会启动此组件来初始化 Pushwoosh 的 Amazon 推送集成。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，Pushwoosh 的 Amazon 推送功能将无法初始化。

en.description: At app startup, Pushwoosh's Baidu integration registers Baidu as a push provider for the SDK. This prepares the app to register for and receive Baidu push messages.
en.disableEffect: Pushwoosh's Baidu push registration and message delivery will not initialize.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，Pushwoosh 的百度集成会向 SDK 注册百度推送支持，为设备注册和接收百度推送做准备。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Pushwoosh 的百度推送注册和消息接收将无法初始化。

en.description: Baidu Push starts this receiver for incoming messages, notification events, and registration callbacks. Pushwoosh forwards message content to its notification handling and records successful or failed registration.
en.disableEffect: Pushwoosh will stop receiving Baidu push messages and registration updates.

zh-CN.description: 百度推送送达消息、通知事件或注册回调时会启动此接收器；Pushwoosh 会处理消息内容并记录注册成功或失败的状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Pushwoosh 将无法再接收百度推送消息和注册状态更新。

en.description: When Pushwoosh's Baidu integration requests phone-state permission, it opens this Activity to show Android's permission prompt and return the user's choice to the SDK.
en.disableEffect: Baidu push registration may fail when the integration needs to request phone-state permission.

zh-CN.description: Pushwoosh 的百度集成请求读取手机状态的权限时，会打开此 Activity 显示系统授权提示，并把用户的选择交回 SDK。

en.description: Qihoo 360 Game Center uses this Activity to host a game-center screen loaded by the SDK when that screen is requested.
en.disableEffect: Qihoo game-center screens that use this host, including account or purchase screens, will not open.

zh-CN.description: 奇虎 360 游戏中心请求运行某个页面时，会用此 Activity 承载 SDK 提供的页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此承载页面的奇虎 360 游戏中心功能（包括账号或购买页面）将无法打开。

en.description: Qihoo 360 Game Center uses this Service to run a background task supplied by a game-center feature when that task is requested.
en.disableEffect: Qihoo game-center features that need this background task will not run.

zh-CN.description: 奇虎 360 游戏中心功能请求后台任务时，会通过此 Service 运行相应任务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此后台任务的奇虎 360 游戏中心功能将无法运行。

en.description: Qihoo 360 Game Center displays this dialog when its update service asks users to install or review a newer SDK package.
en.disableEffect: Qihoo SDK update notices and their optional update actions will not appear; the host game remains available.

zh-CN.description: 奇虎 360 游戏中心更新服务要求用户安装或查看新版 SDK 时，会显示此对话框。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 奇虎 SDK 更新提示及其可选更新操作将不再显示，宿主游戏仍可使用。

en.description: Qihoo 360 Game Center opens its Qcoin cashier when a game purchase uses Qihoo coins and returns the payment result.
en.disableEffect: Purchases through the Qihoo Qcoin cashier will fail.

zh-CN.description: 游戏使用奇虎币购买时，奇虎 360 游戏中心会打开 Qcoin 收银页面并返回支付结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过奇虎 Qcoin 收银台完成的购买将失败。

en.description: When Qiyu customer-service extension modules connect, this Service supplies a private channel for registering extensions and exchanging messages. It runs behind the scenes and is not a screen users open.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it removes the communication channel used by dependent Qiyu modules, so customer-service functions that use those modules stop working.

zh-CN.description: 七鱼客服 SDK 的扩展模块连接时，此服务会提供内部通信通道，用于注册扩展并交换消息。它在后台运行，不会显示为用户可打开的页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，依赖此通道的七鱼模块无法通信，相应的客服功能也会停止工作。

en.description: When Qiyu receives a remote request for diagnostic logs, it collects log entries from the requested time range and uploads them with any collection errors.
en.disableEffect: Disabling this manifest entry does not remove chat features; the analyzed SDK calls the log-collection helper directly, so diagnostic uploads can still run.

zh-CN.description: 七鱼客服 SDK 收到远程诊断日志请求时，会收集指定时间段的日志，并上传日志文件及收集过程中出现的错误信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用此清单项不会影响客服聊天；已分析的 SDK 代码会直接调用日志收集逻辑，因此诊断日志仍可能上传。

en.description: When Qiyu’s separate messaging process needs connection settings, it uses this provider to read server and file-transfer addresses and to refresh the file-download address.
en.disableEffect: Without it, the messaging process cannot exchange these connection settings, so customer-service messages and file transfers stop working correctly.

zh-CN.description: 七鱼客服 SDK 的独立消息进程需要连接设置时，会通过此内容提供程序读取服务器和文件传输地址，并更新文件下载地址。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，消息进程无法交换这些连接设置，客服消息和文件传输将无法正常工作。

en.description: When Qiyu starts its messaging process, it uses this provider to read login details, SDK settings, reconnect timing, and dynamically supplied login tokens or extensions.
en.disableEffect: Without this provider, the messaging process cannot get the login data and settings it needs, so sign-in and message delivery can fail.

zh-CN.description: 七鱼客服 SDK 启动消息进程时，会通过此内容提供程序读取登录信息、SDK 设置、重连时间，以及动态提供的登录令牌或扩展信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，消息进程无法取得所需的登录信息和设置，登录或消息收发可能失败。

en.description: When Android runs one of Qiyu’s scheduled message-delivery jobs, this Service starts the background messaging connection and handles the job’s start or stop callback.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents the SDK’s scheduled background work, which can delay message delivery and reconnection while the app is closed.

zh-CN.description: Android 执行七鱼安排的消息后台任务时，此服务会启动后台消息连接，并处理任务的开始或停止回调。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，SDK 安排的后台任务无法运行，应用关闭时的消息接收和重连可能延迟。

en.description: Qiyu schedules this Receiver with a repeating alarm; when the alarm fires, it starts the messaging Service for an active account and schedules the next check.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it removes this background wake-up route, so incoming support messages and reconnections can be delayed while the app is closed.

zh-CN.description: 七鱼客服 SDK 会用重复闹钟调度此接收器；闹钟触发时，它会为已登录账号启动消息服务，并安排下一次检查。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，这条后台唤醒路径会失效，应用关闭时的客服消息接收和重连可能延迟。

en.description: Qiyu starts this Service in its messaging process to load the saved login settings and run the background connection that receives and sends customer-service messages.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it stops the SDK’s messaging connection, so support conversations and background messages do not work.

zh-CN.description: 七鱼客服 SDK 会在消息进程中启动此服务，读取已保存的登录设置，并运行用于收发客服消息的后台连接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，SDK 的消息连接会停止，客服会话和后台消息收发将无法工作。

en.description: During Qiyu messaging startup, this companion Service runs in the messaging process and stays available as a sticky auxiliary service while the SDK manages its connection.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it removes the SDK’s auxiliary background service and interrupts the persistent messaging and reconnect flow.

zh-CN.description: 七鱼客服 SDK 启动消息功能时，会在消息进程中运行此辅助服务，并在 SDK 管理连接期间保持可用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，SDK 的辅助后台服务会失效，持续消息连接和重连流程会受到影响。

en.description: When Qiyu’s messaging process sends an internal wake-up broadcast, this Receiver wakes the app’s messaging process and refreshes its SDK state.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents this message wake-up path, so incoming messages may not refresh the chat interface promptly.

zh-CN.description: 七鱼客服 SDK 的消息进程发送内部唤醒广播时，此接收器会唤醒应用的消息进程并刷新 SDK 状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，这条消息唤醒路径会失效，收到的消息可能无法及时显示在聊天界面。

en.description: When Qiyu needs to wake the app’s messaging process, it starts this short-lived Service to refresh SDK state and briefly enter the foreground when Android requires it.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it breaks the SDK’s message wake-up flow, so incoming messages and chat updates may not appear promptly.

zh-CN.description: 七鱼客服 SDK 需要唤醒应用的消息进程时，会启动此短时服务刷新 SDK 状态，并在 Android 要求时短暂以前台服务运行。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，SDK 的消息唤醒流程会失效，收到的消息和聊天更新可能无法及时显示。

en.description: When a Qiyu support chat asks the user to attach photos, this Activity lists device photo albums and lets the user select one or more pictures to send.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open the in-chat photo album picker or attach photos through this flow.

zh-CN.description: 七鱼客服聊天需要添加照片时，此页面会列出设备相册，并让用户选择一张或多张图片发送。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开聊天中的相册选择器，也无法通过此流程添加照片。

en.description: After the user chooses photos in a Qiyu album picker, this Activity previews them, lets the user adjust the selection and original-image option, then returns the photos to chat.
en.disableEffect: Users lose the photo preview and selection step needed to review and send images from this picker.

zh-CN.description: 用户在七鱼相册选择器中选取照片后，此页面会预览图片，让用户调整选择和原图选项，再将照片交回聊天页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在此选择器中预览和确认要发送的照片。

en.description: After a user takes a photo in Qiyu’s camera flow, this Activity displays the captured image and offers send or retake before returning it to chat.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot review, retake, or send a photo through Qiyu’s in-chat camera flow.

zh-CN.description: 用户通过七鱼聊天中的相机拍照后，此页面会显示刚拍摄的图片，并提供发送或重拍选项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在七鱼聊天相机流程中预览、重拍或发送照片。

en.description: When a Qiyu attachment is opened or shared, this Provider creates a file link that lets the receiving app access the attachment.
en.disableEffect: Without it, opening or sharing Qiyu attachments can fail on newer Android versions.

zh-CN.description: 七鱼客服附件被打开或分享时，此提供程序会创建文件链接，让接收应用能够访问该附件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，在较新版本的 Android 上打开或分享七鱼附件可能失败。

en.description: When a user chooses to record a video for a Qiyu support conversation, this Activity opens the camera, records the clip, and returns it to chat as an attachment.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot record and attach a video to a Qiyu support conversation.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择为七鱼客服会话录制视频时，此页面会打开相机、录制视频，并将其作为附件交回聊天页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在七鱼客服会话中录制并发送视频。

en.description: When a Qiyu chat requests a picture attachment, this Activity opens the photo library or camera and returns the selected or captured image to the conversation.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot choose or capture a picture for a Qiyu chat attachment through this flow.

zh-CN.description: 七鱼聊天需要添加图片时，此页面会打开相册或相机，并将用户选取或拍摄的图片交回会话。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此流程为七鱼聊天选择或拍摄图片附件。

en.description: When a user opens a picture message in Qiyu chat, this Activity shows the message images full screen, loads the original image when requested, and offers saving it to the device.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open, zoom, or save picture attachments from Qiyu messages through this viewer.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开七鱼聊天中的图片消息时，此页面会全屏显示图片，按需加载原图，并提供保存到设备的选项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此查看器打开、放大或保存七鱼消息中的图片附件。

en.description: When a user opens a video message in Qiyu chat, this Activity downloads it if needed, plays it, shows transfer progress, and offers saving it to the device.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot play or save video attachments from Qiyu messages through this viewer.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开七鱼聊天中的视频消息时，此页面会按需下载并播放视频、显示传输进度，并提供保存到设备的选项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此查看器播放或保存七鱼消息中的视频附件。

en.description: When a Qiyu chat or leave-a-message form asks for a local attachment, this Activity browses device folders and returns the files the user selects.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot browse for and attach local files through Qiyu’s file-selection flow.

zh-CN.description: 七鱼聊天或留言表单需要本地附件时，此页面会浏览设备文件夹，并将用户选中的文件交回表单。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过七鱼文件选择流程查找并添加本地文件。

en.description: During Qiyu media selection, this Activity previews an item from the chosen album and loads the other album items so the user can swipe through them.
en.disableEffect: Users lose the full-screen album preview step in Qiyu’s media-selection flow.

zh-CN.description: 七鱼选择媒体时，此页面会预览所选相册中的一项，并加载相册内其他媒体供用户滑动查看。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在七鱼媒体选择流程中全屏预览相册内容。

en.description: When Qiyu’s media picker opens, this Activity scans device albums and lets the user choose the allowed photos or videos to return to the calling feature.
en.disableEffect: Qiyu features that attach photos or videos cannot open this picker or receive the selected media.

zh-CN.description: 七鱼媒体选择器打开时，此页面会扫描设备相册，让用户选择允许的照片或视频并交回发起功能。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要添加照片或视频的七鱼功能将无法打开此选择器或取得所选媒体。

en.description: After the user selects media in Qiyu’s picker, this Activity previews the selected items and returns the selection state to the picker.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot review the selected media in this preview step before returning to the Qiyu picker.

zh-CN.description: 用户在七鱼选择器中选好媒体后，此页面会预览已选项目，并将选择状态交回选择器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在返回七鱼选择器前通过此页面检查已选媒体。

en.description: When a user opens a customer-service card, this Activity requests the card details from Qiyu and displays the returned information.
en.disableEffect: Card-detail popups in Qiyu customer-service conversations will not open.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开客服卡片时，此页面会向七鱼请求卡片详情，并显示返回的信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 七鱼客服会话中的卡片详情弹窗将无法打开。

en.description: When a user opens a file attachment in Qiyu chat, this Activity downloads it, shows progress, and opens the completed file with a compatible app.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot download and open files attached to Qiyu support messages through this screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开七鱼聊天中的文件附件时，此页面会下载文件、显示进度，并调用兼容应用打开已下载文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此页面下载并打开七鱼客服消息中的文件附件。

en.description: When a user opens Qiyu’s leave-a-message form, this Activity collects the message, required contact fields, and optional attachments, then submits them to customer service.
en.disableEffect: The app’s Qiyu leave-a-message form and its attachment submission will not work.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开七鱼留言表单时，此页面会收集留言内容、必填联系信息和可选附件，并提交给客服。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用中的七鱼留言表单及其附件提交功能将无法使用。

en.description: When a leave-a-message form has a selectable custom field, this Activity shows its choices and returns the user’s selected value or values to the form.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot choose values for selectable custom fields in Qiyu’s leave-a-message form.

zh-CN.description: 七鱼留言表单包含可选自定义字段时，此页面会显示选项，并将用户选定的一个或多个值交回表单。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法为七鱼留言表单中的可选自定义字段选择取值。

en.description: When the app opens Qiyu customer service or the user taps a service notification, this Activity hosts the support conversation screen and its message interface.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot access the Qiyu in-app customer-service conversation through this screen.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开七鱼客服，或用户点击客服通知时，此页面会承载客服会话和消息界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此页面进入应用内的七鱼客服会话。

en.description: When a user taps an image link in Qiyu chat, this Activity loads the image full screen, supports zooming, and offers saving it to the device.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot view or save linked images from Qiyu customer-service conversations through this screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击七鱼聊天中的图片链接时，此页面会全屏加载图片、支持缩放，并提供保存到设备的选项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此页面查看或保存七鱼客服会话中的链接图片。

en.description: When a user opens the Qiyu support-ticket list, this Activity requests their tickets and lets them refresh, search, sort, filter by status, and open a ticket.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot browse, search, or open their Qiyu support tickets through the ticket list.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开七鱼客服工单列表时，此页面会请求工单数据，并提供刷新、搜索、排序、状态筛选和打开工单的功能。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过工单列表浏览、搜索或打开自己的七鱼客服工单。

en.description: When a Qiyu ticket or leave-message form opens attached photos, this Activity displays them in a swipeable full-screen viewer and can return or remove the current photo.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot review attached photos in Qiyu ticket or leave-message flows through this viewer.

zh-CN.description: 七鱼工单或留言表单打开附件照片时，此页面会以可滑动的全屏查看器显示照片，并可返回或移除当前照片。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此查看器检查七鱼工单或留言流程中的附件照片。

en.description: When a user opens a Qiyu support ticket’s attachment list, this Activity shows the attached files and opens the selected item’s preview or download flow.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot browse or open files attached to Qiyu support tickets through this list.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开七鱼客服工单的附件列表时，此页面会显示相关文件，并打开所选附件的预览或下载流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此列表浏览或打开七鱼客服工单中的附件。

en.description: When a user opens a Qiyu support ticket, this Activity fetches and displays its fields, attachments, and history, and provides available actions such as adding files, urging, or rating the ticket.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot view ticket details or use the ticket’s attachment, follow-up, and rating actions.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开七鱼客服工单时，此页面会获取并显示字段、附件和处理记录，并提供可用的添加文件、催办或评价操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法查看工单详情，也无法使用工单附件、催办和评价操作。

en.description: When a user taps an image in a Qiyu ticket’s attachments, this Activity opens a swipeable full-screen preview; other file types can be sent to the download screen.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot preview images attached to Qiyu support tickets through this screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击七鱼客服工单附件中的图片时，此页面会打开可滑动的全屏预览；其他文件类型可转到下载页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此页面预览七鱼客服工单附件中的图片。

en.description: The NetEase Qiyu customer-service SDK opens this screen to browse photo folders and select one or more images for a support conversation.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot select photos to attach to a support message.

zh-CN.description: 网易七鱼客服 SDK 会打开此页面，让用户浏览相册并为客服会话选择一张或多张图片。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法选择图片并附加到客服消息中。

en.description: The NetEase Qiyu customer-service SDK previews album photos and lets users choose which images to send, including whether to send the original-size image.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot review and confirm photos in this support-message selection flow.

zh-CN.description: 网易七鱼客服 SDK 会预览相册图片，并让用户选择要发送的图片，还可选择是否发送原图。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在此客服消息流程中预览并确认图片。

en.description: The NetEase Qiyu customer-service SDK previews a newly captured photo and lets the user send it or retake it.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot confirm or retake a newly captured photo in this support flow.

zh-CN.description: 网易七鱼客服 SDK 会预览刚拍摄的照片，并让用户发送或重新拍摄。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在此客服流程中确认或重拍照片。

en.description: The NetEase Qiyu customer-service SDK uses this Provider to create app-scoped file links for attachments such as photos and documents.
en.disableEffect: Sending or opening file attachments in customer-service chat may fail.

zh-CN.description: 网易七鱼客服 SDK 使用此 Provider 为图片、文档等附件创建应用内文件链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 客服会话中的文件附件可能无法发送或打开。

en.description: The NetEase Qiyu customer-service SDK opens this camera screen to record a video for a support message; users can also choose an existing video.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot record or choose videos to attach to support messages.

zh-CN.description: 网易七鱼客服 SDK 会打开此相机页面，为客服消息录制视频；用户也可以选择已有视频。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法录制或选择视频并附加到客服消息中。

en.description: The NetEase Qiyu customer-service SDK routes image selection to the requested source, such as the camera or local albums, and returns the chosen image; the flow can also crop or select several images.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot capture, choose, or prepare images for support messages.

zh-CN.description: 网易七鱼客服 SDK 会按请求打开相机或本地相册并返回所选图片；此流程还可裁剪图片或多选。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法为客服消息拍摄、选择或处理图片。

en.description: This NetEase Qiyu screen shows photos from support messages, downloads a full image when needed, and can save it to the device.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot view or save photos attached to support messages.

zh-CN.description: 网易七鱼客服页面会展示会话消息中的图片，需要时下载原图，并可将图片保存到设备。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法查看或保存客服消息中的图片。

en.description: This NetEase Qiyu screen downloads and plays a video from a support message or supplied video link; users can also save a message video.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open or save videos from the support conversation.

zh-CN.description: 网易七鱼客服页面会下载并播放会话消息或指定链接中的视频，也可将消息视频保存到设备。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开或保存客服会话中的视频。

en.description: The NetEase Qiyu customer-service SDK browses local folders for files allowed by the selection rules and returns the chosen files for a support message.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot select local documents to attach to support messages.

zh-CN.description: 网易七鱼客服 SDK 会按选择规则浏览本地文件夹，并将选中的文件返回给客服消息流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法选择本地文档并附加到客服消息中。

en.description: The NetEase Qiyu media picker opens this screen to preview an image or video selected from an album before confirmation.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot preview album media before confirming a support attachment.

zh-CN.description: 网易七鱼媒体选择器会打开此页面，供用户在确认前预览相册中选中的图片或视频。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在确认客服附件前预览相册媒体。

en.description: The NetEase Qiyu media picker shows local albums for photo and video selection, returns the chosen items, and can open the camera.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot choose or capture media for customer-service messages.

zh-CN.description: 网易七鱼媒体选择器会展示本地相册供用户选择图片或视频、返回所选内容，也可打开相机。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法为客服消息选择或拍摄媒体。

en.description: The NetEase Qiyu media picker previews the items the user has already selected before returning the selection.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot review selected media in the customer-service attachment flow.

zh-CN.description: 网易七鱼媒体选择器会在返回选择结果前预览用户已选中的媒体。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在客服附件流程中检查已选媒体。

en.description: NetEase YSF customer-service kit schedules this Receiver to check its server for unread support messages and update its background reminder mode.
en.disableEffect: Background unread-message checks and related support alerts stop, so users may not be notified of replies until they reopen the app.

zh-CN.description: 网易云信 YSF 客服套件会定时触发此 Receiver，向服务器查询未读客服消息并更新后台提醒模式。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 后台未读消息检查及相关客服提醒将停止，用户可能要重新打开应用后才能发现回复。

en.description: The NetEase Qiyu customer-service SDK retrieves a service card and shows its details in a popup when the chat flow opens it.
en.disableEffect: Service cards opened from customer-service chat may fail to load.

zh-CN.description: 网易七鱼客服 SDK 会在会话打开服务卡片时获取卡片内容，并以弹窗展示详情。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 从客服会话打开的服务卡片可能无法加载。

en.description: The NetEase Qiyu customer-service SDK opens this screen for a file message, lets users download it, and opens the file after it is saved.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot download or open file attachments from customer-service chat.

zh-CN.description: 网易七鱼客服 SDK 会为文件消息打开此页面，让用户下载文件，并在保存后打开。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法下载或打开客服会话中的文件附件。

en.description: The NetEase Qiyu customer-service SDK opens this leave-message form so users can submit text, requested details, and attachments.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot submit a leave-message request through the customer-service SDK.

zh-CN.description: 网易七鱼客服 SDK 会打开此留言表单，供用户提交文字、所需信息和附件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过客服 SDK 提交留言。

en.description: The NetEase Qiyu leave-message flow shows the choices for a custom field and returns the user's selected value.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot complete leave-message forms that require this choice.

zh-CN.description: 网易七鱼留言流程会展示自定义字段的选项，并返回用户选定的值。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要此选项的留言表单将无法完成。

en.description: This NetEase Qiyu Activity opens the in-app customer-service conversation from an app request or service notification and displays the chat screen.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open the in-app customer-service conversation.

zh-CN.description: 网易七鱼会话页面可由应用请求或客服通知打开，并展示应用内客服聊天界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开应用内的客服会话。

en.description: The NetEase Qiyu customer-service SDK displays supplied image links in a swipeable full-screen viewer and can save an image to the device.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open or save linked images from the support flow.

zh-CN.description: 网易七鱼客服 SDK 会在可滑动的全屏查看器中展示图片链接，也可将图片保存到设备。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在客服流程中打开或保存链接图片。

en.description: The NetEase Qiyu media picker previews selected local images and returns the updated selection, including removals, to the previous screen.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot review or update selected images in the customer-service media flow.

zh-CN.description: 网易七鱼媒体选择器会预览已选的本地图片，并将更新后的选择（包括删除项）返回上一页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在客服媒体流程中检查或调整已选图片。

en.description: When Qiyu starts or receives a video-support call, this Activity shows the call state and provides microphone, camera, answer, reject, or hang-up controls.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot manage incoming or outgoing Qiyu video-support calls through this screen.

zh-CN.description: 七鱼发起或接收视频客服通话时，此页面会显示通话状态，并提供麦克风、摄像头、接听、拒接或挂断控制。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此页面管理呼入或呼出的七鱼视频客服通话。

en.description: During a Qiyu video-support call, this Activity displays the local and remote video, call duration, and the controls used to manage the call.
en.disableEffect: Users lose the Qiyu video-call screen and its in-call audio, video, and call controls.

zh-CN.description: 七鱼视频客服通话期间，此页面会显示本地和远端视频、通话时长以及管理通话的控制按钮。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法使用七鱼视频通话界面及其中的音频、视频和通话控制。

en.description: When Qiyu starts or receives a video-support call, this Activity shows the call state and provides microphone, camera, answer, reject, or hang-up controls.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot manage incoming or outgoing Qiyu video-support calls through this screen.

zh-CN.description: 七鱼发起或接收视频客服通话时，此页面会显示通话状态，并提供麦克风、摄像头、接听、拒接或挂断控制。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此页面管理呼入或呼出的七鱼视频客服通话。

en.description: When a Qiyu video call continues in a floating view, this Service creates a movable window with the remote video and handles call updates while the user is elsewhere in the app.
en.disableEffect: Users lose the floating remote-video view and cannot return to the call through that window.

zh-CN.description: 七鱼视频通话以悬浮窗口继续时，此服务会创建可移动的远端视频窗口，并在用户使用应用其他页面时处理通话更新。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法使用悬浮远端视频窗口，也无法通过该窗口返回通话。

en.description: During a Qiyu video-support call, this Activity displays the local and remote video, call duration, and the controls used to manage the call.
en.disableEffect: Users lose the Qiyu video-call screen and its in-call audio, video, and call controls.

zh-CN.description: 七鱼视频客服通话期间，此页面会显示本地和远端视频、通话时长以及管理通话的控制按钮。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法使用七鱼视频通话界面及其中的音频、视频和通话控制。

en.description: When a user starts screen sharing during a Qiyu video call, this Activity requests Android’s screen-capture permission and starts or stops the sharing flow.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot start or manage screen sharing during Qiyu video-support calls.

zh-CN.description: 用户在七鱼视频通话中开始屏幕共享时，此页面会请求 Android 屏幕捕获权限，并启动或停止共享流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在七鱼视频客服通话中开始或管理屏幕共享。

en.description: While Qiyu screen sharing runs, this Service shows a movable floating window; tapping it returns the user to the screen-sharing controls.
en.disableEffect: Users lose the floating return control while sharing their screen in a Qiyu call.

zh-CN.description: 七鱼屏幕共享运行期间，此服务会显示可移动的悬浮窗口；点击窗口可返回屏幕共享控制界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户在七鱼通话中共享屏幕时将无法使用悬浮返回控件。

en.description: When a Qiyu video call is minimized to a floating view, this Service displays the remote participant’s video and lets the user return to the full call screen.
en.disableEffect: Users lose the floating video window and its shortcut back to the active call.

zh-CN.description: 七鱼视频通话缩小为悬浮视图时，此服务会显示远端参与者的视频，并让用户返回完整通话界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法使用悬浮视频窗口及其返回当前通话的入口。

en.description: When a Qiyu video call continues outside the meeting screen, this foreground Service posts an ongoing-call notification with a shortcut back to the call.
en.disableEffect: The active Qiyu video call loses its background service and return notification, interrupting the ongoing-call experience.

zh-CN.description: 七鱼视频通话离开会议页面后，此前台服务会显示持续通话通知，并提供返回通话的入口。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 正在进行的七鱼视频通话将失去后台服务和返回通知，通话体验会中断。

en.description: When Android launches the screen-sharing action, this foreground Service keeps Qiyu’s screen capture running and connects it to the active video call.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot transmit their screen to the other participant during a Qiyu video-support call.

zh-CN.description: Android 启动屏幕共享操作时，此前台服务会维持七鱼屏幕捕获，并将画面传输到当前视频通话。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在七鱼视频客服通话中向对方共享屏幕。

en.description: When an older Qiyu video-call screen is minimized, this Service creates a movable window that keeps showing the remote participant’s video during the call.
en.disableEffect: Users lose the floating remote-video view used to keep an older Qiyu call visible outside its meeting screen.

zh-CN.description: 旧版七鱼视频通话页面缩小时，此服务会创建可移动窗口，在通话期间继续显示远端参与者的视频。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在旧版七鱼通话离开会议页面后继续通过悬浮窗口查看远端视频。

en.description: AdDesign's advertising return screen for Kuaishou links. When an ad return link opens it, the screen immediately closes to return to the previous app.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it stops the AdDesign ad-return links from being handled by this screen.

zh-CN.description: 这是 AdDesign 广告库用于快手链接的返回界面。广告返回链接打开它后，界面会立即关闭并返回上一个应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，AdDesign 广告返回链接将无法由此界面处理。

en.description: TengShi Live Android SDK opens this Activity after a student joins a live lesson; it presents the lesson video, interactive whiteboard, and class messaging.
en.disableEffect: Students will not be able to open this live classroom screen.

zh-CN.description: 学生加入直播课程后，TengShi Live Android SDK 会打开此 Activity，展示课程视频、互动白板和课堂消息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 学生将无法打开此直播课堂界面。

en.description: TengShi Live Android SDK opens this Activity for a teacher's live lesson; it provides the teaching screen, shared lesson materials, whiteboard controls, and student attendance tools.
en.disableEffect: Teachers will lose this live teaching screen and its lesson and attendance controls.

zh-CN.description: 教师开始直播课程时，TengShi Live Android SDK 会打开此 Activity，提供教学界面、共享课件、白板操作和学生考勤功能。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 教师将无法使用此直播教学界面及其课件和考勤功能。

en.description: Qmai CrashLib opens this screen after a captured crash in its default immediate-report mode, or when a user selects a saved crash report; it displays the error details and offers copy, share, and screenshot actions.
en.disableEffect: With CrashLib’s default immediate-report setting, disabling this Activity makes the post-crash report launch fail; saved report details also cannot be opened.

zh-CN.description: Qmai CrashLib 会在默认的即时报告模式下于捕获崩溃后打开此界面，也会在用户选择已保存的崩溃报告时打开；界面显示错误详情，并提供复制、分享和截图操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 在 CrashLib 默认的即时报告设置下，禁用此 Activity 会导致崩溃后的报告页面无法打开；已保存报告的详情也无法查看。

en.description: Qmai CrashLib uses this provider to create a shareable file link when its report screen shares a saved crash log.
en.disableEffect: Saved crash logs cannot be shared from the report screen on Android 7 and later.

zh-CN.description: Qmai CrashLib 会在报告界面分享已保存的崩溃日志时，通过此 Provider 创建可共享的文件链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 在 Android 7 及更高版本中，禁用后将无法从报告界面分享已保存的崩溃日志。

en.description: Qmai CrashLib opens this screen from its history shortcut to list saved crash reports; selecting an entry opens its details, and users can delete reports here.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot browse or manage saved crash reports through the SDK.

zh-CN.description: 用户通过 Qmai CrashLib 的历史记录入口打开此界面查看已保存的崩溃报告；选择条目可查看详情，也可在此删除报告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过该 SDK 浏览或管理已保存的崩溃报告。

en.description: Qmai CrashLib opens this test screen from its crash-test shortcut; its buttons deliberately trigger sample errors to check crash reporting.
en.disableEffect: The built-in crash-test screen cannot be opened; ordinary app use is unaffected.

zh-CN.description: 用户通过 Qmai CrashLib 的崩溃测试入口打开此界面；其中的按钮会故意触发示例错误，以检查崩溃报告功能。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 内置的崩溃测试界面将无法打开，应用的日常使用不受影响。

en.description: Qonversion opens this Activity to show an in-app automation screen supplied as HTML or a screen ID; the screen can include links and purchase or restore actions.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents Qonversion automation screens from opening, so offers and purchase actions shown there will not work.

zh-CN.description: Qonversion 会用此 Activity 显示自动化流程中的应用内页面，页面内容由 HTML 或页面编号指定，也可包含链接、购买或恢复操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Qonversion 自动化页面无法打开，其中的优惠和购买操作也无法使用。

en.description: This QoreID sample screen lets a developer preview the SDK’s custom form controls with example choices, number controls, and photo inputs. It does not start an identity check.
en.disableEffect: Blocking it removes only this sample screen; QoreID verification remains available.

zh-CN.description: 这是 QoreID 的示例界面，供开发者预览自定义选项、数字输入和照片输入控件；它不会启动身份核验。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后只有这个示例界面无法打开，QoreID 身份核验仍可使用。

en.description: After Android finishes starting the device, QoreID records a startup event for its SDK. This Receiver does not start identity verification or the background tracker.
en.disableEffect: QoreID will miss this startup event; the app and its verification screen can still start.

zh-CN.description: Android 完成设备启动后，QoreID 会为 SDK 记录一条启动事件。这个 Receiver 不会启动身份核验或后台跟踪。
zh-CN.disableEffect: QoreID 将无法记录这条启动事件，但应用和身份核验界面仍可启动。

en.description: During a QoreID Verifind 4D check, this background Service keeps timed monitoring checks running and shows an ongoing notification while it works.
en.disableEffect: Verifind 4D background checks stop, removing a required part of identity verification that uses this monitoring.

zh-CN.description: 进行 QoreID Verifind 4D 核验时，这个后台 Service 会持续运行定时监测，并显示正在运行的通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后 Verifind 4D 后台监测会停止，依赖这些监测的身份核验将无法完成相应检查。

en.description: When QoreID requests a tracker restart, this Receiver starts the background monitoring service again so an active Verifind 4D check can continue.
en.disableEffect: QoreID cannot restart its Verifind 4D monitoring service through this Receiver, so an interrupted check will not resume this way.

zh-CN.description: QoreID 请求重启跟踪服务时，这个 Receiver 会重新启动后台监测，让正在进行的 Verifind 4D 核验继续运行。
zh-CN.disableEffect: QoreID 无法通过这个 Receiver 重启 Verifind 4D 后台监测服务，中断的核验也无法通过此方式恢复。

en.description: On a scheduled timer during a Verifind 4D check, this Receiver signals QoreID to run the next background tracking update.
en.disableEffect: QoreID will stop receiving these scheduled Verifind 4D tracking updates.

zh-CN.description: Verifind 4D 核验期间定时器触发时，这个 Receiver 会通知 QoreID 运行下一次后台跟踪更新。
zh-CN.disableEffect: QoreID 将无法收到这些定时的 Verifind 4D 跟踪更新。

en.description: The host app opens this QoreID Activity to guide a user through identity verification and return a success or error result to the app.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot complete identity verification through QoreID in the app.

zh-CN.description: 宿主应用会打开 QoreID 的这个界面，引导用户完成身份核验，并将成功或错误结果返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在应用中通过 QoreID 完成身份核验。

en.description: Tencent GDT opens this Activity to display full-screen ad content.
en.disableEffect: Tencent GDT full-screen ads will not open, and rewards for watching rewarded ads will no longer be granted.

zh-CN.description: Tencent GDT 会打开此 Activity 展示全屏广告内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Tencent GDT 全屏广告将无法打开，观看激励广告也不再发放奖励。

en.description: Tencent GDT uses this transparent full-screen Activity to display ad dialogs and other ad surfaces when its SDK starts them.
en.disableEffect: GDT ad dialogs that use this screen will not appear, while the app’s own screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: 腾讯优量汇广告 SDK 使用此透明全屏页面展示广告弹窗及其他广告界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，依赖此页面的优量汇广告弹窗不会显示，但应用自身页面仍可使用。

en.description: Tencent GDT opens this Activity in landscape orientation to display full-screen ad content.
en.disableEffect: Tencent GDT landscape ads will not open, and rewards for watching rewarded ads will no longer be granted.

zh-CN.description: Tencent GDT 会以横屏方向打开此 Activity，展示全屏广告内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Tencent GDT 横屏广告将无法打开，观看激励广告也不再发放奖励。

en.description: Tencent GDT opens this Activity in portrait orientation to display full-screen ad content.
en.disableEffect: Tencent GDT portrait ads will not open, and rewards for watching rewarded ads will no longer be granted.

zh-CN.description: Tencent GDT 会以竖屏方向打开此 Activity，展示全屏广告内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Tencent GDT 竖屏广告将无法打开，观看激励广告也不再发放奖励。

en.description: Tencent GDT opens this landscape Activity to show a rewarded video ad.
en.disableEffect: Landscape rewarded video ads will not play, and rewards for watching ads will no longer be granted.

zh-CN.description: 腾讯优量汇广告 SDK 会以横屏方式打开此页面播放激励视频广告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，横屏激励视频无法播放，观看广告的奖励也不会发放。

en.description: Tencent GDT opens this portrait Activity to show a rewarded video ad.
en.disableEffect: Portrait rewarded video ads will not play, and rewards for watching ads will no longer be granted.

zh-CN.description: 腾讯优量汇广告 SDK 会以竖屏方式打开此页面播放激励视频广告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，竖屏激励视频无法播放，观看广告的奖励也不会发放。

en.description: Tencent GDT starts this Service to process its ad-related download queue.
en.disableEffect: Tencent GDT ad downloads will stop working.

zh-CN.description: Tencent GDT 会启动此 Service 处理广告相关下载队列。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Tencent GDT 广告下载将无法使用。

en.description: The Tencent GDT (Youlianghui) ad SDK declares this provider for files in its configured folders and uses it to hand a local file to Android through a shareable content link. It is used during an ad download or file handoff.
en.disableEffect: GDT ad downloads or file handoffs may fail, while the app’s own screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: 腾讯优量汇广告 SDK 为其配置的本地文件目录声明了此提供器；广告下载或文件交接时，它会把本地文件转换成可授权访问的内容链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，优量汇广告的下载或文件交接可能失败，但应用自身页面仍可使用。

en.description: The Tencent GDT developer tools open this screen when a developer sends feedback; it collects a rating and message for Tencent’s advertising SDK support service.
en.disableEffect: Developers lose the GDT feedback form, while the app’s ads continue to work.

zh-CN.description: 开发者通过腾讯优量汇（GDT）工具提交反馈时会打开此界面；界面收集评分和文字意见并发送给广告 SDK 支持服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 开发者将无法使用 GDT 反馈表单，但应用广告仍可正常展示。

en.description: In a debug build, Tencent’s GDT tools screen shows SDK setup, ad configuration, and status checks, with a link to the feedback form.
en.disableEffect: The GDT troubleshooting screen becomes unavailable; ad delivery is unaffected.

zh-CN.description: 在调试版应用中，腾讯优量汇（GDT）工具界面显示 SDK 接入、广告配置和状态检查，并提供反馈入口。
zh-CN.disableEffect: GDT 故障排查界面将无法打开，但广告投放不受影响。

en.description: Tencent's GDT (Guangdiantong) ads SDK, bundled with XiGuSdk, initializes at app startup through this provider and shares its stored user information with ad processes.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents GDT ad initialization and user-information handoff; the host game's non-ad features remain available.

zh-CN.description: 随 XiGuSdk 集成的腾讯广点通（GDT）广告 SDK 会在应用启动时通过此 Provider 初始化，并向广告进程共享已保存的用户信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，广点通广告将无法初始化或获取共享用户信息，宿主游戏的非广告功能仍可使用。

en.description: When Google Play location services send a location result, Gimbal receives the latest position and forwards it to its location service.
en.disableEffect: Gimbal will stop receiving these location updates, so its location-triggered places and experiences will stop updating.

zh-CN.description: Google Play 定位服务发送位置结果时，Gimbal 会接收最新位置并交给自己的定位服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Gimbal 将收不到这些位置更新，依赖位置触发的地点和体验也会停止更新。

en.description: When Google Play reports a geofence event, Gimbal receives the event and forwards its triggering location to the location service.
en.disableEffect: Gimbal will no longer receive these geofence callbacks, so its place-entry and place-exit responses will stop.

zh-CN.description: Google Play 报告地理围栏事件时，Gimbal 会接收事件并把触发位置交给定位服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Gimbal 将收不到这些地理围栏回调，进入或离开地点时的响应也会停止。

en.description: The FTC SDK's About screen in Robot Controller or Driver Station shows the app and library versions, build date, and network details; when the two devices are connected, it also requests the other device's information.
en.disableEffect: You lose the FTC version and connection details screen.

zh-CN.description: FTC SDK 的“关于”页面可在 Robot Controller 或 Driver Station 中打开，显示应用和库的版本、构建日期及网络信息；两台设备连接时，也会读取另一台设备的信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后将无法查看 FTC 版本和连接详情。

en.description: The FTC SDK's advanced Robot Controller settings provide Wi-Fi Direct channel and remembered-group controls, Lynx firmware updates, and module address settings. Disabling the screen removes access to these advanced connection and hub tools.
en.disableEffect: You can no longer open these advanced connection and hub settings in the FTC app.

zh-CN.description: FTC SDK 的 Robot Controller 高级设置提供 Wi-Fi Direct 信道和已记住网络组的控制项，也可打开 Lynx 固件更新和模块地址设置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后将无法在 FTC 应用中打开这些高级连接和 Hub 设置。

en.description: In the FTC SDK, choosing firmware update from advanced settings opens this screen, which lists connected Lynx modules and available firmware files so you can update a selected module.
en.disableEffect: You can no longer update Lynx module firmware through the FTC app.

zh-CN.description: 在 FTC SDK 的高级设置中选择固件更新后，此页面会列出已连接的 Lynx 模块和可用固件文件，供你选择模块并更新固件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后将无法通过 FTC 应用更新 Lynx 模块固件。

en.description: In the FTC SDK's advanced settings, the Lynx address screen scans connected modules and lets you assign new module addresses, then sends those changes to the robot controller.
en.disableEffect: You can no longer change Lynx module addresses through the FTC app.

zh-CN.description: 在 FTC SDK 的高级设置中打开 Lynx 地址页面后，它会扫描已连接的模块，供你分配新地址并将更改发送到机器人控制器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后将无法通过 FTC 应用更改 Lynx 模块地址。

en.description: The FTC SDK's Robot Controller settings screen lets you change controller settings such as the device name and sounds, and open the run log.
en.disableEffect: You lose access to the Robot Controller settings and its in-app log screen.

zh-CN.description: FTC SDK 的 Robot Controller 设置页面可更改设备名称、声音等设置，也可打开运行日志。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后将无法打开 Robot Controller 设置和应用内日志页面。

en.description: When opened from the FTC SDK's advanced settings, this screen lists available Wi-Fi Direct channels and lets you choose the preferred channel for the robot connection.
en.disableEffect: You can no longer select a preferred Wi-Fi Direct channel in the FTC app.

zh-CN.description: 从 FTC SDK 的高级设置打开后，此页面会列出可用的 Wi-Fi Direct 信道，供你选择机器人连接的首选信道。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后将无法在 FTC 应用中选择首选 Wi-Fi Direct 信道。

en.description: When opened from the FTC SDK's advanced settings, this screen shows saved Wi-Fi Direct groups on the local or connected device and lets you clear those saved groups.
en.disableEffect: You can no longer view or clear saved Wi-Fi Direct groups in the FTC app.

zh-CN.description: 从 FTC SDK 的高级设置打开后，此页面会显示本机或已连接设备保存的 Wi-Fi Direct 网络组，并可清除这些记录。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后将无法在 FTC 应用中查看或清除已保存的 Wi-Fi Direct 网络组。

en.description: When the FTC SDK opens error details, this screen displays the error message and its detailed trace in a zoomable view.
en.disableEffect: You can no longer open the detailed error trace in the FTC app.

zh-CN.description: FTC SDK 打开错误详情时，此页面会以可缩放的视图显示错误信息及其详细记录。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后将无法在 FTC 应用中查看详细错误记录。

en.description: Opened from the FTC SDK's Robot Controller settings, this screen displays the selected run log; you can long-press the log to share it with another app.
en.disableEffect: You can no longer view or share Robot Controller logs from the FTC app.

zh-CN.description: 从 FTC SDK 的 Robot Controller 设置中打开后，此页面会显示选定的运行日志；长按日志还可将其分享给其他应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后将无法在 FTC 应用中查看或分享 Robot Controller 日志。

en.description: When you open a saved FTC SDK robot configuration's tree, this screen displays its controllers and connected-device hierarchy.
en.disableEffect: You can no longer inspect a robot configuration as a device tree in the FTC app.

zh-CN.description: 打开 FTC SDK 中已保存的机器人配置树时，此页面会显示其中的控制器和设备层级。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后将无法在 FTC 应用中以设备树方式查看机器人配置。
