en.description: When you choose template setup in the FTC SDK's robot-configuration list, this screen loads available templates and lets you select one to create and edit a hardware configuration.
en.disableEffect: You can no longer start a robot hardware configuration from a template in the FTC app.

zh-CN.description: 在 FTC SDK 的机器人配置列表中选择模板配置后，此页面会读取可用模板，供你选择并据此创建和编辑硬件配置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后将无法在 FTC 应用中从模板创建机器人硬件配置。

en.description: Within the FTC SDK's hardware configuration editor, this screen assigns sensor types and names to analog-input ports.
en.disableEffect: You can no longer configure analog-input ports in the FTC app.

zh-CN.description: 在 FTC SDK 的硬件配置编辑器中，此页面用于为模拟输入端口选择传感器类型并设置名称。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后将无法在 FTC 应用中配置模拟输入端口。

en.description: In the FTC SDK's older hardware-configuration editor, this screen assigns device types and names to analog-output ports on a controller.
en.disableEffect: You can no longer configure analog-output ports in the FTC app.

zh-CN.description: 在 FTC SDK 的旧版硬件配置编辑器中，此页面用于为控制器的模拟输出端口选择设备类型并设置名称。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后将无法在 FTC 应用中配置模拟输出端口。

en.description: When editing a Modern Robotics Device Interface Module in the FTC SDK, this screen sets the module name and opens its PWM, I2C, analog, and digital port settings.
en.disableEffect: You can no longer configure a Device Interface Module and its ports in the FTC app.

zh-CN.description: 在 FTC SDK 中编辑 Modern Robotics Device Interface Module 时，此页面可设置模块名称，并打开其 PWM、I2C、模拟和数字端口设置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后将无法在 FTC 应用中配置 Device Interface Module 及其端口。

en.description: Within the FTC SDK's hardware configuration editor, this screen assigns device types and names to a controller's digital input/output ports.
en.disableEffect: You can no longer configure these digital ports in the FTC app.

zh-CN.description: 在 FTC SDK 的硬件配置编辑器中，此页面用于为控制器的数字输入/输出端口选择设备类型并设置名称。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后将无法在 FTC 应用中配置这些数字端口。

en.description: When editing a Lynx hub in the FTC SDK, this screen assigns devices and names to its digital input/output ports.
en.disableEffect: You can no longer configure digital ports on Lynx hubs in the FTC app.

zh-CN.description: 在 FTC SDK 中编辑 Lynx Hub 时，此页面用于为其数字输入/输出端口选择设备并设置名称。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后将无法在 FTC 应用中配置 Lynx Hub 的数字端口。

en.description: When adding or editing an Ethernet-over-USB device in the FTC SDK's hardware configuration, this screen sets its name and IP address.
en.disableEffect: You can no longer configure Ethernet-over-USB devices in the FTC app.

zh-CN.description: 在 FTC SDK 的硬件配置中添加或编辑 Ethernet-over-USB 设备时，此页面用于设置设备名称和 IP 地址。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后将无法在 FTC 应用中配置 Ethernet-over-USB 设备。

en.description: Within the FTC SDK's hardware configuration editor, this screen assigns I2C devices and names to a controller's I2C ports.
en.disableEffect: You can no longer configure these I2C ports in the FTC app.

zh-CN.description: 在 FTC SDK 的硬件配置编辑器中，此页面用于为控制器的 I2C 端口选择设备并设置名称。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后将无法在 FTC 应用中配置这些 I2C 端口。

en.description: When editing a Lynx hub in the FTC SDK, this screen assigns I2C devices and names to its individual I2C buses.
en.disableEffect: You can no longer configure I2C devices on Lynx hubs in the FTC app.

zh-CN.description: 在 FTC SDK 中编辑 Lynx Hub 时，此页面用于为各个 I2C 总线选择设备并设置名称。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后将无法在 FTC 应用中配置 Lynx Hub 上的 I2C 设备。

en.description: When editing a Modern Robotics Legacy Module in the FTC SDK, this screen shows its six ports so you can select the attached controller or module and edit its settings.
en.disableEffect: You can no longer configure Legacy Module ports and attached controllers in the FTC app.

zh-CN.description: 在 FTC SDK 中编辑 Modern Robotics Legacy Module 时，此页面会显示六个端口，供你选择所连接的控制器或模块并编辑其设置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后将无法在 FTC 应用中配置 Legacy Module 端口及所连接的控制器。

en.description: When editing a Modern Robotics motor controller in the FTC SDK, this screen sets the controller name and configures the motors assigned to its ports.
en.disableEffect: You can no longer configure motor ports on a Modern Robotics controller in the FTC app.

zh-CN.description: 在 FTC SDK 中编辑 Modern Robotics 电机控制器时，此页面用于设置控制器名称并配置各端口连接的电机。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后将无法在 FTC 应用中配置 Modern Robotics 控制器的电机端口。

en.description: When editing a Modern Robotics servo controller in the FTC SDK, this screen sets the controller name and configures the servos assigned to its ports.
en.disableEffect: You can no longer configure servo ports on a Modern Robotics controller in the FTC app.

zh-CN.description: 在 FTC SDK 中编辑 Modern Robotics 舵机控制器时，此页面用于设置控制器名称并配置各端口连接的舵机。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后将无法在 FTC 应用中配置 Modern Robotics 控制器的舵机端口。

en.description: When editing a Lynx hub module in the FTC SDK, this screen sets its name and opens the connected motor, servo, I2C, digital, and analog port settings.
en.disableEffect: You can no longer configure Lynx hub modules and their connected devices in the FTC app.

zh-CN.description: 在 FTC SDK 中编辑 Lynx Hub 模块时，此页面可设置模块名称，并打开其电机、舵机、I2C、数字和模拟端口设置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后将无法在 FTC 应用中配置 Lynx Hub 模块及其连接设备。

en.description: When editing a USB-connected Lynx hub in the FTC SDK, this screen sets the hub name and opens the settings for its individual modules.
en.disableEffect: You can no longer configure a Lynx hub or open its module settings in the FTC app.

zh-CN.description: 在 FTC SDK 中编辑通过 USB 连接的 Lynx Hub 时，此页面可设置 Hub 名称并打开各个模块的设置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后将无法在 FTC 应用中配置 Lynx Hub 或打开模块设置。

en.description: When editing a Modern Robotics Matrix controller in the FTC SDK, this screen enables and names its motor and servo ports.
en.disableEffect: You can no longer configure motor and servo ports on a Matrix controller in the FTC app.

zh-CN.description: 在 FTC SDK 中编辑 Modern Robotics Matrix 控制器时，此页面用于启用电机和舵机端口并设置名称。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后将无法在 FTC 应用中配置 Matrix 控制器的电机和舵机端口。

en.description: When editing a Modern Robotics motor controller in the FTC SDK, this screen sets its name and assigns motors to controller ports.
en.disableEffect: You can no longer edit a Modern Robotics motor controller's port assignments in the FTC app.

zh-CN.description: 在 FTC SDK 中编辑 Modern Robotics 电机控制器时，此页面用于设置名称并为控制器端口分配电机。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后将无法在 FTC 应用中编辑 Modern Robotics 电机控制器的端口分配。

en.description: Within the FTC SDK's hardware configuration editor, this screen assigns a motor type and name to each motor port on the selected controller.
en.disableEffect: You can no longer configure motor ports in the FTC app.

zh-CN.description: 在 FTC SDK 的硬件配置编辑器中，此页面用于为所选控制器的每个电机端口选择电机类型并设置名称。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后将无法在 FTC 应用中配置电机端口。

en.description: When configuring a controller in the FTC SDK, this screen enables or disables its PWM output ports and lets you name them.
en.disableEffect: You can no longer configure PWM output ports in the FTC app.

zh-CN.description: 在 FTC SDK 中配置控制器时，此页面可启用或停用 PWM 输出端口并设置端口名称。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后将无法在 FTC 应用中配置 PWM 输出端口。

en.description: When editing a Modern Robotics servo controller in the FTC SDK, this screen sets its name and assigns servos to controller ports.
en.disableEffect: You can no longer edit a Modern Robotics servo controller's port assignments in the FTC app.

zh-CN.description: 在 FTC SDK 中编辑 Modern Robotics 舵机控制器时，此页面用于设置名称并为控制器端口分配舵机。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后将无法在 FTC 应用中编辑 Modern Robotics 舵机控制器的端口分配。

en.description: Within the FTC SDK's hardware configuration editor, this screen assigns a servo type and name to each servo port on the selected controller.
en.disableEffect: You can no longer configure servo ports in the FTC app.

zh-CN.description: 在 FTC SDK 的硬件配置编辑器中，此页面用于为所选控制器的每个舵机端口选择舵机类型并设置名称。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后将无法在 FTC 应用中配置舵机端口。

en.description: When repairing an FTC SDK robot configuration, this screen lists eligible USB controllers so you can choose one to exchange with the selected controller.
en.disableEffect: You can no longer correct USB controller assignments through the FTC app.

zh-CN.description: 修正 FTC SDK 机器人配置时，此页面会列出可交换的 USB 控制器，供你选择一个与当前控制器互换。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后将无法通过 FTC 应用修正 USB 控制器分配。

en.description: When editing a webcam in the FTC SDK's hardware configuration, this screen sets its name and identifies the connected camera.
en.disableEffect: You can no longer configure webcams in the FTC app.

zh-CN.description: 在 FTC SDK 的硬件配置中编辑网络摄像头时，此页面用于设置摄像头名称并识别已连接的摄像头。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后将无法在 FTC 应用中配置网络摄像头。

en.description: Opened from the FTC SDK's robot-configuration list, this screen edits a hardware configuration, scans connected devices, and lets you assign detected controllers and devices to it.
en.disableEffect: You can no longer create or edit robot hardware configurations in the FTC app.

zh-CN.description: 从 FTC SDK 的机器人配置列表打开后，此页面可编辑硬件配置、扫描已连接设备，并将检测到的控制器和设备分配到配置中。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后将无法在 FTC 应用中创建或编辑机器人硬件配置。

en.description: The FTC SDK's robot-configuration list shows saved configurations and lets you create, edit, activate, delete, inspect, or start template setup for them.
en.disableEffect: You can no longer manage saved robot configurations in the FTC app.

zh-CN.description: FTC SDK 的机器人配置列表会显示已保存的配置，并可创建、编辑、启用、删除、查看配置树或开始模板配置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后将无法在 FTC 应用中管理已保存的机器人配置。

en.description: When you choose to create a new hardware configuration in the FTC SDK, this screen starts a device scan and opens a blank configuration for setup.
en.disableEffect: You can no longer create a new robot hardware configuration in the FTC app.

zh-CN.description: 在 FTC SDK 中选择新建硬件配置时，此页面会扫描设备并打开一个空白配置供你设置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后将无法在 FTC 应用中创建新的机器人硬件配置。

en.description: When the app opens Quantcast’s data-use screen, it explains the anonymous app-use and device data used for measurement and offers a checkbox that controls collection.
en.disableEffect: Users lose Quantcast’s in-app disclosure and collection choice, including the screen used to opt out.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开 Quantcast 数据使用说明时，此界面会说明用于测量的匿名应用使用情况和设备数据，并提供控制数据收集的复选框。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法查看 Quantcast 应用内的数据说明和收集选项，也无法通过此界面选择退出。

en.description: When Android reports a store installation referral, Quantcast reads the referral details and forwards them to other configured receivers for campaign attribution.
en.disableEffect: Quantcast stops receiving install-referral data; the app’s other features remain available.

zh-CN.description: Android 报告应用商店安装来源时，Quantcast 会读取来源信息并转交给其他已配置的 Receiver，用于统计推广来源。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Quantcast 将无法收到安装来源数据，但应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: The older Appier AIQUA SDK schedules this service to fetch campaign and notification data in the background.
en.disableEffect: Background AIQUA campaign and notification refreshes will stop; the app’s other features remain available.

zh-CN.description: 较早版本的 Appier AIQUA SDK 会计划此服务在后台获取营销活动和通知数据。
zh-CN.disableEffect: AIQUA 将停止在后台更新营销活动和通知，应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: The older Appier AIQUA SDK uses this receiver for screen-unlock and notification-action events, then passes them to its notification service.
en.disableEffect: AIQUA will no longer refresh or process notifications through these events; the app’s other features remain available.

zh-CN.description: 较早版本的 Appier AIQUA SDK 使用此接收器处理屏幕解锁和通知操作事件，再将事件交给通知服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: AIQUA 将无法再通过这些事件更新或处理通知，应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: The older Appier AIQUA SDK runs this background service to fetch campaign data, display push notifications, and handle notification taps and links.
en.disableEffect: AIQUA push notifications, campaign refreshes, and their actions will stop; the app’s other features remain available.

zh-CN.description: 较早版本的 Appier AIQUA SDK 会通过此后台服务获取营销活动数据、显示推送通知，并处理通知点击和链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: AIQUA 推送通知、营销活动更新及相关操作将停止，应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: When an older Appier AIQUA campaign requests an email, this screen can ask permission to read email addresses saved in Android accounts and add them to the AIQUA profile.
en.disableEffect: That optional account-based email collection will no longer run; the app’s other features remain available.

zh-CN.description: 较早版本的 Appier AIQUA 营销活动请求电子邮箱时，此页面可申请读取 Android 账户中保存的邮箱地址，并将其添加到 AIQUA 用户资料。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 此可选的账户邮箱收集功能将无法运行，应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: Firebase sends older Appier AIQUA push messages to this service, which forwards supported messages to the SDK’s notification handler.
en.disableEffect: AIQUA will no longer receive Firebase push messages through this service; the app’s other features remain available.

zh-CN.description: Firebase 会将较早版本 Appier AIQUA 的推送消息发送给此服务，再由它转交给 SDK 通知处理程序。
zh-CN.disableEffect: AIQUA 将无法再通过此服务接收 Firebase 推送消息，应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: The older Appier AIQUA SDK uses this file provider to let Android read files stored for its notification features.
en.disableEffect: AIQUA notifications that rely on those files may lose their attached media; the app’s other features remain available.

zh-CN.description: 较早版本的 Appier AIQUA SDK 使用此文件提供程序，让 Android 读取通知功能所需的文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖这些文件的 AIQUA 通知可能无法显示附带媒体，应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: When an older Appier AIQUA campaign asks for an email address or phone number, this screen collects the answer and returns it to the SDK.
en.disableEffect: Those AIQUA prompts will no longer collect an email address or phone number through this screen; the app’s other features remain available.

zh-CN.description: 较早版本的 Appier AIQUA 营销活动要求填写电子邮箱或电话号码时，此页面会收集信息并交回 SDK。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 这些 AIQUA 提示将无法再通过此页面收集电子邮箱或电话号码，应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: When the app opens Quash’s bug-report list, this screen loads reports and lets the user open or remove an entry.
en.disableEffect: Quash’s report list will not open, but the app’s regular features remain available.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开 Quash 问题报告列表时，此界面会加载报告，并允许用户查看或删除条目。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Quash 报告列表将无法打开，但应用的常规功能仍可使用。

en.description: After a user chooses an existing Quash report to edit, this screen lets them update its details and attached evidence before submission.
en.disableEffect: Users can no longer edit an existing Quash report; the app’s other features remain available.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择编辑已有的 Quash 报告后，此界面允许他们修改报告内容和附件，再提交更新。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法编辑已有的 Quash 报告，但应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: When the app opens Quash’s bug-report list, this screen loads reports and lets the user open or remove an entry.
en.disableEffect: Quash’s report list will not open, but the app’s regular features remain available.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开 Quash 问题报告列表时，此界面会加载报告，并允许用户查看或删除条目。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Quash 报告列表将无法打开，但应用的常规功能仍可使用。

en.description: After a user chooses an existing Quash report to edit, this screen lets them update its details and attached evidence before submission.
en.disableEffect: Users can no longer edit an existing Quash report; the app’s other features remain available.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择编辑已有的 Quash 报告后，此界面允许他们修改报告内容和附件，再提交更新。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法编辑已有的 Quash 报告，但应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: When the app opens Quash’s bug-report list, this screen loads reports and lets the user open or remove an entry.
en.disableEffect: Quash’s report list will not open, but the app’s regular features remain available.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开 Quash 问题报告列表时，此界面会加载报告，并允许用户查看或删除条目。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Quash 报告列表将无法打开，但应用的常规功能仍可使用。

en.description: After a user chooses an existing Quash report to edit, this screen lets them update its details and attached evidence before submission.
en.disableEffect: Users can no longer edit an existing Quash report; the app’s other features remain available.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择编辑已有的 Quash 报告后，此界面允许他们修改报告内容和附件，再提交更新。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法编辑已有的 Quash 报告，但应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: When a user sends a problem report through Quash, this screen collects a description and optional screenshots, audio, or screen-capture evidence before submission.
en.disableEffect: The Quash report form becomes unavailable, so users cannot send reports through it.

zh-CN.description: 用户通过 Quash 提交问题报告时，此界面会收集问题说明以及可选的截图、录音或屏幕录制，再发送报告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Quash 报告表单将无法使用，用户不能通过它提交问题报告。

en.description: When Quash asks a user to report a crash or problem, this screen collects a description and selected screenshots, audio, or screen-capture evidence for the report.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot submit a crash or problem report through Quash; the app’s other features remain available.

zh-CN.description: Quash 邀请用户报告崩溃或问题时，此界面会收集问题说明以及选定的截图、录音或屏幕录制作为报告内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 Quash 提交崩溃或问题报告，但应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: When a user sends a problem report through Quash, this screen collects a description and optional screenshots, audio, or screen-capture evidence before submission.
en.disableEffect: The Quash report form becomes unavailable, so users cannot send reports through it.

zh-CN.description: 用户通过 Quash 提交问题报告时，此界面会收集问题说明以及可选的截图、录音或屏幕录制，再发送报告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Quash 报告表单将无法使用，用户不能通过它提交问题报告。

en.description: After Quash receives a crash log, this screen asks whether the user wants to report it and opens the report form with the saved log if they continue.
en.disableEffect: Users will not see Quash’s post-crash reporting prompt; the host app’s crash handling remains unchanged.

zh-CN.description: Quash 收到崩溃日志后，此界面会询问用户是否提交报告；用户继续时，它会把已保存的日志带入报告表单。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将看不到 Quash 的崩溃后报告提示，但宿主应用原有的崩溃处理不受影响。

en.description: When Quash needs notification access for its quick link to reported issues, this screen explains the request and asks for Android notification permission before starting Quash’s reporting service.
en.disableEffect: Quash’s notification setup and quick access to reported issues will not start from this screen.

zh-CN.description: Quash 需要通知权限来显示问题报告快捷入口时，此界面会说明原因并请求 Android 通知权限，然后启动 Quash 报告服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Quash 无法通过此界面完成通知设置或启动问题报告快捷入口。

en.description: After Quash receives a crash log, this screen asks whether the user wants to report it and opens the report form with the saved log if they continue.
en.disableEffect: Users will not see Quash’s post-crash reporting prompt; the host app’s crash handling remains unchanged.

zh-CN.description: Quash 收到崩溃日志后，此界面会询问用户是否提交报告；用户继续时，它会把已保存的日志带入报告表单。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将看不到 Quash 的崩溃后报告提示，但宿主应用原有的崩溃处理不受影响。

en.description: While a user records steps for a Quash report, this foreground service captures screen snapshots and shows a floating recording control.
en.disableEffect: Quash cannot capture screen evidence for its reports through this recorder.

zh-CN.description: 用户为 Quash 报告录制操作过程时，这个前台服务会截取屏幕画面并显示悬浮录制控件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Quash 将无法通过此录制器为报告采集屏幕证据。

en.description: During Quash’s bug-capture flow, this foreground service shows a recording notice and floating control while screen capture runs.
en.disableEffect: Quash users lose this screen-capture control and cannot attach screen-recording evidence through this service.

zh-CN.description: Quash 采集问题过程时，这个前台服务会在屏幕录制期间显示录制通知和悬浮控件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法使用此服务控制屏幕录制，也无法通过它附加录屏证据。

en.description: Quash uses this background service to save captured report files and keep a notification that opens the reported-issues list.
en.disableEffect: Quash cannot save captured files through this service or show its report-list notification.

zh-CN.description: Quash 使用此后台服务保存报告附件，并显示一个可打开问题报告列表的通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Quash 将无法通过此服务保存采集的文件，也不会显示报告列表通知。

en.description: When Quash receives a saved crash log, this service opens the crash-report prompt and carries the log into the report flow.
en.disableEffect: Quash’s crash-report prompt will not open; the app’s regular features remain available.

zh-CN.description: Quash 收到已保存的崩溃日志时，此服务会打开崩溃报告提示，并将日志带入报告流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Quash 的崩溃报告提示将无法打开，但应用的常规功能仍可使用。

en.description: Quash uses this foreground service to keep a report shortcut available, save captured files, and open its crash prompt when a crash log arrives.
en.disableEffect: Quash loses its persistent report shortcut, captured-file handling, and automatic crash prompt; the app’s regular features remain available.

zh-CN.description: Quash 使用此前台服务保留报告快捷入口、保存采集的文件，并在收到崩溃日志时打开报告提示。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Quash 的常驻报告入口、文件处理和自动崩溃提示将停止，但应用的常规功能仍可使用。

en.description: During Quash’s bug-capture flow, this foreground service shows a screen-recording notice and floating control while capture runs.
en.disableEffect: Quash users cannot control this screen capture or attach recording evidence through this service.

zh-CN.description: Quash 采集问题过程时，这个前台服务会在屏幕录制期间显示录制通知和悬浮控件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此服务控制屏幕录制或附加录屏证据。

en.description: When the older Quash crash-reporting flow receives a crash log, this service opens a prompt to review and report it, including any screen recording.
en.disableEffect: Quash’s crash-reporting prompt will not open; the app’s regular features remain available.

zh-CN.description: 较早版本的 Quash 崩溃报告流程收到崩溃日志时，此服务会打开提示，供用户查看并提交日志和屏幕录制。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Quash 的崩溃报告提示将无法打开，但应用的常规功能仍可使用。

en.description: When a Queue-it protected page places someone in a waiting room, this Activity loads the queue page, tracks whether access is granted, and returns the result to the app.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot complete the Queue-it waiting room, so app features that depend on that protected access become unavailable.

zh-CN.description: Queue-it 保护的页面需要用户进入等候队列时，此 Activity 会打开排队页面、跟踪是否获得访问权限，并将结果返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法完成 Queue-it 排队流程，依赖该受保护访问权限的应用功能也无法使用。

en.description: When the app starts Quicko’s embedded income-tax service, this Activity opens the tax-filing experience and lets the user attach supporting documents.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open the app’s Quicko tax-filing flow.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动 Quicko 内嵌所得税服务时，此 Activity 会打开报税流程，并允许用户附上证明文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开应用中的 Quicko 报税流程。

en.description: When Qwasi delivers a broadcast message, this service fetches its details and either displays a Qwasi notification or passes the message to the app’s configured notification handler.
en.disableEffect: Qwasi messages and notifications handled by this service stop; the app’s other features remain available.

zh-CN.description: Qwasi 推送广播消息时，此服务会获取消息详情，并显示 Qwasi 通知或将消息交给应用配置的通知处理程序。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 此服务处理的 Qwasi 消息和通知将停止，但应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: QySDK shows its game-account login and registration flow here, including phone, verification-code, saved-account, and identity-check screens. It may attempt to sign in with a saved account when opened.
en.disableEffect: Players may be unable to sign in, register, or complete identity verification through QySDK.

zh-CN.description: QySDK 在此显示游戏账号登录和注册流程，包括手机号、验证码、已保存账号和身份核验页面；打开时也可能尝试使用已保存账号登录。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，玩家可能无法通过 QySDK 登录、注册或完成身份核验。

en.description: QySDK opens this screen when a game starts a purchase. It loads the order details and available payment methods for the selected account, role, and amount.
en.disableEffect: In-game purchases through QySDK may not start or complete.

zh-CN.description: 游戏发起购买时，QySDK 会打开此页面，并加载所选账号、角色和金额对应的订单信息及可用支付方式。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，游戏可能无法通过 QySDK 发起或完成购买。

en.description: QySDK opens this screen for the payment page returned by its payment service. It can hand supported Alipay or WeChat links to those apps and checks the order again when the page closes.
en.disableEffect: QySDK web checkout and its payment-status check may fail, leaving a purchase unfinished.

zh-CN.description: QySDK 会在支付服务返回网页支付页面时打开此页面，并可将支付宝或微信链接交给对应应用；页面关闭后还会重新查询订单状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，QySDK 网页支付和支付状态查询可能失败，导致购买无法完成。

en.description: QySDK displays account pages and identity-verification pages in an in-app browser. Its login, account, and age-check flows open this screen with the page to show.
en.disableEffect: Players may be unable to manage or verify their game account through QySDK.

zh-CN.description: QySDK 在应用内浏览器中显示账号页面和身份核验页面；登录、账号管理和年龄核验流程会把要显示的网页交给此页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，玩家可能无法通过 QySDK 管理或核验游戏账号。

en.description: QySDK loads a supplied page in an in-app browser. Its game-account pages include privacy and terms information, and web-based identity checks can return results through this screen.
en.disableEffect: QySDK privacy, terms, or web-based verification pages may fail to open or finish.

zh-CN.description: QySDK 会在应用内浏览器中打开指定网页，其游戏账号页面包括隐私和条款信息，网页身份核验也会通过此页面返回结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，QySDK 的隐私、条款或网页身份核验页面可能无法打开或完成。

en.description: The QySDK receiver starts its background service after the device finishes booting or the user unlocks the screen. The analyzed service has no separate user-facing action.
en.disableEffect: The service will no longer start from those boot or unlock events; no other app-facing effect is shown in the analyzed code.

zh-CN.description: 设备启动完成或用户解锁屏幕后，QySDK 接收器会启动其后台服务；所分析的服务没有其他面向用户的操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，设备启动或解锁时将不再启动该服务；所分析代码未显示其他应用层面的影响。

en.description: When Radius Networks’ iBeacon library receives scan results, this service sends beacon-ranging and region entry or exit updates to the app.
en.disableEffect: Apps using this library stop receiving iBeacon and monitored-region updates.

zh-CN.description: Radius Networks 的 iBeacon 库收到扫描结果后，此服务会向应用发送信标测距以及进入或离开监测区域的更新。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此库的应用将无法再收到 iBeacon 和监测区域变化。

en.description: When an app asks Radius Networks’ iBeacon library to watch for or range nearby iBeacons, this service runs Bluetooth scans and tracks matching regions.
en.disableEffect: The app loses the iBeacon detection and region updates provided by this library.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求 Radius Networks 的 iBeacon 库监测附近信标或测距时，此服务会执行蓝牙扫描并跟踪匹配区域。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法使用此库检测 iBeacon 或接收区域更新。

en.description: raiseyang's Weapon SDK saves the app context at startup and sends an internal startup message to the app's own package.
en.disableEffect: Weapon SDK code that depends on this startup context or message may not initialize.

zh-CN.description: raiseyang 的 Weapon SDK 会在应用启动时保存应用上下文，并向应用自身发送内部启动消息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此启动上下文或消息的 Weapon SDK 功能可能无法初始化。

en.description: Rakuten Analytics initializes its tracking module at app startup and applies the app's location, web-tracking, and event settings.
en.disableEffect: When automatic initialization is enabled, Rakuten Analytics will no longer set up its event and location tracking through this startup path.

zh-CN.description: Rakuten Analytics 会在应用启动时初始化跟踪模块，并应用应用配置的位置、网页跟踪和事件设置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 启用自动初始化时，Rakuten Analytics 将无法再通过此启动流程设置事件和位置跟踪。

en.description: Rakuten Analytics can turn matching location-update broadcasts into analytics events. Its manifest declares a different message from the one its code accepts, so broadcasts using the declared message are ignored.
en.disableEffect: Blocking it removes this receiver's location analytics; its declared update message currently does not trigger event tracking.

zh-CN.description: Rakuten Analytics 可将匹配的位置更新广播记录为分析事件。它的清单声明了与代码实际接受内容不同的消息，因此使用清单所声明消息的广播会被忽略。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，此接收器不会再记录位置分析事件；目前清单声明的更新消息也无法触发事件跟踪。

en.description: Rakutentech's Rakuten MiniApp SDK reads the host app's settings at startup, initializes mini-app pages, and records a host-launch analytics event.
en.disableEffect: The app's Rakuten MiniApp pages may fail to initialize or launch.

zh-CN.description: Rakutentech 的 Rakuten MiniApp SDK 会在应用启动时读取宿主应用设置、初始化小程序页面，并记录宿主应用启动分析事件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用中的 Rakuten MiniApp 页面可能无法初始化或打开。

en.description: Rakutentech's Rakuten MiniApp SDK uses this file provider to create app-scoped links to files that mini-app pages need to open or share.
en.disableEffect: Mini-app file access and file-sharing flows that use these links may fail.

zh-CN.description: Rakutentech 的 Rakuten MiniApp SDK 会通过此文件提供程序为小程序需要打开或分享的文件创建应用内链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 小程序的文件访问及依赖这些链接的文件分享流程可能会失败。

en.description: Rakutentech's Rakuten SDK Utils initializes its app-information helper at startup so Rakuten SDK modules can use the host app context.
en.disableEffect: Rakuten SDK utilities that depend on this startup setup may not initialize correctly.

zh-CN.description: Rakutentech 的 Rakuten SDK Utils 会在应用启动时初始化应用信息辅助功能，供 Rakuten SDK 模块使用宿主应用上下文。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此启动设置的 Rakuten SDK 工具功能可能无法正确初始化。

en.description: Razorpay Android Checkout SDK opens this payment screen when the app starts checkout and returns the payment result to the app.
en.disableEffect: Payments that use Razorpay checkout cannot be completed in the app.

zh-CN.description: Razorpay Android Checkout SDK 在应用发起付款时打开此支付页面，并把支付结果返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法完成依赖 Razorpay 收银台的付款。

en.description: Razorpay Android Checkout SDK opens a web storefront or item list for its Magic Checkout flow and returns the shopping result to the app.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot use the Magic Checkout storefront and cart flow.

zh-CN.description: Razorpay Android Checkout SDK 为 Magic Checkout 流程打开网页商店或商品列表，并把购物结果返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法使用 Magic Checkout 商店和购物车流程。

en.description: The React Native WebView library uses this provider when an embedded page requests a camera photo or video for upload. It makes the captured file available to the page through Android's private file-sharing system.
en.disableEffect: Camera-based photo or video uploads from embedded web pages may fail.

zh-CN.description: 内置网页请求拍摄照片或视频并上传时，React Native WebView 会使用此文件提供程序。它通过 Android 的私有文件共享机制将拍摄的文件交给网页。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 内置网页可能无法通过相机拍摄并上传照片或视频。

en.description: When a user chooses card scanning in Hyperswitch checkout, this Activity opens the camera-based card scanner and sends the scanned card number or a cancelled or failed result back to checkout.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, users cannot complete checkout by scanning a card through this flow.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Hyperswitch 结账时选择扫描银行卡，SDK 会通过此 Activity 打开相机扫描界面，并将卡号或取消、失败结果返回结账流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法通过此流程扫描银行卡完成结账。

en.description: Chuck's in-app HTTP inspector uses this provider to store and retrieve captured request and error records. Its data backs the inspector's history screens.
en.disableEffect: Chuck may no longer save or show its request and error history, but the app's own network requests still work.

zh-CN.description: Chuck 应用内 HTTP 检查工具使用此内容提供程序保存和读取请求及错误记录，为历史页面提供数据。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Chuck 可能无法再保存或显示请求和错误历史，但应用自身的网络请求仍可正常工作。

en.description: Chuck's in-app HTTP inspector runs this service when a user clears captured traffic or error history. It deletes the selected records and dismisses the related notifications.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to clear Chuck's saved traffic or error history from its controls; the app still works normally.

zh-CN.description: 用户清除已记录的流量或错误历史时，Chuck 应用内 HTTP 检查工具会运行此服务。它会删除所选记录并关闭相关通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 Chuck 控件清除保存的流量或错误历史；应用仍可正常使用。

en.description: Chuck's in-app HTTP inspector opens this screen to list captured network requests and errors. Users can choose a record to inspect.
en.disableEffect: Chuck's network-history screen will not open, but the app's own network requests continue to work.

zh-CN.description: Chuck 应用内 HTTP 检查工具会打开此页面，列出已记录的网络请求和错误，供用户选择查看。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Chuck 网络历史页面将无法打开，但应用自身的网络请求仍可正常工作。

en.description: Chuck, an Android in-app HTTP inspector, opens when a user selects a captured network request and shows its summary, request, response, search, and sharing options.
en.disableEffect: The request details will not open in Chuck, but the app normal network calls will continue to work.

zh-CN.description: Chuck 是 Android 应用内的 HTTP 检查工具；用户选中一条已记录的网络请求时，此页面会显示概要、请求内容、响应内容以及搜索和分享选项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Chuck 将无法打开请求详情，但应用的普通网络请求仍可正常进行。

en.description: Chuck's in-app HTTP inspector opens this screen to show details for a captured error. It displays the saved error information selected from the history list.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to inspect captured error details in Chuck; normal app features remain available.

zh-CN.description: 用户查看已记录的错误详情时，Chuck 应用内 HTTP 检查工具会打开此页面。页面显示用户从历史列表中选中的错误信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在 Chuck 中查看已记录的错误详情；应用的正常功能仍可使用。

en.description: Chuck's in-app HTTP inspector opens this screen when a user selects a captured network request. It displays that request's details.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to inspect individual captured requests in Chuck; normal app networking continues.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择一条已记录的网络请求时，Chuck 应用内 HTTP 检查工具会打开此页面，显示该请求的详细信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在 Chuck 中查看单条请求详情；应用的正常网络功能仍可使用。

en.description: Realtention Android SDK opens this screen for server-provided app update prompts or message dialogs; an update button can open the app store listing.
en.disableEffect: The app will not show these update or message dialogs, so users may miss a required-update notice.

zh-CN.description: Realtention Android SDK 在收到服务端提供的更新提示或消息时打开此页面；更新按钮可以跳转到应用商店页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法显示这些更新提示或消息，用户可能错过必须更新的通知。

en.description: When Android runs its scheduled check, Zapr (Redbricklane) media and viewership SDK checks whether audio sampling is active and schedules it to restart if it stopped.
en.disableEffect: Zapr may fail to resume media measurement after Android stops its recording service.

zh-CN.description: Android 执行定时检查时，Zapr（Redbricklane）媒体与观看测量 SDK 会检查音频采样是否运行，并在停止后安排重新启动。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Android 停止录音服务后，Zapr 可能无法恢复媒体测量。

en.description: When Android runs the upload job, Zapr (Redbricklane) sends stored audio fingerprints to its service if enough time has passed since the previous upload.
en.disableEffect: Zapr audio fingerprints may not be uploaded, reducing its media measurement.

zh-CN.description: Android 执行上传任务时，Zapr（Redbricklane）会在距离上次上传足够久后，将保存的音频指纹发送到其服务器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Zapr 的音频指纹可能无法上传，媒体测量数据会减少。

en.description: Zapr (Redbricklane) uses this receiver for broadcasts that start, stop, destroy, or update its audio-recognition service and adjust its recording priority.
en.disableEffect: Zapr may miss commands to start or stop background audio recognition, so media measurement can stop or respond incorrectly.

zh-CN.description: Zapr（Redbricklane）通过此接收器处理启动、停止、销毁或更新音频识别服务以及调整录音优先级的广播。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Zapr 可能收不到启动或停止后台音频识别的命令，导致媒体测量停止或响应异常。

en.description: When an audio-sampling alarm fires, Zapr (Redbricklane) uses this receiver to process the next sample for media recognition.
en.disableEffect: Scheduled audio samples will not be taken for Zapr media recognition.

zh-CN.description: 音频采样闹钟触发时，Zapr（Redbricklane）通过此接收器处理下一段媒体识别样本。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Zapr 将无法按计划采集用于媒体识别的音频样本。

en.description: When Zapr (Redbricklane) periodic check alarm fires, this receiver checks its recording service and schedules a restart if the service has stopped.
en.disableEffect: Zapr may not restart background media recognition after its recording service stops.

zh-CN.description: Zapr（Redbricklane）的定期检查闹钟触发时，此接收器会检查录音服务，并在服务停止后安排重启。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 录音服务停止后，Zapr 可能无法重新启动后台媒体识别。

en.description: Zapr (Redbricklane) starts this service to coordinate background audio recognition, sampling alarms, and stop or opt-out requests.
en.disableEffect: Zapr audio recognition and its background start or stop controls will no longer run.

zh-CN.description: Zapr（Redbricklane）通过此服务协调后台音频识别、采样闹钟以及停止或退出请求。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Zapr 的音频识别及后台启动、停止控制将无法运行。

en.description: Zapr (Redbricklane) starts this foreground service for scheduled audio-fingerprint sampling and shows a notification while it is active.
en.disableEffect: Zapr will stop collecting audio samples used to recognize media and measure viewing.

zh-CN.description: Zapr（Redbricklane）通过此前台服务按计划采集音频指纹，并在服务运行时显示通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Zapr 将停止采集用于识别媒体和测量观看情况的音频样本。

en.description: When its periodic upload command runs, Zapr (Redbricklane) sends collected audio fingerprints to its service and limits uploads to at most once per minute.
en.disableEffect: Collected audio fingerprints may not reach Zapr, reducing its media measurement.

zh-CN.description: 定期上传命令触发时，Zapr（Redbricklane）会将采集到的音频指纹发送到其服务器，并限制为每分钟最多上传一次。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 采集到的音频指纹可能无法发送到 Zapr，媒体测量数据会减少。

en.description: On Android 11 and later, Zapr (Redbricklane) starts this media-browser service with an empty media session to support background audio recognition.
en.disableEffect: Zapr background audio-recognition support may be interrupted; this service does not provide music playback for the app.

zh-CN.description: 在 Android 11 及更高版本上，Zapr（Redbricklane）会启动此媒体浏览服务并建立空媒体会话，以支持后台音频识别。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Zapr 的后台音频识别支持可能会中断；此服务不为应用提供音乐播放。

en.description: Zapr Base Data SDK uses this provider to store and read typed settings for registration, audio sampling, and synchronization.
en.disableEffect: Zapr may lose access to settings needed for its registration, sampling, or synchronization.

zh-CN.description: Zapr Base Data SDK 使用此内容提供器保存和读取注册、音频采样及同步所需的类型化设置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Zapr 可能无法读取注册、采样或同步所需的设置。

en.description: When Android runs the configuration job, Zapr Base Data SDK fetches and applies its current remote settings.
en.disableEffect: Zapr remote settings may become stale, interrupting its measurement work.

zh-CN.description: Android 执行配置任务时，Zapr Base Data SDK 会获取并应用最新的远程设置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Zapr 的远程设置可能过期，影响其测量工作。

en.description: When Android runs a registration or synchronization job, Zapr Base Data SDK registers this installation or syncs its SDK data with Zapr.
en.disableEffect: Zapr may fail to register this installation or keep its measurement data in sync.

zh-CN.description: Android 执行注册或同步任务时，Zapr Base Data SDK 会注册此安装实例或与 Zapr 同步 SDK 数据。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Zapr 可能无法注册此安装实例或同步测量数据。

en.description: When Android runs the periodic time-sync job, Zapr Base Data SDK refreshes its time offset with the service for measurement timestamps.
en.disableEffect: Zapr measurement timestamps may become inaccurate over time.

zh-CN.description: Android 执行定期时间同步任务时，Zapr Base Data SDK 会向服务器校准时间偏差，以记录测量时间戳。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Zapr 的测量时间戳可能逐渐变得不准确。

en.description: After device boot, charging, or app replacement, Zapr Base Data SDK uses this receiver to resume registration, configuration, or synchronization work.
en.disableEffect: Zapr measurement work may not resume after reboot, charging, or an app update.

zh-CN.description: 设备开机、接入电源或应用更新后，Zapr Base Data SDK 通过此接收器恢复注册、配置或同步任务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 设备重启、接入电源或应用更新后，Zapr 的测量任务可能无法恢复。

en.description: When Zapr SDK instances exchange setup messages, this receiver shares whether the installation is registered and can record audio or access location.
en.disableEffect: Zapr SDK instances may not coordinate setup, which can interrupt their background measurement.

zh-CN.description: 多个 Zapr SDK 实例交换初始化消息时，此接收器会共享安装注册状态以及录音或定位权限状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 多个 Zapr SDK 实例可能无法协调初始化，导致后台测量中断。

en.description: When another Zapr SDK reports its recording priority, this receiver coordinates which SDK can run audio sampling.
en.disableEffect: Zapr may ignore recording-priority messages and fail to start or stop its data collection at the right time.

zh-CN.description: 其他 Zapr SDK 报告录音优先级时，此接收器会协调由哪个 SDK 执行音频采样。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Zapr 可能无法响应录音优先级消息，导致数据采集未能及时启动或停止。

en.description: When the device clock or time zone changes, Zapr Base Data SDK refreshes its server-time offset and notifies related SDK services.
en.disableEffect: Zapr measurement timestamps may be wrong after a clock or time-zone change.

zh-CN.description: 设备时间或时区变化时，Zapr Base Data SDK 会重新校准服务器时间偏差，并通知相关 SDK 服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 设备时间或时区变化后，Zapr 的测量时间戳可能不准确。

en.description: When an update command arrives while Zapr is active, this service fetches and applies new Zapr configuration.
en.disableEffect: Zapr recording and synchronization settings may remain out of date.

zh-CN.description: Zapr 处于运行状态并收到更新命令时，此服务会获取并应用新的配置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Zapr 的录音和同步设置可能无法及时更新。

en.description: Zapr Base Data SDK uses this service to compare recording priority with other Zapr installations and send a start or stop decision.
en.disableEffect: Zapr may not coordinate which installation performs background audio measurement.

zh-CN.description: Zapr Base Data SDK 使用此服务与其他 Zapr 安装实例比较录音优先级，并发送启动或停止决定。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Zapr 可能无法协调由哪个安装实例执行后台音频测量。

en.description: When a registration or synchronization request starts this service, Zapr Base Data SDK registers the installation or syncs its SDK data with Zapr.
en.disableEffect: Zapr registration and routine SDK synchronization may stop.

zh-CN.description: 收到注册或同步请求并启动此服务时，Zapr Base Data SDK 会注册安装实例或与 Zapr 同步 SDK 数据。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Zapr 注册及常规 SDK 同步可能停止。

en.description: When its time-sync alarm fires, Zapr Base Data SDK requests a fresh server-time offset for its measurement timestamps.
en.disableEffect: Zapr measurement timestamps may become inaccurate over time.

zh-CN.description: 时间同步闹钟触发时，Zapr Base Data SDK 会请求最新的服务器时间偏差，用于测量时间戳。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Zapr 的测量时间戳可能逐渐变得不准确。

en.description: Zapr Base SDK uses this provider to store and read typed settings for its event reporting and upload schedules.
en.disableEffect: Zapr event settings and upload records may become unavailable, interrupting SDK event reporting.

zh-CN.description: Zapr Base SDK 使用此内容提供器保存和读取事件上报及上传计划所需的类型化设置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Zapr 的事件设置和上传记录可能无法读取，SDK 事件上报会中断。

en.description: When Android runs the critical-event job, Zapr Base SDK sends queued high-priority SDK events to its service.
en.disableEffect: High-priority Zapr SDK event reports may not be sent.

zh-CN.description: Android 执行关键事件任务时，Zapr Base SDK 会把排队等待的高优先级 SDK 事件发送到其服务器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 高优先级的 Zapr SDK 事件可能无法上报。

en.description: When the critical-event upload command starts this service, Zapr Base SDK sends queued high-priority SDK events and schedules another upload.
en.disableEffect: High-priority Zapr SDK event reports may be delayed or lost.

zh-CN.description: 关键事件上传命令启动此服务时，Zapr Base SDK 会发送排队等待的高优先级 SDK 事件，并安排下一次上传。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 高优先级的 Zapr SDK 事件可能延迟上报或丢失。

en.description: When Android runs the event-upload job, Zapr Base SDK sends queued SDK events to its service, subject to an upload interval.
en.disableEffect: Routine Zapr SDK event reports may stop reaching its service.

zh-CN.description: Android 执行事件上传任务时，Zapr Base SDK 会按上传间隔把排队等待的 SDK 事件发送到其服务器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Zapr 的常规 SDK 事件可能无法继续上报。

en.description: When its scheduled upload command arrives, Zapr Base SDK sends queued SDK events and schedules the next upload attempt.
en.disableEffect: Routine Zapr SDK event reports may stop reaching its service.

zh-CN.description: 收到计划中的上传命令时，Zapr Base SDK 会发送排队等待的 SDK 事件，并安排下一次上传。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Zapr 的常规 SDK 事件可能无法继续上报。

en.description: Zapr Base SDK receives boot and SDK-state broadcasts here, then schedules or cancels its event-upload jobs to match the current settings.
en.disableEffect: Zapr event uploads may not resume after boot or respond to changes in the SDK settings.

zh-CN.description: Zapr Base SDK 在此接收开机和 SDK 状态广播，并根据当前设置安排或取消事件上传任务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Zapr 事件上传可能无法在开机后恢复，也无法响应 SDK 设置变化。

en.description: When the Zapr Video SDK starts a VAST ad, this Activity plays the video, tracks viewing progress, and lets the viewer visit the advertiser. It also reports whether the ad was dismissed or reached viewing milestones.
en.disableEffect: Zapr video ads cannot play or open their advertiser pages, and rewards for watching those ads will no longer be granted.

zh-CN.description: Zapr 视频广告 SDK 播放 VAST 视频广告、记录观看进度，并允许用户访问广告主页面。它还会报告用户是否关闭广告或观看到相应进度。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Zapr 视频广告无法播放或打开广告主页面，观看这些广告的奖励也不会发放。

en.description: When the app opens the RedMadRobot Debug Panel from its debug controls, this Activity displays the panel as a bottom sheet. The sheet can be dismissed to return to the app.
en.disableEffect: The RedMadRobot debug panel cannot be opened as a bottom sheet; ordinary app screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: 当应用通过 RedMadRobot Debug Panel 的调试入口打开面板时，此 Activity 会以底部抽屉的形式显示面板。用户关闭抽屉后即可返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，RedMadRobot 调试面板无法以底部抽屉形式打开，应用的普通页面仍可使用。

en.description: When the app opens the RedMadRobot Debug Panel, this Activity displays the diagnostic tools registered by the app. It is launched from the panel's debug controls or notification.
en.disableEffect: The RedMadRobot diagnostic panel cannot be opened, while the app's ordinary screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: 当应用打开 RedMadRobot Debug Panel 时，此 Activity 会显示应用注册的诊断工具。它可从面板的调试入口或通知中打开。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，RedMadRobot 诊断面板无法打开，应用的普通页面仍可使用。

en.description: When the user opens Debug Panel settings, this Activity lists configuration screens for plugins that provide settings. The user can choose a plugin to adjust its debug options.
en.disableEffect: The Debug Panel plugin settings screen cannot be opened, but this does not disable the app's regular features.

zh-CN.description: 当用户打开 Debug Panel 设置时，此 Activity 会列出提供设置页面的插件。用户可选择插件调整其调试选项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Debug Panel 的插件设置页面无法打开，但不会停用应用的常规功能。

en.description: When the user taps the RedMadRobot Debug Panel launcher entry, it opens the SDK's debug screen with its available development tools or settings. This entry appears as a separate launcher icon.
en.disableEffect: The separate Debug Panel launcher icon no longer opens its development tools; the app's main launcher remains available.

zh-CN.description: 当用户点按 RedMadRobot Debug Panel 的启动器入口时，它会打开 SDK 的调试页面，显示可用的开发工具或设置。此入口会作为单独的启动器图标出现。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，单独的 Debug Panel 启动器图标无法打开开发工具，应用的主启动入口仍可使用。

en.description: In the older RedMadRobot Debug Panel, this Activity lists plugins that provide a settings screen. Selecting a plugin opens its settings inside the panel.
en.disableEffect: The older panel can no longer open plugin settings, while the app's regular screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: 在旧版 RedMadRobot Debug Panel 中，此 Activity 会列出提供设置页面的插件。选择插件后，会在面板中打开相应设置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，旧版面板无法打开插件设置，应用的普通页面仍可使用。

en.description: When a ReelyActive BLE scan alarm fires, this Receiver wakes the app and starts the SDK's scan service for another Bluetooth scan cycle.
en.disableEffect: Scheduled scans may stop waking the app, so nearby-device detection can stop or become delayed.

zh-CN.description: 当 ReelyActive BLE 扫描闹钟触发时，此 Receiver 会唤醒应用，并启动 SDK 的扫描服务以开始下一轮蓝牙扫描。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，定时扫描可能无法唤醒应用，附近设备检测会停止或变得延迟。

en.description: When the ReelyActive BLE SDK requests another background scan cycle, this Service scans for nearby Bluetooth devices and then lets the phone return to sleep.
en.disableEffect: Nearby-device scanning stops between scheduled scan cycles, so apps using ReelyActive proximity detection may miss updates.

zh-CN.description: 当 ReelyActive BLE SDK 请求进行下一轮后台扫描时，此服务组件 会扫描附近的蓝牙设备，随后让手机恢复休眠。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，定时扫描期间的附近设备检测会停止，使用 ReelyActive 近距离设备检测功能的应用可能无法收到更新。

en.description: When the Refinery89 Monetize App SDK opens its built-in diagnostic screen, this Activity lists tools for checking app details, ad setup, saved preferences, and SDK logs. It also provides links to ad inspection and creative preview tools.
en.disableEffect: Refinery89's built-in diagnostic and ad-preview screens cannot be opened, while ordinary app screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: 当 Refinery89 Monetize App SDK 打开内置诊断页面时，此 Activity 会列出用于查看应用信息、广告设置、已保存偏好和 SDK 日志的工具。页面还提供广告检查和创意预览入口。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Refinery89 内置的诊断和广告预览页面无法打开，应用的普通页面仍可使用。

zh-CN.description: 导出 Refinery89 SDK 日志时，此 FileProvider 会为系统分享界面提供已保存文件的链接。它为该分享流程开放 SDK 应用目录和下载目录中的文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，SDK 尝试分享已保存文件时，Refinery89 日志导出可能失败。

en.description: The Related Digital Android SDK sets this receiver on a repeating alarm to refresh location monitoring for nearby campaign triggers.

zh-CN.description: Related Digital Android SDK 会通过重复闹钟定期刷新位置监测，以便触发附近的营销活动。

en.description: When opened with spin-to-win campaign data, this Related Digital Android SDK screen displays the interactive game.
en.disableEffect: The spin-to-win campaign game will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: Related Digital Android SDK 收到转盘赢奖活动数据后，会用此页面显示互动游戏。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 转盘赢奖活动的游戏将无法打开。

en.description: When opened with campaign story content, this Related Digital Android SDK viewer plays timed images or videos and provides tap-through links.
en.disableEffect: Story campaigns from this SDK will no longer play or open their links.

zh-CN.description: Related Digital Android SDK 收到营销故事内容后，会用此页面按时间播放图片或视频，并提供跳转链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 该 SDK 的故事营销内容将无法播放，相关链接也无法打开。

en.description: When a user interacts with a Related Digital push-notification carousel, this receiver changes the displayed card and records notification opens for campaign reporting.
en.disableEffect: Carousel controls and open reporting for Related Digital push notifications may stop working.

zh-CN.description: 用户操作 Related Digital 推送通知轮播时，此接收器会切换显示卡片并记录通知打开情况供活动统计。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Related Digital 推送通知的轮播控件和打开记录可能停止工作。

en.description: When Firebase delivers a Related Digital push message, this service processes it and displays its notification; it also sends refreshed push tokens to the SDK.
en.disableEffect: Related Digital push notifications and token updates through Firebase will stop.

zh-CN.description: Firebase 收到 Related Digital 推送消息时，此服务会处理并显示通知，也会将更新后的推送令牌发送给 SDK。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Related Digital 的 Firebase 推送通知和令牌更新将停止。

en.description: When Huawei Push delivers a Related Digital message, this service processes it and displays its notification; it also sends refreshed push tokens to the SDK.
en.disableEffect: Related Digital push notifications and token updates through Huawei Push will stop.

zh-CN.description: 华为推送收到 Related Digital 消息时，此服务会处理并显示通知，也会将更新后的推送令牌发送给 SDK。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Related Digital 的华为推送通知和令牌更新将停止。

en.description: When an app requests location access through the Related Digital Android SDK, this screen asks for foreground and, on newer Android versions, background access.
en.disableEffect: An app requesting location through this SDK may fail when opening the permission screen.

zh-CN.description: 应用通过 Related Digital Android SDK 请求位置权限时，此页面会请求前台位置权限，并在较新 Android 版本上请求后台位置权限。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用通过该 SDK 请求位置权限时，权限页面可能无法打开。

en.description: When started by the app, Renxh4 Mock displays a movable floating panel with the device address and the browser port used to mock data.
en.disableEffect: The floating mock-data panel will no longer appear.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动 Renxh4 Mock 时，它会显示可移动的悬浮面板，展示设备地址和用于在浏览器中模拟数据的端口。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用于模拟数据的悬浮面板将不再显示。

en.description: During app startup, the Reteno SDK uses this Provider to create its application-level instance before Reteno features are used. Reteno services and analytics rely on that instance.
en.disableEffect: Reteno cannot create its instance at startup, so later Reteno analytics or push calls can fail.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，Reteno SDK 会通过此 Provider 创建应用级实例，供后续 Reteno 功能使用。Reteno 服务和数据分析都依赖该实例。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Reteno 无法在启动时创建实例，之后调用 Reteno 数据分析或推送功能可能失败。

en.description: When Firebase delivers a Reteno push message or refreshes the device's push token, this Service passes the message or token to the Reteno SDK.
en.disableEffect: Reteno push messages and token updates no longer reach its SDK, while unrelated app features continue to work.

zh-CN.description: 当 Firebase 收到 Reteno 推送消息或更新设备推送令牌时，此 Service 会把消息或令牌交给 Reteno SDK。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Reteno SDK 将无法收到推送消息和令牌更新，应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: When a user taps a Reteno notification, this Activity records the interaction, closes the notification, and opens its linked page or the app. It can also route a Reteno in-app message.
en.disableEffect: Reteno notification taps can no longer be tracked or routed to their linked pages.

zh-CN.description: 当用户点按 Reteno 通知时，此 Activity 会记录交互、关闭通知，并打开通知链接或应用。它也可处理 Reteno 应用内消息的跳转。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Reteno 通知点击将无法记录，也无法跳转到对应页面。

en.description: When a Reteno notification click is delivered as a broadcast, this Receiver records the interaction, closes the notification, and opens its linked page or the app.
en.disableEffect: Reteno notification clicks delivered through this route can no longer be tracked or opened.

zh-CN.description: 当 Reteno 通知点击以广播形式送达时，此 Receiver 会记录交互、关闭通知，并打开通知链接或应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，通过此入口送达的 Reteno 通知点击将无法记录或打开。

en.description: When Reteno's app-resume broadcast is sent as the app returns to the foreground, this Receiver checks whether notifications are enabled and reports the current state to Reteno.
en.disableEffect: Reteno no longer receives this notification-enabled status check when the app resumes.

zh-CN.description: 应用回到前台并发送 Reteno 应用恢复广播时，此 Receiver 会检查通知是否启用，并将当前状态报告给 Reteno。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用恢复时 Reteno 将无法收到这次通知启用状态检查。

en.description: When the app sends a Reteno custom-push broadcast, this Receiver forwards its data to listeners registered for Reteno custom push events.
en.disableEffect: Listeners registered for Reteno custom push events no longer receive these callbacks.

zh-CN.description: 当应用发送 Reteno 自定义推送广播时，此 Receiver 会把其中的数据转发给已注册的 Reteno 自定义推送监听器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，已注册的 Reteno 自定义推送监听器将无法收到这些回调。

en.description: When Android reports that the app or one of its notification channels was blocked or unblocked, this Receiver checks the current notification state and reports it to Reteno.
en.disableEffect: Reteno no longer learns when the user blocks or re-enables the app's notification channels.

zh-CN.description: 当 Android 报告应用或某个通知渠道被屏蔽或重新启用时，此 Receiver 会检查当前通知状态并报告给 Reteno。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户屏蔽或重新启用应用通知渠道时，Reteno 将无法获知状态变化。

en.description: When Reteno's push-permission-changed broadcast is sent, this Receiver checks whether notifications are allowed and reports the current state to Reteno.
en.disableEffect: Reteno no longer receives notification-permission status updates through this receiver.

zh-CN.description: 当发送 Reteno 推送权限变更广播时，此 Receiver 会检查通知是否允许，并将当前状态报告给 Reteno。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Reteno 将无法通过此 Receiver 收到通知权限状态更新。

en.description: When Reteno broadcasts that a push message was received, this Receiver forwards the message data to registered Reteno listeners.
en.disableEffect: App code listening for Reteno push-received events no longer receives those callbacks.

zh-CN.description: 当 Reteno 广播收到推送消息时，此 Receiver 会把消息数据转发给已注册的 Reteno 监听器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，监听 Reteno 推送接收事件的应用代码将无法收到这些回调。

en.description: When Reteno sends custom data for an in-app message, this Receiver forwards that data to the SDK's registered listeners.
en.disableEffect: Listeners for Reteno in-app custom data no longer receive these events.

zh-CN.description: 当 Reteno 为应用内消息发送自定义数据时，此 Receiver 会把数据转发给 SDK 已注册的监听器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Reteno 应用内自定义数据的监听器将无法收到这些事件。

en.description: When Reteno reports that a notification was clicked, this Receiver forwards the notification data to registered click-event listeners.
en.disableEffect: App code listening for Reteno notification-click events no longer receives those callbacks.

zh-CN.description: 当 Reteno 报告通知被点按时，此 Receiver 会把通知数据转发给已注册的点击事件监听器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，监听 Reteno 通知点击事件的应用代码将无法收到这些回调。

en.description: When a Reteno notification is dismissed, this Receiver forwards the notification data to registered deletion-event listeners.
en.disableEffect: App code listening for Reteno notification-dismissal events no longer receives those callbacks.

zh-CN.description: 当 Reteno 通知被关闭时，此 Receiver 会把通知数据转发给已注册的关闭事件监听器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，监听 Reteno 通知关闭事件的应用代码将无法收到这些回调。

en.description: When RevenueCat detects a Test Store key in a release app, this Activity displays a Wrong API Key warning that tells the owner to configure a production store key.
en.disableEffect: RevenueCat's invalid release-key warning flow may fail when it tries to open this disabled screen.

zh-CN.description: 当 RevenueCat 在正式版应用中检测到 Test Store 密钥时，此 Activity 会显示“API 密钥错误”警告，提示应用配置正式商店密钥。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，RevenueCat 尝试打开此页面时，正式版密钥错误提示流程可能失败。

en.description: When RevenueCat starts an Amazon Appstore purchase, this Activity hands the product request to Amazon's billing flow and returns the result to RevenueCat.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot complete Amazon Appstore purchases through RevenueCat.

zh-CN.description: 当 RevenueCat 发起 Amazon Appstore 购买时，此 Activity 会把商品请求交给 Amazon 计费流程，并将结果返回给 RevenueCat。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过 RevenueCat 完成 Amazon Appstore 购买。

en.description: When the app asks RevenueCat to show a paywall, this Activity displays subscription offers and reports purchase, cancellation, or dismissal results to the app.
en.disableEffect: RevenueCat paywalls cannot open or complete the subscription purchase flow that uses this screen.

zh-CN.description: 当应用请求 RevenueCat 显示付费墙时，此 Activity 会展示订阅方案，并将购买、取消或关闭的结果返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，使用此页面的 RevenueCat 付费墙无法打开或完成订阅购买流程。

en.description: When the app opens RevenueCat Customer Center, this Activity displays the user's subscription and purchase-management options and returns when the screen is dismissed.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot open RevenueCat Customer Center, so the subscription-management options provided there are unavailable.

zh-CN.description: 当应用打开 RevenueCat Customer Center 时，此 Activity 会显示用户的订阅和购买管理选项，并在页面关闭时返回。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用无法打开 RevenueCat Customer Center，其中提供的订阅管理选项也无法使用。

en.description: When the app starts a Revolut card checkout, this Activity displays the card form, validates payment details, handles any bank-verification page, and returns the payment result.
en.disableEffect: Card payments through Revolut Merchant Card Form cannot be started or completed.

zh-CN.description: 当应用启动 Revolut 银行卡结账时，此 Activity 会显示银行卡表单、验证付款信息、处理可能出现的银行验证页面，并返回付款结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，无法通过 Revolut Merchant Card Form 发起或完成银行卡付款。

en.description: When the user chooses Learn More in the Revolut Pay promotional widget, this Activity displays an informational page about the Revolut Pay offer.
en.disableEffect: The optional Revolut Pay information page cannot be opened from the promotional widget.

zh-CN.description: 当用户在 Revolut Pay 推广组件中选择了解更多时，此 Activity 会显示 Revolut Pay 优惠的说明页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法从推广组件打开可选的 Revolut Pay 说明页面。

en.description: When the Revolut Pay promotional widget asks for a country choice, this Activity lets the user choose a country and returns it to the widget.
en.disableEffect: The widget cannot select or update its country, so its country-specific offer flow may not work.

zh-CN.description: 当 Revolut Pay 推广组件要求选择国家或地区时，此 Activity 会让用户进行选择，并将结果返回给组件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，该组件无法选择或更新国家或地区，因此相应的地区优惠流程可能无法使用。

en.description: When a Revolut Pay sandbox checkout opens its confirmation link, this Activity shows test-only Confirm and Cancel controls and returns the selected result.
en.disableEffect: The Revolut Pay sandbox cannot complete this test confirmation step; production checkout does not use this screen.

zh-CN.description: 当 Revolut Pay 沙盒结账打开确认链接时，此 Activity 会显示仅供测试的确认和取消选项，并返回所选结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Revolut Pay 沙盒无法完成此测试确认步骤；正式结账不会使用此页面。

en.description: When a Revolut Pay checkout requires hosted confirmation, this Activity loads the confirmation page in an in-app browser and handles its return links.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot complete Revolut Pay checkouts that require this confirmation screen.

zh-CN.description: 当 Revolut Pay 结账需要托管页面确认时，此 Activity 会在应用内浏览器中加载确认页面并处理返回链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法完成需要此确认页面的 Revolut Pay 结账。

en.description: Android starts this RevOS Vehicle Controller SDK receiver for PHONE_STATE and NEW_OUTGOING_CALL broadcasts. It tracks ringing and call changes, sends call events, and clears the connected vehicle display's current image when appropriate.
en.disableEffect: Call-related events and call-aware information on the connected vehicle display may stop updating.

zh-CN.description: Android 收到 PHONE_STATE 或 NEW_OUTGOING_CALL 广播时会启动 RevOS Vehicle Controller SDK 的此接收器。它跟踪来电和通话状态变化、发送通话事件，并在需要时清除已连接车辆显示屏上的当前图像。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通话事件和已连接车辆显示屏上的通话相关信息可能不再更新。

en.description: The RevOS Vehicle Controller SDK uses this receiver for an app-directed stop broadcast. It sends a stop signal to the Bluetooth service and records that the connection should stop.
en.disableEffect: The Bluetooth service may not receive the app's stop signal and could keep running after a stop request.

zh-CN.description: RevOS Vehicle Controller SDK 会通过发给应用的停止广播触发此接收器。它向蓝牙服务发送停止信号，并记录应停止连接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 蓝牙服务可能收不到应用发出的停止信号，并在收到停止请求后继续运行。

en.description: The RevOS Vehicle Controller SDK starts this background service to scan for and reconnect to the remembered vehicle over Bluetooth. It carries device status and control data while the connection is active.
en.disableEffect: The app may lose its background Bluetooth connection, vehicle status updates, and device-control functions.

zh-CN.description: RevOS Vehicle Controller SDK 会启动此后台服务，通过蓝牙搜索并重新连接已记住的车辆；连接期间由它传递设备状态和控制数据。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用可能失去后台蓝牙连接、车辆状态更新和设备控制功能。

en.description: After the user grants notification access, the RevOS Vehicle Controller SDK reads navigation, media, and call notifications and forwards relevant information to the connected vehicle display. It also tracks navigation guidance updates.
en.disableEffect: Navigation directions, media details, and call information may no longer appear on the connected vehicle display.

zh-CN.description: 用户授予通知访问权限后，RevOS Vehicle Controller SDK 会读取导航、媒体和通话通知，并将相关信息转发到已连接车辆的显示屏；它也会跟踪导航指引更新。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 导航指引、媒体信息和通话信息可能不再显示在已连接车辆的显示屏上。

en.description: The RevOS Vehicle Controller SDK opens Cashfree's checkout from a vehicle-related payment flow using its payment token and parameters. It returns the transaction result to the SDK.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot complete or return the result of a Cashfree payment in this flow.

zh-CN.description: RevOS Vehicle Controller SDK 会在车辆相关付款流程中使用付款令牌和参数打开 Cashfree 收银台，并将交易结果返回 SDK。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在此流程中完成 Cashfree 付款或将结果返回 SDK。

en.description: When the RevOS Vehicle Controller SDK needs permissions to discover nearby devices, it asks for location and contacts access. The result is returned to the vehicle-discovery flow.
en.disableEffect: Nearby vehicle discovery may fail when the required location and contacts access has not already been granted.

zh-CN.description: RevOS Vehicle Controller SDK 需要搜索附近设备的权限时，会请求位置和联系人访问权限，并将授权结果返回设备搜索流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 如果尚未授予所需的位置和联系人权限，搜索附近车辆可能会失败。

en.description: RevTwo’s in-app support SDK opens this screen during a support call when the phone is held near the user’s face. It dims the display until the phone is moved away to help prevent accidental touches.
en.disableEffect: A RevTwo support call may error when the phone is brought near the face, and the screen will not dim automatically.

zh-CN.description: RevTwo 应用内支持 SDK 会在支持通话时检测到手机靠近面部后打开此界面并调暗屏幕；移开手机后界面关闭，以减少误触。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 把手机靠近面部时，RevTwo 支持通话可能报错，而且屏幕不会自动变暗。

en.description: After Android finishes starting the device, this RevTwo receiver starts the background support service so call and message alerts can resume without opening the app.
en.disableEffect: After the device restarts, RevTwo support alerts may not resume until the app starts its background service.

zh-CN.description: Android 完成设备启动后，RevTwo 广播接收器会启动后台支持服务，让来电和消息提醒无需先打开应用也能恢复。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 设备重启后，RevTwo 支持提醒可能要等应用启动后台服务后才会恢复。

en.description: Once a RevTwo support voice call connects, this screen provides controls to mute the microphone, switch speaker audio, share the screen, or end the call.
en.disableEffect: A connected RevTwo support call may lose its in-call controls and screen-sharing screen.

zh-CN.description: RevTwo 支持语音通话接通后，此界面提供麦克风静音、切换扬声器、共享屏幕和结束通话的控制。
zh-CN.disableEffect: RevTwo 支持通话接通后可能没有通话控制界面，也无法打开屏幕共享界面。

en.description: The RevTwo in-app support SDK opens this screen for a support ticket or community conversation. Users can read and send messages, attach images, report content, and start a voice call for a community ticket.
en.disableEffect: RevTwo support conversations, image attachments, content reports, and community call entry will be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: RevTwo 应用内支持 SDK 会在打开支持工单或社区对话时显示此界面。用户可以收发消息、附加图片、举报内容，并从社区工单发起语音通话。
zh-CN.disableEffect: RevTwo 支持对话、图片附件、内容举报和从社区工单发起通话的功能将无法使用。

en.description: This RevTwo screen gathers a description of the user’s issue and submits it as a new support ticket. It also retrieves existing support tickets for the user to browse.
en.disableEffect: Users may be unable to submit a new support ticket through the RevTwo support flow.

zh-CN.description: RevTwo 此界面收集用户的问题描述并将其提交为新的支持工单，也会读取已有工单供用户查看。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户可能无法通过 RevTwo 支持流程提交新的支持工单。

en.description: When Android reports a connectivity change, this RevTwo receiver stops the background support service while offline and starts it again after internet access returns.
en.disableEffect: RevTwo support notifications may not reconnect automatically after the network is lost or restored.

zh-CN.description: Android 报告网络状态变化时，RevTwo 广播接收器会在断网时停止后台支持服务，并在网络恢复后重新启动它。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 网络断开或恢复后，RevTwo 支持通知可能无法自动重新连接。

en.description: RevTwo opens this menu from an active support-call notification, where users can mute, switch to speaker, or end the call. In a separate report mode, it lets users flag ticket content.
en.disableEffect: Users may be unable to manage an active RevTwo support call or report ticket content from these menus.

zh-CN.description: RevTwo 会从正在进行的支持通话通知中打开此菜单，用户可静音、切换扬声器或结束通话；举报模式则可标记工单内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户可能无法通过这些菜单管理 RevTwo 支持通话或举报工单内容。

en.description: When RevTwo receives an incoming support call, this screen rings and vibrates and lets the user answer or decline. Answering starts the call and opens its management controls.
en.disableEffect: Incoming RevTwo support calls may not be answerable or rejectable through their call screen.

zh-CN.description: RevTwo 收到支持来电时，此界面会响铃并振动，供用户接听或拒绝；接听后会启动通话并打开管理控制。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户可能无法通过来电界面接听或拒绝 RevTwo 支持来电。

en.description: When users enter RevTwo community support, this screen loads community tickets and opens a message conversation when a ticket is selected.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to browse RevTwo community support tickets or open their conversations.

zh-CN.description: 用户进入 RevTwo 社区支持时，此界面会加载社区工单，并在用户选择工单后打开消息对话。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法浏览 RevTwo 社区支持工单或打开工单对话。

en.description: When a RevTwo support call ends while its ticket is still open, this prompt asks whether to close the issue. Confirming closes the support ticket.
en.disableEffect: The user may not be prompted to mark a support ticket resolved when a RevTwo call ends.

zh-CN.description: RevTwo 支持通话结束且工单仍未关闭时，此提示会询问用户是否关闭问题；确认后会关闭工单。
zh-CN.disableEffect: RevTwo 通话结束时，用户可能不会收到将支持工单标记为已解决的提示。

en.description: RevTwo starts this background service to register the app with its support service and listen for ticket messages and incoming support calls. It posts alerts and manages active calls.
en.disableEffect: RevTwo support-call alerts, ticket-message notifications, and call sessions may stop working.

zh-CN.description: RevTwo 会启动此后台服务，将应用注册到支持服务并接收工单消息和支持来电；它还会发送提醒并管理正在进行的通话。
zh-CN.disableEffect: RevTwo 支持来电提醒、工单消息通知和通话会话可能停止工作。

en.description: In older RevTwo releases, this prompt appears when a support call ends with an open ticket. Confirming closes the support ticket; canceling dismisses the prompt.
en.disableEffect: Users of the older RevTwo flow cannot confirm closing a support ticket from this prompt.

zh-CN.description: 旧版 RevTwo 支持通话结束且工单仍未关闭时会显示此提示；确认会关闭工单，取消则关闭提示。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用旧版 RevTwo 流程的用户将无法通过此提示确认关闭支持工单。

en.description: During a connected RevTwo support call, this screen displays frames from the shared phone screen. It provides controls to stop sharing, change call audio, or end the call.
en.disableEffect: The support agent will not be able to view the phone screen through RevTwo screen sharing, and its call controls may be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: RevTwo 支持通话接通期间，此界面显示共享的手机屏幕画面，并提供停止共享、切换通话音频或结束通话的控制。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 支持人员将无法通过 RevTwo 屏幕共享查看手机画面，相关通话控制也可能无法使用。

en.description: When a user starts a RevTwo support call from a ticket conversation, this screen shows call controls while the connection is set up. Once connected, it moves to the in-call screen.
en.disableEffect: RevTwo support calls may not start or reach their in-call controls.

zh-CN.description: 用户从 RevTwo 工单对话发起支持通话时，此界面会在连接过程中显示通话控制；接通后会切换到通话界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: RevTwo 支持通话可能无法启动或进入通话控制界面。

en.description: Rubicon’s RFM ad SDK opens an in-app browser when an interactive ad opens a link. It loads the destination page and provides navigation and close controls.
en.disableEffect: Destination pages opened from Rubicon ads will not load in the SDK’s in-app browser.

zh-CN.description: Rubicon 的 RFM 广告 SDK 会在互动广告打开链接时启动应用内浏览器，加载目标网页并提供导航和关闭按钮。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Rubicon 广告打开的目标网页将无法在 SDK 的应用内浏览器中加载。

en.description: Rubicon’s RFM ad SDK opens this full-screen player when an interactive ad starts video playback.
en.disableEffect: Video clips launched from Rubicon ads will not play in this player.

zh-CN.description: Rubicon 的 RFM 广告 SDK 会在互动广告开始播放视频时打开此全屏播放器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Rubicon 广告启动的视频片段将无法通过此播放器播放。

en.description: After the user grants screen-capture permission, the Ribbon SDK uses this foreground service to record the display to a video file. Its notification provides pause, resume, and stop controls.
en.disableEffect: Ribbon screen recordings will not start or finish, so any SDK flow that depends on capturing a session loses that recording.

zh-CN.description: 用户授予屏幕捕获权限后，Ribbon SDK 会通过此前台服务将屏幕录制为视频文件；通知中提供暂停、继续和停止控制。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Ribbon 屏幕录制无法启动或完成，依赖会话录制的 SDK 流程将失去录制内容。

en.description: After the user grants screen-capture permission, the Ribbon SDK uses this foreground service to record the display to a video file. Its notification provides pause, resume, and stop controls.
en.disableEffect: Ribbon screen recordings will not start or finish, so any SDK flow that depends on capturing a session loses that recording.

zh-CN.description: 用户授予屏幕捕获权限后，Ribbon SDK 会通过此前台服务将屏幕录制为视频文件；通知中提供暂停、继续和停止控制。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Ribbon 屏幕录制无法启动或完成，依赖会话录制的 SDK 流程将失去录制内容。

en.description: When Ribbon opens a supplied design link, this full-screen page displays its Figma content in an embedded browser view.
en.disableEffect: Ribbon’s embedded design content cannot be opened inside the app.

zh-CN.description: Ribbon 打开传入的设计链接时，此全屏界面会在内嵌浏览器中显示其 Figma 内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Ribbon 的内嵌设计内容将无法在应用中打开。

en.description: RingCentral RCV asks Android Telecom to create incoming and outgoing call connections for calls managed by the SDK. It supplies caller details and connects Android’s call interface to the RingCentral call session.
en.disableEffect: Calls that rely on RingCentral’s Android Telecom integration may fail to appear or connect.

zh-CN.description: RingCentral RCV 会通过 Android Telecom 为 SDK 管理的来电和去电创建通话连接，并提供来电信息，将 Android 通话界面接入 RingCentral 通话会话。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖 RingCentral Android Telecom 集成的通话可能无法显示或接通。

en.description: Poseidon-R LogUtils opens this Activity when the app's diagnostic log viewer is requested. It lists collected debug entries and lets a user copy them to the clipboard.
en.disableEffect: The in-app diagnostic log viewer and its copy action are unavailable.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求打开诊断日志查看器时，Poseidon-R LogUtils 会打开此 Activity。它列出收集到的调试记录，并可将记录复制到剪贴板。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用内的诊断日志查看器及复制功能不可用。

en.description: The temi SDK starts this provider automatically with the app, stores the app context, and connects to the temi robot service. This prepares the SDK’s robot-control connection.
en.disableEffect: Apps using temi APIs may fail to connect to or control the temi robot.

zh-CN.description: temi SDK 会随应用启动自动运行此组件，保存应用上下文并连接 temi 机器人服务，为 SDK 的机器人控制功能建立连接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用 temi API 的应用可能无法连接或控制 temi 机器人。

en.description: Rokid Air screen casting starts this foreground service after Android grants screen-capture permission. It captures the phone display for the cast preview and provides floating controls to return or lock the screen.
en.disableEffect: Rokid Air screen mirroring cannot keep capturing or send the phone display to the cast preview.

zh-CN.description: Android 授予屏幕捕获权限后，Rokid Air 投屏会启动此前台服务，捕获手机画面供投屏预览，并提供返回和锁屏浮动控制。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Rokid Air 投屏将无法持续捕获手机画面或将画面发送到投屏预览。

en.description: When a user taps the lock control during Rokid Air casting, this screen dims the display and blocks touch until the user double-taps to close it.
en.disableEffect: The cast lock control will not open its screen and may interrupt the casting interface.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Rokid Air 投屏时点击锁屏控制，此界面会调暗屏幕并阻止触摸，直到用户双击将其关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 投屏锁屏控制将无法打开锁屏界面，并可能中断投屏操作。

en.description: Rokid Air screen casting opens this screen to request overlay permission when needed, then asks Android for screen-capture permission and starts casting after consent.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot complete Rokid Air’s permission flow or start screen mirroring.

zh-CN.description: Rokid Air 投屏会打开此界面，在需要时申请悬浮窗权限，再请求 Android 屏幕捕获权限，并在用户同意后启动投屏。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法完成 Rokid Air 的权限流程或启动屏幕投屏。

en.description: Rokid Account Network starts this service when an app requests a token for a third-party cloud service. It checks that the user is signed in to Rokid and obtains the token needed for that cloud connection.
en.disableEffect: Cloud integrations that rely on this service may not be able to obtain a token or connect to the user’s account.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求第三方云服务令牌时，Rokid Account Network 会启动此服务。它会检查用户是否已登录 Rokid 账号，并获取连接该云服务所需的令牌。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此服务的云端集成可能无法获取令牌或连接用户账号。

en.description: This Rokid Alliance service plays music or other audio from app assets or a supplied audio source. It supports looping, pause, resume, and stop.
en.disableEffect: Music and other audio routed through the Rokid Alliance playback service will not work.

zh-CN.description: Rokid Alliance 此服务可播放应用资源中的音乐或传入的音频源，并支持循环、暂停、继续和停止。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过 Rokid Alliance 播放服务播放音乐或其他音频的功能将无法使用。

en.description: Rokid Meeting creates this provider at app startup to register Juphoon sign-in, calling, device, sharing, and channel services for its real-time meetings.
en.disableEffect: Rokid Meeting’s Juphoon-based login, calling, and sharing flows stop working because these services are not registered.

zh-CN.description: Rokid Meeting 会在应用启动时创建此内容提供器，为实时会议注册 Juphoon 登录、通话、设备、共享和频道服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，这些服务无法注册，Rokid Meeting 的 Juphoon 登录、通话和共享流程会停止工作。

en.description: At app startup, this provider registers Rokid’s Juphoon-based calling and messaging services for remote collaboration.
en.disableEffect: Calls and meeting messages that use this engine will not be available.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，此提供程序会为 Rokid 远程协作注册基于 Juphoon 的通话和消息服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此引擎的通话和会议消息将无法使用。

en.description: During a one-participant video session, this screen shows the other participant’s live stream and provides microphone and audio-output controls; users can also minimize or leave the session.
en.disableEffect: The focused participant view and its audio controls will not open.

zh-CN.description: 在单人视频会话中，此页面显示另一位参与者的实时画面，并提供麦克风和音频输出控制；用户也可以将会话缩小或离开。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 无法打开此单人画面，也无法使用其中的音频控制。

en.description: During a Rokid meeting, this screen shows the message history and lets participants send text messages.
en.disableEffect: Participants will not be able to open or use this in-meeting chat.

zh-CN.description: Rokid 会议期间，此页面显示消息记录并允许参与者发送文字消息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 参与者将无法打开或使用会议文字聊天。

en.description: Before starting a meeting, this screen lets users set meeting details, choose people to invite, and select camera, microphone, speaker, and recording options.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to configure and start meetings through this screen.

zh-CN.description: 开始会议前，用户可在此设置会议资料、选择邀请对象，并设置摄像头、麦克风、扬声器和录制选项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此页面设置和发起会议。

en.description: At app startup, this provider registers Rokid’s core calling, meeting-media, and messaging services.
en.disableEffect: The meeting SDK will not be able to initialize its call, audio/video, or messaging services.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，此提供程序会注册 Rokid 的核心通话、会议音视频和消息服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 会议 SDK 将无法初始化通话、音视频或消息服务。

en.description: From an active meeting, this screen opens a participant’s live camera view and provides tools for remote camera control, pointing, drawing, image capture, and sharing.
en.disableEffect: The selected participant’s camera-detail session and its collaboration tools will not open.

zh-CN.description: 在会议中打开参与者的实时摄像画面后，用户可在此远程控制摄像头、指点画面、绘图、拍照和共享内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 无法打开该参与者的摄像详情会话或使用其中的协作工具。

en.description: During a meeting, this screen provides a shared whiteboard where participants can draw, change pen color and width, undo marks, clear the board, and save their work.
en.disableEffect: Participants will not be able to open or use the shared whiteboard.

zh-CN.description: 会议期间，此页面提供共享白板，参与者可以绘图、调整笔的颜色和粗细、撤销笔迹、清空白板并保存内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 参与者将无法打开或使用共享白板。

en.description: When users open meeting materials, this screen lists shared files and documents so they can browse or select an item.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to browse or open meeting files through this screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开会议资料时，此页面会列出共享文件和文档，供其浏览或选择。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此页面浏览或打开会议文件。

en.description: When an incoming meeting invitation is shown, this screen displays the caller and offers audio answer, video answer, and reject options.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to answer or reject incoming calls through the Rokid call screen.

zh-CN.description: 收到会议邀请时，此页面显示来电者，并提供语音接听、视频接听和拒绝选项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 Rokid 来电页面接听或拒绝来电。

en.description: This background service listens for Rokid meeting invitations, shows an incoming-call notification, and handles call cancellation or timeout.
en.disableEffect: Incoming invitations may not be monitored or shown while the app is in the background.

zh-CN.description: 此后台服务监听 Rokid 会议邀请、显示来电通知，并处理取消或超时的来电。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用在后台时，可能无法监听或显示来电邀请。

en.description: This screen lets users enter a six-digit meeting code, choose camera and audio settings, and join the matching meeting.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to join a meeting by entering its code.

zh-CN.description: 用户可在此输入六位会议码、选择摄像头和音频设置，并加入对应会议。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过输入会议码加入会议。

en.description: During a meeting, this screen lists participants, shows their audio and video status, and lets users control their own microphone.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to check participant status or control their microphone from this screen.

zh-CN.description: 会议期间，此页面列出参与者、显示其音视频状态，并允许用户控制自己的麦克风。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此页面查看参与者状态或控制自己的麦克风。

en.description: When a participant opens shared pictures, this screen displays them in a full-screen gallery and lets the user move between images.
en.disableEffect: Shared pictures will not open in the Rokid image viewer.

zh-CN.description: 参与者打开共享图片时，此页面会以全屏相册显示图片，并允许用户切换查看。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 共享图片将无法在 Rokid 图片查看器中打开。

en.description: When a meeting video is opened, this screen plays the supplied video and displays its playback controls.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to play meeting videos through this player.

zh-CN.description: 打开会议视频时，此页面会播放视频并显示播放控制项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此播放器播放会议视频。

en.description: When users choose to resume an interrupted meeting, this screen retrieves the meeting details and rejoins the session.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to resume interrupted meetings through this flow.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择恢复中断的会议时，此页面会查询会议资料并重新加入会话。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此流程恢复中断的会议。

en.description: When a user minimizes a meeting, this service creates the movable floating video window used to keep the meeting visible.
en.disableEffect: The floating meeting video window and its return controls will not be available.
