zh-CN.description: 用户缩小会议时，此服务会创建可移动的悬浮视频窗口，让会议画面继续显示。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 会议悬浮画面及其返回控制项将无法使用。

en.description: This is the main Rokid meeting screen: it displays participants and provides controls for audio, video, inviting members, chat, and shared content.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to open or operate the main meeting screen.

zh-CN.description: 这是 Rokid 会议的主页面，显示参与者，并提供音频、视频、邀请成员、聊天和共享内容等控制项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开或操作会议主页面。

en.description: The meeting SDK uses this bound service to check and report whether its augmented-reality collaboration mode is supported.
en.disableEffect: The SDK may not be able to complete its augmented-reality capability check, affecting whether that mode is offered.

zh-CN.description: 会议 SDK 通过此绑定服务检查并报告设备是否支持增强现实协作模式。
zh-CN.disableEffect: SDK 可能无法完成增强现实能力检查，从而影响该模式是否可用。

en.description: During an augmented-reality collaboration session, this screen combines the camera view with shared spatial marks and interactive scene controls.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to open the Rokid augmented-reality collaboration view.

zh-CN.description: 增强现实协作期间，此页面将摄像头画面与共享空间标记和场景交互控制结合起来。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开 Rokid 增强现实协作页面。

en.description: This diagnostic screen previews the small floating meeting window and is opened through the SDK’s test route.
en.disableEffect: Only this diagnostic preview screen will be unavailable; regular meetings and their floating window can still be used.

zh-CN.description: 此诊断页面用于预览会议悬浮小窗，可通过 SDK 的测试入口打开。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 只有此诊断预览页面会无法使用；正常会议及其悬浮窗口仍可使用。

en.description: After a contact is selected, this screen shows that person’s details and the related service or order options.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to open a contact’s detail and related service options.

zh-CN.description: 选择联系人后，此页面显示该联系人的资料以及相关服务或订单选项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法查看联系人的详情和相关服务选项。

en.description: This screen lists available contacts in ranked groups so users can choose someone to invite or contact for a service.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to browse or choose contacts through the Rokid meeting flow.

zh-CN.description: 此页面按级别分组列出可选联系人，供用户邀请或联系以获取服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在 Rokid 会议流程中浏览或选择联系人。

en.description: When a completed service order is opened, this screen shows its participants, timing, result, notes, and recording options.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to review completed order details or access their recordings here.

zh-CN.description: 打开已完成的服务订单时，此页面显示参与者、时间、处理结果、备注和录制内容选项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在此查看已完成订单的详情或访问录制内容。

en.description: This screen lists service orders and lets users open a selected order’s details.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to browse service orders through the Rokid meeting flow.

zh-CN.description: 此页面列出服务订单，并允许用户打开所选订单的详情。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在 Rokid 会议流程中浏览服务订单。

en.description: After a meeting, this screen loads the service-rating questions and lets users submit feedback.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to submit a service rating through this screen.

zh-CN.description: 会议结束后，此页面加载服务评价问题并允许用户提交反馈。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此页面提交服务评价。

en.description: After a service rating is submitted, this screen confirms the submission and lets users return.
en.disableEffect: The rating confirmation screen will not be available.

zh-CN.description: 提交服务评价后，此页面确认提交结果并允许用户返回。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 服务评价提交后的确认页面将无法显示。

en.description: When a completed order’s recording is previewed, this screen plays the supplied session video.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to preview completed-session recordings here.

zh-CN.description: 预览已完成订单的录制内容时，此页面会播放对应的会话视频。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在此预览已完成会话的录制内容。

en.description: When a camera-control request arrives during a meeting, this screen shows controls for the selected participant’s camera, including zoom.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to adjust the selected camera through this meeting control screen.

zh-CN.description: 会议中收到摄像头控制请求时，此页面显示所选参与者摄像头的控制项，包括变焦。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此会议控制页面调节所选摄像头。

en.description: During a meeting, this screen lets a user point to a location on live video so remote participants can see the indicated spot.
en.disableEffect: The in-meeting video-pointing tool will not be available.

zh-CN.description: 会议期间，用户可在此指出实时视频中的位置，让远端参与者看到所指区域。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 会议中的视频指点工具将无法使用。

en.description: Rokid Meeting opens this screen for live augmented-reality collaboration during a meeting. It uses the camera view to place arrows, circles, drawings, and images in the shared scene and exchanges those marks with other participants.
en.disableEffect: Participants lose the shared AR scene and annotation tools in Rokid meetings.

zh-CN.description: Rokid Meeting 会在会议中打开此实时增强现实协作画面。它使用摄像头画面在共享场景中放置箭头、圆圈、涂鸦和图片，并与其他参会者交换这些标注。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，参会者无法使用 Rokid 会议中的共享增强现实场景和标注工具。

en.description: The Rokid Meeting SLAM SDK creates this provider at app startup to check whether the device supports its shared AR meeting mode and send that capability to the meeting service.
en.disableEffect: Rokid Meeting no longer receives the device’s SLAM support status, so it cannot enable shared AR through this capability check.

zh-CN.description: Rokid Meeting SLAM SDK 会在应用启动时创建此内容提供器，检查设备是否支持共享增强现实会议模式，并将这一能力告知会议服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Rokid Meeting 无法收到设备的 SLAM 支持状态，也就无法通过此能力检查启用共享增强现实模式。

en.description: Rokid Meeting opens this screen when an incoming meeting call reaches the app. It shows the caller and lets the user answer with audio or video, or decline the call.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to answer or decline Rokid meeting calls from this screen.

zh-CN.description: Rokid Meeting 收到会议来电时会打开此页面。页面显示来电信息，并提供语音接听、视频接听和拒接操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此页面接听或拒绝 Rokid 会议来电。

en.description: The Rokid Meeting SDK starts this foreground service while meeting call reception is enabled. It keeps the call receiver running and registers for network changes so incoming call alerts can be handled.
en.disableEffect: The app may miss meeting calls or call alerts while running in the background.

zh-CN.description: 启用 Rokid Meeting 来电接收时，SDK 会启动此常驻服务。它在后台保持来电接收，并监听网络变化以处理来电提醒。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用在后台运行时可能收不到会议来电或来电提醒。

en.description: Rokid Meeting opens this screen when a user prepares or starts a call. It previews the camera and microphone settings and provides controls to start or end the meeting call.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to set up or start a meeting call through this SDK screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户准备或发起 Rokid Meeting 通话时，SDK 会打开此页面。页面预览摄像头和麦克风设置，并提供发起或结束通话的操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此 SDK 页面设置或发起会议通话。

en.description: During a Rokid Meeting call, this screen handles camera and meeting detail actions. It supports inviting participants, ending the call, leaving a share, and sending shared drawing updates.
en.disableEffect: In-call camera details, participant controls, and related sharing actions may fail to open or complete.

zh-CN.description: Rokid Meeting 通话期间，此页面处理摄像头和会议详情操作。它支持邀请参会者、结束通话、退出共享以及发送共享涂鸦内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 会中的摄像头详情、参会者控制和相关共享操作可能无法打开或完成。

en.description: Rokid Meeting opens this screen when a user starts a shared drawing session. It displays the drawing canvas and sends marks or images to the other meeting participants.
en.disableEffect: The shared drawing canvas will not open, and meeting participants will not receive drawing updates from it.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Rokid Meeting 中发起涂鸦共享时，SDK 会打开此页面。页面显示绘图画布，并向其他参会者发送标记或图片。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 共享涂鸦画布将无法打开，其他参会者也收不到此页面发送的绘图更新。

en.description: When a user opens or joins a Rokid Meeting invitation, this screen reads the meeting number and name and starts the meeting join flow.
en.disableEffect: Users may be unable to join a meeting through an invitation or meeting number.

zh-CN.description: 用户通过邀请或会议号码加入 Rokid Meeting 时，此页面读取会议号码和名称并开始加入流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户可能无法通过邀请或会议号码加入会议。

en.description: Rokid Meeting opens this room screen for a one-stream meeting session. It shows participants and shared content, and handles meeting messages and whiteboard sharing.
en.disableEffect: The one-stream meeting room and its participant, message, and sharing controls will not work.

zh-CN.description: Rokid Meeting 会为单路视频会议打开此会议室页面。页面显示参会者和共享内容，并处理会议消息与白板共享。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 单路视频会议室及其参会者、消息和共享控制将无法使用。

en.description: Rokid Meeting opens this room screen after a call starts. It shows meeting participants and active shared content, and handles in-call actions such as screen sharing.
en.disableEffect: The meeting room and its in-call participant or screen-sharing controls may fail.

zh-CN.description: Rokid Meeting 在通话开始后打开此会议室页面。页面显示参会者和当前共享内容，并处理屏幕共享等会中操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 会议室及会中的参会者或屏幕共享控制可能无法使用。

en.description: During a Rokid Meeting live camera view, users open this panel to adjust zoom, focus, and lighting, or save an image from the view.
en.disableEffect: Users will lose these camera adjustment and image capture controls during a meeting.

zh-CN.description: Rokid Meeting 显示实时摄像头画面时，用户可打开此面板调整变焦、对焦和补光，也可保存画面截图。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在会议中使用这些摄像头调节和画面截取操作。

en.description: During a Rokid Meeting video call, this screen lets a participant mark a point on the video and share the mark with the room. The user can adjust the mark size and color.
en.disableEffect: The video marking tool will not open or send marks to meeting participants.

zh-CN.description: Rokid Meeting 视频通话中，用户可用此页面在画面上标记位置并将标记分享给会议室。用户还可调整标记的大小和颜色。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 画面标记工具将无法打开，也无法向参会者发送标记。

en.description: Rokid WebView opens this screen for the English web-page route. It loads the requested page, follows account sign-in changes, and supports page actions such as saving an image.
en.disableEffect: English web pages and their account-dependent content will not open through this Rokid route.

zh-CN.description: Rokid WebView 收到英文网页入口请求时会打开此页面。它加载指定网页、跟踪账号登录状态，并支持保存图片等页面操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 英文网页及其依赖账号状态的内容将无法通过此 Rokid 入口打开。

en.description: Rokid Screen Record opens this screen for a station live-video page. It plays the selected device stream and provides controls to record the video and adjust its viewing background.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to open, view, or record station live video through this SDK screen.

zh-CN.description: Rokid Screen Record 会为站点实时视频页面打开此屏幕。它播放所选设备的视频流，并提供录像和调整观看背景的操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此 SDK 页面打开、观看或录制站点实时视频。

en.description: The Rokid ARExperts media library opens a file using the supplied link and file name. It shows file details and download state, then opens a local or downloaded file in an available viewer.
en.disableEffect: File previews, downloads, and opening documents through this library may fail.

zh-CN.description: Rokid ARExperts 媒体库会根据传入的链接和文件名打开文件，显示文件信息和下载状态，并在文件就绪后调用可用的查看器打开本地或下载的文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过此媒体库预览、下载或打开文件的功能可能无法使用。

en.description: The Rokid ARExperts media screen previews files supplied by the app: it displays images and plays video or audio, with playback controls and optional auto-play.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to preview images or play videos and audio through this media screen.

zh-CN.description: Rokid ARExperts 媒体界面用于预览应用传入的文件：显示图片并播放视频或音频，提供播放控制和可选的自动播放。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此媒体界面预览图片或播放视频和音频。

en.description: Rokid Camera Recorder starts this service when the app requests audio recording, video recording, or photo capture. It performs the requested capture and returns status or results to the app.
en.disableEffect: The app will not be able to use this SDK’s audio recording, video recording, or photo capture features.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求录音、录像或拍照时，Rokid Camera Recorder 会启动此服务。它执行相应的采集任务，并将状态或结果返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法使用此 SDK 提供的录音、录像或拍照功能。

en.description: Rokid Ecology's media picker opens this guide after camera, microphone, or photo and video access is denied. It explains the missing permission and can take the user to the app's system settings.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot see the permission guide or reach system settings from the denied media-picker flow.

zh-CN.description: Rokid Ecology 的媒体选择器在摄像头、麦克风或照片与视频权限被拒绝后会打开此说明页。页面解释所需权限，并可带用户前往应用的系统设置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法在媒体选择器权限被拒绝时查看说明或从该流程进入系统设置。

en.description: Rokid Ecology's user center opens this web-based mall from its mall entry. The page loads the mall content inside the app.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open the user-center mall page.

zh-CN.description: Rokid Ecology 的用户中心会从商城入口打开此网页商城，并在应用内加载商城内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法打开用户中心的商城页面。

en.description: Rokid Ecology's user center opens this recommendation page from a mission or recommendation entry. It loads web content for the business category supplied by the app.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open the corresponding user-center recommendation page.

zh-CN.description: Rokid Ecology 的用户中心会从任务或推荐入口打开此推荐页面，并加载应用指定业务类别的网页内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法打开相应的用户中心推荐页面。

en.description: Rokid Ecology opens this profile-editing screen when the user chooses to change their avatar. The screen lets the user update the profile image.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot change their profile avatar through this screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择更换头像时，Rokid Ecology 会打开此资料编辑页面。用户可以在这里更新个人头像。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法通过此页面更换个人头像。

en.description: Rokid Ecology opens this profile-editing screen when the user chooses to change their display name. The screen lets the user update the name shown in the account.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot change their account display name through this screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择修改显示名称时，Rokid Ecology 会打开此资料编辑页面。用户可以在这里更新账户中显示的名称。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法通过此页面修改账户显示名称。

en.description: Rokid Ecology opens this page when a feature passes it a web link to display. It loads that link inside the app, including links opened from the UGC community pages.
en.disableEffect: Web pages opened through this in-app flow cannot be displayed.

zh-CN.description: Rokid Ecology 会在功能传入网页链接时打开此页面，并在应用内显示该链接，包括从 UGC 社区页面打开的链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 此应用内流程打开的网页将无法显示。

en.description: Rokid Overseas Account starts this service when an app requests a token for an overseas cloud service. It refreshes the signed-in Rokid account and obtains the token needed by that cloud connection.
en.disableEffect: Overseas cloud integrations that rely on Rokid account tokens may fail to connect.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求海外云服务令牌时，Rokid Overseas Account 会启动此服务。它会刷新已登录的 Rokid 账号凭据，并获取连接该云服务所需的令牌。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖 Rokid 账号令牌的海外云端集成可能无法连接。

en.description: The Rokid Air SDK opens this screen from its headset setup flow to show local Rokid store locations. If the glasses connect while the page is open, it unlocks them and closes.
en.disableEffect: Users lose the store list and cannot complete the headset-unlock step through this page.

zh-CN.description: Rokid Air SDK 会在眼镜设置流程需要展示门店时打开此页面，列出本地 Rokid 门店；若眼镜在页面打开期间接入，页面会解锁眼镜并关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过此页面查看门店或完成眼镜解锁步骤。

en.description: The Rokid Air SDK shows this setup page after the glasses unlock when the Rokid Air companion app is not installed. Its button opens Rokid’s APK download page in a browser.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot download the companion app through this Rokid Air setup flow.

zh-CN.description: 眼镜解锁后，如果设备尚未安装 Rokid Air 配套应用，Rokid Air SDK 会显示此设置页面；点击按钮会在浏览器中打开 Rokid 应用下载页。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过 Rokid Air 的此设置流程下载配套应用。

en.description: The Rokid Air SDK exposes this activity for links opened from a browser or another app. It reads user details from the link, checks the connected glasses, then continues to the connection, store, or companion-app flow and opens Rokid Air when setup is ready.
en.disableEffect: Rokid Air links cannot open this glasses-setup flow, so users lose its connection, unlock, and companion-app launch path.

zh-CN.description: Rokid Air SDK 将此活动作为可从浏览器或其他应用打开的链接入口。它读取链接中的用户信息、检查已连接的眼镜，并进入连接、门店或配套应用流程；准备完成后会打开 Rokid Air 应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Rokid Air 链接无法打开此设置流程，用户也无法通过此入口连接、解锁眼镜或启动配套应用。

en.description: The Rokid Glass media SDK starts this foreground service after Android grants screen-capture access. It keeps the capture session available to the meeting media system for sharing or recording the phone display.
en.disableEffect: Rokid meeting screen sharing and screen recording cannot use the display capture session.

zh-CN.description: Android 授予屏幕捕获权限后，Rokid Glass 媒体 SDK 会启动此前台服务，为会议媒体系统保留屏幕捕获会话，以便共享或录制手机画面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Rokid 会议无法使用此屏幕捕获会话来共享或录制手机画面。

en.description: The Rokid Glass firmware SDK uses this service while the app updates supported glasses over USB. It requests USB access, connects to the device, and sends update progress, completion, or errors back to the app.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot connect to the glasses through this SDK to install or monitor a firmware update.

zh-CN.description: 应用通过 USB 为受支持的 Rokid 眼镜更新固件时，Rokid Glass 固件 SDK 会使用此服务。它会申请 USB 访问权限、连接设备，并向应用报告更新进度、完成状态或错误。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用无法通过此 SDK 连接眼镜或安装、监控固件更新。

en.description: The Rokid Kaleido SDK exposes this service in its AR process for apps that request a separate glasses window. It manages the extra display where an app appears and routes input to that display.
en.disableEffect: Apps using Rokid Kaleido lose their separate glasses windows and the input controls directed to them.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求在眼镜上显示独立窗口时，Rokid Kaleido SDK 会在其 AR 进程中提供此服务。它管理显示应用画面的额外屏幕，并将操作输入转发到该屏幕。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，使用 Rokid Kaleido 的应用无法显示独立眼镜窗口，也无法使用发往该窗口的操作输入。

en.description: If a Rokid Kaleido integration opens this activity, it shows a black screen on the extra glasses display while the related app is paused and closes when that app resumes.
en.disableEffect: The generic black pause screen is unavailable, while Kaleido’s landscape and portrait pause screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: 如果 Rokid Kaleido 集成直接打开此活动，它会在关联应用暂停时于眼镜的额外显示画面上显示黑屏，并在应用恢复后关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，通用黑屏暂停画面不可用；Kaleido 的横屏和竖屏暂停画面仍可使用。

en.description: The Rokid Kaleido SDK opens this landscape black screen on the extra glasses display while a shown app is paused; it closes when that app resumes.
en.disableEffect: Kaleido cannot cover a paused landscape app window with its black screen during display switching.

zh-CN.description: 显示的应用暂停时，Rokid Kaleido SDK 会在眼镜的额外屏幕上打开此横屏黑画面；应用恢复后，黑画面会关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Kaleido 无法在切换显示内容时用黑屏遮住已暂停的横屏应用窗口。

en.description: The Rokid Kaleido SDK opens this portrait black screen on the extra glasses display while a shown app is paused; it closes when that app resumes.
en.disableEffect: Kaleido cannot cover a paused portrait app window with its black screen during display switching.

zh-CN.description: 显示的应用暂停时，Rokid Kaleido SDK 会在眼镜的额外屏幕上打开此竖屏黑画面；应用恢复后，黑画面会关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Kaleido 无法在切换显示内容时用黑屏遮住已暂停的竖屏应用窗口。

en.description: The Rokid Kaleido SDK opens this activity to launch an app on a separate glasses display and keep that app window in step with the display’s pause and resume state.
en.disableEffect: Apps using Rokid Kaleido cannot open or manage their screens on the extra glasses display.

zh-CN.description: Rokid Kaleido SDK 会通过此活动在独立眼镜屏幕上打开应用，并根据该屏幕上的暂停和恢复状态管理应用窗口。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，使用 Rokid Kaleido 的应用无法在额外的眼镜屏幕上打开或管理应用画面。

en.description: When a Rokid glasses meeting invitation arrives, this screen shows the incoming call and lets the user answer or decline.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to answer or decline incoming glasses meetings through this screen.

zh-CN.description: Rokid 眼镜会议收到邀请时，此页面显示来电，并允许用户接听或拒绝。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此页面接听或拒绝眼镜会议来电。

en.description: This background service listens for incoming Rokid glasses meeting invitations and starts the incoming-call flow.
en.disableEffect: Incoming glasses meetings may not be monitored or presented to the user.

zh-CN.description: 此后台服务监听 Rokid 眼镜会议邀请并启动来电流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Rokid 眼镜会议来电可能无法被监听或呈现给用户。

en.description: When users start a glasses collaboration call, this screen contacts the selected participants and shows the outgoing-call state.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to place Rokid glasses collaboration calls through this screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户发起眼镜协作通话时，此页面呼叫所选参与者并显示呼叫状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此页面发起 Rokid 眼镜协作通话。

en.description: During a glasses meeting, this screen displays the conversation and lets participants use meeting chat.
en.disableEffect: Participants will not be able to open the glasses meeting chat.

zh-CN.description: 眼镜会议期间，此页面显示对话并提供会议聊天功能。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 参与者将无法打开眼镜会议聊天。

en.description: When users open shared documents during a glasses meeting, this screen lists available files and opens a selected document.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to browse or select meeting documents here.

zh-CN.description: 用户在眼镜会议中打开共享文档时，此页面列出可用文件并打开所选文档。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在此浏览或选择会议文档。

en.description: When a document is selected for a glasses meeting, this screen displays it for the participants and supports session navigation controls.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to display or navigate shared documents in the meeting.

zh-CN.description: 为眼镜会议选择文档后，此页面向参与者显示文档，并支持会话中的翻页控制。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在会议中显示或翻阅共享文档。

en.description: When users open the glasses meeting’s back menu, this screen handles device commands for leaving the session and returning to the home screen.
en.disableEffect: The meeting’s back-menu and device-command exit flow will not be available.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开眼镜会议的返回菜单时，此页面处理离开会话并返回主屏幕的设备指令。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 会议返回菜单及设备指令退出流程将无法使用。

en.description: During a glasses meeting, this menu provides access to screen sharing, chat, documents, and meeting audio and video controls.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to open the glasses meeting menu or its sharing controls.

zh-CN.description: 眼镜会议期间，此菜单提供屏幕共享、聊天、文档以及会议音视频控制入口。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开眼镜会议菜单或其中的共享控制项。

en.description: When a participant’s camera is opened in a glasses meeting, this screen shows the live view and provides remote camera, pointing, annotation, and document controls.
en.disableEffect: The participant’s detailed camera session and its collaboration controls will not open.

zh-CN.description: 在眼镜会议中打开参与者摄像头时，此页面显示实时画面，并提供远程摄像头、指点、标注和文档控制。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 无法打开该参与者的摄像详情会话或使用其中的协作控制。

en.description: This is the main glasses collaboration screen, showing the live meeting and controls for participants, chat, documents, screen sharing, and spatial collaboration.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to open or operate the main glasses meeting screen.

zh-CN.description: 这是眼镜远程协作的主页面，显示实时会议，并提供参与者、聊天、文档、屏幕共享和空间协作控制。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开或操作眼镜会议主页面。

en.description: During an augmented-reality glasses session, this screen displays the camera scene and shared spatial marks for remote collaboration.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to open the augmented-reality glasses collaboration view.

zh-CN.description: 增强现实眼镜协作期间，此页面显示摄像头场景和用于远程协作的共享空间标记。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开增强现实眼镜协作页面。

en.description: Rokid Remote Cooperation opens this incoming-call screen when another participant calls. It lets the user accept with audio or video, or reject the call, and opens the meeting after a successful join.
en.disableEffect: Incoming calls have no screen for accepting or rejecting them, so users cannot join calls from the app.

zh-CN.description: 有其他参与者呼叫时，Rokid Remote Cooperation 会打开此来电页面。用户可以通过语音或视频接听，也可以拒绝；接通后会进入会议。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，来电没有可供接听或拒绝的页面，用户无法从应用加入通话。

en.description: Rokid Remote Cooperation opens this page when a participant's camera is selected in a meeting. It shows that participant's video and provides camera controls, shared annotations, and document upload for the call.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open a participant's camera detail page or use its camera, annotation, and document-sharing controls.

zh-CN.description: 在会议中选择某位参与者的摄像头画面时，Rokid Remote Cooperation 会打开此页面。页面显示对方的视频，并提供摄像头控制、共享标注和文档上传功能。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法打开参与者的摄像头详情页，也无法使用其中的摄像头、标注和文档共享功能。

en.description: Rokid Remote Cooperation opens this screen after a user joins a meeting. It shows the participants and meeting status, provides call controls, and opens screen sharing, whiteboard, or camera views.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot enter or stay in the meeting screen, so Rokid Remote Cooperation calls and meetings are unusable.

zh-CN.description: 用户加入会议后，Rokid Remote Cooperation 会打开此页面。页面显示参与者和会议状态，提供通话控制，并可进入屏幕共享、白板或摄像头页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法进入或留在会议页面，因此无法使用 Rokid Remote Cooperation 的通话和会议功能。

en.description: Rokid Remote Cooperation opens this pre-meeting screen when the user creates or joins a meeting. It lets the user check the camera, microphone, and speaker before starting or joining the call.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot complete the create-or-join setup, so they may be unable to start or join a meeting.

zh-CN.description: 用户创建或加入会议时，Rokid Remote Cooperation 会打开此会前页面。用户可以先检查摄像头、麦克风和扬声器，再开始或加入通话。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法完成会前设置，可能因此无法发起或加入会议。

en.description: Rokid Remote Cooperation opens this camera-based augmented-reality view when spatial marking starts during a meeting. Participants can place, undo, or clear marks in the shared scene.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open the shared augmented-reality scene or place spatial marks during a meeting.

zh-CN.description: 会议中开始空间标注时，Rokid Remote Cooperation 会打开此摄像头增强现实页面。参与者可以在共享场景中添加、撤销或清除标记。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法打开共享增强现实场景，也无法在会议中添加空间标记。

en.description: After login, Rokid Remote Cooperation opens this directory with separate group and contact tabs. It also provides access to the user's account page and saved meeting entry points.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot browse the Remote Cooperation groups and contacts or reach its account and meeting entry points.

zh-CN.description: 登录后，Rokid Remote Cooperation 会打开此通讯录页面，分别显示群组和联系人。页面还提供个人账户入口和已保存会议的入口。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法浏览远程协作的群组和联系人，也无法从此页面进入账户和会议功能。

en.description: Rokid Remote Cooperation opens this profile when a user selects someone from a contact or group list. It shows the person's account and availability details and can start a meeting with an available contact.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot view contact details or start a meeting from a person's profile.

zh-CN.description: 用户从联系人或群组列表中选择成员时，Rokid Remote Cooperation 会打开此资料页。页面显示成员的账户和在线状态，并可与在线联系人发起会议。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法查看联系人资料，也无法从成员资料页发起会议。

en.description: Rokid Remote Cooperation opens this shared whiteboard during a meeting. Participants can draw, clear marks, and view a shared snapshot while their whiteboard changes are sent to the meeting.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot start or view the shared whiteboard and its meeting annotations.

zh-CN.description: 会议中使用共享白板时，Rokid Remote Cooperation 会打开此页面。参与者可以绘画、清除标记和查看共享截图，白板内容会同步到会议中。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法启动或查看共享白板及会议中的标注。

en.description: Rokid Remote Cooperation opens this page from a group entry to show the group's members. Users can open a member's details or start a meeting with available group members.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot view the group roster or start a meeting from the group page.

zh-CN.description: 用户进入某个群组时，Rokid Remote Cooperation 会打开此页面并显示群成员。用户可以查看成员资料，也可以与在线群成员发起会议。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法查看群成员列表，也无法从群组页面发起会议。

en.description: Rokid Remote Cooperation opens this picker from an active meeting so the user can select contacts who are not already in the meeting and invite them to join.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot select and invite additional contacts to an ongoing meeting.

zh-CN.description: 正在开会时，Rokid Remote Cooperation 会打开此选择页面，让用户挑选尚未加入会议的联系人并邀请他们加入。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法选择其他联系人并邀请他们加入当前会议。

en.description: Rokid Remote Cooperation opens this sign-in screen to collect the company, account, and password details needed to authenticate the user. On successful login it opens the contacts page.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot sign in to Remote Cooperation, so its contacts, calls, and meetings cannot be used.

zh-CN.description: Rokid Remote Cooperation 会打开此登录页面，收集公司、账户和密码信息以验证用户身份。登录成功后会进入通讯录页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法登录远程协作，因此无法使用其中的联系人、通话和会议功能。

en.description: Rokid Remote Cooperation opens this screen from the account menu when the user chooses to change their password. It checks the entered passwords and submits the change to the account service.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot change their Remote Cooperation password from the app.

zh-CN.description: 用户从账户菜单选择修改密码时，Rokid Remote Cooperation 会打开此页面。页面检查输入的密码并向账户服务提交修改。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法在应用中修改远程协作账户的密码。

en.description: Rokid Remote Cooperation opens this account center from its contact page. It shows company and account details and provides password, logout, binding-QR, and meeting-resolution settings.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot reach the Remote Cooperation account details, password and logout controls, binding QR code, or resolution settings.

zh-CN.description: Rokid Remote Cooperation 会从通讯录页面打开此账户中心。页面显示公司和账户资料，并提供密码、退出登录、绑定二维码和会议分辨率设置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法查看远程协作账户资料，也无法使用密码、退出登录、绑定二维码或分辨率设置。

en.description: Rokid Remote Cooperation opens this reminder when the company account has expired or is within 14 days of expiry. It shows the expiry date and links to the account center.
en.disableEffect: Users no longer see this expiry reminder or its shortcut to the account center.

zh-CN.description: 公司账户已过期或将在 14 天内到期时，Rokid Remote Cooperation 会打开此提醒页面。页面显示到期日期，并提供进入账户中心的入口。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将看不到此到期提醒，也无法通过它进入账户中心。

en.description: Rokid Remote Cooperation opens this page when a meeting participant starts sharing a screen. It shows the shared screen and manages starting, stopping, or switching the share.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot start or view screen sharing during a Remote Cooperation meeting.

zh-CN.description: 会议参与者开始共享屏幕时，Rokid Remote Cooperation 会打开此页面。页面显示共享屏幕，并处理开始、停止或切换共享。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法在远程协作会议中发起或查看屏幕共享。

en.description: Rokid Remote Cooperation starts this service while a meeting is active to listen for live meeting messages. It syncs the current whiteboard state for a new participant and rejects another incoming call while the user is already in a meeting.
en.disableEffect: Late participants may not receive the current whiteboard state, and incoming meeting requests may not be handled correctly.

zh-CN.description: 会议进行期间，Rokid Remote Cooperation 会运行此服务来接收实时会议消息。新参与者加入时，它会同步当前白板内容；用户已在会议中时，它会拒绝另一通来电。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 后加入的参与者可能无法收到当前白板内容，新的会议请求也可能无法正确处理。

en.description: Rokid Remote Cooperation starts this foreground service to keep its account presence current during background use. It sends periodic heartbeat updates and displays an ongoing Remote Cooperation notification.
en.disableEffect: Remote Cooperation stops sending these background heartbeat updates and no longer shows its ongoing status notification.

zh-CN.description: Rokid Remote Cooperation 会在后台运行时启动此前台服务，以维持账户在线状态。服务会定期发送心跳更新，并显示持续的远程协作通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 远程协作将停止发送这些后台心跳更新，也不再显示持续运行通知。

en.description: Rokid Remote Cooperation starts this service for a signed-in account to listen for call and logout messages. It opens the incoming-call screen for a new call and returns to sign-in after a logout.
en.disableEffect: Incoming calls and logout messages can no longer open their required screens, disrupting the Remote Cooperation call and account flows.

zh-CN.description: 远程协作账户登录后，Rokid Remote Cooperation 会启动此服务来接收来电和退出登录消息。收到新来电时会打开来电页面，退出登录后会返回登录页。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 来电和退出登录消息无法再打开相应页面，远程协作的通话和账户流程会受到影响。

en.description: Rokid Remote Cooperation starts this background keep-alive service to schedule a short job and show an ongoing meeting notification.
en.disableEffect: Remote Cooperation loses this background keep-alive job and its ongoing meeting notification.

zh-CN.description: Rokid Remote Cooperation 会启动此后台保活服务，安排一项短任务并显示持续的会议通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 远程协作将失去此后台保活任务和持续显示的会议通知。

en.description: When the user shares a meeting invitation QR code, Rokid Remote Cooperation opens this page and Android's share chooser to send the QR image to another app.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot send the meeting QR image to another app from this sharing flow.

zh-CN.description: 用户分享会议邀请二维码时，Rokid Remote Cooperation 会打开此页面并调用 Android 分享面板，将二维码图片发送到其他应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法通过此分享流程将会议二维码图片发送到其他应用。

en.description: Rokid Remote Cooperation opens this QR scanner when the app asks the user to scan a code. It reads a code from the camera or a selected album image and returns the decoded text to the app.
en.disableEffect: Workflows that require scanning a QR code cannot be completed in the app.

zh-CN.description: 应用要求用户扫描二维码时，Rokid Remote Cooperation 会打开此扫码页面。它可以读取摄像头画面或相册图片中的二维码，并将结果返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用中需要扫描二维码的流程将无法完成。

en.description: Android starts the Rokid Glass UI provider with the app process so it can configure screen-size scaling for the app's layouts. Disabling it can leave screens that rely on this setup at the wrong size.
en.disableEffect: Glass UI layouts that rely on this startup scaling may no longer fit the display correctly.

zh-CN.description: 应用进程启动时，Android 会运行 Rokid Glass UI 的此初始化组件，为应用界面配置屏幕尺寸适配。禁用后，依赖该设置的页面可能无法正确适配屏幕。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此启动适配的 Glass UI 页面可能无法正确匹配屏幕尺寸。

en.description: Rokid Xpert Meeting creates this provider automatically during app startup to register its meeting engine, meeting, device, and contact services.
en.disableEffect: The meeting SDK cannot register these services, so its meeting, device, and contact functions cannot be initialized.

zh-CN.description: Rokid Xpert Meeting 会在应用启动时自动创建此内容提供器，用来注册会议引擎、会议、设备和联系人服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，会议 SDK 无法注册这些服务，会议、设备和联系人功能也无法初始化。

en.description: Rokid WebView opens this screen when the app requests a web page. It reads the page address and title, displays the page, and can handle payment requests from the page.
en.disableEffect: The app’s Rokid web pages will not open, and renewal payments requested from those pages may fail.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求打开网页时，Rokid WebView 会显示此页面。它读取网页地址和标题、显示网页，并可处理网页发起的付款请求。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用中的 Rokid 网页将无法打开，网页发起的续费付款也可能失败。

en.description: Rokid Media opens this player when the app requests a video preview. It reads the video address and sharing options, then plays the video with playback controls.
en.disableEffect: Video previews that use this player will not open or play, and its sharing option will be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求视频预览时，Rokid Media 会打开此播放器。它读取视频地址和分享设置，播放视频并提供播放控制。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此播放器的视频预览将无法打开或播放，其中的分享功能也无法使用。

en.description: Older Rokid Media versions open this screen for a video playback request. It can play a local file or an online video and can provide sharing when requested.
en.disableEffect: Older apps that still use this player will not be able to open its video playback screen.

zh-CN.description: 旧版 Rokid Media 收到视频播放请求时会打开此页面。它可播放本地文件或在线视频，并可按请求提供分享功能。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 仍使用此播放器的旧版应用将无法打开视频播放页面。

en.description: Rokid Share opens this screen when the app starts a share request or a share link is opened. It presents sharing options for images, videos, and web pages.
en.disableEffect: The app’s Rokid sharing screen will not open, so users may be unable to share these items through its share flow.

zh-CN.description: 应用发起分享或打开分享链接时，Rokid Share 会显示此页面。页面提供图片、视频和网页的分享选项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Rokid 分享页面将无法打开，用户可能无法通过该分享流程分享这些内容。

en.description: Rokid Share uses this provider to expose local images and videos as shareable files, so the selected content can be read during a share.
en.disableEffect: Sharing local images or videos through Rokid Share may fail when the receiving app needs to read the file.

zh-CN.description: Rokid Share 通过此文件提供组件共享本地图片和视频，让接收内容的一方能够在分享时读取文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 接收应用需要读取本地文件时，通过 Rokid Share 分享图片或视频可能失败。

en.description: Rokid File Reader opens this page for an audio file and starts playback when the page resumes. It also offers voice controls to pause and resume playback.
en.disableEffect: Audio files opened through Rokid File Reader can no longer be played in this page.

zh-CN.description: Rokid File Reader 打开音频文件时会进入此页面，并在页面显示后开始播放。它还提供暂停和继续播放的语音控制。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过 Rokid File Reader 打开的音频文件将无法在此页面播放。

en.description: Rokid File Reader opens a PDF in this page and displays its pages. Users can move between pages, zoom, lock or reset the view, and go to a chosen page.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot view or navigate PDF files through Rokid File Reader.

zh-CN.description: Rokid File Reader 会在此页面打开并显示 PDF 文档。用户可以翻页、缩放、锁定或重置视图，也可以跳转到指定页。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法通过 Rokid File Reader 查看或翻阅 PDF 文件。

en.description: Rokid File Reader opens an image file in this page. Users can zoom, lock, and reset the image view.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot view image files through Rokid File Reader.

zh-CN.description: Rokid File Reader 会在此页面打开图片文件。用户可以缩放、锁定或重置图片视图。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法通过 Rokid File Reader 查看图片文件。

en.description: Rokid File Reader opens a video file in this page and starts playback. Voice controls can pause, resume, fast-forward, or rewind the video.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot play video files through Rokid File Reader.

zh-CN.description: Rokid File Reader 会在此页面打开并播放视频文件。语音控制可以暂停、继续、快进或快退视频。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法通过 Rokid File Reader 播放视频文件。

en.description: When a Rokid RoKit diagnostic or app-supplied custom page is opened full-screen, this Activity displays that page; a UI-stall alert also opens its monitor screen.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it blocks full-screen Rokid RoKit pages and any app feature launched through RoKit custom pages, and tapping a stall alert will not open its report.

zh-CN.description: 全屏打开 Rokid RoKit 诊断页面或应用提供的自定义页面时，此 Activity 会显示相应页面；点击卡顿提醒也会打开卡顿监控界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Rokid RoKit 的全屏页面及通过其自定义页面功能启动的应用页面将无法打开，点击卡顿提醒也无法查看报告。

en.description: The Rokid Tatooine Lite SDK opens an AR experience’s web page in a WebView. The page can request camera or microphone access.
en.disableEffect: AR experiences that use a web page, including web-based camera or microphone features, will not open.

zh-CN.description: Rokid Tatooine Lite SDK 会在 WebView 中打开 AR 体验的网页。网页可能会请求相机或麦克风权限。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖网页的 AR 体验（包括网页中的相机或麦克风功能）将无法打开。

en.description: The Rokid Tatooine Lite SDK shows a loading screen while an AR experience initializes, and may show it when initialization fails.
en.disableEffect: An AR experience that requests this screen may fail to launch or lose its loading and error screen.

zh-CN.description: Rokid Tatooine Lite SDK 会在 AR 体验初始化时显示加载界面，初始化失败时也可能显示该界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要此界面的 AR 体验可能无法启动，或无法显示加载及错误提示。

en.description: The Rokid Tatooine Lite SDK opens a web-based AR page in its separate helper process. The page can request camera or microphone access.
en.disableEffect: Web-based AR experiences assigned to this helper process will not open.

zh-CN.description: Rokid Tatooine Lite SDK 会在独立的辅助进程中打开网页 AR 页面。网页可能会请求相机或麦克风权限。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 分配到此辅助进程的网页 AR 体验将无法打开。

en.description: The Rokid Tatooine Lite SDK runs a camera-based AR scene in its separate helper process. The scene can provide recording and sharing controls.
en.disableEffect: AR scenes assigned to this helper process will not run, including their recording and sharing controls.

zh-CN.description: Rokid Tatooine Lite SDK 会在独立的辅助进程中运行基于相机的 AR 场景。场景可提供录制和分享控件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 分配到此辅助进程的 AR 场景将无法运行，录制和分享控件也无法使用。

en.description: The Rokid Tatooine Lite SDK opens the web content attached to an AR scene in its separate helper process.
en.disableEffect: AR scenes that use this web content will not open.

zh-CN.description: Rokid Tatooine Lite SDK 会在独立的辅助进程中打开 AR 场景关联的网页内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此网页内容的 AR 场景将无法打开。

en.description: The Rokid Tatooine Lite SDK runs a web-based AR page in its separate helper process; the page can use the camera for AR.
en.disableEffect: Web-based AR experiences assigned to this helper process will not work.

zh-CN.description: Rokid Tatooine Lite SDK 会在独立的辅助进程中运行网页 AR 页面；页面可使用相机实现 AR。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 分配到此辅助进程的网页 AR 体验将无法使用。

en.description: The Rokid Tatooine Lite SDK displays a camera-based AR scene selected by the app. The scene can include recording, sharing, and linked web content.
en.disableEffect: The app’s Rokid AR scenes and their recording, sharing, or linked web features will not work.

zh-CN.description: Rokid Tatooine Lite SDK 会显示应用选定的相机 AR 场景。场景可包含录制、分享和关联网页内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用中的 Rokid AR 场景及其录制、分享或关联网页功能将无法使用。

en.description: The Rokid Tatooine Lite SDK displays web content linked to an AR scene. The page runs in a WebView and can request camera or microphone access.
en.disableEffect: AR scenes that rely on this web page will not work.

zh-CN.description: Rokid Tatooine Lite SDK 会显示与 AR 场景关联的网页。网页在 WebView 中运行，并可能请求相机或麦克风权限。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此网页的 AR 场景将无法使用。

en.description: The Rokid Tatooine Lite SDK opens web-based AR content in a WebView and can grant the page camera or microphone access.
en.disableEffect: The app’s web-based AR content will not open.

zh-CN.description: Rokid Tatooine Lite SDK 会在 WebView 中打开网页 AR 内容，并可向网页授予相机或麦克风权限。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用中的网页 AR 内容将无法打开。

en.description: The Rokid Tatooine Lite SDK starts this service when its logging bridge is used, forwarding SDK log messages to the app’s configured logger.
en.disableEffect: The SDK’s bridged log messages will no longer reach the app’s logging system; AR scenes and pages can still run.

zh-CN.description: Rokid Tatooine Lite SDK 使用日志桥接时会启动此服务，将 SDK 日志转发到应用配置的日志记录器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: SDK 日志将不再转发到应用的日志系统；AR 场景和网页仍可运行。

en.description: The Rokid Tatooine Lite SDK uses this provider to create secure file links when an AR sharing flow sends an image or video to another app.
en.disableEffect: Sharing images or videos from Rokid AR experiences may fail when the app cannot create the required file link.

zh-CN.description: Rokid Tatooine Lite SDK 会在 AR 分享流程向其他应用发送图片或视频时，通过此 Provider 创建安全的文件链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用无法创建所需文件链接时，分享 Rokid AR 体验中的图片或视频可能会失败。

en.description: The Rokid Glass 3 QR scanner opens the camera to scan a code or decodes a code from an image supplied by the app.
en.disableEffect: The app’s QR-code scanning and image-based code reading will not work.

zh-CN.description: Rokid Glass 3 二维码扫描器会打开相机扫描二维码，也可读取应用提供的图片中的二维码。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用的二维码扫描和图片识别功能将无法使用。

en.description: The Rokid Phone SDK bridge shows glasses-pairing guidance when a Bluetooth search does not find a device.
en.disableEffect: The app will lose its guidance screen for pairing glasses when a search finds nothing.

zh-CN.description: Rokid Phone SDK bridge 会在蓝牙搜索未找到设备时显示眼镜配对指引。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 搜索无结果时，应用将无法显示眼镜配对指引。

en.description: The Rokid Phone SDK bridge searches for nearby glasses over Bluetooth and lets the user select one before connection setup continues.
en.disableEffect: Finding and selecting glasses for Bluetooth connection will not work.

zh-CN.description: Rokid Phone SDK bridge 会通过蓝牙搜索附近的眼镜，并允许用户选择设备以继续连接设置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 将无法通过蓝牙查找并选择要连接的眼镜。

en.description: The Rokid Phone SDK bridge checks connected glasses for a system update and displays the download and installation progress.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to check for or install glasses system updates through the app.

zh-CN.description: Rokid Phone SDK bridge 会检查已连接眼镜的系统更新，并显示下载和安装进度。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过应用检查或安装眼镜系统更新。

en.description: The Rokid Phone SDK bridge searches for nearby glasses over Wi-Fi Direct and handles the connection setup.
en.disableEffect: Wi-Fi Direct discovery and connection setup for glasses will not work.

zh-CN.description: Rokid Phone SDK bridge 会通过 Wi-Fi Direct 搜索附近的眼镜并处理连接设置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 眼镜的 Wi-Fi Direct 搜索和连接设置将无法使用。

en.description: The Rokid Phone SDK bridge displays Wi-Fi Direct pairing progress, including connection status and a countdown.
en.disableEffect: The app will lose this glasses-pairing step, so Wi-Fi Direct connection setup may not complete.

zh-CN.description: Rokid Phone SDK bridge 会显示 Wi-Fi Direct 配对进度，包括连接状态和倒计时。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法使用此眼镜配对步骤，Wi-Fi Direct 连接设置可能无法完成。

en.description: The Rokid Phone SDK server initializes shared phone-to-glasses services when the app starts, including Bluetooth, Wi-Fi Direct, account, media, messaging, and update services.
en.disableEffect: Glasses connections and other Rokid phone services may fail to initialize or become unavailable.

zh-CN.description: Rokid Phone SDK server 会在应用启动时初始化手机与眼镜之间的共享服务，包括蓝牙、Wi-Fi Direct、账户、媒体、消息和更新服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 眼镜连接及其他 Rokid 手机服务可能无法初始化或使用。

en.description: The Rokid Phone SDK server can show a floating assistant bubble with idle, inspection, and upload status when the service is started.
en.disableEffect: The optional floating status bubble and its tap controls will no longer appear.

zh-CN.description: Rokid Phone SDK server 可在服务启动时显示悬浮助手气泡，并展示空闲、检查和上传状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 可选的悬浮状态气泡及其点击控件将不再显示。

en.description: Rokid Ecology's UGC feature opens a community page for a selected agent. It loads that agent's posts, supports refreshing and more results, and lets users like or unlike posts.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot view or react to posts on this agent's community page.

zh-CN.description: Rokid Ecology 的 UGC 功能会为选定的智能体打开社区页面。页面加载该智能体的帖子，支持刷新和加载更多，也允许用户点赞或取消点赞。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法查看该智能体社区页面中的帖子或进行互动。

en.description: Rokid Ecology's UGC feature opens a configured official page when navigation supplies its page identifier. The page loads its official banners, menu sections, and post lists.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open the configured official content page.

zh-CN.description: 导航传入官方页面标识时，Rokid Ecology 的 UGC 功能会打开相应的配置页面。页面加载官方横幅、菜单分区和帖子列表。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法打开配置的官方内容页面。

en.description: Rokid Ecology's UGC feature opens this post composer when the user starts a community post. It accepts selected photos or a video, uploads the media, and publishes the post.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot compose or publish photo and video posts in the community.

zh-CN.description: 用户开始发布社区内容时，Rokid Ecology 的 UGC 功能会打开此编辑页面。页面接收所选照片或视频，上传媒体并发布帖子。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法在社区中编辑或发布照片和视频帖子。

en.description: While editing a video post, Rokid Ecology's UGC feature opens this page with the video and its duration. The user selects a video frame as the cover, which is returned to the post composer.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot choose a custom cover frame for a video post.

zh-CN.description: 编辑视频帖子时，Rokid Ecology 的 UGC 功能会传入视频和时长并打开此页面。用户可选择一帧作为封面，选定画面随后返回帖子编辑页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法为视频帖子选择自定义封面画面。

en.description: The Rokid UXR screen-projection plugin starts projection content and a local web server when a projection session begins, and serves requests from the projection controller.
en.disableEffect: Screen projection and the local content service it uses will stop working.

zh-CN.description: Rokid UXR 投屏插件会在投屏会话开始时启动投屏内容和本地 Web 服务，并响应投屏控制器的请求。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 屏幕投射及其使用的本地内容服务将无法运行。

en.description: The Rokid UXR plugin keeps its Unity experience running in the foreground with an ongoing notification, refreshing that notification periodically.
en.disableEffect: The persistent running notification and background keep-alive will stop, so the Unity experience may not stay active in the background.

zh-CN.description: Rokid UXR 插件会通过持续显示的通知让 Unity 体验保持前台运行，并定期刷新通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 持续运行通知和后台保活将停止，Unity 体验可能无法在后台保持活动。

en.description: When a user starts screen sharing, this screen asks Android for permission to capture the screen and returns the user’s choice to the meeting.
en.disableEffect: Screen sharing cannot start without the Android screen-capture permission flow.

zh-CN.description: 用户开始屏幕共享时，此页面请求 Android 允许捕获屏幕，并将用户的选择返回会议。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 缺少 Android 屏幕捕获授权流程时，屏幕共享无法启动。

en.description: This foreground service runs while the meeting shares the screen so Android can keep the screen-capture session active.
en.disableEffect: The meeting cannot start or maintain its screen-capture session.

zh-CN.description: 会议共享屏幕期间，此前台服务维持屏幕捕获会话运行。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 会议将无法启动或维持屏幕捕获会话。

en.description: RongCloud Global IM UIKit opens this screen for a selected one-to-one or group conversation. It shows the conversation's messages and chat controls.
en.disableEffect: The app will not be able to open conversations through RongCloud Global IM UIKit.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开单聊或群聊时，融云 Global IM UIKit 会显示该会话的消息和聊天界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法通过融云 Global IM UIKit 打开会话。

en.description: RongCloud Global IM UIKit opens this screen to show the user's conversation list.
en.disableEffect: The conversation list provided by RongCloud Global IM UIKit will not open.

zh-CN.description: 融云 Global IM UIKit 会通过此界面显示用户的会话列表。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 融云 Global IM UIKit 提供的会话列表将无法打开。

en.description: RongCloud Global IM UIKit opens this screen when a user chooses the camera from a chat. It captures a photo or video and returns the media to attach to the conversation.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to capture and attach photos or videos from the chat camera.

zh-CN.description: 用户在聊天中选择拍摄时，融云 Global IM UIKit 会打开此界面拍照或录制视频，并将媒体返回会话用于发送。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法从聊天相机拍摄并发送照片或视频。

en.description: RongCloud Global IM UIKit starts this provider with the app so its chat screens can access shared app resources.
en.disableEffect: UIKit screens may fail when they need shared app resources, including during chat setup.

zh-CN.description: 融云 Global IM UIKit 会在应用启动时通过此提供器设置共享应用资源访问，供聊天界面使用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: UIKit 界面需要共享应用资源时可能无法正常初始化，包括聊天界面。

en.description: When a user previews selected media in RongCloud Global IM UIKit's picker, this screen shows photos or videos, allows paging between them, and returns the selection for sending.
en.disableEffect: Users will lose the media preview and confirmation step in the local picker.

zh-CN.description: 用户在融云 Global IM UIKit 的媒体选择器中预览内容时，此界面可浏览照片或视频，并将确认的媒体返回用于发送。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在本地媒体选择器中预览和确认要发送的内容。

en.description: When a user adds local media to a chat, this RongCloud Global IM UIKit screen requests media access, lists photos and videos, and returns the selected items.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to browse and choose local photos or videos to send from this picker.

zh-CN.description: 用户向聊天添加本地媒体时，融云 Global IM UIKit 会请求媒体权限、列出照片和视频，并返回所选内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此选择器浏览并挑选本地照片或视频发送。

en.description: RongCloud Global IM UIKit opens this screen to play a local video selected from the media picker. Playback starts when the screen opens and includes standard playback controls.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to preview local videos in the media picker.

zh-CN.description: 融云 Global IM UIKit 会通过此界面播放媒体选择器中的本地视频，打开后自动开始播放，并提供常规播放控制。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在媒体选择器中预览本地视频。

en.description: When a user opens a file message in RongCloud Global IM UIKit, this screen downloads the file if needed and lets the user preview or open it.
en.disableEffect: Users will lose the in-app download and preview flow for chat file attachments.

zh-CN.description: 用户在融云 Global IM UIKit 中打开文件消息时，此界面会在需要时下载文件，并供用户预览或打开。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法使用聊天附件的应用内下载和预览流程。

en.description: When a user opens a GIF message in RongCloud Global IM UIKit, this screen downloads the image if needed and displays it animated.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to open and view animated GIF messages in this screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开融云 Global IM UIKit 中的 GIF 消息时，此界面会在需要时下载并播放动图。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此界面打开和查看 GIF 动图消息。

en.description: When a user opens an image message in RongCloud Global IM UIKit, this screen loads the full image from local or remote storage for viewing and saving.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to open full-size image messages in the UIKit viewer.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开融云 Global IM UIKit 中的图片消息时，此界面会从本地或远程加载大图，供用户查看和保存。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在 UIKit 查看器中打开大尺寸图片消息。

en.description: When a user opens a short video message in RongCloud Global IM UIKit, this screen starts the clip in the message viewer.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to play short video messages in the UIKit viewer.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开融云 Global IM UIKit 中的短视频消息时，此界面会在消息查看器中播放视频。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在 UIKit 查看器中播放短视频消息。

en.description: When a user opens a combined chat message in RongCloud Global IM UIKit, this screen displays its content in a web view and can open attached media such as short videos.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to open the older combined-message viewer or its attached media.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开融云 Global IM UIKit 中的合并消息时，此界面会在网页视图中显示内容，并可打开短视频等附件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开旧版合并消息查看器及其中的媒体附件。

en.description: When a user taps a newer combined-message item in RongCloud Global IM UIKit, this screen displays the included conversation content.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to open newer combined-message details.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击融云 Global IM UIKit 中的新格式合并消息时，此界面会显示其中包含的会话内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开新格式合并消息的详情。

en.description: The Rook SDK opens Health Connect’s permission screen so the app can request access to health data.
en.disableEffect: The app will not be able to request the Health Connect access needed for its Rook health-data features.

zh-CN.description: Rook SDK 会打开 Health Connect 权限页面，让应用申请健康数据访问权限。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法申请 Rook 健康数据功能所需的 Health Connect 访问权限。

en.description: The Rook SDK requests permission to read selected health data from Health Connect.
en.disableEffect: Rook health-data reading will not be able to obtain the required permissions.

zh-CN.description: Rook SDK 会请求读取 Health Connect 中所选健康数据的权限。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Rook 健康数据读取功能将无法取得所需权限。

en.description: The Rook SDK requests permission to write selected health data to Health Connect.
en.disableEffect: Rook will not be able to obtain permission to write the selected health data.

zh-CN.description: Rook SDK 会请求向 Health Connect 写入所选健康数据的权限。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Rook 将无法取得写入所选健康数据的权限。

en.description: The Rook SDK receives device-boot and app-replacement broadcasts and restarts background health syncing or step counting when the app has enabled them.
en.disableEffect: Enabled Rook background health syncing and step counting may not resume after a device restart or app replacement.

zh-CN.description: Rook SDK 会接收设备启动和应用替换广播，并在应用已启用相关功能时恢复后台健康数据同步或步数统计。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 设备重启或应用替换后，已启用的 Rook 后台健康数据同步和步数统计可能无法恢复。

en.description: The Rook SDK uses a scheduled alarm to restart its step-counter service and schedule the next check about 12 hours later.
en.disableEffect: Rook’s scheduled step counting may stop or become less reliable.

zh-CN.description: Rook SDK 会通过定时闹钟重启步数统计服务，并安排约 12 小时后的下一次检查。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Rook 的定时步数统计可能停止或变得不可靠。

en.description: The Rook SDK watchdog alarm restarts background health syncing or step counting when those features are enabled.
en.disableEffect: Enabled Rook background syncing or step counting may not recover when its scheduled check runs.

zh-CN.description: Rook SDK 看门狗闹钟会在相关功能已启用时恢复后台健康数据同步或步数统计。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 定时检查触发时，已启用的 Rook 后台同步或步数统计可能无法恢复。

en.description: The Rook SDK opens Health Connect permissions for health-data access and background reading, then reports the permission result to the app.
en.disableEffect: Rook health-data access and background reading will not be able to obtain or report the required permissions.

zh-CN.description: Rook SDK 会打开 Health Connect 权限页面以申请健康数据访问和后台读取权限，然后将授权结果返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Rook 健康数据访问和后台读取功能将无法取得或报告所需权限。

en.description: The Rook SDK requests Android runtime permissions needed by the app and returns the grant results.
en.disableEffect: The app’s Rook features will not be able to request or receive the required Android permissions.

zh-CN.description: Rook SDK 会申请应用所需的 Android 运行时权限，并返回授权结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用的 Rook 功能将无法申请或接收所需的 Android 权限。

en.description: The Rook SDK runs a foreground step-counting service that reads the device’s step-counter sensor and updates step data.
en.disableEffect: Rook step counts will stop updating through this service.

zh-CN.description: Rook SDK 会运行前台步数统计服务，读取设备的步数计数传感器并更新步数数据。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Rook 步数将无法通过此服务继续更新。

en.description: The Rook SDK runs a foreground service that listens for step-detection events and records step times for later processing.
en.disableEffect: Rook will stop collecting step-detection events and recording their times.

zh-CN.description: Rook SDK 会运行前台服务监听步数检测事件，并记录步数时间供后续处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Rook 将停止收集步数检测事件并记录其时间。

en.description: The Rook SDK displays the available health-data sources and opens a selected source’s authorization page.
en.disableEffect: Users will lose the Rook screen for viewing and connecting health-data sources.

zh-CN.description: Rook SDK 会显示可用的健康数据来源，并打开所选来源的授权页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法使用 Rook 的健康数据来源查看和连接页面。

en.description: Carioca's Hilt test helper provides a blank screen for automated tests that need to launch an Activity with Hilt enabled; it applies an optional test theme when opened.
en.disableEffect: Only tests that use this Hilt test screen stop working; the app's normal features are unaffected.

zh-CN.description: Carioca 的 Hilt 测试辅助库为需要启动 Hilt 界面的自动化测试提供空白页面；页面打开时会应用可选的测试主题。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，依赖此页面的 Hilt 自动化测试无法启动；应用的日常功能不受影响。

en.description: When the app process starts, Multiplatform Settings prepares the app context its automatic key-value storage needs to read and save Android preferences.
en.disableEffect: Without this setup, Multiplatform Settings calls that create preferences without an app context fail, so app settings backed by those calls may stop working.

zh-CN.description: 应用进程启动时，Multiplatform Settings 会准备自动键值存储所需的应用上下文，以读取和保存 Android 偏好设置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，不提供应用上下文的 Multiplatform Settings 存储调用会失败，依赖这些调用的应用设置可能无法读写。

en.description: Fastboot Java (Rohit Verma) initializes at app startup and saves the app context needed to send fastboot commands to a connected device.
en.disableEffect: Fastboot commands that rely on this library will fail because it has no saved app context.

zh-CN.description: Fastboot Java（Rohit Verma）会在应用启动时初始化，并保存向已连接设备发送 fastboot 命令所需的应用上下文。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此库的 fastboot 命令将因没有保存的应用上下文而失败。

en.description: When the app opens RyftPay's checkout, this screen displays the payment form, handles Google Pay responses, and sends the payment result back to the app.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents RyftPay checkout from opening, so the app cannot complete payments through this flow.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开 RyftPay 结账界面时，这个页面会显示付款表单、处理 Google Pay 返回的信息，并把付款结果交还给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，RyftPay 结账页面无法打开，应用无法通过这条流程完成付款。

en.description: When a RyftPay payment needs additional identity verification or a 3-D Secure challenge, this screen performs that step and returns the result to checkout.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot complete payments that require this additional verification if this screen is disabled.

zh-CN.description: RyftPay 付款需要额外身份核验或 3-D Secure 验证时，这个页面会完成相应步骤并把结果交回结账流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用无法完成需要这项额外验证的付款。

en.description: When the Spade SDK opens an in-app page, this full-screen page loads the supplied web content and lets the page close or return control to the app.
en.disableEffect: Spade screens that rely on embedded web content may fail to open or finish.

zh-CN.description: Spade SDK 打开应用内页面时，此全屏页面会加载提供的网页内容，并允许页面关闭或将控制权交还应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖内嵌网页内容的 Spade 页面可能无法打开或正常结束。

en.description: When Android delivers an NFC NDEF tap, this Stripe Terminal Local Mobile SDK Activity opens the contactless payment screen with the supplied amount and transaction details.
en.disableEffect: Tap to Pay will not start from the NFC tap, so this contactless payment flow can fail.

zh-CN.description: Android 收到 NFC NDEF 触碰事件时，Stripe Terminal Local Mobile SDK 会打开无接触支付界面，并读取传入的金额和交易信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，NFC 触碰无法启动 Tap to Pay，这笔无接触支付可能无法继续。

en.description: When Android delivers an NFC NDEF tap, this Stripe Terminal Local Mobile SDK Activity opens the contactless payment screen with the supplied amount and transaction details.
en.disableEffect: Tap to Pay will not start from the NFC tap, so this contactless payment flow can fail.

zh-CN.description: Android 收到 NFC NDEF 触碰事件时，Stripe Terminal Local Mobile SDK 会打开无接触支付界面，并读取传入的金额和交易信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，NFC 触碰无法启动 Tap to Pay，这笔无接触支付可能无法继续。

en.description: When Android delivers an NFC NDEF tap, this Stripe Terminal Local Mobile SDK Activity opens the contactless payment screen with the supplied amount and transaction details.
en.disableEffect: Tap to Pay will not start from the NFC tap, so this contactless payment flow can fail.

zh-CN.description: Android 收到 NFC NDEF 触碰事件时，Stripe Terminal Local Mobile SDK 会打开无接触支付界面，并读取传入的金额和交易信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，NFC 触碰无法启动 Tap to Pay，这笔无接触支付可能无法继续。

en.description: SafeCharge's Android SDK exposes this card-payment screen from the app launcher. When opened, it collects the card number, expiry date, and security code, then authenticates and tokenizes the card.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open or submit this SafeCharge card-payment flow if the screen is disabled.

zh-CN.description: SafeCharge Android SDK 会在应用启动器中提供这个银行卡付款页面。页面会收集卡号、有效期和安全码，然后验证银行卡并生成支付令牌。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法打开或提交这条 SafeCharge 银行卡付款流程。

en.description: The Safer (ISEE-U) safety SDK opens this screen while a user creates an alert. It lets them choose whether they feel uncomfortable, are being harassed, or are in danger, then continues with that alert level.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot choose an alert severity, blocking the app's request-for-help flow.

zh-CN.description: 用户创建求助警报时，Safer（ISEE-U）安全 SDK 会打开此界面。用户可以选择感到不适、正在遭受骚扰或身处危险，应用随后按所选级别继续处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法选择警报级别，应用的求助流程会因此受阻。

en.description: After a user requests help, the Safer SDK sends the selected alert level with their location or chosen safe zone and shows the response status. The screen also offers follow-up chat and a way to cancel the request.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot submit or track help requests from this screen, breaking its safety-alert flow.

zh-CN.description: 用户请求帮助后，Safer SDK 会发送所选警报级别以及用户位置或指定的安全区域，并显示处理状态。此界面还提供后续聊天和取消请求的入口。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法通过此界面提交或跟踪求助请求，安全警报流程会中断。

en.description: When a user asks for help at a festival, this Safer screen lists designated safe spaces so they can choose where they are and continue the request. It also opens the phone dialer for emergency numbers 15 and 18.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot choose a safe-space location for a help request or open the emergency dialer from this screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户在节庆活动中请求帮助时，Safer 会显示指定的安全区域，供用户选择所在位置并继续求助流程。此界面还可打开拨号器拨打 15 或 18 等紧急号码。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法为求助请求选择安全区域，也无法从此界面打开紧急拨号器。

en.description: After Safer responders report that an alert has been handled, this screen asks the user to confirm they are safe or send another alert.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot show this safety check or let users confirm their status and request further help.

zh-CN.description: Safer 响应人员报告警报已处理后，此界面会询问用户是否已安全，并允许用户确认或再次发送警报。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法显示此安全确认，也无法让用户确认状态或继续求助。

en.description: When Safer asks a user to add a contact number, this screen explains that the number can help responders reach them if location or network service is unavailable. The user can open their profile to add it or dismiss the prompt.
en.disableEffect: The app loses its phone-number prompt and shortcut to the profile step used to complete it.

zh-CN.description: Safer 提示用户添加联系电话时，此界面会说明：如果定位或网络不可用，电话号码可帮助响应人员联系用户。用户可以前往个人资料添加号码，也可以关闭提示。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将失去电话号码提示以及前往个人资料补充号码的入口。

en.description: When a user opens the Safer help chat, this screen loads the conversation and sends typed messages to the response team.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot read or send messages in the app's help conversation.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 Safer 求助聊天时，此界面会加载对话，并将用户输入的消息发送给响应团队。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在应用的求助对话中查看或发送消息。

en.description: When a user creates or completes a Safer profile, this screen collects a display name, phone number, and optional profile photo, then submits them with the selected event.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot complete the profile details that Safer uses for event access and help requests.

zh-CN.description: 用户创建或补全 Safer 个人资料时，此界面会收集昵称、电话号码和可选的头像，并将这些信息与所选活动一并提交。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法补全 Safer 在活动服务和求助流程中使用的个人资料。

en.description: When a user opens Safer's safety guidance, this screen presents five practical ways to support someone facing harassment: distract, delegate, direct, document, and dialogue.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open the app's five-step bystander safety guidance.

zh-CN.description: 用户查看 Safer 安全指南时，此界面会介绍帮助遭受骚扰者的五种做法：转移注意、寻求协助、直接制止、记录情况和事后沟通。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开应用中的旁观者五步安全指南。

en.description: This is the Safer SDK's main navigation screen. It hosts the app's alert, safety information, zone list, and profile sections in a bottom navigation menu.
en.disableEffect: The app loses its main navigation screen and users cannot reach its core alert, information, zone, and profile sections.

zh-CN.description: 这是 Safer SDK 的主导航界面。它通过底部菜单承载应用的警报、安全信息、区域列表和个人资料页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将失去主导航界面，用户无法进入核心警报、信息、区域和个人资料页面。

en.description: When the host app opens this Safer screen after a response, it tells the user that a team member has handled the request and that they are safe.
en.disableEffect: The host app cannot display this safety confirmation page after an alert.

zh-CN.description: 宿主应用在求助得到响应后打开此 Safer 界面，告知用户团队成员已处理请求，用户目前安全。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 宿主应用将无法在警报处理后显示此安全确认页面。

en.description: When the Safer experience starts, this welcome screen loads current festival choices and lets the user select an event before continuing.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open the Safer welcome and event-selection flow.

zh-CN.description: Safer 服务启动时，此欢迎界面会加载当前节庆活动选项，供用户选择活动后继续。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开 Safer 欢迎界面和活动选择流程。

en.description: After the welcome step, this screen lists available Safer events and submits the selected event with the user's profile details to start the session.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot choose an event or complete the Safer sign-in flow from this screen.

zh-CN.description: 欢迎步骤之后，此界面会列出可用的 Safer 活动，并将所选活动与用户资料一并提交以开始服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在此界面选择活动或完成 Safer 登录流程。

en.description: When a user opens a festival safety zone, this screen loads and shows the zone's photo, name, and description. It can also open the event plan in another app.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot view safety-zone details or open the related festival plan from this screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开节庆安全区域时，此界面会加载并显示该区域的照片、名称和介绍，也可以在其他应用中打开活动地图。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法查看安全区域详情，也无法从此界面打开相关活动地图。

en.description: The Safer SDK's reminder service posts a notification prompting users without a saved phone number to add one. Tapping it returns to the app and opens the profile area.
en.disableEffect: Users stop receiving the phone-number reminder that directs them to complete their profile.

zh-CN.description: Safer SDK 的提醒服务会向尚未保存电话号码的用户发送通知，提示他们补充号码。点击通知会返回应用并打开个人资料页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将不再收到引导其补全个人资料电话号码的提醒。

en.description: When Safer's scheduled phone-number reminder alarm fires, this receiver starts the service that posts the reminder and directs the app to the profile area.
en.disableEffect: The scheduled reminder to add a phone number no longer appears.

zh-CN.description: Safer 预定的电话号码提醒闹钟触发时，此 Receiver 会启动发送提醒的服务，并将应用后续页面设为个人资料。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 添加电话号码的定时提醒将不再显示。

en.description: When a user opens a transaction in the Sagisu Vault wallet SDK, this screen loads that transaction and displays its payment details.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot show details for a Vault transaction through this screen if it is disabled.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Sagisu Vault 钱包 SDK 中打开某笔交易时，这个页面会读取该交易并显示付款详情。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用无法通过这个页面查看 Vault 交易详情。

en.description: When a user opens the coin-purchase flow in the Sagisu Vault wallet SDK, this screen displays the Buy Coins page.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open the wallet's coin-purchase screen if this page is disabled.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Sagisu Vault 钱包 SDK 中打开购买代币流程时，这个页面会显示购买界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法打开钱包的代币购买页面。

en.description: When a user chooses a contact for a Vault transfer, the Sagisu Vault wallet SDK opens a transfer form for that contact.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot continue a Vault transfer addressed to a selected contact if this screen is disabled.

zh-CN.description: 用户为 Vault 转账选择联系人后，Sagisu Vault 钱包 SDK 会打开该联系人的转账表单。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法继续向已选联系人发起 Vault 转账。

en.description: When the Sagisu Vault wallet SDK opens its contact picker, it requests contacts access and lists saved names and phone numbers so the user can choose a transfer recipient.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot choose a saved contact for a Vault transfer through this screen if it is disabled.

zh-CN.description: Sagisu Vault 钱包 SDK 打开联系人选择页时，会请求读取联系人权限，并列出已保存的姓名和电话号码，供用户选择转账对象。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过这个页面选择已保存的联系人进行 Vault 转账。

en.description: When the Sagisu Vault wallet SDK starts document verification, this screen guides the user through document selection, personal details, address, and Social Security number steps, then opens a success screen after submission.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot complete the wallet's document and identity-verification flow if this screen is disabled.

zh-CN.description: Sagisu Vault 钱包 SDK 启动证件核验时，这个页面会引导用户选择证件、填写个人资料、地址和社会安全号码，并在提交后打开成功页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法完成钱包的证件和身份核验流程。

en.description: In the Sagisu Vault wallet SDK, this screen lets a user add funds and can open Plaid to link a bank account, returning the linked-bank result to the funding flow.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot use this screen to add wallet funds or link a bank account if it is disabled.

zh-CN.description: Sagisu Vault 钱包 SDK 的这个页面可用于向钱包充值，也能打开 Plaid 绑定银行账户，并把绑定结果交回充值流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过这个页面为钱包充值或绑定银行账户。

en.description: When the Sagisu Vault wallet SDK needs a bank link for funding or transfers, this screen requests a Plaid link token, opens Plaid, and returns success or cancellation to the calling flow.
en.disableEffect: Bank linking through Plaid fails, blocking any funding or transfer step that depends on it.

zh-CN.description: Sagisu Vault 钱包 SDK 为充值或转账绑定银行时，这个页面会请求 Plaid 绑定令牌、打开 Plaid，并将成功或取消结果交回原流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Plaid 银行绑定无法完成，依赖它的充值或转账步骤也会受阻。

en.description: When a user chooses a coin to receive in the Sagisu Vault wallet SDK, this screen moves from coin selection to the receive page for that currency.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open the wallet's crypto-receiving flow for the selected currency if this screen is disabled.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Sagisu Vault 钱包 SDK 中选择要接收的代币后，这个页面会从代币选择切换到该币种的收款页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法打开所选币种的钱包加密货币收款流程。

en.description: The Sagisu Vault wallet SDK opens this screen as a host for its transaction-history list.
en.disableEffect: The transaction list opened through this entry point becomes unavailable if this screen is disabled.

zh-CN.description: Sagisu Vault 钱包 SDK 会通过这个页面显示交易历史列表。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，通过这个入口打开的交易列表将无法使用。

en.description: When a user transfers money between a Sagisu Vault wallet and a bank account, this screen loads the matching transfer form and can open Plaid to link the bank.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot use this screen for bank-account or self-transfer flows if it is disabled.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Sagisu Vault 钱包与银行账户之间转账时，这个页面会显示对应的转账表单，并可打开 Plaid 绑定银行。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过这个页面进行银行账户转账或自转账。

en.description: When Sagisu Vault opens its main wallet screen, this page shows the Home, Trade, and Profile sections; a matching Vault story link also opens here.
en.disableEffect: The wallet's main navigation and the pages opened through it or its story link become unavailable if this screen is disabled.

zh-CN.description: Sagisu Vault 打开主钱包页面时，这里会显示首页、交易和个人资料区域；匹配的 Vault 故事链接也会打开此页。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，钱包主导航及通过它或故事链接打开的页面将无法使用。

en.description: When a user opens business-profile settings in the Sagisu Vault wallet SDK, this screen shows enrollment if no profile exists or the existing profile settings.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot create or manage a Vault business profile through this screen if it is disabled.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Sagisu Vault 钱包 SDK 中打开企业资料设置时，如果尚无资料，这个页面会显示注册流程；已有资料时则显示设置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过这个页面创建或管理 Vault 企业资料。

en.description: Sagisu Vault's internal test screen shows an expandable menu labeled Business and DAO; tapping its main button expands the menu.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it removes this test menu screen; the wallet and business-profile screens are separate.

zh-CN.description: Sagisu Vault 的内部测试页面显示可展开的 Business 和 DAO 菜单；点击主按钮会展开菜单。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，这个测试菜单页面不可用；钱包和企业资料页面是独立的。

en.description: When a Sagisu Vault business-request link opens, this screen checks whether the user is signed in and displays the request so a business owner can approve or reject it.
en.disableEffect: Business-request links cannot reach their review and approval screens if this page is disabled.

zh-CN.description: Sagisu Vault 企业请求链接打开时，这个页面会检查用户是否已登录，并显示请求供企业负责人批准或拒绝。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，企业请求链接无法打开审核和批准页面。

en.description: When the user opens ID verification from the Sagisu Vault wallet's Home or Profile screen, this page shows an introduction; its Verify button currently displays a Coming soon message and Skip closes the page.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it breaks the wallet's entry into ID verification from its Home and Profile screens.

zh-CN.description: 用户从 Sagisu Vault 钱包的首页或个人资料页打开身份核验时，这个页面会显示介绍；当前点击 Verify 只会提示即将推出，点击 Skip 会关闭页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，钱包无法从首页或个人资料页进入身份核验介绍。

en.description: After document verification succeeds in the Sagisu Vault wallet SDK, this screen confirms completion and lets the user close it.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it interrupts the wallet's document-verification flow after submission because the success screen cannot open.

zh-CN.description: Sagisu Vault 钱包 SDK 的证件核验成功后，这个页面会确认完成并允许用户关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，证件提交后的成功页面无法打开，钱包核验流程会中断。

en.description: When a user needs access to a Sagisu Vault wallet, this screen handles sign-in or sign-up, phone verification codes, passwords, account recovery, and authenticator setup.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot sign in, create an account, recover access, or complete authenticator setup for the Vault wallet if this screen is disabled.

zh-CN.description: 用户需要访问 Sagisu Vault 钱包时，这个页面会处理登录或注册、手机验证码、密码、账号找回和验证器设置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法登录、注册、找回 Vault 钱包账号或完成验证器设置。

en.description: When the Sagisu Vault wallet starts, this screen checks saved sign-in status and sends the user to login or the main wallet.
en.disableEffect: The wallet cannot continue from startup to login or its main screen if this page is disabled.

zh-CN.description: Sagisu Vault 钱包启动时，这个页面会检查已保存的登录状态，并将用户带到登录页或钱包主页。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，钱包无法从启动页继续进入登录页或主页面。

en.description: When a user starts a crypto transfer in the Sagisu Vault wallet SDK, this screen lets them choose a coin, enter or scan a recipient address, validate it, and submit the transfer.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot send cryptocurrency through this wallet flow if the screen is disabled.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Sagisu Vault 钱包 SDK 中发起加密货币转账时，这个页面可供选择代币、输入或扫描收款地址、验证地址并提交转账。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过这条钱包流程发送加密货币。

en.description: When a user opens a token watchlist in the Sagisu Vault wallet SDK, this screen loads the watchlist for the selected coin.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot view the selected coin's watchlist through this screen if it is disabled.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Sagisu Vault 钱包 SDK 中打开代币关注列表时，这个页面会加载所选币种的列表。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过这个页面查看所选币种的关注列表。

en.description: When a user opens Transactions in the Sagisu Vault wallet SDK, this screen displays the transaction-history list.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot review transaction history through this screen if it is disabled.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Sagisu Vault 钱包 SDK 中打开交易页面时，这个页面会显示交易历史列表。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过这个页面查看交易历史。

en.description: When Sailthru's Android SDK starts this background service, it sends queued app-activity events when a network connection is available.
en.disableEffect: Sailthru activity events may remain queued or unsent, leaving its app-activity tracking incomplete.

zh-CN.description: Sailthru Android SDK 启动这个后台服务后，会在网络可用时发送排队中的应用活动事件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Sailthru 活动事件可能一直排队或无法发送，导致应用活动跟踪不完整。

en.description: When Android reports a connectivity change, Sailthru's Android SDK updates network status, retries any cached registration, and notifies its tracking service.
en.disableEffect: Sailthru cannot retry cached registration or resume queued tracking uploads when connectivity returns.

zh-CN.description: Android 报告网络连接变化时，Sailthru Android SDK 会更新网络状态、重试缓存的注册请求，并通知跟踪服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，网络恢复时 Sailthru 无法重试缓存的注册请求，也无法恢复排队中的跟踪数据上传。

en.description: Salesforce Agentforce Mobile SDK uses this file-sharing provider when sharing files such as PDFs and audio; other apps receive a link they can use to open the shared file.
en.disableEffect: Sharing or opening Agentforce files through other apps may fail if this provider is disabled.

zh-CN.description: Salesforce Agentforce Mobile SDK 使用此文件共享提供程序分享 PDF、音频等文件；其他应用会收到可用于打开共享文件的链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，通过其他应用分享或打开 Agentforce 文件可能失败。

en.description: When a Salesforce Agentforce voice call starts, this service keeps a call notification active and supports hanging up from that notification while the app is in the background.
en.disableEffect: Agentforce voice calls may fail to start or remain active in the background if this service is disabled.

zh-CN.description: Salesforce Agentforce 语音通话开始时，此服务会保持通话通知，并支持应用在后台时通过通知挂断电话。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Agentforce 语音通话可能无法启动或无法在后台保持连接。

en.description: The iRiS Guest Mobile Key integration with SALTO uses this service to connect to nearby Bluetooth access devices and exchange data needed for mobile-key access.
en.disableEffect: The app will no longer be able to use SALTO mobile keys over Bluetooth to access secured areas.

zh-CN.description: iRiS Guest Mobile Key 的 SALTO 集成会通过此服务连接附近的蓝牙门禁设备，并交换手机钥匙所需的数据。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用将无法通过蓝牙使用 SALTO 手机钥匙进入受控区域。

en.description: SambaTech Player starts this service to run or restart offline video downloads. It manages the download queue and posts progress, completion, and failure notifications.
en.disableEffect: Background video downloads cannot resume through this service, and their progress and completion notifications stop.

zh-CN.description: SambaTech Player 会启动此服务来执行或恢复离线视频下载；它管理下载队列，并显示进度、完成和失败通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，后台视频下载无法通过此服务恢复，下载进度和完成通知也会停止。

en.description: The KnoxActivator bundle's Samsung receiver normalizes Knox enterprise broadcast names and forwards results for licensing, kiosk mode, accounts, device policies, and related features to the app.
en.disableEffect: Knox policy and license results may not reach the app in the form its enterprise-management flows expect.

zh-CN.description: KnoxActivator 附带的 Samsung 接收器会规范 Knox 企业广播名称，并将许可证、自助终端模式、账户、设备策略等结果转发给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Knox 策略和许可证结果可能无法按企业管理流程所需的形式传递给本应用。

en.description: Samsung IAP, included in NHN Cloud and GamePub's Android SDKs, opens Samsung Account sign-in when the app needs to verify the store account for a purchase.
en.disableEffect: The app may not be able to confirm a Samsung account needed for in-app purchases.

zh-CN.description: NHN Cloud 和 GamePub 的 Android SDK 中包含 Samsung IAP；应用需要验证购买所用的商店账号时，它会打开 Samsung 账号登录界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，应用可能无法确认内购所需的 Samsung 账号。
