en.description: Samsung IAP, included in NHN Cloud and GamePub's Android SDKs, shows a message if Galaxy Store is missing, disabled, or out of date when the app tries to use Samsung in-app purchases.
en.disableEffect: Users may be unable to fix a missing or outdated Galaxy Store before buying through Samsung IAP.

zh-CN.description: NHN Cloud 和 GamePub 的 Android SDK 中包含 Samsung IAP；应用尝试使用 Samsung 内购时，如果 Galaxy Store 未安装、已停用或版本过旧，它会显示提示。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，用户可能无法根据提示修复缺失或过期的 Galaxy Store，也就无法通过 Samsung IAP 购买。

en.description: Samsung IAP, included in NHN Cloud and GamePub's Android SDKs, displays a purchase error message when the store returns a problem to the app.
en.disableEffect: Samsung IAP errors may no longer be shown, interrupting the app's purchase flow.

zh-CN.description: NHN Cloud 和 GamePub 的 Android SDK 中包含 Samsung IAP；商店向应用返回错误时，它会显示购买错误提示。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，Samsung IAP 错误可能无法显示，影响应用的购买流程。

en.description: Samsung IAP, included in NHN Cloud and GamePub's Android SDKs, opens Galaxy Store's checkout screen for an item and returns whether the purchase completed or was canceled.
en.disableEffect: In-app purchases that use Samsung's store will no longer complete.

zh-CN.description: NHN Cloud 和 GamePub 的 Android SDK 中包含 Samsung IAP；它会为商品打开 Galaxy Store 结账页面，并返回购买是否完成或取消。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，使用 Samsung 商店的应用内购买将无法完成。

en.description: SamuLib opens this screen when an app asks a user to crop a selected image. It lets the user rotate and crop the image, then returns the edited result.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents SamuLib image-cropping requests from opening, so image-editing flows that depend on this screen cannot finish.

zh-CN.description: SamuLib 会在应用要求用户裁剪已选图片时打开此页面。用户可以旋转和裁剪图片，完成后页面会返回编辑结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，SamuLib 的图片裁剪请求无法打开，因此依赖此页面的图片编辑流程无法完成。

en.description: SamuLib declares this Activity as an empty screen. Its image-selection and cropping experiences are provided by separate picker and crop screens.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it makes this empty SamuLib screen unavailable; the separate image picker and crop screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: SamuLib 将此 Activity 声明为空白页面。图片选择和裁剪由单独的选择器与裁剪页面完成。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，这个空白 SamuLib 页面无法打开；单独的图片选择器和裁剪页面仍可使用。

en.description: When Samuel Ribeiro’s TesteRepositorio-Android sample app launches, this Activity displays its main sample screen.
en.disableEffect: The sample app would have no screen to open from its launcher.

zh-CN.description: Samuel Ribeiro 的 TesteRepositorio-Android 示例应用启动时，此 Activity 会显示其主示例页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 示例应用将无法从启动器打开主页面。

en.description: The Gallery Image Picker library opens this screen when an app requests photo selection; it shows the device gallery and returns the selected images to the calling screen.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot open this picker or receive photos through this image-selection flow.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求选择照片时，Gallery Image Picker 图片选择库会打开此界面，显示设备相册并把选中的图片返回给调用界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法通过此图片选择流程打开相册或取得用户选中的照片。

en.description: The Gallery Image Picker library opens this screen when an app requests photo selection; it shows the device gallery and returns the selected images to the calling screen.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot open this picker or receive photos through this image-selection flow.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求选择照片时，Gallery Image Picker 图片选择库会打开此界面，显示设备相册并把选中的图片返回给调用界面。

en.description: After Android finishes booting, the In-Telligent OpenAPI SDK checks whether automatic subscriptions are enabled and, for eligible community types, finds nearby communities and registers their geofences.
en.disableEffect: Nearby-community subscriptions and geofences will not be restored at startup, so location-based alerts may be missed.

zh-CN.description: Android 启动完成后，In-Telligent OpenAPI SDK 会检查是否启用了自动订阅，并为符合条件的社区类型查找附近社区、注册地理围栏。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，启动时不会恢复附近社区订阅和地理围栏，用户可能收不到基于位置的提醒。

en.description: When In-Telligent OpenAPI receives a location-update broadcast, this receiver forwards its location result to the background location worker.
en.disableEffect: Background location updates will not be processed, so nearby-community data and alerts can become stale.

zh-CN.description: In-Telligent OpenAPI 收到位置更新广播时，此 Receiver 会将位置结果转交给后台位置任务处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，后台位置更新将无法处理，附近社区数据和提醒可能过期。

en.description: The In-Telligent OpenAPI SDK starts this Service during initialization; after the user removes the app from Recents, it clears the SDK's previous priority-alert state and stops itself.
en.disableEffect: Priority-alert state will not be cleared when the app is swiped away, so later alert handling may use stale state.

zh-CN.description: In-Telligent OpenAPI SDK 会在初始化时启动此 Service；用户从最近任务中移除应用后，它会清除 SDK 先前的优先提醒状态并停止运行。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，用户划掉应用时优先提醒状态不会清除，之后处理提醒时可能会使用过期状态。

en.description: When an OpenAPI location update contains coordinates, this Service stores the latest location and refreshes nearby-community data when its update interval has elapsed.
en.disableEffect: Nearby-community subscriptions or alerts may stop updating from background location.

zh-CN.description: OpenAPI 收到包含坐标的位置更新时，此 Service 会保存最新位置，并在更新间隔到期后刷新附近社区数据。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，附近社区订阅或提醒可能无法根据后台位置继续更新。

en.description: The In-Telligent OpenAPI SDK schedules this job when an alert receipt is pending; with network access, it sends the oldest receipt to the server and records a successful delivery update.
en.disableEffect: Pending alert receipts may remain unsent, leaving server-side alert status or follow-up handling out of date.

zh-CN.description: In-Telligent OpenAPI SDK 发现提醒回执待处理时会安排此任务；网络可用后，它会向服务器发送最早的回执并记录成功的送达状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，待处理的提醒回执可能无法发送，服务器上的提醒状态或后续处理可能过期。

en.description: When Android reports a registered geofence event, the In-Telligent OpenAPI SDK queues it for background processing.
en.disableEffect: Geofence events will not trigger background community refreshes or related location alerts.

zh-CN.description: Android 报告已注册的地理围栏事件时，In-Telligent OpenAPI SDK 会将其排入后台任务处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，地理围栏事件将无法触发后台社区刷新或相关位置提醒。

en.description: After a geofence event is queued, the In-Telligent OpenAPI SDK processes entry, exit, or dwell events and refreshes nearby communities when due.
en.disableEffect: Nearby-community data and alerts will not refresh after background geofence transitions.

zh-CN.description: 地理围栏事件排队后，In-Telligent OpenAPI SDK 会处理进入、离开或停留事件，并在需要时刷新附近社区。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，后台地理围栏状态变化将无法刷新附近社区数据和提醒。

en.description: When started, Dinesh Scaletech's UpAxis install-tracking SDK periodically sends the configured user-tracking event to its server.
en.disableEffect: UpAxis tracking reports stop; the host app's ordinary screens and features remain available.

zh-CN.description: 启动后，Dinesh Scaletech 的 UpAxis 安装跟踪 SDK 会定期向服务器发送已配置的用户跟踪事件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: UpAxis 跟踪报告会停止，宿主应用的普通界面和功能仍可使用。

en.description: Android starts this Scandit Data Capture barcode provider with the app process. It prepares barcode scanning before the app uses that feature.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it can prevent Scandit barcode features from initializing when the app needs them.

zh-CN.description: Android 会在应用进程启动时启动此 Scandit Data Capture barcode Provider。它会在应用使用相关功能前准备条码扫描。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，应用需要使用 Scandit barcode 功能时，该功能可能无法初始化。

en.description: Android starts this Scandit Data Capture core provider with the app process. It prepares shared services used by other Scandit capture features before the app uses that feature.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it can prevent Scandit core features from initializing when the app needs them.

zh-CN.description: Android 会在应用进程启动时启动此 Scandit Data Capture core Provider。它会在应用使用相关功能前准备其他 Scandit 采集功能共用的服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，应用需要使用 Scandit core 功能时，该功能可能无法初始化。

en.description: Android starts this Scandit Data Capture ID provider with the app process. It prepares identity-document capture before the app uses that feature.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it can prevent Scandit ID features from initializing when the app needs them.

zh-CN.description: Android 会在应用进程启动时启动此 Scandit Data Capture ID Provider。它会在应用使用相关功能前准备证件采集。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，应用需要使用 Scandit ID 功能时，该功能可能无法初始化。

en.description: Android starts this Scandit Data Capture AAMVA barcode verification provider with the app process. It prepares AAMVA barcode verification used to check data from US driver's-license barcodes before the app uses that feature.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it can prevent Scandit AAMVA barcode verification features from initializing when the app needs them.

zh-CN.description: Android 会在应用进程启动时启动此 Scandit Data Capture AAMVA barcode verification Provider。它会在应用使用相关功能前准备用于核验美国驾照条码数据的 AAMVA 条码验证。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，应用需要使用 Scandit AAMVA barcode verification 功能时，该功能可能无法初始化。

en.description: Android starts this Scandit Data Capture label provider with the app process. It prepares product-label reading before the app uses that feature.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it can prevent Scandit label features from initializing when the app needs them.

zh-CN.description: Android 会在应用进程启动时启动此 Scandit Data Capture label Provider。它会在应用使用相关功能前准备商品标签读取。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，应用需要使用 Scandit label 功能时，该功能可能无法初始化。

en.description: Android starts this Scandit Data Capture parser provider with the app process. It prepares parsing scanned data strings into structured fields before the app uses that feature.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it can prevent Scandit parser features from initializing when the app needs them.

zh-CN.description: Android 会在应用进程启动时启动此 Scandit Data Capture parser Provider。它会在应用使用相关功能前准备将扫描文本解析为结构化字段。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，应用需要使用 Scandit parser 功能时，该功能可能无法初始化。

en.description: Android starts this Scandit Data Capture text provider with the app process. It prepares text recognition used by document and text capture before the app uses that feature.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it can prevent Scandit text features from initializing when the app needs them.

zh-CN.description: Android 会在应用进程启动时启动此 Scandit Data Capture text Provider。它会在应用使用相关功能前准备文档和文字采集使用的文字识别。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，应用需要使用 Scandit text 功能时，该功能可能无法初始化。

en.description: The Document Scanner Library by Andrej Lukasevic opens a camera scan flow when requested by the app; it lets the user capture, crop, and rotate a document, choose a scan style, and return the saved image to the app.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot launch this document scan flow or receive its scanned pages.

zh-CN.description: Andrej Lukasevic 的 Document Scanner Library 会在应用请求扫描时打开相机流程；用户可拍摄、裁剪或旋转文档，选择扫描效果，并将保存的图片返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用无法启动此文档扫描流程，也无法获取扫描后的页面。

en.description: Scanzy Barcode Scanner opens this screen when an app requests a barcode scan with the camera picker. It starts the camera scanner and returns the decoded barcode text and type.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents Scanzy barcode requests using this camera picker from completing.

zh-CN.description: 应用通过相机选择器请求扫描条码时，Scanzy Barcode Scanner 会打开此页面。它启动相机扫描，并返回解码后的条码文本和类型。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，使用此相机选择器的 Scanzy 条码扫描请求无法完成。

en.description: Scanzy Barcode Scanner opens this screen when an app requests a barcode scan with the newer camera picker. It starts the camera scanner and returns the decoded barcode text and type.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents Scanzy barcode requests using this camera picker from completing.

zh-CN.description: 应用通过新版相机选择器请求扫描条码时，Scanzy Barcode Scanner 会打开此页面。它启动相机扫描，并返回解码后的条码文本和类型。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，使用此相机选择器的 Scanzy 条码扫描请求无法完成。

en.description: Schibsted Account starts this service with its account lifecycle to keep login sessions up to date. It saves sessions after login or token refresh and removes them after logout.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it can leave Schibsted Account sessions unsaved or stale, disrupting sign-in persistence.

zh-CN.description: Schibsted Account 会随账户生命周期启动此服务，以保持登录会话信息更新。登录或令牌刷新后会保存会话，退出登录后会删除会话。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，Schibsted Account 会话可能无法保存或更新，从而影响登录状态的持久保存。

en.description: Schibsted Account opens this screen for password sign-in or account registration. It presents the account form and returns the result to the login flow.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents password-based sign-in and registration flows from opening.

zh-CN.description: Schibsted Account 会在用户使用密码登录或注册账户时打开此页面。它显示账户表单，并将结果返回登录流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，密码登录和注册流程无法打开。

en.description: Schibsted Account opens this screen for passwordless sign-in. It asks for an account identifier and verification code.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents passwordless sign-in through Schibsted Account.

zh-CN.description: Schibsted Account 会在用户使用免密码方式登录时打开此页面，要求输入账户标识和验证码。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，Schibsted Account 的免密码登录无法使用。

en.description: Schibsted Account opens this screen while completing browser-based sign-in. It returns the authorization success or cancellation to the app.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it can prevent browser sign-in from returning to the app correctly.

zh-CN.description: Schibsted Account 会在完成基于浏览器的登录时打开此页面，并将授权成功或取消结果交还应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，基于浏览器的登录可能无法正确返回应用。

en.description: Schibsted Account opens this screen when the browser redirects back to the app after sign-in. It forwards the sign-in response to the authorization flow.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it can break the return step of browser-based sign-in.

zh-CN.description: 浏览器登录后重定向回应用时，Schibsted Account 会打开此页面。它会将登录响应转交给授权流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，基于浏览器的登录回跳步骤可能无法完成。

en.description: Schibsted Account's login prompt reads and updates saved session records through this provider. It is used when the app presents the SDK's login prompt.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it can prevent the Schibsted Account login prompt from reading or updating the session it needs.

zh-CN.description: Schibsted Account 的登录提示会通过此 Provider 读取和更新已保存的会话记录。应用显示 SDK 登录提示时会使用它。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，Schibsted Account 登录提示可能无法读取或更新所需会话。

en.description: Schibsted Pulse Unicorn receives a notification action that clears the SDK's stored event history. It is an event-inspection tool action, not part of the app's normal user flow.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it only prevents the Pulse event-history clear action from being handled.

zh-CN.description: Schibsted Pulse Unicorn 会接收用于清除 SDK 已存事件历史的通知操作。这是事件检查工具的操作，不属于应用的常规用户流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，Pulse 事件历史的清除操作将无法处理。

en.description: Schibsted Pulse Unicorn opens this diagnostic screen to inspect captured Pulse events, their details, and filters. It is a developer event viewer rather than an app feature screen.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it removes the Pulse event-inspection screen; the app's ordinary features continue.

zh-CN.description: Schibsted Pulse Unicorn 会打开此诊断页面，用于检查捕获的 Pulse 事件、事件详情和筛选条件。它是开发者使用的事件查看器，不是应用功能页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，Pulse 事件检查页面将不可用；应用的常规功能仍可使用。

en.description: Schibsted Pulse Unicorn for Android TV opens this diagnostic screen to inspect captured events, JSON details, and filters. It is an event viewer rather than an app feature screen.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it removes the Pulse TV event-inspection screen; the app's ordinary features continue.

zh-CN.description: Schibsted Pulse Unicorn for Android TV 会打开此诊断页面，用于检查捕获的事件、JSON 详情和筛选条件。它是事件查看器，不是应用功能页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，Pulse TV 事件检查页面将不可用；应用的常规功能仍可使用。

en.description: Shortcut Media’s image-recognition SDK opens the result URL for a recognized item and displays the service page inside the app.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from opening the recognition result page through the Shortcut SDK.

zh-CN.description: Shortcut Media 的图像识别 SDK 会打开识别结果链接，并在应用内显示服务提供的结果页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法通过 Shortcut SDK 打开识别结果页面。

en.description: AnUitor starts this local inspection service when a developer requests a view of the app's screen hierarchy and UI details. It exposes diagnostic information through a local server.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents AnUitor's local screen-inspection service from starting; normal app features continue.

zh-CN.description: 开发者请求查看应用屏幕结构和界面详情时，AnUitor 会启动此本地检查服务。它通过本地服务器提供诊断信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，AnUitor 的本地屏幕检查服务无法启动；应用的常规功能仍可使用。

en.description: Uitor starts this local inspection service when a developer requests screen and view-hierarchy diagnostics. It serves UI details and screenshots from the running app.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents Uitor's local inspection server from starting; normal app features continue.

zh-CN.description: 开发者请求查看屏幕和界面层级诊断信息时，Uitor 会启动此本地检查服务。它提供运行中应用的界面详情和截图。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，Uitor 的本地检查服务器无法启动；应用的常规功能仍可使用。

en.description: When the app sends the LevelUp Beacon SDK's initialization broadcast, this Receiver starts beacon scanning so the app can detect nearby LevelUp beacons.
en.disableEffect: Nearby LevelUp beacon discovery will not start through the SDK's initialization broadcast.

zh-CN.description: 应用发送 LevelUp Beacon SDK 的初始化广播时，此 Receiver 会启动信标扫描，让应用检测附近的 LevelUp 信标。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法通过该初始化流程启动附近 LevelUp 信标检测。

en.description: When Android reports low or recovered battery, this Receiver asks the LevelUp Beacon SDK to adjust beacon scanning for the battery state.
en.disableEffect: Beacon scanning may continue while the battery is low or fail to resume when the battery recovers.

zh-CN.description: Android 报告电量过低或恢复正常时，此 Receiver 会通知 LevelUp Beacon SDK 根据电量调整信标扫描。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 电量过低时信标扫描可能不会暂停，电量恢复后也可能无法重新启动。

en.description: When Android reports that Bluetooth has turned on or off, this Receiver asks the LevelUp Beacon SDK to refresh its beacon scan.
en.disableEffect: LevelUp beacon scanning may not resume correctly after Bluetooth is turned back on.

zh-CN.description: Android 报告蓝牙已开启或关闭时，此 Receiver 会通知 LevelUp Beacon SDK 刷新信标扫描。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 重新开启蓝牙后，LevelUp 信标扫描可能无法正常恢复。

en.description: After Android reports that the device has finished starting, this Receiver clears stale scan state and starts the LevelUp Beacon SDK's scanning service.
en.disableEffect: LevelUp beacon discovery will not restart automatically after the device reboots.

zh-CN.description: Android 报告设备启动完成后，此 Receiver 会清除过期的扫描状态并启动 LevelUp Beacon SDK 的扫描服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 设备重启后，LevelUp 信标检测将不会自动恢复。

en.description: When the LevelUp Beacon SDK starts this service after a battery-state change, it saves the low-battery setting and starts or stops beacon scanning accordingly.
en.disableEffect: The SDK may keep scanning during low battery or fail to resume scanning after the battery recovers.

zh-CN.description: 电量状态变化后，LevelUp Beacon SDK 启动此服务保存低电量状态，并据此启动或停止信标扫描。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 电量过低时扫描可能不会停止，电量恢复后扫描也可能无法重新启动。

en.description: When started by the app or a LevelUp Beacon SDK receiver, this service scans for nearby LevelUp beacons while scanning is enabled and the battery is not low, then reports discoveries to the app.
en.disableEffect: The app will no longer detect nearby LevelUp beacons or receive their discovery events.

zh-CN.description: 应用或 LevelUp Beacon SDK 的 Receiver 启动此服务后，只要扫描已启用且电量不低，服务就会搜索附近的 LevelUp 信标并向应用报告发现结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法再检测附近的 LevelUp 信标或收到信标发现事件。

en.description: When the LevelUp SDK queues an API request for background delivery, this service sends it to LevelUp and reports the response to the app.
en.disableEffect: Background LevelUp API requests may fail to complete, interrupting features that depend on them.

zh-CN.description: LevelUp SDK 将 API 请求安排在后台发送时，此服务会向 LevelUp 发出请求并把响应报告给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 后台 LevelUp API 请求可能无法完成，依赖这些请求的功能也会受影响。

en.description: When the host app starts a GetID verification flow, this Activity presents the configured identity-check steps, including document and face checks when requested.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot complete the identity-verification flow that the app starts through this SDK.

zh-CN.description: 宿主应用启动 GetID 身份验证流程时，此 Activity 会展示配置好的核验步骤，包括所需的证件和人脸检查。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法完成应用通过此 SDK 启动的身份验证流程。

en.description: When a purchase in RuStore Billing selects Paylib's native payment route, this screen opens the Paylib checkout flow and handles its result.
en.disableEffect: Users may be unable to complete in-app purchases that use this Paylib payment route.

zh-CN.description: 在 RuStore Billing 选择 Paylib 原生付款方式时，此页面会打开 Paylib 付款流程并处理返回结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户可能无法完成采用此 Paylib 方式的应用内付款。

en.description: QuickLib opens this screen when asked to preview a list of images; users can swipe through the pictures.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot show images in QuickLib's full-screen preview.

zh-CN.description: QuickLib 收到图片预览请求时会打开此界面，用户可以滑动查看图片。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法使用 QuickLib 的全屏预览查看图片。

en.description: QuickLib opens this screen with a supplied web address and displays the page inside the app.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot display pages that use QuickLib's in-app web screen.

zh-CN.description: QuickLib 会根据调用方提供的网址打开此界面，并在应用内显示网页。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法显示通过 QuickLib 应用内网页界面打开的页面。

en.description: QuickLib opens this screen to render HTML content supplied by the app inside an in-app web view.
en.disableEffect: App-provided HTML pages that use this QuickLib screen will not be displayed.

zh-CN.description: QuickLib 会打开此界面，在应用内网页视图中显示应用提供的 HTML 内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此 QuickLib 界面的应用内 HTML 页面将无法显示。

en.description: When the XSDK Facebook account module starts this Activity for sign-in, it opens Facebook login and returns the access token and profile details to the app.
en.disableEffect: Facebook sign-in through XSDK will not complete.

zh-CN.description: XSDK 的 Facebook 账户模块启动此 Activity 登录时，它会打开 Facebook 登录流程，并将访问令牌和个人资料信息返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法通过 XSDK 完成 Facebook 登录。

en.description: When the XSDK Google account module starts this Activity, it runs Google sign-in and returns the account token and profile to the app.
en.disableEffect: Google sign-in through XSDK will fail.

zh-CN.description: XSDK 的 Google 账户模块启动此 Activity 时，它会执行 Google 登录，并将账户令牌和个人资料返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法通过 XSDK 完成 Google 登录。

en.description: When Firebase delivers an XSDK push message or refreshes its device token, this service forwards the message details or new token to the app.
en.disableEffect: XSDK's Firebase push messages and token updates will no longer reach the app.

zh-CN.description: Firebase 收到 XSDK 推送消息或更新设备令牌时，此服务会将消息内容或新令牌转交给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: XSDK 的 Firebase 推送消息和令牌更新将无法再送达应用。

en.description: When a user opens an XSDK Huawei push notification, this Activity reads its title and payload from the notification link and sends the click data to the app.
en.disableEffect: Huawei push notification taps will no longer reach the app through XSDK.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 XSDK 华为推送通知时，此 Activity 会从通知链接读取标题和内容，并将点击信息传给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 华为推送通知的点击将无法再通过 XSDK 传给应用。

en.description: When Huawei Push Kit delivers a message or refreshes its token, this service forwards the message or new registration token to the app through XSDK.
en.disableEffect: Huawei push messages and token updates will no longer reach the app through XSDK.

zh-CN.description: 华为推送服务送达消息或更新令牌时，此服务会通过 XSDK 将消息或新的注册令牌转交给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 华为推送消息和令牌更新将无法再通过 XSDK 送达应用。

en.description: When a user opens an XSDK Oppo push notification, this Activity reads its title, text, and payload and forwards the click to the app.
en.disableEffect: Oppo push notification taps will no longer reach the app through XSDK.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 XSDK OPPO 推送通知时，此 Activity 会读取通知标题、文本和内容，并将点击信息传给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: OPPO 推送通知的点击将无法再通过 XSDK 传给应用。

en.description: When a moderator adds an operator to a Sendbird open channel, this Activity lets them find and register the new operator.
en.disableEffect: Moderators can no longer add open-channel operators through this Sendbird UIKit screen.

zh-CN.description: 版主为 Sendbird 公开频道添加管理员时，此 Activity 可让他们查找并登记新管理员。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 版主将无法通过此 Sendbird UIKit 页面为公开频道添加管理员。

en.description: When the app opens settings for a Sendbird open channel, this Activity displays the channel's settings and management options.
en.disableEffect: Apps that use this screen lose the open channel's settings and management page.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开 Sendbird 公开频道设置时，此 Activity 会显示该频道的设置和管理选项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此页面的应用将失去公开频道设置和管理页面。

en.description: When a user opens the operator list for a Sendbird group channel, this Activity displays its channel operators.
en.disableEffect: Users can no longer view group-channel operators in this Sendbird UIKit screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 Sendbird 群聊的管理员列表时，此 Activity 会显示该频道的管理员。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在此 Sendbird UIKit 页面中查看群聊管理员。

en.description: When a user opens the participant list for a Sendbird open channel, this Activity displays the people currently in the channel.
en.disableEffect: Users can no longer view open-channel participants in this Sendbird UIKit screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 Sendbird 公开频道的参与者列表时，此 Activity 会显示当前在频道中的用户。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在此 Sendbird UIKit 页面中查看公开频道参与者。

en.description: When a user opens a media attachment from a Sendbird message, this Activity displays it in the message viewer.
en.disableEffect: Users can no longer open message attachments in the Sendbird UIKit viewer.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 Sendbird 消息中的媒体附件时，此 Activity 会在消息查看器中显示该附件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在 Sendbird UIKit 查看器中打开消息附件。

en.description: When a moderator adds an operator to a Sendbird group channel, this Activity lets them find and register the new operator.
en.disableEffect: Moderators can no longer add group-channel operators through this Sendbird UIKit screen.

zh-CN.description: 版主为 Sendbird 群聊添加管理员时，此 Activity 可让他们查找并登记新管理员。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 版主将无法通过此 Sendbird UIKit 页面为群聊添加管理员。

en.description: When Sendbird UIKit opens a downloaded chat file with another app, this provider creates a temporary file link and grants that app access.
en.disableEffect: Downloaded chat files can no longer be opened through Sendbird UIKit's external file-viewing flow.

zh-CN.description: Sendbird UIKit 在其他应用中打开已下载的聊天文件时，此 Provider 会创建临时文件链接并授权该应用访问。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 Sendbird UIKit 的外部文件查看流程打开已下载的聊天文件。

en.description: At app startup, this Sensors Analytics event provider prepares the local storage used for tracking events and session data; Hina Data Track and Aldwx's data-statistics SDK also bundle it.
en.disableEffect: Sensors Analytics events and session data may no longer be stored or uploaded.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，此 Sensors Analytics 事件 Provider 会准备本地存储，用于保存跟踪事件和会话数据；Hina Data Track 与 Aldwx 数据统计 SDK 也包含此组件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Sensors Analytics 事件和会话数据可能不再保存或上传。

en.description: When Sensors Analytics Data Manager stores or queries an event, this provider uses its local event database and flushes queued data when the SDK reaches its upload point.
en.disableEffect: Sensors Analytics Data Manager events may no longer be stored or uploaded.

zh-CN.description: Sensors Analytics Data Manager 保存或查询事件时，此 Provider 会使用本地事件数据库，并在 SDK 需要上传时发送排队的数据。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Sensors Analytics Data Manager 事件可能不再保存或上传。

en.description: At app startup, this Sensors Focus provider prepares local storage for campaign plans, user state, cached values, and diagnostic records.
en.disableEffect: Sensors Focus campaigns and their saved state may fail to load, affecting app flows that rely on those campaigns.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，此 Sensors Focus Provider 会准备本地存储，用于保存活动方案、用户状态、缓存值和诊断记录。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Sensors Focus 活动及其保存状态可能无法加载，依赖这些活动的应用流程会受影响。

en.description: When Sensors Focus launches an in-app campaign, this Activity displays its pop-up content over the current screen and records whether it was shown.
en.disableEffect: Sensors Focus in-app campaign pop-ups and app flows that depend on them will no longer appear.

zh-CN.description: Sensors Focus 启动应用内活动时，此 Activity 会在当前页面上显示弹出内容，并记录内容是否成功展示。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Sensors Focus 应用内活动弹窗及依赖这些弹窗的应用流程将无法显示。

en.description: Sequencing.com OAuth opens this Activity during sign-in, showing the account authorization page and returning the authorization result to the app.
en.disableEffect: If the app uses Sequencing.com sign-in, users cannot log in or link their account.

zh-CN.description: Sequencing.com OAuth 登录期间会打开此界面，显示账户授权页面，并把授权结果交回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 如果应用通过 Sequencing.com 登录，用户将无法登录或关联账户。

en.description: The Sequencing.com File Selector shows the user's personal files and sample files, then returns the selected file to the app.
en.disableEffect: Any app feature that asks users to choose a Sequencing.com file will stop at that step.

zh-CN.description: Sequencing.com File Selector 会显示用户的个人文件和示例文件，并将选中的文件交回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖 Sequencing.com 文件选择的功能会在选择步骤中断。

en.description: The Sequencing.com File Selector first lets users choose personal files or sample files, then opens the matching file list.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot enter the file picker from this choice screen.

zh-CN.description: Sequencing.com File Selector 会先让用户选择个人文件或示例文件，然后打开对应的文件列表。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，用户无法从此选择页面进入文件列表。

en.description: When the Sequencing.com file picker opens, this loading screen fetches the user's available files and then moves to the file source choices.
en.disableEffect: The file list will not load, so file selection through Sequencing.com cannot continue.

zh-CN.description: 启动 Sequencing.com 文件选择器时，此加载界面会获取用户可用的文件，然后进入文件来源选择页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 文件列表无法加载，应用也就无法继续通过 Sequencing.com 选择文件。

en.description: The Serenegiant USB-camera library runs this Service when an app connects an external USB video camera. It manages the camera connection and supplies live video to the app.
en.disableEffect: Apps that rely on this Service cannot connect to or receive video from the external camera.

zh-CN.description: 应用连接外置 USB 摄像头时，Serenegiant USB 摄像头库会运行此 Service，管理摄像头连接并向应用提供实时画面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此 Service 的应用将无法连接外置摄像头或接收其实时画面。

en.description: The PrivacyPolicyWebHelper library opens this screen with a policy link and title supplied by the app; it displays that page in an in-app browser and supports back navigation.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from viewing the app's privacy policy through this library.

zh-CN.description: PrivacyPolicyWebHelper 在应用提供隐私政策链接和标题后打开此页面，在应用内浏览页面并支持返回导航。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过此库查看应用的隐私政策。

en.description: The VeriDoc Global SDK opens this QR-scanning screen; tapping its scan control starts the camera scanner used for document verification.
en.disableEffect: Users will lose this entry point for scanning and verifying VeriDoc Global QR codes.

zh-CN.description: VeriDoc Global SDK 会打开此二维码扫描页面；点击扫描控件后会启动用于文件验证的相机扫描器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此入口扫描并验证 VeriDoc Global 二维码。

en.description: The VeriDoc Global SDK uses this landing screen to open its QR or certificate tools and request the permissions those tools need.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to open VeriDoc Global's QR and certificate workflows from this screen.

zh-CN.description: VeriDoc Global SDK 使用此入口页面打开二维码或证书工具，并请求这些工具需要的权限。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此页面打开 VeriDoc Global 的二维码和证书流程。

en.description: After a VeriDoc Global QR scan, this screen shows the scanned text or opens a recognized verification page inside the app.
en.disableEffect: Users may be unable to read scanned code contents or open the linked verification page.

zh-CN.description: VeriDoc Global 二维码扫描完成后，此页面会显示扫描文本，或在应用内打开可识别的验证网页。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户可能无法查看扫描内容或打开关联的验证页面。

en.description: The VeriDoc Global SDK uses this camera scanner to check certificate QR codes and submit valid entries; it can also read codes from images or PDFs.
en.disableEffect: Certificate QR entries cannot be scanned or submitted through this screen.

zh-CN.description: VeriDoc Global SDK 使用此相机扫描器检查证书二维码并提交有效记录，也可从图片或 PDF 中读取二维码。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此页面扫描或提交证书二维码记录。

en.description: The VeriDoc Global SDK uses this camera scanner to check certificate QR codes and submit valid entries; it can also read codes from images or PDFs.
en.disableEffect: Certificate QR entries cannot be scanned or submitted through this screen.

zh-CN.description: VeriDoc Global SDK 使用此相机扫描器检查证书二维码并提交有效记录，也可从图片或 PDF 中读取二维码。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此页面扫描或提交证书二维码记录。

en.description: The VeriDoc Global SDK scans a private QR code here, checks it with its verification service, and opens the returned verification page when accepted; images and PDFs can also be scanned.
en.disableEffect: Users will be unable to scan private QR codes and open their verification results through this flow.

zh-CN.description: VeriDoc Global SDK 会在此扫描私有二维码，通过验证服务检查后打开返回的验证页面；也可扫描图片和 PDF。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此流程扫描私有二维码并打开验证结果。

en.description: Sezzle's Android Checkout SDK opens this Activity for a merchant order, displays Sezzle's checkout page, and returns the payment outcome to the app.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot complete Sezzle checkout through this flow.

zh-CN.description: Sezzle Android Checkout SDK 会在商家订单付款时打开此界面，显示 Sezzle 结账页面，并把付款结果交回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用无法通过此流程完成 Sezzle 付款。

en.description: Sezzle's Android Checkout SDK opens this payment modal when the app requests Sezzle payment details, then returns cancellation or error results to the app.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot open a Sezzle payment flow that relies on this modal, which may interrupt checkout.

zh-CN.description: Sezzle Android Checkout SDK 会在应用请求付款信息时显示 Sezzle 支付弹窗，并将取消或错误结果交回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用无法打开依赖此弹窗的 Sezzle 付款流程，结账可能因此中断。

en.description: Shake's bug-reporting SDK runs this receiver when someone uses Quick Reply on a Shake chat notification. It sends the typed reply to that ticket and refreshes the notification.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot reply to Shake chat messages from the notification, while the host app's normal screens continue to work.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击 Shake 聊天通知中的快捷回复时，Shake 缺陷反馈 SDK 会运行此接收器，把回复发送到对应对话并更新通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法直接从通知回复 Shake 消息，但应用本身仍可正常使用。

en.description: When notification access is granted and Shake's notification collection is enabled, this service reads the host app's notification titles and text and sends them to Shake as diagnostic events.
en.disableEffect: Shake reports will lose these notification events, but the app's notifications will still appear normally.

zh-CN.description: 用户授予通知访问权限且启用 Shake 通知收集时，此服务会读取应用通知的标题和正文，并将其作为诊断事件发送给 Shake。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Shake 诊断报告将不再包含这些通知事件，应用通知仍会照常显示。

en.description: After a user approves screen capture from a Shake report, this foreground service records the device screen and creates a video that can be attached to the report.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot add screen recordings to Shake reports, but the app's regular screens still work.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Shake 报告界面同意录屏后，此前台服务会录下设备屏幕，并生成可附加到报告的视频。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法将屏幕录像附加到 Shake 报告，但应用的常规界面不受影响。

en.description: When someone opens a file attached to a Shake report, this provider creates a local link so Android can open the file in a compatible app.
en.disableEffect: Shake cannot open report attachments, but the app's other features remain usable.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 Shake 报告中的附件时，此内容提供程序会生成本地文件链接，供 Android 使用兼容应用打开附件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Shake 无法打开报告附件，但应用的其他功能仍可正常使用。

en.description: Shake opens this short-lived Activity after a user taps a chat notification. It routes the user to the matching Shake support conversation.
en.disableEffect: Tapping a Shake chat notification will no longer open its conversation, but the host app remains usable.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击 Shake 聊天通知后，会短暂打开此界面，并将用户带到对应的 Shake 支持对话。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 点击 Shake 聊天通知将无法进入对应对话，但应用仍可正常使用。

en.description: When users open Shake's feedback screen or follow a Shake notification, this Activity displays bug reports, support chat, and diagnostic history, and can start screenshot or screen-recording capture.
en.disableEffect: Shake's in-app reporting and support screens will not open, while the app's regular features continue to work.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 Shake 反馈界面或通过通知进入对话时，此界面会显示缺陷报告、支持聊天和诊断记录，也可启动截图或录屏。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Shake 的应用内报告和支持界面无法打开，但应用的常规功能仍可使用。

en.description: Shake opens this Activity when it needs a runtime permission or screen-capture consent for a reporting feature. It shows Android's permission prompt and returns the user's choice to Shake.
en.disableEffect: Shake cannot request those permissions through its own flow, so permission-gated report tools such as screen recording will be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: Shake 需要运行时权限或录屏授权时会打开此界面，显示 Android 权限提示，并把用户选择交回 Shake。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Shake 无法通过自己的界面申请这些权限，依赖授权的报告工具（例如录屏）也无法使用。

en.description: The WebRTC Kotlin Multiplatform SDK starts this provider with the app to cache the application context used by its camera and media features.
en.disableEffect: WebRTC functions that need this context may fail when called, including camera or media setup.

zh-CN.description: WebRTC Kotlin Multiplatform SDK 会在应用启动时通过此提供程序保存应用上下文，供摄像头和媒体功能使用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: WebRTC 调用这些功能时可能因无法取得上下文而失败，包括摄像头或媒体初始化。

en.description: The Mikes Corporation MKeyboard service appears as an Android input method when the user selects it for typing. It shows numeric or QWERTY layouts for the focused field, but this release's code does not enter tapped keys into the field.
en.disableEffect: MKeyboard disappears from the keyboard choices; this release does not provide working text entry, so disabling it removes its layout without removing functioning key input.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择 Mikes Corporation 的 MKeyboard 输入法时，Android 会显示数字或 QWERTY 键盘布局；但此版本的代码不会将点击的按键输入到文本框中。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，MKeyboard 将从键盘选项中消失；此版本本身无法正常输入文字，因此禁用只会移除该布局，不会移除可用的按键输入功能。

en.description: When IDWise Device Intel Shield checks device integrity, it binds this isolated service to look for Magisk or Zygisk root tools; the check runs in a separate background process without a screen.
en.disableEffect: Shield loses this root-detection check and may not complete its device-risk assessment.

zh-CN.description: IDWise Device Intel Shield 检查设备完整性时，会绑定此隔离服务来检测 Magisk 或 Zygisk 等 root 工具；该检查在独立后台进程中运行，不显示页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Shield 将失去这项 root 检测，设备风险评估可能无法完成。

en.description: When IDWise Device Intel Shield challenges the user, this dialog presents a text code or simple math problem and sends the pass or fail result back to Shield.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot complete Shield's challenge, so the protected flow may stop at that step.

zh-CN.description: IDWise Device Intel Shield 向用户发起挑战时，此对话框会显示文字验证码或简单算术题，并把通过或失败结果返回给 Shield。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法完成 Shield 挑战，受保护的流程可能会停在此步骤。

en.description: When IDWise Device Intel Shield blocks an operation, this dialog displays the supplied title and explanation and stays open until Shield or the app closes it.
en.disableEffect: Users may not see why the operation was blocked, and the Shield flow may fail when it expects this dialog.

zh-CN.description: IDWise Device Intel Shield 阻止某项操作时，此对话框会显示传入的标题和说明，并保持打开，直到 Shield 或应用将其关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户可能看不到操作被阻止的原因，而依赖此对话框的 Shield 流程也可能失败。

en.description: Radware Bot Manager opens this screen when its checks block an app request; it explains the block, shows a transaction reference, offers a support email action, and exits the app if the user presses Back.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, users may lose the explanation and support path when blocked, and the protected app flow may fail.

zh-CN.description: Radware Bot Manager 在检测并拦截应用请求时打开此页面，显示拦截说明和事务编号，并提供联系支持的邮件入口；按返回键会退出应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户遭拦截时可能看不到说明或支持入口，受保护的应用流程也可能无法继续。

en.description: Radware Bot Manager Android Mobile SDK opens this screen when it needs extra verification for a request, showing a waiting animation and the request transaction ID until validation ends.
en.disableEffect: Requests waiting for this check may not complete, so protected sign-in or other server actions can be refused.

zh-CN.description: Radware Bot Manager Android 移动 SDK 在需要额外验证请求时打开此页面，显示等待动画和请求的事务编号，直到验证完成。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要此验证的请求可能无法完成，受保护的登录或其他服务器操作也可能被拒绝。

en.description: When Radware Bot Manager requires a user check, this screen presents the configured text, checkbox, or reCAPTCHA challenge and sends the answer for verification.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to complete the verification required to resume the protected app flow.

zh-CN.description: Radware Bot Manager 要求用户验证时，此页面会显示配置的文字验证码、勾选验证或 reCAPTCHA，并提交答案进行核验。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法完成恢复受保护应用流程所需的验证。

en.description: When a Shift4 card checkout requires extra verification, this Activity opens the 3-D Secure step and returns the verification result to checkout.
en.disableEffect: Shift4 card payments that require this verification cannot complete.

zh-CN.description: Shift4 卡片付款需要额外验证时，此界面会打开 3-D Secure 验证步骤，并把结果交回付款流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要此项验证的 Shift4 卡片付款无法完成。

en.description: Shift4 launches this transparent Activity to display its checkout dialog over the merchant screen; when it closes, it returns the checkout result.
en.disableEffect: The Shift4 checkout dialog cannot open or return its result, interrupting payment.

zh-CN.description: Shift4 会通过此透明界面显示结账弹窗；弹窗关闭后，它会把结账结果交回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Shift4 结账弹窗无法打开或返回结果，付款流程会中断。

en.description: When a Shift4 3-D Secure transaction needs a bank challenge, this Activity shows the challenge form and returns the customer's response to the payment flow.
en.disableEffect: Customers cannot complete card payments that require this Shift4 challenge.

zh-CN.description: Shift4 3-D Secure 交易需要银行验证时，此界面会显示验证表单，并把客户提交的结果交回付款流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 客户无法通过此 Shift4 流程完成需要银行验证的卡片付款。

en.description: SHYS's barcode library opens a camera scanner for QR codes and barcodes, also allows manual entry, and returns the selected code to the calling screen.
en.disableEffect: Apps using this screen for QR/barcode scanning or manual code entry lose that flow.

zh-CN.description: SHYS 条码库会打开相机扫描二维码和条码，也允许手动输入，并将所选代码返回调用页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此页面扫描二维码、条码或手动输入代码的流程将无法使用。

en.description: SHYS's photo-selection library uses this translucent activity as its image picker; users select photos and return their selection to the app.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot complete photo selection through this picker, affecting flows that ask users to choose or attach images.

zh-CN.description: SHYS 图片选择库会将此透明页面用作图片选择器；用户选择照片后，所选图片会返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法通过此选择器完成选图，依赖选图或添加图片的流程会受影响。

en.description: SHYS's Jiguang JPush module receives notification-arrival, notification-open, and registration-result callbacks and forwards them to the app's push handling.
en.disableEffect: JPush notifications and their tap or registration callbacks stop reaching the app through this module.

zh-CN.description: SHYS 的极光 JPush 模块会接收通知到达、通知打开和注册结果回调，并转交应用的推送处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法通过此模块接收 JPush 通知及其点击或注册回调。

en.description: SHYS's Jiguang JPush module declares this common push service in a separate process for background message delivery.
en.disableEffect: Background JPush delivery through the SHYS push module stops.

zh-CN.description: SHYS 的极光 JPush 模块会在独立进程中声明此通用推送服务，用于后台消息传递。
zh-CN.disableEffect: SHYS 推送模块的后台 JPush 消息传递将停止。

en.description: SHYS's location-tracking library uses this provider to store coordinates, accuracy, time, and upload status in its local location database.
en.disableEffect: The tracking service cannot read or save queued location records, preventing their background upload.

zh-CN.description: SHYS 定位跟踪库会通过此提供程序在本地数据库中保存坐标、精度、时间和上传状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 跟踪服务将无法读取或保存待上传的位置记录，后台上传也会停止。

en.description: SHYS's location-tracking library runs this foreground service in its own process and uploads queued location records to the configured service.
en.disableEffect: Background location tracking and upload from this library stop.

zh-CN.description: SHYS 定位跟踪库会在独立进程中运行此前台服务，并将待处理的位置记录上传到配置的服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 此库的后台位置跟踪和上传将停止。

en.description: The 2ndLines Download Library calls this receiver after the phone restarts; in the analyzed version it prepares a request for the download service but does not start that service.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it removes this reboot-time event; this version does not restart downloads from this receiver, and normal downloads remain available.

zh-CN.description: 手机重启后，2ndLines 下载库会收到此广播；在分析的版本中，它只准备了发给下载服务的请求，并没有启动该服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后不再收到这次重启广播；此版本的接收器本来就不会据此恢复下载，正常下载仍可使用。

en.description: The 2ndLines Download Library creates its download database and configures background work when Android starts this provider. Adding a download stores it in the queue and schedules a worker to fetch it.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it can prevent downloads that use this library from being queued or tracked.

zh-CN.description: Android 启动此内容提供程序时，2ndLines 下载库会创建下载数据库并配置后台任务。添加下载后，任务会进入队列并安排后台工作程序获取文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，使用此库的下载可能无法加入队列或跟踪进度。

en.description: The 2ndLines Download Library binds this service when the app requests its download or upload manager. It provides those managers, watches download records, and refreshes notifications as work runs.
en.disableEffect: Downloads or uploads using this library may fail to start, and their progress notifications will stop.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求 2ndLines 下载库的下载或上传管理器时，会绑定此服务。它提供相应管理器、监视下载记录，并在任务运行时更新通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此库的下载或上传可能无法启动，进度通知也会停止更新。

en.description: Shopify Testify uses this host Activity during Compose screenshot tests; it provides an empty screen where the test renders the composable being captured.
en.disableEffect: Compose screenshot tests that use Testify cannot run, but the app's normal screens are unaffected.

zh-CN.description: Shopify Testify 在 Compose 截图测试中使用此界面，为测试渲染待截图的 Compose 内容提供空白页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用 Testify 的 Compose 截图测试无法运行，但应用的正常界面不受影响。

en.description: The Shopiroller UI kit opens the store category screen when shoppers browse the catalog; it shows categories and subcategories or the products in a selected category.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it removes category browsing and category-based product lists.

zh-CN.description: Shopiroller UI kit 的类别页面会在用户浏览商品目录时显示类别和子类别，或展示所选类别下的商品。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法浏览商品类别，也无法通过类别查看商品列表。

en.description: The Shopiroller UI kit opens product filters for a search, category, or showcase list so shoppers can narrow the displayed products.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it removes the product filtering screen.

zh-CN.description: Shopiroller UI kit 会为搜索结果、类别列表或精选专题商品列表打开筛选页面，供用户缩小商品范围。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法打开商品筛选页面。

en.description: The Shopiroller UI kit opens the secure payment step during checkout, displays the supplied 3-D Secure verification page, and returns its success or failure to checkout.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it can prevent a card payment that requires 3-D Secure verification from completing.

zh-CN.description: Shopiroller UI kit 会在结账时打开安全支付步骤，显示提供的 3-D Secure 验证页面，并将成功或失败结果交还结账流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，需要 3-D Secure 验证的银行卡支付可能无法完成。

en.description: The Shopiroller UI kit opens an order’s details when a shopper selects it, showing its status, products, addresses, payment method, tracking details, and totals.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents shoppers from reviewing order details.

zh-CN.description: Shopiroller UI kit 会在用户选择订单时显示订单详情，包括状态、商品、地址、支付方式、物流信息和金额。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法查看订单详情。

en.description: The Shopiroller UI kit guides shoppers through delivery details, payment, order summary, and the final result; it launches the selected online payment flow when needed.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents shoppers from completing checkout and placing orders.

zh-CN.description: Shopiroller UI kit 会引导用户填写配送信息、选择支付方式、确认订单摘要并查看结果；需要时会打开相应的在线支付流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法完成结账和下单。

en.description: During Shopiroller PayPal checkout, this Activity opens PayPal for the order, submits the returned payment approval to the store, and sends success or failure back to the caller.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot complete purchases through its PayPal payment option.

zh-CN.description: Shopiroller 的 PayPal 结账会打开此界面处理订单付款，提交 PayPal 返回的授权信息，并把成功或失败结果交回调用方。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用无法通过 PayPal 付款选项完成订单。

en.description: The Shopiroller UI kit opens a page from product details to display the full formatted product description, including images.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents shoppers from opening the full product description.

zh-CN.description: Shopiroller UI kit 会从商品详情页打开单独页面，展示完整排版的商品说明，包括图片。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法打开完整的商品说明。

en.description: The Shopiroller UI kit opens a product page from the catalog and shows its images, options, stock, price, quantity controls, and add-to-cart control.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents shoppers from viewing product details and adding the product to their cart.

zh-CN.description: Shopiroller UI kit 会从商品目录打开商品页面，展示图片、选项、库存和价格，并提供数量及加入购物车的控件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法查看商品详情或将商品加入购物车。

en.description: The Shopiroller UI kit opens the store’s product search; after a query is submitted it refreshes matching products and saves search suggestions.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it removes product search from the store.

zh-CN.description: Shopiroller UI kit 会打开店铺的商品搜索页面；用户提交查询后，页面会刷新匹配商品并保存搜索建议。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，店铺将无法使用商品搜索。

en.description: The Shopiroller UI kit shows cart items, prices, and totals; shoppers can update quantities, remove items, use a coupon, or continue to checkout.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it removes the cart, coupon controls, and its checkout entry point.

zh-CN.description: Shopiroller UI kit 会显示购物车商品、价格和总额；用户可以修改数量、移除商品、使用优惠券或继续结账。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，购物车、优惠券控件和从购物车进入结账的入口都将无法使用。

en.description: The Shopiroller UI kit opens the products for a selected showcase and displays them in a browsable list.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents shoppers from opening showcase product lists.

zh-CN.description: Shopiroller UI kit 会打开用户选中的精选专题，并以列表形式展示其中的商品。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法打开精选专题的商品列表。

en.description: The Shopiroller UI kit retrieves and displays the signed-in shopper’s order history, with an empty state when no orders are returned.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents shoppers from viewing their order history.

zh-CN.description: Shopiroller UI kit 会获取并显示已登录用户的订单历史；没有订单时会显示空状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法查看自己的订单历史。

en.description: The Shopiroller UI kit opens the player when a product video is selected and plays supported online video streams.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents product videos from opening and playing.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择商品视频时，Shopiroller UI kit 会打开播放器并播放受支持的在线视频流。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，商品视频将无法打开或播放。

en.description: Tapasya99’s ToastLibrary includes a Huawei Push Kit service that receives push messages and new registration tokens, passing refreshed tokens to the library’s token helper.
en.disableEffect: Huawei push messages and token refreshes handled by this integration will stop reaching the app.

zh-CN.description: Tapasya99 的 ToastLibrary 包含 Huawei Push Kit 服务，用于接收推送消息和新的注册令牌，并将更新后的令牌交给库内的令牌处理器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，该集成处理的华为推送消息和令牌更新将无法送达应用。

en.description: ShuftiPro’s identity verification SDK registers this file provider for verification images saved in the app’s Pictures folder; its onsite flow configures the matching provider address.
en.disableEffect: ShuftiPro verification may fail when it needs to pass a saved image to the verification page.

zh-CN.description: ShuftiPro 身份核验 SDK 为保存在应用 Pictures 文件夹中的核验图片注册了文件共享入口；其现场核验流程也配置了对应的共享地址。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 核验流程需要将已保存的图片交给核验页面时，停用后可能会失败。

en.description: ShuftiPro’s identity verification SDK opens this screen for its native verification flow. It guides users through required document or camera proof and reports the verification result to the app.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from completing the native ShuftiPro verification flow.

zh-CN.description: ShuftiPro 身份核验 SDK 会在原生核验流程中打开此页面，引导用户提交所需证件或拍摄证明材料，并将核验结果返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法完成 ShuftiPro 原生核验流程。

en.description: ShuftiPro’s identity verification SDK opens this screen for its onsite flow, requests a verification session, then displays the returned verification page and reports its result to the app.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from completing the ShuftiPro onsite verification flow.

zh-CN.description: ShuftiPro 身份核验 SDK 会在现场核验流程中请求核验会话，随后显示返回的核验页面，并将结果交还应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法完成 ShuftiPro 现场核验流程。

en.description: When a user chooses a starting point or destination in the SmartSoft Asia Siam Piwat MappedIn indoor map, this Activity searches and lists mall stores and sets the selected store as the route origin or destination.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot search for or choose a store as a route endpoint, so indoor directions that use store selection stop working.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 SmartSoft Asia 的 Siam Piwat MappedIn 室内地图中选择起点或目的地时，此 Activity 会搜索并列出商店，并将所选商店设为路线起点或终点。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法搜索或选择商店作为路线端点，因此依赖商店选择的室内导航无法使用。

en.description: Sigmob Wind uses this file provider to expose configured SDK files as content links for ad file-sharing and install flows.
en.disableEffect: Sigmob ad downloads or installs that need these file links may fail.

zh-CN.description: Sigmob Wind 通过此文件提供器将配置的 SDK 文件开放为内容链接，供广告文件分享和安装流程使用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖这些文件链接的 Sigmob 广告下载或安装可能失败。

en.description: The Sigmob Ads SDK opens this Activity so users can view and manage personal-information settings.
en.disableEffect: Users will lose access to Sigmob personal-information query and management controls.

zh-CN.description: Sigmob Ads SDK 会打开此 Activity，供用户查看和管理个人信息设置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法访问 Sigmob 个人信息查询和管理界面。

en.description: The Sigmob Ads SDK opens this Activity to display a full-screen ad selected for the current ad request.
en.disableEffect: Sigmob full-screen ads will not open, and rewards for watching rewarded ads will no longer be granted.

zh-CN.description: Sigmob Ads SDK 会打开此 Activity，展示当前广告请求选择的全屏广告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Sigmob 全屏广告将无法打开，观看激励广告也不再发放奖励。

en.description: The Sigmob Ads SDK opens this landscape Activity to host full-screen ad content.
en.disableEffect: Sigmob full-screen ads in this screen format will not open, and rewards for watching rewarded ads will no longer be granted.

zh-CN.description: Sigmob Ads SDK 会打开此横屏 Activity，承载全屏广告内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 此显示形式的 Sigmob 全屏广告将无法打开，观看激励广告也不再发放奖励。

en.description: The Sigmob Ads SDK opens this landscape transparent Activity to host full-screen ad content.
en.disableEffect: Sigmob full-screen ads in this screen format will not open, and rewards for watching rewarded ads will no longer be granted.

zh-CN.description: Sigmob Ads SDK 会打开此横屏透明 Activity，承载全屏广告内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 此显示形式的 Sigmob 全屏广告将无法打开，观看激励广告也不再发放奖励。

en.description: The Sigmob Ads SDK opens this portrait Activity to host full-screen ad content.
en.disableEffect: Sigmob full-screen ads in this screen format will not open, and rewards for watching rewarded ads will no longer be granted.

zh-CN.description: Sigmob Ads SDK 会打开此竖屏 Activity，承载全屏广告内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 此显示形式的 Sigmob 全屏广告将无法打开，观看激励广告也不再发放奖励。

en.description: The Sigmob Ads SDK opens this portrait transparent Activity to host full-screen ad content.
en.disableEffect: Sigmob full-screen ads in this screen format will not open, and rewards for watching rewarded ads will no longer be granted.

zh-CN.description: Sigmob Ads SDK 会打开此竖屏透明 Activity，承载全屏广告内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 此显示形式的 Sigmob 全屏广告将无法打开，观看激励广告也不再发放奖励。

en.description: The Sigmob Ads SDK opens this transparent Activity to host full-screen ad content.
en.disableEffect: Sigmob full-screen ads in this screen format will not open, and rewards for watching rewarded ads will no longer be granted.

zh-CN.description: Sigmob Ads SDK 会打开此透明 Activity，承载全屏广告内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 此显示形式的 Sigmob 全屏广告将无法打开，观看激励广告也不再发放奖励。

en.description: The Sigmob Ads SDK opens this Activity to present a quick rewarded-video ad.
en.disableEffect: Sigmob rewarded videos will not play, and rewards for watching ads will no longer be granted.

zh-CN.description: Sigmob Ads SDK 会打开此 Activity 播放快速激励视频广告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Sigmob 激励视频将无法播放，观看广告也不再发放奖励。

en.description: SignNow’s Android SDK opens its authorization page when the app begins account authorization and handles the user’s return to the app.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents SignNow authorization from completing through the SDK.

zh-CN.description: 应用开始 SignNow 账户授权时，SignNow Android SDK 会打开授权页面，并处理用户返回应用的结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，SignNow SDK 将无法完成账户授权。

en.description: SignNow’s Android SDK opens a document signing session using the supplied signing links and returns a result when the user signs, declines, or closes it.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from completing SignNow document signing sessions in the app.

zh-CN.description: SignNow Android SDK 会使用提供的签署链接打开文档签署流程，并在用户签署、拒绝或关闭流程时返回结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法在应用中完成 SignNow 文档签署流程。

en.description: Simperium’s Android library opens this account screen for sign-in or account creation, validates the email and password, and sends the request to Simperium.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to sign in or create a Simperium account through the app.

zh-CN.description: Simperium Android 库会在登录或创建账户时打开此页面，检查邮箱和密码并向 Simperium 提交请求。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法通过应用登录或创建 Simperium 账户。

en.description: SimpleCodeMaker LocalX5 starts this provider with the app to prepare what its bundled Tencent X5 web engine needs. LocalX5 uses it to check, install, and initialize the local engine when the app opens a web view that uses LocalX5.
en.disableEffect: LocalX5 may fail to initialize its local X5 web engine because its startup setup is missing.

zh-CN.description: SimpleCodeMaker LocalX5 会在应用启动时运行此 Provider，为其内置的腾讯 X5 网页引擎做准备。应用打开使用 LocalX5 的网页页面时，该库会借此检查、安装并初始化本地引擎。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，LocalX5 可能因启动准备缺失而无法初始化本地 X5 网页引擎。

en.description: The Sina Weibo Android SDK uses this screen for web-based authorization and sharing. It loads the requested Weibo page and returns the result to the app.
en.disableEffect: Weibo authorization and web-based sharing in integrations that use this SDK will fail to open or complete.

zh-CN.description: 新浪微博 Android SDK 会在网页授权或分享时使用此页面，加载指定的微博页面并将结果返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此 SDK 的集成将无法打开或完成微博授权及网页分享。

en.description: The Sina Weibo Android SDK declares this private file provider, and YYXX Game's common-share SDK bundles the same class. Its configured paths let sharing flows pass local image or attachment files to another app.
en.disableEffect: Weibo or YYXX sharing that attaches local files may fail because those files can no longer be handed to the receiving app.

zh-CN.description: Sina Weibo Android SDK 声明了此私有文件提供器，YYXX Game 的通用分享 SDK 也打包了同一个类。它按配置的路径让分享流程将本地图片或附件交给其他应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Weibo 或 YYXX 分享本地文件时可能失败，因为这些文件无法再提供给接收应用。

en.description: The Sina Weibo SDK file provider is opened when Weibo reads a file shared from the app. It serves files from the app-specific external files and cache folders for image or video sharing.
en.disableEffect: Weibo will not be able to read photos or videos shared through this provider, so those media-sharing attempts can fail.

zh-CN.description: 当微博读取应用传出的共享文件时，会访问新浪微博 SDK 提供的这个文件入口。它可让微博读取应用专属外部文件目录和缓存目录中的文件，用于分享图片或视频。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 微博无法读取通过此入口分享的图片或视频，这类分享可能失败。

en.description: The Sina Weibo Android SDK declares this private file provider for shareable files; it serves files under the configured paths to apps receiving a share.
en.disableEffect: Weibo sharing that attaches local files may fail because receiving apps can no longer open those files through the provider.

zh-CN.description: Sina Weibo Android SDK 为可分享文件声明了此私有文件提供器；它会向接收分享的应用提供配置路径下的文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Weibo 分享本地文件时可能失败，因为接收应用无法再通过此提供器打开这些文件。

en.description: The Sina Weibo Open SDK turns prepared content into a share card and opens Weibo to send it to a chat.
en.disableEffect: The app may no longer be able to share content to Weibo chats.

zh-CN.description: Sina Weibo Open SDK 会将准备好的内容整理成分享卡片，并打开微博发送到聊天。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用可能无法将内容分享到微博聊天。

en.description: The Sina Weibo Open SDK routes incoming share requests to the standard share screen or the story publisher based on the request type.
en.disableEffect: Weibo share requests may not reach the standard share screen or the story publisher.

zh-CN.description: Sina Weibo Open SDK 会根据请求类型，将收到的分享请求转到普通分享页面或故事发布页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，微博分享请求可能无法到达普通分享页面或故事发布页面。

en.description: The Sina Weibo Open SDK prepares story media and opens Weibo's story publisher, then returns success, cancellation, or an error.
en.disableEffect: The app's Weibo story-sharing flow may not complete.

zh-CN.description: Sina Weibo Open SDK 会准备故事内容并打开微博故事发布页面，然后返回成功、取消或错误结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用的微博故事分享流程可能无法完成。

en.description: The Sina Weibo Open SDK prepares text, images, video, or link content and hands it to Weibo's share composer.
en.disableEffect: The app may no longer be able to share text, photos, videos, or links to Weibo.

zh-CN.description: Sina Weibo Open SDK 会准备文字、图片、视频或链接内容，并交给微博分享编辑页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用可能无法向微博分享文字、照片、视频或链接。

en.description: The Sina Weibo SDK routes an incoming share request to the appropriate Weibo post or Story screen and handles the return from that sharing flow.
en.disableEffect: Sharing through Sina Weibo may fail or may not return its result to the app.

zh-CN.description: Sina Weibo SDK 会将收到的分享请求转到相应的微博发布或 Story 页面，并处理分享流程返回结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，通过 Sina Weibo 分享可能失败，分享结果也可能无法返回应用。

en.description: The Sina Weibo Open SDK prepares story photos or videos, opens Weibo's story publisher, and returns the result to the app.
en.disableEffect: The app's Weibo story-sharing flow may not complete.

zh-CN.description: Sina Weibo Open SDK 会准备故事照片或视频，打开微博故事发布页面，并将结果返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用的微博故事分享流程可能无法完成。

en.description: When the app starts sharing to Sina Weibo, this screen prepares text, images, or video, opens the Weibo composer or web share page, and returns the result.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot finish its Sina Weibo sharing flow.

zh-CN.description: 应用发起新浪微博分享时，此界面会准备文字、图片或视频，打开微博编辑页面或网页分享页，并返回分享结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法完成新浪微博分享流程。

en.description: The Sina Weibo Open SDK shows its in-app web page for Weibo login or sharing and handles the authorization or share response.
en.disableEffect: Weibo's in-app login and web-based sharing flows may fail.

zh-CN.description: Sina Weibo Open SDK 会显示微博登录或分享的应用内网页，并处理授权或分享响应。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，微博的应用内登录和网页分享流程可能失败。

en.description: Sina Weibo's SDK uses this in-app browser for its web-based sharing and sign-in pages, then returns the result to the app.
en.disableEffect: The app's web-based Sina Weibo sign-in and sharing flows will not complete.

zh-CN.description: 新浪微博 SDK 会在应用内浏览器中显示网页分享或登录页面，并将结果返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用中的新浪微博网页登录和分享流程将无法完成。

en.description: Adappter AP SDK opens the user's egg bag and loads egg inventory and seasonal reward information. Tapping an egg starts its opening or upgrade flow.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot view or manage AP eggs and their related seasonal rewards through this screen.

zh-CN.description: Adappter AP SDK 会打开用户的蛋袋并加载蛋和赛季奖励信息；点击蛋会进入开启或升级流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法通过此页面查看或管理 AP 蛋及相关赛季奖励。

en.description: Adappter AP SDK uses this screen for a custom interstitial ad. It selects configured ad content, displays it, and handles the ad's close or click flow.
en.disableEffect: Adappter AP custom interstitial ads will not display; the app's other screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: Adappter AP SDK 使用此页面展示自定义插屏广告；页面会从已配置的广告内容中选择素材，并处理关闭或点击流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后不会显示 Adappter AP 的自定义插屏广告，应用的其他页面仍可使用。

en.description: Adappter AP's egg-capacity dialog reads which no-space case was passed to it and shows the matching message with cancel and confirmation actions.
en.disableEffect: The AP no-space prompt and its confirmation actions are unavailable.

zh-CN.description: Adappter AP 的蛋袋容量提示会读取传入的无空位情况，并显示对应信息和取消、确认操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，AP 的无空位提示及其确认操作无法使用。

en.description: Adappter AP shows the credited point amount for a season round and offers a route to the season-ticket screen.
en.disableEffect: The AP point confirmation and season-ticket entry screen will be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: Adappter AP 会显示某个赛季轮次获得的积分，并提供进入赛季票页面的入口。
zh-CN.disableEffect: AP 积分确认和赛季票入口页面将无法使用。

en.description: Adappter AP opens a guided egg-upgrade screen after a user selects an egg to evolve. It presents the item's point amount and step-by-step choices, then returns to the egg bag.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot complete the AP egg-evolution flow when this screen is disabled.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择要进化的蛋后，Adappter AP 会打开分步操作页面；页面显示该物品的积分并提供进化选项，完成后返回蛋袋。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，用户无法完成 AP 蛋的进化流程。

en.description: Adappter AP opens this reward screen after a user selects an egg. It shows the egg's points and offers an ad for a higher reward multiplier before confirmation.
en.disableEffect: The ad-based AP egg reward flow will stop; rewards for watching ads in this flow will no longer be granted.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择蛋后，Adappter AP 会打开奖励页面，显示蛋的积分，并提供观看广告提高奖励倍数的选项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，AP 蛋的广告奖励流程会停止；用户将无法获得此流程中观看广告对应的奖励。

en.description: Adappter AP opens this guide from the egg bag to display information about the seasonal egg program. The page has a close action.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open the AP season guide from the egg bag when this screen is disabled.

zh-CN.description: 用户可从蛋袋打开 Adappter AP 的赛季说明页面，查看赛季蛋活动信息并关闭页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，用户无法从蛋袋打开 AP 赛季说明页面。

en.description: Adappter AP opens this screen from the point confirmation flow to show the season round and ask the user to confirm.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open the AP season-ticket confirmation screen when this Activity is disabled.

zh-CN.description: Adappter AP 会在积分确认流程中打开此页面，显示赛季轮次并让用户确认。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，用户无法打开 AP 赛季票确认页面。

en.description: Adappter AP SDK opens the user's egg bag and loads egg inventory, seasonal points, and ranking information. Tapping an egg starts its opening or evolution flow.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot view or manage AP eggs, points, and seasonal rewards through this screen.

zh-CN.description: Adappter AP SDK 会打开用户的蛋袋并加载蛋、赛季积分和排名信息；点击蛋会进入开启或进化流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法通过此页面查看或管理 AP 蛋、积分和赛季奖励。

en.description: When a user opens a Sherlock crash notification, Sherlock (Ajit Singh) shows where the app failed, what went wrong, and device and app details. The report can also be shared from here.
en.disableEffect: Disabling this screen removes Sherlock crash details and report sharing; normal app features continue to work.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 Sherlock 崩溃通知后，Ajit Singh 的 Sherlock 会显示崩溃位置、原因以及设备和应用信息，也可在此分享报告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后将无法在 Sherlock 中查看或分享崩溃报告，但应用的日常功能不受影响。

en.description: The full Sherlock crash reporter uses this screen to list saved crashes and open their details. Versions without crash reporting show a blank screen.
en.disableEffect: Blocking it removes access to the saved crash history in Sherlock; normal app screens continue to work.

zh-CN.description: 完整的 Sherlock 崩溃报告功能会在此页面列出已保存的崩溃并打开详情；不含崩溃报告功能的版本会显示空白页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后将无法查看 Sherlock 保存的崩溃记录，但应用的日常页面仍可使用。

en.description: When someone changes call audio settings, the NXCloud SIP calling SDK opens this page. Users can choose whether each voice format is used only on Wi-Fi, on Wi-Fi and mobile data, always tried, or never used, and change the order in which formats are tried.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to change when each voice format can be used or its priority for calls.

zh-CN.description: 用户调整通话音频设置时，NXCloud SIP 通话 SDK 会打开此页面。用户可为各语音格式选择仅 Wi-Fi、Wi-Fi 和移动数据、始终尝试或从不使用，并调整优先顺序。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法更改各语音格式的网络使用条件或通话优先顺序。

en.description: The NXCloud SIP calling SDK opens this dialer screen when its calling interface is launched. It provides a keypad and recent SIP numbers, and links to account setup and call settings.
en.disableEffect: Users will lose this SDK dialer and will not be able to start calls from it.

zh-CN.description: NXCloud SIP 通话 SDK 在打开其拨号界面时显示此页面，提供拨号键盘和近期 SIP 号码，并可进入账号设置与通话设置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法使用此 SDK 拨号界面，也无法从这里发起通话。

en.description: The NXCloud SIP calling SDK opens this short-lived activity to show the full call screen, then closes it. It is used when a call moves into the in-call interface.
en.disableEffect: The SDK may not be able to open its in-call screen, removing the controls needed to manage a call.

zh-CN.description: NXCloud SIP 通话 SDK 会短暂打开此界面以显示完整通话页面，随后立即关闭；通话切换到通话中界面时会用到它。
zh-CN.disableEffect: SDK 可能无法打开通话页面，用户会失去管理通话所需的控件。

en.description: When the user changes auto-answer in the NXCloud SIP calling SDK, this screen toggles the setting, saves and restores the ring volume, and refreshes the call status.
en.disableEffect: The SDK's auto-answer setting and its related ring-volume handling will not work correctly.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 NXCloud SIP 通话 SDK 中切换自动接听时，此界面会更新设置、保存并恢复铃声音量，并刷新通话状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: SDK 的自动接听设置及相关铃声音量处理将无法正常工作。

en.description: When Android reports an outgoing phone call, the NXCloud SIP calling SDK checks the selected call mode and may route the number through internet calling instead of the phone network. It also handles answer or reject actions during an active call when Bluetooth audio is available.
en.disableEffect: Outgoing calls will no longer be intercepted for the SDK's internet-call routing or its related active-call handling.

zh-CN.description: Android 通知有外拨电话时，NXCloud SIP 通话 SDK 会根据所选模式判断是否改用网络通话，而不是电话网络；蓝牙音频可用时，它也会处理当前通话的接听或拒接操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 外拨电话将不再经过 SDK 的网络通话路由，相关的当前通话处理也会失效。

en.description: When the user switches accounts in the NXCloud SIP calling SDK, this activity selects the other saved account and registers it with the calling service.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to switch the SDK to another saved calling account.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 NXCloud SIP 通话 SDK 中切换账号时，此界面会选中另一个已保存的账号，并向通话服务重新注册。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法把 SDK 切换到另一个已保存的通话账号。

en.description: During an NXCloud SIP call, this screen shows the caller, call status, and in-call keypad, and provides answer, reject, hold, and audio controls. It also manages the screen and proximity sensor while the call is active.
en.disableEffect: Users will lose the SDK's controls for answering, rejecting, and managing active calls.

zh-CN.description: NXCloud SIP 通话期间，此页面显示联系人、通话状态和通话键盘，并提供接听、拒接、保持及音频控制；通话时还会管理屏幕和距离传感器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将失去 SDK 中接听、拒接和管理当前通话的控件。

en.description: The NXCloud SIP calling SDK opens this sign-in screen when a saved session is unavailable or the user must log in. It collects the account details and opens the calling screen after a successful sign-in.
en.disableEffect: Users who need to sign in will not be able to access the SDK's calling screen.

zh-CN.description: 没有可用的已保存会话或需要登录时，NXCloud SIP 通话 SDK 会打开此登录页面；用户登录成功后，页面会进入通话界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要登录的用户将无法进入 SDK 的通话界面。

en.description: When the NXCloud SIP calling SDK's scheduled keep-alive alarm fires for a registered account, this receiver sends a network-call keep-alive and schedules the next check.
en.disableEffect: An idle account may lose its registration, so incoming internet calls may stop arriving.

zh-CN.description: NXCloud SIP 通话 SDK 为已注册账号安排的保活提醒触发时，此接收器会发送网络通话保活消息并安排下一次检查。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 闲置账号可能失去注册状态，导致无法继续接收网络来电。

en.description: When Android supplies a periodic network-based location update, the NXCloud SIP calling SDK passes the location to its configured reporting service if location reporting is enabled.
en.disableEffect: Periodic network-based location updates will stop, while ordinary voice calling remains available.

zh-CN.description: Android 提供周期性网络定位结果时，如果已启用位置上报，NXCloud SIP 通话 SDK 会将位置发送到配置的上报服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 周期性网络定位上报会停止，但普通语音通话仍可使用。

en.description: The NXCloud SIP calling SDK opens this main screen with tabs for dialing, call records, and settings. It can also pass a requested phone number into the calling interface.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to reach the SDK's dialer, call records, or settings from its main screen.

zh-CN.description: NXCloud SIP 通话 SDK 的主页面包含拨号、通话记录和设置标签，也可将指定号码传入通话界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 SDK 主页面进入拨号界面、通话记录或设置。

en.description: When a SIP account's registration-renewal alarm fires, the NXCloud SIP calling SDK asks its calling engine to refresh the account registration.
en.disableEffect: Account registration may expire without renewal, interrupting incoming and outgoing internet calls.

zh-CN.description: SIP 账号的注册续期提醒触发时，NXCloud SIP 通话 SDK 会要求通话引擎刷新账号注册状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 账号注册可能因未续期而过期，中断网络来电和外拨通话。

en.description: When the NXCloud SIP calling SDK's periodic service check runs, this receiver starts or stops its foreground registration service according to the user's allowed network settings.
en.disableEffect: The SDK may stop maintaining its background registration service, making incoming calls less reliable.

zh-CN.description: NXCloud SIP 通话 SDK 的周期性服务检查运行时，此接收器会根据用户允许的网络设置启动或停止前台注册服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: SDK 可能无法继续维护后台注册服务，导致接收来电不稳定。

en.description: When a one-time GPS location result or timeout arrives, the NXCloud SIP calling SDK stops that location request and sends any available coordinates and accuracy to its configured reporting service.
en.disableEffect: One-time GPS location reports will stop, while ordinary voice calling remains available.

zh-CN.description: 一次性 GPS 定位结果或超时通知到达时，NXCloud SIP 通话 SDK 会结束该定位请求，并将可用的坐标和精度发送到配置的上报服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 一次性 GPS 位置上报会停止，但普通语音通话仍可使用。

en.description: When the NXCloud SIP calling SDK's scheduled Wi-Fi check runs and automatic Wi-Fi management is enabled, this receiver turns Wi-Fi off while no call is active.
en.disableEffect: The SDK will stop applying its automatic Wi-Fi setting, which may change power use and the network available for later calls.

zh-CN.description: NXCloud SIP 通话 SDK 的定时 Wi-Fi 检查运行且已启用自动管理时，如果当前没有通话，此接收器会关闭 Wi-Fi。
zh-CN.disableEffect: SDK 将不再应用自动 Wi-Fi 设置，可能改变耗电情况和之后通话可用的网络。

en.description: When a phone link is routed to it, the NXCloud SIP calling SDK forwards the number to Android's regular phone-call screen and closes this activity.
en.disableEffect: Phone links routed through the SDK will no longer open its regular phone-call path.

zh-CN.description: 电话链接交由此页面处理时，NXCloud SIP 通话 SDK 会把号码转交给 Android 的普通电话通话界面，然后关闭此页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 经 SDK 路由的电话链接将无法再打开普通电话通话流程。

en.description: This NXCloud SIP calling SDK receiver handles the app's start and stop calling commands. Starting registers the configured accounts; stopping shuts down the calling engine and registration service.
en.disableEffect: The app will not be able to use these commands to start or stop SIP calling and registration.

zh-CN.description: 此 NXCloud SIP 通话 SDK 接收器处理应用发出的启动和停止通话指令；启动时注册已配置的账号，停止时关闭通话引擎和注册服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法通过这些指令启动或停止 SIP 通话及账号注册。

en.description: When Android reports that the device has started or that the app was updated or became available again, the NXCloud SIP calling SDK refreshes its account registrations.
en.disableEffect: Calling accounts may not register after a restart or app update, so internet calls may stop working.

zh-CN.description: 设备启动、应用更新或应用重新可用时，NXCloud SIP 通话 SDK 会刷新账号注册状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 设备重启或应用更新后，通话账号可能无法注册，导致网络通话无法使用。

en.description: The NXCloud SIP calling SDK starts this foreground service to support background calling and account registration. It displays an ongoing notification and schedules periodic checks of the registration service.
en.disableEffect: Background registration support and its periodic service checks will stop, which can make incoming calls unreliable.

zh-CN.description: NXCloud SIP 通话 SDK 会启动此前台服务以支持后台通话和账号注册；它显示常驻通知并定期检查注册服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 后台注册支持及周期性服务检查会停止，导致接收来电不稳定。

en.description: When a send-to phone link reaches it, the NXCloud SIP calling SDK routes the address according to the user's call preference, using internet calling for SIP addresses or Android's phone app for telephone numbers.
en.disableEffect: Phone and SIP links routed through this activity will no longer start the selected type of call.

zh-CN.description: 发送到电话链接交由此页面处理时，NXCloud SIP 通话 SDK 会按用户选择的模式路由地址：SIP 地址使用网络通话，电话号码交给 Android 电话应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 经此页面路由的电话或 SIP 链接将无法再发起所选类型的通话。

en.description: When Android opens a SIP, contact, or supported messaging call link, the NXCloud SIP calling SDK turns it into a call target and may ask which number or call type to use before starting the call.
en.disableEffect: External SIP links and contact call actions will no longer start calls through the SDK.

zh-CN.description: Android 打开 SIP、联系人或受支持的消息服务通话链接时，NXCloud SIP 通话 SDK 会将其转换为通话目标；必要时先让用户选择号码或通话类型，再发起通话。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 外部 SIP 链接和联系人通话操作将无法再通过 SDK 发起通话。

en.description: When users open calling settings, this NXCloud SIP page configures accounts, network and registration behavior, audio options, and codec preferences; it also manages saved profiles.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to change the SDK's account, network, audio, or saved-profile settings.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开通话设置时，此 NXCloud SIP 页面可配置账号、网络和注册行为、音频选项及编码偏好，也可管理已保存的配置档案。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法更改 SDK 的账号、网络、音频或已保存配置档案。

en.description: The NXCloud SIP calling SDK opens this dialer and call-history screen to place internet calls, view recent SIP numbers, and reach calling settings. It also checks account registration when the screen opens.
en.disableEffect: Users will lose this SDK calling screen and its direct access to dialing and call settings.

zh-CN.description: NXCloud SIP 通话 SDK 会打开此拨号和通话记录页面，用于发起网络通话、查看近期 SIP 号码并进入通话设置；页面打开时也会检查账号注册状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将失去此 SDK 通话页面，以及从这里直接拨号和进入通话设置的入口。

en.description: The NXCloud SIP calling SDK opens this startup screen before choosing the next page. It sends users with saved automatic sign-in to calling, sends others to sign-in, and preserves an optional call target.
en.disableEffect: The SDK will lose its startup route to sign-in or the main calling screen.

zh-CN.description: NXCloud SIP 通话 SDK 会先打开此启动页面，再决定进入哪个页面；已保存自动登录的用户会进入通话界面，其他用户会进入登录页，并保留可选的通话号码。
zh-CN.disableEffect: SDK 将无法通过此启动流程进入登录页或主通话界面。

en.description: During an NXCloud SIP video call, this screen captures and sends camera video and can play the other caller's video. It also provides video quality and audio controls.
en.disableEffect: Video capture and playback in calls will stop, though audio calling can remain available.

zh-CN.description: NXCloud SIP 视频通话期间，此页面会采集并发送摄像头画面，也可播放对方的视频，并提供画质和音频控制。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通话中的视频采集和播放将停止，但语音通话仍可使用。

en.description: When 6Estates’ Intelligent Document Processing SDK needs a document photo cropped, this screen lets the user adjust the crop and returns the saved image for recognition.
en.disableEffect: Blocking it prevents the document photo from being cropped and returned, so the app’s identity-document flow cannot finish.

zh-CN.description: 6Estates 智能文档处理 SDK 需要裁剪证件照片时，会打开此界面供用户调整范围，并把保存后的图片交给后续识别。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，证件照片无法在此裁剪并返回，应用的证件识别流程将无法完成。

en.description: When the 6Estates IDP library opens this screen for a document photo, the user can adjust the crop and return the saved image for recognition.
en.disableEffect: Blocking it prevents the document photo from being cropped and returned, so the app’s IDP document flow cannot finish.

zh-CN.description: 6Estates 智能文档处理库处理证件照片时，会打开此界面供用户调整裁剪范围，并返回保存后的图片用于识别。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，证件照片无法在此裁剪并返回，应用的证件处理流程将无法完成。

en.description: When the app starts, Skelter Labs AIQ.Aware uses this ContentProvider to save the app context required by its SDK. It does not provide content to users or other apps.
