en.disableEffect: Without it, AIQ.Aware does not receive its startup context, so features that use this SDK cannot initialize through this path.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，Skelter Labs AIQ.Aware 会通过此 ContentProvider 保存 SDK 所需的应用上下文；它不向用户或其他应用提供内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，AIQ.Aware 无法通过此启动入口取得应用上下文，依赖该 SDK 的功能将无法初始化。

en.description: The SK Telecom T ID Login SDK declares this shared screen, whose code only forwards normal Android screen lifecycle events and contains no sign-in interface. The SDK's web and browser login screens are separate activities.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it only prevents code that directly opens this otherwise empty screen; the separate T ID login screens are not hosted here.

zh-CN.description: SK Telecom T ID Login SDK 声明了此共享页面，其代码只转发 Android 页面生命周期事件，不包含登录界面。SDK 的网页和浏览器登录页面由其他活动提供。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，只有直接打开此空页面的代码会受影响；其他 T ID 登录页面并不由此页面承载。

en.description: When a T-ID login link hands sign-in between an app and a webpage, this screen shows the login channel and asks the user to continue or cancel. The SDK returns that choice to the app.
en.disableEffect: Blocking it prevents the T-ID login handoff from being confirmed, so sign-in through that provider cannot complete.

zh-CN.description: T-ID 登录需要在应用与网页之间交接时，此界面会显示登录渠道并询问用户是否继续；SDK 会把选择返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，T-ID 登录交接无法确认，通过该服务进行的登录将无法完成。

en.description: The SK Telecom T ID Login SDK uses this activity to open browser-based sign-in and return the authorization result or cancellation to the app.
en.disableEffect: T ID sign-in through the browser may not complete or return its result.

zh-CN.description: SK Telecom T ID Login SDK 会通过此活动打开浏览器登录，并将授权结果或取消状态返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过浏览器进行的 T ID 登录可能无法完成或返回结果。

en.description: When a T-ID sign-in page reports that there is no network connection, this screen explains the error and lets the user go back or close the attempt.
en.disableEffect: Blocking it removes the sign-in flow’s network-error screen and its expected way to return from the failed attempt.

zh-CN.description: T-ID 登录页面报告没有网络连接时，此界面会显示错误信息，并允许用户返回或关闭本次尝试。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，登录流程无法显示此网络错误界面，也无法按预期从失败页面返回。

en.description: When the T-ID sign-in page receives no response, this screen shows the dedicated no-response message and lets the user return or close the attempt.
en.disableEffect: Blocking it removes the no-response screen expected by the T-ID sign-in flow.

zh-CN.description: T-ID 登录页面没有收到响应时，此界面会显示专门的无响应提示，并允许用户返回或关闭本次尝试。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，T-ID 登录流程无法显示预期的无响应页面。

en.description: For phone-based T-ID web sign-in, this portrait-only screen displays the sign-in page and returns the result or cancellation to the app.
en.disableEffect: Blocking it prevents this T-ID sign-in path from opening the page or returning its result.

zh-CN.description: 手机上的 T-ID 网页登录会使用此竖屏界面显示登录页面，并把结果或取消操作返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，此 T-ID 登录流程无法打开页面或向应用返回结果。

en.description: During T-ID web sign-in, this screen displays the authentication page and returns its result or a user cancellation to the app.
en.disableEffect: Blocking it prevents the T-ID web sign-in flow from completing.

zh-CN.description: T-ID 网页登录期间，此界面会显示身份验证页面，并把登录结果或用户取消操作返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，T-ID 网页登录流程将无法完成。

en.description: The SK Telecom T ID Login SDK routes a supplied web-login link through this activity to its in-app sign-in page.
en.disableEffect: T ID web-based sign-in may not open correctly.

zh-CN.description: SK Telecom T ID Login SDK 会通过此活动将提供的网页登录链接转交给应用内登录页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: T ID 网页登录可能无法正常打开。

en.description: The SK Telecom T ID Login SDK displays the supplied sign-in page in this in-app web screen and handles its login navigation.
en.disableEffect: T ID sign-in pages that use the embedded browser will not work.

zh-CN.description: SK Telecom T ID Login SDK 会在此应用内网页页面显示提供的登录页，并处理登录导航。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用内嵌浏览器的 T ID 登录页面将无法使用。

en.description: When the TMAP Mobility Navigation SDK needs location in the background, this service runs with an ongoing notification and accepts bindings from the navigation SDK.
en.disableEffect: TMAP navigation cannot keep this location service active in the background.

zh-CN.description: TMAP Mobility Navigation SDK 需要在后台保持定位时，此服务会带着持续显示的通知运行，并允许导航 SDK 绑定到它。
zh-CN.disableEffect: TMAP 导航将无法在后台保持此定位服务运行。

en.description: When the package installer reports a TMAP update result, the TMAP Mobility TMAP Core SDK receiver reports failures or, on success, reopens navigation.
en.disableEffect: TMAP will not react to that update result, so navigation will not reopen automatically after installation and update errors may not be shown.

zh-CN.description: Android 安装程序报告 TMAP 更新结果时，TMAP Mobility TMAP Core SDK 的此接收器会在成功后重新打开导航，在失败后报告更新错误。
zh-CN.disableEffect: TMAP 将无法处理该更新结果，因此安装后不会自动重新打开导航，也可能不再显示更新错误。

en.description: At app startup, Skydoves Bindables prepares screen updates so changes in app data can be shown.
en.disableEffect: Screens using Bindables may refresh more of the screen than needed when data changes.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，Skydoves Bindables 会准备屏幕更新流程，让应用数据变化能够显示出来。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 数据变化时，使用 Bindables 的页面可能会刷新超出必要范围的内容。

en.description: When Skydoves Snitcher handles an uncaught app error, this screen displays the saved error details.
en.disableEffect: After an uncaught error, the app may not be able to show Snitcher's error details screen.

zh-CN.description: Skydoves Snitcher 处理未捕获的应用错误时，此页面会显示保存的错误详情。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 发生未捕获错误后，应用可能无法显示 Snitcher 的错误详情页面。

en.description: mParticle's Skyhook location kit connects to Skyhook Wireless when location access is allowed. This service provides location checks and monitoring for campaign locations.
en.disableEffect: Skyhook location lookups and campaign-venue monitoring will stop working.

zh-CN.description: 允许访问位置后，mParticle Skyhook 定位套件会连接 Skyhook Wireless。此 Service 提供位置查询，并监测活动使用的地点。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，Skyhook 的位置查询和活动地点监测将无法工作。

en.description: Android starts this mParticle Skyhook service for scheduled background location work. It reports when each job starts, stops, or finishes so Skyhook can manage that work.
en.disableEffect: Skyhook's scheduled background location tasks may not complete.

zh-CN.description: Android 会为计划中的后台定位任务启动此 mParticle Skyhook Service。它会报告任务的开始、停止和完成状态，以便 Skyhook 管理这些任务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，Skyhook 计划执行的后台定位任务可能无法完成。

en.description: Opened from the Skyjie6 djLib animation examples, this Activity loops a refresh-image animation and demonstrates a changing progress panel.
en.disableEffect: The djLib refresh and progress animation example will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: 从 Skyjie6 djLib 动画示例中打开时，此 Activity 会循环播放刷新图案动画，并展示变化的进度面板。
zh-CN.disableEffect: djLib 的刷新和进度动画示例将无法打开。

en.description: Opened from the Skyjie6 djLib view or animation examples, this Activity demonstrates chat-style text with inline pictures loaded from local resources and the internet.
en.disableEffect: The djLib chat-text example screen will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: 从 Skyjie6 djLib 的视图或动画示例中打开时，此 Activity 会展示带有本地及网络图片的聊天式文本。
zh-CN.disableEffect: djLib 的聊天文本示例界面将无法打开。

en.description: From the djLib sample launcher, this Activity lists animation and popup examples and opens the selected example.
en.disableEffect: Users lose this djLib animation-example menu; the host app's other screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: 从 djLib 示例启动页进入后，此 Activity 会列出动画和弹窗示例，并打开用户选中的示例。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法使用 djLib 的动画示例菜单，但应用的其他界面仍可使用。

en.description: From the djLib sample launcher, this Activity lists a screen-capture example and a web-page example and opens the selected screen.
en.disableEffect: The djLib function-example menu will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: 从 djLib 示例启动页进入后，此 Activity 会列出屏幕捕获和网页示例，并打开用户选中的界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: djLib 的功能示例菜单将无法打开。

en.description: From the djLib sample launcher, this Activity lists examples for rounded images, a verification-code countdown, popups, scrolling, chat text, and nine-patch backgrounds.
en.disableEffect: The djLib custom-view example menu will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: 从 djLib 示例启动页进入后，此 Activity 会列出圆角图片、验证码倒计时、弹窗、滚动、聊天文本和九宫格背景等示例。
zh-CN.disableEffect: djLib 的自定义视图示例菜单将无法打开。

en.description: Opened from the djLib view or animation examples, this Activity displays an animated graphic and plays it when tapped.
en.disableEffect: The djLib animated-graphic example will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: 从 djLib 的视图或动画示例中打开时，此 Activity 会显示一个动画图形，并在用户点击时播放。
zh-CN.disableEffect: djLib 的动画图形示例将无法打开。

en.description: When launched from its app icon, the Skyjie6 djLib sample screen shows sections for custom views, animations, and utility demos, and opens a section when selected.
en.disableEffect: If this is the app's launcher entry, users lose its launch screen and cannot reach the djLib demos from the app icon.

zh-CN.description: 从应用图标启动时，Skyjie6 djLib 示例首页会显示自定义视图、动画和功能示例分类，点击分类即可进入。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 如果这是应用的启动入口，停用后用户将无法从应用图标打开该首页或进入 djLib 示例。

en.description: Opened from the djLib sample menus, this Activity demonstrates speech-bubble and popup menus positioned around tapped controls.
en.disableEffect: The djLib popup examples will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: 从 djLib 示例菜单中打开时，此 Activity 会演示围绕点击控件显示的气泡和弹出菜单。
zh-CN.disableEffect: djLib 的弹窗示例将无法打开。

en.description: Opened from djLib sample menus, this Activity shows a long example list with a pull-down header and an edit/delete popup.
en.disableEffect: The djLib pull-down scrolling example will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: 从 djLib 示例菜单中打开时，此 Activity 会显示带下拉头部和编辑、删除弹窗的长列表示例。
zh-CN.disableEffect: djLib 的下拉滚动示例将无法打开。

en.description: Opened from djLib custom-view or animation examples, this Activity displays rounded-image drawing examples and lets the user change a sample label.
en.disableEffect: The djLib rounded-image example will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: 从 djLib 自定义视图或动画示例中打开时，此 Activity 会展示圆角图片绘制效果，并允许用户更改示例文字。
zh-CN.disableEffect: djLib 的圆角图片示例将无法打开。

en.description: Opened from djLib sample menus, this Activity demonstrates a scrolling page whose search bar moves as the user scrolls and whose list can be pull-to-refreshed.
en.disableEffect: The djLib scrolling and refresh example will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: 从 djLib 示例菜单中打开时，此 Activity 会演示滚动页面：搜索栏会随滚动改变位置，列表支持下拉刷新。
zh-CN.disableEffect: djLib 的滚动和刷新示例将无法打开。

en.description: Opened from djLib sample menus, this Activity displays a long list to demonstrate a stretch-scroll layout.
en.disableEffect: The djLib stretch-scroll example will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: 从 djLib 示例菜单中打开时，此 Activity 会显示长列表，用来演示拉伸滚动布局。
zh-CN.disableEffect: djLib 的拉伸滚动示例将无法打开。

en.description: Opened from the djLib custom-view examples, this Activity demonstrates a send-code button that starts a 60-second countdown.
en.disableEffect: The djLib verification-code countdown example will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: 从 djLib 自定义视图示例中打开时，此 Activity 会演示一个点击后开始 60 秒倒计时的发送验证码按钮。
zh-CN.disableEffect: djLib 的验证码倒计时示例将无法打开。

en.description: Opened from the djLib function examples, this Activity shows an embedded web page with a loading indicator; the included example loads a search page.
en.disableEffect: The djLib web screen will no longer open, so any host-app flow that uses this embedded page will be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: 从 djLib 功能示例中打开时，此 Activity 会显示带加载指示的内嵌网页；示例当前加载的是搜索页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: djLib 的网页界面将无法打开，依赖此内嵌页面的应用流程也会受影响。

en.description: Opened from the djLib function examples, this Activity lets the user grant screen-capture permission and displays the captured screen image.
en.disableEffect: The djLib screen-capture example cannot be launched.

zh-CN.description: 从 djLib 功能示例中打开时，此 Activity 会请求屏幕捕获许可，并显示捕获到的屏幕图像。
zh-CN.disableEffect: djLib 的屏幕捕获示例将无法启动。

en.description: Opened from the djLib custom-view examples, this Activity displays sample text using bundled and asset-loaded stretchable image backgrounds.
en.disableEffect: The djLib nine-patch background example will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: 从 djLib 自定义视图示例中打开时，此 Activity 会用内置和资源目录中的可拉伸图片背景展示示例文字。
zh-CN.disableEffect: djLib 的九宫格背景示例将无法打开。

en.description: The uTakePhoto library by SonglongGithub uses this provider to create photo file links that the app and camera tools can read during capture and photo selection.
en.disableEffect: Photo capture or handoff can fail because uTakePhoto cannot create the file link needed to access the image.

zh-CN.description: SonglongGithub 的 uTakePhoto 库通过此 Provider 为照片文件创建访问地址，供拍照和选图流程中的应用及相机工具读取。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，uTakePhoto 无法生成访问照片所需的文件地址，拍照或照片传递流程可能失败。

en.description: The uTakePhoto library by SonglongGithub opens this Activity when a selected photo needs cropping. It shows the crop screen, saves the edited image, and returns it to the calling screen.
en.disableEffect: Photo flows that use uTakePhoto's built-in crop step cannot finish cropping or return the edited image.

zh-CN.description: SonglongGithub 的 uTakePhoto 库在需要裁剪所选照片时打开此 Activity。它显示裁剪界面、保存处理后的图片，并将图片返回调用页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，使用 uTakePhoto 内置裁剪功能的照片流程无法完成裁剪或返回处理后的图片。

en.description: When a user taps a Smaato ad link, Smaato opens the destination in an in-app browser with page progress and navigation controls.
en.disableEffect: Smaato ad links will not open in the in-app browser; the host app remains usable.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击 Smaato 广告链接时，Smaato 会在应用内浏览器打开目标网页，并提供加载进度和导航操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Smaato 广告链接将无法在应用内浏览器打开，但应用仍可使用。

en.description: When the app process starts, this Smaato component connects the ad SDK to foreground and background changes so it can follow the app lifecycle.
en.disableEffect: Smaato may miss foreground or background changes and its ads may not work correctly; the host app remains usable.

zh-CN.description: 应用进程启动时，Smaato 会借此组件感知应用进入前台或后台，以配合广告 SDK 的运行状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Smaato 可能无法正确感知应用的前后台切换，广告功能可能受影响，但应用仍可使用。

en.description: When Smaato has a full-screen interstitial ad ready, it opens this screen to show the ad and handle its display and closing events.
en.disableEffect: Smaato interstitial ads will not display; the host app’s other features remain available.

zh-CN.description: Smaato 准备好插屏广告后，会打开此页面展示全屏广告并处理广告的显示与关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Smaato 插屏广告将无法显示，但应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: When Smaato starts a rewarded interstitial, this screen displays the ad and reports when the viewer closes it.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot complete Smaato rewarded ads, and rewards for watching those ads will no longer be granted.

zh-CN.description: Smaato 开始激励插屏广告时，会打开此页面播放广告，并在用户关闭时回报播放结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法完成 Smaato 激励广告，也不会再获得观看这些广告对应的奖励。

en.description: Smaato SOMA declares this screen for expanded banner ads when a user opens an ad banner.
en.disableEffect: Expanded Smaato banner ads will not open.

zh-CN.description: Smaato SOMA 将此页面用于用户打开横幅广告时展示的展开式广告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Smaato 展开式横幅广告将无法打开。

en.description: Smaato SOMA uses this screen to display a full-screen interstitial ad.
en.disableEffect: Smaato interstitial ads will not open.

zh-CN.description: Smaato SOMA 使用此页面展示全屏插屏广告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Smaato 插屏广告将无法打开。

en.description: Smaato SOMA uses this screen to play video ads, including rewarded video placements.
en.disableEffect: Smaato video ads will not play, and users will no longer receive rewards for watching rewarded ads.

zh-CN.description: Smaato SOMA 使用此页面播放视频广告，包括激励视频广告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Smaato 视频广告将无法播放，用户观看激励广告后也不会再获得奖励。

en.description: Android starts this private provider with Fly2Think SmartDetection. It makes the app available to the SDK so it can connect to an air-quality detector and show readings.
en.disableEffect: The SDK may not be able to connect to an air-quality detector or display its measurements.

zh-CN.description: Fly2Think SmartDetection 会在应用启动时使用这个私有提供程序，以便连接空气质量检测设备并显示读数。
zh-CN.disableEffect: SDK 可能无法连接空气质量检测设备或显示测量结果。

en.description: Android starts this private provider with Fly2Think SmartElectric. It makes the app available to the SDK so it can connect to an electricity-testing device and show results.
en.disableEffect: The SDK may not be able to connect to the electricity-testing device or display its results.

zh-CN.description: Fly2Think SmartElectric 会在应用启动时使用这个私有提供程序，以便连接电力检测设备并显示检测结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: SDK 可能无法连接电力检测设备或显示检测结果。

en.description: When a page built with Smart Library opens, this shared screen displays the page and applies common navigation behavior.
en.disableEffect: Pages that depend on this shared screen may fail to open if it is disabled.

zh-CN.description: 基于 Smart Library 构建的页面打开时，此共享界面会显示页面内容并提供通用导航操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此共享界面的页面可能无法打开。

en.description: The Smart Library React Native screen appears when an app opens a page built with its React Native module. It displays that page and handles back-button and return-from-other-screen navigation.
en.disableEffect: Pages built with this React Native module may not open or return correctly.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开由 Smart Library React Native 模块构建的页面时，会显示此界面。它负责显示页面，并处理返回键和从其他界面返回的导航。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 由此 React Native 模块构建的页面可能无法打开或正确返回。

en.description: The Smart Library accessibility service runs only after the user enables it in Android settings. It watches window changes and reports which app and screen are in front to the library's activity tracker.
en.disableEffect: The optional activity tracker will stop seeing screen changes, so Smart Library diagnostic features that depend on it will no longer update.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Android 设置中启用后，Smart Library 无障碍服务才会运行。它监听窗口切换，并向库内的活动跟踪功能报告当前前台应用和界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 可选的活动跟踪功能将不再获知界面变化，依赖它的 Smart Library 诊断信息也不会继续更新。

en.description: When a user taps the Smart Library debug notification's accessibility shortcut, this receiver checks whether activity tracking is enabled; if it is not, it opens Android Accessibility settings.
en.disableEffect: The debug notification's shortcut will no longer take users to Accessibility settings; regular app screens are unaffected.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击 Smart Library 调试通知中的无障碍快捷入口时，此接收器会检查活动跟踪是否已启用；如果尚未启用，它会打开 Android 无障碍设置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 调试通知中的快捷入口将无法再打开无障碍设置，但应用的常规界面不受影响。

en.description: Smart Library opens this screen when its developer diagnostics panel is requested. It displays the library's built-in diagnostic tools.
en.disableEffect: The optional developer diagnostics panel will not open; regular app screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: 请求打开 Smart Library 开发诊断面板时，会显示此界面。它呈现库内置的诊断工具。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 可选的开发诊断面板将无法打开，但应用的常规界面仍可使用。

en.description: Smart Library uses this separate debug screen when its troubleshooting tools need to show diagnostic or crash details. It provides a place to review that information.
en.disableEffect: Developers may lose the optional in-app diagnostics view when investigating crashes; ordinary app pages can still use the shared screen host.

zh-CN.description: Smart Library 的故障排查工具需要显示诊断或崩溃详情时，会使用此独立调试界面。用户可以在这里查看相关信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 开发者排查崩溃时可能无法使用应用内诊断界面；普通页面仍可使用共享界面。

en.description: Android starts this private provider for Fly2Think PanoramaSystem. It makes the app available to the SDK's panorama sign-in and cloud-publishing tools.
en.disableEffect: PanoramaSystem's sign-in, panorama upload, or publishing features may fail.

zh-CN.description: Android 会在应用启动时为 Fly2Think PanoramaSystem 启动这个私有提供程序，供 SDK 的全景登录和云端发布工具访问应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: PanoramaSystem 的登录、全景上传或发布功能可能无法使用。

en.description: Android starts this private provider for newer Fly2Think PanoramaSystem releases. It makes the app available to the SDK's panorama sign-in and cloud-publishing tools.
en.disableEffect: PanoramaSystem's sign-in, panorama upload, or publishing features may fail.

zh-CN.description: 较新版本的 Fly2Think PanoramaSystem 会在应用启动时使用这个私有提供程序，供 SDK 的全景登录和云端发布工具访问应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: PanoramaSystem 的登录、全景上传或发布功能可能无法使用。

en.description: Android starts this private provider with Fly2Think SmartPressure. It makes the app available to the SDK's pressure-tester connection and measurement screens.
en.disableEffect: The pressure-testing SDK may not be able to connect to a tester or show its measurements.

zh-CN.description: Fly2Think SmartPressure 会在应用启动时使用这个私有提供程序，以便连接压力测试设备并显示测量结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 压力测试 SDK 可能无法连接测试设备或显示测量结果。

en.description: Android starts this private provider in newer Fly2Think SmartPressure releases. It makes the app available to the pressure-testing SDK.
en.disableEffect: The pressure-testing SDK may not be able to connect to a tester or show its measurements.

zh-CN.description: 较新版本的 Fly2Think SmartPressure 会在应用启动时使用这个私有提供程序，供压力测试 SDK 访问应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 压力测试 SDK 可能无法连接测试设备或显示测量结果。

en.description: When SmartAHC SplitCore hands a downloaded app package to Android for opening or installation, this FileProvider gives Android access to that file.
en.disableEffect: Without it, Android cannot receive the downloaded package through SplitCore, so that package update flow fails.

zh-CN.description: SmartAHC SplitCore 将下载的应用包交给 Android 打开或安装时，此 FileProvider 会向 Android 提供该文件的访问入口。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Android 无法通过 SplitCore 获取下载的应用包，该更新流程会失败。

en.description: When an app starts Smartcar vehicle authorization, this screen displays the connection webpage and returns the completed or canceled authorization to the app.
en.disableEffect: Blocking it prevents this Smartcar vehicle-connection flow from returning an authorization result.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动 Smartcar 车辆授权时，此界面会显示连接网页，并把完成或取消的授权结果返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，此 Smartcar 车辆连接流程无法向应用返回授权结果。

en.description: When a Smartcar authorization request needs a webpage, this screen displays the authorization page and returns its redirect result to the app.
en.disableEffect: Blocking it prevents Smartcar authorization from returning the result needed to connect an account or vehicle.

zh-CN.description: Smartcar 授权请求需要打开网页时，此界面会显示授权页面，并把重定向结果返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Smartcar 授权无法返回连接账户或车辆所需的结果。

en.description: When a user links a vehicle through Smartcar, this screen displays the authorization page and returns the connection result to the app.
en.disableEffect: Blocking it prevents the app from completing this Smartcar vehicle-linking flow.

zh-CN.description: 用户通过 Smartcar 关联车辆时，此界面会显示授权页面，并把连接结果返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用无法完成此 Smartcar 车辆关联流程。

en.description: When Smartcar opens an authorization page in its separate sign-in flow, this screen displays the page and returns the redirect result to the app.
en.disableEffect: Blocking it prevents this Smartcar authorization flow from returning its result.

zh-CN.description: Smartcar 在独立的登录流程中打开授权页面时，此界面会显示页面并把重定向结果返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，此 Smartcar 授权流程无法向应用返回结果。

en.description: When the Smartcar SDK starts an authorization webpage, this screen displays it and returns the authorization result to the app.
en.disableEffect: Blocking it prevents the Smartcar sign-in or vehicle-connection flow from completing.

zh-CN.description: Smartcar SDK 启动网页授权时，此界面会显示授权页面并把授权结果返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Smartcar 登录或车辆连接流程将无法完成。

en.description: When Smartcar runs an authorization webpage in its separate sign-in flow, this screen displays the page and returns the authorization result to the app.
en.disableEffect: Blocking it prevents that Smartcar sign-in or vehicle-connection flow from completing.

zh-CN.description: Smartcar 在独立登录流程中运行网页授权时，此界面会显示授权页面并把结果返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，该 Smartcar 登录或车辆连接流程将无法完成。

en.description: When Android reports that a compatible USB accessory is attached, the SmartDeviceLink library finds a router service and passes the accessory connection to it.
en.disableEffect: Automatic SmartDeviceLink connections over USB will stop; the app remains usable on the phone.

zh-CN.description: Android 报告已连接兼容的 USB 配件时，SmartDeviceLink 库会查找路由服务并将配件连接交给它处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: SmartDeviceLink 将无法通过 USB 自动建立连接；应用在手机上仍可使用。

en.description: SmarterApps' AutomateIt Plugin SDK receives requests to list an app's automation actions and triggers, run actions, start or stop triggers, or perform setup. It also handles plugin diagnostic requests.
en.disableEffect: AutomateIt cannot discover or run this app's plugin actions and triggers.

zh-CN.description: SmarterApps 的 AutomateIt 插件 SDK 会接收列出应用自动化操作和触发器、运行操作、启动或停止触发器及执行设置的请求，也会处理插件诊断请求。
zh-CN.disableEffect: AutomateIt 将无法发现或运行此应用的插件操作和触发器。

en.description: The AutomateIt Plugin SDK opens this blank screen when a plugin action must launch another screen and wait for its result. It returns that result to the automation app.
en.disableEffect: Plugin actions that need another screen's result cannot complete through AutomateIt.

zh-CN.description: 插件操作需要打开其他界面并等待返回结果时，AutomateIt 插件 SDK 会使用此空白界面，并把结果传回自动化应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要其他界面返回结果的插件操作将无法通过 AutomateIt 完成。

en.description: The AutomateIt Plugin SDK's launcher screen lists the app's supported automation actions and triggers. It also offers to install AutomateIt if missing.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open the plugin screen to browse this app's AutomateIt actions and triggers.

zh-CN.description: AutomateIt 插件 SDK 的启动界面会列出应用支持的自动化操作和触发器；如果尚未安装 AutomateIt，也会提供安装入口。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开插件界面查看此应用提供的 AutomateIt 操作和触发器。

en.description: After Android finishes starting, SmartMe Monitor (SmartMe) checks saved settings and restarts the enabled app-use, audio, or location collection services.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, SmartMe's background monitoring will not restart after a reboot; the host app's other functions remain available.

zh-CN.description: Android 启动完成后，SmartMe Monitor（SmartMe）会读取已保存的设置，并重新启动已启用的应用使用、音频或位置采集服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，SmartMe 的后台监测不会在设备重启后自动恢复；宿主应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: When SmartMe Monitor's app-use collection is enabled, this foreground service tracks which apps are open on the device and records their names, use duration, connection type, and last saved location.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, SmartMe stops collecting app-use history, while the host app's own screens continue to work.

zh-CN.description: 启用 SmartMe Monitor 的应用使用采集后，此前台服务会跟踪设备上打开过的应用，并记录应用名称、使用时长、网络类型和最近保存的位置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，SmartMe 将停止采集应用使用记录；宿主应用自身的界面仍可正常使用。

en.description: When SmartMe Monitor's audio collection is enabled, this foreground service periodically sends microphone audio to ACRCloud for recognition and saves recognized matches with the last stored location.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, SmartMe will no longer identify or record nearby sounds; the host app's other features remain available.

zh-CN.description: 启用 SmartMe Monitor 的音频采集后，此前台服务会定期将麦克风音频发送给 ACRCloud 识别，并把识别结果与最近保存的位置一起记录。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，SmartMe 将不再识别或记录周围的声音；宿主应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: While SmartMe Monitor's location collection is enabled, this foreground service requests location updates about every three minutes and stores coordinates for its monitoring records.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, SmartMe's monitoring records will no longer receive new location updates; the host app's other features remain available.

zh-CN.description: 启用 SmartMe Monitor 的位置采集后，此前台服务大约每三分钟请求一次位置更新，并保存坐标供监测记录使用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，SmartMe 的监测记录将不再获得新的位置数据；宿主应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: While SmartMe Monitor collects data in the background, this foreground service listens for the screen turning on or off and resumes or pauses selected monitoring accordingly.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, some SmartMe monitoring may no longer adjust when the screen turns on or off; the host app's other features remain available.

zh-CN.description: SmartMe Monitor 在后台采集数据时，此前台服务会监听屏幕亮起或熄灭，并据此恢复或暂停部分监测。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，部分 SmartMe 监测可能无法再随屏幕亮灭进行调整；宿主应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: After Android starts, SmartMe Monitor restarts app-usage monitoring if monitoring was enabled before the device rebooted.
en.disableEffect: App-usage monitoring will not resume automatically after a reboot.

zh-CN.description: Android 启动后，如果重启前已启用监测，SmartMe Monitor 会重新启动应用使用情况监测。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，设备重启后不会自动恢复应用使用情况监测。

en.description: While SmartMe Monitor is active, it responds when the screen turns on or off so it can resume or close the current app-usage interval.
en.disableEffect: Disabling this receiver alone does not stop the monitoring service’s directly registered screen listener, so screen-state monitoring continues while the service runs.

zh-CN.description: SmartMe Monitor 运行期间，屏幕亮起或熄灭时会收到通知，以便继续或结束当前应用使用时段的记录。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 仅停用此接收器并不能停止监测服务直接注册的屏幕监听器，因此服务运行时仍会监测屏幕状态。

en.description: When another SmartMe Monitor instance sends a shutdown command, this receiver stops the usage-monitoring service and closes its monitoring process.
en.disableEffect: The monitoring service will not receive this shutdown request and may keep running in the background.

zh-CN.description: 另一个 SmartMe Monitor 实例发送关闭命令时，此接收器会停止使用情况监测服务并关闭监测进程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，监测服务将收不到此关闭请求，可能继续在后台运行。

en.description: While SmartMe Monitor is enabled, this service records which app is in the foreground and for how long, adds the latest location to each usage record, and uploads the logs.
en.disableEffect: App-use history and its location records will stop being collected and uploaded.

zh-CN.description: 启用 SmartMe Monitor 后，此服务会记录当前前台应用及使用时长，为每条记录附上最近位置，并上传这些记录。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用使用历史及其位置记录将停止采集和上传。

en.description: When SmartMe Monitor starts location tracking after permission is granted, this service requests regular location updates and saves the latest location for usage records.
en.disableEffect: SmartMe Monitor can no longer attach current location to its monitoring records.

zh-CN.description: 获得定位权限后，SmartMe Monitor 启动位置监测时，此服务会定期请求位置更新，并保存最新位置供使用记录使用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，SmartMe Monitor 将无法为监测记录附加当前位置。

en.description: When a Smartsupp ChatBox message push arrives, this service passes it to the chat notification system and updates the chat service when Android refreshes its push registration.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, new Smartsupp chat push notifications will not reach the app; users can still open the chat manually.

zh-CN.description: 收到 Smartsupp ChatBox 的消息推送时，此服务会将其交给聊天通知系统处理，并在 Android 更新推送注册信息时通知聊天服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，应用将收不到新的 Smartsupp 聊天推送；用户仍可手动打开聊天页面。

en.description: When a user opens Smartsupp ChatBox, this Activity displays the chat screen and handles file selection for message attachments.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, the app's embedded support conversation cannot open or attach files.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 Smartsupp ChatBox 时，此 Activity 会显示聊天界面，并处理消息附件的文件选择。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，应用内的客服聊天界面无法打开，也无法选择消息附件。

en.description: SmH Digital Assistant opens this Activity for a medical professional’s workspace, with screens for patients, tasks, patient registration, and individual patient details.
en.disableEffect: The app’s medical-staff patient and task workflows are unavailable.

zh-CN.description: SmH Digital Assistant 会为医务人员打开此 Activity，其中包含患者列表、任务、患者登记和患者详情页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用中的医务人员患者和任务流程将无法使用。

en.description: SmH Digital Assistant opens this Activity for a patient workspace with chat, daily tasks, calendar, and health-registration screens.
en.disableEffect: The app’s patient chat, task, calendar, and registration flows are unavailable.

zh-CN.description: SmH Digital Assistant 会为患者打开此 Activity，其中包含聊天、每日任务、日历和健康登记页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用中的患者聊天、任务、日历和登记流程将无法使用。

en.description: SmH Medical Device Scan opens this camera Activity to read measurements from a supported health device’s display. It recognizes the reading and returns its values and image to the app screen that started the scan.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot scan a device display or receive the measurement from this flow.

zh-CN.description: SmH Medical Device Scan 会打开此相机 Activity，读取受支持健康设备屏幕上的测量值，并将识别出的数值和图像返回发起扫描的应用页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法扫描设备屏幕或通过此流程接收测量结果。

en.description: SmH Medical Device Scan opens this guided camera Activity to recognize measurements shown on a supported health device. It displays the detected reading and lets the user capture it for the app screen that started the scan.
en.disableEffect: The guided device-scan result cannot be reviewed or returned to the app.

zh-CN.description: SmH Medical Device Scan 会打开此引导式相机 Activity，识别受支持健康设备屏幕上的测量值，显示结果，并允许用户拍摄后返回发起扫描的应用页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法查看引导式设备扫描结果或将其返回应用。

en.description: During Smile ID verification, this screen uses the camera to capture the front and, when requested, the back of an identity document, then returns the result to the verification flow.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, identity checks that need an ID image cannot continue.

zh-CN.description: 进行 Smile ID 身份验证时，此界面会使用相机拍摄证件正面，并在需要时拍摄背面，然后将结果交回验证流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，需要证件图像的身份验证将无法继续。

en.description: After Smile ID captures a selfie, this screen shows the image and lets the user confirm it or retake it.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, the user cannot review and confirm the selfie, so that verification step cannot finish.

zh-CN.description: Smile ID 拍摄自拍照后，此界面会显示照片，让用户确认或重新拍摄。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，用户无法检查并确认自拍照，因此该验证步骤无法完成。

en.description: During Smile ID verification, this screen guides automatic selfie capture, then opens the captured image for review.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, the selfie capture and review flow cannot be completed.

zh-CN.description: 进行 Smile ID 身份验证时，此界面会引导用户自动拍摄自拍照，随后打开照片供用户检查。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，自拍拍摄和检查流程将无法完成。

en.description: Before an identity check proceeds, Smile Identity shows the partner's consent explanation, the categories of information involved, and a privacy link here, then records whether the user accepts or cancels.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, the user cannot respond to this consent request, and the identity-check flow may not proceed.

zh-CN.description: 身份验证继续之前，Smile Identity 会在此显示合作方的授权说明、涉及的信息类别和隐私政策链接，并记录用户接受或取消的选择。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，用户无法回应此授权请求，身份验证流程可能无法继续。

en.description: During Smile Identity's Nigerian BVN consent flow, this screen shows the contact methods offered for the entered number and sends the selected method to the verification service before OTP confirmation.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, users cannot choose where to receive a code, so BVN consent cannot continue.

zh-CN.description: 在 Smile Identity 的尼日利亚 BVN 授权流程中，此界面会显示该号码可用的联系方式，并在短信验证码确认前将用户选择提交给验证服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，用户无法选择接收验证码的方式，BVN 授权流程无法继续。

en.description: During Smile Identity's Nigerian BVN consent flow, this screen asks for an 11-digit BVN number and starts the consent check.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, the BVN consent check cannot start from this screen.

zh-CN.description: 在 Smile Identity 的尼日利亚 BVN 授权流程中，此界面会要求用户输入 11 位 BVN 号码并开始授权检查。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，无法通过此界面启动 BVN 授权检查。

en.description: After a code is sent to the selected BVN contact, this Smile Identity screen accepts the code, can request another one, and confirms the consent step.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, users cannot verify the code, so BVN consent cannot be completed.

zh-CN.description: 验证码发送到所选 BVN 联系方式后，Smile Identity 的此界面会接收验证码、允许重新获取验证码并确认授权。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，用户无法验证验证码，BVN 授权将无法完成。

en.description: When Smile Identity has verification requests waiting in its upload queue, this retry service submits them when the phone has a connection and schedules another check while upload files remain.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, delayed identity submissions may remain pending because this retry path cannot send them.

zh-CN.description: Smile Identity 有验证请求等待上传时，此重试服务会在手机联网后提交请求，并在仍有待处理文件时安排再次检查。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，延迟的身份验证提交可能无法通过此重试流程发送，因而一直处于等待状态。

en.description: When Android runs a scheduled Smile Identity upload job, this service sends saved verification requests if the phone is online and schedules another attempt while files remain.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, verification uploads waiting for a connection may remain pending.

zh-CN.description: Android 运行 Smile Identity 预定的上传任务时，此服务会在手机联网后发送已保存的验证请求，并在仍有待处理文件时安排再次尝试。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，等待网络连接的验证上传可能会一直处于待处理状态。

en.description: The X7SY 小7SDK (X7SDK) starts this provider with the app to initialize its interface and permission support and prepare web content storage for other parts of the app. X7 sign-in and plugin pages use this setup.
en.disableEffect: X7 login, permission prompts or plugin screens may fail to initialize.

zh-CN.description: X7SY 的小7SDK 会随应用启动此提供程序，初始化界面和权限支持，并为应用其他部分准备网页内容存储。X7 登录和插件页面会使用这些设置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: X7 登录、权限请求或插件页面可能无法初始化。

en.description: When the app requests an X7SY 小7SDK error-log export, this Activity packages crash logs and the NetEase IM log into a file and returns it to the requesting screen.
en.disableEffect: The app will not be able to export these SDK diagnostic logs through this screen.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求导出 X7SY 小7SDK 错误日志时，此 Activity 会将崩溃日志和 NetEase IM 日志打包成文件并返回给请求页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法通过此页面导出这些 SDK 诊断日志。

en.description: The X7SY 小7SDK exposes this Activity for wake-up links; it opens briefly and closes immediately when Android routes a link to it.
en.disableEffect: Links that use this wake-up entry point may no longer open the app.

zh-CN.description: X7SY 的小7SDK 将此 Activity 用作唤醒链接的入口；Android 将链接交给它时，它会短暂打开并立即关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此唤醒入口的链接可能无法再打开应用。

en.description: The X7SY 小7SDK briefly opens this transparent Activity as a wake-up step for background plugin tasks. It shows an empty screen and closes immediately.
en.disableEffect: X7SDK flows that rely on this wake-up step may fail to start their plugin work.

zh-CN.description: X7SY 的小7SDK 会短暂打开此透明 Activity，以唤起后台插件任务。它显示空白界面后立即关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此唤醒步骤的 X7SDK 流程可能无法启动插件任务。

en.description: The X7SY 小7SDK uses this service to show pages and run tasks supplied by plugins loaded while the app is running.
en.disableEffect: X7 plugin pages or tasks that need this runtime process will not start.

zh-CN.description: X7SY 的小7SDK 使用此服务显示应用运行时加载的插件页面并执行插件任务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要此运行进程的 X7 插件页面或任务将无法启动。

en.description: The X7SY 小7SDK uses this service for background work supplied by its plugins. It checks that the main part of the app is still running before continuing.
en.disableEffect: X7 plugin background services that rely on this process may not run.

zh-CN.description: X7SY 的小7SDK 使用此服务运行插件提供的后台任务，并会在继续前检查应用主程序是否仍在运行。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此进程的 X7 插件后台服务可能无法运行。

en.description: The X7SY 小7SDK opens this transparent Activity when the app requests sign-in, then returns saved login details or a token to the app.
en.disableEffect: X7 sign-in requests that use this handoff may fail, leaving the user unable to log in through the SDK.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求登录时，X7SY 的小7SDK 会打开此透明 Activity，并向应用返回已保存的登录信息或令牌。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此流程的 X7 登录请求可能失败，用户将无法通过该 SDK 登录。

en.description: At app startup, the X7SY 小7SDK checks whether its game speed-up feature is supported, retrieves the matching settings, and prepares the on-screen speed controls.
en.disableEffect: X7 game speed-up controls will not initialize in apps that rely on them.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，X7SY 的小7SDK 会检查游戏加速功能是否受支持、获取对应设置，并准备屏幕上的加速控件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖 X7 游戏加速的应用将无法初始化加速控件。

en.description: At app startup, the X7SY 小7SDK checks for supported game translation data, downloads text or image translation updates, and prepares its translation features.
en.disableEffect: Game text or image translation provided by X7SDK will be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，X7SY 的小7SDK 会检查适用的游戏翻译数据、下载文字或图片翻译更新，并准备翻译功能。
zh-CN.disableEffect: X7SDK 提供的游戏文字或图片翻译将无法使用。

en.description: The X7SY 小7SDK uses this Activity to show pages supplied by plugins when the app opens them. These pages are loaded while the app is running.
en.disableEffect: X7 plugins that use this Activity slot will be unable to open their pages.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开插件页面时，X7SY 的小7SDK 会用此 Activity 显示插件提供的页面。这些页面会在应用运行时加载。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此 Activity 槽位的 X7 插件页面将无法打开。

en.description: The X7SY 小7SDK uses this Activity to show plugin pages that need portrait orientation. These pages are loaded while the app is running.
en.disableEffect: X7 plugins that use this portrait Activity slot will be unable to open their pages.

zh-CN.description: X7SY 的小7SDK 会用此 Activity 显示需要竖屏展示的插件页面。这些页面会在应用运行时加载。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此竖屏 Activity 槽位的 X7 插件页面将无法打开。

en.description: The MyEmulator and antifake libraries provide a background check that reports whether the device looks like an emulator when the host app requests it.
en.disableEffect: The host app can no longer receive an emulator-status result through this service.

zh-CN.description: MyEmulator 和 antifake 库提供后台检测；应用请求时，它会报告设备是否像模拟器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法再通过此服务获取模拟器状态。

en.description: When Collie by Happylishang receives a battery-change broadcast through this receiver, it stores the battery level, maximum level, voltage, and whether the device is charging.
en.disableEffect: Collie's battery-reading helper stops receiving these updates; normal app screens keep working.

zh-CN.description: Happylishang 的 Collie 收到电池变化广播时，会通过此接收器记录电量、最高电量值、电压以及设备是否正在充电。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Collie 的电池读取辅助功能无法接收这些更新，应用的常规页面仍可使用。

en.description: Collie by Happylishang declares a short-lived helper service that stops itself as soon as it starts and shows no screen.
en.disableEffect: Blocking it prevents this brief helper from starting; its code has no user-facing task.

zh-CN.description: Happylishang 的 Collie 声明了一个短暂运行的辅助服务；它启动后会立即停止，也不会显示页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，此辅助服务不会启动；它没有面向用户的功能。

en.description: Collie by Happylishang creates this provider as the app process starts and records the start time used by its battery statistics.
en.disableEffect: Collie's early timing measurement is lost, so its battery statistics may be inaccurate while normal app features keep working.

zh-CN.description: 应用进程启动时，Happylishang 的 Collie 会创建此提供程序，并记录其电池统计所需的启动时间。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Collie 无法取得早期计时数据，电池统计可能不准确，但应用的常规功能仍可使用。

en.description: When Snap Ad Kit (Snap Inc.) opens an ad slot, this Activity displays the requested interstitial, rewarded, or banner placement while the ad session is active.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, these ad placements cannot be shown; users will not receive rewards for watching rewarded ads.

zh-CN.description: Snap Ad Kit（Snap Inc.）打开广告位时，此 Activity 会在广告流程中显示请求的插屏、激励视频或横幅广告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，这些广告位无法显示；用户观看激励广告后将不会获得奖励。

en.description: When Snap CameraKit needs an age-related consent response, this screen asks whether the user is an adult or needs a parent or guardian to continue.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, users cannot complete this age and guardian prompt, so the CameraKit flow that requires it may stop.

zh-CN.description: Snap CameraKit 需要年龄相关的授权回应时，此界面会询问用户是否已成年，或是否需要家长或监护人继续。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，用户无法完成年龄和监护人提示，因此需要此提示的 CameraKit 流程可能会中断。

en.description: When Snap CameraKit requests a legal notice, this screen displays the provided title and message and returns whether the user accepts or closes it.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, a CameraKit flow waiting for this notice cannot receive the user's response and may remain blocked.

zh-CN.description: Snap CameraKit 请求显示法律提示时，此界面会展示提供的标题和内容，并返回用户接受或关闭的选择。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，等待此提示的 CameraKit 流程无法收到用户回应，可能会停滞。

en.description: When Snap CameraKit exports diagnostic records, this Activity opens Android's save-file picker and returns the chosen location to the SDK.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, users cannot save CameraKit diagnostic records; camera and lens features continue to work.

zh-CN.description: Snap CameraKit 导出诊断记录时，此 Activity 会打开 Android 文件保存选择器，并将所选位置交回 SDK。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，用户无法保存 CameraKit 诊断记录；相机和镜头功能仍可使用。

en.description: When Snap CameraKit's Connected Lenses extension needs a user prompt, this screen displays its message and returns an accept or dismiss choice.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, connected-lens prompts cannot be answered, so a flow that requires one may not continue.

zh-CN.description: Snap CameraKit 的 Connected Lenses 扩展需要向用户提示内容时，此界面会显示消息并返回接受或关闭的选择。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，用户无法回应 Connected Lenses 提示，需要该提示的流程可能无法继续。

en.description: When Snap CameraKit's PushToDevice extension manages lens delivery, this menu shows the connection status and lets the user connect or disconnect.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, users cannot manage the connection used to send lenses from Lens Studio to the app.

zh-CN.description: Snap CameraKit 的 PushToDevice 扩展管理镜头传送时，此菜单会显示连接状态，并允许用户连接或断开。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，用户无法管理从 Lens Studio 向应用发送镜头所需的连接。

en.description: When the app launches Snap CameraKit's capture or lens-play flow, this Activity opens the camera preview, applies selected lenses and controls, and can return captured photos or videos.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, the app cannot open the CameraKit camera and lens experience.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动 Snap CameraKit 的拍摄或镜头播放流程时，此 Activity 会打开相机预览、应用所选镜头和控制设置，并可返回拍摄的照片或视频。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，应用无法打开 CameraKit 相机和镜头体验。

en.description: When the app process starts, this Snap Kit CoreKit (Snap Inc.) provider triggers automatic initialization a few seconds later for Snap Kit features.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, Snap Kit features that rely on automatic initialization may fail to start.

zh-CN.description: 应用进程启动时，Snap Kit CoreKit（Snap Inc.）的此 Provider 会在数秒后触发自动初始化，供 Snap Kit 功能使用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，依赖自动初始化的 Snap Kit 功能可能无法启动。

en.description: When an app sends content to Snapchat through Snap CreativeKit (Snap Inc.), the SDK includes this receiver as the target for a follow-up broadcast. In this version, the receiver does not process the result.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, the app will not receive that follow-up share-result broadcast; the share screen itself is started through a separate Snapchat handoff.

zh-CN.description: 应用通过 Snap CreativeKit（Snap Inc.）向 Snapchat 发送内容时，SDK 会将此 Receiver 设为后续广播的接收目标。此版本中，该 Receiver 不会处理结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，应用将收不到后续的分享结果广播；分享界面本身由单独的 Snapchat 跳转流程启动。

en.description: Snap Camera Kit's Fit Finder opens this screen during its sizing questionnaire so shoppers can enter their age and save it with the profile used for a size estimate.
en.disableEffect: The Fit Finder flow can no longer collect age here and may not finish a complete size estimate.

zh-CN.description: Snap Camera Kit 的 Fit Finder 会在尺码问卷中打开此页面，让顾客填写年龄，并将其保存到用于估算尺码的合身资料中。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Fit Finder 将无法在此收集年龄，尺码估算流程也可能无法完整完成。

en.description: During Fit Finder, this screen asks shoppers to choose a body-shape option for their chest, waist, or hips and saves the choice with the sizing profile.
en.disableEffect: The body-shape question will be unavailable, so the Fit Finder questionnaire or resulting size estimate may be incomplete.

zh-CN.description: 使用 Fit Finder 时，此页面会让顾客选择符合自己胸部、腰部或臀部体型的选项，并将选择保存到尺码资料中。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 体型问题将无法使用，Fit Finder 问卷或最终尺码估算可能因此不完整。

en.description: When shoppers choose to clear their Fit Finder profile, this screen asks them to confirm before deleting the saved sizing profile and its related consent record.
en.disableEffect: Shoppers will lose the in-app option to erase their saved Fit Finder profile and clear its related consent record.

zh-CN.description: 顾客选择清除 Fit Finder 资料时，此页面会先请求确认，然后删除已保存的尺码资料及相关同意记录。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 顾客将无法再通过应用内选项删除已保存的 Fit Finder 资料及相关同意记录。

en.description: After Fit Finder processes the sizing answers, this screen presents the product's recommended size options and lets shoppers continue or open profile settings.
en.disableEffect: Shoppers will not see the Fit Finder size recommendation or its follow-up actions.

zh-CN.description: Fit Finder 处理完尺码问卷答案后，此页面会显示商品的推荐尺码，并让顾客继续操作或打开资料设置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 顾客将无法查看 Fit Finder 的尺码推荐及后续操作。

en.description: In the footwear Fit Finder flow, this screen asks shoppers to choose their foot width and includes that answer in the shoe-size estimate.
en.disableEffect: The shoe-size flow may stop before it can collect foot width and complete the recommendation.

zh-CN.description: 在 Fit Finder 的鞋类尺码流程中，此页面会让顾客选择脚宽，并将答案用于鞋码估算。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 鞋码流程可能会因无法收集脚宽而中断，无法完成推荐。

en.description: For lower-body clothing, this Fit Finder screen records a size the shopper already wears, its sizing system, and the garment length used for comparison.
en.disableEffect: Fit Finder may not be able to finish a lower-body size recommendation without this reference size information.

zh-CN.description: 为估算下装尺码时，Fit Finder 会在此记录顾客已有衣物的尺码、尺码体系和衣长信息，以便进行比较。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 缺少这些参考尺码信息时，Fit Finder 可能无法完成下装尺码推荐。

en.description: Fit Finder opens this screen to collect the shopper's height and weight, with metric and imperial input choices, before continuing to the body-shape questions.
en.disableEffect: The sizing questionnaire may stop before collecting measurements and producing a recommendation.

zh-CN.description: Fit Finder 会打开此页面收集顾客的身高和体重，并提供公制和英制单位选择，然后继续填写体型问题。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 尺码问卷可能会在收集测量数据并生成推荐前中断。

en.description: Snap Camera Kit's Fit Finder product page shows the selected item and starts its sizing flow when the shopper taps the fit button; it can instead show an existing size recommendation.
en.disableEffect: The product's Fit Finder entry point and its size recommendations will be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: Snap Camera Kit 的 Fit Finder 商品页面会展示所选商品；顾客点击合身度按钮后，页面会启动尺码流程，也可以直接显示已有的尺码推荐。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 该商品的 Fit Finder 入口和尺码推荐将无法使用。

en.description: For a bra-size questionnaire, Fit Finder opens this screen so the shopper can select a bra size they already wear as a reference for the estimate.
en.disableEffect: The bra-size flow may be unable to collect a reference size and complete its recommendation.

zh-CN.description: 在胸罩尺码问卷中，Fit Finder 会打开此页面，让顾客选择自己目前穿着的胸罩尺码，作为估算参考。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 胸罩尺码流程可能无法收集参考尺码并完成推荐。

en.description: In the footwear questionnaire, this screen lets shoppers search for and choose a shoe brand so Fit Finder can compare their existing shoes with the item being sized.
en.disableEffect: The shoe-sizing flow may not be able to use the shopper's brand reference or continue to the next question.

zh-CN.description: 在鞋类问卷中，此页面会让顾客搜索并选择鞋品牌，以便 Fit Finder 将其现有鞋款与待估尺码的商品进行比较。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 鞋码流程可能无法使用顾客提供的品牌参考，也无法继续下一题。

en.description: This Fit Finder screen asks shoppers to select the shoe size they usually wear and passes it on to the footwear fit questions.
en.disableEffect: The shoe-sizing flow will miss the shopper's reference size and may not finish its recommendation.

zh-CN.description: Fit Finder 会在此页面询问顾客平时穿的鞋码，并将该尺码用于后续的鞋类合身度问卷。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 鞋码流程将缺少顾客的参考尺码，可能无法完成推荐。

en.description: During footwear sizing, this screen asks shoppers to choose the shoe category or type so Fit Finder can apply the relevant size questions.
en.disableEffect: The footwear questionnaire may stop without knowing which shoe type is being sized.

zh-CN.description: 进行鞋类尺码估算时，此页面会让顾客选择鞋类或鞋型，以便 Fit Finder 使用相应的尺码问题。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 鞋类问卷可能会因无法确定待估尺码的鞋型而中断。

en.description: This footwear Fit Finder screen asks how often shoppers wear shoes and saves that frequency with their fit profile before asking about the brand.
en.disableEffect: The shoe-sizing flow may not collect the usage information needed to continue its recommendation.

zh-CN.description: Fit Finder 的鞋类页面会询问顾客穿鞋的频率，并将该信息保存到合身资料中，然后继续询问品牌。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 鞋码流程可能无法收集推荐所需的穿着频率信息，因此无法继续完成推荐。

en.description: Fit Finder opens this screen so shoppers can choose how snug or loose they prefer clothing to feel, then uses that preference in the fit result.
en.disableEffect: Shoppers will not be able to set their fit preference, which can leave the Fit Finder result incomplete.

zh-CN.description: Fit Finder 会打开此页面，让顾客选择喜欢紧身还是宽松的穿着感，并在合身度结果中使用该偏好。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 顾客将无法设置穿着松紧偏好，Fit Finder 的结果可能因此不完整。

en.description: In the older Snap Camera Kit virtual try-on flow, this screen applies the selected product to the shopper's chosen photo and shows the generated try-on preview.
en.disableEffect: The older photo-based virtual try-on flow will not be able to generate or show its preview.

zh-CN.description: 在较早的 Snap Camera Kit 虚拟试穿流程中，此页面会将所选商品应用到顾客选择的照片上，并显示生成的试穿预览。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 较早的照片虚拟试穿流程将无法生成或显示预览。

en.description: After a shopper selects a full-body photo, this screen lets them review or change it, then starts Snap Camera Kit's 2D try-on that generates an image of the selected product on them.
en.disableEffect: Shoppers will not be able to confirm their photo and generate a 2D try-on result.

zh-CN.description: 顾客选择全身照片后，此页面会让他们预览或更换照片，然后启动 Snap Camera Kit 的 2D 虚拟试穿，生成所选商品穿在顾客身上的图片。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 顾客将无法确认照片并生成 2D 虚拟试穿结果。

en.description: After a 2D try-on finishes, this screen displays the generated image of the shopper wearing the selected product and lets them save it to the phone's photo gallery.
en.disableEffect: The generated try-on result cannot be viewed or saved through the Camera Kit flow.

zh-CN.description: 2D 虚拟试穿完成后，此页面会显示顾客试穿所选商品的生成图片，并可将图片保存到手机相册。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 顾客将无法通过 Camera Kit 流程查看或保存生成的试穿结果。

en.description: At the start of Snap Camera Kit's 2D try-on flow, this screen previews the selected product on the shopper's Snap avatar and offers an action to upload a personal photo for the next step.
en.disableEffect: Shoppers will lose the avatar preview and the path from it to selecting a personal photo.

zh-CN.description: 在 Snap Camera Kit 的 2D 虚拟试穿流程开始时，此页面会在顾客的 Snap 头像上预览所选商品，并提供上传个人照片以继续下一步的入口。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 顾客将无法查看头像试穿预览，也无法从此处继续选择个人照片。

en.description: This 2D try-on screen explains the full-length, lighting, and clothing conditions for a useful photo, then opens the phone's image picker so the shopper can choose one.
en.disableEffect: Shoppers cannot choose a photo for the 2D try-on flow.

zh-CN.description: 此 2D 虚拟试穿页面会说明照片应为全身照、光线充足且穿着合身衣物，然后打开手机图片选择器供顾客选取照片。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 顾客将无法为 2D 虚拟试穿流程选择照片。

en.description: Snap Camera Kit's shopping product page displays product images and, when 2D try-on is available, the Try It On action opens the shopper's avatar preview and photo-selection flow.
en.disableEffect: Shoppers will not be able to open Camera Kit's 2D try-on flow from the product page.

zh-CN.description: Snap Camera Kit 的购物商品页面会展示商品图片；如果支持 2D 虚拟试穿，点击试穿入口会打开头像预览和照片选择流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 顾客将无法从商品页面进入 Camera Kit 的 2D 虚拟试穿流程。

en.description: In the older Snap Camera Kit virtual try-on flow, this screen shows available Snap avatars for the selected product and then continues to photo selection.
en.disableEffect: The older virtual try-on flow cannot continue from avatar selection to photo selection.

zh-CN.description: 在较早的 Snap Camera Kit 虚拟试穿流程中，此页面会显示所选商品可用的 Snap 头像，然后继续选择照片。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 较早的虚拟试穿流程将无法从头像选择继续到照片选择。

en.description: In the older Snap Camera Kit virtual try-on flow, this screen opens the image picker so shoppers can choose a photo and pass it to the try-on step.
en.disableEffect: The older photo-based virtual try-on flow cannot continue without a selected shopper photo.

zh-CN.description: 在较早的 Snap Camera Kit 虚拟试穿流程中，此页面会打开图片选择器，让顾客选取照片并将其传给试穿步骤。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 较早的照片虚拟试穿流程将因无法选择顾客照片而无法继续。

en.description: Primer's NOL Pay (Transit) SDK uses this provider at app startup to save the app context and initialize its logging; later Transit SDK calls retrieve that context.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it withholds the app context that Transit expects at startup, so NOL Pay features may fail to initialize.

zh-CN.description: Primer 的 NOL Pay（Transit）SDK 会在应用启动时通过此 Provider 保存应用环境并初始化日志；Transit 后续运行时会读取该环境。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Transit 在启动时无法取得所需的应用环境，NOL Pay 功能可能无法初始化。

en.description: This optional Sobot album example screen opens a gallery of fixed sample picture links when the user taps its preview button, and it can allow pictures to be selected.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it removes this example gallery; the Sobot device-media picker uses separate screens.

zh-CN.description: 点击预览按钮时，这个可选的 Sobot 相册示例界面会打开一组固定的示例图片链接，并可允许用户选择图片。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，这个示例图库将无法打开；Sobot 设备媒体选择器使用其他界面。

en.description: When this optional Sobot album screen is opened, it launches a device photo-and-video picker with camera capture, lets the user choose up to 15 items, and shows the selected items for review.
en.disableEffect: Disabling this optional album screen removes its standalone picker; the Sobot support widget has a separate attachment picker.

zh-CN.description: 打开这个可选的 Sobot 相册界面后，会进入设备照片和视频选择器，并可使用相机；用户最多可选 15 项并查看所选内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，这个独立的相册选择界面将无法使用；Sobot 客服组件另有附件选择界面。

en.description: The Sobot album library opens this screen when photo, video, or mixed-media selection starts. It lists matching items on the device, can offer camera capture, and returns the chosen files.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to choose photos or videos through this Sobot media picker, including its camera fallback.

zh-CN.description: 开始选择照片、视频或混合媒体时，Sobot 相册库会打开此界面。它会列出设备中的匹配内容，可提供相机拍摄，并返回所选文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法通过 Sobot 媒体选择器选择照片或视频，也无法使用其中的相机备用入口。

en.description: When a user opens a media item from the Sobot picker, this full-screen gallery lets them browse items and mark which ones to keep in the selection.
en.disableEffect: Users may lose the ability to preview media or change their selection in the Sobot picker.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Sobot 选择器中打开媒体后，此全屏图库可供浏览媒体，并标记要保留在所选列表中的项目。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户可能无法在 Sobot 选择器中预览媒体或调整所选内容。

en.description: If the Sobot album picker finds no items for the requested media type, this screen shows an empty state and offers photo or video capture when that option is enabled.
en.disableEffect: Users with no matching local media will lose the camera fallback and may be unable to complete that selection.

zh-CN.description: 如果 Sobot 相册选择器找不到所需类型的媒体，此界面会显示空状态；启用相机选项时，用户还可拍照或录制视频。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 没有匹配本地媒体的用户将失去相机备用入口，可能无法完成此次选择。

en.description: The Sobot album library opens this full-screen viewer for a selected set of gallery items so users can inspect them and update the checked selection before returning.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to review or adjust selections in this Sobot gallery view.

zh-CN.description: Sobot 相册库会为一组选中的图库项目打开此全屏查看界面，供用户查看内容、调整勾选项后返回。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法在此 Sobot 图库界面中查看或调整所选内容。

en.description: When an app requests a standalone Sobot album preview, this screen shows selected pictures one at a time and offers a download action for remote pictures.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to browse pictures in this full-screen preview or use its download action.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求 Sobot 相册的独立预览时，此界面会逐张显示所选图片，并为远程图片提供下载操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法在此全屏预览中浏览图片或使用下载操作。

en.description: When the Sobot album library captures a photo or video, this provider gives the camera temporary access to the output file.
en.disableEffect: Camera capture may fail to return its photo or video to the Sobot media picker.

zh-CN.description: 使用 Sobot 相册库拍摄照片或视频时，此提供程序会授予相机对输出文件的临时访问权限。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，相机可能无法将拍摄的照片或视频交回 Sobot 媒体选择器。

en.description: Sobot CallBase, used by the Sobot customer-service call SDK, opens Android’s overlay-access settings when the call flow requests permission for a floating call window. After the user returns, it reports whether permission was granted.
en.disableEffect: Without this screen, users cannot grant overlay access through the SDK, so its floating incoming or ongoing call window may not appear.

zh-CN.description: Sobot 客服呼叫 SDK 使用的 CallBase 模块会在呼叫流程请求悬浮窗权限时打开 Android 悬浮窗设置；用户返回后，页面会反馈授权结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 没有此页面，用户无法通过 SDK 授予悬浮窗权限，因此来电或通话悬浮窗可能无法显示。

en.description: The Sobot customer-service call SDK opens this form when an agent creates or edits a scheduled customer call, including its contact, time, reminder, and note. Saving sends the plan to Sobot.
en.disableEffect: Agents cannot create or update scheduled customer calls from the Sobot call workspace.

zh-CN.description: Sobot 客服呼叫 SDK 会在坐席创建或编辑预约回访时打开此表单，用于填写联系人、时间、提醒和备注；保存后会提交计划。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 坐席将无法在 Sobot 呼叫工作台中创建或更新预约回访。

en.description: The Sobot customer-service call SDK shows this choice when an agent selects how calls should connect, offering mobile-phone and internet-phone modes and returning the selection to sign-in.
en.disableEffect: Agents cannot choose the call connection method in this sign-in flow.

zh-CN.description: Sobot 客服呼叫 SDK 会在坐席选择接听方式时显示此选项，提供手机和网络电话模式，并将选择结果返回登录流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 坐席将无法在此登录流程中选择呼叫连接方式。

en.description: When the host app opens Sobot customer-service calling, this screen loads the agent workspace for the configured call mode. Agents use it to sign in, change availability, place calls, and open call plans, records, and tasks.
en.disableEffect: The app’s Sobot support-calling workspace and its call-management options will be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: 宿主应用打开 Sobot 客服呼叫功能时，此页面会按配置的呼叫模式显示坐席工作台。坐席可在这里登录、切换状态、拨打电话以及查看计划、记录和任务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用中的 Sobot 客服呼叫工作台及其通话管理功能将无法使用。

en.description: The Sobot customer-service call SDK opens this form when an agent adds or edits a customer connected to a call. It loads existing details by phone number and saves the customer’s name, phone, or email.
en.disableEffect: Agents cannot add or update customer contact details through the Sobot call screens.

zh-CN.description: 坐席在 Sobot 客服呼叫流程中添加或编辑客户时，SDK 会打开此表单。页面可按电话号码读取已有资料，并保存客户姓名、电话或邮箱。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 坐席将无法通过 Sobot 呼叫页面新增或更新客户联系资料。

en.description: The Sobot customer-service call SDK opens this keypad when an agent chooses manual dialing. The agent enters a number and the screen starts an outbound call.
en.disableEffect: Agents cannot place manual calls from the Sobot call workspace.

zh-CN.description: 坐席选择手动拨号时，Sobot 客服呼叫 SDK 会打开此拨号键盘。坐席输入号码后，页面会发起外呼。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 坐席将无法从 Sobot 呼叫工作台手动拨打电话。

en.description: When an agent opens scheduled follow-ups, the Sobot customer-service call SDK loads the call-plan list and lets the agent refresh it, edit or delete a plan, or call its customer.
en.disableEffect: Agents cannot review or manage scheduled customer calls from this screen.

zh-CN.description: 坐席打开预约回访时，Sobot 客服呼叫 SDK 会加载回访列表，并允许刷新、编辑或删除计划，也可拨打计划中的客户电话。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 坐席将无法在此页面查看或管理预约回访。

en.description: While an agent creates a call plan, the Sobot customer-service call SDK opens this screen to choose when a reminder should appear and returns that choice to the plan form.
en.disableEffect: Agents cannot set a reminder time for a scheduled call.

zh-CN.description: 坐席创建回访计划时，Sobot 客服呼叫 SDK 会打开此页面供其选择提醒时间，并将结果返回计划表单。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 坐席将无法为预约回访设置提醒时间。

en.description: When an agent opens call history, the Sobot customer-service call SDK loads paged call records and lets the agent open a record for more detail.
en.disableEffect: Agents cannot browse Sobot call history in the app.

zh-CN.description: 坐席打开通话记录时，Sobot 客服呼叫 SDK 会分页加载记录，并允许打开单条记录查看详情。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 坐席将无法在应用中浏览 Sobot 通话记录。

en.description: The Sobot customer-service call SDK opens a selected call record to show its call and customer details. From here, an agent can open the customer form or create a follow-up plan.
en.disableEffect: Agents cannot review call details or use the related customer and follow-up actions from this screen.

zh-CN.description: Sobot 客服呼叫 SDK 会在坐席选择通话记录后显示通话和客户详情；坐席还可打开客户资料表单或创建回访计划。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 坐席将无法查看通话详情，也无法从此页面使用相关客户资料和回访操作。

en.description: When an Sobot call starts or arrives, this screen shows the number and live call state with answer and hang-up controls. It handles incoming and outgoing call requests.
en.disableEffect: Users may be unable to place or answer calls managed by the Sobot customer-service call SDK.

zh-CN.description: Sobot 呼叫开始或来电时，此页面会显示号码和实时状态，并提供接听、挂断操作；页面也处理呼入和呼出请求。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户可能无法接听或拨打由 Sobot 客服呼叫 SDK 管理的电话。

en.description: When an agent opens a customer-service call task, the Sobot SDK loads its contacts and task records. The agent can open a customer, schedule a follow-up, or start a call from the task.
en.disableEffect: Agents cannot review or work through customer-service call tasks from this screen.

zh-CN.description: 坐席打开客服呼叫任务时，Sobot SDK 会加载任务联系人和记录；坐席可打开客户资料、安排回访或从任务中发起呼叫。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 坐席将无法在此页面查看或处理客服呼叫任务。

en.description: During Sobot call sign-in, this screen lists the agent’s available extensions and returns the one they select.
en.disableEffect: Agents cannot select an extension in this sign-in flow.

zh-CN.description: Sobot 呼叫登录流程会在此页面列出坐席可用的分机，并返回其选择的分机。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 坐席将无法在此登录流程中选择分机。

en.description: When an agent signs in to Sobot customer-service calling, this screen loads phone modes and available extensions and lets the agent choose an answer mode, extension, and availability status.
en.disableEffect: Agents cannot configure or complete sign-in to the Sobot call service through this screen.

zh-CN.description: 坐席登录 Sobot 客服呼叫服务时，此页面会加载呼叫方式和可用分机，并供坐席选择接听模式、分机和在线状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 坐席将无法通过此页面配置或完成 Sobot 呼叫服务登录。

en.description: During sign-in or an availability change, the Sobot customer-service call SDK shows the agent states supplied by the service and returns the selected state.
en.disableEffect: Agents cannot choose their availability state in this flow.

zh-CN.description: 坐席登录或更改在线状态时，Sobot 客服呼叫 SDK 会显示服务端提供的坐席状态，并返回其选择。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 坐席将无法在此流程中选择在线状态。

en.description: When a Sobot call flow opens a link, this screen displays the page inside the app and supports navigation, retry, downloads, and file selection.
en.disableEffect: Pages opened from Sobot call flows will not load, which can interrupt any step that depends on them.

zh-CN.description: Sobot 呼叫流程打开链接时，此页面会在应用内显示网页，并支持前进后退、重试、下载和选择文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Sobot 呼叫流程打开的网页将无法显示，依赖这些页面的步骤也会中断。

en.description: When Sobot’s internet-phone call mode is active, this background service keeps the phone connection running, tracks network and audio state, and sends call-state changes to the call screens.
en.disableEffect: Internet-phone calls may fail to start, receive calls, or maintain audio.

zh-CN.description: Sobot 的网络电话模式运行时，此后台服务会维持电话连接、跟踪网络和音频状态，并向呼叫页面发送通话状态变化。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 网络电话可能无法发起、接听或保持音频。

en.description: When the Sobot call SDK requests an agent’s internet-phone account be registered or removed, this receiver applies that change.
en.disableEffect: The Sobot call service can no longer change the agent’s internet-phone account status through this receiver.

zh-CN.description: Sobot 呼叫 SDK 请求注册或移除坐席网络电话账户时，此接收器会应用相应更改。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Sobot 呼叫服务将无法通过此接收器更改坐席网络电话账户状态。

en.description: When Sobot call mode starts, this service connects the agent to the online calling service and manages account registration and live call signaling.
en.disableEffect: Internet-based Sobot calls may not connect or remain active.

zh-CN.description: Sobot 呼叫模式启动时，此服务会连接在线呼叫服务，并管理坐席账户注册和实时通话信令。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Sobot 网络电话可能无法连接或保持通话。

en.description: When the newer Sobot call mode starts, this foreground service connects the agent to the online calling service and manages account registration and live calls.
en.disableEffect: The newer Sobot call mode may not connect or keep agent calls active.

zh-CN.description: 新版 Sobot 呼叫模式启动时，此前台服务会连接在线呼叫服务，并管理坐席账户注册和实时通话。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 新版 Sobot 呼叫模式可能无法连接或维持坐席通话。

en.description: While the Sobot phone service is running, this receiver responds to screen-state events and scheduled alarms to refresh the phone account and keep its connection active.
en.disableEffect: The phone account may expire while the app is in the background, interrupting incoming calls.

zh-CN.description: Sobot 电话服务运行期间，此接收器会响应屏幕状态事件和定时提醒，刷新电话账户并维持连接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用在后台时电话账户可能失效，从而影响来电。

en.description: The Sobot phone service starts the internet-phone connection and reports incoming, connected, and ended calls plus account-status changes to the call screens. It stays active in the foreground during ongoing calls.
en.disableEffect: Internet calling and its call-state updates will stop working as expected.

zh-CN.description: Sobot 电话服务会启动网络电话连接，并向呼叫页面报告来电、接通、结束和账户状态变化；通话期间会保持前台运行。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 网络电话及其通话状态更新将无法正常工作。

en.description: The Sobot call SDK starts this service while setting up a background phone call on some Android versions.
en.disableEffect: The app may not keep calls active in the background on those Android versions.

zh-CN.description: 在部分 Android 版本上，Sobot 呼叫 SDK 会在设置后台通话时启动此服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 在这些 Android 版本上，应用可能无法在后台维持通话。

zh-CN.disableEffect: 坐席将无法在此页面查看通话详情和服务小结，也无法发起回拨。

en.description: During an Sobot call, this screen shows the caller, call state, and duration, and provides controls to answer or hang up. It also handles incoming and outgoing call requests.

zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户可能无法通过新版 Sobot 呼叫模式拨打、接听或管理电话。

en.description: When an agent opens a contact in an Sobot call task, this screen shows the contact, call summary, and call records, with controls to move between contacts or call the customer.
en.disableEffect: Agents cannot review or call contacts from the newer Sobot call tasks.

zh-CN.description: 坐席打开 Sobot 呼叫任务中的联系人时，此页面会显示联系人资料、通话小结和通话记录，并可切换联系人或拨打电话。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 坐席将无法查看或拨打新版 Sobot 呼叫任务中的联系人。

en.description: When an agent opens an Sobot call task, this screen shows its contacts grouped by all, unexecuted, and executed calls, along with the latest call result.
en.disableEffect: Agents cannot review or manage the newer Sobot call-task contacts from this screen.

zh-CN.description: 坐席打开 Sobot 呼叫任务时，此页面会按全部、未执行和已执行分类显示联系人，并展示最近一次通话结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 坐席将无法在此页面查看或管理新版 Sobot 呼叫任务联系人。

en.description: The Sobot call SDK opens this calendar when an agent chooses a custom date interval for call-history filtering. It returns the selected start and end dates.
en.disableEffect: Agents cannot set a custom date range for filtering call history.

zh-CN.description: 坐席为通话记录选择自定义日期范围时，Sobot 呼叫 SDK 会打开此日历，并返回所选起止日期。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 坐席将无法为通话记录设置自定义日期筛选范围。

en.description: The Sobot call SDK opens these filters for call history so agents can choose a date range, incoming or outgoing calls, and answered, missed, or failed results.
en.disableEffect: Agents cannot apply these filters to call history.

zh-CN.description: Sobot 呼叫 SDK 会在通话记录筛选时打开此页面，供坐席选择日期范围、呼入或呼出，以及接通、未接或失败状态。
