zh-CN.description: 当用户为离线留言选择已保存的模板时，Sobot 客服聊天 SDK 会显示此对话框。它加载所选模板的表单设置并将其返回留言流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在离线留言流程中使用已保存的模板。

en.description: When a support form asks for a province, city, or other region, Sobot's customer-service chat SDK shows this dialog. It loads the region levels and returns the selected location.
en.disableEffect: The user will not be able to complete the region field in the support form.

zh-CN.description: 当客服表单要求填写省、市或其他地区时，Sobot 客服聊天 SDK 会显示此对话框。它加载各级地区选项并返回所选地点。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法填写客服表单中的地区字段。

en.description: When a user replies to a support request, Sobot's customer-service chat SDK shows this dialog. It collects a reply, supports photo or video attachments, and submits it.
en.disableEffect: The user will not be able to reply to the support request through Sobot chat.

zh-CN.description: 当用户回复客服请求时，Sobot 客服聊天 SDK 会显示此对话框。它收集回复内容、支持添加照片或视频，并提交回复。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 Sobot 聊天回复客服请求。

en.description: When a user switches to another automated assistant in the chat, Sobot's customer-service chat SDK shows this dialog. It lists available robots and returns the selected assistant.
en.disableEffect: The user will not be able to switch automated assistants in Sobot chat.

zh-CN.description: 当用户在聊天中切换到另一位自动客服时，Sobot 客服聊天 SDK 会显示此对话框。它列出可用的机器人并返回所选助手。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在 Sobot 聊天中切换自动客服。

en.description: When a user chooses which support team should receive the conversation, Sobot's customer-service chat SDK shows this dialog. It loads available support teams and returns the chosen destination.
en.disableEffect: The user will not be able to choose a support team for the conversation.

zh-CN.description: 当用户选择负责此会话的客服团队时，Sobot 客服聊天 SDK 会显示此对话框。它加载可用客服团队并返回所选团队。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法为会话选择客服团队。

en.description: When a user is asked to rate a support ticket’s resolution, Sobot's customer-service chat SDK shows this dialog. It collects a score and optional comments and submits the ticket evaluation.
en.disableEffect: The user will not be able to rate the resolution of the support ticket.

zh-CN.description: 当用户需要评价客服工单的处理结果时，Sobot 客服聊天 SDK 会显示此对话框。它收集评分和可选意见并提交工单评价。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法评价该客服工单的处理结果。

en.description: When a custom form asks the user to choose a time zone, Sobot's customer-service chat SDK shows this dialog. It loads the time-zone choices and returns the selected value.
en.disableEffect: The user will not be able to fill the time-zone field in the Sobot form.

zh-CN.description: 当自定义表单要求用户选择时区时，Sobot 客服聊天 SDK 会显示此对话框。它加载时区选项并返回所选值。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法填写 Sobot 表单中的时区字段。

en.description: When a user needs to search and select a time zone for a form, Sobot's customer-service chat SDK shows this dialog. It filters the available time zones and returns the selected value.
en.disableEffect: The user will not be able to search for or choose a time zone in the form.

zh-CN.description: 当用户需要为表单搜索并选择时区时，Sobot 客服聊天 SDK 会显示此对话框。它筛选可用时区并返回所选值。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在表单中搜索或选择时区。

en.description: When a user starts a Sobot customer-service conversation, Sobot's customer-service chat SDK opens this page. It hosts the live chat screen for exchanging messages with the support service.
en.disableEffect: The user will not be able to open Sobot’s customer-service chat.

zh-CN.description: 当用户开始 Sobot 客服会话时，Sobot 客服聊天 SDK 会打开此页面。它承载与客服服务交换消息的实时聊天页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开 Sobot 客服聊天。

en.description: When a user starts or continues a live Sobot chat session, Sobot's customer-service chat SDK runs this service. It maintains the live message connection and responds to network changes so messages can reach the conversation.
en.disableEffect: Live messages may stop arriving or updating in real time in Sobot chat.

zh-CN.description: 当用户开始或继续 Sobot 实时客服会话时，Sobot 客服聊天 SDK 会运行此 Service。它维持实时消息连接并响应网络变化，让消息送达会话。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Sobot 聊天中的实时消息可能无法继续送达或更新。

en.description: When Sobot chat needs to open or share an attachment stored by the app, Sobot's customer-service chat SDK makes this provider available to Android. It provides Android with a shareable file link for the attachment.
en.disableEffect: Chat attachments may fail to open or be shared from app storage.

zh-CN.description: 当Sobot 聊天需要打开或分享应用保存的附件时，Sobot 客服聊天 SDK 会向 Android 提供此 Provider。它向 Android 提供可分享的附件文件链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 聊天附件可能无法从应用存储中打开或分享。

en.description: The Sobot customer-service chat SDK starts this Service when its chat page opens or returns to the foreground. It handles incoming session updates and can show new-message notifications.
en.disableEffect: Sobot background customer-service notifications and pushed session updates will stop.

zh-CN.description: Sobot 客服聊天 SDK 会在聊天页面打开或返回前台时启动此 Service，用于处理会话更新，并可显示新消息通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Sobot 聊天后台收到的会话更新和新消息通知将无法处理。

en.description: When a user chooses to clear Sobot conversation history, Sobot's customer-service chat SDK shows this dialog. It asks the user to confirm the clear-history action.
en.disableEffect: The user will not be able to clear conversation history from Sobot chat.

zh-CN.description: 当用户选择清除 Sobot 会话记录时，Sobot 客服聊天 SDK 会显示此对话框。它请用户确认清除记录的操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法从 Sobot 聊天中清除会话记录。

en.description: When a user is asked to rate a customer-service conversation, Sobot's customer-service chat SDK shows this dialog. It collects a satisfaction score and optional comment and submits the evaluation.
en.disableEffect: The user will not be able to submit a satisfaction rating for the Sobot support conversation.

zh-CN.description: 当用户需要评价客服会话时，Sobot 客服聊天 SDK 会显示此对话框。它收集满意度评分和可选意见并提交评价。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法提交对此次 Sobot 客服会话的满意度评价。

en.description: When a user needs to search a configured option while filling a support form, Sobot's customer-service chat SDK shows this dialog. It filters the supplied choices and returns the selected item.
en.disableEffect: The user will not be able to search for or select that form value.

zh-CN.description: 当用户在填写客服表单时需要搜索已配置的选项时，Sobot 客服聊天 SDK 会显示此对话框。它筛选传入的选项并返回所选项目。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法搜索或选择该表单值。

en.description: When a user enters a phone number with an international dialing code, Sobot's customer-service chat SDK shows this dialog. It shows searchable calling codes and returns the selected code.
en.disableEffect: The user will not be able to choose a country calling code for the phone field.

zh-CN.description: 当用户填写带国际区号的电话号码时，Sobot 客服聊天 SDK 会显示此对话框。它显示可搜索的电话区号并返回所选区号。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法为电话字段选择国家或地区区号。

en.description: When a user chooses a saved template for an offline message, Sobot's customer-service chat SDK shows this dialog. It loads the selected template’s form settings and returns them to the message flow.
en.disableEffect: The user will not be able to use saved message templates in the offline-message flow.

zh-CN.description: 当用户为离线留言选择已保存的模板时，Sobot 客服聊天 SDK 会显示此对话框。它加载所选模板的表单设置并将其返回留言流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在离线留言流程中使用已保存的模板。

en.description: When a user replies to a support request, Sobot's customer-service chat SDK shows this dialog. It collects a reply, supports photo or video attachments, and submits it.
en.disableEffect: The user will not be able to reply to the support request through Sobot chat.

zh-CN.description: 当用户回复客服请求时，Sobot 客服聊天 SDK 会显示此对话框。它收集回复内容、支持添加照片或视频，并提交回复。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 Sobot 聊天回复客服请求。

en.description: When a user switches to another automated assistant in the chat, Sobot's customer-service chat SDK shows this dialog. It lists available robots and returns the selected assistant.
en.disableEffect: The user will not be able to switch automated assistants in Sobot chat.

zh-CN.description: 当用户在聊天中切换到另一位自动客服时，Sobot 客服聊天 SDK 会显示此对话框。它列出可用的机器人并返回所选助手。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在 Sobot 聊天中切换自动客服。

en.description: When a user is asked to rate a support ticket’s resolution, Sobot's customer-service chat SDK shows this dialog. It collects a score and optional comments and submits the ticket evaluation.
en.disableEffect: The user will not be able to rate the resolution of the support ticket.

zh-CN.description: 当用户需要评价客服工单的处理结果时，Sobot 客服聊天 SDK 会显示此对话框。它收集评分和可选意见并提交工单评价。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法评价该客服工单的处理结果。

en.description: When a user needs to search and select a time zone for a form, Sobot's customer-service chat SDK shows this dialog. It filters the available time zones and returns the selected value.
en.disableEffect: The user will not be able to search for or choose a time zone in the form.

zh-CN.description: 当用户需要为表单搜索并选择时区时，Sobot 客服聊天 SDK 会显示此对话框。它筛选可用时区并返回所选值。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在表单中搜索或选择时区。

en.description: The Sobot CRM SDK opens its customer center after an agent signs in or when the app requests the customer center. It shows customer records and related customer-management tools.
en.disableEffect: Sobot CRM's customer center will not open, so agents cannot browse customers or start customer-management actions there.

zh-CN.description: Sobot CRM SDK 会在客服人员登录后或应用打开客户中心时显示客户记录及相关管理功能。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Sobot CRM 客户中心无法打开，客服人员不能在其中查看客户或进行客户管理操作。

en.description: From the customer center's add button or a customer profile's edit button, the Sobot CRM SDK opens this form to add or update a customer's name, contact details, location, and custom fields.
en.disableEffect: Agents will not be able to add or edit customer profiles through Sobot CRM.

zh-CN.description: 客服人员点击客户中心的添加按钮或客户资料中的编辑按钮时，Sobot CRM SDK 会打开此表单，用于新增或修改客户姓名、联系方式、地区及自定义字段。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，客服人员将无法通过 Sobot CRM 新增或编辑客户资料。

en.description: The Sobot CRM SDK opens this screen from a customer list or merge review to show a customer's profile and contact records. When available, it also offers profile editing and calling.
en.disableEffect: Agents will lose access to customer details and contact records in Sobot CRM, including its in-screen edit and call actions.

zh-CN.description: 客服人员从客户列表或合并核对页面打开此界面后，可以查看客户资料和联系记录；符合条件时还可编辑资料或拨打电话。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，客服人员将无法在 Sobot CRM 中查看客户详情和联系记录，也不能使用其中的编辑和拨号操作。

en.description: When opened, the Sobot CRM SDK clears the saved agent login and shows a prompt to sign in again with the supplied credentials or close the CRM session.
en.disableEffect: If Sobot CRM opens this screen after an agent session ends, the agent cannot use it to sign in again or leave the CRM session cleanly.

zh-CN.description: 此界面打开时，Sobot CRM SDK 会清除已保存的客服登录信息，并提示客服人员用提供的凭据重新登录或退出 CRM 会话。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 如果客服会话结束后 Sobot CRM 打开此界面，停用它会使客服人员无法在此重新登录或正常退出 CRM 会话。

en.description: The Sobot CRM SDK opens this screen when customer records conflict or an agent chooses records to combine. The agent selects which customer record to keep before reviewing the merge.
en.disableEffect: Agents will not be able to choose duplicate customer records for merging in Sobot CRM.

zh-CN.description: 客户记录发生冲突或客服人员选择合并记录时，Sobot CRM SDK 会打开此界面，让客服人员选择要保留的客户资料并继续核对。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，客服人员将无法在 Sobot CRM 中选择重复客户资料进行合并。

en.description: After a customer is selected for merging, the Sobot CRM SDK shows the customer information for review and applies the merge when the agent taps save.
en.disableEffect: Agents will not be able to review and confirm customer merges in Sobot CRM.

zh-CN.description: 选择待合并的客户后，Sobot CRM SDK 会显示客户资料供客服人员核对；点击保存后才会提交合并。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，客服人员将无法在 Sobot CRM 中核对并确认客户合并。

en.description: When a Sobot CRM customer field needs a time-zone and date/time value, this screen loads available time zones and lets the user choose the value to return to that field.
en.disableEffect: Custom customer fields that require this time-zone and date/time selection will not be completed through Sobot CRM.

zh-CN.description: 当 Sobot CRM 的客户字段需要填写时区和日期时间时，此界面会加载可选时区，并让用户选择后返回字段。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Sobot CRM 中需要选择时区和日期时间的客户自定义字段将无法通过此界面完成。

en.description: The Sobot CRM SDK declares this file provider so another app can temporarily access a permitted CRM file when it receives a file link.
en.disableEffect: CRM flows that need to share one of these files through the provider may fail.

zh-CN.description: Sobot CRM SDK 声明了此文件提供程序；其他应用收到文件链接后，可临时访问获准分享的 CRM 文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要通过此提供程序分享这些文件的 CRM 流程可能会失败。

en.description: When requests a change to their service availability in Sobot Online, Sobot's Online SDK for support agents opens this page. It collects the reason and submits the status-change request.
en.disableEffect: The agent will not be able to change their service availability from this screen.

zh-CN.description: 客服人员在 Sobot Online 中申请更改接待状态时，Sobot 客服人员 Online SDK 会打开此页面。它收集更改原因并提交状态申请。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 客服人员将无法通过此页面更改接待状态。

en.description: When opens a web page linked from the agent workspace in Sobot Online, Sobot's Online SDK for support agents opens this page. It loads the page and handles navigation, downloads, and file selection.
en.disableEffect: The agent will not be able to open linked web pages from Sobot Online.

zh-CN.description: 客服人员在 Sobot Online 中打开客服工作台中的网页时，Sobot 客服人员 Online SDK 会打开此页面。它加载网页并处理导航、下载和文件选择。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 客服人员将无法在 Sobot Online 中打开相关网页。

en.description: When signs in to the Sobot agent service in Sobot Online, Sobot's Online SDK for support agents opens this page. It gets an access token, signs in, and opens the agent conversation workspace.
en.disableEffect: The agent will not be able to sign in to Sobot Online or reach its workspace.

zh-CN.description: 客服人员在 Sobot Online 中登录 Sobot 客服人员服务时，Sobot 客服人员 Online SDK 会打开此页面。它获取访问令牌、完成登录并打开客服会话工作台。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 客服人员将无法登录 Sobot Online 或进入工作台。

en.description: When attaches a new picture or video to a customer conversation in Sobot Online, Sobot's Online SDK for support agents opens this page. It opens the camera and returns a captured image or clip for sending.
en.disableEffect: The agent will not be able to capture camera media for a Sobot customer conversation.

zh-CN.description: 客服人员在 Sobot Online 中为客户会话添加新照片或视频时，Sobot 客服人员 Online SDK 会打开此页面。它打开相机并返回拍摄的图片或视频以供发送。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 客服人员将无法为 Sobot 客户会话拍摄相机附件。

en.description: When chooses a category while preparing a customer-service work order in Sobot Online, Sobot's Online SDK for support agents opens this page. It loads the available work-order categories and returns the selection.
en.disableEffect: The agent will not be able to assign a category to the work order.

zh-CN.description: 客服人员在 Sobot Online 中为客服工单选择类别时，Sobot 客服人员 Online SDK 会打开此页面。它加载可用工单类别并返回所选类别。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 客服人员将无法为工单指定类别。

en.description: When opens the customer-conversation workspace in Sobot Online, Sobot's Online SDK for support agents opens this page. It shows current and past customer conversations and lets the agent update their service availability.
en.disableEffect: The agent will not be able to view customer conversations or change service availability from this workspace.

zh-CN.description: 客服人员在 Sobot Online 中打开客户会话工作台时，Sobot 客服人员 Online SDK 会打开此页面。它显示当前及历史客户会话，并允许客服人员更改接待状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 客服人员将无法在此工作台查看客户会话或更改接待状态。

en.description: When opens a file sent by a customer in Sobot Online, Sobot's Online SDK for support agents opens this page. It shows file details and download progress, then lets the agent open the file.
en.disableEffect: The agent will not be able to download or open customer file attachments.

zh-CN.description: 客服人员在 Sobot Online 中打开客户发送的文件时，Sobot 客服人员 Online SDK 会打开此页面。它显示文件信息和下载进度，并在下载后允许打开文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 客服人员将无法下载或打开客户的文件附件。

en.description: When looks for an AI-assisted reply while answering a customer in Sobot Online, Sobot's Online SDK for support agents opens this page. It shows searchable suggested responses for the agent to use.
en.disableEffect: The agent will not be able to consult AI-assisted reply suggestions from this screen.

zh-CN.description: 客服人员在 Sobot Online 中回复客户时查找 AI 辅助回复时，Sobot 客服人员 Online SDK 会打开此页面。它显示可搜索的建议回复，供客服人员使用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 客服人员将无法通过此页面查看 AI 辅助回复建议。

en.description: When handles a live customer conversation in Sobot Online, Sobot's Online SDK for support agents opens this page. It shows the message history and supports sending text, voice, and attachments and managing the conversation.
en.disableEffect: The agent will not be able to handle the live customer conversation in Sobot Online.

zh-CN.description: 客服人员在 Sobot Online 中处理实时客户会话时，Sobot 客服人员 Online SDK 会打开此页面。它显示消息记录，并支持发送文字、语音和附件以及管理会话。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 客服人员将无法在 Sobot Online 中处理实时客户会话。

en.description: When chooses to leave or sign in again from the agent service in Sobot Online, Sobot's Online SDK for support agents opens this page. It disconnects the current service session and either exits the workspace or starts sign-in again.
en.disableEffect: The agent will not be able to exit or restart their Sobot Online session through this prompt.

zh-CN.description: 客服人员在 Sobot Online 中选择退出或重新登录客服服务时，Sobot 客服人员 Online SDK 会打开此页面。它断开当前服务会话，然后退出工作台或重新开始登录。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 客服人员将无法通过此提示退出或重新启动 Sobot Online 会话。

en.description: When blocks a customer from further service contact in Sobot Online, Sobot's Online SDK for support agents opens this page. It collects the block reason and duration and submits the customer block.
en.disableEffect: The agent will not be able to add the customer to the service block list from this screen.

zh-CN.description: 客服人员在 Sobot Online 中将客户加入限制接待名单时，Sobot 客服人员 Online SDK 会打开此页面。它收集限制原因和期限并提交客户限制操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 客服人员将无法通过此页面将客户加入限制接待名单。

en.description: When reviews or enters the reason for transferring a customer conversation in Sobot Online, Sobot's Online SDK for support agents opens this page. It shows the transfer-reason prompt and handles the agent’s choice.
en.disableEffect: The agent will not be able to complete this transfer-reason step.

zh-CN.description: 客服人员在 Sobot Online 中查看或填写转接客户会话的原因时，Sobot 客服人员 Online SDK 会打开此页面。它显示转接原因提示并处理客服人员的选择。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 客服人员将无法完成此转接原因步骤。

en.description: When transfers a customer conversation to another agent or team in Sobot Online, Sobot's Online SDK for support agents opens this page. It lists searchable agents and teams and submits the selected destination.
en.disableEffect: The agent will not be able to transfer the customer conversation to another agent or team.

zh-CN.description: 客服人员在 Sobot Online 中将客户会话转接给其他客服人员或团队时，Sobot 客服人员 Online SDK 会打开此页面。它列出可搜索的客服人员和团队，并提交所选接收方。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 客服人员将无法将客户会话转接给其他客服人员或团队。

en.description: When opens a picture sent in a customer conversation in Sobot Online, Sobot's Online SDK for support agents opens this page. It shows the image full screen and lets the agent save it to the device gallery.
en.disableEffect: The agent will not be able to preview or save customer pictures from the conversation.

zh-CN.description: 客服人员在 Sobot Online 中打开客户会话中发送的图片时，Sobot 客服人员 Online SDK 会打开此页面。它全屏显示图片，并允许客服人员保存到设备相册。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 客服人员将无法预览或保存会话中的客户图片。

en.description: When looks up a saved quick reply during a customer conversation in Sobot Online, Sobot's Online SDK for support agents opens this page. It shows the agent’s quick-reply choices in a tabbed page.
en.disableEffect: The agent will not be able to browse or use saved quick replies from this screen.

zh-CN.description: 客服人员在 Sobot Online 中在客户会话中查找已保存的快捷回复时，Sobot 客服人员 Online SDK 会打开此页面。它以分页方式显示客服人员可用的快捷回复。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 客服人员将无法通过此页面浏览或使用已保存的快捷回复。

en.description: When records a summary after serving a customer in Sobot Online, Sobot's Online SDK for support agents opens this page. It collects service status, category, and notes and saves the summary.
en.disableEffect: The agent will not be able to save the customer-service summary through this page.

zh-CN.description: 客服人员在 Sobot Online 中记录客户服务结束后的服务摘要时，Sobot 客服人员 Online SDK 会打开此页面。它收集服务状态、类别和备注并保存摘要。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 客服人员将无法通过此页面保存客户服务摘要。

en.description: When opens the customer’s profile during a conversation in Sobot Online, Sobot's Online SDK for support agents opens this page. It shows the customer-information pages in the agent workspace.
en.disableEffect: The agent will not be able to view the customer profile from Sobot Online.

zh-CN.description: 客服人员在 Sobot Online 中在会话中打开客户资料时，Sobot 客服人员 Online SDK 会打开此页面。它在客服工作台中显示客户信息页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 客服人员将无法在 Sobot Online 中查看客户资料。

en.description: When someone opens a video message in a Sobot online customer-service conversation, this Activity downloads the clip if needed and plays it with its preview.
en.disableEffect: Video messages in Sobot conversations will not open; tapping one can interrupt the conversation screen.

zh-CN.description: 在 Sobot 在线客服会话中点开视频消息时，此 Activity 会在需要时下载视频，并显示预览和播放界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Sobot 会话中的视频消息无法打开，点按视频时也可能中断当前会话页面。

en.description: Sobot customer-service profile and summary screens use this popup to choose a supplied option, such as a summary status or visitor grade. It can filter the list when search is enabled.
en.disableEffect: The related Sobot profile or conversation-summary choice will not open or return its selection.

zh-CN.description: Sobot 在线客服的资料页和会话小结页会用此弹窗选择当前页面提供的选项，例如小结状态或用户等级；启用搜索时也可筛选选项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，相关资料或会话小结选项无法打开或返回。

en.description: In the Sobot customer-service profile, this screen opens from the enterprise field, searches the available enterprise list, and returns the selected company to the profile.
en.disableEffect: A service agent will be unable to search for or set a visitor company from that profile.

zh-CN.description: 在 Sobot 在线客服资料页点击企业字段时会打开此界面；它会搜索企业列表，并将所选企业返回资料页。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，客服人员无法在该资料页搜索或设置用户所属企业。

en.description: The Sobot conversation-summary form opens this screen to search business or operation categories for the current conversation and returns the selected item to the form.
en.disableEffect: The summary form cannot search for and apply its business category.

zh-CN.description: 填写 Sobot 在线客服会话小结时，此界面会搜索当前会话可选的业务类别，并把选中的类别返回表单。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，小结表单无法搜索和选择业务类别。

en.description: In Sobot online-service history, this screen searches past conversation messages or visitor records, depending on the selected list. Selecting a result reopens that conversation.
en.disableEffect: Service agents cannot search these history records and reopen a matching conversation from the results.

zh-CN.description: 在 Sobot 在线客服历史记录中，此界面会根据当前列表搜索历史会话消息或访客记录；点选结果可重新打开对应会话。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，客服人员无法通过这些历史列表搜索记录并重新打开匹配会话。

en.description: The Sobot customer-service reception list opens this screen to find visitors by keyword. Selecting a result opens the chat and clears its unread count.
en.disableEffect: Service agents cannot search the reception list by keyword or open a matching conversation from the results.

zh-CN.description: Sobot 在线客服接待列表通过此界面按关键词搜索访客；选择结果会打开会话并清除其未读数。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，客服人员无法在接待列表中按关键词查找并打开会话。

en.description: When filtering Sobot customer-service history, this screen sets a date range and, depending on the list, reception scope, conversation-summary status, or visitor-mark status. Saving returns the filters to the list.
en.disableEffect: The corresponding Sobot history list cannot use these date and status filters.

zh-CN.description: 筛选 Sobot 在线客服历史列表时，此界面可按日期范围及列表类型设置接待范围、小结状态或用户标记，并将选择返回列表。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，对应历史列表无法使用这些日期和状态筛选条件。

en.description: The Sobot conversation-summary form opens this screen to browse business-type categories and return the selected category list to the form.
en.disableEffect: Service agents cannot complete the business-type selection in a conversation summary.

zh-CN.description: 填写 Sobot 在线客服会话小结时，此界面可浏览业务类别层级并把所选类别返回表单。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，客服人员无法完成会话小结中的业务类别选择。

en.description: The Sobot online customer-service SDK uses this FileProvider to create content links for local conversation files and grant other apps temporary read access when opening them.
en.disableEffect: Opening or sharing a local file from an Sobot conversation may fail.

zh-CN.description: Sobot 在线客服 SDK 使用此 FileProvider 为会话中的本地文件生成内容地址，并在交给其他应用打开时授予临时读取权限。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Sobot 会话中的本地文件可能无法交给其他应用打开或分享。

en.description: The Sobot customer-service SDK starts this Service after a service-agent login to maintain and reconnect its live connection. It passes incoming visitor messages to the app and can show new-message notifications.
en.disableEffect: The Sobot service console stops receiving live messages and related new-message notifications while this Service is disabled.

zh-CN.description: 客服人员登录 Sobot 在线客服后会启动此 Service，以维持实时连接并在网络变化后重连；它会把收到的访客消息传给应用，也可显示新消息通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Sobot 客服控制台将无法接收实时消息和相关的新消息通知。

en.description: When an agent chooses manual dialing, the Sobot customer-service call SDK opens this keypad. The agent enters a number and the screen starts an outbound call.
en.disableEffect: Agents cannot place manual calls from the Sobot call workspace.

zh-CN.description: 坐席选择手动拨号时，Sobot 客服呼叫 SDK 会打开此拨号键盘；坐席输入号码后页面会发起外呼。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 坐席将无法从 Sobot 呼叫工作台手动拨打电话。

en.description: During an Sobot internet-phone call, this screen shows the number and live status and provides answer and hang-up controls. Outgoing calls start through the Sobot call service.
en.disableEffect: Users may be unable to place, answer, or end older Sobot calls.

zh-CN.description: Sobot 网络电话期间，此页面会显示号码和实时状态，并提供接听和挂断操作；外呼通过 Sobot 电话服务发起。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户可能无法拨打、接听或结束旧版 Sobot 电话。

en.description: While the Sobot phone service is running, this receiver responds to screen-state events and scheduled alarms to refresh the phone account and keep its connection active.
en.disableEffect: The phone account may expire while the app is in the background, interrupting incoming calls.

zh-CN.description: Sobot 电话服务运行期间，此接收器会响应屏幕状态事件和定时提醒，刷新电话账户并维持连接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用在后台时电话账户可能失效，从而影响来电。

en.description: The Sobot phone service starts the internet-phone connection and reports incoming, connected, and ended calls plus account-status changes to the call screens. It stays active in the foreground during ongoing calls.
en.disableEffect: Internet calling and its call-state updates will stop working as expected.

zh-CN.description: Sobot 电话服务会启动网络电话连接，并向呼叫页面报告来电、接通、结束和账户状态变化；通话期间会保持前台运行。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 网络电话及其通话状态更新将无法正常工作。

en.description: When the host app opens Sobot telemarketing, this screen loads the telemarketing workspace where agents sign in, review calling tasks, and work through customer calls.
en.disableEffect: The app’s Sobot telemarketing workspace and its calling-task functions will be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: 宿主应用打开 Sobot 电销功能时，此页面会显示电销工作台，供坐席登录、查看呼叫任务并联系客户。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用中的 Sobot 电销工作台及其呼叫任务功能将无法使用。

en.description: The Sobot telemarketing SDK opens this calendar when an agent selects a custom date interval for filtering call records. It returns the chosen start and end dates.
en.disableEffect: Agents cannot set a custom date range for telemarketing call-history filtering.

zh-CN.description: 坐席为电销通话记录选择自定义日期范围时，Sobot 电销 SDK 会打开此日历并返回起止日期。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 坐席将无法为电销通话记录设置自定义日期筛选范围。

en.description: The Sobot telemarketing SDK opens these history filters so agents can choose a date range, call type, and call result.
en.disableEffect: Agents cannot apply these filters to telemarketing call history.

zh-CN.description: Sobot 电销 SDK 会在筛选通话记录时打开此页面，供坐席选择日期范围、呼叫类型和通话结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 坐席将无法对电销通话记录应用这些筛选条件。

en.description: When an agent opens a telemarketing call record, this screen shows call information, customer details, and follow-up records. It can start a callback when the call service permits it.
en.disableEffect: Agents cannot review telemarketing call details or use related customer and follow-up actions here.

zh-CN.description: 坐席打开电销通话记录时，此页面会显示通话信息、客户资料和跟进记录；呼叫服务允许时还可发起回拨。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 坐席将无法在此页面查看电销通话详情或使用相关客户和跟进操作。

en.description: When an agent chooses manual telemarketing, this screen provides a number keypad and country calling-code selection before starting the call.
en.disableEffect: Agents cannot manually dial customers through the Sobot telemarketing SDK.

zh-CN.description: 坐席选择手动电销时，此页面会提供号码键盘和国家区号选择，然后发起呼叫。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 坐席将无法通过 Sobot 电销 SDK 手动拨打客户电话。

en.description: When an agent signs in to Sobot telemarketing, this screen collects the agent’s availability, call type, extension, phone, and queue choices.
en.disableEffect: Agents cannot sign in to the Sobot telemarketing service through this screen.

zh-CN.description: 坐席登录 Sobot 电销服务时，此页面会收集在线状态、呼叫类型、分机、电话和队列选择。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 坐席将无法通过此页面登录 Sobot 电销服务。

en.description: After an agent signs in to telemarketing, this screen shows the bound phone or extension and assigned groups. It also supports speech-code changes and signing out.
en.disableEffect: Agents cannot view or manage their current telemarketing sign-in details from this screen.

zh-CN.description: 坐席登录电销服务后，此页面会显示已绑定的电话或分机及所属队列，也支持更改语音编码和退出登录。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 坐席将无法在此页面查看或管理当前电销登录信息。

en.description: During a Sobot telemarketing call, this screen shows the customer and agent call state and provides answer, hang-up, and in-call controls. It handles incoming and outgoing call launches.
en.disableEffect: Agents may be unable to place, answer, or manage telemarketing calls.

zh-CN.description: Sobot 电销通话期间，此页面会显示客户和坐席的通话状态，并提供接听、挂断及通话中操作；页面处理呼入和呼出启动请求。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 坐席可能无法拨打、接听或管理电销电话。

en.description: When an agent opens a customer in a telemarketing task, this screen shows contact details, call summary, and call records, with controls to move between contacts or call the customer.
en.disableEffect: Agents cannot review or call contacts from Sobot telemarketing tasks.

zh-CN.description: 坐席打开电销任务中的客户时，此页面会显示联系人资料、通话小结和通话记录，并可切换联系人或拨打电话。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 坐席将无法查看或拨打 Sobot 电销任务中的客户。

en.description: When an agent opens a Sobot telemarketing task, this screen shows the task’s contacts grouped by all, unexecuted, and executed calls, together with the latest call result.
en.disableEffect: Agents cannot review or manage the contacts in Sobot telemarketing tasks from this screen.

zh-CN.description: 坐席打开 Sobot 电销任务时，此页面会按全部、未执行和已执行分类显示联系人，并展示最近一次通话结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 坐席将无法在此页面查看或管理 Sobot 电销任务联系人。

en.description: When Sobot telemarketing starts a call, this foreground service keeps the agent’s internet-phone connection active and sends call-state updates.
en.disableEffect: Sobot telemarketing calls may not connect or stay active.

zh-CN.description: Sobot 电销发起呼叫时，此前台服务会维持坐席的网络电话连接并发送通话状态更新。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Sobot 电销电话可能无法连接或保持通话。

en.description: The Sobot support widget opens this screen when its image or video attachment picker is requested. It lists matching local media and returns the item the user selects.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to choose local images or videos through this Sobot attachment picker.

zh-CN.description: 请求选择图片或视频附件时，Sobot 客服组件会打开此界面。它会列出匹配的本地媒体，并返回用户选中的项目。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法通过此 Sobot 附件选择器选择本地图片或视频。

en.description: When the Sobot widget opens the camera to capture a picture, this provider gives the camera temporary access to the output file.
en.disableEffect: The camera may not be able to save a picture for the Sobot widget to attach.

zh-CN.description: 使用 Sobot 客服组件打开相机拍照时，此提供程序会授予相机对输出文件的临时访问权限。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，相机可能无法保存供 Sobot 客服组件添加的照片。

en.description: The Sobot widget opens this page when a user taps an ordinary web link in a Sobot message. It loads the page inside the app and can handle page file selection and download links.
en.disableEffect: Users may be unable to open ordinary Sobot message links inside the app or submit files on pages opened there.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击 Sobot 消息中的普通网页链接时，Sobot 客服组件会在应用内打开此页面。它会加载网页，并可处理网页文件选择和下载链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户可能无法在应用内打开 Sobot 消息中的普通网页链接，也无法向在此打开的网页提交文件。

en.description: When a Sobot work order needs reactivation, this page lets the support user set its status, priority, team and handler, add a note, and submit the change.
en.disableEffect: The work order cannot be reactivated or reassigned through this flow.

zh-CN.description: Sobot 工单需要重新启用时会打开此页面，支持人员可设置状态、优先级、负责团队和处理人，填写备注并提交变更。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 无法通过此流程重新启用或重新分配工单。

en.description: When a Sobot work-order form needs a custom-field choice, this page shows the field's available options and returns the user's selection.
en.disableEffect: The affected custom field cannot be completed in the work-order form.

zh-CN.description: Sobot 工单表单需要填写自定义字段时，此页面会显示可选值，并将用户的选择返回给表单。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 工单表单中的相关自定义字段将无法填写。

en.description: When a work-order field depends on an earlier group choice, this page loads matching sub-options and returns the selected values.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot complete grouped custom fields in the affected work-order form.

zh-CN.description: 工单字段依赖前一级分组选项时，此页面会加载相应的子选项，并返回用户选中的值。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法填写相关工单表单中的分组自定义字段。

en.description: When the Sobot work-order sign-in needs recovery, this dialog offers a retry with saved credentials or closes the work-order screens.
en.disableEffect: Users may be unable to restore the Sobot work-order session and continue support work.

zh-CN.description: Sobot 工单登录需要恢复时，此对话框可使用已保存的账号信息重试，或关闭工单页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户可能无法恢复 Sobot 工单会话并继续处理工单。

en.description: When a work-order image attachment is opened, this page displays it full-screen and downloads remote or animated images when needed.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot preview attached photos or animated images in the work-order flow.

zh-CN.description: 打开工单图片附件时，此页面会全屏显示图片，并在需要时下载远程图片或动画图片。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在工单流程中预览照片或动画图片。

en.description: When a work-order form asks for a time and time zone, this page loads available zones and lets the user choose the time value.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot select time-zone and time values for the affected work-order fields.

zh-CN.description: 工单表单需要填写时区和时间时，此页面会加载可用时区并让用户选择相应时间。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法为相关工单字段选择时区和时间。

en.description: When a Sobot work-order video attachment is opened, this page downloads it if needed and plays it full-screen.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot play the affected work-order video attachment.

zh-CN.description: 打开 Sobot 工单视频附件时，此页面会在需要时下载视频并进行全屏播放。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法播放相关工单视频附件。

en.description: This page adds a work-order customer or contact by collecting a required name and optional email and phone number, then returns the new user to the ticket flow.
en.disableEffect: A new customer or contact cannot be added while handling a work order.

zh-CN.description: 此页面通过填写必需的姓名和可选的邮箱、电话来添加工单客户或联系人，并将新用户返回工单流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 处理工单时将无法添加新的客户或联系人。

en.description: When a work-order field offers linked choices, this page walks through the dependent options and returns the selected path.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot complete the affected cascading custom field.

zh-CN.description: 工单字段包含关联选项时，此页面会逐级显示依赖选项，并返回用户选择的路径。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法填写相关的级联自定义字段。

en.description: When the user chooses a work-order category, this page loads child categories for the selected parent and returns the chosen category.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot select the affected work-order category.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择工单类别时，此页面会根据所选上级类别加载子类别，并返回选中的类别。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法选择相关工单类别。

en.description: After Sobot work-order sign-in, this page presents the category-based entry to ticket flows and opens the selected work-order path.
en.disableEffect: Users signed into Sobot work-order support cannot reach its category-based entry screen.

zh-CN.description: Sobot 工单登录后，此页面会显示按类别进入工单流程的入口，并打开用户选择的流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户登录 Sobot 工单支持后，将无法进入按类别选择的页面。

en.description: This form collects work-order details, required custom fields, and attachments. Depending on how it was opened, it submits a new ticket or a reply.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot create a Sobot work order or send a reply through this form.

zh-CN.description: 此表单收集工单详情、必填自定义字段和附件。根据进入方式，它会提交新工单或回复。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此表单创建 Sobot 工单或发送回复。

en.description: When a ticket is selected, this page loads its details, activity, and attachments, with actions to accept, reply, activate, or follow the ticket.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot view or manage the affected Sobot work-order ticket.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择工单后，此页面会加载工单详情、动态和附件，并提供接单、回复、重新启用或关注工单等操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法查看或处理相关 Sobot 工单。

en.description: When a user opens a ticket attachment, this page downloads it on request and opens the saved file with a compatible app.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot download or open the affected ticket attachment through Sobot.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开工单附件时，此页面会按需下载附件，并使用兼容的应用打开已保存文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 Sobot 下载或打开相关工单附件。

en.description: The work-order form uses this searchable list to choose an option such as a support team or handler, then returns the chosen item.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot select the affected work-order option.

zh-CN.description: 工单表单使用此可搜索列表来选择负责团队或处理人等选项，并返回选中的项目。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法选择相关工单选项。

en.description: This page searches Sobot tickets using entered text and the current task or status filters, then lets the user open a result.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot search for or open work orders from this search screen.

zh-CN.description: 此页面会根据用户输入的文字及当前任务或状态筛选条件搜索 Sobot 工单，并可打开搜索结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此搜索页面查找或打开工单。

en.description: This page loads a paged list of Sobot tickets for the current task and status filters; tapping a row opens ticket details.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot browse or open tickets from this work-order list.

zh-CN.description: 此页面会按当前任务和状态筛选条件分页加载 Sobot 工单列表，点击条目可打开工单详情。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此工单列表浏览或打开工单。

en.description: In the work-order flow, this page searches the app's user list and returns a selected customer or user.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot search for or select an existing customer in this work-order flow.

zh-CN.description: 在工单流程中，此页面会搜索应用的用户列表，并返回选中的客户或用户。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在此工单流程中搜索或选择已有客户。

en.description: When a Sobot work-order video attachment is opened, this page downloads it if needed and plays it full-screen.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot play the affected work-order video attachment.

zh-CN.description: 打开 Sobot 工单视频附件时，此页面会在需要时下载视频并进行全屏播放。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法播放相关工单视频附件。

en.description: When a user taps a web link in Sobot work-order content, this page shows the page or supplied HTML in an in-app browser with navigation, refresh, and file-selection controls.
en.disableEffect: Sobot work-order links and embedded web forms will no longer open in the app.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击 Sobot 工单内容中的网页链接时，此页面会在应用内显示网页或提供的 HTML，并支持导航、刷新和选择文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Sobot 工单中的链接和内嵌网页表单将无法在应用中打开。

en.description: Sobot uses this file-sharing component to pass downloaded ticket attachments to the viewer or another app.
en.disableEffect: Opening or sharing downloaded work-order files can fail, and some attachment flows may crash.

zh-CN.description: Sobot 使用此文件共享组件，将已下载的工单附件交给预览器或其他应用打开。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 打开或共享已下载的工单文件可能失败，部分附件流程也可能崩溃。

en.description: When a Sobot work-order flow requires extra closing fields, this page collects those values and any attached files before returning them to the ticket flow.
en.disableEffect: Closing or updating a work order may fail when these required details cannot be supplied.

zh-CN.description: Sobot 工单流程需要填写额外的关闭字段时，此页面会收集字段值和附件，再返回工单流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 无法提供这些必填信息时，关闭或更新工单可能失败。

en.description: Josy Issac’s Social API uses this transparent screen for Facebook sign-in when the app selects Facebook. It requests profile and email access, then returns the sign-in result to the app.
en.disableEffect: Facebook sign-in through this library will fail, so any app login flow that depends on it cannot continue.

zh-CN.description: 应用选择 Facebook 登录时，Josy Issac 的 Social API 会通过此透明页面启动 Facebook 登录。它会请求个人资料和邮箱权限，然后将登录结果返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 此库提供的 Facebook 登录将无法完成，依赖它的应用登录流程也会中断。

en.description: When a user opens the configured Sodyo chat, this page loads the chat service inside the app and relays page actions.
en.disableEffect: The Sodyo chat screen will not open, so in-app chat support may be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开已配置的 Sodyo 聊天入口时，此页面会在应用中加载聊天服务并传递页面操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Sodyo 聊天页面将无法打开，应用内聊天支持可能不可用。

en.description: Sodyo's scanner tuning screen lets a user view and adjust saved color filters used when reading visual markers.
en.disableEffect: Saved scanner color adjustments cannot be changed from this screen.

zh-CN.description: Sodyo 扫描器调节页面可查看和调整识别视觉标记时使用的颜色预设。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此页面更改扫描器颜色设置。

en.description: Sodyo's image test screen lets a user choose a saved picture and scan the original or processed image for a visual marker.
en.disableEffect: Testing Sodyo marker scans on saved pictures will no longer be available.

zh-CN.description: Sodyo 图片测试页面可选择已保存的图片，并扫描原图或处理后的图片以查找视觉标记。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法使用已保存的图片测试 Sodyo 标记扫描。

en.description: This page opens Sodyo's scanner settings, including test options, scan history, and tools for importing, exporting, or resetting settings.
en.disableEffect: Sodyo's scanner settings and test controls cannot be opened.

zh-CN.description: 此页面提供 Sodyo 扫描器设置，包括测试选项、扫描记录以及导入、导出或重置设置的工具。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Sodyo 扫描器设置和测试控件将无法打开。

en.description: When a Sodyo visual marker is opened, this full-screen page displays the marker's hosted digital experience, including content linked to a new scan or replay.
en.disableEffect: Sodyo's marker-linked hosted experience will not appear.

zh-CN.description: 打开 Sodyo 视觉标记时，此全屏页面会显示该标记关联的数字内容，包括新扫描或重播的内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Sodyo 标记关联的页面将不会显示。

en.description: During Sodyo scanner troubleshooting, this page collects the user's name, email, issue type, and description, then submits the details for support.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot submit issue details through Sodyo's troubleshooting flow.

zh-CN.description: 排查 Sodyo 扫描器问题时，此页面会收集用户姓名、邮箱、问题类型和描述，并提交给支持团队。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 Sodyo 故障排查流程提交问题详情。

en.description: As part of Sodyo scanner troubleshooting, this page shows a captured screen and continues to the problem-details form.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot review the captured screen or continue the Sodyo screenshot-based troubleshooting report.

zh-CN.description: 作为 Sodyo 扫描器故障排查的一部分，此页面会显示捕获的屏幕，并继续进入问题详情表单。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法查看捕获的屏幕或继续提交基于截图的 Sodyo 故障报告。

en.description: When Sodyo content opens a web page or configured page action, this screen displays it and can return the user to the marker scanner.
en.disableEffect: Marker-linked web pages and any task they provide may stop working in the Sodyo flow.

zh-CN.description: Sodyo 内容打开网页或配置的页面操作时，此页面会显示相应内容，并可返回视觉标记扫描器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Sodyo 流程中的标记关联网页及其提供的功能可能无法使用。

en.description: When the app opens Sodyo scanning, this screen displays the scanner used to read visual markers and start their linked experiences.
en.disableEffect: The app's Sodyo marker-scanning feature and the experiences it opens will be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动 Sodyo 扫描时，此页面会显示用于识别视觉标记并打开关联内容的扫描器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用的 Sodyo 标记扫描功能及其关联内容将无法使用。

en.description: When a ShakeBug report starts, this screen shows the captured app image for markup and optional screen recording, then continues to the report form.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot annotate the captured image or add a screen recording in the ShakeBug report flow.

zh-CN.description: 启动 ShakeBug 报告时，此页面会显示捕获的应用画面供用户标注或录制屏幕，然后进入报告表单。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在 ShakeBug 报告流程中标注截图或添加屏幕录制。

en.description: After the user reviews a ShakeBug issue, this screen collects a description and email and submits the image and optional video.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot submit in-app ShakeBug bug reports.

zh-CN.description: 用户查看 ShakeBug 问题后，此页面会收集描述和邮箱，并提交截图及可选视频。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法提交应用内的 ShakeBug 问题报告。

en.description: When ShakeBug opens its first-use introduction, this full-screen page shows the splash image and closes when tapped.
en.disableEffect: The ShakeBug first-use introduction will not appear.

zh-CN.description: ShakeBug 首次打开介绍时，此全屏页面会显示启动图片，用户点击后关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: ShakeBug 首次使用时将不再显示介绍页面。

en.description: When the user taps Stop Recording on the ShakeBug recording notification, this receiver stops the screen-recording service.
en.disableEffect: The notification's stop action will not stop the ShakeBug recording service.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击 ShakeBug 录屏通知中的停止按钮时，此接收器会停止屏幕录制服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 点击通知中的停止按钮将无法停止 ShakeBug 录屏服务。

en.description: After the user approves screen capture for a ShakeBug report, this foreground service records the screen and stores the video for the report.
en.disableEffect: ShakeBug reports will not include a screen recording captured during the report.

zh-CN.description: 用户允许 ShakeBug 报告进行屏幕捕获后，此前台服务会录制屏幕并保存报告视频。
zh-CN.disableEffect: ShakeBug 报告将无法包含本次报告期间录制的屏幕视频。

en.description: Before a ShakeBug report sends a video, this screen lets the user trim the recording to the allowed length and returns the trimmed clip.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot trim a screen recording before adding it to a ShakeBug report.

zh-CN.description: ShakeBug 报告发送视频前，此页面可让用户将录屏剪辑到允许的时长，并返回剪辑后的视频。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在添加到 ShakeBug 报告前剪辑屏幕录制。

en.description: ShakeBug uses this provider to make private recording files available to its video trimmer and report screen.
en.disableEffect: ShakeBug video preview, trimming, or attaching a recording can fail.

zh-CN.description: ShakeBug 使用此文件提供组件，将私有录屏文件交给视频剪辑页面和报告页面使用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: ShakeBug 视频预览、剪辑或添加录屏可能失败。

en.description: The VisibleDebugTool visible_logcat library starts this service when its floating log viewer is enabled. It places the live log panel over other apps and handles searches from that panel.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it removes the floating log panel and its search and clear controls, while the host app continues to work normally.

zh-CN.description: VisibleDebugTool visible_logcat 日志库在启用悬浮日志查看器时启动此服务。它会把实时日志面板显示在其他应用上方，并处理面板中的搜索操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，悬浮日志面板及其搜索和清除功能不可用，宿主应用仍可正常使用。

en.description: The VisibleDebugTool library opens this screen when its log panel needs permission to appear over other apps. It sends the user to Android overlay settings and checks the result when they return.
en.disableEffect: The log panel can no longer request the required overlay access, so it cannot be enabled through this library; normal app features remain available.

zh-CN.description: VisibleDebugTool 日志库在悬浮日志面板需要显示在其他应用上方时打开此页面。它会引导用户进入 Android 悬浮窗设置，并在用户返回后检查授权结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 日志面板无法再通过此库申请所需的悬浮窗权限，因此无法启用；应用的正常功能仍可使用。

en.description: The VisibleDebugTool library opens this screen when a user chooses to search the displayed logs. It asks for a search word and applies it to the floating log panel.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it removes the log search screen, while the host app continues to work normally.

zh-CN.description: VisibleDebugTool 日志库在用户选择搜索日志时打开此页面。页面会要求输入搜索词，并将筛选结果显示在悬浮日志面板中。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后将无法使用日志搜索页面，但不会影响宿主应用的正常功能。

en.description: The VisibleDebugTool library opens this screen from its log panel to change the panel background, text size, and saved log filters.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it removes access to the log viewer settings, while the host app continues to work normally.

zh-CN.description: VisibleDebugTool 日志库从日志面板打开此设置页面，供用户调整面板背景、文字大小和已保存的日志筛选词。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后将无法进入日志查看器设置，宿主应用仍可正常使用。

en.description: Flare Side Engine (SAMDev313) opens this screen after detecting a possible incident. It shows a countdown and incident location so the user can cancel or continue the alert.
en.disableEffect: The incident-confirmation screen will not open, preventing the user from reviewing or canceling the alert there.

zh-CN.description: Flare Side Engine（SAMDev313）检测到可能的事故后会打开此页面，显示倒计时和事故位置，供用户取消或继续发送警报。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，事故确认页面将无法打开，用户也无法在此查看或取消警报。

en.description: When Flare Side Engine (SAMDev313) schedules an alarm while the app is in the background, this receiver restarts its location-monitoring service.
en.disableEffect: Background alarms will no longer restart Flare location monitoring, so incident monitoring in the background can stop.

zh-CN.description: 应用在后台时，Flare Side Engine（SAMDev313）设置的闹钟会触发此接收器重新启动定位监控服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，后台闹钟将无法重启 Flare 定位监控，后台事故监控可能中断。

en.description: Flare Side Engine (SAMDev313) opens this page from its incident screen and loads a video survey. The user can attach an image or video from the camera or storage.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open this survey page or submit its requested media from the incident flow.

zh-CN.description: Flare Side Engine（SAMDev313）会从事故页面打开此页面并加载视频问卷，用户可通过相机或存储空间添加图片或视频。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法从事故流程打开此问卷页面或提交所需媒体。

en.description: Flare Side Engine (SAMDev313) runs this service during incident monitoring, collecting location updates and sharing them with its incident-handling screens.
en.disableEffect: Location-based incident detection, incident locations, and location updates from Flare will stop working.

zh-CN.description: Flare Side Engine（SAMDev313）在事故监控期间运行此服务，收集定位更新并提供给事故处理页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Flare 的基于位置的事故检测、事故位置显示和定位更新将无法工作。

en.description: The Android Crop image library opens this Activity when an app requests a photo crop, letting the user adjust the crop and return the saved image.
en.disableEffect: Photo flows that use Android Crop will fail to open their crop screen and cannot return the edited image.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求裁剪照片时，Android Crop 图像库会打开此 Activity，让用户调整裁剪范围并返回保存后的图片。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用 Android Crop 的照片流程将无法打开裁剪界面，也无法返回编辑后的图片。

en.description: When Source Analyst resolves a campaign or referral destination, this Activity opens the page inside the app and supports file selection requested by the page.
en.disableEffect: The Source Analyst campaign or referral page will no longer open inside the app.

zh-CN.description: Source Analyst 解析出推广或引荐目的网页后会在应用内打开该页面，也会响应网页发起的文件选择。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Source Analyst 的推广或引荐网页无法在应用内打开。

en.description: When Source Analyst resolves a campaign or referral destination, this Activity opens the page inside the app and supports file selection requested by the page.
en.disableEffect: The Source Analyst campaign or referral page will no longer open inside the app.

zh-CN.description: Source Analyst 解析出推广或引荐目的网页后会在应用内打开该页面，也会响应网页发起的文件选择。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Source Analyst 的推广或引荐网页无法在应用内打开。

en.description: When the Spalla SDK player casts playback to another device, it opens the expanded cast controls screen and adds a button for choosing the playback device.
en.disableEffect: The expanded controls screen for Spalla casting will not open.

zh-CN.description: Spalla SDK 播放器开始投放到其他设备时，会打开扩展的投屏控制页面，并提供选择播放设备的按钮。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Spalla 投屏时无法打开扩展控制页面。

en.description: When the host app requests full-screen playback, the Spalla SDK player opens this screen for a video and accepts live-content and autoplay settings. It keeps playback in sync as the screen resumes, pauses, or closes, and can open cast controls.
en.disableEffect: The Spalla SDK's full-screen video player cannot open.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求全屏播放时，Spalla SDK 播放器会打开此页面播放指定视频，并可按请求自动开始或播放直播内容；页面恢复、暂停或关闭时也会同步控制播放器，并可打开投屏控制页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Spalla 的全屏视频播放页面无法打开。

en.description: The Sparkcentral customer-support SDK receives Firebase push messages here, updates its push token, and turns incoming support messages into notifications.
en.disableEffect: New Sparkcentral support-message notifications will stop arriving, though the app's other features remain available.

zh-CN.description: Sparkcentral 客服消息 SDK 会在此接收 Firebase 推送、更新推送令牌，并为新的客服消息显示通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Sparkcentral 的新客服消息将不再显示推送通知，但应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: The Sparkcentral customer-support SDK binds to this background service while its chat features run. It manages the SDK's user and conversation work, including loading conversations and sending messages.
en.disableEffect: Apps that use Sparkcentral chat will no longer be able to load or send support conversations.

zh-CN.description: Sparkcentral 客服消息 SDK 会在聊天功能运行时连接此后台服务，处理用户和会话操作，包括加载会话与发送消息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，使用 Sparkcentral 聊天功能的应用将无法加载或发送客服消息。

en.description: When the app opens Sparkcentral's support inbox, this screen shows the conversation list and lets users open or start a conversation.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to open the Sparkcentral inbox to browse or start support conversations.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开 Sparkcentral 客服收件箱时，此界面会显示会话列表，供用户查看或发起会话。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法打开 Sparkcentral 收件箱来查看或发起客服会话。

en.description: When a Sparkcentral support conversation is opened, this screen shows the message thread and provides the chat controls.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to read or reply to Sparkcentral support conversations.

zh-CN.description: 打开 Sparkcentral 客服会话时，此界面会显示消息记录并提供聊天操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法查看或回复 Sparkcentral 客服会话。

en.description: When a user taps a Sparkcentral message notification, this screen loads that conversation and opens the chat.
en.disableEffect: Tapping a Sparkcentral message notification will no longer open its conversation.

zh-CN.description: 用户点按 Sparkcentral 消息通知时，此界面会加载对应会话并打开聊天。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，点按 Sparkcentral 消息通知将无法打开对应会话。

en.description: When Sparkcentral broadcasts a new-message event while its conversation is not open, this receiver creates a notification for the support message.
en.disableEffect: New Sparkcentral support-message notifications will not appear.

zh-CN.description: Sparkcentral 收到新消息且对应会话未打开时，此接收器会为客服消息显示通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Sparkcentral 的新客服消息通知将不再显示。

en.description: When a user selects an image attached to a Sparkcentral conversation, this screen downloads and displays it full-screen.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to open image attachments from Sparkcentral conversations.

zh-CN.description: 用户点开 Sparkcentral 会话中的图片附件时，此界面会下载并全屏显示图片。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法打开 Sparkcentral 会话中的图片附件。

en.description: Spice Money's eKYC SDK opens this screen for the device-based verification route; it scans for nearby Bluetooth devices and returns the selected device to that flow.
en.disableEffect: Users who need Bluetooth-device verification cannot select a device and finish that eKYC route.

zh-CN.description: Spice Money eKYC SDK 会在用户选择设备验证时打开此页面，扫描附近的蓝牙设备，并将所选设备交回验证流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要蓝牙设备验证的用户将无法选择设备并完成这条 eKYC 流程。

en.description: Spice Money's eKYC SDK uses this screen for device-based biometric verification; it guides the user through consent and captures data from a supported biometric reader for verification.
en.disableEffect: The device-based biometric KYC route cannot collect and submit its verification data.

zh-CN.description: Spice Money eKYC SDK 使用此页面进行设备生物识别验证；页面会引导用户确认授权，并从受支持的生物识别设备采集验证数据。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 设备生物识别 KYC 流程将无法采集并提交验证数据。

en.description: Spice Money's eKYC SDK opens this screen for Aadhaar OTP verification; it requests and validates one-time codes, then routes the result to a completion screen.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot complete the SDK's Aadhaar OTP verification route.

zh-CN.description: Spice Money eKYC SDK 会在 Aadhaar 短信验证码验证时打开此页面；页面会请求并验证一次性验证码，然后进入结果页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法完成该 SDK 的 Aadhaar 短信验证码验证流程。

en.description: Spice Money's eKYC SDK shows this screen after an identity verification succeeds; it displays the success result and lets the user return to the app.
en.disableEffect: The verification flow loses its success and return screen, leaving users without the SDK's normal completion step.

zh-CN.description: 身份验证成功后，Spice Money eKYC SDK 会显示此页面，呈现成功结果并让用户返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 验证流程会失去成功结果和返回页面，用户无法完成 SDK 的正常收尾步骤。

en.description: Spice Money's eKYC SDK shows this screen after a KYC route completes; it retrieves the user's final details and displays the completion status.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot see the final KYC result or complete the SDK's normal completion flow.

zh-CN.description: KYC 流程结束后，Spice Money eKYC SDK 会显示此页面，获取用户最终资料并呈现完成状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法查看最终 KYC 结果或完成 SDK 的正常收尾流程。

en.description: When opened, Spice Money's eKYC help screen presents a YouTube tutorial preview with play and close controls.
en.disableEffect: Only the in-SDK KYC tutorial video becomes unavailable.

zh-CN.description: 打开 Spice Money eKYC 帮助页面时，会显示 YouTube 教程预览，并提供播放和关闭控件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 只有 SDK 内的 KYC 教程视频会无法使用。

en.description: Spice Money's eKYC SDK loads the available verification products and sessions, lets the user choose one, and opens its OTP or device-based verification screen.
en.disableEffect: Users lose the SDK's product selection entry point and cannot start its supported KYC routes from this screen.

zh-CN.description: Spice Money eKYC SDK 会加载可用的验证产品和会话，供用户选择，并打开对应的短信验证码或设备验证页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将失去 SDK 的产品选择入口，无法从此页面启动支持的 KYC 流程。

en.description: Spice Money Search SDK uses the device's location to find nearby Adhikari agents, displays the results, and offers map and phone-call actions for a selected agent.

zh-CN.description: 字节跳动 VGame SDK 会打开此竖屏页面播放激励视频广告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，激励视频无法播放，观看广告的奖励也不会发放。

en.description: The SSLCommerz payment SDK opens this Activity when a user taps the SDK version area on its support page; it reads a nearby NFC tag and displays the tag details.
en.disableEffect: The support page's NFC diagnostic link will fail to open, and tapping it may fail in the app.

zh-CN.description: 用户点按 SSLCommerz 支付 SDK 客服页面中的版本信息时，会打开此 Activity；它通过 NFC 读取附近标签并显示标签信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 客服页面中的 NFC 诊断入口无法使用，点按该入口时应用操作也可能失败。

en.description: The SSLCommerz payment SDK opens this Activity when a user selects FAQ or Messenger help, then displays the supplied help page inside the app.
en.disableEffect: The embedded FAQ or Messenger help page cannot open, and its in-checkout entry point may fail when tapped.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择常见问题或 Messenger 帮助时，SSLCommerz 支付 SDK 会打开此 Activity，并在应用内显示相应帮助页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用内的常见问题或 Messenger 帮助页面无法打开，结账界面中的对应入口也可能失效。

en.description: The SSLCommerz payment SDK opens this Activity after establishing a payment session to show the merchant checkout, payment methods, account controls, and links to help and offers.
en.disableEffect: The SDK cannot show its checkout screen, so users cannot complete SSLCommerz payments through that app.

zh-CN.description: SSLCommerz 支付 SDK 建立支付会话后会打开此 Activity，展示商户结账界面、付款方式、账户操作以及帮助和优惠入口。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，SDK 无法显示结账界面，用户不能通过该应用完成 SSLCommerz 支付。

en.description: The SSLCommerz payment SDK opens this Activity from checkout to list discounts; choosing an offer returns its details to checkout or opens the offer's payment page.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot choose checkout discounts or open offer-specific payment pages, and the checkout's offer entry point may fail when tapped.

zh-CN.description: SSLCommerz 支付 SDK 会从结账界面的优惠入口打开此 Activity 并展示折扣；选中优惠后，会将优惠信息交回结账界面或打开对应的支付页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法选择结账折扣或打开优惠专属支付页面，点按结账界面的优惠入口时也可能失败。

en.description: The SSLCommerz payment SDK opens this Activity from checkout to show merchant support phone and email details, Messenger help, and SDK information.
en.disableEffect: The in-checkout support page and its contact actions cannot open, and tapping the support entry may fail in the app.

zh-CN.description: SSLCommerz 支付 SDK 会从结账界面打开此 Activity，显示商户客服电话和邮箱、Messenger 帮助入口及 SDK 信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 结账界面中的客服页面及联系操作无法使用，点按客服入口时应用操作也可能失败。

en.description: The SSLCommerz payment SDK opens this Activity when a card, bank, mobile-banking, or offer payment needs a gateway page; it displays that page and returns the merchant-verified payment result.
en.disableEffect: Payments that use these gateway pages cannot be completed or have their results verified.

zh-CN.description: 银行卡、网银、手机银行或优惠付款需要跳转支付网关时，SSLCommerz 支付 SDK 会打开此 Activity；它显示网关页面并返回经商户验证的付款结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖这些网关页面的支付无法完成或无法验证付款结果。

en.description: During SSLCommerz card checkout, this receiver handles Google SMS Retriever results and sends the six-digit verification code or timeout to the payment screen.
en.disableEffect: Card-payment SMS codes may no longer be filled automatically, so verification may require manual entry or fail.

zh-CN.description: SSLCommerz 银行卡结账期间，此 Receiver 会处理 Google 短信验证码结果，并将六码验证码或超时状态交给付款页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 银行卡付款的短信验证码可能无法自动填入，验证可能需要手动输入或会失败。

en.description: The Innovative Products Game Center SDK opens this screen when the host app asks to show its game catalog. It lists games available through the SDK.

zh-CN.description: 宿主应用打开游戏目录时，Innovative Products 游戏中心 SDK 会显示此页面，并列出 SDK 提供的游戏。

en.description: The Innovative Products Game Center SDK opens this screen from its game history and loads games previously played through the SDK on this device.

en.description: The Innovative Products Game Center SDK opens this screen for a selected game or game link. It shows the online HTML5 game and a connection prompt when the device is offline.

zh-CN.description: Innovative Products 游戏中心 SDK 会在用户打开所选游戏或游戏链接时显示此页面，加载在线 HTML5 游戏；断网时会显示连接提示。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法通过此版本的游戏中心 SDK 启动 HTML5 游戏。

en.description: The Innovative Products Game Center SDK opens this screen when a user launches an online game from its catalog or a game link. It displays the playable game and a connection prompt when offline.

zh-CN.description: 用户从目录或游戏链接启动在线游戏时，Innovative Products 游戏中心 SDK 会显示此页面；断网时会提示用户连接网络。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法通过该游戏中心 SDK 启动 HTML5 游戏。

en.description: The Innovative Products Game Center SDK opens this screen for a game delivered through its content network. It loads the selected game screen and its online content.
en.disableEffect: Games delivered through the SDK content network will not open.

zh-CN.description: Innovative Products 游戏中心 SDK 会在用户打开通过其内容网络提供的游戏时显示此页面，并加载所选游戏内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，通过该 SDK 内容网络提供的游戏将无法打开。

en.description: When an app or library using Stanfy’s Enroscar submits background work, this service runs the queued tasks in separate work queues.

zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖 Enroscar 的后台任务可能无法完成，从而影响使用这些任务的应用功能。

en.description: StartApp uses this screen to present its App Wall, a page of promoted apps that users can open.

zh-CN.description: StartApp 会用此页面展示应用推荐墙，用户可以打开其中推广的应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，StartApp 的应用推荐广告将无法使用。

en.description: StartApp Ads opens this screen to show a three-dimensional list of promoted apps; tapping an item can open its store page or link.

zh-CN.description: StartApp Ads 会打开此页面展示全屏或视频广告，并处理广告展示期间的页面状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Start.io 全屏和视频广告将不再显示，应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: StartApp Ads receives Android’s device-start notification to schedule background SDK work.

en.description: StartApp Ads runs background event and metadata jobs through this service.

zh-CN.description: StartApp Ads 通过此服务运行后台事件和元数据任务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Start.io 后台事件和元数据任务可能停止，应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: StartApp Ads uses this scheduled service to run periodic background SDK work.
en.disableEffect: Start.io periodic background work will stop; the app’s other features continue to work.

zh-CN.description: StartApp Ads 使用此定时服务运行周期性 SDK 后台任务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Start.io 周期性后台任务将停止，应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: StartApp uses this screen for a scrollable list of app offers; choosing one opens the advertised destination.

zh-CN.description: StartApp 使用此页面展示可滚动的应用广告列表，用户点选后会打开相应推广内容。

en.description: The Start.io Ads SDK opens this Activity to show full-screen interstitial or video ads and handle the user's ad interaction.

zh-CN.disableEffect: Start.io 的全屏插屏和视频广告将无法打开。

en.description: The Start.io Ads SDK opens this Activity to display its three-dimensional list ad format.

zh-CN.description: Start.io 广告 SDK 启动此后台 Service 后，会请求 Android 在系统停止服务时重新发送相同的启动请求。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Android 停止此服务后，依赖它的 Start.io 后台请求将不会重新启动。

en.description: Android starts this Start.io Ads SDK service for scheduled background work, and the service hands each job to the SDK's job handler.
en.disableEffect: Scheduled Start.io ad SDK work will not run through this service.

zh-CN.description: Start.io 广告 SDK 安排后台任务后，Android 会启动此 Service，由它把任务交给 SDK 处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Start.io 安排的广告 SDK 后台任务将无法通过此 Service 执行。

en.description: Kai Boluo Live SDK opens a news-story detail page when the user selects a story.

en.description: When Reveal’s beacon SDK receives an internal beacon-related background message, this service records its arrival in the SDK’s diagnostics.

zh-CN.description: Reveal 开始监测信标时，此后台服务会搜索附近的蓝牙信标，并将检测到的事件发送给 Reveal SDK。

en.description: When Android reports a device idle-state change, Reveal checks the power state and processes queued beacon-visit events when the device leaves idle mode.

zh-CN.description: Android 通知设备空闲状态变化时，Reveal 会检查电源状态，并在设备退出空闲模式后处理排队的信标访问事件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 设备唤醒后，Reveal 可能无法处理排队的信标访问事件；应用的常规界面仍可使用。

en.description: When Android broadcasts a device boot or power-connection change, Reveal checks whether its background startup has already been handled; this receiver does not start beacon scans itself.

zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Reveal 将收不到这项启动检查，但应用内部启动的信标监测仍可运行。

en.description: When StorifyMe’s Android Stories SDK opens a collection, this screen displays its stories as swipeable pages and starts at the selected item.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot view stories through this StorifyMe screen.

zh-CN.description: StorifyMe Android Stories SDK 打开故事合集时，此页面会以可滑动的页面展示故事，并定位到选中的内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过此 StorifyMe 页面浏览故事。

en.description: When StorifyMe opens a story by its link, this screen loads the story in the SDK’s in-app viewer and handles playback and link interactions.
en.disableEffect: StorifyMe stories and their in-app interactions may not open.

zh-CN.description: StorifyMe 通过链接打开故事时，此页面会在 SDK 的应用内查看器中加载故事，并处理播放和链接交互。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，StorifyMe 故事及其应用内交互可能无法打开。

en.description: When the app opens a StorifyMe story, this screen displays it and reports when the viewer closes or another story is selected.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot view StorifyMe stories in the app.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开 StorifyMe 故事时，此页面会显示故事，并在查看器关闭或用户选择其他故事时通知应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法在应用中查看 StorifyMe 故事。

en.description: When a user follows a web link from StorifyMe stories, this screen opens the page in an in-app browser with a way back to the stories.
en.disableEffect: Those story links cannot open in the SDK’s in-app browser.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 StorifyMe 故事中的网页链接时，此页面会在应用内浏览器中显示网页，并提供返回故事的入口。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，这些故事链接无法在 SDK 的应用内浏览器中打开。

en.description: When the app opens the StorifyMe Snaps editor, this screen lets users create content from their media library or camera and returns when a Snap is saved.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot open this editor or complete its Snap creation workflow.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开 StorifyMe Snaps 编辑器时，此页面允许用户从媒体库或相机创建内容，并在 Snap 保存后返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用无法打开此编辑器或完成 Snap 创建流程。

en.description: When a payment through Straal’s mobile-payments SDK requires 3-D Secure verification, this screen opens the verification page in a browser and returns the result to the payment flow.
en.disableEffect: Payments requiring 3-D Secure may not complete because the verification result cannot be returned.

zh-CN.description: Straal 移动支付 SDK 的付款需要 3-D Secure 验证时，此页面会在浏览器中打开验证网页，并将结果交回付款流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后无法将验证结果交回付款流程，需要 3-D Secure 验证的付款可能无法完成。

en.description: This component is part of the StreetHawk mobile engagement SDK. When Google Play Services delivers an activity-recognition result, StreetHawk's background service maps the most likely motion, such as walking or driving, to a saved activity category. StreetHawk starts it from its location service to keep that category current.
en.disableEffect: StreetHawk will stop updating motion categories used in its location and activity reports.

zh-CN.description: 此组件属于 StreetHawk 移动互动 SDK。Google Play 服务送来活动识别结果时，StreetHawk 后台服务会把最可能的活动（如步行或驾车）转换为保存的类别。StreetHawk 的位置服务会启动它，以持续更新该类别。
zh-CN.disableEffect: StreetHawk 将无法继续更新位置和活动报告使用的运动类别。

en.description: This component is part of the StreetHawk mobile engagement SDK. StreetHawk starts this Service to monitor uncaught crashes and send saved crash reports when a network connection is available. When a crash occurs, it records app and device details, then passes the error to the app's existing crash handler.
en.disableEffect: StreetHawk crash reports will no longer be collected or uploaded.

zh-CN.description: 此组件属于 StreetHawk 移动互动 SDK。StreetHawk 会启动此服务来监视未捕获的崩溃，并在网络可用时发送已保存的崩溃报告。发生崩溃时，它会记录应用和设备信息，然后把错误交给应用原有的崩溃处理程序。
zh-CN.disableEffect: StreetHawk 将不再收集或上传崩溃报告。

en.description: This component is part of the StreetHawk mobile engagement SDK. Google Cloud Messaging starts this StreetHawk service when a push message arrives. It checks and stores the message, then broadcasts an event for StreetHawk to display or process the notification.
en.disableEffect: StreetHawk push notifications and their campaign actions will stop arriving.

zh-CN.description: 此组件属于 StreetHawk 移动互动 SDK。推送消息到达时，Google Cloud Messaging 会启动此 StreetHawk 服务。它会检查并保存消息，再广播事件供 StreetHawk 显示或处理通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: StreetHawk 推送通知及其活动操作将不再送达。

en.description: This component is part of the StreetHawk mobile engagement SDK. Google Play Services starts this StreetHawk Service when a monitored geofence is entered or exited. It updates the saved geofence state and sends qualifying transitions to StreetHawk.
en.disableEffect: StreetHawk location-triggered campaigns and geofence visit reports will stop responding to boundary changes.

zh-CN.description: 此组件属于 StreetHawk 移动互动 SDK。进入或离开已监控的地理围栏时，Google Play 服务会启动此 StreetHawk 服务。它会更新保存的围栏状态，并向 StreetHawk 发送符合条件的进出事件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: StreetHawk 的位置触发活动和地理围栏访问报告将不再响应边界变化。

en.description: This component is part of the StreetHawk mobile engagement SDK. When Google Play reports an install referral, this StreetHawk receiver checks the app key and saves the decoded referral information for growth attribution. The SDK also uses this module for referral and sharing links.
en.disableEffect: StreetHawk install attribution and referral tracking will stop.

zh-CN.description: 此组件属于 StreetHawk 移动互动 SDK。Google Play 报告安装来源时，此 StreetHawk 接收器会核对应用密钥，并保存解码后的来源信息以进行增长归因。SDK 也通过此模块处理推荐和分享链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: StreetHawk 将无法继续记录安装归因和推荐来源。

en.description: This component is part of the StreetHawk mobile engagement SDK. StreetHawk starts this background Service when beacon monitoring is enabled and Bluetooth is available. It scans for nearby Bluetooth beacons and sends detected beacon IDs and distance estimates to StreetHawk.
en.disableEffect: StreetHawk beacon campaigns and proximity reports will stop.

zh-CN.description: 此组件属于 StreetHawk 移动互动 SDK。启用信标监控且蓝牙可用时，StreetHawk 会启动此后台服务。它会扫描附近的蓝牙信标，并向 StreetHawk 发送检测到的信标编号和距离估算值。
zh-CN.disableEffect: StreetHawk 的信标活动和邻近报告将停止。

en.description: This component is part of the StreetHawk mobile engagement SDK. StreetHawk sends this receiver push-message and notification-response events. It displays campaign prompts, opens configured links or app actions, and records whether a prompt was accepted, declined, or postponed.
en.disableEffect: StreetHawk campaign notifications, their actions, and response tracking will stop.

zh-CN.description: 此组件属于 StreetHawk 移动互动 SDK。StreetHawk 会向此接收器发送推送消息和通知响应事件。它会显示活动提示、打开配置的链接或应用操作，并记录用户接受、拒绝或推迟提示的结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: StreetHawk 活动通知、相关操作和响应记录将停止。

en.description: This component is part of the StreetHawk mobile engagement SDK. StreetHawk opens this Activity from a campaign feedback prompt. It lets the user enter a subject and comment, sends the feedback to StreetHawk, and reports whether the prompt was accepted or dismissed.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to open StreetHawk's built-in feedback form from campaign prompts.

zh-CN.description: 此组件属于 StreetHawk 移动互动 SDK。StreetHawk 会在活动反馈提示中打开此界面。用户可以填写主题和意见，提交给 StreetHawk；界面还会报告用户是否接受或关闭了提示。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法从活动提示打开 StreetHawk 内置的反馈表单。

en.description: This component is part of the StreetHawk mobile engagement SDK. StreetHawk opens this Activity when its self-test screen is requested. The screen offers SDK checks and actions for push, location, Bluetooth, feedback, app links, and crash reporting.
en.disableEffect: StreetHawk's diagnostic screen and its built-in checks will be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: 此组件属于 StreetHawk 移动互动 SDK。请求 StreetHawk 自检界面时，SDK 会打开此界面。屏幕提供推送、位置、蓝牙、反馈、应用链接和崩溃报告等检查与操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: StreetHawk 的诊断界面及其内置检查将无法使用。

en.description: This component is part of the StreetHawk mobile engagement SDK. Google Cloud Messaging starts this legacy StreetHawk service for delivered messages. The service passes them through StreetHawk's GCM handler, which checks and routes push content.
en.disableEffect: StreetHawk push messages delivered through this legacy integration will stop.

zh-CN.description: 此组件属于 StreetHawk 移动互动 SDK。Google Cloud Messaging 会在收到消息时启动此旧版 StreetHawk 服务。服务会把消息交给 StreetHawk 的 GCM 处理流程，由其检查并转送推送内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过此旧版集成送达的 StreetHawk 推送消息将停止。

en.description: This component is part of the StreetHawk mobile engagement SDK. StreetHawk starts this Service when its older iBeacon monitor is enabled and configured beacon regions are available. It watches nearby iBeacons and reports matching proximity changes to StreetHawk.
en.disableEffect: StreetHawk iBeacon campaigns and proximity reports will stop.

zh-CN.description: 此组件属于 StreetHawk 移动互动 SDK。启用旧版 iBeacon 监控且已配置信标区域时，StreetHawk 会启动此服务。它会监测附近的 iBeacon，并向 StreetHawk 报告匹配的邻近状态变化。
zh-CN.disableEffect: StreetHawk 的 iBeacon 活动和邻近报告将停止。

en.description: This component is part of the StreetHawk mobile engagement SDK. Android starts this receiver for boot, time-zone, network, Bluetooth, location-provider, and StreetHawk notification-response events. It resumes or stops background location and beacon work and queues related SDK status reports.
en.disableEffect: StreetHawk background tracking, beacon monitoring, and campaign responses will no longer update after these events.

zh-CN.description: 此组件属于 StreetHawk 移动互动 SDK。设备启动、时区、网络、蓝牙、位置服务或 StreetHawk 通知响应发生变化时，Android 会启动此接收器。它会恢复或停止后台位置与信标任务，并排队发送相关 SDK 状态报告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 这些事件发生后，StreetHawk 的后台跟踪、信标监控和活动响应将不再更新。

en.description: This component is part of the StreetHawk mobile engagement SDK. StreetHawk starts this Service when location reporting is enabled. It requests device location updates, adjusts the reporting interval while the app is foreground or background, and queues coordinates for StreetHawk.
en.disableEffect: StreetHawk location reports and location-triggered campaigns will stop updating.

zh-CN.description: 此组件属于 StreetHawk 移动互动 SDK。启用位置报告时，StreetHawk 会启动此服务。它会请求设备位置更新，根据应用在前台或后台调整上报间隔，并将坐标排队发送给 StreetHawk。
zh-CN.disableEffect: StreetHawk 的位置报告和位置触发活动将停止更新。

en.description: This component is part of the StreetHawk mobile engagement SDK. On older Android versions, StreetHawk starts this Service to scan for nearby Bluetooth beacons. It parses detected beacon signals and sends matching proximity reports to StreetHawk.
en.disableEffect: StreetHawk beacon detection and proximity campaigns will stop on devices using this scanner.

zh-CN.description: 此组件属于 StreetHawk 移动互动 SDK。在较旧的 Android 版本上，StreetHawk 会启动此服务扫描附近的蓝牙信标。它会解析检测到的信号，并向 StreetHawk 发送匹配的邻近报告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此扫描器的设备将停止 StreetHawk 信标检测和邻近活动。

en.description: This component is part of the StreetHawk mobile engagement SDK. On newer Android versions, StreetHawk starts this Service to scan for nearby Bluetooth beacons. It parses detected beacon signals and sends matching proximity reports to StreetHawk.
en.disableEffect: StreetHawk beacon detection and proximity campaigns will stop on devices using this scanner.

zh-CN.description: 此组件属于 StreetHawk 移动互动 SDK。在较新的 Android 版本上，StreetHawk 会启动此服务扫描附近的蓝牙信标。它会解析检测到的信号，并向 StreetHawk 发送匹配的邻近报告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此扫描器的设备将停止 StreetHawk 信标检测和邻近活动。

en.description: This component is part of the StreetHawk mobile engagement SDK. Android starts this StreetHawk receiver for boot, Bluetooth changes, and server status updates. It fetches the app's configured beacon list and starts or stops the matching Bluetooth scanner as beacon monitoring changes.
en.disableEffect: StreetHawk will no longer refresh beacon settings or resume beacon monitoring after Bluetooth changes.

zh-CN.description: 此组件属于 StreetHawk 移动互动 SDK。设备启动、蓝牙状态变化或服务器状态更新时，Android 会启动此 StreetHawk 接收器。它会获取应用配置的信标列表，并在监控状态变化时启动或停止对应的蓝牙扫描器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: StreetHawk 将无法刷新信标设置，也无法在蓝牙状态变化后恢复监控。

en.description: This component is part of the StreetHawk mobile engagement SDK. StreetHawk starts this core Service during SDK setup and after device boot. It flushes queued activity and crash reports, schedules hourly status checks, installs crash handling, and registers lifecycle tracking for enabled SDK modules.
en.disableEffect: StreetHawk activity analytics, crash reports, scheduled checks, and module lifecycle tracking will stop.

zh-CN.description: 此组件属于 StreetHawk 移动互动 SDK。StreetHawk 会在 SDK 初始化期间及设备启动后启动此核心服务。它会发送排队的活动与崩溃报告、安排每小时状态检查、安装崩溃处理，并为启用的 SDK 模块注册生命周期跟踪。
zh-CN.disableEffect: StreetHawk 的活动分析、崩溃报告、定时检查和模块生命周期跟踪将停止。

en.description: This component is part of the StreetHawk mobile engagement SDK. Android starts this receiver at boot, on time-zone changes, and for scheduled StreetHawk status checks. It starts the core service after boot and queues time-zone, heartbeat, and app-status reports.
en.disableEffect: StreetHawk scheduled status checks, heartbeats, and time-zone reports will stop.

zh-CN.description: 此组件属于 StreetHawk 移动互动 SDK。设备启动、时区变化或 StreetHawk 定时状态检查时，Android 会启动此接收器。它会在启动后启动核心服务，并排队发送时区、心跳和应用状态报告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: StreetHawk 的定时状态检查、心跳和时区报告将停止。

en.description: This component is part of the StreetHawk mobile engagement SDK. StreetHawk opens this Activity for campaign feedback requests. The user can enter a subject and message, submit it to StreetHawk, and send an accepted or canceled result for the prompt.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to submit feedback through StreetHawk's older campaign form.

zh-CN.description: 此组件属于 StreetHawk 移动互动 SDK。StreetHawk 会在活动反馈请求中打开此界面。用户可以填写主题和消息并提交给 StreetHawk，同时发送接受或取消提示的结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 StreetHawk 旧版活动表单提交反馈。

en.description: This component is part of the StreetHawk mobile engagement SDK. When StreetHawk's app-status response reports a changed feed timestamp, this receiver notifies the feed listener and announces that a new feed item is available in the app.
en.disableEffect: New StreetHawk feed items may not be announced or refreshed in the app's feed.

zh-CN.description: 此组件属于 StreetHawk 移动互动 SDK。StreetHawk 的应用状态响应报告信息流时间戳变化时，此接收器会通知信息流监听器，并告知应用有新的信息流内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用可能无法收到新 StreetHawk 信息流内容的提示或刷新信息流。

en.description: This component is part of the StreetHawk mobile engagement SDK. Google Cloud Messaging starts this older StreetHawk service when a message is delivered. It is the SDK's GCM entry point and delegates delivery to StreetHawk's message handler.
en.disableEffect: StreetHawk push messages delivered through this older integration will stop.

zh-CN.description: 此组件属于 StreetHawk 移动互动 SDK。收到消息时，Google Cloud Messaging 会启动此旧版 StreetHawk 服务。它是 SDK 的 GCM 接收入口，并将消息交给 StreetHawk 处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过此旧版集成送达的 StreetHawk 推送消息将停止。

en.description: This component is part of the StreetHawk mobile engagement SDK. StreetHawk opens this Activity when it needs location permission for geofence monitoring. If the user grants access, it starts StreetHawk's geofence monitoring.
en.disableEffect: StreetHawk cannot request location permission through this screen or start its geofence monitoring.

zh-CN.description: 此组件属于 StreetHawk 移动互动 SDK。StreetHawk 需要为地理围栏监控申请位置权限时，会打开此界面。用户授权后，界面会启动 StreetHawk 的地理围栏监控。
zh-CN.disableEffect: StreetHawk 将无法通过此界面申请位置权限或启动地理围栏监控。
