en.description: This component is part of the StreetHawk mobile engagement SDK. Google Play Services starts this StreetHawk Service when a monitored geofence is entered or exited. It reports the transition and makes the matching enter or exit list available to StreetHawk listeners.
en.disableEffect: StreetHawk geofence events, location-triggered campaigns, and transition reports will stop.

zh-CN.description: 此组件属于 StreetHawk 移动互动 SDK。进入或离开已监控的地理围栏时，Google Play 服务会启动此 StreetHawk 服务。它会报告状态变化，并向 StreetHawk 监听器提供对应的进入或离开列表。
zh-CN.disableEffect: StreetHawk 的地理围栏事件、位置触发活动和状态报告将停止。

en.description: This component is part of the StreetHawk mobile engagement SDK. StreetHawk starts this receiver for server app-status messages, location-provider changes, and scheduled location checks. It refreshes the configured geofence list, restarts monitoring when settings change, and reports when location is disabled.
en.disableEffect: StreetHawk geofence settings and background monitoring will no longer refresh or respond to location changes.

zh-CN.description: 此组件属于 StreetHawk 移动互动 SDK。StreetHawk 会在服务器应用状态消息、位置来源变化和定时位置检查时启动此接收器。它会刷新配置的地理围栏列表、在设置变化后重启监控，并报告位置服务被关闭的情况。
zh-CN.disableEffect: StreetHawk 的地理围栏设置和后台监控将无法刷新或响应位置变化。

en.description: This component is part of the StreetHawk mobile engagement SDK. StreetHawk starts this Service to register configured geofences with Google Play Services and monitor them in the background. It also schedules location checks and provides the last known location for StreetHawk reports.
en.disableEffect: StreetHawk background geofence monitoring and location-triggered events will stop.

zh-CN.description: 此组件属于 StreetHawk 移动互动 SDK。StreetHawk 会启动此服务，将已配置的地理围栏注册到 Google Play 服务并在后台监控。它还会安排位置检查，并为 StreetHawk 报告提供最后已知位置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: StreetHawk 的后台地理围栏监控和位置触发事件将停止。

en.description: This component is part of the StreetHawk mobile engagement SDK. When Google Play reports an install referral, this StreetHawk receiver saves matching referral data for growth attribution. StreetHawk also uses this module to register installs and return referral-link results.
en.disableEffect: StreetHawk install attribution and referral registration will stop.

zh-CN.description: 此组件属于 StreetHawk 移动互动 SDK。Google Play 报告安装来源时，此 StreetHawk 接收器会保存匹配的来源信息以进行增长归因。StreetHawk 也通过此模块登记安装并返回推荐链接结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: StreetHawk 的安装归因和推荐登记将停止。

en.description: This component is part of the StreetHawk mobile engagement SDK. StreetHawk starts this older Service to receive device location updates through Google Play Services. It filters repeated or nearby readings and queues qualifying coordinates for StreetHawk reports.
en.disableEffect: Older StreetHawk location reporting and location-triggered campaigns will stop updating.

zh-CN.description: 此组件属于 StreetHawk 移动互动 SDK。StreetHawk 会启动此旧版服务，通过 Google Play 服务接收设备位置更新。它会过滤重复或过近的位置读数，并将符合条件的坐标排队发送给 StreetHawk。
zh-CN.disableEffect: StreetHawk 旧版位置报告和位置触发活动将停止更新。

en.description: This component is part of the StreetHawk mobile engagement SDK. Android starts this older receiver for boot, time-zone, Bluetooth, network, location-provider, and StreetHawk notification-response events. It restarts the SDK's location or beacon services and handles queued campaign actions.
en.disableEffect: StreetHawk tracking, beacon monitoring, and campaign actions will not resume after these events.

zh-CN.description: 此组件属于 StreetHawk 移动互动 SDK。设备启动、时区、蓝牙、网络、位置服务或 StreetHawk 通知响应发生变化时，Android 会启动此旧版接收器。它会重启 SDK 的位置或信标服务，并处理排队的活动操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 这些事件发生后，StreetHawk 的跟踪、信标监控和活动操作将无法恢复。

en.description: This component is part of the StreetHawk mobile engagement SDK. StreetHawk starts this older Service when location collection is enabled. It selects a device location provider and sends coordinate updates to StreetHawk, using different intervals while the app is foreground or background.
en.disableEffect: StreetHawk location history and location-based campaign reports will stop updating.

zh-CN.description: 此组件属于 StreetHawk 移动互动 SDK。启用位置收集时，StreetHawk 会启动此旧版服务。它会选择设备位置来源并向 StreetHawk 发送坐标更新，同时根据应用在前台或后台调整间隔。
zh-CN.disableEffect: StreetHawk 的位置记录和基于位置的活动报告将停止更新。

en.description: This component is part of the StreetHawk mobile engagement SDK. StreetHawk starts this older Service when iBeacon support is enabled. It connects to the iBeacon monitor, watches configured beacon regions, and reports matching proximity changes.
en.disableEffect: StreetHawk iBeacon detection and proximity campaigns will stop.

zh-CN.description: 此组件属于 StreetHawk 移动互动 SDK。启用 iBeacon 支持时，StreetHawk 会启动此旧版服务。它会连接 iBeacon 监控器、监测已配置的信标区域，并报告匹配的邻近状态变化。
zh-CN.disableEffect: StreetHawk 的 iBeacon 检测和邻近活动将停止。

en.description: This component is part of the StreetHawk mobile engagement SDK. StreetHawk opens this Activity when it needs location access for location reporting. If permission is granted, it starts StreetHawk's location reporting.
en.disableEffect: StreetHawk cannot request location permission through this screen or start location reporting.

zh-CN.description: 此组件属于 StreetHawk 移动互动 SDK。StreetHawk 需要位置权限来上报位置时，会打开此界面。用户授权后，界面会启动 StreetHawk 的位置上报。
zh-CN.disableEffect: StreetHawk 将无法通过此界面申请位置权限或启动位置上报。

en.description: This component is part of the StreetHawk mobile engagement SDK. Android starts this receiver when location providers change and during StreetHawk's scheduled status checks. If location reporting is enabled, it sends the last known coordinates or a location-disabled event to StreetHawk.
en.disableEffect: StreetHawk will stop reporting location changes and scheduled location updates.

zh-CN.description: 此组件属于 StreetHawk 移动互动 SDK。位置来源变化或 StreetHawk 定时检查运行时，Android 会启动此接收器。启用位置上报后，它会向 StreetHawk 发送最后已知坐标或位置服务关闭事件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: StreetHawk 将停止报告位置变化和定时位置更新。

en.description: This component is part of the StreetHawk mobile engagement SDK. StreetHawk starts this Service when location reporting is enabled and permission is available. It requests GPS or network location updates and sends coordinates to StreetHawk, with different intervals while the app is foreground or background.
en.disableEffect: StreetHawk location reports and location-based campaign targeting will stop updating.

zh-CN.description: 此组件属于 StreetHawk 移动互动 SDK。启用位置上报且已获得权限时，StreetHawk 会启动此服务。它会请求 GPS 或网络位置更新并将坐标发送给 StreetHawk，同时根据应用在前台或后台调整间隔。
zh-CN.disableEffect: StreetHawk 的位置报告和基于位置的活动定位将停止更新。

en.description: This component is part of the StreetHawk mobile engagement SDK. StreetHawk sends this receiver push messages, app-status updates, and notification-response events. It displays campaign notifications or prompts, calls registered app listeners, and records user actions such as accepting or dismissing a prompt.
en.disableEffect: StreetHawk push campaigns, their app callbacks, and response tracking will stop.

zh-CN.description: 此组件属于 StreetHawk 移动互动 SDK。StreetHawk 会向此接收器发送推送消息、应用状态更新和通知响应事件。它会显示活动通知或提示、调用已注册的应用监听器，并记录用户接受或关闭提示等操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: StreetHawk 推送活动、相关应用回调和响应记录将停止。

en.description: This component is part of the StreetHawk mobile engagement SDK. StreetHawk opens this Activity from a push-campaign feedback prompt. It collects a subject and message, sends them to StreetHawk, and reports whether the prompt was accepted or canceled.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to submit feedback through StreetHawk push prompts.

zh-CN.description: 此组件属于 StreetHawk 移动互动 SDK。StreetHawk 会从推送活动的反馈提示中打开此界面。它会收集主题和消息并发送给 StreetHawk，同时报告提示是否被接受或取消。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 StreetHawk 推送提示提交反馈。

en.description: This component is part of the StreetHawk mobile engagement SDK. Google Cloud Messaging starts this StreetHawk Service when a push arrives. It verifies the configured sender and message ID, saves the message, and broadcasts it for StreetHawk's push handler.
en.disableEffect: StreetHawk push notifications will stop arriving through Google Cloud Messaging.

zh-CN.description: 此组件属于 StreetHawk 移动互动 SDK。推送到达时，Google Cloud Messaging 会启动此 StreetHawk 服务。它会核对已配置的发送方和消息编号、保存消息，并广播给 StreetHawk 的推送处理器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: StreetHawk 将不再通过 Google Cloud Messaging 收到推送通知。

en.description: This component is part of the StreetHawk mobile engagement SDK. Google starts this StreetHawk Service when the push registration token changes. It fetches the replacement token, saves it, and registers the StreetHawk push module with the new token.
en.disableEffect: StreetHawk push delivery may stop after Google refreshes the registration token.

zh-CN.description: 此组件属于 StreetHawk 移动互动 SDK。Google 更新推送注册令牌时，会启动此 StreetHawk 服务。它会获取并保存新令牌，再用新令牌向 StreetHawk 注册推送模块。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Google 刷新注册令牌后，StreetHawk 推送可能停止送达。

en.description: Stripe PaymentSheet starts this Activity with attestation arguments and receives the completed attestation result from its verification flow.
en.disableEffect: A checkout that requests this attestation will not receive its result and may fail to complete.

zh-CN.description: Stripe PaymentSheet 会携带证明参数启动此 Activity，并从验证流程接收完成后的证明结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要此证明的结账流程将无法收到结果，可能无法完成。

en.description: When Stripe payment confirmation requires a challenge, this Activity hosts the confirmation step and returns its result to the payment flow.
en.disableEffect: Payments that require this confirmation challenge may not complete.

zh-CN.description: Stripe 确认付款需要挑战验证时，此 Activity 会承载确认步骤并将结果返回给支付流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要此确认挑战的付款可能无法完成。

en.description: When a payment needs a passive 3D Secure check, Stripe Payments runs the challenge through this Activity and returns the result.
en.disableEffect: A payment requiring this 3D Secure check may be declined or left unfinished.

zh-CN.description: 付款需要被动式 3D Secure 验证时，Stripe Payments 会通过此 Activity 执行验证并返回结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要此 3D Secure 验证的付款可能会被拒绝或无法完成。

en.description: Stripe Payments starts this Activity to warm up a passive 3D Secure challenge before it is needed, then reports when preparation finishes.
en.disableEffect: The passive 3D Secure challenge will no longer be prewarmed and may take longer to become ready.

zh-CN.description: Stripe Payments 会在需要被动式 3D Secure 挑战前启动此 Activity 进行预热，并在准备完成后报告结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 被动式 3D Secure 挑战将不再预热，需要时可能更久才能准备好。

en.description: When PaymentSheet starts NFC card scanning, this Activity displays the scan flow and returns its success or cancellation result.
en.disableEffect: Card scanning by NFC will be unavailable in PaymentSheet.

zh-CN.description: PaymentSheet 启动 NFC 银行卡扫描时，此 Activity 会显示扫描流程，并返回成功或取消结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: PaymentSheet 将无法使用 NFC 扫描银行卡。

en.description: When a supported card is added by tapping it to the phone, PaymentSheet uses this Activity to run the Tap to Add flow and return the result.
en.disableEffect: The Tap to Add card-entry flow will stop working in PaymentSheet.

zh-CN.description: 支持的银行卡贴近手机添加时，PaymentSheet 会通过此 Activity 执行 Tap to Add 流程并返回结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: PaymentSheet 中的 Tap to Add 添加银行卡流程将无法使用。

en.description: When a Stripe Connect redirect link is opened, this Activity reads the requested URL and opens it in a browser tab for the Connect flow.
en.disableEffect: Stripe Connect onboarding or authorization redirects may not open.

zh-CN.description: 打开 Stripe Connect 重定向链接时，此 Activity 会读取目标网址并在浏览器标签页中打开，以继续 Connect 流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Stripe Connect 的入驻或授权重定向可能无法打开。

en.description: When the app asks Stripe Connections to link a bank account, this Activity displays the account-linking sheet and returns its result.
en.disableEffect: The host app will not be able to complete bank linking through Stripe Connections.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求 Stripe Connections 关联银行账户时，此 Activity 会显示账户关联界面并返回结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法通过 Stripe Connections 完成银行账户关联。

en.description: When a bank sign-in page returns to the Stripe Connections success or cancel link, this Activity forwards that link to the Connections sheet.
en.disableEffect: Bank sign-in returns will not reach the Stripe Connections flow.

zh-CN.description: 银行登录页返回 Stripe Connections 的成功或取消链接时，此 Activity 会将链接转交给 Connections 界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 银行登录后的返回信息将无法传回 Stripe Connections 流程。

en.description: When the host app opens a Stripe Connect embedded component, this Activity displays the embedded Connect interface.
en.disableEffect: The embedded Stripe Connect screen will not open.

zh-CN.description: 宿主应用打开 Stripe Connect 嵌入式组件时，此 Activity 会显示 Connect 界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Stripe Connect 嵌入式界面将无法打开。

en.description: When the host app opens Customer Sheet, this Activity displays the customer payment-method screen and returns the selected changes.
en.disableEffect: Customers will not be able to manage saved payment methods through Customer Sheet.

zh-CN.description: 宿主应用打开 Customer Sheet 时，此 Activity 会显示客户付款方式界面并返回所做更改。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 客户将无法通过 Customer Sheet 管理已保存的付款方式。

en.description: When Stripe Financial Connections starts a bank-linking session, this Activity hosts the connection flow and handles its return to the app.
en.disableEffect: The host app may be unable to link or verify bank accounts through Financial Connections.

zh-CN.description: Stripe Financial Connections 启动银行账户关联会话时，此 Activity 会承载关联流程并处理返回应用的结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 宿主应用可能无法通过 Financial Connections 关联或验证银行账户。

en.description: When a bank authentication page returns through a Stripe Financial Connections link, this Activity forwards the result to the connection flow.
en.disableEffect: Bank authentication may not return to the Financial Connections session, leaving account linking unfinished.

zh-CN.description: 银行身份验证页通过 Stripe Financial Connections 链接返回时，此 Activity 会将结果转交给账户关联流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 银行验证结果可能无法返回 Financial Connections 会话，导致账户关联未完成。

en.description: When the app uses Stripe Financial Connections Lite to link a bank account, this Activity loads the bank connection flow in a WebView.
en.disableEffect: Bank linking through Financial Connections Lite will not open.

zh-CN.description: 应用使用 Stripe Financial Connections Lite 关联银行账户时，此 Activity 会在 WebView 中加载银行关联流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Financial Connections Lite 的银行关联界面将无法打开。

en.description: When a Financial Connections Lite authentication link returns from the bank, this Activity forwards the URL to the Lite WebView flow.
en.disableEffect: Bank authentication returns will not resume the Financial Connections Lite session.

zh-CN.description: 银行返回 Financial Connections Lite 身份验证链接时，此 Activity 会将网址转交给 Lite WebView 流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 银行验证返回后将无法恢复 Financial Connections Lite 会话。

en.description: When Stripe Financial Connections opens its native bank-linking experience, this Activity displays that interface and returns the outcome.
en.disableEffect: The native bank-linking flow will not open or return its result.

zh-CN.description: Stripe Financial Connections 打开原生银行关联流程时，此 Activity 会显示界面并返回处理结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 原生银行关联流程将无法打开或返回结果。

en.description: When the app starts a Google Pay payment, this Activity requests payment data from Google Pay and returns the payment result to Stripe.
en.disableEffect: Google Pay payments through the Stripe launcher will fail.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动 Google Pay 付款时，此 Activity 会向 Google Pay 请求付款数据并将付款结果返回 Stripe。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过 Stripe 启动器进行的 Google Pay 付款将无法完成。

en.description: When the app collects a payment method with Google Pay, this Activity requests Google Pay data and returns the resulting payment method or error.
en.disableEffect: The app will not be able to collect Google Pay payment methods through Stripe.

zh-CN.description: 应用使用 Google Pay 收集付款方式时，此 Activity 会请求 Google Pay 数据并返回付款方式或错误。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法通过 Stripe 收集 Google Pay 付款方式。

en.description: Google Pay starts this Stripe Payments service for its payment-data callback, and the service returns the payment data result to Google Pay.
en.disableEffect: Google Pay callback handling for Stripe payments will stop working.

zh-CN.description: Google Pay 会为付款数据回调启动此 Stripe Payments 服务，服务再将付款数据结果返回给 Google Pay。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Stripe 付款的 Google Pay 回调处理将无法工作。

en.description: When the host app starts Stripe Identity verification, this Activity loads the verification flow, requests camera access when needed, and returns the outcome.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to complete Stripe Identity verification in the host app.

zh-CN.description: 宿主应用启动 Stripe Identity 身份验证时，此 Activity 会加载验证流程、按需请求相机权限并返回结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在宿主应用中完成 Stripe Identity 身份验证。

en.description: Stripe Identity uses this private file provider to create shareable file links for verification documents and captured images.
en.disableEffect: Stripe Identity may not be able to pass verification files to the part of the flow that uploads or reviews them.

zh-CN.description: Stripe Identity 使用此私有文件提供程序为验证文件和拍摄的图像创建可共享的文件链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Stripe Identity 可能无法将验证文件交给上传或审核流程。

en.description: When a customer opens Stripe Link from checkout, this Activity displays the Link flow and handles Link sign-in or web authentication.
en.disableEffect: Customers will not be able to sign in to Link or pay with their saved Link details.

zh-CN.description: 客户在结账时打开 Stripe Link，此 Activity 会显示 Link 流程并处理 Link 登录或网页验证。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 客户将无法登录 Link 或使用已保存的 Link 付款信息。

en.description: When Stripe Link receives an authentication redirect while its flow is active, this Activity processes the incoming link and resumes the foreground flow.
en.disableEffect: Link authentication redirects may not return to the active checkout.

zh-CN.description: Stripe Link 流程进行期间收到身份验证重定向时，此 Activity 会处理链接并恢复前台流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Link 身份验证重定向可能无法返回当前结账流程。

en.description: When the browser returns a Link completion URL, this Activity forwards it to Stripe Link and closes.
en.disableEffect: Link sign-in or checkout may remain stuck after returning from the browser.

zh-CN.description: 浏览器返回 Link 完成网址时，此 Activity 会将网址转交 Stripe Link 后关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 从浏览器返回后，Link 登录或结账流程可能无法继续。

en.description: When PaymentSheet confirms a host-defined custom payment method, this Activity passes the method and billing details to the host app confirmation callback.
en.disableEffect: The host app custom payment method cannot be confirmed through PaymentSheet.

zh-CN.description: PaymentSheet 确认宿主应用定义的自定义付款方式时，此 Activity 会将付款方式和账单信息交给宿主应用的确认回调。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 宿主应用的自定义付款方式将无法通过 PaymentSheet 确认。

en.description: When the host app opens an embedded Stripe payment form, this Activity displays the form for collecting payment details and submitting the payment.
en.disableEffect: The embedded payment form will not open or complete its payment flow.

zh-CN.description: 宿主应用打开 Stripe 嵌入式付款表单时，此 Activity 会显示表单以收集付款信息并提交付款。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 嵌入式付款表单将无法打开或完成付款流程。

en.description: When the host app opens the embedded payment-method manager, this Activity displays the saved payment methods that the customer can manage.
en.disableEffect: Customers will not be able to manage saved payment methods in the embedded Stripe flow.

zh-CN.description: 宿主应用打开嵌入式付款方式管理器时，此 Activity 会显示客户可管理的已保存付款方式。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 客户将无法在 Stripe 嵌入式流程中管理已保存的付款方式。

en.description: When the host app launches the embedded Stripe Payment Element sheet, this Activity restores its arguments and displays the embedded payment interface.
en.disableEffect: The embedded Stripe payment interface will not open or return its payment result.

zh-CN.description: 宿主应用启动 Stripe Payment Element 嵌入式表单时，此 Activity 会恢复参数并显示付款界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Stripe 嵌入式付款界面将无法打开或返回付款结果。

en.description: When a payment requires browser authentication, this Activity opens the Stripe authentication page in the selected browser.
en.disableEffect: Payments that require a browser-based bank or issuer authorization may not complete.

zh-CN.description: 付款需要浏览器身份验证时，此 Activity 会在所选浏览器中打开 Stripe 验证页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要通过浏览器完成银行或发卡机构授权的付款可能无法完成。

en.description: When the browser returns through Stripe's payment-return link, this Activity forwards the return to the browser authentication flow.
en.disableEffect: The payment authentication result may not return to the host app.

zh-CN.description: 浏览器通过 Stripe 付款返回链接返回时，此 Activity 会将结果转交浏览器验证流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 付款验证结果可能无法返回宿主应用。

en.description: When a Stripe payment needs a bank account, this Activity opens Financial Connections to collect or verify the account and returns the result.
en.disableEffect: Bank-account payment setup or verification through Stripe will not complete.

zh-CN.description: Stripe 付款需要银行账户时，此 Activity 会打开 Financial Connections 以收集或验证账户并返回结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过 Stripe 设置或验证银行账户的付款流程将无法完成。

en.description: When a card payment requires 3D Secure, this Activity runs the Stripe challenge and returns the authentication result to the payment flow.
en.disableEffect: Card payments that require 3D Secure authentication may be declined or left unfinished.

zh-CN.description: 银行卡付款需要 3D Secure 时，此 Activity 会执行 Stripe 验证挑战并将验证结果返回支付流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要 3D Secure 验证的银行卡付款可能被拒绝或无法完成。

en.description: When the app confirms a Stripe payment or setup operation, this Activity runs the confirmation and any required authentication steps, then returns the result.
en.disableEffect: The Stripe payment or setup operation may not be confirmed.

zh-CN.description: 应用确认 Stripe 付款或设置操作时，此 Activity 会执行确认及所需的身份验证步骤，然后返回结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Stripe 付款或设置操作可能无法确认。

en.description: When a customer selects WeChat Pay, this Activity launches WeChat for payment authorization and handles the result returned to Stripe.
en.disableEffect: The host app will not be able to finish WeChat Pay authorization through Stripe.

zh-CN.description: 客户选择微信支付时，此 Activity 会启动微信进行付款授权，并处理返回 Stripe 的结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 宿主应用将无法通过 Stripe 完成微信支付授权。

en.description: When PaymentSheet confirms an external payment method, this Activity forwards the method type and billing details to the host app callback.
en.disableEffect: The host app external payment method cannot be confirmed through PaymentSheet.

zh-CN.description: PaymentSheet 确认外部付款方式时，此 Activity 会将付款方式类型和账单信息转交宿主应用回调。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 宿主应用的外部付款方式将无法通过 PaymentSheet 确认。

en.description: When checkout asks the customer to choose a saved or new payment method, this Activity displays PaymentSheet's payment-options screen.
en.disableEffect: Customers will not be able to choose a payment method through this PaymentSheet flow.

zh-CN.description: 结账要求客户选择已保存或新的付款方式时，此 Activity 会显示 PaymentSheet 的付款选项界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 客户将无法通过此 PaymentSheet 流程选择付款方式。

en.description: When the host app opens Stripe PaymentSheet for checkout, this Activity displays available payment methods and handles payment confirmation.
en.disableEffect: The host app Stripe checkout will not be able to display or complete PaymentSheet.

zh-CN.description: 宿主应用打开 Stripe PaymentSheet 结账时，此 Activity 会显示可用付款方式并处理付款确认。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 宿主应用将无法显示或完成 PaymentSheet 结账流程。

en.description: When checkout requests an address, this Activity displays Stripe Address Element so the customer can enter or select one.
en.disableEffect: The host app will not be able to collect an address through Stripe Address Element.

zh-CN.description: 结账请求地址时，此 Activity 会显示 Stripe Address Element，供客户输入或选择地址。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 宿主应用将无法通过 Stripe Address Element 收集地址。

en.description: When a customer searches for an address in Stripe Address Element, this Activity displays address suggestions and returns the selected address.
en.disableEffect: Address search suggestions will not be available in Stripe Address Element.

zh-CN.description: 客户在 Stripe Address Element 中搜索地址时，此 Activity 会显示地址建议并返回所选地址。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Stripe Address Element 将无法提供地址搜索建议。

en.description: When a customer pays by Bacs Direct Debit, this Activity displays the debit mandate and captures its confirmation.
en.disableEffect: The Bacs Direct Debit mandate cannot be confirmed in the Stripe payment flow.

zh-CN.description: 客户使用 Bacs 直接借记付款时，此 Activity 会显示借记授权并收集确认。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Stripe 付款流程将无法确认 Bacs 直接借记授权。

en.description: When Stripe needs the card security code for a saved card, this Activity asks the customer to enter the CVC again.
en.disableEffect: Payments requiring a fresh CVC for a saved card may not continue.

zh-CN.description: Stripe 需要已保存银行卡的安全码时，此 Activity 会要求客户重新输入 CVC。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要重新验证已保存银行卡 CVC 的付款可能无法继续。

en.description: When a payment method is waiting for confirmation, this Activity shows the pending state while Stripe checks the payment result.
en.disableEffect: The customer will not see the pending-payment status or receive its completion result through this flow.

zh-CN.description: 付款方式正在等待确认时，此 Activity 会显示等待状态，并由 Stripe 检查付款结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 客户将无法在此流程中查看待处理付款状态或收到完成结果。

en.description: When a customer selects SEPA Direct Debit, this Activity displays the SEPA mandate for review and acceptance.
en.disableEffect: The customer will not be able to accept the SEPA mandate required for that payment method.

zh-CN.description: 客户选择 SEPA 直接借记时，此 Activity 会显示 SEPA 授权供客户查看并接受。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 客户将无法接受该付款方式所需的 SEPA 授权。

en.description: When a customer adds an eligible Stripe-issued card to a digital wallet, this Activity runs the wallet provisioning flow and returns its result.
en.disableEffect: Adding Stripe-issued cards to the wallet through the host app will stop working.

zh-CN.description: 客户将符合条件的 Stripe 发卡添加到数字钱包时，此 Activity 会执行钱包添加流程并返回结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 宿主应用将无法通过此流程把 Stripe 发卡添加到钱包。

en.description: When a customer chooses Shop Pay during checkout, this Activity loads the Shop Pay page and reports the authentication or checkout result.
en.disableEffect: The Shop Pay checkout option will not open or return its result.

zh-CN.description: 客户在结账时选择 Shop Pay，此 Activity 会加载 Shop Pay 页面并返回验证或结账结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Shop Pay 结账选项将无法打开或返回结果。

en.description: When a card issuer requests 3D Secure verification, this Activity displays the challenge and sends the customer's response back to Stripe.
en.disableEffect: Card payments that require an issuer challenge may not complete.

zh-CN.description: 发卡机构要求 3D Secure 验证时，此 Activity 会显示验证挑战并将客户的响应发送回 Stripe。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要发卡机构挑战验证的银行卡付款可能无法完成。

en.description: When the host app starts Stripe CardScan, this Activity opens the camera scanning flow and returns the scanned card result.
en.disableEffect: Card details cannot be collected with Stripe CardScan.

zh-CN.description: 宿主应用启动 Stripe CardScan 时，此 Activity 会打开相机扫描流程并返回扫描到的银行卡信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 将无法使用 Stripe CardScan 收集银行卡信息。

en.description: When the Payments UI Core card-scanning flow starts, this Activity presents the configured scan screen and returns the result through Stripe CardScan.
en.disableEffect: Card scanning through this Stripe payment UI flow will be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: Payments UI Core 的银行卡扫描流程启动时，此 Activity 会显示配置的扫描界面，并通过 Stripe CardScan 返回结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 此 Stripe 付款界面将无法使用银行卡扫描功能。

en.description: When a payment requires web authentication, this Activity loads the Stripe authentication page and returns the result from the WebView.
en.disableEffect: Web-based issuer or bank authentication required by a payment may not finish.

zh-CN.description: 付款需要网页验证时，此 Activity 会加载 Stripe 验证页面并从 WebView 返回结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 付款所需的发卡机构或银行网页验证可能无法完成。

en.description: When an internal Stripe payment step finishes, this Activity relays the payment result back to the Activity that started it.
en.disableEffect: The host app may not receive the result of a Stripe payment or authentication step.

zh-CN.description: Stripe 内部付款步骤结束时，此 Activity 会将付款结果转交给启动它的 Activity。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 宿主应用可能无法收到 Stripe 付款或验证步骤的结果。

en.description: When a Tap to Pay transaction starts from an NFC card tap, this Activity displays the contactless payment screen for the supplied amount.
en.disableEffect: Stripe Terminal Tap to Pay cannot start or finish this contactless payment flow.

zh-CN.description: Tap to Pay 交易由 NFC 银行卡触碰启动时，此 Activity 会显示对应金额的无接触支付界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Stripe Terminal Tap to Pay 将无法启动或完成此无接触支付流程。

en.description: When a Tap to Pay transaction includes a surcharge, this Activity displays the surcharge amount and asks the customer to consent.
en.disableEffect: The customer cannot review or accept a surcharge through the Stripe Terminal flow.

zh-CN.description: Tap to Pay 交易包含附加费时，此 Activity 会显示附加费金额并请求客户同意。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 客户将无法通过 Stripe Terminal 流程查看或接受附加费。

en.description: When an app runs a simulated Tap to Pay transaction, this Activity displays the simulated contactless payment flow.
en.disableEffect: Simulated Tap to Pay transactions will stop working; real Tap to Pay remains available.

zh-CN.description: 应用运行模拟 Tap to Pay 交易时，此 Activity 会显示模拟的无接触支付流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 模拟 Tap to Pay 交易将无法使用；真实 Tap to Pay 仍可使用。

en.description: Stripe Terminal binds this service for reader discovery, activation, contactless payment collection, PIN collection, cancellation, and disconnect requests.
en.disableEffect: The host app will not be able to connect to its local reader or collect contactless payments through this service.

zh-CN.description: Stripe Terminal 会绑定此服务以发现和激活读卡器、收集无接触付款和 PIN、取消交易或断开连接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 宿主应用将无法通过此服务连接本地读卡器或收集无接触付款。

en.description: When the app uses a simulated Stripe Terminal reader, this service handles simulated reader and payment requests.
en.disableEffect: Simulated reader sessions and simulated payments will stop working; real readers remain available.

zh-CN.description: 应用使用 Stripe Terminal 模拟读卡器时，此服务会处理模拟读卡器和付款请求。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 模拟读卡器会话和模拟付款将无法使用；真实读卡器仍可使用。

en.description: Stripe Terminal binds this service when it needs to discover the Tap to Pay reader, collect a card payment or PIN, or process a reader update.
en.disableEffect: Tap to Pay will not be able to discover its reader or collect contactless payments.

zh-CN.description: Stripe Terminal 需要发现 Tap to Pay 读卡器、收集银行卡付款或 PIN，或更新读卡器时会绑定此服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Tap to Pay 将无法发现读卡器或收集无接触付款。

en.description: When the app uses a simulated Tap to Pay reader, this service handles simulated reader and contactless payment requests.
en.disableEffect: Simulated Tap to Pay sessions and payments will stop working; real Tap to Pay remains available.

zh-CN.description: 应用使用 Tap to Pay 模拟读卡器时，此服务会处理模拟读卡器和无接触付款请求。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Tap to Pay 模拟会话和付款将无法使用；真实 Tap to Pay 仍可使用。

en.description: When the app runs a simulated Tap to Pay reader, this service handles simulated discovery and simulated payment collection.
en.disableEffect: Simulated Tap to Pay payments will stop working; the production Tap to Pay service remains available.

zh-CN.description: 应用运行 Tap to Pay 模拟读卡器时，此服务会处理模拟发现和模拟付款收集。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Tap to Pay 模拟付款将无法使用；正式 Tap to Pay 服务仍可使用。

en.description: Stripe Terminal exposes this protected provider for reading and updating the protobuf data used for payment-method specifications.
en.disableEffect: Stripe Terminal cannot exchange payment-method specifications through this provider.

zh-CN.description: Stripe Terminal 通过此受保护的提供程序读取和更新付款方式规格所用的 protobuf 数据。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Stripe Terminal 将无法通过此提供程序交换付款方式规格。

en.description: When the app runs a simulated Stripe Terminal Local Mobile payment, this Activity displays the simulated contactless transaction.
en.disableEffect: Simulated Local Mobile reader payments will stop working; real reader payments remain available.

zh-CN.description: 应用运行 Stripe Terminal Local Mobile 模拟付款时，此 Activity 会显示模拟的无接触交易。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Local Mobile 模拟读卡器付款将无法使用；真实读卡器付款仍可使用。

en.description: When Android reports that a USB reader was attached, this Stripe Terminal Activity forwards the device event to the SDK and then closes.
en.disableEffect: The SDK may not notice newly attached USB readers, so USB reader discovery can fail.

zh-CN.description: Android 报告 USB 读卡器已连接时，此 Stripe Terminal Activity 会将设备事件转发给 SDK，然后关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: SDK 可能无法发现新连接的 USB 读卡器。

en.description: The Strivacity identity SDK uses this Activity when an identity sign-in returns, delivering the authorization result or error back to the app.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, the app may not receive the sign-in result, so Strivacity login can fail.

zh-CN.description: Strivacity 身份认证 SDK 会在登录流程返回时运行此 Activity，并把授权结果或错误交还给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用可能收不到登录结果，Strivacity 登录流程会失败。

en.description: When a browser returns through the app's sign-in link, this Strivacity Activity passes the returned address to the SDK to finish authentication.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, browser sign-in redirects cannot be delivered back to the app, so login can fail.

zh-CN.description: 浏览器通过应用的登录链接返回时，Strivacity 身份认证 SDK 会运行此 Activity，把返回信息交给登录流程继续处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，浏览器返回的登录链接无法交给应用处理，Strivacity 登录可能无法完成。

en.description: The Strivacity Android SDK opens this Activity to continue a pending identity sign-in and return its result to the app.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, Strivacity sign-in cannot finish reliably and users may be unable to log in.

zh-CN.description: Strivacity Android SDK 会在登录请求返回后打开此 Activity，并将登录结果交给应用处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Strivacity 登录流程可能无法完成，用户可能无法登录。

en.description: The Strivacity Android SDK opens this Activity while a user is signing out, to continue the identity provider's end-session step.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, sign-out may not complete and the user may remain signed in.

zh-CN.description: 用户退出账号时，Strivacity Android SDK 会打开此 Activity，继续完成身份提供方的退出流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，退出流程可能无法完成，用户可能仍保持登录状态。

en.description: This 5G MsgService screen shows the conversation list and prompts for the message, camera, microphone and location access its features use.
en.disableEffect: The main 5G messaging conversation screen will be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: 此 5G MsgService 页面会显示会话列表，并请求消息、相机、麦克风和位置功能所需的权限。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 5G 消息的主会话页面将无法使用。

en.description: The 5G MsgService file-sharing provider gives message files shareable links that other screens or apps can open with temporary access.
en.disableEffect: Opening or sharing message attachments that rely on these links may fail.

zh-CN.description: 5G MsgService 的文件共享服务会为消息文件生成可共享的链接，其他页面或应用可通过临时授权打开文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖这些链接打开或分享消息附件时可能会失败。

en.description: When a carrier delivers a 5G message through an MMS notification, this receiver reads the delivery data and fetches the linked message details.
en.disableEffect: The app may not retrieve message details linked to incoming MMS notifications.

zh-CN.description: 运营商通过彩信通知投递 5G 消息时，此接收器会读取投递数据并获取关联的消息详情。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用可能无法获取传入彩信通知所关联的消息详情。

en.description: The 5G MsgService screen registers this receiver for incoming SMS and downloaded-MMS notices. In the analyzed code, these notices do not add a message or change the screen.
en.disableEffect: No user-visible change from this receiver was found in the analyzed code.

zh-CN.description: 5G MsgService 页面会为新短信和已下载彩信通知注册此接收器。所分析的代码中，这些通知不会添加消息或改变页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 在所分析的代码中，未发现停用此接收器会带来可见变化。

en.description: This screen opens a map at the user’s current position, shows nearby places and lets the user send a selected location in a conversation.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to choose and share a location from the messaging flow.

zh-CN.description: 此页面会在地图上显示用户当前位置和附近地点，并可将选定位置发送到会话中。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在消息流程中选择并分享位置。

en.description: This screen shows a location shared in a message on a map and can open a navigation app for directions.
en.disableEffect: Shared locations cannot be viewed on this map or opened for navigation from the message.

zh-CN.description: 此页面会在地图上显示消息中分享的位置，并可打开导航应用前往该地点。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在此地图上查看分享的位置，也无法从消息中打开导航。

en.description: This screen displays news or linked web pages inside 5G MsgService and routes supported payment or external-app links to the relevant app.
en.disableEffect: In-app news pages and their supported payment or external-app handoffs will not work here.

zh-CN.description: 此页面会在 5G MsgService 中显示新闻或链接网页，并将支持的支付链接或外部应用链接交给相应应用处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用内新闻页面及其支持的支付或外部应用跳转将无法使用。

en.description: This screen displays a web page or supplied web content inside the 5G MsgService app.
en.disableEffect: Screens that rely on this embedded page will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: 此页面会在 5G MsgService 应用中显示网页或提供的网页内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此内嵌页面的应用界面将无法打开。

en.description: This screen shows a chatbot’s name, account number, picture and introduction in 5G MsgService.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to view the chatbot profile from this screen.

zh-CN.description: 此页面会在 5G MsgService 中展示聊天机器人的名称、账号、头像和介绍。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此页面查看聊天机器人资料。

en.description: This is the conversation screen for viewing and sending messages, including shared locations and attachments.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to open or use this conversation screen.

zh-CN.description: 此页面用于查看和发送会话消息，包括分享的位置和附件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开或使用此会话页面。

en.description: This screen shows details for a selected conversation and includes controls for keeping it at the top of the list.
en.disableEffect: Conversation details and their list-position controls will be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: 此页面会显示所选会话的详情，并提供将会话固定在列表顶部的控制项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 会话详情及其列表位置控制项将无法使用。

en.description: This screen plays a video shared in a conversation, displays its title and details, and offers an option to share the video link.
en.disableEffect: Videos opened through this screen cannot be played or shared from the conversation.

zh-CN.description: 此页面会播放会话中分享的视频，显示标题和详情，并提供分享视频链接的选项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过此页面打开的视频将无法在会话中播放或分享。

en.description: This screen searches messages within the conversation selected by the user.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to search messages in a conversation.

zh-CN.description: 此页面用于搜索用户所选会话中的消息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法搜索会话中的消息。

en.description: This screen searches the 5G MsgService directory for chatbot accounts and displays matching results.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to search for chatbot accounts in the service directory.

zh-CN.description: 此页面会在 5G MsgService 服务号目录中搜索聊天机器人账号并显示匹配结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在服务号目录中搜索聊天机器人账号。

en.description: This screen opens photos and videos attached to messages for full-screen viewing and playback.
en.disableEffect: Message photos and videos opened through this screen cannot be previewed or played.

zh-CN.description: 此页面会全屏查看或播放消息附件中的照片和视频。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过此页面打开的消息照片和视频将无法预览或播放。

en.description: This screen opens the camera to take a photo or record a video, then returns the result to the conversation that requested it.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot capture a new photo or video from the messaging flow.

zh-CN.description: 此页面会打开相机拍摄照片或录制视频，并将结果返回到发起请求的会话。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在消息流程中拍摄新照片或录制视频。

en.description: Stytch starts this Activity during single sign-on. It opens the selected browser to the sign-in address, then returns success, cancellation, or an error to the app.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, apps using Stytch single sign-on cannot complete that login flow.

zh-CN.description: 用户通过 Stytch 单点登录时，SDK 会打开此 Activity，并在浏览器中显示身份提供方的登录页面；完成、取消或出错后，它会把结果交回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，使用 Stytch 单点登录的应用将无法完成该登录流程。

en.description: When a browser returns through a Stytch sign-in link, Android opens this Activity to pass the returned address into the ongoing single sign-on flow.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, Stytch cannot receive the browser sign-in response, so single sign-on may fail.

zh-CN.description: 浏览器通过 Stytch 登录链接返回时，Android 会打开此 Activity，把返回信息交给正在进行的单点登录流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Stytch 无法接收浏览器返回的登录结果，单点登录可能失败。

en.description: Stytch's UI SDK opens this Activity with a sign-in configuration to display its login screen. It also handles a browser link returned after sign-in.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, apps using this Stytch sign-in screen cannot complete login.

zh-CN.description: Stytch UI SDK 会使用此 Activity 显示应用配置的登录页面，也会接收浏览器返回的登录链接以完成验证。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，使用此 Stytch 登录页面的应用将无法完成登录。

en.description: Stytch uses this Activity to show a configured business sign-in screen and handle the browser return link after authentication.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, Stytch business-account sign-in cannot complete in apps that use this screen.

zh-CN.description: Stytch Android SDK 会使用此 Activity 显示企业账号登录页面，并处理浏览器返回的登录链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，使用此页面的应用将无法完成 Stytch 企业账号登录。

en.description: Stytch uses this Activity to show a configured consumer sign-in screen and handle the browser return link after authentication.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, Stytch consumer sign-in cannot complete in apps that use this screen.

zh-CN.description: Stytch Android SDK 会使用此 Activity 显示个人账号登录页面，并处理浏览器返回的登录链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，使用此页面的应用将无法完成 Stytch 个人账号登录。

en.description: The SuiFeng Permission library opens this screen when a permission has been denied and the user needs the relevant Android settings page. It explains the denial and offers a route to those settings.
en.disableEffect: Users lose the library path to Android settings for restoring denied permissions, which can leave permission-dependent app features unavailable.

zh-CN.description: SuiFeng Permission 权限库会在某项权限被拒绝、用户需要前往相关 Android 设置时打开此页面。页面说明权限原因，并提供进入相应设置的入口。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此库前往 Android 设置恢复被拒绝的权限，依赖这些权限的应用功能可能无法使用。

en.description: The SuiFeng Permission library starts this screen when the app requests Android runtime permissions. It performs the permission request and returns the granted and denied results to the caller.
en.disableEffect: Features that need these permissions can no longer obtain them through the SuiFeng Permission library.

zh-CN.description: 应用通过 SuiFeng Permission 权限库请求 Android 运行时权限时，会启动此页面。页面执行权限申请，并将已授权和被拒绝的结果返回给调用方。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖这些权限的功能将无法再通过 SuiFeng Permission 权限库获取授权。

en.description: Sum-sdl's Android development library uses this Provider to give the app and other apps protected links to files in the library's configured folders.
en.disableEffect: Apps that receive one of these file links may no longer be able to open it.

zh-CN.description: Sum-sdl 的 Android 开发库通过此 Provider 为配置目录中的文件提供受保护的访问链接，供本应用或其他应用打开。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 收到这些文件链接的应用可能无法再打开相应文件。

en.description: Sum-sdl's Android UI library opens this Activity when an app requests a new photo; users can take a picture, review it, retake it, or return it to the app.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to capture and return a photo through this library's camera screen.

zh-CN.description: 应用需要拍摄照片时，Sum-sdl Android UI 库会打开此 Activity；用户可以拍照、预览、重拍并将照片交回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此库的相机界面拍摄并返回照片。

en.description: Sum-sdl's Android UI library opens this Activity when an app requests photos; users can browse album folders, choose images, optionally take a new photo, and return the selection.
en.disableEffect: Users will lose this library's photo album and selection screen.

zh-CN.description: 应用需要选择照片时，Sum-sdl Android UI 库会打开此 Activity；用户可以浏览相册目录、选择图片、按需拍照并返回所选内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法使用此库的相册浏览和选图界面。

en.description: Sum-sdl's Android UI library opens this Activity to show requested photos full-screen; users can swipe between them, zoom, and close the preview.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to inspect photos in this library's full-screen preview.

zh-CN.description: Sum-sdl Android UI 库会通过此 Activity 全屏展示所请求的照片；用户可以切换照片、放大查看并关闭预览。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法使用此库的全屏照片预览。

en.description: Sum-sdl's Android UI library opens this Activity for in-app web pages, loading the requested site and allowing a page to select a file for upload.
en.disableEffect: Users will lose web pages and file uploads that the host app opens through this library.

zh-CN.description: Sum-sdl Android UI 库通过此 Activity 打开应用内网页，并允许网页选择文件上传。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 宿主应用通过此库打开的网页和文件上传功能将无法使用。

en.description: During OAuth sign-in, SumUp Identity Auth opens this Activity to start the browser authorization step and finish the login when the browser returns.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, the browser-based sign-in response cannot be completed, so authentication may fail.

zh-CN.description: 进行 OAuth 登录时，SumUp Identity Auth 会打开此 Activity 启动浏览器授权，并在浏览器返回后完成登录。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，浏览器返回的登录结果无法完成处理，身份验证可能失败。

en.description: When the browser returns through the app's sign-in callback link, SumUp Identity Auth forwards the returned address to the ongoing authorization flow.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, the app cannot receive the browser sign-in redirect, so login may fail.

zh-CN.description: 浏览器通过应用的登录回调链接返回时，SumUp Identity Auth 会打开此 Activity，并把返回信息交给登录流程处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用无法接收浏览器返回的登录链接，登录可能失败。

en.description: When a merchant opens automatic receipt settings, SumUp Reader displays this screen to turn the setting on or off and return the choice to the app.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, merchants cannot change automatic receipt settings through the SumUp Reader SDK.

zh-CN.description: 商户打开自动回执设置时，SumUp Reader 会显示此页面，供商户开启或关闭自动发送回执，并把选择结果返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，商户无法通过 SumUp Reader SDK 更改自动回执设置。

en.description: SumUp Reader displays this Activity for merchant sign-in, including password login and automatic sign-in with an existing account.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, merchants may be unable to sign in, so Reader features that require an account can fail.

zh-CN.description: 商户登录 SumUp Reader 时，应用会显示此页面，支持密码登录和已有账号的自动登录。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，商户可能无法登录，需要账号的 Reader 功能也可能无法使用。

en.description: SumUp Reader opens this screen for single sign-on or renewed authentication when an access token expires; it also handles identity checks needed before some payments.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, single sign-on and re-authentication may fail, preventing account-dependent payment flows.

zh-CN.description: SumUp Reader 会在单点登录或账号令牌过期时打开此页面，处理重新验证；它也会处理付款开始前需要的身份确认。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，单点登录或重新验证可能失败，依赖账号的付款流程也可能无法继续。

en.description: When Android reports which app was selected for a receipt share, SumUp Reader uses this receiver to record the destination for analytics. It does not send the receipt itself.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, receipt sharing still works, but SumUp Reader stops recording which destination app was chosen.

zh-CN.description: Android 返回用户在回执分享菜单中选择的应用时，SumUp Reader 会用此接收器记录分享目标的统计信息。它本身不负责发送回执。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，回执仍可分享，但 SumUp Reader 不会再记录用户选择的目标应用。

en.description: SumUp Reader opens this screen when reader setup or a connection needs troubleshooting. It shows recovery steps for the reported reader issue and returns the result to setup.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, reader troubleshooting and some connection-recovery flows cannot run, which can leave setup blocked.

zh-CN.description: 读卡器设置或连接需要排查时，SumUp Reader 会打开此页面，根据读卡器问题显示恢复步骤，并把结果返回设置流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，读卡器故障排查和部分连接恢复流程无法使用，设置过程可能受阻。

en.description: During reader setup, connection, or checkout problems, SumUp Reader uses this screen to guide merchants through Bluetooth retry and reset steps.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, users cannot reach Bluetooth recovery steps, and reader setup or payment connections may remain blocked.

zh-CN.description: 读卡器设置、连接或付款遇到蓝牙问题时，SumUp Reader 会显示此页面，指导商户重试或重置蓝牙。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法进入蓝牙恢复步骤，读卡器设置或付款连接可能受阻。

en.description: When a merchant opens the SumUp Reader card-reader page, this Activity shows reader connection controls and status, including firmware-update and low-battery notices.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, merchants lose the reader controls and status page, disrupting card-reader setup and payment use.

zh-CN.description: 商户打开 SumUp Reader 的读卡器页面时，此 Activity 显示连接控件和读卡器状态，也会提示固件更新或电量不足。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，商户无法使用读卡器控制和状态页面，读卡器设置及刷卡付款会受影响。

en.description: When an app starts a payment through the SumUp Reader API, this Activity displays and manages card checkout steps, transaction results, and receipt screens.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, card-payment sessions cannot launch or complete through this SDK.

zh-CN.description: 应用通过 SumUp Reader API 发起付款时，此 Activity 显示并处理刷卡结账步骤、交易结果和回执页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用将无法通过此 SDK 启动或完成刷卡付款。

en.description: When a merchant connects a SumUp card reader, this Activity discovers and pairs Bluetooth readers, handles connection permissions, and can install firmware updates; it also supports a wired setup path.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, merchants cannot set up or connect a card reader, so payments that require the reader may fail.

zh-CN.description: 商户连接 SumUp 读卡器时，此 Activity 会搜索并配对蓝牙读卡器、处理连接权限和固件更新，也支持有线连接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，商户无法设置或连接读卡器，需要读卡器的付款可能失败。

en.description: When a merchant opens SumUp Reader payment settings, this Activity displays the payment-configuration screen.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, merchants cannot open or change payment settings through the Reader SDK.

zh-CN.description: 商户打开 SumUp Reader 付款设置时，此 Activity 会显示付款配置页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，商户无法通过 Reader SDK 打开或更改付款设置。

en.description: When a merchant opens a support link during card-reader setup or Bluetooth troubleshooting, SumUp Reader displays the requested help page in its in-app browser.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, support pages opened from reader setup and Bluetooth troubleshooting may fail, making recovery guidance unavailable.

zh-CN.description: 商户在读卡器设置或蓝牙故障排查中打开帮助链接时，SumUp Reader 会在应用内显示相应的支持页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，读卡器设置和蓝牙排查中的帮助页面可能无法打开，用户会失去相关恢复指引。

en.description: The SUNMI AIDL Wrapper library starts this provider with the app and saves the app context so the library can later connect to SUNMI device services.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, apps that use the wrapper may fail to connect to the SUNMI service needed for their device operation.

zh-CN.description: SUNMI AIDL Wrapper 库会在应用启动时运行此 Provider，保存应用上下文，以便之后连接 SUNMI 设备服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，使用此库的应用可能无法连接所需的 SUNMI 服务，相关设备功能会失效。

en.description: SUNMI POS Router exposes this service to connected clients through a POS-channel request, allowing them to exchange channel configuration and requests with the app.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, clients cannot connect through the SUNMI POS channel, which can break connected POS or payment operations.

zh-CN.description: SUNMI POS Router 会通过此 Service 向连接的客户端提供 POS 通道，让它们与应用交换通道配置和请求。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，客户端无法通过 SUNMI POS 通道连接，相关 POS 或付款操作可能失败。

en.description: When the app receives a SUNMI ThingAdapter load request, this receiver prepares device-adapter communication and starts the app's adapter service.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, adapters used to connect supported devices or peripherals may not start.

zh-CN.description: 应用收到 SUNMI ThingAdapter 的加载请求时，此接收器会准备设备适配器通信并启动应用的适配器服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用于连接受支持设备或外设的适配器可能无法启动。

en.description: Sunst0069’s OL Android library opens this Activity for an in-app web page or web link; it loads the supplied address in an embedded browser and follows page navigation.
en.disableEffect: Web pages that the app routes through OL will no longer open inside the app.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开网页或网页链接时，Sunst0069 的 OL 安卓库会启动此 Activity；它在内置浏览器中加载指定地址并继续网页跳转。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用通过 OL 打开的网页将无法在应用内显示。

en.description: Sunst0069’s OL Android library opens this image viewer for a requested picture; it displays one or more local or remote images and supports zooming or swiping between them.
en.disableEffect: The app’s OL image preview screen will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求查看图片时，Sunst0069 的 OL 安卓库会打开此图片查看器；它可显示一张或多张本地或网络图片，并支持缩放或滑动切换。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用的 OL 图片预览界面将无法打开。

en.description: Sunst0069’s OL Android library uses this Receiver for APK-install requests; when it receives a downloaded APK path, it opens Android’s package installer.
en.disableEffect: The OL download flow will no longer open Android’s installer for a downloaded app.

zh-CN.description: Sunst0069 的 OL 安卓库使用此 Receiver 处理 APK 安装请求；收到已下载 APK 的路径后，它会打开 Android 安装程序。
zh-CN.disableEffect: OL 下载流程将无法为已下载的应用打开 Android 安装程序。

en.description: Sunst0069’s OL Android library uses this Receiver for APK-install requests; when it receives a downloaded APK path, it opens Android’s package installer.
en.disableEffect: The OL download flow will no longer open Android’s installer for a downloaded app.

zh-CN.description: Sunst0069 的 OL 安卓库使用此 Receiver 处理 APK 安装请求；收到已下载 APK 的路径后，它会打开 Android 安装程序。
zh-CN.disableEffect: OL 下载流程将无法为已下载的应用打开 Android 安装程序。

en.description: The Livery Android library’s download Service runs after the host app submits a URL; it downloads and saves the file, reports progress, and can open the file or start APK installation when requested.
en.disableEffect: Downloads, automatic file opening and APK installation handled by Livery will stop working.

zh-CN.description: 应用提交下载地址后，Livery 安卓库的下载 Service 会下载并保存文件、报告进度，并可按请求打开文件或启动 APK 安装。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Livery 提供的下载、自动打开文件和 APK 安装功能将无法使用。

en.description: Sunshuntao’s Livery Android library opens this Activity for an app web page or web link; it loads the supplied address in an embedded browser and supports page navigation.
en.disableEffect: Web pages that the app routes through Livery will no longer open inside the app.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开网页或网页链接时，Sunshuntao 的 Livery 安卓库会启动此 Activity；它在内置浏览器中加载指定地址并支持网页跳转。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用通过 Livery 打开的网页将无法在应用内显示。

en.description: Sunshuntao’s Livery Android library opens this Activity for requested images; it displays the image or image set supplied by the app and supports viewing them in the app.
en.disableEffect: Image previews routed through Livery will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求查看图片时，Sunshuntao 的 Livery 安卓库会打开此 Activity，显示应用提供的一张或一组图片。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过 Livery 打开的图片预览将无法显示。

en.description: Sunshuntao’s Livery Android library uses this Receiver for APK-install requests; when it receives a downloaded APK path, it opens Android’s package installer.
en.disableEffect: The Livery download flow will no longer open Android’s installer for a downloaded app.

zh-CN.description: Sunshuntao 的 Livery 安卓库使用此 Receiver 处理 APK 安装请求；收到已下载 APK 的路径后，它会打开 Android 安装程序。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Livery 下载流程将无法为已下载的应用打开 Android 安装程序。

en.description: At app startup, the Suparnatural file-system library initializes access to the app's files and cache directories for reading, writing, and directory operations.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, app features that read or store files through this library may fail.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，Suparnatural 文件系统库会初始化对应用文件和缓存目录的访问，供文件读写和目录操作使用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，依赖此库读取或保存文件的应用功能可能失效。

en.description: The SurveyMonkey Mobile Feedback SDK opens this Activity when the app starts an in-app feedback survey. It displays the supplied survey and returns the respondent's answers or a cancellation or error result to the app.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot show its SurveyMonkey feedback form or receive the user's answers through this SDK.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动内置反馈问卷时，SurveyMonkey Mobile Feedback SDK 会打开此 Activity 显示问卷，并将用户的回答、取消或错误结果返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用无法通过此 SDK 显示 SurveyMonkey 反馈问卷或接收用户回答。

en.description: The ImageFileSelector library by SW926 uses this Provider to create shareable content addresses for temporary image files. Its cropping flow gives an external cropper access to the input and output images through these addresses.
en.disableEffect: The image selector may fail to share temporary photos with a cropper, so cropping a selected image can stop working.

zh-CN.description: SW926 的 ImageFileSelector 库通过此 Provider 为临时图片创建可共享的内容地址。图片裁剪流程会通过这些地址向外部裁剪应用提供源图片和结果图片。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，图片选择器可能无法向裁剪应用提供临时图片，导致所选图片无法裁剪。

en.description: The Swedbank Pay Mobile SDK opens this Activity when a browser or another app returns from a payment through a web link or the app's configured payment link. It captures the returned address and signals the active payment session.
en.disableEffect: The app may not receive the payment return, leaving checkout unfinished or the payment status out of date.

zh-CN.description: 用户通过网页链接或应用配置的支付链接从浏览器或其他应用返回时，Swedbank Pay Mobile SDK 会打开此 Activity。它接收返回地址并通知正在进行的支付流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用可能收不到支付回跳，导致结账流程未完成或支付状态无法及时更新。

en.description: Sweet Net Monitor starts this provider with the app to prepare its developer diagnostics. On supported Android versions, it also adds shortcuts to the network monitor and saved-preference editor.
en.disableEffect: The diagnostic shortcuts and Sweet Net Monitor startup setup will not be available.

zh-CN.description: Sweet Net Monitor 会在应用启动时运行此 Provider，为开发者诊断工具做准备。在支持的 Android 版本上，它还会添加网络监控和已保存偏好设置编辑器的快捷方式。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 诊断工具快捷方式和 Sweet Net Monitor 的启动设置将不可用。

en.description: Sweet Net Monitor starts this provider with the app to initialize its network-request inspector; it does not show a screen.
en.disableEffect: The diagnostic inspector will not initialize, so its screens will not show captured request details.

zh-CN.description: Sweet Net Monitor 会在应用启动时运行此 Provider，以初始化网络请求检查工具；它不会显示页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 诊断检查工具将无法初始化，其页面也不会显示捕获的请求详情。

en.description: Sweet Net Monitor opens this Activity for its developer settings, including controls for request capture, sample responses, and weak-network testing.
en.disableEffect: Developers lose Sweet Net Monitor’s network-capture and network-simulation settings screen.

zh-CN.description: Sweet Net Monitor 会打开此 Activity 显示开发者设置，包括请求捕获、模拟响应和弱网测试选项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 开发者将无法使用 Sweet Net Monitor 的网络捕获和网络模拟设置页面。

en.description: Sweet Net Monitor opens this Activity from a captured request to show its address, request and response headers and bodies, and timing details.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open the monitor’s detailed view of a captured request.

zh-CN.description: Sweet Net Monitor 会从已捕获的请求打开此 Activity，显示请求地址、请求和响应的标头与内容，以及耗时信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法查看已捕获请求的详细信息。

en.description: Sweet Net Monitor’s launcher entry opens this Activity to display its developer network-monitor dashboard and captured request list.
en.disableEffect: The Sweet Net Monitor dashboard is unavailable from the app launcher.

zh-CN.description: 通过启动器中的 Sweet Net Monitor 入口会打开此 Activity，显示开发者网络监控面板和已捕获的请求列表。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 将无法通过应用启动器打开 Sweet Net Monitor 面板。

en.description: Sweet Net Monitor opens this Activity from its saved-preference inspector to show the values in a selected preference file.
en.disableEffect: Developers cannot inspect an individual saved-preference file in Sweet Net Monitor.

zh-CN.description: Sweet Net Monitor 会从已保存偏好设置检查工具打开此 Activity，显示所选偏好设置文件中的值。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 开发者将无法在 Sweet Net Monitor 中查看单个已保存偏好设置文件。

en.description: Sweet Net Monitor opens this Activity from its preference shortcut to browse and edit the app’s saved preferences.
en.disableEffect: Developers cannot browse or change saved preferences through Sweet Net Monitor.

zh-CN.description: Sweet Net Monitor 会通过偏好设置快捷方式打开此 Activity，供开发者浏览和编辑应用已保存的偏好设置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 开发者将无法通过 Sweet Net Monitor 浏览或修改已保存的偏好设置。

en.description: When XUpdate starts an app update download, this service downloads the update file and can show the user download progress.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot download updates through XUpdate while this service is disabled.

zh-CN.description: XUpdate 开始下载应用更新时，此 Service 会下载更新文件，并可向用户显示下载进度。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用此 Service 后，应用将无法通过 XUpdate 下载更新。

en.description: When XUpdate installs a downloaded update, this provider lets Android's package installer read the update file through a temporary content link.
en.disableEffect: The installer cannot receive the update file from XUpdate, so installing updates through it will fail.

zh-CN.description: XUpdate 安装已下载的更新时，此 Provider 会通过临时内容链接让 Android 安装程序读取更新文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 安装程序无法从 XUpdate 获取更新文件，因此通过它安装更新会失败。

en.description: When XUpdate finds an available update, this screen displays its version information and offers install, background download, and ignore options.
en.disableEffect: The user cannot open XUpdate's update prompt or choose its update actions.

zh-CN.description: XUpdate 检测到可用更新时，此界面会显示版本信息，并提供立即安装、后台下载或忽略更新等选项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开 XUpdate 更新提示或选择其中的更新操作。

en.description: The Swirepay Android SDK opens this Activity when the app starts an order checkout. It shows payment methods such as cards, UPI, and bank transfer, submits the selected payment, then continues to a payment page or result screen.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot submit orders through this Swirepay checkout, so the app's payment flow can fail.

zh-CN.description: 应用开始订单结账时，Swirepay Android SDK 会打开此 Activity。它显示银行卡、UPI 或银行转账等支付方式，提交用户选择的付款，并继续打开支付页面或结果页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过此 Swirepay 结账页面提交订单，应用的支付流程可能无法完成。

en.description: During a Swirepay checkout, this Activity displays the extra web payment step required by the selected payment method. It detects the return from that page and opens the payment status screen.
en.disableEffect: The external payment step may not finish or return its result to the app.

zh-CN.description: Swirepay 结账需要所选支付方式进行网页验证或跳转时，此 Activity 会显示相应页面。用户返回后，它会打开支付状态页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，外部支付步骤可能无法完成，或无法将结果返回应用。

en.description: The Swirepay Android SDK opens this Activity after payment submission or a completed redirect to check the payment session and show success, failure, or retry choices.
en.disableEffect: Users may not see the final payment status or be able to retry through this SDK flow.

zh-CN.description: 提交付款或完成网页跳转后，Swirepay Android SDK 会打开此 Activity 查询支付状态，并显示成功、失败或重试选项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户可能看不到最终支付状态，也无法通过此 SDK 流程重试。

en.description: The Swirepay Android SDK's abstract base Activity supplies the shared in-app browser and file-selection behavior used by several specific payment and account screens. The SDK opens those specific screens; this base has no separate user-facing page.
en.disableEffect: This abstract base Activity has no separate screen or task, so blocking its entry has no independent user-visible effect.

zh-CN.description: Swirepay Android SDK 的此抽象基础 Activity 为多个支付和账户页面提供共用的应用内浏览及文件选择功能。SDK 会打开各个具体页面，此基础类本身没有独立的用户界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 此抽象基础 Activity 没有独立页面或任务，停用它本身不会产生单独的用户可见影响。

en.description: When the app starts Swirepay account setup, this Activity opens Swirepay's secure account connection page and returns the result to the app.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot connect or finish setting up the Swirepay account through this flow.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动 Swirepay 账户设置时，此 Activity 会打开 Swirepay 的安全账户连接页面，并将结果返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用无法通过此流程连接或完成 Swirepay 账户设置。

en.description: When the app requests an invoice payment, the Swirepay Android SDK opens the matching secure invoice page in this Activity and returns the result.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open or pay that invoice through the app's Swirepay flow.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求支付发票时，Swirepay Android SDK 会在此 Activity 中打开对应的安全发票页面，并将结果返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过应用中的 Swirepay 流程打开或支付该发票。

en.description: The Swirepay Android SDK uses this native form to create a payment link. It collects an amount and customer contact details, lets the user choose payment methods and email or text notifications, then sends the request to Swirepay.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot create payment links through this Swirepay form.

zh-CN.description: Swirepay Android SDK 使用此原生表单创建支付链接。表单收集金额和客户联系方式，允许用户选择支付方式及通过邮件或短信通知，然后向 Swirepay 提交请求。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用无法通过此 Swirepay 表单创建支付链接。

en.description: The Swirepay Android SDK opens this Activity when the app starts a payment-link flow. It loads the Swirepay payment page, checks the returned payment status, and sends the result back to the app.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot complete payment through this Swirepay link flow.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动支付链接流程时，Swirepay Android SDK 会打开此 Activity。它加载 Swirepay 支付页面、查询返回的支付状态，并将结果传回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过此 Swirepay 支付链接流程完成付款。

en.description: When a user opens a Swirepay payment button, this Activity loads the button's payment page and returns the payment result to the app.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot pay through the Swirepay payment-button flow.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 Swirepay 支付按钮时，此 Activity 会加载该按钮对应的支付页面，并将支付结果返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过 Swirepay 支付按钮完成付款。

en.description: When the app asks Swirepay to set up a payment method, this Activity opens the secure setup page and returns the selected method or an error.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot add or set up a payment method through this SDK flow.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求通过 Swirepay 设置支付方式时，此 Activity 会打开安全设置页面，并将用户选择的方式或错误结果返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过此 SDK 流程添加或设置支付方式。

en.description: When the app opens a Swirepay subscription option, this Activity loads the plan's checkout page and returns the subscription result.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot start or complete subscriptions through this Swirepay flow.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开 Swirepay 订阅选项时，此 Activity 会加载该方案的结账页面，并将订阅结果返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过此 Swirepay 流程开始或完成订阅。

en.description: When the app requests a payment token, this Activity submits the supplied token request to Swirepay and returns the created token or an error to the app.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot create payment tokens through the Swirepay SDK.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求支付令牌时，此 Activity 会向 Swirepay 提交令牌请求，并将创建的令牌或错误结果返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用无法通过 Swirepay SDK 创建支付令牌。

en.description: When an InMobi Swish Analytics data-store retry is scheduled, this service resends analytics logs that previously failed to upload.
en.disableEffect: Failed data-store analytics logs may not be retried; regular app features remain available.

zh-CN.description: 计划重试 InMobi Swish Analytics 数据存储时，此服务会重新发送先前上传失败的分析日志。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，数据存储中上传失败的分析日志可能不会重试，但应用常规功能仍可使用。

en.description: When an InMobi Swish Analytics event-sync retry is scheduled, this service resends analytics logs that previously failed to upload.
en.disableEffect: Failed event-sync analytics logs may not be retried; regular app features remain available.

zh-CN.description: 计划重试 InMobi Swish Analytics 事件同步时，此服务会重新发送先前上传失败的分析日志。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，事件同步中上传失败的分析日志可能不会重试，但应用常规功能仍可使用。

en.description: Chalk Digital's CD Ads SDK starts this background task when Android reports a monitored location-area transition. It processes arrival, departure, or dwell events for location-based ads.
en.disableEffect: CD Ads will stop receiving these geofence-triggered location events.

zh-CN.description: Android 报告受监测区域的位置变化时，Chalk Digital 的 CD Ads 广告 SDK 会启动此后台任务，处理进入、离开或停留事件以支持位置相关广告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，CD Ads 将无法收到这些由地理围栏触发的位置事件。

en.description: When Android sends a BOOT_COMPLETED broadcast, this receiver asks Chalk Digital's CD Ads location service to resume scanning.
en.disableEffect: The SDK's beacon and location scanning will not resume through this receiver after a device reboot.

zh-CN.description: Android 发送启动完成广播时，此接收器会让 Chalk Digital 的 CD Ads 定位服务恢复扫描。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，设备重启时 SDK 将无法通过此接收器恢复信标和位置扫描。

en.description: When Chalk Digital's CD Ads location service starts, it launches beacon scanning if that option is enabled; otherwise it starts GPS location updates.
en.disableEffect: CD Ads will stop using this service for beacon or GPS location scans.

zh-CN.description: Chalk Digital 的 CD Ads 定位服务启动时，如果启用了信标扫描就开始扫描；否则会开始通过 GPS 更新位置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，CD Ads 将无法通过此服务进行信标或 GPS 位置扫描。

en.description: When someone opens a Swrve push notification, this Swrve Android SDK Receiver records the notification engagement. If disabled, Swrve will stop recording those opens.
en.disableEffect: Swrve reports will no longer include these notification opens.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 Swrve 推送通知时，Swrve Android SDK 的此接收器会记录这次通知互动。停用后，Swrve 将不再记录这些打开行为。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Swrve 报告将不再包含这些通知打开记录。

en.description: When Swrve has queued events to upload, this Service sends them in the background through the Swrve Android SDK.
en.disableEffect: Queued Swrve events may not be uploaded while the app is in the background.

zh-CN.description: Swrve Android SDK 有待上传的事件时，此服务会在后台发送这些事件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用在后台时，排队等待发送的 Swrve 事件可能无法上传。

en.description: Firebase starts this Service for new push tokens and incoming messages; it registers the token with Swrve and passes Swrve notifications to the SDK for processing.
en.disableEffect: Swrve push notifications may stop arriving or being processed.

zh-CN.description: Firebase 收到新的推送令牌或消息时会启动此服务；它会向 Swrve 登记令牌，并将 Swrve 通知交给 SDK 处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Swrve 推送通知可能无法送达或处理。

en.description: When Swrve schedules background work for a location-fence event, this Service sends the enter or exit event to Swrve and schedules a check for related location notifications.
en.disableEffect: Swrve location events and location-based notifications may stop being processed.

zh-CN.description: Swrve 为地理围栏事件安排后台任务时，此服务会向 Swrve 发送进入或离开事件，并安排检查相关位置通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Swrve 位置事件和基于位置的通知可能无法继续处理。

en.description: Android's job scheduler starts this Service to process Swrve location-fence events, send them to Swrve, and schedule related location notifications.
en.disableEffect: Swrve location events and location-based notifications may stop being processed.

zh-CN.description: Android 的任务调度器会启动此服务来处理 Swrve 地理围栏事件、将事件发送给 Swrve，并安排相关位置通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Swrve 位置事件和基于位置的通知可能无法继续处理。

en.description: When Swrve's location module delivers a geofence event, this Receiver processes the enter or exit event and arranges a check for related location notifications.
en.disableEffect: Swrve location events and location-based notifications may stop being processed.

zh-CN.description: Swrve 位置模块传来地理围栏事件时，此接收器会处理进入或离开事件，并安排检查相关位置通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Swrve 位置事件和基于位置的通知可能无法继续处理。

en.description: Huawei's push service starts this Service for token changes or incoming messages; it registers the token with Swrve and processes Swrve notifications.
en.disableEffect: Swrve notifications delivered through Huawei push may stop working.

zh-CN.description: 华为推送服务收到令牌变更或新消息时会启动此服务；它会向 Swrve 登记令牌并处理 Swrve 通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过华为推送送达的 Swrve 通知可能无法使用。

en.description: When Swrve selects an in-app message, this Activity displays its pages and records message views and button actions.
en.disableEffect: Swrve in-app messages, offers, or prompts may no longer appear.

zh-CN.description: Swrve 选中一条应用内消息时，此活动页面会显示消息内容，并记录浏览和按钮操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Swrve 应用内消息、优惠或提示可能不再显示。

en.description: When a Swrve rich notification is dismissed, this Receiver removes the cached GIF image data used by that notification.
en.disableEffect: Images from dismissed Swrve notifications may remain cached longer.

zh-CN.description: 用户关闭 Swrve 富媒体通知时，此接收器会清除该通知使用的 GIF 图片缓存。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 已关闭的 Swrve 通知图片可能会在缓存中保留更久。

en.description: When a user taps a Swrve notification that opens an Activity, this Activity records the engagement and processes the notification's destination before closing.
en.disableEffect: Swrve notification taps may no longer be recorded or routed to their destination.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击会打开活动页面的 Swrve 通知时，此活动页面会记录互动、处理通知目标，然后关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Swrve 通知点击可能不再被记录，也可能无法打开对应目标。

en.description: When a Swrve notification action arrives as a broadcast, this Receiver records the engagement and processes the notification's destination.
en.disableEffect: Swrve notification actions may no longer be recorded or routed to their destination.

zh-CN.description: Swrve 通知操作以广播形式到达时，此接收器会记录互动并处理通知目标。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Swrve 通知操作可能不再被记录，也可能无法打开对应目标。

en.description: Swrve schedules this Service after a location event to check for matching location-based notifications and show eligible messages.
en.disableEffect: Swrve location-based notifications may no longer be fetched or shown.

zh-CN.description: 发生位置事件后，Swrve 会安排此服务查找匹配的位置通知并显示符合条件的消息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Swrve 可能无法再获取或显示基于位置的通知。

en.description: When a scheduled Swrve location-notification alarm fires, this Receiver starts the background check that fetches matching messages and displays eligible notifications.
en.disableEffect: Swrve location-based notifications may no longer be fetched or shown.

zh-CN.description: Swrve 的位置通知定时任务到期时，此接收器会启动后台检查，获取匹配的消息并显示符合条件的通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Swrve 可能无法再获取或显示基于位置的通知。

en.description: Swrve opens this Activity when a notification prompt or in-app message needs an Android permission; it shows the system permission request or the related settings screen.
en.disableEffect: Swrve permission prompts may fail to open, so the notification or message action that requested permission may not work.

zh-CN.description: 通知提示或应用内消息需要申请 Android 权限时，Swrve 会打开此活动页面，显示系统权限请求或相关设置页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Swrve 权限提示可能无法打开，因此发起申请的通知或消息操作可能无法使用。

en.description: When a user taps a Swrve push notification, this Receiver records the engagement and opens its deep link or configured app screen.
en.disableEffect: Swrve push taps may no longer open their destination or report the engagement.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击 Swrve 推送通知时，此接收器会记录互动，并打开通知中的链接或指定的应用页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 点击 Swrve 推送后，可能无法打开目标页面或记录互动。

en.description: When Swrve needs to send queued events in the background, this Receiver starts the background event-sending service.
en.disableEffect: Queued Swrve events may not be sent reliably while the app is in the background.

zh-CN.description: Swrve 需要在后台发送排队事件时，此接收器会启动后台事件发送服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用在后台时，排队等待发送的 Swrve 事件可能无法可靠送达。

en.description: After Swrve queues a background event batch, this Service sends the events and releases the system wake lock when the work finishes.
en.disableEffect: Queued Swrve events may not be uploaded in the background.

zh-CN.description: Swrve 排队安排后台事件发送后，此服务会发送这些事件，并在完成后释放系统唤醒锁。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 排队等待发送的 Swrve 事件可能无法在后台上传。

en.description: When Swrve opens a conversation, this Activity displays its pages and collects the user's answers.
en.disableEffect: Swrve conversations, surveys, or other interactive prompts may no longer appear.

zh-CN.description: Swrve 打开会话内容时，此活动页面会显示各页内容并收集用户回答。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Swrve 会话、问卷或其他互动提示可能不再显示。

en.description: Android sends background location updates here, and Swrve uses them to refresh location tracking and nearby location-based campaigns.
en.disableEffect: Swrve geofence updates and location-based messages may stop responding to movement.

zh-CN.description: Android 会将后台位置更新发送到此接收器，Swrve 用这些更新刷新位置跟踪和附近的位置活动。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Swrve 地理围栏更新和基于位置的消息可能不再随位置变化触发。

en.description: After the phone restarts, Android notifies this Receiver so it can resume Swrve's one-time location updates when geolocation is active.
en.disableEffect: Swrve location tracking may not resume after a phone restart, delaying location-based messages.

zh-CN.description: 手机重启后，Android 会通知此接收器；若 Swrve 地理位置功能已启用，它会恢复一次性位置更新。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 手机重启后，Swrve 位置跟踪可能无法恢复，导致基于位置的消息延迟。

en.description: When Swrve starts continuous location tracking, this foreground Service maintains location updates and shows the configured persistent notification.
en.disableEffect: Continuous Swrve location updates and the location-based features that use them may stop.

zh-CN.description: Swrve 开始持续位置跟踪时，此前台服务会维持位置更新并显示设置好的常驻通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Swrve 持续位置更新及依赖这些更新的位置功能可能停止。

en.description: Swrve opens this Activity to explain and request foreground or background location access, and it can direct the user to app settings after a denial.
en.disableEffect: Swrve may be unable to request location access, so geofences and location-based campaigns may not start.

zh-CN.description: Swrve 会打开此活动页面说明并申请前台或后台位置权限；用户拒绝后，页面还可引导其进入应用设置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Swrve 可能无法申请位置权限，因此地理围栏和基于位置的活动可能无法启动。

en.description: Android sends this Receiver a geofence entry or exit, and Swrve checks the transition to trigger matching location campaigns.
en.disableEffect: Swrve location campaigns may no longer trigger when the user enters or leaves an area.

zh-CN.description: Android 检测到进入或离开地理围栏时会通知此接收器，Swrve 随后检查事件并触发匹配的位置活动。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户进入或离开区域时，Swrve 位置活动可能不再触发。

en.description: After Android returns a one-time location result, this Receiver restarts Swrve's geofence engine and notifies any configured location listener.
en.disableEffect: Swrve may not refresh geofences or deliver the corresponding location update.

zh-CN.description: Android 返回一次性位置结果后，此接收器会重启 Swrve 地理围栏引擎，并通知已配置的位置监听器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Swrve 可能无法刷新地理围栏或传递相应的位置更新。

en.description: When Swrve opens an in-app campaign, this Activity displays the message and records impressions and button actions.
en.disableEffect: Swrve in-app campaigns and their interactive messages may no longer appear.

zh-CN.description: Swrve 打开应用内活动消息时，此活动页面会显示内容，并记录展示次数和按钮操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Swrve 应用内活动及其互动消息可能不再显示。

en.description: When Swrve's default push handler queues an incoming notification, this Service processes it for display through the Swrve Android SDK.
en.disableEffect: Push notifications handled by Swrve's default service may no longer be displayed.

zh-CN.description: Swrve 默认推送处理器排入一条新通知后，此服务会通过 Swrve Android SDK 处理并显示通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 由 Swrve 默认服务处理的推送通知可能不再显示。

en.description: When Swrve hands a push notification to its default handler, this Receiver starts background processing for that notification.
en.disableEffect: Push notifications handled by Swrve's default service may no longer be displayed.

zh-CN.description: Swrve 将推送通知交给默认处理器时，此接收器会启动该通知的后台处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 由 Swrve 默认服务处理的推送通知可能不再显示。

en.description: When the SYN FBird ad SDK opens an interstitial ad, this Activity displays the advertisement and handles its close or dismissal callbacks.
en.disableEffect: Interstitial ads will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: SYN FBird 广告 SDK 打开插页广告时，此活动页面会显示广告并处理关闭回调。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 插页广告将无法再打开。

en.description: When the SYN FBird ad SDK opens a rewarded video, this Activity displays the ad and handles its completion callbacks.
en.disableEffect: Rewarded ads will no longer be available, and rewards for watching ads will no longer be granted.

zh-CN.description: SYN FBird 广告 SDK 打开激励视频时，此活动页面会显示广告并处理完成回调。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 激励广告将无法使用，观看广告后也不会再发放奖励。

en.description: When the SYN FBird ad SDK opens a downloaded app package for installation, this FileProvider gives Android the file access needed to open the installer.
en.disableEffect: Installing an app downloaded through an FBird ad may fail because Android cannot open the package file.

zh-CN.description: SYN FBird 广告 SDK 打开下载的应用安装包时，此文件提供器会向 Android 提供安装器所需的文件访问权限。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Android 无法打开安装包时，通过 FBird 广告下载的应用可能无法安装。

en.description: The Baidu Mobile Ads SDK uses this Activity to host pages it loads for ad interactions, such as an ad destination or download offer.
en.disableEffect: Blocking it prevents those Baidu ad pages from opening; the app’s other screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: 百度移动广告 SDK 会在用户打开广告时使用此 Activity 展示广告页面，例如广告落地页或下载页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，百度广告页面无法打开，应用的其他界面仍可使用。

en.description: Gerry Kwok's takephoto library opens this screen when the app passes in an image to crop; users adjust the crop area and confirm or cancel, and the result is returned to the app.
en.disableEffect: The app's photo-cropping step will no longer open or return the cropped image.

zh-CN.description: 应用把图片交给 Gerry Kwok 的 takephoto 图片工具进行裁剪时，会打开此界面；用户可调整裁剪范围并确认或取消，结果随后返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用的图片裁剪步骤将无法打开，也无法返回裁剪后的图片。

en.description: When an app requests motion updates from SYRF's location and sensor SDK, this service reads three-axis accelerometer movement and sends the readings to the app.
en.disableEffect: App features that rely on SYRF accelerometer readings will no longer receive motion updates.

zh-CN.description: 应用向 SYRF 位置与传感器 SDK 请求运动数据时，此服务会读取加速度计的三轴运动信息并发送给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，依赖 SYRF 加速度计数据的功能将无法收到运动更新。
