en.description: When an app requests motion updates from SYRF's location and sensor SDK, this service reads three-axis gyroscope data and sends the readings to the app.
en.disableEffect: App features that rely on SYRF gyroscope readings will no longer receive rotation updates.

zh-CN.description: 应用向 SYRF 位置与传感器 SDK 请求运动数据时，此服务会读取陀螺仪的三轴数据并发送给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，依赖 SYRF 陀螺仪数据的功能将无法收到旋转更新。

en.description: When an app requests a current position or subscribes to location updates through SYRF's location SDK, this service reads the device's location and sends new positions to the app.
en.disableEffect: Location or tracking features that rely on SYRF will stop receiving fresh positions.

zh-CN.description: 应用通过 SYRF 位置 SDK 请求当前位置或订阅位置更新时，此服务会读取设备位置，并将新位置发送给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，依赖 SYRF 的定位或跟踪功能将无法获取最新位置。

en.description: When an app requests magnetic-sensor updates from SYRF's location and sensor SDK, this service reads the device's three-axis magnetic-field data and sends it to the app.
en.disableEffect: App features that rely on SYRF magnetic-field readings, such as compass behavior, will no longer update.

zh-CN.description: 应用向 SYRF 位置与传感器 SDK 请求磁传感器数据时，此服务会读取设备的三轴磁场数据并发送给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，依赖 SYRF 磁场数据的功能（例如指南针方向）将无法更新。

en.description: When an app requests orientation updates from SYRF's location and sensor SDK, this service reads the device's rotation-vector sensor and sends orientation readings to the app.
en.disableEffect: App features that rely on SYRF orientation readings will no longer receive rotation updates.

zh-CN.description: 应用向 SYRF 位置与传感器 SDK 请求方向数据时，此服务会读取设备的旋转矢量传感器并将方向信息发送给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，依赖 SYRF 方向数据的功能将无法收到旋转更新。

en.description: The ksrainarthas Camera app refreshes this home-screen camera widget when Android sends an app-widget update. Tapping the widget opens the camera screen for photos or video.
en.disableEffect: The home-screen camera widget will stop opening the camera.

zh-CN.description: ksrainarthas Camera 会在 Android 更新桌面小组件时刷新这个相机入口。点按小组件后会打开相机，可拍照或录制视频。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，这个桌面相机小组件将无法打开相机。

en.description: The ksrainarthas Camera app refreshes its one-tap photo widget when Android sends an app-widget update. Tapping it opens the camera directly in photo-taking mode.
en.disableEffect: The one-tap photo widget will no longer open the capture screen.

zh-CN.description: ksrainarthas Camera 会在 Android 更新桌面小组件时刷新这个一键拍照入口。点按后会直接打开拍照界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，这个一键拍照小组件将无法打开拍照界面。

en.description: The ksrainarthas Camera app uses this screen for the live viewfinder and camera controls when the camera is opened. Users can take photos, record video, and review or save the result here.
en.disableEffect: The camera screen will not open, so taking photos or recording video through this camera app will stop.

zh-CN.description: 打开相机时，ksrainarthas Camera 会在此显示实时取景画面和拍摄控制。用户可在这里拍照、录像，并查看或保存拍摄结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，相机界面无法打开，拍照和录像功能会受影响。

en.description: The ksrainarthas Camera app opens this shortcut when its one-tap photo widget is tapped. It starts the main camera in photo-taking mode.
en.disableEffect: The one-tap photo shortcut will no longer open the camera in capture mode.

zh-CN.description: 点按 ksrainarthas Camera 的一键拍照小组件时，会打开此快捷入口。它会直接以拍照模式启动相机。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，一键拍照快捷入口将无法直接打开拍照界面。

en.description: The ksrainarthas LogReport SDK starts this background Service when a log upload is requested. It bundles saved logs with available crash reports and sends the archive to the configured reporting destination.
en.disableEffect: Crash reports and diagnostic log archives will no longer be sent to the configured destination.

zh-CN.description: 请求上传日志时，ksrainarthas LogReport SDK 会启动此后台服务。它会将已保存的日志与可用的崩溃报告打包，并发送到配置的报告接收端。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 崩溃报告和诊断日志压缩包将无法发送到配置的接收端。

en.description: When the ksrainarthas MQTT SDK receives a broker connection or topic command, this Service manages client sessions, retries failed connections, and handles subscribing, publishing, or disconnecting.
en.disableEffect: App features that depend on this SDK will stop receiving and publishing MQTT messages.

zh-CN.description: ksrainarthas MQTT SDK 收到连接服务器或处理主题的指令时，会由此服务管理客户端连接、重试失败的连接，并处理订阅、发布或断开操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此 SDK 的应用功能将无法继续接收或发布 MQTT 消息。

en.description: Opening the ksrainarthas MQTT demo from its launcher shows controls for entering a broker address and port, connecting test clients, subscribing to topics, and publishing messages.
en.disableEffect: The MQTT demo's broker and messaging screen will be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: 从启动器打开 ksrainarthas MQTT 示例应用后，可在此填写服务器地址和端口、连接测试客户端、订阅主题并发布消息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，MQTT 示例应用的服务器连接和消息操作界面将无法使用。

en.description: The ksrainarthas Utils SDK starts this background Service when the app registers a message listener or sends a message. It forwards messages to registered parts of the app.
en.disableEffect: App features that use Utils messaging may stop receiving messages.

zh-CN.description: 应用通过 ksrainarthas Utils 注册消息监听或发送消息时，会启动此后台服务，并将消息转发给应用中已注册的接收方。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖 Utils 消息功能的应用可能无法继续收到消息。

en.description: The ksrainarthas Utils file provider initializes the utility library automatically when Android starts the app and supplies shareable file links for app files. It runs as part of startup, before a screen is shown.
en.disableEffect: Utility initialization and file-sharing flows that use this provider may fail.

zh-CN.description: Android 启动应用时，ksrainarthas Utils 文件提供器会自动初始化工具库，并为应用文件提供可分享的链接。它会在显示界面前参与启动过程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此提供器的工具库初始化和文件分享功能可能会失败。

en.description: When a ksrainarthas Utils permission or system-settings flow is requested, this transparent Activity briefly opens to make the request and return Android's result to the app.
en.disableEffect: Permission and settings requests using the Utils SDK may not complete or return a result.

zh-CN.description: ksrainarthas Utils 请求权限或打开系统设置时，会短暂显示此透明界面，并将 Android 返回的结果交还给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过 Utils SDK 发起的权限或设置请求可能无法完成，或无法把结果返回应用。

en.description: The ksrainarthas Utils SDK opens this transparent helper screen for permission, settings, or other Android requests and returns the result to the app.
en.disableEffect: Permission or settings flows using this helper may not complete or return their result.

zh-CN.description: ksrainarthas Utils 会通过此透明辅助界面处理权限、系统设置或其他 Android 请求，并将结果交还给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此界面的权限或设置流程可能无法完成或返回结果。

en.description: The Szeasco GT-board SDK uses this receiver after Android reports an app installed or replaced; it reconnects the board's companion monitor service when that app changes and reopens the host app after its own update.
en.disableEffect: Companion monitoring will not restart when its app is installed or updated, and the host app will not automatically reopen after an update.

zh-CN.description: Szeasco GT 主板 SDK 在 Android 通知有应用安装或更新时使用此接收器；配套监控应用发生变化时，它会重新连接监控服务，而宿主应用自身更新后会重新打开。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 配套监控应用安装或更新后，监控服务将不会重新连接；宿主应用更新后也不会自动重新打开。

en.description: The Szeasco RK-board system SDK receives package-replaced broadcasts and relaunches the host app when its package has been updated.
en.disableEffect: The app will not automatically reopen after an update.

zh-CN.description: Szeasco RK 主板系统 SDK 在应用包更新后收到系统通知，并重新启动宿主应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用更新完成时将不会自动重新打开。

en.description: The Szeasco hardware SDK opens this screen when the app requests device shutdown or reboot. It signals the impending power change, releases hardware resources, and then carries out the selected command after a delay.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot use this SDK flow to shut down or reboot the device.

zh-CN.description: Szeasco 硬件 SDK 在应用请求关闭或重启设备时打开此界面。它会发出即将改变设备电源状态的通知、释放硬件资源，并在延迟后执行所选操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用无法通过此 SDK 流程关闭或重启设备。

en.description: The Szeasco hardware SDK receives Android NFC technology-discovery intents here, forwards the tag to its ID-card reader, and closes the screen after handling it.
en.disableEffect: NFC tag and ID-card reading through this dispatch flow will stop.

zh-CN.description: Szeasco 硬件 SDK 通过此界面接收 Android 的 NFC 技术发现事件，将卡片交给身份证读卡功能处理，然后关闭界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，此流程将无法处理 NFC 标签或读取身份证。

en.description: The Szeasco hardware SDK binds this service to show content on a second display. It lets the app draw, update, or dismiss a presentation there.
en.disableEffect: The app will not be able to show or dismiss its SDK presentation on the second display.

zh-CN.description: Szeasco 硬件 SDK 通过绑定此服务在第二块显示屏上展示内容，应用可在该屏幕绘制、更新或关闭演示内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用将无法通过此 SDK 在第二块显示屏上显示或关闭内容。

en.description: The Szeasco hardware SDK runs this foreground service in a separate process for board monitoring. It can feed the hardware watchdog and handle monitor heartbeats and scheduled reboot requests.
en.disableEffect: The board will no longer receive watchdog feeds or monitor recovery actions from this service, and scheduled reboot requests will not be handled.

zh-CN.description: Szeasco 硬件 SDK 在独立进程中运行此前台服务以监控主板；它可定期喂硬件看门狗，并处理监控心跳和定时重启请求。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，主板将无法通过此服务获得看门狗喂狗和监控恢复处理，定时重启请求也不会执行。

en.description: Taboola SDK Plus schedules this service to fetch updated settings for its recommendation notifications and home-screen widget. It runs when the SDK's periodic refresh job is due.
en.disableEffect: Taboola SDK Plus will stop receiving these background settings updates.

zh-CN.description: Taboola SDK Plus 会定期安排此服务，为推荐通知和桌面小组件获取更新设置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Taboola SDK Plus 将不再在后台获取这些设置更新。

en.description: Android sends this Taboola SDK Plus widget a refresh broadcast when its home-screen widget needs updating. The widget shows Taboola recommendation cards and opens the selected story or the app when tapped.
en.disableEffect: The Taboola recommendation widget will stop updating, and its story links will no longer work.

zh-CN.description: 桌面小组件需要更新时，Android 会向此 Taboola SDK Plus 组件发送刷新广播。该小组件显示 Taboola 推荐内容，点按后可打开所选内容或应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Taboola 推荐小组件将停止更新，其中的内容链接也将无法打开。

en.description: When Android needs the list shown in a Taboola home-screen widget, this service supplies the recommendation rows.
en.disableEffect: The Taboola widget will not be able to display its list of recommendations.

zh-CN.description: Android 需要显示 Taboola 桌面小组件中的列表时，此服务会提供推荐内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Taboola 小组件将无法显示推荐列表。

en.description: Taboola SDK Plus runs this scheduled job to check whether its home-screen widget is due for refresh and request an update when needed.
en.disableEffect: Automatic refreshes of the Taboola home-screen widget will stop.

zh-CN.description: Taboola SDK Plus 会运行此定时任务，检查桌面小组件是否需要刷新，并在需要时请求更新。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Taboola 桌面小组件将不再自动刷新。

en.description: When Ocamba delivers a push event for Taboola SDK Plus, this receiver passes an incoming notification to Taboola's push handler.
en.disableEffect: Taboola SDK Plus push notifications will no longer be received and handled through Ocamba.

zh-CN.description: Ocamba 为 Taboola SDK Plus 送达推送事件时，此接收器会将收到的通知交给 Taboola 推送处理程序。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Taboola SDK Plus 将无法再通过 Ocamba 接收和处理推送通知。

en.description: This internal Taboola SDK Plus receiver handles push-notification actions: it records a dismissal or opens a breaking-news item when the user taps it.
en.disableEffect: Taboola breaking-news notification taps and dismissals will no longer be handled.

zh-CN.description: 此 Taboola SDK Plus 内部接收器负责处理推送通知操作：记录通知关闭事件，或在用户点按时打开突发新闻内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Taboola 突发新闻通知的点按和关闭操作将不再得到处理。

en.description: When a user navigates or taps a Taboola scheduled recommendation notification, this receiver handles its previous/next, dismissal, story, and attribution actions. It opens a tapped story after device unlock when needed.
en.disableEffect: Taboola scheduled notifications will lose their navigation, dismissal, and story-opening actions.

zh-CN.description: 用户浏览或点按 Taboola 定时推荐通知时，此接收器会处理上一条、下一条、关闭、内容打开和归因操作。设备需要解锁时，它会在解锁后打开所选内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Taboola 定时通知将无法再执行浏览、关闭和打开内容等操作。

en.description: Taboola SDK Plus runs this scheduled job to refresh recommendation-notification content when the configured notification feature is enabled.
en.disableEffect: Taboola scheduled notifications will no longer receive background content refreshes.

zh-CN.description: 启用通知功能后，Taboola SDK Plus 会运行此定时任务，刷新推荐通知的内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Taboola 定时通知将不再在后台刷新内容。

en.description: When a user taps a Taboola notification while the device is locked, this Activity waits for the device to unlock and then opens the saved story or attribution page.
en.disableEffect: Taboola's unlock-and-open flow for notification stories and attribution pages will stop.

zh-CN.description: 设备处于锁定状态时，用户点按 Taboola 通知，此界面会等待设备解锁，然后打开对应内容或归因页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Taboola 通知内容和归因页面的解锁后打开流程将停止。

en.description: After Android reports that the app was updated, this receiver asks Taboola SDK Plus to restore its configuration, notification, widget, and home-screen-news refresh jobs.
en.disableEffect: Taboola SDK Plus refresh jobs will no longer be rescheduled by this receiver after an app update.

zh-CN.description: Android 报告应用已更新后，此接收器会让 Taboola SDK Plus 恢复配置、通知、小组件和桌面新闻刷新任务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用更新后，此接收器将不再为 Taboola SDK Plus 重新安排刷新任务。

en.description: Android creates this private provider during app startup to prepare the Taboola SDK Plus services used by its recommendations, widgets, and notifications.
en.disableEffect: Taboola SDK Plus will no longer initialize its notification and widget services through this provider.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，Android 会创建此私有内容提供器，为 Taboola SDK Plus 的推荐内容、小组件和通知准备所需服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Taboola SDK Plus 将无法再通过此提供器初始化通知和小组件服务。

en.description: When an app opens the TagCommander Consent privacy center, this Activity displays the configured choices about data use and vendors so the user can review or change consent.
en.disableEffect: The app will not be able to open this TagCommander consent center for users to review or change their choices.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开 TagCommander Consent 隐私中心时，此界面会显示已配置的数据用途和服务商选项，供用户查看或更改同意设置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法打开此 TagCommander 同意中心，用户也无法通过它查看或更改选择。

en.description: When an app opens the TagCommander privacy center, this Activity displays the configured choices about data use and vendors so the user can review or change consent.
en.disableEffect: The app will not be able to open this TagCommander privacy center for users to review or change their choices.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开 TagCommander 隐私中心时，此界面会显示已配置的数据用途和服务商选项，供用户查看或更改同意设置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法打开此 TagCommander 隐私中心，用户也无法通过它查看或更改选择。

en.description: Talobin Card-Entry opens this form when the app requests card details. It validates the entered card and returns it to the app; expiry, security-code, and postal-code fields plus an optional scan button can be enabled as requested.
en.disableEffect: Card-payment or card-add flows that use this screen will no longer be able to collect card details.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求输入银行卡信息时，Talobin Card-Entry 会打开此表单。它会验证卡片信息并返回给应用；有效期、安全码、邮编字段和扫描按钮可按需启用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此界面的银行卡支付或绑卡流程将无法收集卡片信息。

en.description: Talobin Card-Entry opens this form when the app requests card details. It validates the entered card and returns it to the app; expiry, security-code, and postal-code fields plus an optional scan button can be enabled as requested.
en.disableEffect: Card-payment or card-add flows that use this screen will no longer be able to collect card details.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求输入银行卡信息时，Talobin Card-Entry 会打开此表单。它会验证卡片信息并返回给应用；有效期、安全码、邮编字段和扫描按钮可按需启用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此界面的银行卡支付或绑卡流程将无法收集卡片信息。

en.description: The Fragments Made Easy library uses this Activity to show an app-provided screen, either the default screen configured for it or one supplied when it is opened.
en.disableEffect: App screens that rely on this host Activity will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: Fragments Made Easy 库通过此界面显示应用提供的页面，可以是预先配置的默认页面，也可以是打开时指定的页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此宿主界面的应用页面将无法打开。

en.description: Umeng Push's Agoo/ACCS transport starts this Service to establish and maintain its push-delivery channel; on older Android versions it also starts a helper service for that channel.
en.disableEffect: Umeng Push messages that use the Agoo/ACCS channel will stop arriving; the app's other features continue to work.

zh-CN.description: 友盟+ 推送的 Agoo/ACCS 传输层会启动此 Service 建立并维持推送通道；在较旧的 Android 版本上，还会启动该通道所需的辅助服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，通过 Agoo/ACCS 通道发送的友盟推送将无法送达；应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: Umeng Push uses this short-lived helper on older Android versions to keep its background push connection running.
en.disableEffect: Umeng Push may not stay connected on older Android versions, so alerts can be delayed or missed.

zh-CN.description: 在较旧的 Android 版本上，友盟推送会用这个短时辅助服务维持后台推送连接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 在较旧的 Android 版本上，友盟推送可能无法保持连接，通知可能延迟或遗漏。

en.description: Umeng Push responds to device startup, network changes, app removal, and user-unlock broadcasts to restart or maintain its push channel.
en.disableEffect: The push channel may not restart or reconnect after these device events.

zh-CN.description: 友盟推送会响应设备启动、网络变化、应用卸载和用户解锁广播，以启动或维持推送通道。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 发生这些设备事件后，推送通道可能无法重新启动或连接。

en.description: Umeng Push uses this receiver for internal start and command broadcasts that activate its push connection.
en.disableEffect: Umeng Push start and command requests will not reach its connection service.

zh-CN.description: 友盟推送会通过此接收器处理内部启动和命令广播，以激活推送连接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 友盟推送的启动和命令请求将无法到达其连接服务。

en.description: When Umeng Agoo/ACCS delivers a message to the app, this Service routes it to Umeng Push's message handler and queues internal requests sent through the same channel.
en.disableEffect: Umeng Agoo/ACCS messages will no longer reach the app's push handler; the app's other features continue to work.

zh-CN.description: 友盟+ Agoo/ACCS 收到发往应用的推送消息后，此 Service 会把消息转交给友盟推送的处理流程，也会排队处理通道内部发出的请求。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，友盟 Agoo/ACCS 消息将无法交给应用的推送处理流程；应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: Umeng Push runs this scheduled service to ping its push channel when Android starts or stops a background job.
en.disableEffect: Scheduled connection checks will not run, which can make push reconnection less reliable.

zh-CN.description: Android 启动或停止后台任务时，友盟推送会运行此定时服务检查推送连接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 连接检查将不会运行，推送连接可能更难恢复。

en.description: Umeng Push forwards app-specific push commands and package-removal events to its connection service through this receiver.
en.disableEffect: Some Umeng push commands and related cleanup will not run.

zh-CN.description: 友盟推送会通过此接收器将应用专属的推送命令和应用移除事件交给连接服务处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 部分友盟推送命令和相关清理操作将无法执行。

en.description: Alibaba EasyMNN's MNNKit test screen opens in camera or image mode when the app starts a model demo. It shows the matching camera or photo analysis flow and returns to the app when closed.
en.disableEffect: The in-app MNNKit camera and image demo screens cannot be opened.

zh-CN.description: 阿里巴巴 EasyMNN 的 MNNKit 测试页会在应用启动摄像头或图片模式的模型演示时打开。页面展示对应的摄像头或图片分析流程，关闭后返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用无法打开 MNNKit 的摄像头和图片演示页。

en.description: Alibaba EasyMNN's MNNKit test screen opens in camera or image mode when the app starts a model demo. It shows the matching camera or photo analysis flow and returns to the app when closed.
en.disableEffect: The in-app MNNKit camera and image demo screens cannot be opened.

zh-CN.description: 阿里巴巴 EasyMNN 的 MNNKit 测试页会在应用启动摄像头或图片模式的模型演示时打开。页面展示对应的摄像头或图片分析流程，关闭后返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用无法打开 MNNKit 的摄像头和图片演示页。

en.description: Weex delivers global events to active Weex pages through a listener registered while each page runs; the declared manifest receiver has no broadcast action of its own.
en.disableEffect: Disabling the manifest entry does not stop the separately registered listeners, so active Weex pages continue to receive their global events.

zh-CN.description: Weex 页面运行期间会注册事件监听器，将全局事件交给当前页面；清单中声明的接收器本身没有广播动作过滤器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用清单中的声明不会影响另外注册的监听器，因此运行中的 Weex 页面仍可收到全局事件。

en.description: Tapjoy's ad SDK uses this Activity to show full-screen video and interactive ad placements. It also supports rewarded placements.
en.disableEffect: Tapjoy ads and rewarded placements will not open, and users will no longer receive rewards for watching rewarded ads.

zh-CN.description: Tapjoy 广告 SDK 使用此全屏页面展示视频和互动广告，也支持激励广告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Tapjoy 广告和激励广告将无法打开，用户观看激励广告后也不会再获得奖励。

en.description: Tapjoy uses this Activity to display full-screen SDK content requested by an ad placement.
en.disableEffect: Tapjoy placement content will not open, and users will no longer receive rewards for completing rewarded ads.

zh-CN.description: Tapjoy 使用此 Activity 展示广告位请求的全屏 SDK 内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Tapjoy 广告位内容将无法打开，用户完成激励广告后也不会再获得奖励。

en.description: The Tapjoy Android SDK opens an in-app full-screen browser for web pages or HTML supplied by Tapjoy ad content. The Tapjoy mediation adapter starts it when that content requests a full-screen web page.
en.disableEffect: Tapjoy ad pages that use this screen will not open, and rewards for watching ads shown through it will no longer be granted.

zh-CN.description: Tapjoy Android SDK 会在应用内用全屏网页显示 Tapjoy 广告内容提供的网页或 HTML。广告内容请求打开全屏网页时，Tapjoy 中介适配器会启动此页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要此页面的 Tapjoy 广告将无法打开，通过此页面观看广告所对应的奖励也将不再发放。

en.description: Tapjoy Ads opens this screen to play audio or video requested by an interactive ad.
en.disableEffect: Tapjoy interactive-ad audio and video will not play; the app’s other features continue to work.

zh-CN.description: Tapjoy Ads 会打开此页面播放互动广告请求的音频或视频。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Tapjoy 互动广告中的音频和视频将无法播放，应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: Tapjoy Ads opens this in-app browser to show a web page linked from an ad.
en.disableEffect: Tapjoy ad-linked web pages will not open in the app; the app’s other features continue to work.

zh-CN.description: Tapjoy Ads 会打开此应用内浏览器显示广告链接的网页。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Tapjoy 广告链接的网页将无法在应用内打开，应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: Tappr (Tapprai) screenshot feedback SDK opens this demo Activity from its audio test button, where a user can record a clip and play it back.
en.disableEffect: The demo's audio recording and playback screen will be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击 Tappr（Tapprai）截图反馈 SDK 演示中的录音按钮后，会打开此 Activity 来录制并回放音频。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 关闭后，演示中的录音和回放页面将无法使用。

en.description: The Tappr screenshot feedback SDK's demo launcher is the app's home screen; it starts screenshot monitoring and offers buttons for the feedback form and audio recording sample.
en.disableEffect: The app loses this launcher screen, so users cannot open the demo or its feedback form from the app icon.

zh-CN.description: Tappr 截图反馈 SDK 的演示启动页是应用的主页面；它会启动截图监控，并提供反馈表单和录音示例的入口。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 关闭后，应用将失去这个启动页面，用户无法通过应用图标打开演示或反馈表单。

en.description: When a user opens the Tappr feedback form, they can choose a problem type, write a report, attach up to four images, and submit it.
en.disableEffect: Users will no longer be able to submit in-app feedback through this form.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 Tappr 反馈表单后，可选择问题类型、填写说明、附加最多四张图片并提交反馈。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 关闭后，用户将无法通过此表单提交应用内反馈。

en.description: After the Tappr feedback form requests recent reports, this screen lists submitted feedback and any attached images.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to review their submitted feedback history in the app.

zh-CN.description: 用户从 Tappr 反馈表单打开历史记录后，此页面会显示已提交的反馈内容及其附图。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 关闭后，用户将无法在应用中查看已提交的反馈记录。

en.description: When a user taps images in Tappr feedback history, this viewer opens the attached photos for swiping and closer viewing.
en.disableEffect: Users will be unable to open and browse images attached to feedback history.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击 Tappr 反馈历史中的附图后，此查看器会打开图片，供用户滑动浏览和放大查看。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 关闭后，用户将无法打开并浏览反馈历史中的附图。

en.description: When Tappx opens an interactive web-based ad, this Activity displays it inside the app.
en.disableEffect: Tappx ad creatives that use this display will not open.

zh-CN.description: Tappx 打开互动式网页广告时，此界面会在应用内显示广告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此界面的 Tappx 广告将无法打开。

en.description: When an install-referrer intent is delivered, this service forwards it to Tappx's attribution handler so the SDK can process the install source.
en.disableEffect: Tappx will no longer process install-referrer information through this service.

zh-CN.description: 收到安装来源信息时，此服务会将其交给 Tappx 归因处理程序，以便 SDK 处理安装来源。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Tappx 将无法再通过此服务处理安装来源信息。

en.description: When the Tappx ad SDK requests a full-screen interstitial ad, this Activity displays it using the SDK's ad renderer.
en.disableEffect: Tappx interstitial ads that use this Activity will not open.

zh-CN.description: Tappx 广告 SDK 请求全屏插页广告时，此界面会使用 SDK 的广告渲染器显示广告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此界面的 Tappx 插页广告将无法打开。
