en.disableEffect: TapTap friends and team-invitation lists will not open in portrait mode.

zh-CN.description: TapTap 以竖屏打开好友或队伍邀请列表时，此页面会显示对应列表。
zh-CN.disableEffect: TapTap 竖屏好友和队伍邀请列表将无法打开。

en.description: TapTap's lightweight friends feature uses this full-screen dialog for team invitations and player profiles.
en.disableEffect: Team invitations and player profiles in TapTap's lightweight friends feature will not open.

zh-CN.description: TapTap 轻量好友功能使用此全屏窗口显示队伍邀请和玩家资料。
zh-CN.disableEffect: TapTap 轻量好友功能中的队伍邀请和玩家资料将无法打开。

en.description: When TapTap's lightweight friends feature opens its portrait invitation list, this screen displays the requested team members.
en.disableEffect: The lightweight TapTap team-invitation list will not open in portrait mode.

zh-CN.description: TapTap 轻量好友功能以竖屏打开邀请列表时，此页面会显示对应队伍成员。
zh-CN.disableEffect: TapTap 轻量好友功能的竖屏队伍邀请列表将无法打开。

en.description: At app startup, this component supplies the app context and logging setup for TapTap Themis Lite, which can return device-identification values when requested.
en.disableEffect: Themis Lite will miss this automatic setup, so features that request its device-identification data may stop working.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，此组件会为 TapTap Themis Lite 提供应用上下文并初始化日志；该服务可在请求时返回设备标识数据。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Themis Lite 将缺少此自动初始化，依赖其设备标识数据的功能可能无法使用。

en.description: When a TapTap Login request opens its authorization flow, this Activity displays the TapTap sign-in interface used to complete account authorization.
en.disableEffect: The TapTap authorization screen will no longer open, so TapTap sign-in cannot complete.

zh-CN.description: TapTap Login 启动授权流程时，此界面会显示 TapTap 登录页面，供用户完成账户授权。
zh-CN.disableEffect: TapTap 授权界面将无法打开，因此 TapTap 登录无法完成。

en.description: When TapTap’s update downloader is used, this component supplies the app context needed to create its download service.
en.disableEffect: TapTap update downloads may fail because the downloader cannot initialize its app context.

zh-CN.description: TapTap 更新下载功能启动时，此组件会提供创建下载服务所需的应用上下文。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 下载器将无法初始化应用上下文，TapTap 更新下载可能失败。

en.description: When a TapTap update has downloaded an APK, this provider gives Android's installer access to the file.
en.disableEffect: Android's installer will not receive the downloaded APK for TapTap updates.

zh-CN.description: TapTap 更新下载 APK 后，此 provider 会把文件交给 Android 安装器读取。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Android 安装器将无法读取 TapTap 更新下载的 APK。

en.description: Tarka Labs Eagle Scan opens a full-screen camera scanner when the app starts its barcode-scanning flow. It returns the scanned text to the screen that opened it, or returns a cancellation or error result.
en.disableEffect: The app's barcode-scanning flow will not open, so users cannot scan a code with this library.

zh-CN.description: Tarka Labs 的 Eagle Scan 会在应用启动条码扫描流程时打开全屏相机扫描页。它会把扫描到的文字返回给原页面，也会返回取消或出错结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用无法通过此库打开条码扫描流程，因此不能使用它扫描条码。

en.description: Tarka Labs Barcode Scanner opens a full-screen camera scanner when the app starts its scan flow. It returns the scanned text to the screen that opened it, or returns a cancellation or error result.
en.disableEffect: The app's barcode-scanning flow will not open, so users cannot scan a code with this library.

zh-CN.description: Tarka Labs Barcode Scanner 会在应用启动扫描流程时打开全屏相机扫描页。它会把扫描到的文字返回给原页面，也会返回取消或出错结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用无法通过此库打开条码扫描流程，因此不能使用它扫描条码。

en.description: Tasomaniac EmailAutoCompleteTextView opens this translucent screen when its email suggestions need permission to read device accounts. It shows Android's permission prompt and returns the user's choice to the email field.
en.disableEffect: The widget cannot request account access, so email suggestions that rely on device accounts may stop working.

zh-CN.description: Tasomaniac 的 EmailAutoCompleteTextView 在邮箱建议需要读取设备账户权限时打开此透明页面。它会显示 Android 权限提示，并把用户的选择返回给邮箱输入框。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 该输入框无法请求读取账户的权限，因此依赖设备账户的邮箱建议可能无法使用。

en.description: TaurusX Ads registers this file-sharing provider for files in its ad-download folder. Android can use it to give another app access to a downloaded file when the SDK hands that file off.
en.disableEffect: TaurusX file handoffs can fail, including ad-download actions that need another app to open a downloaded file.

zh-CN.description: TaurusX Ads 为广告下载目录注册了此文件共享入口。当 SDK 需要把下载文件交给其他应用时，Android 可通过它提供文件访问。
zh-CN.disableEffect: TaurusX 的文件交接可能失败，包括需要由其他应用打开下载文件的广告下载操作。

en.description: TaurusX opens this in-app browser when an ad sends the user to a web page. It loads the destination and provides back, forward, refresh, and close controls.
en.disableEffect: Web pages opened from TaurusX ads will not appear in this in-app browser.

zh-CN.description: TaurusX 会在广告打开网页时显示此应用内浏览页。页面会加载目标网址，并提供返回、前进、刷新和关闭控件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: TaurusX 广告打开的网页将无法在此应用内浏览页中显示。

en.description: TaurusX opens this full-screen player when an ad requests video playback outside the ad page. Playback starts with the video view and returns to the ad flow when the user exits or the video ends.
en.disableEffect: Videos requested by TaurusX ads will not open in this player.

zh-CN.description: TaurusX 会在广告要求脱离广告页面播放视频时打开此全屏播放器。视频视图开始播放，用户退出或视频结束后返回广告流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: TaurusX 广告请求播放的视频将无法在此播放器中打开。

en.description: TaurusX uses this full-screen page to present an app-open ad when the app displays that ad placement. It shows the ad creative and handles taps and closing the ad.
en.disableEffect: TaurusX app-open ads will not appear, while the app's other screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: TaurusX 在展示应用开屏广告位时使用此全屏页面。它显示广告内容，并处理用户点击或关闭广告的操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: TaurusX 应用开屏广告将不再显示，但应用的其他页面仍可使用。

en.description: TaurusX uses this full-screen page for a native app-open ad. It shows the ad image, app name, title, and call-to-action when that placement is opened.
en.disableEffect: TaurusX native app-open ads will not appear, while the app's other screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: TaurusX 使用此全屏页面展示原生应用开屏广告。广告位打开时，页面会显示广告图片、应用名称、标题和操作按钮。
zh-CN.disableEffect: TaurusX 原生应用开屏广告将不再显示，但应用的其他页面仍可使用。

en.description: TaurusX uses this page for full-screen or splash ad placements, loading web, video, native, or linked ad content inside the app and responding to ad interactions.
en.disableEffect: TaurusX full-screen web-based and splash ad placements will not open, while other app screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: TaurusX 使用此页面展示全屏或开屏广告位，在应用内加载网页、视频、原生或链接广告内容，并响应广告交互。
zh-CN.disableEffect: TaurusX 的全屏网页广告和开屏广告位将无法打开，但应用的其他页面仍可使用。

en.description: TaurusX opens this full-screen page to show a video ad placement. It plays the ad and handles the ad's on-screen interactions and closing the page.
en.disableEffect: TaurusX full-screen video ads will not play, while the app's other screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: TaurusX 使用此全屏页面展示视频广告位。页面会播放广告，并处理广告中的操作和关闭页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: TaurusX 的全屏视频广告将无法播放，但应用的其他页面仍可使用。

en.description: TaurusX opens this page for a multi-item video ad placement. It presents the placement's video and linked ad content and handles the user's ad interactions.
en.disableEffect: TaurusX multi-item video ads will not open, while the app's other screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: TaurusX 在展示包含多个内容项的视频广告位时打开此页面。页面显示广告视频及其关联内容，并处理用户的广告操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: TaurusX 的多内容视频广告将无法打开，但应用的其他页面仍可使用。

en.description: TaurusX shows a web page inside the app when an ad destination is opened. It loads the destination and handles links selected within the page.
en.disableEffect: Web pages opened from TaurusX ads will not appear in this in-app view, while other app screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: 打开 TaurusX 广告目标时，页面会在应用内显示网页。它会加载目标页面，并处理用户在页面中打开的链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: TaurusX 广告打开的网页将无法在此应用内显示，但应用的其他页面仍可使用。

en.description: TaurusX opens this browser for a web destination from an ad. It loads the page in an in-app browser with navigation and close controls.
en.disableEffect: Web destinations opened from TaurusX ads will not appear in this browser, while other app screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: TaurusX 会为广告中的网页目标打开此浏览器。它会在应用内加载页面，并提供导航和关闭控件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: TaurusX 广告中的网页目标将无法在此浏览器中显示，但应用的其他页面仍可使用。

en.description: MrTangBo TbLibrary uses this service when an app requests a floating panel. It places the supplied panel over the screen and lets it move and respond to taps.
en.disableEffect: The floating panel is unavailable, so app features that rely on it cannot be used.

zh-CN.description: MrTangBo TbLibrary 在应用请求显示悬浮面板时使用此服务。它会将应用提供的面板显示在屏幕上，并支持拖动和点击。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后悬浮面板将无法显示，依赖该面板的应用功能也无法使用。

en.description: MrTangBo TbLibrary opens this Activity when the app starts a barcode scan. It scans with the camera and can also decode a selected image, then returns the recognized text to the app.
en.disableEffect: The app can no longer scan QR codes or other barcodes through this library.

zh-CN.description: MrTangBo TbLibrary 在应用启动条码扫描时打开此 Activity。它使用相机扫描，也可以识别用户选取的图片，并将识别出的文字交还给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用无法再通过此库扫描二维码或其他条码。

en.description: The TCL VHall live SDK uses this file provider to let its pages and compatible apps open or share local files through temporary access links.
en.disableEffect: Opening or sharing local files through TCL VHall pages may fail if this provider is disabled.

zh-CN.description: TCL 版 VHall 直播 SDK 使用此文件 Provider，通过临时访问链接让其页面和兼容的应用打开或分享本地文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，TCL 版 VHall 页面可能无法通过此 Provider 打开或分享本地文件。

en.description: TCL’s VHall live SDK uses this shared Activity to prepare its other pages, including their layouts, status bars, loading indicators, and message pop-ups. It has no separate page of its own.
en.disableEffect: Users do not lose a standalone screen; TCL VHall pages have their own entry points.

zh-CN.description: TCL 版 VHall 直播 SDK 使用此共享 Activity 初始化其他页面，包括页面布局、状态栏、加载提示和消息提示。它本身没有独立页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后不会少一个独立页面；TCL 版 VHall 的其他页面有各自的入口。

en.description: TCL’s VHall live-event SDK opens this in-app browser for event pages and interactive content such as voting. It loads a page supplied by the SDK and responds to events from the live room.
en.disableEffect: Embedded TCL VHall event pages and voting screens that use this browser will not open if it is disabled.

zh-CN.description: TCL 版 VHall 直播活动 SDK 会用此应用内浏览器显示活动页面和投票等交互内容。它加载 SDK 提供的页面，并响应直播间发来的事件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，使用此浏览器的 TCL 版 VHall 活动页面和投票界面无法打开。

en.description: The TCL VHall chat service can open this Activity as a standalone chat entry, but the analyzed package gives it no screen content. The visible chat is supplied through a separate embedded chat panel.
en.disableEffect: The standalone chat entry cannot be opened if disabled; chat panels embedded in other screens use a separate route.

zh-CN.description: TCL 版 VHall 聊天服务可以通过此 Activity 打开独立聊天入口，但已分析的打包版本没有为它提供页面内容。可见的聊天界面由另一个嵌入式聊天面板提供。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，独立聊天入口无法打开；嵌入其他页面的聊天面板使用不同入口。

en.description: When TCL VHall live video is moved out of its room page, this service places the live player in a movable floating window. Tapping the window returns to the live room.
en.disableEffect: Live video will not continue in a floating window after leaving the room page; watching inside the room still works.

zh-CN.description: 当用户把 TCL 版 VHall 直播画面移出直播间页面时，此 Service 会将播放器放入可移动的悬浮窗。点击悬浮窗可返回直播间。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，离开直播间页面时直播不会继续显示在悬浮窗中；在直播间内观看仍可使用。

en.description: When TCL VHall on-demand video is moved out of its page, this service places the player in a movable floating window and keeps its playback position. Tapping the window returns to the video.
en.disableEffect: On-demand video will not continue in a floating window after leaving its page; watching in the video page still works.

zh-CN.description: 当用户把 TCL 版 VHall 点播视频移出播放页面时，此 Service 会将播放器放入可移动的悬浮窗并保留播放位置。点击悬浮窗可返回视频。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，离开播放页面时点播视频不会继续显示在悬浮窗中；在视频页面内观看仍可使用。

en.description: TCL VHall’s live-event host tools open this screen to review audience questions. Hosts can publish, send again, preview, copy, or remove questions from the event list.
en.disableEffect: Hosts cannot manage audience questions through this screen if it is disabled.

zh-CN.description: TCL 版 VHall 直播活动的主持人工具会通过此页面查看观众问题。主持人可以发布、重新推送、预览、复制或移除活动问题。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，主持人无法通过此页面管理观众问题。

en.description: TCL VHall’s live-event question bank lets a host search saved questions and add a chosen question to the event’s question list.
en.disableEffect: Hosts cannot search the saved question bank or add its questions to an event through this screen if it is disabled.

zh-CN.description: TCL 版 VHall 直播活动的问题库可供主持人搜索已保存的问题，并把选中的问题添加到活动问题列表。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，主持人无法通过此页面搜索问题库或向活动添加其中的问题。

en.description: During a TCL VHall live event, this screen shows the viewer’s question list and opens a selected question or answer page.
en.disableEffect: Viewers cannot browse and open their event questions through this screen if it is disabled.

zh-CN.description: 在 TCL 版 VHall 直播活动中，此页面显示观众的问题列表，并打开选中的问题或回答页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，观众无法通过此页面浏览并打开活动问题。

en.description: TCL VHall opens this page when a viewer selects the event host. It shows the host’s name and portrait with tabbed lists of the host’s live content.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open the host profile or browse that host’s content from this page if it is disabled.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择活动主播时，TCL 版 VHall 会打开此页面。页面显示主播姓名、头像，以及带标签页的直播内容列表。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过此页面打开主播资料或浏览该主播的内容。

en.description: TCL VHall uses this page for scheduled live events. It shows event and host details, a countdown, a reservation button, and a replay or room-entry option when available.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot reserve for or open an event from this preview page if it is disabled.

zh-CN.description: TCL 版 VHall 使用此页面展示预定直播活动。页面显示活动和主播信息、倒计时、预约按钮，以及可用时的回放或进入直播间选项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过此预告页面预约活动或进入活动。

en.description: TCL VHall opens this page to join and display a vertical live room. Leaving the page ends the room session unless picture-in-picture playback is active.
en.disableEffect: Viewers may lose access to the TCL VHall vertical live-room route if this page is disabled.

zh-CN.description: TCL 版 VHall 会通过此页面加入并显示竖屏直播间。离开页面时会结束直播间会话，除非正在使用画中画播放。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，观众可能无法通过 TCL 版 VHall 的此入口进入竖屏直播间。

en.description: TCL VHall opens its live portal or a supplied web page inside the app. A sign-in response from the page can start a live room.
en.disableEffect: The TCL live portal and any room-entry links that use this browser will not open if it is disabled.

zh-CN.description: TCL 版 VHall 会在应用内打开直播门户或传入的网页。网页的登录响应可以启动直播间。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，使用此浏览器的 TCL 直播门户和进入直播间的链接无法打开。

en.description: TapTap Common exposes the app's TapTap client settings and selected language to TapTap components that request them.
en.disableEffect: TapTap components will no longer be able to read these settings from this provider, which can prevent TapTap login and configured features from working.

zh-CN.description: TapTap Common 会向请求设置的 TapTap 组件提供应用的 TapTap 客户端配置和所选语言。
zh-CN.disableEffect: TapTap 组件将无法再通过此提供器读取这些设置，TapTap 登录及依赖配置的功能可能因此无法使用。

en.description: TDXTXT LiteAVPlayer, which uses Tencent LiteAV Player, handles headset and media-button presses during video playback to play, pause, or resume the video.
en.disableEffect: Headset and media-button presses will no longer control video playback.

zh-CN.description: TDXTXT LiteAVPlayer（使用腾讯 LiteAV Player）会在视频播放期间处理耳机和媒体按键，以播放、暂停或继续视频。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 关闭后，耳机和媒体按键将无法控制视频播放。

en.description: TDXTXT SocialGo's shared Activity handles data returned from social apps, passes it to the active platform, and closes after the flow; supported actions include sign-in, sharing, and payment.
en.disableEffect: SocialGo sign-in, sharing, and payment flows will no longer complete their return callbacks.

zh-CN.description: TDXTXT SocialGo 的共享 Activity 会处理社交应用返回的数据并交给当前平台；支持的流程包括登录、分享和支付。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 关闭后，SocialGo 的登录、分享和支付流程将无法完成返回回调。

en.description: TDXTXT SocialGo's WeChat Activity receives WeChat requests and responses and passes them to the shared social flow for login, sharing, or payment results.
en.disableEffect: WeChat login, sharing, and payment callbacks will no longer return to the app.

zh-CN.description: TDXTXT SocialGo 的微信 Activity 会接收微信请求和返回结果，并交给共享社交流程处理登录、分享或支付。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 关闭后，微信登录、分享和支付结果将无法返回应用。

en.description: The Monnify Android SDK opens this checkout screen with the transaction details and lets a customer choose a payment method such as card, bank transfer, direct debit, USSD, or phone payment.
en.disableEffect: Customers cannot complete the Monnify checkout flow.

zh-CN.description: Monnify Android SDK 会使用交易信息打开结账页面，让客户选择银行卡、银行转账、直接扣款、USSD 或电话支付等方式。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 客户将无法完成 Monnify 结账流程。

en.description: Telefónica App Logger uses this file-sharing provider when exporting log reports to another app. It exposes the report files through Android's file-sharing system.
en.disableEffect: App Logger's share and export actions can fail when another app requests the log file.

zh-CN.description: Telefónica App Logger 在向其他应用导出日志报告时使用此文件共享入口。它通过 Android 文件共享机制提供报告文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 其他应用请求日志文件时，App Logger 的分享和导出操作可能失败。

en.description: Telefónica App Logger opens this screen so users can read app logs, filter them by category, search, and share saved reports.
en.disableEffect: The in-app log viewer and its search, filtering, and sharing tools will be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: Telefónica App Logger 使用此页面供用户查看应用日志、按类别筛选、搜索并分享已保存的报告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用内日志查看器及其搜索、筛选和分享功能将无法使用。

en.description: Telefónica Mistica Catalog uses this as its entry screen for browsing design-system component sections. Choosing a section opens its component examples.
en.disableEffect: The Mistica component catalog's main section list and its examples will not open.

zh-CN.description: Telefónica Mistica Catalog 使用此页面作为设计系统组件目录的入口，列出可浏览的组件类别。选择类别后会打开对应示例。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Mistica 组件目录的类别列表和示例将无法打开。

en.description: Mistica Catalog opens this screen after a user selects a section. It displays examples of the reusable components in that section.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to open the selected section's component examples in the catalog.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Mistica Catalog 中选择类别后，会打开此页面查看该类别中的可复用组件示例。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在目录中打开所选类别的组件示例。

en.description: This Mistica Catalog screen displays an empty-state example with the supplied title, message, and button choices.
en.disableEffect: The catalog's empty-state example will not open.

zh-CN.description: 此 Mistica Catalog 页面展示空状态示例，并显示传入的标题、说明文字和按钮选项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 目录中的空状态示例将无法打开。

en.description: This Mistica Catalog screen displays a feedback-page example with its supplied message, reference details, and button choices.
en.disableEffect: The catalog's feedback-page example will not open.

zh-CN.description: 此 Mistica Catalog 页面展示反馈页示例，并显示传入的提示文字、参考信息和按钮选项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 目录中的反馈页示例将无法打开。

en.description: Telefónica Mistica Compose Catalog uses this as its main screen. It presents navigable design-system examples in a Compose interface and includes a brand-theme choice.
en.disableEffect: The Mistica Compose component catalog will not open.

zh-CN.description: Telefónica Mistica Compose Catalog 使用此页面作为目录首页，以 Compose 界面展示可浏览的设计系统示例，并提供品牌主题选择。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Mistica Compose 组件目录将无法打开。

en.description: Tempo Platform's ads SDK opens this Activity to show a full-screen interstitial campaign in a web view.
en.disableEffect: Tempo interstitial ads will not appear.

zh-CN.description: Tempo Platform 广告 SDK 会在此 Activity 中打开全屏插页广告网页。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 关闭后，Tempo 插页广告将不会显示。

en.description: Tempo Platform's ads SDK opens this Activity to show a full-screen rewarded campaign that grants an in-app reward after viewing.
en.disableEffect: Rewarded ads will not open, so users will no longer receive rewards for watching them.

zh-CN.description: Tempo Platform 广告 SDK 会在此 Activity 中打开全屏激励广告，用户观看后可获得应用内奖励。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 关闭后，激励广告无法打开，用户也无法通过观看广告获得奖励。

en.description: When a voice-control client connects to Tencent Yunxiaowei TVS, this service provides controls for video apps such as Tencent Video.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it stops TVS from controlling supported third-party video apps, including through voice commands.

zh-CN.description: 语音控制端连接腾讯云小微 TVS 时，这个服务会提供控制腾讯视频等第三方视频应用的能力。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，TVS 将无法控制受支持的第三方视频应用，包括通过语音命令进行控制。

en.description: When the Tencent Yunxiaowei DMSDK starts a QQ sign-in request, this activity completes the login handoff and returns the result to the SDK.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it breaks QQ sign-in for apps that use the Yunxiaowei SDK.

zh-CN.description: 腾讯云小微 DMSDK 发起 QQ 登录时，这个界面会完成登录跳转并把结果交还给 SDK。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，使用云小微 SDK 的应用将无法通过 QQ 登录。

en.description: When the app receives a playback-status broadcast from QQ Music Watch, this Tencent Yunxiaowei TVS receiver updates the current media state so voice control can track that player.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents TVS from tracking QQ Music Watch playback changes, so related voice-control features may stop working.

zh-CN.description: 应用收到 QQ 音乐手表的播放状态广播时，这个腾讯云小微 TVS 接收器会更新当前媒体状态，让语音控制能够跟踪该播放器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，TVS 将无法跟踪 QQ 音乐手表的播放状态变化，相关语音控制功能可能无法正常工作。

en.description: When Firebase Cloud Messaging issues a token or delivers a message, this Tencent TPNS service forwards it to TPNS and starts the push handling needed for that message.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it stops TPNS from receiving Firebase messages and registering the Firebase token.

zh-CN.description: Firebase Cloud Messaging 更新令牌或送达消息时，这个腾讯 TPNS 服务会将其转交给 TPNS，并启动相应的推送处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，TPNS 将无法接收 Firebase 消息或登记 Firebase 令牌。

en.description: This Tencent TPNS receiver handles Xiaomi Mi Push callbacks, forwarding received messages to TPNS and reporting Xiaomi registration results.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it stops TPNS from receiving Xiaomi-channel messages and registration updates.

zh-CN.description: 这个腾讯 TPNS 接收器处理小米推送回调，把收到的消息转交给 TPNS，并报告小米推送的注册结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，TPNS 将无法接收小米渠道的消息或注册状态更新。

en.description: This Tencent TPNS receiver handles Meizu Flyme Push callbacks, forwarding arriving messages and notification details to TPNS and reporting device registration results.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it stops TPNS from receiving Meizu-channel messages and registration updates.

zh-CN.description: 这个腾讯 TPNS 接收器处理魅族 Flyme 推送回调，把收到的消息和通知信息转交给 TPNS，并报告设备注册结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，TPNS 将无法接收魅族渠道的消息或注册状态更新。

en.description: When a Tencent TPNS notification is opened or a push link is followed, this activity routes the request to the app's selected page, web link, or app action and reports the click to TPNS.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents TPNS notification taps and push links from opening their requested destination.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 腾讯 TPNS 通知或推送链接时，这个界面会将请求转到应用指定的页面、网页或操作，并把点击结果报告给 TPNS。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，TPNS 通知和推送链接将无法打开指定的目标页面或操作。

en.description: When Tencent TPNS reads or saves its settings, this provider exposes typed values from the app's TPNS preference store to the SDK's components.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents TPNS from reading or saving settings through this provider, which can disrupt push registration and delivery.

zh-CN.description: 腾讯 TPNS 读取或保存设置时，这个提供器会向 SDK 组件提供应用内 TPNS 设置中的各类值。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，TPNS 将无法通过此提供器读取或保存设置，推送注册和接收可能因此受影响。

en.description: Tencent TPNS opens this Activity after a push-notification tap or supported TPNS link, then routes the requested action to an app screen, web page, or other Activity.
en.disableEffect: Tencent push taps and their deep links will no longer open the requested destination through TPNS.

zh-CN.description: 用户点按推送通知或受支持的 TPNS 链接后，腾讯 TPNS 会打开此 Activity，并按通知指定的操作跳转到应用页面、网页或其他 Activity。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，腾讯推送的点击操作及深层链接将无法通过 TPNS 打开目标页面。

en.description: When Android creates this Tencent TPNS provider, it supplies the app context and push settings and may initialize TPNS if the app has enabled automatic startup.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it removes a TPNS initialization path and can stop the SDK from registering for or handling push messages.

zh-CN.description: Android 创建这个腾讯 TPNS 提供器时，它会设置应用上下文和推送状态；如果应用启用了自动启动，也会由此初始化 TPNS。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，TPNS 会失去一条初始化途径，推送注册和消息处理可能无法正常进行。

en.description: Tencent TPNS handles internal push-message and keep-alive broadcasts in this Receiver, then wakes its background push service to process messages.
en.disableEffect: TPNS message delivery and keep-alive handling can stop, while the app's other features remain available.

zh-CN.description: 腾讯 TPNS 通过此 Receiver 处理内部推送消息和保活广播，并唤醒后台推送服务来处理消息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，TPNS 消息送达和保活处理可能停止，但应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: When Android creates this Tencent TPNS keep-alive provider, it asks TPNS to start its push service if the app has opted into the TPNS channel.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it removes this startup path for the TPNS push service, so push delivery or background recovery may stop working.

zh-CN.description: Android 创建这个腾讯 TPNS 保活提供器时，如果应用已启用 TPNS 渠道，它会请求启动 TPNS 推送服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，TPNS 推送服务将失去这条启动途径，消息接收或后台恢复可能无法正常工作。

en.description: When Honor Push updates a token or delivers a message, this Tencent TPNS service forwards the token or message into the app's TPNS push handling.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it stops TPNS from registering or receiving messages through Honor Push.

zh-CN.description: 荣耀推送令牌更新或消息到达时，这个腾讯 TPNS 服务会把令牌或消息交给应用中的 TPNS 推送处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，TPNS 将无法通过荣耀推送渠道登记令牌或接收消息。

en.description: When Tencent TPNS opens an in-app message, this activity reads its content and displays the supplied text, media, and action buttons inside the app.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents TPNS in-app messages and their action buttons from appearing.

zh-CN.description: 腾讯 TPNS 展示应用内消息时，这个界面会读取消息内容，并在应用中显示文字、媒体内容和操作按钮。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，TPNS 的应用内消息及其操作按钮将无法显示。

en.description: When the app's push process connects to this Tencent Xinge and TPNS service, it provides the connection used to reach the push service; a start request can also wake that service.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it can prevent the app's separate push process from reaching or waking Tencent's push service, so vendor push messages may stop.

zh-CN.description: 应用的推送进程连接这个腾讯信鸽和 TPNS 服务时，它会提供访问推送服务所需的连接；启动请求也可唤醒该服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用的独立推送进程可能无法连接或唤醒腾讯推送服务，厂商推送消息可能因此中断。

en.description: Tencent TPNS starts this Service in a separate app process to initialize and handle background push work.
en.disableEffect: TPNS background message delivery and maintenance will stop; regular app screens can still work.

zh-CN.description: 腾讯 TPNS 在应用的独立进程中启动此 Service，用于初始化和处理后台推送任务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，TPNS 后台消息送达和维护将停止；应用的常规页面仍可使用。

en.description: When Vivo Push delivers a message or updates its registration token, this Tencent TPNS receiver forwards the event to TPNS; it can also open links attached to tapped Vivo notifications.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it stops TPNS from receiving Vivo-channel messages and registration updates and from opening supported notification links.

zh-CN.description: vivo 推送送达消息或更新注册令牌时，这个腾讯 TPNS 接收器会把事件转交给 TPNS；用户点开带链接的 vivo 通知时，它也可以打开相应链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，TPNS 将无法接收 vivo 渠道的消息和注册更新，也无法打开受支持的通知链接。

en.description: Tencent Bugly Beta and the Tencent Cloud Tinker wrapper use this service after a Tinker patch finishes. It reports patch success or failure, removes the downloaded patch file, and may restart the app so a successful patch takes effect.
en.disableEffect: Patch completion callbacks and restart handling may stop, so an installed fix may not become active.

zh-CN.description: 腾讯 Bugly Beta 和腾讯云 Tinker 封装会在 Tinker 热修复完成后使用此服务。它会报告补丁成功或失败、清理已下载的补丁文件，并可能重启应用以启用成功的补丁。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 补丁完成回调和重启处理可能停止，已安装的修复可能无法生效。

en.description: Tencent Bugly Beta opens this Activity when an update strategy requests an active web alert. It displays the supplied web page inside the app.
en.disableEffect: Bugly active alert pages will no longer open; the rest of the app remains available.

zh-CN.description: 腾讯 Bugly Beta 会在更新策略要求显示主动网页提示时启动此 Activity，并在应用内展示指定网页。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Bugly 的主动提示页面将无法打开，应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: Tencent Bugly Beta opens this Activity for its in-app upgrade dialogs and related update prompts. Before opening it, Bugly re-enables the screen if it was turned off.
en.disableEffect: Bugly tries to turn this screen back on before showing an update prompt; if it remains disabled, the in-app upgrade dialog cannot open.

zh-CN.description: 腾讯 Bugly Beta 会用此 Activity 显示应用内升级对话框和相关更新提示。打开提示前，如果该页面已关闭，Bugly 会重新启用它。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Bugly 会尝试在显示更新提示前重新启用此页面；如果仍处于关闭状态，应用内升级对话框就无法打开。

en.description: Tencent Bugly Beta uses this provider to create a content link for a downloaded APK before asking Android to open the package installer.
en.disableEffect: Bugly may fail to pass a downloaded update to Android for installation.

zh-CN.description: 腾讯 Bugly Beta 使用此 Provider 为已下载的 APK 创建内容链接，然后请求 Android 打开系统安装程序。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Bugly 可能无法将下载的更新包交给 Android 安装。

en.description: The Tencent AI Face SDK example launcher runs its sample license check, then opens the SDK's face detection, comparison, enrollment, and search demos.
en.disableEffect: The built-in face demo menu will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: 腾讯 AI Face SDK 的示例入口会检查示例授权状态，并提供人脸检测、比对、注册和检索演示。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 内置的人脸示例菜单将无法打开。

en.description: This Tencent AI Face SDK example compares a face in a selected photo with faces seen by the live Android camera and displays the comparison result.
en.disableEffect: The SDK's photo-to-camera face comparison example will no longer run.

zh-CN.description: 此腾讯 AI Face SDK 示例会将所选照片中的人脸与 Android 相机实时拍到的人脸进行比对，并显示结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: SDK 的照片与相机人脸比对示例将无法运行。

en.description: This Tencent AI Face SDK example opens two camera feeds and tracks faces from the paired views on screen.
en.disableEffect: The dual-camera face example will no longer open or show its camera feeds.

zh-CN.description: 此腾讯 AI Face SDK 示例会同时打开两个摄像头画面，并在屏幕上追踪其中的人脸。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 双摄人脸示例将无法启动或显示摄像头画面。

en.description: This Tencent AI Face SDK example uses the Android camera to detect faces and draw tracking outlines over the preview.
en.disableEffect: The SDK's live face-detection example will no longer run.

zh-CN.description: 此腾讯 AI Face SDK 示例会使用 Android 相机检测人脸，并在预览画面上标出追踪到的人脸。
zh-CN.disableEffect: SDK 的实时人脸检测示例将无法运行。

en.description: This Tencent AI Face SDK example detects and checks a face from the Android camera, asks the user to confirm a name, and saves the face profile for later searches.
en.disableEffect: The camera-based face enrollment example will no longer run or save new face profiles.

zh-CN.description: 此腾讯 AI Face SDK 示例会通过 Android 相机检测和检查人脸，让用户确认姓名，并保存人脸资料供之后检索。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 基于相机的人脸注册示例将无法运行，也无法保存新的人脸资料。

en.description: This Tencent AI Face SDK example reads face photos from its registration folder, processes one usable face per photo, and saves the resulting profiles for later searches.
en.disableEffect: The file-based face enrollment example will no longer process or register photos.

zh-CN.description: 此腾讯 AI Face SDK 示例会读取注册目录中的人脸照片，处理每张照片中可用的一张人脸，并保存资料供之后检索。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 基于文件的人脸注册示例将无法处理或登记照片。

en.description: This Tencent AI Face SDK example replays saved color, infrared, and depth camera frames one at a time and runs the face-search pipeline on them.
en.disableEffect: The saved-frame face-search replay example will no longer run.

zh-CN.description: 此腾讯 AI Face SDK 示例会逐帧重放保存的彩色、红外和深度摄像头数据，并对这些画面运行人脸检索。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 基于已保存画面的人脸检索回放示例将无法运行。

en.description: This Tencent AI Face SDK example restores its saved face library, then searches it using faces seen by the live Android camera.
en.disableEffect: The SDK's live-camera face-search example will no longer run.

zh-CN.description: 此腾讯 AI Face SDK 示例会恢复已保存的人脸库，再使用 Android 相机实时拍到的人脸进行检索。
zh-CN.disableEffect: SDK 的相机实时人脸检索示例将无法运行。

en.description: This Tencent AI Face SDK example restores its saved face library and searches it using photos from its image-search folder.
en.disableEffect: The SDK's photo-based face-search example will no longer run.

zh-CN.description: 此腾讯 AI Face SDK 示例会恢复已保存的人脸库，并使用图片检索目录中的照片进行人脸搜索。
zh-CN.disableEffect: SDK 的照片人脸检索示例将无法运行。

en.description: This Tencent AI Face SDK example reads color, infrared, and depth streams from a supported IMI camera, checks the face, then searches the saved face library.
en.disableEffect: The SDK's IMI-camera face-search example will no longer run.

zh-CN.description: 此腾讯 AI Face SDK 示例会读取兼容 IMI 摄像头的彩色、红外和深度画面，检查人脸后搜索已保存的人脸库。
zh-CN.disableEffect: SDK 的 IMI 摄像头人脸检索示例将无法运行。

en.description: Tencent Matrix Backtrace starts this Service in a separate process when it prepares a native library for stack capture. It warms the library for later crash and call-stack analysis.
en.disableEffect: Matrix cannot prepare native libraries through this service, limiting native crash and call-stack diagnostics.

zh-CN.description: Tencent Matrix Backtrace 需要为原生调用栈采集准备库文件时，会在独立进程中启动此 Service，以支持后续的崩溃和调用栈分析。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Matrix 无法通过此服务准备原生库文件，相关崩溃和调用栈诊断能力会受限。

en.description: Tencent QQ OpenSDK opens this helper Activity during QQ sign-in, authorization, or sharing and returns the result to the calling app.
en.disableEffect: QQ sign-in, authorization, and sharing flows that use Tencent OpenSDK will fail.

zh-CN.description: 腾讯 QQ OpenSDK 在 QQ 登录、授权或分享时会打开此辅助页面，并将结果返回调用应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖腾讯 OpenSDK 的 QQ 登录、授权和分享流程将失败。

en.description: When a user opens a Tencent Klevin native ad's offer, this page shows the advertised app's details and provides its download route.
en.disableEffect: Native-ad detail and download pages will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开腾讯 Klevin 原生广告的推广内容时，此页面会显示应用详情并提供下载入口。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 原生广告详情页和下载入口将无法打开。

en.description: Tencent Klevin runs this receiver when Android reports that an ad-app download has finished. It checks the downloaded file, records completion, and continues the ad's install handoff.
en.disableEffect: Klevin ad downloads will not be handed off after completion, so their app-install prompt may not appear.

zh-CN.description: Android 报告广告应用下载完成时，Tencent Klevin 会运行此接收器。它检查下载文件、记录完成事件，并继续广告应用的安装交接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Klevin 广告下载完成后将无法继续交接，因此可能不会显示相应的应用安装提示。

en.description: Tencent Klevin uses this receiver for pause and resume actions from its ad-download notification. It dismisses the notification and pauses or restarts the related download.
en.disableEffect: The pause and resume actions in Klevin ad-download notifications will stop working.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Klevin 广告下载通知中选择暂停或继续时，会触发此接收器。它会收起通知，并暂停或恢复对应的下载。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Klevin 广告下载通知中的暂停和继续操作将无法使用。

en.description: Tencent Klevin shows this confirmation dialog when the user chooses whether to continue or cancel an ad-app download. It carries out the selected download action.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to continue or cancel Klevin ad-app downloads through this confirmation screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择继续或取消广告应用下载时，Tencent Klevin 会显示此确认对话框，并执行所选的下载操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此确认页面继续或取消 Klevin 广告应用下载。

en.description: During a Tencent Klevin ad flow, this dialog shows the advertised app's name, developer, version, and update date, with links to permission and privacy details.
en.disableEffect: The Klevin ad compliance dialog and its permission or privacy links will no longer be available.

zh-CN.description: 腾讯 Klevin 广告流程中，此对话框会显示推广应用的名称、开发者、版本和更新时间，并提供权限说明及隐私政策链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Klevin 广告合规对话框及其中的权限说明和隐私链接将无法使用。

en.description: Tencent Klevin uses this screen for full-screen interactive ads and their completion and reward events.
en.disableEffect: Rewards tied to Klevin interactive ads that use this screen will not be issued.

zh-CN.description: 腾讯 Klevin 使用此页面展示全屏互动广告并处理广告完成和奖励事件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此页面的 Klevin 互动广告将无法发放相关奖励。

en.description: Tencent Klevin displays a full-screen interstitial ad in this screen between app activities.
en.disableEffect: Klevin interstitial ads that use this screen will not open.

zh-CN.description: 腾讯 Klevin 使用此页面在应用页面之间展示全屏插页广告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此页面的 Klevin 插页广告将无法打开。

en.description: When a user opens a Tencent Klevin interstitial ad, this full-screen page displays its web content and handles ad links and downloads.
en.disableEffect: Klevin interstitial ad pages and their links or downloads will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开腾讯 Klevin 插屏广告时，此全屏页面会显示广告网页内容，并处理广告链接和下载。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Klevin 插屏广告页面及其中的链接或下载将无法打开。

en.description: When a user follows a Tencent Klevin ad, this page opens the ad's destination inside the app and handles its links and downloads.
en.disableEffect: Klevin ad destinations and their download links will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击腾讯 Klevin 广告后，此页面会在应用内打开广告目标页面，并处理其中的链接和下载。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Klevin 广告目标页及其中的下载链接将无法打开。

en.description: When a Klevin ad download has no Wi-Fi connection, this page shows a network warning and lets the user continue the APK download or close the page.
en.disableEffect: The user will not see this no-Wi-Fi warning or choose to continue the ad download from it.

zh-CN.description: Klevin 广告下载没有 Wi-Fi 网络时，此页面会显示网络提示，供用户选择继续下载 APK 或关闭页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将看不到此无 Wi-Fi 提示，也无法通过此页面选择继续下载广告推广应用。

en.description: Tencent Klevin uses this screen to play a rewarded video and report whether the viewer earned its reward.
en.disableEffect: Rewarded videos will not play, and users will not receive rewards for watching them.

zh-CN.description: 腾讯 Klevin 通过此页面播放激励视频，并报告用户是否达到奖励条件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 激励视频将无法播放，用户也不会因观看这些广告获得奖励。

en.description: Tencent Klevin uses this screen to display and manage a splash ad while the app starts.
en.disableEffect: Klevin splash ads will not display.

zh-CN.description: 腾讯 Klevin 在应用启动时使用此页面展示和管理开屏广告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Klevin 开屏广告将无法显示。

en.description: When a user opens a Tencent Klevin splash ad, this page loads its web destination and can start the advertised app's download.
en.disableEffect: Klevin splash-ad details and their download route will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开腾讯 Klevin 开屏广告时，此页面会加载广告目标网页，并可启动推广应用的下载。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Klevin 开屏广告详情页及其下载入口将无法打开。

en.description: When a user opens a Klevin ad-app download prompt, this page shows the app name and lets the user cancel or continue the download.
en.disableEffect: The Klevin cancel-or-continue download prompt will no longer appear.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 Klevin 广告推广应用的下载提示时，此页面会显示应用名称，并允许用户取消或继续下载。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Klevin 下载取消或继续提示将无法显示。

en.description: Before a Klevin ad's APK is downloaded, this page shows the advertised app's name, publisher, version, update date, and icon, links to permission and privacy details, and offers to start the download.
en.disableEffect: The Klevin download disclosure and consent screen will not appear, so this download flow cannot continue through it.

zh-CN.description: 下载 Klevin 广告推广应用的 APK 前，此页面会显示应用名称、发布者、版本、更新时间和图标，提供权限说明及隐私政策链接，并允许用户开始下载。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Klevin 下载说明和确认页面将无法显示，用户也无法通过此流程继续下载。

en.description: After a Klevin ad-app download, this page asks whether to abandon installation or install the downloaded app now.
en.disableEffect: The Klevin install prompt will no longer appear, so this screen cannot start or abandon installation.

zh-CN.description: Klevin 广告推广应用下载后，此页面会询问用户是放弃安装还是立即安装。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Klevin 安装提示将无法显示，用户也无法通过此页面开始或放弃安装。

en.description: When a Klevin ad APK download is paused without Wi-Fi, this page shows the download details and offers to continue over mobile data or close.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot use this screen to resume a Klevin ad APK download over mobile data.

zh-CN.description: Klevin 广告 APK 下载因没有 Wi-Fi 而暂停时，此页面会显示下载信息，并允许用户使用移动数据继续下载或关闭页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法通过此页面使用移动数据恢复 Klevin 广告 APK 下载。

en.description: Tencent Klevin uses this provider to give Android’s installer access to app packages downloaded from ads.
en.disableEffect: Installing an app package downloaded through Klevin may fail.

zh-CN.description: 腾讯快手联盟广告 SDK 使用此内容提供器，让 Android 安装程序读取广告下载的应用安装包。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过快手联盟广告下载的应用安装包可能无法安装。

en.description: When the Tencent Klevin ad self-test tool checks its setup, this provider returns the ad app ID, initialization state, privacy controls, and file-sharing setup status.
en.disableEffect: The Klevin self-test tool will lose these setup checks; regular ad screens do not use this provider for display.

zh-CN.description: 腾讯 Klevin 广告自测工具检查配置时，此内容提供器会返回广告应用 ID、初始化状态、隐私控制状态和文件共享配置状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Klevin 自测工具将无法检查这些配置；普通广告页面不依赖此提供器显示。

en.description: This Tencent Klevin ad self-test screen provides tabs for SDK checks and ad-format examples.
en.disableEffect: The Klevin self-test home screen and its test tabs will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: 此腾讯 Klevin 广告自测页面提供 SDK 检查和广告类型示例的选项卡。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Klevin 自测主页及其测试选项卡将无法打开。

en.description: This Klevin self-test page lets an integrator load and display a sample full-screen interstitial ad.
en.disableEffect: The self-test tool's interstitial-ad example will no longer run.

zh-CN.description: 此 Klevin 自测页面供集成者加载并展示全屏插屏广告示例。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 自测工具中的插屏广告示例将无法运行。

en.description: This Klevin self-test page loads sample native ads and places their text, images, and interaction areas in the test layout.
en.disableEffect: The self-test tool's native-ad example will no longer run.

zh-CN.description: 此 Klevin 自测页面会加载原生广告示例，并将广告文字、图片和交互区域放入测试布局。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 自测工具中的原生广告示例将无法运行。

en.description: This Klevin self-test page loads and displays a rewarded video ad and reports when its reward callback occurs.
en.disableEffect: Rewarded-ad testing will stop, and watching those test ads will no longer grant their configured rewards.

zh-CN.description: 此 Klevin 自测页面会加载并展示激励视频广告，并在收到奖励回调时记录结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 激励广告测试将停止，观看这些测试广告后也不会再发放相应奖励。

en.description: This Klevin self-test page loads splash ads and lets the integrator try full-screen, half-screen, and hidden-skip-button layouts.
en.disableEffect: The self-test tool's splash-ad loading examples will no longer run.

zh-CN.description: 此 Klevin 自测页面会加载开屏广告，供集成者测试全屏、半屏和隐藏跳过按钮等布局。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 自测工具中的开屏广告加载示例将无法运行。

en.description: This Klevin self-test page displays a loaded splash ad, with an optional skip button and countdown, in a full or half-screen layout.
en.disableEffect: The self-test tool's loaded splash ad will no longer display.

zh-CN.description: 此 Klevin 自测页面会以全屏或半屏布局展示已加载的开屏广告，并可显示跳过按钮和倒计时。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 自测工具中已加载的开屏广告将无法显示。

en.description: When Tencent IM opens its contact picker for a group call, this activity lets the user choose people and continue to an audio or video call.
en.disableEffect: Choosing contacts for IM group audio or video calls may stop working.

zh-CN.description: 腾讯 IM 为群组通话打开联系人选择页时，此 Activity 允许用户选择联系人并继续进行语音或视频通话。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 为 IM 群组语音或视频通话选择联系人可能无法使用。

en.description: When Tencent LiteAV audio features need Android runtime permissions, this screen requests the needed access and returns the user's response to the media SDK.
en.disableEffect: The SDK's permission request may fail, preventing microphone capture or other permission-gated audio features from starting.

zh-CN.description: 腾讯 LiteAV 音频功能需要 Android 运行时权限时，此页面会请求所需权限，并将用户的选择返回媒体 SDK。
zh-CN.disableEffect: SDK 的权限请求可能失败，导致麦克风采集或其他受权限保护的音频功能无法启动。

en.description: When a user starts or answers a Tencent IM audio call, this activity shows the call and its mute, speaker, and hang-up controls.
en.disableEffect: IM audio calls may fail to open or respond to call controls.

zh-CN.description: 用户发起或接听腾讯 IM 语音通话时，此 Activity 会显示通话界面以及静音、扬声器和挂断控件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: IM 语音通话可能无法打开或操作。

en.description: When a user starts or answers a Tencent IM video call, this activity requests camera and microphone access and shows the video-call controls.
en.disableEffect: IM video calls may fail to open or respond to call controls.

zh-CN.description: 用户发起或接听腾讯 IM 视频通话时，此 Activity 会请求摄像头和麦克风权限并显示视频通话控件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: IM 视频通话可能无法打开或操作。

en.description: When an app binds while requesting a location notification, the Tencent Location SDK uses this Service to keep the location session running in the foreground.
en.disableEffect: Location work that relies on Tencent’s background service may stop, interrupting ongoing location updates in the app.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求定位通知并绑定此服务时，腾讯定位 SDK 会让定位任务以前台服务的方式继续运行。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖腾讯后台服务的定位任务可能会停止，导致应用无法持续更新位置。

en.description: Tencent Matrix Backtrace starts this Service in a separate process when it prepares a native library for stack capture. It warms the library for later crash and call-stack analysis.
en.disableEffect: Matrix cannot prepare native libraries through this service, limiting native crash and call-stack diagnostics.

zh-CN.description: Tencent Matrix Backtrace 需要为原生调用栈采集准备库文件时，会在独立进程中启动此 Service，以支持后续的崩溃和调用栈分析。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Matrix 无法通过此服务准备原生库文件，相关崩溃和调用栈诊断能力会受限。

en.description: Tencent Matrix Battery Canary uses this Activity to show its recorded battery statistics, arranged by process and time.
en.disableEffect: Matrix's battery statistics report cannot be opened.

zh-CN.description: Tencent Matrix Battery Canary 使用此 Activity 按进程和时间展示已记录的电量统计。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Matrix 的电量统计报告无法打开。

en.description: When Tencent Matrix OpenGL leak monitoring connects to this Service, it locates graphics functions used to track textures and buffers for leak detection.
en.disableEffect: Matrix cannot locate those graphics functions through this service, limiting OpenGL resource-leak diagnostics.

zh-CN.description: Tencent Matrix 的 OpenGL 泄漏监控连接到此 Service 时，会定位用于跟踪纹理和缓冲区的图形函数，为资源泄漏检测做准备。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Matrix 无法通过此服务定位这些图形函数，OpenGL 资源泄漏诊断会受限。

en.description: Tencent Matrix Resource Canary queues this background Service after a heap-dump report is prepared, passing the report and affected screen name to the resource monitor.
en.disableEffect: Heap-dump reports will not reach Matrix's resource-monitor plugin.

zh-CN.description: Tencent Matrix Resource Canary 准备好堆内存转储报告后会排入此后台 Service，将报告和发生问题的界面名称交给资源监控模块。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，堆内存转储报告不会交给 Matrix 的资源监控模块。

en.description: When Tencent Matrix Resource Canary has a heap dump to analyze, this background Service shrinks the dump, packages its report, and queues the result for the monitor.
en.disableEffect: Heap-dump analysis and the resulting memory-leak reports will not be produced by this service.

zh-CN.description: Tencent Matrix Resource Canary 有堆内存转储文件需要分析时，会启动此后台 Service 压缩文件、打包报告，并将结果交给监控模块。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，此服务不会处理堆内存转储文件，也无法生成相应的内存问题报告。

en.description: This is Tencent TCR's shared screen foundation for cloud-hosted games, not a screen the app can open by itself. A concrete game screen supplied by the host app can use it to show the live game video, send player controls, reconnect, and manage updates.
en.disableEffect: Disabling this base declaration does not disable a separate game screen supplied by the app; this base component cannot be opened on its own.

zh-CN.description: 这是腾讯 TCR 云游戏 SDK 为云端游戏提供的基础页面，应用不能单独打开它。应用提供的具体游戏页面可借助它播放实时游戏画面，并处理操作、重连和更新。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用此基础声明不会停用应用另行提供的具体游戏页面；这个组件本身无法单独启动。

en.description: Tencent Mobile Analytics (MTA) uses this provider to access the app's saved analytics identity data.
en.disableEffect: MTA may lose access to its saved analytics identity data, but the app's features continue to work.

zh-CN.description: 腾讯移动分析（MTA）通过此 Provider 读取和更新应用保存的分析标识。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后 MTA 可能无法读取或更新已保存的分析标识，但应用功能仍可使用。

en.description: Tencent Midas, included with Tencent YSDK, opens this in-app payment page when a game starts a purchase or subscription and returns the result to the game.
en.disableEffect: The Tencent Midas checkout cannot open, so in-game purchases handled by it may fail.

zh-CN.description: 腾讯 YSDK 中的 Midas 支付组件会在游戏发起购买或订阅时打开此应用内支付页面，并将结果返回游戏。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 腾讯 Midas 收银页面将无法打开，因此通过它进行的游戏内购买可能失败。

en.description: Tencent Midas, included with Tencent YSDK, uses this Activity during in-game payments and when returning payment results to the game.
en.disableEffect: Purchases handled by Tencent Midas may fail or their results may not return to the game.

zh-CN.description: 腾讯 YSDK 中的 Midas 支付组件会在游戏内付款流程中使用此 Activity，并将付款结果返回游戏。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过腾讯 Midas 进行的购买可能失败，或付款结果无法返回游戏。

en.description: Tencent Midas opens this Activity when a QQ Wallet payment handoff returns to the game and passes the payment result to the payment service.
en.disableEffect: QQ Wallet payment results may not return correctly, so in-game purchases using QQ Wallet may fail.

zh-CN.description: QQ 钱包支付返回游戏时，腾讯 Midas 会打开此 Activity，并将支付结果交回支付服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: QQ 钱包支付结果可能无法正常返回，游戏内通过 QQ 钱包进行的购买可能无法完成。

en.description: Tencent Midas opens this Activity when a WeChat payment handoff returns to the game and passes the payment result to the payment service.
en.disableEffect: WeChat payment results may not return correctly, so in-game purchases using WeChat Pay may fail.

zh-CN.description: 微信支付返回游戏时，腾讯 Midas 会打开此 Activity，并将支付结果交回支付服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 微信支付结果可能无法正常返回，因此游戏内通过微信支付进行的购买可能失败。

en.description: Entry point for weixin:// links opened from other apps and web pages. Ads use it to jump straight into WeChat mini programs.
en.disableEffect: Ads can no longer jump into WeChat mini programs, but legitimate weixin:// links from other apps and web pages also stop working.

zh-CN.description: 其他应用和网页通过 weixin:// 链接打开微信的入口。广告会借此直接跳转到微信小程序。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 广告无法再直接跳转到微信小程序，但其他应用和网页中正常的 weixin:// 链接也会失效。

en.description: Tencent Cloud COS's AVIF image SDK starts this provider with the app so images in AVIF format can be loaded.
en.disableEffect: AVIF pictures used by the app may fail to display.

zh-CN.description: 腾讯云 COS 的 AVIF 图片 SDK 会在应用启动时运行此组件，以支持加载 AVIF 格式图片。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用中的 AVIF 图片可能无法显示。

en.description: Tencent Cloud COS's TPG image SDK starts this provider with the app so Tencent TPG images can be loaded.
en.disableEffect: TPG pictures used by the app may fail to display.

zh-CN.description: 腾讯云 COS 的 TPG 图片 SDK 会在应用启动时运行此组件，以支持加载腾讯 TPG 图片。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用中的 TPG 图片可能无法显示。

en.description: Tencent Cloud IM's TIMPush entry initializes push support at app startup, registers its push service, and keeps push registration in step with chat login and logout events.
en.disableEffect: Tencent TIMPush registration and its chat-login push updates will stop.

zh-CN.description: 腾讯云 IM 的 TIMPush 入口会在应用启动时初始化推送、注册推送服务，并根据聊天账号的登录和退出状态更新推送注册。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，腾讯 TIMPush 注册及其随聊天账号登录状态进行的推送更新将停止。

en.description: When a user opens a Tencent Cloud IM push link, this activity passes the link to TIMPush so the app can route the tap to its requested screen.
en.disableEffect: Tapping these push links will no longer take the user to the intended screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开腾讯云 IM 推送链接时，此界面会将链接交给 TIMPush，由应用跳转到对应页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，点击这类推送链接将无法跳转到预期页面。

en.description: Tencent Cloud IM (TIM) initializes its offline-push service when the app starts and watches sign-in and sign-out to register or remove the device's push token. It also routes push-notification taps back to the app.
en.disableEffect: Tencent Cloud IM offline-message notifications and push-notification tap handling stop.

zh-CN.description: 腾讯云 IM（TIM）的离线推送服务会在应用启动时初始化，并监听登录与退出，以注册或注销设备推送令牌。它也会把推送通知点击交回应用处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 腾讯云 IM 的离线消息通知和推送通知点击处理会停止。

en.description: Firebase Cloud Messaging launches this Tencent Cloud IM activity for push-link or click intents; it passes them to TIMPush to route the notification tap.
en.disableEffect: Firebase push links and taps will no longer be routed through Tencent TIMPush.

zh-CN.description: Firebase 云消息传递会在推送链接或点击事件到达时启动腾讯云 IM 的此界面；它将事件交给 TIMPush 处理并跳转到对应页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Firebase 推送链接和点击事件将无法通过腾讯 TIMPush 进行跳转处理。

en.description: Tencent Cloud IM's TIMPush SDK runs this background service for rich notifications; it downloads a large image or uses a local image, then updates the notification.
en.disableEffect: Rich push notifications will no longer show images downloaded by TIMPush.

zh-CN.description: 腾讯云 IM 的 TIMPush SDK 会在处理带图片的通知时运行此后台服务；它下载大图或读取本地图片，然后更新通知内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，TIMPush 丰富通知将无法显示由其下载的图片。

en.description: Tencent Cloud IM (TIM)'s push SDK opens this screen when the app requests a runtime permission or notification-listener access; it explains the request, opens Android's permission or settings screen, and returns the result.
en.disableEffect: If the app starts this permission flow while the screen is disabled, the screen cannot open and notification access or the requested permission setup fails.

zh-CN.description: 腾讯云 IM（TIM）的推送 SDK 在应用申请运行时权限或通知监听权限时启动此界面；界面会说明请求、打开 Android 权限或设置页面并返回结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 如果应用在此界面被关闭时发起权限流程，界面无法打开，通知访问或相应权限设置会失败。

en.description: Tencent Cloud IM's TIMPush SDK opens this screen on Android 13 and later to request notification permission and record the user's choice.
en.disableEffect: TIMPush will no longer request notification permission through its built-in screen, so push may stay disabled until permission is granted another way.

zh-CN.description: 腾讯云 IM 的 TIMPush SDK 会在 Android 13 及更高版本中打开此界面，请求通知权限并记录用户的选择。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，TIMPush 将无法通过内置界面请求通知权限；如果用户没有通过其他方式授权，推送可能无法显示。

en.description: When a user starts a group live room in Tencent IM, this activity opens the host view, requests camera and microphone access, and sends room-status updates to the group.
en.disableEffect: Users may be unable to host Tencent IM group live rooms.

zh-CN.description: 用户在腾讯 IM 中开启群直播时，此 Activity 会打开主播界面、请求摄像头和麦克风权限，并向群内发送房间状态更新。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户可能无法在群内开启直播。

en.description: When a user opens a Tencent IM group live room, this activity loads the audience view for that room.
en.disableEffect: Users may be unable to watch Tencent IM group live rooms.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开腾讯 IM 群直播时，此 Activity 会加载该房间的观众界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户可能无法观看群直播。

en.description: When Tencent TUIKit needs text input or one choice from a list, this activity displays the selection page and returns the user's choice.
en.disableEffect: TUIKit settings or actions that use this selection page may not complete.

zh-CN.description: 腾讯 TUIKit 需要用户输入文本或从列表中选择一项时，此 Activity 会显示选择页面并返回用户的选择。
zh-CN.disableEffect: TUIKit 中依赖此选择页的设置或操作可能无法完成。

en.description: When a user taps an image in a Tencent IM chat, this activity opens the image for viewing and can load its original version.
en.disableEffect: Chat images may fail to open or load at full size.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击腾讯 IM 聊天中的图片时，此 Activity 会打开图片供查看，也可加载原图。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 聊天图片可能无法打开查看或加载原图。

en.description: When a user captures a photo or video for a Tencent IM chat, this activity opens the camera and returns the captured media to the chat.
en.disableEffect: Capturing photos or videos in chat may stop working.

zh-CN.description: 用户为腾讯 IM 聊天拍照或录制视频时，此 Activity 会打开相机并将拍摄内容返回聊天。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 在聊天中拍摄照片或视频可能无法使用。

en.description: When a user taps a video attachment in a Tencent IM chat, this activity plays the video.
en.disableEffect: Videos attached to chats may fail to play.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击腾讯 IM 聊天中的视频附件时，此 Activity 会播放视频。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 聊天中的视频附件可能无法播放。

en.description: When a group manager opens Tencent IM group join requests, this activity displays applications for review.

en.description: Android runs this Tencent Cloud TRTC TUICallKit Provider when the app starts. It registers the call and voice-message recording services and watches screen changes so an active call window can be restored.

zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，通话服务无法通过此处注册，正在进行的通话界面也无法由此恢复。

en.description: Android runs this Tencent Cloud TRTC TUICallKit Provider when the app starts. It registers the call and voice-message recording services and signals the kit to restore a floating call view when a call is already active.

zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，通话服务无法通过此处注册，已有通话也无法由此恢复为悬浮界面。

en.description: Tencent Cloud IM's provider registers the Honor push channel and starts Honor Push Kit when TIMPush receives a registration request.
en.disableEffect: The app will no longer register or receive push through the Honor channel in TIMPush.

zh-CN.description: 腾讯云 IM 的此提供程序会注册 Honor 推送通道，并在 TIMPush 收到注册请求时启动 Honor 推送套件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用将无法通过 TIMPush 注册或接收 Honor 通道的推送。

en.description: Tencent Cloud IM (TIM)'s Huawei messaging adapter receives Huawei push events. It reports new or failed Huawei tokens to Tencent Cloud IM and records message and delivery status.
en.disableEffect: Tencent Cloud IM stops receiving Huawei token updates through this service, so Huawei offline-push registration stops refreshing.

zh-CN.description: 这是腾讯云 IM（TIM）的华为消息推送适配器，会接收华为推送事件，把新令牌或令牌错误交给腾讯云 IM，并记录消息及送达状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 腾讯云 IM 无法再通过此服务接收华为令牌更新，华为离线推送注册也会停止刷新。

en.description: Tencent Cloud IM (TIM)'s Huawei push provider starts with the app and registers its connector. When registration is requested, it enables Huawei push and returns the registration result.
en.disableEffect: Huawei push registration stops, and a later token callback from the still-enabled Huawei messaging service can fail because this provider is missing.

zh-CN.description: 腾讯云 IM（TIM）的华为推送提供方会在应用启动时注册连接器。收到注册请求后，它会启用华为推送并返回注册结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 华为推送注册会停止；如果仍启用的华为消息服务之后回传令牌，回调可能因该提供方缺失而失败。

en.description: Huawei Push Kit starts this Tencent Cloud IM service for message and token events; it reports new tokens and token errors to TIMPush and records message callbacks.
en.disableEffect: TIMPush will stop receiving Huawei token updates and message callbacks.

zh-CN.description: 华为推送服务会在消息或令牌事件到达时启动腾讯云 IM 的此服务；它将新令牌和令牌错误交给 TIMPush，并记录消息回调。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，TIMPush 将无法收到华为令牌更新和消息回调。

en.description: Tencent Cloud IM's provider registers the Huawei push channel and initializes its adapter when TIMPush requests channel setup or registration.
en.disableEffect: The app will no longer initialize or register Huawei push through TIMPush.

zh-CN.description: 腾讯云 IM 的此提供程序会注册华为推送通道，并在 TIMPush 请求设置或注册通道时初始化适配器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用将无法通过 TIMPush 初始化或注册华为推送。

en.description: Tencent Cloud IM (TIM)'s Meizu adapter receives Meizu registration, message, and status callbacks. It sends Meizu registration IDs to Tencent Cloud IM; its message callbacks are only recorded here.
en.disableEffect: Tencent Cloud IM stops receiving Meizu registration updates through this receiver, so Meizu offline-push registration stops refreshing.

zh-CN.description: 这是腾讯云 IM（TIM）的魅族推送适配器，会接收魅族注册、消息和状态回调，并把魅族注册 ID 交给腾讯云 IM；此处只记录消息回调。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 腾讯云 IM 无法再通过此接收器接收魅族注册更新，魅族离线推送注册也会停止刷新。

en.description: Tencent Cloud IM (TIM)'s Meizu push provider starts with the app and registers its connector. When requested, it registers the app with Meizu Push using the configured credentials.
en.disableEffect: Meizu push registration stops, and a later registration-status callback from the still-enabled Meizu receiver can fail because this provider is missing.

zh-CN.description: 腾讯云 IM（TIM）的魅族推送提供方会在应用启动时注册连接器。收到请求后，它会使用已配置的凭据向魅族推送服务注册应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 魅族推送注册会停止；如果仍启用的魅族接收器之后返回注册状态，回调可能因该提供方缺失而失败。

en.description: Meizu Push Kit calls this receiver for registration, message, and notification events; it passes registration tokens to TIMPush and records message and notification callbacks.
en.disableEffect: The TIMPush Meizu channel will stop reporting registration results and handling its message callbacks.

zh-CN.description: 魅族推送套件会在注册、消息和通知事件发生时调用此接收器；它将注册令牌交给 TIMPush，并记录消息和通知回调。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，TIMPush 的魅族通道将无法报告注册结果或处理消息回调。

en.description: Tencent Cloud IM's provider registers the Meizu push channel and uses the app's Meizu credentials to start registration when TIMPush requests it.
en.disableEffect: The app will no longer register for Meizu push through TIMPush.

zh-CN.description: 腾讯云 IM 的此提供程序会注册魅族推送通道，并在 TIMPush 发起请求时使用应用的魅族凭据进行注册。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用将无法通过 TIMPush 注册魅族推送。

en.description: Tencent Cloud IM (TIM)'s OPPO push provider starts with the app and registers its connector. When requested, it initializes Heytap push, checks device support, registers the app's credentials, and requests notification permission.
en.disableEffect: OPPO offline push for Tencent Cloud IM no longer registers through this provider.

zh-CN.description: 腾讯云 IM（TIM）的 OPPO 推送提供方会在应用启动时注册连接器。收到请求后，它会初始化欢太推送、检查设备支持情况、注册应用凭据并请求通知权限。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 腾讯云 IM 将无法再通过此提供方向 OPPO 注册离线推送。

en.description: Oppo Push SDK starts this service on older Android versions for data-message deliveries; it passes each message through Oppo's compatibility handler.
en.disableEffect: Oppo data messages delivered through the older Android path will no longer be handled by the app.

zh-CN.description: Oppo 推送 SDK 会在较旧的 Android 版本中启动此服务处理数据消息，并将消息交给 Oppo 的兼容处理流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用将无法处理通过旧版 Android 通道送达的 Oppo 数据消息。

en.description: Oppo (HeyTap) Push SDK starts this service on Android 10 and later for data-message deliveries; it passes each message through the current Oppo handler.
en.disableEffect: Oppo data messages delivered through the current Android path will no longer be handled by the app.

zh-CN.description: Oppo（欢太）推送 SDK 会在 Android 10 及更高版本中启动此服务处理数据消息，并将消息交给当前的 Oppo 处理流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用将无法处理通过当前 Android 通道送达的 Oppo 数据消息。

en.description: Tencent Cloud IM's provider registers the Oppo push channel; when TIMPush requests registration, it starts Oppo push with the app's credentials and schedules a retry if needed.
en.disableEffect: The app will no longer register or receive push through the Oppo channel in TIMPush.

zh-CN.description: 腾讯云 IM 的此提供程序会注册 Oppo 推送通道；TIMPush 请求注册时，它使用应用凭据启动 Oppo 推送，并在需要时安排重试。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用将无法通过 TIMPush 注册或接收 Oppo 通道的推送。

en.description: Vivo Push SDK calls this receiver when a notification is tapped or a registration ID arrives; it saves tap details for TIMPush to route to the app's destination.
en.disableEffect: Vivo notification tap details will no longer reach TIMPush for routing.

zh-CN.description: vivo 推送 SDK 会在用户点击通知或收到注册 ID 时调用此接收器；它会保存点击信息，供 TIMPush 跳转到应用中的目标页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，vivo 通知的点击信息将无法交给 TIMPush 进行页面跳转。

en.description: Tencent Cloud IM's provider registers the Vivo push channel and starts registration when TIMPush requests it, returning the registration result to the app.
en.disableEffect: The app will no longer register for Vivo push through TIMPush.

zh-CN.description: 腾讯云 IM 的此提供程序会注册 vivo 推送通道，并在 TIMPush 发起请求时进行注册，再将结果返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用将无法通过 TIMPush 注册 vivo 推送。

en.description: Tencent Cloud IM (TIM)'s Vivo push provider starts with the app and registers its connector. When requested, it initializes Vivo push, turns it on, and returns the device registration ID.
en.disableEffect: Vivo offline push for Tencent Cloud IM is not initialized or registered through this provider.

zh-CN.description: 腾讯云 IM（TIM）的 vivo 推送提供方会在应用启动时注册连接器。收到请求后，它会初始化并启用 vivo 推送，再返回设备注册 ID。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 腾讯云 IM 将无法通过此提供方初始化或注册 vivo 离线推送。

en.description: Tencent Cloud IM (TIM)'s Vivo adapter receives callbacks when a Vivo push notification is clicked or a registration ID arrives; its code records those events without forwarding message content.
en.disableEffect: This adapter no longer receives Vivo click or registration callbacks; its code does not change notification content.

zh-CN.description: 这是腾讯云 IM（TIM）的 vivo 推送适配器，会接收 vivo 通知点击和注册 ID 回调；代码只记录这些事件，不转发消息内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 此适配器将不再收到 vivo 点击或注册回调；其代码不会改变通知内容。

en.description: Xiaomi Mi Push calls this receiver for message, notification-click, and registration events; it sends registration results to TIMPush and passes notification-click data to its push handler.
en.disableEffect: Xiaomi push registration and notification-click routing through TIMPush will stop.

zh-CN.description: 小米推送会在消息、通知点击和注册事件发生时调用此接收器；它将注册结果交给 TIMPush，并把通知点击数据交给推送处理流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用将无法通过 TIMPush 完成小米推送注册或处理通知点击跳转。

en.description: Tencent Cloud IM's provider registers the Xiaomi Mi Push channel, handles region selection, and starts registration with the app's Xiaomi credentials.
en.disableEffect: The app will no longer register or receive Xiaomi push through TIMPush.

zh-CN.description: 腾讯云 IM 的此提供程序会注册小米推送通道、处理地区选择，并使用应用的小米凭据启动注册。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用将无法通过 TIMPush 注册或接收小米推送。

en.description: Tencent Cloud IM (TIM)'s Xiaomi push provider starts with the app and registers its connector. When requested, it registers the app's configured credentials with Xiaomi's push service.
en.disableEffect: Xiaomi push registration stops, and a later registration result from the still-enabled Xiaomi receiver can fail because this provider is missing.

zh-CN.description: 腾讯云 IM（TIM）的小米推送提供方会在应用启动时注册连接器。收到请求后，它会使用已配置的凭据向小米推送服务注册应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 小米推送注册会停止；如果仍启用的小米接收器之后返回注册结果，回调可能因该提供方缺失而失败。

en.description: Tencent Cloud IM (TIM)'s Xiaomi adapter receives Xiaomi message and registration broadcasts. It returns registration results to Tencent Cloud IM and records notification-arrival, notification-click, and pass-through callbacks.
en.disableEffect: Tencent Cloud IM stops receiving Xiaomi registration results through this receiver, so Xiaomi offline-push registration stops refreshing.

zh-CN.description: 这是腾讯云 IM（TIM）的小米推送适配器，会接收小米消息和注册广播，将注册结果交给腾讯云 IM，并记录通知送达、点击及透传消息回调。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 腾讯云 IM 无法再通过此接收器接收小米注册结果，小米离线推送注册也会停止刷新。

en.description: Tencent Tinker and Tencent Cloud Micro Tinker use this service to handle completed hot-fix patches. On success it removes temporary patch files and restarts the app when a new patch version needs to take effect.
en.disableEffect: A completed patch may not be finalized or activated, leaving an app fix unavailable.

zh-CN.description: 腾讯 Tinker 和腾讯云 Micro Tinker 使用此服务处理热修复补丁结果。补丁成功时，它会清理临时文件；如果新版本需要启用，还会重启应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 已完成的补丁可能无法完成收尾或启用，应用修复可能无法生效。

en.description: While Tencent Tinker applies a hot fix in the background, it binds this Service to keep the update work running after the app's screen closes.
en.disableEffect: Tinker cannot bind this helper, so a hot fix may stop when the app moves to the background; normal app screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: 腾讯 Tinker 在后台应用热补丁时会绑定此 Service，使应用页面关闭后更新任务仍可继续。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后 Tinker 无法绑定此辅助服务，应用转到后台时热补丁可能中断；应用的普通页面仍可使用。

en.description: Tencent Tinker and Tencent Cloud Micro Tinker start this service in the patch process when the app receives a hot-fix package. It applies the patch and sends the result to the configured result handler.
en.disableEffect: Hot-fix packages will not be applied, so fixes or changes delivered through the app’s patch system will not take effect.

zh-CN.description: 腾讯 Tinker 和腾讯云 Micro Tinker 会在应用收到热修复包时，在补丁进程中启动此服务。它负责应用补丁，并把结果交给配置的结果处理服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 热修复包将无法应用，通过补丁提供的修复或改动也不会生效。

en.description: Tencent Tinker and Tencent Cloud Micro Tinker briefly start this helper alongside patch work to give the patch process foreground priority, then it stops itself.
en.disableEffect: The patch process loses this temporary priority helper; patch application still continues, but may be less protected from process shutdown.

zh-CN.description: 腾讯 Tinker 和腾讯云 Micro Tinker 会在补丁任务期间短暂启动此辅助服务，为补丁进程提供前台优先级，然后服务会自行停止。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 补丁进程会失去这项临时优先级辅助；补丁仍会继续应用，但受到进程终止的保护会减弱。

en.description: Tencent Tinker and Tencent Cloud Micro Tinker use this Activity when opening a screen added by a hot-fix patch. This slot matches the patched screen’s launch behavior.
en.disableEffect: If a hot-fix adds a screen that uses this Activity, that screen may fail to launch.

zh-CN.description: 腾讯 Tinker 和腾讯云 Micro Tinker 会在打开热修复补丁新增的页面时使用此 Activity。此槽位适配该页面的启动方式。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 如果热修复补丁新增的页面使用此 Activity，该页面可能无法启动。

en.description: Tencent Tinker and Tencent Cloud Micro Tinker use this Activity when opening a screen added by a hot-fix patch. This transparent variant supports a patched screen that needs to show the app behind it.
en.disableEffect: If a hot-fix adds a screen that uses this Activity, that screen may fail to launch.

zh-CN.description: 腾讯 Tinker 和腾讯云 Micro Tinker 会在打开热修复补丁新增的页面时使用此 Activity。这个透明样式可让页面透出后方的应用内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 如果热修复补丁新增的页面使用此 Activity，该页面可能无法启动。
