en.description: Tencent TMAssistant starts this background service for download tasks; it manages APK downloads and reports their progress and state.
en.disableEffect: Downloads or updates handled by Tencent TMAssistant will stop, while the game's normal features continue.

zh-CN.description: 腾讯应用宝下载组件会在收到下载任务时启动此后台 Service，管理 APK 下载并报告进度和状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过腾讯应用宝处理的下载或更新将停止，但游戏的常规功能仍可使用。

en.description: When Tencent TPNS components share settings or short-lived values across app processes, this provider reads and writes those values through the app's TPNS settings store.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents TPNS components from sharing these settings and values through the provider, which can disrupt push processing.

zh-CN.description: 腾讯 TPNS 组件需要在应用进程间共享设置或临时值时，会通过这个提供器读写应用中的 TPNS 设置数据。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，TPNS 组件将无法通过此提供器共享这些设置和值，推送处理可能受到影响。

en.description: When Tencent TPNS needs its MQTT push channel, it starts this service to initialize the channel that carries push traffic.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents the TPNS MQTT channel from starting, so messages delivered through that channel may not arrive.

zh-CN.description: 腾讯 TPNS 需要使用 MQTT 推送通道时，会启动这个服务来初始化承载推送消息的连接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，TPNS 的 MQTT 通道将无法启动，通过该通道发送的消息可能无法送达。

en.description: The YJJk Video Doctor SDK uses Tencent TRTC to open a call screen, start the local camera and microphone, and join the supplied room to show other participants. Users can switch cameras and mute video or audio.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot open this screen to join or continue its video calls.

zh-CN.description: YJJk Video Doctor SDK 通过腾讯 TRTC 打开通话页面，启动本机摄像头和麦克风，并加入指定房间显示其他参与者。用户可以切换摄像头或关闭视频、声音。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用无法打开此页面加入或继续视频通话。

en.description: The YJJk Video Doctor SDK shows a form for entering a user name and room number, then opens its Tencent TRTC call screen when both values are present.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot enter a call through this room-entry screen.

zh-CN.description: YJJk Video Doctor SDK 会显示用户名和房间号输入页面；两项都有内容后，它会打开腾讯 TRTC 通话页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法通过此页面进入视频通话。

en.description: At app startup, Tencent TYIC stores the app context and initializes its classroom SDK, including app details and web support.
en.disableEffect: TYIC classroom setup may fail.

zh-CN.description: 腾讯 TYIC 会在应用启动时保存应用上下文并初始化课堂 SDK，包括应用信息和网页支持。
zh-CN.disableEffect: TYIC 课堂功能可能无法完成初始化。

en.description: When a user enters a Tencent TYIC class, this activity handles class links or app-provided class details, requests classroom permissions, and opens the class.
en.disableEffect: Users may be unable to join TYIC classes or use the microphone and camera in class.

zh-CN.description: 用户进入腾讯 TYIC 课堂时，此 Activity 会处理课堂链接或应用传入的课堂信息、请求课堂权限并打开课堂。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户可能无法加入 TYIC 课堂或在课堂中使用麦克风和摄像头。

en.description: Tencent YSDK opens this Activity when a free-login handoff returns login information; it saves that information and reports success or failure to the caller.
en.disableEffect: Tencent YSDK's free-login handoff will fail, so players may be unable to sign in through that path.

zh-CN.description: 腾讯 YSDK 的免登录流程返回登录信息时会打开此 Activity；它保存登录信息，并向调用方报告成功或失败。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 腾讯 YSDK 的免登录流程将无法完成，玩家可能无法通过该方式登录。

en.description: Tencent YSDK opens this screen when a player chooses WeChat QR-code sign-in; it starts the QR authentication flow and lets the player cancel it.
en.disableEffect: WeChat QR-code sign-in through Tencent YSDK will be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: 玩家选择微信扫码登录时，腾讯 YSDK 会打开此页面并开始扫码认证，也允许玩家取消登录。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 腾讯 YSDK 的微信扫码登录将无法使用。

en.description: When Tendarts enables it and connectivity changes to online, this Receiver starts sending queued SDK communications.
en.disableEffect: Tendarts push and queued messages may not resume automatically when the connection returns.

zh-CN.description: Tendarts 启用此 Receiver 后，设备网络恢复时它会启动待发送的 SDK 通信任务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，网络恢复时 Tendarts 推送和排队消息可能无法自动继续发送。

en.description: When Tendarts schedules queued work, this Service sends pending SDK communications and schedules another attempt if the app task is removed.
en.disableEffect: Tendarts messages and reporting events may remain queued or stop sending.

zh-CN.description: Tendarts 安排待处理任务时，此 Service 会发送排队中的 SDK 通信；应用任务被移除时，它还会安排再次尝试。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Tendarts 消息和报告事件可能一直滞留或停止发送。

en.description: On Tendarts clear, open-push, or open-list broadcasts, this Receiver clears the stored notification list, opens the selected notification or link, or opens the notification list.
en.disableEffect: Tendarts notification actions and links will stop working, though the app can still open normally.

zh-CN.description: 收到 Tendarts 清除通知、打开推送或打开列表的广播时，此 Receiver 会清除已存通知、打开所选通知或链接，或显示通知列表。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Tendarts 通知操作和链接将无法使用，但应用仍可正常打开。

en.description: When Google Play reports that the push token changed, this 10Darts Android SDK Service starts registering the new token.
en.disableEffect: Tendarts may stop receiving push notifications after the token changes.

zh-CN.description: Google Play 通知推送令牌已更换时，10Darts Android SDK 的此 Service 会启动新令牌注册。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，令牌更换后 Tendarts 可能无法继续接收推送通知。

en.description: When Google Cloud Messaging delivers a push, this 10Darts Android SDK Service processes it, reports receipt, and builds the notification shown to the user.
en.disableEffect: Tendarts push notifications may no longer be received or displayed.

zh-CN.description: Google Cloud Messaging 投递推送时，10Darts Android SDK 的此 Service 会处理消息、上报接收情况并生成要显示的通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Tendarts 推送通知可能无法接收或显示。

en.description: When Tendarts sets up push or refreshes a token, this Service obtains the device token, sends it to Tendarts, and subscribes the device to the SDK push topic.
en.disableEffect: Tendarts push registration and future push delivery may fail.

zh-CN.description: Tendarts 设置推送或刷新令牌时，此 Service 会获取设备令牌、将其发送给 Tendarts，并订阅 SDK 推送主题。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Tendarts 推送注册和后续消息投递可能失败。

en.description: After a user follows a Tendarts push link into the app, this Service measures how long the app stays open and reports that session to Tendarts.
en.disableEffect: Tendarts will no longer receive session-duration reports after push links; normal app screens still work.

zh-CN.description: 用户通过 Tendarts 推送链接进入应用后，此 Service 会统计应用保持打开的时长并将会话报告给 Tendarts。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Tendarts 将无法收到推送链接打开后的会话时长报告，应用普通页面仍可使用。

en.description: When the app binds to this TenKiv TekDAQC service, it accepts board connection, command, and task requests and relays board responses to the app.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents the app from communicating with TekDAQC boards or running commands and tasks on them.

zh-CN.description: 应用连接这个 TenKiv TekDAQC 服务时，服务会接收与采集板连接、发送命令和执行任务的请求，并把设备响应传回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用将无法与 TekDAQC 采集板通信，也无法在设备上执行命令和任务。

en.description: When the app's locator manager starts board discovery, this TenKiv service searches for TekDAQC boards and reports when boards appear, respond, or disappear.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it stops automatic board discovery and updates about which TekDAQC boards are available.

zh-CN.description: 应用的定位管理器开始搜索采集板时，这个 TenKiv 服务会查找 TekDAQC 设备，并报告设备出现、响应或离线的状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用将无法自动发现 TekDAQC 设备或更新设备是否可用的信息。

en.description: When TenKiv starts a connection for a board, this service opens an Ethernet session and runs the board commands requested by the app.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents the app from connecting to a TekDAQC board or sending it commands.

zh-CN.description: TenKiv 为采集板启动连接时，这个服务会建立以太网会话并执行应用发来的设备命令。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用将无法连接 TekDAQC 采集板或向其发送命令。

en.description: When TenKiv broadcasts a board-discovery update, this receiver updates the discovered-board list and notifies the app that a board was found, updated, or lost.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents the app from receiving TekDAQC board discovery and availability updates.

zh-CN.description: TenKiv 广播采集板发现状态时，这个接收器会更新设备列表，并通知应用设备已发现、状态已更新或已离线。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用将无法收到 TekDAQC 设备发现和可用状态更新。

en.description: When TenKiv's locator manager starts or binds this service, it searches for TekDAQC boards at the requested interval and reports discovery changes to the app.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it stops this version of the app's TekDAQC board search and discovery updates.

zh-CN.description: TenKiv 的定位管理器启动或绑定这个服务时，服务会按指定间隔搜索 TekDAQC 采集板，并向应用报告发现状态变化。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，此版本应用的 TekDAQC 设备搜索和发现状态更新将停止。

en.description: When the app reads or stores TekDAQC measurements, this provider accesses the local database of analog-input readings and calibration data.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it can make measurement history and calibration records unavailable to the app.

zh-CN.description: 应用读取或保存 TekDAQC 测量数据时，这个提供器会访问本地数据库中的模拟输入读数和校准数据。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用可能无法读取测量历史记录或校准数据。

en.description: When the app requests a board connection, command, or task, this older TenKiv service opens an Ethernet session, runs the request, and reports connection changes.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it stops the app from communicating with TekDAQC boards through this service.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求连接采集板、发送命令或执行任务时，这个较早版本的 TenKiv 服务会建立以太网会话、处理请求并报告连接状态变化。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用将无法通过此服务与 TekDAQC 采集板通信。

en.description: When the app requests a TekDAQC board search, this older TenKiv service searches the network and broadcasts each discovered board to the app.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents the app from automatically finding TekDAQC boards through this discovery service.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求搜索 TekDAQC 采集板时，这个较早版本的 TenKiv 服务会搜索网络，并把发现的设备广播给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用将无法通过此发现服务自动查找 TekDAQC 采集板。

en.description: When the TenKiv locator broadcasts a board update, this receiver turns it into app notifications for newly found, updated, or removed TekDAQC boards.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents the app from receiving board discovery and availability changes from the TenKiv locator.

zh-CN.description: TenKiv 定位器广播采集板状态时，这个接收器会将信息转成应用通知，报告新发现、状态更新或移除的 TekDAQC 设备。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用将无法收到 TenKiv 定位器发来的设备发现和可用状态变化。

en.description: The TENQUBE Visual IBK SDK opens its finance page when the host app starts this screen. It displays the IBK transaction and receipt experience inside the app.
en.disableEffect: The app will no longer be able to open the TENQUBE IBK finance and receipt screen.

zh-CN.description: TENQUBE Visual IBK SDK 在宿主应用启动此界面时打开金融服务页面，并在应用内展示 IBK 交易和电子收据功能。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法再打开 TENQUBE IBK 金融服务和电子收据页面。

en.description: The TENQUBE Visual IBK receipt SDK opens this screen for app requests or incoming receipt links and displays the linked receipt page.
en.disableEffect: Receipt links and the SDK receipt screen will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: TENQUBE Visual IBK 收据 SDK 会在应用发起请求或收到收据链接时打开此界面，并展示链接对应的收据页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 收据链接和 SDK 的收据页面将无法打开。

en.description: The TENQUBE Visual IBK receipt SDK opens this screen for receipt links and its notification-access flow. It displays the requested page and reports whether notification access is enabled when the user returns from settings.
en.disableEffect: Receipt links and the SDK notification-access flow will stop working.

zh-CN.description: TENQUBE Visual IBK 收据 SDK 会通过此界面打开收据链接或通知访问设置流程。它展示相应页面，并在用户从系统设置返回时告知 SDK 通知访问是否已开启。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 收据链接和 SDK 的通知访问设置流程将无法使用。

en.description: The TENQUBE Visual IBK receipt SDK opens this screen from a receipt link or an in-app request, then displays the associated receipt page.
en.disableEffect: Receipt links and the SDK receipt view will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: TENQUBE Visual IBK 收据 SDK 会在收到收据链接或应用内请求时打开此界面，并展示对应的收据页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 收据链接和 SDK 的收据页面将无法打开。

en.description: TENQUBE Visual’s JB module opens its bank-specific finance page when the host app starts this screen. The page is displayed inside the app.
en.disableEffect: The app will no longer be able to open its JB-specific Visual finance page.

zh-CN.description: 宿主应用启动此界面时，TENQUBE Visual 的 JB 模块会在应用内打开面向 JB 的金融服务页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法再打开 JB 专用的 Visual 金融服务页面。

en.description: TENQUBE Visual listens for new Android notifications after notification access is granted. It filters out ongoing or progress notifications and sends supported message text for transaction parsing.
en.disableEffect: Transactions announced in notifications will no longer be collected for TENQUBE Visual views.

zh-CN.description: 获得通知访问权限后，TENQUBE Visual 会监听新通知，过滤正在进行或显示进度的通知，并将可识别的通知内容交给交易解析功能。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通知中提示的交易将不再收集到 TENQUBE Visual 页面中。

en.description: TENQUBE Visual receives Android’s incoming-SMS broadcast, combines the parts of a message, and sends its text to the transaction parser.
en.disableEffect: Transactions from supported bank or card SMS alerts will stop being collected, so transaction history may be incomplete.

zh-CN.description: TENQUBE Visual 会接收 Android 的新短信广播，合并分段短信，并将短信内容交给交易解析功能。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 支持的银行或银行卡短信中的交易将不再收集，交易记录可能不完整。

en.description: TENQUBE Visual starts this background service after an SMS or supported notification arrives. It passes the message through the SDK transaction parsers.
en.disableEffect: Messages queued by TENQUBE Visual will no longer be processed into transaction data.

zh-CN.description: 收到短信或可识别的通知后，TENQUBE Visual 会在后台启动此服务，并将消息交给 SDK 的交易解析功能处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: TENQUBE Visual 收到的待处理消息将无法转换为交易数据。

en.description: TENQUBE Visual runs this receiver when a scheduled Visual notification fires. It checks whether the saved notification is active, displays it when due, and refreshes the schedule.
en.disableEffect: TENQUBE Visual’s scheduled reminder notifications will stop appearing.

zh-CN.description: TENQUBE Visual 的定时通知触发时会运行此接收器。它检查已保存的通知是否仍然有效，在到期时显示通知，并更新后续安排。
zh-CN.disableEffect: TENQUBE Visual 的定时提醒将不再显示。

en.description: The TENQUBE Visual finance SDK opens this screen when the host app requests its main finance experience. It displays the requested Visual page and synchronizes transaction data for that screen.
en.disableEffect: TENQUBE Visual’s finance pages and transaction views will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: 宿主应用请求打开 TENQUBE Visual 金融服务时，会启动此界面。它展示所请求的 Visual 页面，并为页面同步交易数据。
zh-CN.disableEffect: TENQUBE Visual 的金融服务页面和交易记录页面将无法打开。

en.description: TENQUBE Visual opens this guide after launching Android’s notification-access settings. The guide shows the host app’s name and an animated example of the setting.
en.disableEffect: Only the guide disappears; Android’s notification-access settings can still be opened.

zh-CN.description: TENQUBE Visual 打开 Android 通知访问设置后会显示此指引页面。页面展示宿主应用名称，并用动画说明相关设置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 仅此指引页面会消失；Android 通知访问设置仍可打开。

en.description: TENQUBE Visual opens this prompt when its mobile-receipt feature needs permission to appear over other apps. The button takes the user to Android’s overlay-permission settings.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to complete TENQUBE Visual’s in-app permission flow for mobile-receipt overlays.

zh-CN.description: TENQUBE Visual 的手机电子收据功能需要显示在其他应用上方时，会打开此权限提示。点击按钮会进入 Android 的悬浮窗权限设置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 TENQUBE Visual 的应用内流程开启手机电子收据所需的悬浮窗权限。

en.description: TENQUBE Visual runs this receiver when a scheduled IBK notification fires. It verifies that the saved reminder is active, displays it when due, and refreshes the schedule.
en.disableEffect: TENQUBE Visual’s scheduled IBK reminder notifications will stop appearing.

zh-CN.description: TENQUBE Visual 的 IBK 定时通知触发时会运行此接收器。它确认已保存的提醒仍然有效，在到期时显示提醒，并更新后续安排。
zh-CN.disableEffect: TENQUBE Visual 的 IBK 定时提醒将不再显示。

en.description: The TENQUBE Visual LG Pay guide shows the host app’s name and icon with an animated example of notification access. Its Next button closes the guide; it does not itself grant permission.
en.disableEffect: Only this guidance screen disappears; notification access can still be managed in Android settings.

zh-CN.description: TENQUBE Visual LG Pay 指引页面会展示宿主应用名称和图标，并用动画说明通知访问设置。点击“下一步”会关闭页面；页面本身不会授予权限。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 仅此指引页面会消失；仍可在 Android 设置中管理通知访问权限。

en.description: TENQUBE Visual opens this popup after a parsed transaction when popup display is enabled. It shows purchase details and monthly spending information, and can also display an ad.
en.disableEffect: Purchase-detail and spending-summary popups from TENQUBE Visual will no longer appear.

zh-CN.description: 启用弹窗显示后，TENQUBE Visual 会在解析到交易时打开此弹窗。弹窗展示购买详情和本月支出信息，也可能显示广告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: TENQUBE Visual 的购买详情和支出汇总弹窗将不再显示。

en.description: TENQUBE Visual opens this prompt when mobile receipts need permission to appear over other apps. Its button opens Android’s overlay-permission settings and returns the result to the SDK.
en.disableEffect: The SDK’s mobile-receipt overlay permission flow will be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: 手机电子收据需要显示在其他应用上方时，TENQUBE Visual 会打开此提示。点击按钮会进入 Android 悬浮窗权限设置，并将结果返回给 SDK。
zh-CN.disableEffect: SDK 的手机电子收据悬浮窗授权流程将无法使用。

en.description: TENQUBE Visual opens this screen when the host app requests its finance experience. It loads the Visual pages, synchronizes transaction data, and provides related actions such as exporting records.
en.disableEffect: TENQUBE Visual’s finance pages, transaction views, and in-app actions will no longer be available.

zh-CN.description: 宿主应用请求打开 TENQUBE Visual 金融服务时，会启动此界面。它加载 Visual 页面、同步交易数据，并提供导出记录等相关操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: TENQUBE Visual 的金融服务页面、交易记录和应用内操作将无法使用。

en.description: TENQUBE Visual Base starts this background service with an SMS or a message extracted from a notification, then passes it to the SDK parser.
en.disableEffect: Messages received by the older Visual Base integration will no longer be processed by its parser.

zh-CN.description: TENQUBE Visual Base 会在后台启动此服务来处理短信或从通知中提取的消息，再将消息交给 SDK 解析。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 较旧的 Visual Base 集成收到的消息将无法再由其解析功能处理。

en.description: TENQUBE Visual Base starts this background service after its receiver accepts an SMS or supported RCS message. The service passes that message to the SDK parser.
en.disableEffect: SMS and RCS messages accepted by Visual Base will no longer be parsed into transaction data.

zh-CN.description: Visual Base 接收短信或支持的 RCS 消息后，会在后台启动此服务，并将消息交给 SDK 解析。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Visual Base 接收的短信和 RCS 消息将无法解析为交易数据。

en.description: When enabled and granted notification access, TENQUBE Visual Base receives posted notifications and sends supported message content to its parser. This artifact declares the listener disabled by default.
en.disableEffect: If enabled, notification-based transaction messages will no longer reach the Visual Base parser.

zh-CN.description: 启用并获得通知访问权限后，TENQUBE Visual Base 会接收新通知，并将可识别的内容交给解析功能；此版本默认将该监听服务设为禁用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 如果启用了此服务，通知中的交易消息将无法再传给 Visual Base 解析。

en.description: TENQUBE Visual Base receives Android SMS and supported RCS message broadcasts. When message parsing is enabled, it extracts the message and passes it to the SDK parser.
en.disableEffect: SMS and RCS transaction messages will no longer be collected by Visual Base.

zh-CN.description: TENQUBE Visual Base 会接收 Android 短信和支持的 RCS 消息广播。启用消息解析后，它会提取消息并交给 SDK 解析。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Visual Base 将不再收集短信和 RCS 中的交易消息。

en.description: TENQUBE Visual IBK listens for posted notifications, ignores notifications from the default SMS app, and sends the remaining content to its receipt and transaction parsers.
en.disableEffect: Notification-based IBK receipt and transaction data will no longer be collected.

zh-CN.description: TENQUBE Visual IBK 会监听新通知，忽略默认短信应用发出的通知，并将其他通知内容交给收据和交易解析功能处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通知中的 IBK 收据和交易数据将不再收集。

en.description: Tesera Andbtiles supplies map data when an app requests it. It reads saved offline maps and can fetch missing map images from the configured server.
en.disableEffect: Map screens that use Andbtiles will no longer be able to retrieve their tile images or metadata.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求地图数据时，Tesera Andbtiles 会提供相应内容。它读取已保存的离线地图，也可以从配置的服务器获取缺失的地图图像。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用 Andbtiles 的地图页面将无法获取瓦片图像或地图信息。

en.description: Tesera Andbtiles starts this background service when the app requests a map-file download. It saves the file, adds it to the local map list, and shows download progress and results.
en.disableEffect: Map-file downloads through Andbtiles will fail, so new offline maps cannot be added.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求下载地图文件时，Tesera Andbtiles 会在后台启动此服务。它保存文件、将其加入本地地图列表，并显示下载进度和结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过 Andbtiles 下载地图文件将会失败，无法添加新的离线地图。

en.description: Tesera Andbtiles starts this service to download map images for a selected area and zoom levels so they are available offline. It shows progress and saves the finished map data.
en.disableEffect: Tile prefetching and the resulting offline map data will no longer be available.

zh-CN.description: Tesera Andbtiles 会启动此服务，下载指定区域和缩放级别的地图图像，以便离线使用。它显示进度并保存下载完成的地图数据。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 地图瓦片预下载及其生成的离线地图数据将无法使用。

en.description: FastFramework (Jerry Liu's FastAndroid library) listens for Android connectivity changes and checks whether a network is available. It tells the app's network listener when connectivity appears or disappears.
en.disableEffect: Features that respond to connection changes may stop updating their online or offline state.

zh-CN.description: FastFramework（Jerry Liu 的 FastAndroid 库）监听 Android 网络连接变化，并检查网络是否可用。连接出现或中断时，它会通知应用的网络监听器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖网络变化通知的功能可能无法及时更新在线或离线状态。

en.description: FastFramework (Jerry Liu's FastAndroid library) declares this account-related Provider when the app starts. In this release its queries return no data and its insert, update and delete requests make no changes.
en.disableEffect: Blocking it removes an empty Provider; this release exposes no account data or updates through it.

zh-CN.description: FastFramework（Jerry Liu 的 FastAndroid 库）会在应用启动时声明此账户相关 Provider。此版本的查询不返回数据，新增、修改和删除请求也不会产生变化。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 屏蔽后将移除此空 Provider；此版本不会通过它提供账户数据或更新。

en.description: Worldline Paynimo's test library opens this Activity when the app asks to show its checkout test screen. It displays the library's checkout interface.
en.disableEffect: The Paynimo checkout test screen will not open.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求打开结账测试页面时，Worldline Paynimo 测试库会启动此 Activity 并显示结账界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Paynimo 结账测试页面将无法打开。

en.description: When the device finishes starting, the schedule-release library opens its ad screen and schedules recurring ad launches.
en.disableEffect: The library’s ads will no longer start automatically after the device restarts or be launched by its recurring schedule.

zh-CN.description: 设备完成启动后，schedule-release 库会打开广告页面并安排后续广告启动。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，设备重启后不会自动启动该库的广告，后续周期性广告也不会由它启动。

en.description: The schedule-release library opens this screen after startup or a scheduled launch. It fetches ad settings and displays Google full-screen ads, with a second ad able to follow the first.
en.disableEffect: The library’s full-screen ads will no longer appear.

zh-CN.description: 设备启动后或定时任务触发时，schedule-release 库会打开此页面。它获取广告设置并展示 Google 全屏广告，第一条广告后还可能接着出现第二条。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，该库的全屏广告将不再显示。

en.description: The Meets Android SDK from The Agile Monkeys starts this background service for online-store requests. It runs the network requests that load store information and carry out store actions.
en.disableEffect: Meets-backed store data and actions may fail to load.

zh-CN.description: The Agile Monkeys 的 Meets Android SDK 会为在线商店请求启动此后台服务。它执行用于加载商店信息和完成商店操作的网络请求。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖 Meets 的商店数据和操作可能无法加载。

en.description: The Android Image Cropper library from ArthurHub opens this screen when an app asks someone to select or crop a photo. It provides crop, rotate, and flip controls and returns the edited image to the app.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents photo workflows that rely on this library from completing a crop.

zh-CN.description: ArthurHub 的 Android Image Cropper 图像裁剪库会在应用要求用户选择或裁剪照片时打开此页面。用户可裁剪、旋转或翻转照片，完成后图片会返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，依赖此库的照片编辑流程将无法完成裁剪。

en.description: The FinestWebView library is a general-purpose in-app browser: the app gives it a URL, and it displays the page with a title, loading progress, navigation, refresh, and options to copy, share, or open the link in another browser.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot open pages through this browser, so any app flow routed through it will be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: FinestWebView 是通用的应用内浏览器：应用提供网址后，它会显示网页标题和加载进度，并提供网页导航、刷新、复制、分享或在其他浏览器中打开等选项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用无法通过此浏览器打开网页，依赖这些网页的应用流程也将无法使用。

en.description: The KFormMaster form library includes this demonstration screen, which displays examples of text, choice, date and time, image, and other form fields.
en.disableEffect: Only this built-in form demonstration screen becomes unavailable; the app's other screens and KFormMaster's reusable form controls remain available.

zh-CN.description: KFormMaster 表单库包含此演示页面，用于展示文本、选择、日期和时间、图片等表单控件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 只有此内置表单演示页面会变得不可用；应用的其他页面和 KFormMaster 可复用的表单控件仍可使用。

en.description: THEOplayer (THEO Technologies) opens this Activity when its video player enters full-screen mode, showing the current player in a screen-sized window.
en.disableEffect: THEOplayer videos will no longer open in this full-screen player window.

zh-CN.description: THEOplayer（THEO Technologies）的播放器进入全屏模式时会打开此 Activity，并在铺满屏幕的窗口中显示当前视频。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，THEOplayer 视频无法使用此全屏播放界面。

en.description: THEOplayer starts this private Service when an app starts or pauses a media caching task; it handles saving video media for later playback.
en.disableEffect: The app will not be able to save video through THEOplayer's caching feature for later playback.

zh-CN.description: 应用开始或暂停 THEOplayer 媒体缓存任务时会启动这个私有 Service，用于后台保存视频媒体数据，供之后播放使用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用无法通过 THEOplayer 缓存视频供之后播放。

en.description: THEOplayer opens this Activity when a user switches video to picture-in-picture mode; the video moves to a floating window that can be restored or closed.
en.disableEffect: THEOplayer videos will no longer continue playing in a floating picture-in-picture window.

zh-CN.description: 用户将 THEOplayer 视频切换到画中画模式时会打开此 Activity；视频会缩到浮动小窗中，并可恢复或关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，THEOplayer 视频无法在浮动的画中画窗口中继续播放。

en.description: Android starts this private TheRouter provider with the app. It saves the app reference and automatically initializes route navigation when auto-initialization is enabled.
en.disableEffect: App navigation routes may remain uninitialized, so screens opened through TheRouter may fail.

zh-CN.description: Android 会在应用启动时运行 TheRouter 私有提供程序，保存应用信息，并在启用自动初始化时启动路由导航。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用路由可能无法初始化，通过 TheRouter 打开的页面可能无法使用。

en.description: If launched, this ThinkCar ThinkIM sample Activity displays a simple greeting screen.
en.disableEffect: The ThinkIM sample greeting screen will not open.

zh-CN.description: 启动后，此 ThinkCar ThinkIM 示例 Activity 只会显示一个简单的问候页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: ThinkIM 示例问候页面将无法打开。

en.description: When it receives a screen-on event, this ThinkCar ThinkIM receiver pings and reconnects the chat connection; screen-off and unlock events are only logged.
en.disableEffect: The chat connection may not be refreshed when the screen turns on.

zh-CN.description: 收到屏幕开启事件时，此 ThinkCar ThinkIM Receiver 会向聊天连接发送探测并尝试重连；屏幕关闭和解锁事件只会被记录。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 屏幕开启时，聊天连接可能无法及时刷新。

en.description: This ThinkCar ThinkIM receiver listens for Android time-zone changes and logs them; its handler also corrects chat time when date- or clock-change events reach it.
en.disableEffect: Chat times may not be corrected after a system date or clock change.

zh-CN.description: 此 ThinkCar ThinkIM Receiver 会接收并记录 Android 时区变化；收到日期或时钟变化事件时，其处理逻辑也会校正聊天时间。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 系统日期或时钟变化后，聊天时间可能无法校正。

en.description: When Firebase sends a message for ThinkCar ThinkIM, this Service receives it and records its notification text and message data.
en.disableEffect: Firebase messages for ThinkIM will no longer reach this Service.

zh-CN.description: Firebase 向 ThinkCar ThinkIM 发送消息时，此 Service 会接收消息并记录通知文本和消息数据。
zh-CN.disableEffect: ThinkIM 将无法通过此 Service 接收 Firebase 消息。

en.description: When the ThinkCar ThinkIM chat client binds to this Service, it opens the chat connection, sends periodic pings, reconnects after failures or network changes, and forwards incoming messages.
en.disableEffect: The app's ThinkIM chat will not be able to connect, send messages, or receive messages through this Service.

zh-CN.description: ThinkCar ThinkIM 聊天客户端绑定此 Service 后，它会建立聊天连接、定期发送探测，并在连接失败或网络变化后重连，同时转发收到的消息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用的 ThinkIM 聊天将无法通过此 Service 建立连接、发送或接收消息。

en.description: When an app asks users to choose files, this fileSelector Activity displays folders and files, supports single or multiple selection, and returns the chosen items to the app.
en.disableEffect: Apps that use this picker cannot open it, so their file-selection or upload flow may fail.

zh-CN.description: 应用需要用户选择文件时，此 fileSelector Activity 会显示文件夹和文件，支持单选或多选，并把所选项目返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此选择器的应用无法打开它，文件选择或上传流程可能因此失败。

en.description: THK-IM’s media picker uses this provider to share captured or selected files with the app as content links, without exposing their file paths.
en.disableEffect: Photo and video attachment flows that rely on these links will fail to return captured or selected files.

zh-CN.description: THK-IM 媒体选择器会通过此 Provider 将拍摄或选中的文件作为内容链接交给应用，而不暴露文件路径。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖这些链接的图片和视频附件流程将无法把拍摄或选中的文件交回应用。

en.description: THK-IM opens this screen with chat messages so users can swipe through their images and videos and play videos.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to open or browse image and video messages in THK-IM chat.

zh-CN.description: THK-IM 会在收到聊天消息后打开此页面，供用户滑动浏览图片和视频并播放视频。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 关闭后，用户将无法在 THK-IM 聊天中打开或浏览图片和视频消息。

en.description: THK-IM opens this Activity when a user views a forwarded chat record; it displays the messages and sender names and lets users open embedded images, videos, or nested chat records.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to view forwarded chat records and their embedded media.

zh-CN.description: 用户查看转发的聊天记录时，THK-IM 会打开此 Activity 显示其中的消息和发送者；用户可继续打开图片、视频或嵌套的聊天记录。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 关闭后，用户将无法查看转发的聊天记录及其中的媒体。

en.description: The 3Line MP35 SDK uses this screen to start an EMV card transaction, show its status, and return the transaction result to the app.
en.disableEffect: Card transactions that use the 3Line MP35 SDK may not start or return a result.

zh-CN.description: 3Line MP35 SDK 使用此页面启动 EMV 银行卡交易、显示交易状态，并将结果返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用 3Line MP35 SDK 的银行卡交易可能无法启动或返回结果。

en.description: Jetpack Fly saves an app reference here during startup so its utility functions can access the app.
en.disableEffect: Jetpack Fly functions that need this app reference may fail to work.

zh-CN.description: Jetpack Fly 会在应用启动时在此保存应用引用，供其工具功能使用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此应用引用的 Jetpack Fly 功能可能无法正常运行。

en.description: FlyNavigation prepares its utility functions when the app starts, and this provider can supply configured files to other apps that request them.
en.disableEffect: FlyNavigation utility setup will not run through this provider, and other apps will not be able to access files it serves.

zh-CN.description: FlyNavigation 会在应用启动时准备工具功能，其他应用请求文件时，此提供器可提供已配置的文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: FlyNavigation 可能无法完成初始化，通过它共享的文件也可能无法打开。

en.description: When a user taps a Tianmu ad, this screen shows the advertiser’s details and landing page and can follow the ad’s destination link.
en.disableEffect: The advertiser’s Tianmu landing page and its links will not open.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击天目广告时，此页面会显示广告主信息和落地页，并可打开广告目标链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 天目广告的落地页及其中的链接将无法打开。

en.description: When a user chooses an app promoted by a Tianmu ad, this screen shows the app’s details and starts the ad-download flow.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to open this ad app’s detail page or start its download.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择下载天目广告推广的应用时，此页面会显示应用详情并启动广告下载流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开此广告应用的详情页或开始下载。

en.description: Tianmu opens this page when a user checks which permissions an advertised app requests.
en.disableEffect: The requested permissions for that advertised app will not be shown in this Tianmu page.

zh-CN.description: 用户查看广告推广应用所需权限时，天目会打开此页面显示权限说明。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 此天目页面将无法显示广告推广应用所需的权限说明。

en.description: Tianmu shows a list of app downloads started from ads and refreshes it as each download changes state.
en.disableEffect: The ad-download list and its progress updates will be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: 天目会列出广告中开始下载的应用，并随下载状态变化更新列表。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 广告下载列表及其进度更新将无法使用。

en.description: Tianmu uses this screen to play full-screen video ads, including rewarded videos that use the same player.
en.disableEffect: These full-screen videos will not play, and rewards for watched videos using this flow will no longer be granted.

zh-CN.description: 天目通过此页面播放全屏视频广告，其中也包括使用同一播放器的激励视频。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 这些全屏视频将无法播放，通过此流程观看视频也不会再获得奖励。

en.description: Tianmu opens this full-screen page when it displays an interstitial ad, choosing the portrait or landscape layout for the placement.
en.disableEffect: These Tianmu interstitial ads will not be displayed.

zh-CN.description: 天目展示插屏广告时会打开此全屏页面，并根据广告方向选择竖屏或横屏布局。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 天目插屏广告将无法显示。

en.description: When a user taps a Tianmu ad, this screen shows the advertiser’s details and landing page and can follow the ad’s destination link. It uses a landscape layout.
en.disableEffect: The advertiser’s Tianmu landing page and its links will not open.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击天目广告时，此页面会显示广告主信息和落地页，并可打开广告目标链接。 页面采用横屏布局。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 天目广告的落地页及其中的链接将无法打开。

en.description: For landscape ad placements, Tianmu shows this page with the promoted app’s details and ad destination.
en.disableEffect: This landscape ad detail page will not open.

zh-CN.description: 横屏展示广告时，天目会通过此页面显示推广应用的详情和广告目标页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 此横屏广告详情页将无法打开。

en.description: In landscape view, Tianmu opens this page to show the permissions requested by an advertised app.
en.disableEffect: The landscape permission-details page for the advertised app will not open.

zh-CN.description: 横屏时，天目会打开此页面显示广告推广应用所需的权限。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 广告推广应用的横屏权限说明页将无法打开。

en.description: Tianmu uses this screen to play full-screen video ads, including rewarded videos that use the same player. It uses a landscape layout.
en.disableEffect: These full-screen videos will not play, and rewards for watched videos using this flow will no longer be granted.

zh-CN.description: 天目通过此页面播放全屏视频广告，其中也包括使用同一播放器的激励视频。 页面采用横屏布局。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 这些全屏视频将无法播放，通过此流程观看视频也不会再获得奖励。

en.description: For landscape placements, Tianmu uses this screen to show an interstitial ad.
en.disableEffect: Landscape Tianmu interstitial ads will not be displayed.

zh-CN.description: 横屏广告位展示插屏广告时，天目会使用此页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 天目的横屏插屏广告将无法显示。

en.description: For landscape ad placements, Tianmu uses this screen to show the advertiser’s web page inside the app.
en.disableEffect: Landscape ad pages that use the Tianmu in-app browser will not open.

zh-CN.description: 横屏展示广告网页时，天目会使用此页面在应用内显示广告主网页。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用天目应用内浏览器的横屏广告网页将无法打开。

en.description: Tianmu plays rewarded video ads here and tracks whether playback completes.
en.disableEffect: Users will no longer receive rewards for watching videos through this Tianmu rewarded-ad flow.

zh-CN.description: 天目会在此播放激励视频广告，并跟踪视频是否播放完成。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户通过天目激励广告流程观看视频后将无法获得奖励。

en.description: This Tianmu page appears when a user requests feedback on an ad; it can copy the ad’s reference information to the clipboard.
en.disableEffect: The Tianmu ad-feedback page will not open.

zh-CN.description: 用户提交广告反馈时会打开此天目页面；页面可将广告参考信息复制到剪贴板。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 天目广告反馈页面将无法打开。

en.description: Tianmu opens web pages linked from its ads inside the app.
en.disableEffect: Ad pages that use the Tianmu in-app browser will not open.

zh-CN.description: 天目会在应用内打开广告链接指向的网页。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用天目应用内浏览器的广告网页将无法打开。

en.description: Tianmu runs this background service to show and update notices while an advertised app is downloading.
en.disableEffect: Progress and notification updates for Tianmu ad downloads will stop.

zh-CN.description: 广告推广的应用下载期间，天目会通过此后台服务显示并更新下载通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 天目广告下载的进度和通知将停止更新。

en.description: Tianmu uses this file-sharing provider to give Android’s installer access to an app package downloaded from an ad.
en.disableEffect: Android may be unable to open Tianmu-downloaded app packages for installation.

zh-CN.description: 天目通过此文件共享提供程序，将广告下载的应用安装包交给 Android 安装程序打开。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Android 可能无法打开天目下载的应用安装包进行安装。

en.description: When Android launches the Tianzun China TZAPIForAndroid sample from the app launcher, this screen displays a simple greeting.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it removes this sample app's launcher screen and the greeting it displays.

zh-CN.description: 从应用启动器打开天尊中国 TZAPIForAndroid 示例时，此页面只显示一条简单问候语。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，示例应用的启动器页面和问候内容将无法打开。

en.description: When an app requests a file through Tianzun China's TZAPIForAndroid sharing feature, this provider makes files in configured locations available to other apps through an access-controlled link.
en.disableEffect: Other apps may fail to open files that the host app shares through TZAPIForAndroid.

zh-CN.description: 应用通过天尊中国 TZAPIForAndroid 的文件共享功能请求文件时，此 Provider 会通过受访问授权保护的链接，向其他应用提供已配置位置中的文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 其他应用可能无法打开宿主应用通过 TZAPIForAndroid 共享的文件。

en.description: When the host app uses Tianzun China's TZAPIForAndroid built-in photo capture, this screen opens the camera, saves the picture, and returns it to the app.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot take and return a photo through this TZAPIForAndroid camera screen.

zh-CN.description: 宿主应用使用天尊中国 TZAPIForAndroid 的内置拍照功能时，会打开此相机界面。拍摄的照片会保存后交回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法通过此 TZAPIForAndroid 相机界面拍摄并取回照片。

en.description: When the host app displays a form through Tianzun China's TZAPIForAndroid, this component builds editable text and single-choice fields from the supplied form data.
en.disableEffect: Forms that rely on this TZAPIForAndroid component will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: 宿主应用通过天尊中国 TZAPIForAndroid 显示表单时，此组件会根据提供的表单数据创建文本输入项和单选项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此 TZAPIForAndroid 组件的表单将无法打开。

en.description: When the host app requests permissions through Tianzun China's TZAPIForAndroid, this screen asks Android for any missing permissions and offers to open app settings if access is denied.
en.disableEffect: Features that depend on this permission flow may be unable to get the access they need.

zh-CN.description: 宿主应用通过天尊中国 TZAPIForAndroid 请求权限时，此界面会向 Android 申请缺少的权限；如果用户拒绝，还会提供打开应用设置的选项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此权限流程的功能可能无法获得所需权限。

en.description: When a user opens a photo from a Tianzun China TZAPIForAndroid photo tool, this screen shows one local image or loads one from a web address.
en.disableEffect: Photos opened through TZAPIForAndroid photo tools will no longer appear in this viewer.

zh-CN.description: 用户在天尊中国 TZAPIForAndroid 的照片工具中打开照片时，此界面会显示一张本地图片或加载一张网络图片。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过 TZAPIForAndroid 照片工具打开的图片将无法在此查看器中显示。

en.description: Ticketmaster Accounts Authentication SDK opens this Activity when an account sign-in requires a multi-factor verification step; it displays the verification flow.
en.disableEffect: Users may be unable to complete Ticketmaster sign-in when their account requires multi-factor verification.

zh-CN.description: Ticketmaster 账户认证 SDK 在账户登录要求多重验证时会打开此 Activity，显示额外的身份验证流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，要求多重验证的 Ticketmaster 账户登录可能无法完成。

en.description: Ticketmaster Accounts Authentication SDK opens this Activity for Modern Accounts sign-in, displaying the login flow and returning the result to the app.
en.disableEffect: The app will not be able to complete Ticketmaster Modern Accounts sign-in.

zh-CN.description: Ticketmaster 账户认证 SDK 会在 Modern Accounts 登录流程中打开此 Activity，显示登录界面并将结果返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用无法完成 Ticketmaster Modern Accounts 登录。

en.description: Ticketmaster Accounts Authentication SDK opens this Activity for SportXR account sign-in and handles the return from its authentication page.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to complete the app's SportXR sign-in flow.

zh-CN.description: Ticketmaster 账户认证 SDK 会在 SportXR 账户登录流程中打开此 Activity，并处理认证页面返回应用的跳转。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法完成应用中的 SportXR 登录流程。

en.description: Ticketmaster Presence SDK opens this Activity when ticket access or resale requires a one-time verification code. It lets the user enter, submit, or request another code.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot complete ticket or resale steps that require this verification.

zh-CN.description: 当 Ticketmaster Presence SDK 在取票或转售流程中要求一次性验证码时，此 Activity 会显示验证码输入界面，并允许用户提交或重新获取验证码。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法完成需要此验证的取票或转售步骤。

en.description: Ticketmaster Presence SDK uses this exported Activity to open ticket or order links, including the app link used when returning from Google Wallet linking. It loads the event tickets and handles the wallet-link response.
en.disableEffect: Ticket and order links, including the return from Google Wallet linking, will not open this screen.

zh-CN.description: Ticketmaster Presence SDK 通过此 Activity 打开票券或订单链接，包括 Google Wallet 绑定后的返回链接。它会加载活动票券并处理钱包绑定结果。

zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用无法通过此旧版 sing-box 服务建立或维持 VPN 连接。

en.description: When the app starts an XrayNeko profile, Tim06 VPN Protocols creates an Android VPN tunnel and runs the selected connection in a background process.

zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，XrayNeko 连接无法启动或保持运行。

en.description: When the app starts an XrayNG profile, Tim06 VPN Protocols creates an Android VPN tunnel and runs the selected connection in a separate process.
en.disableEffect: XrayNG connections cannot start or stay active if this service is disabled.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动 XrayNG 配置时，Tim06 VPN Protocols 会建立 Android VPN 隧道，并在独立进程中运行所选连接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，XrayNG 连接无法启动或保持运行。

en.description: The Lazerpay Android payment SDK opens this in-app web checkout for a payment and returns the transaction result or a close event to the app.
en.disableEffect: Lazerpay checkout and its payment result handling may fail.

zh-CN.description: Lazerpay Android 支付 SDK 会打开此应用内网页结账页面，并将交易结果或关闭事件返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Lazerpay 结账及支付结果处理可能失败。

en.description: The TINet online customer-service SDK opens this Activity when a user chooses to capture media in a support chat; it provides camera controls for taking a photo or recording a short video.

zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过此客服流程提交留言。

en.description: The TINet online customer-service SDK opens this Activity when a user taps an image message in a support chat, displaying the image viewer.

zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，客服聊天中的视频无法通过此播放界面打开。

en.description: When Android reports that a download is complete, this receiver checks the TINet customer-service file download and reports its status.

zh-CN.description: Android 报告下载完成时，此 Receiver 会检查 TINet 在线客服的文件下载状态并向应用报告结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，此接收器无法识别或报告客服文件下载的完成状态。

en.description: When Huawei Mobile Services reports a connection error in TINet Push, this translucent Activity opens Huawei's resolution screen and returns the result to the push SDK.

zh-CN.description: 华为移动服务连接异常需要处理时，TINet Push 会启动此半透明 Activity，打开华为的处理界面并将结果返回推送 SDK。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，华为推送无法通过此界面处理服务连接异常，注册或消息投递可能失败。

en.description: Vivo Push sends notification-click events and registration token updates to this TINet receiver, which passes them to the app's push handler.
en.disableEffect: Vivo push notification clicks and registration updates will no longer reach the app.

zh-CN.description: Vivo 推送会将通知点击事件和注册令牌更新发送给此 TINet 接收器，再由它转交给应用的推送处理器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Vivo 推送的通知点击事件和注册更新将无法到达应用。

zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，小米推送消息和注册结果将无法交给应用处理。

en.description: When a host app starts the Tink Link UI SDK, this screen guides the user through connecting a financial account and returns success, cancellation, or failure to the host app. It also handles the return link from the bank flow.
en.disableEffect: The app's Tink account-linking flow cannot be started or completed.

zh-CN.description: 宿主应用启动 Tink Link UI SDK 时，此页面会引导用户关联金融账户，并将成功、取消或失败结果返回宿主应用。银行流程返回应用时，此页面也会处理回跳链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法启动或完成 Tink 账户关联流程。

en.description: Watayouxiang's Tio chat SDK opens this screen for the account settings page. It shows the signed-in phone number and email and offers phone or password changes and account deletion.

zh-CN.description: 这是 Watayouxiang Tio 聊天 SDK 的账号设置页面。它显示已登录账号的手机号和邮箱，并提供修改手机号、密码以及注销账号的入口。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法打开此账号设置页查看联系方式、管理账号安全或申请注销账号。

en.description: Watayouxiang's Tio chat SDK opens this screen for the phone-binding form. It asks the user to verify a phone number and attach it to the current account.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, users cannot bind a phone number to the account through this flow.

zh-CN.description: 这是 Watayouxiang Tio 聊天 SDK 的绑定手机号页面。用户需要验证手机号并将其关联到当前账号。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法通过此流程为账号绑定手机号。

en.description: Watayouxiang's Tio chat SDK opens this screen for the account sign-in page. It accepts an account and password and also handles third-party sign-in results.

zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法通过 Tio 账号页面登录，包括密码登录和第三方登录。

en.description: Watayouxiang's Tio chat SDK opens this screen for the phone sign-in page. It asks for a phone number and SMS verification code to sign in.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, users cannot sign in with a phone number and SMS verification code.

zh-CN.description: 这是 Watayouxiang Tio 聊天 SDK 的手机号登录页面。用户输入手机号和短信验证码即可登录。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法使用手机号和短信验证码登录。

en.description: Watayouxiang's Tio chat SDK opens this screen for the phone-change flow. It verifies the old number, lets the user bind a new number, and shows the completion step.

zh-CN.description: 这是 Watayouxiang Tio 聊天 SDK 的修改手机号流程。它会验证旧手机号、绑定新手机号并显示完成步骤。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法更换账号关联的手机号。

en.description: Watayouxiang's Tio chat SDK opens this screen for the account registration flow. It collects a phone number and can continue to an email-binding step.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, new users cannot register through the Tio account flow.

zh-CN.description: 这是 Watayouxiang Tio 聊天 SDK 的账号注册流程。它收集手机号，并可继续绑定邮箱。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，新用户将无法通过 Tio 账号流程注册。

zh-CN.description: 这是 Watayouxiang Tio 聊天 SDK 的账号注销流程。它说明注销后果，并引导用户继续完成安全验证。

zh-CN.description: Watayouxiang Tio 社交模块的示例页面，可用于试用 QQ、微信登录或分享并查看返回结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，此示例页面不可用；它不是应用日常使用的登录或分享页面。

en.description: Watayouxiang's Tio verification module opens this test screen to try puzzle and word captchas and show their results.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, the verification test screen is unavailable; ordinary app screens remain usable.

zh-CN.description: Watayouxiang Tio 验证模块的测试页面，可用于体验拼图和文字验证码并查看结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，验证码测试页面不可用；应用的日常页面仍可使用。

en.description: Watayouxiang's Tio SDK opens this screen for an incoming or outgoing voice or video call, showing the caller and call controls.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, users cannot answer or place Tio voice and video calls.

zh-CN.description: Watayouxiang Tio SDK 会在收到或发起语音、视频通话时打开此页面，显示通话对象和操作按钮。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法接听或发起 Tio 语音和视频通话。

en.description: When NUGU Auto requests a connection, this TMAP Mobility Automotive SDK receiver reconnects the TMAP voice assistant so in-car voice requests can reach navigation.
en.disableEffect: NUGU Auto cannot bind to TMAP's voice assistant, so its in-car voice-navigation integration stops.

zh-CN.description: NUGU Auto 请求连接时，TMAP Mobility Automotive SDK 的此接收器会重新建立 TMAP 语音助手连接，让车载语音请求能够到达导航。
zh-CN.disableEffect: NUGU Auto 将无法连接 TMAP 语音助手，因此车载语音导航集成会停止。

en.description: When Edith or the car interface broadcasts a navigation or voice-recognition command, the TMAP Mobility Automotive SDK forwards location, route, waypoint, and guidance requests to TMAP. It also mutes or unmutes navigation speech while voice recognition is active.
en.disableEffect: Edith voice commands can no longer start or control TMAP routes, and speech-state changes will not be handled.

zh-CN.description: Edith 或车载界面发送导航或语音识别命令时，TMAP Mobility Automotive SDK 会把定位、路线、途经点和语音指引请求转发给 TMAP。语音识别期间，它也会静音或恢复导航播报。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Edith 语音命令将无法启动或控制 TMAP 路线，语音状态变化也不会得到处理。

en.description: When an Edith client requests navigation information, the TMAP Mobility Automotive SDK returns current location, route state, bookmarks, recent places, destination, waypoints, or quick state.
en.disableEffect: Other apps cannot read TMAP navigation and saved-place data through this interface.

zh-CN.description: Edith 客户端请求导航信息时，TMAP Mobility Automotive SDK 会返回当前位置、路线状态、收藏地点、最近地点、目的地、途经点或快速状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 其他应用将无法通过此接口读取 TMAP 导航和已保存地点的数据。

en.description: When NUGU Auto requests a connection, the TMAP Mobility Automotive SDK receiver starts or rebinds its NUGU connection so in-car voice-navigation requests can reach TMAP.
en.disableEffect: NUGU Auto cannot establish its TMAP voice-assistant connection, so voice-navigation requests through that assistant stop.

zh-CN.description: NUGU Auto 请求连接时，TMAP Mobility Automotive SDK 的此接收器会建立或重新绑定 NUGU 连接，使车载语音导航请求能够到达 TMAP。
zh-CN.disableEffect: NUGU Auto 将无法建立与 TMAP 语音助手的连接，因此无法再通过该助手发送语音导航请求。

en.description: TNK Factory's CPP offerwall opens this Activity when a user views a redeemed Giftishow voucher; it displays the voucher barcode and can save it as an image.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to display or save TNK voucher barcodes, so redeeming those vouchers may fail.

zh-CN.description: TNK Factory 的 CPP 优惠墙会在用户查看已兑换的 Giftishow 礼券时打开此页面，显示礼券条码并可将其保存为图片。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后无法显示或保存 TNK 礼券条码，可能无法兑换这类礼券。

en.description: TNK Factory's CPP offerwall opens this Activity for its event, notice, partner, and help pages when a user selects them.
en.disableEffect: The TNK offerwall's event, notice, partner, and help pages will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择 TNK Factory 的 CPP 优惠墙中的活动、公告、合作伙伴或帮助页面时，SDK 会打开此页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后无法打开 TNK 优惠墙中的活动、公告、合作伙伴和帮助页面。

en.description: TNK Factory's CPP SDK opens this Activity when a user chooses to sign in to a TNK reward account; it presents the SDK's sign-in screen.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot sign in to their TNK reward account or use offerwall features that require that account.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择登录 TNK 奖励账户时，TNK Factory 的 CPP SDK 会打开此页面并显示登录界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后无法登录 TNK 奖励账户，也无法使用依赖该账户的优惠墙功能。

en.description: When a user opens their TNK account's coin-earning list, this Activity loads and displays earnings from CPP offer tasks.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to view their TNK offer-earning list here.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 TNK 账户的赚取记录时，此页面会加载并显示 CPP 优惠任务的收益。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后无法在此查看 TNK 优惠任务的赚取记录。

en.description: When a user opens their TNK account's redeemed-item history, this Activity loads purchased vouchers; selecting a supported voucher shows its PIN or barcode.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to view or redeem vouchers stored in this TNK history.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 TNK 账户的已兑换记录时，此页面会加载购买的礼券；选择支持的礼券后会显示兑换码或条码。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后无法查看或兑换此 TNK 记录中的礼券。

en.description: TNK Factory's CPP SDK uses this Activity for its account menu and reward store, opening the profile or store page requested by the user.
en.disableEffect: The TNK profile and reward-store pages opened through this screen will be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: TNK Factory 的 CPP SDK 使用此页面显示账户菜单和奖励商店，并按用户选择打开个人页面或商店。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后无法通过此页面打开 TNK 个人页面和奖励商店。

en.description: TNK Factory's CPP SDK opens this Activity to show details for a selected item in its reward store.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to open TNK reward-store item details or use options shown there.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择奖励商店中的商品后，TNK Factory 的 CPP SDK 会打开此页面显示商品详情。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后无法打开 TNK 奖励商店的商品详情，也无法使用详情页中的选项。

en.description: TNK Factory's CPP SDK uses this Activity to display its reward-store catalog and load an item's details when selected.
en.disableEffect: The TNK reward-store catalog and its item-detail pages will be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: TNK Factory 的 CPP SDK 使用此页面显示奖励商店目录，并在用户选择商品时加载详情。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后无法查看 TNK 奖励商店目录及其中的商品详情。

en.description: This TNK Factory CPP screen lets users search reward-store items by merchant or text and then open an item's details.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to search the TNK reward store or open results from this screen.

zh-CN.description: TNK Factory 的 CPP 页面允许用户按商家或文字搜索奖励商店商品，并打开搜索结果的详情。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后无法通过此页面搜索 TNK 奖励商店或打开搜索结果。

en.description: TNK Factory's RWD ad SDK registers this ContentProvider at app startup, but its implementation performs no user-facing operation.
en.disableEffect: Disabling this empty provider has no visible effect on the app.

zh-CN.description: TNK Factory 的 RWD 广告 SDK 会在应用启动时注册此内容提供程序，但其实现没有用户可见的操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用此空内容提供程序不会影响应用的可见功能。

en.description: TNK Factory's RWD SDK opens this Activity for its cost-per-sale offer list, where users can search the listed offers.
en.disableEffect: The TNK cost-per-sale offer list and search screen will be unavailable, and rewards tied to those offers may no longer be earned.

zh-CN.description: TNK Factory 的 RWD SDK 会打开此页面显示按销售付费的推广列表，用户可在其中搜索推广内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后无法查看或搜索 TNK 按销售付费的推广，也可能无法获得这些推广对应的奖励。

en.description: NHN Cloud Gamebase initializes its SDK automatically during app startup here, preparing Gamebase services for later use.
en.disableEffect: Gamebase login, web, purchase, and other services may fail to initialize.

zh-CN.description: NHN Cloud Gamebase 会在应用启动时通过此提供程序自动初始化 SDK，为后续使用 Gamebase 服务做准备。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Gamebase 登录、网页、购买等服务可能无法初始化。

en.description: Gamebase opens this screen for its in-app web flows; it displays requested web content and handles close requests and web-certificate errors.
en.disableEffect: Gamebase web-based login or content flows may not open or close correctly.

zh-CN.description: Gamebase 会在其应用内网页流程中打开此页面，显示请求的网页内容，并处理关闭请求和网页证书错误。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Gamebase 的网页登录或内容流程可能无法正常打开或关闭。

en.description: Gamebase opens an in-app sign-in page when its member-account login is requested and returns the sign-in result to the app.
en.disableEffect: The Gamebase member-account sign-in flow will fail.

zh-CN.description: 请求登录 Gamebase 会员账户时，Gamebase 会打开此应用内登录页面，并将登录结果返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Gamebase 会员账户登录流程将失败。

en.description: Gamebase's Apple ID adapter uses this screen for Apple ID sign-in and returns the authentication result through Gamebase.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to complete Apple ID sign-in through Gamebase.

zh-CN.description: Gamebase 的 Apple ID 适配器使用此页面进行 Apple ID 登录，并通过 Gamebase 返回认证结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过 Gamebase 完成 Apple ID 登录。

en.description: Gamebase's Google Play Games auto-login adapter initializes Play Games during app startup so automatic sign-in can run.
en.disableEffect: Play Games automatic sign-in may not initialize, so Gamebase sign-in through Google Play Games may fail.

zh-CN.description: Gamebase 的 Google Play Games 自动登录适配器会在应用启动时初始化 Play Games，以便执行自动登录。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后 Play Games 自动登录可能无法初始化，Gamebase 的 Google Play Games 登录也可能失败。

en.description: Gamebase's Ongame authentication adapter opens this screen for OnGame web sign-in and returns the authentication result to Gamebase.
en.disableEffect: The OnGame sign-in flow through Gamebase will be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: Gamebase 的 Ongame 认证适配器会打开此页面进行 OnGame 网页登录，并将认证结果返回给 Gamebase。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后无法通过 Gamebase 使用 OnGame 登录流程。

en.description: Gamebase uses this screen to dim the current page while it opens another SDK screen, then forwards that screen's result back to the caller.
en.disableEffect: Gamebase flows that rely on this screen transition may not complete.

zh-CN.description: Gamebase 打开其他 SDK 页面时会使用此页面调暗当前画面，并将后续页面的结果返回给调用方。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，依赖此页面切换方式的 Gamebase 流程可能无法完成。

en.description: Gamebase opens this screen when it needs Android runtime permissions; on supported Android versions it shows the system prompt and returns whether access was granted.
en.disableEffect: Gamebase features that require those permissions may fail.

zh-CN.description: Gamebase 需要 Android 运行时权限时会打开此页面；在支持的 Android 版本上，它会显示系统授权提示并返回授权结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，依赖这些权限的 Gamebase 功能可能无法使用。

en.description: Gamebase uses this screen to request runtime permissions for flows such as camera access or web-page file selection, then returns the grant results.
en.disableEffect: Gamebase flows that need camera or file access may fail.

zh-CN.description: Gamebase 会使用此页面为相机访问或网页文件选择等流程申请运行时权限，并返回授权结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，需要相机或文件访问权限的 Gamebase 流程可能失败。

en.description: Gamebase's in-app browser displays a requested web page or HTML content and provides page navigation and file selection.
en.disableEffect: Gamebase flows that display web pages or upload files may fail.

zh-CN.description: Gamebase 的应用内浏览器会显示请求的网页或 HTML 内容，并提供页面导航和文件选择功能。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，显示网页或上传文件的 Gamebase 流程可能失败。

en.description: Gamebase opens this blocking alert when its heartbeat handler reports a banned account; it shows the server message and waits for the user to acknowledge it.
en.disableEffect: The ban notice and its acknowledgement callback may not run, leaving Gamebase session handling incomplete.

zh-CN.description: Gamebase 的心跳处理程序报告账户被封禁时会打开此阻断式提示，显示服务器消息并等待用户确认。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后封禁提示及其确认回调可能不会执行，Gamebase 会话处理可能不完整。

en.description: Gamebase's TOAST IAP adapter registers for Google Play purchase updates when the app starts so completed purchases can reach the purchase flow.
en.disableEffect: Google Play purchase updates may not reach Gamebase, so purchases could fail or remain unconfirmed.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，Gamebase 的 TOAST IAP 适配器会注册 Google Play 购买更新，以便已完成的购买进入购买处理流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后 Google Play 购买更新可能无法送达 Gamebase，购买可能失败或无法确认。

en.description: Gamebase Push receives TOAST push messages, applies the app's notification rules, and displays notifications in the background or when foreground notifications are enabled.
en.disableEffect: Gamebase push notifications may stop appearing, while the app's non-push features remain available.

zh-CN.description: Gamebase Push 会接收 TOAST 推送消息、应用通知规则，并在应用处于后台或允许前台通知时显示通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后 Gamebase 推送通知可能不再显示，但应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: Gamebase's TOAST Push adapter registers message, notification-click, and action callbacks at app startup and applies saved notification options.
en.disableEffect: Gamebase will no longer receive push-message, notification-click, or action callbacks from this adapter.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，Gamebase 的 TOAST Push 适配器会注册消息、通知点击和操作回调，并应用已保存的通知选项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后 Gamebase 将无法通过此适配器接收推送消息、通知点击或操作回调。

en.description: Gamebase opens this blocking alert when a server kickout event occurs; it shows the server message and waits for acknowledgement.
en.disableEffect: The kickout notice and its session-cleanup callback may not run, leaving the Gamebase session in an inconsistent state.

zh-CN.description: 服务器发出踢出事件时，Gamebase 会打开此阻断式提示，显示服务器消息并等待用户确认。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后踢出提示及其会话清理回调可能不会执行，Gamebase 会话状态可能不一致。

en.description: Gamebase uses this in-app browser for web-based SDK pages; it loads requested content, handles app links, and supports file selection.
en.disableEffect: Gamebase web pages and flows that need file selection may fail.

zh-CN.description: Gamebase 使用此应用内浏览器显示 SDK 网页内容、处理应用链接并支持文件选择。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后 Gamebase 网页以及需要文件选择的流程可能失败。

en.description: TOAST IAP's OneStore adapter opens this screen to sign in to OneStore and returns the login result to the purchase flow.
en.disableEffect: OneStore account sign-in required for purchases may not complete.

zh-CN.description: TOAST IAP 的 OneStore 适配器会打开此页面登录 OneStore，并将登录结果返回购买流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，购买所需的 OneStore 账户登录可能无法完成。

en.description: TOAST IAP's OneStore adapter opens this screen for the selected product purchase and returns the purchase result.
en.disableEffect: Purchases through the TOAST IAP OneStore adapter will fail or lose their result callback.

zh-CN.description: TOAST IAP 的 OneStore 适配器会为所选商品打开此页面完成购买，并返回购买结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后无法通过 TOAST IAP OneStore 适配器完成购买或接收购买结果。

en.description: The PAYCO Login SDK opens this screen for PAYCO sign-in and consent; it handles the return link and phone-verification steps.
en.disableEffect: Users may not be able to complete PAYCO sign-in, consent, or phone verification.

zh-CN.description: PAYCO Login SDK 会打开此页面进行 PAYCO 登录和授权，并处理返回链接及手机号验证步骤。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后用户可能无法完成 PAYCO 登录、授权或手机号验证。

en.description: NHN Cloud's TOAST Push FCM SDK receives Firebase push messages and sends them to the app's push handlers; it also processes refreshed FCM tokens.
en.disableEffect: TOAST push messages and token updates will stop, while the app's non-push features remain available.

zh-CN.description: NHN Cloud 的 TOAST Push FCM SDK 会接收 Firebase 推送消息并交给应用的推送处理程序，也会处理更新后的 FCM 令牌。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后 TOAST 推送消息和令牌更新将停止，但应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: The legacy TOAST Push FCM SDK registers a notification-open listener on Android 12 and newer; when a notification opens the app, it reports the open or action and sends open analytics.
en.disableEffect: Notification opens and action callbacks from this legacy module may no longer be reported.

zh-CN.description: 旧版 TOAST Push FCM SDK 会在 Android 12 及更新版本上注册通知打开监听器；用户通过通知打开应用时，它会报告打开或操作事件并发送打开统计。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，旧版模块可能不再报告通知打开事件或执行通知操作回调。

en.description: TOAST Push's Tencent module receives Tencent push messages and passes their contents to TOAST's message handler.
en.disableEffect: Tencent push messages will no longer reach the app through TOAST Push.

zh-CN.description: TOAST Push 的腾讯模块会接收腾讯推送消息，并将消息内容交给 TOAST 的消息处理程序。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，腾讯推送消息将无法通过 TOAST Push 到达应用。

en.description: At app startup, this TOAST Push Tencent provider initializes the TOAST SDK when an application context is available.
en.disableEffect: The Tencent push module may not initialize, so its push messages may stop working.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，如果可以取得应用上下文，此 TOAST Push 腾讯提供程序会初始化 TOAST SDK。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后腾讯推送模块可能无法初始化，其推送消息也可能停止工作。

en.description: TOAST Push SDK runs this receiver when a user taps an action on a rich notification; it handles reply, open-app, open-link, and dismiss actions.
en.disableEffect: Actions on TOAST rich notifications, such as replying or opening a link, will no longer work.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击 TOAST 富媒体通知中的操作时，TOAST Push SDK 会处理回复、打开应用、打开链接或关闭通知等操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，TOAST 富媒体通知中的回复、打开链接等操作将无法使用。

en.description: The Tianjiu e-commerce product SDK opens this screen for a requested shopping scene and loads its theme and content list; tapping a card opens its linked page, while video cards can play inline.
en.disableEffect: The SDK’s shopping-scene list and its inline video content will not open through this screen.

zh-CN.description: 天九电商商品 SDK 会按请求打开购物场景页，并加载场景主题和内容列表；用户点选卡片可进入关联页面，视频卡片可在列表中播放。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，SDK 提供的购物场景列表及其中的视频内容无法通过此页面打开。

en.description: When the Tianjiu e-commerce product SDK opens one of its DCloud UniMP mini-app pages, this screen checks the installed version; if needed, it downloads and installs the updated package before opening the requested page.
en.disableEffect: The mini-app package cannot be downloaded or updated through this flow, so the requested page may fail to open.

zh-CN.description: 天九电商商品 SDK 打开 DCloud UniMP 小程序页面时，会在此页面检查已安装版本；需要更新时下载并安装资源包，然后打开指定页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，此流程无法下载或更新小程序资源包，因此指定页面可能无法打开。

en.description: When started with a video-stream address, the Tianjiu e-commerce product SDK adds a movable floating player with a close button and plays the stream in that window.
en.disableEffect: The SDK’s floating video playback will stop working, so a video cannot continue in this movable window.

zh-CN.description: 天九电商商品 SDK 携带视频流地址启动此服务时，会创建带关闭按钮的可移动悬浮播放器，并在窗口中播放视频流。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，SDK 的悬浮视频播放将无法使用，视频不能在此可移动窗口中继续播放。

en.description: The NetworkRequestQueue SDK by Tomer Goldstein starts this Service when queued requests need to be sent. It sends saved requests when the device is online, removes successful ones, and schedules retries when a request fails.
en.disableEffect: Requests handled by this SDK will not be sent, so an app feature that depends on them may fail to update or complete.

zh-CN.description: Tomer Goldstein 的 NetworkRequestQueue SDK 会在需要发送排队请求时启动此 Service。设备联网后，它会发送保存的请求、移除成功的请求，并为失败的请求安排重试。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 此 SDK 处理的请求将无法发送，因此依赖这些请求的应用功能可能无法更新或完成。

en.description: The NetworkRequestQueue SDK by Tomer Goldstein calls this Receiver when a timed retry for a failed queued request is due. It starts the Service that tries the saved requests again.
en.disableEffect: Requests waiting for a timed retry may remain unsent, which can stop an app feature that relies on them from completing.

en.description: The TradPlus cross-promotion SDK opens this full-screen page to play a promoted-app video and show its end card. Ad links can lead to an app download.
en.disableEffect: TradPlus cross-promotion video ads and their app-download links will stop working.

zh-CN.description: TradPlus 交叉推广 SDK 打开此全屏页面播放推广应用的视频并展示结束页；广告链接可以跳转到应用下载。
zh-CN.disableEffect: TradPlus 交叉推广视频广告及其应用下载链接将无法使用。

en.description: The TradPlus cross-promotion SDK opens this screen for cross-promotion video ads presented in landscape orientation, with an end card and download link.
en.disableEffect: Landscape cross-promotion video ads and their download links will stop working.

zh-CN.description: TradPlus 交叉推广 SDK 以横屏方式打开此页面播放推广视频，并展示结束页和下载链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 横屏交叉推广视频广告及其下载链接将无法使用。

en.description: The TradPlus cross-promotion SDK opens this screen for cross-promotion video ads presented in portrait orientation, with an end card and download link.
en.disableEffect: Portrait cross-promotion video ads and their download links will stop working.

zh-CN.description: TradPlus 交叉推广 SDK 以竖屏方式打开此页面播放推广视频，并展示结束页和下载链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 竖屏交叉推广视频广告及其下载链接将无法使用。

en.description: The TradPlus Tools diagnostics screen shows the integrated ad networks and SDK versions. Its test control opens visual ad configuration.
en.disableEffect: The in-app SDK integration and visual ad-configuration screen will no longer be available.

zh-CN.description: TradPlus Tools 诊断页面显示已接入的广告网络和 SDK 版本，其测试控件可打开可视化广告配置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用内的 SDK 接入检查和可视化广告配置页面将无法使用。

en.description: The TradPlus Tools screen provides ad-unit settings and a test mode, with links to other SDK diagnostics.
en.disableEffect: The in-app TradPlus Tools settings and test screen will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: TradPlus Tools 页面提供广告位设置和测试模式，并可进入其他 SDK 诊断页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用内的 TradPlus Tools 设置和测试页面将无法打开。

en.description: The TradPlus Tools ad-unit screen shows the selected ad type, ad-unit details, and waterfall or bidding networks, and can open an ad preview.
en.disableEffect: Ad-unit diagnostics and previews in TradPlus Tools will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: TradPlus Tools 广告位页面显示所选广告类型、广告位详情以及瀑布流或竞价网络，并可打开广告预览。
zh-CN.disableEffect: TradPlus Tools 中的广告位诊断和预览将无法打开。

en.description: The TradPlus Tools privacy-settings page shows GDPR guidance and lets users view or change the SDK's CCPA and COPPA settings.
en.disableEffect: The in-app TradPlus privacy-settings page will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: TradPlus Tools 隐私设置页面显示 GDPR 指引，并允许用户查看或修改 SDK 的 CCPA 和 COPPA 设置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用内的 TradPlus 隐私设置页面将无法打开。

en.description: The TradPlus Tools screen previews an ad from one selected ad network by narrowing the waterfall or bidding setup to that network.
en.disableEffect: Single-network ad previews in TradPlus Tools will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: TradPlus Tools 通过将瀑布流或竞价配置限定为所选网络，预览该网络的广告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: TradPlus Tools 将无法打开单个广告网络的预览。

en.description: The TradPlus Tools permissions screen lists the Android permissions requested by the app.
en.disableEffect: The requested-permissions list in TradPlus Tools will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: TradPlus Tools 权限页面列出应用请求的 Android 权限。
zh-CN.disableEffect: TradPlus Tools 中的权限列表将无法打开。

en.description: The TradPlus Tools ad-unit list shows configured ad units and opens their diagnostic details when selected.
en.disableEffect: The ad-unit list and its diagnostic screens in TradPlus Tools will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: TradPlus Tools 广告位列表显示已配置的广告位，选择后可打开对应的诊断详情。
zh-CN.disableEffect: TradPlus Tools 中的广告位列表和诊断页面将无法打开。

en.description: TopOn's Tramini provider schedules the Tramini module to initialize shortly after app startup and does not display a screen.
en.disableEffect: The Tramini module will miss its automatic startup initialization, so its ad-related background work will stop.

zh-CN.description: TopOn 的 Tramini 提供器会在应用启动后不久安排 Tramini 模块初始化，不会显示页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Tramini 模块将无法自动初始化，其广告相关后台工作会停止。

en.description: When opened in the Trata Group HSE library, this screen lists local database tables and lets the user inspect, edit, or delete stored rows.
en.disableEffect: Blocking it makes the HSE database inspection screen unavailable.

zh-CN.description: 在 Trata Group 的 HSE 患者管理库中打开后，此页面会列出本地数据库表，并可查看、修改或删除其中的记录。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，HSE 的数据库查看页面将无法打开。

en.description: When the Trata Group HSE library's daily alarm fires, this Receiver resets saved auto-login details and clears the local appointment table.
en.disableEffect: Blocking it stops this scheduled login and appointment cleanup, leaving expired login data and old appointments in local storage.

zh-CN.description: Trata Group 的 HSE 患者管理库设定的每日提醒触发时，此接收器会重置自动登录信息并清空本地预约表。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，定时登录和预约清理会停止，过期的登录信息和旧预约可能留在本地。

en.description: When a user opens media from prescription history, the Trata Group HSE library plays the selected audio or video and provides controls to move through the attached files.
en.disableEffect: Prescription audio and video can no longer be opened in the HSE media viewer.

zh-CN.description: 用户从处方记录打开媒体时，Trata Group 的 HSE 患者管理库会播放所选音频或视频，并提供切换附件的控件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，将无法在 HSE 媒体查看器中打开处方音频和视频。

en.description: When opened from queue management, the Trata Group HSE library loads a dashboard with clinic and prescription summaries and issue statuses for the selected doctor.
en.disableEffect: The HSE dashboard and its clinic, prescription, and issue summaries will not open.

zh-CN.description: 从队列管理页面打开时，Trata Group 的 HSE 患者管理库会加载所选医生的诊所、处方概览和问题处理状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，将无法打开 HSE 仪表板及其中的诊所、处方和问题处理概览。

en.description: When a user opens doctor concerns from queue management, the Trata Group HSE library shows the concern list and lets the user open the concern form.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot view or submit doctor concerns from the HSE queue screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户从队列管理打开医生问题时，Trata Group 的 HSE 患者管理库会显示问题列表，并可打开提交表单。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法从 HSE 队列页面查看或提交医生问题。

en.description: When a user opens an FAQ link from a patient profile or queue screen, the Trata Group HSE library loads the supplied help page in an in-app browser.
en.disableEffect: FAQ and other help pages opened through the HSE screens will not be available.

zh-CN.description: 用户从患者资料或队列页面打开常见问题链接时，Trata Group 的 HSE 患者管理库会在应用内浏览器中加载相应帮助页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，将无法从 HSE 页面查看常见问题和其他帮助内容。

en.description: When feedback is opened from queue management, the Trata Group HSE library loads questions and accepts a mobile number and answers before submitting feedback.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot submit feedback through the HSE queue screen.

zh-CN.description: 从队列管理打开反馈页面时，Trata Group 的 HSE 患者管理库会加载问题，并收集手机号和答案后提交反馈。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过 HSE 队列页面提交反馈。

en.description: When opened from queue management, the Trata Group HSE library lets a doctor prepare an SMS campaign, choose dates, and review message history.
en.disableEffect: The HSE SMS campaign and message-history screen will not work.

zh-CN.description: 从队列管理打开时，Trata Group 的 HSE 患者管理库可让医生设置短信活动、选择日期并查看发送记录。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，HSE 短信活动和发送记录页面将无法使用。

en.description: When opened for a selected patient, the Trata Group HSE library shows basic details and prescription history and can start a quick prescription or appointment-token flow.
en.disableEffect: The selected patient's quick prescription and history screen will be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: 为所选患者打开时，Trata Group 的 HSE 患者管理库会显示患者基本资料和处方记录，并可启动快速开方或预约取号流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，将无法打开所选患者的快速开方和处方记录页面。

en.description: When the patient area is opened in the Trata Group HSE library, this screen hosts patient management and starts with the patient list.
en.disableEffect: The HSE patient-management screen will not open.

zh-CN.description: 打开 Trata Group 的 HSE 患者管理区域时，此页面承载患者管理功能并显示患者列表。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，HSE 患者管理页面将无法打开。

en.description: When queue management requests patient selection, the Trata Group HSE library opens a patient list for choosing a record.
en.disableEffect: Patient selection from HSE queue management will not open.

zh-CN.description: 队列管理需要选择患者时，Trata Group 的 HSE 患者管理库会打开患者列表供用户选择。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，将无法从 HSE 队列管理打开患者选择列表。

en.description: When a patient is selected from a list or appointment, the Trata Group HSE library shows the patient's profile and address and opens history or address-editing screens.
en.disableEffect: Patient profile, address, and history details will not open in HSE.

zh-CN.description: 从列表或预约中选择患者后，Trata Group 的 HSE 患者管理库会显示患者资料和地址，并可打开病史或地址编辑页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，将无法在 HSE 中打开患者资料、地址和病史详情。

en.description: When opened from HSE patient, visit, or payment flows, the Trata Group HSE library lists pending data transfers and lets users retry or remove sync jobs.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot view or manage pending HSE data synchronization from this screen.

zh-CN.description: 从患者、就诊或支付流程打开时，Trata Group 的 HSE 患者管理库会列出待同步数据，并可重试或移除同步任务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过此页面查看或管理 HSE 待同步数据。

en.description: When an appointment or queue flow requests a QR scan, the Trata Group HSE library opens the camera, scans a code, and returns its text to the calling screen.
en.disableEffect: QR-based patient, appointment, and prescription lookups will not work.

zh-CN.description: 预约或队列流程请求扫描二维码时，Trata Group 的 HSE 患者管理库会打开相机、读取二维码并将文本返回调用页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，基于二维码的患者、预约和处方查询将无法使用。

en.description: During patient registration, the Trata Group HSE library starts this background Service to upload selected identity-document images and their verification details.
en.disableEffect: Patient identity documents cannot be uploaded during registration.

zh-CN.description: 患者注册期间，Trata Group 的 HSE 患者管理库会启动此后台服务，上传所选身份文件图片及其核验信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，注册时将无法上传患者身份文件。

en.description: During patient registration, the Trata Group HSE library starts this background Service to upload the selected patient profile photo.
en.disableEffect: Patient profile photos cannot be uploaded during registration.

zh-CN.description: 患者注册期间，Trata Group 的 HSE 患者管理库会启动此后台服务，上传所选患者头像。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，注册时将无法上传患者头像。

en.description: When a user adds patient documents or prescription media, the Trata Group HSE library opens a camera and image picker and returns the selected image files to the form.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot capture or choose images for HSE patient documents and prescription records.

zh-CN.description: 用户添加患者文件或处方媒体时，Trata Group 的 HSE 患者管理库会打开相机和图片选择器，并将所选图片返回表单。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法为 HSE 患者文件和处方记录拍摄或选择图片。

en.description: When HSE captures a patient photo, this Trata Group HSE file provider gives the camera temporary access to save the image in app storage.
en.disableEffect: Camera capture and attaching local patient images may fail because HSE cannot provide the required file access.

zh-CN.description: HSE 拍摄患者照片时，Trata Group 的 HSE 文件提供器会向相机临时开放应用存储位置，以便保存图片。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，HSE 无法提供所需的文件访问权限，相机拍摄和附加本地患者图片可能失败。

en.description: When opened with a PDF link, the Trata Group HSE library displays the document preview inside the app.
en.disableEffect: PDF reports opened through the HSE viewer will not be available.

zh-CN.description: 通过 PDF 链接打开时，Trata Group 的 HSE 患者管理库会在应用内显示文档预览。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，将无法通过 HSE 查看器打开 PDF 报告。

en.description: When the HSE appointment-page entry point is used, this screen presents previous, today, and upcoming appointments.
en.disableEffect: The HSE appointment list and visit flows in its tabs will not open.

zh-CN.description: 使用 HSE 预约页面入口时，此页面会显示过往、今日和即将到来的预约。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，HSE 预约列表及其标签页中的就诊流程将无法打开。

en.description: When a developer opens Trendyol Analytics Logger, this activity displays recorded app analytics events and lets the developer inspect an event.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it removes the screen used to review recorded analytics events.

zh-CN.description: 开发者打开 Trendyol Analytics Logger 时，此 Activity 会显示应用记录的分析事件，并允许查看单条事件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，查看已记录分析事件的界面将无法打开。

en.description: When a developer opens Trendyol Android Debug Menu, this activity displays the debugging actions registered by the app.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it removes the in-app menu for developer debugging actions.

zh-CN.description: 开发者打开 Trendyol Android Debug Menu 时，此 Activity 会显示应用注册的调试操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用内的开发者调试菜单将无法打开。

en.description: When a developer opens Trendyol SharedPreferences Manager, this activity lists the app’s saved local preferences and allows individual values or all preferences to be updated or deleted.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it removes the developer tool for viewing and editing saved local preferences.

zh-CN.description: 开发者打开 Trendyol SharedPreferences Manager 时，此 Activity 会列出应用保存的本地偏好设置，并允许修改或删除单项或全部设置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，查看和编辑本地偏好设置的开发者工具将无法使用。

en.description: When a developer opens Trendyol Deeplink Launcher, this activity provides a screen to select or enter an app link and open it in the app.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it removes the developer tool for opening and checking app links.

zh-CN.description: 开发者打开 Trendyol Deeplink Launcher 时，此 Activity 会提供界面供其选择或输入应用链接，并在应用中打开该链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，开发者将无法通过此工具打开和检查应用链接。

en.description: When Trendyol Environment Manager starts this service, it maintains a notification showing the current environment; tapping the notification opens the environment screen.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it stops the environment tool from maintaining its current-environment notification.

zh-CN.description: Trendyol Environment Manager 启动此服务后，它会持续显示当前环境的通知；点击通知可打开环境设置界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，环境工具将无法持续显示当前环境通知。

en.description: When a developer opens Trendyol Environment Manager, this activity displays the available environments and lets the developer choose the current one.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it removes the screen used to change the app development environment.

zh-CN.description: 开发者打开 Trendyol Environment Manager 时，此 Activity 会显示可用环境，并允许选择当前环境。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，开发者将无法通过此界面切换应用的开发环境。

en.description: When Trimble Driver Workflow sends a workflow event through the Instinct integration, this service forwards the event to the app’s registered listener.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, the app stops receiving Trimble Driver Workflow events, so features that depend on those updates cannot respond to them.

zh-CN.description: Trimble Driver Workflow 通过 Instinct 集成发送工作流事件时，此服务会将事件转发给应用注册的监听器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用将无法接收 Trimble Driver Workflow 事件，依赖这些更新的功能也无法响应。

en.description: When the app opens a Trip38 trip segment, this activity fetches and displays that segment’s cards, using saved card data when available.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, the app cannot open the Trip38 card list for a trip segment.
