zh-CN.description: 应用打开 Trip38 行程分段时，此 Activity 会获取并显示该分段的卡片；有已保存数据时也会先使用本地数据。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用将无法打开 Trip38 行程分段的卡片列表。

en.description: When a user opens a Trip38 card, this activity displays the matching detail page, such as details for an attraction, ticket, or service.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, Trip38 card detail pages cannot be opened.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 Trip38 卡片时，此 Activity 会显示对应的详情页，例如景点、机票或服务详情。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Trip38 卡片详情页将无法打开。

en.description: When the app opens a Trip38 trip segment, this activity displays its cards and refreshes their saved data from Trip38.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, the app cannot open the Trip38 card list for a trip segment.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开 Trip38 行程分段时，此 Activity 会显示该分段的卡片，并从 Trip38 更新已保存的数据。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用将无法打开 Trip38 行程分段的卡片列表。

en.description: When a user opens a Trip38 card, this activity displays the matching detail page, such as details for an attraction, ticket, or service.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, Trip38 card detail pages cannot be opened.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 Trip38 卡片时，此 Activity 会显示对应的详情页，例如景点、机票或服务详情。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Trip38 卡片详情页将无法打开。

en.description: When a Trip38 photo gallery is opened, this activity displays the selected trip photos in a swipeable viewer.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, users cannot open Trip38 photos in the full-screen gallery.

zh-CN.description: 打开 Trip38 照片集时，此 Activity 会以可滑动的图片浏览界面显示所选行程照片。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法在全屏图片浏览界面中查看 Trip38 照片。

en.description: When a user chooses to view all items from a Trip38 card, this activity displays the full list for that section, such as attractions or offers.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, the full lists opened from Trip38 cards cannot be viewed.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择查看 Trip38 卡片中的全部项目时，此 Activity 会显示该类别的完整列表，例如景点或优惠。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法查看从 Trip38 卡片打开的完整列表。

en.description: When a user chooses to view all items from a Trip38 card, this activity displays the full list for that section, such as attractions or offers.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, the full lists opened from Trip38 cards cannot be viewed.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择查看 Trip38 卡片中的全部项目时，此 Activity 会显示该类别的完整列表，例如景点或优惠。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法查看从 Trip38 卡片打开的完整列表。

en.description: When started by the app, this Trip38 background service fetches the user’s trip segments and stores their card data locally for later display.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it stops background refresh of saved trip cards, so cards may require a network fetch when opened and may be unavailable offline.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动此 Trip38 后台服务时，它会获取用户的行程分段，并将卡片数据保存在本地以便之后显示。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，已保存行程卡片的后台更新会停止；打开卡片时可能需要联网，离线时也可能无法查看。

en.description: Tencent TRTC UI Kit starts this foreground service during an active RTC audio or video session and shows the session title and description in a notification. It is marked for microphone and camera foreground use so the session can continue while the app is not on screen.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it can interrupt Tencent RTC calls when the app moves to the background.

zh-CN.description: 腾讯 TRTC UI Kit 在实时音视频通话期间启动此前台服务，并在通知中显示通话标题和说明。它被声明为麦克风和摄像头前台服务，使通话可在应用退到后台后继续运行。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，应用切到后台时，依赖腾讯 RTC 的音视频通话可能中断。

en.description: Tencent TRTC UI Kit starts this audio foreground service after microphone permission is granted; it displays a notification while the audio session runs and keeps the session in the foreground.
en.disableEffect: Audio sessions that rely on this service may stop when the app leaves the foreground.

zh-CN.description: 腾讯 TRTC UI Kit 在获得麦克风权限后启动此音频前台服务，并在音频会话运行时显示通知，让会话可在应用退到后台后继续。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此服务的音频会话可能无法在应用退到后台后继续。

en.description: Tencent TRTC UI Kit uses this media-playback foreground service and shows a notification with the supplied title and description during playback. This lets playback continue as a foreground task while the app is away.
en.disableEffect: Playback that relies on this service may stop when the app is in the background.

zh-CN.description: 腾讯 TRTC UI Kit 在媒体播放期间使用此服务，并显示包含标题和说明的通知。它让播放任务可在应用退到后台后继续。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此服务的媒体播放可能无法在应用退到后台后继续。

en.description: After camera and microphone permission are granted, Tencent TRTC UI Kit starts this foreground service for a video session and shows a notification while it runs.
en.disableEffect: Video calls that rely on this service may be interrupted when the app moves to the background.

zh-CN.description: 获得摄像头和麦克风权限后，腾讯 TRTC UI Kit 会为视频会话启动此前台服务，并在运行期间显示通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此服务的视频通话可能在应用退到后台时中断。

en.description: Tencent TRTC UI Kit opens this screen when it needs Android runtime permissions; it explains the requested access, shows the system permission prompt, and can open app settings after a denial.
en.disableEffect: TRTC features that need microphone or camera access may not be able to request the required permission.

zh-CN.description: 腾讯 TRTC UI Kit 需要 Android 运行时权限时会打开此页面，说明所需权限并显示系统授权提示；用户拒绝后还可跳转到应用设置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要麦克风或摄像头权限的 TRTC 功能可能无法请求所需授权。

en.description: Tencent TRTC UI Kit initializes this provider at app startup so its permission checks, notifications, and other utilities can retrieve the application context.
en.disableEffect: Without it, TRTC UI Kit helpers may fail when they need the app context.

zh-CN.description: 腾讯 TRTC UI Kit 会在应用启动时初始化此组件，让权限检查、通知和其他工具能够获取应用运行环境。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，需要应用运行环境的 TRTC UI Kit 工具可能无法正常工作。

en.description: Tencent TRTC Voice Room SDK registers at app startup for successful account logins, then logs the signed-in user into its room engine with the SDK account credentials.
en.disableEffect: Voice-room setup will not run after login, so joining or creating rooms may fail.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动后，腾讯 TRTC 语音房 SDK 会在账号登录成功时登录语音房服务，并使用当前用户的 SDK 账号信息完成初始化。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，登录后不会完成语音房初始化，因此加入或创建语音房可能失败。

en.description: TrueID SSO runs this provider as Android starts the app's content providers; it initializes the SDK and registers activity lifecycle hooks used by authentication.
en.disableEffect: TrueID startup initialization and lifecycle handling do not run, so SSO or token flows can fail.

zh-CN.description: Android 启动应用的内容提供程序时，TrueID SSO 会运行此提供程序来初始化 SDK，并注册认证所需的活动生命周期处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: TrueID 的启动初始化和生命周期处理将不会运行，SSO 或令牌流程可能因此失败。

en.description: The newer TrueID SSO SDK runs this provider during app startup to initialize its authentication services and register activity lifecycle handling.
en.disableEffect: TrueID authentication services and lifecycle handling are not initialized, which can prevent SSO flows from working.

zh-CN.description: 较新版本的 TrueID SSO SDK 会在应用启动时运行此提供程序，初始化认证服务并注册活动生命周期处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: TrueID 认证服务和生命周期处理将无法初始化，SSO 流程可能无法使用。

en.description: TrueID SSO opens this embedded web screen during an identity-mapping flow; it displays the requested page and returns its result to the app.
en.disableEffect: The TrueID identity-mapping step cannot finish.

zh-CN.description: TrueID SSO 会在身份关联流程中打开此内嵌网页，显示请求的页面并将结果返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: TrueID 的身份关联步骤将无法完成。

en.description: TrueID SSO opens this embedded web screen for interactive sign-in and supported social sign-in, then returns the authentication result to the app.
en.disableEffect: TrueID web login and social sign-in flows that use this screen cannot complete.

zh-CN.description: TrueID SSO 会为交互式登录和受支持的社交登录打开此内嵌网页，并将认证结果返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此页面的 TrueID 网页登录和社交登录流程将无法完成。

en.description: Android's account manager opens this TrueID screen for account authentication; it returns the sign-in result and adds a TrueID account when requested.
en.disableEffect: Account-manager-based TrueID silent sign-in becomes unavailable.

zh-CN.description: Android 账户管理器会为 TrueID 账户认证打开此页面；页面返回登录结果，并在收到请求时添加 TrueID 账户。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 基于账户管理器的 TrueID 静默登录将无法使用。

en.description: TrueID QR login opens this portrait camera screen to scan a code and return the scanner result to the authentication flow.
en.disableEffect: The camera-scanning step of TrueID QR login cannot run.

zh-CN.description: TrueID 二维码登录会打开此竖屏相机页面扫描二维码，并将扫描结果交回认证流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: TrueID 二维码登录的相机扫描步骤将无法运行。

en.description: When the app starts TrueID QR sign-in, this screen launches the camera scanner and sends the scanned code into the authentication flow.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot sign in through TrueID QR codes.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动 TrueID 二维码登录时，此页面会打开相机扫描器，并将扫描到的二维码交给认证流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 TrueID 二维码登录。

en.description: TrueID's account-authentication service binds to Android account-manager requests and supplies its silent sign-in authenticator.
en.disableEffect: Android account-manager requests cannot use TrueID silent sign-in.

zh-CN.description: TrueID 账户认证服务会响应 Android 账户管理器的绑定请求，并提供静默登录认证器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Android 账户管理器将无法使用 TrueID 静默登录。

en.description: When the app starts a TrueLayer payment authorization, this activity displays the payment flow and returns its success or failure result to the app.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, the app cannot display or complete the TrueLayer payment flow.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动 TrueLayer 支付授权时，此 Activity 会显示支付流程，并将成功或失败结果返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用将无法显示或完成 TrueLayer 支付流程。

en.description: When TrueLayer opens a payment result flow for a resource, this activity displays the result screen and sends success or failure back to the app.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, TrueLayer cannot return the payment result through this screen.

zh-CN.description: TrueLayer 为某项支付资源打开结果流程时，此 Activity 会显示结果界面，并将成功或失败状态返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，TrueLayer 将无法通过此界面向应用返回支付结果。

en.description: Farimarwat Camera Helper opens a live camera for document or card capture and returns images, optionally cropped to a selected frame or captured on both sides.
en.disableEffect: Apps using Camera Helper cannot capture and return documents through this screen.

zh-CN.description: Farimarwat Camera Helper 会打开实时相机以拍摄文件或卡片，并返回图像；用户可选择按取景框裁剪或拍摄卡片两面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用 Camera Helper 的应用将无法通过此界面拍摄并获取文件图像。

en.description: Farimarwat Image Helper opens an image supplied by the app for editing, lets the user add or clear stickers, and saves the edited image.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot edit and save images through Image Helper.

zh-CN.description: Farimarwat Image Helper 会打开应用提供的图片供用户编辑，支持添加或清除贴纸并保存编辑结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法通过 Image Helper 编辑并保存图片。

en.description: When the app starts a Trulioo DocV document verification workflow, this activity hosts the verification screen, which can request camera access during the process.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, users cannot complete the app’s Trulioo document verification flow.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动 Trulioo DocV 文件验证流程时，此 Activity 会显示验证界面，流程中可能会请求相机权限。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法完成应用中的 Trulioo 文件验证流程。

en.description: The Truora Identity Verification Common SDK declares this empty mock screen. It opens only when the host app starts it; the regular verification flow uses a separate screen.
en.disableEffect: Blocking it removes only this empty mock screen; the regular Truora verification flow remains available.

zh-CN.description: Truora 身份核验通用 SDK 声明了这个空白模拟页面。只有宿主应用主动打开时才会显示；常规核验流程使用另一个页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，只有这个空白模拟页面无法打开；Truora 常规核验流程仍可使用。

en.description: When the host app starts an identity process, the Truora Identity Verification SDK opens this Activity, loads the process steps, and guides the user through the checks before returning a result.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot start or complete Truora identity verification, so any sign-up or verification flow that depends on it will fail.

zh-CN.description: 宿主应用启动身份核验流程时，Truora 身份核验 SDK 会打开此页面、加载核验步骤，并引导用户完成检查后返回结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用无法启动或完成 Truora 身份核验；依赖该流程的注册或核验步骤会失败。

en.description: The Truora Document Verification SDK declares this empty mock screen. It opens only when the host app starts it; the regular document-check flow uses separate screens.
en.disableEffect: Blocking it removes only this empty mock screen; the regular Truora document-check flow remains available.

zh-CN.description: Truora 证件核验 SDK 声明了这个空白模拟页面。只有宿主应用主动打开时才会显示；常规证件核验流程使用其他页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，只有这个空白模拟页面无法打开；Truora 常规证件核验流程仍可使用。

en.description: When the TrustDecision Liveness Lite SDK starts a web-based liveness session, this Activity opens its full-screen verification page and requests camera access for the face check.
en.disableEffect: TrustDecision cannot open or complete this web-based face check.

zh-CN.description: TrustDecision 轻量活体检测 SDK 启动网页核验时，会打开此全屏页面，并申请相机权限来进行人脸检查。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，TrustDecision 无法打开或完成这项网页人脸核验。

en.description: For a TrustDecision face-liveness check, this screen shows selfie preparation tips and a start button before camera capture. If the SDK skips the tips page, it moves straight to camera capture.
en.disableEffect: The TrustDecision liveness flow cannot open this screen, so checks that use this flow will fail before camera capture.

zh-CN.description: TrustDecision 进行人脸活体检测时，此页面会在相机采集前显示准备提示和开始按钮。若 SDK 跳过提示页，就会直接进入相机采集。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，TrustDecision 无法打开此页面，使用该流程的检测会在相机采集前失败。

en.description: During the TrustDecision Liveness SDK camera flow, this Activity opens the face-capture screen after the user continues from the guide and returns the liveness result to the app.
en.disableEffect: The SDK cannot run its camera-based face check, so app verification that depends on this flow will fail.

zh-CN.description: TrustDecision 活体检测 SDK 的相机流程中，用户从说明页面继续后会进入此人脸采集页面；检测结果随后返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，SDK 无法运行相机人脸检测，依赖此流程的应用核验会失败。

en.description: This is the landscape version of the TrustDecision Liveness SDK face-capture screen. It opens when the app runs the camera-based liveness check in landscape mode.
en.disableEffect: The landscape liveness check cannot open its camera screen and will fail.

zh-CN.description: 这是 TrustDecision 活体检测 SDK 的横屏人脸采集页面；应用以横屏运行相机活体检测时会打开它。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，横屏活体检测无法打开相机页面并会失败。

en.description: After a TrustDecision camera check, this screen shows whether the liveness check passed or failed and provides the available retry or exit choices.
en.disableEffect: The user cannot review or continue from the liveness result screen, so the verification flow may stop.

zh-CN.description: TrustDecision 相机检测结束后，此页面会显示活体检测是否通过，并提供可用的重试或退出选项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法查看检测结果或从结果页继续，核验流程可能中断。

en.description: This is the landscape version of the TrustDecision Liveness SDK result screen, showing whether the camera-based liveness check passed or failed.
en.disableEffect: The landscape liveness result cannot be shown, and the verification flow may stop.

zh-CN.description: 这是 TrustDecision 活体检测 SDK 的横屏结果页面，用于显示相机活体检测是否通过。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，横屏检测结果无法显示，核验流程可能中断。

en.description: When the older TrustDecision Liveness SDK flow begins, this Activity shows the face-check guide and opens the camera check after the user continues.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot begin this TrustDecision face-liveness flow, so verification that depends on it will fail.

zh-CN.description: 较早版本的 TrustDecision 活体检测流程启动时，此页面会显示人脸检测说明；用户继续后会打开相机检测。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用无法开始这项 TrustDecision 人脸活体检测，依赖该流程的核验会失败。

en.description: This is the landscape version of the older TrustDecision Liveness SDK guide screen; continuing from it opens the camera-based face check.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot begin the landscape version of this TrustDecision liveness flow.

zh-CN.description: 这是较早版本 TrustDecision 活体检测 SDK 的横屏说明页面；用户继续后会打开相机人脸检测。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用无法开始横屏 TrustDecision 活体检测流程。

en.description: After a TrustDecision Liveness SDK check returns, this screen displays whether it passed or failed and shows the result details.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot display the TrustDecision check outcome through this result screen.

zh-CN.description: TrustDecision 活体检测 SDK 返回结果后，此页面会显示检测是否通过及结果详情。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用无法通过此结果页面显示 TrustDecision 检测结果。

en.description: During the newer TrustDecision Liveness SDK flow, this Activity requests camera permission, guides the user through a live-face check, and returns the outcome to the app.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot run this TrustDecision live-person check, so verification that relies on it will fail.

zh-CN.description: 较新版本的 TrustDecision 活体检测流程中，此页面会申请相机权限、引导用户完成人脸活体检查，并将结果返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用无法运行这项 TrustDecision 真人检测，依赖该检查的核验会失败。

en.description: During a Transmit Security BindID hosted browser sign-in, this service briefly shows a silent identity-service notification and stops after the sign-in returns to the app.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, BindID cannot keep this temporary foreground service active during browser sign-in, which can interrupt returning the login result to the app.

zh-CN.description: Transmit Security BindID 通过浏览器进行托管登录时，此服务会暂时显示静默的身份服务通知，并在登录返回应用后停止。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，BindID 无法在浏览器登录期间运行此临时前台服务，登录结果可能无法返回应用。

en.description: During a Transmit Security BindID hosted sign-in, this service helps the app remain available while the user completes the sign-in in a browser and returns to the app.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, Android may stop the app while the browser is open, interrupting the BindID sign-in return to the app.

zh-CN.description: Transmit Security BindID 进行托管登录时，此服务会帮助应用在用户通过浏览器完成登录并返回应用期间保持可用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，浏览器打开期间 Android 可能会停止应用，导致 BindID 登录结果无法返回应用。

en.description: aWhalefall's PickGallery opens this screen when the app asks the user to choose photos or take a picture; it supports folders, single or multiple selection, and optional cropping before returning the chosen images.
en.disableEffect: Photo selection and camera capture through PickGallery will stop working, which can interrupt app tasks that need an image.

zh-CN.description: 应用需要用户选图或拍照时，aWhalefall 的 PickGallery 会打开此页面；它支持按相册浏览、单选或多选，并可在返回图片前裁剪。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，PickGallery 的选图和拍照功能将无法使用，依赖图片的应用操作可能受影响。

en.description: When the host app opens the TTC Android BLE SDK device maintenance screen for a selected Bluetooth device, this Activity lets the user choose a firmware file, start or stop the wireless update, monitor progress, and send a reset command.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot update that device firmware or send its reset command through this TTC screen.

zh-CN.description: 宿主应用为选定的蓝牙设备打开 TTC Android BLE SDK 维护页面时，此页面可选择固件文件、开始或停止无线更新、查看进度并发送重置命令。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用无法通过此 TTC 页面更新设备固件或发送重置命令。

en.description: When an app starts the earlier OpenPass Android TV sign-in flow, this Activity presents the authentication screen and returns the resulting tokens or an error to the app.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents this OpenPass sign-in flow from completing.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动旧版 OpenPass Android TV 登录流程时，此 Activity 会显示认证界面，并把生成的令牌或错误结果返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，此 OpenPass 登录流程将无法完成。

en.description: At app startup, the TTLock SDK provider prepares Bluetooth services for TTLock locks and its supported gateways, remotes, keypads, sensors, and meters.
en.disableEffect: TTLock connections and device controls may fail because the SDK Bluetooth services are not initialized.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，TTLock SDK 提供器会为 TTLock 门锁及其支持的网关、遥控器、键盘、传感器和计量设备准备蓝牙服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，SDK 蓝牙服务不会初始化，TTLock 连接和设备控制可能失败。

en.description: When a supported TTLock device firmware upgrade begins, this service runs the Bluetooth firmware transfer in the background.
en.disableEffect: Firmware upgrades for supported TTLock devices will fail.

zh-CN.description: 兼容的 TTLock 设备开始固件升级时，此服务会在后台通过蓝牙传输固件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，兼容 TTLock 设备的固件升级会失败。

en.description: During a TTLock firmware update, this provider lets the updater read the firmware package through a secure Android file link.
en.disableEffect: The TTLock updater cannot access the firmware package, so the device cannot be updated.

zh-CN.description: TTLock 固件更新期间，此提供器会通过 Android 安全文件链接让更新程序读取固件包。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，TTLock 更新程序无法读取固件包，设备也就无法升级。

en.description: When Tuna Software's Tuna payment SDK requests a card scan, this Activity opens the camera and reads the card number, name, and expiration date for checkout.
en.disableEffect: The app will not receive card details from Tuna's scanning screen, which can block a payment flow that uses it.

zh-CN.description: Tuna Software 的 Tuna 支付 SDK 请求扫描银行卡时，此 Activity 会打开相机，读取卡号、持卡人姓名和有效期并交给结账流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 关闭后，应用无法从 Tuna 扫卡页面获取银行卡信息，使用该流程的支付可能无法继续。

en.description: During a payment session in Tuna Software's Tuna Android SDK, this Activity presents the method-selection screen and returns a selected credit card or bank-slip option to checkout.
en.disableEffect: Customers cannot return a payment-method choice through Tuna, so checkout may not proceed.

zh-CN.description: Tuna Software 的 Tuna Android SDK 支付会话中，此 Activity 会显示支付方式页面，并将选定的信用卡或银行付款单选项返回结账流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 关闭后，客户无法通过 Tuna 返回支付方式选择，结账可能无法继续。

en.description: Tuna Software's Tuna Android payment SDK uses this Activity to display its checkout screen, where a customer can choose payment, delivery, and installments, enter a document, and apply a promo code.
en.disableEffect: The app loses Tuna's checkout screen, so purchases that rely on it may not finish.

zh-CN.description: Tuna Software 的 Tuna Android 支付 SDK 使用此 Activity 显示结账页面，客户可选择支付方式、配送和分期，填写证件信息并使用优惠码。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 关闭后，应用无法使用 Tuna 结账页面，依赖该页面的购买流程可能无法完成。

en.description: In Tuna Software's Tuna payment SDK, this Activity hosts the delivery-selection screen and returns the chosen option when checkout asks for it.
en.disableEffect: Checkout cannot collect a delivery choice through Tuna, which can block purchases that require delivery.

zh-CN.description: Tuna Software 的 Tuna 支付 SDK 在结账要求选择配送方式时会显示此页面，并将所选方式返回结账流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 关闭后，结账无法通过 Tuna 收集配送选择，需要配送的购买流程可能受阻。

en.description: In Tuna Software's Tuna payment SDK, this Activity hosts the customer-document entry screen and returns the entered value when checkout asks for it.
en.disableEffect: Checkout cannot collect the requested customer document through Tuna, so that payment step may not finish.

zh-CN.description: Tuna Software 的 Tuna 支付 SDK 在结账要求客户填写证件信息时会显示此页面，并返回输入的内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 关闭后，结账无法通过 Tuna 收集所需证件信息，该支付步骤可能无法完成。

en.description: In Tuna Software's Tuna payment SDK, this Activity hosts the installment choices and returns the selected plan when checkout asks for it.
en.disableEffect: Checkout cannot collect an installment choice through Tuna, so installment payments may not proceed.

zh-CN.description: Tuna Software 的 Tuna 支付 SDK 在结账要求选择分期方案时会显示可选方案，并返回所选方案。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 关闭后，结账无法通过 Tuna 收集分期选择，分期付款可能无法继续。

en.description: When the app opens its AboutLibraries screen, this Activity lists the included open-source libraries and lets users open the available license details.
en.disableEffect: The screen listing the open-source libraries included in the app and their licenses will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开 AboutLibraries 页面时，此页面会列出应用包含的开源库，并可查看提供的许可证详情。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用的开源库和许可证页面将无法打开。

en.description: On older Android releases, this compatibility Activity displays the app open-source library list and available license details.
en.disableEffect: The compatibility screen listing the open-source libraries included in the app and their licenses will no longer open on systems that use it.

zh-CN.description: 在较旧的 Android 版本上，此兼容页面会显示应用包含的开源库和可查看的许可证详情。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，使用此兼容页面的系统将无法打开应用的开源库和许可证页面。

en.description: When Google Play sends the install-referrer broadcast, the TUNE Marketing Console SDK decodes and saves the campaign referrer, then passes it to TUNE for install attribution.
en.disableEffect: TUNE loses this install campaign attribution, while other app features continue to work.

zh-CN.description: Google Play 发送安装来源广播时，TUNE Marketing Console SDK 会解码并保存营销来源参数，再交给 TUNE 进行安装归因。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，TUNE 无法获得这次安装的营销来源；应用的常规功能仍可使用。

en.description: The Tune Talk Dealer SDK opens a searchable country, state, or city list when a dealer form needs a selection, then returns the chosen value to the form.
en.disableEffect: Dealer registration forms may be unable to select the location details they require.

zh-CN.description: Tune Talk Dealer SDK 会在经销商表单需要选择国家、州或城市时打开可搜索列表，并将所选内容返回表单。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 经销商注册表单可能无法选择所需的地点信息。

en.description: The Tune Talk Dealer SDK opens a camera screen for capturing identity documents, OKU cards, or SIM cards during dealer registration and replacement flows.
en.disableEffect: Camera-based identity and SIM capture steps in registration, replacement, or number-transfer flows may not work.

zh-CN.description: Tune Talk Dealer SDK 会在经销商注册或补卡流程中打开相机页面，用于拍摄身份证件、OKU 卡或 SIM 卡。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 注册、补卡或号码转入流程中的证件和 SIM 卡拍摄步骤可能无法使用。

en.description: During Tune Talk SIM registration or number transfer, this screen collects the customer's OKU special-needs documents and submits them with the order.
en.disableEffect: Dealers may be unable to submit the required OKU documents for an eligible SIM registration or number-transfer order.

zh-CN.description: 在 Tune Talk SIM 注册或号码转入流程中，此页面收集客户的 OKU 特殊需求证明，并随订单一同提交。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 经销商可能无法为符合条件的 SIM 注册或号码转入订单提交所需的 OKU 证明。

en.description: Before Tune Talk automatic SIM registration, SIM replacement, or number transfer, this screen requests camera and storage access, lets the dealer choose an identity document, and handles USB card-reader connection events.
en.disableEffect: The related document-scanning and card-reader steps may not be available, blocking those dealer flows.

zh-CN.description: 在 Tune Talk 自动注册 SIM、补卡或号码转入之前，此页面申请相机和存储权限、供经销商选择证件类型，并处理 USB 读卡器连接事件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 相关的证件扫描和读卡器步骤可能无法使用，从而阻止这些经销商流程继续。

en.description: The Tune Talk Dealer SDK collects a customer's current provider, identity, contact, address, and number-transfer details, then submits a mobile-number port-in request.
en.disableEffect: Dealers may be unable to transfer a customer's mobile number from another provider to Tune Talk.

zh-CN.description: Tune Talk Dealer SDK 会收集客户当前运营商、身份、联系和地址信息以及号码转入资料，然后提交携号转入申请。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 经销商可能无法将客户的手机号码从其他运营商转入 Tune Talk。

en.description: The Tune Talk Dealer SDK collects subscriber identity, address, contact, and SIM details, captures an identity image, and submits a new SIM registration.
en.disableEffect: Dealers may be unable to complete automatic registration of a new SIM.

zh-CN.description: Tune Talk Dealer SDK 会收集用户身份、地址、联系和 SIM 信息，拍摄证件并提交新 SIM 注册。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 经销商可能无法完成新 SIM 卡的自动注册。

en.description: The Tune Talk Dealer SDK collects subscriber and SIM details, captures an identity image, and submits a SIM replacement request.
en.disableEffect: Dealers may be unable to submit a SIM replacement request.

zh-CN.description: Tune Talk Dealer SDK 会收集用户和 SIM 信息、拍摄证件，并提交 SIM 补卡申请。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 经销商可能无法提交 SIM 补卡申请。

en.description: During Tune Talk SIM registration, this screen fetches available mobile numbers and lets the customer search and choose one.
en.disableEffect: A customer may be unable to choose an available mobile number for SIM registration.

zh-CN.description: 在 Tune Talk SIM 注册流程中，此页面获取可选手机号码，并让客户搜索和选择号码。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 客户可能无法为 SIM 注册选择可用的手机号码。

en.description: When an Alarmee scheduled reminder is due, this receiver creates and displays it as an Android notification.
en.disableEffect: Alarmee local reminders scheduled by this version will no longer appear.

zh-CN.description: Alarmee 计划的提醒到期时，此 Receiver 会创建并显示 Android 通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，此版本安排的 Alarmee 本地提醒将不再显示。

en.description: When a user taps an action button on an Alarmee notification, this receiver closes the notification and tells the app which action was chosen.
en.disableEffect: The app will not receive notification-button actions, so those buttons will no longer work.

zh-CN.description: 用户轻点 Alarmee 通知上的操作按钮时，此 Receiver 会关闭通知并将所选操作告知应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用将收不到通知按钮的操作，因此这些按钮无法正常使用。

en.description: When an Alarmee scheduled alarm is due, this receiver displays the notification and schedules the next one for repeating reminders. It also supports images, links, and action buttons.
en.disableEffect: Scheduled Alarmee notifications and their repeats will no longer be displayed.

zh-CN.description: Alarmee 计划的提醒到期时，此 Receiver 会显示通知，并为重复提醒安排下一次通知。通知还支持图片、链接和操作按钮。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，计划的 Alarmee 通知及其重复提醒将不再显示。

en.description: When an Alarmee Firebase push includes a title and message, this service displays it as a notification and can include a link into the app.
en.disableEffect: Firebase push notifications handled by Alarmee will stop appearing on the device.

zh-CN.description: Alarmee 收到包含标题和正文的 Firebase 推送时，此 Service 会将其显示为通知，也可附带指向应用内容的链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，由 Alarmee 处理的 Firebase 推送将不再显示在设备上。

en.description: When the app initializes Twilio voice calling, this service starts the call and media managers and makes them available to the app.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, the app cannot initialize the Twilio calling client, so voice calls that use it will fail.

zh-CN.description: 应用初始化 Twilio 语音通话时，此服务会启动通话和媒体管理功能，并提供给应用使用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用无法初始化 Twilio 通话客户端，依赖它的语音通话将无法使用。

en.description: The Moonlight Treasure Box ANR-monitor app opens this screen from its app icon. It lists saved app-hang reports, newest first, and opens a report's analysis when tapped.
en.disableEffect: Users lose the main report list and cannot open saved ANR reports.

zh-CN.description: Moonlight Treasure Box 应用从桌面图标启动后会显示此页面，按时间倒序列出已保存的应用无响应报告。点按报告可查看分析内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法查看报告列表或打开已保存的应用无响应报告。

en.description: In Moonlight Treasure Box, tapping a saved ANR report opens this screen with the captured main-thread stack, message-queue sample, and scheduling details.
en.disableEffect: Users can no longer inspect the details of a saved ANR report.

zh-CN.description: 在 Moonlight Treasure Box 中，点按已保存的应用无响应报告会打开此页面，显示主线程堆栈、消息队列记录和任务调度信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法查看已保存报告的详细信息。

en.description: JustinWjq’s video presentation SDK starts this foreground service when screen sharing begins; Android shows an ongoing notification while the screen-sharing work runs.
en.disableEffect: Screen sharing during a video session may fail if this service cannot start.

zh-CN.description: JustinWjq 的视频展业 SDK 在开始共享屏幕时会启动此前台服务；屏幕共享期间，Android 会显示持续通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，视频会话中的屏幕共享可能无法启动。

en.description: JustinWjq’s video SDK opens this brief permission screen to request camera, microphone, and other runtime permissions or take the user to special Android permission settings.
en.disableEffect: The SDK may be unable to request required permissions, so camera, microphone, or overlay features in a meeting can fail.

zh-CN.description: JustinWjq 的视频 SDK 会短暂打开此权限界面，以申请相机、麦克风等运行时权限，或带用户前往 Android 的特殊权限设置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，SDK 可能无法申请所需权限，会议中的相机、麦克风或悬浮窗功能可能无法使用。

en.description: JustinWjq’s video presentation SDK opens this screen from a meeting to show the shared Tencent Cloud TEduBoard whiteboard and its drawing, erasing, text, and zoom controls.
en.disableEffect: Users can no longer open or use the meeting’s shared whiteboard.

zh-CN.description: JustinWjq 的视频展业 SDK 会在会议中打开此界面，显示腾讯云 TEduBoard 共享白板以及绘画、擦除、文字和缩放工具。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法打开或使用会议中的共享白板。

en.description: JustinWjq’s video presentation SDK opens this screen for a live room built on Tencent Cloud TRTC; participants can manage audio and video, share a screen, and open the shared whiteboard.
en.disableEffect: The app’s live video meeting and its in-call sharing controls cannot be used.

zh-CN.description: JustinWjq 的视频展业 SDK 会为基于腾讯云 TRTC 的直播间打开此界面；参与者可管理音视频、共享屏幕并打开共享白板。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用的实时视频会议及会议中的共享功能将无法使用。

en.description: When the app's uncaught-exception handler catches a crash, this screen shows the error report and lets the user dismiss it or prepare an email with the report.
en.disableEffect: The app will still close after an uncaught crash, but this report screen and its email option will be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: 应用的未捕获异常处理器发现崩溃后，这个界面会显示错误报告，并允许用户关闭它或用邮件发送报告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用发生未捕获崩溃后仍会退出，但不会再显示这份报告或提供邮件发送选项。

en.description: The Uber Core Android SDK opens this screen to sign in or authorize a session, using Uber's web sign-in page and handling the returned token or error.
en.disableEffect: Uber sign-in and authorization flows in the app will fail.

zh-CN.description: Uber Core Android SDK 会打开此界面供用户登录或授权，并处理网页登录返回的令牌或错误。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用中的 Uber 登录和授权流程将无法完成。

en.description: The Uber Core Android SDK receives the browser's sign-in redirect here and returns it to the login screen for completion.
en.disableEffect: Browser-based Uber sign-in cannot return to the app to finish.

zh-CN.description: 浏览器完成 Uber 登录后，会将结果返回到此界面，再交给登录界面完成授权。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过浏览器进行的 Uber 登录将无法返回应用并完成授权。

en.description: The Uber Rides SDK opens a ride request screen, checks location permission, signs in when needed, and loads ride options.
en.disableEffect: The app's Uber ride request feature will not open or complete.

zh-CN.description: Uber Rides SDK 会打开叫车界面、检查定位权限，并在需要时登录后加载可选行程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用中的 Uber 叫车功能将无法打开或完成。

en.description: The Uber Authentication SDK starts a sign-in session in a browser tab and processes the returned authorization code or error.
en.disableEffect: The app's Uber authentication flow will not complete.

zh-CN.description: Uber Authentication SDK 会在浏览器标签页中启动登录，并处理返回的授权码或错误。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用中的 Uber 身份验证流程将无法完成。

en.description: This Uber Authentication SDK screen receives the browser's sign-in redirect and sends it back to the sign-in screen for processing.
en.disableEffect: The browser-based Uber authentication flow cannot return to the app to finish.

zh-CN.description: 此界面接收浏览器返回的 Uber 登录结果，并将结果交回登录界面处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过浏览器进行的 Uber 身份验证将无法返回应用并完成。

en.description: Fast Android Notification runs this receiver when a user dismisses or taps one of its notifications, presses an action button, or sends a quick reply; it updates notification state and forwards the action to the app.
en.disableEffect: Taps, action buttons, and quick replies on notifications created by this library may stop working.

zh-CN.description: 用户关闭或点击 Fast Android Notification 创建的通知、按下操作按钮或发送快捷回复时，此接收器会更新通知状态并把操作传给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，此库创建的通知可能无法响应点击、操作按钮或快捷回复。

en.description: Fast Android Notification's test screen lets users try its notification styles; opening it also starts the library's test service, which posts a sample notification.
en.disableEffect: The Fast Android Notification test screen can no longer be opened.

zh-CN.description: Fast Android Notification 的测试界面可用于试用不同的通知样式；打开时还会启动此库的测试服务并显示一条示例通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，无法打开 Fast Android Notification 的测试界面。

en.description: Fast Android Notification's sample notification opens this test page when its first sample destination is selected.
en.disableEffect: The sample notification's first test destination will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择 Fast Android Notification 示例通知的第一个示例入口时，会打开此测试页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，示例通知的第一个测试入口将无法打开。

en.description: Fast Android Notification uses this test page as a destination in its sample notification navigation.
en.disableEffect: The sample notification's second test destination will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: Fast Android Notification 会将此测试页面用作示例通知导航中的一个目标页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，示例通知的第二个测试入口将无法打开。

en.description: Fast Android Notification starts this test service from its sample screen; the service posts a sample notification when it starts.
en.disableEffect: The test service's sample notification will no longer be posted.

zh-CN.description: Fast Android Notification 会从示例界面启动此测试服务；服务启动后会显示一条示例通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，测试服务将不再显示示例通知。

en.description: When an Umeng Push notification is tapped or dismissed, this receiver opens the app or tells its configured handler about the action and records the event.
en.disableEffect: Tapping or dismissing Umeng push notifications will no longer trigger the app's configured handler through this receiver.

zh-CN.description: 用户点开或关闭友盟推送通知时，此接收器会打开应用，或将操作交给应用设置的处理程序，并记录该事件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户点开或关闭友盟推送通知时，应用设置的处理程序将无法通过此接收器收到操作。

en.description: When Umeng Push hands off a notification event, Android routes it through this exported Activity alias to a translucent handler that reports the event and calls the app's notification callback.
en.disableEffect: Umeng Push notification events and callbacks will no longer reach the app through this entry; the app's other features continue to work.

zh-CN.description: 友盟推送转交通知事件时，Android 会通过此 Activity 别名打开半透明的处理页面；页面会报告事件并调用应用注册的通知回调。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，友盟推送的通知事件和回调将无法通过此入口送达；应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: When a push message includes downloadable media, Umeng Push fetches and caches those files here, then shows the notification when they are ready.
en.disableEffect: Media-rich Umeng push notifications may appear without their downloaded images or other resources.

zh-CN.description: 推送消息包含需要下载的媒体内容时，友盟推送会在此获取并缓存文件，准备好后再显示通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 包含媒体内容的友盟推送通知可能不会显示下载的图片或其他资源。

en.description: When Umeng Push receives a message, this service forwards it to the app's push handler or starts a service requested by the message.
en.disableEffect: Umeng push messages will not be processed by this service.

zh-CN.description: 友盟推送收到消息后，此服务会将消息交给应用的推送处理程序，或启动消息指定的服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 此服务将无法处理友盟推送消息。

en.description: Umeng Push uses this background service to report registration and enable or disable results and to deliver incoming messages to the app's configured handler.
en.disableEffect: Push registration results and configured message callbacks will not be delivered through this service.

zh-CN.description: 友盟推送会通过此后台服务报告注册和启用或停用结果，并将收到的消息交给应用设置的处理程序。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 推送注册结果和应用设置的消息回调将无法通过此服务送达。

en.description: When Umeng's push message receiver action arrives, this service hands the message to Umeng's message processing service.
en.disableEffect: Messages arriving through this Umeng push route will not reach its message processing service.

zh-CN.description: 收到友盟推送的消息广播时，此服务会将消息交给友盟的消息处理服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过此友盟推送路径到达的消息将无法交给消息处理服务。

en.description: When Umeng Push receives a message through Xiaomi's channel, this service passes it through Umeng's standard push-message handling.
en.disableEffect: Umeng push messages arriving through Xiaomi's channel will not be processed by this service.

zh-CN.description: 友盟推送通过小米通道收到消息时，此服务会使用友盟的常规推送处理流程处理消息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过小米通道到达的友盟推送消息将无法由此服务处理。

en.description: When Umeng Agoo delivers a push notification, this Service records its arrival and sends regular messages to Umeng Push for delivery to the app; ad messages go to the SDK's ad handler.
en.disableEffect: Umeng Agoo messages will no longer be processed or delivered by Umeng Push; the app's other features continue to work.

zh-CN.description: 友盟 Agoo 收到推送通知后，此 Service 会记录消息到达，并将普通消息交给友盟推送发送给应用；广告消息则交由 SDK 的广告处理流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，友盟 Agoo 消息将无法由友盟推送处理或送达；应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: When Umeng Push queues a new message, registration result, or push-setting result, this background Service sends it to the app's registered handler or callback.
en.disableEffect: Umeng Push messages and registration or setting results will no longer reach the app's callbacks; the app's other features continue to work.

zh-CN.description: 友盟推送将新消息、注册结果或推送设置结果排入队列时，此后台 Service 会把它们交给应用注册的处理器或回调。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，友盟推送消息以及注册或设置结果将无法送达应用回调；应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: During Umeng Push messaging and in-app messaging, this app-private Provider stores and retrieves notification records, aliases, and in-app-message state.
en.disableEffect: Umeng Push may no longer save or retrieve message history, aliases, or in-app-message state; the app's other features continue to work.

zh-CN.description: 友盟推送处理推送和应用内消息时，会通过此应用私有 Provider 读取和保存通知记录、别名及应用内消息状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，友盟推送可能无法保存或读取消息记录、别名及应用内消息状态；应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: When Umeng Agoo delivers a message to the app, this Service forwards it to Umeng Push's message-processing service.
en.disableEffect: Umeng Agoo messages will no longer be handed to Umeng Push for processing; the app's other features continue to work.

zh-CN.description: 友盟 Agoo 将消息交给应用时，此 Service 会把消息转交给友盟推送的消息处理服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，友盟 Agoo 消息将无法交给友盟推送处理；应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: When a user taps an Umeng Push notification, this short-lived Activity records the tap and invokes the app's registered notification-click handler.
en.disableEffect: Tapping an Umeng Push notification will no longer reach the app's message handler; the app's other features continue to work.

zh-CN.description: 用户点按友盟推送通知时，此短暂显示的 Activity 会记录点按，并调用应用注册的通知点按处理器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，点按友盟推送通知将无法触发应用的消息处理流程；应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: When a user dismisses an Umeng Push notification, this Receiver records the dismissal and sends the dismissed message to the app's notification handler.
en.disableEffect: Umeng Push notification-dismissal events and their callbacks will stop being processed; the app's other features continue to work.

zh-CN.description: 用户清除友盟推送通知时，此 Receiver 会记录清除事件，并将已清除的消息交给应用的通知处理器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，友盟推送通知的清除事件及其回调将无法处理；应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: When Umeng Push hands a notification event to the app, this translucent Activity reads its data, reports the event, and calls the app's notification callback before closing.
en.disableEffect: Umeng Push notification handoffs and related callbacks will no longer be processed; the app's other features continue to work.

zh-CN.description: 友盟推送将通知事件交给应用时，此半透明 Activity 会读取通知数据、上报事件并调用应用注册的通知回调，随后关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，友盟推送的通知转交及相关回调将无法处理；应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: Umeng Push stores and retrieves push messages, temporary messages, settings, and delivery records through this private provider.
en.disableEffect: Umeng Push can no longer access these stored messages and records.

zh-CN.description: 友盟推送通过此私有数据提供程序存取推送消息、临时消息、设置和送达记录。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 友盟推送将无法再访问这些已存储的消息和记录。

en.description: Umeng Social's Sina Weibo integration submits the shared message to Weibo and returns success, cancellation, or failure to the app.
en.disableEffect: Sina Weibo sharing through Umeng Social will fail or return no result.

zh-CN.description: 友盟社交分享的新浪微博集成会提交分享内容，并将成功、取消或失败结果返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过友盟社交分享进行的新浪微博分享将失败或无法返回结果。

en.description: When the Umeng Union ad SDK starts an internal ad handoff, this short-lived Activity passes the ad details to the SDK's ad flow and closes.
en.disableEffect: Some Umeng Union ad handoffs will stop opening or being recorded; the app's other features continue to work.

zh-CN.description: 友盟 Union 广告 SDK 发起内部广告跳转时，此短暂显示的 Activity 会把广告信息交给 SDK 处理，然后关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，部分友盟 Union 广告跳转将无法打开或记录；应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: When an Umeng Union ad notification is marked as ignored, this Receiver forwards its data to the ad SDK for tracking.
en.disableEffect: Umeng Union will stop processing these ad-notification events; the app's other features continue to work.

zh-CN.description: 友盟 Union 广告通知被标记为忽略时，此 Receiver 会将通知数据交给广告 SDK 记录。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，友盟 Union 将无法处理这些广告通知事件；应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: Android creates this Provider during app startup; it initializes Umeng Union's local state and supplies saved ad settings and app values to the SDK's own components.
en.disableEffect: Umeng Union ad components may lose access to their saved settings and identifiers, so ad loading or reporting can fail; the app's other features continue to work.

zh-CN.description: Android 在应用启动时创建此 Provider；它为友盟 Union 设置本地状态，并向 SDK 内部组件提供已保存的广告设置和应用信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，友盟 Union 广告组件可能无法读取已保存的设置和标识，导致广告加载或上报失败；应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: When a user opens an Umeng Union ad link, this Activity loads the ad page inside the app and reports the interaction to the SDK.
en.disableEffect: Umeng Union ad links will no longer open in the app; the app's other features continue to work.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开友盟 Union 广告链接时，此 Activity 会在应用内加载广告网页并向 SDK 报告互动情况。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，友盟 Union 广告链接将无法在应用内打开；应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: When Umeng Union's download system reports a status change, this Receiver looks up the matching ad download and updates its state.
en.disableEffect: Umeng Union ad downloads may stop updating or resuming correctly; the app's other features continue to work.

zh-CN.description: 友盟 Union 下载系统报告下载状态变化时，此 Receiver 会查找对应的广告下载并更新状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，友盟 Union 广告下载可能无法正确更新或继续；应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: When an Umeng Union ad offers an app, this Activity shows its details, permissions, and privacy links; its download button starts the app download.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to view or start app downloads offered by Umeng Union ads; the app's other features continue to work.

zh-CN.description: 友盟 Union 广告展示可下载应用时，此 Activity 会显示应用详情、权限和隐私政策链接；用户点按下载后会开始下载。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法查看或下载友盟 Union 广告推荐的应用；应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: When an Umeng Union download is ready to install but Android requires installation permission, this Activity shows the permission prompt and continues the installer flow after the user responds.
en.disableEffect: Users may be unable to grant installation permission and continue installing apps downloaded from Umeng Union ads; the app's other features continue to work.

zh-CN.description: 友盟 Union 下载的应用准备安装但 Android 要求先授权时，此 Activity 会显示授权提示，并在用户响应后继续安装流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户可能无法授予安装权限并继续安装友盟 Union 广告下载的应用；应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: When a user opens an Umeng Union app-download page, this Activity displays app details, permission and privacy links, and download or install controls.
en.disableEffect: Users will lose the app details and download or install controls for Umeng Union ads; the app's other features continue to work.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开友盟 Union 应用下载页面时，此 Activity 会展示应用详情、权限和隐私政策链接，以及下载或安装选项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法使用友盟 Union 广告中的应用详情及下载或安装选项；应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: When a user taps an Umeng Union download notification, this Activity checks the download status and opens the downloaded app package for installation when it is ready.
en.disableEffect: Tapping an Umeng Union download notification will no longer open the installer for the downloaded app; the app's other features continue to work.

zh-CN.description: 用户点按友盟 Union 下载通知时，此 Activity 会检查下载状态；文件就绪后会打开 Android 安装程序。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，点按友盟 Union 下载通知将无法打开下载应用的安装程序；应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: When Umeng Union's download system sends a status event for an advertised app, this Receiver finds the saved download and updates or resumes it.
en.disableEffect: Umeng Union ad downloads may stop updating or resuming correctly; the app's other features continue to work.

zh-CN.description: 友盟 Union 下载系统发送广告应用的状态事件时，此 Receiver 会查找已保存的下载并更新或继续下载。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，友盟 Union 广告下载可能无法正确更新或继续；应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: When the app requests an Umeng Union rewarded ad, this full-screen Activity plays the reward video and reports whether the viewing task completes or closes.
en.disableEffect: These rewarded ads will stop playing, and users will no longer receive rewards for watching them.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求友盟 Union 激励广告时，此全屏 Activity 会播放奖励视频，并向应用报告观看任务完成或关闭情况。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，这些激励广告将无法播放，用户也不会再获得观看广告的奖励。

en.description: When the app requests a landscape rewarded ad, Umeng Union shows this full-screen video screen and reports whether the viewing task completes or closes.
en.disableEffect: These rewarded ads will stop playing, and users will no longer receive rewards for watching them.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求横屏激励广告时，友盟 Union 会显示此全屏视频页面，并报告观看任务是否完成或关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，这些激励广告将无法播放，用户也不会再获得观看广告的奖励。

en.description: When the app requests a portrait rewarded ad, Umeng Union shows this full-screen video screen and reports whether the viewing task completes or closes.
en.disableEffect: These rewarded ads will stop playing, and users will no longer receive rewards for watching them.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求竖屏激励广告时，友盟 Union 会显示此全屏视频页面，并报告观看任务是否完成或关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，这些激励广告将无法播放，用户也不会再获得观看广告的奖励。

en.description: When Umeng Union routes an ad interaction through the app, this short-lived Activity passes the ad data to the SDK's ad flow and closes.
en.disableEffect: Some Umeng Union ad handoffs will stop opening or being recorded; the app's other features continue to work.

zh-CN.description: 友盟 Union 通过应用跳转处理广告互动时，此短暂显示的 Activity 会把广告数据交给 SDK 处理，然后关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，部分友盟 Union 广告跳转将无法打开或记录；应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: Umeng Union uses this FileProvider to share downloaded ad-app files with Android's installer through a temporary file link.
en.disableEffect: Blocking this provider prevents Umeng Union from handing downloaded APKs to Android for installation, so ad-app installs can fail.

zh-CN.description: 友盟 Union 使用此 FileProvider 通过临时文件链接，将下载的广告应用安装包共享给 Android 安装程序。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，友盟 Union 将无法把下载的 APK 交给 Android 安装，广告应用的安装流程可能失败。

en.description: When Android initializes the app's content providers, this Umeng Union Provider sets up the SDK's local ad state and serves saved ad settings and identifiers to its own components.
en.disableEffect: Umeng Union ad components may lose access to saved settings and identifiers, so ad loading or reporting can fail; the app's other features continue to work.

zh-CN.description: Android 初始化应用的 ContentProvider 时，此友盟 Union Provider 会设置 SDK 的本地广告状态，并向内部组件提供已保存的广告设置和标识。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，友盟 Union 广告组件可能无法读取已保存的设置和标识，导致广告加载或上报失败；应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: When Umeng Union sends an internal ad-notification or download-status broadcast, this Receiver updates the related ad event or download record.
en.disableEffect: Umeng Union will stop processing these ad-notification and download-status events; the app's other features continue to work.

zh-CN.description: 友盟 Union 发送内部广告通知或下载状态广播时，此 Receiver 会更新对应的广告事件或下载记录。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，友盟 Union 将无法处理这些广告通知和下载状态事件；应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: When a user opens an Umeng Union ad landing page, this Activity loads the page inside the app and records its view or click events.
en.disableEffect: Umeng Union ad landing pages will no longer open inside the app; the app's other features continue to work.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开友盟 Union 广告落地页时，此 Activity 会在应用内加载网页并记录页面展示或点按事件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，友盟 Union 广告落地页将无法在应用内打开；应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: Umeng Update shows an available app version and lets the user accept, skip, or dismiss the update prompt.
en.disableEffect: The Umeng update prompt will be unavailable, so users cannot choose an update from it.

zh-CN.description: Umeng Update 会显示可用的应用版本，让用户接受、跳过或关闭更新提示。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Umeng 的应用内更新提示将不可用，用户无法通过它选择更新。

en.description: Umeng Update starts this service to download an offered app update, report its progress, and prepare the downloaded file for installation.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot download offered updates through Umeng Update.

zh-CN.description: Umeng Update 会启动此服务下载应用更新包、报告进度，并准备好安装文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用无法通过 Umeng Update 下载应用更新。

en.description: Unblu Mobile SDK opens this screen when a voice or video support call moves into Android’s picture-in-picture view. It keeps the call view available while the user returns to the rest of the app.
en.disableEffect: An Unblu call will no longer continue in the floating picture-in-picture view.

zh-CN.description: Unblu Mobile SDK 会在语音或视频客服通话切换到 Android 悬浮小窗时打开此界面，让用户返回应用其他内容时仍能看到通话画面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Unblu 通话无法继续显示在悬浮小窗中。

en.description: Unblu Mobile SDK opens this camera screen when a user chooses to take a photo or video for a support conversation. It lets the user capture and preview the media before returning it to the conversation.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot capture and attach a new photo or video through Unblu.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择为客服会话拍摄照片或视频时，Unblu Mobile SDK 会打开此相机界面。用户可以拍摄并预览媒体，然后将其交回会话。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过 Unblu 拍摄并附加新的照片或视频。

en.description: Unblu’s call module starts this service with incoming-call details and keeps the call alert in Android’s foreground notification until the call is stopped.
en.disableEffect: Incoming Unblu calls lose the foreground call notification needed to alert and return to the call while the app is in the background.

zh-CN.description: Unblu 通话模块会用来电信息启动此服务，并在 Android 前台通知中保持来电提醒，直到通话服务停止。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用在后台时将无法通过此持续通知提醒用户并返回 Unblu 来电。

en.description: When a user taps Answer or Decline on an Unblu incoming-call notification, this receiver accepts or declines the call and signals the call alert to stop.
en.disableEffect: The Answer and Decline buttons on Unblu call notifications will not respond.

zh-CN.description: 用户点按 Unblu 来电通知中的接听或拒绝时，此接收器会处理对应选择，并通知来电提醒停止。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Unblu 来电通知中的接听和拒绝按钮将无法响应。

en.description: Unblu opens this full-screen screen for an incoming call. It shows the caller’s call controls and lets the user accept the call.
en.disableEffect: Incoming Unblu calls cannot open their full-screen answer screen.

zh-CN.description: Unblu 会在收到来电时打开此全屏界面，显示来电控制项并让用户接听。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Unblu 来电无法打开全屏接听界面。

en.description: Unblu opens this short screen when a user chooses Decline or Ignore on a targeted notification. It sends that choice to Unblu and closes.
en.disableEffect: Decline and Ignore choices on Unblu targeted notifications will not be sent.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Unblu 定向通知中选择拒绝或忽略时，Unblu 会打开此短暂界面，将选择发送给 Unblu 后关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Unblu 定向通知中的拒绝和忽略操作不会发送。

en.description: When an Unblu targeted-notification action arrives, this service reads its action details, sends the matching response, and stops.
en.disableEffect: Actions attached to Unblu targeted notifications will not be processed.

zh-CN.description: 收到 Unblu 定向通知操作时，此服务会读取操作信息、发送对应响应，然后停止。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Unblu 定向通知附带的操作将无法处理。

en.description: Unblu uses this brief screen when it needs to open another screen and receive a result. It returns that screen’s result to Unblu and then closes.
en.disableEffect: Unblu cannot complete flows that need to open another screen and receive its result.

zh-CN.description: Unblu 需要打开另一个界面并接收返回结果时，会短暂使用此界面。它会把对方返回的结果交给 Unblu，然后关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Unblu 无法完成需要打开其他界面并接收返回结果的流程。

en.description: Unblu uses this transparent screen to request Android permissions for SDK features. It sends the permission result back to Unblu when the request finishes.
en.disableEffect: Unblu cannot request or receive permissions through this screen, so permission-dependent features such as camera access will not work.

zh-CN.description: Unblu 会通过此透明界面申请 SDK 功能所需的 Android 权限。申请结束后，它会把权限结果交回 Unblu。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Unblu 无法通过此界面申请或接收权限结果，因此相机等依赖权限的功能无法使用。

en.description: Unblu opens this screen when someone previews a shared file. It displays supported PDF, image, or text pages with zoom and navigation controls.
en.disableEffect: Shared attachments cannot be previewed in an Unblu conversation.

zh-CN.description: 用户预览共享文件时，Unblu 会打开此界面。它可显示支持的 PDF、图片或文本页面，并提供缩放和翻页控制。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法在 Unblu 会话中预览共享附件。

en.description: Unblu uses this screen to preview a file inside its interface. It reads the selected file and displays supported PDF, image, or text content.
en.disableEffect: Files opened for preview inside Unblu will no longer display.

zh-CN.description: Unblu 会在其界面中通过此屏幕预览文件。它读取所选文件，并显示支持的 PDF、图片或文本内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，在 Unblu 中打开预览的文件将无法显示。

en.description: Unblu opens this screen for a PDF attachment and displays the document in its built-in PDF viewer.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open PDF attachments with Unblu’s built-in viewer.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 PDF 附件时，Unblu 会使用此界面在内置 PDF 查看器中显示文档。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法使用 Unblu 内置查看器打开 PDF 附件。

en.description: Unblu uses Android’s file-sharing provider to create shareable links for captured photos and videos and grant the receiving app permission to read them.
en.disableEffect: Captured photos and videos cannot be passed through Unblu’s shared-file link.

zh-CN.description: Unblu 使用 Android 文件共享提供程序为拍摄的照片和视频创建可共享链接，并授权接收应用读取文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，拍摄的照片和视频无法通过 Unblu 的共享文件链接传递。

en.description: Unblu starts this short service when a file is selected in a web-based support form. It keeps the selected file link available to the upload flow.
en.disableEffect: Files selected from Unblu web forms will not remain available to their upload flow.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Unblu 网页客服表单中选择文件时，Unblu 会启动此短时服务。它会在上传流程中保留所选文件的链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Unblu 网页表单中选择的文件无法继续用于上传。

en.description: Unblu runs this foreground service during an active call to keep an ongoing call notification visible and provide a hang-up action.
en.disableEffect: Unblu cannot maintain its ongoing call notification or handle hang-up from that notification.

zh-CN.description: Unblu 会在通话期间运行此前台服务，以持续显示通话通知并提供挂断操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Unblu 无法维持持续通话通知，也无法处理通知中的挂断操作。

en.description: At app startup, Unblu’s Firebase notification module fetches the device’s Firebase push token and registers it with Unblu so its notifications can be delivered.
en.disableEffect: Unblu push messages, including incoming-call and targeted notifications, will stop arriving on this device.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，Unblu 的 Firebase 通知模块会获取设备的 Firebase 推送令牌并注册到 Unblu，以便向此设备发送通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，此设备将不再收到 Unblu 推送，包括来电和定向通知。

en.description: Unflow opens this screen when one of its push notifications carries a screen reference. It sends the selected screen to Unflow for display and then closes.
en.disableEffect: Tapping an Unflow notification will no longer open its linked screen.

zh-CN.description: Unflow 推送通知携带页面信息时会打开此界面。它会将对应页面交给 Unflow 显示，然后关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，点按 Unflow 通知将无法打开其中链接的页面。

en.description: Unflow opens this screen for a selected in-app page and chooses whether to show it full-page or in a modal window. It loads the page and passes it to the chosen presentation.
en.disableEffect: Unflow pages cannot open, including full-page and modal content.

zh-CN.description: Unflow 会为选定的应用内页面打开此界面，并根据页面设置选择全屏或弹窗展示。它会加载页面并交给对应的展示界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Unflow 页面将无法打开，包括全屏内容和弹窗内容。

en.description: Unflow uses this screen to display selected in-app content as a full-page view.
en.disableEffect: Full-page Unflow screens will not open.

zh-CN.description: Unflow 使用此界面将选定的应用内内容以全屏页面形式展示。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Unflow 全屏页面将无法打开。

en.description: Unflow uses this screen to show selected in-app content in a dialog or bottom sheet over the app.
en.disableEffect: Modal Unflow screens will not open.

zh-CN.description: Unflow 使用此界面在应用上方以对话框或底部弹层展示选定的应用内内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Unflow 弹窗页面将无法打开。

en.description: The China Unicom module of MoMo Cosmos OneLogin opens the agreement page requested during one-tap phone sign-in.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot review or accept the carrier agreement in this flow, so Unicom sign-in may not complete.

zh-CN.description: MoMo Cosmos OneLogin 的中国联通模块会打开一键手机号登录流程所请求的运营商协议页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法在此流程中查看或接受运营商协议，因此联通登录可能无法完成。

en.description: The China Unicom module of MoMo Cosmos OneLogin opens a one-tap phone login screen with the phone number and consent controls.
en.disableEffect: China Unicom one-tap phone sign-in will not complete.

zh-CN.description: MoMo Cosmos OneLogin 的中国联通模块会打开一键手机号登录页面，展示手机号和授权控件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 中国联通一键手机号登录将无法完成。

en.description: UnionPay’s UPPay component opens a checkout or payment-related web page inside the app and returns the payment result to the calling flow.
en.disableEffect: UnionPay web checkout pages cannot open or return their payment result.

zh-CN.description: 银联 UPPay 会在应用内打开收银台或支付相关网页，并把支付结果返回给调用流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 银联网页收银台无法打开或返回支付结果。

en.description: UnionPay’s UPPay component presents its in-app payment flow and can continue an NFC card interaction when Android passes a card tag back to it.
en.disableEffect: UnionPay payments that need this in-app screen or its NFC continuation cannot complete.

zh-CN.description: 银联 UPPay 会显示应用内支付流程；安卓返回银行卡 NFC 标签时，它还会继续处理该卡片交互。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要此支付界面或 NFC 后续处理的银联交易将无法完成。

en.description: UniqueXT Basic’s video player opens when the app asks it to preview a video. It plays the supplied video and gives users pause, seek, and playback controls.
en.disableEffect: The app’s video preview screen will not open or play videos.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求预览视频时，UniqueXT Basic 的视频播放器会打开。它播放指定视频，并提供暂停、定位和播放控制。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用的视频预览界面将无法打开或播放视频。

en.description: UniqueXT Basic’s image viewer shows a selected image from a supplied set and lets the user swipe through the images.
en.disableEffect: The app’s image preview and image browsing screen will no longer be available.

zh-CN.description: UniqueXT Basic 的图片查看器会显示所选图片，并允许用户在提供的图片间滑动浏览。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用的图片预览和浏览界面将无法使用。

en.description: Unity Ads starts this service while an ad is playing and uses it to detect when the viewer removes the app task. It records that interruption for ad playback tracking.
en.disableEffect: Unity Ads loses its signal that an ad was dismissed by leaving the app, which can affect whether a rewarded ad is counted as watched.

zh-CN.description: Unity Ads 会在广告播放期间启动此服务，用来检测用户是否通过移除应用任务离开广告，并记录这次中断供广告播放状态使用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Unity Ads 无法获知用户是否通过离开应用关闭广告，这会影响奖励广告是否被计为已观看。

en.description: Unity Ads uses this full-screen screen to host the player for an ad opportunity and apply its display settings.
en.disableEffect: Unity Ads full-screen ads will not open, so users cannot watch rewarded ads or receive their viewing rewards.

zh-CN.description: Unity Ads 使用此全屏界面播放广告，并应用广告要求的显示设置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Unity Ads 全屏广告无法打开，用户也无法观看奖励广告并领取观看奖励。

en.description: Unity Ads opens this screen to display a web or video ad, including rewarded placements.
en.disableEffect: Unity ads will not open, and rewards for watching rewarded ads will no longer be granted; other app features continue to work.

zh-CN.description: Unity Ads 会打开此页面展示网页或视频广告，包括奖励型广告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Unity 广告将无法打开，观看奖励型广告也不再获得奖励；应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: Unity Ads uses this software-rendered version of its ad screen for video and web ads, including rewarded placements.
en.disableEffect: Unity ads using this screen will not open, and rewards for watching rewarded ads will no longer be granted; other app features continue to work.

zh-CN.description: Unity Ads 使用此软件渲染版本的广告页面播放视频或网页广告，包括奖励型广告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 此页面承载的 Unity 广告将无法打开，观看奖励型广告也不再获得奖励；应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: Unity Ads uses this transparent-window version of its ad screen for video and web ads, including rewarded placements.
en.disableEffect: Unity ads using this screen will not open, and rewards for watching rewarded ads will no longer be granted; other app features continue to work.

zh-CN.description: Unity Ads 使用此透明窗口版本的广告页面播放视频或网页广告，包括奖励型广告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 此页面承载的 Unity 广告将无法打开，观看奖励型广告也不再获得奖励；应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: Unity Ads uses this transparent-window, software-rendered version of its ad screen, including for rewarded placements.
en.disableEffect: Unity ads using this screen will not open, and rewards for watching rewarded ads will no longer be granted; other app features continue to work.

zh-CN.description: Unity Ads 使用此透明窗口、软件渲染版本的广告页面，也可用于奖励型广告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 此页面承载的 Unity 广告将无法打开，观看奖励型广告也不再获得奖励；应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: Unity Ads 2, bundled with the Appodeal ad SDK, uses this Activity to display an ad's web and video views full-screen and handle ad playback events.
en.disableEffect: Unity ads will stop displaying, and rewards for watching ads will no longer be granted.

zh-CN.description: Appodeal 广告 SDK 内置的 Unity Ads 2 使用此 Activity 全屏显示广告网页或视频，并处理广告播放事件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Unity 广告将无法显示，观看广告的奖励也将不再发放。

en.description: Unity Ads 2, bundled with the Appodeal ad SDK, uses this Activity as the software-rendered version of its full-screen ad screen.
en.disableEffect: Software-rendered Unity ads will stop displaying, and rewards for watching those ads will no longer be granted.

zh-CN.description: Appodeal 广告 SDK 内置的 Unity Ads 2 使用此 Activity 以软件渲染方式全屏显示广告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 软件渲染的 Unity 广告将无法显示，观看这些广告的奖励也将不再发放。

en.description: Opened by Unity LevelPlay (ironSource) when an ad leads to a store destination, this Activity launches that destination and reports when the user returns.
en.disableEffect: In-app ad store and app-install destinations cannot open through this SDK.

zh-CN.description: Unity LevelPlay（ironSource）广告跳转到应用商店时会打开此页面，由它启动商店页面并在用户返回时报告结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 此 SDK 中的广告商店跳转和应用安装入口将无法打开。

en.description: The Drifter Unity integration by Teogor opens this Activity when the app opens its Unity-based live wallpaper. It displays the Unity scene and passes screen and input changes through so the scene can keep running.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents the app live wallpaper from opening or responding to input.

zh-CN.description: Teogor 的 Drifter Unity 集成会在应用打开基于 Unity 的动态壁纸时启动此 Activity。它会显示 Unity 场景并传递屏幕和输入变化，让场景继续运行。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用的动态壁纸将无法打开或响应输入。

en.description: Unity Ads opens this full-screen Activity to render an ad, such as an interstitial or rewarded video. It hosts the ad content and relays screen events to Unity’s ad player.
en.disableEffect: Unity Ads will not display; users will not receive rewards for watching Unity rewarded ads.

zh-CN.description: Unity Ads 展示插屏或奖励视频时会打开此全屏界面。它承载广告内容，并把界面状态交给 Unity 广告播放器处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 屏蔽后，Unity Ads 将无法显示；观看 Unity 奖励广告也不会获得奖励。

en.description: Unity Ads uses this software-rendered full-screen Activity when it needs to show an ad without hardware acceleration.
en.disableEffect: Unity Ads will not display; users will not receive rewards for watching Unity rewarded ads.

zh-CN.description: Unity Ads 需要以软件方式渲染广告时会使用此全屏界面，不依赖硬件加速。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 屏蔽后，Unity Ads 将无法显示；观看 Unity 奖励广告也不会获得奖励。

en.description: Unity Ads uses this transparent full-screen Activity for ad content that needs a clear background over the app. It passes screen events to Unity’s ad player.
en.disableEffect: Unity Ads will not display; users will not receive rewards for watching Unity rewarded ads.

zh-CN.description: Unity Ads 的广告需要透明背景覆盖在应用上方时会使用此全屏界面。它会把界面状态交给 Unity 广告播放器处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 屏蔽后，Unity Ads 将无法显示；观看 Unity 奖励广告也不会获得奖励。

en.description: Unity Ads uses this transparent, software-rendered full-screen Activity when an ad needs a clear background without hardware acceleration.
en.disableEffect: Unity Ads will not display; users will not receive rewards for watching Unity rewarded ads.

zh-CN.description: Unity Ads 的广告需要透明背景且不能使用硬件加速时会使用此全屏界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 屏蔽后，Unity Ads 将无法显示；观看 Unity 奖励广告也不会获得奖励。

en.description: Univapay’s Android checkout widget opens this screen when the app starts a payment. It loads the enabled payment methods, presents the checkout forms, and sends success or failure results back to the app.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot complete payments through Univapay from the app.

zh-CN.description: 应用发起付款时，Univapay Android 收银台组件会打开此界面。它会加载已启用的付款方式、展示收银台表单，并将成功或失败结果返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法在应用中通过 Univapay 完成付款。

en.description: Unotag MOK opens this screen for an in-app message configured as a full-screen web page. It loads the message’s web address and reports when the user closes it.
en.disableEffect: Full-screen web-based MOK messages will no longer be displayed.

zh-CN.description: Unotag MOK 会为设置成全屏网页的应用内消息打开此界面。它会加载消息网页，并在用户关闭时返回结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，MOK 全屏网页消息将不再显示。

en.description: Unotag MOK opens this screen to display an in-app message as text, an image, HTML, or a web page. It chooses a dialog or bottom-sheet presentation and records when the message is read.
en.disableEffect: MOK in-app messages will no longer appear or update their read status.

zh-CN.description: Unotag MOK 使用此界面展示应用内消息，内容可以是文字、图片、HTML 或网页。它会选择对话框或底部弹层，并记录消息已读状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，MOK 应用内消息将不再显示或更新已读状态。

en.description: Unotag MOK opens this screen to play a video attached to an in-app message in Android’s picture-in-picture view. It keeps the video playing in a floating window and records the message as read.
en.disableEffect: MOK message videos will not continue in a floating window while the user uses another app.

zh-CN.description: Unotag MOK 会使用此界面在 Android 悬浮小窗中播放应用内消息附带的视频，并记录消息已读状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户切换到其他应用时，MOK 消息视频无法继续在悬浮小窗中播放。

en.description: Unotag MOK opens this screen as the full-screen alert for an incoming-call notification. In the analyzed build it displays an empty red screen; the notification’s Answer and Decline buttons use separate actions.
en.disableEffect: An incoming-call notification will no longer open this full-screen alert; its separate notification buttons remain handled elsewhere.

zh-CN.description: Unotag MOK 会将此界面用作来电通知的全屏提醒。在分析的版本中，它只显示空白红色界面；通知中的接听和拒绝按钮由其他操作处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，来电通知将无法打开此全屏提醒；通知按钮仍由独立操作处理。

en.description: Unotag MOK opens this screen when its client asks to show a web link. It loads the supplied address in an in-app browser and displays loading progress.
en.disableEffect: Web links opened through MOK will no longer display inside the app.

zh-CN.description: Unotag MOK 的客户端请求打开网页链接时，会使用此界面在应用内加载该地址，并显示加载进度。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，通过 MOK 打开的网页链接将无法在应用内显示。

en.description: When a user taps an audio attachment in a ChymeBot conversation, the Unvired ChymeBot SDK opens a player with playback controls. The player reads the attachment saved by the chat.
en.disableEffect: Audio attachments shared in ChymeBot conversations can no longer be played in the app.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击ChymeBot对话中的音频附件时，Unvired ChymeBot SDK会打开带播放控件的播放器，并播放聊天中保存的附件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法在应用中播放ChymeBot对话里的音频附件。

en.description: When the user opens a ChymeBot assistant, the Unvired ChymeBot SDK shows any required sign-in fields, requests an assistant session, and opens the conversation after success.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot sign in to or open the ChymeBot assistant conversation through this flow.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开ChymeBot助手时，Unvired ChymeBot SDK会显示所需的登录字段、请求助手会话，并在成功后打开对话。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法通过此流程登录或打开ChymeBot助手对话。

en.description: After a ChymeBot session is ready, the Unvired ChymeBot SDK shows the conversation, sends and receives messages, and lets users attach media or files.
en.disableEffect: The ChymeBot conversation cannot be used in the app.

zh-CN.description: ChymeBot会话准备好后，Unvired ChymeBot SDK会显示对话、收发消息，并允许用户附加媒体或文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法在应用中使用ChymeBot对话。

en.description: When a user opens an image attachment from a ChymeBot conversation, the Unvired ChymeBot SDK displays it in an image viewer that supports zooming.
en.disableEffect: Users can no longer open or zoom image attachments from ChymeBot conversations.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开ChymeBot对话中的图片附件时，Unvired ChymeBot SDK会在支持缩放的图片查看器中显示图片。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法打开或缩放ChymeBot对话中的图片附件。

en.description: When the Unvired ChymeBot assistant opens HTML content in a conversation, this Activity displays the page in an in-app browser. Regular text messages remain in the chat screen.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open this HTML content inside the app.

zh-CN.description: 当Unvired ChymeBot助手在对话中打开HTML内容时，这个Activity会在应用内浏览器中显示页面。普通文字消息仍显示在聊天界面中。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法在应用内打开这类HTML内容。

en.description: When a user opens About from the Unvired Mobile Platform dashboard, this Activity shows application and framework versions, company and support contacts, and credits.
en.disableEffect: Users can no longer view the version and support information in this screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户从Unvired移动平台主页打开“关于”页面时，这个Activity会显示应用和框架版本、公司与支持联系方式以及版权信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法再通过此页面查看版本和支持信息。

en.description: When Unvired needs the user to choose among saved accounts or switch accounts, this Activity lists the accounts and can open the sign-in screen to add another account.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot choose or switch saved Unvired accounts or start the add-account sign-in flow.

zh-CN.description: Unvired需要用户从已保存的账户中进行选择或切换账户时，这个Activity会列出账户，也可打开登录页面添加账户。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法选择或切换已保存的Unvired账户，也无法通过此入口添加账户。

en.description: When a user taps the connection status on the Unvired platform home screen, this Activity shows server, account, and device details and can test the connection.
en.disableEffect: Users lose this connection and device diagnostics screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击Unvired移动平台主页上的连接状态时，这个Activity会显示服务器、账户和设备信息，并可测试连接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法使用此连接和设备诊断页面。

en.description: When Unvired authentication requires a first-use setup choice, this Activity offers demo data or normal setup and continues with the selected login path.
en.disableEffect: The demo or setup authentication path cannot be completed through this screen.

zh-CN.description: Unvired认证需要用户选择首次配置方式时，这个Activity会提供演示数据或常规设置，并按所选方式继续登录。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法通过此页面完成演示或常规设置登录流程。

en.description: When Unvired cannot read the application database, this Activity asks the user to confirm a reset of local application data.
en.disableEffect: The database recovery prompt cannot be shown, so this flow cannot reset the unreadable local application data.

zh-CN.description: Unvired无法读取应用数据库时，这个Activity会提示用户确认重置本地应用数据。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用无法显示数据库恢复提示，因此无法通过此流程重置无法读取的本地数据。

en.description: The Unvired Mobile Platform Home Activity displays connection and synchronization status, pending message counts, and controls for accounts, system credentials, information messages, logs, and settings.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it removes the Unvired dashboard and its account, credential, synchronization, and troubleshooting controls.

zh-CN.description: Unvired移动平台主页会显示连接和同步状态、待处理消息数量，并提供账户、系统凭据、信息消息、日志和设置入口。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Unvired主页及其账户、凭据、同步和故障排查入口将无法使用。

en.description: After a user selects a server information notice from the Unvired message list, this Activity shows its date, related business item, category, and full message.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot read the selected server notice in detail.

zh-CN.description: 用户从Unvired信息消息列表中选择服务器通知后，这个Activity会显示日期、相关业务对象、类别和完整内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法查看所选服务器通知的详细内容。

en.description: When a user opens Messages from the Unvired Home screen, this Activity lists saved server information notices and lets users open or delete them.
en.disableEffect: Users can no longer read or clear server information notices from the platform screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户从Unvired主页打开“消息”时，这个Activity会列出已保存的服务器信息通知，并允许用户查看或删除通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法再通过平台页面查看或清除服务器信息通知。

en.description: When a user opens Logs from the Unvired Home screen, this Activity displays captured platform logs and provides search, refresh, delete, and sharing options for troubleshooting.
en.disableEffect: Users lose the in-app log review and sharing tools used for troubleshooting.

zh-CN.description: 用户从Unvired主页打开“日志”时，这个Activity会显示平台记录的日志，并提供搜索、刷新、删除和分享等故障排查功能。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法使用应用内的日志查看和分享工具进行故障排查。

en.description: When Unvired requires sign-in or account activation, this Activity collects server and account credentials, offers supported login choices, and starts authentication.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot complete the Unvired built-in sign-in or account-activation flow.

zh-CN.description: Unvired需要登录或激活账户时，这个Activity会收集服务器和账户凭据、提供支持的登录方式并启动认证。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法完成Unvired内置的登录或账户激活流程。

en.description: When an existing Unvired account requires local re-authentication, this Activity asks for credentials and validates them to reopen the saved application data.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot unlock the existing account through Unvired local sign-in.

zh-CN.description: 现有Unvired账户需要本地重新认证时，这个Activity会要求用户输入凭据，并验证后重新打开已保存的应用数据。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法通过Unvired本地登录解锁现有账户。

en.description: When the user chooses single sign-on from Unvired login, this Activity opens the sign-in page in a browser view and returns the resulting login token to the app.
en.disableEffect: Unvired single sign-on cannot finish, which can prevent users from logging in through that option.

zh-CN.description: 用户在Unvired登录页面选择单点登录时，这个Activity会在浏览器页面中打开登录页面，并将返回的登录令牌交给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Unvired单点登录无法完成，用户可能无法通过此方式登录。

en.description: When Unvired receives a server or authentication error, this Activity displays the message and can ask the user to update a password or authenticate again before retrying.
en.disableEffect: Server-error recovery and password re-authentication cannot complete through the Unvired screen.

zh-CN.description: Unvired收到服务器或认证错误时，这个Activity会显示错误信息，并可要求用户修改密码或重新认证后重试。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法通过Unvired页面完成服务器错误恢复或密码重新认证。

en.description: When a user opens a saved backend-system credential from Unvired settings, this Activity shows its account and system details, tests the connection, and saves changes.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot test or update that backend-system credential in the app.

zh-CN.description: 用户从Unvired设置中打开已保存的后端系统凭据时，这个Activity会显示账户和系统信息、测试连接并保存修改。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法在应用中测试或更新此后端系统凭据。

en.description: When a user opens system credentials from the Unvired Home screen, this Activity loads saved backend-system credentials and lets the user select an entry to inspect or edit.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot access saved backend-system credentials through this list.

zh-CN.description: 用户从Unvired主页打开系统凭据时，这个Activity会加载已保存的后端系统凭据，并允许用户选择条目查看或编辑。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法通过此列表访问已保存的后端系统凭据。

en.description: When Unvired detects that an application or framework database version needs upgrading, this Activity migrates the local data and can offer a reset if the upgrade fails.
en.disableEffect: A required local database upgrade may not finish, blocking this Unvired startup flow.

zh-CN.description: Unvired检测到应用或框架数据库版本需要升级时，这个Activity会迁移本地数据，并可在升级失败时提供重置选项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 必需的本地数据库升级可能无法完成，从而阻断Unvired启动流程。

en.description: After sign-in starts a token or device-verification step, this Activity waits for the result, completes authentication, and returns to login if the token expires.
en.disableEffect: Token-based Unvired sign-in cannot finish or recover from expiration through this flow.

zh-CN.description: 登录启动令牌或设备验证步骤后，这个Activity会等待验证结果、完成认证，并在令牌过期时返回登录页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 基于令牌的Unvired登录无法通过此流程完成或处理令牌过期。

en.description: When started, the UpAxis install-tracking SDK published by Dinesh Scaletech and Surfant Media periodically sends its configured user-tracking event to a server.
en.disableEffect: UpAxis tracking reports stop; the host app's ordinary screens and features remain available.

zh-CN.description: 启动后，由 Dinesh Scaletech 和 Surfant Media 发布的 UpAxis 安装跟踪 SDK 会定期向服务器发送已配置的用户跟踪事件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: UpAxis 跟踪报告会停止，宿主应用的普通界面和功能仍可使用。

en.description: When an app launches the Uploadcare file widget, this Activity hosts the picker where users choose local or social files and start uploads to Uploadcare.
en.disableEffect: Apps using the Uploadcare widget cannot open its file-selection and upload interface.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开Uploadcare文件组件时，这个Activity会承载文件选择页面，用户可选择本地或社交来源的文件并开始上传到Uploadcare。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用Uploadcare组件的应用无法打开文件选择和上传界面。

en.description: At app startup, this Uploadcare provider initializes the widget client and context so the file picker and upload flow can be used.
en.disableEffect: Apps relying on this provider will not get the widget startup initialization required for its file-selection and upload flow.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，这个Uploadcare Provider会初始化组件客户端和运行环境，以便使用文件选择和上传流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此Provider的应用将无法获得文件选择和上传流程所需的组件启动初始化。
