en.description: In Uploadcare widget versions that include it, this provider initializes the widget and its background-work scheduler at app startup so queued uploads can run.
en.disableEffect: Queued Uploadcare uploads cannot use the scheduler configured by this provider.

zh-CN.description: 在包含此组件的Uploadcare组件版本中，应用启动时这个Provider会初始化组件和后台任务调度器，以便处理排队的上传任务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 排队中的Uploadcare上传任务无法使用此Provider配置的调度器。

en.description: Airship's Accengage integration receives the system notice after the app is replaced by an update. This receiver only records that the app was updated.
en.disableEffect: The update log is omitted; other app features are unaffected.

zh-CN.description: Airship 的 Accengage 集成会在应用更新安装后接收系统通知。该接收器只记录应用已更新。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后不会记录这条更新信息，应用的其他功能不受影响。

en.description: Airship's optional rate-app action opens the Google Play in-app review flow when requested, or shows a rating dialog when that flow is unavailable.
en.disableEffect: Airship's optional app-rating prompt will no longer appear.

zh-CN.description: Airship 的可选评分操作会在收到请求时打开 Google Play 应用内评价流程；无法使用该流程时会显示评分对话框。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Airship 将无法再显示可选的应用评分提示。

en.description: Airship's wallet-link screen receives a wallet URL, follows its redirect, and opens the destination in a browser.
en.disableEffect: Airship wallet links will not be resolved or opened.

zh-CN.description: Airship 的钱包链接页面接收钱包网址，获取其重定向地址后在浏览器中打开目的页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Airship 钱包链接将无法解析或打开。

en.description: Airship Layout opens this screen to render a modal in-app message with its content and controls.
en.disableEffect: Airship Layout modal messages will not be displayed.

zh-CN.description: Airship Layout 会打开此页面，呈现模态应用内消息及其操作控件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Airship Layout 的模态应用内消息将不会显示。

en.description: Airship Chat opens this screen for an in-app support conversation and loads any supplied draft message.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to open the app's Airship support chat.

zh-CN.description: Airship Chat 会在应用打开内嵌客服对话时加载聊天界面，并可带入已有的草稿内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开应用内的 Airship 客服聊天。

en.description: Airship's Gimbal Adapter responds when Airship is ready, restores previously enabled Gimbal beacon monitoring, and updates device information when the Airship channel is created.
en.disableEffect: Gimbal monitoring and its Airship channel updates will not be restored automatically.

zh-CN.description: Airship 的 Gimbal Adapter 会在 Airship 就绪后恢复此前启用的 Gimbal 信标监测，并在 Airship 渠道创建时更新设备信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Gimbal 监测及其 Airship 渠道信息将无法自动恢复或更新。

en.description: When an Airship channel update arrives, the Gimbal Adapter updates the device attributes used by Gimbal's location-targeting features.
en.disableEffect: Gimbal device attributes will no longer be updated from Airship channel changes.

zh-CN.description: Airship 渠道更新到达时，Gimbal Adapter 会更新 Gimbal 位置定向功能使用的设备属性。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Gimbal 设备属性将不再随 Airship 渠道变化而更新。

en.description: When Airship detects a Google Play services problem, this screen checks for a fix and offers a recovery prompt when possible. After a successful fix, Airship refreshes push registration.
en.disableEffect: Users will not get Airship's repair prompt, so Google push may remain unavailable.

zh-CN.description: Airship 检测到 Google Play 服务异常时，此页面会检查问题并在可恢复时提示用户修复；修复成功后会刷新推送注册。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将看不到 Airship 的修复提示，Google 推送可能仍无法使用。

en.description: Airship Automation uses this full-screen page for in-app messages containing text, media, and buttons.
en.disableEffect: Airship full-screen in-app messages will not appear.

zh-CN.description: Airship Automation 使用此全屏页面展示包含文字、媒体和按钮的应用内消息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Airship 全屏应用内消息将不会显示。

en.description: Airship Automation uses this screen to show an HTML in-app message and handle its links and close action.
en.disableEffect: Airship HTML in-app messages will not appear or respond to their links.

zh-CN.description: Airship Automation 使用此页面展示网页形式的应用内消息，并处理其中的链接和关闭操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Airship 网页形式的应用内消息将无法显示或响应其中的链接。

en.description: Airship Automation uses this screen to show a modal in-app message with its text, media, and buttons.
en.disableEffect: Airship modal in-app messages will not appear.

zh-CN.description: Airship Automation 使用此页面展示包含文字、媒体和按钮的模态应用内消息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Airship 模态应用内消息将不会显示。

en.description: When a user dismisses an Airship Live Update notification, this receiver ends that update and forwards the notification's delete action.
en.disableEffect: A dismissed Live Update may not be stopped cleanly, and its notification delete action may not run.

zh-CN.description: 用户关闭 Airship Live Update 通知时，此接收器会结束对应更新并继续执行通知的删除操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 关闭 Live Update 通知后，对应更新可能无法正常结束，通知的删除操作也可能不会执行。

en.description: When the device language changes, Airship refreshes its locale so its own messages can use the updated language.
en.disableEffect: Airship will not refresh its locale after a device-language change.

zh-CN.description: 设备语言改变时，Airship 会刷新自身的语言设置，以便消息使用更新后的语言。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 设备语言改变后，Airship 将不会刷新自身的语言设置。

en.description: Airship's location module processes system location updates and provider changes for Airship location features.
en.disableEffect: Airship location updates and location-based targeting will stop.

zh-CN.description: Airship 的定位模块会处理系统位置更新和定位服务状态变化，供 Airship 定位功能使用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Airship 的位置更新和基于位置的定向功能将停止。

en.description: Airship Message Center opens this screen to display a selected inbox message.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to open individual messages from Airship's inbox.

zh-CN.description: Airship Message Center 会打开此页面，显示用户选择的收件箱消息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开 Airship 收件箱中的单条消息。

en.description: Airship Message Center opens its inbox here and can display a selected message.
en.disableEffect: The Airship message inbox will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: Airship Message Center 会在此页面打开消息收件箱，也可直接显示选中的消息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Airship 消息收件箱将无法打开。

en.description: Airship uses this screen to request an Android permission and return the user's choice to the app.
en.disableEffect: Airship permission requests may fail or no longer show a prompt.

zh-CN.description: Airship 使用此页面请求 Android 权限，并将用户的选择返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Airship 的权限请求可能失败或不再显示提示。

en.description: Airship opens this screen so users can review or change their message preferences.
en.disableEffect: Users will no longer be able to open Airship's preference center to manage message choices.

zh-CN.description: Airship 会打开此页面，让用户查看或更改消息偏好设置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开 Airship 偏好中心来管理消息选项。

en.description: When a user opens an Airship push notification or chooses one of its actions, this screen processes the selection and routes the requested app action.
en.disableEffect: Airship notification taps and actions will no longer be processed through this screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 Airship 推送通知或选择其中的操作时，此页面会处理该选择并转到相应的应用操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Airship 推送通知的点击和操作将无法通过此页面处理。

en.description: When an Airship notification action is received, this receiver processes it in the background and completes the notification event.
en.disableEffect: Background processing of Airship notification actions will stop.

zh-CN.description: 收到 Airship 通知操作时，此接收器会在后台处理并完成相应的通知事件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Airship 通知操作的后台处理将停止。

en.description: When Amazon Device Messaging delivers an Airship push or registration update, this service passes it to Airship.
en.disableEffect: Airship will stop receiving Amazon Device Messaging pushes and registration updates through this service.

zh-CN.description: Amazon Device Messaging 投递 Airship 推送或注册信息更新时，此服务会将其交给 Airship 处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Airship 将无法通过此服务接收 Amazon Device Messaging 推送和注册信息更新。

en.description: When Amazon Device Messaging delivers an Airship push or registration update, this job service passes it to Airship.
en.disableEffect: Airship will stop receiving Amazon Device Messaging pushes and registration updates through this service.

zh-CN.description: Amazon Device Messaging 投递 Airship 推送或注册信息更新时，此任务服务会将其交给 Airship 处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Airship 将无法通过此服务接收 Amazon Device Messaging 推送和注册信息更新。

en.description: This Airship receiver accepts Amazon Device Messaging registration and push broadcasts and connects them to Airship's push handling.
en.disableEffect: Airship pushes delivered through Amazon Device Messaging will stop working.

zh-CN.description: 此 Airship 接收器接收 Amazon Device Messaging 的注册和推送广播，并将其交由 Airship 处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过 Amazon Device Messaging 投递的 Airship 推送将停止工作。

en.description: When Firebase delivers a push message or refreshes its token, Airship forwards the message or token update to the app.
en.disableEffect: The app will stop receiving Airship messages and token updates through Firebase.

zh-CN.description: Firebase 投递推送消息或刷新令牌时，Airship 会将消息或令牌更新转交给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法再通过 Firebase 接收 Airship 消息和令牌更新。

en.description: This Airship receiver handles Google Cloud Messaging deliveries and registration events, forwarding push messages and token changes to Airship.
en.disableEffect: Airship pushes and registration updates through Google Cloud Messaging will stop.

zh-CN.description: 此 Airship 接收器处理 Google Cloud Messaging 的投递和注册事件，并将推送消息及令牌变化转交给 Airship。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过 Google Cloud Messaging 投递的 Airship 推送和注册更新将停止。

en.description: When Google Cloud Messaging refreshes an app token, this Airship service receives the refresh event for its push integration.
en.disableEffect: Airship's Google Cloud Messaging integration may not respond to token refreshes.

zh-CN.description: Google Cloud Messaging 刷新应用令牌时，此 Airship 服务会接收该事件，供推送集成处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Airship 的 Google Cloud Messaging 集成可能无法响应令牌刷新。

en.description: When Huawei Push Kit delivers a push message or refreshes its token, Airship forwards the message or token update to the app.
en.disableEffect: The app will stop receiving Airship messages and token updates through Huawei Push Kit.

zh-CN.description: Huawei Push Kit 投递推送消息或刷新令牌时，Airship 会将消息或令牌更新转交给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法再通过 Huawei Push Kit 接收 Airship 消息和令牌更新。

en.description: When Urbanbase UBUser starts a social sign-in, this screen offers Google and Facebook login and handles the return from the provider, sending the sign-in token back to UBUser.
en.disableEffect: The app's UBUser social login and authentication return flow will fail.

zh-CN.description: Urbanbase UBUser 启动社交登录时，此页面提供 Google 和 Facebook 登录，并处理登录后的返回结果，将登录令牌交还给 UBUser。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用的 UBUser 社交登录及认证返回流程将无法正常完成。

en.description: Uriio's BLE beacon library receives scheduled beacon alarms and starts its advertising service for the specified beacon.
en.disableEffect: Scheduled beacon advertising may not start when its alarm fires.

zh-CN.description: Uriio 的 BLE 信标库会接收预定的信标闹钟，并为指定信标启动广播服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 闹钟触发时，预定的信标广播可能无法启动。

en.description: Uriio's Beacons library starts or restores active Bluetooth LE beacons, manages their advertising state, and reports state changes to the app.
en.disableEffect: The app's Bluetooth beacons may stop advertising or fail to resume.

zh-CN.description: Uriio Beacons 库会启动或恢复活动中的蓝牙低功耗信标、管理其广播状态，并向应用报告状态变化。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用的蓝牙信标可能停止广播或无法恢复。

en.description: Uriio's Beacons library handles signals to pause or stop active Bluetooth beacons and to start scheduled advertising work.
en.disableEffect: Beacon pause, stop, and scheduled-start actions may not be handled.

zh-CN.description: Uriio Beacons 库会处理暂停或停止活动蓝牙信标以及启动预定广播任务的信号。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 信标的暂停、停止和预定启动操作可能无法处理。

en.description: URX Widgets for the URX App Search API opens a search screen, fetches results, and resolves a selected result to an installed app or the Play Store.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to search or open results through the app's URX search screen.

zh-CN.description: URX App Search API 的 Widgets 会打开搜索页面、获取结果，并将选中的结果转到已安装应用或 Play Store。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过应用中的 URX 搜索页面搜索或打开结果。

en.description: Usabilla Live for Apps opens this screen to capture or choose an image and annotate it for a feedback report.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to capture, choose, or annotate images in Usabilla feedback forms.

zh-CN.description: Usabilla Live for Apps 会打开此页面拍摄或选择图片，并为反馈报告添加标注。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在 Usabilla 反馈表单中拍摄、选择或标注图片。

en.description: Usabilla Live for Apps makes temporary screenshot files available to the camera and feedback flow through Android's file-sharing system.
en.disableEffect: Camera-based screenshot capture may fail because the camera cannot save into the Usabilla feedback flow.

zh-CN.description: Usabilla Live for Apps 通过 Android 文件共享机制，让相机和反馈流程访问临时截图文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 相机可能无法将截图保存到 Usabilla 反馈流程中，导致拍摄截图失败。

en.description: Button Android Publisher SDK opens the Google Play listing for a promoted app and carries its referral link into the install flow.
en.disableEffect: Button app-install offers will no longer open their Google Play install page.

zh-CN.description: Button Android Publisher SDK 会打开推广应用的 Google Play 页面，并将推荐链接带入安装流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Button 的应用安装推广将无法打开对应的 Google Play 页面。

en.description: Button Android Publisher SDK displays an install sheet for a promoted app, including its icon and install action.
en.disableEffect: Button's app-install sheet will not appear.

zh-CN.description: Button Android Publisher SDK 会显示推广应用的安装面板，其中包含应用图标和安装操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Button 的应用安装面板将不会显示。

en.description: Button Android Publisher SDK opens linked pages in its in-app browser and handles their navigation and related install or promotion cards.
en.disableEffect: Pages opened through Button's in-app browser and their associated actions will no longer work.

zh-CN.description: Button Android Publisher SDK 会在应用内浏览器中打开链接页面，并处理页面跳转及相关的安装或推广卡片。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过 Button 应用内浏览器打开的页面及其相关操作将无法使用。

en.description: Button's install-notification receiver opens the target app when a user taps the notice and records when the notice is dismissed.
en.disableEffect: Tapping a Button install notification will not open its linked app through this receiver.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击 Button 安装通知时，此接收器会打开目标应用，并记录通知关闭事件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 点击 Button 安装通知后，此接收器将无法打开关联的应用。

en.description: When the device language changes, Button refreshes locale-dependent configuration for its publisher features.
en.disableEffect: Button will not refresh locale-dependent configuration after the device language changes.

zh-CN.description: 设备语言改变时，Button 会刷新其发布者功能所需的语言相关配置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 设备语言改变后，Button 将不会刷新语言相关配置。

en.description: Button Android Publisher SDK opens a full-screen promotion widget and can continue to the promoted app's install action.
en.disableEffect: Button full-screen promotion widgets and their install action will not open.

zh-CN.description: Button Android Publisher SDK 会打开全屏推广组件，并可继续执行推广应用的安装操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Button 的全屏推广组件及其安装操作将无法打开。

en.description: When a user opens the UserCare help home, this UserCare SDK screen loads its configured support page and routes links to live chat, VIP content, FAQs, or tickets.
en.disableEffect: The UserCare support home and its links to chat, FAQs, VIP content, and tickets will not open.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 UserCare 帮助主页时，UserCare SDK 页面会加载配置的支持页面，并将链接转到在线客服、VIP 内容、常见问题或工单。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，UserCare 支持主页以及通往在线客服、常见问题、VIP 内容和工单的链接将无法打开。

en.description: When a user opens VIP Lounge from UserCare, this screen loads the configured VIP content in an in-app browser.
en.disableEffect: The UserCare VIP content page will not open.

zh-CN.description: 用户从 UserCare 打开 VIP Lounge 时，此页面会在应用内浏览器中加载配置的 VIP 内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，UserCare VIP 内容页面将无法打开。

en.description: When UserCare refreshes offline content, this background Service saves FAQ or other support pages locally according to the configured cache setting.
en.disableEffect: UserCare will stop refreshing its offline support pages, so cached help content may become stale or unavailable.

zh-CN.description: UserCare 刷新离线内容时，此后台服务会根据缓存设置将常见问题或其他支持页面保存到本地。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，UserCare 将停止刷新离线支持页面，缓存的帮助内容可能过期或无法使用。

en.description: When a user opens FAQs in UserCare, this screen displays support topics and lets them search for answers or submit a question.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot browse or search UserCare FAQs from the app.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 UserCare 中打开常见问题时，此页面会显示支持主题，并可搜索答案或提交问题。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法在应用中浏览或搜索 UserCare 常见问题。

en.description: When a UserCare FAQ answer is selected, this screen loads the answer page and collects yes-or-no feedback about it.
en.disableEffect: Selected UserCare FAQ answers and their feedback controls will not open.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择 UserCare 常见问题答案时，此页面会加载答案内容并收集有用或无用的反馈。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，将无法打开所选的 UserCare 答案页面及其反馈控件。

en.description: When a user opens UserCare live chat from its button, a ticket, or a support notification, this screen connects to support and displays the conversation.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open or continue UserCare live-chat conversations.

zh-CN.description: 用户通过 UserCare 按钮、工单或支持通知打开在线客服时，此页面会连接客服并显示对话。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法打开或继续 UserCare 在线客服对话。

en.description: When a file is attached to a UserCare conversation, this background Service handles sending the local file or file link with the chat message.
en.disableEffect: File attachments cannot be transferred through UserCare support conversations.

zh-CN.description: UserCare 对话附加文件时，此后台服务会随聊天消息传送本地文件或文件链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，UserCare 支持对话将无法传送文件附件。

en.description: UserCare starts this background monitor during SDK setup; it records when the app is removed from recent tasks and schedules a restart on Android 4.4.
en.disableEffect: UserCare will no longer track app removal or schedule its Android 4.4 background restart.

zh-CN.description: UserCare 在 SDK 初始化期间启动此后台监控；应用从最近任务中移除时，它会记录状态，并在 Android 4.4 上安排重启。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，UserCare 将不再跟踪应用被移除的状态，也不会安排 Android 4.4 上的后台重启。

en.description: When a user opens My Tickets in UserCare, this screen lists support tickets and routes open tickets to chat or older tickets to their details.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot view or open their UserCare support tickets.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 UserCare 中打开我的工单时，此页面会列出支持工单，并将未结工单转到在线客服、已结束工单转到详情。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法查看或打开 UserCare 支持工单。

en.description: When a user selects a non-open UserCare ticket, this screen displays that ticket's details.
en.disableEffect: Details for closed UserCare tickets will not open.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择已关闭的 UserCare 工单时，此页面会显示该工单的详细信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，将无法打开已关闭 UserCare 工单的详情。

en.description: When the app starts, the UserExperior provider initializes the analytics SDK in the background and registers for screen lifecycle events used in session recording.
en.disableEffect: UserExperior session recording will not initialize through this automatic startup entry; the app’s regular screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，UserExperior 会通过此提供程序在后台初始化分析 SDK，并监听页面生命周期以支持会话记录。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，UserExperior 将无法通过此自动启动入口初始化会话记录；应用的常规页面仍可使用。

en.description: When UserExperior starts this service, it prepares event-session recording and handles saved crash or app-not-responding state.
en.disableEffect: UserExperior event-session processing and recovery handling will stop.

zh-CN.description: UserExperior 启动此服务后，会准备事件会话记录，并处理已保存的崩溃或应用无响应状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，UserExperior 的事件会话处理和恢复状态处理将停止。

en.description: UserExperior binds this service to handle screenshot requests during a recorded session.
en.disableEffect: UserExperior session recordings will no longer include screenshots handled by this service.

zh-CN.description: UserExperior 会绑定此服务，以处理会话录制期间的截图请求。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，UserExperior 会话记录将无法包含由此服务处理的截图。

en.description: When UserExperior queues background work, this service uploads recorded sessions and event, crash, or app-not-responding data.
en.disableEffect: UserExperior will no longer upload the queued session and diagnostic data through this service.

zh-CN.description: UserExperior 安排后台任务时，此服务会上传已记录的会话以及事件、崩溃或应用无响应数据。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，UserExperior 将无法通过此服务上传排队中的会话和诊断数据。

en.description: Before recording, UserExperior opens this screen to ask whether the user allows in-app activity, screen, and gestures to be sent to a third-party analytics service.
en.disableEffect: The UserExperior recording consent prompt will not open, so users cannot grant recording permission through it.

zh-CN.description: 开始记录前，UserExperior 会打开此页面，询问用户是否允许将应用操作、屏幕和手势发送给第三方分析服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，UserExperior 的记录授权提示将无法打开，用户也无法通过此页面授予记录权限。

en.description: SHAREit Ads briefly opens this nearly invisible screen when a promoted app's full-screen install flow starts. It records the install start and then closes.
en.disableEffect: SHAREit Ads will stop recording these promoted-app install starts.

zh-CN.description: 推广应用的全屏安装流程开始时，SHAREit Ads 会短暂打开此几乎不可见的页面，记录安装启动事件后将其关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: SHAREit Ads 将不再记录这些推广应用安装流程的启动事件。

en.description: When a user opens a video ad, the SHAREit Audience Network SDK shows this landing page with the video and the linked offer page. It can provide actions to download or install the promoted app.
en.disableEffect: Video-ad landing pages and their promoted-app actions will not open.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开视频广告时，SHAREit Audience Network SDK 会显示包含视频和关联推广页面的落地页，并可提供下载或安装推广应用的操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 视频广告落地页及其推广应用操作将无法打开。

en.description: The SHAREit Audience Network SDK opens this compact landing page for a video ad and displays the ad's video destination in a smaller layout.
en.disableEffect: Compact video-ad landing pages will not open.

zh-CN.description: SHAREit Audience Network SDK 会为视频广告打开此紧凑落地页，并以较小版式显示广告视频内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 紧凑型视频广告落地页将无法打开。

en.description: The SHAREit Audience Network SDK opens this offer page when a user follows an ad. Its actions can download, install, or open the promoted app.
en.disableEffect: This ad landing page and its promoted-app actions will not be available.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击广告后，SHAREit Audience Network SDK 会打开此推广页面；页面操作可下载、安装或打开推广应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 此广告落地页及其推广应用操作将无法使用。

en.description: After a promoted app installation finishes, SHAREit Ads receives the result here and records whether the install succeeded or failed.
en.disableEffect: SHAREit Ads will not receive or record promoted-app installation results.

zh-CN.description: 推广应用安装完成后，SHAREit Ads 会在此接收结果，并记录安装成功或失败的状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: SHAREit Ads 将无法接收或记录推广应用的安装结果。

en.description: The SHAREit Ads installer opens this screen from an install notice or an app package file. It unpacks the package and its split files, then continues the promoted-app installation flow.
en.disableEffect: SHAREit Ads will not be able to continue installations that use this package format.

zh-CN.description: SHAREit Ads 安装器会从安装通知或应用安装包文件打开此页面，解包主程序和拆分文件后继续安装推广应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: SHAREit Ads 将无法继续安装使用此安装包格式的推广应用。

en.description: The SHAREit Ads download SDK listens for network connection changes here and updates its downloader when connectivity changes.
en.disableEffect: Ad downloads may not react correctly when the network becomes available or is lost.

zh-CN.description: SHAREit Ads 下载 SDK 会在此监听网络连接变化，并在网络状态改变时通知下载器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 网络恢复或断开时，广告下载可能无法正确响应。

en.description: The SHAREit Ads SDK uses this background service to start, pause, resume, and track promoted-app downloads, including their progress notifications.
en.disableEffect: Promoted-app downloads managed by SHAREit Ads will stop or fail to resume.

zh-CN.description: SHAREit Ads SDK 会通过此后台服务启动、暂停和恢复推广应用下载，并跟踪下载进度及通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: SHAREit Ads 管理的推广应用下载将停止或无法恢复。

en.description: The SHAREit Audience Network SDK opens this full-screen page to show an interstitial ad, with its configured countdown and close controls.
en.disableEffect: Interstitial ads from SHAREit Audience Network will not appear.

zh-CN.description: SHAREit Audience Network SDK 会打开此全屏页面展示插页广告，并显示广告配置的倒计时和关闭控件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: SHAREit Audience Network 的插页广告将不会显示。

en.description: SHAREit Ads uses this receiver when a scheduled reserve-ad alarm fires, so it can continue the reserved promotion flow.
en.disableEffect: Scheduled reserve-ad checks will not be triggered by their alarms.

zh-CN.description: SHAREit Ads 的预约广告闹钟触发时会调用此接收器，以继续预约推广流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 预约广告检查将不会由闹钟触发。

en.description: The SHAREit Ads reserve service checks configured promotion times and schedules or cancels alarms for the related promotional notification.
en.disableEffect: Scheduled promotional notifications from SHAREit Ads will stop being prepared.

zh-CN.description: SHAREit Ads 预约服务会检查配置的推广时间，并为相关推广通知安排或取消闹钟。
zh-CN.disableEffect: SHAREit Ads 将无法准备定时推广通知。

en.description: SHAREit Ads uses this service to display a scheduled promotional notification. Tapping it can open the promoted app, and the SDK records display and tap events.
en.disableEffect: Scheduled promotional notifications and their promoted-app links will stop working.

zh-CN.description: SHAREit Ads 会通过此服务显示定时推广通知；点击通知可打开推广应用，SDK 也会记录通知展示和点击事件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 定时推广通知及其推广应用链接将无法使用。

en.description: The SHAREit Audience Network SDK opens this full-screen activity to play a rewarded ad and report the reward after viewing.
en.disableEffect: Rewarded ads will not play, and rewards for watching ads will no longer be granted.

zh-CN.description: SHAREit Audience Network SDK 会打开此全屏页面播放激励广告，并在观看后报告奖励。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 激励广告将无法播放，观看广告也将不再获得奖励。

en.description: When a user follows a SHAREit ad, the SHAREit Ads SDK opens this landing page to show the offer and its available action.
en.disableEffect: This SHAREit ad landing page will not open.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击 SHAREit 广告时，SHAREit Ads SDK 会打开此落地页展示推广内容和可用操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 此 SHAREit 广告落地页将无法打开。

en.description: The SHAREit Ads SDK opens this full-screen player for a video supplied by an MRAID ad.
en.disableEffect: MRAID video ads will not play in this full-screen player.

zh-CN.description: SHAREit Ads SDK 会打开此全屏播放器，播放 MRAID 广告提供的视频。
zh-CN.disableEffect: MRAID 视频广告将无法在此全屏播放器中播放。

en.description: If an ad landing page cannot load because the device is offline, SHAREit Ads opens this screen with network settings and a retry option.
en.disableEffect: The ad-specific offline guide and retry screen will not be available.

zh-CN.description: 设备离线导致广告落地页无法加载时，SHAREit Ads 会打开此页面，提供网络设置和重试选项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 广告专用的离线指南和重试页面将无法使用。

en.description: The SHAREit Ads SDK opens this embedded web page to display an ad-provided link or HTML content and handle ad navigation.
en.disableEffect: Ad links that use this embedded page will not open.

zh-CN.description: SHAREit Ads SDK 会通过此内嵌网页显示广告提供的链接或 HTML 内容，并处理广告页面导航。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此内嵌页面的广告链接将无法打开。

en.description: The PayerMax Payment SDK opens this screen when checkout asks to choose a contact, then returns the selected name and phone number to the payment flow.
en.disableEffect: Checkout flows that request contact selection cannot import a contact and will fail at that step.

zh-CN.description: 结账流程要求选择联系人时，PayerMax Payment SDK 会打开此页面，并将所选联系人的姓名和电话号码返回付款流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要选择联系人的结账流程无法导入联系人，并会在此步骤失败。

en.description: The PayerMax Payment SDK opens this screen for an in-app purchase, showing the amount, available payment methods, agreement text, and confirm or cancel controls.
en.disableEffect: In-app purchases using this SDK cannot choose and confirm a payment method.

zh-CN.description: 进行应用内购买时，PayerMax Payment SDK 会打开此页面显示金额、可用付款方式、协议说明以及确认或取消按钮。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此 SDK 的应用内购买无法选择并确认付款方式。

en.description: When Android broadcasts a system language change, the PayerMax Payment SDK refreshes its saved language settings for later payment screens.
en.disableEffect: PayerMax screens may keep their previous language after the device language changes.

zh-CN.description: Android 发出系统语言变更通知时，PayerMax Payment SDK 会刷新已保存的语言设置，供之后的付款页面使用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 设备语言变更后，PayerMax 页面可能仍显示之前的语言。

en.description: When an app starts a PayerMax hosted checkout, the PayerMax Payment SDK opens this entry screen and returns a success or failure result to the app.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot launch this PayerMax checkout or receive its completion result.

zh-CN.description: 应用发起 PayerMax 托管结账时，PayerMax Payment SDK 会打开此入口页面，并向应用返回成功或失败结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用无法启动此 PayerMax 结账流程或接收完成结果。

en.description: The PayerMax Payment SDK displays a supplied checkout page in this screen and passes messages between the page and the app during payment.
en.disableEffect: The PayerMax hosted payment page cannot open, so payments using this flow cannot finish.

zh-CN.description: PayerMax Payment SDK 会在此页面显示指定的结账网页，并在付款过程中传递网页与应用之间的消息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: PayerMax 托管付款网页无法打开，因此使用此流程的付款无法完成。

en.description: When the app requests a scan, Yipianfengye’s ZXing barcode-scanning library opens a camera preview and returns text recognized from a QR code or barcode.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot complete scan flows that use ZXing to read QR codes or barcodes.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求扫码时，Yipianfengye 的 ZXing 条码扫描库会打开相机取景，并将识别出的二维码或条码文本返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法完成依赖 ZXing 读取二维码或条码的扫码流程。

en.description: ValuePotion advertising saves campaign information from Google Play install-referrer messages and forwards them to other receivers.
en.disableEffect: ValuePotion campaign attribution and install-source forwarding will stop.

zh-CN.description: ValuePotion 广告 SDK 会保存 Google Play 安装来源中的推广信息，并将相关消息转给其他接收器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，ValuePotion 的推广归因和安装来源转发将停止。

en.description: ValuePotion uses this screen to show full-screen interstitial ads and handle ad interactions.
en.disableEffect: ValuePotion interstitial ads will not open, and any reward attached to one will not be granted.

zh-CN.description: ValuePotion 使用此页面展示全屏插页广告并处理广告互动。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，ValuePotion 插页广告将无法打开，与此类广告绑定的奖励也无法获得。

en.description: ValuePotion uses this screen to play full-screen video ads and record whether viewers finish or leave early.
en.disableEffect: ValuePotion video ads will not play, and users will not receive rewards for watching them.

zh-CN.description: ValuePotion 使用此页面播放全屏视频广告，并记录用户看完或提前退出的情况。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，ValuePotion 视频广告将无法播放，用户也无法获得观看奖励。

en.description: When an app using RxPermissions requests access to the camera, location, or another protected feature, this Activity opens the Android permission prompt and returns the user’s choice.
en.disableEffect: Permission requests through this library will stop working, so app features that need those permissions may fail.

zh-CN.description: 应用通过 RxPermissions 请求相机、位置或其他受保护功能的权限时，此 Activity 会打开 Android 权限提示，并将用户的选择返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过此库发起的权限请求将无法正常完成，依赖这些权限的应用功能可能会失效。

en.description: The Reliao Novel SDK (Vanzoo) opens this screen when a reader selects a novel; it shows the title, author, summary, and related books, with links to the chapter list and reader.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents readers from viewing a novel's details or opening related-book recommendations from this screen.

zh-CN.description: Reliao Novel SDK（Vanzoo）在读者选择小说时打开此页面，展示书名、作者、简介和相关书目，并可进入目录或阅读页。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，读者无法在此页面查看小说详情或打开相关书目。

en.description: The Reliao Novel SDK opens this screen to display a reader's saved-novel shelf.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it hides the saved-novel shelf and prevents readers from opening that list.

zh-CN.description: Reliao Novel SDK 在读者打开书架时显示已收藏的小说列表。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，读者无法查看或从此页面打开已收藏的小说。

en.description: The Reliao Novel SDK opens this page from a novel's details to show its chapter list; selecting a chapter opens the reader at that point.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it removes chapter browsing and the option to start a novel at a chosen chapter.

zh-CN.description: Reliao Novel SDK 从小说详情页打开此目录，列出各章节；选择章节后会从该处进入阅读页。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，读者无法浏览章节目录或从指定章节开始阅读。

en.description: The Reliao Novel SDK opens this page to show separate male- and female-novel rankings; its search button opens book search.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it removes the SDK's ranking lists and their search entry point.

zh-CN.description: Reliao Novel SDK 在读者打开排行榜时显示男频和女频小说榜单，页面上的搜索入口可查找书籍。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，读者无法查看该 SDK 的排行榜或从此页进入搜索。

en.description: The Reliao Novel SDK opens this screen to show novel chapters with page-turning, chapter-selection, and reading-display controls.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from reading novels supplied through this SDK.

zh-CN.description: Reliao Novel SDK 在读者开始阅读时显示章节内容，并提供翻页、选章和阅读显示设置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法阅读通过此 SDK 提供的小说。

en.description: The Reliao Novel SDK opens this page to list recently read novels; readers can reopen a book or remove selected history entries.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it removes the recent-reading list and its return-to-reading path.

zh-CN.description: Reliao Novel SDK 在读者打开阅读记录时列出最近读过的小说，支持重新打开书籍或删除选中的记录。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，读者无法查看阅读记录或从记录中继续阅读。

en.description: The Reliao Novel SDK opens this page so readers can choose male, female, or all novels for browsing and save that catalog preference.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it removes the screen for changing the novel catalog's reader-category preference.

zh-CN.description: Reliao Novel SDK 在读者调整书目偏好时提供男频、女频或全部小说的选择，并保存该设置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，读者无法通过此页面更改小说书目的阅读类别偏好。

en.description: The Reliao Novel SDK opens this page when readers search its catalog; it shows recent and recommended searches and loads matching novel results.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from searching the SDK's novel catalog and opening matching results.

zh-CN.description: Reliao Novel SDK 在读者搜索书籍时显示此页面，提供搜索历史和推荐词，并加载匹配的小说结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法搜索此 SDK 的小说书目或打开匹配结果。

en.description: SOHA TV's KingID login SDK opens a web-based sign-in or account-authorization page supplied by the host app. It returns the authentication result through the KingID login flow.
en.disableEffect: KingID sign-in or account verification may fail to open or complete.

zh-CN.description: SOHA TV 的 KingID 登录 SDK 会打开宿主应用提供的网页登录或账户授权页面，并通过 KingID 登录流程返回验证结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: KingID 登录或账户验证可能无法打开或完成。

en.description: KingID uses this Activity to validate a partner app's request for shared sign-in data and grant access to an authorized app. It is part of cross-app KingID account authorization.
en.disableEffect: Partner apps may not be able to complete KingID sign-in or account-sharing handoffs.

zh-CN.description: KingID 会在此验证合作应用对共享登录信息的请求，并向获准的应用授予访问权限；这是跨应用账户授权流程的一部分。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 合作应用可能无法完成 KingID 登录或账户信息共享流程。

en.description: KingID uses this Activity to check a linked app's request for the signed-in account and grant access to shared user information when permitted.
en.disableEffect: The linked app may be unable to complete KingID account sharing.

zh-CN.description: KingID 会在此检查关联应用对已登录账户的请求，并在允许时授予其访问共享用户信息的权限。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 关联应用可能无法完成 KingID 账户共享。

en.description: KingID quick sign-in opens a supplied login page and returns the resulting access token or an error to the calling app.
en.disableEffect: Quick sign-in with KingID may not complete.

zh-CN.description: KingID 快速登录会打开指定的登录页面，并将访问令牌或错误结果返回给调用应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: KingID 快速登录可能无法完成。

en.description: SOHA TV's VietID login SDK opens the authentication or account-authorization page requested by the host app. It handles sign-in and related account actions in a web view and returns the result to the SDK.
en.disableEffect: VietID sign-in and account-authorization flows may fail.

zh-CN.description: SOHA TV 的 VietID 登录 SDK 会打开宿主应用请求的登录或账户授权页面，在网页中处理登录及相关账户操作，并将结果返回给 SDK。
zh-CN.disableEffect: VietID 登录和账户授权流程可能失败。

en.description: VietID quick sign-in opens the supplied login page and returns an access token to the host app when sign-in succeeds.
en.disableEffect: VietID quick sign-in may not complete.

zh-CN.description: VietID 快速登录会打开指定的登录页面，并在登录成功后将访问令牌返回给宿主应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: VietID 快速登录可能无法完成。

en.description: Vdopia’s ad SDK opens this full-screen page for interstitial ads. It loads either a web-based ad or an interactive creative.
en.disableEffect: Vdopia interstitial ads that use this page will not appear.

zh-CN.description: Vdopia 广告 SDK 会打开此全屏页面展示插页广告，广告内容可以是网页广告或互动广告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此页面的 Vdopia 插页广告将无法显示。

en.description: Vdopia’s ad SDK opens an in-app browser when an ad link is tapped or an interactive ad opens a web page. It loads the destination and provides back, forward, refresh, share, and close controls.
en.disableEffect: The Vdopia in-app ad browser and its navigation and sharing controls will not be available.

zh-CN.description: Vdopia 广告 SDK 会在用户点击广告链接或互动广告打开网页时启动应用内浏览器，加载目标网页并提供前进、后退、刷新、分享和关闭按钮。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Vdopia 广告的应用内浏览器及其导航和分享功能将无法使用。

en.description: CodePoem's UploadRepository demo Activity displays a sample layout and prints short Android, Java, and Kotlin greeting messages when launched.
en.disableEffect: The UploadRepository demo screen becomes unavailable.

zh-CN.description: CodePoem UploadRepository 演示库的此 Activity 会显示示例布局，并在启动时输出 Android、Java 和 Kotlin 的简短问候信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，UploadRepository 演示页面无法打开。

en.description: Machbird opens this screen to show an app update prompt and let the user choose an available update source.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to use this Machbird update prompt to get an app update.

zh-CN.description: Machbird 会通过此页面显示应用更新提示，并让用户选择可用的更新来源。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此 Machbird 更新提示获取应用更新。

en.description: Machbird opens this follow-up guide after an update prompt closes and checks whether the app update completes.
en.disableEffect: The Machbird update guide and its completion check will not appear.

zh-CN.description: 更新提示关闭后，Machbird 会打开此后续指南，并检查应用更新是否完成。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Machbird 更新指南及其完成状态检查将不会显示。

en.description: This Machbird receiver handles update notification choices, directing users to install an update, open its store page, or cancel.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to act on update notifications handled by Machbird.

zh-CN.description: 此 Machbird Receiver 会处理更新通知中的选择，引导用户安装更新、打开应用商店页面或取消操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法处理由 Machbird 管理的更新通知。

en.description: When the app update flow opens Android's installer, this private provider gives it temporary access to the downloaded APK file.
en.disableEffect: Android cannot read the downloaded package through this update flow, so installation fails.

zh-CN.description: 应用更新流程打开 Android 安装器时，这个私有提供程序会临时授权安装器读取已下载的 APK 文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Android 安装器无法通过此更新流程读取安装包，因此安装会失败。

en.description: When an app update is started, this service downloads the APK in the background, shows progress in a notification, and hands the finished file to the installer.
en.disableEffect: The app's built-in update download and installation flow will stop working.

zh-CN.description: 启动应用更新后，此服务会在后台下载 APK、通过通知显示进度，并将下载完成的文件交给安装器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用内置的更新下载和安装流程将无法使用。

en.description: When an app starts Verifai identity verification, this Activity guides the user through the document checks and asks for camera access.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot complete its Verifai identity verification flow.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动 Verifai 身份核验时，此 Activity 会引导用户完成证件核验步骤，并请求相机权限。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法完成 Verifai 身份核验流程。

en.description: When the app asks the user to complete Verifai’s liveness check, this screen requests camera and microphone access and runs the check.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot complete the app’s Verifai liveness check, which may block a required identity step.

zh-CN.description: 应用要求用户完成 Verifai 活体检测时，此界面会请求相机和麦克风权限并运行检测。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法完成应用的 Verifai 活体检测，可能因此无法通过必要的身份核验步骤。

en.description: When Verifai needs to read the chip in an identity document, this screen shows scanning instructions, uses the phone’s NFC reader, and returns the scan result.
en.disableEffect: Identity checks that require reading the document chip will not complete.

zh-CN.description: Verifai 需要读取身份证件芯片时，此界面会显示扫描说明、使用手机的 NFC 读取器，并返回读取结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要读取证件芯片的身份核验将无法完成。

en.description: When a VGS Collect payment form asks to scan a card, the BlinkCard adapter opens the camera scanner and fills the form with the card number, expiry date, security code, and cardholder name it reads.
en.disableEffect: Card scanning in the payment form will stop working, and the app may not collect payment details if it offers no other entry method.

zh-CN.description: VGS Collect 支付表单要求扫描银行卡时，BlinkCard 适配器会打开相机扫描器，并将读取到的卡号、有效期、安全码和持卡人姓名填入表单。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 支付表单中的银行卡扫描将无法使用；如果应用没有其他输入方式，可能无法收集付款信息。

en.description: When a VGS Collect payment form requests a card scan, this adapter opens Bouncer’s card capture screen and returns the scanned details to the form.
en.disableEffect: The card-scanning checkout path will stop working, and checkout may fail if the app requires scan results.

zh-CN.description: VGS Collect 支付表单请求扫描银行卡时，此适配器会打开 Bouncer 的银行卡采集界面，并将扫描结果返回给表单。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 结账流程中的银行卡扫描将无法使用；如果应用要求通过扫描获取卡片信息，结账可能会失败。

en.description: When a VGS Collect payment form requests a card scan, the Card.io adapter opens its scanner and returns the card number, expiry date, security code, and other configured details to the form.
en.disableEffect: The app’s Card.io scanning option will stop working, which may block payment if no other entry method is available.

zh-CN.description: VGS Collect 支付表单请求扫描银行卡时，Card.io 适配器会打开扫描器，并将卡号、有效期、安全码及其他已配置的信息返回给表单。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法使用 Card.io 扫描银行卡；如果没有其他输入方式，付款可能会受阻。

en.description: When a VGS Collect form requests a file attachment, this Activity opens Android’s document picker and returns the selected file to the form.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot attach files through that form, so any step that requires an attachment may be blocked.

zh-CN.description: VGS Collect 表单需要添加文件时，此 Activity 会打开 Android 文档选择器，并将选中的文件返回给表单。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过该表单添加文件，因此需要附件的步骤可能无法继续。

en.description: The Vhall Adidas SDK includes this internal test page, which appears only when the host app opens it directly. In this build it reads test login fields and shows an enter-room button with no action attached.
en.disableEffect: Only this test page becomes unavailable; it has no direct role in the SDK's live viewing screens.

zh-CN.description: Vhall Adidas SDK 附带此内部测试页，只有应用直接打开时才会显示。此版本会读取测试登录信息并显示进入房间按钮，但按钮没有绑定操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后只有此测试页无法打开；它不直接参与 SDK 的直播观看页面。

en.description: The Vhall Adidas SDK uses this shared Activity foundation behind its individual screens; it does not present a standalone user page.
en.disableEffect: Disabling this standalone entry does not remove the SDK's separately declared live, web, or viewing screens.

zh-CN.description: Vhall Adidas SDK 的各个页面共用此 Activity 基础组件；它本身不会显示独立的用户页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用此独立入口不会移除 SDK 单独声明的直播、网页或观看页面。

en.description: The Vhall Dingdang SDK uses this shared Activity foundation behind its individual screens; it does not present a standalone user page.
en.disableEffect: Disabling this standalone entry does not remove the SDK's separately declared live, web, or viewing screens.

zh-CN.description: Vhall Dingdang SDK 的各个页面共用此 Activity 基础组件；它本身不会显示独立的用户页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用此独立入口不会移除 SDK 单独声明的直播、网页或观看页面。

en.description: The Vhall Dingdang SDK opens this Activity for in-app event pages. It displays the supplied page in a web view and handles page navigation and live-session interactions.
en.disableEffect: In-app event pages and interactions that rely on this web screen will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: Vhall Dingdang SDK 在应用内打开活动网页时会显示此页面。它使用内嵌网页展示内容，并处理页面跳转和直播互动。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此网页页面的应用内活动内容和互动将无法打开。

en.description: The Vhall Dingdang SDK routes requests to open its chat screen to this Activity, but this build supplies no page layout or chat controls here.
en.disableEffect: The SDK's chat-screen launch fails if this Activity is disabled.

zh-CN.description: Vhall Dingdang SDK 会把打开聊天页面的请求交给此 Activity，但此版本没有为它提供页面布局或聊天控件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，SDK 无法打开此聊天页面入口。

en.description: The Vhall Dingdang SDK opens this screen after an image is selected for cropping. Users can adjust the crop area and return the cropped picture to the calling page.
en.disableEffect: Image-selection flows that need cropping can no longer finish with a cropped picture.

zh-CN.description: Vhall Dingdang SDK 在用户选择图片并需要裁剪时打开此页面。用户可调整裁剪范围，再将裁好的图片返回给调用页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要裁剪图片的选择流程将无法完成并返回裁剪结果。

en.description: The Vhall Dingdang SDK opens this screen to display selected pictures in a full-screen, swipeable preview.
en.disableEffect: Users can no longer review selected pictures in this preview screen.

zh-CN.description: Vhall Dingdang SDK 使用此页面全屏展示已选图片，用户可左右滑动查看。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法在此页面预览已选图片。

en.description: The Vhall Dingdang SDK opens this gallery screen when a page requests picture selection. Users can browse folders, select pictures, optionally take a new photo, and return their choices.
en.disableEffect: Pages that use this selector can no longer choose or return pictures.

zh-CN.description: 页面请求选择图片时，Vhall Dingdang SDK 会打开此图库页面。用户可浏览相册、选择图片、按需拍摄新照片并返回所选内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此选择器的页面无法再选择或返回图片。

en.description: The Vhall Dingdang SDK opens this screen to show chosen pictures one at a time in a full-screen, swipeable preview.
en.disableEffect: Users can no longer open the picture preview used by the selector and other SDK pages.

zh-CN.description: Vhall Dingdang SDK 使用此页面逐张全屏展示图片，用户可左右滑动预览。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法打开选择器及其他 SDK 页面使用的图片预览。

en.description: The Vhall Dingdang SDK opens this screen to review pictures before selection is confirmed. Users can move between pictures, change which ones are selected, and return the final list.
en.disableEffect: The picture-selection flow can no longer review and confirm its selected pictures.

zh-CN.description: Vhall Dingdang SDK 在用户确认图片选择前打开此页面预览。用户可切换图片、调整勾选内容，并返回最终选择列表。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，图片选择流程无法预览并确认所选图片。

en.description: The Vhall Dingdang SDK opens this fallback screen when a live event is reported as too busy to enter. It tells viewers to try again later and provides a back button.
en.disableEffect: When an event is too busy, the SDK can no longer show this retry-later screen.

zh-CN.description: 直播活动因人数过多而暂时无法进入时，Vhall Dingdang SDK 会打开此提示页面，告知观众稍后重试并提供返回按钮。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 活动过于繁忙时，SDK 无法再显示此稍后重试页面。

en.description: The Vhall Dingdang SDK opens this screen for an event preview. It shows the event cover, details, and countdown or live status, then lets viewers enter the room when it is available.
en.disableEffect: The event preview and the flow from its preview page into the live room will no longer work.

zh-CN.description: Vhall Dingdang SDK 在用户查看活动预览时打开此页面，显示活动封面、信息、倒计时或直播状态，并在活动可进入时让观众进入房间。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，活动预览以及从预览页进入直播间的流程无法使用。

en.description: The Vhall Dingdang SDK opens this screen to load and display a live event's text notices. Viewers can refresh the list and browse additional pages.
en.disableEffect: Viewers can no longer open or refresh the event notice list through this SDK.

zh-CN.description: Vhall Dingdang SDK 使用此页面加载并显示直播活动的文字公告，观众可刷新列表或继续浏览后续页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，观众无法通过此 SDK 打开或刷新活动公告列表。

en.description: The Vhall Adidas SDK declares an AndroidX file-sharing provider for the app's configured files. It supplies temporary content links to features that attach or open those files.
en.disableEffect: File-sharing or file-opening flows that use this provider will fail.

zh-CN.description: Vhall Adidas SDK 声明了一个 AndroidX 文件共享提供程序，用于按应用配置向功能提供临时文件链接，以便附加或打开文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此提供程序分享或打开文件的流程将无法使用。

en.description: The Vhall Dingdang SDK opens this vertical viewing screen for a live event or its replay. It joins the room, plays the video, and responds to room updates.
en.disableEffect: Viewers can no longer open vertical live events or replays through this SDK screen.

zh-CN.description: Vhall Dingdang SDK 使用此竖屏观看页面播放直播活动或回放。它加入房间、播放视频并处理房间状态更新。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，观众无法通过此页面观看竖屏直播或回放。

en.description: The Vhall Adidas SDK opens this Activity for in-app event pages. It displays the supplied page in a web view and handles page navigation and live-session interactions.
en.disableEffect: In-app event pages and interactions that rely on this web screen will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: Vhall Adidas SDK 在应用内打开活动网页时会显示此页面。它使用内嵌网页展示内容，并处理页面跳转和直播互动。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此网页页面的应用内活动内容和互动将无法打开。

en.description: The Vhall Adidas SDK routes requests to open its chat screen to this Activity, but this build supplies no page layout or chat controls here.
en.disableEffect: The SDK's chat-screen launch fails if this Activity is disabled.

zh-CN.description: Vhall Adidas SDK 会把打开聊天页面的请求交给此 Activity，但此版本没有为它提供页面布局或聊天控件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，SDK 无法打开此聊天页面入口。

en.description: The Vhall Adidas SDK opens this screen for an event preview. It shows the event poster, details, and countdown or live status, then lets viewers enter the room when it is available.
en.disableEffect: The event preview and the flow from its preview page into the live room will no longer work.

zh-CN.description: Vhall Adidas SDK 在用户查看活动预览时打开此页面，显示活动海报、信息、倒计时或直播状态，并在活动可进入时让观众进入房间。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，活动预览以及从预览页进入直播间的流程无法使用。

en.description: The Vhall Adidas SDK starts this foreground service to keep a live stream playing in a movable floating window. Viewers can return to the live room from that window.
en.disableEffect: Live video can no longer continue in the floating window or return to the room from it.

zh-CN.description: Vhall Adidas SDK 启动此前台服务，在可移动的悬浮窗中继续播放直播，观众也可从悬浮窗返回直播间。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，直播无法在悬浮窗中继续播放，也无法从悬浮窗返回房间。

en.description: The Vhall Adidas SDK starts this foreground service to keep a recorded video playing in a movable floating window, with playback controls and a way back to the room.
en.disableEffect: Recorded video can no longer continue in the floating window or return to the room from it.

zh-CN.description: Vhall Adidas SDK 启动此服务，在可移动的悬浮窗中继续播放直播回放，并提供播放控制和返回房间的入口。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，直播回放无法在悬浮窗中继续播放或从悬浮窗返回房间。

en.description: The Vhall Adidas SDK opens this Activity when a viewer enters a vertical live room. It joins the room, displays the stream, and responds to room updates.
en.disableEffect: Viewers can no longer open vertical live rooms through this SDK screen.

zh-CN.description: 观众进入竖屏直播间时，Vhall Adidas SDK 会打开此 Activity。它加入房间、显示直播画面并处理房间状态更新。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，观众无法通过此页面打开竖屏直播间。

en.description: The VHall live-event SDK uses this file provider to let its pages and compatible apps open or share local files through temporary access links.
en.disableEffect: Opening or sharing local files through VHall live-event pages may fail if this provider is disabled.

zh-CN.description: VHall 直播活动 SDK 使用此文件 Provider，通过临时访问链接让其页面和兼容的应用打开或分享本地文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，VHall 直播活动页面可能无法通过此 Provider 打开或分享本地文件。

en.description: VHall’s live SDK uses this shared Activity to prepare its other pages, including their layouts, status bars, loading indicators, and message pop-ups. It has no separate page of its own.
en.disableEffect: Users do not lose a standalone screen; VHall pages have their own entry points.

zh-CN.description: VHall 直播 SDK 使用此共享 Activity 初始化其他页面，包括页面布局、状态栏、加载提示和消息提示。它本身没有独立页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后不会少一个独立页面；VHall 的其他页面有各自的入口。

en.description: The VHall live-event SDK opens this in-app browser for event pages and interactive content such as voting. It loads a page supplied by the SDK and responds to events from the live room.
en.disableEffect: Embedded VHall event pages and voting screens that use this browser will not open if it is disabled.

zh-CN.description: VHall 直播活动 SDK 会用此应用内浏览器显示活动页面和投票等交互内容。它加载 SDK 提供的页面，并响应直播间发来的事件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，使用此浏览器的 VHall 活动页面和投票界面无法打开。

en.description: The Vhall live streaming SDK binds this service while it initializes or joins a live room. It keeps the room's message and chat connections open and delivers incoming room events to the SDK's live features.
en.disableEffect: Live room chat, event updates, and other features that rely on the room connection stop working.

zh-CN.description: Vhall（微吼）直播 SDK 在初始化或加入直播间时绑定此服务。它维持房间消息和聊天连接，并将收到的房间事件交给直播功能处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，依赖房间连接的直播聊天、事件更新和其他功能将无法工作。

en.description: The Vhall LSS live streaming SDK starts this foreground service when a presenter shares the device screen. It captures the screen and microphone and publishes them to the live room.
en.disableEffect: Users can no longer share their screen in a live room.

zh-CN.description: Vhall LSS 直播 SDK 在主播开始屏幕共享时启动此前台服务。它采集屏幕画面和麦克风声音并推送到直播间。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法在直播间共享屏幕。

en.description: The VHall chat service can open this Activity as a standalone chat entry, but the analyzed packages give it no screen content. The visible chat is supplied through a separate embedded chat panel.
en.disableEffect: The standalone chat entry cannot be opened if disabled; chat panels embedded in other screens use a separate route.

zh-CN.description: VHall 聊天服务可以通过此 Activity 打开独立聊天入口，但已分析的打包版本没有为它提供页面内容。可见的聊天界面由另一个嵌入式聊天面板提供。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，独立聊天入口无法打开；嵌入其他页面的聊天面板使用不同入口。

en.description: When VHall live video is moved out of its room page, this service places the live player in a movable floating window. Tapping the window returns to the live room.
en.disableEffect: Live video will not continue in a floating window after leaving the room page; watching inside the room still works.

zh-CN.description: 当用户把 VHall 直播画面移出直播间页面时，此 Service 会将播放器放入可移动的悬浮窗。点击悬浮窗可返回直播间。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，离开直播间页面时直播不会继续显示在悬浮窗中；在直播间内观看仍可使用。

en.description: When VHall on-demand video is moved out of its page, this service places the player in a movable floating window and keeps its playback position. Tapping the window returns to the video.
en.disableEffect: On-demand video will not continue in a floating window after leaving its page; watching in the video page still works.

zh-CN.description: 当用户把 VHall 点播视频移出播放页面时，此 Service 会将播放器放入可移动的悬浮窗并保留播放位置。点击悬浮窗可返回视频。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，离开播放页面时点播视频不会继续显示在悬浮窗中；在视频页面内观看仍可使用。

en.description: VHall’s live-event host tools open this screen to review audience questions. Hosts can publish, send again, preview, copy, or remove questions from the event list.
en.disableEffect: Hosts cannot manage audience questions through this screen if it is disabled.

zh-CN.description: VHall 直播活动的主持人工具会通过此页面查看观众问题。主持人可以发布、重新推送、预览、复制或移除活动问题。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，主持人无法通过此页面管理观众问题。

en.description: VHall’s live-event question bank lets a host search saved questions and add a chosen question to the event’s question list.
en.disableEffect: Hosts cannot search the saved question bank or add its questions to an event through this screen if it is disabled.

zh-CN.description: VHall 直播活动的问题库可供主持人搜索已保存的问题，并把选中的问题添加到活动问题列表。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，主持人无法通过此页面搜索问题库或向活动添加其中的问题。

en.description: During a VHall live event, this screen shows the viewer’s question list and opens a selected question or answer page.
en.disableEffect: Viewers cannot browse and open their event questions through this screen if it is disabled.

zh-CN.description: 在 VHall 直播活动中，此页面显示观众的问题列表，并打开选中的问题或回答页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，观众无法通过此页面浏览并打开活动问题。

en.description: The VHall live-event SDK opens this page to join and display a vertical live room. Leaving the page ends the room session unless picture-in-picture playback is active.
en.disableEffect: Viewers may lose access to the VHall vertical live-room route if this page is disabled.

zh-CN.description: VHall 直播活动 SDK 会通过此页面加入并显示竖屏直播间。离开页面时会结束直播间会话，除非正在使用画中画播放。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，观众可能无法通过 VHall 的此入口进入竖屏直播间。

en.description: The VHall SDK opens its portal or a supplied web page inside the app. In some versions, a sign-in response from the page can take the user into a live room.
en.disableEffect: VHall portal pages and any room-entry links that use this browser will not open if it is disabled.

zh-CN.description: VHall SDK 会在应用内打开其门户或传入的网页。在部分版本中，网页的登录响应可以带用户进入直播间。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，使用此浏览器的 VHall 门户页面和进入直播间的链接无法打开。

en.description: The Vhall ZXing barcode client opens its camera scanner when an app requests a QR code or barcode scan, then returns the decoded text to the app.
en.disableEffect: Apps that use this scanner can no longer scan QR codes or barcodes through it.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求扫描二维码或条码时，Vhall ZXing 扫码客户端会打开相机取景页，并将识别出的内容返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，依赖此扫码客户端的应用无法通过它扫描二维码或条码。

en.description: The Vhall ZXing barcode client opens this page when the user chooses help from its scanner. It displays the scanning guide bundled with the client.
en.disableEffect: The scanner's help option can no longer open its guide.

zh-CN.description: 用户从 Vhall ZXing 扫码页打开帮助时，此页面会显示客户端附带的扫码说明。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，扫码页中的帮助入口无法打开说明。

en.description: The Vhall ZXing barcode client opens this screen from the scanner's settings option. It lets users adjust scan formats, lighting, vibration, history, and related scanner preferences.
en.disableEffect: Users can no longer open the scanner settings to change these options.

zh-CN.description: 用户从 Vhall ZXing 扫码页打开设置时，此页面可调整识别格式、补光、震动、历史记录等扫码选项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法打开扫码设置来调整这些选项。

en.description: The Vhall ZXing barcode client opens this screen for an ISBN book-content search. It looks up book excerpts online and displays the returned results.
en.disableEffect: ISBN 图书内容查询功能将无法打开。

zh-CN.description: Vhall ZXing 扫码客户端收到 ISBN 图书内容查询请求时，会在线检索图书片段并显示结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，ISBN 图书内容查询功能无法使用。

en.description: The Vhall ZXing barcode client opens this screen when the app asks it to encode text or contact details. It creates a QR code and can share the resulting image.
en.disableEffect: The app can no longer use this client to create and share QR codes from text or contact details.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求把文本或联系人信息编码成二维码时，Vhall ZXing 扫码客户端会打开此页面生成二维码，并可分享生成的图片。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用无法通过此客户端将文本或联系人信息制成并分享为二维码。

en.description: The Vhall ZXing barcode client opens this screen to show saved scan results. Users can reopen a result, delete records, clear the list, or share the history.
en.disableEffect: Users can no longer view or manage the scanner's saved history.

zh-CN.description: Vhall ZXing 扫码客户端在用户查看扫描历史时显示已保存的结果。用户可以重新查看结果、删除记录、清空列表或分享历史。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法查看或管理扫码历史。

en.description: The Vhall ZXing sharing screen opens this list when the user chooses an installed app to share. It returns that app's store link so the client can encode it as a QR code.
en.disableEffect: The app-selection step for creating QR codes that link to app listings will no longer work.

en.description: Vivo Union uses this Activity to handle links from Vivo Game Center shortcuts. It checks the configured Game Center version and validity period before opening the link or directing the user to a download page.

zh-CN.description: Vivo Union 使用此界面处理来自 Vivo 游戏中心快捷方式的链接。它会检查游戏中心的版本和链接有效期，再打开链接或引导用户前往下载页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 游戏中的 Vivo 游戏中心快捷方式链接将无法打开。

en.description: When an app invokes a Vivo Union service such as sign-in or payment, this Activity displays the corresponding service screen and returns the result to the app.

zh-CN.description: 应用调用 Vivo Union 的登录、支付等服务时，此界面会显示相应服务页面，并将结果返回给应用。

en.description: Vizury Android SDK opens this screen when its notification check finds app notifications turned off and the SDK reminder is enabled. It offers a button to open the app’s notification settings.
en.disableEffect: The Vizury reminder to enable notifications will not appear; users can still change notification settings in Android.

zh-CN.description: 当 Vizury Android SDK 检测到应用通知已关闭且提醒功能已启用时，会打开此页面。页面提供按钮，可前往该应用的系统通知设置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Vizury 的开启通知提醒不会再显示；用户仍可在 Android 系统设置中调整通知。

en.description: Vizury Android SDK opens this screen to display a configured in-app campaign with its text, images, and action buttons.
en.disableEffect: Vizury in-app campaign messages and their buttons will no longer appear.

zh-CN.description: Vizury Android SDK 会在展示应用内营销消息时打开此页面，并显示已配置的文字、图片和操作按钮。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Vizury 的应用内营销消息及其按钮将不再显示。

en.description: Vizury Android SDK opens this transparent screen after a user taps one of its push notifications. It opens the campaign link when available, or returns to the app’s launch screen.
en.disableEffect: Tapping a Vizury push notification will no longer open its link or return to the app.

zh-CN.description: 用户点按 Vizury 推送通知后，Vizury Android SDK 会打开此透明页面。页面会打开通知附带的链接；没有可用链接时则返回应用首页。

en.description: Huawei Push starts this Vizury Android SDK service when a push message or a new push token arrives. It registers updated tokens and passes Vizury messages to the SDK’s notification handler.
en.disableEffect: Huawei-delivered Vizury pushes and token updates will no longer be processed by this SDK service.

zh-CN.description: 收到华为推送消息或新推送令牌时，Huawei Push 会启动 Vizury Android SDK 的此服务。该服务会登记新令牌，并把 Vizury 消息交给 SDK 处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 此服务将不再处理通过华为推送送达的 Vizury 消息或令牌更新。

en.description: Vizury Android SDK schedules this job periodically. In the analyzed version its start callback only records a debug message and reports no work, while its stop callback does nothing.
en.disableEffect: There is no visible change in this version because the scheduled callbacks perform no user-facing work.

zh-CN.description: Vizury Android SDK 会定期安排此任务。在分析的版本中，任务启动时只记录调试信息并报告没有待处理工作，停止时不执行操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 此版本的任务回调不执行面向用户的操作，因此禁用后没有明显变化。

en.description: The VK Android API SDK creates this provider during app startup and uses it to initialize the SDK with the application context.

en.description: The VK Android API SDK opens a confirmation dialog when a request needs the user’s approval, then returns whether the user accepted or cancelled.

zh-CN.description: VK Android API SDK 会在请求需要用户确认时显示确认对话框，并返回用户接受或取消的结果。

zh-CN.description: Vogo PlayerLib 会为媒体播放启动此前台服务，并在应用退到后台时显示可重新打开或停止播放器的通知。
