zh-CN.description: 用户接受 Dolby 来电通知时，此接收器会打开应用的来电界面，并停止临时通知服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通知中的“接听”操作将无法打开来电界面，用户可能无法从该通知加入通话。

en.description: On Android 12 and later, this Dolby UXKit Activity opens from the Accept action on an incoming-call notification and brings the call flow into the app.
en.disableEffect: Accepting a call from its notification may no longer open the app's incoming-call flow on Android 12 and later.

zh-CN.description: 在 Android 12 及更高版本中，用户通过来电通知接听时，Dolby UXKit 的此 Activity 会将来电流程带入应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 在 Android 12 及更高版本中，用户可能无法通过通知中的接听操作打开应用来电流程。

en.description: When Dolby receives an incoming-call invitation, this Service creates the ringing call notification with Accept and Dismiss actions and keeps it visible while the call is pending.
en.disableEffect: Incoming-call invitations will no longer be displayed through this Dolby notification service.

zh-CN.description: Dolby 收到来电邀请时，此 Service 会创建带有“接听”和“拒绝”操作的响铃通知，并在来电等待期间保持显示。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Dolby 将无法通过此通知服务显示来电邀请。

en.description: When a user dismisses a Dolby incoming-call notification, this receiver declines the invitation through the calling SDK and clears its notification state.
en.disableEffect: The notification's Dismiss action will no longer decline the call invitation through Dolby.

zh-CN.description: 用户关闭 Dolby 来电通知时，此接收器会通过通话 SDK 拒绝邀请并清除通知状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通知中的“拒绝”操作将不再通过 Dolby 拒绝来电邀请。

en.description: Dolby.io UX Kit runs this Provider at startup to report the installed call-interface add-on version for diagnostics.
en.disableEffect: The call interface can keep working, but Dolby.io diagnostics will no longer include the UX Kit version.

zh-CN.description: Dolby.io UX Kit 会在应用启动时运行此 Provider，将已安装的通话界面扩展版本报告给诊断系统。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通话界面仍可运行，但 Dolby.io 诊断信息将不再包含 UX Kit 版本。

en.description: At app startup, Dolby UXKit registers its MP4 presenter; when someone shares an MP4 link in a call, the video can play in the presentation view.
en.disableEffect: Shared MP4 videos will no longer play in Dolby call presentations.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，Dolby UXKit 会注册 MP4 播放支持；有人在通话中分享 MP4 链接时，视频才能在演示界面播放。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Dolby 通话中的共享 MP4 视频将无法播放。

en.description: At app startup, Dolby UXKit registers support for screen-share presentations; when a participant shares a screen in a call, the shared view can be displayed.
en.disableEffect: Screen-share presentations in Dolby calls will no longer display through this provider.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，Dolby UXKit 会注册屏幕共享演示支持；通话参与者共享屏幕时，共享画面才能显示。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Dolby 通话中的屏幕共享画面将无法通过此组件显示。

en.description: When Android Telecom requests an incoming or outgoing Dolby VoIP call, this Service creates the system call connection.
en.disableEffect: Android Telecom cannot create the app's incoming or outgoing call connection, so this calling integration fails.

zh-CN.description: Android Telecom 请求创建 Dolby VoIP 来电或去电时，此 Service 会创建系统通话连接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Android Telecom 将无法创建应用的来电或去电连接，因此此通话集成会失效。

en.description: When a user taps Leave in an active Dolby call notification, this receiver ends the joined conference.
en.disableEffect: The Leave control in the call notification stops working, so users lose that shortcut for ending a call.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击 Dolby 通话通知中的“离开”时，此接收器会结束当前已加入的会议。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通话通知中的“离开”操作将失效，用户会失去通过通知结束通话的快捷方式。

en.description: When a user taps Mute in the Dolby call notification, this receiver mutes the call microphone.
en.disableEffect: Users lose the notification shortcut for muting their microphone during a Dolby call.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击 Dolby 通话通知中的“静音”时，此接收器会关闭通话麦克风。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将失去在 Dolby 通话通知中快速关闭麦克风的操作。

en.description: When a user taps Unmute in the Dolby call notification, this receiver turns the call microphone back on.
en.disableEffect: Users lose the notification shortcut for unmuting their microphone during a Dolby call.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击 Dolby 通话通知中的“取消静音”时，此接收器会重新打开通话麦克风。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将失去在 Dolby 通话通知中快速打开麦克风的操作。

en.description: During a Dolby conference, this Service follows call and microphone state and updates the ongoing-call notification; when notification actions are enabled, it adds Leave and Mute or Unmute controls.
en.disableEffect: The Dolby ongoing-call notification and state updates will be unavailable, and its call controls may disappear.

zh-CN.description: Dolby 会议期间，此 Service 会跟踪通话和麦克风状态并更新持续显示的通话通知；启用通知操作时，还会提供离开和静音或取消静音按钮。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Dolby 的持续通话通知及状态更新将不可用，通知中的通话控制按钮也可能消失。

en.description: When an app uses Dolby UXKit's system-call notifications, this startup Provider registers the service that maintains the active-call notification and its controls.
en.disableEffect: The Dolby active-call service may not be registered, so its ongoing notification and controls may not appear.

zh-CN.description: 应用使用 Dolby UXKit 的系统通话通知时，此启动 Provider 会注册维护当前通话通知及控制按钮的服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Dolby 当前通话服务可能无法注册，因此持续通话通知和控制按钮可能不会显示。

en.description: At app startup, Dolby UXKit registers support for YouTube links in call presentations so shared YouTube videos can be shown to call participants.
en.disableEffect: YouTube videos shared as Dolby call presentations will no longer open through this provider.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，Dolby UXKit 会注册通话演示中的 YouTube 链接支持，使通话参与者可以观看共享视频。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 作为 Dolby 通话演示共享的 YouTube 视频将无法通过此组件打开。

en.description: Voximplant Kit Chat UI opens this screen to show a conversation’s message history and message-composition controls.
en.disableEffect: In-app chat provided by the Voximplant Kit Chat UI will be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: Voximplant Kit Chat UI 会打开此页面，显示会话消息记录和撰写消息的控件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Voximplant Kit Chat UI 提供的应用内聊天功能将无法使用。

en.description: Voximplant Kit Chat UI starts this foreground service for chat file uploads and displays an upload-progress notification while selected files are being handled.
en.disableEffect: Chat uploads started through this UI may fail in the background, and their progress notification will be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: Voximplant Kit Chat UI 会为聊天文件上传启动此前台服务，并在处理所选文件时显示上传进度通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过此界面启动的聊天上传可能无法在后台完成，上传进度通知也将不可用。

en.description: Voximplant Kit Chat UI starts this foreground service for chat file uploads and displays an upload-progress notification while selected files are being handled.
en.disableEffect: Chat uploads started through this UI may fail in the background, and their progress notification will be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: Voximplant Kit Chat UI 会为聊天文件上传启动此前台服务，并在处理所选文件时显示上传进度通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过此界面启动的聊天上传可能无法在后台完成，上传进度通知也将不可用。

en.description: VPlayed Player SDK packages this landscape sample screen as an app launcher. It initializes the player and starts the bundled sample video stream.
en.disableEffect: The VPlayed sample launcher and its video player will not open.

zh-CN.description: VPlayed Player SDK 将此横屏示例页面作为应用启动页打包。页面会初始化播放器并播放随 SDK 提供的示例视频流。
zh-CN.disableEffect: VPlayed 示例启动页及其视频播放器将无法打开。

en.description: When the device reports a network connection, the FyreON (VRSWeb) forum widget checks its saved crash reports and uploads them if reporting is enabled.
en.disableEffect: The app keeps its normal features, but saved crash reports will not upload automatically when the network returns.

zh-CN.description: 设备报告网络连接恢复时，FyreON（VRSWeb）论坛组件会检查已保存的崩溃报告；启用报告功能时会将其上传。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用日常功能不受影响，但网络恢复时不会自动上传已保存的崩溃报告。

en.description: When a user opens an app entry in FyreON (VRSWeb), this screen shows the app name and icon, likes, comments, and related discussion details.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot open the FyreON app detail and discussion screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 FyreON（VRSWeb）中打开应用条目时，此页面会显示应用名称和图标、点赞数、评论数及相关讨论。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法打开 FyreON 的应用详情和讨论页面。

en.description: When a user opens a discussion item in FyreON (VRSWeb), this screen loads its comments and lets signed-in users post a reply.
en.disableEffect: FyreON discussions cannot be opened here, and users cannot post replies through this screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 FyreON（VRSWeb）中打开讨论条目时，此页面会加载评论，并允许已登录用户发表回复。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此页面打开 FyreON 讨论或发表回复。

en.description: When a user opens the people list for a FyreON (VRSWeb) comment, this screen shows the users who liked it or replied to it.
en.disableEffect: The list of users who liked or replied to a FyreON comment cannot be opened.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 FyreON（VRSWeb）评论的用户列表时，此页面会显示点赞或回复该评论的人。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开点赞或回复 FyreON 评论的人员列表。

en.description: When a user signs in or connects an account through FyreON (VRSWeb), this screen offers the enabled FyreON, Facebook, Twitter, or Google sign-in options and returns account details to the SDK.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot complete the sign-in or account-connection flows provided through FyreON.

zh-CN.description: 用户通过 FyreON（VRSWeb）登录或关联账号时，此页面会提供已启用的 FyreON、Facebook、Twitter 或 Google 登录方式，并将账号信息交回组件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法完成 FyreON 提供的登录或账号关联流程。

en.description: During Twitter sign-in through FyreON (VRSWeb), this screen loads the authorization page and returns the verification result so sign-in can continue.
en.disableEffect: Twitter sign-in through FyreON cannot complete.

zh-CN.description: 通过 FyreON（VRSWeb）使用 Twitter 登录时，此页面会加载授权页面，并返回验证结果以继续登录。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法完成通过 FyreON 进行的 Twitter 登录。

en.description: After a user signs in to FyreON (VRSWeb), this screen loads the profile, account details, and tabs for the user’s apps, comments, and likes; it also provides logout.
en.disableEffect: Users lose access to the FyreON profile, activity tabs, and logout screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户登录 FyreON（VRSWeb）后，此页面会加载个人资料、账号信息，以及其应用、评论和点赞记录标签页；页面也提供退出登录功能。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开 FyreON 个人资料、活动记录标签页或退出登录页面。

en.description: When the FyreON (VRSWeb) wizard is opened, this screen hosts a five-page image guide with next, previous, and finish controls.
en.disableEffect: The in-app FyreON guide cannot be opened.

zh-CN.description: 打开 FyreON（VRSWeb）向导时，此页面会显示包含五页图片的指南，并提供上一步、下一步和完成按钮。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用内的 FyreON 指南将无法打开。

en.description: VSee Kit opens this screen when a meeting host selects a breakout room. It lists the room’s participants and lets the host move participants or remove the room.
en.disableEffect: Hosts will not be able to view or manage participants in a breakout room.

zh-CN.description: 会议主持人选择分组讨论室时，VSee Kit 会打开此页面。页面列出房间参与者，并允许主持人移动参与者或删除房间。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 主持人将无法查看或管理分组讨论室中的参与者。

en.description: VSee Kit opens this screen for an active audio or video meeting. It shows the call and provides controls for the camera, picture-in-picture, and ending the call.
en.disableEffect: The VSee in-call screen and its call controls will be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: VSee Kit 会在音频或视频会议进行时打开此页面，显示通话画面，并提供摄像头、画中画和结束通话等控制。
zh-CN.disableEffect: VSee 通话页面及其通话控制将无法使用。

en.description: VSee Kit opens this screen from a group meeting to list participants and offer invite, phone dial-in, and breakout-room controls.
en.disableEffect: Users will lose the participant list and the related invite, dial-in, and breakout-room controls.

zh-CN.description: 用户从群组会议打开此页面时，VSee Kit 会显示参与者列表，并提供邀请、电话接入和分组讨论室控制。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法查看参与者列表，也无法使用相关邀请、电话接入和分组讨论室控制。

en.description: VSee Kit opens the selected conversation from a chat or notification. It displays the message thread and updates unread counts and chat notifications.
en.disableEffect: VSee conversations cannot be opened through this chat screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户从聊天列表或通知打开会话时，VSee Kit 会显示消息记录并更新未读状态和聊天通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 将无法通过此聊天页面打开 VSee 会话。

en.description: VSee Kit opens this screen for a meeting’s phone-bridge details. It shows the dial-in number and PIN and can pass them to the phone dialer.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to view or dial the meeting’s phone-bridge details through VSee Kit.

zh-CN.description: VSee Kit 会打开此页面显示会议的电话接入号码和 PIN，并可将这些信息交给电话拨号器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 VSee Kit 查看或拨打会议电话接入信息。

en.description: VSee Kit opens this screen when a user chooses to call a phone number from a meeting. It accepts the number and starts an outbound call.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to place an outbound phone call through this VSee Kit screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择从会议拨打电话号码时，VSee Kit 会打开此页面接收号码并发起外拨电话。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此 VSee Kit 页面拨打外部电话号码。

en.description: VSee Kit opens this screen when a user selects a file attachment in chat. It shows the file details and offers download, open, or share actions.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to view or open chat file attachments through this screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户在聊天中选择文件附件时，VSee Kit 会打开此页面显示文件信息，并提供下载、打开或分享操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此页面查看或打开聊天文件附件。

en.description: VSee Kit opens this screen for a group conversation to show its details and participants. Users can change the group name and manage group-chat actions.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to view or manage group-conversation details through VSee Kit.

zh-CN.description: VSee Kit 会为群组会话打开此页面，显示群组信息和参与者。用户可以修改群组名称并管理群聊操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 VSee Kit 查看或管理群组会话信息。

en.description: VSee Kit opens this screen when a user selects an image in chat. It downloads and displays the full-size photo and can save it to the gallery.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to view or save chat photos through this screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户在聊天中选择图片时，VSee Kit 会打开此页面下载并显示原尺寸照片，也可将照片保存到图库。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此页面查看或保存聊天照片。

en.description: VSee Kit opens this screen after a call when it requests call-quality feedback. Users can rate the call, add a comment, and choose whether to attach logs.
en.disableEffect: The optional post-call quality survey will no longer appear.

zh-CN.description: VSee Kit 请求通话质量反馈时，会在通话后打开此页面。用户可评价通话、填写意见，并选择是否附上日志。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 可选的通话后质量调查将不再显示。

en.description: VSee’s application SDK runs this receiver on a scheduled background alarm after login is initialized. It sends a connection check and schedules the next check.
en.disableEffect: VSee may stop maintaining its background connection, so incoming calls or chats may be delayed when push notifications are unavailable.

zh-CN.description: VSee 应用 SDK 会在登录初始化后，通过预定的后台闹钟运行此接收器。它会检查连接并安排下一次检查。
zh-CN.disableEffect: VSee 可能不再维持后台连接；当推送通知不可用时，来电或聊天消息可能延迟。

en.description: VSee Kit uses this foreground service while an audio or video call runs in the background. It posts the ongoing-call notification and keeps call services active.
en.disableEffect: An active call may stop or lose its ongoing notification when the app is in the background.

zh-CN.description: 音频或视频通话在后台进行时，VSee Kit 会使用此前台服务显示持续通话通知并维持通话服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用处于后台时，正在进行的通话可能停止，或失去持续通话通知。

en.description: VSee’s application SDK runs this service when the end-call action in its call notification is selected. It ends the active audio or video call.
en.disableEffect: The end-call button in the VSee notification may not end the call; the in-call screen still has its own end control.

zh-CN.description: 用户点按 VSee 通话通知中的结束通话操作时，VSee 应用 SDK 会运行此服务并结束当前音频或视频通话。
zh-CN.disableEffect: VSee 通知中的结束通话按钮可能无法结束通话；通话页面仍有自己的结束控制。

en.description: VSee’s application SDK starts this foreground service when the app enters the background in battery-saver mode while VSee services are being suspended. It shows a persistent status notification and stops when the app returns to the foreground.
en.disableEffect: The background-suspension notification may be missing, and Android may suspend the app sooner while it is idle.

zh-CN.description: VSee 服务准备暂停且应用在省电模式下进入后台时，VSee 应用 SDK 会启动此前台服务。它显示持续状态通知，并在应用回到前台时停止。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 后台服务暂停状态通知可能不再显示，Android 也可能在应用空闲时更早暂停它。

en.description: Vungle (Liftoff) prepares its ad service automatically when the app starts so the app can request and show Vungle ads later.
en.disableEffect: Vungle ads may no longer initialize or appear; the app's other features remain available.

zh-CN.description: Vungle（Liftoff）会在应用启动时自动准备广告服务，供应用之后请求并展示 Vungle 广告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Vungle 广告可能无法初始化或展示；应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: When a Vungle full-screen ad opens, this screen displays the ad and handles playback, closing, and returning from an ad destination.
en.disableEffect: Vungle full-screen ads will not open; other app screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: Vungle 全屏广告打开时，此界面负责展示广告、处理播放和关闭，并在用户从广告跳转页面返回后继续处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Vungle 全屏广告将无法打开；应用的其他界面仍可使用。

en.description: Vungle opens this screen to play a full-screen video ad and report its playback.
en.disableEffect: Vungle full-screen ads will not play, and any reward tied to completing one will not be granted.

zh-CN.description: Vungle 会用此页面播放全屏视频广告并记录播放情况。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Vungle 全屏广告将无法播放；与看完广告相关的奖励也无法获得。

en.description: Vungle Publisher SDK opens this full-screen page to display an interactive ad.
en.disableEffect: Vungle interactive ads that use this page will not display.

zh-CN.description: Vungle Publisher SDK 会打开此全屏页面展示互动广告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此页面的 Vungle 互动广告将无法显示。

en.description: Vungle Publisher SDK opens this full-screen player to show video ads, including videos offered in exchange for an in-app reward.
en.disableEffect: Vungle video ads that use this player will not play, and rewards for watching rewarded videos will not be granted.

zh-CN.description: Vungle Publisher SDK 会打开此全屏播放器展示视频广告，也包括观看后可获得应用内奖励的视频广告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此播放器的 Vungle 视频广告将无法播放，观看奖励视频也不会获得奖励。

en.description: Vungle uses this background service to download ad content, prepare ads, and handle ad-delivery network requests.
en.disableEffect: Vungle ads will not be prepared or delivered, while the host app’s other features remain available.

zh-CN.description: Vungle 通过此后台服务下载广告内容、准备广告并处理广告投放所需的网络请求。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Vungle 广告将无法准备或投放，应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: The Vungle ads SDK uses this receiver for network-connectivity changes so it can refresh its network status.
en.disableEffect: Vungle ads may not respond correctly when the device's network connection changes.

zh-CN.description: Vungle 广告 SDK 通过此 Receiver 监听网络连接变化，以更新网络状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 设备网络连接变化时，Vungle 广告可能无法正确响应。

en.description: Vungle Ads opens this screen to show a video or web ad for the requested placement.
en.disableEffect: Vungle ads will not open, and rewards for watching rewarded ads will no longer be granted; other app features continue to work.

zh-CN.description: Vungle Ads 会打开此页面，根据请求的广告位展示视频或网页广告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Vungle 广告将无法打开，观看奖励型广告也不再获得奖励；应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: Vungle Ads uses this screen to display an ad that adjusts to different layouts.
en.disableEffect: Vungle flexible-format ads will not open, and rewards from any rewarded placement using it will no longer be granted; other app features continue to work.

zh-CN.description: Vungle Ads 使用此页面展示可适配布局的广告内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Vungle 适配布局广告将无法打开，使用该页面的奖励型广告也不再发放奖励；应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: Vungle Ads opens this screen to show the web page linked from an ad and handle links opened by the user.
en.disableEffect: Vungle ad landing pages will not open; the app’s other features continue to work.

zh-CN.description: Vungle Ads 会打开此页面显示广告链接的网页，并处理用户打开的链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Vungle 广告落地页将无法打开，应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: Vungle's publisher ads SDK runs this Provider at app startup and registers for app-screen lifecycle changes used by its ad flows.
en.disableEffect: Vungle will not receive these automatic app foreground and background updates for its ads.

zh-CN.description: Vungle 发布商广告 SDK 会在应用启动时运行此 Provider，并注册其广告流程所需的应用界面生命周期变化。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Vungle 将无法自动收到应用进入前台或后台的状态更新。

en.description: When Vuukle serves an in-house interstitial ad, this screen displays its image or video and provides close, skip, mute, and download controls.
en.disableEffect: Vuukle in-house ads will not be shown; the app's other features remain available.

zh-CN.description: Vuukle 展示自有插屏广告时，此界面会显示图片或视频广告，并提供关闭、跳过、静音和下载控件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Vuukle 自有插屏广告将不会显示；应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: Vuukle's in-house ads use this provider to store and retrieve app-install click IDs for ad attribution.
en.disableEffect: Vuukle will lose stored click-attribution data; the app's other features remain available.

zh-CN.description: Vuukle 自有广告通过此 Provider 保存和读取应用安装点击 ID，用于广告归因。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Vuukle 将无法读取已保存的点击归因数据；应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: When Google Play sends an install-referral broadcast, this Vuukle receiver reads its click ID and records it for in-house ad attribution.
en.disableEffect: Vuukle will not receive these install click IDs, so install attribution is lost.

zh-CN.description: Google Play 发送安装来源广播时，此 Vuukle Receiver 会读取其中的点击 ID，并记录下来用于自有广告归因。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Vuukle 将无法收到这些安装点击 ID，因此会失去相应的安装归因数据。

en.description: When Vuukle's ad service starts a full-screen real-time-bidding ad, this screen displays it and handles closing and completion.
en.disableEffect: Vuukle full-screen ads will not open; the app's regular screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: Vuukle 的广告服务启动全屏实时竞价广告时，此界面会展示广告并处理关闭和播放完成。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Vuukle 全屏广告将无法打开；应用的常规界面仍可使用。

en.description: The zguop Wisdom image-selection library opens this Activity when a user previews selected photos; it lets the user move between images and change which ones are selected.
en.disableEffect: The app's photo preview and selection screen cannot open.

zh-CN.description: zguop 的 Wisdom 图片选择库在用户预览已选照片时打开此 Activity；用户可切换查看图片并更改选择。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用的照片预览和选择界面无法打开。

en.description: The zguop Wisdom image-selection library opens this Activity when an app requests photo selection; it shows the photo albums and lets the user choose items or open their previews.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot show the Wisdom album picker or return selected photos through it.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求选择照片时，zguop 的 Wisdom 图片选择库会打开此 Activity；它显示相册，供用户选择照片或进入预览。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用无法显示 Wisdom 相册选择界面，也无法通过它返回所选照片。

en.description: When the app opens RoomExplorer with a local database selected, this screen lists its tables and records and lets the user run queries or change and remove rows.
en.disableEffect: Users lose the in-app database inspection screen; the app's normal features can still use the database.

zh-CN.description: 应用使用 RoomExplorer 打开本地数据库时，此界面会列出数据表和记录，并允许运行查询、修改或删除记录。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法使用应用内的数据库查看界面；应用的常规功能仍可使用该数据库。

en.description: Wallee Payment SDK opens this screen when checkout begins. It loads the payment interface and payment methods such as TWINT.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open or complete payments through Wallee Payment SDK.

zh-CN.description: Wallee 支付 SDK 在结账开始时打开此界面，加载支付界面及包括 TWINT 在内的支付方式。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 Wallee 支付 SDK 打开或完成付款。

en.description: Wallee Payment SDK shows this branded loading screen while checkout starts and closes it when the payment screen is ready.
en.disableEffect: The checkout launcher cannot show its loading screen, so opening a Wallee payment flow fails.

zh-CN.description: Wallee 支付 SDK 启动结账时会显示此品牌加载界面，并在支付界面就绪后将其关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 结账启动器无法显示加载界面，Wallee 支付流程将无法打开。

en.description: Wallee's payment SDK opens this screen when checkout begins. It presents the payment interface and supports payment-method interactions, including Twint.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents the Wallee payment screen from opening, so customers may not be able to complete checkout.

zh-CN.description: Wallee 支付 SDK 在结账开始时打开此界面，展示支付流程，并处理包括 Twint 在内的支付方式交互。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Wallee 支付界面无法打开，用户可能无法完成结账。

en.description: Wallee's payment SDK shows this themed loading screen while checkout starts, then closes it after receiving the signal that the payment screen is ready.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it can interrupt checkout startup or leave the payment flow without its loading screen.

zh-CN.description: Wallee 支付 SDK 在结账启动时显示此主题加载界面，并在收到支付界面就绪的信号后将其关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，结账启动可能被中断，或支付流程无法正常显示加载界面。

en.description: Walmart Labs LiveBundle opens for a LiveBundle link or package-scan request and switches a React Native app to a remotely hosted code package, then reloads the app with it.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot switch to a LiveBundle package from this app; its ordinary features remain available.

zh-CN.description: Walmart Labs LiveBundle 在打开 LiveBundle 链接或请求扫描程序包时启动，将 React Native 应用切换到远程代码包并重新加载应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法从此应用切换到 LiveBundle 程序包；应用的常规功能仍可使用。

en.description: Walmart Labs LiveBundle opens this screen to scan a package code or handle a LiveBundle link, then reloads the React Native app with the selected remote package.
en.disableEffect: LiveBundle package scanning and switching will stop; ordinary app features remain available.

zh-CN.description: Walmart Labs LiveBundle 使用此界面扫描程序包二维码或处理 LiveBundle 链接，然后使用所选远程程序包重新加载 React Native 应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，LiveBundle 程序包扫描和切换功能将停止；应用的常规功能仍可使用。

en.description: AndroidProgressHUD's demo screen is the app's launcher. Its sample button runs a timed task that changes the progress message from connecting to downloading and done.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it removes the demo app's launcher screen and prevents the sample progress task from running.

zh-CN.description: AndroidProgressHUD 演示界面是此应用的启动页。点击示例按钮会运行一个计时任务，并依次显示连接中、下载中和完成等进度提示。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，演示应用的启动页和示例进度任务都无法使用。

en.description: When the host app opens this JavaTools Activity directly, it applies the app's selected language and logs screen lifecycle events; it has no screen content of its own.
en.disableEffect: Only direct launches of this empty helper screen stop working; the app's other screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: 宿主应用直接打开 JavaTools Activity 时，它会应用该应用所选语言并记录页面生命周期；它本身没有页面内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，只有这个空白辅助页面无法直接打开，应用的其他页面仍可使用。

en.description: When the JavaTools service is running and device orientation changes, it updates the library's orientation state for screens that use those updates.
en.disableEffect: Apps that rely on JavaTools for rotation updates will stop receiving the current portrait or landscape state.

zh-CN.description: JavaTools 服务运行期间，设备方向变化时它会更新方向状态，供使用这些更新的页面读取。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，依赖 JavaTools 方向更新的应用页面将无法收到当前的横屏或竖屏状态。

en.description: When a host app starts JavaTools LogService, it keeps an ongoing notification and periodically saves the app's logs to a file.
en.disableEffect: New diagnostic log files will no longer be collected in the background.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动 JavaTools 日志服务后，它会显示持续通知，并定期将应用日志保存到文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，后台将不再收集新的诊断日志文件。

en.description: When Android reports Wi-Fi state or connectivity changes, JavaTools tells the app's registered callback when Wi-Fi turns on or off and notes connectivity changes.
en.disableEffect: Wi-Fi state changes will no longer reach JavaTools callbacks, so app functions that react to Wi-Fi may not update.

zh-CN.description: Android 报告 Wi-Fi 状态或网络连接变化时，JavaTools 会在 Wi-Fi 开启或关闭时通知应用注册的回调，并记录网络变化。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，JavaTools 回调将收不到 Wi-Fi 状态变化，依赖这些变化的应用功能可能无法更新。

en.description: The lavalike OkHttp network SDK starts this provider with the app to save its application context and register activity tracking used by the networking library. This initialization happens before the app shows a screen.
en.disableEffect: The SDK's networking setup may be missing, and calls that rely on it can fail.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，lavalike 的 OkHttp 网络 SDK 会通过此提供器保存应用上下文，并注册网络库使用的界面生命周期跟踪。此初始化会在显示界面前发生。
zh-CN.disableEffect: SDK 的网络初始化可能缺失，依赖它的网络请求可能失败。

en.description: When Wappier's Optimization SDK has a full-screen interstitial ad ready, this screen displays its image and text with close and action buttons.
en.disableEffect: Wappier interstitial ads and their linked actions will not open; the app's other screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: Wappier Optimization SDK 准备好全屏插屏广告时，此界面会显示广告图片和文字，并提供关闭和操作按钮。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Wappier 插屏广告及其关联操作将无法打开；应用的其他界面仍可使用。

en.description: Wappier's loyalty program opens this screen to show an achievement and its associated reward groups.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot view Wappier achievement details and related reward groups in the app.

zh-CN.description: Wappier 忠诚度计划使用此界面展示成就及其关联的奖励组。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法在应用中查看 Wappier 成就详情和相关奖励组。

en.description: When a user chooses to earn points from Wappier's loyalty menu, this screen displays the available point-earning reward groups.
en.disableEffect: Users may lose access to Wappier's point-earning offers in the app.

zh-CN.description: 用户从 Wappier 忠诚度菜单选择赚取积分时，此界面会显示可参与的积分奖励组。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户可能无法在应用中使用 Wappier 的积分获取活动。

en.description: When a user opens Wappier loyalty, this screen shows the loyalty home page and links to points, goals, quests, achievements, scratch cards, and rewards.
en.disableEffect: The app's Wappier loyalty menu and the features it links to will be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 Wappier 忠诚度功能时，此界面会显示首页，并提供积分、目标、任务、成就、刮奖卡和奖励入口。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用中的 Wappier 忠诚度菜单及其关联功能将无法使用。

en.description: Wappier opens this screen for a selected loyalty objective. It shows the objective's details and progress and can refresh it after an update.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot review or update this Wappier objective in the app.

zh-CN.description: Wappier 为选定的忠诚度目标打开此界面，展示目标详情和进度，并可在更新后重新载入目标。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法在应用中查看或更新此 Wappier 目标。

en.description: When a user selects a Wappier loyalty quest, this screen shows its steps and updates its status as points or rewards are completed.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot view or complete this Wappier quest in the app.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择 Wappier 忠诚度任务时，此界面会展示任务步骤，并在积分或奖励目标完成时更新状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法在应用中查看或完成此 Wappier 任务。

en.description: When a user selects a Wappier reward group, this screen shows available rewards and points and handles choosing and redeeming a reward.
en.disableEffect: Users may not be able to browse or redeem Wappier rewards in the app.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择 Wappier 奖励组时，此界面会展示可用奖励和积分，并处理奖励选择与兑换。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户可能无法在应用中浏览或兑换 Wappier 奖励。

en.description: When a user opens a Wappier scratch-card offer, this screen lets them scratch the card to reveal the loyalty result.
en.disableEffect: Wappier scratch-card offers cannot be opened or revealed in the app.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 Wappier 刮奖卡活动时，此界面允许用户刮开卡片并查看忠诚度奖励结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用中的 Wappier 刮奖卡活动无法打开或揭晓结果。

en.description: The Wareroom VersionCheck SDK declares this legacy background service for its older version-check flow. It can request version data or start an explicitly configured download, but this bundled implementation ignores the server response.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it stops the legacy updater path; applications using that path will not receive its version-check or download handling.

zh-CN.description: Wareroom VersionCheck SDK 将此服务用于旧版后台版本检查流程，可请求版本信息或处理显式配置的下载，但此构建版本会忽略服务器返回内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，旧版更新流程无法由此服务处理版本检查或下载请求。

en.description: The Wareroom VersionCheck SDK opens this prompt when an update download needs storage access. It reports whether permission was granted so the updater can continue or stop.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it can stop an update download when storage permission is required.

zh-CN.description: Wareroom VersionCheck SDK 在更新下载需要存储权限时打开此提示，并把授权结果返回给更新流程以继续或停止下载。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，需要存储权限的更新下载流程无法继续。

en.description: The Wareroom VersionCheck SDK opens this legacy version-update dialog when an update is ready. Users can accept or cancel, view download progress, retry a failed download, and install the downloaded package.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it breaks the legacy update prompt and APK download/install flow.

zh-CN.description: Wareroom VersionCheck SDK 在旧版更新流程发现新版本后显示更新提示，用户可接受或取消，并查看下载进度、重试失败下载和安装更新包。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，旧版更新提示、APK 下载和安装流程无法完成。

en.description: The Wareroom VersionCheck SDK uses this non-exported file provider to grant Android's installer access to a downloaded APK during an update.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents the updater from handing the downloaded APK to the installer.

zh-CN.description: Wareroom VersionCheck SDK 使用此非导出文件提供方，在更新时向 Android 安装程序授予读取已下载 APK 的权限。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，更新程序无法将下载的 APK 交给安装程序。

en.description: The Wareroom VersionCheck SDK opens this page when an APK download fails. It offers retry or cancel and resumes or closes the update flow accordingly.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it removes the update-download failure and retry screen.

zh-CN.description: Wareroom VersionCheck SDK 在 APK 下载失败时打开此页，提供重试或取消，并据此继续或关闭更新流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法在下载失败页重试或取消更新。

en.description: The Wareroom VersionCheck SDK opens this page while an APK is downloading. It displays progress and lets the user cancel the download.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it removes the download-progress screen and cancellation controls.

zh-CN.description: Wareroom VersionCheck SDK 在 APK 下载期间打开此页，显示进度并允许用户取消下载。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法查看更新下载进度或从此页取消下载。

en.description: The Wareroom VersionCheck SDK opens this page when a version check finds an update. It shows the update prompt and starts or cancels download and installation according to the user's choice.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it breaks the app's in-app update prompt and its accept or cancel flow.

zh-CN.description: Wareroom VersionCheck SDK 在版本检查发现更新时打开此页，显示更新提示，并按用户选择开始或取消下载与安装。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用内更新提示及接受或取消更新的流程无法使用。

en.description: The Wareroom VersionCheck SDK runs this foreground service to download update APKs, publish progress and failure notices, and begin installation after a successful download.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it stops the in-app APK download and update-installation flow.

zh-CN.description: Wareroom VersionCheck SDK 通过此前台服务下载更新 APK、发布进度和失败通知，并在下载成功后开始安装。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用内更新 APK 下载和安装流程会停止。

en.description: When Firebase Cloud Messaging delivers a Machbird push message or token update, this service passes it to the SDK's push handler.
en.disableEffect: Machbird push messages and push token updates will no longer be received.

zh-CN.description: Firebase Cloud Messaging 送达 Machbird 推送消息或令牌更新时，此 Service 会将其交给 SDK 的推送处理器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Machbird 将不再接收推送消息和推送令牌更新。

en.description: When a user taps a Machbird push notification, this screen opens its requested app link, web page, or store listing.
en.disableEffect: Tapping Machbird push notifications will no longer open their destinations.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击 Machbird 推送通知时，此页面会打开通知指定的应用链接、网页或商店页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 点击 Machbird 推送通知后将无法打开对应目标。

en.description: When a user taps a Machbird push notification, this screen opens its requested app link, web page, or store listing.
en.disableEffect: Tapping Machbird push notifications will no longer open their destinations.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击 Machbird 推送通知时，此页面会打开通知指定的应用链接、网页或商店页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 点击 Machbird 推送通知后将无法打开对应目标。

en.description: When an app opens an in-app link through Tio AndroidUtils, this Activity loads the page in the app’s browser, shows its title and loading progress, and supports back navigation.
en.disableEffect: Links routed through Tio’s in-app browser will not open.

zh-CN.description: 应用通过 Tio AndroidUtils 打开应用内链接时，此 Activity 会在网页视图中加载页面，显示标题和加载进度，并支持返回上一页。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，通过 Tio 应用内浏览器打开的链接将无法打开。

en.description: When an app sends a video URL to Tio AndroidUtils, this Activity starts video playback with full-screen and back controls, and pauses or resumes playback as the screen changes state.
en.disableEffect: Videos routed to Tio’s player will no longer play in the app.

zh-CN.description: 应用将视频地址交给 Tio AndroidUtils 时，此 Activity 会开始播放视频，提供全屏和返回控制，并随页面状态暂停或恢复播放。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用中交由 Tio 播放器处理的视频将无法播放。

en.description: When Android reports that an audio output such as headphones has disconnected, this Tio AndroidUtils Receiver runs; it does not pause playback or otherwise change the app.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it has no playback effect in this version because the Receiver takes no action.

zh-CN.description: Android 报告耳机等音频输出设备已断开时，Tio AndroidUtils 的此 Receiver 会运行；但它不会暂停播放，也不会改变应用状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 此版本中停用它不会影响播放，因为该 Receiver 不执行实际操作。

en.description: When Tio AppUpdate opens a downloaded update package with Android’s installer, this provider passes the update file to the installer using Android’s file permissions.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents downloaded updates from being opened for installation, so the updater reports an installation failure.

zh-CN.description: Tio AppUpdate 通过 Android 安装器打开已下载的更新包时，此 Provider 会按 Android 的文件权限将更新文件交给安装器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，已下载的更新包无法交给安装器，更新流程会安装失败。

en.description: When Android reports that an update download is complete, Tio AppUpdate finds the downloaded package and starts installation if the app is set to install updates automatically; tapping the download notification opens the system Downloads screen.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it stops automatic update installation and prevents the updater’s download notification from opening the Downloads screen.

zh-CN.description: Android 报告更新包下载完成时，如果应用设置为自动安装更新，Tio AppUpdate 会查找文件并启动安装；点击下载通知则会打开系统下载页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，更新包不会自动进入安装流程，更新通知也无法打开系统下载页面。

en.description: Watayouxiang's Tio chat SDK opens this screen when the user scans a code or chooses an image to read a QR code.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, users cannot scan or read QR codes through this Tio screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户扫描二维码或选择图片识别二维码时，Watayouxiang Tio 聊天 SDK 会打开此页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法通过 Tio 此页面扫描或识别二维码。

en.description: Watayouxiang's Tio chat SDK opens this screen to load group details and create a QR code that can be saved or shared as a group invitation.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, users cannot view, save, or share a group invitation QR code through this screen.

zh-CN.description: Watayouxiang Tio 聊天 SDK 会打开此页面读取群信息，并生成可保存或分享的群邀请二维码。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法通过此页面查看、保存或分享群邀请二维码。

en.description: Watayouxiang's Tio chat SDK opens this screen to create the signed-in user's personal QR code, which can be saved.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, users cannot view or save their personal QR code through this screen.

zh-CN.description: Watayouxiang Tio 聊天 SDK 会打开此页面生成当前用户的个人二维码，供用户保存。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法通过此页面查看或保存个人二维码。
