en.disableEffect: If disabled, users cannot review or submit the identity details required to use the wallet.

zh-CN.description: 这是 Watayouxiang Tio SDK 集成的首信易支付钱包页面。用户可在此查看或提交使用钱包所需的身份信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法查看或提交使用钱包所需的身份信息。

en.description: The Watayouxiang Tio SDK's PayEase (首信易支付) wallet opens this screen when the user chooses to view the wallet's transaction history.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, users cannot view the wallet's transaction history.

zh-CN.description: 这是 Watayouxiang Tio SDK 集成的首信易支付钱包页面。用户可在此查看钱包交易记录。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法查看钱包交易记录。

en.description: The Watayouxiang Tio SDK's PayEase (首信易支付) wallet opens this screen when the user chooses to view the details of a selected wallet transaction.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, users cannot view the details of a selected wallet transaction.

zh-CN.description: 这是 Watayouxiang Tio SDK 集成的首信易支付钱包页面。用户可在此查看所选钱包交易的详情。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法查看所选钱包交易的详情。

en.description: The Watayouxiang Tio SDK's PayEase (首信易支付) wallet opens this screen when the user chooses to open and activate a wallet account.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, users cannot open and activate a wallet account.

zh-CN.description: 这是 Watayouxiang Tio SDK 集成的首信易支付钱包页面。用户可在此开通并启用钱包账户。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法开通并启用钱包账户。

en.description: The Watayouxiang Tio SDK's PayEase (首信易支付) wallet opens this screen when the user chooses to view a selected red-envelope payment and its status.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, users cannot view a selected red-envelope payment and its status.

zh-CN.description: 这是 Watayouxiang Tio SDK 集成的首信易支付钱包页面。用户可在此查看所选红包及其状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法查看所选红包及其状态。

en.description: The Watayouxiang Tio SDK's PayEase (首信易支付) wallet opens this screen when the user chooses to enter an amount and start adding money to the wallet.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, users cannot enter an amount and start adding money to the wallet.

zh-CN.description: 这是 Watayouxiang Tio SDK 集成的首信易支付钱包页面。用户可在此输入金额并开始向钱包充值。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法输入金额并开始向钱包充值。

en.description: The Watayouxiang Tio SDK's PayEase (首信易支付) wallet opens this screen when the user chooses to view the result of a wallet top-up.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, users cannot view the result of a wallet top-up.

zh-CN.description: 这是 Watayouxiang Tio SDK 集成的首信易支付钱包页面。用户可在此查看钱包充值结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法查看钱包充值结果。

en.description: The Watayouxiang Tio SDK's PayEase (首信易支付) wallet opens this screen when the user chooses to view received and sent red-envelope records.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, users cannot view received and sent red-envelope records.

zh-CN.description: 这是 Watayouxiang Tio SDK 集成的首信易支付钱包页面。用户可在此查看收到和发出的红包记录。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法查看收到和发出的红包记录。

en.description: The Watayouxiang Tio SDK's PayEase (首信易支付) wallet opens this screen when the user chooses to compose and send a red envelope in a chat.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, users cannot compose and send a red envelope in a chat.

zh-CN.description: 这是 Watayouxiang Tio SDK 集成的首信易支付钱包页面。用户可在此在聊天中填写并发送红包。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法在聊天中填写并发送红包。

en.description: The Watayouxiang Tio SDK's PayEase (首信易支付) wallet opens this screen when the user chooses to view the wallet and open its payment features.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, users cannot view the wallet and open its payment features.

zh-CN.description: 这是 Watayouxiang Tio SDK 集成的首信易支付钱包页面。用户可在此查看钱包并进入支付功能。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法查看钱包并进入支付功能。

en.description: The Watayouxiang Tio SDK's PayEase (首信易支付) wallet opens this screen when the user chooses to request a withdrawal from the wallet.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, users cannot request a withdrawal from the wallet.

zh-CN.description: 这是 Watayouxiang Tio SDK 集成的首信易支付钱包页面。用户可在此申请从钱包提现。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法申请从钱包提现。

en.description: The Watayouxiang Tio SDK's PayEase (首信易支付) wallet opens this screen when the user chooses to view the details of a selected wallet withdrawal.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, users cannot view the details of a selected wallet withdrawal.

zh-CN.description: 这是 Watayouxiang Tio SDK 集成的首信易支付钱包页面。用户可在此查看所选钱包提现的详情。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法查看所选钱包提现的详情。

en.description: The Watayouxiang Tio SDK's PayEase (首信易支付) wallet opens this screen when the user chooses to view the wallet's withdrawal history.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, users cannot view the wallet's withdrawal history.

zh-CN.description: 这是 Watayouxiang Tio SDK 集成的首信易支付钱包页面。用户可在此查看钱包提现记录。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法查看钱包提现记录。

en.description: The Watayouxiang Tio SDK's PayEase (首信易支付) wallet opens this screen when the user chooses to view the result of a wallet withdrawal.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, users cannot view the result of a wallet withdrawal.

zh-CN.description: 这是 Watayouxiang Tio SDK 集成的首信易支付钱包页面。用户可在此查看钱包提现结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法查看钱包提现结果。

en.description: Wayz Location, included with eSellTech's location component, runs when an app starts or binds location tracking and supplies location updates through the SDK.
en.disableEffect: Location-based app features that use Wayz will stop receiving location updates.

zh-CN.description: eSellTech 定位组件中的 Wayz Location 会在应用启动或绑定定位功能时运行，并通过 SDK 提供位置更新。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖 Wayz 的应用定位功能将无法继续接收位置更新。

en.description: When users open the wcdxg EditTextClear sample app from its icon, this Activity shows a regular text field and a clearable text field.
en.disableEffect: Disabling this Activity removes the sample screen and can prevent users from opening the demo from the app icon.

zh-CN.description: 用户从应用图标打开 wcdxg EditTextClear 示例应用时，此 Activity 会展示普通文本框和可清除文本框。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用此 Activity 会移除示例页面，并可能导致用户无法从应用图标打开演示应用。

en.description: When WebEngage has events ready to send to its server, this Service processes the queued batch in the background.
en.disableEffect: Queued WebEngage analytics events will no longer be sent; the app's regular features continue to work.

zh-CN.description: WebEngage 有事件需要发送到服务器时，会由此 Service 在后台处理排队的事件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 排队的 WebEngage 分析事件将无法发送，但应用的常规功能仍可使用。

en.description: When WebEngage queues analytics, profile updates, server sync, or push notification work, this Service handles it in the background.
en.disableEffect: WebEngage analytics, profile updates, server sync, and push notification work may stop while the app continues to run.

zh-CN.description: WebEngage 排队处理分析事件、用户资料更新、服务器同步或推送通知任务时，会由此 Service 在后台执行。
zh-CN.disableEffect: WebEngage 的分析事件、用户资料更新、服务器同步和推送通知任务可能停止，但应用仍可运行。

en.description: When a user taps a WebEngage push notification action, this Service follows its app link or refreshes the notification. It runs only for WebEngage notification actions.
en.disableEffect: WebEngage notification links and refresh actions will stop working; the app's normal screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击 WebEngage 推送通知中的操作时，此 Service 会打开相应应用链接或刷新通知。它只处理 WebEngage 通知操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: WebEngage 通知中的链接和刷新操作将无法使用，但应用的常规页面仍可打开。

en.description: When a WebEngage notification action opens it, this Activity briefly handles an app link or notification refresh in a transparent screen, then closes. It is not a regular app page.
en.disableEffect: WebEngage notification links or refresh actions may not complete; regular app navigation still works.

zh-CN.description: WebEngage 通知操作启动此 Activity 后，它会在透明页面中短暂处理应用链接或通知刷新，然后关闭。它不是应用的常规页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: WebEngage 通知链接或刷新操作可能无法完成，但应用的常规导航仍可使用。

en.description: Android starts this JobService when a scheduled WebEngage background task is due. It asks WebEngage to perform that background work.
en.disableEffect: The scheduled WebEngage background task will not run through this service; the app's regular features remain available.

zh-CN.description: WebEngage 的后台任务到期时，Android 会启动此 JobService，由 WebEngage 执行相应工作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: WebEngage 无法通过此服务运行已安排的后台任务，但应用的常规功能仍可使用。

en.description: When Android delivers a WebEngage background event, this Receiver handles session and configuration updates, location updates, and notification refreshes.
en.disableEffect: WebEngage background sync, location targeting, and notification refresh will stop; regular app features remain available.

zh-CN.description: Android 送达 WebEngage 后台事件时，此 Receiver 会处理会话和配置更新、位置更新以及通知刷新。
zh-CN.disableEffect: WebEngage 的后台同步、位置定向和通知刷新将停止，但应用的常规功能仍可使用。

en.description: When WebEngage displays a progress or countdown push notification, this Service updates its timer in the notification and performs its configured action when time expires.
en.disableEffect: WebEngage countdown and progress notifications will not update or complete their timed action.

zh-CN.description: WebEngage 显示进度或倒计时推送通知时，此 Service 会更新通知中的计时，并在时间结束时执行设定的操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: WebEngage 的倒计时和进度通知将无法更新，也不会在计时结束时完成设定操作。

en.description: When this WebEngage Activity starts and stops, it reports that screen's lifecycle to WebEngage analytics. The component itself does not create screen content.
en.disableEffect: WebEngage can miss analytics and session updates for this screen, while the app's other screens continue to work.

zh-CN.description: 此 WebEngage Activity 启动或关闭时，会向 WebEngage 分析功能报告该页面的生命周期。此组件本身不创建页面内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: WebEngage 可能无法记录此页面的分析和会话信息，但应用的其他页面仍可使用。

en.description: When Webex Connect needs runtime permissions, this Activity explains the request, asks the user, and sends the grant or denial result back to the SDK. It can direct users to Settings when a permission remains blocked.
en.disableEffect: Permission-dependent Webex Connect features may stop working because the SDK cannot complete their permission requests.

zh-CN.description: Webex Connect 需要运行时权限时，此 Activity 会说明请求原因、向用户申请权限，并将授权或拒绝结果返回 SDK；权限仍被阻止时也可引导用户前往设置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 由于 SDK 无法完成权限请求，需要这些权限的 Webex Connect 功能可能无法使用。

en.description: When Android reports that the device has finished starting, this Receiver starts Webex Connect's one-time background task so SDK work can resume after a reboot.
en.disableEffect: Webex Connect will not run its boot-time background refresh after a restart; the app can still be opened normally.

zh-CN.description: Android 报告设备启动完成后，此 Receiver 会启动 Webex Connect 的一次性后台任务，以便重启后恢复 SDK 工作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 重启后 Webex Connect 将不再运行启动时的后台刷新，但应用仍可正常打开。

en.description: When Firebase delivers a Webex Connect push message or updates its token, this Service sends the data to Webex Connect's push handler.
en.disableEffect: Firebase-delivered Webex Connect push notifications and token updates will stop; in-app messaging remains available.

zh-CN.description: Firebase 送达 Webex Connect 推送消息或更新令牌时，此 Service 会将数据交给 Webex Connect 推送处理器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Firebase 送达的 Webex Connect 推送通知和令牌更新将停止，但应用内消息功能仍可使用。

en.description: When Huawei Push Kit delivers a Webex Connect push message or updates its token, this Service sends the data to Webex Connect's push handler.
en.disableEffect: Huawei-delivered Webex Connect push notifications and token updates will stop; in-app messaging remains available.

zh-CN.description: Huawei Push Kit 送达 Webex Connect 推送消息或更新令牌时，此 Service 会将数据交给 Webex Connect 推送处理器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Huawei 送达的 Webex Connect 推送通知和令牌更新将停止，但应用内消息功能仍可使用。

en.description: When a user taps an action in a Webex Connect push notification, this Receiver sends the action to the SDK's notification handler.
en.disableEffect: Actions on Webex Connect push notifications will stop working; the app's in-app messaging screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击 Webex Connect 推送通知中的操作时，此 Receiver 会将操作交给 SDK 的通知处理器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Webex Connect 推送通知中的操作将无法使用，但应用内消息页面仍可打开。

en.description: When a Webex Connect notification action needs to open a destination in the app, this Activity handles the action and closes. It is part of interactive push notifications, not a regular app screen.
en.disableEffect: Webex Connect notification actions will no longer open their destinations; in-app messaging screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: Webex Connect 通知操作需要打开应用内目标页面时，此 Activity 会处理该操作并关闭。它用于交互式推送，不是应用常规页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Webex Connect 通知操作将无法打开目标页面，但应用内消息页面仍可使用。

en.description: When a Webex Connect push notification offers a quick reply, this Activity displays a reply field and send control and passes the response to the SDK.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to reply directly from Webex Connect notifications, but can still use in-app messaging.

zh-CN.description: Webex Connect 推送通知提供快速回复时，此 Activity 会显示回复框和发送按钮，并将回复交给 SDK。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法直接回复 Webex Connect 通知，但仍可使用应用内消息功能。

en.description: When a Webex Connect notification opens a web destination, this Activity displays it in an embedded WebView and records notification display or click handling.
en.disableEffect: Web destinations opened from Webex Connect notifications will stop working; the app's other screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: Webex Connect 通知打开网页目标时，此 Activity 会在内置 WebView 中显示网页，并记录通知展示或点击处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 从 Webex Connect 通知打开的网页将无法使用，但应用的其他页面仍可打开。

en.description: Woosmap Mobile SDK handles background entry and exit events for configured geofences here. It passes each triggered area change into the SDK's location processing.
en.disableEffect: The app will stop receiving background geofence entry and exit updates from Woosmap.

zh-CN.description: Woosmap Mobile SDK 在此处理已配置地理围栏于后台触发的进入和离开事件，并将区域变化交给 SDK 的位置处理流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法再收到 Woosmap 在后台发送的地理围栏进入和离开更新。

en.description: When the phone enters or leaves a configured area, this Woosmap Mobile SDK service processes the geofence transition in the background.
en.disableEffect: Background geofence entry and exit events will no longer be processed by Woosmap.

zh-CN.description: 手机进入或离开已配置区域时，Woosmap Mobile SDK 会通过此服务在后台处理地理围栏变化。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Woosmap 将无法再处理后台触发的地理围栏进入和离开事件。

en.description: Woosmap Mobile SDK runs this foreground service during displacement-based location tracking. It requests current and ongoing location readings and processes them for location and geofence updates.
en.disableEffect: Background location collection and geofence updates that use this service will stop.

zh-CN.description: Woosmap Mobile SDK 在进行位移式位置跟踪时运行此常驻服务，获取当前位置和后续位置读数，并处理位置及地理围栏更新。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此服务的后台位置采集和地理围栏更新将停止。

en.description: This Woosmap Mobile SDK receiver handles location results from displacement tracking, sends the latest reading to area processing, and notifies the app's location listener.
en.disableEffect: The app will stop receiving the location callbacks and area updates delivered through this receiver.

zh-CN.description: 此 Woosmap Mobile SDK 接收器处理位移跟踪返回的位置，将最新读数交给区域处理流程，并通知应用的位置监听器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法再通过此接收器收到位置回调和区域更新。

en.description: This Woosmap Mobile SDK receiver accepts background location results from Google Play services, initializes Woosmap, and processes the recorded locations.
en.disableEffect: Background location results delivered through this receiver will no longer reach Woosmap.

zh-CN.description: 此 Woosmap Mobile SDK 接收器接收 Google Play 服务传来的后台位置结果，初始化 Woosmap 并处理这些位置记录。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过此接收器传入的后台位置结果将无法再交给 Woosmap 处理。

en.description: When Google Play services delivers a background location update, this Woosmap Mobile SDK service loads the location settings and sends the readings into Woosmap's position processing.
en.disableEffect: Background location updates delivered through this service will no longer be processed.

zh-CN.description: Google Play 服务传来后台位置更新时，此 Woosmap Mobile SDK 服务会加载位置设置，并将读数交给 Woosmap 的位置处理流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过此服务传入的后台位置更新将无法再处理。

en.description: Woosmap Mobile SDK uses this ongoing service to receive fresh location readings, process them, and show a persistent notification while background tracking is active.
en.disableEffect: The app will lose the ongoing location updates and notification provided by this service.

zh-CN.description: Woosmap Mobile SDK 使用此常驻服务接收并处理新的位置读数，并在后台跟踪期间显示持续通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法再获得此服务提供的持续位置更新和通知。

en.description: The Woosmap Mobile SDK beacon monitor sends this receiver an event when the phone enters or leaves a configured beacon area. The receiver passes the area details to the app's region callback.
en.disableEffect: The app will stop receiving beacon area entry and exit events from Woosmap.

zh-CN.description: 手机进入或离开已配置的信标区域时，Woosmap Mobile SDK 的信标监测会向此接收器发送事件；接收器再将区域信息交给应用的区域回调。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法再收到 Woosmap 发送的信标区域进入和离开事件。

en.description: When queued after a device restart, this Woosmap Mobile SDK job initializes background location collection again and runs the reboot recovery work.
en.disableEffect: Woosmap background location collection will not be restarted through this recovery job.

zh-CN.description: 设备重启后排入此 Woosmap Mobile SDK 任务时，它会重新初始化后台位置采集并执行重启恢复工作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Woosmap 将无法通过此恢复任务重新启动后台位置采集。

en.description: At app startup, this Woosmap Mobile SDK diagnostics provider records process start details and, on Android 11 or later, the previous process exit reason in SDK logs.
en.disableEffect: Woosmap will no longer record these process lifecycle diagnostics.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，此 Woosmap Mobile SDK 诊断 Provider 会在 SDK 日志中记录进程启动信息；Android 11 及以上版本还会记录上次进程退出原因。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Woosmap 将不再记录这些进程生命周期诊断信息。

en.description: WebsiteBeaver Document Scanner opens this camera-based document capture screen when an app starts a scan. It detects page edges, lets the user adjust the crop, and returns the scanned page images.
en.disableEffect: The app's document scan screen and its cropped image results will be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: 应用开始扫描时，WebsiteBeaver Document Scanner 会打开此相机文档采集界面。它会识别页面边缘，供用户调整裁剪范围，并返回扫描后的页面图像。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法打开文档扫描界面或取得裁剪后的图像。

en.description: WebsiteBeaver Document Scanner uses this file provider to create temporary photo links for the Android camera when it captures a page.
en.disableEffect: The camera will not be able to save scan photos through the scanner, so page capture will fail.

zh-CN.description: WebsiteBeaver Document Scanner 使用此文件 Provider 为 Android 相机创建临时照片链接，以便相机保存页面图像。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 相机将无法通过扫描器保存扫描照片，因此页面采集会失败。

en.description: The WeClassroom FirstLeap SDK checks connectivity changes during a live-class session and reports device and media status. After network recovery outside the live-class screen, it can also send diagnostic logs.
en.disableEffect: Connectivity-triggered device reports and diagnostic log uploads will stop.

zh-CN.description: WeClassroom FirstLeap SDK 会在直播课堂期间检查网络连接变化并上报设备和媒体状态；若网络恢复时直播课堂界面不在前台，它还可能上传诊断日志。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 由网络变化触发的设备状态上报和诊断日志上传将停止。

en.description: When requested by the WeClassroom FirstLeap SDK, this service gathers and compresses classroom logs, obtains temporary storage access, and uploads the archive to WeClassroom.
en.disableEffect: FirstLeap classroom diagnostic logs will no longer upload.

zh-CN.description: WeClassroom FirstLeap SDK 请求上传日志时，此服务会收集并压缩课堂日志、获取临时存储凭据，并将压缩包上传到 WeClassroom。
zh-CN.disableEffect: FirstLeap 课堂诊断日志将无法再上传。

en.description: The WeClassroom FirstLeap SDK opens this classroom whiteboard for freehand marks during a lesson. Touch input is sent to the drawing surface.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to open or write on this classroom whiteboard.

zh-CN.description: WeClassroom FirstLeap SDK 会在课堂中打开此白板供用户自由书写，并将触摸操作交给绘图区域处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开此课堂白板或在上面书写。

en.description: The WeClassroom FirstLeap SDK opens this screen for an online live lesson. It initializes the video stream, lesson materials, chat, and classroom controls.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to join or watch a live lesson through this screen.

zh-CN.description: WeClassroom FirstLeap SDK 会为在线直播课打开此界面，并初始化视频流、课程资料、聊天和课堂控制功能。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此界面加入或观看直播课。

en.description: The WeClassroom FirstLeap SDK uses this live-class screen to show an animated participant row alongside the online lesson video and controls.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to open this online live-class screen.

zh-CN.description: WeClassroom FirstLeap SDK 使用此直播课堂界面，在课程视频和控制功能旁显示动态参与者列表。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开此在线直播课堂界面。

en.description: When registered for Android connectivity changes, the WeClassroom LiveCore SDK sends the current user's device and live-stream service details to its reporting service.
en.disableEffect: LiveCore will stop sending device and media status reports when connectivity changes.

zh-CN.description: 注册为 Android 网络变化接收器后，WeClassroom LiveCore SDK 会将当前用户的设备信息和直播服务信息发送到其上报服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 网络连接变化时，LiveCore 将停止发送设备和媒体状态报告。

en.description: When the WeClassroom FirstLeap LiveClass SDK requests diagnostics, this LiveCore Core SDK service compresses and uploads LiveCore and media-engine log files using temporary storage credentials.
en.disableEffect: LiveCore and media-engine troubleshooting logs will no longer upload.

zh-CN.description: WeClassroom FirstLeap LiveClass SDK 请求诊断日志时，此 LiveCore Core SDK 服务会使用临时存储凭据压缩并上传 LiveCore 和媒体引擎日志。
zh-CN.disableEffect: LiveCore 和媒体引擎的故障排查日志将无法再上传。

en.description: The WeClassroom FirstLeap SDK opens this screen for a live group lesson. It joins the classroom and provides teacher and student video, course materials, chat, hand raises, and speaking controls.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to join or participate in a group lesson through this screen.

zh-CN.description: WeClassroom FirstLeap SDK 会为小组直播课打开此界面，加入课堂并提供师生视频、课程资料、聊天、举手和发言控制。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此界面加入或参与小组直播课。

en.description: The WeClassroom FirstLeap SDK opens this screen for large-group live lessons. It joins the room and presents the teacher stream, lesson materials, student media, and chat.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to join or participate in a large live lesson through this screen.

zh-CN.description: WeClassroom FirstLeap SDK 会为大班直播课打开此界面，加入课堂并显示教师视频流、课程资料、学生媒体和聊天。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此界面加入或参与大班直播课。

en.description: During a large-class lesson, the WeClassroom LiveUI SDK service displays the lesson video in a small movable window. Tapping the window returns the user to the full classroom.
en.disableEffect: The lesson video will no longer be available in a floating window while the full classroom is minimized.

zh-CN.description: 大班直播课期间，WeClassroom LiveUI SDK 服务会在可移动的小窗口中显示课程视频；点击窗口即可返回完整课堂。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 完整课堂最小化时，用户将无法再通过浮动窗口观看课程视频。

en.description: The WeClassroom FirstLeap SDK opens this screen for one-to-one lessons. It joins the teacher and student room and provides live video, shared course documents, chat, and screen sharing.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to enter or participate in a one-to-one lesson.

zh-CN.description: WeClassroom FirstLeap SDK 会为一对一课程打开此界面，加入师生课堂并提供实时视频、共享课程文档、聊天和屏幕共享。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法进入或参与一对一课程。

en.description: The WeClassroom FirstLeap SDK opens this player for a supplied lesson video. It plays the video with progress, seeking, and playback controls.
en.disableEffect: Users will be unable to open that lesson video from the app.

zh-CN.description: WeClassroom FirstLeap SDK 会使用此播放器播放应用提供的课程视频，并显示进度、拖动定位和播放控制。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法从应用中打开该课程视频。

en.description: The WeClassroom FirstLeap SDK opens this player for a recorded classroom replay, with video controls and lesson interactions such as replay questions.
en.disableEffect: Users will be unable to watch recorded classroom replays through this player.

zh-CN.description: WeClassroom FirstLeap SDK 会使用此播放器播放录制的课堂回放，并提供视频控制和回放答题等课堂互动。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此播放器观看录制的课堂回放。

en.description: The WeClassroom FirstLeap SDK opens this screen for a small-class live lesson. It joins the room and provides teacher and student video, course documents, chat, and hand-raise controls.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to join or participate in a small-class lesson through this screen.

zh-CN.description: WeClassroom FirstLeap SDK 会为小班直播课打开此界面，加入课堂并提供师生视频、课程文档、聊天和举手控制。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此界面加入或参与小班直播课。

en.description: The WeClassroom LiveCore Log Manager uses this service to compress and upload saved classroom and media-engine logs when a diagnostic upload is requested.
en.disableEffect: Classroom and media-engine diagnostic log archives will no longer upload.

zh-CN.description: WeClassroom LiveCore 日志管理器会在收到诊断上传请求时，使用此服务压缩并上传已保存的课堂和媒体引擎日志。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 课堂和媒体引擎诊断日志压缩包将无法再上传。

en.description: The WeClassroom Weiduan SDK uses this service to package diagnostic files and send them with lesson stream and user details to the vendor's debugging service.
en.disableEffect: Weiduan diagnostic files will no longer reach the vendor's debugging service.

zh-CN.description: WeClassroom Weiduan SDK 使用此服务打包诊断文件，并连同课程流和用户信息发送到厂商的调试服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Weiduan 诊断文件将无法再发送到厂商的调试服务。

en.description: Kotle PlayerModule runs when the app resumes scheduled downloads. It keeps video downloads running in the background and shows their progress.
en.disableEffect: Scheduled video downloads and their progress notifications may stop working.

zh-CN.description: Kotle PlayerModule 会在应用恢复计划中的下载任务时运行，负责后台视频下载并显示下载进度。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，计划中的视频下载及其进度通知可能无法正常工作。

en.description: Kotle MvvmModule opens this screen after the app crashes, showing error details and offering app restart and crash-log saving.
en.disableEffect: After a crash, users lose this error screen, its restart option, and crash-log saving.

zh-CN.description: Kotle MvvmModule 会在应用崩溃后打开此页面，显示错误详情，并提供重启应用和保存崩溃日志的选项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用崩溃后将无法使用此页面查看错误信息、重启应用或保存日志。

en.description: Kotle MvvmModule can open this in-app web screen for a URL supplied by the app; it shows loading and title feedback, supports refresh, and handles page downloads.
en.disableEffect: Pages routed through this screen will not open, so the app's in-app web content and downloads may be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: Kotle MvvmModule 可为应用提供内置网页页面，用于打开应用传入的网址，并显示加载进度和标题、支持刷新及网页文件下载。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过此页面打开的网页无法显示，相关网页内容和下载也可能无法使用。

en.description: When a Pushy notification arrives, this WeLoop Receiver forwards its title, message, and link to the app's notification handling.
en.disableEffect: Push notifications handled through WeLoop will no longer reach the app.

zh-CN.description: Pushy 通知到达时，WeLoop 的此 Receiver 会将标题、内容和链接转交给应用处理通知的部分。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过 WeLoop 处理的推送通知将无法再传到应用。

en.description: The WensXendit payment SDK opens this screen when a payment result is ready. It shows the amount, payment method, reference number, and completion time.
en.disableEffect: Users will not see the WensXendit payment confirmation after a successful payment.

zh-CN.description: WensXendit 支付 SDK 在收到支付结果后打开此页面，显示金额、支付方式、参考编号和完成时间。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户在支付成功后将看不到 WensXendit 的支付确认页面。

en.description: WensXendit opens this screen when a payment provider requires an online checkout page. It loads that page so the user can complete payment.
en.disableEffect: Payments that require the provider's checkout page cannot be completed through this flow.

zh-CN.description: 支付服务商要求在线结账页面时，WensXendit 会打开此页面并载入该页面，让用户完成付款。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，需要通过服务商结账页面完成的支付将无法继续。

en.description: WensXendit opens this screen when the user pays by card. It collects card details and continues the payment request.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot enter or submit card details for WensXendit payments.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择银行卡支付时，WensXendit 会打开此页面收集银行卡信息并继续处理支付请求。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法在 WensXendit 支付流程中填写或提交银行卡信息。

en.description: WensXendit opens this screen during a card payment when the provider requires an additional verification page. The user completes that check there.
en.disableEffect: Card payments that require this verification step may fail or remain incomplete.

zh-CN.description: 银行卡支付需要额外验证时，WensXendit 会打开此页面载入服务商的验证页面，用户在此完成验证。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，需要此验证步骤的银行卡支付可能失败或无法完成。

en.description: WensXendit opens this screen after creating a virtual-account payment. It shows the account number, amount, expiry, and bank payment instructions.
en.disableEffect: Users will not see the virtual-account payment instructions and expiry details.

zh-CN.description: WensXendit 创建虚拟账户支付后会打开此页面，显示账户号码、金额、有效期和银行付款说明。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将看不到虚拟账户付款说明和有效期。

en.description: WensXendit opens this screen when checkout needs a payment method. It presents available choices such as cards, bank transfers, and e-wallets.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot choose a payment method in WensXendit checkout.

zh-CN.description: 结账流程需要选择支付方式时，WensXendit 会打开此页面，列出银行卡、银行转账和电子钱包等可用方式。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法在 WensXendit 结账流程中选择支付方式。

en.description: WensXendit opens this screen for QR-code payments. It displays the payment code and transaction details so the user can complete the transfer.
en.disableEffect: QR-code payments cannot be completed through this flow.

zh-CN.description: WensXendit 处理二维码支付时会打开此页面，显示付款二维码和交易信息，供用户完成转账。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过此流程完成二维码支付。

en.description: AAFactory Commons opens this Activity when the app asks to pick photos; users can browse images as a grid or list and return selected pictures.
en.disableEffect: Users will lose this library's photo selection screen.

zh-CN.description: 应用需要选择照片时，AAFactory Commons 会打开此 Activity；用户可以用网格或列表浏览图片并返回所选照片。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法使用此库的照片选择界面。

en.description: AAFactory Commons opens this Activity to preview chosen photos one at a time before the selection is confirmed.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to review selected photos in the library's preview screen.

zh-CN.description: AAFactory Commons 会通过此 Activity 逐张预览已选照片，供用户确认选择。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法使用此库的照片预览界面检查所选图片。

en.description: Wgllss Dynamic Host exposes this provider for content used by dynamically loaded plug-ins. When the host app or a plug-in requests content, it routes the request to the plug-in registered for that path.
en.disableEffect: Plug-ins that use the shared content address will lose that data access and may not work fully.

zh-CN.description: Wgllss Dynamic Host 为动态加载的插件提供此 Provider。宿主应用或插件请求内容时，它会将请求转交给对应路径注册的插件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此共享内容地址的插件将无法访问相关数据，部分功能可能无法正常工作。

en.description: The CashCat SDK from CashCat22 and BXM SDK from Sinnerlwu both include this WGS advertising page. It opens an ad's supplied destination in an in-app page and can show a countdown and close controls.
en.disableEffect: Users can no longer open this ad destination; the host app's regular screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: CashCat22 的 CashCat SDK 和 Sinnerlwu 的 BXM SDK 都包含此 WGS 广告页面。它会在应用内打开广告提供的网址，并可显示倒计时和关闭按钮。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开此广告落地页，但宿主应用的普通页面仍可使用。

en.description: The CashCat SDK from CashCat22 and BXM SDK from Sinnerlwu both include this WGS advertising page. It plays a full-screen video ad and lets the user skip it or open the advertiser's destination.
en.disableEffect: Full-screen ads and their advertiser links will not open.

zh-CN.description: CashCat22 的 CashCat SDK 和 Sinnerlwu 的 BXM SDK 都包含此 WGS 广告页面。它播放全屏视频广告，并提供跳过广告或打开广告商页面的操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 全屏广告及其广告商页面将无法打开。

en.description: The CashCat SDK from CashCat22 and BXM SDK from Sinnerlwu both include this WGS rewarded-ad page. It plays a video ad and opens the ad's end page after playback completes.
en.disableEffect: Rewarded video ads will not play, and rewards for watching ads will no longer be granted.

zh-CN.description: CashCat22 的 CashCat SDK 和 Sinnerlwu 的 BXM SDK 都包含此 WGS 激励广告页面。它播放视频广告，并在播放结束后打开广告结束页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 激励视频广告将无法播放，观看广告也将不再获得奖励。

en.description: The CashCat SDK from CashCat22 and BXM SDK from Sinnerlwu both include this WGS advertising page. It opens an ad or rewarded offer's web page, and its timed viewing flow can confirm when the required viewing period is complete.
en.disableEffect: These ad pages will not open, and rewards for watching ads in this flow will no longer be granted.

zh-CN.description: CashCat22 的 CashCat SDK 和 Sinnerlwu 的 BXM SDK 都包含此 WGS 广告页面。它打开广告或激励活动的网页，并可在计时观看完成后确认结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 这些广告页面将无法打开，此流程中的观看广告奖励也将不再发放。

en.description: BXM SDK's push-ad flow opens this translucent Activity when ad content is ready. It displays the push ad and handles its interaction or landing action.
en.disableEffect: BXM push ads and their destinations will no longer appear, while the host app's regular features remain available.

zh-CN.description: BXM SDK 的推送广告内容就绪时会打开此半透明活动。它显示推送广告，并处理广告互动或落地页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: BXM 推送广告及其目标页面将不再显示，宿主应用的常规功能仍可使用。

en.description: When BXM SDK's lock-screen information feature is enabled, this first layout opens after the device screen turns off and its configured delay passes. It shows a clock and date with configured web content and floating ad links.
en.disableEffect: This first lock-screen page and its ad links no longer appear, while the rest of the app remains available.

zh-CN.description: 启用 BXM SDK 的锁屏资讯功能后，设备屏幕关闭并经过设定的延迟时间，此第一种页面布局会打开。它显示时钟、日期、配置的网页内容和悬浮广告入口。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 此锁屏页面及其广告入口将不再显示，应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: When BXM SDK selects its second lock-screen information layout, it opens after the device screen turns off and the configured delay passes. It shows clock, date and weather details with configured ad content and a web page.
en.disableEffect: This second lock-screen page, its information and ad links no longer appear, while the rest of the app remains available.

zh-CN.description: BXM SDK 选择第二种锁屏资讯布局时，设备屏幕关闭并经过设定的延迟时间后，此页面会打开。它显示时钟、日期和天气信息，以及配置的广告内容和网页。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 此第二种锁屏页面、资讯和广告入口将不再显示，应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: BXM SDK opens this settings screen from its lock-screen control; the switch turns lock-screen information on or off and may take the user to Android's overlay-permission settings.
en.disableEffect: Users can no longer open this page to control the BXM lock-screen feed or reach the overlay-permission settings it requests.

zh-CN.description: BXM SDK 会从锁屏控制入口打开此设置界面；其中的开关可启用或关闭锁屏资讯，也可能带用户前往 Android 悬浮窗权限设置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开此页面来管理 BXM 锁屏资讯，也无法从这里进入其请求的悬浮窗权限设置。

en.description: BXM SDK opens this in-app browser when a user taps web content on either lock-screen layout; it loads the configured page and can show floating ad links.
en.disableEffect: Tapping those screen links will no longer open their web pages or ad destinations; other app features continue to work.

zh-CN.description: 用户点按任一种锁屏布局中的网页内容时，BXM SDK 会打开此应用内浏览器，加载配置的页面并可显示悬浮广告入口。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 点按这些入口将无法再打开对应网页或广告目标页面，应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: The what3words Android Components SDK opens this transparent screen when a what3words feature needs Android permissions. It asks Android for the requested access and returns the user's decision.
en.disableEffect: what3words features will not be able to request or receive permissions through this screen.

zh-CN.description: what3words Android Components SDK 会在相关功能需要 Android 权限时打开此透明界面，向系统请求所需权限并返回用户的选择。
zh-CN.disableEffect: what3words 功能将无法通过此界面请求权限或取得授权结果。

en.description: The what3words OCR Components extension opens this camera scanner when an app uses its hybrid recognition option. It reads a three-word address and displays validated what3words matches.
en.disableEffect: Users will no longer be able to scan what3words addresses with this recognition option.

zh-CN.description: 应用使用混合识别方式时，what3words OCR Components 扩展会打开此相机扫描界面，读取三词地址并显示验证后的 what3words 匹配结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法再通过此识别方式扫描 what3words 地址。

en.description: The what3words OCR Components extension opens this camera scanner when an app uses Tesseract recognition. It reads a three-word address and displays validated what3words matches.
en.disableEffect: Users will no longer be able to scan what3words addresses with Tesseract recognition.

zh-CN.description: 应用使用 Tesseract 识别时，what3words OCR Components 扩展会打开此相机扫描界面，读取三词地址并显示验证后的 what3words 匹配结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法再通过 Tesseract 识别扫描 what3words 地址。

en.description: The what3words Android OCR Components screen uses Google ML Kit to read a three-word address from the camera and return a validated match, with coordinates when requested.
en.disableEffect: Users will no longer be able to scan what3words addresses with the ML Kit scanner.

zh-CN.description: what3words Android OCR Components 会使用 Google ML Kit 从相机画面读取三词地址并返回验证后的匹配结果；需要时也会返回坐标。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法再通过 ML Kit 扫描 what3words 地址。

en.description: When a local reader payment requires the cardholder PIN, Stripe Terminal opens this protected PIN-entry screen.
en.disableEffect: Card payments that require a PIN cannot be completed.

zh-CN.description: 本地读卡器付款需要持卡人 PIN 时，Stripe Terminal 会打开此受保护的 PIN 输入界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要 PIN 的银行卡付款将无法完成。

en.description: When a Tap to Pay transaction requires the cardholder PIN, Stripe Terminal opens this protected PIN-entry screen.
en.disableEffect: Tap to Pay card payments that require a PIN cannot be completed.

zh-CN.description: Tap to Pay 交易需要持卡人 PIN 时，Stripe Terminal 会打开此受保护的 PIN 输入界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要 PIN 的 Tap to Pay 银行卡付款将无法完成。

en.description: PayU's Wibmo 3-D Secure helper opens this Activity when a card issuer presents a browser-based challenge. It displays the challenge page and sends the user's response back to the authentication flow.
en.disableEffect: The issuer's browser-based card authentication may not complete.

zh-CN.description: 发卡行提供浏览器式验证挑战时，PayU 集成的 Wibmo 3-D Secure 辅助 SDK 会打开此 Activity。它显示挑战页面，并将用户的响应送回验证流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，发卡行的浏览器式银行卡验证可能无法完成。

en.description: PayU's Wibmo 3-D Secure helper opens this Activity when a card issuer requests an in-app authentication challenge, such as a one-time code or another response. It submits the user's answer to the issuer.
en.disableEffect: The issuer's in-app card authentication may not complete.

zh-CN.description: 发卡行要求在应用内完成验证挑战时，PayU 集成的 Wibmo 3-D Secure 辅助 SDK 会打开此 Activity，例如输入一次性验证码或其他响应。它会将用户的回答提交给发卡行。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，发卡行的应用内银行卡验证可能无法完成。

en.description: WeiLian's Android Toolkit and qweiop123's AndroidToolKit provide this debug screen for recorded crashes; users can read, copy, or share the report.
en.disableEffect: The toolkit's crash-detail screen will be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: WeiLian 的 Android Toolkit 和 qweiop123 的 AndroidToolKit 提供此崩溃调试页面，用户可查看、复制或分享崩溃记录。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 工具包中的崩溃详情页面将无法使用。

en.description: WeiLian's Android Toolkit and qweiop123's AndroidToolKit show the details of a selected recorded network request and let users copy or share them.
en.disableEffect: Users will no longer be able to inspect individual recorded requests in the toolkit.

zh-CN.description: WeiLian 的 Android Toolkit 和 qweiop123 的 AndroidToolKit 可显示选中网络请求记录的详情，并允许用户复制或分享。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在工具包中查看单条网络请求记录。

en.description: WeiLian's Android Toolkit and qweiop123's AndroidToolKit show recorded network requests, support searching and clearing the list, and open a detail screen when a row is selected.
en.disableEffect: The toolkit's saved-request list and its search and clear controls will be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: WeiLian 的 Android Toolkit 和 qweiop123 的 AndroidToolKit 会显示网络请求记录，支持搜索和清空列表，并可打开所选记录的详情。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 工具包中的已保存请求列表及其搜索、清空功能将无法使用。

en.description: WeiLian's Android Toolkit and qweiop123's AndroidToolKit open a debug panel with shortcuts to request records and crash details.
en.disableEffect: The toolkit's debug panel will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: WeiLian 的 Android Toolkit 和 qweiop123 的 AndroidToolKit 会打开调试面板，提供请求记录和崩溃详情入口。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 工具包的调试面板将无法打开。

en.description: Hyperion (WillowTree)'s build information tool opens this screen from the debug menu and lists the app's compiled build settings and values.
en.disableEffect: The app continues to run, but Hyperion's build information screen is unavailable.

zh-CN.description: 用户从 Hyperion（WillowTree）的调试菜单打开构建信息工具时，此界面会列出编入应用的构建设置和值。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后应用仍可运行，但无法再打开 Hyperion 的构建信息界面。

en.description: When an app explicitly opens Hyperion's standalone debug panel, this Activity displays the available Hyperion tools full-screen.
en.disableEffect: Hyperion's standalone debugging panel can no longer be opened.

zh-CN.description: 应用显式打开 Hyperion 的独立调试面板时，此界面会全屏展示可用的 Hyperion 工具。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后将无法打开 Hyperion 的独立调试面板。

en.description: Android creates this Hyperion (WillowTree) Provider during app startup; it initializes Hyperion and enables the debug tools unless startup is disabled in the app settings.
en.disableEffect: Hyperion will no longer initialize automatically at startup, so its debugging tools will not be enabled through this Provider.

zh-CN.description: Android 会在应用启动时创建 Hyperion（WillowTree）的此 Provider；它负责初始化 Hyperion，并在应用未关闭启动选项时启用调试工具。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后 Hyperion 不会再通过此 Provider 在启动时自动初始化和启用调试工具。

en.description: While a Hyperion-enabled app screen is open, this service keeps an ongoing notification available; tapping it opens Hyperion's debugging panel.
en.disableEffect: The notification shortcut and this quick way to open Hyperion's debugging panel stop working.

zh-CN.description: Hyperion 启用且应用界面处于打开状态时，此服务会持续显示通知；点击通知可打开调试面板。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后通知快捷入口以及通过它打开 Hyperion 调试面板的方式会失效。

en.description: When Hyperion catches an uncaught app error, it opens this screen in a separate crash process with a report that users can copy or share.
en.disableEffect: The app still fails on the same error, but Hyperion's crash report screen and sharing controls are unavailable.

zh-CN.description: Hyperion 捕获到未处理的应用错误后，会在独立的崩溃进程中打开此界面，显示可复制或分享的错误报告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 相同错误仍会导致应用崩溃，但 Hyperion 的崩溃报告界面和分享功能将不可用。

en.description: This Hyperion Provider is part of the file browser's file-sharing feature and is asked to create links for selected app files.
en.disableEffect: Hyperion's file browser cannot pass selected app files to other apps through this file-sharing feature.

zh-CN.description: Hyperion 文件浏览器的文件分享功能会请求此 Provider 为选中的应用文件创建链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后 Hyperion 文件浏览器无法通过此分享功能将选中的应用文件交给其他应用。

en.description: When someone opens Hyperion's file browser, this Activity displays files stored by the app so they can inspect or open them.
en.disableEffect: The app continues to work, but Hyperion's in-app file browser is unavailable.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 Hyperion 文件浏览器时，此界面会展示应用保存的文件，供查看或打开。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后应用仍可使用，但 Hyperion 的文件浏览器将不可用。

en.description: When a user confirms Hyperion's restart tool, this separate-process Activity clears the cache or app data selected in the restart options and relaunches the app.
en.disableEffect: Hyperion can no longer restart the app through its restart tool or apply those reset options.

zh-CN.description: 用户确认 Hyperion 的重启操作后，此独立进程中的界面会按所选选项清除缓存或应用数据，然后重新启动应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后 Hyperion 无法再通过重启工具重新启动应用或执行所选的重置操作。

en.description: When Hyperion shares a saved screen recording, this Provider makes the video available to other apps through a shareable link.
en.disableEffect: Other apps can no longer open or receive recordings shared from Hyperion.

zh-CN.description: Hyperion 分享已保存的屏幕录制时，此 Provider 会提供其他应用可打开的视频链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后其他应用无法再打开或接收从 Hyperion 分享的屏幕录制。

en.description: After a user starts Hyperion's screen recorder and grants Android's screen-capture permission, this service keeps the recording running in the background and provides a stop button in its notification.
en.disableEffect: Hyperion's screen recording cannot start or continue through its recording controls.

zh-CN.description: 用户启动 Hyperion 屏幕录制并授予 Android 屏幕捕获权限后，此服务会在后台持续录制，并在通知中提供停止按钮。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后 Hyperion 无法通过录制工具启动或继续屏幕录制。

en.description: When a user opens Hyperion's saved recordings list, this Activity shows screen videos recorded by the app and lets the user view or share them.
en.disableEffect: Hyperion's saved recording list and its viewing or sharing controls become unavailable.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 Hyperion 的录制列表时，此界面会展示应用录下的屏幕视频，供查看或分享。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后 Hyperion 的录制列表及其查看、分享功能将不可用。

en.description: When a user selects a saved settings file in Hyperion, this Activity shows its stored values and provides filtering.
en.disableEffect: Hyperion can no longer show the contents of a selected settings file.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Hyperion 中选择一个设置文件后，此界面会显示其中保存的值并支持筛选。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后 Hyperion 无法再显示所选设置文件的内容。

en.description: When a user opens Hyperion's saved-settings tool, this Activity lists the app's stored settings files and provides a search filter.
en.disableEffect: Hyperion's list of saved settings files can no longer be opened.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 Hyperion 的设置浏览工具时，此界面会列出应用保存的设置文件并提供搜索筛选。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后无法再打开 Hyperion 提供的设置文件列表。

en.description: When opened from Hyperion's log tool, this Activity shows recent app log messages and lets the user filter or share them.
en.disableEffect: Hyperion's log viewer and its filtering or sharing controls become unavailable.

zh-CN.description: 用户从 Hyperion 的日志工具打开此界面时，可查看应用最近的日志消息，并筛选或分享它们。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后 Hyperion 的日志查看、筛选和分享功能将不可用。

en.description: The WinterParadox Custom Camera Library opens this screen for photo or video capture when the app requests its camera interface; it saves the result to the requested file.
en.disableEffect: Apps that use this camera screen can no longer take or save photos and videos through it.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求 WinterParadox Custom Camera Library 打开拍照或录像界面时，此界面会采集画面并将结果保存到指定文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此相机界面的应用将无法通过它拍摄或保存照片和视频。

en.description: Wire's Android-Job library receives reboot, quick-reboot, or app-update events and reinitializes saved background jobs so they can be scheduled again.
en.disableEffect: Scheduled background work may not resume after the device restarts or the app is replaced.

zh-CN.description: Wire 的 Android-Job 库会接收设备重启、快速重启或应用更新事件，并重新初始化已保存的后台任务以便再次安排。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后设备重启或应用更新后，已安排的后台任务可能无法恢复。

en.description: Wire's Android-Job scheduler starts this service to check saved background jobs and reschedule any that Android is no longer tracking.
en.disableEffect: Some saved background tasks may not be restored after startup or a device restart.

zh-CN.description: Wire 的 Android-Job 调度器会启动此服务，检查已保存的后台任务，并重新安排 Android 已不再跟踪的任务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，部分已保存的后台任务可能无法在应用启动或设备重启后恢复。

en.description: When an Android-Job alarm for a scheduled task fires, this receiver directs the due background task to the appropriate service, including exact-time jobs.
en.disableEffect: Background tasks delivered by the alarm fallback may not run.

zh-CN.description: Android-Job 为已安排的任务设置的闹钟触发时，此接收器会将到期任务交给相应服务处理，包括定时任务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，通过闹钟备用方式触发的后台任务可能无法运行。

en.description: When a regular Android-Job alarm is due, this service looks up and runs the matching saved background task.
en.disableEffect: Background tasks delivered through regular alarms may be missed.

zh-CN.description: 普通 Android-Job 闹钟到期时，此服务会查找并运行对应的已保存后台任务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，通过普通闹钟触发的后台任务可能会被漏掉。

en.description: When an exact Android-Job alarm fires, this service runs the matching saved background task and stops after it finishes.
en.disableEffect: App tasks that rely on exact alarms may not run.

zh-CN.description: Android-Job 的精确闹钟触发时，此服务会运行对应的已保存后台任务，并在任务结束后停止。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，依赖精确闹钟的应用任务可能无法运行。

en.description: Android's job scheduler starts this Android-Job service when a saved app task is due; it runs the task and handles system stop requests.
en.disableEffect: Background tasks scheduled through Android's job scheduler may not run.

zh-CN.description: 已保存的应用任务到期时，Android 会启动此 Android-Job 服务；它运行任务并处理系统发出的停止请求。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，通过 Android 后台任务调度器安排的任务可能无法运行。

en.description: The WireGuard Android tunnel library runs this VPN service when the app or Android starts a WireGuard connection; it creates and maintains the app's VPN tunnel, including always-on starts.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot establish or keep its WireGuard VPN connection when this service is disabled.

zh-CN.description: 应用或 Android 启动 WireGuard 连接时，WireGuard Android 隧道库会运行此 VPN 服务来建立并维持应用的隧道，也支持系统启动的常开 VPN。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用将无法建立或维持 WireGuard VPN 连接。

en.description: wlwoon ContactPicker opens this screen when an app asks the user to choose contacts. It reads and sorts the contact list, supports single or multiple selection, and returns the chosen contacts to the app.
en.disableEffect: Apps that use this picker can no longer choose and return contacts through its screen.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求用户选择联系人时，wlwoon ContactPicker 会打开此页面。它读取并排序联系人列表，支持单选或多选，并将所选联系人返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此选择器的应用将无法通过此页面选择并返回联系人。

en.description: WonderAndroid’s Huawei ads integration opens this screen to display a Huawei splash ad when the ad placement runs.
en.disableEffect: Huawei splash ads from this integration will no longer appear.

zh-CN.description: WonderAndroid 的华为广告适配会在广告位运行时打开此页面展示华为开屏广告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 此适配提供的华为开屏广告将不再显示。

en.description: WonderAndroid’s China common SDK opens this in-app browser when a user follows a link such as a privacy or service-terms page.

en.description: WonderAndroid’s China common SDK displays this screen to explain restrictions on game time for underage users.

zh-CN.description: WonderAndroid 国内通用 SDK 遇到网络错误时会打开此页面，并提供重试操作。

zh-CN.description: WonderAndroid 国内通用 SDK 会在启动流程中打开此页面展示隐私条款并征求用户同意。

zh-CN.description: WonderPush 在应用界面打开时请求 Android 权限，会通过此界面显示系统权限提示，并将用户的选择返回给 SDK。
