zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，依赖缓存媒体或声音文件的 WonderPush 通知可能无法使用这些文件。

en.description: Android starts this WonderPush Provider during app startup so the SDK can initialize before its notification features are used.
en.disableEffect: The app no longer initializes WonderPush automatically through this startup Provider, so its push setup will not happen here.

zh-CN.description: Android 会在应用启动时创建 WonderPush 的此 Provider，使 SDK 能在通知功能使用前完成初始化。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后应用无法再通过此启动 Provider 自动初始化 WonderPush，推送设置也不会在这里完成。

en.description: When a user opens a WonderPush notification, this Activity records the open and launches the notification's destination screens, then closes.
en.disableEffect: Tapping WonderPush notifications will no longer record opens or follow their configured destinations through this Activity.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 WonderPush 通知时，此界面会记录打开事件、启动通知指定的目标页面，然后关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，点击 WonderPush 通知将无法通过此界面记录打开事件或跳转到指定页面。

en.description: When a WonderPush notification includes remote media, the SDK queues this service to download those files and display the notification.
en.disableEffect: Notifications that need downloaded media may not appear with their configured content.

zh-CN.description: WonderPush 通知包含远程媒体时，SDK 会安排此服务下载文件并显示通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，需要下载媒体的通知可能无法按预期内容显示。

en.description: When a user opens a WonderPush notification or follows its link, this service records the open and sends the link to a matching app screen, with a fallback to the app's home screen.
en.disableEffect: WonderPush notification taps can no longer follow their links or use the SDK's default open behavior through this service.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 WonderPush 通知或点击其中的链接时，此服务会记录打开事件并将链接交给应用中匹配的页面；无法匹配时会返回应用主页。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，WonderPush 通知无法再通过此服务打开链接或使用 SDK 的默认跳转方式。

en.description: During WonderPush push setup, this service reads the app's configured push adapters and loads the matching delivery provider, such as Firebase or Huawei.
en.disableEffect: WonderPush cannot discover its configured delivery provider, so remote push registration or delivery may stop.

zh-CN.description: WonderPush 设置推送时，此服务会读取应用配置的推送适配器，并加载匹配的送达渠道，例如 Firebase 或华为。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后 WonderPush 无法发现已配置的送达渠道，远程推送注册或接收可能停止。

en.description: When Firebase delivers a WonderPush message or registration token, this service forwards the message for notification handling and stores updated tokens.
en.disableEffect: WonderPush messages and token updates delivered through Firebase stop working.

zh-CN.description: Firebase 送达 WonderPush 消息或注册令牌时，此服务会转交消息以处理通知，并保存更新后的令牌。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，通过 Firebase 送达的 WonderPush 消息和令牌更新将停止工作。

en.description: When Huawei delivers a WonderPush message or registration token, this service forwards the message for notification handling and stores updated tokens.
en.disableEffect: WonderPush messages and token updates delivered through Huawei stop working.

zh-CN.description: 华为推送服务送达 WonderPush 消息或注册令牌时，此服务会转交消息以处理通知，并保存更新后的令牌。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，通过华为推送服务送达的 WonderPush 消息和令牌更新将停止工作。

en.description: IBM MobileFirst Analytics opens this screen after the app triggers feedback mode. It shows a screenshot that users can mark up with comments before submitting screen feedback.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to open the screenshot-feedback form, annotate a screen, or submit feedback through IBM MobileFirst.

zh-CN.description: 应用触发反馈模式后，IBM MobileFirst Analytics 会打开此页面。页面显示屏幕截图，用户可添加标记和评论后提交反馈。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开截图反馈表单、标注屏幕或通过 IBM MobileFirst 提交反馈。

en.description: After Worldpay Access Checkout finishes a payment-session request, this receiver returns the session result or error to the checkout screen.
en.disableEffect: Checkout flows that need a Worldpay payment session cannot receive the result needed to continue.

zh-CN.description: Worldpay Access Checkout 完成支付会话请求后，此接收器会将会话结果或错误返回给结账界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要 Worldpay 支付会话的结账流程将无法收到继续处理所需的结果。

en.description: When an app requests a Worldpay payment session, this service sends the request to Worldpay and broadcasts the session result to the checkout flow.
en.disableEffect: Card checkout flows that need a Worldpay session cannot create one.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求 Worldpay 支付会话时，此服务会向 Worldpay 发送请求，并将会话结果广播回结账流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要 Worldpay 会话的银行卡结账流程将无法创建会话。

en.description: During a Worldpay Access Checkout session request, this service sends the requested session data to Worldpay and broadcasts each response or error to the checkout flow.
en.disableEffect: Worldpay checkout cannot retrieve the session data needed to complete card payments.

zh-CN.description: Worldpay Access Checkout 请求支付会话时，此服务会向 Worldpay 发送所需的会话数据，并将响应或错误广播回结账流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后 Worldpay 结账流程无法取得完成银行卡支付所需的会话数据。

en.description: When Worldpay Access Checkout broadcasts session responses, this receiver collects the requested session results and returns them, or an error, to the checkout flow.
en.disableEffect: The checkout flow cannot receive Worldpay's session results, which can stop card payments from completing.

zh-CN.description: Worldpay Access Checkout 广播会话响应时，此接收器会收集所需结果并将结果或错误返回给结账流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后结账流程无法收到 Worldpay 会话结果，银行卡支付可能无法完成。

en.description: When an app requests runtime permission, this screen checks whether an explanation is needed or opens Android’s permission prompt and returns the user’s choice.
en.disableEffect: Features that use this utility may not be able to request the permissions they need.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求运行时权限时，此页面会检查是否需要先说明原因，或打开 Android 权限提示并返回用户的选择。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此工具的功能可能无法请求所需权限。

en.description: This screen opens a selected photo for cropping, saves the cropped image and returns it to the app.
en.disableEffect: Photo-cropping flows that use this screen will no longer work.

zh-CN.description: 此页面会打开选中的照片供用户裁剪，保存裁剪后的图片并返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此页面的照片裁剪流程将无法继续工作。

en.description: This screen lists photo albums on the device so the user can choose one to browse.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open the album list when choosing photos through this tool.

zh-CN.description: 此页面会列出设备上的相册，供用户选择要浏览的相册。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此工具打开相册列表来选择照片。

en.description: This screen shows photos from a selected album and returns the images chosen by the user.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot choose photos from an album through this tool.

zh-CN.description: 此页面会显示所选相册中的照片，并返回用户选中的图片。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此工具从相册中选择照片。

en.description: The Szeasco HID device library uses this service when the app connects to a USB HID reader or controller. It reads device data, sends commands, and passes responses back to the app.
en.disableEffect: Apps that use this service for a connected HID reader or controller will lose communication with that device.

zh-CN.description: Szeasco HID 设备库在应用连接 USB HID 读卡器或控制器时使用此服务；它负责读取设备数据、发送指令并将响应交回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此服务连接 HID 读卡器或控制器的应用将无法与该设备通信。

en.description: Wgllss WX-LRecord starts this foreground service after screen-capture approval to show a floating recording panel. Its controls capture system audio or screen video and stop or combine the recording.
en.disableEffect: The floating recording panel and its capture controls will be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: 获得屏幕录制授权后，Wgllss WX-LRecord 会启动此前台 Service 并显示悬浮录制面板。面板可录制系统声音或屏幕视频，并控制停止或合成录制内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 悬浮录制面板及其录制控制功能将无法使用。

en.description: Wgllss WX-LRecord starts this foreground service after screen-capture permission is granted. It records the screen and audio to files and finalizes the recording when stopped.
en.disableEffect: The SDK will not be able to start or finish screen recordings through this service.

zh-CN.description: 获得屏幕录制授权后，Wgllss WX-LRecord 会启动此前台 Service。它将屏幕和声音录制到文件中，并在停止时完成录制文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: SDK 将无法通过此 Service 开始或完成屏幕录制。

en.description: XayahSuSuSu's Material You File Explorer opens when the app asks the user to browse for a file or folder. It lets the user choose an item and returns its path to the app.
en.disableEffect: App features that use this picker cannot browse or return a file or folder selection.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求选择文件或文件夹时，XayahSuSuSu 的 Material You File Explorer 会打开供用户浏览。用户选定内容后，它会将路径返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此选择器的应用功能将无法浏览或返回文件、文件夹路径。

en.description: The XCONNS PeerDeviceNet SDK runs this foreground Service to find network peers, manage connections and groups, and carry messages between devices. The app starts it when it uses PeerDeviceNet connection or messaging features.
en.disableEffect: Peer discovery, device connections, group communication, and messages through PeerDeviceNet will stop working.

zh-CN.description: XCONNS PeerDeviceNet SDK 通过这个前台服务发现网络中的其他设备、管理连接和群组，并在设备间传递消息。应用使用 PeerDeviceNet 的连接或消息功能时会启动它。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用通过 PeerDeviceNet 进行设备发现、连接、群组通信和设备间消息传递的功能将停止。

en.description: When the app starts a UnionPay payment through EasyPay, this Activity passes the payment request to UnionPay and returns the payment result. Disabling it breaks the UnionPay checkout flow.
en.disableEffect: Users may be unable to complete or return from UnionPay payments.

zh-CN.description: 应用通过 EasyPay 发起银联付款时，此 Activity 会把付款请求交给银联系统并返回付款结果。停用后，银联支付流程会中断。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户可能无法完成银联付款或返回付款结果。

en.description: When the app starts WeChat Pay or WeChat returns from a payment, this Activity forwards the request or payment response to EasyPay. Disabling it can prevent WeChat payments from completing.
en.disableEffect: Users may be unable to finish a WeChat Pay transaction or return its result to the app.

zh-CN.description: 应用发起微信支付或微信支付后返回时，此 Activity 会把请求或付款结果交给 EasyPay。停用后，微信支付可能无法完成。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户可能无法完成微信支付交易，或无法把支付结果返回给应用。

en.description: The Xiaoe WebCore SDK opens this Activity when an embedded web page requests a file. It lets the user select a document or capture a photo or video, then returns the selected item to that page.
en.disableEffect: File attachments, photo uploads, and video capture from those embedded pages will stop working.

zh-CN.description: 小鹅 WebCore SDK 在嵌入式网页请求文件时打开这个界面。用户可以选择文档、拍摄照片或录制视频，然后将所选文件返回给网页。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，嵌入式网页中的文件附件、照片上传和视频拍摄功能将无法使用。

en.description: The Xiaoe WebCore SDK uses this provider to create app-owned file links for files selected or captured from a web page, so Android's file and camera apps can pass those files safely.
en.disableEffect: The WebCore file picker or camera handoff can fail when a page attaches a file or photo.

zh-CN.description: 小鹅 WebCore SDK 通过这个内容提供器为网页选择或拍摄的文件生成应用内文件链接，便于 Android 的文件选择器和相机应用安全地传递这些文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，WebCore 网页中的文件选择或相机文件回传可能失败。

en.description: Android starts this Xiaoe WebCore provider with the app; it stores the context that WebCore's image loader needs to initialize. The loader uses it when a page or preview first requests an image.
en.disableEffect: WebCore image loading can fail when a page or preview requests a picture.

zh-CN.description: Android 会在应用启动时创建小鹅 WebCore 的这个内容提供器；它保存 WebCore 图片加载器初始化所需的上下文。网页或图片预览首次加载图片时会用到这个上下文。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，WebCore 网页或图片预览加载图片时可能失败。

en.description: The XiaoE (Xiaoe) Shop WebCore SDK opens this Activity when embedded web content asks to use the camera or microphone. It requests the Android permission and passes the result back to the web feature.
en.disableEffect: Photo capture or audio recording in those web pages may stop working because the page cannot obtain the required permission.

zh-CN.description: 小鹅通 WebCore SDK 的网页内容需要使用摄像头或麦克风时会打开此 Activity。它申请 Android 权限，并把允许或拒绝的结果交回网页功能。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 网页中的拍照或录音功能可能无法使用，因为页面无法取得所需权限。

en.description: The Xiaoe WebCore SDK opens this Activity when a page's photo picker is used. It displays a photo grid, can crop a camera image, and returns the chosen pictures to the page.
en.disableEffect: The page's built-in photo selection, cropping, and upload flow will stop working.

zh-CN.description: 小鹅 WebCore SDK 在网页打开图片选择器时显示这个界面。它提供照片网格，可裁剪相机拍摄的图片，并把选择结果返回给网页。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，网页中的照片选择、裁剪和上传流程将无法使用。

en.description: The Xiaoe WebCore SDK opens this Activity for its in-page image preview. Users can swipe through pictures and save them; editable image lists also offer a delete action.
en.disableEffect: WebCore pages will not be able to open this picture viewer or use its save and delete actions.

zh-CN.description: 小鹅 WebCore SDK 在网页请求预览图片时打开这个界面。用户可以滑动浏览并保存图片；可编辑的图片列表还提供删除操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，WebCore 网页将无法打开这个图片查看界面，也无法使用其中的保存和删除操作。

en.description: CodeXiaoMai EnvironmentSwitcher lists configured app modules and their available server environments. Tapping an option switches that module to the selected environment.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot use this screen to switch a configured module's environment when it is disabled.

zh-CN.description: CodeXiaoMai EnvironmentSwitcher 会列出应用模块及其可用的服务器环境；点击选项会将对应模块切换到所选环境。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，用户无法通过此页面切换已配置模块的环境。

en.description: Xiaomi Account OAuth opens this authorization page when an app starts Xiaomi sign-in. It displays the account authorization flow in a web view and returns the result.
en.disableEffect: Xiaomi account sign-in cannot open or complete its authorization page.

zh-CN.description: 应用发起小米账号登录时，小米 Account OAuth 会打开此授权页面，在网页界面显示账号授权流程并返回结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 小米账号登录无法打开或完成授权页面。

en.description: The Xiaomi GetApps IAP SDK uses this Activity to display a billing-related web page in a floating screen, loading the address supplied by the payment flow. Users can navigate back within the page or close it.
en.disableEffect: A GetApps IAP flow that needs this web page will not display it.

zh-CN.description: 小米 GetApps IAP SDK 用这个界面在浮动窗口中显示付款流程提供的网页，用户可以在页面内返回或关闭它。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，需要此网页的 GetApps IAP 流程将无法显示页面。

en.description: The Xiaomi GetApps IAP SDK uses this Activity for extra web pages in a purchase flow. It loads the supplied page and can ask whether the user wants to continue or cancel when leaving a payment that is still in progress.
en.disableEffect: The related billing page and its continue or cancel handling may not work.

zh-CN.description: 小米 GetApps IAP SDK 在购买流程中用这个界面显示附加网页。离开仍在进行的付款页面时，它还可以询问用户继续还是取消。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，相关付款页面及其继续或取消操作可能无法正常工作。

en.description: The Xiaomi GetApps IAP SDK uses this Activity to show its online payment page, start the selected billing flow, and return payment or account-binding results to the app.
en.disableEffect: In-app purchases and payment methods that use this page will not complete.

zh-CN.description: 小米 GetApps IAP SDK 用这个界面展示在线付款页面、启动所选支付流程，并把付款或账户绑定结果返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，使用此页面的应用内购买和支付方式将无法完成。

en.description: The Xiaomi GetApps IAP SDK opens this Activity to hand a purchase request to the Xiaomi payment app and return the purchase or cancellation result to the host app.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot start Xiaomi GetApps purchases or receive their results.

zh-CN.description: 小米 GetApps IAP SDK 用这个界面将购买请求交给小米付款应用，并把购买或取消结果返回宿主应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用无法通过小米 GetApps 启动购买或接收购买结果。

en.description: Xiaomi Mi Push uses this provider to read saved service-region and connection-host settings and to reset its host-request flag.
en.disableEffect: Xiaomi push registration or message delivery may fail if its client cannot read these settings; other app functions continue to work.

zh-CN.description: Xiaomi Mi Push 使用此 Provider 读取已保存的服务地区和连接主机设置，并重置主机请求标记。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 推送客户端无法读取这些设置时，Xiaomi 推送注册或消息送达可能失败；应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: Xiaomi Mi Picks Open Store can start this service with a request naming the host app. It accepts the process-start request and stays available as a sticky service.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents Mi Picks from using this process-start entry point, which can break the app’s Open Store integration.

zh-CN.description: Xiaomi 应用商店（Mi Picks）可以通过包含宿主应用名称的请求启动此服务。它接收进程启动请求，并以粘性服务方式保持运行。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Mi Picks 无法通过此入口启动宿主应用进程，可能导致应用的商店集成失效。

en.description: This Xiaomi Mi Picks Open Store service lets approved companion apps connect to the host app’s message center. It forwards cross-app requests and callbacks used by that integration.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it stops approved Open Store callers from exchanging messages with the app and can break its Mi Picks integration.

zh-CN.description: 此 Xiaomi Mi Picks 应用商店服务允许获准的配套应用连接宿主应用的消息中心，并转发集成所需的跨应用请求和回调。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，获准的商店应用无法再与宿主应用交换这些消息，可能导致 Mi Picks 集成失效。

en.description: Xiaomi Mi Push starts this background service to process queued push results; it calls the app's push receiver for messages, notification clicks, and registration results.
en.disableEffect: Mi Push messages and their callbacks will no longer reach the app.

zh-CN.description: 小米推送会启动此后台服务处理排队的推送结果，并调用应用的推送接收器处理消息、通知点击和注册结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，小米推送消息及其回调将无法送达应用。

en.description: When a user taps a Xiaomi Mi Push notification, this tiny temporary Activity passes the click to the Mi Push service so the app can open the message destination, then closes.
en.disableEffect: Tapping Xiaomi Mi Push notifications will no longer reach the app's message destination; the app's other features continue to work.

zh-CN.description: 用户点按小米 Mi Push 通知时，此小型临时 Activity 会把点按转交给 Mi Push 服务，以便应用打开消息目标页面，然后关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，点按小米 Mi Push 通知将无法打开应用中的消息目标页面；应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: Xiaomi Mi Push starts this service to parse incoming push work and dispatch messages or command results to the app's configured receiver; it also handles small SDK data uploads.
en.disableEffect: Xiaomi push messages, command results, and related callbacks will stop being processed.

zh-CN.description: 小米推送会启动此服务解析到达的推送任务，并将消息或指令结果交给应用配置的接收器；它也会处理小米 SDK 的小型数据上传。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，小米推送消息、指令结果及相关回调将无法处理。

en.description: When Xiaomi Market requests diagnostic logs, this Xiaomi Mi Push service gathers and compresses the push SDK logs and shares them back.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents Xiaomi Market from retrieving diagnostic logs from the app's Xiaomi push SDK.

zh-CN.description: 小米应用商店请求诊断日志时，这个小米推送服务会收集并压缩推送 SDK 日志，再提供给商店。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，小米应用商店将无法从应用中的小米推送 SDK 获取诊断日志。

en.description: Android runs this Xiaomi Mi Push job service for scheduled push work; it starts the push connection service with a timer request and then finishes the job.
en.disableEffect: Scheduled Mi Push connection checks and keep-alive work will stop running.

zh-CN.description: Android 会在执行小米推送的定时任务时运行此服务；它会带定时请求启动推送连接服务，然后结束该任务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，小米推送的定时连接检查和保活任务将停止。

en.description: Xiaomi Mi Push runs this service in its separate push process to maintain the background connection and handle incoming push commands and timer requests.
en.disableEffect: Xiaomi Mi Push will lose its background connection and stop receiving push messages.

zh-CN.description: 小米推送会在独立的推送进程中运行此服务，以维持后台连接并处理到达的推送指令和定时请求。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，小米推送将失去后台连接，无法继续接收推送消息。

en.description: When the Xiaomi Mi Push log service shares a compressed diagnostic archive, this provider lets Xiaomi Market read that file from the app's temporary push-log folder.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents the Xiaomi diagnostic service from opening the log archive, so log retrieval will fail.

zh-CN.description: 小米推送日志服务分享压缩后的诊断文件时，这个提供器允许小米应用商店读取应用临时推送日志目录中的文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，小米诊断服务将无法打开日志压缩包，日志获取会失败。

en.description: Xiaomi Mi Push integrations from Cosmos Photon, Leanplum, MoMagic, Tencent TPNS, or Umeng use this receiver when the network changes to reconnect push and retry pending settings or token synchronization.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it can prevent Xiaomi push from reconnecting or resuming after a network change.

zh-CN.description: Cosmos Photon、Leanplum、MoMagic、Tencent TPNS 或 Umeng 集成中的 Xiaomi Mi Push 会在网络变化时使用此 Receiver 重连推送服务，并重试待处理的设置或令牌同步。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，小米推送可能无法在网络变化后重新连接或恢复。

en.description: On Xiaomi Mi Push's internal timer broadcast, this receiver starts the push connection service with a timer request; it also clears the old timer when the SDK cancels it.
en.disableEffect: Mi Push's periodic keep-alive refresh will stop, interrupting background push receipt.

zh-CN.description: 收到小米推送的内部定时广播时，此接收器会带定时请求启动推送连接服务；SDK 取消定时任务时，它也会清除旧任务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，小米推送的周期性保活刷新将停止，后台推送接收会中断。

en.description: When the NXCloud floating-window helper needs overlay access, it opens Android's permission page and reports whether the user granted it.
en.disableEffect: The app may not be able to enable its optional floating call window, while ordinary in-app calling remains available.

zh-CN.description: NXCloud 悬浮窗辅助库需要悬浮显示权限时，会打开 Android 权限页面，并返回用户是否已授权。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用可能无法启用可选的通话悬浮窗，但普通应用内通话仍可使用。

en.description: The XING Android SDK opens this Activity when the app starts XING sign-in. It loads the authorization page, receives the sign-in return, and hands the access credentials back to the app.
en.disableEffect: XING sign-in through this SDK will not complete.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动 XING 登录时，XING Android SDK 会打开这个界面。它加载授权网页、接收登录返回，并将访问凭据交回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，通过该 SDK 进行的 XING 登录将无法完成。

en.description: The XING Android OAuth SDK opens this Activity when the app starts XING sign-in. It displays the authorization page, processes the sign-in return, and hands the token result back to the app.
en.disableEffect: XING sign-in through this SDK will not complete.

zh-CN.description: 应用发起 XING 登录时，XING Android OAuth SDK 会打开这个界面。它显示授权网页、处理登录返回，并将令牌结果交回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，通过该 SDK 进行的 XING 登录将无法完成。

en.description: Luoqqsh's Push SDK Google channel receives Firebase notifications and forwards their text and click destination to the app's registered handler. New registration-token events are logged for the SDK.
en.disableEffect: Firebase notifications and their click actions will no longer reach the app through this channel.

zh-CN.description: Luoqqsh 的 Push SDK Google 通道接收 Firebase 通知，并将正文和点击目标转交给应用注册的处理程序。新的注册令牌事件会记入 SDK 日志。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Firebase 通知及其点击操作将无法再通过此通道送达应用。

en.description: Luoqqsh's Push SDK Huawei channel receives Huawei push messages and registration-token updates. It forwards notification details and token success or failure to the app's push callback.
en.disableEffect: Huawei push messages and registration updates will stop reaching the app through this channel.

zh-CN.description: Luoqqsh 的 Push SDK 华为通道接收华为推送消息和注册令牌更新，并将通知内容及令牌注册结果交给应用的推送回调。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，华为推送消息和注册更新将无法再通过此通道送达应用。

en.description: Luoqqsh's Push SDK Vivo channel receives Vivo registration and data-message callbacks. This version records the registration ID and leaves message handling to Vivo Push's base behavior.
en.disableEffect: Vivo push events will no longer reach this adapter.

zh-CN.description: Luoqqsh 的 Push SDK Vivo 通道接收 Vivo 的注册和数据消息回调。此版本会记录注册 ID，消息处理则交由 Vivo Push 的基础实现。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Vivo 推送事件将无法到达此适配器。

en.description: Luoqqsh's Push SDK Xiaomi channel receives Mi Push message arrivals, notification taps, and registration, alias, and topic updates for the app.
en.disableEffect: Xiaomi push events, notification taps, and registration updates will no longer reach the app through this channel.

zh-CN.description: Luoqqsh 的 Push SDK 小米通道接收 Mi Push 消息、通知点击，以及应用的注册、别名和主题更新。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，小米推送事件、通知点击和注册更新将无法再通过此通道送达应用。

en.description: ECHO ImageEditor opens this screen for an image supplied by the app, where users can crop, rotate, add stickers or text, draw, and return the saved image.
en.disableEffect: The app's image-editing flow will no longer open or return the edited image.

zh-CN.description: 应用传入图片时，ECHO ImageEditor 会打开此编辑界面，用户可裁剪、旋转、添加贴纸或文字、涂画，并把保存后的图片返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用的图片编辑流程将无法打开，也无法返回编辑后的图片。

en.description: After a player shares through WeChat from the YYXXGame YYXX Comm sharing SDK, WeChat returns here with the result; this Activity reports whether the share succeeded, was cancelled, or failed.
en.disableEffect: The WeChat share result is not returned to the YYXX Comm SDK, so the in-app sharing flow may not complete.

zh-CN.description: 玩家通过 YYXXGame 的 YYXX 通信分享 SDK 分享到微信后，微信会把结果返回此 Activity；它会通知 SDK 分享成功、已取消或失败。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 微信分享结果无法返回 YYXX 通信 SDK，应用内的分享流程可能无法完成。

en.description: The Xinliangxiang voice-read SDK uses this provider to let Android's installer read an advertised app's downloaded installation file.
en.disableEffect: The installer may be unable to read the downloaded app file, so installing the advertised app can fail.

zh-CN.description: Xinliangxiang 的 voice-read SDK 使用此文件提供器，让 Android 安装程序读取下载的广告应用安装文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 安装程序可能无法读取下载的应用文件，因此广告应用可能无法安装。

en.description: The Xinliangxiang voice-read SDK starts this service when an ad page needs to download or resume video media. It manages those transfers through a cached download queue and shows a foreground download notification.
en.disableEffect: The SDK's video downloads will stop or will not resume automatically.

zh-CN.description: Xinliangxiang 的 voice-read SDK 会在广告页面需要下载或继续下载视频媒体时启动此服务，通过带缓存的下载队列管理传输，并显示前台下载通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: SDK 的视频下载会停止，或无法自动继续。

en.description: The Xinliangxiang voice-read SDK starts this service when another SDK part needs to share advertising settings or event callbacks. It keeps those ad-service connections available to the rest of the SDK.
en.disableEffect: Some SDK ad settings and interactions may no longer be shared or reported correctly.

zh-CN.description: Xinliangxiang 的 voice-read SDK 会在其他 SDK 模块需要共享广告设置或事件回调时启动此服务，让 SDK 的广告服务保持连接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 部分 SDK 广告设置和互动可能无法正常共享或报告。

en.description: The Xinliangxiang voice-read SDK starts this service when another SDK part needs to share advertising settings or event callbacks. It keeps those ad-service connections available to the rest of the SDK.
en.disableEffect: Some SDK ad settings and interactions may no longer be shared or reported correctly.

zh-CN.description: Xinliangxiang 的 voice-read SDK 会在其他 SDK 模块需要共享广告设置或事件回调时启动此服务，让 SDK 的广告服务保持连接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 部分 SDK 广告设置和互动可能无法正常共享或报告。

en.description: The Xinliangxiang voice-read SDK runs this receiver when a user taps a notification created by an SDK advertisement. It handles the ad click, sends its follow-up action, and dismisses the notification.
en.disableEffect: Tapping the SDK's ad notifications will no longer open their follow-up action or record the click.

zh-CN.description: Xinliangxiang 的 voice-read SDK 会在用户点击 SDK 广告发出的通知时运行此接收器，处理广告点击、执行后续操作并关闭该通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 点击 SDK 广告通知将不再打开后续页面，也不会记录该次点击。

en.description: The Xinliangxiang voice-read SDK opens this screen when a user chooses the video strategy in an interactive ad. It plays the supplied video and counts the required number of views.
en.disableEffect: The interactive ad cannot be completed, and rewards for watching it will no longer be granted.

zh-CN.description: Xinliangxiang 的 voice-read SDK 会在用户在互动广告中选择视频攻略时打开此页面，播放指定视频并累计所需的观看次数。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 互动广告将无法完成，观看该广告的奖励也不会再发放。

en.description: The Xinliangxiang voice-read SDK opens this screen when a user taps an advertised app's download offer. It shows the app's name, version, developer details, and download button.
en.disableEffect: This voice-read app-install offer and its download confirmation page will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: Xinliangxiang 的 voice-read SDK 会在用户点击广告应用的下载入口时打开此页面，显示该应用的名称、版本、开发者信息和下载按钮。
zh-CN.disableEffect: voice-read SDK 的应用安装广告及下载确认页将无法打开。

en.description: The Xinliangxiang voice-read SDK opens this screen when an advertised app uses the second download-confirmation design. It shows the app details and download action in that alternate layout.
en.disableEffect: The second style of voice-read app-install page will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: Xinliangxiang 的 voice-read SDK 会在广告应用使用第二种下载确认页面样式时打开此页面，以另一种版式显示应用信息和下载入口。
zh-CN.disableEffect: voice-read SDK 的第二种应用安装页面将无法打开。

en.description: The Xinliangxiang voice-read SDK opens this screen when an advertised app uses the third download-confirmation design. It shows the app details and download action together with the ad's follow-up page.
en.disableEffect: The third style of voice-read app-install page will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: Xinliangxiang 的 voice-read SDK 会在广告应用使用第三种下载确认页面样式时打开此页面，显示应用信息、下载入口和广告的后续页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: voice-read SDK 的第三种应用安装页面将无法打开。

en.description: The Xinliangxiang voice-read SDK opens this screen when a user chooses to download an advertised app and opens its permission details. It lists the advertised app's requested permissions and offers a download button.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to review this ad app's permissions or continue from this SDK page to its download.

zh-CN.description: Xinliangxiang 的 voice-read SDK 会在用户选择下载广告应用并查看权限详情时打开此页面，列出该应用申请的权限并提供下载按钮。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在此 SDK 页面查看广告应用权限或继续下载。

en.description: The Xinliangxiang voice-read SDK opens this screen when an ad response selects a timed web-browsing reward task. It loads the offer page, tracks the viewing time, and displays the result.
en.disableEffect: This timed ad-browsing task will stop, and its viewing rewards will no longer be granted.

zh-CN.description: Xinliangxiang 的 voice-read SDK 会在广告返回限时网页浏览奖励任务时打开此页面，加载推广页面、记录浏览时长并显示任务结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 限时广告浏览任务会停止，浏览奖励也不会再发放。

en.description: The Xinliangxiang voice-read SDK opens this screen when an ad response selects the clock-style landing offer. It shows its offer details, reward information, and next action.
en.disableEffect: This clock-style ad offer and its reward flow will no longer be available.

zh-CN.description: Xinliangxiang 的 voice-read SDK 会在广告返回时钟样式的落地推广页时打开此页面，显示推广详情、奖励信息和后续操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 时钟样式的广告推广页及其奖励流程将无法使用。

en.description: The Xinliangxiang voice-read SDK opens this screen when an ad response selects the clock-style pop-up landing offer. It shows the ad poster, reward details, and its follow-up action.
en.disableEffect: This pop-up ad offer and its reward flow will no longer be available.

zh-CN.description: Xinliangxiang 的 voice-read SDK 会在广告返回时钟样式的弹出推广页时打开此页面，显示广告海报、奖励详情和后续操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 弹出式广告推广页及其奖励流程将无法使用。

en.description: The Xinliangxiang voice-read SDK opens this screen when duplicate-ad protection routes an advertised app task to the tryout page. It offers the app's download or launch experience and tracks the user's choice.
en.disableEffect: This duplicate-aware advertised-app tryout and download route will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: Xinliangxiang 的 voice-read SDK 会在重复广告保护将应用推广任务转到试用页面时打开此页面，提供应用下载或打开体验，并记录用户选择。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 带重复保护的广告应用试用和下载入口将无法打开。

en.description: When VoiceRead opens an advertisement landing page, this screen shows the promoted app, its description and a download option.
en.disableEffect: The related VoiceRead advertisement and its landing page will no longer appear.

zh-CN.description: VoiceRead 打开广告落地页时，此页面会展示推广应用、应用介绍和下载入口。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 对应的 VoiceRead 广告及其落地页将不再显示。

en.description: The Xinliangxiang voice-read SDK opens this screen when an ad response selects an interactive web introduction. It loads the ad's web content, tracks the required interaction, and can start its video strategy.
en.disableEffect: The interactive ad introduction cannot be completed, and its viewing rewards will no longer be granted.

zh-CN.description: Xinliangxiang 的 voice-read SDK 会在广告返回互动式网页介绍时打开此页面，加载广告网页、记录所需互动，并可启动视频攻略。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 互动广告介绍将无法完成，观看奖励也不会再发放。

en.description: The Xinliangxiang voice-read SDK opens this screen when an ad response selects a live-ad experience. It presents the live promotion and tracks its start and acquisition reward.
en.disableEffect: The SDK live-ad experience and its associated ad reward will no longer be available.

zh-CN.description: Xinliangxiang 的 voice-read SDK 会在广告返回直播推广体验时打开此页面，展示直播推广并记录体验开始和转化奖励。
zh-CN.disableEffect: SDK 直播广告体验及相关奖励将无法使用。

en.description: The Xinliangxiang voice-read SDK opens this screen when a user opens the goods list from a live-shopping ad. It lists promoted items and opens the selected item's offer.
en.disableEffect: The product list and item links in this live-shopping ad will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: Xinliangxiang 的 voice-read SDK 会在用户从直播购物广告打开商品列表时打开此页面，列出推广商品并打开所选商品的推广页。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 直播购物广告中的商品列表和商品入口将无法打开。

en.description: The Xinliangxiang voice-read SDK opens this screen when a user opens the web-based goods list from a live-shopping ad. It hosts the live promotion's product list and its item links.
en.disableEffect: The web-based product list for this live-shopping ad will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: Xinliangxiang 的 voice-read SDK 会在用户从直播购物广告打开网页商品列表时打开此页面，显示直播推广的商品列表和商品入口。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 直播购物广告的网页商品列表将无法打开。

en.description: The Xinliangxiang voice-read SDK opens this screen when a user opens a web-based live-shopping video ad. It shows the video page with comments, product phrases, and goods links.
en.disableEffect: The interactive live-video ad and its product links will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: Xinliangxiang 的 voice-read SDK 会在用户打开网页直播购物视频广告时显示此页面，其中包含视频、评论、商品短语和商品入口。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 互动直播视频广告及商品入口将无法打开。

en.description: The Xinliangxiang voice-read SDK opens this screen when a live-video ad selects its first landing-page design. It shows the live promotion and its app-download action.
en.disableEffect: The first live-ad download page and its offer will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: Xinliangxiang 的 voice-read SDK 会在直播视频广告选择第一种落地页样式时打开此页面，显示直播推广和应用下载入口。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 第一种直播广告下载页及推广内容将无法打开。

en.description: The Xinliangxiang voice-read SDK opens this screen when a live-video ad selects its second landing-page design. It shows the live promotion and its app-download action.
en.disableEffect: The second live-ad download page and its offer will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: Xinliangxiang 的 voice-read SDK 会在直播视频广告选择第二种落地页样式时打开此页面，显示直播推广和应用下载入口。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 第二种直播广告下载页及推广内容将无法打开。

en.description: The Xinliangxiang voice-read SDK opens this screen when a live-video ad selects its third landing-page design. It shows the live promotion and its app-download action.
en.disableEffect: The third live-ad download page and its offer will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: Xinliangxiang 的 voice-read SDK 会在直播视频广告选择第三种落地页样式时打开此页面，显示直播推广和应用下载入口。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 第三种直播广告下载页及推广内容将无法打开。

en.description: The Xinliangxiang voice-read SDK opens this screen when an ad response selects the second-generation live-video experience. It plays the live promotion and tracks whether the viewing requirement is met.
en.disableEffect: This live-video ad task will stop, and its viewing rewards will no longer be granted.

zh-CN.description: Xinliangxiang 的 voice-read SDK 会在广告返回第二代直播视频体验时打开此页面，播放直播推广并记录是否达到观看要求。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 直播视频广告任务会停止，观看奖励也不会再发放。

en.description: The Xinliangxiang voice-read SDK opens this screen when a user opens a product offer in the SDK's shopping promotion. It shows a product video, item details, and available rewards.
en.disableEffect: The SDK's video-led product offer and its purchase action will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: Xinliangxiang 的 voice-read SDK 会在用户打开 SDK 的商品推广时打开此页面，显示商品视频、商品详情和可领取的奖励。
zh-CN.disableEffect: SDK 的视频商品推广页和购买入口将无法打开。

en.description: The Xinliangxiang voice-read SDK opens this screen when a user opens a shopping-ad product landing page. It plays the product video, shows prices and coupons, and opens the linked shop when the user taps buy.
en.disableEffect: The SDK shopping offer, coupon link, and purchase route will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: Xinliangxiang 的 voice-read SDK 会在用户打开购物广告的商品推广页时打开此页面，播放商品视频、显示价格和优惠券，并在点击购买时打开关联店铺。
zh-CN.disableEffect: SDK 购物推广、优惠券入口和购买跳转将无法打开。

en.description: The Xinliangxiang voice-read SDK opens this screen when a user starts a multi-step app-experience reward offer. It explains the experience task and the reward available for completing it.
en.disableEffect: The multi-step ad-reward task cannot start, and its ad-view rewards will no longer be granted.

zh-CN.description: Xinliangxiang 的 voice-read SDK 会在用户开始多步骤应用体验奖励任务时打开此页面，说明体验任务和完成后可获得的奖励。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 多步骤广告奖励任务无法启动，观看相关广告的奖励也不会再发放。

en.description: The Xinliangxiang voice-read SDK opens this screen when a rewarded ad requires the user to install or try another app. It tracks the external app task's progress and warns before the user leaves.
en.disableEffect: This external-app ad task cannot complete, and its associated rewards will no longer be granted.

zh-CN.description: Xinliangxiang 的 voice-read SDK 会在奖励广告要求用户安装或体验另一款应用时打开此页面，记录外部应用任务进度，并在用户离开前提示。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 外部应用广告任务将无法完成，相关奖励也不会再发放。

en.description: The Xinliangxiang voice-read SDK opens this screen when a user opens the guide for an external-app reward task. It explains how to try the advertised app before continuing the task.
en.disableEffect: The guide for this ad-reward task will no longer appear, so users cannot follow this route to its reward.

zh-CN.description: Xinliangxiang 的 voice-read SDK 会在用户打开外部应用奖励任务的说明时打开此页面，说明如何体验广告应用并继续任务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 广告奖励任务说明将无法显示，用户也无法通过此流程领取奖励。

en.description: The Xinliangxiang voice-read SDK opens this screen when a multi-step ad offers an entry screen to register or try the promoted app. It shows the reward amount and starts that app-experience step.
en.disableEffect: This reward-entry step will no longer open, and its associated ad rewards will not be granted.

zh-CN.description: Xinliangxiang 的 voice-read SDK 会在多步骤广告提供注册或体验推广应用的入口时打开此页面，显示奖励金额并启动应用体验步骤。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 奖励任务入口将无法打开，相关广告奖励也不会发放。

en.description: The Xinliangxiang voice-read SDK opens this screen when an ad response selects the multi-stage reward landing page. It shows the reward steps and lets the user continue an unfinished ad-view task.
en.disableEffect: The multi-stage reward flow will stop, and rewards for watching its ads will no longer be granted.

zh-CN.description: Xinliangxiang 的 voice-read SDK 会在广告返回多阶段奖励推广页时打开此页面，显示奖励步骤，并允许用户继续未完成的广告观看任务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 多阶段奖励流程会停止，观看相关广告的奖励也不会再发放。

en.description: The Xinliangxiang voice-read SDK opens this screen when a user pauses or returns to an unfinished experience-reward task. It asks whether to continue the task or give up its pending reward.
en.disableEffect: Users will no longer be able to resume this ad-reward task or claim its pending reward.

zh-CN.description: Xinliangxiang 的 voice-read SDK 会在用户暂停或返回未完成的体验奖励任务时打开此页面，询问是否继续任务或放弃待领取的奖励。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法继续此广告奖励任务或领取待发放的奖励。

en.description: The Xinliangxiang voice-read SDK opens this screen when a user tries to leave before finishing an experience reward. It offers a short additional tryout period to keep the reward available.

en.description: The Xinliangxiang voice-read SDK opens this screen when an app-download ad selects a web landing page. It loads the promotion in an embedded browser and connects its download controls to the SDK.
en.disableEffect: The web-based app-download offer and its download action will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: Xinliangxiang 的 voice-read SDK 会在应用下载广告选择网页落地页时显示此页面，在内嵌浏览器中加载推广内容并连接 SDK 下载控件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 网页应用下载推广及下载入口将无法打开。

en.description: The Xinliangxiang voice-read SDK opens this screen when an ad response selects the live-ad exposure experience. It shows the live promotion and tracks its start and acquisition reward.
en.disableEffect: The live-ad experience and its associated ad reward will no longer be available.

zh-CN.description: Xinliangxiang 的 voice-read SDK 会在广告返回直播曝光体验页时打开此页面，展示直播推广并记录体验开始和转化奖励。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 直播广告体验及相关奖励将无法使用。

en.description: The Xinliangxiang voice-read SDK opens this screen when a user opens the goods list from a live-shopping ad. It lists promoted items and opens the selected item's offer.
en.disableEffect: The product list and item links in this live-shopping ad will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: Xinliangxiang 的 voice-read SDK 会在用户从直播购物广告打开商品列表时打开此页面，列出推广商品并打开所选商品的推广页。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 直播购物广告中的商品列表和商品入口将无法打开。

en.description: The Xinliangxiang voice-read SDK opens this screen when a user opens a web-based live-shopping video ad. It shows the video page with comments, product phrases, and goods links.
en.disableEffect: The interactive live-video ad and its product links will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: Xinliangxiang 的 voice-read SDK 会在用户打开网页直播购物视频广告时显示此页面，其中包含视频、评论、商品短语和商品入口。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 互动直播视频广告及商品入口将无法打开。

en.description: The Xinliangxiang voice-read SDK opens this screen when an ad response selects the live-video reward experience. It plays the promoted live video and tracks when the viewing requirement is met.
en.disableEffect: The live-video ad task will stop, and its viewing rewards will no longer be granted.

zh-CN.description: Xinliangxiang 的 voice-read SDK 会在广告返回直播视频奖励体验时打开此页面，播放直播推广视频并记录是否达到观看要求。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 直播视频广告任务会停止，观看奖励也不会再发放。

en.description: The Xinliangxiang voice-read SDK opens this screen when a user taps the bottom offer in a short-video shopping ad. It shows the product's pop-up offer and its next action.
en.disableEffect: This pop-up shopping offer and its product link will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: Xinliangxiang 的 voice-read SDK 会在用户点击短视频购物广告底部的推广入口时打开此页面，显示商品弹出推广内容和后续操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 弹出式购物推广及商品入口将无法打开。

en.description: The Xinliangxiang voice-read SDK opens this screen when a shopping ad selects the product-introduction page. It plays the product promotion and routes the user to its shop or pop-up offer.
en.disableEffect: The shopping-ad introduction and its associated viewing rewards will no longer be available.

zh-CN.description: Xinliangxiang 的 voice-read SDK 会在购物广告选择商品介绍页时打开此页面，播放商品推广内容，并将用户带到店铺或弹出推广页。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 购物广告介绍页及相关观看奖励将无法使用。

en.description: The Xinliangxiang voice-read SDK opens this screen when a user opens the main product offer from a short-video shopping ad. It shows the promoted product's shopping landing page.
en.disableEffect: The main product offer and its shopping link will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: Xinliangxiang 的 voice-read SDK 会在用户从短视频购物广告打开商品主推广页时打开此页面，显示推广商品的购物落地页。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 商品主推广页及购物入口将无法打开。

en.description: The Xinliangxiang voice-read SDK opens this screen when a user opens the pop-up product offer from a short-video shopping ad. It shows the promoted product in a smaller pop-up landing page.
en.disableEffect: The pop-up product offer and its shopping link will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: Xinliangxiang 的 voice-read SDK 会在用户从短视频购物广告打开弹出式商品推广时打开此页面，在较小的弹出页面中显示推广商品。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 弹出式商品推广及购物入口将无法打开。

en.description: The Xinliangxiang voice-read SDK opens this screen when duplicate-ad protection routes an advertised app task to the tryout page. It offers the app's download or launch experience and tracks the user's choice.
en.disableEffect: This duplicate-aware advertised-app tryout and download route will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: Xinliangxiang 的 voice-read SDK 会在重复广告保护将应用推广任务转到试用页面时打开此页面，提供应用下载或打开体验，并记录用户选择。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 带重复保护的广告应用试用和下载入口将无法打开。

en.description: The Xinliangxiang Voice Read SDK shows an advertiser’s multi-step external-app offer here, including task instructions, progress, and the reward amount. The user follows the steps in another app and returns to continue the offer.
en.disableEffect: Blocking it prevents the SDK's external-app ad task from opening or completing, so rewards for that task will no longer be granted.

zh-CN.description: Xinliangxiang Voice Read SDK 会在这里展示广告主的多步外部应用任务，包括任务说明、进度和奖励金额；用户按指引打开或使用其他应用后，可返回继续任务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，SDK 无法打开或完成这项外部应用广告任务，相关奖励将无法领取。

en.description: When an ad offer provides a swipe guide, the Xinliangxiang Voice Read SDK opens this page after the user swipes up. It plays a configured video or animation that shows the return gesture and explains how to continue the task.
en.disableEffect: Blocking it removes the configured swipe-back guide, interrupting ad tasks that use this return flow; rewards for those tasks will no longer be granted.

zh-CN.description: 当广告任务页配置了滑动指引时，用户上滑后 Xinliangxiang Voice Read SDK 会打开本页，播放视频或动画示范下滑返回并继续任务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，使用此返回流程的广告任务将无法显示滑动指引并继续完成，相关广告奖励将无法领取。

en.description: The Xinliangxiang Voice Read SDK uses this page for a multi-step advertiser offer. It shows the reward amount, task instructions, and progress as the user completes the offer.
en.disableEffect: Blocking it prevents this offer flow from opening, so users cannot complete the associated ad task or receive its reward.

zh-CN.description: Xinliangxiang Voice Read SDK 会在这里展示广告主的多步任务、奖励金额和完成进度；用户按页面指引完成任务后返回领取奖励。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，此广告任务页面无法打开，用户不能完成任务或领取对应奖励。

en.description: For some single-task, experience, or return-visit offers, the Xinliangxiang Voice Read SDK shows this page with advertiser instructions and reward progress, then prompts the user to continue the task.
en.disableEffect: Blocking it prevents the SDK's alternate task and reward flow from completing, so its ad reward will no longer be granted.

zh-CN.description: 对于部分单项或体验类广告任务，Xinliangxiang Voice Read SDK 会展示此页面，说明任务和奖励进度，并提示用户继续或重新打开广告内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，这类 SDK 广告任务无法完成，对应奖励将无法领取。

en.description: When an article in a Xinliangxiang Voice Read SDK reading offer cannot open in the built-in reader, this page plays a guide and explains how to copy the reading link and continue in WeChat.
en.disableEffect: Blocking it removes the WeChat link fallback, so users may not finish this reading ad or earn its reward.

zh-CN.description: 当 Xinliangxiang Voice Read SDK 的阅读任务无法在内置阅读页打开时，本页播放操作视频并提供复制链接、前往微信的步骤；用户可复制链接后切换到微信继续阅读。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法使用微信链接补救流程，可能无法完成此阅读广告任务并获得奖励。

en.description: When a reading check fails and a recovery guide is available, the Xinliangxiang Voice Read SDK shows a video or rotating illustrations with instructions and confirm or close controls.
en.disableEffect: Blocking it removes the retry guidance; users whose reading check fails cannot recover this ad task or receive its reading reward.

zh-CN.description: 阅读检查未通过且有补救指引时，Xinliangxiang Voice Read SDK 会展示本页，播放示范视频或轮播操作图片，并提供确认和关闭入口。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，阅读检查失败时没有补救指引，用户无法恢复此广告任务并领取阅读奖励。

en.description: The Xinliangxiang Voice Read SDK opens this advertiser-branded page for a reading ad. It shows the reward, reading instructions, and a task control, then checks reading progress and displays the next step.
en.disableEffect: Blocking it removes the SDK's reading offer screen; users cannot complete this ad-reading task or receive its reading reward.

zh-CN.description: Xinliangxiang Voice Read SDK 会为广告阅读任务展示本页，说明广告内容、阅读步骤和奖励；用户阅读后，页面会检查进度并显示后续任务提示。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，SDK 的阅读广告任务无法启动或完成，用户将无法获得这项阅读任务的奖励。

en.description: For an advertiser offer with a reading plan, the Xinliangxiang Voice Read SDK shows the advertiser, total reading reward, and a reader panel where users follow assigned articles and track task progress.
en.disableEffect: Blocking it removes the reading-plan offer and article flow, so users cannot complete its ad task or receive the reading reward.

zh-CN.description: 当广告包含阅读计划时，Xinliangxiang Voice Read SDK 会在此显示广告主信息、阅读奖励和阅读面板，用户可按计划浏览文章并查看任务进度。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，阅读计划和文章任务无法完成，用户将无法领取对应广告奖励。

en.description: If the built-in reader cannot open an article, the Xinliangxiang Voice Read SDK shows a guide, copies the reading link, and opens the configured app so the user can paste the link into WeChat.
en.disableEffect: Blocking it removes the failed-open recovery path, preventing affected users from completing the ad-reading task and receiving its reward.

zh-CN.description: 如果内置阅读页无法打开文章，Xinliangxiang Voice Read SDK 会显示操作视频和步骤，复制阅读链接并打开配置的应用，供用户切换到微信粘贴链接继续阅读。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，文章打不开时无法通过此页面继续阅读，受影响的广告阅读任务及其奖励无法完成。

en.description: The Xinliangxiang Voice Read SDK opens this screen for a spoken ad-reward task, showing the advertiser’s message and guiding the user through a read-aloud flow. Its close control can show instructions for leaving the task.
en.disableEffect: Blocking it stops this voice ad task from opening or completing, so rewards for the associated ad will no longer be granted.

zh-CN.description: Xinliangxiang Voice Read SDK 会在本页展示语音广告任务和广告主内容，并引导用户朗读内容以完成任务；退出时可能显示退出提示。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，此语音广告任务无法打开或完成，通过该 SDK 获得的广告奖励将不再发放。

en.description: This older Xinliangxiang Voice Read SDK screen appears for question-based voice ads. It shows an advertiser-related question and answer choices, then guides the user through a spoken answer check.
en.disableEffect: Blocking it prevents the spoken question step from running, so users cannot complete that rewarded ad or receive its reward.

zh-CN.description: 这是旧版 Xinliangxiang Voice Read SDK 用于问答式语音广告任务的页面，会展示广告相关问题和选项，并引导用户通过语音作答来完成检查。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，问答语音步骤无法运行，用户不能完成该奖励广告任务或领取奖励。

en.description: For a slogan-based voice ad, the Xinliangxiang Voice Read SDK shows the advertiser’s slogan and reward, plays spoken guidance, and prompts the user to read the slogan aloud to complete the task.
en.disableEffect: Blocking it prevents the slogan-reading reward step from running, so rewards for completing that ad will no longer be granted.

zh-CN.description: 这是 Xinliangxiang Voice Read SDK 的口号朗读任务页，会展示广告口号和奖励信息、播放语音指导，并引导用户朗读口号完成任务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，口号朗读广告任务无法完成，对应的广告奖励将不再发放。

en.description: After a live-ad task passes its completion check, the Xinliangxiang Voice Read SDK shows the advertiser, reward amount, completion tip, and a countdown before closing this screen.
en.disableEffect: This screen opens after the live-ad reward has already been verified; if it cannot open, the app may stop unexpectedly at the end of the ad.

zh-CN.description: 完成直播广告任务后，Xinliangxiang Voice Read SDK 会显示广告主、奖励金额、完成提示和倒计时，随后关闭此页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 此页面会在直播广告奖励检查通过后打开；如果页面无法打开，应用可能在广告结束时意外退出。

en.description: The Xlythe Message Based Notifications library runs this receiver when someone replies from a conversation notification. It sends the reply to the app and refreshes or closes that notification.
en.disableEffect: Replying from a notification will stop working, so users will need to open the app to answer.

zh-CN.description: 用户从会话通知中回复时，Xlythe Message Based Notifications 库会运行此接收器。它会把回复交给应用，并更新或关闭该通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法直接从通知回复，必须打开应用才能答复。

en.description: The Xlythe Message Based Notifications library runs this receiver when a conversation notification is tapped. It opens the app's supplied conversation screen and removes that notification.
en.disableEffect: Tapping a conversation notification will no longer open the related screen in the app.

zh-CN.description: 用户点按会话通知时，Xlythe Message Based Notifications 库会运行此接收器。它会打开应用提供的会话页面，并移除该通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户点按会话通知后，将无法打开应用中的相关页面。

en.description: The Xlythe Message Based Notifications library runs this receiver when a conversation notification is dismissed. It removes the saved notification entry and notifies the app that the notification was dismissed.
en.disableEffect: The app will not receive notification dismissal callbacks, and saved notification entries may remain until they are refreshed.

zh-CN.description: 用户划掉会话通知时，Xlythe Message Based Notifications 库会运行此接收器。它会删除保存的通知记录，并通知应用该通知已关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将收不到通知关闭事件，保存的通知记录也可能一直保留到下次刷新。

en.description: After the app is updated, the Xlythe Message Based Notifications library uses this receiver to clear its saved conversation and notification cache.
en.disableEffect: Old notification data may remain after an app update and interfere with restored message notifications.

zh-CN.description: 应用更新后，Xlythe Message Based Notifications 库会通过此接收器清除保存的会话和通知缓存。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用更新后，旧通知数据可能残留，并影响消息通知的恢复。

en.description: The Xlythe Message Based Notifications library uses this receiver to restore a saved notification value from Android's system-held copy when the value is requested. The restored value is put back into the library's cache.
en.disableEffect: The library may lose saved conversation and message data needed to rebuild notifications after it leaves memory.

zh-CN.description: Xlythe Message Based Notifications 库需要读取保存的通知数据时，会通过此接收器从 Android 暂存的数据中恢复对应值，再放回库的缓存。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用进程退出后，库可能无法恢复重建通知所需的会话和消息数据。

en.description: The Xlythe Weather Service library runs this worker for scheduled or immediate weather requests. It uses the saved API key and device location to fetch current conditions from OpenWeather, save them, and notify the app that the data changed.
en.disableEffect: The app will stop refreshing current conditions from OpenWeather, so its weather display may become outdated or unavailable.

zh-CN.description: Xlythe Weather Service 库会按计划或立即运行此任务来获取天气。它使用保存的密钥和设备位置从 OpenWeather 获取当前天气、保存结果，并通知应用数据已更新。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法继续从 OpenWeather 刷新当前天气，天气显示可能过期或不可用。

en.description: The Xlythe Weather Service library receives app-update and device-boot broadcasts here. It restores any previously scheduled OpenWeather, Weather Underground, and Pirate Weather refreshes.
en.disableEffect: Scheduled weather refreshes may not restart after the app is updated or the device reboots.

zh-CN.description: Xlythe Weather Service 库会通过此接收器接收应用更新和设备启动广播，并恢复之前安排的 OpenWeather、Weather Underground 和 Pirate Weather 天气刷新任务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用更新或设备重启后，已安排的天气刷新可能不会重新启动。

en.description: The Xlythe Weather Service library runs this worker for scheduled or immediate Weather Underground requests. It fetches location-based weather and astronomy data, saves the results, and notifies the app that they changed.
en.disableEffect: The app will stop receiving Weather Underground weather and astronomy updates.

zh-CN.description: Xlythe Weather Service 库会按计划或立即运行此任务，从 Weather Underground 获取基于位置的天气和天文数据、保存结果，并通知应用数据已更新。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法继续接收 Weather Underground 的天气和天文数据更新。

en.description: The Xlythe Android Text Manager library starts this service after an incoming MMS delivery. It downloads the message content, saves it to the inbox, and sends the received message to the app.
en.disableEffect: Incoming MMS messages may not finish downloading or appear in the app.

zh-CN.description: 收到彩信后，Xlythe Android Text Manager 库会启动此服务。它会下载彩信内容、保存到收件箱，并把收到的消息交给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 收到的彩信可能无法完成下载，也可能不会显示在应用中。

en.description: The Xlythe Android Text Manager library starts this service when the app sends a text or multimedia message. It sends SMS through Android's messaging service or uploads MMS through the carrier connection, then records the result.
en.disableEffect: Messages sent through this library will not be transmitted.

zh-CN.description: 应用发送短信或彩信时，Xlythe Android Text Manager 库会启动此服务。它通过 Android 的短信服务发送短信，或通过运营商连接上传彩信，并记录发送结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过此库发送的消息将无法发出。

en.description: The Xlythe Android Text Manager library runs this receiver when an outgoing MMS operation returns a result. It marks the message as sent or failed in the message store.
en.disableEffect: The app may not show whether an outgoing MMS succeeded or failed.

zh-CN.description: 彩信发送操作返回结果时，Xlythe Android Text Manager 库会运行此接收器，并在消息记录中标记发送成功或失败。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用可能无法显示彩信是否发送成功。

en.description: The Xlythe Android Text Manager library receives Android's delivery result for an outgoing SMS here. In this version it only writes whether delivery succeeded to the app log.
en.disableEffect: Only the SMS delivery-result log is lost; SMS sending and sent-or-failed status updates are handled separately.

zh-CN.description: Android 返回短信送达结果时，Xlythe Android Text Manager 库会运行此接收器。此版本只把送达成功与否写入应用日志。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 只会失去短信送达结果日志；短信发送及发送成功或失败状态由其他组件处理。

en.description: The Xlythe Android Text Manager library runs this receiver when Android returns the result of sending an outgoing SMS. It marks the message as sent or failed in the message store.
en.disableEffect: Outgoing SMS messages may remain pending instead of showing whether sending succeeded.

zh-CN.description: Android 返回短信发送结果时，Xlythe Android Text Manager 库会运行此接收器，并在消息记录中标记发送成功或失败。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 发出的短信可能一直显示为待发送，无法显示是否发送成功。

en.description: The Xlythe Android Text Manager library receives Android's incoming MMS delivery broadcast here. It routes the message for download and then forwards it to the app.
en.disableEffect: Incoming MMS messages may not be downloaded or delivered to the app.

zh-CN.description: Android 发送收到彩信的广播时，Xlythe Android Text Manager 库会通过此接收器处理。它会安排下载彩信，并把消息转交给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 收到的彩信可能无法下载或交付给应用。

en.description: The Xlythe Android Text Manager library receives Android's incoming SMS broadcast here. It parses and stores the message, then notifies the app.
en.disableEffect: Incoming SMS messages may not be received or shown by the app through this library.

zh-CN.description: Android 发送收到短信的广播时，Xlythe Android Text Manager 库会通过此接收器处理。它会解析并保存短信，然后通知应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用可能无法通过此库接收或显示收到的短信。

en.description: The Xlythe Android Text Manager library uses this service when a user chooses the app's reply-by-message action for an SMS or MMS address. It parses and sends the reply without opening a screen.
en.disableEffect: Replies started from Android's message action will not be sent through this app.

zh-CN.description: 用户为短信或彩信地址选择应用的快捷回复操作时，Xlythe Android Text Manager 库会运行此服务。它会解析并发送回复，无需打开应用页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户通过 Android 的消息快捷操作发起的回复将无法由此应用发送。

en.description: The Xlythe ClockView library opens this screen to ask for permission to receive watch-face complication data when that permission is missing. It closes after the permission request.
en.disableEffect: The watch face cannot request complication access, so its data tiles may not update.

zh-CN.description: 缺少权限时，Xlythe ClockView 库会打开此页面，请求接收表盘复杂功能数据的权限；请求结束后页面会关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 表盘无法请求复杂功能数据权限，相关数据卡片可能不会更新。

en.description: The Xiongmai XM FunSDK opens this screen from camera settings and lists the selected device's available capabilities with their current values.
en.disableEffect: Users can no longer view the selected camera's capability list and current settings.

zh-CN.description: 在摄像机设置中打开此页面后，雄迈 XM FunSDK 会列出所选设备支持的功能及其当前状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法查看所选摄像机支持的功能和当前状态。

en.description: The Xiongmai XM FunSDK opens this screen for a selected camera, starts its live video when the screen appears, and stops playback when the user leaves. It also provides a still-image capture control.
en.disableEffect: Users lose this SDK's live-view and still-image capture screen for the selected camera.

zh-CN.description: 雄迈 XM FunSDK 为所选摄像机打开此页面，进入页面时开始播放实时画面，离开时停止播放。页面还提供画面截图功能。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此页面查看所选摄像机的实时画面或截取画面。

en.description: During a camera's QR-code router setup, the Xiongmai XM FunSDK opens this screen to show the configuration code and setup result.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot complete the camera's QR-code router setup through this screen.

zh-CN.description: 使用二维码为摄像机配置路由器连接时，雄迈 XM FunSDK 会打开此页面显示配置二维码和设置结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法通过此页面完成摄像机的二维码路由器配置。

en.description: The Xiongmai XM FunSDK opens this screen when a user signs in to the camera service with an account and password. A successful sign-in proceeds to the device home screen.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot sign in through this account screen to reach the SDK's device home screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户使用账号和密码登录摄像机服务时，雄迈 XM FunSDK 会打开此页面。登录成功后会进入设备主页。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法通过此登录页面进入 SDK 的设备主页。

en.description: The Xiongmai XM FunSDK opens this screen from camera settings and lists the selected device's available capabilities with their current values.
en.disableEffect: Users can no longer view the selected camera's capability list and current settings.

zh-CN.description: 在摄像机设置中打开此页面后，雄迈 XM FunSDK 会列出所选设备支持的功能及其当前状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法查看所选摄像机支持的功能和当前状态。

en.description: The Xiongmai XM FunSDK opens this screen for a selected camera, starts its live video when the screen appears, and stops playback when the user leaves.
en.disableEffect: Users lose this SDK's live-view screen for the selected camera.

zh-CN.description: 雄迈 XM FunSDK 为所选摄像机打开此页面，进入页面时开始播放实时画面，离开时停止播放。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此页面查看所选摄像机的实时画面。

en.description: The Xiongmai XM FunSDK opens this as its main screen, starts with the device list selected, and presents navigation for device, media, cloud, and local content.
en.disableEffect: The SDK's device home screen and its navigation become unavailable.

zh-CN.description: 雄迈 XM FunSDK 将此页面用作主界面，默认显示设备列表，并提供设备、媒体、云端和本地内容的导航。
zh-CN.disableEffect: SDK 的设备主页和相关导航将无法使用。

en.description: Pgyer Android App Update uses this Provider to give Android's installer temporary access to a downloaded update APK on Android 7 and later.
en.disableEffect: Pgyer can no longer share the downloaded APK with Android's installer, so app updates may fail to install.

zh-CN.description: 蒲公英 Android 应用更新库在 Android 7 及更高版本上通过此 Provider，向系统安装程序临时提供已下载更新包的访问权限。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 蒲公英更新库无法再把下载的安装包交给系统安装程序，应用更新可能无法安装。

en.description: Pgyer Android App Update starts this Service when an app update download is requested. It downloads the APK and opens the installer when the download completes.
en.disableEffect: The library's in-app update download and installation flow will not work.

zh-CN.description: 蒲公英 Android 应用更新库在用户请求下载应用更新时启动此 Service。它下载安装包，并在下载完成后打开系统安装程序。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用内的更新下载和安装流程将无法使用。

en.description: Pgyer Android App Update opens this Activity when an update check needs storage permission. It requests the needed Android permissions and returns the result to the update flow.
en.disableEffect: The updater cannot request storage access, so its update check may stop before downloading an update.

zh-CN.description: 蒲公英 Android 应用更新库检查更新时若需要存储权限，就会打开此 Activity。它申请所需的 Android 权限，并把结果交回更新流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 更新库无法申请存储权限，更新检查可能因此无法继续下载更新。

en.description: Gerry Kwok's takephoto library opens this screen when the app passes in an image to crop; users adjust the crop area and confirm or cancel, and the result is returned to the app.
en.disableEffect: The app's photo-cropping step will no longer open or return the cropped image.

zh-CN.description: 应用把图片交给 Gerry Kwok 的 takephoto 图片工具进行裁剪时，会打开此界面；用户可调整裁剪范围并确认或取消，结果随后返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用的图片裁剪步骤将无法打开，也无法返回裁剪后的图片。

en.description: The Xsolla Login SDK uses this screen to open sign-in in a browser and return to the app through an Xsolla link. It chooses a browser tab or the regular browser and handles the return link.
en.disableEffect: Browser-based Xsolla sign-in will not be able to return its result to the app.

zh-CN.description: Xsolla Login SDK 会通过此页面在浏览器中打开登录流程，并通过 Xsolla 链接返回应用。它会选择浏览器标签页或普通浏览器，并处理返回链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 浏览器中的 Xsolla 登录流程将无法把结果返回给应用。

en.description: The Xsolla Login SDK displays its sign-in page inside the app. It watches for the login return link and sends the result back to the screen that started sign-in.
en.disableEffect: In-app Xsolla web sign-in will not open or return its result.

zh-CN.description: Xsolla Login SDK 会在应用内显示登录页面，并识别登录返回链接，再把结果交给发起登录的页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用内的 Xsolla 网页登录将无法打开或返回结果。

en.description: The Xsolla Login SDK uses this screen to start WeChat user-info authorization for social sign-in.
en.disableEffect: WeChat sign-in through Xsolla will no longer start.

zh-CN.description: Xsolla Login SDK 会通过此页面启动微信用户信息授权，以完成社交登录。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 Xsolla 启动微信登录。

en.description: The Xsolla Login SDK uses this screen for social sign-in from Unity games. It starts the selected provider's sign-in and returns success, cancellation, or error to the game.
en.disableEffect: A Unity game may not receive its social sign-in result, leaving login incomplete.

zh-CN.description: Unity 游戏通过 Xsolla Login SDK 进行社交登录时会使用此页面。它会启动所选平台的登录，并把成功、取消或错误结果返回游戏。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Unity 游戏可能收不到社交登录结果，导致登录无法完成。

en.description: The Xsolla Payments SDK uses this private file provider to supply the checkout loading-screen image to Android's trusted browser screen.
en.disableEffect: The trusted browser screen may not be able to display the checkout loading image, and the Xsolla payment launch can fail when that image is required.

zh-CN.description: Xsolla Payments SDK 会通过此私有文件提供器，把结账加载图片交给 Android 的可信浏览器页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 可信浏览器页面可能无法显示结账加载图片；需要该图片时，Xsolla 支付页面也可能无法启动。

en.description: The Xsolla Payments SDK opens the Pay Station checkout page in a trusted browser, browser tab, or in-app web view. It processes payment redirects and results.
en.disableEffect: Users may be unable to complete Xsolla in-app purchases or return the payment result to the app.

zh-CN.description: Xsolla Payments SDK 会在可信浏览器、浏览器标签页或应用内网页中打开 Pay Station 结账页面，并处理支付跳转和结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户可能无法完成 Xsolla 应用内购买，或无法把支付结果返回应用。

en.description: When Android opens an Xsolla payment-return link, this screen forwards it to the Pay Station page so the payment result can be processed.
en.disableEffect: The app may not receive the result when a payment page returns to it.

zh-CN.description: Android 打开 Xsolla 支付返回链接时，此页面会把链接转交给 Pay Station 页面处理支付结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 支付页面返回应用时，应用可能收不到支付结果。

en.description: The Qingshi game SDK opens this Xuanwu JiYan Activity for one-tap phone sign-in; it prepares the verification screen and returns a login token or an error.
en.disableEffect: Xuanwu one-tap phone sign-in cannot open or return its login result.

zh-CN.description: 青石游戏 SDK 在进行一键手机号登录时打开玄武 JiYan Activity；它准备验证界面，并返回登录令牌或错误结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 玄武一键手机号登录界面无法打开或返回登录结果。

en.description: The Qingshi game SDK opens this dialog-style Xuanwu JiYan screen for one-tap phone sign-in; it uses the same verification flow and returns a login result.
en.disableEffect: The dialog-style one-tap phone sign-in flow cannot open or return its result.

zh-CN.description: 青石游戏 SDK 在进行一键手机号登录时会打开此对话框式玄武 JiYan 界面；它使用相同的验证流程并返回登录结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 对话框式的一键手机号登录流程无法打开或返回结果。

en.description: EasyWeb from Chuangke18 displays app-provided web pages inside the app, with back and close controls. It loads the web address or page content supplied by the app.
en.disableEffect: In-app pages that rely on EasyWeb will not open, so the related app feature may stop working.

zh-CN.description: Chuangke18 的 EasyWeb 会在应用内显示应用提供的网页，并提供返回和关闭按钮；网页地址或页面内容由应用传入。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖 EasyWeb 的应用内网页将无法打开，相关功能可能无法使用。

en.description: EasyWeb from Chuangke18 coordinates the app's in-app web pages: it opens a page, updates its content, and tells the app when the page closes.
en.disableEffect: In-app pages handled by EasyWeb will not open or update, breaking app features that depend on them.

zh-CN.description: Chuangke18 的 EasyWeb 服务负责协调应用内网页的打开和内容更新，并在网页关闭时通知应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: EasyWeb 管理的应用内网页将无法打开或更新，依赖这些网页的应用功能会受影响。

en.description: Idolyx provides this developer screen to edit its live-video, shop, and web server addresses; saving the changes restarts the app process.
en.disableEffect: Developers cannot change Idolyx server addresses through this screen.

zh-CN.description: Idolyx 提供此开发者界面来修改直播、商城和网页服务器地址；保存更改后会重启应用进程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 开发者将无法通过此界面修改 Idolyx 服务器地址。

en.description: When a live room is opened, this Idolyx activity plays its video stream and manages the viewer session and room interactions.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot watch or interact with live rooms provided through Idolyx.

zh-CN.description: 打开直播间时，Idolyx 会在此界面播放直播流，并管理观看会话和直播间互动。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法观看或参与 Idolyx 提供的直播间。

en.description: This Idolyx screen loads a paged list of live rooms, supports refresh and load-more actions, and opens the selected room in the player.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot browse or enter the Idolyx live-room list through this screen.

zh-CN.description: Idolyx 会在此界面加载分页直播间列表，支持刷新和继续加载，并打开用户选择的直播间。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此界面浏览或进入 Idolyx 直播间列表。

en.description: When a live-room link is opened, this Idolyx activity displays the associated web page and handles coupon claims that return to the room.
en.disableEffect: Live-room web pages and their coupon flow will not open.

zh-CN.description: 打开直播间链接时，Idolyx 会在此界面显示相关网页，并处理返回直播间的优惠券领取流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 直播间网页及其优惠券流程将无法打开。

en.description: This Idolyx activity plays a recorded live-room video and can open product or coupon pages linked from the replay.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot watch Idolyx live-room replays or open their linked product and coupon pages.

zh-CN.description: Idolyx 会在此界面播放直播间回放，并可打开回放关联的商品页或优惠券页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法观看 Idolyx 直播间回放，也无法打开其中关联的商品和优惠券页面。

en.description: This Idolyx activity hosts the shopping page opened by the app and returns selected photos to that page when requested.
en.disableEffect: Idolyx shopping pages and their photo-selection flow cannot open.

zh-CN.description: Idolyx 会在此界面承载应用打开的商城页面，并在页面请求时将用户选择的照片返回给商城。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Idolyx 商城页面及其照片选择流程将无法打开。

en.description: PictureSelector's uCrop image editor opens this screen when the user chooses to crop multiple selected photos. It lets the user adjust each crop and returns the edited images to the selection flow.
en.disableEffect: The multi-image crop step will be unavailable, so apps that require edited photos cannot complete that step.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择裁剪多张照片时，PictureSelector 的 uCrop 图片编辑器会打开此页面。用户可逐张调整裁剪范围，编辑后的照片会返回选择流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 多图裁剪步骤将无法使用；依赖已编辑照片的应用流程也无法完成。

en.description: Yalantis uCrop opens an image editor when an image picker or media flow requests cropping. The user can adjust framing, scale, and rotation, then return the cropped image.
en.disableEffect: Image or media flows that request cropping cannot finish that crop step or return its result.

zh-CN.description: Yalantis uCrop 会在选图或媒体流程请求裁剪时打开图片编辑界面，用户可调整取景范围、缩放和旋转后返回裁剪结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 请求图片裁剪的选图或媒体流程无法完成裁剪步骤或返回结果。

en.description: uCrop by LuckSiege opens this screen when an app requests cropping for multiple selected images. It applies the crop settings and returns the edited images to the app.
en.disableEffect: The app’s multiple-image cropping flow will not open or return cropped results.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求裁剪多张所选图片时，LuckSiege 的 uCrop 会打开此页面。它按裁剪设置处理图片，并将编辑后的图片返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用的多图裁剪流程将无法打开或返回裁剪结果。

en.description: The YallaChat Platform SDK shares a temporary photo with the camera when its web sign-in or sharing page asks the user to take a picture.
en.disableEffect: Taking a photo from a YallaChat web sign-in or sharing page will fail.

zh-CN.description: YallaChat Platform SDK 的网页登录或分享页面请求拍照时，此文件提供器会把临时照片交给相机应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法从 YallaChat 网页登录或分享页面拍照。

en.description: The YallaChat Platform SDK uses this provider to open cached files associated with a call when sharing media. It exposes the selected file as read-only content for the receiving app.
en.disableEffect: Shared images or other call files that use this route will not open.

zh-CN.description: YallaChat Platform SDK 分享媒体时会通过此提供器打开与通话关联的缓存文件，并以只读内容的形式交给接收应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过此方式分享的图片或其他通话文件将无法打开。

en.description: The YallaChat Platform SDK opens this screen for its sign-in or sharing flow. It hosts the selected page and passes activity and permission results back to that flow.
en.disableEffect: YallaChat sign-in or sharing flows that use this screen will not complete.

zh-CN.description: YallaChat Platform SDK 会在登录或分享流程中打开此页面，显示对应界面，并把系统活动和权限结果交还给该流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此页面的 YallaChat 登录或分享流程将无法完成。

en.description: YnBus (Wengliuhu), a lifecycle event-bus library, installs this provider at app startup. It watches newly created screens and connects their marked event handlers to the bus.
en.disableEffect: Screens will no longer be connected automatically to YnBus, so features relying on those event handlers can stop receiving updates.

zh-CN.description: YnBus（Wengliuhu）是生命周期事件总线库，会在应用启动时安装此 Provider。它会关注新建页面，并将页面中标记的事件处理方法连接到事件总线。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 页面将不再自动连接到 YnBus，依赖这些事件处理方法的功能可能无法收到更新。

en.description: When an app starts its Yanbo VideoDlnaScreen casting session, this service starts UPnP discovery and registers the phone as a media server that nearby players can browse.
en.disableEffect: Nearby DLNA players cannot discover and browse media provided by the app's casting service.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动 Yanbo VideoDlnaScreen 投屏会话时，此服务会启动 UPnP 发现，并把手机注册为附近播放器可浏览的媒体服务器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，附近的 DLNA 播放器无法发现并浏览应用投屏服务提供的媒体。

en.description: When the app connects to a selected DLNA player, this Yanbo VideoDlnaScreen service starts a local media stream server and tracks playback and track changes from that player.
en.disableEffect: The app's DLNA session cannot serve media or receive playback-state updates from the selected player.

zh-CN.description: 应用连接所选 DLNA 播放器时，此 Yanbo VideoDlnaScreen 服务会启动本地媒体流服务器，并跟踪播放器的播放状态和曲目变化。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，应用的 DLNA 会话无法向所选播放器提供媒体流或接收播放状态更新。

en.description: The Yandex AppMetrica Push service runs when Huawei Push Kit delivers a message or refreshes the app's push token, then forwards it for processing.
en.disableEffect: Huawei-delivered AppMetrica push messages and token updates will no longer be handled.

zh-CN.description: Huawei Push Kit 收到消息或更新推送令牌时，Yandex AppMetrica Push 服务会接收并转交消息或令牌进行处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Huawei Push Kit 发送的 AppMetrica 推送消息和令牌更新将不再处理。

en.description: The Yandex Auth SDK uses this exported app-link alias as the return address for sign-in and forwards Yandex's redirect to the SDK result screen.
en.disableEffect: Yandex sign-in cannot return to the app, so the login flow will fail.

zh-CN.description: Yandex Auth SDK 使用此导出的应用链接别名接收登录返回，并将 Yandex 重定向交给 SDK 的结果页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Yandex 登录结果无法返回应用，登录流程会失败。

en.description: When an app requests Yandex sign-in, this Yandex Auth SDK Activity launches the chosen sign-in flow and returns its authorization token or error.
en.disableEffect: The app will not be able to start or complete sign-in through the Yandex Auth SDK.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求 Yandex 登录时，Yandex Auth SDK 会启动所选登录流程，并将授权令牌或错误结果返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法通过 Yandex Auth SDK 发起或完成登录。

en.description: When Yandex returns a sign-in link to the app, this Yandex Auth SDK Activity forwards it into the browser sign-in flow.
en.disableEffect: The browser sign-in flow may not return to the app, so Yandex login can fail.

zh-CN.description: Yandex 登录链接返回应用时，Yandex Auth SDK 会通过此 Activity 将链接转交给浏览器登录流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 浏览器登录结果可能无法返回应用，导致 Yandex 登录失败。

en.description: When the Yandex Auth SDK uses an external browser for sign-in, this Activity opens the login page and receives the authorization result when the user returns.
en.disableEffect: Yandex sign-in through an external browser will not complete in the app.

zh-CN.description: Yandex Auth SDK 使用外部浏览器登录时，此 Activity 会打开登录页面，并在用户返回后接收授权结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法完成通过外部浏览器进行的 Yandex 登录。

en.description: When Yandex returns from sign-in, this Yandex Auth SDK Activity receives the callback link and passes it back into the sign-in flow.
en.disableEffect: The Yandex sign-in redirect cannot return to the SDK, so login may fail.

zh-CN.description: Yandex 登录返回时，Yandex Auth SDK 会通过此 Activity 接收回调链接，并将其交回登录流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Yandex 登录重定向无法返回 SDK，登录可能失败。

en.description: The Yandex Auth SDK opens its sign-in page in a browser tab; this Activity receives the return link and reports the authorization result.
en.disableEffect: Sign-in in a browser tab will not return its authorization result to the app.

zh-CN.description: Yandex Auth SDK 会在浏览器标签页中打开登录页面；此 Activity 接收返回链接并将授权结果交给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过浏览器标签页进行的登录将无法把授权结果返回应用。

en.description: When the Yandex Auth SDK uses in-app sign-in, this Activity displays the login page and returns the token or error after sign-in.
en.disableEffect: In-app Yandex sign-in will fail or leave the login request without a result.

zh-CN.description: Yandex Auth SDK 使用应用内登录时，此 Activity 会显示登录页面，并在登录后返回令牌或错误。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用内 Yandex 登录将失败，或无法向登录请求返回结果。

en.description: Yandex Demeter Profiler uses this provider when its performance screens share CSV and trace reports with another app, creating file links the receiving app can open.
en.disableEffect: Demeter reports cannot be shared with another app from the profiler.

zh-CN.description: Yandex Demeter 性能分析器会通过此 Provider 将性能数据表和跟踪报告分享给其他应用，并生成接收方可打开的文件链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法从性能分析器中将 Demeter 报告分享给其他应用。

en.description: Yandex Demeter Profiler exposes this launcher shortcut to open its local performance dashboard, which lists the configured measurement tools.
en.disableEffect: The Demeter dashboard shortcut disappears from the app launcher.

zh-CN.description: Yandex Demeter 性能分析器通过此启动器入口打开本地性能面板，其中列出已配置的测量工具。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用启动器中将不再显示 Demeter 面板入口。

en.description: Yandex Demeter Profiler opens this screen from its launcher shortcut to show tabs for the configured performance measurements.
en.disableEffect: The in-app performance dashboard and its report browsing screens cannot open.

zh-CN.description: 用户从 Demeter 启动器入口打开此界面后，可以查看各项已配置性能测量的标签页。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用内的性能面板和报告浏览界面将无法打开。

en.description: The Yandex Games Partners SDK opens a selected Yandex game using its game ID and display settings, then shows that game inside the app.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot open Yandex Games that it launches through this SDK.

zh-CN.description: Yandex Games 合作伙伴 SDK 根据游戏编号和显示设置打开选中的 Yandex 游戏，并在应用内展示游戏。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法打开通过此 SDK 启动的 Yandex 游戏。

en.description: The Yandex Games Partners SDK opens its game catalog in a web-based screen when the app requests the catalog.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot browse the Yandex Games catalog inside the app.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求打开游戏目录时，Yandex Games 合作伙伴 SDK 会在网页界面中展示目录。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在应用内浏览 Yandex Games 游戏目录。

en.description: Yandex MapKit receives boot and version-election broadcasts here to compare MapKit copies and choose which one remains active.
en.disableEffect: MapKit may not be able to maintain its active SDK instance, disrupting services that depend on that coordination.

zh-CN.description: 设备启动或收到版本选举广播时，Yandex MapKit 会通过此 Receiver 比较不同 MapKit 实例，并选择保持活动状态的实例。
zh-CN.disableEffect: MapKit 可能无法维持活动实例，依赖该协调机制的服务会受到影响。

en.description: Yandex MapKit uses this Service to keep its active SDK instance registered and schedule periodic checks while it is running.
en.disableEffect: MapKit's active-instance coordination and related background services may stop working.

zh-CN.description: Yandex MapKit 使用此 Service 保持活动实例的登记状态，并在运行期间安排定期检查。
zh-CN.disableEffect: MapKit 的活动实例协调机制及相关后台服务可能停止工作。

en.description: Yandex AppMetrica uses this scheduled service to refresh analytics configuration in the background.
en.disableEffect: AppMetrica background configuration updates will stop; the app’s other features continue to work.

zh-CN.description: Yandex AppMetrica 使用此定时服务在后台更新分析配置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: AppMetrica 的后台配置更新将停止，应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: Yandex AppMetrica uses this service to initialize or refresh analytics configuration when scheduled or requested.
en.disableEffect: AppMetrica configuration work will stop; the app’s other features continue to work.

zh-CN.description: Yandex AppMetrica 使用此服务在收到请求或定时触发时初始化或更新分析配置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: AppMetrica 配置任务将停止，应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: Yandex AppMetrica receives configuration-service notifications through this receiver and passes their data to its updater.
en.disableEffect: AppMetrica configuration notifications will no longer be processed; the app’s other features continue to work.

zh-CN.description: Yandex AppMetrica 通过此接收器接收配置服务通知，并将数据交给配置更新器处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: AppMetrica 将不再处理配置通知，应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: Yandex AppMetrica receives Google Play install-referrer information and forwards it for attribution measurement.
en.disableEffect: AppMetrica install-referrer attribution will stop; the app’s other features continue to work.

zh-CN.description: Yandex AppMetrica 会接收 Google Play 安装来源信息，并转发用于归因统计。
zh-CN.disableEffect: AppMetrica 的安装来源归因将停止，应用的其他功能仍可使用。
