en.description: Yandex AppMetrica uses this service to process analytics events and requests in the background and through its service interface.
en.disableEffect: AppMetrica analytics collection and processing will stop; the app’s other features continue to work.

zh-CN.description: Yandex AppMetrica 使用此服务在后台及其服务接口中处理分析事件和请求。
zh-CN.disableEffect: AppMetrica 的分析数据收集和处理将停止，应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: When preinstall or campaign attribution data is supplied, the Yandex AppMetrica analytics provider stores it for analytics reporting.
en.disableEffect: AppMetrica may lose preinstall and campaign attribution data; ordinary app features continue.

zh-CN.description: 收到预装或推广归因数据时，Yandex AppMetrica 分析 SDK 的 Provider 会保存这些数据以供统计。
zh-CN.disableEffect: AppMetrica 可能丢失预装和推广归因数据；应用的普通功能不受影响。

en.description: The Yandex AppMetrica analytics SDK uses this receiver to process explicit preload-information broadcasts and return the resulting data to the sender.
en.disableEffect: AppMetrica may not receive preload attribution data returned through explicit broadcasts.

zh-CN.description: Yandex AppMetrica 分析 SDK 使用此 Receiver 处理显式发送的预装信息广播，并将处理结果返回发送方。
zh-CN.disableEffect: AppMetrica 可能无法通过显式广播收到预装归因数据。

en.description: The legacy Yandex AppMetrica Push SDK starts this Service to set up push delivery, refresh provider tokens, and process incoming push work.
en.disableEffect: AppMetrica Push setup, token refresh, and push processing may stop working; host app features continue.

zh-CN.description: 旧版 Yandex AppMetrica Push SDK 会启动此 Service 来设置推送、更新推送令牌并处理收到的推送任务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: AppMetrica Push 的设置、令牌更新和推送处理可能停止；应用本身的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: When an AppMetrica push notification action is sent, this receiver forwards it to the Push SDK for handling.
en.disableEffect: AppMetrica notification actions may no longer open the requested app content.

zh-CN.description: 收到 AppMetrica 推送通知操作时，此 Receiver 会将操作交给 Push SDK 处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: AppMetrica 通知操作可能无法再打开相应的应用内容。

en.description: When an AppMetrica push action opens this invisible Activity, it processes the notification response and closes.
en.disableEffect: Notification actions sent through this Activity will no longer be handled.

zh-CN.description: AppMetrica 推送操作打开此不可见 Activity 时，它会处理通知响应后关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过此 Activity 发起的通知操作将不再处理。

en.description: When Android reports that app notifications or a notification channel changed blocked state, this receiver asks AppMetrica Push to refresh delivery registration.
en.disableEffect: AppMetrica Push may not learn when notifications are blocked or restored, so its delivery registration can become stale.

zh-CN.description: Android 报告应用通知或通知渠道的屏蔽状态发生变化时，此 Receiver 会让 AppMetrica Push 更新推送登记信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通知被屏蔽或恢复时，AppMetrica Push 可能无法获知变化，推送登记信息可能过期。

en.description: When an AppMetrica push notification expires, this receiver removes it from the notification shade and reports that it expired.
en.disableEffect: Expired AppMetrica notifications may remain visible and their expiration may not be reported.

zh-CN.description: AppMetrica 推送通知到期时，此 Receiver 会将通知从状态栏移除，并记录通知已过期。
zh-CN.disableEffect: AppMetrica 的过期通知可能仍会显示，过期情况也可能无法上报。

en.description: Firebase sends this legacy AppMetrica Push service a new token when its push registration changes; the service passes the token to AppMetrica.
en.disableEffect: Legacy Firebase token updates will no longer reach AppMetrica, which can interrupt its push delivery.

zh-CN.description: Firebase 推送登记变化时会向此旧版 AppMetrica Push Service 提供新令牌，随后由它交给 AppMetrica。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 旧版 Firebase 令牌更新将无法传给 AppMetrica，可能中断推送送达。

en.description: Firebase calls this AppMetrica Push service for incoming messages and token changes; it forwards both to the Push SDK.
en.disableEffect: Firebase messages and token updates will no longer be handled by AppMetrica Push.

zh-CN.description: Firebase 收到消息或更新令牌时会调用此 AppMetrica Push Service，并将两者交给 Push SDK 处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: AppMetrica Push 将不再处理 Firebase 消息和令牌更新。

en.description: Firebase calls this AppMetrica Push plugin service for messages and token events; it passes them to the push handler when the plugin is enabled.
en.disableEffect: Messages routed through the AppMetrica Push plugin will no longer be processed by this SDK.

zh-CN.description: Firebase 将消息和令牌事件交给此 AppMetrica Push 插件 Service；插件启用时，它会转交给推送处理流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过 AppMetrica Push 插件转入的消息将不再由此 SDK 处理。

en.description: When Android's job scheduler runs queued AppMetrica Push work, this Service dispatches the requested task and reports when it finishes.
en.disableEffect: Scheduled AppMetrica Push tasks, including message processing, may not run.

zh-CN.description: Android 系统任务调度器运行排队的 AppMetrica Push 工作时，此 Service 会执行相应任务并报告完成状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 包括消息处理在内的 AppMetrica Push 定时任务可能无法运行。

en.description: When the AppMetrica Push SDK starts queued push work, this Service dispatches tasks such as setup, token refresh, or message processing.
en.disableEffect: AppMetrica Push setup, token refresh, or message processing that depends on this service may stop.

zh-CN.description: AppMetrica Push SDK 启动排队的推送工作时，此 Service 会执行设置、令牌更新或消息处理等任务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此 Service 的 AppMetrica Push 设置、令牌更新或消息处理可能停止。

en.description: Yandex Mobile Ads opens this screen to display an ad and return ad results to the SDK.
en.disableEffect: Yandex Mobile Ads will not appear, and rewards for rewarded placements will no longer be granted; other app features continue to work.

zh-CN.description: Yandex Mobile Ads 会打开此页面显示广告，并将广告结果返回给 SDK。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Yandex Mobile Ads 将不再显示，奖励型广告位也不再发放观看奖励；应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: When Yandex Mobile Ads opens a full-screen ad, this Activity displays and manages it, including rewarded ads.
en.disableEffect: Yandex ads that need this screen may not display or close correctly, and rewards for watching ads will no longer be granted.

zh-CN.description: Yandex Mobile Ads 打开全屏广告时，此 Activity 会显示并管理广告，其中也包括激励广告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要此页面的 Yandex 广告可能无法正常显示或关闭，而且观看广告将不再发放奖励。

en.description: Yandex Mobile Ads starts this provider automatically during app startup to begin initializing the ad SDK.
en.disableEffect: Yandex Mobile Ads may fail to initialize, so ad requests can fail.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，Yandex Mobile Ads 会自动运行此 Provider，以开始初始化广告 SDK。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Yandex Mobile Ads 可能无法初始化，广告请求可能失败。

en.description: Yandex Mobile Ads starts this provider automatically during app startup to initialize the current ad SDK.
en.disableEffect: Yandex Mobile Ads may fail to initialize, so ad requests can fail.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，Yandex Mobile Ads 会自动运行此 Provider 来初始化当前广告 SDK。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Yandex Mobile Ads 可能无法初始化，广告请求可能失败。

en.description: Yandex Mobile Ads uses this FileProvider to create shareable links to report files from its integration inspector.
en.disableEffect: The integration inspector may be unable to share its report; ad display is unaffected.

zh-CN.description: Yandex Mobile Ads 使用此 FileProvider 为集成检查页面生成可分享的报告文件链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 集成检查页面可能无法分享报告；广告展示不受影响。

en.description: When its debug panel opens, this Yandex Mobile Ads Activity displays the integration-inspection screen and loads its diagnostic checks.
en.disableEffect: The SDK's integration-inspection screen will not open; normal ad display remains available.

zh-CN.description: Yandex Mobile Ads 调试面板打开时，此 Activity 会显示集成检查页面并加载诊断检查。
zh-CN.disableEffect: SDK 的集成检查页面将无法打开；普通广告展示仍可使用。

en.description: Yandex Pay Classic uses this browser return link for Yandex account sign-in; it forwards the link from the browser to the account sign-in screen so the app can receive the result.
en.disableEffect: Browser-based Yandex account sign-in and payment confirmation cannot return to the app through this callback.

zh-CN.description: Yandex Pay Classic 使用此浏览器返回入口处理 Yandex 账号登录；它会把浏览器中的返回链接交给账号登录界面，以便应用收到结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过浏览器进行的 Yandex 账号登录和支付确认无法通过此回调返回应用。

en.description: Yandex Pay Classic opens this payment sheet when the host app starts a payment session, allowing the user to continue the payment flow over the app.
en.disableEffect: The Yandex Pay Classic payment sheet cannot open, so checkout through this flow cannot complete.

zh-CN.description: 宿主应用启动支付会话时，Yandex Pay Classic 会打开此支付面板，让用户在应用上方继续完成支付。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Yandex Pay Classic 支付面板无法打开，因此此支付流程无法完成。

en.description: Yandex Pay's in-app payments SDK opens this checkout screen when an app starts a payment URL flow and reports the payment outcome to the app.
en.disableEffect: The host app cannot open or complete this Yandex Pay in-app payment flow.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动支付链接流程时，Yandex Pay 应用内支付 SDK 会打开此结账界面，并将支付结果返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 宿主应用无法打开或完成此 Yandex Pay 应用内支付流程。

en.description: Yandex Pay opens this screen when a payment needs a browser step, then accepts the browser's return link when checkout finishes.
en.disableEffect: Browser-based Yandex Pay checkout cannot open or return its result to the app.

zh-CN.description: 支付需要通过浏览器处理时，Yandex Pay 会打开此界面，并在结账完成后接收浏览器返回的链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 基于浏览器的 Yandex Pay 结账流程无法打开，或无法将结果返回应用。

en.description: Yandex Pay opens this internal screen when a payment request resolves to a failed or cancelled result.
en.disableEffect: The SDK cannot finish that fallback payment request; launching the disabled result screen causes the payment call to fail.

zh-CN.description: 支付请求无法进入结账流程时，Yandex Pay 会打开此内部界面并返回失败或取消结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: SDK 无法完成此备用支付请求；调用已停用的结果界面会导致支付调用失败。

en.description: The Yandex Pay SDK opens this checkout screen when the host app starts a payment session and handles the in-app payment flow.
en.disableEffect: The host app's Yandex Pay checkout cannot open or complete.

zh-CN.description: 宿主应用启动支付会话时，Yandex Pay SDK 会打开此结账界面并处理应用内支付流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 宿主应用的 Yandex Pay 结账界面无法打开或完成支付。

en.description: The Yandex Pay token SDK opens this screen when the host app starts a token-related payment setup or confirmation flow.
en.disableEffect: Payment setup or confirmation that uses the Yandex Pay token flow cannot complete.

zh-CN.description: 宿主应用启动与支付令牌相关的设置或确认流程时，Yandex Pay 令牌 SDK 会打开此界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用 Yandex Pay 令牌流程的支付设置或确认将无法完成。

en.description: Yandex Pay's widget information feature opens this screen to show cashback or installment details, or a linked information page.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open the widget's cashback, installment, or linked information screens.

zh-CN.description: Yandex Pay 小组件的信息功能会打开此界面，展示返现、分期详情或关联的信息页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开小组件中的返现、分期说明或关联信息页面。

en.description: When Android runs a connectivity recheck scheduled by Yandex Maps Runtime, this Service notifies the SDK when network access is available again.
en.disableEffect: MapKit and NaviKit may miss network-state changes, so online map data may not refresh correctly after connectivity changes.

zh-CN.description: Android 运行 Yandex Maps Runtime 安排的网络重查任务时，此 Service 会把网络状态变化通知 SDK。
zh-CN.disableEffect: MapKit 和 NaviKit 可能收不到网络状态变化，网络恢复后在线地图数据可能无法正确刷新。

en.description: Yandex MapKit Runtime exposes this service so matching app processes can exchange SDK messages.
en.disableEffect: MapKit features that use this cross-process connection may fail or stop responding.

zh-CN.description: Yandex MapKit Runtime 通过此 Service 让签名匹配的应用进程交换 SDK 消息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此跨进程连接的 MapKit 功能可能失败或停止响应。

en.description: When a Google Play activity-recognition update reaches Yandex MapKit Runtime, this Service forwards the detected movement to the app.
en.disableEffect: MapKit features that rely on movement recognition will stop receiving activity updates.

zh-CN.description: Google Play 活动识别结果到达 Yandex MapKit Runtime 时，此 Service 会把检测到的活动状态转发给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖移动状态识别的 MapKit 功能将不再收到活动更新。

en.description: When Yandex returns a browser sign-in link to an app using the legacy Yandex Login SDK, this Activity passes it to the login flow.
en.disableEffect: The older Yandex login flow may not return the browser sign-in result, preventing login.

zh-CN.description: 使用旧版 Yandex Login SDK 的应用收到浏览器登录返回链接时，此 Activity 会将链接交给登录流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 旧版 Yandex 登录流程可能无法收到浏览器登录结果，导致登录失败。

en.description: The legacy Yandex Login SDK starts this Activity to open Yandex sign-in in an external browser and receive the returned authorization link.
en.disableEffect: The older Yandex external-browser sign-in flow will fail to return its result.

zh-CN.description: 旧版 Yandex Login SDK 会启动此 Activity，在外部浏览器打开登录页面并接收返回的授权链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 旧版 Yandex 外部浏览器登录流程将无法返回结果。

en.description: The legacy Yandex Login SDK starts this Activity to show Yandex sign-in inside the app and return the resulting token or error.
en.disableEffect: Apps using this Yandex Login SDK flow will lose in-app sign-in.

zh-CN.description: 旧版 Yandex Login SDK 会启动此 Activity，在应用内显示 Yandex 登录页面并返回令牌或错误。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此 Yandex Login SDK 流程的应用将无法进行应用内登录。

en.description: Yantranet AndroidDownloader receives download completion or failure notices and advances or retries the queued file transfer; older builds also handle size mismatches.
en.disableEffect: The downloader cannot process completion or failure notices, advance its download queue, or retry failed transfers.

zh-CN.description: Yantranet AndroidDownloader 收到下载完成或失败通知后会继续处理或重试队列中的文件传输；较早版本也会处理文件大小不符的情况。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 下载器无法处理完成或失败通知、继续下载队列或重试失败的传输。

en.description: Yantranet AndroidDownloader receives a notice that downloads are waiting and starts processing the queued files.
en.disableEffect: New downloads remain queued without starting.

zh-CN.description: Yantranet AndroidDownloader 收到有待处理下载的通知后，会开始处理队列中的文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 新的下载任务将留在队列中而无法启动。

en.description: Yantranet AndroidUploader starts this background service when it needs to restore saved recurring upload jobs.
en.disableEffect: Saved recurring uploads will not restart when the app asks the uploader to restore them.

zh-CN.description: Yantranet AndroidUploader 需要恢复已保存的周期性上传任务时，会启动此后台服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用要求上传器恢复任务时，已保存的周期性上传将无法重新启动。

en.description: Yantranet AndroidUploader receives upload completion, failure, and skip notices, then finishes or retries the transfer and advances the upload queue.
en.disableEffect: The app loses completion and failure handling, queued-upload retries, and cleanup for transfers managed by this uploader.

zh-CN.description: Yantranet AndroidUploader 收到上传完成、失败或跳过通知后，会结束或重试传输并继续处理上传队列。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法处理此上传器任务的完成和失败结果、重试队列任务或清理已完成的文件。

en.description: Yanzhenjie Album opens its original media picker when the app requests image, video, or album selection; it asks for media access and returns the chosen files.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot use this Yanzhenjie Album picker to select photos or videos.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求选择图片、视频或相册时，Yanzhenjie Album 会打开旧版媒体选择界面、申请媒体访问权限并返回所选文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用无法通过此版 Yanzhenjie Album 选择照片或视频。

en.description: Yanzhenjie Album opens its main photo and video picker, reads device albums after media permission is granted, and lets the user select or preview items.
en.disableEffect: The app's album-based photo and video selection flow cannot open.

zh-CN.description: Yanzhenjie Album 会打开主要的照片和视频选择界面，在获得媒体权限后读取设备相册，并允许用户选择或预览内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用基于相册的照片和视频选择流程无法打开。

en.description: Yanzhenjie Album opens this full-screen preview when the user previews items from its picker, and lets the user review or change their selection.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot preview or adjust selected photos and videos from the album picker.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Yanzhenjie Album 选择器中预览媒体时，会打开此全屏界面查看内容并调整选择。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法在相册选择器中预览照片和视频或调整所选内容。

en.description: Yanzhenjie Album shows this empty-state screen when the requested kind of media is not on the device; if camera use is enabled, it offers photo or video capture.
en.disableEffect: When the device has no matching media, the picker loses its empty-state and camera fallback flow.

zh-CN.description: 设备中没有所请求类型的媒体时，Yanzhenjie Album 会显示此空状态界面；如果允许使用相机，还会提供拍照或录像入口。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 设备中没有符合条件的媒体时，选择器将失去空状态界面和相机备用流程。

en.description: Yanzhenjie Album opens this capture screen for photo or video requests, asks for the needed camera access, and returns the captured media.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot capture a new photo or video through Yanzhenjie Album.

zh-CN.description: Yanzhenjie Album 收到拍照或录像请求时会打开此采集界面、申请相机所需权限并返回拍摄的媒体。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用无法通过 Yanzhenjie Album 拍摄新照片或视频。

en.description: Yanzhenjie Album opens a full-screen viewer for a supplied list of image paths and can let the user mark which images to keep.
en.disableEffect: The app loses this image viewing and optional selection screen.

zh-CN.description: Yanzhenjie Album 会为应用提供的图片路径列表打开全屏查看界面，并可让用户标记要保留的图片。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将失去此图片查看和可选选择界面。

en.description: Yanzhenjie Album opens a full-screen viewer for the selected album's photo and video items, with controls for reviewing or changing the selection.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot review or change the selected items in this album viewer.

zh-CN.description: Yanzhenjie Album 会为所选相册中的照片和视频打开全屏查看界面，并提供查看和调整选择的控件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法在此相册查看界面中查看或调整所选内容。

en.description: Yanzhenjie Album uses this provider to give the camera capture flow a shareable file link for its saved photo or video.
en.disableEffect: On Android 7 and later, disabling this provider stops the camera flow from passing its output file to the camera app, so the captured photo or video cannot be returned.

zh-CN.description: Yanzhenjie Album 会通过此 Provider 为相机拍摄流程生成可分享的文件链接，以便访问保存的照片或视频。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 在 Android 7 及更高版本上停用此 Provider 后，相机流程无法将输出文件交给相机应用，因此拍摄的照片或视频无法返回。

en.description: Yanzhenjie Album opens this media selection screen when the app requests photos or videos, asks for storage access, and returns the selected items.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot use this Yanzhenjie Album screen to select device media.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求选择照片或视频时，Yanzhenjie Album 会打开此媒体选择界面、申请存储访问权限并返回所选内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用无法通过此 Yanzhenjie Album 界面选择设备媒体。

en.description: Yanzhenjie Album opens this camera screen for a photo or video capture request and returns the capture result to the app.
en.disableEffect: Photo and video capture through this Yanzhenjie Album flow will not work.

zh-CN.description: Yanzhenjie Album 收到拍照或录像请求时会打开此相机界面，并将拍摄结果返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 此 Yanzhenjie Album 流程中的拍照和录像功能将无法使用。

en.description: Yanzhenjie Album opens this gallery screen to show and preview media from the current selection flow, with controls to select items.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot preview or select items through this gallery screen.

zh-CN.description: Yanzhenjie Album 会在当前媒体选择流程中打开此图库界面，用于展示和预览媒体并选择内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法通过此图库界面预览或选择媒体。

en.description: Yanzhenjie Album opens this screen to browse and preview photos or videos from a particular album.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot browse or preview media through this album viewer.

zh-CN.description: Yanzhenjie Album 会打开此界面，浏览并预览某个相册中的照片或视频。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法通过此相册查看界面浏览或预览媒体。

en.description: Yanzhenjie Durban opens an adjustable crop screen for one or more chosen images, saves the cropped copies, and returns their paths to the app.
en.disableEffect: Image cropping through Yanzhenjie Durban cannot complete.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择一张或多张图片后，Yanzhenjie Durban 会打开可调整的裁剪界面、保存裁剪后的副本并将路径返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过 Yanzhenjie Durban 进行的图片裁剪无法完成。

en.description: AndPermission exposes app files through shareable content links when the app hands a file to another screen or application.
en.disableEffect: File-opening or sharing flows that use AndPermission's file links will fail.

zh-CN.description: 应用需要将文件交给其他界面或应用时，AndPermission 会通过可分享的内容链接开放该文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用 AndPermission 文件链接的文件打开或分享流程将失败。

en.description: AndPermission opens this screen when an app requests runtime permissions or access to install apps or display overlays, then returns the user's response.
en.disableEffect: Permission requests routed through AndPermission cannot open this screen or return their result.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求运行时权限、安装应用权限或悬浮显示权限时，AndPermission 会打开此界面并返回用户的选择。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过 AndPermission 发起的权限请求无法打开此界面或返回结果。

en.description: AndPermission opens Android's permission dialog or a system settings page when the app requests runtime access, notification access, app installation, or overlay access.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot request or confirm those Android permissions and settings through AndPermission.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求运行时访问、通知访问、安装应用或悬浮显示权限时，AndPermission 会打开 Android 权限对话框或系统设置页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用无法通过 AndPermission 请求或确认这些 Android 权限和设置。

en.description: AndPermission starts this background service for permission requests that need Android's permission or settings screens, then returns the outcome to the app.
en.disableEffect: Permission and settings requests that use this service cannot complete.

zh-CN.description: AndPermission 会在需要打开 Android 权限或系统设置界面的请求中启动此后台服务，并将处理结果返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此服务的权限和设置请求无法完成。

en.description: Yashoid InstaCropper opens a crop screen for a source image, saves the cropped JPEG to the destination chosen by the app, and returns the result.
en.disableEffect: The app's InstaCropper image-cropping flow cannot save a cropped image.

zh-CN.description: Yashoid InstaCropper 会打开源图片的裁剪界面，将裁剪后的 JPEG 保存到应用指定的位置并返回结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用无法通过 InstaCropper 流程保存裁剪后的图片。

en.description: Yazan Tarifi’s Shake Reporter opens when the app launches its reporting screen, where users can review recorded crashes and network requests and export those reports.
en.disableEffect: The app’s crash and network request report screen and its export option will no longer be available.

zh-CN.description: Yazan Tarifi 的 Shake Reporter 会在应用打开报告界面时显示已记录的崩溃和网络请求，供用户查看并导出。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用内的崩溃和网络请求报告界面及其导出功能将无法使用。

en.description: Yazan Tarifi Issuer opens when the app starts its technical issue reporting flow, letting users choose a category or fill out a direct report with text, images and device information.
en.disableEffect: The app’s technical issue report form can no longer be opened.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动技术问题反馈流程时，Yazan Tarifi 的 Issuer 会显示分类或直接反馈表单，用户可填写文字并附上图片和设备信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用内的技术问题反馈表单将无法打开。

en.description: The Yazan Tarifi Shake Reporter launcher entry appears in Android and Android TV app lists; opening it shows the SDK’s crash and network request reports.
en.disableEffect: The report entry disappears from the launcher, so users cannot open the report screen from that icon.

zh-CN.description: Yazan Tarifi 的 Shake Reporter 启动入口会出现在 Android 手机和电视的应用列表中，打开后可查看崩溃和网络请求报告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 启动器中的报告入口会消失，用户无法通过该图标打开报告界面。

en.description: While YC VideoPlayer is active, this Receiver listens for battery changes and updates the player's battery status, including charging and low-battery states. Video playback itself does not depend on this display update.
en.disableEffect: The player may stop showing the current battery or charging state; video playback remains available.

zh-CN.description: YC VideoPlayer 运行时，此 Receiver 会监听电池变化并更新播放器中的电量、充电和低电量状态显示。视频播放本身不依赖此显示更新。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 播放器可能不再显示最新电量或充电状态，但视频仍可播放。

en.description: When network connectivity changes, YC VideoPlayer checks whether the phone is offline and pauses the current stream with an offline state. Disabling it can leave a stream buffering after the connection drops.
en.disableEffect: Streaming video may keep buffering instead of pausing and showing the offline state when the connection is lost.

zh-CN.description: 网络连接变化时，YC VideoPlayer 会检查手机是否断网，并暂停当前视频并显示离线状态。停用后，断网时视频可能一直缓冲。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 网络中断时，在线播放可能持续缓冲，而不会暂停并显示离线状态。

en.description: This Yeepay YP Cashier activity opens from the app’s payment flow, displays the merchant’s cashier page and handles payment choices and transaction results.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot complete payments through this Yeepay cashier flow.

zh-CN.description: 应用发起支付时会打开 Yeepay YP Cashier 的收银页面，用户可选择支付方式，支付结果也会返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 Yeepay 收银流程完成支付。

en.description: Yeepay YP Cashier uses this activity to handle returns from WeChat and continue its hosted cashier page, checking whether a payment succeeded, is still processing or failed before returning the result to the app.
en.disableEffect: The WeChat handoff and the cashier’s payment result flow will fail.

zh-CN.description: Yeepay YP Cashier 使用此界面接收微信支付返回并继续显示收银页面，确认支付成功、处理中或失败后再将结果交回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 微信支付跳转和收银页面的支付结果处理将无法完成。

en.description: Yeepay YP Cashier opens this embedded web page for its web payment channel and sends supported payment links to the matching app on the device.
en.disableEffect: The Yeepay web payment option cannot open or complete its payment page.

zh-CN.description: Yeepay YP Cashier 会在使用网页支付渠道时打开此内嵌页面，并将支持的支付链接交给设备上的相应应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Yeepay 网页支付选项将无法打开或完成支付页面。

en.description: Clistery AppBasic initializes app-wide context and main-screen task support automatically during startup. Other AppBasic helpers use this setup to work with the app.
en.disableEffect: AppBasic helpers that need the startup context or main-screen task support may fail if this setup is disabled.

zh-CN.description: Clistery AppBasic 会在应用启动时保存应用上下文并准备界面任务支持，供库中的通用工具使用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖启动上下文或界面任务支持的 AppBasic 功能可能无法正常工作。

en.description: Clistery AppBasic initializes the app context and process information automatically during startup. Other AppBasic helpers use this shared setup.
en.disableEffect: AppBasic helpers that need the startup context or process information may fail if this setup is disabled.

zh-CN.description: Clistery AppBasic 会在应用启动时保存应用上下文和进程信息，供库中的通用工具使用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖启动上下文或进程信息的 AppBasic 功能可能无法正常工作。

en.description: Clistery BottomNavigationEx checks which Material Components version the app includes during startup so its extended bottom navigation can choose compatible behavior.
en.disableEffect: Apps that use BottomNavigationEx may lose the version setup needed for their extended bottom navigation.

zh-CN.description: Clistery BottomNavigationEx 会在应用启动时检查 Material Components 版本，让扩展底部导航选择兼容的行为。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用 BottomNavigationEx 的应用可能无法完成扩展底部导航所需的版本初始化。

en.description: The Analysys EasyTouch floating tool opens Android display-over-other-apps settings and returns whether permission was granted before showing its floating control.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents the EasyTouch floating tool from requesting overlay permission and completing setup.

zh-CN.description: Analysys EasyTouch 浮动工具会打开 Android 的“显示在其他应用上层”权限页面，并返回用户是否允许显示浮动控件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，EasyTouch 浮动工具无法请求显示权限，也无法继续浮动控件的设置流程。

en.description: The Lizhi LZAuthorize screen opens when the app starts Lizhi account sign-in. It offers phone login and, when configured, Facebook sign-in, and links to the service agreement and privacy page.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot complete the Lizhi account sign-in flow.

zh-CN.description: 这是荔枝（Lizhi）LZAuthorize 的账号登录界面，应用启动荔枝账号授权时会打开。界面提供手机号登录；应用配置后也可使用 Facebook 登录，并可查看服务协议和隐私政策。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法完成这条荔枝账号登录流程。

en.description: The Lizhi LZAuthorize phone sign-in flow opens this screen when users choose a country calling code. It loads the available country codes and returns the selected code to the phone form.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot select a country calling code in this sign-in flow.

zh-CN.description: 荔枝（Lizhi）LZAuthorize 的手机号登录流程会在用户选择国家或地区区号时打开此界面。界面加载可选区号，并将所选区号返回手机号表单。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法在这条登录流程中选择国家或地区区号。

en.description: The Lizhi LZAuthorize screen handles phone sign-in and phone verification after social sign-in. Users enter a phone number and verification code; the SDK sends the code and submits the login or phone binding.
en.disableEffect: Phone sign-in and phone verification for social account linking cannot be completed.

zh-CN.description: 这是荔枝（Lizhi）LZAuthorize 的手机号登录和社交账号绑定手机号界面。用户填写手机号和验证码后，SDK 会发送验证码并提交登录或手机号绑定。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法完成手机号登录，也无法通过此流程验证并绑定手机号。

en.description: After phone verification identifies a new account, the Lizhi LZAuthorize screen collects a display name and gender and submits the account registration.
en.disableEffect: New account registration through Lizhi LZAuthorize cannot be completed.

zh-CN.description: 手机号验证确认需要创建新账号后，荔枝（Lizhi）LZAuthorize 会打开此界面收集昵称和性别，并提交账号注册信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法通过荔枝 LZAuthorize 完成新账号注册。

en.description: During Lizhi authorization, the agreement and privacy links open their pages here in an in-app browser with close and reload controls.
en.disableEffect: The agreement and privacy pages cannot be opened from the authorization flow.

zh-CN.description: 荔枝（Lizhi）账号授权界面中的服务协议和隐私政策链接会在此应用内浏览器中打开，并提供关闭和重新加载按钮。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法从授权流程中打开服务协议和隐私政策页面。

en.description: The Lizhi ITNet network library starts this service when its network client initializes. The service watches connectivity changes and provides the request service used by the library.
en.disableEffect: App features that rely on ITNet to fetch or send server data may stop working.

zh-CN.description: 荔枝（Lizhi）ITNet 网络库会在网络客户端初始化时启动此服务。服务会监听网络连接变化，并为该网络库提供请求处理能力。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖 ITNet 获取或提交服务器数据的应用功能可能无法正常使用。

en.description: When Android reports a connectivity change, the Lizhi LZGlide image library updates its network category so its image resizing rule can choose an image size for that connection.
en.disableEffect: Network-aware image sizing may not refresh after a connection change, while image loading itself can continue.

zh-CN.description: Android 通知网络连接发生变化时，荔枝（Lizhi）LZGlide 图片库会更新网络类型，让图片尺寸规则按当前连接选择图片大小。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 网络切换后，图片尺寸策略可能不会更新；图片加载本身仍可继续。

en.description: The Lizhi LzPermission library uses this provider on Android 7 and newer to create shareable file links for files under its configured sharing paths.
en.disableEffect: File-sharing flows that use LzPermission may no longer be able to give another app access to a file.

zh-CN.description: Android 7 及更高版本中，荔枝（Lizhi）LzPermission 会通过此内容提供器为共享目录中的文件创建可分享链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用 LzPermission 的文件分享流程可能无法再向其他应用提供文件访问权限。

en.description: The Lizhi LzPermission library opens this screen for Android permission requests and special access. It forwards users to the permission prompt or the relevant system settings page, then returns the result.
en.disableEffect: Permission requests or settings recovery handled by this library may fail, leaving features that need those permissions unavailable.

zh-CN.description: 荔枝（Lizhi）LzPermission 在请求 Android 权限或特殊访问权限时会打开此界面。它会转到系统权限提示或相应设置页面，再将结果返回。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 此库处理的权限申请或设置引导可能失效，依赖这些权限的功能会无法使用。

en.description: The Lizhi LzPermission library opens this screen to explain why a permission is needed or to guide users to settings after a denial. Its buttons continue the request or open the relevant setting.
en.disableEffect: Users may be unable to finish the permission guidance flow, leaving affected app features unavailable.

zh-CN.description: 荔枝（Lizhi）LzPermission 会在说明权限用途或权限被拒后引导用户前往设置时打开此界面。用户可通过界面按钮继续申请或进入相应设置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户可能无法完成权限引导，相关应用功能也会因此无法使用。

en.description: The Lizhi PlatformTools provider serves shared settings to SDK components running in another process. The library uses it to read preference values and apply saved changes.
en.disableEffect: SDK features that depend on shared settings across processes may fail to read or save the values they need.

zh-CN.description: 荔枝（Lizhi）PlatformTools 的此内容提供器会向其他进程中的 SDK 组件提供共享设置，供其读取偏好值并保存更改。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖跨进程共享设置的 SDK 功能可能无法读取或保存所需数据。

en.description: When a uni-app feature requests a scan, zwonb’s UnimpModules barcode scanner opens this Activity, asks for camera access and scans from the live camera view.
en.disableEffect: The barcode scanner provided by UnimpModules will not open.

zh-CN.description: uni-app 功能请求扫码时，zwonb 的 UnimpModules 条码扫描器会打开此 Activity、申请相机权限并扫描实时画面中的码。
zh-CN.disableEffect: UnimpModules 提供的条码扫描页面将无法打开。

en.description: zwonb’s UnimpModules video recorder opens this Activity when a uni-app feature requests a recording; it asks for camera and microphone access, records a clip and returns the saved video.
en.disableEffect: The UnimpModules video-recording page will not open, so callers cannot record video through this SDK.

zh-CN.description: uni-app 功能请求录像时，zwonb 的 UnimpModules 录像模块会打开此 Activity、申请相机和麦克风权限、录制视频并返回保存的文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: UnimpModules 录像页面将无法打开，调用此 SDK 的功能也无法录制视频。

en.description: zwonb’s UnimpModules face-detection feature opens this Activity to request camera access, analyze the live view for a face and adjust screen brightness for illumination.
en.disableEffect: The UnimpModules face-detection and assisted-lighting screen will not open.

zh-CN.description: zwonb 的 UnimpModules 人脸检测功能会打开此 Activity，申请相机权限、分析实时画面中的人脸，并调节屏幕亮度进行补光。
zh-CN.disableEffect: UnimpModules 的人脸检测和辅助补光页面将无法打开。

en.description: zwonb’s UnimpModules starts this foreground Service when a uni-app background task requests its persistent “业绩” notice.
en.disableEffect: The ongoing UnimpModules notice and this background service will no longer run; other app screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: uni-app 后台任务请求持续通知时，zwonb 的 UnimpModules 会启动此前台 Service，显示“业绩”通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: UnimpModules 的持续通知和此后台服务将无法运行，应用的其他页面仍可使用。

en.description: zwonb’s UnimpModules lock-screen countdown feature opens this Activity to show a full-screen timer and flash status, then sends state updates to the uni-app runtime.
en.disableEffect: The UnimpModules lock-screen countdown display and its state updates will be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: zwonb 的 UnimpModules 锁屏倒计时功能会打开此 Activity，显示全屏计时和闪屏状态，并向 uni-app 运行环境回传状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: UnimpModules 的锁屏倒计时页面及其状态更新将无法使用。

en.description: zwonb’s UnimpModules native features bind to this Service to exchange messages with the uni-app runtime and receive replies.
en.disableEffect: UnimpModules features that rely on this message bridge may stop responding or fail.

zh-CN.description: zwonb 的 UnimpModules 原生功能会绑定此 Service，与 uni-app 运行环境交换消息并接收回复。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖 UnimpModules 消息通道的功能可能无法响应或运行失败。

en.description: zwonb’s UnimpModules video recorder opens this Activity when uni-app requests a recording; it asks for camera and microphone access, records a clip and returns the saved video.
en.disableEffect: The video-recording flow provided by UnimpModules will not work.

zh-CN.description: uni-app 请求录像时，zwonb 的 UnimpModules 录像模块会打开此 Activity、申请相机和麦克风权限、录制视频并返回保存的文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: UnimpModules 提供的录像功能将无法使用。

en.description: zwonb’s UnimpModules scan module opens this Activity for video recording; it requests camera and microphone access, records a clip and returns the result.
en.disableEffect: The video-recording flow provided by this UnimpModules module will not work.

zh-CN.description: zwonb 的 UnimpModules 扫码模块会通过此 Activity 录像；它会申请相机和麦克风权限、录制视频并返回结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 此 UnimpModules 模块提供的录像功能将无法使用。

en.description: zwonb’s UnimpModules scanner opens this Activity when uni-app requests a code scan; it asks for camera access and scans barcodes or QR codes from the live view.
en.disableEffect: The camera-based code-scanning flow provided by UnimpModules will not open.

zh-CN.description: uni-app 请求扫码时，zwonb 的 UnimpModules 扫码器会打开此 Activity、申请相机权限并扫描实时画面中的条码或二维码。
zh-CN.disableEffect: UnimpModules 提供的相机扫码功能将无法打开。

en.description: zwonb’s UnimpModules screen-flash feature opens this Activity to show a full-screen timed flash display, track battery state and send updates to the uni-app runtime.
en.disableEffect: The UnimpModules screen-flash countdown and its state updates will be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: zwonb 的 UnimpModules 屏幕闪光功能会打开此 Activity，显示全屏定时闪光页面、跟踪电池状态并向 uni-app 运行环境回传状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: UnimpModules 的屏幕闪光倒计时及其状态更新将无法使用。

en.description: zwonb’s UnimpModules voice-call feature starts this Service during an intercom session; it keeps an ongoing foreground notice while the feature runs.
en.disableEffect: The UnimpModules background intercom session may stop or lose its foreground service notice.

zh-CN.description: zwonb 的 UnimpModules 对讲功能运行时会启动此 Service；会话期间它会保持前台运行并显示持续通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: UnimpModules 的后台对讲会话可能中断，或失去前台服务通知。

en.description: zwonb’s UnimpModules voice-call feature starts this Service during an intercom session; it keeps a foreground notice and a Wi-Fi lock while the session runs.
en.disableEffect: The UnimpModules background intercom session may stop or lose the network connection it needs.

zh-CN.description: zwonb 的 UnimpModules 对讲功能运行时会启动此 Service；会话期间它会保持前台通知并持有 Wi-Fi 锁。
zh-CN.disableEffect: UnimpModules 的后台对讲会话可能中断，或失去所需的网络连接。

en.description: YieldNull AliOSS’s upload service runs when the library starts a transfer, scans indexed photos and videos, uploads unrecorded files to Alibaba Cloud OSS over Wi-Fi, and records successful uploads.
en.disableEffect: Photo and video uploads handled by this service stop, including its background retry and continuation.

zh-CN.description: YieldNull AliOSS 启动上传时会扫描媒体库中的照片和视频，通过 Wi-Fi 将尚未记录的文件上传到阿里云 OSS，并记录成功的上传。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 此服务负责的照片和视频上传将停止，后台重试和续传也会失效。

en.description: YieldNull AliOSS’s alarm receiver starts the upload service when its periodic alarm fires, so queued photo and video uploads can continue.
en.disableEffect: Scheduled restarts of the AliOSS upload service stop, so queued uploads may be left waiting.

zh-CN.description: YieldNull AliOSS 的定时接收器会在周期闹钟触发时重新启动上传服务，让排队中的照片和视频继续上传。
zh-CN.disableEffect: AliOSS 上传服务将不再按计划重新启动，排队中的上传可能一直等待。

en.description: YieldNull AliOSS listens for Wi-Fi changes, stopping its uploader when Wi-Fi is disabled and restarting it when a Wi-Fi connection becomes available.
en.disableEffect: AliOSS will no longer automatically pause or restart queued uploads as Wi-Fi changes.

zh-CN.description: YieldNull AliOSS 会监听 Wi-Fi 状态变化：Wi-Fi 关闭时停止上传，有 Wi-Fi 连接时重新启动上传服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: AliOSS 将无法根据 Wi-Fi 状态自动暂停或重新启动排队中的上传。

en.description: Rokid Yiqi Server’s knowledge screen opens from the app’s knowledge section, loads available categories and lets users search for or select an item.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot browse or search Yiqi’s knowledge library.

zh-CN.description: Rokid Yiqi Server 的知识页面会加载可用分类，供用户在应用的知识板块中搜索或选择条目。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法浏览或搜索 Yiqi 知识库。

en.description: Rokid Yiqi Server opens this screen for a selected knowledge item and loads the item’s content by its ID.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open or read selected Yiqi knowledge items.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择知识条目后，Rokid Yiqi Server 会按条目标识加载并显示该条目的内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开或阅读所选的 Yiqi 知识条目。

en.description: Rokid Yiqi Server’s file viewer opens a file link with its name and size, then lets the user preview or open the file and save it when requested by the app.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot view, open or save files through Yiqi’s file viewer.

zh-CN.description: Rokid Yiqi Server 的文件查看器会打开文件链接并显示名称和大小，也可按应用要求预览、打开或保存文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 Yiqi 文件查看器查看、打开或保存文件。

en.description: Rokid Yiqi Server’s media viewer opens a supplied media link, shows its title and thumbnail, and plays video with controls; the app can request automatic playback.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot play media links inside Yiqi.

zh-CN.description: Rokid Yiqi Server 的媒体查看器会打开媒体链接并显示标题和缩略图，还可播放视频；应用也可以要求自动播放。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在 Yiqi 中播放媒体链接。

en.description: Rokid Yiqi Server’s collaboration log screen loads meeting records for the requested category when users open the history list.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot browse Yiqi’s collaboration meeting history.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开协作记录列表时，Rokid Yiqi Server 会加载所选类别下的会议记录。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法浏览 Yiqi 的协作会议记录。

en.description: Rokid Yiqi Server opens a selected collaboration record by its ID, showing meeting details, participants, video and file sections, plus summary and issue status.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open or review collaboration meeting details and attachments.

zh-CN.description: Rokid Yiqi Server 会按记录编号打开协作会议详情，显示会议情况、参与者、视频和文件，以及纪要和问题状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开或查看协作会议详情及附件。

en.description: The Beseting Nes Emulator uses this game screen to render and control the selected NES game during play.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to play the selected NES game through the emulator.

zh-CN.description: Beseting Nes Emulator 使用此游戏页面显示并控制正在游玩的 NES 游戏。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过模拟器游玩所选的 NES 游戏。

en.description: The Beseting Nes Emulator includes this screen to test how its game graphics appear.
en.disableEffect: The emulator graphics test screen will be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: Beseting Nes Emulator 在此测试游戏画面的显示效果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 模拟器的图形测试页面将不可用。

en.description: The Beseting Nes Emulator briefly opens this screen when it must restart the app and then reopen the previous game screen.
en.disableEffect: A restart needed by the emulator may fail to return to the game screen.

zh-CN.description: Beseting Nes Emulator 需要重启应用时会短暂显示此页面，随后重新打开先前的游戏页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 模拟器需要重启时，应用可能无法返回游戏页面。

en.description: The Beseting Nes Emulator opens this screen from a game to view, add, edit, and enable cheat codes for that game.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to manage cheat codes for games in the emulator.

zh-CN.description: Beseting Nes Emulator 的此页面会显示当前游戏的作弊码，并允许用户添加、编辑和启用作弊码。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在模拟器中管理游戏作弊码。

en.description: The Beseting Nes Emulator opens this screen when a user chooses a save or load slot for a game.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to choose a slot to save or restore game progress.

zh-CN.description: 用户为游戏选择存档或读档位置时，Beseting Nes Emulator 会打开此页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法选择用于保存或恢复游戏进度的位置。

en.description: The Beseting Nes Emulator opens this screen for settings that apply to the selected game.
en.disableEffect: Users will lose access to settings for an individual game.

zh-CN.description: Beseting Nes Emulator 会为所选游戏打开此设置页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法调整单个游戏的设置。

en.description: The Beseting Nes Emulator opens this screen for emulator-wide options such as display layout and general controls.
en.disableEffect: Users will lose access to the emulator-wide settings screen.

zh-CN.description: Beseting Nes Emulator 会在此显示模拟器通用选项，例如画面布局和控制设置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开模拟器的通用设置页面。

en.description: The Beseting Nes Emulator opens this screen to assign device keys to game controls and save a keyboard profile.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to change keyboard or game-controller key assignments.

zh-CN.description: Beseting Nes Emulator 会在此将设备按键分配给游戏操作，并保存键盘配置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法更改键盘或游戏手柄的按键分配。

en.description: The Beseting Nes Emulator opens this screen to adjust the size and position of the game image on the display.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to adjust the game image layout through this screen.

zh-CN.description: Beseting Nes Emulator 会在此调整游戏画面在屏幕上的大小和位置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此页面调整游戏画面布局。

en.description: The Beseting Nes Emulator opens this screen to adjust the on-screen touch controls used while playing.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to configure the emulator touch controls through this screen.

zh-CN.description: Beseting Nes Emulator 会在此调整游玩时使用的屏幕触控按键。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此页面配置模拟器的触控按键。

en.description: YOC VIS.X opens this screen when an in-app ad expands, displaying the expanded ad content until the user closes it.
en.disableEffect: Expanded VIS.X ads cannot be shown, while other app content remains available.

zh-CN.description: YOC VIS.X 会在应用内广告展开时显示扩展后的广告内容，直到用户将其关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 展开式 VIS.X 广告将无法显示，应用的其他内容仍可使用。

en.description: YOC VIS.X opens this screen to display a full-screen interstitial ad; closing or pressing Back returns the user to the app.
en.disableEffect: VIS.X interstitial ads cannot appear, while unrelated app features remain usable.

zh-CN.description: YOC VIS.X 会打开此页面显示全屏插页广告；用户关闭广告或按返回键后会回到应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: VIS.X 插页广告将无法显示，应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: YOC VIS.X opens this in-app browser when a user taps an ad destination, with controls to go back, forward, refresh or close the page.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open VIS.X ad destination pages inside the app.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击广告链接时，YOC VIS.X 会在应用内打开带有前进、后退、刷新和关闭按钮的网页。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在应用内打开 VIS.X 广告落地页。

en.description: YOC VIS.X opens this screen when an in-app ad expands, displaying the expanded ad content until the user closes it.
en.disableEffect: Expanded VIS.X ads cannot be shown, while other app content remains available.

zh-CN.description: YOC VIS.X 会在应用内广告展开时显示扩展后的广告内容，直到用户将其关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 展开式 VIS.X 广告将无法显示，应用的其他内容仍可使用。

en.description: YOC VIS.X opens this screen to display a full-screen interstitial ad; closing or pressing Back returns the user to the app.
en.disableEffect: VIS.X interstitial ads cannot appear, while unrelated app features remain usable.

zh-CN.description: YOC VIS.X 会打开此页面显示全屏插页广告；用户关闭广告或按返回键后会回到应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: VIS.X 插页广告将无法显示，应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: YOC VIS.X opens this in-app browser when a user taps an ad destination, with controls to go back, forward, refresh or close the page.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open VIS.X ad destination pages inside the app.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击广告链接时，YOC VIS.X 会在应用内打开带有前进、后退、刷新和关闭按钮的网页。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在应用内打开 VIS.X 广告落地页。

en.description: At app startup, Yodo1 Suit's advertising core prepares its ad adapters and registers app activity tracking so its ads can run.
en.disableEffect: Yodo1 Suit ads and their activity tracking will not initialize.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，Yodo1 Suit 广告核心会准备广告适配器并注册应用界面跟踪，以便广告功能运行。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Yodo1 Suit 广告及其界面跟踪将无法初始化。

en.description: Yodo1 Suit opens this full-screen Activity to display a splash ad. It closes after the ad is closed or fails to display.
en.disableEffect: Yodo1 Suit splash ads will not be shown.

zh-CN.description: Yodo1 Suit 会通过此全屏界面展示开屏广告；广告关闭或展示失败后，界面会退出。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Yodo1 Suit 开屏广告将无法显示。

en.description: Yodo1 FanCraft’s Firebase messaging service receives push messages, displays their notification text and stores refreshed push registration tokens.
en.disableEffect: FanCraft push notifications will stop arriving through Firebase, and new push tokens will not be registered.

zh-CN.description: Yodo1 FanCraft 的 Firebase 消息服务会接收推送消息、显示通知文字，并保存更新后的推送令牌。
zh-CN.disableEffect: FanCraft 将无法通过 Firebase 接收推送通知，也不会登记新的推送令牌。

en.description: Yodo1 FanCraft’s startup provider prepares the SDK’s saved settings and network access as the app starts, so FanCraft features can load and respond while the user moves through the app.
en.disableEffect: FanCraft features that depend on startup setup or server access may stop working.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，Yodo1 FanCraft 会通过此组件准备已保存的设置和网络连接，让 FanCraft 功能能随应用使用正常加载和响应。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖启动设置或服务器连接的 FanCraft 功能可能无法使用。

en.description: Yodo1 FanCraft opens Android’s file picker when a form asks for an attachment, then returns the selected files to the form.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot attach files to FanCraft forms.

zh-CN.description: Yodo1 FanCraft 的表单需要附件时会打开 Android 文件选择器，再将用户选中的文件交回表单。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在 FanCraft 表单中添加文件附件。

en.description: Yodo1 FanCraft’s notification service periodically checks for new messages while it is running and forwards returned notifications to FanCraft.
en.disableEffect: FanCraft’s polled notification messages will no longer be fetched.

zh-CN.description: Yodo1 FanCraft 的通知服务运行时会定期检查新消息，并将收到的通知交给 FanCraft 处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: FanCraft 将不再获取通过此服务轮询的通知消息。

en.description: Yodo1's shared file provider gives Android and other apps access to files used by its Vivo, GDT, Xiaomi ad adapters and MiGu payment adapter.
en.disableEffect: SDK download, installation, or file-sharing flows that use this provider may fail.

zh-CN.description: Yodo1 共用的文件 Provider 会让 Android 和其他应用读取 Vivo、GDT、小米广告适配器及 MiGu 支付适配器使用的文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此 Provider 的 SDK 下载、安装或文件分享流程可能会失败。

en.description: The Yodo1 Game SDK uses this receiver for scheduled local messages; when the game is in the background, it posts a notification that can reopen the game.
en.disableEffect: Yodo1's scheduled wake-up or in-game notifications will not be delivered, while the game itself continues to work.

zh-CN.description: Yodo1 游戏 SDK 用此 Receiver 处理定时本地消息；游戏在后台时，它会发布可重新打开游戏的通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Yodo1 的定时唤醒或游戏内通知将无法送达，但游戏本身仍可运行。

en.description: The Yodo1 Game SDK opens this in-game cashier when a purchase is requested, offering the payment options configured for the game.
en.disableEffect: The Yodo1 cashier cannot open, so purchases through its configured payment channels may fail.

zh-CN.description: 游戏发起购买时，Yodo1 游戏 SDK 会打开此收银页面，并显示游戏已配置的支付方式。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Yodo1 收银页面无法打开，因此通过已配置支付渠道进行的购买可能失败。

en.description: The Yodo1 Game SDK opens this in-app browser for pages such as its terms, privacy, and child-privacy notices, as well as other game links.
en.disableEffect: Yodo1 pages opened inside the game will be unavailable, and any game flow that relies on them may fail.

zh-CN.description: Yodo1 游戏 SDK 会用此应用内浏览器打开服务条款、隐私政策、儿童隐私说明等页面，也可显示其他游戏链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 游戏内的 Yodo1 页面将无法打开，依赖这些页面的流程也可能失败。

en.description: Yodo1 SmartPolly uses Firebase Cloud Messaging to receive push messages. When a message includes a notification body, it displays a notification and reports refreshed push tokens.
en.disableEffect: SmartPolly push notifications will stop appearing, and refreshed push tokens will not be reported to the SDK.

zh-CN.description: Yodo1 SmartPolly 通过 Firebase Cloud Messaging 接收推送消息。消息包含通知正文时，此 Service 会显示通知，并上报更新后的推送令牌。
zh-CN.disableEffect: SmartPolly 推送通知将不再显示，更新后的推送令牌也不会上报给 SDK。

en.description: At app startup, this Yodo1 SmartPolly provider prepares SDK settings and network access and tracks when app screens open or close. SmartPolly uses this setup for its messaging features.
en.disableEffect: SmartPolly's automatic startup, activity tracking, and related notification updates will not initialize.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，Yodo1 SmartPolly 会通过此 Provider 准备 SDK 配置和网络访问，并跟踪应用界面的打开与关闭；这些设置供其消息功能使用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: SmartPolly 的自动初始化、界面跟踪及相关通知更新将无法启动。

en.description: When Yodo1 SmartPolly starts this Service, it periodically requests in-app notification messages from Yodo1 and makes returned messages available to SmartPolly callbacks.
en.disableEffect: SmartPolly in-app messages and app features driven by them will stop updating.

zh-CN.description: Yodo1 SmartPolly 启动此 Service 后，它会定期向 Yodo1 请求应用内通知，并通过 SmartPolly 回调提供收到的消息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: SmartPolly 应用内消息及依赖这些消息的应用功能将不再更新。

en.description: At app startup, Yodo1 Anti-Addiction registers app activity monitoring used by its player-protection and identity-verification features.
en.disableEffect: Yodo1 Anti-Addiction activity monitoring and its verification flow will not initialize.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，Yodo1 防沉迷 SDK 会注册应用界面监控，为玩家保护和身份验证功能提供支持。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Yodo1 防沉迷界面监控及其验证流程将无法初始化。

en.description: Yodo1 Anti-Addiction opens this Activity when the game requests player identity certification. It shows the certification page and returns the result to the SDK.
en.disableEffect: Players may be unable to complete identity checks required by the game's age-protection flow.

zh-CN.description: 游戏请求玩家身份认证时，Yodo1 防沉迷 SDK 会打开此界面显示认证页面，并将结果返回给 SDK。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 玩家可能无法完成游戏防沉迷流程所需的身份验证。

en.description: Yodo1 MAS opens this full-screen activity to show an app-open ad and closes it when the ad ends or fails to load.
en.disableEffect: Yodo1 MAS app-open ads cannot be displayed.

zh-CN.description: Yodo1 MAS 会打开此全屏页面显示应用启动广告，并在广告结束或加载失败时关闭页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Yodo1 MAS 的应用启动广告将无法显示。

en.description: Yodo1 MAS’s debugger opens an ad testing screen where a tester selects an ad format or network, loads a test ad and checks the result.
en.disableEffect: The in-app MAS ad testing screen cannot be used; normal app features are unchanged.

zh-CN.description: Yodo1 MAS 的调试工具会打开广告测试页面，供测试人员选择广告类型或广告网络、加载测试广告并查看结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用内的 MAS 广告测试页面将无法使用，应用的正常功能不受影响。

en.description: Yodo1 MAS’s debugger lists installed ad network integrations and their setup status.
en.disableEffect: The MAS ad network integration status list is unavailable.

zh-CN.description: Yodo1 MAS 的调试工具会列出已集成的广告网络及其配置状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: MAS 广告网络的集成状态列表将无法查看。

en.description: Yodo1 MAS’s debugger shows integration and configuration details for the selected advertising network.
en.disableEffect: Testers cannot inspect that network’s MAS integration details in the debugger.

zh-CN.description: Yodo1 MAS 的调试工具会显示所选广告网络的集成和配置详情。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 测试人员将无法在调试工具中检查该广告网络的 MAS 集成详情。

en.description: Yodo1 MAS’s debugger shows app and SDK setup, test device state and ad network integration status, with links to its other diagnostic screens.
en.disableEffect: The MAS diagnostics menu is unavailable; user-facing app screens remain usable.

zh-CN.description: Yodo1 MAS 的调试工具会显示应用与 SDK 设置、测试设备状态和广告网络集成情况，并提供其他诊断页面的入口。
zh-CN.disableEffect: MAS 诊断菜单将无法打开，应用面向用户的页面仍可正常使用。

en.description: Yodo1 MAS starts this screen when it shows a rewarded video or rewarded interstitial, plays a cached video, and reports completion for the reward.
en.disableEffect: Those video ads will not play, and rewards for watching ads will no longer be granted.

zh-CN.description: Yodo1 MAS 展示激励视频或激励插屏广告时会打开此页面播放已缓存的视频，并在播放结束后通知广告系统发放奖励。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，这些视频广告无法播放，观看广告的奖励也不会发放。

en.description: Yodo1 MAS’s online configuration provider runs at app startup, setting up the SDK’s network helpers and loading its remote configuration.
en.disableEffect: Yodo1 MAS remote configuration will not initialize, which can affect the SDK’s ad setup.

zh-CN.description: Yodo1 MAS 的在线配置组件会在应用启动时准备网络服务并加载 SDK 的远程配置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Yodo1 MAS 的远程配置将无法初始化，可能影响该 SDK 的广告设置。

en.description: The Yodo1 WeChat integration responds to WeChat's app-refresh request and registers the game's configured app with WeChat.
en.disableEffect: WeChat login, payment, or sharing handoffs that depend on this registration may fail.

zh-CN.description: Yodo1 微信接入组件会响应微信的应用刷新请求，并向微信注册游戏配置的应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此注册的微信登录、支付或分享流程可能失败。

en.description: The Yodo1 Bilibili channel SDK registers startup callbacks and attaches Bilibili game services when the app process starts.
en.disableEffect: Bilibili channel features that depend on this initialization may not work.

zh-CN.description: Yodo1 哔哩哔哩渠道 SDK 会在应用进程启动时注册启动回调并接入哔哩哔哩游戏服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此初始化的哔哩哔哩渠道功能可能无法使用。

en.description: The Yodo1 4399 channel SDK reads the game's 4399 settings during startup and initializes 4399 game services when the main game screen opens.
en.disableEffect: 4399 channel sign-in and other game services may not initialize.

zh-CN.description: Yodo1 4399 渠道 SDK 会在启动时读取游戏的 4399 配置，并在主游戏页面打开时初始化 4399 游戏服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 4399 渠道登录及其他游戏服务可能无法初始化。

en.description: Huawei push opens this Activity when a player taps a push link; it routes the player to the game listing, a web page, or an in-app page.
en.disableEffect: Tapping Huawei push links will no longer open their destination, but normal gameplay continues.

zh-CN.description: 玩家点击推送链接时，华为推送组件会打开此 Activity，并跳转到游戏商店页面、网页或应用内页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 点击华为推送链接后将无法打开目标页面，但正常游戏仍可继续。

en.description: Huawei Push Kit starts this service for message and token events; it stores new push tokens, subscribes the game to a message topic, and receives incoming messages.
en.disableEffect: Huawei push registration and message delivery through this SDK will stop, while normal gameplay continues.

zh-CN.description: 华为推送服务会在令牌或消息事件到达时启动此 Service；它保存新的推送令牌、订阅消息主题并接收消息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 此 SDK 的华为推送注册和消息接收将停止，但正常游戏仍可继续。

en.description: Yodo1 SUIT Share SDK uses this file provider when a share flow needs to expose an app file to another app through a content link. The provider's allowed file paths are registered in the app manifest.
en.disableEffect: Sharing a file through the Yodo1 SDK can fail.

zh-CN.description: Yodo1 SUIT Share SDK 在分享流程需要把应用内文件交给其他应用时，会通过此文件提供器创建内容链接；可共享的路径在应用清单中配置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Yodo1 SDK 的文件分享可能无法完成。

en.description: The Yodo1 Game SDK opens this screen for its built-in account feature, where players can sign in or register a Yodo1 account.
en.disableEffect: Players cannot use the game's Yodo1 sign-in or account-registration screen.

zh-CN.description: Yodo1 游戏 SDK 会打开此内置账户页面，供玩家登录或注册 Yodo1 账户。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 玩家将无法使用游戏中的 Yodo1 登录或账户注册页面。

en.description: Yodo1 Share uses this provider to give other apps access to files that the user shares from the game. It is registered for common social and messaging apps.
en.disableEffect: Sharing files through Yodo1 Share may fail in social and messaging apps.

zh-CN.description: Yodo1 Share 使用此 Provider 让其他应用读取用户从游戏中分享的文件，并适配常见社交和消息应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过 Yodo1 Share 向社交或消息应用分享文件时可能会失败。

en.description: Yodo1 Social uses this provider to let social and messaging apps read files shared from the game through secure content links.
en.disableEffect: File sharing through Yodo1 Social may fail.

zh-CN.description: Yodo1 Social 使用此 Provider 通过安全的内容链接，让社交和消息应用读取用户从游戏中分享的文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过 Yodo1 Social 分享文件时可能会失败。

en.description: Yoti Doc Capture SDK opens this screen during an identity-document step and loads the document-selection flow for the verification session. Users choose the document the app will scan here.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot start Yoti's document-selection and capture step.

zh-CN.description: Yoti Doc Capture SDK 在身份文件核验步骤打开此页面，并载入会话对应的证件选择流程；用户在这里选择要扫描的证件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法启动 Yoti 的证件选择和采集步骤。

en.description: Yoti Doc Capture SDK opens this screen after a document type is selected and camera permission is available. It scans the selected identity document and returns the result.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot photograph and submit an identity document through this flow.

zh-CN.description: 用户选定证件类型并授予相机权限后，Yoti Doc Capture SDK 会打开此页面拍摄和扫描证件，然后返回扫描结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法通过此流程拍摄并提交身份证件。

en.description: Yoti Doc Capture SDK starts this entry screen when a document-capture session begins and returns the result to the calling app. It hosts the opening screen of that verification flow.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot open this Yoti identity-capture session.

zh-CN.description: Yoti Doc Capture SDK 在证件采集会话开始时打开此入口页面，并将结果返回给调用它的应用；它承载该核验流程的起始画面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法打开此 Yoti 身份采集会话。

en.description: Yoti Doc Scan SDK uses this screen for its identity-document capture step. It displays the document-capture interface when that step is launched.
en.disableEffect: The app's Yoti identity-document verification flow cannot capture the requested document.

zh-CN.description: Yoti Doc Scan SDK 在身份证件采集步骤使用此页面，并在该步骤启动时显示证件采集界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用的 Yoti 身份证件核验流程将无法采集所需证件。

en.description: Yoti Doc Capture SDK opens this screen for the face-liveness step when the verification session includes that step. It hosts the SDK's liveness instructions and capture flow.
en.disableEffect: The app's Yoti liveness check cannot be completed.

zh-CN.description: 当核验会话包含人脸活体检测步骤时，Yoti Doc Capture SDK 会打开此页面，显示检测指引并承载采集流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法完成 Yoti 人脸活体检测。

en.description: Yoti Doc Scan SDK opens this screen when verification asks the user for supplementary documents. It requests camera access and hosts the supporting-document capture flow.
en.disableEffect: The user cannot add a required supporting document, so this verification step can fail.

zh-CN.description: 核验流程要求用户提交补充材料时，Yoti Doc Scan SDK 会打开此页面并申请相机权限，以采集支持文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法添加所需的补充材料，因此该核验步骤可能无法完成。

en.description: Yoti Doc Scan SDK's supplementary-document flow uses this file provider to create content links for temporary document images. Its capture and image-processing code requests image URIs from it.
en.disableEffect: The SDK cannot create or open captured supporting-document images for review or upload.

zh-CN.description: Yoti Doc Scan SDK 的补充材料流程通过此文件提供器为临时证件图片创建内容链接；拍摄和图像处理流程会向它申请图片 URI。
zh-CN.disableEffect: SDK 将无法创建或打开已拍摄的补充材料图片供查看或上传。

en.description: Yoti Doc Scan SDK's supplementary-document flow opens this helper when it needs an image input. It returns a document-image URI to the verification step.
en.disableEffect: The supplementary-document flow cannot open this helper to return an image.

zh-CN.description: Yoti Doc Scan SDK 的补充材料流程需要图片输入时，会打开此辅助页面，并将证件图片 URI 返回给核验步骤。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 补充材料流程将无法打开此页面并返回图片。

en.description: Yoti Face Capture SDK opens this screen for the face-image capture step. It displays the interface used to capture the user's face.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot capture the face image required by this Yoti flow.

zh-CN.description: Yoti Face Capture SDK 在人脸图像采集步骤打开此页面，显示用于拍摄用户人脸的界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法采集此 Yoti 流程所需的人脸图像。

en.description: Yoti Liveness SDK opens this consent screen before biometric verification so the user can review the face-check consent step.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot present or complete the consent step required by this biometric flow.

zh-CN.description: Yoti Liveness SDK 会在人脸生物核验前打开此同意页面，让用户查看并处理人脸核验所需的同意步骤。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法显示或完成此生物核验流程所需的同意步骤。

en.description: Yoti Liveness Zoom SDK opens this screen to prepare its capture view, run a FaceTec face session, and read the result when that session returns.
en.disableEffect: The app's Yoti zoom liveness check cannot run or return a result.

zh-CN.description: Yoti Liveness Zoom SDK 会打开此页面准备采集界面、运行 FaceTec 人脸核验，并在会话返回后读取结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法运行 Yoti Zoom 活体检测或取得结果。

en.description: Yoti's MRTD capture module opens this screen when verification needs to read an NFC-enabled passport chip. It starts NFC discovery while visible and returns the chip data.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot complete passport-chip verification through this flow.

zh-CN.description: 核验流程需要读取支持 NFC 的护照芯片时，Yoti MRTD 模块会打开此页面；页面显示时会搜索芯片并返回读取的数据。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法通过此流程完成护照芯片核验。

en.description: Yoti Button SDK uses this hidden callback screen when the Yoti app returns a scenario result. It forwards the returned action and data to the calling app, then closes.
en.disableEffect: The Yoti login or identity-sharing result cannot return to the calling app.

zh-CN.description: Yoti Button SDK 在 Yoti 应用返回验证场景结果时使用此隐藏页面；它将返回的动作和数据转发给原应用，然后关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Yoti 登录或身份共享结果将无法返回给调用应用。

en.description: Yoti Button SDK runs this background service for backend requests and scenario launches. It contacts Yoti, returns backend results to the app, or opens the Yoti app or web flow.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot complete Yoti scenario handoffs or receive their backend results.

zh-CN.description: Yoti Button SDK 使用此后台服务处理后端请求并启动验证场景；它会联系 Yoti、将后端结果交还给应用，或打开 Yoti 应用和网页流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法完成 Yoti 场景切换或接收后端结果。

en.description: Yoti SDK starts this screen through its activity contract when an app begins an identity-check flow. It hosts the sequence of verification steps, such as document capture and liveness checks.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot run the Yoti verification sequence.

zh-CN.description: 应用通过 Yoti SDK 的活动入口开始身份核验时，会打开此页面；它承载证件采集和活体检测等验证步骤。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法运行 Yoti 身份核验流程。

en.description: The Youdao ads SDK starts this service to download app packages offered through ads.
en.disableEffect: App-package downloads started by Youdao ads will stop or fail.

zh-CN.description: 有道广告 SDK 启动此 Service，下载广告提供的应用安装包。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 有道广告发起的应用安装包下载将停止或失败。

en.description: The Youdao ads SDK opens this in-app browser when a viewer taps an ad link, showing the linked web page or app destination.
en.disableEffect: Ad links that use the Youdao in-app browser will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: 用户点按广告链接时，有道广告 SDK 会打开此应用内浏览器，展示链接网页或应用目标。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用有道应用内浏览器的广告链接将无法打开。

en.description: The Youdao ads SDK uses this file-sharing provider to give the Android installer access to downloaded app packages.
en.disableEffect: The Android installer may be unable to open app packages downloaded from Youdao ads.

zh-CN.description: 有道广告 SDK 通过此文件共享 Provider 将下载的应用安装包交给 Android 系统安装器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Android 系统安装器可能无法打开有道广告下载的应用安装包。

en.description: The Youdao ads SDK opens this full-screen page to play an in-feed video ad, with an option to visit or download the promoted app.
en.disableEffect: Youdao in-feed video ads and their app links will stop working.

zh-CN.description: 有道广告 SDK 打开此全屏页面播放信息流视频广告，并可提供查看或下载推广应用的选项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 有道信息流视频广告及其应用链接将无法使用。

en.description: The Youdao ads SDK opens this screen to display a full-screen HTML interstitial ad with a close control.
en.disableEffect: Youdao HTML interstitial ads will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: 有道广告 SDK 打开此页面展示带关闭控件的全屏 HTML 插屏广告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 有道 HTML 插屏广告将无法打开。

en.description: The Youdao ads SDK opens this full-screen page to play a rewarded video and show its end card.
en.disableEffect: Youdao rewarded videos will stop, and rewards for watching ads will no longer be granted.

zh-CN.description: 有道广告 SDK 打开此全屏页面播放激励视频并展示结束页。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 有道激励视频将无法播放，用户也不会再获得观看广告的奖励。

en.description: When started, the Digital Pocket SDK by Shiqing reads saved crash reports and uploads them to the SDK service. It then stops after processing the reports.
en.disableEffect: Crash reports from the Digital Pocket SDK will no longer be uploaded.

zh-CN.description: Shiqing 的 Digital Pocket（数字口袋）SDK 启动此后台服务时，会读取已保存的崩溃报告并上传到 SDK 服务端，处理后服务会停止。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Digital Pocket SDK 的崩溃报告将不再上传。

en.description: The Digital Pocket SDK by Shiqing includes this test screen: tapping its card returns a fixed sample ID, and another option opens the camera and password test page.
en.disableEffect: Only the sample screen and its test response become unavailable.

zh-CN.description: Shiqing 的 Digital Pocket（数字口袋）SDK 提供此测试页面：点击卡片会返回固定的示例编号，另一个选项会打开相机和密码测试页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 只有示例页面及其测试返回结果会无法使用。

en.description: The Digital Pocket SDK by Shiqing includes this test page for sample image and key controls; it can open the camera and shows password prompts for those controls.
en.disableEffect: Only this sample camera and password page becomes unavailable.

zh-CN.description: Shiqing 的 Digital Pocket（数字口袋）SDK 提供此图像和密钥测试页面；页面可以打开相机，并会为这些测试操作显示密码提示。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 只有此相机和密码测试页面会无法使用。

en.description: At startup, the Digital Pocket SDK by Shiqing checks whether a card is already saved and opens either the sign-in screen or the create/import-card welcome page.
en.disableEffect: The SDK cannot continue from its startup screen to sign-in or first-time card setup.

zh-CN.description: Shiqing 的 Digital Pocket（数字口袋）SDK 启动时会检查是否已有卡包，并相应打开登录页面或新用户的创建／导入卡包引导页。
zh-CN.disableEffect: SDK 将无法从启动页面进入登录或首次卡包设置流程。

en.description: When a connected service asks for identity proof, the Digital Pocket SDK by Shiqing checks the request, gathers the needed credentials, and returns the authorization result to that service.
en.disableEffect: Sign-in and identity-proof requests from connected services will fail or remain unfinished.

zh-CN.description: 有连接服务请求身份凭证时，Shiqing 的 Digital Pocket（数字口袋）SDK 会检查请求、收集所需凭证，并把授权结果返回给该服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 连接服务的登录和身份凭证请求将失败或无法完成。

en.description: When a Digital Pocket API request returns to the app, this Shiqing SDK screen reads the DID, credential, or QR-scan result and reports it to the requesting service.
en.disableEffect: Connected services may not receive the result of a sign-in or credential-authorization request.

zh-CN.description: Shiqing 的 Digital Pocket（数字口袋）SDK 收到接口回调时，会读取 DID、凭证或扫码授权结果并返回给发起请求的服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 连接服务可能收不到登录或凭证授权结果。

en.description: When a service requests an identity, the Digital Pocket SDK by Shiqing lets the user choose a saved account, unlock it, and approve sending its DID.
en.disableEffect: The user cannot approve DID sign-in requests from connected services.

zh-CN.description: 服务请求身份信息时，Shiqing 的 Digital Pocket（数字口袋）SDK 会让用户选择已保存的账户、解锁账户并确认发送 DID。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法批准连接服务发起的 DID 登录请求。

en.description: When a service requests identity details, the Digital Pocket SDK by Shiqing lets the user select saved credentials, unlock the card, and approve sending the selected proofs.
en.disableEffect: The user cannot approve requests that require identity credentials from the card.

zh-CN.description: 服务请求身份资料时，Shiqing 的 Digital Pocket（数字口袋）SDK 会让用户选择已保存的凭证、解锁卡包，并确认发送所选证明。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法批准需要卡包身份凭证的请求。

en.description: When Android opens a Digital Pocket link, this Shiqing SDK Activity routes `/auth` requests to authorization and `/certificate` requests to a scannable identity code.
en.disableEffect: Digital Pocket authorization and certificate links will no longer open the required screens.

zh-CN.description: Android 打开 Digital Pocket 链接时，Shiqing 的 SDK 会将 `/auth` 请求转到授权流程，并将 `/certificate` 请求转到身份二维码页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Digital Pocket 授权链接和凭证链接将无法打开相应页面。

en.description: For a new or returning user, the Digital Pocket SDK by Shiqing shows a union-card introduction and offers to create a card or restore one that already exists.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot start the card creation or card-restoration flow from this page.

zh-CN.description: 新用户或已有卡包的用户进入时，Shiqing 的 Digital Pocket（数字口袋）SDK 会介绍工会数字卡包，并提供创建新卡或导入已有卡的入口。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法从此页面开始创建或恢复卡包。

en.description: When the user chooses to make a card, the Digital Pocket SDK by Shiqing guides them through the steps to create a union digital-identity card and its recovery information.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot create a new union digital-identity card.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择创建卡包后，Shiqing 的 Digital Pocket（数字口袋）SDK 会引导其完成工会数字身份卡及恢复信息的创建步骤。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法创建新的工会数字身份卡。

en.description: When the user chooses to restore a card, the Digital Pocket SDK by Shiqing opens the multi-step flow for importing an existing union digital-identity card.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot restore an existing card on this device.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择恢复卡包时，Shiqing 的 Digital Pocket（数字口袋）SDK 会打开多步骤流程以导入已有的工会数字身份卡。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在此设备上恢复已有卡包。

en.description: When a user imports recovery words or verifies a benefit voucher, the Digital Pocket SDK by Shiqing scans a QR code with the camera or from a selected image and returns the matching scan result.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot scan recovery-word or benefit-voucher codes in these flows.

zh-CN.description: 用户导入恢复词或核销福利凭证时，Shiqing 的 Digital Pocket（数字口袋）SDK 会用相机或所选图片扫描二维码，并返回相应结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在这些流程中扫描恢复词或福利凭证二维码。

en.description: When the user opens a policy or agreement, the Digital Pocket SDK by Shiqing displays the privacy statement or user agreement in a web page.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot read the privacy statement or user agreement inside the SDK.

zh-CN.description: 用户查看政策或协议时，Shiqing 的 Digital Pocket（数字口袋）SDK 会在网页中显示隐私声明或用户协议。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在 SDK 内查看隐私声明或用户协议。

en.description: After sign-in, the Digital Pocket SDK by Shiqing shows the user's saved identities and credentials, with shortcuts to scan a code, manage settings, and view recovery guidance.
en.disableEffect: Users lose the main card and credential dashboard and its shortcuts.

zh-CN.description: 登录后，Shiqing 的 Digital Pocket（数字口袋）SDK 会显示用户保存的身份和凭证，并提供扫码、设置及恢复指引入口。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法使用主卡包和凭证首页及其快捷入口。

en.description: During password recovery in older Digital Pocket releases, this Shiqing SDK page checks the entered number against a saved phone credential before opening the password-change page.
en.disableEffect: Older releases cannot verify the saved phone number for password recovery.

zh-CN.description: 在较早版本的 Digital Pocket 密码恢复流程中，Shiqing 的 SDK 会在打开改密页面前，用已保存的手机凭证核对用户输入的号码。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 较早版本将无法在密码恢复时核验已保存的手机号码。

en.description: During first-time setup, the Digital Pocket SDK by Shiqing asks for an account name and avatar, creates the user's digital identity, and saves the result.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot create the account needed to set up a new card wallet.

zh-CN.description: 首次设置时，Shiqing 的 Digital Pocket（数字口袋）SDK 会让用户填写账户名称并选择头像，随后创建数字身份并保存结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法创建新卡包所需的账户。

en.description: When a saved card wallet needs unlocking, the Digital Pocket SDK by Shiqing checks the user's password or biometric sign-in and then opens the requested card or authorization screen.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot unlock the card wallet or continue through its sign-in requests.

zh-CN.description: 需要解锁已有卡包时，Shiqing 的 Digital Pocket（数字口袋）SDK 会核验密码或生物识别登录，然后打开用户请求的卡包或授权页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法解锁卡包或继续登录授权流程。

en.description: When a flow requires phone verification, the Digital Pocket SDK by Shiqing sends an SMS code, checks it, and continues sign-in or card setup.
en.disableEffect: Phone-verified sign-in and the card-setup paths that require it will fail.

zh-CN.description: 流程需要手机验证时，Shiqing 的 Digital Pocket（数字口袋）SDK 会发送短信验证码、核验验证码，并继续登录或卡包设置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要手机验证的登录和卡包设置流程将失败。

en.description: When a union service page is opened in older Digital Pocket releases, this Shiqing SDK Activity displays the page and handles requests from it to authorize card credentials.
en.disableEffect: Older union-service pages and their in-page card-authorization requests will stop working.

zh-CN.description: 在较早版本中打开工会服务页面时，Shiqing 的 Digital Pocket SDK 会显示网页，并处理网页发起的卡包凭证授权请求。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 较早版本的工会服务页面及其网页内卡包授权请求将无法使用。

en.description: When a service needs proof of a saved identity, the Digital Pocket SDK by Shiqing displays a short-lived QR code for the selected credential and refreshes it when requested.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot show a digital-identity QR code for service verification.

zh-CN.description: 服务需要核验已保存的身份时，Shiqing 的 Digital Pocket（数字口袋）SDK 会为所选凭证显示限时二维码，并可按需刷新。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法出示数字身份二维码供服务核验。

en.description: When the user scans a service's sign-in or authorization code, the Digital Pocket SDK by Shiqing reads it and opens the matching card-authorization flow.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot scan service codes to sign in or authorize a card.

zh-CN.description: 用户扫描服务提供的登录码或授权码时，Shiqing 的 Digital Pocket（数字口袋）SDK 会读取二维码并打开对应的卡包授权流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法扫描服务二维码来登录或授权卡包。

en.description: When a union service is opened inside the Digital Pocket SDK by Shiqing, this page displays its website and connects page actions to card scans and benefit-voucher verification.

en.description: Yubico YubiKit Android SDK displays this prompt when the app requests an operation on a USB or NFC YubiKey. It waits for the key, runs the selected operation, and returns its result.
en.disableEffect: The app's YubiKey feature that needs this prompt cannot be completed.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求操作 USB 或 NFC YubiKey 时，Yubico YubiKit Android SDK 会显示此提示页面；它等待用户连接或感应密钥，执行所请求的操作并返回结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要此提示页面的 YubiKey 功能将无法完成。

en.description: Yubico YubiKit OTP SDK opens this screen when the app asks to read a one-time password from a YubiKey. It listens for USB or NFC input and returns the code.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot read YubiKey one-time passwords through this SDK.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求从 YubiKey 读取一次性密码时，Yubico YubiKit OTP SDK 会打开此页面；它通过 USB 或 NFC 读取密码并将结果返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法通过此 SDK 读取 YubiKey 一次性密码。

en.description: Yullg Android Scaffold uses this tiny hidden screen as a keep-alive. Its helper opens it while the device is non-interactive and closes it when the device becomes interactive again.
en.disableEffect: Scaffold's screen-off keep-alive behavior stops, so its background process-preservation mechanism is lost.

zh-CN.description: Yullg Android Scaffold 将此极小的隐藏页面用作保活界面：设备不活跃时打开，恢复交互时关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Scaffold 在屏幕关闭期间的保活行为会停止，后台进程维持机制也会失效。

en.description: Yullg Android Scaffold uses this file provider when its file-sharing helpers create a content link for a local file. It also supports importing files into Scaffold storage.
en.disableEffect: Scaffold file-sharing flows can fail when they request a content link.

zh-CN.description: Yullg Android Scaffold 的文件分享辅助功能会通过此文件提供器为本地文件创建内容链接；它也支持将文件导入 Scaffold 存储。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Scaffold 请求文件内容链接时，文件分享流程可能失败。

en.description: Yumi Mediation SDK opens this diagnostics screen when an integrator requests ad-network tests. It checks configured ad slots and shows which providers are available.
en.disableEffect: The SDK's provider test screen will be unavailable; normal app screens are unaffected.

zh-CN.description: 集成方请求检测广告网络时，Yumi Mediation SDK 会打开此诊断页面，检查配置的广告位并显示可用的广告平台。
zh-CN.disableEffect: SDK 的广告平台测试页面将无法使用，应用的普通页面不受影响。

en.description: Yumi Mediation Ads SDK opens this full-screen activity to display a downloaded video ad and its associated web content or landing page.
en.disableEffect: Yumi full-screen video ads and their landing pages will not display.

zh-CN.description: Yumi 广告中介 SDK 使用此全屏页面展示已下载的视频广告及其网页素材或落地页。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Yumi 全屏视频广告及其落地页将无法显示。

en.description: Yumi Mediation Ads SDK receives Android's download-complete broadcast for its ad downloads. It finds the matching Yumi download and processes the resulting APK.
en.disableEffect: Downloaded Yumi ad or offer files may not finish processing, so related ads can fail to open.

zh-CN.description: Yumi 广告中介 SDK 会接收其广告下载对应的 Android 下载完成广播，找到相应任务并处理下载的 APK。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Yumi 广告或推广应用的下载文件可能无法处理完成，相关广告也可能无法打开。

en.description: Yumi Mediation Ads SDK opens this web activity to display an interactive ad loaded from local content or a web address. The ad can report close and install-button events.
en.disableEffect: Yumi interactive ads and their install landing-page actions will not appear.

zh-CN.description: Yumi 广告中介 SDK 会打开此网页页面展示互动广告，素材可来自本地内容或网页地址；广告可以回报关闭和安装按钮事件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Yumi 互动广告及其安装落地页操作将无法显示。

en.description: YXT OpenSDK's screen-size adapter runs this provider when the app starts and prepares layout scaling for screens that use it.
en.disableEffect: Screens that rely on YXT's size adaptation may appear at the wrong scale or with incorrect spacing.

zh-CN.description: YXT OpenSDK 的屏幕适配库会在应用启动时运行此 Provider，为使用该库的页面初始化尺寸适配。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖 YXT 尺寸适配的页面可能出现缩放或排版不正确。

en.description: YXT Photo Viewer SDK opens this screen after it receives an image and crop settings. It lets the user crop the picture and returns the saved result.
en.disableEffect: An app flow that uses YXT's crop screen cannot finish cropping the selected picture.

zh-CN.description: YXT Photo Viewer SDK 收到待裁剪图片和裁剪参数后会打开此页面；用户完成裁剪后，页面会返回保存的图片。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用 YXT 裁剪页面的应用流程将无法完成图片裁剪。

en.description: YXT Live opens this profile screen to load a user's live-service profile and let them change their picture, name, nickname, phone number, or introduction.
en.disableEffect: Users may lose access to profile updates and logout controls in YXT Live.

zh-CN.description: YXT Live 会打开此个人资料页面加载用户信息，并允许用户修改头像、姓名、昵称、手机号或个人简介。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户可能无法在 YXT Live 中修改资料或使用退出登录功能。

en.description: YXT Live uses this screen when the user taps one of its notifications; it opens the app if needed and then closes.
en.disableEffect: Tapping YXT Live notifications may no longer open the app; the app can still be opened from its icon.

zh-CN.description: 用户点按 YXT Live 通知时会进入此页面；如果应用尚未打开，它会启动应用，然后立即关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 点按 YXT Live 通知可能无法打开应用，但仍可从应用图标启动应用。

en.description: YXT Live opens this player when a user enters a live room; it plays the stream and provides chat, questions, gifts, and other viewer interactions.
en.disableEffect: Users may be unable to watch or interact with live sessions provided through YXT Live.

zh-CN.description: 用户进入直播间时，YXT Live 会打开此播放页面，播放直播内容并提供聊天、提问、礼物等互动功能。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户可能无法观看或参与 YXT Live 提供的直播。
