en.description: YXT Live shows this waiting page before a live session is ready; it can route the user into the live room or to required profile checks and forms.
en.disableEffect: Users may be unable to wait for or enter a live session through this flow.

zh-CN.description: 直播尚未就绪时，YXT Live 会显示此等待页面；页面可带用户进入直播间，或前往所需的资料核验和填写页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户可能无法通过此流程等待或进入直播。

en.description: YXT Live opens a supplied web link in this in-app browser and lets the user go back through the page or close it.
en.disableEffect: Web pages opened from YXT Live flows may fail to display.

zh-CN.description: YXT Live 会在应用内浏览器中打开指定网页，并允许用户返回上一页或关闭页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: YXT Live 流程中打开的网页可能无法显示。

en.description: YXT Live's room-login screen asks the user for a room code, nickname, and password before joining a live room, and links to the user agreement.
en.disableEffect: Users may be unable to sign in to live rooms through YXT Live.

zh-CN.description: YXT Live 的直播间登录页面会在进入直播间前要求用户填写房间号、昵称和密码，并提供用户协议入口。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户可能无法通过 YXT Live 登录直播间。

en.description: YXT Live's registration and account-binding screen verifies a phone number with a code and supports the SDK's sign-in flow.
en.disableEffect: Users may be unable to register or bind an account needed for YXT Live.

zh-CN.description: YXT Live 的注册和账号绑定页面会通过验证码核验手机号，并支持 SDK 的登录流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户可能无法注册或绑定 YXT Live 所需的账号。

en.description: YXT Live displays its user-agreement web page when the user opens the agreement link from a live sign-in screen.
en.disableEffect: Users may be unable to review the agreement required by YXT Live's sign-in flow.

zh-CN.description: 用户从 YXT Live 登录页面打开协议入口时，SDK 会在此页面显示用户协议网页。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户可能无法查看 YXT Live 登录流程所需的用户协议。

en.description: YXT Live opens this verification screen during live entry when the user must confirm profile details such as their name and password.
en.disableEffect: A live session that requires this check may not let the user continue.

zh-CN.description: 直播流程要求核验资料时，YXT Live 会打开此页面，让用户确认姓名、密码等信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要此项核验的直播流程可能无法继续。

en.description: YXT Live displays a form when a live session requires additional profile details, then checks and submits the requested information.
en.disableEffect: Users may be unable to provide details required before entering a live session.

zh-CN.description: 直播流程要求补充资料时，YXT Live 会显示表单，并检查和提交所需信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户可能无法填写进入直播前所需的资料。

en.description: YXT OpenSDK's network-state helper responds to Android connectivity changes and reports whether the device is on Wi-Fi, mobile data, or offline.
en.disableEffect: YXT features that react to network changes may stop receiving current connection status and fail to recover cleanly after a network switch.

zh-CN.description: YXT OpenSDK 的网络状态组件会在 Android 网络连接变化时更新状态，并报告当前使用 Wi-Fi、移动网络还是处于断网状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖网络状态变化的 YXT 功能可能收不到最新状态，切换网络后也可能无法正常恢复。

en.description: YXT's network-state service listens for connection changes and notifies SDK listeners when Wi-Fi, mobile data, or offline status changes.
en.disableEffect: YXT features that depend on connection updates may not respond properly when the network changes.

zh-CN.description: YXT 网络状态服务会监听连接变化，并在 Wi-Fi、移动网络或断网状态改变时通知 SDK 监听者。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖网络状态更新的 YXT 功能在网络变化时可能无法正常响应。

en.description: YXT Photo Viewer SDK opens this editor after the user picks or takes a photo when editing is enabled. It lets the user crop, rotate, preview, and return edited images.
en.disableEffect: The app's photo-editing flow cannot return an edited image.

zh-CN.description: 启用照片编辑后，YXT Photo Viewer SDK 会在用户选取或拍摄照片时打开此编辑页面；用户可裁剪、旋转、预览并返回处理后的图片。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用的照片编辑流程将无法返回处理后的图片。

en.description: YXT OpenSDK's photo gallery opens this screen to preview selected pictures stored on the device, move between them, change the selection, or open the editor.
en.disableEffect: The local photo preview and selection flow may fail or close unexpectedly.

zh-CN.description: YXT OpenSDK 的图片库会在用户预览本机所选照片时打开此页面，支持切换照片、调整选择并进入编辑。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 本地照片预览和选择流程可能失败或意外关闭。

en.description: YXT OpenSDK's photo gallery opens this screen when the app asks to preview a list of image links, letting the user view and swipe between those pictures.
en.disableEffect: Image previews opened through YXT's gallery may no longer work.

zh-CN.description: YXT OpenSDK 的图片库会在应用要求预览一组图片链接时打开此页面，用户可以查看图片并左右切换。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过 YXT 图片库打开的图片预览可能无法使用。

en.description: YXT OpenSDK opens this gallery when the app asks the user to choose local pictures or videos; it can also launch the camera and preview selected media.
en.disableEffect: Screens that ask users to select or capture media through YXT may stop working.

zh-CN.description: 应用要求用户选择本地照片或视频时，YXT OpenSDK 会打开此相册页面；用户也可以从这里启动相机并预览所选媒体。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过 YXT 选择或拍摄媒体的页面可能无法正常使用。

en.description: YXT's photo library includes this test screen, which only displays a camera-item layout and has no normal photo-selection or editing flow.
en.disableEffect: Normal app features are unaffected; only this test screen will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: YXT 图片库中的测试页面只显示相机列表项布局，没有正常的照片选择或编辑流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用的正常功能不受影响，只有此测试页面无法打开。

en.description: YXT OpenSDK opens this screen after the user chooses a local video, plays a preview, and returns the clip when the user confirms it.
en.disableEffect: Users may be unable to preview and select local videos in YXT media flows.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择本地视频后，YXT OpenSDK 会打开此页面播放预览，并在用户确认时把视频返回给调用页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户可能无法在 YXT 媒体流程中预览和选择本地视频。

en.description: YXT OpenSDK opens this camera screen when the app asks the user to take a picture; it requests camera access, saves the capture, and can pass it to the image editor.
en.disableEffect: Photo-capture flows that use YXT's camera may fail.

zh-CN.description: 应用要求用户拍照时，YXT OpenSDK 会打开此相机页面并请求相机权限；拍摄的照片会保存，也可以继续交给图片编辑器处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用 YXT 相机的拍照流程可能失败。

en.description: YXT OpenSDK opens this image editor for a chosen picture so the user can draw, erase, crop, and save an edited copy.
en.disableEffect: Photo-editing flows that use YXT's drawing screen may fail or lose their editing step.

zh-CN.description: YXT OpenSDK 会为用户选定的照片打开此编辑页面，供用户涂画、擦除、裁剪并保存编辑后的图片。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用 YXT 涂画页面的照片编辑流程可能失败或无法完成编辑。

en.description: YXT's photo editor opens this crop screen while editing a marked-up picture so the user can adjust the crop and return the result to the editor.
en.disableEffect: Cropping a picture inside YXT's drawing editor may fail.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 YXT 涂画编辑器中裁剪图片时，编辑器会打开此页面调整裁剪范围，再把结果返回编辑器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 在 YXT 涂画编辑器中裁剪图片可能失败。

en.description: YXT OpenSDK opens this photo-cropping screen for an image supplied by the app; users can zoom, rotate, choose a crop shape, and save the result.
en.disableEffect: Photo-cropping flows that use YXT's crop screen may fail.

zh-CN.description: 应用交付待裁剪的图片时，YXT OpenSDK 会打开此裁剪页面；用户可以缩放、旋转、选择裁剪比例并保存结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用 YXT 裁剪页面的照片处理流程可能失败。

en.description: YXT's UI library opens a titled list when an app screen asks the user to choose one item from a set, then returns the selected item.
en.disableEffect: App flows that use this YXT choice list may no longer let users select an option.

zh-CN.description: 应用页面要求用户从一组选项中选择一项时，YXT UI 库会显示带标题的列表，并把选择结果返回。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此 YXT 选项列表的流程可能无法让用户完成选择。

en.description: YXT ATool SDK opens this screen when the app requests an upgrade prompt for an available build. It shows the release information and lets the user skip or download and install the update.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot present or complete this in-app upgrade flow.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求显示可用版本的升级提示时，YXT ATool SDK 会打开此页面；页面展示更新说明，并提供跳过或下载和安装更新的选项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法显示或完成此应用内升级流程。

en.description: YXT's utility library uses this file provider to give app screens content links to files in configured app folders when they need to open or share them.
en.disableEffect: File-opening or sharing flows that use YXT's provider may fail.

zh-CN.description: YXT 工具库的文件提供器会在页面需要打开或分享应用目录中的文件时生成内容链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用 YXT 文件提供器的文件打开或分享流程可能失败。

en.description: The YZQ Logger SDK uses this Activity as an in-app diagnostic screen for collected log messages, with search and severity or tag filters. Users can also clear the displayed log history.
en.disableEffect: The app's in-app log viewer will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: YZQ Logger SDK 用这个界面显示应用收集的日志，并提供搜索、按级别或标签筛选以及清除日志的操作。这是应用内的诊断日志页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用内的日志查看页面将无法打开。

en.description: AndroidX's file provider lets an app expose configured internal or external files through controlled content links when a file needs to be opened or shared with another app.
en.disableEffect: File opening or sharing that relies on these content links may stop working.

zh-CN.description: AndroidX 文件提供器会在需要打开或分享文件时，通过受控的内容链接向其他应用提供已配置的内部或外部文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，依赖这些内容链接的文件打开或分享功能可能无法使用。

en.description: Zamplia Survey opens the selected questionnaire in a web page and returns its completion, exit, or availability status to the app.
en.disableEffect: Users may be unable to complete surveys offered through Zamplia.

zh-CN.description: Zamplia Survey 会在网页中打开用户选择的问卷，并把完成、退出或名额状态返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户可能无法完成 Zamplia 提供的问卷。

en.description: Zamplia Survey loads the available questionnaires for the user and opens the selected survey.
en.disableEffect: Users may lose access to the Zamplia survey list and the surveys it launches.

zh-CN.description: Zamplia Survey 会加载可供用户参加的问卷列表，并打开用户选中的问卷。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户可能无法查看 Zamplia 问卷列表或打开其中的问卷。

en.description: Zapic's Android game platform opens this Activity when a game launches one of its pages; it shows the page inside the game and lets the page select a photo or take one with the camera.
en.disableEffect: Zapic pages and game features delivered through those pages will not open.

zh-CN.description: 游戏打开 Zapic 平台页面时会启动此 Activity；它在游戏内显示页面，并允许页面选择照片或调用相机拍摄。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Zapic 页面及通过这些页面提供的游戏功能将无法打开。

en.description: ZarinPal's payment SDK opens this Activity when an app starts a purchase or a payment result returns, showing the payment sheet and passing the result back to the app.
en.disableEffect: Purchases that use ZarinPal may not start or return their result to the app correctly.

zh-CN.description: 应用发起购买或收到支付结果时，ZarinPal 支付 SDK 会打开此 Activity，显示付款页面并把结果交回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用 ZarinPal 的购买流程可能无法启动，或无法将支付结果交回应用。

en.description: ZarinPal's payment core starts this Provider with the app process and makes the app context available to payment requests, network calls, and error handling.
en.disableEffect: ZarinPal payment requests may fail because the payment core cannot access the app context.

zh-CN.description: 应用进程启动时，ZarinPal 支付核心会运行此 Provider，为支付请求、网络通信和错误处理提供应用上下文。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 支付核心无法取得应用上下文，ZarinPal 支付请求可能会失败。

en.description: When the user returns through a ZarinPal mobile-payment link, this Activity opens the card-payment screen and handles card-number and one-time-code steps for that transaction.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot complete card payments through ZarinPal's mobile gateway.

zh-CN.description: 用户通过 ZarinPal 移动支付链接返回时，此 Activity 会打开银行卡付款页面，并处理卡号和一次性验证码。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 ZarinPal 移动网关完成银行卡付款。

en.description: When ZEGO UIKit creates a ZIP of its log files for sharing, this provider creates the content link used by Android's share sheet.
en.disableEffect: Sharing ZEGO UIKit log files may fail when the SDK tries to create a link for the share sheet.

zh-CN.description: ZEGO UIKit 创建日志压缩包供用户分享时，此 Provider 会生成 Android 分享面板使用的内容链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，SDK 创建分享链接时可能失败，用户可能无法分享 ZEGO UIKit 日志。

en.description: When ZEGO's ZPNs signaling plugin broadcasts a message, notification, or registration update, this Receiver receives the event. This release adds no visible action to those events.
en.disableEffect: Blocking it removes this ZEGO push-event hook; no visible screen or action in this release depends on it.

zh-CN.description: ZEGO ZPNs 信令插件广播消息、通知或注册状态更新时，此 Receiver 会接收这些事件。此版本的实现不会对用户显示页面或执行可见操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后会移除此 ZEGO 推送事件入口；此版本没有依赖它的可见页面或操作。

en.description: Zendrive's Huawei add-on receives activity-recognition updates from Huawei services, converts them into movement events, and passes them to Zendrive's driving tracker.
en.disableEffect: Zendrive may miss movement changes used to identify drives on Huawei devices.

zh-CN.description: Zendrive 华为扩展接收华为服务的活动识别更新，将其转换为移动事件并交给 Zendrive 行车跟踪功能。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Zendrive 可能会漏掉华为设备上用于识别行程的移动状态变化。

en.description: In older Zendrive Huawei integrations, this Receiver converts Huawei activity-recognition updates into movement events for Zendrive's driving tracker.
en.disableEffect: Zendrive may miss movement changes used to identify drives on Huawei devices.

zh-CN.description: 在较早的 Zendrive 华为集成中，此 Receiver 会把华为活动识别更新转换为移动事件，交给 Zendrive 行车跟踪功能。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Zendrive 可能会漏掉华为设备上用于识别行程的移动状态变化。

en.description: In older Zendrive Huawei integrations, this Receiver forwards Huawei geofence entry, exit, or dwell events and their location to Zendrive's trip tracker.
en.disableEffect: Automatic trip detection based on Huawei geofences and the related location records will stop.

zh-CN.description: 在较早的 Zendrive 华为集成中，此 Receiver 会把华为地理围栏的进入、离开或停留事件及位置交给 Zendrive 行程跟踪功能。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 基于华为地理围栏的自动行程检测和相关位置记录将停止。

en.description: When Zendrive's Bluetooth beacon scan detects a signal from a nearby vehicle, this Receiver records the signal and can start a possible drive.
en.disableEffect: Zendrive may miss drives detected from in-vehicle beacons, making automatic drive detection incomplete.

zh-CN.description: Zendrive 的蓝牙信标扫描发现附近车辆的信号时，此 Receiver 会记录该信号，并可据此开始检测可能的行程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Zendrive 可能会漏掉通过车载信标识别的行程，导致自动行程检测不完整。

en.description: Android sends this Receiver Bluetooth connection and disconnection events; Zendrive matches connected devices with saved vehicles and uses them to identify drives.
en.disableEffect: Automatic drive detection may miss trips associated with a paired vehicle.

zh-CN.description: Android 发送蓝牙连接或断开事件时会触发此 Receiver；Zendrive 会将设备与已保存的车辆匹配，用于识别行程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 自动行程检测可能会漏掉与已配对车辆相关的行程。

en.description: When Google or Huawei location services reports a geofence crossing, Zendrive records the event and location and may use it to start or update a drive.
en.disableEffect: Geofence-based drive detection and the related location records will be lost.

zh-CN.description: Google 或华为定位服务报告地理围栏边界变化时，Zendrive 会记录事件和位置，并可能据此开始或更新行程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 基于地理围栏的行程检测及相关位置记录将失效。

en.description: When the Huawei add-on forwards a recognized movement event, Zendrive stores the activity and checks whether it indicates a possible drive.
en.disableEffect: Zendrive may miss or misclassify drives that depend on Huawei activity recognition.

zh-CN.description: 华为扩展转发已识别的移动事件时，Zendrive 会保存活动状态并判断是否可能正在行车。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖华为活动识别的行程可能被漏掉或判断错误。

en.description: In older Zendrive integrations, this Receiver handles geofence events forwarded by Huawei services, records the location, and can start automatic trip detection.
en.disableEffect: Huawei geofence-based trip detection and its location records will stop.

zh-CN.description: 在较早的 Zendrive 集成中，此 Receiver 会处理华为服务转发的地理围栏事件、记录位置，并可启动自动行程检测。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 基于华为地理围栏的行程检测及其位置记录将停止。

en.description: When Zendrive receives a fresh low-power location update, this Receiver checks movement and speed changes and can start automatic trip detection.
en.disableEffect: Zendrive's low-power fallback may stop detecting drives when other movement signals are unavailable.

zh-CN.description: Zendrive 收到新的低功耗位置更新时，此 Receiver 会检查移动和速度变化，并可启动自动行程检测。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 其他移动信号不可用时，Zendrive 的低功耗备用检测可能无法识别行程。

en.description: When Zendrive's annual setup alarm fires, this Receiver schedules the next alarm so the periodic maintenance check can run again.
en.disableEffect: Zendrive will no longer re-arm this annual maintenance alarm, so later setup refreshes may not run automatically.

zh-CN.description: Zendrive 的年度设置闹钟触发时，此 Receiver 会安排下一次闹钟，以便再次运行周期性维护检查。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Zendrive 将不再重新安排此年度维护闹钟，之后的设置刷新可能不会自动运行。

en.description: When Google activity recognition reports movement such as walking or vehicle travel, Zendrive stores the activity and uses it to detect whether a drive has begun.
en.disableEffect: Zendrive may miss or misclassify drives that depend on activity recognition.

zh-CN.description: Google 活动识别报告步行或乘车等移动状态时，Zendrive 会保存该状态并据此判断行程是否开始。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖活动识别的行程可能被漏掉或判断错误。

en.description: When Zendrive's periodic background alarm fires, this Receiver checks trip-monitoring state and schedules another wake-up so automatic drive detection can continue.
en.disableEffect: Zendrive's background trip monitoring may not resume or stay active reliably.

zh-CN.description: Zendrive 的周期性后台闹钟触发时，此 Receiver 会检查行程监测状态并安排下一次唤醒，以便继续自动检测行程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Zendrive 的后台行程监测可能无法可靠恢复或持续运行。

en.description: When Android reports that the app was updated, this Receiver checks Zendrive's saved setup and restores its connections or restarts trip monitoring when needed.
en.disableEffect: After an app update, Zendrive may keep an outdated setup and fail to resume drive monitoring.

zh-CN.description: Android 报告应用更新后，此 Receiver 会检查 Zendrive 保存的设置，并在需要时恢复连接或重新启动行程监测。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用更新后，Zendrive 可能仍使用旧设置，无法恢复行车监测。

en.description: When Zendrive sends recorded driving files, this Service keeps the upload in the foreground with the SDK notification while the upload task runs.
en.disableEffect: Recorded driving data may fail to upload or finish sending.

zh-CN.description: Zendrive 发送已记录的行车文件时，此 Service 会在前台显示 SDK 通知并维持上传任务运行。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 已记录的行车数据可能无法上传或发送完成。

en.description: Zendrive runs this foreground Service while it monitors a possible or active drive, updates trip status, and continues location tracking.
en.disableEffect: Automatic drive detection and recording of active trips may stop.

zh-CN.description: Zendrive 监测可能或正在进行的行程、更新行程状态并持续定位时，会运行此前台 Service。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 自动行程检测和正在进行的行程记录可能停止。

en.description: During Zendrive's background startup, this Service coordinates the driving monitor's setup so the SDK can continue initializing its trip tracking.
en.disableEffect: Zendrive's driving monitor may fail to start or finish its background setup.

zh-CN.description: Zendrive 在后台启动时会使用此 Service 协调行车监测的设置，使 SDK 能继续初始化行程跟踪。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Zendrive 的行车监测可能无法启动或完成后台设置。

en.description: Zendrive starts this Provider with the app process and makes the app context available to its trip-tracking and background services.
en.disableEffect: Zendrive's tracking and upload work may fail to initialize without the app context.

zh-CN.description: 应用进程启动时，Zendrive 会运行此 Provider，为行程跟踪和后台服务提供应用上下文。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 缺少应用上下文时，Zendrive 的跟踪和上传任务可能无法初始化。

en.description: Older releases of AnyLife DownloadInstaller use this provider when passing a downloaded app package to Android's installer. It gives the installer access to the downloaded file.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it can prevent a downloaded app from opening in Android's installer.

zh-CN.description: AnyLife DownloadInstaller 的旧版本在将下载的应用安装包交给 Android 安装程序时使用此提供程序，让安装程序能够读取下载文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，下载的应用可能无法在 Android 安装程序中打开。

en.description: ZeoFlow Flow Kit starts this Service when the user chooses a crash-report notification action; it can remove the saved report or open a share sheet with the log and device details.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to remove or share a crash report from its notification; normal app features are unaffected.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击崩溃报告通知操作时，ZeoFlow Flow Kit 会启动此 Service；它可删除已保存的报告，或打开分享菜单并附上日志和设备信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过通知删除或分享崩溃报告；应用的常规功能不受影响。

en.description: ZeoFlow Flow Kit opens this screen when the user reviews saved crash reports; it lists crashes and exceptions and lets the user clear the logs.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to browse or clear saved crash and exception reports in this screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户查看已保存的崩溃报告时，ZeoFlow Flow Kit 会打开此页面；页面列出崩溃和异常记录，并允许清除日志。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在此页面查看或清除已保存的崩溃和异常报告。

en.description: ZeoFlow Flow Kit opens a selected crash report here to show its log text and device details and let the user remove it.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to open or remove an individual crash report through this screen.

zh-CN.description: ZeoFlow Flow Kit 会在此页面打开选中的崩溃报告，显示日志和设备信息，并允许用户删除报告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此页面打开或删除单条崩溃报告。

en.description: When the same ZeoFlow Depot database is opened in multiple app processes, this Service tells the other processes when database tables change.
en.disableEffect: Data shown in another process may remain out of date after a database change.

zh-CN.description: 同一个 ZeoFlow Depot 数据库在多个应用进程中打开时，此 Service 会在数据表变化后通知其他进程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 数据库发生变化后，其他进程中显示的数据可能不会及时更新。

en.description: At app startup, ZeoFlow Depot's preference dispatcher initializes the shared app context used by its saved-preference features.
en.disableEffect: Preference features that rely on this dispatcher may fail to access saved settings.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，ZeoFlow Depot 偏好设置分发库会初始化其已保存设置功能所需的共享应用上下文。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此分发库的偏好设置功能可能无法读取已保存的设置。

en.description: The older ZeoFlow Flow Kit crash-report screen lists saved crashes and exceptions and lets the user clear the stored logs.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to review or clear saved crash and exception reports in this screen.

zh-CN.description: 较早版本的 ZeoFlow Flow Kit 崩溃报告页面会列出已保存的崩溃和异常记录，并允许清除日志。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在此页面查看或清除已保存的崩溃和异常报告。

en.description: The older ZeoFlow Flow Kit log screen displays a selected crash report and app details and provides actions to delete or share it.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to open, delete, or share an individual crash report from this screen.

zh-CN.description: 较早版本的 ZeoFlow Flow Kit 日志页面会显示选中的崩溃报告和应用信息，并提供删除或分享操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此页面打开、删除或分享单条崩溃报告。

en.description: At app startup, the older ZeoFlow Flow Kit provider initializes the library and registers its handler for saving uncaught errors as crash reports.
en.disableEffect: Flow Kit may stop capturing crash reports, and its features that need the app context may fail.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，较早版本的 ZeoFlow Flow Kit Provider 会初始化库，并注册用于保存未捕获错误的崩溃处理程序。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Flow Kit 可能不再捕获崩溃报告，依赖应用上下文的功能也可能失败。

en.description: At app startup, ZeoFlow Flow Kit initializes the shared app context used by its screens, logging, and crash-report tools.
en.disableEffect: Flow Kit screens and utilities that need this app context may fail when opened.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，ZeoFlow Flow Kit 会初始化共享应用上下文，供其页面、日志和崩溃报告工具使用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 打开依赖此应用上下文的 Flow Kit 页面或工具时，它们可能会失败。

en.description: At app startup, ZeoFlow Memo initializes its key-value storage library and the app context it uses to read and save values.
en.disableEffect: App settings or saved values that rely on ZeoFlow Memo may stop working.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，ZeoFlow Memo 会初始化键值存储库及其读取和保存数据所需的应用上下文。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖 ZeoFlow Memo 的应用设置或已保存数据可能无法使用。

en.description: At app startup, ZeoFlow StartUp finds initialization steps registered by the app and its libraries and runs them.
en.disableEffect: Libraries that depend on automatic startup may not initialize, so their features can be unavailable or fail.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，ZeoFlow StartUp 会查找应用及其库注册的初始化步骤并运行它们。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖自动启动的库可能无法初始化，其功能可能不可用或运行失败。

en.description: ZetaPush (InsurlyTech Android client) opens an authenticated connection when the app requests ZetaPush messaging or services. It reports connection status to the app and keeps the session credentials used by that connection.
en.disableEffect: Apps that rely on this connection may lose live messages and other ZetaPush features.

zh-CN.description: ZetaPush（InsurlyTech Android 客户端）会在应用请求 ZetaPush 消息或服务时建立经过身份验证的连接。它会向应用报告连接状态，并保存连接所用的会话凭据。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此连接的应用可能无法接收实时消息或使用其他 ZetaPush 功能。

en.description: When Mint mediation shows an interstitial ad, this Activity opens the ad's full-screen web creative and handles its close controls.
en.disableEffect: Mint interstitial ads will not open, while the app's own screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: Mint 聚合广告展示插屏广告时，此 Activity 会全屏打开广告网页内容，并处理关闭控件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Mint 插屏广告将无法打开，但应用自身的界面仍可使用。

en.description: When Mint plays a video ad, this Activity moves its player into a full-screen window and manages playback as the user opens, pauses, or closes it.
en.disableEffect: Mint video ads will not play in the app.

zh-CN.description: Mint 播放视频广告时，此 Activity 会将播放器放入全屏窗口，并在用户打开、暂停或关闭广告时管理播放。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用中的 Mint 视频广告将无法播放。

en.description: When the Mint mediation adapter displays a web ad, this Activity loads the ad page in a full-screen browser view and shows a skip control after a delay.
en.disableEffect: Mint web ads cannot open in this full-screen view.

zh-CN.description: Mint 聚合适配器展示网页广告时，此 Activity 会在全屏浏览界面加载广告页面，并在延迟后显示跳过控件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Mint 网页广告将无法在此全屏界面中打开。

en.description: When Mint mediation shows a splash placement, this Activity displays a native ad with its title, icon, media, description, and call-to-action.
en.disableEffect: Mint splash ads will not appear when the SDK displays that placement.

zh-CN.description: Mint 聚合广告展示开屏广告位时，此 Activity 会显示原生广告的标题、图标、媒体内容、说明和行动按钮。
zh-CN.disableEffect: SDK 展示该广告位时，Mint 开屏广告将不会出现。

en.description: Android creates this Mint mediation provider when the app starts. It initializes the SDK automatically or supplies the app context and lifecycle callbacks when manual initialization is enabled.
en.disableEffect: Mint mediation ads may not initialize or follow the app's foreground and background state.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，Android 会创建此 Mint 聚合广告 Provider。自动初始化模式下它会初始化 SDK；手动初始化模式下则提供应用上下文并注册生命周期回调。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Mint 聚合广告可能无法初始化，也可能无法跟踪应用的前后台状态。

en.description: Mint's built-in ad test suite opens this screen for a selected placement or adapter and displays its ad type, identifier, and available instances.
en.disableEffect: The Mint ad test suite will not be able to open this instance detail screen.

zh-CN.description: Mint 内置广告测试套件会为选定的广告位或适配器打开此界面，并显示广告类型、标识和可用实例。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Mint 广告测试套件将无法打开此实例详情界面。

en.description: Mint's built-in ad test suite opens this home screen to list ad placements and network adapters; it can initialize Mint in debug mode for testing.
en.disableEffect: Mint's placement and adapter test screens will not be available.

zh-CN.description: Mint 内置广告测试套件会在此主页列出广告位和广告网络适配器，也可在调试模式下初始化 Mint 以供测试。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Mint 的广告位和适配器测试界面将无法使用。

en.description: When a user taps a Mint ad with a redirect, this Activity shows a loading screen, resolves the ad's destination, and hands it off to the relevant app or store page.
en.disableEffect: Tapping some Mint ads may no longer open the advertised app or store page.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击带跳转链接的 Mint 广告时，此 Activity 会显示加载界面、解析广告目的地，并转到相应应用或商店页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 点击部分 Mint 广告后，可能无法打开广告指向的应用或商店页面。

en.description: The m942890653 main-general utility library makes a local file available to other apps through a shareable content link and grants them permission to read it.
en.disableEffect: File-sharing flows that use these links may fail to open or pass the file to another app.

zh-CN.description: m942890653 的 main-general 工具库会为本地文件创建可分享的内容链接，并授权其他应用读取该文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用这些链接的文件分享流程可能无法打开文件或将文件交给其他应用。

en.description: The Chat SDK-bundled Matisse picker opens this screen when a user previews an item from a photo album. It shows the album's media full-screen and returns the user's selection to the picker.
en.disableEffect: Gallery selection can fail when the picker tries to open an album preview.

zh-CN.description: 用户预览相册中的媒体时，Chat SDK 内置的 Matisse 选择器会打开此界面。它会全屏显示相册内容，并将用户的选择返回给选择器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 选择器尝试打开相册预览时可能会失败，导致无法完成媒体选择。

en.description: The Chat SDK-bundled Matisse picker opens this screen to review items the user has already selected. It shows the selected media full-screen and returns any changes to the picker.
en.disableEffect: The picker cannot open its selected-item review screen, so users may be unable to finish that media-selection flow.

zh-CN.description: 用户查看已选媒体时，Chat SDK 内置的 Matisse 选择器会打开此界面。它会全屏显示已选内容，并将用户的修改返回给选择器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 选择器无法打开已选媒体的预览界面，用户可能无法完成该媒体选择流程。

en.description: Wind Gallery opens this tiny handoff screen after the user selects images, then returns the selected image links and file paths to the calling screen.
en.disableEffect: The image picker may be unable to return selected photos, breaking screens that attach images through Wind Gallery.

zh-CN.description: 用户选好图片后，Wind Gallery 会短暂打开这个小型中转页面，再把所选图片的链接和文件路径交还给调用页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Wind Gallery 可能无法把选中的照片交回应用，依赖图片附件的页面会受影响。

en.description: The Chat SDK-bundled Matisse picker opens when the app asks the user to choose media. It lists device albums, manages photo or video selections, and can launch the camera when capture is enabled.
en.disableEffect: Any app flow that uses this picker to choose chat or profile media stops working.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求用户选择媒体时，Chat SDK 内置的 Matisse 选择器会打开。它会列出设备相册、管理图片或视频选择，并可在启用拍摄功能时打开相机。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此选择器挑选聊天或个人资料媒体的应用流程会停止工作。

en.description: The zhjl37 Permissions library opens this screen after a permission is denied, explains why it is needed, and lets the user open the app's settings or cancel.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot follow this recovery flow to enable a denied permission, so features needing it may remain unavailable.

zh-CN.description: 权限被拒绝后，zhjl37 Permissions 库会打开此页面说明原因，并允许用户前往应用设置或取消。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法通过此流程启用被拒绝的权限，因此需要该权限的功能可能仍不可用。

en.description: Henry Zhu Dev's lib_download receiver responds when Android reports a download completion or notification click; it checks the download, reports its status, and opens the installer for APK downloads marked for installation.
en.disableEffect: Download completion notices and this library's automatic APK installation prompt stop working.

zh-CN.description: Android 通知下载完成或用户点击下载通知时，Henry Zhu Dev 的 lib_download 接收器会检查下载状态、显示结果，并为设为需安装的 APK 打开安装程序。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，下载完成提示以及此库自动打开 APK 安装程序的功能将无法使用。

en.description: Rewarded video advertisement.

zh-CN.description: 激励视频广告。

en.description: Rewarded video advertisement.

zh-CN.description: 激励视频广告。

en.description: The zhsoft88 TestCrosswalkEmbed2 launcher opens zhuatang.com in its built-in browser when the app starts.
en.disableEffect: The app loses its launcher screen and embedded website.

zh-CN.description: zhsoft88 TestCrosswalkEmbed2 的启动页面会在应用打开时通过内置浏览器显示 zhuatang.com。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将失去启动页面及其中的内嵌网站。

en.description: When a ZhugeIO visual-analysis link is opened, this Activity starts the SDK’s visual event analysis and then closes.
en.disableEffect: The visual analytics session will not start; ordinary app use remains available.

zh-CN.description: 打开 ZhugeIO 可视化分析链接时，此 Activity 会启动 SDK 的可视化事件分析，然后自动关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 可视化分析会话将无法启动，但应用的普通功能仍可使用。

en.description: The ZhuSx core library uses this Provider when it shares a file or hands an APK or image to another app, creating a content link the other app can read. It runs when one of those file actions starts.
en.disableEffect: File sharing, image handoff, or giving a downloaded APK to the installer may fail.

zh-CN.description: ZhuSx core 库在分享文件，或把 APK、图片等文件交给其他应用时使用此 Provider，为接收方生成可读取的内容链接；触发这类文件操作时才会运行。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 文件分享、图片传递或将已下载的 APK 交给安装程序可能会失败。

en.description: The ZhuSx Show utility library opens this Activity for its file and diagnostics screens, including browsing files and viewing logs, archives, text, XML, or video. It starts when a user opens one of those tools.
en.disableEffect: Those ZhuSx Show utility screens will not open, while the app's regular screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 ZhuSx Show 工具中的文件或诊断页面时，此 Activity 会显示对应内容，包括浏览文件、查看日志和压缩包，以及打开文本、XML 或视频。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 这些 ZhuSx Show 工具页面将无法打开，但应用的常规页面仍可使用。

en.description: The Android 7 FileProvider compatibility library gives another app temporary access to files the app chooses to share.
en.disableEffect: File attachments and other handoffs that use this provider may fail.

zh-CN.description: Android 7 FileProvider 兼容库会为接收文件的其他应用提供临时访问权限。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此提供程序的文件附件或其他文件传递可能失败。

en.description: When Ziggeo's video SDK queues usage events, this background service sends them to Ziggeo for analytics.
en.disableEffect: Ziggeo will stop receiving this app's usage analytics.

zh-CN.description: Ziggeo 视频 SDK 收集到使用事件后，会通过此后台服务将事件发送给 Ziggeo 做分析。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Ziggeo 将不再收到此应用的使用分析事件。

en.description: When Ziggeo's video SDK records crash details, this background service sends them to Ziggeo's crash-tracking service.
en.disableEffect: Ziggeo will no longer receive crash details from this app.

zh-CN.description: Ziggeo 视频 SDK 记录崩溃信息后，会通过此后台服务将信息发送给 Ziggeo。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Ziggeo 将不再收到此应用的崩溃信息。

en.description: When the app asks Ziggeo to import local media, this screen lets the user choose a file and returns it to the SDK.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot select a local file for a Ziggeo upload or playback flow.

zh-CN.description: 应用通过 Ziggeo 导入本地媒体时，此界面让用户选择文件并将文件交给 SDK。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在 Ziggeo 上传或播放流程中选择本地文件。

en.description: When Ziggeo has a recording ready to upload, this foreground service sends it and shows upload and processing progress.
en.disableEffect: Ziggeo recordings will not complete their upload or processing.

zh-CN.description: Ziggeo 有录制内容需要上传时，此前台服务负责发送内容，并显示上传和处理进度。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Ziggeo 录制内容将无法完成上传或处理。

en.description: When a user starts screen capture or live streaming through Ziggeo, this foreground service captures the screen and manages the recording session.
en.disableEffect: The app's Ziggeo screen-recording and live-streaming flows stop working.

zh-CN.description: 用户通过 Ziggeo 开始录屏或直播时，此前台服务负责捕获屏幕并管理录制过程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用中的 Ziggeo 录屏和直播流程将无法使用。

en.description: When a user opens Ziggeo's audio recorder, this screen records a clip and provides controls to review or play it.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot record or review audio clips through Ziggeo.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 Ziggeo 录音功能时，此界面录制音频片段，并提供试听和回放控制。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 Ziggeo 录制或试听音频片段。

en.description: When a user starts a Ziggeo video or image capture, this screen checks camera access and opens the camera controls.
en.disableEffect: Ziggeo camera recording and image capture stop working.

zh-CN.description: 用户通过 Ziggeo 开始录制视频或拍摄图片时，此界面检查相机权限并打开相机控制界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Ziggeo 的相机录像和拍照功能将无法使用。

en.description: When Ziggeo opens an image by token or local file, this screen displays it for review.
en.disableEffect: Users lose Ziggeo's image-preview screen.

zh-CN.description: Ziggeo 通过内容标识或本地文件打开图片时，此界面会显示图片供用户查看。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法使用 Ziggeo 的图片预览界面。

en.description: When a Ziggeo recording is opened, this screen plays a remote recording or local video.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot play Ziggeo recordings in the app.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 Ziggeo 录制内容时，此界面播放远程录制内容或本地视频。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在应用中播放 Ziggeo 录制内容。

en.description: When a user opens Ziggeo's QR scanner, this screen requests camera access and reads a code with the camera.
en.disableEffect: The app's Ziggeo QR-scanning flow stops working.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 Ziggeo 二维码扫描功能时，此界面请求相机权限并使用相机读取二维码。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用中的 Ziggeo 二维码扫描流程将无法使用。

en.description: When a user starts Ziggeo screen recording, this screen requests Android's screen-capture access and provides recording controls.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot start or control screen recording through Ziggeo.

zh-CN.description: 用户通过 Ziggeo 开始录屏时，此界面请求 Android 的屏幕捕获权限并提供录制控制。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 Ziggeo 开始或控制录屏。

en.description: When a Ziggeo link is opened, this screen routes video-playback links to the player and recording links to the camera or screen recorder.
en.disableEffect: Ziggeo links can no longer open their recording or playback flow.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 Ziggeo 链接时，此界面会将视频播放链接交给播放器，将录制链接交给相机或录屏功能。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Ziggeo 链接将无法打开对应的录制或播放流程。

en.description: When a user edits a Ziggeo clip, this screen previews the video and lets them trim a portion for saving.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot trim and save clips through Ziggeo's video editor.

zh-CN.description: 用户编辑 Ziggeo 视频片段时，此界面预览视频并让用户剪取片段保存。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 Ziggeo 视频编辑器剪辑并保存片段。

en.description: Zalo’s OpenAPI module uses this screen to authorize a share through Zalo and return the result to the calling app.
en.disableEffect: Zalo authorization and any share that requires this result may fail to complete.

zh-CN.description: Zalo OpenAPI 模块会在应用请求通过 Zalo 分享时完成授权，并把结果返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要此授权结果的 Zalo 分享可能无法完成。

en.description: Zalo’s Android SDK shows an in-app sign-in or account-registration page when the user chooses to connect Zalo, then returns the result.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to sign in or register with Zalo through the app.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择关联 Zalo 账号时，Zalo Android SDK 会在应用内显示登录或注册页面，并返回处理结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过该应用登录或注册 Zalo 账号。

en.description: The Zoom Meeting SDK opens this Activity when someone chooses to join meeting audio by phone. It shows the meeting dial-in numbers and details.
en.disableEffect: The in-app phone dial-in screen will not open, so users cannot connect meeting audio by phone through it.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择通过电话接入会议音频时，Zoom Meeting SDK 会打开此页面，并显示会议的拨入号码和相关信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 此页面无法打开，用户将无法通过应用内的电话拨入方式连接会议音频。

en.description: The Zoom Meeting SDK opens this Activity from a live meeting when a user selects meeting preferences, host tools, or audio options. It shows the controls for the selected category.
en.disableEffect: The corresponding in-meeting settings and host controls cannot be opened.

zh-CN.description: 用户在会议中打开会议设置、主持人工具或音频选项时，Zoom Meeting SDK 会显示对应的控制页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开相应的会议设置或主持人控制项。

en.description: The Zoom Meeting SDK uses this Activity to handle in-app navigation requests, including meeting, call, calendar, and chat actions. It opens the Zoom screen requested by the current action.
en.disableEffect: Some Zoom navigation links, notifications, call actions, and chat shortcuts will no longer reach their intended screen.

zh-CN.description: Zoom Meeting SDK 使用此页面处理应用内的导航请求，包括会议、通话、日历和聊天操作，并打开请求对应的 Zoom 页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 部分 Zoom 导航链接、通知、通话操作和聊天快捷入口将无法打开目标页面。

en.description: The Zoom Meeting SDK opens this Activity when a user follows a meeting invitation link or QR code. It checks the link and account state, then continues to the meeting join flow or shows a link error.
en.disableEffect: Meeting links opened inside the app cannot continue through the Zoom join flow.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击会议邀请链接或扫描二维码时，Zoom Meeting SDK 会打开此页面。它检查链接和账户状态，然后继续加入会议或提示链接错误。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用内打开的会议链接将无法继续进入 Zoom 加会流程。

en.description: The Zoom Meeting SDK opens this Activity after a meeting join attempt fails. It shows the failure message and may open a help page supplied for that error.
en.disableEffect: Users may lose the explanation and recovery or help action after a failed meeting join.

zh-CN.description: 加入会议失败后，Zoom Meeting SDK 会打开此页面显示错误信息；某些错误还会提供帮助页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 加入会议失败后，用户可能看不到错误说明以及相应的恢复或帮助入口。

en.description: The Zoom Meeting SDK opens this Activity when a meeting ends or a participant leaves, and for related notices such as recording, time limits, or an expired token. It shows the message or action for that event.
en.disableEffect: Users may not see meeting-end, leave, recording, or session-limit messages and their related actions.

zh-CN.description: 会议结束、参与者离开或出现录制、时长限制、令牌过期等相关事件时，Zoom Meeting SDK 会显示对应的通知或操作页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户可能看不到会议结束、离开、录制或时长限制提示及其相关操作。

en.description: The Zoom Meeting SDK opens this Activity when the user navigates to one of its in-app meeting or conversation pages. It displays the requested page inside the app.
en.disableEffect: Zoom screens that rely on this page will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 Zoom Meeting SDK 的会议或会话页面时，此页面负责显示相应内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此页面打开的 Zoom 界面将无法显示。

en.description: The Zoom Meeting SDK opens this Activity for pages connected to an active meeting, including meeting subgroup conversations. It keeps the meeting information available while that page is open.
en.disableEffect: In-meeting pages that use this screen, including subgroup conversations, will not open correctly.

zh-CN.description: Zoom Meeting SDK 会在打开与当前会议关联的页面（包括分组讨论会话）时使用此页面，并在页面显示期间保留会议相关信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此页面的会议内功能（包括分组讨论会话）将无法正常打开。

en.description: The Zoom Meeting SDK opens this Activity when a meeting poll, its question or results, or the poll list is requested. It displays the available poll content.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot answer meeting polls or review their results in the app.

zh-CN.description: 会议发起投票、查看问题或结果，或打开投票列表时，Zoom Meeting SDK 会显示相应的投票内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在应用中参与会议投票或查看投票结果。

en.description: The Zoom Meeting SDK opens this Activity when a user creates or edits a customized 3D avatar for video. It provides avatar choices and a live preview before the user saves changes.
en.disableEffect: The custom 3D avatar editor will not open.

zh-CN.description: 用户为视频创建或编辑自定义 3D 虚拟形象时，Zoom Meeting SDK 会打开此页面，供用户选择形象、预览并保存更改。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 自定义 3D 虚拟形象编辑器将无法打开。

en.description: The Zoom Meeting SDK opens this Activity from in-meeting camera controls when a participant changes video appearance effects. It displays the available video-effects options.
en.disableEffect: Participants cannot open the in-meeting video-effects controls.

zh-CN.description: 参与者在会议中通过摄像头控制调整画面效果时，Zoom Meeting SDK 会打开此页面并显示可用的视频效果选项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 参与者将无法打开会议中的视频效果控制页面。

en.description: The Zoom Meeting SDK opens this Activity for its standard live meeting screen after a meeting is joined. It displays the meeting and its in-call controls while the session is active.
en.disableEffect: The standard in-meeting screen and its meeting controls will not work.

zh-CN.description: 加入会议后，Zoom Meeting SDK 会打开此页面显示会议内容和通话控制项，并在会议期间保持显示。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 标准会议界面及其会议控制项将无法使用。

en.description: The Zoom Meeting SDK opens this Activity when a user puts an ongoing meeting into picture-in-picture mode. It keeps the meeting visible in a small floating window.
en.disableEffect: Meeting video cannot stay visible in the floating picture-in-picture window.

zh-CN.description: 用户将正在进行的会议切换到画中画模式时，Zoom Meeting SDK 会打开此页面，让会议继续显示在小型悬浮窗口中。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 会议视频将无法继续显示在画中画悬浮窗口中。

en.description: The Zoom Meeting SDK runs this Service when a user connects a Kubi Bluetooth camera stand during a meeting. It finds the stand, connects to it, and sends camera movement commands.
en.disableEffect: Kubi camera discovery, connection, and remote movement will stop, although the meeting itself can continue.

zh-CN.description: 用户在会议中连接 Kubi 蓝牙摄像机底座时，Zoom Meeting SDK 会运行此 Service 来搜索设备、建立连接并控制摄像机移动。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Kubi 摄像机将无法被搜索、连接或远程移动，但会议本身仍可继续。

en.description: The Zoom Meeting SDK starts this Service for screen sharing during a meeting. It keeps the meeting service active with a notification and handles screen-sharing commands.
en.disableEffect: Participants cannot share their device screen in a meeting.

zh-CN.description: 会议中开始屏幕共享时，Zoom Meeting SDK 会启动此 Service。它通过通知保持会议服务运行，并处理屏幕共享操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 参与者将无法在会议中共享设备屏幕。

en.description: The base-lib background service keeps a live connection when the app starts or connects to it, then delivers incoming messages to app features.
en.disableEffect: Apps that use this service will stop receiving live messages through its connection.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动或连接 base-lib 后台服务时，该服务会保持实时连接，并把收到的消息交给应用功能处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此服务的应用将无法再通过这条连接接收实时消息。

en.description: This is part of Nangongkuo's YF CommonLibrary UI toolkit. YF CommonLibrary opens this settings page with app options for rating, sharing, contact, privacy, copyright, and updates.
en.disableEffect: The app's YF settings page and the shortcuts it provides will be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: 这是 Nangongkuo 的 YF CommonLibrary 界面工具库的一部分。YF CommonLibrary 会打开此设置页面，提供评分、分享、联系、隐私、版权和更新等应用选项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用的 YF 设置页面及其中的快捷入口都不可用。

en.description: This is part of Nangongkuo's YF CommonLibrary UI toolkit. When a user selects Privacy in the YF settings page, this screen opens the supplied privacy-policy URL in an in-app web view.
en.disableEffect: The privacy page will not open; selecting the privacy link from YF settings can fail.

zh-CN.description: 这是 Nangongkuo 的 YF CommonLibrary 界面工具库的一部分。用户在 YF 设置页面选择隐私政策时，此页面会在应用内打开指定网址。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，隐私政策页面无法打开；从 YF 设置中点击隐私入口时可能失败。

en.description: AudioRecorder (shichuanenhui), used by PictureSelector, starts this service when recording begins and sends it pause, resume, and stop requests. The service runs the recording session and saves the audio file.
en.disableEffect: AudioRecorder cannot start or control a recording, so PictureSelector cannot return recorded audio.

zh-CN.description: PictureSelector 使用的 AudioRecorder（shichuanenhui）会在开始录音时启动此服务，并通过它暂停、继续或停止录音。此服务负责运行录音过程并保存音频文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: AudioRecorder 将无法启动或控制录音，因此 PictureSelector 不能返回录制的音频。

en.description: MoliHuan File Selector opens a storage browser when an app feature asks the user to choose files or folders. It returns the selected paths or document locations to the app.
en.disableEffect: Features that use this file picker will no longer be able to select files or folders.

zh-CN.description: 应用功能需要用户选择文件或文件夹时，MoliHuan File Selector 会打开存储浏览界面，并把选中的路径或文档位置返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，使用此文件选择器的功能将无法选择文件或文件夹。

en.description: MoliHuan File Selector opens a storage browser when an app feature asks the user to choose files or folders. It returns the selected paths to the app.
en.disableEffect: Features that use this file picker will no longer be able to select files or folders.

zh-CN.description: 应用功能需要用户选择文件或文件夹时，MoliHuan File Selector 会打开存储浏览界面，并把选中的路径返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，使用此文件选择器的功能将无法选择文件或文件夹。

en.description: Maticoo Ads opens an advertiser's landing page inside the app when a user follows an ad link.
en.disableEffect: Advertiser pages opened through Maticoo Ads will not appear; the host app's non-ad screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击广告链接时，Maticoo 广告 SDK 会在应用内打开广告主的落地页。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过 Maticoo 广告 SDK 打开的广告主页面将无法显示；宿主应用的非广告页面仍可使用。

en.description: Maticoo Ads opens an in-app browser for an ad destination, with back, forward, refresh and close controls. The SDK uses it when an ad action opens a web page.
en.disableEffect: Web pages opened from Maticoo ad actions will not appear; the host app's non-ad screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: Maticoo 广告 SDK 会在广告操作打开网页时启动应用内浏览器，并提供前进、后退、刷新和关闭操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Maticoo 广告操作打开的网页将无法显示；宿主应用的非广告页面仍可使用。

en.description: Maticoo Ads opens this full-screen page when an ad placement needs a separate viewing screen. It displays the ad content until the ad closes.
en.disableEffect: Ad placements that use this Maticoo screen will not display; the host app's own non-ad features remain available.

zh-CN.description: Maticoo 广告 SDK 在广告位需要单独的全屏页面时会打开此页面，并在其中展示广告内容，直到广告关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此页面的 Maticoo 广告位将无法显示；宿主应用自身的非广告功能仍可使用。

en.description: When a user dismisses a Zoho SalesIQ Mobilisten chat notification, this Receiver asks SalesIQ to clear that notification and remove its local entry after the request succeeds.
en.disableEffect: Dismissing SalesIQ notifications may no longer sync with its notification service.

zh-CN.description: 用户划掉 Zoho SalesIQ Mobilisten 的聊天通知时，此 Receiver 会请求 SalesIQ 清除该通知，并在请求成功后删除本地记录。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 划掉 SalesIQ 通知后的状态可能无法再同步到其通知服务。

en.description: When a user opens an image in a SalesIQ bot card, this Activity shows it full-screen and offers options to zoom, share, or save it.
en.disableEffect: Images in SalesIQ bot cards cannot be opened full-screen, shared, or saved from the chat.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 SalesIQ 机器人卡片中的图片时，此 Activity 会全屏显示图片，并提供放大、分享和保存选项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 聊天中的 SalesIQ 机器人卡片图片将无法全屏查看、分享或保存。

en.description: When a user opens the Zoho SalesIQ Mobilisten support home, this Activity shows the configured chat, call, and self-service options and can take the user into those support features.
en.disableEffect: The SalesIQ support home and its entry points to chat, calls, and self-service help will not be available.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 Zoho SalesIQ Mobilisten 支持首页时，此 Activity 会显示已配置的聊天、通话和自助服务入口，并可继续进入这些支持功能。
zh-CN.disableEffect: SalesIQ 支持首页以及进入聊天、通话和自助帮助的入口将无法使用。

en.description: Zoho SalesIQ Mobilisten opens this Activity to start or return to an in-app voice or video support call; it presents the call screen and checks the call setup flow.
en.disableEffect: Users may be unable to start, answer, or return to a SalesIQ support call.

zh-CN.description: Zoho SalesIQ Mobilisten 在用户开始客服语音或视频通话，或返回正在进行的通话时打开此 Activity，显示通话页面并处理通话准备流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户可能无法开始、接听或返回 SalesIQ 客服通话。

en.description: Before a configured SalesIQ support chat begins, this Activity displays the visitor form and passes the answers into the conversation flow.
en.disableEffect: Chats that require visitor details or pre-chat questions may not start.

zh-CN.description: 在已配置的 SalesIQ 客服聊天开始前，此 Activity 会显示访客表单，并将填写内容交给后续聊天流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要访客资料或聊天前问题的会话可能无法开始。

en.description: When users open their Zoho SalesIQ support conversations, this Activity shows the conversation list and provides actions to start a new chat or call.
en.disableEffect: The SalesIQ conversation list and its chat or call actions will not be available.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 Zoho SalesIQ 客服会话时，此 Activity 会显示会话列表，并提供开始新聊天或通话的操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: SalesIQ 会话列表以及其中的聊天和通话操作将无法使用。

en.description: When users open Zoho SalesIQ self-service, this Activity displays the configured FAQs and help content; it can also show a question carried over from a chat.
en.disableEffect: SalesIQ self-service FAQs and help screens will not open.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 Zoho SalesIQ 自助服务时，此 Activity 会显示已配置的常见问题和帮助内容，也可以显示从聊天带来的问题。
zh-CN.disableEffect: SalesIQ 自助服务中的常见问题和帮助页面将无法打开。

en.description: When a user opens a photo from a SalesIQ conversation, this Activity displays conversation images in a full-screen gallery.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open or browse full-screen photos from SalesIQ conversations.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 SalesIQ 会话中的照片时，此 Activity 会以全屏图库方式显示会话图片。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法全屏打开或浏览 SalesIQ 会话中的照片。

en.description: When a user taps a Zoho SalesIQ notification, this Activity opens its target link or returns to the host app and passes the notification details to the app.
en.disableEffect: SalesIQ notification taps will no longer open their target or reach the app's notification handler.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击 Zoho SalesIQ 通知时，此 Activity 会打开通知目标链接或返回宿主应用，并把通知内容交给应用处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 点击 SalesIQ 通知后将无法打开其目标页面，也无法把通知交给应用处理。

en.description: Zoho SalesIQ Mobilisten uses this Provider to create file links when a user attaches or shares photos, videos, or other files in a support conversation.
en.disableEffect: Sending or sharing files through SalesIQ chat may fail.

zh-CN.description: 用户在客服会话中添加或分享照片、视频及其他文件时，Zoho SalesIQ Mobilisten 会使用此 Provider 创建文件链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过 SalesIQ 聊天发送或分享文件可能会失败。

en.description: At app startup, Zoho SalesIQ Mobilisten uses this Provider to initialize its chat and call modules, register app lifecycle handling, and prepare local caches.
en.disableEffect: SalesIQ chat and call features may fail to initialize or open.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，Zoho SalesIQ Mobilisten 会通过此 Provider 初始化聊天和通话模块、注册应用生命周期处理，并准备本地缓存。
zh-CN.disableEffect: SalesIQ 聊天和通话功能可能无法初始化或打开。

en.description: At startup and when SalesIQ reads or updates local records, this Provider creates and serves the SDK database for conversation and notification data.
en.disableEffect: SalesIQ conversation history and notification state may fail to load or persist.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动或 SalesIQ 读取、更新本地记录时，此 Provider 会创建并提供 SDK 数据库，用于保存会话和通知数据。
zh-CN.disableEffect: SalesIQ 会话记录和通知状态可能无法读取或保存。

en.description: When a Zoho SalesIQ support conversation opens, this Activity displays its message thread and loads the controls for starting or continuing a chat.
en.disableEffect: The app's SalesIQ live-chat screen may not open or work.

zh-CN.description: Zoho SalesIQ 客服会话打开时，此 Activity 会显示消息记录，并加载开始或继续聊天所需的操作界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用中的 SalesIQ 在线聊天页面可能无法打开或使用。

en.description: When users open SalesIQ help resources, this Activity browses or displays FAQ and article pages and can offer a chat or call from the help screen.
en.disableEffect: SalesIQ help articles, FAQs, and their chat or call options will be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 SalesIQ 帮助资源时，此 Activity 会浏览或显示常见问题和文章页面，并可从帮助页面进入聊天或通话。
zh-CN.disableEffect: SalesIQ 帮助文章、常见问题及其中的聊天或通话入口将无法使用。

en.description: When an app requests a full-screen Markdown file, the Zoho Markdown Renderer opens this Activity and displays its title, formatted text, and code blocks in the requested light or dark theme.
en.disableEffect: Markdown files that use this screen cannot be opened, so their formatted content may be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求全屏显示 Markdown 文件时，Zoho Markdown Renderer 会打开此 Activity，按指定的浅色或深色主题呈现标题、格式化文本和代码块。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此页面的 Markdown 文件将无法打开，格式化内容也可能无法查看。

en.description: When Zoho SalesIQ Mobilisten receives a visitor-trigger broadcast, this Receiver checks the trigger data and runs its configured chat or prompt action.
en.disableEffect: Automatic or timed SalesIQ chat prompts and trigger actions will stop running.

zh-CN.description: Zoho SalesIQ Mobilisten 收到访客触发广播时，此 Receiver 会检查触发信息并执行已配置的聊天或提示操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: SalesIQ 自动或定时触发的聊天提示和操作将停止运行。

en.description: When Zoloz verification requires a behavior challenge, this Activity displays the configured gesture challenge or screen-interaction task and returns the result.
en.disableEffect: The verification cannot complete when it requires this behavior challenge.

zh-CN.description: Zoloz 核验需要行为挑战时，此 Activity 会显示已配置的手势挑战或屏幕交互任务，并返回挑战结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 核验需要此行为挑战时将无法完成。

en.description: When a Zoloz document-verification flow requests native capture, this Activity selects the configured camera workflow and returns the document scan result.
en.disableEffect: Document capture through this Zoloz verification flow may not complete.

zh-CN.description: Zoloz 文档核验流程请求原生采集时，此 Activity 会按配置选择摄像头采集流程，并返回证件扫描结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 此 Zoloz 核验流程中的证件采集可能无法完成。

en.description: When Zoloz verification asks to read an identity document's NFC chip, this Activity waits for the NFC tag, reads its data, and returns the result.
en.disableEffect: Identity checks that require reading the document's NFC chip cannot complete.

zh-CN.description: Zoloz 核验需要读取身份证件的 NFC 芯片时，此 Activity 会等待 NFC 标签、读取其中的数据并返回结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要读取证件 NFC 芯片的身份核验将无法完成。

en.description: When a Zoloz verification page is opened in landscape orientation, this Activity loads the requested page in the SDK's embedded browser and returns page results to the flow.
en.disableEffect: Verification steps that require the landscape web page will not work.

zh-CN.description: Zoloz 以横屏打开核验网页时，此 Activity 会在 SDK 内置浏览器中加载指定页面，并把页面结果交回核验流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要横屏网页的核验步骤将无法使用。

en.description: When a Zoloz verification page is opened in portrait orientation, this Activity loads the requested page in the SDK's embedded browser and returns page results to the flow.
en.disableEffect: Verification steps that require the portrait web page will not work.

zh-CN.description: Zoloz 以竖屏打开核验网页时，此 Activity 会在 SDK 内置浏览器中加载指定页面，并把页面结果交回核验流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要竖屏网页的核验步骤将无法使用。

en.description: When a Zoloz flow opens an embedded web step, this Activity loads the requested page and handles its navigation, permission requests, and results.
en.disableEffect: Verification steps delivered through the embedded web page will not work.

zh-CN.description: Zoloz 流程打开内嵌网页步骤时，此 Activity 会加载指定页面，并处理页面导航、权限请求和返回结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过内嵌网页提供的核验步骤将无法使用。

en.description: When Zoloz requests electronic identity-card verification, this Activity reads the card over NFC, packages the result, and uploads it for verification.
en.disableEffect: NFC-based identity-card verification cannot complete.

zh-CN.description: Zoloz 请求电子身份证核验时，此 Activity 会通过 NFC 读取证件、打包核验结果并上传。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 基于 NFC 的身份证核验将无法完成。

en.description: When Zoloz starts camera-based document text recognition, this Activity runs the configured capture tasks and reports success or failure to the verification flow.
en.disableEffect: Document text scanning through this Zoloz flow cannot complete.

zh-CN.description: Zoloz 启动基于摄像头的证件文字识别时，此 Activity 会运行已配置的采集任务，并向核验流程报告成功或失败。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 此 Zoloz 流程中的证件文字扫描将无法完成。

en.description: Channel.io's customer support chat opens this screen when the app starts a conversation; it loads message history and provides controls for replies, forms, and attachments.
en.disableEffect: The app's Channel.io support conversations and in-chat replies will be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动客服会话时，Channel.io 客服 SDK 会打开这个界面，加载聊天记录，并提供发送回复、表单和附件的功能。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用内的 Channel.io 客服会话和聊天回复将无法使用。

en.description: Channel.io opens this screen when a user taps a file in a support conversation; it downloads the attachment and can open it when the download finishes.
en.disableEffect: Attachments in Channel.io support messages can no longer be downloaded or opened from this screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击客服会话中的文件时，Channel.io 会打开这个界面下载附件，并可在下载完成后打开文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过这个界面下载或打开 Channel.io 客服消息中的附件。

en.description: When a user changes the language for Channel.io support conversations, this screen loads the available languages and lets the user choose one.
en.disableEffect: Users can no longer change the language used in Channel.io support conversations.

zh-CN.description: 用户更改 Channel.io 客服会话语言时，这个界面会加载可选语言并让用户进行选择。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法更改 Channel.io 客服会话使用的语言。

en.description: When a user adds a photo to a Channel.io support message on a device without the Android photo picker, this screen requests photo access and returns the selected images.
en.disableEffect: The Channel.io photo-selection fallback will be unavailable; devices with the Android photo picker can still use it.

zh-CN.description: 在没有 Android 照片选择器的设备上，用户为 Channel.io 客服消息添加照片时，这个界面会请求照片访问权限并返回所选图片。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Channel.io 自带的照片选择界面将无法使用；支持 Android 照片选择器的设备仍可使用系统选择器。

en.description: Channel.io opens this screen when a user taps a video attachment in a support conversation; it plays the clip and offers a download option.
en.disableEffect: Video attachments in Channel.io support conversations can no longer be played or downloaded from this screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击 Channel.io 客服会话中的视频附件时，这个界面会播放视频并提供下载选项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过这个界面播放或下载 Channel.io 客服会话中的视频附件。

en.description: When a user expands a YouTube preview in Channel.io support chat, this screen loads the video in a full-screen player and resumes its saved position.
en.disableEffect: YouTube previews can no longer be opened in Channel.io's full-screen player.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Channel.io 客服聊天中展开 YouTube 预览时，这个界面会以全屏播放器加载视频并恢复上次的播放位置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在 Channel.io 的全屏播放器中打开 YouTube 预览。

en.description: Channel.io opens this screen for links that use its embedded web view; it displays the page and handles navigation, pop-ups, and web file selection.
en.disableEffect: Pages opened inside Channel.io's web view will be unavailable, though some links can still open in the system browser.

zh-CN.description: Channel.io 通过内置网页浏览器打开链接时，会在这个界面显示网页，并处理页面导航、弹出窗口和网页文件选择。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Channel.io 内置浏览器中的网页将无法打开，但部分链接仍可使用系统浏览器。

en.description: When Firebase delivers a push token or message, Channel.io's push add-on registers the token and forwards recognized Channel.io messages for notification handling.
en.disableEffect: Channel.io push-token updates and push notifications will stop working.

zh-CN.description: Firebase 发送推送令牌或消息时，Channel.io 推送扩展会登记令牌，并将识别出的 Channel.io 消息交给通知处理流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Channel.io 推送令牌更新和推送通知将停止工作。

en.description: Channel.io uses this provider to create file links for downloaded support attachments and notification images so other screens or apps can open them.
en.disableEffect: Opening or sharing those Channel.io files can fail because the app can no longer create the required file links.

zh-CN.description: Channel.io 使用这个 Provider 为客服附件和通知图片生成文件链接，供其他界面或应用打开。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用无法再生成所需文件链接，打开或分享这些 Channel.io 文件可能会失败。

en.description: When a user taps a Channel.io push notification, this receiver handles the notification-click action and routes the tap to the relevant support content.
en.disableEffect: Channel.io push notifications will no longer open their related support content when tapped.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击 Channel.io 推送通知时，这个 Receiver 会处理通知点击操作，并跳转到相关客服内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 点击 Channel.io 推送通知后，将无法打开对应的客服内容。

en.description: For Channel.io push clicks routed through this transparent screen, the activity forwards the tap to notification handling and then closes.
en.disableEffect: Push clicks routed through this screen will no longer open the related Channel.io support content.

zh-CN.description: Channel.io 推送点击流程经过这个透明界面时，该界面会转交通知处理流程，然后立即关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 经过这个界面的推送点击将无法打开对应的 Channel.io 客服内容。

en.description: FirstLetterZ's support library uses this screen host to display the page selected by the app and pass navigation and lifecycle events to that page.
en.disableEffect: App screens opened through this host will fail to appear or handle navigation correctly.

zh-CN.description: FirstLetterZ 支持库用此页面容器显示应用选定的页面，并将导航和页面生命周期事件传递给该页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过此容器打开的应用页面将无法显示或正常处理导航。

en.description: FirstLetterZ's support library uses this abstract base screen to host app pages and pass their navigation and lifecycle events.
en.disableEffect: This abstract entry has no screen of its own; concrete app screens built on it remain available.

zh-CN.description: FirstLetterZ 支持库用此抽象页面基类承载应用页面，并传递页面导航和生命周期事件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 此抽象入口本身没有独立页面；基于它构建的具体应用页面仍可使用。

en.description: FirstLetterZ's support library uses this abstract base for one-page screens, where Back leaves the current page or returns to the previous page.
en.disableEffect: This abstract entry has no standalone page; concrete app screens built on it remain available.

zh-CN.description: FirstLetterZ 支持库用此抽象基类承载单页界面；按返回键会离开当前页面或返回上一页。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 此抽象入口没有独立页面；基于它构建的具体应用页面仍可使用。

en.description: When the app opens a page through FirstLetterZ's support library, this screen host displays that page and lets Back return to the prior page or close the screen.
en.disableEffect: Pages opened through this screen host will not open or return correctly.

zh-CN.description: 应用通过 FirstLetterZ 支持库打开页面时，此容器会显示该页面，并在按返回键时返回上一页或关闭页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过此容器打开的页面将无法正常打开或返回。

en.description: When TestPoint opens a selected test entry, this Activity displays that entry’s test screen.
en.disableEffect: The selected TestPoint detail screen will not open; normal app screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: TestPoint 打开某个测试条目时，此 Activity 会显示该条目的测试页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 所选测试条目的详情页将无法打开，应用的普通页面仍可使用。

en.description: Android starts this Provider with the app, and it initializes TestPoint’s list of available test entries.
en.disableEffect: TestPoint’s entries will not be initialized, so its test browser will not work; normal app features remain available.

zh-CN.description: Android 运行应用时会启动此 Provider，并初始化 TestPoint 可用的测试条目。
zh-CN.disableEffect: TestPoint 的测试条目将无法初始化，因此测试列表无法使用；应用的普通功能仍可使用。

en.description: TestPoint’s test-launcher screen lists the app’s registered test entries and opens the selected test page or action.
en.disableEffect: The TestPoint test-entry screen will be unavailable; the app’s regular features remain available.

zh-CN.description: TestPoint 的测试启动页面会列出应用注册的测试条目，并打开所选测试页面或操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: TestPoint 测试条目页面将无法使用，应用的常规功能仍可使用。

en.description: ZSmarter Hulk push uses this Receiver for notification taps and device-token updates, and it also accepts internal push-message broadcasts.
en.disableEffect: Hulk push-token updates and notification-tap handling for this app will stop.

zh-CN.description: ZSmarter Hulk 推送 SDK 使用此 Receiver 处理通知点击和设备令牌更新，也接收 SDK 内部的推送消息广播。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用的 Hulk 推送令牌更新和通知点击处理将停止。

en.description: The Hulk (Zsmarter) push SDK opens this Activity when a user taps one of its notifications. It sends the notification data to the app and then closes.
en.disableEffect: The app will no longer receive the data attached to taps on Hulk push notifications.

zh-CN.description: 用户点按 Hulk（Zsmarter）推送通知时，Hulk 推送 SDK 会打开此 Activity，将通知数据传回应用后关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法再收到 Hulk 推送通知点按操作附带的数据。

en.description: ZSmarter Hulk uses this service to receive Firebase Cloud Messaging events and pass notification contents and refreshed device tokens into its push integration.
en.disableEffect: Firebase-delivered Hulk push messages and device-token updates will stop.

zh-CN.description: ZSmarter Hulk 通过此 Service 接收 Firebase Cloud Messaging 事件，并将通知内容和更新后的设备令牌交给推送集成处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过 Firebase 接收的 Hulk 推送消息和设备令牌更新将停止。

en.description: ZSmarter Hulk’s Honor integration receives Honor push-service callbacks here and reports refreshed device tokens.
en.disableEffect: Push delivery through Hulk’s Honor route will stop.

zh-CN.description: ZSmarter Hulk 的荣耀推送集成通过此 Service 接收推送回调，并上报更新后的设备令牌。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过 Hulk 荣耀通道接收推送的功能将停止。

en.description: ZSmarter Hulk’s Huawei integration receives Huawei push callbacks here and reports refreshed device tokens.
en.disableEffect: Push delivery through Hulk’s Huawei route may stop.

zh-CN.description: ZSmarter Hulk 的华为推送集成通过此 Service 接收华为推送回调，并上报更新后的设备令牌。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过 Hulk 华为通道接收推送的功能可能停止。

en.description: ZSmarter Hulk’s Meizu integration receives Flyme push arrivals, notification taps and registration callbacks.
en.disableEffect: Push messages and token updates through Hulk’s Meizu route will stop.

zh-CN.description: ZSmarter Hulk 的魅族集成会接收 Flyme 推送、通知点击和注册状态回调。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过 Hulk 魅族通道接收推送消息和更新令牌的功能将停止。

en.description: When a Hulk notification is dismissed, this Receiver clears its notification and refreshes the app badge.
en.disableEffect: Hulk notification dismissal and badge cleanup will no longer run automatically.

zh-CN.description: Hulk 通知被清除时，此 Receiver 会取消对应通知并刷新应用角标。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Hulk 通知被清除后，将不再自动执行通知清理和角标刷新。

en.description: ZSmarter Hulk’s OPPO/ColorOS integration uses this service to receive push-message callbacks.
en.disableEffect: Push messages through Hulk’s OPPO/ColorOS route will stop.

zh-CN.description: ZSmarter Hulk 的 OPPO/ColorOS 集成通过此 Service 接收推送消息回调。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过 Hulk 的 OPPO/ColorOS 通道接收推送消息的功能将停止。

en.description: ZSmarter Hulk’s OPPO/HeyTap integration uses this service to receive MCS push messages.
en.disableEffect: Push messages through Hulk’s OPPO/HeyTap route will stop.

zh-CN.description: ZSmarter Hulk 的 OPPO/HeyTap 集成通过此 Service 接收 MCS 推送消息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过 Hulk 的 OPPO/HeyTap 通道接收推送消息的功能将停止。

en.description: The Hulk (Zsmarter) push SDK receives Huawei Push messages here, turns structured data messages into app notifications, and passes new Huawei registration tokens to the app.
en.disableEffect: Huawei push messages and registration updates handled through Hulk will stop reaching the app.

zh-CN.description: Hulk（Zsmarter）推送 SDK 通过此服务接收华为 Push 消息，将数据消息显示为应用通知，并把新的华为注册令牌传给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过 Hulk 处理的华为推送消息和注册信息将无法再送达应用。

en.description: The Hulk (Zsmarter) push SDK receives Xiaomi Push broadcasts and reports notification taps and successful registration results to the app.
en.disableEffect: The app will no longer receive Xiaomi push registration tokens or notification tap data through Hulk.

zh-CN.description: Hulk（Zsmarter）推送 SDK 通过此接收器处理小米 Push 广播，并向应用报告通知点按和成功注册结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法再通过 Hulk 收到小米推送注册令牌或通知点按数据。

en.description: The Hulk (Zsmarter) push SDK exposes this compatibility service for data messages delivered through OPPO's ColorOS MCS push route.
en.disableEffect: Data messages delivered through the legacy OPPO MCS route will no longer reach the app service.

zh-CN.description: Hulk（Zsmarter）推送 SDK 通过此兼容服务接收 OPPO ColorOS MCS 推送通道送达的数据消息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过旧版 OPPO MCS 通道送达的数据消息将无法再到达应用服务。

en.description: The Hulk (Zsmarter) push SDK handles OPPO and HeyTap data-message callbacks here and passes message content to the app's notification handler.
en.disableEffect: The app will no longer receive notification data through this OPPO and HeyTap push route.

zh-CN.description: Hulk（Zsmarter）推送 SDK 通过此服务处理 OPPO 和 HeyTap 数据消息回调，并将消息内容传给应用的通知处理程序。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法再通过此 OPPO 和 HeyTap 推送通道收到通知数据。

en.description: The Hulk (Zsmarter) push SDK receives Vivo Push callbacks here and sends the data from a tapped notification to the app.
en.disableEffect: The app will no longer receive data when users tap Vivo push notifications.

zh-CN.description: Hulk（Zsmarter）推送 SDK 通过此接收器处理 Vivo Push 回调，并在用户点按通知时把附带数据传给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户点按 Vivo 推送通知时，应用将无法再收到附带的数据。

en.description: ZSmarter Hulk’s Vivo integration handles notification-tap callbacks and logs Vivo’s device-registration ID for diagnostics.
en.disableEffect: Vivo notification taps will no longer pass through Hulk, and its registration ID will not be logged.

zh-CN.description: ZSmarter Hulk 的 vivo 集成会处理通知点击回调，并记录 vivo 设备注册 ID 以供诊断。
zh-CN.disableEffect: vivo 通知点击将无法经由 Hulk 处理，注册 ID 也不会再被记录。

en.description: ZSmarter Hulk’s Xiaomi integration receives Mi Push messages, notification taps and registration results here.
en.disableEffect: Push messages and token updates through Hulk’s Xiaomi route will stop.

zh-CN.description: ZSmarter Hulk 的小米集成通过此 Receiver 接收 Mi Push 消息、通知点击和注册结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过 Hulk 小米通道接收推送消息和更新令牌的功能将停止。

en.description: The TriangleView demo opens its sample screen, showing colored corner badges and rounded triangle styles with labels.
en.disableEffect: The demo app’s launcher screen will not open if this Activity is disabled.

zh-CN.description: TriangleView 演示应用会打开示例页面，展示带文字的彩色角标和圆角三角形样式。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用此 Activity 后，演示应用的启动页面无法打开。

en.description: HPay opens this payment Activity to start or resume a WeChat Pay or UnionPay transaction. It hands the order to the payment flow and processes the response when the user returns.
en.disableEffect: WeChat Pay or UnionPay transactions using HPay may fail to start or return a result.

zh-CN.description: HPay 会在发起或恢复微信支付、银联支付时打开此支付 Activity。它会将订单交给支付流程处理，并在用户返回后接收支付结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过 HPay 使用微信支付或银联支付时，支付可能无法启动或无法返回结果。

en.description: HPay uses this receiver when WeChat asks the app to refresh its registration. It registers the configured app with WeChat so the payment handoff can continue.
en.disableEffect: WeChat may not recognize or refresh the app registration, disrupting HPay’s WeChat payment flow.

zh-CN.description: 微信要求应用刷新注册信息时，HPay 会通过此 Receiver 向微信重新注册应用，以便继续支付跳转。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 微信可能无法识别或刷新应用注册信息，从而影响 HPay 的微信支付流程。

en.description: HPlugin uses this Provider for content requests addressed to providers inside loaded plug-ins. It forwards queries, writes, and file requests to the matching plug-in provider.
en.disableEffect: Plug-in features that read, write, or share provider data may fail.

zh-CN.description: HPlugin 会通过此 Provider 处理发往已加载插件内 Provider 的内容请求，并转交查询、写入和文件访问操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖插件 Provider 读取、写入或共享数据的功能可能无法使用。

en.description: HPlugin starts this Service when a loaded plug-in needs background or bound service work. It keeps that plug-in service available to the app while the task runs.
en.disableEffect: Plug-in features that depend on background or bound services may stop working.

zh-CN.description: 已加载的插件需要后台服务或绑定服务时，HPlugin 会启动此 Service，让应用能够使用该插件服务处理任务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖插件后台服务或绑定服务的功能可能停止工作。

en.description: HMedia opens this short-video camera screen when the app starts its recording flow. Users can preview the camera, record and remove clips, switch cameras, and combine the kept clips into a video.
en.disableEffect: The app will lose HMedia’s in-app short-video recording flow.

zh-CN.description: 应用开始录制短视频时，HMedia 会打开此相机界面。用户可以预览相机画面、录制或删除片段、切换前后摄像头，并将保留的片段合成为视频。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法使用 HMedia 的短视频录制流程。

en.description: ZHRecorder opens this screen when the app supplies an existing video for trimming. Users can choose a shorter segment, rotate the picture, and send the exported clip to the preview screen.
en.disableEffect: The app will not be able to trim and rotate a local clip through ZHRecorder.

zh-CN.description: 应用交来本地视频进行剪辑时，ZHRecorder 会打开此界面。用户可以选取较短片段、旋转画面，并将导出的视频交给预览界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法通过 ZHRecorder 剪辑或旋转本地视频片段。

en.description: ZHRecorder opens this editor for an existing or newly recorded video. Users can adjust its timeline, apply a filter, add a sticker or text bubble, and preview the exported video.
en.disableEffect: The app will lose ZHRecorder’s video editing and edited-clip preview flow.

zh-CN.description: ZHRecorder 会为现有或新录制的视频打开此编辑界面。用户可以调整时间轴、应用滤镜、添加贴纸或文字气泡，并预览导出的视频。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法使用 ZHRecorder 的视频编辑和成片预览流程。

en.description: ZHRecorder opens this picker when the app asks users to choose local videos. It scans the device’s video albums, displays clips, and lets users select files for the app’s video flow.
en.disableEffect: Users will no longer be able to choose existing videos through ZHRecorder.

zh-CN.description: 应用要求用户选择本地视频时，ZHRecorder 会打开此选择界面。它会扫描设备中的视频相册并列出片段，供用户选入应用的视频流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 ZHRecorder 选择已有视频。

en.description: ZHRecorder opens this camera screen when the app starts a video-recording session. Users can record multiple clips, switch cameras, adjust the beauty filter, remove a segment, and preview the merged video.
en.disableEffect: The app will lose ZHRecorder’s in-app video-recording flow and camera controls.

zh-CN.description: 应用开始视频录制时，ZHRecorder 会打开此相机界面。用户可以录制多个片段、切换摄像头、调整美颜滤镜、删除片段并预览合成视频。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法使用 ZHRecorder 的视频录制流程和相机控制。

en.description: When users choose a video cover in ZHRecorder, this screen shows frames from the clip and lets them select the point used as the cover.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to choose the video’s cover point through this ZHRecorder screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 ZHRecorder 中选择视频封面时，此界面会显示视频帧，并让用户选定用作封面的时间点。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此 ZHRecorder 界面选择视频封面时间点。

en.description: ZHRecorder opens this player after a clip is recorded or edited. Users can review it, open the editor, choose its cover point, or save the video to the device gallery.
en.disableEffect: The app will lose this ZHRecorder preview screen and its edit, cover-selection, and save controls.

zh-CN.description: 录制或编辑视频后，ZHRecorder 会打开此播放器供用户检查成片。用户可以继续编辑、选择封面时间点，或将视频保存到设备相册。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将失去此 ZHRecorder 预览界面以及编辑、选封面和保存功能。

en.description: ZHRecorder opens this simple player when the app supplies a video for playback. It starts the selected clip inside the app.
en.disableEffect: The video will no longer play in this ZHRecorder screen.

zh-CN.description: 应用交来视频进行播放时，ZHRecorder 会打开此简易播放器并在应用内播放所选片段。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 视频将无法在此 ZHRecorder 界面中播放。

en.description: HPlugin uses this standard Activity slot to show a page loaded from an app plug-in when that page is opened. The screen content comes from the plug-in.
en.disableEffect: Plug-in pages routed through this slot will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: HPlugin 会在应用打开插件页面时使用此标准 Activity 槽位显示动态加载的页面，界面内容由插件提供。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 分配到此槽位的插件页面将无法打开。

en.description: HPlugin uses this Activity slot to show a plug-in page that needs a see-through window background. The page content is loaded from the plug-in.
en.disableEffect: Plug-in pages routed through this translucent slot will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: HPlugin 会使用此 Activity 槽位显示需要透明窗口背景的插件页面，界面内容由插件提供。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 分配到此透明槽位的插件页面将无法打开。

en.description: HPlugin uses this Activity slot for a plug-in page that must stay in its own separate app task. The page content is loaded from the plug-in when requested.
en.disableEffect: Plug-in pages routed through this slot will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: HPlugin 会为需要独立应用任务的插件页面使用此 Activity 槽位。 页面内容会在需要时从插件中加载。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 分配到此槽位的插件页面将无法打开。

en.description: HPlugin uses this Activity slot for a plug-in page that must stay in its own separate app task. Its window background is see-through, and the page content is loaded from the plug-in.
en.disableEffect: Translucent plug-in pages routed through this slot will no longer open.
