en.description: When the ZZYL account SDK resumes a saved game account, this screen continues sign-in with that account and lets users open the saved-account chooser.
en.disableEffect: Saved-account sign-in and account switching through the SDK can no longer work, which may prevent sign-in.

zh-CN.description: ZZYL 账号 SDK 恢复已保存的游戏账号时，会通过此页面继续登录，并允许用户打开已保存账号列表。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，SDK 无法通过此页面使用已保存账号登录或切换账号，用户可能无法登录。

en.description: From the ZZYL account SDK's sign-in or account-management flow, this screen lets users request a verification code and reset, bind, or update an account.
en.disableEffect: Users can no longer recover or bind an account through this screen, so those account-management flows stop working.

zh-CN.description: 在 ZZYL 账号 SDK 的登录或账号管理流程中，此页面可申请验证码，并用于找回、绑定或修改账号。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过此页面找回或绑定账号，相关账号管理流程会失效。

en.description: After signing in with the ZZYL account SDK, this screen shows the account name, user ID, and nickname, with options to switch accounts, manage credentials, and verify identity.
en.disableEffect: Account management and switching through the SDK become unavailable, which can block account flows the app relies on.

zh-CN.description: 使用 ZZYL 账号 SDK 登录后，此页面会显示账号、用户编号和昵称，并提供切换账号、管理凭据和身份验证选项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后无法通过 SDK 管理或切换账号，应用依赖的相关账号流程可能受阻。

en.description: When the ZZYL account SDK opens its loading screen, this activity displays a centered empty layout; the shipped version has no visible progress indicator or message.
en.disableEffect: If an account flow opens this screen, disabling it prevents that step from opening and could interrupt the flow.

zh-CN.description: ZZYL 账号 SDK 打开加载页面时，此页面会显示一个居中的空白布局；当前版本没有可见的进度提示或文字。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 如果账号流程需要打开此页面，停用后该步骤无法启动，可能会中断流程。

en.description: During ZZYL account sign-in, this screen offers Google and Facebook sign-in and an option to continue with an account managed by the SDK.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it removes the SDK's sign-in choices, so users may be unable to log into the host app's account.

zh-CN.description: 进行 ZZYL 账号登录时，此页面提供 Google、Facebook 登录，以及使用 SDK 账号继续登录的选项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，SDK 的登录选项会消失，用户可能无法登录应用账号。

en.description: When the ZZYL account SDK opens its account sign-in page, users can enter an account and password, sign in as a guest, register, or recover a password.
en.disableEffect: Account-and-password sign-in, guest sign-in, registration, and password recovery through the SDK may stop working.

zh-CN.description: ZZYL 账号 SDK 打开账号登录页面时，用户可输入账号和密码，也可使用游客登录、注册账号或找回密码。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，SDK 的账号密码登录、游客登录、账号注册和密码找回流程可能无法使用。

en.description: When a user switches accounts in the ZZYL account SDK, this screen lists saved accounts; choosing one resumes sign-in for that account.
en.disableEffect: Users can no longer choose a saved account or switch accounts through the SDK.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 ZZYL 账号 SDK 中切换账号时，此页面会列出已保存的账号；选中一个账号后即可继续登录。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过 SDK 选择已保存的账号或切换账号。

en.description: When the ZZYL account SDK opens a hosted payment page, this screen loads it in the app's built-in browser.
en.disableEffect: The SDK's in-app web payment pages will not open, so the associated payment flow may fail.

zh-CN.description: ZZYL 账号 SDK 打开网页支付页面时，此页面会在应用内置浏览器中加载该页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，SDK 的应用内网页支付页面无法打开，相关支付流程可能失败。

en.description: When the ZZYL account SDK requests identity verification, this screen collects a real name and ID number and submits them for verification.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot complete the SDK's real-name verification step, which may block account features that require it.

zh-CN.description: ZZYL 账号 SDK 要求进行身份验证时，此页面会收集真实姓名和身份证号码并提交验证。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法完成 SDK 的实名认证，依赖该认证的账号功能可能受阻。

en.description: When a user creates a ZZYL account, this screen collects an email address and password and submits the registration.
en.disableEffect: New account registration through the SDK stops working.

zh-CN.description: 用户创建 ZZYL 账号时，此页面会收集邮箱地址和密码并提交注册。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过 SDK 注册新账号。

en.description: When the ZZYL account SDK presents a prompt, this screen shows its message with confirmation or cancel buttons.
en.disableEffect: Account prompts will no longer appear, so users may miss instructions or the reason an account action failed.

zh-CN.description: ZZYL 账号 SDK 显示提示时，此页面会展示提示内容，并提供确认或取消按钮。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，账号提示不会显示，用户可能错过操作说明或失败原因。

en.description: The Common Pay SDK by feer921 opens this payment screen when the app starts an Alipay or WeChat Pay order, then handles the payment response and returns the result to the app.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents the app from completing or receiving results for payments handled by this SDK.

zh-CN.description: feer921 的 Common Pay SDK 在应用发起支付宝或微信支付订单时打开此支付页面，接收支付响应并将结果返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用无法通过此 SDK 完成支付或接收支付结果。

en.description: Mail.ru's CxHub notification SDK uses this receiver for notification taps and button actions sent as broadcasts; it forwards the selected action to CxHub's background handler.
en.disableEffect: CxHub notification taps or buttons that use this route will no longer open their page or run the selected action.

zh-CN.description: Mail.ru 的 CxHub 通知 SDK 会通过此接收器处理以广播形式发送的通知点击和按钮操作，并将所选操作交给 CxHub 后台处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此路径的 CxHub 通知点击和按钮将无法打开页面或执行相应操作。

en.description: Mail.ru's CxHub SDK schedules this receiver for background alarms; when one fires, it forwards the queued task to CxHub for processing.
en.disableEffect: CxHub's scheduled background work, including notification updates, may not run on time.

zh-CN.description: Mail.ru 的 CxHub SDK 会为后台闹钟安排此接收器；闹钟触发时，它会把排队的任务交给 CxHub 处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: CxHub 安排的后台任务（包括通知更新）可能无法按时运行。

en.description: Android sends this receiver when the device time or time zone changes; it forwards the update to Mail.ru's CxHub background processing.
en.disableEffect: CxHub may miss clock and time-zone updates used by its scheduled background work.

zh-CN.description: 设备时间或时区变化时，Android 会调用此接收器；它会将变化通知 Mail.ru 的 CxHub 后台处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: CxHub 可能无法收到后台任务所需的时间或时区变化信息。

en.description: The Customer360 Android SDK opens this screen when a user starts in-app customer support. It displays the conversation with the support team.
en.disableEffect: Users can no longer open the Customer360 in-app support chat.

zh-CN.description: 用户开始使用应用内客服时，Customer360 Android SDK 会打开此界面，显示用户与客服团队的对话。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开 Customer360 应用内客服聊天。

en.description: After a user submits a Customer360 support ticket, this screen confirms that the ticket was sent.
en.disableEffect: The ticket-submission flow cannot show its confirmation screen and may fail when opening it.

zh-CN.description: 用户提交 Customer360 客服工单后，此界面会确认工单已发送。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 工单提交流程无法显示确认界面，打开该界面时也可能失败。

en.description: When a user contacts support through Customer360, this screen opens the new-ticket form and provides an option to attach a photo.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot create Customer360 support tickets from the app.

zh-CN.description: 用户通过 Customer360 联系客服时，此界面会打开新工单表单，并提供添加照片的选项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在应用中创建 Customer360 客服工单。

en.description: When a user attaches a photo to a Customer360 support ticket, this screen lets them take or choose an image and preview it before attaching it.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot add a new photo through the Customer360 ticket form.

zh-CN.description: 用户为 Customer360 客服工单添加照片时，此界面允许用户拍摄或选择图片，并在添加前预览。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法通过 Customer360 工单表单添加新照片。

en.description: When a user opens a Customer360 support ticket, this screen shows the ticket conversation and provides controls for replying or attaching a photo.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open or reply to Customer360 support-ticket conversations.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 Customer360 客服工单时，此界面会显示工单对话，并提供回复和添加照片的操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开或回复 Customer360 客服工单对话。

en.description: When a user opens the Customer360 support inbox, this screen lists their tickets and provides an option to create a new one.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot browse the Customer360 ticket list or start a new ticket from it.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 Customer360 客服收件箱时，此界面会列出工单，并提供新建工单的入口。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法浏览 Customer360 工单列表，也无法从列表中新建工单。

en.description: When a user opens a photo attached to a Customer360 ticket, this screen lets them browse the ticket's images.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot view attached photos in the Customer360 ticket gallery.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 Customer360 工单中的照片时，此界面会显示工单图片并供用户浏览。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在 Customer360 工单图库中查看附件照片。

en.description: The Customer360 Android SDK receives Google Cloud Messaging updates for support tickets so users can be notified about new messages.
en.disableEffect: Users stop receiving Customer360 push notifications for ticket updates.

zh-CN.description: Customer360 Android SDK 会接收 Google 云消息中的客服工单更新，以便通知用户有新消息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法收到 Customer360 工单更新的推送通知。

en.description: The Customer360 Android SDK processes incoming support-ticket messages and posts notifications that can open the matching conversation.
en.disableEffect: Users stop receiving Customer360 push notifications that announce ticket replies.

zh-CN.description: Customer360 Android SDK 会处理收到的客服工单消息并发布通知，用户可通过通知打开对应的工单对话。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法收到 Customer360 工单回复的推送通知。

en.description: After a user submits a Customer360 support ticket, this screen confirms that the ticket was sent.
en.disableEffect: The ticket-submission flow cannot show its confirmation screen and may fail when opening it.

zh-CN.description: 用户提交 Customer360 客服工单后，此界面会确认工单已发送。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 工单提交流程无法显示确认界面，打开该界面时也可能失败。

en.description: When a user contacts support through Customer360, this screen opens the new-ticket form and provides an option to attach a photo.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot create Customer360 support tickets from the app.

zh-CN.description: 用户通过 Customer360 联系客服时，此界面会打开新工单表单，并提供添加照片的选项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在应用中创建 Customer360 客服工单。

en.description: When a user attaches a photo to a Customer360 support ticket, this screen lets them take or choose an image and preview it before attaching it.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot add a new photo through the Customer360 ticket form.

zh-CN.description: 用户为 Customer360 客服工单添加照片时，此界面允许用户拍摄或选择图片，并在添加前预览。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法通过 Customer360 工单表单添加新照片。

en.disableEffect: Users cannot open or reply to Customer360 support-ticket conversations.

zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开或回复 Customer360 客服工单对话。

en.disableEffect: Users cannot browse the Customer360 ticket list or start a new ticket from it.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 Customer360 客服收件箱时，此界面会列出工单，并提供新建工单的入口。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法浏览 Customer360 工单列表，也无法从列表中新建工单。

en.description: When a user opens a photo attached to a Customer360 ticket, this screen lets them browse the ticket's images.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot view attached photos in the Customer360 ticket gallery.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 Customer360 工单中的照片时，此界面会显示工单图片并供用户浏览。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在 Customer360 工单图库中查看附件照片。

en.description: The Customer360 Android SDK receives Google Cloud Messaging updates for support tickets so users can be notified about new messages.
en.disableEffect: Users stop receiving Customer360 push notifications for ticket updates.

zh-CN.description: Customer360 Android SDK 会接收 Google 云消息中的客服工单更新，以便通知用户有新消息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法收到 Customer360 工单更新的推送通知。

en.disableEffect: Users stop receiving Customer360 push notifications that announce ticket replies.

zh-CN.description: Customer360 Android SDK 会处理收到的客服工单消息并发布通知，用户可通过通知打开对应的工单对话。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法收到 Customer360 工单回复的推送通知。

en.description: DirectOne Smarkio ALTU opens this Activity when the app starts a configured customer chat. It shows the conversation and message-entry screen for chatting with the service team.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open the ALTU customer chat from the app, so its support conversation is unavailable.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动已配置的客服对话时，DirectOne Smarkio ALTU 会打开此 Activity。它显示与客服团队沟通的消息列表和输入界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法从应用打开 ALTU 客服对话，相关支持沟通将不可用。

en.description: DirectOne Smarkio Push handles Android's legacy Google messaging receive and registration broadcasts in this Receiver. For a matching notification message, it records that the push was received.
en.disableEffect: The SDK will no longer record notifications delivered through these legacy broadcasts.

zh-CN.description: DirectOne Smarkio Push 使用此 Receiver 处理 Android 旧版 Google 消息接收和注册广播。对于符合条件的通知消息，它会记录推送已收到。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，SDK 将不再记录通过这些旧版广播送达的通知。

en.description: When the user taps a DirectOne Smarkio Push notification or one of its buttons, this Receiver clears the notification and opens the app or linked page. It also records the notification interaction.
en.disableEffect: DirectOne notification taps and buttons will no longer open their destination, and their interactions will not be recorded.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击 DirectOne Smarkio Push 通知或其中的按钮时，此 Receiver 会清除通知并打开应用或关联网页，同时记录此次交互。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，DirectOne 通知和按钮将无法打开目标页面，相关交互也不会被记录。

en.description: DirectOne Smarkio Push receives Firebase messages through this Service and turns notification messages into system notifications. It can include category-specific buttons and links configured for the message.
en.disableEffect: New DirectOne push messages will no longer appear as notifications or offer their configured buttons.

zh-CN.description: DirectOne Smarkio Push 通过此 Service 接收 Firebase 消息，并将通知消息显示为系统通知。通知还可包含为该消息配置的分类按钮和链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，新的 DirectOne 推送消息将不再显示为通知，也不会提供配置的按钮。

en.description: When Firebase Cloud Messaging delivers a push message or refreshes its token, this Mail.ru CxHub service passes the message or token to CxHub.
en.disableEffect: CxHub push messages and token updates will stop arriving through Firebase; other app features remain available.

zh-CN.description: Firebase Cloud Messaging 收到推送消息或更新推送令牌时，Mail.ru 的 CxHub 服务会将消息或令牌交给 CxHub。
zh-CN.disableEffect: CxHub 将无法通过 Firebase 接收推送消息或令牌更新；应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: When Huawei Push Kit delivers a push message or refreshes its token, this Mail.ru CxHub service passes the message or token to CxHub.
en.disableEffect: CxHub push messages and token updates will stop arriving through Huawei Push Kit; other app features remain available.

zh-CN.description: Huawei Push Kit 收到推送消息或更新推送令牌时，Mail.ru 的 CxHub 服务会将消息或令牌交给 CxHub。
zh-CN.disableEffect: CxHub 将无法通过 Huawei Push Kit 接收推送消息或令牌更新；应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: When RuStore Push delivers a message or refreshes its token, this Mail.ru CxHub service passes the message data or token to CxHub.
en.disableEffect: CxHub push messages and token updates will stop arriving through RuStore; other app features remain available.

zh-CN.description: RuStore Push 收到推送消息或更新推送令牌时，Mail.ru 的 CxHub 服务会将消息数据或令牌交给 CxHub。
zh-CN.disableEffect: CxHub 将无法通过 RuStore 接收推送消息或令牌更新；应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: On newer Android versions, Mail.ru's CxHub SDK opens this short-lived screen to pass a notification tap or button action to its handler, then closes the screen.
en.disableEffect: CxHub notification taps that use this route will no longer be processed; the app's regular screens still work.

zh-CN.description: 在较新版本的 Android 上，Mail.ru 的 CxHub SDK 会短暂打开此页面，将通知点击或按钮操作交给 SDK 处理，随后关闭页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此路径的 CxHub 通知点击将无法处理；应用的常规页面仍可使用。

en.description: When someone opens a Mail.ru CxHub rich notification, this screen displays its image-and-text landing page and configured buttons, then reports image or button selections to CxHub.
en.disableEffect: CxHub rich-notification pages and their image or button actions will be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 Mail.ru CxHub 富通知时，此页面会显示图文落地页和配置的按钮，并将图片或按钮操作反馈给 CxHub。
zh-CN.disableEffect: CxHub 富通知页面及其图片或按钮操作将无法使用。

en.description: Mail.ru's CxHub SDK initializes at app startup through this provider and uses it to share local image files with its notification screens.
en.disableEffect: CxHub may not initialize automatically, and notifications that need a local image or file link may fail when the app tries to open that file.

zh-CN.description: Mail.ru 的 CxHub SDK 会在应用启动时通过此内容提供器初始化，并用它向通知页面提供本地图片文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: CxHub 可能无法自动初始化；通知需要打开本地图片或文件时也可能失败。

en.description: When Google Play broadcasts the install referrer, this Mail.ru CxHub receiver forwards the referrer text to the SDK for install attribution.
en.disableEffect: CxHub will not receive install-attribution information for new installs.

zh-CN.description: Google Play 广播安装来源信息时，Mail.ru 的 CxHub 接收器会将来源文本交给 SDK 用于安装归因。
zh-CN.disableEffect: CxHub 将无法收到新安装的来源归因信息。

en.description: Applifting Firebase Wrapper handles incoming Firebase notification messages in this Service and displays their title and text as a system notification. The wrapper also exposes Firebase topic subscribe and unsubscribe support to the app.
en.disableEffect: Notifications routed through this Service will stop appearing, and messages for its Firebase topics will no longer be processed here.

zh-CN.description: Applifting Firebase Wrapper 使用此 Service 处理收到的 Firebase 通知，并将标题和正文显示为系统通知。该封装还为应用提供 Firebase 主题订阅和取消订阅功能。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，经此 Service 路由的通知将不再显示，相关 Firebase 主题消息也不会再由它处理。

en.description: senRsl’s Dominate plugin library displays screens supplied by app extensions when the app opens them.
en.disableEffect: App screens supplied through a Dominate extension will not open, so features delivered through those extensions may be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: senRsl 的 Dominate 插件库会在应用打开扩展页面时显示这些页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过 Dominate 扩展提供的应用页面将无法打开，相关功能可能不可用。

en.description: senRsl’s Permission library shows Android permission prompts requested by the app and returns the user’s choices to it.
en.disableEffect: Features that need permissions requested through this screen may stop working.

zh-CN.description: senRsl 的 Permission 权限库会在应用申请系统权限时显示 Android 权限提示，并把用户的选择返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过此页面申请权限的功能可能无法正常使用。

en.description: AIPARK's Android SDK uses this background Service to process batched device-location and movement updates. It saves the coordinates and detected activity, then broadcasts those updates inside the app.
en.disableEffect: The app will stop receiving AIPARK's background location and movement updates, so that tracking will stop.

zh-CN.description: AIPARK Android SDK 使用此后台 Service 处理批量的位置和活动状态更新。它会保存坐标与检测到的活动状态，然后在应用内广播这些更新。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用将不再收到 AIPARK 的后台位置和活动状态更新，相关跟踪也会停止。

en.description: When Android delivers a location or detected-movement update, this AIPARK Receiver passes it to the background processor. The processor stores and broadcasts the new information inside the app.
en.disableEffect: AIPARK will stop processing background location and movement updates from Android.

zh-CN.description: Android 送达位置或检测到的移动状态更新时，此 AIPARK Receiver 会将其交给后台处理器。处理器会在应用内保存并广播这些新信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，AIPARK 将不再处理 Android 提供的后台位置和活动状态更新。

en.description: AIPARK's Android SDK starts this Service for background tracking. It requests recurring device-location and movement updates using the saved sampling settings and checks whether location permission is available.
en.disableEffect: AIPARK's background location and movement tracking will stop.

zh-CN.description: AIPARK Android SDK 会启动此 Service 执行后台跟踪。它按照已保存的采样设置请求持续的位置和活动状态更新，并检查是否具有位置权限。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，AIPARK 的后台位置和活动状态跟踪将停止。

en.description: Manojmiyani99's OpenVPN library opens a confirmation prompt when the user taps its VPN notification's disconnect action. Choosing Yes tells the active tunnel to disconnect.
en.disableEffect: The VPN notification's disconnect action cannot show its confirmation or stop the tunnel through that route.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击 VPN 通知中的断开操作时，Manojmiyani99 的 OpenVPN 库会显示确认提示；选择确认后会断开当前隧道。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，VPN 通知中的断开操作无法显示确认提示，也无法通过该入口停止隧道。

en.description: When the NetEase iTVPN SDK starts a saved VPN profile, this Activity handles Android's VPN consent and any required password prompt, then begins the VPN connection.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot start VPN connections through saved profiles.

zh-CN.description: 网易 iTVPN SDK 启动已保存的 VPN 配置时，此 Activity 会处理 Android VPN 授权和所需的密码输入，然后建立 VPN 连接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过已保存的配置启动 VPN 连接。

en.description: When a user opens an OpenVPN profile file from another app, this NetEase iTVPN screen reads and imports the profile and its certificate files.
en.disableEffect: Users can no longer import VPN profiles from .ovpn or similar profile files.

zh-CN.description: 用户从其他应用打开 OpenVPN 配置文件时，网易 iTVPN 的此界面会读取并导入配置及其证书文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法从 .ovpn 等配置文件导入 VPN 配置。

en.description: When the NetEase iTVPN SDK opens its disconnect control, this Activity asks whether to stop or reconnect the active VPN profile.
en.disableEffect: Users lose the SDK's confirmation flow for stopping or reconnecting an active VPN profile.

zh-CN.description: 网易 iTVPN SDK 打开断开控制时，此 Activity 会询问用户是停止还是重新连接当前 VPN 配置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法使用 SDK 提供的 VPN 断开或重连确认界面。

en.description: When a VPN launch opens the connection log, this NetEase iTVPN screen displays connection status and diagnostic messages.
en.disableEffect: The default VPN launch flow can fail when it tries to open this log screen, and users lose access to VPN diagnostics.

zh-CN.description: VPN 启动流程打开连接日志时，网易 iTVPN 的此界面会显示连接状态和诊断消息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 默认 VPN 启动流程可能因无法打开此日志界面而失败，用户也会失去查看 VPN 诊断信息的入口。

en.description: When a user opens settings for a saved NetEase iTVPN profile, this Activity shows editable VPN options and actions to duplicate or remove the profile.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot edit, duplicate, or remove saved VPN profiles from the profile settings screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开网易 iTVPN 已保存配置的设置时，此 Activity 会显示可编辑的 VPN 选项，以及复制或删除配置的操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在配置设置界面编辑、复制或删除已保存的 VPN 配置。

en.description: When another app requests access to the NetEase iTVPN OpenVPN interface, this Activity asks the user to approve or reject that app.
en.disableEffect: External apps cannot be authorized to manage VPN profiles through this interface; the host app's VPN controls remain available.

zh-CN.description: 其他应用请求访问网易 iTVPN 的 OpenVPN 接口时，此 Activity 会询问用户是否授权。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 外部应用将无法获准通过此接口管理 VPN 配置，但宿主应用自身的 VPN 控制仍可使用。

en.description: When an authorized external app requests a VPN connection through NetEase iTVPN, this entry starts the saved profile named in that request.
en.disableEffect: External apps can no longer start a saved VPN profile through this shortcut; the host app can still start it directly.

zh-CN.description: 获准的外部应用通过网易 iTVPN 请求连接 VPN 时，此入口会启动请求中指定的已保存配置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 外部应用将无法通过此快捷入口启动 VPN 配置，但宿主应用仍可直接启动连接。

en.description: When an authorized external app requests a VPN disconnect through NetEase iTVPN, this entry stops the active connection.
en.disableEffect: External apps can no longer stop the VPN through this shortcut; the host app's disconnect control remains available.

zh-CN.description: 获准的外部应用通过网易 iTVPN 请求断开 VPN 时，此入口会停止当前连接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 外部应用将无法通过此快捷入口断开 VPN，但宿主应用自身的断开控制仍可使用。

en.description: When an external app binds to NetEase iTVPN's published OpenVPN interface, it can list profiles and request VPN start, stop, pause, resume, and status updates.
en.disableEffect: Other apps lose this control and status interface; the host app's own VPN screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: 外部应用绑定网易 iTVPN 发布的 OpenVPN 接口后，可列出配置并请求启动、停止、暂停或恢复 VPN，还可接收状态更新。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 其他应用将失去此控制和状态接口，但宿主应用自身的 VPN 界面仍可使用。

en.description: When the external NetEase iTVPN interface needs Android VPN authorization, this Activity opens the system consent screen and returns the user's decision.
en.disableEffect: External integrations cannot complete their VPN permission request through this Activity; the host app's normal connection prompt remains available.

zh-CN.description: 网易 iTVPN 外部接口需要 Android VPN 授权时，此 Activity 会打开系统确认页并返回用户的选择。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 外部集成将无法通过此 Activity 完成 VPN 授权，但宿主应用正常的连接授权流程仍可使用。

en.description: When an authorized external app uses NetEase iTVPN's connect or disconnect shortcut, this Activity checks the request and starts or stops the selected VPN profile.
en.disableEffect: External apps lose these quick VPN controls; the host app's own controls remain available.

zh-CN.description: 获准的外部应用使用网易 iTVPN 的连接或断开快捷入口时，此 Activity 会检查请求并启动或停止所选 VPN 配置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 外部应用将无法使用这些 VPN 快捷控制，但宿主应用自身的控制仍可使用。

en.description: When the NetEase iTVPN app registers for VPN updates, this service forwards connection state, data usage, and log updates to registered callbacks.
en.disableEffect: The app may no longer receive live VPN status and traffic updates.

zh-CN.description: 网易 iTVPN 应用注册 VPN 更新时，此服务会向已注册的回调转发连接状态、流量统计和日志更新。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用可能无法再收到实时 VPN 状态和流量更新。

en.description: Manojmiyani99's OpenVPN library, also included in Skyjie6's ITVPN SDK, starts this Android VPN service when either SDK connects; it creates the tunnel, keeps it running in the foreground, and provides a disconnect action.
en.disableEffect: Blocking this Service prevents the VPN tunnel from connecting and stops any tunnel it currently runs.

zh-CN.description: Manojmiyani99 的 OpenVPN 库以及 Skyjie6 的 ITVPN SDK 都包含此 Android VPN Service；连接时它会建立并在前台维持隧道，同时提供断开操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，VPN 隧道将无法连接，当前由此 Service 运行的隧道也会停止。

en.description: While the NetEase iTVPN VPN is connecting, this service forwards connection state, traffic, and log events and supports the connection flow when a profile needs saved credentials.
en.disableEffect: The VPN screen can lose connection updates, and profiles that require saved credentials may not connect correctly.

zh-CN.description: 网易 iTVPN VPN 连接过程中，此服务会转发连接状态、流量和日志事件，并支持需要已保存凭据的配置连接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: VPN 界面可能收不到连接状态更新，需要已保存凭据的配置也可能无法正常连接。

en.description: The VoiceControls sample app by Frank Zickert exposes this launcher Activity. It starts a sample delivery request asking what the user wants to order, displays demo callbacks, and then closes.
en.disableEffect: Only the VoiceControls sample launcher flow is removed; the app's normal screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: Frank Zickert 的 VoiceControls 示例应用通过此启动 Activity 展示样例。它会启动一个询问用户想订什么的配送请求，显示演示结果，然后关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，仅 VoiceControls 示例启动流程不可用，应用的正常界面仍可使用。

en.description: VoiceControls by Frank Zickert runs this Service for configured voice forms. It sends answers to the VoiceControls backend and presents follow-up questions as notification prompts that accept replies.
en.disableEffect: Voice form requests that need backend interpretation or follow-up answers will not complete.

zh-CN.description: Frank Zickert 的 VoiceControls 使用此 Service 处理已配置的语音表单。它会将回答发送到 VoiceControls 后端，并通过可回复的通知提出后续问题。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，需要后端解析或后续回答的语音表单请求将无法完成。

en.description: VoiceControls by Frank Zickert starts this Service when the app runs a voice form. It asks form questions through notifications, sends the answers for interpretation, and returns a completed result or cancellation to the app.
en.disableEffect: The app will no longer be able to collect or return answers through VoiceControls forms.

zh-CN.description: 应用运行语音表单时，Frank Zickert 的 VoiceControls 会启动此 Service。它通过通知提出表单问题，发送回答进行解析，并将完成结果或取消状态返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用将无法通过 VoiceControls 表单收集并返回回答。

en.description: The VoiceControls test service by Frank Zickert is used by the SDK's test form when it needs to ask a question. It broadcasts the test prompt for the demo screen to display.
en.disableEffect: Only the VoiceControls test prompt stops; regular voice forms continue using the normal service.

zh-CN.description: Frank Zickert 的 VoiceControls 测试 Service 供 SDK 测试表单提问时使用。它会广播测试问题，供演示界面显示。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，仅 VoiceControls 测试问题无法显示；普通语音表单仍使用常规 Service。

en.description: When the user answers a VoiceControls question from a notification, this Activity receives the spoken or typed reply and returns it to the active form.
en.disableEffect: Answers sent from VoiceControls notifications cannot be returned, so question-and-answer forms will not complete.

zh-CN.description: 用户通过通知回答 VoiceControls 问题时，此 Activity 会接收语音或文字回复，并将其返回正在运行的表单。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，通过 VoiceControls 通知提交的回答无法返回，问答表单将无法完成。

en.description: Docutain SDK Barcode opens this Activity when the app starts a barcode scan. It uses the camera to detect barcode values and returns the scan results to the app.
en.disableEffect: The Docutain barcode-scan screen will not open, so users cannot scan barcodes through that flow.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动条码扫描时，Docutain SDK Barcode 会打开此 Activity。它使用相机识别条码内容并将扫描结果返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用将无法使用 Docutain 单次扫描界面识别条码。

en.description: Docutain SDK Barcode opens this Activity when the app requests a multi-barcode scan. It uses the camera to collect several barcode values and returns them as a list.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot scan and return a batch of barcodes through Docutain.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求批量扫描条码时，Docutain SDK Barcode 会打开此 Activity。它使用相机采集多个条码，并将结果列表返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过 Docutain 批量扫描并返回多个条码。

en.description: Docutain SDK UI opens this Activity for a document-scan request. It guides the user through capturing and reviewing scanned document pages.
en.disableEffect: The app's Docutain document-scanning flow cannot open this screen or complete the scan.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求扫描文档时，Docutain SDK UI 会打开此 Activity。它引导用户拍摄并检查扫描得到的文档页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用的 Docutain 文档扫描流程无法打开此界面或完成扫描。

en.description: Docutain SDK UI opens this Activity while the user edits a scanned document to choose an image filter. The selected filter can be applied to one page or all pages.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot choose or apply image filters to scanned pages through Docutain.

zh-CN.description: 用户编辑扫描文档并选择图像滤镜时，Docutain SDK UI 会打开此 Activity。所选滤镜可应用于单页或全部页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过 Docutain 为扫描页面选择或应用图像滤镜。

en.description: Docutain SDK UI opens this Activity when the user edits a scanned page. It displays the page and lets the user rotate it, delete pages, or open the filter screen.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot rotate, remove or adjust scanned pages through the Docutain editing flow.

zh-CN.description: 用户编辑扫描页面时，Docutain SDK UI 会打开此 Activity。它显示页面，并允许用户旋转页面、删除页面或打开滤镜界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过 Docutain 编辑流程旋转、删除或调整扫描页面。

en.description: Docutain SDK UI opens this Activity when the app offers to create a German bank-transfer GiroCode. The user enters recipient and payment details, and the screen validates them and previews the generated QR code.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot generate a bank-transfer GiroCode from the app.

zh-CN.description: 应用提供德国银行转账 GiroCode 生成功能时，Docutain SDK UI 会打开此 Activity。用户输入收款人和付款信息后，界面会校验内容并预览生成的二维码。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法从应用生成银行转账 GiroCode。

en.description: Docutain SDK UI shows this configured photo-payment introduction when the document scanner has onboarding pages to display and has not shown them before. Users can move through the pages or close the introduction.
en.disableEffect: If the app tries to show the configured introduction, launching this disabled Activity can interrupt the scan flow.

zh-CN.description: 文档扫描器配置了照片付款引导页面且此前尚未展示时，Docutain SDK UI 会显示此介绍界面。用户可以翻阅页面或关闭介绍。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 如果应用尝试显示已配置的介绍，启动这个已停用的 Activity 会中断扫描流程。

en.description: CustomWidgets (Domjos) uses this Receiver for the cancel button on a task progress notification. When the button is tapped, it dismisses the notification and stops the running task.
en.disableEffect: Users can no longer stop a running task from its progress notification.

zh-CN.description: CustomWidgets（Domjos）的 Receiver 用于处理任务进度通知中的取消按钮。用户点按该按钮时，它会关闭通知并停止正在运行的任务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法再从任务进度通知中停止正在运行的任务。

en.description: Identos CardReader Provider (gematik) opens this Activity when a supported Identos USB card reader is attached. It makes the reader available to the app and then closes.
en.disableEffect: The app will not detect newly attached Identos readers, so reading cards through them will fail.

zh-CN.description: Identos CardReader Provider（gematik）会在连接受支持的 Identos USB 读卡器时打开此 Activity。它将读卡器交给应用使用，随后关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法发现新连接的 Identos 读卡器，也就无法通过它读取卡片。

en.description: Unearthed (Hannes Struss) starts this Provider with the app to track when Android restores the app in a new process. It detects that case when an Activity is recreated from saved state.
en.disableEffect: The app will no longer detect when Android recreates it in a new process, which can disrupt recovery behavior that depends on this detection.

zh-CN.description: Unearthed（Hannes Struss）会在应用启动时启用进程恢复跟踪。当 Android 在新进程中根据已保存的状态重新创建 Activity 时，它会识别出这次进程重启。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法再检测 Android 是否在新进程中重新创建了它，依赖此检测的恢复流程可能因此受影响。

en.description: J4velin ColorPicker opens this screen when the user chooses to sample a color from a camera photo. It opens the camera, extracts a small palette from the captured image, and applies the swatch the user taps.
en.disableEffect: Users can no longer sample a color from a camera photo.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择从相机照片取色时，J4velin ColorPicker 会打开此页面。它启动相机，从拍下的图像提取一组颜色，并将用户点选的颜色应用到取色器中。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法再从相机照片中提取颜色。

en.description: PictureChooser (J4velin) opens Android's image picker when the app requests a photo, or its own album browser if a system picker is unavailable. It can show a crop screen and return the selected image to the app.
en.disableEffect: Image selection and cropping flows that use PictureChooser will be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: PictureChooser（J4velin）会在应用请求选择照片时打开 Android 图片选择器；如果系统没有可用的选择器，则显示自带相册浏览器。它还可以打开裁剪页面并将选中的图片返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用 PictureChooser 的图片选择和裁剪流程将无法使用。

en.description: Snappy (Nils Druyen) opens a camera screen when the app requests a quick snapshot. It lets the user take photos and returns the saved image files to the app.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot open this in-app photo capture flow or receive images captured through Snappy.

zh-CN.description: Snappy（Nils Druyen）会在应用请求快速拍照时打开相机界面。用户可以拍摄照片，应用随后会收到保存后的图片文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法打开此拍照流程，也无法接收通过 Snappy 拍摄的图片。

en.description: Ethereum Android Lib (Petendi) uses this Service to return results from asynchronous Ethereum requests. When a response arrives, it passes the result back to the requesting app.
en.disableEffect: The app may never receive the results of asynchronous Ethereum requests.

zh-CN.description: Ethereum Android Lib（Petendi）使用此 Service 返回异步以太坊请求的结果。收到响应后，它会将结果传回发起请求的应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用可能无法收到异步以太坊请求的结果。

en.description: RocketBucket (Rocket Internet) opens this screen when the app asks to inspect its experiments. It fetches the available experiments and shows the current group assignment for each.
en.disableEffect: Users lose the RocketBucket screen for reviewing experiment assignments and opening their settings.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求查看实验时，RocketBucket（Rocket Internet）会打开此界面。它会获取可用实验，并显示每项实验当前分配的组别。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法再通过 RocketBucket 界面查看实验分组或打开相应设置。

en.description: RocketBucket (Rocket Internet) opens this screen after an experiment is selected from the list. It shows the available groups and lets the user keep automatic assignment or choose a group manually.
en.disableEffect: Users can no longer change an experiment between automatic assignment and a manually chosen group.

zh-CN.description: 在实验列表中选择一项后，RocketBucket（Rocket Internet）会打开此界面。它会显示可用组别，并允许用户保留自动分配或手动选择组别。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法再为实验切换自动分配或手动选择组别。

en.description: RocketBucket (Rocket Internet) opens this screen when requested by the app. It loads configured experiments and lists the current group assignment for each.
en.disableEffect: The RocketBucket experiment list will no longer be available in the app.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求查看实验时，RocketBucket（Rocket Internet）会打开此界面。它会加载已配置的实验，并列出每项实验当前分配的组别。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用中将无法再打开 RocketBucket 实验列表。

en.description: Telekom Smart Credentials opens this Activity as part of sign-in after an authorization response returns. It exchanges the returned code for tokens and sends success or cancellation back to the app.
en.disableEffect: The Smart Credentials sign-in flow may fail to finish or return its result to the app.

zh-CN.description: Telekom Smart Credentials 会在授权响应返回后，通过此 Activity 处理登录流程。它会用返回的代码换取令牌，并将成功或取消结果传回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Smart Credentials 登录流程可能无法完成，也可能无法将结果传回应用。

en.description: Telekom Smart Credentials One Click Business opens this Activity when a business recommendation is ready. It loads the One Click portal page with the recommendation and sign-in details.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot open the One Click portal to continue with a business recommendation.

zh-CN.description: 有商务推荐可供查看时，Telekom Smart Credentials One Click Business 会打开此 Activity。它会加载 One Click 门户页面，并附带该推荐和登录所需的信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法打开 One Click 门户来继续处理商务推荐。

en.description: Telekom Smart Credentials starts this Service for Firebase push messages and refreshed device tokens. It forwards enabled messages to the Smart Credentials push handler and refreshes configured notification subscriptions.
en.disableEffect: Push notifications routed through Smart Credentials will not reach the app, and subscription updates from new Firebase tokens will stop.

zh-CN.description: Telekom Smart Credentials 会通过此 Service 接收 Firebase 推送消息和更新后的设备令牌。它会将已启用的消息转交给 Smart Credentials 推送处理程序，并按配置更新通知订阅。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过 Smart Credentials 发送的推送通知将无法到达应用，新 Firebase 令牌对应的订阅更新也会停止。

en.description: When DevUtils shares, opens, or installs a file, this Provider gives Android or the receiving app access through a content link to the file.
en.disableEffect: DevUtils file-sharing, file-opening, and APK-install flows that use this Provider will fail.

zh-CN.description: DevUtils 分享、打开或安装文件时，这个 Provider 会生成内容链接，让 Android 或接收文件的应用读取文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此 Provider 的 DevUtils 文件分享、文件打开和 APK 安装流程将失败。

en.description: Blackbox, Anvith Bhat's crash reporting library, watches saved crash reports in the background after the app initializes it. When a new report is saved, it posts a notification with options to copy, share, or view reports.
en.disableEffect: Disabling this stops Blackbox from watching for new reports and showing its report notifications; the app's ordinary features remain available.

zh-CN.description: Anvith Bhat 的 Blackbox 崩溃报告库会在应用初始化后于后台监视已保存的崩溃报告。出现新报告时，它会显示通知，并提供复制、分享或查看报告的选项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，Blackbox 不再监视新报告或显示相应通知，应用的常规功能仍可使用。

en.description: Blackbox's crash report notification uses this Receiver when you tap Copy, Share, or View all; it copies or shares the report text or opens the saved reports list.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it may leave Blackbox's report buttons working; the app's ordinary features are unaffected.

zh-CN.description: 在 Blackbox 崩溃通知中点按“复制”“分享”或“查看全部”时，此接收器会执行相应操作：复制或分享报告文字，或打开已保存的报告列表。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，Blackbox 的报告按钮可能仍可使用；应用的常规功能不受影响。

en.description: Blackbox opens this screen when you choose View all from a crash report notification. It displays saved crash reports.
en.disableEffect: The notification's View all option can no longer open the report list, and tapping it may fail.

zh-CN.description: 在崩溃通知中选择“查看全部”时，Blackbox 会打开此界面并显示已保存的崩溃报告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，通知中的“查看全部”无法打开报告列表，点按该选项时操作可能失败。

en.description: Location Engine, Arpan Sarkar's location library for Google and Huawei services, opens this Activity when a location request needs permission or a change to the device's location setting. It requests location permission and can show the system prompt to enable location.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents this library's permission and location setup from completing, so app features that rely on its location requests may fail.

zh-CN.description: Arpan Sarkar 的 Location Engine 定位库支持 Google 和华为定位服务；当定位请求需要权限或调整设备定位设置时，它会打开此界面。此界面会请求定位权限，并可显示开启设备定位的系统提示。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，此库无法完成权限和定位设置流程，依赖它获取位置的应用功能可能无法正常工作。

en.description: Firebase Client Messaging, Umang Chamaria's Android push library, runs when Firebase Cloud Messaging delivers a message or updates the device's push token. It passes the message or token update to the app's push handling.
en.disableEffect: Push alerts and updates handled through this library stop reaching the app.

zh-CN.description: Umang Chamaria 的 Firebase Client Messaging Android 推送库会在 Firebase Cloud Messaging 收到消息或更新设备推送令牌时运行，并将消息或令牌更新交给应用的推送处理逻辑。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过此库传递的推送通知和更新将无法到达应用。

en.description: Scrcast, Brandon McAnsh's screen recording library, uses this Receiver when you tap pause, resume, or stop on a recording notification. It sends your choice to the active recording.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it can make the recording notification controls unavailable, so you may not be able to pause, resume, or stop a recording there.

zh-CN.description: Brandon McAnsh 的 Scrcast 屏幕录制库会在你点按录制通知上的暂停、继续或停止时使用此接收器，并将选择传给正在进行的录制。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，录制通知中的控制按钮可能无法使用，你可能无法通过通知暂停、继续或停止录制。

en.description: Scrcast, Brandon McAnsh's screen recording library, starts this foreground Service when the app begins recording the screen. It captures the display to a video file and keeps recording controls available in a notification.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents the app from recording the screen through Scrcast.

zh-CN.description: Brandon McAnsh 的 Scrcast 屏幕录制库会在应用开始录屏时启动此常驻服务，将屏幕画面录制为视频文件，并在通知中提供录制控制。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，应用无法通过 Scrcast 录制屏幕。

en.description: When a user opens a captured data item in DevUtils' HTTP capture viewer, this Activity displays its stored fields and lets them copy a value.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot inspect or copy values from captured request details.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 DevUtils HTTP 捕获查看器中打开一条数据时，这个 Activity 会显示保存的字段并允许复制其中的值。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法查看捕获请求的详细数据或复制其中的值。

en.description: When a user opens a module and date from DevUtils' HTTP capture overview, this Activity lists matching captures and lets them filter by data type or grouping.
en.disableEffect: The filtered list of captured requests will not open.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 DevUtils HTTP 捕获总览中打开某个模块和日期时，这个 Activity 会列出对应记录，并允许按数据类型或分组筛选。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 筛选后的请求记录列表将无法打开。
