zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，此 Kiki Provider 会准备更新服务，供应用检查并展示更新。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Kiki 更新功能可能无法初始化，应用可能无法检查或展示更新。

en.description: When Firebase delivers a push message, FireBots forwards its data to the app; when Firebase issues a new push token, FireBots registers that token.
en.disableEffect: FireBots push messages and token subscriptions will stop, so its notifications may no longer arrive as expected.

zh-CN.description: Firebase 投递推送消息时，FireBots 会把消息数据转交给应用；Firebase 更新推送令牌时，FireBots 会注册新令牌。
zh-CN.disableEffect: FireBots 推送消息和令牌订阅将停止，其通知可能无法正常送达。

en.description: When a user taps a FireBots notification, its pending click action runs this Service, which forwards the notification destination to the app.
en.disableEffect: FireBots notification clicks will no longer be forwarded to the app.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击 FireBots 通知时，通知的点击操作会启动此 Service，并将通知目标转交给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: FireBots 通知点击事件将不再转交给应用。

en.description: When FireBots receives its notification-click broadcast, this Receiver forwards the selected destination to the app’s click callback.
en.disableEffect: FireBots registers a receiver instance for this broadcast, so disabling only the manifest entry does not stop the callback.

zh-CN.description: FireBots 收到通知点击广播时，此 Receiver 会将所选目标转交给应用的点击回调。
zh-CN.disableEffect: FireBots 会为此广播注册接收器实例，因此单独停用清单中的组件不会停止该回调。

en.description: When a user opens the ReportoAndroid report screen and taps send, it packages the user's message with the configured app diagnostics and opens Android's share sheet with the report archive.
en.disableEffect: Users can no longer submit or share diagnostic reports through this screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 ReportoAndroid 报告页面并点击发送时，它会将用户留言和已配置的应用诊断信息打包成报告，并打开 Android 分享面板。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法通过此页面提交或分享诊断报告。

en.description: When the app opens an OpenMobile action, this Activity reads the supplied action and parameters, runs the matching action, and closes.
en.disableEffect: OpenMobile action links or notification actions that depend on this Activity will not run.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开 OpenMobile 操作时，此 Activity 会读取传入的操作和参数，执行对应操作后关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此 Activity 的 OpenMobile 操作链接或通知操作将无法执行。

en.description: When OpenMobile is asked to show a screen described by a layout, this Activity renders that screen and closes when the app sends its finish signal.
en.disableEffect: OpenMobile screens rendered through this Activity will be unavailable, which can interrupt the related app flow.

zh-CN.description: OpenMobile 要显示布局描述的界面时，此 Activity 会渲染该界面，并在应用发出结束信号后关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过此 Activity 显示的 OpenMobile 界面将无法使用，相关应用流程可能中断。

en.description: When EasyUpiPayment starts a payment, this Activity opens a UPI payment app and returns the transaction result or cancellation.
en.disableEffect: UPI payments started through EasyUpiPayment will not open or report their result.

zh-CN.description: EasyUpiPayment 发起付款时，此 Activity 会打开 UPI 支付应用，并返回交易结果或取消状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过 EasyUpiPayment 发起的 UPI 付款将无法打开支付应用或回传结果。

en.description: When the app starts, Advanced Biometric Prompt Compat loads device details and initializes its biometric compatibility checks.
en.disableEffect: Biometric authentication and device-specific compatibility handling may fail to initialize in the app.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，Advanced Biometric Prompt Compat 会读取设备信息并初始化生物识别兼容性检查。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用中的生物识别认证及设备兼容处理可能无法初始化。

en.description: After device boot or an unlock event, Advanced Biometric Prompt Compat checks whether biometric sensor lockout state needs to be reset.
en.disableEffect: Biometric lockout recovery after a restart or unlock will not run, so biometric sign-in may remain unavailable after a lockout.

zh-CN.description: 设备启动或解锁后，Advanced Biometric Prompt Compat 会检查是否需要重置生物识别传感器的锁定状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 重启或解锁后的生物识别锁定恢复将无法运行，发生锁定后生物识别登录可能仍不可用。

en.description: During app startup, Location Kit selects and initializes an available Google, Huawei, or Android location backend.
en.disableEffect: Location Kit requests will have no initialized backend, so app features that rely on this location service can fail.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，Location Kit 会选择并初始化可用的 Google、华为或 Android 定位后端。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Location Kit 将没有已初始化的定位后端，依赖此定位服务的应用功能可能失败。

en.description: During app startup, Map Kit selects a supported maps backend and initializes its map APIs.
en.disableEffect: Map Kit maps and map views will not be initialized, so the app’s map screens may fail when opened.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，Map Kit 会选择受支持的地图后端并初始化地图 API。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Map Kit 地图及地图视图将无法初始化，应用打开地图界面时可能失败。

en.description: Place Kit by Supasin Tatiyanupanwong runs this provider when the app starts to select the Google Places or Huawei Site Kit backend for place lookup. It prepares the library before the app requests place data.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, Place Kit is not initialized, so place lookup can fail and using its place features can crash the app.

zh-CN.description: Supasin Tatiyanupanwong 的 Place Kit 会在应用启动时运行此 Provider，选择用于地点查询的 Google Places 或华为 Site Kit 后端。它会在应用请求地点数据前准备好该库。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Place Kit 不会初始化，地点查询可能失败，调用其地点功能还可能导致应用崩溃。

en.description: The Drifter Unity integration by Teogor opens this Activity when its live wallpaper needs to start Unity content. It checks the Unity version and prepares the player for that screen.
en.disableEffect: The live wallpaper may fail to start because its Unity content cannot be prepared.

zh-CN.description: Teogor 的 Drifter Unity 集成会在动态壁纸需要启动 Unity 内容时打开此 Activity。它会检查 Unity 版本并为该界面准备播放器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 由于无法准备 Unity 内容，动态壁纸可能无法启动。

en.description: The Drifter wallpaper integration by Teogor opens this Activity when the app starts its live wallpaper preview. It prepares the Unity content and opens the Android wallpaper preview screen.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot open its Unity live wallpaper preview through this entry point.

zh-CN.description: Teogor 的 Drifter 壁纸集成会在应用启动动态壁纸预览时打开此 Activity。它会准备 Unity 内容并打开 Android 壁纸预览界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用无法通过此入口打开 Unity 动态壁纸预览。

en.description: Testify Compose is a Compose screenshot testing library. This Activity provides a blank Compose screen for the library to capture during screenshot tests.
en.disableEffect: Testify Compose screenshot tests that use this screen cannot launch.

zh-CN.description: Testify Compose 是一个 Compose 截图测试库。此 Activity 提供空白的 Compose 界面，供该库在截图测试中捕获内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此界面的 Testify Compose 截图测试将无法启动。

en.description: When a DevUtils action needs to return a result, this Activity runs that action and sends the outcome back to the app feature that requested it.
en.disableEffect: App features using DevUtils result-returning actions may stop receiving results or fail to complete.

zh-CN.description: DevUtils 执行需要返回结果的操作时，这个 Activity 会运行该操作，并把结果交还给发起操作的应用功能。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖 DevUtils 返回操作结果的应用功能可能无法收到结果或完成操作。

en.description: When a DevUtils caller starts an action that must return a result, this Activity handles the action and gives the outcome back to the caller.
en.disableEffect: Features using this DevUtils result flow may stop receiving results or fail to complete.

zh-CN.description: DevUtils 调用需要返回结果的操作时，这个 Activity 会处理该操作，并将结果交还给调用方。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此 DevUtils 结果流程的功能可能无法收到结果或完成操作。

en.description: When DevUtils requests a runtime permission through its managed permission flow, this Activity shows Android's permission prompt and returns the user's choice.
en.disableEffect: Features that request permissions through this flow cannot receive the permission result and may not work.

zh-CN.description: DevUtils 通过其权限流程请求运行时权限时，这个 Activity 会显示 Android 权限提示，并返回用户的选择。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过此流程请求权限的功能无法收到权限结果，可能因此无法正常工作。

en.description: The Devliving CVScanner library opens this screen to scan an ID or passport; it requests camera access and returns the processed image path.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot scan identity documents or passports with CVScanner.

zh-CN.description: Devliving 的 CVScanner 库会打开此页面扫描身份证件或护照；页面请求相机权限并返回处理后的图像路径。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法使用 CVScanner 扫描身份证件或护照。

en.description: The Devliving CVScanner library opens this screen to crop or rotate an existing scan image; saving returns the processed image path.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot finish manual cropping or rotation of scanned images.

zh-CN.description: Devliving 的 CVScanner 库会打开此页面裁剪或旋转已有扫描图像；保存后会返回处理后的图像路径。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法完成扫描图像的手动裁剪或旋转。

en.description: The Devliving CVScanner file provider gives the camera app temporary access to save document-scan photos through a content link.
en.disableEffect: The camera app may be unable to save a scan photo, breaking CVScanner's camera-capture flow.

zh-CN.description: Devliving 的 CVScanner 文件提供程序通过临时内容链接，让相机应用可以保存证件扫描照片。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 相机应用可能无法保存扫描照片，从而导致 CVScanner 的相机拍摄流程失败。

en.description: The Devliving MVBarcodeReader SDK opens this camera screen to scan the requested barcode formats and returns one or more scanned codes to the app.
en.disableEffect: Barcode scanning through MVBarcodeReader will not work.

zh-CN.description: Devliving 的 MVBarcodeReader SDK 会打开此相机页面扫描指定格式的条码，并将一个或多个扫描结果返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: MVBarcodeReader 的条码扫描将无法使用。

en.description: Tail Mobile SDK by Tail Digital handles background Google Nearby beacon detections and records the beacon identifier with available location data for Tail. It runs when Android delivers a beacon message while the app is in the background.
en.disableEffect: Tail will stop receiving and recording background beacon detections.

zh-CN.description: Tail Digital 的 Tail Mobile SDK 会处理 Google Nearby 在后台检测到的信标，并将信标标识及可用位置信息记录到 Tail。应用在后台收到信标消息时会运行此 Receiver。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Tail 将不再接收和记录后台信标检测信息。

en.description: Tail Mobile SDK by Tail Digital handles Android startup after a reboot, reloads its saved data, and resumes beacon scanning when tracking is enabled.
en.disableEffect: Tail beacon tracking will not automatically resume after the device restarts.

zh-CN.description: Tail Digital 的 Tail Mobile SDK 会在设备重启并启动后读取已保存的数据，并在信标追踪已启用时恢复扫描。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 设备重启后，Tail 信标追踪将无法自动恢复。

en.description: Tail Mobile SDK by Tail Digital runs this Service for scheduled jobs that collect saved SDK error logs and send them to Tail. Android starts it when the scheduled log job is due.
en.disableEffect: Tail scheduled error log collection and reporting will stop.

zh-CN.description: Tail Digital 的 Tail Mobile SDK 会通过此 Service 定期收集已保存的 SDK 错误日志并发送给 Tail。日志任务到期时由 Android 启动此服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Tail 将停止定期收集和上报错误日志。

en.description: BlueNote by Nodes opens this Activity when an app requests BLE setup. It checks Bluetooth support, asks the user to enable Bluetooth when needed, and requests location access used for nearby device scanning.
en.disableEffect: Apps using BlueNote may be unable to finish Bluetooth and location permission setup, so nearby device discovery or connection can fail.

zh-CN.description: Nodes 的 BlueNote 会在应用请求设置 BLE 时打开此 Activity。它会检查蓝牙支持情况，必要时提示用户开启蓝牙，并请求附近设备扫描所需的位置权限。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用 BlueNote 的应用可能无法完成蓝牙和位置权限设置，附近设备发现或连接可能失败。

en.description: Nodes FilePicker opens the camera or Android file chooser when an app asks the user to take a photo or select files. It returns the chosen media location to the calling screen.
en.disableEffect: Apps that use this picker cannot complete their camera or file selection flow.

zh-CN.description: Nodes FilePicker 会在应用要求用户拍照或选择文件时打开相机或 Android 文件选择器，并将所选媒体的位置返回给调用界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此选择器的应用将无法完成拍照或文件选择流程。

en.description: This Nodes FilePicker example Activity presents camera and file-selection options and shows the returned result.
en.disableEffect: The FilePicker usage demo cannot be opened.

zh-CN.description: Nodes FilePicker 的此示例 Activity 会展示拍照和文件选择选项，并显示返回结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: FilePicker 的使用示例将无法打开。

en.description: The legacy NStack SDK by Nodes reads the app ID and API key from manifest settings when the app starts, then initializes NStack if both are present. NStack supplies remote translations and app content.
en.disableEffect: NStack translation, content, or update features may not initialize, and code that uses NStack before initialization can crash.

zh-CN.description: Nodes 的旧版 NStack SDK 会在应用启动时读取清单中的应用 ID 和 API 密钥，并在两者都存在时初始化 NStack。NStack 提供远程翻译和应用内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: NStack 的翻译、内容或更新功能可能无法初始化，未初始化前使用 NStack 的代码还可能导致应用崩溃。

en.description: The NStack Kotlin SDK by Nodes opens this Activity for the app feedback form and sends the name, email, and message entered by the user to NStack when submitted.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot submit feedback through the NStack form.

zh-CN.description: Nodes 的 NStack Kotlin SDK 会通过此 Activity 打开应用反馈表单，并在提交时将用户姓名、邮箱和留言发送给 NStack。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 NStack 表单提交反馈。

en.description: Nodes OkHttp Utils opens this screen after a configured HTTP error or network failure to show the error message; confirming it closes the screen and may close the app when the configured response requests that.
en.disableEffect: Network-error dialogs from this SDK stop appearing, and its attempt to open the disabled screen can fail.

zh-CN.description: Nodes OkHttp Utils 会在配置的 HTTP 错误或网络请求失败后打开此界面显示错误信息；用户确认后界面会关闭，部分配置还会结束应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，SDK 无法显示网络错误界面，尝试打开该界面的错误处理流程也可能失败。

en.description: At app startup, the Nodes OkHttp Utils Provider stores the app context used to open its network-error screen.
en.disableEffect: Without this startup context, requests that need the error screen can fail while the SDK tries to display it.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，Nodes OkHttp Utils 的 Provider 会保存用于打开网络错误界面的应用上下文。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 缺少这份启动时保存的上下文后，SDK 尝试显示网络错误界面时，请求错误处理可能失败。

en.description: When a user starts Bluetooth setup in the DouTing Hearing SDK, this Activity lists paired supported headsets, scans for nearby supported devices, and pairs or connects the selected headset. It returns the connected device to the hearing-test flow.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot pair or connect a supported hearing headset through this SDK, so the Bluetooth headset test setup will fail.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 DouTing Hearing SDK 中启动蓝牙设置时，此 Activity 会列出已配对的兼容耳机、搜索附近的兼容设备，并配对或连接所选耳机。连接完成后，它会将设备信息返回听力测试流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法通过此 SDK 配对或连接兼容的听力耳机，因此蓝牙耳机测试的设置流程会失败。

en.description: When an app opens the DouTing Hearing SDK headset screen, this Activity shows headset setup, connection, purchase, and support choices, and can launch a hearing test or the saved test list.
en.disableEffect: The SDK headset setup, saved-record entry, and hearing-test route will no longer be available from this screen.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开 DouTing Hearing SDK 的耳机界面时，此 Activity 会显示耳机设置、连接、购买和客服选项，并可启动听力测试或打开已保存的测试记录。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 此界面将无法再提供 SDK 耳机设置、已保存记录入口或听力测试入口。

en.description: From the DouTing Hearing SDK headset menu, this Activity retrieves saved hearing-test records and opens the result for a selected record.
en.disableEffect: Users can no longer open saved hearing-test records from the DouTing SDK record list.

zh-CN.description: 此 Activity 会从 DouTing Hearing SDK 获取已保存的听力测试记录，并打开用户选中记录的结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法再从 DouTing SDK 的记录列表打开已保存的听力测试记录。

en.description: When a DouTing Hearing SDK test finishes or a saved record is selected, this Activity displays left- and right-ear results as a chart and text summary.
en.disableEffect: The SDK cannot show the hearing assessment chart and summary after a new test or when a saved record is opened.

zh-CN.description: DouTing Hearing SDK 的测试完成或用户选中已保存记录时，此 Activity 会以图表和文字摘要展示左右耳的听力结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: SDK 无法在新测试完成后或打开已保存记录时显示听力评估图表和摘要。

en.description: When the user starts a DouTing Hearing SDK assessment, this Activity plays test tones and records whether they are heard for each ear. It displays progress on a chart and opens the completed result.
en.disableEffect: The headset assessment stops working because this screen plays tones, records responses, and completes the test flow.

zh-CN.description: 用户启动 DouTing Hearing SDK 评估时，此 Activity 会播放测试音，并记录左右耳是否听到声音。它会在图表上显示进度，并打开完成后的测试结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 此界面负责播放测试音、记录听力反馈并完成测试流程；停用后耳机听力评估将无法进行。

en.description: Bringg Driver SDK sends queued beacon, task, and task-broadcast events to Bringg's analytics service in the background.
en.disableEffect: Bringg analytics events will no longer be uploaded.

zh-CN.description: Bringg Driver SDK 在后台向 Bringg 分析服务发送排队的信标、任务和任务广播事件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Bringg 分析事件将不再上传。

en.description: Bringg Driver SDK displays an ongoing notification while a long-running request continues in the background.
en.disableEffect: Long-running Bringg requests may not stay active in the foreground or finish.

zh-CN.description: Bringg Driver SDK 在长时间运行的请求持续处理时显示通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Bringg 的长时间运行请求可能无法保持前台运行或完成。

en.description: Bringg Driver SDK uses this service to keep pending network work moving in the background.
en.disableEffect: Bringg's queued network work may stop advancing.

zh-CN.description: Bringg Driver SDK 使用此服务继续处理后台待发送的网络更新。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Bringg 排队的网络请求可能无法继续推进。

en.description: Bringg Driver SDK uses this service to send app updates and retry them after network failures.
en.disableEffect: Bringg requests may not run or retry, which can leave driver data unsynchronized.

zh-CN.description: Bringg Driver SDK 使用此服务发送应用更新，并在网络失败后重试。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Bringg 请求可能无法执行或重试，导致司机数据无法同步。

en.description: Bringg Driver SDK processes detected activity changes and updates the app about the driver’s activity state.
en.disableEffect: Bringg will stop receiving activity changes used by driver workflows.

zh-CN.description: Bringg Driver SDK 处理检测到的活动变化，并向应用更新司机的活动状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Bringg 将无法收到司机流程使用的活动状态变化。

en.description: Bringg Driver SDK handles geofence entry or exit results and sends each triggered geofence identifier to its receiver.
en.disableEffect: Bringg will miss geofence events, so location-based task updates may not occur.

zh-CN.description: Bringg Driver SDK 处理进入或离开地理围栏的结果，并将触发的围栏标识交给接收方。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Bringg 将无法收到地理围栏事件，基于位置的任务更新可能不会发生。

en.description: Bringg Driver SDK displays an ongoing notification while shift-related work is active.
en.disableEffect: Bringg may not keep shift work active or report its start and end to the app.

zh-CN.description: Bringg Driver SDK 在班次相关工作进行时显示持续通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Bringg 可能无法保持班次任务运行，或向应用回报班次服务的开始和结束。

en.description: Bringg Driver SDK displays an ongoing notification while data synchronization is active.
en.disableEffect: Bringg may not keep synchronization work active or report its start and end.

zh-CN.description: Bringg Driver SDK 在数据同步期间显示持续通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Bringg 可能无法保持同步任务运行，或回报同步服务的开始和结束。

en.description: When Firebase delivers a CleverTap push, RenderMax helps the SDK finish displaying the notification.
en.disableEffect: Some CleverTap push notifications may not appear or may take longer to display.

zh-CN.description: Firebase 送达 CleverTap 推送时，RenderMax 会协助 SDK 完成通知显示。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 部分 CleverTap 推送可能无法显示，或显示延迟。

en.description: Boybeak EasySAFR uses this helper when it must open another app or system screen and return its result to the app.
en.disableEffect: Any app flow using EasySAFR to open another screen and receive its result can no longer complete.

zh-CN.description: Boybeak EasySAFR 需要打开其他应用或系统页面并将结果返回应用时，会使用此辅助页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 任何依赖 EasySAFR 打开其他页面并接收返回结果的流程都将无法完成。

en.description: When Edna Chat Center opens or shares a message file, this FileProvider creates a content link that lets the receiving screen or app read it.
en.disableEffect: Chat attachment and diagnostic-file sharing paths that use these links may fail.

zh-CN.description: Edna Chat Center 打开或分享消息文件时，会通过此 FileProvider 创建接收界面或应用可读取的内容链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖这些链接的聊天附件和诊断文件分享功能可能会失败。

en.description: When a host app opens Edna Chat Center, this Activity displays the chat conversation screen.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot open its embedded chat screen through this SDK.

zh-CN.description: 宿主应用打开 Edna Chat Center 时，此 Activity 会显示聊天会话界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法通过此 SDK 打开内嵌的聊天界面。

en.description: When a user opens an image attachment in Edna Chat Center, this Activity shows the selected image and allows saving it to the Downloads folder.
en.disableEffect: The chat image preview and its download action stop working.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 Edna Chat Center 中的图片附件时，此 Activity 会显示所选图片，并提供保存到“下载”文件夹的操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 聊天图片预览和下载操作将无法使用。

en.description: When an Edna Chat Center feature asks for Android permissions, this Activity shows the system prompt and can take the user to app settings after denial.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot complete permission requests used by chat attachment features.

zh-CN.description: Edna Chat Center 功能需要申请 Android 权限时，此 Activity 会显示系统权限提示；若用户拒绝，还可引导其打开应用设置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法完成聊天附件功能所需的权限请求。

en.description: When Android reports a battery or charging change, the Maybe Android library receiver writes the event type to its debug log.
en.disableEffect: Only these battery-state log entries stop; the inspected code shows no user-facing battery action.

zh-CN.description: Android 报告电量或充电状态变化时，Maybe Android Library 的接收器会把事件类型写入调试日志。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后只会停止记录这些电池状态日志；检查到的代码没有面向用户的电池操作。

en.description: When Android finishes starting or the Maybe Android library requests a refresh, this receiver starts backend synchronization and schedules repeated pulls.
en.disableEffect: Maybe background synchronization will no longer restart or reschedule from those broadcasts.

zh-CN.description: Android 启动完成或 Maybe Android Library 请求刷新时，此接收器会启动后端同步并安排后续定期拉取。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Maybe 的后台同步将不再由这些广播重新启动或安排。

en.description: When Android broadcasts a network-connectivity change, the Maybe Android library receiver records the event type in its debug log.
en.disableEffect: Only these connectivity log entries stop in the inspected version.

zh-CN.description: Android 广播网络连接状态变化时，Maybe Android Library 的接收器会把事件类型写入调试日志。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 在检查的版本中，停用后只会停止记录这些连接状态日志。

en.description: When Maybe starts it with a log-upload request, the Maybe Android library reads a cached log file and sends its entries to the Maybe backend.
en.disableEffect: Maybe log uploads through this task stop, while the host app's screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: Maybe Android Library 收到日志上传请求时，会读取缓存日志文件并将内容发送到 Maybe 后端。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Maybe 将无法通过此任务上传日志，但宿主应用的界面仍可使用。

en.description: When a Maybe backend push arrives, this Service displays a notification and starts a backend sync.
en.disableEffect: Maybe push notices and the sync they trigger stop; the host app's other screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: 收到 Maybe 后端推送时，此 Service 会显示通知并启动后端同步。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Maybe 推送通知及其触发的同步将停止；宿主应用的其他界面仍可使用。

en.description: When Google Cloud Messaging refreshes its token, this Maybe Service clears the old registration and starts a backend sync.
en.disableEffect: Maybe's push registration will not be refreshed through this callback, so push-triggered updates can stop.

zh-CN.description: Google Cloud Messaging 刷新令牌时，此 Maybe Service 会清除旧注册信息并启动后端同步。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 此回调不再更新 Maybe 的推送注册信息，因此由推送触发的更新可能停止。

en.description: The BumptechLab Shell SDK opens this screen when the app starts a game session; it runs the game and handles commands and return navigation.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open or interact with the SDK's game screen if this Activity is disabled.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动游戏时，BumptechLab Shell SDK 会打开此界面运行游戏，并处理游戏操作和返回导航。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法打开或操作此 SDK 的游戏界面。

en.description: The BumptechLab Shell SDK opens this screen when an app feature requests a web page; it loads the requested address inside the app and supports back navigation.
en.disableEffect: Web pages opened through this SDK will no longer be available if disabled.

zh-CN.description: 应用功能请求打开网页时，BumptechLab Shell SDK 会在应用内载入该网页，并支持返回浏览。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，通过此 SDK 打开的网页将无法使用。

en.description: When LaunchSDK runs a queued app-launch task, this short-lived Activity records the launch, clears its temporary notification, and signals task completion.
en.disableEffect: LaunchSDK app-launch tasks may not complete or record their result.

zh-CN.description: LaunchSDK 执行排队的应用启动任务时，此短暂 Activity 会记录启动、清除临时通知并通知任务完成。
zh-CN.disableEffect: LaunchSDK 的应用启动任务可能无法完成或记录结果。

en.description: When an app requests a Bluetooth printer connection or sends print data, the EasyPrinter Service connects to the selected printer and sends the print bytes.
en.disableEffect: Bluetooth printing through this library stops, so app flows that depend on it cannot print.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求连接蓝牙打印机或发送打印数据时，EasyPrinter Service 会连接所选打印机并发送打印内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 此库提供的蓝牙打印将停止，依赖它的应用流程将无法打印。

en.description: GeoTecINIT BackgroundSensors starts this service when an app binds or starts it to collect configured device sensors in the background; it keeps the recorder active with a foreground notification.
en.disableEffect: The app will no longer collect its configured device-sensor readings through BackgroundSensors.

zh-CN.description: 应用绑定或启动此服务以在后台采集所配置的设备传感器时，GeoTecINIT BackgroundSensors 会开始记录，并显示持续运行的通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用将无法通过 BackgroundSensors 采集所配置的设备传感器数据。

en.description: When an app requests sensor recordings with network-time-aligned timestamps, GeoTecINIT BackgroundSensors starts this service and tries to synchronize its clock with an NTP server first; if that fails, it uses the device clock.
en.disableEffect: The app will no longer be able to record sensor data with network-synchronized timestamps through this service.

zh-CN.description: 应用需要记录与网络时间对齐的传感器数据时，GeoTecINIT BackgroundSensors 会启动此服务并先尝试与 NTP 服务器校时；校时失败时会改用设备时钟。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用将无法通过此服务记录带有网络同步时间戳的传感器数据。

en.description: When a Wear OS watch sends a message through Google Play services, GeoTecINIT WearOS Sensors receives capability requests and forwards accelerometer, gyroscope, magnetometer, heart-rate, location, and plain messages to the app.
en.disableEffect: The app will no longer receive sensor readings or messages sent from the watch.

zh-CN.description: Wear OS 手表通过 Google Play 服务发送消息时，GeoTecINIT WearOS Sensors 会接收能力查询，并把加速度、陀螺仪、磁力计、心率、位置和普通消息转交给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用将无法收到手表发送的传感器读数和消息。

en.description: When an app records data from a Wear OS device, GeoTecINIT WearOS Sensors starts this service and routes the background recording through its wearable-sensor collector.
en.disableEffect: The app will no longer record sensor readings from its Wear OS device through this service.

zh-CN.description: 应用记录 Wear OS 设备的数据时，GeoTecINIT WearOS Sensors 会启动此服务，并通过可穿戴设备的传感器采集器执行后台记录。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用将无法通过此服务记录 Wear OS 设备的传感器数据。

en.description: ExtScreen's Android audio module binds this Service when the app requests audio playback. It plays audio and handles controls such as pause, seeking, and volume.
en.disableEffect: Audio that the app routes through this ExtScreen player will fail to start or respond to playback controls.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求播放音频时，ExtScreen 的 Android 音频模块会绑定此 Service。它负责播放音频并处理暂停、定位和音量等控制。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用通过此 ExtScreen 播放器播放的音频将无法启动或响应播放控制。

en.description: ExtScreen's IJK audio module loads its playback engine and binds this Service for audio playback and controls. It reports playback state and errors to the app.
en.disableEffect: Audio routed through ExtScreen's IJK player will fail to start or respond to playback controls.

zh-CN.description: ExtScreen 的 IJK 音频模块会加载播放引擎并绑定此 Service，以播放音频和处理播放控制。它还会向应用报告播放状态和错误。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过 ExtScreen IJK 播放器播放的音频将无法启动或响应播放控制。

en.description: At app startup, Codlab Kotlin File Access saves the Android app context and private data directory that its file utilities use.
en.disableEffect: File operations that rely on this library may fail because its Android storage context was not initialized.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，Codlab Kotlin File Access 会保存 Android 应用上下文和私有数据目录，供文件工具使用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此库的文件操作可能因 Android 存储上下文未初始化而失败。

en.description: At app startup, the older Codlab Kotlin Permissions library saves the app context used by its runtime permission checks and requests.
en.disableEffect: Permission checks or prompts that rely on this library may fail because its app context was not initialized.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，旧版 Codlab Kotlin Permissions 会保存运行时权限检查和申请所需的应用上下文。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此库的权限检查或申请可能因应用上下文未初始化而失败。

en.description: At app startup, Codlab Kotlin Permissions saves the app context used by its runtime permission checks and requests.
en.disableEffect: Permission checks or prompts that rely on this library may fail because its app context was not initialized.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，Codlab Kotlin Permissions 会保存运行时权限检查和申请所需的应用上下文。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此库的权限检查或申请可能因应用上下文未初始化而失败。

en.description: At app startup, Codlab's Sentry wrapper stores the app context that its error-reporting setup uses.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it can make the wrapper's initialization fail and stop crash reports from being recorded.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，Codlab 的 Sentry 封装会保存错误报告初始化所需的应用上下文。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，该封装的初始化可能失败，崩溃报告也将无法记录。

en.description: The European Commission's EUDI RQES UI library uses this FileProvider to share cached downloads and completed signed PDF files.
en.disableEffect: Users may be unable to open or share PDF files produced by the signature flow.

zh-CN.description: 欧盟委员会的 EUDI RQES UI 库使用此 FileProvider 分享缓存的下载文件和已签署的 PDF 文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户可能无法打开或分享签名流程生成的 PDF 文件。

en.description: When the host app launches the European Commission's EUDI RQES UI, this Activity shows the requested remote-signature screens, including service-provider or certificate selection and completion.
en.disableEffect: The app's qualified-signature flow cannot open, so users cannot continue signing with this library.

zh-CN.description: 宿主应用启动欧盟委员会的 EUDI RQES UI 时，此 Activity 会显示所需的远程签名界面，包括服务提供方或证书选择以及完成页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用的合格电子签名流程将无法打开，用户无法继续使用此库签名。

en.description: When the Genome Payment SDK starts checkout, this Activity displays its payment flow and opens the bank's 3-D Secure verification screen when required.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot complete payment or required bank verification through this SDK.

zh-CN.description: Genome Payment SDK 启动结账时，此 Activity 会显示支付流程，并在需要时打开银行的 3-D Secure 验证界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此 SDK 完成支付或所需的银行验证。

en.description: When Google Cloud Messaging delivers a push to an app using Inloop EasyGCM, this Receiver passes the message to the app for handling.
en.disableEffect: Blocking it stops the app from receiving background messages through Inloop EasyGCM.

zh-CN.description: Google 云消息服务向使用 Inloop EasyGCM 的应用发送推送时，此接收器会把消息交给应用处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用将无法通过 Inloop EasyGCM 接收后台推送消息。

en.description: After Inloop EasyGCM receives a Google Cloud Messaging message, this Service passes its type and contents to the app’s configured message handler.
en.disableEffect: Blocking it stops the app from processing background messages through Inloop EasyGCM.

zh-CN.description: Inloop EasyGCM 收到 Google 云消息服务的推送后，此服务会把消息类型和内容交给应用设置的处理程序。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用将无法通过 Inloop EasyGCM 处理后台推送消息。

en.description: After the app is updated, this Inloop EasyGCM Receiver registers it for push messages again.
en.disableEffect: Push messages may not resume after an app update until the app registers with Google again.

zh-CN.description: 应用更新后，此 Inloop EasyGCM 接收器会让应用重新注册推送服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用更新后可能无法恢复推送，直到再次完成注册。

en.description: When an app starts account linking with the Kevin. Accounts SDK, this Activity guides the user through connecting a bank account and returns the result when they finish or cancel.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot open or complete its Kevin. account-linking flow.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动 Kevin. Accounts SDK 的账户关联流程时，此页面会引导用户连接银行账户，并在用户完成或取消后把结果返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用无法打开或完成 Kevin. 的账户关联流程。

en.description: When an app starts a payment with the Kevin. In-App Payments SDK, this Activity presents the payment steps and returns the result when the user finishes or cancels.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot complete in-app payments through Kevin.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动 Kevin. In-App Payments SDK 的支付流程时，此页面会显示支付步骤，并在完成或取消后把结果返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用无法通过 Kevin. 完成应用内支付。

en.description: When the app starts a NETS Easy Checkout (MiA) payment, this Activity displays the checkout page and handles completion, cancellation, and returns from bank verification or a wallet app.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot display or complete NETS Easy Checkout payments.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动 NETS Easy Checkout (MiA) 支付时，此页面会显示结账网页，并处理支付完成、取消以及从银行验证或钱包应用返回的流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用无法显示或完成 NETS Easy Checkout 支付。

en.description: When the app starts a NETS Easy Checkout (MiA) payment, this Activity displays the checkout page and handles completion, cancellation, and returns from bank verification or a wallet app.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot display or complete NETS Easy Checkout payments.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动 NETS Easy Checkout (MiA) 支付时，此页面会显示结账网页，并处理支付完成、取消以及从银行验证或钱包应用返回的流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用无法显示或完成 NETS Easy Checkout 支付。

en.description: When NETS Netaxept (PiA) opens its card-entry screen, this Activity scans a payment card with the camera and offers manual entry if scanning is unavailable.
en.disableEffect: The SDK cannot open this card-scanning and manual-entry screen, which may prevent a card payment from continuing.

zh-CN.description: NETS Netaxept (PiA) 打开银行卡录入页面时，此页面会调用摄像头扫描卡片；无法扫描时，还可改为手动输入卡片信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，SDK 无法打开此银行卡扫描和手动录入页面，可能导致银行卡支付无法继续。

en.description: When the app starts a card transaction with NETS Netaxept (PiA), this Activity displays the card form and transaction details, then returns the payment result.
en.disableEffect: The app’s NETS Netaxept card-payment screen will not open, so those card transactions cannot be completed.

zh-CN.description: 应用通过 NETS Netaxept (PiA) 开始银行卡交易时，此页面会显示银行卡表单和交易信息，并把支付结果返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用的 NETS Netaxept 银行卡支付页面无法打开，因此无法完成这类交易。

en.description: When a supported wallet returns during a NETS Netaxept (PiA) payment, this Activity reads the return status and passes it back to checkout.
en.disableEffect: A wallet may not be able to return the user to checkout, leaving that payment incomplete.

zh-CN.description: NETS Netaxept (PiA) 支付从受支持的钱包返回时，此页面会读取返回状态并交回结账流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，钱包可能无法将用户带回结账页面，导致该笔支付无法完成。

en.description: When NETS Netaxept (PiA) starts a PayPal payment, this Activity displays the PayPal checkout page and returns its result to the app.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot complete PayPal payments through NETS Netaxept.

zh-CN.description: NETS Netaxept (PiA) 开始 PayPal 支付时，此页面会显示 PayPal 网页结账，并将结果返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用无法通过 NETS Netaxept 完成 PayPal 支付。

en.description: When NETS Netaxept (PiA) starts a Paytrail payment, this Activity opens the provider’s web checkout for the merchant and transaction, then returns the result to the app.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot complete Paytrail checkout through NETS Netaxept.

zh-CN.description: NETS Netaxept (PiA) 开始 Paytrail 支付时，此页面会打开对应商户和交易的网页结账，并把结果返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用无法通过 NETS Netaxept 完成 Paytrail 网页结账。

en.description: When a NETS Netaxept (PiA) card payment requires 3-D Secure verification, this Activity displays the verification page and can open the BankID app when needed.
en.disableEffect: The app may be unable to complete card payments that require 3-D Secure verification.

zh-CN.description: NETS Netaxept (PiA) 银行卡支付需要 3-D Secure 验证时，此页面会显示验证网页，并可在需要时打开 BankID 应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用可能无法完成需要 3-D Secure 验证的银行卡支付。

en.description: When NETS Netaxept (PiA) uses MobilePay for a payment, this Activity opens the MobilePay app and handles the return after authorization.
en.disableEffect: MobilePay payments through NETS Netaxept cannot return to the app and complete.

zh-CN.description: NETS Netaxept (PiA) 使用 MobilePay 支付时，此页面会打开 MobilePay 应用，并处理用户授权后的返回结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，MobilePay 无法将支付结果返回 NETS Netaxept，相关交易可能无法完成。

en.description: When a NETS Netaxept (PiA) test-mode payment uses MobilePay, this Activity opens the wallet app for the test payment and returns its result to the app.
en.disableEffect: The test-mode MobilePay payment cannot return its result to checkout; the regular MobilePay route uses a separate Activity.

zh-CN.description: NETS Netaxept (PiA) 测试环境使用 MobilePay 支付时，此页面会打开钱包应用处理测试支付，并把结果返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，测试环境中的 MobilePay 支付无法将结果返回结账；正式 MobilePay 流程使用单独页面。

en.description: When NETS Netaxept (PiA) uses Swish for a payment, this Activity opens the Swish app and handles the return to checkout.
en.disableEffect: Swish payments through NETS Netaxept may not return to checkout or complete.

zh-CN.description: NETS Netaxept (PiA) 使用 Swish 支付时，此页面会打开 Swish 应用并处理返回结账的流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Swish 支付可能无法返回结账或完成。

en.description: When NETS Netaxept (PiA) uses Vipps for a payment, this Activity opens the Vipps app and handles the return to checkout.
en.disableEffect: Vipps payments through NETS Netaxept may not return to checkout or complete.

zh-CN.description: NETS Netaxept (PiA) 使用 Vipps 支付时，此页面会打开 Vipps 应用并处理返回结账的流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Vipps 支付可能无法返回结账或完成。

en.description: When a NETS Netaxept (PiA) test-mode payment uses Vipps, this Activity opens the wallet app for the test payment and returns its result to the app.
en.disableEffect: The test-mode Vipps payment cannot return its result to checkout; the regular Vipps route uses a separate Activity.

zh-CN.description: NETS Netaxept (PiA) 测试环境使用 Vipps 支付时，此页面会打开钱包应用处理测试支付，并把结果返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，测试环境中的 Vipps 支付无法将结果返回结账；正式 Vipps 流程使用单独页面。

en.description: When a user taps controls on a EuroMessage push-notification carousel, this receiver changes the displayed card and records notification opens.
en.disableEffect: EuroMessage carousel controls and push-open reporting may stop working.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击 EuroMessage 推送通知轮播控件时，此接收器会切换显示卡片并记录通知打开情况。
zh-CN.disableEffect: EuroMessage 轮播控件和推送打开记录可能停止工作。

en.description: When a EuroMessage push notification is opened, this service records the open and launches the app screen configured to receive the message, or the app's launch screen.
en.disableEffect: Tapping EuroMessage notifications may no longer record the open or navigate into the app.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 EuroMessage 推送通知时，此服务会记录打开情况，并启动配置好的消息页面或应用首页。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 点击 EuroMessage 通知时可能不再记录打开情况，也可能无法进入应用。

en.description: When the app starts Atomic Financial Transact, this Activity hosts the interactive financial setup flow and remains open while the user completes or exits it.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open or complete Atomic Financial Transact sessions offered by the app.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动 Atomic Financial Transact 时，此页面会显示交互式金融设置流程，并在用户完成或退出前保持打开。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开或完成应用提供的 Atomic Financial Transact 流程。

en.description: When an app opens an Atomic Financial Transact session, this Service keeps the financial session available and presents its screens when requested.
en.disableEffect: The app’s Atomic Financial Transact screens and sessions may fail to open or continue.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开 Atomic Financial Transact 会话时，此服务会维持金融服务会话，并按需显示相关页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用提供的 Atomic Financial Transact 页面和会话可能无法启动或继续。

en.description: Feed.fm’s music SDK keeps a media session, background playback notification, and system playback controls connected to its audio player while tracks are playing.
en.disableEffect: Feed.fm playback notifications and system media controls will no longer be available.

zh-CN.description: Feed.fm 音乐 SDK 在曲目播放时维持媒体会话、后台播放通知，并将系统播放控件连接到音频播放器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Feed.fm 的播放通知和系统媒体控件将无法使用。

en.description: The Feed.fm music SDK uses this service to choose a station, fetch tracks, and play them in the background with a media notification.
en.disableEffect: Feed.fm stations and their audio tracks will no longer play through the SDK.

zh-CN.description: Feed.fm 音乐 SDK 通过此服务选择电台、获取曲目并在后台播放，同时显示媒体通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Feed.fm 电台及其中的音频曲目将无法通过 SDK 播放。

en.description: The Feeligo sticker SDK opens its sticker store and loads the available sticker packs for the user to browse.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to open the Feeligo sticker store.

zh-CN.description: Feeligo 贴纸 SDK 会打开贴纸商店并加载可供用户浏览的贴纸包。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开 Feeligo 贴纸商店。

en.description: The Feeligo sticker SDK shows details and previews for a selected sticker pack and lets the user add or remove it.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to review, add, or remove sticker packs from this page.

zh-CN.description: Feeligo 贴纸 SDK 会展示所选贴纸包的详情和预览，并允许用户添加或移除贴纸包。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在此页面查看、添加或移除贴纸包。

en.description: When a compatible USB controller is attached, the Fadecandy Android server passes the device to its background service and closes.
en.disableEffect: Attaching a Fadecandy USB controller will no longer automatically notify the server.

zh-CN.description: 兼容的 USB 控制器接入时，Fadecandy Android 服务会将设备交给后台服务处理，然后关闭此入口。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 接入 Fadecandy USB 控制器时，服务将不再自动收到设备通知。

en.description: The Fadecandy Android server manages compatible USB lighting controllers and runs the local server that communicates with them.
en.disableEffect: The app will no longer connect to or control lighting through the Fadecandy USB server.

zh-CN.description: Fadecandy Android 服务会管理兼容的 USB 灯光控制器，并运行与控制器通信的本地服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法再通过 Fadecandy USB 服务连接或控制灯光。

en.description: The Notti Bluetooth SDK provides the app with controls to scan for nearby Notti devices, connect to them, and end those connections.
en.disableEffect: The app will no longer discover, connect to, or control Notti Bluetooth devices.

zh-CN.description: Notti 蓝牙 SDK 为应用提供扫描附近 Notti 设备、连接设备和断开连接的功能。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法再发现、连接或控制 Notti 蓝牙设备。

en.description: The Geo4Cast sensor SDK runs configured device-signal collectors in the background, refreshes their collection rules, and sends the collected records.
en.disableEffect: Geo4Cast will stop collecting and sending the device signals configured for this app.

zh-CN.description: Geo4Cast 传感器 SDK 会在后台运行已配置的设备信号采集器、更新采集规则，并发送收集到的数据。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Geo4Cast 将停止采集和发送此应用中配置的设备信号。

en.description: The Geo4Cast sensor SDK handles movement-recognition updates, such as walking, running, cycling, or driving, and shares them with the SDK’s collectors.
en.disableEffect: Geo4Cast will no longer process movement-recognition updates for collection.

zh-CN.description: Geo4Cast 传感器 SDK 会处理步行、跑步、骑行或驾车等活动识别更新，并将结果提供给其采集器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Geo4Cast 将无法再处理用于数据采集的活动识别更新。

en.description: The Geo4Cast sensor SDK declares this entry so its installed-app scan can detect apps that advertise detection support; opening it shows no screen.
en.disableEffect: Geo4Cast’s installed-app scan will no longer find this app as advertising detection support.

zh-CN.description: Geo4Cast 传感器 SDK 声明了此入口，供其已安装应用扫描查找声明支持检测的应用；打开后不会显示页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Geo4Cast 的已安装应用扫描将无法再发现此应用声明了检测支持。

en.description: The Geo4Cast SDK opens this feedback screen to download a survey; tapping its button starts the survey in an in-app web view.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to open and complete the Geo4Cast feedback survey.

zh-CN.description: Geo4Cast SDK 会打开反馈页面并下载问卷；用户点按按钮后，问卷会在应用内网页中显示。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开并完成 Geo4Cast 反馈问卷。

en.description: The Cheerleader SoundCloud library receives headset and system media-button events and forwards play, pause, next, or previous commands to its audio player.
en.disableEffect: Headset and system media buttons will no longer control Cheerleader audio playback.

zh-CN.description: Cheerleader SoundCloud 库会接收耳机和系统媒体按键事件，并将播放、暂停、下一首或上一首命令传给播放器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 耳机和系统媒体按键将无法再控制 Cheerleader 音频播放。

en.description: The Cheerleader SoundCloud library stores and retrieves cached track records used by its offline player.
en.disableEffect: The library will no longer be able to look up or update its offline track cache.

zh-CN.description: Cheerleader SoundCloud 库会保存和读取离线播放器使用的曲目缓存记录。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 该库将无法再查询或更新离线曲目缓存。

en.description: The Cheerleader SoundCloud library plays audio tracks in a background service and provides playback notifications and controls.
en.disableEffect: SoundCloud audio will stop playing through this library, including in the background.

zh-CN.description: Cheerleader SoundCloud 库通过后台服务播放音频曲目，并提供播放通知和控件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 该库播放的 SoundCloud 音频将无法继续播放，包括后台播放。

en.description: The Cheerleader SoundCloud library pauses audio when Android reports that headphones or another audio output have disconnected.
en.disableEffect: Audio may keep playing through the phone speaker after headphones are unplugged.

zh-CN.description: Android 检测到耳机或其他音频输出设备断开时，Cheerleader SoundCloud 库会暂停播放。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 拔下耳机后，音频可能仍会通过手机扬声器播放。

en.description: The IntentShare library opens a custom sharing screen that lists available apps and opens the user’s chosen destination.
en.disableEffect: The app’s custom sharing screen will not open, so sharing through this flow will stop working.

zh-CN.description: IntentShare 库会打开自定义分享页面，列出可用应用并打开用户选择的目标应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用的自定义分享页面将无法打开，因此此分享流程也会失效。

en.description: The ServerHostChanger SDK opens a screen where the app can use its default server, enter another server address, or reuse a saved address. The app opens it when someone needs to change where it connects.
en.disableEffect: Users can no longer change or restore the app's server address from this screen.

zh-CN.description: ServerHostChanger SDK 会打开服务器设置页面，供用户使用默认服务器、输入其他服务器地址或选择已保存的地址。应用在需要切换连接地址时打开此页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 屏蔽后，用户无法通过此页面更改或恢复应用的服务器地址。

en.description: When a developer opens Gecko, this Activity displays captured network requests and lets the developer browse their request and response details.
en.disableEffect: Gecko's captured-network viewer will be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: 开发者打开 Gecko 时，此 Activity 会显示已捕获的网络请求，并可浏览请求和响应详情。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Gecko 的网络记录查看器将无法使用。

en.description: This Gecko launcher entry opens the SDK's captured-network viewer from the device's app launcher.
en.disableEffect: The Gecko viewer shortcut will disappear from the launcher.

zh-CN.description: 此 Gecko 启动器入口可从设备的应用启动器打开 SDK 的网络记录查看器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Gecko 查看器的桌面入口将从启动器中消失。

en.description: When an app starts media selection, Matisse by LeavesCZY opens this screen to browse and select photos or videos. It returns the chosen media to the app; capture and video playback use the other Matisse screens.
en.disableEffect: Apps using Matisse will not be able to open the media picker or receive selected items.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动媒体选择时，LeavesCZY 的 Matisse 会打开此界面供用户浏览和选择照片或视频，并把选中内容返回应用。拍摄和视频播放由 Matisse 的其他界面处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用 Matisse 的应用将无法打开媒体选择器或收到用户选中的内容。

en.description: Matisse by LeavesCZY opens this screen when the user chooses to capture a new photo from the picker. It requests camera permission, takes the photo, and returns the captured image to the selection flow.
en.disableEffect: The picker will no longer be able to capture a new photo from inside its selection flow.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Matisse 选择器中选择拍照时，LeavesCZY 的 Matisse 会打开此界面。它会请求相机权限、拍摄照片，并把照片返回选择流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法在媒体选择流程中直接拍摄新照片。

en.description: When the user opens a selected video for preview, Matisse by LeavesCZY plays that video's content in this screen. Playback position is retained while the user temporarily leaves and returns.
en.disableEffect: Users will lose in-app playback of selected videos, and apps that rely on this preview flow may fail.

zh-CN.description: 用户预览选中的视频时，LeavesCZY 的 Matisse 会在此界面播放视频。用户暂时离开后再返回时，播放位置会保留。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在应用内播放选中的视频；依赖此预览流程的应用功能可能失败。

en.description: Older versions of LeavesCZY Monitor start this provider with the app to make the application context available to the optional HTTP inspector. The inspector uses it while recording and displaying network requests.
en.disableEffect: The HTTP inspector may not initialize, and apps using its monitoring hook may fail to record or process requests.

zh-CN.description: LeavesCZY Monitor 的旧版本会在应用启动时运行此提供器，为可选的 HTTP 检查工具设置应用上下文。检查工具会在记录和显示网络请求时使用它。
zh-CN.disableEffect: HTTP 检查工具可能无法初始化，使用其网络监控功能的应用可能无法记录或处理请求。

en.description: LeavesCZY Monitor starts this file provider with the app to initialize its HTTP inspector and share files created by its request-inspection screens. It runs before the user opens those screens.
en.disableEffect: The inspector may not initialize, and exporting or sharing its saved request details may fail.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，LeavesCZY Monitor 会通过此文件提供器初始化 HTTP 检查工具，并分享请求检查界面生成的文件。它会在用户打开相关界面前运行。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 检查工具可能无法初始化，导出或分享已保存的请求详情也可能失败。

en.description: LeavesCZY Monitor opens this screen to show HTTP requests recorded by the app's debugging inspector. Selecting a request opens its saved details.
en.disableEffect: The HTTP request inspection screen will be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: LeavesCZY Monitor 会在此显示调试检查工具记录的 HTTP 请求。选择一条请求即可打开已保存的详情。
zh-CN.disableEffect: HTTP 请求检查界面将无法使用。

en.description: LeavesCZY Monitor opens this screen to show the saved details of one recorded HTTP request and response. The screen can also share an exported copy of those details.
en.disableEffect: Saved HTTP request details and their export or sharing screen will be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: LeavesCZY Monitor 会在此显示一条已记录 HTTP 请求及响应的详情。此界面还可导出并分享这些内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 已保存的 HTTP 请求详情及其导出、分享界面将无法使用。

en.description: The 05nelsonm Authentication Manager SDK opens this screen when an app requests local PIN setup, confirmation, reset, or verification. It displays the PIN form and returns the result to the app.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents the app from completing local PIN setup or verification flows that rely on this SDK.

zh-CN.description: 05nelsonm 本地认证管理 SDK 会在应用请求设置、确认、重置或验证本地 PIN 时显示此页面。它提供 PIN 输入界面并将结果返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，依赖此 SDK 的本地 PIN 设置和验证流程将无法完成。

en.description: The 05nelsonm Authentication Manager SDK opens this screen when an app requests local PIN setup, confirmation, reset, or verification. It displays the PIN form and returns the result to the app.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents the app from completing local PIN setup or verification flows that rely on this SDK.

zh-CN.description: 05nelsonm 本地认证管理 SDK 会在应用请求设置、确认、重置或验证本地 PIN 时显示此页面。它提供 PIN 输入界面并将结果返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，依赖此 SDK 的本地 PIN 设置和验证流程将无法完成。

en.description: Glue Home's GlueLock v2 Bluetooth SDK starts this Service when a compatible lock receives a firmware update over Bluetooth. It transfers the lock's firmware and provides the update notification shown during the transfer.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents the app from completing firmware updates for compatible Glue locks.

zh-CN.description: Glue Home 的 GlueLock v2 蓝牙 SDK 会在通过蓝牙更新兼容门锁固件时启动此服务。它负责传输门锁固件，并提供更新期间显示的通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，应用将无法为兼容的 Glue 门锁完成固件更新。

en.description: Park SangGwon's TedImagePicker opens this Activity when an app asks the user to choose images or videos. It shows albums and media, supports camera capture, and returns one or several selected items.
en.disableEffect: The app loses this image and video selection screen, including the picker's camera shortcut.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求用户选择图片或视频时，Park SangGwon 的 TedImagePicker 会打开此 Activity。它展示相册和媒体、支持相机拍摄，并返回一个或多个选中项目。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用将无法使用此图片和视频选择页面，包括选择器中的相机入口。

en.description: Park SangGwon's TedImagePicker starts this provider with the app to prepare the messages shown by its picker when selection is limited or a problem occurs.
en.disableEffect: The picker may fail when it tries to show selection feedback or an error message.

zh-CN.description: Park SangGwon 的 TedImagePicker 会在应用启动时运行此 Provider，为选择受限或发生问题时显示的提示做准备。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，选择器显示操作提示或错误信息时可能失败。

en.description: Park SangGwon's TedImagePicker opens this Activity when a user taps a photo to preview it. It displays the selected image full-screen.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot enlarge and preview a selected image inside TedImagePicker.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Park SangGwon 的 TedImagePicker 中点击照片预览时会打开此 Activity。页面会全屏显示选中的图片。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法在 TedImagePicker 中放大并预览选中的图片。

en.description: The Advanpro BLE SDK starts this service during a Bluetooth device firmware update. It transfers the selected firmware to the device in the background and reports update progress.
en.disableEffect: Disabling this service stops the device firmware update from running.

zh-CN.description: Advanpro BLE SDK 会在通过蓝牙更新设备固件时启动此服务。它会在后台将固件传输到设备并报告更新进度。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 屏蔽此服务后，设备固件更新将无法运行。

en.description: When a BLE firmware update notification is tapped, Advanpro's update service targets this screen, which immediately closes without showing content. The SDK's normal update flow suppresses these notifications.
en.disableEffect: The normal update flow is unaffected; when DFU notifications are enabled, tapping one will no longer open this empty screen.

zh-CN.description: 点击蓝牙固件更新通知时，Advanpro 的更新服务会打开此页面，但页面会立即关闭且不显示内容。SDK 的常规更新流程会关闭这类通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 常规更新流程不受影响；启用 DFU 通知时，点击通知将不再打开此空页面。

en.description: Ponte's Respresso Live Editor uses this screen as a camera scanner for a live-edit setup QR code. After a scan, it returns the code for the editor's localization workflow.
en.disableEffect: The editor can no longer scan the QR code used to attach a localization to a live-edit session.

zh-CN.description: Ponte 的 Respresso Live Editor 会使用此页面扫描实时编辑会话的二维码。扫描后，页面会将二维码内容返回给编辑器的本地化流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 屏蔽后，编辑器无法扫描用于将本地化内容接入实时编辑会话的二维码。

en.description: Ponte's Respresso Live Editor opens its controls for connecting to a live-edit session and setting up QR-based localization editing while the app is running.
en.disableEffect: Developers can no longer connect to a Respresso live-edit session or start its QR localization setup.

zh-CN.description: Ponte 的 Respresso Live Editor 会打开控制页面，用于连接实时编辑会话，并在应用运行时设置二维码本地化编辑。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 屏蔽后，开发者无法连接 Respresso 实时编辑会话或启动二维码本地化设置。

en.description: Avrist Authentication Module opens a password-change form for an account that is already signed in. It checks the submitted details, sends the new password, and can ask for a one-time code before finishing.
en.disableEffect: The app's password-change flow cannot be completed.

zh-CN.description: Avrist Authentication Module 会为已登录账户打开密码修改表单。它会核验填写的信息、提交新密码，并可能要求输入一次性验证码后才能完成。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 屏蔽后，应用无法完成密码修改流程。

en.description: When the app opens this Avrist screen, it asks the user to enter and confirm a new password and submits the change. It then continues to sign-in confirmation or one-time-code verification.
en.disableEffect: The password-creation flow cannot be completed.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开 Avrist 此页面时，用户需要输入并确认新密码，随后提交修改。之后页面会继续进行登录确认或一次性验证码验证。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 屏蔽后，无法完成创建密码流程。

en.description: Avrist Authentication Module checks the user's fingerprint and, after a match, registers the supplied account credentials for fingerprint sign-in. It returns the saved sign-in token to the login screen.
en.disableEffect: The app's fingerprint sign-in setup and login path are unavailable; users must choose another sign-in method.

zh-CN.description: Avrist Authentication Module 会验证用户指纹；验证通过后，它会注册填写的账户凭据以启用指纹登录，并将保存的登录令牌返回给登录页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 屏蔽后，应用无法使用此指纹登录设置和登录流程，用户需要选择其他登录方式。

en.description: Avrist Authentication Module shows the account-recovery form and submits the user's recovery details and new password. Depending on the response, it continues with an OTP check or completes the sign-in handoff.
en.disableEffect: Account recovery and password reset through this module cannot be completed.

zh-CN.description: Avrist Authentication Module 会显示账户找回表单，并提交用户的找回信息和新密码。根据服务端结果，它会继续进行验证码验证或完成登录交接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 屏蔽后，无法通过此模块完成账户找回和密码重置。

en.description: Avrist Authentication Module presents the app's sign-in screen. It supports password, social, fingerprint, and one-time-password sign-in, with links to registration and account recovery.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot sign in through Avrist's authentication flow.

zh-CN.description: Avrist Authentication Module 会显示应用的登录页面，支持密码、第三方账户、指纹和一次性验证码登录，并提供注册和账户找回入口。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 屏蔽后，用户无法通过 Avrist 的认证流程登录。

en.description: After an Avrist sign-in, this screen exchanges the returned ticket for an access token and user profile, then returns that result to the host app.
en.disableEffect: Successful Avrist sign-ins cannot finish or return the user's session to the app.

zh-CN.description: Avrist 登录成功后，此页面会用返回的票据换取访问令牌和用户资料，再将结果交还宿主应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 屏蔽后，Avrist 登录无法完成，用户会话也无法返回应用。

en.description: This Avrist screen starts phone-based sign-in by submitting the entered phone number to request a one-time code. It opens the code-entry step when the request succeeds.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot start the OTP sign-in route.

zh-CN.description: 此 Avrist 页面会提交用户输入的手机号以申请一次性登录验证码。申请成功后，它会打开验证码输入页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 屏蔽后，用户无法启动验证码登录流程。

en.description: This Avrist screen asks for the one-time code sent during an authentication step. It checks the code, can request another one, and returns the resulting authentication ticket.
en.disableEffect: OTP-protected sign-in, password changes, or registration cannot complete through Avrist.

zh-CN.description: 此 Avrist 页面会要求输入认证过程中发送的一次性验证码，并负责校验和重新发送验证码，最后返回认证票据。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 屏蔽后，Avrist 的验证码登录、密码修改或注册验证无法完成。

en.description: Avrist's registration flow opens this screen to collect a phone number and return it to the registration form for account setup and phone verification.
en.disableEffect: Registration flows that require a phone number cannot continue.

zh-CN.description: Avrist 注册流程会打开此页面收集手机号，再将号码返回注册表单用于账户创建和手机验证。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 屏蔽后，需要手机号的注册流程无法继续。

en.description: Avrist Authentication Module loads the app's registration form, collects account and profile details, and submits them to create an account. It can continue through phone, social sign-in, and OTP checks as configured for the app.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot register or complete registration verification through this module.

zh-CN.description: Avrist Authentication Module 会加载应用注册表单，收集账户和资料信息并提交以创建账户；根据应用配置，流程还可能包含手机号、第三方登录和验证码验证。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 屏蔽后，用户无法通过此模块注册或完成注册验证。

en.description: Avrist Authentication Module opens Yahoo's account sign-in page inside the app. It reads the returned identity details and sends them back to the sign-in or registration screen.
en.disableEffect: Yahoo sign-in and registration cannot complete through Avrist.

zh-CN.description: Avrist Authentication Module 会在应用内打开 Yahoo 账户登录页面，读取返回的身份信息并交回登录或注册页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 屏蔽后，无法通过 Avrist 完成 Yahoo 登录或注册。

en.description: Lukas Dylan's Protodroid opens its saved gRPC request-and-response history and detail screens here when the SDK inspector is launched.
en.disableEffect: Protodroid's request-history screen will be unavailable; the host app's other screens can continue to work.

zh-CN.description: Lukas Dylan 的 Protodroid 在启动检查界面时，会通过此 Activity 显示保存的 gRPC 请求和响应记录及其详情。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后将无法打开 Protodroid 的请求历史页面；宿主应用的其他页面仍可使用。

en.description: UnifyID PushAuth opens this screen when a user answers or dismisses a PushAuth notification. It submits the selected response, records the prompt as answered, and closes the notification.
en.disableEffect: PushAuth prompts cannot be answered or dismissed through this built-in response flow.

zh-CN.description: 用户回复或关闭 PushAuth 通知时，UnifyID PushAuth 会打开此页面。它会提交用户选择的响应、记录该请求已处理并关闭通知。

zh-CN.description: Threads 聊天 SDK 打开顾问详情页时，此 Activity 会显示顾问的照片、姓名和状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法查看 Threads 聊天 SDK 提供的顾问详情。

en.description: When a user opens an attachment from a Threads conversation, this Activity loads the conversation's saved files into a swipeable image viewer.
en.disableEffect: Users may not be able to view conversation images and attachments in the SDK's full-screen viewer.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 Threads 会话中的附件时，此 Activity 会将会话保存的文件加载到可滑动的图片查看器中。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户可能无法在 SDK 的全屏查看器中浏览会话图片和附件。

en.description: When a user chooses the quick-reply action on a Threads message notification, this Activity opens a reply window with the consultant's name and message.
en.disableEffect: The quick-reply action on Threads notifications will no longer open; users can still reply from the conversation screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击 Threads 消息通知中的快捷回复操作时，此 Activity 会打开回复窗口并显示顾问姓名和消息内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Threads 通知中的快捷回复窗口将无法打开；用户仍可在会话页面回复。

en.description: When the Threads chat SDK needs a runtime permission, this Activity requests it and returns whether access was granted; if access is denied, it can direct the user to app settings.
en.disableEffect: Chat features that depend on the requested permission may fail because the SDK can no longer show its permission request.

zh-CN.description: Threads 聊天 SDK 需要运行时权限时，此 Activity 会请求权限并返回授权结果；如果用户拒绝，还可引导用户前往应用设置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，依赖所请求权限的聊天功能可能无法使用，因为 SDK 无法再显示权限请求页面。

en.description: When a user starts screen sharing with ZEGO Express Video, this Activity opens Android's screen-capture permission prompt and connects the capture service after approval.
en.disableEffect: Blocking it prevents users from granting screen-capture access, so ZEGO screen sharing cannot start.

zh-CN.description: 用户通过 ZEGO Express Video 开始屏幕共享时，此 Activity 会打开 Android 屏幕录制授权提示，并在用户同意后连接录制服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法授予屏幕录制权限，因此 ZEGO 屏幕共享无法启动。

en.description: After screen-capture permission is granted, ZEGO Express Video binds this foreground Service to keep the capture session running and provide the screen stream to the call.
en.disableEffect: Blocking it prevents ZEGO Express Video from capturing and sharing the screen during a call.

zh-CN.description: 获得屏幕录制授权后，ZEGO Express Video 会绑定此前台 Service 以保持录制会话运行，并将屏幕画面提供给通话。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，ZEGO Express Video 无法在通话中录制并共享屏幕。

en.description: When Firebase delivers a message or refreshes its token, ZEGO's FCM push adapter turns it into a ZEGO push-message or registration update for the app.
en.disableEffect: Firebase messages and refreshed push registrations will no longer reach ZEGO's push system through this adapter.

zh-CN.description: Firebase 收到消息或刷新令牌时，ZEGO FCM 推送适配器会将其转换为 ZEGO 推送消息或注册状态更新并交给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Firebase 消息和更新后的推送注册信息将无法通过此适配器送达 ZEGO 推送系统。

en.description: When Huawei Push delivers a message or refreshes its token, this ZEGO adapter packages the message or registration update for the ZEGO push system.
en.disableEffect: Huawei push messages and refreshed registrations will no longer reach ZEGO through this adapter.

zh-CN.description: Huawei Push 收到消息或刷新令牌时，此 ZEGO 适配器会整理消息或注册状态更新并交给 ZEGO 推送系统。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Huawei Push 消息和更新后的注册信息将无法通过此适配器送达 ZEGO。

en.description: When the older ColorOS push service delivers a data message, ZEGO's OPPO adapter converts it to a ZEGO push event and dispatches it.
en.disableEffect: Older ColorOS push messages will no longer reach ZEGO through this adapter.

zh-CN.description: 较早版本的 ColorOS 推送服务收到数据消息时，ZEGO OPPO 适配器会将其转换为 ZEGO 推送事件并进行分发。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，较早版本的 ColorOS 推送消息将无法通过此适配器送达 ZEGO。

en.description: When the newer HeyTap or OPPO push service delivers a data message, ZEGO's OPPO adapter converts it to a ZEGO push event and dispatches it.
en.disableEffect: HeyTap and newer OPPO push messages will no longer reach ZEGO through this adapter.

zh-CN.description: 较新的 HeyTap 或 OPPO 推送服务收到数据消息时，ZEGO OPPO 适配器会将其转换为 ZEGO 推送事件并进行分发。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，HeyTap 和较新的 OPPO 推送消息将无法通过此适配器送达 ZEGO。

en.description: When Vivo Push reports a registration token, a user taps a notification, or a pass-through message arrives, this ZEGO adapter packages the event and sends it to the ZEGO push system.
en.disableEffect: Vivo push messages, notification clicks, and registration updates will no longer reach ZEGO through this adapter.

zh-CN.description: Vivo Push 返回注册令牌、用户点击通知或收到透传消息时，此 ZEGO 适配器会整理事件并交给 ZEGO 推送系统。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Vivo 推送消息、通知点击和注册状态更新将无法通过此适配器送达 ZEGO。

en.description: When Xiaomi Mi Push reports a pass-through message, notification arrival or click, or a registration update, this ZEGO adapter sends the event to the ZEGO push system.
en.disableEffect: Xiaomi push messages, notification events, and registration updates will no longer reach ZEGO through this adapter.

zh-CN.description: Xiaomi Mi Push 收到透传消息、通知到达或点击事件，或报告注册状态更新时，此 ZEGO 适配器会将事件交给 ZEGO 推送系统。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Xiaomi 推送消息、通知事件和注册状态更新将无法通过此适配器送达 ZEGO。

en.description: When started, this Momo Live SDK background service prepares its embedded browser, processes queued work, and periodically checks downloaded web pages for updates. It stops after the work completes.
en.disableEffect: Embedded pages may miss background setup and updates to their offline content.

zh-CN.description: 此陌陌直播 SDK 后台服务启动后会准备内置浏览器、处理排队任务，并定期检查已下载网页是否需要更新。任务完成后服务会停止。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 内嵌页面可能无法完成后台准备，离线内容也可能无法及时更新。

en.description: When an app opens a service from the SBM Android Library, this screen displays the service and returns its result to the app.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot open SBM services or receive their results.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开 SBM Android Library 提供的服务时，此界面会显示该服务并将结果返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法打开 SBM 服务或接收其处理结果。

en.description: During SBM mobile banking setup, this screen lets the user create or enter a four-digit MPIN and may offer biometric verification.
en.disableEffect: The app's SBM account and device setup may not continue.

zh-CN.description: 设置 SBM 手机银行时，此界面会让用户创建或输入四位 MPIN，并可能提供生物识别验证。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用中的 SBM 账户和设备设置可能无法继续。

en.description: After the user starts SBM device binding, this screen requests phone and SIM access, sends a verification text, and checks whether the bank has linked the device.
en.disableEffect: SBM device binding may not finish.

zh-CN.description: 用户开始绑定 SBM 设备后，此界面会请求手机和 SIM 卡相关权限、发送验证短信，并检查银行是否已完成设备关联。
zh-CN.disableEffect: SBM 设备绑定可能无法完成。

en.description: When the Coinn Proximity SDK receives a merchant-detection push message, this Service builds and posts a notification with the merchant message and any supplied image.
en.disableEffect: Coinn merchant-detection push notifications will no longer be shown.

zh-CN.description: Coinn Proximity SDK 收到商户检测推送消息时，此 Service 会使用商户消息和附带图片创建并显示通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Coinn 商户检测推送通知将不再显示。

en.description: When Google's messaging service reports a changed device token, this Coinn Proximity Service starts the token-registration task so the push subscription can be refreshed.
en.disableEffect: A refreshed device token will no longer be registered for Coinn push messages, so those messages may stop arriving.

zh-CN.description: Google 消息服务报告设备令牌已变化时，此 Coinn Proximity Service 会启动令牌注册任务以刷新推送订阅。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，更新后的设备令牌将无法注册用于接收 Coinn 推送，因此推送可能停止送达。

en.description: When a user taps a Coinn push notification, this Receiver opens the app's main screen if it was in the background, or the Coinn merchant screen if the app was already open.
en.disableEffect: Tapping a Coinn push notification will no longer open its app or merchant destination.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击 Coinn 推送通知时，如果应用在后台，此 Receiver 会打开应用主页面；如果应用已打开，则会打开 Coinn 商户页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，点击 Coinn 推送通知将无法打开应用或对应的商户页面。

en.description: When Google Cloud Messaging delivers an incoming push broadcast, this Coinn Proximity Receiver wakes the message Service to process it.
en.disableEffect: Incoming Coinn push messages will no longer reach the notification Service.

zh-CN.description: Google Cloud Messaging 收到推送广播时，此 Coinn Proximity Receiver 会唤醒消息 Service 来处理推送。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Coinn 推送消息将无法送达通知 Service。

en.description: When Coinn Proximity registers or refreshes push messaging, this background Service fetches and saves the device token, then subscribes it to the Coinn message topic.
en.disableEffect: The device will no longer register or refresh its Coinn push subscription.

zh-CN.description: Coinn Proximity 注册或刷新推送服务时，此后台 Service 会获取并保存设备令牌，然后订阅 Coinn 消息主题。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，设备将无法注册或刷新 Coinn 推送订阅。

en.description: When the Coinn Proximity merchant screen enables location-based beacon scanning, this Service requests periodic location updates and sends the location to the beacon-search helper while background scanning is active.
en.disableEffect: Location-assisted merchant and beacon detection in the background will stop.

zh-CN.description: Coinn Proximity 商户页面启用基于位置的信标扫描时，此 Service 会定期请求位置更新，并在后台扫描运行时将位置提供给信标搜索功能。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，后台的定位辅助商户和信标检测将停止。

en.description: When the app opens Coinn Proximity, this Activity scans for nearby merchant beacons and displays detected merchants with their details and payment controls.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to open Coinn's nearby-merchant and payment screen or use proximity-based discovery through this SDK.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开 Coinn Proximity 时，此 Activity 会扫描附近商户信标，并显示检测到的商户、商户详情和付款操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法打开 Coinn 附近商户及付款页面，也无法使用此 SDK 的邻近发现功能。

en.description: Zabaan Publisher SDK shows its publisher bubble after receiving an internal request to enable it. Users can move or dismiss the on-screen bubble, which exposes the publisher's configured action.
en.disableEffect: The publisher bubble and its configured action will not be available.

zh-CN.description: Zabaan Publisher SDK 会在收到内部启用请求后显示发布者气泡。用户可以移动或关闭屏幕上的气泡，气泡会打开发布者配置的操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，发布者气泡及其配置的操作将无法使用。

en.description: Zabaan Publisher SDK opens this Activity when publisher setup asks the user to scan a QR code shown in Zabaan CMS. It checks the scanned code with the service and reports success or an error.
en.disableEffect: Publisher setup cannot complete through the CMS QR-code flow.

zh-CN.description: Zabaan Publisher SDK 会在发布者设置需要扫描 Zabaan CMS 中的二维码时打开此 Activity。它会向服务验证扫描到的代码，并返回成功或错误结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，发布者设置将无法通过 CMS 二维码流程完成。

en.description: When Android reports that Bluetooth has turned on or off, the Coinn Delivery SDK checks whether cash-on-delivery is active and starts or stops its nearby beacon broadcast.
en.disableEffect: Coinn cash-on-delivery beacon broadcasting will no longer follow Bluetooth state changes.

zh-CN.description: Android 报告蓝牙开启或关闭时，Coinn Delivery SDK 会检查货到付款功能是否正在运行，并相应地启动或停止附近信标广播。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Coinn 货到付款信标广播将不再跟随蓝牙状态变化。

en.description: The Testpress Course SDK opens a selected course or chapter and loads its chapter details from saved data or the Testpress service. It then shows the next chapters or the lessons in that chapter.
en.disableEffect: Learners cannot browse the selected chapter's subchapters or lesson list through the Testpress course flow.

zh-CN.description: Testpress Course SDK 会打开选定的课程或章节，并从本地保存的数据或 Testpress 服务加载章节详情，然后显示下级章节或该章节中的课程内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 Testpress 课程页面浏览所选章节的下级章节或课程列表。

en.description: In older Testpress Course SDK versions, this screen displays a course's chapter grid. Selecting an unlocked chapter opens its next chapter or its lesson list.
en.disableEffect: Learners cannot browse a course's chapters through this screen.

zh-CN.description: 在较早版本的 Testpress Course SDK 中，此页面以网格显示课程章节。选择未锁定的章节后，会打开其下级章节或课程列表。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此页面浏览课程章节。

en.description: When a learner opens a course item, the Testpress Course SDK displays its lesson. Depending on the item, the screen shows formatted text, video, a downloadable attachment, or an exam with start and resume options.
en.disableEffect: Learners lose access to these course lessons and any exam or attachment provided through them.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开课程内容时，Testpress Course SDK 会显示相应课程页面。根据内容类型，页面可显示排版文本、视频、可下载的附件，或带有开始和继续选项的考试。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法查看这些课程内容，也无法使用其中的考试或附件。

en.description: In older Testpress Course SDK versions, this screen loads a chapter when needed and displays the chapter's lessons in a list.
en.disableEffect: Learners cannot open the chapter's lesson list or reach its lessons through this screen.

zh-CN.description: 在较早版本的 Testpress Course SDK 中，此页面会在需要时加载章节，并以列表显示其中的课程内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开章节课程列表，也无法通过此页面进入其中的课程内容。

en.description: When the app opens the Testpress course catalog, this activity displays the learner's course list.
en.disableEffect: Learners cannot browse their Testpress courses from the app.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开 Testpress 课程目录时，此页面会显示用户的课程列表。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在应用中浏览 Testpress 课程。

en.description: When the host app opens this Testpress Course SDK screen with a video address, it plays the video from the supplied position and playback speed. Playback follows the screen's start, pause, and stop lifecycle.
en.disableEffect: The host app cannot use this screen to play or resume videos.

zh-CN.description: 宿主应用通过视频地址打开此 Testpress Course SDK 页面时，页面会按指定的位置和速度播放视频，并随页面的启动、暂停和停止控制播放。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 宿主应用将无法通过此页面播放或继续播放视频。

en.description: When the app opens the Testpress course leaderboard, this activity displays the SDK's learner ranking screen.
en.disableEffect: Learners cannot open the Testpress course rankings from the app.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开 Testpress 课程排行榜时，此页面会显示 SDK 提供的用户排名。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在应用中查看 Testpress 课程排名。

en.description: When a learner chooses to enter an exam access code, the Testpress Exam SDK shows the code form and checks the code to find matching exams.
en.disableEffect: Learners cannot enter an access code to find exams in the app.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择输入考试访问码时，Testpress Exam SDK 会显示输入表单并验证访问码，以查找对应的考试。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在应用中输入访问码并查找对应考试。

en.description: After an access code returns matching exams, the Testpress Exam SDK displays those exams in a list.
en.disableEffect: Learners cannot browse or open the exams found for an access code.

zh-CN.description: 访问码返回匹配的考试后，Testpress Exam SDK 会以列表显示这些考试。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法浏览或打开访问码对应的考试。

en.description: When the app opens exam analytics, the Testpress Exam SDK loads subject performance data and displays it as subject pages in tabs.
en.disableEffect: Learners cannot open these exam performance reports from the app.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开考试分析时，Testpress Exam SDK 会加载各科表现数据，并以分页标签显示报告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在应用中打开这些考试表现报告。

en.description: When a learner opens an exam's attempt history, the Testpress Exam SDK displays past attempts and offers actions to retake the exam or resume a paused attempt.
en.disableEffect: Learners cannot review the attempt history or start and resume exams through this screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开考试记录时，Testpress Exam SDK 会显示以往的作答记录，并提供重考或继续未完成考试的选项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此页面查看作答记录、开始重考或继续未完成的考试。

en.description: When a learner opens saved exam questions, the Testpress Exam SDK shows bookmarks that can be browsed by folder and opened for review.
en.disableEffect: Learners cannot browse or review their saved exam questions.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开已收藏的考试题目时，Testpress Exam SDK 会按文件夹显示收藏，并允许用户打开题目进行复习。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法浏览或复习已收藏的考试题目。

en.description: When learners browse exam categories, the Testpress Exam SDK displays nested categories and lets them switch between a category grid and exam list. It can also open the exam list as the initial view when requested.
en.disableEffect: Learners cannot browse categories to find and open exams.

zh-CN.description: 用户浏览考试分类时，Testpress Exam SDK 会显示下级分类，并可在分类网格和考试列表之间切换。应用也可选择直接以考试列表作为初始页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过分类浏览并打开考试。

en.description: When learners open the Testpress exam catalog or choose a category, this activity displays the available exam list.
en.disableEffect: Learners cannot browse the Testpress exam catalog from the app.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 Testpress 考试目录或选择分类时，此页面会显示可参加的考试列表。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在应用中浏览 Testpress 考试目录。

en.description: When a learner reviews a completed exam, the Testpress Exam SDK displays its questions and lets the learner move between them or select one from the question list.
en.disableEffect: Learners cannot inspect individual questions from a completed exam in this review screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户复习已完成的考试时，Testpress Exam SDK 会显示考试题目，并允许用户切换题目或从题目列表中选择。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在此复习页面查看已完成考试中的单道题目。

en.description: After an exam attempt, the Testpress Exam SDK opens a result screen with score and performance details, or course trophies when course gamification is enabled. The screen also links to question review and analytics.
en.disableEffect: Learners cannot see the attempt result or course trophy screen after finishing an exam.

zh-CN.description: 考试作答结束后，Testpress Exam SDK 会显示成绩和表现详情；启用课程游戏化功能时则显示课程奖杯页面。此页面还可进入题目复习和分析报告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户完成考试后将无法查看作答结果或课程奖杯页面。

en.description: When a learner starts exam search, the Testpress Exam SDK shows a search field and matching exam results; speech input is also available when supported by the device.
en.disableEffect: Learners cannot search the Testpress exam list from the app.

zh-CN.description: 用户开始搜索考试时，Testpress Exam SDK 会显示搜索框和匹配的考试结果；设备支持时也可使用语音输入。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在应用中搜索 Testpress 考试列表。

en.description: When a learner starts or resumes an exam, the Testpress Exam SDK loads the exam and opens its test screen for answering and submitting questions.
en.disableEffect: Learners cannot take, continue, or submit Testpress exams.

zh-CN.description: 用户开始或继续考试时，Testpress Exam SDK 会加载考试并打开答题页面，以便作答和提交题目。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法参加、继续或提交 Testpress 考试。

en.description: When a learner opens timing details for an exam attempt, the Testpress Exam SDK compares time spent on each question with average and best times. Selecting a question opens its answer review.
en.disableEffect: Learners cannot view per-question timing comparisons for the exam attempt.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开考试用时详情时，Testpress Exam SDK 会比较每道题的个人用时、平均用时和最佳用时。选择题目后可进入答案复习。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法查看该次考试逐题用时的比较信息。

en.description: When a learner chooses card payment in the Testpress Store SDK, this screen collects debit or credit card details and sends the payment to PayU.
en.disableEffect: Learners cannot complete card payments for Testpress Store purchases.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Testpress Store SDK 中选择银行卡付款时，此页面会收集借记卡或信用卡信息并提交给 PayU。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过银行卡完成 Testpress Store 购买付款。

en.description: During Testpress Store checkout, this screen submits the prepared payment details to PayU and returns the payment result to the order flow.
en.disableEffect: Testpress Store checkout cannot finish payment through this PayU screen.

zh-CN.description: Testpress Store 结账时，此页面会将准备好的付款信息提交给 PayU，并把付款结果返回订单流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Testpress Store 结账流程将无法通过此 PayU 页面完成付款。

en.description: When a learner chooses net banking in Testpress Store checkout, this screen lists available banks and prepares the payment after a bank is selected.
en.disableEffect: Learners cannot select a bank and pay by net banking through Testpress Store.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Testpress Store 结账时选择网上银行付款后，此页面会列出可用银行，并在用户选择银行后准备付款。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在 Testpress Store 中选择银行并通过网上银行付款。

en.description: After an order is prepared, the Testpress Store SDK shows the available PayU payment methods: debit card, credit card, and net banking.
en.disableEffect: Learners cannot choose a payment method for a Testpress Store order.

zh-CN.description: 订单准备好后，Testpress Store SDK 会显示可用的 PayU 付款方式：借记卡、信用卡和网上银行。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法为 Testpress Store 订单选择付款方式。

en.description: When a learner buys a Testpress Store product, this screen creates the order, collects shipping details when required, and opens payment selection to confirm the purchase.
