en.disableEffect: Learners cannot confirm a Testpress Store purchase or continue through its payment flow.

zh-CN.description: 用户购买 Testpress Store 商品时，此页面会创建订单，在需要时收集配送信息，并打开付款方式选择以确认购买。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法确认 Testpress Store 购买订单或继续其付款流程。

en.description: After a Testpress Store purchase succeeds, this screen shows the order number, amount, and follow-up details, then lets the learner return or continue shopping.
en.disableEffect: Learners cannot see the purchase confirmation or choose how to continue after checkout.

zh-CN.description: Testpress Store 购买成功后，此页面会显示订单号、金额和后续说明，并允许用户返回或继续购物。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法查看购买确认信息，也无法选择结账后的操作。

en.description: When a learner selects a Testpress Store product, this screen loads its description, price, included exams or notes, and purchase options. Buying starts checkout or opens the product's payment link.
en.disableEffect: Learners cannot view product details or start a purchase through Testpress Store.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择 Testpress Store 商品时，此页面会加载商品说明、价格、包含的考试或讲义以及购买选项。购买操作会启动结账，或打开商品付款链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法查看商品详情或通过 Testpress Store 发起购买。

en.description: When the app opens the Testpress Store, this activity hosts the product catalog.
en.disableEffect: Learners cannot browse Testpress Store products from the app.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开 Testpress Store 时，此页面会承载商品目录。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在应用中浏览 Testpress Store 商品。

en.description: When a learner opens an image from Testpress content, the Testpress Core SDK loads it in a full-screen view that supports zooming and panning.
en.disableEffect: Learners lose the full-screen zoomable image view used by Testpress content.

zh-CN.description: 用户从 Testpress 内容中打开图片时，Testpress Core SDK 会在支持缩放和平移的全屏页面中加载图片。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法使用 Testpress 内容提供的全屏图片缩放页面。

en.description: When the older InLocoMedia SDK needs to request an Android permission, this screen hosts its permission prompt and returns the user's choice to the SDK.
en.disableEffect: The older InLocoMedia SDK may be unable to request permissions for its own location or ad functions.

zh-CN.description: 旧版 InLocoMedia SDK 需要申请 Android 权限时，此界面会显示权限请求并将用户的选择交还给 SDK。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，旧版 InLocoMedia SDK 可能无法申请其位置或广告功能所需的权限。

en.description: When the older InLocoMedia SDK displays an ad, opens its linked page, handles an ad click, or saves an ad image, this screen runs that ad experience.
en.disableEffect: The older InLocoMedia ads, linked pages, and ad-image saving may stop working.

zh-CN.description: 旧版 InLocoMedia SDK 显示广告、打开广告链接、处理广告点击或保存广告图片时，此界面会运行相应广告内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，旧版 InLocoMedia 广告、链接页面和图片保存可能失效。

en.description: When the older InLocoMedia SDK requests or registers a location update, this service manages its location monitoring and stops it when asked.
en.disableEffect: Location-based targeting in the older InLocoMedia SDK may stop working.

zh-CN.description: 旧版 InLocoMedia SDK 请求或登记位置更新时，此服务会管理位置监测，并按要求停止监测。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，旧版 InLocoMedia SDK 的位置定向可能失效。

en.description: When the Adjump offerwall SDK opens its offer page, this screen shows Explore, Pending, and Completed tabs for app-install and other offer tasks.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot browse, start, or review Adjump offer tasks from the offerwall.

zh-CN.description: Adjump 激励墙 SDK 打开优惠页面时，此页面会显示探索中、进行中和已完成标签，列出安装应用及其他优惠任务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在 Adjump 激励墙中浏览、开始或查看优惠任务。

en.description: When a user selects an Adjump offer, this screen shows its task steps and reward, then opens the offer link when the user chooses to start it.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open Adjump task details or launch tasks to earn their listed offer rewards.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择 Adjump 优惠时，此页面会显示任务步骤和奖励；用户选择开始后，页面会打开优惠链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开 Adjump 任务详情或启动任务以获得页面列出的奖励。

en.description: Before the Adjump offerwall opens, this screen presents its terms and privacy links and records acceptance before continuing to the offer tabs.
en.disableEffect: The Adjump offerwall cannot proceed past its terms and privacy screen.

zh-CN.description: 打开 Adjump 激励墙前，此页面会展示条款和隐私政策链接，并在用户接受后继续进入优惠标签页。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Adjump 激励墙将无法通过条款和隐私页面继续打开。

en.description: When the Adjump offerwall SDK opens its offer page, this screen shows Explore, Pending, and Completed tabs for app-install and other offer tasks.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot browse, start, or review Adjump offer tasks from the offerwall.

zh-CN.description: Adjump 激励墙 SDK 打开优惠页面时，此页面会显示探索中、进行中和已完成标签，列出安装应用及其他优惠任务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在 Adjump 激励墙中浏览、开始或查看优惠任务。

en.description: When Adrop opens a quest ad, this screen loads its landing page in an in-app browser and handles links or app-store actions from the page.
en.disableEffect: Adrop quest ads and their landing links cannot open.

zh-CN.description: Adrop 打开任务广告时，此页面会在应用内浏览器中加载落地页，并处理页面链接或应用商店操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Adrop 任务广告及其落地链接将无法打开。

en.description: When Adrop presents a full-screen interstitial ad, this screen displays it and reports ad actions back to the SDK.
en.disableEffect: Adrop interstitial ads will no longer be displayed.

zh-CN.description: Adrop 展示全屏插页广告时，此页面会显示广告，并将广告操作结果报告给 SDK。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Adrop 插页广告将不再显示。

en.description: When Adrop presents a popup ad, this screen displays the ad panel and handles its links and close action.
en.disableEffect: Adrop popup ads will no longer be displayed or opened.

zh-CN.description: Adrop 展示弹窗广告时，此页面会显示广告面板，并处理广告链接和关闭操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Adrop 弹窗广告将无法显示或打开。

en.description: When Adrop presents a rewarded video ad, this screen plays the video, tracks playback, and reports the earned reward to the SDK.
en.disableEffect: Rewarded ads will not play, and users will no longer receive rewards for watching them.

zh-CN.description: Adrop 展示激励视频广告时，此页面会播放视频、跟踪播放状态，并将获得的奖励报告给 SDK。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 激励广告将无法播放，用户也不再会因观看广告而获得奖励。

en.description: When Adrop presents a splash ad during app startup, this screen displays the ad or its fallback and then reports the outcome to the SDK.
en.disableEffect: Adrop splash ads will no longer appear when the app starts.

zh-CN.description: Adrop 在应用启动时展示开屏广告，此页面会显示广告或备用内容，并将结果报告给 SDK。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用启动时将不再显示 Adrop 开屏广告。

en.description: The Agora Education Core SDK uses this file-sharing provider when a lesson file needs to be opened by another app; its configured files include app data and Downloads.
en.disableEffect: Other apps will not be able to open files shared through Agora Education Core, so related lesson-file sharing may fail.

zh-CN.description: Agora Education Core 教育 SDK 在需要让其他应用打开课堂文件时使用此文件共享组件；其配置范围包括应用数据目录和 Downloads 目录。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 其他应用将无法打开通过 Agora Education Core 分享的文件，相关课堂文件分享可能失效。

en.description: When Agora Education Core submits file-download requests, this service downloads the requested files in the background and reports their status to the app.
en.disableEffect: Files requested through Agora Education Core will not finish downloading, which can leave classroom materials unavailable.

zh-CN.description: Agora Education Core 提交文件下载请求时，此 Service 会在后台下载文件，并向应用报告下载状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过 Agora Education Core 请求的文件将无法完成下载，相关课堂资料可能无法使用。

en.description: When the app starts with Agora Education Core 2.8.53–2.8.61.101, this provider prepares the SDK settings, messages, logs, and crash reporting for classroom features.
en.disableEffect: That SDK version will miss its automatic startup initialization, which can prevent classroom features from starting correctly.

zh-CN.description: 使用 Agora Education Core 2.8.53–2.8.61.101 时，应用启动会运行此 Provider，为课堂功能准备 SDK 设置、提示消息、日志和崩溃记录。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 该版本 SDK 将无法自动完成启动初始化，课堂功能可能无法正常启动。

en.description: The Agora AVC video-calling app uses this Activity for its call and meeting-room screens; it handles incoming calls and takes users into the room they create or join.
en.disableEffect: Calls, incoming-call screens, and meeting-room entry can stop working in apps that rely on this Activity.

zh-CN.description: Agora AVC 视频通话应用使用此 Activity 展示通话和会议室界面，处理来电，并带用户进入创建或加入的房间。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此 Activity 的应用可能无法使用通话、来电界面和会议室入口。

en.description: During an app update download, the Agora AVC conference SDK uses this Service to show download progress in a notification; tapping it returns to the conference app.
en.disableEffect: Update downloads will no longer show their progress in Android notifications.

zh-CN.description: Agora AVC 会议 SDK 下载应用更新时，会通过此 Service 在通知中显示进度；点击通知可返回会议应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用更新下载时，Android 通知中将不再显示下载进度。

en.description: The Agora AVC conference app uses Xiaomi Mi Push to handle delivery, arrival, error, and registration events. When a user taps a Xiaomi push message containing a meeting invitation, this Receiver opens the invitation in the conference app.
en.disableEffect: Xiaomi push messages and meeting invitations delivered through Xiaomi will no longer be received or opened.

zh-CN.description: Agora AVC 会议应用通过小米 Mi Push 处理消息送达、到达、错误和注册事件。用户点击包含会议邀请的小米推送通知时，此 Receiver 会在会议应用中打开邀请。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 小米推送消息和通过小米送达的会议邀请将无法接收或打开。

en.description: The Agora AVC conference app starts this Service after Xiaomi reports a registration result or supplies incoming meeting data. It updates the push token or passes the invitation data to the app.
en.disableEffect: Xiaomi push registration and incoming meeting data handled by this Service will stop reaching the app.

zh-CN.description: 小米返回推送注册结果或提供会议数据后，Agora AVC 会议应用会启动此 Service。它会更新推送令牌，或将邀请数据交给应用处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 此 Service 处理的小米推送注册结果和会议数据将无法送达应用。

en.description: During an Agora AVC meeting, a participant can receive a notification asking to turn on their microphone or camera. Tapping agree or decline sends that response to the meeting and clears the request notification.
en.disableEffect: You will not be able to answer microphone or camera requests from meeting notifications.

zh-CN.description: Agora AVC 会议中，参与者可能收到开启麦克风或摄像头的通知。点击同意或拒绝后，应用会向会议发送回应并清除请求通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 你将无法通过会议通知回应开启麦克风或摄像头的请求。

en.description: During an Agora AVC call, this foreground Service shows the active room in an ongoing notification and helps keep the call running in the background. When the app task is removed, it closes the call and cleans up its processes.
en.disableEffect: The background call notification and keep-alive stop, and removing the app task no longer triggers this Service’s call cleanup.

zh-CN.description: Agora AVC 通话期间，此前台 Service 会在持续通知中显示当前会议，并帮助通话在后台保持运行。应用任务被移除时，它会结束通话并清理相关进程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 后台通话通知和保活功能将停止；移除应用任务时，此 Service 也不会再执行通话清理。

en.description: When someone responds to an Agora AVC meeting request to enable audio or video, this Service applies the choice to the meeting and updates the request notice.
en.disableEffect: Microphone and camera requests from other meeting participants will not be applied when answered.

zh-CN.description: 有人回应 Agora AVC 会议中的开启音频或视频请求时，此 Service 会将选择应用到会议并更新请求通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 回应其他会议参与者的麦克风或摄像头请求后，设置将无法生效。

en.description: When Agora AVC needs Android permission approval, this transparent Activity briefly handles the request and returns the result to the conference app. It also carries results from system screens used by the app.
en.disableEffect: Permission requests through this flow may fail, preventing features that need camera, microphone, or other protected access from starting.

zh-CN.description: Agora AVC 需要 Android 权限时，会短暂打开此透明 Activity 处理请求，并将结果返回会议应用。应用使用的系统页面返回结果也会经过这里。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 此权限流程可能无法完成，依赖摄像头、麦克风或其他受保护权限的功能可能无法启动。

en.description: During an Agora AVC meeting, this foreground Service supplies captured screen video to the meeting when screen sharing is active.
en.disableEffect: People in the meeting will no longer see the screen shared from this device.

zh-CN.description: Agora AVC 会议开启屏幕共享时，此前台 Service 会将捕获的屏幕画面提供给会议。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 会议中的其他人将无法看到此设备共享的屏幕。

en.description: When a user opens a combined or forwarded chat message in Easemob Chat UIKit, this Activity shows its message history.
en.disableEffect: Combined chat messages will no longer open their full history.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Easemob Chat UIKit 中打开合并或转发的聊天消息时，此 Activity 会显示其中的消息记录。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 合并聊天消息将无法打开完整记录。

en.description: When a user opens a reply thread in Easemob Chat UIKit, this Activity displays the thread conversation and lets the user join and reply.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to open or reply in chat threads.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Easemob Chat UIKit 中打开回复串时，此 Activity 会显示串内对话，并允许用户加入和回复。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开或回复聊天串。

en.description: When a user starts a thread from a message in Easemob Chat UIKit, this Activity opens the form for creating that thread.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to create a thread from a chat message.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Easemob Chat UIKit 中从某条消息发起聊天串时，此 Activity 会打开创建页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法从聊天消息创建聊天串。

en.description: When a user opens the thread list for a message in Easemob Chat UIKit, this Activity shows its threads and opens a selected thread.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to browse or open threads from a message’s thread list.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Easemob Chat UIKit 中打开某条消息的聊天串列表时，此 Activity 会显示相关聊天串，并打开选中的聊天串。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法浏览或从消息的聊天串列表打开聊天串。

en.description: When a user chooses a video attachment in Easemob Chat UIKit, this Activity shows videos from the device and offers a camera option to record one.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to choose or record a video here to send in chat.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Easemob Chat UIKit 中选择视频附件时，此 Activity 会显示设备上的视频，并提供录制视频的选项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在此处选择或录制视频并发送到聊天中。

en.description: When a user opens an image attachment in Easemob Chat UIKit, this Activity shows it full-screen and downloads it first when only the remote copy is available.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to open or download full-size chat images.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Easemob Chat UIKit 中打开图片附件时，此 Activity 会全屏显示图片；如果本地没有图片，还会先下载。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开或下载聊天中的原尺寸图片。

en.description: When Easemob Chat UIKit opens a video already stored on the device, this Activity plays it with playback controls.
en.disableEffect: Locally stored chat videos will not open in the UIKit player.

zh-CN.description: Easemob Chat UIKit 打开设备上已有的视频时，此 Activity 会使用播放器播放视频。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 本地保存的聊天视频将无法在 UIKit 播放器中打开。

en.description: When a user opens a file attachment in Easemob Chat UIKit, this Activity downloads it if needed and opens the file with an Android app that supports it.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to download and open file attachments from chat.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Easemob Chat UIKit 中打开文件附件时，此 Activity 会在需要时下载文件，并调用 Android 中支持该文件的应用打开它。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法从聊天中下载并打开文件附件。

en.description: When a user opens a video message in Easemob Chat UIKit, this Activity downloads the video when needed and then opens it in the local video player.
en.disableEffect: Video messages will not be downloadable or playable through the UIKit viewer.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Easemob Chat UIKit 中打开视频消息时，此 Activity 会在需要时下载视频，然后在本地播放器中打开。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 视频消息将无法通过 UIKit 查看器下载或播放。

en.description: When a user opens a combined message in Easemob Chat UIKit, this Activity displays the messages contained in it.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to open the messages inside a combined chat message.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Easemob Chat UIKit 中打开合并消息时，此 Activity 会显示其中包含的消息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开合并聊天消息中的内容。

en.description: When a user selects a message search result in Easemob Chat UIKit, this Activity opens the matching conversation at that message.
en.disableEffect: Selecting a search result will no longer open the matching message in its conversation.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Easemob Chat UIKit 中选择消息搜索结果时，此 Activity 会打开对应会话并定位到该消息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 选择搜索结果后将无法在会话中打开对应消息。

en.description: When a user opens an image attachment in Easemob Chat UIKit, this Activity displays it full-screen and downloads the attachment when it is not stored locally.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to open or download full-size chat images.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Easemob Chat UIKit 中打开图片附件时，此 Activity 会全屏显示图片；图片不在本地时会下载附件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开或下载聊天中的原尺寸图片。

en.description: When Easemob Chat UIKit opens a video stored on the device, this Activity plays it in the UIKit video player.
en.disableEffect: Locally stored chat videos will not open in the UIKit player.

zh-CN.description: Easemob Chat UIKit 打开设备上保存的视频时，此 Activity 会使用 UIKit 视频播放器播放。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 本地保存的聊天视频将无法在 UIKit 播放器中打开。

en.description: When a user opens a file attachment in Easemob Chat UIKit, this Activity downloads it if needed and opens the saved file with an Android app that supports it.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to download and open file attachments from chat.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Easemob Chat UIKit 中打开文件附件时，此 Activity 会在需要时下载文件，并调用 Android 中支持该文件的应用打开。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法从聊天中下载并打开文件附件。

en.description: When a user opens a video message in Easemob Chat UIKit, this Activity downloads it if needed and opens it in the local video player.
en.disableEffect: Video messages will not be downloadable or playable through the UIKit viewer.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Easemob Chat UIKit 中打开视频消息时，此 Activity 会在需要时下载视频，并在本地播放器中打开。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 视频消息将无法通过 UIKit 查看器下载或播放。

en.description: When an app opens a one-to-one or group conversation in Easemob Chat UIKit, this Activity displays the chat and supports sending pictures, videos, and files.
en.disableEffect: Apps using this UIKit will not be able to open its built-in chat screen or send attachments through it.

zh-CN.description: 应用通过 Easemob Chat UIKit 打开单聊或群聊时，此 Activity 会显示聊天界面，并支持发送图片、视频和文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此 UIKit 的应用将无法打开内置聊天页面或通过该页面发送附件。

en.description: When a user opens the blocked-contacts page in Easemob Chat UIKit, this Activity shows the list and provides contact search.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to view or manage the blocked-contacts list in this UIKit.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Easemob Chat UIKit 中打开屏蔽联系人页面时，此 Activity 会显示列表并提供联系人搜索。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在此 UIKit 中查看或管理屏蔽联系人列表。

en.description: When a user checks a person in Easemob Chat UIKit, this Activity shows the contact profile and lets the user add the person or accept or decline a contact request.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to review a contact profile or act on a contact request through this page.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Easemob Chat UIKit 中查看某人时，此 Activity 会显示联系人资料，并允许添加联系人或接受、拒绝联系人请求。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此页面查看联系人资料或处理联系人请求。

en.description: When a user opens a contact in Easemob Chat UIKit, this Activity shows the person’s details and the available contact actions.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to open contact details or use the actions on this page.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Easemob Chat UIKit 中打开联系人时，此 Activity 会显示对方资料和可用的联系人操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开联系人资料或使用此页面上的操作。

en.description: When a user starts a group conversation in Easemob Chat UIKit, this Activity lets them choose contacts and create the group.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to create group conversations through this UIKit.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Easemob Chat UIKit 中创建群聊时，此 Activity 会让用户选择联系人并创建群组。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此 UIKit 创建群聊。

en.description: When a user opens a group’s details in Easemob Chat UIKit, this Activity shows its settings and links to member and group-editing pages.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to open group details or reach its member and settings pages through this UIKit.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Easemob Chat UIKit 中打开群组详情时，此 Activity 会显示群组设置，并提供成员管理和群资料编辑页面入口。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此 UIKit 打开群组详情或进入成员管理和设置页面。

en.description: When a user edits a group or thread in Easemob Chat UIKit, this Activity presents the relevant name, description, or personal-note fields.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to edit group or thread details through these UIKit pages.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Easemob Chat UIKit 中编辑群组或聊天串时，此 Activity 会显示相应的名称、描述或个人备注编辑项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过这些 UIKit 页面编辑群组或聊天串资料。

en.description: When a user opens the group list in Easemob Chat UIKit, this Activity displays the groups available to them.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to open the UIKit group list.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Easemob Chat UIKit 中打开群组列表时，此 Activity 会显示用户可访问的群组。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开 UIKit 群组列表。

en.description: When a user opens group members in Easemob Chat UIKit, this Activity shows the members and offers pages to add or remove people and change the owner.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to view or manage group members through this UIKit page.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Easemob Chat UIKit 中打开群成员页面时，此 Activity 会显示成员，并提供添加、移除成员和转让群主的页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此 UIKit 页面查看或管理群成员。

en.description: When a user opens new contact requests in Easemob Chat UIKit, this Activity lists requests and supports accepting, declining, or refusing them.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to review or respond to new contact requests in this UIKit.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Easemob Chat UIKit 中打开新的联系人请求时，此 Activity 会列出请求，并支持接受或拒绝。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在此 UIKit 中查看或回应新的联系人请求。

en.description: When a user opens one contact request in Easemob Chat UIKit, this Activity shows the sender’s details and lets the user accept or decline the request.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to review or respond to a contact request’s details in this UIKit.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Easemob Chat UIKit 中打开某条联系人请求时，此 Activity 会显示请求者资料，并允许接受或拒绝请求。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在此 UIKit 中查看或回应联系人请求详情。

en.description: When a user starts search in Easemob Chat UIKit, this Activity can search contacts or messages, select people, or find blocked contacts, depending on the requested search.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to use these UIKit search pages.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Easemob Chat UIKit 中开始搜索时，此 Activity 会根据搜索类型查找联系人或消息、选择用户或搜索屏蔽联系人。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法使用这些 UIKit 搜索页面。

en.description: When a user creates a thread from a message in Easemob Chat UIKit, this Activity opens the thread composer for that conversation.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to create a chat thread from a message through this UIKit.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Easemob Chat UIKit 中从消息创建聊天串时，此 Activity 会打开该会话的聊天串编辑页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此 UIKit 从消息创建聊天串。

en.description: When a user opens a chat thread in Easemob Chat UIKit, this Activity displays its messages and supports replying with text or attachments.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to open or reply in UIKit chat threads.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Easemob Chat UIKit 中打开聊天串时，此 Activity 会显示串内消息，并支持文字或附件回复。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开或回复 UIKit 聊天串。

en.description: When a user opens threads for a conversation in Easemob Chat UIKit, this Activity lists them and opens a selected thread.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to browse or open threads from the conversation’s thread list.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Easemob Chat UIKit 中查看会话的聊天串时，此 Activity 会列出聊天串并打开选中的一项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法浏览或从会话的聊天串列表打开聊天串。

en.description: When a user opens members of a thread in Easemob Chat UIKit, this Activity lists them and provides member-removal controls.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to view or manage thread members through this page.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Easemob Chat UIKit 中打开聊天串成员页面时，此 Activity 会显示成员并提供移除成员的操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此页面查看或管理聊天串成员。

en.description: When an app opens a one-to-one Agora classroom lesson, this Activity joins the live room and displays the lesson video area and controls.
en.disableEffect: One-to-one lessons that use this screen will not open or join.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开 Agora 一对一课堂时，此 Activity 会加入实时课堂，并显示课堂视频区域和控制项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此界面的一对一课堂将无法打开或加入。

en.description: When an app opens a large-class Agora lesson, this Activity joins the live classroom and displays its main teacher-video area and class controls.
en.disableEffect: Large-class lessons that use this screen will not open or join.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开 Agora 大班课堂时，此 Activity 会加入实时课堂，并显示教师主视频区域和课堂控制项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此界面的大班课堂将无法打开或加入。

en.description: When an app opens a small-class Agora lesson, this Activity joins the room and shows participant video and the on-stage participant view.
en.disableEffect: Small-class lessons that use this screen will not open or join.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开 Agora 小班课堂时，此 Activity 会加入课堂，并显示学员视频和上台学员画面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此界面的小班课堂将无法打开或加入。

en.description: When a small-class lesson opens a breakout group, this Activity joins the group room and tracks the main class so participants can return to it.
en.disableEffect: Participants will not be able to join the breakout-room screen provided by this SDK.

zh-CN.description: 小班课堂打开分组讨论时，此 Activity 会加入分组房间并跟踪主课堂，让学员可以返回主课堂。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 学员将无法进入此 SDK 提供的分组讨论界面。

en.description: During a hosted large-class session, this Activity plays the classroom recording video and synchronized audio inside the live room.
en.disableEffect: The hosted large-class recording screen and its synchronized playback will be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: 大型课堂进行托管播放时，此 Activity 会在实时房间中播放课堂录制视频及同步音频。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 托管的大班课堂录制界面及同步播放将无法使用。

en.description: When a large-class recording starts, this Activity displays the combined classroom video and plays its audio in the room.
en.disableEffect: The large-class recording playback screen will not show the combined classroom video or audio.

zh-CN.description: 大班课堂录制开始时，此 Activity 会在房间中显示合成后的课堂视频并播放音频。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 大班课堂录制界面将无法显示合成视频或播放音频。

en.description: When an app opens an Agora vocational-style large class, this Activity joins the live room and displays its teacher and student video layout.
en.disableEffect: Vocational-style large lessons that use this screen will not open or join.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开 Agora 职业教育大班课堂时，此 Activity 会加入实时房间，并显示教师和学员的视频布局。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此界面的职业教育大班课堂将无法打开或加入。

en.description: When the Agora Meeting interface opens, this Activity builds its main screen and routes users among meeting, people, messages, whiteboard, and settings pages.
en.disableEffect: The Agora Meeting interface will not open or navigate between its main pages.

zh-CN.description: Agora Meeting 界面打开时，此 Activity 会建立主界面，并在会议、参会者、消息、白板和设置页面之间切换。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Agora Meeting 界面将无法打开或在主要页面间切换。

en.description: When an app opens an Agora online class, this Activity joins the lesson and displays its live video, whiteboard, and classroom controls.
en.disableEffect: The online-class lesson screen will not open or join its classroom.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开 Agora 在线课堂时，此 Activity 会加入课程，并显示实时视频、白板和课堂控制项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 在线课堂界面将无法打开或加入课堂。

en.description: When an online class opens a breakout group, this Activity joins the group room and keeps its main-class state connected to the session.
en.disableEffect: Participants will not be able to enter the online-class breakout room through this screen.

zh-CN.description: 在线课堂打开分组讨论时，此 Activity 会加入分组房间，并保持与主课堂状态的关联。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 学员将无法通过此界面进入在线课堂的分组房间。

en.description: The LiveStoreHub SHAS screen-sharing library displays available support agents; choosing one requests a connection for a screen-sharing session. Disabling it prevents users from selecting an agent and starting a session from this screen.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to choose a support agent or start screen sharing from this screen.

zh-CN.description: LiveStoreHub SHAS 屏幕共享库会显示可联系的客服人员；选择一位后会为屏幕共享请求连接。禁用后，用户无法在此界面选择客服并开始共享。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在此界面选择客服或开始屏幕共享。

en.description: The LiveStoreHub SHAS screen-sharing library handles remote messages that end a session, stops local screen sharing, and shows a session-ended notification. Disabling it can leave sharing active after the remote party ends the session.
en.disableEffect: A remote session-ending message may no longer stop screen sharing or notify the user.

zh-CN.description: LiveStoreHub SHAS 屏幕共享库会处理远程结束会话的消息、停止本地屏幕共享并显示会话结束通知。禁用后，远端结束会话时共享可能仍保持开启。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 远程结束会话的消息可能无法停止屏幕共享或通知用户。

en.description: The LiveStoreHub SHAS screen-sharing library responds to stop or cancel actions on its sharing notification, ends the remote session when requested, and stops local sharing. Disabling it makes those notification controls unavailable.
en.disableEffect: The user may not be able to stop or cancel screen sharing from its notification.

zh-CN.description: LiveStoreHub SHAS 屏幕共享库会响应共享通知中的停止或取消操作，按需结束远程会话并停止本地共享。禁用后，通知中的这些控制将无法使用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户可能无法通过通知停止或取消屏幕共享。

en.description: The Agora screen-sharing SDK opens Android's screen-capture permission prompt when a share begins and returns the user's choice to the sharing session. Disabling it prevents Android from requesting the permission needed to share the screen.
en.disableEffect: Screen sharing cannot start because its screen-capture permission prompt will not open.

zh-CN.description: Agora 屏幕共享 SDK 会在开始共享时打开 Android 屏幕采集授权提示，并将用户的选择交回共享流程。禁用后，系统无法请求屏幕共享所需的授权。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 屏幕采集授权提示无法打开，因此屏幕共享无法开始。

en.description: When a user starts screen sharing in an Agora meeting, this foreground service captures the display and supplies the frames used by the sharing session.
en.disableEffect: The phone display cannot be captured and shared during an Agora meeting.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Agora 会议中开始共享屏幕时，此前台 Service 会采集屏幕画面，供共享会话传输。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Agora 会议期间将无法采集和共享手机屏幕。

en.description: The Agora screen-sharing SDK keeps a sharing session connected and sends captured screen content to the other participants, with a visible notification while sharing is active. Disabling it prevents the app from starting or maintaining screen sharing.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot start or maintain an Agora screen-sharing session.

zh-CN.description: Agora 屏幕共享 SDK 会保持共享会话连接，并将采集到的屏幕画面发送给其他参与者；共享期间还会显示通知。禁用后，应用无法开始或维持屏幕共享。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用无法开始或维持 Agora 屏幕共享会话。

en.description: When a user starts screen sharing through the Agora RTC screen-sharing SDK, Android opens this Activity to ask for screen-capture approval and return the result.
en.disableEffect: The screen-capture approval prompt cannot open, so screen sharing cannot start.

zh-CN.description: 用户通过 Agora RTC 屏幕共享 SDK 开始共享时，Android 会打开此 Activity 请求屏幕捕获授权并返回结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 屏幕捕获授权页面无法打开，因此无法开始屏幕共享。

en.description: After screen-capture approval through the Agora RTC screen-sharing SDK, this foreground Service stays active for the screen-capture session and reports display changes.
en.disableEffect: The screen-capture session cannot be maintained, so screen sharing will not work.

zh-CN.description: 通过 Agora RTC 屏幕共享 SDK 获得屏幕捕获授权后，此前台 Service 会在共享期间保持运行并报告屏幕变化。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 屏幕捕获会话无法维持，因此屏幕共享将无法使用。

en.description: When the Ahmer Utils library starts with the app, this provider initializes the library and supplies file links for files the app opens or shares.
en.disableEffect: Ahmer Utils initialization and file-sharing actions that depend on this provider may fail.

zh-CN.description: Ahmer Utils 库随应用启动时，此 Provider 会初始化库，并为应用打开或分享的文件提供访问链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Ahmer Utils 初始化以及依赖此 Provider 的文件分享操作可能失效。

en.description: When Ahmer Utils needs a short-lived screen for a permission request or activity result, this transparent Activity carries out the request and returns the result to the app.
en.disableEffect: Permission prompts and other utility actions that rely on this screen may fail.

zh-CN.description: Ahmer Utils 需要请求权限或接收其他界面结果时，会短暂打开此透明 Activity 处理请求并把结果交还应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此界面的权限请求和其他工具操作可能失效。

en.description: When an Ahmer Utils task needs a screen in the app main process, this transparent Activity hosts the brief task and returns its result to the app.
en.disableEffect: Main-process utility prompts and result-returning actions that rely on this screen may fail.

zh-CN.description: Ahmer Utils 的任务需要在应用主进程中使用界面时，此透明 Activity 会短暂承载该任务并把结果交还应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此界面的主进程工具提示和结果返回操作可能失效。

en.description: Aircore Media starts this Service when a media session needs to keep running in the background. It keeps the session in Android’s foreground and shows the app’s playback notice.
en.disableEffect: Without it, an Aircore voice or audio session loses its background support and may stop when the app is no longer visible.

zh-CN.description: Aircore Media 在媒体会话需要于后台继续运行时启动此 Service。它让会话保持在 Android 前台，并显示应用的播放通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，Aircore 的语音或音频会话将失去后台支持，应用不在前台时可能停止。

en.description: BusyBee by American Express uses this Provider at app startup to register its idle-tracking helper only while automated tests are running. This lets tests wait for BusyBee work to finish.
en.disableEffect: Automated tests may not wait for BusyBee work to finish; ordinary app use is unaffected.

zh-CN.description: 美国运通的 BusyBee 只会在自动化测试运行时，通过此 Provider 注册工作状态跟踪工具，让测试等待 BusyBee 的任务完成。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，自动化测试可能无法等待 BusyBee 的任务完成；日常使用应用不受影响。

en.description: Animity Player by Kl3jvi supplies the app’s video screen for local or streamed anime. It provides playback, quality selection, casting, and picture-in-picture controls.
en.disableEffect: The app’s Animity video screen will not open, so playback and casting through this player will stop.

zh-CN.description: Kl3jvi 的 Animity Player 为应用提供本地或在线播放动画的视频页面，并支持播放、画质选择、投屏和画中画控件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Animity 视频页面将无法打开，播放和投屏也会停止。

en.description: The APISENSE Android SDK uses this Service for background collection tasks, handles requests to pause or resume them, and shows a foreground notice while work is active.
en.disableEffect: APISENSE background collection tasks will no longer run or resume.

zh-CN.description: APISENSE Android SDK 使用此 Service 执行后台数据收集任务，并处理暂停或恢复任务的请求；任务运行时会显示前台通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，APISENSE 后台数据收集任务将无法运行或恢复。

en.description: The APISENSE Android SDK opens this screen when a data-collection task presents a form. It lets the user complete one or more pages and returns the answers to that task.
en.disableEffect: APISENSE forms cannot be completed, so answers collected through this SDK will be lost.

zh-CN.description: APISENSE Android SDK 的数据收集任务需要填写表单时会打开此页面。用户可以完成一页或多页问题，答案随后返回给该任务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，APISENSE 表单无法完成，通过此 SDK 收集的答案也无法提交。

en.description: APISENSE NetSense opens this Activity when it needs to measure network quality, asks the user to approve Android’s VPN connection, and starts its monitoring service after approval.
en.disableEffect: APISENSE NetSense cannot request VPN access or start its network measurements.

zh-CN.description: APISENSE NetSense 需要测量网络质量时会打开此 Activity，请求用户允许 Android 建立 VPN 连接，并在获准后启动监测服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，APISENSE NetSense 无法请求 VPN 权限或开始网络测量。

en.description: After VPN access is approved, APISENSE NetSense runs this VPN service to observe network traffic and measure connection quality and user experience.
en.disableEffect: APISENSE NetSense stops collecting and exporting network measurements.

zh-CN.description: 获得 VPN 权限后，APISENSE NetSense 会运行此 VPN 服务，观察网络流量并测量连接质量和使用体验。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，APISENSE NetSense 将停止收集和导出网络测量数据。

en.description: The APISENSE device-data module opens an explanation and takes the user to Android’s Usage Access settings so device-use collection can be enabled.
en.disableEffect: The SDK cannot guide the user to grant Usage Access, so its device-use measurements cannot be collected through this screen.

zh-CN.description: APISENSE 设备数据模块会显示说明，并带用户前往 Android 的使用情况访问权限设置，以启用设备使用数据收集。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，SDK 无法通过此页面引导用户授予使用情况访问权限，因此无法收集相应的设备使用数据。

en.description: When Appgrades displays a configured popup restriction, this Activity shows its message and optional action and cancel buttons.
en.disableEffect: The app’s configured Appgrades restriction prompt cannot open, so the related update or access flow may fail.

zh-CN.description: Appgrades 显示已配置的弹窗限制时，此 Activity 会展示提示内容以及可选的操作和取消按钮。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，应用配置的 Appgrades 限制提示无法打开，相关更新或访问流程可能无法完成。

en.description: When Appgrades applies a view restriction, this Activity covers or blurs the configured content and displays the restriction message and buttons.
en.disableEffect: The app’s configured Appgrades view-restriction flow cannot open, so the related screen may not work as intended.

zh-CN.description: Appgrades 应用页面限制时，此 Activity 会遮挡或模糊指定内容，并显示限制说明和按钮。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，应用配置的 Appgrades 页面限制流程无法打开，相关页面可能无法正常使用。

en.description: AppMetrica Analytics uses this Service to handle analytics work sent through its app service interface.
en.disableEffect: AppMetrica will no longer process analytics work through this Service.

zh-CN.description: AppMetrica Analytics 使用此 Service 处理通过应用服务接口发送的分析任务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，AppMetrica 将无法通过此 Service 处理分析任务。

en.description: AppMetrica Analytics uses this Provider to accept and save preloaded campaign details and attribution identifiers.
en.disableEffect: Campaign details and attribution identifiers sent through this Provider will not be saved by AppMetrica.

zh-CN.description: AppMetrica Analytics 使用此 Provider 接收并保存预加载的推广活动信息和归因标识。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，通过此 Provider 发送的推广活动信息和归因标识不会由 AppMetrica 保存。

en.description: When a user taps an AppMetrica push-notification action, this Activity handles the selected action and closes.
en.disableEffect: Actions attached to AppMetrica push notifications will not be handled through this Activity.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击 AppMetrica 推送通知中的操作时，此 Activity 会处理所选操作，然后关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，AppMetrica 推送通知附带的操作无法通过此 Activity 处理。

en.description: AppMetrica Push receives notification-action broadcasts, such as taps or button selections, and carries out the chosen action.
en.disableEffect: AppMetrica notification actions sent as broadcasts will not run.

zh-CN.description: AppMetrica Push 会接收通知操作广播，例如点击通知或选择按钮，并执行相应操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，以广播方式发送的 AppMetrica 通知操作将无法执行。

en.description: AppMetrica Push responds when Android reports that app or channel notifications were blocked or changed, and sends the updated status for push delivery.
en.disableEffect: AppMetrica will not learn about notification-setting changes through this receiver.

zh-CN.description: Android 报告应用或通知渠道的通知被屏蔽或设置发生变化时，AppMetrica Push 会接收通知并发送更新后的状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，AppMetrica 将无法通过此 Receiver 获知通知设置的变化。

en.description: When an AppMetrica push notification reaches its expiry time, this Receiver removes it and records that it expired.
en.disableEffect: Expired AppMetrica notifications will not be removed through this receiver, and their expiry callbacks will not run.

zh-CN.description: AppMetrica 推送通知到期时，此 Receiver 会将其移除并记录通知已过期。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，过期的 AppMetrica 通知不会通过此 Receiver 移除，相应的过期回调也不会运行。

en.description: Android starts this AppMetrica Push job in the background to process queued push commands.
en.disableEffect: AppMetrica push commands scheduled as background jobs will not run.

zh-CN.description: Android 会在后台启动此 AppMetrica Push 任务，以处理排队中的推送命令。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，作为后台任务排期的 AppMetrica 推送命令将无法运行。

en.description: AppMetrica Push starts this background Service to process its queued push commands.
en.disableEffect: AppMetrica push commands sent through this background Service will not be processed.

zh-CN.description: AppMetrica Push 会启动此后台 Service 来处理排队中的推送命令。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，通过此后台 Service 发送的 AppMetrica 推送命令将无法处理。

en.description: For apps using the AppMetrica plugin adapter, this Firebase service receives push messages and registration-token updates, then passes them to AppMetrica Push.
en.disableEffect: AppMetrica pushes and token updates delivered through this plugin service will not be processed.

zh-CN.description: 使用 AppMetrica 插件适配器的应用会通过此 Firebase Service 接收推送消息和注册令牌更新，再交给 AppMetrica Push 处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，通过此插件 Service 收到的 AppMetrica 推送和令牌更新将无法处理。

en.description: When Firebase delivers an AppMetrica push message or refreshes its token, this Service forwards the message or token to AppMetrica Push.
en.disableEffect: AppMetrica pushes and registration-token updates delivered by Firebase will not be processed.

zh-CN.description: Firebase 收到 AppMetrica 推送消息或更新令牌时，此 Service 会将消息或令牌转交给 AppMetrica Push。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，Firebase 送达的 AppMetrica 推送和注册令牌更新将无法处理。

en.description: When Google Cloud Messaging delivers a message to the app, this Service passes it to AppMetrica Push.
en.disableEffect: AppMetrica pushes delivered through Google Cloud Messaging will not be processed.

zh-CN.description: Google Cloud Messaging 向应用送达消息时，此 Service 会将消息交给 AppMetrica Push 处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，通过 Google Cloud Messaging 送达的 AppMetrica 推送将无法处理。

en.description: When Google refreshes the app’s messaging-registration token, this Service sends the new token to AppMetrica Push.
en.disableEffect: AppMetrica will not receive refreshed registration tokens through Google’s Instance ID service.

zh-CN.description: Google 更新应用的消息注册令牌时，此 Service 会将新令牌发送给 AppMetrica Push。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，AppMetrica 将无法通过 Google Instance ID 服务收到更新后的注册令牌。

en.description: When Huawei Mobile Services delivers an AppMetrica push message or refreshes the app’s token, this Service passes the update to AppMetrica Push.
en.disableEffect: AppMetrica pushes and token updates delivered through Huawei Mobile Services will not be processed.

zh-CN.description: Huawei Mobile Services 送达 AppMetrica 推送或更新应用令牌时，此 Service 会将消息或令牌交给 AppMetrica Push 处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，通过 Huawei Mobile Services 送达的 AppMetrica 推送和令牌更新将无法处理。

en.description: When RuStore delivers an AppMetrica push message or refreshes the app’s token, this Service passes the update to AppMetrica Push.
en.disableEffect: AppMetrica pushes and token updates delivered through RuStore will not be processed.

zh-CN.description: RuStore 送达 AppMetrica 推送或更新应用令牌时，此 Service 会将消息或令牌交给 AppMetrica Push 处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，通过 RuStore 送达的 AppMetrica 推送和令牌更新将无法处理。

en.description: During Asgardeo Android UI Core sign-in, this activity opens the login page in an in-app browser tab and returns the result or cancellation to the app.
en.disableEffect: Asgardeo sign-in flows that use this browser handoff may not complete.

zh-CN.description: Asgardeo Android UI Core SDK 开始登录时，此界面会在应用内浏览器页打开登录页面，并把登录结果或取消状态交回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此浏览器交接步骤的 Asgardeo 登录流程可能无法完成。

en.description: When the browser returns to the app after Asgardeo Android UI Core sign-in, this activity receives the redirect link and passes it into the authentication flow.
en.disableEffect: Browser-based Asgardeo sign-in may stop before the app can finish authentication.

zh-CN.description: Asgardeo Android UI Core 登录后，浏览器返回应用时，此界面会接收重定向链接并交给认证流程处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过浏览器进行的 Asgardeo 登录可能无法返回应用并完成认证。

en.description: During Asgardeo Direct Authentication sign-in, this activity opens the login page in an in-app browser tab and returns the result or cancellation to the app.
en.disableEffect: Asgardeo direct authentication flows that use this browser handoff may not complete.

zh-CN.description: Asgardeo Direct Authentication SDK 开始登录时，此界面会在应用内浏览器页打开登录页面，并把登录结果或取消状态交回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此浏览器交接步骤的 Asgardeo Direct Authentication 登录流程可能无法完成。

en.description: When the browser returns to the app after Asgardeo Direct Authentication sign-in, this activity receives the redirect link and passes it into the authentication flow.
en.disableEffect: Browser-based Asgardeo sign-in may stop before the app can finish authentication.

zh-CN.description: Asgardeo Direct Authentication 登录后，浏览器返回应用时，此界面会接收重定向链接并交给认证流程处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过浏览器进行的 Asgardeo 登录可能无法返回应用并完成认证。

en.description: The Asgardeo Android sign-in SDK opens this screen after the identity provider returns an authorization result. It exchanges that result for access and identity tokens, updates the signed-in user, and returns success or cancellation to the app.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents Asgardeo sign-in from finishing the token exchange and returning its result to the app.

zh-CN.description: 身份提供方返回授权结果后，Asgardeo Android 登录 SDK 会打开此页面，将授权结果交换为访问令牌和身份令牌、更新登录用户，并向应用返回成功或取消结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Asgardeo 登录无法完成令牌交换，也无法向应用返回认证结果。

en.description: When a user selects a saved report in the CrashGrabber crash viewer, this activity loads and displays that report's details.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to open saved crash report details in the CrashGrabber viewer.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 CrashGrabber 崩溃查看器中选择已保存的报告时，此界面会加载并显示报告详情。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在 CrashGrabber 查看器中打开已保存的崩溃报告详情。

en.description: When the CrashGrabber crash viewer is opened, this activity displays the saved crash reports so a user can choose one.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to browse saved crash reports in the CrashGrabber viewer.

zh-CN.description: 打开 CrashGrabber 崩溃查看器时，此界面会显示已保存的崩溃报告供用户选择。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在 CrashGrabber 查看器中浏览已保存的崩溃报告。

en.description: When Firebase refreshes a device's notification registration, the Ayro Android SDK updates its messaging registration if Ayro messaging is enabled.
en.disableEffect: New Ayro chat notifications may stop reaching this device after its registration changes.

zh-CN.description: Firebase 刷新设备的通知注册信息时，如果已启用 Ayro 消息功能，Ayro Android SDK 会更新对应的消息注册信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 设备的注册信息变化后，新的 Ayro 聊天通知可能无法送达。

en.description: When Firebase delivers an Ayro chat message for the signed-in user, the Ayro Android SDK routes it to the chat or notification flow.
en.disableEffect: Users may stop receiving Ayro chat messages and related notifications.

zh-CN.description: Firebase 收到发给当前 Ayro 用户的聊天消息时，Ayro Android SDK 会将消息送入聊天界面或通知流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户可能无法继续收到 Ayro 聊天消息和相关通知。

en.description: When the app opens Ayro chat, this screen loads the conversation and lets the user send messages while showing connection status.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to open or continue the Ayro chat in the app.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开 Ayro 聊天时，此界面会加载对话内容、显示连接状态，并允许用户发送消息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在应用中打开或继续使用 Ayro 聊天。

en.description: When Bayat Games Social Sharing for Unity shares a local file, this provider exposes it through a link that another app can open.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to share local files through the Unity social sharing feature.

zh-CN.description: Bayat Games 的 Unity 社交分享库分享本地文件时，此文件共享组件会生成其他应用可以打开的链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 Unity 社交分享功能分享本地文件。

en.description: At app startup, the BidMachine ads SDK uses this provider to prepare its ad services before ad requests begin.
en.disableEffect: BidMachine ads may fail to initialize or load.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，BidMachine 广告 SDK 会通过此初始化组件预先准备广告服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: BidMachine 广告可能无法初始化或加载。

en.description: When BidMachine opens a full-screen interactive ad, this activity displays the ad and its timed close control when one is required.
en.disableEffect: These interactive ads will not open, and rewarded placements using this screen will not grant rewards for watching ads.

zh-CN.description: BidMachine 打开全屏互动广告时，此界面会显示广告，并在需要时显示计时关闭控件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 此类互动广告将无法打开；使用此界面的激励广告也不会发放观看奖励。

en.description: When BidMachine presents a full-screen interactive ad, this activity retrieves the ad and displays it to the user.
en.disableEffect: Interactive ads using this presentation will not show, and rewarded placements will not grant rewards for watching ads.

zh-CN.description: BidMachine 展示全屏互动广告时，此界面会取出广告并显示给用户。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此界面的互动广告将无法显示，激励广告也不会发放观看奖励。

en.description: When BidMachine presents a video ad, this activity plays it full-screen and reports playback, taps, and completion to the ad SDK.
en.disableEffect: Video ads using this screen will not play, and rewarded ads will not grant rewards for watching.

zh-CN.description: BidMachine 展示视频广告时，此界面会全屏播放视频，并把播放、点击和完成情况传回广告 SDK。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此界面的视频广告将无法播放，激励广告也不会发放观看奖励。

en.description: When a BidMachine native ad includes a video, this activity plays the video full-screen and shows the ad's close control.
en.disableEffect: BidMachine native ad videos using this player will not play.

zh-CN.description: BidMachine 原生广告包含视频时，此界面会全屏播放视频并显示广告关闭控件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此播放器的 BidMachine 原生广告视频将无法播放。

en.description: When the BidMachine SDK opens a full-screen ad, this activity displays the ad and closes its presentation when it ends.
en.disableEffect: BidMachine ads that use this full-screen presentation will not show.

zh-CN.description: BidMachine SDK 打开全屏广告时，此界面会显示广告，并在展示结束时关闭广告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此全屏展示界面的 BidMachine 广告将无法显示。

en.description: When a user expands a BidMachine ad, this activity displays the expanded ad view and collapses it when the view closes.
en.disableEffect: Users will not see expanded BidMachine ad content.

zh-CN.description: 用户展开 BidMachine 广告时，此界面会显示展开后的广告内容，并在界面关闭时收起广告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法看到展开后的 BidMachine 广告内容。

en.description: When another screen opens this KibitzerCZ utility-library Activity with a URL, it displays the page in an in-app WebView and lets the user follow links or go back through page history.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open pages through the library's in-app web viewer.

zh-CN.description: 其他界面携带网址打开 KibitzerCZ 工具库中的此 Activity 时，它会在应用内 WebView 中显示网页，并允许用户打开链接或返回浏览历史。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，用户无法通过此工具库的应用内网页查看器打开页面。

en.description: Branch Engage's Conduit source provider answers discovery requests from verified clients, reports the app's source catalogs and state, and serves cached catalog files on request.
en.disableEffect: Branch Engage clients cannot retrieve the app's source state or cached catalog files through this provider, so connected catalog features stop receiving updates.

zh-CN.description: Branch Engage 的 Conduit 来源提供程序会响应已验证客户端的发现请求，报告应用的内容目录和状态，并按请求提供缓存目录文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Branch Engage 客户端将无法通过此提供程序获取应用的来源状态或缓存目录文件，相关目录功能也会停止更新。

en.description: Branch Android SDK's diagnostics page loads and displays the device-schema report when opened through its diagnostic route.
en.disableEffect: Only the Branch SDK diagnostics page becomes unavailable; normal app screens do not depend on it.

zh-CN.description: 通过诊断入口打开时，Branch Android SDK 的诊断页面会加载并显示设备架构报告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 只有 Branch SDK 诊断页面会无法打开，应用的常规页面不依赖它。

en.description: Bucketeer Android SDK schedules this receiver to refresh feature-flag evaluations in the background and send pending SDK events.
en.disableEffect: Feature-flag values stop refreshing in the background, so app behavior tied to updated Bucketeer flags may remain outdated.

zh-CN.description: Bucketeer Android SDK 会安排此接收器在后台刷新功能开关评估结果，并发送待处理的 SDK 事件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 后台功能开关结果将不再刷新，依赖最新 Bucketeer 开关的应用行为可能保持旧状态。

en.description: Bucketeer Android SDK schedules this receiver to flush queued SDK events to its service in the background.
en.disableEffect: Queued Bucketeer events may remain unsent until a later sync, reducing or delaying SDK reporting.

zh-CN.description: Bucketeer Android SDK 会安排此接收器在后台将排队的 SDK 事件发送到服务端。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 排队的 Bucketeer 事件可能要等到之后同步才会发送，SDK 报告会延迟或减少。

en.description: The Bugtags SDK opens its issue report form when a user starts a report and can show its sign-in screen when requested. The report flow can ask for location permission when needed.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to open Bugtags' report or sign-in screens.

zh-CN.description: Bugtags SDK 会在用户发起问题报告时打开报告表单，也会按请求显示登录界面。报告流程需要定位权限时会向用户申请。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开 Bugtags 的报告或登录界面。

en.description: The Bugtags SDK runs this Receiver when Android reports a connectivity change and asks the SDK to resend queued issue reports.
en.disableEffect: Queued Bugtags reports will not be retried automatically when network connectivity changes.

zh-CN.description: Android 通知网络连接变化时，Bugtags SDK 会尝试重新发送排队中的问题报告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 网络连接变化时，排队中的 Bugtags 报告不会自动重试。

en.description: The Bugtags SDK uses this Service to keep its floating issue report control and its shake or tap triggers available while the app is running.
en.disableEffect: The Bugtags floating report control and its shake or tap triggers will stop working.

zh-CN.description: Bugtags SDK 在应用运行期间使用此服务维持浮动问题反馈入口，并响应摇晃或点击触发的报告操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Bugtags 浮动反馈入口及其摇晃、点击触发方式将无法使用。

en.description: Card.io opens this card-entry screen when a checkout requests card scanning. It reads card details with the camera, can allow manual entry when the integration permits it, and returns the result to checkout.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it stops card scanning and any card entry routed through Card.io; payment screens that launch it may fail or lose card input.

zh-CN.description: 结账流程请求扫描银行卡时，Card.io 会打开此页面读取卡片信息；集成允许时，用户也可手动输入，并将结果返回结账流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，银行卡扫描及经 Card.io 进行的输入将停止，调用它的支付页面可能失败或无法取得卡片信息。

en.description: The card.io card-scanning SDK opens this screen when a payment needs manual card entry or correction. It collects the card number and any requested expiry date, security code, postal code, or cardholder name, then returns the details to the payment flow.
en.disableEffect: Users may be unable to enter or correct card details, which can prevent card payments from completing.

zh-CN.description: 付款流程需要手动输入或修正银行卡信息时，card.io 银行卡识别 SDK 会打开此页面。页面收集卡号以及付款流程要求的有效期、安全码、邮编或持卡人姓名，然后把信息交还给付款流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户可能无法输入或修正银行卡信息，导致银行卡付款无法完成。

en.description: Xiaomi Mi Push delivers Castled messages and registration results to this Castled MiPush receiver. It forwards Castled pass-through messages for notification handling and sends successful registration tokens to Castled.
en.disableEffect: Castled push messages delivered through Xiaomi Mi Push will stop appearing.

zh-CN.description: Xiaomi Mi Push 会在收到 Castled 消息或注册结果时调用此接收器。它将 Castled 透传消息交给通知处理逻辑，并把注册令牌交给 Castled。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过 Xiaomi Mi Push 发送的 Castled 推送将无法显示。

en.description: The Castled Notifications SDK opens its in-app inbox when the app asks to show saved push messages. It organizes messages into categories for the user to browse.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to open or browse the Castled message inbox.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开站内消息中心时，Castled Notifications SDK 会显示收件箱，并按类别展示保存的推送消息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开或浏览 Castled 消息收件箱。

en.description: Firebase Cloud Messaging invokes this Castled Notifications SDK service for token updates and incoming messages. It handles Castled messages and ignores messages from other senders.
en.disableEffect: Castled push messages will no longer be processed, and new push tokens will not reach Castled.

zh-CN.description: Firebase Cloud Messaging 会在令牌更新或收到消息时调用 Castled Notifications SDK 的服务。它处理 Castled 消息，并忽略其他来源的消息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Castled 推送消息将不再处理，新的推送令牌也不会同步给 Castled。

en.description: When a Castled notification action sends a broadcast, this Receiver clears the matching notification and reports the event to Castled.
en.disableEffect: Castled notification action events will no longer be cleared or reported by this Receiver.

zh-CN.description: Castled 通知操作触发广播时，此接收器会清除对应通知并将事件上报给 Castled。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Castled 通知操作将无法通过此接收器清除通知或上报事件。

en.description: When a user taps a Castled notification, this Activity opens its configured link or app screen, or launches the app's home screen, and reports the click to Castled.
en.disableEffect: Tapping Castled notifications will no longer open their configured destinations.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击 Castled 通知时，此 Activity 会打开通知指定的链接或应用内页面，也可以打开应用首页，并将点击事件上报给 Castled。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 点击 Castled 通知将无法打开其指定页面或链接。

en.description: The Castled Notifications SDK opens this Activity when a user taps one of its notifications. It follows the configured link or screen, or returns to the app's launch screen, and reports the click.
en.disableEffect: Tapping a Castled notification will no longer open its configured destination.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击 Castled 通知时，Castled Notifications SDK 会打开此 Activity。它会按通知设置打开链接或应用内页面，也可回到应用主界面，并将点击事件上报给 Castled。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 点击 Castled 通知将无法打开其指定页面或链接。

en.description: The Castled Notifications SDK uses this Receiver for notification action broadcasts; it timestamps the event and reports it to Castled.
en.disableEffect: Castled notification action events will no longer be processed and reported.

zh-CN.description: 收到通知操作广播时，Castled Notifications SDK 会处理事件、记录事件时间并将其上报给 Castled。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Castled 通知操作事件将不再得到处理和上报。

en.description: Firebase Cloud Messaging invokes this Castled Notifications SDK service for new push tokens and incoming messages. It forwards token updates to Castled and passes messages to the SDK's notification handler.
en.disableEffect: Castled push notifications will no longer be handled, and new push tokens will not reach Castled.

zh-CN.description: Firebase Cloud Messaging 会在推送令牌更新或收到消息时调用 Castled Notifications SDK 的服务。它把令牌更新交给 Castled，并把消息交给通知处理逻辑。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Castled 推送消息将不再处理，新的推送令牌也不会同步给 Castled。

en.description: Firebase Cloud Messaging calls this Chabok Push & Realtime Messaging service for token changes and incoming messages. Chabok registers new tokens and displays or updates notifications for its messages.
en.disableEffect: Chabok push notifications will stop arriving, and updated Firebase tokens will no longer be registered with Chabok.

zh-CN.description: Firebase Cloud Messaging 会在令牌变化或收到消息时调用 Chabok Push 与实时消息服务。Chabok 会登记新令牌，并显示或更新其消息通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Chabok 推送通知将无法送达，更新后的 Firebase 令牌也不会再登记到 Chabok。

en.description: The Chabok SDK triggers this Receiver when a user clicks, dismisses, or taps an action button on a Chabok notification. It follows the configured link or app screen and reports the action.
en.disableEffect: Chabok notification links and action buttons will stop working, and click or dismissal events will no longer be reported.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击、关闭 Chabok 通知或点击其中的操作按钮时，Chabok SDK 会调用此接收器。它会按设置打开链接或应用页面，并上报操作事件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Chabok 通知链接和操作按钮将无法使用，点击或关闭事件也不会再上报。

en.description: Chabok Push & Realtime Messaging uses this Provider at app startup to store the application context and register app lifecycle callbacks for its SDK.
en.disableEffect: Without another Chabok context setup, push handling and notification actions can fail when the SDK requests the application context.

zh-CN.description: Chabok Push 与实时消息 SDK 会在应用启动时使用此 Provider 保存应用上下文并注册应用生命周期回调。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 如果应用未通过其他方式设置 Chabok 上下文，SDK 读取应用上下文时推送处理和通知操作可能失败。

en.description: Channel.io opens this screen when a user taps an image attachment in a support conversation; it shows the image and offers copy-link and download controls.
en.disableEffect: Images attached to Channel.io support messages can no longer be viewed or downloaded through this screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击 Channel.io 客服会话中的图片附件时，这个界面会显示图片，并提供复制链接和下载功能。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过这个界面查看或下载 Channel.io 客服消息中的图片。

en.description: Channel.io opens this screen when a user taps an image attachment in a support conversation; it displays the image gallery, thumbnails, and a download option.
en.disableEffect: Images attached to Channel.io support messages can no longer be viewed or downloaded through this screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击 Channel.io 客服会话中的图片附件时，这个界面会显示图片图库、缩略图和下载选项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过这个界面查看或下载 Channel.io 客服消息中的图片。

en.description: When Channel.io cannot run because of an unsupported version, this screen shows the error and offers a close button or a link to the Play Store.
en.disableEffect: The Channel.io unsupported-version screen and its update link will not be available.

zh-CN.description: Channel.io 因版本不受支持而无法运行时，这个界面会显示错误，并提供关闭按钮或前往 Play 商店的链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Channel.io 的版本不受支持提示和更新链接将无法使用。

en.description: When a user opens follow-up contact settings in Channel.io support, this screen loads the requested contact fields and lets the user review or update eligible details.
en.disableEffect: Users can no longer review or update their follow-up contact details through Channel.io support.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Channel.io 客服中打开后续联系设置时，这个界面会加载所需的联系字段，并允许用户查看或更新可编辑的信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 Channel.io 客服查看或更新后续联系信息。

en.description: Channel.io opens this screen when the app launches its support center or a push link; it shows support tabs and starts the selected conversation.
en.disableEffect: The app's Channel.io support center and chat entry points will not open.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开客服中心或通过推送进入客服时，Channel.io 会显示这个界面中的客服标签页和所选会话。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用内的 Channel.io 客服中心和聊天入口将无法打开。

en.description: Chopyourbrain Kontrol opens a developer diagnostics screen with app properties and captured network activity when the app launches its debug menu.
en.disableEffect: Developers can no longer open Kontrol's in-app diagnostics and network-history screens.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开调试菜单时，Chopyourbrain Kontrol 会显示开发者诊断页面，其中包含应用属性和记录的网络活动。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 开发者将无法打开 Kontrol 的应用内诊断和网络记录页面。

en.description: When the app starts a Cine.io broadcast or recording, this screen previews the camera and encodes camera video with microphone audio to a publish destination or local recording file.
en.disableEffect: The app's Cine.io camera and microphone broadcasting or recording flow will not be available.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动 Cine.io 直播或录制时，这个界面会预览摄像头，并将摄像头视频和麦克风音频编码到发布地址或本地录制文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法使用 Cine.io 的摄像头、麦克风直播或录制流程。

en.description: Clistery WebBasic prepares Tencent X5 for embedded pages at app startup when X5 is enabled. It also receives the browser engine's download and installation status.
en.disableEffect: Pages that rely on WebBasic's X5 setup may fail to load without this startup initialization.

zh-CN.description: 启用 X5 时，Clistery WebBasic 会在应用启动时准备腾讯 X5 浏览内核，并接收内核下载和安装状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖 WebBasic 初始化的内嵌网页可能无法加载。

en.description: After a user enables Cobrowse.io's accessibility service in Android Settings, Android starts it to observe screen changes and provide remote-session highlighting and controls.
en.disableEffect: Cobrowse.io sessions will lose accessibility-based screen guidance and remote controls.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Android 设置中启用 Cobrowse.io 无障碍服务后，系统会启动它来观察界面变化，并为远程协作提供屏幕提示和控制。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Cobrowse.io 会话将失去基于无障碍服务的屏幕提示和远程控制。

en.description: At app startup, this provider registers Cobrowse.io's Compose screen-masking support, which hides app content marked for redaction during a co-browsing session.
en.disableEffect: Compose content marked for hiding may remain visible during Cobrowse.io screen sharing.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，这个 Provider 会注册 Cobrowse.io 的 Compose 界面遮挡支持，在远程协作期间隐藏标记为敏感的内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Cobrowse.io 屏幕共享期间，标记为隐藏的 Compose 内容可能仍会显示。

en.description: Android runs this Cobrowse.io provider when the app starts; it saves the app context and watches screen lifecycles for co-browsing sessions.
en.disableEffect: Cobrowse.io session setup can throw an initialization error and fail because the SDK requires this provider.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，Android 会运行 Cobrowse.io 的这个 Provider；它保存应用上下文并观察界面生命周期，以支持远程协作会话。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Cobrowse.io 会话初始化可能因缺少此 Provider 而报错并失败。

en.description: Cobrowse.io starts this foreground service when a full-device sharing session needs screen capture; it keeps the session running with a notification and an end-session button.
en.disableEffect: Cobrowse.io full-device screen-sharing sessions cannot run while this service is disabled.

zh-CN.description: Cobrowse.io 需要捕获整个设备屏幕时会启动这个前台 Service；它通过通知保持会话运行，并提供结束会话的按钮。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用此 Service 后，Cobrowse.io 将无法运行全设备屏幕共享会话。

en.description: Cobrowse.io sends this receiver explicit session and accessibility updates; it ends a requested session or refreshes a live session when accessibility access changes.
en.disableEffect: Cobrowse.io will not handle the session end command or accessibility-state updates through this receiver.

zh-CN.description: Cobrowse.io 会通过显式广播向这个 Receiver 发送会话和无障碍状态更新；它会结束指定会话，或在无障碍权限变化时刷新会话。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Cobrowse.io 将无法通过此 Receiver 处理结束会话指令或无障碍状态更新。

en.description: Android runs this scheduled job with a network connection to register the device with Cobrowse.io and schedule the next registration attempt.
en.disableEffect: Cobrowse.io device registration will stop refreshing, which can prevent remote support sessions from reaching the device.

zh-CN.description: Android 会在有网络连接时运行这个定时任务，向 Cobrowse.io 登记设备并安排下一次登记。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Cobrowse.io 设备登记将不再刷新，远程客服可能无法连接到这台设备。

en.description: When Cobrowse.io requests full-device screen capture from the background, it opens this temporary screen so Android can show the user's screen-capture consent prompt.
en.disableEffect: Background full-device sharing cannot request screen-capture consent and will not start.

zh-CN.description: Cobrowse.io 在后台请求捕获整个设备屏幕时，会打开这个临时界面，让 Android 显示屏幕捕获授权提示。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 后台发起的全设备共享无法请求屏幕捕获授权，因此不会启动。

en.description: During GARI Wallet Web3 sign-in, this activity checks the supplied login token and authentication settings, starts Web3Auth, and handles the browser return.
en.disableEffect: GARI Wallet Web3 sign-in will not complete.

zh-CN.description: 进行 GARI Wallet Web3 登录时，此页面会检查传入的登录令牌和认证配置，启动 Web3Auth 并处理浏览器返回结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，GARI Wallet Web3 登录将无法完成。

en.description: During GARI Wallet WebGari sign-in, this activity opens the wallet authorization page with the supplied token and receives private-key information from the page.
en.disableEffect: GARI Wallet WebGari sign-in will not complete.

zh-CN.description: 进行 GARI Wallet WebGari 登录时，此页面会使用传入的令牌打开钱包授权页面，并接收网页返回的私钥信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，GARI Wallet WebGari 登录将无法完成。

en.description: After a user approves screen capture in Commented.io, this foreground service captures a still image of the current screen and returns it to the comment workflow.
en.disableEffect: The app's screen-capture images for comments or feedback will no longer be available.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Commented.io 授权屏幕捕获后，这个前台 Service 会截取当前屏幕并将图片交给评论流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法再为评论或反馈获取屏幕截图。

en.description: When a user starts a screen-recording comment in Commented.io, this foreground service records the display and saves the video in the Commented movies folder.
en.disableEffect: The app's screen-recording comments and feedback videos cannot be created.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Commented.io 中开始录制屏幕并添加评论时，这个前台 Service 会录制画面并将视频保存到 Commented 影片目录。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法创建屏幕录制评论和反馈视频。

en.description: When Customer.io displays an in-app modal campaign, this screen reads the message details from its launch request and renders the modal over the app.
en.disableEffect: Customer.io in-app modal campaign messages will no longer appear.

zh-CN.description: Customer.io 显示应用内弹窗活动消息时，这个界面会读取启动请求中的消息内容，并在应用中呈现弹窗。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Customer.io 应用内弹窗活动消息将不再显示。

en.description: Google's C2DM receive broadcast starts this Customer.io receiver; it initializes the SDK and passes the push message for processing.
en.disableEffect: Customer.io messages delivered through the C2DM broadcast route will no longer be processed.

zh-CN.description: Google 的 C2DM 接收广播会启动 Customer.io 的这个 Receiver；它初始化 SDK 并交由推送处理流程处理消息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过 C2DM 广播通道送达的 Customer.io 消息将不再处理。

en.description: Firebase starts this Customer.io service for FCM messages and token changes; it registers the device token and processes Customer.io push notifications.
en.disableEffect: Customer.io push-token updates and Firebase-delivered push notifications will stop working.

zh-CN.description: Firebase 收到 FCM 消息或令牌变化时会启动 Customer.io 的这个 Service；它登记设备令牌并处理 Customer.io 推送通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Customer.io 推送令牌更新和 Firebase 推送通知将停止工作。

en.description: After a user taps a Customer.io push notification, this transparent screen processes the click and routes it to the requested app destination before closing.
en.disableEffect: Customer.io push taps will no longer route to their intended app destination.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击 Customer.io 推送通知后，这个透明界面会处理点击，并在关闭前跳转到通知指定的应用页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 点击 Customer.io 推送通知后，将无法跳转到指定的应用页面。

en.description: When a user dismisses a Customer.io live notification, this receiver marks it ended and reports the dismissal to Customer.io.
en.disableEffect: Customer.io will no longer receive dismissal events for live notifications.

zh-CN.description: 用户关闭 Customer.io 实时通知时，这个 Receiver 会将通知标记为已结束并向 Customer.io 报告关闭事件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Customer.io 将不再收到实时通知的关闭事件。

en.description: When the DCloud runtime opens this screen with a task request, it runs the requested operation and returns its result to the waiting part of the app through an app-local broadcast.
en.disableEffect: DCloud features that rely on this cross-process task flow may fail to complete or return their result.

zh-CN.description: DCloud 运行时携带任务请求打开此页面时，它会执行指定操作，并通过应用内广播把结果返回给等待方。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此跨进程任务流程的 DCloud 功能可能无法完成操作或返回结果。

en.description: DCloud Uni-App uses this in-app browser for web and local-page links; it loads the requested page and provides navigation, download, copy, share, and open-in-browser actions.
en.disableEffect: In-app links and any ad destinations routed through this browser will no longer open here.

zh-CN.description: DCloud Uni-App 使用此应用内浏览页打开网页或本地页面；它加载指定内容，并提供页面导航、下载、复制、分享和转到外部浏览器等操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用内链接以及通过此浏览页打开的广告落地页将无法显示。

en.description: DCloud’s gallery or camera opens this screen after an image is chosen; the user can crop or annotate it, apply requested size and quality settings, and return the edited image.
en.disableEffect: Image cropping and editing in DCloud’s gallery and camera flows will not complete.

zh-CN.description: 用户选中图片后，DCloud 相册或相机会打开此编辑页；用户可裁剪或标注图片、应用指定尺寸和画质设置，并返回编辑结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，DCloud 相册和相机流程中的图片裁剪与编辑将无法完成。

en.description: DCloud Uni-App opens this full-screen image viewer from a gallery or image slider; users can swipe through images, optionally loop through them, and long-press an image for app-provided actions.
en.disableEffect: DCloud’s full-screen gallery and image-slider previews will not open.

zh-CN.description: DCloud Uni-App 会从图片库或图片轮播中打开此全屏查看页；用户可滑动浏览图片、按需循环播放，并长按图片触发应用提供的操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，DCloud 的全屏图片库和轮播图预览将无法打开。

en.description: When a DCloud UniMP mini-app is loaded in a separate process, this Activity displays its pages and connects the mini-app to its runtime service.
en.disableEffect: The mini-app using this process slot may not display its pages, so its feature flow can fail.

zh-CN.description: DCloud UniMP 小程序在独立进程中加载时，此页面显示小程序内容，并连接其运行服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，使用此进程的小程序可能无法显示页面，相关功能流程会失效。

en.description: DCloud UniMP starts this background Service for a mini-app running in a separate process; it keeps the mini-app runtime available and carries app commands and status between the mini-app and its host.
en.disableEffect: Mini-apps using this process may fail to start or exchange runtime commands and status with the host.

zh-CN.description: DCloud UniMP 会为独立进程中运行的小程序启动此后台服务；它维持小程序运行环境，并在小程序与宿主之间传递操作和状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，使用此进程的小程序可能无法启动，也无法与宿主交换运行操作和状态。

en.description: DCloud UniMP also uses this Activity to display pages of a mini-app loaded in a separate process through its alternate screen route.
en.disableEffect: Mini-apps assigned to this route may not display their pages, so related features can fail.

zh-CN.description: DCloud UniMP 也会通过此页面，在备用页面入口中显示独立进程里加载的小程序内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，经由此入口运行的小程序可能无法显示页面，相关功能会失效。

zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，经由此入口运行的小程序可能无法显示页面，相关功能会失效。

en.disableEffect: Mini-apps that start through this alternate entry will not be able to open their first page.

zh-CN.description: DCloud UniMP 会通过此备用入口页面打开独立进程中加载的小程序首页。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，通过此备用入口启动的小程序将无法打开首页。

zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，通过此备用入口启动的小程序将无法打开首页。
