zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，通过此备用入口启动的小程序将无法打开首页。

en.description: Didomi opens this activity on connected TVs when a consent notice is shown; it presents the notice in a focused dialog and handles navigation or dismissal.
en.disableEffect: The app may no longer show Didomi's TV consent notice to users.

zh-CN.description: 联网电视显示隐私同意提示时，Didomi 会打开这个界面，以对话框呈现提示并处理导航或关闭操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用可能无法再向用户显示 Didomi 的电视端同意提示。

en.description: When a user opens Didomi privacy settings on a connected TV, this activity loads the interface for reviewing or changing consent choices.
en.disableEffect: Users can no longer open Didomi's TV privacy settings or manage consent choices there.

zh-CN.description: 用户在联网电视上打开 Didomi 隐私设置时，这个界面会加载查看或更改同意选项的页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开 Didomi 电视端隐私设置或管理其中的同意选项。

en.description: Didomi launches this screen with a notice or preferences role to render the configured consent layout and handle its buttons, page changes, and redirects.
en.disableEffect: Didomi's configured consent and privacy-preference screens will not display or work.

zh-CN.description: Didomi 会以同意提示或偏好设置模式启动这个界面，呈现配置好的隐私页面并处理按钮、页面切换和跳转。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Didomi 配置的同意提示和隐私偏好页面将无法显示或使用。

en.description: Display.io Android ad SDK opens this full-screen Activity when it renders an interstitial ad or handles an ad click. It shows the ad and can send the user to the advertiser's page or app store.
en.disableEffect: Interstitial ads and ad click-throughs handled by Display.io will stop working.

zh-CN.description: Display.io Android 广告 SDK 在展示插屏广告或处理广告点击时会打开此全屏 Activity。它显示广告，并可将用户带到广告主页面或应用商店。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Display.io 通过此界面展示的插屏广告和广告跳转将无法使用。

en.description: Display.io Android ad SDK opens this translucent Activity for ad placements that use an overlay. It renders the ad or handles its click destination while leaving the app visible behind it.
en.disableEffect: Display.io ads that use the translucent presentation and their click-through screens will stop working.

zh-CN.description: Display.io Android 广告 SDK 会为采用叠加显示方式的广告打开此透明 Activity。它负责展示广告或处理广告跳转，同时让后面的应用界面保持可见。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 采用透明显示方式的 Display.io 广告及其跳转界面将无法使用。

en.description: When Display.io has location requests enabled and location access is missing, it opens this Activity to ask for location permission and report the result so ad loading can continue.
en.disableEffect: If the app enables this location prompt, Display.io cannot complete that permission flow or resume the related ad setup when this Activity is disabled.

zh-CN.description: 当应用启用了 Display.io 的位置请求且尚未授予位置权限时，SDK 会打开此 Activity 请求权限并接收结果，以便继续加载广告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 如果应用启用了位置权限提示，停用此 Activity 会使 Display.io 无法完成该权限流程或继续相关广告设置。

en.description: The Divide Android client SDK opens this Activity for its account screen. It provides email and password sign-in and account creation, then closes after a user signs in.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot sign in or create a Divide account through this SDK screen.

zh-CN.description: Divide Android 客户端 SDK 会打开此 Activity 显示账户界面，支持通过电子邮件和密码登录或创建账户，并在用户登录后关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法通过此 SDK 界面登录或创建 Divide 账户。

en.description: Dyte's Android SDK opens this Activity when a participant asks to share their screen. It shows Android's screen-capture consent prompt and continues if the user approves.
en.disableEffect: Participants cannot start screen sharing in Dyte calls.

zh-CN.description: 参与者请求共享屏幕时，Dyte Android SDK 会打开此 Activity，显示 Android 的屏幕捕获授权提示，并在用户同意后继续。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 参与者无法在 Dyte 通话中开始屏幕共享。

en.description: After screen capture is approved, Dyte's Android SDK starts this foreground Service with an ongoing notification to keep the screen-share session running.
en.disableEffect: Dyte screen sharing cannot continue after the consent prompt.

zh-CN.description: 用户同意屏幕捕获后，Dyte Android SDK 会启动此前台 Service 并显示持续通知，以维持屏幕共享会话。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 完成授权提示后，Dyte 屏幕共享仍无法继续运行。

en.description: Dyte WebRTC SDK starts this Provider automatically so its calling features can access the app resources needed for camera, microphone, and screen sharing.
en.disableEffect: Dyte camera, microphone, and screen-sharing features may fail to initialize.

zh-CN.description: Dyte WebRTC SDK 会自动启动此 Provider，使其通话功能能够访问摄像头、麦克风和屏幕共享所需的应用资源。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Dyte 的摄像头、麦克风和屏幕共享功能可能无法初始化。

en.description: Elements Pay Components SDK queues this Job Service when payment analytics need to be sent. It sends the event to the selected payment environment over HTTPS.
en.disableEffect: Payment analytics events from this Elements Pay module will no longer be sent.

zh-CN.description: Elements Pay Components SDK 需要发送支付分析事件时会将任务交给此 Job Service，并通过 HTTPS 将事件发送到所选支付环境。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 此 Elements Pay 模块将不再发送支付分析事件。

en.description: Elements Pay SDK queues this Job Service for payment analytics events and sends them to the configured payment environment over HTTPS.
en.disableEffect: Payment analytics events from this Elements Pay module will no longer be sent.

zh-CN.description: Elements Pay SDK 会将支付分析事件交给此 Job Service，并通过 HTTPS 发送到已配置的支付环境。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 此 Elements Pay 模块将不再发送支付分析事件。

en.description: Elements Pay's drop-in checkout binds this Service when processing a payment action. Its built-in handler reports a failure when asked to handle an action.
en.disableEffect: Drop-in payment actions that need this service will fail.

zh-CN.description: Elements Pay 的即用型结账流程会在处理支付操作时绑定此 Service；其内置处理器收到操作后会返回失败。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此服务的即用型支付操作将失败。

en.description: Elements Pay opens this Activity for its drop-in checkout. It displays the configured payment options, coordinates payment actions such as Google Pay, and returns the checkout result to the app.
en.disableEffect: The app's Elements Pay drop-in payment flow cannot complete.

zh-CN.description: Elements Pay 会打开此 Activity 展示即用型结账界面，协调 Google Pay 等支付操作，并将结账结果返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用无法完成 Elements Pay 的即用型支付流程。

en.description: During an Elements Pay card payment that requires bank authentication, this Activity loads the authentication page inside the app and returns the result to the payment flow.
en.disableEffect: A card payment cannot complete when the bank requires this in-app authentication step.

zh-CN.description: Elements Pay 的银行卡支付需要银行验证时，此 Activity 会在应用内加载验证页面，并将结果返回支付流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 银行卡支付需要此应用内验证步骤时将无法完成。

en.description: Elements Pay starts this short-lived Activity to pass a 3-D Secure authentication result back to the waiting checkout, then closes it.
en.disableEffect: The 3-D Secure authentication result cannot be returned to the checkout.

zh-CN.description: Elements Pay 会启动此短暂运行的 Activity，将 3-D Secure 验证结果传回等待中的结账流程，然后关闭它。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 3-D Secure 验证结果将无法返回结账流程。

en.description: When Elements Pay requires browser-based bank authentication, this Activity opens the browser and handles the payment return link from the bank.
en.disableEffect: The browser-based authentication step cannot return to the payment flow, so affected payments fail.

zh-CN.description: Elements Pay 需要通过浏览器进行银行验证时，此 Activity 会打开浏览器并处理银行返回的支付链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 浏览器验证步骤无法返回支付流程，因此相关支付会失败。

en.description: When a bank requests a 3-D Secure 2 challenge during Elements Pay checkout, this Activity presents the verification step and returns its result.
en.disableEffect: A card payment that requires this verification cannot finish.

zh-CN.description: Elements Pay 结账时，银行要求进行 3-D Secure 2 验证，此 Activity 会显示验证步骤并返回结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要此验证的银行卡支付将无法完成。

en.description: Elements Pay opens this Activity for its wallet and payment-sheet screen. It presents the configured payment choices and returns the user's result to the calling app.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot complete this Elements Pay wallet or payment-sheet flow.

zh-CN.description: Elements Pay 会打开此 Activity 显示钱包和支付页面，呈现已配置的支付方式，并将用户的结果返回调用应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法完成此 Elements Pay 钱包或支付页面流程。

en.description: When the app opens Embrace Bug Shake's report screen, it lets users choose a category, write a note, review the captured screenshot, and send the report to Embrace.
en.disableEffect: The app's Embrace bug-report screen cannot be used to submit user reports.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开 Embrace Bug Shake 报告界面时，用户可以选择类别、填写说明、查看已捕获的截图并将报告发送给 Embrace。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用无法使用 Embrace 问题报告界面提交用户报告。

en.description: Embrace opens this Activity when a user taps the screenshot in its bug-report form; it displays the captured image for review.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open the report's full-screen screenshot preview.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击 Embrace 问题报告表单中的截图时，SDK 会打开此 Activity 供用户查看已捕获的图像。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法打开报告中的全屏截图预览。

en.description: When the host app starts Falu Identity verification, this Activity presents document and face checks and returns whether verification succeeded, was canceled, or failed.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot complete the Falu identity-verification flow.

zh-CN.description: 宿主应用启动 Falu 身份验证时，此 Activity 会显示证件和人脸核验流程，并返回验证成功、取消或失败的结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用无法完成 Falu 身份验证流程。

en.description: Ink Filepicker Android SDK opens this Activity when the app asks users to browse configured storage providers, select a file, or capture media for upload. It also provides file-export actions to those providers.
en.disableEffect: The app's file-selection, upload, and export flows through Ink Filepicker stop working.

zh-CN.description: 应用需要浏览已配置的存储服务、选择文件或拍摄媒体并上传时，Ink Filepicker Android SDK 会打开此 Activity；它也提供向这些服务导出文件的操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用通过 Ink Filepicker 进行的文件选择、上传和导出流程将无法使用。

en.description: Ink Filepicker Android SDK starts this Service to browse folder contents, resolve selected files, upload local files, and export files to a storage provider. It returns results or errors to the picker screen.
en.disableEffect: File browsing, selection results, uploads, and exports cannot complete.

zh-CN.description: Ink Filepicker Android SDK 会启动此 Service 浏览文件夹内容、获取所选文件、上传本地文件并向存储服务导出文件，再将结果或错误返回选择界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 文件浏览、选择结果、上传和导出操作都无法完成。

en.description: When FlowUp Android SDK's scheduled configuration task runs, this Service refreshes the remote settings used for performance reporting. It reads the task's API key and upload option, then fetches and saves the updated configuration.
en.disableEffect: Blocking it stops FlowUp from refreshing reporting settings; the host app's regular features remain available.

zh-CN.description: FlowUp Android SDK 的配置任务运行时，此 Service 会刷新性能上报所用的远程设置。它读取任务中的 API 密钥和上报选项，然后获取并保存更新后的配置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，FlowUp 将无法刷新上报设置，但宿主应用的常规功能仍可使用。

en.description: FlowUp Android SDK schedules this Service to remove old performance reports from its local queue. It runs the report-cleanup task without opening a screen.
en.disableEffect: Blocking it stops FlowUp from cleaning old reports, so its stored report data may accumulate; the host app's regular features remain available.

zh-CN.description: FlowUp Android SDK 会安排此 Service 清理本地队列中的旧性能报告。它执行报告清理任务，不会打开界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，FlowUp 不会清理旧报告，已存储的报告数据可能逐渐累积；宿主应用的常规功能仍可使用。

en.description: When FlowUp has queued performance reports and its scheduled Wi-Fi sync runs, this Service uploads batches to FlowUp. It removes reports accepted by the server and reschedules after network failures.
en.disableEffect: Blocking it stops FlowUp's scheduled Wi-Fi report uploads; the host app's regular features remain available.

zh-CN.description: FlowUp 有待上报的性能报告且 Wi-Fi 同步任务运行时，此 Service 会分批上传报告。服务器接收后会移除相应报告，网络失败时会重新安排任务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，FlowUp 将无法通过计划任务使用 Wi-Fi 上传报告；宿主应用的常规功能仍可使用。

en.description: When the host app opens 2C2P PGW UI checkout, this Flutter Activity displays the SDK's payment screen.
en.disableEffect: The PGW payment interface will not open, so users may be unable to pay through this SDK.

zh-CN.description: 宿主应用打开 2C2P PGW UI 结账流程时，此 Flutter Activity 会显示 SDK 的支付页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，PGW 支付界面将无法打开，用户可能无法通过此 SDK 付款。

en.description: Flutter's image picker uses this FileProvider to make selected or captured image files available through app-scoped links.
en.disableEffect: The image-picker flow may fail when it needs to hand a selected or captured image to another screen.

zh-CN.description: Flutter 图片选择组件使用此 FileProvider，通过应用内链接提供选中或拍摄的图片文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 图片选择流程需要将图片交给其他页面时可能失败。

en.description: The Flutter URL-launching plugin uses this screen when a request opens a link inside the app. It displays the requested page in an in-app browser and supports back navigation and closing the view.
en.disableEffect: Links requested for in-app viewing will not open; external-app link launching uses a separate path.

zh-CN.description: Flutter 链接打开插件会在请求于应用内打开链接时使用此界面。它通过网页视图显示链接页面，并支持返回和关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，要求在应用内打开的链接将无法显示；跳转到外部应用的链接使用另一条路径。

en.description: Fyno Push Library declares this Receiver for a custom notification broadcast. Its handler only writes debug log entries for some notification click, action, or dismissal events; it does not display a notification or open a page.
en.disableEffect: Blocking it stops those debug log entries and has no visible effect on notification delivery or app screens.

zh-CN.description: Fyno Push Library 将此 Receiver 声明为接收自定义通知广播。它只为部分通知点击、操作或关闭事件写入调试日志，不会显示通知或打开页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，这些调试日志不会再写入，但通知接收和应用界面不受影响。

en.description: When app-internal code starts this Fyno Push Library Service with an action string, it sends a broadcast with that same action and result data, then stops.
en.disableEffect: If app code uses this relay, blocking it prevents the matching broadcast from reaching the app.

zh-CN.description: 应用内部代码用操作字符串启动 Fyno Push Library 的此 Service 时，它会发出同名广播并附上该字符串作为结果数据，然后停止服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 如果应用代码使用此转发服务，停用后相应广播将无法传递给应用。

en.description: When Fyno Push Library checks that notifications are disabled, it opens this short-lived Activity to request Android's notification permission on Android 13 and newer. The screen closes after the permission response.
en.disableEffect: Blocking it prevents Fyno's built-in notification-permission prompt, so Fyno push notifications may remain off; other app features continue working.

zh-CN.description: Fyno Push Library 检测到通知未启用时，会打开此临时 Activity，在 Android 13 及更新版本上请求通知权限。用户作出选择后，界面会关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Fyno 无法通过内置界面请求通知权限，因此其推送通知可能无法启用；应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: When Firebase delivers a Fyno push message or refreshes its device token, this Fyno Push Library Service handles the message, displays Fyno notification content, and updates the token used for push delivery.
en.disableEffect: Blocking it stops Fyno's Firebase push handling and token updates; the host app's regular features remain available.

zh-CN.description: Firebase 送达 Fyno 推送消息或刷新设备令牌时，Fyno Push Library 的此 Service 会处理消息、显示 Fyno 通知内容，并更新推送所用的令牌。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Fyno 将无法处理 Firebase 推送或更新令牌；宿主应用的常规功能仍可使用。

en.description: When Xiaomi Mi Push delivers or registers a message for Fyno, this Fyno Push Library receiver handles the message, displays Fyno notifications, and saves the Xiaomi push token.
en.disableEffect: Blocking it stops Fyno push delivery through Xiaomi services and token updates; the host app's regular features remain available.

zh-CN.description: 小米 Mi Push 为 Fyno 送达消息或完成注册时，Fyno Push Library 的此 Receiver 会处理消息、显示 Fyno 通知并保存小米推送令牌。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Fyno 将无法通过小米服务接收推送或更新令牌；宿主应用的常规功能仍可使用。

en.description: When a user taps an action button on a Fyno push notification, this Activity reports the click, opens the configured web link or app screen, and closes the notification.
en.disableEffect: Blocking it stops Fyno notification action buttons from opening their configured links or app screens.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击 Fyno 推送通知中的操作按钮时，此 Activity 会记录点击、打开配置的网页链接或应用页面，并关闭该通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Fyno 通知中的操作按钮将无法打开配置的链接或应用页面。

en.description: When a user taps a Fyno push notification, this Activity reports the click and opens the app, a configured app screen, or a web link. It also sends the notification payload to Fyno's push callbacks.
en.disableEffect: Blocking it stops notification taps from opening the app or their configured destination.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击 Fyno 推送通知时，此 Activity 会记录点击并打开应用、配置的应用页面或网页链接。它还会将通知内容发送给 Fyno 的推送回调。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，点击通知将无法打开应用或其配置的目标页面。

en.description: When a user dismisses a Fyno push notification, this Receiver reports the dismissal and passes the notification payload to Fyno's push callbacks.
en.disableEffect: Blocking it stops Fyno from recording notification dismissals; notification delivery and the app's other features continue working.

zh-CN.description: 用户关闭 Fyno 推送通知时，此 Receiver 会报告关闭事件，并将通知内容传给 Fyno 的推送回调。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Fyno 将无法记录通知关闭事件；通知送达和应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: When Gamedock (Azerion) starts an AdMob interstitial or rewarded video, this Activity provides the full-screen loading and cancel screen and runs the selected ad flow.
en.disableEffect: Blocking it stops Gamedock AdMob full-screen ads; users will not receive rewards for rewarded videos handled by this flow.

zh-CN.description: Gamedock（Azerion）启动 AdMob 插屏广告或激励视频时，此 Activity 会显示全屏加载和取消界面，并运行所选广告流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Gamedock 的 AdMob 全屏广告将无法播放；通过此流程观看激励视频的用户不会获得奖励。

en.description: When Gamedock Ads is asked to show a full-screen ad, this Activity displays image, web, or video interstitials and video or VAST rewarded ads. It tells the app when a rewarded video has been completed and its reward earned.
en.disableEffect: Blocking it stops these Gamedock Ads from opening; users will not receive rewards for watching rewarded ads.

zh-CN.description: Gamedock Ads 被要求显示全屏广告时，此 Activity 会展示图片、网页或视频插屏广告，以及视频或 VAST 激励广告。激励视频完成并可获得奖励时，它会通知应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，这些 Gamedock Ads 将无法打开；用户观看激励广告后不会获得奖励。

en.description: When the older Gamedock (Azerion) Android SDK starts a Gamedock interstitial or rewarded video, this Activity provides its full-screen loading, cancel, and ad-display flow.
en.disableEffect: Blocking it stops these Gamedock ads; users will not receive rewards for rewarded videos handled by this flow.

zh-CN.description: 较旧版本的 Gamedock（Azerion）Android SDK 启动 Gamedock 插屏广告或激励视频时，此 Activity 会提供全屏加载、取消和广告展示流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，这些 Gamedock 广告将无法播放；通过此流程观看激励视频的用户不会获得奖励。

en.description: When a user dismisses a Gamedock push notification, this Receiver reports a dismissal event and updates the saved notification record.
en.disableEffect: Blocking it stops Gamedock from recording notification dismissals; gameplay and other app features remain available.

zh-CN.description: 用户关闭 Gamedock 推送通知时，此 Receiver 会报告关闭事件并更新已保存的通知记录。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Gamedock 将无法记录通知关闭事件；游戏和应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: When the app opens Gamedock's help center, this Activity displays the supplied support page and shows copyable Gamedock user and device IDs.
en.disableEffect: Blocking it prevents the in-app Gamedock help page and its user and device IDs from opening.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开 Gamedock 帮助中心时，此 Activity 会显示指定的支持页面，并展示可复制的 Gamedock 用户 ID 和设备 ID。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用内的 Gamedock 帮助页面及其中的用户和设备 ID 将无法打开。

en.description: When the app runs a configured Gamedock age check, this Activity asks the user to choose an age range and reports whether the configured threshold is met. A blocking age gate keeps the screen open for age ranges below that threshold.
en.disableEffect: Blocking it prevents configured age checks from being completed and may interrupt age-gated Gamedock startup or access.

zh-CN.description: 应用执行已配置的 Gamedock 年龄检查时，此 Activity 会请用户选择年龄范围，并报告是否达到设定门槛。启用阻止模式时，低于门槛的年龄范围会留在该界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，已配置的年龄检查将无法完成，可能中断 Gamedock 的年龄限制启动或访问流程。

en.description: When Gamedock opens its optional rating prompt, this Activity collects a star rating and can open a feedback page or the app store. Users can also reject or postpone the prompt.
en.disableEffect: Blocking it disables Gamedock's optional rating and feedback prompt; the app's other features remain available.

zh-CN.description: Gamedock 打开可选评分提示时，此 Activity 会收集星级评分，并可打开反馈页面或应用商店。用户也可以拒绝或稍后处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Gamedock 的可选评分和反馈提示将无法使用；应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: When the app requests Azerion Connect sign-in, sign-out, or account information, this Gamedock Activity runs the account flow and retrieves the user's information.
en.disableEffect: Blocking it disables Azerion Connect sign-in, sign-out, and account-information requests.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求 Azerion Connect 登录、退出或账户信息时，Gamedock 的此 Activity 会执行账户流程并获取用户信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Azerion Connect 登录、退出和账户信息请求将无法使用。

en.description: When an Azerion Connect authorization return address is explicitly sent to it, this Activity forwards the response into the sign-in flow and closes.
en.disableEffect: Blocking it can prevent an Azerion Connect authorization return handled through this Activity from completing.

zh-CN.description: Azerion Connect 的授权返回地址被显式发送到此 Activity 时，它会将响应转交给登录流程，然后关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，经由此 Activity 处理的 Azerion Connect 授权返回可能无法完成。

en.description: When Google Play sends the install-referrer broadcast after installation, this Gamedock Receiver saves the referrer for attribution.
en.disableEffect: Blocking it stops Gamedock from saving install attribution data; app features remain available.

zh-CN.description: 应用安装后，Google Play 发送安装来源广播时，Gamedock 的此 Receiver 会保存来源信息用于归因。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Gamedock 将无法保存安装归因信息；应用功能仍可使用。

en.description: When Gamedock needs to explain a denied Android permission, this Activity shows the reason and can offer app settings or another permission request. It returns permission results to Gamedock.
en.disableEffect: Blocking it prevents Gamedock's permission explanation and recovery options, which may leave permission-based app features unavailable.

zh-CN.description: Gamedock 需要解释被拒绝的 Android 权限时，此 Activity 会说明原因，并可提供应用设置或再次请求权限的选项。它会将权限结果返回给 Gamedock。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Gamedock 的权限说明和恢复选项将无法使用，依赖相应权限的应用功能可能不可用。

en.description: When Gamedock's AIR permission path requests one or more Android permissions, this Activity asks the user and returns the permission results to Gamedock.
en.disableEffect: Blocking it prevents permission requests through this Gamedock path, which may disable features that need those permissions.

zh-CN.description: Gamedock 的 AIR 权限流程请求一个或多个 Android 权限时，此 Activity 会向用户发起请求，并将权限结果返回给 Gamedock。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Gamedock 将无法通过此流程请求权限，依赖这些权限的功能可能不可用。

en.description: When Gamedock requests a privacy choice or the user opens privacy settings, this Activity shows controls for personalized ads and content, saves the selection, and can continue SDK initialization.
en.disableEffect: Blocking it prevents users from completing or changing Gamedock privacy choices and may interrupt initialization that waits for consent.

zh-CN.description: Gamedock 请求隐私选择或用户打开隐私设置时，此 Activity 会显示个性化广告和内容选项、保存选择，并可继续 SDK 初始化。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法完成或更改 Gamedock 隐私选择，等待同意结果的初始化流程也可能中断。

en.description: When Gamedock opens a configured splash screen, daily bonus, more-apps page, or server-provided overlay, this Activity displays the page inside the app and reports its feature events.
en.disableEffect: Blocking it stops those Gamedock pages from opening, so their splash, daily-bonus, promotion, or overlay flows will not work.

zh-CN.description: Gamedock 打开已配置的启动页、每日奖励、更多应用页面或服务器提供的覆盖页时，此 Activity 会在应用内显示页面并报告相应功能事件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，这些 Gamedock 页面将无法打开，其启动页、每日奖励、推广或覆盖页流程也会停止。

en.description: Cocomikes Common Base MVP provides this file-sharing provider for app-approved files. It also initializes the library's utility context when the app starts.
en.disableEffect: Cocomikes utility setup and file-sharing flows that rely on this provider may fail.

zh-CN.description: Cocomikes Common Base MVP 为应用允许访问的文件提供分享入口，并在应用启动时初始化库所需的通用上下文。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此提供程序的 Cocomikes 通用初始化或文件分享流程可能失败。

en.description: Cocomikes RxDownload runs queued file transfers when the app starts or binds to its download manager. It saves download records and supports pausing, resuming, and deleting transfers.
en.disableEffect: Downloads managed by RxDownload cannot start or resume while this service is disabled.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动或连接到下载管理器时，Cocomikes RxDownload 会执行排队的文件下载；它保存下载记录并支持暂停、继续和删除任务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，RxDownload 管理的下载无法启动或继续。

en.description: Stream's push registration provider for its Chat and Video SDKs. Android creates it during app startup, and it finds the push integrations configured by the app so they can receive messages.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents Stream push integrations from initializing, so their push notifications and token updates stop.

zh-CN.description: 这是 Stream Chat 和 Stream Video 的推送注册入口。应用启动时，Android 会创建它；它会查找应用配置的推送集成并初始化这些集成以接收消息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Stream 推送集成无法初始化，其推送通知和令牌更新也会停止。

en.description: Stream Push's startup provider for Stream Chat. Android creates it during app startup, and it reads the app's configured push handlers so they can receive messages.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents Stream Chat's configured push handlers from initializing, so their push notifications and token updates stop.

zh-CN.description: 这是 Stream Chat 的推送初始化提供程序。应用启动时，Android 会创建它；它会读取应用配置的推送处理程序并将其初始化以接收消息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Stream Chat 配置的推送处理程序无法初始化，其推送通知和令牌更新也会停止。

en.description: Stream's Firebase push service for its Chat and Video push integrations. It receives Firebase messages and forwards supported notifications to Stream, and sends refreshed push tokens to the SDK.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it stops Stream notifications sent through Firebase from being processed and registered.

zh-CN.description: 这是 Stream Chat 和 Stream Video 推送集成使用的 Firebase 服务。它接收 Firebase 消息，将支持的通知交给 Stream 处理，并把更新后的推送令牌发送给 SDK。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，通过 Firebase 发送的 Stream 通知将无法处理，推送令牌也无法通过此服务更新。

en.description: Stream's Huawei push service for its Chat and Video push integrations. It receives Huawei push messages and refreshed registration tokens and forwards them to Stream.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it stops Stream notifications and token updates delivered through Huawei Push Kit.

zh-CN.description: 这是 Stream Chat 和 Stream Video 推送集成使用的华为推送服务。它接收华为推送消息和更新后的注册令牌，并将它们交给 Stream 处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，通过华为推送服务发送的 Stream 通知和令牌更新将停止。

en.description: Stream's Xiaomi push receiver for its Chat and Video push integrations. It forwards incoming pass-through messages and Xiaomi registration results to Stream.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it stops Stream notifications and registration updates delivered through Xiaomi Push.

zh-CN.description: 这是 Stream Chat 和 Stream Video 推送集成使用的小米推送接收器。它会将透传消息和小米注册结果交给 Stream 处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，通过小米推送服务发送的 Stream 通知和注册更新将停止。

en.description: Stream Chat's notification action handler. When someone marks a chat as read, replies from a notification, or dismisses it, this receiver applies that choice to the chat.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it removes Stream Chat's notification actions for marking a chat read, sending a quick reply, and dismissing an alert.

zh-CN.description: 这是 Stream Chat 的通知操作接收器。用户在通知中标记已读、快速回复或关闭提醒时，它会将相应操作应用到聊天中。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Stream Chat 通知中的标记已读、快速回复和关闭提醒操作将不可用。

en.description: Stream Chat Compose's gallery for media attached to a message. It opens the message's images and videos in a gallery and provides the SDK's attachment actions.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from opening a message's media gallery and using its attachment controls.

zh-CN.description: 这是 Stream Chat Compose 中用于查看消息附件的媒体图库。它会以图库形式打开消息中的图片和视频，并提供附件操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法打开消息媒体图库或使用其中的附件操作。

en.description: Stream Chat Compose's single-media preview. It opens the supplied media link with its title and provides playback and a way to close the preview.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from opening this media preview from a chat.

zh-CN.description: 这是 Stream Chat Compose 中的单项媒体预览界面。它会打开传入的媒体链接和标题，提供播放和关闭预览的操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法从聊天中打开此媒体预览。

en.description: Stream Chat's Firebase push service. It receives Firebase messages and refreshed registration tokens and forwards them to Stream Chat's notification handlers.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it stops Stream Chat notifications and token updates sent through Firebase from being handled.

zh-CN.description: 这是 Stream Chat 的 Firebase 推送服务。它接收 Firebase 消息和更新后的注册令牌，并将它们交给 Stream Chat 的通知处理程序。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，通过 Firebase 发送的 Stream Chat 通知和令牌更新将无法处理。

en.description: Stream Chat's Huawei push service. It receives Huawei messages and refreshed registration tokens and forwards them to Stream Chat's notification handlers.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it stops Stream Chat notifications and token updates sent through Huawei Push Kit from being handled.

zh-CN.description: 这是 Stream Chat 的华为推送服务。它接收华为推送消息和更新后的注册令牌，并将它们交给 Stream Chat 的通知处理程序。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，通过华为推送服务发送的 Stream Chat 通知和令牌更新将无法处理。

en.description: Stream Chat's Xiaomi push receiver. It forwards incoming pass-through messages and Xiaomi registration results to Stream Chat's notification handlers.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it stops Stream Chat notifications and registration updates sent through Xiaomi Push from being handled.

zh-CN.description: 这是 Stream Chat 的小米推送接收器。它会将透传消息和小米注册结果交给 Stream Chat 的通知处理程序。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，通过小米推送服务发送的 Stream Chat 通知和注册更新将无法处理。

en.description: Stream Chat's file-sharing provider. The SDK uses it to create a shareable content link for an attachment file when another app needs to open it.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents Stream Chat from creating shareable attachment links, so attachment sharing can fail.

zh-CN.description: 这是 Stream Chat 的文件共享提供程序。其他应用需要打开附件文件时，SDK 会通过它生成可共享的内容链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Stream Chat 无法生成附件共享链接，附件共享可能失败。

en.description: Stream Chat's document viewer. When a document attachment is opened, it loads the document link in an in-app web view and shows loading or error feedback.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from opening document attachments in Stream Chat's viewer.

zh-CN.description: 这是 Stream Chat 的文档查看界面。用户打开文档附件时，它会在应用内网页视图中加载文档，并显示加载进度或错误提示。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法在 Stream Chat 的查看器中打开文档附件。

en.description: Stream Chat's channel list screen. It opens a searchable list of chat channels with a connected-channel header.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents apps using this SDK screen from opening the channel list.

zh-CN.description: 这是 Stream Chat 的频道列表界面。它会显示可搜索的聊天频道列表和已连接频道标题。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，使用此 SDK 界面的应用将无法打开频道列表。

en.description: Stream Chat's attachment viewer. When a chat attachment is opened, it displays the linked web content or a GIPHY image.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from opening these chat attachment previews.

zh-CN.description: 这是 Stream Chat 的附件查看界面。用户打开聊天附件时，它会显示链接网页内容或 GIPHY 图片。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法打开这些聊天附件预览。

en.description: Stream Chat's gallery for message attachments. It shows images and videos in a swipeable gallery with options to share, save, delete, reply, or return to the message.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from opening the attachment gallery and using those attachment actions.

zh-CN.description: 这是 Stream Chat 的消息附件图库。它以可滑动的图库显示图片和视频，并提供分享、保存、删除、回复或返回消息等操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法打开附件图库或使用其中的附件操作。

en.description: Stream Chat's player for media attachments. It opens an attachment link in an in-app player and pauses playback when the screen leaves the foreground.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from playing media attachments in Stream Chat's player.

zh-CN.description: 这是 Stream Chat 的媒体附件播放器。它会在应用内播放附件链接，并在界面进入后台时暂停播放。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法在 Stream Chat 的播放器中播放媒体附件。

en.description: Stream Chat's channel screen. It opens a selected conversation and can focus on a particular message.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents apps using this SDK screen from opening a channel conversation.

zh-CN.description: 这是 Stream Chat 的频道聊天界面。它会打开选定的对话，也可以定位到指定消息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，使用此 SDK 界面的应用将无法打开频道对话。

en.description: Stream Chat's message list screen for a selected channel. It opens the conversation and can focus on a particular message.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents apps using this SDK screen from opening a channel's message list.

zh-CN.description: 这是 Stream Chat 中所选频道的消息列表界面。它会打开对话，也可以定位到指定消息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，使用此 SDK 界面的应用将无法打开频道消息列表。

en.description: Stream Log's Android file-logging provider. At app startup it installs Android and file logging and prepares the SDK's saved diagnostic logs.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it stops this Stream Log file-logging setup and its saved-log controls.

zh-CN.description: 这是 Stream Log 的 Android 文件日志提供程序。应用启动时，它会启用 Android 和文件日志，并准备 SDK 保存的诊断日志。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Stream Log 的文件日志初始化和已保存日志操作将停止。

en.description: Stream Log's background service for saved diagnostic logs. It handles requests to share or clear the log files.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents Stream Log from sharing or clearing its saved log files.

zh-CN.description: 这是 Stream Log 用于保存诊断日志的后台服务。它负责处理分享或清除日志文件的请求。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Stream Log 将无法分享或清除已保存的日志文件。

en.description: The legacy Stream Log SDK's Android file-logging provider. At app startup it installs Android and file logging and prepares saved diagnostic logs.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it stops this Stream Log file-logging setup and its saved-log controls.

zh-CN.description: 这是旧版 Stream Log SDK 的 Android 文件日志提供程序。应用启动时，它会启用 Android 和文件日志，并准备保存诊断日志。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Stream Log 的文件日志初始化和已保存日志操作将停止。

en.description: The legacy Stream Log SDK's background service for saved diagnostic logs. It handles requests to share or clear the log files.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents the legacy Stream Log SDK from sharing or clearing its saved log files.

zh-CN.description: 这是旧版 Stream Log SDK 用于保存诊断日志的后台服务。它负责处理分享或清除日志文件的请求。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，旧版 Stream Log SDK 将无法分享或清除已保存的日志文件。

en.description: Stream Chat's Android file-logging provider. At app startup it installs Android and file logging and tracks app lifecycle for diagnostic logs.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it stops this Stream Chat file-logging setup and its saved-log controls.

zh-CN.description: 这是 Stream Chat 的 Android 文件日志提供程序。应用启动时，它会启用 Android 和文件日志，并记录应用生命周期以供诊断。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Stream Chat 的文件日志初始化和已保存日志操作将停止。

en.description: Stream Chat's background service for saved diagnostic logs. It handles requests to share or clear the log files.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents Stream Chat from sharing or clearing its saved log files.

zh-CN.description: 这是 Stream Chat 用于保存诊断日志的后台服务。它负责处理分享或清除日志文件的请求。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Stream Chat 将无法分享或清除已保存的日志文件。

en.description: Stream Video's call screen for incoming, outgoing, accepted, ongoing, and live calls. It displays the call interface and can bring it forward over the lock screen for a call.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents Stream Video from opening this call screen for call and notification actions.

zh-CN.description: 这是 Stream Video 用于来电、拨出、接听、进行中通话和直播通话的界面。它会显示通话界面，并可在来电时显示在锁屏上方。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Stream Video 将无法通过通话或通知操作打开此通话界面。

en.description: Stream Video's call-notification cleanup screen. When opened from a dismissal action, it removes the specified call notification and closes.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it can leave a call notification visible when users invoke this dismissal action.

zh-CN.description: 这是 Stream Video 的通话通知清理界面。用户通过关闭操作打开它时，它会移除指定的通话通知并退出。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户执行此关闭操作时，通话通知可能仍会显示。

en.description: Stream Video's call-notification action for leaving a call. When selected, it leaves the call and clears its notification.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it removes the leave-call action from Stream Video call notifications.

zh-CN.description: 这是 Stream Video 通话通知中的离开通话操作。用户选择后，它会退出通话并清除通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Stream Video 通话通知中的离开通话操作将不可用。

en.description: Stream Video's call-notification action for rejecting an incoming call. It passes the rejection to the SDK's call handler.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it removes the reject-call action from Stream Video notifications.

zh-CN.description: 这是 Stream Video 通话通知中的拒接来电操作。它会将拒接请求交给 SDK 的通话处理程序。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Stream Video 通知中的拒接来电操作将不可用。

en.description: Stream Video's notification action for stopping an active screen share. It stops sharing and clears the screen-sharing notification.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it removes the notification control that stops a Stream Video screen share.

zh-CN.description: 这是 Stream Video 用于停止屏幕共享的通知操作。它会停止共享并清除屏幕共享通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Stream Video 屏幕共享通知中的停止操作将不可用。

en.description: Stream Video's foreground service for audio calls. It keeps the call service running with audio-call permissions and call notifications.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents Stream Video audio calls from using their foreground call service.

zh-CN.description: 这是 Stream Video 的音频通话前台服务。它使用音频通话权限维持通话服务并显示通话通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Stream Video 音频通话将无法使用其前台通话服务。

en.description: Stream Video's foreground service for incoming, outgoing, and ongoing calls. It manages the call session and its ringing or active-call notification until the call ends.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents Stream Video calls from using the service that maintains call state and notifications.

zh-CN.description: 这是 Stream Video 用于来电、拨出和进行中通话的前台服务。它会管理通话状态以及响铃或通话通知，直到通话结束。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Stream Video 通话将无法使用维持通话状态和通知的服务。

en.description: Stream Video's foreground service for livestream audio calls. It keeps the live audio call service running with the permissions used for that call mode.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents livestream audio calls from using their foreground call service.

zh-CN.description: 这是 Stream Video 的直播音频通话前台服务。它会使用该通话模式所需的权限维持直播音频通话服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，直播音频通话将无法使用其前台通话服务。

en.description: Stream Video's foreground service for livestream host calls. It maintains the live call and its notification using the livestream call permissions.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents livestream host calls from using their foreground call service.

zh-CN.description: 这是 Stream Video 的直播主播通话前台服务。它会使用直播通话权限维持通话和通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，直播主播通话将无法使用其前台通话服务。

en.description: Stream Video's foreground service for joining a livestream as a viewer. It maintains the viewer call with the permissions for that mode.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents livestream viewers from using this foreground call service.

zh-CN.description: 这是 Stream Video 用于观众加入直播的前台服务。它会使用观众模式所需的权限维持通话。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，直播观众将无法使用此前台通话服务。

en.description: Stream Video's foreground service for screen sharing. It keeps sharing active and displays an ongoing notification with a stop control.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents Stream Video from maintaining screen sharing through this foreground service and notification.

zh-CN.description: 这是 Stream Video 的屏幕共享前台服务。它会维持屏幕共享，并显示带停止操作的持续通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Stream Video 将无法通过此前台服务和通知维持屏幕共享。

en.description: Stream Video tooling's exception report screen. It displays supplied error details for an app package when the SDK opens its diagnostics.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents this Stream Video diagnostic screen from opening.

zh-CN.description: 这是 Stream Video 工具包中的异常报告界面。SDK 打开诊断页面时，它会显示传入的应用包名和错误详情。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Stream Video 将无法打开此诊断界面。

en.description: Kotle module-android uses this screen when the app opens a page supplied by the app, displaying the page and passing it its data.
en.disableEffect: App screens opened through this navigation flow will not appear.

zh-CN.description: Kotle module-android 会在应用打开指定页面时显示该页面，并传递应用提供的数据。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过此导航流程打开的应用页面将无法显示。

en.description: Kotle PlayerModule runs when the app resumes scheduled downloads. It keeps video downloads running in the background and shows their progress.
en.disableEffect: Scheduled video downloads and their progress notifications may stop working.

zh-CN.description: Kotle PlayerModule 会在应用恢复计划中的下载任务时运行，负责后台视频下载并显示下载进度。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，计划中的视频下载及其进度通知可能无法正常工作。

en.description: This AshishMK myTestLibrary sample screen opens a basic navigation page with a toolbar and a button that displays a placeholder message.
en.disableEffect: The test library's sample screen will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: AshishMK 的 myTestLibrary 会在此示例页面显示基础导航界面、顶部栏和一个弹出占位提示的按钮。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，测试库提供的示例页面将无法打开。

en.description: This AshishMK myTestLibrary sample screen opens a basic navigation page with a toolbar and a button that displays a placeholder message.
en.disableEffect: The test library's sample screen will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: AshishMK 的 myTestLibrary 会在此示例页面显示基础导航界面、顶部栏和一个弹出占位提示的按钮。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，测试库提供的示例页面将无法打开。

en.description: The ChinaVolvocars Tray preference library starts this provider as the app process is created. It stores saved preference values in separate device and user databases and lets the app read or save them.
en.disableEffect: Apps that use Tray for settings or saved preferences may fail to load or save those values.

zh-CN.description: 应用进程启动时，ChinaVolvocars Tray 偏好设置库会创建此 Provider。它将偏好数据分别存入设备和用户数据库，让应用能够读取或保存这些内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖 Tray 保存设置或偏好数据的应用可能无法读取或保存这些内容。

en.description: During an Ackee Screenshotting System report, the SDK saves a screenshot in the app cache and uses this Provider to let the report screen read it.
en.disableEffect: The report cannot open its captured screenshot, and the shake-to-report flow can fail while creating the screenshot link.

zh-CN.description: Ackee Screenshotting System 生成反馈报告时，会把截图保存在应用缓存中，并通过这个 Provider 让报告界面读取截图。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 报告界面无法打开截取的图片，摇动设备提交反馈时也可能因无法生成图片链接而失败。

en.description: When a user taps the screenshot in an Ackee report, this Activity lets them draw on the image, undo or redo marks, and return the edited screenshot.
en.disableEffect: The screenshot annotation step cannot open, so users cannot return an edited image to the report.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击 Ackee 报告中的截图时，这个 Activity 会打开图片供用户标注，并支持撤销或重做标记，然后把编辑后的截图返回报告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 截图标注界面无法打开，用户不能将编辑后的图片返回报告。

en.description: When the device is shaken while Ackee's reporting feature is active, the SDK captures the current screen and opens this Activity with app and device details. Users can add a message, choose another image, and send the report.
en.disableEffect: Ackee's shake-to-report screen cannot open or submit a report, and triggering the flow can cause an app launch error.

zh-CN.description: 启用 Ackee 反馈功能后，用户摇动设备会截取当前屏幕并打开这个 Activity，同时附上应用和设备信息。用户可以填写说明、更换图片并发送报告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Ackee 的摇动反馈界面无法打开或发送报告，触发此流程时还可能导致应用启动错误。

en.description: When an app opens an Aigens OrderPlace page, this Activity displays the supplied online ordering page with the SDK navigation and options.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to open or complete online orders through this Aigens screen.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开 Aigens OrderPlace 页面时，此 Activity 会显示指定的在线订购页面以及 SDK 提供的导航和选项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此 Aigens 界面打开或完成在线订购。

en.description: When the Aigens OrderPlace SDK receives a code-scan request, this Activity opens the camera reader and returns decoded text or opens a scanned web link as an order page.
en.disableEffect: Code scanning and scan-to-order links through this Aigens SDK will no longer work.

zh-CN.description: Aigens OrderPlace SDK 收到扫码请求时，此 Activity 会打开相机扫码界面，并返回识别文本，或将扫到的网址作为订购页面打开。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 此 Aigens SDK 的扫码和扫码进入订购页面功能将无法使用。

en.description: The BillyWei01 EasyAlbum media picker opens when an app asks the user to choose photos or videos; it browses media, previews items, and returns the selection.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to browse, preview, or choose photos and videos through EasyAlbum.

zh-CN.description: 应用要求用户选择照片或视频时，BillyWei01 EasyAlbum 媒体选择器会打开并浏览、预览媒体，然后返回所选内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 EasyAlbum 浏览、预览或选择照片和视频。

en.description: The BillyWei01 EasyAlbum library prepares its media-selection feature when the app starts so its picker can access device media.
en.disableEffect: The EasyAlbum picker may fail to open or load device photos and videos.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，BillyWei01 EasyAlbum 会准备媒体选择功能，使选择器能够读取设备媒体。
zh-CN.disableEffect: EasyAlbum 选择器可能无法打开或加载设备中的照片和视频。

en.description: NotifyVisitors' messaging SDK receives Android's package-replacement broadcast after the app updates and records the update for its engagement reporting.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it can stop NotifyVisitors from recognizing app updates; Android updates and the app's normal features still work.

zh-CN.description: 应用更新后，NotifyVisitors 消息 SDK 会收到 Android 的应用替换广播，并记录这次更新用于用户互动统计。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，NotifyVisitors 可能无法识别应用更新；Android 更新和应用的常规功能仍可使用。

en.description: NotifyVisitors starts this service for an app-version check. It compares the installed app version with the saved one and reports an installation or update to NotifyVisitors.
en.disableEffect: Only NotifyVisitors installation and update reporting may stop; the app's regular screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: NotifyVisitors 进行应用版本检查时会启动此服务。它比较当前安装版本与已保存的版本，并向 NotifyVisitors 上报安装或更新事件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，可能只会停止 NotifyVisitors 的安装和更新统计；应用的常规页面仍可使用。

en.description: The NotifyVisitors sample package includes this simple demo screen with a module label and a button. It appears only when the app opens this screen.
en.disableEffect: Only this sample demo screen will be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: NotifyVisitors 示例包中的这个简单演示页面显示模块标题和一个按钮，只有应用打开该页面时才会出现。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，仅此示例演示页面将无法打开。

en.description: The app opens this NotifyVisitors screen when a user selects the configured chat assistant. It loads the matching chat content and displays the conversation interface.
en.disableEffect: The app's NotifyVisitors chat assistant will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择已配置的聊天助手时，应用会打开 NotifyVisitors 的此页面；页面会载入对应的聊天内容并显示对话界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用将无法打开 NotifyVisitors 聊天助手。

en.description: NotifyVisitors opens this screen when a user visits its in-app notification center. It displays saved messages and refreshes the list from NotifyVisitors when needed.
en.disableEffect: The NotifyVisitors message inbox will be unavailable, while the app's regular screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 NotifyVisitors 应用内通知中心时，会进入此页面查看已保存的消息；需要时页面还会从 NotifyVisitors 刷新列表。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，NotifyVisitors 消息收件箱将无法使用，但应用的常规页面仍可使用。

en.description: Android starts this NotifyVisitors location service when the user enters or leaves a registered area. It checks for matching campaigns and posts the related push notification.
en.disableEffect: Location-triggered NotifyVisitors messages will no longer appear.

zh-CN.description: 用户进入或离开已登记的区域时，Android 会启动 NotifyVisitors 的位置服务；服务会查找匹配的活动并发送相应推送通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，将不再显示由位置触发的 NotifyVisitors 消息。

en.description: NotifyVisitors opens this screen when an in-app campaign calls for a full-screen message. It displays the campaign and its buttons over the app.
en.disableEffect: Full-screen NotifyVisitors campaigns will not be shown.

zh-CN.description: NotifyVisitors 的应用内活动需要全屏消息时，会打开此页面，在应用界面上显示活动内容和按钮。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，将不再显示 NotifyVisitors 的全屏活动。

en.description: NotifyVisitors opens this translucent screen when an in-app campaign calls for a full-screen message. It displays the campaign and its buttons over the app.
en.disableEffect: Translucent full-screen NotifyVisitors campaigns will not be shown.

zh-CN.description: NotifyVisitors 的应用内活动需要半透明全屏消息时，会打开此页面，在应用界面上显示活动内容和按钮。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，将不再显示 NotifyVisitors 的半透明全屏活动。

en.description: NotifyVisitors opens this screen after an in-app campaign action targets a page inside the app. It forwards the user to that destination.
en.disableEffect: Campaign links that use this route will not reach their destination.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击应用内活动并前往应用中的页面时，NotifyVisitors 会打开此页面，再将用户带到目标页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，使用此跳转方式的活动链接将无法打开目标页面。

en.description: NotifyVisitors starts this service after a user taps a push or inbox action. It records the click and opens the campaign's configured web page or app destination.
en.disableEffect: Tapping NotifyVisitors campaign links may no longer open their destinations.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击推送或收件箱中的活动按钮后，NotifyVisitors 会启动此服务记录点击，并打开活动设置的网页或应用页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，点击 NotifyVisitors 活动链接可能无法打开目标页面。

en.description: NotifyVisitors opens this short-lived screen when a push or inbox message routes the user to an app page. It records the click, updates the message badge, and forwards to the destination.
en.disableEffect: Push and inbox actions routed through this screen may stop opening app pages or updating the message badge.

zh-CN.description: 推送或收件箱消息需要将用户带到应用页面时，NotifyVisitors 会短暂打开此页面；它记录点击、更新消息角标并继续跳转。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，经由此页面处理的推送和收件箱按钮可能无法打开应用页面或更新消息角标。

en.description: NotifyVisitors starts this service for push-notification actions that clear a message or its badge. It updates the SDK's notification state after the action.
en.disableEffect: Cleanup and badge updates for NotifyVisitors notifications may stop working.

zh-CN.description: NotifyVisitors 会在推送通知执行清除消息或角标的操作时启动此服务，并更新 SDK 的通知状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，NotifyVisitors 通知的清理和角标更新可能无法正常工作。

en.description: NotifyVisitors sends incoming push data to this background service. It checks the message type and displays the matching notification and campaign actions.
en.disableEffect: Push notifications from NotifyVisitors will no longer be displayed.

zh-CN.description: NotifyVisitors 会将收到的推送内容交给此后台服务；服务会判断消息类型并显示相应通知和活动按钮。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，将不再显示 NotifyVisitors 推送通知。

en.description: NotifyVisitors starts this service when a user taps the close control on its persistent push notification. The service removes that notification.
en.disableEffect: The close control may no longer remove the persistent NotifyVisitors notification.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击 NotifyVisitors 常驻推送通知上的关闭按钮时，SDK 会启动此服务并移除该通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，关闭按钮可能无法移除 NotifyVisitors 常驻通知。

en.description: NotifyVisitors starts this service to refresh a carousel push after a slide or button action. It updates the displayed campaign using the saved message data.
en.disableEffect: Carousel push content may stop updating when users move between slides or use its buttons.

zh-CN.description: 用户切换轮播推送中的页面或点击按钮后，NotifyVisitors 会启动此服务并根据已保存的消息内容刷新活动通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户切换轮播页面或使用按钮时，推送内容可能无法更新。

en.description: NotifyVisitors starts this service when someone selects a star in a rating prompt. It updates the prompt and sends the selected rating to NotifyVisitors.
en.disableEffect: Rating prompts will no longer submit star responses to NotifyVisitors.

zh-CN.description: 用户在评分提示中选择星级时，NotifyVisitors 会启动此服务更新提示，并将所选评分发送给 NotifyVisitors。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，评分提示将无法向 NotifyVisitors 提交星级评价。

en.description: chenfei0928's Android Util Collections opens this Activity when an app uses Alibaba ARouter's result-based navigation to a screen, then closes after the destination opens.
en.disableEffect: App screens that use this result-based navigation flow may no longer open.

zh-CN.description: 应用通过 chenfei0928 的 Android Util Collections 使用阿里 ARouter 的结果式导航打开页面时，此 Activity 会启动目标页面并在其打开后关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，使用此结果式导航流程的应用页面可能无法打开。

en.description: chenfei0928's Android Util Collections initializes its app-wide context and toast support through this Provider when the app process starts.
en.disableEffect: Library utilities that need the app-wide context or toast setup may fail.

zh-CN.description: chenfei0928 的 Android Util Collections 会在应用进程启动时通过此 Provider 初始化全局应用环境和提示消息功能。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，依赖全局应用环境或提示消息初始化的库功能可能无法正常工作。

en.description: Naresh Chocha videoEditer opens a preview and trimming screen for an app-selected video, then saves the chosen section as a new video.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot trim and save a video through this editor.

zh-CN.description: Naresh Chocha videoEditer 会打开应用选定视频的预览和剪辑页面，并将选中的片段另存为新视频。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此编辑器剪辑并保存视频。

en.description: The Chungggg Hello Library opens a sample screen with a simple centered greeting.
en.disableEffect: Only this sample screen is unavailable.

zh-CN.description: Chungggg Hello Library 会打开一个居中显示简单问候语的示例页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 只有此示例页面会无法打开。

en.description: CoolishBee Universal Android SDK uses this callback screen to finish Apple sign-in when the browser returns to the app. It reads the sign-in response and returns the login result.
en.disableEffect: Apple sign-in through Universal Android SDK cannot complete when this callback screen is disabled.

zh-CN.description: 浏览器返回应用时，CoolishBee Universal Android SDK 会通过此回调页面完成 Apple 登录、读取登录结果并返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，CoolishBee Universal Android SDK 的 Apple 登录回调无法完成。

en.description: CoolishBee Universal Android SDK opens this screen for an Apple sign-in page in a custom browser tab and receives the returned authentication link.
en.disableEffect: Apple sign-in through Universal Android SDK's Custom Tabs flow cannot complete when this screen is disabled.

zh-CN.description: CoolishBee Universal Android SDK 会通过此页面在自定义浏览器标签页中打开 Apple 登录，并接收返回的认证链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，CoolishBee Universal Android SDK 的自定义标签页 Apple 登录流程无法完成。

en.description: CoolishBee Universal Android SDK starts Facebook sign-in, requests the user's basic profile, and returns the result or cancellation to the calling screen.
en.disableEffect: Facebook sign-in through Universal Android SDK cannot complete when this screen is disabled.

zh-CN.description: CoolishBee Universal Android SDK 会启动 Facebook 登录、请求用户的基本资料，并将成功结果或取消状态返回给调用页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，CoolishBee Universal Android SDK 的 Facebook 登录无法完成。

en.description: CoolishBee Universal Android SDK starts Google sign-in and returns the account profile and sign-in result to the calling screen.
en.disableEffect: Google sign-in through Universal Android SDK cannot complete when this screen is disabled.

zh-CN.description: CoolishBee Universal Android SDK 会启动 Google 登录，并将账户资料和登录结果返回给调用页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，CoolishBee Universal Android SDK 的 Google 登录无法完成。

en.description: CoolishBee Universal Android SDK displays the address supplied by the calling screen inside an embedded browser. JavaScript is enabled for that page.
en.disableEffect: Any app or SDK flow that opens a page here cannot display that page when this Activity is disabled.

zh-CN.description: CoolishBee Universal Android SDK 会在内嵌浏览器中显示调用页面提供的网址，并为网页启用 JavaScript。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，依赖此 Activity 打开网页的应用或 SDK 流程无法显示该页面。

en.description: The DMarcs Document Scanner opens the camera and detects page edges for cropping; when the user finishes, it returns the cropped document image paths to the calling screen.
en.disableEffect: The app can no longer scan or crop document pages through this feature.

zh-CN.description: DMarcs 文档扫描工具会打开相机并识别页面边缘以进行裁剪；用户完成后，它会把裁剪后的图片路径返回给调用页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法通过此功能扫描和裁剪文档页面。

en.description: The BillyWei01 Doodle image library initializes its app-wide image-loading support when the app starts.
en.disableEffect: Images loaded through Doodle may fail to appear in app pages.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，BillyWei01 Doodle 图片库会初始化应用使用的图片加载功能。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用页面中通过 Doodle 加载的图片可能无法显示。

en.description: When AppSalvager detects repeated startup crashes, it opens this Activity in a separate process and shows the app-configured recovery screen with the crash cause.
en.disableEffect: The recovery screen will not appear, so the app may remain stuck if it keeps crashing at startup.

zh-CN.description: AppSalvager 检测到反复的启动崩溃后，会在独立进程中打开此 Activity，并显示应用配置的恢复界面及崩溃原因。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 恢复界面将无法显示；如果应用持续在启动时崩溃，可能无法恢复使用。

en.description: KFirebase Messaging handles Firebase Cloud Messaging deliveries here: it forwards data messages to the app, displays notification messages through local notifications, and passes refreshed registration tokens to the app.
en.disableEffect: Firebase push messages, displayed notifications, and refreshed-token callbacks will stop reaching the app.

zh-CN.description: KFirebase Messaging 会在此处理 Firebase Cloud Messaging 推送：把数据消息交给应用、通过本地通知显示通知消息，并把更新后的注册令牌传给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 关闭后，Firebase 推送、系统通知和注册令牌更新将无法送达应用。

en.description: KFirebase Messaging runs this job after a push-notification tap and passes the saved message data to the app's click listener.
en.disableEffect: The app will no longer receive KFirebase's callback when a user taps a push notification.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击 KFirebase 推送通知后，系统会运行此 Job Service，并把保存的消息数据交给应用的点击回调。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 关闭后，用户点击推送通知时，应用将无法收到 KFirebase 的回调。

en.description: When a user taps a KFirebase push notification, this receiver saves its data in a network-connected background job and schedules the job to notify the app.
en.disableEffect: Push-notification taps will no longer be forwarded to the app's click listener.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击 KFirebase 推送通知时，此 Receiver 会把通知数据存入需要网络的后台任务，并安排任务通知应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 关闭后，推送通知的点击事件将无法传给应用的回调。

en.description: When the app requests a Quickie scan, this screen opens the camera, asks for camera access if needed, reads the enabled QR or barcode formats, and returns the result to the app.
en.disableEffect: The app will not be able to launch this QR or barcode scanning flow.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求 Quickie 扫描时，此页面会打开相机，必要时申请相机权限，读取已启用格式的二维码或条码，并将结果返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法启动此二维码或条码扫描流程。

en.description: GamePub's Apple sign-in flow opens Apple's authorization page and processes the return link so the user can sign in or link an Apple account.
en.disableEffect: Apple sign-in and Apple account linking will not complete.

zh-CN.description: GamePub 的 Apple 登录流程会打开 Apple 授权页面，并处理返回链接以完成登录或账号绑定。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，Apple 登录和 Apple 账号绑定将无法完成。

en.description: GamePub's Apple sign-in flow opens Apple's authorization page in a browser tab and processes the return link to finish the account login.
en.disableEffect: Apple sign-in through this GamePub flow will not complete.

zh-CN.description: GamePub 的 Apple 登录流程会在浏览器标签页中打开 Apple 授权页面，并处理返回链接以完成账号登录。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，通过这条 GamePub 流程进行的 Apple 登录将无法完成。

en.description: During GamePub account sign-in or linking, this screen requests access to the user's Facebook profile and email, then sends the returned account details to GamePub.
en.disableEffect: Facebook sign-in and account linking through GamePub will not complete.

zh-CN.description: 进行 GamePub 账号登录或绑定时，此页面会请求 Facebook 用户资料和邮箱权限，并将返回的账号信息交给 GamePub。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，GamePub 的 Facebook 登录和账号绑定将无法完成。

en.description: During GamePub account sign-in or linking, this screen opens Google's account chooser, reads the returned identity details, and sends them to GamePub.
en.disableEffect: Google sign-in and account linking through GamePub will not complete.

zh-CN.description: 进行 GamePub 账号登录或绑定时，此页面会打开 Google 账号选择界面，读取返回的身份信息并交给 GamePub。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，GamePub 的 Google 登录和账号绑定将无法完成。

en.description: When the user chooses GamePub guest sign-in, this screen creates a guest profile from device information and submits it to GamePub.
en.disableEffect: Guest sign-in through GamePub will not complete.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择 GamePub 游客登录时，此页面会根据设备信息创建游客资料并提交给 GamePub。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，GamePub 游客登录将无法完成。

en.description: If GamePub cannot open a link in the system's browser tab, it loads the requested page in this in-app browser.
en.disableEffect: GamePub links that rely on this fallback cannot open when the system has no suitable browser tab.

zh-CN.description: 如果 GamePub 无法在系统浏览器标签页中打开链接，就会在此应用内浏览器中加载对应页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，如果系统没有可用的浏览器标签页，依赖此备用方式的 GamePub 链接将无法打开。

en.description: When a Firebase push arrives, the GamePub Android SDK queues background work for data messages and receives push-token update events.
en.disableEffect: This GamePub service will no longer handle its Firebase messages or queue their background work.

zh-CN.description: 收到 Firebase 推送时，GamePub Android SDK 会为数据消息安排后台任务，并接收推送令牌更新事件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，GamePub 的此服务将无法处理 Firebase 消息或安排相应的后台任务。

en.description: If GamePub cannot open a link in the system's browser tab, it loads the requested page in this in-app browser.
en.disableEffect: GamePub links that rely on this fallback cannot open when the system has no suitable browser tab.

zh-CN.description: 如果 GamePub 无法在系统浏览器标签页中打开链接，就会在此应用内浏览器中加载对应页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，如果系统没有可用的浏览器标签页，依赖此备用方式的 GamePub 链接将无法打开。

en.description: If GamePub cannot open a link in the system's browser tab, it loads the requested page in this in-app browser.
en.disableEffect: GamePub links that rely on this fallback cannot open when the system has no suitable browser tab.

zh-CN.description: 如果 GamePub 无法在系统浏览器标签页中打开链接，就会在此应用内浏览器中加载对应页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，如果系统没有可用的浏览器标签页，依赖此备用方式的 GamePub 链接将无法打开。

en.description: When AndroidPermissions asks the user to grant or change permissions, this screen shows the configured explanation or settings dialog and continues to the permission prompt or app settings.
en.disableEffect: The AndroidPermissions permission explanation and settings flow will not work.

zh-CN.description: AndroidPermissions 请求用户授予或更改权限时，此页面会显示配置的说明或设置对话框，并继续打开权限请求或应用设置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，AndroidPermissions 的权限说明和设置流程将无法使用。

en.description: The Halley Wallet SDK shows a card-selection screen and a point-of-sale connection step for its HalleyPay flow.
en.disableEffect: The HalleyPay card-selection and point-of-sale setup screen will be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: Halley Wallet SDK 会显示银行卡选择页面，以及 HalleyPay 流程中的销售终端连接步骤。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，HalleyPay 的银行卡选择和销售终端设置页面将无法使用。

en.description: In Handharbeni Matisse, this screen opens when a user taps an item in an album and lets them view and swipe through album media before selecting it.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot preview album items before confirming a media selection.

zh-CN.description: 在 Handharbeni 的 Matisse 媒体选择器中，用户点开相册项目时会进入此页面，可在选择前全屏查看并滑动浏览媒体。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法在确认媒体选择前预览相册项目。

en.description: In Handharbeni Matisse, this screen opens from the picker preview control and displays selected items so users can review them before confirming.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot review selected items in the picker's full-screen preview.

zh-CN.description: 在 Handharbeni 的 Matisse 媒体选择器中，用户点击预览后会看到已选项目，可在确认前逐一检查。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法在选择器的全屏预览中检查已选项目。

en.description: The Handharbeni Matisse media picker opens when the app asks users to choose photos or videos; it lists device albums and returns selected items to the app.
en.disableEffect: The picker cannot open, so app features that ask users to choose media cannot complete.

zh-CN.description: 应用要求用户选择照片或视频时，Handharbeni 的 Matisse 媒体选择器会显示设备相册，并将所选项目返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，媒体选择器无法打开，依赖它选择媒体的功能无法完成。

en.description: The idonans Core library, also shipped as MrZWC Core, uses this provider to make app files available when the app shares or opens them with another app. It grants the receiving app access to the selected files.
en.disableEffect: File sharing or opening through these core libraries can fail.

zh-CN.description: idonans Core（也以 MrZWC Core 发布）在应用分享文件或用其他应用打开文件时，通过此 Provider 提供文件访问权限。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，通过这些 Core 库分享或打开文件可能会失败。

en.description: The Universal Android SDK opens Apple's sign-in page in an in-app browser when the app requests Apple login, then returns the account result to the app.
en.disableEffect: Apple sign-in through the Universal Android SDK can no longer complete.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求 Apple 登录时，Universal Android SDK 会在应用内浏览器中打开 Apple 登录页，再将账号结果返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用无法通过 Universal Android SDK 完成 Apple 登录。

en.description: The Universal Android SDK starts Facebook sign-in, requests the user's profile and email, and returns the account details to the app.
en.disableEffect: Facebook sign-in through the Universal Android SDK can no longer complete.

zh-CN.description: Universal Android SDK 会启动 Facebook 登录，获取用户资料和邮箱，并将账号信息返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用无法通过 Universal Android SDK 完成 Facebook 登录。

en.description: The Universal Android SDK starts Google sign-in and returns the account token and profile details to the app.
en.disableEffect: Google sign-in through the Universal Android SDK can no longer complete.

zh-CN.description: Universal Android SDK 会启动 Google 登录，并将账号令牌和资料信息返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用无法通过 Universal Android SDK 完成 Google 登录。

en.description: When the app requests guest login, the Universal Android SDK signs in anonymously with Firebase or resumes the existing guest account.
en.disableEffect: Apps using Universal Android SDK guest accounts cannot create or resume a guest session.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求游客登录时，Universal Android SDK 会通过 Firebase 创建匿名登录，或恢复已有的游客账号。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，使用 Universal Android SDK 游客账号的应用无法创建或恢复游客会话。

en.description: The Universal Android SDK receives Firebase messages and schedules background work for messages carrying data. Firebase also delivers notification messages to this service.
en.disableEffect: Universal Android SDK push handling stops, including delivery of messages to this service and its data-message background work.

zh-CN.description: Universal Android SDK 接收 Firebase 消息，并为包含数据的消息安排后台任务；Firebase 也会将通知消息交给此服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Universal Android SDK 的推送处理会停止，包括此服务接收的消息和数据消息后台任务。

en.description: The Universal Android SDK uses this screen for a swipeable image banner with page dots and optional close or hide-for-today controls.
en.disableEffect: The Universal Android SDK's image-banner screen will not open.

zh-CN.description: Universal Android SDK 使用此页面显示可滑动的图片横幅，并提供页码圆点以及可选的关闭或今日不再显示控件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Universal Android SDK 的图片横幅页面无法打开。

en.description: The Universal Android SDK opens a supplied link in an in-app browser when its custom-tab option falls back to a web page inside the app.
en.disableEffect: Links that rely on the Universal Android SDK in-app browser may no longer open.

zh-CN.description: Universal Android SDK 的自定义标签页无法打开链接时，会通过此应用内浏览器显示指定网页。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖 Universal Android SDK 应用内浏览器的链接可能无法打开。

en.description: The Jinxiyang RequestPermission library opens this transparent screen when an app asks for several groups of runtime permissions. It requests each group, collects the grant results, and returns them to the caller.
en.disableEffect: This permission flow will not show its prompts or return their results, so app features that need those permissions can fail.

zh-CN.description: Jinxiyang RequestPermission 库在应用请求多组运行时权限时打开此透明界面。它会逐组请求权限、收集授权结果并返回给调用方。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，此流程无法显示权限请求或返回结果，依赖这些权限的应用功能可能无法使用。

en.description: The Jinxiyang RequestPermission library opens this transparent screen when an app requests runtime permissions. It requests each permission group in order and returns which permissions were granted.
en.disableEffect: This permission flow will not show its prompts or return their results, so app features that need those permissions can fail.

zh-CN.description: Jinxiyang RequestPermission 库在应用请求运行时权限时打开此透明界面。它会按顺序请求各组权限，并返回每项权限的授权情况。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，此流程无法显示权限请求或返回结果，依赖这些权限的应用功能可能无法使用。

en.description: The Erratum crash-handling library opens this screen after an uncaught app error when no custom error screen is configured. It shows the error details and offers to reopen the previous screen.
en.disableEffect: After an uncaught error, users will lose Erratum's error details and recovery screen.

zh-CN.description: 未配置自定义错误界面时，Erratum 崩溃处理库会在应用出现未捕获错误后打开此界面，显示错误详情并提供重新打开上一界面的选项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用发生未捕获错误时将无法显示 Erratum 的错误详情和恢复界面。

en.description: The JourneyApps barcode-scanner Activity opens the camera scan view and reads QR codes or barcodes for the calling app.
en.disableEffect: Features that rely on this scanner will not be able to read a code or return its contents.

zh-CN.description: JourneyApps 条码扫描 Activity 会打开相机扫码界面，为调用它的应用识别二维码或条码。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此扫描器的功能将无法识别或返回码内容。

en.description: Juan Imoli’s StrictMode Notifier starts this background service when its diagnostics are installed; it watches Android’s StrictMode warnings and sends a notification with a report when it finds one.
en.disableEffect: Blocking it stops StrictMode monitoring and warning notifications, but the app’s normal features continue to work.

zh-CN.description: 安装 Juan Imoli 的 StrictMode Notifier 诊断工具后会启动此后台服务；它监视 Android 的 StrictMode 警告，并在发现问题时发送包含报告的通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，StrictMode 监视和警告通知会停止，但应用的正常功能不受影响。

en.description: Juan Imoli’s StrictMode Notifier enables this report screen when its diagnostics are installed; it lists saved warnings, lets the user turn reporting on or off, and opens a selected warning.
en.disableEffect: Blocking it removes the warning list and its controls, while the app’s normal features continue to work.

zh-CN.description: 安装 Juan Imoli 的 StrictMode Notifier 诊断工具后会启用此报告界面；界面会列出已保存的警告，允许用户开关报告功能并查看选中的警告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法查看警告列表或使用相关开关，但应用的正常功能不受影响。

en.description: Juan Imoli’s StrictMode Notifier opens this screen from a warning notification or the report list to show details and let the user copy, share, or delete a report.
en.disableEffect: Blocking it prevents users from reading, copying, or sharing individual warning details; normal app use continues.

zh-CN.description: Juan Imoli 的 StrictMode Notifier 会从警告通知或报告列表打开此界面，显示问题详情，并允许用户复制、分享或删除报告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法查看、复制或分享单条警告的详情，但应用的正常使用不受影响。

en.description: LibXposed's service interface receives connections from the Xposed framework so compatible modules can communicate with the app.
en.disableEffect: Xposed module integrations will lose this connection; the app's regular screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: LibXposed 服务接口接收 Xposed 框架的连接，让兼容的模块能够与应用通信。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Xposed 模块将无法通过此接口与应用通信；应用的常规界面仍可使用。

en.description: Chuck, Mihodi Hasan's HTTP inspection library, creates a local store for recorded requests and responses. The library's network inspector reads and writes those records through it.
en.disableEffect: If the app uses Chuck's network interceptor, requests can fail before being sent because the interceptor cannot save their records.

zh-CN.description: Mihodi Hasan 的 Chuck HTTP 流量查看库会创建本地请求和响应记录库，供流量查看功能读取和保存记录。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 如果应用使用 Chuck 的网络拦截器，记录无法保存时，请求可能会在发出前失败。

en.description: Chuck's HTTP inspection library starts this service when its notification is dismissed to delete the saved request history.
en.disableEffect: Dismissing the Chuck notification will no longer clear saved HTTP transactions; app network requests can continue.

zh-CN.description: 关闭 Chuck 通知时，Chuck HTTP 流量查看库会启动此服务以删除保存的请求记录。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 关闭 Chuck 通知时将无法清除已保存的 HTTP 记录；应用的网络请求仍可继续。

en.description: Chuck opens this screen from its notification or launch shortcut to list recorded HTTP transactions. Selecting a request opens its details.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to open Chuck's request list; the app's network requests and other features remain available.

zh-CN.description: 用户通过 Chuck 通知或启动入口打开此页面后，Chuck 会列出记录的 HTTP 请求；选择一条记录可查看详情。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开 Chuck 的请求列表；应用的网络请求和其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: Chuck opens this screen when a user selects a recorded request. It shows request and response details and offers sharing and cURL export.
en.disableEffect: Recorded request details and export will no longer open in Chuck; other app functions remain available.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择一条已记录的请求时，Chuck 会打开此页面显示请求和响应详情，并提供分享及导出 cURL 的操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Chuck 将无法打开请求详情或导出内容；应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: my_lib (Nitish111) includes this sample screen, which displays a hello message from the library when an app or demo opens it.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open the library's sample hello screen.

zh-CN.description: my_lib（Nitish111）包含此示例页面，应用或演示程序打开时会显示来自该库的问候文字。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开该库的示例问候页面。

en.description: The RxPermissions Android library opens this screen when an app requests runtime permissions. It asks for the permissions and can show a reason or direct the user to app settings after denial.
en.disableEffect: Permission requests handled by RxPermissions may fail, preventing features that need camera, location, storage, or other access.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求运行时权限时，RxPermissions Android 库会打开此页面发起权限请求；被拒绝后还可说明原因或引导用户前往应用设置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: RxPermissions 处理的权限请求可能失败，依赖相机、位置、存储等权限的功能可能无法使用。

en.description: qkcoder's HermesDownloader provider runs at app startup and saves the app context that the downloader needs for later download requests.
en.disableEffect: Downloads started through HermesDownloader may fail without this startup setup.

zh-CN.description: qkcoder 的 HermesDownloader 提供程序会在应用启动时保存下载器后续处理下载请求所需的应用上下文。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 缺少这项启动设置后，通过 HermesDownloader 发起的下载可能会失败。

en.description: ReleaseStandard CodeEditor opens this Activity when a user manages editor extensions. It lists plugins and widgets with their details and controls for enabling or disabling them.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot manage CodeEditor plugins or widgets from this screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户管理编辑器扩展时，ReleaseStandard CodeEditor 会打开此 Activity。页面列出插件和小部件的详情，并提供启用或停用控件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过此页面管理 CodeEditor 插件或小部件。

en.description: When explicitly opened, this screen in Flaker (Rotbolt)'s Android network-simulator package displays a simple greeting.

zh-CN.description: 在 Flaker（Rotbolt）Android 网络模拟器套件中显式打开时，此页面只显示简单的问候语。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后将无法打开此问候页面；该页面不负责运行网络模拟控制功能。

en.description: When explicitly opened, this screen in Flaker (Rotbolt)'s Ktor network-simulator package displays a simple greeting.
en.disableEffect: The greeting screen will not open; this screen does not run the network-simulation controls.

zh-CN.description: 在 Flaker（Rotbolt）Ktor 网络模拟器套件中显式打开时，此页面只显示简单的问候语。

zh-CN.description: 通过启动图标打开 Flaker（Rotbolt）OkHttp 网络模拟器时，此页面会显示已捕获的请求，并提供模拟开关、设置和请求记录搜索。

zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此选择器的照片选择流程将无法把所选照片返回给应用。

en.description: The SimpleInstaller library by solrudev uses this Receiver for Android package installation status broadcasts. While an install session is active, it passes the result back to the app's install flow.
en.disableEffect: SimpleInstaller's APK install flow will not receive the completion status or return the result to its caller.

zh-CN.description: solrudev 的 SimpleInstaller 库通过此 Receiver 接收 Android 软件包安装状态广播，并在安装会话进行时将结果传回应用的安装流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，SimpleInstaller 的 APK 安装流程无法收到完成状态，也无法将结果返回给调用方。

en.description: The SimpleInstaller library by solrudev starts this Activity during APK installation. It opens Android's install or confirmation screen and returns the user's choice to the install flow.
en.disableEffect: SimpleInstaller may be unable to open or complete the system installation screen, so APK installation can fail.

zh-CN.description: solrudev 的 SimpleInstaller 库在安装 APK 时启动此 Activity。它会打开 Android 安装或确认界面，并将用户的选择返回安装流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，SimpleInstaller 可能无法打开或完成系统安装界面，导致 APK 安装失败。

en.description: The SimpleInstaller library by solrudev starts this Activity for an app's uninstall request. It opens Android's confirmation screen for the named package and returns the user's choice.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot complete SimpleInstaller's uninstall request or receive the system confirmation result.

zh-CN.description: solrudev 的 SimpleInstaller 库处理卸载请求时启动此 Activity，为指定的软件包打开 Android 确认界面并返回用户的选择。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用无法通过 SimpleInstaller 完成卸载请求或收到系统确认结果。

en.description: The SimpleInstaller library by solrudev uses this Receiver for Android PackageInstaller session broadcasts. It returns installation status and opens the install confirmation screen when Android requests user confirmation.
en.disableEffect: APK installation can fail or stop before SimpleInstaller receives a required confirmation or completion result.

zh-CN.description: solrudev 的 SimpleInstaller 库通过此 Receiver 接收 Android PackageInstaller 会话广播，回传安装状态，并在系统要求用户确认时打开安装确认界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，APK 安装可能无法完成 SimpleInstaller 所需的用户确认或结果回传。

en.description: The SimpleInstaller library by solrudev uses this Activity on its older Android installation path. It sends the APK to Android's installer and returns the installation result to the app.
en.disableEffect: On this installation path, SimpleInstaller cannot open Android's APK installer or return its result.

zh-CN.description: solrudev 的 SimpleInstaller 库在较旧的 Android 安装流程中使用此 Activity，将 APK 交给 Android 安装程序并把结果返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，SimpleInstaller 无法在此安装流程中打开 Android APK 安装程序或返回安装结果。

en.description: The SimpleInstaller library by solrudev uses this Activity for Android PackageInstaller session installs. It commits the install session and opens the system confirmation screen when needed.
en.disableEffect: APK installation through this session flow may not be submitted or confirmed.

zh-CN.description: solrudev 的 SimpleInstaller 库通过此 Activity 使用 Android PackageInstaller 会话安装 APK。它会提交安装会话，并在需要时打开系统确认界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，通过此会话流程进行的 APK 安装可能无法提交或完成确认。

en.description: At app startup, Treech Net prepares its network client with information from the app so it can make network requests.
en.disableEffect: Treech Net's network client can fail to start because its required app setup is missing.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，Treech Net 会读取应用所需的信息，以准备网络客户端并发送网络请求。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 缺少这项初始化后，Treech Net 的网络客户端可能无法启动。

en.description: At app startup, Treech's XUI library sets up its reusable interface elements for the app.
en.disableEffect: Apps that use Treech UI screens or widgets may fail to prepare or open them.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，Treech 的 XUI 界面库会为应用准备可复用的界面组件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用 Treech UI 页面或控件的应用可能无法完成初始化或打开这些界面。

en.description: When the app opens Treech UI's image viewer, this screen displays selected pictures in a swipeable gallery with an image count or page dots.
en.disableEffect: Image previews provided by Treech UI will not open, so app screens that rely on this viewer lose that feature.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开 Treech UI 图片查看器时，此页面会以可滑动的画廊显示所选图片，并显示图片数量或分页圆点。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Treech UI 提供的图片预览将无法打开，依赖此查看器的应用页面会失去该功能。

en.description: When a video is opened from Treech UI's media viewer, this screen plays the clip and lets the user close it by tapping.
en.disableEffect: Video playback in Treech UI's preview flow will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: 从 Treech UI 媒体查看器打开视频时，此页面会播放视频，并允许用户轻点关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Treech UI 预览流程将无法打开视频播放页面。

en.description: Triniwiz Fancy Camera uses this provider to make cached and external media files available through app-scoped links for camera workflows.
en.disableEffect: Camera workflows that need to hand off or share a saved photo or video can fail because its file link is no longer provided.

zh-CN.description: Triniwiz Fancy Camera 会通过此 Provider 为相机流程提供缓存和外部媒体文件的应用内链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，需要传递或分享已保存照片、视频的相机流程可能因无法获取文件链接而失败。

en.description: FileKit (Vinceglb) uses this provider when it needs to share a selected file with another app; it turns the file into a secure link and grants the receiving app access.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it breaks FileKit flows that convert local files into links that can be shared with other apps.

zh-CN.description: FileKit（Vinceglb）需要把本地文件交给其他应用时会使用此 Provider，将文件转换为安全的文件链接并授权接收方访问。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，FileKit 无法把本地文件转换为可供其他应用读取的链接，相关分享流程会失败。

en.description: FileKit (Vinceglb) uses this provider when it needs to share a selected file with another app; it turns the file into a secure link and grants the receiving app access.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it breaks FileKit flows that convert local files into links that can be shared with other apps.
