zh-CN.description: FileKit（Vinceglb）需要把本地文件交给其他应用时会使用此 Provider，将文件转换为安全的文件链接并授权接收方访问。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，FileKit 无法把本地文件转换为可供其他应用读取的链接，相关分享流程会失败。

en.description: When a payment returns from WeChat, Wankey Mithril Pay opens this Activity to receive the result and pass it back to the app’s payment flow.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it can leave WeChat payments without a completion or cancellation result in the app.

zh-CN.description: 微信支付返回应用时，Wankey Mithril Pay 会打开此 Activity 接收结果，并将结果交回应用的支付流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用可能收不到微信支付的完成或取消结果。

en.description: When the app starts social sign-in or shares text, an image, or a web page, Wankey Mithril RxShare opens this Activity and handles the return from the social app.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents social sign-in from finishing in the app and stops sharing through this library.

zh-CN.description: 应用发起社交账号登录，或分享文字、图片、网页时，Wankey Mithril RxShare 会打开此 Activity，并处理从社交应用返回的结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，社交账号登录无法在应用中完成，依赖此库的分享也无法使用。

en.description: Wallee AG's staging payment SDK starts this screen when the app opens a payment session. It displays the checkout flow using the session details supplied by the app.
en.disableEffect: Users will lose the Wallee checkout screen and cannot complete payments through this SDK.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开支付会话时，Wallee AG 的 staging 支付 SDK 会启动此页面。页面根据应用提供的会话信息显示结账流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开 Wallee 结账页面，也无法通过此 SDK 完成支付。

en.description: Wallee AG's staging payment SDK shows this themed loading screen while checkout opens. It uses the checkout theme and closes when the payment interface signals that it is ready.
en.disableEffect: Wallee starts this screen as part of each payment launch, so disabling it can interrupt checkout startup.

zh-CN.description: Wallee AG 的 staging 支付 SDK 会在结账页面启动时显示此主题化加载页面。它使用结账主题，并在支付界面发出就绪信号后关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Wallee 每次启动支付流程时都会打开此页面；禁用后可能中断结账启动。

en.description: The xit0c Mapbox offline-map plugin starts this Service when an offline map area is downloaded or cancelled. It creates or removes the map region and reports download progress and completion.
en.disableEffect: The app's offline map download and cancellation flows stop working.

zh-CN.description: 下载或取消离线地图区域时，xit0c 的 Mapbox 离线地图插件会启动此 Service。它创建或移除地图区域，并报告下载进度和完成状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法通过此插件下载或取消离线地图区域。

en.description: The XXMD File Preview SDK opens this screen for a selected audio file. Users can play, pause, seek, and follow playback progress.
en.disableEffect: Audio files can no longer be played in this in-app preview.

zh-CN.description: 选择音频文件进行预览时，XXMD 文件预览 SDK 会打开此页面。用户可以播放、暂停、拖动进度并查看播放位置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在应用内预览并播放音频文件。

en.description: The XXMD File Preview SDK uses this shared Activity when presenting its audio, image, video, or web previews after a supported file or link is selected.
en.disableEffect: Disabling this manifest entry does not affect the separate audio, image, video, or web viewer Activities used by the SDK.

zh-CN.description: 选择受支持的文件或链接进行预览时，XXMD 文件预览 SDK 会使用此共享 Activity 展示音频、图片、视频或网页内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用此清单项不会影响 SDK 单独注册的音频、图片、视频或网页预览页面。

en.description: The XXMD File Preview SDK opens this screen when the app previews an image file. It displays the selected image in the in-app viewer.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot view images through this preview screen.

zh-CN.description: 应用内预览图片时，XXMD 文件预览 SDK 会打开此页面显示所选图片。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此页面查看图片。

en.description: The XXMD File Preview SDK opens this screen for a selected video file and starts video playback with on-screen controls.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot play video files through this in-app preview.

zh-CN.description: 应用内预览视频文件时，XXMD 文件预览 SDK 会打开此页面并开始播放，页面提供视频控制选项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此应用内预览播放视频文件。

en.description: The XXMD File Preview SDK opens this screen for a supplied web link and loads the page in an in-app viewer.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot view web links through this in-app preview.

zh-CN.description: 应用内预览网页链接时，XXMD 文件预览 SDK 会打开此页面并加载对应网页。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此应用内预览查看网页链接。

en.description: KFirebase Messaging handles Firebase Cloud Messaging deliveries here, passes message data and notification details to the app, displays titled messages as local notifications, and emits refreshed registration tokens.
en.disableEffect: Firebase push messages, displayed notifications, and refreshed-token callbacks will stop reaching the app.

zh-CN.description: KFirebase Messaging 会在此处理 Firebase Cloud Messaging 推送，把消息数据和通知详情交给应用，将带标题的消息显示为本地通知，并传递更新后的注册令牌。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 关闭后，Firebase 推送、系统通知和注册令牌更新将无法送达应用。

en.description: When opened from the app's Gleap help or feedback control, this activity displays support or survey content and can collect feedback attachments.
en.disableEffect: The in-app Gleap support, feedback, or survey screen will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: 用户通过应用中的 Gleap 帮助或反馈入口打开此页面后，可以查看支持或问卷内容并附加反馈文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用内的 Gleap 支持、反馈或问卷页面将无法打开。

en.description: The GoEasy Android Notification SDK uses this service to link Firebase-based push notifications with GoEasy for delivery to the device.
en.disableEffect: GoEasy may not be able to register this app for Firebase-based push delivery.

zh-CN.description: GoEasy Android Notification SDK 会通过此 Service 将基于 Firebase 的推送与 GoEasy 连接，以便向设备投递通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: GoEasy 可能无法为应用完成基于 Firebase 的推送注册。

en.description: The GoEasy Android Notification SDK uses Honor Push registration information to enable notification delivery to Honor devices.
en.disableEffect: GoEasy push registration and notifications may stop working on Honor devices.

zh-CN.description: GoEasy Android Notification SDK 会使用 Honor Push 的设备注册信息，向 Honor 设备投递通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Honor 设备上的 GoEasy 推送注册和通知可能无法工作。

en.description: The GoEasy Android Notification SDK uses Huawei Push Kit registration information to enable notification delivery to Huawei devices.
en.disableEffect: GoEasy push registration and notifications may stop working on Huawei devices.

zh-CN.description: GoEasy Android Notification SDK 会使用 Huawei Push Kit 的设备注册信息，向 Huawei 设备投递通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Huawei 设备上的 GoEasy 推送注册和通知可能无法工作。

en.description: When Meizu Push is used, GoEasy receives device registration results through this Receiver so it can deliver notifications to Meizu devices.
en.disableEffect: GoEasy may not register Meizu devices for push delivery, so they may miss GoEasy notifications.

zh-CN.description: 使用 Meizu Push 时，GoEasy 会通过此 Receiver 接收设备注册结果，以便向 Meizu 设备投递通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: GoEasy 可能无法为 Meizu 设备注册推送，因此这些设备可能收不到 GoEasy 通知。

en.description: When Xiaomi Mi Push is used, GoEasy receives device registration results through this Receiver so it can deliver notifications to Xiaomi devices.
en.disableEffect: GoEasy may not register Xiaomi devices for push delivery, so they may miss GoEasy notifications.

zh-CN.description: 使用 Xiaomi Mi Push 时，GoEasy 会通过此 Receiver 接收设备注册结果，以便向 Xiaomi 设备投递通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: GoEasy 可能无法为 Xiaomi 设备注册推送，因此这些设备可能收不到 GoEasy 通知。

en.description: The GoEasy Vivo push integration receives notification and registration events, but its included implementation takes no action on them.
en.disableEffect: The included Vivo callbacks have no visible behavior to disable in this SDK version.

zh-CN.description: GoEasy 的 Vivo 推送集成会接收通知和注册事件，但当前实现不会对这些事件执行操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 在此 SDK 版本中，停用这些 Vivo 回调不会造成可见行为变化。

en.description: The Groobee Messaging SDK uses this Receiver when a push arrives or a user opens, dismisses, or cancels one of its notifications. It displays the message, records notification events, and can open the message link.
en.disableEffect: Groobee push notifications and their open, dismiss, cancel, and action handling will stop working.

zh-CN.description: Groobee 消息推送 SDK 会在收到推送，或用户打开、清除推送通知时使用此接收器。它会显示通知、记录通知事件，并可打开消息附带的链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Groobee 推送通知及其打开、清除、取消和操作按钮处理将停止工作。

en.description: The Groobee Messaging SDK opens this Activity when someone taps an action button in one of its notifications; it runs the button's configured action and then closes.
en.disableEffect: Action buttons in Groobee push notifications will no longer run their configured actions.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击 Groobee 消息推送通知中的操作按钮时，SDK 会短暂打开此 Activity，执行按钮配置的操作后关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Groobee 推送通知中的操作按钮将无法执行配置的操作。

en.description: When someone taps the settings button on a Groobee push notification, the SDK opens the app's configured settings page or link and removes that notification.
en.disableEffect: The settings button on Groobee notifications will no longer open its configured page or link.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击 Groobee 消息推送通知上的设置按钮时，SDK 会打开应用配置的设置页面或链接，并移除该通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Groobee 通知上的设置按钮将无法打开配置的页面或链接。

en.description: The Groobee CSAP Messaging SDK uses this Receiver when a push arrives or a user acts on one of its notifications. It displays push messages and handles notification open, delete, and action events.
en.disableEffect: Groobee CSAP push notifications and their open, delete, and action handling will stop working.

zh-CN.description: Groobee CSAP 消息推送 SDK 会在收到推送或用户操作其通知时使用此接收器。它会显示推送消息，并处理通知的打开、删除和按钮操作事件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Groobee CSAP 推送通知及其打开、删除和按钮操作处理将停止工作。

en.description: At app startup, Hackle Android SDK uses this Provider to observe when the app and its screens enter or leave the foreground. Hackle uses those changes for automatic lifecycle tracking.
en.disableEffect: Hackle will lose its automatic app and screen lifecycle tracking, while the app's screens continue to work.

zh-CN.description: Hackle Android SDK 会在应用启动时通过此 Provider 观察应用及其页面何时进入或离开前台。这些状态用于 Hackle 的自动生命周期跟踪。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，Hackle 将失去自动的应用和屏幕生命周期跟踪，但应用页面仍可正常使用。

en.description: Hackle Android SDK uses this Activity for its user inspection screen, which shows account and device identifiers, the push token, and experiment information when opened in the app.
en.disableEffect: Hackle's user inspection screen will not open; the app's other screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: Hackle Android SDK 的用户检查页面会显示账户和设备标识、推送令牌及实验信息，供应用打开该页面时查看。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Hackle 的用户检查页面将无法打开；应用的其他页面仍可使用。

en.description: Hackle Android SDK uses this Receiver for Firebase push messages. It shows a Hackle notification when the message calls for display and Android notifications are allowed.
en.disableEffect: Hackle push messages will no longer appear as Android notifications.

zh-CN.description: Hackle Android SDK 会通过此接收器处理 Firebase 推送消息。当消息需要显示且系统允许通知时，它会显示 Hackle 通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Hackle 推送消息将不再显示为 Android 通知。

en.description: When a user taps a Hackle push notification, this Activity records the click and opens the app or the notification's linked page.
en.disableEffect: Tapping Hackle push notifications will no longer open the app or their linked page through this route.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击 Hackle 推送通知后，此 Activity 会记录点击，并打开应用或通知链接的页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 点击 Hackle 推送通知将无法通过此路径打开应用或通知链接的页面。

en.description: Hanko's FIDO sign-in SDK uses this Activity to handle the app's credential registration, sign-in, and removal requests and return their results.
en.disableEffect: Registration, sign-in, and credential removal through Hanko will stop working.

zh-CN.description: Hanko 的 FIDO 登录 SDK 会用此 Activity 处理应用发起的凭据注册、身份验证和注销请求，并返回结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过 Hanko 进行的注册、登录和凭据注销将停止工作。

en.description: Hanko's FIDO sign-in SDK uses this Activity to register credentials or authenticate with the device's biometric prompt, then return the result to the app.
en.disableEffect: Biometric registration, sign-in, and credential management through Hanko will stop working.

zh-CN.description: Hanko 的 FIDO 登录 SDK 会用此 Activity 注册凭据，或通过设备的生物识别提示进行身份验证，然后将结果返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过 Hanko 进行的生物识别注册、登录和凭据管理将停止工作。

en.description: Heap's View Autocapture SDK starts this Provider with the app and registers screen-change listeners for automatic capture of view activity.
en.disableEffect: Heap's automatic capture of screen and view interactions will stop, while the app's screens continue to work.

zh-CN.description: Heap View 自动采集 SDK 会在应用启动时通过此 Provider 注册页面变化监听，以便自动采集界面活动。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Heap 对页面和界面操作的自动采集将停止，但应用页面仍可正常使用。

en.description: Heap's Compose Autocapture SDK starts this Provider to register interaction processors for screens built with Jetpack Compose.
en.disableEffect: Heap will stop automatically collecting interactions from Compose-based screens; those screens will continue to work.

zh-CN.description: Heap Compose 自动采集 SDK 会在应用启动时通过此 Provider 注册交互处理程序，以便采集由 Jetpack Compose 构建的页面上的操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Heap 将停止自动采集 Compose 页面上的操作，但这些页面仍可正常使用。

en.description: Heap Core SDK starts this Provider when the app launches and tracks the open screen and whether the app is in the foreground for Heap's data collection.
en.disableEffect: Heap's automatic screen and foreground/background tracking will stop, while the app's own screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: Heap Core SDK 会在应用启动时通过此 Provider 跟踪当前页面以及应用是否处于前台，供 Heap 收集数据。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Heap 的页面和前后台状态自动跟踪将停止，但应用自身的页面仍可使用。

en.description: Herald's Bluetooth SDK uses this foreground Service to keep nearby-device sensing active in the background; it displays an ongoing notification and stays active until stopped.
en.disableEffect: Background Bluetooth detection through Herald will stop, so the app can miss nearby-device encounters.

zh-CN.description: Herald 蓝牙 SDK 会通过此前台 Service 在后台持续检测附近设备；它会显示常驻通知，直到收到停止请求。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，Herald 的后台蓝牙检测将停止，应用可能无法发现附近设备。

en.description: When a user starts card scanning in Hyperswitch checkout, this screen uses the camera to read a payment card and returns the scan result or cancellation to the calling screen.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, card scanning through the Hyperswitch payment flow will not open.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Hyperswitch 结账时启动银行卡扫描后，此页面会使用相机读取银行卡，并将扫描结果或取消状态返回上一个页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Hyperswitch 支付流程中的银行卡扫描界面将无法打开。

en.description: During checkout, the Hyperswitch Android SDK opens Google Pay to confirm a payment and returns payment details or a cancellation or error to the checkout screen.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, Google Pay payments through this SDK will not be available.

zh-CN.description: 结账时，Hyperswitch Android SDK 会通过此 Activity 打开 Google Pay 确认付款，并将付款信息、取消或错误结果返回结账页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法通过此 SDK 使用 Google Pay 付款。

en.description: When the app opens Hyperswitch checkout, this Activity displays the configured payment screen and receives return events from external payment pages.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, the app cannot open the Hyperswitch checkout screen, so payments that use it will fail.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开 Hyperswitch 结账流程时，此 Activity 会显示应用配置的支付页面，并接收外部支付页面返回的结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用无法打开 Hyperswitch 结账页面，依赖该页面的支付将无法完成。

en.description: When an external payment page sends the user back to the app, this Hyperswitch screen receives the return link, notifies the open checkout, and closes.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, payments that rely on a browser redirect may not resume in the app.

zh-CN.description: 外部支付页面将用户带回应用时，此 Hyperswitch 页面会接收返回链接、通知正在进行的结账流程，然后关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，依赖浏览器跳转的支付可能无法在应用中继续。

en.description: When a HyperTrack SmartScheduler alarm fires for a scheduled job, this Receiver forwards the job details to the scheduler service for processing.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, jobs scheduled through the alarm service will not be delivered to the app.

zh-CN.description: HyperTrack SmartScheduler 的定时任务触发后，此 Receiver 会将任务信息转交给调度服务处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，通过闹钟服务安排的任务将无法传递给应用。

en.description: When a HyperTrack SmartScheduler alarm fires, this Service passes its job ID back to the scheduler so the scheduled one-off background task can run.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, one-off background jobs scheduled through this library will not run.

zh-CN.description: HyperTrack SmartScheduler 的定时任务触发后，此 Service 会将任务 ID 交回调度器，以运行相应的一次性后台任务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，通过此库安排的一次性后台任务将无法运行。

en.description: Google Play services starts this HyperTrack SmartScheduler Service for a scheduled background task; it passes the task label and data to the scheduler for execution.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, periodic or one-off jobs scheduled through this library will not run.

zh-CN.description: Google Play 服务为已安排的后台任务启动此 HyperTrack SmartScheduler Service；该服务会将任务标识和数据交给调度器执行。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，通过此库安排的周期性或一次性任务将无法运行。

en.description: After a user submits an edited image in the Imoji sticker SDK, this background Service sends the image and tags to create a sticker and reports the result to the app.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, sticker creation may not finish after the user submits the editor.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Imoji 贴纸 SDK 中提交编辑后的图片后，此后台 Service 会发送图片和标签以创建贴纸，并将结果返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户提交编辑器后，贴纸创建流程可能无法完成。

en.description: When the app opens Imoji’s sticker editor, this screen uses the supplied photo or lets the user choose an image, then starts the editing and tagging flow.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, users cannot prepare a photo as a custom Imoji sticker through this editor.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开 Imoji 贴纸编辑器时，此页面会使用已提供的照片，或允许用户选择图片，然后进入编辑和添加标签流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法通过此编辑器将照片制作成自定义 Imoji 贴纸。

en.description: After a user submits an edited image in the Imoji sticker SDK, this background Service sends the image and tags to create a sticker and reports the result to the app.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, sticker creation may not finish after the user submits the editor.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Imoji 贴纸 SDK 中提交编辑后的图片后，此后台 Service 会发送图片和标签以创建贴纸，并将结果返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户提交编辑器后，贴纸创建流程可能无法完成。

en.description: When the app opens Imoji’s editor with a photo, this screen displays the editing flow so the user can prepare a custom sticker.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, users cannot edit a photo for custom Imoji sticker creation through this screen.

zh-CN.description: 应用带照片打开 Imoji 编辑器时，此页面会显示编辑流程，让用户准备自定义贴纸。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法通过此页面编辑照片并制作自定义 Imoji 贴纸。

en.description: InAd Network's offerwall opens when the app shows its install offers. It displays campaigns; choosing one opens its store page or target link and lets the SDK check whether the promoted app was installed.
en.disableEffect: Blocking it removes the offerwall and its install-and-verify flow.

zh-CN.description: InAd Network 广告 SDK 的任务墙会在应用打开安装推广列表时显示推广任务；点按任务会打开应用商店或指定链接，并让 SDK 检查推广应用是否已安装。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后将无法使用任务墙及其安装核验流程。

en.description: When an InAd Network offer-check alarm fires, this receiver starts an install check when the device is online and schedules another check when it is offline.
en.disableEffect: Scheduled checks of offer installs will stop running.

zh-CN.description: InAd Network 广告 SDK 的任务核验定时器触发时，此接收器会在设备联网后启动安装检查；离线时会重新安排检查。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，任务安装情况将不再由定时检查。

en.description: When Android reports that an app was installed, InAd Network starts a check for pending offerwall installs so qualifying offers can be verified.
en.disableEffect: Offerwall installs will no longer be checked automatically after an app is installed.

zh-CN.description: Android 报告有应用安装后，InAd Network 广告 SDK 会检查待核验的推广任务安装情况，以确认符合条件的任务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，安装应用后将不再自动核验推广任务。

en.description: When Android reports that an app was removed, InAd Network clears its offerwall record for that app and refreshes the campaign state.
en.disableEffect: Offerwall status will not update automatically when a promoted app is removed.

zh-CN.description: Android 报告有应用卸载后，InAd Network 广告 SDK 会清除该应用的推广任务记录并更新任务状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，推广应用卸载时任务状态不会自动更新。

en.description: InAd Network runs this background service to check apps installed from its offerwall. It verifies eligible installs and sends their completion result to the offer network.
en.disableEffect: Offerwall install verification and completion reporting will stop.

zh-CN.description: InAd Network 广告 SDK 会在后台检查从任务墙推广的应用，核验符合条件的安装并向广告网络报告完成结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，任务安装核验和完成情况上报会停止。

en.description: When the host app opens its chat screen, the InAppChat SDK sets up a full-screen conversation interface and its chat navigation.
en.disableEffect: The app's InAppChat conversations will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: 宿主应用打开聊天页面时，InAppChat SDK 会显示全屏会话界面并设置聊天页面导航。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，应用中的 InAppChat 会话将无法打开。

en.description: Intercom's support SDK uses this file provider when a conversation shares an attachment. It makes configured app files available through Android's secure content-link system.
en.disableEffect: Attachments in Intercom conversations may fail to open or send.

zh-CN.description: Intercom 客服 SDK 在会话分享附件时会使用此文件提供器，通过 Android 的安全内容链接提供已配置的应用文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，Intercom 会话中的附件可能无法打开或发送。

en.description: At app startup, Intercom's provider registers the app with its late-initialization setup so Intercom can prepare its support features.
en.disableEffect: Intercom support and messaging features may fail to initialize.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，Intercom 的初始化提供器会将应用交给延迟初始化流程，以准备 Intercom 客服功能。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，Intercom 客服和消息功能可能无法初始化。

en.description: When someone opens a support article from an Intercom conversation, Intercom loads the article and shows its content, author details, and available reactions.
en.disableEffect: Support articles opened from Intercom conversations will fail to appear.

zh-CN.description: 用户从 Intercom 会话打开帮助文章时，Intercom 会加载并显示文章内容、作者信息和可用反馈。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，用户将无法从 Intercom 会话打开帮助文章。

en.description: When Intercom presents an in-app carousel, this screen fetches and displays its sequence of cards. A card can request a device permission or open a link or chat.
en.disableEffect: Intercom carousel messages and any actions on their cards will be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: Intercom 展示应用内轮播内容时，此页面会获取并显示一组卡片；卡片可以请求设备权限，也可以打开链接或聊天。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，Intercom 轮播消息及卡片操作将无法使用。

en.description: When the app opens an Intercom Help Center link, this screen loads the supplied support page inside the app with Intercom navigation controls.
en.disableEffect: The in-app Intercom Help Center will not open.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开 Intercom 帮助中心链接时，此页面会在应用内加载指定的客服页面并显示 Intercom 导航控件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，应用内的 Intercom 帮助中心将无法打开。

en.description: When the app opens Intercom support, this screen shows the configured home screen, inbox, or conversation and lets the user continue a support exchange.
en.disableEffect: Intercom support conversations and inbox screens will not open.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开 Intercom 客服时，此页面会显示配置的主页、收件箱或会话，供用户继续联系支持人员。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，Intercom 客服会话和收件箱将无法打开。

en.description: When Intercom displays a note from the support team, this screen shows the note and any available reaction controls. It also marks the related conversation as read.
en.disableEffect: Intercom notes and their reaction controls will not be available.

zh-CN.description: Intercom 展示客服团队发送的便笺时，此页面会显示便笺及可用的反馈控件，并将相关会话标为已读。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，Intercom 便笺及其反馈控件将无法使用。

en.description: When Intercom opens an in-app post, this screen displays the message and its available reply or reaction controls.
en.disableEffect: Intercom posts and their response controls will not open.

zh-CN.description: Intercom 打开应用内帖子时，此页面会显示消息以及可用的回复或反馈控件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，Intercom 帖子及其互动控件将无法打开。

en.description: When Intercom opens a message sheet or home card, this screen fetches its content and displays it in an in-app web view.
en.disableEffect: Intercom message sheets and home cards will not open.

zh-CN.description: Intercom 打开消息面板或主页卡片时，此页面会获取内容并在应用内网页视图中显示。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，Intercom 消息面板和主页卡片将无法打开。

en.description: When a user opens a video in an Intercom message, this screen plays it with Intercom's playback controls.
en.disableEffect: Videos attached to Intercom messages will not play in the app.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 Intercom 消息中的视频时，此页面会使用 Intercom 播放控件播放视频。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，Intercom 消息中的视频将无法在应用内播放。

en.description: When an older Intercom Help Center article opens, this screen loads the article in an in-app web view and shows loading or error states.
en.disableEffect: Help Center articles that use this in-app viewer will not open.

zh-CN.description: 较早版本的 Intercom 帮助中心文章打开时，此页面会在应用内加载文章，并显示加载或错误状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，使用此页面查看的帮助中心文章将无法打开。

en.description: When Firebase delivers an Intercom message or refreshes its registration token, this service forwards the message and registers the device for Intercom notifications.
en.disableEffect: Intercom push notifications and token updates will stop working.

zh-CN.description: Firebase 收到 Intercom 消息或更新推送注册令牌时，此服务会转交消息并为设备注册 Intercom 通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，Intercom 推送通知和令牌更新将停止。

en.description: When the app opens an article from Intercom's Help Center, this screen displays the selected support article.
en.disableEffect: The Help Center article screen will not open.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开 Intercom 帮助中心文章时，此页面会显示所选的客服文章。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，帮助中心文章页面将无法打开。

en.description: When someone selects an article in Intercom's Help Center, this screen loads and displays it, including its reading and feedback controls.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to read Help Center articles in this screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Intercom 帮助中心选择文章时，此页面会加载并显示文章及阅读和反馈控件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在此页面阅读帮助中心文章。

en.description: When the app opens Intercom's Help Center, this screen lists help collections and opens the collection selected by the user.
en.disableEffect: Help Center collections will not open.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开 Intercom 帮助中心时，此页面会列出帮助内容分类，并打开用户选择的分类。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 帮助中心分类将无法打开。

en.description: When a user searches Intercom's Help Center, this screen accepts the search text and displays matching support articles.
en.disableEffect: Help Center article search will not work.

zh-CN.description: 用户搜索 Intercom 帮助中心时，此页面会接收搜索文字并显示匹配的客服文章。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 帮助中心文章搜索将无法使用。

en.description: When someone taps an image in Intercom support content, this screen opens the image in a full-screen viewer.
en.disableEffect: Images in Intercom conversations and articles will not open full screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户点按 Intercom 客服内容中的图片时，此页面会以全屏方式显示图片。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Intercom 会话和文章中的图片将无法全屏打开。

en.description: When the app opens Intercom's main support entry, this screen sets up the support navigation and displays the requested Intercom destination.
en.disableEffect: The main Intercom support screen will not open.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开 Intercom 客服入口时，此页面会设置客服导航并显示所请求的 Intercom 页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Intercom 客服主页面将无法打开。

en.description: When the app embeds Intercom support in a messaging bubble, this activity hosts the support navigation inside that embedded window.
en.disableEffect: The embedded Intercom messaging bubble will not open.

zh-CN.description: 应用将 Intercom 客服嵌入消息气泡时，此 Activity 会在嵌入窗口中承载客服导航。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 嵌入式 Intercom 消息气泡将无法打开。

en.description: When a user previews files attached to an Intercom message, this screen displays the selected files and can open a single PDF in an external viewer.
en.disableEffect: Reviewing or returning selected attachments to an Intercom message may fail.

zh-CN.description: 用户预览附加到 Intercom 消息的文件时，此页面会显示所选文件；单个 PDF 可以在外部查看器中打开。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 预览附件或将所选附件返回 Intercom 消息时可能失败。

en.description: When a user replies from an Intercom notification, this receiver queues the reply for sending when a network connection is available.
en.disableEffect: Quick replies from Intercom notifications will not be sent.

zh-CN.description: 用户从 Intercom 通知中回复时，此接收器会将回复排队，等网络连接可用后发送。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 Intercom 通知快速回复。

en.description: When Intercom opens a newer in-app post, this screen displays its message and lets the user return to the related conversation.
en.disableEffect: Newer Intercom posts and their conversation links will not open.

zh-CN.description: Intercom 打开新版应用内帖子时，此页面会显示消息，并允许用户返回相关会话。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 新版 Intercom 帖子及其会话链接将无法打开。

en.description: When Intercom opens a post through its earlier post flow, this screen displays the post and its related conversation controls.
en.disableEffect: Posts using this Intercom screen will not open.

zh-CN.description: Intercom 通过较早的帖子流程打开内容时，此页面会显示帖子及相关会话控件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此 Intercom 页面打开的帖子将无法显示。

en.description: When Intercom sends a notification broadcast, this receiver handles its dismissal event for notification tracking.
en.disableEffect: Intercom notification dismissals will no longer be recorded.

zh-CN.description: Intercom 发出通知广播时，此接收器会处理通知关闭事件并记录相关状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Intercom 通知关闭状态将不再记录。

en.description: When a user taps an Intercom push notification, this short-lived screen checks Intercom's setup and opens the notification's destination.
en.disableEffect: Tapping an Intercom notification will no longer open its support destination.

zh-CN.description: 用户点按 Intercom 推送通知时，此短暂页面会检查 Intercom 状态并打开通知目标页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 点按 Intercom 通知将无法打开对应的客服页面。

en.description: When Intercom launches a survey, this screen displays the questionnaire and records the user's responses.
en.disableEffect: Intercom surveys will not open.

zh-CN.description: Intercom 启动问卷时，此页面会显示问题并记录用户的回答。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Intercom 问卷将无法打开。

en.description: When a user previews files attached to an Intercom message, this screen displays the selected files and can open a single PDF in an external viewer.
en.disableEffect: Reviewing or returning selected attachments to an Intercom message may fail.

zh-CN.description: 用户预览附加到 Intercom 消息的文件时，此页面会显示所选文件；单个 PDF 可以在外部查看器中打开。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 预览附件或将所选附件返回 Intercom 消息时可能失败。

en.description: The React Native Firebase App module runs during app startup and makes the application context available to Firebase features in React Native apps.
en.disableEffect: Firebase modules may not receive the app context they need, which can stop Firebase features from working.

zh-CN.description: React Native Firebase App 模块会在应用启动时运行，并向 React Native 应用中的 Firebase 功能提供应用上下文。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Firebase 模块可能无法取得所需的应用上下文，导致 Firebase 功能无法正常工作。

en.description: The React Native Firebase Crashlytics module runs at startup and applies the app's setting for automatic crash-report collection.
en.disableEffect: Crash reporting through Crashlytics will not be initialized; normal app features remain available.

zh-CN.description: React Native Firebase Crashlytics 模块会在应用启动时运行，并应用自动收集崩溃报告的设置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Crashlytics 崩溃报告将不会初始化；应用的常规功能仍可使用。

en.description: When the Ionic File Viewer opens an app file in another viewer, this provider makes the file available through Android's secure content-link system.
en.disableEffect: Files handled by the Ionic File Viewer may not open in another app.

zh-CN.description: Ionic File Viewer 在其他查看器中打开应用文件时，此提供器会通过 Android 安全内容链接提供该文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Ionic File Viewer 处理的文件可能无法在其他应用中打开。

en.description: The Jenga PGW (Finserve payment) SDK opens a hosted checkout or verification page inside the app when a payment flow sends it a page title and address.
en.disableEffect: The hosted checkout or verification page will not open, so the payment step that uses Jenga PGW may not complete.

zh-CN.description: Jenga PGW（Finserve 支付）SDK 在支付流程打开托管结账或验证页面时，会在应用内显示该页面及其标题。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 托管结账或验证页面将无法打开，依赖 Jenga PGW 的支付步骤可能无法完成。

en.description: The Johnson Lee Translator SDK downloads its Korean-to-Chinese translation model over Wi-Fi when it starts and adds a movable translation control to supported app screens. Tapping it translates the visible text into Chinese.
en.disableEffect: The floating translation control and on-screen translation will be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: Johnson Lee Translator SDK 启动时会在 Wi-Fi 下下载韩语到中文的翻译模型，并在支持的应用页面添加可移动的翻译按钮。点击按钮可将页面上显示的文字翻译成中文。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 浮动翻译按钮和屏幕文字翻译将无法使用。

en.description: The joynr Android communications framework provides a protected service for messages from authorized clients. When a client connects, the service passes its messages to the app's joynr connection.
en.disableEffect: App features that exchange data through joynr may stop connecting or receiving updates.

zh-CN.description: joynr Android 通信框架通过受保护的服务接收已获授权的客户端消息，并将消息交给应用的 joynr 通信连接处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖 joynr 交换数据的应用功能可能无法连接或接收更新。

en.description: The KARTE notifications SDK handles a tap or dismissal of a KARTE message. It records the response and opens the message's target screen when the user taps it.
en.disableEffect: KARTE notification actions may stop opening their intended screen, and click or dismissal tracking will be lost.

zh-CN.description: KARTE 通知 SDK 在用户点击或关闭 KARTE 消息时处理相应操作并记录结果；用户点击消息时，它会打开消息指定的页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: KARTE 通知可能无法打开指定页面，点击和关闭记录也会停止。

en.description: The KARTE notifications SDK uses this receiver when a message action is delivered. It records clicks or dismissals and opens the message's target screen for a tap.
en.disableEffect: KARTE notification actions may stop opening their intended screen, and click or dismissal tracking will be lost.

zh-CN.description: KARTE 通知 SDK 收到消息操作时会使用此接收器记录点击或关闭事件；收到点击操作时，它会打开消息指定的页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: KARTE 通知可能无法打开指定页面，点击和关闭记录也会停止。

en.description: The Kobza Ads mediation SDK uses this full-screen page to show an in-house image or video ad, with controls to close, skip, mute, or follow the ad when available.
en.disableEffect: Kobza in-house interstitial ads will not be shown.

zh-CN.description: Kobza Ads 广告中介 SDK 使用此全屏页面展示自有图片或视频广告，并按广告内容提供关闭、跳过、静音或跳转控件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Kobza 自有插屏广告将不会显示。

en.description: The Kobza Ads mediation SDK stores and looks up store and click identifiers for its in-house ad attribution in a local database.
en.disableEffect: In-house ad tracking will not be able to read or save these records, and ad click flows that need them may fail.

zh-CN.description: Kobza Ads 广告中介 SDK 将自有广告的应用商店标识和点击标识保存在本地数据库中，供广告归因时查询。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 自有广告归因将无法读取或保存这些记录，依赖这些记录的广告点击流程也可能失败。

en.description: When Google Play sends an install-referrer broadcast, the Kobza Ads SDK reads its click identifier and saves it for in-house ad attribution.
en.disableEffect: Installs that came from Kobza in-house ads may no longer be attributed to the ad click that led to them.

zh-CN.description: Google Play 发出安装来源广播时，Kobza Ads SDK 会读取其中的点击标识，并保存用于自有广告归因。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 由 Kobza 自有广告带来的安装可能无法再归因到对应的广告点击。

en.description: The Kobza Ads mediation SDK opens this full-screen page to display a real-time-bidding interstitial ad and show a close or skip control when the ad allows it.
en.disableEffect: Kobza interstitial ads will not appear; the app's other screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: Kobza Ads 广告中介 SDK 使用此全屏页面展示实时竞价插屏广告，并在广告允许时提供关闭或跳过控件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Kobza 插屏广告将不会显示，应用的其他页面仍可使用。

en.description: The Kodif Android SDK displays the configured guided customer flow as interactive screens, using the starting flow and initial details supplied by the app. A flow can also open its Zendesk support messaging experience.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to open or complete the app's Kodif-guided customer flow.

zh-CN.description: Kodif Android SDK 会根据应用提供的流程和初始信息，显示可交互的客户引导页面；流程也可以打开 Zendesk 客服消息界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开或完成应用中的 Kodif 客户引导流程。

en.description: The Kommunicate chat SDK runs this background service after a network or device-clock change. It synchronizes queued and deleted messages and user status, or refreshes the time offset used for chat timestamps.
en.disableEffect: Queued messages, deletions, or user status may remain out of sync after reconnecting, and chat times may be wrong after a clock change.

zh-CN.description: Kommunicate 聊天 SDK 在网络或设备时间变化后运行此后台服务。它会同步待发送和已删除的消息及用户状态，或更新聊天时间使用的时差。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 重新联网后，待发送消息、删除状态或用户状态可能无法同步；设备时间变化后，聊天时间也可能不准确。

en.description: The Kommunicate chat SDK uses this background service to process incoming messages and synchronize conversation history, message details, and muted-user lists.
en.disableEffect: Incoming messages or conversation updates may not be processed or synchronized.

zh-CN.description: Kommunicate 聊天 SDK 使用此后台服务处理收到的消息，并同步会话记录、消息详情和已静音用户列表。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 收到的消息或会话更新可能无法处理或同步。

en.description: The Kommunicate chat SDK sends queued chat messages through this background service.
en.disableEffect: Messages waiting to send may remain unsent.

zh-CN.description: Kommunicate 聊天 SDK 通过此后台服务发送排队等待发送的聊天消息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 排队等待发送的消息可能无法发出。

en.description: The Kommunicate chat SDK uses this service to manage live conversation and typing updates, including subscriptions for contacts, groups, and support teams.
en.disableEffect: Live chat updates and typing indicators may stop arriving for the app's conversations.

zh-CN.description: Kommunicate 聊天 SDK 使用此服务管理实时会话和输入状态更新，包括联系人、群组和客服团队的消息订阅。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用会话中的实时消息更新和输入状态提示可能停止接收。

en.description: The Kommunicate chat SDK uses this service to update contact or group read status, unread counts, and user presence or last-seen information.
en.disableEffect: Read receipts, unread counts, and user-status information may become stale.

zh-CN.description: Kommunicate 聊天 SDK 使用此服务更新联系人或群组的已读状态、未读数量，以及用户在线或最后活跃信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 已读回执、未读数量和用户状态信息可能不再更新。

en.description: For a signed-in Kommunicate chat user, this receiver requests a background sync after device startup or when connectivity returns.
en.disableEffect: Chat messages and user status may not resynchronize automatically after startup or a network reconnect.

zh-CN.description: Kommunicate 聊天用户登录后，设备启动或网络恢复时，此接收器会请求后台同步。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 设备启动或网络恢复后，聊天消息和用户状态可能不会自动重新同步。

en.description: When the device time or time zone changes, the Kommunicate chat SDK recalculates the time offset used for chat timestamps.
en.disableEffect: Chat timestamps may be inaccurate after a device time or time-zone change.

zh-CN.description: 设备时间或时区变化时，Kommunicate 聊天 SDK 会重新计算聊天时间使用的时差。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 设备时间或时区变化后，聊天时间可能不准确。

en.description: The Kommunicate chat SDK provides temporary file links so camera, gallery, and chat attachment flows can read files selected or captured for a conversation.
en.disableEffect: Capturing, attaching, or sharing photos and videos in chat may fail.

zh-CN.description: Kommunicate 聊天 SDK 通过临时文件链接，让相机、相册和聊天附件流程读取为会话选择或拍摄的文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 聊天中的照片或视频可能无法拍摄、附加或分享。

en.description: When Firebase delivers a Kommunicate chat push or refreshes its device token, this service processes the chat notification or registers the new token.
en.disableEffect: Incoming chat push notifications and updated push-token registration will stop; messages can still sync when the app is opened.

zh-CN.description: Firebase 推送 Kommunicate 聊天消息或更新设备令牌时，此服务会处理聊天通知或登记新令牌。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 聊天推送通知和新令牌登记将停止；打开应用后仍可同步消息。

en.description: The Kommunicate chat SDK opens this screen to show a conversation or conversation list and handle messaging, attachments, location sharing, and related chat actions.
en.disableEffect: The in-app chat screen will not open, so users cannot read or send messages through that conversation.

zh-CN.description: Kommunicate 聊天 SDK 使用此页面显示会话或会话列表，并处理消息、附件、位置分享及其他聊天操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用内聊天页面将无法打开，用户无法通过该会话收发消息。

en.description: When a user opens a photo or GIF from a Kommunicate conversation, this screen displays it full size and offers sharing or forwarding options.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to open chat images or GIFs full screen or share them from this screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 Kommunicate 会话中的照片或 GIF 时，此页面会全屏显示内容，并提供分享或转发选项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在此页面全屏查看或分享聊天中的照片和 GIF。

en.description: When a user adds a file to a Kommunicate message, this screen opens the file or gallery picker, checks the selected attachment, and returns it to the conversation for sending.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to select and attach files to chat messages.

zh-CN.description: 用户为 Kommunicate 消息添加文件时，此页面会打开文件或相册选择器、检查所选附件，并将其交回会话发送。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法选择文件并附加到聊天消息中。

en.description: When a user chooses to share a location in Kommunicate chat, this screen shows a map and current position, lets the user adjust the pin, and returns the chosen location to the conversation.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to choose and send a map location in chat.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择在 Kommunicate 聊天中分享位置时，此页面会显示地图和当前位置，允许调整标记，并将选定位置交回会话。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在聊天中选择并发送地图位置。

en.description: The Kommunicate chat SDK opens rich-message links and help pages in an in-app browser, and can submit payment forms supplied by a conversation.
en.disableEffect: In-chat links, help pages, and payment forms that use this screen will not open or complete.

zh-CN.description: Kommunicate 聊天 SDK 会在应用内浏览器中打开富消息链接和帮助页面，也可以提交会话提供的支付表单。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此页面的聊天链接、帮助页面和支付表单将无法打开或完成。

en.description: When a Kommunicate chat asks for details before starting a conversation, this screen displays and validates the form, then returns the answers or creates the chat user.
en.disableEffect: Users may not be able to submit required contact details or start the conversation that depends on them.

zh-CN.description: Kommunicate 聊天在开始会话前需要收集信息时，此页面会显示并验证表单，然后返回答案或创建聊天用户。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户可能无法提交必需的联系信息，也无法开始依赖这些信息的会话。

en.description: When an app starts LBRY content services, the LBRY SDK for Android keeps its content engine running in the background and reports download progress and completion. It also displays a persistent notice while the service is active.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it can stop LBRY content from loading and prevent background downloads or their progress updates.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动 LBRY 内容服务时，LBRY Android SDK 会在后台维持内容引擎运行，并报告下载进度和完成状态。服务运行期间还会显示持续通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，LBRY 内容可能无法加载，后台下载也会停止或不再更新进度。

en.description: Liftoff Ads opens this screen to show a full-screen HTML interstitial. It displays the ad with a close control and countdown and records when the ad is viewed.
en.disableEffect: Rewards for watching this HTML ad will no longer be granted; if the app requests one, Liftoff does not recover from a failed screen launch and the app may close.

zh-CN.description: Liftoff Ads 展示全屏 HTML 插屏广告时会打开此页面。页面显示广告、关闭控件和倒计时，并记录广告展示情况。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，观看此类 HTML 广告可获得的奖励将不再发放；如果应用仍请求展示广告，Liftoff 无法处理页面启动失败，应用可能因此退出。

en.description: Liftoff Ads opens this screen to display a unified full-screen interstitial ad. It renders the ad content and handles ad-viewing rewards and ad actions.
en.disableEffect: Rewards for watching this unified interstitial will no longer be granted; if the app requests one, Liftoff does not recover from a failed screen launch and the app may close.

zh-CN.description: Liftoff Ads 展示统一格式的全屏插屏广告时会打开此页面。页面呈现广告内容，并处理观看奖励和广告操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，观看此类统一插屏广告可获得的奖励将不再发放；如果应用仍请求展示广告，Liftoff 无法处理页面启动失败，应用可能因此退出。

en.description: Liftoff Ads opens this screen for VAST video interstitials. It plays the ad with its call-to-action, close and replay controls, companion HTML, and video progress tracking.
en.disableEffect: Rewards for watching this VAST video ad will no longer be granted; if the app requests one, Liftoff does not recover from a failed screen launch and the app may close.

zh-CN.description: Liftoff Ads 展示 VAST 视频插屏广告时会打开此页面。页面播放广告及配套 HTML 内容，并提供行动按钮、关闭和重播控件，同时跟踪播放进度。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，观看此类 VAST 视频广告可获得的奖励将不再发放；如果应用仍请求展示广告，Liftoff 无法处理页面启动失败，应用可能因此退出。

en.description: The LiveKit Android SDK starts this foreground service while a room is sharing the screen and displays an ongoing capture notification.
en.disableEffect: LiveKit screen sharing will fail to start or continue.

zh-CN.description: LiveKit Android SDK 会在房间共享屏幕时启动此前台服务，并显示持续的屏幕采集通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: LiveKit 屏幕共享将无法启动或继续。

en.description: When an app starts Logto sign-in, the Logto Android SDK opens the authorization page in a browser tab through this screen. It handles the return from the browser or a user cancellation.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents browser-based Logto sign-in from starting or returning to the app.

zh-CN.description: 应用开始 Logto 登录时，Logto Android SDK 会通过此页面在浏览器标签页中打开授权页面，并处理浏览器返回或用户取消的情况。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法通过浏览器完成 Logto 登录或返回应用。

en.description: When a browser returns to the app through a Logto sign-in link, the Logto Android SDK opens this exported callback screen. It checks the returned link and forwards it to the in-progress sign-in.
en.disableEffect: Users may not complete browser-based Logto sign-in because the callback will not be received.

zh-CN.description: 浏览器通过 Logto 登录链接返回应用时，Logto Android SDK 会打开此回调页面。页面检查返回链接，并将其交给正在进行的登录流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用将无法接收浏览器登录回调，用户可能无法完成 Logto 登录。

en.description: In Logto Android SDK versions that use embedded sign-in, this screen displays the authorization page in an in-app web view and supports the SDK web-based social sign-in flow. Closing it cancels the pending sign-in.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot sign in through the embedded Logto page in app versions that use this flow.

zh-CN.description: 使用内嵌登录流程的 Logto Android SDK 版本会在此页面中显示授权网页，并支持 SDK 的网页社交登录流程。关闭页面会取消当前登录。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，使用此流程的应用版本将无法通过 Logto 内嵌页面登录。

en.description: When a web-based social login returns to the app through a link, the Logto Android SDK opens this callback screen. It passes the returned link to the waiting social sign-in and then closes.
en.disableEffect: Web-based social sign-in cannot finish if this callback screen is disabled.

zh-CN.description: 网页社交登录通过链接返回应用时，Logto Android SDK 会打开此回调页面。页面把返回链接交给正在等待的社交登录流程，然后关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，网页社交登录将无法完成回调。

en.description: When an app starts, stops, or restarts Tor through KmpTor Manager, this service coordinates the Tor session and its status notification.
en.disableEffect: Tor-based features that use KmpTor Manager cannot start or maintain their connection if this service is disabled.

zh-CN.description: 应用通过 KmpTor Manager 启动、停止或重启 Tor 时，此服务会协调 Tor 会话并更新状态通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，依赖 KmpTor Manager 的 Tor 功能将无法启动或维持连接。

en.description: When an app starts or binds to the KmpTor Runtime, this background service hosts the Tor runtime and follows device network changes while Tor is active.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents apps that use KmpTor from starting or maintaining Tor connections.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动或绑定 KmpTor Runtime 时，此后台服务会承载 Tor 运行环境，并在 Tor 运行期间跟踪设备网络变化。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，使用 KmpTor 的应用将无法启动或维持 Tor 连接。

en.description: The 05nelsonm PIN Authentication SDK opens this screen when an app requests local PIN setup, confirmation, reset, or verification. It displays the PIN form and returns the result to the app.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents the app from completing local PIN setup or verification flows that rely on this SDK.

zh-CN.description: 05nelsonm PIN Authentication SDK 会在应用请求设置、确认、重置或验证本地 PIN 时显示此页面。它提供 PIN 输入界面并将结果返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，依赖此 SDK 的本地 PIN 设置和验证流程将无法完成。

en.description: When an app asks TOPL Android Service to start Tor, this service initializes the onion proxy, monitors connectivity, and reports Tor state to the app.
en.disableEffect: Apps that depend on TOPL for Tor connectivity lose that Tor connection if this service is disabled.

zh-CN.description: 应用要求 TOPL Android Service 启动 Tor 时，此服务会初始化洋葱代理、监控网络连接，并向应用报告 Tor 状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，依赖 TOPL 提供 Tor 连接的应用将失去该连接。

en.description: The Mehow Laboratory inspector opens when the app starts its built-in inspection panel and shows the configured feature sections. It is used to inspect the app's added tools.
en.disableEffect: The inspection panel will no longer open; the app's regular screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: Mehow Laboratory 检查器会在应用打开内置检查面板时显示已配置的功能分区，供查看应用中的检查工具。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 检查面板将无法打开，但应用的常规页面仍可使用。

en.description: The Mehow Squash It reporting SDK opens this screen when its issue-reporting setup is incomplete; it lists missing Jira project or account details and offers a way back.
en.disableEffect: Users lose the reporting setup warning, while the host app's other features remain available.

zh-CN.description: Mehow Squash It 问题报告 SDK 在报告设置不完整时打开此页面，列出缺少的 Jira 项目或账户信息，并提供返回操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将看不到报告设置提示，但宿主应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: The Mehow Squash It reporting SDK opens this screen when someone files a problem report; it collects the report details and selected attachments or screenshot before sending them to the configured issue tracker.
en.disableEffect: Users can no longer submit in-app problem reports through Squash It.

zh-CN.description: Mehow Squash It 报告 SDK 在用户提交问题报告时打开此页面，收集报告内容及所选附件或截图，再发送到已配置的问题跟踪服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 Squash It 提交应用内问题报告。

en.description: Mehow Squash It runs this initializer automatically when the app starts to set up its screenshot and issue-reporting hooks. Blocking it removes that automatic support setup, while the host app's ordinary features remain available.
en.disableEffect: Squash It's automatic screenshot and reporting shortcuts will not be set up.

zh-CN.description: Mehow Squash It 会在应用启动时自动运行此初始化项，以接入截图和问题报告功能。停用后不会自动设置这些支持工具，宿主应用的常规功能仍可使用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Squash It 的自动截图和报告入口将不会完成设置。

en.description: Mehow Squash It opens this screen when its issue-reporting settings are missing; it shows what needs attention and offers to open or install Squash It. Blocking it hides this reporting setup guidance.
en.disableEffect: Users will not see the setup guidance when Squash It reporting is misconfigured.

zh-CN.description: Mehow Squash It 在问题报告设置缺失时打开此页面，说明需要补齐的内容，并提供打开或安装 Squash It 的入口。停用后将看不到这些报告设置指引。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Squash It 报告设置不正确时，用户将无法看到相应指引。

en.description: Mehow Squash It opens this form when someone submits a problem report; it displays report progress and can include a screenshot with the submission.
en.disableEffect: Squash It's in-app problem-report flow will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: Mehow Squash It 在用户提交问题报告时打开此表单，显示报告处理状态，并可随报告附上截图。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Squash It 的应用内问题报告流程将无法打开。

en.description: Mehow Squash It shows a captured screen here so the user can draw or mark areas before attaching it to a problem report.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to review or mark screenshots for Squash It reports.

zh-CN.description: Mehow Squash It 会在此显示已截取的画面，供用户在附加到问题报告前进行标记或绘制。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在 Squash It 报告中查看或标记截图。

en.description: After a user requests a Squash It screenshot, this screen asks Android for permission to capture the display and returns the user's choice to the report flow.
en.disableEffect: Squash It's screenshot capture option will no longer complete.

zh-CN.description: 用户请求通过 Squash It 截图时，此页面会向 Android 请求屏幕捕获许可，并把用户的选择交回报告流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Squash It 的截图功能将无法完成。

en.description: The Mehow Squash It capture service runs during report screenshot capture and keeps Android's capture notification visible.
en.disableEffect: Screenshot attachments for Squash It reports may stop working.

zh-CN.description: Mehow Squash It 截图服务会在报告截图期间运行，并显示 Android 要求的屏幕捕获通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Squash It 报告中的截图附件可能无法正常生成。

en.description: Mehow Squash It starts this service to show a notification whose action begins a screenshot and Jira report.
en.disableEffect: The notification shortcut for capturing and reporting a screenshot will be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: Mehow Squash It 会启动此服务并显示通知，用户可通过通知开始截图并提交 Jira 报告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过通知快捷入口截图并提交报告。

en.description: The Mehow Squash It logging add-on runs at app startup and connects Timber log messages to Squash It's reporting tools.
en.disableEffect: Squash It will stop receiving app log messages through this logging integration; regular app features remain available.

zh-CN.description: Mehow Squash It 日志扩展会在应用启动时运行，并将 Timber 日志消息接入 Squash It 报告工具。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Squash It 将不再通过此集成接收应用日志，但应用的常规功能仍可使用。

en.description: The MetaMask Android SDK includes this standalone main screen. In release 0.1.2 the app icon opens it, but it displays an empty screen and contains no wallet connection flow; release 0.6.6 keeps it available for direct opening without the app-icon link.
en.disableEffect: Blocking it hides the empty screen and may remove the app-icon entry point in versions that use it as the launcher.

zh-CN.description: MetaMask Android SDK 包含此独立主页面。0.1.2 版会通过应用图标打开它，但页面为空且没有钱包连接流程；0.6.6 版仍可直接打开此页面，但应用图标不再指向它。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后此空白页面将无法打开；在将它用作启动入口的版本中，应用图标入口也可能消失。

en.description: The Mikes Corporation MKeyboard service appears as an Android input method when the user selects it for typing. It shows numeric or QWERTY layouts for the focused field, but this release's code does not enter tapped keys into the field.
en.disableEffect: MKeyboard disappears from the keyboard choices; this release does not provide working text entry, so disabling it removes its layout without removing functioning key input.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择 Mikes Corporation 的 MKeyboard 输入法时，Android 会显示数字或 QWERTY 键盘布局；但此版本的代码不会将点击的按键输入到文本框中。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，MKeyboard 将从键盘选项中消失；此版本本身无法正常输入文字，因此禁用只会移除该布局，不会移除可用的按键输入功能。

en.description: MoliHuan’s TianDiTu map SDK opens this screen to display a map and, when allowed, center it on the device’s current or last known location. Apps can use it as a map view.
en.disableEffect: Map features that open this screen will no longer be available.

zh-CN.description: MoliHuan 天地图 SDK 会打开此页面显示地图，并在获得授权后将地图定位到设备当前位置或上次已知位置。应用可用它展示地图。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，使用此页面的地图功能将无法打开。

en.description: MoliHuan’s TianDiTu map SDK opens a map screen for choosing a location. It marks the chosen coordinates and keeps them available to the app.
en.disableEffect: Features that use this screen will no longer let the user choose a location on the map.

zh-CN.description: MoliHuan 天地图 SDK 会打开地图位置选择页面，在地图上标记所选坐标并保存供应用使用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，使用此页面的功能将无法在地图上选择位置。

en.description: Monaru's AnyMo Android SDK opens this page when the app requests an AnyMo screen and closes it when the user leaves.
en.disableEffect: AnyMo pages that the app relies on will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: Monaru 的 AnyMo Android SDK 会在应用请求 AnyMo 页面时打开此界面，并在用户离开时关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用依赖的 AnyMo 页面将无法打开。

en.description: The MozoCoin Mozo SDK opens this activity during account sign-in and authorization, displays its authentication page and returns the result to the app.
en.disableEffect: Users may not be able to sign in or complete Mozo account authorization.

zh-CN.description: MozoCoin 的 Mozo SDK 会在账户登录和授权期间打开此界面，显示认证页面并将结果返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户可能无法登录或完成 Mozo 账户授权。

en.description: The MozoCoin Mozo SDK runs this scheduled background service to watch network changes; it reconnects the wallet's live connection and refreshes contacts after service returns.
en.disableEffect: Live wallet updates and contact data may become stale after network changes.

zh-CN.description: MozoCoin 的 Mozo SDK 会通过此后台任务监测网络变化；网络恢复后重新连接钱包的实时服务并刷新联系人。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 网络变化后，钱包实时更新和联系人数据可能无法及时恢复。

en.description: The MozoCoin Mozo SDK opens this form when a user adds a wallet address to saved contacts; it checks and saves the contact.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to add an address from this contact flow.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Mozo 联系人中添加钱包地址时，MozoCoin 的 Mozo SDK 会打开此表单并验证、保存联系人。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此联系人流程添加地址。

en.description: The MozoCoin Mozo SDK displays saved wallet contacts, lets users search them and returns a selected address to the calling payment or transfer screen.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to choose a saved wallet address from the contact book.

zh-CN.description: MozoCoin 的 Mozo SDK 会显示已保存的钱包联系人，支持搜索，并将选中的地址返回付款或转账页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法从联系人列表中选择已保存的钱包地址。

en.description: From the Mozo address book, this screen requests permission to read phone contacts and imports them into the Mozo contact list.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to import phone contacts into Mozo.

zh-CN.description: 用户从 Mozo 通讯录选择导入时，此页面会请求读取手机联系人的权限，并将联系人导入 Mozo 列表。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法把手机联系人导入 Mozo。

en.description: The MozoCoin Mozo SDK opens this screen for a selected transaction or payment request, shows its details and offers Pay when the item is a payment request.
en.disableEffect: Users will lose transaction review and the follow-up payment action for a payment request.

zh-CN.description: MozoCoin 的 Mozo SDK 会在用户选择交易或付款请求时打开此页面，显示详细信息，并在请求付款时提供付款操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法查看交易详情，也无法从付款请求继续付款。

en.description: The MozoCoin Mozo SDK opens this transfer form so users can enter a recipient and amount, choose a saved contact or scan a code, then review and send the transaction.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to prepare or send a Mozo transfer.

zh-CN.description: MozoCoin 的 Mozo SDK 会打开此转账表单，供用户输入收款人和金额、选择联系人或扫描代码，然后确认并发送交易。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法准备或发送 Mozo 转账。

en.description: The MozoCoin Mozo SDK loads the wallet's sent and received transactions here and lets users filter the list and open a selected record.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to review their Mozo transaction history.

zh-CN.description: MozoCoin 的 Mozo SDK 会在此加载钱包的收款和转账记录，供用户筛选并打开所选交易。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法查看 Mozo 交易历史。

en.description: The MozoCoin Mozo SDK opens this payment-request flow so users can create a request for an amount, send it to a wallet address and see the result.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to create or send Mozo payment requests.

zh-CN.description: MozoCoin 的 Mozo SDK 会打开此付款请求流程，供用户填写金额、发送给钱包地址并查看结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法创建或发送 Mozo 付款请求。

en.description: When Mozo's service is under maintenance, this screen shows its status and tips and periodically checks whether service has resumed.
en.disableEffect: Users may miss the maintenance notice and the path back to the Mozo service.

zh-CN.description: Mozo 服务维护时，此页面会显示状态和提示，并定期检查服务是否恢复。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户可能看不到维护通知，也无法顺利返回 Mozo 服务。

en.description: The MozoCoin Mozo SDK opens this screen when one of its wallet flows needs a web page; it loads the supplied page inside the app and provides close and refresh controls.
en.disableEffect: Mozo features that rely on an in-app web page will not open.

zh-CN.description: MozoCoin 的 Mozo SDK 会在钱包流程需要网页时打开此页面，在应用内加载指定网页并提供关闭和刷新操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖应用内网页的 Mozo 功能将无法打开。

en.description: The MozoCoin Mozo SDK opens this camera screen when a user chooses to scan a code; it reads a barcode or QR value and returns it to the wallet flow.
en.disableEffect: Code scanning for Mozo wallet actions will no longer work.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择扫描代码时，MozoCoin 的 Mozo SDK 会打开此相机页面，读取条码或二维码内容并返回钱包流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Mozo 钱包操作中的代码扫描将无法使用。

en.description: The MozoCoin Mozo SDK opens this screen to verify or set a wallet PIN and to show or confirm recovery words during wallet setup or recovery.
en.disableEffect: Wallet unlock, PIN setup or recovery checks may fail.

zh-CN.description: MozoCoin 的 Mozo SDK 会在钱包设置或恢复时打开此页面，用于验证或设置 PIN，并显示或确认恢复词。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 钱包解锁、PIN 设置或恢复验证可能无法完成。

en.description: The MozoCoin Mozo SDK opens its wallet settings here, where users can change the security PIN, back up the wallet, manage cached data or delete the account.
en.disableEffect: Users will lose access to these wallet settings and security actions.

zh-CN.description: MozoCoin 的 Mozo SDK 会在此打开钱包设置，供用户更改安全 PIN、备份钱包、管理缓存或删除账户。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法访问这些钱包设置和安全操作。

en.description: The MozoCoin Mozo SDK opens this checklist to load wallet setup or account tasks and refresh their status; selecting a task continues to the required step.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to use the Mozo setup checklist and its follow-up actions.

zh-CN.description: MozoCoin 的 Mozo SDK 会打开此清单，加载钱包设置或账户任务并刷新状态；选择任务后会继续相应步骤。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法使用 Mozo 设置清单及其后续操作。

en.description: When Mozo requires a newer app version, this screen explains the update and opens the app's store listing.
en.disableEffect: Users will lose the Mozo update prompt and its store link.

zh-CN.description: Mozo 要求更新应用时，此页面会说明更新要求并打开应用商店页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将看不到 Mozo 更新提示及其商店入口。

en.description: The MozoCoin Mozo SDK opens this flow to confirm the current wallet PIN, choose a new PIN and save the change.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to change the wallet PIN.

zh-CN.description: MozoCoin 的 Mozo SDK 会打开此流程，先验证当前钱包 PIN，再设置并保存新 PIN。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法更改钱包 PIN。

en.description: After a user reviews a Mozo balance conversion, this screen confirms, submits and tracks the conversion transaction until it shows success or failure.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to submit or check the result of that conversion.

zh-CN.description: 用户确认 Mozo 余额转换后，此页面会提交并跟踪转换交易，直到显示成功或失败。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法提交该转换或查看其结果。

en.description: The MozoCoin Mozo SDK opens this form to prepare a conversion from the on-chain wallet balance to the in-app balance; it loads balances and network fee details before confirmation.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to prepare this Mozo balance-conversion route.

zh-CN.description: MozoCoin 的 Mozo SDK 会打开此表单，将链上钱包余额转换到应用内余额，并在确认前加载余额和网络费用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法准备此 Mozo 余额转换流程。

en.description: The MozoCoin Mozo SDK opens this form for a conversion between the wallet's on-chain and in-app balances; it loads the balance and network fee before the user continues.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to prepare this Mozo balance-conversion route.

zh-CN.description: MozoCoin 的 Mozo SDK 会打开此表单，在钱包链上余额与应用内余额之间进行转换，并在继续前加载余额和网络费用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法准备此 Mozo 余额转换流程。

en.description: The MozoCoin Mozo SDK backup flow displays wallet recovery words and asks the user to verify them before finishing.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to back up the wallet or confirm the backup.

zh-CN.description: MozoCoin 的 Mozo SDK 钱包备份流程会显示恢复词，并要求用户核对后才能完成。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法备份钱包或确认备份内容。

en.description: The MozoCoin Mozo SDK opens this flow when a user creates a wallet; it creates the wallet and continues to its security setup.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to create a Mozo wallet.

zh-CN.description: 用户创建钱包时，MozoCoin 的 Mozo SDK 会打开此流程，创建钱包并继续安全设置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法创建 Mozo 钱包。

en.description: The MozoCoin Mozo SDK opens this recovery flow when a user resets the wallet PIN; it asks for recovery words and then a new PIN.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to recover access by resetting the wallet PIN.

zh-CN.description: 用户重置钱包 PIN 时，MozoCoin 的 Mozo SDK 会打开此恢复流程，先验证恢复词，再设置新 PIN。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过重置 PIN 恢复钱包访问权限。

en.description: Nangos BeaconControl SDK opens the web page assigned to a beacon action, such as a URL or coupon, when that action is triggered.
en.disableEffect: Beacon-triggered URL and coupon pages will not open, and the associated action can fail.

zh-CN.description: Nangos BeaconControl SDK 会在信标触发已配置的操作（例如网址或优惠券）时打开相应网页。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，由信标触发的网址或优惠券页面将无法打开，相关操作也可能无法完成。

en.description: Nangos BeaconControl SDK processes actions when a configured beacon or zone trigger fires. It reports beacon entry and exit events and can open the URL or coupon page assigned to the action.
en.disableEffect: Beacon-triggered actions, including configured pages and beacon entry or exit reporting, will stop.

zh-CN.description: Nangos BeaconControl SDK 会在已配置的信标或区域触发操作时处理该事件。它会上报信标进入和离开范围的事件，并可打开操作对应的网址或优惠券页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，信标触发的操作将停止，包括打开已配置的页面和上报信标进入或离开范围的事件。

en.description: After Nangos BeaconControl SDK loads beacon settings, this Service provides the configured beacon list to the app so it can use the updated settings.
en.disableEffect: The app will not receive updated beacon lists from BeaconControl, so features that depend on that update will not refresh.

zh-CN.description: Nangos BeaconControl SDK 加载信标设置后，此 Service 会把配置的信标列表传给应用，以便应用使用最新设置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用将收不到 BeaconControl 更新的信标列表，依赖这些更新的功能也无法刷新。

en.description: Nangos BeaconControl SDK sends the app proximity and distance updates for monitored iBeacon devices, including when they enter or leave range.
en.disableEffect: The app will stop receiving beacon proximity updates, so features that react to a beacon becoming nearby or going out of range will no longer update.

zh-CN.description: Nangos BeaconControl SDK 会向应用发送受监控 iBeacon 设备的接近状态和距离更新，包括设备进入或离开范围时。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用将收不到信标接近状态更新，因此依赖信标靠近或离开范围的功能将不再更新。

en.description: Nangos BeaconControl SDK monitors its configured iBeacon devices while scanning is active. It detects when they enter or leave range and reports distance changes so configured actions can run.
en.disableEffect: Configured beacon detection will stop, along with the actions and proximity updates that depend on it.

zh-CN.description: Nangos BeaconControl SDK 会在扫描期间监测已配置的 iBeacon 设备。它检测设备进入或离开范围，并上报距离变化，以便运行已配置的操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，将无法检测已配置的信标，依赖信标的操作和接近状态更新也会停止。

en.description: When NearPay Connect or NearPay Master Connect starts a Bluetooth terminal session, this service lets the payment terminal connect to the app and exchange transaction details.
en.disableEffect: NearPay transactions over Bluetooth will not connect or exchange transaction data.

zh-CN.description: NearPay Connect 或 NearPay Master Connect 启动蓝牙终端会话时，此服务会让支付终端连接应用并交换交易信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用将无法通过蓝牙连接 NearPay 终端或传递交易信息。

en.description: When a NearPay Bluetooth terminal session needs Bluetooth turned on, this screen opens Android’s prompt to enable it.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot ask you to enable Bluetooth, so Bluetooth terminal setup may stop.

zh-CN.description: NearPay 蓝牙终端会话需要开启蓝牙时，此界面会打开 Android 的启用提示。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用无法提示你开启蓝牙，蓝牙终端连接可能无法继续。

en.description: During NearPay Bluetooth setup, this screen asks Android to allow the Bluetooth access needed for connecting; on older Android versions, it asks you to turn Bluetooth on.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot obtain the access it needs to connect to a terminal over Bluetooth.

zh-CN.description: NearPay 设置蓝牙连接时，此界面会向 Android 请求连接所需的蓝牙权限；在较旧的 Android 版本上，它会提示你开启蓝牙。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用无法取得蓝牙终端连接所需的权限。

en.description: When NearPay Connect or NearPay Master Connect starts a network terminal session, this service makes the phone available to the terminal for payment requests and sends transaction results back.
en.disableEffect: Network-based NearPay terminal sessions cannot exchange payment requests or results.

zh-CN.description: NearPay Connect 或 NearPay Master Connect 启动网络终端会话时，此服务会让终端能够向手机发送支付请求，并将交易结果传回。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用无法通过网络终端连接传递支付请求或结果。

en.description: When the app opens NearPay Connect’s connection panel, this screen shows the connection state and the available connect, stop, and unpair controls.
en.disableEffect: The NearPay connection screen and its connection controls will be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开 NearPay Connect 的连接面板时，此界面会显示连接状态，并提供连接、停止和取消配对等操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，NearPay 连接界面及其连接管理操作将无法使用。

en.description: When Android or another app requests a file through NearPay InstallPlugin, this provider shares it using the file paths configured for the plugin’s installation flow.
en.disableEffect: Android may be unable to access files passed through the NearPay plugin installation flow, which can prevent installation from completing.

zh-CN.description: Android 或其他应用通过 NearPay InstallPlugin 请求文件时，此提供程序会按插件安装流程配置的路径共享该文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Android 可能无法读取 NearPay 插件安装流程传递的文件，导致安装无法完成。

en.description: When Android reports the result of a NearPay InstallPlugin package installation, this receiver handles any required confirmation and reports whether installation succeeded.
en.disableEffect: The NearPay plugin installation flow may not receive confirmation or a final success or failure result.

zh-CN.description: Android 返回 NearPay InstallPlugin 的安装结果时，此接收器会处理所需的确认步骤，并报告安装是否成功。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，NearPay 插件安装流程可能收不到确认提示或最终的成功、失败结果。

en.description: When Android or another app requests a file through NearPay InstallPlugin, this provider shares it using the file paths configured for the plugin’s installation flow.
en.disableEffect: Android may be unable to access files passed through the NearPay plugin installation flow, which can prevent installation from completing.

zh-CN.description: Android 或其他应用通过 NearPay InstallPlugin 请求文件时，此提供程序会按插件安装流程配置的路径共享该文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Android 可能无法读取 NearPay 插件安装流程传递的文件，导致安装无法完成。

en.description: When an app starts NearPay InstallPlugin’s install flow, this screen guides the user through installing or updating the payment plugin and returns the result to the app.
en.disableEffect: The app may not be able to install or update the NearPay payment plugin it relies on.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动 NearPay InstallPlugin 安装流程时，此界面会引导用户安装或更新支付插件，并将结果返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用可能无法安装或更新其依赖的 NearPay 支付插件。

en.description: When NearPay Master Connect starts a Bluetooth terminal session, this service lets the payment terminal connect to the app and exchange transaction details.
en.disableEffect: NearPay transactions over Bluetooth will not connect or exchange transaction data.

zh-CN.description: NearPay Master Connect 启动蓝牙终端会话时，此服务会让支付终端连接应用并交换交易信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用将无法通过蓝牙连接 NearPay 终端或传递交易信息。

en.description: When a NearPay Master Connect Bluetooth session needs Bluetooth turned on, this screen opens Android’s prompt to enable it.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot ask you to enable Bluetooth, so Bluetooth terminal setup may stop.

zh-CN.description: NearPay Master Connect 的蓝牙会话需要开启蓝牙时，此界面会打开 Android 的启用提示。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用无法提示你开启蓝牙，蓝牙终端连接可能无法继续。

en.description: During NearPay Master Connect Bluetooth setup, this screen asks Android to allow the Bluetooth access needed for connecting; on older Android versions, it asks you to turn Bluetooth on.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot obtain the access it needs to connect to a terminal over Bluetooth.

zh-CN.description: NearPay Master Connect 设置蓝牙连接时，此界面会向 Android 请求连接所需的蓝牙权限；在较旧的 Android 版本上，它会提示你开启蓝牙。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用无法取得蓝牙终端连接所需的权限。

en.description: When NearPay Master Connect starts a network terminal session, this service makes the phone available to the terminal for payment requests and sends transaction results back.
en.disableEffect: Network-based NearPay terminal sessions cannot exchange payment requests or results.

zh-CN.description: NearPay Master Connect 启动网络终端会话时，此服务会让终端能够向手机发送支付请求，并将交易结果传回。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用无法通过网络终端连接传递支付请求或结果。

en.description: When NearPay Master Connect opens its connection panel, this screen shows the connection state and recovery options for the terminal session.
en.disableEffect: The NearPay Master Connect status and recovery screen will be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: NearPay Master Connect 打开连接面板时，此界面会显示终端会话状态和恢复连接的选项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，NearPay Master Connect 的状态和连接恢复界面将无法使用。

en.description: When NearPay Proxy v2 starts a terminal session, this service announces the app on the local network, receives payment requests, passes them to NearPay’s payment plugin, and returns the results.
en.disableEffect: A NearPay Proxy v2 terminal cannot discover the app or exchange payment requests and results with it.

zh-CN.description: NearPay Proxy v2 启动终端会话时，此服务会在本地网络中发布应用信息，接收支付请求，交由 NearPay 支付插件处理，再返回结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，NearPay Proxy v2 终端将无法发现应用，也无法与应用交换支付请求和结果。

en.description: When NearPay Proxy starts a terminal session, this service keeps the app available for payment requests from the connected terminal and sends the results back.
en.disableEffect: The NearPay Proxy network connection cannot exchange payment requests or results with a terminal.

zh-CN.description: NearPay Proxy 启动终端会话时，此服务会让应用能够接收连接终端的支付请求，并将处理结果传回。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，NearPay Proxy 无法通过网络连接与终端交换支付请求或结果。

en.description: When a NearPay Proxy v2 request needs the payment plugin, this activity passes the request to the plugin and returns its result to the proxy connection.
en.disableEffect: NearPay Proxy v2 requests cannot complete the handoff to the payment plugin.

zh-CN.description: NearPay Proxy v2 请求需要调用支付插件时，此界面会把请求交给插件处理，再将结果返回给代理连接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，NearPay Proxy v2 请求无法交由支付插件处理。

en.description: When the app opens NearPay Proxy’s connection panel, this screen shows the session state and the available controls for managing the connection.
en.disableEffect: The NearPay Proxy connection screen and its session controls will be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开 NearPay Proxy 的连接面板时，此界面会显示会话状态和可用的连接管理操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，NearPay Proxy 连接界面及会话管理操作将无法使用。

en.description: The NearPay SDK, including older NearPay Master Connect releases, uses this service for payment setup, purchases, refunds, reversals, reconciliation, and sign-out.
en.disableEffect: NearPay payment setup and the purchase, refund, reversal, and reconciliation flows will stop working.

zh-CN.description: NearPay SDK（包括旧版 NearPay Master Connect）通过此服务提供支付设置、消费、退款、撤销、对账和退出登录功能。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，NearPay 支付设置以及消费、退款、撤销和对账流程将无法使用。

en.description: When NearPay needs a printable web receipt, this activity loads the supplied receipt page and renders it as an image for the app.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot create the receipt image used for printing or sharing.

zh-CN.description: NearPay 需要生成可打印的网页收据时，此界面会加载收据页面并将其转换为应用可用的图片。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用无法生成用于打印或分享的收据图片。

en.description: When the NearPay SDK hands a payment request to its payment plugin, this activity passes the request along and returns the plugin’s result to the app.
en.disableEffect: Payment requests that rely on the NearPay payment plugin cannot complete.

zh-CN.description: NearPay SDK 将支付请求交给支付插件处理时，此界面会转交请求，并把插件返回的结果交还给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，依赖 NearPay 支付插件的支付请求将无法完成。

en.description: When NearPay sends the user through its app-store installation flow, this screen guides the user to install or update the required payment plugin.
en.disableEffect: The app may not be able to guide the user through installing or updating its NearPay payment plugin.

zh-CN.description: NearPay 启动应用商店安装流程时，此界面会引导用户安装或更新所需的支付插件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用可能无法引导用户安装或更新 NearPay 支付插件。

en.description: After NearPay opens an app store to install the payment plugin, this receiver reports when Android detects that the package has been added.
en.disableEffect: The NearPay install flow may not be told that the store installation completed.

zh-CN.description: NearPay 打开应用商店安装支付插件后，Android 检测到软件包已添加时，此接收器会通知安装流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，NearPay 安装流程可能无法获知应用商店已完成安装。

en.description: When the NearPay SDK starts its required-component installation flow, this screen shows the install prompt and reports whether the process completed.
en.disableEffect: The app may be unable to complete the NearPay component setup required by its payment flow.

zh-CN.description: NearPay SDK 启动所需组件的安装流程时，此界面会显示安装提示，并报告流程是否完成。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用可能无法完成支付流程所需的 NearPay 组件设置。

en.description: When Android returns the result of an APK installation started by NearPay, this receiver handles any required confirmation and reports success or failure to the install flow.
en.disableEffect: NearPay may not receive the confirmation or final result needed to complete its installation flow.

zh-CN.description: Android 返回 NearPay 发起的 APK 安装结果时，此接收器会处理所需确认，并向安装流程报告成功或失败。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，NearPay 可能无法收到完成安装流程所需的确认或最终结果。

en.description: When the NearPay SDK needs to install its payment component, this screen presents the localized setup flow and reports the outcome to the app.
en.disableEffect: The app may not be able to finish installing the NearPay component needed for payments.

zh-CN.description: NearPay SDK 需要安装支付组件时，此界面会显示本地化的设置流程，并向应用返回结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用可能无法完成支付所需的 NearPay 组件安装。

en.description: When Android or another app requests a file through the NearPay SDK, this provider shares it using the file paths configured for the SDK’s install flow.
en.disableEffect: Android may be unable to access files passed through the NearPay installation flow, which can block setup or installation.

zh-CN.description: Android 或其他应用通过 NearPay SDK 请求文件时，此提供程序会按 SDK 安装流程配置的路径共享该文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Android 可能无法读取 NearPay 安装流程传递的文件，导致设置或安装受阻。

en.description: When the NearPay SDK creates a reconciliation receipt, this activity lays out the merchant and settlement details and renders the receipt as an image.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot create a printable or shareable image of the reconciliation receipt.

zh-CN.description: NearPay SDK 生成对账收据时，此界面会排版商户和结算信息，并将收据转换为图片。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用无法生成可打印或分享的对账收据图片。

en.description: When the NearPay SDK needs a transaction receipt image, this activity lays out the merchant and payment details and returns the rendered image to the app.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot create a printable or shareable image of the transaction receipt.

zh-CN.description: NearPay SDK 需要交易收据图片时，此界面会排版商户和支付信息，并将生成的图片返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用无法生成可打印或分享的交易收据图片。

en.description: When Android reports the result of a NearPay SDK installation, this receiver handles any required confirmation and reports success or failure to the install flow.
en.disableEffect: NearPay may not receive the confirmation or final result needed to complete its installation flow.

zh-CN.description: Android 返回 NearPay SDK 的安装结果时，此接收器会处理所需确认，并向安装流程报告成功或失败。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，NearPay 可能无法收到完成安装流程所需的确认或最终结果。

en.description: When Android reports the result of an early NearPay SDK installation, this receiver handles any required confirmation and reports success or failure to the install flow.
en.disableEffect: NearPay may not receive the confirmation or final result needed to complete its installation flow.

zh-CN.description: Android 返回早期 NearPay SDK 安装结果时，此接收器会处理所需确认，并向安装流程报告成功或失败。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，NearPay 可能无法收到完成安装流程所需的确认或最终结果。

en.description: When the NearPay SDK hands a payment request to its payment plugin, this activity passes the request along and returns the plugin’s result to the app.
en.disableEffect: Payment requests that rely on the NearPay payment plugin cannot complete.

zh-CN.description: NearPay SDK 将支付请求交给支付插件处理时，此界面会转交请求，并把插件返回的结果交还给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，依赖 NearPay 支付插件的支付请求将无法完成。

en.description: When a nearby NFC reader requests a URL shared by NearPay, this service makes the URL available for the reader to open.
en.disableEffect: NearPay’s NFC URL-sharing feature will no longer work.

zh-CN.description: 附近的 NFC 读取设备请求 NearPay 分享的网址时，此服务会将网址提供给设备读取。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，NearPay 的 NFC 网址分享功能将无法使用。

en.description: When NearPay InstallPlugin starts its app-store installation flow, this screen guides the user to install the required payment plugin.
en.disableEffect: The app may not be able to guide the user through installing the NearPay payment plugin.

zh-CN.description: NearPay InstallPlugin 启动应用商店安装流程时，此界面会引导用户安装所需的支付插件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用可能无法引导用户安装 NearPay 支付插件。

en.description: After NearPay InstallPlugin opens an app store, this receiver reports when Android detects that the payment plugin package has been added.
en.disableEffect: The NearPay InstallPlugin flow may not be told that the store installation completed.

zh-CN.description: NearPay InstallPlugin 打开应用商店后，Android 检测到支付插件软件包已添加时，此接收器会通知安装流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，NearPay InstallPlugin 流程可能无法获知应用商店已完成安装。

en.description: CoinBrix's Singularity SDK shows its account page inside the app when the app starts Singularity sign-in or receives an account sign-in link. Users sign in there, and returned account credentials are passed back to the SDK.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot complete Singularity sign-in or process its account sign-in return.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动 Singularity 登录或收到账户登录回跳链接时，CoinBrix 的 Singularity SDK 会在应用内显示账户页面。用户在此登录，回跳凭据会交回 SDK 继续处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 屏蔽后，应用无法完成 Singularity 登录或处理登录回跳。
