en.description: CoinBrix's Singularity SDK uses this screen when the app submits a transaction request to Singularity. It sends the transaction request for processing.
en.disableEffect: Transactions submitted through Singularity's app flow will not be processed.

zh-CN.description: 应用向 Singularity 提交交易请求时，CoinBrix 的 Singularity SDK 会使用此页面，并将交易请求发送给 Singularity 处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 屏蔽后，应用通过 Singularity 提交的交易将无法处理。

en.description: When an app requests activity recognition through Smart Location Library, Google Play services starts this service with detected-activity updates, which it forwards to the app.
en.disableEffect: The app will stop receiving the activity-recognition updates it uses.

zh-CN.description: 应用通过 Smart Location Library 请求活动识别时，Google Play 服务会启动此服务并传入识别结果，再由它转发给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用将无法收到所使用的活动识别更新。

en.description: When an app requests a place-name or address lookup through Smart Location Library, this service uses Android’s built-in address lookup feature and sends matching addresses back to the app.
en.disableEffect: Address searches based on place names or coordinates will no longer return results to the app.

zh-CN.description: 应用通过 Smart Location Library 查询地点或地址时，此服务会使用 Android 内置的地址查询功能，并将匹配的地址返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用将无法取得按地点名称或坐标查询的地址结果。

en.description: When Google Play services reports a registered location-boundary event, this service forwards the affected boundary, transition, and triggering location to the app.
en.disableEffect: The app will stop receiving the location-boundary events it uses for alerts or automation.

zh-CN.description: Google Play 服务报告已注册的地理围栏事件时，此服务会将对应围栏、状态变化和触发位置转发给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用将无法收到用于提醒或自动化功能的地理围栏事件。

en.description: When the ObjectBox Admin database browser is opened, this foreground service keeps it available in the background and shows a notification with open and stop controls.
en.disableEffect: The Admin browser may stop staying open in the background, while the app's database continues to work.

zh-CN.description: 打开 ObjectBox Admin 数据浏览器后，此服务会让它在应用切到后台时继续运行，并显示可打开或停止浏览器的通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Admin 浏览器可能无法在后台保持运行，但应用自身的数据库仍可使用。

en.description: When ObjectBox Admin signals that its database browser should stay open, this receiver opens the browser and starts its background notification.
en.disableEffect: ObjectBox Admin cannot be opened through this signal or kept alive in the background; the app's database remains available.

zh-CN.description: ObjectBox Admin 发出保持数据库浏览器运行的信号时，此接收器会打开浏览器并启动后台通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，无法通过此信号打开或在后台保持 ObjectBox Admin；应用数据库仍可使用。

en.description: When a Kujaku map screen is opened with a Mapbox access token, it displays an interactive map, can focus on the user's location, and can return map points the user adds.
en.disableEffect: The app's Kujaku map and map-point selection screen will not open.

zh-CN.description: 应用使用 Mapbox 访问令牌打开 Kujaku 地图时，此界面会显示可交互地图、定位到用户所在位置，并可返回用户添加的地图点。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用中的 Kujaku 地图和地图点选择界面将无法打开。

en.description: When network access returns, this Kujaku receiver resumes offline map downloads that were paused while the device was disconnected.
en.disableEffect: An offline map download paused by a lost connection may not resume automatically.

zh-CN.description: 网络恢复时，Kujaku 会通过此接收器继续因断网而暂停的离线地图下载。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 因断网而暂停的离线地图下载可能无法自动继续。

en.description: When the app saves a map for offline use, this Kujaku service downloads and manages its Mapbox map tiles, including queued, paused, and completed downloads.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to download or manage maps for offline use.

zh-CN.description: 应用保存离线地图时，Kujaku 会通过此服务下载并管理 Mapbox 地图瓦片，包括排队、暂停和完成的下载。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法下载或管理供离线使用的地图。

en.description: When an app requests continuous location tracking for a Kujaku map or check-in, this foreground service collects GPS updates and provides them to tracking listeners.
en.disableEffect: Ongoing GPS updates stop, so map features that depend on continuous location tracking no longer work.

zh-CN.description: 应用为 Kujaku 地图或签到功能请求持续定位时，此前台服务会获取 GPS 更新并提供给位置监听程序。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 持续 GPS 更新将停止，依赖连续定位的地图功能也将无法使用。

en.description: When a user opens help or password recovery from a Brick bank or e-wallet screen, this Activity shows the supplied support page inside the app.
en.disableEffect: Users lose the in-app help and password-recovery pages during account linking.

zh-CN.description: 用户从 Brick 银行或电子钱包界面打开帮助或找回密码时，此界面会在应用内显示相应支持页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 账户关联流程中的应用内帮助和找回密码页面将无法使用。

en.description: After a user selects a personal bank in Brick's institution list, this screen collects the bank login details and submits them for account verification, then continues to any extra verification the bank requires.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot sign in to connect a personal bank account through Brick.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Brick 机构列表中选择个人银行后，此界面会收集银行登录信息并提交验证，然后继续该银行要求的额外验证步骤。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 Brick 登录并关联个人银行账户。

en.description: When a selected bank requires a corporate login, this Brick screen collects the corporate ID, user ID, and password or token and submits them for verification.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot complete the corporate-bank login and account connection.

zh-CN.description: 所选银行要求企业登录时，此 Brick 界面会收集企业编号、用户编号和密码或令牌并提交验证。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法完成企业银行登录和账户关联。

en.description: Brick's bank and e-wallet screens share this base screen for their navigation controls, language selector, and status messages.
en.disableEffect: Brick account-linking screens may fail to open correctly or lose their shared navigation and status controls.

zh-CN.description: Brick 的银行和电子钱包界面共用此基础界面，以提供导航按钮、语言选择和状态提示。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Brick 账户关联界面可能无法正常打开，或失去共用的导航和状态控件。

en.description: When a bank requests an additional verification step during Brick account linking, this screen accepts the PIN or one-time code and can request a replacement code.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot complete the bank's additional verification step or finish linking the account.

zh-CN.description: Brick 关联账户时，银行要求额外验证后，此界面会接收 PIN 或一次性验证码，也可重新请求验证码。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法完成银行的额外验证步骤或关联账户。

en.description: After Brick successfully connects a bank or e-wallet account, this screen confirms the connection and lets the user return to the app or connect another account.
en.disableEffect: Users may be unable to finish the connection flow or return its completed account result to the app.

zh-CN.description: Brick 成功关联银行或电子钱包账户后，此界面会确认关联结果，并允许用户返回应用或继续关联其他账户。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户可能无法完成关联流程，或无法将已关联账户的结果返回应用。

en.description: When the host app starts Brick's account-linking flow, this screen explains the requested access to account information and asks the user to grant permission before choosing an institution.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot grant access or begin Brick's bank and e-wallet selection flow.

zh-CN.description: 宿主应用启动 Brick 账户关联流程时，此界面会说明读取账户信息的用途，并请用户授权后再选择机构。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法授权，也无法开始选择 Brick 银行或电子钱包。

en.description: When Shopee requires a phone verification link during Brick account linking, this screen asks the user to open that link and submit the verification to finish connecting the account.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot submit the final Shopee verification step or complete that account connection.

zh-CN.description: Brick 关联 Shopee 账户时若需要手机验证链接，此界面会提示用户打开链接并提交验证以完成关联。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法提交 Shopee 的最后验证步骤，也无法完成该账户关联。

en.description: After Brick accepts a request to add a missing bank or institution, this screen confirms that the request was submitted and offers a return to the institution list.
en.disableEffect: The add-institution request flow may fail before users see confirmation or return to the institution list.

zh-CN.description: Brick 接受新增缺失银行或机构的请求后，此界面会确认请求已提交，并提供返回机构列表的选项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 新增机构请求流程可能在显示确认信息或返回机构列表前失败。

en.description: When users cannot find a bank or institution in Brick's list, this form collects its name and category and submits a request to add it.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot request that Brick add an institution missing from its list.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Brick 列表中找不到银行或机构时，此表单会收集机构名称和类别并提交新增请求。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法请求 Brick 添加列表中缺失的机构。

en.description: This Brick account-linking screen confirms a successful connection and lets the user finish or choose another institution to connect.
en.disableEffect: The success and next-step screen for this account-linking flow will not open.

zh-CN.description: 此 Brick 账户关联界面会确认关联成功，并允许用户结束流程或继续选择其他机构。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 此账户关联流程的成功提示和后续选项界面将无法打开。

en.description: When a Brick e-wallet connection requires a PIN and verification link, this screen collects both and submits them to verify the account.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot complete the PIN and verification step needed to connect that e-wallet.

zh-CN.description: Brick 关联电子钱包需要 PIN 和验证链接时，此界面会收集两者并提交账户验证。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法完成关联该电子钱包所需的 PIN 和验证步骤。

en.description: After a user selects an e-wallet in Brick, this screen asks for the phone number registered with that provider and requests the next verification step.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot start phone-based verification or connect that e-wallet through Brick.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Brick 中选择电子钱包后，此界面会要求填写该服务登记的手机号并请求下一步验证。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法开始手机号验证，也无法通过 Brick 关联该电子钱包。

en.description: When an e-wallet sends a one-time code during Brick account linking, this screen accepts the code and submits it to complete verification.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot submit the e-wallet verification code or finish linking that account.

zh-CN.description: Brick 关联电子钱包时，服务发送一次性验证码后，此界面会接收验证码并提交完成验证。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法提交电子钱包验证码或完成账户关联。

en.description: After the user grants Brick access, this screen loads a searchable, category-filtered list of banks and e-wallets; selecting one opens its connection steps.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot select a bank or e-wallet to connect, or add another institution to the current flow.

zh-CN.description: 用户授权 Brick 后，此界面会加载可搜索并按类别筛选的银行和电子钱包列表；选择机构后会打开相应关联步骤。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法选择银行或电子钱包进行关联，也无法在当前流程中添加其他机构。

en.description: When an OpenRemote client has no network connection, this screen displays the offline page and waits for connectivity to return, then closes so the app can continue.
en.disableEffect: The app's offline screen and its automatic return after reconnection will not work.

zh-CN.description: OpenRemote 客户端断网时，此界面会显示离线页面并等待网络恢复，恢复后自动关闭以便继续使用应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用的离线提示页面及联网后的自动返回功能将无法使用。

en.description: When a user taps a Passworks Lighthouse beacon notification, this service opens its linked page, image, or pass, or sends its configured response, then records the interaction.
en.disableEffect: Tapping a beacon notification will no longer open its content or complete its associated action.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击 Passworks Lighthouse 信标通知时，此服务会打开关联页面、图片或通行证，或发送配置的响应，然后记录此次互动。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 点击信标通知将无法打开关联内容或完成相应操作。

en.description: When a Piano ID sign-in or sign-up is requested, this screen loads Piano's identity page and returns the authentication result to the app.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot sign in or create an account through Piano ID.

zh-CN.description: 请求 Piano ID 登录或注册时，此界面会加载 Piano 身份页面并将认证结果返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 Piano ID 登录或创建账户。

en.description: During a Piano OAuth login, this screen displays Piano's hosted account-login page and returns the access result to the app.
en.disableEffect: The Piano login and its access handoff to the app cannot complete.

zh-CN.description: 进行 Piano OAuth 登录时，此界面会显示 Piano 托管的账户登录页面，并将访问结果返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Piano 登录及其向应用返回访问结果的流程将无法完成。

en.description: In the older Piano ID OAuth flow, this screen displays the authorization page and returns the user's token when Piano redirects back.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot complete this older Piano ID OAuth sign-in flow.

zh-CN.description: 在较旧的 Piano ID OAuth 流程中，此界面会显示授权页面，并在 Piano 重定向返回时交还用户令牌。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法完成较旧的 Piano ID OAuth 登录流程。

en.description: When the browser returns from Piano ID sign-in, this screen receives the redirect and passes the sign-in result back to the app.
en.disableEffect: The browser-based Piano ID sign-in cannot return its result to the app.

zh-CN.description: 浏览器完成 Piano ID 登录并返回时，此界面会接收重定向并将登录结果交还应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 浏览器中的 Piano ID 登录结果将无法返回应用。

en.description: For older Piano ID browser sign-ins, this screen watches for the return page and hands the resulting token back to the app.
en.disableEffect: The legacy browser sign-in cannot return its authentication result to the app.

zh-CN.description: 较旧的 Piano ID 浏览器登录使用此界面监听返回页面，并将生成的令牌交还应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 旧版浏览器登录流程将无法把认证结果返回应用。

en.description: When Firebase issues a refreshed registration token, the Pivotal Cloud Foundry Push SDK updates the app's push registration with it.
en.disableEffect: Push delivery may stop after Firebase refreshes the registration token.

zh-CN.description: Firebase 更新推送注册令牌时，Pivotal Cloud Foundry Push SDK 会用新令牌更新应用的推送注册。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Firebase 更新注册令牌后，推送消息可能无法继续送达。

en.description: When its scheduled alarm fires, this Pivotal Push receiver starts the job that sends queued analytics events, if analytics are enabled.
en.disableEffect: Queued Pivotal analytics events will not be sent on schedule.

zh-CN.description: 计划闹钟触发时，如果启用了分析功能，此 Pivotal Push 接收器会启动发送排队分析事件的任务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 排队的 Pivotal 分析事件将无法按计划发送。

en.description: After the device restarts, this Pivotal Cloud Foundry Push receiver restores configured geofences and prepares analytics work when enabled.
en.disableEffect: Pivotal geofences and scheduled analytics work may not be restored after a device restart.

zh-CN.description: 设备重启后，此 Pivotal Cloud Foundry Push 接收器会恢复已配置的地理围栏，并在启用时准备分析任务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 设备重启后，Pivotal 地理围栏和计划分析任务可能无法恢复。

en.description: When Pivotal Push queues analytics work, this background service prepares its event store and processes jobs that send those events to Pivotal.
en.disableEffect: Pivotal analytics events will not be processed or uploaded.

zh-CN.description: Pivotal Push 将分析任务加入队列后，此后台服务会准备事件存储并处理向 Pivotal 发送事件的任务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Pivotal 分析事件将无法处理或上传。

en.description: In apps using legacy Google Cloud Messaging with Pivotal Push, this service receives push messages and geofence updates and forwards their data to the app's handlers.
en.disableEffect: Legacy Pivotal push messages and their geofence events will no longer be delivered to the app.

zh-CN.description: 使用旧版 Google Cloud Messaging 与 Pivotal Push 的应用，会通过此服务接收推送消息和地理围栏更新，并将数据交给应用处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 旧版 Pivotal 推送消息及其地理围栏事件将无法送达应用。

en.description: When Pivotal Push receives a geofence update or entry or exit event, this service processes it and passes the event details to the app's geofence handlers.
en.disableEffect: Pivotal location-triggered push events will not be processed or delivered to the app.

zh-CN.description: Pivotal Push 收到地理围栏更新或进入、离开事件时，此服务会处理事件并将详情交给应用的地理围栏处理程序。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Pivotal 基于位置触发的推送事件将无法处理或送达应用。

en.description: When the app queues an Arca background operation, this service schedules it and runs or cancels the requested data work outside the current screen.
en.disableEffect: App data operations queued for background work may not run or finish.

zh-CN.description: 应用将 Arca 后台操作加入队列时，此服务会安排并执行或取消相应数据任务，使其不依赖当前界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 加入后台队列的应用数据操作可能无法运行或完成。

en.description: When the app starts or cancels an Arca operation, this service runs the associated data request or processing work and reports its state.
en.disableEffect: App operations that rely on this service may not run, complete, or report their status.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动或取消 Arca 操作时，此服务会运行关联的数据请求或处理任务并报告其状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此服务的应用操作可能无法运行、完成或报告状态。

en.description: PokPay's RPAY checkout SDK uses this Activity for its checkout screen and payment return links; it displays the checkout flow and returns the result to the app.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents RPAY checkout from opening, so users may be unable to pay in the app.

zh-CN.description: PokPay 的 RPAY 结账 SDK 会在打开支付页面或处理支付返回链接时使用此 Activity；它显示结账流程并把结果交回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，RPAY 结账页面无法打开，用户可能无法在应用内完成付款。

en.description: The PoloBustillo Document Scanner library opens this camera screen when the app starts a scan. It captures one or more pages, detects document edges, lets the user adjust the crop, and returns the cropped images.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot open this document scanning flow, so users cannot scan and return documents through this library.

zh-CN.description: 应用开始扫描时，PoloBustillo 的 Document Scanner 库会打开此相机页面。它可以拍摄一页或多页文档、识别文档边缘、让用户调整裁剪范围，并返回裁剪后的图像。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法打开此文档扫描流程，用户也无法通过该库扫描并返回文档。

en.description: The PoloBustillo Document Scanner library uses this provider when it opens Android camera capture, giving the camera app a temporary file location for each page photo.
en.disableEffect: The camera cannot save captured pages back to the scanner, so the document scanning flow fails.

zh-CN.description: PoloBustillo 的 Document Scanner 库启动 Android 相机拍照时，会使用这个文件提供器为每页照片提供临时保存位置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 相机无法将拍摄的页面保存回扫描流程，因此文档扫描会失败。

en.description: When an Ogury (ExploreStack) ad flow opens its terms screen, this translucent screen displays the terms content supplied by Ogury (ExploreStack).
en.disableEffect: Ogury’s terms screen and any ad flow that requires it will not open; the host app’s other features remain available.

zh-CN.description: Ogury（ExploreStack）广告流程需要展示条款时，会打开此半透明页面显示 Ogury（ExploreStack）提供的条款内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Ogury 条款页面及依赖它的广告流程将无法打开，但应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: Ogury (ExploreStack)’s background service handles scheduled profile and settings work. When enabled by its configuration, it observes app installations, network or screen changes, and syncs selected installed-app, app-use, IP, or account data.
en.disableEffect: Ogury’s background profile and settings updates will stop, while the host app’s own features remain available.

zh-CN.description: Ogury（ExploreStack）的后台服务负责定时处理用户画像和设置任务。配置启用相关功能时，它会关注应用安装、网络或屏幕状态变化，并同步选定的已安装应用、应用使用情况、IP 或账户数据。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Ogury 的后台用户画像和设置更新将停止，但应用自身的功能仍可使用。

en.description: When an Ogury (ExploreStack) scheduled alarm fires, this receiver starts the background settings refresh.
en.disableEffect: Ogury will no longer refresh settings from its scheduled alarm; the host app’s other features remain available.

zh-CN.description: Ogury（ExploreStack）定时闹钟触发时，此接收器会启动后台设置更新。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Ogury 将无法通过定时闹钟更新设置，但应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: When Android runs an Ogury (ExploreStack) scheduled job, this service refreshes Ogury (ExploreStack)’s remote settings and completes the job.
en.disableEffect: Ogury’s scheduled settings refresh will stop; the host app’s other features remain available.

zh-CN.description: Android 执行 Ogury（ExploreStack）的定时任务时，此服务会更新 Ogury（ExploreStack）的远程设置并结束任务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Ogury 的定时设置更新将停止，但应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: Ogury (ExploreStack) starts this background service from an alarm or scheduled job to refresh its remote settings.
en.disableEffect: Ogury’s background settings refresh will stop; the host app’s other features remain available.

zh-CN.description: Ogury（ExploreStack）会由定时闹钟或系统任务启动此后台服务，以更新远程设置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Ogury 的后台设置更新将停止，但应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: After checking whether the app has been idle, the Ogury (Presage) ad SDK briefly opens this transparent Activity as a background helper; it closes itself shortly afterward.
en.disableEffect: Blocking it stops this Ogury background check from opening its helper screen and may reduce SDK tracking or ad maintenance; the app's own screens continue to work.

zh-CN.description: 检查应用是否长时间未活动后，Ogury（Presage）广告 SDK 会短暂打开这个透明 Activity 作为后台辅助界面，随后自动关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，Ogury 无法打开此辅助界面完成后台检查，SDK 的统计或广告维护可能减少；应用自身界面仍可使用。

en.description: The Ogury (Presage) ad SDK uses this Receiver when its scheduled alarm fires. It runs a periodic SDK task and schedules the next alarm.
en.disableEffect: Ogury will miss this background signal for its ads and analytics; the app's own features remain available.

zh-CN.description: Ogury（Presage）广告 SDK 在定时任务触发时使用此接收器。它启动一次周期性 SDK 任务，并安排下一次运行。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，Ogury 将无法收到这类广告和统计后台信号；应用本身的功能仍可使用。

en.description: When Android reports a Bluetooth device connection change or USB accessory removal, this Ogury (Presage) Receiver forwards the event to the SDK's background ad and analytics work.
en.disableEffect: Ogury will miss this background signal for its ads and analytics; the app's own features remain available.

zh-CN.description: Android 报告蓝牙设备连接状态变化或 USB 配件移除时，Ogury（Presage）接收器会将此事件交给 SDK 的广告和统计后台任务处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，Ogury 将无法收到这类广告和统计后台信号；应用本身的功能仍可使用。

en.description: When the device finishes booting, this Ogury (Presage) Receiver sends a startup signal to the SDK's background ad and analytics work.
en.disableEffect: Ogury will miss this background signal for its ads and analytics; the app's own features remain available.

zh-CN.description: 设备启动完成时，Ogury（Presage）接收器会向 SDK 的广告和统计后台任务发送启动信号。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，Ogury 将无法收到这类广告和统计后台信号；应用本身的功能仍可使用。

en.description: When Android reports a mobile carrier configuration change, this Ogury (Presage) Receiver forwards the update to the SDK's background processing.
en.disableEffect: Ogury will miss this background signal for its ads and analytics; the app's own features remain available.

zh-CN.description: Android 报告移动运营商配置发生变化时，Ogury（Presage）接收器会将更新交给 SDK 后台处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，Ogury 将无法收到这类广告和统计后台信号；应用本身的功能仍可使用。

en.description: When an Android calendar reminder fires, this Ogury (Presage) Receiver forwards the event to the SDK's background processing.
en.disableEffect: Ogury will miss this background signal for its ads and analytics; the app's own features remain available.

zh-CN.description: Android 日历提醒触发时，Ogury（Presage）接收器会将此事件交给 SDK 后台处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，Ogury 将无法收到这类广告和统计后台信号；应用本身的功能仍可使用。

en.description: When the device's next scheduled alarm changes, this Ogury (Presage) Receiver forwards the update to the SDK's background processing.
en.disableEffect: Ogury will miss this background signal for its ads and analytics; the app's own features remain available.

zh-CN.description: 设备的下一次闹钟时间发生变化时，Ogury（Presage）接收器会将更新交给 SDK 后台处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，Ogury 将无法收到这类广告和统计后台信号；应用本身的功能仍可使用。

en.description: When Android reports that an installed package has been completely removed, this Ogury (Presage) Receiver forwards the event to the SDK's background processing.
en.disableEffect: Ogury will miss this background signal for its ads and analytics; the app's own features remain available.

zh-CN.description: Android 报告某个已安装软件包已彻底移除时，Ogury（Presage）接收器会将此事件交给 SDK 后台处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，Ogury 将无法收到这类广告和统计后台信号；应用本身的功能仍可使用。

en.description: When the device's system time is changed, this Ogury (Presage) Receiver forwards the update to the SDK's background processing.
en.disableEffect: Ogury will miss this background signal for its ads and analytics; the app's own features remain available.

zh-CN.description: 设备系统时间被更改时，Ogury（Presage）接收器会将更新交给 SDK 后台处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，Ogury 将无法收到这类广告和统计后台信号；应用本身的功能仍可使用。

en.description: When the user returns to or unlocks the device, this Ogury (Presage) Receiver sends a signal to the SDK's background work.
en.disableEffect: Ogury will miss this background signal for its ads and analytics; the app's own features remain available.

zh-CN.description: 用户返回设备或解锁设备时，Ogury（Presage）接收器会向 SDK 后台任务发送信号。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，Ogury 将无法收到这类广告和统计后台信号；应用本身的功能仍可使用。

en.description: Android starts this Ogury (Presage) Service for scheduled background work that may wait until the user returns to the device.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it stops or limits Ogury's background ad and analytics work; the host app's own screens and features remain available.

zh-CN.description: Android 会为 Ogury（Presage）的定时后台任务启动此服务；部分任务会等到用户重新使用设备时再继续。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，Ogury 的广告和统计后台任务会停止或受限；应用本身的界面和功能仍可使用。

en.description: Android starts this Ogury (Presage) Service for scheduled SDK work. It processes the task and tells Android when the job is finished.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it stops or limits Ogury's background ad and analytics work; the host app's own screens and features remain available.

zh-CN.description: Android 会为定时 SDK 任务启动此 Ogury（Presage）服务。它处理任务，并在完成后通知 Android。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，Ogury 的广告和统计后台任务会停止或受限；应用本身的界面和功能仍可使用。

en.description: Ogury (Presage) starts this Service for its background advertising and analytics work. It can also handle SDK work when the screen turns off.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it stops or limits Ogury's background ad and analytics work; the host app's own screens and features remain available.

zh-CN.description: Ogury（Presage）会启动此服务来处理广告和统计后台任务。屏幕熄灭时，它也可继续处理 SDK 任务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，Ogury 的广告和统计后台任务会停止或受限；应用本身的界面和功能仍可使用。

en.description: When an Ogury (ExploreStack) interstitial ad is ready, this full-screen page displays the ad creative and handles orientation and closing.
en.disableEffect: Ogury interstitial ads will not open; the host app’s other features remain available.

zh-CN.description: Ogury（ExploreStack）插屏广告准备好后，会打开此全屏页面展示广告并处理屏幕方向与关闭操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Ogury 插屏广告将无法打开，但应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: On Android 8, Ogury (ExploreStack) uses this orientation-aware screen for regular full-screen interstitial ads.
en.disableEffect: This Ogury interstitial format will not display; the host app’s other features remain available.

zh-CN.description: 在 Android 8 上，Ogury（ExploreStack）会用此可适配方向的页面显示普通全屏插屏广告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 此类 Ogury 插屏广告将无法显示，但应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: On Android 8, Ogury (ExploreStack) uses this translucent screen for interstitial ads designed to appear over the app.
en.disableEffect: This Ogury interstitial format will not display; the host app’s other features remain available.

zh-CN.description: 在 Android 8 上，Ogury（ExploreStack）会用此半透明页面显示需要覆盖在应用界面上的插屏广告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 此类 Ogury 插屏广告将无法显示，但应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: When an Ogury (ExploreStack) interstitial is ready, this screen displays its full-screen ad creative and handles ad display events.
en.disableEffect: Ogury interstitial ads will not open; the host app’s other features remain available.

zh-CN.description: Ogury（ExploreStack）插屏广告准备好后，此页面会展示全屏广告内容并处理广告播放事件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Ogury 插屏广告将无法打开，但应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: On Android 8, Ogury (ExploreStack) uses this orientation-aware screen for regular full-screen interstitial ads.
en.disableEffect: This Ogury interstitial format will not display; the host app’s other features remain available.

zh-CN.description: 在 Android 8 上，Ogury（ExploreStack）会用此可适配方向的页面显示普通全屏插屏广告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 此类 Ogury 插屏广告将无法显示，但应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: On Android 8, Ogury (ExploreStack) uses this translucent screen for interstitial ads designed to appear over the app.
en.disableEffect: This Ogury interstitial format will not display; the host app’s other features remain available.

zh-CN.description: 在 Android 8 上，Ogury（ExploreStack）会用此半透明页面显示需要覆盖在应用界面上的插屏广告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 此类 Ogury 插屏广告将无法显示，但应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: Ogury (Presage) uses this Activity to open a saved home-screen shortcut for an ad experience. When someone taps the shortcut, it loads that experience in the SDK's browser.
en.disableEffect: The Ogury ad shortcut will no longer open its linked experience if this Activity is disabled.

zh-CN.description: Ogury（Presage）会用此 Activity 打开广告体验创建的主屏幕快捷方式。用户点按快捷方式时，它会在 SDK 浏览器中加载对应内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用此 Activity 后，Ogury 广告快捷方式将无法打开对应内容。

en.description: When a user taps a home-screen shortcut created by an Ogury (ExploreStack) ad, this screen opens the shortcut’s interactive ad page inside the app.
en.disableEffect: Ogury ad shortcuts will no longer open their content; the host app’s other features remain available.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击 Ogury（ExploreStack）广告创建的桌面快捷方式时，此页面会在应用内打开对应的互动广告内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Ogury 广告快捷方式将无法打开其内容，但应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: When an Ogury (ExploreStack) timer sends a task, this receiver forwards it to Ogury (ExploreStack)’s background service for processing.
en.disableEffect: Ogury’s timer-triggered background tasks will stop; the host app’s other features remain available.

zh-CN.description: Ogury（ExploreStack）定时器发送任务时，此接收器会将任务转交给 Ogury（ExploreStack）后台服务处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Ogury 由定时器触发的后台任务将停止，但应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: Primer's Stripe integration opens this Activity when a payment needs bank-account details; it presents Stripe's bank-account collection flow and returns the result.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from entering bank-account details for Stripe payments through Primer.

zh-CN.description: Primer 的 Stripe 集成会在支付需要银行账户信息时打开此 Activity；它显示 Stripe 的账户信息收集流程并返回结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过 Primer 为 Stripe 支付填写银行账户信息。

en.description: Primer's iPay88 integration opens this Activity when the app starts an iPay88 payment; it passes the payment details into checkout and returns success, cancellation, or failure to the app.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents the Primer iPay88 checkout and its return result from opening, so those payments cannot complete.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动 iPay88 支付时，Primer 的集成会打开此 Activity；它把支付信息交给结账流程，并将成功、取消或失败结果返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Primer 的 iPay88 结账流程及其返回结果无法打开，因此用户无法完成这类付款。

en.description: ProxSee's beacon SDK starts this background Service for SDK work; Android may restart it if the app process ends.
en.disableEffect: Background beacon or location activity may stop or fail to resume after Android closes the app.

zh-CN.description: ProxSee 信标 SDK 会启动此后台 Service 来承接 SDK 工作；应用进程结束后，Android 可能会重新启动它。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Android 关闭应用后，后台信标或位置活动可能停止，或无法恢复。

en.description: ProxSee's beacon SDK starts this background Service for SDK work; Android may restart it if the app process ends.
en.disableEffect: Background beacon or location activity may stop or fail to resume after Android closes the app.

zh-CN.description: ProxSee 信标 SDK 会启动此后台 Service 来承接 SDK 工作；应用进程结束后，Android 可能会重新启动它。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Android 关闭应用后，后台信标或位置活动可能停止，或无法恢复。

en.description: ProxSee schedules this job to provide a short background run window; after it starts, the job reports completion after about 40 seconds.
en.disableEffect: ProxSee loses this scheduled background window, so some background beacon updates may be delayed.

zh-CN.description: ProxSee 会调度此任务，为后台工作提供一段短暂运行时间；任务启动约 40 秒后会报告完成。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，ProxSee 将失去这段后台运行时间，部分信标更新可能延迟。

en.description: ProxSee's beacon SDK receives startup, power-connection, and alarm broadcasts here; the analyzed receiver records each event for diagnostics.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it removes these diagnostic event records; its code performs no other work.

zh-CN.description: ProxSee 信标 SDK 会通过此 Receiver 接收设备启动、电源连接状态变化和定时提醒；此版本中的代码只记录这些诊断事件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后只会失去这些诊断记录；该 Receiver 的代码没有执行其他工作。

en.description: When a network connection is available, ProxSee runs this job to refresh active beacon data used by its beacon SDK.
en.disableEffect: ProxSee may stop refreshing active beacon data, so beacon-based tracking updates can be missed.

zh-CN.description: 网络可用时，ProxSee 会运行此任务，刷新信标 SDK 使用的活动信标数据。
zh-CN.disableEffect: ProxSee 可能无法继续刷新活动信标数据，信标触发的位置更新可能遗漏。

en.description: ProxSee schedules this network job to perform its server handshake, immediately or on a recurring schedule when a connection is available.
en.disableEffect: The SDK may not complete or refresh its background connection handshake.

zh-CN.description: ProxSee 会调度此网络任务与服务端完成握手；网络可用时，它可以立即运行或按周期运行。
zh-CN.disableEffect: SDK 可能无法完成或刷新后台连接握手。

en.description: The ProxSee network scheduler runs this job when it has queued beacon entry or exit events to send to its service.
en.disableEffect: Without this job, queued beacon entry or exit events may not reach ProxSee, leaving visit data incomplete.

zh-CN.description: ProxSee 的网络调度器会在有待发送的信标进入或离开记录时运行此任务，并将记录发送给服务端。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，信标进出记录可能无法同步到 ProxSee，相关到访数据会不完整。

en.description: When Android delivers Bluetooth beacon scan results, ProxSee passes them to its beacon detector for processing.
en.disableEffect: ProxSee will stop receiving these scan results, so nearby beacons may not be detected by the SDK.

zh-CN.description: Android 送来蓝牙信标扫描结果时，ProxSee 会把结果交给信标检测模块处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: ProxSee 将无法接收这些扫描结果，SDK 可能检测不到附近的信标。

en.description: When ProxSee receives a geofence transition, this receiver reads the triggering location and passes it to the SDK's location processing.
en.disableEffect: ProxSee will stop processing geofence alerts, so location enter and exit events may be missed.

zh-CN.description: ProxSee 收到地理围栏变化时，此 Receiver 会读取触发位置并交给 SDK 处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: ProxSee 将无法处理地理围栏提醒，进入或离开区域的事件可能遗漏。

en.description: Android starts this ProxSee job with a queued location so the SDK can process a background location update.
en.disableEffect: ProxSee will stop processing these background location jobs, so location-based updates may be delayed or missed.

zh-CN.description: Android 会把排队的位置数据交给此 ProxSee 任务，让 SDK 在后台处理位置更新。
zh-CN.disableEffect: ProxSee 将无法处理这些后台位置任务，基于位置的更新可能延迟或遗漏。

en.description: When Android delivers a location update to ProxSee, this receiver extracts the latest location and passes it to the SDK.
en.disableEffect: ProxSee will not process these delivered locations, so location-based tracking may stop.

zh-CN.description: Android 向 ProxSee 送来位置更新时，此 Receiver 会提取最新位置并交给 SDK 处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: ProxSee 将无法处理收到的位置，基于位置的跟踪可能停止。

en.description: Purchasely opens this Activity for Huawei AppGallery purchase or update results; it reads the result and returns the purchase state to Purchasely.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it can prevent Huawei purchase outcomes from reaching Purchasely, so Huawei-billed subscriptions may fail to complete or update.

zh-CN.description: Purchasely 会用此 Activity 处理华为应用市场的购买或更新结果，并把购买状态交回 SDK。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，华为购买结果可能无法返回 Purchasely，用户可能无法完成或更新华为渠道的订阅。

en.description: Purchasely's subscription SDK uses this provider during app startup to give its manager the application context needed by later SDK features.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents Purchasely from receiving its startup context, so paywall and subscription features may fail to initialize.

zh-CN.description: Purchasely 订阅 SDK 会在应用启动时通过此 Provider 为管理器设置应用环境，供后续 SDK 功能使用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Purchasely 无法在启动时取得应用环境，付费墙和订阅功能可能无法初始化。

en.description: Purchasely opens this Activity for a linked or selected presentation, such as a paywall or offer screen, and displays that presentation in the app.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents Purchasely presentations and paywalls from opening, which can block the purchase flow shown there.

zh-CN.description: Purchasely 会在打开链接或选定的展示内容时使用此 Activity，例如应用内付费墙或优惠页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Purchasely 展示内容和付费墙无法打开，相关购买流程可能中断。

en.description: Purchasely uses this Activity to show a URL and its QR code on a TV screen so the user can open the link on another device.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it removes the Purchasely TV link screen, so users cannot scan that link from the TV.

zh-CN.description: Purchasely 会用此 Activity 在电视屏幕上显示链接及其二维码，供用户用另一台设备打开。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Purchasely 的电视链接页面无法显示，用户不能从电视上扫描该链接。

en.description: When a Purchasely presentation opens a web page, this Activity displays the supplied URL in an in-app browser and routes ordinary web links outward.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents Purchasely web pages or checkout links from opening, which can block part of a subscription flow.

zh-CN.description: Purchasely 展示内容需要打开网页时，此 Activity 会在应用内显示指定网址，并将普通网页链接交给外部浏览器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Purchasely 网页或结账链接无法打开，订阅流程的一部分可能中断。

en.description: Purchasely opens this Activity to display a presentation or request as an in-app flow with its own screens.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents Purchasely flows from opening, so users may be unable to finish a subscription offer or purchase shown there.

zh-CN.description: Purchasely 会用此 Activity 将展示内容或请求显示为包含多个页面的应用内流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Purchasely 流程无法打开，用户可能无法完成其中的订阅优惠或购买。

en.description: On Android TV, Purchasely opens this Activity to show subscription details or the subscription cancellation screen.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from viewing or cancelling subscriptions through Purchasely on Android TV.

zh-CN.description: 在 Android TV 上，Purchasely 会用此 Activity 显示订阅详情或取消订阅页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法在 Android TV 上通过 Purchasely 查看或取消订阅。

en.description: When Android reports that the app package was replaced, PureMetrics checks whether the app was updated and records the installation state.
en.disableEffect: PureMetrics may miss app-update measurements, leaving version-change reporting incomplete.

zh-CN.description: Android 报告应用安装包已替换时，PureMetrics 会检查应用是否更新并记录安装状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: PureMetrics 可能漏掉应用更新数据，版本变化统计会不完整。

en.description: When network connectivity returns, PureMetrics schedules its queued measurement data for syncing.
en.disableEffect: Queued PureMetrics measurement data may not sync promptly when the network returns.

zh-CN.description: 网络连接恢复时，PureMetrics 会安排同步排队的测量数据。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 网络恢复后，排队的 PureMetrics 测量数据可能无法及时同步。

en.description: When a user taps or acts on a PushNode notification, this receiver reports that interaction to PushNode for notification handling.
en.disableEffect: PushNode may stop receiving notification taps and actions, so its notification action handling will stop.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击 PushNode 通知或执行通知操作时，此 Receiver 会把互动结果交给 PushNode 处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: PushNode 可能无法收到通知点击和操作，因此通知操作处理会停止。

en.description: PushNode uses this service to receive Firebase Cloud Messaging messages and display non-silent notifications.
en.disableEffect: PushNode notifications delivered through Firebase will no longer be received or shown.

zh-CN.description: PushNode 会通过此 Service 接收 Firebase Cloud Messaging 消息，并显示非静默通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过 Firebase 送达的 PushNode 通知将无法接收或显示。

en.description: PushNode uses this service to receive Huawei Mobile Services push messages and display non-silent notifications.
en.disableEffect: PushNode notifications delivered through Huawei Mobile Services will no longer be received or shown.

zh-CN.description: PushNode 会通过此 Service 接收华为移动服务推送，并显示非静默通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过华为移动服务送达的 PushNode 通知将无法接收或显示。

en.description: After device startup or an app replacement, Radar checks whether location tracking should resume and restores it when needed.
en.disableEffect: Radar will not restore saved location tracking through this receiver after a reboot or app replacement.

zh-CN.description: 设备启动或应用更新后，Radar 会检查是否需要恢复位置跟踪，并在需要时恢复。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 重启设备或更新应用后，Radar 将无法通过此 Receiver 恢复已保存的位置跟踪。

en.description: When Radar starts continuous location tracking, this foreground Service keeps the tracking session active and displays an ongoing notification; it can also stop that session.
en.disableEffect: Continuous Radar location tracking may stop or fail to continue in the background.

zh-CN.description: Radar 启动持续位置跟踪时，此前台 Service 会维持跟踪会话并显示常驻通知；它也负责停止该会话。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Radar 的持续位置跟踪可能停止，或无法在后台继续。

en.description: Radar schedules this job service to process queued location and beacon updates when Android runs background work.
en.disableEffect: Radar may not process queued location or beacon updates while the app is in the background.

zh-CN.description: Radar 会调度此 JobService，在 Android 执行后台任务时处理排队的位置和信标更新。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用处于后台时，Radar 可能无法处理排队的位置或信标更新。

en.description: Radar uses this receiver for location, geofence, beacon, and activity updates, forwarding them to its tracking system or queuing background work.
en.disableEffect: Radar will not process delivered locations, geofence events, or beacon scans, so tracking updates may stop.

zh-CN.description: Radar 会通过此 Receiver 接收位置、地理围栏、信标和活动变化，并将数据交给跟踪系统或排入后台任务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Radar 将无法处理收到的位置、地理围栏事件或信标扫描，跟踪更新可能停止。

en.description: When a Readsee CDP push notification is opened, this Activity forwards its attached link to Android's link handler.
en.disableEffect: Tapping that push notification will no longer open its linked page; the app's other screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: 打开 Readsee CDP 推送通知时，此 Activity 会把通知附带的链接交给 Android 的链接处理程序打开。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 点击这类推送通知将无法再打开链接页面；应用的其他页面仍可使用。

en.description: When the Readsee CDP push SDK requests notification access, this Activity shows Android's permission prompt and creates the SDK's notification channels after approval.
en.disableEffect: Readsee push notifications may stop working because their permission and notification channels cannot be set up through this screen.

zh-CN.description: Readsee CDP 推送 SDK 请求通知权限时，此 Activity 会显示 Android 的权限提示，并在获准后创建 SDK 的通知渠道。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 此页面被停用后，Readsee 推送可能无法完成权限和通知渠道设置。

en.description: When the Refiner survey SDK opens a customer feedback form, this Activity displays the survey and handles its dismissal.
en.disableEffect: Refiner surveys cannot open; if the SDK tries to launch the missing screen, the app may close unexpectedly.

zh-CN.description: Refiner 调查 SDK 打开客户反馈表单时，此 Activity 会显示问卷并处理关闭操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Refiner 问卷将无法打开；如果 SDK 尝试启动缺失的页面，应用可能会意外退出。

en.description: When the Relayr Cloud SDK starts account sign-in, this Activity checks connectivity and opens Relayr's sign-in page; after authorization it saves the account credentials used for cloud access.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot sign in to Relayr Cloud, so account and device features that require a signed-in user may fail.

zh-CN.description: Relayr Cloud SDK 开始账户登录时，此 Activity 会检查网络并打开 Relayr 登录页面；授权后会保存访问云服务所需的账户凭据。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法登录 Relayr Cloud，因此需要登录的账户和设备功能可能无法使用。

en.description: When the Relayr Cloud SDK starts account sign-in, this Activity checks connectivity and opens Relayr's sign-in page; after authorization it saves the account credentials used for cloud access.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot sign in to Relayr Cloud, so account and device features that require a signed-in user may fail.

zh-CN.description: Relayr Cloud SDK 开始账户登录时，此 Activity 会检查网络并打开 Relayr 登录页面；授权后会保存访问云服务所需的账户凭据。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法登录 Relayr Cloud，因此需要登录的账户和设备功能可能无法使用。

en.description: The Replay.io Android client schedules this background Service as a six-hour watchdog to upload queued session replay data that is still waiting to be sent.
en.disableEffect: Some saved Replay.io session data may remain unsent, reducing the session recordings available for review; the app itself continues to work.

zh-CN.description: Replay.io Android 客户端每六小时安排此后台 Service 检查并上传仍在等待发送的会话回放数据。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 部分 Replay.io 会话数据可能无法发送，可供查看的会话记录会减少；应用本身仍可运行。

en.description: When a user taps Requestly's device-ID copy action in its notification, this Receiver copies the Requestly device ID to the clipboard and shows a confirmation.
en.disableEffect: The notification can no longer copy the Requestly device ID; normal app screens and network requests are unaffected.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击 Requestly 通知中的设备 ID 复制操作时，此 Receiver 会将 Requestly 设备 ID 复制到剪贴板并显示确认提示。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 该通知将无法复制 Requestly 设备 ID；应用页面和网络请求不受影响。

en.description: When a user taps Requestly's notification control for network capture, this Receiver handles the request to turn capture on or off.
en.disableEffect: The notification's Requestly capture control no longer works; the app's own network requests still run.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击 Requestly 通知中的网络记录开关时，此 Receiver 会处理开启或关闭记录的请求。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Requestly 通知中的记录开关将无法使用；应用自身的网络请求仍会运行。

en.description: When a user changes Requestly's network-capture setting from its notification, this Service toggles capture and refreshes the status notification.
en.disableEffect: Requestly cannot start or stop its optional HTTP inspection from the notification, but the app's network requests continue normally.

zh-CN.description: 用户通过 Requestly 通知更改网络记录设置时，此 Service 会切换记录状态并更新状态通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过通知启停 Requestly 的可选 HTTP 检查功能，但应用网络请求仍会正常进行。

en.description: When opened, this Requestly Activity presents its in-app network inspector and related tools for request history, analytics, host switching, and logs.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open Requestly's inspection tools from the app; the app's own screens and network requests continue working.

zh-CN.description: 此 Requestly Activity 打开时，会显示应用内网络检查工具，以及请求记录、数据分析、主机切换和日志页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法从应用打开 Requestly 检查工具；应用自身页面和网络请求仍可正常使用。

en.description: When a user chooses to clear Requestly's saved HTTP history from a notification, this Receiver forwards the cleanup request.
en.disableEffect: The notification's clear-history action no longer works, so saved Requestly transactions may remain in its history.

zh-CN.description: 用户从通知中选择清除 Requestly HTTP 历史记录时，此 Receiver 会转交清理请求。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通知中的清除历史记录操作将无法使用，Requestly 保存的请求记录可能继续留在历史列表中。

en.description: When Requestly's notification clear-history action runs, this Service deletes saved HTTP transactions and dismisses their notifications.
en.disableEffect: The notification action cannot clear Requestly's saved HTTP history; other inspector controls may still work.

zh-CN.description: Requestly 通知中的清除历史记录操作运行时，此 Service 会删除已保存的 HTTP 请求记录并关闭相关通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通知操作将无法清除 Requestly 保存的 HTTP 历史记录；检查工具的其他控制项仍可能可用。

en.description: When a user taps Requestly's device-ID copy action in its notification, this Receiver copies the Requestly device ID to the clipboard and shows a confirmation.
en.disableEffect: The notification can no longer copy the Requestly device ID; normal app screens and network requests are unaffected.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击 Requestly 通知中的设备 ID 复制操作时，此 Receiver 会将 Requestly 设备 ID 复制到剪贴板并显示确认提示。

zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过通知启停 Requestly 的可选 HTTP 检查功能，但应用网络请求仍会正常进行。

en.description: When the Requestly HTTP inspector exports a captured request or response as a file, this Provider makes the file available to Android's share sheet.
en.disableEffect: Requestly's file-based request exports cannot be shared and may fail when the inspector tries to create a share link.

zh-CN.description: Requestly HTTP 检查工具将已记录的请求或响应导出为文件时，此 Provider 会将文件提供给 Android 分享面板。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Requestly 将无法分享文件形式的请求导出内容，检查工具生成分享链接时也可能失败。

en.description: When the Requestly OkHttp inspector opens, this Activity lists captured HTTP transactions and lets users search, clear, or export the history.
en.disableEffect: Users lose Requestly's in-app HTTP history screen and its transaction links; the app's own screens and requests still work.

zh-CN.description: Requestly OkHttp 检查工具打开时，此 Activity 会列出已记录的 HTTP 请求，并允许用户搜索、清除或导出历史记录。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法使用 Requestly 应用内 HTTP 历史页面及其请求详情入口；应用自身页面和请求仍可运行。

en.description: When a user selects a captured request, this Requestly Activity shows its request and response details and offers text, cURL, and file exports.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open or export individual HTTP transaction details in Requestly; the app's own features remain available.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择一条已记录的请求时，此 Requestly Activity 会显示请求和响应详情，并提供文本、cURL 和文件导出选项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在 Requestly 中查看或导出单条 HTTP 请求详情；应用自身功能仍可使用。

en.description: When the Requestly in-app HTTP inspector shares an exported request or response file, this Provider makes the file available to Android's share sheet.
en.disableEffect: File-based Requestly exports cannot be shared and may fail when the inspector tries to create a share link.

zh-CN.description: Requestly 应用内 HTTP 检查工具分享导出的请求或响应文件时，此 Provider 会将文件提供给 Android 分享面板。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Requestly 将无法分享文件形式的导出内容，检查工具生成分享链接时也可能失败。

en.description: When the RightMesh Android Wireless Measurement library starts Bluetooth measurements while Bluetooth is off, this Activity asks Android to turn Bluetooth on and resumes scanning if approved.
en.disableEffect: RightMesh cannot prompt for Bluetooth or scan nearby Bluetooth devices, so Bluetooth measurements are unavailable.

zh-CN.description: RightMesh Android Wireless Measurement（AWM）库在蓝牙关闭时开始测量，此 Activity 会请求 Android 开启蓝牙，并在获准后继续扫描。
zh-CN.disableEffect: RightMesh 将无法请求开启蓝牙或扫描附近设备，因此无法收集蓝牙测量数据。

en.description: When the ROX by Rollout.io feature-flag list is opened, this Activity displays the app's flags and lets users change temporary overrides.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open ROX's flag list or change overrides there; the app continues using its configured feature-flag values.

zh-CN.description: 打开 ROX（Rollout.io）功能标记列表时，此 Activity 会显示应用的功能标记，并允许用户更改临时覆盖值。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开 ROX 标记列表或更改其中的覆盖值；应用仍会使用已配置的功能标记值。

en.description: When ROX asks a user to join a named target group, this Activity displays a yes-or-no confirmation and returns the choice to the SDK.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot confirm or decline joining a ROX target group through this prompt.

zh-CN.description: ROX 请求用户加入指定目标组时，此 Activity 会显示是否加入的确认提示，并将选择结果返回给 SDK。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此提示确认或拒绝加入 ROX 目标组。

en.description: After ROX test-device pairing completes, this Activity displays a success or error dialog with the pairing result.
en.disableEffect: ROX no longer shows its test-device pairing result; normal app features continue working.

zh-CN.description: ROX 测试设备配对完成后，此 Activity 会根据配对结果显示成功或错误提示。
zh-CN.disableEffect: ROX 将不再显示测试设备配对结果；应用的正常功能仍可运行。

en.description: RongCloud CallKit starts this service during an active voice or video call. It keeps a call notification visible so you can return to the ongoing call.
en.disableEffect: An ongoing call may lose its persistent notification and its return-to-call screen may not reopen correctly.

zh-CN.description: 融云 CallKit 会在语音或视频通话进行时启动此服务。它持续显示通话通知，方便你返回正在进行的通话。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，通话通知可能消失，正在进行的通话界面也可能无法正常恢复。

en.description: RongCloud CallKit opens this screen when a group call lets you add participants. It loads group members and lets you choose whom to invite.
en.disableEffect: You will not be able to add people through the group-call member picker.

zh-CN.description: 融云 CallKit 会在群组通话添加参与者时打开此页面。页面会读取群成员，并让你选择要邀请的人。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，你将无法通过群组通话的成员选择页面邀请其他人。

en.description: RongCloud CallKit opens this screen for a group voice call. It shows participants and call controls while the call connects and continues.
en.disableEffect: Group voice calls will not be able to open their in-call screen or manage participants.

zh-CN.description: 融云 CallKit 会在群组语音通话时打开此页面。通话连接和进行期间，页面显示参与者与通话控制项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，群组语音通话将无法打开通话界面或管理参与者。

en.description: RongCloud CallKit opens this screen for a group video call. It displays the participants' video and provides camera, microphone and call controls.
en.disableEffect: Group video calls will not be able to open their in-call screen or show participant video.

zh-CN.description: 融云 CallKit 会在群组视频通话时打开此页面。页面显示参与者视频，并提供摄像头、麦克风和通话控制项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，群组视频通话将无法打开通话界面或显示参与者画面。

en.description: RongCloud CallKit opens this screen for a one-to-one voice or video call, whether the call is incoming or outgoing. It shows the call state and controls for answering, switching audio or video, and hanging up.
en.disableEffect: One-to-one internet calls will not be able to open their call screen or handle call controls.

zh-CN.description: 融云 CallKit 会在一对一语音或视频通话的来电和去电过程中打开此页面。页面显示通话状态，并提供接听、切换音视频和挂断等控制项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，一对一网络通话将无法打开通话界面或使用通话控制项。

en.description: RongCloud CallKit uses this receiver when a call invitation arrives or a call notification is tapped. It shows incoming-call notifications and routes actions such as opening or ending a call.
en.disableEffect: Incoming internet calls may not ring or open from notifications, and call notification actions may stop working.

zh-CN.description: 融云 CallKit 会在收到通话邀请或用户点按通话通知时使用此接收器。它显示来电通知，并处理打开或结束通话等操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，网络来电可能不会响铃或无法从通知打开，通话通知操作也可能失效。

en.description: Android sends this RongCloud CallKit receiver updates when a regular phone call starts, changes or ends. If a cellular call is answered during an internet call, it hangs up the RongCloud call to avoid overlapping audio.
en.disableEffect: An internet call may not react correctly when a regular phone call takes over the audio.

zh-CN.description: 普通电话开始、状态变化或结束时，Android 会向融云 CallKit 的此接收器发送通知。如果网络通话期间接听了普通电话，它会挂断融云通话以避免声音重叠。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，网络通话可能无法正确响应普通电话接管音频的情况。

en.description: RongCloud's CallPlus adapter starts this provider with the app so the IM client can handle call event and call-end messages.
en.disableEffect: Call event and call-end messages may not be recognized or handled by the IM client.

zh-CN.description: 融云 CallPlus 适配组件会在应用启动时通过此提供器，让 IM 客户端能够处理通话事件和结束通话消息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: IM 客户端可能无法识别或处理通话事件及结束通话消息。

en.description: RongCloud's Emoji provider starts with the app and initializes emoji compatibility support used by the messaging SDK.
en.disableEffect: Emoji compatibility rendering used by RongCloud messages may not initialize, so some emoji can display incorrectly.

zh-CN.description: 融云 Emoji 提供器会在应用启动时初始化消息 SDK 使用的表情兼容支持。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 融云消息使用的表情兼容功能可能无法初始化，部分表情可能显示异常。

en.description: When a user opens a picture from a RongCloud IM Kit message, this screen displays it in a full-screen, swipeable viewer.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to view chat pictures in the full-screen pager.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开融云 IM Kit 消息中的图片时，此界面会在可滑动的全屏查看器中显示图片。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在全屏翻页查看器中查看聊天图片。

en.description: When a user opens a combined message in RongCloud IM Kit, this screen loads and displays its included conversation content in a web view.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to open combined-message details in RongCloud IM Kit.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开融云 IM Kit 中的合并消息时，此界面会加载并在网页视图中显示其中包含的会话内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在融云 IM Kit 中查看合并消息详情。

en.description: RongCloud IMKit opens this screen when you tap a file message. It shows the file and download progress, lets you resume a download, and opens supported files after they are saved.
en.disableEffect: Files received in chats can no longer be downloaded, resumed or opened from this screen.

zh-CN.description: 点按聊天中的文件消息时，融云 IMKit 会打开此页面。页面显示文件和下载进度，支持继续下载，并在文件保存后打开可识别的文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，你将无法通过此页面下载、续传或打开聊天收到的文件。

en.description: RongCloud IMKit opens this screen when you choose to forward a message. It lists recent conversations so you can select where the message should go.
en.disableEffect: Forwarding messages to another conversation through IMKit will no longer work.

zh-CN.description: 选择转发消息时，融云 IMKit 会打开此页面。页面列出最近的会话，供你选择消息的接收对象。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，你将无法通过 IMKit 把消息转发到其他会话。

en.description: When a user opens a GIF message in RongCloud IM Kit, this screen downloads it if needed and displays the animated image; users can also save it.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to view or save GIF messages through the IM Kit viewer.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开融云 IM Kit 中的 GIF 消息时，此界面会在需要时下载并播放动图，用户也可保存图片。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 IM Kit 查看或保存 GIF 消息。

en.description: RongCloud IMKit opens this viewer when you tap an image in a conversation. It lets you move through nearby chat images and use the available image actions.
en.disableEffect: You will not be able to open and browse full-size conversation images through IMKit.

zh-CN.description: 点按会话中的图片时，融云 IMKit 会打开此查看器。你可以浏览前后相邻的聊天图片，并使用页面提供的图片操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，你将无法通过 IMKit 查看和浏览会话中的大图。

en.description: RongCloud IMKit opens this screen for a web page linked from an SDK conversation or file preview. It displays the page inside the app and handles links and supported downloads.
en.disableEffect: Web pages opened through IMKit will not display, and their in-app links or downloads will be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: 融云 IMKit 会在打开会话中的网页链接或文件预览页时显示此页面。它在应用内展示网页，并处理链接和受支持的下载。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，通过 IMKit 打开的网页将无法显示，页面中的应用内链接和下载也无法使用。

en.description: When a file message is opened in RongCloud IM Kit, this screen downloads it if needed and lets the user preview it in a web view or open it with another app.
en.disableEffect: Users will lose the IM Kit flow for downloading and opening chat file attachments.

zh-CN.description: 用户在融云 IM Kit 中打开文件消息时，此界面会在需要时下载文件，并供用户在网页视图中预览或用其他应用打开。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 IM Kit 下载和打开聊天文件附件。

en.description: RongCloud IMKit opens this screen when you enter a one-to-one or group conversation. It displays the messages and chat controls for that person or group.
en.disableEffect: The app will not be able to open the IMKit conversation screen, so messaging through it will fail.

zh-CN.description: 进入一对一或群组会话时，融云 IMKit 会打开此页面。页面显示该联系人或群组的消息和聊天控制项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用将无法打开 IMKit 会话界面，通过该界面聊天也会失效。

en.description: RongCloud IMKit opens this screen when you ask to inspect a message's read receipts. It shows the receipt details for that message.
en.disableEffect: You will not be able to see read-receipt details for messages through IMKit.

zh-CN.description: 查看消息的已读回执时，融云 IMKit 会打开此页面。页面显示该消息的回执详情。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，你将无法通过 IMKit 查看消息的已读回执详情。

en.description: RongCloud IMKit opens this screen when the app requests its conversation inbox. It provides the list from which you can open a person or group chat.
en.disableEffect: The app will not be able to show the IMKit conversation inbox.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求打开会话收件箱时，融云 IMKit 会显示此页面。你可以从会话列表进入个人或群组聊天。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用将无法显示融云 IMKit 的会话收件箱。

en.description: RongCloud IMKit opens this AMap screen when you choose to attach a location to a message. It shows your position and nearby places so you can select a point to send.
en.disableEffect: You will not be able to choose and send a map location through this screen.

zh-CN.description: 选择给消息附加位置时，融云 IMKit 会打开此高德地图页面。页面显示你的位置和附近地点，供你选择要发送的地点。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，你将无法通过此页面选择并发送地图位置。

en.description: RongCloud IMKit opens this two-dimensional AMap screen when you choose a location to attach to a message. It shows your position and nearby places and returns the selected point.
en.disableEffect: The two-dimensional location picker will not open, so you cannot select a place through this screen.

zh-CN.description: 选择给消息附加位置时，融云 IMKit 会打开此二维高德地图页面。页面显示你的位置和附近地点，并返回选中的地点。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，二维地图选点页面将无法打开，你也无法通过它选择地点。

en.description: RongCloud IMKit opens this AMap screen when you view a location shared in a message. It places the shared location on a map for you to inspect.
en.disableEffect: Location messages will no longer open their map preview through this screen.

zh-CN.description: 查看消息中分享的位置时，融云 IMKit 会打开此高德地图页面。页面在地图上标出分享的位置，供你查看。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，消息中的位置将无法通过此页面打开地图预览。

en.description: RongCloud IMKit opens this two-dimensional AMap screen when you view a location shared in a message. It marks the shared point on the map.
en.disableEffect: Location messages will no longer open their two-dimensional map preview through this screen.

zh-CN.description: 查看消息中分享的位置时，融云 IMKit 会打开此二维高德地图页面。页面会在地图上标出分享的位置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，消息中的位置将无法通过此页面打开二维地图预览。

en.description: RongCloud IMKit opens this AMap screen when you start or join live location sharing in a conversation. It updates the map with participants' locations while sharing continues.
en.disableEffect: You will not be able to view or take part in live location sharing through this screen.

zh-CN.description: 在会话中开始或加入实时位置共享时，融云 IMKit 会打开此高德地图页面。共享期间，页面会更新参与者的位置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，你将无法通过此页面查看或参与实时位置共享。

en.description: RongCloud IMKit opens this two-dimensional AMap screen when you start or join live location sharing in a conversation. It updates participants' positions on the map.
en.disableEffect: You will not be able to view or take part in live location sharing through this two-dimensional screen.

zh-CN.description: 在会话中开始或加入实时位置共享时，融云 IMKit 会打开此二维高德地图页面。页面会在地图上更新参与者的位置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，你将无法通过此二维地图页面查看或参与实时位置共享。

en.description: RongCloud IMKit opens this screen when you search for a place in the location picker. It searches place names and addresses and returns the location you select.
en.disableEffect: You will not be able to search for and select a place by name from the location picker.

zh-CN.description: 在位置选择页面搜索地点时，融云 IMKit 会打开此页面。它搜索地点名称和地址，并返回你选中的位置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，你将无法在位置选择页面按名称搜索并选择地点。

en.description: RongCloud IMKit opens this screen when you choose whom to mention in a group or discussion. It lists members, supports searching, and returns the person you select.
en.disableEffect: You will not be able to choose a person to mention from this member list.

zh-CN.description: 在群组或讨论组中选择要提及的人时，融云 IMKit 会打开此页面。页面列出成员、支持搜索，并返回你选中的人。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，你将无法通过此成员列表选择要提及的人。

en.description: RongCloud IM Kit uses this Android file provider to create shareable content links for downloaded chat files when they are opened in another app.
en.disableEffect: Opening a downloaded chat attachment in another app may fail because the IM Kit cannot provide a shareable file link.

zh-CN.description: 融云 IM Kit 使用此文件提供器，为需要用其他应用打开的已下载聊天文件创建可共享的内容链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: IM Kit 无法提供可共享的文件链接，已下载的聊天附件可能无法交给其他应用打开。

en.description: RongCloud IMKit opens this screen to preview photos selected for a message. It lets you browse the chosen images and confirm which ones to attach.
en.disableEffect: You will not be able to preview and confirm selected photos before sending them through IMKit.

zh-CN.description: 融云 IMKit 会在发送消息前打开此页面预览已选照片。你可以浏览所选图片，并确认要附加哪些图片。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，你将无法在通过 IMKit 发送照片前预览并确认所选内容。

en.description: RongCloud IMKit opens this screen when you choose photos or videos to attach to a message. It reads local albums and lets you select media to send.
en.disableEffect: You will not be able to browse albums and choose photos or videos for IMKit messages.

zh-CN.description: 选择给消息附加照片或视频时，融云 IMKit 会打开此页面。它读取本机相册，并让你选择要发送的媒体。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，你将无法浏览相册并为 IMKit 消息选择照片或视频。

en.description: RongCloud IMKit opens this hidden camera screen when you choose to take a photo or video for a message. It requests camera access, launches the camera and returns the captured media.
en.disableEffect: You will not be able to capture a photo or video from the IMKit attachment flow.

zh-CN.description: 选择为消息拍摄照片或视频时，融云 IMKit 会打开此相机页面。页面申请相机权限、启动相机，并返回拍摄的媒体。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，你将无法在 IMKit 的附件流程中拍摄照片或视频。

en.description: RongCloud IMKit opens this screen to play a video chosen from the local album before it is attached to a message. It provides playback and pause controls.
en.disableEffect: You will not be able to preview an album video through the IMKit attachment flow.

zh-CN.description: 将相册中的视频附加到消息前，融云 IMKit 会打开此页面播放视频。页面提供播放和暂停控制。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，你将无法通过 IMKit 的附件流程预览相册视频。

en.description: RongCloud IMKit opens this screen when you tap a grouped conversation category, such as a list of one conversation type. It shows the conversations in that category.
en.disableEffect: The app will not be able to open the separate list for a grouped conversation category.

zh-CN.description: 点按会话分类时，融云 IMKit 会打开此页面，例如查看某一种会话类型的列表。页面显示该分类下的会话。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用将无法打开会话分类对应的单独列表。

en.description: RongCloud IMKit opens this screen when you look up another user by account ID. It searches for the matching profile and opens it so you can continue the add-friend flow.
en.disableEffect: You will not be able to look up users through the IMKit add-friend page.

zh-CN.description: 按账号 ID 查找其他用户时，融云 IMKit 会打开此页面。它搜索匹配的资料并打开该用户页面，供你继续添加好友流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，你将无法通过 IMKit 的添加好友页面查找用户。

en.description: RongCloud IMKit opens this screen to review friend requests. It lets you switch between all, received and sent requests, and accept or reject received requests.
en.disableEffect: You will not be able to review, accept or reject friend requests through the IMKit page.

zh-CN.description: 审核好友申请时，融云 IMKit 会打开此页面。你可以切换查看全部、收到和发出的申请，并接受或拒绝收到的申请。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，你将无法通过 IMKit 页面查看、接受或拒绝好友申请。

en.description: RongCloud IMKit opens this screen to show your friends. It hosts the SDK's friend list and lets the app route into friend-related actions.
en.disableEffect: The app will not be able to open the IMKit friend list.

zh-CN.description: 查看好友时，融云 IMKit 会打开此页面。页面显示 SDK 好友列表，并供应用进入相关好友操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用将无法打开 IMKit 好友列表。

en.description: RongCloud IMKit opens this screen when you edit the gender field in your profile. It hosts the profile editor and returns the change to the app.
en.disableEffect: You will not be able to change the profile gender through the IMKit editor.

zh-CN.description: 编辑个人资料中的性别时，融云 IMKit 会打开此页面。页面承载资料编辑界面，并将修改结果交回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，你将无法通过 IMKit 编辑器修改个人资料中的性别。

en.description: RongCloud IMKit opens this screen when you edit a profile nickname. It hosts the nickname editor for the profile information supplied by the app.
en.disableEffect: You will not be able to edit the profile nickname through the IMKit screen.

zh-CN.description: 编辑个人资料昵称时，融云 IMKit 会打开此页面。页面根据应用传入的资料显示昵称编辑界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，你将无法通过 IMKit 页面编辑个人资料昵称。

en.description: RongCloud IMKit opens this screen to show your own profile information. It hosts the profile page used by the app's IM user-management flow.
en.disableEffect: The app will not be able to open the IMKit page for your profile.

zh-CN.description: 查看个人资料时，融云 IMKit 会打开此页面。页面承载应用即时通讯用户管理流程中的个人资料页。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用将无法打开 IMKit 的个人资料页面。

en.description: RongCloud IMKit opens this screen when you search your friends. It hosts the friend-search page and displays matching people.
en.disableEffect: You will not be able to search the IMKit friend list through this screen.

zh-CN.description: 搜索好友时，融云 IMKit 会打开此页面。页面承载好友搜索界面，并显示匹配的人。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，你将无法通过此页面搜索 IMKit 好友列表。

en.description: RongCloud IMKit opens this screen when the app needs you to choose one or more friends. It displays selectable people and observes the selection limit supplied by the app.
en.disableEffect: Friend selection through the IMKit screen will no longer be available.

zh-CN.description: 应用需要你选择一位或多位好友时，融云 IMKit 会打开此页面。页面显示可选联系人，并按应用设置的数量限制选择。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，IMKit 的好友选择页面将无法使用。

en.description: RongCloud IMKit opens this screen when you view another person's profile. It loads the selected user's information and any conversation context supplied by the app.
en.disableEffect: You will not be able to open user profiles through the IMKit screen.

zh-CN.description: 查看其他人的资料时，融云 IMKit 会打开此页面。页面加载所选用户的信息，以及应用传入的会话背景。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，你将无法通过 IMKit 页面查看用户资料。

en.description: RongCloud IMKit opens this screen when you add people to a group conversation. It lets you select members to invite to that group.
en.disableEffect: You will not be able to invite people to a group through the IMKit member picker.

zh-CN.description: 向群组会话添加成员时，融云 IMKit 会打开此页面。页面让你选择要邀请进群的人。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，你将无法通过 IMKit 成员选择页面邀请他人加入群组。

en.description: RongCloud IMKit opens this screen to review requests to join groups. It displays applications for the app's group-management flow.
en.disableEffect: You will not be able to review group-join applications through the IMKit screen.

zh-CN.description: 审核加入群组的申请时，融云 IMKit 会打开此页面。页面显示群组管理流程中的入群申请。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，你将无法通过 IMKit 页面审核入群申请。

en.description: RongCloud IMKit opens this screen when the app starts a group-creation flow. It lets you create a group and include the people selected as invitees.
en.disableEffect: The app will not be able to create a group through the IMKit group-creation screen.

zh-CN.description: 应用开始创建群组流程时，融云 IMKit 会打开此页面。你可以创建群组，并加入已选中的邀请对象。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用将无法通过 IMKit 群组创建页面建立群组。

en.description: RongCloud IMKit opens this screen to view the members followed in a group. It displays the group's follow list and related member actions.
en.disableEffect: You will not be able to view the group's followed-member list through IMKit.

zh-CN.description: 查看群组中关注的成员时，融云 IMKit 会打开此页面。页面显示群组关注列表和相关成员操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，你将无法通过 IMKit 查看群组的关注成员列表。

en.description: RongCloud IMKit opens this screen to list the groups available in your account. It lets you browse and open a group.
en.disableEffect: You will not be able to open the IMKit group list.

zh-CN.description: 查看账号中的群组时，融云 IMKit 会打开此页面。你可以浏览群组并进入其中一个群。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，你将无法打开 IMKit 群组列表。

en.description: RongCloud IMKit opens this screen when you search for a group. It displays matching groups for the app's group-management flow.
en.disableEffect: You will not be able to search for groups through the IMKit page.

zh-CN.description: 搜索群组时，融云 IMKit 会打开此页面。页面显示群组管理流程中匹配的群组。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，你将无法通过 IMKit 页面搜索群组。

en.description: RongCloud IMKit opens this screen for the settings and management actions of a selected group. It provides the group-management page for the conversation.
en.disableEffect: Group settings and management actions provided by this IMKit page will be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: 打开所选群组的设置和管理操作时，融云 IMKit 会显示此页面。页面提供该会话的群组管理界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，此 IMKit 页面提供的群组设置和管理操作将无法使用。

en.description: RongCloud IMKit opens this screen to list group managers or another member role selected by the app. It displays the people assigned to that role.
en.disableEffect: You will not be able to view or select group managers through this IMKit page.

zh-CN.description: 查看群管理员或应用指定的其他成员角色时，融云 IMKit 会打开此页面。页面显示被分配该角色的成员。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，你将无法通过此 IMKit 页面查看或选择群管理员。

en.description: RongCloud IMKit opens this screen to show the members of a selected group. It provides the member list used by the group's management flow.
en.disableEffect: You will not be able to view the group's member list through IMKit.

zh-CN.description: 查看所选群组成员时，融云 IMKit 会打开此页面。页面提供群组管理流程中的成员列表。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，你将无法通过 IMKit 查看群组成员列表。

en.description: RongCloud IMKit opens this screen when you choose members to add to a group's follow list. It filters out people already disabled by the calling screen.
en.disableEffect: You will not be able to select group members for the follow list through IMKit.

zh-CN.description: 选择要加入群组关注列表的成员时，融云 IMKit 会打开此页面。页面会排除调用页面指定的不可选成员。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，你将无法通过 IMKit 选择加入群组关注列表的成员。

en.description: RongCloud IMKit opens this screen when you choose people to add as group managers. It lets you select eligible members for that role.
en.disableEffect: You will not be able to add group managers through this IMKit member picker.

zh-CN.description: 选择要设为群管理员的人时，融云 IMKit 会打开此页面。页面让你从可选成员中进行选择。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，你将无法通过此 IMKit 成员选择页面添加群管理员。

en.description: When a user selects the group mention feature in RongCloud IM Kit, this screen opens the member list for the selected conversation so a person can be mentioned.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to choose group members to mention from this IM Kit screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户在融云 IM Kit 中选择群成员提及时，此界面会打开指定会话的成员列表供用户选择。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此 IM Kit 界面选择要提及的群成员。

en.description: RongCloud IMKit opens this screen when you edit a group's name. It displays the name editor for the selected group.
en.disableEffect: You will not be able to change the group name through the IMKit editor.

zh-CN.description: 编辑群组名称时，融云 IMKit 会打开此页面。页面显示所选群组的名称编辑器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，你将无法通过 IMKit 编辑器修改群组名称。

en.description: RongCloud IMKit opens this screen when you edit your own display name in a group conversation. It saves the name shown for you in that group.
en.disableEffect: You will not be able to change how your name appears in a group through this IMKit screen.

zh-CN.description: 编辑自己在群组会话中的显示昵称时，融云 IMKit 会打开此页面。页面保存你在该群中的昵称。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，你将无法通过此 IMKit 页面修改自己在群中的显示昵称。

en.description: RongCloud IMKit opens this screen to view or edit a group's announcement. It displays the announcement for the selected group.
en.disableEffect: You will not be able to use the IMKit page to view or change the group announcement.

zh-CN.description: 查看或编辑群组公告时，融云 IMKit 会打开此页面。页面显示所选群组的公告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，你将无法通过 IMKit 页面查看或修改群组公告。

en.description: RongCloud IMKit opens this screen to view a group's profile and available group actions. It loads the selected group conversation.
en.disableEffect: You will not be able to open the IMKit group profile and its actions.

zh-CN.description: 查看群组资料和可用群组操作时，融云 IMKit 会打开此页面。页面加载所选群组会话。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，你将无法打开 IMKit 群组资料页及其操作。

en.description: RongCloud IMKit opens this screen when you set a personal remark for a group. The remark helps you recognize the group in your own conversation list.
en.disableEffect: You will not be able to set or update your personal remark for a group through the IMKit screen.

zh-CN.description: 为群组设置个人备注时，融云 IMKit 会打开此页面。备注可帮助你在自己的会话列表中识别该群。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，你将无法通过 IMKit 页面设置或修改群组个人备注。

en.description: RongCloud IMKit opens this screen when you choose members to remove from a group. It lists eligible members for the removal flow.
en.disableEffect: You will not be able to select group members for removal through this IMKit screen.

zh-CN.description: 选择要从群组移除的成员时，融云 IMKit 会打开此页面。页面列出移除流程中可选的成员。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，你将无法通过此 IMKit 页面选择要移除的群成员。

en.description: RongCloud IMKit opens this screen when the app starts a group-ownership transfer. It lets you choose the member who will receive ownership.
en.disableEffect: You will not be able to transfer group ownership through this IMKit screen.

zh-CN.description: 应用开始转让群组所有权时，融云 IMKit 会打开此页面。你可以选择接收群主身份的成员。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，你将无法通过此 IMKit 页面转让群组所有权。

en.description: RongCloud IM updates its connection status when this receiver is notified of a network change, then tells its messaging engine to react.
en.disableEffect: RongCloud chats may not reconnect correctly after the network changes.

zh-CN.description: RongCloud 即时通信 SDK 收到网络变化通知时会更新连接状态，并通知消息引擎处理网络变化。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 网络变化后，RongCloud 聊天可能无法正常重新连接。

en.description: RongCloud IM SDK sends this receiver internal heartbeat events while maintaining its connection. It sends a ping so the service can detect an inactive connection.
en.disableEffect: The IM connection may not receive heartbeat checks while the app is idle, which can make reconnection and background delivery less reliable.

zh-CN.description: 融云 IM SDK 维持连接时会向此接收器发送内部心跳事件。它发送探测信号，以便服务发现失效的连接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用空闲时 IM 连接可能无法进行心跳检查，重新连接和后台消息送达也可能变得不稳定。

en.description: Android creates this RongCloud IM SDK provider when the app process starts. It registers the SDK's chat-room support so conversations can use chat rooms.
en.disableEffect: Chat-room support will not be registered, so apps that use chat rooms may lose that feature.

zh-CN.description: 应用进程启动时，Android 会创建融云 IM SDK 的此提供程序。它注册 SDK 的聊天室支持，使会话能够使用聊天室功能。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，聊天室支持将无法注册，使用聊天室的应用可能会失去此功能。

en.description: Android creates this RongCloud IM SDK provider when the app process starts. It registers the customer-service conversation support used by the SDK.
en.disableEffect: Customer-service conversations may no longer be available in apps that use this RongCloud module.

zh-CN.description: 应用进程启动时，Android 会创建融云 IM SDK 的此提供程序。它注册 SDK 使用的客服会话支持。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此融云模块的应用可能无法继续使用客服会话。

en.description: Android creates this RongCloud IM SDK provider when the app process starts. It registers discussion-conversation support with the IM library.
en.disableEffect: Discussion conversations may no longer be available in apps that use this RongCloud module.

zh-CN.description: 应用进程启动时，Android 会创建融云 IM SDK 的此提供程序。它向 IM 库注册讨论组会话支持。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此融云模块的应用可能无法继续使用讨论组会话。

en.description: RongCloud IM binds this service while connecting its messaging engine so the app can send and receive conversations.
en.disableEffect: The app may be unable to connect to RongCloud or send and receive its chat messages.

zh-CN.description: RongCloud 即时通信 SDK 会在连接消息服务时绑定此 Service，让应用收发聊天消息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用可能无法连接 RongCloud，也无法收发聊天消息。

en.description: Android creates this RongCloud IM SDK provider when the app process starts. It registers location-message support with the IM library.
en.disableEffect: The app may lose the SDK's location-message support if this module is not registered.

zh-CN.description: 应用进程启动时，Android 会创建融云 IM SDK 的此提供程序。它向 IM 库注册位置消息支持。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 如果此模块未注册，应用可能无法使用 SDK 的位置消息功能。

en.description: Android creates this RongCloud IM SDK provider when the app process starts. It registers public-service account support with the IM library.
en.disableEffect: Public-service accounts and their conversations may no longer be available in apps that use this module.

zh-CN.description: 应用进程启动时，Android 会创建融云 IM SDK 的此提供程序。它向 IM 库注册公众号支持。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此模块的应用可能无法继续使用公众号及其会话。

en.description: RongCloud Location Kit opens this AMap screen when you choose to send a location in a chat. It shows your position and nearby places so you can select a point to share.
en.disableEffect: You will not be able to select and send a map location through RongCloud Location Kit.

zh-CN.description: 选择在聊天中发送位置时，融云 Location Kit 会打开此高德地图页面。页面显示你的位置和附近地点，供你选择要分享的地点。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，你将无法通过融云 Location Kit 选择并发送地图位置。

en.description: RongCloud Location Kit opens this AMap screen when you tap a location message. It shows the shared point on a map for you to inspect.
en.disableEffect: You will not be able to open a map preview for location messages through RongCloud Location Kit.

zh-CN.description: 点按位置消息时，融云 Location Kit 会打开此高德地图页面。页面在地图上显示分享的位置，供你查看。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，你将无法通过融云 Location Kit 打开位置消息的地图预览。

en.description: RongCloud Location Kit opens this AMap screen when you start or join live location sharing in a conversation. It updates participant positions and shows who is still sharing.
en.disableEffect: You will not be able to view or take part in live location sharing through this screen.

zh-CN.description: 在会话中开始或加入实时位置共享时，融云 Location Kit 会打开此高德地图页面。页面更新参与者位置，并显示仍在共享的人。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，你将无法通过此页面查看或参与实时位置共享。

en.description: Android creates this RongCloud Location Kit provider when the app process starts. It registers the display support for location messages in conversations.
en.disableEffect: Location messages may no longer display with the Location Kit map interface in conversations.

zh-CN.description: 应用进程启动时，Android 会创建融云 Location Kit 的此提供程序。它注册会话中位置消息的显示支持。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，会话中的位置消息可能无法显示 Location Kit 的地图界面。

en.description: RongCloud Location Kit runs this foreground service during live location sharing. It keeps a location-sharing notification visible while the service is active.
en.disableEffect: Live location sharing may stop or lose its required ongoing notification.

zh-CN.description: 融云 Location Kit 会在实时位置共享期间运行此前台服务。服务运行时，它持续显示位置共享通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，实时位置共享可能停止，或无法显示所需的持续通知。

en.description: RongCloud Location Kit opens this screen when you search for a place in its location picker. It searches place names and addresses and returns the location you select.
en.disableEffect: You will not be able to search for and select a place by name in the Location Kit picker.

zh-CN.description: 在融云 Location Kit 的位置选择器中搜索地点时，SDK 会打开此页面。页面搜索地点名称和地址，并返回你选中的位置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，你将无法在 Location Kit 选点页面按名称搜索并选择地点。

en.description: RongCloud IM push opens this small, hidden screen when a push notification or push link is tapped. It passes the incoming notification to the configured push handler and then closes.
en.disableEffect: Tapping a RongCloud push notification or link may no longer open its destination; in-app conversations remain available through their normal screens.

zh-CN.description: 点按融云 IM 推送通知或链接时，SDK 会打开此隐藏小页面。它把收到的通知交给已配置的推送处理器，然后关闭。
