zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，点按融云推送通知或链接可能无法打开对应页面；应用仍可通过常规界面进入会话。

en.description: RongCloud IM push uses this receiver to pass incoming push events to its background service. The service can then process the event without opening the chat screen.
en.disableEffect: RongCloud push events will not reach the background push service, so background message notifications may stop.

zh-CN.description: 融云 IM 推送使用此接收器把收到的推送事件交给后台服务。随后服务会处理事件，而无需打开聊天页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 融云推送事件将无法交给后台推送服务，因此应用在后台时可能不再收到消息通知。

en.description: RongCloud IM push runs this background service to connect to the push server and handle registration, heartbeat and network-change events. It supports delivery of notifications while the app is idle.
en.disableEffect: RongCloud push connectivity and background message notifications may stop, while opening the app can still use its normal conversation screens.

zh-CN.description: 融云 IM 推送通过此后台服务连接推送服务器，并处理注册、心跳和网络变化事件。它支持应用空闲时送达通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 融云推送连接和后台消息通知可能停止，但打开应用后仍可使用常规会话界面。

en.description: RongCloud IMKit opens this screen when you browse short videos shared in a conversation. It lists recent video messages, and tapping one opens its player.
en.disableEffect: You will not be able to browse the conversation's short-video list through IMKit.

zh-CN.description: 浏览会话中分享的短视频时，融云 IMKit 会打开此页面。页面列出最近的视频消息，点按后可打开播放器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，你将无法通过 IMKit 浏览会话中的短视频列表。

en.description: RongCloud IMKit opens this full-screen player when you tap a short-video message or open a supported video link. It plays the selected clip and lets you move between nearby clips.
en.disableEffect: Short videos shared through the IMKit conversation will not be playable in this screen.

zh-CN.description: 点按短视频消息或打开受支持的视频链接时，融云 IMKit 会打开此全屏播放器。它播放所选视频，并让你切换到相邻视频。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，通过 IMKit 会话分享的短视频将无法在此页面播放。

en.description: RongCloud IMKit opens this camera screen when you record a short video for a message. It records the clip and returns the saved video to the conversation composer.
en.disableEffect: You will not be able to record a short video for an IMKit message.

zh-CN.description: 为消息录制短视频时，融云 IMKit 会打开此相机页面。它录制视频片段，并把保存的视频交回会话编辑器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，你将无法为 IMKit 消息录制短视频。

en.description: RongCloud Sticker SDK opens this screen to list the sticker packages the user has downloaded and to show an empty state when there are none.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to manage downloaded sticker packages through this screen.

zh-CN.description: 融云 Sticker SDK 会通过此界面列出用户已下载的贴纸包；没有贴纸时会显示空状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此界面管理已下载的贴纸包。

en.description: At app startup, Sentry's Android SDK checks whether automatic startup is enabled and, when it is, starts crash and error reporting.
en.disableEffect: Sentry will not automatically begin collecting app crashes and errors at startup.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，Sentry Android SDK 会检查是否启用了自动启动；启用后便开始收集崩溃和错误信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Sentry 将不会在应用启动时自动开始收集崩溃和错误信息。

en.description: At app startup, Sentry's Android SDK records startup timing and starts app-start profiling when its saved profiling settings enable it.
en.disableEffect: Sentry startup timing and automatic app-start profiling will not be collected.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，Sentry Android SDK 会记录启动耗时，并在已保存的性能设置启用时开始启动性能分析。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Sentry 将不会收集应用启动耗时或自动进行启动性能分析。

en.description: At app startup, the Sentry Kotlin Multiplatform SDK uses this private provider to save the application's Android context for its error-reporting setup.
en.disableEffect: Sentry's Android error reporting will not initialize through this path, while the host app's own screens and features continue to work.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，Sentry Kotlin Multiplatform SDK 会通过此私有提供器保存 Android 应用上下文，以供错误报告功能初始化使用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Sentry 将无法通过此路径初始化 Android 错误报告，但宿主应用本身的页面和功能仍可使用。

en.description: SEON's ID Verification Android SDK opens this screen when an app starts an identity check. It guides the user through document capture and verification, then returns the result to the app.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot complete SEON identity verification in the app, so any signup or account action that requires it may be blocked.

zh-CN.description: SEON 身份核验 Android SDK 会在应用启动身份核验时打开此页面，引导用户拍摄身份证件并完成核验，然后将结果返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法在应用中完成 SEON 身份核验，依赖核验的注册或账户操作也可能无法继续。

en.description: Setapp's Android settings client initializes when the app starts so it can read or save settings through the Setapp Android app.
en.disableEffect: The app can no longer access settings through Setapp, so any app feature that depends on those values may stop working.

zh-CN.description: Setapp Android 设置客户端会在应用启动时初始化，以便应用通过 Setapp Android 应用读取或保存设置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用无法再通过 Setapp 访问这些设置，依赖这些设置的功能可能无法正常工作。

en.description: Smooth Audio's ExoPlayer SDK starts this service when the app queues audio downloads or Android restarts a scheduled download. It manages audio downloads and cache notifications for listening offline.
en.disableEffect: Audio downloads, cache progress notifications, and offline listening may stop working.

zh-CN.description: 应用安排音频下载或 Android 恢复计划中的下载任务时，Smooth Audio 的 ExoPlayer SDK 会启动此服务。它负责处理音频下载和缓存通知，以供离线收听。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，音频下载、缓存进度通知和离线收听可能无法使用。

en.description: Smooth Audio's ExoPlayer SDK starts this service when audio playback needs an ongoing notification. The notification keeps playback status visible while the user is away from the player screen.
en.disableEffect: Background audio may be stopped by Android, and the playback notification will no longer appear.

zh-CN.description: 音频播放需要常驻通知时，Smooth Audio 的 ExoPlayer SDK 会启动此服务。用户离开播放器页面后，仍可通过通知查看播放状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Android 可能停止后台音频播放，播放通知也不会再显示。

en.description: Split's Android RUM Agent starts observing app screens during startup and records when the first screen opens. It uses that timing for app performance monitoring.
en.disableEffect: Split will miss app-start timing and related performance data, while the app's screens and controls continue to work.

zh-CN.description: Split Android RUM Agent 会在应用启动时开始监听页面，并记录首个页面打开的时间，用于监测应用性能。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Split 将无法收集应用启动耗时等性能数据，但应用页面和控件仍可正常使用。

en.description: StreamLayer's authentication SDK registers this provider for its image picker. When a user takes a photo in an account or profile screen, it gives the camera temporary access to that image file.
en.disableEffect: Photo capture in StreamLayer's authentication screens may fail, so users may be unable to add or change a profile photo.

zh-CN.description: StreamLayer 身份验证 SDK 为图片选择器注册此 Provider。用户在账户或个人资料页面拍照时，它会向相机临时开放该图片文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，StreamLayer 身份验证页面中的拍照功能可能失效，用户可能无法添加或更换个人资料照片。

en.description: StreamLayer's Android SDK opens this screen when a user starts sign-in or account setup. It hosts the SDK's phone-verification and profile screens.
en.disableEffect: Users may be unable to sign in or finish setting up a StreamLayer account, blocking features that require that account.

zh-CN.description: 用户开始登录或创建账户时，StreamLayer Android SDK 会打开此页面。页面中包含手机号验证和个人资料设置界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户可能无法登录或完成 StreamLayer 账户设置，依赖该账户的功能也会受到影响。

en.description: StreamLayer's Android SDK registers this provider for its image picker. When a user takes a photo in an account or profile screen, it gives the camera temporary access to that image file.
en.disableEffect: Photo capture in StreamLayer's authentication screens may fail, so users may be unable to add or change a profile photo.

zh-CN.description: StreamLayer Android SDK 为图片选择器注册此 Provider。用户在账户或个人资料页面拍照时，它会向相机临时开放该图片文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，StreamLayer 身份验证页面中的拍照功能可能失效，用户可能无法添加或更换个人资料照片。

en.description: After a user chooses where to send an invitation from StreamLayer's system share sheet, this receiver tells the SDK that the chooser returned so it can continue the invitation flow.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, StreamLayer cannot receive the share-sheet result, so the invitation flow may not complete even though the system share sheet opens.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 StreamLayer 系统分享面板中选择邀请的发送方式后，此 Receiver 会把选择结果交回 SDK，以便继续邀请流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，StreamLayer 无法收到分享面板的结果，因此即使分享面板仍能打开，邀请流程也可能无法完成。

en.description: StreamLayer's Watch Party SDK starts this foreground service during an active watch party and shows an ongoing notification with a shortcut back to the session. It removes the notification when the party ends.
en.disableEffect: Users lose the ongoing notification and its shortcut back to an active watch party.

zh-CN.description: StreamLayer Watch Party SDK 会在观影派对进行期间启动此前台服务，并显示可返回会话的常驻通知；派对结束后会移除此通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法看到正在进行的观影派对常驻通知，也无法通过该通知返回会话。

en.description: Datafruit's Sugo analytics SDK uses this provider to save and read app-start, app-end, and pause-time state for lifecycle and session analytics.
en.disableEffect: Sugo will lose app lifecycle and session analytics data, while ordinary app screens and controls remain available.

zh-CN.description: Datafruit 的 Sugo 分析 SDK 使用此 Provider 保存和读取应用启动、结束及暂停时长等状态，用于应用生命周期和会话分析。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Sugo 将缺少应用生命周期和会话分析数据，但普通应用页面和控件仍可使用。

en.description: When a user taps an immediate KLocalNotification, this receiver passes the notification data to the app's payload listeners.
en.disableEffect: The app's callbacks for immediate local-notification taps will stop receiving their saved data.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击即时 KLocalNotification 本地通知时，此 Receiver 会把通知数据交给应用的消息监听器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 关闭后，应用将无法通过回调收到即时本地通知点击时保存的数据。

en.description: When a scheduled KLocalNotification alarm fires, this receiver builds a local notification with the supplied text and sets which app screen should open when it is tapped.
en.disableEffect: Scheduled local notifications and their intended tap-through actions will no longer be delivered.

zh-CN.description: KLocalNotification 的预定提醒触发时，此 Receiver 会根据提供的文字创建本地通知，并指定点击后打开的应用页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 关闭后，预定的本地通知及其点击后跳转操作将无法送达。

en.description: Teliver's trip-tracking SDK starts this service for active trips. It receives device-location updates, sends trip positions for live tracking, and displays an ongoing location notification.
en.disableEffect: Active Teliver trips will stop sending live positions, so related trip-progress screens may no longer update.

zh-CN.description: Teliver 行程跟踪 SDK 会为进行中的行程启动此服务。它接收设备位置更新、发送行程位置以供实时跟踪，并显示持续的定位通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Teliver 行程将停止发送实时位置，相关的行程进度页面可能无法更新。

en.description: Teliver's trip-tracking SDK opens this Activity for its tracking map. It displays the user's current position and map markers that move as tracked trips report new locations.
en.disableEffect: Users lose Teliver's map for viewing current position and live trip progress.

zh-CN.description: Teliver 行程跟踪 SDK 会打开此 Activity 显示跟踪地图，其中展示用户当前位置，以及随行程位置更新而移动的地图标记。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法使用 Teliver 地图查看当前位置和实时行程进度。

en.description: Junction Vital Health Connect runs this receiver after device boot, quick boot, exact-alarm permission changes, or its scheduled sync action. It checks that Health Connect and background sync are available, reschedules the next alarm, and starts a foreground sync when an alarm fires.
en.disableEffect: Scheduled background Health Connect updates will no longer be handled, so the app may miss automatic health-data syncs.

zh-CN.description: Junction Vital Health Connect 会在设备启动、快速启动、精确闹钟权限变化或 SDK 同步事件时运行此接收器。它检查 Health Connect 和后台同步是否可用、重新安排闹钟，并在闹钟触发时启动同步。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，Health Connect 的定时后台更新将无法处理，应用可能错过自动健康数据同步。

en.description: Junction Vital Health Connect starts this service when an exact sync alarm fires; it shows a sync notification and runs the automatic Health Connect worker until it finishes.
en.disableEffect: Vital will not be able to run the exact-alarm background health sync.

zh-CN.description: 精确同步闹钟触发后，Junction Vital Health Connect 会启动此服务，显示同步通知并运行自动 Health Connect 同步任务，直到任务完成。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，Vital 将无法执行由精确闹钟触发的后台健康数据同步。

en.description: Upnext BeaconControl opens this screen for a beacon-triggered URL or coupon action; it displays the action name and loads the page in an in-app browser.
en.disableEffect: BeaconControl's beacon-linked offer and information pages will not open.

zh-CN.description: Upnext BeaconControl 在附近信标触发网址或优惠券操作时打开此页面，在应用内浏览器中显示页面名称和内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: BeaconControl 的信标优惠和信息页面将无法打开。

en.description: Upnext BeaconControl runs this service for an action triggered by a beacon; it processes the action and can open its configured web or coupon page.
en.disableEffect: BeaconControl will no longer process actions triggered by nearby beacons.

zh-CN.description: 信标事件触发操作时，Upnext BeaconControl 会运行此服务来处理相关操作，并可按设置打开网址或优惠券页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，BeaconControl 将无法处理附近信标触发的操作。

en.description: Upnext BeaconControl runs this service when its downloaded beacon configuration changes and applies the updated list of beacons to monitor.
en.disableEffect: New beacon configurations will not be applied, so updated beacon campaigns may not trigger.

zh-CN.description: 下载的信标配置发生变化时，Upnext BeaconControl 会运行此服务并应用新的监测信标列表。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 新的信标配置将无法应用，更新后的信标活动可能无法触发。

en.description: Upnext BeaconControl runs this service when a beacon's distance or proximity changes and forwards the detected beacon so the app can be notified.
en.disableEffect: The app will stop receiving BeaconControl proximity updates and related nearby-beacon actions.

zh-CN.description: 检测到信标距离或接近状态变化时，Upnext BeaconControl 会运行此服务并将变化通知应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，应用将收不到 BeaconControl 的信标接近状态更新及相关互动。

en.description: Upnext BeaconControl starts this service when a client begins scanning; it monitors configured Bluetooth beacon regions and reports when the device enters, leaves, or moves near a beacon.
en.disableEffect: BeaconControl will no longer detect nearby beacons or trigger beacon-based campaigns.

zh-CN.description: 应用开始扫描后，Upnext BeaconControl 会启动此服务监测配置的蓝牙信标区域，并报告设备进入、离开或靠近信标的情况。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，BeaconControl 将无法检测附近信标或触发基于信标的活动。

en.description: UserWise's survey SDK opens this screen when the app presents a survey; it loads the survey URL in an in-app browser and records when the user enters, completes, or closes the survey.
en.disableEffect: UserWise surveys will not open or be completed through this screen.

zh-CN.description: 应用显示问卷时，UserWise 问卷 SDK 会打开此页面，在应用内浏览器加载问卷，并记录用户进入、完成或关闭问卷的状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: UserWise 问卷将无法打开或通过此页面提交。

en.description: Vanadium Android opens this activity when Android discovers a matching Vanadium NFC tag; it reads the shared handoff and opens the target screen or action.
en.disableEffect: NFC handoffs and shared actions that use Vanadium Beam will not open.

zh-CN.description: Android 检测到匹配的 Vanadium NFC 标签时，Vanadium Android SDK 会打开此页面，读取分享内容并打开对应的应用页面或操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，通过 Vanadium Beam 发起的 NFC 分享或跳转将无法打开。

en.description: Vanadium Android starts this screen when an app asks it to create a Vanadium identity blessing; it lets the user choose or approve a Google account, then retrieves and returns the identity credentials.
en.disableEffect: Vanadium identity approval and credential setup will fail, so features that depend on that login cannot complete.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求创建 Vanadium 身份凭据时，Vanadium Android SDK 会打开此页面，让用户选择或确认 Google 账号，再获取并返回身份凭据。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，Vanadium 身份授权和凭据创建无法完成，依赖这些登录信息的功能也会失败。

en.description: Vanadium Android runs this service when Google Cloud Messaging delivers a message; the message wakes Vanadium background services.
en.disableEffect: Vanadium background services will no longer wake in response to cloud messages.

zh-CN.description: Google Cloud Messaging 向设备发送消息时，Vanadium Android SDK 会运行此服务并唤醒 Vanadium 后台服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，Vanadium 后台服务不会再因云端消息而唤醒。

en.description: Vanadium Android runs this service during push registration; it fetches and saves the device's Google Cloud Messaging token, then starts the Vanadium services that rely on push.
en.disableEffect: Vanadium's push token will not be registered and push-dependent background services may not start.

zh-CN.description: Vanadium Android SDK 注册推送时运行此服务，获取并保存设备的 Google Cloud Messaging 令牌，然后启动依赖推送的后台服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，Vanadium 推送令牌无法注册，依赖推送启动的后台服务也可能无法运行。

en.description: When Google Cloud Messaging refreshes the device token, Vanadium Android starts a new registration and restarts the services that use that token.
en.disableEffect: After a token refresh, Vanadium push delivery may stop until registration is restored.

zh-CN.description: Google Cloud Messaging 更新设备令牌时，Vanadium Android SDK 会重新注册令牌，并重启使用该令牌的后台服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，设备令牌刷新时 Vanadium 推送可能无法恢复。

en.description: Baku Toolkit starts this service when a Vanadium app starts or binds to Syncbase; it opens a local Syncbase database and keeps it running briefly after the app disconnects.
en.disableEffect: Apps using Syncbase will not be able to start their local distributed database or keep it running for synchronization.

zh-CN.description: Vanadium 应用启动或绑定 Syncbase 时，Baku Toolkit 会运行此服务，启动本地 Syncbase 数据库，并在应用断开后短暂保持运行。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖 Syncbase 的应用将无法启动本地分布式数据库，也无法保持它运行以进行数据同步。

en.description: Vanite Compose’s error page opens when the app routes a problem to it, showing the configured title, optional error details, message and image; Back closes the page only when dismissal is enabled.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot display this error page or return through it, which may break its error handling flow.

zh-CN.description: 应用将问题转交给 Vanite Compose 时会打开错误页面，显示配置的标题、可选错误详情、说明和图片；只有允许关闭时，用户才能按返回键离开。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法显示此错误页面或从该页面返回，错误处理流程可能因此失效。

en.description: Vantiq Android UI SDK runs this Firebase service when Vantiq sends a push; it applies location-tracking changes and handles location-update requests.
en.disableEffect: Vantiq location commands and push-driven location updates will no longer reach the app.

zh-CN.description: Vantiq Android UI SDK 收到 Firebase 推送时会运行此服务，处理位置跟踪设置和位置更新请求。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，应用将收不到 Vantiq 的位置跟踪指令和推送触发的位置更新。

en.description: Vantiq Android UI SDK opens this activity to request foreground or background location access or to end a Vantiq sign-in session; it returns the permission or logout result to the SDK.
en.disableEffect: Vantiq location permission prompts and sign-out completion may fail.

zh-CN.description: Vantiq Android UI SDK 在请求前台或后台位置权限，以及结束 Vantiq 登录会话时，会打开此页面并返回处理结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，Vantiq 的位置授权请求和登录退出操作可能无法完成。

en.description: Vantiq Android UI SDK opens this activity for sign-in or account authorization; it loads the configured login page or opens an authorization browser, then returns tokens and account details to the app.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot complete Vantiq login or return sign-in credentials to the app.

zh-CN.description: Vantiq Android UI SDK 在用户登录或授权账号时打开此页面，加载登录页面或启动授权浏览器，再把令牌和账号信息返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，用户无法完成 Vantiq 登录或将登录凭据返回应用。

en.description: Vantiq Android UI SDK runs this Firebase service when Vantiq sends a push; it applies location-tracking changes, handles location-update requests, and forwards app-message payloads to the app.
en.disableEffect: Vantiq push messages, including location updates, will no longer reach the app.

zh-CN.description: Vantiq Android UI SDK 收到 Firebase 推送时会运行此服务，处理位置跟踪设置和位置更新请求，并将应用消息交给应用处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，应用将收不到 Vantiq 推送处理的消息和位置更新。

en.description: ptyagicodecamp's test_library sample library opens this screen to display an image bundled with the library.
en.disableEffect: The test_library sample image screen will not open.

zh-CN.description: ptyagicodecamp 的 test_library 示例库打开此页面，显示库中附带的一张图片。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，test_library 附带的示例图片页面将无法打开。

en.description: Vitamio opens this screen when media playback needs decoder setup. It loads the playback decoder and then opens the requested media screen when initialization succeeds.
en.disableEffect: Media playback features that rely on Vitamio may fail to start.

zh-CN.description: 媒体播放需要初始化解码器时，Vitamio 会打开此页面加载播放解码器；初始化成功后再打开请求的媒体页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖 Vitamio 的媒体播放功能可能无法启动。

en.description: Weavr Secure Components opens this screen in its identity-verification flow to show required terms documents, track reading, and submit the user's acceptance.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot review or accept required verification terms, so that onboarding step cannot complete.

zh-CN.description: Weavr Secure Components 在身份验证流程中打开此页面，展示必读条款、记录阅读状态，并提交用户的接受结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，用户无法查看或接受必需的验证条款，相关开户或身份验证步骤无法完成。

en.description: Weavr Secure Components opens this screen for biometric or passcode checks used by sign-in, payment authorization, beneficiary management, or 3-D Secure challenges.
en.disableEffect: The related login, payment, beneficiary, and 3-D Secure verification flows cannot complete.

zh-CN.description: Weavr Secure Components 在登录、付款授权、受益人管理或 3-D Secure 验证时打开此页面，完成生物识别或密码验证。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，相关登录、付款、受益人管理和 3-D Secure 验证流程将无法完成。

en.description: Weavr Secure Components opens this screen in its identity-verification flow to show required terms documents, track reading, and submit the user's acceptance.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot review or accept required verification terms, so that onboarding step cannot complete.

zh-CN.description: Weavr Secure Components 在身份验证流程中打开此页面，展示必读条款、记录阅读状态，并提交用户的接受结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，用户无法查看或接受必需的验证条款，相关开户或身份验证步骤无法完成。

en.description: Weavr Secure Components opens this screen for biometric or passcode checks used by sign-in, payment authorization, beneficiary management, or 3-D Secure challenges.
en.disableEffect: The related login, payment, beneficiary, and 3-D Secure verification flows cannot complete.

zh-CN.description: Weavr Secure Components 在登录、付款授权、受益人管理或 3-D Secure 验证时打开此页面，完成生物识别或密码验证。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，相关登录、付款、受益人管理和 3-D Secure 验证流程将无法完成。

en.description: Kotle PlayerModule runs when the app resumes scheduled downloads. It keeps video downloads running in the background and shows their progress.
en.disableEffect: Scheduled video downloads and their progress notifications may stop working.

zh-CN.description: Kotle PlayerModule 会在应用恢复计划中的下载任务时运行，负责后台视频下载并显示下载进度。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，计划中的视频下载及其进度通知可能无法正常工作。

en.description: Abrin's cloud messaging SDK opens this screen when it needs phone-state permission; after permission is granted, it initializes Abrin messaging.
en.disableEffect: Abrin's permission request and the cloud push setup that follows it will not run.

zh-CN.description: Abrin 云消息 SDK 需要读取手机状态权限时会打开此界面；获得授权后，它会初始化 Abrin 消息服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Abrin 的权限请求及后续云推送初始化都不会运行。

en.description: Abrin's cloud messaging SDK uses this background service to process push registration, incoming messages, errors, and tag events for the app.
en.disableEffect: Abrin will no longer deliver these background push events to the app.

zh-CN.description: Abrin 云消息 SDK 使用此后台服务处理推送注册、收到的消息、错误和标签事件，并将事件交给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Abrin 将无法再向应用传递这些后台推送事件。

en.description: Abrin's cloud messaging SDK starts this service for network dispatch and uses it to maintain a connection to Abrin's messaging server and receive push messages.
en.disableEffect: Abrin cloud push and message delivery will stop.

zh-CN.description: Abrin 云消息 SDK 会为网络调度启动此服务，并通过它维持与 Abrin 消息服务器的连接以接收推送。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Abrin 云推送和消息接收将停止。

en.description: Abrin's cloud messaging SDK uses this receiver after device startup and network changes to start or stop its push connection according to connectivity.
en.disableEffect: Abrin push may not restart after reboot or reconnect after the network changes.

zh-CN.description: 设备启动或网络状态变化后，Abrin 云消息 SDK 会通过此接收器按网络连接情况启动或停止推送连接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，设备重启后 Abrin 推送可能无法恢复，网络变化后也可能无法重新连接。

en.description: Abrin's protected registration-request broadcast reaches this receiver, which wakes and forwards the request to Abrin's background service.
en.disableEffect: Abrin registration requests will no longer be forwarded to its background handler.

zh-CN.description: Abrin 的受保护注册请求广播会交给此接收器；它会唤醒 Abrin 后台服务并转发请求。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Abrin 注册请求将无法再转发给后台处理服务。

en.description: Abrin's registration-request receiver targets this background service, but its work handler performs no action in SDK version 0.8.0.
en.disableEffect: No user-visible behavior was found in this release that disabling this service would remove.

zh-CN.description: Abrin 的注册请求接收器会启动此后台服务，但在 0.8.0 版 SDK 中，该服务没有执行任何操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 在此版本中，未发现停用该服务会移除任何用户可见功能。

en.description: Apptimize SDK Countly push handler opens this Activity when a user taps a push notification or one of its action buttons. It records the selected action, dismisses the notification, and opens the configured screen or link.
en.disableEffect: Countly push notification taps and action buttons will no longer be handled by this component; ordinary app use continues.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击推送通知正文或操作按钮时，Apptimize SDK 中的 Countly 推送处理器会打开此 Activity。它记录所选操作、关闭通知，并打开相应页面或链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，此组件将不再处理 Countly 推送通知的点击和操作按钮；应用的日常使用不受影响。

en.description: Fanap Pod Notification handles taps on push notifications, records them as seen, and opens the configured app screen, link, or phone action.
en.disableEffect: Fanap push taps will no longer be recorded or routed to their configured destination.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击推送通知时，Fanap Pod Notification 会记录通知已查看，并打开指定的应用页面、链接或拨号操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Fanap 推送通知的点击将不再记录，也不会跳转到指定目标。

en.description: Fanap Pod Notification records when the user dismisses one of its push alerts.
en.disableEffect: The SDK will no longer record that a push alert was dismissed.

zh-CN.description: 用户清除 Fanap Pod Notification 的推送提醒时，此接收器会记录该操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: SDK 将不再记录推送提醒已被清除。

en.description: Fanap Pod Notification receives Firebase data pushes and reports that each identified message has been received.
en.disableEffect: Data pushes handled by this SDK will no longer receive its delivery update.

zh-CN.description: Fanap Pod Notification 会接收 Firebase 数据推送，并报告已识别消息已送达。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 该 SDK 处理的数据推送将不再收到送达状态更新。

en.description: When a user taps a Netcore Smartech InTrack push notification, this short-lived Activity forwards the notification’s target link or action to the app and closes.
en.disableEffect: Tapping an InTrack push notification will no longer open its linked page or action.

zh-CN.description: 用户点按 Netcore Smartech InTrack 推送时，这个短暂显示的界面会把通知链接或操作交给应用处理，然后关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 屏蔽后，点按 InTrack 推送将无法打开关联页面或执行对应操作。

en.description: Mapir Live Tracking listens for status, error, and location broadcasts from its tracking service, passes location updates to the app, and can restart tracking after the service stops.
en.disableEffect: The app may lose live location updates, tracking status, and automatic recovery of its tracking service.

zh-CN.description: Mapir 实时追踪 SDK 会监听追踪服务发出的状态、错误和位置消息，将位置更新交给应用，并可在服务停止后恢复追踪。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用可能收不到实时位置和追踪状态，也无法自动恢复追踪服务。

en.description: Mapir Live Tracking starts this service for a tracking session; it requests location updates and sends the device's coordinates to Mapir's server at the configured interval. Background sessions use a foreground notification.
en.disableEffect: Live-location publishing and background tracking in the app will stop.

zh-CN.description: Mapir 实时追踪 SDK 会在追踪期间启动此服务，按设定间隔获取位置并将设备坐标发送到 Mapir 服务器；后台追踪时会显示持续通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用的实时位置上传和后台追踪将停止。

en.description: MBaaS.ir listens for completed downloads and, after a successful APK download, opens Android's installer for the user.
en.disableEffect: An managed by MBaaS app update will no longer open the installer automatically after downloading.

zh-CN.description: MBaaS.ir 会监听下载完成事件；APK 成功下载后，它会为用户打开 Android 安装程序。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，MBaaS 管理的应用更新下载完成时将不会自动打开安装程序。

en.description: MBaaS.ir handles push notification buttons by opening the app with the message data or opening the button's web link, then dismissing the notification.
en.disableEffect: Push-notification buttons will stop opening the app or their linked pages.

zh-CN.description: MBaaS.ir 负责处理推送通知按钮：打开应用并传入消息数据，或打开按钮对应的网页，然后清除通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，推送通知按钮将无法打开应用或对应网页。

en.description: MBaaS.ir handles choices on app update notifications. Choosing Update starts an APK download, while choosing Later schedules the next reminder.
en.disableEffect: The app's MBaaS update prompt will no longer download or postpone updates when its buttons are tapped.

zh-CN.description: MBaaS.ir 会处理应用更新通知中的选择：点按立即更新会下载 APK，点按稍后会安排下次提醒。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，点按 MBaaS 更新通知的按钮将无法下载更新或推迟提醒。

en.description: MBaaS.ir receives Google Cloud Messaging pushes, forwards them to the app's listener, and displays or acknowledges each message according to its settings.
en.disableEffect: The app will no longer receive MBaaS push messages or their notifications through this service.

zh-CN.description: MBaaS.ir 通过 Google Cloud Messaging 接收推送，将消息交给应用处理，并按设置显示通知或确认消息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用将无法通过此服务接收 MBaaS 推送消息和通知。

en.description: MBaaS.ir runs this service when Google refreshes its messaging token; it stores the new token and registers the device for push delivery.
en.disableEffect: Refreshed push tokens will not be registered with MBaaS, so push delivery can stop.

zh-CN.description: Google 刷新消息令牌时，MBaaS.ir 会通过此服务保存新令牌并重新注册设备，以继续接收推送。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，刷新后的推送令牌将无法向 MBaaS 注册，推送可能因此中断。

en.description: Metrix's deep link SDK opens this Activity when a link launches the app; it reads the link and routes a valid Metrix deep link or returns the user to the app's launcher screen.
en.disableEffect: Links handled through Metrix may no longer open their intended in-app destination.

zh-CN.description: 通过链接启动应用时，Metrix 深链 SDK 会打开此界面并读取链接，将有效的 Metrix 深链交给应用处理；无法识别时会返回应用首页。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，经 Metrix 处理的链接可能无法打开预期的应用内页面。

en.description: Android runs this provider when the app starts to initialize Metrix analytics and attribution. The SDK also installs its crash-reporting handler during setup.
en.disableEffect: Metrix analytics, attribution, and crash reporting will not start.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，Android 会运行此提供程序来初始化 Metrix 数据分析和归因功能。SDK 还会在初始化时安装崩溃报告处理程序。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 屏蔽后，Metrix 数据分析、归因和崩溃报告将不会启动。

en.description: Metrix initializes its installed modules automatically when the app process starts. This prepares services such as analytics, attribution, and deep links.
en.disableEffect: Metrix analytics and related modules will not initialize automatically.

zh-CN.description: 应用进程启动时，Metrix 会自动初始化已安装的模块，为数据分析、归因和深链等服务做好准备。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Metrix 数据分析及相关模块将无法自动初始化。

en.description: Metrix Notification opens this Activity when it needs to request an Android permission, such as notification permission. It shows the system prompt and returns the user’s choice to Metrix.
en.disableEffect: Metrix cannot request that permission through this screen, so related notification features may stop working.

zh-CN.description: Metrix 通知 SDK 需要申请 Android 权限（例如通知权限）时会打开此界面。它显示系统权限提示，并把用户的选择返回给 Metrix。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 屏蔽后，Metrix 无法通过此界面申请该权限，相关通知功能可能无法使用。

en.description: Android runs this Metrix Notification provider when the app process starts. It sets up Firebase messaging, notification handling, and scheduled message work.
en.disableEffect: Metrix push and scheduled notifications will not be initialized, so those notifications may stop arriving.

zh-CN.description: 应用进程启动时，Android 会运行 Metrix 通知 SDK 的初始化提供程序。它设置 Firebase 消息、通知处理和定时消息任务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 屏蔽后，Metrix 推送和定时通知无法完成初始化，可能不再送达。

en.description: When Firebase delivers a push or refreshes its registration token, this Metrix Notification service forwards the message or token to the SDK. It handles Metrix messages received through Firebase.
en.disableEffect: Metrix push messages and token updates will no longer reach the notification SDK.

zh-CN.description: Firebase 收到推送或更新注册令牌时，Metrix 通知服务会把消息或令牌交给 SDK 处理。它负责接收通过 Firebase 发送的 Metrix 消息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 屏蔽后，Metrix 推送消息和令牌更新将无法传给通知 SDK。

en.description: Metrix Notification opens this Activity when it needs to request an Android permission, such as notification permission. It shows the system prompt and returns the user’s choice to Metrix.
en.disableEffect: Metrix cannot request that permission through this screen, so related notification features may stop working.

zh-CN.description: Metrix 通知 SDK 需要申请 Android 权限（例如通知权限）时会打开此界面。它显示系统权限提示，并把用户的选择返回给 Metrix。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 屏蔽后，Metrix 无法通过此界面申请该权限，相关通知功能可能无法使用。

en.description: Metrix starts this service when a user taps a push notification, presses one of its buttons, or dismisses it. It runs the chosen notification action and reports clicks or dismissals to Metrix.
en.disableEffect: Notification buttons and click or dismissal handling will not run, so linked screens and notification actions may fail.

zh-CN.description: 用户点按 Metrix 推送、点击其中的按钮或关闭通知时，Metrix 会启动此服务。它执行相应操作，并向 Metrix 记录点击或关闭事件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 屏蔽后，通知按钮、点击和关闭操作将无法处理，关联页面或操作可能失效。

en.description: Metrix starts this receiver when a user taps the notification that says an app download is complete. It opens Android’s installer for the downloaded app.
en.disableEffect: Tapping a completed-download notification will no longer open the installer.

zh-CN.description: 用户点按应用下载完成通知时，Metrix 会启动此接收器。它会为已下载的应用打开 Android 安装界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 屏蔽后，点按下载完成通知将无法打开安装界面。

en.description: When Android reports that an app file has finished downloading, Metrix checks the result and records the download. Depending on the message settings, it starts installation or posts a completion notification.
en.disableEffect: Metrix will not process completed app downloads, so automatic installation or the completion notification may be skipped.

zh-CN.description: Android 报告应用文件下载完成后，Metrix 会检查结果并记录下载。它会根据消息设置启动安装，或显示下载完成通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 屏蔽后，Metrix 无法处理已完成的应用下载，自动安装或完成通知可能不会发生。

en.description: Android triggers this Metrix receiver when a scheduled notification is due. It reads the stored message and asks Metrix to display it.
en.disableEffect: Scheduled Metrix notifications will not appear when they are due.

zh-CN.description: Metrix 定时通知到期时，Android 会触发此接收器。它读取已保存的消息并让 Metrix 显示通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 屏蔽后，Metrix 定时通知到期时将不会显示。

en.description: After Android finishes rebooting, this receiver tells Metrix Notification to resume its notification lifecycle and restore scheduled message handling.
en.disableEffect: Scheduled Metrix notifications may not resume after the device restarts.

zh-CN.description: Android 完成重启后，此接收器会通知 Metrix 通知 SDK 恢复通知流程和定时消息处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 屏蔽后，设备重启后 Metrix 定时通知可能无法恢复。

en.description: Metrix opens this Activity for a notification dialog. It displays the message, optional input fields, and buttons supplied with that message.
en.disableEffect: Metrix in-app notification dialogs and their button actions will not appear.

zh-CN.description: Metrix 需要显示通知对话框时会打开此界面。它展示消息内容、可选输入框和消息提供的按钮。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 屏蔽后，Metrix 应用内通知对话框及其按钮操作将无法显示。

en.description: When a user taps a Metrix notification, this short-lived Activity forwards its action to Metrix’s notification handler and then closes.
en.disableEffect: Tapping a Metrix push notification will no longer run its action.

zh-CN.description: 用户点按 Metrix 通知时，这个短暂显示的界面会把操作交给 Metrix 通知处理程序，然后立即关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 屏蔽后，点按 Metrix 推送将无法执行对应操作。

en.description: When Metrix opens a notification link inside the app, this Activity loads the supplied web page in a browser view.
en.disableEffect: Web pages opened from Metrix notifications will no longer open inside the app.

zh-CN.description: Metrix 需要在应用内打开通知链接时，会由此界面在内置网页视图中加载页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 屏蔽后，Metrix 通知中的网页将无法在应用内打开。

en.description: Metrix's referrer SDK receives Cafe Bazaar's app-install referrer response and passes it to Metrix for attribution.
en.disableEffect: Metrix will lose Cafe Bazaar install source data used for attribution.

zh-CN.description: Metrix 来源追踪 SDK 会接收 Cafe Bazaar 返回的应用安装来源信息，并将其交给 Metrix 做归因分析。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Metrix 将无法获取用于归因的 Cafe Bazaar 安装来源信息。

en.description: Tapsell runs this provider when the app starts to initialize its core ad modules before the app requests ads.
en.disableEffect: Tapsell ads will not initialize; rewarded ads will not play, so rewards for watching them will no longer be granted.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，Tapsell 会运行此提供程序，在应用请求广告前初始化广告核心模块。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 屏蔽后，Tapsell 广告将无法初始化；奖励广告无法播放，观看广告也不会获得奖励。

en.description: This older Tapsell provider initializes the SDK’s ad components when the app starts, before the app requests ads.
en.disableEffect: Tapsell ads will not initialize; rewarded ads will not play, so rewards for watching them will no longer be granted.

zh-CN.description: 这个旧版 Tapsell 提供程序会在应用启动时初始化广告组件，以便应用之后请求广告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 屏蔽后，Tapsell 广告将无法初始化；奖励广告无法播放，观看广告也不会获得奖励。

en.description: Tapsell Billboard opens this Activity to display a full-screen ad creative and report when it closes or finishes.
en.disableEffect: Billboard full-screen ads will not display; rewards for watching rewarded placements will no longer be granted.

zh-CN.description: Tapsell Billboard 展示全屏广告时会打开此界面，并在广告结束或关闭时返回结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 屏蔽后，Billboard 全屏广告将无法显示；观看奖励广告也不会获得奖励。

en.description: Android runs this Tapsell Mediation provider when the app starts. It builds the mediation SDK’s core services so ad networks can be set up.
en.disableEffect: Tapsell mediation ads will not initialize; rewarded ads will not play, so rewards for watching them will no longer be granted.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，Android 会运行 Tapsell Mediation 提供程序，构建中介 SDK 的核心服务以便配置广告网络。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 屏蔽后，Tapsell 中介广告将无法初始化；奖励广告无法播放，观看广告也不会获得奖励。

en.description: Tapsell Mediation runs this provider at app startup to initialize its core and registered ad network modules.
en.disableEffect: Tapsell mediation ads will not initialize; rewarded ads will not play, so rewards for watching them will no longer be granted.

zh-CN.description: Tapsell Mediation 会在应用启动时运行此提供程序，初始化核心模块和已注册的广告网络模块。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 屏蔽后，Tapsell 中介广告将无法初始化；奖励广告无法播放，观看广告也不会获得奖励。

en.description: Tapsell opens this Activity to show video or banner ads and lets viewers follow an ad’s web page or app action. It reports whether rewarded video was completed or closed.
en.disableEffect: Tapsell ads will not display; rewards for watching Tapsell rewarded ads will no longer be granted.

zh-CN.description: Tapsell 展示视频或横幅广告时会打开此界面，也可让用户前往广告网页或应用操作。它会记录奖励视频是否看完或关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 屏蔽后，Tapsell 广告将无法显示；观看 Tapsell 奖励广告也不会获得奖励。

en.description: Leap AUI receives control messages from Leap Creator to start or stop a preview and apply project, locale, or developer-mode changes to the app’s interface.
en.disableEffect: Leap Creator will not be able to control AUI previews or apply these live interface changes.

zh-CN.description: Leap AUI 会接收 Leap Creator 的控制消息，用于启动或停止预览，并将项目、语言或开发模式设置应用到界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 屏蔽后，Leap Creator 将无法控制 AUI 预览或实时应用这些界面更改。

en.description: Android runs this provider when the app starts to initialize the Leap AUI runtime and make its interface preview controls available.
en.disableEffect: Leap AUI will not initialize at startup, so screens or live previews that depend on it may fail.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，Android 会运行此提供程序来初始化 Leap AUI，并启用界面预览控制。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 屏蔽后，Leap AUI 将无法在启动时初始化，依赖它的界面或实时预览可能无法工作。

en.description: Android runs this provider at app startup to initialize Leap Creator, which supplies the app’s project-preview and connection tools.
en.disableEffect: Leap Creator setup will not run, so its sign-in, QR pairing, or live-preview flows may fail.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，Android 会运行此提供程序来初始化 Leap Creator，并启用项目预览和连接工具。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 屏蔽后，Leap Creator 将无法完成初始化，登录、二维码配对或实时预览流程可能失效。

en.description: The Leap Creator Android SDK receiver runs when Leap's developer platform matches the app's API key, then starts a Creator session. The SDK registers this receiver at runtime; its manifest entry has no intent filter.
en.disableEffect: Blocking the manifest entry does not remove the runtime pairing listener or affect the app's normal screens.

zh-CN.description: Leap Creator Android SDK 的接收器会在 Leap 开发平台确认应用密钥后启动 Creator 会话。SDK 会在运行时注册该接收器；清单中的声明没有意图过滤器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用清单中的声明不会移除运行时配对监听器，也不会影响应用的日常界面。

en.description: When a user chooses End Preview or Disconnect in a Leap Creator session notification, this receiver updates the notification and Creator session.
en.disableEffect: The notification’s session-ending action will not be handled, so a live preview or connection may not stop normally.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Leap Creator 会话通知中选择结束预览或断开连接时，此接收器会更新通知和 Creator 会话。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 屏蔽后，通知中的结束会话操作将无法处理，实时预览或连接可能无法正常停止。

en.description: Leap Creator runs this foreground service during a preview or connection session and shows an ongoing notification with a session action.
en.disableEffect: The Creator session may lose its ongoing notification and its normal stop or disconnect controls.

zh-CN.description: Leap Creator 在预览或连接会话期间运行此前台服务，并显示带会话操作的持续通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 屏蔽后，Creator 会话可能失去持续通知及常用的停止或断开控制。

en.description: Leap Creator opens this screen when a one-time code is needed to sign in or validate a Creator account.
en.disableEffect: The in-app one-time-code step will not open, so Leap Creator sign-in may not complete.

zh-CN.description: Leap Creator 需要通过一次性验证码登录或验证 Creator 账户时会打开此界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 屏蔽后，应用内验证码界面无法打开，Leap Creator 登录可能无法完成。

en.description: Leap Creator opens this screen to scan a project or pairing QR code with the camera and connect to a preview or shared session.
en.disableEffect: QR-code pairing and camera-based preview setup in Leap Creator will not work.

zh-CN.description: Leap Creator 会打开此界面，用相机扫描项目或配对二维码，以连接预览或共享会话。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 屏蔽后，Leap Creator 将无法通过二维码配对或使用相机设置预览。

en.description: The earlier Leap Creator Android SDK preview flow explicitly opens this camera activity to scan a project or sample-app QR code, fetch its preview setup, and begin on-device preview.
en.disableEffect: Leap Creator's QR-based developer preview sessions will no longer start through this scanner.

zh-CN.description: 较早版本的 Leap Creator Android SDK 会显式打开此相机界面，扫描项目或示例应用二维码、获取预览配置并启动设备端预览。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Leap Creator 将无法通过此扫描器启动二维码开发者预览会话。

en.description: The Leap Creator Android SDK developer screen opens from its debug dashboard and lets developers edit SDK connection settings, project and locale details, and custom user properties. It also controls diagnostic logging and links to saved logs.
en.disableEffect: The SDK's developer settings and custom-property controls become unavailable; the app's regular screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: Leap Creator Android SDK 的开发者界面从调试面板打开，可修改 SDK 连接设置、项目和语言信息以及自定义用户属性。它还可控制诊断日志并打开已保存的日志。
zh-CN.disableEffect: SDK 的开发者设置和自定义属性工具将无法使用，应用的日常界面仍可使用。

en.description: The Leap Creator Android SDK debug dashboard opens from the SDK's developer controls and shows connection details and diagnostic-log status. It also opens setup and user-data pages and can upload SDK logs.
en.disableEffect: Leap Creator's troubleshooting dashboard and log-sharing controls become unavailable; regular app screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: Leap Creator Android SDK 的调试面板从开发者工具打开，显示连接信息和诊断日志状态。它还可打开设置和用户数据页面，并上传 SDK 日志。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Leap Creator 的故障排查面板和日志分享工具将无法使用，应用的日常界面仍可使用。

en.description: When a developer selects an API check in Leap Creator's network diagnostics, this screen shows its success or error message and the related HTTP log.
en.disableEffect: Developers can no longer open the selected request's diagnostic details; the app's own network requests continue.

zh-CN.description: 开发者在 Leap Creator 的网络诊断中选择一项接口检查后，此界面会显示成功或错误信息以及相关的 HTTP 日志。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 开发者将无法查看所选请求的诊断详情，但应用自身的网络请求仍会照常进行。

en.description: From Leap Creator's developer settings, this screen displays recent SDK diagnostic logs and lets developers refresh the list or filter entries by type.
en.disableEffect: Leap Creator's saved-log viewer becomes unavailable; regular app screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: 从 Leap Creator 的开发者设置中打开此界面，可查看近期 SDK 诊断日志、刷新列表并按类型筛选日志。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Leap Creator 的已保存日志查看器将无法使用，应用的日常界面仍可使用。

en.description: This Leap Creator Android SDK screen opens the project list from the developer tools so developers can inspect the available projects.
en.disableEffect: The SDK's project list will no longer open; the app's regular screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: Leap Creator Android SDK 会从开发者工具打开此项目列表，供开发者查看可用项目。
zh-CN.disableEffect: SDK 的项目列表将无法打开，应用的日常界面仍可使用。

en.description: Leap Creator's user-data page shows the SDK user ID and lets developers switch between custom and default user-property lists.
en.disableEffect: The SDK's user-property diagnostic views become unavailable; regular app screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: Leap Creator 的用户数据页面会显示 SDK 用户 ID，并可在自定义属性和默认属性列表之间切换。
zh-CN.disableEffect: SDK 的用户属性诊断界面将无法使用，应用的日常界面仍可使用。

en.description: Leap Creator's preview-pairing flow opens this screen when a developer enters a one-time secret instead of scanning a QR code. The screen can also open the camera scanner and submits the secret for authentication.
en.disableEffect: Secret-based pairing and preview setup through this screen will no longer work.

zh-CN.description: 开发者无法扫描二维码时，Leap Creator 的预览配对流程会打开此界面输入一次性密钥。界面也可打开相机扫描器，并提交密钥进行验证。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过此界面进行密钥配对和预览设置将无法使用。

en.description: Leap Creator's developer preview flow opens the camera scanner to read a project or sample-app QR code, fetch the preview setup, and connect the app to that preview.
en.disableEffect: QR-based preview setup and sample-app connection through Leap Creator will no longer work.

zh-CN.description: Leap Creator 的开发者预览流程会打开相机扫描器，读取项目或示例应用二维码、获取预览配置并连接到该预览。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Leap Creator 的二维码预览设置和示例应用连接将无法使用。

en.description: The Leap Logging Android SDK provider opens a local database for SDK log entries and log-session records when Android starts the app. Leap Creator's diagnostic screens use it to read and share saved logs.
en.disableEffect: Leap's saved diagnostic logs and log-viewing or export tools become unavailable.

zh-CN.description: Leap Logging Android SDK 的内容提供器会在 Android 启动应用时打开本地数据库，保存 SDK 日志和日志会话记录。Leap Creator 的诊断界面会从中读取并分享已保存的日志。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Leap 的已保存诊断日志以及日志查看和导出工具将无法使用。

en.description: When Hilt-based fragment tests run, this Dagger Hilt testing library launches a blank host Activity with the requested theme and hosts the fragment under test.
en.disableEffect: Tests that use this library can no longer launch their fragment; regular app screens are unaffected.

zh-CN.description: 运行 Hilt Fragment 测试时，Dagger Hilt 测试库会启动一个空白宿主 Activity，应用指定主题并承载待测 Fragment。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此测试库的测试将无法启动待测 Fragment，应用的日常界面不受影响。

en.description: The SPF2 application framework receiver runs when the framework reports that this app has been deregistered, then clears the app's stored SPF access token.
en.disableEffect: The stored SPF access token will not be cleared when the framework deregisters the app.

zh-CN.description: SPF2 应用框架会在通知此应用已注销时触发该接收器，随后清除应用保存的 SPF 访问令牌。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 框架注销此应用时，已保存的 SPF 访问令牌不会被清除。

en.description: The Sisal Bill Consumer Android SDK opens this in-app checkout page when the host app starts a Bill payment and reports whether checkout succeeded, failed, or was canceled.
en.disableEffect: Customers cannot complete the Sisal Bill payment flow through this SDK.

zh-CN.description: 宿主应用发起 Bill 付款时，Sisal Bill Consumer Android SDK 会在此界面打开应用内结账页，并返回成功、失败或取消结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此 SDK 完成 Sisal Bill 付款流程。

en.description: Jmdroid Download (Jiang Junmin) runs queued file downloads, tracks their progress and posts completion or failure notifications. The app starts it when downloads are added, resumed or restarted.
en.disableEffect: Downloads that rely on this Service may stop, fail to resume or lose their completion and failure notifications.

zh-CN.description: Jmdroid Download（Jiang Junmin）执行排队的文件下载、跟踪进度，并在成功或失败时发送通知。应用添加、恢复或重启下载时会启动此 Service。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此 Service 的下载可能停止、无法恢复，或不再收到完成和失败通知。

en.description: Jmdroid Download (Jiang Junmin) uses this Android job Service to restart a queued download when its network, idle, charging and storage requirements are met. Android calls it as a scheduled job.
en.disableEffect: Downloads waiting for suitable conditions may not restart in the background.

zh-CN.description: Jmdroid Download（Jiang Junmin）通过此 Android Job Service 在网络、空闲、充电和存储条件满足时重启排队中的下载。Android 会将它作为计划任务调用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 等待合适条件的下载可能无法在后台重新启动。

en.description: HTTP Monitor (Jiang Junmin) initializes the local store for captured request and response details when the app starts. The monitor's recording layer saves traffic there for later review.
en.disableEffect: The monitor may stop saving requests, and apps using its traffic recorder may fail when captured data cannot be stored.

zh-CN.description: HTTP Monitor（Jiang Junmin）会在应用启动时初始化已捕获请求与响应信息的本地存储区。流量记录功能会将数据存入其中，供之后查看。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 监测工具可能无法再保存请求；使用其流量记录功能的应用也可能因数据无法保存而出错。

en.description: HTTP Monitor (Jiang Junmin) displays the saved details for one recorded network request and response. It opens when the user selects an item from the traffic list.
en.disableEffect: The HTTP monitor will no longer open its per-request detail screen.

zh-CN.description: HTTP Monitor（Jiang Junmin）会显示单条已记录网络请求与响应的详细信息。用户从流量清单中选择项目后即可打开此界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: HTTP Monitor 将无法打开单条请求的详细界面。

en.description: HTTP Monitor (Jiang Junmin) lists recorded HTTP traffic and lets users refresh or clear the list. The library's launcher shortcut opens this screen.
en.disableEffect: The saved HTTP-traffic list and its refresh and clear controls will be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: HTTP Monitor（Jiang Junmin）会列出已记录的网络流量，并允许用户刷新或清除清单。库中的启动器快捷方式会打开此界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 已保存的网络流量清单以及刷新、清除功能将无法使用。

en.description: Mock API Server (Jiang Junmin) initializes its local mock service and connects to it automatically when the app starts. The server can supply mock responses from the app's configured test data.
en.disableEffect: App requests or test screens that rely on the local mock server may stop receiving their mock responses.

zh-CN.description: Mock API Server（Jiang Junmin）会在应用启动时初始化本地模拟服务并自动连接。此服务可根据应用设置的测试数据提供模拟响应。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖本地模拟服务的应用请求或测试界面可能无法再取得模拟响应。

en.description: Mock API Server (Jiang Junmin) runs a local mock-response server after its startup Provider connects to it. It loads configured test data when starting and stops the server when the service ends.
en.disableEffect: App requests configured to use this local mock server may fail or lose their mock responses.

zh-CN.description: Mock API Server（Jiang Junmin）会在启动 Provider 连接后运行本地模拟响应服务器。启动时会载入设置的测试数据，Service 结束时则停止服务器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 设置为使用此本地模拟服务器的应用请求可能失败或无法取得模拟响应。

en.description: The CyberAgent Katalog Compose UI catalog library opens this screen when the app explicitly launches its catalog of Compose interface samples.
en.disableEffect: The Katalog sample catalog will no longer open; the app's other screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: 应用显式打开 CyberAgent Katalog Compose UI 目录时，此界面会展示 Compose 界面示例。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Katalog 示例目录将无法打开，应用的其他界面仍可使用。

en.description: The maio ad SDK opens this Activity to play a full-screen video ad and report when it starts, finishes, or is skipped.
en.disableEffect: Maio video ads will not play, and rewards for watching ads will no longer be granted.

zh-CN.description: maio 广告 SDK 会打开此 Activity 播放全屏视频广告，并记录广告开始、结束或跳过的状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: maio 视频广告将无法播放，观看广告的奖励也不会再发放。

en.description: The maio ad SDK opens this Activity to render an HTML ad and its interactive controls, including links opened when the user taps the creative.
en.disableEffect: Maio HTML ads will not render, and rewards tied to completing those ads will no longer be granted.

zh-CN.description: maio 广告 SDK 会打开此 Activity 显示 HTML 广告及其交互控件，包括用户点击广告后打开的链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: maio HTML 广告将无法显示，完成此类广告对应的奖励也不会再发放。

en.description: The maio 2 ad SDK opens this Activity to display a full-screen ad using its web and video content, with controls for playback and closing.
en.disableEffect: Maio full-screen ads will not display, and rewards for watching ads will no longer be granted.

zh-CN.description: maio 2 广告 SDK 会打开此 Activity，使用网页和视频内容显示全屏广告，并提供播放和关闭控件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: maio 全屏广告将无法显示，观看广告的奖励也不会再发放。

en.description: The maio 2 ad SDK opens this Activity to show an interactive playable ad with web content, a playable view, and a close control.
en.disableEffect: Maio playable ads will not open, and rewards tied to completing ads will no longer be granted.

zh-CN.description: maio 2 广告 SDK 会打开此 Activity 显示可交互的试玩广告，其中包含网页内容、试玩画面和关闭控件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: maio 试玩广告将无法打开，完成广告对应的奖励也不会再发放。

en.description: PAY.JP Android Card Form opens this screen when the app requests card entry; it validates card details and returns a payment token, with optional 3-D Secure verification.
en.disableEffect: Card entry and checkout flows that use PAY.JP cannot complete.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求输入银行卡时，PAY.JP Android Card Form 会打开此界面、验证卡片信息并返回支付令牌，也可继续进行 3-D Secure 验证。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用 PAY.JP 的银行卡录入和结账流程将无法完成。

en.description: This PAY.JP Android Card Form screen displays searchable countries and calling codes, then returns the selected region to the card form.
en.disableEffect: The phone-country selector in the PAY.JP card form will not open, which can prevent users from entering the needed country code.

zh-CN.description: PAY.JP Android Card Form 的此界面会显示可搜索的国家和电话区号，并将选中的地区返回给银行卡表单。
zh-CN.disableEffect: PAY.JP 银行卡表单中的电话国家/地区选择器将无法打开，用户可能无法输入所需区号。

en.description: During PAY.JP 3-D Secure checks, this activity opens the verification step and receives the issuer's return link so the card form can continue.
en.disableEffect: Card payments that require 3-D Secure verification may not complete.

zh-CN.description: PAY.JP 进行 3-D Secure 验证时，此界面会打开验证步骤并接收发卡方返回链接，使银行卡表单继续处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要 3-D Secure 验证的银行卡付款可能无法完成。

en.description: When a PAY.JP 3-D Secure check uses an in-app browser, this activity displays the web challenge and sends its return link back to the verifier.
en.disableEffect: 3-D Secure checks that rely on PAY.JP's in-app browser may not finish.

zh-CN.description: PAY.JP 的 3-D Secure 验证使用应用内浏览器时，此界面会显示网页验证，并将返回链接交还给验证流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖 PAY.JP 应用内浏览器的 3-D Secure 验证可能无法完成。

en.description: IPay88 (Cambodia) opens this payment screen during checkout or when a payment app returns to the merchant app. It displays the web payment page and handles payment redirects.
en.disableEffect: IPay88 checkout or payment return links may fail, so users may be unable to complete payment.

zh-CN.description: IPay88（柬埔寨）的支付 SDK 会在结账或支付应用返回商家应用时打开此界面。它显示网页支付流程并处理支付跳转。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，IPay88 结账页面或支付返回链接可能无法打开，用户可能无法完成付款。

en.description: When a Kin wallet backup creates a recovery QR image, this Provider exposes the app's private image file so the backup screen can display or share it.
en.disableEffect: The recovery QR image cannot be opened or shared from the backup flow, so Kin wallet backup cannot be completed.

zh-CN.description: Kin 钱包备份生成恢复二维码时，此 Provider 会提供保存在应用私有文件中的图片，供备份界面显示或分享。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，备份流程无法读取或分享恢复二维码，Kin 钱包备份将无法完成。

en.description: When a user starts a Kin wallet backup, this Activity guides them through creating a password and displaying or sharing a recovery QR code.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot create and save a recovery QR backup through Kin.

zh-CN.description: 用户启动 Kin 钱包备份时，此 Activity 会引导用户设置备份密码，并显示或分享恢复二维码。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法通过 Kin 创建并保存钱包恢复二维码。

en.description: When a user starts Kin wallet recovery, this Activity lets them provide a saved recovery QR code, enter its password, and restore the wallet.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot restore a Kin wallet from its recovery QR code.

zh-CN.description: 用户启动 Kin 钱包恢复时，此 Activity 会让用户提供已保存的恢复二维码并输入密码，以恢复钱包。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法通过恢复二维码还原 Kin 钱包。

en.description: When the app opens an AndroidKit page, this screen displays that page, including the media-download page.
en.disableEffect: App pages that rely on AndroidKit's page host will not appear.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开 AndroidKit 页面时，此页面会显示相应内容，例如媒体下载页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖 AndroidKit 页面容器打开的应用页面将无法显示。

en.description: Kotle AndroidKit opens this player for a media link or item selected by the app; it plays the media and supports full-screen playback.
en.disableEffect: Media items opened through AndroidKit's player can no longer be played there.

zh-CN.description: Kotle AndroidKit 会在应用打开媒体链接或选择媒体播放时启动播放器，并支持全屏播放。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用无法再通过 AndroidKit 播放器播放分配给它的媒体。

en.description: Kotle AndroidKit runs this service during media downloads and keeps a persistent notification visible with the download title.
en.disableEffect: The AndroidKit player can no longer show its persistent download notification.

zh-CN.description: Kotle AndroidKit 会在媒体下载期间运行此服务，并持续显示包含下载标题的通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，AndroidKit 播放器无法显示此类持续下载通知。

en.description: Bootpay opens this screen for biometric card or payment flows; it shows the order and saved-card details and asks the user to confirm with fingerprint authentication.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot complete biometric payment or card registration and editing through this screen if disabled.

zh-CN.description: Bootpay 在用户使用生物识别银行卡或付款流程时会打开此界面，显示订单和已保存的银行卡信息并要求指纹确认。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过此界面完成生物识别付款或银行卡注册、编辑。

en.description: Bootpay opens this screen for biometric card or payment flows; it shows the order and saved-card details and asks the user to confirm with fingerprint authentication.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot complete biometric payment or card registration and editing through this screen if disabled.

zh-CN.description: Bootpay 在用户使用生物识别银行卡或付款流程时会打开此界面，显示订单和已保存的银行卡信息并要求指纹确认。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过此界面完成生物识别付款或银行卡注册、编辑。

en.description: Bootpay opens this screen for biometric card or payment flows; it shows the order and saved-card details and asks the user to confirm with fingerprint authentication.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot complete biometric payment or card registration and editing through this screen if disabled.

zh-CN.description: Bootpay 在用户使用生物识别银行卡或付款流程时会打开此界面，显示订单和已保存的银行卡信息并要求指纹确认。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过此界面完成生物识别付款或银行卡注册、编辑。

en.description: When the app starts a Bluetooth firmware update for a supported 1drop HomeKit device, this 1drop service runs the device-update transfer and its progress notifications.
en.disableEffect: Supported HomeKit device firmware cannot be updated through the app.

zh-CN.description: 应用为受支持的 1drop HomeKit 设备启动蓝牙固件更新时，此 1drop 服务会执行设备更新传输并显示进度通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法为受支持的 HomeKit 设备更新固件。

en.description: When the 1drop HomeKit SDK's measurement retry alarm fires, this receiver checks the device state and sends a Bluetooth control message if retries remain.
en.disableEffect: An active HomeKit measurement will not receive this retry message.

zh-CN.description: 1drop HomeKit SDK 的测量重试闹钟触发时，此组件会检查设备状态，并在仍有重试次数时发送蓝牙控制消息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 正在进行的 HomeKit 测量将无法收到此重试消息。

en.description: When Android reports a Bluetooth state change, this 1drop HomeKit receiver clears connected status for the SDK's devices when Bluetooth is turned off.
en.disableEffect: The app may show an incorrect connection status for HomeKit devices after Bluetooth is turned off.

zh-CN.description: Android 通知蓝牙状态变化时，如果蓝牙被关闭，1drop HomeKit SDK 会清除其设备的已连接状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 关闭蓝牙后，应用可能无法正确显示 HomeKit 设备的连接状态。

en.description: TouchAd (RUNCOMM) opens this full-screen page when a user views an ad offer; it loads the offer content and handles its web-based interactions.
en.disableEffect: TouchAd full-screen ads and their in-ad links will not open.

zh-CN.description: 用户查看广告优惠时，TouchAd（RUNCOMM）会打开此全屏页面，加载优惠内容并处理其中的网页交互。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，TouchAd 全屏广告及其内部链接将无法打开。

en.description: TouchAd (RUNCOMM) opens this page from an offer when a user chooses card registration. It lets them select a transit-card issuer, enter a card number, and submit it to TouchAd.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to register a transit card for TouchAd offers that require it.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 TouchAd（RUNCOMM）优惠页面选择登记交通卡时，此页面会打开，让用户选择发卡机构、输入卡号并提交给 TouchAd。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法为需要交通卡的 TouchAd 优惠登记交通卡。

en.description: TouchAd (RUNCOMM) opens this screen to display the web page supplied for an ad offer or account action, with its navigation and page controls.
en.disableEffect: TouchAd offer pages and other SDK web content will not open.

zh-CN.description: TouchAd（RUNCOMM）会打开此页面显示广告优惠或账户操作对应的网页，并提供导航和页面控件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，TouchAd 优惠页面和 SDK 的其他网页内容将无法打开。

en.description: TouchAd (RUNCOMM) starts this foreground service for app-install offers or a deferred web link. It checks whether an advertised app was installed, reports the result for offer credit, and can open a supplied page after the user unlocks the phone.
en.disableEffect: Install-offer completion checks and related TouchAd credit reporting stop, and deferred pages will not open.

zh-CN.description: TouchAd（RUNCOMM）会为应用安装类优惠或延迟打开的网页链接启动此前台服务；它检查广告应用是否已安装并上报优惠积分结果，也可在手机解锁后打开指定页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，安装类优惠的完成检查和相关积分上报将停止，延迟打开的页面也不会显示。

en.description: Motto (MobileCodit) opens this screen for a selected reward campaign. It routes ad, search, social, or website tasks to their campaign screen and returns the completion reward to the calling screen.
en.disableEffect: Motto campaign tasks opened here will not run, and their rewards will not be reported to the app.

zh-CN.description: Motto（MobileCodit）会在用户选择奖励活动后打开此界面。它会把广告、搜索、社交或网站任务转到相应页面，并将完成结果和奖励返回给调用方。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，通过此界面打开的 Motto 活动将无法进行，奖励也不会回传应用。

en.description: Motto (MobileCodit) opens this screen when its home content links to a page inside the app. It loads the supplied web page in the app.
en.disableEffect: Pages opened from Motto home content will not load in the app.

zh-CN.description: Motto（MobileCodit）会在首页内容链接到应用内网页时打开此界面，并在应用中加载指定网页。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Motto 首页中要求在应用内打开的网页将无法加载。

en.description: Motto (MobileCodit) opens this screen for its mission-account sign-in, sign-up, and account changes. The page supports Kakao sign-in and returns account results to Motto.
en.disableEffect: Users may be unable to sign in to or manage their Motto mission account, which can block account-dependent missions and rewards.

zh-CN.description: Motto（MobileCodit）会在用户登录、注册或管理任务账户时打开此界面。页面支持 Kakao 登录，并将账户结果交回 Motto。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户可能无法登录或管理 Motto 任务账户，依赖该账户的任务和奖励也可能无法使用。

en.description: Motto opens this campaign page when a reward task asks the user to search for a keyword. The page guides the task and returns its completion result and reward.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to complete keyword-search campaigns or receive their rewards through this screen.

zh-CN.description: 当奖励任务要求用户搜索指定关键词时，Motto 会打开此活动页面。页面引导用户完成任务，并返回完成结果和奖励。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过此界面完成关键词搜索活动或领取相应奖励。

en.description: Motto opens this campaign page for a Naver search task that the user completes manually. It guides the search and returns the campaign reward when the task succeeds.
en.disableEffect: Naver search campaigns opened through Motto will not complete or return their rewards.

zh-CN.description: Motto 会为需要用户手动完成的 Naver 搜索任务打开此活动页面。页面引导搜索，并在任务成功后返回奖励。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，通过 Motto 打开的 Naver 搜索活动将无法完成或返回奖励。

en.description: Motto opens this campaign page for an Instagram follow, like, save, or visit task. It guides the selected task and reports completion to the campaign screen.
en.disableEffect: Instagram reward campaigns opened through Motto will not run or return their rewards.

zh-CN.description: Motto 会为 Instagram 关注、点赞、收藏或访问任务打开此活动页面。页面引导用户完成所选任务，并将结果返回活动界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，通过 Motto 打开的 Instagram 奖励活动将无法进行或返回奖励。

en.description: Motto opens this campaign page when a reward task asks the user to visit a website. It guides the visit and returns the task result and reward.
en.disableEffect: Website-visit campaigns opened through Motto will not complete or return their rewards.

zh-CN.description: 当奖励任务要求用户访问网站时，Motto 会打开此活动页面。页面引导访问流程，并返回任务结果和奖励。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，通过 Motto 打开的网页访问活动将无法完成或返回奖励。

en.description: Motto opens this test page to show a list of campaigns used to exercise campaign launches. Selecting an entry starts the selected test campaign.
en.disableEffect: The Motto campaign test list will not open; the regular campaign flow is separate.

zh-CN.description: Motto 会打开此测试页面，显示用于测试活动启动流程的活动列表。选择列表项目会启动对应的测试活动。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Motto 活动测试列表将无法打开；常规活动流程使用其他页面。

en.description: Motto opens this cost-per-click ad campaign when the user selects the offer. It displays the ad and reports the campaign result when the required interaction is completed.
en.disableEffect: Motto click-based ad offers will not open or report their campaign rewards.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择按点击计费的广告活动时，Motto 会打开此页面。页面展示广告，并在完成所需互动后返回活动结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Motto 点击类广告将无法打开或返回活动奖励。

en.description: Motto opens this view-based ad campaign when the user selects the offer. It loads the ad, tracks the required viewing time, and reports the reward after completion.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to complete these ad views; rewards for watching these ads will no longer be granted.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择按观看计费的广告活动时，Motto 会打开此页面。页面加载广告、记录要求的观看时长，并在完成后返回奖励。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法完成这些广告观看任务，也不会再获得观看广告的奖励。

en.description: Motto opens this campaign page to load a third-party ad-network offer. It reports the campaign reward when the ad task completes.
en.disableEffect: Third-party ad-network offers through Motto will not load or return their rewards.

zh-CN.description: Motto 会打开此活动页面加载第三方广告网络的广告任务，并在任务完成后返回活动奖励。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Motto 中的第三方广告网络任务将无法加载或返回奖励。

en.description: Motto opens this page for a manually completed keyword-search campaign. It guides the search task and returns the reward when the campaign succeeds.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to finish these keyword-search campaigns or receive their rewards.

zh-CN.description: Motto 会为需要用户手动完成的关键词搜索活动打开此页面。页面引导搜索任务，并在活动成功后返回奖励。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法完成此类关键词搜索活动或领取相应奖励。

en.description: Motto opens this page for a manually completed Naver campaign. It guides the user through the search task and returns the reward when it succeeds.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to complete these Naver campaigns or receive their rewards through Motto.

zh-CN.description: Motto 会为需要用户手动完成的 Naver 活动打开此页面。页面引导搜索任务，并在成功后返回奖励。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过 Motto 完成此类 Naver 活动或领取奖励。

en.description: Motto opens this page for a manually completed website-visit campaign. It guides the visit and returns the campaign result and reward.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to finish these website-visit campaigns or receive their rewards through Motto.

zh-CN.description: Motto 会为需要用户手动完成的网站访问活动打开此页面。页面引导访问流程，并返回活动结果和奖励。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过 Motto 完成此类网站访问活动或领取奖励。

en.description: Motto opens this in-app page for a keyword-search campaign. It guides the search task inside the app and reports the reward when the user completes it.
en.disableEffect: In-app keyword-search campaigns will not run or return their rewards through Motto.

zh-CN.description: Motto 会为关键词搜索活动打开此应用内页面，在应用中引导搜索，并在用户完成后返回奖励。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Motto 应用内关键词搜索活动将无法进行或返回奖励。

en.description: Motto opens this in-app page for an Instagram follow, like, save, or visit campaign. It guides the selected task and reports completion to Motto.
en.disableEffect: In-app Instagram reward campaigns will not run or return their rewards.

zh-CN.description: Motto 会为 Instagram 关注、点赞、收藏或访问活动打开此应用内页面。页面引导用户完成所选任务，并将结果返回 Motto。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Motto 应用内 Instagram 奖励活动将无法进行或返回奖励。

en.description: Motto opens this in-app page for a website-visit campaign. It guides the visit inside the app and returns the campaign reward when the task succeeds.
en.disableEffect: In-app website-visit campaigns will not complete or return their rewards.

zh-CN.description: Motto 会为网站访问活动打开此应用内页面，在应用中引导访问，并在任务成功后返回奖励。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Motto 应用内网页访问活动将无法完成或返回奖励。

en.description: Motto opens this optional Hall of Fame page from its home screen. The page displays a Naver blog inside the app.
en.disableEffect: The Motto Hall of Fame page will not open; other Motto screens are separate.

zh-CN.description: Motto 会从首页打开此可选的名誉殿堂页面，并在应用中显示 Naver 博客。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Motto 名誉殿堂页面将无法打开，其他 Motto 页面不受此界面影响。

en.description: Motto opens this screen to show the user's available reward missions. Selecting a mission opens its task page, and the list updates after completion.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to browse or launch Motto reward missions from this screen.

zh-CN.description: Motto 会打开此界面显示用户可参与的奖励任务。选择任务会进入任务页面，完成后列表会更新。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过此界面浏览或启动 Motto 奖励任务。

en.description: Nectarine Fruity checks Google Play services and refreshes push registration after the device starts or the app is replaced.
en.disableEffect: Fruity will no longer refresh push registration after startup or an app update.

zh-CN.description: Nectarine Fruity 会在设备启动或应用更新后检查 Google Play 服务并刷新推送注册信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Fruity 将无法在设备启动或应用更新后刷新推送注册。

en.description: Nectarine Fruity saves the registration ID returned by Google push services for later message delivery.
en.disableEffect: Fruity will not save that registration ID, which can stop the app’s push messages from arriving.

zh-CN.description: Google 推送服务返回注册编号时，Nectarine Fruity 会将其保存供后续消息投递使用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Fruity 将无法保存推送注册编号，应用的推送消息可能无法送达。

en.description: The Kusu Chat Escape SDK receiver runs when Android reports a connectivity or Wi-Fi state change. It shows the connection status and reconnects the chat socket if the SDK is already initialized.
en.disableEffect: Network changes will no longer reconnect an initialized chat socket, so chat may stay disconnected after switching networks.

zh-CN.description: Android 报告网络连接或 Wi-Fi 状态变化时，Kusu Chat Escape SDK 的接收器会显示当前连接状态，并在 SDK 已初始化时重新连接聊天服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，网络变化不会触发已初始化的聊天服务重新连接，切换网络后聊天可能会中断。

en.description: When the app opens Chat Escape, this Kusu Chat Escape SDK Activity connects to the chat service and shows messages and action buttons. Users can send messages or commands from this screen.
en.disableEffect: The Kusu Chat Escape chat screen cannot open, so users cannot send or read messages through it.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开 Chat Escape 时，此 Kusu Chat Escape SDK Activity 会连接聊天服务并显示消息和操作按钮，用户可在此发送消息或命令。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Kusu Chat Escape 聊天页面无法打开，用户不能通过它收发消息。

en.description: AirbaPay opens this screen during card checkout with the payment provider's authorization page. It displays the checkout URL returned by the payment flow.
en.disableEffect: The card authorization page may not open, preventing users from completing that AirbaPay payment.

zh-CN.description: AirbaPay 会在银行卡结账时打开此界面，显示支付流程返回的收单机构授权页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，银行卡授权页面可能无法打开，用户可能无法完成这笔 AirbaPay 付款。

en.description: AirbaPay opens this camera screen when the user chooses to scan a payment card. It reads the card number and returns it to checkout; users can enter card details in the separate payment form instead.
en.disableEffect: Card scanning will be unavailable, so users must enter the card number manually in checkout.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择扫描银行卡时，AirbaPay 会打开此相机界面读取卡号并返回结账流程；用户也可以在单独的付款表单中手动输入卡片信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，银行卡扫描功能不可用，用户需要在结账表单中手动输入卡号。

en.description: AirbaPay opens this screen when payment processing returns an error. It selects the matching error explanation or a configured final-error page.
en.disableEffect: Failed payments may not show their explanation or the next available step.

zh-CN.description: AirbaPay 会在付款处理出错时打开此界面，并显示对应的错误说明或已配置的最终错误页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，付款失败时可能无法显示错误说明或可继续执行的步骤。

en.description: AirbaPay opens this screen when the payment flow offers a retry. It displays the retry page so the user can continue after an incomplete or recoverable payment attempt.
en.disableEffect: Users may not be able to retry an AirbaPay checkout after a recoverable failure.

zh-CN.description: 当付款流程提供重试选项时，AirbaPay 会打开此界面，让用户在未完成或可恢复的付款尝试后继续操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户可能无法在可恢复的付款失败后重试 AirbaPay 结账。

en.description: AirbaPay opens this in-app browser during the standard payment flow to load a payment provider's redirect page. The user completes the provider's web checkout there.
en.disableEffect: Provider redirect and authorization pages may not load, interrupting the payment flow.

zh-CN.description: AirbaPay 会在标准付款流程中打开此应用内浏览器，加载支付提供方的跳转页面，供用户完成网页授权或付款。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，支付提供方的跳转和授权页面可能无法加载，付款流程会中断。

en.description: AirbaPay opens this screen for its Google Pay web checkout. It loads the payment URL and marks the session as a Google Pay flow.
en.disableEffect: Google Pay web checkout may not open, preventing users from completing that payment option.

zh-CN.description: AirbaPay 会为 Google Pay 网页付款打开此界面，加载付款链接并将会话设为 Google Pay 流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Google Pay 网页付款可能无法打开，用户无法使用该付款方式完成支付。

en.description: AirbaPay opens this screen for card checkout. It collects card details, offers card scanning, and can display the configured Google Pay option.
en.disableEffect: The AirbaPay payment form will not open, so users may be unable to pay by card or use the payment options shown here.

zh-CN.description: AirbaPay 会打开此界面进行银行卡结账，收集卡片信息、提供扫描卡片功能，并可显示已配置的 Google Pay 选项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，AirbaPay 付款表单将无法打开，用户可能无法使用此处提供的银行卡或其他付款方式。

en.description: AirbaPay opens this progress screen after a payment session is created. It prepares the selected payment flow and lets the user return to the merchant app if they leave the process.
en.disableEffect: The AirbaPay payment session may not initialize, so checkout cannot proceed.

zh-CN.description: 付款会话创建后，AirbaPay 会打开此进度界面，准备所选付款流程；用户退出时可返回商家应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，AirbaPay 付款会话可能无法初始化，结账流程无法继续。

en.description: AirbaPay opens this screen after a successful payment when the merchant has not supplied a custom success page. It displays the payment-complete result and closes the checkout flow.
en.disableEffect: A successful payment may not show its completion page or return to the merchant app correctly.

zh-CN.description: 商家未提供自定义成功页面时，AirbaPay 会在付款成功后打开此界面，显示完成结果并结束结账流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，付款成功时可能无法显示完成页面或正确返回商家应用。

en.description: AirbaPay's test screen opens this activity to exercise an external card-payment flow with a supplied token. It is a test path rather than the regular checkout screen.
en.disableEffect: The external card-payment test will not run; the regular AirbaPay checkout flow is separate.

zh-CN.description: AirbaPay 测试界面会使用提供的令牌打开此页面，以验证外部银行卡付款流程；这是测试路径，不是常规结账页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，外部银行卡付款测试无法运行；常规 AirbaPay 结账流程使用其他页面。

en.description: AirbaPay's test screen opens this activity to exercise an external Google Pay flow with a supplied token. It checks the test payment setup and Google Pay response.
en.disableEffect: The external Google Pay test will not run; the regular Google Pay checkout path is separate.

zh-CN.description: AirbaPay 测试界面会使用提供的令牌打开此页面，以验证外部 Google Pay 流程和付款配置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，外部 Google Pay 测试无法运行；常规 Google Pay 结账流程使用其他页面。

en.description: BTS Digital ID (Kazakhstan) opens this screen when an app requests phone confirmation or identity-document retrieval. It runs the identity-verification flow and returns the result to the caller.
en.disableEffect: Phone confirmation and identity-document verification through BTS Digital ID will not complete.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求手机号确认或获取身份证明文件时，BTS Digital ID（哈萨克斯坦）会打开此界面。它运行身份核验流程并将结果返回调用方。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，通过 BTS Digital ID 进行的手机号确认和身份证明文件核验将无法完成。

en.description: When LeakCanary's separate analysis process starts, this provider initializes automatic memory-leak monitoring in that process.
en.disableEffect: LeakCanary will skip automatic monitoring setup in its separate process; the host app's regular features remain available.

zh-CN.description: LeakCanary 的独立分析进程启动时，此组件会在该进程中初始化自动内存泄漏监测。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，LeakCanary 将不会在独立进程中自动初始化监测，但应用的常规功能仍可使用。

en.description: When the app starts, this LeakCanary provider automatically enables memory-leak monitoring in the main process.
en.disableEffect: LeakCanary will stop automatically watching for leaks in the app's main process; regular app features remain available.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，此 LeakCanary 组件会在主进程中自动启用内存泄漏监测。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，LeakCanary 将不再自动监测主进程中的内存泄漏，但应用的常规功能仍可使用。

en.description: When LeakCanary queues a captured heap dump, this service analyzes it in the separate process and saves the leak-analysis result.
en.disableEffect: LeakCanary will no longer analyze captured heap dumps or report their leak findings; regular app features remain available.

zh-CN.description: LeakCanary 提交内存转储后，此服务会在独立进程中分析转储并保存泄漏分析结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，LeakCanary 将无法分析内存转储或报告泄漏结果，但应用的常规功能仍可使用。

en.description: This Square LeakCanary provider creates controlled file links for memory-leak reports and opens those files when LeakCanary shares or displays them.
en.disableEffect: LeakCanary reports can no longer open or share their saved files; the host app’s normal features remain available.

zh-CN.description: 这个 Square LeakCanary 提供程序会为内存泄漏报告创建受控文件链接，供 LeakCanary 打开或分享相关文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，LeakCanary 将无法打开或分享已保存的报告文件，但宿主应用的日常功能仍可使用。

en.description: At app startup, this older LeakSentry component installs automatic tracking of objects that should have been released so memory leaks can be detected.
en.disableEffect: LeakSentry's automatic memory-leak checks will not start; the app's normal screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，此旧版 LeakSentry 组件会开始自动跟踪本应释放的对象，以便检测内存泄漏。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，LeakSentry 的自动内存泄漏检查将不会启动，但应用的常规界面仍可使用。

en.description: This Square LeakCanary provider starts memory-leak monitoring when the main app process launches.
en.disableEffect: LeakCanary’s automatic memory-leak monitoring will not start; the app’s normal features remain available.

zh-CN.description: 主应用进程启动时，这个 Square LeakCanary 提供程序会自动开始监测内存泄漏。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，LeakCanary 将不会自动开始内存泄漏监测，但应用的日常功能仍可使用。

en.description: This Square LeakCanary receiver handles alert actions, including collecting a memory snapshot when requested.
en.disableEffect: LeakCanary alerts can no longer start those diagnostic actions; app features remain available.

zh-CN.description: 这个 Square LeakCanary 接收器会处理诊断通知的操作，包括按要求收集内存快照。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，LeakCanary 通知将无法启动这些诊断操作，但应用功能仍可使用。

en.description: This Square LeakCanary provider applies automatic fixes for known Android memory leaks as the app starts.
en.disableEffect: Those startup fixes will no longer run, so some known memory leaks may persist.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，这个 Square LeakCanary 提供程序会应用针对已知 Android 内存泄漏的自动修复。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，这些启动时的修复将不再运行，部分已知内存泄漏可能继续存在。

en.description: This Square LeakCanary service runs memory-leak analysis work in a separate app process.
en.disableEffect: LeakCanary’s background analysis in that process will not run; the app’s normal features remain available.

zh-CN.description: 这个 Square LeakCanary 服务会在应用的独立进程中运行内存泄漏分析任务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，该进程中的 LeakCanary 后台分析将无法运行，但应用的日常功能仍可使用。

en.description: This Square LeakCanary activity asks Android for a permission needed by its diagnostics and reports when access is denied.
en.disableEffect: LeakCanary cannot request that permission through its own screen, so related diagnostic alerts may be unavailable.
