zh-CN.description: 这个 Square LeakCanary 页面会为诊断功能向 Android 请求所需权限，并在权限被拒绝时提示用户。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，LeakCanary 将无法通过自己的页面请求该权限，相关诊断提醒可能无法使用。

en.description: When LeakCanary needs access to shared storage, this screen asks the user for permission to save or access heap-dump files.
en.disableEffect: LeakCanary cannot request legacy storage access through this screen, so saving or importing heap dumps on older Android versions may be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: LeakCanary 需要访问共享存储时，此界面会请求用户授权，以便保存或读取内存转储文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，LeakCanary 无法通过此界面请求旧版存储权限，因此在较旧 Android 版本上可能无法保存或导入内存转储。

en.description: When opened from LeakCanary or from a heap-dump file link, this screen lets the user inspect leak reports and saved heap dumps.
en.disableEffect: The LeakCanary report viewer and heap-dump import screen will not open; the rest of the app remains available.

zh-CN.description: 从 LeakCanary 打开或通过内存转储文件链接启动时，此界面可查看泄漏报告和已保存的内存转储。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，LeakCanary 报告查看器和内存转储导入界面将无法打开，但应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: This optional app-drawer shortcut opens LeakCanary's screen for viewing leak reports and saved heap dumps.
en.disableEffect: The LeakCanary shortcut will disappear from the app drawer, though automatic checks can continue.

zh-CN.description: 此可选应用列表入口会打开 LeakCanary 的泄漏报告和内存转储查看界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用列表中的 LeakCanary 入口将消失，但自动检查仍可继续。

en.description: When the older LeakCanary analyzer receives a heap dump for analysis, this service checks it for memory leaks in the separate process.
en.disableEffect: LeakCanary's legacy heap-dump analysis will stop; the app's regular features remain available.

zh-CN.description: 旧版 LeakCanary 分析器收到待分析的内存转储时，此服务会在独立进程中检查其中的内存泄漏。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，LeakCanary 的旧版内存转储分析将停止，但应用的常规功能仍可使用。

en.description: The Lens24 card-scanning SDK opens this screen when the app requests a card scan; it uses the camera to read payment-card details and returns the recognized card data or a cancellation result to the app.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents the app's credit or payment-card scanning flow and leaves the caller without scanned card details.

zh-CN.description: Lens24 卡片扫描 SDK 在应用请求扫描银行卡时打开此页面，使用相机识别卡片信息，并将识别结果或取消结果返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用无法使用信用卡或支付卡扫描流程，调用方也收不到扫描出的卡片信息。

en.description: When a Tap to Pay transaction requires the cardholder PIN, Stripe Terminal opens this protected PIN-entry screen.
en.disableEffect: Tap to Pay card payments that require a PIN cannot be completed.

zh-CN.description: Tap to Pay 交易需要持卡人 PIN 时，Stripe Terminal 会打开此受保护的 PIN 输入界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要 PIN 的 Tap to Pay 银行卡付款将无法完成。

en.description: srccode Base uses this screen to show pages supplied by the app; the displayed page receives its data and can handle the Back button.
en.disableEffect: App pages opened through this screen will not display.

zh-CN.description: srccode Base 用此页面显示应用提供的内容并传入页面数据；页面也可以处理返回操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过此页面容器打开的应用页面将无法显示。

en.description: When an app asks a user to add a payment card, the Liberalize Frontend Android SDK opens this screen. The user enters the card number, holder name, expiry date, and security code; the SDK submits the card setup request and returns success or an error to the app.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from completing Liberalize card setup and returning the saved card result to the app.

zh-CN.description: 应用要求用户添加支付卡时，Liberalize Frontend Android SDK 会打开此页面。用户输入卡号、持卡人姓名、有效期和安全码后，SDK 会提交绑卡请求，并将成功或错误结果返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法完成 Liberalize 支付卡绑定，应用也无法收到绑定成功返回的卡片信息。

en.description: 100ms.live Room Kit opens this optional pre-call diagnostic screen to check region, camera, microphone, and connection before a meeting. It guides users through those checks.
en.disableEffect: The built-in pre-call checks will be unavailable; the app can still use its separate meeting flow.

zh-CN.description: 100ms.live Room Kit 会打开此可选的会前诊断界面，检查区域、相机、麦克风和网络连接，并引导用户完成检查。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，内置会前检查将无法使用；应用仍可通过单独的会议流程发起通话。

en.description: 100ms.live Room Kit starts this foreground service during a call to keep the call active with an ongoing notification while the app is in the background. The notification can return the user to the meeting.
en.disableEffect: Calls may be interrupted when the app moves to the background, and the ongoing call notification will be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: 通话期间，100ms.live Room Kit 会启动此前台服务，在应用进入后台时维持通话并显示持续通知；用户可从通知返回会议。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用进入后台时通话可能中断，持续通话通知也将不可用。

en.description: 100ms.live Room Kit opens this screen when the user joins a video meeting. It displays the meeting and its participant, audio, video, and call controls.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to enter or control the Room Kit video meeting.

zh-CN.description: 用户加入视频会议时，100ms.live Room Kit 会打开此界面，显示会议、参会者以及音视频和通话控制。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法进入或控制 Room Kit 视频会议。

en.description: 100ms.live starts this service after the user approves screen sharing in a meeting. It captures the device screen and sends the video frames into the live call while showing a foreground notification.
en.disableEffect: Screen sharing during 100ms.live calls will not work.

zh-CN.description: 用户在会议中批准屏幕共享后，100ms.live 会启动此服务。它捕获设备屏幕并将画面传入实时通话，同时显示前台通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，100ms.live 通话中的屏幕共享将无法使用。

en.description: 100ms.live schedules this receiver to run a daily cleanup of its local session logs. It checks the log directory and removes files when they exceed the configured size.
en.disableEffect: The SDK's periodic session-log cleanup may stop, leaving more log files on the device.

zh-CN.description: 100ms.live 会安排此接收器每天清理本地会话日志。它会检查日志目录，并在文件超出配置大小时删除日志。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，SDK 定期清理会话日志的任务可能停止，设备上会留下更多日志文件。

en.description: VideoSDK's real-time communication SDK receives Android phone-state broadcasts and tells an active meeting when a cellular call is answered, rejected, or ends.
en.disableEffect: A VideoSDK meeting may not respond correctly when a cellular call arrives or finishes.

zh-CN.description: VideoSDK 实时通信 SDK 会接收 Android 电话状态广播，并在手机通话接通、拒接或结束时通知正在进行的会议。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 手机来电或通话结束时，VideoSDK 会议可能无法正确响应。

en.description: When a user shares their screen in a VideoSDK meeting, this service keeps sharing active in the foreground and shows an ongoing notification.
en.disableEffect: VideoSDK screen sharing cannot run correctly and may stop when the app moves to the background.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 VideoSDK 会议中共享屏幕时，此服务会在前台维持共享并显示持续通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: VideoSDK 屏幕共享将无法正常运行，并可能在应用进入后台时停止。

en.description: When VideoSDK needs permissions for a call or screen sharing, this activity asks the user for them and reports whether they were granted.
en.disableEffect: Calls or screen sharing that require these permissions may fail to start.

zh-CN.description: VideoSDK 需要通话或屏幕共享权限时，此页面会向用户请求权限并返回授权结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要这些权限的通话或屏幕共享可能无法启动。

en.description: The PayHere Android payment SDK opens this Activity for checkout, showing payment methods or card details and the payment result.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open PayHere's checkout or complete a payment in the app.

zh-CN.description: PayHere Android 支付 SDK 会在结账时打开此页面，显示支付方式或银行卡信息，并呈现支付结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开 PayHere 结账页面或在应用中完成付款。

en.description: Nuoyan's Android Auth Library opens this activity for Huawei account sign-in and returns Huawei's authorization result to the app.
en.disableEffect: Huawei sign-in cannot complete or return its result to the app.

zh-CN.description: Nuoyan Android Auth Library 会在用户使用华为账号登录时打开此页面，并将华为授权结果返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 华为账号登录将无法完成，授权结果也无法返回应用。

en.description: Nuoyan's Android Auth Library uses this activity to handle results from QQ sign-in or sharing and return them to the app.
en.disableEffect: QQ sign-in and sharing results cannot return to the app, so those flows may fail.

zh-CN.description: Nuoyan Android Auth Library 会通过此页面处理 QQ 登录或分享的返回结果，并将结果交还应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: QQ 登录或分享的结果无法返回应用，因此这些流程可能失败。

en.description: Nuoyan's Android Auth Library uses this activity to handle results from Sina Weibo sign-in or sharing and return them to the app.
en.disableEffect: Sina Weibo sign-in and sharing results cannot return to the app, so those flows may fail.

zh-CN.description: Nuoyan Android Auth Library 会通过此页面处理新浪微博登录或分享的返回结果，并将结果交还应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 新浪微博登录或分享的结果无法返回应用，因此这些流程可能失败。

en.description: Nuoyan's Android Auth Library processes responses from WeChat sign-in, payment, or sharing and returns the outcome to the app.
en.disableEffect: WeChat sign-in, payment, or sharing flows may not return their results to the app.

zh-CN.description: Nuoyan Android Auth Library 会处理微信登录、支付或分享的返回信息，并将结果交还应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 微信登录、支付或分享流程可能无法将结果返回应用。

en.description: Nuoyan's Android Auth Library opens this activity for UnionPay checkout and processes the payment result returned by UnionPay.
en.disableEffect: UnionPay checkout cannot complete or return its payment result to the app.

zh-CN.description: Nuoyan Android Auth Library 会在用户使用银联结账时打开此页面，并处理银联返回的支付结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 银联结账将无法完成，支付结果也无法返回应用。

en.description: Nuoyan's Android Auth Library uses this activity for Alipay payment and agreement-payment returns; its browsable link receives the result sent back to the app.
en.disableEffect: Alipay payment or agreement-payment results cannot return to the app, so those payment flows may fail.

zh-CN.description: Nuoyan Android Auth Library 会通过此页面处理支付宝付款和协议支付的返回结果；支付宝会通过可浏览链接将结果送回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 支付宝付款或协议支付的结果无法返回应用，因此这些支付流程可能失败。

en.description: Nuoyan's Android Utils Library opens this grid when a user taps its floating tools button; the app can add utilities such as environment selection, cache clearing, app information, and logs.
en.disableEffect: The floating developer-tools menu will no longer open; the app's regular screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击浮动工具按钮时，Nuoyan Android Utils Library 会打开此工具网格；应用可在其中提供环境切换、清理缓存、应用信息和日志等工具。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 浮动开发工具菜单将无法打开，但应用的常规页面仍可使用。

en.description: Nuoyan's Android Utils Library opens this scanner when the app requests a QR scan; it reads codes with the camera or from a selected photo.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot scan QR codes with the camera or from an image through this SDK.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求扫描二维码时，Nuoyan Android Utils Library 会打开此扫描页面，可使用摄像头或读取用户选择的图片。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此 SDK 使用摄像头或图片扫描二维码。

en.description: Nuoyan's Android Utils Library opens this scanner when the app requests a QR scan; it reads codes with the camera or from a selected photo.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot scan QR codes with the camera or from an image through this SDK.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求扫描二维码时，Nuoyan Android Utils Library 会打开此扫描页面，可使用摄像头或读取用户选择的图片。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此 SDK 使用摄像头或图片扫描二维码。

en.description: The ChatCenter iO customer-support SDK runs this service while a user shares live location in a chat, periodically sending updated positions for that share.
en.disableEffect: Live-location sharing in ChatCenter chats will stop or fail to update.

zh-CN.description: 用户在聊天中共享实时位置时，ChatCenter iO 客户支持 SDK 会运行此服务，定期发送位置更新。
zh-CN.disableEffect: ChatCenter 聊天中的实时位置共享将停止或无法更新。

en.description: The ChatCenter iO SDK opens this information page from its About menu, with links to the service site, terms, privacy policy, service agreement, and copyright information.
en.disableEffect: Users lose access to ChatCenter's About and policy links from this menu; the host app's main features remain available.

zh-CN.description: 用户从 ChatCenter iO 的关于菜单打开此信息页面，可查看服务网站、使用条款、隐私政策、服务协议和版权信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法从此菜单查看 ChatCenter 的关于和政策链接，但应用的主要功能仍可使用。

en.description: The ChatCenter iO SDK opens this screen when an agent assigns a support conversation or chooses who follows it; selected people are saved to that conversation.
en.disableEffect: Agents cannot assign conversations or manage their followers in ChatCenter.

zh-CN.description: 客服人员在 ChatCenter iO 中分配会话或选择关注者时，此页面会列出人员，并将所选人员保存到会话。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 客服人员将无法在 ChatCenter 中分配会话或管理关注者。

en.description: The ChatCenter iO SDK opens this screen for a support conversation, loads its messages, and lets the user send replies, attachments, and supported chat actions.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open or use the ChatCenter conversation screen to read or send messages.

zh-CN.description: ChatCenter iO SDK 会为客户支持会话打开此页面，加载消息，并允许用户发送回复、附件和支持的聊天内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开 ChatCenter 会话页面阅读或发送消息。

en.description: The ChatCenter iO SDK opens this page from About to display the SDK's license and copyright information in a web view.
en.disableEffect: Users lose access to the ChatCenter license page; other host-app features remain available.

zh-CN.description: 用户从关于页面进入时，ChatCenter iO SDK 会在网页视图中显示 SDK 的许可证和版权信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法查看 ChatCenter 许可证页面，但应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: The ChatCenter iO SDK opens this screen when an agent chooses a saved reply, loads the available phrases, and returns the selected text to the conversation.
en.disableEffect: Agents cannot browse or insert saved replies in ChatCenter conversations.

zh-CN.description: 客服人员选择预设回复时，ChatCenter iO SDK 会打开此页面，加载可用短语并将所选文本填入会话。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 客服人员将无法在 ChatCenter 会话中浏览或插入预设回复。

en.description: The ChatCenter iO SDK opens this list when an agent chooses a conversation funnel, then returns the selected funnel for filtering the inbox.
en.disableEffect: Agents cannot choose a funnel to filter ChatCenter conversations.

zh-CN.description: 客服人员选择会话流程分类时，ChatCenter iO SDK 会打开此列表，并将所选分类返回以筛选收件箱。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 客服人员将无法选择分类来筛选 ChatCenter 会话。

en.description: The ChatCenter iO SDK opens this screen from a conversation to show contact and conversation details and, for agents, manage assignment, followers, funnel, and open or closed status.
en.disableEffect: Users lose the conversation details screen, and agents cannot manage its assignment or status there.

zh-CN.description: 用户从会话进入时，ChatCenter iO SDK 会显示联系人和会话详情；客服人员还可管理分配对象、关注者、分类及会话状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法查看会话详情，客服人员也无法在此管理分配对象或状态。

en.description: The ChatCenter iO SDK opens this screen to view or manage a live-location share; starting a share asks for location permission and lets the user choose a place.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot start, view, or stop live-location sharing in ChatCenter.

zh-CN.description: ChatCenter iO SDK 会打开此页面查看或管理实时位置共享；开始共享时会请求位置权限并让用户选择地点。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在 ChatCenter 中开始、查看或停止实时位置共享。

en.description: The ChatCenter iO SDK opens this inbox to load and search support conversations, filter them by status or funnel, and let agents manage channels.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open the ChatCenter conversation inbox or select a conversation from it.

zh-CN.description: ChatCenter iO SDK 会打开此收件箱，加载和搜索客户支持会话，并按状态或分类筛选；客服人员还可管理会话。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开 ChatCenter 会话收件箱或从中选择会话。

en.description: The ChatCenter iO SDK opens this editor when an agent adds or changes an internal note on a conversation, then returns the saved text.
en.disableEffect: Agents cannot add or edit internal notes on ChatCenter conversations.

zh-CN.description: 客服人员为会话添加或修改内部备注时，ChatCenter iO SDK 会打开此编辑页面，并返回保存的文本。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 客服人员将无法为 ChatCenter 会话添加或修改内部备注。

en.description: The ChatCenter iO SDK opens this screen to display an image attachment from a conversation and let the user share it.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot view or share conversation images through the ChatCenter screen.

zh-CN.description: ChatCenter iO SDK 会打开此页面显示会话中的图片附件，并允许用户分享图片。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 ChatCenter 页面查看或分享会话图片。

en.description: The ChatCenter iO SDK opens this preview before a user sends an image or interactive chat item, allowing them to review it and confirm sending.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot review and confirm images or interactive items before sending them in ChatCenter.

zh-CN.description: 用户发送图片或互动聊天内容前，ChatCenter iO SDK 会打开此预览页面，供用户检查并确认发送。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在 ChatCenter 中预览并确认发送图片或互动内容。

en.description: The ChatCenter iO SDK opens this editor to create an interactive question for a conversation, with yes-or-no, choice, checkbox, or rating answers.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot create or send interactive questions in ChatCenter conversations.

zh-CN.description: ChatCenter iO SDK 会打开此编辑页面，为会话创建互动问题，可设置是非题、选择题、复选项或评分答案。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在 ChatCenter 会话中创建或发送互动问题。

en.description: The ChatCenter iO SDK opens this planner to choose dates and times for a schedule item that can be sent in a conversation.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot create or send schedule items through ChatCenter.

zh-CN.description: ChatCenter iO SDK 会打开此安排页面，供用户选择日期和时间，并将安排内容发送到会话。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 ChatCenter 创建或发送安排内容。

en.description: The ChatCenter iO SDK opens this map when a user chooses a place to share in a conversation, with controls for the location and sharing duration.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot select and send a place or location share through ChatCenter.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择要在会话中分享的地点时，ChatCenter iO SDK 会打开此地图，并提供位置和共享时长设置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 ChatCenter 选择并发送地点或位置共享。

en.description: The ChatCenter iO SDK opens this screen for a support video call, requests camera or microphone access when needed, and lets users join or end the call.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot start, answer, or manage ChatCenter video calls.

zh-CN.description: ChatCenter iO SDK 会为客户支持视频通话打开此页面，在需要时请求摄像头或麦克风权限，并允许用户接听或结束通话。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法发起、接听或管理 ChatCenter 视频通话。

en.description: The ChatCenter iO SDK opens this page for web links or documents selected in a conversation or the SDK's information pages.
en.disableEffect: Web links and documents opened inside ChatCenter will no longer be available through this screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户在会话或 SDK 信息页面中选择网页链接或文档时，ChatCenter iO SDK 会通过此页面显示内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此页面查看 ChatCenter 中打开的网页链接和文档。

en.description: The ChatCenter iO SDK opens this list for a conversation and selected interactive-item type, loading matching items from the conversation history.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot browse the selected type of interactive items in ChatCenter conversations.

zh-CN.description: ChatCenter iO SDK 会针对某个会话和所选互动内容类型打开此列表，并从会话记录中加载匹配内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法浏览 ChatCenter 会话中所选类型的互动内容。

en.description: At app startup, the Countly Android analytics SDK registers for app screen changes so Countly can keep track of the current screen for its features.
en.disableEffect: Countly loses the current-screen reference used by its SDK features; the host app's startup and screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，Countly Android 分析 SDK 会监听应用页面变化，以便 Countly 的功能能够获取当前页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Countly 将无法获取其 SDK 功能所需的当前页面信息，但应用启动和页面使用不受影响。

en.description: When Countly displays in-app web content, this activity opens a transparent panel over the current screen and adjusts it to the device orientation.
en.disableEffect: Countly's in-app panels that use this screen will not appear; the host app's own screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: Countly 显示应用内网页内容时，此页面会在当前屏幕上打开透明面板，并根据设备方向调整显示。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Countly 使用此页面显示的应用内面板将不再出现，但应用自身页面仍可使用。

en.description: When a user taps a Countly push notification or one of its buttons, this Countly Android SDK activity records the action and opens its app screen or link.
en.disableEffect: Tapping Countly push notifications will no longer record the action or open its destination; the host app remains usable.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击 Countly 推送通知或其中的按钮时，Countly Android SDK 会记录该操作并打开应用页面或链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 点击 Countly 推送通知将不再记录操作或打开目标页面，但应用仍可正常使用。

en.description: The Kite Print SDK opens this Activity from shipping details to show saved delivery addresses. Users can choose an address or add, edit, or delete one.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot select or manage saved delivery addresses in the Kite checkout, which can prevent checkout from continuing.

zh-CN.description: Kite Print SDK 会在填写配送信息时打开此 Activity，显示已保存的地址，供用户选择、添加、编辑或删除。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法在 Kite 结账流程中选择或管理已保存的配送地址，结账可能因此无法继续。

en.description: The Kite Print SDK opens this Activity when a delivery address is added or changed, then returns the completed details to checkout. It can also collect an email address when checkout requests one.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot enter or update delivery details, which can prevent a print order from being placed.

zh-CN.description: Kite Print SDK 会在添加或修改配送地址时打开此 Activity，并将填写好的信息返回结账流程；结账需要时也会在此收集电子邮箱。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法填写或更新配送信息，可能因此无法提交打印订单。

en.description: The Kite Print SDK opens this Activity after an order is submitted or when an order is opened from order history. It shows the success receipt or order failure details.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot view the order confirmation or failure details after submitting or reopening an order.

zh-CN.description: Kite Print SDK 会在提交订单后或从订单历史记录打开订单时显示此 Activity，其中展示成功回执或订单失败详情。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户提交订单或重新查看订单时将无法看到确认回执或失败详情。

en.description: During Kite Print SDK checkout, this Activity reviews the order and presents its payment options. It handles the payment step and submits the order after payment.
en.disableEffect: Customers cannot complete payment or submit print orders through the Kite checkout.

zh-CN.description: 在 Kite Print SDK 结账时，此 Activity 用于核对订单并显示付款方式；付款完成后会提交订单。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法通过 Kite 结账流程完成付款或提交打印订单。

en.description: During Kite Print SDK checkout, this Activity collects the delivery address and email, plus a phone number when required. Its address button opens saved addresses or the address form.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot provide delivery details and continue through checkout.

zh-CN.description: 在 Kite Print SDK 结账时，此 Activity 会收集配送地址和电子邮箱，并在需要时收集电话号码；地址按钮会打开已保存地址或地址填写页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法提供配送信息并继续结账。

en.description: The Kite Device Photo Picker opens when the print flow asks users to choose pictures from their device. It lists local photo folders and returns the selected pictures to the print flow.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot add photos stored on the device through the Kite print flow.

zh-CN.description: Kite Device Photo Picker 会在打印流程需要从设备选图时打开，列出本地照片文件夹，并将用户选中的照片返回打印流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法通过 Kite 打印流程添加设备中保存的照片。

en.description: The Kite Facebook Photo Picker opens when the print flow requests Facebook pictures. It loads the connected account albums and photos so users can choose images for a print order.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot select Facebook photos for print orders through this picker.

zh-CN.description: Kite Facebook Photo Picker 会在打印流程需要选择 Facebook 照片时打开，加载已连接账号中的相册和照片，供用户选入打印订单。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法通过此选图页面将 Facebook 照片加入打印订单。

en.description: The Kite Print SDK uses this service when Google refreshes push notification registration for the device. It asks the SDK to register the replacement with Kite.
en.disableEffect: A refreshed token will not be registered, so Kite push notifications may stop reaching this device.

zh-CN.description: Kite Print SDK 会在 Google 刷新设备的推送通知登记信息时使用此服务，并请求 SDK 将新的登记信息发送给 Kite。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 令牌刷新后将无法重新登记，因此设备可能无法继续收到 Kite 推送通知。

en.description: The Kite Print SDK starts this service to register the device for its push notifications. It obtains a push registration from Google and sends it to Kite.
en.disableEffect: Device registration for Kite push notifications stops, although print ordering can continue.

zh-CN.description: Kite Print SDK 会启动此服务，为设备登记推送通知。它会从 Google 获取登记信息并发送给 Kite。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 设备将无法登记接收 Kite 推送通知，但打印下单仍可继续。

en.description: The Kite Print SDK uses this service while users edit an image. It processes cropping, horizontal flipping, and rotation in the image editor.
en.disableEffect: Image edits cannot be processed and creating or editing a print product may be interrupted.

zh-CN.description: 用户编辑图片时，Kite Print SDK 会使用此服务处理图片裁剪、水平翻转和旋转。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 图片编辑无法完成，创建或编辑打印商品的流程可能中断。

en.description: The older Kite Instagram Photo Picker opens this Activity after Instagram sign-in to show the account photos. Users can select pictures and return them to the print flow.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot browse or select Instagram pictures for print orders.

zh-CN.description: 较早版本的 Kite Instagram Photo Picker 会在 Instagram 登录后打开此 Activity，显示账号中的照片，供用户选择并返回打印流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法浏览或选择 Instagram 照片用于打印订单。

en.description: The Kite Instagram Photo Picker opens this Activity when Instagram authorization is needed. It shows the sign-in page, receives access approval, and continues the photo selection flow.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot authorize Instagram or use its photos in the print flow.

zh-CN.description: Kite Instagram Photo Picker 需要 Instagram 授权时会打开此 Activity，显示登录页面并接收授权结果，然后继续选图流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法授权 Instagram，也无法在打印流程中使用其中的照片。

en.description: The Kite Instagram Photo Picker opens this Activity to browse photos from a connected Instagram account. It asks users to sign in when needed and returns their selected photos to the print flow.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot sign in through this picker or select Instagram photos for printing.

zh-CN.description: Kite Instagram Photo Picker 会打开此 Activity 浏览已连接 Instagram 账号中的照片；需要时会先要求登录，并将所选照片返回打印流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法通过此选图页面登录或选择 Instagram 照片进行打印。

en.description: The Kite Print SDK opens this Activity to show items in the print basket and their prices. During checkout it collects shipping details and starts payment for an order.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot review the basket or continue checkout to place print orders.

zh-CN.description: Kite Print SDK 会打开此 Activity 显示打印购物篮中的商品和价格；结账时还会收集配送信息并启动付款。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法查看购物篮或继续结账提交打印订单。

en.description: During the Kite Print SDK shopping flow, this Activity guides users through adding or editing a product and its photos, then saves the result to the basket.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot create or edit print products in the Kite flow, so adding them to the basket fails.

zh-CN.description: 在 Kite Print SDK 购物流程中，此 Activity 会引导用户添加或编辑商品及其照片，然后将结果保存到购物篮。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法在 Kite 流程中创建或编辑打印商品，因此无法将其加入购物篮。

en.description: The Kite Print SDK opens this Activity to show the users saved order history. Selecting an order opens its receipt details.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot review past Kite print orders or reopen their receipts.

zh-CN.description: Kite Print SDK 会打开此 Activity 显示用户已保存的订单历史记录；选择订单可查看其回执详情。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法查看以往的 Kite 打印订单或重新打开订单回执。

en.description: The Kite Print SDK opens this Activity to load its product catalogue and let users choose a print product and its options. It then opens the product editor.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot browse products or start a new print order through the Kite SDK.

zh-CN.description: Kite Print SDK 会打开此 Activity 加载商品目录，供用户选择打印商品及其选项，随后进入商品编辑页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法通过 Kite SDK 浏览商品或开始新的打印订单。

en.description: The Kite Android Photo Picker opens this Activity when an app asks users to select local pictures. It lists folders from the device photo library and opens the chosen folder.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot browse local photo folders or continue photo selection in apps using this picker.

zh-CN.description: 应用通过 Kite Android Photo Picker 请求选择本地照片时会打开此 Activity。它会列出设备照片库中的文件夹，并打开用户选中的文件夹。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此选图器的应用中，用户将无法浏览本地照片文件夹或继续选图。

en.description: The Kite Android Photo Picker opens this Activity for a selected local photo folder. It displays that folders pictures and returns the ones users select.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot select and return local photos to apps using this picker.

zh-CN.description: Kite Android Photo Picker 会针对选中的本地照片文件夹打开此 Activity，显示其中的照片，并将用户选中的照片返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此选图器的应用中，用户将无法选择并返回本地照片。

en.description: The Warply Android SDK lists active loyalty coupons in order of expiry. Choosing a coupon opens its details and barcode.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot open this active-coupon list, so users cannot view these coupons here.

zh-CN.description: Warply Android SDK 会按到期时间列出有效的忠诚度优惠券。点选优惠券可查看详情和条码。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用无法打开有效优惠券列表，用户不能在此查看这些优惠券。

en.description: The Warply Android SDK shows active supermarket coupons and combined coupons in the member wallet. Users can open a coupon or select eligible coupons to activate as one combined coupon.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open or activate these supermarket coupons in the app.

zh-CN.description: Warply Android SDK 会在会员钱包中显示有效超市优惠券和合并优惠券。用户可查看优惠券，也可选择符合条件的优惠券并合并激活。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法在应用中查看或激活这些超市优惠券。

en.description: The Warply Android SDK uses this Activity to host its loyalty home page and bottom navigation. In SDK releases that declare a VIEW link for it, opening the link displays this home screen.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot open the Warply loyalty home page or a link directed to this screen.

zh-CN.description: Warply Android SDK 使用此 Activity 承载忠诚度首页和底部导航。在声明 VIEW 链接入口的 SDK 版本中，打开链接会显示此首页。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用无法打开 Warply 忠诚度首页或指向此页面的链接。

en.description: The Warply Android SDK opens a contextual offer here, with its description and terms. Activating the offer submits it using an eligible phone number.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot open or activate these contextual Warply offers.

zh-CN.description: Warply Android SDK 会在此显示情境优惠的说明和条款。激活优惠时，SDK 会使用符合条件的电话号码提交申请。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用无法打开或激活这些 Warply 情境优惠。

en.description: The Warply Android SDK shows a selected coupon’s description, validity, terms and barcode. The screen also links to participating shops, the merchant website and coupon sharing.
en.disableEffect: Users lose access to coupon details and the barcode, along with the related shop and sharing options.

zh-CN.description: Warply Android SDK 会显示所选优惠券的说明、有效期、条款和条码。此页面还提供商店、商家网站和优惠券分享入口。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法查看优惠券详情和条码，也无法使用相关商店及分享入口。

en.description: The Warply Android SDK lets a user share or gift a selected coupon by entering an eligible phone number. It sends the sharing request and reports whether it succeeded.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot share or gift coupons through this screen.

zh-CN.description: Warply Android SDK 允许用户输入符合条件的电话号码，将所选优惠券分享或赠送给他人。SDK 会提交分享请求并显示结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过此页面分享或赠送优惠券。

en.description: The Warply Android SDK lists the member’s coupons and provides active and redeemed filters. Selecting a coupon opens its details.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot show the member’s coupon list or open coupon details from it.

zh-CN.description: Warply Android SDK 会列出会员的优惠券，并提供有效和已兑换筛选项。点选优惠券可查看详情。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用无法显示会员优惠券列表，也无法从列表打开优惠券详情。

en.description: The Warply Android SDK shows a coupon-set offer with its description and terms. Users can claim or redeem the offer from this screen.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot view or claim these coupon-set offers in the app.

zh-CN.description: Warply Android SDK 会显示优惠券组优惠的说明和条款。用户可在此领取或兑换优惠。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法在应用中查看或领取这些优惠券组优惠。

en.description: The Warply Android SDK lists coupon sets for the selected category and subcategory. Choosing a set opens its offer details.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot browse these coupon categories or open their offer details.

zh-CN.description: Warply Android SDK 会按所选类别和子类别列出优惠券组。点选一组可打开优惠详情。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法浏览这些优惠券类别或打开优惠详情。

en.description: The Warply Android SDK presents gifts and promotional offers. Selecting an item opens its coupon details, phone-service offer or campaign page.
en.disableEffect: The app’s Warply gifts and promotional offers cannot be browsed from this screen.

zh-CN.description: Warply Android SDK 会展示礼品和促销优惠。点选项目可查看优惠券详情、手机服务优惠或活动页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过此页面浏览 Warply 礼品和促销优惠。

en.description: The Warply Android SDK home screen loads offer banners, coupon categories and the member’s active coupon count. Users can open their coupons or browse a category, and the screen can ask a member to complete a questionnaire.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot open this Warply home screen or reach the coupon and offer sections from it.

zh-CN.description: Warply Android SDK 首页会加载优惠横幅、优惠券类别和会员的有效优惠券数量。用户可打开优惠券或浏览类别；页面也可能提示会员填写问卷。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用无法打开此 Warply 首页，也无法从这里进入优惠券和优惠专区。

en.description: The Warply Android SDK displays expired and shared coupons in separate lists. Users can browse the coupon analysis and sharing history.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot view this expired-coupon analysis or the related sharing history.

zh-CN.description: Warply Android SDK 会分别列出已过期和已分享的优惠券。用户可查看优惠券分析和分享记录。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法查看已过期优惠券分析或相关分享记录。

en.description: The Warply Android SDK summarizes loyalty wallet totals for deals, gifts, supermarket coupons and other reward groups. Selecting the gifts or supermarket section opens a more detailed coupon analysis.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot view the Warply loyalty summary or open its detailed coupon analyses.

zh-CN.description: Warply Android SDK 会汇总优惠、礼品、超市优惠券及其他奖励类别的会员钱包数据。点选礼品或超市类别可查看更详细的优惠券分析。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法查看 Warply 忠诚度汇总或打开详细的优惠券分析。

en.description: The Warply Android SDK shows expired and shared supermarket coupons in separate lists. The results are based on the member’s coupon and sharing history.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot review expired or shared supermarket coupons in the app.

zh-CN.description: Warply Android SDK 会分别列出已过期和已分享的超市优惠券。列表依据会员的优惠券和分享记录生成。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法在应用中查看已过期或已分享的超市优惠券。

en.description: The Warply Android SDK shows the member’s supermarket pass and its barcode. From here, users can open pass information or the associated shop and campaign page.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot view or present this supermarket pass and its barcode in the app.

zh-CN.description: Warply Android SDK 会显示会员的超市通行证及其条码。用户可在此查看通行证说明，或打开相关商店和活动页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法在应用中查看或出示此超市通行证及其条码。

en.description: The Warply Android SDK explains where the supermarket pass can be used, including in-store shopping and online purchases. The back button returns to the pass screen.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open the pass-use instructions from the supermarket pass screen.

zh-CN.description: Warply Android SDK 会说明超市通行证的使用场景，包括线下购物和网上购物。返回按钮会回到通行证页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法从超市通行证页面打开使用说明。

en.description: The Warply Android SDK groups additional campaigns into research, exclusive, contest and contextual sections. Selecting an item opens its campaign page or offer details.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot browse these additional Warply campaigns or open their offer pages.

zh-CN.description: Warply Android SDK 会将更多活动分为调研、专属、竞赛和情境优惠等类别。点选项目可打开活动页面或优惠详情。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法浏览这些 Warply 活动或打开其优惠页面。

en.description: The Warply Android SDK loads and displays the member’s coupons. Selecting a coupon opens its details.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot show this Warply coupon screen or open coupon details from it.

zh-CN.description: Warply Android SDK 会加载并显示会员的优惠券。点选优惠券可查看详情。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用无法显示此 Warply 优惠券页面，也无法从中打开优惠券详情。

en.description: The Warply Android SDK displays participating merchants on a map. Selecting a map marker opens that shop’s information.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot browse these merchant locations or open shop details in the app.

zh-CN.description: Warply Android SDK 会在地图上显示参与活动的商家。点选地图标记可查看商店信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法在应用中浏览这些商家位置或查看商店详情。

en.description: The Warply Android SDK shows merchants for a selected coupon on a Huawei map. Users can open shop details, directions or the merchant website.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot see participating shops or use their directions and website links from the coupon screen.

zh-CN.description: Warply Android SDK 会在华为地图上显示所选优惠券的参与商家。用户可查看商店详情、路线或商家网站。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法从优惠券页面查看参与商店或使用路线和网站入口。

en.description: The Warply Android SDK shows an individual coupon’s validity, terms and code or barcode. Users can copy its code, find participating shops or open the merchant website.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot view or use the coupon details, copy its code, or reach its shop links from this screen.

zh-CN.description: Warply Android SDK 会显示单张优惠券的有效期、条款和代码或条码。用户可复制代码、查找参与商店或打开商家网站。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法查看或使用优惠券详情、复制代码或从此页面进入商店链接。

en.description: The Warply Android SDK shows an individual coupon-set offer and its terms. Redeeming it requests a coupon and then opens that coupon’s details.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot review or redeem this coupon-set offer in the app.

zh-CN.description: Warply Android SDK 会显示单个优惠券组优惠及其条款。兑换后，SDK 会领取一张优惠券并打开其详情。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法在应用中查看或兑换此优惠券组优惠。

en.description: The Warply Android SDK shows a mobile-service offer with its allowance, type, duration and terms. Activating it uses an eligible phone number to submit the offer.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot review or activate these mobile-service offers from the app.

zh-CN.description: Warply Android SDK 会显示手机服务优惠的额度、类型、时长和条款。激活时，SDK 会使用符合条件的电话号码提交申请。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法在应用中查看或激活这些手机服务优惠。

en.description: The Warply Android SDK shows a combined supermarket coupon with its barcode, participating merchants and included coupons. Users can also cancel the combined coupon.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot view or present the combined coupon barcode, or manage it from the app.

zh-CN.description: Warply Android SDK 会显示合并后的超市优惠券、条码、参与商家和所含优惠券。用户也可取消合并优惠券。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法在应用中查看或出示合并优惠券条码，也无法管理此优惠券。

en.description: The Warply Android SDK opens campaign content inside the app using a campaign session or web address. It also handles campaign pages opened from Warply notifications.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open Warply campaign pages or follow notification links to that content.

zh-CN.description: Warply Android SDK 会根据活动会话或网址在应用内打开活动内容，也会处理从 Warply 通知进入的活动页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法打开 Warply 活动页面，也无法通过通知进入这些内容。

en.description: The Warply Android SDK uses this screen while asking Android for permissions, then receives which requested permissions the user granted or denied. Location and other permission-based SDK features depend on this flow.
en.disableEffect: Warply permission requests can fail, which may prevent location-dependent SDK features from working.

zh-CN.description: Warply Android SDK 会在请求 Android 权限时使用此页面，并接收用户授予或拒绝的权限结果。定位等依赖权限的 SDK 功能需要此流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Warply 权限请求可能失败，依赖定位的 SDK 功能也可能无法使用。

en.description: When Bluetooth is turned on, the Warply Android SDK initializes its nearby-beacon features. This receiver runs when Android reports a Bluetooth state change.
en.disableEffect: Warply beacon-based nearby promotions may not start when Bluetooth is enabled.

zh-CN.description: 蓝牙开启时，Warply Android SDK 会初始化附近信标功能。Android 报告蓝牙状态变化时会触发此接收器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，开启蓝牙时 Warply 的信标附近促销可能无法启动。

en.description: The Warply Android SDK responds to network changes by enabling location updates when the device reconnects and disabling them when it goes offline.
en.disableEffect: Warply location updates may not resume after the device reconnects, so location-based offers may be stale.

zh-CN.description: 网络状态变化时，Warply Android SDK 会在设备重新联网后启用位置更新，并在断网时停用位置更新。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，设备重新联网时 Warply 位置更新可能无法恢复，基于位置的优惠也可能不会及时更新。

en.description: The Warply Android SDK receives location and location-provider updates here, then schedules the location work used for nearby and geofenced offers.
en.disableEffect: Warply will stop processing these location updates, so nearby and geofenced offers may not refresh.

zh-CN.description: Warply Android SDK 会在此接收位置和定位服务状态更新，并安排附近优惠及地理围栏优惠所需的位置任务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Warply 将无法处理这些位置更新，附近优惠和地理围栏优惠可能无法刷新。

en.description: When a Warply notification alarm fires, this receiver forwards its title and message to the notification service that displays it.
en.disableEffect: Scheduled Warply reminders and promotional notifications may not appear.

zh-CN.description: Warply 通知闹钟触发时，此接收器会将标题和消息转交给负责显示通知的服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Warply 计划提醒和促销通知可能不会显示。

en.description: After a messaging token changes, the Warply Android SDK schedules this background task to refresh device information stored by the SDK service.
en.disableEffect: Warply’s server-side device information may remain outdated, which can affect push or device-targeted updates.

zh-CN.description: 消息令牌变化后，Warply Android SDK 会安排此后台任务，向 SDK 服务更新设备信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Warply 服务端的设备信息可能过期，进而影响推送或面向设备的更新。

en.description: This Warply Android SDK service receives Firebase messages, saves refreshed messaging tokens and handles Warply campaign notifications. The manifest connects it to Firebase messaging events.
en.disableEffect: Warply push campaigns and notifications delivered through Firebase will stop working.

zh-CN.description: 此 Warply Android SDK 服务接收 Firebase 消息、保存更新后的消息令牌并处理 Warply 活动通知。清单将其接入 Firebase 消息事件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，通过 Firebase 送达的 Warply 推送活动和通知将无法使用。

en.description: This Warply Android SDK service receives Huawei push messages, saves refreshed messaging tokens and handles Warply campaign notifications. The manifest connects it to Huawei messaging events.
en.disableEffect: Warply push campaigns and notifications delivered through Huawei services will stop working.

zh-CN.description: 此 Warply Android SDK 服务接收华为推送消息、保存更新后的消息令牌并处理 Warply 活动通知。清单将其接入华为消息事件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，通过华为服务送达的 Warply 推送活动和通知将无法使用。

en.description: The Warply Android SDK runs this background location task to apply its location settings, obtain location when permitted, and send location or geofence updates.
en.disableEffect: Nearby and geofenced Warply offers will stop receiving these location updates.

zh-CN.description: Warply Android SDK 会运行此后台定位任务，以应用定位设置、在获得许可时获取位置，并发送位置或地理围栏更新。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，附近及地理围栏 Warply 优惠将无法收到这些位置更新。

en.description: Started by a Warply notification alarm, this service displays the scheduled notification title and message to the user.
en.disableEffect: Scheduled Warply in-app reminders and promotional notifications will not be displayed.

zh-CN.description: Warply 通知闹钟启动此服务后，服务会向用户显示计划通知的标题和消息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Warply 计划的应用内提醒和促销通知将不会显示。

en.description: The Warply Android SDK scans for nearby Bluetooth beacons and reports detections to its service. Matching responses can trigger a campaign notification.
en.disableEffect: Warply cannot detect nearby beacons or show beacon-triggered promotions.

zh-CN.description: Warply Android SDK 会扫描附近的蓝牙信标，并向其服务报告检测结果。匹配的响应可能触发活动通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Warply 无法检测附近信标或显示信标触发的促销内容。

en.description: The Warply Android SDK declares this Provider as an app endpoint, but its code returns no data and stores nothing. It does not provide a user-facing screen.
en.disableEffect: The empty Warply endpoint becomes unavailable; the app loses no screen or stored content from this Provider.

zh-CN.description: Warply Android SDK 将此 Provider 声明为应用端点，但其代码不返回数据，也不存储内容。它不提供用户界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，这个空的 Warply 端点将不可用；应用不会因此失去页面或由此 Provider 存储的内容。

en.description: When started by ACTV8, this Service monitors Gimbal place visits and nearby beacon sightings, then sends matching observations to ACTV8’s trigger service.
en.disableEffect: ACTV8 place and nearby-beacon triggers will no longer be detected or delivered.

zh-CN.description: ACTV8 启动该服务后，它会监测 Gimbal 地点到访和附近信标，并将匹配的观测结果发送给 ACTV8 触发服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: ACTV8 的地点和附近信标触发将无法再被检测或传递。

en.description: When started by ACTV8, this Service scans for Kontakt Eddystone beacons, applies a configured namespace filter when present, and sends discoveries to ACTV8 after a session is active.
en.disableEffect: ACTV8 nearby-beacon triggers will no longer be detected or delivered.

zh-CN.description: ACTV8 启动该服务后，它会扫描 Kontakt Eddystone 信标；如已配置命名空间，则按该范围筛选，并在会话有效时将发现结果发送给 ACTV8。
zh-CN.disableEffect: ACTV8 的附近信标触发将无法再被检测或传递。

en.description: Kamaravichow Commons opens this Activity when the app displays its About page; the screen uses the library’s bundled About layout.
en.disableEffect: The app’s About page will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: 应用显示“关于”页面时，Kamaravichow Commons 会打开此 Activity，并使用库中自带的页面布局。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用的“关于”页面将无法打开。

en.description: Kamaravichow Commons opens this Activity when the app displays its About page; the screen uses the library’s bundled About layout.
en.disableEffect: The app’s About page will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: 应用显示“关于”页面时，Kamaravichow Commons 会打开此 Activity，并使用库中自带的页面布局。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用的“关于”页面将无法打开。

en.description: The Kamaravichow Commons library opens this in-app browser when the app sends it a URL to show. It can display a page title and open the page full-screen.
en.disableEffect: Help pages or links routed through this screen will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: 应用传入网页地址时，Kamaravichow Commons 会在此应用内浏览器中打开网页；页面可显示标题，也可全屏浏览。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，通过此页面打开的帮助内容或链接将无法显示。

en.description: When an app opens a screen built on Kamaravichow Commons, this shared Activity applies the saved language and prepares the common page layout and progress display.
en.disableEffect: This Activity has no screen of its own; disabling it does not prevent the other Commons screens from opening.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开基于 Kamaravichow Commons 构建的页面时，此共用 Activity 会应用已保存的语言设置，并准备通用页面布局和进度显示。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 此 Activity 本身没有独立页面；停用它不会阻止 Commons 的其他页面打开。

en.description: Kamaravichow’s Instagram SDK opens Instagram’s sign-in page in an in-app browser when the app starts Instagram authorization.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to sign in to Instagram through this screen.

zh-CN.description: 应用开始 Instagram 授权时，Kamaravichow 的 Instagram SDK 会在应用内浏览器中打开 Instagram 登录页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法通过此页面登录 Instagram。

en.description: When VCloud’s scheduled alarm fires, this Receiver posts a missed-call notification and sends a background heartbeat if the messaging service is active and the app was in the background.
en.disableEffect: VCloud’s alarm-driven missed-call notifications and background heartbeat will stop.

zh-CN.description: VCloud 设置的定时闹钟触发时，该接收器会发布未接来电通知；若消息服务仍在运行且应用处于后台，也会发送后台心跳。
zh-CN.disableEffect: VCloud 通过闹钟发送的未接来电通知和后台心跳将停止。

en.description: When VCloud starts its messaging connection, this background Service processes unsent messages, fetches offline conversations, handles incoming messages, and starts call support.
en.disableEffect: VCloud conversations may no longer sync or receive messages, and the call service it starts may not be brought up.

zh-CN.description: VCloud 启动消息连接时，该后台服务会处理未发送的消息、获取离线会话、接收新消息，并启动通话支持服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: VCloud 会话可能无法同步或接收消息，它启动的通话服务也可能无法运行。

en.description: Android sends this VCloud Receiver network-connectivity and mobile-data state changes; it updates the chat connection and stops active call audio or video when the network is lost.
en.disableEffect: Chats and calls may not reconnect or stop cleanly when network connectivity changes.

zh-CN.description: Android 在网络连接或移动数据状态变化时通知 VCloud 接收器；它会更新聊天连接，并在网络断开时停止进行中的通话音频或视频。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 网络状态变化时，聊天和通话可能无法重新连接或正常停止。

en.description: Android sends this VCloud Receiver Bluetooth-headset connection and media-button broadcasts; it updates call audio routing and forwards headset button presses to the active call interface.
en.disableEffect: Bluetooth call routing and headset-button controls will stop being handled, so users may need to use calls without those headset controls.

zh-CN.description: Android 在蓝牙耳机连接状态或媒体按键变化时通知 VCloud 接收器；它会更新通话音频路由，并将耳机按键操作转发给当前通话界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 蓝牙通话路由和耳机按键控制将停止工作，用户可能需要不使用这些耳机控制来通话。

en.description: Android sends this VCloud Receiver removable-storage mount, removal, unmount, bad-removal, and shared-storage broadcasts; it refreshes the SDK’s cached file directory.
en.disableEffect: VCloud’s cached file location will not refresh after storage changes, which can interrupt access to attachments on removable storage.

zh-CN.description: Android 在可移动存储挂载、移除、卸载、异常移除或共享时通知 VCloud 接收器；它会刷新 SDK 缓存的文件目录。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 存储变化后，VCloud 缓存的文件位置不会刷新，可能导致无法访问可移动存储中的附件。

en.description: Android sends this VCloud Receiver boot, unlock, screen on/off, and network-change broadcasts; it starts VCloud’s push, messaging, and call services for background communication.
en.disableEffect: VCloud may stop restarting background communication services after those device events, so incoming message or call alerts may be delayed or missed.

zh-CN.description: Android 在设备启动、解锁、屏幕开关或网络变化时通知 VCloud 接收器；它会启动 VCloud 推送、消息和通话服务以维持后台通信。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 这些设备事件发生后，VCloud 可能不再重启后台通信服务，因此新消息或来电提醒可能延迟或丢失。

en.description: When opened from VCloud’s camera settings, this Activity shows a live camera preview and controls for adjusting the video-call beauty effect.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open VCloud’s video-call beauty controls or adjust the camera effect from this screen.

zh-CN.description: 从 VCloud 摄像头设置打开时，该活动会显示实时摄像头预览，并提供视频通话美颜效果调节控件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开 VCloud 视频通话的美颜控件，也无法在此界面调节摄像头效果。

en.description: When VCloud’s image flow opens it, this Activity loads a selected image, lets the user adjust a crop, and saves the result to the requested output location.
en.disableEffect: VCloud’s image-cropping flow cannot complete, which can prevent a cropped photo from being used in a message.

zh-CN.description: VCloud 图片流程打开该活动时，它会载入所选图片、供用户调整裁剪区域，并将结果保存到指定位置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: VCloud 图片裁剪流程将无法完成，可能导致裁剪后的照片无法用于消息。

en.description: When VCloud’s photo flow opens it, this Activity previews a selected or captured image, crops the visible area, and returns the saved image location.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot crop and return a photo through this VCloud flow, interrupting photo selection or sharing.

zh-CN.description: VCloud 照片流程打开该活动时，它会预览所选或拍摄的图片、裁剪当前显示区域，并返回保存后的图片位置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此 VCloud 流程裁剪并返回照片，从而中断照片选择或分享。

en.description: When VCloud needs to explain a camera or microphone permission for a call, this Activity shows the matching permission dialog and closes after the user responds.
en.disableEffect: The in-app camera or microphone permission explanation cannot open, which can interrupt starting a voice or video call.

zh-CN.description: VCloud 需要为通话说明摄像头或麦克风权限时，该活动会显示相应的权限对话框，并在用户响应后关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用内的摄像头或麦克风权限说明无法打开，可能中断语音或视频通话的启动。

en.description: When a VCloud group conversation opens its member picker, this Activity displays contacts so the user can choose people to mention in the conversation.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot choose group members through VCloud’s mention picker.

zh-CN.description: VCloud 群组会话打开成员选择器时，该活动会显示联系人，供用户选择要在会话中提及的人。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 VCloud 的提及选择器选择群组成员。

en.description: When VCloud opens a conversation’s image gallery, this Activity shows the image URLs supplied by the chat and returns the position of the image the user taps.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open the conversation’s image grid through this VCloud flow.

zh-CN.description: VCloud 打开会话图片库时，该活动会显示聊天传入的图片，并在用户点选后返回图片位置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此 VCloud 流程打开会话图片网格。

en.description: Opened from VCloud’s message composer, this Activity lets the user select photos from albums or take a new photo, then returns the selected file paths for the message.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot attach or capture photos through VCloud’s image picker.

zh-CN.description: 从 VCloud 消息编辑器打开时，该活动允许用户从相册选择照片或拍摄新照片，然后将所选文件路径返回给消息流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 VCloud 图片选择器附加或拍摄照片。

en.description: VCloud opens this Activity to preview conversation images; its menu lets the user save an image locally or forward it to another conversation.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot use VCloud’s image-preview, save, or forward controls for these images.

zh-CN.description: VCloud 打开该活动以预览会话图片；菜单允许用户将图片保存到本地或转发到其他会话。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法使用 VCloud 的图片预览、保存或转发控件。

en.description: Started by VCloud’s messaging and call controls, this background Service maintains one-to-one and group voice/video calls and handles live-room media.
en.disableEffect: VCloud calls, group video, and live audio/video sessions may not connect or continue.

zh-CN.description: 由 VCloud 消息和通话控件启动时，该后台服务会维护一对一及群组语音或视频通话，并处理直播间媒体。
zh-CN.disableEffect: VCloud 通话、群组视频及直播音视频可能无法连接或继续运行。

en.description: Opened with a VCloud live-room role and room ID, this Activity creates or rejoins the live-video view and resumes video playback as the room state changes.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot re-enter or continue a VCloud live-video room through this screen.

zh-CN.description: 收到 VCloud 直播角色和房间编号后，该活动会建立或重新加入直播画面，并根据房间状态恢复视频播放。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此界面重新进入或继续 VCloud 直播间。

en.description: Opened for a VCloud live room, this Activity lets hosts and viewers create or join a live video session, exchange room messages, and use live-call controls.
en.disableEffect: VCloud live video, room chat, and on-stage call features using this screen will fail to open.

zh-CN.description: VCloud 打开该活动以创建或加入直播视频会话；主播和观众可在其中发送房间消息并使用连麦通话控件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此界面的 VCloud 直播、房间聊天和连麦功能将无法打开。

en.description: VCloud launches this Activity for its conversation screen; it opens one-to-one and group chats and connects the chat and call interfaces.
en.disableEffect: VCloud’s main chat interface cannot open, blocking conversation and call flows supplied by the SDK.

zh-CN.description: VCloud 启动该活动显示会话界面；它可打开单聊和群聊，并连接聊天及通话界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: VCloud 主聊天界面将无法打开，SDK 提供的会话和通话流程也会受阻。

en.description: When a VCloud live room opens its comment composer, this Activity lets the user type and send a message to the live conversation.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot send messages from the VCloud live-room composer.

zh-CN.description: VCloud 直播间打开评论编辑器时，该活动允许用户输入并向直播会话发送消息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 VCloud 直播间编辑器发送消息。

en.description: When the host app opens Codeboy Android Common’s update screen, this Activity displays an update title, release details, and action buttons.
en.disableEffect: An app that uses this screen cannot display or complete this update prompt.

zh-CN.description: 宿主应用打开 Codeboy Android Common 的更新界面时，该活动会显示更新标题、版本说明和操作按钮。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此界面的应用将无法显示或完成该更新提示。

en.description: Daemon369 Android Infrastructure uses this provider to expose eligible app files through private content links, including downloaded packages handed to Android's installer.
en.disableEffect: Blocking it breaks package installation through this library on Android 7 and later, along with other file links that rely on it.

zh-CN.description: Daemon369 Android Infrastructure 使用此 Provider 通过私有内容链接提供应用文件，包括交给 Android 安装程序的已下载安装包。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 在 Android 7 及更高版本中停用后，该库的安装包安装流程会失效，依赖它的其他文件链接也无法打开。

en.description: When CZXing (Devilsen QR and barcode scanner) completes a scan without an app-provided result handler, this Activity shows the scanned text and lets the user copy it.
en.disableEffect: The scanner cannot open its built-in result screen, so scans that rely on that screen will not show or copy the result.

zh-CN.description: CZXing（Devilsen 二维码和条码扫描库）完成扫描且应用未提供结果处理界面时，此 Activity 会显示扫描文本，并允许用户复制内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 扫描器无法打开内置结果界面，因此依赖该界面的扫描流程将无法显示或复制结果。

en.description: When an app starts the CZXing scanner, this Activity requests camera access and opens a camera preview to read QR codes and barcodes. It can also accept an image selected from the album and return successful scan results to the app or the SDK result screen.
en.disableEffect: QR and barcode scanning in the app can no longer open this scanner or return a scan result.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动 CZXing 扫描器时，此 Activity 会请求相机权限并打开相机预览以读取二维码和条码。它也可以接收从相册选取的图片，并将扫描结果返回应用或 SDK 的结果界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用中的二维码和条码扫描功能将无法打开此扫描界面或返回扫描结果。

en.description: When digi.me opens this Activity during a consent flow, it hands the supplied web link to the browser or receives the return link and passes the consent result and authorization details back to the app.
en.disableEffect: digi.me consent or authorization may not return a result, preventing the related account-linking or data-sharing flow from completing.

zh-CN.description: digi.me 在同意流程中打开该活动时，它会将提供的网页链接交给浏览器，或接收返回链接并把同意结果和授权信息传回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: digi.me 同意或授权流程可能无法返回结果，导致相关账户关联或数据共享无法完成。

en.description: During digi.me guest consent, this Activity hands the supplied link to the browser and receives the consent return link, reporting acceptance or cancellation to the app.
en.disableEffect: The app may not receive the guest-consent result, so the digi.me guest-sharing flow can fail.

zh-CN.description: digi.me 来宾同意流程中，该活动会将提供的链接交给浏览器，接收同意后的返回链接，并向应用报告接受或取消结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用可能无法收到来宾同意结果，导致 digi.me 来宾共享流程失败。

en.description: When a digi.me return notification is tapped after the SDK opens the digi.me app for consent or postbox creation, this short-lived Activity closes immediately to bring the host app back to the foreground.
en.disableEffect: The return notification cannot bring the host app back to finish the digi.me consent or postbox handoff.

zh-CN.description: SDK 为同意或创建数据箱而打开 digi.me 应用后，用户点按返回通知时，该短暂活动会立即关闭，使宿主应用回到前台。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 返回通知将无法把宿主应用带回前台以完成 digi.me 同意或数据箱交接。

en.description: When CrashWoodpecker opens its crash-log viewer, this Activity lists captured crash traces and offers to share the report.
en.disableEffect: Crash-log browsing and sharing will be unavailable; ordinary app screens are unaffected.

zh-CN.description: CrashWoodpecker 打开崩溃日志查看器时，该活动会列出捕获的崩溃记录，并提供分享报告的操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 崩溃日志查看和分享将不可用；应用的日常界面不受影响。

en.description: When CrashWoodpecker presents an error-recovery prompt, this Activity shows the supplied message and lets the user download an offered build or restart the app.
en.disableEffect: CrashWoodpecker’s recovery prompt will not appear; the normal app flow is unaffected.

zh-CN.description: CrashWoodpecker 显示错误恢复提示时，该活动会呈现传入的说明，并允许用户下载提供的版本或重启应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: CrashWoodpecker 的恢复提示将不会显示；应用的正常流程不受影响。

en.description: When CrashWoodpecker presents a patch prompt, this Activity shows the supplied update message and offers download or restart actions.
en.disableEffect: CrashWoodpecker’s patch prompt will not appear; the normal app flow is unaffected.

zh-CN.description: CrashWoodpecker 显示补丁提示时，该活动会呈现传入的更新说明，并提供下载或重启操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: CrashWoodpecker 的补丁提示将不会显示；应用的正常流程不受影响。

en.description: UETool (Ele.me) is a UI inspection tool; it opens this transparent Activity over the app to show view details, a layout grid, or spacing between elements. It is used for the tool’s inspection overlay.
en.disableEffect: UETool’s on-screen layout inspection tools will not open.

zh-CN.description: UETool（Ele.me）是界面检查工具；它会在应用上方打开此透明 Activity，显示视图信息、网格或元素间距。此 Activity 用于工具的检查浮层。
zh-CN.disableEffect: UETool 的屏幕布局检查工具将无法打开。

en.description: When ID.me Social Contacts starts a contact-connection flow, this Activity opens an embedded web page for Yahoo contact authorization and retrieval.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot connect Yahoo contacts through ID.me Social Contacts.

zh-CN.description: ID.me Social Contacts 启动联系人连接流程时，该活动会打开内嵌网页以授权并获取 Yahoo 联系人。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 ID.me Social Contacts 连接 Yahoo 联系人。

en.description: When ID.me authentication starts, this Activity shows sign-up and sign-in choices and hosts the selected account flow.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot complete ID.me sign-in or registration through this SDK.

zh-CN.description: ID.me 身份验证启动时，该活动会显示注册和登录选项，并承载用户选择的账户流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此 SDK 完成 ID.me 登录或注册。

en.description: Opened from ID.me’s identity flow, this Activity displays the SDK’s help page for account or credential verification.
en.disableEffect: The ID.me help page cannot open, leaving that guidance unavailable.

zh-CN.description: 由 ID.me 身份流程打开时，该活动会显示 SDK 的账户或凭证验证帮助页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: ID.me 帮助页面将无法打开，相关说明也无法查看。

en.description: When ID.me credential verification starts, this Activity opens the camera and scans an identity credential’s barcode, then returns the scan result to the SDK.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot scan an identity credential, so ID.me verification through this flow cannot finish.

zh-CN.description: ID.me 凭证验证启动时，该活动会打开摄像头并扫描身份凭证条码，然后将扫描结果返回 SDK。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法扫描身份凭证，因此无法通过此流程完成 ID.me 验证。

en.description: When the app starts ID.me verification or sign-in, the ID.me Web Verify SDK opens its identity page in a browser tab.
en.disableEffect: ID.me verification or sign-in cannot open, so the app cannot complete that authentication flow.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动 ID.me 身份验证或登录流程时，ID.me Web Verify SDK 会在浏览器标签页中打开 ID.me 页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，ID.me 页面无法打开，应用也无法完成该身份验证流程。

en.description: When the browser returns from ID.me, the ID.me Web Verify SDK receives the redirect and returns the sign-in result to the app; it also handles the return from sign-out.
en.disableEffect: ID.me sign-in or sign-out cannot return its result to the app.

zh-CN.description: 用户从浏览器返回 ID.me 时，ID.me Web Verify SDK 会接收重定向并把登录结果交回应用，也会处理退出登录后的返回。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，ID.me 登录或退出流程无法把结果返回给应用。

en.description: In older ID.me Web Verify flows, this screen displays the ID.me verification page inside the app.
en.disableEffect: The older SDK cannot open this verification screen, so its sign-in or verification flow cannot finish.

zh-CN.description: 在旧版 ID.me Web Verify 流程中，此页面会在应用内显示 ID.me 验证页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，旧版 SDK 无法打开该验证页面，相关登录或验证流程无法完成。

en.description: When an app shares a file or folder from a USB drive, the libaums library serves it over HTTP and keeps an ongoing notification while the server runs.
en.disableEffect: The app can no longer share USB drive files through this HTTP service.

zh-CN.description: 应用共享 USB 驱动器上的文件或文件夹时，libaums 库会通过 HTTP 提供这些内容，并在服务运行期间显示持续通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用无法通过此 HTTP 服务共享 USB 驱动器上的文件。

en.description: The libaums USB storage library makes connected USB drives available in Android's document picker and updates the listing when drives are attached or removed.
en.disableEffect: USB drives will not appear through this document source, so apps cannot browse, open, or save their files there.

zh-CN.description: libaums USB 存储库会在 Android 文件选择器中提供已连接的 USB 驱动器，并在设备插入或移除时更新列表。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，USB 驱动器不会通过此来源显示，应用也无法在这里浏览、打开或保存其中的文件。

en.description: When an app shares a file or folder from a USB drive, the libaums library serves it over HTTP and keeps an ongoing notification while the server runs.
en.disableEffect: The app can no longer share USB drive files through this HTTP service.

zh-CN.description: 应用共享 USB 驱动器上的文件或文件夹时，libaums 库会通过 HTTP 提供这些内容，并在服务运行期间显示持续通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用无法通过此 HTTP 服务共享 USB 驱动器上的文件。

en.description: The libaums USB storage library makes connected USB drives available in Android's document picker and updates the listing when drives are attached or removed.
en.disableEffect: USB drives will not appear through this document source, so apps cannot browse, open, or save their files there.

zh-CN.description: libaums USB 存储库会在 Android 文件选择器中提供已连接的 USB 驱动器，并在设备插入或移除时更新列表。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，USB 驱动器不会通过此来源显示，应用也无法在这里浏览、打开或保存其中的文件。

en.description: The AndroidAutoSize library, originally by JessYan and also distributed in community copies, initializes the app's screen-size adaptation when the app starts.
en.disableEffect: The app may stop applying this screen-size adaptation, so controls and text can appear too large or too small.

zh-CN.description: AndroidAutoSize 库（原作者为 JessYan，也有社区分发版本）会在应用启动时初始化屏幕适配。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用可能不再使用这套屏幕适配，控件和文字可能显得过大或过小。

en.description: Leon406's Ade cmp-lib utility library starts this file provider during app initialization. It initializes the utility helpers and supplies shareable links for files configured by the app.
en.disableEffect: Utility startup and file-sharing flows that use this provider may fail.

zh-CN.description: Leon406 的 Ade cmp-lib 工具库会在应用初始化时启动此文件提供器。它会初始化工具功能，并为应用配置的文件提供可分享的链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此提供器的工具初始化和文件分享流程可能失败。

en.description: Leon406's Ade cmp-lib opens this transparent screen when it requests runtime permissions, permission to change system settings, or permission to draw over other apps. It returns the user's grant or denial to the app.
en.disableEffect: Permissions requested through cmp-lib may not appear or return a result, which can break app features that need them.

zh-CN.description: Leon406 的 Ade cmp-lib 请求运行时权限、修改系统设置权限或悬浮显示权限时，会打开此透明界面，并将用户的允许或拒绝结果返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过 cmp-lib 发起的权限请求可能无法显示或返回结果，依赖这些权限的应用功能可能受影响。

en.description: When Android initializes Luzhuo Core's file-sharing provider at app startup, it saves the app context and exposes the library's approved files for sharing with other apps.
en.disableEffect: Features that rely on the library's startup context or shared files may fail to initialize or share files.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，Luzhuo Core 的文件共享提供程序会保存应用上下文，并允许其他应用读取 SDK 配置的共享文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖该库启动上下文或文件共享功能的部分功能可能无法初始化或分享文件。

en.description: When the app opens a video from Luzhuo Image Select, this screen displays its cover image and plays the selected video with playback controls.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot play videos through the Image Select library's video viewer.

zh-CN.description: 应用通过 Luzhuo Image Select 打开视频时，此页面会显示封面并播放选中的视频，同时提供播放控制。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过 Image Select 库的视频页面播放视频。

en.description: When an app starts a scan from Luzhuo QRCode, this screen opens the camera, reads a QR code, and returns its text; it also offers a flashlight control when available.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot scan QR codes or return their contents through this screen.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动 Luzhuo QRCode 扫码时，此页面会打开相机读取二维码并返回内容；设备支持时还可控制补光灯。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用无法通过此页面扫描二维码并取得内容。

en.description: When the app starts a barcode scan, Majiajie Barcode Scanning opens a camera screen, lets the user toggle the flashlight, and returns the first detected barcode text.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot use this SDK screen to scan barcodes and return their text.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动条码扫描时，Majiajie Barcode Scanning 会打开相机页面，允许切换闪光灯，并返回第一个识别到的条码文本。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用无法通过此 SDK 页面扫描条码并返回文本。

en.description: When the app opens Majiajie RFID Helper settings for a connected reader, the screen shows reader details and lets the user adjust read power or the beeper, disconnect, or return to scanning.
en.disableEffect: Users lose this screen for viewing or changing reader settings and disconnecting the reader.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开 Majiajie RFID Helper 的已连接设备设置时，页面会显示阅读器信息，并可调整读取功率或提示音、断开设备或返回扫描。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过此页面查看或更改阅读器设置，也无法从此处断开设备。

en.description: When an app starts Bluetooth setup for an RFID reader, Majiajie RFID Helper lists Bluetooth devices and connects the selected OR2505 reader.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot select and connect an OR2505 Bluetooth reader through this screen.

zh-CN.description: 应用为 RFID 阅读器启动蓝牙连接时，Majiajie RFID Helper 会列出蓝牙设备，并连接用户选中的 OR2505 阅读器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过此页面选择并连接 OR2505 蓝牙阅读器。

en.description: When the app connects an OR2127 RFID reader, this Majiajie RFID Helper screen lists Bluetooth devices, connects the selected reader, and returns the connection result.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot connect an OR2127 reader through this screen.

zh-CN.description: 应用连接 OR2127 RFID 阅读器时，Majiajie RFID Helper 页面会列出蓝牙设备、连接所选设备并返回连接结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用无法通过此页面连接 OR2127 阅读器。

en.description: When the app connects an OR2505 RFID reader, this Majiajie RFID Helper screen lists Bluetooth devices, connects the selected reader, and returns the connection result.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot connect an OR2505 reader through this screen.

zh-CN.description: 应用连接 OR2505 RFID 阅读器时，Majiajie RFID Helper 页面会列出蓝牙设备、连接所选设备并返回连接结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用无法通过此页面连接 OR2505 阅读器。

en.description: When the app opens an UnlockPremium offer, this screen lists premium benefits and provides options to purchase or restore in-app purchases.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot show this offer or start its purchase and restore flow through UnlockPremium.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开 UnlockPremium 购买页时，此页面会列出高级权益，并提供购买或恢复应用内购买的入口。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用无法通过 UnlockPremium 显示该购买页或开始购买、恢复流程。

en.description: When an app requests Disqus authorization, Disqus for Android displays the login page in a WebView and returns the authorization result to the app.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot complete Disqus authorization or receive the login token.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求 Disqus 授权时，Disqus for Android 会在应用内网页中显示登录页面，并将授权结果返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用无法完成 Disqus 授权或收到登录令牌。

en.description: Proton AG's Proton Core Android SDK opens this Activity when the app asks to sign out, disable, or remove an account. It asks the user to confirm that account action.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, the app may not be able to complete its account sign-out, disabling, or removal flow.

zh-CN.description: Proton AG 的 Proton Core Android SDK 会在应用要求退出、停用或移除账户时打开此 Activity，并请用户确认该操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用可能无法完成账户退出、停用或移除流程。

en.description: Proton AG's Proton Core Android SDK opens this Activity when the app starts account recovery for an account. It presents the recovery dialog and can continue to password management.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, account-recovery steps and the password-management handoff that use this dialog will not open.

zh-CN.description: Proton AG 的 Proton Core Android SDK 会在应用启动账户恢复时打开此 Activity，显示恢复对话框，并可继续进入密码管理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，依赖此对话框的账户恢复步骤和密码管理入口将无法打开。

en.description: Proton AG's Proton Core Android SDK opens this dialog during account recovery when a password reset is needed. It offers the password-reset step and can open Proton's account reset page.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, the user may be unable to continue the password-reset part of account recovery in the app.

zh-CN.description: Proton AG 的 Proton Core Android SDK 会在账户恢复需要重置密码时打开此对话框，提供密码重置步骤，并可打开 Proton 账户重置页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户可能无法在应用中继续账户恢复的密码重置步骤。

en.description: Proton AG's Proton Core Android SDK opens this Activity when the user chooses to add an account. It runs the sign-in or sign-up flow and returns the result to the app.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, users may be unable to add another account or finish sign-in through the add-account flow.

zh-CN.description: Proton AG 的 Proton Core Android SDK 会在用户选择添加账户时打开此 Activity，运行登录或注册流程，并将结果返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户可能无法通过添加账户流程添加其他账户或完成登录。

en.description: Proton AG's Proton Core Android SDK opens this Activity from sign-in help. It offers account-recovery and support choices, including help for starting sign-in on a new device.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, users may lose the in-app help and recovery routes needed to regain access to an account.

zh-CN.description: Proton AG 的 Proton Core Android SDK 会在用户打开登录帮助时显示此 Activity，提供账户恢复和支持选项，也包括在新设备上开始登录的帮助。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户可能无法使用应用内的帮助和恢复入口来重新访问账户。

en.description: Proton AG's Proton Core Android SDK opens this Activity during new-account setup so the user can choose or confirm a Proton email address. It checks available domains and username suggestions before returning the setup result.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, new-account setup may not be able to finish choosing the account address.

zh-CN.description: Proton AG 的 Proton Core Android SDK 会在新账户设置期间打开此 Activity，让用户选择或确认 Proton 邮箱地址；它会检查可用域名和用户名建议，然后返回设置结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，新账户设置可能无法完成地址选择。

en.description: Proton AG's Proton Core Android SDK opens this Activity when an account action requires the user to confirm their password. It returns whether the password check succeeded.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, password-confirmation steps for sensitive account actions may fail to open.

zh-CN.description: Proton AG 的 Proton Core Android SDK 会在账户操作需要再次确认密码时打开此 Activity，并返回密码验证是否成功。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，敏感账户操作所需的密码确认步骤可能无法打开。

en.description: Proton AG's Proton Core Android SDK opens this Activity during sign-in when a new device needs approval. It presents the account's device-approval step, including member or administrator approval.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, sign-ins that require device approval may not complete.

zh-CN.description: Proton AG 的 Proton Core Android SDK 会在新设备登录需要批准时打开此 Activity，显示账户的设备批准步骤，包括成员或管理员批准。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，需要设备批准的登录可能无法完成。

en.description: Proton AG's Proton Core Android SDK opens this Activity when sign-in needs a backup password or organization-admin help. It guides the user through those account-security steps and returns the outcome.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, users who need a backup password or administrator assistance may be unable to finish signing in.

zh-CN.description: Proton AG 的 Proton Core Android SDK 会在登录需要备用密码或组织管理员协助时打开此 Activity，引导用户完成账户安全步骤并返回结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，需要备用密码或管理员协助的用户可能无法完成登录。

en.description: Proton AG's Proton Core Android SDK opens this Activity when the app asks a user to sign in. It collects the account credentials, handles the sign-in result, and returns the signed-in account to the app.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, users may be unable to sign in to the app or access their accounts.

zh-CN.description: Proton AG 的 Proton Core Android SDK 会在应用要求用户登录时打开此 Activity，收集账户凭据、处理登录结果，并将已登录账户返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户可能无法登录应用或访问账户。

en.description: Proton AG's Proton Core Android SDK opens this Activity when an organization account signs in through single sign-on. It opens the identity-provider page in an in-app web view or browser tab and processes the return to the app.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, organization single sign-on and its return flow may not work.

zh-CN.description: Proton AG 的 Proton Core Android SDK 会在组织账户使用单点登录时打开此 Activity，在应用内网页或浏览器标签页中打开身份提供方页面，并处理返回应用的结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，组织单点登录及其返回流程可能无法使用。

en.description: Proton AG's Proton Core Android SDK opens this Activity for a two-step sign-in flow. It asks for the account name or email first, then the password, and can continue through supported single sign-on.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, users assigned this sign-in flow may not be able to access their accounts.

zh-CN.description: Proton AG 的 Proton Core Android SDK 会在两步登录流程中打开此 Activity，先询问账户名或邮箱，再询问密码，也可继续使用受支持的单点登录。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，使用此登录流程的用户可能无法访问账户。

en.description: Proton AG's Proton Core Android SDK opens this Activity after password sign-in when the account requires two-factor authentication. It accepts a one-time or recovery code, or a security key, and returns the verification result.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, users who have two-factor authentication enabled may be unable to sign in.

zh-CN.description: Proton AG 的 Proton Core Android SDK 会在密码登录后、账户要求双重验证时打开此 Activity。它可接收一次性验证码或恢复码，也可使用安全密钥，并返回验证结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，启用了双重验证的用户可能无法登录。

en.description: Proton AG's Proton Core Android SDK opens this Activity for accounts that use a separate mailbox password. It asks the user to unlock the Proton Mail mailbox after sign-in.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, users with a separate mailbox password may be unable to unlock their mail after signing in.

zh-CN.description: Proton AG 的 Proton Core Android SDK 会为使用独立邮箱密码的账户打开此 Activity，在登录后要求用户解锁 Proton Mail 邮箱。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，使用独立邮箱密码的用户可能无法在登录后解锁邮件。

en.description: Proton AG's Proton Core Android SDK opens this Activity when the user creates a Proton account. It collects account details and password, supports recovery and verification steps, and returns the sign-up result.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, users may be unable to create an account through the app.

zh-CN.description: Proton AG 的 Proton Core Android SDK 会在用户创建 Proton 账户时打开此 Activity，收集账户信息和密码，支持恢复及验证步骤，并返回注册结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户可能无法通过应用创建账户。

en.description: Proton AG's Proton Core Android SDK opens this Activity on the current device when the user starts an account transfer to another device. It guides the source-device side of the transfer.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, users may not be able to prepare or complete this device-migration flow.

zh-CN.description: Proton AG 的 Proton Core Android SDK 会在用户从当前设备向另一台设备转移账户时打开此 Activity，引导原设备完成转移步骤。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户可能无法准备或完成此设备迁移流程。

en.description: Proton AG's Proton Core Android SDK opens this Activity on the receiving device during account migration. It guides the new device through connecting to the existing account and returns the sign-in or migration result.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, users may not be able to connect a new device or finish the migration sign-in.

zh-CN.description: Proton AG 的 Proton Core Android SDK 会在账户迁移期间于接收设备上打开此 Activity，引导新设备连接现有账户，并返回登录或迁移结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户可能无法连接新设备或完成迁移登录。

en.description: Proton AG's Proton Core Android SDK opens this Activity when device migration needs to scan a pairing QR code. It uses the camera to read the code and can return a request for manual entry.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, QR-based device pairing may not work and the migration flow may not complete.

zh-CN.description: Proton AG 的 Proton Core Android SDK 会在设备迁移需要扫描配对二维码时打开此 Activity，使用相机读取二维码，也可返回手动输入请求。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，二维码设备配对可能无法使用，迁移流程也可能无法完成。

en.description: Proton AG's Proton Core Android SDK opens this Activity when Proton requires a human-verification check, such as during account creation. It presents the verification flow and returns whether it completed.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, sign-up or other account flows that require human verification may be blocked.

zh-CN.description: Proton AG 的 Proton Core Android SDK 会在 Proton 要求人机验证时打开此 Activity，例如创建账户期间。它显示验证流程，并返回是否完成。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，需要人机验证的注册或其他账户流程可能会受阻。

en.description: Proton AG's Proton Core Android SDK opens this Activity when a flow needs to show a web page inside the app. It loads the requested page and reports success, cancellation, or an error to the caller.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, web-based sign-in and other flows that rely on this in-app page may fail.

zh-CN.description: Proton AG 的 Proton Core Android SDK 会在某个流程需要于应用内显示网页时打开此 Activity。它加载指定页面，并向调用方返回成功、取消或错误状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，依赖此应用内网页的登录和其他流程可能会失败。

en.description: Proton AG's Proton Core Android SDK receives an internal app link from a notification or pending intent and routes it to the matching in-app screen.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, notification links that use this route may stop opening their intended screen.

zh-CN.description: Proton AG 的 Proton Core Android SDK 会接收来自通知或待处理意图的应用内链接，并将用户带到对应页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，使用此入口的通知链接可能无法打开对应页面。

en.description: Proton AG's Proton Core Android SDK opens this Activity when the app asks the user to enable notifications. It explains the request when needed, launches Android's notification-permission prompt, and returns the user's choice.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, this in-app flow cannot request notification permission, so app notifications may not be enabled from the app.

zh-CN.description: Proton AG 的 Proton Core Android SDK 会在应用询问用户是否启用通知时打开此 Activity。需要时它会说明原因，随后启动 Android 通知权限提示，并返回用户的选择。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用无法通过此流程请求通知权限，因此可能无法在应用内启用通知。

en.description: Proton AG's Proton Core Android SDK opens this Activity during supported in-app checkout. It presents billing details, processes the payment, and returns the purchase result.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, users may be unable to complete an in-app purchase or subscription payment.

zh-CN.description: Proton AG 的 Proton Core Android SDK 会在支持的应用内结账流程中打开此 Activity，显示账单信息、处理付款并返回购买结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户可能无法完成应用内购买或订阅付款。

en.description: Proton AG's Proton Core Android SDK opens this Activity when a purchase needs the user to choose a payment method. It lists the available options and starts the selected payment flow.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, users may be unable to choose a payment method or continue checkout.

zh-CN.description: Proton AG 的 Proton Core Android SDK 会在购买流程需要用户选择付款方式时打开此 Activity，列出可用选项并启动所选付款流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户可能无法选择付款方式或继续结账。
