en.description: Proton AG's Proton Core Android SDK opens this Activity when a payment provider requires a secure approval page for a payment token. It loads that page and returns whether the token is ready to charge.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, payments requiring this approval step may not complete.

zh-CN.description: Proton AG 的 Proton Core Android SDK 会在付款提供方要求安全页面批准付款令牌时打开此 Activity。它加载该页面，并返回令牌是否可用于扣款。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，需要此批准步骤的付款可能无法完成。

en.description: Proton AG's Proton Core Android SDK opens this Activity when the app presents its dynamic plan choices. It hosts the plan-selection page so the user can review available subscriptions.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, users may not be able to open the plan chooser or continue to a selected subscription.

zh-CN.description: Proton AG 的 Proton Core Android SDK 会在应用显示动态套餐选项时打开此 Activity，承载套餐选择页面供用户查看可用订阅。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户可能无法打开套餐选择器或继续选择订阅。

en.description: Proton AG's Proton Core Android SDK opens this Activity from a plan-upgrade link or flow. It shows upgrade options for the account and returns the selected plan and billing result.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, plan-upgrade links and in-app subscription upgrades may not work.

zh-CN.description: Proton AG 的 Proton Core Android SDK 会在打开套餐升级链接或流程时启动此 Activity，显示账户可升级的选项，并返回所选套餐和付款结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，套餐升级链接和应用内订阅升级可能无法使用。

en.description: Proton AG's Proton Core Android SDK opens this Activity when it finds a Google Play purchase that has not yet been applied to the account. It asks whether to redeem the purchase and reports the result.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, a pending Google Play purchase may remain unredeemed and the related subscription may not activate.

zh-CN.description: Proton AG 的 Proton Core Android SDK 会在发现尚未应用到账户的 Google Play 购买时打开此 Activity，询问是否兑换该购买并返回处理结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，待处理的 Google Play 购买可能无法兑换，相关订阅也可能无法激活。

en.description: Proton AG's Proton Core Android SDK opens this Activity when the server tells the app that an update is required. It displays the blocking update message and can offer a learn-more link.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, users may be unable to continue when the service requires a newer app version.

zh-CN.description: Proton AG 的 Proton Core Android SDK 会在服务器要求应用更新时打开此 Activity，显示阻止继续使用的更新提示，并可提供了解详情的链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，当服务要求使用较新版本时，用户可能无法继续操作。

en.description: Proton AG's Proton Core Android SDK opens this Activity when the user chooses to report a problem. It presents the bug-report form and returns the report-submission result.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, users may not be able to submit a bug report from the app.

zh-CN.description: Proton AG 的 Proton Core Android SDK 会在用户选择报告问题时打开此 Activity，显示问题报告表单并返回提交结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户可能无法通过应用提交问题报告。

en.description: Proton AG's Proton Core Android SDK opens this secure dialog when the app starts device recovery for an account. It presents the recovery step for that user and closes or returns when the step is finished.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, users who need this account-recovery step may be unable to restore access to the account.

zh-CN.description: Proton AG 的 Proton Core Android SDK 会在应用为账户启动设备恢复时打开此安全对话框，显示该用户的恢复步骤，并在完成或退出时返回。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，需要此恢复步骤的用户可能无法重新访问账户。

en.description: Proton AG's Proton Core Android SDK opens this Activity from account settings to change the account password. It supports the main and second password and returns the update result.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, users may be unable to change their account password in the app.

zh-CN.description: Proton AG 的 Proton Core Android SDK 会在账户设置中打开此 Activity 以修改账户密码。它支持主密码和第二密码，并返回修改结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户可能无法在应用中修改账户密码。

en.description: Proton AG's Proton Core Android SDK opens this Activity from security settings to add or manage security keys used with the account's two-factor sign-in.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, users may be unable to add or manage security keys for account sign-in.

zh-CN.description: Proton AG 的 Proton Core Android SDK 会在安全设置中打开此 Activity，以添加或管理用于账户双重验证登录的安全密钥。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户可能无法添加或管理账户登录所用的安全密钥。

en.description: Proton AG's Proton Core Android SDK opens this Activity when an account action needs an extra two-factor check. It asks the user to verify their identity and returns the proof to the app.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, account actions that require this two-factor confirmation may fail.

zh-CN.description: Proton AG 的 Proton Core Android SDK 会在账户操作需要额外双重验证时打开此 Activity，要求用户验证身份并将验证凭据返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，需要此双重确认的账户操作可能会失败。

en.description: Proton AG's Proton Core Android SDK opens this Activity from account settings to add, confirm, or change the recovery email address. It returns the update result to the app.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, users may be unable to set or update the email used to recover the account.

zh-CN.description: Proton AG 的 Proton Core Android SDK 会在账户设置中打开此 Activity，以添加、确认或更改恢复邮箱，并将修改结果返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户可能无法设置或更新用于恢复账户的邮箱。

en.description: After Android reports that the device has restarted, WeLoop's Pushy Receiver starts the background service that reconnects to notifications.
en.disableEffect: Push notifications will not be restored automatically after a device restart.

zh-CN.description: Android 通知设备重启后，WeLoop 集成的 Pushy Receiver 会启动后台通知服务并重新连接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 设备重启后，推送通知将无法自动恢复连接。

en.description: When an internal refresh broadcast arrives, this WeLoop Pushy Receiver briefly wakes the device and restarts the notification connection.
en.disableEffect: The background notification service will not restart in response to that signal.

zh-CN.description: 收到内部刷新广播时，WeLoop 集成的 Pushy Receiver 会短暂唤醒设备并重启通知连接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 后台通知服务将无法响应此信号重新启动。

en.description: Android runs this WeLoop Pushy Service on a background schedule to reconnect to the notification server and keep the connection active.
en.disableEffect: Scheduled reconnects and background push delivery through this service will stop.

zh-CN.description: Android 会按后台计划运行 WeLoop 集成的 Pushy Service，以重新连接通知服务并保持连接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 此服务安排的重连和后台推送将停止。

en.description: After Pushy starts it, this WeLoop Service maintains the notification connection and reconnects when network access changes.
en.disableEffect: Push notifications will stop while this connection is unavailable.

zh-CN.description: Pushy 启动此 WeLoop Service 后，它会维持通知连接，并在网络变化时重新连接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 连接不可用时，推送通知将停止。

en.description: Android UIX (Shouheng88) displays its crash screen here after the app sends it an error message. The screen can show the error and log details, copy the log, or restart the app.
en.disableEffect: The app will lose this crash screen, its copyable log details, and its restart action.

zh-CN.description: Android UIX（Shouheng88）会在应用传入错误信息后显示此崩溃页面，可展示错误和日志详情、复制日志或重启应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法显示此崩溃页面、复制日志详情或使用重启操作。

en.description: Android UIX (Shouheng88) displays the app’s introductory pages here, with controls to move between pages, skip them, or finish onboarding. The app supplies the page text and images.
en.disableEffect: The app’s introduction or onboarding flow will not be available.

zh-CN.description: Android UIX（Shouheng88）在此显示应用介绍页面，并提供翻页、跳过和完成引导的操作；页面文字和图片由应用提供。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用的介绍或新手引导流程将无法使用。

en.description: Android UIX (Shouheng88) displays its newer crash screen here when the app supplies an error report. The screen can show details, open the report action, or restart the app.
en.disableEffect: The app’s crash details, report action, and restart screen will not open.

zh-CN.description: Android UIX（Shouheng88）会在应用传入错误报告后显示新版崩溃页面，可查看详情、提交报告或重启应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法打开崩溃详情、报告操作或重启页面。

en.description: Android UIX (Shouheng88) opens a full-screen viewer for photos the app provides. Users can swipe between photos and close the viewer by pulling the screen back.
en.disableEffect: The app’s UIX photo-viewing flow will not open.

zh-CN.description: Android UIX（Shouheng88）会全屏显示应用传入的照片，用户可左右滑动切换，并通过下拉手势关闭查看页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法打开 Android UIX 的照片查看流程。

en.description: Android UIX (Shouheng88) opens an in-app camera for taking photos or videos and can also open the photo album. It returns captured media or selected photos to the app.
en.disableEffect: The app’s UIX camera and album-selection flow will not open.

zh-CN.description: Android UIX（Shouheng88）会打开应用内相机来拍照或录像，也可打开照片库，并把拍摄的媒体或选中的照片返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法打开 Android UIX 的相机和照片库选择流程。

en.description: Android UIX (Shouheng88) shows a screen for creating, entering, or resetting the app’s lock code. Depending on the app’s setup and device, it can also ask the user to confirm identity with biometrics or another device check.
en.disableEffect: The app’s lock-code setup, entry, or reset flow will not open.

zh-CN.description: Android UIX（Shouheng88）会显示用于设置、输入或重置应用锁密码的页面；根据应用配置和设备能力，也可要求用户通过生物识别或其他设备验证身份。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法打开设置、输入或重置锁密码的流程。

en.description: Android VMLib (Shouheng88) uses this Activity as a screen for a page chosen by the app. It fills the screen with that page and applies any theme and transition settings supplied by the app.
en.disableEffect: App pages routed through this screen will fail to open.

zh-CN.description: Android VMLib（Shouheng88）使用此 Activity 显示应用指定的页面，并应用应用提供的主题和转场设置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过此 Activity 打开的应用页面将无法显示。

en.description: Jisungbin's KakaoTalkBotBaseModule uses this notification-listener service after the user grants notification access. When the bot is on, it reads KakaoTalk message notifications and passes sender, chat, and message details to the app's bot handler for replies.
en.disableEffect: The app's bot will stop receiving KakaoTalk messages from notifications and cannot send notification-based replies.

zh-CN.description: 用户授予通知访问权限后，Jisungbin KakaoTalkBotBaseModule 会使用此通知监听服务。机器人开启时，它读取 KakaoTalk 消息通知，并将发件人、聊天和消息内容交给应用的机器人处理和回复。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用的机器人无法再从通知接收 KakaoTalk 消息，也无法通过通知回复。

en.description: Jisungbin's KakaoTalkBotBaseModule starts this foreground service when the app enables background bot support. It keeps the device awake and shows a persistent notification with a bot on/off shortcut.
en.disableEffect: The service will no longer keep the device awake for background bot work, and its persistent notification and shortcut will be gone.

zh-CN.description: 应用启用后台机器人支持时，Jisungbin KakaoTalkBotBaseModule 会启动此前台服务。它会保持设备唤醒，并显示带有机器人开关快捷按钮的常驻通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，此服务不会再为后台机器人任务保持设备唤醒，常驻通知及其快捷按钮也会消失。

en.description: Jisungbin's KakaoTalkBotBaseModule uses this receiver for the bot on/off button in its persistent notification. Pressing the button changes whether bot processing is enabled and shows a confirmation.
en.disableEffect: The persistent notification's bot on/off button will no longer change the bot's state.

zh-CN.description: Jisungbin KakaoTalkBotBaseModule 使用此接收器处理常驻通知中的机器人开关按钮。按下按钮会启用或停用机器人处理，并显示确认提示。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，常驻通知中的机器人开关按钮将无法改变机器人的状态。

en.description: Taifuno's Android SDK opens this Activity when the app or user opens its in-app chat. It shows the conversation and lets the user exchange messages through the Taifuno service.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, the app's Taifuno chat screen will not open, so in-app conversations will be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: Taifuno 的 Android SDK 会在应用或用户打开内置聊天时启动此 Activity，显示对话，并通过 Taifuno 服务收发消息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用中的 Taifuno 聊天页面将无法打开，内置对话也无法使用。

en.description: Taifuno's Android SDK starts this Service when its configured app-rating schedule is reached. It displays an optional star-rating or review prompt over the app.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, Taifuno's optional rating and review prompts will no longer appear.

zh-CN.description: Taifuno 的 Android SDK 会在达到设定的应用评分时间时启动此 Service，并在应用上显示可选的星级评分或评价提示。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Taifuno 的可选评分和评价提示将不再出现。

en.description: JobSchedulerCompat, Evan Tatarka’s Android job-scheduling backport, starts an app’s saved background tasks when their timing and device conditions are met.
en.disableEffect: Any app feature that depends on these scheduled tasks may stop working.

zh-CN.description: JobSchedulerCompat（Evan Tatarka 开发的 Android 作业调度兼容库）会在时间和设备条件满足时运行应用安排的后台任务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用通过该服务安排的后台任务将无法运行，因此依赖这些任务的功能可能会停止工作。

en.description: JobSchedulerCompat records an app’s job requests and their timing, network, charging, and idle requirements, then arranges for ready jobs to run.
en.disableEffect: Apps that rely on this library may lose scheduled work, delaying or breaking the features attached to those jobs.

zh-CN.description: JobSchedulerCompat 保存应用安排的任务及其时间、网络、充电和设备空闲条件，并在条件满足时运行任务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此库的应用可能无法正常安排后台任务，相关功能会延迟或停止工作。

en.description: After the device restarts, JobSchedulerCompat uses this receiver to restore saved jobs so app background work can resume.
en.disableEffect: Saved jobs will not be restored after a restart, so features that rely on them may not resume.

zh-CN.description: 设备重启后，JobSchedulerCompat 会用此接收器恢复已保存的任务，让应用的后台工作继续运行。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 重启后，已保存的任务不会恢复，依赖这些任务的应用功能可能无法继续运行。

en.description: JobSchedulerCompat checks screen activity and screen-saver state to tell when the device is idle and when idle-constrained app jobs can run.
en.disableEffect: Tasks that wait for the device to be idle may not run when expected, delaying app features that use them.

zh-CN.description: JobSchedulerCompat 根据屏幕活动和屏保状态判断设备是否空闲，并安排要求设备空闲的应用任务运行。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 要求设备空闲的任务可能无法按预期运行，使用这些任务的应用功能会延迟。

en.description: When network connectivity changes, JobSchedulerCompat updates whether scheduled jobs have the connection or unmetered network they require.
en.disableEffect: Jobs waiting for a network condition may remain pending, delaying features that rely on them.

zh-CN.description: 网络连接变化时，JobSchedulerCompat 会检查已安排的任务是否获得所需的网络连接或不限流量网络。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 等待特定网络条件的任务可能一直无法运行，依赖它们的应用功能会延迟。

en.description: JobSchedulerCompat monitors low-battery and charging changes and marks which app jobs can run under those power conditions.
en.disableEffect: Jobs that require charging or a battery that is not low may not start as expected, interrupting app features that use them.

zh-CN.description: JobSchedulerCompat 会监测低电量和充电状态变化，并据此判断哪些应用任务可以运行。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要充电或要求电量不低的任务可能无法按预期启动，使用这些任务的应用功能会受影响。

en.description: JobSchedulerCompat sets alarms for app jobs when their delay expires or their deadline arrives, then checks which jobs are ready.
en.disableEffect: Time-based jobs may run late or miss their deadline, delaying app features that depend on them.

zh-CN.description: 应用任务的等待时间结束或截止时间到达时，JobSchedulerCompat 会设置提醒并检查哪些任务可以运行。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 按时间安排的任务可能延迟运行或错过期限，依赖它们的应用功能也会延迟。

en.description: Zalo’s wake-up module watches for supported Zalo apps being installed and notifies the matching app’s helper; the handoff can include Zalo’s device identifier.
en.disableEffect: The install-time notification and wake-up handoff between supported Zalo apps will stop.

zh-CN.description: Zalo 唤醒模块会监听受支持的 Zalo 应用安装，并通知对应应用的辅助程序；交接信息可能包含 Zalo 设备标识。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Zalo 应用之间的安装通知和唤醒交接将停止。

en.description: When a user follows a GFAuth authorization link, this Activity checks the link with GFAuth and opens the app screen configured to receive the resulting account details.
en.disableEffect: The authorization link cannot return the user's account details to the app, so this GFAuth sign-in flow fails.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 GFAuth 授权链接时，此 Activity 会向 GFAuth 核验链接，并打开应用预先设置的页面以接收账户信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，授权链接无法把账户信息返回应用，GFAuth 登录流程会失败。

en.description: The OneKeyAds (Oneway) ad SDK opens this full-screen Activity to display a campaign ad or its landing content.
en.disableEffect: Ads or ad landing pages that use this screen will not open; the host app's other screens can continue to work.

zh-CN.description: OneKeyAds（Oneway）广告 SDK 会打开此全屏 Activity 来展示广告或广告落地页。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，使用此页面的广告或广告落地页将无法打开，应用的其他页面仍可使用。

en.description: When a user follows an Oneway ad's install option, this OneKeyAds provider shares the downloaded APK with Android's installer.
en.disableEffect: Ad installs that depend on this provider will not open, but the host app's other features remain available.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择 Oneway 广告中的安装选项时，OneKeyAds 会通过此 Provider 将下载的 APK 交给 Android 安装程序。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此 Provider 的广告安装流程将无法打开，但应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: The Oneway ad runtime uses this provider when an ad module loaded at runtime needs to read or write shared content or open a file.
en.disableEffect: Loaded ad experiences that need this provider may stop working, while features outside Oneway ads remain available.

zh-CN.description: Oneway 广告运行环境会在动态加载的广告模块需要读取、写入共享内容或打开文件时使用此 Provider。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此 Provider 的动态广告内容可能无法运行，Oneway 广告以外的应用功能仍可使用。

en.description: Oneway (OneKeyAds) uses this full-screen Activity to display ad pages loaded at runtime when an ad needs its own screen.
en.disableEffect: Those runtime-loaded ad pages will not open, while the rest of the app can continue to work.

zh-CN.description: Oneway（OneKeyAds）会在广告需要独立页面时，通过此全屏 Activity 展示动态加载的广告内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，这些动态加载的广告页面将无法打开，应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: Oneway (OneKeyAds) uses this full-screen Activity to display ad pages loaded at runtime when an ad needs its own screen.
en.disableEffect: Those runtime-loaded ad pages will not open, while the rest of the app can continue to work.

zh-CN.description: Oneway（OneKeyAds）会在广告需要独立页面时，通过此全屏 Activity 展示动态加载的广告内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，这些动态加载的广告页面将无法打开，应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: Oneway (OneKeyAds) uses this full-screen Activity to display ad pages loaded at runtime when an ad needs its own screen.
en.disableEffect: Those runtime-loaded ad pages will not open, while the rest of the app can continue to work.

zh-CN.description: Oneway（OneKeyAds）会在广告需要独立页面时，通过此全屏 Activity 展示动态加载的广告内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，这些动态加载的广告页面将无法打开，应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: Pocket Media Native Ads opens the web destination linked from a native ad and sends Play Store links to Google Play when available.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to open the landing page or Google Play listing linked from the native ad.

zh-CN.description: Pocket Media Native Ads 会打开原生广告关联的网页；Google Play 可用时，商店链接会转到 Google Play。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开该原生广告关联的落地页或 Google Play 应用页面。

en.description: Pocket Media Native Ads opens the web page attached to a native ad when the user follows the ad.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to open the web page linked from the native ad.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开原生广告时，Pocket Media Native Ads 会显示广告关联的网页。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开原生广告关联的网页。

en.description: When an app starts an invoice checkout through the RBK.money Payment Android SDK, this screen displays the checkout and handles the payment flow.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot open or complete RBK.money invoice checkout.

zh-CN.description: 应用通过 RBK.money Payment Android SDK 发起发票结账时，此界面会显示结账页面并处理付款流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法打开或完成 RBK.money 发票结账。

en.description: When a card payment requests 3-D Secure verification, the RBK.money Payment Android SDK opens the bank's verification page inside the app.
en.disableEffect: Card payments that require 3-D Secure verification may not complete.

zh-CN.description: 银行卡付款需要 3-D Secure 验证时，RBK.money Payment Android SDK 会在应用内打开银行验证页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要 3-D Secure 验证的银行卡付款可能无法完成。

en.description: When an app opens a service from the Spense Android Library, this screen displays the service and returns its result to the app.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot open Spense services or receive their results.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开 Spense Android Library 提供的服务时，此界面会显示该服务并将结果返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法打开 Spense 服务或接收其处理结果。

en.description: When an app opens Spense content through the Spense Android Library, this screen displays that content and returns the result.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot open or complete the affected Spense flow.

zh-CN.description: 应用通过 Spense Android Library 打开 Spense 内容时，此界面会显示相关内容并返回处理结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法打开或完成相关 Spense 流程。

en.description: During Spense device setup, this screen checks whether an MPIN is already configured and routes the user to create one or continue device verification.
en.disableEffect: The app's Spense device setup may not continue.

zh-CN.description: 设置 Spense 设备时，此界面会检查是否已设置 MPIN，并引导用户创建 MPIN 或继续设备验证。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用中的 Spense 设备设置可能无法继续。

en.description: During Spense bank-account linking, this screen collects the bank customer ID, PAN and date of birth, checks the customer's details, and continues to device verification.
en.disableEffect: The app may not be able to verify the bank customer or link the account.

zh-CN.description: 关联 Spense 银行账户时，此界面会收集银行客户编号、PAN 和出生日期，核验客户信息后继续设备验证。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用可能无法核验银行客户身份或关联账户。

en.description: During Spense device setup, this screen lets the user create or enter a four-digit MPIN and may offer biometric verification.
en.disableEffect: The app's Spense account and device setup may not continue.

zh-CN.description: 设置 Spense 设备时，此界面会让用户创建或输入四位 MPIN，并可能提供生物识别验证。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用中的 Spense 账户和设备设置可能无法继续。

en.description: After the user starts Spense device binding, this screen requests phone and SIM access, sends a verification text, and checks whether the service has linked the device.
en.disableEffect: Spense device binding may not finish.

zh-CN.description: 用户开始绑定 Spense 设备后，此界面会请求手机和 SIM 卡相关权限、发送验证短信，并检查服务是否已完成设备关联。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Spense 设备绑定可能无法完成。

en.description: When the app retrieves a prepaid payment card through the Spense Android Library, this screen displays the card details returned by the card service.
en.disableEffect: The app may not be able to show the prepaid card details.

zh-CN.description: 应用通过 Spense Android Library 获取预付卡时，此界面会显示发卡服务返回的卡片信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用可能无法显示预付卡信息。

en.description: When the user requests access to Spense prepaid-card details, this screen accepts and verifies the one-time code sent for that request.
en.disableEffect: The app may not be able to verify the user or show the requested card details.

zh-CN.description: 用户申请查看 Spense 预付卡信息时，此界面会接收并验证为该请求发送的一次性验证码。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用可能无法核验用户身份或显示所申请的卡片信息。

en.description: When a user creates or changes a Spense prepaid-card PIN, this screen collects the PIN and continues the card verification flow.
en.disableEffect: The app may not be able to set or change the prepaid-card PIN.

zh-CN.description: 用户创建或更改 Spense 预付卡 PIN 时，此界面会收集 PIN 并继续卡片验证流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用可能无法设置或更改预付卡 PIN。

en.description: During Spense SDK device setup, this screen checks whether an MPIN is already configured and routes the user to create one or continue device verification.
en.disableEffect: The app's Spense device setup may not continue.

zh-CN.description: 设置 Spense SDK 设备时，此界面会检查是否已设置 MPIN，并引导用户创建 MPIN 或继续设备验证。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用中的 Spense 设备设置可能无法继续。

en.description: When an app opens Spense content through the Spense SDK, this screen displays that content and returns the result.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot open or complete the affected Spense flow.

zh-CN.description: 应用通过 Spense SDK 打开 Spense 内容时，此界面会显示相关内容并返回处理结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法打开或完成相关 Spense 流程。

en.description: During Spense SDK device setup, this screen lets the user create or enter a four-digit MPIN and returns the setup result.
en.disableEffect: The app's Spense device setup may not continue.

zh-CN.description: 设置 Spense SDK 设备时，此界面会让用户创建或输入四位 MPIN，并返回设置结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用中的 Spense 设备设置可能无法继续。

en.description: After the user starts Spense SDK device binding, this screen requests phone and SIM access, sends a verification text, and checks the binding status.
en.disableEffect: Spense SDK device binding may not finish.

zh-CN.description: 用户开始通过 Spense SDK 绑定设备后，此界面会请求手机和 SIM 卡相关权限、发送验证短信，并检查绑定状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Spense SDK 设备绑定可能无法完成。

en.description: Quiin’s Unified Contact Picker opens this screen when the host app requests contact selection; it lists saved phone numbers and email addresses, lets the user choose entries, and returns the selection to the app.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot open this contact picker or return selected contacts to a feature that uses it.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求选择联系人时，Quiin 的 Unified Contact Picker 会打开此界面；它列出保存的电话号码和邮箱，供用户选择并将结果返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用无法打开此联系人选择器，也无法把所选联系人交给依赖它的功能。

en.description: When a DappMX vendor or wallet app starts QR scanning, this screen opens the scanner and handles scan results or retries.
en.disableEffect: The app's DappMX vendor or wallet scanning flow may not open or return a result.

zh-CN.description: DappMX 商户端或钱包应用启动二维码扫描时，此界面会打开扫描器并处理扫描结果或重试。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用中的 DappMX 商户端或钱包扫描流程可能无法打开或返回结果。

en.description: When a customer app starts a DappMX payment, this screen collects or reads the point-of-sale code and returns the payment result.
en.disableEffect: The app may not be able to complete DappMX customer payments.

zh-CN.description: 客户应用发起 DappMX 付款时，此界面会收集或读取销售点代码并返回付款结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用可能无法完成 DappMX 客户付款。

en.description: When a merchant scans a DappMX payment code, this screen submits the code and sale details to the payment service and returns the result.
en.disableEffect: The app may not be able to accept DappMX payments at the point of sale.

zh-CN.description: 商户扫描 DappMX 付款码时，此界面会将付款码和交易信息提交给支付服务并返回结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用可能无法在销售点受理 DappMX 付款。

en.description: When a DappMX wallet user scans a code, this screen reads the code and returns it to the wallet.
en.disableEffect: The app's DappMX wallet scanning flow may not open or return a scanned code.

zh-CN.description: DappMX 钱包用户扫描二维码时，此界面会读取二维码并将内容返回钱包。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用中的 DappMX 钱包扫描流程可能无法打开或返回扫描内容。

en.description: When an app starts a terminal card charge through the Openpay SDK, this screen runs the charge flow and returns the transaction result.
en.disableEffect: The app may not be able to complete terminal card charges.

zh-CN.description: 应用通过 Openpay SDK 发起终端刷卡付款时，此界面会处理付款流程并返回交易结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用可能无法完成终端刷卡付款。

en.description: When an Openpay payment offers reward-point redemption, this screen lets the customer choose whether to use points.
en.disableEffect: The app may not be able to offer or apply points to the payment.

zh-CN.description: Openpay 付款支持使用奖励积分时，此界面会让客户选择是否使用积分。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用可能无法提供或使用积分抵扣付款。

en.description: When an Openpay payment offers installment plans, this screen lets the customer choose a plan.
en.disableEffect: The app may not be able to offer or apply an installment plan.

zh-CN.description: Openpay 付款支持分期时，此界面会让客户选择分期方案。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用可能无法提供或应用分期方案。

en.description: When an Openpay charge requires a customer signature, this screen captures the signature and returns it to the payment flow.
en.disableEffect: The app may not be able to complete charges that require a signature.

zh-CN.description: Openpay 付款需要客户签名时，此界面会收集签名并将其返回付款流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用可能无法完成需要签名的付款。

en.description: When a merchant starts an Openpay smart-terminal charge, this screen validates and runs the card payment, including available plan or points choices.
en.disableEffect: The app may not be able to process smart-terminal card payments.

zh-CN.description: 商户发起 Openpay 智能终端付款时，此界面会验证并处理银行卡交易，包括可选的分期或积分支付。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用可能无法处理智能终端银行卡付款。

en.description: When an Openpay smart-terminal payment offers monthly installments, this screen lets the customer choose a plan and returns the choice.
en.disableEffect: The app may not be able to offer monthly installment payments.

zh-CN.description: Openpay 智能终端付款支持按月分期时，此界面会让客户选择方案并返回选择结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用可能无法提供按月分期付款。

en.description: When an Openpay smart-terminal payment offers reward-point redemption, this screen lets the customer choose whether to apply points.
en.disableEffect: The app may not be able to apply reward points to the payment.

zh-CN.description: Openpay 智能终端付款支持使用奖励积分时，此界面会让客户选择是否抵扣积分。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用可能无法使用奖励积分抵扣付款。

en.description: When a merchant starts a tap-on-phone sale through Openpay, this screen runs the contactless card payment using the phone.
en.disableEffect: The app may not be able to accept tap-on-phone card payments.

zh-CN.description: 商户通过 Openpay 发起手机碰一碰收款时，此界面会使用手机处理非接触式银行卡付款。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用可能无法使用手机受理碰一碰银行卡付款。

en.description: When a merchant refunds a previous tap-on-phone sale through Openpay, this screen submits the refund and returns its result.
en.disableEffect: The app may not be able to refund tap-on-phone sales.

zh-CN.description: 商户通过 Openpay 退还此前的手机碰一碰交易时，此界面会提交退款并返回处理结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用可能无法退还手机碰一碰交易。

en.description: When Android reports a connectivity change, the Navegg tracking SDK checks the connection and sends stored user, page-view, custom-event, and onboarding data when online.
en.disableEffect: Queued Navegg tracking data may not be sent when connectivity returns.

zh-CN.description: Android 报告网络连接状态变化时，Navegg 跟踪 SDK 会检查网络，并在联网后发送已保存的用户、页面浏览、自定义事件和引导数据。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，网络恢复时排队等待的 Navegg 跟踪数据可能不会发送。

en.description: When Admixer serves a full-screen ad, this Activity displays interstitial, rewarded, browser or interactive ad content.
en.disableEffect: Admixer ads and their landing pages will no longer open; rewards for watching rewarded ads will no longer be granted.

zh-CN.description: Admixer 展示全屏广告时，此界面会显示插页、激励、浏览器或互动广告内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Admixer 广告及其落地页将不再打开；观看激励广告也将不再获得奖励。

en.description: AIHelp customer support opens this screen when someone enters the in-app help center, FAQ, or support conversation. It displays the requested support page and handles its forms and navigation.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents AIHelp help and support pages from opening in the app.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开应用内帮助中心、常见问题或客服对话时，AIHelp 客服 SDK 会显示此页面。它展示对应的帮助内容，并处理表单和页面跳转。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用内的 AIHelp 帮助和客服页面将无法打开。

en.description: AIHelp customer support opens this screen when a user taps an image, video, or file attachment in a support conversation. It previews the file and can return a selected attachment to the conversation.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from previewing or choosing attachments in AIHelp support conversations.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 AIHelp 客服对话中点开图片、视频或文件附件时，客服 SDK 会打开此页面预览文件，也可将选中的附件返回给对话。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法在 AIHelp 客服对话中预览或选择附件。

en.description: The AuroPay Payments SDK uses this file provider when the user shares a generated payment receipt. It gives the system share panel access to the receipt image.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it makes sharing an AuroPay receipt fail.

zh-CN.description: 用户分享付款收据时，AuroPay 支付 SDK 通过此文件提供程序把收据图片交给系统分享面板。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，AuroPay 收据无法分享。

en.description: The AuroPay Payments SDK opens this screen when the app starts checkout. It shows merchant and order details, runs the payment flow, and returns the result to the app.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents AuroPay checkout from opening, so payments through this SDK cannot complete.

zh-CN.description: 应用开始付款时，AuroPay 支付 SDK 会打开此页面。页面展示商户和订单信息，处理付款流程，并把结果返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，AuroPay 收银页面无法打开，用户不能通过此 SDK 完成付款。

en.description: ChinaEdu Live SDK initializes this Provider at app startup so its download manager can use the app context; the SDK also uses its declared file access when sending saved files to Android's media scanner.
en.disableEffect: The SDK's download manager can fail to initialize, and saved local files may not be refreshed in the device gallery.

zh-CN.description: ChinaEdu Live SDK 会在应用启动时通过此 Provider 初始化下载管理器所需的应用环境，并在通知 Android 媒体扫描器处理已保存文件时使用其文件访问配置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，SDK 下载管理器可能无法初始化，保存的本地文件也可能无法更新到设备图库。

en.description: When a user starts screen sharing through Agora in ChinaEdu Live SDK, this Activity opens Android's screen-capture permission prompt and returns the approval to the sharing flow.
en.disableEffect: Agora-based screen sharing in ChinaEdu Live SDK will not be able to obtain screen-capture approval.

zh-CN.description: 用户通过 ChinaEdu Live SDK 的 Agora 功能开始共享屏幕时，此 Activity 会打开 Android 屏幕捕获授权提示，并将授权结果交回共享流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，ChinaEdu Live SDK 的 Agora 屏幕共享将无法取得屏幕捕获授权。

en.description: During an Agora live screen-sharing session, ChinaEdu Live SDK uses this Service to capture the display and send it to the live channel.
en.disableEffect: Users will lose Agora-based screen sharing in ChinaEdu Live SDK.

zh-CN.description: 在 Agora 实时屏幕共享期间，ChinaEdu Live SDK 会通过此 Service 捕获屏幕并发送到直播频道。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法使用 ChinaEdu Live SDK 的 Agora 屏幕共享。

en.description: During a Tencent Cloud Live screen-sharing session, ChinaEdu Live SDK uses this Service to capture the display and stream it to the configured live address.
en.disableEffect: Users will lose Tencent Cloud Live screen sharing in ChinaEdu Live SDK.

zh-CN.description: 在腾讯云直播屏幕共享期间，ChinaEdu Live SDK 会通过此 Service 捕获屏幕并推送到配置的直播地址。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法使用 ChinaEdu Live SDK 的腾讯云直播屏幕共享。

en.description: During a Tencent TRTC room session, ChinaEdu Live SDK uses this Service to share the device screen with the room.
en.disableEffect: Users will lose Tencent TRTC screen sharing in ChinaEdu Live SDK.

zh-CN.description: 在腾讯 TRTC 房间会话中，ChinaEdu Live SDK 会通过此 Service 将设备屏幕共享给房间内的其他人。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法使用 ChinaEdu Live SDK 的腾讯 TRTC 屏幕共享。

en.description: When ChinaEdu Live SDK requests screen capture, this Activity asks Android for screen-capture permission and passes the approved capture access back to the SDK.
en.disableEffect: Screen-capture features that use this ChinaEdu Live SDK flow will no longer work.

zh-CN.description: ChinaEdu Live SDK 请求屏幕捕获时，此 Activity 会向 Android 请求授权，并将获准的屏幕捕获权限交回 SDK。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，依赖 ChinaEdu Live SDK 此流程的屏幕捕获功能将无法使用。

en.description: When the Consent Manager CMP SDK needs to show consent choices, it opens this page with the requested privacy information. Users can review or update their consent here.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from reviewing or updating consent through the Consent Manager screen.

zh-CN.description: Consent Manager CMP SDK 需要展示同意选项时会打开此页面，并显示相关隐私信息。用户可在此查看或更新自己的同意选择。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过 Consent Manager 页面查看或更新同意选择。

en.description: The Crofis Android UI Kit opens this screen for standard photo capture. It shows camera controls and returns the confirmed image or its file reference to the app.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents photo capture through the Crofis camera flow.

zh-CN.description: Crofis Android UI Kit 会在应用请求普通拍照时打开此页面。页面显示相机控件，并将确认后的图片或文件引用返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过 Crofis 相机流程拍照。

en.description: The Crofis Android UI Kit opens this square-format camera screen when the app requests a square photo. It captures the image and returns it after confirmation.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents square photo capture through the Crofis camera flow.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求拍摄方形照片时，Crofis Android UI Kit 会打开此页面。页面拍摄照片，并在确认后将图片返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过 Crofis 相机流程拍摄方形照片。

en.description: The Crofis Android UI Kit opens this screen when the app asks to crop an existing image. Users can adjust the crop, rotate the image, and return the saved result.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents the Crofis crop flow from returning an edited image.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求裁剪现有图片时，Crofis Android UI Kit 会打开此页面。用户可以调整裁剪范围、旋转图片，并返回保存后的结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Crofis 图片裁剪流程无法返回编辑后的图片。

en.description: The Crofis Android UI Kit opens this page to list albums on the device when a user chooses a photo. Choosing an album opens its image grid.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents album-based photo selection through the Crofis picker.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择照片时，Crofis Android UI Kit 会打开此页面列出设备相册。选择相册后会打开其中的图片列表。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过 Crofis 选择相册中的照片。

en.description: The Crofis Android UI Kit opens this page to list photos in the chosen album and let users select one or more images. Confirming returns the selected images to the app.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents this Crofis photo-selection flow from returning images to the app.

zh-CN.description: Crofis Android UI Kit 会打开此页面列出所选相册中的照片，用户可选择一张或多张图片。确认后，所选图片会返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，此 Crofis 图片选择流程无法将图片返回给应用。

en.description: CSDN DaVinci uses this provider to give the photo picker and camera flow file links for approved media. Other apps can access only files allowed by the configured paths.
en.disableEffect: DaVinci camera capture and media-sharing flows that rely on this provider may fail.

zh-CN.description: CSDN DaVinci 使用此提供程序为图片选择和相机流程生成获准媒体的文件链接；其他应用只能访问配置路径允许的文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此提供程序的 DaVinci 拍照和媒体分享流程可能失败。

en.description: CSDN DaVinci opens this picker to browse photo and video albums, select media, or take a new photo with the camera. It returns the selected media to the calling screen.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot use DaVinci's built-in photo and video picker or its camera option when this Activity is disabled.

zh-CN.description: CSDN DaVinci 会打开此选择器浏览照片和视频相册、选择媒体或调用相机拍照，并将选中的媒体返回给调用页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，应用无法使用 DaVinci 内置的照片和视频选择器及拍照入口。

en.description: CSDN DaVinci opens this screen to review selected photos or videos in a larger preview. Users can browse and handle the selected media before leaving the preview.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot preview selected photos or videos through DaVinci.

zh-CN.description: CSDN DaVinci 会打开此页面放大预览已选照片或视频，用户可浏览和处理媒体后离开预览页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，用户无法通过 DaVinci 预览已选的照片或视频。

en.description: Dr Mercer’s PickerForUnsplashPhotos opens this Activity to search and browse photos from Unsplash; choosing a photo returns its ID to the app.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot choose an Unsplash photo through this picker.

zh-CN.description: Dr Mercer 的 PickerForUnsplashPhotos 会打开此 Activity，用于搜索和浏览 Unsplash 照片；选中照片后会把照片 ID 返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此选择器挑选 Unsplash 照片。

en.description: When Android reports that boot has finished, this Donky Core SDK receiver runs, but it has no action in the analyzed version.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it makes no visible difference in this version.

zh-CN.description: Android 通知设备启动完成时，Donky Core SDK 会收到该广播；但分析的版本中此接收器没有执行任何操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 在此版本中禁用它不会带来可见变化。

en.description: When Donky Core requests a background synchronization, this receiver starts the service that synchronizes Donky data with Donky’s network.
en.disableEffect: Donky background synchronization and message refreshes may stop.

zh-CN.description: Donky Core 请求后台同步时，此接收器会启动同步服务，将 Donky 数据与 Donky 网络同步。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Donky 的后台同步和消息更新可能会停止。

en.description: When Donky Core runs a background synchronization, this service exchanges SDK data with Donky’s network.
en.disableEffect: Donky account and message data may stop refreshing in the background.

zh-CN.description: Donky Core 执行后台同步时，此服务会与 Donky 网络交换 SDK 数据。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Donky 账户和消息数据可能不再在后台更新。

en.description: When Firebase delivers a Donky push message or refreshes the device token, this Donky Core service processes the message or registers the new token with Donky.
en.disableEffect: Donky push messages will stop arriving and refreshed tokens will not be registered; other app functions can continue.

zh-CN.description: Firebase 投递 Donky 推送消息或更新设备令牌时，此 Donky Core 服务会处理消息，或向 Donky 注册新令牌。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Donky 推送消息将无法送达，更新后的令牌也不会注册；应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: When Donky’s legacy Google Cloud Messaging integration requests device registration, this Donky Core service registers the app for Donky push messages.
en.disableEffect: Legacy Donky push registration and delivery may stop.

zh-CN.description: Donky 的旧版 Google Cloud Messaging 集成请求注册设备时，此 Donky Core 服务会为应用注册 Donky 推送。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 旧版 Donky 推送注册和消息送达可能会停止。

en.description: When Google Cloud Messaging delivers a Donky message, this Donky Core receiver forwards it to the service that processes the message.
en.disableEffect: Legacy Donky GCM messages will no longer reach the SDK.

zh-CN.description: Google Cloud Messaging 投递 Donky 消息时，此 Donky Core 接收器会将消息转交给处理服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 旧版 Donky GCM 消息将无法送达 SDK。

en.description: When a legacy Donky GCM message arrives, this service processes pending notification updates and synchronizes with Donky when needed.
en.disableEffect: Legacy Donky push messages and their notification updates will stop being processed.

zh-CN.description: 旧版 Donky GCM 消息到达时，此服务会处理待更新的通知，并在需要时与 Donky 同步。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 旧版 Donky 推送消息及其通知更新将不再处理。

en.description: When Google refreshes the app’s legacy GCM registration token, this Donky Core service clears the old token and starts a new push registration.
en.disableEffect: Legacy Donky push may stop working after Google refreshes the device token.

zh-CN.description: Google 更新应用的旧版 GCM 注册令牌时，此 Donky Core 服务会清除旧令牌并重新注册推送。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Google 更新设备令牌后，旧版 Donky 推送可能无法继续工作。

en.description: When a user dismisses or taps a Donky push notification, this service clears it and records the click; for open or link actions, it opens the app or the matching link.
en.disableEffect: Donky notification buttons will no longer dismiss, record, or open their selected destinations; other app functions can continue.

zh-CN.description: 用户关闭或点按 Donky 推送通知时，此服务会清除通知并记录点击；选择打开应用或链接时，它会打开相应页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Donky 通知按钮将无法清除通知、记录点击或打开目标页面；应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: When the app opens the Donky rich-message inbox, this Donky Rich Inbox Activity shows the inbox and lets the user open a selected message; this version has no top toolbar.
en.disableEffect: Users may lose access to the Donky rich-message inbox and its message details.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开 Donky 富消息收件箱时，此 Donky Rich Inbox 界面会显示收件箱，并允许用户打开选中的消息；此版本没有顶部工具栏。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户可能无法再打开 Donky 富消息收件箱及其中的消息。

en.description: When the app opens the Donky rich-message inbox, this Donky Rich Inbox Activity shows the inbox and lets the user open a selected message with a top toolbar.
en.disableEffect: Users may lose access to the Donky rich-message inbox and its message details.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开 Donky 富消息收件箱时，此 Donky Rich Inbox 界面会显示收件箱，并允许用户打开选中的消息；此版本带有顶部工具栏。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户可能无法再打开 Donky 富消息收件箱及其中的消息。

en.description: When the app opens a Donky rich message directly, this Donky Rich Inbox Activity displays the message without a top toolbar.
en.disableEffect: Users may be unable to read Donky rich messages opened outside the inbox.

zh-CN.description: 应用直接打开 Donky 富消息时，此 Donky Rich Inbox 界面会显示消息内容，且没有顶部工具栏。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户可能无法阅读从收件箱以外入口打开的 Donky 富消息。

en.description: When the app opens a Donky rich message directly, this Donky Rich Inbox Activity displays the message with a top toolbar.
en.disableEffect: Users may be unable to read Donky rich messages opened outside the inbox.

zh-CN.description: 应用直接打开 Donky 富消息时，此 Donky Rich Inbox 界面会显示消息内容，并带有顶部工具栏。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户可能无法阅读从收件箱以外入口打开的 Donky 富消息。

en.description: When a user opens a message from Donky’s inbox, this Donky Rich Inbox Activity displays the selected message without a top toolbar.
en.disableEffect: Users may be unable to read messages opened from Donky’s inbox.

zh-CN.description: 用户从 Donky 收件箱打开消息时，此 Donky Rich Inbox 界面会显示所选消息，且没有顶部工具栏。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户可能无法阅读从 Donky 收件箱打开的消息。

en.description: When a user opens a message from Donky’s inbox, this Donky Rich Inbox Activity displays the selected message with a top toolbar.
en.disableEffect: Users may be unable to read messages opened from Donky’s inbox.

zh-CN.description: 用户从 Donky 收件箱打开消息时，此 Donky Rich Inbox 界面会显示所选消息，并带有顶部工具栏。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户可能无法阅读从 Donky 收件箱打开的消息。

en.description: Android creates this Donky Rich Messaging provider during app startup, where it initializes local message storage. Donky also uses it to read, add, update, and remove rich-message records.
en.disableEffect: Blocking it can leave Donky’s rich-message storage uninitialized, preventing rich messages and the inbox from loading.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，Android 会创建此 Donky Rich Messaging provider，并由它初始化本地消息存储。Donky 也通过它读取、新增、更新和删除富消息记录。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，Donky 富消息存储可能无法初始化，富消息和收件箱也可能无法加载。

en.description: When Donky presents a queued rich message as a popup, this Activity shows the message and removes it from the pending popup list when it resumes.
en.disableEffect: Donky rich-message popups may fail to appear or be recorded as viewed.

zh-CN.description: Donky 将排队的富消息作为弹窗显示时，此界面会展示消息，并在恢复显示时将其从待展示列表中移除。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Donky 富消息弹窗可能无法显示，或无法正确记录为已查看。

en.description: FlowNetFast by Han Xiaofeng initializes shared library services as the app starts, including local storage and network and app-lifecycle tracking.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it skips FlowNetFast startup setup, which may break screens that rely on its saved settings or network-state updates.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，Han Xiaofeng 的 FlowNetFast 会初始化共享服务，包括本地存储、网络变化和应用生命周期跟踪。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，FlowNetFast 的启动设置不会运行，依赖其保存设置或网络状态更新的页面可能出错。

en.description: When the app starts Gini Bank’s capture flow, this Activity opens the invoice capture or import screens and returns the result to the app.
en.disableEffect: Users may no longer be able to capture or import invoices through the app’s Gini Bank flow.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动 Gini Bank 的采集流程时，此界面会打开发票拍摄或导入页面，并将结果返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户可能无法再通过应用的 Gini Bank 流程拍摄或导入发票。

en.description: When the app starts a Gini Capture document scan, this Activity opens the camera capture screen and returns the capture result to the app.
en.disableEffect: The app’s Gini document-scanning flow may stop working.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动 Gini Capture 文档扫描时，此界面会打开相机拍摄页面，并将采集结果返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用中的 Gini 文档扫描流程可能无法继续使用。

en.description: After Android returns the result of sharing a payment-request PDF from Gini Health’s review screen, this receiver notifies the SDK so the review flow can react.
en.disableEffect: Gini Health may miss the share-sheet result, so its PDF-sharing flow may not finish cleanly.

zh-CN.description: 用户从 Gini Health 审核页分享付款请求 PDF 后，Android 会将分享结果交给此接收器，由它通知 SDK 继续处理审核流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Gini Health 可能收不到分享面板的结果，导致 PDF 分享流程无法正常完成。

en.description: When Gini Health shares a payment-request PDF, this provider creates a temporary content link that lets the selected app open the file without exposing its local path.
en.disableEffect: The receiving app may not be able to open the shared PDF, breaking Gini Health’s sharing flow.

zh-CN.description: Gini Health 分享付款请求 PDF 时，此 provider 会创建临时内容链接，让用户选择的应用打开文件而不暴露本地路径。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 接收应用可能无法打开共享的 PDF，导致 Gini Health 的分享流程受阻。

en.description: When Gini’s internal payment SDK shares a payment-request PDF, this provider creates a temporary content link for the app selected in Android’s share sheet.
en.disableEffect: The selected app may not be able to open the shared PDF, breaking the payment-sharing flow.

zh-CN.description: Gini 内部支付 SDK 分享付款请求 PDF 时，此 provider 会为 Android 分享面板中选定的应用创建临时内容链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 选定的应用可能无法打开共享的 PDF，导致支付分享流程受阻。

en.description: After Android returns the result of sharing a PDF through Gini’s internal payment SDK, this receiver notifies the SDK so the payment flow can react.
en.disableEffect: The payment flow may miss the share-sheet result and fail to complete its sharing step cleanly.

zh-CN.description: 通过 Gini 内部支付 SDK 分享 PDF 后，Android 会将分享结果交给此接收器，由它通知 SDK 继续处理支付流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 支付流程可能收不到分享面板的结果，导致分享步骤无法正常完成。

en.description: When Gini Merchant shares a payment-request PDF, this provider creates a temporary content link so the selected app can open the file.
en.disableEffect: The selected app may not be able to open the shared PDF, breaking the Gini Merchant sharing flow.

zh-CN.description: Gini Merchant 分享付款请求 PDF 时，此 provider 会创建临时内容链接，让用户选择的应用打开文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 选定的应用可能无法打开共享的 PDF，导致 Gini Merchant 分享流程受阻。

en.description: After Android returns the result of sharing a PDF through Gini Merchant, this receiver notifies the SDK so the payment flow can react.
en.disableEffect: Gini Merchant may miss the share-sheet result and fail to complete its sharing step cleanly.

zh-CN.description: 通过 Gini Merchant 分享 PDF 后，Android 会将分享结果交给此接收器，由它通知 SDK 继续处理支付流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Gini Merchant 可能收不到分享面板的结果，导致分享步骤无法正常完成。

en.description: When the network changes and Gotev Host Monitor has configured hosts to check, this receiver starts a reachability check using the new connection.
en.disableEffect: Host Monitor may miss network-change checks, leaving apps that use its results with stale host status.

zh-CN.description: 网络发生变化且 Gotev Host Monitor 已配置要检查的主机时，此接收器会使用新的网络连接启动可达性检查。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Host Monitor 可能无法在网络变化时检查主机，使依赖该结果的应用继续使用过期状态。

en.description: When Gotev Host Monitor is started, this service checks configured remote hosts and ports and broadcasts any change in reachability.
en.disableEffect: The app will no longer receive Host Monitor reachability updates and may keep using stale connection status.

zh-CN.description: Gotev Host Monitor 启动时，此服务会检查已配置的远程主机和端口，并广播可达状态的变化。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法再收到 Host Monitor 的可达性更新，可能继续使用过期的连接状态。

en.description: When an app using Feige SIP configures an account, changes registration, or places or answers a call, this service runs SIP account and voice or video call operations.
en.disableEffect: Incoming and outgoing SIP calls and related call controls will stop working.

zh-CN.description: 使用 Feige SIP 的应用配置账户、更改注册状态或拨打、接听电话时，此服务会处理 SIP 账户以及语音或视频通话。
zh-CN.disableEffect: SIP 来电、去电和相关通话控制将无法使用。

en.description: When an app queues a background file upload, Gotev Android Upload Service runs the upload task and shows its progress in an ongoing notification.
en.disableEffect: Background file uploads can fail or stop, preventing the app from sending files.

zh-CN.description: 应用排入后台文件上传任务时，Gotev Android Upload Service 会执行上传，并通过持续通知显示进度。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 后台文件上传可能失败或停止，导致应用无法发送文件。

en.description: When an app starts Droid Xing’s barcode scanner, this Activity opens the camera view, reads supported codes, and returns the scan result to the app.
en.disableEffect: Users may no longer be able to scan barcodes or QR codes through the app’s Droid Xing screen.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动 Droid Xing 条码扫描器时，此界面会打开相机、读取支持的码，并将扫描结果返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户可能无法再通过应用的 Droid Xing 页面扫描条码或二维码。

en.description: SQLightning (HenryCo SQLite helper library) includes this empty test screen, which appears only when an app explicitly opens the library's test page. It does not create or manage the app's normal database screens.
en.disableEffect: The blank test page will be unavailable; normal app screens and database use remain available.

zh-CN.description: SQLightning（HenryCo SQLite 辅助库）包含一个空白测试页面，只有应用主动打开该库的测试页时才会显示。它不负责应用日常数据库界面的创建或管理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 该空白测试页将无法打开，应用的正常界面和数据库使用仍可继续。

en.description: When HockeyApp’s update manager marks the installed build as expired, it ends the current screen and opens this page explaining the expiry.
en.disableEffect: An app using HockeyApp’s expiry gate may lose its expiry notice or fail when the SDK tries to open it.

zh-CN.description: HockeyApp 更新管理器判定当前安装版本已过期时，会结束当前页面并打开此页面说明过期情况。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用 HockeyApp 过期控制的应用可能无法显示过期提示，或在 SDK 打开提示页时失败。

en.description: When a user opens HockeyApp feedback, this Activity lets them read or send messages and attach files or screenshots.
en.disableEffect: The app’s HockeyApp feedback and bug-report screen will no longer open; other app features can continue.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 HockeyApp 反馈功能时，此界面允许其查看或发送消息，并附加文件或截图。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用中的 HockeyApp 反馈和问题报告页面将无法打开；其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: When HockeyApp feedback requires identity verification, this Activity collects the user’s HockeyApp email or login details and sends them to the SDK.
en.disableEffect: HockeyApp feedback authentication will no longer open; the app’s own sign-in flow is unaffected.

zh-CN.description: HockeyApp 反馈需要验证身份时，此界面会收集用户的 HockeyApp 邮箱或登录信息并提交给 SDK。
zh-CN.disableEffect: HockeyApp 反馈身份验证页面将无法打开；应用自身的登录流程不受影响。

en.description: When a user chooses to mark up a screenshot attached to HockeyApp feedback, this Activity opens the image for drawing and returns the edited attachment.
en.disableEffect: Screenshot annotation in HockeyApp feedback will no longer be available; other app features can continue.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择标注附在 HockeyApp 反馈中的截图时，此界面会打开图片供其绘制，并返回编辑后的附件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: HockeyApp 反馈中的截图标注功能将无法使用；应用的其他功能仍可继续。

en.description: When HockeyApp finds an available app update and needs a full update screen, this Activity displays the update details and download flow.
en.disableEffect: HockeyApp’s in-app update screen may fail to open, breaking the app’s update flow.

zh-CN.description: HockeyApp 找到可用应用更新并需要显示完整更新页面时，此界面会展示更新信息和下载流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: HockeyApp 的应用内更新页面可能无法打开，导致更新流程中断。

en.description: When the iLocalize screenshot tool starts a screen capture, this foreground Service uses Android's approved screen stream and supplies it to the capture tool.
en.disableEffect: iLocalize cannot capture screen images; the app's ordinary screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: iLocalize 截图工具开始截屏时，这个前台服务会使用 Android 授权的屏幕画面，并将画面交给截图工具。
zh-CN.disableEffect: iLocalize 无法截取屏幕画面；应用的日常界面仍可使用。

en.description: When iLocalize requests screen-capture access, this Activity opens Android's screen-capture approval prompt and returns the choice to the screenshot tool.
en.disableEffect: iLocalize cannot request screen access, so screen captures that need this prompt cannot start.

zh-CN.description: iLocalize 请求屏幕捕获权限时，这个界面会打开 Android 的屏幕捕获授权提示，并将用户的选择返回给截图工具。
zh-CN.disableEffect: iLocalize 无法请求屏幕访问权限，因此需要此授权的截屏无法开始。

en.description: When iLocalize reviews one translated string, this Activity shows the current text and its source text and lets the user rate it and send a comment.
en.disableEffect: Single-string translation reviews and feedback cannot be submitted through iLocalize.

zh-CN.description: iLocalize 评审某条译文时，这个界面会显示当前文本和原文，并允许用户评分和提交意见。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 无法通过 iLocalize 提交单条译文的评审和意见。

en.description: When iLocalize opens an overall translation review, this Activity lets the user rate the translations and send a comment.
en.disableEffect: Overall translation feedback cannot be submitted through iLocalize.

zh-CN.description: iLocalize 打开整体译文评审时，这个界面允许用户为译文评分并提交意见。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 无法通过 iLocalize 提交整体译文意见。

en.description: When details for a saved iLocalize screenshot are opened, this Activity shows the image and the translated strings associated with it.
en.disableEffect: The screenshot's linked string details cannot be viewed through iLocalize.

zh-CN.description: 打开 iLocalize 已保存截图的详情时，这个界面会显示图片及与图片关联的译文。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 无法通过 iLocalize 查看截图关联的文本详情。

en.description: When a saved iLocalize screenshot is opened, this Activity previews the image and offers access to its details.
en.disableEffect: Saved screenshots cannot be previewed through iLocalize.

zh-CN.description: 打开 iLocalize 已保存的截图时，这个界面会预览图片，并提供查看图片详情的入口。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 无法通过 iLocalize 预览已保存的截图。

en.description: When iLocalize's screenshot manager opens, this Activity lists saved screen captures and lets the user select, upload, or delete them.
en.disableEffect: Screenshots cannot be managed or uploaded from the iLocalize screenshot manager.

zh-CN.description: iLocalize 截图管理器打开时，这个界面会列出已保存的截屏，并允许用户选择、上传或删除。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 无法在 iLocalize 截图管理器中管理或上传截图。

en.description: When iLocalize needs overlay access for its floating screenshot and upload controls, this Activity opens Android's permission settings and reports the result.
en.disableEffect: iLocalize cannot request overlay access, so its floating screenshot and upload controls cannot be enabled.

zh-CN.description: iLocalize 的悬浮截屏和上传控件需要悬浮窗权限时，这个界面会打开 Android 权限设置并返回授权结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: iLocalize 无法请求悬浮窗权限，因此不能启用悬浮截屏和上传控件。

en.description: In older indigitall SDK versions, this Service handles incoming Google Cloud Messaging data, shows non-silent indigitall notifications, and forwards message data to app listeners.
en.disableEffect: Legacy indigitall GCM messages are no longer processed or shown.

zh-CN.description: 在较早版本的 indigitall SDK 中，这个服务会处理收到的 Google Cloud Messaging 消息、显示非静默推送，并将消息转发给应用监听器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 旧版 indigitall GCM 消息将不再处理或显示。

en.description: When an indigitall notification or action button is tapped, this Activity passes its message and button choice to the SDK so it can open the configured destination.
en.disableEffect: Tapping an indigitall notification or its buttons no longer opens the configured destination; the app remains available from its icon.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击 indigitall 推送或操作按钮时，这个界面会把消息和按钮选择交给 SDK，以打开设置的目标页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 点击 indigitall 推送或按钮将无法打开设置的目标页面；仍可从应用图标打开应用。

en.description: In older indigitall SDK versions, this Receiver accepts Google Cloud Messaging receive and registration broadcasts for the SDK sender and hands matching messages to background processing.
en.disableEffect: The app no longer receives legacy indigitall GCM messages through this receiver.

zh-CN.description: 在较早版本的 indigitall SDK 中，这个接收器会接收发给 SDK 发送方的 Google Cloud Messaging 注册和消息广播，并将匹配的消息交给后台处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法再通过此接收器接收旧版 indigitall GCM 消息。

en.description: When Android finishes starting, this indigitall Receiver logs the boot event and the SDK's saved next-alarm time.
en.disableEffect: Only this startup log is lost; the receiver code does not start a service or post a notification.

zh-CN.description: Android 启动完成时，这个 indigitall 接收器会记录启动事件和 SDK 保存的下次闹钟时间。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 只会失去这条启动日志；接收器代码不会启动服务或发布通知。

en.description: In older indigitall SDK versions, this JobService processes queued Google Cloud Messaging messages, shows non-silent notifications, and forwards push data to the app.
en.disableEffect: Queued legacy GCM messages are no longer turned into indigitall notifications or app events.

zh-CN.description: 在较早版本的 indigitall SDK 中，这个任务服务会处理排队的 Google Cloud Messaging 消息、显示非静默推送，并将推送数据转发给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 排队中的旧版 GCM 消息将不再转换为 indigitall 通知或应用事件。

en.description: While an indigitall push with an animated image remains active, this scheduled service refreshes the notification image.
en.disableEffect: Animated images in indigitall notifications stop updating; ordinary app screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: 带动画图片的 indigitall 推送仍显示时，这个定时服务会更新通知中的图片。
zh-CN.disableEffect: indigitall 通知中的动画图片将停止更新；应用日常界面仍可使用。

en.description: While an indigitall push with an animated image remains active, this Service refreshes the notification image until the notification is dismissed.
en.disableEffect: Animated indigitall notifications can no longer update while visible.

zh-CN.description: 带动画图片的 indigitall 推送仍显示时，这个服务会持续更新通知图片，直到通知被关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: indigitall 动画通知显示期间将无法更新图片。

en.description: When Google refreshes the app's Firebase push token, this Service retrieves the new token and saves it for indigitall.
en.disableEffect: A refreshed Firebase token is not saved for indigitall, which can prevent later push messages from reaching the app.

zh-CN.description: Google 刷新应用的 Firebase 推送令牌时，这个服务会获取新令牌并保存给 indigitall 使用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 刷新后的 Firebase 令牌不会保存给 indigitall，后续推送可能无法到达应用。

en.description: On scheduled background runs, this JobService checks indigitall device registration, sends changed device and push details, refreshes configuration, and schedules another check.
en.disableEffect: Indigitall cannot refresh push registration or configuration in the background, so its notifications and location-triggered messages can become stale or stop.

zh-CN.description: 这个任务服务会按计划在后台检查 indigitall 设备注册状态、发送更新后的设备和推送信息、刷新配置并安排下次检查。
zh-CN.disableEffect: indigitall 无法在后台刷新推送注册信息或配置，因此通知和位置触发的消息可能过期或停止。

en.description: When Firebase delivers an indigitall push, this Service reads its data, shows non-silent notifications, and forwards the message to app listeners.
en.disableEffect: New indigitall Firebase messages are not processed, so their notifications and app callbacks stop.

zh-CN.description: Firebase 投递 indigitall 推送时，这个服务会读取消息数据、显示非静默通知，并将消息转发给应用监听器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 新的 indigitall Firebase 消息将不再处理，因此通知和应用回调会停止。

en.description: When indigitall starts or refreshes its setup, this Service checks device registration, sends device and push details, retrieves configuration, and schedules later checks.
en.disableEffect: Indigitall push setup and scheduled refreshes no longer run, so remote notifications and related location messages can stop.

zh-CN.description: indigitall 启动或刷新配置时，这个服务会检查设备注册状态、发送设备和推送信息、获取配置并安排后续检查。
zh-CN.disableEffect: indigitall 推送初始化和定时刷新将不再运行，远程通知及相关位置消息可能停止。

en.description: When the app schedules an indigitall local notification, this JobService builds and posts it from the supplied title, text, image, and action.
en.disableEffect: Locally scheduled indigitall notifications do not appear.

zh-CN.description: 应用安排 indigitall 本地通知时，这个任务服务会根据提供的标题、正文、图片和操作创建并发布通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: indigitall 安排的本地通知将不会显示。

en.description: When the app asks indigitall to show a local notification, this Service builds and posts it from the supplied message text, image, and action.
en.disableEffect: Locally requested indigitall notifications do not appear.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求 indigitall 显示本地通知时，这个服务会根据提供的消息正文、图片和操作创建并发布通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用请求显示的 indigitall 本地通知将不会出现。

en.description: When scheduled location checks run, this indigitall JobService starts location updates if the SDK's location settings allow them.
en.disableEffect: Indigitall stops collecting background location updates through this path, so location-triggered messages can stop arriving.

zh-CN.description: 定时位置检查运行时，如果 SDK 的位置设置允许，这个 indigitall 任务服务会启动位置更新。
zh-CN.disableEffect: indigitall 将无法通过此路径在后台收集位置更新，因此位置触发的消息可能停止接收。

en.description: When indigitall's location feature is enabled, this Service starts location updates so the SDK can use changes in the device's position.
en.disableEffect: Indigitall stops collecting location updates through this service, so location-triggered messages can stop arriving.

zh-CN.description: indigitall 的位置功能启用时，这个服务会启动位置更新，供 SDK 使用设备位置变化。
zh-CN.disableEffect: indigitall 将无法通过此服务收集位置更新，因此位置触发的消息可能停止接收。

en.description: When an indigitall notification or action is tapped, this Service opens the configured app screen or link, records the interaction, and applies requested tag or dismissal changes.
en.disableEffect: Taps on indigitall notifications or buttons can no longer open their target or update interaction status; messages may remain visible.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击 indigitall 通知或操作按钮时，这个服务会打开设定的应用页面或链接、记录交互，并执行请求的标签或关闭操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 点击 indigitall 通知或按钮将无法打开目标页面或更新交互状态；通知可能仍会显示。

en.description: When the app asks the mReady Hover library to show a floating panel, this service places it over the current screen and adjusts it when the screen turns off, turns on, or unlocks.
en.disableEffect: The app's floating panels and their notifications will no longer be available.

zh-CN.description: 应用要求 mReady Hover 显示浮动面板时，此服务会将面板叠加在当前屏幕上，并在屏幕关闭、亮起或解锁时调整面板状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用的浮动面板及其通知将无法使用。

en.description: The mReady PhotoPicker file provider creates a temporary content link for a photo file so the camera can save the image and the app can read it.
en.disableEffect: The camera mode cannot receive the file link needed to save a photo, so that photo-capture flow will fail.

zh-CN.description: mReady PhotoPicker 的文件提供程序会为照片文件创建临时内容链接，供相机保存照片并让应用读取。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，相机模式无法获得保存照片所需的文件链接，该拍摄流程会失败。

en.description: When the app requests a photo, the mReady PhotoPicker activity opens the camera or image gallery, processes the image size and compression, and returns the local image to the app.
en.disableEffect: The app's photo-selection or capture flow will not open, so users cannot attach a picture through this picker.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求选择照片时，mReady PhotoPicker 会打开相机或图片库，处理图片尺寸和压缩质量后将本地图片交还给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过此选择器挑选或拍摄照片。

en.description: When the app connects a personal cloud-storage account, Netheos PCS API opens this activity for the provider's web sign-in and authorization, then returns the account credentials to the app.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot complete sign-in for those cloud-storage providers through the app.

zh-CN.description: 应用连接个人云存储账户时，Netheos PCS API 会通过此界面打开网页登录和授权，再将账户凭据返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过应用完成这些云存储服务的登录。

en.description: AppAuth opens the browser for an OAuth sign-in request, handles the redirect back to the app, and reports success or cancellation.
en.disableEffect: Sign-in flows using AppAuth will not return an authorization result to the app.

zh-CN.description: AppAuth 会为 OAuth 登录请求打开浏览器，处理返回应用的重定向，并报告成功或取消结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用 AppAuth 的登录流程将无法向应用返回授权结果。

en.description: This OpenID AppAuth activity receives an OAuth or OpenID Connect return link from the browser and passes it to the authorization flow.
en.disableEffect: Sign-in flows that rely on AppAuth browser redirects cannot complete.

zh-CN.description: 这个 OpenID AppAuth 页面会接收浏览器返回的 OAuth 或 OpenID Connect 链接，并交给授权流程处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，依赖 AppAuth 浏览器跳转的登录流程将无法完成。

en.description: Qiujuer’s Genius Android library starts this bound Service when the app requests a command; it runs that command in the background and returns its text output.
en.disableEffect: App operations that rely on Genius command execution may stop working.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求执行命令时，Qiujuer 的 Genius Android 库会启动此绑定 Service；它在后台运行命令并把文本结果返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖 Genius 执行命令的应用操作可能无法继续工作。

en.description: When the app requests an operating-system command, the Genius-Android Kit runs it in the background and returns the command output to the app.
en.disableEffect: Any app operation that relies on this command service will not complete.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求执行系统命令时，Genius-Android Kit 会在后台运行命令并将输出结果返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此命令服务的应用操作将无法完成。

en.description: Solovyev's Android Common Library Billing receives Google Play purchase notifications and billing replies, then passes them to the app's purchase handler.
en.disableEffect: The app may fail to confirm purchases or update purchase status after returning from Google Play.

zh-CN.description: Solovyev 的 Android Common Library Billing 会接收 Google Play 的购买通知和账单回复，并交给应用的购买处理程序。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用可能无法确认购买或在从 Google Play 返回后更新购买状态。

en.description: Solovyev's Android Common Library Billing starts this Service for purchase checks, in-app purchase requests, and transaction restoration while it connects to Google Play billing.
en.disableEffect: Users may be unable to make in-app purchases or restore previous purchases.

zh-CN.description: Solovyev 的 Android Common Library Billing 会在检查购买支持、发起应用内购买或恢复交易时启动此服务，并连接 Google Play 账单服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户可能无法进行应用内购买或恢复以前的购买。

en.description: RxLocationManager, a location library, starts this Provider with the app process and stores the application context used by location requests.
en.disableEffect: If the app uses RxLocationManager for location updates, those requests may fail because the shared application context is not initialized.

zh-CN.description: RxLocationManager 定位库会在应用进程启动时创建此 Provider，并保存定位请求所需的应用上下文。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 如果应用使用 RxLocationManager 获取位置，停用后共享的应用上下文无法初始化，定位请求可能失败。

en.description: When Sprockets is asked to change stored content, this background Service applies insert, edit, or delete requests through Android’s content resolver; it can also clear the related notification.
en.disableEffect: Sprockets data changes will no longer be applied, so app features that save, edit, or delete that content may stop working.

zh-CN.description: Sprockets 收到内容修改请求时，此后台 Service 会通过 Android 内容解析器执行新增、编辑或删除操作，也可以清除相关通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Sprockets 将无法应用这些内容变更，依赖保存、编辑或删除该内容的应用功能可能失效。

en.description: Android creates this Sprockets Provider when the app starts; it initializes the library’s shared components before app features use them.
en.disableEffect: Sprockets components may be unavailable when the app first uses them, which can break app features built on this library.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，Android 会创建此 Sprockets Provider；它会在应用功能使用该库之前初始化共享组件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用首次使用 Sprockets 组件时，这些组件可能尚未就绪，依赖该库的功能可能无法使用。

en.description: Shinsoft ImagePicker uses this shared base Activity to style the status bar when its picker, crop, and preview screens are created; the library does not open it as a separate screen.
en.disableEffect: Disabling its standalone manifest entry leaves the picker, crop, and preview screens available because each has its own Activity entry.

zh-CN.description: Shinsoft ImagePicker 会在选择、裁剪和预览界面创建时通过此基础 Activity 设置状态栏样式；该库不会单独打开这个界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用它单独的清单注册项后，选择、裁剪和预览界面仍可使用，因为这些界面各自有独立的 Activity 注册项。

en.description: In Shinsoft ImagePicker, this Activity opens when a selected photo is sent for cropping; it lets the user adjust the crop and returns the saved image.
en.disableEffect: Photo-cropping workflows that use Shinsoft ImagePicker will not open or return a cropped image.

zh-CN.description: 在 Shinsoft ImagePicker 中，用户选择照片并进入裁剪流程时会打开此 Activity；用户调整裁剪区域后，它会保存并返回图片。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖 Shinsoft ImagePicker 的照片裁剪流程将无法打开，也无法返回裁剪后的图片。

en.description: When the app opens Shinsoft ImagePicker, this Activity loads image folders and lets the user choose photos, preview them, and confirm the selection.
en.disableEffect: The image-selection screen will not open, so app workflows that rely on this picker cannot choose photos.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开 Shinsoft ImagePicker 时，此 Activity 会加载图片文件夹，让用户选择照片、预览并确认选择。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 图片选择界面将无法打开，依赖此选择器的应用流程也无法选取照片。

en.description: When a user previews selected images in Shinsoft ImagePicker, this Activity displays them full-screen and lets the user browse and confirm the selection.
en.disableEffect: Users will lose the picker’s full-screen photo preview and cannot confirm selections through this screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Shinsoft ImagePicker 中预览所选图片时，此 Activity 会全屏显示图片，并允许用户浏览和确认选择。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法使用选择器的全屏照片预览，也无法通过此界面确认图片。

en.description: At launch, Aywa Payment Gateway’s exported Activity displays the SDK’s simple welcome screen.
en.disableEffect: That screen will no longer open; in version 0.0.1 the Activity only displays a static “Hello World!” layout and starts no payment action.

zh-CN.description: 启动 Aywa Payment Gateway 时，这个对外开放的 Activity 会显示 SDK 的简单欢迎界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后该界面不会打开；0.0.1 版本中的 Activity 只显示静态的 “Hello World!” 页面，没有启动支付操作。

en.description: The BLiP Chat Android widget opens this activity to display a support conversation in its embedded chat view. The flow also handles message attachments and location permission requests.
en.disableEffect: In-app BLiP support conversations and their attachment or location features may stop working.

zh-CN.description: BLiP Chat Android 聊天组件会打开此活动，通过内嵌聊天页面显示客服对话；该流程还处理消息附件和位置权限请求。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用内 BLiP 客服对话及其附件或位置功能可能无法使用。

en.description: The BLiP Chat Android widget uses this provider to share captured photos with the chat screen through temporary file links.
en.disableEffect: Sending photos captured for a BLiP chat may fail.

zh-CN.description: BLiP Chat Android 聊天组件会通过此提供器生成临时文件链接，将拍摄的照片交给聊天页面发送。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 在 BLiP 聊天中发送拍摄的照片可能失败。

en.description: Veloxity’s contextual-offer SDK sends nearby beacon scan results to this background Service for processing.
en.disableEffect: Veloxity will miss nearby-beacon signals, reducing location-based recommendations; the host app’s own screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: Veloxity 情境优惠 SDK 会把附近信标扫描结果交给此后台 Service 处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Veloxity 将收不到附近信标信号，基于位置的推荐会减少；宿主应用本身的界面仍可使用。

en.description: Veloxity starts this background Service to monitor and range nearby Bluetooth beacons for contextual recommendations.
en.disableEffect: Veloxity’s beacon detection and nearby-place signals will stop, while the host app’s unrelated features remain available.

zh-CN.description: Veloxity 会启动此后台 Service 来监测和测距附近的蓝牙信标，以支持情境推荐。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Veloxity 的信标检测和附近地点信号会停止，宿主应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: Android runs this Veloxity job when the SDK schedules an immediate or periodic Bluetooth beacon scan.
en.disableEffect: Scheduled Veloxity beacon scans will not run, reducing its nearby-device context and related recommendations.

zh-CN.description: Veloxity SDK 安排即时或周期性蓝牙信标扫描时，Android 会运行此 JobService。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Veloxity 安排的信标扫描将无法运行，附近设备情境信息及相关推荐会减少。

en.description: When Android reports that the app has been updated, this Veloxity Receiver sends the SDK’s startup request so its background service can resume.
en.disableEffect: Veloxity’s background tracking and offers may not resume automatically after an app update; the host app’s other features remain available.

zh-CN.description: Android 通知应用已更新时，Veloxity Receiver 会发送 SDK 启动请求，以恢复其后台服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用更新后，Veloxity 的后台跟踪和优惠可能无法自动恢复；宿主应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: Veloxity registers this Receiver for device boot, quick-boot, and its own startup signal. Version 6.1.9 initializes the SDK on boot; version 7.0.3 proceeds only for Veloxity’s startup signal.
en.disableEffect: Veloxity may not restore its contextual tracking and offer service after startup; the host app’s ordinary screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: Veloxity 会为设备启动、快速启动和 SDK 自身的启动信号注册此 Receiver。6.1.9 版本会在设备启动时初始化 SDK；7.0.3 版本只处理 Veloxity 自身的启动信号。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Veloxity 的情境跟踪和优惠服务可能无法在启动后恢复；宿主应用的普通界面仍可使用。

en.description: When Veloxity requests permission for its data-collection setup, this Activity shows the SDK’s prompt and requests phone-state and precise-location access; it reports the user’s choice and continues SDK setup.
en.disableEffect: Veloxity’s permission prompt and follow-up context tracking may not run, limiting its recommendations; the host app’s unrelated features remain available.

zh-CN.description: Veloxity 请求进行数据收集设置时，此 Activity 会显示 SDK 提示并申请电话状态和精确位置权限；随后将用户选择返回给 SDK 并继续设置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Veloxity 的权限提示和后续情境跟踪可能无法运行，推荐能力会受限；宿主应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: Veloxity uses this Receiver to maintain its background schedules and respond to internal service-check, disable, and shutdown signals.
en.disableEffect: Veloxity’s periodic uploads, nearby-device and sensor collection, and service recovery may stop; the host app itself can still open.

zh-CN.description: Veloxity 通过此 Receiver 维护后台任务，并处理内部服务检查、停用和关闭信号。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Veloxity 的周期上传、附近设备和传感器收集以及服务恢复可能停止；宿主应用本身仍可打开。

en.description: While Veloxity’s background Service runs, this Receiver handles requests to change location, sensor, playlist, and monitoring modes.
en.disableEffect: The Service also registers this handler at runtime, so disabling its manifest entry alone does not stop these SDK mode updates.

zh-CN.description: Veloxity 后台 Service 运行期间，此 Receiver 会处理位置、传感器、活动列表和监测模式的切换请求。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Service 还会在运行时注册此处理器，因此仅停用清单中的注册项不会停止这些 SDK 模式更新。

en.description: Veloxity opens this Activity for a multi-line push message; it displays the supplied title, message, and response buttons.
en.disableEffect: Veloxity’s multi-line push prompts will not appear, but the host app’s own screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: Veloxity 收到多行推送消息时会打开此 Activity，显示消息标题、正文和可选按钮。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Veloxity 的多行推送提示将不再显示，但宿主应用自身的界面仍可使用。

en.description: When a user taps a Veloxity push notification, this translucent Activity passes the notification action to the SDK and closes.
en.disableEffect: Tapping Veloxity notifications will no longer open their associated offer or destination; other app features remain available.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击 Veloxity 推送通知时，此半透明 Activity 会把通知操作交给 SDK 处理，然后关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 点击 Veloxity 通知将无法打开关联优惠或目标页面；应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: When a user opens a Veloxity promotion, this Activity can show an offer dialog or web view, open a web link, or launch the promoted app.
en.disableEffect: Veloxity promotion screens and their links will not open; the host app’s ordinary features remain available.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 Veloxity 推广内容时，此 Activity 可以显示优惠对话框或网页、打开网页链接，或启动推广的应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Veloxity 推广界面及其链接将无法打开；宿主应用的普通功能仍可使用。

en.description: Veloxity’s background Service uses this Receiver for internal device-state, test, and promotion-widget messages.
en.disableEffect: The Service registers the handler at runtime, so disabling its manifest entry alone does not stop those SDK updates.

zh-CN.description: Veloxity 后台 Service 通过此 Receiver 处理内部设备状态、测试和推广组件消息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Service 会在运行时注册此处理器，因此仅停用清单中的注册项不会停止这些 SDK 更新。

en.description: For a Veloxity push promotion, this Activity displays a small web-based offer with an image; tapping it opens the listed website or app-market page.
en.disableEffect: Veloxity’s pop-up offers and their external links will not appear; the host app’s other features remain available.

zh-CN.description: Veloxity 推广推送会通过此 Activity 显示带图片的小型网页优惠；点击后会打开指定网站或应用市场页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Veloxity 的弹出优惠及外部链接将不再显示；宿主应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: Veloxity starts this foreground Service to support its main background Service; it shows a persistent notification while tracking is active and then stops.
en.disableEffect: Veloxity’s long-running background tracking may be interrupted or lose its required notification; the host app’s main interface remains available.

zh-CN.description: Veloxity 会启动此前台 Service 来支持主后台 Service；跟踪运行时它显示持续通知，之后会自行停止。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Veloxity 的长期后台跟踪可能中断或无法显示所需通知；宿主应用的主界面仍可使用。

en.description: Veloxity starts this Service for background contextual-data collection, including location, network, device-state, and usage-access changes.
en.disableEffect: Veloxity will lose these background signals and related location-based recommendations; the host app’s unrelated screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: Veloxity 会启动此 Service，在后台收集位置、网络、设备状态和应用使用权限变化等情境信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Veloxity 将无法获取这些后台信号，基于位置的推荐也会受影响；宿主应用的其他界面仍可使用。

en.description: Veloxity’s contextual-offer SDK stores and returns its device identifier through this Provider so its services can recognize the same device.
en.disableEffect: Veloxity loses this device-ID lookup and storage path, which can reduce cross-session matching and offer relevance; normal host-app features remain available.

zh-CN.description: Veloxity 情境优惠 SDK 通过此 Provider 保存和读取设备标识，以便其服务识别同一设备。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Veloxity 将无法通过此路径查询和保存设备标识，跨会话匹配和优惠相关性可能降低；宿主应用的普通功能仍可使用。

en.description: Veloxity Core uses this Provider to store and return device records when its contextual-offer services request an identifier.
en.disableEffect: Veloxity Core cannot read or save these device records, which can reduce device matching for SDK recommendations; the host app’s other features remain available.

zh-CN.description: Veloxity Core 会通过此 Provider 保存并读取设备记录，供情境优惠服务查询设备标识。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Veloxity Core 无法读取或保存这些设备记录，SDK 推荐的设备匹配能力可能降低；宿主应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: When the app sends custom attributes to Veloxity as a JSON message, this Receiver forwards them to the contextual-offer SDK.
en.disableEffect: Veloxity will not receive those custom attributes, so its targeting and recommendations may be less relevant; the host app’s own features remain available.

zh-CN.description: 应用以 JSON 消息向 Veloxity 发送自定义属性时，此 Receiver 会将属性转交给情境优惠 SDK。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Veloxity 将收不到这些自定义属性，定向和推荐的相关性可能降低；宿主应用自身的功能仍可使用。

en.description: When Firebase delivers a device token or a data message intended for Veloxity, this Service forwards it to the contextual-offer SDK.
en.disableEffect: Veloxity push messages and token updates will no longer be handled by this service; the host app’s other features remain available.
