zh-CN.description: Firebase 向 Veloxity 发送设备令牌或数据消息时，此 Service 会将其转交给情境优惠 SDK。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 此 Service 将不再处理 Veloxity 推送消息和令牌更新；宿主应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: When Google Play Services reports entering, leaving, or dwelling in a monitored area, this Veloxity Receiver passes the event and location to its tracking system.
en.disableEffect: Veloxity will stop receiving these geofence signals, reducing location-based contextual recommendations; the host app’s unrelated features remain available.

zh-CN.description: Google Play 服务报告进入、离开或停留在监测区域时，此 Veloxity Receiver 会把事件和位置交给跟踪系统。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Veloxity 将收不到这些地理围栏信号，基于位置的情境推荐会减少；宿主应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: When an app is installed or removed, Veloxity’s hybrid module refreshes its installed-app list in the background.
en.disableEffect: Veloxity will no longer refresh this list after package changes, which may reduce its contextual targeting; the host app’s normal features remain available.

zh-CN.description: 应用安装或移除时，Veloxity 混合模块会在后台刷新已安装应用列表。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 软件包变化后 Veloxity 将不再刷新此列表，情境定向能力可能降低；宿主应用的普通功能仍可使用。

en.description: After device boot or quick boot, Veloxity’s hybrid module sends a signal to schedule its next contextual-score calculation.
en.disableEffect: Hybrid recommendation calculations may not be rescheduled after device startup; the host app’s other features remain available.

zh-CN.description: 设备启动或快速启动后，Veloxity 混合模块会发送信号，安排下一次情境评分计算。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 设备启动后，混合推荐计算可能不会重新安排；宿主应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: When Veloxity’s hybrid Service starts, it loads SDK settings, registers device and network context, and schedules background recommendation work.
en.disableEffect: Veloxity’s hybrid context collection and recommendation updates will stop; the host app’s unrelated features remain available.

zh-CN.description: Veloxity 混合 Service 启动时，会加载 SDK 设置、登记设备和网络情境，并安排后台推荐任务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Veloxity 混合模块的情境收集和推荐更新将停止；宿主应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: When Veloxity’s hybrid alarm signal arrives, this Receiver schedules the next contextual-score calculation.
en.disableEffect: The hybrid module may not schedule its next background calculation, leaving recommendations out of date; the host app remains usable.

zh-CN.description: Veloxity 混合模块的闹钟信号到达时，此 Receiver 会安排下一次情境评分计算。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 混合模块可能无法安排下一次后台计算，导致推荐内容不再更新；宿主应用仍可使用。

en.description: When Veloxity’s hybrid scoring signal arrives, this Receiver enqueues a background recalculation and schedules the next cycle.
en.disableEffect: Veloxity’s hybrid recommendation score will no longer be recalculated on schedule; the host app’s other features remain available.

zh-CN.description: Veloxity 混合评分信号到达时，此 Receiver 会安排后台重新计算，并设置下一轮任务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Veloxity 混合模块将无法按计划重新计算推荐评分；宿主应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: Veloxity’s hybrid module stores and returns its device identifier through this Provider and looks for a matching identifier in other installed Veloxity providers.
en.disableEffect: The hybrid module loses this shared device-ID lookup, which may reduce cross-app matching and recommendation relevance; the host app’s normal features remain available.

zh-CN.description: Veloxity 混合模块通过此 Provider 保存和读取设备标识，并会在其他已安装的 Veloxity Provider 中查找匹配标识。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 混合模块将无法使用此共享设备标识查询，跨应用匹配和推荐相关性可能降低；宿主应用的普通功能仍可使用。

en.description: When Google Play Services delivers location updates for Veloxity, this Receiver forwards each location for background processing.
en.disableEffect: Veloxity will lose these background location signals and related location-based recommendations; the host app’s unrelated location features remain available.

zh-CN.description: Google Play 服务向 Veloxity 发送位置更新时，此 Receiver 会将每个位置转交后台处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Veloxity 将收不到这些后台位置数据，基于位置的推荐会受影响；宿主应用其他定位功能仍可使用。

en.description: Veloxity’s background processes use this Provider to read and update the SDK’s saved preferences across processes.
en.disableEffect: Veloxity components that share settings across processes may stop working correctly; the host app’s other features remain available.

zh-CN.description: Veloxity 的后台进程通过此 Provider 跨进程读取和更新 SDK 保存的偏好设置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要跨进程共享设置的 Veloxity 组件可能无法正常工作；宿主应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: When the app opens a VMate support screen, this Activity creates the SDK’s support interface and starts its support helper.
en.disableEffect: The in-app support center provided by VMate will not open.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开 VMate 支持界面时，此 Activity 会创建 SDK 支持页面并启动支持功能。
zh-CN.disableEffect: VMate 提供的应用内帮助中心将无法打开。

en.description: When Android reports another app being installed or removed, the Youmi Overseas Offers Wall SDK processes that app for its install-task tracking. It is also registered for package replacement and keyboard-change notices.
en.disableEffect: App-install offers will stop receiving app-change updates, while the host app’s other screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: Android 通知有应用安装或卸载时，Youmi 海外积分墙 SDK 会处理该应用的信息，用于跟踪安装类任务。它还注册接收应用替换和输入法切换通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 安装类任务将无法再收到应用变化信息，但宿主应用的其他页面仍可使用。

en.description: When a user follows a Youmi Overseas Offers Wall web link, this screen loads the supplied page inside the app and shows its title and loading progress.
en.disableEffect: Youmi pages that use this in-app browser will not open, but the host app’s other screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 Youmi 海外积分墙的网页链接时，此页面会在应用内加载对应网页，并显示标题和加载进度。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此内置浏览器的 Youmi 网页将无法打开，但宿主应用的其他页面仍可使用。

en.description: The Youmi Overseas Offers Wall SDK opens this screen as its offer wall. It shows available earning tasks and task records, with links to the SDK’s help and agreement pages.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to browse Youmi offers or their task records, while the host app’s other features remain available.

zh-CN.description: Youmi 海外积分墙 SDK 会将此页面作为积分墙主界面，展示可参与的任务、任务记录，以及 SDK 的帮助和协议页面入口。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法浏览 Youmi 任务或任务记录，但宿主应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: After Youmi reports a successful point award, this dialog displays the credited amount with a short coin animation, then closes automatically.
en.disableEffect: Users will no longer see this points confirmation, but the host app’s other features remain available.

zh-CN.description: Youmi 确认积分发放成功后，此对话框会显示到账数量和简短的金币动画，随后自动关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将看不到这条积分到账确认，但宿主应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: When a user selects an offer from the Youmi wall or task records, this screen shows its reward and required steps and lets the user start or continue a step. A successful point claim opens Youmi’s points confirmation.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open or continue that Youmi offer task through this screen, but the host app’s other features remain available.

zh-CN.description: 用户从 Youmi 积分墙或任务记录中选择一项任务时，此页面会显示奖励和所需步骤，并允许用户开始或继续任务。积分领取成功后会打开 Youmi 的到账确认页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法通过此页面打开或继续该 Youmi 任务，但宿主应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: When Android reports an app install or removal, the Youmi Overseas Offers Wall SDK updates its installed-app tracking and checks whether a pending task should open that app. The receiver is also registered for boot, package-replacement, and keyboard-change notices.
en.disableEffect: App-install offers will no longer update their tracking or resume a waiting task app, while the host app’s other features remain available.

zh-CN.description: Android 通知有应用安装或卸载时，Youmi 海外积分墙 SDK 会更新已安装应用记录，并检查是否有等待启动该应用的任务。此接收器还注册接收开机、应用替换和输入法切换通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 安装类任务将无法更新跟踪信息或继续启动等待中的应用，但宿主应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: When a user follows a Youmi Overseas Offers Wall web link, this screen loads the supplied page inside the app and shows its title and loading progress.
en.disableEffect: Youmi pages that use this in-app browser will not open, but the host app’s other screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 Youmi 海外积分墙的网页链接时，此页面会在应用内加载对应网页，并显示标题和加载进度。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此内置浏览器的 Youmi 网页将无法打开，但宿主应用的其他页面仍可使用。

en.description: The Youmi Overseas Offers Wall SDK opens this as its home page. It shows task categories, the user’s point balance, and shortcuts to point records and withdrawal options.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to browse Youmi tasks or reach its points and withdrawal screens, while the host app’s other features remain available.

zh-CN.description: Youmi 海外积分墙 SDK 会将此页面作为主界面，展示任务分类、用户积分余额，以及积分记录和提现入口。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法浏览 Youmi 任务或进入积分和提现页面，但宿主应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: When opened from Youmi’s home or withdrawal pages, this screen shows the user’s point history in selectable categories.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to review their Youmi point history through the offer wall.

zh-CN.description: 从 Youmi 主页面或提现页面进入时，此页面会按可选分类展示用户的积分记录。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过积分墙查看 Youmi 积分记录。

en.description: After Youmi reports that points have been awarded, this brief dialog shows the credited amount with a coin-and-star animation and closes automatically.
en.disableEffect: Users will no longer see this points confirmation, but the host app’s other features remain available.

zh-CN.description: Youmi 确认积分发放成功后，此对话框会用金币和星星动画显示到账数量，随后自动关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将看不到这条积分到账确认，但宿主应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: When a user selects a task from Youmi’s task lists or records, this screen shows its point value and required steps and lets the user start or continue the task.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to view or complete the selected Youmi task through this page, while the host app’s other features remain available.

zh-CN.description: 用户从 Youmi 任务列表或记录中选择任务时，此页面会显示积分奖励和所需步骤，并允许用户开始或继续任务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此页面查看或完成所选的 Youmi 任务，但宿主应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: After a user selects a Youmi point-redemption option, this screen shows its point cost and payout method, collects the required contact details, and submits the redemption.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to redeem Youmi points through this screen, while the host app’s other features remain available.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择 Youmi 积分兑换选项后，此页面会显示所需积分和收款方式，收集必要的联系信息并提交兑换。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此页面兑换 Youmi 积分，但宿主应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: When a user opens Youmi’s withdrawal section, this screen lists available point-redemption options and the current point balance; selecting an option opens its payout form.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to browse Youmi’s redemption options or open their payout forms.

zh-CN.description: 用户进入 Youmi 提现页面时，此页面会列出可用的积分兑换选项和当前积分余额；选择一项后会打开收款表单。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法浏览 Youmi 的兑换选项或打开收款表单。

en.description: When an app starts NETPIE Microgear, this service connects to NETPIE and carries messages between the app and its connected IoT devices.
en.disableEffect: The app can no longer send or receive messages through NETPIE, so connected-device features may stop working.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动 NETPIE Microgear 时，此服务会连接 NETPIE，并在应用与联网设备之间传递消息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用无法再通过 NETPIE 收发消息，依赖联网设备的功能可能停止工作。

en.description: After the Verifybloc KYC SDK has collected identity details and document photos, this page lets the user review the application and confirm submission. The user can return to correct details or retake a photo.
en.disableEffect: The user cannot review and submit the identity application, so the Verifybloc KYC flow cannot finish.

zh-CN.description: Verifybloc KYC SDK 收集身份资料和证件照片后，会打开此页面供用户检查并确认提交。用户也可以返回修改资料或重拍照片。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法检查并提交身份验证申请，Verifybloc KYC 流程可能无法完成。

en.description: The Verifybloc KYC SDK opens this guide before a document photo or live selfie check. It shows framing and lighting instructions, then continues to the matching camera step.
en.disableEffect: The user cannot continue from this camera guide to the required document or selfie capture step.

zh-CN.description: Verifybloc KYC SDK 会在拍摄证件照片或进行自拍视频检测前显示此指引。页面介绍取景和光线要求，用户继续后会进入对应的拍摄步骤。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法通过此拍摄指引进入所需的证件或自拍视频步骤。

en.description: After the user photographs the back of an ID card or driver license, the Verifybloc KYC SDK shows the image here for a readability check. The user can accept it or retake it.
en.disableEffect: The user cannot review and confirm the back of the identity document, which can stop the KYC application.

zh-CN.description: 用户拍摄身份证或驾驶证背面后，Verifybloc KYC SDK 会在此显示照片，供用户检查文字是否清晰，并选择确认或重拍。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法检查并确认证件背面照片，KYC 申请可能因此无法完成。

en.description: After the user photographs the front of an ID card or driver license, the Verifybloc KYC SDK shows the image here for a readability check. Accepting it saves the photo and advances to the back-side or face-check step as required.
en.disableEffect: The user cannot review and confirm the front of the identity document, which can stop the KYC application.

zh-CN.description: 用户拍摄身份证或驾驶证正面后，Verifybloc KYC SDK 会在此显示照片供用户检查。确认后会保存照片，并按流程进入背面拍摄或人脸检测步骤。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法检查并确认证件正面照片，KYC 申请可能因此无法完成。

en.description: After a Verifybloc camera capture, this shared review page shows the saved image and lets the user retake or accept it. The accepted image is returned to the active verification step.
en.disableEffect: The user cannot review or confirm a captured image in flows that use this page, which may block KYC completion.

zh-CN.description: Verifybloc 拍摄完成后会在此共享页面显示照片，供用户重拍或确认。确认的照片会返回当前身份验证步骤。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此页面的流程将无法检查或确认拍摄的照片，KYC 可能无法完成。

en.description: After the selfie-photo step, the Verifybloc KYC SDK previews the captured face image so the user can retake or accept it. Accepting continues to the live-selfie instructions.
en.disableEffect: The user cannot review and confirm the selfie photo required by this verification flow.

zh-CN.description: 自拍视频照拍摄后，Verifybloc KYC SDK 会在此预览人脸照片，供用户重拍或确认。确认后会继续显示自拍视频指引。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法检查并确认此验证流程所需的自拍照片。

en.description: When the selected identity document needs both sides, the Verifybloc KYC SDK opens the camera for the back-side photo. The captured image is passed to the review step.
en.disableEffect: The user cannot photograph the back of a two-sided identity document, so that KYC submission may be incomplete.

zh-CN.description: 所选证件需要拍摄两面时，Verifybloc KYC SDK 会打开此相机拍摄背面，并将照片交给检查页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法拍摄双面证件的背面，相关 KYC 申请可能无法完成。

en.description: During the Verifybloc KYC document step, this camera page photographs the selected identity document and passes the image to review. It is used by the SDK release that has a single general document-capture screen.
en.disableEffect: The user cannot photograph an identity document through this capture step, which can prevent KYC completion.

zh-CN.description: Verifybloc KYC 证件步骤会打开此相机页面拍摄所选证件，并将照片交给检查页面。此页面用于采用通用证件拍摄界面的 SDK 版本。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法通过此拍摄步骤提供证件照片，KYC 流程可能无法完成。

en.description: When the user reaches identity-document photography, the Verifybloc KYC SDK opens the camera for the front of the selected document. The captured photo is sent to the image-review page.
en.disableEffect: The user cannot photograph and submit the front of the identity document required by this KYC flow.

zh-CN.description: 用户进入证件拍摄步骤时，Verifybloc KYC SDK 会打开此相机拍摄所选证件的正面，并将照片交给检查页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法拍摄并提交此 KYC 流程所需的证件正面照片。

en.description: When the Verifybloc KYC SDK opens its error route, this page shows a failure message and a close control. It gives the user a way to leave the failed verification screen.
en.disableEffect: The SDK cannot show its KYC error and exit page, so an error route may fail to open.

zh-CN.description: Verifybloc KYC SDK 进入错误页面时，会显示失败提示和关闭按钮，供用户离开未完成的验证页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: SDK 无法显示 KYC 错误提示和退出页面，错误流程可能无法正常打开。

en.description: If the user permanently denies camera access, the Verifybloc KYC SDK opens this page to explain that camera access is off. Its button opens the app settings page so access can be restored.
en.disableEffect: The user loses the SDK recovery instructions for camera access, so document and selfie capture may remain unavailable.

zh-CN.description: 用户永久拒绝相机权限后，Verifybloc KYC SDK 会打开此页面说明相机权限已关闭。页面按钮会打开应用设置，供用户恢复权限。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法使用 SDK 提供的相机权限恢复指引，证件和自拍拍摄可能仍不可用。

en.description: When opened by the host app, the Verifybloc KYC SDK shows an overview of the identity check, including an ID or passport, a selfie, a legal name, and an estimated review time. The page includes a Start now button.
en.disableEffect: The KYC overview and its checklist cannot be shown to users whose host flow opens this page.

zh-CN.description: 宿主应用打开此页面时，Verifybloc KYC SDK 会介绍身份验证所需内容，包括身份证或护照、自拍、法定姓名以及预计审核时间。页面还显示开始按钮。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 宿主流程使用此页面时，用户将无法看到 KYC 概览和所需资料清单。

en.description: Before a live-selfie check, the Verifybloc KYC SDK shows instructions for framing and lighting the face during video recording. Continuing opens the selfie-video camera.
en.disableEffect: The user cannot read the live-selfie instructions or continue to that required face-check step.

zh-CN.description: 进行自拍视频检测前，Verifybloc KYC SDK 会说明录制时的人脸取景和光线要求。用户继续后会进入自拍视频相机。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法查看自拍视频指引或进入所需的人脸检测步骤。

en.description: After the user continues from the live-selfie guide, this Verifybloc KYC camera records a face video and checks that a face stays in the frame. The clip is then passed to the review and verification step.
en.disableEffect: The user cannot record the live-selfie video needed to complete this identity check.

zh-CN.description: 用户从自拍视频指引继续后，Verifybloc KYC 会打开此相机录制人脸视频，并检查人脸是否保持在画面内。视频随后会交给检查和验证步骤。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法录制此身份验证所需的自拍视频。

en.description: After recording, this page plays the live-selfie video so the user can review it. The user can upload it for verification or record it again.
en.disableEffect: The user cannot review or submit the live-selfie video required by this KYC flow.

zh-CN.description: 录制完成后，此页面会播放自拍视频供用户检查。用户可以提交视频进行验证，也可以重新录制。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法检查或提交此 KYC 流程所需的自拍视频。

en.description: After document capture, the Verifybloc KYC SDK asks for personal details such as legal name, birth date, gender, and document dates and number. The user submits these details as part of the identity application.
en.disableEffect: The user cannot enter and submit the personal details required for this identity application.

zh-CN.description: 证件拍摄后，Verifybloc KYC SDK 会要求用户填写法定姓名、出生日期、性别以及证件日期和号码，并将资料提交到身份申请中。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法填写并提交此身份申请所需的个人资料。

en.description: During the selfie-photo step, the Verifybloc KYC SDK opens the front camera, checks that the face is in frame, and takes a photo for review.
en.disableEffect: The user cannot take the selfie photo required by this identity-verification flow.

zh-CN.description: 自拍照片步骤会打开前置相机，Verifybloc KYC SDK 会检查人脸是否位于画面中，并拍照供用户检查。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法拍摄此身份验证流程所需的自拍照片。

en.description: Before a selfie photo, the Verifybloc KYC SDK shows tips for positioning the face and eyes and removing glasses if needed. Continuing opens the selfie camera.
en.disableEffect: The user cannot see the photo-taking guidance or continue to the selfie capture step.

zh-CN.description: 拍摄自拍照片前，Verifybloc KYC SDK 会提示用户摆正脸部和眼睛，并在需要时摘下眼镜。用户继续后会进入自拍相机。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法查看拍照指引或继续自拍步骤。

en.description: When the host app starts Verifybloc identity verification for a user, this page loads the user current verification state. The SDK then opens the next personal or business step, or the matching review status.
en.disableEffect: The host app cannot start or resume the Verifybloc identity-verification flow.

zh-CN.description: 宿主应用为用户启动 Verifybloc 身份验证时，此页面会读取用户当前的验证状态。SDK 随后打开下一项个人或企业验证步骤，或显示对应的审核状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 宿主应用无法启动或继续 Verifybloc 身份验证流程。

en.description: When a country selector opens, the Verifybloc KYC SDK lists the countries supported by the current flow. Choosing one returns it to the previous verification page.
en.disableEffect: The user cannot choose and return the country required by the verification form.

zh-CN.description: 国家选择器打开时，Verifybloc KYC SDK 会列出当前验证流程支持的国家。用户选择后，所选国家会返回上一验证页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法选择并返回验证表单所需的国家。

en.description: Before document verification, the Verifybloc KYC SDK asks which country issued the identity document; for a business check it asks where the organization is located. The user can open the country list and continue.
en.disableEffect: The user cannot specify the document-issuing country or business location needed by the verification flow.

zh-CN.description: 开始证件验证前，Verifybloc KYC SDK 会询问证件签发国家；企业验证则询问组织所在地。用户可打开国家列表并继续。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法填写验证所需的证件签发国家或企业所在地。

en.description: After country selection, the Verifybloc KYC SDK lists the identity document types available for that verification flow. Choosing a supported document sets the type and continues to photo capture.
en.disableEffect: The user cannot select the identity document needed to continue KYC.

zh-CN.description: 选择国家后，Verifybloc KYC SDK 会列出当前验证流程可用的证件类型。用户选择受支持的证件后，流程会设置类型并进入拍摄步骤。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法选择继续 KYC 所需的身份证件。

en.description: At the start of personal identity verification, the Verifybloc KYC SDK explains what the user will provide and presents the terms. Continuing opens the issuing-country step, while the terms link opens its web page.
en.disableEffect: The user cannot start the personal identity-verification flow or review its linked terms from this page.

zh-CN.description: 个人身份验证开始时，Verifybloc KYC SDK 会说明需要提供的资料并展示相关条款。继续后会进入证件签发国家步骤，点击条款链接会打开相应网页。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法从此页面启动个人身份验证或查看相关条款。

en.description: When the document-language picker opens, the Verifybloc KYC SDK lists the available language choices. Selecting one returns it to the previous verification page.
en.disableEffect: The user cannot choose the document language requested by the verification flow.

zh-CN.description: 证件语言列表打开时，Verifybloc KYC SDK 会列出可选语言。用户选择后，所选语言会返回上一验证页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法选择验证流程所需的证件语言。

en.description: The Verifybloc KYC SDK asks which language the identity document is written in. Opening the selector shows supported languages for the user to choose.
en.disableEffect: The user cannot specify the document language used during identity verification.

zh-CN.description: Verifybloc KYC SDK 会询问身份证件所用的语言。打开选择器后，用户可以从支持的语言中进行选择。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法指定身份验证所需的证件语言。

en.description: When the user selects a phone country prefix, the Verifybloc KYC SDK displays dialing codes and returns the chosen code to the form.
en.disableEffect: The user cannot choose and return the phone country code required by the verification form.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择电话国家区号时，Verifybloc KYC SDK 会显示可选区号，并将所选区号返回表单。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法选择并返回验证表单所需的电话国家区号。

en.description: After loading or submitting an application, the Verifybloc KYC SDK shows whether it is under review, approved, rejected, or needs resubmission. The page presents the next action for that status.
en.disableEffect: The user cannot see the verification result or follow the status-specific next step.

zh-CN.description: 申请读取或提交后，Verifybloc KYC SDK 会显示审核中、已通过、已拒绝或需要重新提交等状态，并提供相应的后续操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法查看验证结果或执行对应状态的后续操作。

en.description: When a user opens linked terms, policy, or support information in the Verifybloc KYC flow, this page displays the supplied web page inside the app.
en.disableEffect: Linked terms, policy, or support pages in the KYC flow cannot be displayed.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Verifybloc KYC 流程中打开条款、政策或支持信息链接时，此页面会在应用内显示对应网页。
zh-CN.disableEffect: KYC 流程中的条款、政策或支持网页将无法显示。

en.description: When business verification requires supporting documents and the user chooses to take a photo, the Verifybloc KYC SDK opens this camera. The captured image is passed to a review page.
en.disableEffect: The user cannot photograph supporting business documents through this KYC step.

zh-CN.description: 企业验证需要证明文件且用户选择拍照时，Verifybloc KYC SDK 会打开此相机。拍摄的照片会交给检查页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法通过此 KYC 步骤拍摄企业证明文件。

en.description: After a supporting business document is photographed, this Verifybloc KYC page shows the image for review. Confirming it returns the photo to the business-document upload step.
en.disableEffect: The user cannot review and confirm the photographed business document.

zh-CN.description: 企业证明文件拍摄后，Verifybloc KYC 会在此页面显示照片供用户检查。确认后，照片会返回企业文件上传步骤。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法检查并确认拍摄的企业证明文件。

en.description: During business verification, this Verifybloc KYC page asks for a code sent to the organization email address. The user can enter the code or request another one to confirm access to that mailbox.
en.disableEffect: The user cannot confirm access to the organization email required for this business-verification flow.

zh-CN.description: 企业验证过程中，Verifybloc KYC 会要求用户输入发送到组织邮箱的验证码。用户可输入验证码或重新获取，以确认能够使用该邮箱。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法确认企业验证流程所需的组织邮箱。

en.description: The business-verification flow asks for the organization name, address, phone, email, and optional website on this page. Verifybloc KYC submits the details for an organization lookup and may request email confirmation or documents.
en.disableEffect: The user cannot provide the organization details required to continue business verification.

zh-CN.description: 企业验证流程会在此页面收集组织名称、地址、电话、邮箱和可选网站。Verifybloc KYC 会提交资料查询组织信息，并可能要求邮箱确认或补充文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法提供继续企业验证所需的组织资料。

en.description: When business verification needs a photographed supporting document, the Verifybloc KYC SDK opens this camera and sends the image to review before upload.
en.disableEffect: The user cannot photograph supporting evidence for business verification.

zh-CN.description: 企业验证需要拍摄证明文件时，Verifybloc KYC SDK 会打开此相机，并在上传前将照片交给检查页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法拍摄企业验证所需的证明材料。

en.description: When organization details need supporting evidence, this Verifybloc KYC page lets the user choose image or PDF files, take a photo, and upload the documents.
en.disableEffect: The user cannot attach or upload the supporting documents needed for business verification.

zh-CN.description: 组织资料需要证明材料时，Verifybloc KYC 会让用户选择图片或 PDF 文件、拍照并上传文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法添加或上传企业验证所需的证明文件。

en.description: At the start of business verification, the Verifybloc KYC SDK explains the organization information and connection evidence that may be required and presents the terms. Continuing opens the organization-location step.
en.disableEffect: The user cannot start the business identity-verification flow or review its linked terms from this page.

zh-CN.description: 企业身份验证开始时，Verifybloc KYC SDK 会说明可能需要的组织资料和关系证明，并展示相关条款。继续后会进入组织所在地选择步骤。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法从此页面启动企业身份验证或查看相关条款。

en.description: SimplePay Gateway opens this Activity for its checkout or Remember payment flow. It collects card and optional billing details, then handles the PIN, bank verification, or one-time code needed for payment.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents the app from completing SimplePay card payments or the Remember flow.

zh-CN.description: SimplePay Gateway 会在应用发起结账或 Remember 付款流程时打开此 Activity。它收集银行卡信息和可选账单资料，并处理付款所需的 PIN、银行验证或一次性验证码。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用将无法完成 SimplePay 信用卡付款或 Remember 流程。

en.description: SimplePay Gateway opens this Activity when the app starts a card checkout. It collects payment details and continues through PIN or one-time-code checks when the payment requires them.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents the app from completing this SimplePay card payment.

zh-CN.description: 应用发起信用卡结账时，SimplePay Gateway 会打开此 Activity。它收集付款信息，并在付款需要时继续进行 PIN 或一次性验证码验证。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用将无法完成这笔 SimplePay 信用卡付款。

en.description: SimplePay Gateway opens this Activity for its Remember payment flow. It collects card details and handles any required PIN or one-time-code checks.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents the app from completing the SimplePay Remember payment flow.

zh-CN.description: 应用发起 Remember 付款流程时，SimplePay Gateway 会打开此 Activity。它收集银行卡信息，并在需要时处理 PIN 或一次性验证码验证。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用将无法完成 SimplePay 的 Remember 付款流程。

en.description: CoffeeIT Bagtag opens this Activity to show its airline baggage-tag workflow. It guides the user through account connection, flight details, and communicating with a Bluetooth bag tag to upload its status.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from opening the app Bagtag screen for connection and tag upload.

zh-CN.description: CoffeeIT Bagtag 会通过此 Activity 展示航空行李牌流程，引导用户连接账户、查看航班信息，并通过蓝牙行李牌上传状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法打开应用中的 Bagtag 连接和行李牌上传流程。

en.description: The Androscope developer tool opens this Activity from the app launcher. It starts the local inspection server, shows its status, and offers a restart control.
en.disableEffect: The app inspection screen and its server controls will no longer be available.

zh-CN.description: 用户从应用启动器打开 Androscope 开发工具时，会进入此 Activity。它启动本地检查服务、显示运行状态，并提供重启控制。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用检查界面及其服务控制将无法使用。

en.description: The Androscope developer tool runs this Provider during app startup. When automatic inspection is enabled, it watches for the first app screen to open and starts the inspection server.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it turns off automatic server startup for Androscope; normal app startup and screens continue to work.

zh-CN.description: Androscope 开发工具会在应用启动时运行此 Provider。启用自动检查后，它会等待应用首个界面打开，再启动检查服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Androscope 将不再自动启动检查服务；应用正常启动和使用不受影响。

en.description: The Androscope developer tool starts this Service when its inspection screen or automatic-start option needs the local inspection server. The server provides the app inspection page and reports its status to the screen.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it stops the Androscope inspection page and its status controls from working.

zh-CN.description: Androscope 开发工具需要本地检查服务时，会启动此 Service。该服务提供应用检查页面，并向界面报告运行状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Androscope 检查页面及其状态控制将无法使用。

en.description: The NVList Android engine starts the visual novel when the user opens the app. It initializes the game engine and loads the game using files included with the app.
en.disableEffect: The app will not be able to start its visual novel.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开应用时，NVList Android 引擎会启动视觉小说。它初始化游戏引擎，并使用应用内的文件加载游戏。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用中的视觉小说将无法启动。

en.description: Nordic Semiconductor BLE Scanner Compat delivers Bluetooth LE scan results for background requests on Android 8 and later. It filters results and forwards nearby-device discoveries or scan errors to the app.
en.disableEffect: Background nearby-device discovery through this library will stop and may break app features that rely on it.

zh-CN.description: 在 Android 8 及更高版本上，Nordic Semiconductor BLE Scanner Compat 会为后台蓝牙 LE 扫描传递结果。它会筛选结果，并将发现的附近设备或扫描错误转交给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用将无法通过此组件在后台发现附近设备，依赖此功能的应用功能可能无法使用。

en.description: On Android 4.3 through 7.x, Nordic Semiconductor BLE Scanner Compat uses this Service to run background Bluetooth LE scans. It starts or stops scans and passes nearby-device results to the app.
en.disableEffect: Background Bluetooth LE scans on those Android versions will stop, which can break app features that rely on nearby-device discovery.

zh-CN.description: 在 Android 4.3 至 7.x 上，Nordic Semiconductor BLE Scanner Compat 使用此 Service 执行后台蓝牙 LE 扫描。它启动或停止扫描，并将附近设备的结果传递给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，这些 Android 版本上的后台蓝牙 LE 扫描将停止，依赖附近设备发现的应用功能可能无法使用。

en.description: Esafirm Compose UI Book shows the selected example from the app's UI catalog as a preview page.
en.disableEffect: The selected UI example page will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: Esafirm Compose UI Book 会将应用选中的界面示例显示为预览页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 选中的界面示例将无法打开。

en.description: Esafirm Compose UI Book provides a launcher page listing the app's registered UI examples; choosing one opens its preview.
en.disableEffect: The UI example catalog will no longer open from its launcher entry.

zh-CN.description: Esafirm Compose UI Book 提供一个启动页面，列出应用注册的界面示例；选择示例后会打开对应预览。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 无法再通过它的启动入口打开界面示例目录。

en.description: Appfigurate starts this Provider during app startup to prepare the app runtime configuration and feature settings. It loads the app-specific configuration before those settings are used.
en.disableEffect: Features that read Appfigurate configuration may fail or be unavailable because the settings are not initialized.

zh-CN.description: Appfigurate 会在应用启动时运行此 Provider，以准备应用的运行时配置和功能设置，并在这些设置被使用前加载应用专属配置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，依赖 Appfigurate 配置的功能可能无法使用，或因设置未初始化而出错。

en.description: Appfigurate runs this Receiver after the system clock or date changes. It refreshes scheduled configuration values so the app can apply the settings for the new time.
en.disableEffect: Scheduled feature settings may remain stale after a system time or date change until another configuration refresh occurs.

zh-CN.description: 系统时间或日期发生变化后，Appfigurate 会运行此 Receiver。它刷新计划配置值，让应用采用新时间对应的设置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，系统时间或日期变化时，计划功能设置可能无法及时更新，直到再次刷新配置。

en.description: The Trade Me Konfigure SDK opens this configuration screen when the app requests it; the screen lists registered settings and lets users search or change values.
en.disableEffect: Users can no longer open or edit the Konfigure settings panel; the app continues using its existing configuration.

zh-CN.description: Trade Me 的 Konfigure SDK 在应用打开配置面板时显示此页面；页面列出已注册的设置项，用户可以搜索或修改它们。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，用户无法打开或编辑 Konfigure 设置面板；应用仍会使用现有配置。

en.description: Credify's Android SDK can open this Activity for an offer-redemption web page; it displays the supplied address in an in-app browser and can return when the Credify consent page opens.
en.disableEffect: Offer-redemption links that use this screen cannot open or return from the consent step.

zh-CN.description: Credify Android SDK 可在打开优惠兑换网页时启动此 Activity；它会在应用内浏览器中显示指定页面，并可在 Credify 同意页面打开后返回。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此页面的优惠兑换链接将无法打开或完成同意步骤后返回。

en.description: Credify IdX opens this screen when an app starts VNPT identity verification; it collects the document and face-check results and sends them to Credify's KYC service.
en.disableEffect: Credify's VNPT identity-verification flow cannot finish.

zh-CN.description: 应用通过 Credify IdX 启动 VNPT 身份验证时会打开此页面；它收集证件和人脸核验结果并提交给 Credify 的 KYC 服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Credify 的 VNPT 身份验证流程将无法完成。

en.description: Credify IdX opens Facebook sign-in while creating a Credify account; after Facebook returns a sign-in token, the SDK submits the account-creation request.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot create a Credify account through Facebook.

zh-CN.description: 创建 Credify 账户时，Credify IdX 会打开 Facebook 登录；Facebook 返回登录凭据后，SDK 会提交账户创建请求。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 Facebook 创建 Credify 账户。

en.description: Credify IdX opens LinkedIn authorization while creating a Credify account; it uses the returned sign-in token to submit the account-creation request.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot create a Credify account through LinkedIn.

zh-CN.description: 创建 Credify 账户时，Credify IdX 会打开 LinkedIn 授权页面，并使用返回的登录凭据提交账户创建请求。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 LinkedIn 创建 Credify 账户。

en.description: Credify IdX opens this screen when a user chooses Facebook sign-in; it requests profile and email access and returns the sign-in result.
en.disableEffect: Facebook sign-in through Credify IdX will not work.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择 Facebook 登录时，Credify IdX 会打开此页面；它请求访问个人资料和邮箱，并返回登录结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Credify IdX 的 Facebook 登录将无法使用。

en.description: Credify IdX opens this screen to sign in through LinkedIn; it displays LinkedIn's authorization page in a WebView and returns the access token.
en.disableEffect: LinkedIn sign-in through Credify IdX will not work.

zh-CN.description: Credify IdX 通过此页面使用 LinkedIn 登录；页面在应用内显示 LinkedIn 授权页面，并返回访问令牌。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Credify IdX 的 LinkedIn 登录将无法使用。

en.description: Credify's Android SDK opens this Activity to show an offer selected for the user, including redemption or referral details, after the app requests an offer screen.
en.disableEffect: Credify offer details and the related in-app redemption flow will not open.

zh-CN.description: Credify Android SDK 会在应用请求显示优惠时启动此 Activity，向用户展示所选优惠及兑换或推荐相关内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Credify 优惠详情及相关的应用内兑换流程将无法打开。

en.description: Credify's Android SDK opens this screen with a web address to show service pages inside the app; it can also download files from the page.
en.disableEffect: Credify pages and downloads that use this screen will be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: Credify Android SDK 会在应用内打开此页面显示指定网页，也可以下载网页提供的文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此页面的 Credify 网页和文件下载将无法使用。

en.description: Credify's Android SDK opens this Activity when the app starts a VNPT identity check for a selected document type; it runs the check, uploads the returned document and liveness results, and sends the verification status back to the app.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot complete the VNPT identity verification required by the app.

zh-CN.description: Credify Android SDK 会在应用为所选证件启动 VNPT 身份核验时打开此 Activity；它会执行核验、上传证件识别和活体检测结果，并将核验状态返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法完成应用所需的 VNPT 身份核验。

en.description: Credify Android SDK opens this screen for a Passport or service-instance page when the app requests either page; the content appears inside the app.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open the Credify Passport or service-instance page.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求打开 Passport 或服务实例页面时，Credify Android SDK 会在此页面中显示相应内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开 Credify Passport 或服务实例页面。

en.description: Credify Android SDK opens this screen for a web address supplied by the app and displays it inside the app, with page navigation and file downloads.
en.disableEffect: Credify features that open pages through this in-app browser will be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: Credify Android SDK 会在此页面内显示应用提供的网址，并支持网页内导航和文件下载。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过此应用内浏览器打开网页的 Credify 功能将无法使用。

en.description: Pice's official payment SDK opens this account-activation flow with the supplied workflow; it guides the user through login and bank selection.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot activate a Pice account or connect a bank through this flow.

zh-CN.description: Pice 官方支付 SDK 会根据传入的流程打开账户激活页面，引导用户登录并选择银行。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此流程激活 Pice 账户或连接银行。

en.description: Pice's official payment SDK opens this screen when the app starts a payment flow; its layout has a payment summary and a payment-content area.
en.disableEffect: The Pice checkout screen cannot open, so payments through this SDK are unavailable.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动支付流程时，Pice 官方支付 SDK 会打开此页面；页面包含支付摘要和支付内容区域。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Pice 结账页面将无法打开，因此无法使用此 SDK 支付。

en.description: This Machbird file provider gives other apps temporary access to downloaded files in the app's cache, files, or external storage areas.
en.disableEffect: Other apps will not be able to open or install files that Machbird shares through this provider.

zh-CN.description: 此 Machbird 文件 Provider 会临时授权其他应用访问应用缓存、文件目录或外部存储中的下载文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 其他应用将无法打开或安装 Machbird 通过此 Provider 分享的文件。

en.description: The ABTO SIP library included with iRiS Guest VoIP uses this provider to access local internet-phone accounts, call history, filtering rules, and messages.
en.disableEffect: Internet-phone account and call data may no longer be read or saved, which can break calling features.

zh-CN.description: iRiS Guest VoIP 集成所带的 ABTO SIP 库会通过此内容提供程序存取本地网络电话账户、通话记录、过滤规则和消息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，网络电话账户和通话数据可能无法读取或保存，影响通话功能。

en.description: The app binds to this ABTO service included with iRiS Guest VoIP to start internet calling and handle voice or video calls, including answering and ending calls.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents the app from starting internet calls or controlling active calls.

zh-CN.description: 应用会连接 iRiS Guest VoIP 集成所带的 ABTO 服务，以启用网络电话并处理语音或视频通话，包括接听和挂断。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用无法启动网络电话或控制正在进行的通话。

en.description: ACRA’s crash reporter uses this provider to make attached files available when a crash report is sent.
en.disableEffect: Files attached to ACRA crash reports can no longer be opened by the report sender.

zh-CN.description: ACRA 在发送崩溃报告时使用此内容提供程序读取报告附件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，ACRA 将无法读取崩溃报告中的附件。

en.description: After a crash, ACRA uses this screen to show report options and let the user add details before sending the report.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot review or submit crash details through ACRA's dialog.

zh-CN.description: 发生崩溃后，ACRA 使用此界面显示报告选项，并让用户在发送前补充信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 ACRA 对话框查看或提交崩溃信息。

en.description: When a user taps an ACRA crash notification, this screen opens the report action and dismisses the notification.
en.disableEffect: Tapping an ACRA crash notification will no longer open its report actions through this screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击 ACRA 崩溃通知后，此界面会处理相应操作并关闭通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，点击 ACRA 崩溃通知将无法通过此界面打开报告操作。

en.description: When a user chooses send or discard on an ACRA crash notification, this receiver processes that choice for the saved report.
en.disableEffect: ACRA will not process send or discard choices from crash notifications, so queued reports can remain unsent.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择 ACRA 崩溃通知中的操作时，此接收器会处理发送或丢弃已保存报告等选项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: ACRA 将无法处理崩溃通知中的发送或丢弃选择，排队的报告可能无法发送。

en.description: After ACRA schedules recovery following a crash, this service reopens the app’s last screen.
en.disableEffect: The app will no longer reopen automatically after an ACRA recovery job; the user can start it manually.

zh-CN.description: ACRA 在崩溃后安排恢复时，此后台任务会重新打开应用上次显示的界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: ACRA 恢复任务运行后，应用将不再自动重新打开；用户仍可手动启动应用。

en.description: When Android runs a scheduled ACRA upload, this service sends queued crash reports in the background.
en.disableEffect: Queued ACRA crash reports will no longer be sent by this scheduled service.

zh-CN.description: Android 运行 ACRA 的定时上传任务时，此服务会在后台发送排队的崩溃报告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 排队的 ACRA 崩溃报告将不再由此定时服务发送。

en.description: When ACRA uses its older background service to send crash reports, this service sends the saved reports.
en.disableEffect: Crash reports that use ACRA's legacy sending path will no longer be sent.

zh-CN.description: ACRA 选择旧版发送流程时，会通过此旧版服务发送排队的崩溃报告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用 ACRA 旧版发送流程的崩溃报告将无法发送。

en.description: ACRA's crash-reporting library uses this job to send queued crash reports in the background.
en.disableEffect: Crash reports waiting to be sent through ACRA may not upload.

zh-CN.description: ACRA 崩溃报告库会使用此作业在后台发送等待处理的崩溃报告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 等待通过 ACRA 发送的崩溃报告可能无法上传。

en.description: ACRA 4 uses this background service to send saved, approved crash reports to the app’s configured reporting destinations.
en.disableEffect: Approved ACRA 4 crash reports will no longer be sent through the configured report destinations.

zh-CN.description: ACRA 4 通过此服务将已批准的崩溃报告发送到应用配置的报告接收端。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 已批准的 ACRA 4 崩溃报告将无法发送到应用配置的接收端。

en.description: When Google Play sends an install-referrer broadcast shortly after installation, this Machbird receiver forwards the campaign information for attribution.
en.disableEffect: Machbird will lose campaign attribution data handled by this receiver.

zh-CN.description: Google Play 在安装后发送安装来源广播时，此 Machbird Receiver 会转交其中的推广活动信息用于归因。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Machbird 将失去此 Receiver 处理的推广活动归因数据。

en.description: When Google Play sends an install-referrer broadcast, this Machbird receiver forwards eligible campaign information to the SDK's tracking system.
en.disableEffect: Machbird will lose campaign attribution data handled by this receiver.

zh-CN.description: Google Play 发送安装来源广播时，此 Machbird Receiver 会将符合条件的推广活动信息交给 SDK 的追踪系统。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Machbird 将失去此 Receiver 处理的推广活动归因数据。

en.description: At app startup, the AeroGear or Aerobase Android core SDK loads this provider to initialize its services and send app and device metrics when configured.
en.disableEffect: AeroGear or Aerobase services that depend on automatic initialization may fail to start.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，AeroGear 或 Aerobase Android 核心 SDK 会加载此提供程序来初始化服务，并在启用时发送应用和设备指标。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖自动初始化的 AeroGear 或 Aerobase 服务可能无法启动。

en.description: The AeroGear or Aerobase push SDK receives Firebase token-refresh events through this service and refreshes its push registration.
en.disableEffect: AeroGear or Aerobase push registration will not refresh when Firebase issues a new token.

zh-CN.description: Firebase 推送令牌更新时，AeroGear 或 Aerobase 推送 SDK 会通过此服务刷新推送注册信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Firebase 更新令牌后，AeroGear 或 Aerobase 的推送注册信息将无法刷新。

en.description: Firebase sends push messages to the AeroGear or Aerobase push SDK through this service; it forwards each message's data to the SDK's handlers.
en.disableEffect: AeroGear or Aerobase will no longer handle incoming push messages.

zh-CN.description: Firebase 会通过此服务将推送消息交给 AeroGear 或 Aerobase 推送 SDK；服务会把消息数据转交给 SDK 的处理程序。
zh-CN.disableEffect: AeroGear 或 Aerobase 将不再处理收到的推送消息。

en.description: When the AltBeacon Android Beacon Library receives a scan result, this background service turns it into nearby-beacon and region entry or exit updates for the app.
en.disableEffect: Apps using AltBeacon stop receiving beacon and monitored-region updates.

zh-CN.description: AltBeacon Android Beacon Library 收到扫描结果后，这个后台服务会将其转换为附近信标以及进入或离开监测区域的更新，并通知应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用 AltBeacon 的应用将无法再收到信标和监测区域变化。

en.description: When an app asks AltBeacon to watch or range Bluetooth beacon regions, this background service runs the scans and tracks matching regions.
en.disableEffect: The app loses AltBeacon beacon detection and monitored-region updates.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求 AltBeacon 监测蓝牙信标区域或测距时，这个后台服务会执行扫描并跟踪匹配的区域。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法使用 AltBeacon 检测信标或接收监测区域更新。

en.description: AltBeacon Android Beacon Library runs timed Bluetooth scans, processes nearby beacon readings, and schedules the next scan when beacon monitoring or ranging is active.
en.disableEffect: Beacon monitoring and proximity alerts that depend on background scans may stop or be delayed.

zh-CN.description: AltBeacon Android Beacon Library 会按计划扫描蓝牙信标、处理附近信标的数据，并在监测或测距功能启用时安排下一次扫描。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖后台扫描的信标监测和邻近提醒可能停止或延迟。

en.description: When the device restarts or Android reports a background Bluetooth scan, AltBeacon checks whether the app is monitoring beacons and resumes or processes that scan.
en.disableEffect: Beacon detection may not resume after a restart or background scan, so app features that depend on nearby beacons can fail.

zh-CN.description: 设备重启或 Android 报告后台蓝牙扫描时，AltBeacon 会检查应用是否正在监测信标，并恢复检测或处理扫描结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 重启后或系统报告后台扫描时，信标检测可能无法恢复，依赖附近信标的应用功能可能失效。

en.description: AltBeacon Android Beacon Library periodically checks that Bluetooth scanning and beacon broadcasting work, and may notify the user when a scan failure is detected.
en.disableEffect: These checks and Bluetooth failure alerts will stop, so apps relying on beacon scanning may miss a problem the checks would have found.

zh-CN.description: AltBeacon Android Beacon Library 会定期检查蓝牙扫描和信标广播是否正常；发现扫描故障时可能提醒用户。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 这些检查和蓝牙故障提醒将停止，使用信标的应用可能无法及时发现扫描问题。

en.description: AmneziaWG's Android VPN service establishes and maintains the VPN tunnel when a user connects, and shuts the tunnel down when the service ends.
en.disableEffect: The AmneziaWG VPN connection may fail to start or stop working.

zh-CN.description: 用户连接 VPN 时，AmneziaWG 的 Android VPN 服务会建立并维持隧道，并在服务结束时关闭隧道。
zh-CN.disableEffect: AmneziaWG VPN 可能无法启动或会停止工作。

en.description: AmneziaWG's older Go backend uses this Android VPN service for user connections and Android's Always-on VPN starts; it closes the tunnel when the service stops.
en.disableEffect: VPN connections using this AmneziaWG backend may fail or be interrupted.

zh-CN.description: AmneziaWG 较早的 Go 后端会通过此 Android VPN 服务建立连接，Android 的始终开启 VPN 也会启动它；服务停止时会关闭隧道。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此 AmneziaWG 后端的 VPN 连接可能失败或中断。

en.description: When Umeng Push receives data over its network connection, this service saves the message and passes it to the SDK's message and notification handling.
en.disableEffect: Push messages arriving through this service will not be saved or passed on for delivery.

zh-CN.description: 友盟推送通过网络连接收到数据时，此服务会保存消息并交给 SDK 的消息和通知处理流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过此服务到达的推送消息将无法保存或继续投递。

en.description: When Firebase delivers a push message or refreshes the app's registration token, this Umeng adapter forwards the message to Umeng Push and reports the token.
en.disableEffect: Firebase-delivered messages and refreshed tokens will no longer reach Umeng Push; the app's other features continue to work.

zh-CN.description: Firebase 向应用发送推送或更新注册令牌时，此友盟适配服务会将消息转交给友盟推送处理流程，并上报令牌。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Firebase 发送的消息和更新后的令牌将无法交给友盟推送；应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: When Honor Push delivers a message or token, this Umeng adapter forwards the message to Agoo and registers the token for Umeng Push.
en.disableEffect: Honor Push messages and tokens will no longer reach Umeng Agoo; the app's other features continue to work.

zh-CN.description: 荣耀推送发送消息或令牌时，此友盟适配服务会将消息交给 Agoo，并为友盟推送注册令牌。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，荣耀推送消息和令牌将无法交给友盟 Agoo；应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: Huawei Push sends registration-token and message broadcasts here; Umeng forwards the token and passes messages to its push handler.
en.disableEffect: Push messages from the Huawei channel will not reach Umeng's handler.

zh-CN.description: 华为推送会将注册令牌和消息广播发送到此接收器；友盟会转交令牌并将消息交给推送处理程序。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 来自华为通道的推送消息将无法交给友盟处理。

en.description: When Huawei Push delivers an app message or token, this Umeng service passes the message to Agoo and registers the token for Umeng Push.
en.disableEffect: Huawei Push messages and tokens will no longer reach Umeng Agoo; the app's other features continue to work.

zh-CN.description: 华为推送发送应用消息或令牌时，此友盟服务会将消息交给 Agoo，并为友盟推送注册令牌。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，华为推送消息和令牌将无法交给友盟 Agoo；应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: When Huawei Push reports an app token or delivers a push message, this Umeng Receiver forwards the token or message to Agoo for processing.
en.disableEffect: Huawei Push registration and message handling through Umeng Agoo will stop; the app's other features continue to work.

zh-CN.description: 华为推送报告应用令牌或发送推送消息时，此友盟 Receiver 会将令牌或消息交给 Agoo 处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，经友盟 Agoo 接入的华为推送注册和消息处理将停止；应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: When Huawei Push delivers an app message or token, this Umeng service passes the message to Agoo and registers the token for Umeng Push.
en.disableEffect: Huawei Push messages and tokens will no longer reach Umeng Agoo; the app's other features continue to work.

zh-CN.description: 华为推送发送应用消息或令牌时，此友盟服务会将消息交给 Agoo，并为友盟推送注册令牌。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，华为推送消息和令牌将无法交给友盟 Agoo；应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: When Meizu Push reports a registration token or incoming message, this Receiver sends the token or message to Umeng Agoo.
en.disableEffect: Meizu Push messages and registration tokens will no longer reach Umeng Agoo; the app's other features continue to work.

zh-CN.description: 魅族推送报告注册令牌或收到消息时，此 Receiver 会将令牌或消息交给友盟 Agoo。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，魅族推送消息和注册令牌将无法交给友盟 Agoo；应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: When Vivo's push SDK reports a registration ID, this Receiver stores it with Umeng Push so the app can use Vivo as a notification channel.
en.disableEffect: The app will no longer register its Vivo push token with Umeng, so notifications through that channel may stop.

zh-CN.description: Vivo 推送 SDK 返回注册 ID 时，此 Receiver 会将 ID 保存到友盟推送，以便应用使用 Vivo 推送通道。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用将无法向友盟注册 Vivo 推送令牌，该通道的通知可能无法送达。

en.description: Xiaomi Mi Push sends registration results and pass-through messages here; Umeng reports the token and forwards message content to its push handler.
en.disableEffect: Push messages sent through Xiaomi's channel will not be delivered through Umeng.

zh-CN.description: 小米推送会将注册结果和透传消息发送到此接收器；友盟会报告令牌并将消息内容交给推送处理程序。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过小米通道发送的推送消息将无法经由友盟投递。

en.description: The AndroidAudioPlugin Web UI SDK serves a ZIP of web-based plug-in screens when an audio plug-in requests its content link, using the bundled or default interface.
en.disableEffect: Web-based audio plug-in screens may not load.

zh-CN.description: 音频插件请求内容链接时，AndroidAudioPlugin Web UI SDK 会提供包含插件网页界面的 ZIP 文件，使用内置界面或默认界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 基于网页的音频插件界面可能无法加载。

en.description: Apache Cordova Camera uses this provider to give the camera app temporary access to the photo file when the user takes a picture.
en.disableEffect: Taking a photo through the app’s Cordova camera feature can fail because the camera cannot write the image file.

zh-CN.description: 用户拍照时，Apache Cordova Camera 会通过此提供程序临时允许相机应用写入照片文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 相机应用无法写入照片文件，通过应用的 Cordova 相机功能拍照可能失败。

en.description: When Android reports a connectivity change, the Chat21 Firebase Chat SDK checks whether Wi-Fi or mobile data is connected. In this version, its responses only record the network state in the log.
en.disableEffect: Chat21 would stop checking and logging network changes through this receiver; the analyzed code does not use it to change chat behavior.

zh-CN.description: Android 通知网络连接发生变化时，Chat21 Firebase 聊天 SDK 会检查 Wi-Fi 或移动数据是否已连接。此版本只会在日志中记录网络状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Chat21 将不再通过此接收器检查和记录网络变化；所分析的代码没有用它来改变聊天功能。

en.description: When Android sends a normal shutdown event, the Chat21 Firebase Chat SDK removes this device from the user's online-presence list and records the last-online time.
en.disableEffect: Chat21 would miss this explicit shutdown cleanup, so this device might remain listed as online until its connection is detected as lost.

zh-CN.description: Android 发出正常关机事件时，Chat21 Firebase 聊天 SDK 会从用户的在线状态列表中移除此设备，并记录最后在线时间。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Chat21 将无法执行这项关机清理；系统检测到连接断开前，此设备可能仍显示为在线。

en.description: When Firebase issues a new messaging token, the Chat21 Firebase Chat SDK saves it to the signed-in user's account so chat notifications can reach this device.
en.disableEffect: After Firebase changes the token, this device might stop receiving Chat21 message notifications until the new token is registered.

zh-CN.description: Firebase 生成新的消息令牌时，Chat21 Firebase 聊天 SDK 会将其保存到已登录用户的账户，以便聊天通知送达此设备。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Firebase 更换令牌后，在新令牌完成登记前，此设备可能无法收到 Chat21 消息通知。

en.description: When Firebase delivers a Chat21 message, the SDK shows a notification for direct or group chats unless that conversation is already open. Selecting the notification opens the conversation.
en.disableEffect: New Chat21 messages would no longer create these notifications on the device.

zh-CN.description: Firebase 送达 Chat21 消息时，如果对应聊天尚未打开，SDK 会为单聊或群聊显示通知。点击通知即可打开相应聊天。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 设备将不再为新的 Chat21 消息显示这些通知。

en.description: During Chat21 group creation or while editing a group, this screen lets users search contacts and choose people to add to the group.
en.disableEffect: Users could not choose or add participants to Chat21 group conversations through this flow.

zh-CN.description: 创建 Chat21 群组或编辑群组时，此页面允许用户搜索联系人并选择要加入群组的人。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此流程选择或添加 Chat21 群聊成员。

en.description: When a user opens a Chat21 group's details, this screen shows its name, owner, creation time, and members. The group owner can add people, and selecting a member opens that member's group options.
en.disableEffect: Users would lose the group details and member-management screen, including the group owner's add-member option.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 Chat21 群组详情时，此页面会显示群组名称、群主、创建时间和成员。群主可以添加成员，选择成员还可打开相应的群组操作选项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法查看群组详情或管理成员，也无法使用群主的添加成员选项。

en.description: When users open their Chat21 group list, this screen loads their groups from the chat service. Selecting a group opens its conversation.
en.disableEffect: Users could not browse their Chat21 groups or open a group conversation from this list.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 Chat21 群组列表时，此页面会从聊天服务加载其群组。选择群组即可打开相应的聊天。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法浏览 Chat21 群组列表，也无法从列表打开群聊。

en.description: During Chat21 group creation, this screen collects a group name and creates the group with contacts selected in the previous step.
en.disableEffect: Users could not create a Chat21 group through the SDK's group-creation flow.

zh-CN.description: 创建 Chat21 群组时，此页面会收集群组名称，并使用上一步选定的联系人创建群组。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 SDK 的群组创建流程创建 Chat21 群组。

en.description: When the Chat21 interface opens its contact list, this screen displays searchable chat contacts. Selecting a contact starts a direct conversation.
en.disableEffect: Users could not search this contact list or start a direct conversation by selecting a contact.

zh-CN.description: Chat21 界面打开联系人列表时，此页面会显示可搜索的聊天联系人。选择联系人即可开始单聊。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法搜索此联系人列表，也无法通过选择联系人开始单聊。

en.description: The Chat21 Firebase Chat SDK opens this screen to show active conversations. Selecting a conversation opens its message thread.
en.disableEffect: Users could not open the active-conversation list to return to an existing chat.

zh-CN.description: Chat21 Firebase 聊天 SDK 会打开此页面显示活跃会话。选择会话即可打开消息聊天页。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开活跃会话列表并返回已有聊天。

en.description: When users open Chat21 sign-in, this screen accepts an email address and password for Firebase authentication and offers a way to sign up.
en.disableEffect: Users could not sign in through this Chat21 Firebase login screen or reach its sign-up option.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 Chat21 登录页面时，此页面会接收电子邮箱和密码以进行 Firebase 身份验证，并提供注册入口。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此 Chat21 Firebase 登录页面登录或进入注册流程。

en.description: When users choose Chat21 sign-up, this screen checks their account details, creates a Firebase account, and stores their chat profile.
en.disableEffect: New users could not create a Chat21 account or chat profile through this sign-up screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择注册 Chat21 账户时，此页面会检查账户信息、创建 Firebase 账户并保存聊天资料。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 新用户将无法通过此注册页面创建 Chat21 账户或聊天资料。

en.description: When someone opens an image from a Chat21 message, this screen loads the image and shows the message sender, text, and time.
en.disableEffect: Users could no longer view images from Chat21 messages in the full image viewer.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 Chat21 消息中的图片时，此页面会加载图片并显示消息发送者、文字和时间。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在完整图片查看器中查看 Chat21 消息里的图片。

en.description: When a Chat21 direct or group conversation opens, this screen loads its messages and supports sending text and attached images or files.
en.disableEffect: Users could not open this Chat21 message screen to read or send direct and group messages.

zh-CN.description: 打开 Chat21 单聊或群聊时，此页面会加载消息，并支持发送文字、图片或文件附件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开此 Chat21 聊天页面，也无法阅读或发送单聊和群聊消息。

en.description: When a user opens a Chat21 contact's profile, this screen shows the contact's details and current or last-seen status from the chat service.
en.disableEffect: Users would lose the Chat21 contact profile and its online or last-seen information.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 Chat21 联系人资料时，此页面会显示联系人信息以及聊天服务提供的在线或最后在线状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法查看 Chat21 联系人资料及其在线或最后在线信息。

en.description: CustomTabsHelper, Zhang Hai’s Android Custom Tabs library, supplies a keep-alive connection while an app opens a page in a Custom Tab.
en.disableEffect: A Custom Tab will no longer hold this helper connection, so Android may reclaim the app while its browser page is open.

zh-CN.description: Zhang Hai 的 CustomTabsHelper 库会在应用通过 Custom Tab 打开网页时提供保活连接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Custom Tab 打开网页时将失去这条保活连接，Android 可能在网页打开期间回收应用进程。

en.description: When the app requests cloud attribute modules, this Machbird service registers the named modules for use by the SDK's cloud features.
en.disableEffect: Machbird cloud features that depend on these registered attributes will not receive them.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求云属性模块时，此 Machbird Service 会注册指定模块，供 SDK 的云功能使用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖这些已注册属性的 Machbird 云功能将无法获取它们。

en.description: When a Cobalt-powered app opens an in-app page, the Cobaltians Cobalt hybrid framework displays it inside the Android app and handles page navigation, menus, and back actions.
en.disableEffect: Cobalt-powered app pages that use this screen could not open, interrupting those app screens and their navigation.

zh-CN.description: 使用 Cobalt 的应用打开内部页面时，Cobaltians Cobalt 混合应用框架会在 Android 应用中显示该页面，并处理页面导航、菜单和返回操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此页面的 Cobalt 应用界面将无法打开，其页面功能和导航也会中断。

en.description: The TakePhoto image selection library opens this screen when the app asks users to choose pictures. It lists device photo albums and opens the selected album.
en.disableEffect: The app can no longer use this library to open the photo album chooser.

zh-CN.description: 应用通过 TakePhoto 图片选择库请求选取照片时，会打开此页面。页面列出设备相册，并进入用户选中的相册。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用无法通过此库打开照片相册选择器。

en.description: After an album is chosen, the TakePhoto image selection library shows its photos here and returns the images selected by the user to the calling app.
en.disableEffect: Photo selection through the TakePhoto library stops working.

zh-CN.description: 用户选定相册后，TakePhoto 图片选择库会在此页面显示其中的照片，并将用户选中的图片返回给调用应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用无法通过 TakePhoto 库选择照片。

en.description: TakePhoto uses this provider during camera and crop handoffs to create shareable links for temporary image files, so the camera or crop app can read or write them.
en.disableEffect: TakePhoto photo-capture and crop flows may fail when they cannot pass the image file to the camera or crop app.

zh-CN.description: TakePhoto 在相机和裁剪流程交接图片时使用此提供器，为临时图片文件创建可分享的链接，让相机或裁剪应用能够读取或写入文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 相机或裁剪应用无法接收图片文件时，TakePhoto 的拍照和裁剪流程可能失败。

en.description: XLibrary provides a shared Activity for list screens with a scrollable list, pull-to-refresh, and load-more behavior. Apps display their own content on pages built around it.
en.disableEffect: The library does not use this as a page by itself, so disabling it alone does not remove the app's separately opened list screens.

zh-CN.description: XLibrary 为列表页面提供共享 Activity，支持滚动列表、下拉刷新和加载更多；应用页面可用它展示各自的内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: XLibrary 不会把它单独作为页面打开，因此仅禁用此组件不会移除应用单独打开的列表页面。

en.description: The imchina X5WebView library opens this temporary screen when an embedded page requests a file, photo, video, or permission. It opens Android's chooser or camera and returns the user's selection.
en.disableEffect: File uploads, camera or video capture, and permission requests from embedded X5WebView pages may fail.

zh-CN.description: imchina 的 X5WebView 库会在内嵌网页请求文件、照片、视频或权限时打开此临时页面，并调用 Android 的选择器或相机后返回用户的选择。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 内嵌 X5WebView 页面中的文件上传、拍照、录像或权限请求可能失败。

en.description: The imchina X5WebView library uses this provider to pass browser-created files and captured photos or videos to Android's chooser and embedded pages.
en.disableEffect: Attaching a captured photo or video, or opening a file created by an embedded page, may fail.

zh-CN.description: imchina 的 X5WebView 库通过此提供程序将浏览器生成的文件以及拍摄的照片或视频交给 Android 选择器和内嵌网页。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 内嵌网页可能无法附加拍摄的照片或视频，也可能无法打开网页生成的文件。

en.description: When Android starts the device or replaces the host app after an update, the DP3T Android exposure-tracing SDK restarts background synchronization and broadcasts updated tracing status if tracing was initialized and enabled.
en.disableEffect: DP3T would not restart its sync worker on boot or after an app update, so exposure status might stop refreshing in the background.

zh-CN.description: 设备启动或应用更新后被替换时，如果 DP3T Android 暴露追踪 SDK 已初始化并启用，此接收器会重新启动后台同步并广播最新追踪状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: DP3T 将不会在设备启动或应用更新后重新启动同步任务，暴露状态可能因此无法在后台继续更新。

en.description: When the DP3T SDK reports a tracing error, this receiver updates the status notification, showing it when attention is needed and clearing it when no reported errors remain.
en.disableEffect: Users might stop seeing DP3T tracing-error notices and would not know when synchronization needs attention.

zh-CN.description: DP3T SDK 报告追踪错误时，此接收器会更新状态通知：需要处理时显示通知，没有待报告错误时清除通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户可能不再看到 DP3T 追踪错误提醒，也就无法得知何时需要处理同步问题。

en.description: The DP3T Android exposure-tracing SDK listens for Google Play services exposure results. When an exposure-state update arrives, it starts background work to match the reported exposures.
en.disableEffect: DP3T would no longer process these exposure updates, so exposure results could be missed or stop refreshing.

zh-CN.description: DP3T Android 暴露追踪 SDK 会监听 Google Play 服务发来的暴露结果。收到暴露状态更新时，它会启动后台任务来匹配报告的暴露记录。
zh-CN.disableEffect: DP3T 将无法继续处理这些暴露状态更新，暴露结果可能遗漏或无法刷新。

en.description: CommonLibrary starts this provider with the app to prepare shared app resources used by its screens, image tools and video helpers.
en.disableEffect: Without it, CommonLibrary helpers that read app resources or display settings lack their required context and can fail.

zh-CN.description: CommonLibrary 会随应用启动此 Provider，为其页面、图片工具和视频辅助功能准备共享的应用资源。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，CommonLibrary 中读取应用资源或屏幕设置的辅助功能会缺少所需上下文并可能失效。

en.description: CommonLibrary uses this Activity to display a set of images at a chosen starting position in a swipeable, zoomable gallery.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it removes the app's in-library image gallery screen.

zh-CN.description: CommonLibrary 使用此 Activity 从指定位置开始，在可滑动和缩放的图库中显示一组图片。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用内由该库提供的图片浏览页面将无法打开。

en.description: Dynckathline IJKPlayerLib declares this receiver without an automatic manifest filter; a video screen can register it for Android connectivity changes, and it reports whether Wi-Fi or mobile data is connected and available.
en.disableEffect: The manifest declaration receives no automatic connectivity broadcasts, so disabling it does not remove normal playback or current-network checks.

zh-CN.description: Dynckathline IJKPlayerLib 声明了此 Receiver，但没有配置自动接收广播的清单过滤条件；视频页面可注册它来接收 Android 网络变化，并获知 Wi-Fi 或移动数据是否已连接且可用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 此清单声明不会自动接收网络广播，因此禁用它不会移除正常播放或当前网络状态检查。

en.description: Dynckathline ZXingLibrary opens this screen from the scanner’s settings flow so users can choose barcode types and adjust scan sound, vibration, focus, and camera behavior.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot change these scanner options through this screen, but scanning continues with the existing or default settings.

zh-CN.description: 用户从扫描器的设置入口打开 Dynckathline ZXingLibrary 的此界面，可选择条码类型并调整提示音、振动、对焦和相机行为。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此界面更改扫描器选项，但扫描仍会使用现有或默认设置。

en.description: When an app using the Eclipse ECSP Vehicle Connect SDK requests sign-in, this Activity processes the authorization result, saves returned access credentials, and reports success or failure to the calling flow.
en.disableEffect: The vehicle sign-in flow could not complete, leaving the app without the updated authorization needed for vehicle services.

zh-CN.description: 使用 Eclipse ECSP Vehicle Connect SDK 的应用请求登录时，此 Activity 会处理授权结果、保存返回的访问凭据，并向调用流程报告成功或失败。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 车辆登录流程将无法完成，应用也无法获得车辆服务所需的最新授权。

en.description: Eclipse Paho's Android MQTT service starts or binds when an app uses its MQTT client. It maintains broker connections, sends and receives topic messages, and reconnects clients when network access returns.
en.disableEffect: Apps that rely on MQTT through this service may stop sending or receiving updates, which can break features that depend on those messages.

zh-CN.description: 应用使用 Eclipse Paho 的 MQTT 客户端时，会启动或绑定此 Android 服务。它维护消息服务器连接、收发主题消息，并在网络恢复后重新连接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此服务的应用可能无法收发 MQTT 消息，依赖这些消息的功能也可能失效。

en.description: The FTC SDK starts this background service with the Robot Controller app to relaunch the controller after a crash when automatic restart is enabled.
en.disableEffect: The Robot Controller will no longer be automatically relaunched after a crash.

zh-CN.description: FTC SDK 会随 Robot Controller 启动此后台服务；启用自动重启时，它会在应用崩溃后重新打开控制器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Robot Controller 在崩溃后将不会自动重新打开。

en.description: The FTC SDK's Program & Manage screen opens the Robot Controller's browser-based programming and file-management page, where you can work with FTC projects and transfer files.
en.disableEffect: You can no longer open the Robot Controller's Program & Manage page in the FTC app.

zh-CN.description: FTC SDK 的“Program & Manage”页面会打开 Robot Controller 中基于浏览器的编程和文件管理页面，供你使用 FTC 项目和传输文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后将无法在 FTC 应用中打开 Robot Controller 的“Program & Manage”页面。

en.description: The FTC SDK starts this service on the Robot Controller to provide build support for OnBot Java projects used from the browser-based programming page.
en.disableEffect: You can no longer build OnBot Java projects from the Robot Controller's browser page.

zh-CN.description: FTC SDK 会在 Robot Controller 上启动此服务，为浏览器编程页面中的 OnBot Java 项目提供构建支持。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后将无法在 Robot Controller 的浏览器页面中构建 OnBot Java 项目。

en.description: The FTC SDK starts this service on the Robot Controller and Driver Station to keep desktop file-transfer folders in sync with files on the phones.
en.disableEffect: The FTC desktop file-transfer folders will no longer stay synchronized with the phones.

zh-CN.description: FTC SDK 会在 Robot Controller 和 Driver Station 上启动此服务，使电脑端文件传输目录与手机上的文件保持同步。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，FTC 的电脑端文件传输目录将不再与手机保持同步。

en.description: When the Control Hub updater sends a result broadcast, the FTC SDK receives it and forwards the update status to the Robot Controller web page or shows it to the user.
en.disableEffect: The FTC interface will no longer display Control Hub update results.

zh-CN.description: Control Hub 更新程序发送结果广播时，FTC SDK 会接收结果并将更新状态转发到 Robot Controller 网页或显示给用户。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，FTC 界面将不再显示 Control Hub 更新结果。

en.description: The FTC SDK's Driver Station inspection screen shows checks for the phone's setup, including Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, location, Android version, and battery status.
en.disableEffect: You can no longer check Driver Station phone readiness in the FTC app.

zh-CN.description: FTC SDK 的 Driver Station 检查页面会显示手机状态检查，包括 Wi-Fi、蓝牙、位置信息、Android 版本和电量。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后将无法在 FTC 应用中检查 Driver Station 手机的准备状态。

en.description: The FTC SDK's Robot Controller inspection screen checks controller and robot status; when opened from a connected Driver Station, it requests the controller's report and prepares the inspection QR code.
en.disableEffect: You can no longer inspect Robot Controller status or use its FTC inspection QR workflow.

zh-CN.description: FTC SDK 的 Robot Controller 检查页面会检查控制器和机器人状态；从已连接的 Driver Station 打开时，它会请求控制器报告并生成检查二维码。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后将无法查看 Robot Controller 状态或使用 FTC 检查二维码流程。

en.description: ForgeRock's Android authentication SDK starts this Provider automatically when the app process opens. It keeps the app context and tracks the active screen so sign-in, device binding, and other interactive authentication steps can use the right Activity.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, ForgeRock authentication steps that need the app context or current Activity can fail, including device binding and interactive sign-in.

zh-CN.description: ForgeRock Android 身份验证 SDK 会在应用进程启动时自动运行此 Provider。它保存应用上下文并跟踪当前界面，供登录、设备绑定等交互式认证步骤使用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，ForgeRock 在需要应用上下文或当前 Activity 的认证步骤可能无法完成，包括设备绑定和交互式登录。

en.description: ForgeRock's PingOne Protect integration starts this Provider with the app and registers the SDK's initialization and risk-evaluation callbacks.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, those callbacks are not registered and the app's PingOne Protect risk checks do not run.

zh-CN.description: ForgeRock 的 PingOne Protect 集成会在应用启动时运行此 Provider，并注册 SDK 的初始化和风险评估回调。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，这些回调不会注册，应用中的 PingOne Protect 风险检查也无法运行。

en.description: The ForgeRock Authentication SDK opens this Activity when an app starts its built-in sign-in flow. It displays the SDK login form and returns the success or error result to the app.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, the app cannot complete login through ForgeRock's built-in sign-in screen.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动 ForgeRock 内置登录流程时，会打开此 Activity。它显示 SDK 的登录表单，并把成功或错误结果返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用无法通过 ForgeRock 内置登录界面完成登录。

en.description: The ForgeRock Authentication SDK opens this Activity when the app starts its registration flow. It displays the SDK registration form and reports whether registration finished successfully.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, users cannot complete registration through the ForgeRock form.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动 ForgeRock 注册流程时，会打开此 Activity。它显示 SDK 的注册表单，并向应用返回注册是否成功。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过 ForgeRock 表单完成注册。

en.description: The Cling Android UPnP library starts its device-network engine when this service is created and exposes a device registry and control point to apps that bind it. Apps use these to find and control compatible UPnP or DLNA devices.
en.disableEffect: Apps that rely on Cling to discover or control local UPnP and DLNA devices lose that device-connection feature.

zh-CN.description: Cling Android UPnP 库会在此服务创建时启动设备网络服务，并向绑定它的应用提供设备列表和控制入口，供应用查找和控制兼容的 UPnP 或 DLNA 设备。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖 Cling 查找或控制本地 UPnP、DLNA 设备的应用将失去相应连接功能。

en.description: When a user selects the edit command for a bookmark, Loopeer Reader opens a simple text-entry screen with OK and Cancel buttons.
en.disableEffect: The bookmark edit command will no longer open its text-entry screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户在书签菜单中选择编辑时，Loopeer Reader 会打开一个带有“确定”和“取消”按钮的简易文本输入页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 书签菜单中的编辑操作将无法打开文本输入页面。

en.description: Opened from the reader's bookmark controls, Loopeer Reader lists bookmarks for the current book and all books, supports searching, and lets users jump to or remove a bookmark.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to browse or search saved bookmarks, or jump to a bookmarked passage from this screen.

zh-CN.description: 从阅读器书签入口打开后，Loopeer Reader 会列出当前书籍和全部书籍的书签，支持搜索、跳转和删除书签。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此页面浏览或搜索书签，也不能跳转到已标记的位置。

en.description: When a cancel-menu request arrives, Loopeer Reader shows available return actions and sends the chosen action back to the reader.
en.disableEffect: The reader will not be able to show this cancel menu or return the selected action.

zh-CN.description: 收到显示取消菜单的请求时，Loopeer Reader 会列出可返回的操作，并把所选操作交还给阅读器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 阅读器将无法显示此取消菜单或接收所选操作。

en.description: When a user opens a supported book or another app sends a book-opening request, Loopeer Reader displays the book and handles reading, search, and reader navigation.
en.disableEffect: Books opened through Loopeer Reader will no longer reach its reading screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开受支持的书籍或其他应用发送阅读请求时，Loopeer Reader 会显示书籍并提供阅读、搜索和导航操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过 Loopeer Reader 打开的书籍将无法进入阅读页面。

en.description: When users open Loopeer Reader's plugin installer, it lists missing optional plugins and offers links to get them from the app store.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot install optional plugins here, so formats or add-ons provided by those plugins may be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 Loopeer Reader 的插件安装页面时，它会列出尚未安装的可选插件，并提供前往应用商店安装的入口。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法通过此页安装可选插件，因此插件提供的格式或附加功能可能无法使用。

en.description: When users open a book's contents, Loopeer Reader lists chapter headings, lets users expand or collapse sections, and jumps to the selected section.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open the chapter list or jump to a section from this screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开书籍目录时，Loopeer Reader 会列出章节标题，支持展开或收起目录，并跳转到选中的章节。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法从此页面打开章节列表或跳转到指定章节。

en.description: When another app connects to the Loopeer Reader API, the SDK provides book details, current page information, reading options, and available reader actions.
en.disableEffect: Apps that use the Loopeer Reader API can no longer query or change reader data and options through it.

zh-CN.description: 其他应用连接到 Loopeer Reader 接口后，该 SDK 会提供书籍详情、当前页信息、阅读选项和可用的阅读器操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用 Loopeer Reader 接口的应用将无法通过它读取或更改阅读器数据与选项。

en.description: When Loopeer Reader needs saved settings, this service loads and saves fonts, colors, layout, and other options.
en.disableEffect: Saved reader preferences may fail to load or save, affecting fonts, colors, layout, and other settings.

zh-CN.description: Loopeer Reader 需要读取或保存设置时，会通过此服务处理字体、颜色、布局和其他选项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 已保存的阅读设置可能无法读取或保存，字体、颜色、布局等设置会受影响。

en.description: When Loopeer Reader opens its crash screen, it displays a message that required reading support is missing and an OK button to close it.
en.disableEffect: After a crash, users may see the reader's general report screen instead of its missing-library message.

zh-CN.description: Loopeer Reader 打开崩溃提示页面时，会显示所需阅读支持缺失的信息，并提供“确定”按钮关闭提示。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 发生崩溃后，用户可能会看到通用错误报告页，而不是缺少阅读支持的提示。

en.description: When Loopeer Reader opens a book-error screen, it shows the supplied error text and lets users email an issue report.
en.disableEffect: Book-reading errors may lose their message and email-report screen, and the error flow may fail when it tries to open it.

zh-CN.description: Loopeer Reader 打开书籍错误页面时，会显示错误内容，并允许用户通过电子邮件发送问题报告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 书籍读取错误可能无法显示错误内容和邮件报告页面，尝试打开该页面时错误处理也可能失败。

en.description: Loopeer Reader starts this service with its reading screen to stream videos embedded in books through a local connection, including support for seeking.
en.disableEffect: Embedded book videos will not be served to the player, so playback and seeking can fail.

zh-CN.description: Loopeer Reader 打开阅读页面时会启动此服务，通过本地连接传输书籍中嵌入的视频，并支持拖动播放进度。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 播放器将无法通过此服务读取书籍中的视频，播放或拖动进度可能失效。

en.description: When the reader opens a book image in its separate viewer, Loopeer Reader displays it full-screen and lets users zoom and drag it.
en.disableEffect: Book images will not open in the separate full-screen viewer or support its zoom and pan controls.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Loopeer Reader 的独立查看器中打开书籍图片时，可以全屏查看、缩放并拖动图片。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 书籍图片将无法在独立的全屏查看器中打开，也无法使用其中的缩放和拖动操作。

en.description: When the user asks for book information, Loopeer Reader shows the cover and details such as title, authors, series, tags, language, and file information.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open a book's cover and metadata screen from the reader or library.

zh-CN.description: 用户查看书籍信息时，Loopeer Reader 会显示封面、书名、作者、丛书、标签、语言和文件详情。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法从阅读器或书库打开书籍封面和详细信息页面。

en.description: When the user opens its library, Loopeer Reader browses indexed books and categories, supports search, and opens book details or a selected book.
en.disableEffect: The in-app library, including browsing and search, will not be available.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 Loopeer Reader 书库后，可以浏览已索引的书籍和分类、搜索书籍，并打开详情或开始阅读。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用内书库将无法使用，包括浏览和搜索书籍。

en.description: When Android sends a library search request, Loopeer Reader forwards the search text to its library and then closes this screen.
en.disableEffect: Library search requests will not reach the results screen.

zh-CN.description: Android 发送书库搜索请求时，Loopeer Reader 会把搜索文字转交给书库页面，然后关闭当前页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 书库搜索请求将无法转到结果页面。

en.description: Loopeer Reader uses this background service to index book folders, watch for file changes, and store its library, reading progress, bookmarks, and highlighting styles.
en.disableEffect: The reader may fail to list books or load and save reading progress, bookmarks, and highlight styles.

zh-CN.description: Loopeer Reader 用此后台服务扫描书籍目录、监视文件变化，并保存书库、阅读进度、书签和高亮样式。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 阅读器可能无法列出书籍，或读取和保存阅读进度、书签及高亮样式。

en.description: When the user edits a book's information, Loopeer Reader lets them change its title, authors, tags, language, and text encoding.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot change a book's title, authors, tags, language, or encoding through the reader.

zh-CN.description: 用户编辑书籍信息时，Loopeer Reader 可修改书名、作者、标签、语言和文本编码。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过阅读器修改书名、作者、标签、语言或文本编码。

en.description: When reader preferences are opened, Loopeer Reader provides controls for language, display, text, scrolling, dictionaries, image handling, and other reading options.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open the reader's preferences to configure its display and reading behavior.

zh-CN.description: 打开阅读器偏好设置后，Loopeer Reader 会显示语言、外观、文字、翻页、词典、图片等阅读选项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开阅读器偏好设置来调整显示与阅读行为。

en.description: When the user edits a saved highlight style, Loopeer Reader lets them change its name, visibility, and background color.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot edit the names or backgrounds of saved highlighting styles.

zh-CN.description: 用户编辑已保存的高亮样式时，Loopeer Reader 可修改样式名称、显示状态和背景颜色。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法编辑已保存高亮样式的名称或背景颜色。
