en.description: When a user assigns or changes a highlight style for a bookmark, Loopeer Reader lists saved styles and applies the selection; the screen also offers deleting the bookmark.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot choose or edit highlight styles for bookmarks from this screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户为书签指定或更改高亮样式时，Loopeer Reader 会列出已保存的样式并应用所选样式；页面还可删除该书签。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法通过此页面为书签选择或编辑高亮样式。

en.description: When editing a book's details, Loopeer Reader opens this screen to add, rename, or remove authors from the book's list.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot edit a book's author list.

zh-CN.description: 编辑书籍详情时，Loopeer Reader 会打开此页面以添加、重命名或删除作者。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法编辑书籍的作者列表。

en.description: When editing a book's details, Loopeer Reader opens this screen to add, rename, or remove tags from the book's list.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot edit a book's tags.

zh-CN.description: 编辑书籍详情时，Loopeer Reader 会打开此页面以添加、重命名或删除标签。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法编辑书籍标签。

en.description: After an uncaught Loopeer Reader error, this report screen shows device details and the error information and lets users email the report to the developers.
en.disableEffect: The crash report screen will not appear after an error, so users cannot review or email its report.

zh-CN.description: Loopeer Reader 发生未捕获错误后，此报告页面会显示设备信息和错误详情，并允许用户通过电子邮件将报告发送给开发者。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 发生错误后，崩溃报告页面将不会显示，用户无法查看或通过邮件发送报告。

en.description: Godot Engine uses this service when a game downloads extra files from Google Play; it provides the verification information and scheduling support for that download.
en.disableEffect: A game that needs those extra files may be unable to download or load them.

zh-CN.description: Godot Engine 在游戏需要从 Google Play 下载额外文件时使用此服务；它为下载提供校验信息和调度支持。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要这些额外文件的游戏可能无法下载或加载它们。

en.description: When a Godot game must restart, the engine opens this screen in a separate process, starts the requested game screen again, and ends the old process.
en.disableEffect: Engine-requested restarts may fail and leave the game unable to recover from a restart request.

zh-CN.description: Godot 游戏需要重启时，引擎会在单独进程中打开此页面，重新启动指定的游戏页面并结束旧进程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 引擎发起的重启可能失败，导致游戏无法完成此次恢复重启。

en.description: Oplus Instant's HapJS Channel SDK binds to this Service when a trusted instant app requests a channel. It checks whether that app is allowed and then carries messages between the instant app and the native app.
en.disableEffect: HapJS instant apps cannot open a communication channel with the app, so integrations that exchange messages with them will stop working.

zh-CN.description: 可信的快应用请求建立通道时，Oplus Instant 的 HapJS Channel SDK 会绑定此 Service。它会检查对方是否获准接入，然后在快应用与原生应用之间传递消息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: HapJS 快应用将无法与该应用建立通信通道，依赖双方消息交互的集成功能也会停止工作。

en.description: Henjue's Common Share SDK opens this Activity when WeChat returns from a sign-in or share request. It passes WeChat authorization details back to the app, or reports whether sharing succeeded, was canceled, or failed.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, WeChat sign-in and share responses cannot return to the app.

zh-CN.description: 微信完成登录或分享后，Henjue 通用分享 SDK 会打开此 Activity 接收返回内容。它会把微信授权信息交回应用，或反馈分享成功、取消或失败。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，微信登录和分享的返回结果无法交回应用。

en.description: Machbird's crash-reporting SDK opens this screen when a user chooses to inspect a crash report. It displays the report details and privacy information.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to inspect Machbird crash reports from this screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择查看崩溃报告时，Machbird 崩溃报告 SDK 会打开此页面，显示报告详情和隐私信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此页面查看 Machbird 崩溃报告。

en.description: Machbird's crash-reporting service uploads queued crash reports in the background. It runs when the SDK has a report to send.
en.disableEffect: Machbird crash reports will no longer be uploaded.

zh-CN.description: Machbird 崩溃报告服务会在后台上传已排队的崩溃报告，并在 SDK 有报告需要发送时运行。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Machbird 崩溃报告将不再上传。

en.description: Machbird's crash-reporting SDK opens this screen in its optional report flow to ask about uploading a captured crash report or viewing its details.
en.disableEffect: The optional Machbird crash-report prompt and upload flow will not open.

zh-CN.description: Machbird 崩溃报告 SDK 会在可选报告流程中打开此页面，询问用户是否上传已收集的崩溃报告或查看详情。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Machbird 可选的崩溃报告提示和上传流程将无法打开。

en.description: This Machbird screen displays an Android permission request and returns the user's decision to the requesting feature.
en.disableEffect: Machbird features that need this permission will not be able to complete their permission request.

zh-CN.description: 此 Machbird 页面会显示 Android 权限请求，并将用户的选择返回给请求该权限的功能。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要此权限的 Machbird 功能将无法完成权限请求。

en.description: This Machbird screen displays an Android permission request and returns the user's decision to the requesting feature.
en.disableEffect: Machbird features that need this permission will not be able to complete their permission request.

zh-CN.description: 此 Machbird 页面会显示 Android 权限请求，并将用户的选择返回给请求该权限的功能。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要此权限的 Machbird 功能将无法完成权限请求。

en.description: When Machbird requests Android runtime permissions, this screen shows the system prompt and reports which permissions the user granted or denied.
en.disableEffect: Machbird features that require runtime permissions will not be able to finish their permission flow.

zh-CN.description: Machbird 请求 Android 运行时权限时，此页面会显示系统提示，并返回用户授予或拒绝的权限。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要运行时权限的 Machbird 功能将无法完成权限流程。

en.description: When an app service requests runtime permissions through Machbird, this service opens the permission screen and returns the result to the requester.
en.disableEffect: App features that request permissions through Machbird will not receive a permission result.

zh-CN.description: 应用 Service 通过 Machbird 请求运行时权限时，此 Service 会打开权限页面并将结果返回给请求方。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过 Machbird 请求权限的应用功能将无法收到权限结果。

en.description: Machbird's background service clients bind here to maintain an internal connection used by the SDK's keep-alive services.
en.disableEffect: Machbird's internal background service connection and keep-alive support will stop.

zh-CN.description: Machbird 的后台 Service 客户端会在此绑定，以维持 SDK 保活 Service 使用的内部连接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Machbird 的内部后台 Service 连接和保活支持将停止。

en.description: At app startup, this Machbird provider initializes the local service connection and can return a binder to internal SDK clients.
en.disableEffect: Machbird's internal background service connection and keep-alive support will stop.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，此 Machbird Provider 会初始化本地 Service 连接，并可向 SDK 内部客户端返回绑定接口。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Machbird 的内部后台 Service 连接和保活支持将停止。

en.description: The Homunculus Android component library uses this Provider when the app takes a photo through one of its image-picking flows, giving the camera app access to a temporary image file.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, the camera cannot access or return that temporary photo in the library’s capture flow.

zh-CN.description: Homunculus Android 组件库在应用通过其图片选择流程拍照时使用此 Provider，让相机应用能够访问临时图片文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，相机将无法在该库的拍照流程中访问或返回这张临时图片。

en.description: When the Homunculus Android component library handles an uncaught app error, it briefly opens this transparent Activity while clearing the affected screen and resetting the app window.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, the app’s recovery flow may leave the affected screen blank after an uncaught error.

zh-CN.description: Homunculus Android 组件库处理未捕获的应用错误时，会短暂打开这个透明 Activity，以清理异常界面并重置应用窗口。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，未捕获错误发生时，应用的恢复流程可能会使受影响的页面保持空白。

en.description: When IDPass SmartScanner opens its result screen with a scanned QR code, it reads and displays the card information and lets the user enter a PIN for verification. The screen also loads the scanner's face and shape data files.
en.disableEffect: The card result and PIN verification screen will not open, so IDPass identity checks can fail.

zh-CN.description: IDPass SmartScanner 使用扫描得到的二维码打开结果页面时，会读取并显示证件信息，并允许用户输入 PIN 进行验证。页面还会加载扫描器所需的人脸和形状数据文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，证件结果和 PIN 验证页面无法打开，IDPass 身份核验可能失败。

en.description: When internet access returns, Infobip Mobile Messaging retries sending messages and updates that were waiting to sync.
en.disableEffect: Queued messaging data may not be retried automatically when the device reconnects.

zh-CN.description: 网络连接恢复时，Infobip Mobile Messaging 会重试发送等待同步的消息和更新。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，设备重新联网时等待发送的消息数据可能不会自动重试。

en.description: When a user opens an Infobip Mobile Messaging notification, this brief screen passes the message tap to the app and marks it seen when configured.
en.disableEffect: Notification taps may no longer reach the app handlers or update the message seen status.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 Infobip Mobile Messaging 通知时，此短暂界面会把点击消息交给应用处理，并可按设置将消息标记为已读。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，通知点击可能无法传给应用处理程序，消息已读状态也可能无法更新。

en.description: Infobip Mobile Messaging Chat uses this provider to create private file links for photos and other attachments sent through in-app chat.
en.disableEffect: Chat attachments may fail to open or share, and the attachment flow may break.

zh-CN.description: Infobip Mobile Messaging Chat 会用它为应用内聊天中的照片和其他附件创建受限文件链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，聊天附件可能无法打开或分享，附件流程也会失效。

en.description: After Infobip Mobile Messaging finishes personalizing a message, this receiver checks and syncs the in-app chat registration in the background.
en.disableEffect: The in-app chat connection may fail to register or refresh after a personalized message.

zh-CN.description: Infobip Mobile Messaging 完成消息个性化处理后，此接收器会在后台检查并同步应用内聊天登记。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用内聊天连接可能无法在个性化消息后完成登记或刷新。

en.description: When Infobip Mobile Messaging creates a push token, Infobip Chat sends it to the chat service so new chat messages can reach the device.
en.disableEffect: Push alerts for new chat messages may stop updating, although the chat screen can still open.

zh-CN.description: Infobip Mobile Messaging 创建推送令牌后，Infobip Chat 会将令牌发送给聊天服务，以便新消息能送达设备。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，新聊天消息的推送提醒可能无法更新，但聊天界面仍可打开。

en.description: When the app opens Infobip in-app chat, this screen displays the live-chat conversation and its message controls.
en.disableEffect: The app's in-app support chat will not open.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开 Infobip 应用内聊天时，此界面会显示实时聊天会话及其消息控件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用内客服聊天将无法打开。

en.description: When someone opens an attachment in Infobip in-app chat, this screen shows the supported file preview and download options.
en.disableEffect: Users may be unable to preview or download attachments from the chat.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 Infobip 应用内聊天中的附件时，此界面会显示支持的文件预览和下载选项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户可能无法预览或下载聊天附件。

en.description: When Firebase delivers an Infobip Mobile Messaging message or a new push token, this service queues the message or token for the SDK to process.
en.disableEffect: Infobip push messages and token updates may stop reaching the app.

zh-CN.description: Firebase 送达 Infobip Mobile Messaging 消息或新推送令牌时，此服务会将消息或令牌交给 SDK 处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Infobip 推送消息和令牌更新可能无法送达应用。

en.description: When Huawei Mobile Services delivers an Infobip Mobile Messaging message or a new push token, this service queues it for the SDK to process.
en.disableEffect: Infobip push messages and token updates may stop reaching the app on Huawei push delivery.

zh-CN.description: Huawei Mobile Services 送达 Infobip Mobile Messaging 消息或新推送令牌时，此服务会将其交给 SDK 处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，通过华为推送送达的 Infobip 消息和令牌更新可能无法到达应用。

en.description: When Android finishes starting the device, Infobip Mobile Messaging restores geofences that the app has enabled for location-based messages.
en.disableEffect: Enabled location areas may not resume monitoring after the device restarts.

zh-CN.description: Android 完成设备启动后，Infobip Mobile Messaging 会恢复应用为位置消息启用的地理围栏。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，已启用的位置区域可能不会在设备重启后恢复监测。

en.description: When Android location settings change, Infobip Mobile Messaging resumes geofence monitoring if location is enabled and pauses active areas if it is disabled.
en.disableEffect: Location-based messaging may not resume or pause correctly when location settings change.

zh-CN.description: Android 位置设置变化时，如果位置服务已开启，Infobip Mobile Messaging 会恢复地理围栏监测；如果关闭，则暂停活动区域。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，位置设置变化时，位置消息功能可能无法正确恢复或暂停。

en.description: In the background, Infobip Mobile Messaging rebuilds geofence monitoring after scheduled refreshes or system changes, and removes expired location areas.
en.disableEffect: Location areas may remain stale or stop triggering location-based messages after system changes.

zh-CN.description: Infobip Mobile Messaging 会在后台定期刷新或因系统变化重建地理围栏监测，并移除过期的位置区域。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，系统变化后的位置区域可能过期，无法正常触发位置消息。

en.description: When the clock changes, location-service data is cleared, or a scheduled geo check is due, this receiver sends the event to Infobip Mobile Messaging's background location handler.
en.disableEffect: Geofences may not be refreshed after system time or location-service changes.

zh-CN.description: 系统时间变化、位置服务数据被清除或到达计划检查时间时，此接收器会将事件交给 Infobip Mobile Messaging 的后台位置处理程序。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，系统时间或位置服务变化后可能无法刷新地理围栏。

en.description: When the device enters or leaves a tracked area, Infobip Mobile Messaging processes the location transition for location-based messages.
en.disableEffect: Entering or leaving tracked areas may no longer trigger Infobip location messages.

zh-CN.description: 设备进入或离开已跟踪区域时，Infobip Mobile Messaging 会处理该位置变化，以支持基于位置的消息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，进入或离开跟踪区域可能不再触发 Infobip 位置消息。

en.description: When Android reports that the device entered or left a tracked area, this receiver starts Infobip Mobile Messaging's background handler for the transition.
en.disableEffect: Geofence entries and exits may not be delivered to Infobip for location-based messaging.

zh-CN.description: Android 报告设备进入或离开跟踪区域时，此接收器会启动 Infobip Mobile Messaging 的后台处理程序。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，地理围栏进出事件可能无法送到 Infobip 以触发位置消息。

en.description: When a user taps an interactive Infobip notification action, this receiver dismisses the notification, captures any typed reply, and sends the action to the app.
en.disableEffect: Notification buttons and inline replies may no longer reach the app, which can break actions offered there.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击 Infobip 通知中的交互操作时，此接收器会关闭通知、读取输入的回复并将操作交给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，通知按钮和直接回复可能无法传给应用，相关操作可能失效。

en.description: When its scheduled network job runs, Infobip Mobile Messaging retries syncing queued messages and updates after internet access becomes available.
en.disableEffect: Queued messaging data may not sync automatically when the network returns.

zh-CN.description: 计划的联网任务运行时，Infobip Mobile Messaging 会在网络恢复后重试同步排队的消息和更新。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，网络恢复时排队的消息数据可能不会自动同步。

en.description: When a user opens a web link in an Infobip notification, this screen displays the page and sends supported app links to the browser or matching app.
en.disableEffect: Web pages linked from Infobip notifications may not open through the SDK screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 Infobip 通知中的网页链接时，此界面会显示页面，并将支持的应用链接交给浏览器或相应应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Infobip 通知中的网页可能无法通过 SDK 界面打开。

en.description: The Instnt Android SDK opens this Activity when the app requests a configured identity form. It shows text, choice, checkbox, and date fields, then submits the entered values or reports cancellation or an error.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, the app cannot collect or submit the Instnt form details.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求显示身份验证表单时，Instnt Android SDK 会打开此 Activity。它显示文本、选项、复选框和日期字段，并提交填写内容或返回取消及错误结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用无法收集或提交 Instnt 表单中的信息。

en.description: The iQNECT iQKIT augmented-reality Activity opens when the host app requests AR content for a channel. It starts a live camera view over that content and supports saving or sharing a screenshot.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, the app cannot open the channel's augmented-reality view or share screenshots from it.

zh-CN.description: 宿主应用请求显示某个频道的增强现实内容时，会打开 iQNECT iQKIT 的增强现实 Activity。它启动实时相机画面并叠加频道内容，还支持保存或分享截图。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用无法打开该频道的增强现实画面，也无法分享其中的截图。

en.description: The iQNECT iQKIT search Activity opens from the SDK entry point or Android VIEW and SEND intents. It routes shared text, links, text queries, images, and scan results to search, and provides the SDK's history and news sections.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, the app loses this version of the iQNECT search screen and cannot route shared or scanned searches through it.

zh-CN.description: 通过 SDK 入口或 Android VIEW、SEND Intent 打开时，iQNECT iQKIT 搜索 Activity 会处理分享的文字、链接、文本查询、图像和扫描结果，并提供搜索历史与新闻页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用将无法使用这一版本的 iQNECT 搜索界面，也无法通过它处理分享或扫描发起的搜索。

en.description: The iQNECT iQKIT SDK uses this manifest alias as its public camera-search entry point. It opens the scanner Activity used in that SDK version so users can search by barcode or product image.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, the app cannot open the iQNECT camera-search entry point through this alias.

zh-CN.description: iQNECT iQKIT SDK 将此清单别名用作相机搜索入口。它会打开对应版本的扫描界面，让用户通过条码或商品图像进行搜索。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用无法通过此别名打开 iQNECT 的相机搜索入口。

en.description: The iQNECT iQKIT main Activity opens for the SDK's main, Android VIEW, or SEARCH action. It routes text and image searches and supplied search results, and hosts the search home, news, history, and linked web pages.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, the app cannot open the iQNECT search experience, history, news, or linked pages through this Activity.

zh-CN.description: 收到 iQNECT iQKIT 主入口、Android VIEW 或 SEARCH Intent 时，会打开此主 Activity。它处理文本和图像搜索及传入的搜索结果，并承载搜索首页、新闻、历史记录和链接网页。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用无法通过此 Activity 打开 iQNECT 搜索界面、历史记录、新闻或链接页面。

en.description: The iQNECT iQKIT and AIQ Image Match UI SDKs launch this Activity with their search-result action after a search. It displays the returned result and can open linked web content.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, search results from these SDK flows cannot open in their result screen.

zh-CN.description: 搜索完成后，iQNECT iQKIT 和 AIQ Image Match UI SDK 会通过搜索结果 Action 打开此 Activity。它显示返回的搜索结果，也可以打开关联网页。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，这些 SDK 流程返回的搜索结果无法在结果页面中打开。

en.description: The iQNECT iQKIT and AIQ Image Match UI camera Activity starts an image or barcode search from the live camera. It sends camera frames or detected barcodes for lookup and opens the result screen when a match is returned.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, users cannot search with the camera or view matches returned by either SDK.

zh-CN.description: iQNECT iQKIT 和 AIQ Image Match UI 的相机 Activity 使用实时画面发起图像或条码搜索。它会提交相机画面或识别到的条码进行查询，并在收到匹配结果后打开结果页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过相机搜索，也无法查看这两个 SDK 返回的匹配结果。

en.description: The iQNECT iQKIT camera Activity can be launched for a result by its host app. It scans live images and barcodes, and also accepts a chosen gallery image for a search.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, the app's barcode and image-search flow cannot open or deliver its results.

zh-CN.description: 宿主应用可以通过请求结果的方式启动 iQNECT iQKIT 相机 Activity。它扫描实时画面和条码，也接受用户从相册选取图像进行搜索。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用无法打开条码和图像搜索流程，也无法取得该流程的搜索结果。

en.description: The iQNECT iQKIT and AIQ Image Match UI camera flow opens this screen when a user-started scan has no matching result. It shows the submitted image with failure feedback and lets the user close the screen.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, the app cannot show feedback for a scan that finds no match.

zh-CN.description: 用户主动扫描但没有找到匹配项时，iQNECT iQKIT 和 AIQ Image Match UI 的相机流程会打开此界面。它展示提交的图像和未匹配提示，并允许用户关闭页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用无法显示扫描无匹配结果时的反馈界面。

en.description: The iQNECT iQKIT SDK opens this screen when the app asks the user to manage search channels. It shows active channels, lets the user reorder them or open channel selection, and saves or discards changes.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, users cannot manage the channels used by the app's iQNECT searches.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求管理搜索频道时，iQNECT iQKIT SDK 会打开此界面。它显示已启用的频道，允许用户调整顺序或进入频道选择，并保存或放弃更改。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法管理应用在 iQNECT 搜索中使用的频道。

en.description: The iQNECT iQKIT SDK opens this screen from channel management so the user can add or remove available search channels. It returns whether the changes were saved or discarded.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, the app cannot offer the channel-selection step or apply the user's choices.

zh-CN.description: iQNECT iQKIT SDK 会从频道管理界面打开此页面，让用户添加或移除可用的搜索频道。页面会返回用户是保存还是放弃了更改。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用无法提供频道选择步骤，也无法应用用户的选择。

en.description: The iQNECT iQKIT SDK opens this Activity for a selected coupon. It shows the coupon's title, summary, image, and details.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, users cannot open the full details for an iQNECT coupon.

zh-CN.description: 选择优惠券后，iQNECT iQKIT SDK 会打开此 Activity。它显示优惠券的标题、简介、图片和详细信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法查看 iQNECT 优惠券的完整信息。

en.description: The iQNECT iQKIT SDK opens its wallet screen to show saved coupons. The screen can load, add, or remove coupons from the user's wallet.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, the app's iQNECT coupon wallet and its add or remove flow are unavailable.

zh-CN.description: iQNECT iQKIT SDK 会打开优惠券钱包页面，显示已保存的优惠券。该页面可以加载、添加或移除钱包中的优惠券。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用中的 iQNECT 优惠券钱包以及添加和移除操作将无法使用。

en.description: The iQNECT iQKIT SDK opens this Activity with a link, initializes Facebook if needed, and presents Facebook's share dialog.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, users cannot share iQNECT links through Facebook from the app.

zh-CN.description: iQNECT iQKIT SDK 会通过链接打开此 Activity，必要时初始化 Facebook SDK，并显示 Facebook 分享对话框。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法在应用中通过 Facebook 分享 iQNECT 链接。

en.description: The iQNECT iQKIT SDK opens a list of previous searches. Selecting an item runs that search again in the app.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, users cannot view or rerun saved iQNECT searches.

zh-CN.description: iQNECT iQKIT SDK 会打开以往搜索记录列表。选择其中一项即可在应用中重新执行该搜索。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法查看或重新执行已保存的 iQNECT 搜索。

en.description: The iQNECT iQKIT and AIQ Image Match UI SDKs open a supplied page URL in an embedded browser with an optional title or full-screen view. This Activity is also used for linked result and legal pages.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, linked result pages, legal pages, and other in-app web content cannot open through these SDKs.

zh-CN.description: iQNECT iQKIT 和 AIQ Image Match UI SDK 会在内置浏览器中打开传入的网址，并可设置标题或全屏显示。搜索结果链接、法律信息等页面也会使用此 Activity。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，这些 SDK 无法打开搜索结果链接、法律信息及其他应用内网页。

en.description: The JBoss AeroGear Android Push SDK receives Firebase Cloud Messaging data messages here and forwards their fields to the app's registered push handlers.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, incoming AeroGear push messages are not passed to the app, so features that rely on those messages stop updating.

zh-CN.description: JBoss AeroGear Android Push SDK 会在此 Service 中接收 Firebase Cloud Messaging 数据消息，并把消息内容交给应用注册的推送处理程序。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，AeroGear 推送消息不会交给应用处理，依赖这些消息的功能将无法更新。

en.description: The JBoss AeroGear Android Push SDK receives Firebase data messages here and forwards them to the app's registered handlers. When Firebase issues a new device token, it also updates the token registered with UnifiedPush.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, AeroGear messages are not delivered to the app and refreshed device tokens are not registered with UnifiedPush.

zh-CN.description: JBoss AeroGear Android Push SDK 会在此 Service 中接收 Firebase 数据消息并转交给应用注册的处理程序。Firebase 更新设备令牌时，它还会把新令牌登记到 UnifiedPush。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，AeroGear 消息不会送达应用，更新后的设备令牌也不会登记到 UnifiedPush。

en.description: The JBoss AeroGear Android Push SDK starts this Service when Firebase refreshes the device token. It sends the new token and device details to the app's UnifiedPush server so future push messages can reach the device.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, a refreshed device token is not sent to UnifiedPush and push delivery can stop.

zh-CN.description: Firebase 更新设备令牌时，JBoss AeroGear Android Push SDK 会启动此 Service。它把新令牌和设备信息发送到应用的 UnifiedPush 服务器，以便后续推送仍能送达设备。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，更新后的设备令牌不会发送到 UnifiedPush，推送可能因此无法继续送达。

en.description: JetBrains Compose Multiplatform Resources starts this Provider with the app and stores the Android app context for its resource system.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, Compose resource lookups that depend on this Android context cannot load their resources.

zh-CN.description: JetBrains Compose Multiplatform Resources 会在应用启动时运行此 Provider，并为资源系统保存 Android 应用上下文。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，依赖此 Android 上下文的 Compose 资源查询将无法加载资源。

en.description: JewelSample opens its main app screen when the user launches it.
en.disableEffect: JewelSample loses its launcher screen and cannot be opened.

zh-CN.description: 用户启动 JewelSample 时，该页面会显示应用主界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: JewelSample 将失去启动页面，无法打开。

en.description: The Jitsi Meet SDK registers this service with Android's call system to manage incoming and outgoing internet calls. It reports call state and connection changes to the system.
en.disableEffect: Jitsi call integration with Android's call controls may fail, disrupting voice or video meetings.

zh-CN.description: Jitsi Meet SDK 会向 Android 通话系统注册此服务，以管理互联网来电和去电，并向系统报告通话状态和连接变化。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Jitsi 通话与 Android 通话控件的集成可能失效，影响语音或视频会议。

en.description: The Jitsi Meet SDK opens this screen when the app asks to join a conference. It displays and runs the audio or video meeting.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to join meetings hosted through the Jitsi Meet SDK.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求加入会议时，Jitsi Meet SDK 会打开此页面。页面负责显示并运行语音或视频会议。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法加入由 Jitsi Meet SDK 提供的会议。

en.description: The Jitsi Meet SDK starts this foreground service during a conference to keep the meeting active and show its ongoing-call notification while the app is in the background.
en.disableEffect: A Jitsi meeting may lose its ongoing-call notification or stop when the app moves to the background.

zh-CN.description: 会议期间，Jitsi Meet SDK 会启动此前台服务，以便应用进入后台后会议仍能保持运行并显示通话通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用进入后台后，Jitsi 会议可能失去持续通话通知或停止运行。

en.description: Joty 2.0 Mobile opens this Activity from its password-change flow. It checks the old password when required, collects the new password twice, and submits it after both entries match.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, the app cannot complete its Joty password-change flow.

zh-CN.description: Joty 2.0 Mobile 会在修改密码流程中打开此 Activity。需要时它会核对旧密码，要求输入两次新密码，并在两次内容一致后提交。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用无法完成 Joty 的密码修改流程。

en.description: Joty 2.0 Mobile opens this Activity when a session needs user authentication. It collects the username and password and, when shared access is enabled, the sharing key before continuing login.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, users cannot sign in through the Joty login flow.

zh-CN.description: 会话需要用户验证时，Joty 2.0 Mobile 会打开此 Activity。它收集用户名和密码；启用共享访问时，还会收集共享密钥，然后继续登录。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过 Joty 登录流程登录应用。

en.description: Joty 2.0 Mobile opens this Activity during startup to load the configured start page and read the application server address from it, then initializes the connection.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, the app may not resolve its service address or finish connecting at startup.

zh-CN.description: Joty 2.0 Mobile 会在启动过程中打开此 Activity，加载已配置的起始页面并从中读取应用服务器地址，然后初始化连接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用可能无法解析服务地址或完成启动时的连接。

en.description: Joty 2.0 Mobile opens this Activity when the starting server address must be entered or changed. The user can enter a URL, which the SDK saves before continuing its startup connection flow.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, the user cannot set the start address needed for the app's Joty connection flow.

zh-CN.description: 需要输入或更改起始服务器地址时，Joty 2.0 Mobile 会打开此 Activity。用户可以输入网址，SDK 保存后会继续启动连接流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法设置 Joty 连接流程所需的起始地址。

en.description: BoD's Android Wear Color Picker library opens this Activity through its result contract. It displays a color picker seeded with an optional existing color and returns the selected color.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, users of the color-selection flow cannot open the picker or return a chosen color.

zh-CN.description: BoD 的 Android Wear Color Picker 库会通过结果契约打开此 Activity。它显示颜色选择器，可预先选中已有颜色，并返回用户选定的颜色。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，使用颜色选择流程的用户无法打开选择器或返回所选颜色。

en.description: When Android finishes a WebView download that matches the one recorded by Jun1or DWebView, this component opens the file in an app that can handle it.
en.disableEffect: Web downloads can finish, but matching files will no longer open automatically.

zh-CN.description: Android 完成与 Jun1or DWebView 记录相符的网页下载后，此组件会调用可处理该文件的应用将其打开。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，网页文件仍可下载完成，但对应文件不会再自动打开。

en.description: When Kin is asked to process an invoice payment, this Activity presents the confirmation and progress screens and returns the result to the calling app.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot complete invoice payments through Kin's payment flow.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求 Kin 处理账单付款时，此 Activity 会显示确认和处理进度，并将结果返回给调用应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用无法通过 Kin 的付款流程完成账单支付。

en.description: Frank Monza’s Kustom Dashboard API opens the skin pack dashboard when the host app launches it. It lists the pack’s preset pages and, when configured, its wallpaper collection.
en.disableEffect: Users would lose this skin pack's dashboard for browsing presets and any configured wallpapers.

zh-CN.description: Frank Monza 的 Kustom Dashboard API（Kustom）会在宿主应用打开皮肤包面板时显示该包的预设页面，并在配置了壁纸目录时一并显示壁纸内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此面板浏览皮肤包的预设和已配置的壁纸。

en.description: When a user selects a wallpaper from the dashboard, Frank Monza’s Kustom Dashboard API opens this screen. It loads the image and offers controls to apply it or save it when downloads are enabled.
en.disableEffect: Users could no longer preview, apply, or save wallpapers from the dashboard.

zh-CN.description: 用户在面板中选择壁纸时，Frank Monza 的 Kustom Dashboard API 会打开此页面并加载图片；启用下载后，用户还可以应用或保存壁纸。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在面板中预览、应用或保存壁纸。

en.description: The Palace Project's Library Simplified audiobook SDK receives Android media-button presses and forwards them to the audiobook playback session.
en.disableEffect: Headphones and other media buttons can no longer control audiobook playback.

zh-CN.description: The Palace Project 的 Library Simplified 有声书 SDK 会接收 Android 媒体按键事件，并将其转交给有声书播放会话。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，耳机和其他媒体按键将无法控制有声书播放。

en.description: The Palace Project's Library Simplified audiobook SDK creates a media session that lets Android playback controls and connected devices control audiobook playback, including in the background.
en.disableEffect: System playback controls and connected devices cannot control audiobook playback through this session.

zh-CN.description: The Palace Project 的 Library Simplified 有声书 SDK 会创建媒体会话，让 Android 播放控件和已连接设备控制有声书播放，包括后台播放时。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 系统播放控件和已连接设备将无法通过此会话控制有声书播放。

en.description: After a photo is chosen or captured through Ligboy's SelectPhoto image picker, this Activity lets the user crop or rotate it and returns the edited image.
en.disableEffect: Photo flows that require cropping cannot finish through SelectPhoto.

zh-CN.description: 用户通过 Ligboy 的 SelectPhoto 图片选择库选择或拍摄照片后，此 Activity 可让用户裁剪或旋转图片，并返回编辑后的照片。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要裁剪照片的 SelectPhoto 流程将无法完成。

en.description: When an app asks the user to choose a photo, Ligboy's SelectPhoto image picker offers camera capture or the device's image picker and returns the selected image, cropping it when requested.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot use SelectPhoto to choose or capture a photo.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求用户选择照片时，Ligboy 的 SelectPhoto 图片选择库会提供相机拍摄和设备图片选择功能，并返回所选照片；需要时还会裁剪图片。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用无法通过 SelectPhoto 选择或拍摄照片。

en.description: When Ligboy's SelectPhoto captures a new photo, this Provider gives the camera app temporary access to write the image into the host app's cache.
en.disableEffect: Camera capture through SelectPhoto fails because the camera cannot write the photo to the app's cache.

zh-CN.description: Ligboy 的 SelectPhoto 拍摄照片时，此 Provider 会临时允许相机应用将图片写入宿主应用的缓存。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，相机应用无法将照片写入应用缓存，SelectPhoto 的拍摄功能会失败。

en.description: When a MapLibre offline-map download starts or is canceled, this Service creates or removes the map area, tracks progress, and updates the download notification.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot download or cancel offline map areas through this plugin.

zh-CN.description: MapLibre 离线地图下载开始或取消时，此 Service 会创建或移除地图区域、跟踪进度并更新下载通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法通过此插件下载或取消离线地图区域。

en.description: When an app asks the user to save a map area for offline use, this Activity opens MapLibre's region picker and returns the selected area and name.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot let users select map areas for offline download through this plugin.

zh-CN.description: 应用让用户保存离线地图区域时，此 Activity 会打开 MapLibre 区域选择界面，并返回所选区域及其名称。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用无法通过此插件让用户选择要下载的离线地图区域。

en.description: When an app starts a route with MapLibre Navigation, this Activity opens the turn-by-turn screen and begins guidance for that route.
en.disableEffect: MapLibre route guidance cannot open its navigation screen.

zh-CN.description: 应用使用 MapLibre Navigation 启动路线时，此 Activity 会打开逐向导航界面并开始路线引导。
zh-CN.disableEffect: MapLibre 路线引导无法打开导航界面。

en.description: During MapLibre Navigation guidance, this Service keeps a foreground notification with route progress and updates it as the route advances.
en.disableEffect: Users lose the ongoing route-progress notification during MapLibre guidance.

zh-CN.description: MapLibre 路线引导期间，此 Service 会持续显示包含路线进度的前台通知，并随路线进展更新。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户在 MapLibre 导航期间无法看到持续更新的路线进度通知。

en.description: The Matrix.org Matrix Android SDK 2 registers this Provider to expose cached downloads to file-sharing flows and report each file's type. Android makes it available under the SDK's file authority.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it can break sending or opening cached attachments in Matrix chats.

zh-CN.description: Matrix.org 的 Matrix Android SDK 2 注册此 Provider，用于在文件分享流程中提供缓存的下载文件，并在请求时返回文件类型。Android 会通过 SDK 的文件地址调用它。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Matrix 聊天中的附件发送或打开可能失败。

en.description: On Android versions before 5.0, SNetBus updates the shared network status when Android reports a connectivity change.
en.disableEffect: Apps that rely on SNetBus for network status will stop receiving these connectivity updates.

zh-CN.description: 在 Android 5.0 之前，MeetSL 的 SNetBus 网络状态库会在系统报告连接变化时更新应用可读取的网络状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，依赖 SNetBus 网络状态的功能将无法及时获知网络连接变化。

en.description: The microG GmsCore Cast device service connects an app to its selected receiver and relays playback controls, volume, device status, and messages. It starts when an app asks to control a Cast device.
en.disableEffect: Apps using Cast may be unable to connect to, control, or receive status from a receiver.

zh-CN.description: microG GmsCore 的 Cast 设备服务会将应用连接到选中的接收设备，并转发播放控制、音量、设备状态和消息。应用请求控制 Cast 设备时，此服务会启动。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用 Cast 的应用可能无法连接或控制接收设备，也无法获取设备状态。

en.description: During Android work-profile setup, this microG GmsCore screen requests access to settings shared from the personal profile, then stores the permission returned by Android.
en.disableEffect: microG will not automatically connect shared settings between the work and personal profiles.

zh-CN.description: 设置 Android 工作资料时，microG GmsCore 的此界面会请求访问个人资料中共享的设置，并保存 Android 返回的授权。
zh-CN.disableEffect: microG 将无法自动连接工作资料与个人资料之间共享的设置。

en.description: When work-profile setup requests shared settings, this microG GmsCore screen returns a read-only settings link from the personal profile with permission for the work profile to keep using it.
en.disableEffect: The work profile may not be able to access the shared microG settings it needs.

zh-CN.description: 工作资料请求共享设置时，microG GmsCore 的此界面会从个人资料返回一个只读设置链接，并授予工作资料持续访问权限。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 工作资料可能无法访问所需的 microG 共享设置。

en.description: When Android initializes a managed work profile, this microG GmsCore receiver opens the cross-profile setup screen so that shared settings can be connected.
en.disableEffect: New work profiles will not automatically start microG's shared-settings setup.

zh-CN.description: Android 初始化受管理的工作资料时，microG GmsCore 的此接收器会打开跨资料设置界面，以连接共享设置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 新建工作资料时，microG 不会自动启动共享设置流程。

en.description: The microG GmsCore DroidGuard service answers app bindings for device checks and processes ping requests by preparing app-specific diagnostic data for a server check.
en.disableEffect: Apps that rely on microG DroidGuard checks may fail their security or verification step.

zh-CN.description: microG GmsCore 的 DroidGuard 服务会响应应用的设备检查连接，并在收到探测请求时准备应用专属诊断数据以提交服务器检查。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖 microG DroidGuard 检查的应用可能无法通过安全或验证步骤。

en.description: When a privileged FIDO2 client connects, this microG GmsCore service provides credential lookup and passkey registration or sign-in actions.
en.disableEffect: Passkey registration or sign-in flows that use the privileged FIDO2 service may fail.

zh-CN.description: 特权 FIDO2 客户端连接时，microG GmsCore 的此服务会提供凭据查询以及通行密钥注册或登录操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用特权 FIDO2 服务的通行密钥注册或登录流程可能失败。

en.description: When an app connects for FIDO2, this microG GmsCore service provides WebAuthn passkey registration and sign-in actions to the app.
en.disableEffect: Apps may be unable to register or use passkeys for sign-in.

zh-CN.description: 应用连接 FIDO2 服务时，microG GmsCore 会向其提供 WebAuthn 通行密钥注册和登录操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用可能无法注册通行密钥或使用通行密钥登录。

en.description: When a FIDO2 request opens this microG GmsCore screen, it handles passkey or security-key registration and sign-in, then returns the credential result to the app.
en.disableEffect: Apps may be unable to complete passkey or security-key registration and sign-in.

zh-CN.description: FIDO2 请求打开 microG GmsCore 的此界面后，它会处理通行密钥或安全密钥的注册与登录，并将凭据结果返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用可能无法完成通行密钥或安全密钥的注册与登录。

en.description: When a WebAuthn link starts a phone-as-security-key session, this microG GmsCore screen requests Bluetooth access, connects to the other device, and handles credential creation or sign-in.
en.disableEffect: Phone-as-security-key registration and sign-in flows may not complete.

zh-CN.description: WebAuthn 链接启动手机作为安全密钥的会话时，microG GmsCore 的此界面会请求蓝牙权限、连接另一台设备，并处理凭据创建或登录。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用手机作为安全密钥的注册和登录流程可能无法完成。

en.description: When an app requests a GMS device-compliance result, microG GmsCore returns a successful response that marks the device compliant.
en.disableEffect: Apps that require this compliance response may reject the device or block sign-in and other protected features.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求 GMS 设备合规结果时，microG GmsCore 会成功返回并将设备标记为合规。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要此合规结果的应用可能会拒绝该设备，或阻止登录及其他受保护功能。

en.description: When an app asks the user to enable Exposure Notifications, this microG GmsCore screen identifies the requesting app and requests required Bluetooth and location permissions.
en.disableEffect: Apps may be unable to obtain user approval and activate Exposure Notifications.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求启用接触通知时，microG GmsCore 的此界面会显示请求方，并申请所需的蓝牙和位置权限。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用可能无法获得用户授权并启用接触通知。

en.description: When the user opens Exposure Notifications settings, this microG GmsCore screen displays the controls for managing that feature.
en.disableEffect: Users may be unable to open or change Exposure Notifications settings through this screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开接触通知设置时，microG GmsCore 的此界面会显示相关功能的管理选项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户可能无法通过此界面打开或修改接触通知设置。

en.description: While Exposure Notifications monitoring is enabled, this microG GmsCore service broadcasts temporary Bluetooth identifiers so participating nearby devices can detect encounters.
en.disableEffect: The device will stop broadcasting encounter identifiers, reducing exposure detection.

zh-CN.description: 启用接触通知监测期间，microG GmsCore 的此服务会通过蓝牙广播临时标识，让附近参与的设备检测到接触。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 设备将停止广播接触标识，从而降低接触检测能力。

en.description: When Exposure Notifications data needs maintenance, microG GmsCore runs daily cleanup of stored diagnosis keys and encounter records.
en.disableEffect: Expired exposure records may remain stored longer and use additional space.

zh-CN.description: 接触通知数据需要维护时，microG GmsCore 会每日清理已保存的诊断密钥和接触记录。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 过期的接触记录可能保留更久并占用额外存储空间。

en.description: When an app shares exported Exposure Notifications files, this microG GmsCore provider grants temporary access to the configured files.
en.disableEffect: Apps may be unable to open or share exposure-key files provided through this route.

zh-CN.description: 应用分享接触通知导出文件时，microG GmsCore 的此提供器会临时授予对指定文件的访问权限。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用可能无法打开或分享通过此方式提供的接触密钥文件。

en.description: When an app connects to the Exposure Notifications API, microG GmsCore handles monitoring, diagnosis-key, status, and exposure-summary requests.
en.disableEffect: Apps will lose access to Exposure Notifications monitoring and exposure-reporting features.

zh-CN.description: 应用连接接触通知接口时，microG GmsCore 会处理监测、诊断密钥、状态和接触摘要请求。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法使用接触通知监测和接触报告功能。

en.description: When Exposure Notifications cannot run because Bluetooth, location, or required nearby permissions are off, this microG GmsCore service shows a warning and refreshes it when those settings change.
en.disableEffect: Warnings that explain why exposure monitoring is unavailable will no longer appear.

zh-CN.description: 蓝牙、位置或所需的附近设备权限关闭而导致接触通知无法运行时，microG GmsCore 的此服务会显示提醒，并在相关设置变化时更新提醒。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 接触监测不可用原因的提醒将不再显示。

en.description: While exposure monitoring is enabled, this microG GmsCore service scans for participating devices' Bluetooth broadcasts and records rotating identifiers used to detect encounters.
en.disableEffect: The device will stop detecting nearby encounter broadcasts, so exposure matching may miss contacts.

zh-CN.description: 启用接触监测期间，microG GmsCore 的此服务会扫描参与设备的蓝牙广播，并记录用于检测接触的轮换标识。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 设备将停止检测附近的接触广播，可能会漏掉接触匹配。

en.description: When an app requests configuration from the older microG GmsCore Exposure Notifications service, this receiver saves any submitted settings and sends the current configuration back.
en.disableEffect: Apps using this older setup flow may be unable to read or update Exposure Notifications configuration.

zh-CN.description: 应用向旧版 microG GmsCore 接触通知服务请求配置时，此接收器会保存提交的设置并返回当前配置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此旧版设置流程的应用可能无法读取或更新接触通知配置。

en.description: After device startup, app replacement, or package restart, this microG GmsCore receiver checks which exposure-monitoring background services are needed and starts them again.
en.disableEffect: Exposure monitoring may not resume automatically after a reboot or app restart.

zh-CN.description: 设备启动、应用更新替换或软件包重启后，microG GmsCore 的此接收器会检查所需的接触监测后台服务并重新启动它们。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 设备重启或应用重启后，接触监测可能无法自动恢复。

en.description: When an app asks the user to enable Exposure Notifications, this microG GmsCore screen identifies the requesting app and requests required Bluetooth and location permissions.
en.disableEffect: Apps may be unable to obtain user approval and activate Exposure Notifications.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求启用接触通知时，microG GmsCore 的此界面会显示请求方，并申请所需的蓝牙和位置权限。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用可能无法获得用户授权并启用接触通知。

en.description: When the user opens Exposure Notifications settings, this microG GmsCore screen displays the controls for managing that feature.
en.disableEffect: Users may be unable to open or change Exposure Notifications settings through this screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开接触通知设置时，microG GmsCore 的此界面会显示相关功能的管理选项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户可能无法通过此界面打开或修改接触通知设置。

en.description: When an app requests information for its open-source notices, microG GmsCore returns the submitted license entries sorted by name.
en.disableEffect: The app may not be able to retrieve or display its open-source license list.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求开源声明信息时，microG GmsCore 会按名称排序并返回应用提交的许可证条目。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用可能无法获取或显示开源许可证列表。

en.description: When an app requests reCAPTCHA verification, this microG GmsCore service routes the request to an available web-challenge or device-check implementation.
en.disableEffect: Apps that require reCAPTCHA for sign-in or abuse prevention may not complete verification.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求 reCAPTCHA 验证时，microG GmsCore 的此服务会将请求交给可用的网页验证或设备检查实现。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 登录或防滥用依赖 reCAPTCHA 的应用可能无法完成验证。

en.description: When a SafetyNet reCAPTCHA challenge opens, this microG GmsCore screen loads the challenge in an in-app browser and returns the response to the requesting app.
en.disableEffect: Apps waiting for this reCAPTCHA response may not complete sign-in or other protected actions.

zh-CN.description: SafetyNet reCAPTCHA 挑战打开时，microG GmsCore 的此界面会在应用内浏览器中加载挑战，并将结果返回请求应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 等待此 reCAPTCHA 结果的应用可能无法完成登录或其他受保护操作。

en.description: When an app connects to SafetyNet, microG GmsCore handles device-attestation and reCAPTCHA verification requests and returns their results.
en.disableEffect: Apps that rely on SafetyNet checks or verification may reject the device or block a protected flow.

zh-CN.description: 应用连接 SafetyNet 时，microG GmsCore 会处理设备证明和 reCAPTCHA 验证请求，并返回结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖 SafetyNet 检查或验证的应用可能会拒绝该设备，或阻止受保护的流程。

en.description: Apps and microG GmsCore services use this provider to read and update saved check-in, messaging, authentication, location, exposure-notification, and profile settings.
en.disableEffect: GmsCore features that depend on these settings may lose saved options or fail when reading them.

zh-CN.description: 应用和 microG GmsCore 服务会通过此提供器读取或更新设备登记、消息、身份验证、位置、接触通知和资料设置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖这些设置的 GmsCore 功能可能丢失已保存的选项，或无法读取设置。

en.description: When a UnifiedNlp backend needs runtime permissions, microG UnifiedNlp uses this screen to show Android's permission request and report whether all requested permissions were granted.
en.disableEffect: A backend may not obtain required permissions, so its location or geocoding feature can stop working.

zh-CN.description: UnifiedNlp 后端需要运行时权限时，microG UnifiedNlp 会通过此界面显示 Android 权限请求，并返回所需权限是否全部获准。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 后端可能无法取得所需权限，导致其位置或地理编码功能停止工作。

en.description: When Android requests address lookup, this microG UnifiedNlp service connects the v1 geocoder to the selected backend and returns forward or reverse geocoding results.
en.disableEffect: Address searches based on place names or coordinates may stop working through this geocoder.

zh-CN.description: Android 请求地址查询时，microG UnifiedNlp 的此服务会将 v1 地理编码器连接到选定后端，并返回地址或坐标查询结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过此地理编码器按地点名称或坐标查找地址的功能可能停止工作。

en.description: When Android requests network-based location, this microG UnifiedNlp v2 service connects to configured location backends and supplies their location results.
en.disableEffect: Apps that depend on UnifiedNlp network location may receive no location updates.

zh-CN.description: Android 请求基于网络的位置时，microG UnifiedNlp v2 服务会连接已配置的位置后端并提供其定位结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖 UnifiedNlp 网络定位的应用可能无法收到位置更新。

en.description: When Android requests network-based location through its v3 provider interface, this microG UnifiedNlp service supplies results from configured location backends.
en.disableEffect: Apps using the UnifiedNlp v3 network-location interface may receive no location updates.

zh-CN.description: Android 通过 v3 提供器接口请求网络定位时，microG UnifiedNlp 的此服务会提供已配置位置后端的结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用 UnifiedNlp v3 网络定位接口的应用可能无法收到位置更新。

en.description: When UnifiedNlp clients request forward or reverse geocoding, this microG service routes the lookup to the configured geocoding backends and returns matching addresses.
en.disableEffect: Clients using UnifiedNlp will lose address lookup through their configured geocoders.

zh-CN.description: UnifiedNlp 客户端请求地址或坐标查询时，microG 的此服务会将请求转发给已配置的地理编码后端，并返回匹配地址。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用 UnifiedNlp 的客户端将无法通过已配置的地理编码器查询地址。

en.description: When UnifiedNlp clients request current or last-known network location, this microG service coordinates the configured location backends and returns their results.
en.disableEffect: Clients depending on UnifiedNlp location backends may stop receiving network-based location.

zh-CN.description: UnifiedNlp 客户端请求当前或最近一次网络位置时，microG 的此服务会协调已配置的位置后端并返回结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖 UnifiedNlp 位置后端的客户端可能无法再收到网络定位结果。

en.description: When Android reports that an app package changed, was removed, or restarted, microG UnifiedNlp checks whether it is a selected location or geocoding backend and reloads the service if needed.
en.disableEffect: UnifiedNlp may keep stale backend selections after a provider is changed or removed, disrupting location or geocoding.

zh-CN.description: Android 报告应用软件包发生更改、移除或重启时，microG UnifiedNlp 会检查它是否为已选的位置或地理编码后端，并在需要时重新加载服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 提供器更改或移除后，UnifiedNlp 可能仍保留过时的后端选择，影响定位或地址查询。

en.description: When an older UnifiedNlp client requests the combined location service, this microG entry service connects it to the configured location and geocoding backends.
en.disableEffect: Older clients using the combined UnifiedNlp service may lose network location and geocoding.

zh-CN.description: 旧版 UnifiedNlp 客户端请求组合定位服务时，microG 的此入口服务会将其连接到已配置的位置和地理编码后端。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用组合 UnifiedNlp 服务的旧版客户端可能无法再使用网络定位和地址查询。

en.description: The Mozilla GeckoView engine (also forked by Equalitie for CENO) uses this provider to serve copied images and other rich items when another app reads them from Android’s clipboard.
en.disableEffect: Copied images and other rich items may not paste into other apps, although plain text copying can still work.

zh-CN.description: Mozilla GeckoView 浏览器引擎（包括 Equalitie 为 CENO 制作的分支）通过此内容提供器向 Android 剪贴板提供网页复制的图片及其他非纯文本内容，供其他应用读取。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 在其他应用中粘贴从 GeckoView 复制的图片或其他非纯文本内容可能失败；纯文本通常仍可粘贴。

en.description: The Mozilla GeckoView engine (also forked by Equalitie for CENO) starts this service when one of its browser processes crashes so it can create a crash report from the saved crash data.
en.disableEffect: Browsing can continue, but GeckoView may no longer save a report when one of its processes crashes.

zh-CN.description: Mozilla GeckoView 浏览器引擎（包括 Equalitie 为 CENO 制作的分支）的浏览器进程发生崩溃时会启动此服务，用崩溃数据生成报告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用仍可继续浏览，但 GeckoView 进程崩溃时可能无法保存崩溃报告。

en.description: The Mozilla GeckoView engine (also forked by Equalitie for CENO) binds this service when a page needs Android media codecs or DRM support. It creates the codec and protected-media sessions used for playback.
en.disableEffect: Audio or video that needs this service may fail to play, including some protected media.

zh-CN.description: Mozilla GeckoView 浏览器引擎（包括 Equalitie 为 CENO 制作的分支）在网页需要 Android 媒体编解码或 DRM 支持时绑定此服务，为播放创建相应的编解码和受保护媒体会话。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要此服务的音频或视频可能无法播放，包括部分受保护内容。

en.description: The Mozilla GeckoView engine (also forked by Equalitie for CENO) starts this separate worker when a page needs a Gecko media plug-in for protected playback, such as DRM video.
en.disableEffect: Protected video that relies on a Gecko media plug-in may not play.

zh-CN.description: Mozilla GeckoView 浏览器引擎（包括 Equalitie 为 CENO 制作的分支）在网页需要 Gecko 媒体插件进行受保护播放（例如 DRM 视频）时启动此独立进程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖 Gecko 媒体插件的受保护视频可能无法播放。

en.description: The Mozilla GeckoView engine (also forked by Equalitie for CENO) starts this separate worker when a page needs graphics work handled by the device’s GPU.
en.disableEffect: Some page graphics may not display correctly, and pages may fail if GeckoView cannot start this worker.

zh-CN.description: Mozilla GeckoView 浏览器引擎（包括 Equalitie 为 CENO 制作的分支）在网页需要设备 GPU 处理图形时启动此独立进程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 部分网页图形可能显示异常；如果 GeckoView 无法启动此进程，网页也可能无法正常运行。

en.description: The Mozilla GeckoView engine (also forked by Equalitie for CENO) includes this service for developer tests that check communication between its processes; it runs when those tests request it.
en.disableEffect: GeckoView process-communication tests that need this service will not run; normal browsing is unaffected.

zh-CN.description: Mozilla GeckoView 浏览器引擎（包括 Equalitie 为 CENO 制作的分支）提供此服务供开发测试检查进程间通信，并仅在测试请求时运行。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要此服务的 GeckoView 进程通信测试将无法运行；正常浏览不受影响。

en.description: The Mozilla GeckoView engine (also forked by Equalitie for CENO) starts this numbered service when a web page needs its own isolated background process, separate from other page content.
en.disableEffect: Pages assigned to this worker may fail to load or crash, breaking app screens that display web content.

zh-CN.description: Mozilla GeckoView 浏览器引擎（包括 Equalitie 为 CENO 制作的分支）在网页需要独立隔离的后台进程时启动此编号服务，使该网页与其他页面内容分开运行。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 分配给此进程的网页可能无法加载或发生崩溃，使用网页内容的应用界面也可能因此失效。

en.disableEffect: If disabled, GeckoView may fail to start a page process when this service is selected, so the affected tab may not load or run correctly.

zh-CN.description: Mozilla GeckoView（CENO Developers 为 CENO Browser 提供的分支）需要为网页内容启动额外进程时，会启动此服务。引擎会从这组编号服务中分配一个，在应用主进程之外处理网页内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 如果停用此服务，GeckoView 在分配到它来启动页面进程时可能失败，相关标签页可能无法加载或正常运行。

en.description: Mozilla GeckoView, in the CENO Developers fork for CENO Browser, starts this Service when it needs another process for web page content. GeckoView assigns these numbered Services from a pool so page work runs separately from the main app process.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, GeckoView may fail to start a page process when this service is selected, so the affected tab may not load or run correctly.

zh-CN.disableEffect: 如果停用此服务，GeckoView 在分配到它来启动页面进程时可能失败，相关标签页可能无法加载或正常运行。

en.disableEffect: If disabled, GeckoView may fail to start a page process when this service is selected, so the affected tab may not load or run correctly.

zh-CN.disableEffect: 如果停用此服务，GeckoView 在分配到它来启动页面进程时可能失败，相关标签页可能无法加载或正常运行。

en.disableEffect: If disabled, GeckoView may fail to start a page process when this service is selected, so the affected tab may not load or run correctly.

zh-CN.description: Mozilla GeckoView（CENO Developers 为 CENO Browser 提供的分支）需要为网页内容启动额外进程时，会启动此服务。引擎会从这组编号服务中分配一个，在应用主进程之外处理网页内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 如果停用此服务，GeckoView 在分配到它来启动页面进程时可能失败，相关标签页可能无法加载或正常运行。

en.disableEffect: If disabled, GeckoView may fail to start a page process when this service is selected, so the affected tab may not load or run correctly.

zh-CN.description: Mozilla GeckoView（CENO Developers 为 CENO Browser 提供的分支）需要为网页内容启动额外进程时，会启动此服务。引擎会从这组编号服务中分配一个，在应用主进程之外处理网页内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 如果停用此服务，GeckoView 在分配到它来启动页面进程时可能失败，相关标签页可能无法加载或正常运行。

en.description: Mozilla GeckoView, including the CENO Developers fork for CENO Browser, starts this Service when it requests a separate utility process. The Service starts Gecko there and connects the process to the engine.
en.disableEffect: If GeckoView requests this process while it is disabled, utility work assigned to it cannot start and browser features that require that work may fail.

zh-CN.description: Mozilla GeckoView（包括 CENO Developers 为 CENO Browser 提供的分支）请求独立辅助进程时会启动此服务。此服务会在该进程中启动 Gecko，并将其连接到引擎。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，GeckoView 请求此进程时，分配给它的辅助任务将无法启动，依赖这些任务的浏览器功能可能异常。

en.description: Mozilla GeckoView, including the CENO Developers fork for CENO Browser, starts this Service on Android 10 or later when app-zygote mode is enabled and it needs an isolated process for web page content. This process runs the Gecko child that handles the page.
en.disableEffect: If app-zygote mode is enabled, disabling this Service can prevent GeckoView from starting isolated page processes, so affected tabs may fail to load; when the mode is off, GeckoView does not select this Service.

zh-CN.description: 在 Android 10 及以上版本启用了应用 Zygote 模式并需要网页隔离进程时，Mozilla GeckoView（包括 CENO Developers 的 CENO Browser 分支）会启动此服务。该进程运行负责网页内容的 Gecko 子进程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 如果启用了应用 Zygote 模式，停用此服务可能使 GeckoView 无法启动隔离的页面进程，相关标签页可能无法加载；未启用该模式时，引擎不会选择此服务。

en.description: When an app starts Multipaz's credential-presentation flow, this screen shows connection, sharing, waiting, and failure prompts while a digital identity credential is presented to a reader.
en.disableEffect: The app will not be able to show this presentation flow, so users cannot complete credential sharing through it.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动 Multipaz 凭据出示流程时，此界面会在向读取设备出示数字身份凭据期间显示连接、共享、等待和失败提示。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法显示此出示流程，用户也无法通过它完成凭据共享。

en.description: The MyGuide (EdCast) guide SDK starts this service to show a movable shortcut while guides are available. Tapping the shortcut opens the guide home screen for signed-in users.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it removes the floating shortcut used to open MyGuide guides.

zh-CN.description: MyGuide（EdCast）指南 SDK 会启动此服务，在有可用指南时显示可移动的快捷入口。已登录用户点按入口后可打开指南主页。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用于打开 MyGuide 指南的悬浮入口将不可用。

en.description: The MyGuide (EdCast) guide SDK starts this service during a screen walkthrough. It displays guide steps over the app and lets the user move through or close them.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents MyGuide interactive walkthroughs from appearing.

zh-CN.description: MyGuide（EdCast）指南 SDK 会在播放界面引导时启动此服务。它会在应用界面上显示引导步骤，供用户继续、返回或关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，MyGuide 的交互式界面引导将无法显示。

en.description: The MyGuide (EdCast) guide SDK opens this screen when someone selects a guide. It shows the guide title and details before playback.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from opening MyGuide guide details.

zh-CN.description: MyGuide（EdCast）指南 SDK 会在用户选择指南时打开此页面，显示指南标题和详情，供用户开始播放前查看。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法打开 MyGuide 指南详情。

en.description: The MyGuide (EdCast) guide SDK opens this full-screen home screen so users can browse available guides.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from opening the MyGuide guide list.

zh-CN.description: MyGuide（EdCast）指南 SDK 会打开此全屏主页，供用户浏览可用指南。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法打开 MyGuide 指南列表。

en.description: This Machbird Account provider stores account, profile, and shared data in the app's local database for the SDK's account screens.
en.disableEffect: Machbird account and profile flows will not be able to read or update their saved local data.

zh-CN.description: 此 Machbird Account Provider 会在应用本地数据库中保存账户、个人资料和共享数据，供 SDK 的账户页面使用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Machbird 账户和个人资料流程将无法读取或更新已保存的本地数据。

en.description: When a user changes the Machbird account photo, this screen lets them crop the selected image and return the finished picture.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to crop a new account photo through Machbird.

zh-CN.description: 用户更换 Machbird 账户照片时，此页面可裁剪选中的图片并返回处理后的照片。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 Machbird 裁剪新的账户照片。

en.description: This Machbird Account screen edits profile text, education, address, or interests and returns the changes to the profile page.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to edit these Machbird account profile details.

zh-CN.description: 此 Machbird Account 页面可编辑个人资料文字、教育经历、地址或兴趣，并将更改返回个人资料页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法编辑这些 Machbird 账户资料。

en.description: This Machbird Account page supports email registration by sending and checking verification codes before continuing.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to complete email registration through this Machbird page.

zh-CN.description: 此 Machbird Account 页面通过发送和验证验证码来支持邮箱注册。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此 Machbird 页面完成邮箱注册。

en.description: This is the Machbird Account sign-in screen, with Google, Facebook, phone, and email sign-in options.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to open this Machbird Account sign-in screen.

zh-CN.description: 这是 Machbird Account 登录页面，提供 Google、Facebook、手机号和邮箱登录方式。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开此 Machbird Account 登录页面。

en.description: This Machbird Account screen registers or verifies a phone number using an SMS code and a selected country or region.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to register or verify a phone account through this screen.

zh-CN.description: 此 Machbird Account 页面使用短信验证码和所选国家或地区来注册或验证手机号。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此页面注册或验证手机号账户。

en.description: This Machbird Account page shows the user's profile and lets them change personal details and their account photo.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to view or edit their Machbird account profile here.

zh-CN.description: 此 Machbird Account 页面会显示用户资料，并允许更改个人信息和账户照片。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在此查看或编辑 Machbird 账户资料。

en.description: This Machbird Account screen lets users choose a country or region for phone account flows and returns that choice to the previous page.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to choose a country or region in Machbird phone account flows.

zh-CN.description: 此 Machbird Account 页面供用户选择国家或地区，并将选择结果返回上一页面，用于手机号账户流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在 Machbird 手机号账户流程中选择国家或地区。

en.description: The Nexage MRAID browser bundled with Appodeal opens rich-media ad destinations in an in-app web view. It provides navigation controls and handles supported links from the ad.
en.disableEffect: Rich-media ad pages and their landing links may no longer open; the host app's non-ad features remain available.

zh-CN.description: Appodeal 内置的 Nexage MRAID 浏览器会在应用内网页中打开富媒体广告页面，并提供导航控件和广告支持的链接处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 富媒体广告页面及其落地链接可能无法打开；应用的非广告功能仍可使用。

en.description: Appodeal Ads’ bundled video player opens this screen for full-screen video ads, including rewarded placements.
en.disableEffect: These video ads will not play, and rewards for watching rewarded ads will no longer be granted; other app features continue to work.

zh-CN.description: Appodeal 的 SourceKit VAST 播放器会打开此页面播放全屏视频广告，包括奖励型广告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 此类视频广告将无法播放，观看奖励型广告也不再获得奖励；应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: Appodeal Ads’ bundled interactive video player opens this screen for interactive ads, including rewarded placements.
en.disableEffect: These interactive video ads will not open, and rewards for watching rewarded ads will no longer be granted; other app features continue to work.

zh-CN.description: Appodeal 的 SourceKit VPAID 播放器会打开此页面播放互动视频广告，包括奖励型广告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 此类互动视频广告将无法打开，观看奖励型广告也不再获得奖励；应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: When Mypoolin's NPCI UPI credential library binds this Service, it provides the remote interface that carries bank credential requests and responses for payment verification.
en.disableEffect: UPI authentication requests cannot reach the credential flow, preventing affected UPI payments.

zh-CN.description: Mypoolin 的 NPCI UPI 凭据库绑定此 Service 时，它会提供远程接口，在支付验证期间传递银行凭据请求和响应。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，UPI 认证请求无法进入凭据验证流程，相关 UPI 支付将无法完成。

en.description: When NPCI's UPI library starts an authentication request, this screen asks for bank credentials such as a UPI PIN or one-time code and returns the result; it can detect SMS codes when the app has the required permission.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot complete the affected UPI credential or payment verification flow.

zh-CN.description: NPCI 的 UPI 库发起认证请求时，此界面会要求用户输入 UPI 密码或一次性验证码等银行凭据并返回结果；获得所需权限后，也可识别短信验证码。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法完成相关 UPI 凭据验证或支付认证流程。

en.description: Machbird starts this private app-process service to handle background requests for the SDK's user and device information module.
en.disableEffect: Machbird's background user and device information requests will not run.

zh-CN.description: Machbird 会在应用进程内启动此私有 Service，以处理 SDK 用户和设备信息模块的后台请求。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Machbird 的用户和设备信息后台请求将无法运行。

en.description: The About screen in Samagra's ODK Collect client opens from the app menu and lists the project website, community forum, sharing and review links, and open-source licenses.
en.disableEffect: You will lose the About page and its links and license list.

zh-CN.description: Samagra 构建的 ODK Collect 客户端会从应用菜单打开“关于”页面，其中列出项目网站、社区论坛、分享与评价入口以及开源许可证。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后将无法打开“关于”页面及其中的链接和许可证列表。

en.description: When an ODK Collect form asks for a compass bearing, this screen reads the device compass sensors and returns the measured direction to the form. It is part of the Samagra ODK Collect client.
en.disableEffect: Compass-bearing questions in forms will no longer be answerable.

zh-CN.description: 当 ODK Collect 表单要求记录方位角时，此页面会读取设备的罗盘传感器，并把测得的方向返回给表单。 它是 Samagra 构建的 ODK Collect 客户端的一部分。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后将无法填写表单中的罗盘方位角问题。

en.description: After ODK Collect detects a crash from an earlier run during startup, this screen shows the crash recovery view and can return the user to the main menu. It is part of the Samagra ODK Collect client.
en.disableEffect: The crash recovery screen and its route back to the main menu will be unavailable after a detected crash.

zh-CN.description: ODK Collect 启动时发现上次运行发生崩溃后，会显示此恢复页面，并可从这里返回主菜单。 它是 Samagra 构建的 ODK Collect 客户端的一部分。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，检测到崩溃时将无法显示恢复页面或从这里返回主菜单。

en.description: Choosing Manage Files in Samagra's ODK Collect client opens tabs for saved data and forms so users can review and manage them.
en.disableEffect: You will lose the in-app screen for managing saved data and forms.

zh-CN.description: 在 Samagra 构建的 ODK Collect 客户端中选择“管理文件”后，此页面会显示已保存数据和表单的分页，供用户查看和管理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后将无法在应用内管理已保存的数据和表单。

en.description: When ODK Collect has no project configured, this first-run screen lets the user set one up with a QR code, configure it manually, or continue with the demo project. It is part of the Samagra ODK Collect client.
en.disableEffect: A new or unconfigured ODK Collect installation will have no setup screen for creating or selecting a project.

zh-CN.description: ODK Collect 尚未配置项目时，此首次启动页面可通过二维码或手动方式设置项目，也可继续使用演示项目。 它是 Samagra 构建的 ODK Collect 客户端的一部分。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 新安装或尚未配置的 ODK Collect 将无法通过此页面创建或选择项目。

en.description: When another app asks Samagra's ODK Collect client to choose or open a form, this entry opens the available-form list and returns or opens the selected form.
en.disableEffect: Other apps will no longer be able to use ODK Collect's form chooser entry point.

zh-CN.description: 其他应用请求 Samagra 构建的 ODK Collect 客户端选择或打开表单时，此入口会显示可用表单，并返回或打开所选表单。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，其他应用将无法通过此入口使用 ODK Collect 的表单选择器。

en.description: When ODK Collect is asked to open its form-download screen, this entry routes the user to the list of forms available from the configured server. It is part of the Samagra ODK Collect client.
en.disableEffect: The form-download screen will no longer open through ODK Collect's external entry point.

zh-CN.description: 请求 ODK Collect 打开表单下载页面时，此入口会转到已配置服务器上的可用表单列表。 它是 Samagra 构建的 ODK Collect 客户端的一部分。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，其他入口将无法通过此入口打开 ODK Collect 的表单下载页面。

en.description: From Get Forms or an external request, Samagra's ODK Collect client lists forms on the configured server and downloads the selected forms and their media.
en.disableEffect: Users will no longer be able to browse and download forms from the configured server.

zh-CN.description: 从“获取表单”或外部请求进入后，Samagra 构建的 ODK Collect 客户端会列出已配置服务器上的表单，并下载所选表单及其媒体文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法浏览并下载已配置服务器上的表单。

en.description: After a user selects a form or opens a saved response, Samagra's ODK Collect client displays its questions, accepts answers, and saves form progress.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to fill in, edit, or review forms through this screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择表单或打开已保存的答卷后，Samagra 构建的 ODK Collect 客户端会显示问题、接收答案并保存填写进度。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法通过此页面填写、编辑或查看表单。

en.description: While a form is open in ODK Collect, this screen shows its question and group hierarchy so the user can jump directly to a section. It is part of the Samagra ODK Collect client.
en.disableEffect: Users will lose the form's question and group navigation view.

zh-CN.description: 在 ODK Collect 中填写表单时，此页面会显示问题和分组层级，方便用户直接跳转到某个部分。 它是 Samagra 构建的 ODK Collect 客户端的一部分。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法通过问题和分组层级浏览表单。

en.description: From the map control beside a form, ODK Collect shows that form's mapped records; selecting a record opens it for editing, while the map can also start a new record. It is part of the Samagra ODK Collect client.
en.disableEffect: Users will lose the map-based way to locate, edit, or start records for a form.

zh-CN.description: 在表单旁选择地图入口后，ODK Collect 会显示该表单的地图记录；选择已有记录可进行编辑，也可从地图开始新记录。 它是 Samagra 构建的 ODK Collect 客户端的一部分。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法通过地图查找、编辑或新建该表单的记录。

en.description: From Review Data or View Sent Forms, Samagra's ODK Collect client lists saved responses; choosing one opens it for editing or review, or returns it to an app that requested a selection.
en.disableEffect: Users will lose the saved-response chooser used for reviewing, editing, and selecting records.

zh-CN.description: 从“查看数据”或“查看已发送表单”进入后，Samagra 构建的 ODK Collect 客户端会列出已保存答卷；选择答卷可进行编辑或查看，也可返回给发起选择请求的应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法通过此选择器查看、编辑或选取已保存答卷。

en.description: After selected responses are sent for submission, this ODK Collect screen uploads them to the configured server and reports the result. It is part of the Samagra ODK Collect client.
en.disableEffect: The server-upload step for selected form responses will no longer work.

zh-CN.description: 选中答卷并发起提交后，ODK Collect 会通过此页面将答卷上传到已配置的服务器并显示结果。 它是 Samagra 构建的 ODK Collect 客户端的一部分。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，所选表单答卷将无法通过此流程上传到服务器。

en.description: When another app opens ODK Collect's send-data screen, this entry routes the user to the list of saved responses awaiting submission. It is part of the Samagra ODK Collect client.
en.disableEffect: Other apps will no longer be able to open ODK Collect's send-data list through this entry.

zh-CN.description: 其他应用打开 ODK Collect 的发送数据页面时，此入口会转到等待提交的已保存答卷列表。 它是 Samagra 构建的 ODK Collect 客户端的一部分。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，其他应用将无法通过此入口打开 ODK Collect 的发送数据列表。

en.description: From Send Data, Samagra's ODK Collect client lists saved responses, lets users select records, and submits them to the configured server or Google Sheets.
en.disableEffect: Users will no longer be able to select and submit saved responses from the app.

zh-CN.description: 从“发送数据”进入后，Samagra 构建的 ODK Collect 客户端会列出已保存答卷，供用户选择并提交到已配置的服务器或 Google 表格。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法在应用中选择并提交已保存的答卷。

en.description: When Samagra's ODK Collect client launches, this main menu opens the project and provides routes to enter, review, send, and download form data and manage files.
en.disableEffect: The app's main screen and its routes to core form workflows will be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: Samagra 构建的 ODK Collect 客户端启动后，此主菜单会打开当前项目，并提供填写、查看、发送和下载表单数据以及管理文件的入口。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用主界面及其核心表单流程入口将无法使用。

en.description: When a form asks the user to scan a barcode, ODK Collect opens this full-screen camera view to read it, with flashlight support. It is part of the Samagra ODK Collect client.
en.disableEffect: Barcode questions in forms will no longer be answerable with the built-in scanner.

zh-CN.description: 表单要求扫描条码时，ODK Collect 会打开此全屏相机页面读取条码，并支持使用闪光灯。 它是 Samagra 构建的 ODK Collect 客户端的一部分。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法使用内置扫描器回答条码问题。

en.description: During a read-only form review, ODK Collect shows the question and group hierarchy and provides an exit control without allowing edits. It is part of the Samagra ODK Collect client.
en.disableEffect: Users will lose the read-only hierarchy view for reviewing a form.

zh-CN.description: 只读查看表单时，ODK Collect 会显示问题和分组层级，并提供退出入口，但不允许编辑。 它是 Samagra 构建的 ODK Collect 客户端的一部分。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法通过只读层级页面查看表单。

en.description: If ODK Collect needs to display a project page inside the app, this screen loads the supplied web address and shows page-loading progress. It is part of the Samagra ODK Collect client.
en.disableEffect: Project pages that fall back to the in-app browser will no longer open there.

zh-CN.description: ODK Collect 需要在应用内显示项目网页时，此页面会加载指定网址并显示加载进度。 它是 Samagra 构建的 ODK Collect 客户端的一部分。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，无法通过应用内浏览器打开需要回退到该方式的项目网页。

en.description: From project settings, ODK Collect opens tabs to scan a configuration QR code or display a QR code for the current app settings. It is part of the Samagra ODK Collect client.
en.disableEffect: Users will lose the QR-based project configuration and sharing screen.

zh-CN.description: 从项目设置进入后，ODK Collect 会显示二维码扫描和查看当前应用设置二维码的分页。 它是 Samagra 构建的 ODK Collect 客户端的一部分。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法通过二维码配置或分享项目设置。

en.description: When a form image question requests a drawing, ODK Collect opens a canvas where the user can draw or annotate an image and save it back to the form. It is part of the Samagra ODK Collect client.
en.disableEffect: Users will lose the drawing and image-annotation answer option in forms.

zh-CN.description: 表单中的图像问题要求绘图时，ODK Collect 会打开画布，供用户绘制或标注图像并保存回表单。 它是 Samagra 构建的 ODK Collect 客户端的一部分。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法在表单中使用绘图或图像标注作为答案。

en.description: When Android asks ODK Collect to create a shortcut, this screen lets the user choose a form and returns a shortcut that opens it. It is part of the Samagra ODK Collect client.
en.disableEffect: Users will no longer be able to create home-screen shortcuts for individual forms.

zh-CN.description: Android 请求 ODK Collect 创建快捷方式时，此页面会让用户选择表单，并返回可直接打开该表单的快捷方式。 它是 Samagra 构建的 ODK Collect 客户端的一部分。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法为单个表单创建主屏幕快捷方式。

en.description: When another app opens a form or saved-response link in ODK Collect, this screen checks the project and passes the request to the form screen. It is part of the Samagra ODK Collect client.
en.disableEffect: External links will no longer be able to open forms or saved responses in ODK Collect.

zh-CN.description: 其他应用通过链接在 ODK Collect 中打开表单或已保存答卷时，此页面会检查项目并将请求交给表单页面处理。 它是 Samagra 构建的 ODK Collect 客户端的一部分。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，外部链接将无法在 ODK Collect 中打开表单或已保存答卷。

en.description: Other apps that integrate with Samagra's ODK Collect client can use this provider to find, add, update, or remove project forms.
en.disableEffect: Integrated apps will no longer be able to access or manage ODK forms through this provider.

zh-CN.description: 与 Samagra 构建的 ODK Collect 客户端集成的其他应用可通过此内容提供器查找、新增、更新或删除项目表单。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，集成应用将无法通过此提供器访问或管理 ODK 表单。

en.description: Other apps that integrate with Samagra's ODK Collect client can use this provider to read, add, update, or remove saved form responses.
en.disableEffect: Integrated apps will no longer be able to access or manage saved responses through this provider.

zh-CN.description: 与 Samagra 构建的 ODK Collect 客户端集成的其他应用可通过此内容提供器读取、新增、更新或删除已保存的表单答卷。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，集成应用将无法通过此提供器访问或管理已保存的答卷。

en.description: When users choose Enter Data, Samagra's ODK Collect client lists available blank forms and opens a selected form for a new response.
en.disableEffect: Users will no longer be able to choose a blank form and start a new response from the app.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择“填写数据”后，Samagra 构建的 ODK Collect 客户端会列出可用空白表单，并打开所选表单以新建答卷。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法在应用中选择空白表单并开始填写新答卷。

en.description: For a project configured to use Google Drive, ODK Collect opens the user's Drive folders and downloads selected forms into the project. It is part of the Samagra ODK Collect client.
en.disableEffect: Users will no longer be able to browse Google Drive and download forms through ODK Collect.

zh-CN.description: 项目配置为使用 Google Drive 时，ODK Collect 会打开用户的云端硬盘文件夹，并将所选表单下载到项目中。 它是 Samagra 构建的 ODK Collect 客户端的一部分。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法通过 ODK Collect 浏览 Google Drive 并下载表单。

en.description: When a project submits data to Google Sheets, ODK Collect uses this screen to authorize the account and upload the selected form responses. It is part of the Samagra ODK Collect client.
en.disableEffect: Selected form responses will no longer be submitted to Google Sheets through ODK Collect.

zh-CN.description: 项目使用 Google 表格提交数据时，ODK Collect 会通过此页面授权账户并上传所选表单答卷。 它是 Samagra 构建的 ODK Collect 客户端的一部分。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，所选表单答卷将无法通过 ODK Collect 提交到 Google 表格。

en.description: When users open project settings in Samagra's ODK Collect client, this screen displays the settings and applies changes for the current project.
en.disableEffect: Users will no longer be able to open or change project settings.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Samagra 构建的 ODK Collect 客户端中打开项目设置时，此页面会显示当前项目的设置并应用更改。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法打开或修改项目设置。

en.description: When the user taps ODK Collect's location-tracking notification, this brief screen closes immediately so the existing app screen can return to the foreground. It is part of the Samagra ODK Collect client.
en.disableEffect: Tapping the location-tracking notification will no longer return the user to the open ODK Collect screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户点按 ODK Collect 的位置跟踪通知时，此短暂页面会立即关闭，让已打开的应用页面回到前台。 它是 Samagra 构建的 ODK Collect 客户端的一部分。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，点按位置跟踪通知将无法返回已打开的 ODK Collect 页面。

en.description: When an ODK Collect form records an audio answer, this foreground service starts, pauses, resumes, and saves the recording while the form is being filled. It is part of the Samagra ODK Collect client.
en.disableEffect: Audio-recording questions will no longer be able to record and save audio.

zh-CN.description: ODK Collect 表单录制音频答案时，此前台服务会在填写过程中启动、暂停、恢复并保存录音。 它是 Samagra 构建的 ODK Collect 客户端的一部分。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，音频录制问题将无法录制和保存音频。

en.description: From ODK Collect's entity tools, this screen lets the user browse available entity datasets and inspect the records in a selected dataset. It is part of the Samagra ODK Collect client.
en.disableEffect: Users will lose the in-app browser for entity datasets and their records.

zh-CN.description: 从 ODK Collect 的实体工具进入后，此页面可浏览实体数据集，并查看所选数据集中的记录。 它是 Samagra 构建的 ODK Collect 客户端的一部分。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法在应用内浏览实体数据集及其记录。

en.description: When a form download or submission flow opens its error list, ODK Collect displays the supplied problems in a readable list. It is part of the Samagra ODK Collect client.
en.disableEffect: Users will no longer be able to open the detailed error list for failed form transfers.

zh-CN.description: 表单下载或提交流程打开错误列表时，ODK Collect 会以列表形式显示相关问题。 它是 Samagra 构建的 ODK Collect 客户端的一部分。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法查看表单传输失败时的详细错误列表。

en.description: When a form requests a location point, ODK Collect opens this location-entry dialog, gathers a GPS position, and returns it to the form. It is part of the Samagra ODK Collect client.
en.disableEffect: Location-point questions will no longer be answerable with this built-in location screen.

zh-CN.description: 表单要求记录地点时，ODK Collect 会打开此定位对话框，获取 GPS 位置并返回给表单。 它是 Samagra 构建的 ODK Collect 客户端的一部分。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法通过内置定位页面回答地点问题。

en.description: When a form uses a map to answer a location-point question, ODK Collect opens this map so the user can place or adjust the point. It is part of the Samagra ODK Collect client.
en.disableEffect: Users will lose the map-based way to set or adjust a location-point answer.

zh-CN.description: 表单使用地图回答地点问题时，ODK Collect 会打开此地图，供用户放置或调整位置点。 它是 Samagra 构建的 ODK Collect 客户端的一部分。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法通过地图设置或调整地点答案。

en.description: When a form asks the user to map a line or area, ODK Collect opens a map for placing points or recording a GPS path, then returns the shape to the form. It is part of the Samagra ODK Collect client.
en.disableEffect: Line and area mapping questions will no longer be answerable through the built-in map.

zh-CN.description: 表单要求绘制路线或区域时，ODK Collect 会打开地图，让用户放置点或记录 GPS 轨迹，再将图形返回给表单。 它是 Samagra 构建的 ODK Collect 客户端的一部分。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法通过内置地图回答路线和区域绘制问题。

en.description: When ODK Collect records a location path in the background, this foreground service keeps location updates running and shows the tracking notification. It is part of the Samagra ODK Collect client.
en.disableEffect: Background GPS path recording in forms will stop working.

zh-CN.description: ODK Collect 在后台记录位置轨迹时，此前台服务会持续获取位置更新并显示跟踪通知。 它是 Samagra 构建的 ODK Collect 客户端的一部分。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，表单中的后台 GPS 轨迹记录将无法工作。

en.description: When a form requests a selfie or video capture, ODK Collect opens this camera screen, checks camera permission, and returns the captured file to the form. It is part of the Samagra ODK Collect client.
en.disableEffect: Selfie and video-capture questions will no longer be able to capture their requested media.
