zh-CN.description: 表单要求拍摄自拍照或视频时，ODK Collect 会打开此相机页面、检查相机权限，并将拍摄文件返回给表单。 它是 Samagra 构建的 ODK Collect 客户端的一部分。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，自拍照和视频问题将无法拍摄所需媒体。

en.description: When opened, this OpenCV sample shows a live camera view and offers calibration controls for capturing patterns and calculating camera settings.
en.disableEffect: The app’s OpenCV camera calibration demo will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: 打开此 OpenCV 示例后，它会显示实时相机画面，并提供采集校准图案、计算相机参数的操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，应用中的 OpenCV 相机校准示例将无法打开。

en.description: When opened, this OpenCV sample shows a live camera view; tapping a color in the preview makes it highlight matching color regions.
en.disableEffect: The app’s OpenCV color tracking demo will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: 打开此 OpenCV 示例后，它会显示实时相机画面；点击画面中的颜色后，示例会突出显示相近颜色的区域。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，应用中的 OpenCV 颜色追踪示例将无法打开。

en.description: When opened, this OpenCV sample loads its bundled face detection model and marks detected faces on the live camera view.
en.disableEffect: The app’s OpenCV face detection demo will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: 打开此 OpenCV 示例后，它会载入内置的人脸检测模型，并在实时相机画面上标出检测到的人脸。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，应用中的 OpenCV 人脸检测示例将无法打开。

en.description: This older OpenCV face detection sample shows a live camera view and marks faces found with its bundled classifier.
en.disableEffect: The app’s older OpenCV face detection demo will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: 这个较早版本的 OpenCV 人脸检测示例会显示实时相机画面，并用内置分类模型标出检测到的人脸。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，应用中较早版本的 OpenCV 人脸检测示例将无法打开。

en.description: When opened, this OpenCV sample shows a live camera view with selectable image effects, including edge detection, color changes, and zoomed views.
en.disableEffect: The app’s OpenCV camera effects demo will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: 打开此 OpenCV 示例后，它会显示实时相机画面，并可切换边缘检测、颜色变换和局部放大等图像效果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，应用中的 OpenCV 相机图像效果示例将无法打开。

en.description: When opened, this OpenCV sample overlays a 15-piece sliding puzzle on the camera view; touching the screen moves the tiles.
en.disableEffect: The app’s OpenCV camera puzzle demo will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: 打开此 OpenCV 示例后，15 格滑动拼图会叠加在相机画面上；触摸屏幕可以移动拼图片。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，应用中的 OpenCV 相机拼图示例将无法打开。

en.description: When opened, this OpenCV tutorial displays a live preview from the device camera.
en.disableEffect: The app’s OpenCV camera preview tutorial will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: 打开此 OpenCV 教程后，它会显示设备相机的实时预览画面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，应用中的 OpenCV 相机预览教程将无法打开。

en.description: When opened, this OpenCV tutorial displays a live camera view and lets the user switch between a grayscale preview and edge outlines.
en.disableEffect: The app’s OpenCV image processing tutorial will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: 打开此 OpenCV 教程后，它会显示实时相机画面，并可在灰度预览和边缘轮廓效果之间切换。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，应用中的 OpenCV 图像处理教程将无法打开。

en.description: When opened, this OpenCV tutorial initializes the device camera and displays its live preview.
en.disableEffect: The app’s OpenCV camera tutorial will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: 打开此 OpenCV 教程后，它会启动设备相机并显示实时预览画面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，应用中的 OpenCV 相机教程将无法打开。

en.description: The OpenZiti Android SDK opens the system file picker when someone enrolls a device in a private network. The selected enrollment file is then used to connect the device.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents file-based OpenZiti network enrollment.

zh-CN.description: OpenZiti Android SDK 会在用户将设备加入专用网络时打开系统文件选择器，随后使用所选的注册文件完成设备注册。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，基于文件的 OpenZiti 网络注册将无法完成。

en.description: The OpenZiti Android SDK uses this file provider when someone sends diagnostic feedback, so the app can attach its log archive to a support message.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents the app from attaching OpenZiti logs to feedback and may interrupt that support action.

zh-CN.description: OpenZiti Android SDK 会在用户发送诊断反馈时通过此文件提供器，让应用将日志压缩包附加到支持消息中。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用将无法在反馈中附加 OpenZiti 日志，相关支持操作也可能中断。

en.description: The Pireco KYP SDK opens this setup screen for camera-based verification or registration. Users can choose an action and adjust capture controls before continuing to the camera flow.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from starting KYP verification or registration through the SDK screen.

zh-CN.description: Pireco KYP SDK 会打开此设置页面，用于启动基于相机的验证或注册。用户可以选择操作、调整拍摄控件，然后进入相机流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法通过 SDK 页面启动 KYP 验证或注册。

en.description: The Pireco KYP SDK uses this camera screen to capture and process face images for verification or registration, then returns the result to the app.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents the KYP camera capture and verification or registration result from completing.

zh-CN.description: Pireco KYP SDK 会通过此相机页面拍摄并处理人脸图像以进行验证或注册，随后将结果返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，KYP 相机拍摄以及验证或注册结果流程将无法完成。

en.description: The MyGuide (EdCast) guide SDK starts this service to show a movable shortcut for opening the guide list.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it removes the floating shortcut used to reach MyGuide guides.

zh-CN.description: MyGuide（EdCast）指南 SDK 会启动此服务，显示用于打开指南列表的可移动入口。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用于进入 MyGuide 指南的悬浮入口将不可用。

en.description: The MyGuide (EdCast) Creator SDK starts this service when a guide author records a walkthrough. It tracks screen steps and provides floating recording controls.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents authors from recording MyGuide walkthroughs.

zh-CN.description: MyGuide（EdCast）Creator SDK 会在作者录制界面引导时启动此服务，记录屏幕步骤并提供悬浮录制控件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，作者将无法录制 MyGuide 界面引导。

en.description: The MyGuide (EdCast) guide SDK starts this service while playing a walkthrough. It places guide steps over the app and provides controls to continue, go back, or close.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents MyGuide walkthrough steps from appearing over the app.

zh-CN.description: MyGuide（EdCast）指南 SDK 会在播放界面引导时启动此服务，在应用界面上显示引导步骤，并提供继续、返回和关闭控件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，MyGuide 的界面引导步骤将无法显示。

en.description: The MyGuide (EdCast) Player SDK uses this service to play guide steps over the app, including messages, images, and video, with controls to continue or finish.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from playing MyGuide walkthroughs.

zh-CN.description: MyGuide（EdCast）Player SDK 会通过此服务在应用界面上播放指南步骤，包括文字、图片和视频，并提供继续或结束控件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法播放 MyGuide 界面引导。

en.description: The MyGuide (EdCast) Creator SDK opens this screen while an author edits a recorded guide step. The author can enter and save the step title.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents authors from reviewing and renaming recorded guide steps.

zh-CN.description: MyGuide（EdCast）Creator SDK 会在作者编辑录制的指南步骤时打开此页面，供作者填写并保存步骤标题。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，作者将无法在此页面检查或重命名录制的指南步骤。

en.description: The MyGuide (EdCast) guide SDK opens this screen when someone selects a guide. It shows the guide details and available steps.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from opening MyGuide guide details.

zh-CN.description: MyGuide（EdCast）指南 SDK 会在用户选择指南时打开此页面，显示指南详情和可用步骤。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法打开 MyGuide 指南详情。

en.description: The MyGuide (EdCast) guide SDK opens this full-screen home screen so users can browse available guides.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from opening the MyGuide guide browser.

zh-CN.description: MyGuide（EdCast）指南 SDK 会打开此全屏主页，供用户浏览可用指南。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法打开 MyGuide 指南浏览页面。

en.description: The MyGuide (EdCast) Creator SDK opens this screen when an author trims a video for a guide. It previews the clip and returns the trimmed video when confirmed.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents authors from trimming video clips for MyGuide guides.

zh-CN.description: MyGuide（EdCast）Creator SDK 会在作者为指南剪辑视频时打开此页面，预览片段并在确认后返回剪好的视频。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，作者将无法为 MyGuide 指南剪辑视频片段。

en.description: The Prebid Mobile advertising SDK opens this in-app browser when someone taps an ad landing link. It can display a web page or video with navigation controls.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it stops ad landing links from opening in this embedded browser.

zh-CN.description: Prebid Mobile 广告 SDK 会在用户点按广告落地页链接时打开此应用内浏览器，可显示网页或视频并提供导航控件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，广告落地页链接将无法在此内置浏览器中打开。

en.description: PublicValue’s Kotlin Multiplatform OIDC support library opens this Activity when a browser-based OpenID Connect sign-in returns to the app. It passes the sign-in response back and can open the sign-in page in a browser or an in-app web view.
en.disableEffect: Users may be unable to complete browser-based sign-in or return to the app after signing in.

zh-CN.description: PublicValue 的 Kotlin Multiplatform OIDC 支持库会在浏览器登录完成并跳回应用时打开此 Activity，将登录响应交还应用；它也可在浏览器或应用内网页中打开登录页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户可能无法完成浏览器登录，或无法在登录后返回应用。

en.description: When RADAR-base background monitoring starts this source, it reports app and device status such as the app version, time zone, uptime, connection state, and queued or sent record counts. It can also send device details to the monitoring service.
en.disableEffect: The monitoring service will stop receiving this app and device health and upload-status data.

zh-CN.description: RADAR-base 后台监测启动此数据源后，它会报告应用和设备状态，例如应用版本、时区、运行时间、连接状态以及排队或已发送的数据条数，也可向监测服务发送设备信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 监测服务将不再收到此应用和设备的健康状态及数据上传状态。

en.description: When a RADAR-base audio collection interval runs (one hour by default), this service records a short microphone sample, 15 seconds by default, and processes it into audio features for upload.
en.disableEffect: RADAR-base will stop recording and sending audio features from the phone microphone.

zh-CN.description: RADAR-base 的音频采集间隔到达时（默认每小时一次），此服务会录制一段较短的麦克风音频（默认 15 秒），并处理成音频特征后上传。
zh-CN.disableEffect: RADAR-base 将无法继续通过手机麦克风采集并发送音频特征。

en.description: When RADAR-base collection is configured for a nearby Bittium Faros monitor, this service connects to the device and collects acceleration, ECG, heartbeat intervals, temperature, and battery readings.
en.disableEffect: RADAR-base will stop collecting data from Bittium Faros monitors.

zh-CN.description: 当 RADAR-base 配置为采集附近 Bittium Faros 设备的数据时，此服务会连接设备并采集加速度、心电、心搏间隔、温度和电量信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: RADAR-base 将无法继续采集 Bittium Faros 设备的数据。

en.description: When RADAR-base collection is configured for an Empatica E4 wristband, this service scans for and connects to the band, then collects movement, pulse, blood-volume pulse, skin response, heartbeat intervals, temperature, battery, and device status.
en.disableEffect: RADAR-base will stop connecting to Empatica E4 wristbands and collecting their sensor readings.

zh-CN.description: 当 RADAR-base 配置为采集 Empatica E4 腕带数据时，此服务会搜索并连接腕带，然后采集运动、脉搏、血容量脉搏、皮肤反应、心搏间隔、温度、电量和设备状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: RADAR-base 将无法连接 Empatica E4 腕带或继续采集其传感器数据。

en.description: When RADAR-base activity collection is enabled, this service asks Google Activity Recognition for changes in movement activity and sends the detected transitions to the monitoring service.
en.disableEffect: RADAR-base will stop receiving recognized activity changes such as walking or stillness.

zh-CN.description: 启用 RADAR-base 活动采集后，此服务会向 Google 活动识别请求运动状态变化，并将识别到的状态转换发送给监测服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: RADAR-base 将无法继续收到步行、静止等已识别的活动变化。

en.description: When a location update or scheduled lookup triggers RADAR-base place collection, this service asks Google Places for nearby place matches and reports the likely places and available place details.
en.disableEffect: RADAR-base will stop identifying and reporting nearby places from the phone's location.

zh-CN.description: 位置更新或定时查询触发 RADAR-base 地点采集时，此服务会向 Google Places 查询附近地点，并报告可能的地点及可用的地点信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: RADAR-base 将无法继续根据手机位置识别并报告附近地点。

en.description: When RADAR-base sleep collection is enabled, this service asks Google Activity Recognition for sleep segments and classification updates, then sends the detected sleep periods to the monitoring service.
en.disableEffect: RADAR-base will stop receiving sleep-period and sleep-classification data from Google.

zh-CN.description: 启用 RADAR-base 睡眠采集后，此服务会向 Google 活动识别请求睡眠时段和分类更新，并将识别到的睡眠时段发送给监测服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: RADAR-base 将无法继续收到 Google 提供的睡眠时段和睡眠分类数据。

en.description: When RADAR-base Bluetooth collection runs, this service discovers nearby Bluetooth devices and reports discovery results, paired-device counts, and protected device identifiers.
en.disableEffect: RADAR-base will stop collecting nearby and paired Bluetooth-device information.

zh-CN.description: RADAR-base 蓝牙采集运行时，此服务会搜索附近的蓝牙设备，并报告搜索结果、已配对设备数量及经过保护的设备标识。
zh-CN.disableEffect: RADAR-base 将无法继续采集附近及已配对蓝牙设备的信息。

en.description: When RADAR-base contact-list collection runs, this service checks the phone's contacts and reports the total count and detected additions or removals.
en.disableEffect: RADAR-base will stop receiving contact-count and contact-list change data.

zh-CN.description: RADAR-base 联系人列表采集运行时，此服务会检查手机联系人，并报告联系人总数以及检测到的新增或删除情况。
zh-CN.disableEffect: RADAR-base 将无法继续收到联系人数量及联系人列表变化数据。

en.description: When RADAR-base location collection runs, this service receives GPS or network location updates at configured intervals and reports location, using relative coordinates by default.
en.disableEffect: RADAR-base will stop receiving the phone's location data.

zh-CN.description: RADAR-base 位置采集运行时，此服务会按配置的间隔接收 GPS 或网络定位更新并报告位置，默认使用相对坐标。
zh-CN.disableEffect: RADAR-base 将无法继续收到手机的位置数据。

en.description: When RADAR-base phone-sensor collection is enabled, this service reads the accelerometer, magnetic-field, gyroscope, light, and step-counter sensors and reports their samples along with battery information.
en.disableEffect: RADAR-base will stop collecting these motion, light, step, and battery readings from the phone.

zh-CN.description: 启用 RADAR-base 手机传感器采集后，此服务会读取加速度计、磁场、陀螺仪、光线和步数传感器，并连同电量信息一起报告采样数据。
zh-CN.disableEffect: RADAR-base 将无法继续采集手机的运动、光线、步数和电量数据。

en.description: When RADAR-base's audio-input recording controls are used, this service records microphone audio and supports pausing, playback, and sending the recording.
en.disableEffect: RADAR-base's manual microphone recording and its playback or send controls will stop working.

zh-CN.description: 使用 RADAR-base 音频输入录制控件时，此服务会录制麦克风音频，并支持暂停、播放和发送录音。
zh-CN.disableEffect: RADAR-base 的手动麦克风录音、播放和发送控件将无法使用。

en.description: When opened, RADAR-base's audio-input screen lists available microphones and provides controls to record, pause, play back, and send an audio recording.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to open RADAR-base's microphone selection and recording screen.

zh-CN.description: 打开后，RADAR-base 音频输入界面会列出可用麦克风，并提供录音、暂停、回放和发送录音的控件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开 RADAR-base 的麦克风选择和录音界面。

en.description: When RADAR-base phone-log collection runs, this service reads call and text-message log entries and reports event details such as call timing or duration and message length.
en.disableEffect: RADAR-base will stop receiving call-log and text-message event metadata from the phone.

zh-CN.description: RADAR-base 电话日志采集运行时，此服务会读取通话和短信日志，并报告通话时间或时长、短信长度等事件信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: RADAR-base 将无法继续收到手机的通话日志和短信事件元数据。

en.description: When RADAR-base phone-usage collection runs, this service reads Android app-usage events and reports app activity, user interaction, screen state, and related device-use changes.
en.disableEffect: RADAR-base will stop receiving phone app-usage and device-interaction data.

zh-CN.description: RADAR-base 手机使用情况采集运行时，此服务会读取 Android 应用使用事件，并报告应用活动、用户交互、屏幕状态及相关设备使用变化。
zh-CN.disableEffect: RADAR-base 将无法继续收到手机应用使用情况和设备交互数据。

en.description: When RADAR-base collection is configured for a Polar wearable, this service connects over Bluetooth and collects heart rate, ECG, movement, pulse-wave, heartbeat-interval, and battery readings.
en.disableEffect: RADAR-base will stop connecting to Polar wearables and collecting their sensor readings.

zh-CN.description: 当 RADAR-base 配置为采集 Polar 穿戴设备数据时，此服务会通过蓝牙连接设备，并采集心率、心电、运动、脉搏波、心搏间隔和电量信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: RADAR-base 将无法连接 Polar 穿戴设备或继续采集其传感器数据。

en.description: When opened, RADAR-base's Polar screen shows Bluetooth and device status and lets the user connect a Polar wearable and start or stop collection.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to open RADAR-base's Polar device and collection controls.

zh-CN.description: 打开后，RADAR-base 的 Polar 界面会显示蓝牙和设备状态，并允许用户连接 Polar 穿戴设备以及开始或停止采集。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开 RADAR-base 的 Polar 设备连接和采集控制界面。

en.description: When opened, RADAR-base's timed camera pulse-measurement screen lets the user start a phone-based measurement.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to start a camera-based pulse measurement from RADAR-base's screen.

zh-CN.description: 打开后，RADAR-base 的定时相机脉搏测量界面允许用户启动手机测量。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 RADAR-base 界面启动基于相机的脉搏测量。

en.description: When RADAR-base phone pulse measurement starts, this service uses the rear camera to sample image color changes and sends phone-camera pulse readings to the monitoring service.
en.disableEffect: RADAR-base will stop measuring and reporting pulse readings from the phone camera.

zh-CN.description: RADAR-base 手机脉搏测量启动后，此服务会使用后置相机采样图像颜色变化，并将手机相机测得的脉搏数据发送给监测服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: RADAR-base 将无法继续通过手机相机测量并报告脉搏数据。

en.description: When a scheduled RADAR-base weather update runs with network access, this service uses the phone's recent location to request local weather and reports conditions such as temperature, pressure, humidity, clouds, and precipitation.
en.disableEffect: RADAR-base will stop receiving weather conditions for the phone's location.

zh-CN.description: 有网络时，定时 RADAR-base 天气更新会使用手机最近的位置查询当地天气，并报告温度、气压、湿度、云量和降水等情况。
zh-CN.disableEffect: RADAR-base 将无法继续收到手机所在位置的天气情况。

en.description: The Restcomm WebRTC SDK service maintains the app's communication device and handles registration and call or message events, including work started by push notifications.
en.disableEffect: Disabling this service stops the app's Restcomm calling, messaging, registration, and incoming-push handling.

zh-CN.description: Restcomm WebRTC SDK 的此服务负责维护应用的通信设备并处理注册、通话和消息事件，包括由推送通知触发的工作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用此服务会使应用的 Restcomm 通话、消息、注册和推送来电处理停止工作。

en.description: When Firebase refreshes the push token, the Restcomm WebRTC SDK sends the updated token to the Restcomm service so push notifications can reach the app.
en.disableEffect: Restcomm will no longer receive refreshed push tokens, preventing incoming call or message notifications from reaching the app after token rotation.

zh-CN.description: Firebase 刷新推送令牌时，Restcomm WebRTC SDK 会将新令牌发送给 Restcomm 服务，以便推送通知能够到达应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Restcomm 将无法收到更新后的推送令牌，令牌轮换后应用可能收不到来电或消息通知。

en.description: When Firebase delivers a Restcomm push message, this service forwards it to the Restcomm WebRTC SDK so the app can handle incoming calls or messages.
en.disableEffect: Incoming Restcomm call or message pushes will no longer be handled by the app.

zh-CN.description: Firebase 收到 Restcomm 推送消息时，此服务会将消息转交给 Restcomm WebRTC SDK，以便应用处理来电或消息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法继续处理 Restcomm 推送的来电或消息。

en.description: After Android finishes starting, this Restcomm QoS library receiver restarts background network-quality monitoring when the app has enabled start-on-boot and has not stopped that monitoring.
en.disableEffect: Restcomm QoS monitoring will no longer restart automatically after the phone reboots.

zh-CN.description: Android 启动完成后，如果应用启用了开机启动且未停止监测，此 Restcomm QoS 库接收器会重新启动后台网络质量监测。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 手机重启后，Restcomm QoS 监测将不再自动恢复。

en.description: When the app starts Restcomm QoS monitoring, this background service checks network coverage and call quality, records test results, and uploads monitoring events.
en.disableEffect: Restcomm network-coverage and call-quality monitoring and reports will stop; the communication SDK remains separate.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动 Restcomm QoS 监测时，此后台服务会检查网络覆盖和通话质量、记录测试结果并上传监测事件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Restcomm 网络覆盖和通话质量监测及报告将停止；通信 SDK 与此监测服务相互独立。

en.description: While Restcomm QoS monitoring is active, this receiver handles phone and network changes, scheduled checks, and speed or latency test results for the monitoring service.
en.disableEffect: Restcomm QoS monitoring will miss these event-triggered updates and test results.

zh-CN.description: Restcomm QoS 监测运行期间，此接收器会为监测服务处理手机和网络变化、定时检查以及网速或延迟测试结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Restcomm QoS 监测将无法收到这些事件触发的更新和测试结果。

en.description: When the user opens a Restcomm QoS event, this screen loads its details and can display the related coverage or network map in a web view.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to open QoS event details or the related coverage-map screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 Restcomm QoS 事件时，此界面会加载事件详情，并可在网页视图中显示相关覆盖或网络地图。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开 QoS 事件详情或相关覆盖地图界面。

en.description: When opened, the Restcomm QoS event-history screen lists dropped-call and call-failure events and offers a way to share the history.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to view or share the Restcomm QoS call-event history.

zh-CN.description: 打开后，Restcomm QoS 事件历史界面会列出掉线和通话失败事件，并提供分享记录的方式。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法查看或分享 Restcomm QoS 通话事件历史。

en.description: When the host app opens its configured Maoni feedback flow, this screen lets the user write feedback and optionally attach a screenshot or diagnostic logs for the app's feedback handler.
en.disableEffect: The Maoni feedback screen will not open, but the host app's other features remain available.

zh-CN.description: 宿主应用打开配置的 Maoni 反馈流程时，此界面允许用户填写反馈，并可选择附上截图或诊断日志交给应用的反馈处理程序。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Maoni 反馈界面将无法打开，但宿主应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: When a ROS Android app needs to choose a ROS master, this screen lets the user enter or select its address and a network interface, test the connection, and return the chosen settings.
en.disableEffect: The app will not be able to use this screen to choose or verify its ROS master connection.

zh-CN.description: ROS Android 应用需要选择 ROS 主节点时，此界面允许用户输入或选择地址和网络接口、测试连接，并返回所选设置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法通过此界面选择或验证 ROS 主节点连接。

en.description: When a ROS Android app starts or binds to this service, it runs requested ROS node tasks and maintains their connection to the selected ROS master while active.
en.disableEffect: The app's ROS nodes and features that depend on them will not run.

zh-CN.description: ROS Android 应用启动或绑定此服务时，它会运行请求的 ROS 节点任务，并在运行期间维持与所选 ROS 主节点的连接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用的 ROS 节点以及依赖这些节点的功能将无法运行。

en.description: The MyGuide (EdCast) Creator SDK starts this service while an author records a walkthrough. It tracks screen steps and shows floating recording controls.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents authors from recording MyGuide walkthroughs.

zh-CN.description: MyGuide（EdCast）Creator SDK 会在作者录制界面引导时启动此服务，记录屏幕步骤并显示悬浮录制控件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，作者将无法录制 MyGuide 界面引导。

en.description: The MyGuide (EdCast) Player SDK uses this service to play guide steps over the app, including messages, images, and video, with controls to continue or finish.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from playing MyGuide walkthroughs.

zh-CN.description: MyGuide（EdCast）Player SDK 会通过此服务在应用界面上播放指南步骤，包括文字、图片和视频，并提供继续或结束控件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法播放 MyGuide 界面引导。

en.description: The MyGuide (EdCast) Creator SDK opens this screen while an author edits a recorded guide step. The author can enter and save the step title.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents authors from reviewing and renaming recorded guide steps.

zh-CN.description: MyGuide（EdCast）Creator SDK 会在作者编辑录制的指南步骤时打开此页面，供作者填写并保存步骤标题。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，作者将无法在此页面检查或重命名录制的指南步骤。

en.description: The MyGuide (EdCast) guide SDK opens this screen when someone selects a guide. It shows the guide details and available steps.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from opening MyGuide guide details.

zh-CN.description: MyGuide（EdCast）指南 SDK 会在用户选择指南时打开此页面，显示指南详情和可用步骤。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法打开 MyGuide 指南详情。

en.description: The MyGuide (EdCast) Creator SDK opens this full-screen home screen so users can browse guides and return to guide content.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from opening the MyGuide guide browser.

zh-CN.description: MyGuide（EdCast）Creator SDK 会打开此全屏主页，供用户浏览指南并返回指南内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法打开 MyGuide 指南浏览页面。

en.description: The MyGuide (EdCast) Creator SDK opens this screen when an author trims a video for a guide. It previews the clip and returns the trimmed video when confirmed.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents authors from trimming video clips for MyGuide guides.

zh-CN.description: MyGuide（EdCast）Creator SDK 会在作者为指南剪辑视频时打开此页面，预览片段并在确认后返回剪好的视频。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，作者将无法为 MyGuide 指南剪辑视频片段。

en.description: The MyGuide (EdCast) Player SDK plays walkthrough steps over the app, including messages, images, and video.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from playing MyGuide walkthroughs.

zh-CN.description: MyGuide（EdCast）Player SDK 会在应用界面上播放界面引导步骤，包括文字、图片和视频。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法播放 MyGuide 界面引导。

en.description: The MyGuide (EdCast) Player SDK opens this screen when someone selects a guide. It shows the guide details and available steps.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from opening MyGuide guide details.

zh-CN.description: MyGuide（EdCast）Player SDK 会在用户选择指南时打开此页面，显示指南详情和可用步骤。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法打开 MyGuide 指南详情。

en.description: The MyGuide (EdCast) Player SDK opens this full-screen home screen so users can browse, start, or continue guides.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from opening the MyGuide guide home screen.

zh-CN.description: MyGuide（EdCast）Player SDK 会打开此全屏主页，供用户浏览、开始或继续指南。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法打开 MyGuide 指南主页。

en.description: LinX OpenNetwork's SendingNetwork Android SDK uses this Activity for its Jitsi voice and video meeting screen. It refreshes the meeting when Android reports a change to work-profile restrictions.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it can prevent the app from opening SendingNetwork meetings through this screen.

zh-CN.description: LinX OpenNetwork 的 SendingNetwork Android SDK 用此 Activity 显示 Jitsi 语音和视频会议界面。Android 的工作资料限制发生变化时，它会刷新会议。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用可能无法通过此界面打开 SendingNetwork 会议。

en.description: LinX OpenNetwork's SendingNetwork Android SDK uses this Provider to create shareable links for downloaded chat files and report a file's type when requested.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it can break sharing or opening downloaded chat attachments.

zh-CN.description: LinX OpenNetwork 的 SendingNetwork Android SDK 用此 Provider 为已下载的聊天文件生成可分享链接，并在请求时返回文件类型。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，分享或打开已下载的聊天附件可能失败。

en.description: OpenSRP Client Core starts this background Service during record sync and uploads profile photos that have not yet reached the OpenSRP server.
en.disableEffect: Profile photos captured in the app will stay on the device instead of syncing with their records.

zh-CN.description: OpenSRP Client Core 会在同步记录时启动此后台服务，将尚未上传的个人资料照片发送到 OpenSRP 服务器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用拍摄的个人资料照片会留在设备上，无法随记录同步。

en.description: OpenSRP Client Core starts this background Service after a submitted form is saved as local health records. In the analyzed releases, the service does no work when started.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it has no user-visible effect in these releases because the service does not process its request.

zh-CN.description: 表单提交并保存为本地健康记录后，OpenSRP Client Core 会启动此后台服务；在分析的版本中，服务启动后不执行任何操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 在这些版本中，停用它不会改变用户可见的行为，因为服务没有处理任务的代码。

en.description: OpenSRP Client Core opens this Activity when a health record requests a photo; it starts the device camera, saves a resized image, and attaches it to a woman or child record.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot take and attach photos to eligible-couple or child records.

zh-CN.description: 健康档案需要照片时，OpenSRP Client Core 会打开此页面调用设备相机，保存缩小后的照片并关联到妇女或儿童记录。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法为符合条件的夫妇或儿童档案拍摄并添加照片。

en.description: OpenSRP Client Core opens this screen when a user selects an eligible-couple record, showing its profile and refreshing the displayed photo after a new one is captured.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open eligible-couple profiles to review their details and linked photos.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择符合条件的夫妇记录时，OpenSRP Client Core 会显示其档案，并在拍摄新照片后刷新页面中的照片。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法打开这类档案查看详情和关联照片。

en.description: OpenSRP Client Core opens this Activity for a full registration or follow-up form, displays the selected form, and returns submitted health information to the app.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot complete the registration and follow-up forms that open in this screen.

zh-CN.description: 填写完整登记或随访表单时，OpenSRP Client Core 会打开此页面显示所选表单，并将提交的健康信息交回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法填写并提交通过此页面打开的登记或随访表单。

en.description: OpenSRP Client Core's older web-based home screen provides the app's main navigation and shows sync status and the number of forms waiting to upload.
en.disableEffect: Apps using this home screen cannot open their main page or navigate to features from it.

zh-CN.description: OpenSRP Client Core 的旧版网页式首页提供应用的主导航，并显示同步状态和待上传表单数量。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此首页的应用将无法打开主页面或从中进入各项功能。

en.description: OpenSRP Client Core opens this compact, landscape form screen when a workflow requests a short form; it appears in a dialog-style window.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot complete workflows that open a short form in this screen.

zh-CN.description: 工作流程需要填写简短表单时，OpenSRP Client Core 会以横屏弹窗形式打开此页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法完成需要在此页面填写简短表单的流程。

en.description: OpenSRP Client Core uses this Activity for the eligible-couple register, where users can search records, filter by village, sort results, start registration, and open profiles.
en.disableEffect: Users lose the register used to find, add, edit, and open eligible-couple records.

zh-CN.description: OpenSRP Client Core 使用此页面展示符合条件的夫妇名册，用户可搜索记录、按村庄筛选和排序、开始登记或打开档案。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法通过此名册查找、新增、编辑或打开符合条件的夫妇记录。

en.description: OpenSRP Client Core opens this native dashboard after sign-in; it shows counts for health registers and links to registers, reports, and videos.
en.disableEffect: Users lose the main dashboard used to reach registers, reports, and videos.

zh-CN.description: 登录后，OpenSRP Client Core 会打开此原生仪表盘，显示各类健康名册的记录数量，并提供进入名册、报告和视频的入口。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法使用此主页面进入名册、报告和视频。

en.description: OpenSRP Client Core opens this report screen when a user selects the cases counted for an indicator and month; it lists the matching records.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open the records behind a report indicator's monthly count from this screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择某个月某项指标所统计的个案时，OpenSRP Client Core 会打开此报告页面列出对应记录。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法从此页面查看报告月度指标所统计的个案。

en.description: OpenSRP Client Core opens this screen after a user selects a report indicator; it shows the indicator's description, target, and monthly progress.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot review an indicator's details or progress in the reports section.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择报告指标后，OpenSRP Client Core 会打开此页面，显示指标说明、目标和每月进度。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法在报告中查看指标详情和进度。

en.description: OpenSRP Client Core opens this screen for a selected report category and lists its available indicators and progress.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot browse the indicators in a report category.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择报告类别后，OpenSRP Client Core 会打开此页面，列出该类别的指标及其进度。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法浏览报告类别中的指标。

en.description: OpenSRP Client Core opens this overview from the home screen and displays the app's report categories for users to choose from.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open the reports overview or continue to its categories and indicators.

zh-CN.description: 从首页进入报告时，OpenSRP Client Core 会打开此概览页面，展示可供选择的报告类别。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法打开报告概览并继续查看类别和指标。

en.description: OpenSRP Client Core opens this Activity from the home screen and displays the app's video guidance page.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot access the in-app guidance videos from this page.

zh-CN.description: 从首页进入视频时，OpenSRP Client Core 会打开此页面展示应用内的视频指导内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过此页面观看应用内的指导视频。

en.description: OpenSRP Client Core receives Android network-change broadcasts and starts its data-sync scheduler when connectivity returns or stops it when the device goes offline.
en.disableEffect: Background data syncing may not restart after the device reconnects or pause when it goes offline.

zh-CN.description: OpenSRP Client Core 接收 Android 的网络变化广播；设备恢复联网时会启动数据同步计划，断网时会将其停止。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，设备重新联网时后台同步可能不会恢复，断网时也可能不会暂停。

en.description: When an OpenSRP sync alarm sends this receiver a broadcast, OpenSRP Client Core fetches server updates and synchronizes form submissions and form versions.
en.disableEffect: Scheduled synchronization of forms and server updates stops.

zh-CN.description: OpenSRP 的同步闹钟发送广播时，OpenSRP Client Core 会获取服务器更新并同步表单提交和表单版本。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，表单和服务器更新的计划同步将停止。

en.description: When the clock or time zone changes, OpenSRP Client Core notifies the app so its time-sensitive features can refresh.
en.disableEffect: Time-sensitive screens and tasks may continue using outdated time information after a clock or time-zone change.

zh-CN.description: 设备时间或时区发生变化时，OpenSRP Client Core 会接收 Android 广播并通知应用中已注册的监听方。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，时间敏感的页面或任务在设备时间或时区变化后可能继续使用旧信息。

en.description: When the app connects an IKEv2 profile, Tim06 VPN Protocols starts its strongSwan VPN service to establish and maintain the encrypted connection.
en.disableEffect: IKEv2 VPN connections cannot start or stay active if this service is disabled.

zh-CN.description: 应用连接 IKEv2 配置时，Tim06 VPN Protocols 会启动 strongSwan VPN 服务来建立并维持加密连接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，IKEv2 VPN 连接无法启动或保持运行。

en.description: The Tim06 VPN Protocols IKEv2 state service reports the selected profile, connection status, and errors to the app, and handles requests to connect or disconnect.
en.disableEffect: The app loses IKEv2 connection controls and status updates, so it cannot manage this VPN reliably.

zh-CN.description: Tim06 VPN Protocols 的 IKEv2 状态服务会向应用提供所选配置、连接状态和错误信息，并处理连接或断开请求。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用会失去 IKEv2 连接控制和状态更新，无法可靠管理此 VPN。

en.description: When the app receives a request to start or disconnect an IKEv2 profile, this Tim06 VPN Protocols activity handles it and asks for confirmation before replacing an active connection.
en.disableEffect: IKEv2 profile start and disconnect requests cannot complete through this activity.

zh-CN.description: 应用收到启动或断开 IKEv2 配置的请求时，Tim06 VPN Protocols 的此 Activity 会处理请求，并在替换现有连接前要求确认。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，IKEv2 配置无法通过此 Activity 完成启动或断开请求。

en.description: Android uses the Tim06 VPN Protocols IKEv2 Quick Settings tile while the user views or taps it; the tile shows connection state and can connect or disconnect the saved profile.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot use the Quick Settings tile to connect or disconnect an IKEv2 profile.

zh-CN.description: 用户查看或点击 IKEv2 快捷设置磁贴时，Android 会调用 Tim06 VPN Protocols 的磁贴服务；它显示连接状态，并可连接或断开已保存的配置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法通过快捷设置磁贴连接或断开 IKEv2 配置。

en.description: AiTyu AndroidUtils opens a file browser when an app asks the user to choose files, letting them browse folders and return selected files.
en.disableEffect: The file-selection screen will not open, so app features that import or attach files may fail.

zh-CN.description: 爱T鱼 AndroidUtils 在应用要求用户选取文件时打开文件浏览器，供用户浏览文件夹并返回所选文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 文件选择界面将无法打开，依赖导入或附加文件的应用功能可能无法使用。

en.description: AiTyu AndroidUtils opens Android runtime permission prompts when the app requests access and returns the user decision to the app.
en.disableEffect: The permission-request flow that uses this screen cannot finish, so features needing those permissions may fail.

zh-CN.description: 爱T鱼 AndroidUtils 在应用请求权限时打开 Android 运行时权限提示，并把用户的选择返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此界面的权限申请流程将无法完成，因此需要这些权限的功能可能无法使用。

en.description: AiTyu AndroidUtils launches the camera or image picker when an app asks the user to take or choose a picture, then returns the image location.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot finish a camera or gallery image-selection flow that uses this screen.

zh-CN.description: 爱T鱼 AndroidUtils 在应用要求用户拍照或选取图片时打开相机或图片选择器，然后返回图片位置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用无法完成依赖此界面的拍照或图库选图流程。

en.description: AiTyu AndroidUtils opens the Android settings page requested by the app and returns control after the user comes back.
en.disableEffect: Settings flows that rely on this screen cannot finish, which may prevent users from enabling access needed by an app feature.

zh-CN.description: 爱T鱼 AndroidUtils 打开应用指定的 Android 设置页面，并在用户返回后把控制权交还给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此界面的设置流程将无法完成，用户可能无法开启某项应用功能所需的权限。

en.description: AiTyu AndroidUtils shows a movable log panel when the built-in diagnostic viewer is opened, with controls to filter, pause, and save log output.
en.disableEffect: The floating diagnostic panel and its saved-log controls will be unavailable, while ordinary app screens remain usable.

zh-CN.description: 爱T鱼 AndroidUtils 在打开内置诊断查看器时显示可移动的日志面板，并提供筛选、暂停和保存日志的控件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 悬浮诊断面板及其日志保存控件将无法使用，但应用的普通界面仍可使用。

en.description: AiTyu AndroidUtils starts this service for its diagnostic viewer to read application log messages, stream them to the panel, and save recordings.
en.disableEffect: The diagnostic viewer will no longer collect or record log output, while ordinary app features remain available.

zh-CN.description: 爱T鱼 AndroidUtils 为诊断查看器启动此服务，以读取应用日志、将日志显示在面板中并保存记录。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 诊断查看器将无法继续收集或记录日志，但应用的普通功能仍可使用。

en.description: The Teslasoft ID authentication SDK opens this Activity when an app starts sign-in; it checks the app, requests permission, opens the Teslasoft account picker, and returns account details and an authentication token.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot sign in through Teslasoft ID or return their account token to the app.

zh-CN.description: 应用发起登录时，Teslasoft ID 身份验证 SDK 会打开此页面检查应用、请求授权并显示 Teslasoft 账户选择界面，之后将账户信息和验证令牌返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过 Teslasoft ID 登录，也无法将账户令牌返回给应用。

en.description: The CommonHealth Client SDK opens this internal Activity to start a health-data authorization or process its completion after the user returns from the connected service.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot start or finish authorization for a health-data sharing connection.

zh-CN.description: CommonHealth Client SDK 会打开此内部页面以发起健康数据授权，或在用户从已连接的服务返回后完成授权。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法发起或完成健康数据共享连接的授权。

en.description: The CommonHealth Client SDK receives the browser link for its configured authorization return address and forwards a valid response to the authorization screen.
en.disableEffect: Browser returns cannot complete CommonHealth authorization.

zh-CN.description: CommonHealth Client SDK 会接收浏览器返回到已配置授权地址的链接，并将有效结果转交给授权页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，浏览器返回结果无法完成 CommonHealth 授权。

en.description: The CommonHealth Client SDK receives connection notices and seamless setup requests from other health apps, then handles their responses or schedules background setup work.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot handle cross-app health connection notices or seamless setup requests.

zh-CN.description: CommonHealth Client SDK 会接收其他健康应用发来的连接通知和快速设置请求，并处理相关响应或安排后台设置任务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用无法处理跨应用的健康连接通知或快速设置请求。

en.description: The CommonHealth Client SDK processes queued seamless setup requests from other health apps in the background and validates them before handling the connection.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot complete background setup for a connection between CommonHealth and another health app.

zh-CN.description: CommonHealth Client SDK 会在后台处理来自其他健康应用的快速设置请求，并在处理连接前进行验证。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法完成 CommonHealth 与其他健康应用之间的后台连接设置。

en.description: The CommonHealth Client SDK receives requests from connected health apps for a sign-in token and queues them for background processing.
en.disableEffect: Other health apps cannot request the app sign-in token through this connection.

zh-CN.description: CommonHealth Client SDK 会接收已连接健康应用的登录令牌请求，并将请求排入后台处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 其他健康应用将无法通过此连接请求本应用的身份令牌。

en.description: The CommonHealth Client SDK handles queued sign-in requests, retrieves the app token, and returns it to the requesting health app.
en.disableEffect: Cross-app sign-in that depends on this token fails.

zh-CN.description: CommonHealth Client SDK 会处理排队的登录请求，获取本应用的令牌并返回给发起请求的健康应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，依赖此身份令牌的跨应用授权将失败。

en.description: TINet's Paho-based MQTT client starts this Service when it connects to a message server; the Service maintains the connection, reconnects after network changes, and carries messages.
en.disableEffect: Features that rely on this MQTT client will not be able to send or receive live messages and updates.

zh-CN.description: TINet 的 Paho MQTT 客户端连接消息服务器时会启动此 Service；它保持连接、在网络变化后重连，并传递收发消息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此 MQTT 客户端的功能将无法正常收发实时消息和更新。

en.description: When a user shares console output and plain-text sharing fails, the TinyLisp Android activity SDK uses this Provider to create a shareable link for the saved log file.
en.disableEffect: The fallback file-sharing path fails when the provider is blocked.

zh-CN.description: 用户分享控制台输出且纯文本分享失败时，TinyLisp Android Activity SDK 会通过此 Provider 为保存的日志文件创建可分享链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，分享日志文件的备用方式将无法使用。

en.description: When the host app starts Guardian Project’s Tor Android service, it starts Tor in the background, provides local SOCKS and HTTP proxy ports, and broadcasts service status.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot start Tor or use the local Tor proxy for features that depend on it.

zh-CN.description: 宿主应用启动 Guardian Project 的 Tor Android 服务时，该服务会在后台启动 Tor、提供本地 SOCKS 和 HTTP 代理端口，并广播服务状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖 Tor 的应用功能将无法启动 Tor 或使用本地 Tor 代理。

en.description: When a TrackAsia Android Offline Plugin request starts or cancels a map-area download, this service manages the offline region, reports progress, and updates the download notification.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot download, cancel, or track offline map areas through the plugin.

zh-CN.description: TrackAsia Android Offline Plugin 收到开始或取消地图区域下载的请求时，此服务会管理离线区域、报告进度并更新下载通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，应用无法通过该插件下载、取消或跟踪离线地图区域。

en.description: When the app asks the TrackAsia Android Offline Plugin to select an offline map area, this screen lets the user choose a region and returns its bounds and name to the app.
en.disableEffect: The user cannot select a map region for offline use through the plugin.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求 TrackAsia Android Offline Plugin 选择离线地图区域时，此页面允许用户选择区域，并把区域范围和名称返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，用户无法通过该插件选择供离线使用的地图区域。

en.description: WGT Ads (WGT) opens this full-screen page when it displays a site ad. It loads the ad, records viewing and click events, and reports completion after the countdown for rewarded formats.
en.disableEffect: Full-screen ads will not open, and rewards for watching ads will no longer be granted.

zh-CN.description: 显示站点广告时，WGT Ads（WGT）会打开此全屏页面。它加载广告并记录观看和点击情况；对于激励广告，倒计时结束后会报告观看完成。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 全屏广告将无法打开，观看广告的奖励也将不再发放。

en.description: The Leobert Lan DaVinCi style viewer opens this launcher screen to preview the registered background styles. It loads the available styles into a scrollable gallery.
en.disableEffect: The DaVinCi style gallery will no longer open, so its background previews cannot be viewed.

zh-CN.description: Leobert Lan 的 DaVinCi 样式查看器会从启动器打开此界面，预览已注册的背景样式。它会将可用样式加载到可滚动的展示列表中。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，DaVinCi 样式展示界面将无法打开，背景样式预览也无法查看。

en.description: When CrashReport uses its default screen after an uncaught app crash, this Activity shows configured error details and offers restart or close options.
en.disableEffect: After a crash, users will not see CrashReport's default error details or recovery screen.

zh-CN.description: 应用发生未捕获崩溃且 CrashReport 使用默认错误页面时，此 Activity 会按配置显示错误详情，并提供重启或关闭选项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 发生崩溃后，用户将看不到 CrashReport 默认的错误详情和恢复页面。

en.description: Android starts this CrashReport provider with the app process; it installs the SDK's uncaught-crash handler, which can open the configured error screen if the app crashes.
en.disableEffect: CrashReport's automatic crash handling and error screen will not be installed, while the app's normal screens can still run.

zh-CN.description: Android 随应用进程启动 CrashReport Provider；它会安装未捕获崩溃处理器，并可在应用崩溃时打开配置的错误页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，CrashReport 不会自动处理崩溃或显示错误页面，应用的正常页面仍可运行。

en.description: When Papa's shell-profiling command arrives, this receiver makes the app available to shell-based profiling tools.
en.disableEffect: Papa tools will no longer be able to enable shell profiling through this broadcast.

zh-CN.description: 收到 Papa 的 shell 性能分析请求时，此接收器会让性能分析工具能够从 shell 检查应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Papa 工具将无法通过此广播启用 shell 性能分析。

en.description: When Papa's tracing command arrives, this receiver enables system tracing for the app.
en.disableEffect: Papa tools will no longer be able to enable system tracing through this broadcast.

zh-CN.description: 收到 Papa 的跟踪请求时，此接收器会为应用启用系统跟踪。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Papa 工具将无法通过此广播为应用启用系统跟踪。

en.description: When Papa's profiling tools request garbage collection, this receiver runs it and signals when it finishes.
en.disableEffect: Papa tools will not be able to trigger and observe garbage collection through this receiver.

zh-CN.description: Papa 性能分析工具请求垃圾回收时，此接收器会执行回收并在完成后发出信号。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Papa 工具将无法通过此接收器触发并观察垃圾回收。

en.description: At app startup, Square's Papa performance library initializes its performance measurements.
en.disableEffect: Papa startup performance measurements will not initialize; the app's regular features remain available.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，Square 的 Papa 性能库会初始化性能测量。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Papa 启动性能测量将不会初始化，但应用的常规功能仍可使用。

en.description: The NXT Checkout SDK opens this Activity when the app starts checkout, displays the payment screen, and returns the result after checkout finishes.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot complete payments through the NXT Checkout screen.

zh-CN.description: 应用开始结账时，NXT Checkout SDK 会打开此页面显示付款界面，并在结账结束后返回结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过 NXT Checkout 页面完成付款。

en.description: Farimarwat ANR Spy shows details when its exit-report option handles a detected app freeze; closing the report exits the app.
en.disableEffect: The ANR details screen will not appear; the app's regular screens are unaffected.

zh-CN.description: Farimarwat ANR Spy 在检测到应用卡死且启用退出报告时显示详情；关闭报告会退出应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: ANR 详情界面将无法显示；应用的常规界面不受影响。

en.description: Bright Inventions' SLF4Android Notify Developer handler opens this Activity to ask whether to email an error report with optional log attachments. Its prompt can be triggered by shaking the device.
en.disableEffect: The error report prompt may fail to open when the handler needs this screen, interrupting that reporting flow.

zh-CN.description: Bright Inventions 的 SLF4Android Notify Developer 错误报告处理器会打开此界面，询问用户是否通过邮件发送错误信息和可选的日志附件。摇晃设备可以触发此提示。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 处理器需要打开此界面时，错误报告提示可能无法显示，相关上报流程会中断。

en.description: Bright Inventions' SLF4Android Notify Developer handler uses this Provider when an error report email includes log files. It lets the email app read those files through temporary content links.
en.disableEffect: Error report emails can still open, but their log attachments are omitted; ordinary app features are unaffected.

zh-CN.description: 错误报告邮件包含日志时，Bright Inventions 的 SLF4Android Notify Developer 处理器会使用此提供程序，通过临时内容链接让邮件应用读取日志文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 错误报告邮件仍可打开，但不会附带日志文件；应用的常规功能不受影响。

en.description: The Droids On Roids FoQA quality-assurance tools run this Provider when the app starts. In Firebase Test Lab it detects the test environment and disables Hyperion's startup tools; elsewhere it has no effect.
en.disableEffect: In Firebase Test Lab, Hyperion may stay enabled; regular app features are unaffected.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，Droids On Roids 的 FoQA 质量检查工具会运行此 Provider。它会检测 Firebase Test Lab 环境并关闭 Hyperion 的启动工具；其他情况下不做处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 在 Firebase Test Lab 中，Hyperion 可能会继续启用；应用的常规功能不受影响。

en.description: When Google Play services delivers a message from a paired Android Wear device, Michal Tajchert's BusWear library passes it to the app's event listeners.
en.disableEffect: Watch messages will no longer reach the app, so features that rely on them may stop working.

zh-CN.description: Google Play 服务收到配对 Android Wear 设备发来的消息时，Michal Tajchert 的 BusWear 库会将消息传给应用的事件监听者。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，手表消息将无法送达应用，依赖这些消息的功能可能无法正常工作。

en.description: When Google Play services delivers a message from a paired Android Wear device, Michal Tajchert's BusWear library passes it to the app's event listeners.
en.disableEffect: Watch messages will no longer reach the app, so features that rely on them may stop working.

zh-CN.description: Google Play 服务收到配对 Android Wear 设备发来的消息时，Michal Tajchert 的 BusWear 库会将消息传给应用的事件监听者。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，手表消息将无法送达应用，依赖这些消息的功能可能无法正常工作。

en.description: When a paired Android Wear device sends an ExceptionWear error report, this service on the phone reads the report and passes it to the app's exception handler with the watch's device details.
en.disableEffect: Error reports sent from a watch will no longer reach the app's handler.

zh-CN.description: 配对的 Android Wear 设备向手机发送 ExceptionWear 错误报告时，此服务会读取报告和手表设备信息，并交给应用的异常处理程序。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，手表发送的错误报告将无法交给应用处理。

en.description: On a Wear device, this ExceptionWear service runs when the app submits an error report; it packages the error and device details and sends them to the paired phone.
en.disableEffect: Error reports from the watch will no longer be sent to the phone.

zh-CN.description: Wear 设备上的应用提交错误报告时，此 ExceptionWear 服务会收集错误和设备信息，并发送到配对手机。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，手表上的错误报告将无法发送到手机。

en.description: When Google Play services delivers messages, data changes, or connection updates from a paired Wear device, Michal Tajchert's ServiceWear library relays them to the app.
en.disableEffect: The app will stop receiving Wear messages and updates, so features that use the paired device may stop working.

zh-CN.description: Google Play 服务收到配对 Wear 设备的消息、数据变化或连接状态更新时，Michal Tajchert 的 ServiceWear 库会将这些信息传给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用将无法收到 Wear 消息和更新，依赖配对设备的功能可能无法正常工作。

en.description: When ServiceWear receives a message, data change, or connection update from a paired Wear device, this Receiver notifies the app about the update.
en.disableEffect: The app will no longer receive these Wear updates, so functions that depend on the paired device may stop working.

zh-CN.description: ServiceWear 收到配对 Wear 设备的消息、数据变化或连接状态通知时，此 Receiver 会告知应用发生了相应更新。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用将收不到这些 Wear 更新，依赖配对设备的功能可能无法正常工作。

en.description: When a user shares an AdaptivePlus story image, this Provider lets other apps access the image saved in the app's cache.
en.disableEffect: Sharing AdaptivePlus story images with other apps may fail.

zh-CN.description: 用户分享 AdaptivePlus 故事图片时，此 Provider 会让其他应用读取保存在本应用缓存中的图片。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，AdaptivePlus 故事图片可能无法分享给其他应用。

en.description: The Vest SDK opens this screen when its app requests online content; it loads the requested page in an in-app browser and supports game-style launches.
en.disableEffect: Content and game pages opened through the Vest SDK will not open if this screen is disabled.

zh-CN.description: 应用通过 Vest SDK 请求在线内容时会打开此界面；它在应用内载入网页，也支持游戏内容页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Vest SDK 打开的内容页和游戏页面将无法打开。

en.description: The Gooten Android SDK opens this storefront About page from its menu and shows the configured text or webpage. It provides information about the print-shopping service.
en.disableEffect: The About page cannot be opened, so shoppers lose this information screen.

zh-CN.description: Gooten Android SDK 会从商品选购界面的菜单打开此“关于”页面，并显示配置的文字或网页，介绍照片打印购物服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 此页面将无法打开，用户也就无法查看相关介绍。

en.description: The Gooten Android SDK opens this screen to add or edit a delivery address during checkout. It checks the recipient, street, city, postal code, phone number, and email before saving the address.
en.disableEffect: Shoppers cannot add or correct a shipping address, which can prevent checkout.

zh-CN.description: Gooten Android SDK 会在结账时打开此页面，用于新增或修改收货地址。保存前会检查收件人、街道、城市、邮编、电话号码和电子邮箱。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法新增或修改收货地址，可能因此无法完成结账。

en.description: The Gooten Android SDK shows saved delivery addresses so a shopper can choose one for an order. From here the shopper can add or edit an address, then continue to shipping review.
en.disableEffect: The checkout flow cannot choose a delivery address or continue to shipping review.

zh-CN.description: Gooten Android SDK 会显示已保存的收货地址，供用户为订单选择地址。用户也可以新增或修改地址，然后继续查看配送方式。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 结账流程将无法选择收货地址，也无法继续查看配送方式。

en.description: The Gooten Android SDK loads the countries it supports and lets shoppers search for and select the destination country. The selected country also supplies the currency used by the shopping flow.
en.disableEffect: Shoppers cannot change the destination country, which can leave product availability, shipping, or prices incorrect for their order.

zh-CN.description: Gooten Android SDK 会加载支持的国家和地区，供用户搜索并选择配送目的地；所选国家也会决定购物流程使用的货币。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法更改配送国家，商品可选范围、配送方式或订单价格可能与实际目的地不符。

en.description: The Gooten Android SDK loads supported currencies and lets shoppers search and choose the currency used to display product and order prices.
en.disableEffect: Shoppers cannot change the currency in the Gooten shopping flow.

zh-CN.description: Gooten Android SDK 会加载支持的货币，供用户搜索并选择商品和订单价格的显示货币。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在 Gooten 购物流程中更改货币。

en.description: The Gooten Android SDK opens this editor for photo products made from a list of pictures, such as prints or magnets. Shoppers review the selected pictures, set the product quantity, and can return to add more photos.
en.disableEffect: The affected multi-photo products cannot be reviewed or prepared for the cart.

zh-CN.description: Gooten Android SDK 会为照片列表类商品打开此编辑页面，例如照片冲印或磁贴。用户可以检查已选照片、设置商品数量，也可以返回添加更多照片。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 相关多照片商品将无法检查或整理后加入购物车。

en.description: The Gooten Android SDK opens a photo-book editor where shoppers view the current page, replace its picture, and save their finished book to the cart.
en.disableEffect: Shoppers cannot finish or save a photo book made through the Gooten flow.

zh-CN.description: Gooten Android SDK 会打开照片书编辑器，供用户查看当前页面、更换照片，并将完成的照片书保存到购物车。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法完成并保存通过 Gooten 流程制作的照片书。

en.description: The Gooten Android SDK opens this editor for a personalized product. Shoppers can adjust its text, effects, layout, product options, and selected photos before continuing with the order.
en.disableEffect: Shoppers cannot customize the affected product or continue its creation flow.

zh-CN.description: Gooten Android SDK 会为个性化商品打开此编辑器。用户可以调整文字、效果、版式、商品选项和所选照片，然后继续下单。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法定制相关商品，也无法继续制作流程。

en.description: The Gooten Android SDK opens this Help page from its storefront menu. It displays the configured help text or loads the configured help webpage.
en.disableEffect: Shoppers cannot open the Gooten help content from its menu.

zh-CN.description: Gooten Android SDK 会从商品选购界面的菜单打开此帮助页面，显示配置的帮助文字或加载帮助网页。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法从菜单打开 Gooten 帮助内容。

en.description: The Gooten Android SDK opens this page from its storefront menu to explain how its photo-printing and product-ordering service works.
en.disableEffect: Shoppers lose the in-flow explanation of how the Gooten service works.

zh-CN.description: Gooten Android SDK 会从商品选购界面的菜单打开此页面，介绍照片打印和商品下单服务的使用方式。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在购物流程中查看 Gooten 服务的使用说明。

en.description: The Gooten Android SDK opens this screen while customizing products that support a background or border color. Shoppers choose a preset color or a custom color for the selected product.
en.disableEffect: Shoppers cannot set the background or border color for affected products.

zh-CN.description: 对于支持背景色或边框颜色的商品，Gooten Android SDK 会打开此设置页面。用户可以为所选商品挑选预设颜色或自定义颜色。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法为相关商品设置背景色或边框颜色。

en.description: After a Gooten order succeeds, this screen shows its confirmation and order summary. It also records the order for the shopper's history and clears the completed cart.
en.disableEffect: Shoppers cannot see the confirmation and order summary after purchase, and the normal order-history update may not run.

zh-CN.description: Gooten 订单成功后，此页面会显示确认信息和订单摘要，也会将订单保存到历史记录并清空已完成的购物车。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 购买后用户将无法查看确认信息和订单摘要，正常的订单历史记录更新也可能无法完成。

en.description: The Gooten Android SDK loads a selected order and displays its ID, total, items, quantities, prices, and item statuses.
en.disableEffect: Shoppers cannot inspect the items or status of an individual order.

zh-CN.description: Gooten Android SDK 会加载用户选择的订单，并显示订单编号、总额、商品、数量、价格和各商品状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法查看单笔订单中的商品及其状态。

en.description: The Gooten Android SDK lets a shopper enter an order number and look up its status. A valid result opens the detailed order view.
en.disableEffect: Shoppers cannot look up an order by entering its number.

zh-CN.description: Gooten Android SDK 允许用户输入订单编号并查询状态；查询到有效订单后会打开订单详情。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过输入订单编号查询订单。

en.description: The Gooten Android SDK shows orders saved on the device, including their date, number, and total. Selecting an order opens its details.
en.disableEffect: Shoppers cannot access the saved order-history list from the storefront.

zh-CN.description: Gooten Android SDK 会显示保存在设备上的历史订单，包括日期、编号和总额；选择订单后可查看详情。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法从商品选购界面查看已保存的订单历史。

en.description: The Gooten Android SDK opens this checkout screen to collect or confirm payment details, upload product images, and submit the order. It supports card payment and a PayPal payment flow.
en.disableEffect: Shoppers cannot complete payment or submit the Gooten order.

zh-CN.description: Gooten Android SDK 会在结账时打开此页面，用于填写或确认付款信息、上传商品照片并提交订单；页面支持银行卡和 PayPal 付款。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法完成付款或提交 Gooten 订单。

en.description: The Gooten Android SDK loads a product's photos, description, price, and available variants. Shoppers review the item and begin creating it from this page.
en.disableEffect: Shoppers cannot review or start creating products that use this details screen.

zh-CN.description: Gooten Android SDK 会加载商品照片、说明、价格和可选款式，供用户查看并开始制作商品。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法查看或开始制作使用此详情页面的商品。

en.description: This is the newer Gooten Android SDK product-details screen. It loads a product's images, description, price, variants, and creation options before the shopper starts making it.
en.disableEffect: Shoppers cannot review or start creating products routed through the newer details screen.

zh-CN.description: 这是 Gooten Android SDK 的新版商品详情页面。它会加载商品图片、说明、价格、款式和制作选项，供用户查看后开始制作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法查看或开始制作通过新版详情页面展示的商品。

en.description: The Gooten Android SDK asks shoppers to choose the available product options, such as a size or color, and any required layout. It passes the selection into the photo and customization flow.
en.disableEffect: Shoppers cannot choose required product options or continue to customize the item.

zh-CN.description: Gooten Android SDK 会让用户选择商品可用选项，例如尺寸或颜色，以及所需版式，然后将选择结果交给照片和定制流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法选择必要的商品选项或继续定制商品。

en.description: The Gooten Android SDK loads and displays its product categories and catalog. Selecting a product opens its details, and the page also links to the shopping cart.
en.disableEffect: Shoppers cannot browse the Gooten catalog or open product details from this screen.

zh-CN.description: Gooten Android SDK 会加载并显示商品分类和目录。用户选择商品后会打开详情页面，此页面也可进入购物车。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法浏览 Gooten 商品目录或从此页面打开商品详情。

en.description: This is the newer Gooten Android SDK product catalog. Shoppers can search or filter products by category, choose a destination country, and open the cart.
en.disableEffect: Shoppers cannot browse or search products through the newer catalog screen.

zh-CN.description: 这是 Gooten Android SDK 的新版商品目录。用户可以搜索商品、按分类筛选、选择配送国家并打开购物车。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过新版目录浏览或搜索商品。

en.description: The Gooten Android SDK opens this page from its storefront menu to show the configured quality-guarantee information as text or a webpage.
en.disableEffect: Shoppers cannot read the Gooten quality-guarantee information in the app.

zh-CN.description: Gooten Android SDK 会从商品选购界面的菜单打开此页面，以文字或网页形式显示配置的质量保证信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在应用中查看 Gooten 的质量保证信息。

en.description: The Gooten Android SDK shows photo sources and selected pictures for a product order. Shoppers choose pictures here, then continue to the matching product editor or photo-list screen.
en.disableEffect: Shoppers cannot choose the photos required to prepare the affected product.

zh-CN.description: Gooten Android SDK 会在商品下单流程中显示照片来源和已选照片。用户在此选择照片后，会进入对应的商品编辑器或照片列表页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法选择制作相关商品所需的照片。

en.description: The Gooten Android SDK reviews the items in an order, delivery methods, shipping prices, discounts, and totals. The shopper chooses a shipping method here before continuing to payment.
en.disableEffect: Shoppers cannot review shipping costs or continue from shipping selection to payment.

zh-CN.description: Gooten Android SDK 会汇总订单商品、配送方式、运费、折扣和总额。用户在此选择配送方式后继续付款。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法核对配送费用，也无法从配送选择继续付款。

en.description: The Gooten Android SDK displays the shopper's products, totals, and coupon codes. Shoppers can edit cart items and continue to delivery-address selection for checkout.
en.disableEffect: Shoppers cannot review or check out the Gooten items in their cart.

zh-CN.description: Gooten Android SDK 会显示用户购物车中的商品、总额和优惠码。用户可以编辑商品，并继续选择收货地址以结账。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法查看购物车中的 Gooten 商品或继续结账。

en.description: The Gooten Android SDK uses this entry screen when the host app opens its print-shopping flow. When a successful photo or customization step returns, it continues to the shopping cart.
en.disableEffect: The Gooten flow cannot start or return normally to the cart after product preparation.

zh-CN.description: 宿主应用打开照片打印购物流程时，Gooten Android SDK 会使用此入口页面；照片选择或定制步骤成功返回后，流程会继续进入购物车。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Gooten 流程将无法正常启动，商品准备完成后也无法返回购物车。

en.description: When a shopper connects Dropbox in the Gooten photo picker, this Activity opens Dropbox authorization in a web page. After sign-in, the Gooten picker can browse account photos.
en.disableEffect: The Dropbox connection and photo-import flow cannot complete.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Gooten 照片选择器中连接 Dropbox 时，此页面会打开 Dropbox 授权网页。登录后，Gooten 选择器即可浏览账户中的照片。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Dropbox 连接和照片导入流程将无法完成。

en.description: When a shopper chooses Facebook as a Gooten photo source, this Activity starts Facebook sign-in and requests access to the account's photos.
en.disableEffect: Shoppers cannot authorize Facebook or import photos from that account through Gooten.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Gooten 中选择 Facebook 作为照片来源时，此页面会启动 Facebook 登录并请求访问账户照片。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法授权 Facebook，也无法通过 Gooten 导入该账户中的照片。

en.description: When a shopper connects Flickr in the Gooten photo picker, this Activity opens Flickr authorization and returns to the picker after sign-in. The connected source can then load photos and albums.
en.disableEffect: Shoppers cannot connect Flickr or import its photos and albums through Gooten.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Gooten 照片选择器中连接 Flickr 时，此页面会打开 Flickr 授权页面，并在登录后返回选择器。连接成功后即可加载照片和相册。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法连接 Flickr，也无法通过 Gooten 导入其中的照片和相册。

en.description: When a shopper connects Instagram in the Gooten photo picker, this Activity opens the account-authorization page and returns the result to the photo source.
en.disableEffect: Shoppers cannot authorize Instagram or use it to import photos through Gooten.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Gooten 照片选择器中连接 Instagram 时，此页面会打开账户授权页面，并将授权结果返回给照片来源。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法授权 Instagram，也无法通过 Gooten 从中导入照片。

en.description: Privakey’s Android SDK opens the configured identity provider’s sign-in page in a browser view, then returns an authorization code or ID token and any error when the provider redirects back.
en.disableEffect: Privakey sign-in and authentication flows cannot complete.

zh-CN.description: Privakey Android SDK 会在内置浏览器中打开配置的身份服务商登录页面，并在服务商重定向返回时向应用交回授权码、ID 令牌或错误。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Privakey 登录和身份验证流程将无法完成。

en.description: When EasyPermissions needs to direct a user to the app's system permission settings, this Activity displays a confirmation dialog, opens the settings page, and returns the result.
en.disableEffect: The permission-settings prompt may fail to open, leaving app features that need the denied permission unavailable.

zh-CN.description: EasyPermissions 需要引导用户前往应用的系统权限设置时，此 Activity 会显示确认对话框、打开设置页面并返回结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，权限设置提示可能无法打开，依赖该权限的应用功能也将无法使用。

en.description: When a Doric screen is opened, this Activity displays it and passes permission and activity results back to the screen.
en.disableEffect: Doric screens launched through this Activity will fail to open.

zh-CN.description: 打开 Doric 页面时，此 Activity 会显示页面，并将权限请求和其他页面操作的结果返回给该页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，通过此 Activity 打开的 Doric 页面将无法显示。

en.description: Doric's developer kit opens this Activity to scan a QR code containing a development-server address. It starts the camera and returns the decoded address to the developer panel.
en.disableEffect: Developers cannot connect to a Doric development server by scanning a QR code.

zh-CN.description: Doric 开发工具会用此 Activity 扫描包含开发服务器地址的二维码，并将识别出的地址返回开发面板。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，开发者将无法通过扫描二维码连接 Doric 开发服务器。

en.description: When Doric's developer tools are opened, this Activity lists active Doric screens and lets developers connect to a development server or turn diagnostics on and off.
en.disableEffect: Doric's in-app development panel and debugging controls will be unavailable; regular app screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: 打开 Doric 开发工具时，此 Activity 会列出正在运行的 Doric 页面，并让开发者连接开发服务器或开关诊断功能。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Doric 应用内开发面板和调试控件将无法使用；应用的常规页面仍可使用。

en.description: Doric's developer kit opens this Activity from a screen's debugging menu to show rendering timings and detailed performance steps.
en.disableEffect: Developers lose Doric screen performance details; regular app features are unaffected.

zh-CN.description: Doric 开发工具会从页面调试菜单打开此 Activity，显示页面渲染用时和详细性能步骤。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，开发者无法查看 Doric 页面性能详情；应用常规功能不受影响。

en.description: Doric's developer kit opens this Activity to display an expandable tree of the current screen's nested layout elements.
en.disableEffect: Developers cannot inspect the Doric screen layout tree; regular app features are unaffected.

zh-CN.description: Doric 开发工具会用此 Activity 展示当前页面中可展开的嵌套布局树。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，开发者无法检查 Doric 页面布局树；应用常规功能不受影响。

en.description: When a Doric app requests barcode scanning, this extension opens the camera and returns the scanned text and barcode format.
en.disableEffect: App features that scan barcodes through the Doric extension will stop working.

zh-CN.description: Doric 应用请求扫描条码时，此扩展会打开相机并返回识别出的文本和条码格式。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，通过 Doric 扩展扫描条码的应用功能将无法使用。

en.description: When Tencent Yunxiaowei DMSDK requests its service identity or server list, this provider returns the device identifier and network addresses the SDK needs to contact Tencent.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it can prevent DMSDK from resolving the identifiers or server addresses needed for its online features.

zh-CN.description: 腾讯云小微 DMSDK 查询服务身份或服务器列表时，这个提供器会返回 SDK 联系腾讯服务所需的设备标识和网络地址。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，DMSDK 可能无法取得在线功能所需的设备标识或服务器地址。

en.description: BasePopup (RazerDP) initializes automatically as the app starts and tracks the screen currently in front so its popup windows can attach to it.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, BasePopup will not track the current screen at startup, so popup windows that depend on it may fail to appear.

zh-CN.description: BasePopup（RazerDP）弹窗库会在应用启动时自动初始化并跟踪当前页面，让它的弹窗能够显示在正确页面上。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，BasePopup 无法在启动时跟踪当前页面，依赖它的弹窗可能无法显示。

en.description: When enabled, the Befrest push library's Receiver responds to network changes and signals its push service to connect or disconnect.
en.disableEffect: Befrest's push connection may not update when network access changes.

zh-CN.description: 启用后，Befrest 推送库的 Receiver 会响应网络变化，并通知推送服务连接或断开。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，网络状态变化时 Befrest 推送连接可能无法及时更新。

en.description: When started by the Befrest push library, this Service maintains a server connection, receives push messages, and broadcasts them to the app; it also reconnects after interruptions.
en.disableEffect: Befrest push messages and connection updates will stop; the app's other features remain available.

zh-CN.description: Befrest 推送库启动此 Service 后，它会维持与服务器的连接、接收推送消息并通知应用；连接中断后也会尝试重连。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Befrest 推送消息和连接状态更新将停止；应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: When the app asks RikkaX Chooser to handle an action, this Activity shows matching apps and lets the user choose one.
en.disableEffect: The app’s RikkaX sharing or open-with selection screen will not appear.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求 RikkaX Chooser 处理某项操作时，此 Activity 会显示可处理该操作的应用供用户选择。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用中的 RikkaX 分享或“打开方式”选择界面将无法显示。

en.description: This provider receives binder from Shizuku server. When app process starts, Shizuku server (it runs under adb/root) will send the binder to client apps with this provider.

zh-CN.description: 此提供程序接收来自 Shizuku 服务器的 Binder。当应用进程启动时，在 adb/root 下运行的Shizuku 服务器将使用此提供程序将 Binder 发送给客户端应用程序。

en.description: When the app opens its optional route-list page, Deepthought Routing by Teagan42 lists the navigation routes registered with the library and their descriptions.
en.disableEffect: The route-list page will not open, while other registered destinations can still work.

zh-CN.description: 当应用打开可选的路由列表页面时，Teagan42 的 Deepthought Routing 会显示已注册的导航路由及其说明。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，这个路由列表页面无法打开，但其他已注册的页面仍可使用。

en.description: AndroidPvt by arthursmel opens a psychomotor vigilance test with instructions, timed visual stimuli, and reaction-time recording. At the end it returns the test results to the calling app.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot run this reaction-time test or receive its results.

zh-CN.description: arthursmel 的 AndroidPvt 会打开精神运动警觉性测试，显示提示和限时视觉刺激并记录反应时间。测试结束后，它会把结果返回给调用应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法运行这项反应时间测试或接收测试结果。

en.description: When a user opens a knowledge-base article in the app's help center, Apps-M inapphelp displays the selected article.
en.disableEffect: The in-app help center cannot open its knowledge-base articles.

zh-CN.description: 当用户在应用内帮助中心打开知识库文章时，Apps-M inapphelp 会显示所选文章。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，应用内帮助中心无法打开知识库文章。

en.description: When a user adds a picture to an in-app help ticket, Apps-M inapphelp opens a picture chooser and lets the user mark up the selected image before attaching it.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot edit and attach pictures to help requests through this flow.

zh-CN.description: 当用户为应用内帮助工单添加图片时，Apps-M inapphelp 会让用户选择图片、在图片上标记并将其作为附件返回。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，用户无法通过此流程编辑图片并将其附加到帮助请求中。

en.description: When a user opens in-app help, Apps-M inapphelp displays the help home page and its available topics.
en.disableEffect: The app's in-app help home page cannot be opened.

zh-CN.description: 当用户打开应用内帮助时，Apps-M inapphelp 会显示帮助首页和可用主题。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，应用内帮助首页无法打开。

en.description: When a user opens an image attachment in an in-app help article or ticket, Apps-M inapphelp displays that image.
en.disableEffect: Image attachments in the help center cannot be previewed in the app.

zh-CN.description: 当用户在应用内帮助文章或工单中打开图片附件时，Apps-M inapphelp 会显示该图片。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，用户无法在应用中预览帮助中心的图片附件。

en.description: When a user opens an existing help request, Apps-M inapphelp displays that ticket's details; it can also open a ticket reached from a help notification.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open help-ticket details through the in-app support flow.

zh-CN.description: 当用户打开已有的帮助请求时，Apps-M inapphelp 会显示工单详情；从帮助通知进入的工单也会在此打开。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，用户无法通过应用内支持流程查看工单详情。

en.description: When a user chooses to report a problem through in-app help, Apps-M inapphelp opens the form for creating a support ticket.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot submit new support tickets through this help-center flow.

zh-CN.description: 当用户通过应用内帮助报告问题时，Apps-M inapphelp 会打开创建支持工单的表单。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，用户无法通过此帮助中心流程提交新的支持工单。

en.description: When someone submits a first help ticket without a saved help profile, Apps-M inapphelp displays a form for their name and email and then continues ticket creation.
en.disableEffect: A new help-center user cannot register and submit their first ticket through this flow.

zh-CN.description: 首次提交帮助工单且没有已保存资料时，Apps-M inapphelp 会显示姓名和邮箱登记表，完成验证后继续创建工单。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 新用户无法通过此流程登记资料并提交第一张帮助工单。

en.description: When a user opens a topic section in the help knowledge base, Apps-M inapphelp displays that section and its entries.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open knowledge-base sections in the in-app help center.

zh-CN.description: 当用户打开帮助知识库中的主题栏目时，Apps-M inapphelp 会显示该栏目及其条目。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，用户无法打开应用内帮助中心的知识库栏目。

en.description: When a help attachment download finishes or the user taps its download notification, Apps-M inapphelp reports the result or opens the system download list.
en.disableEffect: The help center will not show its attachment-download completion notification or handle its download-notification shortcut.

zh-CN.description: 帮助附件下载完成或用户点击下载通知时，Apps-M inapphelp 会显示下载结果，或打开系统下载列表。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，帮助中心不会显示附件下载完成通知，也无法处理该通知的下载列表入口。

en.description: The 0xera ThemeChanger library shows a brief screenshot transition when the user changes themes, then returns control to the host app to finish the change.
en.disableEffect: The host app cannot use this transition screen as part of theme switching, so that theme-change path stops working.

zh-CN.description: 用户切换主题时，0xera ThemeChanger 库会短暂显示截图过渡效果，然后交由应用完成主题切换。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用无法通过此过渡页面完成主题切换，因此该切换路径会失效。

en.description: When opened, Bartwell's Delight SQL Viewer provides a screen for browsing and editing databases registered by the app.
en.disableEffect: Database browsing and editing through this viewer will be unavailable, while the app can still use its databases normally.

zh-CN.description: 打开后，Bartwell 的 Delight SQL Viewer 会提供界面，让用户浏览和编辑应用注册的数据库。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，无法通过此查看器浏览或编辑数据库，但应用仍可照常使用这些数据库。

en.description: When opened, Bartwell's Delight SQL Viewer entry Activity provides a screen for browsing and editing databases registered by the app.
en.disableEffect: The SQL viewer screen will not open, while the app can still use its databases normally.

zh-CN.description: 打开后，Bartwell 的 Delight SQL Viewer 入口 Activity 会提供界面，让用户浏览和编辑应用注册的数据库。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，SQL 查看器界面无法打开，但应用仍可照常使用其数据库。

en.description: When the app asks Bartwell's ExFilePicker to choose files or folders, this Activity shows a storage browser and returns the selected path or paths.
en.disableEffect: File and folder selection through ExFilePicker will fail when the app needs it.

zh-CN.description: 当应用调用 Bartwell 的 ExFilePicker 选择文件或文件夹时，此 Activity 会显示存储浏览器并返回所选路径。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用需要通过 ExFilePicker 选取文件或文件夹时，该流程会失败。

en.description: When the app starts Bartwell's Ultra Debugger on a chosen port, this Service runs a local web interface for its diagnostic modules.
en.disableEffect: Ultra Debugger's local diagnostic pages and endpoints will be unavailable; normal app screens are not served by this Service.

zh-CN.description: 应用在指定端口启动 Bartwell 的 Ultra Debugger 时，此 Service 会运行本地网页界面，供其诊断模块使用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，Ultra Debugger 的本地诊断页面和接口将无法使用；普通应用页面不由此 Service 提供。

en.description: E. Rikov FilePicker handles Android’s GET_CONTENT file request by letting users browse shared storage and return a selected file to the calling app.
en.disableEffect: Apps cannot use this library’s screen to pick a file from shared storage.

zh-CN.description: E. Rikov FilePicker 会处理 Android 的 GET_CONTENT 文件请求，让用户浏览共享存储并将选中的文件返回给调用应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法通过该库的界面从共享存储中选择文件。

en.description: E. Rikov FilePicker exposes internal storage as a source in Android’s document picker and lets that picker list, open, create, and delete documents.
en.disableEffect: Internal storage is no longer available through this provider in Android’s document picker, which can interrupt file selection or editing.

zh-CN.description: E. Rikov FilePicker 会将内部存储作为来源提供给 Android 文档选择器，并让该选择器列出、打开、创建和删除文档。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，Android 文档选择器将无法通过此 Provider 访问内部存储，文件选择或编辑流程可能中断。

en.description: YooMoney's YooKassa payments SDK receives phone-state changes while its payment security checks are active. It passes these events to the checks as device-risk signals.
en.disableEffect: The payment security checks will no longer receive phone-state signals, which may prevent a payment that depends on them from completing.

zh-CN.description: YooMoney 的 YooKassa 支付 SDK 会在支付安全检查运行时接收电话状态变化，并将这些事件作为设备风险信号交给检查流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 支付安全检查将无法再收到电话状态信号，依赖这些信号的付款可能无法完成。

en.description: YooMoney's YooKassa payments SDK uses this background service when its device-security checks need to run. It keeps the SDK's security-data collection available during checkout.
en.disableEffect: Checkout cannot use this service for device-security checks, so a payment that depends on those checks may fail.

zh-CN.description: YooMoney 的 YooKassa 支付 SDK 会在需要执行设备安全检查时使用此后台服务。它让结账流程中的安全数据收集保持可用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 结账流程无法通过此服务执行设备安全检查，依赖这些检查的付款可能会失败。

en.description: KiberneticWorm’s Awesome Buttons library uses this launcher screen to showcase animated icon and text buttons.
en.disableEffect: The button showcase screen will no longer open from its launcher entry.

zh-CN.description: KiberneticWorm 的 Awesome Buttons 库通过此启动页面展示带动画的图标按钮和文字按钮。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，启动入口将无法打开按钮展示页面。

en.description: JNDCrash, Ivan Arh’s native crash reporter, starts this service in a separate process when the app enables out-of-process crash handling. It collects native crash details and writes a report in the background.
en.disableEffect: Native crash reports will no longer be collected by this service; normal app features should continue to work.

zh-CN.description: Ivan Arh 的 JNDCrash 原生崩溃报告库在应用启用独立进程崩溃处理时启动此服务。它在后台收集原生崩溃信息并生成报告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 此服务将不再收集原生崩溃报告，但应用的普通功能应可继续使用。

en.description: Mail.ru's OAuth SDK opens this Activity when an app starts Mail.ru sign-in; it uses the Mail.ru app or a browser/web sign-in flow and returns the authentication result.
en.disableEffect: Mail.ru sign-in cannot complete in apps that use this SDK.

zh-CN.description: 应用使用 Mail.ru OAuth SDK 开始 Mail.ru 登录时会打开此 Activity；它通过 Mail.ru 应用或浏览器网页完成登录并返回认证结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此 SDK 的应用将无法完成 Mail.ru 登录。

en.description: When a browser returns from Mail.ru sign-in, this Activity receives the redirect and passes its response back to the OAuth sign-in flow.
en.disableEffect: The browser-based Mail.ru sign-in flow may not return its result to the app.

zh-CN.description: 浏览器完成 Mail.ru 登录并返回时，此 Activity 接收跳转结果并交回 OAuth 登录流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 浏览器版 Mail.ru 登录可能无法把结果返回应用。

en.description: When Firebase Cloud Messaging delivers a push message or refreshes its token, this Mail.ru libnotify service passes the message or token to the notification SDK.
en.disableEffect: libnotify notifications and token updates will stop arriving through Firebase; other app features remain available.

zh-CN.description: Firebase Cloud Messaging 收到推送消息或更新推送令牌时，Mail.ru 的 libnotify 服务会将消息或令牌交给通知 SDK。
zh-CN.disableEffect: libnotify 将无法通过 Firebase 接收通知或令牌更新；应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: When Huawei Push Kit delivers a push message or refreshes its token, this Mail.ru libnotify service passes the message or token to the notification SDK.
en.disableEffect: libnotify notifications and token updates will stop arriving through Huawei Push Kit; other app features remain available.

zh-CN.description: Huawei Push Kit 收到推送消息或更新推送令牌时，Mail.ru 的 libnotify 服务会将消息或令牌交给通知 SDK。
