zh-CN.disableEffect: libnotify 将无法通过 Huawei Push Kit 接收通知或令牌更新；应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: When RuStore Push delivers a message or refreshes its token, this Mail.ru libnotify service passes the message data or token to the notification SDK.
en.disableEffect: libnotify notifications and token updates will stop arriving through RuStore; other app features remain available.

zh-CN.description: RuStore Push 收到推送消息或更新推送令牌时，Mail.ru 的 libnotify 服务会将消息数据或令牌交给通知 SDK。
zh-CN.disableEffect: libnotify 将无法通过 RuStore 接收通知或令牌更新；应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: Mail.ru libnotify's debug package opens this dashboard for inspecting notification data and launching banner or in-app preview screens.
en.disableEffect: The libnotify debug dashboard cannot be opened; regular notifications do not use this screen.

zh-CN.description: Mail.ru libnotify 的调试模块会打开此面板，用于查看通知数据以及进入横幅或应用内消息预览页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: libnotify 调试面板将无法打开；常规通知不使用此页面。

en.description: Opened from Mail.ru libnotify's debug panel, this screen can fetch banner data, list saved banners, inspect their data, and display a preview banner.
en.disableEffect: Banner-fetching and preview controls in the libnotify debug tools will be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: 从 Mail.ru libnotify 调试面板打开后，此页面可获取横幅数据、列出已保存的横幅、查看其内容并显示预览横幅。
zh-CN.disableEffect: libnotify 调试工具中的横幅获取和预览功能将无法使用。

en.description: After a tester selects a saved banner or in-app item, Mail.ru libnotify opens this screen to show the item's details and event state.
en.disableEffect: Detailed inspection of a selected item in libnotify's debug tools will be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: 测试人员选中已保存的横幅或应用内消息后，Mail.ru libnotify 会打开此页面显示该项目的详情和事件状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: libnotify 调试工具将无法查看所选项目的详细信息。

en.description: Mail.ru libnotify's debug screens open this page to list saved banner or in-app items and let a tester select one for inspection.
en.disableEffect: The saved-item list in libnotify's debug tools will be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: Mail.ru libnotify 的调试页面会打开此列表，展示已保存的横幅或应用内消息，供测试人员选择查看。
zh-CN.disableEffect: libnotify 调试工具中的已保存项目列表将无法使用。

en.description: Mail.ru libnotify's debug screens open this page with data to display JSON objects and lists in a readable view.
en.disableEffect: The JSON inspection page in libnotify's debug tools will be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: Mail.ru libnotify 的调试页面会将数据传入此页面，以易读方式展示 JSON 对象和列表。
zh-CN.disableEffect: libnotify 调试工具中的 JSON 查看页面将无法使用。

en.description: Opened from Mail.ru libnotify's debug panel, this screen provides controls to fetch and view in-app notification data and inspect its events.
en.disableEffect: Fetching and previewing in-app notification data from libnotify's debug tools will be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: 从 Mail.ru libnotify 调试面板打开后，此页面可获取和查看应用内通知数据并检查相关事件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: libnotify 调试工具将无法获取或预览应用内通知数据。

en.description: In older Mail.ru libnotify releases, Firebase Cloud Messaging calls this service for messages and token updates; it forwards the sender, message data, or token to libnotify.
en.disableEffect: Firebase push messages and token updates will no longer reach this libnotify release; other app features remain available.

zh-CN.description: 在较早的 Mail.ru libnotify 版本中，Firebase Cloud Messaging 会在收到消息或更新令牌时调用此服务；它会将发送方、消息数据或令牌交给 libnotify。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 此版本的 libnotify 将无法再通过 Firebase 接收推送消息或令牌更新；应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: In older Mail.ru libnotify releases, Huawei Push Kit calls this service for messages and token updates; it forwards the sender, message data, or token to libnotify.
en.disableEffect: Huawei push messages and token updates will no longer reach this libnotify release; other app features remain available.

zh-CN.description: 在较早的 Mail.ru libnotify 版本中，Huawei Push Kit 会在收到消息或更新令牌时调用此服务；它会将发送方、消息数据或令牌交给 libnotify。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 此版本的 libnotify 将无法再通过华为推送接收消息或令牌更新；应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: When a user opens a rich Mail.ru libnotify notification, this Activity displays its image, title, message, and up to three buttons.
en.disableEffect: Rich notifications that use this landing screen will not open or respond to their buttons.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 Mail.ru libnotify 的图文通知时，此 Activity 会显示图片、标题、消息和最多三个按钮。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此页面的图文通知将无法打开，通知按钮也无法响应。

en.description: When Mail.ru libnotify has an image-and-text landing ready, it opens this screen to display the notification content and its configured buttons.
en.disableEffect: Image-and-text landing pages and their image or button actions in libnotify messages will be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: Mail.ru 的 libnotify 准备好图文落地页后，会打开此页面显示通知内容和配置的按钮。
zh-CN.disableEffect: libnotify 消息中的图文落地页及其图片或按钮操作将无法使用。

en.description: Mail.ru libnotify opens this short-lived screen for a notification tap or button action that must be handed to the SDK's background handler; the screen then closes.
en.disableEffect: Notification taps or buttons that use this route will no longer be handled by libnotify.

zh-CN.description: Mail.ru libnotify 会短暂打开此页面，将需要交给 SDK 后台处理的通知点击或按钮操作传递过去，随后关闭页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此路径的通知点击或按钮将无法由 libnotify 处理。

en.description: When Google Play broadcasts the install referrer, this Mail.ru libnotify receiver forwards the referrer text to the SDK for install attribution.
en.disableEffect: libnotify will not receive install-attribution information for new installs.

zh-CN.description: Google Play 广播安装来源信息时，Mail.ru 的 libnotify 接收器会将来源文本交给 SDK 用于安装归因。
zh-CN.disableEffect: libnotify 将无法收到新安装的来源归因信息。

en.description: Android invokes this Mail.ru libnotify provider at app startup to initialize the SDK; notification screens also use it to share local image files.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it can prevent libnotify from initializing automatically and can break notifications that need to open local images or files.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，Android 会调用 Mail.ru 的 libnotify 内容提供器来初始化 SDK；通知页面也会通过它打开本地图片文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后 libnotify 可能无法自动初始化，需要打开本地图片或文件的通知也可能无法正常工作。

en.description: Mail.ru libverify, a phone verification SDK, schedules this Service as a background job when it has fetch work and a network connection is available. It helps refresh data used by the SDK verification flow.
en.disableEffect: Mail.ru libverify may stop refreshing verification data in the background, so phone verification can miss updates or fail.

zh-CN.description: Mail.ru libverify 手机验证 SDK 会在有网络时把此 Service 安排为后台任务，用于更新 SDK 验证流程所需的数据。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Mail.ru libverify 可能无法在后台更新验证数据，手机验证可能错过更新或失败。

en.description: Mail.ru libverify starts this Service for fetcher start or stop requests and for a fetch check when no action is supplied. It runs background retrieval used by the phone verification SDK.
en.disableEffect: Mail.ru libverify may stop running background fetch checks, which can leave phone verification without current data.

zh-CN.description: Mail.ru libverify 会在收到启动、停止或未指定操作的检查请求时运行此 Service，为手机验证 SDK 获取后台数据。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Mail.ru libverify 可能无法执行后台获取检查，手机验证所需的数据可能无法及时更新。

en.description: When Google or Firebase issues a new push token, Mail.ru libverify uses this Service to refresh its token registration for verification messages.
en.disableEffect: After a token change, libverify may stop receiving verification messages, which can interrupt automatic phone verification.

zh-CN.description: Google 或 Firebase 更新推送令牌时，Mail.ru libverify 会通过此 Service 刷新用于接收验证消息的令牌登记。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 令牌变更后，libverify 可能无法继续收到验证消息，从而中断自动手机号验证。

en.description: After a Google push handler hands it a Mail.ru libverify message, this Service processes verification data and server or fetcher updates for the SDK.
en.disableEffect: Push-based verification messages and SDK updates will not be processed.

zh-CN.description: Google 推送处理器将 Mail.ru libverify 消息交给此 Service 后，它会处理验证数据以及 SDK 的服务器或获取器更新。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，基于推送的验证消息和 SDK 更新将无法处理。

en.description: When Google Firebase/GCM delivers a push message for Mail.ru libverify, this Service forwards it into the verification SDK for processing.
en.disableEffect: Push-delivered verification messages and updates will stop reaching libverify.

zh-CN.description: Google Firebase/GCM 为 Mail.ru libverify 送达推送消息时，此 Service 会将消息交给验证 SDK 处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，libverify 将无法收到通过推送送达的验证消息和更新。

en.description: When Mail.ru libverify starts or its push token changes, this Service obtains and stores the app's Google push registration token, retrying if needed.
en.disableEffect: Libverify may not register for verification messages, so automatic phone verification can stop working.

zh-CN.description: Mail.ru libverify 启动或推送令牌变更时，此 Service 会获取并保存应用的 Google 推送登记令牌，失败时会重试。
zh-CN.disableEffect: libverify 可能无法登记接收验证消息，导致自动手机号验证无法使用。

en.description: Apps or processes that use Mail.ru libverify can bind to this Service to exchange phone verification messages with the SDK. It runs when an integrated app requests that connection.
en.disableEffect: Apps that rely on Mail.ru libverify across processes may lose verification requests and results, disrupting SMS login or phone verification.

zh-CN.description: 集成 Mail.ru libverify 的应用或进程可绑定此 Service，与 SDK 交换手机验证消息；集成方请求连接时它会运行。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖 Mail.ru libverify 跨进程功能的应用可能无法发送验证请求或接收结果，从而影响短信登录或手机验证。

en.description: Apps or processes that use Mail.ru libverify can bind to this Service to exchange SMS notification events with the SDK. It runs when an integrated app requests that connection.
en.disableEffect: Apps that rely on Mail.ru libverify notification handling across processes may lose notification events or controls.

zh-CN.description: 集成 Mail.ru libverify 的应用或进程可绑定此 Service，与 SDK 交换短信通知事件；集成方请求连接时它会运行。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖 Mail.ru libverify 跨进程通知处理的应用可能无法接收通知事件或执行通知操作。

en.description: Mail.ru libverify receives Android broadcasts when the app or a notification channel is blocked or unblocked, then refreshes its notification settings. It runs after those system notification settings change.
en.disableEffect: The SDK may not notice a notification setting change promptly, so SMS verification alerts may use an outdated setting.

zh-CN.description: 当应用或通知频道被禁止或重新允许时，Mail.ru libverify 接收 Android 广播并刷新通知设置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: SDK 可能无法及时发现通知设置变化，短信验证提醒可能继续使用旧设置。

en.description: Mail.ru libverify runs this Service when you confirm, cancel, or dismiss one of its SMS notifications. It sends that choice to the verification SDK.
en.disableEffect: Confirming or dismissing SMS verification notifications may stop working, which can interrupt a verification flow.

zh-CN.description: 当你确认、取消或关闭 Mail.ru libverify 的短信通知时，此 Service 会运行并把你的选择交给验证 SDK。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 短信验证通知的确认或关闭操作可能失效，从而中断验证流程。

en.description: Mail.ru libverify opens this Activity from an SMS notification to show notification options, including blocking alerts and viewing message history. It runs when the user opens that notification's settings.
en.disableEffect: The SMS notification settings screen will be unavailable, but the app's other features and phone verification can continue.

zh-CN.description: 从短信通知打开时，Mail.ru libverify 会用此 Activity 显示通知选项，包括屏蔽提醒和查看消息历史。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 短信通知设置页面将无法使用，但应用的其他功能和手机验证仍可继续。

zh-CN.description: 点击短信验证提醒时，Mail.ru libverify 会打开此 Activity 显示短信内容，并提供确认、关闭和设置选项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 你可能无法在 SDK 中查看或确认短信验证提醒，依赖此流程的登录可能失败。

en.description: Mail.ru libverify opens this Activity to show a list of SMS notification conversations. Tapping a conversation opens its message history.

zh-CN.description: Mail.ru libverify 使用此 Activity 显示短信通知会话列表；点击会话可查看其中的消息历史。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 短信通知会话历史将无法查看。

en.description: Mail.ru libverify opens this Activity to show the SMS notification history for a selected conversation. It runs when a user opens a conversation from the history list.
en.disableEffect: The messages stored for SMS notification history will no longer be viewable in the app.

zh-CN.description: Mail.ru libverify 使用此 Activity 显示所选会话的短信通知历史；用户从历史列表打开会话时它会运行。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用中将无法查看短信通知历史中保存的消息。

zh-CN.description: Mail.ru libverify 的 Firebase 集成通过此 Service 接收手机验证相关的 Firebase Cloud Messaging 消息和推送令牌更新。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Mail.ru libverify 将无法接收 Firebase 推送消息和令牌更新，依赖推送的验证功能可能受影响。

en.description: Mail.ru libverify's Firebase integration receives the SMS Retriever result from Google Play services and passes it to the verification SDK. It runs when an SMS retrieval result arrives.

zh-CN.description: Mail.ru libverify 的 Firebase 集成会接收 Google Play 服务返回的短信检索结果，并交给验证 SDK 处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过 Google Play 服务自动读取短信验证码将停止，验证可能需要手动输入验证码或失败。

en.description: Mail.ru libverify's Huawei integration receives Huawei push messages and refreshed push tokens used by phone verification.
en.disableEffect: Mail.ru libverify will stop receiving Huawei push messages and token updates, which can disrupt verification features that use push.

zh-CN.description: Mail.ru libverify 的华为集成会接收手机验证所用的华为推送消息和推送令牌更新。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Mail.ru libverify 将无法接收华为推送消息和令牌更新，依赖推送的验证功能可能受影响。

en.description: Mail.ru libverify's Huawei integration receives SMS Retriever results from Huawei services and passes them to the verification SDK.
en.disableEffect: Automatic SMS code retrieval through Huawei services will stop, so verification may require manual code entry or fail.

zh-CN.description: Mail.ru libverify 的华为集成会接收华为服务返回的短信检索结果，并交给验证 SDK 处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过华为服务自动读取短信验证码将停止，验证可能需要手动输入验证码或失败。

zh-CN.disableEffect: 基于来电的手机验证将停止，依赖此方式的登录流程可能失败。

en.description: Mail.ru libverify listens for incoming SMS broadcasts and forwards each message to its verification system. It runs when a text message arrives.
en.disableEffect: Automatic SMS code detection will stop, so sign-in may require manual code entry or fail.

zh-CN.description: Mail.ru libverify 会监听收到的短信广播，并把短信交给验证系统处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 自动检测短信验证码将停止，登录可能需要手动输入验证码或失败。

en.disableEffect: Automatic SMS or call verification will stop, so related sign-in flows may require manual steps or fail.

zh-CN.description: Mail.ru libverify 会处理手机验证所需的来信短信和响铃来电信息，提取短信发件方与内容后交给 SDK。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 自动短信或来电验证将停止，相关登录流程可能需要手动操作或失败。

en.description: When Google or Huawei's SMS Retriever reports a message for an active verification request, this Receiver passes the result to Mail.ru libverify.

zh-CN.description: Google 或 Huawei 的短信检索服务为当前验证请求报告短信时，此 Receiver 会将结果交给 Mail.ru libverify。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过短信检索服务收到的验证码将无法进入 SDK 的验证流程。

en.description: When the SMS Retriever service returns a result, Mail.ru libverify checks its status and passes any retrieved text to the active verification flow.

zh-CN.description: Mail.ru libverify 会接收定时提醒，用于刷新推送令牌、检查 SDK 设置、更新短信模板或解除通知屏蔽。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 定时验证设置检查和推送令牌更新可能停止，手机验证或相关提醒可能无法及时更新。

en.description: When the battery becomes low, recovers, or charging starts, this Receiver reports the battery-state change to Mail.ru libverify.

zh-CN.description: 电量变低、恢复正常或开始充电时，此 Receiver 会向 Mail.ru libverify 报告电池状态变化。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，libverify 将收不到这些电池状态更新。

en.description: This Mail.ru libverify compatibility Receiver forwards a network event to the SDK's current connection-state handler.
en.disableEffect: Libverify may miss connectivity changes, delaying network checks when service returns.

zh-CN.description: 此 Mail.ru libverify 兼容 Receiver 会把网络事件转交给 SDK 当前的连接状态处理器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，libverify 可能错过网络状态变化，网络恢复后的检查也可能延迟。

en.description: When the app is replaced or a package is removed, Mail.ru libverify refreshes push registration and schedules a package-state check.
en.disableEffect: Libverify may miss an app-update or package-state check, interrupting verification setup after an update.

zh-CN.description: 应用更新或软件包移除时，Mail.ru libverify 会刷新推送登记并安排软件包状态检查。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，libverify 可能错过应用更新或软件包状态检查，影响更新后的验证设置。

en.description: When the screen turns on or off, this Receiver records the new screen state and event time for Mail.ru libverify.

en.description: When Mail.ru libverify queues a settings or device-state check on older Android versions, this Service runs it in the background.

zh-CN.description: 较旧的 Android 版本上，Mail.ru libverify 排队设置或设备状态检查时，此 Service 会在后台执行检查。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，排队的 SDK 检查可能无法完成，使手机号验证设置或更新不完整。

en.description: After the device finishes restarting, this Receiver asks Mail.ru libverify to refresh push registration and run its startup check.

zh-CN.description: 设备重新启动完成后，此 Receiver 会让 Mail.ru libverify 刷新推送登记并执行启动检查。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 设备重启后，验证消息登记和启动检查可能无法恢复。

en.description: While Mail.ru libverify has verification work to finish, this JobService keeps its background task scheduled with a network requirement.
en.disableEffect: Phone-verification work may stop before finishing when the app is in the background.

zh-CN.description: Mail.ru libverify 有验证任务待完成时，此 JobService 会在需要网络的条件下保持后台任务的调度。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用处于后台时，手机号验证任务可能在完成前停止。

en.description: While Mail.ru libverify has verification work in progress, this Service keeps the background operation active.

zh-CN.description: Mail.ru libverify 需要检查网络时会安排此后台 Service；有网络连接后，它会作为任务运行。

en.description: This Mail.ru libverify compatibility Receiver forwards a network event to the SDK's current connection-state handler.

en.disableEffect: Queued verification and notification actions may not run, which can interrupt sign-in or leave SDK settings out of date.

zh-CN.disableEffect: 排队的验证和通知操作可能无法运行，从而中断登录或导致 SDK 设置过期。

en.description: Mail.ru libverify processes background actions for verification, notifications, and SDK settings. It runs when the SDK sends it an action to handle.
en.disableEffect: Verification and notification actions sent through this Service may stop running, which can disrupt sign-in.

zh-CN.description: Mail.ru libverify 会处理验证、通知和 SDK 设置的后台操作；SDK 发送待处理操作时它会运行。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过此 Service 发送的验证和通知操作可能无法执行，从而影响登录。

en.description: When the device date, time, or time zone changes, this Receiver notifies Mail.ru libverify so it can update time-sensitive checks.
en.disableEffect: Libverify may keep stale clock or time-zone information for verification checks.

zh-CN.description: 设备日期、时间或时区变化时，此 Receiver 会通知 Mail.ru libverify 更新依赖时间的检查。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，libverify 在验证检查中可能继续使用过期的时钟或时区信息。

en.description: Mail.ru libverify keeps active phone verification work eligible to continue as a network-required Android job. It runs while the SDK has verification work in progress.
en.disableEffect: Active verification work may be interrupted in the background, causing a phone verification or sign-in attempt to fail.

zh-CN.description: Mail.ru libverify 会将进行中的手机验证保持为需要网络的 Android 后台任务；SDK 有验证任务时它会运行。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 后台运行中的验证任务可能被中断，导致手机验证或登录失败。

en.description: Mail.ru libverify keeps active verification work running in the background and holds a temporary wake lock while needed. It starts when the SDK has an operation in progress.
en.disableEffect: Phone verification work may stop when the app is in the background, which can make a sign-in attempt fail.

zh-CN.description: Mail.ru libverify 会在后台维持进行中的验证任务，并在需要时短暂保持设备唤醒；SDK 有操作进行时它会启动。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用进入后台后手机验证任务可能停止，导致登录失败。

en.description: When Android reports a connectivity change, this Mail.ru libverify Receiver updates the connection state and notifies the SDK when it changes.
en.disableEffect: The SDK may not notice restored network access, delaying phone-verification checks.

zh-CN.description: Android 报告网络连接变化时，此 Mail.ru libverify Receiver 会更新连接状态，并在状态变化时通知 SDK。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，SDK 可能无法及时发现网络恢复，导致手机号验证检查延迟。

en.description: Stingray Mobile Palette opens this launcher Activity as an image color-picking screen. Dragging across its sample image selects a region and displays colors extracted from it.
en.disableEffect: The Palette screen will no longer launch, so users cannot select an image region or view its extracted colors.

zh-CN.description: Stingray Mobile Palette 会通过此启动 Activity 打开图片取色界面；在示例图片上拖动可选取区域并显示提取出的颜色。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Palette 界面将无法启动，用户不能选取图片区域或查看提取出的颜色。

en.description: JLatexMath-Android initializes the formula-rendering library when the app starts. The library needs this setup to load its math fonts and resources.
en.disableEffect: Math formula rendering can fail because the library cannot access its bundled fonts and resources before initialization.

zh-CN.description: JLatexMath-Android 会在应用启动时初始化公式渲染库；该库需要此初始化来读取数学字体和资源。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 由于库无法在初始化前访问内置字体和资源，数学公式渲染可能失败。

en.description: The Tinkoff Acquiring 3-D Secure SDK opens this Activity when a card issuer requires an HTML verification challenge during payment. It displays the issuer's page and submits the shopper's response to the payment flow.
en.disableEffect: Payments that require this challenge cannot be authenticated and may fail.

zh-CN.description: 发卡行在付款时要求通过 HTML 页面验证时，Tinkoff 收单 3-D Secure SDK 会打开此 Activity。它显示发卡行提供的验证页面，并把用户提交的结果交回支付流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要此验证的付款将无法完成身份验证，可能会失败。

en.description: The Tinkoff Acquiring 3-D Secure SDK opens this Activity when a card issuer asks the shopper to choose several answers in a payment challenge. It shows the available choices and sends the selected answers back for verification.
en.disableEffect: Payments that require this multiple-choice challenge cannot be authenticated and may fail.

zh-CN.description: 发卡行要求用户在付款验证中选择多个答案时，Tinkoff 收单 3-D Secure SDK 会打开此 Activity。它显示可选答案，并把用户的选择交回发卡行验证。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要此多选验证的付款将无法完成身份验证，可能会失败。

en.description: The Tinkoff Acquiring 3-D Secure SDK opens this Activity when a card issuer asks the shopper to confirm a payment through a separate channel. It displays the issuer's instructions and returns the confirmation to the payment flow.
en.disableEffect: Payments that require this separate confirmation cannot be authenticated and may fail.

zh-CN.description: 发卡行要求用户通过其他渠道确认付款时，Tinkoff 收单 3-D Secure SDK 会打开此 Activity。它显示发卡行提供的确认说明，并把确认结果交回支付流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要此额外确认的付款将无法完成身份验证，可能会失败。

en.description: The Tinkoff Acquiring 3-D Secure SDK opens this Activity when a card issuer asks the shopper to choose one answer in a payment challenge. It displays the choices and sends the selected answer back for verification.
en.disableEffect: Payments that require this challenge cannot be authenticated and may fail.

zh-CN.description: 发卡行要求用户在付款验证中选择一个答案时，Tinkoff 收单 3-D Secure SDK 会打开此 Activity。它显示可选答案，并把用户的选择交回发卡行验证。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要此验证的付款将无法完成身份验证，可能会失败。

en.description: The Tinkoff Acquiring 3-D Secure SDK opens this Activity when a card issuer requires the shopper to enter text, such as a verification code, during payment. It submits the entered response to the issuer.
en.disableEffect: Payments that require this text challenge cannot be authenticated and may fail.

zh-CN.description: 发卡行要求用户在付款时输入验证码等文字信息时，Tinkoff 收单 3-D Secure SDK 会打开此 Activity。它把用户输入的内容提交给发卡行验证。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要此文字验证的付款将无法完成身份验证，可能会失败。

en.description: When a RuStore SDK needs a system confirmation, this screen opens the supplied confirmation request and returns the user's result to the SDK.
en.disableEffect: RuStore flows that require this system confirmation may not complete.

zh-CN.description: RuStore SDK 需要系统确认时，此页面会打开确认请求，并把用户的选择返回给 SDK。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此系统确认步骤的 RuStore 流程可能无法完成。

en.description: When RuStore Billing needs the user to authorize an account, this screen displays the billing authentication dialog.
en.disableEffect: Users may be unable to sign in or finish purchases that require RuStore account authorization.

zh-CN.description: RuStore Billing 需要用户验证账户时，此页面会显示账户验证对话框。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户可能无法登录，或无法完成需要 RuStore 账户验证的付款。

en.description: Android creates the RuStore Game Center provider during app startup, and it initializes the Game Center client for the app.
en.disableEffect: Game Center features may fail to initialize or open.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，Android 会创建 RuStore Game Center provider，由它初始化游戏中心客户端。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 游戏中心功能可能无法初始化或打开。

en.description: During app startup, the RuStore Imaging SDK creates its shared image loader; image requests made through the SDK use it to fetch and display images.
en.disableEffect: Images requested through the RuStore Imaging SDK may fail to load.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，RuStore Imaging SDK 会创建共享图片加载器，供 SDK 获取并显示图片。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过 RuStore Imaging SDK 请求的图片可能无法加载。

en.description: At app startup, the RuStore Install Referrer SDK reads its type setting from app metadata and stores it for install-referrer reports.
en.disableEffect: Install-referrer reports may be missing the SDK type label.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，RuStore Install Referrer SDK 会读取应用元数据中的 SDK 类型设置，供安装来源报告使用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 安装来源报告可能缺少 SDK 类型标记。

en.description: When Android runs this scheduled RuStore Install Referrer job, it processes and sends a queued install-attribution report.
en.disableEffect: This background install-attribution report will no longer be sent to RuStore.

zh-CN.description: Android 执行此 RuStore Install Referrer 后台任务时，它会处理并发送暂存的安装归因报告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: RuStore 将不再收到这项后台安装归因报告。

en.description: When Android runs this scheduled RuStore Install Referrer job, it processes and sends queued install-referrer data.
en.disableEffect: This background install-referrer report will no longer be sent to RuStore.

zh-CN.description: Android 执行此 RuStore Install Referrer 后台任务时，它会处理并发送暂存的安装来源数据。
zh-CN.disableEffect: RuStore 将不再收到这项后台安装来源报告。

en.description: When Android runs the scheduled job, RuStore Metrics sends queued SDK usage events in the background.
en.disableEffect: SDK usage metrics will no longer be reported; the app's main features remain available.

zh-CN.description: Android 在后台执行排定任务时，RuStore Metrics 会发送暂存的 SDK 使用事件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: SDK 使用指标将不再上报；应用主要功能仍可使用。

en.description: During app startup, RuStore Pay reads the app's payment settings and initializes its payment client.
en.disableEffect: RuStore Pay may not initialize, so in-app payments that use it can fail.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，RuStore Pay 会读取应用的付款设置并初始化付款客户端。
zh-CN.disableEffect: RuStore Pay 可能无法初始化，使用它的应用内付款也可能失败。

en.description: When the app opens a RuStore Pay purchase or subscription flow, this screen displays the payment interface using the requested theme.
en.disableEffect: Users may be unable to complete RuStore Pay purchases or subscription payments.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动 RuStore Pay 购买或订阅流程时，此页面会按指定主题显示付款界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户可能无法完成 RuStore Pay 购买或订阅付款。

en.description: When RuStore Push needs to update its background message handling, this receiver processes the push client's host update.
en.disableEffect: Push delivery may stop updating correctly.

zh-CN.description: RuStore Push 需要更新后台消息处理方式时，此接收器会处理推送客户端的更新。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 推送消息的接收和处理可能无法继续正常更新。

en.description: At app startup, RuStore Push Client automatically starts its push service in apps set up to use RuStore notifications.
en.disableEffect: Automatic RuStore push initialization and delivery stop, while unrelated host-app features remain available.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动且已设置为使用 RuStore 通知时，RuStore Push Client 会自动启动推送服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，RuStore 推送将无法自动初始化和送达，但宿主应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: When Android runs this scheduled RuStore Remote Config job, the SDK fetches updates for saved configuration values and reports completion or errors.
en.disableEffect: App settings and features controlled by RuStore Remote Config may remain outdated.

zh-CN.description: Android 执行此 RuStore Remote Config 后台任务时，SDK 会获取已保存配置的更新，并报告完成状态或错误。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 由 RuStore Remote Config 控制的应用设置和功能可能一直无法更新。

en.description: When Firebase Cloud Messaging delivers a token or message, RuStore Universal Push records the token and passes supported messages to its push handler.
en.disableEffect: Push messages delivered through Firebase may no longer reach the app.

zh-CN.description: Firebase Cloud Messaging 送达令牌或消息时，RuStore Universal Push 会记录令牌，并把支持的消息交给推送处理流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过 Firebase 送达的推送消息可能无法到达应用。

en.description: When Huawei Mobile Services delivers a token or message, RuStore Universal Push records the token and passes supported messages to its push handler.
en.disableEffect: Push messages delivered through Huawei Mobile Services may no longer reach the app.

zh-CN.description: Huawei Mobile Services 送达令牌或消息时，RuStore Universal Push 会记录令牌，并把支持的消息交给推送处理流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过 Huawei Mobile Services 送达的推送消息可能无法到达应用。

en.description: When RuStore Push delivers a token or message, RuStore Universal Push records the token and passes supported messages to its push handler.
en.disableEffect: RuStore Push messages may no longer reach the app.

zh-CN.description: RuStore Push 送达令牌或消息时，RuStore Universal Push 会记录令牌，并把支持的消息交给推送处理流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用可能无法再收到 RuStore Push 推送消息。

en.description: When Ackpine starts an APK installation, this file provider exposes the APK as a content link that Android's installer can read.
en.disableEffect: APK installations through Ackpine's file-based route may fail because Android cannot open the package file.

zh-CN.description: Ackpine 开始安装 APK 时，此文件 provider 会把 APK 提供为 Android 安装程序可读取的内容链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Android 安装程序无法读取安装包，Ackpine 的文件安装流程可能失败。

en.description: When Ackpine installs a package file stored in the app's assets, this provider opens the asset as a readable file for the installer.
en.disableEffect: Package files stored in app assets may no longer be readable for Ackpine installation.

zh-CN.description: Ackpine 安装保存在应用 assets 中的安装包时，此 provider 会为安装程序打开可读取的文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 保存在应用 assets 中的安装包可能无法被 Ackpine 读取和安装。

en.description: When Ackpine prepares split APK files from an archive, this provider streams the requested archive entries as readable files for installation.
en.disableEffect: Split APK packages stored in archives may fail to install through Ackpine.

zh-CN.description: Ackpine 从压缩包准备分包 APK 时，此 provider 会把所需文件条目以可读取的文件流提供给安装流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 保存在压缩包中的分包 APK 可能无法通过 Ackpine 安装。

en.description: When a user dismisses an Ackpine installation notification, this receiver posts the notification again with its saved content and action.
en.disableEffect: A dismissed installation notification may not reappear, although the installation itself can continue.

zh-CN.description: 用户关闭 Ackpine 安装通知时，此接收器会用已保存的内容和操作重新显示通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 关闭后的安装通知可能不会再次显示，但安装过程仍可继续。

en.description: When Ackpine uses Android's intent-based install route, this screen opens the system package installer with the selected APK and returns its result.
en.disableEffect: Users may be unable to start or confirm APK installs through this Ackpine route.

zh-CN.description: Ackpine 使用 Android 的 intent 安装流程时，此页面会把选中的 APK 交给系统安装程序，并返回处理结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户可能无法通过此 Ackpine 流程启动或确认 APK 安装。

en.description: When Ackpine starts an install session, this screen handles Android's package-install confirmation and reports the user's choice to the session.
en.disableEffect: Users may be unable to confirm or finish session-based package installations.

zh-CN.description: Ackpine 启动安装会话时，此页面会处理 Android 安装确认，并把用户的选择返回给会话。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户可能无法确认或完成基于会话的应用安装。

en.description: When Android's package installer reports an install result, this receiver updates the matching Ackpine installation session with success or failure.
en.disableEffect: Ackpine installation sessions may not receive their final result and can remain incomplete.

zh-CN.description: Android 安装程序报告安装结果时，此接收器会把成功或失败状态写回对应的 Ackpine 安装会话。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Ackpine 安装会话可能收不到最终结果并一直无法完成。

en.description: When Android's package installer reports an uninstall result, this receiver updates the matching Ackpine uninstall session.
en.disableEffect: Ackpine uninstall sessions may not receive their final result and can remain incomplete.

zh-CN.description: Android 安装程序报告卸载结果时，此接收器会更新对应的 Ackpine 卸载会话。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Ackpine 卸载会话可能收不到最终结果并一直无法完成。

en.description: When Ackpine uses Android's intent-based uninstall route, this screen opens the system uninstall confirmation for the selected app and returns the result.
en.disableEffect: Users may be unable to uninstall apps through this Ackpine route.

zh-CN.description: Ackpine 使用 Android 的 intent 卸载流程时，此页面会打开所选应用的系统卸载确认，并返回处理结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户可能无法通过此 Ackpine 流程卸载应用。

en.description: When Ackpine uses a package-installer uninstall session, this screen opens Android's supplied uninstall confirmation and checks whether the app was removed.
en.disableEffect: Users may be unable to confirm or finish package-installer-based uninstalls.

zh-CN.description: Ackpine 使用安装程序的卸载会话时，此页面会打开 Android 提供的卸载确认，并检查应用是否已移除。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户可能无法确认或完成基于 Android 安装程序的卸载。

en.description: When Ackpine starts an uninstall session, this screen opens Android's uninstall confirmation for the selected app and reports the result to Ackpine.
en.disableEffect: Users may be unable to uninstall apps through Ackpine.

zh-CN.description: Ackpine 启动卸载会话时，此页面会打开所选应用的 Android 卸载确认，并把结果返回给 Ackpine。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户可能无法通过 Ackpine 卸载应用。

en.description: When SurfStudio's permission flow needs to explain a requested permission, this screen shows the explanation in a dismissible dialog.
en.disableEffect: The permission explanation step will not appear, so flows that depend on it may stop before requesting permission.

zh-CN.description: SurfStudio 权限流程需要解释申请某项权限的原因时，此页面会显示可关闭的说明对话框。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 权限说明步骤将无法显示，依赖它的流程可能会在申请权限前中断。

en.description: When SurfStudio's permission flow asks a user to change a permission in Android settings, this screen explains why and opens the app's settings if the user chooses.
en.disableEffect: The in-app route for granting a permission through Android settings will no longer work.

zh-CN.description: SurfStudio 权限流程请用户到 Android 设置中更改权限时，此页面会说明原因，并在用户选择后打开应用设置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过应用内流程进入 Android 设置授予权限的方式将无法使用。

en.description: When someone opens, dismisses, or chooses an action on a SurfStudio push notification, this receiver sends the event to the app's registered push callback and clears saved notifications in that group.
en.disableEffect: Push notification taps, dismissals, and action buttons will no longer reach the app's callbacks.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开、关闭或选择 SurfStudio 推送通知中的操作时，此接收器会把事件交给应用注册的推送回调，并清理该组通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 推送通知的点击、关闭和操作将无法再触发应用的回调。

en.description: The T-Bank ID authorization SDK opens this Activity to continue sign-in in the shopper's browser using a secure Custom Tab. It returns the authentication result or cancellation to the app.
en.disableEffect: Sign-in flows that use T-Bank ID through this screen cannot complete.

zh-CN.description: T-Bank ID 授权 SDK 会通过此 Activity 在用户浏览器的安全自定义标签页中继续登录。它会把登录结果或取消状态返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过此页面进行的 T-Bank ID 登录将无法完成。

en.description: The T-Bank ID authorization SDK opens this Activity to display its sign-in page inside the app. It watches for the authentication redirect and returns the result to the app.
en.disableEffect: Sign-in flows that use this T-Bank ID screen cannot complete.

zh-CN.description: T-Bank ID 授权 SDK 会通过此 Activity 在应用内显示登录页面。它会识别登录后的跳转，并将结果返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此 T-Bank ID 页面进行的登录将无法完成。

en.description: When the app opens the Tensor SabyCom support widget, this screen displays the online support chat in a dialog and returns results to the widget.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to open the app's SabyCom support chat.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开 Tensor SabyCom 客服组件时，此页面会以对话框显示在线客服聊天，并把处理结果返回给组件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开应用中的 SabyCom 客服聊天。

en.description: In the Tinkoff Acquiring SDK used by Tinkoff Insurance, this Activity opens the card payment form when an insurance payment starts. It handles saved cards and 3-D Secure checks, then returns success, cancellation, or an error to the insurance flow.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot finish card payments through this Tinkoff Insurance checkout.

zh-CN.description: 在 Tinkoff 保险的支付流程中，Tinkoff Acquiring SDK 会打开此 Activity 显示银行卡付款页面。它处理已保存的银行卡和 3-D Secure 验证，并把成功、取消或错误结果交还给保险流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在 Tinkoff 保险的结账流程中完成银行卡付款。

en.description: The Tinkoff Acquiring SDK opens this Activity when the shopper chooses to read a bank card by NFC. It reads the card number and expiration date and returns them to the card form.
en.disableEffect: The SDK's NFC card-reading option will not work, so shoppers cannot fill those card details by tapping a compatible card.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择通过 NFC 读取银行卡时，Tinkoff 收单 SDK 会打开此 Activity。它读取卡号和有效期，并将信息返回银行卡表单。
zh-CN.disableEffect: SDK 的 NFC 读卡功能将无法使用，用户不能通过贴近兼容银行卡来填写这些信息。

en.description: The Tinkoff Acquiring SDK opens this Activity from its card-entry screen when the shopper chooses NFC card scanning. It reads a supported card's NFC data and returns the parsed card details to the payment form.
en.disableEffect: The older SDK's NFC card-scanning option will not work.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Tinkoff 收单 SDK 的银行卡输入页面选择 NFC 扫卡时，SDK 会打开此 Activity。它读取兼容银行卡的 NFC 数据，解析后将卡片信息返回支付表单。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 旧版 SDK 的 NFC 扫卡功能将无法使用。

en.description: The Tinkoff Acquiring SDK opens this Activity when its redesigned checkout needs the shopper to choose a saved card. The screen also lets the shopper add a card or continue with a new card.
en.disableEffect: Shoppers cannot use this saved-card selection and add-card screen in the redesigned checkout.

zh-CN.description: 新版 Tinkoff 收单 SDK 需要用户选择已保存的银行卡时，会打开此 Activity。页面也允许用户添加银行卡，或改用新卡继续付款。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 新版结账流程中的已保存银行卡选择和添加银行卡页面将无法使用。

en.description: The redesigned Tinkoff Acquiring SDK uses this Activity as its checkout screen. It hosts the payment flow and routes shoppers through card entry, saved cards, recurring payments, and supported wallet or bank-transfer options.
en.disableEffect: The SDK's redesigned checkout cannot open or complete its payment screens.

zh-CN.description: 新版 Tinkoff 收单 SDK 使用此 Activity 显示结账页面。它承载支付流程，并根据用户选择进入银行卡输入、已保存银行卡、定期付款以及支持的钱包或银行转账页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: SDK 的新版结账流程将无法打开或完成支付页面。

en.description: The Tinkoff Acquiring SDK opens this Activity for the main payment form. It collects card details and presents the available ways to continue, including saved cards, Mir Pay, or a fast bank transfer when enabled.
en.disableEffect: The redesigned payment form and the payment methods it offers will not be available.

zh-CN.description: Tinkoff 收单 SDK 会通过此 Activity 显示主要付款表单。它收集银行卡信息，并根据配置提供已保存银行卡、Mir Pay 或快速银行转账等付款方式。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 新版付款表单及其中提供的付款方式将无法使用。

en.description: The Tinkoff Acquiring SDK opens this Activity after the shopper selects Mir Pay. It starts the Mir Pay payment flow and handles the result returned to checkout.
en.disableEffect: Shoppers cannot complete a payment through Mir Pay in this SDK flow.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择 Mir Pay 后，Tinkoff 收单 SDK 会打开此 Activity。它启动 Mir Pay 付款流程，并处理返回结账页面的结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此 SDK 流程使用 Mir Pay 付款。

en.description: The redesigned Tinkoff Acquiring SDK opens this Activity when the shopper chooses to pay with a new bank card. It displays the card-payment form and returns the payment result to checkout.
en.disableEffect: The new-card payment form in the redesigned checkout will not work.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择使用新银行卡付款时，新版 Tinkoff 收单 SDK 会打开此 Activity。它显示银行卡付款表单，并将付款结果返回结账流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 新版结账流程中的新卡付款表单将无法使用。

en.description: The Tinkoff Acquiring SDK opens this Activity for a recurring payment using a previously selected card. It presents the recurring-payment step and returns its outcome to checkout.
en.disableEffect: Recurring payments through this SDK flow cannot be completed.

zh-CN.description: Tinkoff 收单 SDK 会通过此 Activity 使用先前选择的银行卡处理定期付款。它显示定期付款步骤，并将结果返回结账流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 此 SDK 流程中的定期付款将无法完成。

en.description: The Tinkoff Acquiring SDK opens this Activity when a shopper selects a fast bank transfer but no supported banking app is available. It explains the situation and offers a link with more information.
en.disableEffect: Shoppers may see no guidance when no compatible bank app is installed, and the fast-transfer path may fail.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择快速银行转账但设备上没有可用的银行应用时，Tinkoff 收单 SDK 会打开此 Activity。它说明当前情况，并提供查看详细信息的链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 设备没有兼容的银行应用时，用户可能无法看到提示，快速转账流程也可能失败。

en.description: The Tinkoff Acquiring SDK opens this Activity for a fast bank-transfer payment. It lists supported banking apps and opens the app the shopper selects to continue the transfer.
en.disableEffect: Shoppers cannot choose a bank app or continue this fast bank-transfer payment.

zh-CN.description: Tinkoff 收单 SDK 会通过此 Activity 处理快速银行转账。它列出支持的银行应用，并打开用户选择的应用以继续转账。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法选择银行应用或继续此快速银行转账付款。

en.description: The Tinkoff Acquiring SDK opens this Activity after the shopper selects T-Pay. It starts the T-Pay payment flow and handles the result returned to checkout.
en.disableEffect: Shoppers cannot complete a payment through T-Pay in this SDK flow.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择 T-Pay 后，Tinkoff 收单 SDK 会打开此 Activity。它启动 T-Pay 付款流程，并处理返回结账页面的结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此 SDK 流程使用 T-Pay 付款。

en.description: The Tinkoff Acquiring SDK opens this Activity when the shopper chooses to add or link a bank card. It shows the card-entry flow and completes any card verification required before saving the card.
en.disableEffect: Shoppers cannot add or link a card through this SDK screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择添加或绑定银行卡时，Tinkoff 收单 SDK 会打开此 Activity。它显示银行卡输入流程，并在保存银行卡前完成所需验证。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此 SDK 页面添加或绑定银行卡。

en.description: The Tinkoff Acquiring SDK opens this Activity when a fast bank-transfer flow asks the shopper to choose a banking app. It can open the selected bank or a payment link in the browser.
en.disableEffect: Shoppers cannot choose a banking app in this fast-transfer flow, so the transfer may not continue.

zh-CN.description: 快速银行转账流程需要用户选择银行应用时，Tinkoff 收单 SDK 会打开此 Activity。它可以打开用户选择的银行应用，或在浏览器中打开付款链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在此快速转账流程中选择银行应用，转账可能无法继续。

en.description: The Tinkoff Acquiring SDK opens this Activity to hand off selected Google Pay or Tinkoff Pay payments and show their success, failure, or cancellation result. It returns that result to the app's payment flow.
en.disableEffect: Wallet payments that rely on this screen may fail or return no result to the app.

zh-CN.description: Tinkoff 收单 SDK 会通过此 Activity 启动所选的 Google Pay 或 Tinkoff Pay 付款，并显示成功、失败或取消结果。它会将结果返回应用的支付流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此页面的钱包付款可能失败，或无法向应用返回付款结果。

en.description: The Tinkoff Acquiring SDK uses this Activity for its checkout flow. It shows the payment form and routes the shopper through supported steps such as bank transfer or issuer verification when needed.
en.disableEffect: Payments that use this checkout Activity cannot be completed.

zh-CN.description: Tinkoff 收单 SDK 使用此 Activity 承载结账流程。它显示付款表单，并在需要时引导用户完成银行转账或发卡行验证等步骤。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此结账 Activity 的付款将无法完成。

en.description: The Tinkoff Acquiring SDK opens this Activity to display a payment QR code, either for a fixed QR payment or for a card payment's generated QR flow. It reports the payment outcome to checkout.
en.disableEffect: QR-code payments that use this screen cannot be completed.

zh-CN.description: Tinkoff 收单 SDK 会通过此 Activity 显示付款二维码，可用于固定二维码付款或银行卡付款生成的二维码流程。它会将付款结果返回结账流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此页面的二维码付款将无法完成。

en.description: The Tinkoff Acquiring SDK opens this Activity to display a shopper's saved cards. The shopper can select a card, remove one, or continue to add a card for payment.
en.disableEffect: Shoppers cannot select or manage saved cards through this SDK screen.

zh-CN.description: Tinkoff 收单 SDK 会通过此 Activity 显示用户已保存的银行卡。用户可以选择或删除银行卡，也可以继续添加银行卡用于付款。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此 SDK 页面选择或管理已保存的银行卡。

en.description: The Tinkoff Acquiring SDK opens this Activity when a card issuer requires a 3-D Secure check during payment or card linking. It displays the issuer's verification page and returns the result to the SDK.
en.disableEffect: Payments or card-linking flows that require this check cannot be verified and may fail.

zh-CN.description: 发卡行在付款或绑定银行卡时要求进行 3-D Secure 验证，Tinkoff 收单 SDK 就会打开此 Activity。它显示发卡行的验证页面，并把结果返回 SDK。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要此验证的付款或银行卡绑定流程将无法通过验证，可能会失败。

en.description: The Tinkoff Acquiring SDK opens this Activity when a shopper continues a Yandex Pay payment. It submits the Yandex payment details and handles the result returned to checkout.
en.disableEffect: Shoppers cannot complete the Yandex Pay option through this SDK flow.

zh-CN.description: 用户继续使用 Yandex Pay 付款时，Tinkoff 收单 SDK 会打开此 Activity。它提交 Yandex 付款信息，并处理返回结账流程的结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此 SDK 流程完成 Yandex Pay 付款。

en.description: The Tinkoff ID authorization SDK opens this Activity to display its sign-in page inside the app. It watches for the authentication redirect and returns the result to the app.
en.disableEffect: Sign-in flows that use this Tinkoff ID screen cannot complete.

zh-CN.description: Tinkoff ID 授权 SDK 会通过此 Activity 在应用内显示登录页面。它会识别登录后的跳转，并将结果返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此 Tinkoff ID 页面进行的登录将无法完成。

en.description: The Dolyame installment-payment SDK opens this Activity when a shopper starts a Dolyame purchase. It hosts the purchase and payment steps and returns the outcome to the app.
en.disableEffect: Shoppers cannot complete a Dolyame installment purchase through the app.

zh-CN.description: 用户开始使用 Dolyame 分期付款时，Dolyame 分期付款 SDK 会打开此 Activity。它承载购买和付款步骤，并将结果返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过应用完成 Dolyame 分期购买。

en.description: After a phone number is submitted in the Tinkoff Insurance SDK, this Activity asks for the four-digit SMS code and checks it to finish sign-in. It can also request that a new code be sent.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot confirm a phone number or continue the sign-in flow.

zh-CN.description: 在 Tinkoff 保险 SDK 提交手机号后，此 Activity 会要求用户输入四位短信验证码并进行验证，以完成登录；用户也可以在这里请求重发验证码。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法验证手机号或继续登录流程。

en.description: During Tinkoff Insurance sign-in, this Activity collects a Russian phone number and sends it for verification; after the number is accepted, it opens SMS-code entry.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot enter a phone number to start or continue phone-based sign-in.

zh-CN.description: 在 Tinkoff 保险登录流程中，此 Activity 收集俄罗斯手机号并提交验证；号码通过后会打开短信验证码输入页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法输入手机号来开始或继续手机号登录。

en.description: In Tinkoff Insurance's CASCO flow, this Activity collects vehicle and contact details and sends them to request a CASCO quote. On success, it opens a confirmation screen with callback details.
en.disableEffect: Users lose the CASCO quote request flow.

zh-CN.description: 在 Tinkoff 保险的 CASCO 车险流程中，此 Activity 收集车辆和联系信息并提交报价请求。请求成功后，它会打开确认页面，告知后续回访信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法使用 CASCO 车险报价流程。

en.description: After a CASCO quote request succeeds, this Activity shows the applicant's name, car, and phone number and says an agent will call within 24 hours.
en.disableEffect: Users will not see the request confirmation or its callback details.

zh-CN.description: CASCO 报价请求成功后，此 Activity 显示申请人姓名、车辆和手机号，并告知客服会在 24 小时内回电。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将看不到请求确认信息和回访安排。

en.description: After an electronic OSAGO policy is issued, this Activity confirms that the policy was emailed and links to the user's Tinkoff account.
en.disableEffect: Users lose the policy-delivery confirmation and the in-app route to their account.

zh-CN.description: 俄罗斯强制汽车责任险（OSAGO）电子保单签发后，此 Activity 会确认保单已发送到用户邮箱，并提供进入 Tinkoff 账户的链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将看不到保单发送确认，也无法从这里进入账户查看保单。

en.description: When the OSAGO purchase flow asks users to get ready, this Activity lists documents to have on hand, such as a passport, vehicle registration papers, and drivers' licenses; it also shows the diagnostic card when required.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot see the document checklist before continuing the insurance application.

zh-CN.description: OSAGO 投保流程要求用户准备材料时，此 Activity 会列出需要备好的证件，例如护照、车辆登记文件和驾驶证；如有需要，也会提示准备车辆诊断卡。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户在继续投保前将无法查看所需材料清单。

en.description: When an insurance form opens a detailed editor for a field, this Activity lets the user update that value and sends the edited result back to the form. It can also coordinate a document scan started from the field.
en.disableEffect: Expanded insurance fields and scan-assisted data entry cannot return their results to the form.

zh-CN.description: 保险表单打开某个字段的详细编辑页面时，此 Activity 让用户修改该项并将结果返回表单；它也会处理从字段编辑页面启动的证件扫描。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 保险表单的详细字段编辑和扫描录入将无法把结果返回表单。

en.description: When an OSAGO quote flow opens a third-party offer, this Activity forwards the supplied page to Tinkoff Insurance's in-app browser.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open the third-party offer page from the quote flow.

zh-CN.description: OSAGO 报价流程打开第三方保险方案时，此 Activity 会将指定页面交给 Tinkoff 保险的应用内浏览器显示。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法从报价流程打开第三方方案页面。

en.description: When the SDK opens an account, about, or other insurance URL, this Activity displays the page inside Tinkoff Insurance and handles back navigation.
en.disableEffect: In-app account, about, and other insurance pages cannot open.

zh-CN.description: SDK 打开账户、产品介绍或其他保险链接时，此 Activity 会在 Tinkoff 保险应用内显示网页，并处理返回操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用内的账户、产品介绍和其他保险页面将无法打开。

en.description: In Tinkoff Insurance's full OSAGO flow, this Activity collects and validates the information needed for a policy quote across several steps. After all required fields are complete, it opens the quote result screen.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot complete the full OSAGO application or reach its quote result.

zh-CN.description: 在 Tinkoff 保险的完整 OSAGO 投保流程中，此 Activity 分多个步骤收集并检查报价所需信息。必填项完成后，它会打开报价结果页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法完成完整的 OSAGO 申请或查看报价结果。

en.description: After OSAGO details are submitted, this Activity displays the calculated premium and lets the user retry a failed calculation, buy the policy, or open a third-party offer. Starting a purchase hands the amount and order to Tinkoff Acquiring for payment.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot review or pay for this OSAGO quote from the result screen.

zh-CN.description: 提交 OSAGO 信息后，此 Activity 显示计算出的保费，并允许用户重试失败的计算、购买保单或打开第三方方案。开始购买时，它会把金额和订单交给 Tinkoff Acquiring 处理付款。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在报价结果页面查看报价或完成付款。

en.description: While completing a quick OSAGO quote, this Activity searches city and address suggestions as the user types and returns the selected location to the quote.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot select the location needed by this quick quote.

zh-CN.description: 填写 OSAGO 快速报价时，此 Activity 会根据用户输入搜索城市和地址建议，并将选定地点返回报价表单。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法选择此快速报价所需的地点。

en.description: In the quick OSAGO quote flow, this Activity lets the user enter or choose vehicle details and returns them to the quote; completing the selection opens the updated quote screen.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot enter or change the vehicle used for the quick quote.

zh-CN.description: 在 OSAGO 快速报价流程中，此 Activity 让用户填写或选择车辆信息，并将结果返回报价；完成选择后会打开更新后的报价页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法填写或更改快速报价所用的车辆信息。

en.description: During a Tinkoff Insurance document request, this Activity gathers photos of documents needed for the application, including passports, drivers' licenses, and vehicle papers, then submits them after validation.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot submit the requested insurance document photos.

zh-CN.description: Tinkoff 保险要求提交证件时，此 Activity 会收集申请所需的证件照片，包括护照、驾驶证和车辆文件，并在检查通过后提交。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法提交保险流程要求的证件照片。

en.description: When a Tinkoff Insurance form requests a document image, this Activity opens the camera or gallery so the user can capture or choose a photo, then returns the selected images to the form.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot capture or choose photos for insurance documents.

zh-CN.description: Tinkoff 保险表单要求提供证件图片时，此 Activity 会打开相机或图库，让用户拍摄或选择照片，再将所选图片返回表单。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法拍摄或选择保险证件照片。

en.description: When a saved quick OSAGO quote needs vehicle details restored, this Activity opens the vehicle-entry screen and returns those details to the quote flow.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot provide missing vehicle details while restoring that quote.

zh-CN.description: 恢复已保存的 OSAGO 快速报价但缺少车辆信息时，此 Activity 会打开车辆信息填写页面，并将信息交回报价流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 恢复报价时，用户将无法补充缺失的车辆信息。

en.description: In the earlier Tinkoff Insurance quick OSAGO flow, this Activity collects the short quote form and calculates an estimate when the form is valid. It can then show a result or continue to the full policy application.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot request the quick quote or continue to the full policy application.

zh-CN.description: 在旧版 Tinkoff 保险 OSAGO 快速报价流程中，此 Activity 收集简要报价信息，并在表单有效时计算估价。随后可显示结果或继续填写完整保单申请。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法申请快速报价或继续填写完整保单。

en.description: After the earlier quick OSAGO calculation, this Activity shows the vehicle and estimated premium, with an action that returns the result to the insurance flow.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot review or continue from the quick quote result.

zh-CN.description: 旧版 OSAGO 快速报价计算完成后，此 Activity 显示车辆和估算保费，并提供继续保险流程的操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法查看快速报价结果或从结果继续办理。

en.description: In the newer quick OSAGO flow, this Activity shows the selected vehicle, city, and estimated price, lets the user edit the vehicle or location, and can open the full application or document checklist.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot review or adjust quick quote details or move to the full application.

zh-CN.description: 在新版 OSAGO 快速报价流程中，此 Activity 显示所选车辆、城市和估算价格，允许用户修改车辆或地点，也可打开完整申请或材料清单。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法查看或修改快速报价信息，也无法继续填写完整申请。

en.description: When Tinkoff Insurance finds a saved OSAGO quote, this Activity asks whether to restore it and reopens the saved quick quote, full application, or result as available. If vehicle details are missing, it opens vehicle entry.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot resume a saved quote or application.

zh-CN.description: Tinkoff 保险发现已保存的 OSAGO 报价时，此 Activity 会询问是否恢复，并根据已有进度重新打开快速报价、完整申请或结果页面。车辆信息缺失时，它会转到车辆填写页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法恢复已保存的报价或申请。

en.description: The Beeline09 uniDevId library returns a saved device identifier when the app requests this service.
en.disableEffect: The app and uniDevId callers will no longer receive this device identifier, which can prevent services that rely on it from recognizing the device.

zh-CN.description: Beeline09 uniDevId 通用设备标识库会在应用请求该服务时返回已保存的设备标识。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用和 uniDevId 调用方将无法再取得此设备标识，依赖它的服务可能无法识别该设备。

en.description: When an app begins checkout with Yandex.Money, this Activity shows the payment steps and returns the completed invoice or cancellation result.
en.disableEffect: An app that relies on Yandex.Money checkout will be unable to show or finish that payment flow.

zh-CN.description: 应用开始 Yandex.Money 结账时，此 Activity 会显示支付步骤，并返回完成的账单或取消结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖 Yandex.Money 结账的应用将无法显示或完成支付流程。

en.description: During Yandex.Money checkout, this background Service fetches payment details, submits or confirms the payment, and sends the result back to the payment screen.
en.disableEffect: Yandex.Money payments cannot be requested or confirmed, so checkout may fail.

zh-CN.description: Yandex.Money 结账期间，此后台 Service 会获取支付信息、提交或确认付款，并将结果发回支付页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Yandex.Money 支付无法请求或确认，结账可能失败。

en.description: When Yandex SpeechKit starts its voice-recognition screen, this Activity requests microphone access, displays the recognition dialog, and returns recognized text or an error.
en.disableEffect: SpeechKit voice recognition cannot open or return a result in apps that use this dialog.

zh-CN.description: Yandex SpeechKit 启动语音识别页面时，此 Activity 会请求麦克风权限、显示识别对话框，并返回识别文本或错误。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此对话框的应用将无法打开 SpeechKit 语音识别或取得识别结果。

en.description: In the YooMoney Authorization SDK, this Activity opens the signed-in account screen, where users can view or change details such as email, phone number, password, and linked social accounts.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot view or manage their YooMoney account from the app.

zh-CN.description: 在 YooMoney 授权 SDK 中，此 Activity 打开已登录账户页面，用户可查看或修改电子邮件、手机号、密码和已关联的社交账户等信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在应用中查看或管理 YooMoney 账户。

en.description: When an app starts the YooMoney Authorization SDK sign-in or registration flow, this Activity hosts account access screens, including phone or email sign-in and account recovery.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot sign in, register, or recover account access through this SDK.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动 YooMoney 授权 SDK 的登录或注册流程时，此 Activity 会承载账户访问页面，包括手机号或电子邮件登录以及账户找回。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此 SDK 登录、注册或找回账户。

en.description: When an app requests YooMoney auxiliary-token authorization, this Activity presents the requested access scopes for the user to review and approve.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot complete the requested auxiliary-token authorization.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求 YooMoney 辅助令牌授权时，此 Activity 会显示所申请的访问权限，供用户查看和批准。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法完成所请求的辅助令牌授权。

en.description: During a default YooMoney authorization flow, this background service requests Google Play location updates when location permission and GPS are available, then supplies location metadata for authorization requests.
en.disableEffect: YooMoney sign-in and account requests no longer receive the location metadata supplied by this service.

zh-CN.description: YooMoney 默认授权流程运行时，如果已授予定位权限且 GPS 可用，此后台服务会通过 Google Play 获取位置更新，并为授权请求提供位置数据。
zh-CN.disableEffect: YooMoney 登录和账户请求将不再收到此服务提供的位置数据。

en.description: During a default YooMoney authorization flow, this background service requests Huawei location updates when location permission and GPS are available, then supplies location metadata for authorization requests.
en.disableEffect: YooMoney sign-in and account requests no longer receive the location metadata supplied by this service.

zh-CN.description: YooMoney 默认授权流程运行时，如果已授予定位权限且 GPS 可用，此后台服务会通过华为定位服务获取位置更新，并为授权请求提供位置数据。
zh-CN.disableEffect: YooMoney 登录和账户请求将不再收到此服务提供的位置数据。

en.description: When the app starts YooMoney's QR sign-in flow with a process ID, this Activity runs the authorization request and displays its status so the user can finish signing in on the website.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot complete the sign-in request started from the YooMoney website QR flow.

zh-CN.description: 应用使用流程编号启动 YooMoney 二维码登录时，此 Activity 会处理授权请求并显示状态，让用户完成网站上的登录。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法完成从 YooMoney 网站二维码发起的登录。

en.description: In the YooMoney Authorization SDK, this Activity handles sign-in through Gosuslugi (ESIA) and receives the redirect back from that service. The YooKassa Android payment SDK also includes this authorization screen.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot finish signing in or linking an account through Gosuslugi from this SDK.

zh-CN.description: 在 YooMoney 授权 SDK 中，此 Activity 处理通过 Gosuslugi（俄罗斯公共服务门户 ESIA）登录，并接收该服务跳回应用的结果。YooKassa Android 支付 SDK 也包含此授权页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此 SDK 完成 Gosuslugi 登录或账户关联。

en.description: In the YooMoney Authorization SDK, this Activity handles sign-in through Sber ID and receives the redirect back from Sberbank. The YooKassa Android payment SDK also includes this authorization screen.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot finish signing in or linking an account through Sber ID from this SDK.

zh-CN.description: 在 YooMoney 授权 SDK 中，此 Activity 处理通过 Sber ID 登录，并接收从 Sberbank 返回应用的结果。YooKassa Android 支付 SDK 也包含此授权页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此 SDK 完成 Sber ID 登录或账户关联。

en.description: When a user chooses VK ID in the YooMoney Authorization SDK, this Activity starts VK's fast sign-in flow and returns its result to the authorization screen. The YooKassa Android payment SDK also includes this authorization screen.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot finish signing in or linking an account through VK ID from this SDK.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 YooMoney 授权 SDK 中选择 VK ID 时，此 Activity 会启动 VK 快速登录并将结果返回授权流程。YooKassa Android 支付 SDK 也包含此授权页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此 SDK 完成 VK ID 登录或账户关联。

en.description: When an app launches a form through the YooMoney Forms SDK, this Activity displays the configured title and interactive form fields. After submission, it returns the form result to the calling app.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open or submit the configured YooMoney form.

zh-CN.description: 应用通过 YooMoney 表单 SDK 启动表单时，此 Activity 会显示配置的标题和可填写内容。用户提交后，它会把表单结果返回调用应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开或提交配置的 YooMoney 表单。

en.description: YooMoney's YooKassa payments SDK opens this Activity when a bank or payment page returns a confirmation link. It completes the confirmation step and sends the payment result back to the app.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot finish payment confirmations returned from a bank or payment page, so affected payments will not complete.

zh-CN.description: 银行或支付页面返回确认链接时，YooMoney 的 YooKassa 支付 SDK 会打开此 Activity。它完成确认步骤，并将付款结果返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用无法处理银行或支付页面返回的确认信息，因此相关付款无法完成。

en.description: The older YooMoney YooKassa payments SDK opens this Activity to explain saving a card or allowing future automatic charges. It displays payment-specific information and lets the user acknowledge it.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot review or acknowledge the card-saving or automatic-charge information required by this checkout flow.

zh-CN.description: 旧版 YooMoney YooKassa 支付 SDK 会打开此 Activity，说明保存银行卡或允许后续自动扣款的事项。它显示与付款相关的信息，供用户阅读并确认。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法查看或确认此结账流程要求的银行卡保存或自动扣款说明。

en.description: YooMoney's YooKassa payments SDK opens this Activity during checkout to show additional payment information, including formatted text and links. The user can read the details before continuing or closing the screen.
en.disableEffect: The checkout cannot show this payment information screen, so a flow that requires the user to review it may not continue.

zh-CN.description: YooMoney 的 YooKassa 支付 SDK 会在结账时打开此 Activity，显示补充付款信息，包括带格式的文字和链接。用户可以阅读内容后继续或关闭页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 结账流程无法显示此付款信息页面，需要用户先阅读该信息的流程可能无法继续。

en.description: YooMoney's YooKassa payments SDK opens this Activity to explain what happens when a user saves a card or wallet for later charges. It presents the terms for that payment option before the user continues.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot review or complete the save-payment or automatic-charge permission step in checkout.

zh-CN.description: YooMoney 的 YooKassa 支付 SDK 会打开此 Activity，说明保存银行卡或钱包以便日后扣款的事项。用户继续前可以查看该付款选项的相关条款。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法在结账时查看或完成保存付款方式及授权自动扣款的步骤。

en.description: YooMoney's YooKassa payments SDK opens this Activity when a checkout needs a bank verification page, such as a 3-D Secure challenge. It displays the secure page and returns to checkout when verification finishes.
en.disableEffect: Payments that require the bank verification page cannot complete.

zh-CN.description: 结账需要银行验证页面（例如 3-D Secure 验证）时，YooMoney 的 YooKassa 支付 SDK 会打开此 Activity。它显示安全验证页面，并在验证完成后返回结账流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 需要银行验证页面的付款将无法完成。

en.description: YooMoney's YooKassa payments SDK opens this Activity when the app starts a checkout. It shows the available payment methods so the user can choose one and continue.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open YooKassa checkout to select a payment method or start a payment.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动结账时，YooMoney 的 YooKassa 支付 SDK 会打开此 Activity。它显示可用的付款方式，供用户选择并继续付款。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法打开 YooKassa 结账页面来选择付款方式或开始付款。

en.description: YooMoney's YooKassa payments SDK opens this Activity to start a payment action supplied by a bank or payment provider. It waits for that action to return and forwards the result to checkout.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot launch or receive the result of payment actions that use this handoff, so those payments may fail.

zh-CN.description: YooMoney 的 YooKassa 支付 SDK 会打开此 Activity，以启动银行或支付服务提供方交给应用的付款操作。它等待操作返回，并将结果转交给结账流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用无法启动或接收通过此交接方式执行的付款结果，因此相关付款可能失败。

en.description: In older YooMoney YooKassa versions, this Activity opens a secure payment page inside the app. It returns to checkout when the page reports that the payment step is complete.
en.disableEffect: Checkout cannot open or finish payment steps that rely on this in-app page.

zh-CN.description: 在旧版 YooMoney YooKassa 中，此 Activity 会在应用内打开安全付款页面。页面报告付款步骤完成后，它会返回结账流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 结账流程无法打开或完成依赖此应用内页面的付款步骤。

en.description: The YooMoney Partner Cards SDK opens this Activity for its card feature. It hosts the screens where users view and manage cards used by the partner payment flow.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open the partner card screens, so payment flows that depend on them may not work.

zh-CN.description: YooMoney Partner Cards SDK 会为银行卡功能打开此 Activity。它承载合作方付款流程中供用户查看和管理银行卡的页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法打开合作方银行卡页面，依赖这些页面的付款流程可能无法使用。

en.description: The YooMoney Payment Contract SDK opens this Activity to show the payment form. Users can choose a wallet or card, review bonus use, and confirm a charge.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot show or complete payment forms that use this SDK.

zh-CN.description: YooMoney Payment Contract SDK 会打开此 Activity 显示付款表单。用户可以选择钱包或银行卡、查看奖励金抵扣情况并确认扣款。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用无法显示或完成使用此 SDK 的付款表单。

en.description: The YooMoney Payment Contract SDK opens this Activity after a payment attempt to show whether it succeeded or failed. It returns the result to the app when the user closes the screen.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot see the payment result or return it through the SDK's normal payment flow.

zh-CN.description: YooMoney Payment Contract SDK 会在尝试付款后打开此 Activity，显示付款成功或失败。用户关闭页面时，它会将结果返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法查看付款结果，也无法通过 SDK 的常规付款流程返回该结果。

en.description: The YooMoney QR SDK opens this Activity when a user starts its camera scanner. It scans QR codes and barcodes used to pay bills, transfer money, or sign in, then returns the recognized result to the app.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot scan payment or sign-in codes with the YooMoney QR feature.

zh-CN.description: 用户启动相机扫描器时，YooMoney QR SDK 会打开此 Activity。它扫描用于支付账单、转账或登录的二维码和条形码，并将识别结果返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法使用 YooMoney QR 功能扫描付款码或登录码。

en.description: The YooMoney QR SDK opens this Activity when a user asks for scanner help. It explains how the scanner reads codes for bill payments, transfers, and sign-in.
en.disableEffect: The scanner help page is unavailable, but the QR scanner itself can still scan codes.

zh-CN.description: 用户查看扫描器帮助时，YooMoney QR SDK 会打开此 Activity。它介绍如何使用扫描器处理账单付款、转账和登录所需的码。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 扫描器帮助页面将无法打开，但二维码扫描功能仍可使用。

en.description: The older YooMoney QR SDK opens this Activity to display its camera-based QR scanner. The scanner sends the recognized code back to the calling app.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot scan QR codes through this older YooMoney QR flow.

zh-CN.description: 旧版 YooMoney QR SDK 会打开此 Activity，显示基于相机的二维码扫描器。扫描器会将识别到的码返回调用应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法通过旧版 YooMoney QR 流程扫描二维码。

en.description: The YooMoney 2FA library opens this Activity when sign-in needs an extra check. It coordinates verification by SMS, email, or a phone call and shows the required challenge.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot complete a YooMoney sign-in challenge that requires the second factor.

zh-CN.description: YooMoney 双重验证库在登录需要额外验证时打开此 Activity。它会处理短信、电子邮件或电话验证码，并显示相应的验证步骤。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法完成需要第二重验证的 YooMoney 登录。

en.description: The YooMoney Wallet authorization SDK opens this Activity to create, change, or request the wallet access code. Users need this code to protect or unlock wallet actions.

zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用要求钱包访问码时，用户将无法创建、更改或输入该访问码。

en.description: The YooMoney Wallet authorization SDK opens this Activity to run a wallet sign-in or authorization flow. It displays the steps needed to verify the user's account.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot complete wallet sign-in or authorization through this SDK.

zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法通过此 SDK 完成钱包登录或授权。

en.description: The YooMoney Wallet authorization SDK opens this Activity when an authorization step asks for the user's email address. It displays the email-entry screen and continues the wallet flow.

zh-CN.disableEffect: 钱包授权流程要求邮箱时，用户将无法填写邮箱。

en.description: The YooMoney Wallet authorization SDK opens this Activity to finish enrolling a user in a wallet after authorization. It displays the wallet-enrollment step and returns to the app's flow.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot finish wallet enrollment through the SDK.

zh-CN.description: 授权完成后，YooMoney Wallet 授权 SDK 会打开此 Activity，为用户完成钱包开通。它显示钱包开通步骤，并返回应用流程。

en.description: The YooMoney Wallet authorization SDK opens this Activity to show a wallet or bank page inside the app. It can request authorization and return the user to the wallet flow when the page finishes.

zh-CN.description: YooMoney Wallet 授权 SDK 会打开此 Activity，在应用内显示钱包或银行页面。页面可以要求用户授权，并在完成后返回钱包流程。

zh-CN.disableEffect: SAN 推广应用下载可能无法开始、继续或报告进度。

en.description: When SAN sends an advertised-app download command, this Receiver passes the start, resume, or pause request to the SDK's download handler.
en.disableEffect: SAN download commands will not reach the advertised-app download handler.

zh-CN.description: SAN 发送推广应用下载命令时，此 Receiver 会将开始、继续或暂停请求交给 SDK 下载处理器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: SAN 下载命令将无法传递给推广应用下载处理器。

en.description: When a SAN ad or offerwall starts an advertised-app download, this Service runs the download and handles pause, resume, removal, and progress updates.
en.disableEffect: SAN advertised-app downloads may not start, resume, or report their status.

zh-CN.disableEffect: SAN 推广应用下载可能无法开始、继续或报告进度。

zh-CN.disableEffect: SAN 推广应用下载可能无法开始、继续或报告进度。

zh-CN.disableEffect: SAN 推广应用下载可能无法开始、继续或报告进度。

zh-CN.disableEffect: SAN 推广应用下载可能无法开始、继续或报告进度。
