en.disableEffect: SAN advertised-app downloads may not start, resume, or report their status.

zh-CN.description: SAN 广告或积分墙启动推广应用下载时，此服务会执行下载并处理暂停、继续、删除和进度更新。
zh-CN.disableEffect: SAN 推广应用下载可能无法开始、继续或报告进度。

en.description: Sascha Peilicke's Android CustomTabs library uses this Activity as an in-app web fallback when no compatible Custom Tab browser is available and the caller requests a fallback. It loads the requested web address and displays the page title.
en.disableEffect: Links using this fallback will not open in the app when a compatible Custom Tab browser is unavailable.

zh-CN.description: Sascha Peilicke 的 Android CustomTabs 库会在没有兼容的 Custom Tab 浏览器且调用方请求备用方式时，使用此 Activity 在应用内打开网页。它会加载指定网址并显示网页标题。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 没有兼容的 Custom Tab 浏览器时，使用此备用方式打开的链接将无法在应用内显示。

en.description: Log4K (Sascha Peilicke) starts this Provider with the app so its Android file logger can use the app's cache folder for log files. It stores the app context for that logging support.
en.disableEffect: Log4K file logging may fail because the library cannot get the app cache location, and an app flow that relies on that logger may fail.

zh-CN.description: Log4K（Sascha Peilicke）会在应用启动时运行此 Provider，让 Android 文件日志功能能够使用应用缓存目录保存日志。它会为这项日志功能保存应用上下文。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 由于无法获取应用缓存目录，Log4K 文件日志可能失效；依赖该日志功能的应用流程也可能失败。

en.description: The Sber ID SDK opens this screen during sign-in to show the authentication web page at the address supplied by the sign-in flow.
en.disableEffect: The Sber ID web sign-in flow cannot complete.

zh-CN.description: Sber ID SDK 会在登录过程中打开此界面，并显示登录流程提供的身份验证网页。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Sber ID 网页登录流程将无法完成。

en.description: The Sber ID SDK opens this activity as part of its web-based identity sign-in flow and handles the authentication result.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot complete sign-in through this Sber ID authentication flow.

zh-CN.description: Sber ID SDK 会在网页身份验证登录流程中打开此界面，并处理验证结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此 Sber ID 身份验证流程完成登录。

en.description: CITCON's mobile payment SDK opens this screen when WeChat Pay returns to the app. It reports the order's success or failure to the active payment.
en.disableEffect: The app will not receive WeChat Pay results, leaving those payments unable to finish normally.

zh-CN.description: 微信支付返回应用时，CITCON 移动支付 SDK 会打开此页面，并把订单成功或失败的状态交给当前支付流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将收不到微信支付结果，这类支付无法正常完成。

en.description: The Chat SDK contact-book flow opens this screen when a user chooses to find people from the device contacts. It matches those contacts with chat accounts, adds matches, and offers email or text invitations for people without an account.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot find or add contacts, or invite them by email or text, through this screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择从设备通讯录查找联系人时，Chat SDK 会打开此界面。它会将通讯录联系人与聊天账户匹配、添加匹配的账户，并为没有账户的人提供邮件或短信邀请。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法通过此界面查找、添加联系人，也无法发送邮件或短信邀请。

en.description: Chat SDK starts this background service when a user acts on a chat notification. It sends a typed reply to the conversation or marks that conversation as read.
en.disableEffect: Reply and mark-as-read actions from Chat SDK notifications stop working.

zh-CN.description: 用户操作聊天通知时，Chat SDK 会启动此后台服务。它会将用户输入的回复发送到对应会话，或将会话标记为已读。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Chat SDK 通知中的回复和标记已读操作会停止工作。

en.description: Chat SDK starts this service while opening the app and uses it to detect when the user swipes the app away from Recents. That event lets connected chat modules perform their app-dismissal cleanup.
en.disableEffect: Chat modules will not receive the app-dismissal cleanup event when the user swipes the app away.

zh-CN.description: 打开应用时，Chat SDK 会启动此服务，并用它检测用户是否从最近任务中划掉应用。检测到后，已连接的聊天模块可执行应用退出清理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户划掉应用时，聊天模块将收不到应用退出清理事件。

en.description: Chat SDK's encryption module opens this screen when the user chooses to export the local encryption keys. It creates and displays a QR code containing the key data.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot export encryption keys from this screen to transfer them elsewhere.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择导出本地加密密钥时，Chat SDK 的加密模块会打开此界面。它会生成并显示包含密钥数据的二维码。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法通过此界面导出加密密钥并转移到其他位置。

en.description: Chat SDK's encryption module opens the camera scanner when the user chooses to import encryption keys. After reading a QR code, it imports the key pair and closes.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot import an encryption key pair from a QR code through this flow.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择导入加密密钥时，Chat SDK 的加密模块会打开相机扫描界面。读取二维码后，它会导入密钥对并关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法通过此流程从二维码导入加密密钥对。

en.description: When Firebase delivers a push message, Chat SDK passes it to the app's registered push handlers unless the app has enabled manual push handling.
en.disableEffect: Default Chat SDK handling of Firebase push messages stops, which can prevent chat notifications from being processed.

zh-CN.description: Firebase 收到推送消息时，Chat SDK 会将消息交给应用已注册的推送处理程序，除非应用启用了手动推送处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Chat SDK 默认的 Firebase 推送处理会停止，聊天通知可能无法处理。

en.description: Chat SDK opens this sticker picker when a user chooses to add a sticker to a conversation. Selecting a sticker returns it to the message composer.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot choose stickers for messages through this picker.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择向会话添加贴纸时，Chat SDK 会打开贴纸选择界面。选中的贴纸会返回消息编辑界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法通过此选择器为消息挑选贴纸。

en.description: Chat SDK opens this player when a user selects a video message that uses its ExoPlayer-based screen. It plays the supplied video and preserves the playback position when the screen pauses.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot watch videos that the app opens through this player.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择由此播放器播放的视频消息时，Chat SDK 会打开此界面。它会播放指定视频，并在界面暂停时保留播放进度。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法观看应用通过此播放器打开的视频。

en.description: Chat SDK opens this screen to play a video file in a conversation. The video starts automatically and loops until playback ends or the user closes the screen.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot watch videos opened through this video screen.

zh-CN.description: Chat SDK 会打开此界面播放会话中的视频文件。视频会自动开始并循环播放，直到播放结束或用户关闭界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法观看通过此视频界面打开的视频。

en.description: Chat SDK's profile-picture module opens this gallery for a user's saved profile photos. The current user can add or remove photos and choose a default; other users' galleries are view-only.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot view or manage profile-photo galleries through this module.

zh-CN.description: Chat SDK 的个人资料照片模块会打开此相册，显示用户已保存的资料照片。当前用户可以添加或删除照片并设置默认照片；其他用户的相册只能查看。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法通过此模块查看或管理个人资料照片。

en.description: Chat SDK's Sinch calling module receives Firebase messages carrying call data and relays matching messages to its call service. This runs in the background when a matching push arrives.
en.disableEffect: If the app relies on this service to receive call pushes, incoming-call alerts stop through that path.

zh-CN.description: Chat SDK 的 Sinch 通话模块会接收包含通话数据的 Firebase 消息，并将匹配的消息转交给通话服务。收到匹配推送时，此服务会在后台运行。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 如果应用依赖此服务接收来电推送，停用后将无法通过这条路径收到来电提醒。

en.description: Chat SDK's Sinch module opens this screen for an active voice or video call. It shows the other caller and call status, and provides controls to hang up, mute, and toggle video.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot control or properly view active calls through the app's call screen.

zh-CN.description: Chat SDK 的 Sinch 模块会在语音或视频通话进行时打开此界面。界面显示对方和通话状态，并提供挂断、静音和切换视频的控制。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法通过应用的通话界面查看或控制正在进行的通话。

en.description: Chat SDK's Sinch module opens this screen for an incoming call. It rings, shows caller details, and lets the user answer or decline; answering proceeds to the active call screen.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot answer or decline incoming calls through the app.

zh-CN.description: 收到来电时，Chat SDK 的 Sinch 模块会打开此界面。界面会响铃、显示来电者信息，并允许用户接听或拒绝；接听后会进入通话界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法通过应用接听或拒绝来电。

en.description: Chat SDK opens this contact-selection screen when the user chooses to add people to a conversation. It adds the selected contacts to that conversation.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot add participants to a conversation through this flow.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择向会话添加成员时，Chat SDK 会打开此联系人选择界面。它会将选中的联系人加入会话。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法通过此流程向会话添加成员。

en.description: When the user opens a conversation, Chat SDK displays its message thread and chat interface here. The screen loads the conversation selected by the app.
en.disableEffect: The conversation screen cannot open, preventing users from reading or sending messages in that thread through the SDK.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开会话时，Chat SDK 会在此显示消息记录和聊天界面。界面会加载应用指定的会话。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 会话界面无法打开，用户将无法通过 SDK 阅读或发送该会话的消息。

en.description: Chat SDK opens this flow when the user starts a new conversation. It creates a one-to-one chat or sends a multi-person selection to the group setup screen.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot start a new one-to-one or group conversation through this flow.

zh-CN.description: 用户开始新会话时，Chat SDK 会打开此流程。它会创建一对一聊天，或将多人选择交给群聊设置界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法通过此流程发起一对一会话或群聊。

en.description: Chat SDK opens this screen when the user edits a profile. It can update the name, status, availability, contact details, avatar, and header image, and also provides a sign-out option.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot edit their profile details or sign out through this screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户编辑个人资料时，Chat SDK 会打开此界面。用户可修改姓名、状态、在线状态、联系方式、头像和顶部图片，也可在此退出登录。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法通过此界面修改个人资料或退出登录。

en.description: Chat SDK opens this screen to set up a new group or public chat, or to edit an existing conversation. It lets the user set its name and, when enabled, its picture.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot create or edit group and public chats through this screen.

zh-CN.description: Chat SDK 会打开此界面创建群聊或公共聊天室，也可用于编辑现有会话。用户可设置名称，并在启用时设置会话图片。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法通过此界面创建或编辑群聊及公共聊天室。

en.description: When a user chooses to forward messages, Chat SDK opens this recipient-selection screen. It creates or selects direct conversations and sends the chosen messages to those recipients.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot forward messages to other conversations through this screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择转发消息时，Chat SDK 会打开此收件人选择界面。它会为收件人创建或选择一对一会话，并发送选中的消息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法通过此界面将消息转发到其他会话。

en.description: Chat SDK opens this screen when the user needs to sign in or create an account. It supports password login, registration, anonymous login when enabled, and password-reset requests.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot sign in, register, or request a password reset through the Chat SDK screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户需要登录或创建账户时，Chat SDK 会打开此界面。它支持密码登录、注册、启用时的匿名登录以及密码重置申请。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法通过 Chat SDK 界面登录、注册或申请重置密码。

en.description: When the host app uses Chat SDK's tab-based layout, this activity provides the main chat screen. It displays the configured tabs, supports search in the current tab, and opens the current user's profile from the toolbar.
en.disableEffect: The tab-based Chat SDK home screen and its navigation and search cannot open.

zh-CN.description: 宿主应用使用 Chat SDK 的标签页布局时，此界面会提供聊天主屏幕。它显示已配置的标签页、支持搜索当前标签内容，并可从工具栏打开当前用户的资料。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Chat SDK 的标签页主屏幕及其导航和搜索将无法打开。

en.description: Chat SDK opens this screen after registration when the new account still needs a name. It collects profile details and an optional photo, saves them, and continues to the main chat screen.
en.disableEffect: New users cannot complete the profile setup needed to continue through this registration flow.

zh-CN.description: 注册后如果新账户还没有姓名，Chat SDK 会打开此界面。它会收集个人资料和可选照片、保存信息，然后进入聊天主界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 新用户无法完成此注册流程所需的资料设置。

en.description: Chat SDK opens this screen when the user views an account profile. It loads the selected user's details into the profile view.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open account profile pages through this screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户查看账户资料时，Chat SDK 会打开此界面。它会在资料页面加载所选用户的信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法通过此界面打开账户资料页。

en.description: Chat SDK opens this screen when the user searches for other chat accounts. It shows matching users and can add selected accounts as contacts, or add a user by ID when that option is enabled.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot search for or add new contacts through this screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户搜索其他聊天账户时，Chat SDK 会打开此界面。它会显示匹配用户并可将选中账户添加为联系人；启用相应选项时，也可按用户编号添加。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法通过此界面搜索或添加新联系人。

en.description: Chat SDK opens this startup screen while activating the chat system. It restores sign-in when possible and routes the user to login, profile setup, or the main chat screen.
en.disableEffect: The SDK's startup authentication and navigation flow cannot run.

zh-CN.description: Chat SDK 激活聊天系统时会打开此启动界面。它会在条件允许时恢复登录状态，并将用户引导至登录、资料设置或聊天主界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: SDK 的启动身份验证和页面引导流程将无法运行。

en.description: Chat SDK opens this screen to review image or video attachments before sending them in a conversation. Users can add or remove media and send the selected items as messages.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot review or send image and video attachments through this screen.

zh-CN.description: Chat SDK 会打开此界面，让用户在发送前预览会话中的图片或视频附件。用户可添加或移除媒体，并将选中内容作为消息发送。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法通过此界面预览或发送图片和视频附件。

en.description: Chat SDK opens this screen from a conversation to show its members and controls. Depending on access, users can add members, edit, join, leave, mute, refresh roles, or destroy the conversation.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot view conversation members or manage the conversation through this screen.

zh-CN.description: Chat SDK 会从会话中打开此界面，显示成员和会话控制项。根据权限，用户可添加成员、编辑、加入、退出、静音、刷新角色或删除会话。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法通过此界面查看会话成员或管理会话。

en.description: When the host app uses Chat SDK's drawer layout, this activity provides its main chat screen. The drawer navigates configured chat tabs and includes the user's profile and sign-out options.
en.disableEffect: The drawer-based Chat SDK home screen and its chat navigation cannot open.

zh-CN.description: 宿主应用使用 Chat SDK 的抽屉式布局时，此界面会提供聊天主屏幕。抽屉可切换已配置的聊天标签，并提供用户资料和退出登录选项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Chat SDK 的抽屉式主屏幕及聊天导航将无法打开。

en.description: Chat SDK opens the camera scanner when the user chooses to add a contact by QR code. It reads the account ID from the code and adds that account as a contact.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot add contacts by scanning their QR codes through Chat SDK.

zh-CN.description: 用户选择通过二维码添加联系人时，Chat SDK 会打开相机扫描界面。它会读取二维码中的账户编号，并将该账户添加为联系人。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法通过 Chat SDK 扫描二维码添加联系人。

en.description: Chat SDK opens this screen to show a QR code for a user's account ID. Another person can scan it to add that account as a contact.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot share an account ID using this QR-code screen.

zh-CN.description: Chat SDK 会打开此界面，显示用户账户编号对应的二维码。其他人可扫描二维码并将该账户添加为联系人。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法通过此二维码界面分享账户编号。

en.description: Chat SDK opens this screen when an authorized user selects a member in a group conversation. Depending on permissions, it can show that member's profile, change their role or speaking access, or remove them from the group.
en.disableEffect: Authorized users cannot manage group-member roles, speaking access, or removal through this screen.

zh-CN.description: 有权限的用户在群聊中选择成员时，Chat SDK 会打开此界面。根据权限，用户可查看成员资料、修改其角色或发言权限，或将其移出群聊。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 有权限的用户无法通过此界面管理群成员角色、发言权限或移除成员。

en.description: Chat SDK opens this screen to display the settings supplied by the app and its chat modules. The list can navigate to another screen, apply a choice, or change a setting when selected.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot view or change settings exposed through the Chat SDK screen.

zh-CN.description: Chat SDK 会打开此界面，显示应用及聊天模块提供的设置项。用户选择后可跳转到其他界面、应用选项或更改设置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法通过 Chat SDK 界面查看或更改其中提供的设置。

en.description: InTrack Android SDK and UserMost Android SDK use this screen when a user opens a push notification; it forwards the selected link or app action and then closes.
en.disableEffect: Push-notification taps and their linked navigation will no longer be handled through these SDKs.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开推送通知时，InTrack Android SDK 和 UserMost Android SDK 会使用此页面转发所选链接或应用操作，随后关闭页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过这些 SDK 发出的推送通知点击及其链接跳转将无法处理。

en.description: When a user dismisses a timed InTrack notification, this receiver stops its timer, removes it, and records the dismissal with Smartech.
en.disableEffect: InTrack may not stop the notification timer or record the dismissal when a notification is swiped away.

zh-CN.description: 用户关闭 InTrack 定时通知时，此接收器会停止计时、移除通知，并向 Smartech 记录关闭事件。

en.description: The OpenWeb (Spot.IM) community SDK uses this provider when a user takes a photo for a discussion. It gives the camera a shareable link to the saved image.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it breaks the OpenWeb photo capture flow when the saved image is returned to the app.

zh-CN.description: OpenWeb（Spot.IM）社区 SDK 会在用户为讨论拍摄照片时使用此 Provider，为已保存的图片提供可安全传递的链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，拍摄讨论照片并将图片交回应用的流程会失败。

en.description: The OpenWeb (Spot.IM) community SDK runs this provider when the app process starts to initialize its conversation services. This setup happens automatically before users open a discussion.
en.disableEffect: Without this startup step, OpenWeb conversation and community screens may fail to initialize when opened.

zh-CN.description: OpenWeb（Spot.IM）社区 SDK 会在应用进程启动时通过此 Provider 初始化讨论服务。用户打开讨论页面前会自动执行这一步。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，OpenWeb 讨论和社区页面所需的初始化可能无法完成。

en.description: The OpenWeb (Spot.IM) community SDK opens this screen when a user starts, edits, or replies to a discussion comment. It provides the editor for the selected conversation.
en.disableEffect: Users can no longer create, edit, or reply to comments through OpenWeb.

zh-CN.description: OpenWeb（Spot.IM）社区 SDK 会在用户撰写、编辑或回复讨论评论时打开此页面，为所选讨论显示编辑器。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过 OpenWeb 创建、编辑或回复评论。

en.description: The OpenWeb (Spot.IM) community SDK opens its sign-in screen when a user enters an account-only community flow. It also handles the return from the sign-in provider.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot complete OpenWeb sign-in, so community actions that require an account are unavailable.

zh-CN.description: OpenWeb（Spot.IM）社区 SDK 会在用户进入需要账户的社区流程时打开登录页面，并处理身份提供方返回的登录结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法完成 OpenWeb 登录，因此需要账户的社区操作不可用。

en.description: The OpenWeb (Spot.IM) community SDK opens this screen when a user profile is selected. It shows the selected member profile and posts, with follow controls.
en.disableEffect: Users lose profile viewing and follow controls in the OpenWeb community interface.

zh-CN.description: OpenWeb（Spot.IM）社区 SDK 会在用户选择某个个人资料时打开此页面，显示该成员的资料、帖子和关注操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: OpenWeb 社区界面中的个人资料浏览和关注功能将不可用。

en.description: The OpenWeb (Spot.IM) community SDK opens this screen when a user reports a comment. It lets the user choose a reason and provide any requested details.
en.disableEffect: Users can no longer submit comment reports through OpenWeb.

zh-CN.description: OpenWeb（Spot.IM）社区 SDK 会在用户举报评论时打开此页面，供用户选择举报原因并填写所需说明。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过 OpenWeb 提交评论举报。

en.description: The OpenWeb (Spot.IM) community SDK opens this screen when a user taps an image in a discussion. It displays that image in a full-screen viewer.
en.disableEffect: Users can no longer view discussion images full screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户点按讨论中的图片时，OpenWeb（Spot.IM）社区 SDK 会打开此页面全屏显示该图片。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法全屏查看讨论图片。

en.description: The OpenWeb (Spot.IM) community SDK opens this screen for a conversation and uses it to route users to comment threads and related discussion screens.
en.disableEffect: OpenWeb conversation routes that use this screen, including comment threads, will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: OpenWeb（Spot.IM）社区 SDK 会通过此页面打开讨论，并将用户带到评论串及相关讨论页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，依赖此页面的 OpenWeb 讨论入口（包括评论串）将无法打开。

en.description: When someone sets up a card reader, Sr. Pago's card-present payment SDK lists available readers and checks which reader types are enabled.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it can prevent the app from registering a reader, so payments that use that reader may not work.

zh-CN.description: 用户设置刷卡器时，Sr. Pago 刷卡支付 SDK 会列出可用读卡器，并检查哪些设备类型已启用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用可能无法注册读卡器，也无法使用该设备完成现场刷卡付款。

en.description: During reader setup in Sr. Pago’s card-present payment SDK, this screen guides the user through linking a Bluetooth or audio reader and returns the selected device type to setup.
en.disableEffect: Reader setup cannot be completed, so payments that rely on that reader may fail.

zh-CN.description: 在 Sr. Pago 刷卡支付 SDK 的读卡器设置过程中，此页面引导用户连接蓝牙或音频读卡器，并将选择结果交回设置流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，读卡器无法完成配对，依赖该设备的付款可能无法进行。

en.description: When Sr. Pago’s card-present payment SDK pairs a WisePad reader, this screen shows the pairing animation and asks the user to press the reader’s green button before returning to setup.
en.disableEffect: The user cannot complete this WisePad pairing step, preventing setup of that reader.

zh-CN.description: Sr. Pago 刷卡支付 SDK 为 WisePad 读卡器配对时，此页面播放配对动画，并提示用户按下设备上的绿色按钮后返回设置流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法完成 WisePad 配对步骤，也就无法设置该读卡器。

en.description: When Sr. Pago’s card-present payment SDK requires a signature, this screen captures the customer’s signature and returns it to the payment flow.
en.disableEffect: Payments that require a signature may not complete.

zh-CN.description: Sr. Pago 刷卡支付 SDK 需要签名时，此页面会收集持卡人的签名并将其交回付款流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，需要签名的付款可能无法完成。

en.description: When a user taps a Strict Canary notification about an Android policy violation, Alex Dadukin's Strict Canary opens this screen to show the violation list or selected details.
en.disableEffect: Strict Canary notifications can no longer open the violation list or details; the app's regular screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: 用户点击有关 Android 策略违规的 Strict Canary 通知时，Alex Dadukin 的 Strict Canary 会打开此界面，显示违规列表或所选违规的详情。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Strict Canary 通知将无法打开违规列表或详情；应用的常规界面仍可使用。

en.description: When an app opens Ada Support's assistant chat, this Activity builds the in-app chat view from the supplied settings and handles file selection requested during a conversation.
en.disableEffect: The embedded Ada assistant cannot open, and conversations routed through it are unavailable.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开 Ada Support 助手聊天时，这个 Activity 会根据传入的设置创建应用内聊天界面，并处理对话中发起的文件选择。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Ada 内嵌助手无法打开，应用中通过它提供的对话功能也会不可用。

en.description: When an app opens Ada Support's assistant chat, this Activity builds the in-app chat view from the supplied settings and handles file selection requested during a conversation.
en.disableEffect: The embedded Ada assistant cannot open, and conversations routed through it are unavailable.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开 Ada Support 助手聊天时，这个 Activity 会根据传入的设置创建应用内聊天界面，并处理对话中发起的文件选择。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Ada 内嵌助手无法打开，应用中通过它提供的对话功能也会不可用。

en.description: When the app process starts, Square's Tart performance library initializes startup measurements.
en.disableEffect: Tart startup performance measurements will not run; the app's regular features remain available.

zh-CN.description: 应用进程启动时，Square 的 Tart 性能库会初始化启动性能测量。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Tart 启动性能测量将不再运行，但应用的常规功能仍可使用。

en.description: OPay Offline Acquirer opens this screen from its cashier link, reads the order and amount, and loads the available payment methods. Users choose a method here to continue checkout.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to open or finish checkout through this OPay cashier flow.

zh-CN.description: OPay Offline Acquirer 会通过收银台链接打开此界面，读取订单和金额并加载可用的支付方式。用户可在此选择付款方式并继续结账。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此 OPay 收银台流程开始或完成结账。

en.description: When OPay Offline Acquirer receives a Mini POS payment request, this Activity displays the payment screen and initializes the connected payment-terminal provider. It accepts an order from the app or an OPay payment link.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot pay through the OPay Mini POS flow, including payments that require the connected payment terminal.

zh-CN.description: OPay Offline Acquirer 收到 Mini POS 支付请求时，此 Activity 会显示支付界面并初始化连接的支付终端服务。它可以接收应用传入的订单，也可以处理 OPay 支付链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 OPay Mini POS 流程付款，包括需要连接支付终端的付款。

en.description: When OPay Offline Acquirer opens its QR checkout link, this Activity displays a payment QR code and checks the order status until a payment result is available.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot pay by QR code through this OPay flow or see whether that order was paid.

zh-CN.description: OPay Offline Acquirer 打开二维码结账链接时，此 Activity 会显示支付二维码，并持续查询订单状态，直到获得支付结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此 OPay 流程扫码付款，也无法查看该订单是否已支付。

en.description: OPay Offline Acquirer opens this screen for deposit, cashier, deposit-history, or bank USSD payment links. It reads the order details and displays the matching payment or deposit screen.
en.disableEffect: The OPay deposit, cashier, history, and bank USSD entry points handled here will not open, preventing those payment flows from completing.

zh-CN.description: OPay Offline Acquirer 会通过存款、收银台、存款记录或银行 USSD 支付链接打开此界面。它读取订单信息，并显示相应的支付或存款页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 此界面处理的 OPay 存款、收银台、记录和银行 USSD 入口将无法打开，这些支付流程也无法完成。

en.description: When OPay Offline Acquirer opens the nearby-agent locator, this Activity requests location access and displays a map of nearby cash-deposit agents.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot find nearby agents through the app when making a cash deposit.

zh-CN.description: OPay Offline Acquirer 打开附近代理点查询时，此 Activity 会请求位置信息权限，并显示附近现金存款代理点的地图。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户办理现金存款时将无法通过应用查找附近代理点。

en.description: When OPay Offline Acquirer starts its share flow, this Activity opens a share sheet for the supplied items and returns the selected destination and file path to the app.
en.disableEffect: Users lose the OPay in-app sharing flow for the items handled by this SDK.

zh-CN.description: OPay Offline Acquirer 启动分享流程时，此 Activity 会为传入的内容打开分享面板，并将用户选择的目标和文件路径返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法使用此 SDK 提供的应用内分享流程分享相关内容。

en.description: When the host app starts AIQ Kit visual search, the AIQ Tech Vision Search SDK opens its camera scanner and sends the result to the search results screen.
en.disableEffect: Camera-based visual searches through AIQ Kit will not be available.

zh-CN.description: 应用发起 AIQ Kit 视觉搜索时，AIQ Tech Vision Search SDK 会打开相机扫描页面，并将搜索结果交给结果页面显示。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用无法使用 AIQ Kit 的相机视觉搜索功能。

en.description: After AIQ Kit visual search completes, this AIQ Tech Vision Search SDK Activity displays the results and recognized text, and can show a web page linked to a result.
en.disableEffect: AIQ Kit search results and their linked web pages cannot open in this screen.

zh-CN.description: AIQ Kit 视觉搜索完成后，此 AIQ Tech Vision Search SDK 页面会展示搜索结果和识别出的文字，也可以打开结果关联的网页。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，AIQ Kit 的搜索结果及其关联网页无法在此页面打开。

en.description: When the host app starts AIQ Kit visual search, this AIQ Tech Vision Search SDK Activity opens the camera and analyzes its preview. When it gets a search result, it opens the results screen.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot use AIQ Kit's camera-based visual search flow.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动 AIQ Kit 视觉搜索时，此 AIQ Tech Vision Search SDK 页面会打开相机并分析预览画面；取得搜索结果后会切换到结果页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用无法使用 AIQ Kit 的相机视觉搜索流程。

en.description: When AIQ Kit opens a result link, this AIQ Tech Vision Search SDK Activity loads the supplied address in its in-app browser and handles page navigation and permissions.
en.disableEffect: Links that rely on AIQ Kit's in-app browser will not open.

zh-CN.description: AIQ Kit 打开搜索结果中的网页时，此 AIQ Tech Vision Search SDK 页面会在应用内加载网页，并处理页面导航和所需权限。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，依赖 AIQ Kit 内置浏览器的链接无法打开。

en.description: When the host app starts an Amwal Payment sheet, this Activity checks the payment configuration and presents the SDK's in-app payment screen. It returns the payment result to the app when the flow ends.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot open and complete its Amwal payment flow.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动 Amwal Payment 付款页时，此 Activity 会检查付款配置并显示 SDK 的应用内付款界面；流程结束后会把付款结果返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用无法通过 Amwal SDK 打开并完成付款流程。

en.description: When Beep Android Loader opens a URL for a cashless-payment or telematics workflow, this Activity loads it in the SDK's embedded browser and forwards requests between the page and the loader.
en.disableEffect: Beep Loader cannot display its URL-based pages, preventing workflows that use those pages from finishing.

zh-CN.description: Beep Android Loader 为无现金付款或车联网流程打开网址时，此 Activity 会在 SDK 内置浏览器中加载页面，并转发网页与加载器之间的请求。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Beep 加载器无法显示网址页面，依赖这些页面的流程将无法完成。

en.description: When the Dojo Pay SDK starts a card payment, this Activity displays the payment screen, runs payment checks, and returns the result. It opens a 3-D Secure verification step when required.
en.disableEffect: Dojo card payments cannot complete if this screen is disabled.

zh-CN.description: Dojo Pay SDK 发起银行卡付款时，此 Activity 会显示付款页面、执行付款检查并返回付款结果；需要时还会打开 3-D Secure 验证页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Dojo 银行卡付款无法完成。

en.description: When the Dojo Pay SDK starts its virtual-terminal payment flow, this Activity hosts the payment screen and returns a success or failure result to the app.
en.disableEffect: The Dojo virtual-terminal payment flow cannot complete.

zh-CN.description: Dojo Pay SDK 的虚拟终端付款流程启动时，此 Activity 会承载付款页面，并向应用返回成功或失败结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Dojo 的虚拟终端付款流程无法完成。

en.description: When the Dojo Pay SDK processes a Google Pay request, this Activity checks whether Google Pay is ready, collects the payment, handles required 3-D Secure verification, and returns the result.
en.disableEffect: Google Pay payments through Dojo will not work.

zh-CN.description: Dojo Pay SDK 处理 Google Pay 付款时，此 Activity 会检查 Google Pay 是否可用、完成付款，并在需要时处理 3-D Secure 验证后返回结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Dojo 的 Google Pay 付款无法使用。

en.description: When the app starts the Dojo Pay drop-in payment UI, this Activity provides payment-method selection, card entry, saved-card management, and payment-result screens. It also connects the flow to Google Pay and virtual-terminal payment handlers.
en.disableEffect: Dojo's in-app payment screen cannot open, so its checkout flow cannot complete.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动 Dojo Pay 一站式付款界面时，此 Activity 会提供付款方式选择、银行卡填写、已保存银行卡管理和结果页面，并连接 Google Pay 与虚拟终端付款处理流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Dojo 的应用内付款页面无法打开，结账流程不能完成。

en.description: The Guazi Internet Environment Setting screen lets the host app choose TEST, WEB6, or ONLINE service hosts, save host addresses, or clear the saved settings.
en.disableEffect: The app can no longer use this screen to switch or clear its saved service hosts.

zh-CN.description: Guazi 网络环境设置页面供应用选择 TEST、WEB6 或 ONLINE 服务地址，也可以保存或清除这些地址配置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用无法通过此页面切换或清除已保存的服务地址。

en.description: Neokred Card Details opens its card-management screen when an app starts this card flow. It uses the supplied customer and client information to load card details and provide virtual-card controls such as blocking a card or changing online transaction access.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open Neokred's card details and virtual-card management flow in the app.

zh-CN.description: Neokred Card Details 会在应用启动卡片管理流程时显示卡片界面。它使用应用传入的客户及应用信息加载卡片详情，并提供锁定虚拟卡、开关线上交易等操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法在应用中打开 Neokred 的卡片详情和虚拟卡管理流程。

en.description: Nimbbl Checkout opens its payment screen when an app starts checkout. If the user presses Back, it asks the user to confirm cancellation and choose a reason before closing.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot complete or cancel a payment through the app's Nimbbl checkout flow.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动 Nimbbl Checkout 付款时，此组件会显示结账界面。用户按返回键时，界面会先确认是否取消，并可让用户选择取消原因。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法通过应用中的 Nimbbl 结账流程完成或取消付款。

en.description: When the MuPDF library needs a file, this Qiji Tech screen browses folders for supported documents or a certificate file, then opens a chosen document in the reader or returns the certificate to the requesting flow.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, the reader's built-in file browsing and certificate selection cannot be used.

zh-CN.description: MuPDF 需要用户选择文件时，Qiji Tech 的界面会浏览文件夹并列出支持的文档或证书文件，然后打开所选文档或将证书交回请求流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，阅读器内置的文件浏览和证书选择功能将无法使用。

en.description: When a supported document is opened for viewing, this Qiji Tech MuPDF Activity renders it for reading, including PDF, XPS, CBZ, and EPUB files, and offers outline navigation and printing.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, supported documents cannot open in this reader, so the app's document-viewing flow fails.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开支持的文档进行查看时，Qiji Tech 的 MuPDF Activity 会显示文档供阅读，支持 PDF、XPS、CBZ 和 EPUB，并提供目录导航和打印入口。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，支持的文档无法在此阅读器中打开，应用的文档查看流程会失效。

en.description: When the user opens a document's table of contents in the MuPDF reader, this Qiji Tech screen lists the outline entries and returns the selected page.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, users cannot jump to a page from the document outline.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 MuPDF 阅读器中打开文档目录时，Qiji Tech 的界面会列出目录条目，并返回所选页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，用户无法通过文档目录跳转到指定页面。

en.description: When the user chooses to print from MuPDF, this Qiji Tech Activity opens the Google Cloud Print web dialog with the current document's content.
en.disableEffect: If disabled, users cannot send a document from this reader through its Google Cloud Print dialog.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 MuPDF 中选择打印时，Qiji Tech 的 Activity 会打开 Google Cloud Print 网页对话框并载入当前文档。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，用户无法通过此阅读器的 Google Cloud Print 对话框发送文档进行打印。

en.description: Scanto Vision Search opens this screen after a visual search to show matching results and text read from the image. It can also display a related web page inside the search flow.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot show Scanto search results or related pages in this screen.

zh-CN.description: Scanto Vision Search 会在图像搜索后打开此界面，显示匹配结果和从图像中识别出的文字。用户也可以在搜索流程中查看相关网页。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用将无法在此界面显示 Scanto 搜索结果或相关页面。

en.description: Scanto Vision Search opens a camera screen to scan barcodes or search from a captured image. It sends image data for visual search and can return the resulting matches to the app.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot scan or search for images through Scanto Vision Search.

zh-CN.description: Scanto Vision Search 会打开相机界面扫描条码，或根据拍摄的图像进行搜索。它会发送图像进行视觉搜索，并可将匹配结果返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用将无法使用 Scanto Vision Search 扫描条码或搜索图像。

en.description: Scanto Vision Search uses this in-app browser to open a URL supplied by the app. It displays the page, supports back navigation and downloads, and handles links that the app recognizes.
en.disableEffect: In-app flows that open a URL through Scanto's browser will no longer be available.

zh-CN.description: Scanto Vision Search 使用此内置浏览器打开应用提供的网址。它显示网页、支持返回浏览，并可下载内容或处理应用能够识别的链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用将无法通过 Scanto 内置浏览器打开相关网页。

en.description: Skot Framework's viewlegacyTests library provides a portrait test screen that appears when the app explicitly opens its framework test feature.
en.disableEffect: The Skot test screen will not open, while the app's regular screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: Skot Framework 的 viewlegacyTests 测试库提供竖屏测试界面，应用主动打开框架测试功能时才会显示。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Skot 测试界面将无法打开，应用的日常页面仍可使用。

en.description: SudMGP uses this Activity when an app starts a Unity-powered mini-game. It initializes the game player used to render the mini-game inside the app.
en.disableEffect: SudMGP mini-games that use this player may fail to open or display correctly.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动 Unity 小游戏时，SudMGP 会使用此界面初始化游戏播放器，在应用中呈现游戏画面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，依赖此播放器的 SudMGP 小游戏可能无法打开或正常显示。

en.description: SudMGP uses this Activity briefly when starting a Unity mini-game. It prepares the game screen and closes when startup is complete.
en.disableEffect: The Unity game screen may not initialize, preventing the mini-game from starting correctly.

zh-CN.description: SudMGP 启动 Unity 小游戏时会短暂打开此界面来准备游戏画面，准备完成后界面会自动关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Unity 游戏画面可能无法初始化，SudMGP 小游戏也可能无法正常启动。

en.description: SudMGP runs this Service while its Unity mini-game is active. It keeps the game responsive to screen changes, pause and resume events, and touch or key input.
en.disableEffect: SudMGP mini-games may fail to run or respond correctly to screen changes and user input.

zh-CN.description: SudMGP 会在 Unity 小游戏运行期间使用此服务。它负责让游戏响应画面变化、暂停和恢复，以及触摸或按键输入。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，SudMGP 小游戏可能无法正常运行，或无法响应画面变化和用户操作。

en.description: The VibWifi library runs this background service when the app requests repeated Wi-Fi scans. It collects nearby network names and signal levels, then sends the results back to the app.
en.disableEffect: Screens that rely on VibWifi's repeated Wi-Fi scan results will not be able to show nearby networks.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求重复扫描 Wi-Fi 网络时，VibWifi 库会运行此后台服务。它收集附近网络名称和信号强度，再把结果发送回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖 VibWifi 重复扫描结果的页面将无法显示附近的 Wi-Fi 网络。

en.description: When the app task is removed from Recents while this service is running, Rabbit's RDC Android SDK ends the tracking session and stops the service.
en.disableEffect: Rabbit may miss the session-end tracking event when a user removes the app from Recents.

zh-CN.description: 此服务运行期间，如果用户从最近任务中移除应用，Rabbit RDC Android SDK 会结束本次跟踪会话并停止服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户从最近任务中移除应用时，Rabbit 可能无法记录会话结束事件。

en.description: TheoremReach's rewarded-survey SDK opens this Activity when an app requests a Moment survey and displays the survey page. It reports whether the user completed, left, or was not eligible for the survey.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to take TheoremReach Moment surveys or earn their survey rewards.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求 TheoremReach 激励问卷时会打开此 Activity，并显示问卷页面；用户完成、退出或不符合资格时，它会向应用返回相应结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法参加 TheoremReach Moment 问卷或获得相应问卷奖励。

en.description: TheoremReach's rewarded-survey SDK opens this Activity when an app opens its reward center, showing available surveys and rewards in a web page.
en.disableEffect: Users will lose access to TheoremReach's survey and reward offers in the app.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开 TheoremReach 奖励中心时会启动此 Activity，并在网页中显示可参加的问卷和奖励内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过此页面浏览 TheoremReach 问卷或获取相应奖励。

en.description: Jamun Country-Picker opens a country list for single or multiple selection. The app receives the country choices made on this screen.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot select and return a country through Jamun Country-Picker in the app.

zh-CN.description: Jamun Country-Picker 会显示国家列表，供用户单选或多选。应用会收到用户在此界面中选择的国家。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法通过 Jamun Country-Picker 选择国家并将结果返回应用。

en.description: Jamun Language-Picker displays a list of languages for single or multiple selection. The app receives the selected language choices.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot select and return a language through Jamun Language-Picker in the app.

zh-CN.description: Jamun Language-Picker 会显示语言列表，供用户单选或多选。应用会收到用户选择的语言。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法通过 Jamun Language-Picker 选择语言并将结果返回应用。

en.description: Jamun Pickers opens its country-selection screen when an app requests a country choice. It supports single or multiple selection and returns the chosen countries to the app.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot select and return countries through this Jamun Pickers screen.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求选择国家时，Jamun Pickers 会打开国家选择界面。它支持单选或多选，并会将所选国家返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法通过此 Jamun Pickers 界面选择国家并返回结果。

en.description: Jamun Pickers opens its language-selection screen when an app requests language choices. It supports single or multiple selection and returns the selected languages to the app.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot select and return languages through this Jamun Pickers screen.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求选择语言时，Jamun Pickers 会打开语言选择界面。它支持单选或多选，并会将所选语言返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法通过此 Jamun Pickers 界面选择语言并返回结果。

en.description: Jamun Browser opens a web address inside the app and displays the page with browser controls. Users can navigate the page, copy or share its address, and follow links.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open web pages through Jamun Browser inside the app.

zh-CN.description: Jamun Browser 会在应用内打开网址，并显示带浏览控件的网页。用户可以浏览页面、复制或分享网址，也可以打开页面中的链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法通过 Jamun Browser 在应用内打开网页。

en.description: Jamun Calendar displays a calendar for choosing a start and end date. It returns both selected dates to the app.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot collect a date range through Jamun Calendar's two-date picker.

zh-CN.description: Jamun Calendar 会显示日历，供用户选择开始和结束日期，并将两个日期返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用将无法通过 Jamun Calendar 的双日期选择界面收集日期范围。

en.description: Jamun Calendar displays a calendar for choosing one date or month, depending on the app's request. The app can limit the available choices and receives the selection.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot collect a single date or month through Jamun Calendar's picker.

zh-CN.description: Jamun Calendar 会显示日历，供用户根据应用的请求选择一个日期或月份。应用可以限制可选范围，并接收用户的选择。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用将无法通过 Jamun Calendar 的选择界面收集单个日期或月份。

en.description: Jamun Camera opens a camera screen for taking and previewing a photo. Users can also choose a picture from the gallery, and the app receives the saved image.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot take or return a picture through Jamun Camera's capture flow.

zh-CN.description: Jamun Camera 会打开相机界面供用户拍照和预览。用户也可以从图库中选择图片，应用会收到保存后的图像。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法通过 Jamun Camera 拍照或将图片返回应用。

en.description: Jamun Country-Picker opens a country list when the app requests a country choice. It supports single or multiple selection and returns the selected countries.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot select and return a country through Jamun Country-Picker in the app.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求选择国家时，Jamun Country-Picker 会打开国家列表。它支持单选或多选，并会将所选国家返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法通过 Jamun Country-Picker 选择国家并将结果返回应用。

en.description: Jamun Gallery opens a larger preview of an image selected by the app. It displays the image and provides a back control to return to the previous screen.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open the app's selected image in Jamun Gallery's preview screen.

zh-CN.description: Jamun Gallery 会为应用选中的图片打开较大的预览界面。它显示图片，并提供返回控件回到上一界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法在 Jamun Gallery 的预览界面中查看应用选中的图片。

en.description: Jamun Gallery opens a picker for images, audio, files, or video, depending on what the app requests. It returns the selected item or items to the app.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot choose images, audio, files, or video through Jamun Gallery in the app.

zh-CN.description: Jamun Gallery 会根据应用的请求打开图片、音频、文件或视频选择界面，并将用户选中的内容返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法通过 Jamun Gallery 在应用中选择图片、音频、文件或视频。

en.description: Jamun Language-Picker opens a language list when the app requests a language choice. It supports single or multiple selection and returns the selected languages.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot select and return a language through Jamun Language-Picker in the app.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求选择语言时，Jamun Language-Picker 会打开语言列表。它支持单选或多选，并会将所选语言返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法通过 Jamun Language-Picker 选择语言并将结果返回应用。

en.description: Jamun Pickers opens its country-selection screen when an app requests a country choice. It supports single or multiple selection and returns the chosen countries to the app.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot select and return countries through this Jamun Pickers screen.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求选择国家时，Jamun Pickers 会打开国家选择界面。它支持单选或多选，并会将所选国家返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法通过此 Jamun Pickers 界面选择国家并返回结果。

en.description: Jamun Pickers opens its language-selection screen when an app requests language choices. It supports single or multiple selection and returns the selected languages to the app.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot select and return languages through this Jamun Pickers screen.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求选择语言时，Jamun Pickers 会打开语言选择界面。它支持单选或多选，并会将所选语言返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法通过此 Jamun Pickers 界面选择语言并返回结果。

en.description: Jamun Scanner opens the camera to read QR codes or barcodes, and it can also accept a code entered by the user. It returns the scanned or entered text to the app.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot scan a code or return a scanned value through Jamun Scanner.

zh-CN.description: Jamun Scanner 会打开相机读取二维码或条形码，也允许用户手动输入代码，并将扫描或输入的文字返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法通过 Jamun Scanner 扫描代码或将扫描结果返回应用。

en.description: Jamun Calendar displays a calendar for choosing a start and end date. It returns both selected dates to the app.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot collect a date range through Jamun Calendar's two-date picker.

zh-CN.description: Jamun Calendar 会显示日历，供用户选择开始和结束日期，并将两个日期返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用将无法通过 Jamun Calendar 的双日期选择界面收集日期范围。

en.description: Jamun Calendar displays a calendar for choosing one date. The app can set the allowed date range and receives the selected date.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot collect a single date through Jamun Calendar's date picker.

zh-CN.description: Jamun Calendar 会显示日历供用户选择一个日期。应用可以设置可选日期范围，并接收用户选择的日期。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，应用将无法通过 Jamun Calendar 的日期选择界面收集单个日期。

en.description: When the app opens a JamunX Browser page with a URL, this Activity loads the page inside the app and offers back, share, and copy-link controls.
en.disableEffect: Any app flow that relies on this in-app browser will not be able to open its page.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开 JamunX Browser 的内置网页并传入网址时，此 Activity 会加载页面，并提供返回、分享和复制链接操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此内置浏览页面的应用流程将无法打开网页。

en.description: When the app opens a JamunX SingleTabBrowser page with a URL, this Activity loads the page inside the app and offers back, share, and copy-link controls.
en.disableEffect: Any app flow that relies on this in-app browser will not be able to open its page.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开 JamunX SingleTabBrowser 的内置网页并传入网址时，此 Activity 会加载页面，并提供返回、分享和复制链接操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此内置浏览页面的应用流程将无法打开网页。

en.description: When the app asks JamunX Calendar for a date range, this screen lets the user choose the start and end dates and returns the selection.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot complete date-range choices that depend on this calendar screen.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求 JamunX Calendar 选择日期范围时，此界面会让用户选择开始和结束日期，并将结果交回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此日历界面的日期范围选择将无法完成。

en.description: When the app asks JamunX Calendar for one date, this screen lets the user choose a day and returns the selected date.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot complete date choices that depend on this calendar screen.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求 JamunX Calendar 选择日期时，此界面会让用户选定一天，并将结果交回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此日历界面的日期选择将无法完成。

en.description: When the app opens the JamunX Camera screen, the user can take a photo or choose an existing image, preview it, and return the saved image to the app.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot capture or select an image through this JamunX screen.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开 JamunX Camera 界面时，用户可以拍照或选择已有图片、预览图片，并将保存的图片交回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法通过 JamunX 的此界面拍照或选择图片。

en.description: When the app asks JamunX Country-Picker to choose one or more countries, this screen presents the supplied country list and returns the selection.
en.disableEffect: Country choices that rely on this picker cannot be completed.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求 JamunX Country-Picker 选择一个或多个国家时，此界面会显示应用提供的国家列表，并交回所选结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此选择器的国家选择流程将无法完成。

en.description: When a selected picture is opened for viewing, JamunX Gallery displays a larger preview of that image.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot show the selected image preview through JamunX Gallery.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开图片预览时，JamunX Gallery 会显示所选图片的较大预览。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法通过 JamunX Gallery 查看所选图片的预览。

en.description: When the app opens JamunX Gallery to select an image, audio item, or file, this screen displays device items and returns one or more selections.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot select images, audio items, or files through this gallery screen.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开 JamunX Gallery 选择图片、音频或文件时，此界面会显示设备中的项目，并交回一个或多个选择结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法通过此图库界面选择图片、音频或文件。

en.description: When the app asks JamunX Language-Picker to choose one or more languages, this screen presents the supplied language list and returns the selection.
en.disableEffect: Language choices that rely on this picker cannot be completed.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求 JamunX Language-Picker 选择一种或多种语言时，此界面会显示应用提供的语言列表，并交回所选结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此选择器的语言选择流程将无法完成。

en.description: When the app asks JamunX Pickers to choose one or more countries, this screen presents the supplied country list and returns the selection.
en.disableEffect: Country choices that rely on this picker cannot be completed.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求 JamunX Pickers 选择一个或多个国家时，此界面会显示应用提供的国家列表，并交回所选结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此选择器的国家选择流程将无法完成。

en.description: When the app asks JamunX Pickers to choose one or more languages, this screen presents the supplied language list and returns the selection.
en.disableEffect: Language choices that rely on this picker cannot be completed.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求 JamunX Pickers 选择一种或多种语言时，此界面会显示应用提供的语言列表，并交回所选结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此选择器的语言选择流程将无法完成。

en.description: When the app opens JamunX Scanner, this screen scans QR codes or barcodes with the camera and returns the decoded text; it also accepts code text entered by the user.
en.disableEffect: The app cannot scan or submit codes through this JamunX screen.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开 JamunX Scanner 时，此界面会用相机扫描二维码或条形码并交回识别文本，也允许用户手动输入代码。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法通过 JamunX 的此界面扫描或提交代码。

en.description: When an agent opens the incentives screen, JungleWorks' Tookan Agent SDK loads the incentive summary and shows the total and details in tabs.
en.disableEffect: Agents will not be able to view their incentive totals or details.

zh-CN.description: 代理人打开奖励页面时，JungleWorks 的 Tookan Agent SDK 会加载奖励汇总，并按标签页显示总额和明细。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 代理人将无法查看奖励总额和明细。

en.description: When an agent opens the wallet screen, JungleWorks' Tookan Agent SDK shows an agent's wallet balances and transaction history, with date and transaction filters.
en.disableEffect: Wallet balances and transactions will no longer be available in the agent app.

zh-CN.description: 代理人打开钱包页面时，JungleWorks 的 Tookan Agent SDK 会显示代理人的钱包余额和交易记录，并提供日期及交易类型筛选。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 代理人将无法在应用中查看钱包余额和交易记录。

en.description: During the JungleWorks' Tookan Agent background-check flow, this screen displays the authorization document and collects an agent's Social Security number, electronic signature, and consent for submission.
en.disableEffect: The background-check authorization cannot be completed or submitted.

zh-CN.description: 在 JungleWorks 的 Tookan Agent 的背景审查流程中，此页面显示授权文件，并收集代理人的社会安全号码、电子签名和提交授权。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 背景审查授权将无法完成或提交。

en.description: JungleWorks' Tookan Agent SDK starts the background-check consent flow by showing a summary notice and asking the agent to confirm receipt before continuing.
en.disableEffect: Agents will not be able to proceed through the background-check consent steps.

zh-CN.description: JungleWorks 的 Tookan Agent SDK 会先显示背景审查摘要，并要求代理人确认已收到摘要后再继续。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 代理人将无法继续完成背景审查的同意流程。

en.description: When an agent opens the capacity screen, JungleWorks' Tookan Agent requests fleet capacity data and displays total and currently available capacity.
en.disableEffect: Fleet capacity totals will no longer be visible in the agent app.

zh-CN.description: 代理人打开容量页面时，JungleWorks 的 Tookan Agent 会获取车队容量数据，并显示总容量和当前可用容量。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 代理人将无法在应用中查看车队容量数据。

en.description: When an agent opens a task checklist, JungleWorks' Tookan Agent SDK displays the checklist attached to a task and lets the agent complete and submit its items.
en.disableEffect: The task checklist cannot be completed or submitted.

zh-CN.description: 代理人打开任务检查清单时，JungleWorks 的 Tookan Agent SDK 会显示任务附带的检查清单，供代理人填写并提交各项内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 任务检查清单将无法填写或提交。

en.description: When a user creates a task in JungleWorks' Tookan Agent, this screen collects pickup and delivery details, addresses, timing, and other task fields before submission.
en.disableEffect: New tasks cannot be created through the Tookan Agent interface.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 JungleWorks 的 Tookan Agent 中创建任务时，此页面会收集取件和送达信息、地址、时间及其他任务内容，然后提交任务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 Tookan Agent 创建新任务。

en.description: JungleWorks' Tookan Agent opens a camera scanner when a task requires a barcode; the agent can also enter the code manually and return it to the task.
en.disableEffect: Barcode-based task checks and the manual code-entry screen will be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: 任务需要条形码时，JungleWorks 的 Tookan Agent 会打开相机扫描界面；代理人也可手动输入条码并将结果交回任务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 基于条形码的任务核验和手动输入界面都将无法使用。

en.description: When an agent proceeds through the background-check flow, JungleWorks' Tookan Agent SDK displays a disclosure document and requires the agent to acknowledge it before continuing to authorization.
en.disableEffect: Agents cannot acknowledge the disclosure and continue through authorization.

zh-CN.description: 代理人继续背景审查流程时，JungleWorks 的 Tookan Agent SDK 会显示披露文件，并要求代理人确认后才能继续授权流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 代理人将无法确认披露文件并继续授权流程。

en.description: JungleWorks' Tookan Agent opens a page selected from its side menu inside the app, using the page title and address supplied by the app.
en.disableEffect: Side-menu pages that rely on this in-app view cannot be opened.

zh-CN.description: 用户从 JungleWorks 的 Tookan Agent 侧边菜单选择页面时，应用会在内部页面中打开相应标题和网址的内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此页面显示方式的侧边菜单内容将无法打开。

en.description: When an agent selects a task's earning or pricing details, JungleWorks' Tookan Agent shows the task reference and the corresponding breakdown.
en.disableEffect: The selected task's earning and pricing details will no longer be available.

zh-CN.description: 代理人查看某项任务的收入或价格明细时，JungleWorks 的 Tookan Agent 会显示任务信息及相应的费用明细。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 代理人将无法查看所选任务的收入和价格明细。

en.description: When an agent opens the earnings screen, JungleWorks' Tookan Agent SDK loads an agent's earnings and displays the total payout and individual earning entries.
en.disableEffect: Agents will not be able to review their earnings or payout totals.

zh-CN.description: 代理人打开收入页面时，JungleWorks 的 Tookan Agent SDK 会加载代理人的收入，并显示总付款额和各项收入记录。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 代理人将无法查看收入记录或付款总额。

en.description: When a task photo is attached, JungleWorks' Tookan Agent previews it and lets the user add or edit its caption before returning it to the task.
en.disableEffect: The task photo caption cannot be reviewed or edited in this screen.

zh-CN.description: 添加任务照片时，JungleWorks 的 Tookan Agent 会显示照片，并允许用户添加或修改说明后将照片交回任务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在此页面查看或修改任务照片说明。

en.description: When an agent changes availability, JungleWorks' Tookan Agent lets an agent mark work days as available or unavailable and save schedule changes; it also shows warnings about pending tasks.
en.disableEffect: Agents will not be able to change their availability schedule here.

zh-CN.description: 代理人更改可用时间时，JungleWorks 的 Tookan Agent 允许代理人将工作日期设为可用或不可用并保存排班，也会提示尚未完成的任务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 代理人将无法在此页面更改可用时间安排。

en.description: JungleWorks' Tookan Agent opens a selected task for editing, including its timing, locations, contact details, and custom fields, and submits the changes.
en.disableEffect: Tasks cannot be edited through this screen.

zh-CN.description: JungleWorks 的 Tookan Agent 会打开所选任务的编辑页面，供用户修改时间、地点、联系人和自定义字段并提交更改。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此页面编辑任务。

en.description: When a freelancer agent opens the task list, JungleWorks' Tookan Agent SDK loads date-specific available tasks for freelancer agents and provides calendar and task filters.
en.disableEffect: Freelancer agents will not be able to review available tasks by date.

zh-CN.description: 自由职业代理人打开任务列表时，JungleWorks 的 Tookan Agent SDK 会加载自由职业代理人按日期可接的任务，并提供日历和任务筛选。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 自由职业代理人将无法按日期查看可接任务。

en.description: After sign-in, the main screen of JungleWorks' Tookan Agent shows an agent's task list and map, provides access to task, wallet, and schedule workflows, and refreshes task data.
en.disableEffect: The agent's main task and map screen will not open.

zh-CN.description: 代理人登录后打开 JungleWorks 的 Tookan Agent 主页面时，可查看任务列表和地图、进入任务、钱包及排班流程，并查看刷新的任务数据。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 代理人的主任务页面和地图将无法打开。

en.description: When an invoice is requested for a task, JungleWorks' Tookan Agent renders the supplied invoice document inside the app.
en.disableEffect: Task invoices that use this in-app page cannot be viewed.

zh-CN.description: 用户查看任务发票时，JungleWorks 的 Tookan Agent 会在应用内显示传入的发票内容。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此页面的任务发票将无法查看。

en.description: On launch, JungleWorks' Tookan Agent SDK checks location readiness and opens the sign-in or saved-agent startup flow.
en.disableEffect: The Tookan Agent startup and sign-in flow cannot open.

zh-CN.description: JungleWorks 的 Tookan Agent SDK 启动时会检查定位状态，并进入登录或已登录代理人的启动流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Tookan Agent 的启动和登录流程将无法打开。

en.description: When an agent opens the new-task list, JungleWorks' Tookan Agent displays new tasks offered to an agent so they can review and respond to the available work.
en.disableEffect: Agents will not be able to review or respond to newly offered tasks here.

zh-CN.description: 代理人打开新任务列表时，JungleWorks 的 Tookan Agent 会显示分配给代理人的新任务，供其查看并响应可接工作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 代理人将无法在此页面查看或响应新任务。

en.description: When an agent opens the notifications screen, JungleWorks' Tookan Agent SDK shows saved task and app notifications and lets the agent review or clear them.
en.disableEffect: Saved notifications cannot be reviewed or cleared from this screen.

zh-CN.description: 代理人打开通知页面时，JungleWorks 的 Tookan Agent SDK 会显示已保存的任务和应用通知，供代理人查看或清除。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 代理人将无法在此页面查看或清除已保存的通知。

en.description: During phone verification, JungleWorks' Tookan Agent asks the user to enter a one-time code and provides verify and resend actions.
en.disableEffect: Phone verification through the one-time-code screen cannot be completed.

zh-CN.description: 进行手机验证时，JungleWorks 的 Tookan Agent 会要求用户输入一次性验证码，并提供验证和重新发送选项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过一次性验证码页面完成手机验证。

en.description: When an agent opens payout details, JungleWorks' Tookan Agent collects payout account details such as a recipient's name, phone, email, bank account, routing code, or UPI address.
en.disableEffect: Agents cannot add or update payout account details through this screen.

zh-CN.description: 代理人打开收款资料页面时，JungleWorks 的 Tookan Agent 会收集收款人姓名、电话、邮箱、银行账号、银行代码或 UPI 地址等付款资料。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 代理人将无法通过此页面添加或更新收款账户资料。

en.description: When an agent opens the payout section, JungleWorks' Tookan Agent SDK presents payout history and payment-method tabs and returns a selected payout method to the agent workflow.
en.disableEffect: Payout history and payment-method management will be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: 代理人打开付款页面时，JungleWorks 的 Tookan Agent SDK 会以标签页显示付款记录和付款方式，并将所选方式交回代理人流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 付款记录和付款方式管理将无法使用。

en.description: When an agent opens their profile, JungleWorks' Tookan Agent displays an agent's account profile and additional information and allows profile details to be edited and saved.
en.disableEffect: Agents cannot view or update their profile through this screen.

zh-CN.description: 代理人打开个人资料页面时，JungleWorks 的 Tookan Agent 会显示代理人的账户资料和补充信息，并允许用户编辑和保存资料。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 代理人将无法通过此页面查看或更新个人资料。

en.description: JungleWorks' Tookan Agent shows tasks related to a selected task on a map so the agent can review their locations and status.
en.disableEffect: Related tasks cannot be reviewed in the map view.

zh-CN.description: JungleWorks 的 Tookan Agent 会在地图上显示与所选任务相关的任务，供代理人查看位置和状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在地图页面查看关联任务。

en.description: After a ride or task is completed, JungleWorks' Tookan Agent displays the completion page supplied by that workflow inside the app.
en.disableEffect: The completion page for workflows that use this view will not be shown.

zh-CN.description: 行程或任务完成后，JungleWorks 的 Tookan Agent 会在应用内显示该流程提供的完成页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此页面的完成流程将无法显示完成内容。

en.description: When an agent opens the schedule, JungleWorks' Tookan Agent displays an agent's schedule and availability by day, including available, busy, or unavailable periods.
en.disableEffect: Agents cannot view or manage their schedule through this screen.

zh-CN.description: 代理人打开排班页面时，JungleWorks 的 Tookan Agent 会按日期显示代理人的排班和可用状态，包括可用、忙碌或不可用时段。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 代理人将无法通过此页面查看或管理排班。

en.description: While creating or editing a task, JungleWorks' Tookan Agent lets the user search the supplied task templates and return a selection.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot search for or select a task template here.

zh-CN.description: 创建或编辑任务时，JungleWorks 的 Tookan Agent 允许用户搜索提供的任务模板并返回所选模板。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在此页面搜索或选择任务模板。

en.description: When an agent opens settings, JungleWorks' Tookan Agent's settings screen manages choices such as language, map and navigation options, notification sounds, vehicle type, and vibration.
en.disableEffect: Agents cannot change these Tookan Agent settings through the app.

zh-CN.description: 代理人打开设置页面时，JungleWorks 的 Tookan Agent 设置页面用于管理语言、地图和导航选项、通知铃声、车辆类型及振动等设置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 代理人将无法通过应用修改这些 Tookan Agent 设置。

en.description: When a new agent starts sign-up, JungleWorks' Tookan Agent collects account and contact details and submits the sign-up form.
en.disableEffect: New agent accounts cannot be created through this sign-up flow.

zh-CN.description: 新代理人开始注册时，JungleWorks 的 Tookan Agent 会收集账户和联系方式并提交注册表单。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此注册流程创建代理人账户。

en.description: When an agent opens Stripe payout setup, JungleWorks' Tookan Agent's Stripe payout setup collects bank and identity details and submits the required payment and verification information.
en.disableEffect: Stripe payout and identity setup cannot be completed through this screen.

zh-CN.description: 代理人打开 Stripe 收款设置时，JungleWorks 的 Tookan Agent 的 Stripe 付款设置会收集银行和身份资料，并提交付款及核验所需信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此页面完成 Stripe 收款和身份设置。

en.description: When an agent opens Stripe transaction history, JungleWorks' Tookan Agent SDK displays transaction history for the agent's Stripe payout workflow.
en.disableEffect: Stripe payout transactions cannot be reviewed in the agent app.

zh-CN.description: 代理人打开 Stripe 交易记录时，JungleWorks 的 Tookan Agent SDK 会显示代理人 Stripe 收款流程的交易记录。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 代理人将无法在应用中查看 Stripe 收款交易记录。

en.description: When an agent opens a task's subtasks, JungleWorks' Tookan Agent displays the subtasks and required checklist fields for a task and saves the agent's updates.
en.disableEffect: Subtasks and their required checklist fields cannot be completed here.

zh-CN.description: 代理人打开任务的子任务时，JungleWorks 的 Tookan Agent 会显示任务的子任务和必填检查项，并保存代理人的更新。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在此页面完成子任务及其必填检查项。

en.description: When an agent opens an assigned task, JungleWorks' Tookan Agent shows an assigned task's details and map and lets the agent update its status, scan a barcode, and add notes, images, signatures, or other fields.
en.disableEffect: Agents cannot open task details or complete the task actions provided by this screen.

zh-CN.description: 代理人打开已分配任务时，JungleWorks 的 Tookan Agent 会显示已分配任务的详情和地图，供代理人更新状态、扫描条码，以及添加备注、图片、签名或其他字段。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 代理人将无法打开任务详情或完成此页面提供的任务操作。

en.description: After a task is completed, JungleWorks' Tookan Agent summarizes its distance, duration, and earnings and may ask the agent to rate the customer before continuing.
en.disableEffect: The completion summary, earnings details, and any required customer rating cannot be completed.

zh-CN.description: 任务完成后，JungleWorks 的 Tookan Agent 会汇总行驶距离、时长和收入，并可能要求代理人在继续前评价客户。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 任务完成摘要、收入明细以及必需的客户评价将无法完成。

en.description: For a taxi-type task, JungleWorks' Tookan Agent shows the active ride, map, and task-status controls used during the trip.
en.disableEffect: Agents cannot open the active ride screen or update the ride from it.

zh-CN.description: 对于出租车类型的任务，JungleWorks 的 Tookan Agent 会显示进行中的行程、地图和行程状态操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 代理人将无法打开进行中的行程页面或在其中更新行程。

en.description: When an agent starts identity or profile verification, JungleWorks' Tookan Agent collects additional agent or profile verification information and documents and displays pending, successful, or failed verification status.
en.disableEffect: Required identity or profile verification cannot be submitted or reviewed.

zh-CN.description: 代理人开始身份或资料核验时，JungleWorks 的 Tookan Agent 会收集代理人或个人资料所需的补充核验信息和文件，并显示待处理、成功或失败状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法提交或查看必需的身份或资料核验。

en.description: When a task needs a pickup or delivery address, JungleWorks' Tookan Agent opens a map-based picker to search for or choose a location and return it to the task form.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot search for or select task addresses through this map screen.

zh-CN.description: 任务需要取件或送达地址时，JungleWorks 的 Tookan Agent 会打开地图选址页面，供用户搜索或选择地点并返回任务表单。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此地图页面搜索或选择任务地址。

en.description: The JungleWorks' Tookan Agent SDK receives Firebase task messages, refreshes task or location state, and posts task notifications with response actions.
en.disableEffect: Tookan task push alerts and location changes delivered through push will no longer be processed.

zh-CN.description: JungleWorks 的 Tookan Agent SDK 会接收 Firebase 任务消息、刷新任务或定位状态，并发布带有响应操作的任务通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Tookan 任务推送提醒及通过推送发送的定位变更将不再处理。

en.description: JungleWorks' Tookan Agent receives high-accuracy background location batches, saves the latest position, and passes it to the agent's location tracking flow.
en.disableEffect: Background position updates will stop reaching the Tookan Agent tracker, so task locations can become stale.

zh-CN.description: JungleWorks 的 Tookan Agent 会接收高精度后台定位数据，保存最新位置，并将其交给代理人定位流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 后台位置更新将无法传给 Tookan Agent 定位流程，任务位置可能变得过时。

en.description: On a scheduled location check, JungleWorks' Tookan Agent looks for stale GPS readings, requests a location refresh, and can notify the agent when updates are missing.
en.disableEffect: Stale location checks and automatic location refreshes will stop, which can leave task tracking out of date.

zh-CN.description: JungleWorks 的 Tookan Agent 会在定时定位检查时确认 GPS 数据是否过时、请求刷新位置，并可在缺少更新时通知代理人。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 过时定位检查和自动位置刷新将停止，任务跟踪数据可能不再及时。

en.description: JungleWorks' Tookan Agent runs a foreground service to keep the agent's location tracking active while the app is in the background.
en.disableEffect: Background location tracking for agent tasks will stop or be interrupted.

zh-CN.description: JungleWorks 的 Tookan Agent 会运行前台服务，在应用处于后台时保持代理人定位跟踪。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 代理人任务的后台位置跟踪将停止或中断。

en.description: On a scheduled upload, JungleWorks' Tookan Agent sends the saved agent route points and location details to the Tookan service.
en.disableEffect: Saved background route and location updates will no longer be uploaded to Tookan.

zh-CN.description: JungleWorks 的 Tookan Agent 会在定时上传时，将保存的代理人路线点和位置数据发送到 Tookan 服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 保存的后台路线和位置更新将不再上传到 Tookan。

en.description: After the device restarts, JungleWorks' Tookan Agent checks for a saved signed-in session and restarts background location tracking when one exists.
en.disableEffect: Location tracking will not resume automatically after a reboot until the app starts it again.

zh-CN.description: 设备重启后，JungleWorks 的 Tookan Agent 会检查是否保留登录状态，并在已登录时重新启动后台定位跟踪。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 设备重启后，定位跟踪将不会自动恢复，直到应用再次启动该功能。

en.description: When Android reports a change to location-provider availability, JungleWorks' Tookan Agent checks whether GPS is enabled and updates its location state.
en.disableEffect: Tookan Agent will not automatically react to GPS being turned on or off, so location status may be outdated.

zh-CN.description: Android 通知定位服务状态变化时，JungleWorks 的 Tookan Agent 会检查 GPS 是否开启并更新定位状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Tookan Agent 将无法自动响应 GPS 开关变化，定位状态可能不准确。

en.description: JungleWorks' Tookan Agent handles task-notification actions such as accepting, declining, acknowledging, or opening a task when the agent taps a notification control.
en.disableEffect: Task-notification buttons will no longer update or open tasks; agents can still manage tasks from the app's task screens.

zh-CN.description: 代理人点击通知操作时，JungleWorks 的 Tookan Agent 会处理接受、拒绝、确认或打开任务等操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 任务通知按钮将无法更新或打开任务；代理人仍可在应用的任务页面中管理任务。

en.description: JungleWorks' Tookan Agent reacts to motion-state updates and schedules a pause in location tracking after the agent has remained still for five minutes.
en.disableEffect: Motion-based pauses will stop, so background location collection may continue while the agent is still.

zh-CN.description: JungleWorks 的 Tookan Agent 会响应移动状态变化，并在代理人静止五分钟后安排暂停位置跟踪。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 基于移动状态的暂停将停止，因此代理人静止时后台定位可能仍会继续。

en.description: When a task report is exported, JungleWorks' Tookan Agent sends its PDF download to Android's download manager and shows the download notification.
en.disableEffect: Task report PDFs that use this download flow cannot be downloaded.

zh-CN.description: 导出任务报告时，JungleWorks 的 Tookan Agent 会将 PDF 下载交给 Android 下载管理器并显示下载通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此下载流程的任务报告 PDF 将无法下载。

en.description: When the JungleWorks' Tookan Agent workflow starts it, a small draggable shortcut appears over other apps; tapping it returns to the current Tookan screen.
en.disableEffect: The floating return shortcut will no longer appear.

zh-CN.description: JungleWorks 的 Tookan Agent 流程启动此服务时，会在其他应用上显示可拖动的小型快捷入口；点击后可返回当前 Tookan 页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 悬浮返回快捷入口将不再显示。

en.description: When Android starts the app, JungleWorks' Tookan Tracker prepares its tracking feature so location and map screens can use it later.
en.disableEffect: Tookan Tracker screens may fail to initialize if this startup component is disabled.

zh-CN.description: Android 启动应用时，JungleWorks 的 Tookan Tracker 会为后续定位和地图页面准备跟踪功能。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用此启动组件后，Tookan Tracker 页面可能无法初始化。

en.description: On the JungleWorks' Tookan Tracker location-check alarm, this component checks how recently a GPS position arrived and refreshes location requests when updates are stale.
en.disableEffect: Tookan Tracker will stop checking for stale GPS data and refreshing missed location updates.

zh-CN.description: JungleWorks 的 Tookan Tracker 收到定位检查闹钟时，会检查最近一次 GPS 位置的时间，并在数据过时时刷新定位请求。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Tookan Tracker 将停止检查过时 GPS 数据和刷新缺失的位置更新。

en.description: JungleWorks' Tookan Tracker starts background GPS tracking, holds a wake lock while it runs, and schedules a restart while tracking remains enabled.
en.disableEffect: Tookan Tracker's background GPS collection and route reporting will stop or be interrupted.

zh-CN.description: JungleWorks 的 Tookan Tracker 会启动后台 GPS 跟踪，运行期间保持设备唤醒，并在跟踪仍开启时安排重启。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Tookan Tracker 的后台 GPS 采集和路线报告将停止或中断。

en.description: When the host app opens its tracking screen, JungleWorks' Tookan Tracker SDK supplies a live map for a selected agent or task, showing the current position and route while tracking.
en.disableEffect: Disabling this unused Activity registration does not remove the embedded live map from the host app's tracking screen.

zh-CN.description: 宿主应用打开跟踪页面时，JungleWorks 的 Tookan Tracker SDK 会为所选代理人或任务提供实时地图，在跟踪期间显示当前位置和路线。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用未使用的 Activity 注册不会移除宿主应用跟踪页面中的嵌入式实时地图。

en.description: When a task needs a location, JungleWorks' Tookan Agent searches map places and lets the user choose an address to return to the task form.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot search for and select map addresses through the Tookan Agent location picker.

zh-CN.description: 任务需要地点时，JungleWorks 的 Tookan Agent 会搜索地图地点，并允许用户选择地址后返回任务表单。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 Tookan Agent 地点选择页面搜索和选择地图地址。

en.description: When a developer opens Hone's Android developer screen, it shows the app's current tuning values and lets the developer clear or refresh cloud values.
en.disableEffect: Hone's developer screen for inspecting and refreshing tuning values will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: 应用开发者打开 Hone Android 库的开发者界面时，该界面会显示应用当前的调试配置值，并可清除或重新获取云端配置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Hone 的开发者界面将无法打开，开发者不能再通过此界面查看或刷新调试配置。

en.description: ClarkMonitor's JVM memory analyzer starts when the library submits a saved memory snapshot. It checks the snapshot for leaked screens and retained objects, then writes a report in a separate process.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it stops ClarkMonitor from producing JVM leak reports; ordinary app screens do not depend on this separate analysis service.

zh-CN.description: ClarkMonitor 提交保存的内存快照进行分析时，此服务会在独立进程中查找未释放的页面和对象，并生成报告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，ClarkMonitor 不再生成 JVM 内存泄漏报告；应用的日常页面不依赖这项独立分析服务。

en.description: When the app requests a scan with FullJ ZXing Capture, this screen opens the camera viewfinder and reads QR codes or barcodes; it can also scan a chosen image when gallery scanning is enabled.
en.disableEffect: App features that rely on this scanner will not be able to read QR codes or barcodes.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求 FullJ ZXing Capture 扫描时，此界面会打开相机取景并识别二维码或条形码；启用图库扫描时也可识别所选图片。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此扫描器的应用功能将无法识别二维码或条形码。

en.description: Simla-published OpusLib runs when the app sends an audio request; it handles playback, recording, seeking, and Opus file encoding or decoding.
en.disableEffect: Apps using OpusLib will lose its audio playback, recording, and conversion requests.

zh-CN.description: 应用发送音频请求时，Simla 发布的 OpusLib 会处理播放、录音、定位，以及 Opus 文件的编码或解码。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用 OpusLib 的应用将无法通过它播放或录制音频，也无法转换音频文件。

en.description: AndroidBitmapMonitor initializes this provider with the app process and registers to track whether the app has visible screens, so its optional floating diagnostics panel can follow the app's visibility.
en.disableEffect: The app still runs, but the bitmap monitor loses this visibility tracking and its floating panel can no longer follow whether the app is visible.

zh-CN.description: AndroidBitmapMonitor 会随应用进程初始化此内容提供器，并注册应用界面可见状态的跟踪，让可选的悬浮诊断面板随应用显示或隐藏。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用仍可运行，但位图监控器会失去可见状态跟踪，悬浮面板也无法再根据应用是否显示来调整。

en.description: AndroidBitmapMonitor opens this detail screen when a user taps a bitmap record; it shows the image's size, dimensions, creation time, app area, stack details and any saved image.
en.disableEffect: You can no longer inspect a selected bitmap's full details in the monitor, while normal app use remains available.

zh-CN.description: 用户点按位图记录时，AndroidBitmapMonitor 会打开此详情页，显示图片大小、尺寸、创建时间、所在应用界面、调用堆栈信息以及已保存的图片。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 你将无法在监控器中查看所选位图的完整详情，但应用的正常功能仍可使用。

en.description: Tapping the AndroidBitmapMonitor floating panel opens this list, which summarizes created and unreleased bitmap memory and lets users sort outstanding images by size or time.
en.disableEffect: The bitmap record list and memory summary are unavailable, but the app's ordinary features are unaffected.

zh-CN.description: 点按 AndroidBitmapMonitor 的悬浮面板会打开此列表，其中汇总已创建和未回收位图占用的内存，并可按大小或时间排序查看未回收的图片。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 位图记录列表和内存汇总将无法查看，但应用的常规功能不受影响。

en.description: AndroidBitmapMonitor starts this service when its optional floating monitor is enabled and overlay permission is available. The panel shows the current bitmap count and memory use, and a tap opens the record list.
en.disableEffect: The floating bitmap count and memory panel disappears, while the app's ordinary functions continue to work.

zh-CN.description: 启用 AndroidBitmapMonitor 的可选悬浮监控并授予悬浮窗权限后，系统会启动此服务。面板显示当前位图数量和内存占用，点按后会打开记录列表。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 位图数量和内存悬浮面板会消失，应用的常规功能仍可使用。

en.description: IJKPlayer View (Cai Xing Ming) starts this Service when background playback is enabled and keeps the current video player available while the app screen is away. The video view saves and clears that player as background playback starts or stops.
en.disableEffect: Video playback configured for background use may stop or lose its player when this Service is blocked.

zh-CN.description: IJKPlayer View（Cai Xing Ming）在启用后台播放时启动此 Service，并在应用界面离开前台后保留当前视频播放器。视频界面会在后台播放开始或停止时保存或清除该播放器。

en.description: The xdtianyu LibMediaPlayer SDK opens this full-screen Activity when the app starts a video or opens a shared video link, then plays the selected video with playback controls.

zh-CN.description: 应用开始播放视频或打开分享的视频链接时，xdtianyu 的 LibMediaPlayer SDK 会打开此全屏页面，并提供播放控件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户无法通过此播放器打开或观看视频。

en.description: ExtScreen's ad player opens a full-screen Activity for an image ad, loads the image from cache or downloads it, and displays it. It closes if the image cannot be loaded.
en.disableEffect: Image ads handled by ExtScreen will not display.

zh-CN.description: ExtScreen 广告播放器会为图片广告打开全屏 Activity，从缓存读取或下载图片后进行展示。图片无法加载时界面会关闭。
zh-CN.disableEffect: ExtScreen 处理的图片广告将无法显示。

en.description: ExtScreen's ad player opens a full-screen Activity for an ad video, loads the supplied video resource, and plays it. It stops the video when the screen leaves view.
en.disableEffect: Video ads handled by ExtScreen will not play.

zh-CN.description: ExtScreen 广告播放器会为视频广告打开全屏 Activity，加载给定的视频资源并播放；界面离开前台时会停止视频。
zh-CN.disableEffect: ExtScreen 处理的视频广告将无法播放。

en.description: ExtScreen's ad player loads a supplied web address in a full-screen web view and supports back navigation within the page. It is used for web ads and destinations opened from ads.
en.disableEffect: ExtScreen web ads and their landing pages will not open.

zh-CN.description: ExtScreen 广告播放器会在全屏网页视图中加载给定的网址，并支持在页面内返回。它用于展示网页广告及广告打开的落地页。
zh-CN.disableEffect: ExtScreen 网页广告及其落地页将无法打开。

en.description: The SuperAwesome ads SDK shows this safety reminder before sending a viewer from an ad to another app or website. The page includes a short countdown before continuing.

zh-CN.description: SuperAwesome 广告 SDK 在用户从广告跳转到其他应用或网站前显示安全提示，并在继续前短暂倒计时。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 广告跳转流程可能停止，安全提示也不会显示。

en.description: The SuperAwesome ads SDK opens this full-screen page to display an interstitial ad with a close control.

zh-CN.description: SuperAwesome 广告 SDK 打开此全屏页面展示带关闭控件的插屏广告。
zh-CN.disableEffect: SuperAwesome 插屏广告将无法打开。

en.description: This ECPay (綠界科技) Payment Gateway SDK screen opens during an ATM bank-transfer checkout and displays the order payment details. It returns the result to the app when the payment flow ends.
en.disableEffect: ATM payment checkout may not open or return its result to the app.

zh-CN.description: 这是 ECPay（綠界科技）支付网关 SDK 的页面，在 ATM 银行转账结账时显示订单付款信息，并在流程结束后把结果返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，ATM 付款可能无法打开，或无法把结果返回应用。

en.description: This ECPay (綠界科技) Payment Gateway SDK screen handles an ATM bank-transfer checkout in the SDK’s transparent window style. It displays the order payment details and returns the result to the app when the flow ends.
en.disableEffect: ATM payment checkout on this route may not open or return its result to the app.

zh-CN.description: 这是 ECPay（綠界科技）支付网关 SDK 的页面，以透明窗口形式承载 ATM 银行转账流程，显示订单付款信息，并在流程结束后把结果返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，这一路径的 ATM 付款可能无法打开，或无法把结果返回应用。
