zh-CN.description: 用户通过 ECPay 结账时，此页面处理银行卡付款（包括银联）；如银行要求 3-D Secure 验证，也会继续完成验证流程，并把付款结果返回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，银行卡付款或所需的银行验证可能无法打开或完成。

en.description: When a user adds or edits a saved card in the ECPay (綠界科技) Payment Gateway SDK, this screen collects card details such as the number, expiration date, and security code, then submits them.
en.disableEffect: Users may be unable to add or edit a saved payment card through ECPay.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 ECPay 中添加或修改已保存的银行卡时，此页面收集卡号、有效期和安全码等信息并提交卡片资料。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户可能无法通过 ECPay 添加或修改已保存的付款卡片。

en.description: When a user opens saved-card management in the ECPay (綠界科技) Payment Gateway SDK, this screen loads the saved card list and offers actions to add or edit a card.
en.disableEffect: Saved-card management may not open, so users may be unable to review or update cards used for payment.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 ECPay 的已保存银行卡管理页面时，此页面加载卡片列表，并提供添加或修改卡片的入口。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，已保存银行卡管理页面可能无法打开，用户可能无法查看或更新付款卡片。

en.description: When a user chooses convenience-store code or barcode payment in the ECPay (綠界科技) Payment Gateway SDK, this screen displays the order payment instructions and returns the result to the app.
en.disableEffect: Convenience-store code or barcode checkout may fail to open or finish.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 ECPay 中选择便利店代码或条码付款时，此页面显示订单付款说明，并把流程结果返回应用。

zh-CN.description: LiG Player SDK（Light Generation Technology）会在 AR 场景需要连接蓝牙低功耗设备时打开此页面。页面请求蓝牙权限、扫描附近设备，供用户选择并连接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 场景中的蓝牙设备选择和连接功能将无法使用。

en.description: After a LiG Player scene selects a device, this service manages its Bluetooth Low Energy connection and sends connection and device-data updates back to the scene. It discovers device services and reads or subscribes to characteristics, including heart-rate updates when available.
en.disableEffect: Scenes that rely on the selected Bluetooth device will lose its connection and data updates.

zh-CN.description: LiG Player 场景选择设备后，此服务管理蓝牙低功耗连接，并把连接状态和设备数据更新传回场景。它发现设备服务、读取或订阅设备数据；设备支持时也会接收心率更新。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖该蓝牙设备的场景将失去连接和数据更新。

en.description: The MyCard payment SDK uses this Activity during checkout to display MyCard's payment options and collect the purchase result.
en.disableEffect: MyCard checkout may not load or return its payment result.

zh-CN.description: MyCard 付款 SDK 会在结账时使用此 Activity 显示 MyCard 付款选项并获取购买结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，MyCard 结账页面可能无法加载或返回付款结果。

en.description: A MyCard billing link or the app's checkout opens this Activity to show the payment page in a browser and return its result to the app.
en.disableEffect: MyCard payments that require this browser screen may not finish.

zh-CN.description: MyCard 付款链接或应用的结账流程会打开此 Activity，在浏览器界面中显示付款页面并将结果返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 禁用后，需要此浏览器页面的 MyCard 付款可能无法完成。

en.description: The Artcodes Scanner SDK (Horizon Institute / University of Nottingham) opens the camera to scan Artcode markers for an experience. When it recognizes a marker, it opens the experience’s configured link with the code or returns the code to the calling app.
en.disableEffect: The app will not be able to scan Artcodes markers or open the linked experience from this screen.

zh-CN.description: Artcodes Scanner SDK（Horizon Institute / University of Nottingham）会打开相机，为某个体验扫描 Artcode 图案码。识别后，它会打开该体验配置的链接并附上代码，或把代码返回调用它的应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法通过此页面扫描 Artcode 图案码或打开关联体验。

en.description: BanDev Unexpected Exception Handler opens this screen after an uncaught app error. It shows the exception details and stack trace and offers actions to copy them, report the issue, or reopen the app.
en.disableEffect: The SDK’s crash details and copy, report, and relaunch screen will not appear after an uncaught error.

zh-CN.description: BanDev Unexpected Exception Handler（意外异常处理）会在应用发生未捕获错误后打开此页面，显示异常信息和堆栈，并提供复制、提交问题和重新打开应用的操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 发生未捕获错误后，SDK 的崩溃详情、复制、报告和重新打开应用页面将不会显示。

en.description: BanDev Unexpected Exception Handler binds this service during app startup to receive uncaught-error details and open its crash screen. It runs for error reporting rather than the app’s normal screens.
en.disableEffect: Normal app features remain available, but the SDK will not show its crash details and recovery/reporting screen after an uncaught error.

zh-CN.description: BanDev Unexpected Exception Handler 会在应用启动时绑定此服务，用它接收未捕获错误的信息并打开崩溃页面。它用于错误报告，不参与应用的日常页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用日常功能仍可使用，但发生未捕获错误后，SDK 不会显示崩溃详情及恢复或报告页面。

en.description: The InnoExtract Android library (Alan Woolley) binds this service when an app checks or extracts an Inno Setup installer. It validates the input and extracts its contents to a file or folder destination while reporting progress.
en.disableEffect: The app will not be able to validate or extract Inno Setup installer files through this library.

zh-CN.description: InnoExtract Android 库（Alan Woolley）会在应用检查或解压 Inno Setup 安装文件时绑定此服务。它校验输入文件，并将内容解压到文件或文件夹位置，同时报告进度。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法通过此库校验或解压 Inno Setup 安装文件。

en.description: CITCON's UPI payment SDK uses this screen to receive the result when a WeChat Pay handoff returns. It reports the order's success or failure to the UPI checkout.
en.disableEffect: The UPI checkout will not receive WeChat Pay results and may remain unfinished.

zh-CN.disableEffect: UPI 结账流程将收不到微信支付结果，可能无法完成。

zh-CN.description: 参与者在会议中通过摄像头控制调整画面效果时，Zoom Meeting SDK 会打开此页面并显示可用的视频效果选项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 参与者将无法打开会议中的视频效果控制页面。

en.description: The Zoom Meeting SDK opens this Activity when a user opens comments for a one-to-one or group conversation. It displays the selected message thread and its comments.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open the corresponding chat comment thread.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开单人或群组会话的评论时，Zoom Meeting SDK 会显示所选消息线程及其评论。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开相应的聊天评论线程。

en.description: The Zoom Meeting SDK opens this Activity when the meeting or webinar Q&A page is selected. It displays the requested question-and-answer screen within the meeting context.
en.disableEffect: Hosts and attendees cannot open the SDK Q&A screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户在会议或网络研讨会中打开问答页面时，Zoom Meeting SDK 会在当前会议上下文中显示所选的问答界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 主持人和参会者将无法打开 SDK 的问答页面。

en.description: The Zoom Meeting SDK opens this Activity when a user creates or edits a customized 3D avatar for video. It provides avatar choices and a live preview before the user saves changes.
en.disableEffect: The custom 3D avatar editor will not open.

zh-CN.description: 用户为视频创建或编辑自定义 3D 虚拟形象时，Zoom Meeting SDK 会打开此页面，供用户选择形象、预览并保存更改。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 自定义 3D 虚拟形象编辑器将无法打开。

en.description: The Zoom Meeting SDK opens this Activity when its built-in documentation page is requested. It loads Zoom documentation inside the app.
en.disableEffect: Only the in-app SDK documentation page becomes unavailable; meeting and chat features remain available.

zh-CN.description: 用户请求查看 Zoom Meeting SDK 内置文档时，Zoom Meeting SDK 会在应用中加载 Zoom 文档页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用内的 SDK 文档页面将无法使用，但会议和聊天功能仍可使用。

en.description: The Zoom Meeting SDK opens this Activity when a user requests the My Notes feature. It displays the notes page and connects it to the notes service.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open or review notes through this Zoom screen.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开我的笔记功能时，Zoom Meeting SDK 会显示笔记页面并连接笔记服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此 Zoom 页面打开或查看笔记。

en.description: The Zoom Meeting SDK opens this Activity when a user opens the in-meeting whiteboard dashboard. It shows the available whiteboard and board-opening options.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open the meeting whiteboard dashboard or start a board from it.

zh-CN.description: 用户在会议中打开白板面板时，Zoom Meeting SDK 会显示可用的白板及打开选项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开会议白板面板或从中启动白板。

en.description: The Zoom Meeting SDK opens this Activity when a user opens a whiteboard or a specific board in a meeting. It displays the board dashboard or selected whiteboard canvas.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open or continue using whiteboards in a meeting.

zh-CN.description: 用户在会议中打开白板或指定白板时，Zoom Meeting SDK 会显示白板面板或所选白板画布。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在会议中打开或继续使用白板。

en.description: The Zoom Meeting SDK opens this Activity when it needs to show a privacy disclosure for a feature. It displays the notice and lets the user respond before continuing.
en.disableEffect: A feature that requires this disclosure may not be able to continue because its notice cannot be shown.

zh-CN.description: 某项功能需要展示隐私说明时，Zoom Meeting SDK 会打开此页面，并在继续前让用户查看和回应说明。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 由于无法显示隐私说明，需要该说明的功能可能无法继续。

en.description: The Zoom Meeting SDK opens this Activity for its in-person meeting flow. It displays that meeting screen and handles its permission and return events.
en.disableEffect: The SDK in-person meeting flow will be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: Zoom Meeting SDK 会在使用线下会议流程时打开此页面，并处理会议界面、权限和返回结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: SDK 的线下会议流程将无法使用。

en.description: The Zoom Meeting SDK opens this Activity when a user views the participants in a meeting. It displays the meeting participant list and its available controls.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open the meeting participant list.

zh-CN.description: 用户查看会议参会者时，Zoom Meeting SDK 会打开此页面显示参会者列表及相关控制项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开会议参会者列表。

en.description: The Zoom Meeting SDK opens this Activity when a user selects a file for a meeting or chat action. It lists files of the requested types and returns the chosen file.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot select files through the SDK file picker for meeting or chat sharing.

zh-CN.description: 用户为会议或聊天操作选择文件时，Zoom Meeting SDK 会列出指定类型的文件并返回用户选中的文件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 SDK 文件选择器为会议或聊天共享文件。

en.description: The Zoom Meeting SDK opens this Activity when a user adds a photo to a chat message. It lets the user choose a photo to attach.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot choose photos to attach to Zoom chat messages.

zh-CN.description: 用户在聊天消息中添加照片时，Zoom Meeting SDK 会打开此页面供用户选择要附加的照片。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法选择照片并附加到 Zoom 聊天消息中。

en.description: The Zoom Meeting SDK opens this Activity when a user opens a meeting chat conversation. It displays the conversation thread and its messages.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open the meeting chat conversation.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开会议聊天会话时，Zoom Meeting SDK 会显示该会话及其中的消息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开会议聊天会话。

en.description: The Zoom Meeting SDK opens this Activity when a user opens comments on a message in meeting chat. It displays the selected comment thread.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open comments on meeting chat messages.

zh-CN.description: 用户查看会议聊天消息的评论时，Zoom Meeting SDK 会显示所选评论线程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法查看会议聊天消息的评论。

en.description: The Zoom Meeting SDK opens this Activity when a user edits a picture before sending it in meeting chat. It provides the image-editing screen for the selected picture.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot edit pictures in meeting chat before sending them.

zh-CN.description: 用户在会议聊天中发送图片前进行编辑时，Zoom Meeting SDK 会打开此页面显示图片编辑工具。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在会议聊天发送图片前进行编辑。

en.description: The Zoom Meeting SDK opens this Activity when a user crops a picture for a meeting chat message. It displays the crop controls for that picture.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot crop pictures with the meeting chat editor.

zh-CN.description: 用户为会议聊天消息裁剪图片时，Zoom Meeting SDK 会显示该图片的裁剪工具。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法使用会议聊天编辑器裁剪图片。

en.description: The Zoom Meeting SDK opens this Activity when a user browses images in a meeting chat conversation. It displays the conversation image list.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot browse the image list from meeting chat.

zh-CN.description: 用户浏览会议聊天会话中的图片时，Zoom Meeting SDK 会显示该会话的图片列表。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法浏览会议聊天中的图片列表。

en.description: The CustomOnCrash crash-reporting library shows this screen after routing an app error to its handler; it displays error details and offers restart, copy, and email actions.
en.disableEffect: The crash details and recovery screen will not appear after an app error; normal app use is unaffected.

zh-CN.description: CustomOnCrash 崩溃报告库将应用错误交给处理器后会显示此界面，其中包含错误详情以及重启、复制和发送邮件的选项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用发生错误后将不再显示崩溃详情和恢复界面；正常使用不受影响。

en.description: The AppDaemon background-service library receives its restart broadcast in a separate process and starts the configured service when the broadcast requests recovery.
en.disableEffect: AppDaemon will no longer restart the configured service in response to that broadcast.

zh-CN.description: AppDaemon 后台服务库在独立进程中接收重启广播，并在广播请求恢复时启动已配置的服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: AppDaemon 将无法再根据该广播重新启动已配置的服务。

en.description: The AppDaemon background-service library runs this service in its own process, checks whether a configured service is alive, and starts it again when missing.
en.disableEffect: Apps relying on AppDaemon to keep a background service running may lose its automatic restart.

zh-CN.description: AppDaemon 后台服务库在独立进程中运行此服务，检查已配置的服务是否存活，并在服务停止后重新启动它。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖 AppDaemon 保持后台服务运行的应用将失去自动重启功能。

en.description: Ipak Yuli Bank's acquiring library opens this screen with a field for entering a bank-card number.
en.disableEffect: The app's card-entry or acquiring screen will not open.

zh-CN.description: Ipak Yuli Bank 收单库会打开此页面，供用户输入银行卡号。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用的银行卡输入或收单页面将无法打开。

en.description: MetaOne Wallet SDK opens this Activity for wallet browsing and links; it displays websites, connects a selected wallet, and lets users review requests to sign.
en.disableEffect: Users will lose the SDK's browser and its wallet-link signing flows.

zh-CN.description: MetaOne 钱包 SDK 通过此 Activity 打开网页和钱包链接，并连接所选钱包、展示待签名请求供用户确认。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法使用 SDK 浏览器及其中的钱包链接签名流程。

en.description: This MetaOne Wallet Activity appears when the SDK asks the user to review a wallet transaction; it displays the request and handles confirmation or cancellation.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to approve or reject transactions through this confirmation screen.

zh-CN.description: SDK 请求用户检查钱包交易时，MetaOne 钱包的此 Activity 会展示请求并处理确认或取消。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此确认界面批准或拒绝交易。

en.description: When a MetaOne wallet needs a new authorization code, this Activity guides the user through setting and confirming it.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to finish the SDK's wallet-code setup flow.

zh-CN.description: MetaOne 钱包需要设置新的授权码时，此 Activity 会引导用户设置并确认该密码。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法完成 SDK 的钱包授权码设置流程。

en.description: When MetaOne receives a token-send request, this Activity shows the amount, destination, and network details for the user to approve or reject.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to review or confirm token sends through this screen.

zh-CN.description: MetaOne 收到代币转账请求时，此 Activity 会展示金额、收款地址和网络信息，供用户批准或拒绝。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此界面检查或确认代币转账。

en.description: When a website requests a contract transaction in MetaOne's browser, this Activity shows transaction and network details so the user can approve or reject it.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to review or confirm browser contract transactions through this screen.

zh-CN.description: 网站在 MetaOne 浏览器中请求合约交易时，此 Activity 会展示交易和网络信息，供用户批准或拒绝。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此界面检查或确认浏览器中的合约交易。

en.description: When the MetaOne browser receives a contract-transaction request, this Activity shows its details for the user to approve or reject.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to review or confirm these browser transactions through this screen.

zh-CN.description: MetaOne 浏览器收到合约交易请求时，此 Activity 会展示交易详情，供用户批准或拒绝。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过此界面检查或确认此类浏览器交易。

en.description: The older MetaOne SDK home screen offers a way into the wallet and lets users choose a light, dark, or blue appearance.
en.disableEffect: Users lose this optional home and theme screen; the wallet itself has a separately registered screen.

zh-CN.description: 旧版 MetaOne SDK 的主页提供进入钱包的入口，并允许用户选择浅色、深色或蓝色外观。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法使用此可选主页和主题设置界面；钱包本身另有单独注册的界面。

en.description: When a MetaOne user changes the wallet authorization code, this Activity guides the user through entering and confirming the replacement.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to complete the SDK's wallet-code reset flow.

zh-CN.description: MetaOne 用户修改钱包授权码时，此 Activity 会引导用户输入并确认新密码。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法完成 SDK 的钱包授权码重置流程。

en.description: After an SDK signing request fails, this Activity displays the failure result and lets the user return to the wallet.
en.disableEffect: Users will lose the visible failure result for a signing request.

zh-CN.description: SDK 签名请求失败后，此 Activity 会显示失败结果，并允许用户返回钱包。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法看到签名请求失败的提示界面。

en.description: When a website asks MetaOne to sign a message, this Activity presents the request for the user to approve or cancel.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to review or approve message-signing requests.

zh-CN.description: 网站请求 MetaOne 对消息签名时，此 Activity 会展示请求，供用户批准或取消。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法检查或批准消息签名请求。

en.description: After MetaOne completes a signing request, this Activity displays a success result and returns the user to the wallet.
en.disableEffect: Users will lose the visible completion result for a signing request.

zh-CN.description: MetaOne 完成签名请求后，此 Activity 会显示成功结果并带用户返回钱包。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法看到签名请求完成后的结果提示。

en.description: When MetaOne requires email verification, this Activity lets users complete the email-check step for their account.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to finish the SDK's email verification flow.

zh-CN.description: MetaOne 要求验证邮箱时，此 Activity 会让用户完成账户邮箱验证步骤。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法完成 SDK 的邮箱验证流程。

en.description: MetaOne Wallet SDK opens this Activity to show its wallet interface and handle web-page navigation and file selection within the wallet.
en.disableEffect: Users will lose access to the SDK's wallet screen and its in-wallet web interactions.

zh-CN.description: MetaOne 钱包 SDK 通过此 Activity 展示钱包界面，并处理钱包内网页浏览和文件选择。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法进入 SDK 钱包界面或使用其中的网页交互。

en.description: When the app opens the InAd Network offer wall, this Activity loads promoted app offers and lets users open the advertised app or page; it also records clicks and checks completed installs.
en.disableEffect: The offer wall and its install offers disappear, and users will no longer earn credits for completing those offers.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开 InAd Network 任务墙时，此 Activity 会加载推广应用的任务，并允许用户打开广告中的应用或页面；它还会记录点击并检查安装是否完成。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 任务墙及其中的安装任务将消失，用户也无法再通过完成这些任务获得积分。

en.description: At scheduled InAd offer checks, this Receiver starts a background check when the network is available or schedules another check when it is not.
en.disableEffect: InAd’s background offer-install checks stop, so completed offers may not be credited.

zh-CN.description: 到达 InAd 任务检查时间时，此接收器会在网络可用时启动后台检查，网络不可用时则安排再次检查。
zh-CN.disableEffect: InAd 的后台任务安装检查将停止，已完成的任务可能无法获得积分。

en.description: When Android reports that a new app was installed, this InAd Receiver starts a check to see whether the install completes a promoted app offer.
en.disableEffect: InAd may miss completed app-install offers and fail to award their credits.

zh-CN.description: Android 通知有新应用安装时，此 InAd 接收器会启动检查，以确认该安装是否完成了推广任务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: InAd 可能无法识别已完成的应用安装任务，也不会发放相应积分。

en.description: When Android reports that an app was uninstalled, this InAd Receiver removes the matching app from the offer wall’s saved install records.
en.disableEffect: The offer wall may retain stale records for apps that have been removed, making offer status inaccurate.

zh-CN.description: Android 通知有应用卸载时，此 InAd 接收器会从任务墙的安装记录中删除对应应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 任务墙可能保留已卸载应用的过期记录，导致任务状态不准确。

en.description: InAd checks whether apps saved from its offer wall have been installed, reports completed installs, and sends the related offer-credit event to the app.
en.disableEffect: InAd will no longer verify or credit app-install offers.

zh-CN.description: InAd 会检查任务墙记录的应用是否已安装，报告已完成的安装，并将相应的任务积分事件发送给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: InAd 将不再核实或发放应用安装任务的积分。

en.description: The myG game SDK opens a titled web page inside its account flow, including the password-change page from sign-in.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to open myG account pages such as password change.

zh-CN.description: myG 游戏 SDK 会在账号流程中打开带标题的网页，包括登录页面里的修改密码页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，用户将无法打开 myG 提供的修改密码等账号网页。

en.description: The myG game SDK displays account sign-in and registration, including password, Facebook, and Google sign-in.
en.disableEffect: Players will not be able to use myG sign-in or registration.

zh-CN.description: myG 游戏 SDK 会显示账号登录和注册界面，并提供密码、Facebook 和 Google 登录方式。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，玩家无法使用 myG 登录或注册账号。

en.description: myG turns incoming game messages into phone notifications; tapping one opens the game or a link from the message.
en.disableEffect: Notifications handled by this older myG push flow will no longer appear.

zh-CN.description: myG 会将收到的游戏消息显示为手机通知；点开通知后可返回游戏或打开消息中的链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，此 myG 推送流程将不再显示通知。

en.description: myG registers refreshed Firebase device tokens with its notification service so push messages can be delivered.
en.disableEffect: myG may stop receiving push messages after Firebase changes the device token.

zh-CN.description: Firebase 更新设备推送令牌时，myG 会将新令牌登记到自己的通知服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，Firebase 更新令牌时 myG 可能收不到新令牌，相关推送也可能无法送达。

en.description: myG receives Firebase game messages and displays their title and text as phone notifications using the app icon.
en.disableEffect: These myG push notifications will no longer appear on the device.

zh-CN.description: myG 会接收 Firebase 游戏消息，并使用应用图标将标题和内容显示为手机通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，这些 myG 推送通知将不会显示。

en.description: When a myG notification is tapped, this receiver opens the game or the link included with the message and dismisses the notification.
en.disableEffect: Tapping myG notifications will no longer open the game or their linked pages.

zh-CN.description: 用户点开 myG 通知时，此接收器会打开游戏或消息附带的链接，并关闭该通知。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，点开 myG 通知将无法跳转到游戏或相关网页。

en.description: myG displays the player’s balance and payment options here, then returns the payment result to the game.
en.disableEffect: The game’s myG payment and top-up screen will not open.

zh-CN.description: myG 会在此显示玩家余额和支付方式，并将支付结果返回给游戏。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，游戏内的 myG 充值和支付页面将无法打开。

en.description: myG loads the signed-in player’s bank-payment page inside the app for purchases.
en.disableEffect: Players will not be able to pay by bank through myG.

zh-CN.description: myG 会在应用内加载已登录玩家的银行卡支付页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，玩家将无法通过 myG 使用银行卡支付。

en.description: myG starts the selected in-app purchase through Google Play and reports its result to the game.
en.disableEffect: Players will not be able to buy the selected game items through Google Play.

zh-CN.description: myG 会通过 Google Play 为玩家启动所选游戏商品的应用内购买，并将结果通知游戏。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，玩家将无法通过 Google Play 购买所选游戏商品。

en.description: myG opens the web checkout for a purchase and returns its success result to the payment screen.
en.disableEffect: Players will not be able to complete these myG web payments.

zh-CN.description: myG 会打开订单对应的网页收银台，并将支付成功结果返回充值页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，玩家将无法完成这类 myG 网页支付。

en.description: myG saves campaign details from Google Play install-referrer messages and passes them to Google campaign tracking.
en.disableEffect: myG install-source details will no longer be saved or passed to campaign tracking.

zh-CN.description: myG 会保存 Google Play 安装来源中的推广信息，并将其交给 Google 安装推广跟踪功能。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，myG 的安装来源信息将不会保存或转交给推广跟踪功能。

en.description: myG opens the player account center with configured pages such as profile, inbox, transaction history, support, game offers, and invitations.
en.disableEffect: Players will lose access to the myG account center, including its profile and transaction pages.

zh-CN.description: myG 会打开玩家账号中心，并按应用配置显示个人资料、收件箱、交易记录、客服、游戏推荐或邀请页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，玩家将无法打开 myG 账号中心及其中的个人资料和交易记录页面。

en.description: When the app opens a conversation, the Tiki Android Chat SDK creates the chat screen and passes it the conversation address and any attachment supplied by the app.
en.disableEffect: Users cannot open this conversation screen, so the app's in-app chat feature is unavailable.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开会话时，Tiki Android Chat SDK 会创建聊天页面，并接收应用传入的会话地址和附件。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户无法打开此会话页面，应用内聊天功能会不可用。

en.description: When a user opens a Tiki chat link, the Tiki Android Chat SDK converts it into a chat page address and opens that conversation.
en.disableEffect: Tiki chat links cannot open their conversation in the app.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 Tiki 聊天链接时，Tiki Android Chat SDK 会将链接转换为聊天页面地址并打开对应会话。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Tiki 聊天链接无法在应用中打开对应会话。

en.description: When a user opens a Tiki chat link from outside the app, the Tiki Android Chat SDK passes the link to the app's launch screen so it can open the matching conversation.
en.disableEffect: External Tiki chat links cannot route the user into the requested conversation.

zh-CN.description: 用户从应用外打开 Tiki 聊天链接时，Tiki Android Chat SDK 会将链接交给应用入口，以便继续打开对应会话。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，外部 Tiki 聊天链接无法将用户带入指定会话。

en.description: When a user opens a Tiki chat link, the Tiki Android Chat SDK converts it and sends the resulting chat address to the app for handling.
en.disableEffect: The app does not receive chat links through this path, so those links cannot open their conversation.

zh-CN.description: 用户打开 Tiki 聊天链接时，Tiki Android Chat SDK 会转换链接，并将生成的聊天地址发送给应用处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用无法通过此入口接收聊天链接，因此无法打开对应会话。

en.description: The AHEL socket library runs a separate-process service for TCP connections requested by the app. It relays connection status and received messages between app clients and those connections.
en.disableEffect: App features that rely on this library for live socket messages may lose their connection.

zh-CN.description: AHEL 套接字库会在独立进程中为应用请求的 TCP 连接运行服务，并在应用客户端与连接之间转发连接状态和收到的消息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖此库实时套接字消息的应用功能可能会断开连接。

en.description: When Mapp Engage broadcasts a user's identifier to Mapp Intelligence, this receiver stores it so analytics events can be associated with that user.
en.disableEffect: Mapp Engage and Mapp Intelligence will stop sharing this user identifier.

zh-CN.description: Mapp Engage 向 Mapp Intelligence 广播用户标识时，此接收器会保存标识，以便将分析事件关联到该用户。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Mapp Engage 与 Mapp Intelligence 将无法再共享此用户标识。

en.description: When Mapp Intelligence sends an alias update through the Mapp event broadcast, this receiver saves the alias for Mapp Intelligence.
en.disableEffect: Alias changes sent from Mapp events will no longer be saved by Mapp Intelligence.

zh-CN.description: Mapp Intelligence 通过 Mapp 事件广播发送别名更新时，此接收器会为 Mapp Intelligence 保存该别名。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Mapp 事件发送的别名变更将不再由 Mapp Intelligence 保存。

en.description: Wigzo’s messaging SDK opens this Activity when a push message is tapped or displayed while the app is open; it shows the message and follows its configured app link or review action.
en.disableEffect: Wigzo push message dialogs and their app links or review prompts will no longer open.

zh-CN.description: 用户点开 Wigzo 推送，或应用打开时收到推送，Wigzo 消息 SDK 会显示此 Activity；它展示消息，并按推送设置打开应用页面或评价入口。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Wigzo 推送的消息窗口、应用链接和评价入口将无法打开。

en.description: Wigzo’s real-time messaging SDK uses this Receiver for Google cloud push broadcasts and forwards received messages to Wigzo’s message service.
en.disableEffect: Wigzo push campaigns will no longer be received by this app; the app’s other features remain available.

zh-CN.description: Wigzo 实时消息 SDK 使用此 Receiver 接收 Google 云推送广播，并把收到的消息交给 Wigzo 消息服务处理。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法接收 Wigzo 推送活动消息，但其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: Wigzo’s messaging SDK starts this Service after a push arrives; it checks the message and posts a notification, or opens the message in a dialog when the app is already open.
en.disableEffect: Wigzo push notifications and in-app message prompts will stop appearing.

zh-CN.description: Wigzo 消息 SDK 在收到推送后启动此 Service；它检查消息内容并发布通知，或在应用已打开时显示消息窗口。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Wigzo 推送通知和应用内消息提示将不再显示。

en.description: Wigzo’s push SDK opens this Activity when a user taps a notification; it records the open and takes the user to the configured app screen or web link.
en.disableEffect: Wigzo push notification links will no longer open their configured destination.

zh-CN.description: 用户点开推送通知时，Wigzo 推送 SDK 会启动此 Activity；它记录通知已打开，并跳转到设置的应用页面或网页。
zh-CN.disableEffect: Wigzo 推送通知将无法打开其指定页面或网页。

en.description: Google Play services starts this Wigzo Service when the push registration token changes; it clears the old registration state and starts registration again.
en.disableEffect: Wigzo push delivery may stop after a token change, while the app’s other features remain available.

zh-CN.description: 推送注册令牌发生变化时，Google Play 服务会启动 Wigzo 的此 Service；它清除旧注册状态并重新注册。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 令牌变化后，Wigzo 推送可能无法继续送达，但应用的其他功能仍可使用。

en.description: Wigzo’s push SDK starts this Service after registration changes to obtain the Google push token, send it with device and organization details to Wigzo, and subscribe the device to its push topic.
en.disableEffect: The app may stop receiving Wigzo push messages or have its device registration out of date.

zh-CN.description: Wigzo 推送 SDK 在注册状态变化后启动此 Service，获取 Google 推送令牌，将令牌和设备、组织信息发送给 Wigzo，并订阅对应的推送主题。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用可能无法收到 Wigzo 推送，或设备注册信息无法更新。

en.description: Mappable MapKit runs this scheduled job to notify the app when network connectivity changes. The SDK’s map and navigation features can then refresh their online or offline state.
en.disableEffect: Map and navigation features may not respond correctly when connectivity is lost or restored.

zh-CN.description: Mappable MapKit 会在系统调度此任务时通知应用网络连接状态发生变化，让 SDK 的地图和导航功能更新在线或离线状态。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 网络断开或恢复时，地图和导航功能可能无法正确响应。

en.description: Shanya SerialPort opens this screen to search for paired and nearby Bluetooth devices. Choosing a device starts a BLE or classic Bluetooth connection.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to discover and connect Bluetooth devices through the SerialPort screen.

zh-CN.description: Shanya SerialPort 会通过此界面搜索已配对和附近的蓝牙设备；选择设备后会建立 BLE 或经典蓝牙连接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法通过 SerialPort 界面发现并连接蓝牙设备。

en.description: While a Shanya SerialPort Bluetooth server connection is active, this service reads incoming data from the connected device and sends it to the app's receive callback.
en.disableEffect: The app will stop receiving data from devices connected through SerialPort server mode.

zh-CN.description: Shanya SerialPort 蓝牙服务端连接处于活动状态时，此服务会读取设备发来的数据并交给应用的接收回调。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法接收通过 SerialPort 服务端模式连接的设备数据。

en.description: While a Shanya SerialPort classic Bluetooth connection is active, this service reads incoming data and reports it to the app as text or hexadecimal bytes.
en.disableEffect: The app will stop receiving data over classic Bluetooth serial connections.

zh-CN.description: Shanya SerialPort 经典蓝牙连接处于活动状态时，此服务会读取设备数据，并以文本或十六进制字节形式交给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将无法通过经典蓝牙串口连接接收设备数据。

en.description: WormholeLogger uses this provider at app startup to initialize its logging client and connect to the optional cloud-logging service.
en.disableEffect: The app can still run, but WormholeLogger will not connect its client for cloud log forwarding.

zh-CN.description: WormholeLogger 会在应用启动时通过此 Provider 初始化日志客户端，并连接可选的云端日志服务。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用仍可运行，但 WormholeLogger 将无法连接日志客户端并转发云端日志。

en.description: When a WormholeLogger client binds, this service accepts log messages and passes them to a handler that buffers and uploads them through Firebase.
en.disableEffect: App features remain available, but WormholeLogger messages will not reach its cloud logging service.

zh-CN.description: WormholeLogger 客户端绑定后，此服务会接收日志消息并交给处理器暂存和通过 Firebase 上传。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用功能仍可使用，但 WormholeLogger 日志将无法发送到云端日志服务。

en.description: Luoqqsh's DialogDialog Provider exposes local files as shareable links and initializes the library's application context when Android starts app providers.
en.disableEffect: Disabling it removes DialogDialog's startup context setup and file-sharing path, which can break library features or initialization.

zh-CN.description: Luoqqsh 的 DialogDialog Provider 将本地文件转换为可分享链接，并在 Android 启动应用 Provider 时初始化该库的应用上下文。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，DialogDialog 的启动上下文设置和文件分享路径会失效，可能导致库功能或初始化出错。

en.description: Luoqqsh's DialogDialog starts this Service when its optional step-count helper is requested. It listens for step-counter readings and writes them to the library log.
en.disableEffect: The optional step readings from this helper will no longer be collected or logged.

zh-CN.description: Luoqqsh 的 DialogDialog 在调用可选的计步功能时启动此 Service。它监听计步传感器数据并将读数写入库日志。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，此辅助功能将不再采集或记录步数。

en.description: Luoqqsh's DialogDialog opens this Activity for file or media selection and preview flows. It displays the picker or preview screen requested by the app.
en.disableEffect: DialogDialog file/media selection and preview flows will fail to open.

zh-CN.description: Luoqqsh 的 DialogDialog 在文件或媒体选择、预览流程中打开此 Activity。它会显示应用请求的选择器或预览页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，DialogDialog 的文件或媒体选择及预览流程将无法打开。

en.description: Luoqqsh's DialogDialog starts and binds to this Service for background file downloads. It reports progress in a notification and can offer an install action when a downloaded app package finishes.
en.disableEffect: File downloads, their progress notifications, and any app-package installation flow using this Service will stop working.

zh-CN.description: Luoqqsh 的 DialogDialog 通过此 Service 执行后台文件下载。它会在通知中显示进度，并可在应用安装包下载完成后提供安装操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，文件下载、进度通知以及使用此 Service 的应用安装流程将无法工作。

en.description: Luoqqsh's DialogDialog opens this Activity when a library feature requests Android permissions or document access. It shows the permission flow and returns the result to the requester.
en.disableEffect: Permission requests cannot complete, so DialogDialog features that need those permissions or document access may fail.

zh-CN.description: Luoqqsh 的 DialogDialog 在库功能申请 Android 权限或文档访问权限时打开此 Activity。它显示权限申请流程，并将结果返回给请求方。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 权限申请将无法完成，因此依赖这些权限或文档访问的 DialogDialog 功能可能失效。

en.description: When the Moloco Android ad renderer displays an interactive ad, this Activity shows it full screen and handles its orientation and close controls.
en.disableEffect: Interactive ads using this renderer will not display.

zh-CN.description: Moloco Android 广告渲染器展示互动广告时，此页面会全屏显示广告并处理屏幕方向和关闭操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此渲染器的互动广告将无法显示。

en.description: When the Moloco Android ad renderer presents a static ad, this Activity shows the ad full screen and handles ad taps or closing.
en.disableEffect: Static ads using this renderer will not display.

zh-CN.description: Moloco Android 广告渲染器展示静态广告时，此页面会全屏显示广告并处理点击或关闭操作。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此渲染器的静态广告将无法显示。

en.description: When the Moloco Android ad renderer presents a video ad, this Activity plays it full screen and closes when the ad finishes or is dismissed.
en.disableEffect: Video ads using this renderer will not display.

zh-CN.description: Moloco Android 广告渲染器展示视频广告时，此页面会全屏播放广告，并在播放结束或关闭后退出。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此渲染器的视频广告将无法显示。

en.description: AppInform opens its web-based guided tour in this screen using the tour address and identity details supplied by the app. It appears when the app requests an onboarding guide.
en.disableEffect: Guided tours will not open, and an app request to launch one may fail.

zh-CN.description: AppInform 会在此界面打开网页引导，使用应用提供的引导地址和身份信息。应用请求显示新手引导时会启动此界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 引导流程将无法打开，应用启动引导的请求也可能失败。

en.description: ComposeHooks opens Android’s biometric prompt when an app requests biometric verification. It passes the authentication result back to the calling flow.
en.disableEffect: Apps using this hook may be unable to complete biometric sign-in or unlock.

zh-CN.description: 应用请求生物识别验证时，ComposeHooks 会打开 Android 生物识别提示，并将验证结果返回给调用流程。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 使用此功能的应用可能无法完成生物识别登录或解锁。

en.description: Junerver FileSelector opens a local file browser, requests the required storage access, and returns the files the user selects. Apps start it when a user chooses files to attach or import.
en.disableEffect: The app’s file-picking or import flow may fail.

zh-CN.description: Junerver 文件选择器会打开本地文件浏览界面、请求所需的存储访问权限，并返回用户选中的文件。用户选择要附加或导入的文件时，应用会启动此界面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用的文件选择或导入流程可能失败。

en.description: Junerver's update library initializes this provider at app startup and checks for update information when the configured app screen resumes.
en.disableEffect: The app will stop receiving automatic update checks from this library; its normal screens remain available.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动时，Junerver 更新库会初始化此内容提供程序，并在配置的应用界面恢复时检查更新信息。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用将不再收到此库的自动更新检查，但正常界面仍可使用。

en.description: The Junerver Utils Android utility library starts this Provider when Android initializes the app's content providers; it initializes the utility library and supplies app-scoped file links for file operations.
en.disableEffect: Utility functions that rely on its startup setup or file links, including file sharing and app installation helpers, can fail or crash.

zh-CN.description: Android 初始化应用的内容提供程序时，Junerver Utils 工具库会启动此 Provider；它负责初始化工具库，并为文件操作提供应用内的文件访问链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 停用后，依赖其初始化或文件访问链接的工具功能（包括文件分享和应用安装辅助功能）可能失败，甚至导致应用崩溃。

en.description: The Junerver Utils Android utility library briefly opens this Activity for runtime permission requests and other operations that need to return a result to the app.
en.disableEffect: Apps that rely on these helpers may lose permission prompts or returned results, which can block permission-dependent features.

zh-CN.description: Junerver Utils 工具库会在申请运行时权限或需要向应用返回操作结果时短暂打开此 Activity。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 依赖这些辅助功能的应用可能无法显示权限请求或接收操作结果，导致需要相关权限的功能无法使用。

en.description: When an app opens an article URL with Klinker's Android Article Viewer, this Activity fetches and displays the article. If the page cannot be parsed as an article, it opens the URL in a browser custom tab.
en.disableEffect: The app's Klinker article reader will not open, so article reading through that screen is unavailable.

zh-CN.description: 应用使用 Klinker Android Article Viewer 打开文章链接时，此 Activity 会获取并显示文章；如果页面无法解析为文章，则会在浏览器自定义标签页中打开链接。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用的 Klinker 文章阅读页面将无法打开，用户不能通过该页面阅读文章。

en.description: When an app opens an article image with Klinker's Android Article Viewer, this Activity loads the image URL into a full-screen, swipe-away image view.
en.disableEffect: Images opened through the article viewer will no longer display in its image screen.

zh-CN.description: 应用通过 Klinker Android Article Viewer 打开文章图片时，此 Activity 会加载图片链接，并以可滑动关闭的全屏视图显示图片。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过文章阅读器打开的图片将无法在其图片页面中显示。

en.description: When the app opens Klinker's Giphy Search picker, it loads trending GIFs or stickers, searches entered terms, and downloads a selected item to the configured location.
en.disableEffect: The app's GIF and sticker picker will not open, so users cannot search for or download items from it.

zh-CN.description: 应用打开 Klinker Giphy 搜索选择器时，它会加载热门 GIF 或贴纸、搜索输入的内容，并将选中的项目下载到指定位置。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用的 GIF 和贴纸选择器将无法打开，用户不能在其中搜索或下载内容。

en.description: When a user chooses a typed response in the Klinker Wear Reply flow, this Activity accepts the text and returns it to the calling screen.
en.disableEffect: Typing a response from the wearable reply screen will no longer work.

zh-CN.description: 用户在 Klinker Wear Reply 流程中选择输入文字时，此 Activity 会接收文本并将其返回给调用页面。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法在可穿戴设备回复流程中输入文字回复。

en.description: When the app asks Klinker Wear Reply to compose a wearable notification reply, this Activity offers preset responses, voice recognition, or typed text and returns the selected response to the app.
en.disableEffect: Preset, voice, and typed replies from that wearable reply screen will no longer be available.

zh-CN.description: 应用使用 Klinker Wear Reply 编写可穿戴设备通知回复时，此 Activity 会提供预设回复、语音识别或文字输入，并将选中的回复返回给应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 该可穿戴设备回复页面中的预设、语音和文字回复功能都将无法使用。

en.description: The MetaKeep Android SDK opens this Activity when the app begins browser-based authentication; it launches the sign-in page and returns the success or cancellation result to the app.
en.disableEffect: MetaKeep authentication cannot complete, so app features that require that sign-in may be unavailable.

zh-CN.description: 应用通过 MetaKeep Android SDK 发起浏览器认证时会打开此 Activity；它会启动登录页面，并将成功或取消结果交回应用。
zh-CN.disableEffect: MetaKeep 认证无法完成，因此依赖该登录流程的应用功能可能无法使用。

en.description: When a browser returns through the MetaKeep SDK's configured Android link, this Activity forwards the returned link to the SDK authentication screen to complete sign-in.
en.disableEffect: The browser return cannot reach the app, so MetaKeep authentication may remain incomplete.

zh-CN.description: 浏览器通过 MetaKeep SDK 配置的 Android 链接返回时，此 Activity 会将返回链接交给 SDK 的认证页面以完成登录。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 浏览器返回链接无法交回应用，MetaKeep 认证流程可能无法完成。

en.description: TrueNight's RxInApps Google Play billing library opens this transparent Activity for a purchase request; it launches Play's purchase confirmation and processes the returned purchase result.
en.disableEffect: In-app purchases and purchase restoration through this library cannot complete, so paid content may not unlock.

zh-CN.description: TrueNight 的 RxInApps Google Play 应用内购库会在发起购买时打开此 Activity，启动 Play 购买确认页面并处理返回的购买结果。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 通过此库进行的应用内购买和购买恢复无法完成，付费内容可能无法解锁。

en.description: The vfhhu AndroidLib toolkit opens this Activity with a permission request; it requests supported runtime permissions and offers retry or exit choices when access is denied.
en.disableEffect: The app may be unable to request permissions through this screen, preventing features that need that access from working.

zh-CN.description: vfhhu AndroidLib 工具库会在应用发起权限请求时打开此 Activity；它申请支持的运行时权限，并在用户拒绝时提供重试或退出选项。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用可能无法通过此页面申请权限，导致需要相关访问权限的功能无法使用。

en.description: Zendesk Belvedere uses this Provider to make selected files available to attachment and sharing features, so the support app or receiving app can open them.
en.disableEffect: Attaching or sharing files may fail because the app can no longer provide the selected file.

zh-CN.description: Zendesk Belvedere 通过此 Provider 向附件和分享功能提供选中的文件，使支持应用或接收应用能够打开它们。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 应用无法再提供选中的文件，添加附件或分享文件可能会失败。

en.description: The Zendesk Messaging SDK opens this screen when the app starts a support conversation. It displays the conversation and message composer and handles navigation within the chat.
en.disableEffect: Users will not be able to open or use the Zendesk support conversation.

zh-CN.description: 应用启动客服对话时，Zendesk Messaging SDK 会打开此页面，显示对话和消息输入框，并处理聊天内的页面导航。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 用户将无法打开或使用 Zendesk 客服对话。

en.description: YooMoney's YooKassa payments SDK binds this background worker when its device-fingerprinting checks need to run. It supplies device signals used during payment security checks.
en.disableEffect: The payment security checks cannot use this worker, so a payment that depends on its device signals may fail.

zh-CN.description: YooMoney 的 YooKassa 支付 SDK 会在需要执行设备指纹检查时连接此后台工作服务。它提供支付安全检查所用的设备信号。
zh-CN.disableEffect: 支付安全检查无法使用此服务，依赖其设备信号的付款可能会失败。
